Random Ingredients: blackberry,chocolate,beef tenderloin steak,vegetarian bacon,taco seasoning mix,romaine lettuce,tart apple,salad dressing
title: Apple & Blackberry Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1/2 lb beef tenderloin steak, trimmed | 1 envelope taco seasoning mix | 1/2 cup vegetarian bacon, cooked and crumbled | 1/2 lb tart apple, chopped ( about 1 small ) | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh blackberries | 1/2 cup ripe rindless blackberries | 2 tablespoons low-fat salad dressing | 3/4 cup light mayonnaise or 3/4 cup vegetarian mayonnaise | 4 tablespoons herbed shaved dark-marmal bacon ( about 2 slices ) or 4 teaspoons crumbled cooked deli ham ( about 2 slices )
instructions: Trim excess fat from steak.

title: Crispy-Crispy Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: cooking spray | 2 beef tenderloin | 14 ounces spaghetti | 2 tablespoons vegetable shortening | 1 teaspoon dried mint | 1 large hard-boiled egg
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Lightly spray a shallow 1 1/2 quart casserole dish. In a saucepan, heat shortening and mint over medium high heat, stirring constantly, until melted. Cut a 1/4 inch deep slice from the beef with a sharp knife and discard outer shells. Arrange beef in prepared casserole dish. Brush cut side of beef with melted shortening and mint mixture. Wrap beef in cheesecloth and secure with toothpicks. Cut 2 eggs into wedges and arrange on top. Bake 35 - 40 minutes or until beef is browned. Let stand 10 minutes before slicing.

Random Ingredients: spiracha chili sauce,spaghetti,kasseri cheese,malt vinegar,carrot,italian tomato
title: Spicy Italian Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti | 4 carrots, grated | 1 can italian diced tomatoes | 1 cup kasseri cheese, shredded | 2 tablespoons malt vinegar | spiracha chili sauce
instructions: Cook spaghetti in boiling water for about 7 minutes or according to package directions to al dente. Add carrots to cooked spaghetti. To the spaghetti, add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Serve hot over hot spaghetti.

Random Ingredients: ricotta cheese,walnut,farfalle pasta,ketchup,self rising flour,sesame oil,cabbage,red chili
title: Cheese and Walnut Pasta Salad
ingredients: 250 g farfalle pasta, dry and broken into large bite sized pieces | 1 red chili, chopped ( or a red chili of your choice ) | 1/2 head cabbage, finely shredded | 200 g ricotta cheese | 1/2 bunch walnuts, shelled | 1 cup self-rising flour | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 tablespoon ketchup
instructions: Cook the pasta in lightly salted boiling water for 8 minutes according to the directions on pack. Drain well and place in a mixing bowl. Toss the chilli, shredded cabbage, ricotta and the walnuts together. Sprinkle over the flour and stir the mixture until all ingredients are thoroughly combined. Heat a little sesame oil in a frying pan, place the bowl of pasta over a medium heat and cook, stirring regularly, for about 4 minutes until the mixture has slightly thickened slightly. Add the ketchup, then immediately toss through the warm pasta mixture. Season. Enjoy.

title: The Ultimate Nutter Meatball and Red Chili
ingredients: 2 tablespoons espresso coffee | 12 ounces of your favorite dark beer ( corona or ancho premium ) or 12 ounces budweiser beer ( corona or ancho premium ) | 1 jar of your favorite red chili, chopped ( green chili-jalapeno ) | 1 whole jalapeno, stemmed, seeded and finely chopped ( remove seeds if desired ) | chili-garlic infused espresso grinder ( optional )
instructions: Put the espresso in a large skillet. Stir in one of the cans of beer while the coffee heats up. Once the coffee is simmering, remove from the heat. Add the chili and jalapenos to the skillet and stir to coat with the coffee mixture. Add the espresso mixture to the skillet. Cook, breaking up the beer, just until the chili thickens. Pour into a pitcher. Serve in bowls or glasses topped with your choice of freshly chopped jalapenos and shaved black olives or sliced green onions. Note, i like to use a mini food processor to make the chili really runny. Also, the beer can adds some to the chili while the beer cooks, reducing its carbonated beverage to approximately 32 ounces total.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,cheddar cheese,bleu cheese salad dressing,alfredo sauce,artichoke,mango,italian breadcrumb,pace picante sauce
title: Mango Artichoke Pizza
ingredients: 2 cups italian breadcrumbs | 2 cups bleu cheese salad dressing | 2 cups shredded cheddar cheese | 1 cup chopped frozen artichoke | 1/2 cup diced mango | 1 cup diced ripe avocado | 1/2 cup pace picante sauce | 1 cup sour cream or 1 cup greek yogurt
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Mix together bread crumbs, bleu cheese, cheddar cheese, artichoke, mango and avocado. Place in large bowl and lightly combine. Combine picante sauce and sour cream. Pour over bread mixture. Bake 20 minutes then top with fresh fruit or cheddar. Bake 10 minutes longer or until it is bubbly. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: vermouth,red pepper,black tea leaf,cointreau liqueur,black bean,chicken tender
title: Cuban Black Bean-Chicken Salad
ingredients: 4 chicken tenders | 1/2 bottle dry vermouth or 1/2 bottle white rum | 1/4 cup cointreau liqueur or 1/4 cup orange juice | 1 1/2 teaspoons black tea leaves | 1 1/2 teaspoons red peppers, chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons black beans, cooked and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Remove any plastic from chicken tenders, and cut each into 2 to 4 pieces. Arrange the chicken on a rack in a baking dish, and bake or bake according to package directions, or just until juices run clear, and chicken begins to brown on each piece. Set chicken aside to cool, then slice chicken into strips. Dissolve the cognac or orange juice in a small saucepan over medium heat, and stir in the cointreau and black tea leaves. Pour boiling liquid over chicken, and bring to a simmer. Reduce heat to low, cover and cook until mixture is reduced by half, about 5 minutes. Rinse black bean and red pepper in a small bowl, and drain. Add to the saucepan, and continue cooking until heated through, about 1 minute. Spoon black bean mixture onto plates, and top with strips of chicken.

title: Turkish Lentils With Pomegranate and Mint.
ingredients: 1/2 cup pomegranate | 1 tablespoon chili paste | 1/2 cup lentils | 1 small fresh mint sprig
instructions: Bring 2 - 5 cups of water to a boil in a medium pot. Rinse and drain the lentils. Stir in the pomegranate, chili paste and chopped mint. Cover and cook over medium low heat for about 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until lentils are soft and cooked but not mushy. Serve warm with pita bread.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,spice,mustard seed,star anise,french mustard,black pepper,red chili powder
title: Bombay Spice Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups french mustard | 4 teaspoons mustard seeds | 2 teaspoons mixed spice | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon whole star anise, crushed | 3/4 teaspoon black pepper | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 -3 teaspoon finely ground red chili powder ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Store in refrigerator.

title: Butterscotch Chips (For Fingers)
ingredients: 1/2 lb butterscotch chips, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons butterscotch chips ( unsalted ) or 2 tablespoons semisweet chocolate chips ( unsalted )
instructions: Preheat and generously butter 9 x 11 glass baking dish. Combine butterscotch chips and 2 tbsp butterscotch chips in medium bowl. Mixture should be the consistency of course meal. Spread mixture in prepared dish. Using hands, press chips into choc chip mixture and sprinkle evenly with remaining 1 tbsp butterscotch chips. Press plastic wrap onto top of chip, pressing down well to get even coating. Refrigerate 3 hours, or overnight if desired.

Random Ingredients: green zucchini,turmeric powder,white wine vinegar,onion flake,hot chili pepper,deli roast beef,meatball,coriander seed
title: Roast Beef and Vegetables
ingredients: 1 lb deli roast beef, sliced | 16 medium meatballs | 1/2 cup dry white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons dried onion flakes | 1 tablespoon whole coriander seed | 2 hot chili peppers, cut into large pices | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 green zucchini, thinly sliced
instructions: Combine all and marinate beef and vegetables in the refrigerator in a ziploc bag for up to two days, turning periodically. Drain beef and vegetables, reserving marinade and beef juices. Grill or barbeque meat until no longer pink & cooked through. Serve with sauce of your choice.

title: Bitter Melon and Sweet Tomato Glaze for Pork or Beef
ingredients: 2 bitter melons ( known as `` deribbon melon '' in vietnamese if available ) | 1 lb pork shoulder or 1 lb stewing pork, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 1 cup canned diced tomato | 2 teaspoons instant espresso powder | 2 teaspoons cider vinegar | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon freshly ground espresso powder
instructions: Cut bitter melons crosswise into 1/4 slices, discarding ends. If the flesh is very bitter, you can easily grind it into a paste with your fingernail. Combine bitter melon slices and pork in a bowl. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over pork. Mix well. Cover and chill overnight. Bring to room temperature before serving. You can also freeze the pork glaze for up to 6 months.

title: North African leg of lamb (Arak)
ingredients: 1 lamb leg | 1/2 teaspoon harissa
instructions: Clean the lamb. Heat a heavy skillet on medium heat. Add the lamb. Coat it with harissa. Sear the lamb on both sides to flavor. Turn the lamb over once or twice until it is a rich, browned crust. Serve the lamb with kibbee.

title: Mango Fritters
ingredients: 2 mangoes | 1 cup soft breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup wine vinegar | 1/2 cup ice cream
instructions: Peel mangoes and cut into medium dice. Place in bowl. Add breadcrumbs and vinegar. Mix well. Fill pices with mixture and press down with hands. Deep fry until crisp and golden. Serve immediately.

title: Blueberry Mint and Blueberry Parfait
ingredients: 1/4 cup currants or 1/4 cup apricot preserves | 4 cups cracked wheat | 3 cups fresh blueberries | 1/4 cup of fresh mint, chopped or 1/4 cup of fresh mint, chopped
instructions: Gently warm 1/4 cup currants in a small saucepan over low heat until they are completely softened, 2 - 3 minutes. Transfer the currants to a large mixing bowl. Set aside. Add 2 cups cracked wheat to the cracked wheat and mix gently with a fork. Transfer the cracked wheat to the bowl with the currants. Gently fold the wheat into the wheat mixture with the blueberries and mint. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Using wet hands, shape the mixture into marble sized patties, about 2 inches in diameter, and slightly smaller than the original recipe. Place in the freezer. Cover and freeze until firm, 2 hours to 3 hours depending on the freezer. To serve, let stand at room temperature about 5 minutes or in a medium size bowl, stirring. Transfer to a serving platter and serve warm.

title: Classic Italian Bread
ingredients: 1 baguette | 5 eggs | 2 tablespoons cumin powder | 1/4 cup pecorino cheese, grated
instructions: Prick bread all over with a fork and bake in 300f oven for 20 minutes. Beat eggs well, then stir in remaining ingredients. When bread is done, remove from oven and add cheese to it. Return to oven until the cheese is melted and a nice crusty loaf is formed.

title: Spicy Steak
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs of leftover prime rib steak, cut into thin slices 3/4 inch thick | 1 can stewed tomatoes | 1 teaspoon salad oil | 3/4 teaspoon mustard seeds, crushed | 1 whole vanilla bean, split lengthwise
instructions: Combine all sauce ingredients in a 5 to 6 qt slow cooker. Tie the roast with kitchen string or two paper towels and place atop the sauce. Cover and cook on low for 7 to 8 hours or on high for 5 to 7 1/2 hours until sauce is reduced by half and thickened. Remove the roast to a platter and keep warm. Skim off any fat from the sauce.

Random Ingredients: chipotle pepper,creole seasoning,nutritional yeast,chicken bouillon,bay leaf,spaghetti
title: Creamy Chipotle Spaghetti Sauce
ingredients: 1 can chipotle peppers, or to taste | 1 1/2 teaspoons creole-style seasoning | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon | 2 teaspoons dried parsley in snipped parsley | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried chipotle powder ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons nutritional yeast ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups drained spaghetti, or as desired ( optional )
instructions: Stir chilies, creole style seasoning, bouillon, parsley, and chipotle powder together in a bowl.

title: PintÒs Fondue
ingredients: 1 cup yellow lentils | 1/2 cup picante sauce | 3/4 cup crumbled gorgonzola
instructions: Combine the yellow lentils, picante sauce and gorgonzola in a saucepan and bring to a slow simmer over medium heat. Simmer for 15 minutes. Remove from the heat and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: anaheim chilies,canola oil,head cabbage,kirby cucumber,purple onion,asparagus spear
title: Asparagus and Cabbage
ingredients: 1 head cabbage, thinly sliced | 1 cup purple onion, sliced and divided into rings | 2 teaspoons canola oil | 2 anaheim chilies, sliced | 2 kirby cucumbers, thinly sliced | 8 asparagus spears, trimmed and halved lengthwise
instructions: In a large bowl, combine cabbage, 1/2 cup onions, and 2 teaspoons oil and mix well. Cover cabbage with plastic wrap and refrigerate 1 1/2 hours. Meanwhile, grill asparagus until crisp tender, 5 to 8 minutes. Remove asparagus and onions from plastic wrap and place on a plate. Cover and set aside. In a small skillet, saute remaining 1 1/2 cups onions in oil for 7 minutes over medium low heat. Place cabbage, 1/2 cup onions, chilies, and cucumber slices in a bowl. Top with onions. Serve remaining cabbage on the side.

title: Tropical Kiwifruit Patties
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 1 kiwi fruit, peeled, cored and sliced
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the ground beef and the kiwifruit. Form into patties, about 2 tablespoons each, and freeze on waxed paper in an airtight container. To defrost, place in the freezer until frozen, about 10 minutes. Meanwhile, preheat the barbecue on medium heat. Remove meat patties from the freezer, reserving liquid and grilling liquid in the original container. Cook over medium heat until no pink remains, turning once. Slice the meat and serve on a platter. Serve hot with a green salad.

title: Egg and Parmesan Parfait
ingredients: 4 hard-boiled eggs | 3 tablespoons parmesan cheese, grated | 1 tablespoon currants ( optional ) or 1 tablespoon dried cranberries ( optional )
instructions: To make parmesan, cut eggs in half lengthwise and scoop out the yolks. Rinse the halves, then crack them into a small bowl with a paring knife or a fork. Beat the yolks, cheese and currants together with a large spoon until well combined. Mound about 1/4 cup of the cheese mixture into each half shell. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes at 350 degrees f or until the egg is set. Serve warm with some seasonal salad leaves.

Random Ingredients: vegetable,mustard seed,soda water,water,tabasco sauce,chunky salsa,heavy cream,red lentil
title: Quick & Easy Indian-Style Soda Bread
ingredients: 1/2 cup red lentil | 1/4 cup water | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped mixed vegetables | 1/2 cup chunky salsa, or to taste | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons shredded sharp cheddar cheese blend | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1 tablespoon tabasco sauce | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1/4 cup soda water, or as needed
instructions: Place lentils in a large saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium low.

title: Korean Spam Meatballs
ingredients: 1/2 cup sesame seeds | 4 large egg whites
instructions: In a small bowl soak sesame seeds in water until the water is completely absorbed. Combine the soaked sesame seeds with egg whites until the mixture is a smooth consistency, about 10 minutes. Form 2 tablespoon sized balls and drop into korean korean marinade. Place a kebab skewer on grill rack over medium high heat and char meatballs, turning to coat evenly with the korean marinade.

title: Easiest Tandoori Vegetable Broth
ingredients: 2 cups finely chopped frozen mixed vegetables ( broccoli, cauliflower, carrots ) | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Heat the broth in a 2 quart sauce pan. Add the vegetables. Sprinkle with turmeric.

title: Spinach, Brussels Sprouts and French Bread Salad
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon saffron threads | 2 lbs french bread | 1 lb brussels sprout ( sliced into rings ) | 4 tablespoons salad oil | assorted mixed salad oil
instructions: Place the saffron threads in a small bowl, add 3 cups warm water to dissolve the threads. Soak over direct heat 10 minutes, stirring to avoid scorching. Cut the day old french bread into 1/4 inch slices and place in the bowl with the saffron water. Set aside. Trim the ends from the brussels sprouts and slice the brussels sprouts. In a large bowl toss all of the sprouts with the mixed salad oil and drained saffron water. Pour half of the salad oil on the bottom and side of the french bread slice to cover the bottom. Slice the slices of the rest of the french bread and arrange over the sprouts. Cover with more salad oil and saffron water, and top with more slivers if desired. Bake in a 350 oven for 30 minutes, or until the bread turns a golden brown color and is slightly crisp and crunchy.

Random Ingredients: burrito flour tortilla,monterey jack pepper cheese,ramen noodle
title: Cheesy Ramen Burritos
ingredients: 1 package burrito-size flour tortilla | 3 ounces monterey jack pepper cheese, sliced | 1 package crispy fried tofu
instructions: Prepare the burritos and fry in a pan sprayed with cooking spray for about 10 minutes on med/high. Heat up 1/4 cup of monterey jack cheese and fry in pan with 2 oz of crispy tofu. Heat and serve.

title: Potato Chips #5FIX
ingredients: 2 packages simply potatoes diced potatoes with onion | 6 cups nonstick cooking spray
instructions: Heat oven to 450/f degrees. Grease a large baking sheet. In a large mixing bowl combine potatoes, onion and spray. Mix well with a fork until ingredients are blended. Bake for 20 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes, until potatoes are crispy and browned.

Random Ingredients: green chile pepper lengthwise,ziti pasta,marjoram,garam masala,red potato,bitter melon
title: Indian Bitter Melon and Ziti Salad
ingredients: 4 bitter melon, peeled and chopped | 6 cloves garlic, peeled | 8 green chile peppers, halved lengthwise | 1 pint ziti pasta | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the bitter melons, garlic, green chile peppers and ziti pasta to the boiling water.

Random Ingredients: mint,chicken bouillon cube,cilantro leaf,pam cooking spray,liquid smoke,blueberry,cornflour
title: Blueberry Mint-Cilantro-Cilantro Blend
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons cornflour | 3/4 cup fresh blueberries ( about 2oz ) | 8 stalks fresh cilantro leaves | 1 1/4 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon cube, dissolved in | 1/3 cup boiling water | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke | fresh mint, leaves, to serve ( optional )
instructions: Place blueberries, cilantro leaves, chicken base and boiling water into a small saucepan. Over low heat, stir to combine all. Simmer, uncovered, about 15 minutes or until the liquid is slightly reduced. Stir in liquid smoke and mint leaves, if using. Serve warm or cold, with fresh mint leaves alongside.

title: Grilled Steak for Cheese
ingredients: 3 lbs beef eye round | 1 cup grated mexican cheese | shredded parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Spray a grill rack with non stick cooking spray and heat it until very hot, about 10 minutes. Cut the steak into serving portions about 1/2 inch thick, each portion having some meat on the side of the steak. Sprinkle both sides of the steak with shredded cheese and cover with a kitchen towel so any excess moisture drains from the steaks. Set the steaks on the rack and grill 5 minutes on each side.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,double cream,guinness stout,provolone cheese
title: Quick and Easy Guinness and Provolone Cheese Dessert
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 24 slices provolone cheese ( or similar cheese, depending on size of bowl size ) | 24 slices provolone cheese | 1 pint guinness stout
instructions: Prepare idahoan signature™ russets mashed potatoes according to package directions with plenty of salt and no fat, or until smooth in texture, stirring every 5 - 6 minutes. Spray pam in 12 inch lodge cast iron skillet and place over medium high heat. Place 1 piece of provolone diagonally across top of each piece of provolone then press in gently. The provolone will melt and become pliable. When the cheese starts to melt, top one slice of provolone with a piece of provolone, and place 1 more slice of provolone in the center. Using two spatulas, fold one side of the cheese over the top of the provolone, gently pressing down on the cheese. Repeat to make 12 more layers of cheese, ending with a layer of provolone on top and pressing down lightly. Heat reserved guinness in a 1 quart saucepan over high heat until almost boiling.

title: Scallops in Mustard Tauphine
ingredients: 12 large scallops | 1/2 cup dry mustard powder | 1/4 cup sifted fresh thyme sprig | 1 1/2 cups dry wine | 1 tablespoon fennel seed, crushed | 2 tablespoons dried cilantro leaves | 36 ladyfingers | 1/4 cup tahini
instructions: Rinse scallops. Heat heavy large pot with wide handle. Coat with cooking spray and add scallops to pot.

title: Gingered Popcorn (For Pastry)
ingredients: 1/2 cup stone ground corn | 1 teaspoon anise extract | 1/3 teaspoon ginger powder | 1/3 teaspoon black pepper | 1/3 cup white flour
instructions: Combine corn, anise extract, ginger powder, and pepper in a mixing bowl. Mix until thoroughly combined. Gradually add the white flour and mix until the mixture comes together to form dough. Wrap dough in plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 3 hours at room temperature. Preheat the oven to 425°f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and spray with nonstick cooking spray. Form the pastry into a log about 1 1/2 inch in diameter. Gently transfer the log onto the prepared paper. Bake for 15 minutes or until lightly golden.

title: Herbs and Scented Kumquats (Kumquat Snack)
ingredients: 1 kg kumquats | chopped fresh herbs ( to taste )
instructions: Wash, peel and soak the kumquats in boiling water. Remove the stems, and then pat out the flesh. You want about 5 centimeters thick. Cut into chunks. Sterilise the kumquats with the optional herbs. Variation, for extra flavour, add a little dried herbs or a sprinkle of lemon peel. Variation, for a slightly different flavour, use chopped fresh herbs and/or chives.

title: Curried Chicken Hashbrowns
ingredients: 4 lbs chicken parts, with skin | 3 teaspoons curry powder | 4 cups frozen hash browns, thawed | 1 1/2 cups pomegranate juice | 1/4 cup amaretto | 4 -5 dashes tequila
instructions: In a large frypan put in a tablespoon of oil, 2/3 cup potato and 1/2 cup of curry, stir fry until golden brown and crisp. Put in a bowl with remaining curry and chicken and allow to cool a bit. Take 1/4 cup of the pomegranate juice and pour it over chicken and potatoes. Add as much as you like but do not mix too much. Mix so you have a smooth marinade. Marinate chicken in this for about 30 minutes. This is a great over the counter as is or with a pot of your favourite curry, a good lunch or dessert.

title: BBQ Chicken Wings - Macadamia Nut
ingredients: 24 chicken wings | 2 tablespoons soya sauce | 1/4 cup hazelnuts, crushed | 2 tablespoons ground pepper | 1/2 cup chopped mixed herbs | 2 hoagie rolls
instructions: Heat up some olive oil and add your wings, cooking over medium high heat until golden brown, stir frequently. Remove from pan and cool. Place all other ingredients except hoagie rolls in a pan and stir well as you add your cooled wings to make a sauce. Return wings to pan, cook until heated through. Place your hoagie rolls on a clean baking sheet, drizzle over the honey sauce and serve warm.

title: Makrati Halwa
ingredients: 300 g plain yogurt ( strained to remove excess moisture. ) | 1/2 tablespoon margarine
instructions: Line a baking tray with aluminium foil. Whip the yogurt until smooth. Add margarine. Spread the mixture on the baking tray. Place in a preheated 180 degree celsius oven. After 15 minutes, check the center of the mixture with a palette knife. If the mixture is browning, the excess liquid will run out.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,parsley leaf,duck,salt pepper,cream cheese
title: Duck Rolls-Sauce
ingredients: 1 duck ( the whole duck ) | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce ( or light soy sauce ) | salt and pepper | 200 g cream cheese | 2 sprigs parsley leaves
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c/400°f/gas the oven is good too preheat all your other ingredients in a skillet, and mix together with the duck on a board. Use a meat mallet to grind the duck very thinly across the board. It usually does this while it is being pounded. Spread the cream cheese evenly across the duck skin, and roll the duck up, securing it tightly with a sausage or tooth pick. The duck should be approximately 5cm long and slightly raised in the middle. Place the roll on an oven tray with a good lid. Repeat until all of your duck or stuffing has been used. Bake the duck for 15 minutes, turning once during baking. Serve with your favourite side dishes. These can also be eaten with roasted veg like carrots and asparagus or zucchini.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,snow pea,jalapeno pepper,mexican cheese,green grape
title: Jalapeno Peas & Snow Peas
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh snow peas ( not frozen ) | 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded and chopped | 2 cups shredded mexican blend cheese | 1 tablespoon garlic powder | 1 cup slivered green seedless grape
instructions: Prepare jalapeno pepper for pepper flakes, according to directions. Set aside during pre heat. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add snow peas, cook 2 minutes, drain. Preheat broiler. In a large bowl, combine snow peas, jalapeno, cheese, garlic powder and reserved pepper flakes with cheese mixture. Spray a 12”x9”x2” glass baking dish with non stick cooking spray. Spoon filling into prepared dish. Broil 5 to 7 inches from heat for 2 to 3 minutes, or until cheese is bubbly. Remove from oven. Immediately sprinkle with remaining cheese. Broil 2 to 3 minutes or until cheese is bubbly.

title: Ceviche
ingredients: 1 fresh anaheim chilies, seeded or 2 dried anaheim chilies | 1/2 cup pomegranate molasses ( or treacle )
instructions: Heat a cast iron skillet or grill over high heat. Lightly mist the skillet with cooking spray or brush with a small amount of vegetable oil. Fry the pepper for about about 1 minute per side, or until it is golden brown.

title: Taquitos II
ingredients: 2 ears corn oil | 1 package corn tortilla chips
instructions: First, take the ears and cut off the top so it will stay flat and hold it steady with sharp knife. Slice off some of the ear from the corn husk so it will stick out of the center of the ear of corn to expose the kernels to the water and place into a colander to drain for about 30 minutes. Then, using the blade of your knife, start cutting the kernels off of the cob and into the corn cob until you have the desired amount of water. In a deep frying pan, or cast iron skillet, heat the corn oil until the entire can is hot enough for frying. Test one to see if the oil is ready by dropping one corn tortilla into the oil, it should give off a slightly flattened ball. If the tortillas are done, they will brown a little but should not be quite completely cooked. Use a slotted spoon to remove the tortillas from the oil and place in a large paper bag until ready for use. When all the tortillas are done, put them in a bowl with some of the oil from the oil and gently push to the sides so they hold their shape and the tortillas cook quickly. When the tortillas are slightly golden, remove them with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels to drain any juice. Serve hot, with sour cream on the side.

title: Pan-Fried Pork Tenderloins With Strawberries in Cream
ingredients: 8 ounces pork tenderloin, trimmed | 1 pint double cream, whipped | 1/2 cup corn flakes, crushed | 12 fresh strawberries ( to garnish )
instructions: Remove fat from pork under running water and cut into 3 - 4 chunks. Set aside. In a large bowl, whisk the cream with 1/4 t.Salt and corn flakes, add pork and mix well. Cover and refrigerate at least 6 hrs or overnight. Drain pork well, pat dry and sprinkle over fruit, turning to coat. Cover and refrigerate at least 12 hrs or overnight. Preheat wok over high heat until very hot. Add remaining 1 t. Flavored cream. Swirl pork to coat and reduce heat to low. Cook, covered, for 15 minutes, turning occasionally or until pork is tender but not crisp. Transfer to an oven proof dish. Let rest 3 minutes and serve over hot rice or noodles, garnish with parsley. Serve with strawberry sauce if desired.

title: Pork & Chocolate Phyllo Bickies
ingredients: 4 pork cutlets | 1 package sweetened condensed milk chocolate chips | 1 package phyllo pastry | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric, ground | 1/4 teaspoon msg ( optional )
instructions: Thaw phyllo pastry sheets slightly before using. Slice pastries into approximately 1/8 inch wide strips. Coat meat with a thin layer of sauce ingredients to coat meat evenly. Lay meat over phyllo strips, being careful not to let the dough touch the bottom layer. Fold over meat once over and brush with butter. Bake at 350°f for about 25 minutes or until meat is cooked. Add 1/4c water to the pan if not using right away. Slice diagonally.

title: Green-Topped Spaghetti
ingredients: 2 cans spaghetti sauce | 1 large poblano chile, seeded and diced | 1 package frozen meatballs, thawed, cut into chunks | 1/2 bunch green beans, trimmed | 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 2 tablespoons gin
instructions: Combine spaghetti sauce and poblano in slow cooker. Cut green beans in half and remove strings and strings with scissors, leaving 2 inches at ends and 2 inches around ends of beans. Place meatballs in crockpot.

title: Pixie Dust
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | skewers
instructions: If you can, dry fry the cayenne flakes in a small nonstick skillet over medium heat for about 10 seconds or until fragrant. If you're wearing two wooden sticks, use a pastry brush, followed by a pastry brush. If your skillet is not nonstick, then you can rub the cayenne off the flakes before wrapping in foil. When you are wrapping the foil wrapped candy, you can seal shut the entire package and store in a dry airtight container.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower floret,leg lamb,cannellini bean,heavy whipping cream,mint leaf,picante sauce,sparerib
title: Creamy Lamb and Cauliflower Fajita Recipe
ingredients: 1 cup picante sauce | 1 tablespoon minced mint leaf | 8 ounces cooked cannellini beans | 12 ounces dried cannellini beans | 2 1/2 lbs boneless leg of lamb, cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces | 1 head cauliflower floret | heavy whipping cream
instructions: Heat picante sauce in medium saucepan over med heat until hot, about 1 min. Discard mint. Add 1 tbsp chili powder to remaining picante sauce and stir well. Stir in cannellini beans, beans, lamb, and cauliflower. Cover and simmer until lamb is cooked through, about 30 minutes. While lamb and cauliflower mixture is simmering, remove any string from cauliflower floret. Cook cauliflower until just tender and remove from heat. Pour lamb and sauce into serving bowl. Toss with cauliflower floret mixture.

title: Lettuce and Raisins Salad
ingredients: 1 head lettuce, chopped | 3/4 cup white raisins
instructions: Steam the raisins in water for 2 minutes. Place lettuce into a bowl, add raisins and mix. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: granny smith apple,roasting chicken,canola oil,beef broth,italian sausage,purslane,green onion
title: Green apple turkey with beurre manie
ingredients: 4 green onions, chopped ( can use all parts ) | 1/2 lb boneless smoked italian sausage, sliced | 1 1/2 cups beurre manie ( french onion soup, recipe id # 24952 ) | 1 1/2 cups beef broth | 1 roasting chickens, cut up | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 granny smith apple, peeled and sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Remove all fat from chicken. Wrap chicken in net and poke holes all over with fork. Place in roasting pan and roast for 20 minutes. Remove from oven and tent with aluminum foil. Pour beurre manie over top and return to oven. Bake for 40 minutes. Remove foil and top with sliced beurre mani, broth, and apple.

title: Easy Curried Pasta
ingredients: 15 ounces pasta sauce ( i like classico ) | 19 ounces kidney beans ( drained, i use one 16 oz. can ) | 1/3 cup purple onion, diced | 2 tablespoons curry
instructions: Saute onions until translucent. Add curry and garlic. Add beans. Simmer until ready. Serve over your favorite pasta you have on hand.

title: Radish Tea
ingredients: 3 radishes, shredded | 4 cans carbonated lemonade concentrate
instructions: Combine radishes, lemonade concentrate and 2 cups of the hot water in a large container. Cover and let stand for 3 hours before using.

title: Onion Salad
ingredients: 1 small onion, about 3 ounces, peeled and sliced | 2 cups watercress leaves, packed and washed | 2 tablespoons custard powder ( see note ) | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne | 2 heads romaine lettuce, packed
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl and gently mix well. Cover tightly and chill several hours to allow flavors to blend, before serving. Notes, custard powder is ammonium carbonate which can be prepared as directed in recipe description but is not meant to be thick. You may use a blender in place of custard powder. It should be a smooth consistency. If it has a thick texture, it is not necessary. If you have a salad spinner, remove any leaves from the lettuce and discard. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl and mix thoroughly. Serve immediately or allow to chill for a few hours, stirring a couple of times to ensure even taste. Note, custard powder can be made up to 3 days ahead and chilled, covered.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,catsup,lemon pepper,toothpick,jasmine rice,tomato green chilies
title: Sweet and Savory Mexican Rice
ingredients: 1 cup jasmine rice, uncooked, rinsed in microwave ( or any long-grain rice ) | 2 cups chopped tomatoes with green chilies | 1/2 cup catsup or 1/2 cup catsup | 1/2 teaspoon lemon pepper | 1 bell pepper ( optional ) | toothpick
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Meanwhile, combine remaining ingredients in large skillet. Stir fry over medium heat until heated throughout. Arrange bell pepper and/or seafood on top of rice. Spoon hot mixture in center of rice.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast fillet,dill,vodka,floury potato,lemon zest,baking potato,vegetable,irish cream
title: Baked Chicken With Irish Potato & Dill Salsa
ingredients: 1 large baking potato, peeled and roughly chopped | 1 large lemon, zest of, grated finely | 1/4 cup dried mixed mushrooms | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill | 1 cup vegetable or 1 cup vegetable stock, may need up to 1/2 cup | 300 g floury potatoes, quartered | 6 chicken breast fillets, skin removed | 1/4 cup vodka ( optional ) or 1/4 cup cognac ( optional ) | 150 ml irish cream ( optional )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 400°f. Place potato, zest, mushrooms and dill in a large ovenproof bowl and pour over enough vor so that the potato is covered on a baking sheet. Cover with a slightly damp towel and leave to stand for 10 - 15 minutes. Remove the potato mixture from the bowl and toss in the rest of the ingredients. Place chicken on the prepared baking sheet and bake for 30 - 35 minutes, until chicken is cooked. Serve with irish potato & dill salsa, if desired.

title: Finnish Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless beef chuck roast | 4 yukon gold potatoes, scrubbed
instructions: Clean and wash the potatoes and cut off the ends. Cut the roast into large cubes about 1 1/2 by 2 feet. Pour water into a large pot or dutch oven and add the potatoes. Bring to a boil. Cover, lower the heat and cook for 1½ hours or until the meat is very tender. Remove all the ingredients from the pot and set aside in a bowl to cool for about an hour or two. The meat will continue to firm if refrigerated in a covered container. When it has cooled, remove the meat and shred or cut, if you like. Return the meat back to the potatoes and stir until well coated. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: red chile pepper,black peppercorn,chocolate,peppercorn,baby spinach,cinnamon,part mozzarella cheese,celery rib
title: Chocolate Chilli Spinach
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs baby spinach, washed and coarsely chopped | 3 tablespoons coarsely chopped roasted peppercorns, from a jar ( dark ) | 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped celery ribs | 1 tablespoon coarsely chopped red chile pepper | 10 whole black peppercorns | 1 cup shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese, divided | 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon | 2 squares unsweetened chocolate | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon
instructions: Drain and rinse spinach thoroughly, then drain well. Combine peppercorns, celery, chili pepper, peppercorns, 1 1/2 cups cheese, and 2 cups spinach in a large bowl. Mix together remaining 2 cups spinach with the cheese mixture and stir well with a wooden spoon. Spread evenly into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake in a preheated oven at 350°f for about 15 to 20 minutes or until lightly browned. Turn off oven and leave in, covered, for about 3 to 5 minutes. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Stir before serving.

title: Peanut Jelly Mushrooms for Shrimps, Grilled
ingredients: 1/2 lb raw shrimp, shelled, deveined & halved | 1 lb mushroom, such as shitake, caps only | 8 ounces bamboo shoots, drained and cut lengthwise into 1/4 inch slices | 2 packets fish sauce | 2 whole black peppercorns
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to boil& add the shrimp. Boil for 2 minutes and remove shrimp with slotted spoon. Drain shrimp and set aside. Remove mushroom stems from mushrooms& place caps on absorbent paper and set aside. Cut reserved caps into 3/4 1 slices& set aside. Coat mushrooms with fish sauce. Remove peppercorns from can& set aside. Push peppercorns through a sieve. Add caps and peppercorns to seafood& pour liquid into sieve& toss. Let jelly cool& set aside until firm. Slice or break into pieces about the size of shrimp& reserve for later use.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast,baking potato,blackberry,creme de cassis,crescent dinner,dark soy sauce,ginger root,grain mustard
title: Chicken with Blackberry Pies
ingredients: 4 large baking potatoes, scrubbed | 1 cup chopped fresh blackberries | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce, divided | 1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger root | 2 teaspoons ground mustard | 1 1/2 pounds skinless, boneless chicken breast, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 cup crumbled creme de cassis, divided | 1 package refrigerated crescent dinner rolls
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place potatoes, 3/4 cup blackberries, 2 tablespoons soy sauce, ginger root, and mustard in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: english mustard,sumac,orange juice,chunky salsa,flounder fillet,kosher salt
title: Salsa Crusted Fish
ingredients: 4 flounder fillets | 1/2 cup chunky salsa | 1/4 cup orange juice | 1/4 cup fresh orange juice | 2 teaspoons english mustard | 1/8 teaspoon ground sumac | kosher salt, for salting fish
instructions: Prepare salsa by combining all ingredients in a medium sized bowl. Set aside until needed. Season fish with salt and coat evenly on both sides with the salsa. Refrigerate until ready to cook. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Remove fish from refrigerator and drain off excess marinade. Lightly oil a baking dish and coat with nonstick cooking spray. Place fillets on prepared baking dish and bake for 6 to 8 minutes on each side or until fish is golden brown. Serve immediately.

title: Pistachio Rice Balls
ingredients: 2 cups short-grain rice | 2 ripe anjou pears, peeled and finely chopped | 1 cup unsalted pistachios, chopped | 1/2 cup sweet soy sauce | 1/4 cup sweet cherry, drained, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Place rice in bowl of a stand mixer or blender, add enough water to cover rice, cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until rice is cooked, up to 1 hour. To make pistachio spread, in a small bowl, combine pistachios, soy sauce, cherries, and sesame seeds. Spread on your prettiest hard surface and roll/shape rice into a ball, then press together slightly. Repeat procedure with remaining rice with remaining fillings. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Place balls on a baking sheet. Bake until tops of rice are golden brown and crispy, about 30 minutes.

title: Minted Tomato Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 tablespoon corn oil | 18 slices sandwich-style sandwich bun | 1 pint tomato juice | 3 tablespoons fresh mint, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon coarsely chopped peeled romaaine lettuce
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of the oil over medium heat in a medium saucepan, place the bread slices in the pan, and flip to one side. In a small bowl, blend the tomato juice, mint and remaining teaspoon of oil. Pour the tomato mixture over the bread slices, being careful not to spill. Top lightly with coarsely chopped romaaine lettuce. Spread the remaining cup of tomato juice mixture on the bread slices to serve.

title: Holy Guacamole
ingredients: 1 can crushed italian tomatoes | 3 1/2 ounces serrano chili | 4 ounces fresh jalapenos
instructions: Take out the seeds and jalapeños and cut the chilis into 1/4 inch slices. Place all ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth. Pour this mix into a small bowl and add just a little bit of water. Enjoy.

title: Green Prawn Bubble Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce, washed, dried and finely shredded | 1 kg green prawns, shelled, deveined and washed | 100 g shaved roast pork ( deli slices ) | 100 g tabasco sauce
instructions: Mix the lettuce together with the shredded prawns and prawns. Drizzle over tabasco and tabasco sauces.

title: Easy Four-Cheese Burger
ingredients: 3 pounds hamburger, thinly sliced | 4 large leaves provolone cheese, sliced | 1 package provolone cheese, sliced
instructions: Preheat a grill for high heat. Lightly oil the grilling surface. While the grill is heating, thoroughly mix the hamburger, provolone, and provolone. Place the beef mixture on the hot grate, and cook until well done, flipping once.

title: Pizza Sauce II
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried oregano leaves, crushed | 1/2 cup chile pepper, minced
instructions: Combine the oregano, chile peppers, and minced chili pepper in a medium bowl.

Random Ingredients: laughing cow cheese,tomato paste,italian herb seasoning,chili paste garlic,nonstick cooking spray,linguine
title: Linguini With Chili and Cheese
ingredients: 10 ounces linguine | 2 laughing cow cheese, chunks | 1 tablespoon italian herb seasoning | 1 tablespoon chili paste with garlic ( in a pinch garlic powder ) | 1 teaspoon tomato paste | 1/4 cup nonstick cooking spray
instructions: Cook linguini according to package directions, drain. In microwave safe bowl, put the laughing cow cheese chunks so it melts faster, microwave for 3 minutes. Then toss in italian herb seasoning, chili paste, tomato paste and the microwaved linguini until well mixed. Then sprinkle the nonstick spray on top, microwave on high for another 2 minutes. Serve and enjoy.

title: Pizza Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 cup pizza sauce
instructions: Cook pizza sauce according to manufacturer's directions. Remove from heat and stir in cocoa powder. Serve with toppings. Note, recipe should be served at room temperature.

title: Baked Spicy Beef and Apples in Parchment
ingredients: 5 granny smith apples ( about 3 pounds ) | 1 beef bouillon cube
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Slice off top 3/4 pound of beef to release juice. Do not remove rind. With a medium baking sheet, place apple slices at one end of the parchment. Remove as many pieces as possible, but not much as you want. Sprinkle the meat with beef boullion, breaking off pieces of beef as needed but removing any large pieces of that you don't mind eating whole. Place these on the un parchment lined baking sheet with space between each piece of meat. Bake 20/25 minutes, basting once and a while with juices.

Random Ingredients: poppy seed,beef stock,dijon mustard,heavy cream,red chili pepper,peach
title: Beef With Peach Dip
ingredients: 1 lb thinly sliced beef top round or 1 lb beef top rump, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 1/2 cups chopped fresh peaches | 1 cup beef stock | 1 cup heavy cream | 1 tablespoon poppy seed | 2 teaspoons dijon mustard | 2 -3 red chili peppers, sliced thinly
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Place beef, peaches, beef stock, cream, poppy seeds, mustard and chilies in a 6 quart casserole. Cover tightly and bake for 30 minutes. Uncover and bake for an additional 25 to 30 minutes until meat is cooked through. Serve with your choice of buns.

title: Pantry Baking Dough
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1/4 cup olive oil | 2 cups unbleached white bread flour
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup warm water. Let stand until foamy, about 5 minutes stir in olive oil and set aside. Whisk 2 cups flour into yeast mixture and add to flour. Stir until dough is smooth and elastic. Turn out onto a lightly floured surface and knead until elastic and satiny, about 8 - 10 minutes. Place in a sealed container and let rise in a warm place until doubled in volume, about 1 - 2 hours. Deflate dough and turn onto lightly floured surface. Knead dough 5 - 10 times, adding more flour if it is sticky. Place dough in a large buttered bowl and turn to coat with oil. Cover with a towel and let rise until doubled, about 45 minutes. Punch down dough and divide into 2 pieces. Roll each piece out into a rectangle about 10x6 inches. Place on a lightly oiled baking sheet and top with a second piece of dough, again flattening the shape, and top with a third piece of dough. Place on a parchment lined baking sheet and cover with a towel. Let rise until doubled, about 45 minutes. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Cut the foccacia into twelve 2 inch pieces. Use your finger, poke a series of holes in the top of each piece, then place 6 or 8 pieces of foccacia on each one. Bake on middle shelf of preheated oven until lightly browned, about 8 to 10 minutes, switching position of pizza pans halfway through. Remove from oven and place on rack for a minute to allow the foccacia to settle. When cool, cut into squares. Store as a gift.

title: Sausage and Pasta Casserole
ingredients: 500 g italian sausages or 500 g ground venison | 2 1/2 cups fresh breadcrumbs | 6 stalks celery, sliced | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried breadcrumbs | 500 g penne pasta
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Melt the sausages in a pan, add about 1 cup of water and simmer for 3 - 5 minutes, remove from heat transfer to a large baking dish. Place bread crumbs in a shallow ceramic dish and sprinkle over it the celery. Drain the sausages and combine with the breadcrumbs. Mix everything together really well, trying to leave just enough for the mixture to bind in with your hands. Bake for about an hour or until it browns well. Cook pasta as per package directions. When cooked, drain and coat with bread crumb mixture and sprinkle with the breadcrumb mix.

title: Spicy Cheesy Mango Chicken
ingredients: 2 cups shredded cheddar cheese | 1 cup mango chutney | 4 cloves garlic, minced | 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves, cut into bite-size pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly grease a medium baking dish with cooking spray. Blend Cheddar cheese, mango chutney, garlic, and chicken in a blender or food processor until the mixture is smooth. Spoon chicken mixture into the prepared baking dish, and bake for 30 minutes in the preheated oven, or until thoroughly heated.

title: Perfect No-Fuss Pancetta Spread
ingredients: 2 ounces pancetta bacon, chopped | 2 ounces soymilk | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Heat a griddle or frying pan set over medium heat. Add the pancetta and fry until crispy and golden. In a small mixing bowl, pour the soy milk and add the bay leaf. Add the pancetta and pour mixture into a blender. Blend for 1 minute or until desired consistency is achieved.

title: Easy Microwave  Crock Pot Swiss Steak
ingredients: 3 russet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/4 inch thick slices | 1 lb chuck roast, trimmed
instructions: Place potatoes in a 9 x 13 inch glass dish or 2 large resealable plastic bags. Using hands, pierce potatoes all over with small sharp knife marks, if desired. Place sliced beef on potato slices and top with remaining potatoes. Cover and microwave on high power 7 - 8 minutes, or until beef is tender and potatoes have begun to brown on top. Let stand 5 seconds, or microwave on low power 15 - 20 minutes, turning meat once.

title: Roesti in 2 days
ingredients: 1/2 cup margarine | 1 package red potatoes | 1/2 lb lard | 2 tablespoons clove
instructions: Use a cheese cloth, or use a sieve to remove hard rinds from potatoes. Peel and slice the potatoes and lard, using a sharp knife. Place the potato slices in a heavy skillet with 4 c water, cover and boil over medium heat until the potatoes are just tender. Drain. Remove from heat, drain well and add the butter and cloves to the lard. Mix well. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,pie crust,honey,black cardamom pod,chocolate syrup,wheat pastry flour,chicken stock,sun tomato
title: Heavenly Chicken Tart for One
ingredients: 2 cups diced unpeeled fresh chicken breasts | 1 1/2 quarts chicken stock | 1 cup unbleached whole wheat pastry flour | 1/2 cup chopped fresh italian parsley | 2 tablespoons honey | 1/4 cup chocolate syrup | 1/2 teaspoon black cardamom pod, crushed | 1 pie crust, unbaked and cooled
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Cook chicken in a large pot over medium heat just until cooked through, about 10 minutes. Drain and remove any excess fat from chicken. Strain and set aside chicken reserving stock. Combine chicken, chicken stock, and whole wheat pastry flour in a large saucepan. Cover with plastic wrap and bring to boil over high heat. Reduce heat and simmer 3 to 5 minutes until mixture comes together and is slightly thickened. Stir in parsley, honey, chocolate syrup, and cardamom. Remove from heat. Pour mixture into prepared pastry case. Cover with lid or a damp cloth. Bake in the preheated oven until puffed and golden, about 40 minutes. Remove from oven and cool slightly.

title: Greek Cognac Balls
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups egg substitute | 1/4 cup cognac | 1 teaspoon garlic paste, crushed | 1/4 cup lemon rind
instructions: Combine all ingredients until well blended.

title: Hot Dog
ingredients: 500 g beef, minced | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 1/2 teaspoon bottled hot tomato ketchup | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake in a moderate oven for 1/2 hour. Serve with fresh vegetables.

title: Sizzlin' Ham & Kielbasa
ingredients: 12 slices whole wheat bread | 1 lb kielbasa | 1 can watermelon, cut into wedges ( honeydew slices, about 6 slices ) | 3/4 cup madeira wine | 1/4 teaspoon cumin powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Arrange bread on baking sheet and spread evenly with oil. Bake for about 25 minutes or until light brown.

title: Pecan Chicken Sandwiches
ingredients: 3 poblano peppers | 1/2 cup chopped pecans | 1/4 teaspoon ground ginger root | 1 pound thinly sliced cooked ham
instructions: Roast poblano peppers on a baking sheet at 350 degrees f for 20 minutes, turning with tongs. Remove stems and cores, then coarsely chop. Stir ground ginger into chopped peppers. Spoon 1/4 of pepper mixture onto each slice of ham. Wrap each piece of ham into a long, cigar shaped piece of cheese. Place the poblanos onto a baking sheet and bake at 350 degrees f for 15 to 20 minutes, or until thoroughly warm and golden brown.

Random Ingredients: five spice powder,pork tenderloin,milk ricotta cheese,steak
title: Czech Flank Steak Pizza
ingredients: 3 lbs flank steaks | 4 ounces whole milk ricotta cheese | 1 teaspoon five-spice powder | 12 ounces sliced steak ( about 3 slices of your choice, preferably in a jar )
instructions: Using a fork poke 3 small holes in crust. If possible, make a slash with a sharp, straight knife in 2 opposite directions across meat at 1 inch intervals, creating diamond shapes. Spread ricotta over cuts, making sure to leave a 2 inch depth overhanging crust all around, and top with sliced meat. Sprinkle liberally with five spice powder. Cover pan with foil, and place on table, or let stand for 15 - 20 minutes before serving.

title: Pixie Dust
ingredients: 2 ounces brandy ( or rum and rum extract ) | 3 ounces limeade ( i recommend da vinci )
instructions: Pour the brandy/rum through a strainer to remove any lumps. Pour the limeade into a collander over a bowl and press in the bottle of limeade to release all the juices. Allow excess liquid to drain off and then stir in the brandy powder and limeade until thoroughly mixed.

title: Quick and Easy Sausage
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ketchup | 1 -2 red chili pepper, chopped
instructions: Mix all ingredients together until well mixed. Place on buns that have been slightly toasted. Serve cold.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,mexican oregano,sesame seed,italian parsley,basil leaf
title: Mexican Herb Pudding
ingredients: 24 ounces heavy cream | 2 tablespoons cilantro leaves | 4 tablespoons fresh basil leaves | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 2 tablespoons mexican oregano | 2 tablespoons dried italian parsley
instructions: In a heavy 2 quart saucepan, heat cream to a simmer over medium heat. Slowly stir in the cilantro and basil.

Random Ingredients: cocoa,curry powder,green onion,chinese rice wine,skewer,white vinegar
title: Korean BBQ Skewers
ingredients: 3 lbs korean bbq skewers | 4 tablespoons cocoa | 2 tablespoons chinese rice wine ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons white vinegar | 2 tablespoons curry powder | 2 tablespoons green onions, finely chopped, including 1/2 cup | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Combine cocoa, rice wine, vinegar, curry powder, green onions, and unsweetened cocoa in a glass bowl. Thread one or two pieces of the korean bbq onto the skewer, length wise. Skewer should nearly cover korean bbq.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,corn kernel,green onion,bacon,herb,lime zest
title: Grilled Corn and Black Beans
ingredients: 1 large green bell pepper | 12 ounces fresh corn kernels | 1 cup chopped green onion | 2 slices thick cut bacon | 1 tablespoon fresh herb or 1 tablespoon chives, chopped fine | 1 teaspoon lime zest, grated
instructions: Halve the pepper lengthwise. Core and chop the pepper. Combine bell pepper, corn, green onion, bacon and herbs. Stuff the pepper mixture into a 1/2 inch thick slice of aluminum foil. Close the foil tightly over the mixture. Lightly press the foil, secure the foil with toothpicks, and refrigerate for 24 hours. Remove from the refrigerator about 15 minutes before cooking, to allow the steam to escape. Heat grill to medium heat. Remove the foil, unwrap the toothpicks, and grill for 15 to 20 minutes or until browned and tender. Remove toothpicks using a long handled spoon and cut corn off cob, including its juices. Serve hot or warm.

Random Ingredients: avocado oil,sunflower oil,watercress,parmesan cheese,flour,flat leaf italian parsley
title: Fried Fritters
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 1 tablespoon flour | 2 tablespoons parmesan cheese | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh flat-leaf italian parsley | 4 -6 tablespoons watercress, finely chopped, plus fresh sprigs ( to garnish ) | parmesan cheese, to garnish ( optional )
instructions: Heat the oil in a large frying pan. When hot, add the floured butter and flour and work the flour into a paste with the cheese. Stir in the parsley and gradually add a cup of the water, stirring all the while. Allow the mixture to bubble gently over a medium heat, stirring all the while.

title: Yummy Semolina Paratha (Strawberries in Syrup- Semolina-Sambal)
ingredients: 2 cups semolina | 1/4 cup lemon juice ( optional ) | 1/4 cup chopped green onion | 1/4 teaspoon chili pepper flakes ( optional ) | 1 cup fresh strawberries, sliced ( can use frozen ) | 1 -2 tablespoon dried hijiki seaweed ( optional )
instructions: Prepare semolina according to directions on box, using the lemon juice and/or salt to taste. Add a little water if mixture struggles to stick. Dress with optional ingredients or mix before sprinkling with additional nuts. Place in fridge, covered with a towel for 10 minutes or until ready to serve. Wash and slice strawberries or use frozen berries.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,french bread,canadian bacon,red onion,cocoa,soya sauce,tomato
title: Bacon Onion & Tomato Pizza
ingredients: 1 tablespoon canadian bacon, chopped | 1 small red onion, chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons canadian soya sauce | 1/2 teaspoon cocoa | 5 slices of shredded french bread | 1/2 tomatoes, chopped | 1 tablespoon whole wheat flour
instructions: Sauté onions until clear in a pan in canola oil. Add sauces and continue heating until bubbles start to form around edge of pan. Add the bacon. Heat for 1 minute. Remove from heat and place bread on pizza maker. Top with bacon mixture. Sprinkle on tomato and top with cheese. Bake at 220c for 15 mins. Remove from oven and cut into 1 slices.

title: Caribbean Ambrosia
ingredients: 1 cup low-fat cheese, shredded | 1 tablespoon sweetened pineapple juice | 1 teaspoon mandarin orange juice | 1 teaspoon thyme | 1/4 cup fat-free canned low fat crushed fat crushed soda pop
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and serve.

title: Beef Baked in Cajun Salt
ingredients: 1/2 cup plus 2 tablespoons ice water | 3 tablespoons cajun mustard seeds | 1/2 cup plus 1 tablespoon plus 1 tablespoon cajun salt ( about 2 teaspoons ) | 1 -2 lb flounder fillet | 2 -3 tablespoons mustard seeds | 1 large carrot | 8 -12 ounces pasta
instructions: In one bowl, soak ice water in ice water until it melts, stir in mustard seeds. Dice fish and set aside. Coat a small frying pan with olive oil. Preheat on med high. Place whole mustard seeds in a little oil. If they pop, just stir until they turn brown. Turn down heat on pan, if they have popped, and add meat and salt. Stir until meat is browned. Add mustard seeds that have popped into oil. Add remaining salt & the carrot. Stir. Cover and place in the oven in the middle of the oven. Do not open oven door at this point. Do not add salt to the broth. Bake for 30 minutes. The meat should be cooked through when pierced with a fork. Cook pasta and serve.

title: Zeytinya
ingredients: 12 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 12 leaves black sesame seed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Place the chicken breasts in a baking dish. Sprinkle with black sesame seed. Bake 10 to 15 minutes in the preheated oven, until the chicken is no longer pink.

Random Ingredients: seasoning salt,prosciutto,milk powder,pesto sauce,duck,dark sesame oil,chunky salsa,orange zest
title: Duck with Pesto and Green Salsa
ingredients: 1/2 duck ( bone in, boned, skin removed ) | seasoning salt | 1/2 cup chunky salsa | 2 teaspoons pesto sauce | 1 teaspoon orange zest | 1/2 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1 cup skim milk powder | 3 slices thick-cut prosciutto, chopped into 1-inch squares ( can sub ham, ham of your choice )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Season the duck with black pepper. Bring about one third of the salsa to a boil and set aside. Combine all remaining ingredients in a bowl and set aside. Place duck on a rack in a roasting pan. Roast for 45 minutes, or until done. Remove duck from the oven and top with remaining salsa and prosciutto. Broil until browned and bubbly.

title: Creamy Oriental Chicken
ingredients: 2 fryer chickens | 1 tablespoon creole seasoning | 1 1/2 cups sliced mushrooms | 1 large cherry tomatoes, quartered | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/2 teaspoon coriander, powder | 1 pinch allspice | rice or wheat or chow mein noodles
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and leave in the fridge for half an hour. Place chicken on the chicken and cook in a pan with a little oil till done, then place in serving dish. Serve with rice or noodles. Note, in the middle of the dish, top with chopped peanuts or cashew nuts.

title: Italian Steak Seasoning
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried rosemary | 1 1/2 cups ice water | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1 lb top sirloin, cut into thin strips
instructions: Combine the dried rosemary with the ice water in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,broccoli floret,american cheese,chicken liver
title: Cheesy Broccoli Liver
ingredients: 1 jar sliced broccoli florets | 6 links hot chicken livers | 2 cans condensed cream of mushroom soup | 4 slices processed american cheese
instructions: Spread a thin layer of cream of mushroom soup on the bottom of a 9x13 casserole dish. Arrange broccoli florets around the cream of mushroom soup. Cover with slices of american cheese.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,brown sugar,vanilla,vanilla extract,carrot,purpose flour
title: Caramelized Glazed Carrots
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 3 large carrots, peeled and cut into thin bite-size pieces | 1/3 cup granulated brown sugar | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped crystallized fruit or 2 tablespoons dried fruit, soaked in hot water for 1 minute, drained | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/4 cup packed brown sugar
instructions: Drain carrot pieces and pat dry. Place carrots in a lightly greased 8 inch square baking dish. Combine 1/3 cup glaze ingredients.

title: Focaccia Gift Mix II
ingredients: 1 cup all-purpose flour | 1/8 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: Blend all ingredients with a fork. Sprinkle with more red pepper flakes, if desired. Drop by teaspoonfuls on to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake in a preheated 475°f oven for 7 to 10 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: nonfat cream,vodka,green bean,garlic clove,garam masala,corn kernel,calamari
title: Calamari and Green Beans
ingredients: 2 pounds green beans, trimmed & cut into 3-inch pieces | 2 garlic cloves, minced | 2 1/4 cups water | 1 tablespoon vodka | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 1 cup frozen corn kernels, thawed | 2/3 cup nonfat sour cream
instructions: Bring water to boil in a wide pot.

title: Hamburger Helper Mix I
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs hamburger | 1/2 ounce onion soup mix | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 teaspoon beef broth
instructions: Brown hamburger. Drain fat from hamburger. Add 2 tablespoons of onion soup mix to hamburger.

title: Choclo Flourless Pie - Spanish Chicken
ingredients: 1 sheet ready rolled top round baking chocolate, grated | 1 large egg yolk | 3 dashes chicken bouillon or 3 chicken bouillon flavoring | 1 container frozen whipped topping
instructions: Grease a 9 pie plate. In a bowl or a measuring cup, mix together chocolate, egg yolk and chicken bouillon or bouillon until well blended. Spread half of the cake mixture into pie plate. Top with whipped topping. Gentle cover the top with aluminum foil and refrigerate for at least 15 minutes or until set. Do not let it sit over night as the eggs will scramble and become mushy.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper,chocolate chunk,beer,urad dal,cold water,black coffee,green lentil,walnut half
