Random Ingredients: veggie crumbles,grape tomato,crescent dough,eggplant,corn kernel,bay leaf,sultana
title: Grape Tomato Wraps
ingredients: 1 lb eggplant, peeled and cut lengthwise | 2 tablespoons sultanas | 7/8 cup grape tomatoes or 7/8 cup cherry tomatoes, chopped into large pieces | 1 bay leaf | 15 ounces corn kernels, drained | 4 ounces crumbled crescent roll dough | vegetable oil or sunflower oil, for frying
instructions: Slice eggplant lengthwise into fourths. Lay out flat and cut into about 2 inch thick slices using a biscuit cutter. Arrange them on a plate and sprinkle with 2 tablespoons sultanas and 2/3 of the tomato and bay leaf. Wrap up each one with a sheet of crescent dough, stretching it in a tight spiral about 11 inches long and 14 inches wide. Repeat for all pieces of the wrap and place on a tray covered with plastic wrap or plastic wrap. Refrigerate for at least one hour. When ready to cook, preheat oil to 350°f. Fry the wraps, 3 or 4 at a time, in batches for 3 or 4 minutes on each side or until golden brown and crisp on the outside.

title: Tomato Sauce Recipe
ingredients: 1 quart tomato puree ( if this can be done in a pressure cooker ) | 6 tablespoons tomato paste with herbs or 6 tablespoons tomato puree | 1 cup mashed potato starch | 2 teaspoons dry mustard | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bring to a boil and then simmer over medium heat for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.

title: Lace and Bacon Pies - for Bread Machine
ingredients: 150 g self-rising flour ( all purpose flour can also be used ) | 75 g streaky bacon, coarsely chopped | 150 ml double cream
instructions: Place flour in the bowl of a food processor, followed by the bacon and cream. Pulse for 10 - 15 seconds. Using the bread machine's dough setting, follow the manufacturers instructions. Transfer the dough to a lightly oiled bowl, cover, and then leave to rest in a cool, dry place for 15 - 30 minutes, until the dough has doubled in volume. Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 190c/fan 160c/gas line a baking tray with oiled baking paper. Use two lightly floured or non stick cooking forks to roll out the dough with a rolling pin into two sheets of 4 5cm thickness. Slice each sheet into 6 - 8 wedges. Roll the wedges in each mixture, and transfer to a lightly oiled baking tray. Mark into slices with a sharp knife, and bake for 15 - 25 minutes until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: olive oil,white chocolate,fish sauce,peanut oil,spaghetti,cashew,chicken wing,caper
title: Cashew Baked Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 whole boneless chicken wings, cut into two pieces | 4 ounces white chocolate, grated | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 3/4 cup cashews, roasted | 3 tablespoons capers, drained | 2 tablespoons peanut oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Wash and dry the spaghetti, put in a large oven proof dish, then toss with 2 tablespoons of oil for about a half hour, tossing after 7 minutes. Drain and put aside. In the same pot, heat the remaining oil. Add the chicken pieces in the order listed and cook them on all sides for about 25 minutes, turning a few times. Remove from pan and set aside. Stir together the grated chocolate, fish sauce, cashews, capers and peanut oil. Put the pan back on the stove and cook on low heat for about 15 minutes, stirring frequently until the sauce starts to set.

title: The World's Easiest Quinoa
ingredients: 3 cups quinoa | 3/4 teaspoon chile powder | 3 tablespoons poppy seeds
instructions: Saute poppy seeds in a large pan until they start to pop. Add quinoa and stir. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer until water is absorbed. Allow quinoa to cool. Serve.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,hot italian sausage,enchilada sauce,eggplant,celery rib
title: Eggplant & Italian Sausage Stew
ingredients: 1 eggplant, peeled and sliced into � inch thick pieces | 1 lb hot italian sausage, casings removed ( the sausage can be made into pork, beef or turkey ) | 1 celery rib, chopped | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh italian parsley | 1 jar mild enchilada sauce ( i used paul newman's brand )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375° on a cookie sheet, place eggplant slices on the cookie sheet and bake for 1 hour. Remove from oven and allow eggplant to cool for 10 minutes. In a medium skillet, crumble sausage into bite sized pieces. Fry over medium heat until browned. Drain, discard fat. Transfer sausage to a medium size sauce pot. Spray sauce pot with vegetable spray. Add celery and parsley and cook for 10 minutes over medium heat. Add enchilada sauce to the skillet and heat through. Return to a boil and add cooked eggplant to sauce pot. Cook a few minutes until sauce goes fairly smooth and hot. Serve over cooked eggplant.

title: Celery Root and Rosemary Pickles
ingredients: 2 kg celery root, about 2-3 lbs | 2 tablespoons fresh rosemary or 1 1/2 teaspoons dried rosemary | 3 -4 tablespoons fresh rosemary ( to taste )
instructions: Peel celery root and remove the outer white layers. Cut celery roots into 3 or 4 pieces. Cut peeled celery roots into 1 2cm lengths. Place in a large pan with about 7 cups of water. Pierce each layer in a few places with a skewer, adding a small rosemary stalk at the end of each layer. Bring to the boil and skim off any scum that has risen to the top. Cover the pan and boil gently for about 1 1/2 hours or until the celery roots are completely tender. The celery roots may be left to a cool place until cool enough to handle. Remove celery roots when cool enough to handle. Remove and discard the rosemary stems and put into a clean jar. If using fresh rosemary, remove with the tweezers of a sharp knife. This pickles is best eaten several days in advance, but can be frozen. This pickle can be reheated and reheated for a stronger flavour. Serve the pickles immediately, or pack into clean jars and keep for use.

title: Roast Beef With Asafetida(Mild) Spices
ingredients: 2 lbs beef chuck, trimmed and cut into 2-rib pieces ( i use chuck roast ) | 12 cups water, room temperature | 2 teaspoons dry chili pepper flakes | 1 cup asafoetida powder | 1 bunch fresh savory, picked ( tied into one bundle ) | 1 bunch fresh raspberries, fresh ( quartered )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. Line a roasting pan with aluminum foil, leaving about 1/4 inch between the aluminum and foil. Place meat in pan and pour water over. Bring to boil. Sprinkle with chili flakes. Cover pan tightly and roast about 10 minutes, then remove pan from oven and place meat in oven, and roast uncovered for 20 minutes. Turn meat over and continue roasting covered about 30 minutes longer, or until meat is richly browned, very tender. Remove meat and cover loosely with foil to keep warm. Discard water in pan juices. Drain liquid from pan. Discard spices. To make the sauce, stir together asafoetida and half the savory, and add the remaining savory. Remove a small ladleful of the liquid that is left in roasting pan and put back in pan. Stir well. Cook over medium heat until it starts to thicken slightly. Put remaining savory into a small bowl. Stir in the raspberry pieces and put into soup. Serve meat on a flat serving dish or in a gravy bowl. Spoon sauce over meat.

title: Red Beans in Hot Tomato Broth
ingredients: 1 packet dried red kidney beans | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme leaves
instructions: Wash beans, soak in cold water for an hour, drain and place in a pan with enough water to just cover. Simmer for 15 minutes over a medium heat. Remove from heat and stir through thyme leaves. Serve with crusty bread and your favourite vegetables, such as a french baguette. Variation, leave out the thyme before boiling or use 3 tbs lemon juice instead of olive oil.

title: Camarones - Portuguese Shrimp
ingredients: 2 lbs shrimp, cleaned | 1/4 cup pesto sauce, preferably homemade | 4 slices canadian bacon | 1 dried apricot
instructions: Combine 2 1/2 cups of cold water with 2 tsp of salt. Add shrimp to the boiling water, cover. Boil, and turn the shrimp once. Remove shrimp from water and drain in sink, set aside. Cover with cold water. Drain shrimp, return to boiling water, and remove shrimp to separate shells from head and tails. Mix together the pesto and 1/2 tsp salt. Bring to boil, add shrimp and remove from heat, set aside. Place bacon in pan, and cook until just crisp. Remove bacon and bacon from pan and drain on paper towels.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,bread,green enchilada sauce,irish cream,beef sirloin,cilantro leaf
title: Baked Beef Empanadas
ingredients: 3/4 1/4 lb beef sirloin or 3/4 lb rib eye steaks, thinly sliced | 4 ounces irish cream or 4 ounces sour cream, stirred | 1 3/4 cups cooked long-grain white rice, chilled | 1 cup green enchilada sauce, purchased ( mild or medium ) | 3 tablespoons fresh cilantro leaves | shredded irish bread ( optional )
instructions: Combine meat, cream, 2/3 cup rice, enchilada sauce and 3/4 cup cheese. Mix well. Divide and shape meat mixture evenly among 4 - 8 wooden or glass baking cups. Sprinkle each with remaining 1/3 cup cheese. Place on foil lined baking trays. Bake at 400°f for 17 minutes or until beef mixture is cooked and bubbly.

title: Apricot Won Tons
ingredients: 1 envelope margarita mix | 1 teaspoon dried sage leaves | 1 tablespoon dried apricot | 1 teaspoon ground asafoetida powder | 1 cup ice | 1 package wonton wrappers
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium low heat. Mix margarita mix, sage leaves, apricots, aneheim chilies, and asafoetida powder into the margarita mix until evenly moist. Spread a wonton wrapper with 1/4 teaspoon margarita mix over the entire won ton wrapper. Place 2 tablespoons of the remaining margarita mix on top of the wonton. Fold the wonton in half, and pinch all the edges together. Cook in the preheated skillet until edges are lightly browned, 3 to 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,spring onion,parmigiano reggiano cheese,tortilla,butter bean,tomato paste,beef tenderloin
title: Beef & Bean Fondue
ingredients: 1 tablespoon butter beans or 1 tablespoon other light olive oil | 5 beef tenderloin | 1 small yellow bell pepper, thinly sliced crosswise | 1/2 bunch spring onion, including green tops, cleaned well, leaves stripped | 1 large tomatoes, cut into wedges | 2 teaspoons tomato paste | grated fresh parmigiano-reggiano cheese ( about 1 1/2 oz )
instructions: Heat the butter or oil in a large dutch oven, preferably cast iron. Brown the beef, cut side down, over medium high heat until it is well browned.

title: Savory Orzo with Peaches and Squash
ingredients: 12 ounces uncooked orzo pasta | 8 ounces firm drained canned peaches ( see description ) | 3 scallops, rinsed | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh basil ( see description ) | 2 tablespoons soymilk | 8 pepperoncini peppers, drained, cut in thin rings ( optional )
instructions: Cook pasta as package directs. Drain. Meanwhile, peel and slice the peaches into 1/4 inch slices. Place in a large bowl. Add the other ingredients. Drain pasta, if desired, but don't rinse it. Add to bowl.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,broccoli floret,green pepper,grain white rice,farina,arborio rice,white flour,salt black pepper
title: Rice Broccoli and Peppers Arancione
ingredients: 3 cups uncooked short-grain white rice or 3 cups regular short-grain white rice | 1 1/4 cups arborio rice | 3/4 - 1 1/2 lb broccoli floret | 2 green peppers, cut into strips, seeds and ribs discarded | 1 red bell pepper, cut into strips, seeds and ribs discarded | 1 tablespoon white flour | 1 teaspoon salt and black pepper | 1/2 cup farina
instructions: Cook rice in 2 c water for 25 minutes, then drain. Meanwhile, place 1 1/4 c water in a large dutch oven and arrange broccoli, peppers and half of the rice in a 3 qt pot. Bring just to boil, then reduce heat to low, cover and simmer 10 - 12 minutes until vegetables are tender and rice is beginning to absorb liquid. Transfer vegetables to a serving bowl, reserving 3/4 cup cooking liquid. Stir in remaining rice, remaining liquid, remaining vegetables and flour. Place farina in a bowl and stir in hot cooking liquid. If you like thinner farina, bring up to 2 - 3 tbsp water. Drain farina from cooking liquid through a fine mesh sieve then stir in farina and season with salt and pepper.

title: Korean Coffee Sandwiches(Vegetarian)
ingredients: 2 bunches parsley ( use about 1/4 cup each ) or 2 bunches basil ( use about 1/4 cup each ) | 2 medium carrots | 200 g hamburger | 1 medium banana | 1/4 cup hazelnuts, roughly chopped | sesame seeds or walnuts ( optional )
instructions: Chop the parsley sprigs, basil, carrots and mushrooms very finely. Mix them all together. Mince any meat as required or use a vegetable peeler to remove the peel. Mix the meat mixture all together. Shape into walnut sized balls. Cover with sesame or walnut seeds. Place in hot grill over medium heat and cook until lightly browned.

title: Ladyfrise's Tiramisu
ingredients: 1/2 lb unsweetened ladyfinger | 1/4 lb vodka | 1 bunch fresh chives, snipped or 1 cup snipped snipped fresh chives
instructions: Put the ladyfingers in a large mixing bowl, sprinkle with the snipped chives.

title: Campbell's French Onion Soup
ingredients: 750 g rump beef mince | 1 bunch watercress | 300 ml campbell's chicken soup ( campbell's less sodium )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Place rump and all ingredients in a large roasting tray and cook in oven for 30 mins or until meat is cooked, stirring regularly. Serve with a green salad as suggested.

title: Pixie Magic (Iced Chocolate) - My Favourite
ingredients: 3 ounces cake flour | 1 pinch nutmeg | 5 tablespoons cocoa | 3 ounces soymilk ( or almond milk ) | 5 tablespoons brandy | 3 green cardamom pods, crushed ( or 6 black ones )
instructions: If necessary, prepare the chocolate mixture first of all. If possible, cover it with a lid of aluminium foil. Place your oven on convection for 8 minutes, which gives you 3/4 to 1/2 more minutes of baking. Once the oven is hot, prepare the cocoa using one tbsp of cocoa, 1 tsp of nutmeg, 1/2 tsp of cocoa, the soy milk, the brandy and 2 tbsp of chocolate shavings that have been mixed together well for 5 minutes. Remove the lid if you need to. Pour the cocoa mixture into your piping bag. Fill the bag with the cocoa mixture then pipe a ribbon of cream through the piping bag using a piping tube, the green cardamoms or the black ones, into your 4 x 3 cm thick bars. Leave to cool for at least 20 minutes before eating.

title: Greek Ouzo and Pork for the BBQ and Grill
ingredients: 500 500 g boneless pork shoulder or 500 g pork tenderloin | 2 tablespoons ouzo | kalamata olive, to top
instructions: Trim fat from the pork. Score it into 8 5cm slices. Lightly rub the pork with ouzo. Place in a large, straight sided flameproof dish and sprinkle with kalamata olives. Place your bbqplate on top of the foil and grill until well browned.

Random Ingredients: rice flour,pinto bean,orange zest,strawberry,grape,lemon juice zest,mango chutney
title: Mango & Strawberry Chutney - No-Yeast Added
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups rice flour ( can use gluten free/vegan flour ) | 2 -3 tablespoons pinto beans ( drained ) | 400 g diced mango chutney | 1/2 large lemon, juice and zest of | 3/4 cup of fresh grapes ( i use a mix of red and green grapes but any grapes like pears will also work ) or 3/4 cup other small fresh fruit ( i use a mix of red and green grapes but any grapes like pears will also work ) | orange zest, for garnish | strawberry, for garnish
instructions: In a large bowl, mix rice flour, pinto beans, mango chutney, lemon juice and zest and grapes and mix well to combine. Stir in a little of the grape juice or orange zest if using.. Spoon mixture into a greased shallow bowl or tray and gently press down. You don't want to press out the mixture and just leave it in the bowl. Cover with cling wrap, refrigerate over night. Note for those who don't like ginger, i sometimes use ground ginger in place of the lemon, so they don’t get too carried away when mixing or eating. When starting out, keep in mind that this can be difficult if it's fresh or not if the greeks aren’t gluten free. Afterwards, when you’re starting, remove cling wrap from bowl from bowl and sprinkle the top of the chutney with it. This will create air bubbles around the edge and will help to smooth out the chutney while it’s still hot. Sprinkle the sides of the bowl with orange zest and/or lemon juice to give it a nice, crunchy texture. Cover with cling wrap and refrigerate until ready to serve. Note for those who like garlic &/or sugar, i usually don’t use the sugar in this recipe but it has a subtle bite. It goes well with chips and other vegetables.

title: Kielbasa Wrap
ingredients: 1/4 pound kielbasa, cut into 1 inch slices | 8 flour tortillas, warmed
instructions: Preheat an oven to 375 degrees f. Mix together the kielbasa, and warm tortillas in a small bowl. Spoon about 2 ounces of kielbasa mixture onto each warmed tortilla. Fold each wrap in half before placing on a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until kielbasa is warmed and kielas are hot, 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Indian Spiced Fish Satay - for Crock Pot or Grills
ingredients: 4 lbs sea bass or 4 lbs red snapper fillets, with bones ( about 1 1/2 pounds in total weight ) | 1 1 tablespoon curry powder | 1/2 teaspoon msg | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat your oven's broiler. Rinse fish under cold water, and pat dry. Place fish onto a broiler pan, skin side down, with just enough water to cover. Broil about 4 inches from the heat, turning once, until fish will flake easily with a fork. Transfer fish to clean, oiled plastic resealable bags. Combine curry paste ingredients in a bowl. Place bag in a bowl, add fish, squeezing to coat well. Refrigerate for at least 4 hours. Remove fish from plastic and pat dry with paper towels. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Thread fish onto metal skewers. Paint skewers with curry paste, pressing any paste onto the fish. Wrap and refrigerate for up to 2 days. The fish should be completely submerged in curry paste.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,mexican cheese,asparagus spear,french bread,chicken breast,extra virgin olive oil
title: Cheesy Chicken Sandwiches With Asparagus
ingredients: 2 chicken breasts, thin sliced | 1 1/2 cups shredded mexican blend cheese | 1 teaspoon extra virgin olive oil | 4 fresh kaffir lime leaves, torn into pieces | 12 asparagus spears, trimmed and cut into 2-inch lengths ( about 3 cups ) | 2 loaves crusty french bread, halved lengthwise
instructions: Heat oven broiler. In a plastic bag, combine chicken, cheese, olive oil, lime leaves and asparagus. Close bag and shake to coat. Arrange in a single layer on a cookie sheet. Drizzle with olive oil. Place under broiler until cheese melts, about 5 minutes. Cut bread diagonally. Set oven to broil. Add bread to a large bowl. Top with chicken mixture.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,garam masala powder,spinach leaf,kidney bean
title: Easy Spinach Bean and Kidney Bean Masala
ingredients: 400 g spinach leaves, stems removed | 2 cups dried kidney beans or 2 cups garbanzo beans, soaked overnight | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala powder
instructions: Press the leaves with your fingers making a thick layer. Cut lengthwise in half. Drain and wash them well with fresh water. In a wok, heat oil. Add chilli powder and curry powder. Fry well for 2 minutes. Add drained beans and mix well. Press down on the spinach to drain excess water. Cover and cook over medium heat for 5 minutes. Fluff and mix. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: almond,leg lamb,spaghetti,french bean,red curry paste,spinach leaf
title: Easy Beef and Bean Stew
ingredients: 1 tablespoon red curry paste ( i use thai curry that i use'thai kitchen'brand ) | 500 g leg of lamb, thinly sliced | 350 g french beans, trimmed | 3 bundles fresh spinach leaves, washed and torn | 4 pieces spaghetti, cooked | 40 g sliced almonds
instructions: Heat the curry paste in a non stick frying pan with a very small amount of water and cook for about 3 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add the lamb and brown quickly and evenly. Remove the lamb from the pan and put onto a plate while i brown the beans. I like my stew really soft and tender while this is cooking.. Add the french beans to the pan with the spinach to warm through and add them to the lamb in the pan. Now for the pasta, cook the spaghetti in plenty of boiling water, until it is cooked then drain, reserving 1/2 of the water. When the pasta is almost done add the remaining water and cook for about 5 minutes and the spinach to wilt. Toss all the salad ingredients in the salad and serve together.

title: Italian Style Pork
ingredients: 2 lbs pork belly, fat removed | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 1 tablespoon oregano leaves | 1 bag frozen broccoli florets
instructions: Rinse pork belly under cold water. Place in a large roaster and sprinkle with horseradish. Sprinkle oregano over and toss in the corn. Cover with foil. Bake at 350° for 2 hours. Remove from oven and stir in the broccoli. Cook for 45 to 60 minutes.

Random Ingredients: lemon grass,celery,cumin powder,tamarind pulp,caper,chilies,cannellini bean,cardamom seed
title: Cape Malay Beans
ingredients: 8 pints cannellini beans | 1 1/2 cups sliced celery | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh lemon grass | 4 dried chilies, chopped | 1 teaspoon chopped cardamom seed | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 3 teaspoons capers, rinsed | 3 teaspoons tamarind pulp ( paste )
instructions: Combine beans, celery, lemon grass, chilies, cardamom, cumin, capers, and tamarind in a large pot. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer, uncovered, for 1 hour. Season with salt before serving.

Random Ingredients: french bread,chickpea,cinnamon sugar,cilantro leaf,fenugreek seed,mini chocolate chip,half cream,onion
title: Chickpea Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons fenugreek seeds | 1/4 lb sliced french bread | 1 cup frozen chickpeas ( thawed, cooked or canned ) | 1/2 cup chopped onion | 1/2 cup half-and-half cream | 1/2 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 2 tablespoons melted mini semisweet chocolate chips | 1/4 cup cinnamon sugar
instructions: Spread seeds from 1/4 inch of fenugreek over both sides of the bread. Broil until seeds are lightly toasted and lightly golden brown. Turn off broiler and set aside. Place chickpeas and onion in a food processor or blender. Add half and half, cilantro, melted chocolate, and cinnamon sugar. Pulse for 1 minute in a food processor to combine. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours or overnight. Spoon hot mixture into a serving bowl. Serve immediately.

title: Czechoslovakian Style Pork Loin
ingredients: 1 tablespoon kosher salt | 1 boneless pork loin roast, trimmed
instructions: Pour kosher salt evenly over bottom of large ziplock crock or storage container. Cut pork into 4 thin slices. Lay sliced pork slices across fat in a single layer, reserving as much salt as possible. Layer pork on top of salt and let rest for 20 minutes. Use a meat hammer to poke holes in pork with your fingers. Insert two skewers onto each skewer. Place pork on an oiled rack of a roasting pan and pour water into pan. Cover tightly and refrigerate for 24 hours. Turn over every few hours and remove from oven. Using a knife, scrape all of the salt from the pork. Let cool, uncovered, at least 2 hours. Shred meat with two forks or a fork. Reserve. Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Slice meat crosswise into thin slices 3/4 inch thick. Toss slices with reserved pork salt. Arrange slices in a single layer in a large roasting pan. Bake, basting slices with the reserved pork salt for about 40 minutes or until the pork slices turn golden brown. Serve with your favorite chutney.

Random Ingredients: salsa,chinese five spice powder,brown sugar,rye flour
title: Chinese 5 Spice Bread
ingredients: 1 cup light brown sugar | 1/2 cup salsa ( your favorite ) | 1 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 1 teaspoon rye flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Sift brown sugar, salsa, 5 spice powder, and rye flour into a large bowl, then stir in the flour. Place bread slices in oven and bake approximately 15 minutes, or until lightly toasted, and sticky on the bottom. Watch for burning while cooking, and add more toppings if desired.

title: Goats Cheese Pockets
ingredients: 1/8 teaspoon saffron, soaked in 1 1/2 - 2 tsp warm water and drained | 8 ounces soft fresh goat cheese, rinds removed, at room temerature | 1/2 small spring onion, thinly sliced | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon finely chopped fresh clove, to taste ( optional ) | 4 1/3 cups buttermilk ( or low fat milk and 2 1/2 tbsp. sour cream to taste ) | 2 -3 teaspoons guacamole
instructions: Put the saffron water in a medium sized dutch oven or other non stick skillet, stir and place over medium heat. Cook until the water is reduced to 1 t., about 3 minutes. Meanwhile, melt the goat cheese over medium low heat. Remove the pan from the heat, and stir in the spring onions and clove, if using, and set aside. Preheat the broiler. In a large jug, mix the egg and buttermilk with the saffron, a dash of water, and the parmigiano reggiano cheese. If you plan on keeping the cheese at room temerature, divide it between the 4 parmigiano cups in the top of the cup. If not using a parmigiano, press the mixture to form a cup shape. Carefully slide the pear shaped patties into the egg mixture. Broil until patties have cooked through, 1 - 2 minutes, and cheese is melted, 3 - 5 minutes more. Serve and top with guacamole.

Random Ingredients: garam masala powder,brown sugar,wheat flour,arrowroot,maraschino cherry,irish whiskey,olive oil,mediterranean flat bread
title: Spicy Irish Parker Country Bread
ingredients: 6 -8 slices whole wheat flour, whole grain bread, cut in 2, each about 3/4 inch thick | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala powder | 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 2 tablespoons arrowroot or 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 -2 tablespoon irish whiskey | 1 teaspoon smoky maraschino cherry | 1 tablespoon coarsely ground olive oil
instructions: Heat oven to 425 degrees. Place a 12 hole mini or regular muffin tin in oven with the rack in center. Put the flour, greek seasoning, brown sugar and arrowroot/cornstarch in a bowl, stir until blended. Add the whiskey and maraschino cherries. Stir until combined. Add the bread to the bowl and coat both sides evenly with the batter. If using muffin tin, bake approximately 8 - 10 minutes, until golden and loaf is heated through.

Random Ingredients: pork tenderloin,vanilla essence,apple cider vinegar,pork roast,extra virgin olive oil,cornstarch,espresso powder,orzo pasta
title: Gluten Free Pork and Pork Tenderloin (Sbd P1) With Orzo.
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb pork roast, fat trimmed | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 2 teaspoons instant espresso powder or 2 teaspoons instant chicken broth granules | 1/2 cup orzo pasta | 1/2 cup apple cider vinegar ( or equivalent white vinegar ) | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1/3 cup apple cider vinegar ( or equivalent white vinegar ) | 1/2 teaspoon pure vanilla essence
instructions: The night before roast is to be served in marinade, score the surface of the meat, place the rack directly on the heat. When you hear the meat jumping out of the rack, place the roast in the freezer for 15 - 20 minutes to harden the meat and help it to a more tenderness, while you roast the meat. After 15 - 20 minutes, score the surface at a 50 degree angle along the bone where the center of the bone was attached and the bone was exposed. This should also have caused the bone to crack. This should take about 40 to 50 minutes. When your meat is done, remove from the oven, and in a medium bowl mash the cornstarch into the espresso powder until there are no visible traces of flour and cornstarch. Rinse the orzo and drain well. Heat 2 teaspoons of the olive oil in a skillet and lightly brown the orzo. Stir in the remaining 1/3 cup of olive oil. This will have thickened slightly, not thin. Combine the cornstarch mixture with the vinegar, adding small pieces at a time, stirring until thickened. Slice the meat, arrange it in a dish, and cover with the orzo pieces. Pour the vinegar mixture over all, and let the meat rest for about 20 minutes. Serve with some french bread or with cooked rice.

Random Ingredients: chickpea,red lentil,deli roast beef,green bell pepper,black peppercorn,green chilies,kluski noodle,white onion
title: Sausage-Lentil Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 1/2 lb dried red lentils | 2 cups thinly sliced white onions | 4 cans canned diced green chilies, drained ( 4 cans ) | 1 package fresh kluski noodles | 10 -12 whole black peppercorns | 12 ounces deli roast beef, sliced thinly | 1 lb sliced deli rotisserie-cooked beef, cut into thin strips | 1 can chopped green chilies | 1 can cooked chickpeas
instructions: Sort and rinse lentils. Place lentils on a baking sheet, and cover with about 8 inch cool faucet type lid, and let soak for 8 - 10 hours.. Meanwhile, rinse kluski noodles and drain. In a 2 1/4 quart glass baking dish, layer 1 cup onion, green chiles, noodles, 1/2 cup meat, chickpeas, rotisserie grilled beef, green chilies. Pour in lentils, add 1/2 cup water. Cover and bake at 350°f for 40 minutes, or until noodles are soft. In a large mixing bowl, combine all ingredients including but 1 cup water. Toss lightly. Serve warm.

title: Rosemary Whiskey
ingredients: 2 ounces irish whiskey | 6 leaves fresh rosemary | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder
instructions: Heat glass full of ice in microwave on full power for about 30 seconds. Add whiskey to glass and mix with rosemary leaves. Enjoy.

title: Pea Burgers
ingredients: 1/2 lb frozen peas | 2 teaspoons brandy or 2 teaspoons balsamic vinegar | 2 thick slices bacon, cooked | fine breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400ºf. Combine peas, brandy or vinegar, bacon and breadcrumbs. Coat a 4 round or oval ovenproof frypan with cooking spray and line with nonstick foil. Place under the hot grill until hot and lightly browned. Serve with slices of bread.

title: Spicy Garbanzo Beans
ingredients: 1 can garbanzo beans | 1/2 teaspoon dried basil | 1/2 teaspoon brinjals
instructions: Drain garbanzo beans, reserving 1/4 cup of the liquid. Cook bean liquid in a medium skillet over medium high heat, about 5 minutes. Stir in basil, and cook 2 more minutes. Stir in brinjals, and season with salt and pepper if desired. Bring bean mixture to a boil. Reduce heat to low, and simmer 5 minutes.

title: Kielbasa Skewers
ingredients: 1/4 lb uncooked kielbasa | 4 tablespoons olive oil | 1 lb fresh shiitake mushroom
instructions: Cut kielbasa into 1'' cubes.

Random Ingredients: fennel powder,brown rice,chinese cabbage,cumin powder,fish sauce
title: Asian Fish and Cabbage With Nuts
ingredients: 1/2 head chinese cabbage | 1 head chinese cabbage | 2 tablespoons brown rice ( or as needed ) | 2 tablespoons ginger and garlic paste | 1 teaspoon fennel powder ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon cumin powder or 1 teaspoon brown sugar
instructions: Separate and slice cabbage into 1 - 2 inch pieces. Remove core and large white pith from cabbage. Discard outer leaves, wash leaves thoroughly, tear cabbage into 1 inch to 2 inch chunks. Bring large pot of water to a boil over high heat with a splash of salt. When it boils, add cabbage chunks and cook just until leaves wilt a bit, stirring occasionally. Add brown rice and mix thoroughly. Turn heat off when rice is slightly translucent but still crunchy. Add ginger, fennel, cumin, and salt. Mix thoroughly. You can also add other ingredients to sauce, but you'll likely have to add water until you have a thick, moist, and flavorful consistency. Serve with soy sauce/vegetable/fish sauce condiments such as ginger juice, fish sauce, or sambal oelek.

Random Ingredients: lima bean,catsup,vegetable stock,heavy cream,silver beet,mint sprig
title: Silverbeet (Egg-Live) and Mint Soup
ingredients: 2 teaspoons chopped of fresh mint sprigs | 5 cups vegetable stock ( cold ) | 7 ounces silver beet, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon catsup | 2 teaspoons heavy cream | 1/2 cup lima beans, cooked ( optional )
instructions: Place mint in a small bowl and cover with boiling water. Stand for 2 minutes. Remove half the sprigs and reserve. Rinse under cold water. Drain and set aside. Divide remaining mint leaves between 4 heatproof serving bowls/dishes. Top with silverbeet slices. Combine stock, beet and 1 tablespoon of the catsup in a saucepan. Simmer over medium heat for 10 minutes or until thickened, then remove from heat. Stir through mint sprigs and remaining catsup, then heat through. Divide soup among bowls and top with lima beans. Sprinkle each serving with sprigs of mint.

Random Ingredients: parsnip,chunky salsa,clove,star fruit,pork tenderloin,half cream,red chili powder
title: Garlic and Spice Pulled Pork
ingredients: 4 whole star fruit | 1 teaspoon red chili powder, or more to taste | 1 whole clove | 8 whole cloves | 1/3 pound pork tenderloin, trimmed | 2 jars chunky salsa | 1 cup half-and-half cream | 4 parsnips
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Place star fruit, chile powder, and cloves in a large roasting pan or roasting dish. Rub pork with whole mixture, being sure to rub evenly. Place roast on top of the star fruit mixture.

title: Teresa's Cucumber Bean & Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 2 medium cucumbers, diced | 2 bunches green onions, chopped | 4 -5 cups cooked kidney beans, drained | tea ( to taste, i like it hot! )
instructions: Stir the soup in a large saucepan. Add the chopped cucumbers, onions & beans. Cook on medium heat until heated through. Serve warm, sprinkled with a few teaspoons of tea leaves.

instructions: Core the cabbage and slice it into rounds about 2'' in diameter. Peel the skin from the cabbage and cut it into large shreds if necessary. Bring a large pan of water to a boil. title: Simple Slow Cooker Chicken

instructions: Place all ingredients in the crockpot. Cover and cook on low 7 - 10 hours. Stir and serve..

title: Chicken Ranch Salad
ingredients: 1 kg cooked chicken thighs | 1 cup fresh coriander leaves, to taste | 2 packets hidden valley in ontario ranch salad dressing | 2 tablespoons chopped drained bottled pimientos
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except for the chicken. Pour dressing over chicken and dressing mixture.

title: Spicy Beef Sticks
ingredients: 4 beef tenderloin | 2 tablespoons half-and-half cream | 1 teaspoon thai red curry paste | 2 italian-style breadcrumbs
instructions: Remove the meat from the refrigerator and trim off any excess fat. Cut away all visible fat from the ends of the tenderloin. With a sharp knife cut a wedge of meat from the meat, cutting about 1” long and 1” long from the long side of the meat. Place beef strips into a single layer into a bowl, then put the other side on top of the meat. In another bowl, combine the cream and curry paste. In a separate bowl, combine bread crumbs and half and half. Sprinkle meat with bread crumb mixture. Roll beef strips in the cream mixture and then toss in the crumbs so that they are evenly coated. Place the beef in a baking dish and bake in a 375 degree oven for about 20 minutes or until the beef is just cooked through.

Random Ingredients: parsley leaf,kaffir lime leaf,fontina cheese,cheese,palm sugar
title: Cheese Pharoons
ingredients: 3 -5 tablespoons finely grated palm sugar ( for dusting ) | 1 kaffir lime leaf, crushed ( optional and amount to taste ) | 125 g grated fontina cheese | 250 g grated fontina cheese ( or substitute mozzarella for mozzarella and provolone cheese ) | 6 -8 tablespoons finely chopped fresh parsley leaves ( for garnishing )
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c or 170c if fan forced /170c if using conventional oven. Put palm sugar in a bowl, add kaffir lime leaf and enough water to moisten and mix well. Add fontina.

title: Cardamom Stuffed English Muffins

instructions: Toast the muffins. Preheat the oven to 400°f. In a bowl, combine the raspberries, bamboo shoots, lemon zest, soya sauce, rice wine, ground cardamom, and lemon juice. Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,nut,white onion,cherry,red curry paste,hot chili powder,tomato paste,chicken bouillon granule
title: Curried Tomato and Onion Soup
ingredients: 1 medium white onion, chopped | 1 kg tomato paste | 1 tablespoon red curry paste or 1 tablespoon hot chili powder | 2 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon granules | 1/3 cup dark brown sugar or 1/3 cup palm sugar | 250 g chopped pitted cherries | 1 teaspoon hot chili powder | 1/2 teaspoon vegetable oil or 1/2 teaspoon sesame oil

title: Harry's Favorite Graham Cracker Mix
ingredients: 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1/2 cup fresh-squeezed lemon juice
instructions: Place cereal into a small bowl, drizzle with lemon juice, and sprinkle with graham cracker crumbs. Store in a cool, dry place.

title: Beef  With Aubergine
ingredients: 1 large aubergine, cut into 2 cm slices | 1 kg stewing beef | 1/2 kg plum sauce | 120 ml heavy whipping cream | white sugar | coriander leaves | 2 ounces feta cheese, roughly crumbled
instructions: Soak the aubergine slices in cold water for 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: horseradish,white flour,ginger,plain flour,cannellini bean,swiss cheese,american cheese,beef tenderloin steak
title: Beef and Swiss Rollatine With Horseradish Crust
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tenderloin steaks, trimmed of fat & cut into thin slices | 24 ounces swiss cheese, shredded | 3 ounces canned cannellini beans, drained ( white ones if available ) | 4 slices white american cheese, halved | 4 slices swiss cheese, halved ( or use cheddar ) | 12 toothpick-sized slices pickled ginger | 1 cup plain flour | 1 1/2 cups white flour | 1 tablespoon horseradish, freshly grated
instructions: Drain the beans, reserving liquid. Coarsely mash the beans with the reserved liquid and spread on your work surface. Mix the american slices with the american slices, cutting them in half if necessary, but removing most of the core if necessary. Top with the swiss cheese. Roll each piece of beef tightly. Starting at the wide end of the roll, roll each piece up tightly jellyroll fashion with a sharp knife. Cut along the roll to form a roll, with tapered ends, and secure with skewers or toothpicks. Knead the dough on a floured surface until it is a smooth, elastic consistency. Divide it into 8 portions, roll each into a ball, and flatten into a circle 7 - 8 inches in diameter. Place a roll, seam side down, on a buttered baking sheet. Score 3 1/2 wide circles on the top with a sharp knife, to make them easy to lift and place in the oven on a preheated 400 degree for 20 to 25 minutes or until puffed and lightly golden. Serve hot, sprinkled with a little soured cream, if desired.

title: Tofu Apricot Jam and Appetiser
ingredients: 3 lbs firm tofu | 2 cups apricot jam | 6 tablespoons chutney, chaat
instructions: Drain, press and cut the tofu into 1/2 inch cubes. Set aside. Remove the tofu cubes so that they are 1/4 inch thick and line the bottom of a jelly roll pan with them with two circles of parchment paper. Spread some jam on each circle of tofu pressing gently to absorb all the liquid/herb etc. Cover with a layer of jam with a couple more circles of tofu and repeat until all of the tofu and jam mixture is used or your firm tofu has been used. Spread the chutney evenly over the tamarind pudding. Cut into squares when cool. May be refrigerated up to 3 days.

title: Homemade Horseradish for Cornish Pastry
ingredients: 1 quart shortening | 1 teaspoon dried horseradish
instructions: Cut the block of shortening into pieces 1/4 to 1/2 inch square inch by 4 to 6 inch squares. Cut into squares with scissors, then press squares into pastry bags. Add the horseradish into the flour. Work the horseradish into the flour with your fingers until well mixed. Dump the pieces of shortening into the bag, and shake to the cornish edge. Then press down on the flour with your fingers, forming a round cake the size of a small woman's fist. Wrap the bag back in the shortening, and twist it to tighten it. Use about 2 of these as a handle for your cornedish pastries, for instance, or 3 or 4 for scotch bonnet pepper and 3 or 4 as an accompaniment to vegetables, meat and game dishes.

title: Puff Pastry Dampers (Mock Sauce)
ingredients: 1 cup breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 dash red pepper flakes
instructions: Combine dry breadcrumbs, essence & red pepper flakes.

title: Spicy Tomato and Pumpkin Calzones

instructions: To make the pesto, place the vinegar, anchovy paste, cardamom and pumpkin in a blender.

title: Stir-Fried Beef With Spinach

instructions: Place ingredients in a wok and heat until the meat is just browned, stir frying it over medium heat for 3 - 5 minutes. Serve over toasted tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: onion,basil leaf,cold water,couscous,coriander leaf,dill pickle,beef stock chicken,lemon extract
title: Couscous and Dill Pickle Soup
ingredients: 3 cups cold water | 8 ounces couscous | 1 kg fresh coriander leaves | 3 -4 large dill pickles, thinly sliced | 1/2 onion, chopped | 2 cups beef stock or 2 cups chicken stock | 1 lemon extract | basil leaves, to garnish
instructions: Heat the water over a high heat in a large saucepan. Add the couscous and bring to the boil, stirring continuously. Cover with a tight fitting lid and remove from the heat. After 10 minutes return the stock to the boil, reduce the heat, remove the lid and simmer for 10 minutes or until stock has been absorbed. Stir in dill, pickles, onion and lemon extract. Transfer to bowls and garnish with basil leaves.

Random Ingredients: plain nonfat yogurt,beef,flax seed,szechuan peppercorn,cake flour,steak seasoning,pinto bean

Random Ingredients: american cheese,beef chuck roast,simple syrup,vodka,serrano chilies,lettuce leaf
title: Beef, Vodka and Chillies Sandwich

instructions: In a medium saucepan over high heat, stir together the vodka, syrup, 1/2 lb of the cheese and the chile slices until the cheese melts. instructions: In a small bowl, dissolve the yeast in 1 teaspoon of the tomato sauce and allow to stand for 10 minutes. Spread the mixture on a large baking sheet. title: Lahmi's Mexican-Creamy Corn on Rice (Lahmi's Recipe)

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Microwave frozen whipped topping on high for 1 to 1 1/2 minutes or until warm and easy to spread on rice. Using a fork, poke holes in the rice with a fork. Spread 1/2 cup of whipped topping on to the bottom of an oiled 9 inch square baking dish. Spread the corn evenly over the whipped topping. Top with the remaining 1/2 cup of whipped topping. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Stove Top Sweet Peppers

instructions: Place the peppers in a large roasting pan. Sprinkle the top with the pineapple preserves and bake at 375 degrees f for 20 to 25 minutes.

instructions: Slice zucchini and spinach vertically. Place zucchini, spinach, curry paste, sesame seeds, sesame oil, chilies, and lemon wedge in large bowl.

instructions: Boil the chicken until it is tender, then drain it, run cold water over the chicken, and let cool. When the chicken is cool, chop it up, and put it in a large pot. Random Ingredients: italian spice,asiago cheese,bread flour,kosher salt black pepper

instructions: Preheat oven to 180c. Lightly oil a baking mould or tray. In a large bowl, combine all ingredients except the sprouts. Using the spoon, mix well to combine. instructions: In a 2 quart covered saucepan, brown meat and chilies over medium heat until no longer pink. Remove meat and chilies and set aside. Return saucepan to stove and add sliced bread. title: Kielbasa

Place the bacon in a dry frypan, cook over a low heat, stirring until evenly coloured. Remove from the heat and set aside. Remove the meat from the saucepan and pour off the fat, then add the remaining ketchup. Cook for a few minutes, then stir in the chilie. Remove from the heat and allow to cool. instructions: Put the port, chiles, red onion, and mushrooms in a large skillet. Simmer for 40 minutes, stirring occasionally.

instructions: Mix all ingredients together place in a small dish and toast. Use with chips and use as a condiment to top tacos, or eat plain as a dip.

title: Pollo En Salsa

instructions: Cut chicken into bite size pieces. Place chicken pieces in a crock pot with a lid. Use the low setting and allow to marinate overnight. Random Ingredients: chickpea flour,lime juice zest,chili pepper,pork loin roast
title: Lime and Chilli Grilled Pork Loin
ingredients: 6 tablespoons lime juice and zest ( see notes for ingredients ) | 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper | 500 g boneless pork loin roast | 1/2 cup chickpea flour
instructions: Mix the lime juice and zest with the chili pepper to make a marinade. Add the pork and turn to coat evenly. Cover and marinate in the fridge for at least 6 hours or overnight. Heat your grill. Uncover and cook over a high heat until hot and browned on the top. Brush with water and transfer to a plate. Reduce the heat to maintain a gentle simmer and cook for 10 minutes, until meat is cooked to your liking and the sauce is reduced. Serve with rice and naan bread.

title: American Kitchen Classic Dressing and Remaining Dressing
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1/2 teaspoon hot sauce ( to taste ) | 1 teaspoon soy sauce | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh sage leaf | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon chopped fresh tarragon, for topping
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender or food processor and blend on high speed, stopping the blades once or twice to scrape down the sides, for about 30 seconds or until the dressing is smooth and emulsified. Store covered for up to 1 week.

title: Irish Corned Beef
ingredients: 1 corned beef brisket | 1 slice orange | 2 teaspoons anise seeds | 1/2 cup shredded swede or 1/2 cup chopped celery
instructions: Place brisket fat side down in a roasting pan or saucepan. Sprinkle with orange, aniseed seeds and shredded swede or celery. Turn oven to 325 degrees f. Roast uncovered for 1 1/2 hours or until brisket is tender.

title: Warm Cabbage and Beet Salad
ingredients: 1/2 kg cabbage | 1/2 kg beet ( see note ) | 3/4 glass blanched almond | 200 g honey | 2 bunches chocolate
instructions: Wash, cut in quarters and wash the cabbage. Cut the beet into 5cm rounds and slice thinly, put aside in a glass dish with water to cover it. Place the cabbage on the boiling water and leave for 1 minute. Put the almonds in a mortar and crush them. Boil the beet skin with 3/4 glass blanched almond. Drain and peel the beet and beet, leave the beet whole. Then place the honey in a pan. Keep on low while stirring frequently until it comes up to temperature to dissolve. Pour the honey into the beet slices and cabbage.

title: Spiced Parsley
ingredients: 1 bunch flat leaf parsley | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Trim top and bottom end from parsley, then remove root end and discard. Blend parsley leaves, cardamom root part, and parsley together in a mortar or blender until finely chopped.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,mint leaf,orange juice,cocoa,ham,garlic salt,lamb shoulder
title: Lamb With Chocolate Minted Noodles
ingredients: 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 lb lean lamb shoulder, trimmed and cut into 1-inch cubes | 1/2 cup fresh orange juice | 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa, dissolved in 1 tablespoon cold water | 2 tablespoons miniature mint leaves | 1/2 cup bean sprouts | 3 tablespoons chopped of fresh mint leaves
instructions: Sprinkle lamb with garlic salt. Place in a heavy, ovenproof skillet or dutch oven. Add fresh orange juice, cocoa and mint. Cover and braise in a 350°f oven for 2 to 2 1/2 hours. Remove cover, stir, and braise 2 longer minutes. Remove lamb, cover and simmer about 2 minutes more. Cover and set aside. Stir bean sprouts and mint into the braised lamb. Serve over noodles.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,asafoetida powder,pear,red food coloring,chocolate shaving,phyllo dough,worcestershire sauce
title: Torta Di Asafoetida (Pear and Chocolate Phyllo Purses)
ingredients: 1 lb fresh pear, peeled, pitted and sliced into thin wedges ( about 3 cups ) | 1 lb phyllo dough, thawed if frozen and kept warm | 4 teaspoons dark sesame oil | 4 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 8 -10 drops red food coloring to taste ( optional ) | 4 -6 strips of yellow asian chocolate shavings, for garnish ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground asafoetida powder, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Heat the sesame oil in a large non stick skillet. Add the pear and worcestershire sauce.

title: Eggplant (Aubergine) Salad
ingredients: 2 eggplants | 100 g cut green beans or 100 g fresh green beans | 1 bunch fresh basil | 1 bunch fresh dill | 2 pinches dried dill | 2 pinches dried basil | 3 pinches dried sumac | 2 pinches dried breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon grated dry unsalted dry roasted peanuts
instructions: Slice the eggplant finely. Put both into a large pot. Cover with cold water. Bring to a boil, then lower heat. Leave to simmer for 5 minutes or until eggplant is soft. Remove from heat and allow to sit, covered for 20 minutes. Once cold, peel the eggplant from the skin and dice into 1cm cubes. Set aside. Wash the fresh or frozen bean and place in a medium size pot with enough cold water to cover. Bring to boil then cook until beans are bright green. Remove from heat and drain. Drain water from eggplant and place in a salad bowl. Add beans, fresh herbs, dried herbs, and pinches of sumac. Mix well. Pour over the dressing and sprinkle with roasted peanuts.

Random Ingredients: creamy peanut butter,oyster sauce,steak,cremini mushroom,sausage meat,ladyfinger,fettuccine
title: Peanut Sausage and Fettuccine
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb ground sausage meat ( i use extra lean pork sausage and may use turkey bacon ) | 1 cup fresh cremini mushroom, chopped | 12 ounces creamy peanut butter | 8 ladyfingers | 10 -12 ounces fettuccine | 1 - 1 1/2 cup creamy peanut butter | 1/4 cup oyster sauce | 1 1/2 cups creamy peanut butter ( creamy or plain, to taste )
instructions: Brown/cool ground sausage meat in large skillet over medium heat. Once nicely browned, remove sausage and set aside. In the same skillet, melt peanut butter over medium heat. Do not allow peanut butter to burn. Remove from heat and set aside. In separate skillet, heat up ladyfingers. Add peanut butter to skillet and mix well with other ingredients until thoroughly mixed. While that's cooking, cook fettuccine according to package directions. Drain and pour fettuccine into a large serving bowl. While pasta is cooking, melt peanut butter while spaghetti is cooking and stir. Once the noodles are cooked, place onto serving plate and spread creamy peanut butter mixture onto noodles. Top with more creamy peanut butter to finish. Serve with more creamy peanut butter and oyster sauce as desired.

title: Corned Turnips
ingredients: 1 kg turnip greens | 500 ml beef stock | 1 tablespoon pickle relish | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 1 tablespoon beef base | 1 teaspoon fennel, seeds
instructions: Boil 1 litre water in the base of the pressure cooker. Add turnips. Allow to boil gently and tenderise. Add remaining ingredients, stir and set on a high heat. When it starts to boil add pickle wedges for flavour and colour. Lower the heat and simmer, stirring occasionally until turnips are tender.

title: Beef Strap (Gourmet)
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef | 2 lbs swiss cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Place beef in a roasting pan. Rub meat with the salt. Cover and place on stove burner. Let cook until meat is fork tender about 1 hour. Remove meat and place on paper towel. Cut cheese into thin slices. Place on top of meat, sprinkle with salt, and place under broiler to melt cheese.

title: Easiest Beef & Onion Gravy for One
ingredients: 1 kg sirloin tip steak, in about 4 to 6 pieces ( or any other steak ) | 3 1/2 cups leftover stock | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon granules ( or 3 to 4 large packets of maggi veg seasoning ) | 5 spring onions, chopped finely | 1 teaspoon coriander powder
instructions: Trim of any excess fat from the steak and cut into 4 to 6 pieces. Place the steak in a bowl, pour over enough stock to cover and leave to marinate in the fridge for 4 hours. After the 3 hours, remove the steak from the marinade. Heat some oil spray in a pan and sear the beef in batches on both sides, turning over and then add the rest of the ingredients. Season with salt and pepper. Cook on a medium heat for about 20 minutes until cooked and golden brown. This could take up to a little over 15 minutes to finish the gravy.

title: Quinoa and Cherry Chutney
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dry quinoa | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 teaspoon dried sage | 1 cup dried cherries
instructions: Cook quinoa and thyme in 3 3/4 cups boiling water until quinoa is tender and mixture resembles coarse porridge. Remove from heat and set aside for 15 minutes. Drain. In medium saucepan, combine quinoa mixture and cherries. Bring to boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,napa cabbage,vegetable,grand marnier,corn oil
title: French Cabbage in the Pressure Cooker
ingredients: 1 head napa cabbage, cored ( can use a smaller head ) | 1/2 cup vegetable or 1/2 cup olive oil, heated | 1 tablespoon grand marnier | corn oil or olive oil, to cover | shredded monterey jack cheese ( garnish )
instructions: If using a head of napa cabbage, cut out the leaves into quarters or shred the smaller wedge. Slice off and discard about the thick core from the core and discard, leaving about 10 whole cabbage shells. Place the cabbage in the bottom of each of 4 - 2 quart pressure cooker. Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a heavy deep skillet. Cook half a cabbage, cut side down, over medium heat until lightly browned, about 2 minutes. Flip the entire head over and cook until browned and wilted, about 2 more minutes. Repeat with the remaining cabbage and oil. In a small bowl, whisk the grand marnier into the remaining 2 tablespoons of olive oil until lumps dissolve. Spoon half of the hot oil mixture over the cabbage and sprinkle with half of the cheese. Repeat with the remaining cabbage and oil mixture and cheese until the dish is full. Set the pressure cooker cover on top of the cooker with a lid and cook until the pressure has been released, about 30 minutes. Remove the lid and continue with the rest of the dish. Do not remove the lid as it will release as much steam as the lid. Carefully remove the lid. Close the cooker and reset the cooker to its pressure and cook until the pressure indicator goes off. Release the pressure if you want a steam cooker with a thicker, more intensely flavored stew.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,sparkling apple cider,blueberry,salt black pepper,meat
title: Buffalo Hot Dogs
ingredients: 15 pounds processed meat, cut into cubes | salt and ground black pepper to taste | garlic salt to taste | 1 bottle sparkling apple cider | 1 cup dried blueberries
instructions: Heat the processed meat, a sprinkling of salt, and freshly ground black pepper to a boil in a large pot over medium heat. Cook the hot dogs in the hot pot until they are very brown on the outside, about 10 minutes, but will still be slightly chewy in the center in 30 seconds to 1 minute. Remove hot dogs from pot and set aside to drain on paper towels. Wipe out the pot, return hot dogs to the pot and bring to a simmer over medium heat. Pour apple cider into the pot, and simmer until apple cider reduces by half, about 25 minutes. Add the drained hot dogs to the pot and stir to coat. Stir in the blueberries to serve.

Random Ingredients: orange flower water,thai red curry paste,italian parsley,hot water,shallot,no cook lasagna noodle,sirloin
title: Sliced Steak With Orange
ingredients: 1 teaspoon orange flower water | 1 teaspoon thai red curry paste | 1 teaspoon hot water | 3 ounces italian parsley, chopped | 1 1/2 lbs steak | 14 ounces no-cook lasagna noodles | 12 shallots, chopped
instructions: In small bowl, combine water, red curry paste and hot water. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Place steak on sheet of plastic wrap and pound with flat side of meat mallet to 1/4 inch thick. Arrange 1/3 noodles on top of 1/3 steak and spread with 1/3 of curry mixture. Top with 1 t shallots. Repeat with remaining noodles, curry mixture and shallots. Place in 9x13 pan, cover and refrigerate 3 hours or overnight, turning meat occasionally. Bring to boil in covered saucepan and reduce heat, simmering 20 minutes or until steak is tender. Remove cover and cook 10 minutes longer or until juices run clear.

title: Drought Breaker --  Dried Celery Root  (Bowl)
ingredients: 5 lbs celery root ( cut into 1-inch or 1-inch cubes ) | 1 teaspoon ground black cumin
instructions: Trim off root ends and root ends of celery root. Cut in 1/2 inch pieces removing tough outer layers and coarse ends. Place in large pot of salted cold water and bring to a boil. When barely bubbling, reduce heat and simmer, covered, for about 1 hour, until celery roots are tender. Drain and cool. Trim off and discard root end. Use a heavy knife or potato peeler to remove tough outer leaves from washed celery root, cut in half in chunks, and rinse in cold water. Add whole cumin seeds to boiling water.

title: Quick Easy Chili Sauce for Noodles
ingredients: 1 cup chili sauce | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine the chili sauce and vanilla extract.

Random Ingredients: ancho chile powder,snap pea,coriander seed,radish,chunky salsa
title: Mexican Snap Peas
ingredients: 12 ounces frozen snap peas | 1/2 teaspoon coriander seed, slightly crushed | 1/4 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder | 1 tablespoon chunky salsa | 1 radish, thinly sliced
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large microwave safe bowl. Cover and microwave on high power for 2 to 3 minutes, or until vegetables are thawed to your liking.

title: Pumpkin and Chorizo Cakes
ingredients: 2 lbs firm pumpkin, peeled, cut into 1 inch dice | 1/4 lb chorizo sausage ( casing removed, sliced thinly )
instructions: Place pumpkin in a steamer basket fitted with a steamer basket or bamboo steamer over boiling water.

Random Ingredients: green olive,potato starch,dark molasses,hamburger bun,green cardamom pod,beef tenderloin,vegetable stock chicken
title: Ethiopian Beef Soup
ingredients: 1/2 cup beetroot, peeled if using frozen | 3 tablespoons potato starch, beaker | 1/2 cup green cardamom pods | 2 quarts vegetable stock or 2 quarts chicken stock | 1/2 cup dark molasses | 1 - 1 1/2 lb hamburger bun ( i use soft roll bread ) | 1/2 lb lean beef tenderloin
instructions: Remove the membrane from the stemless piece of meat with kitchen shears. Slice the meat diagonally into thin strips. You can also cut strips in to 1/2 inch cubes. Place the meat on a plate with a piece of paper towel in between the strips. Cover the meat with potato starch. Place the cardamom pods in the pot and bring all to a boil. Place the hot broth in a large stockpot. Boil it rapidly for 5 minutes. Turn off the heat and stir in the molasses. Allow the soup to cool. Place a piece of meat diagonally across the base of each warmed soup bowl. Pour a cup full of the soup over the meat and serve.

title: Lemongrass and Yellow Squash Fritters
ingredients: 500 g yellow squash, shredded | 1/2 cup maize cornmeal | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1/2 teaspoon lemongrass, chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and mix well. Heat about 3 tbs of oil in a pan using medium heat. Drop mixture by tbs into pan to brown on both sides, remove to plate. Place squash on serving plate and serve hot. Alternatively, put mixture in a steamer and steam for 20 - 30 minutes until tender.

title: Apple Butter
ingredients: 100 g dried apples | 1 1/2 teaspoons paprika | 1 1/2 teaspoons fennel seeds | 1 teaspoon gingerroot, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons margarine | 1 1/2 teaspoons rice wine
instructions: Place dried apples, paprika, fennel seeds and gingerroot in a processor. Pulse until smooth. Add butter and process until mixed well. If dough starts to clump, add water, 1 tbsp at a time until dough is firm and manageable. Turn dough onto a floured surface and knead with hands for 4 - 5 minutes until the dough comes together in small crumbs. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour. Roll dough out to 1 cm thickness. Cut out 10 circles with a cookie cutter or a floured glass. Place on greased oven trays and prick all over with a fork. Glaze with rice wine. Bake for 25 minutes at 180°c, until golden.

title: Erika Blanco
ingredients: 6 chorizo sausages | 1 teaspoon dried mint
instructions: Remove the casing from the chorizo. Heat a griddle on the stovetop. Smear the chorizo with a teaspoon of the mint. Sear until crispy on the outside but not cooked through. Cut with a serrated knife into 1/2 inch strips. Serve with pappardelle, frijoles and tomato passes. You can also use chorizo for sandwiches and also fry the chorizo. Variation, instead of mint you can use oregano and sage and a little black pepper. Use a little fresh thyme if you like.

Random Ingredients: oriental sesame oil,red chile,milk,cooking spray,cognac,hot red pepper flake,mango salsa
title: Grilled Creole Mango-Mango Sirloin
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 1/2 lbs boneless sirloin steaks or 1 1/2 lbs flank steaks, cut 1 inch thick | 1 tablespoon dried hot red pepper flakes | 3 cups sweetened condensed milk or 3 cups evaporated milk | 1/2 cup cognac or 1/2 cup rum | 1 1/2 cups diced ripe mangoes with 1/4 cup salsa, preferably with pits removed and reserved | 2 teaspoons crushed oriental sesame oil
instructions: Prepare grill for medium high heat, on a medium high setting. Coat grill tray with cooking spray. Pat sirloin dry with paper towels. Sprinkle with red pepper flakes. Place meat on grill tray, and grill 8 minutes, turning once, or until thermometer reads 160 degrees, or meat is very well done. Transfer all but 2 tblsps. Of the milk into a cup. Add sweetened condensed milk to cup, whisking until incorporated. Heat cream cheese and sasapopicama in a small pot over medium heat until melted. Dip each steak in cream cheese/sauce mixture, flipping to coat both sides. Serve with mango salsa and sliced prawns.

title: Sage (cardamom and Cardamom Powder)
ingredients: 4 tablespoons cream of tartar | 2 tablespoons cardamom powder ( pisi haldi ) or 2 tablespoons powdered cardamom | 4 fresh sage leaves
instructions: Put all the dry ingredients in a clean bowl. Add the cream of tartar into this and stir to combine. Cover with a damp cloth with the kitchen cloth or place plastic wrap on top of it. Keep aside for 20 minutes. After 15 minutes remove the cloth and use your fingers to make a small well in the dry ingredients. Add a little of the dry spice mixture to the well. Use your fingers or a wooden spoon to stir to mix all the contents. This will stop the spices from clumping together and releasing any air bubbles. After you have used this mixture, if you are using a food processor, pour the contents into a small jar and cover with a lid. Store in a warm dark place until ready to use. This brings out the distinctive aroma of rose petals. Enjoy.

title: Mexican Salsa
ingredients: 1 jar picante sauce | 1 jar marinara sauce
instructions: Combine the picante sauce and marinara sauce in a small sauce pan. Heat over medium low heat, but don't boil.

title: Chiles Rellenos
ingredients: 4 cups shredded cheese ( monterey jack, colby jack, cheddar, mozzarella etc. ) | 8 saffron strands ( see saffron strand link ) or 8 saffron threads | 2 -3 drops hot sauce, your choice, to taste | 1/2 cup grated monterey jack cheese, divided, if needed ( optional )
instructions: Place cheese on cutting board and cut off any excess with scissors or a sharp knife. Cut a slit in center of cheese with sharp knife parallel to slit, cutting just off the white membrane. Insert pinch of saffron or a few strands of saffron threads into cheese. Pinch saffron to release flavor from inside. Using a knife, stuff center of cheese with one fourth of cheese filling. Warm a small skillet over low heat then pour 2 tablespoons hot sauce into center. Let the sauce bubble for a few minutes until it begins to simmer. Remove from heat and sprinkle with grated cheese. Serve with corn tortillas or plain rice.

Random Ingredients: hazelnut,red kidney bean,lemon pepper,eye roast,juice,celery rib,blackberry
title: Roasted Beef and Red Beans
ingredients: 1 eye of round roast | 1 can red kidney beans, drained | 2 teaspoons lemon pepper | 1 celery rib, sliced | 1/2 cup hazelnuts, chopped | 1/3 cup fresh blackberries | 1 tablespoon fresh juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 275 degrees, line a large roasting pan with foil, and spray with oil. Place roast in roasting pan, then place on a rack in the center. Roast for 3 to 4 hours. Pierce roast between bones with a fork, then set aside for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, in a medium saucepan combine kidney beans, lemon pepper, celery, hazelnuts, and blackberries. Add just enough water to cover. Bring to boil. Once beans are heated, take pan off oven and cover tightly with foil. Allow to sit for 20 minutes before slicing. This may also be done on a rack in the oven, warming the pan until you have heated through. Remove roasting pan from oven, then spread sliced beef over the top.

title: Irish Whiskey Potato Cakes
ingredients: 1 can refrigerated biscuits ( use biscuits of your choice such as keebler or gold medal biscuits ) | 1 pint cherry tomatoes ( approx. 1.5 lbs ) | 1/4 cup irish whiskey
instructions: Pour 1 package of refrigerated biscuits in to a medium size glass bowl. Carefully spoon the cherry tomatoes inches. Pour the whiskey into another bowl. Dip the biscuits into the whiskey and place on a plate. Place the remaining biscuits on top and lightly press the cherry tomatoes into the top of each biscuit. Roll the biscuits around the cherry tomatoes to create a semi circle. Place the coated and unpeeled biscuit into your preheated 350 degree oven and bake in a preheated oven for about 10 - 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Spid's Calamares (Spaghetti and Calamares)
ingredients: 1/2 lb spaghetti sauce | 8 ounces squid, bodies peeled, tentacles left on | 1/2 lb white bread flour | 1/2 lb sultana | breadcrumbs ( for dredging )
instructions: Soak the squid under running water. Remove head from head after washing thoroughly and separate into rings and tentacles. If using squid you may need to add more squid and tentacles while doing this, to keep them moist. Remove eyes from rings and use the tip of a knife to scrape the membrane off the body of the squid so that the white portion of the tentacles stay on. Chop tentacles into bite size pieces, then set aside. Drain squid bodies, then pat dry with paper towel. Add sausage meat to the squid, and mix well with your hands. Place the seasoned flour onto a plate. Dredge the calamari pieces in the seasoned flour, coating completely. Bring a large pot of water to a boil, add a pinch of salt and place the calamari into the simmering water. This will stop the calamari cooking. When the water returns to a boil again, drain the calamari and place into a colander with cold water to stop the cooking. Place the colander over the sink, and place into a large bowl. This will make it easier to remove the calamari later. Place a small dish, such as crumpled foil, onto the pan to keep the calamari covered. Put the drained, cleaned squid into the dish, and coat with the crumbs. The calamari should not be touching. Cook for 5 minutes a side, or until it is slightly crisp and golden on the bottom and crusty on top. Remove from the pan with the crumbs and set aside on top of a plate. Turn the oven on to the lowest setting, and set the oven to broil. Place a large cast iron skillet over medium heat. When the skillet is hot, add a few drops of oil and a small piece of calamari in the center of the skillet.

title: Liver and Vermicelli Parcels
ingredients: 600 g beef liver | 2 tablespoons rice vermicelli | 2 teaspoons dried tarragon | 150 ml double cream ( light is fine ) | 1 red capsicum ( green, deseeded and diced ) | 200 g feta ( greek )
instructions: Rinse both liver and pat dry. Slice very thinly and chop finely. Boil vermicelli in salted water for 30 - 60 minutes. Drain. Mix with 1 tsp of tarragon, mix well and set aside. Combine cream and pepper and set aside. Cut liver into slices approximately 1/4 thick and roughly chop capsicum. Mix 2 tbsp of vermicelli with feta. Spread a even amount of meat mixture on base of a large patty tin. Spread a layer of vermicelli and capsicum over this. Place another patty tin, remaining meat and more vermicelli on top and repeat layers with remaining meat and cheese. Top with a final patty tin and place into preheated oven for approx 60 - 90 minutes.

Random Ingredients: turkey breast,french bread,grape,butter lettuce,sage,yellow cake mix,onion powder
title: Stromboli
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread | 1 package yellow cake mix | 1 teaspoon dried sage | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 4 cups cooked turkey breast, sliced thick | 2 tablespoons butter lettuce, chopped | 4 cups seedless grapes
instructions: Cut bread loaf in half on the diagonal. Cut bottom half in 1/2 inch slices. Grease inside of a 9x13 inch pan with cooking oil. Place meat in pan. Prepare the cake mix, sage, and onion powder as directed on box using the box directions. Place 1/2 cup turkey mixture in center of bread and top with slices of the top bread. Top with remaining filling on top and sides of bread. Cover with foil and refrigerate overnight. Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Remove foil and bake for 40 minutes. Increase heat to 400 degrees and bake an additional 15 minutes or until tops are lightly browned. Cut into 10 to 15 large serving slices and arrange on serving platter. Surround slices with grape slices and sour cream on top and around edges.

title: Prawn and Coffee Crumble
ingredients: 1/2 cup self-rising flour | 1 1/4 cups brewed espresso | 1 1/4 lbs prawns, peeled deveined ( tails left on ) | 3/4 cup chilled whipped topping | 5 green cardamom pods | 1/2 cup fresh cherries ( optional )
instructions: Place flour in a wide, shallow bowl. Make a well in the center of the flour and pour the espresso into the well. Add prawns and turn with a fork to coat evenly. Cover and leave to marinate at room temperature for 30 minutes or in the fridge for 1 hour. Heat oven to 200°c or 220°c if possible. Line a baking tray with baking paper. Stir the whipped topping in to the well. Spread onto baking tray. Break up prawns with a fork. Toss prawns with marinated topping, cardamom pods and cherries. Bake for about 10 - 12 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Feta Spread
ingredients: 10 ounces feta cheese, drained and crumbled | 1/4 - 1/2 cup finely chopped onion
instructions: In a bowl, mix together the feta cheese, onion and 1 1/2 tablespoons water. Cover, and refrigerate until serving time. Serve with pita chips or pita bread triangles.

title: Kumara (Sweet Potato and Hazelnut Crumble)
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs kumara, peeled and cut into 1 inch pieces | 4 -8 ounces prosciutto | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon kumara ( chopped or finely chopped ) | 1 teaspoon hazelnuts, chopped | 1 tablespoon white whole wheat flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Cook kumara in boiling water for 10 minutes, until soft. Drain. Grease a 5 qt casserole dish. Place kumara pieces in the casserole dish, piling them down so they fit. In a small bowl, mix nuts, flour and kumara together. Sprinkle the nut mixture over the kumara, reserving some for topping. Bake in the oven for 25 - 30 minutes, or until lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: double cream,cornflour,red potato,pita bread,thyme sprig,skirt steak,button mushroom,grand marnier
title: Beef and Mushrooms With Pita Paddles (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 11)
ingredients: 75 g button mushrooms, sliced and left whole | 75 g crimini button mushrooms, sliced | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprigs | 2 1/2 tablespoons cornflour | 150 ml double cream | 1 teaspoon grand marnier | 2 1/2 lbs trimmed skirt steaks | 6 medium red potatoes, cut into 5cm chunks | 3 pita bread, breads to serve
instructions: Place all the pitta/soup ingredients in a large pan and stir over a low to medium heat until the mushrooms are just soft and the cream has almost completely reduced, about 5 minutes. Increase the heat and cook, stirring for 1 minute or until the sauce has thickened slightly. Season with 1/2 teaspoon of salt and set aside to cool. Place the steak in a large pan and add the rest of the ingredients over a medium heat. Cook for 3 - 4 minutes each side or until cooked to your liking. Transfer the meat with a slotted spoon to a plate, cover and set aside to rest. While the meat is resting, place the potatoes in a pan of boiling water for 10 - 15 minutes or until just tender. Drain well with a slotted spoon, pat dry with absorbent paper and chill. Using a mandoline or your hands, roughly chop the potato. Place in a warm oven and warm in the oven until just tender, around 10 - 15 minutes. Remove from the oven, season with 1/2 teaspoon of salt and pile onto a large plate. Dollop with the pitta/soup and serve.

title: Baked Turnips With Mushrooms & Rum
ingredients: 2 -3 small turnips, peeled | 1 large mushroom, sliced | 1 tablespoon dark rum | 1 tablespoon brown sugar ( or more if needed ) | 1 spring onion, finely chopped | 2 small radishes, grated | 2 tablespoons tomato juice
instructions: Boil turnips, salt and pepper until tender.

title: sweetcorn Muffins
ingredients: 1 can sweetcorn, drained | 1 egg
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Combine the sweetcorn and egg and pour into 4 muffin cups. Bake for 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Italian Chickpea Fruit  Mix
ingredients: 2 cups cranberry juice | 2 cups chickpea flour | 2 tablespoons molasses | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1/2 cup pineapple, cubed or 1/2 cup apple, shredded | fresh italian herb ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Sprinkle with additional chopped mixed herbs if desired.

title: Pea and Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 cups fresh peas or 1 1/2-2 cups frozen peas | 6 -10 medium baking potatoes | 1 cup peas | 1/2 cup green olives, sliced | 6 ounces goat cheese, crumbled | 1 medium cucumber ( optional )
instructions: Bake or broil potatoes or peel potatoes cut lengthwise into 1/2 slices. Place in strainer and cool until barely warm. Drain in cool running water to get rid of starch. Drain peas if using fresh or frozen peas. Place potatoes in large bowl and cover with cold water. Add salt, pepper, if using fresh peas. Toss with cold water to prevent skin from forming. Place peas in microwave on high until potatoes are soft, about 15 minutes. Place green olives in another bowl and add drained peas in same order. Toss with warm cooked potatoes and add cheese on top if using. Place in fridge to cool. Top with chopped cucumber on top as a garnish.

title: Cindi
ingredients: 4 smoked ham hocks | 1/2 ounce anchovy fillet, mashed ( optional ) | 2 ounces milky chocolate, chopped | 1 red chilies ( chopped ), deseeded and minced | 1 ounce milk chocolate, chopped | 1 1 red chilies, deseeded and minced | 1 teaspoon brandy
instructions: Bowls,. Use a knife to slice down the middle of the hock, removing as many of the meat as possible. Open them up and place in a large pan of cold water. Bring just to the boil then simmer for 2 hours. Remove the meat from the pan and place in a clean bowl. Remove any fat from the meat, if desired. Strain the water from the pan and, using a fine sieve, mash the meat until it is a smooth paste. Discard the pan juices and set aside. Skim fat from the meat and set aside. Skim the fat from the surface of the roasting pan, if necessary. Place the pan over medium heat and add the butter, milk and chopped chillies. Cook gently, stirring, for 3 - 4 minutes or until the mixture boils and thickens slightly. Add the brandy to this mixture and simmer, stirring, for 2 - 3 minutes or until reduced to 4 tablespoons. Season to taste and serve at once with bread of your choice to dip.

Random Ingredients: tamarind paste,seasoning,chicken bouillon,cheddar monterey cheese,asafoetida powder
title: Quick Chiang Mai Style Enchiladas
