title: Caribbean Grill
ingredients: 2 lbs hamburger | 50 g dried chestnuts, chopped | 2 tablespoons pine nuts, ground | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons sea salt | 1 1/3 cups buttermilk | 1 cup raisins | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard
instructions: Mix ground meats and spices. Dip into buttermilk, then into mustard seeds. Cook slowly. Do not brown. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: cotija cheese,stewing beef,cashew nut,celery seed,thyme leaf,broccoli floret
title: Beef Broccoli and Cashews
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef | 1 cup celery seed ( optional ) | 1/4 cup cashew nuts, ground fine ( optional ) | 1/4 cup fresh thyme leaves | 1/4 cup dried roasted unsalted cashew nuts | 1/4 cup crumbled cotija cheese | 2 tablespoons fresh thyme leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to cut meat in 1 inch pieces and place in an ovenproof skillet. Top with remaining ingredients. Cover and bake 35 to 40 minutes. Sprinkle with cotija cheese and thyme leaves, and return uncovered to oven, stirring frequently, to melt cheese and spice mix. Serve with rice.

title: Molho Barbecued Tomatillo Appetizer
ingredients: 1/2 lb tomatillo, husked | 2 tablespoons lemon zest, grated | 2 tablespoons peanuts, roasted
instructions: Place the tomatoes on a foil lined baking sheet and sprinkle with the lemon cheese and the peanuts. Broil the tomatoes until the cheese is beginning to melt. Turn once to allow the cheese to melt.

title: The Best Salsa Dip
ingredients: 1 container cream cheese, softened | 1 can chunky salsa
instructions: In medium bowl, blend cream cheese and salsa until well blended.

title: Limas and Sauerkraut
ingredients: 2 cups dried lima beans | 1 1/2 cups sauerkraut, drained | 1 can kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 2 tablespoons buttermilk
instructions: Combine the lima beans, sauerkraut, kidney beans, and fennel seed in a saucepan. Bring to a simmer over medium heat, then reduce heat and simmer until thick and the juices are released and the beans are tender, about 20 minutes. Stir occasionally. Remove from the heat, and let stand until cool enough to handle. Transfer the sauerkraut to a large serving bowl, and refrigerate at least 3 hours before serving. Stir the buttermilk into the sauerkraut.

title: Minted Mousse
ingredients: 1 lb mint leaf, fresh | 6 ounces heavy cream
instructions: Wash the mint leaves, then drain them well. Using a heavy knife cut a small hole through each leaves, cutting away the dark green inner ribs. Stem and clean the mint, then roughly chop. Make the mousse, using a thin metal spoon, mix 2 tablespoons of the mint with the cream until thoroughly blended. Spoon the mint mixture into an 8 ounce glass jar, then carefully fill the jar with the mint and cream mixture. Cover with waxed paper, seal and store in the fridge for 3 - 4 days, shaking the jar once or twice before using to stir off excess ice crystals. Keeps in the fridge for up to 3 years.

title: Gingersnaps
ingredients: 1 lb fresh gingerroot, peeled, trimmed well and chopped finely | 1/2 teaspoon oregano flakes | 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 12 allspice | 1/2 teaspoon black mustard seeds | 1 lb parmesan cheese | 5 tablespoons grated fresh parmesan cheese
instructions: Sauce, mix all ingredients in a frying pan, except the last tablespoon of cheese, heat until cheese is melted, take off heat, pour onto wax paper, or plastic wrap. Chop roughly with the back of slotted spoon. Serve, it does not keep forever, refrigerated.. It is even better the next day.

Random Ingredients: chicken liver,kalamata olive,yukon gold potato,mirin,dark brown sugar,tandoori paste,cauliflower floret
title: Tandoori Chicken Liver and Potatoes With Cauliflower and Onions
ingredients: 1 lb cauliflower floret, trimmed | 1 lb yukon gold potato, peeled and quartered | 2 tablespoons tandoori paste | 12 whole kalamata olives, chopped | 1 lb chicken liver, sliced into 1/2-inch slices | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar | 1/2 cup mirin
instructions: Fill a large pot with water and bring to a boil. Add the cauliflower and potatoes and boil for 15 to 20 minutes or until tender. Stir well to separate any clumps. Taste and adjust seasoning. Cover and refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: peppercorn,salad green,tart apple,kimchi,monterey jack cheese,s b curry golden sauce mix
title: Vegetarian Chop Suey
ingredients: 2 tart apples | 1 bag mixed salad greens | 3 -4 tablespoons monterey jack cheese or 3 -4 tablespoons colby-monterey jack cheese ( depending on how cheesy you want your dish ) | 2 teaspoons kimchi | salt and freshly cracked peppercorn | 1 packet kiffinade curry golden sauce mix

In a small skillet, heat the kimchi on medium heat. Do not let it boil or else the kimchi will not crisp up. Add half the spice to the water and cook a few seconds until it's bubbling up a little. Pour over the salad greens and mix well with a large spoon. Adjust seasonings to your own taste. Serve in a small bowl with warm crusty french bread or toasted pita bread.

instructions: Cook broccoli according to package directions. Meanwhile, fry pancetta until crisp about 10 minutes. Drain on paper towels. Serve rice with beef, broccoli and pepper seasoning. This goes very well with hot soup and salad.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,tortilla chip,sirloin,cream tartar,sazon goya seasoning
title: Beef Taco Filling

instructions: Brown meat. Drain fat add rest of ingredieients except flour and bring to boil and simmer over low until ready to use. Use corn flour mixed with just enough flour to make a thin paste. title: Ginger-Garlic Chicken Skewers
ingredients: 1/2 orange, zest of, grated | 1 tablespoon sweet paprika ( we used hot ) | 1 1/4 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs | 12 ounces goat cheese | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 small red apple, finely dice | 1/2 sweet red pepper, diced | 1/2 cup roasted cashews, coarsely chopped
instructions: Soak the cashews in water for 30 minutes and then remove the skins and cashew pieces and coarsely chop them. Put the chicken onto the foil and pour the sauce around. Broil the chicken until cooked through, about 8 minutes. Cut the goat cheese into cubes, put into a small bowl and pour the goat cheese mixture over the chicken. Put on the broiler for another 5 minutes or until lightly golden. Turn off the broiler, then put the chicken on serving plate and top with the sweet red pepper and cashews.

title: Beef and Mushrooms in Garlic Sauce

instructions: Combine parsley, mushrooms, beef and frozen whipped topping in 6 bowls.

instructions: Cut each chicken breast horizontally into thirds. Combine the flour, lemon peel and salt then spoon equal amounts of the flour mixture into each chicken breast half. title: Italian Pasta

instructions: In large bowl, combine all ingredients.

title: Greek Meatball Sandwiches W-Feta and Carrots
ingredients: 3 lbs baby carrots | 1/2 cup coffee | 1/4 cup fat free greek yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme | 12 meatballs | 9 slices french bread
instructions: In a non stick skillet, place the carrots in a small amount of water and bring to a boil. Cook 5 minutes then immediately drain under cold water until completely cool then peel. Place the carrots in a bowl and crush with a fork or with the back of a spoon. Add the coffee, greek yogurt, thyme and pepper to the carrots and stir to mix until all the flavors are incorporated. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f and place a baking sheet on the top rack. Toast the french bread. Remove the beef jerky from the refrigerator and spread on top of each piece of toast. Return to oven and bake for about 8 - 10 minutes or until the cheese is melted and golden brown. Top with your favorite beverage and serve immediately.

title: Fenugreek-Cumin Lobster
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds lobster tail, cut into 2-inch pieces | 1 cup broccoli florets | 1 teaspoon dried fenugreek seeds | 1 teaspoon cumin, or to taste
instructions: Rinse lobster, and set aside. Fill a pot with water, and bring to a boil. Once boiling, stir in broccoli and fenugreek seeds.

instructions: Mix bananas, worcestershire sauce, rosemary, and malt vinegar together in a bowl. Refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving to blend flavors.

title: Beef and Yellow Peppers

instructions: Heat oil and 1 tablespoon of butter in a skillet over medium high heat. Brown the beef and onion in the hot oil. Stir in the sweet onion and bell pepper and hot sauce. title: Mexican Rice and Vegetables
ingredients: 2 1/4 cups low sodium vegetable broth or 2 1/4 cups chicken broth | 1/4 cup coconut milk | 1/8 teaspoon saffron thread | 2 cups uncooked whole grain white rice, rinsed and drained | 3 portabella mushrooms, trimmed, stems reserved ( about 5 ounces ) | 1/4 cup chopped pecorino romano cheese, divided | 12 tablespoons picante sauce
instructions: Add broth, coconut milk and saffron to medium saucepan.

title: Kaisersla (Spinach Oatmeal)

instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet or pot over medium high heat. Pour in the spinach and jalapenos, and sauté until the spinach just starts to wilt. Toss the mixture well with the vegetables and cooked beans. Serve immediately.

title: Stuffed Apple
ingredients: 4 large apples | 8 large slices honey-roasted chicken fillets | 2 tablespoons fresh ginger root, thinly sliced | 2 slices sweet breadcrumbs | 1 cup coarsely chopped candied cherry tomatoes | 1/3 cup lime juice | 2 teaspoons ground ginger
instructions: To prepare the apple filling, peel the apples but do not remove the root ends. Carefully peel the outside skin from the apple until no more than 2mm deep. Arrange the apple slices in a 9x5x3 inch glass baking dish. Sprinkle with ginger and cover with chicken. Stir together ginger slices, bread crumbs, cherry tomatoes and lime juice, and pour over fruit. Marinate in the refrigerator, covered, for at least 4 hours and up to 2 days. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place the dish on a baking sheet that has been lightly coated with cooking spray. Bake in the preheated oven until the apple filling is slightly browned and stuffing is tender, 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Lau Lau (Lavender Colcannon)
ingredients: 1 head cabbage, shredded | 3 tablespoons butter | kosher salt ( to taste ) | 1/4 cup brandy ( clear liqueur )
instructions: In a large bowl add shredded cabbage. In a medium sized, heavy skillet, melt 1 tbsp. Of butter over medium flame. When the butter is bubbly, place a dinner plate on top to weigh it down. When the plate is heated and pliable, hold your hand in a holding motion. Put shredded cabbage in the sauce in the palm of your hand, then with your hand in the center of the plate, gently toss cabbage with the butter and salt. If any of the cabbage is still luke warm, pour it carefully in the skillet, then, holding plate at a 45 degree angle to prevent overcooking and scorching, toss the cabbage with the brandy in the skillet. When the lukewarm liquor has been absorbed into the cabbage, put a plate on top to weigh down and allow to sit for at least 8 hours to fully absorb all that wonderful flavor. This will take approximately 15 minutes to achieve this. Note, it's best to let the cabbage sit for a few hours with the skillet on over a medium heat before serving.

title: Shirataki Potstickers
ingredients: 3 packages dry shirataki noodles | 2 sheets dried seaweed | 1 tablespoon brewed tea
instructions: Fill a pot about 2/3 full with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the shirataki noodles and return to a boil. Cook the noodles uncovered, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but still firm to the bite, about 5 minutes. Drain well, and transfer to a bowl. Microwave tofu for 1 minute on high in the microwave, or until slightly softened and beginning to brown. Drain well, and cut into strips about 1/2x1/4 inch. Spread 1 tablespoon brewed tea over each rice sticks, and sprinkle with shirataki.

title: Peach Phyllo Triangles

instructions: Prepare pealeys coffee powder according to package directions. Spread pea slices on phyllo in an even layer. Cover with plastic wrap and leave in refrigerator in a cool place until phyllo is firm.

title: Tortilla Casserole

instructions: Combine butter beans and crushed pineapple in saucepan. Bring to a boil, lower heat, and simmer for 20 to 30 minutes until slightly thickened.

instructions: Peel, core and dice apple. Saute apple and rice in oil until apple is tender. Chop or break up rice, and serve on the side. Great with some fresh fruit and raisins.

title: Mint Cheese Breadcrumbs

instructions: Cut loaf in half lengthwise and then crosswise to make 1 wide round crust. Place one half, cut side up, in a lightly greased 9 x 10 x 2 baking dish. Mix all other ingredients together except bread through mint. Sprinkle breadcrumb topping over breadcrumbs. Let stand at room temp for 20 minutes, toss and bake at 400 degrees f. For 30 minutes.

title: Lomo Saltano

instructions: Trim excess fat from the pork. Place in the crockpot and pour enough water over to cover. Set to low, and cook for 5 hours. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Spread the can of french bread over the bottom and layer pork on top of each slice. Place the polenta on a baking sheet, and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Bake in the preheated oven until the bread is lightly browned and tender, approximately 30 minutes.

title: Green Applesuppe

title: Shrimp Kisses

instructions: Peel shrimp and devein.

instructions: Put mustard seeds in a 1 gallon plastic bag.

instructions: Combine all ingredients, and let sit for 10 - 15 minutes to allow flavors to meld. Use over cooked chicken or as a dipping sauce.

title: Ginger Beer (Ginger Beer Float)

instructions: Mix ginger root, and chili paste. Pour into tall chilled glass. Serve.

title: Ancho Marinade and Beef

instructions: Combine vinegar, chili and meat and marinate in refrigerator 4 hours or overnight. Grill to desired doneness.

title: Tandoori Beef Burger

Cook, stirring occasionally, just until heated. Stir in chocolate chips. Serve immediately.

title: Barbecue Lentil Spread
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried lentils | 1/3 cup light margarine | 3 tablespoons barbecue sauce | 3/4 1/4 cup light beer or 3/4 cup dark beer | 1/4 cup dried black olives, minced | 1 teaspoon sage ( fresh or dried )
instructions: Drain lentils well and rinse. Place lentils in large bowl. Melt margarine in same large bowl. Add barbeque sauce and stir with wire whip on medium until margarine is melted. Add lentils. Add black olives and sage and mix well. Refrigerate overnight, stirring the next day.

title: Pistachio Poached Baguettes
ingredients: 8 slices baguette, cut in half | 3 tablespoons fish oil, divided | 1 1/2 teaspoons seasoning, divided | 2 teaspoons chili paste | 1 teaspoon poultry seasoning | 2 tablespoons aniseed | 2 tablespoons cocoa | 1 cup pistachios, cut in half
instructions: Soak baguette in water 10 minutes and then squeeze out excess bran. Place each piece of bread on a board with sides. Using a rolling pin roll one piece of bread round to flatten to approximately 9' in diameter. Dip each of the pieces of bread in the fish oil and then brown in 2 tbsp of the seasoning, chili paste and poultry seasoning. Repeat with the remaining bread rounds. When all the bread rounds are fried, stack and cover. Remove all the bread from the pan and set aside. When all the breads are fried, remove from pan and sprinkle with cocoa. Melt remaining 2 tbsp of fish oil in pan and pour over the bread and let cook 2 minutes. Toast pistachios on a griddle or on broiler pan in oven until just lightly browned. To serve, place two poached pieces of bread over each plate and top with a handful of pistachios. Drizzle the remaining 2 tbsp of fish oil over and around it.

title: Saucepan-Bake Potatoes and Clam Stew
ingredients: 4 large russet potatoes | 2 cans peeled clams | 1 can chopped jalapeno peppers, with peppers, with juice | 3/4 cup quick-cooking oats | 1/2 cup grated romano cheese | 1 bunch scallion, chopped
instructions: Scrub potatoes and set aside. Slice thinly the potatoes. Put into a large pot with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil and cook until easily pierced with a knife and the inside of the potatoes is still slightly moist. This should take about 15 to 20 minutes. Drain and put into a large bowl along with the clams, peppers, oats, cheddar jack cheese and scallions.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower,pecorino romano cheese,active yeast,yellow cornmeal,palm oil,red curry paste
title: Curried Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast | 1/2 cup warm palm oil | 4 -5 cups cauliflower, cleaned, heads removed, and cut into flowerets | 1 1/2 cups unbleached cane sugar or 1 1/2 cups unsulfured cane sugar | 3 tablespoons red curry paste | 1/2 cup grated pecorino romano cheese ( about 4 ounces ) or 1/2 cup parmesan cheese ( about 4 ounces )
instructions: To make the paste, lightly oil a 5 quart or larger bowl. Dissolve yeast in warm water, then stir into warm water. In a 3 - 4 qt. Dutch oven fitted with the rack set at the middle position, combine the yeast mixture, sugar, and curry paste. Cook, stirring, over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture comes to a boil, about 2 minutes. Ladle mixture into the bowl and sprinkle with cheese. Cool to warm room temperature, about 1 hour. Cut into wedges and serve cold. If making ahead, prepare as directed except refrigerate the curried cauliflower.

title: Crunchy Chinese Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 6 cups chinese cabbage ( shredded ) | 1 box rice pudding ( any flavor and flavour you have on hand ) | 4 eggs | 1 package grain and wild oats blend rice pudding | 2 cups grapes tomatoes | 1 cup molasses or 1 cup honey | 1 tablespoon salt | 1/2 cup corn or 1/2 cup coconut flakes, to dust rolls
instructions: Steam cabbage until just softened, not soft. Remove outer leaves and place on cookie sheet. Mix rice pudding mixes, molasses, tomatoes, salt and corn. Mix rice mixture into cabbage. Place cabbage leaves on top of molasses mixture, then spread out to the edges. Sprinkle with coconut flakes. Put on 325 oven and bake 45 minutes to an hour, or until golden brown.

title: Polish Collards With Pineapple
ingredients: 8 collard greens or 2 lbs collard greens, whole | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon sweet hungarian paprika | 3/4 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 cup pineapple juice ( your own or from canned pineapple jar )
instructions: Place the pineapple in a large mixing bowl. Mix the paprika and bread crumbs well. Mix the meat and spice well with the bread crumbs, then coat the collards in the spice mix and let soak at room temperature for several hours, or overnight. Line a large roasting pan with waxed paper. Arrange the coated collards on the waxed paper and spoon the pineapple juice evenly on top of them. Cover and refrigerate for 2 - 3 days, shaking about a half hour before serving.

title: Sizzling Slump (With Hamburger and Veggies!) #2
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs hamburger | 1 large green pepper, diced | 1/2 cup catsup | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 1/4 cup meat gravy
instructions: Put all ingredients in a bowl and mix well. Put in a pan and cook on high for 45 minutes. Serve with toast & steak, vegies, chips & vegetables or roast beef etc.

title: Champagne Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 lb button mushroom | 1 tablespoon dates
instructions: Remove stems from mushroom and discard. Cut caps into quarters length wise. Fill each mushroom with portugese. Dribble date syrup over all. Add a small pinch of salt and a grind of pepper. Serve on toasted bread.

title: Sugar-Free Sweet Pea Snacks
ingredients: 1 lb sugar snap peas | 1/2 teaspoon salt ( to taste ) | 1 cup brandy or 1 cup sherry wine, made from a high quality sweetened orange | 2 tablespoons sugar-free sugar-free sugar-free sweetened sherry ( to taste )
instructions: Cook peas in salted water for 5 minutes, until crisp tender. Drain, and rinse under cold water. Peel back peas. Discard any tough seeds. Transfer peas to a bowl, and add salt. Let stand 5 minutes. Drain, then stir in remaining ingredients. Chill at least 1 hour. Serve hot or cold.

Random Ingredients: red enchilada sauce,extra virgin olive oil,masala,tomato juice
title: Easy Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 1 can red enchilada sauce | 1 can diced tomatoes with juice | 1 tablespoon masala ( or more, to taste ) | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Pour the tomato juice into a saucepan, and bring to a boil. Turn off the heat. Add the masala. Mix in about 1/2 cup of the enchilada sauce or 1/2 cup of water if you are using the leftover sauce. Return to the heat, but do not boil. Simmer on low about 20 minutes. Add in 1/2 cup more of enchilada sauce or water and simmer on low about 10 minutes. Use a potato masher to break up any lumps that form. Serve over your favorite mexican dish and enjoy.

title: Chessy Chutney Spread
ingredients: 1 container prepared chutney, or to taste | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1/4 teaspoon graham cracker crumbs | 2 tablespoons chopped genoa salted mandarin oranges
instructions: Stir the chutney, cardamom, graham cracker crumbs, and mandarin orange peel together in a bowl.

title: Homemade Refreshing Cream Cheese
ingredients: 6 tablespoons philadelphia cream cheese, softenable | 1 dried chile pepper, broken into pieces | 18 cashews, chopped ( optional )
instructions: In food processor, combine cream cheese, chile pepper, and cashews. Cover and process mixture on medium speed until mixture forms ball, about 30 - 40 seconds. Spread mixture onto wax paper or plastic wrap so it is just 1/2 inch thick. Refrigerate until chilled, about 3 hours. Cut into 18 pieces.

title: Spice Seasoning (For French Fries, Vegetables)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cumin seed | 1/4 cup taco sauce ( i use homemade ) | 1 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Put everything in a dry skillet and toast a few minutes, until it becomes a darker and fragrant smell, and the cumin becomes aromatic. Taste for more heat and/or type of spices you would like, and adjust to suit your personal spice level. This could also be made by mashing together 1 teaspoon ground cumin with 1 1/4 teaspoons dried mustard powder. It might be necessary to add 1/2 teaspoon cayenne when mixed the first time, but that's not necessary.

Random Ingredients: cayenne,oil,coriander leaf,ice water,sun tomato paste,plain nonfat yogurt,red curry paste
title: Suny Day Indian Curry
ingredients: 1 teaspoon oil | 1 teaspoon oil | 2 teaspoons red curry paste | 1 teaspoon sun-dried tomato paste | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | 1 cup ice water | 2/3 cup low-fat plain nonfat yogurt | 1/3 cup coriander leaves, finely chopped
instructions: In a deep saucepan, heat oil and curry paste.

title: Baked Crevette Oranges
ingredients: 18 large scallops | 12 large oranges | 1 1/2 cups chicken soup | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 cup semolina | 1 cup real orange marmalade, such as kahlua
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Trim or wash the scallops, taking out the outer shell and the excess skin. Cut the scallops lengthwise into 1/16 inch slices, and pound out any excess muscle with a meat mallet to flatten slightly. Arrange on a rimmed baking sheet and bake at 350°f for 20 to 30 minutes, just until the shells puff up and begin to darken. Place the orange segments in a large bowl, add the chicken soup, fennel seed, semolina, and marmalade. Mix well with clean hands to combine. Place the scallops on their shells and bake at 350°f for 20 to 25 minutes, or until the scallops turn opaque. Serve immediately, but be sure to watch carefully. Note, if you're worried, remove the scallop shells from the baking sheet and transfer to a serving dish, allowing excess liquid to drip back into the bowl. Use a slotted spoon to remove the scallops to the serving dish.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile,beef stock,iceberg lettuce,pork,spaghetti,dark chocolate,beer,pork shoulder
title: Truffle Smoked Chili (Carnival Chimayo)
ingredients: 1 -2 canned chipotle chile | 1/2 cup beef stock | 1 tablespoon dark chocolate or 1 tablespoon cocoa powder | 1 1/2 lbs boneless lean pork shoulder | 1/2 lb boneless lean pork butt | 14 ounces canned chipotle chiles | 1 head iceberg lettuce, shredded | 1 cup chilled beer | spaghetti
instructions: Puree chilies in food processor until smooth. Pour through cheesecloth in a medium bowl. Place remaining ingredients in slow cooker and stir, except bodacious pork shoulder. Cover and cook 2 hours on hi or 5 hours on low.

title: Napa Dave's Favorite Noodles
ingredients: 2 cups pasta, any size | 6 tablespoons chili powder, or to taste | 4 tablespoons finely chopped walnut oil | 1 tablespoon mustard | 2 leaves fresh basil, chopped
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the pasta, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink, and set aside. Return the pasta to the pot, and coat with chili powder. Heat the walnut oil in a skillet over medium heat, until hot. Stir in the mustard, and cook until it's very dark, like chocolate. Stir in the cooked pasta, basil, and chili powder. Serve over noodles.

title: Pomegranate Stew From Yakisoba
ingredients: 1 lb ground chuck | 1 green pomegranate, peeled ( seed if desired ) | 1/4 cup raisins | 1 tablespoon agave nectar | 1/2 cup sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 1/8 teaspoon crushed red pepper ( optional )
instructions: Rinse pomegranate and place in a bowl. Break up the peels. Dry pomegranate and use peeler to remove any loose seeds. Set aside. Brown ground chuck in large casserole. Add remaining ingredients. Heat to boiling, stirring to blend ingredients, and allow to simmer for at least an hour, stirring occosionally. The mixture will be soupy. Serve over hot rice, perhaps sprinkled with a bit of chablis or drizzled with a little extra greek yogurt, and served with sliced green onions and lots of chopped pimento pepper.

title: Easy Quinoa Con Carne (Mexican Style Quinoa Side Dish)
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa, uncooked | 1 lime, cut into wedges | 2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce
instructions: Place quinoa in a large bowl, cover with 1/4 cup hot water. Let stand 30 minutes. Drain, reserving liquid and fluff with a fork. Transfer quinoa to a baking dish, cover with foil and bake, tossing occasionally, in a preheated 350 degree oven until tender, 20 to 25 minutes. Meanwhile, squeeze juice from lime into a bowl. Toss with reserved liquid. Stir in worcestershire sauce. Remove quinoa from heat and toss with lime juice. Serve warm.

title: BBQ Lamb Shanks, Irish Style
ingredients: 12 lamb shanks | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke | 6 ounces smoked sausage, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 1 tablespoon apple, pared, grated | 12 ounces smoked lamb shanks | 3/4 cup dry irish british barley | 1/3 cup guacamole | 3/4 cup dry sauerkraut, rinsed, squeezed dry
instructions: Preheat a grill to medium high or place your oven rack 6 inches from the heat. In a flameproof casserole, over medium high, place the shanks and liquid smoke. Cook the shanks, turning occasionally, for about 45 minutes or until fully cooked.. Remove the shanks from the casserole. When cool enough to handle, cut them into pieces. In a blender or food processor, combine the sausage, apples, and lamb shank pieces and blend until finely chopped. Layer in the following order, 2 shanks and liquid smoke. 1 tablespoon guacamole. 1 more shank. 2 teaspoons arabic hot sauce, soaked 1 minute in the sauerkraut. Drain the rice in the strainer and place the rinsed, drained, drained rice in a bowl. Spread the guacamole on the rice and top with 1/2 cup sauerkraut. Drizzle with the remaining 1 tablespoon of sauerkraut. Place the shanks on the bbq or grill rack and cook until the meat is just cooked, about 10 minutes. Turn the shanks over and continue cooking until the rice is browned, about 10 minutes more. Turn the shanks over again and cook about 5 minutes longer. Cut diagonally into 8 wedges and serve with the rice.

title: Hot Broth
ingredients: 4 cups chicken stock or 4 cups broth | 15 ounces capers, rinsed and drained
instructions: Add broth and capers to your favourite soup pot or crockpot. Bring to simmer, cover, and cook for about 20 minutes. Stir. Serve.

title: Authentic Beef Jerky - Sausage
ingredients: 2 lbs top sirloin steaks, cut to about 1-inch inch thick | 1 jar enchilada sauce, i used old el paso mild | 1 1/2 teaspoons coriander, chopped & divided
instructions: Combine marinade ingredients. Place steak on broiler pan or rack placed in cookie sheet or a heavy duty paper bag with a rack. Apply half the marinade to the top sirloin steak. Place on rack. Broil 4 - 5 inches from heat for 7 - 10 minutes, or until done.

Random Ingredients: onion flake,mini meatball,vegetable,peanut,peach,cottage cheese,toblerone chocolate bar
title: Peach Surprise
ingredients: 1 package mini meatballs | 1 package frozen mixed vegetables | 1 cup peaches, cut in 1/2 inch slices | 1 cup chopped onion | 1 cup crushed peanuts | 1/2 cup whipped cottage cheese | 1 toblerone chocolate bar, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Place frozen mini meatballs in a greased and lined 3lb pan or in a lightly greased and floured bundt pan. Cover with fruit and onions. Spread remaining cheese over meatballs. Cover and bake 1 hour. Serve with chocolate sauce.

title: Cuban Coco Lopez
ingredients: 4 tablespoons dried raspberries ( i didn't make this, but it would be interesting with fresh raspberries ) | 1 lb chicken bouillon cube | 6 tablespoons minced shallots | salt, to taste | 2 tablespoons fresh cilantro leaves, minced | 1 can coco lopez
instructions: Rinse and drain raspberries. Place raspberries in blender, add bouillon and process until smooth, about 1 minute. Pour mixture over ground chicken, add shallots and cilantro and process again for about 1 to 2 minutes. Pour into a bowl. Pour can of coco lopez into saucepan with about ¾ cup water. Bring to a gentle boil over medium high heat and boil until thick, about 5 minutes. Ladle in bowl and ladle through a funnel over rice.

Random Ingredients: canadian bacon,banana pepper,passion fruit pulp,cider vinegar
title: Stove Top German Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 cup canadian bacon | 2 bunches paprika banana peppers, chopped | 1/2 cup can german-style bacon, chopped | 1/3 cup cider vinegar
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl and toss well. Chill one hour, then serve.

Random Ingredients: napa cabbage,brown rice,almond extract,chinese duck sauce,bay leaf
title: Roasted Chinese Cabbage
ingredients: 1 head napa cabbage | 1/4 cup chinese duck sauce | 3 tablespoons toasted slivered almonds ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon almond extract | 1/4 cup brown rice or 1/4 cup white rice
instructions: Cut the outer 2 inches of the cabbage so that the head resembles a regular cabbage. Remove core and discard. Cut the cabbage head lengthwise into 1/2-inch wedges or 1/4 to 1/2 inch thick wedges. Heat oven to 450°. Combine turkey duck sauce, almonds, and almond extract in a small bowl and set aside. Arrange cabbage wedges, separated by head, on a large rimmed baking sheet. Pour turkey duck mixture over cabbage and sprinkle with toasted slivered almonds. Bake in middle of oven for 45 to 60 minutes, or until the top is browned and cabbage is tender. Serve.

Random Ingredients: vanilla sugar,sea salt pepper,tequila,purpose flour,egg white,halloumi cheese,queso fresco
title: Halloumi Cheese Balls
ingredients: 8 ounces halloumi cheese, diced small | 4 ounces queso fresco, diced small | 1 egg white | 1/4 cup real butter, melted | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt and pepper, to taste | 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 1 tablespoon tequila
instructions: In a large bowl, mix cheese with egg white until well blended. Add melted butter, then mix in flour, sea salt, pepper, vanilla sugar, and tequila. Stir well to combine. Using your hands, flatten batter into 1 1/2 wide by 9 inch circle. Refrigerate until ready to cook. Lightly grease an 8x8 inch or larger pan. Cook until browned on the bottom, about 12 to 15 minutes. Use a knife to ease out the cooked batter. Serve immediately. To serve, scoop up the center of a plate, and slide your cheese rounds inside. Drizzle with a little tequila and serve with other side dishes such as sour cream and creme fraiche.

title: Sausages in Garlic
ingredients: 500 g breakfast sausages | 4 teaspoons garlic paste | 2 teaspoons anise seed | 1 1/2 teaspoons cornflour
instructions: Boil garlic in water until completely softened. Remove garlic and place in sieve to extract the liquid. Put garlic in food processor with salt, aniseeds and corn flour and process. Fry sausages quickly on both sides until the outside is crisp and golden brown. Serve with gravy.

title: Mexican Chicken
ingredients: 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cubed | 2 tablespoons instant espresso powder | 1 cup pearl barley | 2 large ripe tomatoes, chopped | 2 ounces unsweetened chocolate | 1 tablespoon hazelnuts
instructions: In a large skillet, stir together all ingredients. Transfer mixture to a crock or serving dish and set aside. Simmer over low heat for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,brandy,parsley sprig,heavy cream,bean sprout,beef bouillon cube
title: Beef Au Feu
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef ( or other good ground meat ) | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 8 teaspoons brandy or 8 teaspoons rum | 4 -8 drops cardamom seeds, to taste ( optional ) | 4 -6 parsley sprigs, to garnish | 2 beef bouillon cubes, crumbled, to taste ( optional )
instructions: Heat the beef in a medium skillet. Cook it over medium high heat until it has a nice brown color.. Pour the cream into the pan and stir occasionally. Watch the cream, boil it for about five minutes. Remove from heat and allow to cool. Add brandy to the cream. Add enough hot water to the cream and bring to a boil to dissolve the cream slightly. Add cardamom, if using. Add the beef and break it into small pieces. When it is cooked, remove the beef. Add the cream to the sauce. Pour the sauce over the beef and garnish with fresh parsley. Note, if the meat appears oily, add 1 tablespoon hot cream to the pan and mix well. If it appears to be soupy or dry, add more cream.

title: Simple Crock Pot Celery, Garlic, and Potatoes
ingredients: 6 medium baking potatoes, unpeeled | 1/2 - 1 head garlic, peeled, left whole
instructions: Wash and cut up the garlic into cloves. Put garlic cloves in a non corrosive crock pot and pour over enough water to get a good fit. Add enough water to cook the potatoes in a crock at least 4 - 5 hours on low.. When potatoes are done, add garlic and allow to come to a boil. You don't have to check it, it should be just right. Note, i have a 3 lb crock pot using a crock pot liner and the recipe i have for works well in a pan, so keep your cooking the veggies on low. The water i had just boiled up to about the level of the garlic and the potatoes can be eaten as is.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,tomato puree,turkey,chipotle pepper,salad green,dark brown sugar,island dressing,egg noodle
title: Ultimate Chipotle and Noodles
ingredients: 8 ounces egg noodles ( uncooked ) | vegetable oil flavored cooking spray | 1 lb ground turkey | 1 cup diced tomatoes with pimento and chipotle peppers | 1 teaspoon dark brown sugar | 1/4 cup thousand island dressing | 1 can tomato puree
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Cook noodles according to package directions, drain. Coat a large skillet with cooking spray and brown turkey. Drain off excess grease and add tomatoes. Mix brown sugar, sauce and chipotle well. Add to turkey and simmer until thickened. Place noodles and turkey onto a 10x6x2 casserole dish. Pour sauce over and cover with foil. Bake until heated through, about 11/2 15 minutes. Serve with crispy, fresh corn bread or sourdough bread.

title: Tarantula (Ethiopian Dipping Sauce)
ingredients: 1/2 cup distilled white vinegar | 1 teaspoon sambal oelek ( hot pepper sauce )
instructions: Mix together in a jar with lid. Serve in an earthenware container with a tight fitting lid. Let it slowly spritz a jar before serving.

title: Cauliflower Wrapped in Doritos
ingredients: 1 large cauliflower, florets separated | 1 package refrigerated pie shells | 1 cup doritos, crushed ( mexican cactus chips ) | 1 teaspoon dried basil, crushed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Mix doritos and basil until well combined. Place cut side up in a 9x13 inch pan that has been sprayed with pam. Bake at 400 degrees f for 5 to 10 minutes or until lightly toasted. Remove from oven and top with cauliflower. Place a toasted bag of doritos in the center of the filling. Roll, and serve.

Random Ingredients: black,chipotle pepper adobo sauce,irish cream,phyllo pastry,picante sauce,kosher salt black pepper,chili oil
title: Tex Mex Blackened Phyllo Triangles With Chipotle Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chili oil | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1/2 teaspoon finely minced chipotle pepper in adobo sauce | 1/2 cup adobo sauce | 1/2 cup picante sauce, plus more for pan | 1/2 cup bailey's irish cream ( optional ) | 1 phyllo pastry sheet ( thawed and left out of the refrigerator, if needed, but recommended, for an even thinner, thinner, and more manageable filo pastry sheet )
instructions: Position a 12 x 1 inch non stick baking sheet in the freezer. Heat the chile oil in a heavy medium size saucepan over medium high heat. Season with salt and pepper. Sauté the chipotle pepper with adobo sauce for 2 minutes, until warm. Remove the pan from the heat and stir in the picante sauce and the bailey's, if using. In a large, heavy duty, clean bowl with a well hanging over at edges, layer the filo sheets. Add 1/3 of the chipotle cream sauce to the bottom of the pan to coat. Arrange a second layer of filo sheets in the pan. Spread 1/3 of the remaining chipotle cream sauce and 1/3 of the remaining sauce over the filo. Add 1/3 of the remaining sauce, and top with the sheet of filo. Using a large, sharp knife, score all the sheets of filo into 2 triangles. Brush the edges with a little water, fold over, and slice crosswise into triangles. Repeat until all the triangles are used or you have assembled 12 servings.

Random Ingredients: black pepper boursin cheese,chicken broth,brown sugar,bean
title: Easy Peasy Boursin Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup fat-free low-fat chicken broth | 1/4 cup fat free refried beans | 2 tablespoons brown sugar ( brown sugar can be found in health food section of grocery store ) | 1/2 teaspoon black pepper ( optional )
instructions: Blend all ingredients until smooth. Pour into jar with tight lid.

title: White Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 can white beans ( drained ) | 3/4 lb feta cheese ( crumbled ) | 3 -4 raspberries
instructions: Blend all ingredients into a bowl. Serve with toasted croutons. To make russian dressing, drizzle oil over cooled croutons. Add a dash of cinnamon.

Random Ingredients: hot red pepper flake,taco seasoning mix,vinegar
title: Homemade Taco Onions
ingredients: 7 lbs onions, peeled and sliced into rings | 1 cup taco seasoning mix | 1/2 cup vinegar
instructions: Place onions into a colander in a large bowl. Sprinkle generously with taco seasoning. Stir to coat onions completely. Cover and leave in the refrigerator, stirring occasionally. After about 48 hours, remove onions and drain liquid, leaving enough liquid to pour over the onions. Discard liquid. Cover and refrigerate overnight. The next day, remove from refrigerator and drain onions. Place onions into a large, shallow pan or roaster. Arrange drained onions on top of onions. Mix the vinegar, seasoning mix and any leftover liquid from the onions, tossing well together. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Cook's notes, restaurant and food writers may use 1 3/4 cups of water to rinse liquid from the onions, but the onions will need to be covered by the liquid at this time. If the onions have absorbed the liquid before cooking, allow them to cool to room temp before cooking.

title: Fajita Quesadilla
ingredients: 2 soft flour tortillas, cut into quarters | 1/2 tablespoon fajita-flavored lime juice
instructions: Place a quarter portion of tortillas on a work surface. Carefully fold a quarter portion of tortillas in half, then press each quarter portion to form a triangle. Spread a layer of fajita lime juice evenly on one side of each quesadilla square.

Random Ingredients: yukon gold potato,green olive,canola oil,pinto bean
title: Spanish Potato and Olive Salad (Tapas)
ingredients: 16 ounces yukon gold potatoes ( about 4 medium ) | 1 lb can pinto beans, rinsed and drained | canola oil, for frying ( or sunflower ) | 1/4 cup sliced pimento-stuffed green olives
instructions: Cook potatoes in boiling salted water 5 - 8 minutes or until tender. Drain and peel. Boil beans in lightly salted water until tender crisp. Drain and cool under running water, then peel potatoes and slice into 1/4 to 1/2 inch wide x 1/4 inch slices. Combine potatoes, beans, and 1 t oil into a bowl. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Sprinkle with olives just before serving.

title: Lumpia Pie
ingredients: 1 package frozen shortcrust pastry | 1 1/2 cups half-and-half or 1 1/2 cups cream, warmed | 1 cup ice
instructions: Roll out pastry on floured board until 4 x 9 inches. Cut out 8 pie shaped wedges with star tip or sharp knife. Roll out wedges a little more than 1/4 inch thick, then press into 9 pie shaped pastry. Pour heated cream over top, then refrigerate until firm. Cut into 5 wedges using sharp knife that has been cut in half horizontally. Bake at 425f for 12 minutes or til golden brown, turning once. Serve cold with crackers, or a glaze of your choice.

title: Tamari and Italian Sausages
ingredients: 2 lbs sweet ground mild italian sausage links ( i had it at a mexican market ) | 1/4 cup dry onion flakes | 1 1/2 tablespoons tamari
instructions: In a large bowl, combine hot sausage, onion and tamari. Mix well and form mixture into 1 inch balls.

title: Peruvian Potatoes & Noodles (Cameroon)
ingredients: 3 2/3 lbs russet potatoes or 2 2/3 lbs yukon gold potatoes, peeled, cut lengthwise into 1/4-inch-wide strips, about 7 cups | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 3 tablespoons packed fresh cilantro, minced | 2 tablespoons minced fresh parsley leaves | 3 tablespoons minced fresh cilantro leaves | hot cooked rice noodles or thin spaghetti
instructions: Cook potatoes in boiling hot water about 7 minutes. Drain and set aside to cool slightly. Meanwhile, toss potatoes, ketchup, cilantro, parsley and cilantro in large bowl. Cover and refrigerate at least 3 hours or overnight. Arrange potatoes in single layer on rack in broiler pan. Broil or grill 5 to 10 minutes, or until lightly browned and crisp. Slide onto platter and sprinkle each serving with 1 tablespoon minced fresh cilantro.

Random Ingredients: cottage cheese,dark chocolate,candy sprinkle,rump roast,mint,carrot,apple,green chili pepper
title: Carrot Beef Pot Roast Sandwich
ingredients: 1/4 cup chopped of fresh mint | 8 ounces shaved dark chocolate | 1 teaspoon grated fresh green chili peppers | 1 tablespoon paprika ( sweet ) or 1 tablespoon cayenne pepper | 1 small carrot, grated | 4 -5 leaves leftover rump roast | 1/4 cup low fat cottage cheese or 1/4 cup ricotta salata cheese | 1 tablespoon finely chopped of fresh mint | candy sprinkles, for garnish
instructions: Pierce one side of the rump roast about 3/4 way through to make a pocket. Place the shaved dark chocolate, chopped green chili pepper and paprika in a small microwavable bowl and stir to combine. Place the shaved roast in the center of the chocolate mixture. Spoon the mixture over the roast and place the rump roast on a microwave safe plate. Pierce numerous slices of carrot around the roast with a fork to allow steam to escape. Microwave on high for 45 - 60 seconds. Remove the instant read thermometer and top with shredded carrot. Microwave on high for 10 - 15 minutes more. Remove the beef from the microwave with a slotted spoon and place on a serving platter/top of a serving platter. Add a handful of spiced cottage cheese to a plate to help hold the sauce slightly in the pot. Place a mint leaf in a small pile on top of the cottage cheese. Serve with a little whipped cream and a sprinkle of freshly chopped mint and optional grated carrot.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,parmigiano reggiano cheese,bratwurst
title: Tuscan Brats
ingredients: 4 bratwursts | 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 4 pinches grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place bratwurst on a baking pan. Drizzle with olive oil. Sprinkle the grated cheese over the brats. Bake in the preheated oven until brats are browned and crispy, 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Lobster Tails
ingredients: 1 large fennel bulb, cored | 2 lobster tails, fresh meat, peeled | ground cayenne pepper, or to taste
instructions: Cut the fennel bulb in half lengthwise and cut in half again lengthwise. Remove the feathery white membrane along one edge of the fennel.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,bourbon,asafoetida powder,celery rib,ricotta cheese,linguine,chocolate chip
title: Sweet & Spicy Stuffed Peppers
ingredients: 1 package linguine | 2 tablespoons light cream b bourbon or 2 tablespoons rum | 1 package anthotiro cheese, at room temperature | 2 tablespoons fat free ricotta cheese | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1/4 cup chunky salsa | 2 tablespoons shredded low-fat chocolate chips | 1 large celery rib, sliced
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain. Combine the 1st measure of ingredients in a medium bowl except the celery. Mix, set aside to cool slightly. Cut stem off the celery and reserve. Cut 1/2 slice from the top of the celery stalk and discard. Slice the remaining stalk thinly over the celery and discard. Place slices of celery in each pasta shells. Divide the filling among the peppers, spooning 1/3 of the chunky salsa in the center of each. Garnish with the reserved cheese. Serve with additional salsa if desired.

title: Chocolate-Crab Wings
ingredients: 1/2 kg prepared chicken wings, cut into 2-inch lengths | 1/3 liter kahlua | 600 g dark chocolate, chopped coarsely | 2 1/2 cups cake flour | 250 g fresh crabmeat, shredded | 8 fresh sage leaves | 5 -10 fresh edible dried hot chocolate
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c/350°f put wings and kahlua into a large saucepan and bring to the boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat and simmer for 2 minutes. Mix together ground chocolate and cake flour and add to saucepan and stir until well combined. Add crab and sage and gently stir until well combined. Transfer to ovenproof dish. Bake for 50 - 55 minutes, or until golden brown. Allow to cool completely. Strain and store in an airtight container for up to 2 months.

title: Miniature Red Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 can small red beans, drained and rinsed | 1 cup feta cheese | 1 pint plum juice | 1 tablespoon almond extract | 1 1/2 cups fresh lingonberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f and lightly oil a 9 x 13 baking dish. Combine beans, cheese, plum juice, and almond extract in a blender until smooth. Combine berries and cheese mixture. Pour mixture into baking dish, filling to 1/3. Bake for 30 minutes, or until cheese melts and sauce has thickened. Cool 5 minutes before serving, or refrigerate at least up to 3 hours.

title: Amber's Linguine Delight
ingredients: 1/2 lb linguine | 1/2 lb sirloin, thinly sliced | 1/2 lb hamburger | 6 -8 ounces peas ( fresh or frozen ) | 1/3 cup apple cider vinegar | 1 cup double cream ( whipping cream )
instructions: Fry the linguine in a little olive oil. Set aside when finished. Slice the hamburger as thinly as possible. Set aside. In a large skillet pour in a little more olive oil and cook the hamburger. Then add the peas. When the hamburger is fully cooked, add the lemon slices. Pour the vinegar. Set aside. Drain all of the liquid from the cooked linguine and place into a serving bowl. Cut the linguine into bite size pieces. Add the cream to the hamburger mixture, and stir and mix. Pour this over the linguine, and refrigerate until serving time.

title: Artichokes, Pineapple, Black Olives, and Artichoke Hearts
ingredients: 1 can drained artichoke hearts, rinsed and drained | 1 can drained, crushed pineapple with juice | 1 can sliced black olives
instructions: Arrange artichokes, pineapple with juice, and olives in the bottom of a medium bowl. Chill to blend flavors, about 1 hour. Serve cold.

title: Easy Veggies With Garlic on Garlic Croutons
ingredients: 1 lb tiny peas or 1 lb carrots | 1 minced garlic clove
instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add garlic and cook for 1 - 2 minutes. Meanwhile, steam the peas until tender. In a casserole dish over low heat, add the peas. Pour garlic and garlic over the peas and mix. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,beef brisket,couscous,french bread,coconut,celery rib,onion powder,pie crust
title: Couscous Beef
ingredients: 2 ounces prepared couscous | 1 1/3 lbs beef brisket, well trimmed of excess fat | 1 tablespoon onion powder | 1 celery rib, trimmed & sliced | 1 green bell pepper, seeded & cut into chunks | 2 large yellow bell peppers, seeded & cut into chunks | 8 -12 slices french bread | 1/4 cup shredded coconut
instructions: Make the couscous, using the water indicated on the box, stir in the onion powder & beef. Cover & leave in the marinating for 2 hours. Prepare the filling, heat oven to 425 degrees. Place the meat, vegetables & crust in a roasting pan and arrange on top. Roast for a total of 75 minutes, or until the meat is just cooked & tender. Remove from the oven & pour the filling over the meat. Sprinkle with coconut if desired & return it to the oven to bake for 10 - 15 minutes, or until it has melted & is heated through & the filling is warmed. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: no salt tomato,cauliflower floret,pecorino romano cheese,cream mushroom soup,chili garlic sauce,penne,green chili pepper
title: Spicy Cauliflower and Creamy Penne
ingredients: 1 lb penne, cooked and drained | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/3 cup canned diced green chili pepper | 4 teaspoons chili-garlic sauce | 1 medium cauliflower floret, cut into pieces | 2 ounces pcorino romano cheese, shredded | freshly grated pecorino romano cheese
instructions: In a skillet over medium high heat, add cauliflower and sauté until just starting to soften, about 5 minutes. Add soup, chilies, garlic sauce, and pepper sauce, and cook for 3 minutes. Toss cooked pasta with sauce and serve with cheese on top.

title: Spicy Chinese Coffee
ingredients: 200 ml hot coffee | 1 teaspoon soya sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in the mug and mix gently.

Random Ingredients: french bread,enchilada sauce,orange bell pepper,pineapple ring,white bean,red cabbage,peanut oil,confectioner ' sugar
title: Mexican White Bean and Pineapple Panzanella
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread, sliced into 6 slices, 3/4-inch thick | 8 ounces unsweetened baked white beans ( or homemade, canned beans may be used in place of beans ) | 3/4 cup canned white beans, drained and rinsed | 8 pineapple rings, halved | 1 red cabbage, thinly sliced | 1 small orange bell pepper, sliced | 1/4 cup peanut oil | 1/8 cup enchilada sauce | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f arrange the 4 bread slices in a single layer on a baking sheet. Bake until toasted, about 8 minutes. Stir together the beans, drained pineapple, and pineapple.

Random Ingredients: purpose flour,salmon fillet,orange liqueur,nori,flat leaf italian parsley,cherry tomato
title: Italian Creamed Salmon
ingredients: 2 salmon fillets, skin removed | 4 sheets nori ( dry seaweed ) | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour, plus extra for dusting | 1/2 cup orange flavoured liqueur | 2 tablespoons chopped flat-leaf italian parsley | 1 pint cherry tomatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°f. Line a baking sheet with clingfilm, then lightly spray with olive oil or butter. Roll each piece of salmon in flour. Arrange on baking sheet. Dollop 1/2 tbsp of the liqueur on each piece of salmon. Sprinkle with herbs. Bake 35 to 40 minutes, or until opaque and cooked through, depending on the thickness of the fillet. Serve hot, with any side of meal.

Random Ingredients: poblano chile,sea bass fillet,baking potato,jalapeno pepper,spinach,bacon,bay leaf
title: Baked Sea Bass With Spinach
ingredients: 4 sea bass fillets | 1 bay leaf | 1 large baking potato, peeled, cut into eighths | 2 poblano chiles, seeded and chopped | 2 -3 slices bacon | 1 cup frozen chopped spinach, thawed | 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded and chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. Line a baking sheet with foil or parchment paper. Season the fish with salt and pepper and set aside while preparing the vegetables. Place the bay leaf and potato in an oven proof dish, then arrange poblanos over the top. Cook for 10 minutes, covering with a piece of foil to keep them from burning. Stir in the bacon, then place the fish on top of the potatoes along with any vegetables on the baking sheet. Place in the oven once oven temperature reaches 400°. Bake uncovered for 18 to 20 minutes, or until fish is easily flaked with a fork, adding another piece of foil if needed, until it flakes easily with a fork and vegetables soften. Add the spinach, then season with salt and pepper. Serve with frijoles a la spokes of a wheel.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile,olive oil,egg wrap,green chile,ham,heavy whipping cream,vegetable oil cooking spray,mushroom
title: Sue's Egg Rolls
ingredients: 8 egg roll wraps | 3 tablespoons finely chopped fresh vegetable oil, divided | 1/2 lb ham, cooked ( or turkey ) | 1 can chopped green chiles | 1/2 lb mixed mushrooms | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/4 cup chipotle chile, chopped and seeded | olive oil cooking spray
instructions: Brown the ham, turkey or vegetables in 3 tablespoons of oil. Remove from pan and drain. Add chicken to pan with remaining 2 tablespoons of oil and the green chile chilies. Saute over medium high heat until chicken is well cooked, about 5 minutes. Remove and keep warm with lid on pan while making egg rolls. In the same pan, add 2 tablespoons of oil to a small pot and fry the marinated chicken for 10 minutes on a medium heat until chicken is cooked through. When done, remove from pan and keep warm. Add cream and the chipotle chile to the ham, turkey or vegeti and chile mixture and simmer over low heat for 5 minutes. Place 1 egg roll wrapper on a cutting board and lay a small piece of ham in the middle of them folded in half. Add 1/4 of the egg roll mixture on top of the ham and stuffing. Top the eggroll with a small dollop of stuffing. Roll up from the long side. Place on a cookie sheet and spray lightly with cooking spray. Bake in the oven at 375 degrees for 20 - 25 minutes until cooked through.

Random Ingredients: pine nut,turmeric,serrano pepper,salmon fillet,whipping cream,celery rib,rosemary
title: Grilled Salmon With Creamy Pine Nut Mousse
ingredients: 1 cup whipping cream | 1/4 cup fresh rosemary, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric | 2 serrano peppers | 1 celery rib, cut into 1/4-inch slices | 4 salmon fillets, 6 to 8 fillets each 6 to 7 inches in diameter ( skin on ) | 1/2 cup pine nuts, lightly toasted, chopped and divided ( about 2 tbsp )
instructions: Combine cream, mint, turmeric, and remaining ¼ cup of the chopped rosemary in bowl of electric mixer. Reserve one piece of serrano chili pepper. Cut remaining serrano chili pepper into very thin slices and add to cream mixture. Soak salmon fillets at room temperature 1 hour or refrigerate for up to 3 days. Preheat grill on medium, or preheat broiler. In medium bowl, gently blend together chile, cream mixture, and 2 tbsp of the chopped rosemary. Arrange salmon fillets on work surface and top with mousse. Sprinkle with remaining chopped rosemary and pine nuts. Grill salmon over medium hot fire with 1/2 inch of water until cooked through, 3 to 4 minutes per side, depending on thickness of fillets. Serve with remaining chopped rosemary and pine nuts.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,chili sauce,garam masala,vegetable oil cooking spray,caraway seed,bouquet garni
title: A Simple and Yummiest Bouquet Garni
ingredients: 8 -20 small fresh vegetables, depending on size, eg sweet peppers, tomatoes, baby boillies ( e.g. broccoli, cauliflower, beet, or potato ) | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 1 tablespoon sweet chili sauce | 1 teaspoon caraway seed ( optional ) | vegetable oil cooking spray
instructions: Slice vegetables and place in a large dish. Spray both sides of the bouquet garni with oil. Sprinkle the garam masala on the vegetables and toss well to coat. Place vegetables in remaining dish and spray vegetables again with oil. Sprinkle the chilli sauce on top. Cover dish and cook on high for 20 - 25 minutes or on medium/high for 4 - 5 minutes. Let stand for 15 minutes before serving. Serve in individual bowls with fresh bread or with basmati or rice. Tip, to prevent vegetables from sticking to the bottom of the dish, cook only a small amount of hot water when adding the bouquet garni to taste to avoid the bouquet garni becoming slimy. Tip, a good idea is to add vegetables to the dish before serving.

title: Arepas With Corn, Gruyere & Lemon
ingredients: 100 g gruyere cheese ( you may use swiss or emmenthal ) | 4 -8 creamed corn kernels, boiled | 1 tablespoon grated lemon peel | 3 tablespoons icing sugar
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200c/130c fan forced. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Grate or slice the gruyere, set aside. Place the creamed corn in a bowl & add the lemon peel. With your hands, crush it into a roughly rough paste with a mallet, or by hand. Mix together the corn & cheese, then add the cheese mixture & lemon, then mix until the mixture is well incorporated. Spread the mixture on the prepared tray & bake for 20 mins, stirring every 5 mins to make sure it is evenly browned. Cool a few mins, then cut into slices & spread with icing sugar.

Random Ingredients: beef roast,pearl onion,taco seasoning mix,mint leaf,red leaf lettuce,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Minty Beef Dip
ingredients: 1 beef roast | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1/2 bunch red leaf lettuce | 8 large fresh mint leaves | 1/2 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 8 large fresh mint leaves
instructions: Slice off top of roast about 1/2 inch of any thin slicing that you like and set aside. Place the roast in the center of a piece of reynolds wrap heavy duty aluminum foil. Spread the seasoning evenly over the roast. Using two slivers of lettuce and 2 of the mint leaves, roll up the slice from the center outwards like it's closing up to form a cylinder.. Repeat on the other end to make a total of eight roll ups. You should have the roast rolls about three inches long. Sprinkle the wrap with a little ground black pepper. Set the roll ups side by side on a foil lined baking sheet and cook at 375 degrees f on the top shelf for about 3 hours.. Use a fork, slice or shred the roast to desired thickness and serve. Minty beef dip, place about 1/4 cup of the mint and 1/4 cup of the cheese in a jar and shake until combined and melted. Stir a handful of fresh mint leaves into dip and serve.

title: Shelly's Potluck Beef Burgers
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 2 tablespoons pinto beans, soaked overnight and cooked | 2 tablespoons white miso | 6 tablespoons half-and-half | 2 medium potatoes, peeled ( diced )
instructions: In a non stick frying pan add beef and beans. Brown and crumble meat with miso for 5 minutes, remove and add potatoes to hamburgers. Mix thoroughly with potato, add half and half. Bake at 375 degrees for 15 - 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: clam,molasses,red onion,spicy brown mustard,torn romaine lettuce,ranch dressing
title: Mexican Baked Clam Salad
ingredients: 1 can whole clams, drained and chopped | 1/4 cup molasses | 1/3 cup spicy brown mustard | 1/4 cup ranch dressing | 1/4 cup diced red onion | 1/4 cup torn romaine lettuce
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In a medium baking dish, mix the clams, molasses, mustard, ranch dressing, onion and lettuce. Bake in the preheated oven for 30 to 40 minutes, or until flavors are blended.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,coriander,vegetable oil,seasoning mix,flax seed,hamburger,coffee,egg yolk
title: Panko Corned Beef Sandwich (Barefoot Contessa)
ingredients: 2/3 lb hamburger | 1/4 cup instant coffee | 1 tablespoon flour | 1 teaspoon vegetable oil | 4 egg yolks, lightly beaten | 2 ounces seasoned stuffing mix | 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream or 1/4 cup milk | 1 teaspoon ground coriander | seasoning mix ( optional )
instructions: Make the corn corns as directed on the package, but only cook them exactly as directed on the package and reserve the cooked corn for later. If you use pre soaked, whole, frozen corn beef hashbrowns, cook for 5 - 7 minutes or until no longer pink. Drain on paper towels or grease a jelly roll pan and set aside. Grill the hamburger until cooked to your liking, turning if necessary. Drain off any excess grease from the meat and transfer to the crockpot. Sprinkle the coffee over the hamburger and cover. Set on low for six hours or medium low for 10 to 12 hours. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, mix the flour and oil. In a medium sized bowl, beat the egg yolks, then whisk in the seasoned stuffing mix, heavy whipping cream or milk and coriander until well blended. Add a drop or two of seasoning if desired. Remove the corn beef hashbrowns from the crockpot and spread about 1 1/2 tablespoons of the gravy over the bottom of the crockpot. Top with the fried beef and spread a few tablespoons of gravy on the beef and beef. Repeat with remaining gravy and beef. Cook on high for at least twenty minutes, or on low for several hours, or until the gravy thickens slightly and the ingredients are warm.

title: Sweet Pot Pulled Beef
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs sirloin steaks, trimmed | 1 cup port wine vinegar | 12 ounces lean boneless pork roast, trimmed
instructions: Cut meat into 5 inch pieces. Add meat to a heavy plastic bag. Add pork and marinade. Refrigerate at least 8 hours or overnight. Place meat, fat side up, on a rack in a roasting pan large enough to hold it. Roast in a 375° oven for about 2 hours, turn several times to brown lightly and roast evenly. Tent with foil. Remove meat to a warm platter and allow to cool slightly. Transfer meat to a platter or platter, allowing some of juices to be collected.

Random Ingredients: beef stock,white bread flour,mix,crouton,ginger root,milk ricotta cheese,gruyere cheese
title: Gruymesti
ingredients: 500 g shredded gruyere cheese | 350 g plain white bread flour | 4 tablespoons sour mix | 300 ml hot beef stock | 500 g whole milk ricotta cheese | 1 piece fresh ginger root, finely chopped | crouton
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees celsius or gas grease a 2 cup ovenproof dish. Put the grated cheese in a large bowl. Mix in the bread flour, sour, beef stock, ginger and shredded cheese until the mixture makes a doughy dough with no lumps. On a floured surface, knead the dough until smooth and elastic. Form into a ball and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Divide the dough into pieces. Flour a work surface and roll the ball. With floured hands, cut out 2 circles of 5 cm diameter. Line the bottom and sides of the baking dish with the circles, leaving a few cm between each layer. Place dough circles on top of the circles of dough. Sprinkle the top of the dough with croutons. Bake for 20 minutes. Serve with butter or cream.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,rhubarb,cucumber,chili sauce,graham cracker,white vinegar,lemon wedge,pork loin chop
title: Spicy Pork Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 teaspoon white vinegar | 2 teaspoons curry powder | 4 boneless pork loin chops, about 1-inch thick | 4 green cucumbers, very thinly sliced | 4 rhubarb, ends trimmed, sliced into 1/4-inch slices | 1 cup sweet chili sauce | 3/4 cup sweet chili sauce | 3/4 cup lemon juice, freshly squeezed | 1 bag frozen graham crackers, coarsely crushed
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together vinegar and curry powder. Dredge pork chops in the mixture.

title: No-Timely Moist Mincemeat Loaf
ingredients: 500 g mincemeat | 2 boxes jiffy corn muffin mix, packets | 2 tablespoons celery or 2 tablespoons chives, chopped | 1 tablespoon vanilla instant pudding | 1 teaspoon mace
instructions: Heat oven to 180c. Grease loaf tin, and line with baking paper. Combine mincemeat, fettucine, celery or chives, pudding mixes & mace. Mix carefully with wet hands until combined. Spoon ¾ cup of mincemeat mixture into prepared tin and spread evenly. Sprinkle with remaing grated cheese. Bake for 1 1/2 hour.

title: Cheese Sticks
ingredients: 6 1/2 ounces manchego cheese | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1 bamboo skewers, soaked in | 1 tablespoon water
instructions: In a blender puree the cheese, cornflour and 2 teaspoons of water until the mixture is smooth and the mixture is no longer runny. Pour the blended mixture into a piping hot mould and carefully pipe the cheese mixture onto the skewers. Roll out skewers to form sticks about 6 cm long and 5 cm wide. Heat a barbecue plate on medium heat and barbecue or grill the cheese sticks for 3 minutes each side until they are slightly softened.

Random Ingredients: red wine,cauliflower,stewing beef,black olive,pineapple chunk,red food coloring,coconut cream
title: Pineapple Beef Stew
ingredients: 1/2 lb stewing beef | 1 large cauliflower or 1 large broccoli floret | 8 ounces fresh pineapple chunks | 1 can unsweetened coconut cream | 1 jar diced canned pineapple | 2 1/2 cups red wine or 2 1/2 cups white wine | red food coloring
instructions: Cut beef into 1/2 inch cubes. Cut cauliflower or broccoli floret into 1 inch florets. Remove stem and seeds of pineapple pieces and discard. Rinse the meat well with cold water, and pat dry with paper towels. Place in bottom of slow cooker, cover with cauliflower or broccoli floret and pineapple slices. Sprinkle with coconut cream, pineapple and red wine. Sprinkle with food coloring. Cover and cook for 6 to 8 hours on medium low or until meat is tender and vegetables and nuts are tender.

title: Diane's Cumin Pickles
ingredients: 5 dill pickles, sliced | 2 oranges, quartered | 4 cumin powder
instructions: Place oranges in a bowl of cold water. Soak at least 1 hour or use 2 cups water and 1/2 cup of cold water. Remove fruit from water, rinse, and pat dry. Cut in 1/2 rounds and slice. Place on a medium hot griddle with a little oil underneath. Cook over a medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes on one side until golden. Turn and lightly brown the other side. You can also use napa, cucumber, onions, black bean, celery.

title: Lentil and Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 1 package dry lentils, rinsed and drained | 3 lbs boneless beef chuck | 3 tablespoons dried dill
instructions: Cover chickpeas and lentils with water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes or until tender. Meanwhile, cut beef into 1/2 inch cubes and reserve. Strain chickpeas and lentils and mix with beef and dill and set aside. Cook and stir over medium high heat for 2 minutes or until beef is no longer pink. Serve and enjoy.

title: Sopes (Chorizo Breads)
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups spanish-style chorizo, crumbled or 2 1/2 cups cooked ham, grated | 1/4 cup masa harina
instructions: In a medium mixing bowl, add all ingredients, knead until well blended. On a floured surface, roll into a 1 inch thick rope. Cut the rope into 1 inch chunks. Place in a greased or oiled baking sheet. Bake at 400° f for 15 minutes, or until lightly browned.

title: Spicy Chicken & Nori Samosas
ingredients: 24 sheets frozen phyllo pastry | 8 ounces cooked chicken | 1/2 cup vegetable broth | 2 teaspoons dried marjoram | 2 teaspoons ground cayenne | 1 lime, quartered | 1 fresh nori, sheet cut into 3-inch cubes
instructions: Thaw phyllo pastry at room temperature and preheat oven to 400°f. Cut phyllo pastry sheets in half crosswise to form four squares. Place 3 triangles on each of the 4 sheets of phyllo. Cut chicken into bite size pieces. Place the chicken, vegetable broth, marjoram, cayenne, and lime quarters in a microwave safe, nonstick skillet. Cover and microwave on high heat 15 seconds. Place a square of phyllo on a sheet of plastic wrap. Place half of the chicken mixture on top of the phyllo, then fold corners over the top and roll tightly. Place seam side down on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Repeat until phyllo pastry is gone from pan. Place parchment paper over chicken and cut roll into 4 pieces. Serve with salsa. Cook's notes, to freeze, place a sheet of phyllo wrapped chicken on sheet of plastic wrap and cut in half diagonally so it will be frozen for ease when wrapping.

title: Prawns With Cumin, Rice Wine & Cumin (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 11)
ingredients: 8 teaspoons cumin seeds | 450 g peeled uncooked prawns, washed
instructions: Heat oven to 220c/gas grind the cumin seeds in a mortar and pestle. Stir the cumin and pesser into the prawns and coat well, then press the cumin and prawn into the prawns. Place on a non stick baking tray, bake for 8 - 10 minutes, turning or shaking the tray and baking over time. Serve warm.

title: Fennel Raisin Spread
ingredients: 1 cup fresh raisins or 1 cup candied raisins, soaked and drained | 3 cups light cream | 1/2 cup chopped toasted almond ( or to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon lemon rind ( or to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed
instructions: Soak raisins in boiling water for 10 minutes. Drain and rinse. Strain raisins. Mix all ingredients in mixing bowl until well mixed. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours.

title: Potato Nests
ingredients: 1 jar potato flakes | 1 -2 teaspoon chilies
instructions: Put potato flakes onto a floured board. Form into small finger sized fingers. Using a rolling pin make finger sized indentations across top. Use a teaspoon to indent the opening in the fingers at the neck of each finger. Push the fingers up into the cup where they are going to be able to get to the top. Roll the finger sized fingers in potato flakes covering all of the hole. Prick the lid of the jar with a fork and put lid back under to secure. Let sit for 6 hours in the fridge. When ready to serve it will make a pretty dented red dot in the top of the nests.

title: Julie's Roquefort Ham
ingredients: 1/2 yellow bell pepper | 1/2 lb thinly sliced ham | 1/3 cup roquefort cheese | 1 -2 tablespoon chopped fresh basil
instructions: Cut bell pepper into matchsticks. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Lay bell pepper pieces on baking sheet, shiny side down. Roast about 10 minutes or until tender with light brown edges. Turn bell peppers and roast for an additional 5 minutes. Remove from oven. Cool slightly. In med size bowl, mix red pepper, ham, cheese and basil until well mixed. Fill ham with mixture and sprinkle with salt and/or pepper to taste. You can also sprinkle ham with parsley if like.

title: Pretend Slice
ingredients: 4 small tomatoes | 8 -12 pieces white bread | 1 lb beef brisket, sliced | 12 soft ladyfingers | 3/4 cup dark brown sugar | 2 cans refrigerated biscuits | 1 ounce dark brown sugar | waffle
instructions: In medium baking tray arrange tomatoes on top, cut crusts off crisp crusts. Cover, refrigerate. Meanwhile, lay the bread pieces on a tray. Place brisket slices on top of the bread. Combine the sugar, biscuits and brown sugar, dip biscuit crumbs in, coat with brown sugar mixture. Arrange on top of brisket slices. Cover the brisket with the biscuits. Make waffles. Grill on middle rack 3 minutes on each side or until biscuits are golden. Cool, slice and serve.

Random Ingredients: ladyfinger,dark soy sauce,yogurt,black bean,marjoram,ginger root,plain flour,macadamia nut
title: Macadamia Nut and Black Bean Tarts
ingredients: 8 ounces macadamia nuts | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 inch piece fresh ginger root, chopped | 2 tablespoons plain flour | 2 tablespoons marjoram | 8 ounces soft unsweetened yogurt | 8 ladyfingers | 1 can black beans
instructions: Cook macadamia nuts in a dry frying pan over medium heat, stirring to break into pieces, until lightly toasted and fragrant. Let cool, then coarsely chop coarsely. Transfer to a small bowl. In a mixing bowl, stir together dark soy sauce and ginger until creamy. Stir in flour until just mixed. Stir in nut mixture and marjoram.

title: Sesame Seeds Granola
ingredients: 1 tablespoon toasted sesame seeds | 1 cup toasted almond, cut into thin strips | olive oil flavored cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Lightly sprinkle sesame seeds on a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until fragrant and golden, 10 to 12 minutes. Cool slightly. Coarsely chop sesame seeds. Place almonds in a small bowl. Cover with olive oil. Set aside. Spread sesame seeds on a baking sheet just large enough to hold them all. Bake in the preheated oven until golden, 10 to 12 more minutes. Cool to room temperature. Transfer to an airtight container. Let cool completely. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: tomato soup,apricot,parsley sprig,maraschino cherry,french bread,cilantro leaf,peanut
title: Mexican Bread Croutons
ingredients: 24 slices french bread, toasted | 2 cans condensed tomato soup | chopped fresh parsley sprig | 1/2 cup chopped dried apricot | 1/2 cup chopped cilantro leaves, plus more | chopped fresh parsley sprig | 1/2 cup roasted dry roasted peanuts, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese or 1/2 cup pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Pour the soup into a shallow 2 2/3 inch wide soup baking dish. Arrange the bread slices on top. Sprinkle with parsley, apricots, cilantro and peanuts. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake, uncovered, in a 350° oven for 13 minutes or until heated through.

title: Mom's Italian Cheese Ball
ingredients: 16 ounces shredded mozzarella cheese | 1 tablespoon chopped walnuts ( optional )
instructions: Roll each ball in walnut size pieces of cheese. Spray a cookie sheet with cooking spray. On a piece of parchment paper, place the balls. Bake at 350 degrees for 20 - 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: baguette,beef bouillon cube,jalapeno pepper,reynolds wrap foil,peanut,radish,cream cheese,picante sauce
title: Shredded Beef Sandwiches With Chipotle Cream Cheese Spread
ingredients: 4 tablespoons fresh cream cheese or 4 tablespoons neufchatel cheese | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon cube | 1 tablespoon jalapeno pepper, finely diced ( seeds and ribs removed ) | 8 slices baguette | 1/2 cup peanuts, finely chopped | 8 slices ripe tomatoes ( thin or jicama, 8 slices total ) | 8 -12 slices thin pickled jalapeno pepper ( optional ) | 8 radishes, sliced | 2 -3 teaspoons picante sauce
instructions: Shredded beef over easy with fork and set aside. In a small bowl add cream cheese, beef bouillon cube, and jalapeno pepper. Cover and let rest for 15 min at room temperature. Cut bread into eight 3/4 slices then cut each slice into 8 pieces. If using the pickled jalapenos, place all of the ingredients in a small crockpot. Cover and warm on low, setting temperature as low as possible for 8 to 10 hrs until thickened. Turn crockpot to high then add peanuts, tomatoes, and jalapeno slices, cover, and heat on high until warm, stirring often. Cut bread into 8 sandwiches. Spoon beef mixture onto toasted bread slices then top with shredded cheese. Top with slices of sour cream, fresh peanuts, and the sliced pickled jalapenos.

title: Japanese Sesame-Soy Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 roma ( plum ) tomatoes, sliced and seeded | 2 teaspoons dark sesame oil
instructions: Arrange tomato slices in a bowl. Sprinkle with dark sesame oil.

Random Ingredients: chicken wing,escarole,lime juice,strawberry,tomato sauce,shrimp,lettuce leaf,tamarind paste
title: Lettuce-Wrapped Wings of Escarole with Fruit Salad
ingredients: 2 cups chopped fresh seaweed stems ( escarole, bibb or any green or savoy lettuce ) | 1/2 cup chopped raw shrimp | 1 can tomato sauce | 2 -4 tablespoons tamarind paste ( paste, available at asian specialty stores ) | 2 tablespoons lime juice | 1 tablespoon bottled minced fresh ginger ( i've used fresh minced ) | lettuce leaf | 1/2 head shredded lettuce
instructions: Remove hard muscle in centre of each wing.

title: Super Easy Tamale Joes
ingredients: 6 -8 large tomatillos ( you can find it in the international deli ) | 1 package corn chex, frozen | 1 -2 cup milk powder
instructions: Remove the tomatillos from the freezer to bring it out of its frozen state. Put the tomatillos in a food processor or with a fork and pulse until smooth. I like to use my immersion blender to get the puree, although if you don't have that, you can just add up to 5 - 4 tablespoons milk powder to give it a little texture. I like to add about 1 teaspoons of milk powder, depending on how creamy you like the mixture. While the tomatillo puree is whizzing, thaw the corn and get each one individually into a bag containing about 1 1/2 teaspoons of cornstarch and 1 egg yolk, and place in the bag. You can do this by putting it in the microwave for about 2 minutes, stirring and heating it up a little. Taste and add more milk powder if needed, although not required. When the puree is whizzed up, put it back in the microwave and microwave on high for another 3 - 5 minutes or so. I like to put everything in the microwave in a bag the night before, but this is a little messy. When the puree is done, transfer it to a bowl or dish and beat in the egg yolk. If the corn is hot, melt it in the microwave on high for 45 seconds, or until it steams out. Once you got this messy mess out, you can put in the bowl or dish right before you eat it. Also, this recipe makes a ton of leftovers.

title: Cheese Filler for One
ingredients: 3/4 cup grated gruyere cheese | 1/4 cup grated havarti cheese or 1/4 cup muenster cheese | 1 cup watermelon, in cubes | 1/4 cup cheddar cheese, cut into pieces ( optional )
instructions: Mix cheeses and watermelon in bowl and refrigerate till mixture is cold. Served with cocktail sticks or as a filling for crackers.

Random Ingredients: pumpkin seed,red pepper flake,superfine sugar,marsala wine,pecorino cheese,cream chicken soup,chili pepper flake,orange bell pepper
title: Pumpkin Seed  Pepperoni Spicy  Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 2 tablespoons chopped pecorino cheese | 1/8 cup chopped fresh basil or 1/8 cup parsley | 1 cup shredded pumpkin seeds | 1/8 cup chopped red pepper flakes ( more if you like it hotter ) | 1 teaspoon hot chili pepper flakes | 1 small orange bell pepper, finely diced | 1 tablespoon marsala wine
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the cream of chicken soup, pecorino cheese and basil or parsley. Heat on low just to warm the soup slightly. Add the pumpkin seeds and hot pepper flakes and stir well. Serve at once. Garnish with orange pepper flakes, if desired. Variation, i have been known to double the amount of pepperoni pepperoni and use it in pasta.

title: Simmered Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 lb shiitake mushroom, stems trimmed | 1 tablespoon dried shiitake powder, to taste | 1/2 teaspoon cumin | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder
instructions: Rinse mushrooms with cold water and place in a steamer basket over boiling water. Cover and steam over boiling water for 20 to 30 minutes or until tender. Drain. Cool, trimming of stems, and discard. Remove stalks from stems and discard. Chop mushroom stems and set aside.
