Place shiitake powder, cumin, and onion powder in a large bowl and toss to mix well with mushrooms. Serve.

Random Ingredients: orange,red pepper flake,wheat flour,lemon wedge,chicken part,yellow onion
title: Persian Chicken and Orzo with Orzo (Kurdish Pritze)
ingredients: 2 cups whole wheat flour | 1/2 cup yellow onion, chopped | 2 large oranges, juice and zest of | 1 -2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 4 -6 chicken parts, skinned | lemon wedge, for serving ( optional )
instructions: Whisk the flour, onion, orange juice, and zest in a large bowl. Season the chicken with salt and crushed red pepper. Heat a medium pan, such as an dutch oven, on medium high heat. Place chicken in pan and fry for about 5 minutes to brown the outside. Turn the chicken over and saute another 10 minutes. Transfer chicken to a plate and pour off all but about 2 tablespoons fat. Cook the pan juices until the pan becomes dry, about 5 minutes. Add enough of the hot fat to the pan to form a rich but pourable sauce. Return to medium low heat. Boil until about 1/3 cup of liquid remains. Remove from heat. Strain out the solids. Return the sauce to pan and warm through until it has reduced by half. Pour over the fried chicken pieces and serve with lemon wedges for squeezing over.

title: Tami Tacos - Tacos
ingredients: 1/2 pound thick slab bacon | 1 1/2 teaspoons cream of tartar | 1 1/2 cans taco sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons tamari
instructions: Cook taco shells according to package directions. Meanwhile, in a large nonstick skillet, cook bacon over high heat until browned, about 5 minutes. Transfer bacon to a paper towel lined plate, reserving 1 tablespoon of the bacon drippings. Pour off the fat.

Random Ingredients: spring onion,table cream,cremini mushroom,apricot preserve,pita bread
title: Hot Mushroom and Pancakes W- Apricot Compote
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 cup cremini fresh mushrooms or 1/2-3/4 cup button mushroom, thinly sliced | 3 tablespoons apricot preserves | 2 tablespoons table cream or 2 tablespoons heavy whipping cream | 2 small pita bread or 2 small whole wheat pita bread | 1 spring onion, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Combine mushrooms and preserves in a food processor or blender. Process until smooth. Spoon 1 tablespoon of the filling into each pita or bread. Sprinkle each serving with a teaspoon of the spring onion if used.

title: Amaratha ( Indian Peppercorns)
ingredients: 1 cup dark corn syrup | 2 cups green peppercorns | 1 fresh mint leaves, chopped
instructions: Heat the corn syrup in a heavy skillet on low heat. When it starts to bubble, add the green peppercorns. Stir well. Turn the heat to medium low. Simmer, uncovered, until reduced to a paste consistency, about 2 hours.

title: Vegan Besam (Methi Nuts)
ingredients: 500 g asafoetida powder | 500 ml mirin | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Combine the dry ingredients and stir, then add enough water to get a thin paste. Heat bbq to low/medium high heat. Spread the mixture out evenly on the bottom of the tray. Cook for around 45 - 60 minutes. The aroma can be adjusted with a little water or cooking spray. The top should be dry and crunchy. Leave until cool. The flavour of the nut will be absorbed then eat as desired.

title: Mixed Chutney
ingredients: 150 g dried cranberries | 150 g dark corn syrup | 150 g mango chutney | 300 ml sour cream | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 150 ml beer | 1/4 teaspoon coriander powder | 50 g corn, kernels
instructions: Soak fruit in water overnight, then put in a deep, wide pan. Sprinkle seeds. Add all other ingredients and mix with a stick blender. Cover a lid with foil, place over a slow heat and stir occasionally. Keep stirring every 20 mins until thick, but not dry. Leave to stand for 5 10mins until thick and starting to get a golden colour. Turn out onto plate and cut into strips. You may use any chutney that has your kids saying it's a bit unpleasant. Serve topped with extra coriander or paprika if desired.

title: Meat and Baked Eggs
ingredients: 3 links sweet and sour hot sausage | 1/4 cup soya milk or 1/4 cup low-fat milk | 2 egg yolks, beaten | 1 small piece fresh flat-leaf parsley | 1 teaspoon basil | 1/4 cup oil | 1 slice pineapple | 1 slice fresh pineapple, 1/8 inch thick
instructions: Cut sausages in half lengthwise and cut crosswise into 1 1/2 inch slices. Combine with milk and let sit for 15 mins. Preheat oven to 400°f. Remove all fat and casings from sausage. Drain milk mixture into a bowl, add egg yolks, parsley, basil, oil and pineapple slices, mixing to combine. Dip sausage pieces first in milk mixture and then roll gently in egg mixture. Place sausages side by side in a pan lined with foil, sprayed lightly with vegetable oil. Bake at 400f for about 25 mins, turning after about 5 mins. Serve with a green salad and bread. Tip if served with mashed potatoes, make sure the potatoes have a bit of the crisp texture you prefer.

title: Tamari Tacos (Tortilla Chips)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs hard taco shells | 1/3 cup tamari | 1 tablespoon brown mustard seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Arrange taco shells on a baking sheet. Divide tamari between the taco shells. Sprinkle lightly with mustard seeds. Sprinkle remaining mustard seeds on top. Bake for an additional 7 - 10 minutes.

title: Taquito
ingredients: 8 cups tomato juice, preferably homemade | 1 cup masa harina
instructions: Put the water in a large pot and bring to a boil. Meanwhile, put the masa harina in a plastic tub and add a tablespoon of hot water at a time to it. You will see the mixture begin form small lumps. Slowly add the masa harina to the boiling water, cooking for about a minute or two, stirring a few times. After the last minute, the mixture will be thick and smooth. The aim is to remove all the lumps. If necessary, pour in a little warm water to reach your desired consistency. Add more water, a few drops at a time, to make the water thinner to pour back into the masa harina. The preparation and cooking times are not exact, just a bit shorter as the masa harina absorbs the tomato juice.

Random Ingredients: mustard powder,greek yogurt,new mexico chile powder,crabmeat,vanilla,slab bacon
title: Crazy Cajun Crab Tacos
ingredients: 1 pound fresh crabmeat | 1 cup crumbled new mexico chile powder | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1 teaspoon dried mustard powder | 8 slices thick slab bacon, diced | 1 1/2 cups greek yogurt
instructions: Place the crabmeat in a saucepan with the new mexico chile powder, vanilla, and mustard powder. Cover, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, and simmer for about 10 minutes. Allow the mixture to cool, then transfer to a resealable plastic bag large enough to hold the crab. Refrigerate for 1 hour to marinate. Place one slice of bacon in the plastic bag, and squeeze in about 1/4 cup of the reserved marinade. Close the bag, and squeeze over more of the liquid as desired. Squeeze out any excess air, and mix in the yogurt. Serve with the remaining bread for dipping.

title: Polish Halibut in Pimentos - Gjal - Jokos - Jokolades
ingredients: 3 lbs halibut, filets, boneless cut into quarters | 3 tablespoons finely chopped pimientos | 2 tablespoons finely cut vegetables ( carrots, celery, zucchini ) | 2 kaffir lime leaves, finely torn | 20 thick slices breadcrumbs | 32 assorted fresh polish sausages or 32 small other italian sausages, cut into quarters
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a large baking sheet with foil. Place halibut in a large shallow pan. Dip in hot water on all sides, and allow excess to drain off. Arrange half of the pimientos and all of the veggie pieces on the half of the halibut. Dip half of the kaffir lime leaves into the pimentos, and arrange the halves on the halibut, making sure they are all snug and completely packed in the peels. Arrange sausage pieces on top of the pimientos, and continue to alternate layers until all the halibut is used. Top and tail off the other piece of halibut. Roll up the pastry, and using a sharp knife remove the end of the foil. Transfer to a baking sheet, and place all halves of the rolls on the same baking sheet. Bake for about 1 hour, or until the halibut is easily flaked with the tip of a knife. If desired, allow halibut to rest for 10 minutes prior to serving.

Random Ingredients: baking powder,meatball,soya sauce,ice water,vanilla extract,white bean,baking soda,marshmallow
title: Krystal's Easy Meatball Cookies
ingredients: 2 lbs frozen cooked meatballs | 2 1/4 cups ice water | 1 can white beans | 1/2 cup soya sauce ( or more if desired, if you want more of a `` kick '' you can add 2 tbsp b ) | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 2/3 cup white flour | 1/4 cup miniature marshmallows
instructions: Bake frozen meatballs in oven in crockpot on low setting for 10 - 15 minutes. Drain excess water. Discard meatballs & set aside for now. Cook beans according to above recipe # 4. Pour bean mixture, including meatballs into crockpot, & mix thoroughly. Add soy sauce, soda, and baking powder. Stir, & remove from heat & stir until combined. Add flour, stir, & return to the slow cooker. Note, if using 1 pound of meatballs, you may not need to cook them fully, but i find doing it is trial & error when it comes to meatballs, just be sure to stir them every so often to avoid clumping. This could also be done with other frozen meatballs.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,soy sauce,cardamom seed,grape,coconut milk,german mustard
title: Grape Curry With Coconut Milk
ingredients: 1 cup grapes, halved | 1/4 cup whole milk | 1/4 cup light coconut milk | 2 teaspoons light soy sauce | 1 teaspoon fresh grated ginger or 1 teaspoon fresh ground ginger | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom pod, cracked ( optional ) | green cardamom pods, cracked ( optional )
instructions: Combine coconut milk, grapes, soy sauce, ginger& cardamom pods in a saucepan. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to simmer and simmer, uncovered, 3 - 5 minutes. If desired, garnish with cardamom pods, if desired.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile,red kidney bean,hamburger,meyer lemon juice,cumin seed
title: Chile Con Carne in a Hurry With Beans and Crispy Chips
ingredients: 1 canned red kidney beans | 1 tablespoon meyer lemon juice | 2 - 2 1/2 tablespoons ground cumin seed | 1/2 lb hamburger, thinly diced ( or bacon ) | 1 -2 chipotle chile, depending on how spicy you like it
instructions: Drain the kidney beans but do not rinse, leaving behind any juices. Place them in a large, heavy skillet. When heated through, add the lemon juice. Lower heat and simmer for about 5 minutes, uncovered. Add the cumin and continue to simmer for about 5 minutes. Meanwhile, prepare the hamburger. Sauté lightly in a nonstick skillet until the outsides are browned and the burger is cooked through, about 5 minutes. Add the chipolte chile, adjust heat to low, cover, and simmer over low heat until the meat is no longer pink inside, about 5 minutes more.

title: Tomato Rice Salad
ingredients: 3 cups fresh bread, cut into 1/4-inch cubes | 1/4 cup salad oil | 2/3 cup tomato sauce | 2 cups cooked long-grain white rice | 1/4 cup chopped pecans | 1/2 cup chopped fresh blueberries, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Toss the breadcrumbs with the salad oil in a bowl. Spread the rice on a baking sheet, and bake for 15 minutes in the preheated oven, stirring once or twice. Cool completely, then cool completely and squeeze out 1/2 cup of bread crumbs and tear into small pieces. Transfer the rice and bread crumbs to a large bowl, stir in the tomato sauce, and divide the salad among 8 salad plates. Sprinkle the pecans and blueberries over the top of the salad, and drizzle with the salad dressing to taste. Garnish with additional pecans and blueberries if desired.

title: Crock Pot Chick Peas With Canadian Bacon
ingredients: 2 lbs yellow onions, sliced | 1 lb canadian bacon, diced ( canadian bacon if you like ) | 1 can chickpeas, drained and rinsed ( garbanzo beans ) | 2 -3 tablespoons beef bouillon
instructions: Place all ingredients into crock pot on high and cook approximately 3 hours or until veggies are tender. Serve over cooked pasta with a salad or as a side dish.

title: Paneer (White Wine Braised Celery Ribs) in Mint Oil
ingredients: 8 celery ribs | 1/4 cup olive, preferably virgin | 1/4 cup sauterne white wine | 8 mint sprigs, to garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f in a baking tray with 1/3 cup water, rub celery with olive oil so as to coat. Place in oven and bake 45 - 55 minutes. Remove celery from oven.

Random Ingredients: poblano chile,olive green,fennel,pork shoulder,jalapeno chile,almond flour,gouda cheese,turmeric powder
title: Pork Chops in Poblano Chile Con Queso (Pressure Cooker)
ingredients: 5 pounds boneless pork shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes | 3 poblano chiles, diced | 2 jalapeno chiles, deseeded and diced | 2 fennel, leaves roughly chopped, stems removed | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/2 cup blanched almond flour | 1/2 cup juliennel pazzi mozzarella cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons olive oil
instructions: Place pork in a pressure cooker with the poblanos, jalapenos, fennel, turmeric and salt to taste. Pour enough water into the pressure cooker to come halfway up the side of the cooker. Cover, and bring to high pressure over high heat. Once pressure is achieved, remove from heat and open lid.

Random Ingredients: pea,mozzarella cheese,buttermilk,parsley sprig,snow pea,italian turkey sausage link
title: Gourmet Supper
ingredients: 1 package italian turkey sausage links, cut in 1-inch slices | 1/4 cup peas | 1 cup buttermilk | 24 slices mozzarella cheese | 24 fresh parsley sprigs | 1 lb fresh snow pea
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Place sausage on a broiler pan and broil 3 - 4 minutes each side, or until seared all over and just cooked through. Place peas in a microwave safe bowl, cover, and heat in the microwave on high for 3 - 5 minutes, or until heated through. Remove from the microwave, cover, and let cool slightly. When cooled, stir in the buttermilk. When cool enough to slice, place 1 slice of mozzarella on each of two plates. Top each slice with a snow pea. Spoon a little melted cheese onto the top, then drizzle peas over mozzarella. Serve hot.

title: Chocolate Rice Bowl
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked long grain white rice | 1 cup cooked pork and beans ( pork and beans can be substituted ) | 1 cup mayonnaise | 3 ounces grated chocolate ( optional ) | 1/4 cup packed coriander | 1/4 cup chopped choc-covered sweet morsels or 1/4 cup other chocolate-covered dry-roasted choc-covered sweet morsels
instructions: To prepare rice bowl, bring 4 cups water to boil in covered saucepan over high heat. Stir in rice. Cover, reduce heat to medium low and simmer until water is absorbed and rice is tender, about 20 minutes. Fluff with fork. To prepare filling, mix rice, beans, mayonnaise, chocolate and coriander in large bowl. Spoon filling into chilled bowl.

title: Tortilla Shrimp
ingredients: 3/4 lb uncooked medium shrimp, peeled | 1 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Place shrimp in a large, wide saucpan.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,granny smith apple,cranberry,shrimp,cherry tomato
title: Shrimply Apples and Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 1 cup short-grain white rice | 1 cup dried whole cranberries | 1 granny smith apple, peeled, cored and chopped | 3/4 pound small shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 pint cherry tomatoes, halved
instructions: Place the rice, dried cranberries, apple and shrimp in a saucepan over medium high heat, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer for 30 minutes, until all the liquid has been absorbed and the rice is tender. Remove the lid and continue cooking until any excess liquid has been absorbed. Remove from heat and set aside for about 5 minutes to cool to room temperature. Serve the pilaf warm with cherry tomatoes, if desired.

Random Ingredients: grenadine,tomato green chilies,butter margarine,red curry paste,dinner,strawberry,salt
title: Grilled Thai Party Sandwiches
ingredients: 8 dinner rolls ( frozen or fresh ) | 12 tablespoons red curry paste ( or red chili pepper flakes if you prefer ) | 8 tablespoons butter or 8 tablespoons margarine | 1 cup strawberry, sliced | 3 cans rotisserie-cooked tomatoes and green chilies, undrained | 1 dash salt | 1 dash grenadine
instructions: Remove rolls from plastic wrap and cut rolls into eight triangles. Arrange eight triangles on a baking sheet. Place 1/2 tbsp red curry paste onto each triangle. Brush top of triangles with olive oil. Grill, one side, or pan grill triangles. Do not overcook. Top with remaining two tablespoons red curry paste. Grill, other side, or pan grill tomato. Top with shredded hot strawberries. Sprinkle lightly with a pinch of salt. Sprinkle grenadine for decoration. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: onion powder,fajita seasoning mix,pesto sauce,lasagna,bamboo shoot,cilantro stem,crabmeat
title: California Calab Rolls
ingredients: 6 lasagna sheets | 1 medium onion, chopped | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce | 1/2 teaspoon chili-garlic seasoning mix | 1 can sliced bamboo shoots, drained | 2 cans crabmeat, drained | fresh cilantro stem ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Arrange sheets of lasagna over each other on a lightly oiled, lightly greased baking sheet. Spread pesto sauce between the sheets.

title: Cardamom and Capers Tea(Cook's Country)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons shallots, finely chopped | 3 teaspoons espresso powder | 1/4 cup dry white wine | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1/2 cup capers
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine shallots and espresso and bring to a boil. Stir in wine and cardamom and remove from heat. Allow to cool to room temperature, then chill. Place capers in a small plastic bag, seal, and marinate in the refrigerator for 1 hour. Serve cold or warmed.

Random Ingredients: red potato,black cardamom pod,cauliflower,turnip,pork loin chop
title: Tandoori Pork and Vegetables
ingredients: 300 g red potatoes | 200 g sweet potatoes | 300 g turnips | 7 tablespoons pork loin chops or 7 tablespoons lard | 7 tablespoons black cardamom pods | 6 1/2 tablespoons fresh cauliflower, washed
instructions: Grate the potatoes into the food processor. Dice the turnips into bite sized pieces. Heat the lard in a frying pan. Once it's hot, throw in the pumpkin, turnip and cauliflower. Keep turning and add salt. Let it fry for 10 minutes, stirring frequently. Add the black cardamoms and the rest of the pork. Let it fry until it releases its juices, then drain it. Spread the stuffing on half of the meat. Sprinkle coriander over it.

title: Oven-Bake Shells With Vanilla Ice Cream
ingredients: 12 medium shells pasta | 2 tablespoons light canola oil | 1 pint vanilla ice cream, ice cream cones kept in the freezer
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Cook pasta in water to al dente. Meanwhile, heat canola oil in 12 nonstick frying pans over medium heat until oil is hot but not smoking. Pour about 1/4 of the pasta cooking water into each pan. Drain, stir in ice cream cones and drizzle in extra hot oil. Swirl until the cones are very hot and the pasta is hot, but still a little crisp around the edges. Sprinkle with salt.

title: Polish Bullet Steating Broccoli
ingredients: 5 broccoli | 1 ounce galliano
instructions: First put the head on the steamer basket. Put the water in the bottom, so the broccoli sticks until it sticks into the stick. Turn the basket over on the top of the broccoli head. Let the head steam for 15 minutes on high heat, turn the broccoli over, and let it steam for another 15 minutes. Put the stick or slitt, right away, in the bottle.

title: Kofte
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs beef brisket | 1/4 cup dried fenugreek seeds
instructions: Heat oven to 300 degrees. Trim and thoroughly pat brisket dry with paper towels. Sprinkle with salt, wrap in heavy aluminum foil, and set in roasting pan or dutch oven. Cover tightly with foil and roast at 300 degrees for three hours. Remove from oven, loosely tent with foil, and let rest for 30 minutes. Remove brisket from roasting pan, discard foil, and let cool. When meat is cool enough to handle, remove as much fat as possible. Shred into very fine pieces. In a large bowl, toss the fenugreek seeds with enough water to make a soft, slightly sticky paste. Place half the fenugreek on a serving platter and arrange in a layer over meat, making sure fat sides are facing up. Spread remaining fenugreek on a third platter and arrange on fat layer for all the meat. Pour some fenugreek flavored water over brisket. Cover tightly and refrigerate for at least 6 hours or overnight.

Random Ingredients: cardamom,turmeric,chocolate chip,guacamole,snow pea,spinach leaf,corn flake,bartlett pear
title: Chilled Pear Salad With Powdered Spinach
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped spinach leaves | 6 ripe ripe bartlett pears, halved vertically | 1/3 cup miniature guacamole | 4 teaspoons chopped fresh turmeric | 4 teaspoons chopped fresh cilantro or 4 teaspoons parsley | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cardamom | 3 cups coarsely chopped fresh spinach leaves | 1 cup snow peas, trimmed, washed | 1 package corn flakes, toasted
instructions: Drain the spinach leaves and remove the stems. Cook the pears, uncovered, over medium high heat for 4 minutes, until tender crisp & beginning to peel. Remove from the heat & set aside. Arrange the pears, cut side down, on a foil lined baking sheet. Bake, uncovered, at 350 for 1 to 1 1/2 minutes. Turn the pears over & prick with a fork on the other side. Bake for an additional 1 to 1 1/2 minutes or until pears are slightly marked. Remove from the oven & set aside. Remove the pears from the foil & set aside. In a blender, combine the guacamole & 1 tsp of the turmeric. Pulse about 15 seconds, until well blended, stopping to scrape down the sides. Add the remaining tumeric, cilantro & cardamom & blend in the spinach. Add the spinach pesto mixture & process in a food processor or blender until the spinach is fully incorportated. Remove from the processor & stir in the pears, the shrimp & snow peas. Add the corn flakes & season to taste with salt & pepper. Serve either at room temp or chilled.

title: Cauliflower With Fig Compote.
ingredients: 1 small head cauliflower, broken into florets | 20 dried figs, cut into 1-inch pieces | 2 whole cloves
instructions: Steam the cauliflower for 8 minutes, then drain. Place the figs into a skillet and sprinkle with cloves. Cook over medium heat until they just begin to release their juices. To assemble, preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. Place the cauliflower into a large baking dish. Wrap the fig compote around the cauliflower, reserving some figs for garnish. Sprinkle remaining fig pieces around the plated cauliflower. Dot with reserved figs and bake for 15 minutes.

title: Easy Cheater Easy Baked Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb spiral pasta or 1 lb any similar pasta, prepared to your liking | 3 tablespoons quick-cooking tapioca | 1/2 cup jarred pasta sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Cook pasta according to package directions, but without adding salt, then drain. Combine tapioca and pasta sauce in a bowl and mix until well mixed. Put mixture into an 11 x 7 x 2 inch square baking dish. Cut a few slits for steam to escape and sprinkle top with extra finely grated cheese. Bake uncovered for 45 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Sauerkraut Pies
ingredients: 1 can sauerkraut | 1/2 cup vegetable oil | 2 tablespoons palm oil | 1 package frozen whipped topping, thawed | seasoning to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Stir sauerkraut, vegetable oil, palm oil, and sour cream together in a bowl until well blended. Form the filling into four 2 inch diameter patties.

title: Spiced Wine
ingredients: 5 ounces fresh white wine ( i prefer port ) | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: In a small heatproof bowl, pour in the wine. Add the turmeric powder and let soak for 3 - 4 minutes. Pour into a glass wine bottle, seal and place in the fridge for up to 24 hours.

title: Blueberry Soup
ingredients: 4 large blueberries | 1 cup vegetable stock | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1 egg yolk, lightly beaten
instructions: Rinse blueberries and place in a saucepan of cold water to cover. Bring to a boil over medium high heat. Boil and stir until lightly browned, 5 to 7 minutes. Remove from heat. Transfer blueberries into a large bowl. Cover with cold water to cover.

title: Lamb Chops With Vegetables and Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb uncooked rotini pasta, small squares | 8 lamb chops | 1 lb yellow pepper, halved and seeded | 1/3 cup slivered almonds
instructions: Heat a large, deep skillet over high heat. Coat pan with cooking spray. Add lamb chops.

title: Sweet Corn on the Cob
ingredients: 3 corn cobs, husked | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: Heat grill for indirect grilling over high heat. Insert a piece of aluminum foil onto grill grate and arrange corn on foil. Sprinkle with chili powder. Broil corn 12 minutes, or until corn is crispy and slightly charred.

title: Kebabs - Ethiopian Spice Mix
ingredients: 4 tablespoons hot red chili powder | 1 teaspoon serrano pepper
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients together. Make small balls, or grind them yourself in a spice grinder or blender. Use as a spread on bread or vegetables.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,kirsch,fish sauce,syrup,cocoa powder,lemon zest,rye bread,avocado
title: Baked Avocados With a Romantic Touch
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 tablespoon kirsch | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 2 medium avocados ( or other firm white fleshy ) | 1 tablespoon pure chocolate chips or 1 tablespoon cocoa powder ( hershey's ) | 1 tablespoon kirsch | 1 tablespoon syrup | 1 lemon, zest of | 1 loaf rye bread, crust ( or other sandwich bread )
instructions: Peel avocados and pit in a bowl with a fork.

title: Dijon Cherry Tomato Salad Dressing
ingredients: 125 -200 ml cherry tomatoes, halved | 3 tablespoons dijon mustard
instructions: Combine in a screw top jar. Store in the fridge. Shake well before using for best results.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,greek yogurt,potato starch,veal,amaretto,cream cheese chive,berry
title: Sour Cream Dill Swiss Steak or Ground Beef Fondue and Chive Dumplings
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese with chives | 2 teaspoons dark brown sugar | 1 ounce amaretto | 1 teaspoon soft potato starch | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon gelatin or 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 lb ground veal | 1 lb lean ground beef or 1 lb lean ground beef, cooked and drained | 2/3 cup low-fat greek yogurt
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together the cream cheese, dark brown sugar, amaretto, potato starch, and egg. Stir in the veal, then add the chopped beef. Gently mix the gelled cornstarch and yogurt with a fork or spoon until well blended. Divide into 2 parts and spread onto a preheated fondue pot. Cook for about 8 minutes at 375°f. Remove, sprinkle with more crème fraiche, and serve.

title: Cheese and Lime Leaf Skewers With Lime
ingredients: 2 lbs cheddar cheese, grated | 1 1/4 lbs kaffir lime leaves, chopped
instructions: Place the cheddar in a bowl and add the lime leaves. Mix well until all the pieces of cheese are thoroughly coated. Place each piece of cheese in an oiled 9 metal or bamboo skewer and place on a tray. Place a metal skewer on top. Let sit 30 - 45 minutes, covered, in the refrigerator. Remove the cheese from the skewers and slice into squares or triangles.

title: Hot Joes
ingredients: 1 lb roast beef, coarsely chopped | 1 lb kielbasa, chopped | 1 lb frozen okra, thawed | 1 package frozen green pea, thawed | 1 1/2 teaspoons onion powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground walnuts or 1 1/2 teaspoons ground almonds | 2 cans whipped topping
instructions: Preheat broiler. Combine meat and next 6 ingredients.

Random Ingredients: rom tomato,rice,mushroom,parmesan cheese,linguine,white flour,ghee,italian pork sausage
title: Spanish Rice and Sausage
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked linguine | 2 lbs sweet italian pork sausage | 12 ounces white flour | 1 cup rice | 2 cups ghee ( clarified butter ) or 2 cups vegetable oil | 1 cup sliced sliced mushrooms | 1 roma tomato, chopped | 1/4 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Cook linguine in a large pot of boiling salted water until al dente, about 8 minutes. Drain. Meanwhile, preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. Remove sausage casing, cut sausage into 1/2 inch slices. Spread flour on a plate or rimmed baking sheet, and coat sausage with flour. Place sausage in a single layer on the flour. Brown in a heavy nonstick skillet, turning once, over medium high heat. Add rice, sausages, mushrooms, and tomatoes. Remove the sausage mixture from skillet and drain excess oil from skillet. In a small saucepan, melt ghee over medium heat, or in a large saute pan over low heat. Stir in the parmesan cheese. Add sauteed mixture and bring to a slow boil. Lower heat and simmer, adding a little water as needed to maintain a thick sauce when necessary. Cook at a slow boil for 15 minutes. Serve over hot cooked linguine.

title: Pumpkin Crusted Fish (Covered and Fried W- Crisp)
ingredients: 5 -8 ounces fresh pumpkin | 4 firm firm-flaky fish fillets | butter or margarine, for greasing
instructions: If you are using fresh pumpkins, peel well the skin will be too easily cut off. Wash them and cut off any protruding pulp at the base and the inside. Place the fillets in a heavy ovenproof, oven proof pot. Cover them with greaseproof or parchment paper over the top, with about 1/2 inch depth of water. Cover and put in a pre heated oven. Bake, uncovered, in a warm oven for about 45 to 50 minutes to 1 hour or until the fish flakes easily with a fork. This will take about 20 to 25 minutes. The outside of the fish is cooked. Take one piece of fish out of the oven, cut out any bones with a knife, and carefully place on to the top of the pumpkin pieces in a serving bowl. The other pieces of fish will need a longer but be cooked a little earlier depending on how soft and flakey you prefer your pumpkin.

title: Corn & Couscous Rösti
ingredients: 16 ounces rigatoni, uncooked | 1 can creamed corn | 2 1/2 cups couscous | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed | 3/4 cup romano cheese or 3/4 cup parmesan cheese, grated | 1 1/2 teaspoons saltines or 1 1/2 teaspoons crackers, crushed
instructions: In a large bowl, combine 1 1/2 cups water, creamed corn, and couscous.

title: Laks-gandye (Laks-gandye)
ingredients: 1/2 lb unripened dried leeks ( likens ) | 8 cups chicken stock or 8 cups vegetable stock | 2 lbs ground veal | 1 teaspoon kosher salt ( for seasoning )
instructions: Trim leeks and slice into 1 cm slices about 1/4 inch thick. Rinse leeks and dry well. Set aside. Pour a little vegetable oil in a large stockpot or dutch oven and heat over medium heat. Brown meat and stir and cook for about 5 minutes. Add leeks and stock to pot. Turn heat down to medium low and cover tightly and let simmer for about 1 1/2 to 1 - ¾ hours. You might need to add salt, just not to taste. If too dry, add some more stock, just a few tablespoons. If too wet, add a tablespoon or two and check for liquid. It should be a creamy thick paste.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,beef chuck roast,chickpea,peanut butter
title: Indonesian Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless beef chuck roast | 1 can chickpeas | 1/4 cup peanut butter | 2 -3 lbs boneless skinless chicken breast halves
instructions: Place chuck roast in crockpot. Add chickpeas and remaining ingredients and cook at medium heat for 6 - 7 hours on low or until meat is tender.

title: Easy Chili Pasta Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar alfredo sauce | 8 ounces red chili, drained, rinsed, and chopped
instructions: In a saucepan, combine alfredo sauce and chili. Heat through.

title: Easy Peasy Easy Tomato-Pea-Balls #5FIX
ingredients: 1 package frozen peas and carrot | 4 -6 tablespoons low-fat sour cream or 4 -6 tablespoons nonfat sour cream | 1/8 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Put thawed frozen peas and carrots in a food processor and blend until very fine. If it looks like its too thick, thin by adding the 1/8 tsp of cream of tartar. Pour mixture into freezer until needed. Remove from freezer and put in a freezer bag. After 20 - 30 mins, transfer to a freezer bag. Mix sour cream with cream of tartar and place in the microwave on high for 45 seconds, stopping the microwave after about 1 minute. After you get it through the bowl, stir and pour into a 9x13 dish. Let chill for a minimum of 2 hours. This will keep in the freezer up to a week.

title: Quick and Easy Vietnamese Broccoli
ingredients: 2 packages frozen broccoli florets | 2 teaspoons brown sauce | 1 dash fish sauce ( optional )
instructions: In a large saucepan add the broccoli and water. Bring to a boil over high heat and cook for five minutes. Add the fish sauce and heat to dissolve. Serve.

Random Ingredients: pistachio nut,baking potato,green tomato,whipping cream,duck,chicken,balsamic vinegar,chicken bouillon powder
title: Chicken and Potatoes With Balsamic Syrup & Pistachio
ingredients: 2 cups whipping cream | 14 ounces whole chickens | 1 1/2 lbs baking potatoes | 2 tablespoons instant chicken bouillon powder | 2 cups whipping cream | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 2 -3 tablespoons chopped pistachio nuts | 1 chicken, cut into 16 pieces
instructions: Heat oven to 375f. Prepare chicken. Cut chicken into 16 serving size pieces and place in ungreased 13x9 inch backing dish. Bake 20 minutes or until juices run clear. Transfer chicken to platter, cover with foil, and let stand 20 minutes. Meanwhile, boil potatoes until tender. Drain potatoes and set aside. Remove skin and fat from chicken. Using a large sharp knife cut through skin of remaining chicken and discard. With a cleaver or cleaver blade on cutting back meat from the bones and shred meat into coarse strands. Bring cream to simmering over medium heat. Remove from heat. Gradually stir in chicken. Add bouillon powder and whisk briskly to loosen browned bits. Stir in cream and balsamic vinegar. Fold in pistachio and remove from heat. In a 9x13 inch glass baking dish arrange 3 pieces of chicken, skin side down. Repeat layers ending with chicken. Pour sauce over chicken and bake about 45 minutes or until chicken is heated through and sauce has thickened.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,korean rice,salad green,farfalle pasta,sage leaf,purpose flour,halloumi cheese
title: Gyuewewu or Korean Pancake (Papetor) Salad
ingredients: 2 pints mixed salad greens, torn into pieces | 1 cup cooked kidney bean, rinsed and drained | 6 fresh sage leaves | 2 cups cooked farfalle pasta | 1 package halloumi cheese, sliced thin ( about 2 1/2 cups ) | 6 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1/2 cup korean-style rice
instructions: In a large serving bowl, toss the salad greens with the kidney beans, sage, and the farfalle pasta. Layer the sliced ham on top of the salad. Top with the farfalle pasta. Sprinkle with the cheese. Place a wooden match or two in the center of the salad. Dust the outside of the salad with flour, then cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight, turning the bowl once or twice for best results. The next day, preheat the oven to 350°f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or a silicone mat, and transfer the farfalle to the sheet. Bake for 30 - 45 minutes. To serve, cut the farfalle into wedges and arrange on a serving platter.

Random Ingredients: head cauliflower,nut,maraschino cherry,mussel,pepper flake,mint,cilantro leaf,yellow pepper
title: Lebanese Fish Stew (Saheena)
ingredients: 1 medium head cauliflower, about 15 to 20 heads | 1 lb frozen mussels ( preferably the big ones ) or 1 lb frozen clams in shell, thawed and well drained ( preferably the big ones ) | 3/4 cup maraschino cherry, quartered | 1 medium yellow pepper, chopped finely | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 2 tablespoons chopped of fresh mint | 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons ground nuts, toasted
instructions: Trim off the hard stem of the cauliflower to expose florets and wash well, cut off the heads and the very small leaves, set the heads aside. Remove the stem from the cauliflower and break into florets, set aside. In a large, heavy skillet over medium heat, add the oil and when it shimmers, add the cauliflower and sauté on medium heat, stirring frequently, until it is a light golden color. Scrape into a bowl, stir in all other ingredients and set aside. Serve over rice or as a side dish with plenty of crusty bread to mop up the juice.

Random Ingredients: leek,vegetable stock,french tarragon,green enchilada sauce,cheese tortellini,kaiser,coriander powder,spring onion
title: Green Enchilada Burger
ingredients: 250 g french tarragon sticks | 2 leeks | 2 tablespoons vegetable stock | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder | 200 g cheese tortellini | 1 teaspoon chopped pickled french tarragon | 1/2 green enchilada sauce | 1/4 cup chopped fresh coriander | 1 spring onion, thinly sliced
instructions: Soak english tarragon sticks for 5 minutes in 1/2 cup hot water. Cut roots off leeks & discard. Cut sticks into 2 cm pieces & place in a colander. Place drained tarragon sticks in a food processor with the stock.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,green tomato,pie crust,urad dal,parsley,cake flour,corn tortilla chip
title: Spice Crusted Sour Cream Pie  (Barsi)
ingredients: 2 cups frozen sour cream | 1 cup prepared cake flour | 1 teaspoon sesame seeds | 1/2 cup chopped green tomatoes | 1 tablespoon chopped parsley | 1 cup urad dal, split red lentils | 1 pie crust, baked or 1 bottom pie crusts
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. In a bowl combine sour cream, sesame seeds, tomato, parsley and urad dal. Add flour and mix well. Pour mixture onto top of pie crust and bake for 20 minutes. Remove from oven and allow to set for 10 minutes before serving. Serve with sour cream.

Random Ingredients: turmeric powder,triple sec,soy sauce,cinnamon sugar,fava bean
title: Foul Mudammes (Fava Beans in a Sweet Wine)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dried fava beans ( or other small green beans ) or 1 1/2 cups fresh fava beans ( or other small green beans ) | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 teaspoon triple sec | 1/8 teaspoon ground cinnamon sugar
instructions: Wash and soak the dried fekkamis on the same water for 4 hours if using fresh beans, bring to a boil the same water used for soaking. Meanwhile, cut the beans roughly and place in a large pot along with the remaining ingredients. Bring to boil and cover and cook over a med/low heat. The water should be boiling hot enough, but not boiling low, not boiling low. The reason you picked up the fekkamis so quickly you can taste them, if you feel like you need to, it means that everything is cooking. If the water seems to be boiling very quickly, you still have to add some water to keep the fekkamis covered until you put the next step inches. After you have prepared your fekkamis, it's time to make the syrup, you must place them in a pan and warm over the low heat, then stir in the syrup once it is heated through. It's easy, too.. When you are ready to eat the fekkamis, remove them from the syrup with a slotted spoon, place on a plate and drizzle the syrup over them. Eat them immediately, it's so delicious.

title: Basic Basic Refried Beans
ingredients: 3 cups fresh bean sprouts, trimmed | kosher salt
instructions: Wash sprouts in cool running water for 30 minutes. Drain immediately and let stand until sprouts dry. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add beans and salt. Cook 4 to 5 minutes. Drain and reserve. Reheat beans, covered, over low heat for 15 minutes. Add more water if necessary and salt to taste. Serve.

Random Ingredients: blueberry,ginger,white mushroom,scotch bonnet pepper,shallot,pizza crust,green apple,jalapeno chile
title: Smokey Mango Chutney Pizza With Sage-Crock Pot Option
ingredients: 1 medium green apple, cored, cut in chunks | 1 medium jalapeno chile, chopped, with seeds | 1 can chopped white mushrooms | 2 medium shallots, sliced | 1 medium scotch bonnet pepper, chopped coarsely | 1/2 cup torn fresh blueberries | 1/2 cup shredded light mozzarella cheese | 1 prepared pizza crust
instructions: Heat oven to 425 degrees. In large bowl, combine apples, jalapeno, mushrooms, sliced shallots, scotch bonnet, cheddar and blueberries. Spoon topping onto pizza crust and top with mango chutney. Bake 10 to 15 minutes or until crust golden brown.

title: Homemade Tzatziki
ingredients: 3 tablespoons dried tzatziki | 1 1/4 cups crushed ice cubes, divided | 1 teaspoon whole cumin seeds, or more to taste
instructions: Stir tzatziki into crushed ice cubes until water has mostly dispersed but the yogurt is still pourable. Add cumin seeds.

title: Pavlova from Iceland
ingredients: 6 small grape tomatoes | 1 orange, rind of, a zest of, grated
instructions: Slice the tomatoes up horizontally to remove seeds and membrane. Place the tomatoes in a pan and fill with enough water to just cover them. Bring to the boil and cook over a low heat for about 20 minutes. Turn down the heat and leave to simmer for 15 - 20 minutes until the tomatoes are quite soft. Test them for doneness. Remove the tomatoes from the water with a slotted spoon and place on a bowl. Squeeze the orange rind over them and pour half of the orange juice in through the skin. If the juice comes to the top of the tomatoes, dislodge the top with a spoon. Serve immediately.

title: Elegant Seaweed Rolls
ingredients: 1 pound cake, cut acrosswise into 1/4 inch slices | 1 bunch kale, leaves picked from stems and cut into 2 inch lengths | 1/2 pound pound pound poundcake, cut crosswise into 1/4 inch slices | 1/2 pound romaine lettuce - rinsed, dried and shredded | 1 bottle greek yogurt | 1/8 teaspoon hot chili, or to taste | 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 2 teaspoons dried minced chili | 1 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Place the cut cake and kale leaves into food processor.

title: Easy Creamy Onion Soup
ingredients: 2 onions ( medium to fine ) | 3 -5 cups chicken stock | 1 package cream cheese ( can substitute vegan cream cheese )
instructions: If cooking in a pan, place entire package of cream cheese in a saucepan. On top of that, just cook it slowly until it is the consistancy of the desired consistency. If your cream cheese has a real block of cheese in it, it will soften slightly. Put in a blender or food processor and pulse until it is finely ground. The best way to do this is in a coffee canister for about 30 seconds and it will blend. You will have to do this in 2 batches. Once this is pureed use a regular blender, although for me this is quite a dry soup, you will not need to boil it down. Add the chopped onions and mix thoroughly until they are fully incorporated. If you like you can sprinkle with additional salt. Pour the soup mixture into a pot and simmer over medium heat for 45 minutes or until the soup has thickened slightly. Don't boil it down, just stir, and remove from heat. You can eat it right away, or store it in the fridge, covered, for up to a week or make it the next day ahead of time and reheat it before serving. It is especially nice when you serve it straight from the pot.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,cinnamon bark,red wine vinegar,white pepper,cream cheese
title: Stacked Sour Cream Cheese Appetizer
ingredients: 2 packages cream cheese, soft | 1 cup dark soy sauce | 1/3 cup red wine vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | 1/8 teaspoon ground cinnamon bark
instructions: Blend cream cheese, soy sauce, vinegar, white pepper and cinnamon bark in blender until smooth.

Random Ingredients: white bread,red curry paste,mayonnaise,dill weed,yukon gold potato
title: Breaded Kumara on the Grill
ingredients: 1 lb yukon gold potato, peeled and cut in half | 1 teaspoon red curry paste or 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1 tablespoon mayonnaise | 1/2 teaspoon dill weed | 2 slices white bread, cut 1/2 thick
instructions: Place the potato in a large pot of salted water. Bring to a boil over medium high heat, and cook until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain and cool under running water. Meanwhile, combine the red curry paste, mayonnaise and dill weed in a mortar and pestle or food processor, and stir to blend. Spread the potato slices on toasted bread slices. Dip each slice of bread into curry mixture and then spread on toasted bread. Grill the bread, turning once, in batches, until golden on the cheese side.

Random Ingredients: margarine,taco sauce,onion powder,black olive,wide egg noodle,chicken broth,cheddar cheese,date
title: Noodle and Beef Bake
ingredients: 3 tablespoons margarine | 1/2 cup chopped onion | 32 ounces canned and drained fully cooked boneless round beef or 32 ounces chicken breasts | 1 jar taco sauce | 0.5 package wide egg noodles ( i use pkg. of 'champagne noodle') | 1/2 cup sliced large fresh pitted black olives | 1/2 cup shredded cheddar cheese | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning or 1 teaspoon onion powder
instructions: Preheat oven to melt butter in microwave. Add onion and cook on high 1 to 2 minutes stirring until softened. Add beef and taco sauce, stir to heat throughout and cook about 3 to 5 minutes until heated through. Mix noodles, olives, & cheese in large bowl and pour beef mixture into casserole dish. Cook uncovered in oven@ 400 for 15 to 20 minutes or until heated through.

title: Red Beans With Beer
ingredients: 400 g red beans, cleaned and drained | 150 ml beer or 150 ml ale
instructions: Pour enough beer or ale to just cover the beans, and mix. Leave to ferment in a cool dark place until aldente. If you are in a hurry, just pop back in the fridge for a half hour, then put on the lid again and reheat.

title: Spicy Curry Powder (Smoked Chile Powder)
ingredients: 2 pounds ground round | 1/4 cup mild indian curry paste ( such as masala or mild curry powder ) | 1 tablespoon mexican oregano | 1 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Combine the ground meat with the curry paste, oregano and allspice in a bowl. Shape the ground meat into small balls that are less than 1 1/2 inches in diameter and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.

title: Mexican Pizza Pie Crust
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast | 1 teaspoon guajillo prepared horseradish ( the real stuff ) | 1 can campbell light cream of mushroom soup ( the real stuff ) or can low-fat cream of mushroom soup ( the real stuff ) | 1 teaspoon low-fat sour creamed hyrian's prepared horseradish | 1 tablespoon lime juice | 5 1/2 - 6 cups miniature multicolored pizza crusts, lightly greased
instructions: The day before using, and yeast are in separate container and the sour cream is room temperature. In a separate bowl, mix together with an electric mixer the 2 cans soup, sour cream and creamed hyrian's horseradish until smooth. Stir in yeast mixture and pour into a greased 13x9 pan. Scatter pizza crusts evenly over pizza. Cover and let rise until doubled. Bake in 400f degree oven for 20 minutes or until crust is golden brown. Remove from oven and let cool. Cut into squares. Serve with your favorite dip or topping.

title: Buffalo Pepperoni
ingredients: 1 package pepperoni | 0.5 package taco seasoning mix | 0.5 package curry paste
instructions: Place pepperoni and taco seasoning mix into a bowl and stir. Place spice mix into a pan with some water. Heat and simmer the paste with the pepperoni for 10 to 15 minutes or until the flavors are blended. Serve with chips, vegetables, or as a dip with your favorite cheese.

title: Egg Drop Soup for Two
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dry kidney beans ( or white beans ) | 6 large eggs | 1/4 lb fresh pecan halves or 1/4 lb ground walnuts | 1/8 cup fish sauce ( nuoc mam ) | 1 1/2 cups bottled hot sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Cook, stirring frequently, until the eggs are set and egg yolks are slightly thickened. If desired, you can add a little hot sauce. If desired, you can make these in a large soup pot. Serve the soup with a large scoop of ice cream..

title: Southern Balsamic Chicken and Hominy
ingredients: 2 cans white hominy | 4 pounds chicken wings | 1 sprig dried savory | 1 cup balsamic vinegar | 1 pound balsamic vinegar
instructions: In a large bowl drain and rinse the hominy.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce,chili powder,milk chocolate,green bean,basil leaf,egg yolk
title: Chili-Rific Chocolate Salad
ingredients: 1/2 head romaine lettuce | 8 large egg yolks, beaten | 16 ounces green beans, cut into 1-inch pieces | 16 ounces milk chocolate, chopped and cooled | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 3 tablespoons fresh basil leaves
instructions: Slice romaine lettuce head crosswise into six ribbons.

Random Ingredients: spice,mozzarella cheese,chicken bouillon cube,red wine,tortilla,bread crumb,champagne
title: Chicken or Chardonnay Nachos
ingredients: 1 chicken bouillon cube | 2 tablespoons champagne | 1 tablespoon dry bread crumbs | 2 tablespoons red wine | 1 tablespoon mixed spice | 1/2 cup lowfat mozzarella cheese | 2 large tortillas
instructions: Put chicken broth, champagne, bread crumbs, wine and mixed spice in a large saucepan. Simmer for 5 minutes or until it tastes to your liking. Take off heat and remove the chicken or chardonnay from the broth. Cut the tortillas into strips and set aside. Put about 1 teaspoon of this broth mixture in each tortilla strip and then top with equal amounts of cheese and chicken or chardonnay. Spray a nonstick skillet with cooking spray and lightly heat over medium heat. Place one tortilla strip in the skillet and turn over. When the tortilla strip is golden brown on one side, place it on a plate and place it back in the pan. Repeat steps 3 - 4 until all the tortillas are done, adding more broth mixture if necessary. When it is done spoon all the nachos on a plate.

title: Easy Microwave Poached Fish
ingredients: 4 cups fish, cooked | 3 chile peppers
instructions: Mix with a brush till well coated, refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: oatmeal,hot chili sauce,beef bouillon,parmesan cheese,grain white rice,black bean sauce
title: Jamaican Rice
ingredients: 3 cups cooked medium grain white rice | 1 can black beans in hot chili sauce | 1 cup oatmeal ( quick cooking ) | 1/4 cup parmesan cheese ( optional-i prefer the kraft variety of grated cheese ) or 1/4 cup swiss cheese ( optional-i prefer the kraft variety of grated cheese ) | 2 tablespoons hot chili sauce ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons beef bouillon ( optional )
instructions: Stir oatmeal and pepper sauce until oatmeal is toasted. Add toasted rice. Stir in parmesean, if using. Add hot chili sauce and beef bouillon. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: cardamom,plum tomato,mint,portuguese bread,vegetable oil,pork loin roast
title: Minty Bread and Tomato Pulled Pork
ingredients: 2 packages portuguese or country bread pieces | 4 pounds boneless pork loin roast | 2 1/2 cups chopped fresh mint | 2 1/2 cups diced peeled plum tomatoes | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Place the bread into a large resealable plastic bag. Slice into 1/2 inch pieces. Place into a roasting pan large enough to accommodate both pieces. Pour enough water into the pan to come 1/4 up the side of the bread and bread. Arrange the pork slices in an even layer over the bread. Bake in the preheated oven until meat is cooked through, about 2 hours.

title: Queso Blanco
ingredients: 2 cups light taco sauce | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Spoon taco sauce into a blender, adding almond extract on top.

Random Ingredients: canadian bacon,spring onion,chili flake,chicken broth,celery salt
title: Spicy Canadian Bacon Soup
ingredients: 4 slices canadian bacon, in 1/2 `` pieces | 1 1/4 cups diced celery salt | 1 bunch spring onion, diced | 5 1/4 cups canned chicken stock or 5 1/4 cups low sodium canned chicken broth | 2 teaspoons dried chili flakes ( optional )
instructions: Over medium heat fry the bacon until crispy, about 6 minutes, add the celery salt, and stir to coat the bacon, about 3 minutes. Add the bacon and the spring onion to the mixture, stir well, and cook about 1 minute more. Add the chicken or vegetable broth, and chile flakes, and heat up until the soup boils almost completely. Serve hot. Variations with potatoes, broccoli, carrots, celery, green beans, or corn.

title: Crispy Won Ton Wraps With Lime Juice and Batter
ingredients: 24 wonton wrappers | 1 1/2 cups buttermilk | 1 tablespoon potato flour | 1 tablespoon lime juice
instructions: Prepare a baking sheet with olive oil spray. In a medium bowl, stir together the buttermilk, salt, and 1 tablespoon of potato flour. Stir in the lime juice. Brush a won ton wrapper with oil and place a teaspoon of the won ton mixture along the center vein of the wonton wrapper. Press together the edges of the wrapper and make a triangle. Repeat with remaining won ton wrapper and filling. Brush tops of the won tons with the remaining lime juice and sprinkle generously with the paprika. Place on the prepared baking sheet. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes in the preheated oven, until the tops are golden.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,elbow macaroni,chickpea flour,asafoetida powder,head lettuce,goat cheese,kalamata olive
title: Goat Cheese and Chickpea Bites
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups uncooked elbow macaroni | 3/4 cup canned diced goat cheese | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom seed | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 1 teaspoon crushed dried chickpea flour | 1/2 cup finely chopped kalamata olives | 1 head lettuce, chopped
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Cook elbow macaroni in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain and set aside. Meanwhile, mix goat cheese, cardamom, asafoetida, and chickpea flour in a bowl. Stir in olives. Pour cheese mixture into the bowl with goat cheese mixture. Chill until the filling is firm, about 1 hour.

title: Apple Beef Stew (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 3 lbs stewing beef, trimmed | 1/2 cup canola oil | 1/2 cup capers, drained | 1 large apple, cored & cut into 1/4 inch slices | 1/4 teaspoon msg
instructions: Coat the bottom of a 3 to 4 to 5 quart crock with oil and place beef over it. Sprinkle the apple slices evenly over the beef. Sprinkle the capers over the meat. Pour hot water into slow cooker to reach the top of the meat. Set to high. Cook for 8 hours. Remove cover, using two forks, and remove beef from crock. Increase temperature to high. Stir in msg and pour contents into crock. Heat to boiling.

title: Grape Leaves With Poppy Seed
ingredients: 12 large egg yolks | 5/8 teaspoon chili powder | 10 tablespoons poppy seeds
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk the egg yolks with the chili powder. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for about 20 minutes, until mixture is very thick and the whisk is clean. To assemble the leaves, brush the flat edge of 2 large saute pans with some oil and set aside. Scatter about 1 tablespoon of poppy seeds evenly on the bottom of the saute pans, then layer about 1 tablespoon each of poppy and grape leaves, overlapping the rows of seeds slightly to form a square base layer and a narrow wall that is about 1/2 inch wide. Repeat with remaining ingredients in another saute pan, ending with grape leaves on top. Cover with a plate, to keep warm. Place a heavy object of the saute pan over medium high heat. When a bead of water dropped on the saute pan bottom instantly evaporates it, holding the pan over the burner. Turn off the heat. Carefully remove the plate and any excess moisture from the saute pan, leaving the remaining drippings inside. Use as garnish over the grape leaves at the table.

Random Ingredients: green bean,sherry wine,ladyfinger,veal cutlet,olive oil,golden raisin,catsup
title: Veal With Two Fillings
ingredients: 1/2 lb veal cutlet | 6 ladyfingers | 6 tablespoons sherry wine or 6 tablespoons apple cider | 3 tablespoons catsup, a.1 | 1/2 lb fresh green beans, trimmed | 2 tablespoons oil or 2 tablespoons olive oil | 2 tablespoons golden raisins
instructions: Cut veal crosswise 1/4 inch thick. Brush both sides with oil. Heat heavy large skillet over moderate heat until hot but not smoking. Add half of veal, fat side up and sauté 3 minutes or until golden brown and fat is rendered. Using slotted spoon transfer veal to large platter and keep warm. Repeat procedure with remaining veal. While skillet is heating, soak ladyfingers in sherry until softened, about 10 minutes.

title: French Onion Salad
ingredients: 1/2 small onion ( espelled and thinly sliced ) | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar
instructions: Mix gently. This can be served either cold or room temperature, but is better after an hour or so refrigerated.

title: Pimento Garlic Loaf
ingredients: 300 g self-raising flour | 1 teaspoon garlic powder ( or equivalent ) | 3 tablespoons chopped pimiento
instructions: Sift dry ingredients into a large bowl with a fork. Drain liquid from the pimientos into this. Sprinkle garlic onto mixture and combine. Wrap bowl with kitchen absorbent paper and place on top of foil on your counter. Set in microwave and cook on high power for 9 - 11 minutes. Remove from dish and allow to sit for a few minutes. Cut into slices and serve.

Random Ingredients: yellow mustard,spaghetti,tomato green chilies,hot italian sausage,cilantro
title: Spicy Sausage and Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 package dry spaghetti | 1/2 lb hot italian sausage | 2 cans diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 1/2 cup red-wine prepared yellow mustard | 1/2 cup chopped cilantro
instructions: To prepare, bring 3/4 cup water to boil in a large saucepan. Meanwhile, remove casings from sausage. Cut sausage into 1/2 inch slices. Add sausage to boiling water and cook 3 minutes or until no longer pink. Drain, return to saucepan. Add tomatoes and chilies. Simmer, uncovered, over medium high heat 8 minutes or until slightly thickened, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat. Stir in mustard and cilantro. Serve over cooked spaghetti.

title: Quick Honey Moroccan Chicken
ingredients: 1 cup pizza sauce | 2 tablespoons honey | 1 1/2 lbs chicken drumsticks | 1 bag olives, chopped
instructions: Rinse chicken pieces under cold water. Pat dry and set aside. Preheat oven to 250 degrees. In large frying pan bring pizza sauce and honey to a boil. Slice chicken in half lengthwise and scrape all the white juices from the bottom of the pan. Arrange in a shallow casserole dish. Put the olives on the chicken. Pour sauce over chicken. Bake covered, for about 45 minutes.

title: Tuna and Apricot Stuffed With Two Skin
ingredients: 1/3 cup heavy cream | 4 tablespoons canned tuna chunks, drained | 2 packages ladyfingers | 1/2 cup apricot, chopped | 1/3 cup japanese eggplant, diced | 1 package crescent rolls
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. In small bowl, mix cream and tuna. Separate ladyfingers into 2 layers. Sprinkle 1 cup of apricots over ladyfingers. Place a layer of tuna mixture in center of each ladyfinger.

title: Champignons Mushrooms
ingredients: 100 g button mushrooms | 1/2 teaspoon scotch bonnet pepper
instructions: Cut the mushrooms into quarters and slice the caps into halves or quarters again. Heat a pan over medium heat, when there are 1/4 cup of water nearby, add the sctch bonnet pepper and quickly sauté it for a few seconds, but do not allow it to brown. Add the mushrooms, sauté them for a minute or two, then remove from heat and serve right away.

title: Tender and Creamy BBQ Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb boneless chicken breast | 2 tablespoons dried parsnips | 2 ounces hot strong coffee | 14 ounces sage, leaves and stems
instructions: Cut chicken into 1 inch cubes. Toss chicken with dried parsnips.

title: Minty Citrus Delight
ingredients: 3 serrano chilies or 3 pasilla chilies, seeded and chopped | 2/3 cup orange juice or 2/3 cup lemon juice | 2 celery ribs, chopped | 1 sprig of fresh mint, chopped
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender and blend on high speed just until smooth. Store in refrigerator when ready to use or store in small jars for up to 2 months. Yield is estimated.

Random Ingredients: beef stock,brown rice,flat leaf parsley,caper,spring onion
title: Brown Rice With Caper Gravy
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice, uncooked | 1 2/3 cups beef stock | 2 tablespoons capers, drained ( drained of liquid ) | 1 teaspoon finely chopped flat leaf parsley | 1 -2 bunch spring onion, finely chopped
instructions: Bring the beef stock to the boil in a saucepan and then add the cooked brown rice, chopped flat leaf parsley, drained capers and a few green spring onions. Cook on high heat until liquid is absorbed and rice thickens slightly. You may need to add a little more stock and water as the rice is cooking. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,tomato paste,pizza cheese,peanut,corn tortilla chip,navy bean
title: Chilean Pizza With Navy Beans & Corn Chips
ingredients: 2 cups leftover cooked navy beans, chilled overnight | 2 cups finely crushed corn tortilla chips | 1 cup shredded light breadless pizza cheese | 1/3 cup tomato paste | bean sprouts, drained ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons chopped and salted peanuts, finely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Combine bean sprouts and cheese in medium bowl, breaking up crumbs. Spread bean sprouts evenly over tortilla strips, top with bean sprouts and cheese. Bake 15 - 20 minutes or until crumbs are golden brown and cheese is bubbly. Serve pizza sprinkled with peanuts on the side.

title: Famous Italian Meatloaf
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 1 cup white breadcrumbs | 1 can tomatoes
instructions: Combine ground beef and bread crumbs. Press into 9x5 loaf pan. Sprinkle top with can of tomatoes. Bake 350 for 45 min until internal temperature reaches 160. Remove from oven, spoon off fat. Let stand for a few minutes before cutting into 16 slices using a pizza cutter or pizza cutter. Serve.

title: Chestnut Cakes
ingredients: 1/2 cup chestnuts or 1/2 cup cooked chestnuts, chopped | 1 egg white | 1 tablespoon peas | 2 tablespoons sliced green peppers | 1/4 cup chopped pecan pieces | 1 teaspoon lemons or 1 teaspoon vinegar | green onion, chopped
instructions: Process chestnuts, egg white, peas, green peppers and pecans. Blend well. Shape into 1 inch patties. Grill. Serve on lettuce leaves.

title: Pomegranate Molasses Snack - Snack
ingredients: 1/2 cup pomegranate molasses | 4 cups breadcrumbs | 1 cup guacamole, heated
instructions: Mix pomegranate molasses and bread crumbs. Mix hot pomegranate molasses and pomegranate molasses. Spread on cracker/vegetables. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: garam masala powder,hot noodle,mayonnaise,red food coloring,italian parsley,hard
title: Indian Parsley Appetizers
ingredients: 8 slices hard rolls ( indian bread ) | 3/4 cup mayonnaise | 3 tablespoons sweet chili sauce or 3 tablespoons red food coloring | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala powder | 3/4 cup roasted italian parsley ( chopped ) | 1/4 teaspoon italian parsley ( chopped )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Using a paper towel, pat rolls dry. Cut rolls in half, then split each half lengthwise. Set aside. Mix together the mayonnaise, chili sauce, garam masala and parsley. Spread mixture on top half of rolls. Place cut side down on baking sheet. Bake at 375°f for 4 - 5 minutes or until golden. Allow to cool then cut each roll in half and serve.

title: Baked Parsnip & Cannellini Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 lb parsnip, washed, unpeeled, bathed in | coffee | 2 cans cannellini beans, drained | 2 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, chopped | 5 tablespoons yoghurt
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Cut the parsnips into small wedges. Place in a baking dish. Douse with coffee. Cover tightly with aluminium foil and place in the oven. Bake for 15 mins and then turn the oven off. Leave to cook for a further 12 minutes. While the parsnips are roasting, mix the beans with the parsley. Add the yoghurt and stir in to combine. When cooked, toss through the parsnips and gently heat through. Serve.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,thai basil,herring fillet,vegetable oil cooking spray,pork sauce,red wine vinegar,heavy cream
title: Herring in Red Wine
ingredients: 1 medium herring fillet, cut into rings | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/2 can reduced-sodium pork sauce | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 1/2 cup packed light brown sugar | 1/4 cup heavy cream | 1/4 cup fresh thai basil, torn with fingers
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f arrange herring in one layer in a 9x13x2 inch baking dish coated with oil. Bake about 10 minutes or until fish flakes easily when flaked with a fork. In a small bowl, combine pork sauce, vinegar, brown sugar and cream. Stir well. Pour over fish, tossing until coated. Bake, uncovered, about 20 minutes or until fish flakes easily when pierced with a fork. In a small serving bowl, toss basil with half of cream mixture. Spoon dollops over fish.

title: Mexican Beef With Turnips
ingredients: 1/2 cup diced jalapeno chile ( canned ) | 1 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin, sliced ( or use sirloin ) | 1 beef bouillon cube, dissolved in | 1/4 cup water
instructions: Place jalapenos in a small bowl. Cover with boiling water, and let soak, stirring occasionally, until tender. Drain. Combine jalapenos, beef bouillon, and water in a skillet, and heat over medium heat until boiling. Add sliced tenderloin, reduce heat, and simmer until no pink remains. Sprinkle with salt when serving.

title: Oven Calzone
ingredients: 2 large roasting pumpkin | 3 ounces light muscovado sugar | 2 fluid ounces single cream | 2 teaspoons creole seasoning
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°c. Remove the flesh from the pumpkin, cut into thick slices and place on a roasting tray, skin side down. Rub the sugar and creole seasoning over the pumpkin. Place the tray in the oven and bake for 1 hour 15 minutes.

title: Quinoa Fish Pie
ingredients: 0.5 pre-made pie crust ( like old world isle pie crust ) | 1 1/3 cups light cornflour | 3 tablespoons chopped pickled jalapenos or 3 tablespoons pickled jalapeno peppers | 2 1/2 cups dry quinoa ( not minute rice ) | 1/3 cup bottled clam juice | 6 lemons, cut into wedges
instructions: In a large frying pan, combine cornflour and jalapenos. Stir over low heat until mixture resembles a thick paste. Stir in quinoa until combined. Pour into pre baked pie shell and bake at c for 10 - 15 minutes or until golden brown. When pie is almost cooked, combine clam juice and lemon juice.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt black pepper,italian spice,bell pepper,pepper,grapeseed oil,cardamom seed,dough,chili powder
title: Lebanese Pepper Bread
ingredients: 1 1/3 cups grapeseed oil | 1/2 cup dried bell peppers or 1/2 cup roasted red pepper | 1 -2 tablespoon chili powder | 2 -3 tablespoons kosher salt, to taste | 1 tablespoon ground pepper | 1 large bell pepper, seeded and diced | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed, crushed | 1 teaspoon freshly ground italian spices | 1 teaspoon fresh ground pepper | 1 pinch kosher salt | 1 pinch cardamom seed, crushed
instructions: Heat grapeseed oil in a skillet over medium to medium high heat. Add dry peppers and sautee for 5 minutes, stirring frequently. If peppers become dry, pour in some water and stir. Add chili powder and kosher salt. Add 1/2 teaspoon pepper and sautee for 2 - 3 minutes, stirring occasionally. Do not allow mixture to dry out. Add bell pepper, stir. Add remaining 1/2 teaspoon pepper, cardamom seeds, italian seasoning and 1 pinch of salt. Stir again. Remove from heat and allow to cool for 5 minutes. The pepper mixture should be fairly dry. Add cardamom seeds and mix well. Transfer mixture to a loaf pan or large baking sheet, cover and chill for 2 - 24 hours. Slice into thick slices and serve warm. It tastes wonderful if eaten the next day.

Random Ingredients: vegetable broth,milk,vinegar,green onion,chipotle chile,potato,red pepper flake,black
title: Chipotle Potato and Pepper Soup
ingredients: 2 onions, chopped | 3/4 cup vegetable broth | 1 can chipotle chiles, diced ( in adobo sauce ) | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 1 tablespoon ground black pepper, to taste | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes ( or to taste ) | 2 medium potatoes, peeled and diced | 3 cups 1 % low-fat milk
instructions: In a medium saucepan, saute onion in oil for a few minutes until translucent. Meanwhile, break up the chipotle chiles into small pieces as you cut. Add the chipotle chiles and vinegar to the onions and blend. Add broth, potatoes, black pepper and red pepper flakes stir to blend well. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes. Enjoy.

title: Homemade Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 cup lettuce ( i recommend romaine or mix of green leaf lettuces and green peas ) | 1 tablespoon minced garlic clove
instructions: Prepare 1 cup lettuce or mixed greens and set aside. In a small bowl, add garlic and minced garlic. Dice remaining cup of greens and add to garlic mixture. Dressing is done dressing may need to be served at room temperature or chilled.

title: Chicken With Mustard
ingredients: 8 chicken legs | 1 1/4 tablespoons dry sherry wine | 2 teaspoons anchovy, minced | 2 cans cut green beans | 1 1/2 tablespoons honey mustard | 1/2 cup salted cracker ( i use the crisp cracker crumb from trader joe's ) | 1/4 cup dressing, creamy kind ( or more )
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees. Place chicken legs in large casserole dish.. Pour sherry over, sprinkle with sea salt. Insert a wooden stick or toothpick in each piece so that tooth picks don't slip through into chicken.. Cover with foil, bring to temperature, bake for 45 minutes. Meanwhile, pour anchovies into small bowl, add 1/2 cup water, mix well. Drain chicken, discard bones and skin. Pour water mixture over chicken, bake for another 45 minutes, or until chicken is done. To thicken, stir in remaining ingredients. Note, the dip can be made into a thick but spreadable dressing if desired.

title: Sardines in Cheese and Sesame Crust
ingredients: 12 fresh sardines, rinsed | 1/3 cup finely grated orange zest | 3/4 cup grated gruyere | 1/4 cup sesame seeds | salt and pepper, to taste | 12 manicotti | 24 slices manicotti | 2 cups shredded asadero cheese
instructions: Pre heat oven to 400 degrees. Place all ingredients except for the manicotti in a food processor or blender and process until finely grated. Cut a slit into each end of the sardines and fill each one with the mixture. Place on a well seasoned baking sheet and bake about 40 minutes, or until sardines are firm. In a separate baking pan, heat the asadero cheese and the manicotti shells. Sprinkle tops with the asadero cheese. Bake until hot.

title: Chinese Watercress Tea
ingredients: 1 bunch chinese rice wine ( mai fun ), chilled | 24 fresh watercress, leaves picked | 1 ounce sliced prosciutto ( or other thin, crisp piece of ham )
instructions: Divide watercress among four tea cups. Bring 2 inches of water to a boil in a deep saucepan and skim off any foam that rises to the top. Add the chilled wine. Cover and let steep about 20 minutes. Ladle 1 - 2 teaspoonfuls of tea into a glass and top with ham. Garnish with additional greens.

title: Mexican Veggies
ingredients: 2 cans chicken broth | 1 red chili pepper, seeded and finely chopped | 1/2 medium yellow squash, sliced into thin bite-sized strips | 1 scallion, sliced ( green onion may be substituted )
instructions: Pour 1 cup of the chicken broth into a 9x13 inch glass baking dish. Set aside in refrigerator. In a large bowl, stir 1 cup of the chicken broth with the green onion and the finely chopped chili. Stir in half of the squash, half of the scallion, half of the veggie mixture, and 1/2 cup of the remaining broth. Dot with remaining squash mixture. Cover generously and refrigerate for at least four hours, and up to 8 hours. Note, if desired, add additional 1 cup of the reserved chicken broth. This can be served cold.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms (Capetown Mushrooms)
ingredients: 1 box button mushrooms, cleaned | 2 tablespoons raisins | 1/2 - 1 cup milk, depending on desired consistence | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon distilled white vinegar | ice cube
instructions: Prepare mushroom caps and wash. Take off the stems of the mushrooms. Cut a large hole down the center of the cleaned mushrooms so they resemble a cup. Fill the mushroom caps with the dried stuffing. Put on the ice cubes and let sit for 10 minutes. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: corn syrup,tuna,cashew nut,ginger root,chipotle chile,pea,red chile
title: Smoothie-Cashew Nut Tuna Spread
ingredients: 1 can tuna | 1 package frozen peas | 4 ounces cashew nuts, cashew nuts, cashew oil peanuts | 5 dried red chiles | 2 chipotle chiles | 1 tablespoon light corn syrup | 1 slice fresh ginger root
instructions: Open the can of tuna and drain. Combine the drained tuna with the peas, cashew nuts, chiles, chipoltes, corn syrup, ginger, and cashew nuts in a food processor and process into a smooth paste. Cover and refrigerate until serving.

Random Ingredients: coconut extract,red pepper,white chocolate,pinto bean,spanish onion,black bean,chunky salsa
title: Spanish Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans | 1 can black beans | 1 jar chunky salsa | 1 tablespoon coconut extract | 1 spanish onion, diced | 1 tablespoon red pepper, diced | 1 package white chocolate, chopped
instructions: Drain all the liquid out of the can of beans. Transfer the beans to a saucepan and add the rest of the ingredients. Cover and simmer on the lowest possible heat for 45 minutes. Turn off heat and leave the dip and set for 20 minutes. Serve warm with tortilla chips.

title: Indian Style Sliced Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tenderloin | 1 cup fresh grated white breadcrumb | 1/2 cup fresh cilantro leaves | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1/2 orange
instructions: Slice or score the meat. Mix breadcrumbs, cilantro, mace and garam masala, with the orange into a paste. Pour over meat. Marinate in the refrigerator for 3 days, turning occasionally. Drain meat in bag for 10 - 15 minutes before serving.

title: Swiss Chard With Brown Sugar and Parsley
ingredients: 1 -2 swiss chard | 1 ounce dried parsley | 2 tablespoons brown sugar, packed
instructions: Separate leaves of chard, removing stems and blemishes. Thoroughly wash leaves, then set them crosswise in a bowl. Trim stems with fingers. Cut lengthwise into 1/4 inch slices and cut diagonally into 3/4 inch wide strips of chard. Wash well. Place in a 2 quart saucepan with just enough water to cover and bring to a boil over moderate heat. Simmer, covered, until chard is very tender, about 2½ hours. Drain well and place in a fine mesh strainer. Combine chard stems, parsley and sugar.

title: Raspberry Gravy for Pasta
ingredients: 1/4 cup dried crushed raspberries or 1/4 cup chopped fresh raspberries | 1 cup small onion, chopped | 4 tablespoons raspberry jam | 1/2 cup pizza sauce | 1 teaspoon white sugar
instructions: Mix the dried fruit and onion. You can add a little lemon juice or honey if desired. Add the preserves and stir to mix. Bring to boiling. Reduce heat and simmer 15 - 20 minutes. Season to taste. Serve with your favourite dry pasta.

Random Ingredients: vegetable seasoning,beef brisket,beef chuck roast,red onion,caper,kernel corn,tabasco sauce
title: Slow Cooker Shredded Beef Pot Roast
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs beef chuck roast | 1 red onion, sliced | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 1 can chipotle peppers in adobo sauce ( use your choice of heat level ) or ( 12 ounce ) can chipotle chilies in adobo sauce ( use your choice of heat level ) | 1 -2 teaspoon vegetable seasoning ( optional garnish ) | 1 -2 tablespoon capers | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon tabasco sauce, to taste
instructions: Place roast in crock pot. Top with onion. In a saucepan heat chipotle sauce, vegetable seasoning, capers and tabasco sauce to desired heat level. Pour over roast, onion, and spice mixture in crock pot. Cover and cook on low for 8 - 10 hours or on high for 5 hours. Remove beef to carving board, cool slightly and shred with two forks. Return sliced meat to cooker, mix well. Serve. Leftovers can be frozen.

title: Lamb or Tabbouleh
ingredients: 1 lb lamb or 1 lb beef, sliced into long slivers | 1 pinch cayenne pepper, ground
instructions: Place the lamb or beef on a dry, flat surface. Sprinkle the cayenne pepper over the beef or lamb. Roll the meat around the onion. Tie with butcher string or kitchen twine. Rub the meat with the cayenne. Place it in a foil lined roasting tin which has been heated to the boiling point of the meat. Cook in a pre heated 275f degree oven for about 2½ hours to two hours or until a meat thermometer reaches 155f on an instant read thermometer. Variation, you could also roast the meat on a baking tray in the oven at 425f for 30 45minutes. Bake in a pre heated 375f degree oven for 40 45minutes or until brown. This way, the lamb will be much more cooked through and delicious. Variation, if you wish to serve as roast meat, serve these with boiled rice. Variation, the alternative to the lamb is to cook on top of a pan of boiling water and simmer on the stove top with a tight fitting lid and cook the outside of the lamb or beef for about 1 hour. Or you can bake in the oven at 350 in a pan for 3 hours with a tight fitting lid, then bake.

Random Ingredients: brown rice flour,basmati rice,rose essence,baking potato,graham cracker crumb,water
title: Langham Pilaff - Sticky Rice Balls
ingredients: 3 ounces graham cracker crumbs, crushed | 1 large baking potato, chopped finely | 1 -2 tablespoon brown rice flour | 2 teaspoons rice essence or 2 teaspoons essence | 1/4 cup water ( optional ) | 1 1/4 cups basmati rice, rinsed
instructions: Combine graham cracker crumbs, potato, rice flour, essence& water and mix thoroughly. Form mixture into balls or patties and refrigerate while making the rice mixture.. Place rice in deep saucepan and cover with 5 cups boiling water. Bring to the boil, reduce heat, cover and simmer for 10 - 15 mins or until almost cooked. Remove from heat. Cool, then chill. Prepare rice, drain and return rice to saucepan. Cover with boiling water and stand for 10 mins or until almost cooked. Remove from heat. Drain rice mixture. Using your hands, press a few rice balls into hot rice until well coated, about 5cm or less thick. Flip over and cook a few minutes more, until lightly golden. Dip in rice immediately to coat the other side. Serve with your favourite curry and minted yoghurt or chutney.

title: Home Made Chicken
ingredients: 2 cups chicken bouillon, crushed | 1 tablespoon hing
instructions: Mix together. Marinate up to 2 days no longer than 24 hours.

title: Zucchini Almond Crabs
ingredients: 2 medium zucchini ( about 1 pound ) | 4 tablespoons almond paste | 1/2 cup peas, fresh | 1 cup crabmeat, fresh | 1/2 cup cornmeal, plain | pam cooking spray
instructions: Cut zucchini in half lengthwise, then cut into 1/4 inch slices crosswise. Place in 1 layer on cookie sheet. Cover with plastic wrap and microwave until zucchini is tender, about 12 minutes. Stir almond paste into zucchini until smooth. Stir peas into zucchini mixture. Preheat oven to 400°f. Spray each piece of zucchini with pam. Spray a large shallow baking dish or a 3 1/2 to 4 1/2 cup ovenproof skillet with pam. Spread half of squash mixture in dish, leaving 1 1/2 inch edge on all sides. Top with 2 tablespoons crab. Top with 1/2 cup peas. Arrange remaining halves of squash mixture over crab. Spread cornmeal on top and sides of the shrimp. Dunk the shrimp in cornmeal and place on top of the vegetables. Top shrimp with more cornmeal. Cover with foil and bake until shrimp turn bright pink, about 40 minutes. Remove foil and top with the remaining half of squash mixture. Bake until shrimp turn pink, about 20 minutes.

title: Raita Maafe
ingredients: 1 small cabbage | 1/2 teaspoon channa dal
