instructions: Pick up a whole cabbage. Break it away. Take a piece of the cabbage core and wrap it around a small piece of dried channa dal. Wrap it with some or all of the optional ingredients. You can use a large piece of twine to tie it up or you can tie it up. Add the dal to a pan and turn the heat to low. Let simmer until the channa dal cooks in about 10 minutes.

title: Crispy Red Curry
ingredients: 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar or 1 tablespoon sherry vinegar | 1 tablespoon cornflour
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl. Use as required for curry.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,lemon peel,caper,baby spinach,poblano chile,ra el hanout spice mix,rice,enchilada mix
title: Spanish Spinach and Rice Entree
ingredients: 2 bags baby spinach, frozen | 3 poblano chiles, roasted, skinned and blanched | 1 cup gruyere cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons ra el hanout spice mix | 4 cloves garlic, minced | 1/4 cup capers | 1 envelope dry enchilada mix | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon peel, grated | 4 cups cooked rice
instructions: Preparation, to prepare spinach mix and filling, place first 5 ingredients in a food processor, process to a paste. Remove mixture from food processor, and stir in conch de sauce, lemon peel and juice. Place spinach mixture in an oven proof dish. Sprinkle the top with cheese and bake at 350°f for 40 minutes. To serve, sprinkle with the capers. Serve with a dollop of sour cream if desired.

Random Ingredients: wasabi paste,purpose flour,vegetable oil,chunky salsa,kosher salt
title: Wasabi Salsa
ingredients: 2 cups chunky salsa | 1 package wasabi paste blend | 6 cups all-purpose flour | 2 cups vegetable oil | 6 tablespoons kosher salt
instructions: In a large bowl, combine salsa, wasabi paste blend, flour, salt, and oil. Mix until evenly combined. Adjust seasoning with kosher salt.

title: Coriander and White Onions (Serves Many)
ingredients: 450 g large white onions, roughly chopped | 1 tablespoon coriander seed
instructions: Heat the oil in a large frying pan, add all the ingredients and stir well. Simmer for 20 minutes until the onions are soft and glazed.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,eggplant,ouzo,celery seed,raisin,arborio rice,tomato soup,pepper sauce cayenne
title: Ratatouille with Rice
ingredients: 4 cups arborio rice or 4 cups basmati rice, dry | 1 large eggplant | 2 cans condensed tomato soup, undiluted | 2 tablespoons ouzo | 1 tablespoon celery seed, if desired | 1/2 cup raisins | 1 dash hot pepper sauce ( cayenne ) | 1 teaspoon dry basil or 1 teaspoon oregano
instructions: Peel eggplant. Cut into 3/4 inch slices. Place in a saucepan, cover with water and bring to a boil. Decrease heat to medium. Simmer 2 minutes, until slightly tender. Drain and allow to cool. Peel eggplant from skin and set aside. Cook rice according to package directions, then rinse. Drain the rice and let cool slightly, then spread in a greased 3 quart casserole dish. Spread the tomatoes with their juice evenly over the top of the rice, then spread the soup undiluted over the rice. Sprinkle on the ouzo, celery seeds, raisins and hot sauce. Spoon the eggplant over the soup and sprinkle with dry basil or oregano. Bake at 375 degrees f over low heat for 35 to 45 minutes, or until the tops are lightly browned and the soup bubbles up. This can also be made the night before and refrigerated, covered with plastic wrap.

Random Ingredients: garlic paste,beef chuck roast,thyme,coconut,snow pea,coffee,marinara sauce
title: Beef With Snow Peas and Coconut
ingredients: 1 small beef chuck roast | 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 3 cups bottled marinara sauce | 3 1/2 ounces sliced coconut | 3/4 cup brewed coffee | 5 ounces fresh snow peas
instructions: Trim excess fat from beef and cut into serving size pieces. Spray a nonstick frying pan with oil. Place meat pieces into hot pan and sear well on all sides. Reduce temperature to low and put marinara inside, cover and simmer 30 minutes. Stir often. Remove meat and shred meat. Return meat to broth and add coconut and coffee. Simmer, uncovered, 5 minutes, taste for flavor. Serve over fresh steamed rice or noodles.

title: Japanese Brandy Sauce (Niku No-Yaki) Easy Version
ingredients: 3/4 lb sweet white sesame oil ( i use dark sesame oil ) | 1/2 cup brandy ( use a good brandy brand )
instructions: Dissolve sesame oil, 1/2 cup brandy, into 1 cup water. Use as you would any other cooking oil.

title: Thai Charishma
ingredients: 2 cups short grain glutinous rice | 1/2 cup chopped dates | 2 tablespoons turbinado sugar | 2 tablespoons dried chili | 1 cup chopped mixed dried fruit | 1/3 cup icing sugar | 4 ounces corn, melted
instructions: To make the spice mixture, dry roast and brown the chillies in the sugar and then mix with the spice mixture. Keep heat on low, cook and stir till thick. Put the rice with dates in a large bowl. Add the spice mixture, sugar and dried fruit and mix with hands. Then add the icing sugar and mix well. Put over a pan of boiling water and leave to stand till all the liquid is absorbed. Pour into a sieve and let cool and then store in an airtight container. Serve cold.

title: Easy Brazilian Stock
ingredients: 4 cups chicken stock, such as swanson's | 1 tablespoon dried oregano
instructions: Combine chicken stock and dried oregano in a pot over medium heat.

title: Lime Cilantro Chutney
ingredients: 20 leaves fresh cilantro | 2 limes, zest and juice | 2 teaspoons caster sugar ( see notes ) | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 2 teaspoons italian parsley
instructions: Wash and chop cilantro fine, then put in a mixing bowl. Add the zest and juice and stir in the sugar, worcestershire sauce and parsley. Put in the refrigerator, stirring frequently for about 1 hour or until completely chilled.

title: Cilantro Vinaigrette
ingredients: 3 tablespoons fresh cilantro, minced | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1/2 cup packed light brown sugar
instructions: In a medium bowl combine 1 t. water, cilantro, vinegar & brown sugar.

title: Tasteedy Italian Style Tiramisu
ingredients: 1 container extra creamy greek yogurt | 4 cups very thin ladyfingers | 1 jar prepared alfredo sauce | 6 cups hot cooked rice
instructions: In a large bowl, combine yogurt and ladyfingers. Pour a layer of alfredo sauce in the bottom of an 8x8 inch glass dish or a 9x9 in square glass dish. Top with 1 1/2 cups of hot cooked rice. Repeat layers until dish is full. Top with remaining 1 1/2 cups of rice and 2 cups of yogurt mixture. Cover, and refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Serve.

Random Ingredients: pearl barley,white vinegar,green pea,cooking spray,tomato,soy sauce,broccoli floret,white bread
title: Beef Stir Fry With Green Peas and Broccoli
ingredients: 2 slices white bread, crusts removed | 1 tablespoon soy sauce | cooking spray | 1/3 cup frozen broccoli floret | pearl barley | 2/3 cup green peas | 2 tomatoes, sliced 1/4 inch thick | 1/2 cup white vinegar
instructions: Pour soy sauce over bread, sprinkle with some cracked pepper. Soak 8 - 10 minutes. Slice bread in half. Toast bread in oven or in toaster oven, 2 - 3 minutes till crisp. Remove bread from bread. Cook beef in pan sprayed with cooking oil. Heat 1/4 cup of water in microwave, add peas and barley. Cover and cook for 3 - 4 minutes till peas are crisp tender. Add tomatoes and simmer, covered, stirring once, 3 mins until tomatoes are tender. Mix together. Stir in vinegar and remaining water in pan, cook 1 minute. Serve beef over rice, garnish with peas and tomatoes.

title: Strawberries in a Cream and Lemon Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups strawberries, hulled and sliced | 1/2 white onion, diced small | 1 tablespoon icing sugar | 3 tablespoons lemon juice | 3/4 cup sliced almonds, toasted | 12 tortillas, torn | icing sugar, for dusting
instructions: Put strawberries in a medium bowl, add the onion and enough cold water to cover. Cover and chill until completely soft, 20 minutes to 1 hour. Drain off excess water. Combine the diced onion and sugar in a medium bowl with the lemon juice and almonds, and set aside. Brush each tortilla with melted butter or margarine and heat in a dry skillet until lightly toasted, about 2 seconds on each side. Stack the tortillas and divide the filling among them.

title: Teddy's Somen Shoyu Rice
ingredients: 1 cup sushi rice ( short or medium grain ) | 5 tablespoons peanut oil or 5 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1/2 cup canned chinese mushrooms ( optional )
instructions: Place a rice cooker with the lid or in the cooker's quick setting to the desired level of cooking. Heat oil in a 2 quart saucepan over high heat until a bead of white bead of water vaporizes on contact. Lift lid from cooker and add rice and mushrooms. Stir rice around until rice is well covered with oil and mushroom fluids.

Random Ingredients: chili paste,wheat flour,green olive,grape,asafoetida powder,dill pickle,tahini
title: Mixed Grapes with Dill Pickles
ingredients: 400 g whole wheat flour | 100 g safflower oil or 100 g grapeseed oil | 6 tablespoons tahini or 6 tablespoons lemon juice | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 red asafoetida powder, to taste | 100 g grape, seeded, cut into half | 1 can green olives, drained
instructions: Dough, mix flour and seasonings. Sourdough, mix ingredients. Form into a ball. Fold in greens and olives. Refrigerate until ready to use. Form into 6 patties, depending on your size, the dough should be elastic and a little sticky when you press a pattie into place. Refrigerate until needed. Cook on heated grill, on medium high, until the bottoms have turned light golden brown and patties start cooking.

title: Thai Basil Fish Sauce
ingredients: 1 can tomato sauce | 1/4 cup thai basil
instructions: Blend well in a food processor or with your regular vingear or immersion blender. To use, add a little hot water or paste to thin if desired. Can be stored in refrigerator, or frozen and reheated.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,linguine,chili pepper flake,manchego cheese,rindless bacon
title: Pineapple Glazed Over Linguine
ingredients: 3/4 lb linguine | 4 slices rindless bacon | 2 tablespoons pineapples in juice | 2 tablespoons manchego cheese, grated and divided | 1/4 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes
instructions: Cook linguine following instructions on package. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in skillet. Add rind and stir fry until lightly browned, 3 - 4 minutes. Remove from skillet, drain in paper towels and set aside. Add bacon and heat over med hi heat until beginning to crisp. Add pineapples and chile flakes. Stir fry until pineapples begin to turn golden. Toss with linguine and add 1 cup of the cheese..

Random Ingredients: channa dal,vegetable oil cooking spray,margarine,flat bread
title: Channa Dal Pita
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups uncooked channa dal | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 cup crumbled flat bread | 1 tablespoon margarine, melted
instructions: If fresh channa dal is still in pods, rinse it under cold water to remove excess moisture. In a microwave proof bowl, pour a little water to cover the top and microwave on high for about 20 seconds. Spread a little water on the bottom and sides of a baking tray. Place channa dal in a bowl, cover with water and add a little of the water, to moisten it. Microwave on high for 20 seconds until fully soft, to remove some of the moisture. Spread the channa dal on a plate and gently pat to dry the grains. Spray a little vegetable oil on the surface of the channa dal. Spread bread crumbs on a plate and in a separate plate, spray with margarine to lightly coat, then cut the bread into 8 wedges, using the rim of a glass dipped in vegetable oil.

title: Creole-Style Chicken Livers
ingredients: 20 chicken livers | 10 slices gingerroot | 1/2 ounce kahlua | 10 slices black olives | 1 celery rib, cut into 2 inch pieces
instructions: Arrange the chicken livers in a large bowl. Cut 1 slice of ginger in half, remove the hard outer pith from the central portion, and thinly slice across the livers removing all of the white pith and set aside. Measure ¼ cup of kahlua into a medium bowl, and mix with ½ cup water, and stir well to dissolve the alcohol. Strip each half into a ball with your thumb and tip out into a glass jar. Add the remaining ginger to the kahlua in the bowl, and coat the outside of the ball with the kahlua. Add the olives to the kahlua in the bowl, and shake to distribute. Transfer this mixture to the jar and cover with a layer of white plastic wrap. Store in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. Once ready to cook, bring the water to a boil, reduce the heat slightly, and refrigerate for up to 8 hours. When ready to cook, remove the plastic wrap, and carefully remove the livers from the jars using tongs, placing them in a large pot of boiling water, and cooking 6 minutes, or until al dente.

title: Fajita Stacks
ingredients: 2 cans tomato sauce | 2 teaspoons unsweetened cocoa | 1 1/2 tablespoons crisco | 2 cups dates, pitted and finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Mix tomato sauce, cocoa, crisco and dates. Roll mixture into 1 1/2 inch balls. Place on baking sheet, 2 inches apart, and bake until crisp on top, 20 to 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: saffron,kaffir lime leaf,champagne,canola oil,vegetable stock,rice vinegar,fennel bulb,pepperoni
title: Antipasto (Vegetarian Soup)
ingredients: 2 large fennel bulbs, trimmed and finely chopped ( about 2 cups ) | 3 tablespoons canola oil | 1 cup sliced pepperoni | 3 cups vegetable stock | 1/8 teaspoon saffron ( optional ) | 6 fresh kaffir lime leaves | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar or 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon sake or 1 tablespoon white wine
instructions: In a dutch oven over high heat, add the fennel and the oil and cook until the fennel has begun to char but is not yet beginning to brown, about 5 minutes. Add the pepperoni and sauté until the pepperoni has lightly browned, about 5 minutes. Add the stock and bring to a boil. Add the saffron, kaffir lime leaves and rice vinegar. Turn the heat back up to medium and bring to a boil. Turn the heat down and simmer until the soup is very thin and the flavors have blended and the soup is reduced by about half, about 30 minutes. Discard the kaffir lime leaves. Serve hot or at room temperature.

title: Orange Ginger Smoothie
ingredients: 1 cup orange juice | 2 teaspoons rice wine ( or soy sauce )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender or in a container, and mix well. Enjoy.

title: Guinness Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef stew meat, cut into 3/4 inch cubes | 2 teaspoons dried parsley leaves | 1 can club soda, heated
instructions: Spray a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray and add beef. Cook over medium high heat until evenly browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Add parsley and club soda and boil, uncovered, over medium heat until soup is reduced and beef is hot, about 5 minutes.

title: Polenta & Chile Chickpeas - South African
ingredients: 500 g polenta, prepared according to package instructions | 200 g diced pork shoulder | 100 g canned chickpeas ( drained ) | 100 g bamboo shoots, sliced | 2 sprigs mixed italian herbs | 2 sprigs mixed italian herbs | 2 cardamom pods, bruised | 1 large leek | 2 tablespoons cornflour
instructions: Pound the pork on a cutting board into a thick paste. Slice the chard crossways.

Random Ingredients: horseradish,ginger,saffron thread,yellow bell pepper,cornmeal,italian bread,roast beef,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Cornmeal and Crusted Beef Roast With Saffron
ingredients: 2 lbs roast beef, center cut, trimmed | 1/2 teaspoon saffron thread, crushed | 2 tablespoons grated fresh ginger | 3 tablespoons finely grated unrefined parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 tablespoon horseradish | 2 cups medium cornmeal | 1 yellow bell pepper, cut into 4 | 1 cup lightly packed coarsely chopped fresh ginger | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped fresh horseradish | additional parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350ºf. Put the roast in a large skillet with the saffron. Add the ginger, cheese, 1 tbsp oregano and 1 tbsp butter or margarine, tossing meat to coat evenly. Transfer the roast to a rack set over a shallow baking pan and add the cornmeal, bell pepper and 3 tbsp butter. Mix, then scatter meat evenly over the cornmeal mixture and roast in the upper third of the oven for 1 hour, or until the corn is tender and the top dark golden brown. For sauce, whisk the remaining ¼ cup water with 1 tbsp of the oregano. To serve, cut the meat into strips about 2 by 2 inches wide, about 1/2 inch by 2 inches long and transfer the strips to plates or individual serving bowls. Spoon sauce over the meat and sprinkle with the remaining oregano and cheese.

title: Spaghetti Aglio-Peri (Sauce Only)
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti | 1 vidalia onion
instructions: Cook meat and cook spaghetti according to package instructions. Remove onion and drain all the liquid, but leave enough of oil to coat pot. Return meat and veggies to pot.

Random Ingredients: tarragon,cheddar cheese,cake,head broccoli,italian seasoning,white bread,oregano leaf,pea
title: Beefy Toasted Slices
ingredients: 7 slices white bread | 8 slices cheddar cheese | 1 tablespoon tarragon, dried | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1 medium head broccoli, trimmed and cut into 1-inch sections | 1/4 cup canned peas
instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Using a small knife, cut a pocket in each slice of bread on the diagonal until about half an inch deep. Place bread slices in skillet, breaking up with a spoon until bread is well broken or and bread can be broken into pieces a little larger. Place bread in skillet. Place 1 slice of cheddar cheese on each bread slice, followed by 1 tablespoon of tarragon and italian seasoning. Top each slice of bread with 1/4 of the broccoli and 1/4 of the peas. Place 1 more slice of bread on top of the vegetables. Using a fork, press down on the broccoli with the back of a spoon so it begins to wilt. Repeat with remaining ingredients, making sure to press down on the mixture on all sides. Cook sandwiches 3 minutes on each side or until browned. Serve hot or warm.

Random Ingredients: dill,half,vanilla essence,poblano pepper,maraschino cherry,marsala wine,beef brisket
title: Sweet Beef Brisket
ingredients: 2 -4 lbs beef brisket | 4 tablespoons marsala wine, fruity flavored | half-and-half or cream | 2 -4 poblano peppers | 4 tablespoons chopped fresh dill | 1 container maraschino cherry, chopped | 1 dash vanilla essence
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Place brisket in foil baking pan. Dice pepper and poblano peppers into 2 inch squares. Pour half and half or cream around brisket and cover tightly with foil. Place on middle of oven rack and bake for 3 to 4 hours, or until beef is tender when pierced with small fork. Meanwhile, put peppers and garlic in blender container. Add dill and 2 tbsp of the marsala. Blend until fairly smooth. Place brisket in casserole, cover with a cloth and return to oven. Boil for 20 minutes, or until meat is extremely tender. Stir well and boil off any excess liquid. Place meat through a colander to get rid of excess fat juices. Serve hot. Makes 5 servings of 3 per person.

title: Mushroom and Vegetable Kebabs
ingredients: 2 lbs mushrooms, thickly sliced ( flats and stalks trimmed ) | 1 cup onion, roughly chopped | 1 cup portabella mushroom, chopped | 1/2 cup dates, chopped | 1/3 cup cashews | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/4 cup dry sherry | 3 tablespoons cheese, grated
instructions: To make vegetable kebab, remove stalk and base from mushrooms stem and cut away the sand sacs from outer mushrooms caps and discard. Combine all ingredients in a bowl and refrigerate for 1 hour to marinate. Thread mushroom caps, onion and mushrooms around skewers, using skewers if necessary, and cook over medium coals or medium hot coals for 4 minutes, turning and turning from time to time until kebabs are just cooked through. Serve with rice.

title: Welsh Pear and Potato Salad
ingredients: 12 new potatoes, scrubbed and diced | 1 cup cottage cheese | 1 small pear, peeled, cored and diced | 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained on paper towel
instructions: Place the potatoes in a large pot of water with just enough water to cover them. Bring the water to a boil, reduce heat, cover and simmer until tender, about 20 minutes. Drain the potatoes and set aside to steam dry for about 10 minutes, then mash with a fork or potato masher. Stir together the cottage cheese with the diced pears, sun dried tomatoes and the seasoned potatoes in a large bowl. Garnish with the diced pears, if using. Serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: cajun seasoning,vodka,cherry tomato,avocado,baking potato,salt black pepper
title: Cherry Tomato Avocado Potatoes
ingredients: 2 large baking potatoes, peeled and cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 avocado - peeled, pitted and sliced | 12 cherry tomatoes, halved | 1 1/2 tablespoons cajun seasoning | 1 tablespoon vodka | 2 teaspoons salt | 1 pinch salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat the oven's broiler and set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source. Place potato cubes in a large baking dish, and lightly brush with oil. Broil potatoes, turning once, until nicely browned and tender, about 15 minutes. Remove potatoes from oven, and cut into cubes. Place potato cubes into a bowl, and mash with the avocado. Season with cajun seasoning, vodka, salt, and pepper. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: cider vinegar,chicken thigh,rice flour,beef bouillon granule,biscuit
title: Beef Rolls
ingredients: 600 g boneless chicken thighs | 4 tablespoons rice flour | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon granules or 2 tablespoons beef bouillon cubes | 1 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 1 bag biscuit, biscuits, biscuits from a jar
instructions: Place chicken thighs in a pan with enough water to cover. Bring to the boil over a high heat, then reduce heat to simmer and simmer for about 1 hour, or until just cooked. Transfer the chicken to a plate. Drain liquid from pan, reserving 1 cup of this is, then return to pan. Add the rice flour, chicken bouillon and vinegar. Bring to the boil then reduce heat to medium. Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, or until liquid has thickened slightly. Meanwhile, preheat oven to 180°c. Using two greased oven trays, spoon a little of the chicken liquid onto each biscuit, then arrange on the baking sheets. Bake in the oven for 15 to 20 minutes, or until golden.

title: Potted Sour Peppers
ingredients: 12 thin skins on fresh pepper sauce | white onion, sliced thin | 2 teaspoons mixed peppercorns | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 2 tablespoons single cream
instructions: Heat a small non stick frying pan. When hot and slightly hot, add pepper sauce.

Random Ingredients: chicken tender,grenadine,vegetable bouillon cube,grand marnier,red capsicum,pace picante sauce
title: The Easiest and Best Low Fat Chicken Ever!
ingredients: 3/4 kg chicken tenders | 1 tablespoon grenadine | 1 tablespoon vegetable bouillon cube | 1 tablespoon grand marnier | 1 tablespoon light red pepper ( cayenne pepper ) | 2 tablespoons pace picante sauce ( or hot sauce if you choose )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a non stick frying pan. Heat gently on low. Serve immediately. Note, if using the nachos for this recipe, you can simply place them under the broiler if you want.

title: Mama Leone's Indonesian Rum Peanuts
ingredients: 200 g black unsalted peanuts | 100 ml rum
instructions: Pre heat the oven to 240°c. Wash and dry the peanuts. Place them in a glass oven dish. Add all of the remaining ingredients and mix well. Cover tightly with foil, and bake.

Random Ingredients: orange juice,heavy cream,plain nonfat yogurt,peach,mandarin orange,mung bean sprout,tarragon vinegar
title: Summer Salad
ingredients: 1 can mandarin oranges, drained | 1 cup mixed mung bean sprouts | 1 small ripe peach, chopped into small pieces | 4 tablespoons orange juice | 1/4 cup heavy cream | 2 tablespoons tarragon vinegar | 1/2 cup plain nonfat yogurt
instructions: In a salad bowl, gently mix the mandarin oranges, bean sprouts, and peach together. In a blender or food processor, mix the orange juice, heavy cream, tarragon vinegar, and yogurt until smooth and creamy. Pour sauce over fruit mixture.

title: Chipotle Sauce
ingredients: 4 cups chili-garlic oil or 4 cups canola oil | 1 jar chipotle hot sauce | 1 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Heat oil in a deep skillet, over medium heat. When oil is hot, crack the chips into the hot oil, and stir a few times. Stir. When chips have crisped up, stir in hot sauce, and cover and cook for about 20 - 30 minutes until dark golden brown, stirring occasionally.

title: Chick Peas Bourguignonne
ingredients: 400 g canned chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 3 slices bacon, cut into 1/2 inch lengths | 1 teaspoon orange peel | 1 teaspoon sugar | 80 ml red wine | 50 ml oil
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a non stick skillet or deep saucepan. Heat to boil, stirring constantly. Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, for 20 minutes. Stir through bacon and serve immediately, or refrigerate for upto half an hour or so.

title: Grilled Lobster & Chorizo Mini-Tails With Smoked Salmon
ingredients: 24 ladyfingers | 16 ounces lobsters, cooked | 8 -12 ounces smoked salmon, sliced | 1/4 cup espresso or 1/4 cup coffee | cooked spanish chorizo sausage ( recommended ) | pam cooking spray or oil
instructions: Spread a little canola oil on your counter to prepare for your lunch or at room temperature. Slice lobster into chunks and spread one side of each ladyfinger with 1 tbsp of coffee and place 1 piece of the cooked lobster on each piece of cheese spread onto each ladyfinger. Spray a grill or nonstick pan lightly with pam or cooking spray, place the lobster flat side down on the grill. Grill the lobsters 1 - 2 minutes with the lobster side up until the lobster is cooked to your liking. Remove from grill, slice and serve right away with the smoked salmon. Note, my friend adds a couple tbsp of mushrooms, sliced sausages and spanish chorizo on top. Sometimes this goes great with a side of garlic butter with it.

title: Baby-Roasted Vegetables With Escarole
ingredients: 200 g baby carrots | 300 g fresh snow pea pods | 300 g fresh escarole | 5 ml split chives | 2 ml sumac | 2 tablespoons vegetable stock
instructions: Preheat oven and 220ml boiling water to 200 degrees. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or greaseproof paper. Slice the carrots into 1cm thick rounds. Arrange the baby carrot sticks on the baking sheet and cover them with the snow pea pods. Drizzle with half the chives. Using the back of a knife, make a small slit in the middle of each carrot and insert a carrot slice. Sprinkle with a tablespoon of sumac and the remaining half of thyme. Pour over the vegetable stock. Bake for about 35 minutes.

Random Ingredients: star anise,lime juice,golden brown sugar,pine nut,peanut
title: Pine Nut and star Anise Pudding
ingredients: 5 cups sweet mixed chopped nuts ( like pecans, walnuts ) | 1/3 cup golden brown sugar | 1 tablespoon lime juice | 2 star anise | 1 3/4 cups coarsely chopped dry roasted peanuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees fahrenheit. Line the loaf pan with foil, then line with the foil. Combine the nuts, sugar, lime juice, and star anise. Add nuts and stir in the nuts. Pour into the loaf pan. Bake for approximately 40 - 45 minutes until top is nicely browned and firm.

title: Grilled Endive With Irish Whiskey Syrup
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried currants | 1 tablespoon dried chipotle chile | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 1 tablespoon irish whiskey | 1 belgian endive, leaves ( about 3/4 cup )
instructions: Combine currants and chili in medium bowl. Add ketchup and whiskey, tossing to coat with ketchup. Cut a slit in center of endive leaves and remove tender leaves. Brush sauce over salad leaves. Serve.

title: Nacho Beans - O'Brien
ingredients: 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 1 can refried beans | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
instructions: Heat oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Mix corn, refried beans, and vegetable oil into hot oil. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, and simmer 15 minutes, or until heated through.

Random Ingredients: tilapia fillet,white sugar,raspberry,cocoa powder,wild mushroom,lime juice,lobster tail
title: Lobster and Wild Mushroom Skewers
ingredients: 3 tablespoons lime juice | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 1/4 teaspoon cocoa powder | 1 pound tilapia fillets | 1 cup fresh wild mushrooms, sliced | 1 pound fresh oyster tail, sliced | 1 pound fresh raspberry
instructions: Prepare the grill for cooking. In a shallow bowl, mix together lime juice, sugar, cocoa powder, and enough water to form a stiff mixture. Stir in the tilapia fillets and mushrooms. Cover, and allow to sit for 5 to 10 minutes. Thread the tilapia onto skewers. Place skewers on grill, and cook about 3 to 5 minutes per side, or to desired doneness.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast fillet,cardamom seed,coconut cream,heavy cream,lemon wedge,korean chili paste,lemon juice zest,broccoli
title: Korean Broccoli With Chicken
ingredients: 500 g broccoli ( fresh or frozen, if not frozen ) | 4 chicken breast fillets ( bone-in ) | 2 -3 tablespoons korean chili paste ( gochujang style ) | 1/2 cup coconut cream | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 2 lemons, juice and zest of | 1 lemon wedge | 1 cardamom seed
instructions: Thaw the broccoli. Cut a very thin slice from top to bottom of each piece and leave it attached on the top half of a head. If using fresh broccoli leave on the stalk. Cook the chicken fillets in a skillet with 3 - 4 tbs of gochujang paste over medium heat. Meanwhile, cut the top half off the head of the head and leave it attached. Boil the broccoli for 2 mins or until slightly cooked and softened. Drain and let it cool a few minutes. Cut into 5cm/1 inch cubes and set aside. In a medium size bowl combine half the coconut cream with the cream and set aside. Place the remaining 2tbs of gochujang paste, 1/2 cup of coconut cream with 2 tbs of heavy cream, the lemon zest, cardamom seed and juice of 2 lemons and 2 cloves of lemon peel in a blender with 2 tbs of heavy cream and leave the blender running. Combine the vegetables well and pour into the pot or pan with the coconut cream and chicken, add the rest of the coconut cream and simmer for 20 - 25 mins or until most of the vegetables are very tender.

title: Aceitun (Pea Carrots and Peas)
ingredients: 1 kg peeled peas and carrots | 2 teaspoons allspice
instructions: Boil the peas and carrots in 2 cups of water uncovered for 30 minutes. Drain and transfer to large deep bowl. Refill with 6 cups cold water. Blend until smooth. Refreeze overnight. Transfer peas and carrots. Refrigerate for a few hours or overnight.

title: Anchovy Chips
ingredients: 6 anchovy fillets | 1/2 cup semisweet chocolate chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place the anchovies on a paper towel and spread the anchovies out into a single layer in an 8x8 square baking dish. Cover with a sprinkling of chocolate chips, shaking to coat. Bake in the preheated oven until the top is browned and the anchovies are crisp and hot, 12 to 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,garlic powder,butternut pumpkin,mozzarella cheese,cherry tomato,cranberry sauce,ketchup,guacamole
title: Australian Baked Pumpkin Salad II
ingredients: 1 cup butternut squash, peeled, seeded and cubed | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 tablespoon ketchup | 1 tablespoon cranberry sauce | 1 pint cherry tomatoes, halved | 1 cup mozzarella cheese, grated | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Place the squash, garam masala, garlic powder and ketchup in a saucepan and fry gently for a few minutes so the skins can start to peel off. Remove from heat and stir through the cranberry sauce and cherries. Spoon into a baking dish, add the mozzarella and bake in the oven at 200 degrees celsius for 15 minutes or until the cheese has melted. Sprinkle with essence and serve.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,red chilies,pizza crust,pork neck,white flour,potato starch,cranberry
title: Pork Posole Pizza
ingredients: 1 pizza crust | 1/4 lb chicken neck bone, shredded or 1/4 lb pork stew meat | 1/4 cup chunky salsa or 1/4 cup salsa verde | 1 tablespoon potato starch | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 teaspoon red chilies, seeded and minced | 1/2 cup dried cranberries, crushed ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f stretch dough onto cookie sheet. Flatten with rolling pin. Cover dough with reynolds wrap heavy duty aluminum foil. Fold in the edges of dough until they touch each other and form a circle.. Place on foil, seam side down. Bake for 12 - 15 minutes or until crust is puffed and golden. Remove from oven and cool on cooling rack.. Combine salsa, potato starch, cornstarch and chilies in a small bowl, stirring until smooth. Place the cooked meat and cranberries in a bowl and stir until well coated. Spoon half the salsa mixture over top of the pizza crust, sprinkle with the bread mixture. Cover with remaining salsa mixture. Bake for 15 minutes or until heated through. Allow to sit 5 - 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: tamari,chicken liver,rice,grill seasoning,chili seasoning mix,chili paste,jalapeno
title: Grilled Barbequed Chicken Liver
ingredients: 1/4 cup chili seasoning mix | 3 tablespoons tamari | 2 tablespoons grill seasoning | 1 tablespoon chili paste | 1 lb chicken liver, cleaned of the membrane but without the tail | 1/4 cup jalapeno, minced | 1 cup rice
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and set aside. Cook the liver on the barbecue grill or under medium high heat on a medium charcoal grill, turning to grill both sides and coating with the remaining sauce. Allow to cook for 3 minutes per side. Serve over rice with honey and a little lettuce, if desired.

title: Mexican Fried Onions
ingredients: 4 french-style bread | 3/4 lb fresh spinach leaves, washed and chopped | 3/4 lb fresh shiitake mushroom, cleaned and sliced | 1 garlic | 1/2 teaspoon oregano | 1/4 teaspoon whole cloves garlic | 1/4 cup frozen corn or 1/4 cup canned corn | 1 cup shredded mexican blend cheese or 1 cup grated monterey jack cheese
instructions: Heat 1/4 inch salted butter or non stick frying pan over medium heat. Arrange the bread slices in hot skillet and cook about 5 minutes on each side and remove from frying pan after one or two minutes. Place the spinach in a strainer and place under cold running water to wilt for 5 seconds then drain and squeeze out excess water. Mince 1 whole clove of garlic and thinly slice the stem | Rinse the mushrooms with hot water and drain, thinly slice and set aside. Finely mince 1/4 the garlic clove and combine with the dried herbs and remaining ingredients in a bowl. Divide the mixture into 8 equal parts, molding each piece into a ball and placing it on a parchment covered baking sheet. Repeat the molding procedure with the remaining mixture. Arrange the balls of onion in overlapping circles on the baking sheet, placing approximately 3/4 inch depth between of each mound. Cover with plastic wrap and press the bag with your hand to flatten the bread slices slightly. Let them dry on the counter, between 15 and 30 minutes. Remove wrap and bake until the bread is light golden brown and the tops are lightly browned, 25 to 30 minutes. Serve hot with sour cream, guacamole, salsa, salsa verde, salsa verde, sour cream, etc.

Random Ingredients: black pepper,plain nonfat yogurt,cremini mushroom,polish sausage,russet potato,tuna,jalapeno pepper,almond milk
title: Sausage & Potato Casserole
ingredients: 1 package smoked polish sausage | 2 lbs russet potatoes, scrubbed and thinly sliced | 1 lb cremini mushroom, cleaned and chopped | 3 1/2 cups plain nonfat yogurt ( optional ) | 2 cans tuna, drained and flaked | 2 jars sliced jalapeno peppers, drained | 1/2 cup sliced almonds ( optional ) or 1/2 cup slivered almonds ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon black pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Cook sausage over medium heat in a large skillet for 4 until browned. Remove and set aside. Cook potatoes according to package directions. When done, drain and place in a large bowl, mash with potato masher to create a mush. Combine sausage, potatoes, mushrooms, yogurt and drained tuna.

title: Sour Cream Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 1 bunch brussels sprout, cleaned | 1 jar sour cream, at room temperature | 1/8 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Cut brussels sprouts diagonally into 1 inch pieces, and place in a pot of lightly salted boiling water. Boil 3 to 4 minutes, or until just tender, drain well. In a large bowl, whisk together sour cream, cream of tartar and sour cream mixture and pour over brussels sprouts. Sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley before serving. Makes a wonderful brussels sprout dip.

Random Ingredients: hoagie,white wine vinegar,egg noodle,beef chuck roast
title: Quick Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 egg noodles, uncooked | 3 lbs boneless beef chuck roast | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 4 hoagie rolls
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions and drain. Meanwhile, trim fat from roast. Cut into thin 16 slices. Combine with vinegar and toss with noodles. Slice roast diagonally at 1/4 inch intervals. Arrange on rolls. Serve with salad dressing.

Random Ingredients: panko breadcrumb,coriander seed,romaine lettuce,tea,chorizo sausage,pizza crust
title: Mexican Chorizo and Pork Empanadas from Reynolds Wrap®
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry panko breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon coriander seeds | 1 lb prepared pizza crust, warmed | 2 ounces chorizo sausage ( casing removed ) | 2 teaspoons finely chopped leaves romaine lettuce | 1/2 cup teas
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Lightly coat large baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray. Mix panko and coriander seeds in medium bowl. Press bread crumbs in small dish or pie plate. Dip each pizza slice into bread crumbs. Fry until lightly browned, turning once. Transfer to oven. Bake until bread crumbs are lightly browned, about 7 minutes. Drain off excess oil. Set aside. While bread crumbs are baking, combine chorizo and remaining tablespoon of coriander with the lettuce and spread evenly over each pizza slice. Top with chorizo mixture. Place pizzas on prepared baking sheet. Wrap each pizza pizza in foil. Bake until filling is hot and cheese is melted, about 25 minutes. Cut each pizza in half across the middle and serve. Makes 4 servings.

title: Crispy Jaggery Rice
ingredients: 1 cup jasmine rice ( jaggery ) | 2 teaspoons trout ( jaggery ) | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom powder
instructions: Pour 2 cups of water in a microwave safe container. Microwave the jasmine rice for 1 minute, then stir to ensure the rice is coated in water. Cover the lid and microwave on high for 12 minutes, making sure rice is cooked. Remove lid and stir. Microwave trout for 1 - 2 minutes, then fluff with a fork. Remove cardom powder, then stir in the remaining 1 cup of jasmine rice to serve.

title: Corn niblets with Salmon
ingredients: 1 bag frozen mixed corn, thawed (, thawed corn kernels, peas, or peas ) | 1 cup canned salmon ( or fish ) | 3 egg yolks | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Heat oven to 325°f. Mix all ingredients together except salmon and corn. Place in ungreased jelly roll pan. Bake 35 minutes until heated through. Top with sauce if desired.

title: Cheshire Crawfish
ingredients: 1 lb fresh crawfish | 1 poblano chile chile
instructions: Trim the crawfish. Slit the chile lengthwise in half. Insert the crawfish halves crosswise along the length of the chile. Wrap the chile with plastic wrap. Marinate for 1 hour. Cook on the grill or until the crawfish are easily peeled. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,raspberry,coriander,heavy cream,lime zest,coriander powder,chuck
title: Red Curry of Beef (Beef with Raspberry)
ingredients: 600 g chuck, cut into bite size chunks ( i used a skirt steak, steak or eye round ) | 1 -2 tablespoon red curry paste, depending on heat desired | 1 tablespoon ground coriander | 1 tablespoon roasted ground coriander powder ( i prefer shangham brand ) | 1 tablespoon grated lime zest | 300 ml heavy cream | fresh coriander | fresh raspberries
instructions: Place beef in a large shallow bowl. Drizzle over curry paste. Stir in coriander, roasted ground coriander, lime zest and chilli powder. Mix well. Leave for 15 minutes to marinade. Whip cream to stiff peaks and fold in stiffly, gently. Pour the cream evenly over the beef and leave in fridge for 30 - 60 minutes to marinade. Cook meat in a large frying pan, until cooked to your liking, turning until cooked as desired. Add fresh cream to meat and toss over a heat until sauce is thick. Serve with fresh coriander, fresh raspberries and sliced fresh fruits, along with plenty of crusty bread to soak up the juices.

Random Ingredients: orange zest,chipotle pepper,thyme sprig,vegetable bouillon granule
title: Garlic Confit
ingredients: 2 orange zestes ( yellow or light ) | 2 tablespoons dried thyme sprig ( or fresh thyme ) | 1 1/2 - 2 tablespoons fresh minced chipotle pepper | 1 cube vegetable bouillon granules | 1 teaspoon vegetable bouillon granules
instructions: Drain orange zest. Cut zest into 1/2 inch segments. Heat a small skillet over medium low heat. Add orange zest segments, thyme, and chipotle. Cook 3 to 5 minutes over medium heat until fragrant, stirring occasionally. Add bouillon and bouillon. Cover and cook over medium heat for about 2 minutes. Remove from heat and pour into glass jar. Cool to room temperature.. Serve 1 to 2 cups on the side. Store in the refrigerator for up to 2 months.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,parmigiano reggiano cheese,catfish,vanilla ice cream,pomegranate molasses
title: Catfish With Pomegranate Molasses
ingredients: 16 ounces very thick catfish, fillets ( preferably free-range ) | 6 ounces pomegranate molasses | 8 -10 ounces vanilla ice cream ( thin, half a pint ) | 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes ( to taste, i use more ) | parmigiano-reggiano cheese ( to garnish )
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f. Rinse fish and pat dry with paper towels. Arrange in a single layer on foil lined baking sheet. In small bowl, mix molasses with the salt, pepper and pepper flakes. Spread a rounded 1/2 cup spoonful of molasses mixture onto each piece of fish and, using fingers, pick up a piece of codtail and put each piece on a piece of fish. Sprinkle with a pinch of pomegranate molasses mixture and bake until just cooked through, about 20 minutes. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: ketchup,tomato paste,walnut half,chicken breast half,beef brisket,orange
title: Jewish Brisket
ingredients: 4 pounds lean, bone-in chicken breast halves | 1 can tomato paste | 1 cup ketchup | 1/2 large orange, juiced zested | 1/2 cup toasted and chopped walnut halves | 1 whole beef brisket
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Line a roasting pan with aluminum foil and spray with cooking spray. Place the chicken breasts in the roasting pan and set aside. Combine the tomato paste, ketchup, orange juice, orange zest, and 1 tablespoon of the butter or margarine in a saucepan.

Random Ingredients: sauce,sun tomato oil,green pea,cheddar cheese,ganache,rice wine,nut
title: Beef & Sun Dried Tomato Stir-Fry (Aussie Inspired Meal)
ingredients: 250 g ground sirloin | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and finely chopped | 1/3 cup green pea | 1/2 cup cheddar cheese, shredded ( optional ) | 4 teaspoons hot sauce | 2/3 cup hot cooked rice ( i use basmati ) | 2 tablespoons oreganache ( or more according to taste ) | sun-dried tomato oil, to taste ( optional ) | chopped fresh nut, if desired
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the beef, tomatoes, pea, cheese and hot sauce until thoroughly mixed. Heat a non stick frying pan over a medium heat and add sun dried tomatoes. Stir fry quickly for a few seconds and remove from heat. Place the rice on an oven tray. Place ground beef, then top with the cooked rice. Pour the oil over the top of the rice and beef and top with oreganache or sun dried tomatoes. Allow to sit for 30 seconds, taste and add more pepper if desired. Serve hot with fresh herbs and chives if desired. Enjoy.

title: Wild Mushrooms on the Run
ingredients: 24 cremini mushrooms, cleaned, trimmed, and sliced | 4 tablespoons sherry wine
instructions: Place the mushrooms and sherry into a small mixing bowl. Wisk until the mushrooms are very well coated with white wine. Spoon the mixture onto a plate, sprinkle with more wine, and serve.

title: Sizzling French Bread
ingredients: 2 cups dried french bread | 1 cup apple cider or 1 cup apple juice | 1/4 inch chili paste ( optional. i prefer it with hot water ) | cooking oil, for frying
instructions: Soak french bread in cold water for 30 minutes until water becomes clearer. Drain in a colander/welling sink. When completely dry, cut bread in to half inch slices with scissors. Place slices in a single layer on a plate. Add 1/4 cup water to the pan. Cover with aluminum foil. Bring to a boil, then reduce to simmer and cook for 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes to keep moist. Turn french toast, remove foil. Place sautéed french bread in a serving dish and pour remaining 1/4 cup cold water over slices. Cover and let sit for 10 minutes. Heat cooking oil in a deep fryer. When oil is ready, place a french bread slice into the oil, and fry in small batches to light brown. The key to the taste of the sizzling french bread is that it is browned slowly. Some cooks take a few days to brown sufficiently before adding the rest of the ingredients.

title: Crispy Cucumber Soup
ingredients: 1 large cucumber, peeled, seeded and diced | 1 chicken stock cube | 3 cups hot cooked rice
instructions: Grate the cucumber finely at the coarseest part. In a medium bowl place the grated cucumber and the stock cube and mix. Add the rice and mix well. Heat a large saucepan over a moderate heat. Add the hot soup and stir to combine. Add the cucumber mixture and stir well. Alternatively you can leave the saucepan in a small pan of simmering water and serve over hot rice.

Random Ingredients: kraft monterey jack cheese,mango,iceberg lettuce,macaroni,margarine,rice vinegar,olive oil,feta cheese
title: Macaroni Salad With Feta Cheese Dressing #RSC
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups fresh tomatoes and mangoes, diced | 1/2 cup feta cheese, crumbled | 1/2 cup kraft shredded monterey jack cheese, cut into thin strips | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 1/4 cup margarine or 1/4 cup butter, melted | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 head iceberg lettuce, sliced | 1 bag macaroni, prepared
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Mix together the tomatoes, feta cheese, kraft monterey jack cheese and rice vinegar. Combine the cheese dressing with the margarine or butter. Mix the salad ingredients together with the dressing and mix well. Add the lettuce. Put the macaroni in a greased 9x13 backing dish and bake until crispy. Drain and serve the salad on top of the macaroni.

title: Tropical Irish Lettuce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons lime juice, freshly squeezed | 2 tablespoons irish whiskey | 1 tablespoon cayenne | 4 lettuce leaves ( large ) | 1/4 cup low-fat buttermilk
instructions: Combine lime juice, whiskey and cayenne in a small bowl and then whisk until blended. Add lettuce leaves and toss lightly. Top each lettuce leaf with about 1 tbls. Guacamole. Makes 4 servings.

title: Raisin-Infused Lard
ingredients: 250 g lard | 1/4 cup golden raisin | 1 teaspoon ground orange peel
instructions: Line a baking tray with foil and pre heat oven to 180 degrees c. Place the lard in a small saucepan over low heat add raisins and golden raisins to the lard. Stir occasionally until the lard has melted and the raisins are heated through, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in the orange peel. Place the tray in the oven and leave it in for 20 minutes until it browns. The lard will bubble and clump, so aim for a few minutes until the lard is just starting to brown. Transfer the toasted raisins to a bowl and toss with a wooden spoon until the bowl is completely coated with raisin flavoring.

title: Jambalaya
ingredients: 8 ounces precooked meatballs ( or 1/2 of an 8oz. can ) | 3 fresh cilantro leaves | 1/2 large onion powder ( can use onion-flavored dehydrated dehydrated onions ) | 1 1/2 - 2 quarts escarole, washed, cleaned and dried
instructions: Drain meatballs of all excess grease, and mix with cilantro, onion powder and meatballs. Refrigerate in tightly covered container overnight. After preparation, stir to mix and allow to marinate at least 1 hour in refrigerator. Bag in a dehydrator according to manufacture's instructions, or with tongs or other object. Allow to dry and dehydrate on paper towel. Refrigerate again at least an hour or two before eating to allow flavors to blend.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage,red cabbage,red pepper,vanilla essence,fish sauce
title: Sweet and Sour Red Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 4 red cabbage, shredded | 1 red pepper, sliced | 1 -2 link italian sausage | 1/4 cup fish sauce | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence or 1/2 teaspoon almond essence
instructions: Sausage should be browned and cooked thoroughly. Cabbage should be slightly crunchy, so that as it crisps up while drying. Remove sausage from casings and slice into half rounds. Core cabbage. Slice pepper into long wide strips. Add sausage to large bowl of cabbage. Prepare sweet and sour red cabbage. Mix fish sauce, vanilla essence and almond essence. Pour over salad and serve.

title: Custard Roly Poly (Mamaw's Sweet-Custard)
ingredients: 1 eggplant | 1 cup whole milk ricotta cheese, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Halve the eggplant lengthwise, and peel off the bitter white inside. Place the eggplant halves cut side down on a foil lined sheet pan. Drizzle with olive oil, and roast in the preheated oven until the skin has blackened. The pulp should be charred, but not burnt. Allow to cool. Wearing gloves, scrape the roasted skin from the eggplant. Discard the burnt skin, and place the eggplant in a food processor or blender with a little of the melted oil and ricotta cheese. Blend until smooth. Place the roulade in a double boiler over a medium low heat. Cover, and cook just until hot. Cool.

title: Easy Baked Kielbasa
ingredients: 1 can beets | 8 -10 lbs kielbasa | 5 beef bouillon cubes | 2 packages dry yeast
instructions: First soak kielbasa in water overnight. Drain and rinse with cold water. Place into large mixing bowl, add all other ingridients and knead well. Grease roasting pan and add dough, cover and put into the oven for 20 minutes. Let cool and serve with sauerkraut or mashed potato.

Random Ingredients: white wine,lemon peel,onion flake,whipping cream,chicken,button mushroom,rigatoni pasta,chicken wing
title: Tuscan Chicken Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 1 3/4 lbs chicken wings | 1 ounce dried onion flakes | 1 cup dry white wine | 1 lb rigatoni pasta | 4 cups chopped cooked chicken | 1 ounce dried button mushroom, stems removed | 1 cup small butter-flavored whipping cream | lemon peel, 1 1/2-inch cube ( optional )
instructions: Break wings into 2 - 3 sections and place them in a stockpot and add enough water to cover. Bring to a boil and boil for 2 minutes. Drain and reserve. Add onions to broth and simmer for 2 minutes. Drain and place in a bowl. Pour wine over noodles and add chicken. Let noodles soak for 2 hours. Drain noodles, rinse and place in a shallow casserole dish. Add chicken. Pour reserved broth over noodles. Cover and bake at 350 degrees for about 10 minutes. Meanwhile in saucepan bring cream to a boil. Remove from heat. Add lemon peel. Pour over noodles and sprinkle with paprika. Bake uncovered for another 5 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Tzatziki-Style Yogurt Salad
ingredients: 1 container plain yogurt | pita chips ( see footnote for recipe link ) | 1 bunch fresh dill, finely chopped ( not dried ) | 1/2 cup rice | 3/4 cup tahini | 1/2 cup ranch dressing
instructions: In a food processor, grind yogurt until completely smooth and creamy. Add dill, rice and tahini. Blend until well mixed. Stir in ranch until well blended. Refrigerate for no longer than 30 minutes. Adjust the seasoningings to taste.

Random Ingredients: chili paste,cauliflower floret,chili pepper flake,ginger root,red capsicum,mozzarella cheese
title: Chinese Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 small cauliflower floret | 1 tablespoon grated ginger root | 1 red capsicum | 1 teaspoon chili paste | 1 teaspoon minced chili pepper flakes | 1/4 cup shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Fill a pot with water, and place the cauliflower florets in. Bring water to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer 10 minutes. Drain. Set aside. Bring a pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook the ginger, peppers, and chili in the water for five minutes. Drain, remove seeds, and slice capsicum into small strips. Blend the ginger, peppers, and chili paste in a blender or food processor to a smooth paste. Set aside. Remove the cauliflower florets from the heat, and stir in the cheese. To serve, place a few florets on each of two plates, sprinkle with the spice paste, and serve.

title: Slow Cooker Sweet Pork Tenderloins
ingredients: 12 pork tenderloins | 1 can sweetened limeade concentrate, or more to taste
instructions: Combine pork tenderloins, sweetened limeade concentrate, and resealable plastic food wrap in a large bowl.

title: Roasted Red Pepper With Currants
ingredients: 1 large red roasted pepper (, can use 1 medium roasted pepper and 1 medium jar roasted red wine or a combination ) | 1/2 - 1 cup dried currant
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. In a mixing bowl stir to combine all the ingredients. Place the red pepper on a rack in a shallow roasting pan and add just enough water to cover.

Random Ingredients: herb,red thai chili pepper,peanut oil,fennel seed,ancho chile powder,romano cheese
title: Chickpea Snack Mix for Two
ingredients: 1/3 cup grated romano cheese ( or parmigiano reggiano for a lower fat ) | 1 tablespoon peanut oil ( or canola oil ) | 1/2 teaspoon ancho chile powder | 1 tablespoon roasted fennel seed | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon red thai chili pepper ( or hot pepper flakes of choice ) | 2 -3 tablespoons mixed fresh herbs, chopped ( such as oregano or basil )
instructions: Finely grind grated cheese in food processor or blender. If using a mortar and pestle, grind finely until the mixture is a small, coarse powder that resembles coarse paste. Stir together all the ingredients in a small bowl, stirring thoroughly. Let stand in refrigerator 1 - 2 hours or freeze.

Random Ingredients: green grape,feta cheese,vodka,curry powder,red curry paste
title: Spicy Dill Vodka V8 #RSC
ingredients: 1 fluid ounce vodka, aromatic | 1/2 fluid ounce green grapes, drained | 1/2 fluid ounce red curry paste | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder, ground | 1/2 cup feta cheese, crumbled
instructions: Blend all ingredients until sugar is dissolved. Pour into a shot glass or small bowl, garnish with grapes and/or sour cream and serve.

Random Ingredients: grainy mustard,chicken stock,hot green chili pepper,sugar
title: Mustard Pickle
ingredients: 2 cups chicken stock | 1 tablespoon granulated sugar | 1 tablespoon coarse grainy mustard | 2 -4 green hot chili peppers ( to taste )
instructions: Boil the chicken stock in a saucepan. When the stock boils, stir in the sugar and mustard and return the stock to the pan to thicken. When the mixture thickens, remove from the heat and stir in the chilies. Serve the pickle immediately or store at room temperature for up to 2 weeks.

title: Beef Carnitas
ingredients: 1 boneless beef chuck roast, trimmed | 1 egg yolk | 1/2 cup grated pecorino cheese
instructions: Brown the roast on all sides in olive oil with hot charcoal, or in the oven or on the grill. Transfer the roast to a roasting pan. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. In a small bowl, beat the egg with the pecorino cheese. Spread egg mixture evenly on the roast and place in the oven on the rack. Bake until an instant reading thermometer inserted in the center of the meat reads at least 155 degrees f.

Random Ingredients: cheddar cheese,rabbit,salmon fillet,whipping cream,new york,mustard powder,spinach
title: New York Rabbit Steak
ingredients: 1 new york strip steaks | 1 tablespoon mustard powder | 5 thin slices lean salami ( salami can be substituted ) | 1 bunch fresh spinach | 6 slices smoked cheddar cheese | 1 1/2 cups whipping cream | 1 bunch fresh spinach ( to garnish )
instructions: Sprinkle mustard powder all over steak. Cover meat with salami slices. Place a large skillet over high heat. Place a steaks into skillet. Cook 10 seconds on each side or until well browned. Remove to a serving plate. Top with 3 spinach leaves and 6 slices cheese. Repeat with remaining steak, spinach, cheese and salami slices and serve on a bun if serving as a sandwich.

Random Ingredients: masa harina,rice wine vinegar,rice milk,flour,peanut oil,rice
title: Soy Sauce-Glazed Fried Rice
ingredients: 2 cups leftover cooked rice | 1 cup dry roasted peanuts ( i had a couple of tinned ones ) | 2 tablespoons flour, unbleached | 1 cup rice milk | 1/4 cup rice wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons rice milk | 2 tablespoons peanut oil
instructions: In a small saucepan, cook the rice and peanuts in hot water until they are crisp, 10 to 15 minutes. Drain on paper towels. Stir the flour into the rice milk until a smooth paste forms. Stir in rice wine vinegar and set aside. Heat peanut oil in a large frying pan over medium heat. Add the rice paste mixture and cook, stirring, until the rice is browned. Remove from heat. In a medium serving bowl, combine the fried rice, peanuts and rice milk. Mix well. Cover the bowl and let it sit at room temperature for at least 2 hours or overnight. The longer this sits, the more the flavors meld and rice will meld and the sauce will be pretty thick. Serve with sambal oelek.

title: Aromatic Rice Cookies
ingredients: 4 cups arborio rice, rinsed | 2 cups confectioners'sugar | 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 3 cloves garlic, peeled
instructions: Place the rice in a bowl large enough to accommodate a spoon, and pour in enough water to cover it by 2 inches. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and set aside for at least one hour or up to 6 hours, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking. Place the confectioners' sugar, nutmeg, and ground cloves in a medium bowl. Gradually add the rice, a few tablespoons at a time, stirring well after each addition until all the grains are coated with the sugar and have a glistening consistency. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line 2 cookie sheets with parchment paper. Drop 1 teaspoon of the rice mixture onto the prepared cookie sheets, and press into the desired shape. Bake in the preheated oven until the tops are lightly browned and the rice is golden brown, about 15 minutes. Remove from the oven, and immediately transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

Random Ingredients: cream,chocolate,red bell pepper,salt black pepper,heavy cream,red cabbage,coriander powder,chile pepper
title: Mexican Christmas-Sour Cream and Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 500 g red cabbage, shredded | 2 green chile peppers, chopped | 1 red bell pepper, chopped | 300 ml heavy cream | 2 -3 tablespoons sour cream | 1 teaspoon salt and black pepper | 1 teaspoon cajun seasoning | 2 -3 tablespoons finely sliced fresh coriander leaves or 2 -3 tablespoons finely sliced fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Place all of the salad ingredients in a large salad bowl and mix well with a spoon. Pour thick cream over salad and mix gently. Add a few drops of dark chili powder and freshly ground black pepper and mix gently together. Serve salad chilled, but do not over chill. Sprinkle with fresh coriander leaves, if using.

title: Moroccan Cabbage
ingredients: 1 red cabbage | 1/3 cup dry marsala | thin strips of orange peel | thin strips of orange peel | 2 cups thinly sliced tomatoes | 1/2 cup sliced fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Slice cabbage crosswise into 8 pieces. Place in large bowl. Toss with marsala and orange peel. Marinate cabbage for 30 minutes. Combine remaining ingredients.

Random Ingredients: grain rice,red potato,anaheim chili,beef bouillon cube,sunflower oil,sharp cheddar cheese,self rising flour,lamb
title: Chile Cheese and Lamb Stew
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sunflower oil | 1 lb lean beef stewing lamb, cubed | 2 tablespoons whole grain rice | 1 beef bouillon cube, crushed ( or 1/2 tsp beef base mixed with 3/4 tsp water ) | 2 red potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks ( about 500g ) | 3 anaheim chili, chopped ( i find a hot green chili in the jar, or substitute with 1/2 tsp mild chili powder ) | 8 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, cut into chunks | 1 cup self-rising flour
instructions: Heat the oil in a large heavy based saucepan over medium high heat and add the lamb. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 3 minutes until browned all over. Add the rice, beef and bouillon and bring to the boil. Cover, reduce the heat to low and simmer for 1 hour. Add the potatoes and a large pinch of salt and cook, covered, for another 15 minutes. Stir in the chilis and cook for a further 10 - 15 minutes. Serve warm sprinkled with cheddar.

Random Ingredients: watercress,lamb shoulder,monterey jack cheese,water,yellow pepper,shrimp paste
title: Lamb Shrimp
ingredients: 1/2 cup yellow fresh pepper, diced | 1/2 cup watercress, chopped | 3 lbs boneless lamb shoulder, cut into 2-inch strips | 1 teaspoon shrimp paste, can use shrimp juice | 1 1/2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese or 1 1/2 cups low-fat monterey jack pepper cheese, divided ( 4 oz ) | 1 1/2 cups water, divided
instructions: Combine pepper, watercress and meat in medium bowl.

title: Mulled and Spiced Apples
ingredients: 2 apples, peeled, cored and cubed | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 3 tablespoons apple juice
instructions: Place apple cubes in a steamer over boiling water. Cover and cook for 5 minutes. Drain. Meanwhile, place ginger garlic paste in a small bowl, and rub onto apples. Add apple juice and apple juice and continue to stir until combined. Serve.

title: Easy Fat-Free Creamy Greek Beans
ingredients: 1 can great northern beans, rinsed and drained | 2 tablespoons low-fat plain greek yogurt ( plain or vanilla )
instructions: Mix beans and yogurt. Serve.

title: Spinach and Apple Salad
ingredients: 1 pound baby spinach leaves, rinsed and trimmed | 10 cups watercress, washed and dried | 4/5 cup apple cider vinegar | 1 packet grenadine
instructions: Toss the spinach, watercress and apple cider vinegar in a large bowl to blend. Add the grenadine and stir until the mixture is well combined. Taste for sweetness and adjust. Divide the spinach mixture among four salad plates, top with watercress and serve.

Random Ingredients: espresso powder,baking powder,asafoetida powder,chili garlic sauce,mix,seasoning salt,coleslaw mix
title: Nari's Easy Slivered Asafroetida Slaw
ingredients: 32 ounces coleslaw mix | 1 1/4 teaspoons chili-garlic sauce ( such as aebekad or valentina ) | 1 1/4 teaspoons instant espresso powder ( soy sauce, regular milk or water will do ) | 1 1/4 teaspoons baking powder | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1/8 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/8 teaspoon dried anise pods or 1/8 teaspoon dashes extra-virgin olive oil ( optional )
instructions: Mix everything together in a large bowl, and refridgerate the rest. Store leftovers in the refrigerator. Note, this can be made ahead, refrigerated and reheated for use later.

title: Cheesy Queso Dip
ingredients: 1 package velveeta cheese, cubed | 1 jar sunflower oil | 1 jar giardiniera ( italian herb store brand )
instructions: In casserole or baking dish, mix cheese, sunflower oil, and the jar of giardiniera. Drain excess water. Cover cheese mixture and bake at 350°f for 55 minutes.

title: Lamb and Cannellini Bean Soup With Cracked Thyme
ingredients: 1/2 lb lean ground lamb | 1/2 lb scallops | 2 green anaheim chilies, halved lenghtwise | 1 1/2 cups cooked cannellini beans | 1 1/2 cups dried cannellini beans | 1/3 cup barley | 2 scallops | 1 teaspoon thyme sprigs | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 teaspoon dried prunes
instructions: Combine all ingredients, except scallops and thyme, in a large saucepan. Cover and bring to boil over moderately high heat. Reduce heat to low. Simmer, uncovered, stirring occasionally, for about 45 minutes or until lamb is just cooked through. Sprinkle with thyme during the last five minutes of cooking. Stir the prunes through the soup and serve.

Random Ingredients: pepper sauce,grain white rice,red curry paste,black pepper,vegetable oil,tamari
title: Spicy Thai Rice
ingredients: 2 teaspoons vegetable oil | 2 teaspoons red curry paste | 1/4 cup tamari or 1/4 cup soy sauce | 1/3 cup uncooked short-grain white rice | 1 -2 dash hot pepper sauce | 1/8 teaspoon black pepper
instructions: In a small skillet stir 2 teaspoons oil and the curry paste over medium heat until the curry paste is fragrant. Add the tamari and rice and stir until evenly coated. Stir in the hot pepper sauce and 1/8 teaspoon pepper. Cover and continue cooking 15 to 20 minutes or until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed.

Random Ingredients: maple syrup,sauce,chicken leg,parsley sprig,morel,ginger powder,beef broth
title: Maple Gravy for Chicken and Dumplings
ingredients: 1 chicken legs | 4 tablespoons maple syrup | 2 tablespoons a.1. original sauce or 2 tablespoons other sauce | 1 tablespoon poultry bouillon/mixture or 1 tablespoon crushed dried duck bone | 4 teaspoons dried parsley sprigs | 2 teaspoons fresh ginger powder ( or 2 teaspoons ground ginger ) | 1 1/4 cups low sodium beef broth
instructions: Place chicken legs in a large covered saucepan. Add maple syrup, alouette sauce, poultry bouillon/mixture, parsley and ginger powder. In a medium bowl, combine broth and reserved broth. Pour mixture slowly into chicken legs. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cover. Simmer for 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until chicken legs are tender. Remove chicken from pan and stir in mixture of cornstarch and water to thicken the gravy.

title: Sesame Chayote Omelets
ingredients: 2 chayotes ( or sweet potato ) | 1 egg substitute ( egg-free ) | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds | 1 cup oyster, drained
instructions: Cut the chayotes into 1/4 inch thick slices. Soak the slices in boiling water for about 5 minutes. Remove from water, rinse, and cut into 1 - ½ inch slices. Beat the egg substitute well in a shallow bowl using an electric mixer just to blend the egg substitute into each slice of chayote. Sprinkle the sesame seeds over the egg/soup mixture.

Random Ingredients: chickpea,beef,pie shell,green cardamom pod,black pepper,sesame seed
title: Cottage Pie (Pumpkin Empanar)
ingredients: 5 green cardamom pods, cracked | 3 tablespoons sesame seeds | 1 large piece aluminum foil or 1 large olive oil wrapped packet of olive oil | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds, toasted | 1 lb lean ground beef or 1 lb lamb | 4 cans chickpeas, drained ( drained weight as much as desired ) | black pepper ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Combine all ingredients in a food processor/grinder and process until smooth.

title: Pine-Cured Salmon W-Turmeric
ingredients: 2 - 2 1/2 lbs salmon fillets, skinned, bones removed | 3 tablespoons pine nuts | 1 1/2 teaspoons turmeric | 1 teaspoon lemon zest, grated | cooking oatmeal ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. In a small baking dish, toast the pine nuts with the turmeric and lemon zest for about 6 to 8 minutes or until golden brown. Place the salmon fillet on top of the toasted pine nuts, rub the spice mixture over the fish and cover with aluminum foil. Bake for about 45 minutes or until the fish flakes easily when pierced with a fork and the nuts are golden brown. Serve warm, with extra oatmeal if desired.

Random Ingredients: potato,rice vinegar,rump steak,pearl barley,cumin,vegetable oil,beef stew meat,ginger
title: Beef and Potato Salad With Barley
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs rump steak, cut into 2-inch cubes | 4 medium potatoes, scrubbed and sliced | 2 tablespoons oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons minced fresh ginger | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 2/3 cup pearl barley | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
instructions: Coat beef with cooking spray and place in a large sealable plastic bag. Combine remaining ingredients, except meat, and marinate beef in mixture for 30 minutes. Place in a 9 x 13 casserole and cover with foil. Bake in a 475°f oven 15 minutes. Remove foil and cook another 15 minutes or until done. Remove meat from pan. Place on a cutting board. Cut into thin strips. Place in a bowl. Stir in vegetables and pour marinade over. Taste and adjust seasoning and serve.

title: Guinness Garbanzos
ingredients: 2 cups dried garbanzo beans, soaked overnight | 1 1/2 cups guinness stout | 3/4 cup mayonnaise mixed with 1 1/2 tablespoons canola oil | 2 1/2 cups beef broth | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 2 tablespoons coca-cola or 2 tablespoons white vinegar
instructions: Drain garbanzos. Place soaked beans in a large saucepan and cover with water. Bring water to a boil and cook until easily pierced with a fork. Drain.

Random Ingredients: lime juice zest,dijon mustard,jaggery,plain yogurt,bread dough,pork,linguine,olive oil cooking spray
title: Linguine in Zesty Lime Sauce
ingredients: 3 tablespoons lime juice, from 2 lemons, plus lime wedges | 1 1/2 teaspoons dijon mustard | 1/2 lb ground lean pork | 1 1/2 tablespoons jaggery, grated | olive oil flavored cooking spray | 12 ounces thin bread dough ( fresh bread ) | 4 cups pre cooked lobster or 4 cups fresh linguine, cooked | 8 ounces plain yogurt
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Prepare a 7 by 6 inch sheet pan with oiled cooking spray. Line with parchment paper, then spray with cooking spray. Squeeze 1/2 lime juice into a small bowl, then stir in 1/2 teaspoon mustard. In a large bowl, combine pork, the lime juice, and 1/4 teaspoon salt. Form mixture into 2 1/2 inch thick rounds, then press rounds flat into a 10 by 15 inch nonstick baking pan. Using a pastry brush, coat bread rounds with oil. Cover with plastic wrap, then foil, and refrigerate, 1 hour or up to 2 days. Remove bread from refrigerator 5 minutes before baking. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add half the pork to the hot skillet, then sprinkle with 1 1/2 tablespoons jaggery and cook, stirring, until pork is just slightly browned and no longer pink in the crust, about 5 minutes. Transfer 1/2 of cooked pork to a bowl with remaining sauce. To the skillet, add the remaining pork, remaining jaggery, 1/4 teaspoon salt, and 1/4 teaspoon pepper and cook, stirring, until pork is no longer pink, 5 to 7 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the cooked pasta to a serving dish and set aside. Repeat with another 1/2 cup cooked pasta, then stir in the pork mixture. Set aside, covered. Wipe out skillet and return to medium high heat. Coat pan with cooking spray. Working with one sheet of bread at a time, dip each round in the hot skillet and transfer to the prepared sheet pan. Using a serrated knife, gently cut bread rounds into quarters. Brush the tops with a little bit of lime juice and sprinkle with remaining jaggery. Bake until bread is golden brown, about 12 minutes. Meanwhile, in a large bowl, stir together the bread and lobster or pasta. Cover with yogurt and stir until combined.

Random Ingredients: cider vinegar,brown sugar,limoncello,corn tortilla,beef broth,orange,grand marnier
title: The New "lobster's Tongues"
ingredients: 1/2 cup limoncello | 1/2 cup beef broth | 1/4 teaspoon dry yeast ( not instant ) | 1/4 teaspoon grated orange rind | 1/4 cup coarse brown sugar | 12 corn tortillas | 1/3 cup grand marnier ( optional )
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the limoncello, beef broth and orange peel. Cover and set aside. Sprinkle the yeast over the top of 1/4 cup boiling water in a small saucepan. Let stand until foamy, about 5 minutes. Add the brown sugar and beat vigorously with a wooden spoon until dissolved. Drain the tortillas and arrange in a platter. Pour the limoncello mixture over the tortillas, then add just enough grand marnier to moisten the sauce.

title: Kris' Fire Roasted Red Pepper Cookies
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs red peppers ( or any other mild red pepper ) | 2 cups flour | 1/2 cup guacamole ( optional )
instructions: Place peppers on a baking sheet and toss so they bake about 8 minutes at 375°f in a large bowl combine flour, guacamole and red pepper flakes. Roll each pepper by hand and roll them in the flour mixture until well coated.

Random Ingredients: lime leaf,creole seasoning,parsley flake,shell pasta,snow pea,white wine,bacon,granny smith apple
title: Shredded Apple and Snow Pea Salad
ingredients: 3 tablespoons dry white wine | 2 teaspoons reduced sodium creole seasoning | 1 cup shredded peeled granny smith apple | 1 cup chopped small white potatoes | 1/2 lb cooked small shell pasta | 1/2 cup chopped fresh parsley flakes | 2 lime leaves, thinly sliced lengthwise
instructions: Preheat a 4 minute or until hot. Stir the white wine and creole seasoning in a medium bowl. Add the apple and potatoes and toss to coat. Toss in the pasta, parsley, and lime leaves and serve immediately.

title: Honey Orange Pea Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 1 packet frozen peas | 1/3 cup plain flour | 2 teaspoons finely grated orange peel | 2 eggs, lightly beaten | 150 g egg noodles | 4 tablespoons honey
instructions: Cook onion without oil in large frypan over medium heat until soft. Stir in flour, orange peel and peas. Remove from heat. Combine eggs, honey and noodles and stir until combined. Spoon mixture into buttered ovenproof dish. Bake casserole at c for 15 minutes or until golden.

Random Ingredients: chili flake,shrimp,beef,lipton onion soup mix,rye bread,bailey irish cream,currant,cucumber
title: Low Fat Irish Beef and Shrimp Cocktail Sandwich
ingredients: 2 loaves rye bread ( or more if you wish ) | 24 -30 shrimp, medium | 14 ounces beef, cooked ( whatever meat you like best ) | 24 slices cucumbers | 1 1/2 ounces biailey's irish cream | 1 package lipton onion soup mix | 1 teaspoon dried chili flakes | 1/4 cup currants
instructions: Soak bread in cold water for a few seconds to remove starch. Drain, then cut into 10 pieces. Put on grill, or on broiler rack. Grill until bread is toasted and cooked through. Slice meat in slices if desired. Spread shrimp on the bread. Arrange sliced meat on the bread slices. Combine soups and chili flakes in a blender and mix well, scraping down sides of bowl as needed. Combine the currants with half a cup of water. Pour the liquid mix over the meat, then spread evenly across the bread. Put under the grill until hot and bubbly. Serve immediately.

title: Almond Salad
ingredients: 1/3 cup blanched slivered almonds | 1 -2 cup fresh lettuce | 3/4 cup cold water
instructions: Soak almonds at least an hour, remove the skins& grind almonds in a blender to a fine powder. Pour boiling cold water on to this ground almonds and grind in a blender. Mix almonds with lettuce, add more water to thin. Variation add 1/4 cup toasted bread crumbs + 1/4 cup of almonds & 2 tbsp of butter in place of almonds.

Random Ingredients: green cabbage,peanut oil,yellow bell pepper,sage leaf,wheat spaghetti,mirin,couscous,asafoetida powder
title: Green Cabbage and Pepper Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb fresh whole wheat spaghetti | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 1/2 small green cabbage, shredded | 1/2 small yellow bell pepper, seeded and chopped | 1/2 cup couscous | 1/4 cup mirin | 1/4 cup chopped fresh sage leaf
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions, drain and keep warm. In a large skillet, heat peanut oil over medium heat.

title: Homemade Cheese
ingredients: 7 ounces cottage cheese | 5 1/2 tablespoons dark soy sauce ( or tamari if you like )
instructions: Mix all ingredients and place in a large bowl with a lid. Serve.

title: Pecan Candy
ingredients: 4 cups of finely chopped pecans | 1/2 cup brown sugar, firmly packed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees farenheit. Toast nuts in oven until they are fragrant and beginning to brown, 8 - 10 minutes. Cool. Combine brown sugar and pecans in mixing bowl until well mixed. Break candy into pieces and place into a shallow dish, letting excess air drippings drip back into the bowl. Dip in the melted candy so that coated candy sticks are coated, then roll nuts in the pecan mixture to coat. Place on a greased cookie sheet or baking tray.

Random Ingredients: tofu,garlic powder,red chilies,egg white,coleslaw mix,vegetable shortening,red chili
title: Tofu Omelet
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable shortening, at room temperature | 8 ounces firm tofu, drained | 3 large egg whites | 3 tablespoons coleslaw mix | 3 red chilies, seeded, membranes removed | 2 tablespoons garlic powder | 1 teaspoon dried red chili, crushed
instructions: Dice tofu into 1/4 inch cubes. Cut 2 chilies in half lengthwise and scrape out seeds with fingers, discard seeds. Place tofu cubes into a colander set in a microwave safe bowl with 2 tablespoons water. Cover bowl with plastic wrap and microwave on high for 3 to 5 minutes or until tofu is pliable, stirring every 2 minutes. Cool 5 minutes. Transfer tofu to bowl and mash with a fork or fork. In a medium bowl, combine egg whites, coleslaw mix, red chili, garlic powder and chiles. Whisk egg whites until soft peaks form but not dry. Add tofu mixture and stir until just combined. Pour into a small, buttered 8 inch square pan. Chill until serving time. Break into squares or wedges and serve. Yield, 4 servings.

title: Smoked Salmon for the Grill!
ingredients: 6 salmon ( skin and fat removed and finely diced ) | 1 tablespoon lemon pepper ( dried grated mixed with the lemon juice ) | 2 cups fresh spinach leaves ( cleaned and coarsely chopped )
instructions: Mix all ingredients into 1 1/2 cup of water and allow to sit at least 1 hour. When ready to cook, brush with mixture. Cook the salmon on a hot ridged grill about 2 - 3 minutes on each side until cooked through..

title: Lemon-Onion Refried Beans
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds dried pinto beans | 1/2 tablespoon lemon extract | 1 small onion seeds, or to taste | 1 large tomato, diced
instructions: Rinse the beans completely and transfer to a blender. Mix in the lemon extract, onion seeds, and tomato. Blend until smooth.

title: Pecan Cookies
ingredients: 12 ounces pecan pieces | 4 ounces plain flour
instructions: Roll out very finely the pecan and mix into the flour. Add salt and mix well. Shape into small balls and leave to set before drying in a dry place.

title: Fiesta Zucchini
ingredients: 1/8 teaspoon cayenne | 1 medium zucchini, sliced paper thin | crushed ice
instructions: Toast cayenne in a large skillet over medium heat until fragrant, about 2 minutes. Stir in zucchini.

Random Ingredients: mace,jiffy cornbread mix,salt beef,sweetcorn,yellow bell pepper
title: Roasted Sweet Corn and Pepper Hot Dogs
ingredients: 1 package jiffy cornbread mix | 1 yellow bell pepper | 1 package corn | 1/2 lb salt beef | 1 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Preheat oven to spray a baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray. Heat corn to boiling in large pot on stovetop. Add bell pepper and salt to hot pot, cook until veggies are slightly tender, stirring occasionally. Cut into 1 strips. Place corn strips in a bowl and place in pan. Sprinkle with ground mace. Mix with spoon until ingredients are mixed and potatoes are thoroughly coated. Spread each hot dog generously with the corn mixture.. Bake, covered with foil for 20 minutes.
