Uncover, sprinkle with green onions, shredded cabbage wedges and/or carrots for a garnish.

title: French Garlic Dip
ingredients: 1 pound bulbs garlic, peeled | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup
instructions: Place bulbs in a bowl with enough water to cover. Soak and peel garlic cloves. Place in a blender. Cover with cream of chicken soup, and blend until finely chopped. Chill. To serve, pour into a gravy bowl, and spread with cracker crumbs or finely chopped green onions.

Random Ingredients: chicken gizzard,sesame oil,bicarbonate soda,italian tomato,lime wedge,dark sesame oil,kirsch
title: Sesame Chicken (Jugged)
ingredients: 500 g chicken gizzards or 500 g zubaidi sausage | 1 cup kirsch | 1/4 cup dark sesame oil | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 tablespoon powdered bicarbonate of soda | 1 liter italian stewed tomatoes ( about 12-14 oz ) or ( 14 ounce ) liter canned italian tomatoes, undrained | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 6 lime wedges ( to garnish )
instructions: Slice the chicken into small bite and mix in the kirsch, sesame oil, oil, bicarbonate of soda and tomato and marinate for 6 hours. Thread the chicken onto skewers and grill under a medium heat for 10 - 12 minutes per side, turning once or twice or until cooked. To serve, slice the chicken and add the tomato sauce. Garnish with lime wedges.

title: Pineapple-Herring Salad
ingredients: 12 ounces pineapple, firm | 1 tablespoon mirin ( or 2 tbsp sake ) | 24 herring fillets, in one piece
instructions: Cut herring fillets lengthwise into 5 slices. Place pineapple in a shallow bowl. Sprinkle with mirin. Set aside for 30 minutes. Carefully remove herring fillets from bowl and discard any excess marinade. Cook fillets in a frying pan over medium heat, brushing with a little of the cooking oil, for 4 minutes on each side. Set aside to cool slightly. Cut herring fillets from skin onto serving plates and spoon salad among plates. Surround with remaining pieces of pineapple.

Random Ingredients: milk,beef chuck shoulder steak,spinach leaf,cumin powder,rice vinegar
title: Spinach-Spinach With Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs beef chuck shoulder steaks or 2 lbs other tender beef, 3/4 inch thick | 2 packages washed & dried spinach leaves | 3 cups hot cooked rice vinegar | 2 cups skim milk | 1 teaspoon cumin powder or 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Cut steak into 2 or 3 pieces, season with salt and pepper. Place in a slow cooker, add spinach leaves and cover. Cook on high setting for 10 to 12 hours or on low setting for 2 to 4 hours. Remove steak from slow cooker. Combine vinegar, milk, and cumin in a saucepan.

Random Ingredients: rice,wheat flour,pomegranate seed,pineapple juice,anchovy,italian seasoning,red chili powder
title: Crunchy Italian Breadcrumbs
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups wheat flour | 2 cups rice ( uncooked ) | 1/2 cup pomegranate seeds | 2 tablespoons anchovies | 1/2 - 3/4 cup fresh tomato sauce ( i use solo brand ) | 1 teaspoon dried red chili powder | 1 pinch dried italian seasoning
instructions: If you have a kitchenaid rice paddle, put all dry ingredients in rice paddle and make a well in the breadcrumb mixture to add liquids to flour and spices. Make sure there are no lumps. Make sure the well in the breadcrumb mixture is not sticking too much to your kneaded rice paddle. Mix flour and liquid in a small bowl and add to the well. Mix to form a thick paste and press into a breadcrumb like dough using your fingers or dough spoons. Turn onto lightly floured surface. Place on lightly greased cookie sheet. Let rise for about 30 minutes. Meanwhile, remove crust from breadcrumb and bake at 350f for about 20 - 25 minutes. Cool. In the meantime, mix toppings in a sauce pan. Once cool cut into pieces with a pizza cutter or a serrated knife or a sharp knife.

Random Ingredients: mint,calvados,pork rib,taco seasoning mix,white sugar,pesto sauce,creamy peanut butter
title: Mexican Style Pork Ribs
ingredients: 1 pound pork ribs | 1/2 cup creamy peanut butter | 1/2 cup dry-roasted peanuts | 2 teaspoons dry-packed calvados | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning mix, or more to taste | 2 teaspoons white sugar | 1/3 cup sour cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Line a roasting pan with aluminum foil. Place pork ribs in a roasting pan and coat with cooking spray. Roast in the preheated oven until pork is easily pulled away from the bone, about 1 hour. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 145 degrees f.

title: Salt Cod With Hummus
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs salt cod fish | 2 tablespoons tahini | 1 can garbanzo beans, drained | 2 tablespoons chopped ripe olives ( moroccan or pitted ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom ( i use freshly ground cardamom and use half this ) | 1 -2 small hot habanero pepper
instructions: In a sauce pan, bring salted water to a boil. Add cod and cook for 3 minutes. Drain and rinse. Pat dry with cool water. In shallow baking dish, add salt cod. Sprinkle with about half the pita bread seasoning. Cover cod with remaining pita bread seasoning. In a small bowl, mix tahini, beans, olives and spices. Spread on the top of the salted cod and cover with remaining salted cod. Cover with foil and bake at 350 degrees until the fish is opaque, 25 to 30 minutes. Serve the remaining pita bread on the side.

title: Spicy Fish
ingredients: 1 lb white onion | 1 teaspoon chili sauce | 24 sheets phyllo pastry, thawed
instructions: Place onions in a saucepan, add 1/3 cup water and place over medium heat. Turn heat to low and cook onions for about 20 minutes or until beginning to soften. Add chili sauce and cook for 10 minutes. Cool onions with a wire wrack. Roll filo pastry out between 2 sheets of plastic wrap to 4x6 inch rectangles and set aside. Spray a 12x18 inch or larger pan with nonstick spray. Arrange 1 sheet on bottom of pan and lightly spray with pam as it crisps. Drain onions on paper towels and spread 1/2 of onions over bottom of pastry and sprinkle 1/2 with salt. Repeat layers. Pour 1/3 liquid into pan with onions and sprinkle with salt. Sprinkle remaining onions over onions. Cut strips off the top and brush with a little water. Bake at 375ºf for about 15 minutes or until golden.

title: Tofu in Coconut Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb firm tofu, in 1/2 in size | 15 ounces corn oil | 1 -2 garlic clove, crushed | 1 -2 ounce white flour | 10 ounces light coconut milk | 20 ladyfingers
instructions: Start with the coconut milk and put corn oil in a pan, stir in garlic and white flour until batter is runny. Add drained tofu and cook. Keep the mixture and put in a small crock pot. Take out lady fingers, cut tofu into ½ thick slices. Put on warmed plate, put a tofu slice on the bread and serve.

title: Mexican Pot Roast With Peaches
ingredients: 7 lbs rump roast | 4 poblano chiles, roasted, peeled, seeded, chopped | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 cup canned peaches, sliced
instructions: Put the roast in the crock pot and add the chiles, bouillion cube, and half the peach slices. Cook on high for 4 to 5 hours on high or on low for 8 to 10 hours. Shred the meat, cover loosely with foil and let sit for about 10 minutes. Shred the meat and serve on corn tostada shells with sour cream and a side of tortilla chips.

title: Asparagus and Herb Raita
ingredients: 1 lb asparagus ( or other green or yellow ) | 1/4 1/4 lb radish or 1/4 lb other greens | 4 fresh thyme sprigs | 6 ounces dried fruit ( or fresh apricots or apples ) | 1/4 cup low-fat buttermilk or 1/4 cup milk
instructions: Trim the ends off the asparagus and cut the tips off any green parts. Break off a few cloves of fresh thyme and save them for garnish. Trim the tips off the greens, wash and dry. Bring a pot to a boil and boil for 3 to 4 minutes. Drain, rinse lightly, and dry the leaves. Trim the stems of the herbs and arrange on a serving plate. Sprinkle the asparagus and radishes with the thyme leaves. Sprinkle the dried fruit over. In the cup or small bowl, use a fork to mix the buttermilk and milk. Pour the milk mixture over the asparagus and radishes. Serve immediately.

title: Nairobi Beef Stew -- Shashlyk
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs rump roast | 1/2 teaspoon chili paste ( sambal oelek )
instructions: Remove all visible fat from the pork roast. Spread the ground chili paste all over the meat and rub it into the meat. Place the roast in a dutch oven or other large heavy pot. Cover the meat with the water. Bring to a boil, then lower the heat to a simmer and cook, covered, for 3 hours turning the meat frequently. When the roast is very tender and the water is reduced, remove from heat and discard fat pieces and gristle. Strain the meat and skim off any gristle that rises to the surface, skim off all but 1 - 2 tablespoons of fat. Return the meat, uncovered, to the pot and stir to mix well. Simmer over low heat for 30 minutes. Discard any solids in the pan. Skim off any white foam that rises to the surface. Transfer to serving dish and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: salmon steak,chili pepper flake,golden syrup,olive,pasta,sea salt black pepper,white miso,poundcake
title: Miso Glazed Salmon
ingredients: 12 ounces poundcake, cut into 1 inch cubes | 6 ounces fresh salmon steaks, trimmed and cut in half | 1 1/2 tablespoons olive, pure | 1 1/2 teaspoons golden syrup | 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1 cup frozen mixed whole pitted olive | sea salt and black pepper | 1 package dry pasta
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Put the cake pieces, olive pure, golden syrup, chili, and olives into a blender.

title: Mushroom Stoup Appetizer
ingredients: 1 large sweet potato stick ( you can use frozen potato sticks ) | 1 large head of garlic | 1 can condensed golden mushroom soup | 3 spring onions, chopped | 1/2 cup margarine ( or more ) or 1/2 cup butter, melted
instructions: In a large, covered plastic bag, or ziplock, combine all ingredients except the margarine or butter. Refrigerate for 4 - 5 hours or overnight, stirring the contents occasionally. Remove the squishly mixture and form into small, thick patties.. Brown in a heated well buttered hot skillet over medium low heat until lightly brown, 1 - 2 minutes each side. Serve hot.

title: Chili Hotpot
ingredients: 12 ounces fresh kidney beans or 12 ounces pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 6 ounces catsup | 1 anaheim chili | 1 puff pastry
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200c degrees. Prepare a baking tray with a removable base. Place the beans in a saucepan, fill with water to cover, bring to boil and simmer for 10 min or until cooked. Add chili, cook for 5 minute drain and cool. Roll out puff pastry to a 20cm x 12cm rectangle. Cut pastry length ways into two 2 cm squares. Divide beans among the pastry, top with chili and pour catsup evenly over bean mixture. Top with chille. Bake for 40 minutes or until pastry is crispy.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock vegetable,coffee ice cream,chicken breast,apricot preserve,tea,scallion
title: Chicken and Apricot Ice Cream Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 lb boneless chicken breast | 1/2 cup apricot preserves | 8 scallions, chopped | 4 scallions, trimmed | 8 ounces brewed tea ( herbal preferred ) | 300 ml chicken stock or 300 ml vegetable stock | 200 ml coffee ice cream
instructions: Preheat broiler. In a bowl, mix the chicken breast with jam, scallions and scallions. Place about 5 cm of the chicken mixture onto the bottom of a hot flat surface and roll up. Place the rolled chicken, seam side down, onto a baking tray. Repeat with remaining chicken and scallions. Place each tray into a preheated 450 degrees f. Oven. Once the tray is hot, insert a toothpick into the end of each roll to allow it to escape easily. Broil for 10 minutes until the tops have lightly browned and chicken is cooked. Transfer to a plate and slice into thick pieces. Serve with spiced tea and apricot preserves on the side.

Random Ingredients: yellow tomato,onion powder,black bean,mace,limeade concentrate,lime wedge,red snapper,artichoke heart
title: Spicy Black Bean Snapper With Artichokes and Yellow Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 can yellow tomatoes, diced | 3 jars marinated artichoke hearts | 1 can black beans, drained, lightly diced | 2 teaspoons limeade concentrate, drained ( can use lemon juice ) | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | lime wedge
instructions: Drain tomatoes from can, reserving 1/2 cup. Reserve tomatoes. Combine remaining ingredients.

title: Pittsburgh Hots - for 1 or 2!
ingredients: 1 hamburger | 1 teaspoon tarragon
instructions: Mix tarragon into your hamburger. I also like to mix a little paprika with the tarragon to help it stick. Place on a sandwich buns and spread with your favorite cheese.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage,tahini,tomato paste,mexican cheese,mexican chocolate,mint leaf
title: Mexican Spaghetti Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb dry italian sausage - casings removed | 2 tablespoons tahini | 1/2 cup dry crushed tomatoes paste | 1/2 cup shredded mexican blend cheese | 1/4 cup shredded mexican chocolate | fresh mint leaves, minced
instructions: Brown and drain sausage. In a medium bowl combine sausage along with tahini and tomato paste. Add cheese, cover and simmer 30 minutes or until thickened. Add mint leaves and simmer 10 minutes. Serve over your favorite spaghetti.

Random Ingredients: yoghurt,sugar lemon gelatin,chicken bouillon,chili without bean
title: Homemade Cholaine Cheese (Fat Free)
ingredients: 4 packages fat-free sugar-free lemon gelatin | 2 bags fat-free yoghurt | 2 teaspoons chili without beans | 1 cube chicken bouillon
instructions: You will need 1 1/2 pints of cheese cloth free fat free yoghurt. Place the strainer in a strainer over a bowl and sprinkle with the chicken bouillon cube. Place the yoghurt on a plate and pour over a 1 gallon quantity of yoghurt to cover about 1/4 of the strainer. Cover with plastic wrap and put in the refrigerator, stirring occasionally. When the strainer is completely drained you can do whatever you want. When you have a full supply of the yoghurt, stir it through the colander.. You will notice that the cheese will start to lose liquid but if it starts to stick, let the strainer drip out and stir into your strained yoghurt. When all the cheese is drained place in your container, chill, and dig in or add the following while at least 5 hours.

title: Grilled Hawaiians
ingredients: 2 teaspoons black mustard seeds | 4 tablespoons sprite or 4 tablespoons lemon juice | 2 -4 leaves lettuce
instructions: Toast mustard seeds, cover with plastic wrap & let stand for 30 minutes. Turn heat to high & add remaining ingredients & blend well. Cover & refrigerate for at least 3 hours before serving.

title: Chicken With Beets
ingredients: 1 chicken breast | 1 can beets
instructions: Take the chicken out of its packaging in to the fridge for about 20 minutes. Slice open with fork and put beet pieces on it. If the beet pieces can be easily pierced with a toothpick, then cook them on the grill till they can be cooked from the outside and just a bit charred on the edges. If you can't get the beet pieces, you could just boil them in a little boiling water for about 5 mins, drain then put them in a blender with a little vinegar and puree until all the beet is pureed. Put everything in a pan, mix and bring to boil and simmer for about 1 hour. Serve as you would normally.

Random Ingredients: cabbage leaf,okra,hot chili pepper,chili pepper flake,bean sprout,mint sprig,grain mustard,cooking oil
title: Sour  Cabbage and  Okra  Sprouts(Shanghai)
ingredients: 4 cabbage leaves, coarsely chopped | 200 g bean sprouts, trimmed and cut into wedges | 200 g okra, trimmed and cut into 4 long diagonal slices | 2 fresh hot chili peppers, thinly sliced | 2 teaspoons cooking oil | 1 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped of fresh mint sprigs | 1 teaspoon prepared whole grain mustard
instructions: Heat the oil over medium heat in a large wok.. Add the chiles and stir fry for 5 minutes. Add the cabbage and okras. Stir fry for 2 minutes. Add the soured cucumber mixture and mustard. Stir fry for 3 - 4 minutes, coating the vegetables with the mixture well. Serve hot. If you want, serve with steamed jasmine rice.

title: Pork and Sole Fillets
ingredients: 4 sole fillets | 2 tablespoons finely chopped pork
instructions: Place a frying pan over high heat, add the pork, and spread about a tablespoonful of the pork mixture on top. Cook for 1 to 2 minutes on each side until the pork has changed color. Serve sprinkled with the chopped parsley and the rest of the pork mixture on top.

Random Ingredients: suet,lemon zest,turmeric powder,mozzarella cheese,black bean garlic sauce,clam,bean
title: Cheese Lovers Irish Style With Clam Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans crushed beans | 2 cans minced clams | 1/2 lb shredded mozzarella cheese | 2 tablespoons minced fine onion | 6 tablespoons black bean garlic sauce | 1 lemon, zest of | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Combine the first seven ingredients in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Turn down heat and simmer for ten minutes. Serve over your choice of sandwich or crackers, or with a cold saucer or a salad.

title: Smoked Salmon Burgers
ingredients: 2 salmon fillets, 1 inch thick, skinned | 1/4 cup fat free greek yogurt | 1/3 cup mushroom soup ( or 1 mushroom of your choice ) | 1/4 cup fat-free walnuts, chopped | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh rosemary | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried rosemary, crushed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Lightly brush a nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Cut salmon into 6 portions, then into 4 even pieces. Place salmon portions on skillet in a single layer, skin side down. Spray top with cooking spray. Roast salmon approximately 4 minutes or until just flaky. While salmon is roasting combine 1/4 cup plus 2 tablespoons greek yogurt with 1/3 cup mushroom soup or mushroom of your choice, walnuts, and 1 tablespoon rosemary. Stir well, then spread over salmon pieces in skillet. Return to oven, uncovered, and continue baking approximately 12 - 15 minutes or until done.

title: Chinese Cabbage and Nuts
ingredients: 6 heads chinese cabbage | 2 tablespoons molasses | 2 teaspoons hazelnuts or 2 teaspoons peanuts
instructions: Wash cabbage finely by submerging in boiling water for 5 - 10 minutes. Drain and place in a bowl, toss with molasses and nuts. Taste and adjust seasoning.

title: Guacamole for One
ingredients: 6 tablespoons guacamole | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar
instructions: Mix all ingredients and serve.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower,marshmallow,ranch bean,dark soy sauce,anise seed,mango,hard egg
title: Fruit, Avocado and Ranch Salad
ingredients: 1 medium cauliflower | 1 hard-boiled egg, peeled | 2 fresh ripe mangoes | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 12 marshmallows | 1 can ranch-style beans ( drained )
instructions: Break cauliflower in half, remove outer leaves, and cut into 3/4 inch pieces. Place in steamer basket, add water to cover and steam until cauliflower is tender, about 6 to 8 minutes. Drain and cool. Cut the egg in half, peel egg white, trim ends, and halve egg whites. Core mangoes so they are about the width of a french fry stick and slice into a half moon shape. Remove egg white from steamer and slice into halves. Chop marshmallows about 1/4. Place in a bowl and toss with beans. Cut cuke in 1/2 and add to bowl with mango, egg white, marshmallows and anise seeds. Serve at room temperature.

title: Vegetable Kofta With Mushrooms
ingredients: 6 tablespoons currants | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 bunch fresh chives, chopped | 12 snow peas, trimmed and halved | 1/4 lb asparagus or 1/4 lb wood ear mushroom, trimmed and cut diagnally into 1 `` lengths | 100 g cauliflower, separated into individual florets ( optional ) | 24 lettuce leaves, large | 3/4 lb fresh snow pea ( optional )
instructions: Place currants in a small bowl. Sprinkle with asafoetida. Mix well. Add chive, snow peas and stir fry over low heat until snow peas are softened and vegetables are just tender. Meanwhile, place cauliflower and mushrooms into a steamer basket and water to a depth of 1/2 inch. Cover and cook for 3 minutes or just until crisp tender. Drain vegetables and vegetables on towels and keep vegetables warm. Add the currants and asafoetida to the vegetables and toss with the cooked vegetables and mushrooms. To serve, place lettuce leaves on individual lettuce leaves. Divide the snow peas between the lettuce leaves and roll up the rolls tightly. Serve with sauce.

title: Broccoli Saute With Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 cups fresh broccoli | 2 tablespoons shallots, chopped ( about 1 t. ) | 1/2 lb cremini mushroom, sliced ( about 3 cups ) | 1/3 cup radish, coarsely chopped ( about 1 t. )
instructions: Preheat broiler. In a large bowl toss the broccoli with the shallots. Arrange the mushrooms on a baking sheet. Broil, turning once and brushing frequently with the shallot, until tender all the way through, 15 - 20 minutes. Let cool to room temperature and chop coarsely. In a large nonstick skillet, heat the remaining tablespoon oil over high heat. Add the broccoli mixture and radishes. Toss to combine. Cover and cook until the veggies are hot and the flavors are combined, 1 to 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt,chipotle pepper,allspice,celery rib,sumac,chive,blue curacao,red curry paste
title: Spicy Chipotle Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 3 tablespoons red curry paste | 2 teaspoons kosher salt | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 1/4 cup fresh chives or 1/4 cup dill, chopped | 2 1/2 tablespoons blue curacao | 1/3 cup chipotle pepper, seeded, minced | 1 1/2 tablespoons sumac or 1 1/2 tablespoons other spicy spices to taste | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped fresh chives or 1 1/2 tablespoons dill
instructions: Heat a small saucepan over moderate heat until hot but not smoking. Add red curry paste, salt, and allspice, and stir to blend. Stir in chives or dill, curacao, and chipoltes. Cook until sauce is thickened and fragrant, 5 to 10 seconds. If you have trouble getting the chipoltes to stick and plump, add a little water. Transfer sauce to bowl, and chill 1 to 2 hours before serving.

title: Tortilla & Spinach Quesadillas
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon shallot, minced | 1/3 cup broth | 1/3 cup picante sauce | 1/2 cup russet potato, thinly sliced | 4 whole wheat tortillas | 1 bag fresh spinach, cooked
instructions: Spray pan with cooking spray. Stir cooking spray & sprinkle shallot over cooking spray. Heat until sizzling, remove from heat & stir in broth & picante. Set aside. Combine potatoes & salt in another large bowl & toss with enough hot water to moisten. Drain & press to remove extra water. Place 1 tortilla in a hot nonstick skillet, then top with 1/4 of spinach & 1/8 of tomato mixture. Cook until bottom is browned. Transfer to plate & top with remaining veggies. Spoon over all & sprinkle spinach over top.

Random Ingredients: gingersnap,belgian endive,rye flour,beef brisket,nectarine,tomato green chilies,pork tenderloin
title: Beef and Pork Salpicao
ingredients: 2 lbs beef brisket, trimmed, cut in 1-inch thick slices | 1/4 lb lean pork tenderloin, trimmed and cut into 1/4 inch slices | 4 ounces napales or 4 ounces melon, quarters | 12 ounces beards, peeled, pitted and halved | 12 ounces tomatoes and green chilies, drained | 4 ounces brarguez and gingersnaps | 2 belgian endive, leaves
instructions: Lay each piece of beef and pork on a platter and scatter the naps over it. Cover with plastic wrap and place in the refridgerator. Let marinate at least 2 hours. The more time the beef and pork are kept put across each other and in those little plastic pieces, the more tender it will be. When ready to stuff, soak napales in cold water for 5 minutes and drain. Cut the napales in half and cut them in half lengthwise. Put in a large roasting pan. Place the endive leaves on top, cut side down, then place the ends on top. Cover with another roasting pan or flat baking stone and pour in enough cold water to come halfway up the sides of the pan. Cover the pan and place on the middle rack of oven and bake at 350 degrees for about 3 hours or until the beef and pork are tender. Serve with rice and vegetables.

Random Ingredients: baby green,basil,chicken thigh,shell pasta,five spice powder,guacamole,butternut pumpkin
title: Quick Calico Chicken With Roasted Pumpkin and Primavera
ingredients: 1 tablespoon five-spice powder | 1 package baby spinach | 9 ounces skin-on chicken thighs, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 large butternut pumpkin | 1 cup dry small shell pasta | 1/4 cup guacamole | 1/4 cup basil, chopped
instructions: Mix 5 spice powder with spinach on large rimmed baking sheet, breaking up clumps with rubber spatula. Arrange chicken pieces in a single layer over spinach and pressing lightly on spinach with back of spoon. Roast at 450 f for 35 - 40 minutes or until chicken is golden. Meanwhile boil pasta in salted water. Drain and toss with guacamole, basil and remaining 5 spice powder salt and freshly ground black pepper. Serve chicken with sauce.

title: Edible Popcorn
ingredients: 1/2 cup red radish, sliced thin | 2 ounces margarine | 1 package instant vanilla pudding
instructions: Put all ingredients into a greased 9x13 pan. Microwave on high until mixture is hot and pudding is bubbly, stir a few times. This should steam popcorn well and pop popcorn into popcorn.

Random Ingredients: cherry,truffle,dark sesame oil,egg white,ginger root,egg noodle,sumac
title: Baked Noodles Al-Khabeesh
ingredients: 3 ounces uncooked medium egg noodles | 1 tablespoon minced fresh ginger root | 1 1/2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1/2 cup candied cherry, cut in half | 1/2 teaspoon ground sumac | 1 egg white, lightly beaten | 2 teaspoons thinly sliced fresh lemons ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook egg noodles until tender yet firm, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cannellini bean,hash brown,english muffin,pace picante sauce
title: Mexican Hash Browns
ingredients: 1 package frozen hash browns | english muffins | 1 can cannellini beans or ( 16 ounce ) can great northern beans | 1 can pace picante sauce, with onions
instructions: Prepare hash browns, cook according to package directions until lightly browned on the outside. Break frozen hash browns apart and place them between paper towels to drain off liquid. Lightly toast english muffins and set aside. In a medium size bowl place hash browns and drained beans, picante sauce and onions. Stir together.

Random Ingredients: brie cheese,wheat flour,prosciutto,cottage cheese,cream chicken soup,macaroni,sirloin steak
title: A Great Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sirloin steaks | 2 ounces prosciutto | 8 ounces cream of chicken soup | 2 ounces cottage cheese | 10 ounces light sour cream | 1 lb whole wheat flour | 14 ounces macaroni
instructions: Start to brown beef in skillet. Place into casserole dish. Cut prosciutto into strips and then shred into pieces. In small bowl mix soup with cottage cheese, add to meat. Bring to boil then add sour cream. Mix well. Combine flour with hot water in small bowl, add into mixture. Add to meat mixture in casserole dish. Bake at 350 degrees for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Easy Creamy Parmesan Crackers
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup finely grated parmesan cheese | 3 tablespoons hot sauce | 1 dash white pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, stir together the cream of chicken soup, parmesan cheese, hot sauce and white pepper until thoroughly combined. Stir into ground crackers. Spread onto a cookie sheet. Bake, stirring every 10 minutes, until puffed and lightly browned, about 20 minutes. Cool slightly. Place the crackers onto a wax paper covered cookie sheet. Keep an eye on them, so they do not burn. Variation, add 1/4 cup melted butter and 1/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese for each cracker.

Random Ingredients: gluten breadcrumb,cream chicken soup,red wine vinegar,fruit
title: Gluten Free French Onion Soup
ingredients: 2 cans condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup dry gluten-free breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup gluten free french onion soup | 3/4 cup red wine vinegar
instructions: Place all ingredients in a pot and stir well. Set to low and keep at least 1 hour. Use for vegetarian use only the french onion soup and not the chicken soup.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,chunky salsa,phyllo pastry,maple syrup,gold tequila
title: Salsa Crusted Bakery Chicken
ingredients: 1 chicken bouillon cube | 3 tablespoons maple syrup | 1/2 cup chunky salsa ( homemade or canned ) | 1/2 cup golden tequila | 1 lb phyllo pastry sheets ( or 2 boxes ) | pure maple syrup ( optional )
instructions: Preheat saute pan over medium high heat until it is very hot. Spray pam or oil lightly. Remove the chicken bouillon cube from saute pan and discard. In same saute pan, add 3 tblsp maple syrup. Allow to melt and turn heat to high. Add chicken bouillon cube and mix well. Place in a small bowl and add 2 cups salsa, and tequila. Stir well. Lay one sheet in the pan. Add another sheet and turn on other side. Cut into 3 pieces for double wrapping the chicken. Place chicken seam side down on top of phyllo. Fold corners over chicken. Repeat layering process until you have 6 layers. Fold over each piece of chicken using the back of a cleaver to keep it from sticking to pan.. Place chicken in pan and brush with pure maple syrup. Bake in 350 degree oven for 35 - 40 minutes until chicken is cooked through and golden brown. Note, this can also be done in a pressure cooker by baking in the water. Note, if you like, you can cook in a sauce pan that will cover the chicken, or on the grill. Also if you are on the grill you can baste with maple syrup for extra flavor.

title: Mexican Green Monster
ingredients: 1 lb fresh tomatillos | 1/2 cup kahlua | 1 1/2 cups extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Wash the tomatillos whole and put them to the side with the kahlua. Take one side and put a tablespoon of olive oil on it and sprinkle it with the olives. Grill at medium low for about 25 - 40 minutes.

title: Pork Roast-Dip or Canapes With Canadian Bacon
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs red capsicums | 1 1/2 lbs canadian bacon | 1/4 cup water | 1/4 cup light olive, pitted if you like | 1 teaspoon sage | 3 teaspoons cornflour | 2 teaspoons brandy ( optional ) ( optional )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200c. Dice the bacon into small strips. Place in ovenproof dish and cook for about 10 min, drain bacon when cool. Cut into smaller pieces and set aside. Slice the capsicum into thin strips. Place in frying pan, dry with oil, oil is high. Stir often, until the capsicum is soft. Add water until the capsicum dries up. Cook for about 3 4mins until the liquid is syrupy. Add sage and pepper. Remove from heat. In a small bowl add cornflour and brandy and whisk until combined. Stir into the liquid and return to the skillet. Mix until the sauce starts to thicken. Simmer for a minute or so and check taste and adjust if necessary.. Pour the sauce into a small dish or bowl and place the fried bacon on top. Serve with fresh bread or toast.

title: Lobster Thermidor
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh lobster, cleaned and cored | 2 lbs turnips, cleaned and cut into wedges | 1 large russet potato, cleaned and cut in to wedges | 2 slices bacon, fat or 6 slices of ham, diced | 4 ounces cilantro, chopped roughly | 1/4 cup oil or 1/4 cup melted butter
instructions: If using fresh lobsters, cut off any that are under the shell. Cut the tails off lobster, remove and set aside. Slice cleaned lobster into bite sized pieces. If using fresh lobsters, slice the heads into small pieces. Place lobster and turnip pieces in large pan with 6 - 8 cups of water and turn on med high heat. Bring to a boil and cook for 20 minutes. If using fresh lobsters, place in ice water to blanch until easy to remove from shells. If using fresh lobsters, set aside at room temperature for 30 minutes, then drain well. If using leftover lobster pieces, preheat oven to broil. In a deep frying pan, fry bacon until crispy, remove and drain on paper towels. In the same frying pan, heat up the oil or butter until it turns a nice dark red color, about 5 minutes on high. Add lobster pieces and fry for about 5 minutes stirring frequently. Add turnip pieces and fry until turning a nice golden color about 5 minutes. Add cilantro and cook for another 3 - 5 minutes. Turn heat down to medium. In two oven proof casseroles or soups plates, place your lobster chunks on top of the lobster pieces, add fresh cilantro to each plate and take the reserved bacon from the fry pan. Place a dollop of clarified butter between each plate, placing a few pieces of lobster in the center of each and garnish with fresh cilantro.

title: Papaya and Pineapple Treat (Popsicles)
ingredients: 8 ripe papayas | 1 jar pineapple preserves
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Cut 1 papaya in half lengthwise, scrape out pulp, and cut pulp into cubes. Place in a baking dish, spread the fruit out evenly. Place 1 tablespoon of pineapple preserves on top of the fruit, and carefully roll it up with toothpicks. Place in the preheated oven for 30 minutes, or until the center appears dry.

title: Barefoot Contessa's Caesar Salad
ingredients: 1 cauliflower, chopped | 1 teaspoon black vinegar | 1 package provolone cheese, sliced
instructions: In a medium bowl combine cauliflower and black vinegar.

title: Toasted Couscous
ingredients: 1 cup couscous, whole wheat or 1 cup regular couscous | 2 -3 tablespoons of fresh flat-leaf parsley, roughly chopped
instructions: Pick over the couscous and discard any unabsorbed grains. Place a large, heavy, lidded skillet over medium heat and add 2 cups water. Bring to a boil. Add the couscous, lower the heat, cover the pan, and set aside for 15 minutes. Fluff the grains with a fork and stir the liquid into the couscous. When the couscous has absorbed all the liquid, add the parsley and fluff it again. Set toasted couscous on a serving platter and enjoy.

title: Roasted Potatoes
ingredients: 3 lbs red onions, quartered | 14 lbs white potatoes, halved | 1 cup fresh italian parsley, chopped | 1 cup honey
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°. Place onions and potatoes into a large bowl. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over the potatoes. Toss to coat evenly, put in a roasting pan. Roast potatoes 45 - 50 minutes, until browned and tender.

Random Ingredients: kernel corn,green food coloring,red grape,pizza crust,baking potato
title: Corn Fritters
ingredients: 2 tablespoons pizza crust | 2 baking potatoes, peeled and cubed | 1 can corn, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup diced red grapes | green food coloring, optional
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or aluminum foil. Bake rice in the preheated oven 12 to 18 minutes, until browned and tender. Drain off grease. Meanwhile, in a large bowl, mash the potato cubes with a fork. Mix in corn, grapes and optional food coloring. Stir in the corn mixture. Drop by rounded spoonfuls onto the center of the rice. Bake in the preheated oven 5 to 8 minutes on each side, until golden.

Random Ingredients: cheddar cheese,shortening,yogurt,mexican tomato,hamburger,english mustard powder,picante sauce
title: Yogurt Quesadillas
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups plain yogurt | 1 teaspoon prepared ranch style ground mustard powder ( mccormick brand ) | 3 tablespoons picante sauce | 2 slices cheddar cheese | 1/4 lb hamburger | 1/4 cup shredded cheddar cheese | 1 tablespoon shortening
instructions: Mix yogurt, mustard, picante sauce, 2 tablespoons cheese and hamburger in medium bowl. Heat large nonstick skillet on medium setting. When hot, add 1 tablespoon shortening.

title: Quick Sambal Chicken With a Kiwi and Fruity Curried Noodles
ingredients: 500 g boneless skinless chicken breasts, sliced into strips | 8 curry leaves, with the stem finely sliced | 100 ml fish stock | 100 ml light rum or 100 ml port wine | 100 g kiwi fruits | pasta or noodles, of choice | 1 -2 teaspoon grated nutmeg
instructions: Heat a large fry pan, add the oil, swirl to coat, add the chicken strips and stir fry over a high heat 3 - 4 minutes. Add the ginger and curry leaves and stir fry over a high heat for 1 minute. Add the fish and cook until the chicken is cooked through and the curry leaves are wilted. Stir in the rum or port and turn up the heat to high. Simmer over a high heat for 3 minutes then set aside to cool. For the noodles, rinse out the frypan and then gently heat up the wok with the coconut cream. Add the kiwi fruits and stir fry for 5 - 6 minutes. Add the noodles and stir fry for 1 - 2 minutes or until heated through. Add the chicken and gently toss to coat in the curry. Serve immediately, with wedges of lemon.

title: Okra and Beef Brisket Dinner
ingredients: 3 tablespoons yeast ( or 4 teaspoons ) | 5 cups fresh okra ( one 15-ounce package, rinsed well before chopping ) | 1/2 lb frozen beef brisket, thawed ( i used a little bit of fat cut it in very thin strips ) | 2 cans condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 can fat-free canned tomatoes | 1 can chickpeas, drained | 1 cup frozen okra ( one 15-ounce package, rinsed well before chopping ) | 2 teaspoons chili powder ( or to taste ) | chili powder, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Stir yeast into 1 cup of prepared okra. Put 5 cups okra and the remaining ingredients into a large bowl and put into a large, buttered, baking dish. Dice meat into bite size pieces and put into the crockpot. Cover and cook on medium low about 7 hours, stirring and cleaning and dissolving spices. If you like your stew a little thicker, add water or broth. Add salt to taste and enjoy.

title: Quick  Milkshake
ingredients: 1/3 cup bulgur | 1/4 vanilla bean ( optional ) | 1 cup ice water
instructions: Dissolve the vanilla bean in the water. If using, transfer to a pitcher. Add the bulgur and vanilla bean to blender. Cover and blend well, until smooth. Scrape down sides of blender if needed. Pour into 4 glasses and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,coconut,kosher salt,cardamom seed,vanilla bean,cremini mushroom,stock
title: Coconut-Mushroom Soup
ingredients: 1 celery rib, chopped | 1 lb cremini mushroom, chopped | 4 ounces unsweetened flaked coconut | 4 cups hot stock | 1 vanilla bean, split, scraped, and split lenghtwise | kosher salt | 1 cardamom seed
instructions: In a large soup pot, saute celery and mushrooms until celery is tender. Add coconut and saute another few seconds, until a light golden colour. Stir constantly. Add hot stock and scrapings.. Simmer 5 minutes. Taste for salt and add as needed. Stir in vanilla bean.

Random Ingredients: black pepper,chicken breast half,double cream,black olive,cinnamon,mint,chili sauce,italian herb seasoning
title: Moroccan Chicken and Black Olives
ingredients: 16 ounces boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 8 ounces pitted black olives | 1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper | 1/4 teaspoon dried italian herb seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/4 cup chili sauce | 1/2 cup double cream | 2 tablespoons of fresh mint, coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Trim chicken of all extraneous fat. Cut into 1 1/2 cubes. Cut olives into halves, if necessary, and place in a medium bowl. Sprinkle with pepper and herbs. Stir in cream. In a small, heavy frying pan, bring chili sauce and cream to a boil over medium heat. Dip chicken, one at a time, in sauce, and arrange in a single layer in a single layer in a shallow roasting pan. Drizzle over olive mixture. Roast 3 hours or until chicken is cooked through and juices run clear.

title: Chili Grilled Steak
ingredients: 3 slices crusty white bread or 1 slice cubed rye bread | 1 boneless bottom round steak | 4 slices thin sliced french bread | 2 teaspoons finely chopped canned chili | 4 cups veggie broth or 4 cups bottled vegetable broth, made from 1-3/4-ounces of veg | 14 ounces cleaned unpeeled scallops
instructions: Place bread cubes in a heavy large skillet.

title: Pumpkin Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh pumpkin ( peeled, cubed, or 1 3/4 cups canned pumpkin ) | 2 1/2 cups skim milk ricotta cheese | 1 1/2 cups cheez whiz
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Mix together all ingredients. Place mixture in a lightly buttered casserole dish and bake for 30 minutes, or until the dip thickens and the pumpkin is tender. Serve hot with tostito chips.

title: Vegan French Bread
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon yeast | 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 1 can fat-free refried beans ( vegetarian can be sub )
instructions: The amount of bakers yeast can be a bit higher, if you want a really light french loaf, but not so high as to create a very low heat baked bread or cookie dough which results in a more authentic french loaf. Spray the breadmaker with cooking spray, pour the liquids and yeast into the breadmaker, add the rest of the baked bread ingredients except the beans and sprouts and mix well. Put breadmaker on low and let the bread rise about 5 hours.. After that, mix the sprouts and sprouts in with the bread and spread on more of the french bread if desired. If desired, you could spread the sprouts on top of the other pieces of bread and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: pomegranate seed,cherry,fenugreek seed,pineapple chunk,goat cheese,lime juice,poblano chile,cinnamon
title: Sultan's Pomegranate and Cherry Salad
ingredients: 3 pomegranates, stemmed, halved | 2 cans pineapple chunks, drained in juice | 1/2 cup pomegranate seeds, shelled | 1/2 cup pomegranate powder ( or 1 tablespoon pumpkin seeds ) | 2/3 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/4 teaspoon ground fenugreek seeds | 1 lime, juice of | 4 ounces feta cheese, crumbled ( or goat cheese )
instructions: Make the pomegranate dressing by combining pomegranates, pineapple, pomegranate seeds, pomegranate powder, cinnamon, and fenne in a blender and process until smooth, about 10 seconds. Stir in the lime juice. Add feta cheese, and fold well. Chill thoroughly. This is a wonderful salad.

title: Quick Pasta With Spicy Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 8 ounces alfredo sauce | 1 bag spinach leaves | 1/2 cup chopped parsnip | 1 can garbanzo beans ( reserve liquid ) | 2 teaspoons almond extract
instructions: Heat alfredo sauce to boiling, add greens and cook for 3 - 5 minutes until wilted. Add parsnips and cook 1 - 2 minutes. Add garbanzo beans and almond extract. Stir. Serve over your favourite pasta.

title: Easy Greek Quinoa (Quinoa Cooker)
ingredients: 2 quinoa, medium brown wheat or 1 large brown rice, washed ( rinsed, drained, and allowed to dry ) | 2 -3 tablespoons lemon juice, fresh | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Place the rinsed, drained, brown rice in to a medium sized mixing bowl. Add all your remaining ingredients to the bowl and mix until completely mixed and the grains are the size and shape of pearl barley or couscous. Cover bowl with lid or plastic wrap and leave in fridge for about 3 or 4 hours. The longer you leave it in the fridge, the fluffier it will be in the end. Remove the cooked or leftovers from the fridge, stir again, and serve. Or, for more authenticity serve some sliced lemon wedges with garlic.

Random Ingredients: cooking oat,baking soda,large shrimp,mint sprig,mustard green
title: Oat Scones 2007
ingredients: 2 tablespoons quick-cooking oats | 2 teaspoons baking soda | 1 lb large shrimp, shelled and deveined | 2 cups quick-cooking oats | 6 mint sprigs | mustard greens ( optional )
instructions: Place 1 tbsp quick bake oats in a shallow bowl. In the center of bowl, sprinkle 2 tbsp quick bake oats on top. Using your hands or two large spoons, toss the oat mix evenly, then spoon 2 tbsp quick bake oats on top, spacing evenly, and sprinkle 2 tsp baking soda evenly all over, then sprinkle 1 1/4 cups of shrimp onto baking oats. Using your hands or large spoon, toss the shrimp around the scones until thoroughly coated. Arrange the shrimp on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, and sprinkle the remaining 2 tbsp quick bake oats over the top. Using the spatula, lightly press the shrimp to flatten out the oats. Bake in a 400 degree oven for 7 to 10 minutes, or until the tops are just lightly toasted. Remove from oven, and place immediately in a bowl, or cover bowl with plastic wrap and set aside at room temperature. In a medium size bowl, mix 2 1/2 cups quick bake oats and the remaining 2 1/2 cups quick bake oats using your hands or spoons. Spoon the contents of the bowl onto a baking rack and cool, stirring once, for at least an hour or two. To serve, break the scones apart and toss with mustard greens.

title: Shrimp Bites
ingredients: 24 wonton wrappers | 12 scallions, thinly sliced
instructions: Mix shrimp and scallions together with a fork. Lay wonton wrappers flat on a dry towel lined baking sheet just large enough to fit over the other ingredients without touching. Bake at 450°f for 10 - 15 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Gruyere Salad #2
ingredients: 1 cucumber ( peeled, seeded and chopped ) | 1 tablespoon parsley ( chopped ) | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds ( black seeds ) | 1 teaspoon angostura bitters | 1 1/2 cups gruyere cheese ( shredded & divided ) | 1/2 lb snow pea ( steamed, chopped )
instructions: Combine the mustard seeds, bitters, 1 cup of cheese and cucumber. Toss well. Pour over the salad and toss to mix.

title: Slow Cooker Tangy leg of lamb
ingredients: 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 4 pounds leg of lamb
instructions: In a large bowl, mix the golden syrup and the lamb. Place lamb in a slow cooker and cover with the golden syrup mixture. Cook on low for 10 to 12 hours, until meat is very tender and easily shredded.

title: Easy Italian Appetizer
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry sherry wine ( white balsamic ) | 1 cup frozen whipped topping
instructions: Combine sherry and whipped topping in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: russet potato,blue cheese,arborio rice,green pepper,steak,marsala wine
title: Blue Cheese Beef Risotto
ingredients: 1 lb round steak, trimmed of fat, cut into strips | 1 cup arborio rice | 1/4 cup marsala wine | 4 medium russet potatoes, peeled & halved | 1 green pepper, cut into thin strips | 1/2 cup crumbled blue cheese ( optional )
instructions: Combine 1/2 cup arborio with marsala wine, refrigerate 30 minutes, or until flavors blend. Heat oven to 350 degrees f. Place russet potato in a greased 13x9x2 inch glass baking dish. Sprinkle with 1/2 of the cheese. Spoon 1/2 of arborio mixture over cheese. Repeat layers. Bake, uncovered for 30 minutes, or until heated through.

title: Hot and Spicy Bamboo Shoots
ingredients: 1 cup canned bamboo shoot, drained and chopped | 1/4 cup finely chopped imitation crabmeat | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | cooking spray
instructions: Combine the bell pepper, imitation crab meat, and dijon mustard.

title: Grilled Clam with Garlic Salt
ingredients: 1 head clams in shell | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 rosemary sprig
instructions: Rinse clams with cold water and place on a medium high fire. Steam until clams open and clams have opened. Crack open clams while they are cooking using a hot grill. Use a slotted spoon to remove clams from the shells. Toast garlic salt lightly in skillet just enough to release aroma. Immediately remove from skillet and let cool. Fill and remove hard shell from shells, leaving a 1/4 inch shell and about 1/4 inch shell of each clam. Arrange on platter and sprinkle with a few cloves of fresh garlic salt. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cream,apricot jam,red capsicum,white pepper,lasagna noodle italian,catsup
title: Quick & Easy Apricot Apricot Lasagne
ingredients: 1 jar apricot jam | 500 g prepared meat lasagna noodles ( i prefer 1 lb ) | 250 ml sour cream | 1 jar catsup | 1 medium red capsicum, sliced into thin strips ( we use a bottled sliced tomato ) | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Spread 1 tbsp apricot jam on the bottom of a 2 litre ovenproof dish in a thin layer place 3 lasagnes, overlapping each other, spread with apricot jam. Repeat layering until all ingredients are used, ending with the sauce. Cover and refrigerate for 4 hours or overnight. In a large bowl mix the sour cream, catsup and white pepper. Place in the refrigerator for about 15 minutes to set. Remove from the refrigerator and slice into 3 pieces each.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,coconut milk,pearl barley
title: Coconut-Parmesan Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 14 ounces unsweetened coconut milk | 1 lb pearl barley | 1/3 cup extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Heat coconut milk in a large nonstick pan over medium heat until warm. Cook barley, uncovered, stirring occasionally just until liquid is absorbed, about 10 minutes. Drain, reserving pan drippings. Stir into coconut milk and cook, stirring constantly over medium heat until rice is just cooked through, about about 3 minutes. Stir in 1/2 t. Of olive oil and 2 t. Of reserved coconut drippings.

title: Spanish Style Stew
ingredients: 1 lb ground lean pork | 1 lb dried navy beans | 1/3 cup black olives or 1/3 cup green olive
instructions: Cook pork the way you like drain. Add remaining ingredients except olives. Simmer covered 1 1/2 hours. Add olives and cook an additional 5 minutes.

title: Ancho Chili
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried ancho chiles | 2 cans vegetable stock | 4 ounces bittersweet chocolate, broken in pieces | 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 1/4 cup freshly squeezed lime juice | lemon wedge
instructions: Heat the ancho and 1 tbsp of the vegetable stock in a medium saucepan over medium high heat. Remove from heat, set aside and steep for 30 minutes. Pour into a blender the remaining vegetable stock and bittersweet chocolate and process until the chocolate is smooth. Pour into a bowl and add the lime juice, lemon juice, and remaining 1 tbsp of vegetable stock. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Chill until mixture is ready. Serve with lemon wedges.

title: Mustard Watercress
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg watercress leaves, tightly packed | 3 tablespoons mustard oil
instructions: Blanch the cress leaves for 2 minutes and then refresh them in fresh water. Heat the mustard oil and fry the watercress for 2 - 3 minutes until limp and beginning to change color. Drain the watercress and spread in a small dish. Spoon over the mustard mixture and serve.

title: Pineapple Flan
ingredients: 1 bottle pineapple juice | 2 eggs
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk butter, 1 cup of the pineapple juice, eggs and remaining 1 cup of pineapple juice. Pour mixture into a 9 x 13 pan, making sure it is evenly spread. Cover and refrigerate until ready to fill with filling. Uncover and bake in a 350 degree f oven 12 minutes or until the center is set and the edges are a deep golden brown.

title: Grilled Halibut
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs halibut fillets | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons kahlua, kahlua or 1 tablespoon dark cherry liquor | 2 tablespoons canned jalapenos, drained and sliced in half | 1 tablespoon canned radishes, drained and sliced | 2 ounces beer, such as amber, such as budweiser budweiser
instructions: Make marinade, in a medium bowl, combine the dark soy sauce, kahlua and jalapenos. Rinse and remove pectoral and ventral fins with a knife as well as outside membrane. In a small saucepan, combine the marinade with the beer and bring to a low boil. Turn off the heat. Brush the cutlets with the marinade and grill over high heat for 4 minutes per side. Transfer to a platter and turn off the heat and let stand 5 minutes to cool. Slice and serve with the dark soy sauce glaze.

title: Chicken and Mallow Croquettes
ingredients: 2 cups vegetable stock | 1/2 cup miso | 3 tablespoons red wine ( or sherry ) | 1 - 1 1/2 lb chicken wings | 1/2 lb gouda cheese or 1/2 lb other cheese | 12 ladyfingers | 4 teaspoons dried marzipan, crushed
instructions: In a saucepan, simmer broth and miso until it is reduced by half about 5 minutes. Put the chicken wing pieces in a separate bowl and pour the broth over them. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes or until the juices run clear. Meanwhile, cut cheese into 1 to 3/4 inch cubes and dip the ladyfingers one at a time into the broth and turn them over so they are soaked. Drain on paper towel. Arrange cheese in a circle in a casserole dish. Top with the chicken and marzipan. Broil in a 400 degree oven for 10 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Tartar Sauce
ingredients: 4 ounces crumbled fat free cream cheese | 1 1/2 tablespoons nonfat yogurt | 1 tablespoon celery rib, chopped | 1 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients through cocoa if using. Cook on medium heat for 2 - 3 minutes or until well blended. If you feel it is too dry, add an extra tablespoon of cream cheese. Sauce should thicken and thicken up slowly. Do not boil. Serve over rice with your favorite fruit.

Random Ingredients: seasoning,heavy whipping cream,kale,vanilla sugar,bratwurst,head garlic,kosher salt
title: Smokin' Hot Bratwurst
ingredients: 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 tablespoon vanilla sugar | 1 tablespoon seasoning | 2 pounds hot bratwurst | 1 bunch kale, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 1 whole head garlic, peeled
instructions: In a large serving dish, whip cream with vanilla sugar and seasoning. Rub bratwurst onto the entire surface of the bratwurst. Cover and refrigerate for 6 hours. Preheat grill for high heat. Remove bratwurst from dish. Place kale and garlic on the grill. Cook, turning occasionally, until bratwurst is no longer pink inside, about 30 minutes.

title: Chile Gelato
ingredients: 2 cups whipping cream | 2 cans green chilies, chopped | 1/2 cup whipping cream
instructions: Blend cream and chiles to fine liquid. Put mixture in mold and freeze until firm.

title: Danish Date and Watermelon Soup
ingredients: 200 g seedless watermelon | 150 g gruyere cheese | 400 g dashi granules | 250 ml water | 2 tablespoons snipped dill | 150 g dates, chopped
instructions: Cut watermelon into cubes and boil for five minutes. Dislodge watermelon and blend in a blender or food processor, until smooth. Heat butter in a pan.

title: Chinese Breakfast Tea Burritos
ingredients: 1 cup burritos ( rice-shaped burritos ) | 1 can kidney beans | 1/8 cup chinese black mushrooms | 2/3 cup sweet roasted peanuts ( or cashews ) | 2 teaspoons capers | 1/4 teaspoon baking powder | leaves english muffin, for breakfast or tea | 2 teaspoons tea
instructions: In large skillet, combine all ingredients and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Turn heat down to medium to simmer, cover and cook for 15 minutes. Remove cover and cook 10 minutes more. Transfer burritos to small casserole dish and garnish with a few coriander leaves. Serve with fruit, if desired. Note, for breakfast, add a couple of spoonfuls of hot steamed rice to the burrito mix before ladling into soup bowls. Or serve cold from the inside of the soup bowls. For tea, stir 1 - 2 tsp tea into 3 cups of hot boiled water. Then add 2 more tsp tea to the pot, and return to boil and stir. Remove pot from heat, and set aside for 4 - 5 minutes before removing from heat.

Random Ingredients: bailey irish cream,cardamom,italian dressing,barramundi fillet,beef bouillon granule,quinoa,pigeon pea,chicken stock
title: Chef John's Australian Baked Baked Quinoa
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked quinoa | 2 cups chicken stock | 1/4 cup good seasons italian dressing | 2 tablespoons knorr beef bouillon granules | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 cup barramundi fillets, chopped | 1/2 cup frozen peas | 1/4 cup baileys irish cream ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Combine quinoa and chicken stock in a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce heat to medium low. Simmer about 8 minutes or until liquid is absorbed. Remove from heat and stir in italian dressing. Place barramundi fillets, peas, and irish cream in a 3 quart baking dish. Spoon mixture into dish and cover with foil. Bake in the preheated oven 35 minutes, or until fish is easily flaked with a fork and filling is hot and bubbly. Let salmon rest 5 minutes, then cover and chill.

Random Ingredients: walnut,iceberg lettuce,chicken wing,cocoa powder,mayonnaise,mexican cheese,flour tortilla
title: Grilled Chicken Tacos, "chill Machaca"
ingredients: 12 pieces chicken legs, thigh and drumsticks | 4 cups freshly shredded mexican blend cheese | 4 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 head iceberg lettuce, core removed, washed well, shredded ( or romaine lettuce ) | canola oil cooking spray ( optional ) or balsamic vinegar ( optional ) | 8 flour tortillas | 3/4 cup mayonnaise or 3/4 cup sour cream
instructions: Poke holes all over the chicken legs with a meat tenderizing mallet or small knife in several places. Arrange them one side on a solid platter or cookie sheet and let rest in a warm place for about 30 minutes. Spray the tortillas with the canola oil or balsamic vinegar. Preheat grill. Spread the chicken legs out in a single layer on one of the tortillas. Sprinkle 1 cup cheese evenly on the chicken legs. Top each with a spoonful of the coleslaw mix. Starting with an edge, roll up the tortillas, jelly roll fashion. Wrap each with a toothpick and set aside on a foil lined baking sheet and refrigerate until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: reblochon cheese,cardamom seed,vanilla extract,phyllo pastry,apple cider vinegar,campbell tomato soup
title: Smoky Tomato & Cheese Strudel
ingredients: 16 sheets frozen phyllo pastry, defrosted if previously frozen | 2 cans campbell's tomato soup | 1 1/2 cups apple cider vinegar | 2 teaspoons vanilla extract | 2 teaspoons cardamom seeds | 1/2 cup reblochon cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Spray a 13x9 inch glass baking dish with sides with cooking spray. Combine tomatoes soup, vinegar, vanilla and cardamom seeds in a saucepan. Bring to a boil. Remove from heat. Layer 2 sheets of phyllo in the bottom of the baking dish. Spread the rest of the phyllo sheets across the bottom of the baking dish. Cover with a layer of the provolone cheese, spraying the extra sheets with cooking spray if using. Repeat above steps until all the phyllo sheets are used up, ending with provolone cheese on top. Place in oven and bake for 45 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: taco sauce,green pepper,sesame seed,tart apple,raspberry,asiago cheese,vegetable broth,molasses
title: Apple Sweet & Smoky Chili Rivels
ingredients: 1 package asiago cheese or ( 1 ounce ) package mozzarella cheese, sliced, divided | 1/2 cup vegetable broth | 1/2 cup diced ripe tart apple | 1/4 cup canned diced green peppers | 1/4 cup sweetened condensed milk and molasses, divided | 1/4 cup taco sauce | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | fresh raspberry ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place one of the sliced cheese slices into each of four oven proof crocks, leaving about 1/4 inch of space on each slice of cheese. In a large saucepan, combine 3 teaspoons of the broth, apple, green pepper, milk, molasses, and taco sauce.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,pie crust,celery,chicken stock,liquid smoke,table salt,scallion
title: Chinese Chicken Pie
ingredients: 1 box refrigerated pie crusts, softened as directed on box | 6 cups chicken stock, heated | 2 cups vegetables ( any kind you want, broccoli, bell peppers, and potatoes ) | 1/2 cup low sodium soy sauce ( or tamari ) | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce ( or tamari ) | 2 scallions, sliced, green parts only, sliced into 1/2 inch pieces | 2 teaspoons table salt ( or braggs )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Open pie dough.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,baking apple,hamburger bun,lime,bread,beef broth
title: Red Chili Burgers
ingredients: 2 lbs ground beef ( may sub beef and pork ) | 1 large baking apple, peeled and finely grated | 2/3 cup beef broth | 1 small red chili pepper, seeded and finely chopped | 2 limes, cut into wedges | 8 -10 hamburger buns | crusty bread, for serving
instructions: In a large bowl combine the beef, apple, broth, chili pepper and limes. Mash lightly to combine. Shape into six patties about 6 ¼” in diameter. Brush with oil if using a large frying pan. Cook over medium high heat, turning once, until golden brown on both sides and cooked through. Transfer to a plate. Divide the burger among the bun halves and top with a dollop of sour cream, if using.

title: Radish Salad
ingredients: 8 radishes, trimmed and thinly sliced | sugar syrup
instructions: Prepare the sugar syrup as directed on the side of the recipe. Place the radishes in a serving dish and drizzle with syrup. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,monterey jack pepper cheese,italian tomato,chicken breast fillet,garlic salt,white sugar
title: Italian Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 green bell pepper, sliced thinly | 1/2 medium white bell pepper, sliced thinly | 1 small italian tomatoes, sliced thinly | 2 tablespoons minced garlic salt | 300 g chicken breast fillets, sliced thinly ( boneless, skinless ) | 3 tablespoons white sugar | 1 cup monterey jack pepper cheese
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl, mix well on a pre greased grill. Cook on a preheated grill for 6 minutes only, turn with a spatula and cook until browned. Serve with a green salad and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: amaretto liqueur,chicken soup base,anise seed,maraschino cherry,english cucumber,kidney bean,beef broth
title: French Quarter Beef Salad
ingredients: 2 cups beef broth | 1 can condensed chicken soup base | 4 tablespoons maraschino cherries, chopped | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1 teaspoon amaretto liqueur | 1 small english cucumber, shaved with a vegetable peeler | 1 cup maraschino cherry, halved
instructions: Combine broth, soup base and cherry, in a saucepan,. Heat over medium, until boiling. Reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes to blend flavors. Cover and let sit 30 minutes. Place cucumber, cherries in a bowl of ice water. Remove ice from saucepan and set aside. Blend cucumber mixture with remaining broth. When ready to serve, add reserved cucumber mixture. Chill until ready to serve. Spoon dressing onto a serving platter.

title: Garlicky Vegetarian Goulash
ingredients: 150 g button mushrooms | 300 g white wine | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 2 teaspoons hungarian paprika | 1 can kidney beans
instructions: Slice the mushrooms, white wine, and vanilla into small square pieces, wash and drain the beans, and add these to the meat mixture. Mix well. Add paprika and mix again. Bake the mixture in a skillet till the meat is cooked. Serve over rice, or with some vegetable or meat sauce.

Random Ingredients: white bean,ra el hanout spice mix,mozzarella cheese,veal,cracker
title: Cheese and Lamb Stuffed Whole Roast Veal
ingredients: 1 1/4 kg whole veal, jointed | 6 slices mozzarella cheese | 40 g ra el hanout spice mix | 20 g cracked whole crackers ( optional ) | 80 g white beans
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c. Place a large sheet of plastic wrap on the counter and spread it out so that a thin slice goes all the way to the edge of the wrap. Sprinkle the mozzarella with the ra el hanout. Remove the top layer of plastic wrap.

title: Caribbean Okra Salad
ingredients: 350 g okra, cut into small pieces | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 2 teaspoons dried thyme | 1 head iceberg lettuce, separated | 1/2 cup fresh flat leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: Place okra and bicarb soda into a large bowl, cover with cold water and mix well. Allow to sit for 10 minutes. Add thyme and lettuce to the okra and toss to combine well. Garnish with parsley.

title: Turkish Pockets
ingredients: 1 kg lamb, well trimmed of fat, cubed | 4 teaspoons sweet chili powder | 4 teaspoons salt | 1/4 kg soup bones or 1/4 kg bouillon cubes | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 1/2 bunch spearmint, finely chopped | 100 confectioners'sugar
instructions: Mix together all the wet ingredients, put aside. Heat 4 cups of vegetable oil, in a big pot. When the oil is a little hot put in the dry spices and the meat. Dip each piece of meat in the wet, making sure to get the meat on all sides. Remove meat. Pour enough water to just cover the meat. Bring to the boil. Cover, reduce heat and simmer for around 2 hours. Keep checking to see if the meat is cooked to your liking. If the meat falls of the bones, drain off the liquid and add to the soup. Remove meat and set oven to 150°c. Sprinkle meat with confectioner's sugar when serving.

Random Ingredients: onion salt,guinness stout,red pepper,urad dal,baking powder,cream
title: Guinness Dumpled Saucing
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups guinness stout | 1/2 cup sour cream | 1 cup onion salt, seasoned with salt | 1/2 cup dry adal | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground red pepper
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 2 quart sauce pan and bring to a simmer, stirring constantly. Simmer 10 minutes or until slightly thickened, stirring occasionaately.

title: Taco Seasoning or Addition
ingredients: 1 packet taco seasoning | 1 packet cardamom pods ( with or without pips )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bag or pan with a tight fitting lid. Shake well. Store in a cool dark pantry/skillet to allow the flavors to meld. Use as directed above, for a main dish of your choice.

Random Ingredients: dijon mustard,green pepper,pork loin chop,tomato,reynolds wrap foil,saffron thread
title: Porotos Granados (Pork Wraps With Saffron)
ingredients: 4 boneless pork loin chops, 1/2 pound each | 2 -3 saffron threads | 1 large tomatoes, peeled, seeded, and cut into 12 wedges | 1/4 cup roasted green pepper, from a jar, diced | reynolds wrap foil | 4 teaspoons mustard
instructions: Place pork breasts in a large nonstick fry pan filled with 1/2 cup water. Cover and cook over medium high heat for 7 minutes or until a fork easily pierces them. When cool enough to handle, cut into ½ inch thick slices and set aside. Place tomato wedges on plate and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Preheat broiler. Place one or two slices of pork on a square of reynolds wrap, about 1/2 inch thick. Top with tomato wedges, black raisins, and roasted green peppers. Roll up tightly so as to hold ingredients as tightly as possible without breaking the pork. Broil in a preheated oven for 5 minutes, or until pork is browned and crisp. Serve with dipping sauce.

title: Spicy Kielbasa and Potato Rice
ingredients: 4 large baking potatoes, peeled and cut lengthwise into 1-inch slices | 1 lb kielbasa | 1/2 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves | fresh ground pepper | basmati rice, for serving
instructions: Place potatoes, kielbasa, and cilantro in a skillet over medium low heat and cook until kielbasa is browned and beginning to break down, 5 to 7 minutes. Remove kielbasa to a plate and cover it with foil to keep warm. Stir the rice into the kielbasa mixture and remove the foil. Bake in a preheated 350°f oven until the rice is cooked and the flavors have melded, about 20 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in the pepper. Serve the kielbasa, crumbled topping with the roasted rice.

title: Apricot Dessert Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried apricots | 1/4 cup water chestnut | 1 cup half-and-half
instructions: Soak the apricots in water before using for several hours over night drain. In food processor add the apricots, apricots, and water chestnuts, process for 5 - 10 seconds, then puree until smooth. Add cream and process again until smooth. Serve with your favourite dessert.

title: Greek Yogurt with Roasted Garlic Dressing
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups plain greek yogurt | 20 cloves roasted garlic, rinsed
instructions: Combine yogurt and garlic in a medium bowl. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour. Serve cold.

title: Herbed Red Pepper Sauce for Beef
ingredients: 1 jar roasted red chili peppers, chopped | 1/2 cup mixed fresh herbs, chopped ( thyme, basil, dill or rosemary )
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the roasted red peppers and fresh herbs. Use a brush, spoon or spooning the hot peppers and herbs into a container. Serve with other cuts of beef.

title: A Very Simple Egg Mess
ingredients: 2 egg whites | 1 cup whipping cream | 1/2 cup mushroom, sliced or 1/2 cup spinach | 1/2 cup bamboo shoot, sliced
instructions: Combine egg whites and cream in a bowl and beat with an electric mixer at high speed until stiff peaks form. Fold in mushroom, bamboo, and spinach until well blended. The mixture will look very dry. Divide mixture into 6 portions and place on an ungreased large baking sheet. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate the mixture for 1 hour prior to baking. Preheat oven to 360°f. Bake in the middle of the oven for 45 - 55 minutes, or until golden brown and puffed. Cut into squares when cool enough to handle.

Random Ingredients: coriander seed,coconut oil,taco seasoning mix,cauliflower,rotel tomato
title: Cauliflower Taco Filling
ingredients: 1 cauliflower, cut into florets | 1 can rotel tomatoes, drained | 3/4 cup canola original diced tomatoes | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning mix | 1 teaspoon coriander seed, crushed | 1 tablespoon coconut oil
instructions: In large pot cook cauliflower in a little water with salt, until tender crisp, drain meanwhile, in same pot heat oil on med low. Add taco seasoning and coriander seeds. Cook 1 minute. Combine tomatos and cauliflower mixture, add to skillet. Simmer 5 minutes.

title: Snapper on a Stick
ingredients: 1 kg stewing beef | 2 dozen red snapper, scales removed | 1 tablespoon crushed dried newcastle brown rub ( i use a mix )
instructions: Preheat a grill to medium heat or 200 c degrees f. Rub the beef with crushed newcastle rub. Arrange the snovies around the side and cover with water to about 1/8cm above the fish. Cover. Place in a medium sized, heavy based saucepan. Cover with water, about half way up the fish. Bring to the boil. Boil for about 15 - 20 minutes with the lid slightly ajar, and fish on one side only.. Turn over, cover, and leave to cook for a further 15 - 20 minutes to crisp up the fish. The fish should be completely flaky, just slightly charred on the outside and just opaque when done. Remove the fish and leave to stand covered until cooked and warm. Slice into pieces and serve immediately with a salad.

title: Suet's Escarole and Bacon
ingredients: 1/4 lb suet | 6 cups escarole, shredded | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme sprig | 1/4 cup water | tortilla chips
instructions: Fry suet in a little oil. Add shredded cabbage. Mix water and thyme and put into pan. Cook until tender. Add crumbled bacon. Serve with tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: lime juice,onion,tart apple,large shrimp,romaine lettuce,horseradish cream
title: Spicy Shrimp Cocktail
ingredients: 1 container horseradish cream | 1 lime, juice of | 1/4 cup chopped onion ( optional ) | 2 medium ripe tart apples | 8 large peeled uncooked large shrimp, coarsely chopped | 1 head washed trimmed romaine lettuce
instructions: Place the horseradish cream, lime juice and onion in a medium bowl. Add apples and mix well. Place shrimp in a large shallow glass pan. Mix well and divide among salad bowls. Add shrimp mixture. Serve.

title: Baked Tomatillo Crab
ingredients: 1 pint fresh tomatillo, husked | 1/2 cup blanched almonds, toasted | 1/2 cup golden caster sugar | 1/2 teaspoon gingerroot, grated | 2 teaspoons chili-garlic sauce | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace | 1 lb fresh crabmeat, shell on, peeled, cut into chunks | 3/4 cup frozen peas
instructions: Pre oven to 350 degrees. Combine tomatillos, almonds, sugar, ginger, chile bean sauce and mace in small baking dish. Place in oven and bake for 25 minutes add crab meat and peas.

Random Ingredients: anchovy,grand marnier,baby bok choy,creme fraiche,cooking wine,bean
title: Baked Bean Soup
ingredients: 2 tablespoons creme fraiche, or as needed | 2 tablespoons cooking wine | 2 anchovies, finely chopped | 4 baby bok choy ( optional ) | 1 can diced anchovies | 1 tablespoon grand marnier ( optional ) | 2 cans baked beans, such as cannellini, drained and rinsed ( optional )
instructions: Mix creme fraiche and wine together in a bowl. Gently fold in anchovies. Pour enough creme fraiche mixture into a 3 quart oven safe casserole dish to cover the base. Sprinkle a little grand marnier over the top. Cut bok choy crosswise into 1/4 thick strips and arrange over top of creme fraiche mixture. Sprinkle on anchovies. Cover and bake at 375 degrees f until bok choy is tender and bok choy is translucent, about 45 minutes. Remove cover, scatter with remaining grand marnier, cover and bake an additional 15 minutes.

title: Mongolian Noodles (Lamb, Noodle and Nut Stew)
ingredients: 1/2 lb lean lamb, sliced thin ( or stewing lamb ) | 8 ounces noodles ( i use medium egg noodles ) | 2 tablespoons caster sugar | 2 tablespoons noodles ( i used medium dashi noodles ) | 1 cup boiling water ( to boil noodles ) | 3 eggs, beaten | 1 dash nutmeg | ice cube
instructions: Cut lamb or stewing meat into small cubes. Put the noodles in a large bowl add sugar and knead lightly till they have a consistent texture. Break the noodles up, break up any lumps and add to the noodles. Pour over boiling water. Add beaten eggs and mix well. Add nutmeg. Put in a preheated oven for 15 30min at 250°c. Enjoy with a crisp lettuce, tomato and chinese vegetables..

title: Chinese Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 lb egg noodles, cooked | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained & chopped | 1/2 cup slivered almonds | 1 cup cider vinegar
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Allow the salad to marinate at least 1 hour or overnight.

title: Quick White Bean Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups canned navy beans, drained | 1/4 cup green onion, thinly sliced | 1/3 cup arborio rice or 1/3 cup carnaroli rice | 1 -2 tablespoon liquid honey
instructions: Put all ingredients into a 1 - 2 qt glass baking dish and stir to combine. Bake in a 350 f for 40 - 45 minutes or until rice is tender.

title: Simple Mexican Appetizer Tray by Angels
ingredients: 1 lb fresh peel | 48 ounces of your favorite picante sauce ( i prefer pace picante )
instructions: Place 1 lb peel of 1 firm or floured apple with the peel on a flat surface, flatten slightly so the thickness remains wide enough to cover the apple. Place on your favorite cookie tray that has been lined with wax paper. Spread 1/2 cup of your favorite picante on the peel. Cover with your best saran wrap or aluminum foil. Put your cookie tray into a cold oven on 400 degrees for about one hour or until the peel begins to turn brown and soft. Cut away the wax paper with scissors. Remove your apple from the oven and allow the peel to cool and harden. This can be very hot and can be served over toast or your favorite meal. The peel can also be prepared by microwaving the peel and place it in a plastic freezer bag. After a few moments, remove the peel from freezer and slice in half lengthwise. You don't need to slice it into half or even half again. This will only take a few slices at a time since you are using a whole peeled apple. Place them back in the freezer bag for about an hour or until they are completely cold. Remove peel from freezer. Place in a storage bag and slice up small cubes. Use as desired.

Random Ingredients: pumpkin pie spice,lasagna noodle,safflower oil,orange marmalade,marsala wine,yellow pepper,pecan,garlic powder
title: Pumpkin Salsiccia
ingredients: 1 tablespoon safflower oil | 1/2 cup yellow pepper, diced | 1 teaspoon garlic powder, i use fresh minced garlic | 2 tablespoons marsala wine | 1 packet pumpkin pie spice | 2/3 cup orange marmalade, i use homemade | 16 uncooked lasagna noodles | 1 cup toasted pecans, chopped, i like pecan nuts
instructions: Cook lasagna noodles over medium heat in safflower oil, drain. Immediately add to a greased 9x13 pan. In a small bowl, mix squash spice, marsala, marmalade. Coat squash spice over the noodles.

title: Oat Bran Crusted Beef Tenderloin With Irish Dill Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons beef stock | 1 1/2 tablespoons oat bran | 1 tablespoon beef stock | 16 ounces beef tenderloin, trimmed | 2 ounces rye bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f place the beef tenderloin in a shallow roasting pan or baking tray and top with the oat bran and beef stock. Cook at 400°f for 40 minutes or until the beef feels firm when prodded gently with a skewer. Remove the beef from the oven and turn it over, keeping it rarer in rare, then return the beef to the oven for another 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pork stew meat,plain flour,graham cracker crumb,canadian bacon,tortilla,basil,half
title: Homemade Pork Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg pork stew meat | 1 1/2 cups plain flour, sifted | 10 slices graham cracker crumbs | 1/4 cup fresh basil | 100 ml half-and-half | 100 g canadian bacon, finely chopped | 1 package tortillas
instructions: Place all ingredients in the order listed into the pan. Cook over a low heat stirring occasionally until the meat comes away from the bone, about 20 minutes. Turn off the heat and leave the casserole in the pan to cool. It should then be totally cool away from the oven. Allow to cool completely. To finish, cut tortilla into 1cm slices and lay them on a serving tray lightly covered with a cloth. Brush the tortilla lightly with a little olive oil and roll the tortilla through the tortilla until both sides are wet, pressing lightly to remove the excess moisture. Allow the tortilla to cool slightly. Spray a 9/5cm pie plate with cooking oil spray and line with the torn tortilla. Place the cake on the lined plate and allow to cool for 5 minutes. Sprinkle or crumble the cheesecake with crumb topping. Chill for at least 2 hours before serving. This recipe can be made by roasting a piece of onion in a frying pan at medium heat for 10 - 15 minutes. Turn to cook until the onion is very soft and the onion has begun to turn golden in colour.

title: Sausage Enchilada Meatball Sub (Sausage Alcatra)
ingredients: 3 lbs sausage ( or combination of all three ) | 1 medium yellow onion, halved and sliced | 1 cup red wine | 1/2 cup enchilada sauce ( mild ) | arrowroot ( or cheesecloth to help thicken ) | finely chopped mushroom ( optional )
instructions: Heat up a small pan to medium. Meanwhile brown the sausage and onions until lightly browned, then remove from pan, drain. Set aside. In same pan add wine, and simmer till reduced by half. Stir in the enchilada sauce and arrowroot to desired thickness. Add sausage and onions back to pan, and simmer till it thickens, then remove from heat. Serve over black beans with rice or beans.

Random Ingredients: chicken wing,savoy cabbage,celery salt,honey,curry powder,hot chili sauce
title: Easy Malaysian Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1 package chicken wings | 2 tablespoons sweet chili sauce ( ketjap manis ) | 2 tablespoons habanero hot chili sauce or 2 tablespoons thai hot chili sauce | 2 tablespoons celery salt | 1 tablespoon curry powder | 1 teaspoon savoy cabbage, shredded
instructions: Cut the wings into 2 pieces each and place in a large pot or deep fryer at a medium heat. Heat the chicken wings until tender but not mushy, around 5 minutes.. Mix 1 tablespoons of sweet chili sauce with the honey and mix well. Stir in the rest of the sweet chili sauce or thai chili sauce. Stir in the cilantro. Stir in the cabbage. Cover and let sit for 5 minutes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: french bread,pizza sauce,salt black pepper,pine nut,baguette,mirin
title: French Bread Pizzas
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated pizza sauce | 4 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil | 3 tablespoons mirin ( sweetened soy sauce ) | 1 baguette, cut into 1-inch slices | freshly ground salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1/4 cup pine nuts, lightly toasted
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. Prepare pizza sauce by combining all sauce ingredients in a small saucepan. Bring to boil over medium high heat. Cover and remove from heat. Let cool slightly.
