Preheat grill. Brush oil onto each slice of bread, season with salt and pepper, and place on the preheated grill. Grill for 2 to 3 minutes, turning once, so that both sides of the bread are toasted. Transfer to pizza plates and top with toasted bread.

Random Ingredients: turnip,cream mushroom soup,wild rice,jigger silver tequila,cinnamon,ginger powder,italian tomato
title: Quick and Easy Spanish Stove-Top Indian-Style Wild Rice
ingredients: 1 cup wild rice, uncooked | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup ( or mushroom and onion soup ) | 1/4 cup jigger silver tequila ( optional ) | 4 teaspoons peeled and minced ginger powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/2 cup diced dried italian-style tomatoes | 1/2 cup chopped turnip
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. While rice is cooking, blend soup, tequila, ginger, cinnamon, tomatoes and turnip in small bowl. When rice is done, gently stir in soup mixture and bring to a boil. Cover and bake at 250 degrees for 1 hour, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,baking potato,five spice powder,parsnip,egg white,breadcrumb,brown mustard
title: Spiced Spiced Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs cubed beef stew meat | 2 large baking potatoes, cubed | 2 -3 parsnips, peeled and sliced | 1 egg white, beaten | 1/4 cup plain breadcrumbs | 1/2 teaspoon five-spice powder | 1/4 cup brown mustard
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees fahrenheit. In a large heavy roasting pan combine stew meat, potatoes, parsnips, egg white, bread crumbs, five spice powder, and mustard. Spread evenly over meat mixture. Cover and bake at 250 degrees fahrenheit for 2 - 3 hours or until meat is tender. Serve with mashed potatoes and fresh vegetables.

title: Cranberries Irish Cream
ingredients: 2 lbs cranberries or 2 lbs grapes | 1/2 cup vanilla vodka | 1 cup yogurt, to your liking
instructions: Place cleaned cranberries in a container with a tight fitting lid. Stir in the vodka. Cover and let sit at room temperature for 45 minutes. Stir occasionally. Just before serving, stir in yogurt.

title: Cranberry Shortbread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cake flour ( unbleached ) | 2 cup cranberry ( fresh or frozen ) | 2/3 cup port wine | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a mixing bowl, sift together all dry ingredients. Cut in butter until mixture resembles a small pebbles. Fold cranberries into the flour mixture. On a floured surface, roll out mixture as thinly as possible. Cut out with a heart shaped cookie cutter. Place on a non stick baking pan. Bake at 350 for 20 minutes. When finished, let cool on a wire rack for 5 minutes. Turn out and with a knife, lightly score down the center of the shortbread with a sharp knife. This should make it easier to work with. Store in an airtight container at room temperature for 1 - 2 days before using.

Random Ingredients: peanut butter,corn flake,coffee granule,granny smith apple
title: Peanut Butter Fudge
ingredients: 150 g peanut butter | 150 g granny smith apples or 150 g waupettos apples, pureed | 1 teaspoon instant coffee granules | 2 teaspoons corn flakes, ground ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients, in a pan and mix very fast. Pour into a greased loaf pan or a deep 2 litre tin. Flatten down and smooth out with an electric mixer. Keep in the refrigerator until ready to serve.

title: Bean, Parsnip and Noodle Soup
ingredients: 1 package dried rice noodles | 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 1 cup fresh parsnip, diced | 1/4 cup italian parsley, chopped | 1/4 cup rum or rum flavored cocktail schnapps | crushed new potatoes, for garnish
instructions: Bring 4 quarts water with salt to a boil. Cook the rice noodles according to package directions. Drain, rinse with cold water, drain again and cut into 1 inch pieces. In a large saucepan over medium heat, combine the beans, parsnips and rum and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 10 minutes. Stir in the noodles until heated through. Add the parsley and serve.

title: Nif's Date and Meatball Soup
ingredients: 1 package farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 2 cups beef broth | 6 egg yolks | 1 cup white sugar | 2 dates, pitted and chopped
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook pasta in boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain. Place farfalle in a large pot with enough hot water to cover.

Random Ingredients: milk ricotta cheese,confectioner sugar,yellow pepper,hollandaise sauce,flour,brown sugar
title: Hollandaise Sauce for Dessert
ingredients: 1 package whole milk ricotta cheese | 1 cup confectioners'sugar | 1/3 cup confectioners'sugar for dusting | 1/3 cup flour | 2 tablespoons hollandaise sauce | 1/4 cup sliced yellow pepper, or to taste | 1 teaspoon butter ( optional )
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine ricotta cheese, 1 cup confectioners' sugar, flour, hollandaise sauce, and yellow pepper.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,mace,seltzer water,green salsa,jumbo shrimp,horseradish,russet potato,cayenne pepper sauce
title: Gourmet Shrimp and Potato Salad
ingredients: 3 jumbo shrimp, cooked and deveined | 3 large russet potatoes, peeled and diced | 1/3 cup green salsa | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish, drained ( bottled is fine ) | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper sauce | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace | 1/2 cup bottled seltzer water
instructions: Combine shrimp, potatoes and salsa in a large bowl. In a small bowl, combine remaining ingredients, whisking to mix. Pour dressing over shrimp mixture, toss lightly to coat. Cover and chill salad for at least one hour. Serve shrimp salad cold or at room temperature.

title: Tamari Chicken (Korean)
ingredients: 1/2 kg chicken meat ( kimchi bonuk ) | 2 t tamari
instructions: Place the kimchi on a large sheet of aluminum foil. Bake at 400 f for 20 to 30 minutes. Remove the sheets from the oven and discard the foil. Place the kimchi around the edge of the foil. Pinch the sides of the foil close, using the edges to make a tight package. Place 2 cups of water and 2 tablespoons of tamari in a medium saucepan and bring to a boil. Boil for 10 minutes, watching for the tamari to soften. Remove the tomato packages from the tamari and discard. Drain the tamari from the water and place in a deep bowl. Chop the meat finely. Pour the tamari onto the kimchi, ensuring all the meat is covered and set aside. Serve warm with green onion rings.

title: Rice and Potato Salad With Savoy Coleslaw
ingredients: 1/2 savoy cabbage ( cored and shredded ) | 1/4 cup chives ( thinly sliced ) | 8 ounces glutinous rice ( jasmine works great ) | 1 small potato traditional ( optional )
instructions: Cook jasmine rice according to package directions. Drain rice and rinse with cold water to soak, then drain again. Mix with cabbage to thoroughly coat. Put potato traditional and chives in a bowl and toss with rice. Top with savoy cabbage.

title: Art With Arugula on Cheese and Arugula (Arugula)
ingredients: 1 lb bagged arugula | 4 slices american cheese
instructions: Toast arugula, then rub with a good quality butter knife. Remove the arugula, top with 1 slice of cheese and spread on toasted arugula. Note, arugula can be stored in air tight container in the fridge for up to 3 days.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,pistachio nut,rye bread,mussel,orange peel
title: Bread and Butter Prawns With Pistachio Caramelized Ree
ingredients: 60 g self-rising flour | 40 g butter | 40 g sliced orange peel | 40 g mussels, cleaned and debearded | 80 g pistachio nuts, roughly chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees celsius. Place flour in a large mixing bowl. With fingertips mix in butter. Using a rolling pin, gently gently press the butter into the flour until it looks like coarse breadcrumbs. Add orange peel & mussels to the mixture & work it into the breadcrumbs with a wooden spoon to thoroughly combine everything. Shape the mixture into 40 large balls. Place on an oven tray & bake for 30 minutes or until they are golden brown, turning once.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,flat leaf parsley,anchovy,red wine,broccoli,snow pea,blackberry,italian parsley
title: Grilled Salmon on a Berry
ingredients: 1 head broccoli, cut into bite-sized pieces | 16 leaves fresh italian parsley | 16 snow peas, washed and split in half | 16 leaves fresh french haricots vert or 16 swiss sprouts, washed and spun dry | 24 blackberries | 16 anchovies, drained | 1 bottle red wine | 2 tablespoons dark rum or 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 1/4 cup chopped fresh flat leaf parsley
instructions: Prepare the grill to medium high heat. Grill the broccoli, italian parsley, snow peas, haricots vert, blackberries, anchovies and wine until the fruit are soft, about 12 minutes. Turn the salmon and season with salt and pepper. Garnish with a few berries. Serve directly from the grill.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,red salmon,campbell tomato soup,pineapple tidbit,chili garlic sauce
title: Mexican Fish
ingredients: 1 can red salmon, drained | 1 can campbell tomato soup | 1 can pineapple tidbits, drained | 1 yellow bell pepper, chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili-garlic sauce
instructions: Mix tomatoes soup, juice from pineapple and tomato soup. Fold in salmon. Heat and serve over tortilla chips. Garnish with pineapple rings.

Random Ingredients: black tea,hot water,sazon goya seasoning,self raising flour
title: Pizza Crackers
ingredients: 1 cup self raising flour | 1/2 cup hot water | 1 packet sazon goya seasoning | 1 cup tea, chilled
instructions: Cream together the sazon goya and the warm water. Add to the mix the self raising flour. Roll out on a lightly floured surface. Cut while working with floured fingers. Place on pizza tray lined with buttered baking paper. Score a cross in the top with a sharp knife. Spread with teabags or spray with oil. Bake at 190c for approximately 15min.

title: Achiote-Date Pasta With Grape and Zucchini
ingredients: 1 lb fresh penne pasta | 1 1/2 lbs zucchini, ends trimmed and sliced into rounds about 2 x 1-1/4-inch | 1/3 cup all-purpose flour | 1 3/4 teaspoons dried sage leaves | 1 tablespoon achiote paste | 1/2 cup pitted dates, 1 cut each date into 8 wedges | 2 teaspoons coarsely chopped gephardt-style tzatziki
instructions: Cook the pasta following package directions and drain. Meanwhile, in a large saucepan of boiling water, blanch the zucchini slices 3 to 5 seconds, then drain in a colander. Add the zucchini slices to the pasta and simmer until crisp tender and cooked through, approx 8 minute toss in the flour to thicken then gently toss in the sage. Sauté the zucchini slices in a bit of achiote paste until slightly browned, add to the pasta and mix. Top with pitted dates and tzatziki.

title: Chilli-Lavender Colcannon
ingredients: 2 1/2 tablespoons gluten-free prepared grainy mustard | 2 1/2 tablespoons dried lindt chives ( or 2 1/2 tbsp stalks of green ) | 2 1/2 teaspoons coarsely ground almonds | 1 2/3 cups desiccated coconut | 1/4 cup fresh lovage (, leaves from 2 fresh lovage ) or 1/4 cup savory leaves ( or 1/4 cup savory leaves ) | 1/4 teaspoon chili flakes | 1 pinch allspice berries
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f spread mustard out on a baking paper lined cookie sheet. Bake until grainy mustard is toasted, stirring often, about 5 minutes. Combine almonds, coconut, lovage leaves, chilli flakes and allspice in a processor or food processor and process into ground paste. Toast slighly under broiler until golden, about 6 minutes. Transfer to a medium bowl. Increase oven temperature to 450f and bake until brown, about 7 minutes. Cool before cutting.

Random Ingredients: maple syrup,dark corn syrup,porcini mushroom,eggplant,spice,bulk italian sausage
title: Stuffed Eggplant Boats (With or Without Maple Syrup)
ingredients: 1 eggplant, medium size, washed, unpeeled, cut lengthwise into 3/8-inch slices | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 12 whole porcini mushrooms | 1/2 cup dark corn syrup | 2 tablespoons hot spice ( sage, rosemary, cloves, crushed red pepper flakes, poultry seasoning or marjoram ) | 1 lb bulk italian sausage
instructions: Place 1/3 of the sausages in the eggplant slices, making sure the slices are evenly spaced throughout the stuffing. Place 1 slice of the sausage around the stuffing, covering the sausage completely. Place 2 porcini mushrooms in the middle of the sausage. Place 2 more slices in the next row. Top off the mushrooms with the remaining sausage, then place on top of the sausages and porcini mushrooms. Set this stuffing in a dutch oven over medium high heat. Make sure the pot is large enough to hold all the pieces and the stuffing to fit easily. Stir the sausage pieces about so they are not crowded. You can do this by making a vertical crumble along the loaf of stuffing into the pot.

title: Homemade Egg Noodles
ingredients: 3 tablespoons egg whites | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 pinch kosher salt | 1 lb boneless pork ribs, cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes | 15 ounces egg noodles | 1/2 cup capers, drained
instructions: In a small dish, using a whisk, thoroughly beat egg whites with ground nutmeg and salt until stiff peaks form. Stir in pork cubes until well coated and let stand at room temperature for 1 hour. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add egg noodles, and cook until tender. Drain, and toss noodles with capers until evenly coated, about 6 minutes.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,bean pork,bread crumb,gorgonzola,chocolate chip,confectioner ' sugar
title: Wild Gorgonzola (chocolate Stuffed Mushrooms)
ingredients: 20 button mushrooms | 1 quart soft bread crumbs | 1 cup gorgonzola, crumbled finely | 16 ounces soft whole-milk chocolate chips | confectioners'sugar | 1 tablespoon confectioners'sugar
instructions: Rinse mushrooms and dry with paper towels. Sprinkle inside of mushroom caps with gorgonzola cheese. Place a mushroom cap on a plate. Top with a layer of crumbs and a tablespoon of chocolate chips. Repeat for remaining four mushrooms. Dust with a little confectioners' sugar and serve.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,yellow onion,fruit,chili sauce,spaghetti sauce,cayenne,serrano pepper
title: Baked Spaghetti Meatballs in Sweet Chili Sauce
ingredients: 1 package spaghetti sauce | 1/4 cup chopped yellow onion | 1 tablespoon chopped chili sauce | 1 tablespoon coriander powder | 1 serrano pepper, chopped | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon cayenne, to taste | 1/2 cup dried fruit
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Combine all ingredients except fruit, cover and refrigerate several hours. Roll meat in fruit and set aside for 1 hour. Bake at 400 degrees f for 30 minutes.

title: Lentils with Nuts and Quick-cooking spray (Tabil-Tassoun (Lentils with Nuts)
ingredients: 1/2 cup brown lentils | cooking spray
instructions: Remove rinsed and dried lentils and place on a paper towel to dry and drain excess water. Cover and place a heavy, nonstick skillet over medium high heat. When it’s very hot, add cooking spray spray. When it’s hot, add brown lentils in a single layer and stir to coat with the spray. Serve lentils topped with a sprinkling of salt.

Random Ingredients: maple syrup,sun tomato oil,grand marnier,green asparagus,bean sprout
title: Stir Fry-Invented Maple and Asparagus
ingredients: 5 tablespoons maple syrup | 10 green asparagus | 8 sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drain on paper towels, reserve the oil and cut into thin strips | 1 1/2 tablespoons grand marnier ( recommended ( or to taste ) or 1 1/2 tablespoons orange liqueur ( recommended ( or to taste ) | 8 ounces bean sprouts
instructions: Using a deep fryer or large saucepan, melt the maple syrup slowly on medium low heat. Do not let it boil. Carefully separate the asparagus from the stalk parts and set aside to drain for 10 minutes. Slice each stalk lengthwise on the stem side. Set aside while you continue. Slice the asparagus into one inch pieces. Combine the remaining 4 tablespoons of marnier, grand marnier and 2 teaspoons of garlic flavored oil and set aside. Add the asparagus to the saucepan and stir fry for about 2 minutes. Remove immediately and add the maple syrup mixture to the asparagus and stir fry until everything is well mixed. Stir in the sun dried tomatoes and top with bean sprouts.

Random Ingredients: cannellini bean,simple syrup,no boil lasagna noodle,prosciutto
title: Pasta With No-Bean Cannellini Beans
ingredients: 15 no-boil lasagna noodles | 1/4 lb prosciutto | 29 ounces cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 cup simple syrup
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Lay out half of the lasagna noodle and spread evenly. Layer half of the beans. Layer the other half of the noodles. Put the prosciutto on top and spread evenly. Sprinkle remaining veggies on top and bake for 20 minutes. Let it sit for 5 minutes and cut into slices and serve.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,rigatoni pasta,chocolate chip,cardamom pod,cream tartar,peach brandy,cocoa
title: Cocoa Chantilly Cheesecake Pasta With Peaches
ingredients: 5 ounces fresh rigatoni pasta, uncooked | 3 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa | 1/4 cup chipotles in light rum or 1/4 cup brandy | 1/4 cup peachy brandy | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom pod | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 2 large peeled and sliced peaches, about 1 cup, about 2 cups., well drained on paper towels
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f lightly butter a 9 inch springform or loose bottomed tart round pan with a removable bottom with removable bottom.

Random Ingredients: quinoa,mint leaf,beef stock,mandarin orange segment,rice wine
title: Mandarin-Orange Quinoa Soup
ingredients: 16 ounces mandarin orange segments, drained ( reserve liquid ) | 2 quinoa, rinsed | 1 liter beef stock | 2 tablespoons of fresh mint leaves, chopped ( reserve half half of the leaves ) | 2 teaspoons rice wine
instructions: Place orange juice, reserved orange juice, rice wine and reserved mandarin orange segments in the large stock pot. Simmer for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, soak rinsed quinoa in water according to package instructions. Drain, rinse with cold water and drain again to remove excess water. Place rinsed quinoa in blender and pour in boiling beef stock. Blend at low speed, add mint and half of the reserved mandarin orange slices. Slowly pour in the reserved mandarin orange segments and add enough reserved mandarin orange liquid to yield this soup. Blend for 5 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Lobster tail
ingredients: 24 small white-fillet fresh lobster tails | 3 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 3 1/2 teaspoons chopped italian parsley
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Add the sesame oil and shrimp. Add the tail meat. Mix lightly with a fork. Cook about 5 minutes, turning the crab meat so it cooks evenly. Sprinkle with parsley if desired.

Random Ingredients: rigatoni pasta,green cabbage,corn tortilla chip,lamb chop,rice noodle,american cheese,vinaigrette
title: Lamb Chops With Lazy Rice Noodles & Blankets
ingredients: 12 ounces lamb chops, 1/2 '' thick | 2 1/4 cups green cabbage, sliced thinly | 8 8-inch corn tortillas or 8 -12 inch whole wheat tortillas, 6-inch x 4-inch | 4 ounces white american cheese or 4 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, halved | 1/2 cup vinaigrette | cooked rigatoni pasta or other small-to-mushroom flavored pasta ( 8 - 9 ounces ) | cooked rice noodles or other tiny-to-mushroom flavored pasta, such as linguine
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees. Butterfly lamb chops lengthwise in half crosswise. Place half the lamb chops on one side of a large piece of foil, add 1/2 cup each of cabbage, tortillas and cheese to the other half of foil and wrap tightly in foil. Place the two sandwiches, side by side on a baking sheet and bake until casserole is hot and meat is well browned, stirring half way through. During the last 30 seconds of baking, add remaining cabbage, tortillas and cheese and bake for 2 to 3 minutes longer, just until cheese is melted.

title: Lentils and Brown Rice With Lemon
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups green lentils | 1 tablespoon lemon peel | 1 tablespoon chili paste | 1 3/4 cups arborio rice ( short or medium-grain )
instructions: Add lentils, lemon peel, and chili paste to rice cooker. Add water and rice. Cover and turn on to cook. When done, fluff rice with fork.

title: Chile Tampiquoo
ingredients: 12 bamboo skewers, soaked in water for 30 minutes | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Soak bamboo skewers in hot water for 10 minutes. Drain. Heat a skillet over medium high heat. Mix in cream of tartar. Dip soaked bamboo skewers in cream and return to skillet. Cook until lightly browned and firm, 3 to 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,garlic,hard egg,plain flour,shiitake mushroom,cardamom pod,apricot,parmesan cheese
title: Mushroom and Apricot Cheese Ball
ingredients: 2 ounces pate grana padano cheese | 6 ounces cream cheese | 6 ounces chopped apricots | 1/2 cup shiitake mushroom | 1 teaspoon minced garlic | 1 teaspoon cardamom pod | 1/2 cup plain flour, gluten free | 1/4 cup parmesan cheese | 1 hard-boiled egg
instructions: Process all ingredients except the egg until smooth. Dough, preheat oven to 450°f. Roll 2/3's to 3/4's of the dough into a ball, or line a 12” by 10” tart dish with parchment paper. Use 2 teaspoons of dough per mushroom if desired. Place ball onto the parchment paper. Sprinkle on the remaining 1/3 cup of flour, and sprinkle cheese on top and around the sides. Fold parchment to fit. Prick the top and sides with a fork. Place in oven. Bake for 25 minutes, or until lightly browned and bubbly. Remove from oven and let rest for 5 minutes before removing from pan. Serve with a scoop of your favourite ice cream, or a green salad.

Random Ingredients: tequila,asparagus,chili paste garlic,baking soda,brandy,white wine,texas bean salsa,coriander seed
title: Baja Style Chili Beans
ingredients: 1 can white beans in salsa ( can use yellow and limo beans ) | 1 cup crushed texas bean salsa | 1/2 cup brandy | 3 tablespoons tequila | 1 tablespoon chili paste with garlic | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 teaspoon coriander seed | 1/2 teaspoon crushed dried coriander seeds
instructions: Empty contents of the 3 cans of the beans into a mixing bowl and mash. Mix crushed coriander in with the brandy and set aside. Mix tequila, chili paste with garlic, baking soda and the remaining ingredients in a mixing bowl and set aside. Heat a grill pan to medium high heat. When hot, add pepper to taste and sear the pepper until slightly charred and aromatic. Add the brandy mixture to the pan, and stir. Turn heat to medium and allow to simmer. Do not cook until the majority of the liquid evaporates, but the pepper will still be strong. This will take about 20 minutes and it does burn easily. Serve hot.

title: Pear and Bok Choy Sushi
ingredients: 2 cups sushi rice | 1 pckg. pear, cut into 8 chunks | 1/4-inch piece bok choy, thinly sliced | 1 package pecan halves, cut in half
instructions: Combine water and rice in a large skillet. Bring to a boil.

title: Fruit and Marsala Krispy Marsala
ingredients: 1 packet rice krispies | 2 tablespoons marsala wine | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped dried apricots
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees celsius. Line baking trays with baking paper. Break krispies into 6 equal pieces place on tray and bake for 5 minutes. Remove from oven, mix in marsala to coat and sprinkle over apricots. Return to oven and bake for 30 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes for even browning.

Random Ingredients: celery seed,green cardamom pod,horseradish,dark rum,cremini mushroom,lard
title: Flammeaux
ingredients: 2 lbs cremini mushrooms | 16 ounces dark rum | 1/2 cup prepared horseradish | 2 ounces light lard | 2 green cardamom pods | 3 tablespoons ground celery seed ( optional )
instructions: Wipe mushrooms and remove stems, and discard. Cut into quarters, discard tough stems. Trim mushrooms if using regular mushrooms. Cut into quarters and set aside. Melt lard in large saute pan. Add mushrooms, cardamom pods, celery seed and a dash of dark rum. Cover and saute gently over medium low heat about 10 minutes. When mushrooms are soft, remove mushrooms to bowl and keep warm. Add prepared horseradish to pan and cook about 4 minutes, or until horseradish is dark and smooth. Strain juices from pan into pan. Pour liquid over mushrooms and cook uncovered over low heat until liquid evaporates and mushrooms are sauteed lightly, stirring often, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: fennel seed,collard green,chocolate chip,kielbasa,chicken stock this essential,chipotle chile
title: Hot Chocolate Chowder
ingredients: 1 cup shredded collard greens | 1/2 cup chopped kielbasa ( about 1/2 a link ) | 1/2 cup chopped chipotle chile | 1/4 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 tablespoon chicken stock ( this essential, see note below ) | 1/2 cup chocolate chips
instructions: In bowl toss collards, sausage, chiles, and fennel well. Add the chicken stock and chocolate chips.

Random Ingredients: broth,dark soy sauce,red potato,vanilla sugar,onion powder
title: Sweet Potato Simmered in Broth and Onions
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs red potatoes, peeled and cut into wedges seperately | 1 can low sodium broth | 1 tablespoon onion powder | 1 tablespoon vanilla sugar
instructions: Place the potatoes in a large saucepan and cover with cold.  water. Simmer, covered, about 30 minutes, or until just tender. Place the broth in a saucepan. Drain the potatoes, reserving the broth in the pot. Discard the liquid, returning the potatoes to the pan and mash them until a smooth potato mixture forms. Add soy sauce, onion powder, and sugar to the potatoes. Stir to combine. Serve.

title: Crock Pot Southwest-Style Pot Roast and Beans
ingredients: 1 large lard, at room temperature ( such as crisco ) | 3 -4 lbs beef brisket | 1 can pink beans or ( 16 ounce ) can dark kidney beans, undrained | 2 cups frozen corn, thawed | 1 envelope taco seasoning, divided | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano, divided | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour
instructions: Using a sharp knife, cut slits in brisket lengthwise down the center, not cutting all the way to the bottom. Insert slivers of lard into each slit. Insert 2 tablespoons of beans, corn, seasoning, and 1/2 teaspoon oregano into each slit. Place brisket into crock pot. Cover and cook on low for 7 hours, or until meat is tender and no longer pink inside. Remove meat from crock pot, place on a serving dish, cover with foil, and keep warm. Strain juices from crock pot into a saucepan, and skim off the fat. Cook until reduced to about half its original amount, about 20 minutes. Taste and adjust seasoning. Serve broth over slices of hot cooked white rice.

title: Quick Barbecue Apricot Jam Spread
ingredients: 4 tablespoons apricot jam | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons dried fruit or 2 tablespoons fresh apricots, chopped | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke, or to taste
instructions: Place apricot jam, soy sauce, fruit, and liquid smoke in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,chinese five spice powder,green apple,red chilies
title: Chinese Five-Spice Apples
ingredients: 6 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil, or more if needed | 1 teaspoon chinese five-spice powder | 1 teaspoon finely chopped red chilies | 1 large green apple, such as granny smith
instructions: Heat 3 tablespoons olive oil in a skillet over low heat, stirring occasionally until oil shimmers, but do not allow oil to smoke. Cook about 1 to 2 minutes. Add 1 teaspoon five spice powder and stir. Shake skillet to mix, then pour in 5 tablespoons warm oil. Stir in chilies until well combined. Peel and core apple, then cut into quarters. Stir apple, chile oil, and green apple into hot oil.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,chicken breast fillet,harissa,golden syrup,garlic clove,cumin seed,garlic powder
title: Tunisian Chicken (Dairy Free)
ingredients: 4 chicken breast fillets | 1 ounce harissa | 2 tablespoons heavy cream | 2 garlic cloves, crushed | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin seed | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Mix ingredients together till garlic powder is pulverized.

title: Indian Chilie Paste
ingredients: 1 lb yellow onion, minced well | 1/2 cup scallion, minced well | 3 tablespoons garam masala powder | 3 -6 chiles, minced ( cayenne, habanero, serrano or jalapeno depending on how hot you like it ) | 1/2 teaspoon accent seasoning
instructions: Place all ingredients in a food processor or blender and blend until smooth. Place in a dry pan and toast in a 350 degree oven till light brown. You may also use a mortar and pestle to chop things up, like chocolates, sago, etc.

title: Fondue (Rutabaga - Rutabaga)
ingredients: 2 teaspoons sunflower oil ( or vegetable oil ) | 2 cups peeled rutabagas | 1 grape tomatoes, halved
instructions: Heat the sunflower oil in a large frying pan. Add the rutabaga and tomatoes, and fry on a low/medium heat for about 2 minutes. Pour over the fondue and serve immediately.

title: Warm Chocolate and Asparagus Salad
ingredients: 1 cup low-fat stewed tomatoes with juice | 16 ounces fresh asparagus, trimmed | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa | 2 -3 teaspoons prepared mustard seeds | 8 ounces dark chocolate, chopped | 1/3 cup amaretto | 1 lime peel, rind of ( optional )
instructions: Bring the tomatoes and asparagus to a boil in a pot over medium heat. Cover and remove from heat. Let stand for 10 to 15 minutes, or until the asparagus is crisp tender. Drain and cool under cold running water. Peel the asparagus and slice into 2 inch lengths. Blanch the asparagus in boiling water for 2 to 3 minutes, then peel. Melt the chocolate and 1/3 cup amaretto in a double boiler, or in a food processor. Stir to blend. Remove the asparagus from the pot with a slotted spoon or slotted spoon and set it aside to cool. Reserve any remaining asparagus. When the chocolate is cool, whisk the mixture into the reserved asparagus and tomato mixture. Scoop heaping tablespoons of the chocolate sauce onto a large plate and sprinkle with the lime peel. Place the asparagus on top of the lime sauce, or serve at room temperature.

title: Beef Fritters (Oamc)
ingredients: 20 ounces top quality chicken bouillon | 1 cup dried breadcrumbs | 1/4 teaspoon ginger | 1 tablespoon powdered guacamole | 1 tablespoon powdered instant chicken bouillon | 1 lb ground chuck ( preferably lean ) | 2 large yukon gold potatoes ( about 2 pounds ) | 1 large pear ( about 1 pound ) | 1 frozen dough round, thawed ( optional )
instructions: Cook beef in skillet until browned, crumbling with fork. Mix beef, potatoes and pear in a large bowl. Stir 1 cup water with bouillon into beef mixture. Set aside. Place dough between two pieces of plastic wrap. Flatten dough into a circle about 1 inch thick and 2 inches wide. Place 1/2 cup beef mixture at cut edge of dough round on ungreased baking sheet. Fold dough over and press out any air. Top with remaining mixture and seal edges. Spray tops of fritters with cooking spray and bake in a preheated 450 f oven until dough is puffed and golden, about 15 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Mexican Chili Oil
ingredients: 1 cup olive oil | 1 teaspoon chili powder
instructions: Mix together, and store in a tightly closed container until ready to use.

title: Fenugreek Beans
ingredients: 1 lb dried cannellini beans or 1 lb other small white beans, such as great northern | 4 teaspoons fenugreek leaves | 1/2 cup lightly packed dried fenugreek leaves
instructions: Sort and wash the beans.

title: Champiñones Con Fontina
ingredients: 1 cup grated fontina ( white cheese ) | 1/2 cup grated fontina ( white cheese ) | 2 serrano chilies, seeded and chopped
instructions: Preheat a skillet or griddle over medium high heat. In a small bowl, mix 1 cup fontina with the chiles. Spread the remaining 1/2 cup fontina mixture thinly with a spatula. Place 1/2 cup fontina on a plate. Place 2 or 3 tablespoons of the grated fontina on top. Cook until brown, 1 to 2 minutes. Flip the fontina and cook until the second side is browned more, about 2 minutes. Repeat to make 4 more vol au vent holes in the griddle. Slide grilled cheese into the skillet and top with the remaining 1/2 cup grated fontina. Place under the broiler until cheese is browned and bubbly, 2 to 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,beef tenderloin,green cardamom,date,cardamom pod,chicken wing,cajun seasoning
title: Crispy Chicken on Bamboo Sticks With Dates (Yum Yum)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dates, pitted cut into 2-3 inch pieces | 1 kg beef tenderloin | 100 -150 g green cardamoms | 2 teaspoons whole cardamom pods | 1 1/2 teaspoons cajun seasoning ( or to taste ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla extract ( or to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom ( or to taste )
instructions: Cut strips about 2cm wide on the side of the beef. Trim away as much fat as possible of the meat, and reserve the meat. Score the top of meat with a criss cross. In a small bowl, combine cardamom and cardamom pods. Sprinkle spices over the meat using the back of a knife. Add the date pieces to the spices, toss well, then place each piece of meat on a piece of kitchen paper. Set aside. Wrap the ends of the string around the meat to form a loose packet. Put in the fridge, turning the tray occasionally, at least 6 hours or overnight. It will take about 4 hours, but will probably take somewhere between 3 hours and 4 hours for a packet. When ready to cook, rinse out the meat and place on to a rack over a tray with the meat. Cook in a preheated 325f oven for 30 - 40 minutes, or until meat is browned slightly. Remove from oven, let cool slightly, and serve. Variation 1, the date chicken will be grilled in a casserole. The original recipe says to leave the meat on the bone. Variation 2, use the date sticks instead of wooden sticks.

Random Ingredients: chuck,pineapple chunk,stewing beef,kosher salt,active yeast,amaretto liqueur,rice
title: Caribbean Beef
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef | 1 tablespoon active dry yeast | 1 1/2 tablespoons amaretto liqueur | 2 tablespoons amaretto liqueur | 10 ounces pork shoulder or 10 ounces beef tenderloin, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 1 1/2 cups rice, hot, cooked
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in 3/4 cup of warm water. Place roast in a 2 gallon zipper bag. Add the 3 tablespoons of amaretto liqueur and salt. Seal and let sit 10 minutes. Pour out the liquid and sprinkle the yeast mixture over top. Turn roast and coat all sides with the remaining 1 1/2 tablespoons amaretto and 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt. Cover and let stand 1 hour in a warm location. Rinse and drain the meat and pat dry with paper towels. Turn oven to 300 degrees f and place the beef and vegetables in the middle of the oven. Bake 1 1/2 1 1/2 hours, checking for doneness periodically. To serve, place rice on a platter and top with meat dish.

title: Jamaican-Style Clam Sauce
ingredients: 4 cups clam juice | 1/2 cup light sesame soya sauce | 1/4 cup dark rum ( i prefer malibu ) | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh thyme | 1 teaspoon cardamom seeds
instructions: In a medium saucepan, heat the clam juice, sesame tamari, dark rum, and cilantro. Add thyme, cardamom, and remaining ingredients. Cover and simmer for 10 - 15 minutes. Serve over your favourite warm fish.

title: Pasta With Indian Steamed Mussels
ingredients: 5 large fresh mussels, scrubbed | 1 green pepper, sliced thinly | 1/2 cup creme fraiche or 1/2 cup greek yogurt | 1/4 cup golden syrup ( or use honey ) | 6 ounces farfalle pasta
instructions: Steam the mussels until they open. Remove from pot and set aside. Discard the top shell of the mussels by placing them in a bowl with plenty of cold water to cover. Remove the hairy shells of the mussels. Discard the top shell and discard them with a spoon. Slice the green pepper thinly. In a large pot of boiling salted water, cook the farfalle for 5 minutes or until just done. Drain and place a generous cup of warm water on to keep them from sticking together. Heat the creme fraiche in a small saucepan, and add the mussels, green pepper and golden syrup or honey. Bring to a boil and simmer over a low heat for 5 minutes.

title: Onion Salad
ingredients: 1 cup minced onion | 1 1/2 cups crushed italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons minced fresh tarragon | 1 tablespoon minced fresh dill
instructions: In a bowl, combine the onions, bread crumbs, tarragon and dill.

Random Ingredients: orange muscat wine,corn tortilla,cherry,green onion,kalamata olive,plain flour
title: Prawn and Cherry Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons plain flour | 2 tablespoons sour orange muscat wine | 500 g prawns ( in shells ) | 125 g kalamata olives, pitted and coarsely chopped | 1 bunch green onion, sliced into 2 cm segments | 310 g pitted kalamata olives, halved | 310 g fresh cherries, pitted
instructions: Combine flour and wine in a wide frying pan and stir over low heat until mixture thickens slightly. Add prawns and cook on medium high, turning occasionally, for 3 minutes. Stir in pitted, sliced olives, sliced green onion and halved cherries. Serve immediately.

title: Cheesy Cracker Crumbs
ingredients: 3 cups shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350. In a large bowl, mix cheese and graham cracker crumbs. Stir cheese crumbs into cheese mixture until well combined. Turn mixture into buttered casserole dish. Bake 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: panko breadcrumb,kaffir lime leaf,hot sauce,vegetable oil,mexican cheese,spaghetti
title: Grilled Cheese Baked With Spaghetti
ingredients: olive oil | spaghetti, cooked as directed | kaffir lime leaf ( or 1 tablespoon lime zest ) | spaghetti-cooked as directed | shredded mexican cheese | panko breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat grill to 400 degrees. Lightly oil grates. Combine spaghetti, kaffir lime zest, lime juice and shredded cheese. Put about 1/3 cup of mixture on each piece of cheese. Brush with panko. If making for company, place spaghetti pieces on grill, close to light grill and grill for 1 to 2 minutes on each side until desired level of doneness, or just an internal smoke point. When done, turn pieces over and top with remaining cheese. Close grill and close lid and allow cheese to melt while cooking. Serve on bed of spaghetti with salsa for dipping. Tips. For grill, place a little of the spaghetti/spaghetti liquid on the grates and brush and flip the dish a few times and rotating the pan for even grilling.

title: Cheese & Egg White Spread
ingredients: 1/2 lb mexican blend cheese, grated | 1 large egg white | 1/2 cup gin ( optional )
instructions: Place egg white in blender with cheese.

Random Ingredients: celery,beef broth,beer,brown button mushroom,soymilk,green chili pepper
title: Wild Mushroom
ingredients: 1 lb beef broth | 1 lb brown button mushroom, sliced | 1 can chopped green chili peppers | 1/4 cup soy milk | 1/2 cup beer ( any colour ) | 1 stalk celery, chopped
instructions: Simmer broth for 15 minutes and remove from heat. In a large baking dish, add mushrooms, chilies, soy milk and beer. Cover and bake for 1 1/2 hour at 475°f until mushrooms are tender and liquid has reduced slightly. Top with fresh herbs, if you wish.

Random Ingredients: guava juice,pinto bean,farfalle pasta,cider vinegar,cream corn
title: Pasta con guilanto (Pasta Salad)
ingredients: 1 pound dried pinto beans | 1 can cream-style corn | 3 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 can guava juice | 1 package farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pinto beans, and cook until tender but still firm to the bite, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: black peppercorn,corn,parchment paper,romaine lettuce heart,sherry wine
title: French Wedge and Wrapped Onions on Parchment Paper
ingredients: 1/2 cup sherry wine | 1/2 teaspoon black peppercorns or 1/2 teaspoon black peppercorns, cracked | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs rainbow lettuce hearts, in single-leaf pieces | 2 -3 romaaine lettuce hearts, in single-leaf pieces | 1 package parchment paper
instructions: In a jar with a lid, add sherry, peppercorns, and 1 lettuce head. Cover and let cool to lukewarm. Wash outside of the paper with a moist cloth and cut into 4 squares or wedges. Place on a greased or parchment paper lined cookie sheet, allowing space for spread. To assemble, arrange a piece of romaine heart on top of each piece of lettuce/onion and then wrap the paper over the ingredients of the bundle. Place one whole or two pieces of romaine/onion into the bottom of each parchment paper square. Drizzle w/spice mixture from package. Cover and let sit 5 - 10 minutes on a cookie sheet. Remove the parchment paper and unwrap bundles. With your fingers, press the pieces of parchment away from the bundles and stack them in a row on top of each other. Using the parchment paper stack to hold, firmly hold the packages and wrap the bundles back up back in the parchment paper. Repeat steps 8 - 9 until the bundles are wrapped. They should look as if they were wrapping on top of each other. Note, if your package is large, wrap tightly with foil to prevent drying out. The parchment paper stacks can be stored in an airtight container for up to 2 weeks.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,cremini mushroom,pineapple chunk,white sugar,shiitake mushroom,flax seed,mint leaf,maple extract
title: Sweet Nut Rice
ingredients: 2 tablespoons flax seeds | 12 ounces cremini mushrooms | 1 can pineapple chunks | 12 fresh shiitake mushrooms | 3 tablespoons white sugar | 1/2 cup white basmati rice | 1/3 cup cremini fresh mushrooms | 1 pinch maple extract | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh mint leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place flax seeds in a resealable plastic bag, and toss in nuts until evenly coated. Remove from bag, and shake off any excess. Cut mushrooms in half, lengthwise, and slice off the stems. Slice mushrooms crosswise into thin strips. Squeeze pineapple juice, and pour into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Add mushrooms, then pineapples, toasted flaxseed bag, and mix to combine. Pour mushroom mixture over the mushroom mixture, and sprinkle with sugar. Bake in the preheated oven until rice is fluffy, and the topping is light golden brown, 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Sausage Rolls
ingredients: 4 dinner rolls | 1 carrot | 24 ramekins
instructions: Take the rolling from the package and separate the roll into 5 inch sections. Put one section of the roll onto a bamboo rolling mat, place the remaining sections on top of that. Roll the sheet around the roll. Cut a hole in the middle of the roll and stuff with half a small carrot, all of the ramekin's worth. Put it into a microwave, add water to cover, set timer for 10 minutes to cook, then microwave for another 5 minutes. Remove from microwave. Take out the roll and place on plate. Place ramekin inside a sausage maker and put water in to a container so the rolls don't dry out. When you take out the first one to be sure the liquid did not drain off, place the sasuage into the sink with a bowl underneath to support. Let cool until warm a little. When it's cold, take off meat from sausage and cut into cubes and roll into the balls. Roll in ramekin's forloots and serve.

title: Tortilla De Banane (bananas in Spicy Olive Oil)
ingredients: 6 firm-ripe bananas | 2 cups extra virgin olive oil | vanilla | baking soda
instructions: Peel and roughly chop the bananas. Heat the oil and fry the bananas until they begin to give off liquid.

Random Ingredients: ha avocadoes,french onion soup,sage,turbinado sugar,angostura bitter,salami,egg noodle
title: Easy Peasy Noodles
ingredients: 16 ounces egg noodles | 2 hard-boiled eggs | 1 package mild salami, chopped | 1 can condensed french onion soup | 1 teaspoon angostura bitters ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon turbinado sugar | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage, crushed
instructions: Thoroughly rinse the egg noodles, then add to a large bowl. Slice the boiled eggs and add to the noodles. Add the crumbled salami, soup, bitters, sugar and sage. Mix well. Refrigerate for at least 4 hours, but not more than 3 hours. Serve with corn bread. Variation, a sprinkle of crushed sage can be added after mixing with the egg noodle mixture after breaking the egg noodles. Note, this can be served hot or slightly warm.

title: Peameal's Sweet Veggies
ingredients: 2 lbs baby carrots | 1/2 cup pecan pieces
instructions: Cut the tops off the carrots and snap off the strings. Bring a pot of water to a rolling boil and add the carrots. Boil until the carrots are tender but still bright green in the center. Drain the carrots. Return the water to a boil, add the pecans, and boil 5 minute remove from the heat.

title: Creole Fried Onions
ingredients: 10 -12 small lard ( or crisco ) | 2 bunches green onions, peeled with stem ( or 2 bunches ) | creole seasoning, such as mccormick's | 1 teaspoon dried basil leaves
instructions: Heat up a deep fryer or large skillet to 375 degrees f. Place the lard in a pan and set over a low heat. Add the green onion tops to the lard and sprinkle with creole seasoning. Fry for a few minutes, stirring frequently, until the green onions are tender, not soft and brown. Add the basil and mix well. Cover the pan and leave the onions on the stove. Check after 5 minutes, and add more creole seasoning. Do not stir. Let the mixture stand for about 10 minutes before serving.

title: Spicy and Cheesy Tangerine Cheeseses
ingredients: 6 ounces dark chocolate, grated | 4 ounces unsalted butter | 1/2 teaspoon chicken bouillon powder | 1 ounce tangerine peel, grated ( about 2 inches in length ) | 1 jalapeno, sliced
instructions: Melt the chocolate and butter in a small bowl over hot water. Remove the bowl from the heat, add the bouillon and stir until blended. Pour into a small bowl and sprinkle over the tangerine peel and jalepeno. Refrigerate until firm and chill until ready to use.

title: White Beans with Cheese
ingredients: 1 pound dry white bean, picked over | 1 container cottage cheese
instructions: Place the beans in a large saucepan, and add enough water to cover the beans by an inch or two. Bring to a boil over medium heat, and remove from the heat. Cover with a lid, and let stand for 1 hour. While the beans are cooking, prepare the cheese filling by mixing together the cottage cheese, cottage cheese, and white pepper in a medium bowl. Return the bean to the saucepan to warm it through. When the bean has cooked for 1 hour, drain the water, and return it to the pot. Stir in the cheese mixture as desired, then serve warm.

Random Ingredients: beet,anaheim chilies,baking chocolate,green chile pepper,ancho chile powder,self raising flour,cauliflower floret,tofu
title: Bunuelos
ingredients: 1 package tofu, chopped into cubes | 1 cup chopped beet | 1 cup cauliflower florets | 2 anaheim chilies, deseeded and chopped | 1 can chopped green chile peppers | 4 teaspoons ancho chile powder | 1 1/2 cups self-raising flour | 16 ounces baking chocolate, chopped into squares
instructions: Place the tofu, beet, cauliflower, chilies, ancho chile powder and flour into a bowl. Add baking chocolate and mix until the mixture is mixed in evenly. Preheat the oven to 400°f. Form the mixture into small balls. Place on parchment paper lined baking sheets. Flatten the balls slightly and bake for 10 minutes or until golden. Allow to cool slightly when they have cooled. Once the buns have cooled, place into a container filled with ice cubes to store.

title: Roasted Blueberries With Chipotle Chiles and Adobo
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs blueberries ( fresh or frozen ) | 1 cup chipotle chile in adobo, minced ( canned, fresh or canned ) | 2 tablespoons thai fish sauce
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Spread the berries on a baking pan/stone or baking sheet and roast in the oven. It will swell up a little bit but the berries will still be edible. When the berries are cool enough to handle, remove the seeds by rubbing the back of a wooden spoon down the side of the berries. Break them up and let them set in a large salad bowl.. In another bowl, combine the minced chile, fish sauce and chipotle with adobo sauce and gently combine. Add the berries and gently toss to coat them. Cover and let stand for 5 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: cake flour,bread,salt black pepper,tapioca starch,onion powder,marjoram,baguette
title: Chef John's French Onion Pain Perdu
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cake flour | 2 teaspoons tapioca starch | 1/4 teaspoon onion powder or 1/4 teaspoon anise, or more to taste | 1/8 teaspoon dried marjoram, or more to taste | salt and ground black pepper to taste | 1 loaf baguette, sliced into 1/2-inch slices
instructions: Whisk together cake flour, tapioca starch, minced onion powder, marjoram, salt, and pepper in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: fish sauce,clove,chili pepper flake,spring onion,stewing beef
title: Vietnamese Lemongrass Beef
ingredients: 800 g stewing beef | 6 cm gingerroot, peeled and finely julienned | 4 cloves | 1 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1 spring onion, chopped | 2 tablespoons fish sauce
instructions: Trim fat from beef. Cut into thin strips. Combine rest of ingredients in a non reactive container and leave in fridge overnight. Drain beef strips in a colander over a large bowl. Dredge in sauce.

title: Spaghetti Warehouse Method
ingredients: 3 slices bacon, chopped | 3 -4 slices lemon peel | 1/4 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 tablespoon grated fresh sage
instructions: Place bacon in microwave safe dish with lemon peel. Microwave on high 3 minutes or until crisp. Add 3/4 cup grated parmigiano reggiano cheese, and 1 tbls. Truffle rub all over bacon and lemon peel. Sprinkle evenly with remaining 1/4 cup parmigiano reggiano cheese. Microwave uncovered 1 to 2 minutes.

title: Cebyla's Feta Salad
ingredients: 3 plum tomatoes, seeded and chopped ( about 1 cup ) | 1 celery rib, chopped fine ( about 1/2 cup ) | 1/2 cup crumbled feta | 1/2 cup mirin | 1 tablespoon almond extract
instructions: Mix all ingredients together, except the almond extract, and refrigerate several hours. Enjoy.

title: The Bestest Seasoning for Chicken
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried anise seed | 3 tablespoons italian seasoning | 3 tablespoons chicken bouillon
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together. Put in a quart size bag. Seal bag. Let this sit in the fridge. It will keep a nice, dry, dark, and consistent coating over the chicken, never before.

Random Ingredients: apple cider vinegar,caster sugar,dark brown sugar,apple,fast rising yeast,orange peel,mirin,raisin
title: Apple Kvass
ingredients: 3 eggs | 4 cups caster sugar | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar | 3 tablespoons apple cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon finely grated orange peel | 1 tablespoon finely grated fresh orange rind | 1 1/2 teaspoons fast rising yeast | 400 g apples, coarsely grated | 1/4 cup raisins
instructions: Place eggs, sugar, brown sugar, vinegar, orange peel, orange rind and yeast in large bowl. Beat with mixer until thick and creamy. Fold in apples. Allow to rest in fridge for 8 hours. In shallow roasting dish, add apple mixture and raisins. Cover and bake at 180°c for 1 hour or until topping browns. Serve warm.

title: Orange Pea Pods Salad
ingredients: 4 cups frozen peas pods, thawed | 1 tablespoon orange rind, zest | cooking oil | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 4 tablespoons fat free whipped topping or 4 tablespoons sour cream
instructions: Using a slotted spoon, remove the peas from the freezer and defrost in the microwave. Rinse the peas and snap them into segments about 1/4 inch thick. Cut the segments into about 1 1/2 inch pieces. Place the frozen peas into a bowl, sprinkle with the orange zest and stir. In a small bowl, mix together the oil and rice vinegar. Add the oil and vinegar mixture to the peas, stirring well. Chill for about 10 minutes. Just before serving, stir in the soy whipped topping.

Random Ingredients: apple,chocolate ice cream,squid,cilantro leaf,barbecue sauce,pie shell
title: Smokey Swiss Steak Pie with Cilantro Applesauce
ingredients: 1 frozen pie shells, thawed and sliced into quarters | 4 ounces fresh cilantro leaves, coarsely chopped | 8 ounces hot barbecue sauce, i recommend bullseye ( sweet baby ray's ) | 2 large zucchini, sliced | 12 ounces fresh steaks ( i recommend barb-a-karen bold chicken, steak, or skirt steak ) | 1 cup cubed fresh apple ( such as fuji )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Combine the cilantro and 1/4 cup bbq sauce in a small bowl.

title: Fettuccine with Sesame Tomato Sauce
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 package dry fettuccine pasta | 1 medium tomato, seeded and chopped
instructions: Prepare fettuccine according to package directions. Drain.

title: Raspberry Sausages With Wheat and Horseradish (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 1 lb skinless pork sausages or 1 lb skinless turkey sausages | 3/4 cup coarsely cracked bulgur wheat, preferably bulgar | 1/4 cup raspberry jam | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish
instructions: Place bulgur in large saucepan and cover with water.

Random Ingredients: french onion soup mix,banana,oregano,fine sea salt,cashew nut,vanilla essence,star anise
title: Baked Sweet, Savoury French Onion Soup
ingredients: 150 g french onion soup mix | 400 g bananas, cut in 5cm pieces | 200 g cashew nuts | 1 1/2 tablespoons fine sea salt | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 pinch star anise | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c/400°f/gas lightly spray a shallow ovenproof baking dish with oil. Put the onion soup mix, cashew nuts, salt, ground essence and oregano into a food processor and whiz up for 3 - 4 minutes until it's finely chopped. Pour into the prepared baking dish to ensure the soup mix covers the base evenly. Cover then bake for 1 hour. Take out when cooked. Remove from the oven, then leave the pan uncovered. Take out the sweet, savoury soup mix from the oven and put in one of the empty bowls. Now, take the tray of sweet, savoury soup mix out of the oven, add the vanilla, and then top with the sweet and savoury soup mix. Pour back into the baking dish the sweet, savoury soup mix from the base and top with the chopped pumpkin and sliced bananas.

title: Aniseed Nuts
ingredients: 1 lb fusilli | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed | 1 1/3 ounces butter | 3 chipotle chiles
instructions: Cook fusilli according to package directions. Meanwhile, in a dry frying pan, toast aniseed seeds until golden brown, about 3 to 4 minutes, stirring constantly. Cool. Drain fusilli and place in a bowl. Cut the chiles into chunks and combine with fried aniseed and chilis. Toss well.

title: Spiced Chicken Bags
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chicken leg quarters, skinned, halved crosswise | 3 tablespoons sweet chili paste | 1 -2 tablespoon roasted jalapeno, seeded and minced | 2 tablespoons orange sections, juice | 2 teaspoons mixed spice, such as curry
instructions: Place chicken in shallow dish. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over chicken. Cover, refrigerate at least 1 hour. Preheat oven to 425°. Roast chicken in oven for 25 minutes, basting once or twice. Let chicken rest for 10 minutes before slicing into thin slices.

title: Tofu Sandwiches With Toasted Toasted Pine Crackers
ingredients: 12 ounces firm tofu | 3/4 cup packed brown sugar | 1/4 cup golden syrup | 1/2 cup black peppercorns | 2 3/4 - 3 1/2 tablespoons whole wheat bread loaves | butter, softened and cut into 12 pieces if desired
instructions: Using a strainer, press the tofu on a cutting board to remove any excess moisture. Cut tofu crosswise into 1/8 inch thick slices and set aside. Combine brown sugar, golden syrup and peppercorns in a small saucepan and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, maintaining a slow simmer, and simmer a few minutes until syrup thickens slightly. Dip each bread slice in syrup and arrange on a cookie sheet in a single layer. Spread both sides of bread with soft butter. Place 1 or 2 slices of tofu on each bread slice. Broil in a preheated broiler until golden, 2 - 5 minutes, turning half way. Serve warm or at room temperature with more toasted pine nuts.

title: Brazilian Grilled Skewers
ingredients: 1 lb lean beef sirloin, cut in 1 1/4 x 1/4 x 1/2 inch strips | 1 1/2 cups jicama, finely chopped | 12 whole cloves | 1 can cantaloupe, cut in 1-inch chunks
instructions: Preparing the meat on the grill, place the sirloin strips on a cutting board. Spread the skewers with about 1 teaspoon or so of each of the julian peperoncinis, garlic powder, or other seasoning that you would like, and 1 teaspoon of the peperoncinis powder. Allow the meat to sit at room temperature for 45 minutes. Alternate cuts of beef and julian peperoncinis on skewers. Grill the skewers 7 to 10 minutes, turning once, until the beef is charred and the julienne is tender. Use tongs or two forks to serve and watch them carefully for any sign of burning. Serve with spanish rice.

title: Homemade Harissa
ingredients: 1 can chick-peas, rinsed and drained | 1 package canned pimientos, drained | 1 can chili beans, drained
instructions: Combine the chickpeas, pimientos, and chili beans in a food processor. Pulse until finely minced.

title: Broiled Corn Fritters (Crispy)
ingredients: 4 ears fresh corn kernels ( preferably with the cob in it ) | 3 cups fresh white breadcrumbs | pepper
instructions: Preheat broiler. Remove the husks from the corn and boil the corn kernels for about 20 minutes or until cooked through. Drain the corn, if using fresh kernels. Mix half of the bread crumbs with some pepper, then mix with the corn kernels. Form into 8 fritters and sprinkle with remaining bread crumbs. Broil or grill for 3 - 4 minutes per side, depending on the desired colour. Serve.

Random Ingredients: french green bean,chicken thigh,eggplant,kernel corn,curry powder,grain rice,black olive
title: Quick Indian Curry
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups long grain rice | 1 eggplant ( peeled, cut into 2/3 inch cubes ) | 2 cans chicken thighs | 1 can french style green beans ( drained ) | 1 can black olives or ( 7 ounce ) can green chilies ( drained ) | 1 cup frozen cauliflower whole kernel corn | 1 tablespoon curry powder ( or to taste )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. In a large saucepan, combine the rice, eggplant, chicken, green beans, black olives, cauliflower and curry powder. Stir to combine. Spray a 3 quart baking dish with cooking spray. Pour the curry mixture into the baking dish, sprinkle with extra curry, and bake uncovered for 45 minutes. Let stand 15 minutes before serving. Variation, you can use any combination of curry and vegetables. Instead of green beans and eggplant, use 3 cups of green beans and/or red beans, cut into 3 inch chunks. This method is very versatile.

title: Green Beet Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces fresh spinach leaves | 1 cup jalapeno pepper, chopped ( the whole pepper ) | 1 cup fresh raw beet, peeled and chopped
instructions: Place the spinach and the peppers in a salad bowl and toss with the chopped beet. Serve immediately or refrigerate until chilled.

Random Ingredients: broccoli,red onion,cream,ice cube,green capsicum,orange zest,mace,tomato paste
title: Sizzling Tomato Broccoli Cheese Dip
ingredients: 250 g broccoli, chopped | 1 green capsicum, chopped | 1 large red onion, finely diced | 1 can tomato paste | 4 teaspoons orange zest | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 1 cup cream | 4 cups ice cubes
instructions: Place all ingredients in the ingredients in a food processor and process to smooth and creamy. Serve in bowls with fresh toasted breadcrumbs.

title: American Green Beans and Onions
ingredients: 1 medium fresh yellow onion, peeled | 1 can cut green beans, with liquid | 1 cube chicken bouillon
instructions: Place all ingredients except for the green beans in the slow cooker. Cover and cook on high for 4 hours or on low for 10 to 12 hours. When done, slice and serve.

Random Ingredients: napa cabbage,red pepper flake,pork roast,red bell pepper,lard,green chili pepper,vanilla bean
title: Costa Rican Pork and Cabbage
ingredients: 2 lbs pork roast ( butt or shoulder can be subbed. you may also use leg or shoulder roast instead ) | 2 pinches crushed red pepper flakes ( to taste ) | 2 1/2 lbs napa cabbage, shredded | 1 large green chili pepper, sliced | red bell pepper, sliced | 1 1/2 cups lard ( can sub light or light olive oil to make a smokey flavor ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla bean, split ( optional )
instructions: If using lamb or other meat, cut into chunks. If using chicken, boil to own desired doneness, about 45 minutes for chicken. Add pork during the last 10 minutes of cooking, stir and set aside to cool slightly. Remove any pieces of meat, which should be falling away in your prep. Slice the pork into 1/4 inch wide chunks or strips about 1/4 inch wide. Heat the butter and lard in a heavy bottomed skillet over medium heat. Add the meat with the crushed red pepper and stir fry until browned. Add the pork, cabbage, and green pepper and mix well. Add the vanilla bean and cook for 4 - 5 minutes. Season with salt/pepper. Spoon hot meat and cabbage mixture on large platter. Add some chiles on each platter, if desired.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,pepperoni,white fish fillet,veggie burger,sesame oil,caraway seed
title: Spicy Beef & Veggie Bites With Sauteed Peppers
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb white fish fillet, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1/2 cup veggie burger | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 1/2 teaspoon caraway seed | pepperoni, chopped coarsely
instructions: Slice fish into thin strips. Combine remaining ingredients in a bowl.

title: Chowder Bombay (Curried Clam Sauce)
ingredients: 2 cans minced clams | 1 teaspoon curry powder
instructions: Drain clams, reserving juice. Combine clam juice and curry powder in a small glass or ceramic bowl. Pour contents into casserole over crushed clams.

Random Ingredients: white grape juice,beef roast,zucchini,chicken stock,cashew,egg white,pimiento
title: Easy Shredded Beef
ingredients: 3 lbs beef roast, cubed | 1/4 cup chicken stock | 1/2 cup pimiento, chopped | 1 egg white, beaten | 1 1/2 cups cashews or 1 1/2 cups peanuts, roasted and chopped | 4 cups sliced zucchini | 1/2 cup white grape juice
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees f. Combine beef and the chicken stock. Marinate at least 2 hours or overnight. Place in a greased 10 x 15 baking pan. Stir in pimiento, egg white and cashews. Bake 30 - 45 minutes until heated through. Serve with salad and green veggies. Pimientos, a jar of chopped onions, drained chinese rice wine, garlic chilies, ginger, red pepper flakes, chilies, oyster sauce and garlic. Store 1/4 cup of this to be used in sauces as a dipping sauce.

title: Kadai (Yemenite Pork Kabobs)
ingredients: 1/4 lb boneless pork, ground | 1 fresh kaffir lime leaf, bruised well | 2 teaspoons fresh italian parsley, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh kaffir lime leaf, shredded ( optional )
instructions: Use your hands to squeeze out excess water from the kaffir lime leaf. Mix ground pork with lime leaf, italian parsley, and shredded kaffir lime leaf. Put on grill, cook for 25 minutes. Cut into squares or wedges.

Random Ingredients: cottage cheese,pomegranate juice,chile garlic sauce,chili paste,tofu,vanilla yogurt,mustard,bulgur
title: Spicy Tofu Burgers
ingredients: 1 package firm tofu, crumbled | 2 tablespoons pomegranate juice | 1/2 teaspoon chili paste | 1/2 teaspoon mustard | 1 container low-fat vanilla yogurt | 3 tablespoons prepared chile-garlic sauce | 1/4 cup prepared cottage cheese
instructions: In a small bowl, toss together the tofu, pomegranate juice, chili paste, mustard and yogurt. Shape into 4 patties, and chill in refrigerator while preparing grill. Remove tofu burgers from refrigerator, grill or grill in oil until just cooked through. Top each burger with the reserved sauce, cottage cheese and pomegranate juice cocktail.

title: Simple Sour Beef Rice Noodle
ingredients: 12 ounces dried rice noodles | 4 ounces fresh straw mushrooms, sliced | 1/2 cup sesame oil
instructions: Wash your noodles and rinse them well under cold running water. Drain and set aside when noodles are almost done cooking. You can either slice the noodles into 1/4 inch pieces or leave them for extra crunch. Fry them in your sesame oil in a large frying pan or wok with a little sesame oil. Be sure to add a lot of the oil as you can fry the noodles quickly. When you can smell the noodles turning they are done. Remove from the pan and slice very thinly, to leave them about 1/4 or two centimetres or so. Serve with your sesame oil, soy sauce, and/or a touch of ground black pepper if desired. Yum.

title: Rotini Pasta (Rice Cooker)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon liquid smoke | 2 tablespoons rotini pasta, dried | 1 pinch black pepper, freshly ground ( or more to taste )
instructions: Combine the liquid smoke, pasta, and pepper in the rice cooker. Stir until well combined. Add water if not blending.

title: Auntie Lori's Special Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 6 lbs beef tenderloin | 2 onions, sliced thinly | 1 ounce vanilla essence
instructions: Preheat oven to 160 degrees and line a cookie sheet with parchment paper. In a shallow dish combine the meat, onions, and vanilla essence. Pour enough hot water into the dish to almost cover the meat and onions. Place the meat mixture into the prepared cookie sheet. Bake meat for 3 1/2 1hr at 160 degrees, or until meat is done.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,pecorino romano cheese,candy sprinkle,wheat flour,phyllo dough
title: Easy Pizza Bianca
ingredients: 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1/2 cup pcorino romano cheese | 1 cup plain whole wheat flour | 2 teaspoons candy sprinkles | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 3 sheets phyllo dough
instructions: Preheat oven to 550 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment. Add 1/2 cup olive oil to a medium skillet over medium heat.

title: Mandarin Oranges
ingredients: 6 mandarin oranges | 1 ounce hazelnuts ( toasted if desired )
instructions: Toast the hazelnuts in oven or toaster oven until they turn light brown. Prick oranges at base of orange with a sharp knife or fork, poke deeply with a fork, remove from oven and spread with warm hazelnuts. Sprinkle with a little grated orange peel, and serve.

title: Pomegranate Molasses Rice
ingredients: 2 cups cooked long-grain rice, cooled | 2 teaspoons italian seasoning, crushed | 2 teaspoons pomegranate molasses ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In a large bowl, combine the rice, italian seasoning, and molasses, if using. Place the rice into an oven proof casserole dish. Place the dish in the fridge, and bake 2 hours, or until the rice is creamy.

Random Ingredients: pistachio,vegetable oil,guajillo chilies,pecorino romano cheese,garlic,italian sausage,arborio rice
title: Cheese Arancini
ingredients: 2 teaspoons vegetable oil | 1/2 lb sweet italian sausage, casings removed | 2 cloves garlic, finely chopped | 4 ounces arborio rice or 4 ounces carnaroli rice | 3 ounces pistachios, chopped, unsalted | 2 dried guajillo chilies, finely chopped | 1/4 cup pecorino romano cheese, grated
instructions: In a small saucepan, over medium low heat, cook the sausage with 1/2 teaspoon of the oil until heated through, breaking up into small chunks. In a large saucepan, bring 1 cup of water with the remaining teaspoon of oil to a boil. Add the rice and cook, stirring occasionally, until tender and creamy all the way through, about 15 minutes. Drain, stir into the sausage, and set aside. In a separate skillet, heat 1/4 cup of water with 2 tablespoons of the pistachios over medium heat for about 10 minutes. Add the chiles, cover, and cook another five minutes. Stir in the sausage, rice, and parmesan cheese.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper flake,banana,pie shell,salt black pepper,baking potato
title: Portuguese Banana Bread
ingredients: 2 large baking potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/4-inch slices | 1/8 teaspoon crushed red chili pepper flakes | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 small banana, cut into 1/4-inch dice | 1 refrigerated pie shell, prepared and refrigerated
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Place potatoes in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Scrub them with a brush, and sprinkle with chili flake. Add just enough water to come a good 3/4 of the way up the side of the potatoes. Simmer, partially covered until tender, about 15 minutes. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, mash together the potatoes and chili flakes. Season with salt and pepper. Place the banana pieces in a mixing bowl, and mash until the pieces are well coated. Place on top of the potato mixture in an 8 inch square baking dish. Bake for 10 minutes in the preheated oven, until hot and lightly browned. Cut into wedges and serve.

title: Easy Rhubarb Corn Fritters
ingredients: 1 package frozen rhubarb, thawed and peeled | 1 tablespoon fajita seasoning | 1/4 cup sour cream
instructions: Wash and dry the rhubarb. Cut out the base of the rhubarb by slicing up at the stem end. You don't want it to be like you would chop up from the bag, just like it is diced up. Place the rhubarb in a saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat slightly, and simmer 5 minutes, or until rhubarb is still slightly firm. Drain any excess water, and return rhubarb in pan. Mash the rhubarb in the rhubarb until creamy, and stir in the fajita seasoning. Spoon a portion into a glass measuring cup or bowl. Top with a dollop of sour cream. Note, i usually use a teaspoon to scrape out the sour cream into the bowl with the sour cream, then spoon some right into a container the container is a little too liquid to give a thick consistency.

Random Ingredients: beef mince,whipping cream,thyme sprig,gingerroot,confectioner ' sugar,garlic powder,sage,rice flour
title: Rice Flour Crusted Beef Rissoles
ingredients: 350 g beef mince | 2 teaspoons rice flour | 2 teaspoons ground sage ( or other dried sage that have been ground ) | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprig | 3/4 teaspoon grated gingerroot | 1 cup whipping cream ( double cream ) | confectioners'sugar
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cream. Add cream and stir till dough is easy to handle. Place on well floured board and form into 1inch balls and then knead lightly until smooth. Refrigerate for 1 hour. Preheat oven to 190°c. Arrange rissoles on a baking tray, and bake for 25 mins till cooked. Serve with salad and seasonal vegetables.

title: Mixed Pearl Barley and Pepperoni Casserole
ingredients: 1/2 cup pearl barley, uncooked | 1/2 cup farina | 1/2 lb ground lamb shoulder | 12 slices bread, torn into 1/8-inch pieces | 1 jar pepperoni, sliced | 12 slices sandwich fresh lettuce | 2 medium tart apples, cut into 8 wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. While the water is coming to a boil, combine barley and farina in large bowl of food processor. Cover and set aside. Place lamb in a large skillet. Cook over medium heat until no longer pink. Remove from heat. Add bread to skillet and cook until golden. Remove bread and set aside. Add farina mixture to skillet and place 1/2 of the lamb and 1/2 of the pepperoni. Cook over medium heat 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Arrange the bread mixture in a 2 quart baking dish. Repeat with remaining ingredients. Bake 40 minutes or until browned and bubbly.

title: Orange and Pomegranate Crusted Salmon
ingredients: 1 lb salmon fillet | 1/2 cup pomegranate, seeds free if available but can be made if desired | 32 ounces mixed greens, washed ( i would recommend spinach, kale, boston, etc ) | 2 oranges, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup dried cranberries | 1/4 cup dried pomegranate | 2 -3 ounces pomegranate slices, as needed ( to garnish ) | 1 tablespoon light brown rice or 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 1 teaspoon guacamole ( optional )
instructions: Slice salmon fillet into four crosswise slabs, about 4 by 4 by 1/2 depending on size. Place into a ziploc bag and pour undrained orange juice over salmon and seal securely. Marinate about 15 minutes. Wash greens. Pat dry with paper towel and cut into 1/4 slices. Set aside. Place orange slices around salmon. Remove salmon from marinade. Heat grill on high. Remove salmon from marinade and place on grill. Season with salt pepper to taste. Grill or broil salmon, flipping and rearranging orange slices, about 10 minutes total, until flesh flakes easily when tested with a fork. Cut crosswise into slices. Serve with pomegranate pomegranate pomegranate pomegranate syrup. Guacamole, in a small bowl, cover dried pomegranate seeds with hot water. Bring to a boil for about 5 minutes. Drain. Place in a mixing bowl. Peel and thinly slice oranges about 1/2 inch thick. Sprinkle with fresh orange juice, then place into a small bowl. To serve, place on a plate with a piece of plastic wrap. Top with orange slices to resemble a fresh dollop of guacamole, if desired.

Random Ingredients: poblano chile,vegetable oil cooking spray,beef tenderloin steak
title: Grilled Beef Filets(ATK) With Poblanos
ingredients: 1/2 lb beef tenderloin steak | vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 poblano chiles
instructions: Prepare grill to high or preheat to moderate. Spray both sides of fillets with veggie spray. In hot skillet over medium heat, grill filets 3 to 4 minutes on each side, or until desired level of doneness for medium or desired degree of doneness for medium. Serve with poblanos.

Random Ingredients: tequila,savoy cabbage,white onion,hot red pepper lengthwise,leek
title: Cabbage Tacos
ingredients: 6 cups savoy cabbage, shredded | 1 1/4 cups tequila | 1 1/4 cups finely chopped leeks | 2 hot red peppers, sliced lengthwise | 1 small white onion, finely chopped
instructions: In a large bowl, place the cabbage, tequila, leeks and red pepper. Toss gently to mix. Spray a large nonstick skillet with medium high sides with medium low heat and cook the mixture for 10 minutes. Add onion and toss once. Place the mixture in a warm tortilla, add cheese to taste and roll up.

Random Ingredients: green bean,cornflour,cinnamon,ginger garlic paste,chicken bouillon cube,red pepper green,cocoa powder
title: Cha Cha Chicken
ingredients: 2 teaspoons cornflour ( mixed with about 1 1/2 tbsp water ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste | 250 g chicken bouillon cubes | 1 tablespoon red pepper ( seeded & chopped ) | 250 g green beans | 2 teaspoons cinnamon | 2 teaspoons cocoa powder
instructions: Cut the chicken into thin strips. Sprinkle on both sides with the cornflour. Bring water, ginger garlic paste and remaining ingredients together to a boil& let cook over medium heat for 10 minutes. Add the green beans and cook for 10 minutes. Drain any liquid left on the bottom, serve with plain rice & indian parathas. Note this might be difficult to beat because of the lack of air in the recipe. This is for those who like a harder chinese restaurant style dish we loved the addition of cocoa.

title: Dumplings II
ingredients: 2 cups cornstarch | 1 tablespoon xanthan gum | 1 cup ranch dressing | 2 tablespoons olive oil
instructions: Mix cornstarch, xanthan gum, and ranch dressing together in a bowl until cornstarch mixture is well coated. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Dip each coated spoonful into corn starch mixture, coating both sides completely, then into oil. Fry dumplings in the hot oil until golden brown.

title: Feta and Cannellini Bean Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb cannellini beans | 3 ounces feta cheese, crumbled
instructions: Rinse and drain beans. Cook the crumbled cheese in a frying pan until it is golden brown but not burnt.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,anchovy,orange juice zest,pistachio,garlic paste,swiss cheese,salt
title: Low Cal Low Fat Baked Swiss Cheese
ingredients: 3 tablespoons orange juice and zest | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh garlic garlic ( or to taste ) | 1 teaspoon salt or 2 teaspoons kosher salt | 1 anchovy ( optional ) | 4 ounces low fat swiss cheese, cut into cubes ( or use mozzarella ) | 1/2 cup pistachios, coarsely crushed ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Preheat broiler. In a 1 quart baking dish, stir together rind, garlic paste, orange juice and zest, salt and anchovy. Add cheese and mix well. Sprinkle with pistachios. Bake uncovered, until bubbly. It will have a nice brown crust. It's ready when toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Serve with crackers.

title: Blueberry and Garlic head Wraps (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 11)
ingredients: 10 small garlic heads | 1 pint blueberries
instructions: Place each head of garlic in a plastic bag. Divide 3/4 cup of blueberries between the cloves. Seal bag and close the bag. Let bugs redistribute all over the top and bottom of the bag. Allow bugs to drain at least 25 minutes, maximum 2 hours, maximum 30 minutes. After bugs have drained, cool off under cold water on a cutting board or in a tea towel. Slice up and serve. Note, you can use any colour, such as oranges and yellow.

title: Creamy German Dill Stock (Zupa)
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons apple juice | 1 lb chicken bouillon cube | 1 1/2 cups chicken stock | 2 tablespoons dried dill
instructions: Put everything on top of a double boiler over low heat and bring to simmer and reduce to a simmer. Cook, uncovered, at low temperature until the stock is reduced to 1 1/2 pint in the pot and the flavors have combined, about 2 hours. Taste for seasonings and adjust.

title: Cotija-Basil Spread
ingredients: 2 cups crumbled cotija cheese | 1/4 cup sweet pickled mustard | 2 tablespoons chopped basil leaves
instructions: Place the cream cheese in a bowl, and stir in the mustard, basil, and cotija cheese until well blended. Cover, and refrigerate for several hours before serving to allow the flavors to blend.

title: Cheesy Mexican Raisins
ingredients: 1 cup mexican blend cheese ( reduced fat is ok ) | 3 tablespoons golden raisins
instructions: Preheat oven to 375º. Mix the cheese, raisins until well mixed. Put a heaping tablespoon of raisin on a cookie sheet. Bake 30 - 45 minutes at 375f, until the raisins are soft and the cheese is golden brown.

title: Pork Belly
ingredients: 2 lbs pork butt | 1 cup hot sauce or 1 cup white rum | 1/4 cup dashi stock, diluted in | 1 teaspoon cumin powder or 1 teaspoon aji amarillo chili powder
instructions: Preheat a pot of water boiling for the butt to come to a full boil. Drain the water away from the meat and set aside. Slice the pork butt into 1 inch square slices, approximately 3 inches long, using the slicing attachment of the meat pounder.

Random Ingredients: ginger powder,tapioca flour,berry,chili,fennel seed,kosher salt,chocolate sauce,banana
title: Rababag Grilled Banana Lollies
ingredients: 2 bananas, sliced ( ripe for this, your choice ) | 1/2 teaspoon chili, crushed | 1/4 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/2 teaspoon ginger powder | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 1 tablespoon tapioca flour | 1/2 cup fresh berry, chopped ( optional ) | 1 cup chocolate sauce
instructions: In a large skillet, cook bananas over medium heat for 6 to 7 minutes on each side, depending on the size of the banana slices. Remove bananas from skillet and sprinkle with chili powders, fennel seeds and ginger powder. Return bananas to skillet and coat bananas with the chocolate sauce. Serve bananas piled with the berries.

title: Rigatoni With Roasted Beef
ingredients: 3 lbs beef roast | 1/2 package shredded mozzarella cheese | 1 cup of leftover beef roast gravy | 1 teaspoon of finely ground savory
instructions: Cut roast into 1 inch cubes. Place in an oven proof dish and sprinkle with mozzarella cheese to cover. Spread gravy evenly over roast.
