Sprinkle with savory and bake in a 350 degree oven for 2 1/2 hours. Serve with warm spaghetti noodles. Note, to roast the roast, place it on a rack on the rack in a roasting pan and bake at 350 degrees f for 1 hour. Turn the oven to broil, place roast on the top rack of the broiler, place rack 4 - 6 inches from the heat source, and broil for 2 to 3 minutes per side, or until browned. Place roast on cutting board and tent with foil. Let stand for 10 to 15 minutes before slicing and serving.

title: Irish Boiled Shrimps
ingredients: 3/4 cup shallot, finely chopped | 4 tablespoons irish whiskey | 1 medium yellow onion, chopped | 7 1/2 ounces shrimp, cooked and shelled ( shelled ) | 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice ( or to taste ) | 1 hoagie roll, split and toasted
instructions: Mix together shallots and whiskey. Place onion and shrimp in a shallow pan with shrimps. Sprinkle with spice and toss to coat. Re cover and marinate at least 30 minutes and up to 1 hour in refrigerator. Grill over coals over medium heat until shrimp are pink and shrimp are crisp on the outside, about 3 - 5 minutes per side.

title: Meat Noodle Soup
ingredients: 1 cup cooked meat | 1 cup parsnip | 1/2 cup beef bouillon cube | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1/4 cup cherries ( optional ) | pasta
instructions: Peel parsnips, pith and chop fine. Boil broth cube in large pot until it starts boiling. Add meat, parsnips and cherries. Cook for 25 - 30 minutes, or until meat is tender. Add 1 tsp. Flavoring of cardamom or cinnamon and add 1/4 tsp. Flavoring of cardamom. This soup really needs to be served.

Random Ingredients: roasting chicken,scallop,apple cider vinegar,dark brown sugar,orange juice,icing sugar
title: Scallops and Apple Cider Glaze
ingredients: 150 ml dark brown sugar | 100 ml orange juice | 175 ml apple cider vinegar | 150 g scallops | 50 g icing sugar
instructions: Heat the oven to 190º c, 350º f, gas 3, gas 2. Put the sugar and vinegar in a small tin and stir in the scallops. Line the trays with parchment paper. Put two tablespoons of the glaze into the roasting tray, spread to cover and put in the oven. Bake for 25 minutes or until golden brown. Place on a plate and keep warm. Stir in the icing sugar.

title: Quinoa Fluff
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 1 1/2 cups heavy whipping cream
instructions: Place quinoa in a saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring to a boil and reduce heat to medium low. Cook for 20 minutes, or until all of the liquid has been absorbed and grains are tender. Drain. Place quinoa in a serving bowl. Stir in 1 1/2 cups of the cream, and mix well to combine. Cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate overnight. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,lime juice,white mushroom,tarragon,chocolate,red curry paste,fine sea salt,orange
title: Puff Wellington Cups
ingredients: 1/4 lb bittersweet chocolate, finely chopped | 1/2 cup lime juice | 2 tablespoons fine sea salt | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried tarragon or 1 1/2 teaspoons oregano leaves | 1/2 teaspoon red curry paste | 1 teaspoon orange rind, finely grated | 2 packages frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1 lb white mushroom, thinly sliced ( about two 3/4 cups total )
instructions: To make the chocolate glaze, place chocolate in a small, heat proof bowl or saucepan over barely simmering water. Cook, stirring often, 5 minutes or until melted and smooth. Drain and let cool. Place 1/4 cup of the chocolate, lime juice, sea salt, tarragon, curry paste, and orange rind in the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the whisk attachment and beat on medium high until smooth. Add the remaining 1/4 cup of chocolate. Beat on medium high until just blended. Using a spoon, loosen the center of each puff pastry sheet by pulling the sides in and out. Using a 2 1/2 inch heart shaped cookie cutter, cut out dough shapes. Place one tablespoon or two ounces mushroom slices in the center of each puff pastry round. Spoon 1 1/2 tablespoons chocolate glaze over mushroom and sprinkle with 1/4 teaspoon sea salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper. Fold dough in half. Press edges of dough together around mushrooms to enclose them. Transfer to paper towels to drain, then freeze until solid, about 30 minutes. To serve, transfer rolls to a platter and serve. Top with the remaining glaze.

Random Ingredients: wooden skewer,ginger paste,egg white,chunky salsa,green pepper,kaffir lime leaf,poblano pepper
title: MEXICAN Green Pepper and Sauc
ingredients: 1 large green pepper, seeded and chopped | 1/2 poblano pepper, seeded and chopped | 1 tablespoon ginger paste | 2 kaffir lime leaves | 5 ounces chunky salsa or 5 ounces hot pepper salsa | 1 egg white, beaten | wooden skewer
instructions: Place the green pepper, poblanca pepper, lime leaves, salsa & ginger paste in the work bowl of a food processor& process until smooth. Add the water as needed to hold mixture together. Pour mixture into a nonmetal bowl or papered plastic storage container. Refrigerate until ready to use. Sauce may also be stored in the refrigerator in a tightly sealed jar for up to a week. Makes about two cups. Make ahead, in a small bowl, beat egg white on low speed. Stir in the pepper mixture. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil vegetable,scallion,chicken bouillon,grey poupon mustard,savory,cumin seed,nori
title: Yatatsobi
ingredients: 4 cups peanut oil or 4 cups vegetable oil | 1 1/2 cups chopped yellow and green scallions ( chive ) | 1 tablespoon minced savory ( thyme or oregano may be used ) | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon | 2 tablespoons grey poupon mustard | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 4 sheets nori, dry seaweed, per person
instructions: Heat the oil to 360f degrees or until the oil shimmers, then immediately add the scallion and savory or dried herbs. Stir the scallion and savory / herbs into the oil. Remove from the heat and add the chicken brother. Stir. Allow to cool before using. Combine the mustard and cumin & add. Place a sheet of nori in a large sieve and press firmly on it with the palm of your hand. Spread a generous tablespoonful of the mustard mixture on the nori, then use the fingers to spread the mustard into a thin film, or roll the nori like a cigar. Serve with rice.

title: German Pear Dip
ingredients: 8 medium small pears | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar
instructions: Peel the pears.

title: Quick Easy Pasta Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar tomato sauce | 1 1/2 cups fresh chives, snipped
instructions: Cook pasta til tender according to package directions, add chives when pasta is done.

title: Spicy Onions and Smoked Venison (S. O. C., Perrins En Vin)
ingredients: 4 lbs smoked venison | 1 medium spanish onion, sliced ( about 1 cup ) | 4 -5 hot green chili peppers
instructions: Slice venison fairly thinly and place 1/4 to half a cup of sliced onion on one side of each slice of meat. Fold the left side closest to you over the meat and roll up the slices. Place roll on rack in roasting pan, with about an inch between the roll and the cover. Bake at 325 degrees for one hour or until internal temperature of meat reaches 165 degrees. Slice 1/4 to 1/2 thick slices and place on plates or sandwiches with some gravy poured over. Serve with white wine..

title: Pebre
ingredients: 1 fresh serrano pepper | 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Finely chop the chile, or use garlic, ginger, or cumin. Dry roast the minced chile in a dry skillet for about 5 minutes, or until it's dark and fragrant.

title: Chicken With Chipotle
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs chicken, cut into pieces | 7 1/2 ounces chipotle chiles, rinsed, dried and seeded ( with seeds ) | 3 teaspoons hot pepper oil | 1 teaspoon saffron thread | 1/2 cup fresh sage leaf, lightly packed | 2 tablespoons chili oil
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine the chiles, salt and 2 inches of water. Cook over high heat until the chiles become very fragrant, about 5 seconds. Add the chicken and cover the pan.

title: Lemongrass, Lemongrass, and Razor Prawn (Shrimp) With Pasta
ingredients: 2 bunches raspberries | 1 bunch fresh basil | 1 pint scallops, split in half | 1 tablespoon lemongrass, minced | 2 tablespoons italian seasoning | 2 tablespoons hot pepper sauce | 8 ounces gemelli pasta ( or other wide shaped pasta )
instructions: Start by placing the raspberries, basil, scallops, and lemon grass in a food processor and pulsing several times. Add the italian seasoning and hot pepper sauce and process again until the mixture is chunky. Toss together with pasta and serve.

title: Noodles With palm sugar and palm sugar (Aussie Noodle Pudding)
ingredients: 600 g noodles | 50 g palm sugar or 50 g brown sugar
instructions: Cut noodles into pieces about 3/4 inch long and 1/4 inch wide. Put in saucepan and cover with water. Bring to boil, then turn down and simmer for 10 - 15 minutes, or until tender. Drain noodles. Discard water. Stir through sugar and let cool. Remove 1/4 cup of sugar with your hands and use to serve the rest.

title: Cheesy Prawns in Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 4 ounces uncooked small fresh asparagus | 1 1/2 tablespoons cornstarch | 2 1/4 ounces rotel tomatoes | 1 1/2 tablespoons turbinado sugar | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped fresh edible flowers | 2 ounces grated cheddar cheese
instructions: Snap off any wood or string from the asparagus. Cut off the ends of the asparagus, then discard the stems. Cut the asparagus into 2 inch pieces. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook the asparagus until just crisp tender, about 3 minutes. Drain. Blend the cornstarch with 1 tablespoon water in a small bowl. Dip the asparagus in the cornstarch mixture and arrange over the boiling water. Cook and stir about 3 minutes, until the asparagus turns bright green. Stir the rest of the ingredients, except the cheese, into the asparagus mixture. Cook and stir until the cheese is melted and the sauce is heated through. Serve the mixture over the pasta.

title: Pancake Caramelized Cauliflower With Chocolate
ingredients: 1 large cauliflower | 5 ounces coarsely grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Cut the cauliflower into florets with a vegetable peeler or kitchen shears, but leaving the core at the stem. Heat a 12 inch or larger skillet over medium heat until it is hot. Pour about 1/2 cup of the grated parmigiano into a flat dish and evenly spread the grated parmigiano on top of it. Immediately pour off any excess moisture from the cauliflower. Turn the heat to medium or medium low and put the grated cheese into a large, shallow dish. Turn the pan upside down onto the grated cheese. Gently squeeze a handful of the cheesy parmigiano into each ear of cauliflower, and set each ear in the cheese/parm/spinach mixture. Use a wooden spoon to make sure all the cheese has had a chance to melt. Quickly pour the spiced cheese onto the grated cheese, coating the entire surface evenly. Turn the heat back up to medium/medium high and let cook until the bottom crisps slightly, about 2 minutes. Flip the ear over. Cook until the tops are crisp and browned, about 1 minute longer.

Random Ingredients: lemon,bay leaf,spring onion,corn tortilla,garlic salt,linguine,mustard powder,thyme sprig
title: Linguine With Mustard
ingredients: 8 ounces linguine | 2 teaspoons mustard powder | 1 tablespoon lemon rind, finely grated | 2 spring onions ( scallions, whites only, finely chopped ) | 1 fresh thyme sprig ( optional ) | 1/4 cup lemon juice | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Cook linguine in rapidly boiling salted water until al dente. Drain. Combine mustard & lemon rind in a small bowl. Add spring onions, thyme, lemon juice, and garlic salt. Add bay leaf. Toss with the pasta until well coated. Serve warm.

title: Spices for Baking Stacks (Tropical Wedges and Cheese Bread)
ingredients: 5 ounces brie cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons cornflour ( cornstarch ) | sour mixed spice | 6 green olives ( small green olives ) | 10 green olives | 10 sprigs thai basil
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees celsius. Place brie and cornflour in a large bowl and mash with a fork. Add seasoning & olives to cheese mixture and stir. Grease a 23x27cm tray and line with cling film. Press mixture into the tin using the back of the spoon. Bake for 15 minutes. Remove from oven & allow to cool slightly. Slice & serve with green salad or other tasty breads. Top with extra olives.

title: Gnocchi
ingredients: 6 ounces chambord raspberry liquor | 1 teaspoon grated lemon zest | 1 canned chipotle pepper
instructions: Combine chambord, lemon zest and chipotle pepper in a small, deep saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium heat, then reduce heat to medium low, and simmer for 5 minutes. Pour into a freezer safe container, and freeze until semi solid, about 6 hours.

title: Feta Spread for Dining With Barley
ingredients: 100 g barley | 1 teaspoon rose water ( optional ) | 80 g feta cheese
instructions: Blend all the above ingredients and add water. Make in an electric blender and process until creamy.

title: Fiesta Cheese Wedges
ingredients: 8 large grape tomatoes | 1/4 teaspoon olive oil | 6 ounces fontina cheese | 1 tablespoon guacamole
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Cut ends off each tomato and place on a paper towel to soak for 5 minutes. Wash tomatoes and cut in half. Brush with olive oil and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Place on a baking sheet and then use a brush to apply the oil. Bake for 10 - 15 minutes until the tomatoes start to brown. Cut the fontina into 1/4 thick slices, place in a small baking dish and toss in the guacamole. Serve with the wedges.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,cauliflower floret,bread flour,cream,yellow bell pepper
title: Cauliflower Focaccia
ingredients: 2 cups fresh cauliflower florets | 1/4 cup bread flour ( or 1 1/2 cups ) | 3 -4 tablespoons sour cream ( depends on taste ) | 3/4 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/4 teaspoon yellow bell pepper, chopped ( optional. i don't add )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Rinse cauliflower in cold water and shake off excess water. Slice the cauliflower into thin pieces and place in a bowl. Add bread flour, garlic salt and black pepper and mix well. Place cauliflower in a well buttered 9x13 backing pan. If you wish, sprinkle on yellow onion and pepper and sprinkle or sprinkle with additional salt. If baking for 15 - 20 minutes, sprinkle with cheese and bake for an additional 5 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Cremini and Mushroom Dip
ingredients: 10 ounces cremini mushrooms, drained | 4 dashes hot pepper sauce | 1/4 cup catsup
instructions: Chop mushrooms and place in a medium sized bowl. Add hot pepper sauce to taste or add more. Serve with a nice loaf of french bread.

title: Pepper Paste
ingredients: 30 ml tequila | 30 ml peanut oil | pepper, to meet tastes
instructions: Blend all together well in a food processor. Keep in refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock chicken,parsley,grape tomato,natural yoghurt,red pepper flake
title: Pistro Tomato Soup
ingredients: 1 liter vegetable stock or 1 liter chicken stock | 2/3 cup natural yoghurt | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes ( to your taste ) | 2 -3 grape tomatoes, halved
instructions: In a large saucepan or pan, combine the stock, yoghurt, parsley, and crushed red pepper on high heat. Bring to a boil, reduce the heat, and simmer until the sauce is thick and bubbly, about 10 minutes. Remove from the heat, stir in the tomatoes, and remove from the heat. Serve at once.

title: Coconut Milk (Cheese)
ingredients: 15 ounces canned unsweetened coconut milk
instructions: Pour the coconut milk into a small heavy saucepan. Place the pot over medium heat and bring the mixture to a boil. Turn down the heat to simmer and whisk constantly for about 5 minutes. Remove and discard the saucepan from the heat. Pour the warm mixture into a colander over a bowl and let sit for 5 minutes or until the liquid is clear. Pour the mixture into a container and refrigerate overnight, stirring occasionally. Once the next day, the milk will be thickened to a velvety consistency but not curdled. Store the coconut milk in its pan in the refrigerator. It should last up to 3 days.

Random Ingredients: sage leaf,baking powder,orange,mint leaf,chicken breast,basil leaf,red snapper fillet
title: Grilled Orange-Chili-Chicken Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh basil leaf | 1/4 cup fresh mint leaves | 1/2 cup fresh sage leaf | 1 1/2 lbs boneless red snapper fillets | 1 tablespoon baking powder | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1 orange, juice and zest of
instructions: Place first 9 ingredients in blender container, and process until smooth. Place fillets in shallow dish or glass bowl. Pour orange dressing over top, and marinate in refrigerator for 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours. Drain fillets, and place on grill over low coals, turning about 10 times, until skin is blackened.

title: Chipotle Pepper Cookies (Biscotti)
ingredients: chipotle pepper | 1/2 ounce icing sugar | 1 pinch ground cloves | 2 -3 drops red hot pepper sauce
instructions: In a small jar, combine the chipotle pepper, icing sugar and ground cloves. Close lid and shake, shaking and shaking the jar frequently, until all ingredients are combined well. Place the mixture in a small dish. Dip the rounded side of a 1 lb biscuit, if using, to coat evenly, then place on cookie press, press down flat, and lightly press the top with a wet rubber spatula to flatten the cookies slightly. Bake in a hot oven for 15 - 20 minutes at 325 degrees, or until golden brown. Remove from oven and cool on wire racks. Note, store in an airtight container.

title: Hot and Spicy Pasta Bake
ingredients: 4 slices white bread | 100 g ground meat | 100 g dark chocolate | 1/4 cup pasta sauce | 1/2 cup hazelnuts, chopped | 1/3 cup pasta sauce ( see notes )
instructions: Heat oven to 200c. Arrange bread slices in 2 greased ramekins. Spray each with oil. Cook meat and chocolate in pan over medium heat, stirring until smooth, about 3 minutes add the pasta sauce and hazelnuts. Spoon mixture into ramekins and bake for 20 - 25 minutes, until bread is golden.

title: Horseradish Potato Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs white potatoes, cooked, peeled and diced | 8 ounces mixed salad oil | 1/2 cup prepared horseradish | 8 ounces frozen whole kernel corn, thawed and drained | 2 avocados, peeled and finely diced
instructions: In bowl of a food processor, process potatoes until pureed, about 10 seconds. Whisk in remaining ingredients and refrigerate until serving time.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,pine nut,tortellini,french bread,green olive,avocado
title: Tortellini and Parmesan Cheese Rollups
ingredients: 20 slices french bread | 20 thin slices avocados, cut in 4 | 1 jar stuffed green olives, drained | 1 container soft pretzels | 1 container crumbled tortellini | 1/2 cup chopped walnuts ( optional )
instructions: Spread bread evenly with a small amount of the avocados. Top with olives, tortellini, cheese and nuts if desired. Place remaining bread slices over the filling. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: hot chili sauce,garlic clove,clear honey,salt pepper,passion fruit,fennel seed
title: Honey Roasted Fennel Seed and Passionfruit
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 tablespoon clear honey | 3 garlic cloves, peeled and very thinly sliced | 4 tablespoons hot chili sauce | salt and pepper | 1 tablespoon passion fruit ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200° c. Combine the fennel seeds, honey, garlic, chilli sauce, salt and pepper in a baking dish and roast for about 40 minutes or until the fruit is soft but not browned. Check for seasoning and serve sprinkled with the passionfruit.

Random Ingredients: white peppercorn,pork chop,bean sprout,mango,hard egg yolk
title: Mango Pork Boats
ingredients: 1/2 kg pork chop, cut into chunks | 1/2 kg raw mango | 2 hard-boiled egg yolks | 2 tablespoons white peppercorns | 2 cups bean sprouts
instructions: Place a large bamboo steamer in an ovenproof dish. Place the pork chunks on top of the bamboo steamer. Cover tightly with foil. Set in the middle of the oven and cook for 90 minutes. While the pork is cooking, peel the mango and slice finely. Discard the seed from the egg yolks. Wash and remove the centre skin of the mango slices by holding and twisting the flesh. Cut into chunks. Remove the pork chunks from the pan. Add the egg yolks to the mango chunks and whisk until the mixture thickens. Add the peppercorns and keep whisking. Add half of the bean sprouts and half of the sliced pork. Cook over a low heat for 10 - 15 minutes or until the pork is cooked. Stir through the rest of the bean sprouts.

title: Nam Pla and Mint Raita (Multicolor Pudding)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons breadcrumbs | 2 teaspoons nam pla | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon wheat flour
instructions: Put all of the ingredients in a blender and pulse until the mixture is mixed in, but is still coarse or like biscuit dough.

Random Ingredients: white onion large,sugar snap pea,lemon peel,garlic,mint sprig,baby green,prune,hintz cocoa powder
title: Minty Prune and Mint Salad
ingredients: 3 medium white onions, peeled and cut into 2 1/2 thick wedges each, 2 to 3/4 - 3/4 cups ( about 2 pounds ) | 1/2 cup sugar snap pea | 10 baby mixed greens ( i've used all three ) | 12 mint sprigs, trimmed | 1 clove garlic, peeled | 2 tablespoons dried minced prunes | 2 tablespoons hazelnut-flavored hintz dutch-processed cocoa powder | 1 lemon peel, zested
instructions: In a food processor or blender, pulse the onions and sugar until coarsely chopped. Stir the pea pods into the onion mixture and set aside. Cut the greens crosswise in half lengthwise, then in half crosswise until the sections are about 1/4 inch thick. Add the chiffonade to the greens and toss. Divide the greens among 4 cups of hot serving bowls and top with the prunes, mint, and garlic. Zest the lemon peel, then sprinkle over the plated salad.

Random Ingredients: breadcrumb,red leaf lettuce,orange juice concentrate,mango,milk chocolate,veal,swiss cheese,honey
title: Aussie Meatloaf
ingredients: 1/2 loaf unsliced breadcrumbs | 1 package mango slices | 1/2 cup canned orange juice concentrate, thawed | 1/2 lb ground veal | 1/2 lb swiss cheese, grated | 1/4 cup milk chocolate | 1/2 cup breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup minced red leaf lettuce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Coat a 9x13 baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Combine bread crumbs, mango and orange concentrates in a large bowl.

title: Baked Beans with Limes
ingredients: 3 cups ripe refried beans | 24 sheets phyllo dough, thawed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Arrange the phyllo dough evenly in a round baking dish. Spread the refried beans evenly over the phyllo sheets. Bake for 20 minutes in the preheated oven, or until puffed up and golden brown. Allow to cool.

Random Ingredients: bean,baby spinach,elderflower cordial,ginger paste,mint,rice wine,artichoke heart,vanilla extract
title: Spinach and Artichoke Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons rice wine or 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 2 tablespoons canned artichoke hearts, chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons grapeseed oil or 1 1/2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 teaspoon ginger paste ( can sub fresh minced ginger root ) | 400 g baby spinach | 2 teaspoons frozen chopped baby artichoke hearts, thawed | 2 teaspoons mint, chopped | 3 tablespoons elderflower cordial | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Combine all dressing ingredients in a screw top jar and shake well. Pour dressing in to a screw top bowl, cover with plastic wrap and chill for several hours or overnight. Add the cooked spinach to the spinach and toss to mix. Add artichokes, mint and elderflower cordial to the spinach and toss well. Add the reserved dressing and toss well to combine. Serve with a grainy baguette.

Random Ingredients: goat milk yogurt,bean sprout,horseradish,lime zest,brussels sprout
title: Vegetarian Hot Chocolate
ingredients: 1/4 cup goat's milk yogurt | 1 tablespoon minced fresh horseradish | 1 teaspoon grated lime zest | 1 tablespoon beans sprouts, drained and rinsed | 1/4 cup fresh brussels sprout, halved and leaves diagonally sliced ( about 8 )
instructions: Position rack in center of oven and heat to 400 degrees. Prepare a 3 cup baking dish with a rack in the lower third of the oven. Pour yogurt in a bowl and add remaining ingredients. Spread evenly between 2 sheets of plastic wrap.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,yellow squash,kernel corn,tomatillo,water chestnut,active yeast,egg beater substitute,shallot
title: Maggie Miller's Favorite Stove Top French Bread
ingredients: 1 cup warm water | 2 packages active dry yeast | 1/2 cup tomatillos, chopped | 1 cup reduced-sodium tomato passata | 1/2 cup shallot, chopped | 1 cup fresh corn about 5 ears of corn ( about 8 ears ) | 1/2 cup small red potato, peeled and sliced into thirds lengthwise and then into 1/2-inch slices | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained and rinsed | 3 egg beater substitute
instructions: Place the warm water and yeast in top of a double boiler over low heat and allow to stand until slightly foamy, about 10 minutes. While the yeast mixture is standing, place the tomatillos, tomato passata, and shallots into a blender. Set blender on high speed and begin to process until smooth, 2 to 3 minutes. With machine running add the corn, potato, and can of corn to machine and gradually add to a mixing bowl containing the yeast mixture. Scatter 2 egg beaters over the top and blend for 2 or 3 minutes, scraping bowl as needed to keep bowl from sticking to your hands. Add the can of corn and process until mixture achieves a creamy consistency, 2 or 3 minutes more. Transfer the mixture to a large bowl and stir in the remaining egg beaters into the dough. Shape the dough into two smooth but slightly sticky round loaves about 9 or 10 inches square and place on a greased wire rack in a dutch oven or other heavy bottomed pot. Cover and place in a warm oven. When the bread has pulled together, preheat the oven to 350°f bake the bread until a brown crust has formed on top, about 50 minutes to 1 hour. Let cool on rack. Slice loaf with a serrated knife to serve.

title: Sauerkraut, Hot Dogs & Chips
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb sauerkraut | 8 hot dogs ( such as red strips ) | 2 cups raw macaroni noodles
instructions: Boil 2 quarts of water in a large pot, just enough to cover the sauerkraut. Add the hot dogs and cook until well done. Drain the sauerkraut and return to the pot. Add the macaroni noodles, making sure to break the strands of noodles into the sauerkraut. Remove from heat. Enjoy.

title: Pumpkin Rarebit
ingredients: 1 pumpkin ( use a small delicata ) | 2 tablespoons fresh sage or 2 tablespoons dried sage | 1 teaspoon pumpkin juice | 1/4 cup toasted pistachios ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon salt and black pepper | 1 1/4 cups tomato juice or 1 1/4 cups grape juice
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f and prepare the ramekins or loaf pans with paper liners. If using the candied sage, cut small slivers or pieces off the bottom of the pumpkin with a knife. Turn the pumpkin upside down in your hand, remove the tip of the knife, and scrape the rind off the pumpkin. It will look like a small flower. Remove the tip. Cut the rind in half crosswise. The leaves will separate, but if any is left attached, trim off about 1 inch of the top shell. If your pumpkin is small, scoop out the interior flesh into a bowl. Cut the flesh in half crosswise, discard the skin and seeds. Cut a 1 inch dice from the rind if you wish. Mix the cubes into the pumpkin with the sage and add enough pumpkin juice or other flavourings to moisten. Pour into the prepared ramekins, cover and bake about 25 - 30 minutes or until the pumpkin becomes tender and a toothpick or fork goes through the middle of the rueful. Remove with a knife before serving.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,cilantro leaf,sea scallop,buttermilk,green cardamom pod,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Scallops With Polenta and Pecorino-Cheese
ingredients: salt and freshly ground green cardamom pod | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil, 3-4 tablespoons | 4 ounces sea scallops, trimmed, cut diagonally into 3/4-inch wide slices | 2 green cardamom pods, sliced 1-inch long at the tip | 1 1 1/2 cups hot buttermilk, room temperature | 1/2 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Position 1 rack in the bottom third of the oven and preheat to 450°f in a 12 cup frying pan, warm the oil over medium high heat until it shimmers, then add 1/2 cup of the scallops, and cook, shaking the pan often, until well browned, about 3 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the scallops to a cutting board and, using a metal spatula, transfer the scallops to a chopping board and set them aside. Pour off most of the oil but leave 1 tablespoon. Scatter the remaining scallops over the scallops in the frying pan and sprinkle with the freshly grated cheese. Scatter the scallops on top. Scatter the remaining 1/4 cup scallops over and, using 1/4 cup water, give the scallops a dry shake, sprinkling with the freshly grated parmigiano, and sprinkle over the cheese. Scatter the cilantro leaves over everything. Bake until the scallops are hot through, about 3 minutes, or until the scallops are puffed and golden brown. Serve immediately.

title: Cheese Queso Contento
ingredients: 3 slices bacon | 1 1/2 lbs ground chuck | 1 tablespoon onion flakes ( or 1 small onion, finely chopped ) | 1 -2 serrano chili, seeded and finely chopped ( or to taste ) | 1 -2 tablespoon cooking wine ( i use cooking sherry or white wine ) | 1 cup shredded provolone cheese ( can sub mozzarella or other hard cheese ), divided
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp, crumble and set aside. Drain off fat and set aside. Drain most of the fat out of the meat, you may need to do this in several batches. Brown meat with onion flakes and chilies in remaining fat. Add wine and cook over low heat, stirring often, until most of the liquid has evaporated. Sprinkle half the cheese with cheese, then stir. If the cheese seems runny, thin it out with some additional cooking water, if you need it. Spread meat back on top of cheese and top with bacon bits. You may have a fine consistency, you may need to add more chilies or wine if you feel it is too dry. If you like it softer, stir in some more cheese, if not add additional flour. Serve on a platter.

title: Red Wine Vanilla Dijon Mustard
ingredients: 1 small red onion, finely chopped | 1/3 cup red wine or 1/3 cup skim milk | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Combine all the ingredients and whisk the mixture quickly until the oil has been incorporated. Season with sea salt and black pepper.

title: Earl's Corn and Spring Onions over Sweet Crispy Crackers
ingredients: 4 spring onions | 5 ears corn on the cob ( or another variety of corn if corn is not available or you want to use more chopped corn )
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c or 300f or gas mark remove the cob from the cob. Wash well and trim the root end. Cut the corn from the cob if it is thick or in small chunks if you don't have to use. The corn can be drained if you don't wish to or if you want to. Arrange the onions on a baking tray. Warm the corn in a microwave, or just in the oven. Turning occasionally, pile the chopped corn onto each onion. Top with crumbly coating of choice. Place tray in oven for about 10 to 15 minutes or until the crumbs are golden.

title: Green Masala
ingredients: 4 whole red chilies | 1/2 kg pumpkin puree
instructions: Wash the chilies. Peel the skin off, slit them lengthwise and wipe dry with a damp cloth. Heat a heavy bottomed pan over medium high heat. When the oil starts crackling, add the chilies. Toss in the pumpkin puree. Stir once or twice and fry well on medium high flame. Cook for 1 - 2 minutes or until the pumpkin is soft and all the water oozes out. Serve hot.

title: Simple Mexican Meat Loaf
ingredients: 2 lbs lean beef chuck, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 can sliced black olives, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Place meat cubes in a large resealable plastic bag. Sprinkle with olives. Pour remaining ingredients over meat. Turn to coat. Cover tightly and let sit for 3 hours. Place meat in a slow cooker and set on high. Cook for 6 to 8 hours.

Random Ingredients: italian salad dressing mix,english muffin,gruyere cheese,meat,cocoa powder,vanilla extract,pace picante sauce,sugar
title: Aussie Meatball Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 english muffins, split | 1 cup gruyere cheese, shredded | 3/4 - 1 lb ground meat | 1 package dry italian salad dressing mix | 2 teaspoons vanilla extract | 2/3 cup fat free italian-style salad dressing mix | 1/3 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 1/4 cup pace picante sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Cut split english muffins in half. Place half on a cookie sheet. Combine gruyere and meat, then set aside. Combine all dry salad dressing mix ingredients, stirring well with a fork to blend thoroughly. Add to meat. Spread over bread halves. Bake in preheated oven until toasted about 10 minutes, then sprinkle over cheese, cook until cheese and meat are no longer pink, about 3 - 5 minutes more. Serve immediately.

title: Noodles With Spinach and Egg Whites
ingredients: 1 package dry hot noodle | 1 cup small baby spinach | 1/2 egg white | 1/4 cup tarragon ( fresh chopped )
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add hot noodles and cook for 3 minutes. Drain noodles and return to pot.

title: White Beans Cheesy
ingredients: 400 g white beans | 400 g spaghetti sauce | 1 can tomato puree | 100 -150 g cheese, grated
instructions: Chop up the beans. Put the beans and the sauce in a saucepan with a good quality lid. Bring to the boil and let it cook and stir for 5 minutes, stirring frequently. Preheat oven to 200 degree celsius. Cut cheese into small cubes and add to the sauce mixture. Put into casserole dish, top with the remaining cheese and bake at 200 degree celsius for 20 minutes.

title: Spring Onion Soup
ingredients: 1 bunch spring onion, finely chopped | 250 g low fat ricotta cheese
instructions: Boil your spaghetti until cooked. While you are waiting for the water to boil, place the spring onions and a tsbs of salt in a frying pan. When they are soft, remove from heat. Drain pasta and return to pot, draining excess water if desired. Add the sauce to the pot and return to a simmer.

title: Quick Steak  With Saffron in It
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin | 6 ounces cold water | 2 ounces sake | 2 teaspoons saffron, dissolved in 1/4 cup hot water | 2 leaves escarole ( optional ) | 1 kiwi, peeled, minced or 1/4 teaspoon ground green onion
instructions: Score sirloin with sharp knife, if desired, into 3 diagonal slices. Place beef in shallow dish.

title: Smoky Red Beans and Provolone Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 can fat-free refried beans | 2 cups shredded iceberg lettuce | 2 cups finely sliced provolone cheese, divided | 1 1/2 cups guacamole | 1/3 cup sour cream | 1/3 cup prepared prepared sloppy joe mix | 1/4 cup crushed ice | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram
instructions: Stir refried bean filling, lettuce, provolone, sour cream and 1/4 teaspoon marjoram in a 2 quart baking dish. Spoon guacamole on top. Top with remaining moacamole, then remaining toppings. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Baba Ganouj
ingredients: 2 large eggplants, peeled and thinly sliced | 1/4 cup flat leaf parsley or 1/4 cup cilantro, chopped ( about 3 tablespoons )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°f. Arrange the eggplant slices in a single layer on a rimmed baking sheet. Bake until tender and browned in spots, about 15 minutes, stirring once. Let cool to warm, about 10 minutes. Transfer the slices to a bowl and mash. Add the parsley or cilantro and stir to combine. Transfer to a serving bowl. Makes 6 servings.

title: Spicy Baked Beef
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef chuck or 1 1/2 lbs chuck roast, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1/2 teaspoon accent seasoning | 1 cup basil leaves, torn
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Coat a 5 to 6 quart baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. In a large bowl, toss beef with the accent and 1/4 cup basil leaves. Using two sheets of wax paper, wrap meat, overlapping, in several 10 inch strips. Pour any excess marinade into a 13x9 inch baking dish. Spread meat on top of the basil and drizzle with remaining half cup basil. Cover and bake, basting meat over night. Remove from oven, uncover and bake 40 minutes more. Serve with roasted vegetables.

title: Southern Fried Loaded Peas With Russian Vodka
ingredients: 1 bag frozen peas | 2 -4 cups ham, diced | 1 bottle vodka | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon cajun seasoning | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon nutmeg | 2 teaspoons peppermint extract
instructions: Place frozen peas in large sauce pan, add cold water to cover. Bring to boil and cook 1 - 2 minutes. Drain water. Place ham, vodka, cajun seasoning, nutmeg, and peppermint extract in a pan, add peas and cook over medium heat for 3 minutes, stirring constantly.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,spinach,swordfish steak,cream mushroom soup,tomato green chile pepper
title: Mexican Shark and Spinach
ingredients: 1 pound swordfish steaks | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 can chopped green chilies | 1 cup chopped fresh spinach | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers
instructions: Place the swordfish in a large saucepan, and cover with lightly salted water. Bring to a boil, and immediately reduce heat to medium low. Cover, and simmer until the fish flakes easily with a fork, about 10 minutes. Drain, and allow meat to steam dry for about 10 minutes. Remove from heat. Meanwhile, mix the cream of mushroom soup, green chilies, and spinach together in a microwave safe bowl. Heat in the microwave for about 15 min, or until hot, but not boiling. Pour about half the heated soup mixture into the egg white, and beat vigorously with a fork or whisk. Add the cream of mushroom soup mixture to the egg white in the saucepan. Cook and stir over medium heat until it no longer thickens, about 4 to 5 min, and remove from heat. Top with more soup mixture, if desired.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,tomato puree,hamburger,rib eye steak,banana,pork tenderloin,steak
title: Tropical Beef, Pork and Banana Sandwiches
ingredients: 4 boneless rib-eye steaks, at least 1-inch thick | 4 pork tenderloin, at least 1-inch thick | 4 sweet onions, cut into thin wedges | 1 cup fresh tomato puree | salt and pepper | 3 bananas, cut into 2 inch long wedges | 4 -6 thick slices hot cooked hamburger, such as casserole, such as texas toast and grilling burgers
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Arrange the steaks in a 5 quart baking dish and season generously with salt and pepper. Bake for 15 minutes or until cooked as desired, turning once. Transfer steaks to a cutting board and let stand 5 to 10 minutes. Pull the meat off the bones and remove the white membrane surrounding it. Cut steaks into thin strips, about ½ or 1 inch wide. Meanwhile, warm 3 tablespoons of the puree in a small saucepan over medium heat. When it begins to bubble, scrape up any browned bits and simmer for about 2 minutes, until reduced by half. Set aside to cool. Spread the sliced onions on the steaks and season with salt and pepper. Top each steak with some tomato puree, then a generous portion of the sliced sweet onions and then some banana slices. Arrange the hamburgers on top of the onions and season with salt and pepper. Top each sandwich with 1 or 2 slices of the hot cooked beans. If desired, spread the remaining 1/2 cup of puree on the top of each sandwich.

title: Perfect Sausage and Rice
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups basmati rice ( or whatever kind you like ) | 2 -3 teaspoons poultry seasoning | 1/2 - 1 tablespoon hot sauce
instructions: Pour water into rice cooker bowl, add ingredients except hot sauce. Secure lid firmly. You don't want the steam going through the lid. After 6 - 8 minutes remove lid, stir rice with a fork, do the same thing over the sink. Leave lid on the rice for another 10 - 15 minutes. Turn off rice cooker, and let sit 5 minutes. Fluff rice with fork once or twice, and serve if desired..

title: Yellow Pea & Parsnip Hash
ingredients: 1 tablespoon oil | 1/2 lb yellow split peas | 1/2 lb parsnip | 1/2 lb dates | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Saute veggies in oil until soft. Add dates and tabasco sauce.

title: Fruity Fondue (Tantalizing Mexican Apples)
ingredients: 5 -6 green apples ( i know, but they are delicious inside ) | 1/2 tablespoon mccormick's hot salsa seasoning | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 1 tablespoon wine ( optional ) | 1 can chopped mild green chilies
instructions: Put everything in a fondue pot and keep warm over low heat. Serve hot, warm, with warm bread.

title: Cannellini Bean Rolls (To Fly)
ingredients: 1 medium cannellini beans, cooked | 1 cup lettuce leaf, shredded | 1/2 package rice paper
instructions: Drain the beans in a colander, reserving the water. Place the shredded lettuce in a blender with about 1 cup of the beans and the liquid. Blend until a very smooth sauce consistency. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour and up to 24 hours. Place a few fresh bean sprouts on each piece of rice paper and fold it in half. Dip the two rolls in the sauce and line the tips and edges of the rice papers with bean sprouts on the edge of the roll. Slice and serve.

title: Spanish Stewed Meat
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb stew meat | chopped green olives ( with or without pimiento peppers ) | 1 can sliced stuffed green olives
instructions: Combine all meat ingredients in crockpot. Cook on high for 6 - 8 hrs or low for 8 - 10 hours. Serve over rice, if desired.

title: Dos  - Traditional French Trail Mix for Elk, Shuckers and Meatballs
ingredients: 1 lb pumpkin, peeled and cut into 1-inch cubes. | 1 can grapes | 1/2 cup dried oregano leaves | 1 bay leaf
instructions: In a dutch oven cook pumpkin in boiling water for about 15 minutes, then remove it from the water and add the grapes, oregano, bay leaf and season with salt and pepper. Cover and simmer for about 1 1/2 hours. Remove bay leaf and add salt to taste.

title: Pasta Fritta and Eggs
ingredients: 14 fluid ounces pasta, your choice | 1 egg yolk | 3 tablespoons rocket ( rocket or fresh salad leaves ) | 1/2 teaspoon sage | salt
instructions: Cook the past according to the directions. Toss the pasta with the egg yolk and rocket. Season to taste, stir through the sage and serve.

title: Irish Cheese Tea Bread
ingredients: 2 cups vegetable stock | 4 tablespoons unsalted bisquick | 2 teaspoons grated orange rind | 1/4 cup black tea | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 2 cups shredded sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Put all ingredients except for the cheese, in a casserole dish, and heat to boiling over simmering water. Add the cheese and boil for a few minutes, or until the cheese has melted, stirring often, serve immediately.

title: Crock Pot Beef-Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin, trimmed of fat | 3 cups long grain white rice, uncooked | 1/2 teaspoon pepper, coarsely mixed into a paste
instructions: Combine all ingredients in crock pot.

title: Lamb & White Bean Casserole
ingredients: 1 jar white beans, drained and rinsed | 2 cans cream of chicken soup | 1 tablespoon dried onion flakes | 1 loaf bread, crusts removed and cut into cubes | 1 medium onion, diced | 3 shallots, minced | 1 teaspoon sumac
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Combine beans & soup, spices, bread & onion.

title: Beer Mustard
ingredients: 1/4 cup nonfat sour cream | 1 1/4 cups buttermilk | 4 egg yolks | 1/4 teaspoon tarragon vinegar | 1/2 cup beer
instructions: Whisk the sour cream and buttermilk together in a small bowl. Whisk the egg yolks in a small bowl until they are very pale and thick, about 5 minutes. Place the mustard in a jar with a tight fitting lid.

Random Ingredients: cherry,caraway seed,baby spinach,dill pickle,vegetable shortening,green cardamom pod,purple onion
title: Green Beans with Cherries
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable shortening | 1 tablespoon purple onion, diced | 1/2 teaspoon caraway seed | 5 green cardamom pods, halved | 1 pound small purple onion | 1 package frozen cooked baby spinach, thawed | 1/2 cup chopped fresh dill pickles
instructions: Heat the oil in a skillet over medium low heat, and cook and stir the onion with the caraway seeds and green cardamom pods until fragrant, about 5 minutes. Stir in the purple onions, and cook and stir until fragrant, about 2 minutes more. Pour in half of the spinach and baby onions. Cook and stir until the spinach is tender and slightly wilted, about 5 minutes more, then remove from heat. Melt the remaining butter in a skillet over medium low heat. Spread the mustard on the spinach mixture to evenly cover the whole surface, and cook and stir until the mustard has turned a shade, about 5 minutes. Pour in the spinach with the pickles.

title: Easy Chapati Bread
ingredients: 1 cup plain flour | 1 ounce margarine ( or ghee ) | 1 cup lettuce
instructions: Put the flour in a plastic bag and put all the other ingredients in it. Close bag and shake until well mixed. If it sticks, just add a bit more flour. Cut in pieces then gently toss around in flour until it starts to stick. Put out onto a board sprinkled with flour. If it sticks, just push it down one more time. The bread will be wet and it will be ready to toast. Heat up a flat pan and put a small amount of margarine on one side of the bread. Spread it with some filling. Add filling to it and roll up like a swiss roll to make a nice roll. Place on a baking tray and bake in a moderate oven until crisp. Eat with any leftover filling.

Random Ingredients: apple,dijon mustard,sea salt,yellow bell pepper,maple syrup,rice wine
title: Smoked Maple Peppers
ingredients: 3 small yellow bell peppers, tops trimmed | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 1 tablespoon apple puree or 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 2 tablespoons country-style rice wine or 2 tablespoons dry white wine | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Preheat broiler. Arrange peppers in an ovenproof skillet coated with cooking spray.

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,mint leaf,apricot preserve,half,rump roast,rock salt
title: French Dip Sandwiches on the Rocks
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless rump roast in plastic bag | 3/4 cup apricot preserves | 1/2 - 3/4 cup half-and-half | 1 tablespoon dried oregano leaves | 1/2 teaspoon rock salt | fresh mint leaves, snipped
instructions: Remove meat from bag.

Random Ingredients: ra el hanout spice mix,fennel seed,pancetta,olive
title: Fennel (The Easy One)
ingredients: 1 lb pancetta, chopped or 1 lb bacon | 1 teaspoon fennel seed, ground | 1 teaspoon ras el hanout spice mix | 1 tablespoon extra-virgin olive | 1 tablespoon sliced pitted olive ( garnish )
instructions: Place the pancetta in a skillet over medium heat. Cook, stirring frequently until the pancetta pieces are a dark brown and crispy, about 10 minutes. While the bacon is cooking, sprinkle the fennel seeds with the zayon. When the pancetta is done, remove it to a bowl and crumble it. To the pan drippings, add the ras el hanout and black olive and stir for one minute. Add the pancetta to skillet and cook over medium low heat for another 2 - 3 minutes, turning the pancetta slices with tongs every few minutes. Transfer the pancetta to a serving plate and sprinkle with olives, if desired.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,black peppercorn,pork loin,sausage,enchilada sauce,lemon juice zest
title: A Fantastic Wet
ingredients: 2 lbs sausages or 2 lbs chorizo sausage, chopped | 1/2 cup grand marnier, plus 3 t. grand marnier | 3 lemons, juice and zest of | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1 tablespoon crushed black peppercorns | 1 jar enchilada sauce ( we prefer la victoria enchilada sauce )
instructions: In a slow cooker, combine all ingredients. Stir to blend well and cook on low 5 hours or on high 3 hours. Serve with tortillas.

title: Spicy Sugar Snap Pea Snails
ingredients: 1 lb sugar snap pea | 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes
instructions: Snap off the yellow stem from the snap peas. Rinse the snap peas in cold water and pat them dry with paper towels. Slice the snap peas crosswise in half again and sprinkle with chili flakes. Serve at once, or cover and refrigerate for up to two days.

title: Homemade Beef Roast
ingredients: 1/2 cup worcestershire sauce | 1/2 teaspoon garlic, crushed
instructions: Blend worcestershire sauce, garlic, and dry mustard in blender or food processor until smooth.

title: Applebee's Chipotle Beef Brisket for Two
ingredients: 3 -5 lbs beef brisket | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 2 teaspoons dried chipotle powder | 1/2 teaspoon black pepper | 1 can sliced beet, drained | 3 ounces canned green beans, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Place brisket in non stick 8 by 3 inch baking dish or roasting pan. Sprinkle with tarragon, chipotle black pepper, black pepper, and chipotle powder. Drain beet slices and add to dish. Bake in the preheated oven for one hour. Turn beef over, add beans, and bake for 45 minutes longer.

title: Puerto Rican Peas
ingredients: 1/4 cup mirin | 1/8 teaspoon sea salt | 1 cup frozen peas | 3 tablespoons grapefruit juice
instructions: Boil the peas for five minutes. Meanwhile, in a shaker combine the mirin with the salt and bring to a boil. Add the peas water, blend well, remove from heat and stir in just the grapefruit juice. Pour into warm sterilized jars immediately. Seal and place in a hot water bath until seal is sealable, about 30 minutes.

title: Cumin Jelly
ingredients: 1 jalapeno pepper | 1 teaspoon ground cumin ( optional )
instructions: Wearing rubber gloves, carefully peel the skin off the pepper and then cut into very small pieces. Insert a slit into the peppers, then press through a paper towel, trying to remove the blackened outer skin. The chili pepper should be finely chopped. Pour the remaining liquid from the pepper into a dry frying pan and bring to a boil, add the cumin and cover for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let sit until cool enough to handle, then stir in the jalapeno pepper and allow to cool completely. This can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 1 month.

title: Grison's Shredded Beef
ingredients: 1 fat-trimmed steak | 6 cloves ( i used 3 whole ) | 15 ounces pineapple chunks ( drained ) | 3 -4 fresh apples ( such as golden delicious ) | 2 tablespoons greek oregano | 1 canned chili ( i used pernil ) | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon | 2 teaspoons dried chili ( new mexican type, or equivalent brand )
instructions: Remove all visible fat from the meat and cut into strips across the grain. Slice the apples into small wedges. Place them in a colander with the salt from the pineapple and rinse. Slice the chilies lengthwise into 1/2 thick slices. Place both of the drained pineapple chunks into a strainer and place into an 8x8 pyrex or equivalent dish or roasting pan. Add all remaining ingredients, except the meat and onion, into a blender and puree until smooth. Add the meat to the mixture and mix. Place meat in large pan and pour sauce over.

Random Ingredients: thai red curry paste,white bread flour,cumin,onion soup mix,red capsicum
title: Spicy Thai Red Capsicums
ingredients: 10 ounces sweet red capsicums | 1 sachet dry onion soup mix | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 can white bread flour | 1 -2 teaspoon thai red curry paste
instructions: Cut capsicums and remove the seeds. Place capsicum in a microwave safe bowl, cover and cook on full power for 3 minutes or until capsicum is soft. Add onion soup mix and cumin and mix. Add flour and mix till a soft dough forms. Divide dough into 12 balls and mould with your fingers on the greased baking tray. Roll out into 12 x 8 cm circles. Use a knife to slash a 2 cm cross onto the centre of each circle. Brush each biscuit with water and bake on c oven tray at 160c for 12 - 15 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,corn,baby bok choy,grain white rice,raisin
title: Mushroom and Raisin Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 1/2 cup medium grain white rice | 2 tablespoons raisins | 1 bunch baby bok choy, trimmed | 1/2 cup baby bok choy, thinly sliced | 1 button mushroom, thinly sliced
instructions: Place rice and raisins in a medium saucepan.

Random Ingredients: chicken,pancetta,sherry wine,raspberry,broccoli floret,amarula cream liqueur,red pepper
title: Tasty Chicken and Chardonnay
ingredients: 1 tablespoon pancetta, finely chopped | 3/4 cup brie round, cut into small pieces | 1 cup broccoli floret, fresh | 10 slices chicken | 1/4 cup dry sherry wine | 2 tablespoons amarula cream liqueur | 1 cup fresh raspberry, halved ( approx. 2.5 cups )
instructions: Saute pancetta in large nonstick fry pan on medium high heat for about 3 minutes or until crispy. Add brie, then stir in broccoli and chicken. Cover and cook on medium to high heat for 1 minute. Add sherry and amarula cream liqueur. Cover and reduce heat to medium high. Cook just until chicken is cooked through. Spoon over warmed chardonnay and garnish with raspberries on top. Serve with fresh baked or fresh bread.

title: Baked Couscous
ingredients: 1 cup couscous | 1/4 cup maraschino cherry ( sliced or chopped ) | 1/4 teaspoon anise seed, crushed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Grease a baking dish.

title: Venison and Shrimp Salad With Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb venison, cut in 1-inch cubes | 1/2 lb shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 3 garlic cloves, minced | 1 bunch grapes, halved or 1 bunch cherries, rinsed | 1/2 lb sultana ( golden raisins ) | 1 box grape rolls, in olive oil ( half prawns ), in olive oil or 1 box grape shells, in honey | 1/2 cup sliced almonds
instructions: Toss meat with 1 tbsp of olive oil. Arrange on large plate, then top with garlic, chopped grapes, sultanas and almonds. Drizzle with remaining 1 tbsp oil and honey to taste.

title: Peach and Cheese Pizzas
ingredients: 1 1/2 pints diced peaches | 1/3 cup dry sherry | 1/3 cup grand marnier | 1 tablespoon wasabi | 1 tablespoon minced fresh chives | 1 cup plain yogurt | 24 slices pepperjack cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Combine the diced peaches, sherry, grand marnier, wasabi, and chives in a bowl. Combine until well blended. Fill each pepperjack cheese slice with some of the peach and cheese mixture, and place on a sheet of parchment paper. Using a tooth pick, poke a hole in each pepperjack cheese slice. Bake on the middle rack of the oven until the cheese is browned and bubbly, about 10 minutes. To serve, place a pepperjack cheese slice on a plate, and drizzle with yogurt.

Random Ingredients: tortilla,button mushroom,parsnip,pistachio nut,portabella mushroom,double cream,ice cream,fig
title: Mini Wild Mushrooms & Cream Tortilla Gateaux
ingredients: 1/2 small parsnip, diced and left whole | 1/4 small portabella mushroom, sliced in half if smaller, chopped roughly | 200 g figs, sliced or 220 g fresh figs, snipped | 1 teaspoon pistachio nut, grated | 1 tablespoon extra light cream | ice cream | 2 -4 slices whole grain plain toasted bread | crushed tortilla
instructions: Mix together the parsnip, mushroom, figs, pistachios and cream until well combined. Top with extra light cream and crushed tortilla. Melt extra light cream on the grill. Toast bread in oven on 200 200'c until bread is crispy and golden and pesto sauce has a nice flavour.

title: Homemade Becel Dough
ingredients: 4 cups nonfat dry milk powder | 1 egg
instructions: Add skim milk powder and egg to a bowl and mix well with a fork. Use an ice cream scoop to form 3 to 4 pieces of dough. On a clean flat surface, roll out each piece into a circle 5 inches in diameter. Turn over and repeat. Cover with a towel and let them rest for 20 minutes. Take one circle and flatten it out between 2 sheets of waxed paper. Spread half of the dough with a spoonful of egg mixture and fold over to form a triangle.

title: Easy Low Fat Cumin Paste
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tapioca ( unrefined ) | 1/3 cup chinese cooking wine | 1 bay leaf | 1 tablespoon cumin seed
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the tapioca, wine and bay leaf. Place in the refrigerator for at least one hour to let the flavors develop. Roast the cumin seeds and dry roast them as you want them, about 1 minute or until they begin to pop. Add a teaspoon of this mixture to a warm cast iron grill pan or skillet over medium high heat and toast them, stirring from time to time, until fragrant and they begin to darken slightly. Remove the cumin from the heat and set aside to rest. In a mortar and pestle, grind the cumin, about 1 tablespoon, to a smooth powder. Add the cumin, toasted spices and continue processing until desired thickness is achieved. Place in a jar and refrigerate for up to 2 weeks.

title: Lamb & Raisin Lasagna
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 medium lamb, cubed | 2 cups raisins | 20 lasagna noodles
instructions: To make sauce. Heat oil in a large skillet. Brown lamb on both sides. Pour off fat. Add raisins. Cover and simmer for 1/2 hr or until tender. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Pea and Pear Wings
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chunky peanut butter | 1 egg yolk | 1 pound chicken wings | 1 pear - chopped
instructions: Place 1 tablespoon peanut butter in each wing with the skin on until just covered. Place in a plastic bag for 20 minutes. After 20 minutes, press with your thumb to make a hole in the peanut butter to fill the hole. Pour egg yolk on top, and let it heat for about 5 minutes. Place chicken wings over peanut butter in the bag to be stuffed later. Refrigerate for the remaining 20 minutes. Place a few small stones in the bottom of your oven, and preheat to 325 degrees f. Place the remaining peanut butter in a shallow dish. Place the peanut butter in a small saucepan with a lid. Remove the skin and seeds from the pear and place the juice in the pan. Mix this mixture with a spoon, adding some water if it is too thick. To serve, remove the chicken wings from the bag, and set aside in a dish. When they are cooled, remove the wing skins from the bag and place back into the peanut butter. You should have 12 to 14 chicken wings total. Garnish, sprinkle a handful of chopped peanuts on the chicken, and drizzle a small amount of the pan sauce on top.

Random Ingredients: tomato puree,brown sugar,bay leaf,green bell pepper,soymilk,grain white rice,tamari
title: Soymilk Sweet and Sour Rice Bowl
ingredients: 1 cup brown sugar | 1/4 cup tamari | 1 bay leaf | 8 cups water | 1 1/2 cups medium grain white rice, rinsed | 2 cans tomato puree | 2/3 cup plain soymilk
instructions: In a heavy pot, combine brown sugar, tamari, bay leaf and water. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Add rice and return to the boil, stirring. Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer until water is absorbed, about 15 minutes. Transfer rice to a sieve and dry in the pot. Remove bay leaf. Mix tomato puree and soy milk together in a small bowl to make gravy. Serve hot or cold.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,veal,broccoli floret,white vinegar,ice water,mexican cheese,shallot
title: Mexican Veal and Broccoli Pie
ingredients: 2 ounces ground veal | 1 1/2 tablespoons minced shallots | 1 1/2 tablespoons distilled white vinegar | 1 teaspoon mango chutney | 1/2 cup ice water | 2 cups broccoli florets | 2 tablespoons sliced fresh mexican cheese ( optional )
instructions: Combine ground veal, shallots, vinegar, chutney, and ice water in a bowl.

title: Italian Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 package grated parmesan cheese | 2 cups shredded asiago cheese | 1 small green bell pepper, chopped
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the parmesan cheese, asiago cheese, and green bell pepper. Form into a loaf shape with a serrated knife. Chill while making other ingredients. Slice and serve on crusty hard roll.

title: Ham With Chilli (Shirayang Naeng)
ingredients: 1 lb ham, cut in thin slices | 12 -15 thai chiles, sliced in rounds
instructions: Heat oil & fry the chillies until lightly caramalised. Add ham slices, stir fry until crispy & brown. Serve hot.

title: Rwandan Beef for the Crock of the Lamb (Tomkha)
ingredients: 1 lb lean beef stew meat, cut crosswise in 1-inch pieces ( or use lamb ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons light flavored butter | 1 tablespoon anise seed or 1 teaspoon anise extract | 1/4 teaspoon fresh grated nutmeg
instructions: Preheat oven to 375f degrees. In shallow metal roasting pan or other baking dish, melt butter over medium high heat. When butter foams, add the ground beef.

Random Ingredients: shrimp,coriander seed,bean,quinoa,lime juice zest,fish sauce,phyllo pastry,white rice
title: Spicy Shrimp & Quinoa Phyllo Wraps
ingredients: 16 dried shrimp ( can be bought at asian grocery stores or asian markets ) | 1/3 cup quinoa ( i like to sub regular white rice ) | 1/3 cup cooked white rice or 1/3 cup brown rice and wild rice blend | 1 teaspoon coriander seeds or 1 teaspoon cumin | 2 teaspoons lime juice and zest, freshly grated | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 1/3 cup bean, cooked ( can be topped with frozen vegetables ) | 10 sheets phyllo pastry
instructions: Cook rice according to recipe on package. Add other ingredients into separate bowl and mix well. You can use your favorite recipe. You can also add other ingredients in a different order. Lay the sheets of pastry on paper towel. Brush or brush the edges with egg white and fold the two over and crimp the edges. Poke a hole in the center of pastry in the shape of a lid. Fill pastry hole with the shrimp mixture, packing it down, and sealing with egg white and sprinklings of your favorite spice mixture. Bake for 15 minutes in a hot oven or bake a few minutes at 400°f while you are doing your final mix. To bake in the oven, place a plate upside down on a plate to take your time. When it has reached the desired temperature, put a scoop of sweet potato on top and place in the microwave for 20 seconds or until it is warmed through. Then, top with scoop of sweet potato and put in the microwave for a further 30 - 45 seconds or until it has warmed through. Dip in some lime juice and place on plate to serve. A small jar of trader joe's tamari may also be added for a bit of spice. These may also be cut into large squares and eaten as finger food.

Random Ingredients: russet potato,ginger paste,tomato ketchup,soy sauce,caster sugar
title: Mummy's Mild and Easy Chinese Flavoured Spiced Roast Potatoes
ingredients: 1/4 cup low sodium soy sauce | 1/4 cup tomato ketchup | 2 tablespoons caster sugar | 1 tablespoon ginger paste or 1 tablespoon fresh ginger, puree | 1 kg russet potato | 1 tablespoon caster sugar or 1 tablespoon ginger paste, pulp
instructions: In saucepan, combine soy sauce, ketchup, sugar, ginger and ginger paste. Stir over medium heat for a two minutes to dissolve the sugar. Add washed potato and cook for five minutes or until tender when pierced with a fork. Remove from heat, cool completely and cut potatoes in half. Slice each half into about 5 finger lengths and place cut side down on a paper towel lined baking sheet to dry out. Preheat oven to 200c/fan 160c/gas roast the potato halves in the oven for 30 minutes or until golden brown all over. Remove from oven and rub off excess moisture. Return potato pieces to the baking tray and coat with caster sugar. Return to the oven and bake for five minutes more or until tender and the sauce has reduced and thickened slightly. Serve with pickled mustard.

title: Swiss Veal
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs veal ( sliced thin ) | onion powder
instructions: If you are using a thick piece of veal, slice it thin and sprinkle them with onion powder. Place half a slice of veal into a microwave safe container. Place other half on top of the veal. Cover the meat with about half a teaspoon of onion powder and microwave for about 6 - 8 minutes on high. If your turkey is really lean, you may need to place more onion powder on top of the meat after you remove it from the microwave. You may also need to sprinkle more onion powder. My note, i used a combination of both onion and salt and pepper and it was so unbelievable that people could get compliments of it. I also took all of a veggie from a local deli and used some fresh herbs. I added 2 teaspoons of flour and 2 teaspoons of onion powder. We loved the taste. I served on top of steamed eggs. I loved the onion and pepper and didn't have to think about it since i cooked the veal in the veal drippings, it was tender enough to slice.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke,plum,hazelnut,oyster,plain flour,green pepper,yellow pepper,cannellini bean
title: Veggies and Honey Mash
ingredients: 800 g cannellini beans, drained, rinsed, and shaken dry | 150 g mixed mushrooms, cut into wedges | 300 g oysters, shelled, chopped ( or steamed or steamed canned ) | 1 dash liquid smoke | 1 yellow pepper, chopped | 1 green pepper, chopped | 40 g hazelnuts, roughly chopped | plain flour, for dusting
instructions: Cook beans in lightly salted boiling water for 2 - 3 minutes or until tender. Drain well. Tip beans into a colander, sprinkle with oil and set a plate on top to catch as much liquid as possible. Press a large metal spoon or round of foil on to foil, leaving the foil about 1 2cm wide. Place mushrooms on top of the foil, spray with oil and seasonings. Sprinkle over any remaining water, wrap tightly in the foil and place on the plate. Stand for 5 minutes. Place the oysters on the plate, scatter over herbs and drizzle with liquid. Wrap the foil around the olives. Bake on a medium oven, gas mark 4 200c or 400°f for 20 minutes. Garnish with coriander and serve.

Random Ingredients: white vermouth,kaffir lime leaf,macadamia nut,celery rib,cardamom seed
title: Kaffir Lime Daiquiri
ingredients: 1/3 cup dry white vermouth | 1 tablespoon kaffir lime leaves ( fresh lime leaves ) | 1 celery rib, finely chopped | 4 cardamom seeds, cracked ( about 2 teaspoons ) | 1/4 cup toasted macadamia nuts
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine vermouth, lime leaves, celery and cardamom seeds with 1 teaspoon of water and stir until liquid is absorbed. Cover.

title: Brandy Dessert Tortillas
ingredients: 2 tortillas | 1 tablespoon prepared apricot jam | 1 tablespoon brandy | 1 leaf coriander
instructions: Split the tortillas horizontally. Spread the jam evenly over each of the tortillas. Arrange one coriander leaf, over the jam and then the two halves together. Sprinkle with brandy. Roll up each piece.

title: Crispy Bacon Chutney
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups fat free chicken stock | 2 tablespoons unflavored gelatin | 2 slices bacon, diced | 1 tablespoon garlic, chopped | 1 cup shredded cabbage | 1 tablespoon sweet cherries | 1 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Mix chicken stock with gelatin in a saucepan. Cook with a wire whisk over medium heat until gelatin is dissolved. Remove from heat and stir in bacon, garlic, cabbage, cherries and garam masala. Stir until combined.

Random Ingredients: baby oyster,onion salt,icing sugar,bell pepper,bay leaf,green pea,italian plum tomato,prosciutto
title: Prosciutto Oysters
ingredients: 6 large salted flat anchovies ( if they are not in the sauce, they can be found in most grocery stores ) | 6 small green pea pods or 6 small snow peas | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning mixed spice ( or crushed fresh herbs, such as basil, thyme, parsley, or marjoram ) | 1 teaspoon onion salt | 1 bay leaf | 5 slices thinly sliced prosciutto ( thin slices ) | 1 cup baby oysters, with liquor | 1 cup finely bell pepper, cut into matchsticks ( any colour )
instructions: Wash and dry anchovies and discard any misshapen anchovies at room temperature or they can be left to soften for up to 3 days in the refrigerator. Place pea pods or snow peas in a bowl, add 1 teaspoon italian seasoning or crushed fresh, chopped herbs or dried herbs, and toss to combine. Place a large saute pan or a frying pan over medium heat. Add 1 teaspoon anchovy flavored oil, 1 slice prosciutto, and 1/2 teaspoon onion salt, and saute for 3 - 4 minutes, or until crisp. Add 1/2 cup baby oysters, with liquor and 1/2 cup green peas. Saute for 4 - 5 minutes, tossing gently. Toss with remaining 1 teaspoon italian seasoning, onion salt, bay leaf and remaining 2 slices prosciutto. Add the sauteed vegetables to the pan.

title: Beef Stifado (Afghani Stew)
ingredients: 3 lbs beef stew meat | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 4 tablespoons peanut butter | 2 cans italian-style whole mixed-canned tomatoes, undrained | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried thyme | 1/2 cup chopped pomegranate
instructions: Cut beef into 2 to 3 inch cubes, and place in pot, turning the meat over over constantly, add peanut butter to pot. Stir until well combined with other ingredients. Heat to boiling, and then reduce heat to low, and simmer for 2 1/2 hours, or until meat is very tender. Stir through chopped thyme and pomegranate just before serving.

title: Oriental Spiced Plantains
ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter | 12 medium ripe plantains, sliced into 1/4-inch rounds ( can sub yellow plantains if preferred ) | 1 1/4 cups finely chopped spring onion | 1/4 cup chopped toasted almond | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract | 1 box pastry dough, thawed ( about 1 1/2-2 cups ) | 1 large lime wedge, to garnish
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Lightly butter a 2 1/2 quart casserole dish.

title: Cashew Asiago and Pear Toss
ingredients: 1 jar arugula packed in oil | 1 jar cashews | 2 tablespoons shredded red capsicums | sea salt | asiago cheese, shredded
instructions: Combine cashew nuts, red capsicum, sea salt in a food processor until combined. Add the asiago to the nuts and stir to combine. Serve with crackers, chips or bread.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock,paprika,torn basil leaf,caesar salad dressing
title: Caesar Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1/4 cup chicken stock | 1 1/2 teaspoons smoked paprika | 1/4 cup caesar salad dressing | 1/2 cup torn fresh basil leaf
instructions: Pour the chicken stock into a blender.

title: Spinach Veggie Grilled Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb fresh spinach, packed washed, stems removed | 4 ounces cooked american cheese or 4 ounces regular american cheese, cut into thin slices | 1/2 cup hoisin sauce | 2 -4 tablespoons oil | 1 medium yellow bell pepper, sliced into thin strips | 4 medium broccoli, stalks peeled
instructions: Preheat grill for high heat. Place spinach and cheese in a mixing bowl or storage container and toss well to coat. Place in refrigerator to marinate. Prepare grill for direct heat. Heat oil in a 10 inch nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add bell pepper and broccoli. Saute about 3 minutes until tender crisp turning now and then. Serve with cooked steamed vegies.

Random Ingredients: cinnamon swirl bread,spaghetti,caraway seed,celery,red chili powder,vegetable oil cooking spray,marsala wine
title: Spaghetti
ingredients: 1/4 cup dry marsala wine or 1/4 cup your favourite wine | 2 teaspoons red chili powder | 1 teaspoon caraway seed | 1 teaspoon cinnamon swirl bread, cubed very small ( like nutmeg ) | 10 ounces cooked spaghetti, broken into 1 inch pieces | vegetable oil cooking spray | fresh red chili powder, to taste
instructions: Place first 3 ingredients in a small bowl. Add the bread cubes and mix well. Divide the cooked spaghetti into four small bowls. Spray a large nonstick skillet with veggie oil cooking spray. Add the spaghetti and bread mixture and mix quickly until the spaghetti is evenly coated. Do not over crowd the skillet. The spaghetti should just be sticking slightly to itself. Turn the spaghetti mixture over and cook until the spaghetti is piping hot.

title: Caribbean Oats (Raw Foods)
ingredients: 2 cups breadcrumbs | 3 ounces coconut milk | 4 ounces chopped chilies | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground nutmeg | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 2/3 cup quickcooking oats
instructions: Mix ingredients until well combined. Shape into 24 chunks. Spray a nonstick griddle or frying pan with olive oil spray. Place on the griddle over medium heat and cook until golden brown, about 3 to 5 minutes per side. Remove to a plate and cut into triangles.

title: Fiddlehead Chicken Wings
ingredients: 4 tablespoons bacon bits, fried | 2 lbs fiddleheads | 1 can green chilies, chopped | 2 teaspoons orange peel, chopped | 1 can chicken wings, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven 350°f. Mix fiddleheads, chiles, browned bacon, orange peel and chicken wings in 13x9x2 inch casserole dish. Cover with foil. Bake 70 minutes.

title: Cherry Chocolate Balls With Powdered Almonds
ingredients: 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1/2 cup roasted peanuts, coarsely chopped | 2 teaspoons ground allspice | 1 1/2 tablespoons cocoa | 1/2 lb dried sour cherry pie filling | 2 tablespoons light peanut butter | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh rosemary
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the oyster sauce, peanuts, allspice, and cocoa. Place 1 tbsp of the cherry filling and 1 tbsp of the peanut mixture into each cherry. Form into about 18 balls, and press lightly into the balls. Place into the refrigerator for about 15 minutes, or until set. Melt the remaining tablespoon of peanut butter in a small nonstick skillet over medium heat, stirring constantly to make sure the peanut mixture does not burn. Stir in the rosemary to serve.

title: Sweet Potato Cabbage Potato Casserole - OAMC
ingredients: 3 lbs baking potatoes, peeled and cut in half | 12 cups chopped fresh red cabbage | 1 1/2 cups ketchup | 1 1/2 cups ketchup
instructions: Cook the peeled and cut potatoes in boiling water until just tender until fork tender, stirring occasionally. Drain. In a large saucepan or dutch oven combine potatoes and cabbage and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat and simmer, covered, just until the mixture thickens slightly, about 10 to 15 minutes. Spread half of the cabbage mixture in the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Arrange half the ketchup over the cabbage mixture. Spread with half the remaining cabbage mixture. Repeat layering of tomato sauce, potato mixture, ketchup, ketchup, and red cabbage mixture in layers. Cover and bake in a preheated 350 degree f oven until bubbly and hot, about 35 minutes.

title: Irish Spinach and Whiskey Dip
ingredients: 3/4 lb white american cheese | 3/4 lb rye whiskey | 2 tablespoons fresh coriander, chopped | 2 1/8 ounces packages frozen chopped spinach leaves
instructions: Combine all the ingredients and mix thoroughly. Cover and chill for at least 2 hours or overnight.

title: Roasted Banana Soup
ingredients: 2 cans vegetable stock with chicken | 1 can diced bananas, drained
instructions: Place the vegetable stock and banana together in a stockpot over medium heat. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 20 - 30 minutes, or until bananas are tender. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: cremini mushroom,coriander seed,flour tortilla,dijon mustard,large shrimp,white corn,garlic clove
title: Shrimp Creole Wraps
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1/2 teaspoon coriander seed | 1/4 - 1/2 garlic clove, minced | 1 lb raw large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 2 garlic cloves, chopped | 1 cup fresh white corn or 1 cup frozen tiny corn | 1 package cremini mushrooms | 12 flour tortillas, warmed
instructions: In small bowl, combine mustard, coriander seeds and garlic. Spread ground mustard mixture on shrimp, sprinkle with salt. Wrap each shrimp with about a 1/4 teaspoon of reserved dijon mustard mixture and then with mushrooms and corn. Lay the tortillas on cutting board or baking sheet.

title: Beef Tenderloin with Peas & Green Peppers
ingredients: 4 - 6 lbs beef tenderloin fillets | 1 lb frozen green pea ( or fresh ) | 1 bag frozen fully cooked chicken thighs ( i do this at the holidays ) or ( 1 lb ) bag other frozen veggies ( i do this at the holidays )
instructions: Preheat electric pan for approximately 20 - 30 minutes. Place frozen veggies in oven until frozen about 8 - 10 minutes, or approximately 30 - 40 minutes, depending on how thick they are. Remove veggies from oven and set aside until cool enough to handle. Place one filet on a cutting board, flatten with a meat mallet or similar instrument. Using large sharp knife cut approximately 45 - 50 slices from center of the filet, then cut into approximately 1 1/2 cubes. Place all of the meat in a skillet and arrange around it in one layer. Add one bag frozen peas along with 3 - 4 large pinches of salt. Place the chicken pieces evenly over the top of the pork. Spread the rest of the peas evenly over the chicken and vegetables. Cook meat in hot oven, turning occasionally until meat is cooked to desired doneness.

Random Ingredients: pace picante sauce,ricotta cheese,green pepper,dark sesame oil,grand marnier,egg beater substitute,active yeast,guacamole
title: Tex-Mex Cheesecake
ingredients: 2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1/2 cup guacamole | 2 large eggs ( substitute 2 tablespoons for egg whites ) | 2 cups ricotta cheese | 1 cup egg beaters egg substitute, room temperature | 1/2 cup pace picante sauce | 1/4 cup dark sesame oil | 1/2 cup finely chopped green pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Sprinkle the outside of a 9 inch springform pan with melted butter. In a large bowl, sprinkle the yeast over 1/2 cup of guacamole on the bottom of the lined pan. Pour in about 1 cup of the batter into the pan with yeast.

title: Easy Pizza Sauce for One
ingredients: 1 jar pizza sauce, any variety | 2 cups sliced green peppers
instructions: Combine sauce and peppers in a medium or large skillet or saucepan. Bring to a boil. Simmer until heated through about 4 to 5 minutes. Serve with your favorite protein toppings or make your own sauce with a recipe posted for those.

Random Ingredients: brussels sprout,raspberry,cumin powder,beef sirloin steak,pea,chicken bouillon cube,chicken stock
title: St. Patrick’s Day Beef and Peas
ingredients: 8 beef sirloin steaks, cubed | 1/2 cup chicken stock | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 beef bouillon cube, i used knorr brand | 1 cup frozen peas ( fresh or thawed ) | 1/2 cup frozen raspberries ( fresh or thawed ) | 1 -2 cup sliced rainbow ( optional )
instructions: Place the beef meat and the bouillon cube in crockpot along with the peas. Cook on low for 8 - 10 hours or on high for 6 - 8 hours. Remove cubes and set aside. When you’re ready to serve up, remove the steak and set aside to cool a bit. The leftover marinade doesn’t really matter here. In a small bowl, add the cumin and stir. Slice the beef and add that to the marinade at step serve hot or cold.

title: Thai Basil Rashers
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups garam masala | 1/2 cup thai basil, rinsed and dried
instructions: Place all ingredients in a mortar and pound with a pestle until blended and well mixed.

Random Ingredients: chicken tender,cornstarch,green onion,graham cracker crumb,cocoa powder,bacon,green cardamom pod,pork loin roast
title: Tantalizing Chicken Mole
ingredients: 4 -6 ounces thin sliced chicken tenders | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 2 tablespoons cocoa powder | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 tablespoon green curry powder ( or green chili ) | 1 teaspoon cracked green cardamom pods | 1 green onion | 1 slice bacon | 1/4 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Place chicken tenders in zip lock bag and add about 1/4 teaspoon of salt. Toss to coat in taco seasoning. Shake to coat. Place chicken in a shallow dish. Sprinkle with cocoa powder, cornstarch, curry mixture, green cardamom seeds, and onion slices. Pour on coat from crock. Dip in crumbs. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Heat a 12 inch nonstick fry pan over high heat and add the bacon, stirring to brown. Drain on paper towels lined plate and serve.
