Random Ingredients: lasagna noodle,cider vinegar,pork sausage,white sugar,french onion,garlic flake
title: Italian Style Sausage
ingredients: 10 links mild pork sausage | 1 jar french fried onions | 1/3 cup red wine vinegar | 1 cup white sugar | 2 cloves garlic flakes | 8 ounces lasagna noodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. Place the sausage links in a large skillet, and place over medium high heat. Cook, stirring occasionally, until evenly browned, about 10 minutes. Remove the sausage from the skillet, and set aside. Drain the skillet, and reduce heat to medium, and stir vinegar and sugar into the sausage. Bring to a simmer, and cook about 5 minutes, until syrupy. Remove from heat, and stir in garlic until fully cooked. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta, and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, or until al dente. Drain. Transfer sausage mixture to the prepared baking dish, and cover with the french fried onions. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes. Remove the foil, and continue baking until bubbly, about 20 more minutes.

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,sauce,plum tomato,gouda cheese,nonfat cream,broccoli floret,dark sesame oil,chicken
title: Spanish Broccoli Steak and Chipped Chicken
ingredients: 3/4 cup nonfat sour cream | 1 lb flank steak | 3/4 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/4 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1 lb broccoli floret | 2 cups chopped plum tomatoes | 1/2 cup hot sauce | 1/2 cup shredded gouda cheese
instructions: Heat nonfat sour cream in a medium nonstick skillet over medium/high heat. Add steak.

Random Ingredients: cilantro,red potato,chicken flavor bouillon,caraway seed,bay leaf,thai basil,grain rice,apricot
title: Moroccan Rice
ingredients: 2 cups long grain rice | 1 teaspoon caraway seed, crushed | 4 1/4 cups fat-free chicken flavor instant bouillon, drained | 1 teaspoon dried cilantro | 1 bay leaf | 1 can chopped apricots, drained | 1 package fresh thai basil | 1 cup chopped red potatoes
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine the rice, caraway and broth ingredients. Cover and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 35 minutes or until all of the liquid is absorbed. Let stand, covered, for 5 minutes. Add the herbs and potatoes and stir to combine. Let stand for 5 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: sugar,salt pepper,red bell pepper,white onion,portabella mushroom,parsley
title: Mushroom, Portabella and Onion Stir Fry (Tirk Patouthe)
ingredients: 1 portabella mushroom | 1 small white onion | 1 red bell pepper | 2 tablespoons sugar | 1 bunch fresh parsley | salt and pepper
instructions: Peel the onion and finely chop into 1/2 inch pieces. Peel and chop the red bell pepper into 1 inch pieces. In a skillet or wok, bring 2 - 3 tablespoons of water to a boil. Add the bell pepper and onion and sauté gently for a few minutes, then add the mushrooms. They have been covered for 10 minutes to allow the flavours to blend, then remove them from the heat and cover. Let stand for 2 - 3 minutes before removing them from the heat. Remove the mushroom stems and finely chop them. In a small bowl, add the sugar, salt and pepper. In a separate bowl, combine the parsley and chopped parsley and mix well. Add about 2 tablespoons of the cooking liquid to the sugar mixture and stir until it has dissolved. Remove the mushroom stems and onions and place them into the bowl with the sugar and pepper mixture. Reserve the liquid in your skillet and set the pan over medium low heat and cook the mixture for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, or until it has absorbed the liquid. Add the onion mixture back to the skillet. Cook it for another 5 minutes or until it has heated through. Serve in a bowl that is wide and shallow, with steamed vegetables for the vegetables and rice.

title: Fresh Leek and apple pea puree
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried yellow split peas | 1 1/2 cups chopped red onions | 1 cup chopped peeled apple | 2 teaspoons annatto seeds | 4 leeks, trimmed and sliced
instructions: In a large pot, combine the split peas, onions, apple, annatto seeds and leeks. Bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: soba noodle,lima bean,sharp cheddar cheese,basil pesto,red chili pepper
title: Creamy Italian Noodle Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces soba noodles, uncooked | 1/2 cup fresh basil pesto | 1/2 cup lima beans, beans or 1/2 cup frozen lima beans | 1 small red chili pepper ( seeded and membrane removed, minced ) | 1/2 cup sharp cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: Cook noodles as directed. Drain and rinse with cold water, then cool to room temperature. Chop the beans and chilli and mix into noodles. Add cheese. Serve at room temperature.

title: Italian Pesto & Strawberries(Vegan)
ingredients: 4 cups fresh strawberries | 4 tablespoons pesto sauce | 2 tablespoons molasses, vegan if possible
instructions: Wash and drain your strawberries. Put 2 tbs. Of liquid from the jar into a blender add the rest of the ingredients, except for molasses and blend for 30 seconds. Place into a serving dish and sprinkle with remaining sugar if desired. Or, pour over freshly grated vegan cheese, place under the broiler and turn the entire mix so the sugar is turned in on the cheese. The sugar will be light brown.

title: Fish in a Sweet Soy Sauce
ingredients: 3 ounces fish fillets | 2 tablespoons coriander, chopped | 4 tablespoons spicy apricot preserves | 1 small green cabbage, finely diced | 3 tablespoons sweet chili oil | 1 cup green cabbage, shredded
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Place fish in a large casserole dish. Sprinkle fish with extra sweet soy sauce. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight. Cook in the microwave for 10 - 12 minutes. Serve with steamed rice.

Random Ingredients: white bread,spinach ravioli,sage,shortening,wide egg noodle,coconut milk
title: Ravioli With Noodles - Vegetarian
ingredients: 1 lb curly egg noodles | 1 package frozen baby spinach ravioli or ( 10 ounce ) package ravioli | 1/4 cup shortening | 1 can unsweetened coconut milk | 2 cups packed coarsely chopped fresh sage | 16 slices country white bread
instructions: Cook pasta in large pot of boiling water until al dente. Prepare linguine. Drain pasta. In large skillet, melt shortening over medium heat. Stir in cottage cheese. Add coconut milk and sage, cook and stir until mixture thickens. Spread 1 cup of cooled pasta mixture in a lightly greased 13 x 9 baking dish. Arrange 1 or 2 dauphine noodles over mixture, then cover with 1/2 of remaining filling. Repeat layers and sprinkle with remaining cheese. Top with bread. Bake uncovered at 400 degrees fahrenheit for 30 minutes or until puffed.

title: Rice Noodles
ingredients: 1/2 lb round steak, cut into 1/4-inch slices ( or more, depending on type of meat ) | 2 tablespoons cinnamon, divided | 8 ounces rice noodles
instructions: In large pot of boiling water, simmer noodles according to package directions. Coat nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Sauté meat in skillet over medium heat 2 minutes per side, or until browned and crisp. Remove from heat and stir in 5 tablespoons of the cinnamon. Place noodles into shallow serving bowl and sprinkle with the remaining 1 tablespoon cinnamon. Serve noodles over meat mixture, pouring sauce over all.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,cauliflower,chicken cutlet,cumin powder,raisin,simple syrup,half,golden raisin
title: Moroccan-Spiced Chicken and Cauliflower
ingredients: 3 tablespoons golden raisins | 1 tablespoon raisins | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 1 lb chicken cutlet ( or any other breast meat ) | 1 cauliflower, cut into florets | 1 tablespoon cumin powder | 1 tablespoon simple syrup | half-and-half
instructions: Soak raisins in 2 - 3 t. Water for about 30 minutes, until they soften. Drain and reserve raisins. Add 1 tablespoons golden raisins and 1 more t. Raisins to chicken. Mix well. Arrange chicken on a serving platter, and cover with aluminum foil. Let marinate for 30 - 40 minutes. Turn oven on to grill. Put cauliflower on the grill, cover, and cook to desired tenderness. Put remaining 2 t. Raisins in a small saucepan with one t. Of raisins, the garam masala, and half and half and a small amount of water, and bring to a boil. Heat all together for 5 minutes, and serve with hot cooked rice.

title: Easy Chicken and Swiss Cheese Empanadas
ingredients: 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves, shredded | 8 ounces swiss cheese, shredded | 2 tablespoons horseradish | 1 can refrigerated crescent rolls | oil for deep frying | 2 tablespoons sliced pickled horseradish, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Place shredded chicken breast breasts in a medium bowl with the swiss cheese and horseradish.

Random Ingredients: white wine,sushi rice,sun tomato oil,cayenne,bean,vegetable oil,ham
title: Cafe Rio Sushi (Sushi)
ingredients: 2 cups sushi rice | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil, plus extra for brushing | 4 ounces diced ham | 4 ounces thinly sliced cooked ham | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, minced | 1/2 cup dry white wine | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne, plus extra for sprinkling | 2 cups mixed beans, cooked ( optional )
instructions: Rinse the rice in a strainer until the water runs clear. Remove from fridge and put in a warmed jasmine dish or on a nori sheet with 1 inch sides. Place a sheet of plastic wrap on top of rice, then cover with several layers of plastic wrap, letting it cling up over the rice, until it's totally free. Place a bamboo rolling mat on top, which has been slightly dampened with water. When almost ready to go, start placing the rice on it, using one hand so the plastic holds the rice shape. Using the mat, gently roll the rice from the short side into a long cylinder, adding more rice around the rice. Using your rolling pin, start to roll the cylinder from the short side as you go. Repeat until the sushi is finished roll making sure to push the plastic wrap down inside the roll. Use a sharp, damp knife to cut the roll into squares. This is a very long and very sticky sushi so you could leave the plastic wrap on the pan, or you could transfer the sushi onto a sushi rolling mat and cut into squares. Cut each square into 4 pieces with a vegetable peeler. You should have enough sushi to cover the bottom of your pan. Preheat a broiler or two place the sesame or sun dried tomatoes on the pan if using. Place the ham and sun dried tomatoes on top of the rice. Top with the ham, sun dried tomatoes and the beans if using. Brush the rice with vegetable oil. Broil or grill until lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,wine,apple pie filling,celery,white fish fillet
title: Sweet Apple and Fish Salad
ingredients: 6 apple pie filling, halved | 1/4 cup wine | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 2 teaspoons shredded celery | 1 lb white fish fillet, cubed
instructions: Place the apple cut side down on parchment paper or a baking sheet just large enough to wrap an entire fillet. Brush them with olive oil and set them aside. Arrange half of the fish on top of the apple.

title: Pizza Sauce
ingredients: 1 can tomato paste | 4 tablespoons molasses | hot sauce, such as tabasco, to taste
instructions: Drain tomato paste, mix with molasses and hot sauce. Use to top pizza bases, etc.

title: Chile Paste (Sicilian Spice Paste)
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh herbs | 6 large chile peppers ( i use jalapeno peppers but it's up to you ) or 6 large serrano peppers, stemmed seeded and deveined | 1/2 cinnamon stick | 1 teaspoon ground dried chile
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a mortar and pestle or blender and grind to a smooth paste. If you want the mixture to be a bit too thick, chill it for a few hours but it is good for an extra kick. Store in an airtight container.

title: Bread Pizza-Pork Loin Cutlets
ingredients: 4 boneless pork loin chops, 3/4-inch thick | 1 can stewed tomatoes passata | 8 slices brioche bread
instructions: Place pork between waxed paper and press firmly with a meat pounder to flatten slightly. Place tomatoes on cookie sheet that is large enough to hold one slice of bread with some of the passata in it. Cook in 450 degree f oven for about 5 minutes. Turn over and cook for about 5 minutes until golden on underside. Turn slices over and cook an additional 3 to 4 minutes until golden. Slice to desired width.

Random Ingredients: poblano chile,white poppy seed,chocolate,soya sauce,chili pepper
title: Mexi Devil Fudge (Qutera)
ingredients: 1/2 cup chili peppers, fresh, thinly sliced, seeds left on or 1/2 cup canned mild chili pepper | 2 tablespoons soya sauce | 6 ounces unsweetened chocolate | 1/4 cup white poppy seeds | 25 poblano chiles, roasted, seeded, & cut into pieces or 25 jalapeno chiles, roasted, seeded, peeled
instructions: Put chiles into a food processor and pulse a few times to roughly chop them. Add soya sauce, chocolate and poppy seeds and pulse for a few seconds. In a heavy 8x8x2 inch pan, add the chiles in rows and press down with a wooden spoon pressing firmly. Spread this mixture over the chiles. Sprinkle the roasted or sliced poblanos over the top. Bake in a 300 degree f until the edges are beginning to brown, about 45 minutes. Cool completely before slicing.

title: Bananas Vinaigrette
ingredients: 3 medium bananas, cut lengthwise into halves ( about 4oz each ) | 2 teaspoons sweet white wine vinegar | 1 small fresh lime, juice of, only | 1 tablespoon fresh parsley, minced
instructions: Place the bananas in a 1/4 cup champagne or other saucepan.

title: Easy Microwave Chicken Rice
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked rice ( i used long grain white ) | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 cup chicken bouillon cube ( i bought two )
instructions: Microwave rice on full power for about 12 minutes. In a 1 quart casserole dish or small bowl, crush bouillon cube in broth cube and put chicken cube into dish. Add rice, mixing to coat. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and microwave for 7 - 10 more minutes or until rice is completely cooked and broth cube is mostly absorbed and liquid is absorbed and rice is tender.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno chile,sirloin steak,beef ravioli,season salt,sirloin,serrano pepper,red chili powder
title: Ravioli With Shredded Beef and Shredded Beef
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs sirloin steaks, cut into thin strips | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 lb refrigerated beef ravioli | 1/2 lb red chili powder | 1/4 cup red chili chili powder | 1/2 cup dehydrated jalapeno chile | 1 jalapeno chile
instructions: Spray large skillet with veggie spray and heat over medium high heat. Add beef and sprinkle on seasoning salt and 1/2 cup of crushed chili powder. Stir frequently and cook until beef is browned and no longer pink. Wet the tortillo maker and cook ravioli according to package directions, or as directed on the package. Drain and keep warm. Stir in remaining ingredients and heat to serving temperature. Note, if serving immediately, freeze or thaw the beef and beef and heat through in oven. When frozen, thaw and reheat. When ready, reheat through. Serve with cooked ravioli.

title: Courgettes in Agrodolce
ingredients: 200 g green beans, chopped | 200 g courgettes, chopped into 2 cm lengths
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a deep, non metallic fry proof dish. Cover with a tight fitting lid and place in a preheated oven. Steam over a low heat for 25 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender, but not falling apart.

title: Champagne Chicken
ingredients: 1 chicken | 6 ounces champagne | 1 tablespoon poppy seed
instructions: Wash and wash chicken parts. Cut pieces in half. Boil breasts in two or three tablespoons of chicken stock for about 20 minutes or until fully cooked. Remove meat from bones and skin and slice. Slightly open a champagne bottle. Fill the bottle with water and add a bit of poppy seed. Put the chicken into the bottle, making sure the chicken is completely covered. Close the lid and gently shake to mix and coat all the pieces of chicken. You should have a good amount of marinade that the chicken will be cooking into. If not, add another bottle and another cup of water. Close the lid again, and then tighten the lid again. Turn on the oven to 350 degrees. Cook for about 12 to 15 minutes, or until chicken is cooked. Variation, for a bit of spice, stir in 1 t. Garlic powder and 1 t. Ground turmeric or 1 t. Pimento pepper. In a large non metallic bowl or platter, mix together the ingredients for the marinade. Pour over the chicken and serve.

title: Asparagus Burgers (Danish Style)
ingredients: 4 -6 asparagus spears | 8 slices hamburger, thick ( any ham such as sainsbury ) | radish, slices | 1 pinch saffron | prepared topping, to taste
instructions: Cut asparagus spears diagonally into 5 - 6 thin slices. Bake until crisp tender drain and cool under running water. Slice meat to about 1/4 thick. Spray frying pan with cooking spayed with olive oil and cook meat on both sides until desired consistency. Garnish with radishes and saffron. Serve on hamburger bun or with bread.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,balsamic vinegar,chicken,pita bread,serrano chili,pecan half,nonfat milk,yellow bell pepper
title: Creamy Chicken Pitas with Pecan Dip With Pecans
ingredients: 8 ounces boneless chicken, cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons lemon juice, fresh | 2 1/2 cups nonfat milk ( low-fat can be used ) | pecan halves | 6 pita bread, warmed | 1/2 cup julienne-cut yellow bell pepper | 1 small serrano chili, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup pecan halves, toasted and coarsely chopped
instructions: In a 12 inch nonstick skillet or grill pan, stir the chicken with 2 tablespoons of the vinegar over moderately high heat, breaking up the chicken with a wooden spoon, until it loses all its pink color, 2 to 3 minutes. Scatter the lemon juice evenly over the chicken and cook, stirring occasionally, until just glazed, 1 to 2 minutes. Transfer the chicken to a large bowl and let cool slightly then stir in the remaining 1 tablespoon vinegar. Add the milk to the skillet and cook over moderately high heat, stirring for 2 minutes. Scatter the remaining 1/2 cup milk into the pan and cook over moderately high heat, stirring, until it just begins to boil, 1 to 2 minutes. Off the heat, spoon the milk mixture over the chicken and sprinkle with the pepper and chile. Serve warm with the pecan halves and warm pita bread. For pecan dip, if pecans or a sharp knife is not available, place 1 tablespoon of the pecan halves among the points for each warmed pita.

title: Grandma's Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken legs | ketchup
instructions: Combine ketchup and ketchup to cover chicken. Bake in a 450 f oven until chicken is done. Remove chicken from oven and brush with the juices. Enjoy ketchup is the sauce.

Random Ingredients: ice water,barberry,cilantro leaf,raspberry liqueur,soba noodle,tomato paste,celery seed,cream cheese
title: Soffrito
ingredients: 16 ounces soba noodles, broken in half | 5 -6 ounces cream cheese | 1 bunch cilantro leaves | 1/3 cup tomato paste | 1/3 cup raspberry liqueur | 1 tablespoon celery seed | 1 1/2 cups fresh raspberries or 1 1/2 cups frozen raspberries | 2 1/2 cups ice water, enough to cover pasta | freshly crushed barberries or fresh cherries, to taste ( optional )
instructions: Soak the soba in water until soft. Drain noodles and place in food processor. Process until fine but not dry. Set aside. Mix the cream cheese and a little of the chopped cilantro and add to the cooked noodles. Add all of the tomato paste, raspberry liqueur, celery seed, raspberries and water and process until smooth. Add the ice water to thin or blend, if necessary. Mix the mixture and transfer to an ice covered serving dish. Refrigerate until firm.

title: Moroccan Spice Rub
ingredients: cooking spray | 2 teaspoons ground cumin | 4 teaspoons chili oil | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed | 4 teaspoons lime rind, finely grated | 1/2 cup sliced ripe olives
instructions: Preheat grill pan over medium high heat.

title: Fried Rice Noodles With Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1 package rice noodles | 2 -3 tablespoons olive oil | 1/8 cup extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Heat 2 tbl. Olive oil in a skillet or wok, add rice noodles. Cook until noodles are soft and cooked through. Remove the noodles from the skillet or wok, drain on paper towels until completely dry. While noodles are still warm, cut the noodles in half lengthwise and into thin strips about 10 to 12 inches long. Heat 2 tbl. Olive oil in a large skillet, add a few tablespoons of the hot oil. When the oil shimmers. Add some of the noodles and stir fry at first but then, while stirring, until well browned. Turn noodles out onto a platter, arrange noodles around them drizzle with vinaigrette and top with more of the hot oil. Sprinkle with extra olive oil.

Random Ingredients: chicken leg quarter,tamarind pulp,kielbasa,creamy peanut butter
title: Creamy Indonesian Style Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken leg quarters, cut into thirds | 1/3 cup creamy peanut butter | 1 can tamarind pulp | 2 pounds kielbasa, cut into half-moons
instructions: Preheat grill for high heat. Wrap each chicken leg with an overlapping piece of aluminum foil. Place on preheated grill, and cover. Cook until chicken is no longer pink in the center and the meat is no longer translucent, about 20 minutes. Remove from heat, and allow to cool for 15 minutes. Transfer chicken to a large bowl, and stir in peanut butter, tamarind pulp, and kielbasa. Let rest for a couple of minutes before serving.

title: Sherry Spiced Brats
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs hamburger | 1/2 cup cooking sherry | 3 tablespoons vodka | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/4 teaspoon pepper | 2 teaspoons seasoning salt | 2 dashes clove
instructions: Brown the hamburger and drain most of it. Remove hamburger to plate. Melt the butter in a large skillet over low to med heat. Add the meat and brown, stirring occasionally, until golden, 10 - 15 minutes. Remove and drain on paper towels. Add the sherry and vodka to the meat. Sprinkle with the cumin, cayenne, pepper, & salt. Mix thoroughly. Slather all over to your taste with your favorite dippers and enjoy.

title: The Crazy Ha!
ingredients: 1/2 cup tahini | 1 can condensed cream of wild mushroom soup | 1/2 cup mango chutney | 1 1/2 cups chopped fresh figs
instructions: Blend tahini, cream of mushroom soup, and mango chutney in a bowl. Stir in figs.

title: Sonia's Bean and Cheese Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 14 sheets phyllo pastry, thawed | 1 can white beans, rinsed | 24 ounces beer, of your choice
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Place four sheets of phyllo pastry in a 13 x 9 inch baking pan and brush with half of your beer. Sprinkle the white beans over the phyllo and spray with remaining beer. Repeat with 4 sheets and 3 sheets of phyllo and top with remaining 3 sheets and spray with remaining beer. Spray top with remaining 1 inch of beer and place 2 sheets of phyllo over top. Cut a slit through the top of the phyllo and place the filled strips in the pan. Spray the top with water and cover pan tightly. Bake for 25 minutes or until phyllo is golden.

title: Catfish Fashada
ingredients: 12 catfish ( fresh or frozen ) | 2 tablespoons vodka ( sweet or hot, you choose ) | 1 lemon, zest of, finely grated | 24 large ladyfingers
instructions: In a small bowl add catfish, vodka, lemon zest and cover. Stir in the ladyfingers to coat. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place catfish, skin side down, on a foil paper lined baking sheet. Spray with cooking spray. Bake, until catfish is easily flaked with a fork. Cook time depends on the size of your catfish.

title: Simple Summer Tomato Soup
ingredients: 1 can italian-style tomatoes | 1 can diced red plums | ice | crushed peanuts ( for topping ) | 8 slices country bread, with crusty bread alongside | 1 sliced fresh squash ( for topping )
instructions: Put all ingredients except bread in a 6 quart pan. Bring to a boil.

title: Ouzo-Ouzo (Coconut Pudding and Ice Cream)
ingredients: 1 package unflavored gelatin ( or 2 pkg. unflavoured gelatin ) | 1 can coconut milk ( use 2 1/2 pints of coconut milk if unavailable ) | 1 cup ouzo
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in water and set aside. In a large bowl, dissolve the gelatin in 1 1/2 cups of water then stir in the 2 1/2 cups of coconut milk.

title: Potato and Spicy Chile Sauce
ingredients: 3 large russet potatoes | 1/4 cup cilantro, chopped | 1/2 cup chili sauce
instructions: Preheat grill to medium heat. Brush a medium size baking dish with olive oil or cooking spray, or grease with cooking spray.

title: Smoked Haddock
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs haddock, skin and bones removed | 3 tablespoons hot sauce ( see note at intro )
instructions: Clean the haddock and remove any wood fragments or bones that are caught in a piece of clothing. Place in large, deep pan with about 1 inch of head of fish on top of the fish.

Random Ingredients: flour,garlic salt,green lentil,chili pepper flake,navel orange,chili sauce,confectioner sugar,streaky bacon
title: Spicy Green Lentils
ingredients: 6 slices streaky bacon ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/4 cup green lentils | 1 dash chili pepper flakes | 1 pinch chili sauce | 1 navel orange, juiced | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 1 teaspoon flour
instructions: Place the bacon in a skillet over medium heat, and cook until evenly browned, about 10 minutes. Stir in the garlic salt, lemon lime juice, chili pepper flakes, and chili sauce. Simmer for 5 to 7 minutes, then mix in the orange and confectioners' sugar. Continue cooking 2 to 3 minutes, or until thickened. Serve over yellow rice, topped with croutons or sliced cucumber.

Random Ingredients: baby green,italian dressing,black eyed pea,corn oil,green bean,orange,red capsicum
title: Baby Greens & Corn in Italian Sizzling Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon corn oil | 2 bunches baby greens | 500 g fresh green beans, trimmed | 1 small red capsicum, sliced | 1 orange, zested & segmented | 1 can black-eyed peas, drained & rinsed | 1/3 cup italian dressing
instructions: Heat oil in a saucepan over gentle heat & saute cabbages in batches. Using a slotted spoon, transfer to a bowl & set aside. Add greens & beans. Toss over gentle heat, coating well. Stir in capsicum, orange zest & segments of pepper. Cover & cook for 2 - 3 mins, stirring occasionally. Stir in dressing & cook, stirring for 1 minute. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: pork loin,nonfat cream,red pepper,margarine,puff pastry,beef tenderloin,cake flour,fruit
title: Capsicum Pork Tenderloins
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ground red pepper | 2 ounces potato pancakes or 2 ounces pancake mix | 1 beef tenderloin, sliced thinly | 1 tablespoon cake flour, sifted | 1 tablespoon cooking margarine ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon dried fruit | 1 tablespoon nonfat sour cream | 1 puff pastry sheet
instructions: Make capsicum, combine pepper, potato pancakes mix and beef tenderloin. Roll out puff pastry sheet to a 12x8 inch rectangle. Brush the top with margarine and sprinkle with fruit and soured cream. Press edges well with a fork. Brush border with margarine. Lay 1 piece of dough on the middle of phyllo sheet. Roll the short side over the filling. Top with another rectangle, cut to desired size. Repeat with the remaining pastry sheets and filling. Place onto a baking tray and brush with margarine. Bake in preheated oven at 450 degrees f. For about 25 minutes. Serve with a wedge of mango and mayonnaise.

title: Sweet and Sour Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 15 ounces beer ( not beer ) | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 tablespoon triple sec | 1 teaspoon scallion, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon hot chili paste | 1 teaspoon margarine | 1 teaspoon curry paste
instructions: In a small bowl, combine beer, cornstarch, triple sec, scallion, chili paste, and margarine. Whisk in curry paste. Serve hot.

title: Baked Rum Cake
ingredients: 1 cup sour cream | 1 1/2 teaspoons seasoning salt | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and beat at slow speed until light and fluffy. Serve on paper lined cookie sheet in single layer. Variation, mix in 1 egg white with 1/2 teaspoon of cornstarch mixed with 1/2 cup cold water.

title: Yummy Red Capsicum and Mango Chutney Rice
ingredients: 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 2 bay leaves | 1 inch ginger | 3 bay leaves | 200 g red capsicums | 1 teaspoon mango powder | 2 cups rice, washed and drained
instructions: Heat mustard seeds in oil. Once they crackle, add bay leaves and ginger. Fry for a few seconds. Add capsicum and saute for a few minutes. Sprinkle mango and stir. Add rice and mix it in well. Cook, uncovered, over medium heat for 5 minutes. Cover and cook on low heat for 1 minute. Serve hot.

title: Crock Pot Kentucky Potatoes
ingredients: 11 russet potatoes | 1/2 cup buttermilk | 1 lb italian bread, crumbs | 1/3 cup lime sherbet
instructions: Peel russets potatoes and cut into quarters. Put russets in crockpot. While russets are cooking mix buttermilk, crumbs and sherbet. Pour over potatoes and toss to coat evenly.

Random Ingredients: amaretto,guacamole,currant,cream chicken soup,kosher salt,hard egg,phyllo pastry
title: Phyllo Purses With Avocado Cream
ingredients: 2 bunches fresh arugula, large stems removed, leaves washed ( about 20 cups ) | 2 quarts cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup chopped pitted ripe guacamole | 1/4 cup dried currants ( about 2-3/4 cups ) | kosher salt | 12 sheets frozen phyllo pastry, thawed | 1 cup crushed hard-boiled egg
instructions: Place arugula and 1 1/2 quarts cold water in a large, heavy pot.

title: Simple Radish Salad
ingredients: 2 cups thinly sliced radishes | 1/4 cup corn oil | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 1/4 cup sliced salami, cut into 1/4 inch slices
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together the radishes with the oil, rice vinegar and salami. Chill for 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: ham,lime,wild rice,white button mushroom,asafoetida powder,picante sauce,cumin seed
title: Wild Rice and Asafoetida(Mushroom and Chile Stew)
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon of crushed cumin seeds | 1 small bunch wild rice ( cook as per instructions on the package ) | 1 -2 tablespoon cooked ham, cubed or 1 -2 tablespoon cooked chicken, cubed, to taste | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( optional ) or 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder ( optional ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup picante sauce ( to taste ) | 1/2 lime, juice of | 1/4 - 1/2 cup white button mushrooms or 1/4-1/2 cup mushroom
instructions: Put the spices in a small bowl and mix well. Heat up a large skillet or wok with high sides over high heat until it's hot but not smoking. Add the oil or cooking oil and let it sauté the asafoetida and cumin seeds for a minute or two. Add the green and white button mushrooms/parsley and sauté for 2 - 3 minutes. When done, add the rice and stir well and remove from heat. Put back in to low heat and add the picante sauce. Cook, covered on low until absorbed, about 5 - 10 minutes. Stir well and serve hot.

title: Squashes W- Tequila
ingredients: 1 yellow squash, cut in 1 pieces | 3 tablespoons toasted sesame seeds | 1/2 cup tequila
instructions: Preheat grill to high. In a pan, heat the tequila. Add the squash and cook for 10 minutes on med high. Remove and stir every 5 minutes to prevent burning. When all the liquids have been absorbed, remove from heat and stir in the sesame seeds. Serve over fresh green salad.

Random Ingredients: msg,wheat bread,zucchini,flour,creamy peanut butter,plain yogurt,arborio rice,almond extract
title: Rice Balls
ingredients: 2 cups whole wheat bread, dry | 2 cups zucchini, chopped | 1/2 cup plain fat-free yogurt | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1 cup arborio rice | 4 tablespoons creamy peanut butter | 2 teaspoons msg | flour
instructions: Blend yogurt, almond extract, rice and msg until well combined.

title: Roasted Bell Pepper Salad
ingredients: 1 yellow bell pepper | 2 teaspoons paprika | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar
instructions: Wash, core and seed the bell pepper and slice into thick strips. Place in a mixing bowl and mix in paprika and vinegar. Toss and serve at room temperature.

title: Crock Pot Leek and Barley Soup
ingredients: 2 cups leeks | 1 cup pearl barley | 1 lb hamburger | 1 head cauliflower
instructions: Put all ingredients into crock pot. Cook on low for 5 - 7 hours. Serve warm.

title: Fettuccine Con Carroque (Pasta in Carroque)
ingredients: 1 lb fettuccine pasta | 2 -3 tablespoons corn oil
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Meanwhile, cook pasta in boiling water until al dente. Drain, reserve 1/4 cup of the pasta cooking water. Imash the pasta by running a knife around the inside of the pot a few times, turning to loosen. Place pasta in a large serving bowl or platter and pour in the oil and reserved cooking Water. The fettuccine will be cooked at this point. Serve with parmesan cheese, if desired.

title: Crusty Bran English Muffins
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups bran cereal | 4 teaspoons fast rising yeast
instructions: In a 2 1/2 to 3 cup bowl, dissolve the bran in a small amount of warm water. Sprinkle the yeast over 1 cup of the bran and stir to form a loose batter. Let rise in a warm place until doubled in bulk, about 30 to 60 minutes. Pour batter onto greased, preheated muffin pans. Stir the remaining 1/2 cup bran into the batter. Top each muffin with a scant 1/4 scant teaspoon of the batter mixture. Cover with plastic wrap and let rise until doubled, about 30 minutes. Bake in a 375 f oven for 18 to 20 minutes.

title: Artichokes and Artichokes in Jelly (Artichokes de La Vera)
ingredients: 8 artichoke hearts | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla | 3 tablespoons jelly ( i prefer jelly )
instructions: Dip artichoke hearts in jelly, and lay them in an attractive, shallow baking dish. Sprinkle artichokes with a pinch of salt. Roast in 375°f oven for 45 minutes, or until just beginning to brown. If using jelly, boil 3 minutes, then add to artichokes, and continue roasting. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: pork loin chop,phyllo pastry,dark soy sauce,broiler fryer chicken,masa harina,curry paste,red chili pepper,white cabbage
title: Sweet and Spicy Fried Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs broiler-fryer chickens | 12 frozen phyllo pastry sheets | 1 can cream of coconut stewed tomatoes ( 398 ml ) | 1 medium white cabbage, grated | 2 tablespoons masa harina | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 fresh red chili pepper | 1 tablespoon curry paste
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees. Pour 1 inch of water into a large pan and place over high temperature to bring to a boil. Salt and cook chicken, covered, for 12 to 15 minutes, until cooked through. Remove chicken from pan and cool, then slice into 1/4 inch strips. To make sauce, place coconut stewed tomatoes in a small saucepan with just enough water to cover. Bring to a boil and reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring frequently, for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool for 5 minutes. Remove skin from cabbage and shred cabbage. Combine coconut meat with masa harina, dark soy sauce, red chili and curry paste in a bowl. Place chicken strips and cabbage mixture in a large, deep baking dish or roasting pan and top with sauce. Bake, covered, for 50 minutes.

Random Ingredients: vodka,pork loin steak,worcestershire sauce,kosher salt black pepper,green capsicum
title: BBQ Steak Skewers
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs pork loin steaks, cut into 1/4 inch chunks | 2 green capsicum, cut into 1/4 inch chunks, removing seeds | 4 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 2 tablespoons vodka | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Thread meat onto long skewers, alternating with capsicum. Blend vodka and worcestershire until well blended. Pour mixture over skewers and marinate for 1 hour. Heat bbq to medium, then cook for 2 to 3 minutes or until sizzling. Turn and continue cooking for an additional 3 - 5 minutes or until meat is cooked through.

title: French Onion Soup
ingredients: 1 can condensed tomato soup | 4 cups chicken stock ( or chicken bouillon ) | 1/4 - 2/3 teaspoon onion powder
instructions: Place all ingredients into a soup pot and let simmer for about 30 minutes stirring frequently or until onions are clear and the soup is thickened. Serve warm.

title: Grilled Veggie Salad
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce hearts | 1 medium cauliflower, flowerets and stem removed | 1 tablespoon spicy mustard | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon | 1 small wedge lime | 1 -2 tablespoon peppercorn ( optional )
instructions: In a large bowl, combine all ingredients and mix well. Refrigerate and allow to marinate for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Sesame Beef Roast
ingredients: 1 1/3 lbs beef chuck roast | 1 medium onion, chopped | 1/2 cup dry vermouth | 3 tablespoons dried onion flakes | 1 tablespoon dried coriander | 2 teaspoons sesame oil
instructions: Rub spice mixture onto the roast. Marinate in the fridge overnight for flavor to meld. Spray grill rack with pam. Grill over medium hot coals. Let meat cook at 1st 10 mins each side, or until desired doneness of meat. Serve over noodles or rice.

title: Danish Baked Beans
ingredients: 2 cans ranch style beans | 1/4 lb anisette ( dried bread crumbs ) | 1 tablespoon spices ( see notes ) | 1/2 cup margarine or 1/2 cup butter | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract | spices
instructions: Combine all ingredients, except the sugar, in a heavy skillet. Let simmer 15 min over medium heat, shaking the pan to prevent sticking. Place in 2 baking dishes. Sprinkle with sugar. Bake, uncovered, at 350f for 20 minute. Note, the anisette can be found at most grocery stores, sometimes frozen, sometimes even on baking sheets in a 9 x 11 baking pan. It can also be cut and stored in small plastic bags. Note, you may substitute a combination of dried beans and dried beans. Use 1/2 cup of each to make 2 pints, about 3 cups per pound.

title: BBQ Stuffed Bananas
ingredients: 2 lbs veal roast ( or other veal roast ) | 1 package dry fettuccine pasta ( i like whole wheat ) | 1 loaf shredded cheese ( i like kraft colby jack, but colby colby jack is good too ) | 4 bananas | 2 tablespoons liquid honey ( i use honey-roasted honey ) | 1/4 cup hoisin sauce ( i use kikkoman )
instructions: Trim the edges of the veal roast, if it is cut a short way, then cut the roast in half lengthwise. If you cut this in half too long, cut those halves crosswise into pieces, then cut each half lengthwise into thin strips, about an inch wide and about 4 inches long. Remove and discard the strings attached to the veal meat. Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain and set aside. Lay the breaded meat out on a cutting board and carefully smack it with the flat of a cleaver to make it easier to slice. Cut along both sides of the meat, stopping about two inches along the width of the meat. Remove one strip of breaded meat, if you used one, and cut the other strip into slices 1/4, then cut into large pieces. Set the breaded meat aside. Heat the sauce over direct high heat but gently bubble for a few moments to thicken. In a large pan of boiling water, cook a few pieces of the breaded meat for about 7 minutes or just until it starts to crisp but is still soft. Do not overcook or they will lose their crunch. Drain the pasta in a colander, or in a colander shake it well until all is hot again. Then put the heated tomato sauce in a large bowl, along with 2/3 of the cheese. Cut the cut ends off the bananas and gently separate into slices. Set aside. If the ham/mushroom/burgundy/burgundy sauce is to harden, drain it, but keep it warm, which takes about 1 hour. Just before serving, place the bananas on a serving platter. Assemble the sandwiches with the warm tomato sauce, then top with remaining cheese.

title: Mexican Macaroni Salad With Nutty Roasted Mac & Walnuts
ingredients: 8 ounces macaroni | 2 cups walnuts, coarsely chopped ( about 5 to 7 ) | 8 ounces frozen limeade concentrate, thawed | 12 -15 fresh cilantro stems ( see note in introduction ) | chopped fresh cilantro stem ( to garnish ) | tortilla chips
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions.

title: Simple Mexican Soda Bread
ingredients: 1 cup ice water | 1 tablespoon baking powder | 1/2 cup ice cubes
instructions: Measure 1 cup of ice water into the top of a bowl. Pour the baking powder into the bowl. Stir, then slowly mix, making sure the water is evenly distributed with the baking powder. Place the bowl onto a cookie sheet lined with waxed paper. Sprinkle the baking powder cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until ready to use. When ready to bake, preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place 1/2 cup ice cubes in a small baking dish and press lightly. Spoon 1 rounded tablespoon of dough into the center of the ice cubes. Using a fork, poke holes in top of the dough with the fork, about 1/2 inch deep. Bake until golden brown and crust is lightly browned, about 15 minutes.

title: Spinach Saute With Cardamom and Milk
ingredients: 20 -25 small baby spinach, washed, dry and spun dry | 2 -3 pieces cardamom pods, crumbled | 4 tablespoons mirin, if needed
instructions: Heat a heavy bottom nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add 1 tbls. Of mirin and 1 cardamon, if using. Turn the fire to medium high, add spinach, and shake the skillet a few times. Stir with a fork to distribute the oil evenly so that all the spinach leaves are evenly coated. Spread spinach with a generous helping of the pan juices. Cover and cook for 10 minutes, shaking the skillet once or twice to ensure it is not burning, or 10 minutes more. The dish should be slightly dry. Flip the spinach and sprinkle with the remaining cardamom, and press into a golden/puffed/scrape like consistency. Cover with a damp dishtowel, close lid, and continue on medium heat for 20 - 30 minutes. Taste and re season with additional mirin or cardamom if using.

Random Ingredients: parsley,cocoa powder,matzo,sea salt,chicken bouillon granule,vidalia onion
title: Passover Hot Chocolate Matzoh Balls
ingredients: 2 matzos, finely grated ( about 3/4 cup per batch ) | 2 vidalia onions, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon dried parsley | 2 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon granules | 1/4 - 1/2 cup cocoa powder | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon sea salt ( depends on how salty your sugar tastes )
instructions: Set oven at 350 or mark 6 and grease a baking sheet. Mix the grated matzoh together with the onions, parsley, bouillon powder and cocoa. Gradually add enough water to produce dough like dough that has the consistency of heavy cream. You should have about 1 1/4 cups of liquid with about 1 1/4 cups of dry ingredients. Roll out balls of dough between sheets of waxed paper about the size of a walnut. Cut into pieces about 1/2 inch thick. Arrange on greased baking sheet with a side seam up. Sprinkle tops with sea salt. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes, check doneness and add a little more water if necessary to keep matzos a little crunchy. Remove from oven and set aside to cool for at least 20 minutes before removing paper from cookie sheet and sprinkling tops with more cocoa. You can serve matzos right after cooling but should not be too chewy when they are too dry.

title: Gourmet Seared Beef
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups raw cashews, divided ( unsalted ) | 1 3/4 teaspoons pickling spices | 1/3 cup dark rum ( sweetened to taste, or use rum, brandy, or a combination of the two ) | 1 1/2 lbs sirloin | 24 whole radish
instructions: To make cashew nuts, place about 2 cups cashews in the bowl of your meat thermometer, and place the meat in a large mixing bowl containing hot water. Sprinkle the nuts with the pickling spices and toss to coat. Transfer the cashew nuts to a large, cast iron skillet, and place over medium low heat. Pour the rum over the nuts, and gently toast the nuts for about a minute, stirring constantly, until the nuts have burned off much of the rum. Be careful to not burn the nuts, and it is important to leave them in a single layer. Place the beef meat in the skillet, and cook, turning the meat frequently, until the meat is well browned on all sides and a thermometer reads 160°f with a meat thermometer, about 3 1/2 hours. Transfer the beef to a cutting board, and slice thickly. Serve immediately, or refrigerate overnight in an airtight container or freeze for later use.

title: Simple Feta Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 jar salsa
instructions: Spread feta cheese over a large serving platter with a thick edged spoon. Pour salsa over top and serve with chips.

Random Ingredients: black eyed pea,sherry wine,beef brisket,carrot,coconut milk,self raising flour,mango,cooking oat
title: Ridge of Frijoles
ingredients: 500 g beef brisket, fat trimmed | 1 can coconut milk | 2 tablespoons sherry wine, plus | 2 teaspoons sherry wine ( extra, to drizzle ) | 1 carrot, peeled and cut into thick sticks | 1 can black-eyed peas | 2 tablespoons self-raising flour | 1 teaspoon grated fresh grated fresh mango | cooking oat, extra, to sprinkle
instructions: Place brisket fat side up, in large, wide based saucepan. Pour 3 cups water into pan. Bring to boil. Reduce heat.

title: Easy Herbed Sausage with Turnips
ingredients: 4 links sweet italian sausage | 2 1/2 teaspoons mixed herbs | 2 1/2 teaspoons dried parsley flakes | 6 medium turnips, peeled and cut into 1/4 to 1/2 inch slices ( or other cooking vegetables as desired )
instructions: Remove sausage casings from casings and brown in nonstick skillet on medium heat.

title: Oven Roasted  Potatoes and Herbs
ingredients: 4 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 tablespoon ground sage ( fresh or dried ) | 1 large russet potato, peeled | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 1 1/2 cups finely chopped fresh mint leaves
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Heat the oil in a heavy baking dish until just beginning to smoke. Remove the pan from the oven and immediately toss the potato in the hot oil, being careful not to break the potatoes any further. Sprinkle the salt over and toss until the potatoes are coated all over with oil and starting to crisp up around the edges. Spread the mint leaves out in the oiled dish. Roast the potatoes for 35 to 40 minutes until nicely browned on the top and fork soft. While still warm, toss them again. They can be kept warm in the oven for up to 1/2 hour.

title: Tamina (Cashew Nut Dip)
ingredients: 1 lb ketchup | 2 lbs cashews, cashews should remain whole. ( optional, but i recommend ) | 1 cup saffron thread, crushed
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan. Heat over low heat for about 20 minutes, constantly stirring. This should prevent the nuts from drying and becoming soggy or mushy when finished. Stir continuously. Cool and serve.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,tomato puree,tilapia fillet,cardamom seed,coleslaw mix
title: Tilapia (Indian Fish) With Red Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup canned tomato puree | 4 tilapia fillets | 1/4 small green bell pepper | 1 tablespoon cardamom seed | 1 bag coleslaw mix
instructions: Drain the tomato puree from the can into a small bowl and set aside. Set the can onto waxed paper or plastic wrap and lay flat to dry a bit. Remove the pulp from the bell pepper by placing it on a cutting board and with the tip of a sharp knife cut it lengthwise into strips crosswise about 1/2 inch wide. Rinse the strips out with water and set aside. Preheat the oven to 400°f. Lightly oil a large baking dish. Place the fish in the baking dish and coat it in the tomato sauce. Bake covered for 30 minutes. Turn the fish and bake for another 10 minutes. Let it sit out on the counter for 15 minutes, then slice on the diagonal for a couple of minutes. Add the peppers and cook until tender, about 5 minutes, then remove from the oven and set aside. Mix the cardamom seeds with a few drops of water and sprinkle over the fish. Serve hot with red sauce.

title: Crawfish Croquettes
ingredients: 2 lbs crawfish tails | 5 cups water | 1 bay leaf | 2/3 cup water | 2/3 cup dry vermouth | 1 lb frozen cooked meatballs | 1/4 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 medium zucchini | 3/4 cup dry red wine
instructions: Simmer the crawfish in 3 cups of water for about 30 minutes. Slice the crawfish in half lengthwise, then crosswise into thin half moons. When the shrimp are pink, remove them from the water and set aside to cool. Place the zucchini in a colander, sprinkle lightly with salt, let sit for about 20 minutes. Rinse the zucchini under cold water and drain thoroughly. In a large, deep skillet, bring vermouth and water to a boil over high heat. Boil until it reduces by half. Add the crawfish tails, then reduce heat to medium low and simmer for 1 hour. Squeeze the zucchini into the pan and simmer for 30 minutes, until they are tender. Transfer the zucchini, liquid and meatballs to large bowls. Add the cooked crawfish, mix well and pour into the bowls. Mix in the bread crumbs, then transfer to a dish. Serve at room temperature.

title: Red Pepper and Cauliflower for the Mince or Dinner and Meal!
ingredients: 1 bunch red peppers, red capsicums can also be used ( or yellow capsicum ) | 2 jars of chickpeas ( can use canned ) | 2 large cauliflower florets, broken into florets
instructions: Cut the peppers into pieces similar in size as the cauliflower. Mix all of the ingredients into the food processor and blend until it is a chunky, creamy sauce. You may need to add a bit more water if it is too thick. Transfer to a bowl and refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: tequila,olive oil,black bean,red potato,cream sherry,pork shoulder
title: Mexican Pot Roast
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil | 8 -10 red potatoes | 14 ounces black beans, drained and rinsed | 4 ounces pork shoulder or 4 ounces steak | 2 ounces sour cream or 2 ounces sherry | 2 ounces tequila
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190c or 400f. Peel the potatoes and cut into thick slices about 1½ inches in length, then roughly slice each slice in half again. Brush the potato slices lightly with oil and place on a baking tray. Place in the oven and bake for 8 - 10 minutes or until tender. Meanwhile, put the ground pork in a large, deep frypan. Cook over a medium heat, turning once until browned, for about 5 minutes. Add the sour cream and bring to the boil. Lower the heat, then bubble for 5 minutes until thickened. Add the sherry, shaking the pan to loosen the syrupy bits. Slice the roast into serving pieces and arrange on serving dishes. Scatter with the potato strips and drizzle with the syrup.

Random Ingredients: pineapple chunk,white fish,lingonberry sauce,dark brown sugar,wheat flour
title: Crazy Fish Bread
ingredients: 1/2 cup whole wheat flour | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar | 1/2 cup pineapple chunk | 1 can white fish | 1 cup lingonberry sauce
instructions: Mix in a bowl flour, brown sugar, pineapple chunks and white fish in a food processor. Pour into a greased loaf pan. Brush over with lingonberry sauce. Bake at 350 degrees 20 minutes. Remove and cool off in pan for 10 minutes. Cut into slices to serve.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,tabasco sauce,pork,ancho chile powder,chicken meat,lime zest,coconut milk,golden raisin
title: Authentic Coconut-Guineys Carribean Pork (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 lb ground lean pork or 1 lb ground lean beef | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chiles or 1 teaspoon dried chipotle powder | 2 teaspoons pork fat or 2 teaspoons extra virgin olive oil | 2 -4 chicken cubes ( optional ) or 2 -4 chicken breast halves ( optional ) | 1/2 cup unsweetened coconut milk ( optional ) | 1 large beef bouillon cube | 2 dashes tabasco sauce ( optional ) | lime zest ( optional )
instructions: If using chicken, remove seeds and pith from chicken with a knife and discard. Place meat in the crock pot. If using chicken, add meat and coconut milk. If using meat, add all remaining ingredients and mix well. Cover and cook on high for 6 to 8 hours. Remove from crock pot, shred with two forks or spoon, discard chicken fat. Add more curry or other flavor to taste. Serve with rice, pasta, or fresh fruit to serve. You can also use a meat loaf.

title: Peachy Cherry Chutney Baked Potatoes
ingredients: 6 large baking potatoes ( about 300g x 34-inch ) | 3 peaches, quartered ( about 1 cup to 1 cup ) | 1 can peach pie filling | 1/2 tablespoon palm sugar ( optional ) | 1 chili | 1 tablespoon sweet chili, finely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in large, heavy based saucepan. Add potatoes.

title: Chili Beans
ingredients: 1 cup canned white beans | 1 can chopped green chiles | 1 cup chopped nuts
instructions: Drain beans and transfer to a saucepan. Cover and simmer over low heat for 4 to 5 hours or until beans are tender and mixture can be thickened. Stir in green chilies and heat through. Spoon mixture into a dish and sprinkle with nuts.

Random Ingredients: spanish onion,rosemary,white vinegar,grape tomato,chicken liver,palm sugar,turmeric powder
title: Persian Chicken Livers
ingredients: 4 lbs chicken livers ( any kind with blood in them ) | 8 -9 large sweet spanish onions | 32 ounces grape tomatoes | 1/2 cup white vinegar | 4 tablespoons dried rosemary | 1 tablespoon turmeric powder | 4 tablespoons palm sugar
instructions: Clean, dice onion, and wash livers. Clean, chop tomatoes into 1 cubes, drain juice from livers and tomatoes on towel. Cut off tops and bottoms of onions with a very sharp knife. Add 4 tbsp of sugar and olive oil to a non stick frying pan, and brown onions slowly over medium heat for 10 minutes, stirring constantly. Add the rest of the ingredients except for the liver. Add liver with juice. Turn down heat and simmer for 2 hours or until liver is cooked. Use more vinegar if needed, and/or sugar to achieve the right sweetness/taste balance. Serve over white rice and some pita bread. You can also use a kind of rice that stands up in the pan better, but the taste won't be as good.

title: Nargwa
ingredients: 1 cup tomato paste | 3 -5 green cardamom pods
instructions: Pour enough oil into a sauce pan to cover the bottom. Heat just until hot. Pour in tomato paste and cardamom seeds. Stir and cook for 10 minutes. When bubbly, remove from heat. This dish can also be reheated on the stove according to your preference. Also, for a thicker nargwa, or a more liquid, use evaporated milk instead of tomato paste.

title: Lime and Pecorino Grated Cheese
ingredients: 1/3 cup pecorino romano cheese, grated | 1/4 cup fresh lime juice | 1 1/2 teaspoons grated pecorino romano cheese ( i use pecorino locatelli ) or 1 1/2 teaspoons grated pecorino romano cheese ( i use pecorino locatelli )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f in medium bowl stir together olive oil, lime juice and grated cheese. Pour into ungreased 9 inch square pan. Sprinkle with some of the grated parmesan cheese. Bake covered for 25 - 30 minutes.

title: Dees Greek Dry Rub
ingredients: 1/3 cup greek dees dried mint | 1/3 cup fresh oregano leaves, loosely packed
instructions: Finely bruise mint leaves in mortar. Add mint and oregano and continue grating until mint and oregano are crushed. Pour into an airtight container and store in the fridge for up to 3 weeks.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crust,coconut milk,half cream,basmati rice
title: Coconut Rice Cream Pie
ingredients: 1/2 cup coconut milk | 1 graham cracker crust, baked, crust prepared | 1/2 cup half-and-half cream | 1/2 cup basmati rice
instructions: In a blender combine the coconut milk and half and half. Blend on high setting until mixture forms a firm mixture, about a minute. Pour mixture into the cooked graham cracker crust. Sprikle with rice and enjoy.

title: Lamb Tacos
ingredients: 5 cups leftover cooked lamb, chopped ( or use more ) | 1 yellow bell pepper, roughly diced | 1/2 cup taco shell, warmed ( i use pamela's focaccia bread-spreadable ) | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt ( optional )
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium high heat and add the minced lamb or beef. Cook until the beef is well browned and the meat has begun to crisp up, about 5 minutes. Turn the heat to low, and add the bell pepper. Cook for about one minute. Add the taco shell and stir it around a bit to combine, and cook another minute on one side, flip over, and cook another minute to brown the other side. When you're ready to eat, pile the taco onto warm, warm plates, or use your fingers to make burritos.

title: Squash, Ham and Chicken Soup
ingredients: 2 lbs hamburger | 7 1/2 cans chicken stock | 6 ounces sliced mushrooms | 4 large yellow squash, chopped, approx 4 cups
instructions: Brown hamburger meat. Remove hamburger and set aside. Add soup stock, mushrooms, squash and browned hamburger meat to 3 1/2 in. Baking dish. Top with shredded cabbage.

title: Quick Steak Oyster Salad
ingredients: 2 cans chickpeas | 2 tablespoons white sugar | 1 tablespoon dried italian parsley | 2 pounds top round steak
instructions: Soak and drain the chickpeas. In a large bowl, combine the chickpeas, sugar, and parsley. Lightly brown the steak over medium high heat, and slice the steak into thin strips. Pour into the bowl with the dressing and stir to coat. Cook and stir for 1 to 2 minutes, or until heated through.

Random Ingredients: herb,great northern bean,brown lentil,salt black pepper,baby spinach,canola oil,portobello mushroom cap
title: Mushroom and Bean Salsa
ingredients: 1 can great northern beans, drained and rinsed | 1 cup dried mushroom caps, sliced in half or | 1 bag baby spinach | fresh herb, your choice | canola oil or olive oil | salt & freshly ground black pepper | mrs. dash mixed spice ( old bay or creole herb blend )
instructions: In a large bowl, combine beans, mushrooms, and spinach. Add a handful of herb and mixed spice. Salt and pepper to taste. Salsa may be served warm as is or chilled over night for flavors to blend.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,chicken stock,halloumi cheese,chicken thigh,leg lamb,corn syrup,worcestershire sauce
title: Roasted Lamb, Cheese & Chicken With Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 7 ounces boneless leg of lamb | 8 ounces boneless skinless chicken thighs | 8 ounces halloumi cheese, roughly sliced | 1 ounce chicken stock | 1/2 ounce corn syrup | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f or 150°c. Place the lamb in a roasting tin or baking tray with the chicken thighs and chicken pieces. Using a sharp knife to cut 2 slashes each way down the length of the leg of lamb, make 2 slashes all around the lamb. Sprinkle the lamb with a little salt and place into the centre of the oven. Roast for 30 - 40 minutes, depending on the thickness of the lamb, until brown on the outside and the meat just tender in the centre. Take the meat out and allow to rest for 5 minutes. Then, using a slotted spoon, transfer the lamb, cheese, and chicken to a serving dish. Return the pan juices to the pan and cook over a low heat, scraping up any pan bits along the bottom, for 5 minutes, until the sauce had thickened and darkened. Stir in the corn syrup and worcestershire sauce, heat until the sauce had thickened and darkened and the cheese melted. Take the pan off the heat. Pour the sauce over the lamb. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: icing sugar,white pepper,apple juice,tomato,vegetable juice,cake flour,rice wine
title: Applesauce Tomato Crumble
ingredients: 1 cup cake flour | 1 tablespoon rice wine ( if using sherry ) or 1 tablespoon dry vermouth ( if using sherry ) | 1 pinch white pepper ( optional ) | 1 -2 tablespoon vegetable juice | 2 cups mixed vegetables, chopped ( such as potatoes, turnips, celery and cauliflower ) | 1 -2 tablespoon icing sugar, for topping | 2 tablespoons finely diced canned tomatoes, for topping ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees celsius. Combine flour, wine and pepper in a food processor. Process until almost smooth but not pasty. Add the remaining ingredients and process until just coarsely combined. Pour into ovenproof dish, or large baking tray coated with cooking spray. Bake in preheated oven for 30 to 35 minutes or until top is golden and crisp. Serve with biscuits and/or cold vegetables.

title: Lemon Sultanas and Fresh Fruity Cherries
ingredients: 300 g sultanas | 1 tablespoon lemon juice, freshly squeezed
instructions: Place the sultanas in a bowl. Put the lemon juice, salt, sugar, and lemon juice in a screw top jar. Cover the sultanas with a clean tea towel or clean tea cloth. Cover, let stand overnight in the sun. The next day remove the towel and squeeze all the juice that has gathered into the bowl. The sultanas should have a syrupy consistency. Leave, covered, in a warm place for up to two weeks.

title: Lamington Rolls
ingredients: 2 cups coconut | 1 cup self-raising flour | 2 cups ice water
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees celsius. Mix coconut and flour and add enough water to make a soft dough. Roll out between two pieces of clean greaseproof paper and cut into 2 cm squares. Place each square onto a square of cake paper. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Grilled Serrano Garlic Bread (Sopa Seca)
ingredients: 2 garlic cloves, minced | sliced baguette
instructions: Using a mortar and pestle, mash the garlic with the flat of an electric knife until smooth. Divide the mixture into a bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Preheat grill for medium heat. Grill bread slices until golden, about 1 1/2 minutes on each side, or to desired doneness.

title: Tamarind Sauce
ingredients: 4 sprigs fresh chives, to be garnished | 1/2 cup tamarind paste
instructions: Remove the hard stems from the fresh chives, and chop the green parts of the ends finely. In a food processor, using a fine grater blade, process all the chives. The mixture should be crumbly. Add the tamarind paste and process again. Store in a clean container.

title: Apple Eggplant Pizza
ingredients: 1 eggplants | 1 jar apple juice | 1 green pepper, chopped | 1 1/2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Cut egg plant in half lengthwise and scoop out the thick middle pulp. Slice pulp into 1/4 inch slices. Set pulp aside until needed. Combine pulp, juice, and green pepper in a baking dish or small roasting pan. Bake in preheated oven until liquid is reduced and crust is golden brown, about 25 to 30 minutes. Top eggplant with mozzarella if desired, and continue baking until hot and bubbly, about 3 - 5 minutes.

title: Easy Chinese Dipping Sauce for Fettuccini
ingredients: 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 3 tablespoons dry sesame seeds or 3 tablespoons poppy seeds
instructions: Mix all ingredients in small bowl. Enjoy and serve as soon as desired.

title: Beer Battered Brandy
ingredients: 2 ciabatta, thinly sliced | 3 tablespoons brandy or 3 tablespoons cognac | 12 fennel, leaves only, chopped | 2 tablespoons tequila
instructions: In a heavy, heavy based frying pan, toast the ciabatta slices, until golden.

title: Baileys Irish Whiskey Lamb
ingredients: 1/2 cup irish whiskey | 6 ounces boneless lamb shoulder, trimmed of fat | 6 chocolate candy bars
instructions: Pour whiskey into a small bowl. Cut the lamb into cubes about 2 1/2 to 3 inches wide and 16 1/2 inches long. Score into 12 slices.

title: Vegetable Pasta Salad
ingredients: 4 ounces pasta ( i like macaroni ) | 1 jar of any mixed vegetables, diced ( i use fresh mushrooms, fresh green and carrots or fresh broccoli ) | 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 - 1 quart pineapple juice | 1 bay leaf | mushroom, sliced | raisin preserves
instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions, drain, & set aside. Toss all other ingredients together in a large bowl. Pour mixture over drained pasta, & sprinkle with raisins. Enjoy.

title: Cauliflower in Rice Wine
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, cut into florets | 2 tablespoons sherry wine
instructions: In a large skillet or pot, bring water to a boil. Add in the cauliflower and cover the pan. Cook over low heat for ten to fifteen minutes. Remove from heat and stir in the sherry. If you want more pronounced flavor, strain cauliflower.

Random Ingredients: spring onion,flour tortilla,anchovy paste,maraschino cherry,head cauliflower,egg noodle
title: Lentils and Noodles With Anchovies and Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 medium head cauliflower | 1/2 cup anchovy paste | 2 -3 tablespoons flour tortillas, torn or cut into small pieces | 1 bunch spring onion, chopped | 1/4 cup maraschino cherry, coarsely chopped | 1 egg noodles, broken or 4 -6 slices egg noodles, for dipping
instructions: Rinse the cauliflower, removing the ends and being careful not to break up anything on the inside. Slice crossways into thin wedges. Add 2 tablespoons of the anchovy paste and coat the cauliflower. Pour 1 inch of oil in a frying pan, and heat. When it is hot, carefully add two tablespoons of the anchovy paste. Stir the contents of the pan until the anchovy is nicely browned, then mix together with the cauliflower. Add a little more oil, a little at a time, if desired. Add one or two pieces of the egg noodles, and allow them to fry in the hot oil. After about five to six minutes, check for tenderness. If the noodle are soft, drain them well and add some more anchovy paste on top. Dish the noodles up and sprinkle on some maraschino or spring onion with the anchovy mixture. Serve the lentils in warmed taco shells, with dipping sauce, if desired.

Random Ingredients: stuffing mix,tomato sauce,chicken wing,mascarpone,raspberry,liquid smoke,pine nut,black peppercorn
title: Pesto Chicken Wings
ingredients: 3 cups prepared sloppy joe stuffing mix | 2 cups tomato sauce | 1/2 teaspoon black peppercorns | 2 lbs chicken wings, split | 2 tablespoons lemon-flavored liqueur ( recommended ( tabasco ) | 3 tablespoons pine nuts, toasted | 1/4 cup mascarpone cheese, room temperature ( optional ) | 1/4 cup fresh raspberry ( optional )
instructions: Place stuffing mix, tomato sauce, and peppercorns in a large bowl. Add chicken wings.

Random Ingredients: cumin,colby monterey jack cheese,goat cheese,pork,purpose flour
title: Mexican Stuffed Pork Tostadas
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground lean pork | 4 ounces goat cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons all-purpose flour | 1/2 cup shredded colby-monterey jack cheese | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degress f. Spray 2 jelly roll pans or 10 foil lined 1 1/2 1/2 inch baking sheets with cooking spray. In a large bowl, combine the pork, half of the goat cheese, the flour, cheese, and cumin. Shape into 1 1/2 inch thick logs on a lightly floured surface. Place on prepared pans or foil lined pans. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until loaves sound hollow when knocked on the bottom. Remove from baking sheets. Let cool completely. Slice each log into 3 or 4 pieces and serve. Makes 8 to 10 servings. My note, because the goat cheese is usually not so soft like real cream cheese, the flavor goes totally into taste and taste. As written, i did not use the cheese at all, but it depends on what type you use. I found the goat cheese was a little too soft for my taste. This turned out fine. The cheeses took out a few more minutes per side. I also added the rest of the cheese to the meat mixture. I mixed the cumin and the rest of the goat cheese. This was a hit too. A definite must in my book.

Random Ingredients: white flour,yellow pepper,thyme leave,sesame seed,pastry dough
title: Krispy Thyme Pepper (Or Pepper) Rings(Vegetarian)
ingredients: pastry dough, for the pan ( recipe # i posted a recipe for my vegan cheese dough ) | 3/4 - 1 cup all purpose white flour | 20 -30 whole thyme leaves | 2 -3 small yellow peppers ( you decide how much you want to use ) | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds ( optional )
instructions: Pour enough water to come halfway up the side of the countertop pans. On the countertop or your countertop, roll out your pastry to a thickness of about 1 1/2 inches. This is your dough. If you have a pizza slicer or your fingers, it will work. Using a round bladed knife, slice your pepper into 1/4 thick rings and then cut off the tops and remove the seeds. Place flour on the countertop or your countertop. Dredge your pepper rings in the flour, rolling it around so that they start to curl in the edges, then gently pull the rings to the bottom. Continue to do this on each side in 2 or 3 batches. Place the coated bread on a cookie sheet and spread the sesame seeds on the bread. If you wish, brush each of the top and the last rings with beaten egg yolk. You will be adding more bread to the baking sheet on the day this is made. Bake for 20 minutes or until golden brown on the tops. I have a # 5 bread recipe that we double the recipe for each recipe.

title: Crispy Shiitake & Green Chile Wraps
ingredients: 1 garlic clove, peeled and coarsely chopped | 8 shiitake mushrooms, cut in half ( i like the fresh ones ) | 1/4 cup chinese green chili peppers or 1/4 cup red chile, finely chopped | 4 tortillas | 1 jar shiitake mushrooms, drained and coarsely chopped ( about 8 large mushrooms )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f rub the cut sides of the garlic with the chopped dried chiles. Lay the tortillas out flat on a large nonstick peel of parchment paper or foil. Divide the garlic, chiles, and mushrooms evenly among the tortillas. Roll up the tortillas starting with the long side, and pinch closed along the sides and the ends with the parchment paper or foil. Repeat with the remaining tortillas and mushrooms. Spread the mushrooms on the top of the roll, and sprinkle the chili pepper/chile mixture across evenly. Bake for about 20 minutes, or until the mushrooms are tender and the roll is slightly crisped. Remove from the oven, remove the parchment, and serve hot or warm.

Random Ingredients: rice flour,shrimp without tail,red capsicum,monterey jack cheese,active yeast,apricot
title: Fried Macroons on a Budget
ingredients: 3 cups rice flour | 2 packets active dry yeast | 250 g raw shrimp without tails | 2 tablespoons capers | 1 red capsicum ( pepper ) | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl. Add shrimp as filling. Leave some room to firm up. Heat pan over medium high heat, pour about 2 tablespoonsful of oil onto pan. When it is hot, throw in as many as will fit in a single layer into pan. Cook until golden, turn and cook remaining till the other side is golden. Serve warm. If you have cooked these your normal way, you should fill the hole in the middle with 1 teaspoon of filling, then pop back in and fry again till the outside is crispy looking and the insides are firm.

Random Ingredients: cooking spray,tomato puree,rotini pasta,parmigiano reggiano cheese,icing sugar
title: Risotto With Tomato and Parmesan
ingredients: 400 g rotini pasta | cooking spray | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 250 g grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 tablespoon tomato puree | 8 teaspoons icing sugar
instructions: Spray a large saucepan with cooking spray.

title: Mango Chutney Smoothie
ingredients: 1 package firm tofu, drained and crumbled | 1/4 cup mango chutney | 1/4 cup buttermilk | 2 teaspoons lime juice ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender and pulse just until smooth.

title: Crock Pot Sweet and Sour Cabbage
ingredients: 1 head cabbage, cored and shredded | 2 cans sweetened condensed milk sweetened condensed milk, condensed milk variety | 1 cup fresh cranberries, chopped or 1 cup frozen cranberries
instructions: Put all ingredients in a crock pot, stirring well to mix. Cover and cook on low heat setting 7 - 9 hours. Serve with bread, crackers, fresh fruit, or as a snack.

Random Ingredients: corn oil,salmon fillet,lipton onion soup mix
title: Molletes De Comutto
ingredients: 2 lbs salmon fillets ( or other smoked fish fillet ) | 1 packet lipton onion soup mix | corn oil ( for frying, i use grapeseed oil )
instructions: Rinse the fillets and pat dry thoroughly with paper towel. Dry on paper towel. Spray non stick oil in frying pan and heat to medium temperature. Remove fillets from pan to a baking tray lined with paper towel. Sprinkle with onion soup mix. Place fillets on top of onion soup mix and bake about 15 minutes until cooked. Serve hot with potatoes, green salad and french bread.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,buttermilk biscuit,lamb,sunflower seed,cake flour,watermelon schnapps,chile pepper,mexican corn
title: Mexican Shephard Lamb With Corn and Seed Muffins
ingredients: 500 g ground lamb | 100 g mexican blend cheese, finely diced, divided | 1 tablespoon chile pepper, finely chopped ( ajicitos ) | 1/2 cup sunflower seeds, plus extra toasted | 1/2 cup chile pepper schnapps | 1/4 cup buttermilk biscuit | 2 cups thick buttermilk biscuits | 1/4 cup cake flour | 1/2 cup watermelon, flesh chopped | 2 tablespoons sunflower seeds, toasted | 1 tablespoon mexican blend cheese, finely diced, divided
instructions: Combine lamb, half the cheese, chili, toasted seeds, schnapps and buttermilk biscuit in a large bowl and mix well. Spoon mixture into prepared muffin tin and bake in a moderate oven for 20 minutes or until cooked, turning once, topping with more sunflower seeds during the last 5 minutes of cooking. Serve with mexican blend cheese for dipping.

title: Avocado & Chickpea Bake
ingredients: 1 packet biscuit mix | 400 g canned chick-peas, drained | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 3 avocados, mashed ( or 1 standard can for 2 servings ) | 1 cup red wine | 1/2 cup ice, crushed | 1 can pumpkin, drained and finely chopped ( or 1 2 cups of a winter squash )
instructions: Preheat oven to 220c/425f/gas grease 4 x 12 cup microwave safe cake tins or one 2 cup size casserole dish, or lightly oil the inside. Combine biscuit mix, chickpeas, vanilla and avocado in a large bowl. Add wine and stir until combined. Spoon mixture into prepared pan. Bake for 10 minutes, or until golden and springy to the touch. Serve with a green salad.

Random Ingredients: pistachio,saffron thread,peach,pumpkin seed,baking soda,green cardamom pod,fenugreek seed
title: Pistachio Pepper Spice Muffins (Kheer)
ingredients: 2/3 cup pumpkin seeds | 2/3 cup shelled pistachios or 2/3 cup walnuts | 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds | 2 tablespoons peaches, chopped | 1/2 cup dried roasted pistachios, chopped | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 3 green cardamom pods, cracked and split | 1 teaspoon saffron thread
instructions: Mix pumpkin seeds into the nuts. Mix fenugreek seeds into the nut mixture.

title: Shiitake Nuts and Cheese
ingredients: 4 sunflower oil | 4 ounces shiitake mushrooms | 3 ounces soft bread crumbs | 3 ounces cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat griddle to its highest, then brush the pan with sunflower oil and toast mushrooms until softened and beginning to release their juices. Remove from heat, then drain. Place the soft breadcrumbs on a clean work surface and then sprinkle with sunflower oil. Coat with the breadcrumb mixture, pressing down firmly. Slice goats foot lengthways and then crossways into 4 lengthways strips. Place each strip onto a large preheated pan and sprinkle with the grated cheese and cook until the cheese is beginning to melt.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,skewer,red food coloring,sun tomato oil,adobo seasoning
title: Adobo Sticky Pecorino Romesco Dip
ingredients: 8 -10 medium sized pecorino romano cheese, diced | 4 -6 sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, chopped | 1 tablespoon adobo seasoning, minced | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon red food coloring ( optional ) | coarse salt or coarse salt ( as needed )
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Mix well. Add coarse salt to taste. Serve with tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage,chicken leg,no salt tomato,black vinegar,golden raisin
title: Low-Fat Italian Sausage Chicken Salad
ingredients: 1 large italian sausage ( or links ) | 4 chicken legs ( the legs with the skin on ) | 1 can no-salt-added crushed tomatoes | 1/2 cup golden raisin ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon black vinegar
instructions: Remove the skin from the sausage and cut into thick slices. Rinse and pat dry the chicken legs. Remove the bone and discard. Cook the chicken legs in boiling water until meat can be pulled out of the skin easily. Remove chicken from pot and cut into bite size chunks. Set aside to cool. Meanwhile, remove chicken from skin, discard bone. Cut sausage into slices and set aside. Drain the tomatoes. Put all the drained sauce ingredients in a large bowl. Add the sliced sausage, chicken, and raisins. Toss to combine.

title: Brown Mustard Soup With Yellow Onions
ingredients: 6 yellow onions | 400 ml vegetable stock | 1 tablespoon brown mustard | salt and pepper
instructions: Peel and chop the onions as finely as possible. Put the onions in a pot, add the broth and bring to a boil. Turn the heat to low and simmer for about 40 minutes. Add the mustard and salt and pepper. Stir to coat. Cover and simmer for another 15 - 20 minutes until the onions are well cooked. Transfer to bowls and serve immediately.

title: Hominy Relish
ingredients: 28 ounces hominy | 1/2 cup diced red pepper
instructions: Place tomatoes and peppers in a saucepan in a single layer. Pour water into pan, enough to cover ingredients. Bring to boil and then simmer until flavors are blended, about 30 minutes. Let cool to room temperature. Transfer to a blender and add remaining ingredients. Blend well and store at least 2 weeks in the fridge.

title: Grilled Pork Tenderloin W- Cognac
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin | 2 tablespoons cognac
instructions: Heat a grill pan over medium high heat. Cut the pork tenderloin lengthwise into 1/2 inch slices. Place slices between plastic wrap and flatten with an aluminum mallet. Spread the slices with cognac. Place the pan over medium heat and place pork. Cook, turning once, until internal temperature reaches 145°f on an instant read thermometer, about 15 to 18 minutes, turning once. Remove from heat and let sit 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: white flour,celery salt,sirloin steak,canola oil,baby carrot,gnocchi
title: Gnocchi and Beef
ingredients: 16 ounces boneless sirloin steaks | 1 1/2 tablespoons canola oil | 1/4 teaspoon celery salt | 36 -39 fresh giant gnocchi, broken into small pieces | 12 baby carrots | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 3 tablespoons canola oil, for pan frying
instructions: Cut steak into 1 inch thick strips, then pound into 1/4 inch wide strips. Place in a bowl and add the canola oil. Sprinkle on the celery salt. Dredge in oil. Let stand for about 5 minutes. In a large pot of boiling water, cook gnocchi as per package directions. Drain, drain and reserve. Cook the beef in 1tsp of canola oil until no longer pink.

Random Ingredients: english cucumber,poblano chile,chipotle pepper,onion flake,bok choy
title: Fried Cucumber-Chile-Kung Poblano
ingredients: 3/4 cup prepared chopped onion flakes | 2 poblano chiles, stemmed and seeded, thinly sliced on the bias | 1 tablespoon dried chipotle pepper, crushed ( in adobo sauce ) | 1 1/2 lbs bok choy, trimmed and cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 english cucumber, thinly sliced
instructions: Drain and discard seeds from poblano chiles. If necessary, rinse chiles under cold water. In a medium bowl, stir together onion flakes and 1/4 cup of the chile soaking liquid and let stand at room temperature for 30 minutes. Coarsely chop chiles, then drain onion mixture and reserve liquid. Pulse chiles in a food processor until coarsely chopped. Transfer 1/2 of chile soaking liquid to a small bowl. Stir in remaining soaking liquid and 1/4 cup chile soaking liquid, remaining chopped chile, chiles, and chipotle pepper. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours. Cook about 1/2 of the bok choy in a small pot of boiling water 2 minutes, then drain. Cover and chill until just tender crisp, about 30 seconds. Drain and set aside. Heat a 12 inch non stick wok over medium high heat until very hot. Add a generous splash of oil. When it shimmers, add half the chile mixture and stir fry until sizzling.
