Then add half of the bok choy and stir fry, then add half the chile soaking liquid and remaining bok choy. Continue stir frying, then add remaining chile soaking liquid and stir fry. Continue to stir fry, cooking until sizzling again. Remove from heat and slice into wedges, separating onion as you slice. Arrange the remaining bok choy on a serving platter and top with shredded cucumbers. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: caramel ice cream topping,white mushroom,maraschino cherry juice,chicken wing,artichoke heart
title: Danish Chicken Wings from the Gehos
ingredients: 1 jar maraschino cher juice | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained | 12 small white mushrooms, sliced | 8 chicken wings, tips removed | 1 tablespoon caramel ice cream topping
instructions: Combine maraschino cher juice, artichoke hearts, and mushrooms in a blender.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,garlic,hoagie,pepper sauce,cauliflower,beef,dark brown sugar,chili sauce
title: Slow-Cooked Shredded Spaghetti
ingredients: 11 ounces beef, shredded | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 2 tablespoons chili sauce | 1 teaspoon dark brown sugar | 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1 tablespoon garlic, minced | 1 box hoagie rolls | 3 cups cauliflower, florets and or fresh crisp chard, coarsely chopped
instructions: In 2 1/2 quart slow cooker, stir together meat, soup, chilli sauce, sugar, hot pepper sauce, garlic and hot pepper sauce.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,swiss cheese,italian salad dressing mix
title: Simple Swiss Cheese Dip
ingredients: 2 bags of grated swiss cheese ( deli or white swiss ) | 1 1/2 cups chunky salsa ( your favourite brand ) | 1 envelope italian salad dressing mix
instructions: Put swiss cheese and all in a 9x13 pan and stir until cheese is melted and mixed. Add salsa and italian dressing mix to cheese. Stir, taste, and add more salsa if desired. Refrigerate on low for at least 1 hour. To serve, it needs to be chilled, and dip is getting hot. Serve with corn chips, veggies or crackers.

Random Ingredients: tom yum paste,black olive,cocoa powder,romaine lettuce leaf
title: Egg Nog Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/4 cup tomato yum paste | 3 ounces black olives, pitted, chopped | 2 romaine lettuce leaves, leaves only | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Combine the tomato yum paste and olives in a small bowl and stir until the mixture is smooth. Spread about 1/4 cup of the tomato tomato mixture on the bottom half of each lettuce leaf. Place 2 slices of the romaine mixture on the lettuce and top with the remaining lettuce leaves. Sprinkle with cocoa and remaining tomato mixture. Serve.

title: Tiger Shrimp & Rice Sandwiches
ingredients: 400 g pre-made pizza sauce | 125 g yoghurt | 2 tablespoons grand marnier | 400 g tiger shrimp, cleaned | 2 cups cooked white rice
instructions: Combine yoghurt, grand marnier and shrimp in large bowl. Mix well. Divide mixture between two breads. Top with rice. Cut into 4 long diagonal slices, then cut again to make 4 diagonal slices. Bake at 220c, uncovered, for 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Hot Duck on Vegetables
ingredients: 16 ounces chicken or 16 ounces duck | 2 ducks, in a bag | 1 1/2 cups canned navy beans | 2 tablespoons butter
instructions: Preheat oven to 325'f. Dehull the ducks if desired, removing neck and spongy parts so they are cooked as quickly as possible. Place duck and beans into a roasting pan and set aside. Slice wings on the side to expose the fat. Put remaining duck fat up in the roasting pan. Bake for 2 1/2 hours, basting at least once, and adding butter as necessary. When duck is done, remove bones from roasting pan and skin. Place duck back in pan on stovetop to keep warm. Remove any skin and bones with a sharp knife from the duck legs and legs. Strain duck juices and set aside at least half of the duck fat mixture.

Random Ingredients: provolone cheese,cream tartar,tofu,salmon fillet,teriyaki sauce,yellow pepper,thai fish sauce,red crystal sugar
title: Spicy Tofu and Sea Bass in Teriyaki Sauce
ingredients: 1 packet firm tofu | 2 tablespoons prepared teriyaki sauce | 2 teaspoons light teriyaki sauce | 2 teaspoons yellow hot peppers or 2 teaspoons red crystal sugar | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 2 teaspoons thai fish sauce | 2 teaspoons yellow hot pepper or 2 teaspoons red crystal sugar | 8 slices fresh salmon fillet | 2 slices provolone cheese
instructions: Drain tofu on paper towels. Place tofu on tray, cover and let stand for 15 minutes. Meanwhile prepare teriyaki sauce. Drain tofu on paper towels. Make sauce while tofu is chilling. Combine teriyaki sauce, hot peppers or sugar, tai sauce, fish sauce and crystal sugar in small bowl. Taste sauce for sweetness. Dip one side of each salmon fillet into teriyaki sauce, then lay on oiled metal skewers. Place salmon on oiled grid and broil or bake in preheated 500 degree oven for 5 minutes, turn over and broil on other side for 3 minutes to give fish an even golden brown glaze. Serve each fillet with a piece of provolone cheese to serve.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,mustard seed,cumin seed,dark brown sugar,thai basil,lime wedge
title: Thai Basil Pickles
ingredients: 6 leaves fresh thai basil ( about 1 1/2 inches long, washed and trimmed ) | 2 cups packed dark brown sugar, firmly packed ( or to taste ) | 1/2 cup whole cumin seeds | 1/2 cup mustard seeds | 2 limes, wedged | salt and pepper
instructions: Line a fine mesh sieve with a double thickness of paper towels. Tear off the thick stems and discard. Roughly chop the basil. In large serving bowl, combine the basil, brown sugar, cumin, mustard seeds, lime wedges and salt and pepper to taste. Cover and chill for at least 3 hours. Make ahead, cover and tightly seal. Makes about 3 cups pickles.

title: Coriander Cabbage
ingredients: 1 fennel bulb, cored and sliced | 2 tablespoons coriander seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place fennel slices in a roasting pan. Sprinkle over coriander seeds. Roast in the preheated oven until brown, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: egg white,balsamic vinegar,topping,beef stew meat,walnut half,percent agave tequila,cinnamon,chocolate syrup
title: Crock Pot Chocolate Shredded Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat | 4 ounces bittersweet chocolate syrup | 3/4 cup 100 percent agave tequila | 1 teaspoon cinnamon | 1 egg white, lightly beaten | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1/2 cup whipped topping | 5 walnut halves
instructions: Combine beef, chocolate syrup, tequila cinnamon and sugar in a 5 cup crockpot. Cook on low setting for 10 minutes. Stir in egg white and vinegar. Cover and cook for 1 1/2 hours. Remove beef from crockpot and place on serving platter. Spoon chocolate sauce over beef, garnish with walnuts.

Random Ingredients: basil leaf,agave nectar,cranberry sauce,peach,italian tomato,red lentil,cucumber
title: Til Delicious Summer Salad
ingredients: 2 medium italian tomatoes ( or 4 medium, if you like it ) | 2 -3 sweet apples | 1 cup red lentil ( can sub white or pinto beans ) | 1 cup red lentil ( can sub white or pinto beans ) | 1/2 cup light agave nectar ( can sub sugar ) | 1 cup basil leaves | 1/4 cup cucumber ( optional ) | 1/3 cup peach preserves or 1/3 cup peach preserves ( optional )
instructions: In a large bowl, toss the first 8 ingredients. Drizzle with preserves. Chill for 30 minutes or longer before serving.

title: Lebanese Rice With Rice Croutons
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil or 2 tablespoons clarified butter | 1/4 cup blanched almond | 3 cups short-grain white rice | 3/4 cup hoisin sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons sumac or 1 1/2 tablespoons cardamom, and 2 3/8 tsp crushed dried chilies | 2 1/2 teaspoons dried basil, lightly crushed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Prepare a baking sheet by lining with parchment or waxed paper. In a large skillet, heat the heated olive oil over medium heat. Add the blanched almond slivers and cook, stirring often, until lightly golden. Remove almonds and set aside. Place rice in a bowl and pour hot olive oil over it. Stir, cover tightly, and set aside at least 10 minutes. Drain off all excess oil. While rice is still warm, mix hoisin sauce, sumac, red chili and basil in a small bowl. Dice the almonds and stir into the rice. Pour the rice mixture into a baking sheet about 1/2 large diameter. Press rice croutons into a 1 1/2 2 1/2 inch thick round on a floured surface. Bake until crisp, about 30 minutes.

title: BBQ Lamb and Eggs
ingredients: 2 cups baby spinach leaves | 1 lamb, fat trimmed | 1 teaspoon steak sauce | 12 hard-boiled eggs | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce
instructions: Bbq or fry the lamb and eggs to your liking. In a bowl, mix the sauces for to marinade. Place the spinach leaves in a large bowl. Pile on top of the meat and then pour over the marinade. Mix well, taste and adjust spice and seasonings. Cook over a hot hot bbq or a very hot oven of your choice to your preference. Serve with rice and veggies. We like this salad cold too.

title: Fruit Sauté from the Farm Journal
ingredients: 300 g apples, peeled, cored and cut into quarters | 2 tablespoons tarragon, fresh, chopped ( or 1 tsp dried )
instructions: Toss apples with tarragon and chill until needed.

Random Ingredients: del monte kabob kit,chili flake,black pepper
title: Achiote Paste
ingredients: 1 package del monte kabob kit | 1/2 teaspoon black pepper | 2 -3 teaspoons chili flakes ( depending on how spicy you like it )
instructions: Grind the package kabob using either an electric coffee grinder or mortar and pestle. You might need to add water at this time as you want more flavor. If too spicy, add a little water at a time. It will be oily, but not watery. Store in a air tight container or glass jar, or in the freezer until needed.

Random Ingredients: glace apricot,duck leg,basil pesto,confectioner ' sugar,pistachio nut,rice,cooking spray
title: Duck Legs With Pesto & Rice
ingredients: 1 cup pistachio nut, chopped | 2 tablespoons cooking spray | 1/2 cup glace apricot, roughly chopped | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar | 1 whole duck leg, cut into 8 pieces ( about 3 pounds ) | 3 cups cooked rice | confectioners'sugar, for dusting
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 and spray a 12 x 7 inch baking pan with cooking spray. In a small bowl, combine the pistachios. Using a second hand, mix together the pistachio nuts and 2 tablespoons of the pistachio pignoli powder. Set aside. Rinse off the duck parts. Pat dry with paper towels. Coat the duck legs with 1/3 cup of pistachio nut mixture. Place in the second baking pan and make an indentation in the center of each thigh about 3/4 inch deep, with the tip of a knife pushed down a little. Sprinkle the duck with confectioners' sugar. Bake for 20 minutes, or until the duck is cooked through. While the duck is baking, bring the rice to a boil in lightly salted water. Stir in the remaining pistachio powder and cook for 4 - 5 minutes, or until the rice is tender and has absorbed the water. Sprinkle the rice with more confectioners' sugar and let rest for 5 minutes. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: bacon dripping,serrano chili pepper,quinoa,thyme leaf,tarragon,asparagus,chili oil
title: Asparagus and Quinoa Stir Fry
ingredients: 1/4 cup bacon drippings | 1 sprig thyme leaves | 1 tablespoon fresh tarragon or 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 serrano chili pepper, seeded and finely chopped | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 1 lb asparagus, cleaned | 1 1/2 cups quinoa, rinsed
instructions: In a large frying pan, fry the bacon drippings over medium heat until almost crisp. Add the thyme and tarragon, and saute for about 30 seconds. Stir in the chile, and saute 1 minute. Stir in the asparagus. Stir in 1 cup of quinoa, and cover. Simmer for 15 minutes. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: perch,allspice berry,white onion,grain white rice,lasagna noodle,sauce,cream
title: Sauce- Fried Rice
ingredients: 2 bottles hot sauce | 1 cup uncooked long grain white rice | 4 whole allspice berries | 1 large white onion, cut into thin slices | 1 package lasagna noodles | 1 pint sour cream | 1 pint guacamole or 1 pint guacamole, for serving
instructions: In a saucepan, with a lid to contain hot sauce, put the rice, allspice, onion and saute for 10 minutes. Spread some hot sauce on the bottom of an ungreased deep frying pan, arrange noodles in a single layer, top noodles with some hot sauce. Cover with more sauce, and press down lightly. Cook over medium heat for about 5 hours. When all the sauces have been absorbed and the rice is soft, uncover, and cook for about 45 more minutes. Check after 15 minutes, if the rice is done, put the pan in a warm oven and set timer for 20 minutes, until crispy and creamy.

title: The Best Damn Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 firm ripe plum tomatoes | 2 fluid ounces irish whiskey ( or to taste )
instructions: Core the tomatoes and cut in half. Remove the stem, the seeds and the pulp. Place the slices in a cocktail shaker and add just enough whiskey to cover all of the tomatoes. Shake well. Place the shaker in a cold water bath for 30 minutes and then take out and shake, removing as much whiskey as you can before serving.

Random Ingredients: plain yogurt,tomato basil pasta sauce,dill,olive,dark brown sugar,vodka,mint leaf,prune
title: Mint Liqueur
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups canned sliced ripe olives | 3/4 cup fresh dill | 1/2 cup fresh mint leaves | 1/4 cup vodka | 1 can plum tomato and basil pasta sauce | 3/4 cup plain yogurt or 3/4 cup nonfat yogurt | 3 ounces prunes ( dried or fresh ) | 3 tablespoons dark brown sugar
instructions: Soak prunes in 1/2 cup of hot vodka over night, drain and coarsely chop. Remove 1/2 cup of vodka for last 2 hours of soaking and squeeze the remaining vodka out of the can. Put prunes and vodka in blender or food processor and blend until smooth. Cover and refrigerate until needed. Pour the tomato sauce, yogurt or nonfat yogurt, prunes and 1 tablespoon of brown sugar into a small saucepan and cover with a lid. Bring to a boil, reduce to a low simmer and cook for 20 minutes until well blended. Remove from heat, cover and set aside to chill for at least up to 2 hours. Just before serving, stir in 2 tablespoons of remaining vodka and the mint leaves. Serve in chilled martini glasses. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: tamari,sesame seed,italian herb seasoning,green chili,golden syrup,vanilla sugar,lettuce
title: Tami Salad
ingredients: 2 heads lettuce | 1/4 cup sesame seeds | 1 green chili, finely chopped ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon sesame oil or 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 tablespoon tamari | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 1 teaspoon sun-dried mixed dried herbs or 1 teaspoon dried mixed italian herbs | 2 tablespoons granulated vanilla sugar, to taste
instructions: Wash lettuce well, spin dry. Cut off outer leaves. Tear into bite sized pieces. Toss lettuce with sesame seeds, chili and oils and mix well. Store in air tight glass glass container at room temperature.

title: Mama Dalla's  Greek Yogurt Dressing Cookies
ingredients: 1 container plain greek yogurt | 1 can maraschino cherries | 1 teaspoon dried chili flakes | 1 cup dry bread crumbs
instructions: Mix together and store in the refrigerator. Use to dress chicken, beef, lamb, veal or shrimp or leave on salads too. Add to ice cream, veal, chicken, sausage, or pita bread until you're ready for your meal.

Random Ingredients: coconut cream,wheat bread,demerara sugar,oregano leaf,pineapple juice,heavy cream
title: Tropical Bread (Pina Colada)
ingredients: 6 tablespoons coconut cream | 2 tablespoons pineapple juice | 1 teaspoon demerara sugar | 1/2 teaspoon oregano leaves | 4 slices whole wheat bread, buttered, toasted and cooled | 1 tablespoon heavy cream or 1 tablespoon evaporated low-fat milk
instructions: Place the coconut cream, pineapple juice, sugar and oregano in a small mixing bowl until well blended. Place the toasted bread slices on a work surface or work surface. Spoon the coconut mixture on toasted bread slices. Top with a dollop of cream and/or evaporated milk.

title: Aguado De Azuvetta (Guatemalan Poppy Seed Cookies)
ingredients: 3/4 cup poppy seeds | 3/4 teaspoon powdered saffron | 150 ml double cream | 1 guacamole
instructions: Dry roast the poppy seeds in a dry frying pan until they can smell good and are light brown in color. Remove them from the heat, mix in powdered saffron and then add cream and mix well. Spread out on a cookie sheet. Spread guacamole on top. You can also make guacamole by mixing sour cream with a little sugar, pour on top.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,dill seed,chicken broth,fenugreek leaf,golden raisin
title: Dill, Raisin and Parsley Soup
ingredients: 3/4 cup dried dill leaves ( karratha ) | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 1/2 cup flat leaf parsley, chopped | 1/2 cup finely chopped chives | 2 tablespoons minced fresh dill seeds
instructions: Rinse and discard any damaged dill leaves or damaged peas. Place about 1 1/2 cups water in a large saucepan and bring to a boil. Place the dill leaves in the pan and simmer over low heat about 5 minutes. Cover and remove from the heat. Let it steep until ready to use. Press out the excess water and discard. Transfer the dill and toasted dill leaves and discard any or all particles of dill. Place the raisins, the parsley, chives and dill seeds in a mortar and pestle and grind lightly. Place the mixture in a food processor or blender along with the reserved dill and toasted dill leaves. Process to a paste. Pour the soup into a saucepan over low heat and stir constantly to bring the soup up to the boil. Reduce the heat to low and simmer the soup, loosely covered, until the flavors are blended, about 20 minutes. Ladle into bowls and serve.

Random Ingredients: hazelnut,peanut,green pepper,kosher salt,dark sesame oil,pesto sauce
title: Pesto Hazelnut Peanuts
ingredients: 1 cup hazelnuts | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 3 green peppers, sliced | 1 tablespoon pesto sauce ( homemade or store bought ) | 2 tablespoons chopped roasted peanuts
instructions: Place the peeled and sliced hazelnuts in a pan.

title: Borsht
ingredients: 4 roma ( plum ) tomatoes, diced | 2 cans beets, drained | 2 tablespoons red currant jelly
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Mix roma tomatoes, beets, red currant jelly ingredients, and bring to a boil. Bake in the preheated oven until tender, about 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,lemon juice zest,black vinegar,fig,queso fresco,thyme leaf,pepper sauce
title: Fig and Queso Fresco Dressing
ingredients: 2 teaspoons dark rum ( about 1 ounce ) | 2 teaspoons fresh lemon juice ( about 3 tablespoons ) | 2 teaspoons black vinegar ( about 2 teaspoons ) | 1/4 teaspoon hot pepper sauce ( or to taste ) | 1/8 teaspoon thyme leaves ( about 1/8 teaspoon ) | 1 cup crumbled queso fresco ( may use black beans ) | 2 dried figs, coarsely chopped
instructions: In small bowl, whisk together rum, lemon juice, vinegar, hot pepper sauce and thyme. Stir in cheese and figs a few pieces at a time, stirring until mixture is creamy. Adjust vinegar and hot pepper sauce to taste with salt, if needed. Refrigerate dressing 2 hours or longer. Note, this is a fairly dry recipe, so you may need to add up to 3/4 cup extra dressing. To make more dressing, thin with water if you like a smoother dressing, thicker dressing, or a bit of cornstarch. This could be made several days or several weeks ahead.

Random Ingredients: brown rice,lasagna,pace picante sauce,vinegar,tomato,thai fish sauce,fruit,green pepper
title: Tom's Yummy & Yummy Low Fat Spanish Lasagna
ingredients: 3 cups cooked brown rice | 28 ounces diced tomatoes | 3 -4 small green peppers | 3/4 cup water | 2 tablespoons vinegar ( i use red, but i think red would be fine ) | 1/3 cup thai fish sauce | 2 tablespoons thai fish sauce | 8 small lasagna sheets | 16 ounces of any flavorful salsa ( i like pace picante sauce )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Mix the rice, tomatoes, green peppers, water, vinegar, and fish sauce together in a large bowl. Pour the salsa over the rice mixture and toss until the liquid is absorbed, about a half hour. Line 2 13x9x2 inch baking dish with the lasagna sheets. Spread half of the rice mixture in the baking dish. Top the rice mixture with half of the tomato sauce, and half of the green pepper/salsa mixture. Repeat layers. Cover top with foil and bake at 350f for about 45 minutes. Remove foil and bake until the cheese is browned and bubbly. Let stand for 15 to 20 minutes before slicing.

title: Tofu and Pasta in Cherry Sauce
ingredients: 8 small red potatoes, quartered | 8 ounces soft fresh cheese ( such as provolone or gorgonzola ) | 1 egg yolk | 6 ounces firm tofu, thawed, drained, squeezed dry and cut into pieces | 1 cup cherry, halved | 2 tablespoons shredded fresh italian parsley ( flat-leaf parsley ) | 1 tablespoon fresh rose water | 2 cups hot cooked pasta
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Toss potatoes with 1/2 t.Salt and pepper in large bowl. Cut cheese into 1/4 inch thick slices. In small bowl, blend together egg yolk, egg, and remaining 1 t. Salt. Set bowl over saucepan of boiling water. Bowl vigorously until yolk coats back of spoon, 10 mls. Stir cheese, potato mixture, egg mixture, potatoes, cherry halves and parsley in large bowl until combined. Add rosewater. Transfer to oven.

Random Ingredients: turkey breast,cayenne pepper,veal,tomato sauce,bell pepper,chili sauce,garlic salt,guacamole
title: Veal and Guacamole
ingredients: 1 lb of veal, cut in 3/4-inch slices | 1 large bell pepper, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons chili sauce | 2 tablespoons tomato sauce | 2 teaspoons chili sauce | 1 teaspoon salt | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon ground cayenne pepper | 16 ounces guacamole ( refrigerated or homemade, the better, but you can use homemade as well )
instructions: Place meat in a large frying pan and add 4 tbsp each of chili sauce, tomato sauce, chili sauce, garlic salt and cayenne pepper. Turn the mixture over and heat through until the meat is warmed through. Turn off the burner. Dip the meat in the hot sauce and place in a single layer on a plate. Place the bell pepper in the same pan you cooked the meat in and toss. Place the meat on top of the vegetables and continue tossing until the bell pepper has turned a light gold color. Arrange the meat on a platter and refrigerate until all of the meat has been eaten. Spread each slice of meat with the remaining 1 tbsp each of chili sauce and the remaining 1 tbsp each of tomato sauce and chilli sauce. Garnish with guacamole..

title: Beef Ribs With Snow Peas, Cranberries, and Almonds
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh snow pea | 1/2 lb fresh cranberry | 2 teaspoons instant beef rib rub | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Place peas and cranberries in a small bowl and cover with water.

Random Ingredients: anise,green lentil,angel hair pasta,pesto sauce,sesame seed,farfalle pasta,pistachio ice cream,oregano leaf
title: Pasta With Pesto and Lentils on Pistachio Ice Cream
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups green lentils, rinsed of any debris and picked over ( about 12 ounces ) | 1/4 cup pesto sauce | 1 tablespoon toasted sesame seeds | 3/4 cup whole-milk sun-dried tomatoes, rehydrated if using canned pasta, rinsed and drained | 1 teaspoon anise | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1 package farfalle pasta ( bowtie ) | 3/4 cup prepared pesto sauce | 1/3 cup toasted shelled pistachio and crushed ice cream
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the lentils and 3/4 cup of water. Bring to a boil over medium high heat, cover, and reduce heat to low. Cook until tender, about 5 minutes. Drain the lentils, reserving the cooking liquid. Return the lentils to the pan, stir in 1/4 cup of the pesto, sun dried tomatoes, anise, oregano, and remaining 1/4 cup of cooking liquid. Bring to a simmer over medium high heat. Cook until the flavors blended and the lentils are tender, about 8 minutes. Meanwhile, cook the pasta in a large pot of salted boiling water until just tender but still firm to the bite, stirring often. Drain. Stir the pesto into the sauce and remove from the heat. Serve pesto over the pasta. Garnish with pistachios and crushed ice cream.

title: Crazy Rose Petals - Roasted Mushrooms!
ingredients: 12 large white mushrooms | 1 can of chickpeas, drained but reserving liquid | 1 tablespoon fresh rose petal, slivers or 1 tablespoon dried rose petals | rose petal, slivers | peppermint extract
instructions: Clean each mushroom by trimming stems. Cut caps and top off mushroom caps with a very sharp knife or razor blade, removing the woody part of the mushroom cap. Remove and discard as many of the hard part attached mushroom stems as possible from mushroom caps. Dice the caps and place in a small bowl. Rinse and drain chickpeas, reserving any liquid. Cut away any loose stems from the rose petals, cut them in half lengthwise. Add chickpeas, including any reserved liquid, to the mushroom caps and stir well. In a small baking dish combine the rose petal with peppermint extract, or use a blender and puree to a paste. Sprinkle this mixture evenly over the mushrooms in the baking dish. Bake at 425 degrees f for 20 - 30 minutes or until mushrooms are tender and the liquid is reduced.

title: Spanish Mashed Potatoes on a Stick
ingredients: 1 large baking potato, peeled | 1 serrano pepper, seeded | 2 slices mozzarella cheese, cut into 4 pieces | 1 english muffin, split
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. In a small bowl, mash the potatoes with a fork. Slice the pepper in half lengthwise, scrape out any seeds, and remove the stem and white parts of the pepper. Slice the pepper into 4 pieces, and place in a small baking pan with 3 inches of water. Cover the baking pan with foil and bake for 10 minutes. Remove from the oven and add the pepper pieces to the mashed potato and mash for a further 10 minutes. Remove from the oven and add the mozzarella to the mashed potato. Split the english muffin halves and wrap in microwave safe foil. Bake for 10 minutes, remove from the oven, and allow to cool for 8 minutes, this will help soften the cheese. Slice each potato into 4 pieces and serve.

Random Ingredients: american cheese,lime,beef stock,apple juice,prosciutto,tomato puree,cumin powder
title: Baked American Cheese With Tomato Mojo
ingredients: 12 ounces american cheese ( i use mild ) | 4 slices prosciutto | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 4 tablespoons unsweetened apple juice | 2 cups beef stock | 1 can tomato puree | 1 teaspoon lime rind, grated, peel
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f degrees. Wrap the american cheese with prosciutto, and place on foil lined cookie sheet, and bake for about 7 - 10 minutes or until the prosciutto crisps up a little bit. Remove from oven, and let cool for a moment. In a small bowl combine the cumin powder and apple juice, then stir. Pour into a large saucepan over medium heat, and cook for a minute. Add the beef stock, tomato puree, and lime peel, and stir. Heat through. Spread sauce over the cheese. Return to the oven. Bake for 20 minutes to melt the cheese.

title: Peaches with Peaches
ingredients: 4 large ripe peaches, peeled and sliced thin | cayenne pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 225°f. Cut the peaches lenghtways. Line a large roasting pan with foil and place the peaches in pan. Sprinkle on the cayenne pepper. Cover loosely with foil and bake about 3 hours, or until the peaches are tender.

Random Ingredients: seafood,lemon juice,green enchilada sauce,mini chocolate chip,parmigiano reggiano cheese,tomato paste
title: Safecordo
ingredients: 8 ounces mini semisweet mini chocolate chips | 11 ounces tomato paste | 4 ounces hot green enchilada sauce | 1/2 cup fresh lemon juice | 32 ounces of your favorite seafood | 1/2 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 360°f. Coat a small casserole dish with cooking spray, then set aside. Spray a medium saucepan with cooking spray, then place on stove over medium heat. While constantly stirring, add in the tomato paste, a small stream of lemon juice and a small stream of green enchilada sauce. As soon as the tomato mixture begins to bubble and become very tomato flavored, pour in the hot sauce. Reduce heat to medium low, and continue cooking, stirring every few minutes, until it is reduced almost completely and the sauce is heated through. Stir in half of the parmigiano and continue cooking for a minute or two until most of the sauce has reduced off and is slightly thick. Add the remainder of the parmigiano into the saucepan and stir until heated through. Remove from the heat and immediately pour into the prepared casserole dish. Sprinkle with grated parmigiano reggiano. Bake until the top is starting to brown, approximately 20 minutes. Take the casserole out of the oven, and allow to sit for approximately 10 minutes before serving.

title: Chinese Beef With Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, lean, cut into 1 inch chunks | 1 cup turnip, unpeeled, cut into 1/4 inch chunks | 4 tablespoons chile sauce, sriracha asian | 1 package linguine, refrigerated | 1 can corn, drained and rinsed | 2 tablespoons fresh ginger, peeled and diced | 3/4 cup farfalle pasta, quick-cooking, uncooked pasta, fazool
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a shallow roasting pan with foil and spray the foil with nonstick cooking spray. Place meat chunks evenly over the foil and place in roasting pan in a single layer. Roast uncovered for 30 minutes, stirring halfway through. Meanwhile, in a saucepan, combine turnips and chile sauce. Cook over medium high heat until meat is cooked through and turnips appear lightly browned, approximately 5 minutes. Meanwhile, cook pasta according to package directions. Drain and set aside. Remove meat mixture from oven and keep warm. Increase oven temperature to 400 degrees f. Add the corn and ginger to the pan and cook for 1 - 2 minutes to lightly cook corn mixture and stir. Add the pasta and meat mixture and toss. Transfer to a serving platter and serve with additional chile sauce.

title: Swiss Brownies
ingredients: 2 cans baked beans ( spicy or mexican ) | 2 tablespoons whipping cream | 3 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Grease a 9x13 inch pan. Spread beans evenly in the pan. Cover with whipping cream. In a small bowl, combine cocoa and oil. Drizzle over warm bean mixture. Cover with a lid or aluminum foil tightly. Bake in the oven for 1 hour or until thickened. Let cool completely. Cut into 1 bars.

title: Mango and galangal Teriyaki Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons clear honey | 1 1/2 tablespoons crushed galangal | 1 kg mango powder
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a food processor and blend until smooth. Transfer to a shallow dish and marinate overnight in the refrigerator.

title: Easy and Quick Fajita Sandwiches With Parma
ingredients: 2 lbs ground burger | 1 package fajita seasoning mix | 1/2 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Grill hamburger, making sure to shake off excess oil, for about 12 min in olive oil. Place on baking sheet, cover and bake at 300f for 2hours. Mix fajita seasoning in bowl and pour over hamburger. Let sit 30 minutes. While heating up, sprinkle cheese on inside of sandwich and place under broiler for 3 - 5 min, or until golden brown and bubbly. Serve with sour cream and chopped onion.

Random Ingredients: chili paste,black olive,cream cheese,wheat bread crumb,coriander,guacamole,five spice powder
title: Black Olive and Mozzarella Cheesecake
ingredients: 7 ounces reduced-fat cream cheese, cut into 1/2 inch thick rounds | 1/2 cup fat free sour cream or 1/2 cup fat free greek yogurt | 1 teaspoon five-spice powder | 1 teaspoon chili paste ( or to taste ) | 2 ounces black olives, drained and chopped | 1/4 cup low-fat guacamole | fresh coriander ( to garnish )
instructions: In a bowl add cream cheese, sour cream and chili paste powder, mixing well. Fold in olives. Spoon mixture into a 9 1/2 inch springform pan. Cover lightly with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 30 minutes or overnight. Prepare topping by combining the guacamole and coriander and sprinkling over the cheesecake.

title: American Kitchen Classic Lexington Style
ingredients: 1/8 cup ketchup | 1 tablespoon margarine
instructions: Mix ketchup and margarine together with a fork until butter is melted. Chill cocktail glasses.

title: Italian Pepperoni Patty Melts
ingredients: 1 package pepperoni slices | 1/3 cup tamari or 1/3 cup soy sauce
instructions: Cut thin slices from pepperoni. Place one slice of pepperoni in each melter.

title: Refried Refried Beans
ingredients: 1 lb fresh beans ( california ) | 1/2 cup green chili pepper, canned, chopped
instructions: Rinse beans and drain well. Heat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Drain green chili pepper.

title: Tuna and Pecorino Romano With Croutons
ingredients: 20 slices bread, crusts removed | 15 -35 slices of fresh mint leaves | 20 -30 slices of fresh chervil ( or tarragon leaves ) | 10 ounces fresh tuna, cooked | 1/4 cup pecorino romano cheese, freshly shaved
instructions: Preheat the broiler / toaster oven. Remove the crusts from the bread, and butter them liberally on a hot baking sheet. Add any extra bread from the loaf pan. Arrange a few tuna slices on top, then place the croutons on top of the tuna. Sprinkle with chervil and cheese. Place under the broiler for approximately 2 - 3 minutes until the croutons are lightly toasted, then remove from the broiler. Serve warm or cool.

Random Ingredients: yellow mustard,clove,dark brown sugar,heavy cream,mexican cheese,soy yogurt coconut,maraschino cherry,fettuccine
title: Creamy Yummy Spicy Fettuccine
ingredients: 1/2 cup yogurt ( i used light plain coconut yogurt ) | 1/4 cup heavy cream | 2 tablespoons soy yogurt or 2 tablespoons coconut cream | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 1/8 teaspoon ground cloves | 1 tablespoon prepared yellow mustard | 1/4 cup shredded mexican blend cheese | 1 tablespoon maraschino cherry, coarsely chopped
instructions: In medium bowl, stir together yogurt, cream, cheese, mustard and brown sugar. Pour over pasta, and top with cherries. Garnish with reserved cherries to serve.

title: Skippy Indian Eggplant Halves
ingredients: 2 large eggs, beaten | 1 large eggplant, peeled | 8 stalks collard greens, washed and torn | 1 cooking apple, peeled and shredded | 1/2 cup whiskey | 1/2 cup white tequila | 3/4 teaspoon whole cardamom seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Brush a 9x13 inch baking dish with melted butter. Place 1 eggplant halved into dish and coat with egg, shaking off excess. Place eggplant halved lengthwise on a rack over a baking sheet. Bake 40 to 45 minutes in the preheated oven, until light yellow and tender. Let cool until easily handled. Meanwhile, cut remaining eggplant into 12 half inch slices on a mandoline. Place in a large bowl and mash with potato masher until mixture is smooth. Stir in collard greens, apples and whiskey. Stir in the rye meal, cardamom seeds and remaining 1 teaspoon of cardamom. Spoon dollops of eggplant halve onto each serving.

title: The Old Fashioned Irish Steak
ingredients: 6 -12 lbs stewing beef, cubed | 1 cup seasoned bread dough, sifted | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | toothpick
instructions: Pour bread dough into large bowl, knead in flour until it sticks together. Roll out dough until about twice its size. Take a chunk of beef. Place onto dough. Roll out more dough, and pinch it over meat so that dough doesn't stick to hands. Repeat with remaining beef and dough. Tie with kitchen string. Roll out bread dough into strips about 1 1/2 inches wide. Tie with kitchen string. Place on a greased grill over medium high heat. When ready to cook, preheat oven to 200 degrees fahrenheit. Cook for about 15 minutes on each side to seal in the juices on the surface.

title: Spanish Sauce
ingredients: 1 spanish onion, minced | 2 cups wine or 2 cups apple juice | 1 liter apple juice
instructions: Put onion in a pot with the apple juice.

title: Taco Bread
ingredients: 1 slice whole wheat bread | 1 t taco sauce, warmed
instructions: Lightly toast and smear with taco sauce. Spread warm taco bread with warmed taco sauce. Cut into 5 triangles and serve hot with remaining taco sauce if desired.

title: Wilde Mushrooms, Grape & Wine Dip
ingredients: 1 portabella mushroom | 400 g red grapes | 1/2 cup sweet white wine
instructions: Wash the portabello mushroom but do not remove the base. Remove the stem if necessary. Mince it coarsely. Tie the mushrooms, grapes and wine. Mix everything together in an ovenproof dish or pan. Place in a pan over low heat and leave to soften a bit. Serve warm or chilled.

title: Tomato and Fenugreek Dip
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese, softened | 1 cup minced plum tomatoes | 1 tablespoon dried fenugreek seeds | 2 teaspoons ground pepper, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Mix cream cheese, plum tomatoes, fenugreek flakes, and ground black pepper together in a bowl.

title: Cheesy Alfredo Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup milk chocolate chips | 1/2 cup shredded fontina cheese | 2 tablespoons shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Microwave chocolate chips on high 30 seconds, stirring every 30 seconds. Stir in fontina cheese and mozzarella cheese.

Random Ingredients: strawberry,sambal oelek,graham cracker crust,espresso,chicken breast half,poblano chile,brown sugar
title: Chili Chicken Sandwiches With Strawberry-Coffee Sauce
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1 tablespoon espresso, hot ( espresso beans ) | 1 teaspoon brown sugar | 8 slices crusty graham cracker crust | 8 ounces fresh strawberries, hulled and sliced | 1 poblano chile, seeded, deveined and diced | 2 teaspoons sambal oelek ( or your favourite chile paste )
instructions: Place chicken between two sheets of wax paper.

Random Ingredients: raspberry,red radish,peanut oil,frying oil pork lard,savory
title: Grilled Red Radishes With Raspberry-Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 1 quart frying oil ( use pork lard or other fat from pork ) | 20 fresh red radishes | 4 ounces fresh raspberries | 24 ounces powdered savory | 1 lb powdered peanut oil ( or veg spreadable oil )
instructions: Wash and dry the radishes. Slice the radishes lengthwise to form rings. Put 2 tbsp oil in a heavy, deep fryer and heat to 375°f. Arrange the radishes in the hot oil and set them in a single layer. Fry them gently as they fry, turning them carefully with a slotted spoon. As you fry them you should get a nice golden brown color on all sides. Put them in a colander and leave them to drain before use. When ready to use cut the radishes in half, remove the seeds, and put both halves in a blender or food processor fitted with chopping blade. Put the raspberries andsavory into a bowl and mix with the powdered whey. Take the radish rings and add them to the ricotta mixture. Stir to coat. Put the 2 tbsp of oil in a deep fryer and set it to 200°f. In batches if necessary, deep fry the radish rings. Serve them in a gravy boat or a bowl with heated sauce.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile,sesame seed,red wine vinegar,american cheese,beef bouillon cube,celery,tamari,white bread
title: Chipotle Steak Gyros
ingredients: 5 tablespoons sesame seeds | 3/4 lb american cheese, sliced | 10 slices white bread ( i use pepperidge farm club ) | 12 ounces low-sodium beef bouillon cubes | 1/2 celery, diced | 1 fresh chipotle chile, minced | 3 tablespoons tamari | 1/2 teaspoon red wine vinegar
instructions: Heat grill. Combine sesame seeds and 2 tablespoons oil in a small skillet over medium high heat. Toast bread. Spread one side of each piece of toasted toasted bread with 1/4 cup oil. Rub top side of each toasted slice with 1/4 teaspoon salt. Combine beef, celery, chile, tamari and remaining 2 tablespoons oil and vinegar in a food processor or blender until smooth. Place remaining toast on a cutting board. Grill steaks for 4 to 5 minutes on each side, to desired doneness. Dipping sauce. To serve, add reserved dipping sauce.

Random Ingredients: fish sauce,self raising flour,hamburger bun,cider vinegar,head lettuce
title: Crunchy Slice-up Burger
ingredients: 2 slices hamburger buns, split | 2 tablespoons self raising flour | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 1/4 cup shredded lettuce
instructions: Place bun halves in a large shallow baking dish with 1 tablespoon of the dipping sauce. Combine the flour, remaining dipping sauce, and vinegar in a bowl. Add the fish sauce and remaining dipping sauce to the dipping sauce. Dip the bread half in the sauce mixture and spread on toasted bread. Bake in a moderate oven for 15 - 20 minutes until browned.

title: A Different Macaroni and Cheese With Lard & Beans
ingredients: 1 cup quick-cooking barley | 1/2 cup creme fraiche, at room temperature | 1/2 cup catsup | 2 -3 teaspoons creme fraiche or 2 -3 teaspoons sour cream | 2 tablespoons dry cooking mixed grains | 2 tablespoons cornmeal | 1 lb spaghetti or 1 lb macaroni | 4 tablespoons lard | 1/2 lb grated monterey jack cheese
instructions: In a pot bring water to a rapid boil for the barley, stir, cover and cook over low heat until tender, about 25 - 30 minute. Drain the barley and return it to the pot and add the crema fraîche, catsup, creme fraîche and grains if using. Mix well. Keep warm over very low heat. Meanwhile, boil a large pot of water and add the pasta as directed. Drain the pasta, toss it with the lard in a bowl and pour the cooked, drained barley over it. Sprinkle cheese on top and allow to melt.

title: Authentic Viennese - Chocolate-Braised Spiced Chicken
ingredients: 3 lbs chicken legs-thighs | 3 tablespoons cocoa powder ( dutch's lily'cocoa powder is a good substitute ) | 2 -3 cups low sodium chicken broth
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Place the chicken legs in 3 large roasting pans, cover with aluminum foil, and place on a wire rack over a roasting pan. Place in the oven and heat to the temperature recommended on the package, about 75 70°f. Carefully place the rack in the lowest second position in the oven. Bake until the thighs register 165°f on a meat thermometer, about 1 hour. Transfer the thighs skin side up to platter. Pour the accumulated fat into a 10 cup dutch oven. Pour the heated fat into a deep heavy pot and stir in the cocoa powder, 3 1/2 cups of the broth, and the remaining 1/2 cup chicken broth. Bring to a simmer over medium heat, stirring to blend the cocoa with the broth, about 5 minutes. Add the legs pieces and return to a simmer. Cook covered, stirring several times to prevent sticking, until the meat is falling off the bone tender to your desired degree of doneness, about 1 1/2 hours. Strain the meat, skim off all but 2 1/2 cups of fat, and discard the accumulated fat. Skim any fat remaining out of the surface as the pot is filled. If you’re making chocolate sauce, heat the sauce over medium heat until the chocolate is completely melted. It should be a rich, dark, rich color with no significant lumps stuck to the surface of the sauce. If you’re making chocolate sandwich filling, place 2 2/3 cups of the broth and the cocoa in a bowl, stir, and season with salt and pepper to taste. If you’re making sandwich filling, strain the remaining broth. Place the pan in the oven and cook until the sauce is reduced to 2 1/3 cups, about 20 minutes. Use a wire mesh strainer or slotted spoon to remove the sauce from the oven. Stir in the remaining 2 1/2 cups of broth, about 2 tablespoons at a time, stirring the mixture after each addition. Remove the pan from the oven when the sauce is no longer hot. Serve immediately with the sliced biscotti and your favorite spiced chocolate sauce or just serve them separately.

Random Ingredients: english muffin,lettuce leaf,caster sugar,wheat flour,white bread,kale,bread,white onion
title: Toast & Lunch! Lunch!
ingredients: 2 slices whole-wheat flour | 1 bunch english muffin | 2 slices white bread | 1/2 cup finely chopped white onion | 1 1/2 tablespoons caster sugar | 6 kale, finely chopped | 2 leaves lettuce leaves | 2 slices bread, toasted
instructions: Toast the whole wheat flour, english muffin & bread slices & butter if using whole wheat flour. Add sugar & chopped onion. Fry lightly in skillet until soft and golden brown. Add the chopped kale & cook to wilt. Spread salad leaves w/ toast & top with toast mixture. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,celery seed,white wine vinegar,tomato green chile pepper
title: Mexican Style Stuffed Tomatoes
ingredients: 8 tomatoes with green chile peppers | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons celery seed | 1 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. Slice tops and the ends off each tomato. Scoop out the seeds and pulp, reserving about 3/4 cup. Stuff tomatoes with a mixture of green chile peppers and vinegar. Place the remaining 1/4 cup of chopped cheddar cheese into a small bowl. Roll each tomato and serve. Coleslaw can be served as an appetizer, or served as a side dish with other dishes.

Random Ingredients: garlic,turmeric powder,brussels sprout,apricot jam,melon,cooking apple,poblano chile
title: Brussels Sprouts, Persian Style
ingredients: 1 medium brussels sprout | 2 tablespoons apricot jam | 2 tablespoons cooking apples, minced ( a gizzard is a good substitute ) | 1/2 teaspoon saffron or 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 teaspoon garlic, minced ( i use roasted fresh garlic ) | 1/2 teaspoon poblano chile, chopped ( a mexican blend )
instructions: Wash sprouts and cut off the tops, but leave a little of what a “s” shape. Cook in boiling salted water for 3 minutes, or until tender but still brightly colored. Drain and set aside. Heat a skillet over medium heat. Add jam and cook until it's reduced to about 1/4 cup. Add saffron or turmeric and cook 2 seconds, then add garlic. Pour this into the skillet. Continue to cook and stir for 1 minute more. Add brussels sprouts and sliced apples and cook 5 minutes more. Sprinkle on chili and serve.

title: Rigatoni Pasta With Penne, Meat and Coriander
ingredients: 750 g short penne pasta | 500 g lean ground meat | 50 g coriander seeds, roasted | 2 cups rigatoni pasta
instructions: Heat a large saucepan of boiling water and bring to the boil. Cook the pasta. Drain and return to the pan. Add the meat, cook, stirring, for 5 minutes until browned. Meanwhile heat the oil in a large skillet. Add the coriander seeds, bring to the boil and cook, stirring, for 3 minutes or until fragrant. Add the rigatoni pasta and cook for 2 minutes or until the liquid has been absorbed. Serve in bowls.

title: Dutch Ham Pot
ingredients: 1 kg baby carrots, washed | 50 g pine nuts, toasted
instructions: Preheat oven to 160 degrees celsius. Combine carrots, toasted pine nuts and carrots in a large oven proof pan. Bake in the oven for 1 1/2 hours. Remove from the oven, cool, then refrigerate overnight. Place in food processor and process until fine. Return to oven and bake uncovered until golden brown..

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,zucchini,marjoram,chili oil,red cabbage,chicken nugget,yoghurt,strawberry
title: Chicken and Strawberries Salad
ingredients: 4 large chicken nuggets | 1/2 head red cabbage, washed and shredded | 2 zucchini, shredded | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons yoghurt | 1 teaspoon chili oil | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 bunch fresh strawberries, washed and cut into wedges
instructions: Heat 1 teaspoon of oil in a pan. Quickly cook the nuggets until golden brown on each side. Remove from pan onto a tea towel and drain on paper towels. Repeat until all nuggets are cooked, then set aside. Heat 1 teaspoon of oil in a pan/skillet, add red cabbage and fry, stirring occasionally, until it is bright green in colour, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat and put 1 tablespoon of yoghurt in a bowl. Add 1 teaspoon of chili oil and the marjoram leaves to the bowl, then stir to combine. Place a salad of cucumber, tomatoes, and strawberries in a bowl. Add the nuggets, sauce and remaining yoghurt to the salad. Toss to make sure the salad is well mixed.

title: Tamarind Sweetened Condensed Milk
ingredients: 2 cans beef consomme ( or any other condensed milk product, you want a low-fat version with a good quality flavor ) | 1/3 cup tamarind paste ( or other indian sweetener ) | 2 tablespoons finely chopped canned parsley sprigs | 2 packets vanilla frozen yogurt or ( 14 ounce ) packets vanilla flavored nondairy yogurt, to serve
instructions: Place the condensed milk, tamarind concentrate, parsley, and vanilla in a large non aluminum pan and mix well. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Reduce the heat and simmer until reduced by half. Remove 1/2 cup of the tamarind concentrate broth, then skim off any solid fat that forms on top. Place the condensed milk into a shallow bowl. Break up the remaining block of tofu, discarding the silken tofu or other solid block of tofu. Place the shredded fat block in the milk and tamarind broth. Place the bowl onto the sauce for 1 - 2 minutes.

title: Houmous
ingredients: 1 lb jumbo shrimp, deveined & peeled | 1/2 teaspoon marjoram | 1/4 cup nutritional yeast | 1/3 cup semolina
instructions: Combine all ingredients except your pasta. Form into small patties. Spray with pam. Broil or grill until desired doneness is reached.

title: Raisin-Style Baked Hazelnuts
ingredients: 3 ounces an anaheim chilies, stemmed and seeded | 1/4 cup hazelnuts, toasted ( about 5 ounces total ) | 1/4 cup chopped mixed berry ( about 2 cups ) | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 3 large fresh curry leaves ( or 1 t. chopped fresh basil ) | hot sauce
instructions: Position oven rack in upper third of oven and set oven to 400°f butter a 13x9x2 inch glass baking dish or 9x13 inch metal baking dish. Rinse chiles and pat dry with paper towels. Cut chiles diagonally in half lengthwise.

Random Ingredients: egg substitute,hot chili sauce,caraway seed,corn,curry powder,liquid smoke,salsa
title: Spicy Caraway Corn on the Cob
ingredients: 1 can corn, drained | 2 tablespoons hot chili sauce ( such as tabasco brand ) | 3 large eggs, beaten | 2 teaspoons curry powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons liquid smoke | 1 1/2 teaspoons caraway seeds | 1/4 cup salsa
instructions: Preheat a grill for high heat. In a small bowl, mash the corn with the hot sauce. Set aside. In a large bowl, beat the eggs with the curry powder, liquid smoke and caraway seeds until well blended. Stir in the corn, salsa and dressing. Spoon the corn mixture onto the preheated grill grate above hot coals, close lid and grill for 10 to 15 minutes or until a knife pick inserted into the corn comes out clean. To unmold on the grill, carefully remove the pick and allow to stand for 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,heavy whipping cream,cream,bacon bit,gravy mix
title: Gravy Substitute
ingredients: 1/4 cup bacon bits | 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 2 cups hot gravy mix | 2 cups whipped cream
instructions: In a heavy skillet, cook bacon bits over medium high heat until crisp and golden.

Random Ingredients: lemon peel,whiskey,mayonnaise,american cheese,italian seasoning mix,ricotta cheese,dark chocolate
title: Chocolate Glazed Cheese Rolls
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups italian cheese blend, shredded finely | 4 ounces cream cheese, softened | 1/4 cup mayonnaise | 1/3 cup dark chocolate, melted | 1/4 cup light mayonnaise | 1/4 cup whiskey | 1 teaspoon lemon peel, grated | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning mix
instructions: To make the dough, in the bowl of a food processor, combine shredded cheese, cream cheese, mayonnaise, chocolate chips, dark mayonnaise, whiskey, lemon peel and italian seasoning. Pulse until completely combined. Refrigerate at least 1 hour or until dough is well incorporated. On a floured surface, roll out the chilled dough to 1/8 inch thickness. Cut into 2 6x6 inch logs. Place about 2 tablespoons of the cheese dough into the center and fold the dough over the filling. Press the seams together to seal. Repeat with remaining dough and filling. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Slice each log of log lengthwise into about 12 slices. Serve warm, layered with extra cheese glaze.

title: Braised Short Ribs
ingredients: 3 lbs beef short ribs, trimmed ( your choice of meat ) | 1 lemon, juice and zest of
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a roasting pan with foil and heat in oven for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, trim short ribs of any excess fat and discard. Using a sharp paring knife, scrape the fat from the pan. Cut the short ribs into 1 or 1 1/2 inch pieces. Place in the roasting pan. Squeeze the lemon zest into the bottom of the pan. Pour the lemon juice evenly over them. Sprinkle ribs evenly with lemon zest. Cover with a piece of aluminum foil and cook for 90 minutes. Take the foil off and bake for 1 hour and 30 minutes more. Allow to stand for 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast,palm sugar,tabasco sauce,white flour,mustard,maraschino cherry
title: Japanese Style Crispy BBQ Chicken
ingredients: 500 g chicken breasts or 1 1/2 kg chicken thighs, of maximum weight | 3 tablespoons white flour | 1 tablespoon dry mustard | 1 1/2 teaspoons tabasco sauce | 2 tablespoons palm sugar, finely grated | 2 maraschino cherries, cut in half
instructions: Use a bamboo skewer, or bamboo skewers. Place chicken breasts on the skewers, and allow to sit for 3 - 4 hours. If you have any left over fat on hand chop it up into pieces and place on a piece of aluminium foil to rest. This way it does not stick. Mix flour, dry mustard and tabasco in a small bowl, add palm sugar and mix well. Roll chicken up in the mixture, using marinated chicken as a guide. Thread chicken and any remaining leftover stuffing onto skewers. Barbecue or bbq chicken or grill until very well browned, around 20 minutes.

title: Italian Mushrooms and Rose 'n' Sugar
ingredients: 6 good size fresh white mushrooms | 2 cups icing sugar | 3 -4 tablespoons cake flour | 2 tablespoons italian dressing
instructions: Wash and dry mushrooms, slice the quarters. Put the icing sugar in a bowl in a nice looking hurry and put the sizzling spoon in right on top. Put 2 tbsp of the cake flour and the 1 tbsp of dressing into a plastic bag. Snip the corner of the bag and quickly squeeze the bag from you with your finger. Make a dent in the top of each mushroom, it does not just have to fit through the hole, but is also a good idea to snip out the core and white mushroom in two lengthwise. If they don't all fit, place them between wax paper and cover with plastic wrap. You do not have to do this. Put into an airtight container at room temperature and leave for at least 1 hour or longer. You don't need to refrigerate, but at least it will get better in about 3 hours. Remove from the bag and use right away or wrap in clingfilm and chill up to 1 month. When ready to serve i usually use the microwave for about 1 minute on high power. I put the fridge in the freezer to cool, then put over the edge of my pasta dish and i put the pan back in the freezer for another 45 minutes.

title: Sweet-Cous Basics
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground chuck | 1/3 cup mint, chopped | 1/2 cup pineapples ( chunks or tidbits, canned chunks or pears can be used ) | 1 teaspoon anise oil ( light flavored should be used ) ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Serve over hot couscous.

title: Lighter Orange Lasagna
ingredients: 9 lasagna noodles | 1 medium orange
instructions: Slice the orange into 2 or 3 thin slivers. Place each slice in the bottom of a 13 x9 x2 pan, preferably glass, with a few slivers on the bottom. Fill each slivers with an orange slice. Cover each slice with another slightly flattened slice of orange. Cover the pan with plastic wrap and let marinate overnight. The next day, preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Bake covered loosely with foil if desired. About 30 - 40 minutes. Remove paper and top each slice with your favourite spaghetti sauce.

title: Sorghum Crackers (Hungarian Gomen)
ingredients: 100 g sugar | 50 g sorghum flour or 50 g white flour | 2 tablespoons lard
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Pour the sugar into a large mixing bowl, add the sorghum flour, the lard, and mix until well combined. Add the souredrum flour and work through the sugar to mix well. Press the mixture onto a prepared, lightly greased oven tray, and flatten slightly if there are any cracks. Bake at 180c for 15 - 20 minutes, or until pale golden brown.

title: Shrimp or Prawn With Lentils
ingredients: 1/2 lb small shrimp, cleaned | pepperoni, strips | 1/2 cup medium salsa, medium strength | 1/4 cup green lentil, medium strength | 1/4 cup pimiento, medium strength | 8 sprigs parsley, for garnish
instructions: Cook the shrimp or prawns until just done and pink in the center, about 3 minutes.

title: Mexican Steak
ingredients: 2 1/4 lbs chuck steaks | 2 1/4 cups mexican blend cheese, shredded ( see my note ) | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, sliced | 3 1/4 teaspoons orange zest, fine, packed ( see my note )
instructions: Remove all visible fat from steak. Slice all visible fat from meat with a sharp knife, cutting to fit in your cooking pan, and then slicing the meat.. Place meat in a bowl. Combine the remaining ingredients except the cheese and water chestnuts and spread half over the meat on the meat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 3 hours, but preferably overnight and even overnight. Cover and refrigerate for up to 3 days. Remove meat and discard marinade. Heat a skillet to medium high on top of the stove. Sprinkle 1/2 cup cheese over meat. Add 1/2 cup remaining marinade, place meat in skillet, cook meat until desired doneness. Spoon off any excess liquid. Serve on bed of brown rice, or on its own or at my favorite mexican table salsa, with tortillas.

title: Rose and Herb Rollups for Vegetites or Meat.
ingredients: 1 package fat-free cocktail topping mix | 2 -3 tablespoons canola oil | 3 tablespoons rose water | popped herring or herring, to cover rollups
instructions: In small bowl, mix together the first three ingredients until well blended. Spread or roll each herring or meat into a ball and roll to your preferred shape, set on waxed paper to keep fresh. Heat a cast iron skillet or griddle to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Spread about 2 tablespoon of each topping mixture onto rollups, roll up tightly and place them on the center of the griddle. Cook for 3 to 5 minutes per side, or until golden brown.

title: Indian Corn Chips
ingredients: 1 cup corn oil | 2/3 cup plain yogurt | 1 cup strawberry preserves | 1 1/2 teaspoons corn oil | 1 clove garlic salt | 1 tablespoon ground coriander | 1/2 cup butter
instructions: Heat 1 cup of the corn oil in a deep fryer to 375 degrees f. Stir together yogurt and preserves until smooth. Stir in the rest of the ingredients and mix until well blended. Drop batter by tablespoons into hot oil. Fry until golden on both sides. Drain on paper towels, and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: pork loin roast,skewer,peanut,green olive,mint,white peppercorn,red chili pepper
title: Grilled Pork Satay With Peppercorns and Green Olives
ingredients: 300 g pork loin roast or 300 g lamb loin roast | 12 green olives ( pitted ) | 12 small sichuan peppercorns | 3 red chili peppers | 2 tablespoons dried mint | 1/2 cup dry roasted peanuts | 1/2 cup olive, chopped for decoration
instructions: Prepare the barbecue by lightly brushing the meat with oil. Grill the meat directly over a medium heated coals setting, brushing frequently with oil. When cooked, remove from flame and cover so that the meat is not too dry. Cut into slices of 1 cm thick. Slice into 2 cm lengths, then halve the lengthy side to form 1/2 cm pieces. Grill or broil the olives over a medium heated coals, turning, while still slightly warm. Place the pork between two slices of wax paper and flatten with the back of a large, fat heavy spoon for about 5 minutes, turning once, until it is well browned all over. Remove the pork from the pan, put on a warmed serving platter, cover and keep warm. Place the chilies in a mortar and crush coarsely. Place the crushed chilies in a saucepan with the mint and 2 tbsp of the peanuts. Grill the peanuts until lightly browned. Remove from heat and grind very coarsely in a food processor or coffee grinder,. Remove meat from the chilies and discard the stems, seeds and thick nerve like layers of softened pepper and black matter. Serve meat, with mixed olives, garnished with mint and peanuts.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,red bird eye chilies,cumin seed,ketjap manis,sun tomato oil,almond meal
title: Spicy Almond Snack (Aka Arroz Con Langostinos Al Dinho)
ingredients: 1/3 cup ketjap manis | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained | 1 tablespoon roasted cumin seed | 1 fresh red bird's eye chilies, seeded and chopped | 1/4 teaspoon dark soy sauce
instructions: In a small, dry frying pan, dry fry the cumin seeds until fragrant and roasted but not black. Put this into a mortar, or blender and grind until very fine. Stir in the chilies, soy sauce, ground nuts and dark soy sauce and cook over low heat for 10 minutes or until heated through and dry. Transfer to a jar, covered with a thick airtight lid and store. Variation, if you want to make this as a snack, add 2 tbsp soy bean paste to the sauce.

title: Clams on a Stick
ingredients: baby clams in shell, scrubbed | 1/2 teaspoon dried fennel seed | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne | 1 medium zucchini, sliced thick ( about 6 slices ) | 1 bunch fresh asparagus spear, trimmed | 1 red onion, cut into 5 slices | 1/2 cup pitted dates, halved
instructions: Place clam shells in a large, heavy pot. Add water to cover.

Random Ingredients: orange peel,watermelon,cauliflower floret,cannellini bean,xanthan gum,pineapple juice
title: Gluten Mango - Wheat Free Mock Vegetables
ingredients: 8 cups watermelon, cut crosswise into 1/8-inch slices | 1 cup white cannellini beans, rinsed and drained | 1 cup cauliflower floret | 1 orange peel, zested and cut into matchsticks | 1 cup pineapple juice | 2 tablespoons xanthan gum
instructions: Combine watermelon, cannellini beans, cauliflower, and orange zest in a large pot. Stir in the zest. Whisk together the pineapple juice, xanthan gum, and 3 tablespoons of water in a separate bowl.

title: Spiced Cheese Spread
ingredients: 225 g soft cheese | 1/2 cup finely grated cheese ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons cinnamon | 1/2 teaspoon ground pepper
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together, put through a strainer or press through your hands until thoroughly mixed. Serve with vegetables and crackers.

title: Spiced Lima Beans With Cherries
ingredients: 1 lb frozen lima beans | 2 teaspoons coffee powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons caribbean jerk seasoning | chopped cherries, to serve
instructions: In a large crockpot, place the lima beans, coffee powder, and jerk seasoning. Cook on high heat for 1½ to 2 hours, turning the beans over after 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: thyme,red cabbage,white bread,arborio rice,green onion,cod fillet
title: Cod and Cabbage risotto
ingredients: 1 cup arborio rice | 3 lbs white fish fillets, cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes | 8 cups loosely packed torn red cabbage | 1 bunch green onion, sliced thinly and separated | 1/2 lb cod fillet, cut into chunks | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh thyme
instructions: Set oven to 350°f combine rice and 2 cups water in heavy medium saucepan. Bring to boil. Cover and transfer to oven and bake until tender, about 45 minutes. Uncover, fluff with fork and set aside. Heat 1/2 cup water in 12 inch nonstick skillet over medium high heat until just below simmering. Sprinkle fish with salt. Add fish to skillet. Raise heat to high. Add cabbage.

title: Beef and Shellfish Filling
ingredients: 1 kg stewing beef | 3 teaspoons yeast | 12 -15 shrimp paste
instructions: Clean the beef, removing as much of the fat as possible, and removing any connective tissue on the outside of the meat. Cut into small cubes, then flatten with your hands, leaving enough excess fat on them for the filling to rise. Cut each shrimp paste into 4 long diagonal slices, removing any meat and shellfish pieces on the inside. Bring 6 cups of water to a boil, and add 1 tsp of the yeast and allow to bubble for a few seconds. Place the beef in the solution and allow to double in size. Remove all pieces of beef, and once cooked through, remove and serve on a tray with some anchovies and capers as a dipping sauce, or serve in the traditional manner with rice and bread.

title: Beef, Cheese and Zucchini
ingredients: 500 g chuck roast ( trimmed or trimmed of fat ) | 175 g plain yogurt | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 4 dried juniper berries or 4 peppercorns | 1 lemons or 1 orange, zest finely grated | spices ( optional ) | 3 -5 sprigs fresh lemon rind, chopped
instructions: Cut the meat into 1 cubes and put in a bowl. Put the yogurt and mustardpowder into a saucepan, add some freshly ground black pepper and some salt or pepper, if you wish. Bring to the boil over medium heat, stirring, and lower the heat. Leave to simmer very slowly, with a lid ajar, for at least 2 hours, stirring and replacing it as necessary. Stir every so often, so as not to burn the bottom of the pan. It will be very thick. Just before serving, stir in the zucchini or aubergines. Sprinkle on some chopped lemon rind. Serve with a crisp green salad.

Random Ingredients: white radish,red potato,parmesan cheese,baking potato,banana,bacon dripping
title: Italian Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs baking potatoes | 1 1/2 lbs small red potatoes | 3 small bananas | 4 teaspoons bacon drippings | 1 large white radish | grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Wash fresh potatoes and peel. Bake potatoes at 325 for 1 hour or until tender. Cool slightly. Cut potatoes into quarter inch slices and mix with radishes, bacon strips, and parmesan. Let sit for 20 minutes before serving so flavors can develop.

title: Grilled Norwegian Meatballs With Harissa Sauce
ingredients: 2 lbs ground meat ( sirloin, chuck or blade ) | 3 tablespoons harissa peppers ( see harissa sauce ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons mild vegetable shortening | 2 chopped fresh chili peppers | coriander sprigs or basil
instructions: To make your sauce, combine all ingredients, mixing thoroughly. Pour sauce over meat and marinate 15 minutes at room temperature or refrigerate overnight. Grill over hot coals until done, turning once and basting with sauce, about 15 minutes. Or place meat in ovenproof dish and bake at 350 degrees f. For 25 - 30 minutes. Serve with sauce or wrap individually and serve at room temperature.

title: Glazed Jasmine Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups jasmine rice | 1/4 cup lime juice | 1/2 cup rice-oaked tapioca
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. In a bowl, stir together the rice and lime juice until coated. Spread rice in the baking sheet. Bake rice for about 35 minutes, or until dry and sticky. Let cool slightly. Pour tapioca into a resealable plastic bag.

title: Pear Risotto With Roast Beef
ingredients: 1 lb boneless bottom round roast | 4 teaspoons mixed spice | 1 cup nonfat sour cream | 1/2 pear, pared, and diced | 1 1/2 cups arborio rice | 1 cup real maple syrup
instructions: Cut meat into thin strips. In large bowl with fingers, mix sour cream and spices and mix. Mix in pear. Coat meat with spice mixture. Arrange meat in 3 quart casserole. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 2 hours or up to 3 days. Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Remove roast from marinade. In ovenproof casserole dish, pour just enough hot water into marinade to reach just below boiling.

title: Faux Bagels
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups finely chopped marshmallow creme | 1 pinch dried fenugreek leaves | 2 slices rye bread, thickly sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spray cookie sheets with cooking spray. In a bowl, mash marshmallow cream and fenugreek leaves together with fingers until well incorporated. Spread evenly on bread slices. Place slices on cookie sheets and bake for 5 to 7 minutes, or until lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: curry paste,pecorino romano cheese,tamari,barley,fettuccine pasta,cremini mushroom,oyster mushroom
title: Stir Fry Fettuccine With Mushrooms & Pecorino Romano Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 cup barley ( fresh or frozen ) pasta | 2 cups light cremini mushrooms | 1/4 cup oyster mushroom | 1/4 cup parsley ( italian chopped ) | 1 tablespoon curry paste ( homemade or purchased ) | 1 teaspoon tamari or 1 teaspoon soy sauce
instructions: In a wok, bring water to a boil and add barley and mushrooms and cook for 3 to 4 minutes. Add oyster mushrooms, parsley and curry paste and stir until mixed. Remove from heat and stir in tamari. Prepare fettuccine according to package directions and drain. Add fettuccine to stewed mixture and toss until heated through and the dish goes creamy. Serve immediately and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: rice wine,bucatini pasta,monterey jack pepper cheese,broth,strawberry,bulgur,portabella mushroom,red chili powder
title: Spicy Broccoli Tabbouleh
ingredients: 1 package bucatini pasta | 1 head fresh broccoli, cut into small bite size pieces | 1 cup finely chopped portabella mushrooms | 1/2 package refrigerated crunchy fresh strawberries | 3 tablespoons whole grain prepared rice wine | 1 tablespoon chicken or 1 tablespoon vegetable broth base | 1/2 teaspoon red chili powder | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack pepper cheese
instructions: Cook bucatini pasta according to directions in a large pot of boiling water. Meanwhile, cook broccoli under fresh water, in a large skillet for 5 - 7 minutes or until crisp tender. Drain. Combine broccoli with mushrooms in a blender, and process until finely chopped. Add drained bucatini, remaining sauce ingredients and broccoli mixture.

title: Baked Pork Loin With Peaches and Paprika
ingredients: 300 ml double cream | 200 g pork loin | 150 g sliced peaches | 2 tablespoons chopped shallots
instructions: Cut the loin into thick slices. Place the slices between two layers of clean plastic wrap. Slide the pieces under the plastic wrap to keep the slices flat. Make a hole in the skin side of the loin, fill with cream and secure with toothpicks. Place the pork, sliced peaches and shallots in an ovenproof dish. Cover with plastic wrap and bake in a moderate oven for 50 minutes, basting every 15 minutes with pan juices. Turn the meat and bake for at least 1 hour longer or until a meat thermometer reaches 160f.

title: Fried Matzas
ingredients: 3 matzos | 1 pound ground meat | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 10 cherry tomatoes, halved
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Place matzo sheets on a baking sheet, and cut a slit into one side of each sheet. Roll each piece into a tortilla shape. Repeat with other side, until all sheets are used. In a medium skillet over medium heat, cook the ground meat. Break apart meat using a fork.

title: Kebabs (Chicken) With Milk
ingredients: 375 g frying chicken | 1/4 cup milk | 1 tablespoon condensed milk | 500 g meat, steaming cubes, cut into cubes
instructions: Wash the chicken, remove the bones and cut into small cubes, wash in a clean plastic bag. Heat the oil in a wok on high. Dampen one end of the bag with water and place the chicken pieces into the oil. Cook the chicken pieces on medium flame for three to five minutes or until they turn golden brown, stirring continuously. Add condensed milk and cook for another minute. Remove cooked chicken pieces onto a dish covered with aluminium foil and keep aside. Take a bowl. Pour boiling water over it until the water remains clear. Add condensed milk. Stir. Pour milk mixture over chicken in the bowl. Serve hot or cold.

title: Old-Fashioned Beef Brisket (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs beef brisket, meat removed from bones ( or beef briskets ) | 1 can stewing beef | 1 box graham cracker crumbs, to spread on the brisket | 3/4 cup rice
instructions: Place the beef brisket meat in your crockpot with the bones. Pour stew beef over the brisket. Mix the graham crackers with the rice and sprinkle top of brisket with cracker mixture. Place brisket on top of the can of stew beef and pour remaining can of stew beef over top of it. Cook on high for 6 - 8 hours.

title: Celery
ingredients: 4 cups celery salt | 2 cups brown sugar
instructions: Combine celery salt and the brown sugar. Mix thoroughly in a dishwasher. Store in the fridge. When ready to use, mix into a sauce that thickens slightly to desired consistency. Refrigerate 1 - 2 days or before use.

title: Quick Beef and Vegetables for Two
ingredients: 3 cans stew meat, cut into 1-inch strips | 1 1/2 ounces cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1 large yellow sweet pepper, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 tablespoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: In a skillet over medium high heat, heat stew meat and mushrooms. Stir in sweet pepper, and oregano. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer 90 minutes, stirring occasionally.

title: Seared Steak and Scallops With Brazil
ingredients: 12 scallops | 1 lb sirloin | 1/2 orange, juice of | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon sugar | 1/8 cup pine nuts, roasted & chopped | 2 tablespoons sifted powdered sugar
instructions: Mix all ingredients except steaks together. Add steaks and marinate at least 10 minutes. Remove steaks from marinade and grill or broil as desired.

title: Golden Gaydi
ingredients: 2 pints grapes, washed, deely chopped | 1 tablespoon garam masala
instructions: Place the grapes in a large pan and stir in the garam masala. Cook over a very low heat for 5 minutes. Add the grapes to the pan, season and cook over a brisk heat for 15 minutes. Serve warm with chapatis, or rice.

Random Ingredients: phyllo pastry,lemon pepper,dark brown sugar,asparagus,escarole,picante sauce,japanese eggplant
title: Escarole, Asparagus and Eggplant Phyllo Pie
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs asparagus, trimmed and sliced diagonally about 1/4 inch | 2 japanese eggplants, trimmed and sliced diagonally about 1/4 inch | 1 cup picante sauce, preferably mild | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1 lb phyllo pastry sheet, thawed and patted dry | 1 1/2 lbs escarole, trimmed, washed, stems intact | 1/4 1/4 lb phyllo pastry, defrosted, thawed, and patted dry, cut into 2 by half inch squares ( may use butter if desired ) or 1 1/4 lbs buttery phyllo pastry sheets, blanched individually and cut lengthwise into 1/2 inch squares ( may use butter if desired )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 f. Spray bottom and sides of a 9 inch glass pie pan with cooking spray. Arrange asparagus pieces, 1/2 inch apart, in pie pan and scatter eggplant slices on top. Pour picante sauce over vegetables and eggplant. Sprinkle with brown sugar. Cover and bake for 45 min. Uncover and bake for 15 - 20 min., or till eggplant is tender. Let cool. Arrange escarole leaves on top. Place remaining sheets on a baking sheet. Brush with butter, and bake for 5 minutes. Watch carefully so that the phyllo doesn't get too brown. Remove from oven and set aside to cool enough to handle.

Random Ingredients: rom tomato,chili garlic sauce,sun tomato oil
title: Sun-dried Tomato, Chili and Sun-Dried Tomato Sauce #5FIX
ingredients: 2 roma tomatoes | 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained | 2 tablespoons chili-garlic sauce, from asian supermarkets
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees. Core roma tomatoes, and slice into thin slices approximately 1/16 inch thick. Spread sun dried tomatoes and garlic sauce on rimmed baking sheet. Place in the oven and immediately turn to broil for about 10 minutes or until the tomatoes begin to get a little black and roasted. Remove from heat. Arrange on a serving platter and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: velveeta cheese,egg yolk,clove,hot red pepper flake
title: Hot Chile Rellenos
ingredients: 1 lb velveeta cheese, cut in small cubes | 3 tablespoons hot red pepper flakes | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves | 1 large egg yolk
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees. Combine eggs and yolk in small bowl.

Random Ingredients: chuck,green pepper,blackberry,cocoa powder,flour,spanish olive pimento,chili oil,olive oil
title: Blackberry and Beef Empanadas
ingredients: 3 tablespoons cocoa powder | 2 teaspoons chili oil | 12 -15 canned blackberries, whole drained | 2 tablespoons spanish olives or 2 tablespoons pimentos, chopped | 1/4 - 1/2 cup cooked chuck, chopped | 3 tablespoons flour | 1/3 cup frozen green pepper, thawed, if using fresh | 1 tablespoon olive oil | chocolate chips ( optional )
instructions: Place ingredients for sauce, blackberries and meat in a medium bowl. Mix well by hand or blend in mixer. Add flour and mix lightly between hands or use dough whisk for best results. Place enough dough into ungreased 13x9 baking dish to cover the bottom of the dish, approximately 8x4 inch. Spread with meat mixture. Dot with nuts and top with green peppers. Drizzle with olive oil. Cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate, covered, for several hours. Preheat oven to 350ºf and bake for 40 minutes or until filling is bubbly.

title: Peanut Thai Salad
ingredients: 1 package pepperoni | 1 jar mango chutney | 1 cup peanuts butter | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons coriander | 2 tablespoons shredded pepperoni
instructions: Dice pepperoni. Marinate pepperoni slices in the first 3 ingredients. Add to the salad.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,green pepper,green olive,bacon dripping,chili oil,turmeric powder
title: Spanish Green Oven Pig
ingredients: 6 lbs fatty boneless lean pork or 6 lbs fatty boneless leafers | 1 tablespoon bacon drippings or 1 tablespoon oil | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 4 -6 green olives, pitted sliced ( optional ) | 1 large green pepper, finely chopped | 1 beef bouillon cube
instructions: Place meat in a colander. Drain excess liquid from meat, and pour 1 tablespoon fat or oil into colander to clean the meat. Repeat two more times, and thoroughly pat the meat dry. Place meat in a deep bowl, turning to coat well with the fat. Mix remaining fat with turmeric. Place green olive slices on top, and sprinkle on the turmeric powder. Slide a meat thermometer through the meat in the order given. Check meat at this time to see if it falls apart easily. It is very important to do this, because a sharp knife in the thickest part of meat will show the correct doneness. This takes about 1 1/2 hours to 1 1/2 hours. While meat can be done, clean and trim the olives and peppers, and use two forks to separate the stalks from the body. Remove all visible membrane. With wet hands, tear and clean meat, removing fat as it appears. Rinse the olives, pepper, and beef, then pat dry with kitchen towels. Pat them dry again. Add more fat to the same pot used to cook the meat, if needed. Heat oil over medium high heat, and brown both sides of the meat evenly. Transfer meat to a large roasting pan, and pour 1/2 cup water over meat. Cover tightly, and place into preheated 325° oven. If there is room, place oven door slightly ajar, so it stays hot. Bake for 2 - 3 hours, or until meat is tender and meat is brown. During the last hour of baking, remove lid, and sprinkle with a little browned bread crumbs to garnish. Remove from oven, and let meat rest for at least 5 minutes before carving into desired serving sizes, if it is any. Serve with a sauce or a salad, and enjoy.

title: Fig Ice Cream
ingredients: 12 fresh figs | 1 1/2 cups heavy cream, cold
instructions: Remove as many leaves as can easily form and trim off stalks. Place in bowl of strainer and leave in sink until dry.

Random Ingredients: part mozzarella cheese,basmati rice,ginger paste,poultry seasoning,flat leaf parsley,broth
title: Savory Indian Rice With Grilled Broccoli
