ingredients: 1 tablespoon ginger paste | 1/2 cup basmati rice | 3 cups broth | 1 1/2 cups part-skim mozzarella cheese, cut into cubes | 1 1/2 teaspoons poultry seasoning | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley
instructions: In a saucepan, bring broth and ginger paste to a boil. Add rice.

title: Anchovies
ingredients: 2 cans anchovies | 1/4 teaspoon onion salt
instructions: Drain anchovies well and mash with pestle. Stir in onion salt until well mixed.

title: Spiced Catfish With Grape Mash
ingredients: 6 -8 new potatoes, depending on their size | 350 -350 g grapes, depending on their size | 1 quart milk | 1 bunch fresh coriander leaves, chopped | 200 g fillets or 200 g catfish fillets, skin and pin bones removed
instructions: Preheat the grill or a griddle. Put the potatoes in a saucepan with enough water, a few tablespoons of sea salt and about 300ml. Bring to the boil. As soon as it boils, place the potatoes on to the grill or griddle and cook, turning until the potatoes are light golden, about 8 minutes. Drain and chill in the fridge. Wash, pat dry, chop roughly and put to the side. Heat a little butter or oil in a large saucepan and fry the grapes for about 5 minutes. Remove and set aside. Heat the milk over a good heat and gradually add the corriander. When it starts to simmer, add the potatoes and gently boil, stirring often, until they are well cooked. Serve hot and top with the chopped corriander and freshly grated parmesan cheese.

title: Creamy White Cranberry Mustard
ingredients: 2 gallons cranberry juice | 1 teaspoon brown mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon anise seed
instructions: In a large stockpot combine mustard seeds, aniseed, cranberry juice and mustard seeds. Bring to a rolling boil. Boil rapidly for 20 to 30 minutes or until mustard seeds have popped and most of the liquid has been absorbed. Cool down and pour into a bottle.

Random Ingredients: farfalle pasta,lemon pepper,tomato green pepper onion,lemon,grape tomato,half,fruit,lamb
title: Lamb and Fruity Pasta Salad
ingredients: 16 ounces farfalle pasta or 16 ounces ziti pasta | 2 cups half-and-half | 1 lb ground lamb | 2 cups grape tomatoes, halved | 4 lemons, juice of | 1 lemon pepper | 1 tablespoon dried fruit ( optional ) | 1 bunch green onion, sliced | 1/2 teaspoon lemon pepper
instructions: Cook the pasta according to directions, drain, and rinse under cold water. Bring a large pot of well salted water on the stove. Cook the lamb until no longer pink in the thickest part, about 10 minutes, breaking it into bite sized pieces as it cooks. Drain or remove any excess fat. In large bowl, mix the cooked pasta, half and half, pasta, lamb, tomatoes, lemon juice, lemon pepper, and lemon pepper together in a large bowl. Garnish with green onion.

title: The Perfect Ginger Beer
ingredients: 4 gallons ginger ale | 12 clove or more to taste ground cloves
instructions: Add ginger ale in a large bucket to a bottle with a tight fitting lid. Stir ginger ale with a wooden spoon or long handled wooden spoon. When bubbles form from the ginger ale and the bottle, remove beer from the burner. Stir cloves into ginger ale to make a medium amber color. Pour into the prepared beer bottle. Let stand at least 4 hours before serving to release air. Enjoy.

title: Spicy Artichoke Mayonnaise
ingredients: 1 package frozen artichoke hearts, thawed, peeled, and quartered | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprigs | 3 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 teaspoon dry mustard
instructions: Combine the artichokes, thyme, oyster sauce, and mustard in the container of a blender. Cover, and pulse until the mixture becomes thick, creamy, and smooth. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Chinese Cabbage (Tortilla)
ingredients: 1/2 chinese cabbage, shredded ( we like chinese cabbage, i just find mine in the asian supermarket ) | 12 ounces cheese ( i like mexican blend ) | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 pint cherry tomatoes ( chopped )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well and refrigerate until ready to serve. Garnish with sour cream and chopped cilantro if desired.

title: Thai-style Brisket
ingredients: 5 whole cloves | 2 white peppercorns | 2 tablespoons white sugar | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 4 pounds beef brisket
instructions: Place cloves, peppercorns, sugar, and fish sauce into a glass or ceramic bowl. Trim off the thick end of the brisket and rub with salt. Place brisket into the bowl, and coat all sides with the spice mixture. Cover, and refrigerate for 6 to 7 hours. Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat, and lightly oil grate.

title: Arroz De Pollo - Mexican Rice With Peppers and Green
ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice, with 1/2 cup of uncooked corn kernels on the cob and 1/4 cup of uncooked white rice on top | 2 cups chicken broth
instructions: In a casserole dish with a tight fitting lid, layer the rice, corn, chicken broth and remaining green ingredients. Cover tightly with tight fitting lid and bake at 350° for 1 hour. Uncover and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes.

title: Peaches and Peppers Jelly
ingredients: 2 packages lime gelatin | 12 small green sweet peppers, washed, drained, chopped | 1 jar peaches, chopped
instructions: Dissolve the lime gelatin in 3 cups of hot water. Add the sweet peppers to 3/4 of the jelly. Mix well until smooth. Pour this into a buttered 9x13 inch pan. Spread the chopped fruit in rows on the top. Cover and set in the refrigerator at least 6 hours. If making ahead, refrigerate until serving time.

Random Ingredients: piri,ginger garlic paste,rice noodle,salami,dark beer,spring wrapper,polish sausage
title: Rice Noodle Samosas
ingredients: 2 spring roll wrappers | 2 tablespoons dark beer | 1 large link polish sausage | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 lb sausage, removed from casing and crumbled | 1/2 teaspoon dried piri-piri | 1 -2 cup cooked rice noodles
instructions: Lightly coat wrappers in a little beer. Bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 20 - 25 minutes. Allow to cool, then dip in beaten egg to coat both sides. Slice the links, then crumble across the top. Toast ginger in a pan for 2 - 3 minutes until golden brown, then add mushrooms and sausages. Cook for 15 minutes. Drain the fat from pan and add piri piri. Mix well and add rice noodles. Fill rice noodle mixture, and seal the corners. These can be eaten with any kind of meat as long as they are well cooked. Serve with garlic bread and sweet pickles for dipping.

Random Ingredients: almond,white chocolate chip,tamarind paste,white wine vinegar,grain rice
title: White Chocolate Rice Salad With Tamarind
ingredients: 200 g long-grain rice | 75 g dried tamarind paste | 500 ml dry white wine vinegar | 100 g dried white chocolate chips | 100 g ground almonds
instructions: Wash the rice in a fine mesh sieve until the runs runny liquid remains.

title: Easy Syrup
ingredients: 1 cup molasses | 1 lemon, zested
instructions: In a small saucepan, stir molasses and lemon zest together. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 1 minute. Remove from heat. Stir frequently until syrupy, about 10 minutes. Cool mixture completely, about 20 minutes. Pour into a covered container and refrigerate until cold, up to 2 weeks.

title: Chocolate Lentils
ingredients: 2 cups lentils ( green or brown ) | 80 -100 dark chocolate, melted
instructions: Drain any excess water by putting the lentils in a large bowl with a lid attached. Put the drained lentils into an electric blender and add the melted chocolate. Mix well. Store in the fridge or freeze.

Random Ingredients: orange juice,blue cheese,almond extract,green olive,citrus peel,green leaf lettuce,pesto sauce,pink grapefruit
title: Spoonful Citrus Salad
ingredients: 1 jar mixed green olives | 1 pink grapefruit, sectioned and peeled | 3 tablespoons orange juice | 2 tablespoons orange juice | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce | 1/2 teaspoon citric acid ( optional ) | 1/4 cup chopped green leaf lettuce | 1/4 cup chopped green olives ( optional ) | 1/4 cup chopped pink grapefruit ( optional )
instructions: Dry salad. Cut away peel from olives. Place in a bowl of cold water for about 1 minute until al dente, but they won't be ready to slice. Drain, then rinse well. Cut into bite size pieces and place in the bowl with olives and the sliced grapefruit. Sprinkle on the orange juice, pesto and citric acid. Stir to combine. Drizzle orange and lemon juice over salads and mix. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour or overnight. Garnish with green, green or black olives if desired. Serve right away.

title: Courgette & Potato Soup
ingredients: 1 bunch courgette, cut into half to make 2-3-3-4-inch size pieces ( preferably white ones ) | 5 -6 cups vegetable stock ( or just use vegetable stock ) | 4 -6 baking potatoes ( i sometimes used yellow )
instructions: In a 2 5l pot put the broth and potatoes. Cook slowly on the stovetop or on the stove. If using a pressure cooker, just turn on and keep heating for about 5 minutes. When the soup reaches the boiling point, the potatoes should turn a little golden. Serve immediately, garnished with a little more chopped courgettes, if desired.

Random Ingredients: hot sauce,guacamole,kosher salt,crabmeat,steak,cooking oil,beef chuck,cremini mushroom
title: Shish Kabobs
ingredients: 1 pound cubed beef chuck | 1 pound sliced cremini mushrooms | 1 pound cooked crabmeat, drained | hot sauce to taste ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons chopped sun-dried tomatoes | 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 4 teaspoons guacamole
instructions: Place beef, mushrooms, crabmeat, and hot sauce in a bowl. Toss to coat. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Cook meat for about 5 minutes until browned. Stir in mushrooms, and continue cooking about 5 more minutes.

title: Granny's Zucchini
ingredients: 1 large zucchini, sliced paper thin | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Lightly toast zucchini in a skillet. When zucchini is soft, slice into 1/4 inch thick strips. Place on paper towels to drain. Place cream in a small bowl and microwave for 20 - 30 seconds or so until cream is starting to boil. Pour cream into zucchini on a platter and sprinkle with additional zucchini.

title: Peach 'n Pepperoni Appetizer
ingredients: 12 apricot jam jars | 12 pepperoni, sliced | 1/2 cup sweet chili paste ( like sambal oelek ) | 1 lb pear, peel left on ( about 2 )
instructions: Set jam jars on jelly roll pan. Drench each row of pepperoni slices along one edge in hot jam, then remove from towel. Sprinkle chili paste and cut pear lengthwise into 1/4 inch slices. Lay pepperoni slice over jam layer. Roll up jelly roll fashion, jelly roll fashion, jelly roll fashion, and pinch ends shut. Bake at 250 f for 10 minute. Let stand 4 minutes, then serve.

title: Broccoli and Broccoli Sprouts
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh green beans, trimmed | 1/2 lb fresh broccoli floret, trimmed
instructions: Cut beans diagonally into 1/2 wide by 1/2 long pieces. Steam broccoli 3 to 4 minutes or until crisp tender.

title: Chunky Chicken Bites
ingredients: 2 cups chicken, diced | 1 cup quinoa | 200 g butter | 1 tablespoon plain flour | 1 tablespoon grated ginger | 1 teaspoon salt
instructions: Place chicken, quinoa and half the butter in a large saucepan, add enough water just to cover the chicken, bring to simmer, then cook for 15 minutes. Stir in sifted flour and ginger. Remove from heat and stir in remaining butter/butter mixture. Drain chicken from saucepan and add to pan. Dish into small balls. Stand in warm water until pliable then freeze. Can be reheated in simmering cupboard for 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: lemon pepper,anchovy paste,arrowroot,espresso powder,radish,tomato basil pasta sauce,brown sugar
title: Alami Salad
ingredients: 1 lb radish ( about 5 large ) | 2 cans of hunts tomato and basil pasta sauce | 1 can anchovy paste | 1/2 cup brown sugar | 1/2 cup arrowroot ( may use corn starch ) | 1/2 teaspoon lemon pepper | powdered ginger and fresh basil
instructions: Cut the radish into quarters and slice each quarter again lengthwise. Remove the seeds and coarsely chop the larger pieces. In a large bowl mix the tomato and basil sauce, anchovy paste, brown sugar, arrowroot and lemon pepper. Cover and refrigerate for 2 - 4 hours. When ready to serve stir to combine and sprinkle with paprika and fresh basil.

title: Pasta with Turnips and Pistachios
ingredients: 500 g large turnips, cut into large chunks | 400 g pasta, of your choice | 1/2 cup pistachio nut, toasted | celery seed, for sprinkling
instructions: Put the turnips in a large saucepan with enough water to cover them. Cook, covered, over the lowest possible heat until tender, about 30 minutes. While they are cooking, bring a large pan of salted water to the boil. When the water comes to a boil, add pasta and cook to al dente. Drain the liquid and reserve. When the turnips are done, drain, toss into the pasta, and sprinkle generously with toasted pistachios. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: green coriander,cremini mushroom,cold water,double cream,chicken breast half
title: Creamed Chicken With Mushrooms and Dried Cremini
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1 teaspoon double cream | 2 tablespoons cold water | 1/2 cup green coriander, roughly chopped | 8 ounces cremini mushrooms or 8 ounces other firm white mushrooms
instructions: Remove the fat from the chicken breasts using a rolling pin. With a meat mallet, pound the chicken breasts to 1/4 inches thickness. Season each piece with salt and pepper. Heat one teaspoon of cream in a skillet over medium high heat. Place the breasts in the pan, and cook 2 - 4 minutes. Turn, and cook 2 - 4 minutes longer. Transfer to a plate. Add the remaining cream to the skillet, and bring to a boil. Stir in the coriander, and remove from heat. Cut mushrooms into quarters lengthwise. Arrange the mushrooms on top of the chicken breasts, and spoon sauce over.

title: Kielbasa and Coffee
ingredients: 1 package fresh kielbasa | 3 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 5 tablespoons icing sugar | 1 2/3 cups black hot strong coffee
instructions: Slice kielbasa into 1 inch wide sticks. Mix together the ginger garlic paste and icing sugar. Set aside. Bring coffee to a boil and pour into a tall glass. Dip and coat kielbasa with ginger garlic mixture. Pour hot coffee over kielbasa sticks. Serve.

Random Ingredients: hoisin sauce,oyster sauce,cherry,pecorino romano cheese,asafoetida powder,white wine,ancho chile powder
title: Italian Spiced Asafoetida
ingredients: 1 teaspoon finely chopped pecorino romano cheese | 1/2 teaspoon ancho chile powder | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1/4 cup oyster sauce | 1/8 cup white wine | 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce | 1 tablespoon dry white wine, for drizzling, if desired
instructions: Mix the cheese with the chili powder and set aside. Heat a wok over high heat, add a small amount of oil and wait for a bead of water on the bottom. Drop a few asafoetida at a time to make a hole in the center. Quickly stir fry the asafoetida for about 30 seconds, then pour in oyster sauce and white wine. When the mixture boils, immediately stir in hoisin sauce and dry white wine. Taste and add more hoisin sauce if desired. Garnish with finely chopped green onion if desired.

title: Champlain Swiss Roll  -  Cheese Filled  Rolls
ingredients: 4 -6 cups diced velveeta cheese ( or any other wi cheese you can find ) | 1 box of belgian swiss roll | 1 cup shredded coconut ( i use kraft brand ) | 1 teaspoon sesame seeds | 1 bottle of belgian sparkling wine ( any sweet and sour you choose )
instructions: Get your belgian sweet roll and cut each roll in half and spread each half with one tbsp of sesame seeds. Cut up the cheese and place one half onto each roll. Roll each tightly, then wrap the ends of the cheese in the coconut. Keep a close eye on them so they don't burn and let the roll chill. Drain any excess liquid, slice the roll with a bread knife, and serve with your favorite beverage such as a sweetened balsamic, chinese mustard or any type of dijon mustard you may use this for a change. To do this, in a small bowl mix together, 1 tsp sesame seeds and 1 tsp sugar, and drizzle over rolls as desired. Enjoy the applause, oh so good.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,yellow mustard,scallion,white pepper,white sugar,brandy,star anise pod,self rising flour
title: Gran's Easy Mustard Crackers
ingredients: 3 cups self-rising flour | 1 1/2 cups white sugar | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 2 tablespoons brandy | 1 teaspoon ground white pepper | 1 teaspoon freshly cracked yellow mustard | 1/2 star anise pod, crushed | 2 scallions, minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Sift self rising flour into a large bowl. Stir in sugar, oil, brandy, pepper, and mustard until well blended. Shape dough into a ball, transfer to a lightly floured, lightly floured work surface, and knead, using more flour if needed to make a stiff dough that does not stick to your hands. Wrap dough with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for at least 6 hours or overnight. Lightly oil a large baking sheet. Divide dough into 4 parts. Make each part of the rolling pin into a rectangle 5x6 inches. Cover dough evenly with plastic wrap. Repeat with the remaining dough. Slice dough into 6 equal sized triangles. Place triangles on prepared baking sheet. Bake at 350 degrees f for 20 minutes. Remove from oven, and place on a wire rack to cool. Mix white pepper and scallion, and brush onto tops of each crouton. Return to the oven, and bake for another 10 minutes. Cool, and store in an airtight container.

title: Pumpkin Oat
ingredients: 2 cups oatmeal | 3 teaspoons pumpkin pie spice | 2 teaspoons maple syrup
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Mix together oatmeal, pumpkin spice and maple syrup until well incorporated. Dump into a greased and floured bundt pan. Bake, uncovered, for 20 minutes, or until lightly browned.

title: Greek Yogurt Balls
ingredients: 16 ounces plain greek yogurt | salt and pepper | 2 tablespoons rice or 2 tablespoons arabic rice, soaked for 5 minutes and drained | 12 ounces chocolate sprinkles, finely chopped | 6 mint leaves, chopped
instructions: Mix together the rice or arabic rice, melted chocolate sprinkles and chopped mint leaves. Stuff the mint into the molds of your choice that have been prepared lined with foil with parchment. Using damp hands shape balls from the rice/rosemary mixture into flat mini balls. Bake for 25 - 30 minutes at 350 degrees or until completely cooked.

title: Easy Lemon Linguine
ingredients: 3 tablespoons pineapple juice | 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 2 tablespoons quick-cooking spray | 8 ounces linguine, cooked
instructions: Place linguine in a large bowl and add your topping. Stir to combine. Serve immediately.

title: Tres Leches "Cabbage"
ingredients: 8 medium cabbage, quartered | 1/4 cup turbinado sugar | 4 ounces mexican cheese | 1 loaf unsliced italian bread
instructions: Pre heat oven to 300°f. Place 1/4cup of the sugar in a shallow pan. Cut a circle from the top of each cabbage quarter just to form circle. Sprinkle the bottom edge of the crust with turbinado sugar. Place 1/2 of the cabbage quarters, cut side down, on the sugar. Fill or leave the center of the circle in tact with the core removed, or place each quarter on the rim of a greased baking dish. Cut the loaf and slide it carefully into the oven with the oven door ajar. As the bread comes out of the oven you will be sealing it with foil or sealing it with tin foil and browning it on the top side a bit. Remove the tray from the oven. To finish cooking turn on the broiler. Cut the bread in 4 slices and stack on 4 serving plates. Place the cooked crispie on the bottom edge and the cheese on the top. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: tamari soy sauce,tomato soup,orange peel,white fish fillet
title: Gourmet Tomato Fish Soup
ingredients: 6 tomatoes ( medium ) | 1 tablespoon tamari soy sauce ( or tamari soy sauce ) | 1/2 teaspoon orange peel, finely grated | 1 white fish fillet
instructions: Rinse tomato well under cold running water. Drain well and cut into 1/4 inch dice. Bring all ingredients to gentle boil. Lower heat and simmer gently until fish is just cooked about 15 minutes. Serve immediately, sprinkled generously with some of the dark soy sauce, if desired.

Random Ingredients: oil,oyster sauce,bay seasoning,flour tortilla,palm sugar,cardamom seed,cheddar cheese,balsamic vinegar
title: Nayarayef (Nayarin Style) Quesadilla
ingredients: 8 flour tortillas | oil | 3 cups cheddar cheese, shredded | 3 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 1/2 cup palm sugar, grated | 1 tablespoon old bay seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed, crushed
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl, except for tortillas. Pour into a 9 inch deep, 16 inch frying pan. Heat over medium heat. When oil is ready, add tortillas in a single layer and fry until crisp on both sides. Transfer to paper towels to drain. While tortillas are frying, bring oil to a boil in medium saucepan. Place tortillas in oil and fry until brown in color and moisture, about 3 minutes per side. Pour off excess oil and place on paper towels to drain. Sprinkle tortilla with grated cheese. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,koshi,raspberry,mustard powder,dill,apple cider,sumac,splenda sugar substitute
title: Sour Apple Salad
ingredients: 2 apples | 1 lb fresh spinach leaves | 1/4 cup fresh dill, washed and chopped | 2 tablespoons splenda sugar substitute or 2 tablespoons sugar | 1/4 cup dried sour apple cider | 1 teaspoon pure dry mustard powder | 1/2 teaspoon dried koshi | 1 cup raspberries or 1 cup fruit preserves
instructions: Peel and core apples and cut into thin slices. Prepare dressing in a blender bowl. Slice spinach and dill. Mix with apple, mustard, koshi and berries. Put dressing into a shallow bowl. Add apples salad ingredients. Serve on toasted bread.

Random Ingredients: walnut,sage,vanilla sugar,ramen noodle,kaiser,phyllo pastry,pork shoulder roast
title: Easy Phyllo Pastry
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/4 lb pork shoulder roast | 2 packages kraft signature lemon zesty rolled sweet alfredo flavor ramen noodles | 1 package phyllo pastry | 6 ounces frozen chopped walnuts | 1 1/2 cups vanilla sugar or 1 1/2 cups cane syrup, not sweetener ( if you can not find sugar or syrup, substitute with a 1/2 cup honey ) | 1 tablespoon dried sage | 1 large loaf kaiser round ( or other roll )
instructions: Slice pork across the grain into 1 slices. You should be able to work with about 5 slices. Set aside. In a 9x13 pan, spread the ramen seasoning packets into the bottom of the pan. Add approximately 1/3 of the ramen noodles to the bottom of the pan. Next add about 2/3's of the walnuts and about a 1/3 of the vanillin sugar or syrup. Add 1 1/2 cups of the pork meat and more of the noodles. Repeat the layers in steps 6 8. End with a top layer of bread. Cover the phyllo pastry with aluminum foil over the phyllo to prevent drying out. This phyllo pastry can be frozen before cooking. Pre heat oven to 400°f. Uncover pastry and let thaw in fridge for about 20 minutes. Lay out phyllo sheets on a clean counter. Use half of phyllo sheets at a time until you have 8 sheets. You should have 8 sheets of phyllo. Brush approximately 2 tablespoons of cooking spray onto sheet and stack onto the phyllo sheets. Top with approximately half of meat, walnuts, remaining dough, then another layer of dough, then lastly another layer of phyllo. Pile another 1/2 3/4 of the pork, walnuts, and nuts on top of each sheet. Use additional sheets of phyllo if necessary. Brush top stack with cooking spray before putting it in the oven. Bake for about 30 minutes or until golden brown on top.

title: Mums Beef Burgers
ingredients: 1 lb beef mince | 1/2 cup brown lentils | 1/8 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 tablespoon catsup
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Form into 4 - 4 patties. Pan fry over high heat until cooked through and firm, about 5 - 10 minutes. Serve on buns or with cooked noodles.

Random Ingredients: yellow onion,coriander,yellow mustard,bulk italian sausage,molasses,prosciutto,swiss cheese,polenta
title: Crispy Sausage and Polenta Rounds
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs bulk sweet italian sausage, casings removed | 1 1/2 cups grated swiss cheese ( about 4 cups ) | 3/4 cup reduced-sodium prepared polenta | 1/4 cup molasses | 2 teaspoons yellow mustard | 1 teaspoon ground coriander | 2 tablespoons prosciutto, minced | 1 medium yellow onion, coarsely chopped
instructions: . Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly grease a 9x5x2 inch casserole dish. Line bottom of prepared casserole dish with parchment paper. Cut sausage links crosswise into 1/8 inch slices, then cut slices crosswise 1/8 inch thick. Drain well. Combine sausage, 1/2 cup swiss cheese, polenta, molasses, mustard and coriander in a large bowl and stir well. Spoon half of sausage mixture in prepared casserole dish. Top with half with prosciutto and onion. Top with remaining swiss cheese and sausage mixture. Repeat with rest of sausage mixture and prosciutto. Sprinkle top with remaining swiss cheese. Bake, uncovered, for 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown. Let stand 10 minutes, then cut in squares and serve.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,sun tomato oil,orange flower water,salmon fillet
title: Salmon With Sun-dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 lbs salmon fillets, skin, bone and skin removed | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 2/3 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and patted dry | 1/3 cup orange flower water | 3 tablespoons white vinegar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f season salmon with salt and pepper. In a large baking dish or broiler pan, heat oil. Arrange salt pork on all sides and arrange in an even layer. Cook for 4 minutes on each side until browned and flake easily when tested with a fork. Transfer to a platter.

Random Ingredients: lemon wedge,tofu,black mustard seed,vegetable oil cooking spray,caraway seed,parsnip,allspice,mozzarella cheese
title: Mock Ravioli With Tofu & Veggies
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 10 whole allspice berries, crushed | 1 tablespoon lemon wedge | 2 teaspoons caraway seeds or 2 teaspoons caraway powder | 2 teaspoons black mustard seeds | 1/4 lb tofu, diced | 2 large parsnips, halved lengthwise and thinly sliced | 1/2 lb fresh mozzarella cheese, sliced with meyer string cheese attached ( about 8 slices )
instructions: Coat a large skillet with cooking spray and place over medium high heat. When very hot, add allspice berries, lemon wedge, caraway seeds and mustard seeds. Turn as needed to char allspice berries. Add tofu and parsnips and cook until crisp tender, about 3 minutes. Add cheeses and cook until melted and heated through, about 3 minutes. Toss with the ravioli and serve.

title: Tortillas
ingredients: 12 tortillas | 1 teaspoon anise, crushed, or more to taste | 1 teaspoon zucchini, shredded | 1 teaspoon ancho chile powder | 1 teaspoon salt | 4 cups iceberg lettuce, chopped | 1/4 cup crushed iceburg lettuce, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Grill tortillas with anise seeds and chile powder until slightly charred, 30 seconds to 1 minute per side. Sprinkle zucchini and ancho powder onto a plate and add 2 tortillas, each about 3/4 inch thick, keeping remaining tortillas as a guide to remove tortillas from grill.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,pam cooking spray,pepperoni,button mushroom,banana,strawberry
title: Banana Strawberry Pizza
ingredients: 25 g sliced pepperoni | 25 g sliced mushrooms | 2 slices bananas | 1 packet frozen strawberries, thawed | 1 tablespoon self-raising flour | pam cooking spray
instructions: Place pepperoni slice and mushroom slices onto a large plate. Place banana slices onto banana, sprinkle with flour, cover with strawberry and pepper sauce and a dash of paprika.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,turnip green,spaghetti,apple juice,pepperoni,salmon,blackberry jam,double cream
title: Salmon Spaghetti Pie
ingredients: 8 ounces fresh spaghetti, such as roni's, well drained | 2 teaspoons apple juice | 1 tablespoon blackberry jam, such as karpal | 5 ounces smoked salmon | 4 ounces swiss gruyere cheese, rind removed and grated | 4 ounces turnip greens, stalks only, finely shredded | 1 1/2 ounces double cream
instructions: Cook the pasta and drain. Preheat oven to 400f degrees f/190c. Place the raspberry's jam in small shallow ovenproof dish. Tear the salmon into bite sized pieces, season with salt and pepper, and toss with the grated cheese and turnip greens. Pour the pasta mixture onto the jam. Mix the cream with two tablespoons water in a jug. Cover partially tightly and leave to stand for at least an hour, stirring occasionally. Remove the dish and spread the cream on the top. Bake the pie for 10 - 15 minutes, or until the cream is bubbling and the pasta is tender. Top with remaining grated cheese.

title: Easy Mexican Pot Roast
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/4 lb beef roast | 1/2 cup hot sauce | 2 cups salsa
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Use a roasting pan large enough to fit roast on. Put beef roast in pan, add hot sauce. Cover and put in oven. Turn heat down to 375°f and cook for 5 hours. Use tongs to pull beef out of pan. Remove meat and put it on a platter. Pour salsa and hot sauce over the meat, and serve with warm tortillas, rice, etc.

Random Ingredients: peanut butter,live dungeness crab,flat leaf parsley,superfine sugar,bulk italian sausage,tapioca flour
title: Boc Diavolo (Spicy Crab and Sausage Rolls)
ingredients: 2 cups coarsely chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 2 cups coarsely chopped fresh flat-leaf italian sausage | 1 cup unsalted peanut butter, or more if needed | 3/4 cup superfine sugar | 1 1/2 cups tapioca flour | 1 1/2 pounds live dungeness crab, cleaned, heads reserved
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Mix parsley, sausage, peanut butter, and sugar together in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: tamarind paste,corn syrup,apricot,buttermilk,italian tomato,shell pasta,liquid smoke
title: Tomato Apricot Nogado
ingredients: 2 cups canned italian tomatoes, drained | 1 cup pitted soft dried apricot, coarsely chopped | 1 cup buttermilk | 1/4 cup light corn syrup | 1/4 cup tamarind paste | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke ( optional ) | 1 lb shell pasta
instructions: Combine tomatoes, apricots, buttermilk, corn syrup, and tamarind paste in a 3 1/2 to 4 qt saucepan. Bring to boil over high heat.

Random Ingredients: poultry seasoning,cardamom seed,orange marmalade,corn,red food coloring
title: Indian Corn-Orange Peel - Goog-Goon-Honeyed Corn
ingredients: 6 ears corn, shucked | 2 packets orange marmalade | 2 packets orange food coloring | 1 tablespoon poultry seasoning | 1 tablespoon orange marmalade | 1 teaspoon cardamom seeds
instructions: Prepare the shucked corn, you don't want to chop the corn kernels from the cob, just pull the husks off the cob. They won't sink to one another. Soak the shucked corn in water over night. Then rinse the corn well under cold running water, and drain. The next day rinse in a strainer under cold running water and run under cold water to remove excess moist water. Leave the corn on whole kernels, and if they are thick, take a second brush on a little more oil to coat. Use on the grill. While the corn is rubbing out the oil, mix the marmalade, food coloring, orange marmalade, cardamom, and onion and garlic powder in an electric blender. When the corn is cool enough, peel it from the cob and put it in a glass bowl with the marmalade mixture. Stir to mix. Heat the corn over high heat in the microwave for about 20 - 30 seconds to get a good spread. This will look very messy, so try to avoid burning it. If it's still very warm, it can be cut with a scissors. After about 5 minutes, stir the corn and marmalade mixture. Spread it on the cob. The coating will not stick to the corn while it grills, and the coating will stick to the kernels. Grill for about 5 - 7 minutes, flipping over once or twice to ensure it cooks evenly.

Random Ingredients: mustard,russet potato,garam masala,double cream,italian green bean
title: Beans and Potatoes
ingredients: 12 large russet potatoes, scrubbed and unpeeled ( about 2 pounds ) | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1 teaspoon dry mustard | 12 ounces fresh fresh italian cut green beans, trimmed | 1 cup double cream or 1 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Place the potatoes in a large pan of salted, boiling water, then cook until tender, about 20 minutes. Drain and plunge into ice water, then drain well. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, combine garam masala and dry mustard. Sprinkle the potato mixture with the mustard and green beans and toss together. Chill, covered, while making custard. When ready to serve, heat the cream and serve the potatoes on individual plates with a sprinkle of mustard and garam masala over and around the meat and beans if desired.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,feta cheese,superfine sugar,nonfat milk,picante sauce
title: Greek Feta Dip
ingredients: 14 ounces black crumbled feta cheese | 1/2 cup picante sauce | 1/4 cup superfine sugar | 1/2 cup nonfat milk | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar
instructions: In an electric mixer, combine the feta cheese, picante sauce, sugar, and milk. Cover and refrigerate at least 8 hours or overnight. Drain the dip. Serve chilled or at room temperature. Makes 8 servings.

title: Barbecue Chicken Wings with Mango and Walnuts
ingredients: 3 lbs skinless chicken wings | 1 mango, peeled and diced into bite size pieces | 1 3/4 ounces rice vinegar | 1 1/2 tablespoons granulated sugar | salt and pepper | kosher salt | 1 ounce walnut pieces
instructions: Trim any tips from the wing tips. In a large resealable plastic bag, combine all remaining ingredients and shake well to mix. Place wing tips into a 9x13 inch pan or baking dish and pour marinade over them. Let rest 2 1/2 hours. Bring a large saucepan to a boil. Add the wings and cook for 1 to 2 minutes. Cook for 3 to 5 minutes or until the tips are tender, turning to cook evenly. Arrange on a platter and serve with the mango and walnuts on the side.

title: Berlin Beet Bons (Pensalletas Salpil)
ingredients: 1 cup beet, cooked, peeled, and sliced, cooked through medium holes and drained | 3 tablespoons marsala or 3 tablespoons cognac | 2 teaspoons vanilla sugar ( or anise extract ) | 3 tablespoons finely minced fresh dill ( or 5 tablespoons dried dill ) | 1 tablespoon beet, cooked, peeled and sliced ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons tapioca, granular ( see note above, or use 1/3 cup barley flour mixed with the 1/3 cup barley starch ) | 1 tablespoon lemon juice, freshly squeezed ( if using )
instructions: Place all the ingredients into a blender except the lemon juice, and puree thoroughly. Pour into a large dish and refrigerate for 3 days or freeze for up to 2 months. Stir to keep from sticking. Serve with warm toast brushed with butter or milk. Also good cold.

title: Baked Salmon With Parsley and Salmon
ingredients: 1 salmon, weighing about 2 pounds ( or other white fish fillet ) | chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f place the fish on a foil lined baking tray and coat fish with parsley. Bake the fish for 15 to 18 minutes until cooked through, and flesh flakes easily when tested with a fork. Serve hot with a green salad and crusty french sticks.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,egg white,greek yogurt,ham,white rice,manchego cheese,mexican cheese
title: Rice Breakfast Bake
ingredients: 4 cups cooked white rice, divided | 1/2 cup greek yogurt | 1 cup shredded mexican cheese blend, divided | 6 tablespoons grated manchego cheese, divided | 3 egg whites | 2 ounces ham, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1/2 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Combine cooked rice and 1/2 cup of the cheese in a large bowl and set aside. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a small bowl combine the yogurt, 1/2 cup of the cheese and the egg whites. Stir in ham, parmigiano reggiano and 3/4 cup of the cheese. Line a 4 1/2 x4 inch loaf pan with parchment paper. Spread half of the rice mixture equally into the pan and sprinkle with remaining cheese. Pour yogurt/cheese mixture over cheese and rice, making sure to coat each layer with yogurt. Bake in the preheated oven for 40 to 50 minutes, or until heated thoroughly. Let stand for 10 minutes. Cut into 1 inch pieces and serve immediately.

title: Shrimp for Two
ingredients: 1 lb shrimp | 1 can diced green chilies
instructions: Clean and clean shrimp. Wash and drain shrimp, removing heads, shells, and all. Put shrimp into mixing bowl and stir fry until just pink. Add green chilies and mix well. Serve in a bowl.

title: Mango and Cranberry Appetizer
ingredients: 3/4 cup greek yogurt | 2 tablespoons dried cranberries | 1 tablespoon mango chutney | 8 cups frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: In a bowl, stir together the yogurt, cranberries, and mango chutney. Spread into the bottom of a large cereal bowl. Spread about 1/2 cup of the yogurt mixture on top of the cranberry mixture.

title: Salt Airm
ingredients: 2 cups salt ( to taste ) | 1/2 cup black peppercorns | 1/2 tablespoon aniseed | 1/4 cup vinegar ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons garlic salt
instructions: Put all ingredients into a blender. Shake vigorously until salt dissolves. Keep on the counter, and add some water as needed to blend.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,beef stock,cream mushroom soup,shortening,garlic clove,soymilk,chickpea
title: The Best Beef Stew Ever!
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs stewing beef, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 can drained chickpeas | 3 tablespoons shortening | 1 can fat-free beef stock | 1 garlic clove, chopped | 2 tablespoons light soymilk
instructions: Brown beef in the shortening in a skillet. Add the condensed soup, drained chickpeas and stock. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes. Add garlic and serve over noodles. You may substitute any beef you like if you like.

title: Homemade Taco Dip
ingredients: 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 fresh parsley sprig
instructions: Prepare an 8x8 inch dish with cooking spray. Mix taco seasoning with 1 cup warm water and spread into baking dish. Bake, uncovered in the oven, for 30 minutes at 350 degrees. Remove from oven and sprinkle with the parsley. Let stand until completely cooled and serve with tortilla chips. Store airtight in refrigerator. This recipe does not turn out well.

Random Ingredients: rotel,coconut oil,black pepper,jalapeno chile,spanish onion,baking soda
title: Mexican Style Baked Onions
ingredients: 6 medium spanish onions, halve lengthways and sliced 1/3 thick | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 can rotel ( mexican-style mild tomato-based hot tomato sauce ) | 1 teaspoon ground black pepper | 1 tablespoon coconut oil | 1 jalapeno chile, very finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°°f. Trim ends of onions with a sharp knife. Place onion halves cut side up in a large shallow baking dish. Combine remaining ingredients in a bowl. Pour over onions and bake for 1 hour or until onions are soft and caramelized. Place onion and juice in a food processor and process until smooth. Serve immediately.

title: Easy Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 lb boneless sirloin, lean | 11 ounces ground sirloin | 1 1/2 cups golden raisins | food coloring ( optional )
instructions: Cook meat as directed on package of beef stew mix. In crockpot place meat mixture and raisins. Push with fingers to get into small pieces of meat or leave small pieces of meat for texture. Mix well. Cook on high setting for 1 hour.

title: Baked Chilled Dessert Nuts With Pecans
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dried apricots | 1 cup balkan yogurt | 3/4 cup apricot brandy ( or rum ) | 1/4 cup khoya | 1/4 cup pine nuts, toasted
instructions: Soak the dried apricots for at least 5 hours. In an ovenproof dish, mix together the yogurt, crumbled apricots, brandy, khoya and toasted pine nuts. Dip the nuts in the yogurt mixture and bake at 180 grades c for 45 minutes or until puffed up and lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: salad dressing,salt pepper,breakfast sausage,topping,dark brown sugar,orange,sake,cucumber
title: Korean Spaget or Gyro Sandwich
ingredients: 8 ounces steak ( any other type of meat of your preference cut into 3/4 inch cubes. the longer they marinate, the spicier. ) | 1 ounce sweet light brown sugar, packed | 1 slice orange ( in the center ) | 1 pinch salt and pepper | 1 tablespoon fresh-squeezed orange juice ( from 1-3 ) | 8 ounces of any style breakfast sausage ( any flavor ) ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon of your favourite dark brown sugar, packed | topping : | 1/2 cucumber, peeled, diced very small | sweetened salad dressing, like miracle whip | salt and pepper
instructions: In a bowl combine the steak with the dark brown sugar, orange juice, salt and pepper until mixed. Set aside. Slice the orange into thin strips and place on paper towls when ready to use. When ready to cook, sprinkle the brown sugar on all sides of the beef. Heat a skillet over medium high. Add half of the beef to the pan and fry to desired doneness. Remove beef from the pan onto a plate and set aside. Repeat with remaining beef. Toppings, place the remaining beef back into the pan. Add the drained orange slices and 1/4 cup of brown sugar. Stir well to mix and cover. Let mixture cook on low heat. In a bowl, dissolve 1 tablespoon of the dark brown sugar in the remaining 1 tablespoon of brown sugar. Pour the mixture over top of the beef. Serve with a dollop of sweetened salad dressing and some minced cucumber. Note, if you don't like the spiciness of korean sausage, add 3 tablespoons of your favorite dark brown sugar to the meat mixture, along with the juice of 1/2 orange. You do not have to use this mixture to make the gogi, you just want to add some more sugar to the meat. You can also use this mixture to make the korean sandwiches.

title: Figs Tacos
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh fig, cut crosswise into halves | 1 package taco seasoning mix
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with foil. Arrange fig halves on prepared baking sheet.

title: Quick Steak and Potato Tarts
ingredients: 1 cup leftover stuffing, thawed | 1 cup diced potato, from a package | 1 cup diced leftover steak | 1 can progresso ro-tel tomatoes | 1/2 cup diced mixed vegetables, from a jar | 1/2 teaspoon black mustard seeds | 1/2 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon, dissolved | 1 can sliced grapes, drained ( i use grapes in natural juice )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f mix first seven ingredients in a medium bowl. Spread potatoes out evenly on a baking sheet, or lined baking sheets with parchment paper. Cut any large squares of wax paper between each square. Evenly divide filling between waxed paper cups, mounding the filling slightly. Carefully sprinkle mustard and bouillon over filling. Arrange grapes around each pastry sheet.

Random Ingredients: pork tenderloin,walnut oil,wonton wrapper,mexican chocolate,cornstarch,red pepper flake,oregano leaf,beef chuck
title: Chiles Roasted Pork Tenders
ingredients: 2 pork tenderloin, 2 to 1 inch thick | 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped walnuts or 2 tablespoons macadamias, divided | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped mexican blend cheese or 1/4 cup gouda cheese | 1 teaspoon cornstarch | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1 package wonton wrappers | vegetable oil or light olive oil, for brushing over finished wrappers
instructions: In a small bowl combine peppercorns, cheese, and oregano, crushing the pepper flakes in with your hands. Use fingers to shape a hole in each pork tenderloin half.

title: Jicama With Sausages & Sausage (Tseau Con Salsé)
ingredients: 3 lbs italian sausage ( or sweet sausage, or other savory beef and turkey sausage ) | 2 medium jicama | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400°f. Place sausage and jicama on a piece of heavy aluminum foil. Add turmeric. Wrap the foil loosely around ingredients. Place in oven and cook for 45 - 60 min's, until sausages are tender. Slice in slices if desired.

Random Ingredients: guacamole,pearl barley,cherry,ra el hanout spice mix,green olive,vegetable broth
title: Barley and Pepper Morocco Salad
ingredients: 15 ounces low sodium vegetable broth | 1/4 cup pearl barley | 10 ounces low sodium guacamole, divided ( about 1-1/2 cups purchased ) | 1/2 teaspoon ras el hanout spice mix | 1 1/2 ounces green olives, pitted and halved | 1/3 cup dried cherries ( or other plumped, dried apricots, pitted and coarsely chopped )
instructions: Combine broth and remaining ingredients in medium saucepan. Bring to boil over high heat. Reduce heat, cover and cook over low heat 20 minutes or until barley tender and liquid is absorbed. Season to taste with salt and pepper and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: green pepper,red bell pepper,thyme sprig,asparagus spear,water chestnut
title: Spicy  Asparagus Salad
ingredients: 1 can chopped water chestnuts | 1 cup finely chopped red bell peppers | 1 cup finely chopped green pepper | 1 envelope of thawed frozen asparagus spears, thawed | 1 fresh thyme sprig | 1 jar roasted red bell pepper, drained and slivered
instructions: Drain the canned asparagus and rinse well in a colander over a bowl to remove as much water as possible. Toss together the asparagus, red bell pepper, green pepper, thawed asparagus, and thyme sprigs. Chill before serving.

title: Lamb and Mango Sandwich
ingredients: 2 lbs leg of lamb ( about 4 pounds ) | 1 1/2 lbs mangoes ( medium ripe ) | 1/2 teaspoon parsley | 2 -3 large pita bread, split
instructions: Cut lamb into pieces about 2 - 3 by 1 1/2 inches. Place and let lamb cubes hang from the outside edge of a large cast iron or other heavy skillet, on top of a piece of waxed paper. If you have a cast iron skillet, you may use the meatiest you can find. If not, use some leftover from a roast, or other product of your choice that you may have. Place a large piece of waxed paper onto the meat. Lay meat into the waxed paper and pat down so that it forms a rectangle. The meat is probably aproximately 3/4 inch thick and will absorb the marinade for at least 1/2 hour. If you find the lamb too dry and start over, let it rest at least an hour. Meanwhile, peel mangoes. Cut meat into 1/2 inch thick slices and cut mangoes into 1/2 inch wedges. Preheat grill. Drain meat, discarding marinade. Thread meat onto the skewers. Cook on hot grill, turning once and brushing with reserved marinade, for 7 to 10 minutes or until cooked and nicely browned. Serve hot or room temperature.

title: Smoky Honey & Lime Relish
ingredients: 5 large dried cascabel ancho chilies, stemmed, seeded, and torn into chunks | 1 teaspoon salt | 5 cups peeled and diced, peeled apples ( see note ) | 1 cup finely diced spanish onion | 1/4 cup honey | 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh grated gingerroot | 1/4 cup freshly squeezed lime juice | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish ( optional )
instructions: To prepare the relish, place the dried chilies in a clean kitchen towel, and cover with a damp cloth. Allow 10 - 10 minutes to soften, then squeeze out the excess moisture. Place the chilies in a small dry frying pan and toast over medium heat, stirring often, until fragrant, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside to cool slightly. Place the chilies in a bowl, cover, and refrigerate until ready to use, at least 20 minutes. Drain the chilies, discarding stems, and set aside at room temperature. Place apples, onion, honey, ginger, lime juice, and horseradish in a food processor. Process until smooth.

title: Farfalle Apricot Pastry Salad
ingredients: 1 package farfalle pasta | 1 container dried apricots | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1 tablespoon coarsely ground dried apricot
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain.

title: Grilled Macs - Shrimp on a Stick
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs shrimp, cleaned | 3 tablespoons dry sherry | 2 rosemary sprigs | 3/4 cup cashews | 1 kaiser roll
instructions: Rinse shrimp well under cold water and pat dry with paper towels. Cut meat into bite size pieces and place in bowl with sherry and rosemary. Let sit for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Preheat grill to high. Grill shrimp with salt on one side only, moving from time to time. Turn and leave shrimp whole. Turn when other side is done, just long enough that shrimp are cooked through, about 15 minutes total. Toast cashews, remove shell and discard. Sprinkle tops with toasted cashews and garnish with rosemary sprigs.

Random Ingredients: white breadcrumb,adobo seasoning,fish,black bean,graham cracker crumb,curry leaf,coriander powder,sherry wine
title: Beans and Chips in a Snap
ingredients: 1 lb fish, cut up | 1 can black beans | 2 slices white breadcrumbs, toasted | 1 packet curry leaves | 3 -4 slices fresh graham cracker crumbs | 1 tablespoon ground coriander powder | 2 tablespoons sherry wine or 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 teaspoon arrowroot or 1 teaspoon cornstarch
instructions: Prep and cook fish, beans, garlic, graham cracker crumbs and coriander powder in a pan, stirring until well mixed. Add sherry or cider vinegar, cook until sauce coats fish and beans. Dip the bread slices in the vinegar and then the crumb mixture. Fry over medium heat until golden, turning as necessary and serve with salad.

Random Ingredients: farfalle pasta,flour tortilla,red chilies,dark sesame oil
title: Spicy Shellfish Wraps
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 12 ounces farfalle pasta | 2 dried red chilies, seeded and minced | 12 flour tortillas, 8 inch
instructions: In a large skillet, heat sesame oil over medium high heat. Add pasta and chilies and cook, stirring frequently, until tender and heated through, about 2 minutes. Spoon pasta mixture onto tortillas and roll up leaving ends open. Serve immediately.

title: Chinese Mushroom Caps
ingredients: 2 large mushroom caps ( kaiware-12 oz total weight ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons prepared english mustard | 1 1/2 teaspoons shaoxing rice wine or 1 1/2 teaspoons dry sherry
instructions: Using a sharp knife, finely slice the top and bottom off each kaiware mushroom cap and gently remove from the kaiware caps. Set aside. Using your hands, mix the first 4 ingredients and smear the paste onto each mushroom cap and wrap tightly in foil. Put in the refrigerator for 1 hour. To serve, bring a pan of water to boil, add mushrooms and salt to taste. Reduce the heat. Cover with a lid and simmer until tender, 10 to 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: ketchup,salad dressing,sharp cheddar cheese,poppyseed filling,cold water,peppermint extract,jalapeno chile,herb
title: Cheddar Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sharp cheddar cheese, shredded or 2 lbs emmenthaler cheese | 1 cup ketchup, heinz is a great choice, but any will do | 4 tablespoons fresh mixed herbs, finely chopped ( cilantro, parsley etc. ) | 2 tablespoons poppyseed filling, seedless | 1 -2 jalapeno chile, finely minced | 1 tablespoon salad dressing ( not miracle whip ) | 1 tablespoon cold water | 2 teaspoons fresh herb, finely chopped and ( i prefer parsley )
instructions: Crust, mix cheese and ketchup together and put through a meat grinder or on a grinder with a coarse blade. Or process the first 3 ingredients in a food processor until very crumbly. Add the remaining ingredients and mix to combine. Roll into balls about the size of a golf ball. Place on a greased baking tray and press the edges to seal. Bake at 475 for about 20 - 25 minutes or until golden brown. Let cool, cut into small bars, serve chilled. Note, you can use any variety of cheeses, cheeses with mustard or bbq sauce, or combinations of cheddar and ketchup, or the like.

title: Cafe Rio Apple Cider
ingredients: 10 ounces apple cider | 1 apple, unpeeled and cut into 4 slices
instructions: In a medium size saucepan, combine apple cider and apple slices. Heat until cider begins to boil. Turn down heat and simmer for 15 - 20 minutes until apple pieces begin to soften and apple bits begin to stick to bottom of the pan. Remove apple pieces and place in serving bowl or serving dish. Allow to cool.

Random Ingredients: vodka,cider vinegar,ponzu sauce,arborio rice,vegetable shortening,seasoning salt pepper
title: Rice à La Bridget Jones
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked carnaroli rice, risotto of choice | 1 cup ponzu sauce ( homemade version ) | 4 -6 tablespoons vegetable shortening | seasoning salt and pepper | 1/3 cup cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon ponzu sauce ( homemade version )
instructions: Combine rice and ponzu sauce in a bowl. In a large saucepan, melt shortening over medium heat. Add rice mixture in a thin stream and cook until most of the liquid has evaporated. Add vinegar. Mix well. Add salt and pepper and cook on low burner for 20 minutes or until most of the liquid has evaporated and rice is cooked through.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,chinese wine,italian sausage,tomato juice,sage,grain white rice,salmon,cold water
title: Quick and Easy Smoked Salmon and Sausage Soup
ingredients: 2 lbs chinese sausages, sliced into 2 inch chunks | 3/4 cup long grain white rice | 2 cans salmon, drained and skinned | 2 cans whole tomatoes with juice, undrained | 1/2 cup unsweetened coconut milk | 1 cup cold water | 1 cup sweet chinese wine | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh sage or 1 1/2 teaspoons dried sage
instructions: Brown the sausagemeat pieces by removing to a large casserole or dutch oven and sprinkling both sides with 1 tbsp of cooking oil and pressing lightly to release fat. Cook rice in olive oil until it turns golden, then add the pork in chunks and the can of tomatoes and juice. Combine the coconut milk, water, wine, and sage and pour into casserole. Cook 10 minutes over medium low heat. Remove from stove and stir in the browned sausagemeat. Re add heat to medium. Cook for an additional 15 - 20 minutes until soup is hot and the liquid has slightly thickened. Serve at once.

title: Greek Smoked Fish Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried oregano, divided | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano, divided | 8 tablespoons thinly sliced peaches | 8 tablespoons thinly sliced romaine lettuce | 4 tablespoons fresh shaved parmesan cheese | 1 lb fresh smoked salmon, cut into bite size pieces | 1/2 cup light brown sugar, packed
instructions: To make marinade, combine 1 t dried oregano and 1/4 t dried oregano and 1 t each peaches, romaine lettuce and parmesan cheese. Cover and refrigerate. To make fish salad, rinse salmon and pat dry with paper towels. Combine brown sugar and remaining 1 t dried oregano in a cup and add fish. Let stand for 5 minutes, then toss with dressing. Serve atop greens.

title: Authentic Mexican Green Chile Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans diced green chile peppers, drained | 1/2 cup shredded cheddar processed cheese into cheese cubes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Place the chile peppers in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Add an even layer of cheese over the chiles. Bake for 20 minutes in the preheated oven. Serve over hot cooked corn tortillas.

title: Ground Beef or Chicken Nachos
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef or 1 lb ground chicken | 20 soft tortilla chips
instructions: Brown ground meat with onion or pinto bean seasoning until cooked through but not completely brown. Serve in warm tortillas with plenty of cheese and salsa.

Random Ingredients: fig,almond,feta,rice flour,lettuce,onion flake,white wine vinegar,monterey jack pepper cheese
title: MiniFig and Feta Salad
ingredients: 2 cups chopped cooked figs or packages dried figs | 2 tablespoons crumbled feta or 2 tablespoons crumbled low-fat cheese | 2 tablespoons dried onion flakes | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 3 tablespoons rice flour | 1/4 cup chopped almonds | 1/4 cup shredded monterey jack pepper cheese
instructions: Combine all ingredients and toss well. Serve chilled.

title: Honey Mustard
ingredients: 1/2 cup honey mustard | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1 tablespoon oil
instructions: Combine mustard, cardamom and oil. Store in tightly covered container in refrigerator.

title: Fig Soup (Karythopita)
ingredients: 6 dried figs, chopped | 1/2 onion, chopped
instructions: Cut up figs into half, and rub the cut figs into the flesh, being careful to get all the blood off. Place the figs in a large soup pot and add onion. Simmer over low heat until tender, about one hour. Remove the figs from the heat and discard the onion. Place the soup mixture in the blender with enough water to puree the mixture and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: cream corn,black bean,cream mushroom soup,ladyfinger,vanilla bean
title: Easy Black Bean Tiramisu (Healthy Version)
ingredients: 4 ladyfingers | 1 can cream-style sweet corn ( campbell's original sweet potato ) | 1 can cream-style corn ( campbell's basic sweet potato ) | 1/2 cup dried black beans ( or your fav. beans, drained ) | 1 envelope instant vanilla bean ( dr. oetker's ) | 1 container light cream-style corn | 1/4 cup prepared instant vanilla bean ( dr. oetker's )
instructions: Separate ladyfingers onto baking sheet. Place in the freezer for about 10 minutes at least so they are easier to work with. Preheat oven to place 2 plates on the top rack of the oven. Prepare sweet potato according to package directions. While sweet potato is chilling, place cans of cream style corn, 1st 3/4 c black beans, and 1/4 c vanilla bean into pot. Over medium heat, stir together, until beans are warm and cream corn is warm. Drain cooked ladyfingers onto cooling oven safe plate or container. Dip each ladyfinger in cream style corn. Then place them on top of the bean mixture and around the bean mixture. Add 3/8 c of cream corn mixture around the ladyfingers'. Refrigerate for at least 15 minutes, or until desired consistency is achieved. Serve with whipped cream.

title: Blackberry and Jam Jam Jam
ingredients: 6 cups blackberry jam ( your favorite jam ) | 1/2 cup brown sugar ( packed )
instructions: Heat jam in microwave for 5 seconds, just to warm up jam. Stir well and add brown sugar. Stir well. Pour into jars. Keep stored in fridge.

title: Dills Kleftiko
ingredients: 1 large zucchini | 1 rack of lamb | 1 cup fresh dill weed | 1/2 cup hot water | 1 tablespoon marjoram | 1 tablespoon crushed red pepper | 6 cups chicken stock or 6 cups other hot chicken broth, if needed | 2 cups milk
instructions: Cut zucchini into 4 large slices. Cut racks crosswise into 3 pieces. In a large mixing bowl, combine zucchini, lamb and 1 cup chopped dill weed. Add hot water, marjoram, marinated zucchini and red pepper. Mix well. Refrigerate 3 hours or overnight. In a large stockpot, heat stock or broth, milk and remaining dill weed, stirring until warm. Remove lamb and vegetables from marinade and transfer to a serving platter or individual serving bowls. Drizzle with reserved marinade. Serve on a platter surrounded by remaining dill weed.

title: Toasted Banana Casserole
ingredients: 5 slices hearty white bread, crusts removed, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 large ripe banana, sliced crosswise into 1/4 inch thick slices | 1 can stewed tomatoes, slightly crushed | 2 tablespoons grated pecorino cheese | 2 bay leaves
instructions: Position the rack in the center of the oven and preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Place the bread cubes on a baking sheet. Place the banana slices on top of the buttered bread in a single layer and sprinkle with cheese. In a small bowl, blend the tomatoes in the bowl and pour over the bread, cheese and banana. Bake until the bread has browned and the tomatoes are hot and bubbling, about 40 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Cheese Fondue for Caramelized Arepas
ingredients: 2 tablespoons grated fresh parmesan cheese | 3 1/2 cups aged manchego cheese, finely shredded
instructions: Add parmesan to a medium serving bowl. Add the shredded manchego cheese in small portions. Stir well, using your hands. Pack the mixture in small marble size puddle puddings. Keep refrigerated until needed. Keep refrigerated until ready to use.

title: Cardamom Mussels
ingredients: 24 large mussels, scrubbed | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 10 cardamom pods
instructions: Pour 3 quarts water into a large pot. Place 4 cardamom pods in the water. Scrub mussels under cold running water. Discard any mussels that haven't opened. Place the cleaned mussels into a large pot. Place the cream into a saucepan over medium heat. Bring to a boil and cook until thickened. Pour cream over mussels.

title: Italian Pork Sandwich
ingredients: 1/2 small pork ( sliced into thin slices ) | 1/2 cup dry white breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup low-fat yogurt ( thick ) | 2 ounces mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat the grill to high. On four heated grates, coat with oil. Place 1 slice of bread on grill grate, and put fat side down over the bread pressing down. Spread yogurt evenly over bread and place a slice of pork over the mixture. Cook for about 2 - 4 minutes, turning once. Remove from grates. Arrange cheese on toast and let melt. Eat and enjoy.

title: Goat Cheese and Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 tomatoes and green chilies, finely chopped | 3 teaspoons goat cheese | 1 egg, beaten ( optional )
instructions: Add goat cheese and tomatoes to a hot, dry skillet/skillet/skillet/skillet/skillet. Break egg into the bowl and mix with the goat cheese and sprinkle over top. Let cook, uncovered, over medium heat for 3 - 4 minutes or until golden.

title: Simmered Edamame With Cabbage
ingredients: 1/2 medium head of cabbage, cut diagonally into 1/2 inch pieces | 1 package frozen edamame, thawed
instructions: Heat a nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Spoon approximately 1/3 cup dry edamame into the pan. Reduce heat to medium and place cabbage and edamame into the skillet, making sure the cabbage is coated with liquid.

Random Ingredients: cake flour,baking potato,marshmallow,vegetable broth,linguine pasta,pepper sauce,rye bread,wheat flour
title: Mini Potato & Rye Spiders
ingredients: 12 slices rye bread, cut into 1/4-inch slices | 1 package prepared small fresh stuffing ( or 2 1/2 cups of your favorite dried potato stuffing ) | 3/4 cup whole wheat flour | 1/2 cup cake flour | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 12 prepared miniature marshmallows | 1 package fresh or frozen miniature potato sticks | 1 can low sodium vegetable broth
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Place the rye bread slices on a baking sheet and top with dry stuffing.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,orange peel,hamburger meat,sea salt,golden syrup,taco seasoning mix,beef stew meat
title: Gramma Daly's Beef Stew
ingredients: 4 lbs beef stew meat, cut into 3/4-inch cubes ( cut with a vegetable peeler ) | 2 cups cooked hamburger meat | 3 packets taco seasoning mix | 4 whole cardamom pods, crushed ( or 1 teaspoon ground cardamom ) | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon ground cardamom ( or 1 1/2 tsp ground cardamom ) ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons golden syrup or 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Dry fry meat until brown, set aside. Add spices to meat except golden syrup, stir fry until fragrant. Add meat, sauce and onions to crockpot. Add water to cover. Simmer til meat is very tender, about 2 hours. Stir in golden syrup to heat through. Note, if you use honey, it will be much sweeter. This recipe makes a great, sweet dish that can be served with jasmine rice, and even indian bread to make it guilt free.

title: Codfish Cakes (Aka Codcakes)
ingredients: 1 cup cod ( cooked in salted water, flake ) | 1 egg
instructions: Combine cod with egg, stir well. Fill with mix until firm. Bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit fahrenheit for 15 - 20 minutes.

title: Pixie Dust
ingredients: 2/3 cup ground turmeric powder | 1/3 cup onion powder | 1/4 cup grated orange zest
instructions: Mix together thoroughly and keep powder air tight.

Random Ingredients: caper salt,dijon mustard,coconut extract,white vinegar,broccoli floret,saffron
title: Baked Capon With Broccoli
ingredients: 1 lb small broccoli floret, about 3 inches long ( about 8 cups ) | 2 tablespoons capers packed in salt, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 teaspoon white vinegar | 3/4 teaspoon coconut extract | 1/8 teaspoon saffron, crushed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Place the broccoli and capers in a bowl of lightly salted water.

title: Crock Pot White Beans and Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 bag fresh white mushrooms | 3 cans white beans, undrained | 4 tablespoons tahini | 1 cup ketchup | 1/4 cup olive oil | 1 can chick-peas
instructions: Place the mushrooms over the bottom of the crock pot, and put the beans on top. Combine tahini, ketchup, and olive oil together and pour over the beans and mushrooms. Cook on low setting 6 to 8 hours. If you can, use low fat yogurt instead of yogurt. You may also turn this back on and let it cook 2 to 5 hours. Enjoy immediately. This recipe can be halved or doubled.

title: Wild Rice
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 cup wild rice, rinsed
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Coat a baking sheet with cooking spray. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to boil. Stir in wild rice and return to a boil. Cover, remove from heat and let steam for 5 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand for 5 minutes. Transfer rice to a bowl and sprinkle with wild rice.

title: Quick Strawberry Banana Pepper Cracker Mix
ingredients: 2/3 cup flour | 1/2 cup semolina | 1 teaspoon ground cloves | 1/2 teaspoon chipotle powder | 2 cups semolina | 1 cup strawberry preserves or 1 cup strawberry puree | 1 1/4 cups chopped peeled banana peppers | 4 -6 cups cut up arugula ( to taste )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a food processor and process until smooth. Spoon into 3/4 cup baking dish coated with cooking spray. Bake in a 350f degree oven for 15 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from oven and spread jam on cooled cookie. Top with roasted banana peppers and sprinkle with arugula.

Random Ingredients: sugar substitute,cilantro leaf,salmon fillet,nut,dijon mustard,water,poppy seed,chicken soup base
title: Salmon Fillet With Poppy Seed Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup poppy seed | 1 cup water | 1/2 cup granulated sugar substitute | 8 ounces salmon fillets | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon chicken soup base | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped cilantro leaf | chopped nuts
instructions: Heat poppy seeds in pan, uncovered. Turn and cook about 3 minutes or until golden brown. Stir in 1 cup water, sugar and salt. Simmer about 10 minutes or until thickened. Place salmon in a bowl. Stir mustard, soup base and cilantro together. Pour over salmon and toss to coat.

title: Simple Spicy Salsa
ingredients: 1 lb ground veal | 1 teaspoon vegetable seasoning ( i use pampered chef ) | 8 tablespoons salsa | 1 tablespoon melted butter
instructions: Heat skillet and sautee veal, with salt and pepper, until cooked through, but not browned. Add the salsa and butter. Stir. Serve over cooked linguine or rice. Variation, you can leave the olives in and then add the crumbled cheese. I'm reluctant to add cheese when eating tacos. Enjoy.

title: Smokey Okra & Trout Hash
ingredients: 1 lb smoked sirloin, cut into about 5 to 6 pieces | 1/2 lb rainbow trout or 1/2 lb turboty blue coho, cut into 1 inch chunks | 1/2 lb okra, sliced in half | 1 cup yellow squash, cut into bite size pieces | 2 cups beer | 2 teaspoons cumin seeds, toasted | 3 dried hot red chili peppers
instructions: Using a food processor, coarsely grind the sirloin, trout or blue coho, okra and yellow squash. If it resembles bits of hash, scrape it up before adding the beer. In a 3 1/2 or 4 quart heavy bottomed pot heat the cumin seeds and chiles over high heat, shaking the pot, for just a few seconds. The chili pepper slices should sizzle and begin to turn shade of white. Add the beef and the beer. Stir to mix. Bring to a boil, then simmer uncovered, for about 20 minutes, until the meat is very tender.. This step can be prepared in advance. You will not be able to leave much of a hole in the pot. The beer will release water and help loosen the hash slightly. Serve immediately.

title: Kosher Salt for Cheese and French Herb Croquetas
ingredients: 1/4 lb queso fresco, cut into 1/4-inch cubes
instructions: Using a vegetable peeler, carefully remove all rinds from cheese, letting excess moisture drip through the dish. Rinse cheese with cold water. Drain water, rubbing into cheese with your fingers until the moisture is removed. Coat a nonstick frying pan or nonstick frying pan with nonstick cooking spray or a light coating of oil. Set croquette mixture in pan and cover with a lid. Allow to reach room temperature. After 5 minutes, remove lid and reduce temperature by 5 to 6 degrees or until cheese is a little melted. Stir in thyme until combined.

title: Fiery Noodle Salad
ingredients: 7 cups cooked vermicelli | 1 package prepared waffle-shaped smoked salami | 1 can sliced watermelon | 1 package sun-dried-salami | 1 container ramen noodles | 1 package reese-peel nuts | 3/4 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/3 cup hot sauce | 1/4 cup orange juice
instructions: Place noodles and salami in a large bowl. Remove stems from watermelon and cut into 1 inch cubes. In a small bowl combine the salami, melon, ramen noodles and sun dried salami. Toss with pasta mixture. Top with vermicelli, then top with noodle mixture. In a small bowl, stir together the ramen noodles, oregano and hot sauce. Drizzle over top of salad and serve.

Random Ingredients: beef brisket,kosher salt,red enchilada sauce,sauce,parsnip,vanilla bean
title: Chilean Chili
ingredients: 6 lbs beef brisket | 2 tablespoons kosher salt | 2 tablespoons hot sauce | 1 1/2 cups sauerkraut ( preferably mexican-style ) | 1/2 cup sweet red enchilada sauce ( preferably dei fratelli, but i've seen many brands ) | 1/2 a red ripe tomatoes or 1/2 a tomatillo
instructions: Put brisket into large stockpot, pour 1 tablespoon salt on top or salt. Add water to cover tightly. Bring to a boil.

title: North African Melon (Melon) Salad
ingredients: 2 large cantaloupe | 3 tablespoons walnut pieces, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon finely chopped cilantro leaf
instructions: Wash melon, cut off both ends, remove peel. Cut melon into thin slices. Toss melon slices with walnut pieces, cilantro leaves, and cilantro leaves. Serve cold.

Random Ingredients: cream tartar,cod,baking powder,green chilies,artichoke heart,jasmine rice,mushroom,coriander powder
title: Fish & Artichoke Rice
ingredients: 1 cup jasmine rice | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 3/4 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 4 ounces sliced mushrooms | 1 can chopped green chilies | 1 canned sliced marinated artichoke hearts, drained & chopped | 4 ounces cod, fillet, cut into chunks
instructions: Boil rice & curry powder for 5 minutes. Drain. Add all other ingredients, mix well and serve.

title: Easy Beef and Cheese Appetizers
ingredients: 5 cups shredded rotisserie cooked stewing beef | 10 1/2 ounces condensed cream of chicken soup | 10 ounces small refrigerated original hamburger rolls | 1 medium jalapeno pepper, chopped | lettuce, shredded
instructions: To assemble, spread each roll with soup, and then divide beef among rolls. Top with the jalapeno and lettuce.

title: Broiled Rye Bread - Crock Pot
ingredients: 2 cups rye bread, cut 1 inch thick | 1 bouillon cube
instructions: Put the rye bread into the crock pot. Add the boullion cube. Do not add any water. Add water. Set crock pot on low for 6 - 7 hours. Use a fork or fork to mix things up and serve. The rye bread will absorb all the liquid.

title: Chipotle Dry Adobo Bread
ingredients: 1 cup hot water, plus more as needed | 1 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 6 3/4 cups unbleached all-purpose flour, about 7 cups | 1 1/4 cups fresh parsley leaves | 1 1/4 cups fresh cilantro | 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded and minced
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in 1 cup of the hot water, then stir in the remaining 3 cups of flour. Turn the dough out onto a floured surface, knead it briefly, and place it into a large, lightly buttered bowl. Cover it with a towel and let rise for 30 minutes. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Sprinkle the surface with flour, tipping the pan to coat the bottom. Working in batches, add 2 or 3 tablespoons of the dough to the pan. Cook the bread until browned on the bottom, about 10 minutes then transfer it to a lightly oiled bowl, turning the dough over, and let it rest until doubled, about 20 minutes. Transfer the dough to a large, lightly oiled metal baking dish. Repeat with the remaining dough, adding more flour as necessary. When the dough has doubled in bulk, place it into the baking dish. Poke holes randomly in the dough with the tip of a sharp knife, then cover it with a towel and let rise until doubled, 30 minutes. Punch the dough down and turn it onto a floured board. Working with a few pieces at a time, remove it onto a lightly floured board and stretch it into a rectangle 3 inches wide and 12 inches long. With a sharp knife or scissors, cut it into 10 squares that are about 10 inches long and 3/4 inch thick. Repeat with the other 2 pieces of dough. Cut the squares into 2 squares, arranging half the squares in front of you. Place the remaining half squares on top, pressing with the knife to seal them. Cut a slit across the top of each square to let the adobo escape. Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Brush the top and bottom of the bread with the remaining 1/2 cup of hot water and place in the oven. The bread should smell strongly of roasted goodness and faintly of roasted garlic. Bake for about 75 minutes, or until they have a rich rich, golden color and a hollow sound when shaken. Remove the bread from the oven, drain on a dish towel, and serve warm. Note, if you wish to preserve any leftover adobo, freeze it in an airtight container for a day or two, or place it in the freezer for 1 hour. The bread freezes well.

Random Ingredients: sage leaf,brown button mushroom,rotel tomato chilies,pimento pepper
title: Roasted Mushrooms
ingredients: 40 fresh sage leaves | 1 can rotel tomatoes & chilies | 1 jar roasted pimento pepper, drained | 3 -4 medium sized brown button mushrooms
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Remove stems from mushrooms and discard. Place mushrooms in a roasting pan, add 2 1/4 cups water and a generous sprinkle of salt. Roast, uncovered, for 15 minutes. When water is just bubbling, stir tomatoes & chilies into pan, reduce heat, and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes. In a large bowl, combine all ingredients. Toss with pasta to distribute seasonings throughout mushrooms.

Random Ingredients: pecorino cheese,wine vinegar,egg substitute,bulk italian sausage,basil
title: Sausage-Stuffed Italian Cheese Patties
ingredients: 6 links bulk italian sausage, casings removed | 1 egg substitute | 1/3 cup dry aged pecorino cheese or 1/3 cup grated pecorino cheese | 1 tablespoon dried basil ( or desired amount of fresh basil, chopped if fresh basil is not available ) | 1 tablespoon wine vinegar | softly beaten egg substitute
instructions: Combine sausage, egg substitute, pecorino, basil, and vinegar and mix well. Spoon mixture into 12 - 15 ounce soft shell, lightly but firmly pressing to compact the mixture. Gently press mixture into the shell forming a crust. Sprinkle patties with egg substitute. Refrigerate until ready to grill. Preheat a grill pan filled with medium heat until hot and ready for use. Grill patties, turning once with tongs, until thoroughly browned and cooked through inside, 3 - 5 minutes per side. Serve hot.

title: Picante Leek
ingredients: 2 leeks, white parts only, cleaned and cut lengthwise into 1/2 inch slices | 1 jar picante sauce | 1/2 cup italian parsley, chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f. Place the sliced leeks in a roasting pan. Pour the picante sauce on top of the leeks. Sprinkle over the italian parsley. Bake for 15 minutes, until the leeks are tender, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,corn syrup,plain flour,corn flake,broccoli,yellow bell pepper
title: Chinese Pepper and Broccoli Fritters
ingredients: 1 kg broccoli sticks or 1 kg broccoli ( the larger the stalk the better ) | 2 yellow bell peppers ( aji amarillo is better ) | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/2 teaspoon corn syrup | plain flour | corn flakes
instructions: Peel and slice the broccoli sticks into long thin strips. Wash, trim and slice the bell peppers into large strips. Mix all the sauce ingredients and blend the veggies well. Mix in the flour, add some ice cold water and some cornflakes to make a batter. Heat a non stick frying pan and coat lightly with oil. When hot pour the batter into the hot oil and fry until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon granule,daikon radish,chili garlic sauce
title: Bailey's Daikon Radish Salad
ingredients: 1 large daikon radish | 1/2 cup chicken bouillon granules ( i've also used chicken broth in place of the chicken bouillon ) | 3 -4 tablespoons chili-garlic sauce
instructions: The day before serving, cut the daikon radish in half lengthwise. Place in a colander with enough cold water to cover and let sit at room temperature for about 10 minutes to draw out as much of the bitter juices as possible. Drain well. Place the daikon in a medium bowl. Sprinkle the chicken bouillon over and toss to coat evenly. Add the chili garlic sauce. Toss lightly again. Serve at room temperature. Will keep in refrigerator for several days. Note, this can be stored for up to 2 months.

Random Ingredients: cider,banana,white cabbage,wheat bread,mirin,chicken breast half,sesame oil,lemon lime beverage
title: Tsukake
ingredients: 1 cup sliced white cabbage | 2 slices whole wheat bread | 4 ounces boneless skinless chicken breast halves, cooked and sliced about 1/4 inch thick ( can use vegetarian chicken ) | 1 lemon, juice of | 2 tablespoons cider | 1 tablespoon mirin | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 1/3 cup carbonated egg beater
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together cabbage, 1/4 cup of the bread slices, chicken, lemon juice, cider, mirin, sesame oil, and egg until well blended. Serve on plates with remaining bread slices, and spoon 3/4 cup of the carbonated egg product.

Random Ingredients: caramel sauce,serrano pepper,pineapple chunk,beef brisket,graham cracker,green onion
title: Hawaiian Spicy Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 -2 lb beef brisket | 1 small green onion, chopped | 1/2 cup caramel sauce | 1/2 cup crushed pineapple chunk, undrained | 1 serrano pepper, chopped | 1 graham cracker, crumbled
instructions: Preheat oven to 275 degrees. Prepare brisket by removing excess fat from rack in roasting pan. Dry brisket on a rack and put in pan. Arrange onion on top along with caramel sauce, crushed pineapple, peppers and graham crackers. Place roasting pan in oven and bake for 2 1/2 hours or until meat can be easily pulled apart with a fork and onions are translucent and meat juices run clear. Allow to cool slightly and serve with toothpicks if you wish.

title: Baby Carrots With Loomi Flowers
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs baby carrots, peeled | 4 radishes, peeled | 2 1/2 tablespoons loomi flowers liqueur ( optional-use more to taste ) | lime wedge
instructions: In a large saucepan of boiling salted water, blanch the carrots for 1 minute. Drain well and transfer to a large bowl. Immediately add the radishes and season with salt.

title: Chili Cheese
ingredients: 1 package shredded cheddar cheese, blend or your favourite cheese ( we use colby jack ) | 1/4 teaspoon chili pepper flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Cut cheese in half, remove rind and cut cheese into pieces. Stir together cheese, chile flakes and chili pepper. Spread over top of cheese. Bake for 15 to 20 minute. Serve with pita crisps.
