title: Spicy Almond Paste
ingredients: 2 teaspoons chili paste | 3/4 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Stir together chili paste and almond extract.

title: Chinese Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti | 1 tablespoon chili-garlic sauce
instructions: Start by starting to boil the water for the pasta. Cook the spaghetti according to the directions on the package. Meanwhile, heat up some soy sauce in a small pan. Drain the spaghetti and add it to the soy sauce and chili garlic sauce. Mix together and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,egg noodle,double cream,green chili pepper,catsup
title: Chicken Noodle Casserole (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 3/4 lb egg noodles | 2 green chili peppers, sliced | 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves ( about 1 pound each ) | 1/3 cup catsup | 1/3 cup double cream
instructions: Brown chicken in a nonstick pan sprayed with cooking spray. Place in the crockpot/slow cooker. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cover and cook on low for 5 hours or on high for 2 1/2 to 3 hours. Remove chiles. Cut chicken into bite size pieces.

Random Ingredients: garlic paste,hard egg,hazelnut,roast,chinese five spice powder,pear,white peppercorn
title: Roast Chicken With Spices
ingredients: 1 kg turkey roast, whole skinned or 1 kg lamb, sliced lengthways into 8 pieces or 1 kg lamb shank | 200 g chinese five spice powder | 250 g raw hazelnuts | 100 g raw pears, chopped | 50 g mixed hard-boiled eggs, grated | 4 tablespoons garlic paste | 10 hard-boiled eggs
instructions: Rub spice mix onto chicken. Set aside while preparing the garnishes & eggs. Place hazelnuts & pears on a tray & roast for 30mins at 160°c. Set aside to cool. When the chicken has cooled, place 1/2 the pears & 1/2 the hardboiled eggs in a pan with 100ml water & cook in the meantime. Remove the chicken from the pan & slice into 8 pieces. Place 1/2 the hazelnuts and remaining hardboiled eggs in a food processor with a little seasoning and process to a fairly fine puree. Stir the hazelnuts & hardboiled eggs on top of the turkey, cover tightly & refrigerate until required. Remove the turkey from the refrigerator & arrange the stuffing on top of the turkey, drizzle with the remaining olive oil & sprinkle with the garlic paste. Garnish with the hard boiled eggs, if desired. Serve immediately.

title: Applebee's Easy Chicken Noodle Bowls
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked rice | 8 boneless chicken thighs | 1 3/4 cups sweetened applesauce | 2 packages spaghetti or ( 16 ounce ) packages vermicelli
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. If you have a 13x9 inch baking dish, set aside. In a large bowl, place brown rice, chicken thighs, applesauce and noodles. Toss until well mixed and evenly coated. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour, or longer. Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Heat until hot in oven, about 10 minutes. Note, if you can smell the aroma from the applebee's, do not stir.

Random Ingredients: dill weed,chinese five spice powder,guinness stout,dark roast coffee,no salt tomato sauce,sesame paste,cornmeal
title: Smokey Barbecue Corn Bread (Bodacious Bar-B-Q Chicken)
ingredients: 1 can guinness stout ( can use other dark beer, but not recommended ) | 1/4 cup tomato sauce | 1 teaspoon sesame paste | 1 tablespoon chinese five spice powder | 1 teaspoon black pepper | 1 dash dill weed, to taste | 1 cup cornmeal, fine
instructions: Preheat grill to medium. Combine everything and blend thoroughly, adding flour as needed, but not too much as the mixture will be sticky. Pour into a pan and bake in the oven at 350f for 30 - 45 minutes until thoroughly browned and firm to the touch. Serve hot from grilling pan, drizzled with extra smokey barbecue sauce, dipping chicken slices in sauce, etc. This recipe may also be made using beer instead of your preferred recipe.

title: Bahia's Best Ever Pork Hocks
ingredients: 2 tablespoons canola oil, or more as needed | 1 turkey pork hocks | 2 pounds snow peas | 1 pound peeled and thinly sliced apples | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh rosemary, or more to taste | 1/2 teaspoon dried asafoetida | 1 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 teaspoon canola oil for frying
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon canola oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Brown the hocks on both sides in hot oil, without crowding, 5 to 7 minutes per side. Transfer the steaks to a paper towel lined plate and set aside. Add 1 more tablespoon canola oil to the pan.

title: Easy leek & Date Soup
ingredients: 2 teaspoons leeks, washed and chopped ( white part only ) | 2 1/2 cups chicken stock ( low-fat, low fat or low-sodium chicken broth ) | 1 tablespoon fat free dates syrup ( optional )
instructions: Place the chopped leeks in a colander, pour over boiling water to cover, and leave to soak for about an hour. Place the celery stalks in a bowl & add the stock & dates syrup, if using. Pour the mixture into a pan, bring to the boil, then simmer for about 2 minutes, before removing from the heat & allow to rest for 3 - 5 minutes. Serve hot. Note, the soup can be frozen for up to a month, then reheat in a microwave for about 5 - 7 minutes, before adding to the hot soup.

Random Ingredients: red miso,leg lamb,baby spinach,sun tomato oil,rice wine vinegar,feta cheese,chicken breast
title: Skillet Lamb and Spinach
ingredients: 7 lamb, thighs | 5 ounces feta cheese, crumbled | 7 ounces baby spinach, packed coarsely chopped | 4 ounces sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained and coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons red miso | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons roasted sweet baby cos into garlic infused miso
instructions: Spray nonstick skillet with vegetable oil spray, heat, add the chicken and cook 2 minutes per side, until browned. Remove chicken from skillet, and cook the other side. Toss the feta, baby spinach, sun dried tomatos, red miso paste, rice wine vinegar and roasted garlic in a bowl to combine.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,veal,baby spinach,chunky salsa,herb,cilantro stem,tart apple
title: Quick and Easy Turkey and Spinach Salad
ingredients: 1 pound ground turkey | 1 cup finely chopped tart apple | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh mixed herbs | 4 ounces fresh baby spinach | 1/4 cup chunky salsa | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro stems | 4 salmon fillets
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Place turkey in a large, deep skillet. Cook over medium high heat until evenly brown.

Random Ingredients: thai basil,cumin powder,stout beer,broiler fryer chicken
title: Thai Beer Can Chicken
ingredients: 1 broiler-fryer chicken | 1/2 cup thai basil | 1 tablespoon cumin powder | 2 bottles st. james's texas style beer
instructions: Rinse chicken and pat dry. Combine basil and cumin in a bowl. Set aside. Dredge chicken in basil mixture. Set aside. Place beer canner or coals into canner. Cover and cook chicken on high 30 seconds to 1 minute.

Random Ingredients: black bean,clove,ginger root,porcini mushroom,salt pork,avocado,marsala wine
title: Champignon a La Marsala (Seared Black Beans)
ingredients: 1 can black beans | 2 cups finely chopped fresh porcini mushrooms | 2 slices fresh ginger root, coarsely chopped | 1 piece salt pork, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup dry marsala wine | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped fresh ginger root | 1/8 teaspoon cloves, divided | 1 avocado - peeled, pitted and diced
instructions: Open black beans and place in a bowl. Cover with cold water.

title: Cabbage
ingredients: 1 head red cabbage, cut into thin strips | 3 large red apples, cored and diced | 1/4 cup dried currant
instructions: In a large bowl, combine cabbage, apples, and currants. Toss to coat, then chill before serving.

title: Mascarpone and Mascarpone Pastries
ingredients: 500 g mascarpone cheese, drained and room temperature | 1 tablespoon plain flour | 1 tablespoon soft plain flour | 1 stalk celery, including leaves, finely chopped | 1/4 cup mascarpone cheese, extra
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c or 400°f. To make mascarpone, blend mascarpone, flour and stalks into the mascarpone until well combined, then divide into 4 pieces. Form 2 small, flat, flat discs from each piece of dough, and place them on a baking tray lined with baking paper. Bake in the centre of the oven for 15 to 20 minutes, or until cooked through. Keep warm until ready to serve. To serve, scoop out portions of pastry, and place a mound of mascarpone on top of each, then drizzle with extra mascarpone, sprinkle with a little grated parmesan and more chopped celery. Serve immediately.

title: Onion Chucks
ingredients: 1 bag chocolate chips | 1 onion, chopped
instructions: Combine the chocolate chips and chopped onion in a bowl. Melt in the microwave or in a pot, stirring every so often until melted, about 2 minutes. Pour the melted chocolate mixture into wax paper, roll into balls, and either freeze or place on wax or plastic wrap and put in a freezer bag. Serve and enjoy.

title: Smoky Beef N'dizi Rolls
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 lb extra lean ground beef | 1/2 package frozen okra | 1 -2 tablespoon red curry paste, as desired | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon cayenne powder | 4 tortillas ( i use la victoria brand for this roll ) | 1 ounce smoked salmon ( use your favourite hot roll ) or 1 ounce salmon ( use your favourite hot roll )
instructions: Prepare the grill or oven by adding grill rack to grill pan and preheat to 200' f, 230' c or 220' if using an outdoor grill. While grill is heating up, cut the okra into 3/4 inch wide strips, cook in hot water until just barely tender. Drain well, and put aside. Meanwhile, heat up the curry paste in a pan for 1 minute. Add okra, mix well, then add 1 tablespoon curry paste, and pinch of red cayenne. Mix well. If the okra is not coated with sauce, just cook a few minutes longer. Split each tortilla into 3 - 6 pieces. Place a portion of spam mix near the center of the tortilla. Roll it up tightly so that there are no gaps. Brush roll with oil, and place seam side down on an oiled baking sheet. Brush tops with a little extra oil. Place finished rolls, seam side down, on baking sheet in the oven. After 20 minutes, remove from the oven, and brush with curry sauce. Return to the oven about 15 minutes longer. Remove from the oven, and serve from the baking sheet.

title: Crock Pot Mediterranean Beef
ingredients: 1 filet of beef, trimmed | 1/2 - 1 cup oregano leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Score the meat with a sharp knife, making diamond shaped cuts across the meat. Place the beef fat side up on a rack of a large baking dish, cover with a lid, and let marinate in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour, turning and rearranging the beef several times until it is done. Add the oregano just a few minutes before you are ready to serve and heat in the oven, for about 7 to 10 minutes or until slightly dried out. Serve on a bed of lettuce for a nice rustic look.

Random Ingredients: orange juice,water chestnut,large shrimp,chicken stock vegetable
title: Sizzlin' Shrimp Cocktail
ingredients: 1 lb large shrimp, peeled, deveined and tails on | 1 cup chicken stock or 1 cup vegetable stock | 1/4 cup orange juice | 1 can cream-style water chestnuts, drained and rinsed
instructions: Bring stock to boil in a heavy bottomed skillet over high heat. Reduce heat to medium. Add shrimp and cook, stirring, just until they turn pink. Stir in orange juice and water chestnuts. Serve hot.

title: Noodles - Microwave Version
ingredients: 4 ounces rice noodles | 1 lime, quartered | 1 tablespoon soggy seasoning salt | 1/2 cup sultana | 4 ounces sake
instructions: Put the rice noodles aside for at least 5 minutes so they dont get overdone. Mix everything, except the soggy seasoning salt, in a microwave safe jug. Put in the microwave for 15 minutes if required, but no longer if you want to cook them longer. Stir half way through cooking.

title: Spicy Pepperoni Salad (Diabetic)
ingredients: 8 ounces pepperoni, chopped | 1/3 cup fat free sour cream | 1/3 cup nonfat sour cream | 3 tablespoons vinegar | 1 cup broccoli floret, chopped ( optional ) | 1/3 cup fat-free cream
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl and refrigerate until well blended.

title: Vietnamese-Style Pork and Shiitake Mushrooms Wrapped in Banana Pepper Wrap
ingredients: 1 package smoked pork sausage, sliced | 1 can sliced shiitake mushrooms, drained and finely chopped | 4 flour tortillas | banana pepper, slices for topping ( optional )
instructions: Stir sausage and mushrooms together in a medium non stick skillet over medium/high heat until pork is partially cooked. Add banana pepper during the last few minutes of cooking to heat. Add a few tablespoons of water and continue to cook until sauce is slightly reduced and mushrooms are tender. Serve with your favorite condiments.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,cider vinegar,green peppercorn,part mozzarella cheese
title: Slow Cooker Barbecued Chicken
ingredients: 4 bone-in skinless chicken breast halves | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 1/3 cup chopped green peppercorn | 1/2 cup shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese
instructions: Place chicken breasts in the bottom of a slow cooker. In a small bowl, whisk together the cider vinegar, green peppercorns and a handful of the mozzarella cheese. Pour this mixture over the chicken and turn to coat evenly. Cover and cook on low setting for 10 to 12 hours, or on high setting for about 4 hours. Remove chicken pieces when they are tender, drain and reserve broth to serve over pasta and vegetables.

title: The Real Deal
ingredients: 1/2 cup apricot jam | 1/4 cup sweetened orange juice | 1/8 cup bourbon | 1 1/2 - 2 teaspoons fresh basil leaves
instructions: Mix jam up with orange juice in small serving bowl. Stir. Place in fridge, cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate until chilled. Stir. Garnish with basil.

Random Ingredients: ancho chile powder,vital wheat gluten,onion flake,cherry,currant,cocoa,buttermilk
title: Acho Chili Dogs With Ancho Chile (Spice Mix)
ingredients: 1 cup dried chile flakes | 1 1/4 cups boiling pitted cherries ( about 15 cut up sweet cherries ) | 1/2 ancho chile powder | 1/2 cup dried onion flakes | 1 1/3 cups quick-cooking buttermilk | 1 teaspoon cocoa | 1/2 teaspoon vital wheat gluten ( i used fleischmann's vegan, gluten free and fiber-free ) ( optional )
instructions: Soak chili flakes in boiling water until softened, about 5 minutes. Drain and reserve soaking liquid. Combine chili flakes with drained cherries in a small bowl.

title: Chepkee Rice
ingredients: 2 cups cooked long-grain rice | half-and-half cream | 1/2 cup honey | 1 small jalapone chile, minced
instructions: In a 3 to 4 quart crockpot, mix together rice, half and half, honey, jalapeno.

title: Pumpkin & Olive Raita
ingredients: 1 cup reduced-fat yogurt | 1/2 cup canned pumpkin puree, drained | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed | kalamata olive, to garnish | 1 tablespoon vodka
instructions: Place the yogurt, pumpkin purée, onion seeds & almonds in a food processor & blend until smooth. Stir in the vodka & pour into a shallow ceramic dish. Sprinkle evenly with the reserved yogurt mixture. Place the potato ricotta on top & refrigerate until thoroughly chilled & set, approximately 20 minutes or so.

Random Ingredients: nonfat milk,white wine vinegar,baking powder,red chilies,chicken thigh,beef stew meat,rice wine
title: Red Chile Braised Chicken
ingredients: 2 tablespoons rice wine | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground red chilies | 1 1/2 pounds boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 cup nonfat milk | 1/4 cup nonfat dry milk
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix rice wine, vinegar, baking powder and ground chiles in a large bowl. Add chicken pieces and toss to coat. Place chicken into 9x5x3 inch baking dish. Pour enough nonfat milk over chicken to cover. Bake in preheated oven for 55 to 60 minutes, or until chicken is no longer pink and juices run clear.

title: Rice Noodle with Pineapple
ingredients: 200 g dried rice noodles | 1 jar pineapple juice | 1 1/2 cups pure maple syrup or 1 1/2 cups tomato puree | 2 teaspoons white peppercorns, crushed
instructions: Soak rice noodles in hot water. Drain, then spread noodles out in a large saucepan of warm water. Bring to the boil and then reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, combine pineapple juice, syrup and crushed peppercorns in a pan and gently heat through over the lowest possible heat for 5 - 10 minutes, or until syrup is bubbling but not boiling. Drain the noodles and then stir into pineapple sauce. Remove from heat and serve, warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: butter,thai chili sauce,cheddar cheese,orange zest,black cardamom pod
title: Spiced Cheddar Cheese!
ingredients: 6 ounces cheddar cheese | 2 tablespoons butter | 5 -6 black cardamom pods, split | 1/2 medium sized orange, zest of | 2 teaspoons thai sweet chili sauce | 1 tablespoon thai sweet chili sauce
instructions: Cut the cheese into cubes and put into a frying pan with a little butter, cardamon pods and the chillies. Melt the remaining butter on low heat and add the cheese cubes and stir until it melts and begins to thicken slightly. Add the sauce and cook on low heat for about 3 minutes until the cheese has heated.

title: Caribbean Chicken Mole
ingredients: 1 cup mango juice, bottled ( i use the amber ) | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa ( i use dutch cocoa ) | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 2 -3 cups cubed challah | 1/2 cup finely chopped yellow squash ( the small squash kind ) | 2 -3 small boneless skinless chicken drumsticks | 1 leek, finely chopped | 1 small ripe mango, peeled, pitted and diced into 1/2 inch cubes | 3 -4 small ripe cantaloupe, seeded and diced into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 -2 teaspoon chopped fresh cilantro ( optional )
instructions: Put everything in a blender, cover and blend on high until smooth but with a little graininess. You have choices, you can serve it as is, or transfer it to a serving dish, cover and refrigerate for up to 1 week. This should hold at least one container of sauce. Serve in a bowl with a scoop of vanilla ice cream, and a bowl to dip in while slurping up the sauce. If the sauce is too thick, add a little water, but it should not become runny.

Random Ingredients: beef roast,tortilla,dijon mustard,butter,icing sugar,cardamom,beef bouillon granule,ra el hanout spice mix
title: Fantastic Beef Roast
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs beef roast | 1 package dijon mustard | 2 packets beef bouillon granules | 1/4 cup ra el hanout spice mix, ( or any seasoning blend ) | 1 teaspoon beef base or 1 teaspoon beef bouillon paste | 4 -5 tablespoons soft butter | 3 tablespoons icing sugar | couple shakes cardamom | 10 tortillas or 10 flour tortillas
instructions: Place meat in crock pot or roaster. Combine mustard, 1/2 of the bouillon granules and the ras el hanout in a bowl. Spread the dry mustard mixture on the top. Cut slits into the roast. Dot roast with butter. Add salt, pepper, and a drizzle of the rest of the bouillon granules to the rest of the ingredients. Stir. Pour over meat. Add remaining 1/2 of buillon granules. Cover roast with tin foil. Place in a cool place to let slow cook for at least 2 hours. Take from crock on to the table, cut the meat into strips or serve on toothpicks. I make the strips about the size of a swiss roll with the meat, usually about 12 long. Cut in two or three sections about 1 wide. Then slice those two pieces of meat into thin strips. You will be taking two pieces of meat that are about 8 wide and one slice. You can freeze the strips for a later meal, just put meat on the counter and cut the strips into slices and toss them in some plastic wrap.

title: Red Curry Strawberries
ingredients: 10 berry strawberries, halved | 1 tablespoon thai red curry paste ( or more if you wish ) | 1 - 1 1/4 cup lime-flavored tamari ( can also add soy sauce if desired ) | 1/2 cup salsa ( or other flavor of your choice )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Place the strawberries on a baking sheet & pour the curry paste onto each one. Smear it evenly with the lime flavoured tamari, coating the strawberries evenly. Serve immediately, or refrigerate for up to 1 day.

title: Chipotle Veal
ingredients: 2 cups chipotle chiles, with liquid | 1 cup white sugar | 3 pounds veal fat, cubed
instructions: Preheat an oven to 300 degrees f. Combine the chiles, chipotle liquid, and sugar in a large baking pan.

title: Ww Core Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 3/4 teaspoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: In a mixing bowl beat whipping cream with worcestershire and salt until soft peaks form. Add a little worcestershire to the cream to bind and dilute. Gradually mix in the cream. Refrigerate or serve.

title: Andouille and Smoked Sausage & Meatball Laundry
ingredients: 1 lb andouille sausage, casing removed | 1 2/3 cups frozen reduced-sodium frozen limeade concentrate, thawed and drained | 6 ounces frozen smoked meatballs, drained and lightly crushed | 6 teaspoons hot sauce | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 1/2 cups double cream | 1 1/2 tablespoons minced fresh chives
instructions: Combine sausage, limeade concentrate, meatballs, hot sauce, and salt in a 2 to 3 quart ceramic bowl. Cover bowl. Refrigerate overnight. Using 2 teaspoons per sausage, stir cream to loosen browned bits from the bottom, then discard. Remove from bowl. Divide cream among 6 dinner plates. Arrange 1 sausage and 3 meatballs atop cream. Sprinkle with chives. Place remaining cream in a small saucepan. Heat over moderately low heat, uncovered, until cream just begins to thicken, about 3 minutes. Set aside 2 teaspoons cream, then stir cream into sauce. Return cream to small saucepan with remaining sausage and meatballs. Cook over moderate heat, stirring, just until heated through, then transfer to plates. Serve sauce in individual dishes. Note, the sausage mixture can be made ahead to this point and refrigerated in an airtight baking pan for up to 3 days.

title: Italian Style Baked Spaghetti in the Crock Pot
ingredients: 1 lb dried orecchiette | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1/2 lb provolone cheese, cubed
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Cook spaghetti until al dente, approx 8 - 10 minutes. Drain. While pasta is cooking, mix baking soda, and cheese together in a small bowl. Dredge spaghetti in cheese mixture, then place in crock pot. Pour remaining sauce from crock pot over spaghetti and toss till coated. Top with extra cheese before serving.

Random Ingredients: cannellini bean,french bread,tamarind paste,spring onion,provolone cheese
title: Quick & Easy French Bean Casserole
ingredients: 4 slices country style french bread | 4 cups cannellini beans, drained and rinsed under cold water | 2 stalks spring onions, thinly sliced | 2 1/2 cups grated provolone cheese | 1 -2 teaspoon tamarind paste
instructions: Preheat oven to 190°c line a 2 1/2 cup ovenproof dish with baking paper and spray with oil. Layer the bread slices over the bottom of dish, then the beans, then half the spring onions. Combine the cheese and tamarind paste, then sprinkle evenly over the top. Bake in oven for 10 - 15 minutes, or until cheese starts to brown.

title: Earl's Baked Beet Appetizers
ingredients: 600 g cooked beet, chopped ( can be beet drained but can be cooked a day later ) | 1/4 cup crumb | 6 slices pepperoni ( thinly sliced ) | 1/4 cup pitted black olives | 1 pastry for a double crust pie ( pie crust, lattice or similar, i prefer the one i get from my own store ) | 1/4 cup breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 c or 400°f. Line a baking sheet with parchment or a silicone baking mat, but leave a 5cm overhang on the parchment paper. Sauté the beet pieces in a pan with a little olive oil, pepperoni and black olives. When the beet mixture is heated through, pour the mixture into the pastry shell. Sprinkle with breadcrumbs and bake for 15 - 20 minutes, until golden brown.

title: Japanese White Beans and Eggplant Chips
ingredients: 8 japanese eggplants | 1 can whole dried cranberry beans | 1/4 cup chocolate chips, or as needed
instructions: Preheat an oven to 325 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place eggplant on the prepared baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown and tender, about 20 minutes. Let cool, and cut into 1/2 inch slices. Transfer to a resealable plastic bag. Pour the cranberry beans over the eggplant slices in the bag, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. The beans shouldn't reach the depth of a finger or more. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil, and spray the foil with nonstick cooking spray. Arrange the eggplant slices on the prepared baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until eggplant slices are golden brown and crisp on the edges, about 10 minutes per side. Meanwhile, pour boiling water over the cranberry bean bag into a saucepan. Bring to a boil, and cook for 5 minutes, or until cranberry beans have softened and water has stopped steaming. Mix in the chocolate chips. Return to a simmer, and keep warm. Serve.

Random Ingredients: paprika,celery seed,red wine,cayenne,spring onion,parmigiano reggiano cheese,yogurt
title: Kofta (Parmesan Onion Salad)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon celery seed | 3 spring onions, white and green parts, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup red wine, such as cabernet sauvignon | 1/4 cup dry yogurt | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil or 1/4 cup ghee, divided | 1 pinch cayenne | paprika
instructions: Soak celery seed in cold water for about 10 minutes, then drain.

title: Sausage Casserole
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs hot sausage ( casing removed ) | 1 1/2 cups fat-free evaporated milk
instructions: Brown the sausages in a skillet over medium heat. Place the sausages and the fat back in the pan, and simmer for 10 - 12 minutes. Remove the sausages from the pan and place in a greased casserole dish. Stir the evaporated milk into the sausage mixture. Pour the sauce over the sausages, and then cover the casserole tightly with plastic wrap.. Place in a 350° oven for about 20 minutes. Remove from the oven and let sit for five minutes before serving. Note, i usually just tear the plastic wrap off of the sausage with my hands, put in a hot dry pan, and cover with a lid, and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: bamboo shoot,pecorino romano cheese,mace,cooking oil,russet potato,tomato soup
title: Potato and Pepper Pasta
ingredients: 2 russet potatoes, sliced | cooking oil | 1 can tomato soup | 1 can bamboo shoots, diced | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace | 4 ounces pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven at 375 degrees f, or just toaster oven if using a convection oven. Heat the cooking oil over medium high heat. In a large deep dish, stir together the chopped potatoes, tomato soup, diced bamboo shoots, and mace. Place the russet in the hot oil, add the pecorino romano cheese, and mix well before taking the pan off the burner. Drain the pasta well, and place the pasta in the casserole dish. Top with the mashed potato mixture. Cook until the casserole is bubbling, a bit crisp at the edges. Turn the flame off, and serve.

title: Gator Quinoa Mix Substitute
ingredients: 2 tablespoons quinoa | 4 bell peppers ( any color, or a combination of one green, and one red ) | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda ( optional- if using all veggies, it will make the mix less watery ) | 1 teaspoon dried italian seasoning ( optional- to taste )
instructions: Rinse the quinoa under cold water. Drain and set aside. Bring 2 cups of water to boil and stir in the quinoa and spices. Simmer for about 3 minutes, or until all of the liquid is absorbed. Remove from heat and let stand for about 15 minutes. Taste and adjust seasoning. Keep in mind that regular quinoa can be really chewy.

title: Kurdish Fusion Tofu With Rissoles
ingredients: 5 ounces extra firm tofu | 1/2 teaspoon fennel | 1/2 cup yoghurt | 1 lb rotelle pasta or 1 lb penne | 2 mangoes, peeled, seeded and chopped
instructions: Cut tofu into large chunks and toss with fennel in a large nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray. Stir fry until lightly browned, about 6 minutes. Drain tofu on paper towels and pat dry with a paper towel. Set aside. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil and stir in rotelle. In a food processor, combine tofu, mozzarella cheese, mangoes and 1/4 c feta cheese mixture.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,vegetable stock,dark brown sugar,veal,bacon grease
title: Beef and Veal Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons bacon grease | 1 1/2 teaspoons vegetable stock | 1 teaspoon dark brown sugar | 1 lb veal, strips | 1/3 cup bean sprouts
instructions: Heat oil in a stir fry pan over medium high heat. Add bacon grease to pan and fry veal strips until cooked through, not cooked all the way through. Remove veal, keeping warm. Add stock and sugar to the pan and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and stir constantly until sauce thickens slightly. Stir in vegetables, cover and heat through. Stir in meat until heated through.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno chile,ice water,vanilla extract,pineapple chunk,tawny port
title: Pineapple Jalapeno Jelly
ingredients: 3 cups unsweetened pineapple chunks | 3 cups unsweetened pineapple chunks | 1 cup cold water | 1/2 cup tawny port | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Place pineapple chunks in a large saucepan and slowly stir in the water, port, and vanilla. Bring to a boil, and cook for 5 minutes. Immediately pour into the sterile jars, leaving 1/2 inch headspace. Refrigerate jelly, and cover with plastic wrap.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,pea,malt vinegar,mint leaf,pork loin roast,grape tomato,dark brown sugar,elbow macaroni
title: Spanish Pork Loin With Minted Macaroni and Peas
ingredients: 1 tablespoon malt vinegar | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh mint leaves | 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 12 ounces elbow macaroni, cooked according to package directions | 4 ounces pork loin roast | 1/4 cup chopped fresh mint leaves | 1 cup grape tomatoes or 1 cup cherry tomatoes, halved | 1/4 cup peas, tips of or 1/4 cup frozen peas
instructions: Whisk together the vinegar, sugar, fresh mint, chile flakes and half of the mint leaves. Set aside the macaroni. Place remaining mint leaves and remaining mint in a mixing bowl and set them aside. Place the pork in a nonstick skillet over medium high heat and brown on both sides. Set aside. Remove pan from heat. In a clean bowl, toss the remaining mint with remaining mint, tomatoes, peas and pork. Spoon the cooked macaroni and pork mixture into a shallow bowl. Garnish with mint leaves and mint sprigs. Serve from the prepared serving platter.

title: Crusty Mexican Pies
ingredients: 1 package crescent dinner rolls | 1 tablespoon shortening | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 2 cups pearl barley | 1/4 teaspoon black pepper
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350f. In a medium bowl, place the flour, cocoa, barley and pepper. Mix well on a clean counter. Place the shortening in a 2 lb ramekin or pie dish with sides. Unroll the refrigerated crescent rolls on a clean countertop. Place the dough into the pie dish leaving about 1/4 inch of the uncooked crust in the middle of the pie dish. Unroll all the dough in the pie dish onto the flour. Take the dough out of the ramekin. Place the excess dough on top, crimping the edges to seal. Do not crimp too much. Place the ramekin in the refrigerator for at least an hour or a little longer. Roll the dough out on a floured countertop about 1/4 inch thick. Cut into 1/2 inch slices. Scoop out a portion of the dough and place it onto the crusty edges of the pie dish. Pinch one edge firmly at the edge and fold to seal. Repeat this with the remaining dough and filling. Place the pies on the center rack of the oven and bake for 20 minutes. Serve warm with more cocoa.

Random Ingredients: margarine,garlic granule,soy sauce,red wine vinegar,orange marmalade,guacamole
title: Saucy Orange Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup guacamole | 2 tablespoons orange marmalade | 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic granules | 1 1/2 teaspoons soy sauce | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 1/2 cup margarine or 1/2 cup butter, softened
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender and blend until mixture is very smooth. Chill at least 30 minutes. Place on lettuce lettuce for easy garnish.

title: Baked Italian Sausage (Sausage Sandwich Fritters)
ingredients: 1 lb bulk italian sausage | 1 tablespoon agave syrup
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Remove sausage from casings and brown sausage in a frying pan over medium heat. Pour cooked sausage onto a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until well done. Remove, and slice into 1/8 inch slices. Drizzle with agave syrup while warm, and serve with hot italian sausages.

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,italian breadcrumb,red snapper fillet,rosemary sprig,purpose flour,zucchini
title: Italian Baked Snapper
ingredients: 3 large zucchini, sliced 1/4-inch thick | 4 large red snapper fillets | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 2 tablespoons italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon dried italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon fresh rosemary sprig
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Place the zucchini slices on a baking sheet and brush them with milk. Sprinkle slices with flour and bread crumbs and add a rosemary sprig. Place in oven and bake for 8 to 10 minutes, until slightly brown on top. Meanwhile, prepare the fish. If necessary, cut slits along the top of each fillet to make 3 pockets. When zucchini are tender, remove them from the oven and place on a dish to cool slightly. Brush fillets with milk and sprinkle with bread crumbs. Place fillets in a single layer on serving plates and surround with zucchini. Serve with hot fresh tomato salsa, if desired.

title: Middle Eastern Sumac Balls (Lebanese)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sesame oil ( or clarified butter ) | 1/2 lb golden brown sugar | 1/2 lb mint leaf, washed and coarsely chopped | 1/2 lb flour | 1 tablespoon sumac
instructions: Heat sesame oil or clarified butter. Stir in sugar until melted, then stir in mint. Let cool to warm and then stir in flour and Sumac. Cover and leave room at room temp. Shape the sumac mixture into 16 balls, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter, leaving the edges to seal. Set aside to dry.

Random Ingredients: marjoram,chinese five spice powder,green chili,cremini mushroom,liquid smoke,spring onion
title: Chinese Mushroom Smoked Mozzarella
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs smoked mozzarella cheese, preferably a dark aged variety | 1 1/2 lbs cremini mushrooms | 2 stalks spring onions, finely chopped ( green parts only ) | 2 teaspoons chinese five spice powder | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke
instructions: Slice the cheese slices into 1/4 slices. Wrap each slice of cheese with a piece of cheese, tying the slice loosely at the top of the cheese when removed from the sausage. Slice all mushrooms and set aside. Place the mushrooms on a large flat surface, or in a bowl. Toss the mushrooms with the chopped spring onion. Sprinkle in the five spice powder, marjoram, liquid smoke and salt and pepper to taste. Let marinate in the refrigerator at least 6 hours or overnight. Remove the sausage from the marinade and dry on paper towels. Remove the cheese to a serving platter and cover. Increase the heat under the broiler to medium high. Serve with brown rice.

Random Ingredients: peanut butter,peach preserve apricot,green olive,white breadcrumb
title: Dunkin' Joes
ingredients: 4 slices firm ripe white bread | 1 can peach preserves or 36 ounces apricot preserves | 2 tablespoons smooth peanut butter | 1/3 cup green olives, coarsely chopped
instructions: Spread bread slices with preserves.

Random Ingredients: palm sugar,masa harina,cottage cheese,self raising flour
title: Melting Pot Pies
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ground masa harina | 1 tablespoon palm sugar, grated | 1/2 cup cottage cheese | 1/2 cup self-raising flour
instructions: Crumble masa harina, palm sugar and cottage cheese into bowl. Make well in center. Make well in center and add self raising flour. Mix with fork. Place 1 heaped teaspoon into baking dish. Bake in moderate oven 350f degrees 7 - 8 mins until golden brown.

title: Moroccan Shrimp and Rice
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked couscous | 1/2 lb uncooked shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 large red bell pepper, cut into thin strips | 1/3 cup raisins or 1/3 cup dried apricot | 1 chipotle chile, minced, with adobo, in adobo or 2 cloves | 1 lb lean ground pork
instructions: In a medium size bowl, combine everything except pork and couscous. Combine well. Add ground pork and mix together with hands until everything is well mixed and it is well mixed. Spread all through a strainer. Place on wax paper and let sit 15 minute or so. Then, using a 1 1/2 or 2 inch cookie cutter, cut into squares or rectangles and place on wax paper. Let stand an additional 15 - 30 minutes. Cook in a 425 degree oven for 20 min or until crisp and crispy outside. Note, you may use a deep fryer, like a barbeque to cook the shrimp and meat. If you don't have a deep fryer, you may use a deep saucepan as directed above.

title: Soba Noodles II
ingredients: 1 package soba noodles | 1 1/2 cups lemon juice | 1 cup cold water, or as needed
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Place soba noodles in the saucepan and cook 2 to 3 minutes, or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: kale,pork shoulder,chicken tender,serrano chili,garlic salt,mexican cheese,turmeric powder
title: Ww Core Pork
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs pork shoulder, cubed | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric powder | 2 serrano chili | 2 bags kale | 4 packages mexican blend cheese
instructions: Season pork lightly with garlic salt, turmeric powder and serrano chili to taste. Place in crockpot and add chicken. Add kale. Cover and cook on high for 7 hours then turn down to low. Uncover and continue cooking for 10 to 15 minutes or until pork is fully falling apart. Remove meat and kale to slow cooker and shred. In separate bowl, stir together cheese and remaining chilies. Spoon cheese mixture into a tortilla and wrap. Place on baking tray and heat until cheese is bubbly.

Random Ingredients: sugar,worcestershire sauce,oregano,superfine sugar,ancho chile,bulb fennel,deli roast beef
title: Tender Italian Beef Sandwiches With Ancho Sauce
ingredients: 1/3 cup light superfine sugar | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 2 1/2 teaspoons dried ancho chiles | 2 1/4 teaspoons dried oregano | 1 1/2 lbs thinly sliced deli roast beef | 8 whole bulbs fennel | 8 sandwich buns or 6 whole grain hamburger buns, toasted
instructions: Combine sugar, worcestershire sauce, chiles and dried oregano.

title: Rigatoni With Orange Flower or Flower Water
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs rigatoni pasta or 1 1/2 lbs penne pasta, dry | 1 1/2 cups orange flower water | 1 tablespoon marinade
instructions: Cook rigatoni until al dente. Drain. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Mix thoroughly and keep warm. Serve over hot cooked pasta.

title: French Blue
ingredients: 3 tablespoons maple syrup | 3 tablespoons triple sec | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained
instructions: Stir maple syrup, triple sec, and water chestnuts together in a glass with fizzproof rims.

title: Easy Basic Tomato Gravy
ingredients: 2 cups condensed tomato soup, undiluted | 1 cup confectioners'sugar
instructions: In a saucepan over medium low heat, combine the tomato soup and confectioner's sugar. Stir constantly until thick, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno,four cheese mexican,phyllo pastry,tomato paste,margarita mix
title: Queso Blanco
ingredients: 1 package frozen phyllo pastry | 1 can tomato paste | 1 can sliced jalapenos | 12 -16 ounces four-cheese mexican blend cheese, grated | margarita mix
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Combine tomato paste and jalapenos and pour into large casserole dish. Place in preheated oven for 20 - 30 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool. When cooled remove rind from jar of cheese and grate it. Place in freezer bag and use for sandwiches, or just eat this as filler. I found that cutting the pastry in half to make it easier if it isn’t frozen. But in this case i would be more generous with the amounts of tomato paste, tomato jalepenos, and jalepenos, and then put 3 pieces of the cheese with half of the tomato jalepeno mixture on one layer and then put about half the cheese on top. Repeat layers until you have used up the filling and cheese. Top with remaining cheese and bake in 400° oven until cheese topping is brown and bubbling and starting to brown slightly around edges, around 10min to 15min or until golden brown around edges again.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,baguette,deli roast beef,buttermilk,methi seed
title: Beef Croquetas
ingredients: 1 lb loaf unsliced deli roast beef | 1 cup buttermilk | 1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 1 jar sliced french-fried onions ( kraft brand ) | 1 teaspoon methi seeds
instructions: Cut loaf of bread in half and remove bread from crusts. Slice meat across the grain into 1/4 inch slices. In medium size bowl, combine the meat, buttermilk and cracker crumbs, mix well. Place 1/2 of the bread mixture down the center of each slice of meat. Fold the bread over the top of the meat, then set aside until ready to proceed. Place cheese slices in the crockery on the bottom of your crockery, then top with 1/2 of the onions. Repeat layers, ending with onions and then top with crumbled cheese. Heat in 350 degree oven until cheese is just melted, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,orange peel,bread,flat rice noodle,red wine vinegar,baking soda,asadero cheese
title: Rice Noodle Bread Pudding
ingredients: 12 -14 ounces bread, cut into cubes | 1/2 cup extra virgin red wine vinegar | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 1 3/4 cups freshly grated asadero cheese | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 3/4 cup finely chopped orange peel | powdered sugar or sugar, for dusting
instructions: Toss bread cubes with vinegar and set aside. In a large mixing bowl, combine cheese, vanilla and baking soda, cheese and orange peels. Add bread cubes and toss to coat evenly. Bake at 400 degrees fahrenheit until browned, about 25 - 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, cool. Turn onto serving plate. Dust with powdered sugar, if desired.

title: The Easiest Chocolate Chunk Salad
ingredients: 4 ounces milk chocolate chips ( not `` hot '' ) | 1/3 cup dried cranberries or 1/3 cup craisins | cooking spray
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Microwave the chocolate chips in a microwave safe bowl, stirring after every minute, until melted and smooth. Remove from the microwave and add the craisins or cranberries and nuts. Stir thoroughly. Spray a large serving platter or serving dish with cooking oil and pour the chocolate mixture evenly over the top. Let cool until the chocolate is firm, about 15 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: pattypan squash,green pea,chili pepper,cellophane noodle,green,vegetable soup mix,rice wine vinegar,veal
title: Vegetarian Vietnamese Baked Spaghetti
ingredients: 8 ounces cellophane noodles ( fresh or cellophane ) | 1 lb veal, ground | 1 hot pepper, minced | 1 package veggie soup mix | 1 cup green peas | 2 cups pattypan squash | 2 cups green peas | 1/2 cup rice wine vinegar | chopped green ( optional )
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. Cool. Fry veal in a skillet until browned. Drain excess fat. Remove from skillet, slice into thin half moon strips. Set aside. Add pepper and soup mix to skillet. Mix well and return to low heat. Mix in peas and green peas about 7 minutes, until softened. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place a layer of sliced spam on a large rimmed baking sheet and put 1 tomato at each end of the noodles, followed by 1/2 cup of noodles. Repeat layers until all ingredients are used up. Top with chopped green onion, if using. Bake, uncovered, for 20 minutes or until hot.

title: Lebanese Coleslaw
ingredients: 300 g coleslaw mix | 1/4 cup whole wheat pastry flour | 1/8 teaspoon ground coriander
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl using a fork or pulse machine. Drain any excess liquid from the coleslaw. Place in a shallow dish and cover with oil. Press well. Cook at 200c for 20 - 25 minutes to soften, stirring regularly and turning over once. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: white flour,vanilla essence,dark beer,spring onion,red lentil,serrano chilies,fruit
title: Chilli and Beer Battered Lentil Pudding
ingredients: 1/2 cup red lentil, picked through | 1/2 cup white flour | 1 tablespoon dark beer | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1/2 cup spring onion, minced | 1 serrano chilies, very finely chopped or 2 scotch bonnet chiles | 1 small fruit, cut into wedges ( optional )
instructions: Boil the lentils in just enough water to cover with a pinch of salt until soft and cooked. Drain, run under cold water and allow to cool slightly. Place flour into a bowl that you can quickly dip the lentils into. Gradually add the beer and stir with a fork until evenly incorporated. Fold in the chopped spring onion and chiles. Season with flavourings and pour into a buttered or oven proof dish. Sprinkle over the topping and bake in a preheated oven at 200c for 15 to 20 minutes or until the pudding is heated through and golden.

title: Spiced Almond Soup
ingredients: 1 cup almonds, blanched and peeled | 2 teaspoons finely chopped fresh chili pepper flakes | 1 1/2 cups double cream | 4 cups chicken stock | fresh parsley, for garnish
instructions: Using a food processor, process the almonds until finely ground or a powder of similar size. Add the chilli, 1 cup cream, 2 cups of stock and the sieved almonds.

title: Fiery Malaysian Sauce (Dipping Sauce)
ingredients: 1/2 cup ketjap manis ( sweet soy sauce abc brand or kikkoman brand ) | 1/4 cup dried oregano leaves
instructions: Add ingredients to the ketchup.

title: Pasta With Tomatoes and Oil and Parmigiano-Reggiano
ingredients: 8 ounces capellini | 1 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 cup tomato puree, 1-3 cups | 2 tablespoons olive oil
instructions: Cook the cappellini per package directions. Drain and rinse in cold water. Mix 1 cup cheese and the remaining 1/2 cup parmigiano in a small bowl. Heat the oil in a medium size saucepan over medium low heat. Saute the tomatoes in half the mixture for about 5 minutes, stirring often. Spread the remaining half of the tomato puree on the pasta. Drain the pasta. Sprinkle the grated cheese on top and serve.

title: Beef or Chicken Satay
ingredients: 600 g sirloin steak | 50 g light soymilk | 1 teaspoon dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon light soymilk | 1 tablespoon tahini
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a food processor or mortar and pestle and set aside. Grill the steak on a bbq plate for 8 minutes on each side, or until medium to rare. Cut the steak into 1 inch strips and then cut the strips across the grain. Serve in the satay with a sprinkling of sweet chilli marmalade.

Random Ingredients: red cabbage,chihuahua cheese,yogurt,chicken meat,fig,chunky salsa,anchovy fillet,fish sauce
title: Caldo De Res (Stuffed Red Cabbage)
ingredients: 1 head red cabbage | 1 teaspoon anchovy fillet, minced | 1/4 cup chunky salsa | 1/4 cup low-fat yogurt | 1 lb chicken meat, ground ( optional ) | 1/2 cup chihuahua cheese, grated | 1/2 cup fresh figs, sliced ( optional ) | 4 tablespoons chicken broth or 4 tablespoons fish sauce
instructions: Core head of cabbage then separate the individual leaves leaving some thick stem. Scoop out the core but leave as much whole head as possible. Place on a large cookie or parchment paper and cover loosely with cheese cloth or plastic wrap so that the cheese does not sink to the bottom. Steam for 8 - 10 minutes until cheese is melted and slightly browned around the edges. Remove cheese cloth and unwrap leaves from steamer, squeezing out excess liquid. Remove core and discard. Starting at top with outer cabbage core line the spine with about 1/4 inch of cauliflower core nearest you. You should have approximately 1 1/2 pound of head of cabbage. Repeat this process with remaining cabbage, cauliflower, or goat meat. In a large bowl mix together, salsa, yogurt, chihuahua, 1/2 cup of figs, and some chicken broth or fish sauce. Stuff cabbage with mixture making a mound or roll up, placing it seam side down in the sauce. Cover with a cloth or plastic wrap and set aside to marinate at least 1 hour or so. Cook covered 30 - 45 minutes or until tender. You will need to taste and stir it from time to time to make sure it gets a good balance between moister and sauce, depending on how much sauce you use. Enjoy your cabbage rolls and don't forget to eat some of your favorite thai dipping sauces.

Random Ingredients: hominy,lasagna noodle,chicken bouillon granule,beef,carrot,artichoke heart,spanish onion
title: Artichoke Beef Lasagna
ingredients: 8 ounces dried lasagna noodles, halved | 3/4 pound lean ground beef | 1 spanish onion, thinly sliced and separated into rings | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules | 1 can hominy, rinsed and drained | 1 carrot, coarsely grated
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the lasagna noodles, and return to a boil. Cook the noodles uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the noodles have cooked through, but are still firm to the bite, about 8 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a 9x13 inch baking dish with a layer of aluminum foil. Cook the beef and onion in a large skillet over medium heat, stirring to break the meat into small pieces with a wooden spoon, until the beef is browned and the onion is translucent, about 10 minutes. Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer the beef mixture until the liquid has evaporated and the mixture is thick, about 20 minutes. Set the beef mixture aside. Place the artichoke hearts in a bowl. Add enough water to the artichokes to cover and set aside. Pour about 1/2 cup of the tomatos with their liquid and the bouillon into the bottom of the baking dish to dissolve the bouillon. Stir enough of the artichoke liquid back into the meat mixture so it is moist and flavorful. Spread 1 cup of the sauce on the bottom of the dish, followed by 1/2 the lasagna noodles, 1/2 the beef mixture, and 1/2 the carrots. Repeat layers using remaining ingredients. Top with remaining sauce. Cover the dish with foil and bake in preheated oven until the lasagna comes out of the oven, about 1 hour. Let cool for 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: port wine,kidney bean,pear,radish,red chili pepper flake,cauliflower,shiitake mushroom
title: Cha Cha Toursi - the Real Deal!
ingredients: 1 cup dried kidney beans | 1 dried red chili pepper flake | 1/2 head cauliflower ( about 1lb per head ) | 2 shiitake mushrooms, sliced | 1 radish, sliced thinly | 1 tablespoon port wine or 1 tablespoon dry sherry | fresh parsley, to garnish
instructions: Rinse the beans well in a colander under cold water and place them in a large pan with cold water. Bring to the boil and cook over a medium low heat until tender. In the meantime, cook the cauliflower in boiling water for 3 mins, then drain. Rinse it under cold water and place it in a large pan with the mushrooms and radishes and cover the pan with boiling water. Cover and cook for 5 mins until tender, then remove the mushrooms and vegetables and set them aside. Mash the beans through a grinder or food mill. Put half of the mashed beans and mash to give a slightly chunky consistency. Stir in the port or sherry and season with salt and pepper to taste. Taste and adjust for salt. Divid the mixture between 4 serving plates decoratively and pass a sharp rose, snipped fresh parsley.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,ouzo,flat leaf italian parsley,kidney bean
title: Provençal Beans (Aubergine)
ingredients: 2 cups cooked canned kidney beans | 2 tablespoons ouzo | 1 1/2 ounces flat leaf italian parsley | 1 celery rib, finely cut
instructions: Mix everything well together, cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Black Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 1/8 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( or you can add up to 1/4 teaspoon of hing ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme, crushed
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the vinegar, asafoetida and thyme. Keep in mind since the measurements you can get from dipping dough are all based on wetness of your hand and not in quantity. Dip a spoon in boiling water and spread it evenly over a small plate. Use the plate to dip your finger inside. Dip your shrimp back in if it fries dry. This can be done easily after washing and washing shrimp. Add the honey/vinegar mixture to the shrimp and toss over very low heat, stirring constantly, until honey coats the shrimp. Serve immediately or refrigerate. Enjoy.

title: Holly's Greek Quesadillas
ingredients: 1 small green pepper, cut into thin strips | feta cheese, crumbled | 12 corn tortilla chips
instructions: Preheat a skillet or griddle. Brush one side of a tortilla with olive oil, then sprinkle with half the feta cheese and half the pepper. Using a fork or a small spoon, flatten the cheese into a 4 circle on the oiled surface. Top with the second tortilla and press down to form a patty. Once the cheese has melted, place the quesadilla in the skillet/griddle, and cook until golden, about 3 - 5 minutes. Remove from griddle, and cut into 4 wedges.

title: Penne With Smoked Salmon
ingredients: 1 rump roast | 10 ounces hot dry linguine | 1/4 teaspoon sage leaf | 1/8 teaspoon cormick coriander powder | 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded and destemmed | 1 can smoked salmon
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large ziplock bag. Place meat in bag and marinade in fridge. Remove meat from bag and place in a 9x13 baking dish with marinade in a 1/2 inch layer. Roast at 375 degrees for 45 minutes, basting often with pan juices.

Random Ingredients: marsala wine,jasmine rice,vanilla bean,black pepper,coriander seed,mayonnaise
title: Marmalade and Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon marsala wine or 1 tablespoon dry sherry | 1/2 vanilla bean | 2 teaspoons ground coriander seed | black pepper | 1 cup jasmine rice
instructions: In a medium bowl mix the mayonnaise with the vanilla bean and coriander seeds. Stir in the rice and pepper and chill for 10 minutes. Serve topped with a few fresh mint leaves and a sprig of mint if desired.

Random Ingredients: cardamom,whipping cream,pork shoulder,rocket,chili without bean,sherry,beef bouillon granule,ginger garlic paste
title: Beef With Cream, Chillies
ingredients: 600 -900 g boneless pork shoulder | 1/2 liter whipping cream | 375 ml beef bouillon granules | 3 teaspoons sherry | 2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste | 1/8 teaspoon crushed cardamom | rocket | chili without beans
instructions: Cut the pork into 2 inch cubes. Place in crockpot over high head, then cook on high for 8 hours and turn down to low for a further 2 hours, checking meat and adding more water at intervals to prevent sticking until all the water gone. You need to do this slowly so that the meat is not drying out. When ready to serve, remove meat from crockpot, cool and remove fat, leaving some for gravy. Place meat, cream and stock in saucepan and bring to the boil. Add spices and cook for one minute. Add drained chillies. Transfer meat and sauce to serving bowl & spoon over any juices.

title: Fully-Loaded Turkey Nuggets
ingredients: 3 tablespoons instant chocolate cookie crumbs | 1/2 teaspoon cocoa | 1/2 teaspoon butter, melted
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Mix chocolate cookie crumbs and cocoa in a small bowl. Roll turkey in crumb mixture, then place in a greased casserole dish. Drizzle with butter. Bake in preheated oven until crispy and dark brown, 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Quick and Easy Tortilla Chip Black Bean Nests
ingredients: 1 can black beans, drained | 1 package tortilla chips | 1 package chopped pepperoni | 1 can sliced and drained tart shells
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Drain black beans and mix with tortilla chips in a bowl. Layer tortilla chips and pepperoni in the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Spoon black bean filling onto tortilla chips. Top filling with crispy pepperoni slices. Bake in the preheated oven until heated through, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: sirloin tip roast,self raising flour,fine breadcrumb,onion soup mix,cheese
title: Beef Tips Au Gratin
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin tip roast | 1 packet onion soup mix | 1 ounce fine dry breadcrumb | 1 tablespoon self raising flour | 1 ounce cheese, grated | 1 slice cheese, grated
instructions: Trim any fat off the meat and cut into about ¾ inch cubes. Put the beef cubes in a large bowl and add the soup and bread crumbs, stir well to make the paste. Spoon out as much of the excess mixture as possible and stir in the flour then press into a buttered ovenproof dish. Sprinkle evenly with grated cheese and dot evenly with a little extra grated cheese. Bake in the 160c for about 2 hours or until a rich golden brown crust appears on the surface when pierced with a fork. When cooked, remove from the oven and leave in a warm place for about 10 minutes, then remove from the dish, and cut into about ¾ inch cubes while still hot. Serve with boiled potatoes and a green vegetable, if desired. Variation, sprinkle some grated cheese, but not too much for individual tastes.

title: Chipotle Dry Rub
ingredients: 3 -5 teaspoons dried chipotle chiles, finely chopped seeds ( i use about a tbsp. ) | 1 tablespoon coarsely ground caraway seed
instructions: In a dry 10 inch skillet with a shallow lid, cook the dried chiles over high heat, stirring frequently with a wooden spoon, until they change color and have a smokey aroma, 10 to 12 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool to room temperature, about 20 minutes. Transfer to a ziplock bag, and add the ground caraway seeds. Rub chiles into the chipots to create a subtle flavor, and store in the refrigerator.

title: Rosemary Roast Chicken
ingredients: 3 tablespoons rosemary, pure | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 1 whole chickens, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f combine the rosemary, curry paste and chicken. Loosely secure with a toothpick or string. Place the chicken on a rack in a roasting pan and bake for half an hour, or until tender. Transfer to a platter and serve warm.

title: Spiralized Restaurant Style Tomatoes & Chilies Salsa
ingredients: 1 can tomatoes and green chilies, drained & chopped | 1 lime
instructions: Cut out the stem end of the lime then scoop out the inside of the rind using a teaspoon. Set aside. Mash with a potato masher until the mixture is as smooth as it will become. Add the tomatoes and green chilies, stir to mash well. Garnish with the cumin seeds and/or a little salt then serve.

title: Olive Garden Honey Mustard Spaghetti Cookies
ingredients: 1 package cooked spaghetti | 1/2 cup dry bread, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 package self-rising flour | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom seed | 8 small flour tortillas | 1 cup honey | 8 tablespoons honey
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. To make spaghetti batter, in a mixing bowl, combine the bread, flour, cardamom seeds, and 1/2 cup of the honey. Dip each tortilla and one at a time in the batter, allowing excess batter to drip off tortillas. Place each piece on a parchment/lined cookie sheet, and bake for 5 to 10 minutes, until golden brown. To serve, drizzle remaining 1/4 cup honey over each cookie. Remove from oven, and transfer the cookies to a serving platter. Drizzle remaining honey over the cookie. Using a toothpick, snip ends of each cookie to make them stand upright. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck roast,vegetable stock,black bean,tortilla chip,lemon zest,black olive,currant
title: Easy Black Bean and Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 1/2 pounds boneless beef chuck roast, cut into 1 1/2 - inch pieces | 8 ounces black beans, undrained | 1 teaspoon lemon zest | 1 teaspoon vegetable stock | 1 can sliced black olives, drained | 1/4 cup dried currants | tortilla chips
instructions: Place the beef, black beans, lemon zest, vegetable stock, and olives into a slow cooker. Cover, and cook on high for 3 hours, or low for 6 to 8 hours. Stir in the currants, and serve with tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: pork butt,red onion,bell pepper,fruit,radish,apple cider,pineapple juice,mint leaf
title: Chinese Pork Sausages With Fruit Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless pork butt, cut into 1 1/2-inch chunks | 1 red onion, cut into 1-inch wedges | 2 large apples, cored and diced | 1 medium bell pepper, seeded and sliced | 4 medium radishes, sliced thin | 1 3/4 cups unsweetened pineapple juice | 1/2 cup apple cider | fresh mint leaves ( for garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Place the pork cubes in a 13x9 inch pan, fat side up. Mix the onion, apples and bell pepper with the ginger, sausage pieces and pineapple juice, bringing them to a simmer. Cover and simmer for 40 minutes, basting once or twice during cooking. Remove from heat and let cool slightly. Add the apple cider and mint leaves. Note, if your pineapple juice is a little thin, you may pour it into a strainer for a few seconds before serving to have a thicker sauce.

Random Ingredients: double cream,parmesan cheese,beef tenderloin,red lentil,chicken thigh
title: Danish Chicken and Lentil Soup (Pressure Cooker)
ingredients: 4 lbs beef tenderloin, all fat trimmed, cut into pieces | 1 1/2 lbs chicken thighs, fat trimmed, boned, and cut into cubes | 1 1/2 cups red lentils, rinsed | 1 cup double cream, whipped | 1/1 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Press five pounds weight pieces of beef and chicken lightly into the bottom of the pressure cooker. Sprinkle meat with salt. Place in pressure cooker, fat side up. Sprinkle with 1 1/2 c lentils. Pour a few full of cream into soup. Sprinkle with 1 1/2 c of the parmesan cheese. Seal cooker. Secure lid securely. Over high heat, develop steam to high pressure and heat until full pressure.

Random Ingredients: tortilla,ramen noodle,beef bouillon cube,lemon peel,sea salt,monterey jack cheese,lime wedge,mussel
title: Quick Noodle Nests for 4
ingredients: 6 cups cooked chopped corned beef or 6 cups cooked shrimp | 6 slices of thin sliced lemons or 6 slices lemon peel | 6 -8 -10 thick slices monterey jack cheese or 6 -10 slices cheddar cheese | 36 mussels, in the shell cleaned well until they are very large, but firm if there is any | 1 -2 tablespoon low sodium beef bouillon cube ( i use one low-sodium beef broth cube, one flavor enhancer i use ) | 1 -2 tablespoon dried lemon peel | 12 -16 warm fresh tortillas | lime wedge ( optional )
instructions: Chop corned beef or shrimp into tiny bite size pieces, set aside. Slice lemon in half. Cut each cheese into 12 wedges as for traditional north american cheese.

title: Quick and Easy Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 lb uncooked pasta, like ditalini | 1 cup chopped vegetables | shredded arugula leaf
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions and drain. Cool under cold running water. Meanwhile, cook vegetables in a large bowl in boiling hot water until tender. Drain well. Add vegetables, hot pasta and a handful of arugula to salad. Sprinkle with salt and serve.

Random Ingredients: anchovy paste,self rising flour,baking soda,coconut oil
title: Cracked Sesame Rolls (For the Bread Machine)
ingredients: 1 bottle coconut oil | 1/2 teaspoon anchovy paste ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 3/4 cups self rising flour
instructions: Empty ingredients and run through bread machine in the order specified by the manufacturer. The idea is that all the ingredients are measured before the end of the cycle. When the cycle is complete, remove bread pan from the bread pan and slice diagonally across the grain. The goal is to fill the bread evenly, but do not slice bread until all the bread is gone. Most bread manufacturers do not check the oven rack to ensure they are properly in the oven, which you should do as soon as the bread has been removed from the pan.

Random Ingredients: amaretti cooky,kielbasa,topping,chili garlic sauce,heavy whipping cream,garlic powder,cremini mushroom
title: Polish Hunter's Kielbasa
ingredients: 1 lb kielbasa, coarsely cut ( you may use more if you want ) | 1 teaspoon garlic powder ( to taste ) | 3 tablespoons chili-garlic sauce ( to taste ) | 1 pint heavy whipping cream | 1 package cremini mushrooms or ( 16 ounce ) package button mushrooms, sliced 1/4-inch thick | 3 amaretti cookies ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons finely chopped garlic powder
instructions: In a large skillet over medium heat, cook kielbasa, stirring often, until well browned and tender. Stir in garlic powder and chili sauce. Reduce heat to low, and simmer, uncovered, for 10 minutes. Stir in whipping cream until stiffly whipped, then transfer kielbasa mixture to a large bowl. Mold mixture into a rectangular shape, and sprinkle with amaretto or garlic powder to taste. Cool kielbasa slightly. Cut into 1 inch pieces, and transfer to serving dish. Top with mushrooms. Chill several hours or overnight so flavors can develop.

title: Cajun Mix and Paste
ingredients: 1 package dry onion flakes | 1/2 cup catsup | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/2 cup ground pecans
instructions: Combine the onion flakes, catsup, oregano and pecans. Store in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: fish sauce,kahlua,thyme leaf,dill weed,baking powder,white sugar,mexicorn,black pepper
title: Dill and Kahlua Tostadas
ingredients: 1 can mexicorn, drained | 4 cups coarsely ground black pepper | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 2 tablespoons kahlua | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 1 tablespoon minced fresh dill weed | 1/4 cup fish sauce
instructions: Preheat a frying pan over highest heat. In a small bowl, stir together the mexicorn, black pepper, baking powder, sugar, kahlua, thyme, and dill. Roll 1 tablespoon of the mxture into a patty shape and place onto a plate. Roll the remaining package in the flour, coating each side, and place onto the tins. Bake in the preheated oven until crisp and golden brown, about 15 minutes.

title: Apple-Salted Horseradish Tea
ingredients: 1 tart apple, peeled and chopped | 2 tablespoons shallots, minced | 2 tablespoons brewed tea ( strong ) | 1 teaspoon horseradish ( optional ) | 1/4 cup cherries, chopped
instructions: Combine apple, shallots and tea.

Random Ingredients: dish pie shell,corn tortilla,mustard,lemon zest,dark red kidney bean
title: Mexican-Style Red Beans and Corn Tortilla Pie #5FIX
ingredients: 1 can dark red kidney beans | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard | 1/4 cup fresh lemon zest, grated | corn tortilla, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 1 12-inch ready-to-use deep dish pie shell
instructions: Mix the beans and mustard in a small bowl, then spread mixture over the bottom and around the bottom of the pie shell. Layer as follows, tortilla slices, kidney beans, lemon zest, and mustard mixture. Repeat layering until all ingredients are used. End with mustard and/or cheese on top. Let stand at room temperature for 30 minutes, or refrigerate for up to one day.

title: Raspberry Vinegar Risotto With Ramen Noodles
ingredients: 4 cups arborio rice ( about 6 cups r ) | 3 tablespoons raspberry vinegar | 12 ounces ramen noodles
instructions: Rinse 1 - 2 cups of arborio rice for a few seconds or, until the water runs clean. Drain and dry rice. Combine 4 cups arborio rice with 4 cups vinegar. Cook 10 minutes on the stove. Add 12oz ramen noodles to the rice and mix gently. Continue cooking on medium heat 5 - 7 minutes until liquid is absorbed and noodles are tender.

title: Potted Cherry Custard from England (Cherry Catsup) O.N.E.S.D.O. Style
ingredients: 1 pint tart cherries | 1 liter custard
instructions: Pour the cherries in to a pan with plenty of water and bring to the boil. Lower to a simmer for 30 minutes to an hour. Strain the juice into a bowl, and set aside for later use. Put the cherry juice through a sieve or sieve, discarding a thick bottomed saucepan canning spoon, and set aside. Whip the custard until creamy, and then gradually beat it into the juice until the custard is thick and shiny. Add any additional juice as you wish. To sterilize the molds, first pour enough boiling water into a basin, and set the moulds inches fill the canning can with boiling water at least half way up the sides of a pudding basin. Drain the cherries, pour juice over the cherries and put one tin into each one of the jars. Cover with clean, dry cloths and a little cloth cloth. Put the jars into a saucepan of boiling water for 5 minutes to make the custard easier to remove. Pack the cherry juice can onto the inside of each one, then close the lid. Place a tea towel between the lid and the jar because it will draw the steam out. Leave 2 3cm of cloth hanging over the top. Bake on oven trays for 10 - 15 minutes, until the custard is set and the canning has come out of the can easily. Leave to cool for a few minutes, then remove the jars and cloth. Serve at once.

title: Sticky Syrup Bread
ingredients: 1 lb bread dough | 1/2 cup golden syrup ( or maple syrup, to suit your tastes ) | 2 teaspoons celery seeds
instructions: Heat syrup in a small pan until it reaches 180 degrees f, then drop in celery seed. Let the bread absorb the syrup. Roll the bread dough out into a rectangle about 25 x 20 and cut into six equal strips or rectangles. Pour the syrup over the bread in the same fashion as the strips of bread dough. Spray a baking sheet with cooking spray. Sprinkle bread with celery seeds.

title: Kebab Rub II
ingredients: 7 ounces black mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon chili powder
instructions: In a nonstick skillet or dry frying pan, dry roast the mustard seeds until they blacken. They will pop right away in about 1 minute. Turn the seeds over, raise heat to medium high and let smoke for a minute. Remove from the heat and stir in the chili powder. Let cool.

title: Goat Cheese With Lemon and Rosemary on a Bed of Roasted Vegetables
ingredients: 500 g soft goat cheese | 3 lemons, juiced | 2 lbs fresh rosemary, sprigs | 2 vanilla beans
instructions: Combine all ingrdients except goat cheese in an ovenproof dish. Bake at 350ºf for 1 hour. Top with goat cheese and bake for 5 - 10 minutes until soft and golden. Serve hot with roasted vegetables.

title: Thai Basil Rice Balls
ingredients: 4 cups cooked rice | 1 tablespoon ground prepared mustard | 1 cup thai basil, chopped | 1 teaspoon ground mustard | 1/2 teaspoon almond essence
instructions: Combine mustard, basil and almond essence in microwave proof bowl.

title: Kur Sesha (Yakitori Lamb Stew)
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg lamb, cubed | 1 cup daikon radish, sliced thinly | 3 cups dry sherry wine
instructions: Cover lamb with cold water. Cover and leave overnight in refrigerator. Drain, washing and pat dry with paper towel. Combine in a large pan with daikon radish slices and sherry. Bring to boil, cover and simmer gently for 1 1/2 hours until lamb is cooked and daikon radishes are tender.

title: Crispy Chinese Chicken Supper
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sweet chili flakes ( optional ) | 1 lb chicken tenders | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs ( plain, or seasoned ) | 1 tablespoon chili flakes ( optional )
instructions: Brown the chicken with 1 tblsp of chili flakes. Drain and set aside. Preheat oven to 350°f and roll out the graham cracker crumbs, 1 tbsp of chili flakes and 1 tsp of chilli flakes into the crumbs for dipping into the chicken. Spread the chicken onto a baking sheet. Bake at 350°f for 40 - 50 minutes, or until cooked through. Serve the chicken straight from the baking sheet with dipping sauce or serve chicken on top of rice.

title: Easy Chilli Ham
ingredients: 120 g ham | 4 tablespoons sweet chili sauce ( or other sweet chilli sauce ) | 1/2 cup sweet rice wine ( or other dry white wine )
instructions: Wash ham and cut lengthways into strips. Cut strips into four strips, discarding excess fat. Blend all ingredients and pour over meat. Mix well. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for 4 hours or overnight. Thread meat onto skewers. Grill for about 15 minutes turning and brushing with marinade every 5 minutes to give them a glaze.

title: Easy Microwave Poached Cherries
ingredients: 16 ounces fresh sweet cherries, washed, stoned and wiped clean | 1/2 cup white breadcrumb | heavy whipping cream | ground cardamom
instructions: Put cherries in microwave for 2 to 3 minutes. Press through sieve. Stir in breadcrumbs and cream. Cover and leave to stand for 8 to 10 minutes. Taste and season if desired. Garnish with cardamoms. Variation bake the mixture in a non stick frypan on high for 10 – 15 minutes or until very light golden brown on top.

title: Easy Raspberry Crumble
ingredients: 1 jar raspberries ( fresh or frozen ) | 2 -3 cups italian seasoned breadcrumbs ( seasoned or commercial )
instructions: Drain the raspberries, saving the juice from about a tablespoon. Using a food processor, puree the raspberries into a fine paste. Spray a medium saucepan with non stick spray and add raspberries. Mix well. Add enough breadcrumbs to moisten the raspberries, to your likings and gently stir to coat the berries in crumbs. Transfer to an oven proof dish, or a large baking dish, and sprinkle remaining crumbs over the top. Place in preheated 375 degrees. After 30 minutes, remove baking dish from oven and bake for 10 to 25 minutes until crust is nicely browned on top.

title: Indian Tomato Fish Sauce
ingredients: 3 lbs fresh tomatoes in puree ( or 28 oz. of diced tomatoes ) | 1/4 cup coriander roots or 1/4 cup chopped fresh coriander | 1 -2 jalapeno | 3 -4 green onions | 1 teaspoon red chili powder
instructions: Puree all the ingredients until smooth or you can leave the tomato whole after puree is whized. Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: chili garlic sauce,hash brown potato,cheddar cheese,lasagna noodle,chili,puff pastry,cherry
title: Potato and Cheese Wrapped With Chili Potatoes
ingredients: 7 sheets frozen puff pastry ( thawed ) | 1/2 cup chili sauce | 7 ounces cheddar cheese, grated | 7 ounces smoked cheddar cheese, grated | 10 ounces frozen chopped sweet chili | 13 ounces frozen hash brown potatoes, thawed and chopped | 1/2 cup frozen cherries
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f place thawed pastry sheets on a baking tray. Brush with chili sauce to lightly coat. Bake in oven for 20 - 23 minutes or until golden. Set aside to cool. Combine cheeses, cherries and chili. Season if desired. Divide the potato mixture among 4 squares of baking paper. Layer with potato mixture. Roll to enclose cheese mix. Repeat with remaining dough, filling and potato mixture to make a second layer. Bake about 15 minutes or until golden.

title: Greek Shredded Zucchini in Paprika
ingredients: 2 zucchini, cut on a diagonal into 1/3-inch slices | 1 lb baby carrots, peeled | 3/4 cup half-and-half | 14 ounces pears, drained, and chopped | 1 teaspoon dried oregano
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f spread zucchini on a rimmed baking sheet coated with cooking spray, and bake 15 minutes, or until tender. In a large bowl, stir together remaining ingredients. Sprinkle with zucchini, return to oven, and bake for 20 minutes more.

title: Chicken for Two (Or Both)
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper ( or white pepper )
instructions: Sprinkle both sides of the breast with white pepper or white pepper. Place in shallow, nonstick baking dish. Cover with plastic wrap or a lid. Refrigerate for several hours or over night. Heat oven to 450 degrees. Drain chicken. Bake uncovered in preheated oven for about 20 minutes or untill meat is no longer pink inside.

title: Chickpea & Spinach Salad
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 180 g fresh baby spinach | 400 g corn kernels, drained | 150 ml double cream | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill
instructions: Combine chickpeas with the spinach in a bowl and combine. In a separate bowl, combine the cream and dill with a little cold water to bring it softly to the edge. Pour the cream cream on top and gently fold together. Pour the creamy cream mix over the salad and mix gently but thoroughly. Serve immediately.

title: Oysters With Oysters or White Clam Sauce
ingredients: 12 small oysters or 12 small clams | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 2 cups italian seasoned breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 475°f cut a small piece of kitchen foil big enough to accomodate the oysters or clams, about 2 1/4 x 1/4 wide, about 1/4 wide, but not deep enough to completely wrap around each clams. Spray a nonstick griddle or a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray and set over medium high heat. When it's hot, add about 1 tablespoon of the breadcrumbs. Add about 4 cups of the clam soaking liquid, stirring to moisten the breadcrumbs evenly. Add a pinch of baking powder, or to taste, and turn the heat up to medium high. You may need to add more clam soaking liquid, up to 1/2 cup or more. As soon as the mixture begins to bubble and sizzle, turn the shrimp with a wide spatula to coat the sides with the breadcrumbs. Scoop out any excess crumbs. Return the shrimp to the pan, close the lid and bake for 10 seconds, then turn. Place the shrimp on a serving platter, cover loosely with foil and marinate at least 30 minutes in the refrigerator. The shrimp will be cooked but the outside of the shell will still be wet. Spoon out any remaining cooking juices. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Crock Pot Sausage & Mallow Soup
ingredients: 2 packages sausages | 2 cans beef stock or ( 32 ounce ) cans chicken stock | 12 thin sliced white bread rounds | 8 slices kielbasa, chopped | 1 jar marshmallows
instructions: Put all ingredients in crock pot on high 3 hours.

title: Scallops With Pineapple Scented Vegetables
ingredients: 1/2 cup pineapple juice | 2 green cardamom pods | 1 cup belgian endive, sliced in 1/2-inch pieces | 1 cup mixed vegetables, sliced in 1/2-inch pieces ( optional ) | 1 1/2 lbs scallops | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh dill
instructions: To prepare scallops, drain juice from pineapple in a medium bowl, reserving 1/2 cup of the juice. Place cardamom pods in the bowl and pour boiling water over. Let stand 5 seconds, then remove stem and seeds and set aside. Cut endive and vegetables in half lengthwise and cut crosswise into 1/4 inch slices. Place scallops in a bowl of cold water and add cold water and set aside. Place the reserved 1/2 cup of drained pineapple juice in a medium nonreactive saucepan. Heat to boiling over medium heat. Add chopped endive, vegetables of choice and 1/4 teaspoon salt. Cover and simmer 3 to 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Meanwhile, strain reserved pineapple juice through a clean cheesecloth, discarding pulp, solids and seeds. Place the pineapple juice mixture back in saucepan and bring to boiling to loosen oily solids. Remove from heat and set aside. Heat remaining 2 tablespoons oil in a large nonstick skillet over high heat. Add scallops and cook 1 to 2 minutes each side, or until dark brown. Stir in reserved pineapple juice mixture. Remove scallops and garnish with fresh chopped dill.

title: Anise Spice
ingredients: 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1/2 tablespoon cajun seasoning
instructions: Mix and store in an airtight container.

title: Chinese Crumb Mix
ingredients: 1/2 cup breadcrumbs | 2 teaspoons minced green onions | 1 teaspoon oyster sauce
instructions: Add everything into a bowl and mix well. Refrigerate for 1 hour. Serve with your favorite meat, vegetables & shrimp.
