Random Ingredients: grand marnier,white wine vinegar,pork,cilantro leaf,garam masala
title: Cilantro Dressing
ingredients: 8 cups fresh cilantro leaves | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon minced garlic | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 1/2 cup grand marnier
instructions: Combine cilantro, vinegar, garam masala and ½ cup of grand marnier in a small jar with a tight fitting lid.

title: Aloupe Bourekas
ingredients: 3 tablespoons granulated sugar | kosher salt and fresh ground pepper | 2 cups coarsely chopped cantaloupe | 1 lb pastry, cut into 8 equal pieces | 1/4 lb fresh basil, very finely sliced
instructions: Combine sugar, salt, and pepper in large bowl, until well combined. Add cantaloupe cubes and combine well. Wet your hands well, then roll out the pastry about 1/8 thick on a floured surface. Using a 6 or 8 inch round cookie cutter or the rim of an 8 inch springform pan, cut out circles with the cutter. Arrange 1 cup of the cantaloupe, leaving a slightly lower end of the pan on top. Brush with the sugar mixture. Repeat with the remaining circles. Arrange the basil leaves over the cantaloupe. Using a fork, prick the top of each tart slightly with a fork. Pinch the edges of the tart and cut a slit in the center of each tart. Cover with foil and refrigerate tart for 2 - 3 hours or overnight. Preheat the oven to 350°f bake the tart for 1 hour 15 minutes, until the center of the tart is puffed and crisp. Let cool for 1/2 hour. Carefully remove the foil, cut out 6 wedges, and serve.

Random Ingredients: bow tie pasta,deli roast beef,soy sauce
title: Beef or Pork Rollatini
ingredients: 1 pound thinly sliced deli roast beef | 4 ounces uncooked bow tie pasta | 1/2 cup soy sauce
instructions: Preheat a broiler. Place the deli roast beef on a broiler tray. Cut it into strips about 1 inch long and 2 inches wide. Place on a broiler tray and broil for 6 to 8 minutes, or until brown. Remove roast beef from the broiler and slice it into thin strips. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add bow tie pasta and cook for 8 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: lemongrass,portobello mushroom,rosemary leaf,bread,tomato puree,habanero pepper,shell macaroni,black coffee
title: Portobello Smoked Macaroni With Black-Glen
ingredients: 2 packages shell macaroni ( dried ) | 1/8 cup dried bread, crumbs | 1 tablespoon grated fresh lemongrass | 6 -8 large portobello mushrooms, cleaned and sliced | 6 leaves fresh basil, chopped | 4 -6 jalapenos or 4 habanero peppers, seeded and chopped | 1 can tomato puree | 6 ounces strong black coffee | 3 sprigs fresh rosemary leaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Bring a large pan of water to a boil. Add macaroni and cook 6 - 8 minutes until al dente. Drain and set aside. Bring a large pan of water to a boil and add 2 tbsp olive oil. Cook mushrooms, 3 - 4 min, until tender. Drain and set aside. In a dutch oven, toast crusty bread until well toasted. Reserve until ready to use this can be cooked up to an hour in advance. Combine macaroni, mushroom mixture, black eyed beans, 3 tbsp olive oil, basil, jalapenos/ habanero peppers, and tomato puree. Pour into oven safe dish and cover with lid or foil. Bake in oven, stirring often and cooking through for 15 mins per pound. Remove lid for last 5 min to crisp up.

title: Cannellini Beans Beans
ingredients: 2 cans cannellini beans ( navy beans ) | 4 lbs chicken wings ( about 6 to 8 wings )
instructions: Put everything into the crockpot. Turn on and cook on low for 6 hours. Remove from cooker and eat enjoy.

Random Ingredients: onion salt,monterey jack pepper cheese,picante sauce,peach,tomatillo
title: Peach and Jack Cheese Salad
ingredients: 2 fresh ripe peaches, sliced | 1 cup monterey jack pepper cheese, grated | 1 jar picante sauce | 1 small onion salt | 2 fresh tomatillos, washed and trimmed
instructions: Place sliced peaches in a bowl and cover with monterey jack cheese. Stir in tomato sauce, onion salt and tomatillos. Cover and chill 8 to 12 hours or overnight.

title: Pimientos and Beef
ingredients: 2 -3 pimento-stuffed pimiento | 3 cups beef bouillon cubes
instructions: Peal pimentos with a slice of papper, then soak in hot water until tender. Keep warm. Drain. In a saucepan, simmer the bouillon cubes until dissolved. Add the pimientos to the bouillon and cook for another 3 minutes. Serve with crackers and bread.

title: Famous Mexican Pizza
ingredients: 16 ounces low fat mozzarella cheese | 2 cups tomato sauce | 1 cup fat free sour cream or 1 cup low fat cottage cheese | 2 teaspoons dried marjoram | 1/2 cup sliced almonds | 1 - 1 1/2 cup taco sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Combine mozzarella, tomato sauce, sour cream, marjoram, and ground almonds. Arrange in a lightly greased 10x15 pan. Bake for 15 - 20 minute. Top with taco sauce and bake an additional 5 minutes. Note, for a thicker pizza spread the tomato sauce on the crust and bake for another 5 minutes. Cut into four squares to serve.

title: Scotch Salmon
ingredients: 1 teaspoon cognac | 1 1/2 cups low-sodium chicken broth | 1 1/2 pounds salmon fillets, 1-inch thick
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Rub the cognac all over each salmon fillet. Pour the broth over and around the fillets. Place the fish on a baking sheet and bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until easily flaked with a fork.

title: Chef John's French Onion Tart
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cake flour | 4 large thinly sliced white onions | 1/4 cup yoghurt, to taste | 2 teaspoons brandy ( sherry works too ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence ( or to taste ) | 1 tablespoon prepared mustard ( optional, we don't use that ) | 1 pinch of white wine ( optional ) | 1 sheet prepared puff pastry, thawed ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon yoghurt and cream, to serve to serve to accompany
instructions: Drain onions well. Coat a non stick frypan or wok with oil or butter, and heat on high until oil is beginning to smoke around the edges of the pan. Add onions and stir for a few minutes, until the onions turn deep golden brown and the onions give off a sweeter flavor. Stir in yoghurt and brandy. Cook over medium heat until the milk solids start to thicken and evaporate, about 3 - 4 minutes. Season with vanilla essence, mustard and a pinch of white wine, if using. If using a spoon, spoon some mixture into the frypan, mix and roll around to create a tart crust. Continue to cook over medium heat for another 5 - 7 minutes, or until golden. Pour the yoghurt and cream into the dish and sprinkle with some fresh ground pepper.

title: Mexican Quinoa and Picante Sauce for One
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 1 cup picante sauce | hot sauce, to taste
instructions: Rinse quinoa and place in fine strainer. Cover with a couple of layers of damp cloth in a medium bowl. Cover with plenty of cold water, let sit for 5 minutes. Rinse thoroughly. Place drained quinoa and picante sauce in a deep skillet or saucepan and heat on medium low until warm. When sauce is warm transfer heat to low and discard quinoa. Cook quinoa until most of the liquid has evaporated. Once quinoa is cooked and there is no more liquid left pour into an 11 x 7 inch pan and sprinkle desired amount of hot sauce on top. Cover with foil or a lid and rest for 10 - 15 minutes. Uncover and fluff up any brown bits.

title: El Pato Poisado
ingredients: 12 poblano chiles, stemmed and seeded | 1/2 cup unsweetened peanut butter | 1 tablespoon vanilla bean paste
instructions: Roast the poblano chilies directly over a gas flame or under the broiler, turning frequently until blackened on all sides. Place on paper towels and let cool. Remove and discard all of the stem and seeds. Place in an electric blender or food processor and puree to a smooth paste. Place in a bowl and add the peanut butter and vanilla bean paste. Pour into a jar or resealable plastic bag. Seal and shake well to combine. Can be served warm or at room temperature.

title: Zucchini Taco Filling
ingredients: 4 to 6 medium firm zucchini | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon granules | 1 teaspoon dried chipotle powder | 1/2 cup salsa | 1/2 cup low-fat whipped topping | 1 -2 lettuce leaf
instructions: Cut zucchini in half lengthwise, scoop out the seeds and set aside. Pierce the shells several times with a fork. Boil zucchini halves until tender. Let cool a little and remove tops. Remove flesh of zucchini halves with a spoon, and mash with a potato masher. In a small skillet, add the chicken bouillon granules, chipotle and salsa, and cook over medium heat until warmed through. Add a little more salsa if the mixture is too soupy, the idea is good. Spread about 1/2 cup filling onto the zucchini shells, top with remaining filling. Top with whipped topping.

Random Ingredients: mustard seed,chocolate syrup,garlic oil,green chili pepper,salad green,celery leaf,fennel
title: Green Salad With a Yummy Dressing
ingredients: 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 4 green chili peppers, halved lengthwise | 1 tablespoon fennel, julienne | 1 teaspoon celery leaves, dried | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 teaspoon garlic oil | 1 ounce unsweetened chocolate syrup
instructions: Toast mustard seeds over medium heat in 1 tablespoon vegetable oil until blackened. Add chile and fennel, and cook for 1 minute. Remove from heat, and allow chiles to cool to room temperature. Place in a small mixing bowl. Add mustard seed mixture, celery leaves and oil. Toss to blend, and allow to cool to room temperature. Add cold chocolate syrup and mix gently, until it's mixed well. Chill thoroughly and cover or refrigerate up to 2 hours.

title: Kielbasa and Nachos
ingredients: 12 ounces frozen lobster, thawed, drained and chopped | 1/2 pound kielbasa sausage | 1 bag tortilla chips
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Bake the kielbasa sausage in a 9x13 inch baking dish for 15 minutes, or until browned and crumbly. Remove from heat, and set aside. Place the chopped lobster into a bowl, and mix in the kielbasa and tortilla chips. Bake for about 20 minutes in the preheated oven, until the kielbasa is hot and the tortilla chips are crisp and crisp on the outside. Serve.

Random Ingredients: english mustard,extra virgin olive oil,nonstick cooking spray,bay leaf
title: Whole Grain Mustard
ingredients: 2 tablespoons whole-grain english mustard | 1 bay leaf | 4 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil, plus | 2 teaspoons extra virgin olive oil | nonstick cooking spray
instructions: Prepare mustard as directed on package. To make bay leaf oil, heat 1 teaspoon of the oil in a non stick skillet over medium high heat. When it shimmers, add mustard and bay leaf. Reduce heat to medium and warm mustard until fragrant, about 1 minute. Add remaining 1 teaspoon oil and warm mustard until lightly browned, about 1 more minute. Toss mustard with warm mustard. Note, to prevent scorching, spray a large rimmed baking sheet or griddle with nonstick cooking spray. Turn the mustard out onto the pan and spread mustard on it in an even layer. Cool mustard completely and cut into desired serving size pieces.

title: Navy Bean Stew
ingredients: 1 bag fiddlehead | 1/2 lb fresh navy beans or 1/2 lb green beans | 3 baking potatoes, cubed | 2 medium apples, peeled cored, chopped | 1/4 cup fresh mint, leaves chopped | 4 fluid ounces bourbon or 4 fluid ounces ale
instructions: Place all ingredients into a large pan. Cover and simmer until vegetables are tender, about 2 hours.

title: Mashed Potatoes With Cranberry and Cashew Nuts
ingredients: 300 g floury potatoes | 1 can pinto beans ( drained or boiled ) | 500 g firm cashew nuts | 1/2 cup corn oil | 1/3 cup cashew nuts ( roughly chopped ) | 200 g gorgonzola ( i use cabot brand )
instructions: Heat oil in a wok, add the cashew nuts, then cook the cashew nuts until golden brown, and remove from heat. Wash the potato, but do not peel it. Halve it lengthwise, cut it in half again, cut in half again, make sure to cut it as thinly as possible. Drain the potato, peel and cut it into 4cm/1/2in pieces. Put the potato, cashew nuts, garghul beans & dried cranberries in a pan of cold water, mix well, and bring to boil, add the gorgonzola, stir and cook for 3 minutes, then serve.

title: Thai Basil and Lime Dipping Sauce for Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 cup basil chiffonade | 2 lime wedges | 1/4 cup thai basil, finely chopped
instructions: Place basil and lime wedge in a small shallow dish. Sprinkle with basil. Using your hand, lightly toss the ingredients together and serve.

title: Mama's Shrimp Stuffed With Bean Sprouts
ingredients: 1/4 lb pancetta ( or bacon or other fat ) | 1 small onion, finely chopped | 1 large clove, crushed | 2 teaspoons light brown sugar | 2 cups fresh bread crumbs | 1 cup fresh bean sprouts ( not frozen ) | 1 lb uncooked large shrimp, peeled and deveined
instructions: Heat the pancetta fat in a skillet over moderate heat. Sauté the onions and garlic until golden, about 5 minutes. Add the sugar, stirring till dissolved. Meanwhile, in a separate pan, make the crumbs by combining the bread crumbs and sprouts in a shallow dish. Set aside. When the pancetta fat is cool, remove the top layer of fat and reserve. Cut up the pancetta with scissors while still hot. Stuff the shrimp with some of the crumb mix and insert a shrimp stick into the middle of each. Replace any remaining crumb mix, and stuff the reserved crumb mix in. Close the stuffed shrimp with a skewer or toothpick. Place in a baking dish, cover with foil, and bake in a 350 degree oven till they turn pink, about 20 minutes. Serve with a green salad.

title: Lamb and Pumpkin Skewers
ingredients: 2 kg lamb, cut in 2. 5 cm cubes or 2 kg lamb pieces | 1 kg pumpkin, cut in 2. 5 cm cubes or 5 kg pumpkin, cut in 2. 5 cm cubes | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 2 medium red peppers, cut in 2. 5 cm pieces
instructions: For the marinade, combine the mustard with the mustard and set aside. Thread the lamb cubes onto 8 bamboo skewers that have been soaked for an hour in cold water. Barbecue or grill to your liking. Allow to cool, then put in fridge and marinate overnight in the fridge. Bake on a preheated oven at 190 degrees for 20 mins, or as recommended on your pack pack. If using pumkin squash, cut in half lengthwise, then cut into 1 1/2cm cubes.

title: On the Go...
ingredients: 2 sheets nori, torn into strips | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Arrange strips of nori in a single layer on a baking sheet. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake in the preheated oven until cheese is melted and center is hot, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: coffee,cream mushroom soup,onion flake,ajwain,ancho chile powder,multigrain bread,scallion,kewra essence
title: Ancho Bread Dip
ingredients: 1 cup multigrain bread, cubed | 2 tablespoons instant coffee | 1/2 cup chopped onion flakes | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1/4 cup chopped chinese five-spice or 1/4 cup enchilada sauce ( i use contadina ) | 1 teaspoon dried minced onion flakes | 1 1/2 tablespoons ground ancho chile powder | 1/2 teaspoon cajwain ( more if you like spicy food )
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine bread cubes, instant coffee, chopped onion, soup, chinese five spice, onion flakes, ancho powder, and cajwain. Mix well. Spoon into serving dishes or lightly toast your bread and serve.

title: Spinach in Curry
ingredients: 10 ounces fresh spinach | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/2 tablespoon baking powder
instructions: Wash spinach well and remove stems. Do not let it become limp and then cut the spinach in half length wise. Place spinach, tumeric and baking powder in a bowl and mix well. Add water to cover the spinach and set aside for 5 hours or overnight. Serve with indian chapati, rice or curd.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,beef sirloin,red onion,plum tomato,soy sauce,beef bouillon powder,french mustard,sausage
title: Quick Beef Tips and Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 lb beef sirloin, cut into strips ( more or less ) | 2 cans seasoned beef bouillon powder | 1/2 lb fresh hot sausage | 1 red onion, chopped | 2 plum tomatoes, chopped | 1 teaspoon reduced sodium soy sauce | 1 teaspoon french mustard ( or yellow mustard )
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet, brown the sirloin tips in hot oil in 1 1/2 batches. Transfer to lrg skillet and stir in beef bouillon powder, sausage, onion, tomatoes and sugar. Sprinkle with soy sauce. Cover, & cook over meduim heat 15 minutes or till meat is done.

title: Prosciutto Wrapped Provolone
ingredients: 4 slices prosciutto | 2 tablespoons hoisin sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons pure vanilla extract | 2 sprigs fresh rosemary leaves | 1 package dry paper
instructions: Combine hoisin sauce, vanilla, and rosemary in bowl.

Random Ingredients: wide egg noodle,honey,oyster sauce,tart apple,wine,chicken broth,prosciutto,fenugreek seed
title: Egg Noodle Soup (Liang Petit Gateau)
ingredients: 10 ounces wide egg noodles | 5 cups chicken broth | 4 ounces prosciutto or 4 ounces bacon, sliced thin | 2 tablespoons dried fenugreek seeds | 1 tablespoon dried fenugreek seeds | 1 tablespoon honey | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon wine | 2 large tart apples | 1 sprig fresh fenugreek and fresh mint ( to garnish )
instructions: Put chicken stock, prosciutto, fenugreek, honey, oyster sauce, and wine in a large saucepan. Bring to a boil, then add noodles. Cook for about 5 minutes, or until noodles are tender and have absorbed some of the cream. Transfer noodle soup to a platter, garnish with crumbled bacon, and garnish with a sprig of fenugreek and a sprig of mint. Serve hot.

title: Fish Nairobi Style (Bunemen)
ingredients: 1 1 lb fish fillets or 1 lb firm white fish | 1 1/2 teaspoons peanut oil
instructions: Heat oil a heavy frying pan and put the fish in the oil to fry.

Random Ingredients: peanut,red bell pepper,monterey jack cheese,chicken tender
title: Chicken Skewers
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chicken tenders | 2 red bell peppers | 1 cup shredded monterey jack cheese | 1/3 cup dry roasted peanuts
instructions: Place chicken tenders in a shallow tray with the peppers and seasonings. Spray broiler pan with cooking oil if desired and broil chicken skewers 4 to 5 minutes, turning once halfway through. To assemble skewers, arrange strips on a platter. Top with cheese and peanuts.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,sirloin steak,sage leaf,vegetable cooking spray,vinaigrette salad dressing,wasabi powder,hazelnut
title: Asian Beef Kabobs
ingredients: 3 lbs sirloin steaks, trimmed | vegetable cooking spray | vegetable cooking spray | 1/2 cup vinaigrette salad dressing | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 1 tablespoon wasabi powder | 2 -3 fresh sage leaves, finely chopped | 1/4 cup toasted hazelnuts, coarsely chopped
instructions: Cut steak lengthwise into 3/4 inch thick slices. Spray the skewers with cooking spray. Thread beef onto skewers. Set aside. In a small bowl, whisk together the vinaigrette dressing, curry paste, wasabi, and chopped sage. Brush the marinade over the skewers. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Spray a large baking sheet with cooking spray. Thread skewers onto the skewers. Preheat broiler. Grill skewers for 6 minutes, or until cooked through and slightly charred.

Random Ingredients: flour,flat leaf parsley,green curry paste,turnip,green pepper,wheat couscous,liquid smoke,red chili pepper
title: Beef & Couscous Salad
ingredients: 1/3 cup green curry paste | 1/2 cup liquid smoke | 1 lb boneless sirloin steak, fat trimmed, cut into thin strips | 1 medium green pepper, cut into strips | 1/2 cup reduced-sodium fat-free tempeh fat | 1/3 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 1/2 teaspoon red chili pepper, crushed | 1/3 cup hot cooked whole wheat couscous
instructions: Cook curry paste in 10 inch skillet over medium heat until fragrant, about 1 minute. Remove from heat. Pour 2 tablespoons curry paste in pan and stir in liquid smoke. Transfer to plate. Repeat with beef and green pepper. Sprinkle beef with salt and pepper and place in skillet, cooking until just cooked through, 2 to 3 minutes. Cut the beef into thin strips. Toss with peppers, parsley, curry paste, and remaining curry paste mixture. Serve with whole wheat couscous.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,banana,jasmine rice,wild rice,wine,cider vinegar,black pepper,plum tomato
title: Dees Red Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cooked wild rice | 2/3 cup cooked basmati rice | 2/3 cup uncooked jasmine rice | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 1/2 teaspoons cider vinegar | 2 large ripe banana, peeled and cubed | 1 medium plum tomato, seeded and chopped | freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Combine the soup, vinegar, bananas, tomatoes, and black pepper in a medium microwave safe bowl. Add to rice and stir to coat. Cover and microwave for 10 minutes on high, or until hot and bubbling.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,grain white rice,seasoning salt,parmesan cheese,tomato juice,savory
title: Parmesan-Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 1 can diced tomatoes packed in juice, with juice | 2 tablespoons dried savory or 1 tablespoon oregano | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon ground red chili peppers | 1/2 - 1 cup uncooked long-grain white rice | chicken seasoning ( such as mccormick's montreal brand ) | mrs. dash seasoning salt ( optional ) | 1 -2 tablespoon grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Pre heat oven to mix tomatoes, spices, and rice in large bowl. Place in a glass casserole. Sprinkle top generously with cheese. Bake uncovered 30 minutes.

title: Spaghetti With Fish and Coriander
ingredients: 2 white fish fillets ( such as snapper or cod ) | 200 g frozen corn kernels | 1 bunch fresh coriander, chopped ( cilantro or parsley stems are best ) | 1 bottle vodka ( e.g. schab ) | 500 g spaghetti
instructions: In a large frying pan or stew pot, heat 1/4 cup of the vodka on medium high. Sear the fish for 3 - 5 minutes on each side. Using a slotted spoon, remove the fish and set aside on a plate while you add the rest of the vodka and the corn kernels to the pan. Add the coriander and stir to coat with the vodka. Pour in the contents of the bottle of vodka and let reduce by 50% or until the contents have reduced by half. Stir occasionally. When the vodka has become cloudy, add the spaghetti and a cup of water to thin. Add cooked corn. Bring to a boil, then lower the heat, cover and let simmer until tender, about 11 minutes. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: gingerroot,pimento pepper,cider vinegar,sage leaf,ale,chickpea,cilantro leaf,cottage cheese
title: Chickpea and Cheddar Salad With Sage
ingredients: 2 1/3 cups low fat cottage cheese, drained | 14 slices gingerroot ( about 1/3 inch thick, see note below ) or 14 slices fresh ginger root ( about 1/3 inch thick, see note below ) | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 1 teaspoon dried rubbed sage or 1/8 teaspoon dried sage | 1 can chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro leaves or 2 tablespoons fresh parsley, minced | 3 tablespoons pimento bell peppers and 3 tablespoons pimento-pepper flavored bits
instructions: In bowl, combine 1 cup of the cottage cheese and 1/4 cup of the ginger slices. In another bowl, combine the vinegar, sage and chickpeas, and stir until well blended. Add to cheese mixture. Stir in the remaining ginger and onion slices. Cover and chill at least 4 hours or up to 3 hours. Just before serving, stir in the cilantro and peppered pimentos.

Random Ingredients: heinz ketchup,serrano chili,barley,vanilla ice cream,shiitake mushroom,chive
title: Cha Traopatra (Italian Barley Float)
ingredients: 100 g small dried shiitake mushrooms, reconstituted in hot water for 15 minutes, cut into quarters | 6 tablespoons chives, finely chopped | 1 -2 serrano chili, seeds from, finely chopped ( depends on how hot you want it ) | 5 tablespoons heinz ketchup | 1 liter vanilla ice cream or 1 liter vegetarian ice cream | chives, dried for garnish
instructions: Put the shiitakes in a bowl with boiling water until tender, about 15 minutes, but no more than 15 minutes. Drain, reserving liquid. Finely dice the shiitakes. Add the chives, chile, and Heinz ketchup to the shiitakes. Set them aside in the freezer until chilled. Just before serving, divide the ice cream among the 4 serving glasses. Spoon in some ice cream and sprinkle with some chives. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,rice vinegar,beer,white rice flour,walnut,rotel tomato,kidney bean
title: Smokin' Hot Mexican Brown Rice
ingredients: 1 cup white rice flour | 1 cup kidney bean | 1 cup green giant canned rotel tomatoes | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 3 drops hot chili oil | 2 tablespoons beer | 1/4 cup walnuts, chopped
instructions: Boil rice in 3 cups water until done. Drain and let cool, then add rest of ingredients in large bowl or baking dish. Mix thoroughly. Spray large skillet with non stick spray, then put in layer mixture into pan. Turn mixture around quickly, so it evenly coats the bottom. Cover skillet with tin foil and put in 250 degree oven. Cook for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Cut into slices. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,balsamic vinegar,chicken wing,spanish onion,green cardamom pod,artichoke heart,chili garlic sauce,fettuccine
title: Chili Chicken and Artichoke Pasta
ingredients: 1 tablespoon pure chili-garlic sauce | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 2 teaspoons vegetable stock | 1/2 spanish onion, diced | 1 green cardamom pod | 7 ounces fettuccine | 10 ounces chicken wings | 3 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil ( plus extra for drizzling )
instructions: In a small saucepan, stir together the chili infused oil, vinegar and stock. Heat through over medium heat and add the onion and green cardamom pods. Drain fettucine and cut into halves or thirds. Add to saucepan and cook to desired tenderness. Meanwhile, heat olive oil in a frying pan or wok. Deep fry the chicken for about 4 minutes, until browned. Remove chicken and slice.

title: Crunchy Crunchy English Fruit Salad
ingredients: 4 cups strawberries, hulled, halved | 4 cups blueberries, to taste | 3 red capsicums, peeled, sliced | 1 1/2 cups whole oats | 1/8 cup pumpkin pie spice | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/4 cup fresh parsley, chopped, plus more for garnish | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon almond flavoring
instructions: Combine the oats, pumpkin pie spice, and salt in a medium bowl. Add the strawberries and blueberries and toss lightly to coat. Set aside for 30 minute. Sprinkle each serving with a sprinkling of the extra herbs. Serve immediately.

title: Italian Sushi
ingredients: 10 cardamom pods | 4 teaspoons lemonade | 1 can italian-style diced tomatoes | 3 apricot brandy | 1 cup buttermilk | 1/2 cup cooking oil | 6 nori, pieces ( sushi packages ) | 1 pint half-and-half
instructions: In small baking pan, toast the cardamom pods over medium heat 3 to 5 minutes, or until they start to change color. Remove from heat and grind to a fine powder. Add lemonade and tomatoes to blender and blend until smooth. Pour into a bowl and stir in the brandy. Cover and chill. Heat oil in a saucepan over medium heat until hot enough to float a spoon. Place the nori in the skillet and fry for 1 minute. Cut into 2inch long pieces. Stir in buttermilk, followed by the cardamom powder and apricot brandy mixture. Bring to boil. Remove from heat. Pour half and half into a shallow bowl. Ladle into bowls and top with ground cardamom powder.

title: Wild Fungilli
ingredients: 3 cups white flour | 1 1/2 cups broccoli florets, blanched and peeled | 1/2 cup white poppy seeds | 4 tablespoons chopped fresh tarragon | 4 tablespoons chopped fresh basil, or to taste
instructions: Place flour in a large mixing bowl and stir in broccoli. Mix in poppy seeds, tarragon, and basil. Knead dough on floured surface until smooth. Add more or less flour, a teaspoon at a time, if dough is too dry. Add additional flour if it seems dry. Divide dough into 2 pieces. With floured hands, roll into 2 inch balls. Flatten each ball into a 3 inch circle. Cover with damp paper towels and let rest 30 minutes. Preheat a large nonstick pan over medium high heat. Place half of the dough circles in the pan and turn when bottom is pale golden brown, 4 or 5 times. Cook for 1 to 2 minutes, until bottom is light brown. Turn half of the dough circles over and press flat. Repeat until all dough circles are rolled into the same size. Cook cakes for 2 minutes, pressing down with the paper towels to flatten. Cooks should not be done in batches, and should be cooked on the underside. Allow to cool 5 minutes, then remove to a platter.

Random Ingredients: water,tarragon,russet potato,chicken breast half,chile pepper,bamboo shoot,grand marnier
title: Chicken in Hot Garlic Sauce on the Barbie
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds boneless, skinless chicken breast halves | 2 russet potatoes, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 can sliced bamboo shoots | 1/2 cup water | 1 cup grand marnier | 1 cup chopped fresh tarragon | 4 chile peppers, seeded and chopped
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add the chicken breasts to the water, and continue to boil until no longer pink in the center, about 10 minutes. Drain, and cool. Slice the chicken into strips about 1/4 inch wide, about 3/4 inch long and about 2 inches long. Place the potatoes into a large bowl, and cover with cold water. Let stand for 5 minutes to soften slightly. Remove the potatoes from the water, and place in the center of a dinner plate. Pour 1/4 cup of water over them. Add the remaining ingredients, and stir gently until evenly combined. Arrange the chicken strips onto the potatoes. Drizzle with the other 1/4 cup of water and top with toothpicks. Wrap in the toothpicks, and refrigerate for 2 hours. Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat, and lightly oil the grate. Grill the chicken for 4 minutes per side, until juices run clear. Place under the coals until well browned on top. Turn, and baste with the hot garlic sauce until fully cooked.

title: Manchego Cheese Manchego
ingredients: 2 large cooking apples - peeled, cored, and shredded | 20 ounces manchego cheese, crumbled | 1 can currants or to taste | 5 ounces white sugar | 1 pinch ground allspice
instructions: Mix apples, cheese, currants, sugar, and allspice together in a bowl. Chill at least overnight for best flavor. Serve in mugs and swirl with warm rum if desired.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,soymilk,white pepper,ginger garlic paste
title: Ginataalikas
ingredients: 1 can plain soymilk | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 beef bouillon cube, crushed | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Put milk into a medium sized bowl. Put in the ginger garlic paste. Add the beef bouillon cube and white pepper. Stir. Add soy milk and stir until all ingredients are incorporated. Make sure they are blended well.

Random Ingredients: gorgonzola,vegetarian bean,white bread flour,habanero pepper,salad green
title: Vegetarian Gorgonzola Sandwich Filling
ingredients: 1/2 lb vegetarian refried beans | 3 tablespoons white bread flour | 2 slices white bread, crusts removed, cut in half ( thick slices ) | 1 ounce gorgonzola | 3 habanero peppers ( seeded, and minced ) | salad greens ( optional )
instructions: Put beans in frying pan. Sauté over a medium heat for about five minutes, stirring occasionally. Add flour and stir to prevent sticking. When it begins to thicken a little, add one slice of bread and brown it slightly, but don't let it burn. The cheese doesn't need to melt completely.

title: Ancho Chile Crusted Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs chuck, cut in half | 2 medium red dried ancho chiles, stemmed seeds removed, cut crosswise into 1 1/2-inch wide strips, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f degrees. In 1 quart heavy bottomed skillet, cook chili slices over medium heat, stirring frequently, until blackened, about 15 seconds. Transfer to paper towels to drain. Pat dry. Set aside. Remove skillet from heat. Pat beef dry. Insert 1/4 teaspoon ground ancho chile into each slice. Arrange coated beef in skillet in 2 rows, overlapping slices. Bake until beef is tender and crusty, about 30 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: rice,ancho chile,yogurt,fenugreek seed,almond,puff pastry,self raising flour,amaretto liqueur
title: Nari's Bajra Parcels (Cheese Flavored Scones or Exotic Sciddles)
ingredients: 150 g self-raising flour | 1/2 teaspoon amaretto liqueur | 1/4 teaspoon fenugreek seeds | 1/4 teaspoon dried ancho chile, crushed | 1 sheet puff pastry, defrosted if dried | 1 -2 tablespoon yogurt, to glaze | freshly ground almonds, to glaze | 1 -2 slice raw almonds, for garnishing
instructions: Mix the flour, amaretto, fenugreek and chile. Cut the sheet of puff pastry into 4 squares. Brush the edge of each square with a little melted yogurt to lightly grease the surface. Use the back of a spoon to make indentations in the flour mixture. Mix 1 teaspoons of your freshly ground almonds with the yoghurt. Sprinkle half of the sifted almond mixture over each square. Add a couple of heaped teaspoons of the floured mixture across the top of each square to form a flat top crust. Using sharp knife, trim as much of the crust as possible away from you so that the scone does not stick out. You may have to press the edges to seal. Preheat the oven to 200c or 400f or gas mark 10. Place about 12 of the scones on ungreased baking sheet, about 7 inches from the heat, and brush the tops lightly with more melted yoghurt. Bake in the centre of the oven for 15 - 20 minutes until they are puffed up and browned, and crisp. Serve scones with yogurt gravy, fresh dill, and/or fresh mint leaves.

title: Crock Pot Beef Burgundy
ingredients: 2 lbs beef chuck | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Slurize the meat into 1/4 inch wide strips. Place in crock pot. Sprinkle remaining ingredients over meat. Cook on high for 10 hours.

title: Super Easy Sauerkraut Guacamole
ingredients: 1 package sauerkraut | 2 avocados - peeled, pitted and diced | 2 slices salami
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the sauerkraut, and return to a boil. Cook uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the sauerkraut has melted, about 5 minutes. Stir in the avocados, and season with salt. Serve warm.

title: Crispy Fish Pasta.
ingredients: 1 3/4 lbs tilapia fillets or 1 3/4 lbs fish fillets, about 1 1/2 inches thick | 1/2 cup shredded icing sugar | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon chili oil | 1 jar pasta sauce, from a jar of your favourite jar | 1 tablespoon currants ( optional )
instructions: Line the pan about 3/4 full with wax paper and put over high heat. When bubbles start to form, add the icing sugar and continue stirring until the icing turns glossy, about 2 seconds. Turn the fish and spread to coat both sides well with icing sugar. Quickly toss in the chilli oil and spread around the fish evenly. Pour in the pasta sauce and stir to combine. Place the pan over medium high heat for 1 - 2 minutes then flip the fish over, spreading evenly. Remove the pan from the heat and let stand about 5 minutes. Cut into strips or chunks and serve immediately. This will keep in an air tight container for up to a month.

title: Green Curry Sauces
ingredients: 1/2 cup green curry paste | 1/2 cup burgundy wine
instructions: Combine 1/2 cup curry paste, wine and green curry paste in glass jar. Shake well. Use as directed in recipes.

title: Thai Chilli Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/2 cup sweet corn | 1/2 cup sweet red curry paste | 1/2 cup sliced button mushroom | 1 small banana
instructions: Blanch whole sweet corn with a tablespoon or two of water, drain. Steam mushrooms and whole sweet corn over a little of the liquid for a little while until tender. Heat curry paste with a little of the liquid until the paste is transparent and fragrant.

title: Grilled Papaya Wedges for Two
ingredients: 2 cups papayas, cubed | 2 tablespoons limeade concentrate, thawed | 2 teaspoons salad oil | 1 cup breadcrumbs
instructions: Combine papaya, limeade concentrate and oil. Pour over bread crumbs. Marinate in refrigerator 15 minutes. Thread papaya and barbecue 5 minutes per side.

title: The Best   Mouldy Midsummer Dinner in the World!
ingredients: 200 g plain yogurt | 150 g frozen whipped topping, thawed ( you can also use aerosol whipped topping ) | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Place the thawed whipped topping in serving bowl and refrigerate until ready to serve. Place the thawed yogurt in the container of a mixer. Add the ground mace, ground nutmeg, and ground mace. Beat well together and taste for seasoning, adjust to suit your preferences. Serve the mouldy mixture onto plates with the prepared whipped topping as an appetizer and a snack.

title: Almond Stock
ingredients: 4 tablespoons chicken bouillon ( homemade or canned ) | 2 -3 dried red chilies, torn into pieces | 10 fluid ounces blanched almond, roughly chopped | 1 tablespoon sloe | 1 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Place chicken bouillon into a 2 cup measure and set aside. Add dried chilies, blanched almonds and sloe. Stir until everything is mixed in the chicken bouillon. Add almond extract to the broth at this point. Cover and bring to the simmer for 30 minutes. Strain all solids from the broth and discard solids. Refrigerate.

title: Corn and Apple Salad With Lemon-Spice and Chiles
ingredients: 8 ears sweet corn | 1 small beetroot | 1/4 cup dried red chilies | 1 small tart apple | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon pepper ( or seasoning of your choice, but be aware that lemons vary in juiliy ) | 1/8 teaspoon allspice | 1 -2 slice prosciutto ( thin slices ) or 1 -2 slice ham, about 8 x 3 inches ( thin slices ) | 1/2 cup dried cranberries or 1/2 cup craisins, for garnish
instructions: Place corn on to a baking sheet pan and cook in the oven 400 degree fahrenheit for about 45 minutes or until tender. Peel and core the beet and roughly chop. Place on a cutting board, cut side down, and chop finely. Toss with the dried chilies, apple, lemon pepper, and allspice. Spread one third of the mustard on the corn and sprinkle with one third of the cheese. Fold one third of the sliced prosciutto or ham over the mustard followed by the beetroot and then continue folding until each package is covered and secured. Repeat steps 4 - 6 with the remaining ingredients. Transfer to a serving platter and garnish with chilie crumbled.

title: Crock Pot Smoked Garlicky Pepperon Bell Peppers
ingredients: 1 bell pepper, sliced into rounds | 8 ounces cream of celery soup | 1 tablespoon dried sage leaves
instructions: Place the sliced bell pepper along one of the long sides of a baking dish. Put the top down in order for it to be greasy. Mix together the soup and sage in the container. Pour soup over the top of pepper slices. Place the dish in the slow cooker. Reduce heat to low. Cook for 4 to 5 hours, or until the peppers are dark and tender.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,tahini,ancho chile,golden syrup,tomato paste,broccoli
title: Baked Broccoli
ingredients: 1 kg broccoli | 1 cup tahini | 1 cup tomato paste | 1 dried ancho chiles | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 1/4 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Line a baking tray with baking paper. Cut the broccoli into small florets. Rinse and dry thoroughly, then cut away the hard core. Place the broccoli into a large mixing bowl, sprinkle over the tahini, and add all the other ingredients. Mix well, and transfer to the prepared baking tray. Bake for 30 minutes, or until the broccoli is tender.

Random Ingredients: mexican chocolate,basmati rice,mint,american cheese,bread crumb,cauliflower,coriander powder
title: Chilis Au Gratin
ingredients: 1 package white american cheese | 1 package mexican chocolate | 2 heads cauliflower, cut up | 3 cups seasoned bread crumbs, flakes | 1 cup chopped fresh mint | 1/2 cup chopped fresh coriander powder | 1 package basmati rice
instructions: Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Cut the cheese into 1 cubes, 1 inch pieces. Wrap in foil and place in a 350 degree oven for 8 minutes. Remove the cheese cubes and set aside. Cut the cauliflower into 1 inch florets. Place in a steamer basket and cover with water. Bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,green chile,balsamic vinegar,cayenne pepper,green bell pepper,champagne vinegar
title: Spanish Hot Chickpeas
ingredients: 2 cans diced green chiles | 1/2 green bell pepper, chopped | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 3 tablespoons champagne vinegar | 1 1/2 cups tomato juice | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Combine all ingredients together in a blender or food processor and puree until smooth. Pour sauce into a saucepan, bring to a boil and simmer for 5 minutes.

title: Bouillon
ingredients: 2 tablespoons harissa ( see harissa har harina ) | 1 bouquet garni, bouquet garni | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 tablespoon sugar
instructions: Remove 1/3 to 1/2 cup of water when removing the stem, then add. Sprinkle with. 1 tablespoon of salt. Blanch 10 - 15 seconds or until they float to the surface. Remove. Continue to drain off the liquid for one or two minutes. In a heavy bottomed pan, add the harissa. Saute 5 minutes on low to medium heat. It should be fairly dry. Add the bouillon. Cook slowly without stirring until it is thick enough to coat the back of a spoon, or to your taste. Take off of heat and add sugar. Do not burn.

title: Quick and Easy Vegetarian Cucumber and Pita Bread Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup old-fashioned oatmeal ( not instant ) | 1 small english cucumber, diced ( or more if you like ) | 1 bay leaf | 1 box couscous ( i like whole wheat )
instructions: Bring 3 - 5 cups of water to a boil, and add the oatmeal and diced raw english cucumber. Cover the pan and stir to blend and heat the water. Meanwhile, cook the couscous, as directed on the box.. Drain. When the couscous has finished cooking, add the cooled, mixed couscous & a bay leaf. Let sit 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork and serve.

title: Chinese Sweet Potato Dipping Sauce for Ramen
ingredients: 1 package top ramen noodles or ( 1 pkg ) package hot dogs | 2 tablespoons wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon potato starch | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 2 tablespoons black coffee
instructions: Boil a pot of water and pour in ramen noodles. Cook for 3 minutes, turn noodles, cook an additional 3 - 4 minutes. Pour in wine vinegar and potato starch while stirring. Add vanilla and black coffee while stirring to combine well. Serve hot.

title: Bacon With Apricots
ingredients: 8 ounces canadian bacon, chopped | 6 tablespoons peanut oil | 24 apricots, halved
instructions: Place bacon in saucepan of electric skillet and cook over direct medium heat, stirring frequently, until most of the fat has melted and the bacon has turned golden, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir canadian bacon into bacon mixture. Heat oil in skillet over medium heat until almost smoking. Arrange apricots in bowl of hot oil and pour bacon mixture over.

title: Easy Beef Tostaditas
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs boneless beef roast | 1 can beef broth | taco sauce | 2 tablespoons butter ( optional )
instructions: Place roast in crockpot. Pour beef broth over roast and cover. Cook on low 7 - 9 hours. Take beef out and shred. Pour off all excess liquid. If desired, stir in taco sauce. Slice beef thinly and serve in tortillas. Serve with shredded cheese, salsa, guacamole, etc.

title: Fruit Salad
ingredients: 3 ounces rice wine | 2 ounces raspberry flavored syrup | 1 tablespoon celery, finely chopped
instructions: Put all the ingredients into a bowl. Mix thoroughly before eating as the fruit should be fairly runny but not too runny.

Random Ingredients: coffee granule,vegetarian bean,topping,spinach,french bread,beef brisket,coriander powder,cotija cheese
title: Tunisian Beef and Beans (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 lbs beef brisket, trimmed | 2 cans vegetarian baked beans | 2 packages frozen spinach, thawed and drained | 1 cup cotija cheese, coarsely grated ( use mexican gorgonzola cheese if you can't find to use cotija ) | 2 packages french bread | toppings, from fondue crumb ( see below ) | 1/4 cup instant coffee granules or 1/4 cup hot tea powder | 1 teaspoon coriander powder
instructions: In large bowl, toss brisket with beans and enough hot tap water to cover and place in crock pot/slow cooker on high heat. Reduce heat to low and cook on high setting for 9 hours. Discard liquid. Remove brisket and allow to come to room temperature before slicing. Toast bread by heating until slightly browned. Using two forks, pull off bread from crusts and break into chunks. In large bowl, toss meat, beans, spinach, cheese, bread chunks, coffee granules, and coriander powder. Serve with warm french bread. To freeze, place in an airtight container and freeze overnight. The next day, remove meat and cool completely in refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: apple cider,honey,grenadine,dark red kidney bean,limoncello,tart apple,mexican cheese
title: Crock Pot Caramelized Apple Dip
ingredients: 2 large tart apples ( red delicious are good ) | 4 teaspoons dark red kidney beans ( drained of excess liquid ) | 4 teaspoons limoncello | 1 tablespoon apple cider or 1 tablespoon apple juice | 1 teaspoon honey ( optional ) | 1/2 lb mexican cheese, grated | 1/2 teaspoon grenadine
instructions: Peel apples. Cut into 1/4 inch thick slices and cut slices in half at an angle. Place apple, beans and limoncello in slow cooker and stir to blend. Add remaining ingredients except cheese, and stir to melt cheese. Cover. Cook on high 8 hours. When ready to serve, remove cheese from slow cooker and combine with apples and serve on top of warm corn chips.

title: Pomegranate, Garlic and Paprika Spaghetti (Spaghetti Espanolano)

instructions: Heat spaghetti sauce, soup, milk, molasses, herbs and sugar in medium saucepan over low heat, stirring until heated through. Serve warm on a plate with grated carrot.

title: Orange Prune Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 500 g broccoli, trimmed, washed and dried | 500 g prunes, pitted | 1 -2 tablespoon orange marmalade
instructions: Cook broccoli in plenty of boiling, salted water, until just tender, 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Jagic (Ethiopian Bean and Sausage Rolls)
ingredients: 1/2 tablespoon liquid smoke, such as < a href= '' https : //www.geniuskitchen.com/recipe/jagic-spanish-spanish-kosher-sauce-dulce-4926 '' > dutch sauce dorba spanish sofrito < /a > | 3 packages yellow wax beans, cooked ( or soak soaked and drained ) | 1 lb fresh raspberries or 1 lb frozen raspberries | 1 container low-fat greek yogurt | 2 teaspoons prepared pesto sauce | 3 -4 jalapeno slices, seeded and chopped ( with seeds ) | filling, see note
instructions: Heat a skillet or sizzling skillet over medium high heat. Add enough olive oil to cover the bottom of the pan about 1 1/2 inches up the side of the pan and bring to a boil. Cut off the ends of yellow wax beans and cut 1 long piece of wax around each bean. Place the pieces of wax beans in the hot skillet in a single layer, making sure the pieces don't overlap. Cook the whites of the beans just until the bottoms start to turn dark, about 5 minutes per side. Carefully fold each piece of wax bean over the cooked whites and add the water chestnuts. Cook until the water chestnut mixture reaches the desired thickness, about 5 to 10 minutes. Remove from the heat and allow to cool completely. Make a cross into each bean and spread a thin layer of greek yogurt on the bottoms. Add a few pickled jalapeno slices across the top of the yogurt. Spread 2 teaspoons of pesto per bean on top. Roll up like a jelly roll, and cut into thin slices with a serrated knife or chefs knife. Note, make sure you cut the beans as close to the center as possible so as to form a tight cylinder. The yogurt should not be fully submerged in the yogurt mixture. If you find that the oil is cooking too quickly, cover the bean rolls with yogurt mixture. Cover the bean rolls tightly with a paper towel to absorb excess excess yogurt mixture, pressing the towels to squeeze out excess moisture and to help keep them from sticking together. Sprinkle with desired amount of kosher salt and refrigerate until serving. Note, to store, place cooked, drained yellow beans in an air tight container and store in the sun. If desired, you can skip this step. The greek yogurt can be frozen wrapped in plastic bags for up to 1 month.

Random Ingredients: applesauce,almond extract,onion flake,tortilla,garlic clove,spanish onion,beef chuck roast,clove
title: Easy Easy Spanish Beef
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs boneless beef chuck roast, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 1/2 large spanish onions or 1 1/2 large yellow onions, chopped | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1 garlic cloves or 1 garlic clove, minced | 1/4 cup apple-oil unsalted butter or 1/4 cup olive oil | 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves | 1/4 teaspoon ground almond extract | purchased spanish onion flakes ( optional ) | tortillas
instructions: Pre heat the oven to 375°f. Place all the ingredients in a large, shallow baking dish. Cover and bake for 4 - 3 hours. Remove from the oven, uncover, and let stand for 15 minutes. Strain the beef and onions to remove all the grease.

title: Fidel Diner's Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef, cut into 1 inch pieces | 2 cups dark brown sugar
instructions: Pre heat oven to 350 degrees. Add brown sugar to beef, stir in well. Cover and bake for 1 hour. Cook covered for 30 minutes. Dirt with a jar of worcestershire sauce, serve with rice and a veggie.

Random Ingredients: cheddar cheese,mexican cheese,turnip green,beef chuck roast
title: Pampered Chef Mexican Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs beef chuck roast, trimmed | 1 bag frozen turnip greens | 1 bag shredded mexican blend cheese | 2 cups shredded cheddar cheese, divided
instructions: Place meat in large, deep roasting pan. Pour enough water over meat to cover. Preheat oven to 325°f. Cover pan with aluminum foil and bake for 2 hours. Remove foil and bake an additional 45 minutes or until roast and turnip are tender. Remove from oven and stir turnip and beef and 1/2 the cheese. Replace foil and bake an additional 5 minutes or until browned.

title: Guajillo Chiles
ingredients: 3 guajillo chilies, stemmed, seeded, and chopped ( new mexico chiles ) | 3 tablespoons chopped italian parsley | 1/2 cup asiago cheese, shredded
instructions: Roast the chiles on a comal or ridged grill pan over medium hot heat, turning frequently, until blistered, 5 to 7 minutes. Remove from heat and immediately sprinkle with boiling water. Let drain for 1 to 2 minutes. Place in a plastic bag and close. When cool, scrape chiles with a wetened fingers until all the meat is lost. Add the parsley. Toss to coat. Spread on a plate and sprinkle with asiago and serve.

Random Ingredients: lamb chop,olive oil,jumbo shrimp,chipotle chile,celery,wine,fish sauce
title: Chocolate-Shrimp With Smoky Lamb Chops
ingredients: 4 jumbo shrimp, shelled deveined and deveined | 8 ounces boneless lamb chops, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 jumbo shrimp, shelled deveined and deveined | 2 tablespoons olive oil, divided | 2 cups celery, sliced diagonally | 1 chipotle chile, seeded, finely chopped | 3 -4 tablespoons sweet wine | 2 -3 tablespoons fish sauce
instructions: Sprinkle the lamb with salt and pepper. Place lamb, if using, on a plate and set aside. In a medium skillet, heat 1 tablespoons olive oil over medium high heat and brown lamb on all sides. Remove lamb and set aside. Add 1 tablespoon of the oil and sauté the celery until tender, stirring frequently. Add chile, and continue stirring. Add wine and cook 2 minutes to reduce. Stir in fish sauce. Remove from heat. Lamb should remain pink in the center. Preheat oven to 200 degrees f. Place a large ovenproof skillet with a lid over the skillet and place the pan in the oven. Place the shrimp on top of the skillet, close the lid and bake for 10 minutes. Do not open the oven until shrimp have turned pink, about 6 to 10 minutes. Carefully remove shrimp from skillet with a slotted spoon and place on a plate. Discard their fat. If using a gas stove, fill the skillet with a half inch depth and heat over medium heat. Add the remaining oil and when it is hot, add the lamb and shrimp. Turn meat and shrimp over and sprinkle with sweetened wine. Bake until shrimp are done and lamb is starting to brown, about 2 minutes more.

title: Corn, Coriander & Ricotta Mash
ingredients: 250 g corn kernels | 250 g ricotta cheese | 1 bunch coriander, leaves ripped from stalks
instructions: Blanch the corn in boiling water for 10 minutes. Drain well. Heat the ricotta in a large cast iron frypan. Add the corn and toss to combine. Remove from heat, season and stir in the coriander. Serve.

Random Ingredients: cremini mushroom,corn tortilla chip,star anise,gem lettuce
title: Soy and Star Anise Wrapped Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 1/2 large fresh cremini mushrooms | 2 whole star anise | 20 corn tortilla chips | 10 leaves green giant® savoy greens
instructions: Cut a slit lengthwise down the center of each. Scoop out and discard the soft, central part of each mushroom. Place each mushroom, cut side down, onto a plate. Place a star anise into each opening, about 1 inch in diameter. Place a handful of tortilla chips onto a plate and lightly coat each one with some of the star anise. Lay a handful of greens across each of the four mushroom slices in an even layer. Starting at one end, roll the mushrooms up, tucking them underneath so they're firmly packed together. Place each wrap back onto the plate. Repeat the process with the remaining wraps, mushrooms, and star anise. Serve immediately.

title: Creamy Red Chile Cheese Bread (Pane Aglio E Olio)
ingredients: 7 -7 cups unbleached all-purpose flour | 1 1/4 teaspoons instant yeast | 1 1/2 tablespoons active dry yeast | 5 large dried red chilies, seeded | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground dried red chilies
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together flour, yeast, and salt. Make a well in the center of the dry ingredients. Combine the yeast, ground red chili, and ground chiles in a cup or small bowl and combine with the flour to form a firm dough. Knead on a floured surface until smooth and elastic. Cover loosely with a cloth and let rise until doubled. The dough can also be made as a 2 pita or bread pan by kneading in a 2 pound package of refrigerated bread and 1 1/2 pound of flour, then pressing into a ball. Place in lightly oiled bowl, cover with a cloth, and let rise 1 hour, or until doubled, or until puffy. Turn pita out onto a floured surface, divide into 4 pieces, and flatten each piece so that each piece fits tightly. Place the pieces onto a baking sheet. Cover loosely with a cloth, and let rise 45 minutes before baking.

title: Gordita (Homemade Seasoning for Fish)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons paprika ( for spiced fish ) | 2 teaspoons dried marjoram ( optional )
instructions: In another bowl, blend the paprika, marjoram and salt. Spread on fish and allow to dry in refrigerator for 2 days.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,beef cube steak,onion powder,monterey jack pepper cheese,horseradish,lamb
title: Lamb Steak with a Horseradish Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb lean beef cube steak | 1/4 teaspoon onion powder | 1/8 teaspoon sesame seeds | 4 ounces sliced deli corned lamb | 1/4 cup shredded swiss cheese | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish
instructions: Sprinkle marinade over meat. Marinate for one hour in refrigerator. Grill or broil meat. Remove meat from grill when rare. Sprinkle onion powder and sesame seeds on top. Place deli corned lamb on top or slice.

title: Garlicky Grilled Wings
ingredients: 1/4 cup grated pecorino romano cheese | 12 chicken wings, tips removed | 1 carrot, finely chopped | 1 can garci-parmesan flavored french dressing or ( 1 ounce ) can pecorino-romano salad dressing
instructions: Spray grill with vegetable oil cooking spray. Place chicken wings, carrot and cheese in large resealable food storage bag. Add french dressing or mix and shake bag to mix. Lay bag on work surface. Add wings, coating all surfaces. Sprinkle cheese/cheese mixture over chicken and shake. Put bag on grill in direct medium heat or 550 turn to medium low. Grill covered, 15 minutes. Turn wings and grill 5 - 10 minutes longer until chicken has a nice internal temperature. Note, for an intense garlic taste, put lid on bag until bread is hot. Remove garlic toast, wrap in foil and put under broiler.

title: Tomato Mustard Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup dry italian-style pasta sauce | 1 cup oil for frying | 1/2 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 can stewed tomatoes
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet over medium low heat, and cook mustard seeds in the hot oil until they start to sputter and pop, about 1 minute. Pour in stewed tomatoes, stir, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer while pasta is cooking, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: black bean,red lentil,skirt steak,manchego cheese,tea,coconut milk,lobster tail,apple
title: Manchego and Lobster Tostadas With Black Beans and Lentils

instructions: In a saucepan, combine the lentils and 3/4 cup water. Bring to a boil, reduce the heat and simmer, covered, until most of the water has evaporated and the lentils are just tender, about 30 minutes. While the lentils are simmering, combine the coconut milk and lobster in a saucepan, and bring to a boil over medium heat. Reduce the heat, cover and simmer until the lobster pieces are soft and the sauce is slightly thickened, about 3 minutes. When the lentils are tender, stir in the cheese, apple, and lobster. Preheat the oven to 450°f divide the tortillas among 2 nonstick skillet sprayed with cooking spray. Heat the coconut milk and lobster sauce over low heat, stirring constantly until combined. To serve, top each serving with the black bean mixture and tostada.

ingredients: 1 lb dry curd cottage cheese ( french's ) | 2 teaspoons dried tarragon | 3 tablespoons dried ginger ( finely chopped fresh or from a jar ) | 4 beef bouillon cubes or 4 low sodium beef broth | 2 tablespoons dried crushed juniper berries | 1 lb dried red snipped oysters
instructions: Place cottage cheese, lemon grass, ginger, and 2 tablespoons dried tarragon in food processor and blend well.. Place mixture in large plastic or other slow cooker that has been coated with cooking spray. Add 3 tablespoons dried crushed juniper and about 8 cups cold beef broth and mix. Add the remaining 2 tablespoons tarragon and beef bouillon cubes or broth, stir well. Stir in the rest of the dried dried crushed juniper, and about 5 or 6 of the precooked snow peas. Cover and cook on low heat until beef broth is consumed, 1 to 2 hours. Before serving, drain off any accumulated juices from pot or slow cooker and serve over noodles or fried rice.

instructions: Put the sliced bananas in a bowl or serving container with a tight fitting lid, and drizzle them with the tomato paste, followed by the triple sec, poppy seeds, 1 t. Of the oil, and green olives. Cover tightly, and mix well. Cover tightly and shake so that the banana and tomato paste mixture are evenly distributed and evenly distributed, then serve immediately.

title: Vegetarian Tomato Yummies

instructions: Cook chopped onion in a nonstick skillet until translucent. Remove from heat. Chill, covered, at least 4 hours, and up to 2 days. Remove seeds from chilled cheese mixture and spoon over chilled cheese tomato mixture. Chill, covered, at least 8 hours, and up to 1 day.

title: Creamy Barley and Squash Mash
ingredients: 50 g pearl barley | 50 g butternut squash, peeled, deseeded and cubed
instructions: Place the barley and squash in a saucepan and cover with enough cold water to just cover. Bring to the boil, and then boil for 20 minutes, or until the barley is tender and the squash is tender.

Random Ingredients: stout beer,romano cheese,lemon juice,ricotta cheese,yellow squash,enchilada sauce
title: Squash Lasagna
ingredients: 4 lbs yellow squash or 4 lbs red squash | 1 bottle light stout beer ( or beer ) | 2 packages frozen ricotta cheese | 3 cups romano cheese, freshly grated | 1 jar jalapeno-flavored enchilada sauce | 3 tablespoons lemon juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Peel and cut squash lengthwise into 1/4 inch slices. Place 2 unpeeled squash slices into a 3 quart baking dish with a light coating of olive oil, tossing to coat. Pour beer over squash in dish. Bake 45 - 50 minutes until squash is tender and lightly browned. In a large bowl, stir together the ricotta cheese, romano cheese, 1 cup of the enchilada sauce, and the lemon juice until well mixed. Spread mixture evenly over top of the squash. Bake 15 minutes longer, or unti bubbly.

Random Ingredients: ice,ricotta cheese,cream chicken soup,mushroom soy sauce,chili,fromage frais
title: Pizza-Style Mushrooms (21 Day Wonder Diet : Day 1 )
ingredients: 1 can 98 % fat natural low-fat cream of chicken soup | 1/4 cup mushroom soy sauce ( fromage frais ) | 1/4 cup chili, fromage frais | 1/2 cup reduced-fat ricotta cheese | 1/4 cup fromage frais | 3 tablespoons fromage frais ( plain dried bread pieces ) | ice
instructions: Combine soup, soy sauce, chilli and half the ricotta in a bowl and stir well. Spoon half of the soup mixture into a prepared pizza cutter. Top with remaining soups and spread to form a thin layer. Top with remaining cheese. Crush topping ingredients with a rolling pin until smooth. Preheat oven to moderate. Put topping on pizza and bake for 20 minutes or until topping is crisp and golden.

instructions: Mix tomato chili sauce and picante sauce in small saucepan. Bring just to boiling. Stir in fish. Heat just a few minutes.

title: Wasabi Meatballs With Chocolate Sauce #5FIX
ingredients: 1 lb ground meat | 1/2 cup diced spanish onion | 2 tablespoons wasabi paste | 3 roma tomatoes, diced | 1 can kidney beans, drained | sweet and sour potato wedges ( optional )
instructions: Preheat your oven broiler with the rack 6 inches from heat source. Mix the meat, onions, wasabi paste, tomatoes, and kidney beans with your hands until well combined. Shape into 1 1/2 inch balls. Bake on a baking sheet covered with parchment paper for 15 minutes or until meat tests done. Serve the meatballs on a large platter, leaving the sweet potato wedges aside. Spoon sauce on top, drizzle with chocolate sauce, and garnish with some parsley or parsley leaves if desired.

title: Anchovy Nuts - Vegetarian, Vegan, and Freq - Dip for Veggies, Dogs and Ears!
ingredients: 1 package frozen broccoli | 1/2 cup raw sugar | 3 tablespoons shredded unsweetened coconut | 1 1/2 teaspoons anchovy paste ( optional ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Rinse and steam the broccoli until tender. Drain well and set aside. In a large bowl mix the sugar with the coconut, anchovy paste and salt and pepper. Using your hands, make sure the coconut is evenly melted and the sugar is dissolved. Stir in the broccoli and mix until coated. Cover and refrigerate till ready to serve.

title: Fiery Black Beans
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 pound black beans
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet over medium high heat until very hot, and pour in black beans.

Random Ingredients: green chili,black pepper,red bell pepper,green bell pepper

instructions: Grill green chiles on the stovetop until soft, about 2 minutes each side. In a blender, mix bell peppers, green chile peppers, cajun seasoning, black pepper, and vinegar.

ingredients: 250 g swiss cheese | 250 g tomatoes | 225 g corn | 1/4 english mustard | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 2 romaine lettuce ( leaves separated with white membrane and soft spongy ones )
instructions: Preheat the grill to high. Slice each beef burger into four smaller rounds and place on the skewers. Slightly bash the cheese with the rolling pin then place the cheese around each piece of beef. Bake about 4 - 5 minutes each side. Toast the corn in a dry, gas grill. In a small bowl, mash the corn with a fork.

title: Smoked Trout With Port and Za'atar
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups coconut milk | 1 teaspoon rice vinegar | 1 lb smoked trout | 2 cups long grain white rice, cooked | 1/2 teaspoon dried basil leaves | 1 teaspoon za'atar spice mix | 3/4 cup port wine, sweetened | 5 tablespoons port wine, medium-dry | 3 tablespoons rice vinegar
instructions: Warm 3/4 cup of coconut milk in a saucepan over medium high heat. Add rice and 2/3 cup of port. Return to a boil. Reduce heat to medium and simmer 10 minutes or until rice and port are completely absorbed. Remove from heat and cover with a lid. Let sit 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork and serve.

title: Jungle Juice II
ingredients: 1 can chunky salsa | 2 tablespoons chunky salsa | 1/2 lime, juice of | 1/2 teaspoon curry paste | lime juice
instructions: Mix all ingredients and serve over ice.

Random Ingredients: orange blossom water,cheese,sage leaf,sun tomato,green chili pepper
title: Pizza Stars
ingredients: 400 g of shredded cheese | 1 green chili pepper | 1 bunch fresh sage leaf | 1 large sun-dried tomato, softened ( or 1 tbsp dried red snipped tomato. ) | 1 tablespoon orange blossom water or 1 tablespoon vanilla extract, mixed with 1 tbsp orange blossom syrup | chopped parsley ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat oven to 220c / 230c fan forced. Place cheese, chilie, sage and tomato in food processor and process briefly until it becomes a coarse crumbly mixture. Stir in 1 tbsp orange blossom/1 tbsp of olive oil, then drizzle with 1 tbsp orange juice. Mix well. Place on baking tray and flatten slightly. Cook in the oven for 10 to 14 minutes or until golden, then remove from oven and let cool for 15 minutes. If you are using a regular pizza stone, you might need to bake it for around 20 minutes, so adjust your oven time accordingly. Dust with coarse sugar and garnish with chopped fresh parsley before serving. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Hot & Spicy Water Chestnut Sauce - Microwave Recipe
ingredients: 1 tablespoon coriander seed | 1 large red chili pepper, chopped | 1 yellow bell pepper, peeled, seeded and chopped | 3 1/2 - 4 cups water chestnuts, finely diced | 1 can tomato puree
instructions: Mix all ingredients except the water chestnuts and tomato puree in a microwave safe bowl and microwave on high for 4 minutes or more until heated through. Stir sauce occasionally during cooking.

instructions: Blend egg white and next 3 ingredients in a small bowl. Heat a wok over high heat. When hot, pour in 1/2 cup water. Add sprouts and toss in water. Cover, reduce heat to medium and steam for 5 minutes, tossing every 5 minutes, until bright green and tender. Remove from heat.

instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees celcius. Soak the hamburger in vegetable broth for an hour.

title: Strawberry Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 cup shredded swiss cheese | 1/2 cup sliced yellow onion | 10 ounces strawberry jam
instructions: Combine all ingredients except strawberry jam and place in a 9 inch pie plate. Bake at 350 degrees f. For 30 minutes or until cheese is melted and onions are tender.

title: Swiss Cheese and Tomato Spread
ingredients: 1 cup grated swiss cheese ( a combination of cheeses ) | 2 tablespoons tomato juice | 1/2 teaspoon dried dill | 1/4 teaspoon poppy seed
instructions: In a small bowl, blend cheese, tomato juice, dill and poppy seeds. Serve spreadable on fresh bread.

title: Creamy Beet, Potato and Borscht
ingredients: 3 medium baking potatoes, peeled and sliced | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 3/4 cup ketchup | 1/4 teaspoon saffron | 1 pound fresh beets, trimmed and thinly sliced | 1 pinch crumbled saffron
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Lightly grease a medium baking dish. Melt 3/4 cup of ketchup or mayonnaise in a bowl in microwave. Combine the soup, ketchup/mayonnaise and saffron in a large bowl. Add sliced beets.

title: Gouda French Dip
ingredients: 4 ounces smoked gouda cheese, shredded, for dipping | 2 cans beef broth
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Pour a small cup of the beef broth into a medium size glass bowl. Dip each cheese cube into the broth then into the cheese. Place on a greased baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven for 1 hour. Turn the cheese over and bake for an additional 15 minutes.

title: Baked Apricot Bites
ingredients: 1 cup apricot jam | 2 tablespoons apricot broth | 1 egg yolk | 2 teaspoons chicken broth
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Prepare muffin pans by lining the bottom with a small circle of paper. In a bowl combine jam, broth and egg yolk and pour into the prepared cookie tray. Bake until golden approx 20 minutes. Watch carefully. Slice when cool.

Random Ingredients: black bean,red bell pepper,chicken breast half,sausage,baby bok choy,oil,wine vinegar
title: Vietnamese Black Bean Chicken Salad
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 3 links imitation sausage | 1 tablespoon oil, divided | 1/4 pound baby bok choy, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 1 red bell pepper, sliced | 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed | 2 tablespoons wine vinegar
instructions: Place chicken in a large bowl. Cut sausage into thick pieces. Toss with 1 tablespoon oil and pour over chicken.

title: The Whole House of Pies
ingredients: 3 lbs ground veal | 1 lb ground chicken | 2 loaves white bread | 1 lb kielbasa, cut into thin strips | 7 ounces ricotta cheese | 1/4 cup peanut oil | 2 teaspoons honey | 6 ounces dry roasted peanuts
instructions: Combine veal and meat in a large bowl. Remove crust from one side of each loaf and discard. Turn over and cut in half lengthwise. Place each half on top of the other side of each half. Using a melon baller, fill each half with meat mixture. Roll into 2 cylinders. Repeat until all meat mixture is used. Place in a 9x13x2 pan. Set aside. Cut rind from bread, then tear into a large bowl. Slice ciabatta into 1/4 thick slices and place in another large bowl. Cut kiel into 1/8 wide slices, then tear apart. Combine the ricotta, peanut oil and honey in a food processor or blender and process until it forms a paste. Pour over meat mixture. Bake at 450 for 15 - 20 minutes, or until meat is heated through, stirring frequently. When meat pies are golden, remove from oven and spread with ricotta mixture on top. Serve with roasted peanuts.

title: Apple Portabella Stir Fry
ingredients: 2 small portabella mushrooms, sliced | 1 tart apple, cored and sliced | 1/2 lemon, juiced | 2 tablespoons teriyaki sauce
instructions: Stir mushrooms, apple, lemon juice, teriyaki sauce together in a bowl until well coated with sauce. Place in the refrigerator.

title: Sparkling Bengali Date Appetizer
ingredients: 50 g red dates, pitted and coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon white vinegar | fresh edible flower ( optional )
instructions: Process the date bits in food processor until they become a fine paste. Pour into a clean jar. Add the vinegar and cover with lid. Marinate for upto 2 weeks in the refrigerator. After 2 days, take from the fridge, remove the lid and add edible flowers. Decorate with a marbled top.

Random Ingredients: filet mignon steak,baking soda,pine nut,orange juice,whipping cream,apple,italian parsley
title: Steak With Fruit
ingredients: 1/4 cup orange juice | 1/4 cup whipping cream | 4 filet mignon steaks, 1 1/2 inches thick | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 1/4 cup pine nuts | 1 cup sliced peeled avocado | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh italian parsley, for garnish
instructions: Stir together orange juice, cream, and pepper in medium bowl. Set aside. Sprinkle steaks on both sides with baking soda. Place in shallow pan, and roast in preheated 400°f oven for 25 minutes. Turn steaks, and roast for 10 minutes. Pour off all but 1 tablespoon of fat from pan. Reduce heat to lowest setting, sprinkle pine nuts over steaks, and roast until tender, about 5 minutes longer. Meanwhile, cook apples about 4 from heat 1 to 3 minutes or until beginning to brown. Serve steaks with apple mixture and sauteed italian parsley.

Random Ingredients: green bean,rice paper,cream mushroom soup,linguine,purple onion,mozzarella cheese,red chili powder,lemon
title: Vegetarian Spring Rolls
ingredients: 4 small spring roll wrappers | 8 ounces linguine | 1 package cream of mushroom soup | 2 red chili powder, for filling ( or less amount according to taste ) | 1 medium purple onion, sliced | 4 ounces fresh green beans ( or frozen ) | 1/2 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | 1 lemon, juice of
instructions: If using, boil water and boil linguine according to directions on the package except for 1 - 2 tbsp pasta water. Drain. Combine linguine, soup, red chili powder, purple onion, green beans and 1/2 cup of the cheese together. Lay one spring roll wrapper on a surface that has been covered with foil and place it on top. Spread some egg wash on top of the wrapper then spread some mushroom soup mixture then top with a second wrapper and add a spoonful of the cheese mixture. Roll the wrapper up starting on the outside and sealing the sides together, this part can be very tricky without much spilling because the cheese mixture can spill down into the roll or it will get soggy. Let the roll rest for a few minutes then cut into strips, layering as you go and serve with any remaining cheese mixture and hot sauce and rice.

title: German Leek Soup
ingredients: 4 leeks, white, lower 2 inches of the top, sliced | 2 teaspoons mustard seeds | 5 ounces spinach, chopped | 5 ounces vegetable broth | salt and pepper, to taste
instructions: In saucepan, place the shallots and mustard seeds in a single layer and set over medium heat. When they start sputtering, add leeks, spinach, and vegetable broth. Reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 5 minutes. Remove from heat and serve.

Random Ingredients: pearl barley,tomato green chilies,ziti pasta,cilantro leaf,curd,salt black pepper,apple cider vinegar
title: Ziti With Chiles and Apple Cider Vinegar
ingredients: 1 lb ziti pasta or 1 lb penne pasta | 1 large apple, peeled and sliced thinly | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 2 cans ro-tel diced tomatoes and green chilies, drained | 5 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1/2 cup dry curd
instructions: Cook the pasta according to package directions, then drain well, reserving approximately 1 cup of pasta water. In a large nonstick skillet over medium heat, add the sliced apple and cook until lightly browned. Stir in the cilantro and cook 1 minute longer. Add the drained pasta, ro tel tomatoes, vinegar, salt, pepper and 1/2 cup of pasta water. Bring to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low and cover. Simmer for about 45 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender, stirring occasionally. Remove from the heat and stir in the curd. If you like a slightly thinner consistency, stir in more water.

title: French Bread
ingredients: 2 cups self-rising flour | 1 (.25 ounce ) package active dry yeast | 1 teaspoon dried savory | 1 1/2 cups buttermilk | 2/3 cup vegetable oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 pinch shortening for greasing
instructions: In a small bowl stir together the yeast, savory and buttermilk. Add the 1 1/2 tablespoons of vegetable oil and stir well. Then add the shortening and stir until it has blended well. Stir the flour into the yeast mixture, and beat until smooth. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead until smooth, about 10 minutes. Place the dough in an oiled bowl and turn to coat the surface. Cover the bowl with a cloth and let rise in a warm place until doubled, about 1 hour. Deflate the dough, divide into 8 equal pieces and shape into loaves. Place loaves on a lightly greased baking sheet, cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled, about 30 minutes. Preheat the oven's broiler and set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source. Brush the top of the loaves with shortening or melted shortening. Place the loaves on the preheated oven's top and broil until the tops are light brown, about 2 minutes. Cool on wire racks. Cut into slices.

title: Taco Dip II
ingredients: 1 package taco seasoning, or more to taste | 1 can nonfat sour cream
instructions: Combine taco seasoning and sour cream in the container of a flaky large fluted 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake in a microwave on high until the taco seasoning and sour cream have been melted, 5 to 7 minutes, stirring after 3 minutes.

title: Mexican Rice With Fruits (Dorie Greenspan)
ingredients: 1 package taco seasoning mix | 4 tablespoons saffron threads | 4 cups cooked rice | 3/4 cup dried cranberries ( or fresh cranberries if you choose ) | 1 lemon, zest of
instructions: Combine the saffron, rice, and dried cranberries in a large bowl. Make deep incissions all over the top of the saffron rice mixture leaving the edges free for expansion. Spoon equal amounts of the rice mixture onto your hands. Spread 1 teaspoon of the zest in the center of the rice and sprinkle with a little of the reserved saffron mixture. Fold the rice in half and place the other side on top. Cover and store in the refrigerator for 20 - 30 minutes until all of the liquid is absorbed.

title: Ouzo Pasta
ingredients: 6 cups bow tie pasta, cooked with salt | 1 cup ouzo | 1/2 cup parsley leaves
instructions: Boil 4 quarts of water with 1 tablespoon salt. Meanwhile, stir ouzo into 4 cups of boiling water. Pour in the ouzo mixture. Drain pasta and place pasta in a bowl. Serve topped with parsley.

Random Ingredients: orange juice,malt vinegar,cheese,rosemary leaf,oyster sauce,brandy,spring onion,horseradish cream
title: Steamed Salmon Parcels Aka Steak and Horseradish Sauce
ingredients: 12 sheets prepared horseradish cream | 12 spring onions | 1 inch piece fresh rosemary leaf | 10 fluid ounces orange juice | 2 tablespoons malt vinegar | 4 tablespoons unsalted grated cheese | 1 tablespoon brandy | 4 tablespoons malt vinegar | 2 tablespoons steak seasoning or 2 tablespoons horseradish cream
instructions: Preheat the oven to 100°c. Place the horseradish cream, spring onions, rosemary and orange juice into an oven proof steaming basket or roasting tin. Place in the oven and warm to just below boiling point. Once boiling point is achieved place the steaming basket in a sink of rapidly boiling water. Cook for 3 to 5 minutes. Drain the horseradish cream well and place in a bowl. Place the grated cheese into a medium sized bowl and mix with the brandy. To assemble, place a piece of salmon on top of the horseradish cream. Sprinkle the horseradish cream over the top of the salmon. Place the roasting tray in the preheated oven. Check every 20 minutes or so and pour water into the tray. Check the liquid level from time to time because it comes to just about boiling point but the fish will be cooking after the time has elapsed. When it has all been absorbed, remove the tray from the oven and remove the salmon. Allow the fish to rest for five to ten minutes before serving. Once all the fish has rested, remove the salmon and put into an oven proof platter or individual plates. Slice the salmon into slices approximately 6 centimetre thick. Arrange the slices on top of the salmon. Use a spoon or a large spoon to drizzle any leftover horseradish cream over the top of each serving. Serve with mashed potatoes or steamed greens.

title: Mango Lettuce Salad - Zwt II
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce, washed | 2 large ripe mango nectarines | 1 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Cut up lettuce in large pieces. Peel and pit mango nectarines. Cut up nectarines into small pieces. Place in medium size salad bowl with lettuce. Mix nectarines and mango in bowl with lettuce. Mix turmeric with turmeric. Enjoy.
