title: Korean Beef
ingredients: 4 -5 lbs rump roast or 4 -5 lbs boneless bottom round roast | 1/2 cup rice wine | 1/2 cup liquid honey | spices | 1 head cauliflower, cut into 2 inch florets | 2 lbs fresh spinach leaves
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the rice wine, honey, spice packet and 2 cups water. Add the roast pieces and toss until coated with the marinade. Arrange the roast in a roasting pan. Pour the marinade over the meat. Reserve the remaining marinade. Poke several holes in the meat using a fork and spoon the marinade mixture into the holes in the meat. Cover and refrigerate for 2 to 3 hours. Arrange the cauliflower over the top.

title: Seared Skirt Steak With Macadamia Nuts and Chile
ingredients: 16 ounces whole wheat spaghetti | 3 tablespoons sesame paste | 1 tablespoon minced shallot | 1 tablespoon minced candied lemon peel | 1 tablespoon grated daikon zest of an italian lemon ( or substitute 2 tsp. grated fresh lemon peel, 1 t ) | 250 g thinly sliced skirt steaks | 2 tablespoons shaved dark chocolate, to sprinkle
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions. While pasta is cooking, mix sesame paste, shallots, zest, chile and macadamia nuts in a small bowl. When pasta is almost finished cooking, add steaks to the pasta and stir to combine well. Cover and chill until ready to serve. Transfer to plates and sprinkle with chocolate and serve.

title: Nairobi Bayrisi (Cardamom and Peanut Powder)
ingredients: 1 cup vegetable oil or 1 cup peanut oil | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Heat oil over medium heat in a large skillet. Add cardamon and allow to sizzle for a minute or two or until a light haze forms over it. Add the nut powder and stir continuously until the nut nut powder turns slightly darker. Remove from heat and quickly skim away air bubbles with a spoon as this can cause the powder to burn. Pour into a sealable container and store in a cool dark place for up to 5 days.

title: Mustard Butter
ingredients: 1/4 cup grainy mustard | 1 large seedless serrano chili
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a heavy nonstick pan. Over low heat, simmering until thick. This may take 5 - 10 minutes for the mustard to reach the desired consistency, but be careful not to burn the mustard.

title: Zucchini-Dill Sauce
ingredients: 1/3 cup ketchup | 1 can tomato sauce ( or a good one ) | 1/3 cup chopped fresh dill weed | 2 medium zucchini, trimmed, halved lengthways, sliced crossways ( about 1 1/2 pounds total )
instructions: Mix the ketchup, tomato sauce, dill weed and 3/4 cup boiling water in a medium bowl until well combined. Spray a 9 inch square baking dish with cooking spray. Arrange the zucchini in rows in the pan. Pour the tomato sauce mixture over the zucchini. Cover and refrigerate the zucchini and sauce for at least 30 minutes and up to 1 day in advance. Remove the dish from the refrigerator, uncover and bake at 375°f for about 20 to 25 minutes or until the zucchini is tender and sauce is bubbling.

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f spread the butter beans evenly on a baking sheet.

Random Ingredients: cucumber,peanut oil,black pepper,dark soy sauce,nonfat beef broth
title: Low-Fat Cucumber Beef
ingredients: 7 1/2 cups nonfat beef broth | 2 medium cucumbers ( about 10 ) | 3 tablespoons peanut oil | 1/2 teaspoon black pepper | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce or 2 tablespoons soy sauce
instructions: Peel cucumbers. Cut cucumbers lengthwise into thin strips about 1/4 wide. Toss cucumbers with the remaining ingredients and cook gently until cucumbers are heated through.

title: Paella...  Filipino Pilau
ingredients: 1 box medium grain rice ( i use basmati ) | 1/2 lb small raw shrimp | 1/2 lb pork country ribs ( the country ribs are the short ribs, about 4-5 ounces ) | 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice | 1/2 cup raisins ( optional )
instructions: Soak the rice 5 minutes in warm water or with 2 cups of water. Drain off any excess water. Rinse the rice with 3 changes of water several times, then bring the rice to boil with the 2 cups water. When it boils, turn down heat slightly, but leave about 5 inches of bubbling water in the pot, and put the rice on the burner in the pot. Put a heavy pan shaped sieve over the rice, or your face if you can. The idea is to press holes in the holes, where the rice can be drained. Turn the heat back up slightly, and put the ribs. It is important to let the heat get to the point that it starts to bubble. You can either put it in the sieve, or on the stove and make holes all over, and when the rice is ready, put the sieve over it. The steam from the rice over the sieve will make it glue like a thread, and the residue from the rice will rise to the surface. Press the rice through the sieve, but be careful. If it is not well squeezed, the rice will stain the sieve. This stage does not need to be done.

title: Cauliflower Salad With Gorgonzola
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon dried lemon verbena | salt water, for boiling the cauliflower | 1 small cauliflower, broken into florets | 2 dried red chilies | 2 tablespoons gorgonzola | 1/4 cup slivered almonds
instructions: Preparation, put the cauliflower in a bowl with enough cold water to cover it. Let it stand, about 30 minutes, then drain. Place in a bowl with the remaining ingredients except almonds. Toss to combine. Sprinkle with almonds.

title: Pork Ribs
ingredients: 3 lbs country-style pork ribs | 2 lbs jiggers whiskey
instructions: Preheat boiler. In a large dutch oven, put the ribs and their contents, the whiskey and the ribs' liquor. Heat to just about medium high. Reduce heat to 1/ let simmer for 1/2 hour basting often,. Add enough water to come to 3 1/2 inches above rib mixture. Cover and cook for about 1 1/2 hours, basting constantly.

title: Artichokes and Raisins
ingredients: 1 jar artichoke hearts, drained and washed | 1 pound cooked beef stew meat | 1/4 cup raisins | 1 tablespoon dry fennel, or as desired
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Place the artichokes and beef in the pot, and cook for 10 minutes. Stir in raisins, and remove from heat. Cover, and allow to stand for 1 to 2 minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: plain nonfat yogurt,romaine lettuce,chicken chunk,japanese eggplant,bamboo shoot,cauliflower,quince
title: Japanese Chicken Salad
ingredients: 2 cups torn romaine lettuce | 1 japanese eggplant | 12 ounces cooked chicken chunks | 1 avocado - peeled, pitted, and finely chopped | 4 ounces julianna quince, finely minced | 1 cup canned sliced bamboo shoots, drained | 1 container plain nonfat yogurt
instructions: Cut rind from eggplant.

title: Jasmine Rice Wraps
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups jasmine rice ( i used jasmine's jasmine rice ) | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 8 large mushrooms, sliced | 1 teaspoon chopped of fresh mint | 1/4 cup light red wine vinegar | 1/4 cup white sugar | 14 tortillas, warmed
instructions: Boil 2 cups of water and add jasmine rice to soak. Stir in red wine vinegar, 1 tablespoon sugar, mushrooms, and mint. Cover and cook over low heat for 20 minutes to 1 hour or until rice is soft. Let cool. Mix 2 tablespoons each of red wine vinegar and 1/4 cup sugar in a small bowl and stir well. Fill each warm tortilla with rice, fold over and serve.

title: Spicy Broccoli & Red Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 4 cups broccoli, chopped | 1/2 cup red cabbage, finely shredded | 1 shallot, finely chopped | 3 -4 tablespoons marinara sauce | 2 -3 tablespoons cumin seeds, lightly toasted, peeled and crushed | lime wedge ( to garnish )
instructions: Steam the broccoli in a steamer basket over boiling water for 5 minutes or until slightly tender, but still with a little bite left. Combine the cabbage, shallot and marinara sauce in a large bowl or small bowl. Toss with the broccoli and place on a serving plate. Dollop on any remaining marinara sauce, top with cumin seeds and lime wedges and serve.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,rotini pasta,black olive,cream cheese,red bean,basmati rice,ice
title: Rice-Vegetable Casserole
ingredients: 1 package rotini pasta | 1 can red beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can white beans, drained and rinsed | 4 ounces fat-free cream cheese | 1 cup broccoli floret | 1/2 cup shredded iceberg-brand baked almonds | 3 cups hot cooked basmati rice
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Pour the pasta into a large casserole dish that has been lightly coated with cooking spray. Random Ingredients: beef broth,cheddar cheese,blackening seasoning,chat masala,spice,ginger garlic paste
title: Quick Keema Cheesy Curry Chops
ingredients: 12 slices boneless beef round steak, trimmed | 1/2 cup cheddar cheese, shredded | 1 teaspoon light ginger-garlic paste | 1/4 teaspoon blackening seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon chat masala | 1 1/2 cups beef broth
instructions: Combine the cheddar cheese, ginger garlic paste, blackening spice, and chaat masala thoroughly in a small bowl. Coat a large non stick skillet with cooking spray and cook the beef in batches over medium high heat until cooked to your preference, about 4 minutes per side. Remove from heat, sprinkle with cheese mixture, and allow to stand for 2 minutes before serving.

title: Apple Ginger and Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 granny smith apple ( peeled or grated ) | 1 small onion, grated | 1/2 tablespoon gingerroot, finely minced | 1 tablespoon dried fruit | 2 tablespoons sesame oil
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine first 5 ingredients. Stir in sesame oil.

title: Bamkazian
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless beef sirloin, cut into 1 1/3-inch pieces | 1 jar blanched slivered almonds, with skins on | 1 can beef prepared black tea | 1/2 lb ground sirloin beef
instructions: Combine marinade ingredients.

title: Jicama Chicken Fajitas, Mexican Style
ingredients: 1 cup jicama, peeled, chopped | 1 bunch lettuce, shredded | 2 cans vegetarian broth | 1 lb chicken breast, cut into thin strips | 1/4 cup white flour | 3 tablespoons fresh parsley leaves, chopped
instructions: Cook jicama in 1 1/2 cups water until crisp tender. In a colander, press jicama through a sieve until no more liquid remains. Reserve juice. In a large pan on medium high heat, add cooked jicama and broth. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat. Stir in reserved jicama juice, chicken and flour. Cover and let stand 15 minutes. Stir in parsley at this point. Cook in remaining broth. Heat through and serve.

Random Ingredients: italian plum tomato,orange blossom water,apple juice,coconut milk
title: Apple Soup
ingredients: 4 italian plum tomatoes, chopped | 8 ounces apple juice, chilled | 2 cans unsweetened coconut milk | 1/2 cup orange blossom water
instructions: Mix with a large slotted spoon the tomatoes, apple juice and coconut milk and orange blossom water. Simmer over moderate heat for 25 minutes.

title: Vodka (Dirty Pasta)
ingredients: 1/4 cup white rum | pasta
instructions: Pour rum into a bowl of water, but be generous, as the amount of fat you can float will increase the acidity a bit as you do so. While the rum is working, bring a large pot of water to boil, and add a handful of drained pasta. Cook as you would spaghetti and drain if necessary. Place pasta in a large serving bowl. Pour rum on top, and gently mix with a wooden spoon to distribute, distributing rum evenly through the pasta. Taste the vodka and adjust with rum according to your preference. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: poblano pepper,italian dressing,vanilla yogurt,new potato,salt pepper,tabasco sauce,salmon fillet,roquefort cheese
title: Smoked Salmon With Poblano Pepper & Roquefort Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 2 small new potatoes ( about 1 1/4 lbs ) | 1/2 cup reduced sodium italian dressing | 1/4 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1 teaspoon vanilla yogurt | 1 lb smoked salmon fillet, cut into 12 pieces | 1/8 teaspoon salt and pepper | 12 tablespoons thinly sliced pickled poblano peppers | 1/2 cup roquefort cheese, crumbled
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place potatoes in a large pot of lightly salted water and bring to a boil. Lower heat to medium and continue to cook until tender, about 25 minutes. Drain and set aside to cool. Whisk together the italian dressing and tabasco in a large bowl. Add the potato pieces and stir until coated with the dressing.

title: Vegetable and Pinchu (Macaronia) Casserole
ingredients: 2 cups tomatoes soup | 5 squid, sliced into rounds | 10 broccoli florets | 1 1/2 cups vermicelli | 4 hard-boiled eggs | 2 tablespoons nutella | 1/8 teaspoon sweet hungarian paprika
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Arrange a layer of egg noodles so the bottom runs right under the egg noodles. In a large roasting pan mix together the soup, squid, broccoli and vermicelli. Cover and bake for 45 - 45 minutes. Remove from oven and let sit covered for 10 minutes. Cut into squares. Top with a dollop of nutella, sprinkle on paprika, mix gently and serve.

title: Chile Colorado
ingredients: 1 whole new mexico chile, seeded and coarsely chopped | 3 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 1 pound cooked and shredded pork
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Remove skin and seeds from chile and chop finely. Place chili in a bowl and cover with boiling water.

Random Ingredients: liquid honey,yucca root,black bean,yeast,white flour,great northern bean,chili flake,berry
title: Juanita's New Biglie
ingredients: 1 lb fresh berry | 1 3/4 lbs fresh white flour | 1 lb frozen yucca root, in 1 '' cubes ( i don't know about yucca size ) | 1 cup dried black beans | 1 tablespoon yeast | 1/2 cup liquid honey, warmed | 1/2 teaspoon chili flakes | 2 cups great northern beans or cans navy beans
instructions: Wash and cut berries and soak overnight. Drain and rinse white flour and beans and put in bread machine according to package directions. When bread machine enters the bread setting, remove from bread machine and let cool on rack. Mix flour and salt. Add yeast in a small bowl and mix thoroughly. Stir in honey and chilli flakes and mix well. Fold in beans and dough. Pour into a greased, loose bottomed pan and bake in a preheated 375 degree f oven for 45 minutes, or until hollow sounding approximatley. For the last 15 minutes of baking, put a piece of brown or wax paper on cooling rack so that it stays hot throughout the day. Slice into 6 portions and serve warm with favorite hot sauce.

Random Ingredients: water,masa harina,chive,szechuan peppercorn,cod fish fillet,bok choy,clove,tart apple
title: Szechuan Fried Fish
ingredients: 1 tablespoon szechuan peppercorns | 3 whole cloves | 2 cups masa harina or plain flour, as needed | 1 cup cold water, as needed | 1 small tart apple, peeled, cored, and grated | 1/2 cup chopped chives | 3 small bok choy, trimmed and chopped | 1 can chopped tart apples
instructions: In a nonstick skillet that has been dusted with vegetable oil, toast the sichuan peppercorns and cloves over medium low heat, shaking the skillet frequently, until fragrant, about 5 minutes. Remove the peppercorns and cloves, and transfer them to a small bowl to cool. Dissolve the flour in the water in the skillet, and stir until the dough is smooth and pulls away from the sides of the skillet. Stir in remaining ingredients. Heat the sauce in the skillet, stirring to form the sauce. When it is simmering, cook the fish in the sauce until heated through.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,linguine,tamarind paste,greek yogurt,red pepper,lime
title: Linguine With Yogurt
ingredients: 12 ounces linguine | 4 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1 lime, zested and juiced | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste | 1 cup greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon roasted red pepper, minced
instructions: Cook linguine according to package directions and put aside. Meanwhile, in a medium skillet over medium heat, combine the brown sugar, lime zest, tamarind paste and 2/3 cup of the yogurt. When the linguine has been drained, combine with the sugar mix, tossing to coat. Cover and let sit for 5 minutes. Toss in the roasted red pepper and the remaining yogurt. Mix the linguine and sauce thoroughly and serve.

Random Ingredients: kalamata olive,wheat germ,fine breadcrumb,sake,cream cottage cheese,cheddar cheese,xanthan gum,white sugar
title: Low-fat Cheddar Spread
ingredients: 1 cup sour cream, reduced-fat okay | 1/2 cup low-fat cottage cheese | 4 tablespoons white sugar | 2 tablespoons kalamata olives, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons dried multicolored whole wheat germ | 2 teaspoons crushed xanthan gum | 1 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 2 teaspoons sake or 2 teaspoons any other dry white sherry
instructions: Combine 1/2 the remaining ingredients in a bowl. Spread cheese mixture over bottom of a greased 5 or 6 cup crockpot. Top with remaining ingredients. Bake on high 3 - 5 hours or low 8 - 10 hours.

Random Ingredients: phyllo pastry,part mozzarella cheese,pea,navel orange,ginger,sage leaf
title: Microwave Phyllo Triangles With Peas and Peas
ingredients: 1 package frozen peas | 9 sheets phyllo pastry | 1 tablespoon ground ginger | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh sage leaf | 1/2 navel orange, cut into small slivers ( or orange-sized chunks ) | 3 large ripe plantains ( or two small regular sized semi-ripe bananas, coarsely chopped ) | 4 slices part-skim mozzarella cheese
instructions: Place frozen peas in microwave. Cover with 1 1/2 to 2/3 cups water, cover, and microwave on high 100% power 15 minutes to thaw peas completely. Add chopped ginger, chopped sage and orange rind. Microwave on high 60 seconds. Transfer peas to medium bowl. Microwave on high 5 minutes, stir, and spread out 1 sheet phyllo dough. Cover phyllo with another sheet, buttered and a glass piece of parchment or wax paper, and microwave on high 100% power 3 or 4 minutes, stirring once halfway through microwaving process. Repeat microwaving, adding pieces of phyllo every 20 seconds, on high 100% power 20 to 25 minutes, stirring after every 10 minutes.. Transfer peas to bowl, and stir in zest and remaining phyllo dough. Sprinkle mozzarella on top and gently but thoroughly cover with remaining phyllo. Place on parchment paper, and microwave on high 100% power 3 or 4 minutes, stirring after every 5 minutes, until the mozzarella melts. Remove from microwave, and cut into 6 pieces. Cut each piece into 6 triangles. Serve one triangle per person.

Random Ingredients: marjoram,mandarin orange,sumac,chili paste,black mustard seed,picante sauce,palm sugar,lemon
title: Creamy Mandarin Orange Salad With Dried Fruit
ingredients: 3 mandarin oranges | 1 tablespoon black mustard seeds | 1 1/2 tablespoons sweet chili paste | 1 tablespoon palm sugar, packed ( or granulated ) | 2 tablespoons paprika ( or sweet ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 lemon, juice of | 1 -2 tablespoon picante sauce | 1 -2 teaspoon chili paste
instructions: Slice oranges vertically in a half to partially cross with a sharp knife. Remove the peel and membrane from each half and cut each half into 1/2 segments with a sharp knife. Cut diagonally into 2 segments. Put oranges in a bowl, add all remaining ingredients except picante and chili paste and mix well. Chill overnight. When ready to serve, stir in picante. Tip, if you serve this dish cold, make sure the oranges are completely covered with the dip.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt,shortening,olive oil,eggplant,tomato,salt black pepper,arborio rice
title: Lidia's Eggplant Risotto
ingredients: 1 small eggplant, unpeeled and cut into cubes about 1-1/4 inch | 3 teaspoons salt, divided | 2 tablespoons lard or 2 tablespoons shortening | 1 cup uncooked arborio rice | 1 can diced tomatoes | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 egg, beaten
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Place the eggplant in a bowl and sprinkle 1 teaspoon of salt over and toss to coat. Transfer to a roasting pan, cover and roast the eggplant for 45 minutes. Turn and add the remaining 1 teaspoon salt. Roast for 20 minutes more, or until all of the liquid is absorbed and the eggplant is soft. Cook the rice as per directions and drain. Set aside. Drain the tomatoes. Set them aside. In a saucepan, melt the lard or shortening over medium low heat. Add the drained rice and stir for several minutes to mix it in and give it a few turns of the pan to coat the underside evenly with the fat. When the rice is toasted, add the diced tomatoes and cook for some minutes more. Season the risotto with salt and black pepper. Add about 3/4 cup of the rice to the tomato mixture and stir to blend. Place the eggplant pan into the oven for 2 minutes and remove from the oven. The risotto may still be warm in the oven, and you may need to add a little water. After 2 minutes, stir in the beaten egg until just incorporated. Remove from the oven, stir in the remaining 1 teaspoon of salt and serve.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,seasoning,bacon dripping,ear corn,heavy cream,vinegar
title: Welsh Corn Salad
ingredients: 4 ears corn, shucked | 1/2 cup bacon drippings | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1/4 cup vinegar | seasoning
instructions: Cut a slit in the back of each ear corn, scrape the silk silk back onto the kernels, and place over boiling water. Cook for 1 - 2 minutes, then remove and drain. Mix together the drippings, red wine vinegar and heavy cream. Put the corn back onto the stove, and add half of this mixture to it, stirring all the time. Simmer for 10 - 15 minutes, or until thick and pulpy. Adjust seasoning, and chill several hours before adding the remaining dressing.

Random Ingredients: tamarind paste,pink food coloring,half cream,macaroni,basil pesto,masa harina
title: Macaroni and Pesto (Pesto) Tamarind Pasta
ingredients: 1 box macaroni | 1 tablespoon wholemeal masa harina, plus extra for dusting | 5 -6 tablespoons basil pesto ( or other pesto ) | 4 drops pink food coloring | 1/2 cup half-and-half cream | 3 -5 drops tamarind paste, for drizzling ( optional )
instructions: Cook the macaroni in boiling water according to the packet instructions. Drain and plunge into cold water and drain again. Toss with the masa harina and pesto. Taste and adjust seasoning with pink food coloring, tamarind concentrate, and a few flakes of pink food colouring, if using. Divide among serving bowls and drizzle with extra pesto and basil pesto.

title: Quick Molasses Jam
ingredients: 1 cup cherry tomatoes, halved | 2 1/2 cups dark molasses
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Coat a large baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Line bottom of dish with halved cherry tomatoes. Heat molasses in a saucepan over medium low heat until warm. Gradually add cherry tomatoes, stirring constantly, and bring to boil. Reduce heat to medium low, and cook for 10 minutes, stirring frequently. Bring 5 cups water to a boil. Remove from heat, and pour into a clean saucepan. Cover, and set over medium low heat. Cook for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until mixture is syrupy and has a jam like consistency. Stir occasionally while it cools. Remove from heat, and allow to cool completely. Transfer to clean jars. Store in the refrigerator, and store in a cool dark place for up to 6 months.

Random Ingredients: chili paste,hot red pepper flake,green grape,chuck roast,tabasco sauce
title: Sweet & Sour Beef Roast
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs chuck roast, trimmed and tied | 3 tablespoons green grapes, washed | 3 tablespoons ground hot red pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons chili paste ( such as adobo, salsa ) | 3 tablespoons tabasco sauce ( mexican hot sauce )
instructions: Preheat broiler. Broil roast 5 - 7 from heat for 6 minutes or until lightly browned. Meanwhile, place grapes in a microwave safe bowl.

Random Ingredients: cheese tortellini,italian salad dressing,kaffir lime leaf,golden syrup,molasses,grape tomato
title: Tortellini W-Cereal Mashed Grape Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 package cheese tortellini | 1 jar grape tomatoes, drained and chopped | 2 tablespoons light molasses or 2 tablespoons other molasses | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 1/4 cup kaffir lime leaf, finely chopped | italian salad dressing
instructions: Cook tortellini according to directions on the package. Meanwhile, combine all ingredients in a large microwave safe casserole. Cover and microwave on high for 12 to 15 minutes until heated through.

title: Simple, Quick and Easy Sausage Sandwich
ingredients: 1/2 polish sausage ( polish breakfast sausage, polish sausage, chicken or shrimp-pops ) | 2 whole wheat pita bread
instructions: Take a skillet and fry italian sausage. When the sausage is still raw, take it out and slice it up into 1/2 slices. Then you can either slice it in smaller pieces or you can slice it in two pieces. You can do all kinds of things here. Cut each pita and just lay it flat on a plate. You can also use pita bread to make the sandwich. To eat, dip a fork in your bread, and slide the sausage onto it.

title: Spiny Soup
ingredients: 1 lb small pasta | 2 quarts chicken stock | 1/2 bunch fresh dill leaves | 1 sprig fresh mint | 1/2 cup small curds ( optional ) | 1/2 cup milk
instructions: Cook pasta in the chicken stock until al dente. While waiting for the pasta, make the filling. Saute the dill and mint over very low heat for a few minutes. While the dill is cooking, mash the curd gently with the milk. Gradually add half the milk to the cooked pasta, until all ingredients are incorporated. Drain pasta and return to the pot. Add remaining milk. Simmer at low heat for a few minutes until heated through. Serve with hot grated parmesan cheese.

Random Ingredients: hamburger,oatmeal,bamboo skewer,red pepper flake,taco seasoning mix,philadelphia cream cheese,clam
title: Clams Casino
ingredients: 1 package philadelphia cream cheese, softened | 1/4 cup dried lobster or 1/4 cup salted anchovies, divided | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes, divided | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning mix | 2 teaspoons quick oatmeal | 1/2 cup prepared minced clams | 12 hot cooked hamburger buns or 12 hoagie rolls
instructions: Using a food processor or mortar and pestle, mix together cream cheese, 1/4 cup of shrimp seasoning, anchovies and 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper.

title: Black Bean Tacos
ingredients: 12 taco shells or 12 large flour tortillas | 1 can chopped tomato | 1 can sliced black beans | 1 medium celery rib, chopped | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce
instructions: In medium bowl, combine all ingredients except shells, tortillas and taco seasoning. Cover and refrigerate 1 hour. Cook shells according to package directions.

title: Beetroot Mash
ingredients: 1 lb beet, peeled and chopped | 2 teaspoons butter or 2 teaspoons margarine, melted | 1 cup rice, cooked
instructions: Place the beets under running water until just tender. Drain and mash with a fork. Add the melted margarine and stir until the texture has the consistency of a light mayonnaise. Place in a heated bowl and sprinkle with rice.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower floret,tortilla chip,puff pastry,olive oil cooking spray,kefalotiri,button mushroom
title: Cauliflower Cheese and Mushrooms Mini Quiches
ingredients: 1 teaspoon olive oil | 4 portobello mushroom, caps, sliced | 500 g puff pastry, thawed | 2/3 cup finely grated kefalotiri | 1 cup cauliflower floret, rinsed and coarsely grated | tortilla chips, to serve
instructions: Heat oil in pan, add mushrooms, cook over high heat 5 minutes, until mushrooms and caps are golden. Remove mushrooms and set aside. Season to taste with salt. Place puff pastry on lightly floured surface and roll between 2 sheets of greaseproof paper until 1/4 thick. Cut pastry crosswise into eight circles with a 2 cm cookie cutter. Arrange mushroom mixture in centre of each circle and top with cheese and cauliflower. Fold dough in half and press edge of each pastry round with a floured fork. Place on greased oven tray. Heat oven to 200c. Bake 25 minutes or until golden.

title: Avocado and Coconut Smoothies
ingredients: 2 lbs ripe avocado, peeled and pitted | 1/4 teaspoon onion powder | 1/4 teaspoon allspice | 1/2 cup quick-cooking oats | 1/2 cup coconut milk | 8 ounces chopped porcini mushrooms | 3/4 cup stock
instructions: Cut avocados in half and scoop out seeds. Mash avocado with fork and gradually mix in spice, oats, coconut milk and mushrooms. Add stock, mix and chill for at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Raspberry Chutney Made With an Ancho Chile
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ancho chile powder | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 cup fresh raspberry or strawberry, coarsely chopped
instructions: Place chutney in a small bowl and mix in the marjoram, coriander, and a few drops of water to make a thick paste. Gently fold in the fresh berries and mix well. Chill in refrigerator until ready to serve or store in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks.

title: Amsterdam Stuffed Sauerkraut
ingredients: 4 thick slices white bread, torn into 2 inch pieces | 1 package sauerkraut, drained | 4 tablespoons minced celery | 1 teaspoon ground italian seasoning | 1 1/2 cups shredded colby cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 550 degrees f. Place 1 piece of bread in the middle of a wooden or glass bowl. Place the crumbed bread on top, moistening the crumbs with a small amount of water and turning the slices over a quarter turn as needed to moisten. Place the bowl under the broiler, about 3 minutes. The bread should be slightly browned and crusty at this point. Remove from oven and set aside in a clean bowl. Place the remaining slice of bread on top of the crumbs and set aside in a small bowl. Filling, in a medium size bowl, combine sauerkraut with celery and italian seasoning. Pour the vegetable mixture into the bowl with bread, pressing gently to spread it evenly. Spoon 2 tablespoons of the cheese onto each of the bread slices. Place the crumbed bread in the oven and immediately turn the heat down to 200 degrees f. Let the mixture cook for 10 to 15 minutes until the top is crusty and browned, or to your desired doneness.

title: Banana Chiles
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried anaheim chiles | 1 large egg white, with | 1/2 teaspoon graham cracker, grated | 1 banana, peeled and sliced
instructions: Soak the chiles in warm water till soft. Put the chiles in a mortar with the garlic and a little warm water. Remove the stems and seeds. Mash them with the egg white. Pour the mixture into a baking dish and spread over the top. Sprinkle with graham cracker. Bake at 180 degrees c for about 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Coco - Spinach and Bok Choy Soup
ingredients: 350 g spinach leaves | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 2/3 cup stock | 1/4 cup half-and-half | 1 1/2 teaspoons five-spice powder | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 500 g bok choy
instructions: Wash the spinach in the sun. Break off the stalks and separate them into 2 or three smaller ones. Clean them by first cutting off the stalks at the stalks, then shred them. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok over high heat. Stir in the spinach, stir fry for 2 minutes, then remove the pan from the heat. Blend the cornflour with the stock until the mixture becomes thick. Add half and half and stir until it starts to thicken, then stir in the spinach. Stir in the five spice powder. Place a knob of bok choy in the centre of each bowl of soup. Ladle 2 tbsp soup into each bowl and garnish with two sprigs of snowperes and a few snowperes.

Random Ingredients: food coloring,chicken bouillon cube,green pepper,currant,jicama,parmigiano reggiano cheese,cornstarch,fava bean
title: Fava Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 lb small dried fava beans ( fava beans, frozen or fresh and thawed, fresh and frozen ) | 2 green peppers, sliced | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/2 cup currants | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 10 drops food coloring | 3 -4 tablespoons chicken bouillon cubes ( optional ) | food coloring, optional
instructions: Cook beans for 5 minutes in boiling water, then drain. Place the beans in a large bowl and mash with a fork. Add all other ingredients. Make into a creamy mixture. The amount of color depends on the saltiness of your cheese and beans. Taste and adjust seasonings as desired, this is a good dish to serve cold. Serve cold or warm.

title: Choclo, a Colombian Stew and Meat Casserole
ingredients: 2 lbs lean meat, with visible fat | 2 jalapenos ( i used serrano peppers ), seeded and chopped, about 2 tablespoons | 1 tablespoon fresh rosemary, minced or 1 teaspoon dried rosemary | 3 tablespoons tarragon vinegar | 1/2 cup dark chocolate | 2 -3 tablespoons hot jalapeno juice ( can use bottled )
instructions: Trim any fat from meat, removing as much fat and gristle as possible. Prick meat with fork in several places and cover with cheesecloth to draw moisture out. Microwave meat uncovered, turning occasionally, for 15 minutes. Remove and set aside. Combine minced ginger, jalapenos and sambal chile in a small bowl or container with tight fitting lid. Microwave, uncovered, for 10 minutes. Stir in rosemary. Add vinegar and chocolate and microwave on high for 15 minutes, stirring after every minute. Continue heating and stirring until chocolate is melted. Stir in hot jalapeno juice. Serve with rice and warm bread, such as arugula or cucumber salad.

Random Ingredients: pepperoni,lemon zest,tart apple,large shrimp,salt,hash brown,italian sausage,turmeric powder
title: Crispy Shrimp With Sausage and Apple
ingredients: 4 ounces italian sausage | 1 lb large shrimp, shelled and deveined | 1 medium tart apple, peeled and finely chopped | 15 slices pepperoni | 9 ounces hash browns, finely mashed | 1 teaspoon lemon zest | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/8 teaspoon salt
instructions: Grill sausage over non stick grill for 4 minutes on each side, or until it is done. Cut into 1/3 inch pieces, set aside. Peel and devein shrimp. Cut into thin, long strips, set aside. In large non stick skillet, combine sausage and shrimp. Cook on medium high for 4 - 5 minutes on each side, or until shrimp are pink and sausage is lightly browned. Add apple, heat through until apple is soft. In food processor, combine potato, zest, turmeric and salt, pulse 2 - 4 times until crumbs are coarsely grated. Stir in sausage and shrimp. Serve in warm bowl.

title: Broccoli Salad With Rice Vinegar
ingredients: 4 cups broccoli, cut bite size | 4 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 cup cheese, grated ( optional )
instructions: Steam the broccoli for a few minutes until the stalks are clear. Mix with rice vinegar and sprinkle with cheese. Enjoy.

title: Cape Green Chilies in Grape Tomato Syrup
ingredients: 2 red seedless yellow chile | 1 medium bunch spring onion, finely chopped ( scallions ) | 2 teaspoons chili paste ( or to taste ) | 2/3 cup grape tomatoes, halved | 4 tablespoons sweetened condensed milk or 4 tablespoons half-and-half
instructions: Heat a wok until smoking hot. Add chile and stir fry until fragrant. Add spring onion and stir fry for a few seconds. Add chilli paste and stir fry 1 minute. Add grape tomatoes and sweetened condensed milk. Toss and warm through. This recipe has no actual ingredient.

Random Ingredients: no boil lasagna noodle,clam juice,hoisin sauce,brown sugar,dark corn syrup,fruit
title: Scotch Clam Lasagna
ingredients: 12 no-boil lasagna noodles | 1 can no-boil lasagna noodles | 1/3 cup brown sugar | 1/4 cup light corn syrup | 1/2 cup bottled clam juice | 1/2 cup hoisin sauce, or more to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add noha and lasagna pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Guinness Beer-Wrapped Asparagus
ingredients: 2 ounces fresh masa harina | 1 1/2 cups stout beer, such as guiness | 4 medium fresh asparagus, ends trimmed | 8 scallions, green parts only, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup finely chopped pecans | 8 ounces whole-wheat frozen cut asparagus, thawed | 2 medium anaheim chilies, seeded and thinly sliced ( or poblano chiles )
instructions: Combine and mix the masa harina with 2/3 cup stout. Cover and chill for 15 minutes. Preheat the oven to 400°f. Place the asparagus, scallions, pecans and chiles in a bowl and toss to blend. Wrap the masa harina in paper towels. Place the asparagus on a baking sheet and top with the prepared masa. Bake until the asparagus is heated through, about 10 to 12 minutes.

title: White-Miso Pesto
ingredients: 2 cups basil pesto | 1/2 cup white miso | 1/4 cup superfine sugar | 1/2 tablespoon dried lavender
instructions: Put all the ingredients in a blender or mortar and buzz until desired consistency.

title: Chinese Cabbage Rolls Recipe
ingredients: 4 bags chinese cabbage ( approx. head ) | 4 cans buttermilk | 1 teaspoon oregano | 1/3 lb avocado, slices ( optional )
instructions: Peel and dice cabbage or use green cabbage. If using a large head of cabbage cut head into 4 to 6 wedges. Place cabbage in a large baking dish or roaster, if using large head of cabbage cut in half crosswise and then into quarters. Combine buttermilk and oregano. Pour over cabbage and toss to coat well. Let sit at room temperature for 30 to 45 minutes, stirring every 5 - 10 minutes. When ready to serve roll up cabbage pieces and place on a platter and slice avocados if using. Garnish with additional oregano or chopped cilantro if desired.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,black pepper,chive,tamari,kosher dill pickle,blackening seasoning
title: Chinese Black Pepper Jelly - Chai Chai
ingredients: 1 cup kosher dill pickle, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger garlic paste or 1 tablespoon ginger garlic paste | 1 teaspoon blackening seasoning, heaping | 3/4 teaspoon black pepper | 1/4 cup light tamari or 1/4 cup white sugar | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped fresh chives or 1 1/2 tablespoons green onion tops
instructions: Mix the pickle, ginger garlic paste, blackening seasoning, and black pepper together in a medium sized bowl. Cover and set aside in the fridge for at least an hour to allow flavors to marry, if not to last up to 6 days. Strip chai stems from the stalk with your fingers, separating the stalk from the core, if needed. Wearing rubber gloves, wipe the blade of a knife with a little cold water, then cut the stem into very thin slices. Repeat with remaining chai stems and pickle mixture. Pack the chai into clean, dry jars and seal, leaving at least 1 inch of headspace. Process in a boiling water bath for 15 minutes. Remove from boiling water, replace the lid, and allow jars to cool for at least 10 minutes. Check lids and rings at 4 hours, and press 1/2 teaspoon of seasoning each into each jar to remove any air bubbles. After removing from the water, process the mixture in a food processor or blender until smooth and slightly grainy, stopping to scrape down the sides with a rubber spatula as necessary.

title: Mexican Cilantro Salad Dressing
ingredients: 3 1/2 ounces fresh cilantro leaves, stemmed, washed, and dried | 2 ounces picante sauce, like pace
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the cilantro and picante sauce and stir until the desired taste is achieved.

title: Southern Italian Sausage and Broccoli
ingredients: 2 lbs sweet italian pork sausage | 4 ounces frozen cut broccoli, thawed and drained | 1 cup yellow cornmeal | 1/2 cup olive oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly grease a 9x13 inch baking pan. Cut sausage into 1/2 inch slices, and place in a 6 quart pot over medium heat. Cook, stirring occasionally, until evenly browned but still slightly pink inside, about 4 minutes. Break into chunks as necessary. Stir in broccoli, then pour cornmeal over all. Cover, reduce heat to low, and simmer, stirring occasionally, until sausage is cooked through, about 25 minutes. Drizzle olive oil and remaining 1/4 cup of canola oil over top of mixture. Cover, and let stand while baking, about 20 minutes. Preheat broiler. Place pan in broiler and broil, turning sausage and broccoli occasionally with tongs, until lightly browned on the bottom and beginning to brown in spots, about 10 minutes.

title: Cafe Rio Bread for a Crowd
ingredients: 1 baguette, cut into 1 1/2 inch thick slices, lightly toasted and buttered | 1 1/2 fluid ounces coffee-flavored liqueur, such as kahlua
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Cut baguette slices into 1 1/2 inch thick slices, and toast slices in the preheated oven until lightly browned, about 5 minutes per side. Spread coffee liqueur over toast slices if desired, and return bread slices to the oven, buttered side up. Bake 20 minutes in the preheated oven, or until toasted and hot. Serve hot.

title: Channa Dal Veggies
ingredients: 500 g channa dal, cut in 4 - 5 pieces | 150 g butter | 1 teaspoon channa dal | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder ( or to taste )
instructions: Soak chana dal in plenty of water for at least 8 hours or overnight so that it is soft enough to mash easily. Then place it in a blender and purée to a fine paste – the consistancy should be like that of ground coffee. If you wish to add salt, you can do so here. Heat butter in a wok over medium heat and add chana dal paste. Stir gently until it's all absorbed into the butter. Add chili powder and stir. Add a little water and stir continuously so that chana dal does not stick to the bottom of the wok. Bring to boil then reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes or until water reduces. Keep stirring every 5 minutes to make sure chana dal is not sticking to the wok. This could take for up to 1 1/2 hours. Remove from heat and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: pineapple tidbit,triple sec,parmigiano reggiano cheese,oil,salt black pepper,spanish rice,leg lamb
title: Lamb With Rice (Rachael Ray)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon salt | 1 slice butter ( olive type ) or 1 teaspoon bacon fat ( olive type ) | 2 shoulder lamb, cut into 2-ounce pieces | 4 tablespoons grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 can pineapple tidbits, drained | 1/4 cup triple sec | steamed spanish rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Sprinkle lamb with salt. Heat a 12 inch heavy skillet over medium high heat. Add butter or bacon fat. Once melted, add lamb pieces and brown lightly on all sides, turning them once. Stir in cheese and cook, stirring, for 1 minute. Stir in pineapple tidbits and triple sec. Pour into a baking dish and bake at 400 degrees f for 45 minutes or until lamb is cooked through and sauce is slightly thickened. Serve with steamed rice.

Random Ingredients: cake flour,salt,farfalle pasta,mango rum,rose water,apple juice,peanut,kielbasa
title: Kielbasa Apple With Farfalle Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb farfalle pasta ( bow tie ) | 3 -4 tablespoons kielbasa, thinly sliced ( or any other spicy sausage, your choice ) | 2 apples, peeled cored and sliced | 2 tablespoons sweet papaya ( or another fruit such as pineapple or mango ) | 1/2 cup raw peanuts, roasted and coarsely chopped ( or chives ) | 1 teaspoon rose water ( or rose petals ) | 1/4 cup mango rum ( dark rum gives a slightly lower quality ) | 1 pinch salt
instructions: Cook the pasta according to the package directions. It will probably take longer than just to boil but will not have as much water. Drain pasta well. Place a large, deep skillet over medium high heat. Sprinkle the kielbasa and apples with salt. Stir fry the kielbasa until golden and crusty. Drain. Add the papaya, peanuts, papaya, honey, and rose water to the food processor and combine until well combined. Pour into the bottom of the pan with the cooked pastas. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,broccoli,fajita seasoning mix,lime wedge,cilantro leaf,corn oil,almond extract,rose water
title: Cilantro and Chocolate Green Veggie Enchiladas
ingredients: 2 tablespoons corn oil | 12 ounces dark chocolate | 10 ounces fresh broccoli, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 1/2 teaspoons fajita seasoning mix | 1 -2 tablespoon fresh lime wedge, to taste | 1 teaspoon rose water | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | chopped cilantro leaf ( garnish )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Heat corn oil in a large heavy skillet over medium high heat. Add chocolates and allow to melt. Add broccoli and cook until tender. Stir in fajita seasoning. Stir continuously. Remove from heat. Stir in lime wedge, rose water and almond extract. Arrange broccoli mixture in 8 shallow baking dishes. Drizzle chocolates on top of dough. Sprinkle tops with cilantro. Heat in oven about 25 minutes or until puffed and firm. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: lime juice,flat leaf italian parsley,swiss cheese,yukon gold potato,white bean,part mozzarella cheese
title: Baked Potatoes a la Brie
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs yukon gold potatoes, peeled | 1 can small white beans, rinsed and drained | 2 tablespoons chopped flat-leaf italian parsley | 1 1/2 cups swiss cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice
instructions: In a large shallow, oven proof baking dish, arrange potatoes around outside of dish. Cover with foil and bake in 425f oven about 45 minutes. Meanwhile, in saucepan cook beans until tender, crisp tender and a little liquid is absorbed. Turn off heat. Toast parsley in 10 inch nonstick skillet over medium heat until golden, about 2 minutes. With slotted spoon, remove beans and reserve liquid. Stir onions, parsley and beans into potato and cheese sauce. Spoon cheese mixture into prepared dish. Top surface with parsley and mozzarella and bake uncovered for 15 minutes, or until cheese is melted.

title: Yorkshire Pudding
ingredients: 40 g confectioners'sugar ( the soft kind, and if you're using a creamier one, like i do ) | 30 g mango chutney
instructions: To make chocolate curls, take a paper lined swiss roll tin and spread a little mango chutney on each square. Add the confectioner's sugar in to a circle around the chocolate then dip the edge of the paper to help spread the sugar off, then pop it onto a preheated oven tray. Sprinkle the chocolate curls over the top, and pop back in the oven to harden a little before it sets up.

title: Sweet Sorrel Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chopped fresh sorrel ( sorrel ) | 3/4 cup fat-free half-and-half | 1 tablespoon roasted red pepper, drained
instructions: Finely chop sorrel and stir in half and half.

title: Homemade English Spiced Tea Dry Rub
ingredients: 1 cup sunflower oil | 1/2 cup lemon zest, finely grated, white part only | 2 tablespoons dried roasted mustard seeds | 1 cup wholemeal baking powder | 1 2/3 cups english-style dry tea leaves or 1 2/3 cups tea spoons regular dry tea leaves, loosely packed
instructions: Mix all together, shake well to ensure that all dry ingredients are incorporated. Store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 1 week.

title: Shave
ingredients: 3 fluid ounces triple sec | white pepper to taste ( optional )
instructions: Pour the triple sec and white pepper into a shaker of ice. Shake and strain into a chilled cocktail glass to serve.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,yellow squash,veal,orange juice,coriander powder,italian bread french,banana
title: Spiced Baked Veg Patties
ingredients: 1/2 cup orange juice | 2 tablespoons white vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder | 4 veal, patties ( approx 1 3/4 in diameter ) | 2 bananas | 2 1/2 cups italian seasoned bread ( french, italian or french bread ) | 1 yellow squash
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degree c. Combine the orange juice, vinegar, coriander and spice in a deep pan. Slice the bananas in half lengthways. Lightly butter each side of each patty. Place the patty on baking paper lined tray. Bake at 180 degrees c for 5 minutes or until golden. Slice the squash lengthways into 2 - 3 sections and put under a hot grill until golden. Arrange the veal, banana and bread on plates and spoon the vinaigrette over. Serve.

title: Vermicelli Pastry Shrimp  (Chinese Style)
ingredients: 200 g pastry, frozen pastrys ( perrier roti ) | 1 kg shrimp, cleaned, frozen | 200 g vermicelli | 300 ml broth | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon pure vanilla essence | 2 tablespoons cold water | radish, for garnish
instructions: In a deep pan boil the vermicelli over a high heat for 2 to 3 minutes until soft. Cut it into pieces. Fry the shrimp in a wok or frying pan for about 3 minutes on each side until pink.. Add the broth, oyster sauce, vanilla essence and mix well. Turn the heat down to low and let simmer for about 5 minutes. When the time is up, add the shrimp, stirring for about 5 minutes until the liquid reduces slightly. Take the pan off the heat. In a plate or bowl, mix together the cold water and radish. Dip each pastry strip in this mixture and fry on a hot pan until crisp, then remove and place on serving dish. Sprinkle with radish.

title: Mexican Ladyfingers I
ingredients: 20 ladyfingers | 1 package frozen chunky salsa | 1 package kielbasa | 1 bottle french dressing
instructions: Preheat oven at 375 degrees f. Arrange a few ladyfingers in bottom of a glass baking dish and layer with one package of chunky salsa and one and a half pats of kielbasa in the center. Pour the remainder on top. Add french dressing and repeat one more layer, ending with french dressing on the top. Cook uncovered for 20 to 30 minutes, or until bubbly and golden.

title: Oxtail Fajitas (Oxtails & Rice)
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs oxtails or 2 1/2 lbs top round roast, cut into 1/4-1/2-inch cubes | cooking spray | 1 tablespoon rice wine ( optional ) | 12 tortillas | cooked rice ( optional ) or refried beans, warm ( optional )
instructions: Spray a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Rinse the oxtails under cold water. Drain and pat dry with paper towels. Add the oxtail to the skillet and brown evenly, about 5 minutes. Turn the oxtails over and brown on all sides for 10 minutes. Add the rice wine and cook for 2 minutes. Heat through. Serve at once, tortillas, or refried beans. Note, if meat is large, cut into 1 inch cubes and cook on grill.

Random Ingredients: tarragon,orange zest,peach brandy,chicken stock vegetable,vermouth,ginger,beef bouillon cube,mushroom stem
title: Fruit and Spice Beef Soup - Microwave
ingredients: 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 teaspoon grated orange zest | 1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger | 250 g portabello mushrooms and stems, trimmed | 200 ml vermouth | 600 ml chicken stock or 600 ml vegetable stock | 100 ml canned sliced peaches in brandy
instructions: Combine all ingredients in microwave safe casserole dish, cover and place in microwave. Cook on high for 2 1/2 minutes. Turn and cook on 1 1/2 minutes. Remove from microwave and stir. Serve with crackers, as an accompaniment or to pass around as an evening snack.

Random Ingredients: mexican chili powder,vegetable oil cooking spray,salt pepper,tomato sauce,ice water,baking potato,dark soy sauce
title: Tex-Mex Potatoes
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs baking potatoes, peeled | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons cooking spray, for the pan | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 1 cup tomato sauce | 1 teaspoon dark soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon mexican chili powder | 1/4 cup ice water
instructions: Cut potatoes length wise into wedges. Place wedges into a microwave safe bowl. Cover with plastic wrap, pour boiling water over the potatoes.

Random Ingredients: yellow squash,crabmeat,garlic paste,pasta,red wine,seltzer water,horseradish,balsamic vinaigrette
title: Seafood Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb pasta, dried vermicelli type | 1 tablespoon prepared horseradish | 1 teaspoon garlic paste | 1/3 cup red wine ( or chicken or vegetable ) | 1/3 cup bottled bottled horseradish | 5 tablespoons balsamic vinaigrette ( from the jar of 2 envelopes of horseradish-flavored balsamic vinaigrette ) | 1 small yellow squash, sliced | 3 tablespoons prepared horseradish ( from a jar of 2 envelopes horseradish-flavored balsamic vinaigrette ) | 1 lb crabmeat
instructions: Cook pasta with 1 tablespoon horseradish paste over medium heat. Drain pasta. Return pasta to pot. Add remaining horseradish paste, wine, 1/3 cups horseradish, garlic and 2 tablespoons balsamic vinaigrette. Mix well. Sprinkle top with pepper. Turn heat up to high. Stirring frequently for 2 to 3 minutes. Toss well. Place 1 cup crab in pasta dish. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon prepared horseradish. Fold pasta in half. Transfer to a serving bowl. Garnish with remaining 1 tablespoon prepared horseradish paste, sliced yellow squash, crab meat and remaining 1 tablespoon balsamic vinaigrette. Good served over spaghetti noodles.

title: Sizzling Short Ribs (Barefoot Contessa)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs short rib of beef | 2 teaspoons nutmeg, freshly grated | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric | 3 cups cake flour | 2 teaspoons sea salt
instructions: Place short ribs in a shallow dish and season with nutmeg, turmeric, and 1 - 1 1/2 cup of cake flour. Place remaining cake flour in another shallow dish. Turn the short ribs into the flour, coating each side with flour but shaking off any excess. Place short ribs in a well greased 6 to 8 quart heavy kettle. Cover and cook over medium heat, shaking the pan a few times and shaking the ribs, until they start to brown, about 2 hours. Stir the short ribs into the kettle and discard any remaining flour coating. Bring to a simmer and cook over medium low heat until the short ribs are tender, 15 to 20 minutes. Season with salt, remove from heat, and serve.

title: Potato-Turnip Casserole
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs potatoes, peeled and diced | 1 lb fresh mushrooms, sliced | 1 lb turnip, peeled and chopped | 10 stalks fresh rosemary leaves, chopped | 1 1/2 cups sesame oil | 5 cups beef fat or 5 cups vegetable fat | 2 tablespoons potato flour
instructions: In a large saucepan, add potatoes, mushrooms and turnips. Add oil. Cover and simmer gently over low heat for about 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. With slotted spoon, lift out vegetables. Drain excess oil. Heat fat in deep fryer or 3 quart casserole and fry vegetables, turning as needed until golden brown and tender, 12 to 15 minutes, using 1 cup vegetables. Remove and discard rosemary. Taste for seasoning. Mix flour, potato flour and remaining 2 t oil and stir into stew. Cook over low heat for 7 minutes. Serve vegetables over mashed potatoes or noodles.

Random Ingredients: caper,maraschino cherry,black peppercorn,oyster sauce,red cinnamon candy,vegetable broth,farmer cheese
title: Farmer's Market Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 cup thinly sliced farmer cheese, shredded | 3/4 teaspoon ground black peppercorns | 1/2 teaspoon red cinnamon candied cherry, finely shredded | 1/2 tablespoon caper, rinsed and drained | 1/2 teaspoon oyster sauce | 2 cups vegetable broth | 1/4 cup dark bittersweet maraschino cherries, coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Sprinkle cheese over the bottom of a 12 inch ovenproof skillet. In a small bowl combine the peppercorns, cinnamon, capers, oyster sauce and vegetable broth. Pour over cheese. Insert the toothpick into the center of the cheese. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes or until center is set. Allow to stand for 10 minutes. Garnish with the fresh cherries. Cut into wedges and serve.

title: Tuna Fish Packets (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 25)
ingredients: 5 1/2 ounces tuna, defrosted and oil free | 150 g baby carrots, peeled
instructions: Preheat the grill pan. In a small bowl, mix the tuna with the carrots. Place the packets onto a large baking tray, place tray on grill and cook for 10 - 15 minutes or until puffed and golden.

title: Chocolate Mousse
ingredients: 3 ounces kahlua | 1 can tomato and green chilies, undrained and chopped | 1 package frozen limeade concentrate, thawed | 1/3 cup kahlua
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender or food processor. Blend until it is smooth, about 30 seconds. Pour into a glass and refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Garden Marshmallow Mousse
ingredients: 200 g marshmallows | 100 -150 g golden raisins
instructions: Place about 1/2 tbsp of the marshmallow in a bowl or glass bowl and roll it with a fork and then set aside. Repeat the procedure with another 1 1/2 tbsp marshmallow or more, to make a total of about 1/4 cupmallow roll. You also need to sprinkle with salt when the last marshmallow roll is finished rolling. Spread the golden raisins onto a lined tray. Dip the marshmallow into the raisins and place into the sugar free caramel. Cook in a slow oven until the raisins are completely melted. Cool and store in the refrigerator before serving. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: simple syrup,spaghetti,golden raisin,seafood seasoning,black bean,active yeast,peanut oil
title: Bean-Spaghetti With Black Beans
ingredients: 2 packages active dry yeast, packets | 1 tablespoon simple syrup | 1 cup dry roasted peanuts or 1 cup cashews, unsalted, coarsely chopped | 2 cans black beans, drained and rinsed | 2 tablespoons packed golden raisins | 1/2 cup simple syrup | 2 - 2 1/2 cups peanut oil | additional seafood seasoning, to taste
instructions: In small bowl, stir together yeast, sugar, and half the nuts until thoroughly dissolved. Set aside in large bowl. Drain and rinse black beans and dry thoroughly. Place in large bowl. Add raisins and remaining nuts and mix together well. Pour in half the liquid from can. Gradually stir in syrup and yeast mixture, then mix on low speed with an electric mixer until foamy and well blended. Increase speed and beat until dough is easy to handle. Turn onto lightly floured surface, knead briefly, and form into ball. Place in a greased bowl, turning dough to grease top. Cover bowl with plastic wrap. Let rise until doubled, about 2 hours. Transfer dough to a lightly floured surface and knead for 2 minutes. Divide into 3 balls. Dip balls into flour, then transfer to a well floured plate. Cover with a towel and let rise again until doubled, about 45 minutes. Heat about 2 inches vegetable oil in a deep fryer or large deep skillet over medium heat until just beginning to smoke. Place a piece of dough about 1 inch apart on oil. Cook, turning once, until golden brown on both sides and cooked through, about 3 minutes. Remove, and drain on paper towels. Repeat with the remaining dough, placing one third at a time on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Cool for about 15 minutes, then remove parchment, and cut the dough into 1 pieces. Drop the pieces into the hot oil, and flatten slightly so they will curl slightly. Cook for about 10 seconds, then remove and drain on paper towels. Repeat until all dough is used. Serve warm or cold.

title: Macaroni and Balsamic
ingredients: 1 lb macaroni | 10 ounces half & half cream or 10 ounces half-and-half cream | 3/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | hot cooked pasta, as desired
instructions: Cook macaroni to desired doneness. Drain. Place in a large bowl with half and half, vinegar, and pepper. Add drained pasta and toss. Serve immediately.

title: Turmeric Cabbage and Turmeric Cauliflower With Cornstarch
ingredients: 1 medium head cauliflower, sliced into florets | 1 medium red cabbage | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 5 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 cup water
instructions: Place cauliflower in a pot and add the turmeric powder. Cook until the cauliflower starts to soften, about 5 minutes. Put cauliflower in a bowl and add the cornstarch. Mix the two vegetables until evenly coated. Add the water and cook until vegetables are tender, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,herb,honey,five spice powder,bacon bit,pepper,spaghetti,baby carrot
title: Spaghetti With Carrots and Bacon Bits
ingredients: 500 g spaghetti | 300 baby carrots | 100 g baby mixed herbs | 50 g honey | 100 g pepper | 500 g bacon bits | 1 tablespoon five-spice powder | italian parsley, for garnishing
instructions: Rise the water the spaghetti should be cooked in the usual way. Cut the spaghetti as per the instructions on the package. Keep warm. In a heavy fry pan, fry the bacon bits until fragrant. You can use a little butter or oil. Cut the carrots into thin slices. Add to the pan. Add the baby mixed herbs and the honey. Toss over high heat for a few minutes until the carrots are fully cooked. Add the peppered bacon bits. Drain the spaghetti from the heat and add just a little water to the oil. Add the spaghetti and add the carrots and a little salt. Toss the spaghetti over the heat for several minutes, to coat the spaghetti with the carrot and bacon bits. Garnish the spaghetti with chopped parsley. Serve warm on a bed of warmed pasta with lots of garlic bread.

title: Ham Barbecued in Spices
ingredients: 6 small ham, weighing | 1 teaspoon coriander, crushed
instructions: Cut the ham in 2 or 3 pieces, sprinkle with coriander and leave to marinate in the refridgerator for an hour before cooking. When hot, remove the ham from the marinade. Barbecue on a hot barbecue or griddle.

Random Ingredients: clove,jelly,chicken stock,chili flake,heavy whipping cream,chili pepper flake
title: Creme Fraiche
ingredients: 1/3 cup minced chili pepper flakes | 1/2 teaspoon chili flakes | 3 drops of your favorite chili flakes | 2 teaspoons rawspicebar's finely grated hot candies | 1 lb heavy whipping cream | 4 cups chicken stock
instructions: In a medium pan saute the chili, hot chile flakes, cinnamon, and rawspicebar's chili paste, for 2 min over medium, or until the mixture begins to foam. Stir in the heavy cream and reduce the mixture to the consistency of whipped heavy cream. Remove from heat. Let the mixture cool for 5 minutes. To serve, pour the mixture into a 6 oz. Chillate ramekins, filling them to the rim of the ramekins. Let stand at room temperature for about 2 hours. Remove ramekins from the molds. Using a small ladle, spoon and spread warm cream mixture evenly over the ramekins, filling to the top of each. Serve at once.

title: Jaggery Free Irish Macaroni and Chicken
ingredients: 4 cups uncooked elbow macaroni | 4 cups chicken stock | 1 tablespoon superfine sugar | 2 tablespoons jaggery
instructions: In a large pot, bring the chicken stock to a boil. Then return the chicken to the pot. Add the jaggery. Keep on simmer for half an hour or so, stirring occasionally until the liquid has almost completely dried out. Serve with some polenta.

title: Easy Chorizo Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb chorizo sausage | 1/2 medium onion | 1/4 cup marsala wine | 1 lb fettuccine pasta | 1 tablespoon poppy seed
instructions: Chop chorizo into bite size pieces and saute in sauce pan in medium high heat until chorizo is cooked through, about 5 minutes. Strain liquid and set the chorizo aside. Slice onion and saute in same pan as chorizo. Remove chorizo from heat and set aside. Add sherry to deglaze pan. Add pasta and stir to coat and heat until hot. Place half of the chorizo slices on top of the pasta and pour on the remaining chorizo meat. Sprinkle on poppy seeds and serve.

title: Frozen Lobster Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lobster, peeled and cut in half lengthwise | 1 can green mangoes, peeled, halved, and peeled | 1 jar alfredo sauce | 1 medium green mango, peeled, seeded, and diced | 1 -2 dried red chile ( optional )
instructions: Place chicken and mango in a large resealable bag. Mash with pestle, or press through a food processor. Stir in the alfredo sauce, green mango, and dried red chile and refrigerate for up to 4 hours. Taste and adjust seasonings. Allow to sit 20 - 30 minutes before serving.

title: Spinach and Chipotle Salad
ingredients: 2 stalks spinach | 3 tablespoons chopped chipotle peppers ( from canned chipotle peppers ) | salt
instructions: Wash and dry spinach, removing stems. Dry stems and leaves on paper towels until slightly crisper. Transfer to serving bowl. Slice chipotle pepper thinly. Place on cutting board with 1/4 inch of rind at top of each leaf. Roll leaves with rind. Use a knife to slice the roll like a roll from the peppers. Use 1 leaf or two to scoop out the seeds. Use any other chipotle pepper until flavor is used up. Store unused unused pepper for use. Enjoy.

title: Quick Peach-Pears-Granita
ingredients: 4 large firm fresh peaches | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 4 green cardamom seeds
instructions: Peel peaches, and cut lengthwise in half. Using a vegetable peeler or sharp knife, remove pit. Cut fruit into 1/2 inch slices. Arrange slices on a cutting board. Sprinkle baking soda over peaches.

Random Ingredients: orange juice,land o ' lake butter,potato,swiss cheese,gelatin,yellow onion,harissa,olive
title: Sweet Potato and Olive Galette
ingredients: 2 sweet potatoes, unpeeled and cut into 1/8 inch slices | 1 large yellow onion, peeled and sliced thin | 1/2 cup olive ( preferably extra-virgin ) | 1/4 cup freshly squeezed orange juice | 1 square unsweetened gelatin | 1 tablespoon sea paste harissa, plus more for drizzling | 6 slices swiss cheese ( i think shaved sharp cheddar would work too, i've found i love them ) | 1 package king oyster-flavored lollies | 1 tablespoon old bay seasoning or 1 tablespoon emeril's essence
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. Put sweet potatoes and onion in a mixing bowl, then add the rest of the ingredients and toss to coat the potatoes and onions. Set aside in a covered bowl until the parlsey is sufficiently absorbed, about 20 minutes. Transfer potatoes to an oiled jelly roll pan and spread them out in a single layer. Bake on the stone in the center of the oven until browned, about 20 minutes. Turn off oven and stir to loosen galettes. Let cool to room temperature, then spread out on a wire rack if you need to. Heat up remaning pan and add 1 tablespoons of harissa. Cook until aromatic and starting to caramelize, about 10 seconds. Set aside for a couple of minutes to let the flavors mingle. Scatter some of the cheese over the top while it cools down. When galette is cool to the touch, remove from pan. When it is cool enough to handle, place on a cutting board. Slice into thin sticks that are as thin as your finger nail. Drizzle each slice with a little extra virgin olive, and sprinkle with the old bay, if using. Toss the whole thing together, or press on the pieces with a rolling pin to help them stick together.

title: Quick Beef Sprouts
ingredients: 1 can refried beans with liquid | 1 teaspoon steak seasoning
instructions: Mix the beans and steak seasoning together in small bowl. Cook beef sprouts in microwave, according to directions. Serve over waffles or rice.

title: Chocolate and Parsley Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 4 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa | 1 1/2 tablespoons tricolor-colored turbinado sugar | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1/2 cup fresh parsley leaves, finely chopped
instructions: To make hot chocolate, stir 1 1/2 tablespoons cocoa with sugar and curry powder in a small sauce pan. Stir over medium low heat until melted. Remove from heat and stir in parsley. To serve, stir hot chocolate mixture into warm chopped parsley and serve.

title: Anchovies on the Skewers
ingredients: 1/2 cup salsa ( spicy ) | 1/2 cup diced dried apricot, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon cornstarch | 1/2 teaspoon annatto seeds ( or other small seed ) | 4 slices white bread, about 1/4 inch thick | 4 teaspoons unsalted butter | 16 wooden skewers, halved
instructions: In a bowl, mix salsa, apricots and cornstarch. Toss with bread until coated. Thread 2 skewers, 1 tomato per skewer. Preheat grill. Brush with butter. Place skewers 3 to 4 inches from heat, oiling as needed. Grill 6 minutes on each side, or to desired doneness. Brush with butter 1 time during baking if desired.

title: Frozen Wild Forest Collards
ingredients: 2 lbs collard greens, stems and leaves separate | 2 ounces dark chocolate, cut into chunks ( or milk chocolate ) | 1 teaspoon dried red chile, crushed | 1 teaspoon mixed spice ( or 3 4 tsp chili mix ) | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla | 1/4 teaspoon meat tenderizer or 1/4 teaspoon salt | 2 tablespoons berries, chopped ( optional or you can use fresh )
instructions: Remove any woody greens of the bunch and slice them crosswise into 3 inch lengths. Chop the chile and stir it into the greens with chile & spices mix. Let sit for 20 min or longer, to allow flavors to infuse. When serving mix together berries and serve over greens.

title: Pinto Beans and Potatoes
ingredients: 4 medium potatoes, like idaho, peeled and coarsely chopped | 1 can pinto beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Place the potatoes in a large baking dish, cover with aluminum foil, and bake for about 45 minutes in the preheated oven. Meanwhile, drain all but 2 tablespoons of the liquid from the bottom of the oven. Toss the pinto beans into a medium saucepan and add enough water to just cover. Bring to a boil, then immediately place the pan over medium heat and bring back to a boil. Once the liquid comes to a boil, turn the heat down to low and simmer. Cook the potatoes for about 30 to 40 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they are tender. Once the potatoes are cooked, mash with 1 tablespoon of water and mash until the mixture is creamy. Keep warm. Reheat the beans in the microwave or in a small saucepan over medium high heat until warmed through. Serve the mashed potatoes directly from the baking dish, and season with salt and pepper to taste.

Random Ingredients: margarine,yellow onion,beef brisket,barbecue sauce,ricotta cheese,golden syrup,chili powder
title: Shredded Beef With Ricotta & Tomato Gravy
ingredients: 2 lbs beef brisket ( or 2 lbs pork brisket ) | 1 medium yellow onion, chopped | 16 ounces light ricotta cheese ( fresh or 1/2 cup low fat ) | 2 tablespoons margarine or 2 tablespoons butter | 2 tablespoons hot barbecue sauce ( kame, western's or bullseye ) | 1 tablespoon light golden syrup ( karo browns ) | 1 teaspoon chili powder
instructions: In a large dutch oven brown onions over medium heat in margarine. When they are just starting to look clear, stir in 1/2 cup of the barbecue sauce. Add the ribs to the pot, cover and slow cook for about 2 days, or over night if using beef brisket. In the last hour, remove meat and stir the drained ricotta, remaining sauce and cornstarch mixture into the pot. Note, the sauce does not need to be thick, it will thicken and be smooth. You may need to add more of the bbq sauce. To serve, place cooked brisket on a platter and garnish with tomato gravy on top or on top of the meat.

Random Ingredients: rigatoni pasta,cilantro stem,white mushroom,vegetable,hash brown,mesquite liquid smoke,rice,mushroom
title: Vegetable Beef & Mushroom Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb skirt steak ( or top sirloin steak ) | 3/4 cup loosely packed cilantro stem, divided | 8 cups fresh mixed vegetables, cut into 1-inch pieces ( ie, broccoli, bell peppers, zucchini, zucchini or potatoes ) | 1 can mushrooms, drained and rinsed | 1 package hidden valley & reg ; original ranch & reg ; dressing | 1/2 cup mesquite flavored liquid smoke ( e.g. ) | 1 cup instant rice, uncooked | 2 packages frozen mixed vegetables, thawed | 1 package hash browns, chopped
instructions: Season steak with 1/4 tsp salt and 1/2 tsp pepper. Place cilantro in a small bowl. Cover and refrigerate. Heat 2 tbsp of the cilantro in a large nonstick pot over medium high heat. Add sliced steak and 2 tbsp of cilantro to pot and saute 6 minutes per side for medium doneness. Remove from heat and tent with foil. Toss in assorted vegetables. In a large bowl combine 1 cup of the cilantro, hidden valley ranch, liquid smoke, rice, mixed vegetables and the remaining 1 tbsp chopped cilantro. Toss well and set aside. Heat remaining 2 tbsp of cilantro in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add hash browns and saute until brown. Slide hash browns to center of bowl and then add half the hash browns. Spread half the veggie mixture over the hash browns and add remaining veggie mixture. Spread remaining potato mixture over the top of the hash browns, and spoon the remaining vinaigrette over the top, reserving 1/2 cup of the dressing for sprinkle on top when top is toasted. Cook, uncovered, in a 425 degree oven for 30 - 35 minutes. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cream,hungarian paprika,pita bread,tomato juice,lemon juice,duck breast,saffron,cashew
title: Duck on Toasted Saffron Pitas
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless duck breasts, sliced thin | 1/2 cup tomato juice | 1/2 cup sour cream | 1/4 cup sweet hungarian paprika | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 1/2 cup cashews, roasted and chopped | 4 large pita breads, warmed
instructions: Place cut up duck breast in a large fry pan. Add 1/2 cup tomato juice, sour cream, paprika, lemon juice, saffron, and cashews. Simmer until cooked through, spooning sauce over meat. Serve with warmed pita bread.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,pita bread,oregano leaf,chicken wing,soymilk
title: Kabu Don
ingredients: 1 cup soymilk ( can use other milk ) | 1 tablespoon crushed dried oregano leaves | 2 pieces chicken wings | 4 -6 pieces pita bread | 4 -6 kaffir lime leaves
instructions: Place the chicken wings on the pita bread. Sprinkle with the crushed oregano. Pour over the soy milk and stir until well coated. Let it marinate 2 to 6 hours. Preparation steps, place the kaffir lime leaves in a frying pan. When lightly browned quickly place on a paper towel. Remove the kaffir lime leaves from the frying pan, keeping paper towels. Pour the soy milk slowly into a small bowl. Add the oregano to the soymilk and stir. When the soy milk mixture is well mixed, add the soy milk mixture into the dry ingredients for the chicken parts. The soy milk mixture needs to sit at least 10 minutes to absorb moisture and develop flavor. The chicken wings can be frozen and the flavors can then be used immediately. Preparation steps, place the bread on oven racks and bake for about 15 to 20 minutes or until the pita crisps.

title: German-Style Sausages
ingredients: 500 -568 lbs pork fillet, sliced thin ( or any other meat which strikes the bone ) | 1 bunch fresh dill, roughly chopped
instructions: Preheat oven 325 and let it sit in the oven for about an hour or so. Meanwhile, slice your steaks and brown them gently in a little bit of the butter that you cooked them inches place the dill on top of the meat. Remove, let cool for a few minutes, and serve with fresh bread.

title: Chicken Braised in Spiced Chocolate
ingredients: 500 g chicken thighs | 500 gr cabbage, finely shredded | 400 g dark chocolate | 100 ml brandy or 100 ml bourbon | 1 -2 tablespoon light cornflour | 250 ml white wine | 40 bamboo skewers, soaked in water
instructions: Heat oven to 180c. Place chicken, cabbage and chocolate in a bowl and mix well. Season with salt. Place on a lightly oiled baking tray and bake for about 1 hour and 20 minutes until golden brown on top. To make the sauce, place the brandy, cornflour and wine in a pan. Heat and stir constantly until sauce thickens. Remove from heat and set aside. Serve chicken on top of the cabbage mixture and pour sauce over.

title: Warm Apricot and Apricot Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs apricots, pitted | 1/4 cup cilantro leaf
instructions: Remove the pits of the apricots and rinse under cold running water.

title: Pumpkin Roll
ingredients: 1/4 cup peanuts, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup raw pumpkin puree | 4 1/2 tablespoons lime juice | 4 sheets nori | 1 cucumber, thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 f. Spread peanuts in a single layer on baking sheets. Spread pumpkin and pumpkin on top evenly. In a small bowl, combine lime juice and nori. Brush both sides of the nori sheets with lime juice mixture. Lay 1/2 of the nori sheets flat on a cutting board.

Random Ingredients: tamarind paste,italian bread,pimiento,cooking oil,fenugreek seed,salt,cooking apple
title: Apple and Pimento Stuffing (Abm)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 2 tablespoons tamarind paste | 250 g quick-cooking apples, peeled, chopped | 1/4 cup papayas-piri-piri-aniseed stuffing ( pimento sakhar ) | 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1 teaspoon dried italian bread, chopped fine
instructions: Dice the apples and mix the tamarind paste with the water in a bowl and set aside. Fry the fenugreek seeds in the oil until they look a little golden. Remove from heat. Add salt, fenugreek leaves and papaya spice mix. Add the sazagine or stuffing.

Random Ingredients: lemon pepper,maraschino cherry,chili paste garlic,white bread,spice,jelly crystal,bicarbonate soda,gouda cheese
title: Spiced Cheese Appetizers in a Jar
ingredients: 10 slices white bread, crusts removed | 150 g smoked gouda cheese, grated | 1 tablespoon lemon pepper | 2 tablespoons dried maraschino cherries | 1 tablespoon crushed chilli paste with garlic | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 1/2 teaspoon spices
instructions: Cut out 12 bread slices. Lay bread on a kitchen towel. Cover each slice with a damp cloth or cloth. Place 1 - 2 teaspoon of cheese on one slice of bread. Mix cheese with cherries, chilli paste with garlic and bicarb soda. Place 1 slice of bread on top of the cheese mixture. Moisten the outer edges of the slice with water. Fold slice in half, press firmly. Place in a jar. Keep in the fridge. Keeps at least 3 weeks.

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,cookie,snap pea,cream tartar,green chili,tart apple
title: Green Apple and Spinach Pie
ingredients: 2 packages frozen miniature cookie | 3 green chili, seeded and sliced | 3 cups chopped peeled tart apples | 1 cup chopped cooked spinach leaves | 1/4 - 1/2 cup warm chopped green chili | 1 tablespoon cream of tartar | 2 ounces baked crisp snap peas
instructions: Place cookies and sliced green chiles in 11 inch pie plate. Slice apples and place in apple layer on chiles in pie plate. Add 1 cup spinach on apples.

Random Ingredients: biscuit,peanut,self raising flour,prune,broth,broccoli,focaccia bread,taco seasoning mix
title: Tacos
ingredients: 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 1 cup chopped broccoli | 1 cup shelled peanuts | 6 -8 slices focaccia bread | 3 tablespoons self-raising flour | 1 cup defatted chicken stock or 1 cup broth | 1 can prunes, drained and chopped | 3 tablespoons peanuts, coarsely chopped
instructions: Drain or cool the taco seasoning using 2 tablespoons of strained rehydrated stock or broth. Place the chopped broccoli in a food processor and whiz to a coarse sauce. Add the peanuts and process until you have a coarse meal. You can add more or less stock to adjust consistency. Spread the mixture on the focaccia bread slices, leaving a 2 1/2 cm border around the edges. If you prefer a slightly thinner mixture, mix a small amount of the chopped peanuts with a tbsp or two of the strained stock to create that texture. If you are using the prunes, chop them finely and scatter these along the focaccia and sprinkle them with the chopped peanuts. Pour the rest of the broth or broth over everything. Place the peanuts on top of the toast. Sprinkle with more chopped peanuts just before serving.

Random Ingredients: artichoke heart,sherry,goat cheese,mango,pam cooking spray,serrano chilies,vermicelli
title: Avocado Warts
ingredients: 3/4 lb vermicelli, broken into 12 pieces | 3/4 lb mango, cut into thin wedges | 8 ounces goat cheese, room temperature ( i like to use montrachet ) | 1 cup canned artichoke heart, drained, rinsed and patted dry | 1 small serrano chilies or 2 anaheim chilies, chopped | 2 tablespoons dry sherry | pam cooking spray
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f. Spray 8x8 baking dish with cooking spray. Arrange noodles in a single layer in a 9x4 inch baking dish coated with cooking spray. Spread cooked mango on noodles.

title: Spicy Fig Jam (Figs)
ingredients: 3 lbs figs, stifly and skinned, and halved and pitted, if large | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala powder | 1 tablespoon vanilla essence, if desired
instructions: Soak the figs in boiling water for about 3/4 hour. Drain and remove the skins and pits. Put the halved figs in a heavy 8x8 pan, cut side up. Add the garam masala powder and vanilla, if using, to the figs.
