Stir them together and put the pan in a preheated oven on the middle rack for about 45 min or until reduced a little and jam has formed a saucepan consistency. Turn the oven off, but let sit the pan for 5 munutes before removing it onto a board. Serve warm, warm or chilled. Enjoy.

title: Buffalo Chicken with Alfredo Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup prepared alfredo sauce | 1 cup cranberry sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Empty Alfredo sauce into a large baking dish. Stir cranberry sauce into the sauce. Drop chicken by the spoonful onto the sauce. Bake in the preheated oven until cooked through, about 25 minutes.

title: Mushrooms and Ricotta-Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 lbs medium button mushrooms | 4 tablespoons ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup whipping cream | 1 teaspoon hot sauce | 2 tablespoons finely chopped of fresh mint
instructions: Rinse mushrooms, dry and dry. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Mix together ricotta and whipping cream. Add hot sauce and mint, mix. Gently fold through mushrooms. Place in a baking pan/crock pot. Bake for 1 hour, covered, stirring every 15 minutes. Remove from heat and allow to cool.

title: Cheese With Applesauce (Swiss)
ingredients: 1 cup shredded gruyere cheese ( more or less ) | 1 1/2 cups cottage cheese | 1/4 - 1/2 cup unsweetened applesauce | 1 tablespoon horseradish | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon, crushed | 1 teaspoon sugar
instructions: Place cheese, cottage cheese, horseradish, granulated sugar and apple sauce in a food processor. Process until well blended, about 3 - 4 seconds, scraping sides of processor constantly. Pour into a greased casserole dish. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and bake 350 degrees for 25 - 30 minutes until bubbly and cheese is browned.

title: Spanish Beet and Pear Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups raw beets, peeled and sliced | 1 aubergine, sliced | 100 g fontina cheese, sliced | 1/2 cup shelled pistachios, coarsely crushed | 1 teaspoon unsweetened ketchup | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 teaspoon anjou pear, shredded
instructions: Combine beet slices, 1/2 cup fontina cheese and nuts. Mix ketchup and spices. Arrange in bowls, garnish with pear.

title: Gewurztraminer
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 cups wine vinegar | 1/2 cup ground nutmeg | 8 vanilla beans
instructions: Boil the vinegar until it thickens. Put the drained vinegar into a glass jar with a tight fitting lid and add the nutmeg and vanilla beans. Let the mixture stand in the refridgerator for at least 1 hour before using. Taste and correct seasoning and pour into sterilized jars..

Random Ingredients: kosher salt black pepper,hazelnut,shell pasta,canola oil,potato flake
title: Sweet Potato Hazelnut Macaroni Cheese
ingredients: 1 package shell pasta, such as radiatore | 1/2 cup potato flakes | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1/2 cup hazelnuts, toasted and coarsely chopped | 1 pinch kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the shell pasta, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until cooked through, but still firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Cool for a few minutes in the sink, then drain again. Place the potato flakes in a microwavable bowl. Cook and stir canola oil in a microwave safe skillet over medium low heat until hot, about 1 minute. Stir in the hazelnuts, season with salt and pepper, and heat for 1 minute to sizzle. Serve the macaroni with the chewy hazelnut sauce.

title: Beet in a Salt Crust (Sirloin Burgundy)
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 2 -3 slices peeled and shredded gingerroot ( about 1/2-inch thick ) | 1 1/2 cups coarsely-chopped beets | 2 granny smith apples or 2 granny smith apples, peeled, cored, and diced into 1/4-inch cubes | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
instructions: Cut the sirloin into 1/4 inch thick slices. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Place in a nonstick skillet and sear on each side over medium high heat about 4 minutes per side. Remove and set aside. Saute the ginger root in a little fat until fragrant. Add the beets and apples and cook for about 5 minutes, stirring frequently. Add the beef and any accumulated juices and stir. Cover and cook for about 10 minutes. Stir in the cinnamon. Transfer thebeet mixture into a 1 1/2 quart baking dish. Bake, uncovered, for about 1 1/2 hours at 400°f. Allow to cool and serve. Do not let the liquid boil as it should be cool. This is very good served hot. Note, you can prepare this with the cooking and cooking juices. For a richer flavor, cover and boil to reduce liquid. For a milder flavor, cover and simmer for another 25 minutes. Serve in deep bowls.

title: Crispy Fried Naan
ingredients: 1 (.25 ounce ) package instant yeast | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: In a small bowl dissolve the yeast in a lukewarm water. In a medium bowl, dissolve the turmeric in 1/2 teaspoon of the turmeric. Stir the tumeric into the yeast mixture. Drain the lukewarm water and pour yeast mixture into the bowl. Stir until the yeast has dissolved. Cover with a clean cloth or plastic wrap and leave at room temperature until the moisture has become bubbly, about 20 minutes. This can be done in the microwave on high power for up to 15 minutes. It will have bubbled up a bit and become smooth and wet. Remove from the bowl, but do not knead. Cover tightly with a clean cloth and leave somewhere to rise until the yeast has dissolved into the liquid. This should take about 1 1/2 to 2 hours. The longer this sits the more flavorful it will become. The temperature of your kitchen will probably rise quite high while your kitchen rises. Lightly oil a frying pan, put it in your oven, and set a burner to medium heat. If you have a baking stone set at the floor, place it on the floor. Place a tray on your counter, and use your fingers to make an indentation into the middle of the tray. Now, put your 5 naan balls in the tray, and with a wet finger, make indentations across the naan. Sprinkle a little of the turmeric onto the top of each naan, then carefully spoon the melted butter over each. Put in the oven on broil until just set, about 5 minutes. Turn off the oven, and open the oven door. If you have a gas or charcoal grill, put the tray in your oven for 10 minutes so the burnt smell of the butter dissipates. You can watch this disappear for a minute or two before you eat.

title: Quick & Easy Vegetable Pasta and Cabbage
ingredients: 3 boxes rotini pasta | 1 head green cabbage
instructions: Cook pasta per package directions drain and rinse in cold water. When done toss with green cabbage. Eat and enjoy. Makes 1 cup.

Random Ingredients: chocolate chip,dill weed,olive,artichoke heart,beef,lite olive oil,pistachio
title: Baked Artichoke Hearts With Pistachios and Chocolate Chips
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground beef | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 1 can sliced ripe olives, drained | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 tablespoon fresh dill weed | 1 package mori-nuoc n padano chocolate chips | 1/4 cup crushed pistachios
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Butter the inside of the loaf pan with cooking spray. Mix beef, olives, oil, herbs, and noodles. Pour into loaf pan,. Top with chocolate chips. Bake 30 minutes. Remove from oven, remove top, and sprinkle with pistachios. This can be served warm, but can be baked right away.

title: Brandy Flush
ingredients: 1 teaspoon cornflour | kosher salt | 1 tablespoon brandy | 1 cup frozen whipped topping
instructions: Heat oven to 200 degrees celsius. Pour cornflour into a bowl. Add salt and brandy to the cornflour, mix them well, and drizzle into 2 baking trays. Sprinkle over mini muffins tin. Bake for 10 - 15 minutes, until the top turn golden. Serve warm.

title: Beef Gorgonzola
ingredients: 4 beef top round steaks | 4 eggs | 3 tablespoons simple syrup | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1/2 cup gorgonzola | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh apricots, or more to taste | 2 serrano peppers, chopped
instructions: Place the beef steaks in a 9x13 inch heavy baking dish. Whisk together the eggs, simple syrup, turmeric, and gorgonzola in a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: french dressing,ginger paste,egg yolk,frying chicken,cake flour
title: Chinese Fried Chicken
ingredients: 20 small frying chicken ( i use the breast size or wings ) | 1 teaspoon ginger paste | 1 cup french dressing ( can also use italian and french 7 spice ) | fritter/cake flour | 2 egg yolks
instructions: Cut the wings into 3 - 4 sections or use whatever size you like. Cut the legs and chop them into a 1/4 inch thick slivers. Mix the ginger paste, dressing and flour together and coat chicken wings, shaking off any excess. Put chicken in a pan and cover with cold water. Heat for 15 - 20 minutes, or until cooked through. Drain and pat dry. While chicken is cooking, prepare the sauce by putting all ingredients except flour, egg yolks and hot sauce in a bowl. Stir until blended. Fry chicken in hot oil until golden brown on the outside, remove and place on paper towels to absorb excess oil. Pour sauce over chicken and serve.

title: Saucepan Quinoa With Beans and Chiles
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dry quinoa, rinsed in 4 changes of water | 1 can no-salt-added diced tomatoes with chilies, undrained ( 1 cup reserved ) | 4 -8 serrano chili, stemmed | 1/2 cup annatto seeds
instructions: If you’d like a smoother consistency, place the quinoa in a blender or food processor and pulse a few times. Pour the reserved tomato juice into a 2 quart saucepan and add the chiles. Bring to a simmer.

title: Broiled Apple Rice With Blue Cheese
ingredients: 4 tablespoons margarine, melted | 1/4 cup basmati rice or 1/4 cup jasmine rice | 1/2 cup white balsamic vinegar or 1/2 cup apple cider | 1/4 cup grated apple cider ( or a splash of balsamic vinegar, for a more pronounced balsamic flavor ) | 1/4 cup crumbled blue cheese ( optional )
instructions: Melt margarine in a small saucepan. Add rice and stir to coat. Set aside. In a small saucepan over medium heat, stir in vinegar and cider. Bring to boil, stirring constantly, and cook until most of liquid evaporates, about 2 minutes. Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer for about 10 minutes, then stir in cheese. Serve hot.

title: Astracusata Con Melon (Watermelon Tart)
ingredients: 2 lbs watermelon, cored and cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 2/3 cup corn oil | 1/4 cup locatelli cheese or 1/4 cup other hard swiss cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Place watermelon cubes in one layer in a buttered casserole dish, overlapping edges with tines of a fork. Place cheese slices over the melon. In a small bowl pour water to cover watermelon. In a small bowl, mix corn oil into a paste and pour over cheese. Place dish into oven and bake for 25 minutes or until topping is golden brown and syrup is bubbly.

title: Quick Bread and Cheese Sandwich
ingredients: 2 loaves bread | 2 ounces american cheese, sliced | 2 tablespoons honey mustard | chicken broth | 2 tablespoons peas or 2 tablespoons corn on the cob
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f. Arrange half of one cheese slice in the bottom of a 9x13 inch glass baking dish. Spread about 1 tablespoon of the mustard on each slice. Cover with about half the peas or corn and 1 tablespoon of the honey mustard. Repeat the layering and top with the remaining cheese slices. Cover with foil and bake in the preheated oven for 25 to 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pearl barley,juniper berry,muscovado sugar,thai basil,french bread,salmon steak
title: Overnight Sea Bass with Mustard and Marmalade
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 lbs sea bass steaks | 4 cups pearl barley or 4 cups whole grain red wine | 6 -8 large fresh jullienne thai basil | 1 1/2 cups packed coarsely chopped fresh thai basil | 1 tablespoon granulated thai muscovado sugar | 1 tablespoon juniper berries ( optional )
instructions: Soak pearl barley or rinsed whole grains in cold water for at least half an hour. Pour boiling water over the barley and return to a boil to cook. Drain and rinse in a sieve over a bowl and set aside. Cut remaining pieces of sea bass into four fillets, removing fat. Place fish and marmalade in a shallow roasting pan, and place in the oven on top of its bed of jullienne basil and thai basil. Bake at 450 degrees f for 15 minutes, turning once or twice. Place fish on a serving platter, spoon over the mustard and garnish with a few juniper berries and some additional marmalade.

title: Braised Ouzo Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken leg quarters | 1 cup dry red wine | 1 cup ouzo, or as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Arrange the chicken legs side by side on the baking sheet, and brush with 1 cup of the wine. Roast in the preheated oven until golden brown.

title: Quickly Easy Easy & Yummy Raspberry Fudge
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated semisweet chocolate | 1 can apricot preserves
instructions: In a double boiler, melt chocolate over low heat, stirring constantly, until smooth. Once melted stir in preserves, and cook in double boiler over low heat for 10 minutes or until mixture starts to bubble on top. Pour into buttered loaf pan and let cool. Once cold cut into 1 inch slices to serve, decorate with red swirls if desired.

title: Roasted Radishes and Swiss Cheese
ingredients: 1 can philadelphia cream cheese, at room temperature ( neufchatel ) | 1/2 cup bacon drippings, from cooked bacon | 4 -6 small thin-sliced radishes | fresh rosemary sprig ( optional )
instructions: In small bowl, using electric mixer beat cream cheese with bacon drippings until creamy, scraping bowl after a few minutes. Arrange the radishes around a bowl, sprinkle with rosemary sprigs if desired and stir. Drain mixture and allow to set. Slice cheese into 1/2 inch pieces and transfer to a serving plate. Top with sour cream and serve at room temperature.

title: Mexican Bread Loaf
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain mexican beer | 2 tablespoons chopped pecans | 1 tablespoon instant yeast | 1 cup greek yogurt | 3 tablespoons oil
instructions: Place everything but the oil in a medium sized mixing bowl or a stand mixer with the paddle. Add the oil to get the olive oil and stir it up so if a little foamy, that it forms a light film on top. Add the yeast to the bowl with the first tablespoon of oil. Once the oil is mixed well, it will turn into a light foamy yeast mixture. Stir in the beer and pour the mixture into a greased loaf pan. Bake at 180 degrees celcius for half an hour, or until golden brown. This bread was great when it was sliced with cream cheese and was excellent on tacos too, or as a sandwich spread.

Random Ingredients: cassava,shell pasta,chili oil,cilantro,dill pickle,bamboo shoot,black bean
title: Black Bean Pasta Salad
ingredients: 2 cups fresh black beans, cooked, shelled and drained | 2 slices cassava ( palm or mozzarella ) | 2 tablespoons dill pickles | 2 tablespoons chopped cilantro | 1 can chopped bamboo shoots, drained ( reserve liquid ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons chili oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh dill or 1 1/2 tablespoons ground dill
instructions: Mix well. Add remaining ingredients.

title: Pear Nests With Garlicky Baked Pasta
ingredients: 2 large ripe pears ( about 12 ounces ) | 3/4 cup fresh gala's golden raisin | 1/3 cup thinly sliced leeks or 1/3 cup other green onion | 3 cups small shell pasta ( such as pearl shaped ) | 1/4 cup grated zucchini | 1 cup shredded graham cracker crumbs | 2 tablespoons thinly sliced scallions
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°. Place whole pears in a saucepan of boiling water. Cook the pears until just tender, about 2 minutes. Drain well and peel. Cut out the cores and peel. Cut into 2 inch long pieces. Place the chopped almonds or raisins in a small saute pan and dry roast over medium hear until the pears are just turning tender and the raisins beginning to brown, about 5 minutes. Let cool. Heat a small skillet over medium heat until hot but not smoking. Add the gala's, leeks or other green onions and sauté until the onions are translucent, about 3 to 5 minutes. Transfer to large bowl. Add all the pears and raisins to the bowl. Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain and stir into the bowl with the pears and raisins and pears. Sprinkle with zucchini and toasted crumbs and scallions. Serve warm.

title: Hazelnuts
ingredients: 6 ounces hazelnuts, chopped | 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. In a small bowl, mix the hazelnuts with the olive oil. Spread the hazelnut mixture on an ungreased baking sheet and bake for 10 minutes, or until puffed and dry. Cool. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: apple cider,grain rice,dark sesame oil,peanut oil,palm sugar,snow pea,french bread
title: Shanghai Fried Rice -- Lo-Qiao Chao Zhou Dou (Chinese Style)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 2/3 cup long grain rice, rinsed under cold water and drained | 1/8 cup apple cider ( not apple jelly ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons palm sugar | 15 ounces french bread, cut into 1/2 to 1-inch cubes | 3 ounces snow peas, trimmed
instructions: Heat peanut oil and sesame oil in small deep skillet over medium high heat until very hot but not smoking. Add rice and cook, stirring, for 2 minutes. Add apple cider and sugar.

title: Hot Cashews Rooibos
ingredients: 200 g cashews | 6 tablespoons red wine ( a cabernet sauvignon or reisling are best ) | 1/2 cup superfine sugar ( a demerara sugar can be used for the sweeten ) | 2 tablespoons cooking tapioca
instructions: Preheat your oven to 160 degrees celsius. Cut the cashewnuts into 1 cm wide chunks, place on a baking tray and bake for 15 - 20 minutes, until lightly browned. Heat the wine in a saucepan and then add the sugar and tapioca. Once the sugar has melted, transfer the mixture to a blender and process until they have the texture of an oily paste. Add the cashews and process again, until they are ground into a uniform paste. Arrange the raoibos in a shallow serving dish and pour the sauce over until it looks completely covered. Allow to cool until room temperature. Serve.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,string bean,yellow bell pepper
title: Hot Italian Sausages
ingredients: 6 green bell peppers, sliced into rings | 6 yellow bell peppers, sliced into rings | 12 thin whole string beans
instructions: Preheat your grill. Line the grill rack with aluminum foil. Place sliced green bell peppers and yellow bell peppers inside the foil and season with salt. Heat your grill to medium high. Grill the sausages for 5 - 7 minutes per side, or to desired doneness, turning them halfway through. The long cooking of these sausages makes it easy to move around the grill during reheating the sausages.

title: Glamorgan Sausages
ingredients: 1 kg ground pork or 1 kg ground beef | 1/3 cup fresh italian parsley or 1/3 cup fresh dill, chopped | 1/3 cup irish cream ( optional ) or 1/3 cup creme fraiche ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and form into patties. Heat a little olive oil in non stick fry pan on medium high heat, with a few drops on each batch. Fry over medium heat turning until golden brown on each side. These may also be cooked as an appetizer or main course with pasta.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,fruit,rice vinegar,noodle,reynolds wrap foil,asparagus
title: Asparagus Wrapped With Noodles and a Thousand Island Dressing
ingredients: 1 lb of reynolds wrap foil | 4 cups cooked asparagus, coarsely chopped | 4 bags of crispy rice sticks ( we like thai brand ) | 1 pint heavy whipping cream | 1 -2 tablespoon rice vinegar | 2 packages of ronzoni smart noodles ( the type with the wide strips hanging out of the package, so i just have to cut back the package if they are a little wide )
instructions: Prepare bag of noodles and drain in colander. You should have 6 c of noodles on the bottom, 4 c on the top. Cut asparagus into lengths 1 1/2 long and 2 wide. On ungreased cookie sheet or pizza sheet, spray with non stick cooking spray. Lay ronzoni noodles out and place on sheet, flat side down. Drizzle with good quality light tasting rice vinegar and toss with cream. Bake 15 - 20 minutes or until noodles are just tender and a little browned outside. You may add any vegetables you like if you want for different flavors or just place a couple of slices of orange blossom water on top of your noodle and top with the crispy asparagus and sauce. You may also add red bell peppers and/or mushrooms if desired.

title: Penne with Cilantro
ingredients: 1 package uncooked penne ( about 8 ounces ) | 6 tablespoons canola oil, divided | 1 large white onion, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons chili paste | 1 bunch fresh cilantro, stems cut off, stalks reserved
instructions: In a large pot of boiling water, cook penne until al dente, about 12 minutes.

title: Spicy Grilled Squash
ingredients: 2 medium yellow squash, cut into 1/4 in. thick rounds | 3 tablespoons mayonnaise | 2 skewers
instructions: Combine the mayonnaise and the grill. Thread the squash onto the skewers. Cook over a medium direct heat, turning and basting with the mayonnaise until tender. Serve immediately or cool and place in freezer until serving hours.

Random Ingredients: milk chocolate chip,tahini,chili oil,bell pepper,frankfurter,spinach leaf,beet,garlic clove
title: Spanakorizo
ingredients: 1 package fresh spinach leaves, rinsed, dried, torn and squeezed dry | 1 bell pepper, chopped | 3 -4 large beet, peeled, chopped into 1-inch pieces | 1 -2 frankfurters, chopped ( depending on heat level desired ) | 3 -5 roasted garlic cloves, chopped ( depending on heat level desired ) | 2 cups milk chocolate chips | 1 tablespoon tahini | 1 -2 teaspoon chili oil ( to taste ) or 1 -2 teaspoon hot sauce ( to taste )
instructions: Sautee peppers, beets, garlic and frankfurters and cook on low, medium heat, stirring from time to time until veggies are softened. Add milk chocolate chips and stir. Cook on simmer until chocolate is melted. Add cooked peppers with beet juice or tahini and chili oil. If you want to freeze them, let soften for 45 minutes before use when thawed, transfer to an airtight container and freeze. Will keep for 2 - 4 months in the refrigerator. You can also freeze these beets for about 6 months.

Random Ingredients: ricotta cheese,caper,bisquick baking mix,savoy cabbage,genoa salami,vegetable oil cooking spray,sage
title: Zippy Calzones
ingredients: 8 ounces genoa salami, thinly sliced | 6 ounces ricotta cheese | 1/2 teaspoon rubbed sage | 2 -3 tablespoons dried parsley ( optional ) | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/2 teaspoon dried savoy cabbage ( optional ) | 1 cup bisquick baking mix
instructions: If using savoy cabbage, peel and coarsely shred the cabbage. If using savoy cabbage, peel and coarsely shred the cabbage. If using regular cabbage, shred it. Slice the salami crosswise into 1/2 inch wide slabs. In a medium bowl stir together the ricotta cheese, sage, parsley, or a combination of both, sage, and crannci according to taste. Coat a nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Spray until hot. Add the salami and cook over moderately high heat until brown on both sides, about 5 minutes. Place the salami slices on paper towel and roll until paper towels and towels are damp. Transfer 1 tablespoon of the ricotta cheese mixture to the pan. Pour the bisquick mix in and spread evenly and quickly with a spatula. With a spatula, push any dough on the bottom of the pan into a circle just large enough to accommodate the filling, about 1/2 inch thick. Place the pancake onto the hot pan, close the cover, and cook over moderately high heat until the bottoms are lightly browned, about 8 minutes.

title: Low Fat Alfredo Cheese Dip
ingredients: 2 containers low fat cottage cheese | 3/4 cup taco blend cheese | 1 envelope fat-free alfredo sauce
instructions: Mix and serve with tortilla chips for dipping.

title: Gordano and Parmigiano-Reggiano Cheese
ingredients: 12 slices parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 bay leaf | 2 tablespoons grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: In a large glass baking dish, place 4 slices of parmigiano reggiano cheese. Evenly distribute the 4 slices of parmigiano reggiano in an even layer. Sprinkle 3 slices of parmigiano reggiano parmigiano reggiano all over the parmegiano reggiano making sure the parmigiano reggiates all around the cheese. Drizzle 3 - 4 tbsp of olive oil all over top of the parmegiano reggiano. Top with a bay leaf. Heat for 1 - 2 minutes on each side to sear the garlic and release the flavor. Remove, let cool slightly, then place in a resealable plastic bag. Pour the extra virgin olive oil over the parmegiano reggiano and serve cold.

title: Spicy Oil
ingredients: 4 teaspoons coriander seeds, freshly crushed | 2 tablespoons chili paste | 1 tablespoon of roasted unpeeled peanuts, coarsely crushed
instructions: Place the coriander seeds and chilli paste in a dry frying pan over medium heat. Cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 1 minute. Add the peanuts and cook, stirring, until the peanuts are golden brown. Transfer to a dish and serve.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,russet potato,prune,cauliflower floret,rice,pistachio,rice vermicelli,leg lamb
title: Lamb Leg, Pilaf With Prunes, & Rice
ingredients: 1/2/3 cup raw pistachios | 2 cups medium-grain rice, rinsed and drained | 1 tablespoon russet potato, peeled and coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon whole cardamom seed | 2 1/2 lb leg of lamb, cut in 2-inch pieces | 1/2 lb cauliflower floret, trimmed | 2 tablespoons rice vermicelli ( soaked in hot water for 15 minutes ) | 1 cup dried prune, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons ground pistachios ( garnish )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f mix pistachios in processor with 1 1/2 cups water.

title: Spicy Tequila
ingredients: 1 1/4 ounces tequila | fresh roasted red pepper
instructions: Combine ingredients in a cocktail shaker. Strain into an old fashioned glass, garnish with a sprig of fresh roasted red pepper and serve.

title: Easy Apple Pork Burgundy
ingredients: 1 pound pork roast | 1 eggnog, divided | 1 pinch white pepper | 1 cup chopped yellow sweet pepper, or to taste | 4 tart apples - peeled, cored, and sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Poke holes in the top of the roast with a fork, and place into the bottom of a baking dish. Pour 1/2 the eggnog evenly over the roast, then sprinkle with white pepper. Cover with yellow pepper. Place tart apples across the blackened surface. Drizzle remaining 1/2 eggnog evenly over the top. Cover baking dish with foil. Heat in the preheated oven until the juices run clear, about 1 1/2 hours. Remove foil and beef slices from the baking dish. Use a spoon to scrape the browned bits from the bottom. Serve alongside other tapas.

Random Ingredients: red chile pepper,chicken meat,asparagus spear,orange juice,anaheim chilies,chestnut,lamb shank
title: Lamb Shank and Chestnuts in Chili Sauce
ingredients: 2 lamb shanks | 1 teaspoon finely chopped dried red chile pepper | 2 anaheim chilies, seeded and chopped | 1 large orange, juice of | 1/2 cup orange juice | 500 g asparagus spears | 8 asparagus spears
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees c. Place lamb shanks in a large ovenproof dish. Sprinkle with chilli, anaheim chillies, orange juice and orange juice. Bake for 40 minutes, basting 2 times during baking with the pan juices from the dish. Remove lamb shanks reserving pan juices, and return lamb shanks to the oven for 15 minutes. Strain liquid and discard solids from pan. Cut asparagus into 2 cm chunks, cook in pan juices 2 minutes, then drain. Remove any excess fat from pan juices, then reduce heat to low, add asparagus and cook, covered, for 10 minutes. Serve lamb shanks and asparagus on a platter, with a heap of chili sauce on the side.

Random Ingredients: golden syrup,chipotle chile pepper,nonstick cooking spray,icing sugar,red pepper flake,white shoepeg corn,shiitake mushroom,beef stew meat
title: Beef or Chicken Mole With Corn With Chipotle Glaze
ingredients: 5 cups nonstick cooking spray | 2 cups icing sugar | 1 can white shoepeg corn, drained and rinsed well | 1 lb beef stew meat ( or chicken ) | 1/4 cup golden syrup | 1 tablespoon crushed red pepper flakes | 3 chipotle chile peppers, with seeds, minced, deveined, deveined and seeded | 1 cup shiitake mushrooms, stemmed and chopped
instructions: Preheat over to in small bowl, combine icing sugar, corn, and beef or chicken with olive oil. Shape into 2 logs about 15 inches long and 1 1/2 inch thick. Bake at 350 degrees for 25 minutes. Meanwhile, in small bowl, combine glaze ingredients.

title: Japanese Beef Miso Prawns
ingredients: 500 g uncooked prawns | 1 - 1 1/2 cup white miso paste ( kombu kelp ) | 2 -3 dill ( kombu kelp ) | chopped pepperoni, optional garnish
instructions: Take off the shell and wash the prawn heads in water until all the shells have turned pink and all the pink meat has been removed. Place the shrimp in a pot with 1 1/2 cups of water and bring to a boil. Dip each shell in the miso coating all over. Return the shrimp to the pot, then lower the heat and cover. Simmer for 45 minutes or until the shells have changed colour and the shrimp are cooked through. Do not overcook them or they will dry out and become tough. Drain. Add 1 1/2 cups of water to the pot. Place on low and simmer for about 2 hours. It should be creamy and all the water has been absorbed.

title: Poblano Con Piselli (Courgettes with Rice)
ingredients: 2 poblano chiles, seeded, chopped | 1 1/2 cups long grain rice | 1 plum tomato, chopped | 1 tablespoon dried rosemary | 1/2 cup roughly chopped fresh rosemary
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place poblano on parchment paper. Bake until poblano blackens and soft, about 10 minutes. Remove from the oven and place on a plate lined with foil. Allow to cool.

title: Graham Bread III
ingredients: 2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 3/4 cup white sugar | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1 cup light sweetened mayonnaise, such as kame dark | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce, such as koon chun brand
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix graham cracker crumbs, 3/4 cup white sugar, mayonnaise, light sweetened mayonnaise, oyster sauce, and koon Chun sauce. Press mixture into a 9x13 inch cake pan. Bake in the preheated oven until the topping has turned a light brown color, about 20 minutes. Allow cake to cool completely before removing from pan.

title: Tahini Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup tahini ( sesame seed ) | 28 ounces tomato sauce | 1 tablespoon cornstarch
instructions: Blend cornstarch and a little water well. Add to a medium saucepan. Add tomato sauce, tahini and some sesame seeds to saucepan. Cook over medium heat until heated through. Enjoy with pita bread.

title: Spicy Tomato Oysters from the 70's
ingredients: 20 ounces fresh oysters, shucked | 1 tablespoon horseradish | 1 english tomatoes, sliced in half
instructions: Split the tomatoes, remove the seeds and cut each half into 5 thick slices. Place them on a plate. Sprinkle with horseradish and wrap well in foil. Bake in a 325f degrees oven for 15 to 20 minutes, until the tomatoes start to caramelize. Serve straight away.

Random Ingredients: ginger powder,roast pork,flour,green bell pepper,garlic powder,basil,espresso powder
title: Chili Espresso Pork Sirloin
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless roast ( fat trimmed ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant coffee powder | 1/4 cup flour | 3 teaspoons ground ginger powder | 3/4 teaspoon basil | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 green bell pepper ( chopped )
instructions: Preheat over to 450 degrees. Cut slits in the roast. Insert meat thermometer into cuts to vent. Place roast in roasting pan. Stir together all dry spices and pour over roast. Cover tightly with aluminum foil. Bake for 25 minutes. Remove meat. Add green pepper. Cover. Bake for 30 minutes more or until desired doneness.

title: Raspberry and Prosciutto Crunch
ingredients: 4 thin slices prosciutto, cut into 1 inch squares | 2 medium head cauliflower, trimmed and cut into florets | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 1/4 teaspoon dried marjoram | 2 slices rye crisp bread | 1 cup frozen raspberries
instructions: Combine prosciutto and cauliflower in a baking dish. Combine maple syrup, marjoram and drizzle over mixture.

title: Queso Fresco Quesadillas
ingredients: 2 tablespoons flour | salt | 1 teaspoon black cardamom pods | 10 ounces queso fresco | 1 -2 teaspoon dried chipotle powder ( optional )
instructions: Stir the flour and cardamom into a bowl. Add the cheese, chipotle powder, and 2 tablespoons of water, stir thoroughly and set aside. Heat a griddle or frying pan. Lightly oil it, and heat till warm. Form the cheese mixture into 4 balls, and fry on both sides til they turn light brown. Serve on a plate, with salsa and sour cream.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,bacon,thai basil,cooking apple,bay leaf,cremini mushroom,green capsicum,self raising flour
title: Spiced Mushrooms and Bacon
ingredients: 200 g thick bacon, chopped | 450 g cremini mushrooms, sliced | 500 g green capsicums, sliced | 4 cooking apples, chopped | 2 large bay leaves | 150 g self-raising flour | 1 teaspoon dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon fresh thai basil, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c cook bacon in large ovenproof pan until browned on all sides. Remove bacon from pan. Drain bacon fat, then return bacon to pan. Add mushrooms, apples, and bay leaves. Stir well. Combine flour, soy sauce, and basil in a mixing bowl. Dredge the mushrooms and apples in the flour mixture and place in the bacon fat. Place mushrooms and apples on top of vegetables in pan. Roast for 30 – 40 minutes or until vegetables are golden and bacon fat has rendered. Serve with steamed rice.

title: Roasted Sweet Red Pepper (Charcoal)
ingredients: 4 large red sweet bell peppers, halved, cored | 3 tablespoons pure maple syrup | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees f. Line your large baking sheet with aluminum foil. Combine sweet red peppers, maple syrup, and asafoetida. Spread sauce mixture on baking sheet. Roast peppers in oven until skins blister and char, 15 to 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: spanish onion,thai basil,hamburger bun,seasoning salt,provolone cheese,blueberry,cucumber
title: Stir Fry Burger
ingredients: 3/4 lb hamburger bun, sliced | 1 jar sliced black olives, drained ( reserve 2 tbls. olive oil ) | 1/2 medium spanish onion, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/2 cup crumbled provolone cheese | 8 slices cucumbers, thin | 1/2 cup fresh blueberries | 1/2 cup chopped fresh thai basil
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the first 6 ingredients, except the provolone. Divide the mixture into four portions, shaping each into a patty. Cook over medium heat for 2 - 3 minutes on each side, until the bottom is lightly browned, turning once. Place on a paper towel lined plate. Top the burgers with the provolone cheese and cucumber slices. Garnish with fresh blueberries and thai basil.

title: Lebanese Beef Kabobs
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice | 1 beef tenderloin | 4 teaspoons margarine
instructions: Soak rice in water. Soak meat with rice, 1 tsp soy and 1/2 tsp salt. Drain rice, then put into a glass baking dish. Pour 1/2 tsp soy over meat. Mix and put meat into baking dish to marinate 1 week. After marinating overnight, put out meat. Let meat rest 1/2 3 hours, then place in oven. Bake 45 min 1hour.

title: Nasi Lemak - Split Pea Soup
ingredients: 2 tablespoons split peas, shelled | 1/4 lb fresh coconut cream ( i used a non-sweet version of this, though most brands have a slightly unpleasant taste ) | 2 whole pinches fresh garlic, minced
instructions: Put split peas into a large, deep pan, and cover with enough cold water to cover. Bring to boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat and simmer until peas are tender, 45 to 60 minutes. Uncover, and simmer until split peas are well flavored, 10 to 15 minutes longer. The soup will thicken and brown lightly. Add coconut cream and minced garlic. Simmer until soup thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon, about 15 minutes. Discard garlic. Serve warm.

title: Vegetable Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 1/3 cup sunflower seeds, toasted | 2 medium turnips, chopped into large chunks or 1 1/2 lbs potatoes | 1 tablespoon horseradish | 1 tablespoon ground coriander | 1 teaspoon hot sauce | 1/2 cup tomato sauce
instructions: Place the toasted sunflower seeds in a food processor or blender with the turnips and horseradish.

title: Chunky Mushroom Casserole
ingredients: 8 slices bacon, cooked and crumbled | 1 can campari | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chilies, undrained | 1 package button mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Grease a 2 qt casserole dish. Place bacon in a large frypan over medium high heat, cook until fat is rendered, about 5 minutes. Add campari, mushroom slices, and tomatoes and chilies.

Random Ingredients: almond paste,bok choy,white fish,gingerroot,romano cheese,white bread
title: Baked Fish With Chilli Nuts
ingredients: 1 large white fish | 1 piece fresh gingerroot, peeled, washed well, chopped | 3 tablespoons bok choy, roughly chopped | 1 1/2 cups romano cheese, grated | 1 1/2 ounces almond paste | 8 slices firm white bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees celcius. Rinse fish and pat dry with paper towels. Cut around the bones in random directions, cutting at the joints, cutting through the head into a small piece of fish head. You should now have 24 pieces with the same size of fish cut away from the skin. This is not the workable portion that can be cut in half. Place fish in a shallow baking dish. Sprinkle ginger and bok choy over the fish. Drizzle 1 - ½ tablespoons of bok choy and ½ tablespoon of romano cheese over the fish. Dot with a spoon. Add 1 - ¼ ounces of almond paste and place under the oven for 8 minutes. The fish should be cooked inside. Serve immediately with thin slices of toast.

title: Lemon and Chilli Jam
ingredients: 2 red chili peppers, chopped | 1 tablespoon lemon zest, chopped | 60 g fresh parsley stems
instructions: Put the chilies in a small frying pan with the lemon zest and a small glass of cold water. Cook over a low heat for a few minutes until the chilies are tender. Strain the juice and pass through the strainer. Add the parsley and lemon rind. Bring to the boil, then simmer for a few minutes until the jam is thick. Bottle in sterilised jars, and seal. Process in a bain marie for 2 - 3 days.

Random Ingredients: asparagus spear,serrano pepper,cumin,cashew,extra large egg,baking soda,superfine sugar
title: Ajiaco (Mexican Asparagus) With Cashews and Serrano Peppers
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs asparagus spears, trimmed | 2 serrano peppers, seeded | 5 extra-large eggs | 2 tablespoons superfine sugar | 2 teaspoons ground cumin | 1/2 teaspoon ground aspida ( optional ) | 2 1/2 teaspoons baking soda
instructions: Place asparagus in a large pot with just enough water to cover them by 2 inches, bring to a boil, and cook for 10 minutes. Drain. Transfer asparagus to a colander, wash under cold running water, and immediately immerse in ice water. Let sit for about 12 minutes,, until crisp tender. Cut a lengthwise slit and cut each spear lengthwise into 3 to 4 pieces. Set aside. Cut peppers into strips, set aside and keep the juice. In a small bowl, beat eggs with sugar and spices. Pour egg mixture into a skillet over medium heat. As soon as mixture comes to a boil, reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon, for 15 to 25 minutes, until the eggs are firm and the sauce is thick and creamy. Add peppers to cooked asparagus and cashews while still hot. In a clean bowl, mix baking soda with 1 tablespoon water and whisk over a low heat for several minutes, until foamy. Stir the sauce into the hot asparagus mixture and pour into a greased 13 in. X 9 in baking dish. Cover tightly and bake at 350 f.  for 45 minutes, until lightly browned.

title: Tasty Jicama and Paprika - Youcan Make Ahead for Winter
ingredients: 4 lbs jicama or 4 lbs yama | 2 1/2 teaspoons paprika
instructions: Peel the jicama or yama. Cut down about 1½ long by ¼ . Use a sharp knife. The jicama will peel easily while it is still raw. You should cut in ½” slices. Pierce a few holes between the slices. Spray the grill with nonstick spray on both sides with pam or brush with oil. Grill the jicama for approximately 5 minutes on each side, or until it is cooked but does not crack from the bones. Let it cool to room temperature. Cut jicama into ¾ cubes. Arrange on a tray, cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: pickling salt,ginger,tomato,green onion,dark soy sauce,monterey jack pepper cheese,espresso
title: Quickresso Chile Con Carne (Aka Drunken Pepper-Green Chile)
ingredients: 3 cans of stewed tomatoes ( i recommend goldstar brand ) | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 2 - 2 1/4 tablespoons pickling salt ( or to taste ) | 1 teaspoon sugar ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon fresh ginger, grated ( or to taste ) | 1 1/2 inches ginger, grated ( for grilling, or to taste ) | 2 -4 cups monterey jack pepper cheese, shredded or sliced ( for topping ) | 2 -3 green onions, finely chopped ( for garnish )
instructions: Put all ingredients in a blender and mix until smooth, scraping sides occasionally. Marinate your beef for up to 24 hours in your chosen container. The longer this holds, the better. Grill over medium coals over high heat, turning often, until the heat of the peppers reaches 160 f., brushing with a little oil or butter periodically. Sprinkle the cheese with the green onions before serving over mashed potatoes.

title: Saffron Vegetable Compote
ingredients: 1 package cottage cheese | 1 teaspoon cardamom pods, crushed
instructions: Place a piece of cheese in a small frying pan. Heat the oil over medium heat and pour in a pinch of cardamom. When the cheese is warm to the touch, but not burn, stir in the spices. Continue stirring over low heat until all of the cheese is completely melted and the solids have turned into a creamy paste.

title: Lentils and Peppers With Spinach
ingredients: 2 2 cups fresh yellow lentils or 2 cups brown lentils | 2 tablespoons tamari ( or gluten-free soy sauce ) | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1/4 cup sliced pepperoni | 8 ounces baby spinach | 1/2 cup chopped fresh thyme
instructions: Rinse and remove any discolored lentils and lentils from the packaging. In a large saucepan, cover the lentils with boiling water and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat.

title: Quick One-Bowl Turkey Fondue
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs turkey breast or 1 1/2 lbs turkey legs with thigh | 1 cup beef sirloin | 1 1/2 tablespoons powdered sugar
instructions: Pound turkey into 1/8 inch thick slices. Cut into narrow 1 inch wide strips. Combine all the ingredients and toss with turkey. Put bag in a crock. Cook in crock 4 - 5 hours on low.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,brandy,orange juice concentrate,scallion,pear,kosher salt,bell pepper,brown sugar
title: Truffles - the Real Thing!
ingredients: 1/2 cup orange juice concentrate ( concentrate can be found in many grocery stores ) | 2 tablespoons brandy ( i usually just shake the can ) | 1 tablespoon kosher salt | 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 2 1/2 - 3 lbs pears, sliced ( about 3 4 cups, i leave the core on ) | 1 1/2 lbs pears ( about 3 4 cups ) | 1 1/2 - 2 medium scallions | 1 cup flat leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: Stir concentrate with brandy, salt, and sugar until blended. Line 2 large rimmed baking sheets with plastic wrap, then set aside. Peel all pears, leaving just the very thick core intact, then slice across the pear lengthwise into thin slices. Arrange the sliced pears on the prepared baking sheets. Cover. Bake at 350°f/180°c for about 25 minutes. While pears are baking, heat up the broth on the stove until it comes to a boil, then add the orange juice and simmer for a few more minutes. Remove from the heat and set aside. Remove the pears from the oven. Set a bowl of ice water over the bowl, then pour the cooled juices over the pears and cover. Let stand at least 30 minutes to develop the flavor. Meanwhile, in a small frying pan over high heat, fry the scallions, stirring constantly, until they become limp. Add the parsley as soon as you remove them from the skillet. Heat skillet over high heat. When hot, add the orange juice mixture, stirring to coat with juice. Simmer for about 3 minutes, just until warm. Pour over pears. Allow to rest a few minutes. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: root beer,coconut milk,garbanzo bean,sourdough bread,plum sauce,cucumber,basmati rice
title: Hurry N Rice Bowl
ingredients: 1/2 cup hulled garbanzo beans ( chickpeas ) | 1/2 cup dried plums in tomato sauce, diced | 1 1/2 cups diced cucumbers | 2 cups cooked basmati rice | 1 cup light coconut milk | 1 loaf sourdough bread | 1 tablespoon coarsely chopped fresh basil ( optional )
instructions: Soak garbanzo beans 30 minutes, or until tender. Drain and set aside. Cook plums in tomato sauce over medium heat until soft. Chop into bite sized pieces and transfer to a large bowl. Add the cooked garbanzo beans and cucumbers and stir to coat. Toss rice with coconut milk and add to bowl. Mix well. Transfer bowls to the table and sprinkle with basil, if desired.

title: Barbecue Mango Salad
ingredients: 1 mango, peeled & chopped | 1 can bamboo strips, cut in half | 2 slices ham, cut into slices
instructions: In a bowl combine mangoes, bamboo strips& ham. Let stand 20 minutes to blend flavors. Enjoy.

title: Faux Brandy Spinach Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/4 cup minute tapioca ( not quick cooking ) | 2 tablespoons brandy | 2 tablespoons bacon bits | 12 slices french bread | 16 ounces baby spinach
instructions: Prepare tapioca. Prepare brandy and bacon bits. Sprinkle the inside of each slice of bread with tapioca and crumbled bacon bits. Spread the brandy and bacon bits onto your french toast. Cut your spinach into very thin slices. Place a slice on top of the brandy and bacon bits on the toast. Serve immediately. Can also be made in advance and frozen for later.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,cherry tomato,cumin seed,meat,cider vinegar,cauliflower floret,beef sirloin steak,shallot
title: Sancocho - Spanish Meatloaf on the Skillet
ingredients: 3 lbs meaty lean beef top sirloin steaks ( cut into 2 inch pieces ) | 6 ounces diced smoked meat ( deli meat with casings removed ) | 8 -10 cherry tomatoes, quartered ( or other fresh tomato halves or grape tomatoes, quartered ) | 10 -12 cauliflower florets ( washed and dried lightly, or about 2/3 cup fresh ) | 2 tablespoons minced fresh shallots | 1 large chicken bouillon cube ( or 2. 5 oz. can ) | 1 teaspoon whole cumin seed ( or 1 tbsp. roasted cumin seeds, ground to a paste ) | 1/2 cup cider vinegar | 1/4 cup finely chopped drained ripe canned tomatoes
instructions: In a large skillet over medium high heat, heat 1 t. Oil or cooking spray. Sprinkle sirloin with salt and pepper. Add meat to skillet in a single layer and brown on both sides. Set beef aside in a bowl. Reduce heat to medium and add remaining 1 t. Oil or cooking spray. Add tomatoes, garlic, shallots, chicken bouillon cube, cumin, vinegar and tomatoes. Stir to combine and scrape the bottom of the skillet with a wooden spoon. Simmer sauce over medium low heat 1 more hour stirring constantly. Remove meat and discard bones and vegetables. Pour sauce over drained noodles, noodles or meatloaf and stir gently. Enjoy.

title: Roasted Mushrooms and Olive Tapas
ingredients: 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon vegetable shortening | 1 tablespoon vodka | 1 tablespoon cognac | 1 lb mixed fresh mushrooms, trimmed and sliced | 1/2 cup sultana | 2 tablespoons chopped coriander | 2 tablespoons olive slices
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. Mix the vinegar, shortening and vodka in a small dish. Pour the mixture onto a large baking sheet and roast for 30 minutes. Increase the oven temperature to 200°f. Remove the pan from the oven. Add the cognac, mushrooms, sultanas, coriander and 1/2 the olive slices to the pan.

title: Duck Legs in Creme
ingredients: 350 g duck legs | 3 tablespoons double cream or 3 tablespoons milk | 2 kaffir lime leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 160 degrees celsius. Remove and discard giblets from duck legs and place skin side up in a roasting tin. Prick skin all over with a fork then pour over cream or milk. Smooth duck skin around leg with back of spoon. Sprinkle with remaining lime leaves and bake in oven for 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: vegetable shortening,sun tomato oil,yellow bell pepper,caraway seed
title: Fried Stuffed Yellow Bell Peppers
ingredients: 12 -25 yellow bell peppers or 12 -25 any bell pepper | 1/2 cup vegetable shortening ( for dredging ) | 1 cup fresh sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and thinly sliced | 1/4 teaspoon caraway seed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. Wash and dry the peppers, and line the interior of a baking sheet with a light coating of vegetable shortening. Arrange the peppers on the baking sheet. In a small bowl, stir together the sun dried tomatoes and caraway seeds.

title: Spinach Salad
ingredients: 10 ounces frozen chopped spinach, thawed and patted dry | 1 white onion, sliced into 1/4 inch slices | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1/4 teaspoon grated orange zest
instructions: Drain the spinach, toss with the onion slices, cover and refrigerate for an hour or longer. When ready to serve, stir in the worcestershire sauce. Serve cold on top of cooked pasta of your favourite greens.

Random Ingredients: yogurt,coriander leaf,rutabaga,corn flake crumb,honeydew melon,vinegar,date,green pepper
title: Sweet Cornflake Rice Cakes
ingredients: 1 bunch coriander leaves ( cilantro ) | 350 g medium rutabagas | 500 g yellow sweet peppers | 3 teaspoons chopped green peppers | 2 cups corn flakes crumbs | 4 tablespoons vinegar | 500 g yogurt ( thick consistency ) | 1/4 cup honeydew melon | 1 tablespoon chopped coriander leaves
instructions: Wash and pick over the coriander, removing the roots and stems. If you are using the stems, break off the roots and discard. Slice the rutabaga thinly. Halve and seed the yellow sweet pepper. Drain the rutabaga and sweet pepper and place in a large bowl of cold water for 10 minutes. Remove the stems and seeds. Drain thoroughly and set aside. Drain completely and set aside. Drain the cornflake crumbs of cornflake crumbs and wash and clean the water from the coriander. Drain the coriander thoroughly and put in a food processor/blender along with the sliced rutabaga and peppers. Blend all together to form a puree. Set aside. Wash and pick over the hyggeres and deseed them. Dice them finely. Mix into all the above mixture and mix well to ensure that all mixed properly. Shape mixture into small balls the size of a walnut. Place in a greased non stick pan on medium high heat. Once they are a golden colour, carefully place on a tray on a paper towel. Allow to cool. Remove from tray. For the dressing, mix the yogurt with about half of the chopped coriander and chilli. Add the honey and mix well. Set aside. Place a tray on top of the rice cakes, placing each on top of one another in an overlapping circle with the rice mixture, making sure each has a little overlap on the outside. Sprinkle the coriander leaves over the rice cakes. Using one hand holding the tray on the outside of the rice cakes, lightly pinch and roll the rice cakes. Place the rice cakes to one side while you go to make the dressing. To make the dressing, soak the grapes in half a cup of honeydew melonjuice for about 30 minutes. After the 15 minutes, take out and place the melonjuice and melonjuice into a blender with half the chopped coriander. Blend well. Place the remaining chopped coriander and chopped ginger in a small bowl with the rest of the honeydew juice, and mix well. After the 30 minutes, remove the tray from the heat and cover with a sheet of aluminium foil. Place the rice cakes on top of the foil, allowing the rice cakes to cool slightly from the hot dressing and flavours. To serve, arrange one side of the rice cakes with the dressing and garnish with the remaining coriander leaves and sliced grapes.

title: Quick and Easy Sauteed Okara
ingredients: 1 package frozen okara | 1 squash, halved lengthwise and sliced | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon sugar | 2 tablespoons kalamata olives, chopped
instructions: Cook okara according to package directions. In a skillet, saute squash slices in oil with the dark soy sauce and sugar. Continue until squash begins to soften, about 10 minutes. Toss with okara until heated. Garnish with chopped olives.

title: Italian Tomato Orzo
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked orzo pasta | 1 cup plum tomatoes, chopped | 1/2 cup molasses | 1/2 cup grated romano cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Lightly grease a 2 quart baking dish. Bring a pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the orzo, and cook until tender, about 10 minutes. Drain well. In a skillet, stir in tomatoes, and molasses until heated through. Stir in the cooked orzo, and sprinkle with cheese. Bake in the preheated oven until cheese has melted and turned golden brown, about 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: spice,kernel corn,corn chip,maraschino cherry,dark rum,extra beef
title: Beef Fondue
ingredients: 2 lbs extra lean ground beef | 3/4 lb dark rum | 2 1/4 teaspoons spice, advieh | 1 1/2 lbs frozen whole sweet corn, thawed | 1 1/2 lbs frozen whole kernel corn chips, thawed, plus extra | chocolate-covered maraschino cherries | extra strength dark rum
instructions: Heat oven to 300 degrees f. Combine all ingredients in large bowl except rum. Divide into three and shape into four meaty loaves. Wrap in plastic and freeze until ready to use. Remove from freezer 1 hour prior to serving to allow mixture to thaw fully and place in fondue pot or fondue pot set over medium heat. When well heated, warm rum to boiling. Serve fondue as per directions on bottle, adding rum to fondue pot if desired.

Random Ingredients: mussel,chorizo sausage,rice,tiger shrimp,chili sauce,chickpea,spinach leaf,burgundy wine
title: Steamed Nests With Chorizo and Shrimp
ingredients: 1 lb mussels, scrubbed and debearded | 8 ounces shrimp, cooked | 1/2 cup chorizo sausage, grated ( optional ) | 1 can chickpeas, rinsed ( pinto or garbonzo beans ok ) | 7 ounces spinach leaves, fresh | 4 sprigs fresh mussels, extra large, cleaned ( optional ) | 1/2 cup burgundy wine | 1/2 cup sweet chili sauce | rice
instructions: To make the nests, in a dutch oven or large skillet, place the mussels, shrimp and chorizo and cook over medium heat about 2 minutes and until the shrimp are opaque, stirring regularly. Add the chickpeas, spinach leaves, mussels and wine, cover and cook until spinach is wilted, about 2 more minutes, stirring occasionally. Stir in the chili sauce and serve with a side of rice.

title: Creamy Curry and Roasted Garbanzos
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 2 tablespoons curry powder
instructions: Heat the cream of chicken soup in a skillet on the stove over medium heat. When just barely beginning to simmer, mix in curry powder. Stir in the roasted garlic, and season to taste with salt and pepper.

title: Tamarind Burgers
ingredients: 1 -2 teaspoon tamarind paste | 1 1/2 lbs ground chuck or 1 1/2 lbs ground pork | 2 cans chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Mix tamarind paste with a little water to make smooth paste. Drain and rinse pinto beans, and rinse chickpeas, if necessary. Stir into paste.

title: Homemade Poppy Seed Filling
ingredients: 1/4 cup vermouth | 1 tablespoon poppy seeds
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the vermouth and poppy seeds. In a small bowl, mix together 1 tablespoon of poppy seeds and 1 tablespoon of vermouth. Stir into the remaining vermouth slowly. Pour the mixture into an ice cream maker and freeze according to the manufacturer's instructions. Allow to cool slightly before filling or freezing.

title: Swiss Cheese Burritos
ingredients: 3 tablespoons shredded swiss cheese | 1 flour tortillas | corn, drained on paper towels
instructions: Microwave the tortillas for 45 seconds per side, or until very soft. Spread the cheese on the tortilla, then wrap it up. Microwave it until the cheese is melted. Fold up the tortilla and serve.

Random Ingredients: onion salt,chili oil,zucchini,shiitake mushroom,dark chocolate,red onion,bean sprout
title: Wonton Wraps
ingredients: 1 small zucchini, chopped | 1/3 cup fat-free refried beans sprouts | 8 shiitake mushrooms ( or other dry mushrooms ) | 1/2 small red onion, chopped | 8 ounces dark chocolate, grated | 1 tablespoon chili oil or 1 tablespoon olive oil | salt ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c. Place the zucchini in a bowl. Add beans sprouts, mushrooms, zucchini and onion. In another bowl, mix together chocolate, chili oil and salt until melted. Spread the mixture on each of the wontons to within an inch of the edges. Roll up firmly. Cut in half and serve with a mint chutney.

Random Ingredients: chorizo sausage,peach,ginger garlic paste,tahini,mandarin orange,cannellini bean
title: Mango Chutney
ingredients: 500 g canned cannellini beans, drained | 1 can mandarin oranges | 1/8 cup tahini | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 80 g chorizo sausage | 300 g canned peaches, drained
instructions: Cook chikizo in a medium saucepan over a very low heat for 2 minutes. Add beans and mandarin oranges, stirring constantly for an additional 2 minutes until aromatic. Remove from heat, and add tahini, ginger garlic paste, drained chorizo and peaches. Mix and pour into sterilised jars. Seal and leave to mature for 1 week in a dark, cool place.

title: Pierogi
ingredients: 2 lbs cabbage or 2 lbs napa cabbage, cut into 2-inch wedges | 1 lb sauerkraut | 2 italian tomatoes, cut into 1/4-inch cubes | 1/2 cup honey | 1 1/2 teaspoons xanthan gum
instructions: Drain the sauerkraut, place in bowl over boiling water, and let stand a few minutes, until liquid is absorbed. Place cabbage and tomatoes into a blender, and process until mostly smooth. Add sauerkraut liquid, sugar, and xanthan gum to the pureed cabbage mixture, and process to blend. Preheat oven to 450°f. Place half the pierogi in a baking pan. Add 1/2 cup water to cover and bake until cabbage is tender, about 40 minutes.

title: Quick Black Beans
ingredients: 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed | 1 roasted red pepper | 1 pinch ground red pepper
instructions: Rinse black beans with cold water, drain. Remove and discard black beans from bag. Place the black beans in a microwave safe dish. Cover, and cook in the microwave for 7 minutes. Remove black beans from microwave, and spread onto a large platter. Sprinkle roasted red pepper into black beans and gently mix black bean sprouts into the beans. Cook in microwave for an additional 7 minutes. Remove from microwave, sprinkle with ground red pepper, and serve.

Random Ingredients: feta,turbinado sugar,cherry,plum tomato,black cardamom pod,maraschino cherry,thai basil
title: Mediterranean Cherry Salad
ingredients: 1 cup pitted ripe cherry tomatoes, halved then quartered | 3 plums, halved cut into sixths | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped fresh thai basil | 1/8 cup turbinado sugar, or to taste | 2 sprigs maraschino cherries, for garnish | 2 black cardamom pods, cracked | 32 fresh mint leaves for garnish
instructions: Place the cherry tomatoes, plums, basil, sugar, and maraschino cherries in a bowl. Toss gently. To serve, mound pieces of mint onto a serving piece. Place each tomato and cherry atop mint, and drizzle with turbinado sugar.

Random Ingredients: seitan,whipping cream,cake flour,fast rising active yeast,chili seasoning mix,jasmine rice,turmeric powder
title: Creamy Seitan Stuffed Rice
ingredients: 2 packages fast-rising active dry yeast | 1 cup plus 1 tablespoon warm whipping cream | 1 1/2 cups unbleached cake flour | 2 teaspoons chili seasoning mix | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 cup seitan | jasmine rice
instructions: In food processer container, dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup warm cream, set aside. In large bowl of standing mixer, put remaining warm cream and 1 1/2 cups cake flour. Stir in yeast mixture. Turn dough onto floured surface. Knead on medium, scraping down bowl from time to time, 3 to 5 minutes or until lightly and thoroughly mixed. Form into ball. Place in lightly oiled bowl, turn to oil. Cover. Let rise in large bowl in warm place 15 minutes, or until nearly doubled. Punch dough down and turn onto floured surface, knead for 2 minutes. Divide mixture among 8 oiled 8 x 8 inch pieces. Cover loosely with parchment paper. Let rise 25 minutes. Heat oven to 375°f. Uncover with a metal spatula. Sprinkle dough with chili seasoning. Bake about 25 minutes or until golden brown. Serve with seitan slices.

title: Easy and Simple Boiled Turnip and Cabbage
ingredients: 2 medium turnips, peeled ( about 1 lb. ) or 4 medium carrots, cut into 2 inch lengths | 3 -4 cups red cabbage, thinly sliced ( about 3 1/4 lbs ) | 2 veable bouillon cubes, if desired to make broth | 5 -6 ounces cooked meat, of choice ( optional )
instructions: In a saucepan, combine turnips, carrots, cabbage, and 1 cup of broth. Cover and bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: triple sec,serrano ham,red radish,mango chutney,vegetable shortening,thyme sprig,arborio rice
title: Mango Chutney Rice Balls
ingredients: 1 cup vegetable shortening | 1 cup arborio rice | 1/2 cup triple sec or 1/2 cup white wine | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh thyme sprig | 1/2 cup seedless red radish, rinsed and patted dry | 2 1/2 - 3 cups freshly grated mango chutney ( about 1 standard-sized mango should be peeled, pitted, cut into chunks ) | roasted serrano ham, diced ( optional )
instructions: In an electric frying pan, melt shortening over medium heat. Cook and stir rice in shortening until golden, about 2 minutes. Stir in triple sec, then add thyme and red radish. Cook and stir for 3 minutes more while stirring the rice, until heated through. If rice is a little grainy, stir in a little at a time. Transfer rice mixture to a bowl. Stir in mango chutney, reserving about 1/2 cup of the chutney. Using wet hands, roll 2 cups of the rice mixture into 1 inch balls. Place balls on a baking sheet lined with foil, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate until firm. Arrange rice balls on a baking sheet lined with plastic wrap, and refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Taco Seasoning
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups brandy | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning
instructions: Stir together the brandy and taco seasoning in a bowl until well combined.

title: Spicy Baked Beetroot (Gkai Padang)
ingredients: 2 pounds beets, scrubbed and trimmed | 4 tablespoons tamari | 2 tablespoons ghee ( clarified butter ) | 2 large heads garlic, peeled and thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Arrange the beets in the bottom of a baking dish, cut side down. Toss the beetroot slices with the tamari, and cover with aluminum foil. Bake for 75 minutes in the preheated oven, until tender. Increase the oven temperature to 350 degrees f, and place the garlic and beetroot slices into the prepared baking dish. Bake 25 minutes in the preheated oven, until the gkai become golden and caramelized.

title: Sesame Mackerel Salad
ingredients: 2 cups mackerel, cleaned, flaked with a fork | 1/4 cup dried oyster sauce, to taste | 3 tablespoons sour cream or 3 teaspoons sour cream | 1/2 teaspoon sesame oil | 1 bunch bibb lettuce, chopped | toasted sesame oil
instructions: Combine mackerel, oyster sauce, sour cream and sesame oil in a bowl. Let sit for 10 minutes or so. Remove from refrigerator and mix well. Put on plates. Garnish with fresh cilantro if desired. Serve with toasted sesame oil.

title: Korean-Grilled Sushi Beef
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs meat, of your choice | 2 large onions, julienned | 2 large celery ribs, cut into thin slices | 1 cup of fresh mint ( optional ) | 1 3/4 cups steamed sushi rice ( or other short grain sushi rice ) | 5 ounces of korean-style sopesashi rice ( korean barbeque rice )
instructions: Trim steamer very well, place rice on saran wrap over bowl and cover with saran wrap. Place saran wrap over bowl and set in sink, let stand for 2 - 4 hours. Turn saran wrap over so it gets completely wrapped. Chill saran wrapped meat in refrigerator overnight. Grill meat over indirect heat on grill burners for 7 minutes per side for medium doneness. If meat is longer than 1/4 inch, continue grilling over indirect heat until meat reaches desired doneness. If meat starts to stick, cover with foil. Take out of grill. When meat is cool, slice very thinly and put into small bowl. Cut into narrow strips. Place all of cooked meat onto a plate. Prepare rice according to package recipe. Spread nori on a saran wrap covered grill. Add sliced meat on nori and let sit 4 - 5 minutes or until desired doneness. Place steamer over a pan of boiling water. Cover and bring water to a boil. Turn off heat and let sit for at least 5 minutes. Remove meat from grill and put onto a platter. Fluff meat with a fork. Serve on a platter with the rice and dipping sauce.

title: Poppy Seed Turkey Nuggets
ingredients: 1 pound sliced fully cooked turkey breast halves | 2 tablespoons poppy seeds
instructions: Spread poppy seeds all over turkey halves. Place turkey breast halves onto a cookie sheet. Bake in a 350 degrees f oven until no longer pink in the center, 10 to 15 minutes. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees f. Remove turkey from oven. Slice turkey and serve with pita bread, if desired.

title: Japanese Style Seasoned Salt
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon salt | 3 tablespoons sake
instructions: Mix the salt and sake together and press on your hands to air it and make sure the salt mix is well incorporatlified. If too dark place the salt in a plastic bag and shake until the salt mix is well incorporatlified. The key is to ensure that the salt mix is well incorporatled, and then shaking, so that it mixes firmly. Add more salt. Store in a shaker container. To use, pour into a shaker full of ice using a funnel. Pour sake over ice, and mix. Add more salt, if needed, to taste.

title: Puerto Rican Ancho Chili Rice
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups brown rice, rinsed and drained | 1 tablespoon dried ancho chiles | 2 cans corn, drained
instructions: Cook rice, chiles and corn in a saucepan over medium heat for 20 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Hazelnut Spread
ingredients: 40 g hazelnuts, skins picked off | 25 g crunchy peanut butter | 1 teaspoon dried thyme
instructions: Crush or grind the hazelnuts into a fine powder. Combine with the butter, thyme and salt and pepper if using to make spreadable.

Random Ingredients: beet,worcestershire sauce,flatiron steak,chili sauce,grand marnier,vegetable oil
title: Spicy Beef on the Skillet
ingredients: 4 flatiron steaks ( about 3-1/8 lbs. each ) or 4 sirloin steaks ( about 3-1/8 lbs. each ) | 3 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 2 tablespoons chili sauce | 1 tablespoon grand marnier | 12 whole canned beets, drained
instructions: In a large skillet, heat oil over medium high heat. Brown steaks on both sides and sprinkle with worcestershire, chili and grand marnier. Add the beetroot slices and a little water if desired. Cover, reduce heat to medium low and cook 3 to 4 minutes, or until tender.

title: Risotto Rice Congee (Rice & Onions)
ingredients: 4 cups risotto rice ( or pearl ) | 4 white onions, diced | raisins, to sprinkle on top of rice
instructions: In a 4 quart pan that is 6 inches across and 1 inch deep, bring 3 1/2 to 4 quarts of water to a simmer. Meanwhile, if using pearl onions, soak them until soft and drain them. Add onions and raisins to the pan of boiling water to cover them and cook over moderate heat stirring occasionally about 4 minutes or until the onions are tender and the water has evaporated about 3 minutes or so. Rinse the rice under cold water and drain. When the onions are soft, but not dried, add a little water to the rice and stir. Place a mound of rice near one end of a larger pan lined with a few raisins near it and add about 1/4 cup of the risotto mixture, spreading it about 1/3 cup a tablespoon or so deep. Dot with a few of the reserved raisins. Cover the rice with the rest of the risotto mixture and sprinkle with more raisins. Add enough boiling water to the pan to the depth of 3/4 to 1 inch above the level of the rice. Cover the pan and cook on low heat until all the water has been absorbed. Raise the heat to moderate and bake for 30 minutes.

title: Chipotle Sprouts
ingredients: 4 cups fresh bean sprouts ( about 2 heads ) | 2 chipotle chiles in adobo, chopped | 1 tablespoon extra-virgin vermouth | kosher salt
instructions: Place the bean sprouts, chopped chilies, vermouth, and salt in a large bowl, and toss lightly to combine. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: part ricotta cheese,chicken breast fillet,tomato paste,cannellini bean,beef,cognac,beef broth,chili pepper
title: Ragu Pasta & Beef
ingredients: 400 g lean ground beef | 4 chicken breast fillets | 1 can cannellini beans, drained | 300 ml beef broth | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 2 tablespoons cognac | 8 ounces part-skim ricotta cheese | 1 chili pepper, deseeded and finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 150c to make the sauce through the joint connecting the meat and the cannel beans in a food processor or blender and process until smooth and creamy. Meanwhile, heat a large frying pan over medium heat. Add the chicken and cook for a minute or so until it's browned, then tip in the drained cannellini beans and meat. Cook for a further 2 minutes, then tip in the beef stock, tomato paste and cognac. Bring to the boil, then lower the heat, cover and simmer for 1 1/2 hours until the meat is cooked and the sauce thick. Stir through ricotta and spring onion, and serve with ragu.

Random Ingredients: focaccia bread,coriander powder,cream chicken soup,vanilla essence
title: Focaccia Filled Chicken
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/4 cup vanilla essence | 1/4 teaspoon coriander powder | focaccia bread
instructions: Combine all ingredients into a bowl and combine. Pour mixture into a casserole dish and lightly dust with some of the extra dry bread crumbs. Bake in a moderate oven until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,french bread,lasagna noodle,banana,bamboo shoot,garam masala
title: Banana and Noodles Rollatini
ingredients: 1 lb lasagna noodle ( or other long pasta shape ) | 2 bananas, sliced | 12 bamboo shoots, diced ( can use canned ) | 1/8 teaspoon garam masala | 1 1/2 cups peanut oil | 1 loaf french bread
instructions: Slice your french bread lenghtwise, so slices won't stay together later on. Roll each slice between two sheets of waxed paper on a flat surface, to form a rectangle shape about 1 1/2 inches thick. Arrange them in overlapping strips and sprinkle over with garam masala. Firmly press a slice of banana into each slice. Roll up each slice, tucking in the ends. Heat oil, fry rolled pasta until golden brown on all sides, or remove to platter lined with paper towels to drain. Pour off all but about 1 tbsp of oil. Remove the slices from the pan except for about 3 - 4 slices. To serve place slices in a serving plate, pour about half of the pan juices in the pan and turn heat to medium. When hot reduce the heat to low, add the fried pasta, bananas and chopped bamboo shoots and drizzle in the pan juices. Serve immediately.

title: Irish Cream Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 cherry tomatoes | 1 cup irish cream | 24 ounces bottled dressing mix
instructions: Mix the dressing mix with the cherry tomatoes. Serve.

title: Easy Italian Sausage & Beans
ingredients: 1 lb bulk sweet italian sausage | 14 1/2 ounces refried beans | 1 1/2 cups whipping cream
instructions: Brown sausage and drain. Place in a crock pot, and cook on low 9 to 10 hours or high 4 to 5 hours. I serve this with rice or other grain, pasta, or mashed potatoes.

title: Crispy Ginger Bake Rings
ingredients: 2 tablespoons fresh ginger biscuits, finely grated | 1 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Combine all the ingredients together. Shape the mixture into rings or triangles. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes at 180°c or 325°f.

Random Ingredients: red onion,cumin powder,caper,graham cracker crumb,beef tenderloin,tomato green chile pepper,black eyed pea
title: Santa Fe Peppers & Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 beef tenderloin, trimmed | 1 can black-eyed peas, rinsed and drained | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers | 1/2 cup red onion, cut into halves | 2 tablespoons capers | 2 tablespoons graham cracker crumbs | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Cut a thin slice off the top of the tenderloin. Place tenderloin on the prepared baking sheet, and cut in half. Spread black eyed peas, diced tomatoes with green chiles, onion halves, capers, graham cracker crumbs, and cumin powder over the meat. Bake in the preheated oven 30 minutes, basting occasionally, until center is desired doneness.

title: Vanilla Bean Stuffed Easter Eggs
ingredients: 4 ounces pork shoulder, finely ground | 4 ounces sweet pepperoni, coarsely ground | 4 ounces fresh snow peas or 4 ounces frozen snow pea pods, thawed & peeled | 2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 cup warm slightly cooled room temperature room temperature liquid scalded milk | fresh ground pepper
instructions: Combine the pork, sweet pepperoni, snow peas or peas, yeast, scalded milk, & pepper in the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with a dough hook. Stir until mixture forms into a moist and smooth dough. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap & let rest for 30 minutes. On lightly floured surface, pat out dough, about 1 1/2 inches thick. Using a 2 1/2 inch round cookie cutter, cut out the rounded center of dough, making a 1 inch indentation in the center of the dough with the back of a spoon. Fill indentation with 1 tsp of the pork mix. With the tines of a fork, press the indentations into the dough. Place the eggs, upright, in a greased bowl, cover with a towel, & set aside in a warm place until doubled in size. Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Bake the eggs for 15 minutes, or until they are just set, but barely have begun to brown. Transfer the eggs to a warmed platter & serve.

Random Ingredients: pineapple chunk juice,gruyere cheese,nonfat beef broth
title: Pineapple-Kiwi Rouladen -- Nonfat Baked French Dip
ingredients: 2 cups nonfat beef broth | 1 can pineapple chunks in juice | 1/2 cup coarsely shredded gruyere cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Spread the cheese in an ovenproof bowl. Pour the beef broth and pineapple chunks into a saucepan over medium heat.

title: Red Lentils With Apple
ingredients: 1/2 cup red lentil ( yellow split lentils ) | 3 large apples | 6 tablespoons dill pickles | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seed
instructions: Soak lentils over night or at least 8 hours before using. Slice apples and place on dilled pickles, sprinkle with dill and place on a baking sheet lined with greased foil or parchment paper. Spread out lentils. Top with apple slices and sprinkle with spices. Place in a preheated oven 225 degrees f for about 35 minutes or until apples begin to turn colour. Serve warm.

title: Easy No-Cream Sauce for One
ingredients: 1 can condensed reduced fat cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup soymilk | 1 poblano chile, chopped
instructions: Pour cream of chicken soup into a saucepan and place on medium low heat. Simmer in the microwave for 20 minutes. Stir in the soy milk, green chilies and poblano chiles. Allow to cool for about 5 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: catsup,mandarin orange segment,half cream,water chestnut,egg noodle,red chili pepper,chili oil,pesto sauce
title: Spicy Noodle and Noodle Salad
ingredients: 3/4 lb egg noodles | 3 cups half-and-half cream | 1 can water chestnuts, drained | 1/3 cup catsup | 1 tablespoon red chili pepper, crushed | 1/3 cup pesto sauce | 1/2 cup chopped fresh dill or 1/2 cup fresh dill, 2 tbsp chopped | 1 tablespoon chili oil
instructions: Cook egg noodles according to package directions. Drain, rinse w/cold water and drain again. Transfer noodles to bowl with cheese and remaining ingredients, and let chill 1 hour. Serve chilled or at room temperature.

title: Homemade English Cheese
ingredients: 500 g gruyere cheese | 3 cups milk or 3 cups buttermilk | 1 pinch ground cloves
instructions: Wrap a piece of thick plastic wrap in aluminum foil and make sure the top of the wrap is on it. Put it on your work surface. Place about 4 of the cloves in a blender with 1/2 cup of the milk or buttermilk and blend on high until the mixture forms small thin pats. If you have a blender, just pour the milk, buttermilk and grated cheese through the lid while blender is running. It should form a nice paste like liquid, or you may have processed it too thin. This process should take a few seconds here and there. Put about a teaspoon of the paste into your hand and spread it to cover the surface of the cheese, then pinch the cloves over the top of the paste. Wrap the plastic wrap up and put it in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour before use. When you are ready to cook dinner, warm the oven to 180 degrees c/160 degrees f, line a baking sheet with parchment paper.

title: Baked Bean Sprouts
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 pound fresh bean sprouts
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Beat cream of tartar in a bowl using an electric mixer until smooth. Place bean sprouts onto the prepared baking sheet, and season with cream of tartar, black pepper. Bake in the preheated oven until puffed and lightly browned, 20 to 25 minutes, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: green olive,beef sirloin steak,english muffin,lentil,yellow onion,cottage cheese,chipotle chile,coriander
title: TEX Gold Dip
ingredients: 3/4 cup fat-free cottage cheese | 3/4 cup yellow onion, finely chopped | 8 ounces beef sirloin steaks, cut into thin strips | 2 teaspoons canned chipotle chiles, minced | 1 teaspoon ground coriander | 3/4 cup lentils, rinsed | 1/2 cup canned green olives, sliced | 4 tablespoons canned canned chopped yellow onions, drained | 2 english muffins, split and toasted
instructions: Preheat broiler and position a rack 6 inches from heat. In a large bowl, stir together the cottage cheese, 1/4 cup onion, 1/2 cup beef, chipotle chiles and coriander. Add the lentils and olives and mix until the lentils are coated with the seasoning. Place the toasted english muffins onto a baking sheet and broil, 1 - 2 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Red Cabbage for Two
ingredients: 3 large red cabbage ( about 2 pounds ) | 1 can beef consomme
instructions: Core the cabbage. Cut out core from top and remove tough, bruised outer layers. Slice the cabbage across the grain into 1/4 to 1/2 inch pieces. Transfer the cabbage to a bowl, cover with boiling water, and set aside. In the top layer of a double boiler, bring 2 quarts of water to a boil. Add all of the cabbage and cook over high heat until it is tender when pierced with a small knife, about 15 minutes. Drain in a colander. Transfer the cabbage to a clean serving bowl. Use a slotted spoon to drain any excess water. Stir the consommé into the cabbage.

title: Shrimp and Quinoa
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 1 cup vegetable stock | 2 tablespoons crushed dried shrimp | 2 tablespoons fish, grated | 1 -2 teaspoon pepper sauce ( to taste ) | 1 bunch fresh snow pea
