instructions: Rinse the quinoa under running water, then place in the rice cooker. Set the pc to the keep warm setting and bring to a boil. Drain the quinoa onto a tea towel or strainer lined with a double thickness of newspaper to drain any excess liquid. Add the stock, shrimp, grated fish and pepper sauce to the quinoa and mix thoroughly with your hands. Tightly pack the quinoa on to a large piece of foil and fold the top to make a cone shape and place into the steamer. Steam for 20 minutes or until completely cooked and liquid is absorbed.

title: Channa Ki Bari
ingredients: 250 g split green peas | 1 teaspoon almond paste | 1 dried tomatoes and green chilies, chopped finely
instructions: Roast the almond paste with the dried tomatoes and green chilies in a non stick pan. Remove from the heat, cover and allow it to cool down a little bit. Add the split peas and mix. Spread out evenly and use a flat spatula to fold the peas and tomatoes into it. Cook it on low heat, covered. Cook for 15 - 20 minutes or until split peas are very tender.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,cooking spray,bacon,cardamom,pear,pork butt,bean dip,wonton skin
title: Faux Baked Beans ("wonton Chips)
ingredients: 1 package bean dip ( plain doritos ) | 1 1/2 cups shredded gruyere cheese | 1 tablespoon quick-cooking spray | 2 smoked pork butt | 3/4 cup chopped pears, drained | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 package wonton skins | 2 tablespoons crisply cooked bacon, diced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spread bean dip in center of each doritos wrapper. Combine the gruyere cheese and bacon in a small bowl. Spread a little cheese and bacon mixture over the top of the doritos, then sprinkle liberally with the bean mix. Place on a large baking sheet. Bake in preheated oven until golden, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: applesauce,parsley,red pepper flake,chipotle chile adobo,soy sauce
title: Hot Apple Chipotle Marinade
ingredients: 1/4 cup sweetened dried chipotle chile in adobo, minced | 1/4 cup soy sauce | 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley | 1 tablespoon canola or canola oil, or as needed | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground red pepper flakes
instructions: Combine chipotle chile with adobo sauce, soy sauce, parsley, canola oil, red pepper flakes, and salt in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: channa dal,orange juice,lamb,sea salt,beef,chocolate,salad dressing,accent seasoning
title: Chana Dal Chess
ingredients: 6 ounces channa dal ( chickpeas - soaked overnight ) | salt | 2 1/2 lbs ground lean lamb | 3 tablespoons salad dressing | 3 tablespoons orange juice | 1 1/2 2 1/2 tablespoons channa dal ( chickpeas - soaked overnight ) | 1 pinch accent seasoning ( pinch ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons chopped hazelnuts ( or almonds or cashew nuts ) or 1 1/2 teaspoons chopped roasted almond ( or cashew nuts ) | 3 tablespoons extra-virgin salad dressing
instructions: Place dal in a fine mesh strainer over a large bowl and sprinkle with salt.

title: Kiwi Jam (Kalopsa)
ingredients: 4 kiwi fruits | 2 teaspoons sambal oelek | 1 teaspoon marjoram
instructions: Peel the kiwis and slice into rounds about 1/4 thick, then cut into slices. Place kiwi slices in a pan with just enough water to cover the kiwi slices and bring to a boil. Turn the heat down and simmer gently to soften slightly, for about 15 minutes, then drain. Add sambal oelek and marjoram to the kiwi mixture and cook for 5 minutes longer, stirring often, until jam has thickened. Stir the jam often, and allow it to cool to room temperature. Then store it in the refrigerator until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: sauce,zucchini,red currant jelly,chipotle chile,jicama,italian plum tomato,garlic,lemon peel
title: Chipotle Zucchini and Salsa
ingredients: 1 can jicama, drained | 2 zucchini, cubed | 1/2 cup hot sauce | 1/2 cup dry red currant jelly | 2 cloves garlic, minced | 1 tablespoon minced lemon peel | 3 cans italian plum tomatoes, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon minced chipotle chile
instructions: Place jicama, zucchini, hot sauce, redcurrant jelly, garlic, lemon peel, tomatoes, and chipotle chile into a blender. Blend until smooth, about 30 - 60 seconds. Serve over hot cooked pasta.

title: Fried Eggplants
ingredients: 1 large eggplant, peeled | 1/2 cup maraschino cherries
instructions: Cut lengthwise into 1/8 inch slices, then slice crosswise into a 3 inch wide by 4 inch wide slices. Place eggplant slices in a large heavy skillet and cover with water. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer 2 or 3 minutes. Drain and discard water from skillet. Heat 2 inches of oil in a deep fryer or large deep skillet to 350 degrees f. Working in batches, dip eggplant in hot oil several at a time, turning as necessary until golden brown, about 3 minutes per batch. Transfer fried eggplant to a colander to drain. Dry completely. Return skillet to stove over medium heat. Repeat process with remaining eggplant, adding more oil as needed.

title: Acorn Squash With Green
ingredients: 2 large acorn squash | 1 large green pepper, cut into 1/8 to 1/4-inch pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f slice each acorn squash in half horizontally without cutting all the way through. Cut each half into 6 serving size wedges. Place wedges in a large baking dish. Bake 40 minutes or until tender, basting occasionally. Remove from oven.

title: Cottage Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 package cottage cheese | 2 tablespoons teriyaki sauce | 1/2 green bell pepper, chopped
instructions: Blend cottage cheese, teriyaki sauce, and green bell pepper together in a blender or food processor until smooth.

Random Ingredients: watermelon,chicken bouillon cube,cardamom,lemon zest,pineapple juice,cauliflower,baking soda
title: Lemon Hawaiian Watermelon Soup
ingredients: 1 1/8 cups watermelon, chunks | 1 large sweet onion | 4 chicken bouillon cubes ( or vegetable stock cubes ) | 1 -2 tablespoon baking soda ( optional ) | 2 -4 teaspoons grated lemon zest | 1 lemon, juice of | baking soda | cauliflower ( if you prefer )
instructions: Chop and cube the watermelon. Peel and chop the onion, and sauté in a soup pot with 5 cups water until tender. While the vegetables are sauteing, in a large bowl, pour some baking soda into a cup. Dissolve, and combine all ingredients except the cauliflower in the bowl. Add this mixture to the soup and simmer for 1/2 hour, or stir. Add cauliflower during the last 15 minutes. Serve hot. Do not overcook. Serve hot or cold with lots of napkins on the side.

title: Chow Mein (Mallow Cake)
ingredients: 6 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1/4 cup half-and-half | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 6 fresh marshmallows
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Combine the vinegar, half and half, sesame oil, and marshmallows in a mixing bowl. Stir until well blended. Place mixture in a 10x15 inch glass baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven until golden, 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Quick Cheese Mexican Dip
ingredients: 2 cans cottage cheese, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup salsa | 2 tablespoons raisins ( optional )
instructions: Mix well. Spread onto toast.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese,tomato green pepper onion,mace,basil pesto,chicken stock cube
title: Baked Greek Tomato Slices
ingredients: 4 tablespoons pesto | 6 medium ripe tomatoes ( roma plum, sweet, ripe, about 2 cups ) | 2 -3 tablespoons chicken stock cubes | 1 tablespoon basil pesto | 1/2 tablespoon finely minced fresh basil or 1/2 tablespoon chopped fresh oregano
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees or grill to high. Spread pesto on each square of tin foil and heat. Coat tomatoes with pesto. Sprinkle with stock cubes. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until slightly charred. Arrange tomato slices on serving plates. Drizzle with sauce and fresh herbs as desired. Serve on top of tomato slices. Note, this goes great with pita bread as a side dish or just on its own as a grilled item.

Random Ingredients: green chili,sambal oelek,ziti pasta,dark soy sauce,sharp cheddar cheese,heavy whipping cream
title: Pasta With Shredded Cheesy Ziti
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups shredded ziti pasta ( short, 3 1/2-oz/13. 2 cups ) | 1/3 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/3 cup dark soy sauce | 1 chopped green chili ( red, yellow or green ) | 1/2 - 3/4 cup chopped mild green chili | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon sambal oelek ( substitute sriracha for sriracha ) | 2 ounces shredded sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Cook pasta until al dente drain, return pasta to dutch oven and stir in cream, soy sauce, green chiles and sugar. Cook and stir over medium heat until slightly thickened, taking care that the sauce does not burn pour pasta mixture over ziti and toss well to combine. Sprinkle with sambal olek and cheese, cover and bake until ziti is heated through and cheese is melted and bubbly throughout.

title: Collard Greens
ingredients: 2 bunches collard greens | 2 cooked white fish fillets
instructions: Steam first 3 ingredients for 3 - 5 minutes until fish is cooked and stringy. Add collard greens to hot greens in the pan. Serve hot.

title: Sweet Mustard, Cashews and Beans
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard | 2 teaspoons ketchup | 1 tablespoon butter or 1 tablespoon margarine | 1 small yellow or white onion, chopped | 1 lb dried red beans, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1/2 cup chopped cashews
instructions: Mix mustard, ketchup, and butter in small bowl. Add onions and beans and toss to coat. Pour into 2 11/2 inch glass baking dishes. Cover and bake in 400° f preheated oven 10 to 15 minutes, or until beans are tender.

title: Easy Cheesy Italian Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup cheddar cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup italian salad dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Place in refrigerator. Shake well before using.

Random Ingredients: golden brown sugar,chicken bouillon cube,seasoning salt,chicken breast half,food coloring
title: Chicken Terrine
ingredients: 2 tablespoons maggi seasoning salt | 1 chicken bouillon cube ( i used knorr ) or 1 vegetable bouillon cube, crumbled | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 3/4 lbs boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1 -2 tablespoon granulated food coloring
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together the ingredients. Add the chicken and coat. Set aside to marinate in the refrigerator overnight. The next day, line a 9 x 5 x 3 inch loaf pan with aluminum foil and spray with cooking spray. Remove chicken from the marinade reserving marinade and reserve. Sprinkle 1/4 of all of the reserved marinade over the pan. Pour reserved marinade ingredients evenly over all. Let stand and refrigerate 6 hours. Slice chicken into 10 slices, then arrange slices on top. Heat oven to 400 degrees. Remove foil from pan and spray with cooking spray. Bake at 400 degrees for 15 minutes. Turn chicken slices over and bake 3 - 5 minutes more or until no longer pink inside.

title: Easy Baked Prawns and Black Beans
ingredients: 250 g raw prawns, shelled | 400 g grape tomatoes | 3 tablespoons dried sage | 2 cups canned black beans, drained | 2 tablespoons key lime juice
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200% celsius. Line a roasting tray with baking paper. Place the prawns on the lined tray, and bake in the oven for about 5 - 8 minutes, or until they are light brown. Turn the prawns and return to the oven for another 3 - 4 minutes. While the prawns are baking, place the tomatoes, sage and half the beans in a heatproof bowl. Pour boiling water over to just cover the tomatoes and leave to stand at room temperature for about 5 minutes or until soft. Stir in salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste. Preheat oven to 200% celsius. When prawns are ready, drain and arrange in a single layer on the baking sheet. Pour the tomatoes and sage/jamaica over the prawns, then sprinkle with lime juice. Bake in a preheated oven for about 15 minutes or until prawns are pink. Serve with salad leaves.

Random Ingredients: golden raisin,turmeric powder,lime wedge,white vinegar,italian breadcrumb,beef tenderloin
title: Spiced Roasted Beef Tenderloin for Two
ingredients: 1 3/4 lbs beef tenderloin, 2 1/2-in | 1/3 cup golden raisin | 2 teaspoons ground turmeric powder | 1/2 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup distilled white vinegar | 2 limes, wedged ( to garnish )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 300 degrees. Remove meat from refrigerator 20 minutes before you are ready to cook it. Remove meat from refrigerator and let come to room temperature. Place oven rack in top 3/4 of oven. Line a 3 lb roasting pan with foil and set aside. Add raisins to roasting pan and sprinkle with turmeric, mix well. Cut meat into 1 inch slices, 3/4 of a cup for each slice, 3/4 for each slice. Mix bread crumbs, vinegar, and the juice of 2 limes in a medium bowl.

title: Smoked Trout and Walnut Filling
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs smoked trout fillets, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 cup walnut halves ( i prefer hazelnuts ) | 1 lb cauliflower floret | 2 medium carrots, peeled and diced | 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped parsley ( from 2 tablespoons ) | 1 teaspoon dried mint | 1 teaspoon ground mace | 1/4 cup shortening
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Place walnuts on a baking sheet and toast in middle of oven until they are dark brown, about 30 to 40 minutes. Remove and cool thoroughly. Place florets and carrots in a large saucepan and cover with 2 inches of water. Place over high heat. When it comes to a boil, add 1/2 teaspoon salt and the fish. Lower heat and simmer for 7 minutes. Drain and cool completely. In a small bowl, combine 2 tablespoons walnut oil and the remaining walnut oil and set aside. Prepare the smoker by heating the smoker to high. Place fish in hot smoker and smoke for 10 minutes. Remove from smoker and set aside. Remove carrot strips and cauliflower strands, then cut them into smaller pieces. Place cauliflower chunks and carrot pieces in a large mixing bowl. Add 1 tablespoon walnut oil, mint and ground mace and combine. Add a little of the flavored oil to help to bind the mixture. Combine the stuffing and vegetables with the walnut mixture. Mix well until everything is thoroughly coated. Place the turkey in the smoker and smoke until the turkey is cooked through, about 25 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: yellow pepper,nutritional yeast,white onion,chili paste,chickpea,butterscotch chip,hot italian sausage,taco seasoning
title: Mexican Chili Nests
ingredients: 12 ounces white onions | 12 ounces yellow sweet peppers | 4 hot italian sausages ( remove casings ) or 4 hot italian sausages ( remove casings ) | 12 ounces butterscotch chips | 3 packets taco seasoning | 3 tablespoons dry tahini ( sesame paste ) | 6 ounces buttercotch chips | 2 cans chickpeas, drained
instructions: Soak sweet peppers for about 2 hours in very hot water. Remove from water and let them sit until they're soft. Drain peppers and rinse well under cold water. Cut in half, remove seeds and membrane, and then cut into 1 inch pieces. Cut in half again and set aside. Slice sausages into 1 inch pieces. Preheat oven to 325 and spray cookie sheet with pam cooking spray. Cut the onion into 1 inch cubes. In pan with butter/olive oil, saute the onion and chopped sweet peppers until translucent. Remove from heat and mix them with the chili powder, taco seasoning and butterscotch chips. Remove hot sausage from casing and put it into a separate skillet with the melted butter/olive oil. Dip the stuffed pepper in butterscotch chips and place into baking sheet about 6 inches wide. Sprinkle with 3 tablespoons tahini, stir until everything is well mixed and coated. Fill the pepper half with hot mixture, spreading evenly. Place in oven and bake 15 minutes, or until hot.

Random Ingredients: rum,tomato juice,horseradish,pizza crust,yellow pepper,amaretto,cinnamon raisin bread
title: Spicy Tomato and Horseradish Bread Pizza
ingredients: 1 pre-baked pizza crust, such as boboli | 1 container prepared horseradish-flavored light spreadable jam or light molasses | 2 -3/4 cups commercial crushed plum tomatoes with juice | 1 loaf cinnamon raisin bread | 1 large yellow sweet pepper, seeded and thinly sliced | 1/4 - 1/2 cup rum | 1 dash ground cinnamon ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Place the pizza crust on a large nonstick baking sheet, cover with parchment, and press and press the top and bottom with a circular motion, tilting the sheet to ensure even baking. Spread the jam evenly over the bottom of the prepared crust.

title: Rice, Radish and Beer Salad
ingredients: 1 cup long-grain white rice, such as arborio | 12 ounces smoked beer | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 8 radishes, thinly sliced
instructions: Prepare rice according to package directions, omitting the salt and fat. Drain. When ready to serve, combine the beer, olive oil and chili powder. Just before serving, add the rice and radishes and toss to mix.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,mustard,tomato green chilies,active yeast,white pepper,dill weed,red cherry
title: Sweet Dilled Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 teaspoons dry active yeast | 2 teaspoons white pepper | 1 teaspoon mustard | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies | 5 -6 tablespoons peanut oil | 2 tablespoons dried dill weed | 1 cup shredded red cherries
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the yeast, pepper and mustard. In a small frying pan, heat oil until hot but not smoking and sauté the chopped dill weed. Add the tomatoes, one at a time, and sprinkle the dried dill weed on top, stir to coat evenly and slowly pour in the yeast mixture. Keep stirring. Bring to medium heat, cook for a few minutes, then pour into hot, sterilized jars. Put a little lemon juice in the pot if the liquid soaks inches. Seal in the hot cherry juice, and store in a cool, dark.

Random Ingredients: flax seed,jalapeno pepper,red pepper flake,turkey bacon,jiffy cornbread mix,red kidney bean,oregano leaf,hot egg noodle
title: American Kitchen Classic Cornbread Casserole
ingredients: 1 package jiffy cornbread mix ( jiffy brand, not martha ) | 2 cans red kidney beans ( drained and rinsed ) | 1 lb 93 % lean ground turkey bacon ( about 4 slices ) | 3 bunches fresh oregano leaves, divided | 2 hot jalapeno peppers, seeded and diced | to taste red pepper flakes | 2 containers jiffy cornbread mix | 1 1/2 tablespoons flour | 2 teaspoons flax seeds, toasted
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, crumble cornbread into small chunks and set aside. Drain kidney beans well and stir in the rinsed beans. Set aside. In a large skillet over medium high heat, cook the chicken until thoroughly cooked, 15 - 18 minutes. With a slotted spoon, remove chicken to a platter. Spoon off most of the fat remaining in the skillet. Saute chopped red peppers and oregano until garlic is soft, 6 - 8 minutes. Remove peppers from skillet and set aside. Place jiffy mix into a small bowl with red pepper flakes, and 1/2 cup of the oregano mix. Mix until well combined, then pour mixture into a 9x9 inch baking dish. Layer the cooked chicken over the cornbread mixture. Add the remaining 1/2 cup of oregano mix to mixture. Place the bacon over the mixture. Top with cornbread mixture. Sprinkle with 1 cup of the reserved chopped red pepper mix. Dot with remaining 1/2 cup of oregano mix. Bake in a preheated 325 degree oven until golden brown, 35 - 40 minutes.

title: Roasted Pork-Horseradish Broccoli
ingredients: 1/2 kg fresh broccolini steamed | 350 -500 g of fresh pork shoulder | 30 ml of prepared horseradish
instructions: Heat oven to 200c, 400c or gas mark 6. Line a shallow roasting pan with aluminium foil, allowing it to be slightly overhang. Bring a large lrg pot of boiling water to a boil, then drop in the steamed broccoli. Boil for 5 mins, add the pork & horseradish & continue to boil for 2 - 3 mins until tender. Remove from the heat & serve immediately.

title: Cauliflower Fritters
ingredients: 1 cup cauliflower floret | 12 ounces half-and-half | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1 sprig fresh mint
instructions: Rinse and drain the cauliflower. Place the floret in a mixing bowl of water for about 10 minutes and then transfer to a colander and rinse the excess water off. Place the cauliflower floret, salt, and enough half and half to cover the cauliflower and stir well. Let this mixture rest for about 20 minutes. Stir the mixture well and divide into six fritters. Serve with fresh mint for garnish.

title: Ginger Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 tablespoon minced ginger root | 1 package spaghetti | 1 pint heavy whipping cream | 1 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook spaghetti in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 12 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pepper sauce,malt vinegar,yeast,ham,velveeta cheese,corn syrup,nigella seed,olive
title: Cuban Ham Rollups
ingredients: 3 slices cooked ham, cut into thin wedges | 1/4 - 1/2 lb velveeta cheese or 1/4-1/2 lb cream cheese, cubed | 2 slices ripe olives | 1 packet yeast | 1/4 cup light corn syrup | 1/4 cup malt vinegar | 1/4 cup hot pepper sauce | 1/4 teaspoon nigella seeds
instructions: Mix the yeast with a cup of cool water. Dissolve the yeast, let it rest for 5 minutes. Stir together the cheese, olives, flour, sugar, pepper sauce, dash of nigella seeds, and sugar. Add the rest of the sauce to the yeast, mix well. Fold in the ham and spread out into a jelly roll pan. Let rise in a warm place, covered for about 90 minutes. Preheat the oven to 475 degrees fahrenheit. After 10 minutes, bake for 10 - 14 minutes. Turn off the oven and open door. Leave for another 20 minutes. Note, if you make this in a bolas, roll dough up like a jelly roll and put on a cookie sheet with wax paper between the dough.

Random Ingredients: chuck roast,tabasco sauce,yellow onion,peanut butter,beef chuck steak
title: Peanut Butter Smothered Swiss Steak or Barbeque Beef Stew
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless chuck steaks | 1 medium yellow onion | 2 tablespoons reduced light peanut butter, creamy | 6 drops tabasco sauce | 1/4 cup peanut butter, creamy
instructions: Trim fat. Cut steak into 3 pieces. Cut steak into 2 strips, then set aside. Trim ends of onion and cut into 1/4 inch slices. In medium bowl combine steak pieces. Cut up with 2 forks. Place in a 10 x 7 inch baking dish. Sprinkle onion slices over steak. Mix 8 drops tabasco sauce and remaining 8 drops tabasco sauce. Spoon mixture over all. Cover with foil. Bake in preheated oven 450f degrees for 1 hour. Serve over rice or noodles.

Random Ingredients: focaccia bread,head cauliflower,bisquick baking mix,green pea,cherry tomato,italian tomato,pepperoni,sirloin tip roast
title: Beef and Cauliflower Focaccia
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin tip roast, trimmed and cut into 1/2-inch slices | 1 large head cauliflower, cut into thick wedges | 3/4 cup bottled italian-style stewed tomatoes, undrained | 1 can italian-style stewed tomatoes, undrained | 1 package frozen cut green peas, thawed | 1 bag day old focaccia bread, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 teaspoons uncooked bisquick baking mix | 1/8 teaspoon pepperoni | 8 cherry tomatoes
instructions: Heat oven to 400^f in 10 inch skillet, toss beef with salt and pepper. In bowl, combine tomatoes and next 3 ingredients.

title: Alfredo
ingredients: 1/2 ounce mascarpone | 1/4 cup chopped asiago cheese
instructions: In a bowl, mix mascarpone and asiago cheese. Pour into serving glasses. Top with additional cheese, if desired, and serve.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,clam,red potato,icing sugar,cayenne,corn tortilla,jumbo shrimp
title: Shrimp & Clam Fajitas
ingredients: 36 extra large clams, scrubbed | 3 large red potatoes, scrubbed ( approx, i've use white! ) | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 5 ounces frozen small shrimp, thawed and drained | icing sugar | cayenne ( optional ) | corn tortilla
instructions: Scrub the clams, reserving any clams for later use. Bring a little water to a boil in a large pot. Add the potatoes and the clams and return to a boil. Boil about 3 minutes, just until they open. Drain the clams, remove the clams by dropping them and their contents into a bowl with some ice water. Reserve the clams, empty them into a bowl of iced water, and gently squeeze out the juice. Add soup, shrimp, and reserved clam juice to the potato mixture, stirring until thoroughly blended. Taste and add a little cayenne, if desired. Preheat the broiler, as many indoor shot holes as you can into the top of your oven, to your liking. Arrange the clams in a shallow baking dish. Spoon the fajitas on top of the clams. Set the oven to 400 degrees, and broil, turning once, until the fajitas are browned underneath, about 4 minutes or so. Let cool slightly, then cut in half and serve.

title: Beer-Steamed Squash
ingredients: 3 lbs fresh shucked squash ( approximately ) | 6 fluid ounces water | 1 cup beer ( preferably a pale ale or pacifico flavored, although any ale will do in a pinch. -- if possible, aquavit will be enough to give it a good kick. -- try it. )
instructions: Steam the squash for 45 - 60 minutes or until tender. Cool and discard the pulp and peel, place the squash in a large saucepan that has been completely filled with water. Boil until tender, about 10 - 15 minutes. Drain and cool completely. When cool enough to handle, cut the squash in half lengthwise, then in half again lengthwise, then divide into eight equal portions. Steam the squash until tender, approximately 12 - 15 minutes, depending on your preferred method of cooking. Remove squash from the baking pan and allow to cool. Transfer the squash into a bowl and mash well with a fork, using a fork until it is all incorporated. Add the beer, adjust the seasoning if necessary, and stir to heat through for a minute or two. Place the cooled, cleaned squash into a large, greased colander or large strainer, and gently tap the colander to remove any excess liquid. Allow to drain over a bowl, allowing excess liquid to drain back into the bowl. Serve.

Random Ingredients: tomato paste,vegetable stock chicken,epazote,asparagus spear,red snapper fillet,red chili pepper
title: Tomatillo Red Snapper
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried epazote | 1 fresh hot red chili pepper, seeded and chopped | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs red snapper fillets | 14 ounces tomato paste | 20 asparagus spears, trimmed | 5 cups vegetable stock or 5 cups chicken stock
instructions: Mix the epazote and chili in a small bowl, and set aside. Lay the snapper fillets on a clean surface, and using a sharp knife, slice lengthways into 1/2 inch thick slices. Remove the seeds from each slice, and set aside. Spread the tomato paste on the fish. Brush all of the inside of the wok with olive oil or cooking spray, and set over high heat. When it is hot, add the chili paste. Stir fry just a minute or so, then stir in the asparagus spears. Stir in the stock, and return to the boil. Cover, reduce the heat to medium, and cook for 10 minutes. Serve immediately, accompanied by hot cooked white rice or noodles.

title: Chopi and Prosciutto di Parma
ingredients: 3 slices prosciutto di parma, thinly sliced di parma | 1 teaspoon cornflour | 1 teaspoon dried chipotle powder
instructions: Place a piece of prosciutto di parma on kitchen paper, then sprinkle with a little cornflour and chipotle powder. Roll up and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: orange juice,cheese,dijon mustard,kernel corn,peach preserve,chickpea flour,yeast
title: Peachy Chickpea Dip with Mustard
ingredients: 250 g chickpea flour | 50 g chipolata cheese | 1/4 cup dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon peach preserves | 1 tablespoon orange juice | 2 1/2 teaspoons dried yeast | 400 g kernel corn, drained
instructions: Put the chickpeas in a large bowl and add the rest of the ingredients and mix well. Cover and leave to ferment in a warm place for 24 hours to ferment. Add more oats to the mix after 24 hours, if required. You may leave this until you need to. When ready to serve, heat the dip in a preheated oven for 5 - 10 minutes until bubbly. Serve the dip warm with chips and slices of green onion. For the best flavour, leave the dough in the refrigerator completely overnight, or serve it cold.

Random Ingredients: kalamata olive,baking potato,beef sirloin,ginger,mexican cheese,caraway seed,palm sugar
title: Korean Beef Roulades
ingredients: 1 pound beef sirloin, thinly sliced | 1 cup shredded mexican cheese blend, shredded | 2 medium baking potatoes, cut into 1/4-inch slices ( optional ) | 1/2 cup sliced kalamata olives ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon caraway seeds ( optional ) | 1/4 cup freshly grated asian-style prepared ginger | 1/4 cup granulated palm sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Arrange the beef slices on the prepared baking sheet. Sprinkle each slice with 1 cup of mexican cheese blend. Bake in preheated oven until beef is browned and internal temperature reaches 140 degrees f, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven, and slice thinly on the diagonal. Layer the sliced beef on the potato slices. Top with olives and caraway seeds, if desired, and top with ginger. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake in preheated oven until cheese is melted and slightly browned, about 15 minutes.

title: Macadamia Feta Seed Wedges
ingredients: 500 g self-rising flour | 250 g reduced fat feta cheese, cubed | 180 g macadamia nuts | 4 large squashes
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 c or 325 f, and grease a baking tray with butter. Mix flour, feta, macadamia nuts and half the grated parmesan into the yoghurt until they resemble coarse breadcrumbs. Knead dough lightly on bench until it is smooth. Shape into a ball and roll into a circle and place on greased tray, pressing dough down lightly. Bake for about 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown on top.

Random Ingredients: cardamom,russet potato,thai basil,vegetable stock,sun tomato,cremini mushroom,cocoa powder
title: Coconut Mushroom Soup (Healthy)
ingredients: 4 tablespoons vegetable stock | 8 ounces cremini mushrooms or 8 ounces shiitake mushrooms, cleaned and roughly chopped | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes ( not oil packed ) | 1 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom ( try a cardoon of grated nutmeg for a better flavour! ) | 2 cups finely diced russet potatoes | 1/2 cup roughly chopped basil
instructions: Heat your puree/stock to almost boiling point in a small saucepan over medium heat. Add your mushrooms and sundried tomatoes and stir. Pour in the cocoa and stir until the flavours are well dispersed throughout. Bring back to the boil about two minutes, then add your potatoes and stir again. Cover the pan with a lid, remove from the heat, and let sit for 5 minutes. If you have a hand held chopper, do a quick chop, chop or process the mushrooms until they resemble chunky bits of potato. I chop them roughly and throw them in a blender with roughly a tablespoon of boiling water. Add the rest of your ingredients and puree. Cover the pan and simmer for 30 minutes, gently allowing the flavours to meld. Serve garnished with chopped basil and extra sun dried tomato if desired.

title: Mexican Cannellini Bean Triangles
ingredients: 15 sheets phyllo pastry | 1 can cannellini beans | 1 teaspoon coconut extract | 1 jar enchilada sauce
instructions: Drain the beans and rinse. In a medium sauce pan, add the beans and a 1/4 teaspoon of coconut extract. Cook on low until heated through, about 5 minutes. Spread 1/8 of the bean mix in one corner of the phyllo dough, and 2/3 of the enchilada sauce. Top half of these with remaining phyllo dough and bean mix. Cut a small piece of plastic wrap off of the top corner of the pastry and brush 2/3 of the pastry with water. Using the plastic wrap, lightly roll the pastry around the pastry and enchilada sauce. Then fold the top corner over the pastry. Repeat until the phyllo dough is gone. Cover with a clean dish towel and let rest for at least 15 minutes, depending upon the size you rolled out. To cut, place a sheet of pastry lengthwise on a plate or a cutting board. Roll out the pastry so it is approximately 1/4 inch thick, placing the plastic wrap directly on the surface. It is vital when you are rolling the phyllo and filling into the sheets. Cut to desired size and thickness. I use 8 x 7 inch strips because it makes cleaning the filling easier later than other tube pastry. When rolled out, cut into the desired shapes. Heat an ungreased pan so they are about 4 inches in diameter on high. After frying, transfer them to an oiled pan, turning once, to prevent sticking.

title: Tasty Chili Rub
ingredients: 1 -2 teaspoon dried red chili pepper | 2 teaspoons dried currants | 1 teaspoon dried onion powder | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Place chili pepper, currants, onion powder and salt in an airtight jar or other container with a lid. Make sure lid is tight and shake well. Store in refrigerator for up to 2 weeks. Shake well to mix seasonings together.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,farfalle pasta,chili pepper flake,ice water,veal,cream cheese,strawberry preserve
title: Veal and Bow Tie Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb ground veal | 3 packages cream cheese | 2 bags frozen bow tie pasta ( farfalle, bow tie ) | 1 pint of sliced fresh strawberries in syrup | 1 jar picante sauce | 2 teaspoons dried chili pepper flakes | 2 -3 tablespoons ice water ( optional )
instructions: Brown meat in skillet with a little olive oil and drain. Prepare bow tie pasta according to directions on package. Meanwhile, combine cream cheese, sour cream and chili flakes in bowl. When cooked, drain off fat and add ice water as needed to thin the cream cheese mixture, if necessary. When noodles are done and drain well, put meat and cheese on top and add strawberry sauce, reheat gently until cheese is melted. Pour into a nice serving bowl and enjoy it is delicious.

title: Cheese Toasts
ingredients: 1 cup mild monterey jack cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup light giardineri vinaigrette vinegar | 1/4 cup pecan halves
instructions: Preheat grill to moderate. Spray a small oven proof casserole dish with cooking spray. Combine cheese, vinaagrette and pecans in medium bowl.

Random Ingredients: beef broth,black eyed pea,celery seed,spring onion,chili garlic sauce
title: Sierra Leonean Style Black-Eyed Pea Soup
ingredients: 2 cups sliced spring onions | 2 tablespoons shredded celery seeds | 1 cup dried black-eyed peas | 1/2 cup beef broth | 1 teaspoon chili-garlic sauce
instructions: Brown and stir the onions with the celery seeds over med high heat in a soup pot. Add peas, beef broth and chili sauce and bring to a boil. Lower heat and simmer for at least 20 - 30 minute serve topped with parmesean cheese.

title: Chile Sour Cream
ingredients: 3 tablespoons plain flour, sifted | 600 ml thickened cream ( or sour cream, see note below ) | 400 g pickled passion fruit, drained and chopped | 1 teaspoon finely chopped serrano chili
instructions: Using a large mixing bowl, lightly spoon the flour into the cream. Beat with a hand held electric mixer until mixture forms soft peaks and resembles softly whipped cream. Fold in sour cream. Transfer cream to a bowl. Add pickled passionfruit and serrano chilies and mix well. Cover & chill. Will keep refrigerated for up to 1 week. Note cream can be served chilled or slightly warmed before serving. Yield is estimated.

title: Ratatouille With Ziti
ingredients: 1 small eggplant, peeled, washed and diced | 1 medium ziti pasta | 4 tablespoons cocoa | 4 tablespoons superfine sugar | 1 baguette, thinly sliced | 1 medium sweet red pepper, sliced thinly
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a large pot of boiling water, blanch eggplant for 10 seconds. Drain and peel. Set aside to cool. Boil ziti for 10 minutes, then drain. In a small bowl, combine the cocoa and sugar. Heat a large, nonstick frying pan over medium high heat. Add the eggplant and pepper and cook for one to two minutes until the pepper is softened and the pepper is beginning to crisp up. Pour half of the cocoa mixture into a 9x13 inch baking dish and place the eggplant pepper over the cocoa mixture. Cover pan with a lid or foil. Place in the oven and bake 45 minutes. Allow to cool for 10 minutes. Slice baguette in half lengthwise, then into 3/4 inch pieces. Tear off a piece of bread about 1 inch thick and press into the baguette slices to make bread crumbs. Place the slices of cheese over the eggplant mixture, and top with the remaining sauce. Top with a piece of bread. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,cherry,kaffir lime leaf,animal cracker cooky,yoghurt,mozzarella cheese,beef base,marshmallow creme
title: Kaffir Lime Grilled Meat Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups mozzarella cheese, shredded | 1 cup swiss cheese, shredded | 1/4 cup sweet greek yogurt or 1/4 cup whole milk yogurt ( not skim ) | 2 teaspoons animal cracker cookies ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon animal fat free liquid steak seasoning ( optional ) | 500 mince meat ( optional ) | marshmallow creme, to decorate ( optional ) | 10 kaffir lime leaves ( optional )
instructions: Combine cheese and mozzarella in bowl, pour over soy milk and beat lightly until cheese is melted. Add cracker cookies, if using butta toast, if using. Add mince meat if using. Place in an 8 or 9 cake pan or an 8 loaf pan and sprinkle top with remaining mozzarella. Sprinkle top with marshmallow creme and chopped kaffir lime leaves. Cover with wax paper. Refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight. Uncover on serving platter and let stand until cheesecake is set. Cut into wedges to decorate.

Random Ingredients: ice,grain rice,kaffir lime leaf,chipotle chile adobo,green bean,lettuce leaf
title: Chipotle Rice Bowl
ingredients: 2 cups short-grain rice, rinsed and drained | 1 tablespoon chipotle chiles in adobo, finely chopped | 2 cups mixed lettuce leaves, cut into 1-inch x 3-inch pieces ( optional ) | 8 kaffir lime leaves or 8 thai basil leaves, coarsely chopped | 8 cups mixed greens | ice
instructions: Cook rice in hot skillet 1 minute, stirring frequently, remove from heat. Let rice stand, covered, 5 minutes. Meanwhile, mix chipotle pepper, lettuce, and kaffir lime leaves in large bowl. Add rice and lettuce, tossing to coat. Divide rice among individual serving bowls. Garnish with green sprouts and basil.

title: Amanda's Mushroom Bread Dip
ingredients: 1 pound fresh mushrooms, sliced | 1 cup canned bamboo shoots, drained | 1 cup dry bread crumbs | 1 tablespoon yellow mustard | 1 teaspoon ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Lightly grease a 9x5 inch loaf pan. Mix the mushrooms, bamboo, bread crumbs, mustard, and black pepper in a bowl. Spread mixture into the prepared loaf pan. Bake in the preheated oven until bubbly, about 30 minutes.

title: Pumpkin-Ziti
ingredients: 1 bunch broccoli, chopped | 1 cup cooked ziti pasta or 1 cup penne pasta, cooked | 2 tablespoons ginger paste | 1 package cottage cheese | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 2 tablespoons instant coffee | 1/2 cup water | 1 can pumpkin
instructions: Combine pasta or pasta sauce ingredients except pumpkin, and place into a crockpot on low heat and add pumpkin. Cook for 2 hours or more.

title: Rosemary Garlic Chicken Drumsticks
ingredients: 6 chicken drumsticks | 1 can chicken fat ( i use 2, but the flavor will be weaker ) | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary | 2 -3 tablespoons dark smoked liquid smoke | rosemary ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Lay chicken in dish or roasting pan.

Random Ingredients: tarragon,fine sea salt,brown rice,chicken wing,green cardamom pod,italian herb seasoning
title: Tarragon Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1 whole chicken wings | 2 teaspoons dried tarragon | 3 teaspoons dried mixed italian herbs seasoning | 1 teaspoon green cardamom pod | 1 teaspoon brown rice | 1 teaspoon dried italian herb seasoning | 1 teaspoon fine sea salt ( maldon )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f in a 12 inch saute pan on medium heat, brown chicken wings, then place chicken in a roaster. Add tarragon, meyerra wine, green cardamom, italian herb seasoning and salt, to taste. Cover and bake for one hour, then uncover and bake an additional 45 minutes. Remove from oven to cool to room temperature, then remove the skin and bones from the chicken and discard. Rinse the ribs and the fat and discard. Place chicken on platter, cut into 10 pieces, then put in serving platter.

title: Italian Sausage With Catsup
ingredients: 1 lb bulk sweet italian sausage | 1/2 cup catsup
instructions: In a large skillet, cook sausage over medium heat until no longer pink. Stir in catsup and heat through. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: water,hash brown,cornmeal,white bread flour,demerara sugar,apple juice
title: Healthy Apple Pie
ingredients: 4 cups peeled chopped apples ( such as a red or pink ) | 1 cup water | 2 tablespoons white bread flour or 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 cup cornmeal | 1/2 cup water | 1 package finely shredded hash browns ( i use the kind in the refrigerated section of my grocery store ) | 1/2 cup demerara sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f lightly grease a 9 pie plate or a quiche dish and set aside. In a saucepan, combine the apples, water, flour, cornmeal and 1/2 cup of water. Bring to a boil over medium high heat, stirring, and boil 3 minutes or until apples are tender. Stir in the potatoes. Pour filling into pie plate. Bake for 30 minutes, or until crust is golden and apples are tender.

title: Grilled Salmon and Pasta
ingredients: 2 pounds salmon | 1 cup water | 1/2 cup white sugar | 3 tablespoons canola oil | 3 cups rigatoni pasta
instructions: Preheat your grill for high heat and lightly oil the grate. Cut a piece of salmon off the bones. Cut the meat into four equal pieces, then cut each piece into four serving portions. Combine the water, sugar, and canola oil in a non reactive saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium high heat. Quickly whisk the soup into the hot sugar water, stirring constantly. Remove from the heat, and whisk until the sugar has dissolved. To serve, spoon the soup into four serving bowls, and place a salmon piece on top. Serve with cooked rigatoni, if desired.

Random Ingredients: barbecue sauce,green chile pepper,orange juice,quinoa,rye bread,green
title: Red and Green Slider
ingredients: 4 cups packed, shredded green and/or red salad greens | 8 wedges green ( to taste ) | 1 cup orange juice | 1 can chopped green chile peppers | 2 tablespoons barbecue sauce | 5 cups fresh quinoa, cooked and chilled
instructions: Line a 1 1/2 quart casserole dish with plastic wrap and spray with cooking spray. Arrange the greens at the bottom of the dish. In a medium bowl, whisk together the orange juice, chilies, barbecue sauce and quinoa. Top with green and/or red slivers. Cover loosely with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 3 hours or overnight. Bring to room temperature before serving.

Random Ingredients: yellow potato,cornstarch,italian herb seasoning,cream chicken soup
title: Savory Potato Rounds #5FIX
ingredients: 2 cans condensed cream of chicken soup, undiluted | 4 cups pre-shredded yellow potatoes | 1 tablespoon dried italian herb seasoning | 1 tablespoon cornstarch
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a large, oven proof bowl mix together the soup, potatoes, italian herb seasoning and cornstarch until well blended. Spoon mixture into a 9 x 13 inch pan. Bake, uncovered, at 400 degrees f for 20 minutes. Remove from oven.

title: Apple and Radish Enchilada Filling
ingredients: 2 cups apples, diced | 1/4 cup radish, finely chopped, about 20 | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 2 tablespoons red enchilada sauce | 2 tablespoons hazelnuts, chopped
instructions: Place in a food processor, pulse for 30 seconds or until finely chopped. Add apples through vinegar. Add spices and process until mixture has an emulsified texture. Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 1 week..

title: Ccottage Cheese & Chile Hot Potatoes
ingredients: 10 small new potatoes | 1 small mild chile pepper | 1 container cottage cheese ( i use 2 % ) | 3 tablespoons half-and-half
instructions: Rinse the baby potatoes under cold water, and prick them with a fork to dry out any tiny bits. Place the peeled potatoes in a pot with enough water to cover them by at least 1/2 inch or submerge. Bring to a boil over high heat, add the chile pepper, cover, and simmer until the potatoes are almost tender, about 15 minutes. Drain off the water, cool to room temperature, and chop the potatoes into uniform sized pieces. Add the cottage cheese to the potato water in the pot, and mix in the half and half. Heat over medium flame until bubbling vigorously, but do not boil.

Random Ingredients: soya sauce,tea,chicken breast half,ice,broth,turmeric powder,whipping cream,pimiento
title: Chicken Breasts in Soy Cream Sauce
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 2 cups beef stock or 2 cups broth | 2 tablespoons soya sauce | 2 teaspoons instant tea | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 cup whipping cream | 1 -4 slice pimiento, to taste | ice ( optional )
instructions: Place chicken in a saucepan, pour the stock over and saute slowly until chicken is cooked and skin is black. Set aside for 5 - 10 minutes. Remove the chicken and let it cool for 10 - 15 minutes. Remove the meat from the pan. Reserve pan juices to make a gravy. To make gravy, bring all ingredients to a boil and simmer for 3 minutes. Pour over the chicken, cover and simmer for five minutes. Remove the chicken to warmed serving platter and remove skin. Slice the breasts into very thin strips. Strain the liquid from the pot and keep one cup of broth in a saucepan and add the other cup of broth as well. Bring all ingredients to the boil. Add the chicken and simmer for 15 - 20 minutes until the chicken is cooked and sauce is thickened slightly a little. Place the pimiento slices onto serving platter and spoon the chicken and sauce on top. Optional, serve with the warm, freshly made ice cream.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf italian parsley,pea,thai fish sauce,walnut,green bell pepper
title: Fresh Veggies Ga Nuoc
ingredients: 1/2 lb green bell pepper, cut into thin strips | 1 cup frozen peas, thawed | 3 tablespoons walnuts, chopped | 1 tablespoon flat-leaf italian parsley, finely chopped | 1 -2 tablespoon thai fish sauce
instructions: Cook chinese vegetables in boiling water until just tender. Drain and set aside. In small bowl combine walnuts, parsley and fish sauce. Add to vegetables and toss and season with salt and pepper. Serve immediately.

title: Mexican Eggs
ingredients: 1 tablespoon taco seasoning | 1 tablespoon dried minced meat | 2 eggs, beaten | 1/2 cup chopped green pepper | 1 cup watercress
instructions: Dilute taco seasoning and minced meat in small amounts. Add beaten egg, adding green pepper and watercress. Add enough water to just barely cover. Simmer over medium heat for about 5 minutes. Garnish with green and hot pepper strips, if desired.

title: Rosemary Mango Dip
ingredients: 1 container soft light cream cheese | 1 ripe mango, peeled, pitted and diced | 1/2 cup canned diced tomato with juice | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh gingerroot | 1 fresh rosemary sprig, chopped
instructions: Place the cream cheese in a medium bowl, and mix in the mango, tomatoes and ginger. Garnish with rosemary.

title: Basic Taco Seasoning -- for Beef and Chicken
ingredients: 1 packet beef bouillon cubes, such as mccormick's montreal steak seasoning | 4 -6 stalks celery salt | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine all ingredients, mix until well incorporated. Use as directed in taco seasoning recipe.

Random Ingredients: grain mustard,puff pastry,kaffir lime zest,feta cheese,tequila,navy bean,large shrimp
title: Spicy Shrimp and Feta Pasties
ingredients: 1 cup navy beans, rinsed and drained ( optional ; don't use black beans that are pre-soaked and not drained ) or 2 cups cooked black beans ( optional ; don't use black beans that are pre-soaked and not drained ) | 3 sheets frozen puff pastry ( or similar type of pastry pastry dough, your choice - i like to use a 6-inch square of thawed pastry from trader joe's ) | 2 lbs large shrimp, peeled, deveined ( don't use the tails ) | 3 teaspoons whole grain mustard | 3 -4 kaffir lime zest ( optional, for color ) or 3 -4 jalapeno chiles ( optional, for color ) | 1/4 cup tequila | coarsely crumbled feta cheese ( optional ) or ranchero ( optional )
instructions: Put beans, shellfish and remaining ingredients in a large pot and simmer until shrimp are pink and beans are soft about 5 minutes. Adjust seasoning and serve, or cool and freeze for up to 2 months, or up to 3 months, and store the defrosted pastry sheets in an airtight container at room temperature or freezer. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Cut pastry sheets into 1 wedges, then toss them in a bowl with enough cold water to keep them from sticking together and to prevent them from sticking together. Arrange half the wedges in a single layer on a baking sheet. Bake for 10 minutes, or until lightly browned. Let cool on the baking sheet on a rack for 15 minutes. Remove dough from oven and spoon the shrimp bean mixture onto each wedge. Top with a crumbled half cup of crumbled feta or parlsey or ranchero if using.

title: Swiss & Mushroom Pizza
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti or 1 lb rotisserie style bread | 1 cup iceberg lettuce, chopped | 1 cup swiss cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup oyster mushrooms, sliced | 1 cup thai basil, chopped | 4 cups lettuce | 1/2 cup dressing
instructions: Cook spaghetti or rotisserie style bread dough. To serve, place pizza crust on large baking sheet and prick top evenly with fork. Bake, uncovered in 400°f oven about 6 minutes or until crust is crisp, turning oven to broil. Reduce heat to 325°f to make filling, arrange 1/2 cup chopped lettuce on pizza crust, arrange 1/2 cup shrimp or fish in over that and 1/2 cup bbq meat of choice. Topping, place 1/2 cup basil, 1/2 cup mushroom and 1/2 cup rice on top of meat. Brush crust edges with dressing. Slide pizza onto baking sheet, broil until hot, about 2 minutes.

title: Cuban Pizza (Tocook)
ingredients: 1 lb ground meat | 1/4 teaspoon dry yeast | 1/3 cup rice vinegar | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1 teaspoon pesto sauce ( homemade or prepared ) | 3 cups shredded red cabbage | 14 1/2 ounces black beans, drained
instructions: Put all ingredients except cabbage and beans in large bread machine. Add cabbage and beans. Set to regular or dough setting. Push start and check often to make sure it’s not sticky. Remove when dough is done.

title: Finnish Noodle Toss
ingredients: 1 lb dry bulgur | 6 ounces cottage cheese or 6 ounces ricotta cheese | 9 ounces enoki mushrooms | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1 teaspoon light soya sauce
instructions: Boil bulgar in water. Mix all ingredients together except cottage cheese or ricotta. Drain off water. Add cottage cheese or ricotta to noodle mix. Chill.

title: Famous French Dijon-style Mustard
ingredients: 3/4 cup light golden syrup ( about 2 1/4 tablespoons ) | 3/4 cup dijon mustard ( or to taste ) | 3/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon ( or to taste )
instructions: Whisk the mustard and cinnamon together. Place the mustard mixture over warm, barely warm water in a bowl. Place the saucepan over low heat, add the mustard and cinnamon. Continue whisking while you gradually stir in the syrup. The sauce has the consistency of honey and it does not have a toasty taste. Do not allow to boil while the mustard is still hot.

Random Ingredients: sugar,serrano pepper,wild rice,bay seasoning,tart cooking apple,kahlua,scallop
title: Crock Pot Irish Scallops
ingredients: 4 scallops ( i like the size of a pea for my husband and husband ) | 1/4 cup kahlua | 1/4 cup wild rice ( i've used regular ) | 1 teaspoon dried taro seasoning ( or to taste ) ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon powdered sugar | 1 tablespoon old bay seasoning | 2 small tart cooking apples
instructions: Slice the scallops crosswise into 1/2 inch slices. Place into a 3 1/2 quart slow cooker. Mix together the ingredients in small bowl. Pour mixture over the scallops. Cover and cook on low for 7 - 9 hours until scallops are tender.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,splenda sugar substitute,coriander powder,cellophane noodle,baby carrot,wheat flour,button mushroom,mango powder
title: Vegan English Mango Noodle Sandwich Recipe
ingredients: 15 ounces button mushrooms, sliced ( one package ) | 10 ounces baby carrots, small | 1 tablespoon skim milk | 6 ounces cellophane noodles, plain | 2 slices rye bread, whole wheat | 1 tablespoon wheat flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons splenda sugar substitute or 1 1/2 teaspoons sugar | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder or 1/2 teaspoon curry powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients except bread and roll each piece of bread in flour to coat both sides with flour. Place in plastic bag. Seal, refrigerate overnight. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Heat 1/2 tbs oil, add noodles, toss until coated well and heated through. If noodle sauce is to thick, thin with milk. Lay out bread on cookie sheet with tops. Heat 2 tbs of oil, add noodles and toss until coated well and heated through. Spread sliced bread on both sides with sauce, top with sliced noodles & serve warm.

title: Baileys Irish Cream Frappé
ingredients: 1 beef stock cube | 1/2 ounce baileys irish cream ( or similar liqueur )
instructions: Shake the beef stock cube into a jug. Add the bailey's and shake. Stir. Pour into a heat proof glass or ceramic mug.

title: Nate's Mexican Shrimp
ingredients: 1 lb stew meat | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 1 tablespoon quick-cooking spray | 1/2 teaspoon dried fruit | 1 dash dried chipotle powder | 1/2 tablespoon lemon juice
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a ziplock bag. Marinate, in the refrigerator, for at least 24 hours. Transfer to a ziplock bag and snip off any excess air. Scoop meat from bag and shake well. Arrange in a pan. Cover and cook on medium heat, stirring every 2 minutes until browned, 7 - 9 minutes. Do not overcook or shrimp will toughen.

title: Chicken Fried Rice--Ensalada De Repollo
ingredients: 3 cups uncooked long grain rice | 20 pieces chicken, thighs and drumsticks | adobo seasoning | 2 tablespoons butter | 1/2 red cabbage, chopped into chunks
instructions: Cook rice as directed on package. Add chicken pieces, seasoned with adobo and butter to the rice and stir to mix well. Transfer rice to a plate and top with shredded cabbage.

Random Ingredients: raspberry,kalamata olive,cold water,linguine,tomato puree,adobo sauce,picante sauce
title: Picante Pasta With Fresh Raspberries and Tomato Salsa
ingredients: 2 cups picante sauce ( store-bought ) | 2 tablespoons adobo sauce ( from a packet of the adobo sauce aisle of your local mexican restaurant ) | 1/4 cup cold water | 12 ounces linguine, broken into pieces | 1 can raspberries, drained and juice squeezed out | 1 can tomato puree | 1/2 cup kalamata olive, roughly chopped
instructions: Prepare the sauce by mixing everything together in a bowl and set aside. When ready to cook the pasta, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the linguine and boil uncovered until it is just tender. Drain, reserving 1/2 cup of the cooking water, and toss the pasta with the picante sauce in a bowl. Add 2 tablespoons of the reserved cooking water to the bowl with the tomatoes and olives. Add this tomato mixture to the cooked linguine. Add the drained raspberries and toss.

title: Pesto Cream Sauce
ingredients: 4 cups heavy cream | 1 jar prepared pesto sauce
instructions: Whip cream, then stir in pesto. Refrigerate until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: plain nonfat yogurt,corn oil,pace picante sauce,brown lentil,macaroni,maple syrup
title: Mexican Rice and Lentils
ingredients: 1 cup dried brown lentils | 6 tablespoons corn oil | 1/2 cup pure maple syrup | 1 cup prepared macaroni | 2 cups plain nonfat yogurt | 1 cup pace picante sauce
instructions: Place drained brown lentils in a large bowl, cover with cold water and place in the refrigerator for 2 hours or until tender. Drain and rinse. Heat the corn oil in a deep skillet. In a medium saucepan, heat the maple syrup and bring to a boil over medium heat. Add the macaroni and cook, uncovered, stirring gently with a fork just until it is crisp tender. Stir into the skillet the cooked lentils, syrup, and macaroni. Reduce heat to low and stir often until heated through, about 5 minutes. Transfer to a serving platter and serve with pico de gallo and shredded cheese.

title: Tarragon Nuts (Cook's Illustrated)
ingredients: 1/2 cup raw cashews | 1/4 cup tarragon
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Spread cashews evenly and toast in a single layer in the preheated oven until they are lightly browned, 8 to 10 minutes. Pour the roasted cashews onto a large piece of aluminum foil.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crust,cremini mushroom,colby monterey jack cheese,oregano leaf,baking powder,black bean
title: Black Bean and Mushroom Filling for Two
ingredients: 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 1 cup dried cremini mushrooms, coarsely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder | 1 1/2 cups shredded colby-monterey jack cheese | 9 graham cracker crust
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Mix the beans and mushrooms together in a bowl. Stir in the oregano, baking powder, and 1 cup of the cheese. Add the filling mixture and mix well. Fill each graham cracker crust as described on the package, spreading about 3/4 cup of the filling on each crust. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, or until the filling reaches the desired filling temperature.

title: Cakewells
ingredients: 500 -500 g bottlegourd | 2 teaspoons icing sugar | 1 teaspoon five-spice powder
instructions: Preheat oven at 200c. Cut bottlegourd into 2 inch square pieces. Cut 1/4 inch cube of baking parchment. Place in baking pan. Add a teaspoon of icing sugar. Add a small spoon of five spice powder. Mix. Spread half of mixture over bottlegourd cubes. Place in oven for 10 - 15 minutes, until golden brown.

title: Cafe Vienna Mix
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 1/4 cup cocoa or 1/4 cup coffee
instructions: Simply stir all the ingredients together except for the cocoa and/or coffee. To make it even spicier, add the coffee just before blending with the rest of the ingredients. The coffee should have a little bit of a kick to it.

Random Ingredients: chicken drumstick,cilantro stem,matzo cake meal,egg white,fennel seed
title: Bali Chicken
ingredients: 6 chicken drumsticks | 1 1/2 cups matzo cake meal | 1 1/2 teaspoons fennel seeds | 2 egg whites | fresh cilantro stems, for garnish
instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine the matzo meal and fennel seeds and blend well. Add the egg whites and mix well until a stiff dough forms. If the dough is too dry, add a few tablespoons of water. If it is too wet, add flour until the dough is manageable and can be turned out of the bowl onto a floured surface. If the dough is too wet, add water a little at a time until you have a stiff dough that the chicken will be able to hold together in your hand, but won’t be sticky. Heat a 10 inch or medium skillet over medium high heat until a bead of water dropped onto the surface evaporates immediately. Place about 1 teaspoon of the dough in the center of the pan. Use your finger to gather the edges of the dough into a circle about 1/4 inch thick and 2 1/2 inches in diameter. Place a chicken, breast side up, in the center of the circle and roll to surround the chicken with the filling. Wearing a knife, carefully transfer the rolled chicken to a plate covered with plastic wrap and cover with another plate covered with plastic wrap. Set aside when all of the rolls are rolled out. Repeat with the remaining dough and filling. Bring a large skillet of water to a boil. Carefully slide the rolled out chicken into the water, several at a time. When the water returns to a boil, carefully lower into a warm pot of ice water until the chicken is cool. Cut the chicken into portions with a very sharp knife. Garnish each dish with fresh cilantro sprigs and serve, recipe is posted here, http, //bali chicken cookbook.

title: Low Calorie Spam® Succulent Grilled Broccoli
ingredients: 10 ounces fresh broccoli florets | 1 cup low-fat cheese, shredded ( daiya brand is recommended ) | 2 cups italian seasoned breadcrumbs
instructions: Rinse the fresh broccoli florets in cold water and then cut them in half lengthwise. Do not cut off the tips in the broccoli. Slice into thin pieces. Set aside. Combine the 3 cups of shredded cheese, salt and bread crumbs together in a bowl or food processor. Stir until well mixed. Dip each piece of broccoli into crumbs, then coat with the cheese on both sides. Place on a lightly greased grill pan or griddle, and cook over medium heat, turning once, until golden brown, about 6 - 8 minutes.

title: Lamb With Pear and Mango
ingredients: 1 cup chopped green cardamom pods | 1 cup chopped ripe mango | 1 cup grated fresh arugula lettuce | 1/2 cup chopped, sweet ripe pear | 2 tablespoons slivered almonds | vegetable oil or peanut oil, for frying | 1 -2 teaspoon chopped fresh sage
instructions: In a bowl, combine the green cardamom halves, mango, arugula, pear and almonds. Toss to blend. Heat the vegetable oil in a deep fryer to 375 degrees f. Dip the cooked lamb in the mango mixture, and sprinkle with sauteed sage. Place the dipped lamb in the oil, and repeat for 1/2 to 1 cup of lamb. Remove from oil when the lamb is crisp and golden, and drain on paper towels.

Random Ingredients: shell pasta,oil,cherry,syrup,english mustard powder,italian seasoning,topping,green chile pepper
title: Spicy Cherry Italian Shells
ingredients: 1 package shell pasta | topping : | 4 cans whole pitted cherries, drained | 1 package frozen whipped topping | toppings : | 1 jar chopped italian-style hot peppers | 1/4 cup chopped green chile peppers | 1/4 cup oil | 1/4 cup dry english-style mustard powder | 1 tablespoon dried italian seasoning
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook shell pasta at a boil, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain well. Stir cherry halves, whipped topping, sour cream, italian style hot peppers, green chile peppers, oil, mustard powder, and italian seasoning together in a large bowl.

title: English Cucumber Salad (Sbd)
ingredients: 1 can english cucumbers | 1 1/2 cups madeira cake | 1 lemonade
instructions: Combine english cucumbers and madeira in a small bowl & pour in lemonade. Cover & chill for at least 1 hour before serving. This can be made a night before & refrigerated, then just before serving, as flavor gets stronger, too.

title: Vanille Kipferl - Cherry Oat Cookies
ingredients: cooking oat | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar | 1/2 cup flour | 1/4 cup cherry preserves
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Grease cookie sheets. Mix dry ingredients in a medium bowl. Dip the cookies in the flour, then the cherry preserves. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or just until the cookies are golden.

title: Rotini With Raisins and Radishes
ingredients: 8 ounces rotini pasta | 2 cups packed slivered radishes, thin, i use french's and it comes out perfect | 1/2 cup golden raisin ( optional )
instructions: Cook the pasta until al dente. Rinse pasta in a colander.. Meanwhile, place the raisins in a pan. Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the raisins to the hot oil. Add the radishes, cover and fry until the radishes are crisp tender, about 5 minutes. Add the drained pasta to the skillet and mix well. Remove from heat. Serve hot.

title: Pear Teriyaki Sauce
ingredients: 2 pears | 1 piece gingerroot | 2 tablespoons tamari soy sauce
instructions: Peel and slice the pears. Put all ingredients into a frying pan and put on gentle heat for 5 minutes. Stir and keep on a gentle heat for another 5 - 10 minutes, or the mixture becomes dry and hard to stir. Remove from heat. Serve as a condiment on meat or vegetables.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,picante sauce,brown rice,pork butt,chili garlic sauce,corn tortilla
title: Mexican Pork Nachos
ingredients: 24 corn tortillas | 1 lb pork butt | 1 can green chilies | 8 ounces picante sauce ( mild ) | 2 tablespoons chili-garlic sauce | cooked brown rice
instructions: Brown pork in large fry pan sprayed with pam or similar product. Drain the grease and set aside. When pork is browned, remove pork from pan, add picante sauce and chili sauce. Tear off strips of meat and place on top of pork and sauce mixture, mixing well. Simmer on low til meat is soft. Remove pork from heat and stir in rice and mix until thoroughly mixed. Spoon into flour, or roll out and cut into strips. Fry in olive oil until golden brown, drain on paper towel and serve hot as an appetizer.

title: Macadamia and Tarragon Crumble Potatoes #5FIX
ingredients: 1/2 cup macadamia nuts ( toasted, about 2 ounces ) | 1/2 teaspoon tarragon | 1/2 cup sherry | 24 ounces simply potatoes starch
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Mix together the nut and tarragon in a medium sized bowl. Stir sherry into dry ingredients and set aside. Press potato slices into potato starch on baking sheet, about 3 tablespoons. Sprinkle with nut mixture. Cook in oven for 8 minutes. You may serve on a bed of savoury veggies or vegetables of your choice.

title: Tahini Pickle Spread
ingredients: 1 cup tahini | 3 -4 tablespoons radishes, finely chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons fresh lemon rind | 1/2 teaspoon paprika ( smoked if you want extra spiciness ) | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: In a small bowl, combine all ingredients. Let sit for about 10 - 15 minutes to let flavors develop.

Random Ingredients: heart palm,asafoetida powder,thyme,red chili paste,beef,iceberg lettuce,dark rum
title: Sweetheart Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1/4 cup dark rum or 1/4 cup brandy | 1/4 cup asafoetida powder ( or substitute 1/2 teaspoon green chili ) | 1/8 teaspoon thyme, leaves | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs ground beef | 1/4 red chili paste ( amount per taste ) | 1 head iceberg lettuce, washed and chopped | crushed iceberg lettuce ( optional )
instructions: Combine rum, asafetida, thyme, and pepper in bowl of food processor. Add beef and pulse til well mixed, about 30 - 40 seconds. Add chilli paste and pulse til mixed. Toss with lettuce leaves and roll up. Serve with spicy red chutney on the side.

title: Easy Broth Chicken
ingredients: 1 cup finely chopped pecans | 1/4 cup low sodium soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 4 cups cooked chicken | 1/2 cup low sodium mayonnaise | 2 1/2 cups broth | corn or wheat, for dipping
instructions: Thoroughly mix the sauce ingredients together and place in small saucepan over low heat. Heat through, stirring, but do not boil. Serve over greens, lettuce, or as a side dish with poultry, tofu or vegetables. I prefer a combination of these.

Random Ingredients: chicken broth,chilies,kumquat,arborio rice,spaghetti,pork sausage,stewing beef,spinach leaf
title: Spaetzle Soup - Zuppa Di Riso
ingredients: 1 lb pork sausage | 2 stalks fresh spinach leaves, chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried arborio rice | 1 package spaghetti or ( 1 7 ounce ) package vermicelli, broken in three pieces | 1 can chopped chilies | 4 cups chicken broth | 1 cup canned cubed stewing beef | 1/2 1/2 cup canned kumquat or 1/2 cup zucchini ( optional )
instructions: Cut pork sausage in half lengthwise.

Random Ingredients: lasagna noodle,tomato puree,vanilla extract,double cream,beef bouillon cube,celery seed
title: Lazy Lasagna
ingredients: 1 can tomato puree | 3 teaspoons dried celery seeds | 3 tablespoons instant beef bouillon cubes | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 package lasagna noodles | 2 tablespoons double cream, for each serving
instructions: Pour tomato puree into a 3 quart saucepan set over medium heat. Stir frequently to avoid burning, about 2 minutes. Stir in celery seed, beef bouillon cubes and vanilla. Bring to a boil, then stir in noodles. Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer until noodles have absorbed most of the liquid and are tender, about 20 minutes. Stir occasionally during the cooking process. Stir cream into simmering tomato mixture until well blended. Heat to boiling.

Random Ingredients: white pepper,mexican cheese,puff pastry,rye bread,pimiento,cream cheese,aubergine
title: Smoked Aubergine Sandwich
ingredients: 1 puff pastry sheet | 2 large aubergines, sliced thinly | 2 tablespoons finely chopped pimientos | 4 tablespoons cream cheese, cubed ( i use cream cheese-based equivalent ) | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon sour cream | 1/2 teaspoon mexican blend cheese, grated ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Cut 4 long sheets from the pastry leaving at least 4 inch of pastry uncovered at one edge. Line with a double thickness of foil & brush lightly with oil. Bake on a low heat for 25 - 30 minutes until the pastry is cooked but not browned. While the aubergine is cooking, heat the cream cheese in a small saucepan using the pimientos & then add the sour cream & mexican blend cheese, stirring continuously. When the mixture is warm, remove the foil & turn the heat up a bit. Slice the top from the pastry. Spread the cream cheese filling over the base of the pastry & sprinkle with white pepper & more cheese if you desire. Lay the sliced aubergines on top & cut the top to allow room for the filling to penetrate. Carefully slice the pastry into four triangles & put them under the grill or a broiler to brown the edges. Alternatively, place the triangles on a cookie sheet lined with baking paper to set. Heat the grill / grill / broiler to 500 f / 180°c, then cook the triangles briefly for 2 - 3 minutes or until the cheese on top and the aubergines are crisp. Remove them from the grill, & allow them rest for about 10 minutes. Slice the slices & serve with a side of french or italian bread & your favourite salad.

Random Ingredients: part ricotta cheese,cream mushroom soup,sherry,dark corn syrup,cucumber,seasoning salt,artichoke heart
title: Artichoke Hearts in Creamer-Soy Sauce
ingredients: 3 packages frozen artichoke hearts | 3 containers part-skim ricotta cheese | 1 1/2 cups sour cream ( light or fat free ) | 1/2 lb. frozen sliced cucumbers | 2 tablespoons dark corn syrup | 3/4 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup
instructions: Cook artichoke hearts according to package instructions, cool thoroughly. Heat oven to 325°f remove artichoke hearts from bag.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,celeriac,strawberry jam,alfalfa sprout,buttermilk,red pepper,nam pla,chipotle powder
title: Namiche Cilantro's Strawberry Cheese Dip
ingredients: 2 teaspoons nam pla | 1/4 cup crushed roasted red pepper | 1/4 cup buttermilk | 500 g monterey jack cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup strawberry jam | 1 1/4 cups alfalfa sprouts | 1 teaspoon chile powder | 1 teaspoon chipotle powder
instructions: Combine nam pla and roasted red pepper, mix well. Spread in the bottom of a glass pie dish or crock of a medium sized serving dish. Layer monterey jack cheese, sprouts, chile powder, chipsotle powder and the melted melted cheese. Place in preheated 475f oven until bubbly and hot.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,herbes de provence,parmesan cheese,jicama,cooking oil
title: Jicama Salad
ingredients: 4 small jicama | 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 1 teaspoon dried herbes de provence ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon chili powder | 1/4 cup parmesan cheese, grated
instructions: Peel the jicama and cut into 1/4 1/2 inch slices. Place in a bowl with the cooking oil, herbes de provence and chilli powder. Toss well. Fold in parmesan cheese until melted. Cover with plastic wrap and place in the refrigerator until served.

title: Mock Devonshire Mustard and Rice
ingredients: 2 -3 tablespoons dijon mustard | 2 -3 cups cooked long-grain white rice or 2 -3 cups cooked long-grain white rice
instructions: Combine mustard and rice in a serving dish. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: anise oil,extra beef,rice wine vinegar,green enchilada sauce
title: Fiesta Beef Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs extra lean ground beef | 11 ounces green enchilada sauce | 1/2 cup rice wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon anise oil
instructions: In a skillet over medium low heat, cook beef until well browned. Drain and set aside. In a medium bowl, combine enchilada sauce and rice wine vinegar. Mix well and pour over the beef in skillet. Bring to a boil over medium high heat. After 10 minutes, reduce heat to low and simmer for an additional 10 minutes. Remove from heat and allow to cool slightly before proceeding. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Serve with your favorite tortillas.

Random Ingredients: pistachio,red bell pepper,cumin powder,stout beer,butter,cremini mushroom
title: Seared Mushrooms With Red Pepper Puree
ingredients: 10 ounces cremini mushrooms | 2 tablespoons butter | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 tablespoon pistachios | 1 small red bell pepper | 8 ounces stout beer
instructions: In a large skillet add 2 tbsp butter, 1/2 tsp cumin, 2 tbsp pistachios, 1 red bell pepper and the rest of the pistachios. Saute together until the ingredients soften up about 3 - 5 minutes. Take out and set aside in a bowl. Take care to retain all the cooking liquid. Save leftover liquid. Clean mushrooms in water bath then set aside in a bowl. In the same skillet add 2 tbsp butter and 1/4 tsp cumin and saute the mushrooms until dark colored. Add ½ cup of the reserved cooking liquid. When liquid is absorbed add mushroom mixture to skillet. Let boil for 2 minutes then remove from the heat. Pour into serving bowl and garnish with remaining pistachios and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,adobo seasoning,caster sugar,sherry wine,self raising flour,guava,brown button mushroom
title: Guava Mushroom and Mushroom Bites
ingredients: 2 cups self-raising flour | 1/4 cup caster sugar | 1/4 cup chopped guava | 2 tablespoons dry sherry wine | 25 g brown button mushrooms | 1/4 cup heavy cream, lightly whipped
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c line a baking tray with baking paper, then lightly grease with butter. Put the flour, sugar, guava, sherry and mushrooms in a bowl and season with salt and pepper. Mix well. Make a well in the centre of the mixture and pour in the cream. Mix till just combined, then spoon into large, round, grease free plastic bag. Cut a small hole in each corner. Squeeze out extra air and ensure bag is well in the space. Put bag on top of a tray of hot water, then pop it into the oven and bake for 15 - 20 minutes or until browned and tj marks appear. Remove from oven and cool for 5 minutes in the bag. Invert onto a plate. If your fingers hurt during this, cut a slash in the centre to help loosen the bread. Serve with fresh fruit, tea or chips.

title: Chipotle Spiced Heirloom Sweet Spiced Heirloom Sausag
ingredients: 3 links sweet italian sausage | 2 tablespoons black peppercorns, cracked | 1 pinch dried chipotle chile, or more to taste | 1/2 cup sparkling water | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa | 2 lemons, juiced | 2 teaspoons kosher salt, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Rub one side of each sausage link with cracked pepper and dried chipotle chili pepper. Place sausage links onto a baking sheet. Bake in preheated oven until the sausage has cooked through and the peppers have turned a deep golden brown color, 7 to 10 hours.

title: Green Onion Jam
ingredients: 3 bunches green onions | 2 cans fruit preserves
instructions: Wash green onions and slice thick. Place in large kettle and add preserves. Pour in enough water to cover and bring to boil.

title: Cheddar & Smoked Kielbasa Sandwiches
ingredients: 5 kielbasa, thinly sliced | 1 bottle tangerine juice | 1/2 cup thinly sliced smoked salmon | 1 tablespoon minced garlic | 1/2 cup coarsely grated cheddar cheese | lemon twist
instructions: Arrange kielbasa in a single layer on a plate.

title: Halloween Veggies
ingredients: 12 ounces frozen mixed vegetables ( or more ) | 2 cans chickpeas ( drained weight ) | 1 medium yellow bell pepper ( finely chopped ) | 1 tablespoon table salt ( or less ) | 1 can corn niblets
instructions: Thaw mixed vegetables overnight. When fresh vegetables are thawed, transfer to a large casserole or heavy duty stockpot. Rinse the chickpeas. Place in microwave safe bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Microwave on high power for 30 seconds on high, then turn off microwave, open and allow to sit 5 minutes. Drain the water out of the cans and combine with the salt and corn or veggies. Add the peas, bell pepper and mix well. Cover and refrigerate overnight to marinate. Bring to a boil, then turn heat to low and cover the casserole tightly. Allow to stay heated throughout and heat through, about 25 - 30 minutes.

title: Coleslaw With Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 package fresh shredded coleslaw mix or ( 12 ounce ) package mixed salad greens | 3 tablespoons finely chopped tarragon leaves | 3 tablespoons butter or 3 tablespoons margarine, melted | 1 teaspoon sugar | 2 pork tenderloins or 2 pork loin steaks, cut into slices about 1/4 inch thick | 1/4 cup olive oil
instructions: Prepare the beef and pork.

title: A Jook
ingredients: 1/2 cup ice water | 1/3 cup beef broth | 1 pinch ajinomoto ( dried chilies ) | 1 1/2 cups mixed fruit cocktail
instructions: Mash the chilies with the beef broth and dissolved ajinomoto into it. Mix with the mixed fruit cocktail and serve. Note, if you can make a jook instead, this will give you 1 cup of mixed fruit cocktail.

title: Lamb Temptation
ingredients: 2 lamb, leg pieces | 250 g canadian bacon, chopped | 1 teaspoon chili oil | 1 teaspoon brown sugar | 1 tablespoon canadian bacon, drained
instructions: Remove most of the visible fat from the lamb. If there is any visible fat, remove the excess fat. Cut the lamb leg into 1 wide strips. Place the piece of lamb in a non metal bowl and sprinkle with the chopped Canadian bacon, chilli oil and brown sugar. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and put in the refrigerator until needed. When ready to cook, heat the canadian bacon in a large frying pan or in a fryng pan. Remove the lamb from the refrigerator, drain the bacon, pat dry and brown the lamb on all sides.

title: Toasted Mushrooms With Topping
ingredients: 1 cup toasted graham cracker crumbs | 8 ounces fresh button mushrooms | 2 teaspoons finely grated fresh cheese
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees. Line baking sheet with parchment paper. In medium bowl, toss mushrooms with toasted graham cracker crumbs. Spoon about 2 tablespoons of mushroom mixture onto prepared sheet of parchment paper. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake 10 minutes. Serve warm or room temperature.

title: Crispy Pistachios
ingredients: 1/2 cup coarsely chopped pistachios | 1 1/2 teaspoons caraway seeds
instructions: Place pistachios in a saucepan.

title: Scottish Crumbed Chicken
ingredients: 1 pint malt vinegar | 250 g chicken | 1 teaspoon ground mace | 250 g smoked sausage, cut into 1cm cubes | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1/4 cup crushed cracker crumbs
instructions: Place the malt vinegar, chicken, mace and sausage in an ovenproof dish and cover with foil. Set aside for an hour. Heat the oil in a frying pan, and fry the chicken for about 10 minutes each side until golden brown. Serve with gravy or steamed vegetables.

Random Ingredients: orange zest,corn flake,italian spice,curry,hot chili powder,milk chocolate chip
title: Indian Chocolate Pie
ingredients: 1 box corn flakes ( i use frozen corn flakes ) | 1/2 cup milk chocolate chips | 1 tablespoon curry | 1 teaspoon hot chili powder ( or less to your liking ) | 1 dash zest | 1 dash italian spices
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and put in a medium sized pie plate. Cook at 350°f for 30 - 40 minutes until melted and browned on top. Serve warm.

title: Rice Salad
