ingredients: 1 cup short-grain rice, rinse well | 3 1/2 tablespoons cointreau liqueur or 3 1/2 tablespoons other orange-flavored liqueur | 1/2 cup drained raisins ( or your favourite golden raisins ) | 1/4 cup chilled cointreau liqueur or 1/4 cup other orange-flavored liqueur | 1/2 lemon, juice of
instructions: Put the rice in a bowl, and pour over the cointreau and 1 tablespoon of the cointreau.

Random Ingredients: seasoning salt,white sugar,parmigiano reggiano cheese,mandarin orange,tea
title: Mandarin Tea
ingredients: 1/3 cup strong tea ( such as irish breakfast ) | 1/2 cup white sugar | 1 tablespoon dried mandarin oranges ( julienned ) | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 tablespoon grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Bring the tea, sugar, mandarin oranges, and seasoned salt to a boil in a saucepan over high heat. Reduce heat to medium low, cover the pan, and simmer until the tea has turned thickened, about 3 minutes. Remove from the heat, and stir in the parmigiano reggiano cheese. Let cool, then refrigerate until cold, at least 1 hour. Spoon into cups to serve.

title: Pressed Nuts With Capicola and Hiccupine
ingredients: 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 tablespoon mixed fresh herbs | 2 ounces capicola, cut into thin 1 1/2-inch long slices | 14 ounces salted green olives, coarsely chopped | 2 slices italian bread, about 1-inch thick, crust trimmed, cut into 1/3-inch wide slices ( about 4 slices per slice ) | 1 tablespoon nam pla ( fish sauce )
instructions: Heat 1 1/2 tablespoons oil in a 12 inch heavy frying pan over moderately high heat until hot but not smoking, then fry the herbs, capicola, olives, and bread, stirring, until the bread is golden brown and crusty, about 1 minute. Transfer the toasted bread slices to warm plates. Drizzle half of the oil and 1 1/2 teaspoon salt into the pan. Working quickly and carefully, in batches of 4, cook the nuts, turning once, until golden brown and heated through, about 3 minutes total. Transfer the nuts to a platter and sprinkle with the remaining 1 teaspoon salt and the fish sauce. Serve each piece of the nuts hot or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: poblano pepper,raspberry,cottage cheese,dark chocolate,baking soda,tangerine,white pearl onion,red bell pepper
title: Choclo Poblano
ingredients: 1 tablespoon baking soda | 1 lb white pearl onion ( about 4 medium ) | 1 lb fresh raspberry | 1 tablespoon chopped canned tangerine | 1 large poblano pepper, seeded, minced ( may sub anaheim if desired ) | 1/2 cup dry red bell pepper | 1/2 lb cottage cheese | 10 ounces frozen raspberries
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f. Combine baking soda with onion and cook over medium heat until golden brown. Stir often. Transfer to large bowl. In 4 x3 inch glass baking dish, add onions and raspberries. Sprinkle with baking soda mixture. Arrange in 2 rows on top of onions. Sprinkle zest of 1 tangerine over raisins. Add remaining poblano pepper, pepper and tangerine juice in small dish. Place dish in oven and bake 20 to 25 minutes or until berries are tender. Let stand 10 minutes. Place cottage and remaining juice in heatproof measuring cup. Cover and heat in microwave, stirring every now and then 5 to 6 minutes, until warm. Add to onions. Top with raspberries and bake until topping is lightly browned and berries are tender. If making ahead, cover and let cool completely. Just before serving, remove poblanos. Remove seeds and ribs. Remove skin and membranes before slicing.

title: Crazy Raspberry Glazed Cod Fillets
ingredients: 800 g fish fillets | 3 tablespoons raspberry preserves ( your choice ) | 50 g vanilla sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees celsius. Line a baking tray with baking parchment. Take the fillets and cut them lengthways. Place on baking tray and brush with raspberry preserves. Sprinkle with vanilla sugar. Bake for 20 minutes, or until crisp and golden. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon,salad dressing,vanilla bean,maraschino cherry,seasoning salt
title: Cherry Dressing - Low Fat and No Fat
ingredients: 3 tablespoons salad dressing | 1/4 cup chicken bouillon, granules dissolved in | 1/4 cup fresh maraschino cherry, chopped | 1/2 cup reduced-fat dried cranberry and chutney or 1/2 cup reduced fat sugar and 1/2 cup marianara dressing | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: Whisk together the salad dressing, bouillon granules and cherry crumbs in a small bowl. Season with seasoned salt. Serve topped with sweet croutons, fresh grated parmesan or pecorino cheese.

title: Spinach With Irish Whiskey
ingredients: 6 cups baby spinach ( fresh or frozen ) | 2 tablespoons chili powder | 1/3 cup cider vinegar | 1/3 cup dry white wine | 1/2 cup brewed tea
instructions: Place spinach in a heavy large pot or saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring to a boil over high heat. Cook, covered, for 2 minutes, then drain. Wipe off excess water, then set greens on a serving platter or chopping board. Blend chili powder, vinegar, wine and tea. Pour over greens to serve.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,italian seasoning,ghee,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Easy Queso Sauce
ingredients: 1/3 cup ghee | 1/8 cup chopped green chili pepper | 1/2 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1/2 cup of grated sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Saute the ghee and green chili pepper till the aroma begins to get stronger. Add italian seasoning. Saute the cheese till it melts. Cool it. To use, melt in a blender till smooth. Add salt/chili powder. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: barbecue sauce,corn tortilla,salt,vanilla extract,vegetable broth,dungeness crabmeat,red cherry pepper,chili
title: Barbecue Crab Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 lb dungeness crabmeat | 1 cup vegetable broth or 1 cup chicken broth | 1 package corn tortillas | 4 tablespoons barbecue sauce | 1 teaspoon finely chopped chili | 2 tablespoons barbecue sauce | 2 teaspoons chili power or 2 teaspoons vanilla extract | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 1/2 cup red bell pepper, diced or 1/2 cup pickled red pepper, in a few pieces
instructions: Mix crab meat with remaining ingredients. Cook about 20 minutes in hot vegetable broth until the consistency of heavy cream. Add some more salt and blend well. Place one tortilla in a shallow casserole dish and pour some of the sauce over it. Roll up the enchilada. Repeat the layers, starting with sauce and ending with sauce. Dip into remaining sauce and place on platter. Serve with other accompaniments.

title: Fava Bean Salad (Fava Beans Salad)
ingredients: 1 lb dried fava beans | 1 package cream cheese | 1 bunch lettuce, chopped | 1 package tomatillos, chopped | 1 - 1 1/2 cup mirin | 1 tablespoon seasoning salt ( or salt substitute ) | 1 cup greek yogurt
instructions: Rinse and pick through the favas if available. Soak overnight in cool water, this will aid the fermentation process. Drain and remove the outer layers. Mix together the beans and enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer. Cook 3 - 5 minutes or until all the water is absorbed and the beans soft. Drain the beans, and reserve. Combine the cream cheese, lettuce, tomatillos, and mirin. Add the cooled bean/cheese mixture to the cream cheese mixture, and stir until combined. Cover and chill in the refrigerator at least 1 hour or overnight. Serve with a dollop of greek yogurt on top.

title: Italian Pepperoni Beans
ingredients: 1 bag fresh pepperoni, cut in half | 1 can red beans ( drained and rinsed )
instructions: Soak the pepperoni whole in water for 30 minutes to remove some of the bitterness. Put pepperoni into a food processor and process it for about 30 seconds or until fine. Then drain the pepperoni. Put the peppers and pepperoni and 2 or 3 tablespoons of bean liquid into a large saucepan, and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat and simmer for about 15 minutes. Serve.

title: Mascarpone Mornay
ingredients: 1/2 bunch fresh mazure sardine ( sardines ) | 6 tablespoons margarine | 1 cup vegetable stock | 1 1/2 cups thickened cream yoghurt | 2 tablespoons poppy seeds | 5 ounces egg noodles
instructions: Heat oven to 325 degrees f and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Cut the sardines into 1 inch pieces. Heat the margarine, stock and poppy seeds in a medium, ovenproof frying pan until the mornay cooks, stirring now and then and adding the yoghurt. Simmer for 5 minutes then remove from the heat. Transfer the mornay to the prepared baking sheet, spreading it to coat. Roast in the preheated oven for 25 to 30 minutes, stirring now and then, until golden.

title: Irish Parsnips - Parsnips in Cream
ingredients: 1 kg parsnip | 3 chicken bouillon cubes | 3 tablespoons single cream | 1 teaspoon cardamom pod, cracked
instructions: Wash, peel and cut the parsnips in very thin slices. Place in saucepan with water add bouillon, parsnips and cardamom pods and simmer 10 - 15 minutes. Stir frequently. Remove from pan and stir in cream. Chill at least 4 hours.

title: Ribatoni and Pasta with Vodka Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 2 cups arborio rice | 2 1/2 cups ice | 2 1/2 cups vodka | 1 box rigatoni pasta
instructions: Whisk together mayonnaise and mustard. Slowly whisk in rice until mixed thoroughly. Pour into a 2 quart pan and stir in the ice and vodka. Cover with plastic wrap and freeze until completely solid, at least an hour. After thawing, toss with the rigatoni, and serve.

title: Peanut Rice With Parsnips (Yumurti Paratha)
ingredients: 1 kg parsnip, with stem | 1 large pinch saffron strand, crushed | 1/2 cup raw unsalted dry-roasted peanuts | 1 box long-grain rice
instructions: Wash parsnips thoroughly. Using a sharp knife, peel and cut into 5 cm lengths. Rinse salt from parsnips well, drain well and remove strings. Cut parsnips in 5 cm lengths. Place parsnips, saffron, peanuts, and 2 cups water in a pan.

title: Vegetarian Burritos
ingredients: 2 burrito-size flour tortillas | 1/4 cup chopped nuts ( optional ) | 1/4 cup instant tea ( i use decaf )
instructions: Heat the oven to 400 degrees. Lightly grease the tortillas. Place the tortillas on a plate and microwave for 15 seconds, turning once. Spread a tablespoon of tea on the one tortilla. Top with 2 or 3 tablespoons of nutmeats if using. Roll and eat on one or two separate plates.

Random Ingredients: cheddar cheese,chicken thigh,snow pea,anaheim chilies,fig,ancho chile powder,spaghetti,yellow pepper
title: Mexican Pizza Soup With Chicken
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless chicken thighs | 6 slices cheddar cheese or 6 slices monterey jack cheese | 12 ounces snow peas or 12 ounces green beans, ends trimmed | 1 small yellow pepper, seeded and cut into bite-size cubes | 1/3 ancho chile powder | 1/3 chile powder, more if desired | 1 can sliced chardigs, in a squeeze bottle ( optional ) | 8 dried yellow chilies, seeded and torn into bite-size pieces ( fresh or bottled ) | 14 1/2 ounces spaghetti | 1 - 1 1/2 ounce dried figs, stems removed
instructions: Pierce chicken thighs with a fork or fork and arrange on a platter. Cover with cheese and refrigerate until serving time. Place snow peas on the rack in a broilerproof glass baking dish and sprinkle with both chile powders. Broil or grill chicken 12 minutes, turning once. Cool slightly.

title: Pesto Glaze Cookies
ingredients: 1 2/3 cups cake flour, sifted and all | 3 tablespoons cake flour, sifted | 1/3 - 1/2 cup prepared pesto sauce ( commercial is best! )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. In the bowl of an electric mixer fitted with the bowl of a stand mixer, combine 1 2/3 cup cake flour and 1/3 cup cake flour and mix. Stir in pesto until mixture forms stiff dough.

title: Cherry Blossom Pie Shell
ingredients: 1 pie shell, baked | 1 can red cherry peppers, drained | 1 teaspoon crushed corn flakes
instructions: Place red cherries in pastry shell. Sprinkle with crushed corn flakes. Bake on medium low oven for about 45 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Pan-Fried Salmon With Yeast
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups warm orange juice or 1 1/2 cups warm water | 1/2 teaspoon active dry yeast | 1/2 teaspoon orange zest, cut into 2 pieces
instructions: In a small bowl, combine all ingredients. Set aside and allow to ferment in a warm area for 30 minutes, or until frothy but not bubbly, stirring occasionally. Preheat oven to 400f degrees. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Place the salmon fillets in the center of the baking sheet. Pour remaining sauce over the salmon, leaving about 1 1/2 inches of the salmon exposed to the baking sheet. Cover with the prepared pan. Bake in oven for 15 minutes, then remove from oven and turn the oven to broil. Broil salmon for 7 - 10 minutes on each side for pink color and body, or until the skin begins to flake. Or you can remove the pan and bake salmon right away on the pan for a crisp, brown and somewhat crisp finish with a crisp crisp crisp, brown and somewhat crispy finish with a crisp, brown and slightly crisp finish, and slightly crisp finish with a crisp, brown and slightly crisp finish. You may serve a salmon fillet with a gravy and fresh vegetables, or if you like a more authentic recipe, you can serve the salmon on a platter with a little butter and butter and serve the pan fries.

title: Pasta and Cucumber Sauce
ingredients: 200 g spaghetti | 200 g cucumbers | 200 g penne, cooked
instructions: Put your spaghetti into boiling water. In a frying pan, add oil, and cook the spaghetti until al dente'. Add cucumbers and cook until cucumbers. Drain spaghetti, add sauce and add your pasta to skillet to coat. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: green bean,white wine,rump steak,fish sauce,espresso powder,peanut sauce,purpose flour,white bean
title: Beef and Bean Stir Fry
ingredients: 1/2 lb thinly sliced peeled rump steak | 1/4 lb fresh green beans, trimmed | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | 1 teaspoon instant espresso powder | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 1 tablespoon white wine or 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar | 3 tablespoons peanut sauce | 1/2 can white beans, rinsed and drained
instructions: Combine steak, beans, flour, and instant espresso in processor.

Random Ingredients: paprika,tortilla,hot water,tomatillo,cauliflower floret,green capsicum,white wine vinegar
title: Cauliflower and Green Capsicum With Tomatillo Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 head cauliflower floret | 1/2 green capsicum | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons paprika | 2 tablespoons hot water | 1 package tortillas | 400 g chopped tomatoes with tomatillos
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Place the cauliflower and green capsicum on a baking sheet and bake in preheated oven for about 10 minutes or until tender. Cool. Chop into pieces and place into a bowl. Combine vinegar and paprika and stir well. Rinse tomatillo sauce jar and heat on the stove top, pour over cauliflower mixture and mix well. Transfer to a shallow ovenproof casserole dish and bake uncovered in middle of oven for 10 - 15 minutes or until the sauce has reduced. Heat tortillas in a pan or skillet. Spread about 3 tablespoons of the sauce over 3 tortillas and scatter with tomato.

title: Leek & Leek Ice Cream
ingredients: 250 g leeks | 500 ml double cream
instructions: Finely grate leeks using a fine grater. Grate 2tbsp grated leek and mix with half of the grated leeks to make the leek & leek paste. Spoon into a greased 8 inch pie pan, pressing down firmly. Bake in a moderate oven for about 35 mins until softened. Let cool slightly then freeze in a freezer bag for up to 2 months. Defrost in the fridge, then place in a freezer container and freeze for up to 2 months. Once frozen remove from freezer, scrape out any remaining juice and slice into 1/2 cm thickness. Place in an ice cream maker, return to freezer and churn until smooth. Serve with ice cream.

title: Smoked Salmon With Veggies and Brats (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 11)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon reduced sodium soy sachet vegan margarine, melted | 2 teaspoons nutritional yeast | 250 g smoked salmon fillet, coarsely chopped | 400 g portabella mushrooms, thickly sliced | 1 large red cabbage ( or 2 150 grams cored capsicum ) | 25 g salted cashews
instructions: Preheat wok over high. Add margarine, nutritional yeast and mushrooms to pan and sauté until mushrooms are golden, stir in the cabbage, mushrooms and fish. Place over medium high heat, stir to combine and then add cashews. Cook until cashews turn golden, serve.

title: Quick  Oatmeal  Vegetable Pudding With a Twist
ingredients: 2 cups oatmeal | 1 orange and 2 lemon juice, zest of | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 2 tablespoons kalamata olives or 2 tablespoons other oil | 1 medium turnip ( medium or dark green )
instructions: In a large bowl, mix the oatmeal with spices, a bit of salt and juice from two small lemon squirts of olive oil.

title: Yogurt Cheese (Tikka)
ingredients: 250 g plain yogurt | cooking spray
instructions: Combine the yogurt and cooking spray in a bowl and mix to combine. Serve at once or store in a sealed container up to one week.

Random Ingredients: chili seasoning mix,tomato puree,iceberg lettuce,baking potato,baby carrot,vegan butter,poppy seed
title: Potato, Carrot and Poppy Seed Pizza
ingredients: 1 baking potato, peeled and cut into 6 wedges | 2 teaspoons vegetable oil or 2 teaspoons sunflower oil | 1 package vegan seasoning mix | 1/2 cup tomato puree | 1 cup shredded iceberg lettuce | 10 ounces baby carrots, trimmed, halved lengthways | 2 teaspoons poppy seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Place potato wedges on a baking tray and drizzle with oil.

title: Totally Twisted Gruyere and White Glaze. by Betty Webb
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dark corn syrup | 6 fluid ounces brewed tea ( i use decaf ) | 12 ounces gruyere cheese, shredded
instructions: Combine the dark corn syrup and the brewed tea. Heat the mixture over low heat until it begins to bubble and thickens slightly.

title: Lobster Betty's Easy and Tasty Lobster Tarts
ingredients: 12 tart shells | 3/4 cup lobster meat | 2 tablespoons superfine sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Fill tart shells with lobster meat and sprinkle with sugar. Bake in the preheated oven 15 minutes. Let cool for 5 minutes then serve.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour tortilla,red curry paste,graham cracker crumb,wasabi paste,corn cob
title: Wasabi Corn
ingredients: 1/2 cup wasabi paste | 12 ounces corn on the cob, husks removed | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 2 tablespoons graham cracker crumbs | 1 corn on the cob ( optional ) | 1/4 cup graham cracker crumbs ( optional )
instructions: Heat wasabi paste in a small amount of water until warm. Cut corn from cob and discard the husks and the cob tops. Chop the corn from the cob. Combine wasabi paste and half of the graham cracker crumbs. Sprinkle the corn with the graham cracker crumbs. Place the corn into a 9x13 glass baking dish, top with wasabi paste and remaining cheese. Bake at 350 degrees f. For approximately 40 minutes, or until the cheese is starting to brown.

title: Champinones De Franconis (Mushroom Noodle Soup)
ingredients: 1 quart boiling water | 1 lb dried buckwheat noodles | 3 tablespoons whiskey | 3 tablespoons liquid honey | 1/2 cup finely chopped onion | 1/4 cup finely chopped parsnip ( or a 1/4-1/2/3 cup of parsley ) | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh mushrooms
instructions: Soak buckwheat noodles at least 8 hours, stirring each day, for 24 hours. In a large pot of boiling water, add the noodles and cook till tender.

Random Ingredients: italian seasoning,white fish fillet,irish cream,lime juice,coriander powder,pimiento
title: Baked Fish With Irish Cream
ingredients: 2 white fish fillets | 10 -12 tablespoons irish cream | 2 tablespoons lime juice | 1 tablespoon pimiento | 1/4 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 teaspoon dried italian seasoning
instructions: Place fish fillets in baking dish, with a liberal amount of sauce and cover with extra sauce. Bake in a moderate oven, 350f for 1 1/2 & 20 - 30 minutes. Whisk together all ingredients. Serve in a gravy boat.

title: Noodles With Golden Syrup (Microwave)
ingredients: 1/2 cup golden syrup | 1 cup uncooked rice noodles, broken into 2 inch pieces | 1/4 cup minced anaheim chili ( optional )
instructions: Combine syrup and noodles in medium bowl. Cover and microwave on high power 2 minutes or until hot. Stir. Spread noodles on serving plate. Top with chili, if using.

title: Matzoh Cake
ingredients: 4 cups matzo meal | 1 1/2 cups molasses | 4 1/2 teaspoons chili flakes | 4 1/2 teaspoons ground turmeric | 2 limes, zested and juiced | 1 lb uncooked shell pasta
instructions: Cook and cook matzoh meal according to package directions. Drain and set aside. In a large bowl, combine matzoh meal with molasses, chili flakes, turmeric and lime zest. Stir in cooked matzoh meal, leaving a light coating of molasses. Bring a large pot of salted water to boil. Add pasta and cook until al dente, about 15 minutes. Drain well and spread into a large 10 inch springform pan. Smooth top of pan. Serve warm.

title: Cheater's Easy Chicken and Potato Wedges
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs idaho potatoes, peeled and sliced lengthwise into 1/4-inch wide wedges | 1/2 cup chicken or 1/2 cup beef gravy or 1/2 cup gravy powder
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. In a large bowl, toss the potatoes with the gravy until they are coated well with the gravy. Spread out on a rimmed baking sheet. Bake for 20 minutes, or until the potatoes are browned and the tops have given off an aroma and are tender. Variation, use cooked peeled chicken or beef.

title: Yummy Vegetarian Refried Beans & Refried Beans!
ingredients: 1 cup dried cannellini beans | 1 cup roasted red capsicum | 1 cup frozen mixed vegetables | 2 teaspoons garlic ( or equivalent ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda ( optional ) | 2 serrano peppers
instructions: Soak beans in enough cold water to cover by 5 inches for 6 hours, or overnight if desired. Drain beans. Combine all ingredients, except salt and pepper, together and toss to mix. Allow sit at room temperature until beans are heated up. Add salt and pepper to taste, and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: kiwi fruit,yellow bell pepper,port wine,lettuce,italian parsley
title: Spicy Kiwi Salad
ingredients: 2 kiwi fruits, peeled and sliced | 1/2 yellow bell pepper, cut into 1/4 inch strips | 1/2 cup chopped italian parsley | 1 cup chopped lettuce | 1/2 cup port wine
instructions: Combine kiwifruit, yellow bell pepper, parsley, lettuce, and port on a serving platter. Sprinkle with additional wine and serve.

title: Creamy Chilled Canadian Burger
ingredients: 2 slices lean hamburger | 2 slices ripe bananas | 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: In a large skillet, toast the burger. Remove from skillet and set aside on paper towels to drain excess fat. In a small bowl, chop the bananas and set aside. Place the skillet back on its medium high heat. Place the ground burger into the skillet. Sprinkle with sun dried tomatoes and ground cardamom, and cook until toasted, about 2 minutes. Using a medium high heat source, add all of the burger mixture. Cook to desired thickness, about 4 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Pita Chips
ingredients: 1 bag baby spinach | 1 parsnip | 1/2 yellow pepper | 1 tablespoon catsup | 4 tablespoons catalina sandwich spreadable cheese | 2 cans pita bread | parsley ( flat leaf )
instructions: Cook baby spinach, parsnip and yellow pepper in boiling water til veggies are tender crisp. Drain well and transfer to food processor. Add catsup, cheese and pita crisps. Process until chips are well mixed. Place chips on serving platter and garnish with parsley.

Random Ingredients: sherry,horseradish,xanthan gum,hot paprika,bamboo shoot,mcvites digestive biscuit,baking potato
title: Baked Baked Horseradish and Vegetable Patties
ingredients: 8 -10 fresh mcvites digestive biscuits ( or other flavourful biscuits ) | 125 g canned mixed vegetables ( any type, such as broccoli, mushrooms, chilli ) | 1 small baking potato, cut into small cubes | 1/2 cup canned bamboo shoot | 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 2 teaspoons hot paprika | 1/2 teaspoon xanthan gum ( optional ) | 1/4 cup pickled horseradish ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven ot 200°c mix all ingredients in a large, ovenproof bowl. Put the biscuits in a single layer onto a baking tray lined with parchment paper or baking paper. Put into the centre of the oven and roast for about 40 minutes. Or until golden brown and crispy but not burnt. Serve with pickled horseradish for dipping if desired.

Random Ingredients: red chilies,taco seasoning mix,marsala wine,red potato
title: Taco Potatoes
ingredients: 8 large red potatoes, cleaned | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning mix | 1 teaspoon crushed red chilies | 1/4 cup marsala wine
instructions: Peel potatoes and cut into large chunks. Place potatoes chunks in a large bowl, add remaining ingredients and mix together. Spray frying pan with pam. Put contents of bowl into frying pan and turn on high heat. Once bottom of pan is nice and hot, add meat. Leave until browned then flip over and put potatoes back on top. Let sit until meat browns and potatoes brown all over.

title: Candied Squash
ingredients: 1 lb squash | 4 ounces bittersweet chocolate
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f peel the squash, trim and discard the stem. Cut each in half and scoop out the seeds and string, and place the squash in a medium bowl. Toss with the chocolate. Place on a foil lined baking sheet, and coat with cooking spray. Bake for about 15 minutes or until firm.

title: Homemade Softened Oaxacan Coleslaw With Lime
ingredients: 1/4 cup finely shredded cabbage leaves | 1 1/2 tablespoons coarse crushed ice ( about 5 1/2 tablespoons ) | lime wedge ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in medium bowl. Cover and chill until serving. Divide coleslaw among 6 plates or bowls and serve with lime wedges.

title: Quick and Simple Romaine Salpicao
ingredients: 2 cups milk | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 2 heads romaine lettuce or 2 heads butter lettuce
instructions: Bring milk and oregano to simmering in a medium saucepan. Turn to low and simmer for 10 minutes. Place 2 cups cooked milk and romaine in a large bowl and gently knead until mixed. Divide greens among 4 plates and top with warm milk mixture.

title: Beef and Corn Loaf
ingredients: 6 lbs beef chuck, trimmed of fat | 1 box frozen corn, thawed | 24 ounces frozen coarsley chopped coarsley chopped corn | 6 -8 garlic heads, with top | crusty loaf bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees. Heat a skillet over medium high heat. Add chuck and brown on all sides, about 10 minutes. Transfer chuck to a jellyroll pan large enough to hold it in two layers. Add 1 package of frozen corn, coarsley chopped coarsley chopped coarsley corn, and garlic heads. Stir to combine. Spread mixture evenly over the chuck. Cover pan tightly with foil. Bake until meat thermometer inserted in center of meat reads at least 160 degrees, about 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: macadamia nut oil,graham cracker crumb,lemon pepper,margarine,cardamom pod,fennel seed,salt,pomegranate juice
title: Macadamia Nut Balls
ingredients: 4 cups graham cracker crumbs | 1/2 cup margarine, melted | 1 cup pomegranate juice ( see note ) | 2 cups pomegranate seeds ( see note ) | 1/3 cup ground macadamia nuts | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 1 teaspoon lemon peppercorns or 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom pod ( optional )
instructions: Line cookie sheet with parchment paper. In medium bowl, toss the graham cracker crumbs with melted margarine. Toast in preheated 325 degree oven until golden brown, about 12 minutes. Pour in pomegranate juice, nuts, salt, peppercorn, cardamom, and lemon pepper, and mix well. Set aside and allow to cool. Make small balls with a golf ball sized piece of dough. Store in airtight container.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach,jasmine rice,thai fish sauce,vodka,sage,white wine
title: Portobello (Thai Savory Noodle and Spinach)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried sage, or more to taste | 1 pound baby spinach | 1/4 cup vodka | 2 tablespoons thai fish sauce | 1 1/2 cups white wine | 2 cups cooked jasmine rice
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium heat. Stir sage, and let it cool slightly, about 30 seconds. Place spinach and 1/4 cup vodka into a blender or food processor, and process until blended. Stir fish sauce, wine, and remaining vodka together in the skillet.

title: Hot Beans & Peppers
ingredients: 2 cups pinto beans, boiled | 1/4 bell pepper ( chopped ) | 1/4 chili paste, in oil ( kochi ) | 1/4 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Saute bell pepper and chili paste together till cooked through. Add the beans and mix with the rest of the ingredients. Serve with rice or noodles.

title: Spiced Honey Drumsticks
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken wings, separated at joints but whole skin removed | 6 cloves, minced | 2 teaspoons garam masala | 1/2 cup mexican cheese, shredded | 2 cups egg wash
instructions: Place wings in large dutch oven or flameproof bowl. Sprinkle with salt. Add 1/2 cups water.

title: Pork Pie
ingredients: 1 cup dry vermicelli, broken | 1 boneless pork shoulder | 12 large eggs | 1 cup buttermilk | 1 box refrigerated pie shells, pie crusts | 1 1/4 cups ricotta cheese | lettuce
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook vermicelli in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm, about 6 minutes. Drain and press noodles through a colander. Cut pork into 1 inch chunks. Place pork and eggs in a large skillet over medium heat, and cook and stir until pork is no longer pink. Drain excess grease. Beat buttermilk and ricotta cheese together in a large glass or metal mixing bowl until creamy. Fold egg mixture into pork mixture, then pour into prepared pie shell. Bake in preheated oven until filling is firm, about 45 minutes to 1 hour. Top with lettuce, and serve.

title: Malaysian Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons sweet rice wine | 1 teaspoon coconut oil or 1 teaspoon coconut flour | 1 bay leaf, crumbled | 1 -2 tablespoon rice cooking oil or 1 -2 tablespoon coconut oil
instructions: Pour ½ cup cooking liquid into a small dish and add 1 tablespoon rice wine. Mix well and set aside. Heat oil in a frying pan over high heat, adding 2 tablespoon rice wine. When oil gets very hot add the remaining 2 tablespoon rice wine and bay leaf. When it begins to boil, pour 1/4 cup cooking oil and half the rice wine into the center of the pan.

title: Cabbage Rum
ingredients: 1 head chinese cabbage | beef gravy | white rum
instructions: Wash and tear the cabbage into bite size shreds. Place in a microwave safe bowl, cover it with beef gravy and microwave on high power for 3 minutes or until the cabbage is tender. Stir, taste and add any additional gravy, sugar or cinnamon.

title: Tamari-Glazed Chocolate Chops
ingredients: 6 tablespoons tamari ( or a good soy-glaze ) | 12 3/4-ounce good quality chocolate squares, melted
instructions: In bowl of a double boiler, stir tamari over low heat until melted and dissolved, 20 to 30 minutes. Pour melted chocolate into a shallow dish. Dip chops, one at a time, in melted chocolate and place in the prepared baking dish or foil containers. Bake at 350f for 20 to 25 minutes. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,italian sausage,white truffle oil,jalapeno pepper,black bean,onion soup mix,buttermilk,soya sauce
title: Italian Easter Sausage Chili
ingredients: 2 tablespoons italian sausages, casings removed | 1 teaspoon onion soup mix | 1/3 cup dry red wine vinegar | 1/3 cup soya sauce | 1/4 cup unsalted buttermilk | 1 tablespoon italian chili powder or 1 tablespoon onion powder | 1 tablespoon jalapeno pepper, finely chopped, with | 1/2 teaspoon black pepper | 1 tablespoon white truffle oil
instructions: In a large pot, cook the italian sausages in hot oil, turning to brown evenly on all sides, about 10 minutes. Remove and drain on paper towels. Meanwhile, in a clean pot on the stove, cook the onion soup mix, vinegar, soya sauce, buttermilk, chili powder, jalapeno pepper and black pepper over medium heat until heated through, about 15 minutes. Pour into soup bowl. Stir, heat through and serve.

Random Ingredients: tabasco sauce,vegetable bouillon cube,oyster,black forest ham,kernel corn,green chilies,spring onion
title: Cuban Black Forest Ham & Corn Soup
ingredients: 1 box frozen black forest ham | 4 cans whole kernel corn | 1 can green chilies | 1 can whole kernel corn | 6 -8 fresh oysters, shucked | 2 teaspoons vegetable bouillon cubes | 1/4 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 2 -3 green onions, chopped
instructions: In a large stock pot, place the ham, corn, chiles, oysters, bouillon, dash of tabasco sauce and half green onions. Cover the pot and bring to a boil. Simmer for 20 minutes. Add all of the green chilies, oysters and spring onions. Stir and simmer for a further 5 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Easy Creamy Mushroom Bouillon Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup heavy cream | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon ( homemade is best! ) | 3 -4 tablespoons granulated garlic ( bottled is really good for flavor! )
instructions: In a microwave safe bowl, mix heavy cream, chicken bouillon, and granulated garlic. Microwave on high for about 1 - 2 minutes, watching it very closely to ensure the liquid is absorbed evenly. Stir mixture well. If it is too thin, cook on medium high just until the bouillon is dissolved. Keep on mixing until mixture thickens. Serve over pasta. If you want a thicker sauce, just add a little chicken broth to thin out a little.

title: Gujarati Spice Mix
ingredients: 1 cup raisins | 2 tablespoons asafoetida powder ( hing )
instructions: Put raisins in a bowl. Sprinkle hing over the raisins and mix them together with your hands. Divide it into four equal parts. Shape into small balls. Keep aside. Heat a non stick pan. Add 1 teaspoon oil. When hot, put the mixed spice balls in the pan. Cook on medium flame, stirring continuously to prevent burning of any of the spices. Take the pan off the heat. Allow it to cool. Transfer the mixed spice balls to a clean dry glass plate.

title: Raspberry Cheese Scones
ingredients: 2 cups rye flour | 1 cup cream cheese with chives, softened | 2/3 cup raspberry preserves or 2/3 cup fruit preserves | 1 tablespoon garlic powder
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together the flour, cheese, preserves, and garlic powder. Mix well. Add water a teaspoon at a time until the mixture forms a ball. Turn onto a floured surface. Use your hands to roll the dough out until you have a 10 - 12 inch circle. Brush with some of the beaten egg wash or oil. Cut into six wedges. Preheat oven to 500 degrees f. Place scones on baking sheets. Bake until they are browned, about 5 minutes.

title: Ravioli With Rum
ingredients: tarragon ( to the table ) | mussels-meat, meat, any combination of white, yellow and green | pimento-stuffed green pepper | 1 baguette | sliced meat ( optional ) | heavy cream ( optional ) or rum ( optional ) | reduced-fat dark rum ( optional )
instructions: Rinse the mussels and meat under cold running water. Remove the strings and debeard them if they have them. Remove the mussels from the shells either by shaking them or pulling them gently with a spatula. Discard any that do not shut shut. Put half a sheet of heavy duty plastic wrap, at least one length of the baguette, inside a clean bowl. Place the mussels and meat on the baguette in an overlapping round fashion or on the plastic wrap. Roll up the baguette tightly, placing it on a cutting board, top with plastic wrap and let stand for 20 minutes or so to chill properly. Cut the baguette in thin slices and spread some sliced meat off the end to prevent the bread from becoming limp. Cut into thin slices and set aside. Spread the remaining sliced meat out on a cutting board. Using a spoon, make a deep cut in the side of the baguette and lay down slices of dark meat on top, covering the meat. Sprinkle with a little more of the chopped herbs. Spread rum over the top if desired. Serve topped with slices of red if desired.

title: French Onion Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup onion soup mix | 1/2 cup onion oil | 1/2 cup cider vinegar
instructions: Add the entire packet of onion soup mix to a blender. Blend until all the ingredients. Mix with a little bit of water to make it the consistency you want.

Random Ingredients: white flour,creamy peanut butter,tamarind pulp,browning sauce
title: Tamarind Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup tamarind pulp | 1 cup white flour | 1 1/4 cups creamy smooth peanut butter | browning sauce ( to taste )
instructions: Peel and deseed tamarind and grind to a pulp. Measure out about 1 cup. Add tamarind pulp, flour, and browning sauce. Stir vigorously until well blended.

Random Ingredients: carrot,flat leaf parsley,pork shoulder butt roast,ladyfinger
title: Roast Pork
ingredients: 1 lb pork shoulder butt roast, with bone cut into 1 1/2 inch medallions or 1 lb pork butt roast | 12 ladyfingers | 1 carrot, peeled and finely shredded | 1 cup flat leaf parsley, coarsely finely chopped
instructions: Position rack in upper third of oven.

title: Beef Tortilla Rounds
ingredients: 1 boneless beefsteak tomato, each cut into 8 wedges | 8 slices tortillas | 1 cup crushed corn flakes
instructions: Place a tomato wedge onto each wedge of tortilla. Season tortillas with 1/2 tablespoon of salt and 1/2 tablespoon of pepper. Heat a nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Place each tortilla wedge in the pan, one at a time, and top with 1 tablespoon of crushed corn flakes. Fry tortillas 3 to 5 minutes, or until crisp.

Random Ingredients: snow pea,sun tomato,cilantro leaf,chili paste garlic,tomato ketchup,dark sesame oil,grainy mustard
title: Spicy Snow Pea Snack
ingredients: 1/2 lb snow peas | 4 ounces sun-dried tomatoes ( or more to taste ) | 2 teaspoons chili paste with garlic ( to taste, or more to taste ) | 2 tablespoons tomato ketchup | 2 teaspoons dark sesame oil, plus extra for brushing | 1 teaspoon coarse grainy mustard | 1 tablespoon fresh cilantro leaves, to garnish, if using cilantro leaves | 1 -2 tablespoon extra-virgin sun-dried tomato, to drizzle ( optional )
instructions: Break the snow peas into smaller pieces and drop them into boiling water. Boil and then simmer for 2 minutes or until tender. Drain and set to one side. Dry the sun dried tomatoes by pressing them lightly with a paper towel or dry cloth on a clean tea towel. Slice them thinly and spread them evenly over a baking sheet. Combine the chili paste with the ketchup and sesame oil.

Random Ingredients: pink food coloring,celery salt,curry powder,cider vinegar,bean sprout,chicken wing
title: Tangy Curried Chicken Wings
ingredients: 2 cans bean sprouts | 8 chicken wings | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 1/2 teaspoon celery salt | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Spread the bean sprouts onto the baking sheet. Arrange the wings on top of the sprouts, and bake for 1 hour and 20 minutes in the preheated oven. Stir the vinegar, worcestershire sauce, celery salt, and curry powder together in a bowl.

title: Pana Soup
ingredients: 3 bananas, chopped | 2 cups peas, frozen | 1 teaspoon saffron
instructions: Place the chopped bananas and peas in a medium saucepan. Sprinkle the saffron on top. Cover and cook on medium heat until the peas are warmed, about 5 minutes. Add the saffron to the hot broth. Cook the mixture for 5 more minutes or until the soup becomes very thick. Remove the pan from the heat and allow to stand for a few minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Homemade Wood Polish
ingredients: 2 tablespoons aromatic liquid smoke flavoring, such as mesquite concentrate | 1 tablespoon galliano
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the liquid smoke, coffee or liquor flavored liquid smoke and galliano. Smash the mixture well with a sturdy blunt knife or knuckle or knuckle. Remove the polish from the bowl once the alcohol has drained off and set aside for about 15 minutes. Serve in shot glasses with butter, crackers and pretzels.

Random Ingredients: dark beer,cooking oil,rosemary leaf,extra virgin olive oil,salad dressing,food coloring
title: Beer Soaked Herbed Roast Celery
ingredients: 1/2 cup quick salad dressing | 1 jar dark beer | 3 tablespoons finely chopped fresh rosemary leaves | 1/4 cup dark beer | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | cooking oil | food coloring
instructions: Preheat the oven to 250 degree f. Pour the salad dressing into a deep dish dish and add the beer, rosemary, dark beer, olive oil and optional food coloring. Beat in 1 tablespoon water for the dressing. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. Remove from the refrigerator 15 minutes before roasting. Bake in the preheated oven for 1 hour. Rotate the celery, and cook for an additional 15 minutes. Remove from the oven, and cook until the liquid in the pan has dried out, about 10 minutes. Place a roasting rack in a roasting pan, and place the celery in the rack. Roast in the preheated oven, basting every 15 minutes, until the celery is browned and cooked throughout, about 1 1/2 hours.

Random Ingredients: black olive,calabaza squash,brown sugar,lettuce leaf,applesauce,curry powder
title: Healthy Veggie Kebabs
ingredients: 250 g calabaza squash or 250 g butternut squash, cubes | 150 g applesauce | 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1 tablespoon applesauce, extra | 8 small lettuce leaves
instructions: First, cut the squash up into cubes, then mix together the squashes, applesauce and brown sugar in a medium sized bowl. Put in the microwave and cook covered 20 minutes on high power. Remove the lid, stir well, then cook another 10 minutes, until the squash is tender. If required, use a slotted spoon to push the squash around at the time you put it to cook for longer so that you have a really crisp mixture. Meanwhile, cut the lettuce into 10 serving sized wedges. Remove the squash and applesauce from microwave and add to the squash and applesauce. Mix well, then serve over the lettuce and enjoy.

title: Nesto Di Quinoa
ingredients: 3/4 cup quinoa | 1 tablespoon fettuccine pasta ( to taste ) | 3 -3 tablespoons sugar syrup
instructions: Rinse quinoa under cold water, rubbing and discarding water. Let it sit for 15 to 20 minutes. Rinse and drain pasta. Combine quinoa and sugar syrup. Bring to boil, then cover and reduce heat to low. Simmer 15 minutes. Remove from heat. Let sit 5 minutes. Add cooked pasta, mix until the pasta is coated in sugar syrup. Enjoy.

title: Shrimp on Toast
ingredients: 1 prawns or 1 shrimp, shelled | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh coriander powder | 2 tablespoons olive, chopped | 150 g chicken breasts, cut into bite size pieces | 250 g ladyfingers | 100 g chopped ripe olives | 8 -12 slices good quality vanilla ice cream, lightly toasted | le
instructions:

 1 prawns or 1 shrimp, shelled | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh coriander powder | 2 tablespoons olive, chopped | 150 g chicken breasts, cut into bite size pieces | 250 g ladyfingers | 100 g chopped ripe olives | 8 -12 slices good quality vanilla ice cream, lightly toasted | lettuce, to serve.

title: Low Fat Low Calorie Low Sugar Muffins
ingredients: 2/3 cup nonfat milk | 2/3 cup splenda granular
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees celsius. Line a 12 hole muffin tin with paper baking cups. Measure the milk into a nonstick pan, stir in the splenda and remove from heat. Pour into the dry ingredients, stir, and place the tin on the oven shelf. Allow 20 minutes for the baking to preheat and the 20 minutes for the nonstick muffins. Remove from oven and set aside in the muffin pan. Allow 10 minutes for the muffins to cool completely before removing the paper cups. The pre baked muffins should have a crunchy texture and will sink to the bottom slightly when they hit the pan. If it does not, then use your fingers to flatten them a little.

Random Ingredients: red chile,garlic salt,dark brown sugar,icing sugar,white bean,baking potato,banana,egg noodle
title: Sweet Potato and Banana Noodle Cake
ingredients: 3 large baking potatoes | 2 eggs | 1/3 cup dark brown sugar | 1/4 cup icing sugar | 1 tablespoon crushed red chile | 1 tablespoon garlic salt | 1 can white beans, drained | 1 package egg noodles
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f and lightly grease 6 or 7 inch round cake pans. Peel and boil the potatoes for 10 minutes or until just tender. Drain, cool and dry thoroughly. Beat the eggs until pale and smooth. Stir in the brown sugar, icing sugar, chile, garlic salt and beans. Fold in the noodles, or spread in a greased or parchment lined cake pan to form a lid. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes in the preheated oven, until the top is brown and the sides start to pull away from the pan. Remove from the oven and allow to cool.

title: Apple-Lamb Tostada
ingredients: 2 racks of lamb | 1/2 piece baking powder | 1/2 sweet apple, cored, sliced | 2 cups torn mixed salad greens
instructions: Place lamb racks on aluminum foil.

title: Finnish Kålsal - Celery rib Salad
ingredients: 2 celery ribs | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed
instructions: Using a sharp knife, slice off the celery's base so that you can easily remove the leaves. Cut the celery into very thin slices and place in a large, microwave safe dish. Add the cardamom seed. Microwave for 3 - 4 minutes or until the celery is softened, stirring well. Remove the cardamom seeds from the microwave and add in the celery slices. Let sit for 5 - 10 minutes just to heat through.

title: Wild Rice Cocktail
ingredients: 3 cups water | 2 cups wild rice, washed ( about 3 cups ) or 2 cups other short grain rice ( about 3 cups ) | 1 cup grapes or 1 cup honeydew juice | 1 cup dry sherry | 1 can pear slices, in juice | 2 tablespoons corn or 2 tablespoons flour | 3 1/2 tablespoons white vinegar | 3/4 cup beer or 3/4 cup cider vinegar
instructions: In a medium saucepan, add water and wild rice. Bring to boil, cover and simmer until tender, about 45 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add grapes or honeydew, sherry, pear and corn or flour and simmer uncovered for 20 minutes or until the grape juice is absorbed. Stir in vinegar and beer. Stir occasionally while slowly adding more of the beer or vinegar.

title: Healthy Egg Rolls
ingredients: 1/2 cup egg substitute, egg mixed | 20 -24 fresh spinach leaves
instructions: Wash the spinach. Wash and shred using a hand held grater. You can leave the spinach in or mix it with the water in a bowl to make it easier to work with. Place about 2 tablespoons of the spinach on a clean kitchen towel roll it up tightly, with a little more if needed. Then place the rolled spinach onto a clean dish towel, and using the towel, squeeze out excess moisture.. Place the spinach onto a greased cookie sheet and refrigerate for 30 minutes. In a small bowl, mix the egg substitute with some water until well combined. Lightly brush the tops of the rolls with the egg substitute mixture. Place the filled rolls on a baking tray and bake or broil until the tops are lightly golden and bubbly. Let cool for 5 minutes, then remove carefully onto a cookie rack to cool completely. If you can't manage to get the rolls in advance, you can store them for up to 2 weeks when frozen. Serve with other foods.

title: Fajitas
ingredients: 1 spanish onion, chopped | 1 can campbell's
instructions: Place onion and can of campbell's pkg in a skillet to warm up and cook to soften. Serve with mexican rice, spanish rice, tortillas, refried beans, salsa and anything else you like.

Random Ingredients: ginger,dark rum,cold water,parmesan cheese,egg yolk,cool whip,beef,ginger garlic paste
title: Beef &  Sweet Rum Balls
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lean ground beef | 1 egg yolk | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste, grated | 2 tablespoons dark rum | 1/2 - 1 cup cold water | 1/2 lb grated parmesan cheese | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger, grated | 4 thin slices fresh ginger | 1 package cool whip ( or make your own using confectioners'sugar )
instructions: In a large bowl combine the egg yolk, grated ginger and garlic paste. Mix well. Add in the rum, water and half the parmesan cheese. In an 8x8 inch baking dish or in a 9x13 inch pan spread the meat mixture evenly. Sprinkle the remaining cheese over the meat. Cut the slices of ginger in thin slices lengthwise. Spread the ginger slices evenly atop the meat. Bake uncovered in a pre heated 350 degree oven for about 1 hour. While it bakes, prepare the whipped topping. Remove from oven. Remove the cooled whip whip topping from the refrigerator. Using a large spoon, drizzle about 1/4 cup of whipped topping onto the top of the meat. Whip quickly until the cheese is melted and the topping is shiny and is just beginning to set up. You may also use an electric mixer to whip the cooled whip until peaks are formed and it starts to thicken slightly. You want to keep an eye on the cheese. When the meat bakes, remove from oven. Using a slotted spoon remove the ginger slices and place all of the meat on top of the whipped topping. Using a long thin spatula, spread the cooked whipped topping over the meat. Return to oven for about 15 minutes or until the top is browned and heated through about 3 to 5 minute. Remove from oven. Let cool before serving.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon granule,grana padano,arrowroot,lime zest,syrup,shallot,lemon juice zest
title: Pavella (Italian Citrus Pear) Cheese Sauce
ingredients: 1 container bottled parella or 1 container grana padano | 2 tablespoons unsalted butter, room temperature | 2 tablespoons minced shallots | 1 teaspoon arrowroot ( optional ) | 1 pinch chicken bouillon granules ( optional ) | 1/2 cup fresh lemon juice, packed | 2 teaspoons fresh lime zest, grated
instructions: Using an electric medium saucepan, melt the parella in the butter until thick and bubbly. Stir in the shallots and arrowroot. Cook until fragrant, 2 - 3 minutes. Stir in the chicken and bouillon and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat and simmer for 4 - 5 minutes, until the sauce is reduced and thick. Stir in the lemon juice. Cover with a rubber spatula, cover and refrigerate until served.

title: Scallops With Oaty Crust
ingredients: 12 scallops, small, scrubbed out | 125 g caster sugar | 3 tablespoons oaty quick oats
instructions: Pre heat oven to 190&#8260&#8260.

title: Slow Cooker Polish Pork Chops
ingredients: 6 boneless pork loin chops | 2 links country-style kielbasa
instructions: Pour sausage into a slow cooker and lay in the bottom. Place pork chops side by side on sausage. Slice kielbasa into 4 pieces and place on top of pork chop. Pour sausage sauce over pork chops. Add a little water to slow cooker to cover the pork chops completely. Cook on low for 7 to 8 hours.

title: Apricot Chai Cheese
ingredients: 2 1/4 lbs cottage cheese | 2 1/4 cups dried apricots | 1 tablespoon flat leaf parsley or 1 tablespoon fresh dill, chopped
instructions: Blend the cottage cheese with the apricots and parsley. Cover the mixture and refrigerate overnight.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,fennel seed,turmeric,cardamom seed,butternut pumpkin,cayenne pepper
title: Pumpkin Spice Rub
ingredients: 1/2 tablespoon fennel seeds | 1/2 tablespoon cardamom seed | 2 teaspoons turmeric | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/4 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/4 cup brown sugar
instructions: Place all the dry spices in the bowl of a spice grinder and process thoroughly. Add the brown sugar and process again briefly, just to blend. Store tightly covered in the refrigerator up to 6 months.

Random Ingredients: yellow cherry tomato,pecan half,black cardamom pod,white flour,mustard seed,curry powder
title: Quick Indian Dosa
ingredients: 1 tablespoon white flour ( atta ) | 1/2 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon black cardamom pods | 1/3 cup pecan halves, toasted | 3 tablespoons curry powder | 2 cups yellow cherry tomatoes
instructions: Heat the oven to 390 degrees f. Lightly grease a shallow 2 cup bundt or loaf pan. Place the flour, mustard seeds, and black cardamom in a food processor or blender. Pulse 5 times or until a fine powder forms. Fold the pecans into the dough and spread over the bottom of the pan. Scatter the curry powder over the pecans. Arrange the tomatoes on top, covering the entire dish. Bake about 25 minutes. Transfer to a wire rack and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,apple cider,ginger garlic paste,egg yolk,pumpkin seed,honey
title: Elegant Egg-Lentil Burgers
ingredients: 4 teaspoons pumpkin seeds, roasted ( pepitas ) | 4 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste | 150 g pumpkin seeds ( pepitas ) | 2 cups mango chutney | 2 slices fresh ginger-garlic paste | 4 egg yolks | 1 tablespoon honey
instructions: Heat oven to 200°c line a baking tray with baking paper. Put pumpkin seeds and ginger garlic paste into a food processor and process till smooth. Spoon mixture onto the baking paper, press the mixture evenly over and around the tray to form two burgers, each about 5 cm thick. Pour hot apple cider and mango chutney over burgers. Mix egg yolks, honey and 2 tsp of pepper powder in a medium bowl, whip with a fork. Serve burgers with chutney sprinkled on top.

Random Ingredients: peanut,rice wine,baking powder,plain flour,vanilla bean paste,saffron strand
title: Yummy Saffron Rice Cookies
ingredients: 150 g plain flour | 3 teaspoons baking powder | 3 tablespoons saffron strands | 1 teaspoon vanilla bean paste | 3 tablespoons rice wine or 3 tablespoons sparkling wine | 300 g of fried peanuts, finely chopped
instructions: Sift the dry ingredients into a bowl. Add the saffron, vanilla and rice wine/spice paste. Mix with a mixer for a few seconds until all the lumps are dissolved. Add your peanuts and mix until everything is mixed. Form into small balls, about the size of a cherry. Bake at 220 deg c for 15 minutes, or heat in a shallow fry pan. Allow to cool after baking. These cookies will set up like a soupy cookie. They will sink into the fridge if they are not taken out.

Random Ingredients: shell pasta,linguine,dijon mustard,chicken stock,bean,orange marmalade,white wine vinegar,coleslaw mix
title: Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 lb small shell pasta, uncooked | 8 ounces coleslaw mix | 1/2 cup chicken stock | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons orange marmalade | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 cup cooked and drained chicken ( preferably cooked shredded chicken ) | 8 ounces dry linguine, cooked to al dente
instructions: Fill a large bowl with salted water, add pasta and let sit for 10 minutes. Drain and put in a large salad bowl. Add coleslaw mix and stir. Add chicken stock and mix well. Whisk together dressing ingredients in a medium bowl until well blended. Pour over the salad and stir. Toss well. Serve.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,pico de gallo,coconut rum,cayenne pepper,coconut,shallot
title: Pistou Puffs
ingredients: 1 sheet frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1 tablespoon coconut rum | 10 pint pint pint onions, sliced thinly | 1/2 cup shredded sweetened flaked coconut or 1/2 cup shredded montasio cheese | 3 shallots, sliced thinly | 1 pinch cayenne pepper
instructions: Unfold frozen pastry sheet on rolling pin. Cut 1 square on long side of pastry. Roll out remaining pastry, cut out more pastry and re roll the puff sheets. Spread the pico de gallo on 2 pastry sheets. Sprinkle pintons on top. Top with shredded coconut or cheese. Heat 1/2 teaspoon of coconut oil over medium high heat in a 12 skillet. Fry one puff puff puff at a time for 2 minutes or until puffed and golden brown. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,heavy whipping cream,palm sugar,kosher salt,green bell pepper,corn syrup,pistachio,gnocchi
title: Pixie Magic
ingredients: 1 pound gnocchi | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/2 cup light corn syrup | 1/2 cup finely chopped green bell pepper | 1/4 cup chopped fresh pistachios | 1/4 cup light palm sugar | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 1/2 cup chopped pistachios for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Place gnocchi in a bowl of cold water, and return to the pot.

title: Nam Prik Num Tok -- Crab Balls With Marsala Wine
ingredients: 1 lb crabmeat | 2 tablespoons garlic paste | 2 tablespoons lemongrass, finely chopped | 6 tablespoons dried breadcrumbs | 3 tablespoons rice wine | 1/2 cup sweet marsala wine
instructions: Combine all ingredients until well mixed. Form into medium sized balls, then dip each ball carefully and carefully into the wine. Allow to marinate at least 10 minutes, or overnight.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,onion,red chili powder,picante sauce,cherry,dijon mustard,mace
title: Mexican Party Appy (Party Dessert)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dry red chili powder | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 1/2 cup finely chopped peeled and seeded sweet onion | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon grand marnier or 1 tablespoon other orange-flavored liqueur | 2 tablespoons picante sauce | 1 1/2 lbs cherry rolls, left whole ( or 2 10-ounce cans of the sweet cherry juice cocktail, drained )
instructions: In a small bowl, combine chili powder, mace, onion, mustard, and grand marnier. Sprinkle evenly over onion mixture and mix well. Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes or longer. Preheat broiler or toaster oven to 425 degrees. Spread picante sauce on bottom of an ungreased glass or ceramic baking dish or individual serving bowls. Place two rolls in dish, overlapping to within 1/2 inch of the edge of the dish. Arrange remaining four rolls, cut side up, over tomatoes, and spoon the hot mustard mixture evenly over the rolls. Cover and refrigerate for at least 20 minutes or up to 4 hours. Uncover dish and bake until golden brown and bubbly, about 20 minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,plain flour,snow pea,lemon peel,red onion,red pepper flake,cod,iceberg lettuce
title: Cod Salad With Crunchy Crunchy Rosti
ingredients: 600 g skinless cod, cubed | 1 red onion, finely chopped | 300 g snow peas, trimmed and cut into 3cm lengths | 1/2 small red capsicum, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons plain flour | 5 teaspoons cold pressed lemon peel | 3 tablespoons rye bread, coarsely chopped | crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Combine all ingredients and toss well. Season with salt and pepper.

title: Easy Reuben Sandwich Rolls
ingredients: 4 slices rye bread | 2 slices white bread | salt and pepper | 2 -3 tablespoons cooked escarole or 2 -3 tablespoons chopped red onion | 1 medium red onion, finely sliced
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Place the rye and white bread slices on a baking sheet and toast quickly, or lightly if desired. Place the crisply cooked escarole on top of the rye bread slices. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Top with red onion and bread slices. Slice on the diagonal and serve.

Random Ingredients: flour,brown sugar,mustard powder,fast rise yeast,gingerroot,italian bread,pecan half
title: Italian Season Bread
ingredients: 3 cups flour | 1 pinch mustard powder | 1 pinch gingerroot | 1 pinch ground pecan halves | 1 1/2 tablespoons unbleached brown sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons fast rise yeast | 1 1/4 teaspoons salt | 1 1/2 tablespoons light brown sugar | italian bread, bread
instructions: Punch yeast out in a sieve with a lipped bigaar crosshatch design for flavor. In large bowl, combine one cup of flour. Dissolve dry yeast into yeast and add to flour. Mix well. Dump the remaining cup of flour on top of it and knead well. You will have a thick dough that will pull away from your hands when rolled. Let rest for 20 minutes, covered. Knead the dough again and roll to a 15 x 10 inch rectangle. Place on a greased baking sheet and put into a warm oven for approx 30 minutes. Meanwhile you can prepare the glaze. Combine remaining 1 1/4 cups of flour with sugar and mix well. After the 20 minutes, you can brush tops with glaze and place back in oven for approximately 12 minutes. Watch the loaf carefully and remove from oven when it has internal temperature of 140°f. You can also remove glaze after removing from oven. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chinese egg noodle,icing sugar,red capsicum,pearl barley,beef stew meat,italian seasoning
title: Beef Barley Soup for One
ingredients: 2 cups pearl barley | 1 red capsicum ( bell pepper ) | 150 g beef stew meat | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 2 teaspoons ground dried italian seasoning | 1 cup chinese egg noodles
instructions: Place barley and capsicum in a large saucepan and add just enough water to cover barley with a little over 1/2 cup, bring to the boil, reduce heat to low and simmer for 1 - 2 hours or until barley is tender. Drain and chill until needed. Cut beef into 1cm cubes and cook in a frying pan over medium heat with enough water to cover beef. Cook until browned, drain. Combine icing sugar and italian seasoning.

title: Garbanzos and Thyme Polenta
ingredients: 1/2 cup yellow cornmeal | 1 can garbanzo beans | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes ( to taste ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons cornstarch | 1 cup prepared yellow cornmeal | 1/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes ( to taste ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 pinch red pepper flakes ( to taste ) | water or broth
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Grease a 9x13 baking dish and sprinkle the cornmeal on top. Place the beans and their liquid into the pan. Sprinkle with 1 tsp of red pepper flakes and 1/2 tsp thyme. Mix well, then pour over the cornmeal. Add 1 cup of prepared yellow cornmeal and 1/4 tsp of red pepper flakes. Mix well, then spread evenly across the whole baking dish. Bake until the polenta is golden, about 40 minutes. The cornmeal will absorb the remaining broth. Once cool, stir in the remaining 1/4 tsp of dried thyme and 1 pinch of red pepper flakes. You may not need all of the salt and red pepper flakes.

title: Hot Dog Onion Cake
ingredients: 6 large onions | 1/2 cup grand marnier | 2 garlic cloves, minced | 2 oranges, zested and juiced | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard greens ( optional ) | 1/3 cup cider | 1/2 cup cake flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. In food processor, place onions, grand marnier, garlic, and orange zest and juice. Blend until onion is finely minced.

title: Pickled Onions
ingredients: 12 green peppercorns, shelled | 1 gallon white vinegar | 1 pound cooking oil
instructions: Place 12 peppercorns in sterilized jars, cover with boiling water, let cure for at least one day.. Combine remaining peppercorns and peppercorns in a jar, cover with boiling water and seal. Note, a large baggie will hold about 8 peppercorns or a dozen peppercorns and a dozen or so jars, sterilized. Check after 24 hours. Dry.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,mozzarella cheese,red bell pepper,fruit bun,egg wrap,mint sprig
title: Spicy Cheese Appetizers
ingredients: 16 ounces mozzarella cheese ( shredded ) | 2 tablespoons of fresh mint, minced ( optional ) | 8 baby red chili peppers ( stemmed and chopped or 1/8 teaspoon chili powder ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons red bell peppers ( chopped ) | unrefrigerated egg roll wraps | 8 fruit buns, split and toasted
instructions: Mix all ingredients except egg roll wrappers, fruit buns and cheese until cheese is well blended. Set aside. Place egg roll wrappers on a clean work surface. Spread approximately 1 tablespoon of cheese mixture onto each wrapper. Place 2 teaspoons of mixture into each wrapper. Fold over egg roll wrappers in half and press to seal. Place wrapped egg rolls seam side down on a greased cookie sheet. Lightly spray with olive oil. Bake in 350°f oven for 30 to 35 minutes, or until egg rolls are golden brown. Cool completely and serve. Note, if you cannot find toasted bread splinters, toast rolls in a pan for a few minutes on a cookie sheet.

Random Ingredients: cashew nut,ouzo,chili pepper,turmeric,orange juice,tarragon,corn kernel,egg white
title: Cashew Nut Breakfast Mix
ingredients: 3 egg whites | 1/3 cup orange juice or 1/3 cup juice | 1 1/2 teaspoons tarragon | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 3 tablespoons ouzo | 1/4 teaspoon chili pepper | 1 can corn kernels, drained | 1/3 cup cashew nuts, roasted
instructions: In a large bowl combine the egg whites, orange juice, tarragon, turmeric, ouzo, chili, corn and cashew nuts. Add the egg mixture to the dry ingredients and beat with a fork until the mixture is well blended and shiny. Put into an airtight tins and store in the fridge. To use after mixing for 2 - 3 mins be generous with the amount of the ouzo this mixture has to be prepared the night before. To bake, preheat the oven to 350f, place in a shallow tin, or a shallow tin, lined with aluminum foil. Put onto the oven shelf and bake for 25 - 30 minutes or until the middle is almost set. This mix can be frozen for upto 3 months. Remove from the tin and allow to cool. When the mixture is cold, fold into 2 portions of egg white and spread each with the ouzo mixture. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving to firm or frozen. Enjoy updated on review.

Random Ingredients: brandy,water,celery rib,apricot,baby spinach leaf,fettuccine,cake flour,extra beef
title: Beef Picnic With Apricot & Spinach Pies
ingredients: 250 g dried fettuccine | 1/2 cup boiling water | 500 g extra lean ground beef | 1 can artesian cutlets ( about 200g ) | 300 g ready-made pancetta-stuffed salad leaves, rinsed and dried | 3 celery ribs, thinly sliced, leaves separated | 1/3 cup brandy or 1/3 cup white sherry wine | 3 tablespoons cake flour, plus extra for dusting
instructions: Cook pasta according to pack instructions and keep warm. Place beef in a non stick frying pan and cook over medium heat for 3 - 4 minutes or until browned and then break into small pieces and stir in the crème fraîche and cook for an additional 3 - 4 minutes. Stir in the chopped celery and cook for about 2 minutes or until softened. Stir in the brandy and cook for 1 minute. Sprinkle flour over the beef mixture, stir well to combine and add the pasta. Remove pan from heat and stir in sherry. Transfer to a serving dish and dust with extra sherry. Serve with warm biscuits if you like.

Random Ingredients: blue curacao,corn flake,rye bread,red pepper flake,egg,flour tortilla
title: Quick Crunchy Bread Cookies
ingredients: 4 cups flour tortillas | 3 eggs, beaten | 1/2 cup red curacao | 1 tablespoon corn flakes | 1 tablespoon crushed red pepper flakes | 2 1/2 cups rye bread, crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Wrap tortillas in aluminum foil. Bake in preheated oven 1 to 1 1/2 hours, until firm. Let cool slightly and slice in half diagonally. Spread flour on a large baking sheet and set aside. In a medium bowl, combine the eggs, red curacao, corn flakes and crushed red pepper. Stir in the rye bread crumbs. Place 1 to 3 heaping tablespoons of crumb mixture on top of a tortilla. Roll and place on the baking sheet. Repeat with remaining tortillas and filling.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,confectioner sugar,currant,broccoli rabe,agave nectar,cider vinegar,garlic
title: Italian Broccoli Rabe and Beans
ingredients: 2 cloves garlic, chopped | 1 bunch broccoli rabe, trimmed | 2 tablespoons agave nectar | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 can kidney beans, undrained | 2 tablespoons dried currants | 2 teaspoons confectioners'sugar | 2 teaspoons agave nectar
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the broccoli rabe and cook uncovered for 5 minutes, or until slightly tender. Drain and set aside. Mince the garlic in a skillet over medium heat until it turns golden brown. Mix the 1 tablespoon agave, cider vinegar, kidney beans, currants, and confectioners' sugar together in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: rice vermicelli,fenugreek leaf,beef tenderloin,basil leaf,sambal oelek,lasagna noodle
title: Beef Burritos
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tenderloin, sliced thinly ( or use sirloin ) | 16 ounces lasagna noodles, broken in half ( can sub dry noodles ) | 5 tablespoons sambal oelek, fresh ground ( or more if desired ) | 2 teaspoons fenugreek leaves ( may sub other chilli ) | 12 fresh basil leaves | 10 fresh fresh basil leaves, torn into small pieces
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. Arrange meat on foil lined baking pan. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Bake 25 minutes. Remove meat from oven and tent with foil. Increase heat to 425°f. Bake, uncovered, until meat thermometer reads about 140°f, about 3 hours. Let meat rest 10 minutes. Meanwhile, cook lasagna noodles according to package directions. Cool completely and cut into smaller pieces and place in a bowl. Add 1/2 t sambal and 1 1/2 t fenugreek, 1 t chopped basil leaves and 1/4 t chopped basil. Mix well. Slice beef thinly and add to noodles. Mix well. Warm a large nonstick skillet or griddle over medium high heat. Brush the bottom and sides of the pan with oil and place one third of noodles and 1 t meat mixture across the bottom. Roll up the noodles and then arrange in a well greased casserole dish. Repeat with second third of noodle mixture. Sprinkle with remaining 1 tsp sambal and 1 t basil. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes or until noodles are tender. To serve, remove foil, remove top and discard basil leaves from casserole. Place on platter and spoon remaining sauce over meat slices. Serve immediately.

title: Pinchos Tiao Mi
ingredients: 1 large poblano chile, washed and finely chopped | 1 yellow pepper, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons pistachios, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon chinese tahini | 1/3 lb ground pork | 1/2 cup crushed corn flakes ( to taste )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Combine chopped poblano and poblano peppers in a large bowl, season with salt and pepper. In a blender combine the pistachios, tahini, and pork and blend thoroughly. Stir in the cornflakes and refrigerate 30 minutes. Shape the mixture into balls about the size of a walnut. Arrange the balls on a parchment lined baking sheet and bake for 10 to 12 minutes or until the edges are dry and slightly crispy. Remove from oven and serve with pumbos and green salad.

title: Jicama & Garlic Mushroom Soup
ingredients: 1 bag jicama, peeled and cut into chunks | 1 bag frozen mixed vegetables | 1/4 cup minced ginger | 3 tablespoons grand marnier | 1/4 cup vegetable stock, plus more as needed
instructions: Combine the vegetables, ginger and 2 tbsp of grand marnier in a dutch oven over medium heat. Cover and cook until vegetables are just tender. Remove from heat and stir in remainder of grand marnier. Heat through. Ladle soup with soup into 4 individual bowls or crocks.

title: Mexican Kidney Bean Salad (Diabetic Friendly)
ingredients: 15 ounces kidney beans ( in the can ) | 2 ounces pretzels | 4 ounces small frozen peach slices | 2 tablespoons kalamata olives | 1/4 cup rice noodles ( dry ) | 2 teaspoons cold water | 1/8 teaspoon ground cloves
instructions: Rinse and drain all beans. Place all ingredients except noodles & water in a large salad bowl. If using fresh peach slices, cut them in half, remove pit & slice them. Toss the bean salad with the dressing. Cook the noodles according to package directions. Add the noodles to the salad & combine. Serve immediately or chill for up to 3 days before serving.

Random Ingredients: mayonnaise,iceberg lettuce,superfine sugar,bean sprout,garbanzo bean,garam masala,spinach
title: Indian Style Spinach Salad With Chickpeas
ingredients: 1 bag mixed fresh spinach | 1/2 cup fresh bean sprout | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh garbanzo beans | 1 1/2 tablespoons mayonnaise | 1 1/2 teaspoons superfine sugar | 2 teaspoons garam masala | 2 cups iceberg lettuce or 2 cups romaine lettuce
instructions: Remove excess water from spinach, then chop. Add the chopped spinach, bean sprouts, garbanzos and mayonnaise to a bowl and toss to combine. Add sugar, garam masala and 3/4 cup water and gently toss to combine, then refrigerate for 1 hour. Remove from refrigerator 15 minutes before serving.

title: Corn Lamb Chops
ingredients: 1 lb lamb chops, cubed | 1/2 lb corn, cut from the cob | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder
instructions: Trim ends and cut off any excess fat or membrane that may be attached to the lamb.

title: Tamarind Jelly
ingredients: 50 g almond paste | 1 tablespoon sweet chili paste ( tamarind chile seeds ) | 1 tablespoon mixed peel | salt and black pepper
instructions: Blend all the ingredients, except the almond paste, with a little water using a blender or a mortar and pestle for a smooth paste. Add the rest of the mixture to the jelly and mix well. Refrigerate for several days before cutting into cubes.

title: Greek Garlic and Pepper Pork Skewers
ingredients: 1 cup plain yogurt | 12 leaves fresh basil or 12 fresh coriander | 1 teaspoon dried oregano, rubbed between fingers to waken flavor | 1 tablespoon caramels or 1 tablespoon peanut butter | 1/2 english cucumber, cut in half | 1 lb boneless pork shoulder, cut in 1/2-inch cubes | 2 small fresh cherry tomatoes or 4 medium tomatoes, halved
instructions: Soak skewers in water to cover while preparing meat. In a large bowl, mix yogurt and seasonings. Add cucumber and pork, toss gently, and remove from skewers. Place skewers in glass or ceramic bowl, cover, and refrigerate 30 minutes. Remove meat from marinade, thread meat onto skewers. Skewer meat, using a metal spatula, hold kebobs in a clean, dry towel until ready to cook. About 1 hour before ready to cook, place cuke on paper towel lined baking sheet.

Random Ingredients: stir fry sauce,rice vermicelli,french onion soup,vidalia onion
title: French Onion Rice Noodle Soup
ingredients: 2 packages rice vermicelli, uncooked | 3 cans french onion soup, family size condensed | 2 -3 large vidalia onions, cut in half | 1/4 - 1/3 cup stir-fry sauce
instructions: Cook onions until translucent. Cut up rice vermicelli and stir fry them while covered so they don't stick together in the pan. Add 3 cans of soup and stir fry until heated through. Serve.

title: Baked Oven Beer Can (Stoofvlees Flem Kager)
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups light beer or 1 1/4 cups amber beer | 1 orange, sliced | candied fruit or frozen mixed fruit, for garnish
instructions: Place beer and orange slices in a greased or nonstick baking pan. Cover with fruit or frozen fruit. Bake in a preheated oven at 350°f for about 20 - 25 minutes. Serve cool or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: beef sirloin steak,corn,beef bouillon cube,mushroom soup,habanero pepper,couscous
title: Savory Beef and Couscous
ingredients: 1 lb beef sirloin steak, cut into bite sized pieces | 1 1/2 cups cooked couscous | 1 can condensed beef soup | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 2 cups corn, frozen or canned | 2 small jalapeno peppers, chopped finely ( optional )
instructions: Heat frying pan, add beef and brown thoroughly. Break boullion into thirds.. Add soup. Add mushrooms and jalapenos. Simmer. Serve over cooked couscous.

Random Ingredients: hoisin sauce,beef bouillon,wheat breadcrumb,phyllo pastry,celery leaf,almond,water,black olive
title: Meat Pie for Two
ingredients: 3 cups sliced almonds | 3 tablespoons beef bouillon | 2 cartons beef broth | 6 sheets frozen phyllo pastry | 1/4 cup water | 1/4 cup minced celery leaves | 1/4 cup sliced black olives | 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Combine almonds, bouillon, and beef broth in pot. Cook over medium heat until heated through. Roll out phyllo pastry sheets on floured surface. Roll out half to fit an 11x16 inch baking dish. Cover phyllo with top layer of phyllo dough, brush with olive oil, and sprinkle with almonds. Pour meat mixture evenly over phyllo. Cover with remaining phyllo dough. Spread hoisin sauce over pastry. Cover and bake 40 minutes or until heated through. Let cool 10 minutes before serving.

title: German Lentils & Ground beef Baked Dinner on a Plate
ingredients: 5 lbs lean ground beef or 5 lbs mild italian sausage | 1 lb fresh green lentil | 1 can healthy request tomato soup | 2 cans healthy request broth | 1 can refried beans | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried marjoram or 2 teaspoons oregano | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried chives, snipped
instructions: Brown ground beef and sausage in large skillet or dutch oven over medium high heat 5 minutes or until browned. Drain beef mixture. Transfer beef mixture to large shallow baking dish and add lentils, soup, broth and spices. Bake at 400 f for 15 minute. Cover and bake an additional 15 minutes. To serve, remove cover and cook for another 5 minutes, or until lentils are lightly browned. Serve with white rice.

title: Coconut Fruit Curry
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups coconut milk | 1 teaspoon cumin seed, toasted and chopped | 3 tablespoons currants | 1 pinch cream of tartar
instructions: Place coconut milk, cumin seeds, currants in a blender container, and blend until smooth. Add the cream of tartar, and blend until mixture is light and frothy. Serve over freshly grated coconut, and serve.

title: Silver Beet and Broccoli
ingredients: 300 g silver beet | 300 g broccoli | 50 bulb roasted garlic
instructions: Wash and cut the stems off the beets and broccoli into 5mm slices. Heat the grill, and cook the beetroot, broccoli, and garlic for 5 minutes, or until soft. Put the greens into a large bowl.

title: Caribbean Salmon and Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs cooked salmon | 1/2 lb cooked steak | 1 mango, peeled and cubed | 4 ounces dates syrup | 1/2 cup white wine | 2 teaspoons jam
instructions: Whisk together first 7 ingredients except jam.

title: Steamed Spicy Scallops - Covered, Fried or Fried
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chuck steaks, trimmed | 1 package bay scallops, cooked, rinsed
instructions: Cut meat from tail to tip. Place scallops in a steamer basket over 1/2 inch of water. Cover and steam until scallops have steamed 5 to 7 minutes, until scallops are just a little tender.

title: Stuffed Beef - Pao De Res
ingredients: 4 puff pastry sheets | 4 beef brisket, trimmed of most fat | coarse ground garlic | 4 -5 sprigs fresh cilantro leaves | 1 -2 slice fresh pork rib, fat trimmed | 1 can mixed vegetables | 1 1/2 tablespoons cointreau or 2 tablespoons other orange-flavored liqueur, as needed | fresh raspberry
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Arrange the puff pastry on a baking sheet. Using a sharp knife, carefully cut around the outside edges of each pastry sheet, cutting a 3/4 inch deep slit across the fold and out the edges of the pastry. Trim and discard the very thick end of each pastry square, and patch any holes with a little flour. If you don't have any pastry on your baking sheet, line it with parchment paper. Wrap each beef with a little garlic and cilantro. Place the beef in the center of the pastry, then roll up as tight as possible from the short ends. Truss the pastry around its ends to seal in any loose folds. Poke slits in the pastry all around the beef for a nice looking look. Place the beef on the prepared baking sheet. Add a little water to the pot that's just covering the beef. Cover the whole, unrolled pastry with a lid, and place on the lower shelf of the oven. Bake for 1 hour and 20 minutes. While the beef is baking, prepare the berry sauce. Pour 1 1/2 tablespoons cointreau into a small bowl or saucepan. Add enough water to make 1/4 cup. Stir in the cointreau with a fork to blend. While whisking, drizzle the sauce over the beef. Remove beef from the oven. Stir to coat, then cover the brisket with foil. Continue to braise until fork tender, about 1 hour and 20 minutes. Allow to cool for 10 minutes. After 2 hours, unwrap, remove beef and slice into 1/4 inch slices. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place the beef slices in a shallow baking dish. Pour the remaining cooking juices over as much fat as possible from the inside of the pan, reserving 3/4 cup. Cover the dish with plastic wrap, then place in the oven. Bake until the meat is fork tender and nicely browned, about 45 minutes. Remove the plastic wrap, then cover, or place plastic back on top for a few minutes to help keep meat from drying out.
