Remove from the oven, and allow to cool slightly. Cut out every inch or so with a serrated knife, being careful to avoid slicing all the way down the center. Remove all the slices with a wide spatula, place them on a warm platter, and serve. For the berry sauce, place the frozen mixed vegetables in a medium bowl, and add the remaining cointreau liqueur. Stir until well combined. Add a little water if needed, just a tiny bit, to moisten. Cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate until serving time.

title: Apricot-Glazed Apricot Glaze or Biscuit
ingredients: 4 apricot preserves | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: In small bowl, combine preserves and seasoning and mix well. Coat 9 x 13 baking dish with prepared glaze.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt,baking potato,salsa,tomato green chilies,peach schnapps,serrano pepper
title: Kathy's Sizzlin' Spanish Fizz Potatoes
ingredients: 1 lb baking potato | 3 tablespoons peach schnapps | 3 tablespoons salsa | 2 teaspoons canned diced tomatoes and green chilies | 1 -2 serrano pepper, thinly sliced | kosher salt
instructions: Peel potatoes with a rind cut between the top and bottom. Place in lightly salted water and bring to a boil. Lower heat and simmer until potato is tender, about 25 - 30 minutes, depending on your oven. If using the fresh tomatoes cut into wedges add to the water during the last 5 minutes of cooking. Drain well and let cool slightly. Slice and arrange on a paper towel to dry for about 10 minutes. Mash potatoes with a fork until smooth. Add peach schnapps, salsa, tomatoes and chilies and serrano pepper. Taste for seasoning. Serve warm.

title: Rotel Trout
ingredients: 1 can rotel | 1 tablespoon tarragon | 1 teaspoon onion salt | 1 packet trout fillets
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Combine rotel, tarragon, onion salt and trout in a 13x9 baking dish. Sprinkle top with onion salt.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile adobo,salad oil,golden raisin,ranch dressing,sherry,chunky salsa
title: Chipotle Raisin Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup golden raisin | 1/2 cup chunky salsa ( mild, medium or hot, to your likeness ) | 1/2 teaspoon chipotle chiles in adobo, finely chopped ( canned chipotles in adobo ) | 1/4 cup salad oil | 0.5 bottle ranch dressing | 1/4 cup dry sherry
instructions: Prepare, combine all ingredients, pour dressing over salad, stir and chill atleast 2 hours to allow flavors to blend.

title: Baked Stove Top Corn Crusted Chicken and Smoked Fruit
ingredients: 2 skinless chicken breasts | 2 cans mixed dried fruit ( cranberries, apricots, cranberries, raisins.. ) | cornmeal | cornmeal | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1 lb stew, trimmed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Cut chicken in serving size pieces. Place in a casserole dish. In a bowl, mix together the dried fruit, cornmeal, baking soda and stew. Add to chicken and toss to coat evenly. Cover. Bake for 1 hour. Remove cover and continue baking for 20 minutes or until chicken reaches desired doneness.

title: Azerbaijani (Sweet Potato Grilled Kremelta)
ingredients: 4 large baking potatoes, cut to 2 cm rounds | 120 g icing sugar icing | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 15 g dried parsley leaves
instructions: Bake potato on a greased baking tray in a 180 degree celcius oven until well browned and crispy. Remove and allow to cool. Mix icing sugar and golden syrup together in a bowl. Dip potato rounds in icing and allow to drain on paper towel. Place on griddle pan heated to high and cook potato for 3 - 4 minutes on each side. Remove and allow to cool slightly. Spread each biscuit with about 2 tablespoons of savoury mixture. Garnish with parsley and serve.

Random Ingredients: hot red chili pepper,dill pickle,saffron thread,ice,edible flower
title: Persian Dill Pickles
ingredients: 1 lb fresh edible flower | 6 cups hot red chili peppers, coarsely chopped | 1 pinch saffron thread | ice | 4 cups dill pickle slices
instructions: In a large bowl, toss together the hot peppers through the saffron, then add enough ice to cover. Place the pickles in a freezer bag. Place 4 tablespoons ice in each glass and freeze until hard, at least 2 hours. About an hour before serving, transfer the pickles to a serving bowl. Garnish with pickle slices and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper,onion soup mix,marshmallow,watercress,red bell pepper,confectioner sugar,white vinegar,lamb
title: Lamb with marshmallow and Relish
ingredients: 1/2 pound ground lamb | 1 teaspoon minced onion soup mix | 2 1/2 cups sweet potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced | 1 package sweetened marshmallows | 1 jar sliced jalapeno peppers, drained and coarsely chopped | 1/4 red bell pepper, chopped | 1/4 cup white vinegar | 2 tablespoons watercress, chopped | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Cook and stir beef and onion soup mix in the hot skillet until thoroughly mixed. Stir sweet potatoes and marshmallows into meat mixture until well coated. Mix jalapeno peppers, red bell pepper, vinegar and watercress into meat mixture. Place meat mixture in a casserole dish, and cover with plastic wrap. Place dish on a wire rack.

Random Ingredients: poppy seed,russet potato,tomato,chunky salsa,anchovy paste,cardamom pod,rom tomato
title: Poppy Seed Potato Chipolte, South African
ingredients: 1/2 cup chunky salsa | 1/4 cup tomato, chopped | 1 teaspoon poppy seed | 1/2 teaspoon anchovy paste | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom pod ( or 2-3 pods ) | 2 russet potatoes, peeled & thinly sliced | 3 roma tomatoes, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Mix all ingredients& transfer to baking sheet. Bake 40 - 45 min or until golden brown and bubbly. Let cool and serve immediately. You can put the chips straight on the grill or toast in a dry skillet for a couple of minutes on each side over a low heat if you like or place on the broiler pan on a baking sheet with a lid & broil till browned and bubbly. Remove from oven& place on a plate and cool on a rack. You can also freeze this if needed. You can place chipolte in an ice cream maker or on the rack & bake for 10 minutes until hard.

Random Ingredients: hard egg,zucchini,red chili pepper,chili pepper flake,lasagna noodle,pimiento,tomato onion
title: Easy Baked Zucchini Lasagne
ingredients: 1 lb zucchini, chopped | 6 hard-boiled eggs | 12 lasagna noodles | 1 jar pimientos, drained | 6 canned red chili peppers, drained | 2 -3 teaspoons red chili pepper flakes | 2 jars tomatoes with onions, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Combine zucchini, eggs and sliced hard boiled eggs and lightly mix in 2 - 3 chopped green onions. Arrange 4 noodles, overlapping the slices. Pour 1/5 of the tomato and 1/5 of the pimentos over the zucchini mixture. Top with remaining noodles. Top with remaining tomatoes and pimentos. In a small bowl, add 1 tsp of chili flakes to each jar of chopped canned chiles and mix. Add 1 tbsp chili mixture to each jar of chopped green chili peppers and blend. Pour 1/5 of tomato mixture over tomato mixture in casserole dish. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake for 90 minutes. Remove foil and cook 15 more minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Sausage Sticks (Sausages With Wine, Lemon Pepper & Wine)
ingredients: 12 -14 ounces sweet italian sausages | 2 tablespoons lemon pepper ( fresh & minced! )
instructions: Prick the sausages numerous times with a fork & place into a well oiled pan. Sprinkle evenly with lemon pepper & reduce the heat to a golden brown. Bake at 325 degrees f for 35 - 45 mins to 1&1/2 hr. Serve hot or at room temperature.

title: Campari With Asparagus
ingredients: 2 tablespoons lite olive oil | 2 tablespoons fresh dill, chopped | 8 ounces asparagus, trimmed, cut diagonally into thirds | 2 cans campari | 1 can kidney beans, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. In a large bowl combine asparagus with campari, and transfer to a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake, uncovered, for 30 minutes or until asparagus is tender and top is golden brown.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,prosciutto,shortening,apple juice,dijon mustard,orange juice,flour tortilla
title: Apple, Cheese or Cheese French Fries
ingredients: 2 - 2 1/2 cups thinly sliced proscuitto, divided | 2 tablespoons shortening, softened | 1/4 cup apple juice, cold | 2 tablespoons orange juice, fresh squeezed or 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 can low-fat cream of mushroom soup, undiluted | 1 -2 flour tortilla
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Arrange half the proscuitto slices on an ungreased baking sheet and lightly brush with shortening. Sprinkle the remaining prosscuitto slices with salt and pepper. Spread apple juice and orange juice over them. In a small bowl, combine mustard, soup, remaining proscuitto and salt and pepper. Spread evenly over the prosscuitto slices. Cover the pan with aluminum foil and bake for about 30 minutes or until lightly browned. Remove foil and bake 10 - 15 minutes longer or until golden. Serve with sour cream, chopped onions, cheese, etc.

title: Pineapple Balsamic Dressing
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups pineapple juice | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1/2 cup white poppy seeds
instructions: In a blender, combine first four ingredients.

title: Lobster (Furniture) Burfi
ingredients: 1 lb lobster ( cleaned and de-boned ) | 12 black cardamom pods ( finely crushed ) | 1 cup soft lobster | kosher cocoa powder | 1 large eggplant ( peeled and cut into cubes )
instructions: Rinse the lobster thoroughly with cold running water and place in a large pot. If your lobster is fresh, wash it first with cold running water and place into a pan of boiling water for about 30 - 45 minutes, or until the lobster is white all the way to the shell. Remove from heat and drain the shells and set aside. Place the lobster shells and lobster meat in a food processor and process until smooth. Place into a bowl and mix with the cocoa powder. Add the eggplant cubes and mix thoroughly. Add in the lobster tails and blend well. Scoop out the desired amount of stuffing and serve with bread or french rolls.

title: Bahama Bay Bugs
ingredients: 1/4 lb cod ( small ) | 1/4 lb pumpkin ( in winter, if possible ) or 1/4 lb winter squash ( in winter, if possible ) | 1/4 lb ham ( small dice ) or 1/4 lb pork ( small dice ) | 1 teaspoon black mustard seeds | 2 -3 tablespoons dry sherry
instructions: Wash bugs thoroughly under cold running water. Drain well. Place all ingredients in a pot with cold water to cover. Bring to boil, lower heat and simmer for 50 - 55 minutes to 2 - 3 minutes. Drain the water from the pot, remove bugs, and serve hot or as a condiment to meat dish and poultry. You may also serve it cold as a dipping sauce for fish.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,vanilla bean,graham cracker crumb,hard egg,star anise,rosemary,creme de cacao
title: Chocolate French Kiss
ingredients: 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs | 3 tablespoons pure vanilla bean paste | 1 large star anise | 2 teaspoons fresh rosemary, finely chopped | 1 large hard-boiled egg, chopped | 2 tablespoons pineapple juice | 2 tablespoons creme de cacao, or more to taste
instructions: Set oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source and preheat the oven's broiler. Mix graham cracker crumbs, vanilla bean paste, star anise, rosemary, egg, pineapple juice, and creme de cacao together in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,farfalle pasta,tomato green chilies,date
title: Pasta Alentejana
ingredients: 1 lb farfalle pasta ( bowtie pasta ) | 3/4 cup dates, chopped small | 3/4 cup pitted black mediterranean tomatoes with green chilies, chopped small | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar
instructions: Cook pasta according to directions on box, or until al dente. Drain and keep warm. Combine remaining ingredients and toss over pasta. Serve immediately.

title: Fried Chicana Fritters
ingredients: 1 lb thick slab bacon or 1 lb bacon | pomegranate molasses | taco sauce | 1 cup flour
instructions: Break bacon up into tiny pieces and fry in microwave until completely cooked. In a mixing bowl roll warm pomegranate molasses and taco sauce together. In a large frying pan over medium heat fry bacon until it begins to crisp, remove bacon and fry the fritters until completely browned drain on paper towel, serve with pomegranate molasses for dipping.

title: Italian Seasoning Mix for Meatballs
ingredients: 2 teaspoons dried oregano | 2 teaspoons lemon extract | 2 teaspoons dried italian seasoned breadcrumbs
instructions: Dampen hands and dry meatballs with the back of a spoon. Roll meatballs in crumbs. Set in a dish with a tight fitting lid. To a slow cooker, add all three ingredients and combine. Stir. Cover, set to high and cook until done, setting a timer for 40 minutes after the hour of cooking time.

Random Ingredients: lettuce,fish sauce,sesame seed,leek,spinach leaf,cayenne pepper,marjoram,black bean
title: Spinach and Black Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups spinach leaves | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 2/3 cup sliced leeks | 1/2 teaspoon ground black beans or 1/2 teaspoon chili sauce | 1/4 teaspoon dried marjoram | 2 teaspoons fish sauce | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 cup shredded lettuce
instructions: Heat a heavy nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add the sesame seeds and cook, stirring frequently, for 1 minute. Remove from heat. Place the spinach in a salad bowl. Scatter the leeks over the spinach. Sprinkle black beans over the leeks and stir in the marjoram, fish sauce, cayenne pepper, and lettuce and mix well. Drizzle with the sesame seeds. Serve immediately.

title: Sweet Prawn and Mango Curry With Mango
ingredients: 2 poblano chiles | 2 -3 teaspoons mango powder | 1 -2 teaspoon curry powder ( or as per your like ) | 2 teaspoons lime juice
instructions: Soak poblanos in water about 45 minutes prior to making the curry.. They'll cook more quickly. They're really starting to open.. Rinse after 45 minutes. When poblanos are soft, cut off the stem. Remove seeds and wash the poblanos. Cut them up fine. Chop flesh about 1 inch squares. Put poblanos and mango in a blender. Add curry powder. Mix until smooth. Add lime juice, mix til you get the right consistency. I sometimes add an extra lime. Put in a plate and serve.

title: Chinese Beef on the Belly Roll-Ups
ingredients: 3/4 lb ground beef | 1 teaspoon msg | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon lime rind, grated | 1 baked pie shell | 1/2 cup gruyere
instructions: Brown meat with msg until no longer pink. If there are excess juice you may want to use the next time. Drain and cool completely. Mix oyster sauce and lime rind. Dip the inside of the pastry shell in the liquid, letting some of the excess go in the cavity. Slice the meat into thin slices. Put some of the meat slices inside pastry shell. Place on top of meat. Sprinkle gruyere on top, if desired. Roll like a jelly roll. Repeat with the rest of the meat, place on top and then sprinkle on more cheese. Bake 425 and cook 25 minutes. Cut into slices and enjoy.

title: Shallot Powder
ingredients: 1 teaspoon mustard seeds ( optional ) | 8 ounces coarsely ground walnuts or 8 ounces unsalted butter, room temperature | 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped fresh mint leaves ( or 2 tsp dry mint leaves ) | 1 teaspoon dry mustard | 2 whole red chile | 1 tablespoon good quality mustard oil or 1 tablespoon walnut oil
instructions: Put the mustard seeds into a small skillet and toast over moderate heat, stirring, a few times, until they are fragrant, about 10 seconds. Let cool. Stir together the walnuts, mint leaves, mustard and chile. Slowly drizzle in the mustard oil and stir until well blended, then season with salt and pepper to taste. Enjoy.

title: Fried Cabbage and Meat Tenderizer
ingredients: 1 large head of cabbage, cored, chopped into bite size pieces | 1 package frozen meat tenderizer
instructions: Place cabbage in a large dutch oven. Cover with 2 cups cold water. Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer for 40 minutes. Drain well. Place tenderizer in a colander and lightly crush with a rolling pin. Place into hot deep heavy skillet. When water begins to boil, drain cabbage and place on skillet. Slice and stir meat tenderizer through the cabbage. Serve hot. Leftovers freeze well.

title: Yemenite Radish & Daikon
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg daikon radishes, washed | 4 tablespoons coarsely chopped marjoram | 1/3 kg sliced olives
instructions: Put daikon in a bowl & cover with 3 tbsp water, let stand for 20 minutes, drain. Cut into 2 cm cubes. Heat 2 tbsp oil in wok, add marjoram. When it sizzles, add daikon and toss. Stir well until daikon absorbs the oil. Keep tossing & tossing till daikon is cooked.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,cucumber,cola,flour,cocoa,garlic powder,chicken breast half,cayenne
title: Easy Chicken Cola
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves, cut into 1 '' | 1 cup cola | 4 green bell peppers, sliced into 1 '' strips | 6 cubes cola | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/4 cup flour | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne | 2 cups cucumbers, sliced
instructions: Cook chicken in cola, green bell pepper and 1/2 cube of cola in skillet on med high until chicken is cooked. Drain off grease. Mix remaining cola with the garlic powder and cayenne. Set aside. Add remaining cola and cucumbers to skillet with the chicken meat. Cover and simmer for 5 minutes until sauce is well blended. Serve over white rice.

Random Ingredients: cocoa,meatball,garlic pepper seasoning,red cabbage,rice wine vinegar
title: Korean Beef and Pork Sausage #RSC
ingredients: 1 package frozen cooked meatballs | 1 lb red cabbage ( shredded or julienned ) | 2 tablespoons cocoa | 3 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | garlic pepper seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Cook meatballs and cabbage about 15 minutes until meatballs are cooked through. Drain and set aside. Combine cocoa and vinegar in a small sauce pan. Heat until warm. Add the garlic pepper seasoning and bring to a boil. Add meatballs and cabbage and simmer until heated through, about 5 - 8 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Spanish Onion Condiment
ingredients: 1 small spanish onion, thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Mix well and store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: steak seasoning,kaffir lime leaf,egg noodle,sage,amaretto liqueur,grand marnier,mint leaf
title: Bergie's Noodles
ingredients: 1 package egg noodles | 1/2 cup grand marnier | 1/2 cup amaretto liqueur | 2 tablespoons grand marnier | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage | 1/2 teaspoon dried mint leaves | 1 pound flank steak seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon dried leaf rubbed sage
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the egg noodles, 1/2 cup grand marnier, amaretto liqueur, 1/2 teaspoon dried sage, 1/2 teaspoon dried mint leaves, flank steak seasoning, and dried leaf rubbed sage. Return to a boil, then reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until tender, about 12 minutes.

title: Baked Beef and Rice Pilaf With Raisins and Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 cups brown rice, uncooked | 1 cup dried cherries ( canned or fresh or cherry tomatoes ) | 1/2 cup raisins | 1 lb ground sirloin | 1 can chicken broth, undiluted | 1/2 cup quick-cooking pasta or 1/2 cup macaroni, uncooked
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f in a small pan add the brown rice, cherries, raisins and brown beef. Cook and stir until beef is brown and ingredients are coated well. In a 10 x 3 x 2 inch baking dish add the cooked rice mixture, chicken broth and spaghetti or macaroni. Bring to boil and reduce heat to a simmer. Cover and bake, stirring occasionally, for about 25 minutes or until beef is cooked through, and rice is tender. Stir in the saffron rice, cover and bake an additional 10 minutes or until heated through.

Random Ingredients: rice vinegar,purpose flour,honey mustard,sambal oelek,kiwi fruit,tri tip steak,pearl barley
title: BBQ Steak on Hawaiian Roll
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef tri-tip steak ( or other steak of your choice ) | 2 teaspoons honey mustard | 1/3 cup pearl barley | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 2 tablespoons seasoned rice vinegar | 3 -4 teaspoons sambal oelek | 1 kiwi fruit, sliced thinly ( optional )
instructions: Trim all excess fat from the steak and cut into long strips. Place on a plate and cover with plastic wrap. Place in the fridge to marinate at least 30 minutes and up to a day. Combine the grain mustard, flour and rice vinegar in a large bowl. Add the sambal oelek. Toss to coat. Add the sliced kiwi.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,basil,sriracha hot sauce,pie crust,asparagus,baking soda,fajita seasoning mix,kaffir lime leaf
title: Asparagus Fajitas
ingredients: 2 pounds asparagus, trimmed | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 jar sriracha hot sauce, divided | 1 cup vegetable stock | 1 package fresh kaffir lime leaves | 1 package fajita seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh basil
instructions: Preheat an oven to 325 degrees f. Grease a baking sheet. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook the asparagus in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until just tender, about 10 minutes. Drain. Place the asparagus in a large bowl and pour enough boiling water over them to cover. Set aside. Sift the baking soda into a saucepan. Place 1/2 cup of sriracha hot sauce in the saucepan, and add the vegetable stock. Bring to a boil, then set aside. In a small bowl, combine 1/4 cup of sriracha hot sauce and the lime leaves. Brush both sides of asparagus with the lime juice and vegetable stock mixture. Bake in the preheated oven until the fish is easily flaked with a fork, about 20 minutes. Place asparagus on warm serving plates, and top with the remaining sauce, and the basil. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: tonic water,tabasco sauce,coconut milk,arugula,ancho chile powder,scallop,saffron
title: Prawns in Saffron-Ancho Chile Coconut Soup
ingredients: 1 2 pounds scallops or other large scallops | 5 ancho chile powder ( ancho or new mexico chile powder ) | 3/4 teaspoon saffron | 1 pinch tabasco sauce | 1/3 cup coconut milk | 1/2 cup ticine water | 1 bunch arugula
instructions: Place scallops or scallops in a colander and sprinkle with ancho chili powder or pasilla chili powder. Let marinate for 1 to 2 hours. Discard the scoorishiness and drain well. Meanwhile, dissolve saffron in coconut milk. Bring coconut milk to a boil and cook for 10 minutes to reduce. Stir in scallops and marinated ancho chili powder. Simmer until shrimp are just cooked enough to turn pink, stirring a few times. Wash arugula and toss in a strainer with a little olive oil to keep from sticking. Dump in shrimp mixture, cover and simmer just until the shrimp are pink. Serve in bowls with arugula as a garnish.

title: Tomato Cheese and Fish Salad
ingredients: 1/4 pound tomato sauce, prepared | 1 tablespoon chopped leeks | 1 pound white fish fillets, cut into strips | 4 ounces aged boursin cheese, crumbled
instructions: Bring a large pan of salted water to a boil. Add the tomato sauce and chopped leeks.

title: Pot Roast
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs beef rump roast | 1 can of coarsely chopped tomatoes | 1 head savoy cabbage
instructions: Place roast in the slow cooker. Add tomatoes and savoury cabbage to beef and juice the tomatoes add salt and pepper and stir. Cover slow cooker and cook on low setting until meat is very tender about 8 - 10 hours.

title: Cauliflower Corn Fritters With North African Spices
ingredients: 4 green plantains | 2 large cauliflower florets | 1 tablespoon gluten | 1 3/4 tablespoons gluten | 2 tablespoons flour | 1 stalk fresh thyme | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 teaspoon dried fenugreek leaves
instructions: Cut plantains into quarters lengthwise and then crosswise into 1/8 inch slices. Peel the cauliflower florets and cut the florets crosswise into 1/8 inch slices. Place cauliflower into a large strainer for about 8 minutes or until the water runs clear. Rinse well and then drain. Dry the florets lightly with paper towels. In a food processor or blender, process the cauliflower, fenugreek, flour and 1 t. Of the thyme into a thick paste. In a measuring cup, stir together the remaining 1 t. Thyme, vinegar and cornstarch. Add a tbsp of water if mixture's too thick. Set aside. Heat an oiled wok or deep fat fryer to 375 degrees f or until a bead of water instantly sizzles.

title: Egg Mousse With Soy Milk
ingredients: 400 g soymilk ( or other milk of choice ) | salt
instructions: Put the soy milk in a small saucepan, bring to the boil and stir continuously until the liquid starts to thicken, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,tomato soup,salmon fillet,confectioner ' sugar,lamb
title: Lamb and Salmon (Lomo Saltada Al Diavolo)
ingredients: 4 lbs whole lamb | 1 lb salmon fillet | 4 cups tomato soup | 4 cups dry white wine vinegar | 2 cups confectioners'sugar
instructions: In a large pot, cover lamb with enough fresh water to just cover meat. Add salt and bring to a boiling. Skim foam from surface as it will continue boiling. Cover and cook over low heat to about 3 hours. When a knife comes out dry, remove lamb from pot and allow to cool. Using a meat hammer, hammer the lamb to 1 inch wide pieces. Remove bones and any bones that float to the surface. In a large container, mix together tomato soup and white wine vinegar. Place lamb in this solution. Turn often until the mixture is the consistancy of a thick tomato sauce. Cover and refrigerate overnight. In a bowl, mix confectioner's sugar with enough water into a paste to make an icing. Remove salmon from liquid and coat on both sides. Serve with the hot salad.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,ancho chile powder,mexican chili bean,rice wine,coriander seed,star anise
title: Ancho Chili Beans (Hot and Spicy)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons coriander seeds | 1 tablespoon hot mexican chili beans | 1 star anise | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes ( to taste ) | 1/4 cup rice wine | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder, crushed ( or 1/2 teaspoon crushed chiles ) ( optional )
instructions: Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Place coriander seeds in pan. Sprinkle each with ancho chili and chili powder and roast, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 2 minutes. Scrape the mixture into a small bowl and allow to cool. Refrigerate any remaining ancho chili powder mixture.

title: Rice and Accent Flavoured Crisco
ingredients: 2 teaspoons cooking oil | 1 cup basmati rice | 1 teaspoon accent seasoning | 1 tablespoon brown sugar
instructions: Stir fry rice in oil until color changes. Stir in Accent seasoning and brown sugar and turn off heat. Leave to stand for 5 mins covered. Stir well before cutting into squares.

title: Oops for One
ingredients: 1 whole squid ( cleaned and cut into rings ) | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/3 cup quick-cooking oats
instructions: Sprinkle the turmeric powder on the cut squid and leave aside. Heat up 1/3 c water in a pan until the water comes to a boil. Add oat and cover with lid. Allow to boil for 2 min being careful not to overcook it. Place whole squid in a bowl of a tea towel over the sink.

title: Cured Ribs
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs country-style pork ribs | 1 1/2 lbs country-style pork ribs | 2 bunches dill, leaves picked
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°f. Rinse the ribs under cold, running water and remove any extra blood. Place them in a large dutch oven in a single layer, add water to cover them, and bake them, uncovered, 1 1/2 hours, or until tender. Drain the pork, reserving the water and bones, and reserve the cooking water. Cool the ribs until the skin loosens from the bone and then cut them into 3/4 inch pieces. Rinse the bones and serve them as finger food or as accompaniment to salads.

Random Ingredients: apple juice,sesame seed,rotel tomato chilies,water chestnut,rosemary leaf,italian seasoning,shiitake mushroom cap
title: Sesame Mushroom
ingredients: 6 tablespoons sesame seeds ( dark, or white ) | 4 tablespoons apple juice | 3 mushrooms, cleaned, trimmed, sliced thin ( i use mixed mushrooms ) | 1 can whole canned tomatoes with chilies, drained | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained, reserving | 1 tablespoon dried italian seasoning | 2 teaspoons dried rosemary leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Pulverize the sesame seeds in a blender and set aside. In a large bowl, combine the sesame seeds, apples and juice. Add the mushrooms, tomatoes, water chestnuts and italian seasoning. Stir to combine and spread the mixture into a 9x13 baking dish, then sprinkle the top with the reserved sesame seeds. Bake until the top has a golden color, 50 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Tandoori Style Ricotta
ingredients: 2 lbs ricotta, unshelled | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Wash and dry ricotta, place in a bowl. Cover with water. Add turmeric, mix it well, and refrigerate. Line a cookie sheet with parchment paper, lay it in the oven, and preheat oven for 10 minutes. Remove ricotta from water and place in the bowl it was boiled in, pour 1/4 cup water around the bowl and mix well. Remove the bowl from the oven and sprinkle with 1/4 teaspoon turmeric. Place in oven for 10 minutes, stir around, and continue checking for a golden crust, or it needs a little longer and maybe a little more water. The longer it stays in the oven, the darker it gets.

title: Honey Chestnut Champagne
ingredients: 80 g honey chestnuts | 200 ml champagne | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme leave, chopped ( or 1 t. dried, if fresh ) or 2 teaspoons dried, chopped thyme ( or 1 t. dried, if fresh ) | water ( as required ) or sparkling wine, to taste ( as required )
instructions: Heat a pan over high heat, add the honey chestnuts, and toast over a medium heat, stirring constantly, until they become aromatic and begin to smell fragrant.. When they are toasted, stir in the champagne. Remove from heat and stir in the thyme leaves or dried thyme and the fresh water or sparkling wine until your guests have a choice. Leave at room temperature. Serve.

Random Ingredients: sharp white cheddar cheese,mushroom,taco meat,vanilla extract,pork loin chop
title: Taco Chops
ingredients: 4 pork loin chops, 1-inch thick | 2 cups shredded sharp white cheddar cheese | 3 cups sliced mushrooms | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 package taco meat
instructions: Spray an 11 x 7 x 2 inch glass baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Arrange the pork chops in a single layer in the dish. Sprinkle the cheese and mushrooms over the pork chops. Pour the vegetable juice over the cheese and mushrooms. Cover and refrigerate for 8 hours. Remove the pork chops from the marinade and discard marinade. Sprinkle the surface of the pork chops with the vanilla or other desired seasonings. Arrange the pork with the reserved marinade in the dish. Bake, uncovered, at 375 degrees for 20 to 25 minutes or until done.

title: Mom's Ramen Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 pound ground beef chuck | 12 ounces shirataki-style ramen noodles, broken into thirds | 1/4 cup blanched slivered almonds | 2 packages roasted peanuts | 3 large fresh tomatillos, cut into wedges lengthwise
instructions: In a skillet, brown ground beef. When no longer pink, drain. Place the ground beef into a bowl. Add the ramen noodles, slivered almonds, and peanuts. Toss well to coat. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: fennel seed,chipotle chile,kiwi fruit,chive,whipping cream,coffee granule,wine,dill
title: Kiwi Fool
ingredients: 1 cup sugar | 1/2 cup whipping cream | 1 teaspoon instant coffee granules | 2 -3 drops worcestershire sauce | freshly grated kiwi fruit | freshly ground fennel seed | chopped chives ( to garnish ) | 1 pinch dried dill
instructions: Using an electric mixer, blend together the sugar and cream until creamy, then whip in the coffee granules and wile sauce. Fold in the kiwis, then garnish with chives, fennel, and dill before serving.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,red bell pepper,red lentil,pie shell,bouillon cube,pineapple juice,grand marnier
title: Sweet Red Lentil Pie
ingredients: 2 cans red lentils | 1 bouillon cube | 1 red bell pepper, diced | 1 green chili pepper, minced | 1 tablespoon grand marnier | 1 cup pineapple juice | 1 pie shell, unbaked
instructions: Place lentils in large pot with cold water to cover. Bring to boil, reduce heat to medium low and cook 2 hours, until lentils are tender. Drain. Place lentils and 1 bouillon cube in a 4 quart casserole dish. Dice pepper and add along with the chili pepper stirring to coat. Pour water over the lentils completely cover and cook about 30 minutes at stir every 10 minutes until lentils are tender. Remove cover from casserole and add remainder of broth. Continue cooking and stirring until lentils are tender and liquid is reduced, about 20 - 25 minutes. Remove from heat, stir in grand marnier and pineapple juice and leave in until serving time.

Random Ingredients: white onion,plain yogurt,salmon,kahlua,green bell pepper,cucumber,coconut rum
title: The Real Irishman's Delight
ingredients: 3/4 pound salmon, cut into chunks | 1 container plain yogurt | 1/2 cup coconut rum | 1 teaspoon finely chopped white onion | 1/2 teaspoon finely chopped green bell pepper | 1/2 cucumber - peeled, seeded, and finely chopped | 1 tablespoon kahlua
instructions: Place salmon in a large, resealable plastic zipper bag. Mix yogurt, coconut rum, minced onion, bell pepper, cucumber, and kahlua together in a small bowl.

title: Argentinean Baked Stuffed Jalapeno Peppers (Coxinhas
ingredients: 4 large jalapeno peppers, halved and stems quartered | 1 lb american cheese, sliced thickly | 1 lb fresh lasagna noodle, cooked | 2 teaspoons rice flour | 1 -2 teaspoon cracked peppercorn | 1 slice prosciutto
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Cut slit of peppers on the sides and remove seeds. Carefully open and trim off tops 1/4 from top. Remove peels with a spoon. Remove all seeds and white membrane from inside peppers. Wrap with plastic wrap and set in a large baking dish. Place in the oven and set aside at room temperature for 25 minutes. Remove peppers from oven and let cool for ten minutes. Using a small bowl or teaspoon, mix the cheese and the rice flour. Stuff a slice of cheese over each pepper. Stuff the pepper open and fold in the prosciutto. Sprinkle each stuffed pepper with cracked peppercorns. Place wrapped peppers in a single layer, skin side up. Place peppers in baking dish and bake for 15 minutes.

title: Crock-Pot Baked Chicken With Fruits and Mango
ingredients: 200 g mangoes | 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg or 1 teaspoon cinnamon | cooking spray | 8 chicken breast fillets | olive ( optional )
instructions: Place the mangoes and a dash of nutmeg in the bottom of a 4 - 5 litre capacity crockpot. Spray with oil and roll up firmly. Spray the top of the chicken with oil. Place in a plastic bag and put in the crockpot on top of the mangoes. I use my pressure cooker, this one, just so that the mango can pick out the juices and set it to high for 10 minutes. I then cook the chicken for around 20 mins on high, then reduce the temperature to low. Cover and leave for a further 20 mins, until the chicken is cooked through and cooked through. Remove the chicken from the crockpot when the juices run clear and allow to stand. Remove the string and cut into slices if there is any remaining fruit. Serve the chicken immediately with the fruit and a drizzle of olive oil if you wish.

title: Quick and Easy Chicken
ingredients: 4 tablespoons butter or 4 tablespoons oil | 2 tablespoons flour | 1 medium chicken or 2 chicken stock cubes, dissolved in | 1 cup chicken stock or 1 cup vegetable stock | 1 tomatoes or 1 small tomatoes, sliced thinly
instructions: Melt the butter or oil in the bottom of the cooker. Add the flour and mix well. Fry for 1 minute. Add the stock and bring to boil. Put the chicken on top of the base and pour in the stock over the chicken. Cook on low for about 45 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink on the surface.

title: Garlicky Garlic Bread
ingredients: 1 large garlic | 2 tablespoons cream of tartar | 1 loaf fresh mozzarella ball, thinly sliced | 1/3 cup cashew pieces | 1/2 teaspoon dried mint | breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place garlic on a foil lined baking sheet. Bake in preheated oven for 10 - 15 minutes. Remove from oven. Set aside and allow to cool. Once cool, crush garlic with garlic press or the flat side of a cleaver. Add cream of tarter, mozzarella, cashews, mint and some bread crumbs to garlic. Toss to combine. Transfer to a serving plate. Serve with crackers.

title: Gingerbread Crumpets
ingredients: 4 cups miniature marshmallows | 1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger
instructions: Prepare 1 sheet pan with pam for cooking spray. Place marshmallows in medium bowl and sprinkle with ginger. Spoon marshmallow mixture into 1 cup miniature marshmallows. Drop rounded tablespoon 1 tablespoon at a time onto pam coated pan, tilting pan as necessary. Cook until marshmallows are just melted, 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Baked Purslane Cheese
ingredients: 1 package fresh mozzarella cheese | 1 container frozen crumb, thawed | 2 pints fresh purslane, leaves only, washed to remove sand
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Remove the mozzarella cheese from the refrigerator and cut the cheese into strips about 2 inches long and 2 inches wide. Tear off about 1 pound of the mozzarella and place in a medium bowl. Add the crumbs, the remaining 2 pounds of mozzarella, the purslane leaves, and the salt and pepper to taste. Toss and thoroughly mix together to blend. Place about 1/2 tablespoon of mixture in the center of each graham cracker shell. Roll the filled shells up around the cheese and place in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Cover with aluminum foil and bake for 45 minutes in the preheated oven. Uncover and continue baking until golden, 30 to 40 more minutes.

title: Cream Cheese Smoked Salmon
ingredients: 1/2 cup light cream cheese | 2 salmon fillets, about 1 lb each
instructions: Spread cream cheese evenly on both sides of salmon. Preheat grill to high. Wrap salmon in aluminium foil. Place fish, skin side down, on grill rack that has been lightly oiled. Grill salmon for about 8 minutes.

title: Roasted Zucchini and Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 large zucchini | 1 can plum tomatoes, with juices, chopped
instructions: Slice zucchini lengthwise into quarters. In a roasting pan, arrange zucchini quarters on top, skin sides down, with juices. Stir plum tomatoes so all is coated. Roast in a 400 degree f oven for 20 minutes, or until zucchini is tender. Let cool.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,bran cereal,spaghetti,basil,jumbo pasta shell,corn syrup
title: Jamaican Nachos
ingredients: 2 boxes jumbo pasta shells | 1 jar jumbo pasta shells | 6 ounces bran cereal ( like bran or rice krispies ) | 1/4 cup light corn syrup | 2/3 - 3/4 cup shredded monterey jack cheese | 1/2 teaspoon dried basil
instructions: In a large pot of lightly salted boiling water, cook the spaghetti until tender but firm, about 10 minutes. Drain well and set up a side. Meanwhile, put the shells on a baking sheet and preheat oven to 350 degrees. Line the bottom of a 11x 7 glass baking dish with cooked or microwavable noodles. In a small bowl stir together the corn syrup and corn syrup until they are light and fluffy. Stir in the cheese and basil. Add the cooked noodles and toss well to combine. Serve the mixture hot in paper or plastic cups, with the cheese mixture sprinkled on top.

title: Chili-Garlic Sauce(Nepal)
ingredients: 2 cups green olives ( you can use black or regular olives. i've tried using pink or black, if preferred ) | 2 tablespoons chinese chili-garlic sauce | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 1/8 teaspoon dried thyme
instructions: In blender or food processor, process lebanese olives in hot garlic sauce til smooth. Add salt, thyme and process til smooth. Sauce can be served with meats, vegetables, noodles or soup.

title: Chocolate Sausages
ingredients: 500 g pork sausage | 1/2 cup cocoa | 1/3 cup chopped italian parsley | pastry flour, for rolling
instructions:
Place chci sausage and enough pastry to roll out | chili oil, to taste, for rubbing 

 ## Cooking instructions ##
 Roll out dough into thin sheets and cut each sheet into 2 rectangles. Roll one sausage in it to seal the roll. Cover with a damp cloth for half an hour. When the dough has rolled out, roll each strip again and cut into 3 rounds with a rolling pin. Heat up your chili oil, place all the rounds out on a clean tea towel and brush with a little oil to stop them drying out. Cook until golden brown. Let cool. Eat or seal with a chocolate glaze.

Random Ingredients: banana,curd cottage cheese,velveeta cheese,bread crumb,tabasco sauce
title: Banana Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 lb dry bread crumbs | 1 lb velveeta cheese, cut into cubes | 6 links small banana pieces | 2 cans small curd cottage cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons tabasco sauce, if desired | 1 loaf bread crumb
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In a large bowl toss together bread crumbs and velveeta cubes. In a 4 quart baking dish, layer half of the crumb mixture, cheese, bananas and half of the bread crumb mixture.

title: Kerry Fruit Appetizer
ingredients: 1 lb kiwi fruit or 1 lb orange, peeled and sliced to 1/2-inch thickness ( 2 cups ) | 12 asparagus, peeled, steamed and cut diagonally into 1 inch lengths ( 2 cups ) | 3/4 cup bourbon whiskey
instructions: Combine all ingredients.

Random Ingredients: cilantro,red capsicum,coriander powder,cardamom,plum tomato,cider vinegar,tabasco sauce,citron peel
title: Indian Relish
ingredients: 7 cups plum tomatoes, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup red capsicum, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup fresh cilantro, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup coriander powder | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom | 2 teaspoons citron peel, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 2 teaspoons cider vinegar
instructions: In a large bowl combine the tomatoes, capsicums, cilantro, coriander, cardamom and citron stir in the worcestershire sauce and cider vinegar. Cover and keep in the refrigerator for up to 1 week or until serving time.

Random Ingredients: breadcrumb,russet potato,french bread,chocolate,anchovy fillet,green bell pepper
title: Anchovy Chocolate Breadcrumb Bread Appetizer
ingredients: 500 500 g russet potatoes or 500 g butternut squash | 2 teaspoons dried anchovy fillets, roughly chopped | 150 g grated chocolate ( to taste, i use dark ) or 150 g milk chocolate ( to taste, i use dark ) | 1 green bell pepper, diced ( to taste, i use optional ) | breadcrumbs, seasoned ( see my description ) | 20 g french bread, sliced and toasted
instructions: Wash and steam the washed and peeled potatoes or squash until tender but not mushy. Drain, mash potatoes with the anchovy paste.

Random Ingredients: cake flour,potato starch,beef tenderloin,rotel tomato,cranberry,spanish paprika,pasta
title: Cranberry Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 2 teaspoons potato starch | 1 teaspoon cornstarch | 1 lb beef tenderloin | 1 teaspoon spanish paprika | 1 can rotel tomatoes | 3/4 cup fresh cranberries | 1 package frozen potato starch
instructions: Place beef in skillet and sprinkle with 1 tsp of potato starch and corn starch to coat. Brown roast until nice and tan colored, about 10 - 15 minutes, then add paprika and rotel tomatoes with juice. Simmer for 2 minutes and add 2 tsp corn starch to thaw the remaining potatoes and cranberries. Taste and add more salt if necessary. Slice tenderloin across the grain into thin slices, and place in pan. Bring sauce to boil, then cover and simmer 5 minutes or until meat is tender. Serve over your favorite pasta, or over whole wheat egg noodles.

title: Crunchy Bean Cakes
ingredients: 1/4 cup millet | 2 -6 ounces pears, chopped | 1/2 small red chili, finely chopped | 1/4 cup black olives, chopped | 2 tablespoons arugula lettuce, coarsely chopped | 2 large egg whites, lightly beaten | 1 tablespoon mirin | 5 ounces bean sprouts
instructions: Put millet in a small saucepan with the pears, chilli, black olives and arugula. Mix well and cover with enough boiling water. Cook for 20 - 25 minutes, keeping the lid off to keep the mixture watery. Drain off the water completely. Fry the bean sprouts in a little oil, drain on paper towel and mix well. Scoop about 1 tablespoon of bean sprouts onto a skewer and spread over the bean sprouts. Roll lightly. Repeat until the bean sprouts are used up, adding more bean sprouts to the top if required.

title: Quick Beef Tenderloin - for Crock Pot
ingredients: 4 rump steak ( one-inch thick ) | 1/2 teaspoon lemon zest ( from fresh lemon )
instructions: Cut tenderloin crosswise 1/3 of the way down the center of each steak. Remove meat, reserving the cooking liquid. Score the surface of each steak into 1/4 slices. Place the whole peeled lemon into each steak. Place steak onto the lemon rinds. Pierce each piece with a fork about 1/2 inch deep. Place beef on your grill rack over medium high heat on your grill. Close the lid. Cook, turning once, until the meat thermometer reads 140 - 130 degreis or 140 degreis. When done, allow to rest for a few minutes before slicing or basting with the cooking liquid. Serve on a bed of fresh vegetables.

title: Spicy Indian Broccoli Ham & Veggie Casserole
ingredients: 2 cups broccoli florets | 2 chilies, roasted dried chilies, chopped | 2 ounces ham, chopped into 1 inch pieces | 1 cup mushroom, sliced | 2 tablespoons pumpkin seeds | 1/2 celery rib, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder
instructions: Cut broccoli, chillies and ham in half and place into a baking dish. In a blender or food processor, puree half of the beans, chick peas or split peas, mushrooms and pumpkin seeds until they are smooth. In a bowl, combine remaining ingredients, mix well, pour over broccoli and ham and bake in oven or covered casserole for 15 - 20 minutes.

title: Kielbasa and Chilli Kebabs
ingredients: 500 g beef tenderloin, ground | 2 -3 tablespoons turmeric, powder | 4 -5 slices kielbasa | 4 tablespoons green chilies | 3 tablespoons iceberg lettuce, shredded | 1 packet biscuits | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 2 -3 teaspoons low-fat milk or 2 -3 teaspoons coconut milk
instructions: Mix the ground burger with the turmeric powder and chilli powder. Slice the kielbasa into long strips. Divide the burger among the skewers. Set aside for at least 30minutes. Place a few slices on each skewer. Grill the kebabs approximately 6 8minutes on each side until crisp and cooked through. To serve, top with lettuce, beetroot, biscuits, and the vanilla essence. Serve with dipping sauces such as dipping sauces like lime and cream.

title: Easy Linguine
ingredients: 500 g linguine | 125 g brown onions, chopped | 1 tablespoon cumin powder | 3 teaspoons bread flour
instructions: Cook pasta, when it is done toss in olive oil and seasonings in a bowl. Pour into a large bowl and toss with a bowl.

title: Italian Aromatic Roasted Spice Rub
ingredients: 2 tablespoons anise seed | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke
instructions: Combine all ingredients and massage to the rims of a small jar, or to coat the meat. Allow to sit for 1 hour at room temperature, shaking the jar once a week.

title: Fajita Seasoning
ingredients: 8 pints ketchup, or as needed | 1/2 cup celery, chopped | 2 tablespoons ketchup, or as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Coat the inside of a roasting pan with cooking spray. In a large bowl, stir together the ketchup, celery, and ketchup until thoroughly combined. Spread the mixture into the prepared roasting pan. Cook in the preheated oven until ketchup is bubbling, 30 to 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pecan,beef,mexican cheese,anise seed,canola oil,green chilies,cheese cheddar,snow pea
title: Cheese Nests
ingredients: 2 cups shredded mexican blend cheese | 1 1/2 cups shredded pecans | 1 cup shredded reduced-fat mexican cheese blend | 2 cans diced green chilies | 1/2 lb ground beef | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 teaspoon anise seeds | 2 packages frozen snow pea, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to spray cookie sheet with nonstick spray. Combine pepper jack, mexican cheese, pecans and chilies in medium bowl. Press into bottom of greased cookie sheet. Bake at 400 for 5 - 6 minutes or until topping is slightly toasted. Combine beef, oil, aniseed, cheese mixture and green chilies. Stuff each chilie with 1/2 of the cheese mixture. Spoon beef mixture onto each chilie.

title: Salmon With Roasted Tomato Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons lemon zest, finely minced | 3 tablespoons fresh parsley, chopped | 2 plum tomatoes, sliced in wedges | 1 1/2 tablespoons light muscovado tomatoes or 1 1/2 tablespoons habanero-infused tomato sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons salted peanuts, toasted | 2 hass avocadoes, halved and stones removed | 2 1/4 lbs skinless salmon fillets, skin removed | peanut oil or vegetable oil
instructions: Lightly coat salad bowl with oil.

Random Ingredients: orange juice,red onion,chive,pea,hazelnut,superfine sugar,pizza sauce,fajita seasoning mix
title: Quick Pea Pizza
ingredients: 1 packet fajita seasoning mix | 1/4 - 1/3 cup red onion, chopped | 1/2 cup hazelnuts, toasted, chopped | 2 tablespoons chives, chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh orange juice | 500 g frozen peas, thawed | 7 3/4 ounces pizza sauce | 1/2 cup superfine sugar or 1/2 cup caster sugar
instructions: Cook fajita seasoning mix as per packet instructions. Drain. Cook onion on a large non stick frying pan with a splash of olive oil. Add the nuts and chives. Add orange juice, peas and pizza sauce to a non stick saucepan. Stir to combine. Cook 10 - 15 mins, stirring occasionally until warmed through, adding sugar a little at a time. Serve with crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,onion powder,masa harina,parmesan cheese
title: Onion and Pimento Scones
ingredients: 1/2 cup masa harina | 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1/4 teaspoon onion powder | 3 drops heavy whipping cream
instructions: In a bowl combine the first 4 ingredients. Stir in cream. On floured surface, work mixture with floured hands to a disk of about 1 1/2 inch thick. Cut into 2 inch squares. Place scones on floured baking sheet and brush tops with remaining heavy cream. Bake at 450° 20 - 25 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Chicken Naan
ingredients: 2 lbs steak | 1 can chickpeas | 1 can garbanzo beans | 1 can coconut cream | 16 slices prosciutto ( or any other smoked cut of you want ) | 16 pieces chicken breasts | 2 bags of rice noodles ( optional )
instructions: Cut steak in bite size pieces then mix in a mixing bowl. Add coconut cream, chickpeas, garlic, and proscuitto. Stir mixture together and wrap each chicken breast in a strip of the prosciutto. Line a 9x13 pan with a large pot of water so that it covers the bottom of the pan. I use water to soak the rice noodles for the same reason. Boil chicken for 40 min or until cooked through. After 40 min dice chicken into bite size pieces and add back to soup. Cook for 20 min and serve on rice noodles.

title: Tandoori Fish
ingredients: 8 red snapper fillets | 2 teaspoons tandoori masala | 1 small avocado
instructions: Combine sambul and chill until serving.

Random Ingredients: olive oil,mushroom stem,sherry,scallion,dill weed,parsley leaf,epazote,yellow food coloring
title: Mushroom Soup
ingredients: 1 teaspoon olive oil | 12 ounces mushroom stems | 2 scallions, thinly sliced | 3 tablespoons fresh dill weed, chopped | 1/3 cup dry sherry | 1/2 teaspoon yellow food coloring ( optional ) | 1 package philadelphia-mushroom coursely choppies | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley leaves, for garnish
instructions: Heat oil in a dutch oven over medium heat. Add mushrooms and scallions.

title: Guacamole Pretzels
ingredients: 1 teaspoon active dry yeast | 2 cups warm guacamole | 1 teaspoon superfine sugar | 1/2 cup hot water
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in the warm guacamole, then add the sugar. Pour the hot water over the yeast mixture, then let stand in a warm place until the mixture has doubled in volume, about 4 hours or longer. Dredge pretzels in a few changes of white and black sprinkles, and place on parchment lined baking sheets. Refrigerate pretzels for at least 8 hours before serving.

title: Simple Mexican Rice Noodles
ingredients: 1 package dried rice noodles ( about 1 1/2 pints ) | 1 can la santo light soymilk | 8 ounces salsa | 0.5 can mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Fry the noodles in just enough water to cover them. Then drain. In a large bowl mix the soy milk and noodles. Mix into other ingredients. Add mushrooms and cook on low heat until noodles are done.

Random Ingredients: red cabbage,italian pork sausage,butter bean,white bread,leg lamb,orange peel,asparagus
title: Warm Italian Pork and Asparagus Casserole
ingredients: 1/2 cup orange peel, shredded | 1/2 cup butter beans, drained | 5/8 cup red cabbage, shredded | 1/2 teaspoon ground asparagus | 6 boneless lean legs of lamb, trimmed of all visible fat and cut into 1-inch cubes | 1/2 lb lean ground italian pork sausage | 12 slices white bread, toasted
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f lightly grease a 9 inch glass or ceramic oven proof baking dish. Place orange peel, butter beans, red cabbage, and asparagus in a food processor and process until chunky. Combine lamb, pork sausage, and bread crumbs in a large bowl.

title: Easy Pizza Sauce
ingredients: 1 can tomato sauce ( i prefer progresso italian, it is the best i can get into the freezer ) | 1/2 cup chicken broth ( i prefer better or lite )
instructions: Empty tomato sauce into a large saucepan, add chicken broth and simmer until slightly thickened. I like the consistency of a drop of red sauce. Pour the thickened sauce into an oven proof dish that has been pan sprayed with cooking spray or a non stick spray. Allow to cool slightly. I usually just let it sit on the counter to cool down a bit and then place the dish in my freezer. Once it is partly cooled down, i transfer the sauce to a blender and blend until smooth. Use as a pizza base filling, pizza sauce for your favorite pizza topping, topping, etc.

title: Spicy Bakers
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 cup hot pepper, chopped ( i use jalapeno peppers ) | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1/4 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Scoop out the seeds of the bell peppers using a teaspoon as you go.

title: Black Russian
ingredients: 1 cup black coffee | 2 tablespoons guava paste, or to taste
instructions: Pour brewed black coffee into a glass or mug. Top with guava paste.

Random Ingredients: kasuri methi,green chili powder,tamarind juice,green bell pepper,pecorino romano cheese,beef bouillon
title: Beef Pasanda
ingredients: 3 lbs beef bouillon, beef flavor cubes | 1/4 cup tamarind juice | 1 tablespoon kasuri methi | 2 green chili powder | 1 green bell pepper, diced | shredded pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Place all ingredients except cheese inside pot and bring to a boil. Turn down heat and simmer for 3 hours. Serve with warm loaf of bread. Sprinkle with a little pecorino romano cheese before serving.

title: Laos Green Tea
ingredients: 250 g green peppercorns | 120 ml baileys irish cream | 1 pinch juniper berries
instructions: Rinse and dry the green peppercorns. Place a wok over low heat, with enough water to cover the nuts. Bring just to the boil. Place the peppercorns in a fine mesh strainer and drop them into the hot water. Allow to stand for 5 minutes, then drain. Transfer to a pot and add the bacilace. Re pour the irish cream and pour around the green peppercorns. Serve as you like.

title: Chilled Wheaten Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup coarse grain glutinous rice | 3 cups cold or hot water | 1 1/2 cups grapefruit juice | 1/2 cup wheat bran
instructions: Pick over rice and remove any debris. Make sure the rice is well rinsed under running water, removing any damaged bones. Place the rice into a heavy 1 gallon freezer bag and pour water into the bag. Close the bag, pressing out as much air as possible. Freeze for 6 to 8 hours. Place the rice bag into the freezer. Prepare a grill or preheat the broiler. Remove rice from the freezer and remove plastic bag, allowing the rice to cool enough to handle. Lightly oil the grates of your rifle. Grill or broil the rice until the color becomes dark red in color, about 20 minutes. Flip and repeat until the other side is light. Turn over once or twice. Spread a small plate directly on the surface for a handle while the rice cools. Cut into 3 inch squares and set aside. While the rice is cooling, combine grapefruit juice and wheat bran in a blender. Cover and blend until smooth. Pour into a medium bowl and stir vigorously to dissolve any grain of rice. Cover and refrigerate while the rice is chilling. To use, remove from the refrigerator 1 hour before serving and gently squeeze out as much air as possible. You should have about 1/2 cup of liquid, but not a total of water. Store in the refrigerator until needed.

Random Ingredients: velveeta cheese,fish fillet,italian seasoning,chicken bouillon cube,pepperoni,jalapeno pepper,purpose flour,red pepper flake
title: Chef Boy's Italian Fish
ingredients: 4 lbs fish fillets, fresh or frozen from the refrigerator section ( i use a 3 1/2 oz. box of frozen fillets ) | 1 box velveeta cheese, cubed | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 3 tablespoons dried italian seasoning ( or seasoning of your choice ) | 1/3 cup diced pepperoni | 1 tablespoon jalapeno pepper, finely chopped ( optional ) | 1 chicken bouillon cube, dissolved in | 3 tablespoons water | 2 tablespoons crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Place frozen fish in a large pot and cover with water. Place over medium heat and boil until fish flakes easily. The water should be at a full boil, but there should be about 3 1/2 cups of water still. Do not overcook. When done, remove fish from poaching liquid and separate fish from shells. Cut larger fish into 1 inch squares and set aside. Place in a large deep skillet and layer the sliced fish on top of the fish. Set aside. In a small bowl, mix the flour, italian seasoning, pepperoni, jalapeno pepper, bouillon, and the 1/3 cup water until well mixed. Pour mixture over the fish and place in a 13x9 inch glass pan. Top with the cheese. Bake covered at 350 degrees for 50 - 60 minutes until the fish is golden brown on top.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,mirin,orange juice,red chile pepper,sunflower oil,pepper
title: Spicy Red Pepper Stir-Fry
ingredients: 2 red bell peppers, halved deseeded and halved | 2 tablespoons pickled hot red chile peppers | 3/4 cup orange juice | 1 tablespoon sunflower oil | 1/2 cup mirin ( sweet rice wine ) | 6 small red chile peppers, halved lengthways and coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon cracked pepper
instructions: Heat the sunflower oil in a wok over high heat, add the red bell peppers and saute for a few moments then add the hot red peppers, stirfry for 2 minutes then add the orange juice and re reduce the heat. Scatter over the chiles and pepper. Cover and allow to stir for 25 - 30 minutes until the peppers and peppers are tender when pierced with a fork. Remove from the heat and stir in the mirin or rice wine. Serve straight away.

title: Almond Terrine
ingredients: 12 ounces cremini mushrooms | 1/2 cup malt vinegar, to taste or 1/2 cup rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon minced lemon grass | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/8 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Combine all ingredients in small bowl. Place mold in refrigerator 15 to 20 minutes. Turn occasionally until cool.

title: Quick Broadbean Soup
ingredients: 2 cups frozen broad beans, thawed | 1/4 cup hawaiian or other tropical salad dressing, such as < a href= '' https : //www.geniuskitchen.com/recipe/swiss-naf-dressing-33938 '' > swiss naf dressing < /a > | 4 slices thin sliced raw onions or 5 slices shallots
instructions: Drain the broad bean in a fine mesh strainer into a small bowl, reserving 3/4 cup of the cooking liquid. Shred the bean by hand with 2 or 3 forks to a coarse puree. While the beans are cooking, combine the remaining cooking liquid, broad bean puree and the salad dressing in a small saucepan over low heat. Sauté the onion in the hot liquid, stirring occasionally, until translucent and slightly softened. Garnish with onions and serve.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast fillet,plain flour,lime,white vinegar,tabasco sauce
title: Chicken with Lime
ingredients: 2 chicken breast fillets | 1/3 cup plain flour | 1/3 cup lime | 1 tablespoon white vinegar | 4 drops tabasco sauce
instructions: Cut chicken into slices 1 1/2cm thick. Coat chicken slices with flour. Place in marinade. Cover and leave to marinate in the refrigerator for 30 minutes. Remove from marinade. Place in shallow pan. Peel and finely dice lime rind, place in a bowl with remaining ingredients and mix. Set aside. Reduce cooking time by 50 - 90 mins or until sauce is reduced to desired thickness. Serve chicken slices with sauce.

Random Ingredients: tarragon,frying chicken,lettuce leaf,breadcrumb,worcestershire sauce,sesame oil,sugar,bamboo shoot
title: Chinese Bamboo Shoots (Or Chicken) Baked in Lettuce Leaves
ingredients: 1 frying chicken, cut in pieces | 12 slices breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons celery tops ( finely cut ) | 1 -2 teaspoon sesame oil | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon tarragon | 2 tablespoons sugar | lettuce leaf ( as is in the asian section of your store )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Rinse the chicken with cold water, drain thoroughly and put into ovenproof, ovenproof dish. Add celery and sesame oil and gently cook for about 20 - 30 minutes until chicken is tender and lightly coloured. Add worcestershire sauce, tarragon and sugar and mix through. Put on the lettuce leaves. Place in oven until lettuce starts to brown and chicken cooked fully.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,cream mushroom soup chicken,hot paprika,galangal,chicken stock,extra virgin olive oil,chili sauce
title: Filipino Pangangal Soup
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 3 tablespoons minced fresh galangal | 1 lb cubed fresh boneless chicken ( or use 2 chicken breasts ) | 3 tablespoons hot paprika | 2 1 tablespoon sweet chili sauce ( or to taste ) | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup with chicken, undiluted ( or use 1 can with cream of mushroom soup and 1 can with chicken or eliminate cream of chicken ) | 1 1/4 cups chicken stock
instructions: Heat the oil over medium heat in a soup pot. Add the ginger and cook, stirring, about 30 seconds. Add the galangal and saute, stirring, about 30 seconds. Add the chicken and stir until fragrant, about 1 minute. Add the paprika, chile sauce, soup and chicken stock and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer 20 minutes, or until the chicken is tender.

title: Korean Fruit Rolls
ingredients: 2 mangoes, peeled & cut in chunks | 1 package round dumpling wrappers | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1 teaspoon sesame oil
instructions: Spread the fruit mixture into the center of the dough dumplings. Roll up the korean roll starting with the edge, then gently push and roll to seal the edges. Repeat with remaining ingredients. You can either freeze the korean roll or remove from the package, and slice into thin slices. Serve, or remove with a fork.

title: Taste of Tropical
ingredients: 1/2 small watermelon, seeded | 1/2 small pineapple, seeded | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 2 skinless chicken thighs, sliced | 4 egg yolks | 1 1/2 tablespoons sweetened flaked coconut
instructions: To cook, cut melon into quarters. Put all ingredients except coconut into a blender.

title: Slow Cooker Pork and Jelly
ingredients: 4 lbs lean pork, cut into 1 to 1-inch cubes ( or more ) | 1 can diced tomatoes with jalapenos
instructions: Layer pork in crock of slow cooker. Sprinkle with tomatoes and jalapenos. Cover. Cook on high for 4 hours. Stir contents of slow cooker, cover. Cook on low for 20 minutes longer.

Random Ingredients: pistachio pudding mix,peach liqueur,lemon extract,red bell pepper,chocolate pudding mix,sugar syrup,coconut cream,red potato
title: Caribbean Spiced Potatoes and Peaches
ingredients: 6 medium red potatoes ( about 1 1/2- to 2 lbs ) | 1 package instant chocolate pudding mix | 1 box pistachio pudding mix ( jello ) | 1 cup fat-free sweetened condensed milk | 1 tablespoon sugar syrup | 1/8 teaspoon lemon extract | 14 ounces peaches in juice ( about 8-10 ripe ) | 1 package red bell peppers, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Coat a 2 cup soupa pan or rimmed jelly mold with cooking spray. Cut potatoes crosswise into 8 wedges. Using a vegetable peeler, thinly slice 1 wedge each of potatoes and peppers. Push wedges in so potatoes become like coarse strips. Place wedges in a bowl and add 1 tspps instant chocolate pudding mix, sugar syrup, and other cereal ingredients. Drain peaches and save juice. Stir remaining liquid into mixture. Pour onto prepared dish. Bake for 15 - 17 minutes or until set. Remove from oven and top with red bell pepper slices.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,fine salt,barbeque sauce,champagne,rosemary sprig,cayenne,hamburger,cranberry
title: BBQ Beef Burgers With Rosemary, Corned Caramelized Ham and Parmigiano-Reggiano
ingredients: 2 lbs lean hamburger, ground | 2 1/2 tablespoons fine salt | 1/4 teaspoon ground red cayenne | 1/4 teaspoon ground rosemary sprig, crushed | 1/4 cup barbeque sauce | 2 tablespoons light glaze or 2 tablespoons barbeque sauce | 1 cup cranberries, fresh or frozen | 1/4 cup shaved parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Mix ground beef, fine salt, cayenne, black pepper, rosemary and barbeque sauce together well. Shape into 6 patties about 1 1/2 thick. Place about 2 tbls. Of the melted cheese on each steak and roll up. Secure with a tooth pick if necessary. Grill the patties for 15 minutes on each side or until cooked through and desired doneness. To serve, top with the barbeque sauce and cranberries.

Random Ingredients: spring onion,orange peel,savoy cabbage,mustard powder,peanut oil,pork loin chop,chicken stock water
title: Pork Normandy
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 5 spring onions, thinly sliced | 3 tablespoons peanut oil | 600 ml good chicken stock ( use water, not dry stock ) | 2 teaspoons grated orange peel | 1 savoy cabbage ( about 2 bunches ) | 5 lean boneless pork loin chops
instructions: Place the pork chops in a bowl then sprinkle with mustard and mix well. Set aside. Heat a wok over high heat. Add the oil then add mustard. Swirl the oil around the inside edges until smoking, but not brown. Cook half the spring onions and half the pork for 2 minutes, until browned. Add stock and orange. Increase the heat to high and boil for 2 minutes without stirring. Remove from heat and place the pan over a heatproof bowl, covered with foil, for 5 minutes. Uncover and toss well to combine. Meanwhile, remove the cores from the cabbage and slice into wedges. Arrange the cabbage in a serving bowl. Slice the reserved spring onions across the top and serve with pork.

title: Homemade Tomato and Olive Sauce, OAMC- Fast and Simple
ingredients: 1 cup frozen tomatoes with juice, defrosted and drained | olive oil flavored cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to place the frozen tomatoes in a baking dish, cover with olive oil flavored with cooking spray. Spray with cooking spray, and bake for 20 minutes. Serve over pasta.

title: Hungarian Naked Hamburger
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 1 package kielbasa | 1/2 teaspoon marjoram
instructions: Cook hamburger, kielbasa and marjoram together with salt to taste. Add kielbasa and brown in frying pan, drain. Serve with hamburger buns.

title: German Pepper Sauce
ingredients: 30 -35 caraway seeds ( coarsely crushed ) | 12 dashes hot sauce | 3 tablespoons brandy
instructions: Toast caraway seeds in a dry frying pan, turning a few times, for 10 to 20 seconds until browned. Cool, then crush with rolling pin. Add remaining ingredients. Heat in a small saucepan.

title: Beetroot Chips
ingredients: 1 lb bok choy, root ends trimmed and cut into 1/4-inch-thick slices on the diagonal | 2 tablespoons finely chopped capers | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1 star anise, broken into pieces
instructions: Heat a skillet over high heat. Add a few drops of oil to the pan at a time, swirling the pan until the oil is smoking. Working in batches if necessary, add the beetroot and toss until the slices are well coated. Immediately add the star anise and capers. Toss until the chips are bright red and the vegetables are coated all over with the chip oil. Transfer the chips to paper towels. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: colby monterey jack cheese,baby spinach leaf,parsley,molasses,baby bok choy,kidney bean,pork tenderloin
title: Beef, Pork and Vegetables with Molasses Stew
ingredients: 1 tablespoon molasses | 1 lb pork tenderloin or 1 lb rib roast, cut into 2 inch pieces | 2 cups baby bok choy, washed, chopped | 1 lb baby spinach leaves, cleaned | 1 cup prepared colby-monterey jack cheese or 1 cup monterey jack pepper cheese, grated | 1 cup cooked kidney bean, drained | chopped fresh parsley, for garnish
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet, combine the molasses and pork. Cook, stirring constantly, for 2 minutes or until pork is browned. Add bok choy, spinach and colby jack cheese. Cook, stirring frequently, for 2 minutes. Stir in beans and cook for 2 minutes or until heated through. Serve garnished with parsley.

Random Ingredients: cornish hen,taco sauce,green pepper,soy sauce,chuck,corkscrew macaroni,poblano chile
title: Mexican Game Hens With Macaroni #RSC
ingredients: 1 package corkscrew macaroni | 1 pound poblano chiles | 4 cornish hens | 2 tablespoons taco sauce | 1/4 cup taco sauce | 1/4 cup soy sauce | 1/4 cup green pepper, diced
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the cornish hens and boil until done, about 4 minutes per side for pink, 6 to 8 minutes per side for white or 11 to 12 minutes per side for brown.

title: Grilled Swiss Chard
ingredients: 1 lb swiss chard | 1/4 cup soya sauce
instructions: Wash and remove the woody rib on the chard leaves. Rinse under running water and pat dry. Prepare the grill and set the flame. When the grill is ready brush the chard leaves with soya sauce to lightly burn. Turn and brush with more soya sauce, place on grill and cook for about 10 minutes until the chard is browned and hot. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: guacamole,celery salt,farfalle pasta,pepper,spaghetti,dark corn syrup,wheat bread
title: Stove Top Noodle Sandwich
ingredients: 1 package farfalle pasta, cooked | 16 16 thin slices whole wheat bread or 8 slices multigrain bread | 12 ounces thin strips cooked bacon or 12 ounces ham | 1 teaspoon celery salt | 1 teaspoon pepper | 1/4 cup dark corn syrup or 1/4 cup brown sugar | guacamole, to top bread and serve with ( optional )
instructions: Cut bread slices into long crumbs. If using whole wheat bread, cut into 1/4 inch slices. In skillet, fry bacon or ham until brown. Add celery salt, pepper and corn syrup. Mix well. Pour into bowl with cooked pasta and toss well to coat pasta with syrup. Cut the bread into 1 inch pieces, then separate one piece of bread from its triangular shape. Place on a cookie sheet and place a piece of bacon or ham inside each, then top with a slice of bread. Pour the hot pasta sauce over bread, then top as desired with guacamole if desired.

title: Kathy's  Cream Cheese Frosting
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese ( or use 3 1/4 oz. tub of cream ) | 1 1/2 cups cold water
instructions: Use a food processor to finely chop cream cheese, then mix it all together using a fork. Add water and mix till the batter is smooth. Pour onto a greased cookie sheet, making a ring or circle from the top to bottom of the pan, then spread with a spatula until the frosting reaches your desired thickness, as i do. Cool and frost as desired.

Random Ingredients: iceberg lettuce,savoy cabbage,rice wine vinegar,eggplant,roquefort cheese,bean thread noodle,date,bell pepper
title: Vegetable and Roquefort  Rice Salad
ingredients: 6 large eggsplants ( about 3 medium ) | 4 bell peppers | 4 ounces roquefort cheese, softened | 2 cups savoy cabbage, shredded ( about 1 pound ) | 1 cup iceberg lettuce, shredded | 1/4 cup dates, chopped | 6 cups cooked rice wine vinegar | 2 cups refried beans thread noodles, heated ( store-bought or homemade )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Remove peel from 6 medium eggplants and trim ends and ends. Slice eggplants across the grain into 1/2 inch thick slices. Set slices aside. Place bell peppers, rinds, and bell peppers on a baking sheet and roast, turning occasionally, until blackened and blistered, about 20 minutes. Transfer the vegetables to a bowl and cover tightly with foil. Allow peppers to steam in hot oven until skins are loosened, about 20 minutes. Cool peppers inside a plastic bag, about 10 minutes. Carefully remove skin, removing seeds and membrane. Slit peppers in half through the stem, leaving the stem intact. Peel peppers and discard seeds. Cut the peppers in half across the stem, remove seeds and membrane, and set aside. Cut the cheese into pieces about 3/4 inch in size, then combine with the cabbage. In a large bowl, combine the lettuce, dates, and rice wine vinegar. Arrange the eggplant slices on top of the cheese mixture. Toss with the vinegar mixture and top with hot tortilla strips or bean threads.

title: Cheese Poppy Seed
ingredients: 4 cups shredded fontina cheese ( about 1 pound ) | 1/2 cup poppy seed ( toasted, for garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 400°f. Place 2/3 of the cheeses in the bottom of a jelly roll pan. Using a spoon, coat the entire top with the poppy seeds. Bake for 15 minutes or till it starts to brown slightly and the cheese will be bubbly.

Random Ingredients: pesto sauce,liquid smoke,green bean,chili powder,irish cream
title: Lighter Pesto Green Beans
ingredients: 8 ounces frozen cut green beans | 2 teaspoons chili powder | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke | 1 1/2 teaspoons prepared pesto sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons irish cream
instructions: Prepare a large skillet by spraying with nonstick cooking spray set over medium heat. Add beans and chile powder and cook, stirring occasionally, until bean mixture begins to soften, about 15 to 20 minutes. Add pesto sauce and liquid smoke.

Random Ingredients: yucca root,queso fresco,wheat bread flour,brown basmati rice,romaine lettuce leaf,pearl onion,couscous
title: Peruvian Rice & Veggies
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups brown basmati rice or 1 1/4 cups basmati rice | 1/4 1/4 cup queso fresco or 1/4 cup feta cheese | 1/2 small romaine lettuce leaf | 1 small navel orange, peeled and sectioned | 2 frozen pearl onions | 3/4 cup coarse whole wheat bread flour | 1 tablespoon pearl onion, sliced | freshly-textured wheat bread, for serving
instructions: For the rice, in a medium pot, add 1 cup water, the rice and a pinch of salt. Cover, reduce the heat, and bring the water to a boil. Cover and over medium heat cook for 15 minutes. Stir in the rice, cover, and return to a boil. Reduce the heat, cover and simmer, cooking until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed, about 25 minutes. Drain off any excess water and cool for about 10 minutes. For the filling, in a small bowl, stir the queso fresco or feta cheese with the lettuce, orange sections, and sliced olives. Set aside. For the breadcrumbs, in a medium bowl, stir the flour with the pearl onions. Mix well. Dip the rice into the flour, shaking off excess. Then, using a large spoon, tear the rice into small pieces, discarding any remaining flour. Return the rice to the rice, sprinkle with the crumb mixture and toss well to coat. Repeat with each portion of the crumbs. Transfer the fried rice to a plate, drizzle with more crumbs, and keep warm on the oven shelf below the oven until ready to serve. Serve hot or room temperature.

title: Potato Salad
ingredients: 3 large tiny new potatoes ( about 1-1/4 lbs ) | 1 medium apple ( such as fuji or fuji ) | 1/2 cup walnuts | 1 teaspoon of freshly grated lemon rind ( optional ) or 1 teaspoon lemon ( optional )
instructions: Cook the potatoes and apple in boiling water for 10 minutes or until just tender, drain and cool slightly. When cool enough to handle break into small chunks and mash in a large bowl along with other ingredients. Let stand for a few minutes. Serve at room temperature.

title: Moroccan Chicken With Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 roasting chicken | 1 cup sliced almonds or 1 cup slivered almonds | 1 teaspoon lemon juice and zest of | 1/2 teaspoon harissa | 1 1/2 teaspoons sugar | 2 cups chopped straw mushrooms | 1/4 cup cilantro
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f place the almonds in a single layer on a jelly roll pan. Broil until they make crackling noises, about 5 minutes per side. In a small bowl, combine the rest of the ingredients. Sprinkle over the almonds. Place the chicken skin side down in the roasting pan. Roast for 20 minutes. Turn the pan over, baste with any pan juices, and roast for another 20 minutes or longer. During the last 15 minutes of baking, add the mushrooms for an additional 15 or 20 minutes until golden brown and tender. Remove from the oven and sprinkle with the cilantro.

Random Ingredients: island dressing,ancho chile powder,apple cider vinegar,taco sauce,canola oil,baking soda
title: Saucy Taco Baked Chips
ingredients: 2 cups island-style dressing | 1/2 cup apple cider vinegar | 1/2 cup canola oil | 1/2 cup taco sauce | 1 tablespoon ground ancho chile powder ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Combine the thousand island dressing and apple cider vinegar in a bowl, and mix thoroughly. Mix in taco sauce, ancho powder, baking soda, and water, if desired. Scoop chips from baking sheet. Spread chips evenly onto a cookie sheet with the back of a spoon. Sprinkle with the desired amount of the ancho powder and bake in the preheated oven until crispy and dark brown, about 15 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Holiday Enchiladas (Stuffed Beef)
ingredients: 1 lb boneless ground beef chuck | 1 lb venison steak | 1 ounce unsweetened chocolate | 2 tablespoons margarine or 2 tablespoons butter | 1/4 cup fat-free broth | 1 can navy beans, drained | 1 1/2 cups hot cooked penne or 1 1/2 cups angel hair pasta, cooked and drained | 5 medium 6-inch flour tortillas, torn in half | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom ( optional )
instructions: In skillet, cook ground chuck and venison steak over medium heat. Drain. Stir in chocolate and margarine. Continue to cook and stir until chocolate and mixture is smooth. Stir in broth and beans. Cook until heated through. Fill each tortilla with about 1 cup of meat mixture, roll up and place seam side down in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Combine remaining ingredients.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,black olive,topping,fettuccine pasta,rigatoni pasta,pork tenderloin,wheat flour,gingerroot
title: Pasta With Pork and Black Olives
ingredients: 1 lb rigatoni pasta | 4 ounces long grain white rice, uncooked | 1/4 cup whole wheat flour | 1 tablespoon gingerroot, grated | 16 ounces lean pork tenderloin, trimmed and cubed | 1 cup black olives, sliced | 1 carton frozen whipped topping, thawed | topped fat and light fat free cheese, for topping
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Meanwhile, spray a skillet with nonstick cooking spray and add pork.

title: Chinese Five-Spice Mint Curd
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry, cracked wild-meafood mint | 3/4 cup apple juice ( or orange juice or sweet apple cider ) | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil
instructions: Finely chop the mint and combine with the other ingredients in a serving dish. Chill for at least 2 hours before serving, or overnight. Makes 1 cup minted coriander.
