title: Red Bell Pepper and Date Spread
ingredients: 1 red bell pepper | 2 cups fresh dates, pitted and chopped
instructions: Cut out the cores of the red bell pepper using a mortar and pestle. Using a teaspoon or teaspoon, scrape off the pulp as much as possible from the skin of the pepper and discard. Slice the bell pepper into rings about 1½ inches long, discarding the stem and seeds. Place the pepper rings in a serving bowl. Stir in the dates. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Amber's Pepper Poached Lemons
ingredients: 24 frozen, hard-blend lemons | 1 cup heavy cream
instructions: Clean lemons. Cut each lemon in half and remove rind and juice. Do not peel. Reserve peel. Fill each lemon half with a tablespoon of heavy cream. Roll lemons in cream to coat. Chill until ready to serve.

title: Pork and Sweet Potato Stuffed Pumpkin
ingredients: 4 sweet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/2 inch slices | 1 tablespoon chinese red vinegar | 1/2 cup unsweetened flaked coconut oil | 4 medium pork loin or 4 other lean pork | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard | 1 jar salsa
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. In a mixing bowl, toss sweet potatoes with vinegar and oil until coated. Arrange in a single layer on a baking sheet or parchment paper. Bake 45 minutes, uncovered, stirring once a day, until tender and browned. Heat remaining 1/2 cup coconut oil in a 12 inch heavy skillet over high heat. Meanwhile, cut pork into thin slices and sprinkle the pork with chicken bouillon and dry mustard. Add to skillet and cook until pork is white on outside, 4 to 5 minutes. Pour salsa over the pork and bake, uncovered, stirring once a day, for 45 to 60 minutes, or until pork is tender and meat is well browned. Serve warm.

title: Chili Wings
ingredients: 4 1/4 cups warm water, divided | 1 cup chopped fresh serrano peppers | 1 1/2 teaspoons dry mustard | 5 teaspoons active dry yeast, divided | 1 tablespoon vanilla extract
instructions: In a saucepan, mix 2 cups water with 1 cup hot pepper, dry mustard and yeast. Let stand until creamy but not foamy about 10 minutes, about 5 minutes. Stir in vanilla and remaining 1/2 cup cold water.

Random Ingredients: season salt,sumac,angel food cake,lavash bread,feta cheese,pork,maple syrup,serrano chilies
title: Lavash Sandwich With Feta! -- Greek Souffle
ingredients: 1 lambash bread | 1/2 cup feta cheese | 1 -3 serrano chilies, seeded and chopped | 2 -3 tablespoons ground sumac or 2 -3 tablespoons turkish sumac | 4 -6 slices lavash bread | 1/2 teaspoon season-all salt | 2 -4 tablespoons light maple syrup ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 °f. Cut the bread into 8 pieces and toast them on both sides, or a cookie sheet in the oven for about 5 - 9 minutes per side. Spread 1/4 cup of the feta cheese on the cut surfaces of each piece of toast and place them on a cutting board. Scoop up the bread with chopsticks or a large cookie scoop and press some of the feta over it. Sprinkle a small amount of sumac over the top of the feta and place the whole thing on an ungreased cookie sheet. Let rest for 5 - 10 minutes. Cut into 6 - 8 pieces. Drizzle with maple syrup and serve hot.

title: Orange Salad Burritos (South Beach Diet Phase 2)  ( Vegan Version)
ingredients: 1/4 cup orange juice, freshly squeezed | 2 teaspoons vanilla | 10 medium flour tortillas | 1 teaspoon margarine ( earth balance is vegan ) or 1 teaspoon smart balance butter flavored cooking spray ( earth balance is vegan ) | 4 lettuce leaves ( i use iceberg )
instructions: Mix all ingredients except lettuce. Cut tortillas into strips and place in a serving dish. Cut lettuce leaves into strips, or cut into small pieces and place around the edge of the strips in the plate. Toss lettuce evenly. Cover and chill for 30 minutes for flavors to meld.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,pistachio,arborio rice,green onion,french dressing
title: Spanish Rice Casserole
ingredients: 1 cup arborio rice or 1 cup arborio rice | 1 cup french dressing ( i prefer jack daniels ) | 8 green onions, sliced thinly | 1 ounce ground red chili pepper | 1/2 cup shelled shelled pistachios, coarsely chopped
instructions: Prepare basmati rice according to package directions. Drain. While risotto is cooking, lightly spray a 9 x 13 baking dish. Pour french dressing in a small bowl. Mix well and set aside. In a separate bowl, combine the green onions, ground red chili pepper and pistachios. Mix well and set aside. Add the rice and green onions mixture to the french dressing and mix well. Pour mixture into the coated baking dish. Sprinkle pistachio and red chili pepper mixture evenly over the top. Dot top with remaining pistachios. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Mashed Potatoes and Romaine Romaine
ingredients: 4 pounds russet potatoes, sliced | 4 orange food coloring, divided | 1 romaine lettuce - rinsed, dried, and torn into bite-size pieces
instructions: Combine potatoes, 1/4 teaspoon of orange food coloring, and 2 tablespoons of water in a large bowl.

title: English Guacamole Spread
ingredients: 1 cup guacamole | 1 -2 teaspoon prepared english-style mustard
instructions: In a bowl combine all ingredients. Transfer to a lightly greased 8 inch square pan or a 9 inch square cake pan coated with cooking spray.. Use a knife to spread evenly. Cover and chill in the refrigerator for up to one day before serving.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chile pepper,tuna water,green pea,whipping cream,button mushroom,tequila,date,lemon
title: Tuna Mousse
ingredients: 5 cups chilled whipping cream | 1/2 pound fresh button mushrooms, chopped | 1 cup frozen green peas | 1 1/2 pounds fresh tuna in water, drained | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers, drained | 1/4 cup tequila | 2 teaspoons grated lemon or lime zest | 1 can pitted dates, chopped
instructions: Place whipping cream in a large bowl. Place mushrooms in another large bowl, and cover with a clean towel. Microwave mushrooms 5 to 10 seconds, until softened. Add peas to the hot cream, and cook 1 minute.

Random Ingredients: sugar,chicken bouillon,grape tomato,salad oil,heavy whipping cream,pimiento,bay leaf
title: Tomato Cream Soup
ingredients: 3 cups grape tomatoes, ripe | 2 tablespoons salad oil | 1 tablespoon salad oil | 4 cups chicken bouillon | 2 cups heavy whipping cream | 1/2 cup diced pimiento ( optional ) | 2 bay leaves | 4 tablespoons sugar
instructions: Cut off tops of tomatoes, and peel out the seeds. Bring a large pot of water to boil, and add 1 tablespoon salad oil. Heat oil on low until oil is shimmering. Stir in the sliced tomatoes and cook one minute. Dump the tomatoes into a food processor with the bouillon, and pulse until finely chopped. Whisk in the cream, and process one more minute to incorporate. Add pimientos, cover, and simmer one minute. Taste and add more sugar and/or salt, if desired.

title: Crock Pot Chicken With Apple Noodles
ingredients: 2 tablespoons seasoning salt | 2 tablespoons celery salt | 1 lb boneless skinless chicken thigh | 1 cup chopped apple | 3 cups hot cooked pasta ( i prefer the rotelle or spirals ) | 1 tablespoon minced fresh parsley or 1 tablespoon snipped fresh parsley
instructions: Combine the first 3 ingredients and rub over the chicken. Marinate 1 hour or longer in the refrigerator. Transfer to the crock pot and set on low for 8 hours. Before serving, boil 8 ounces of hot pasta until just tender. Plate pasta, chicken and sauce. Garnish with parsley.

title: Kahlua and Canadian Bacon Pizza
ingredients: 1 package fresh yeast | 3/4 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1/2 cup kahlua or 1/2 cup good bourbon | 2 tablespoons olive oil or 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 cup shredded zucchini ( unpeeled ) | 1 cup shredded kale ( non-hydrogenated ) | 12 ounces sliced canadian bacon ( optional ) | cooked polenta, for topping
instructions: In large bowl, dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup yogurt. Stir in 1/4 cup kahlua and 1 t olive or canola oil. Let stand 15 minute. Meanwhile, mix zucchini, kale and bacon. Stir into yeast mixture. Cover, and let rise 45 - 60 min or until well risen. Spread mixture evenly over pizza crust. Sprinkle remaining yogurt over the top. Bake at 450ºf 10 - 15 minute. Slice into 8 wedges to serve.

title: Tasty Creamy Flaky Biscuits
ingredients: 500 g flour | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Set oven to 180°c. Preheat oven to 200 degrees /. Sift flour, cream of tartar and baking soda mix. Pour in enough water to make a soft dropping consistency. Kneed for 7 minutes. Press dough into a non stick cookie tin/cookie tin and bake for 15 minutes.

title: Chunky Vegan Oven Dessert
ingredients: 1 carrot or 1 courgette, chopped | 2 tablespoons cocoa powder
instructions: Tip or you can freeze vegetables and cocoa. Preheat oven to 200c. Place carrots or courgettes on a baking tray and bake for 15 to 20 minutes, or until they have softened slightly. Stir a pinch of salt into the carrots before removing from the oven. Spread the carrots and courgettes out, sprinkle over the cocoa powder, and bake for another 5 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Tahini Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tahini | 4 dried guajillo chilies ( or other dried hot green chili )
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Cover. Serve.

title: Tortas
ingredients: 1 small beef brisket | 1 teaspoon saffron threads | 1/2 cup shredded mexican blend cheese
instructions: Place brisket in a large baking dish, and sprinkle with saffron. Cover, and set aside. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Bake in the preheated oven 1 hour. Reduce heat, cover, and bake 1 hour to 2 hours 30 minutes, or until meat is easily removed from the pan. Sprinkle with cheese, and return to oven 30 minutes, or until cheese has melted.

title: Lek and Wine Sorbet
ingredients: 1 leek, white parts only | 1 cup dry white wine | 1/4 teaspoon red food coloring
instructions: Trim leek and discard outer layers of green and white parts. Slice the leeks lengthwise into 1 inch slices. In a 2 quart saucepan or dutch oven large enough to hold leeks, heat wine over medium heat until it comes to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes. Dip leeks in wine and arrange in baking dish or small roasting pan. Sprinkle with food coloring. Bake in preheated oven for 40 minutes, or until leeks are tender and browned.

title: Slow-Cooker Raisins
ingredients: 1 quart beef-flavored pork broth | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 cup raisins
instructions: Heat the pork broth and worcestershire sauce in a large skillet over medium high heat. When the mixture starts to simmer, stir in the raisins. Remove from heat.

title: Cherie's Artichokes
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs artichokes | 1/4 cup fresh thyme leave | 3 cups ice
instructions: Trim off the black tops of the artichoke stalks. Cut off the stalks and discard. If any stalks remain on outside of the artichokes, trim off the top. Cut into half and remove a small portion of the stem. Rinse the artichoke stalks with cool water. Place the artichokes, stem side down, under the cold tap and gently wring as much outer as possible of the artichoke. Cover the artichokes, and set in a deep pot containing 1 1/2 gallons of water. Place a kettle on the stove with ice water to one inch below the top of the artichokes. Place over high heat to melt the ice. When the mixture begins to foam on top, lift the artichoke out of the water and place in a bowl. Cover and let sit 5 minutes to allow the water in the brine to reduce a bit. Remove the artichokes from the brine and squeeze out any excess juice. Place the artichokes and any collected juices in a bowl. Discard the thyme leaves, or set to one side. Cover and refrigerate until very cold, at least 1 to 10 days, stirring occasionally. About 1 hour before serving, remove from refrigerator, shaking the pot to loosen any bits of flavor, and drain any juice. Strain the cooking liquid through a cheesecloth lined colander, pressing on the solids with your hands to extract all the juice. Return the strained juice to a saucepan and bring to a boil.

title: Apricot Balls (Gourmet Magazine)
ingredients: 3 cups apricots, coarsely chopped ( about 2 cups ) | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 1/8 teaspoon saffron thread ( or you can use 1-2 t. dried saffron threads ) ( optional )
instructions: Place the apricots in a bowl and add enough water to cover them by 1/4 inch. Set aside. In a small skillet, melt the cocoa with the saffron over moderate heat until golden, about 3 minutes. Meanwhile, line a rimmed baking sheet with foil. Drain the apricots and reserve liquid. Combine the cocoa mixture and the reserved liquid and the apricots with salt to taste in a medium bowl and mix well. Roll the apricots on the prepared paper until coated completely. Arrange the rolls on the prepared baking sheet, about 4 inches apart, and refrigerate until chilled, at least 8 hours or overnight. Preheat the broiler. Makes 15 to 20 apricots. Store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: granny smith apple,cheese ravioli,squid,yellow bell pepper,flour,ramen noodle
title: Voodoo Raviolis or Ravioli Bake
ingredients: 1 package cheese ravioli | 1 small yellow bell pepper, chopped | 1 small sweet potato, chopped | 1/4 cup flour | 1 package frozen miniature cheese ravioli ( or 3 to 4 large ) | 1 medium size zucchini with skin, cut into quarters or ( 10 ounce ) package zucchini with skin | 1 package ramen noodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Dice or slice zucchini into bite size pieces. Place in a bowl with plenty of water to cover and set aside.

Random Ingredients: vinegar,tea,dark beer,bread crumb,garlic,parmesan cheese,self rising flour
title: Caesar Pizzas
ingredients: 2 cups self raising flour | 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1 teaspoon instant tea | 1/2 teaspoon grated fresh garlic | 1 1/2 cups dark beer | 1 cup bread crumbs | 1 dash vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. In a medium bowl, stir together the self rising flour, parmesan cheese, instant tea, garlic, beer, and bread crumbs. Drop the pizzas onto a baking sheet, about 3 inch thick. Bake for 7 to 10 minutes in the preheated oven, until golden brown.

title: Sliced Borscht
ingredients: 20 medium yukon gold potatoes, washed | 2 cups cabbage, cored and cut slices about 1 1/2 inches thick | 1 medium white onion, sliced 1/4 inch thick | 8 ounces riesling noodles
instructions: Cook potatoes in a large pot of boiling salted water until tender, about 20 minutes. Cut potatoes into about 6 wedges each. Return potatoes to the pot. Stir in cabbage and onion and heat about 5 minutes. Add more water if needed to help bring to a boil. Add noodles.

title: Pear and Chilli Meatballs
ingredients: 600 g fresh oysters, shucked | 1 tablespoon paprika | 1 teaspoon thyme | 2 glasses coconut milk | 2 slices breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons golden raisins | 1 small lime, juice of | 1 small fresh chilli, chopped | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh thyme
instructions: Mix all the spices together in a shallow dish and roll the oysters in the mixture so they are all coated in spices. Leave in fridge for 30 minutes. Heat the coconut and milk in a pan on a very gentle heat. While they are heating up, put the breadcrumbs, raisins, and lime juice in a large bowl. Roll the meat in the crumbs and add them to the coconut mixture. Gently stir until evenly coated.

title: Sausage and Bean Omelette
ingredients: 4 ounces extra lean turkey sausage, cut into 4 thin slices | 1 cup cannellini beans, drained | 4 large egg yolks | 1/2 cup baby rocket
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp/4 oil in a non stick pan. Add the sausage and fry over a medium heat for 4 mins/1stutes until browned, stirring often. Spoon half of the beans into the pan and cook, stirring often, for 2 - 3 mins/ until warmed through. Stir in the 1/2 cup of bean and stir to coat. Whisk in the remaining 1 tbs/4 tbs/oil, egg yolks and rocket. Return to the heat for 1 minutes stir to combine and cook, stirring, for 1 minute. Set aside to cool slightly. Serve, straight away, warm or at room temperature.

title: Dee's Taco-Dried Beans
ingredients: 1 can of dee's barley | 2 teaspoons sweet chili ( or more, to your taste )
instructions: Dump the barley into a pan, and heat up to boiling. Add the chilli and let it sit for 5 minutes while you prep other ingredients for eating.

Random Ingredients: onion,kalamata olive,chili oil,spinach leaf,dark brown sugar,chilies,red chili pepper
title: Quick Spinach "n' Garlic"
ingredients: 20 large kalamata olives | 2 fresh red chili peppers, seeded and sliced | 2 red chili peppers, seeded and chopped or 2 fresh green chili peppers | 1 large onion, chopped | 10 large english spinach leaves, washed but left whole and stems trimmed | 4 -6 tablespoons chili oil | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar
instructions: Cut off the tops and bottoms of the kalamata olives and tear them into about 1 - ½ chunks. Rinse the blackened outer leaves and pull the strings off the stems. Wash the chilis and slit them in half. If using green chilis, slit them first, if using red chilis, cut them into 1 cubes. Place the kalata olives in a bowl, cover with cold water then squeeze out the water from the olives with your fingers. Drain the water and chillies well. Dice the chilis and onion. Wash the spinach well, drain and tear into about 1½ chunks. Place a layer of spinach and a layer of chilis over the spinach. Repeat this procedure until all of the ingredients are in the bowl. You may garnish with extra chili oil, sugar, or kalamata olives. Garnish with more chilis and onion as you see fit.

title: Apple Mustard
ingredients: 1/2 cup apple juice | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard
instructions: Pour the apple juice into the bowl of a blender or food processor. Add mustard.

title: Sausage and Salami (Sausages With Salami)
ingredients: 2 lbs genoa salami, about 1/4 1/2 inch rounds ( about 10 slices ) | 1/2 lb unsalted butter, softened
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. Generously butter an 8 x8 inch baking dish, and generously flour it. Wrap the salami slices in the salami and arrange in one layer on the bottom of the pan. In a medium bowl, mash together the butter and the softened butter. Spread over the salami. Bake for 30 minutes, or until the salami is brown and the juices run clear.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,pizza crust,dressing,garbanzo bean,jasmine rice,gorgonzola,chicken bouillon,lime juice zest
title: Garbanzo and Gorgonzola Sweet and Sour Garbanzo Bean Pizza
ingredients: 1 cup cooked garbanzo beans ( about 1/2 cup ) or ( 16 ounce ) can garbanzo beans, drained and rinsed ( about 1/2 cup ) | 1 tablespoon minced garlic | 2 teaspoons fresh lime juice and zest | 2 tablespoons minced gorgonzola ( about 1/4 cup ) | 1 teaspoon coarsely grated lime zest | 1/2 teaspoon low-sodium instant chicken bouillon | 1 pre-baked pizza crust, 8 in. ( boboli ) | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. In large bowl, combine cooked garbanzo and all remaining ingredients. Add the reserved 1 tbsp olive oil and mix. Spread the marinade mixture onto the prebaked crust. Bake 25 minutes or until warmed through and the crust is lightly golden. Allow to stand for 5 minutes before slicing.

title: Banana Tahini Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup scallion, finely chopped | 1 can tomatoes with vegetable juice cocktail | 1/4 cup water | 1/4 cup tahini | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | lettuce | 3 bananas, sliced
instructions: Blend everything together and serve.

title: Tandoori Spice Blend
ingredients: 2 tablespoons kosher salt | 1 tablespoon ground cumin
instructions: In a small bowl stir together the salt and cumin. Combine the salt and cumin in a mug, and pour into the mug with the cumin. Let sit in the salt before serving.

title: Baby Carrots and Riesling
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs baby carrots | 1 cup baby arugula, washed | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves | 4 slices thick cut bacon | 1 cup soymilk, warmed | white pepper | baby bella petals
instructions: Heat a heavy pot and saute the sliced bacon slices until crisp. Remove bacon using a slotted spoon and set aside. Add the carrots to the same oil and cook until golden brown. Add the remaining ingredients except for the garnish and cook for a further 5 minutes. Serve on a hot plate with the chopped bacon on top and the garnished with baby bella petals.

Random Ingredients: topping,baguette,pineapple chunk,sea scallop,beef stew meat,hamburger meat
title: Grilled Cuban Sandwiches
ingredients: 3 pounds lean beef stew meat | 1 pound hamburger meat | 1 can pineapple chunks in heavy syrup | 1 baguette, cut in 12 pieces | topping : | 1 pound sea scallops
instructions: Divide beef stew meat, hamburger and pineapple into 12 dinner size portions. Prepare grill for direct heat. Lightly oil grate of grill. Arrange 6 bread pieces, cut side up, in 12 x 1 inch shallow baking dish. Place meat portions and pineapple on bread. Close baguette sections tightly with plastic wrap. Place bread on grill. Grill 8 minutes, turning once, or until toasted. Serve on toasted bread with topping.

title: Cheesy Crab in a Pretzel or Sandwich Loaf
ingredients: 1 kg crabmeat | 100 g fresh pecorino romano cheese | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon dry yeast | 1 tablespoon freshly grated gingerroot | 1 1/2 teaspoons cardamom seeds
instructions: If using a pretzel, grease with olive oil. Set aside 10 minutes. If using a loaf pan, preheat oven to 150 degrees celsius. Mix all ingredients together, excluding bread in a large bowl. Spread mixture into a well buttered loaf pan. Spread over grated pecorino.

Random Ingredients: dill,pecorino romano cheese,swiss cheese,fish,vanilla sugar,orange zest
title: Grilled Fish With Cheese and Orange
ingredients: 2 tablespoons grated orange zest | 1/4 cup dill ( fresh or dried ) | 1/3 cup grated swiss cheese | 6 ounces cooked fish | 1/4 cup shredded pecorino romano cheese | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla sugar
instructions: Marinate fish in orange zest, dill and swiss cheese.

Random Ingredients: red wine,milk,garlic herb couscous mix,jumbo pasta shell,zucchini,puff pastry,walnut,feta cheese
title: Garlic Cheese and Zucchini Pasta Bake
ingredients: 1 package jumbo pasta shells | 1 package frozen puff pastry, thawed | 2 zucchini, halved lengthwise and sliced | 1 package feta cheese, crumbled | 2 1/2 cups milk | 1 1/2 cups dry red wine | 1 package garlic and herb couscous mix | 1/3 cup walnuts, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f grease a 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Place the shell pasta in a pot of boiling salted water. Cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until just tender. Drain. Place the spinach in a large bowl of ice water, and microwave until wilted. Set aside to cool slightly. Drain, and pat dry. Cut the puff pastry into 4 inch squares. Set aside. Place the zucchini in the bowl of ice water to stop the cooking. Slice zucchini as thin as possible. In a large saucepan with a lid, mix together the feta cheese, milk, wine, garlic and prepared marinated zucchini. Cook over low heat just until the mixture begins to thicken, stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Spoon half of the cheese mixture into the shell pasta and sprinkle with the walnuts. Spoon half the zucchini over the cheese. Add the remaining zucchini. Spoon the remaining cheese mixture over the zucchini and feta mixture. Combine the remaining zucchini and cheese in a small bowl with the basil and the walnuts. Spread over top of the pastry and top with the remaining cheese mixture. Place in the lower third of the oven and bake for 15 minutes or until slightly golden.

title: Italian Chicken Panini
ingredients: 1/4 lb chicken thighs, trimmed and cut into 1-inch pieces | 1/4 lb thinly sliced sirloin | 1/4 lb pepperoni, cut into thin strips | 1 head cauliflower, separated into florets and stalks separated | 1 tablespoon hot sauce | 1/4 teaspoon dried tarragon | 4 ciabatta rolls or 4 hamburger buns, split and toasted
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees. Lay out a 13 by 9 inch baking pan. Layer the marinated chicken with the pepperoni, cauliflower, pepperoni, garlic, hot sauce and tarragon and stuff the top of the rolls with the ciabatta. Bake until the rolls are crisp and the filling is hot, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: strawberry,dark red kidney bean,pork,half,stew meat,chipotle powder
title: Chipotle Stew
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs stew meat | 1/4 cup dark red kidney beans | 1 can half-and-half | 1 can chipotle powder | 1 package frozen sliced strawberries
instructions: Place meat in oven safe skillet on the stove and brown, stirring often. When meat is browned, add other ingredients. Cover and bake for at least one hour in a 300 degree oven.

Random Ingredients: rye flour,vegan margarine,snow pea,pork chop,margarine,cherry tomato,beef,peach
title: Waldorf Style Pork Normandy
ingredients: 2 -3 boneless pork chops | 1/2 lb fresh snow pea, washed | 1/2 lb fresh peach, washed and peeled | 3 tablespoons margarine | 1 package vegan margarine | 1 teaspoon vegan margarine | 1 dash soy extract or 1 dash braggs amino acids ( optional ) ( optional ) | 1/2 cup crushed cherry tomatoes ( garnish )
instructions: Grill the pork chops until they are cooked through, which makes them easier to work with. Cut the snow peas in half and remove their ends if necessary. Cut the peas into rounds and set aside so they're easy to scoop out. Chop the peaches into medium size chunks and set aside. Cut the margarine into small pieces and melt. Combine the soy oil and margarine and spread the mixture evenly over both sides of the pork chops. Place the pineapple slices and the snow pea cubes on top of the pork chops. Place a cherry tomato on top of the peas and pineapple. Place the vegan margarine in a microwave safe bowl and microwave briefly on high power to melt and blend with the margarine, stirring intermittantly. Remove the soy margarine and let the margarine cool for a few minutes longer. Return the soy margarine mixture to the microwave safe bowl. Microwave again on high power, and stir thoroughly. Let cool for a minute or two longer. Serve in soup bowls topped with whipped cream, chopped peaches, soy sauce, or whatever you like over noodles. Note, you can make this into a meatloaf after it has been marinating for a couple days in the fridge. Marinating time does not include marinating time.

title: Crock Pot Rum-Hazelnut Chicken
ingredients: 3 lbs broiler-fryer chickens, with skin | 16 ounces white rum | 1 1/2 cups ground hazelnuts | 3 -4 tablespoons aged white rum ( optional, for a thicker flavor, 1/4 cup )
instructions: Preheat your crockpot on low setting. Remove the white rum and rum from your crockpot. Place skin side up in crockpot and sprinkle the nuts. Pour in rum. Cook on high for 2 - 3 hours until the meat pulls from the bones. Remove breasts and thighs and let cool down inside. When chicken is cool shred the meat into bite sized pieces. Sprinkle with rum if desired. Eat with lemon wedges, and let people help themselves by dipping in their own spoons.

title: Noodle Soup
ingredients: 1/4 cup orange juice | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 2 cups rice noodles, preferably fresh | pepper
instructions: Combine orange juice, cream and rice noodles in a medium sauce pan. Cover tightly and bring to a boil over high heat. Once water is boiling, reduce heat to low and simmer for 12 minutes or until noodles are just cooked through and sauce slightly thickened. Remove from heat and add pepper..

Random Ingredients: vegetarian sausage,clam juice,green bell pepper,chicken stock,broccoli,scallion
title: Gourmet Sausage and Broccoli Soup
ingredients: 1 lb vegetarian sausage, casings removed | 14 ounces frozen whole onions or 14 ounces frozen shallots, thawed | 8 green bell peppers, roasted and sliced lengthwise | 1 can of diced chopped whole clams with juice | 3 cups chicken stock | 5 ounces frozen, chopped broccoli
instructions: In a large pot with 8 cups of water add the chopped onions. Bring to a boil and then simmer the mixture for 30 minutes. Add the bell peppers and chicken stock, garlic salt and red pepper flakes. Boil for another 30 minutes. Lastly, add the sausage. Bring to a simmer and simmer for 3 minutes. Add broccoli and heat through. Serve with crusty bread of your choice.

Random Ingredients: stir fry vegetable,mango chutney,ham,apricot jam,tortilla chip,yellow pepper
title: Stir Fry Banh Mi Breakfast (Vegetarian, Low Fat)
ingredients: 1 package tortilla chips, or more as desired | 1/4 cup quick stir-fry vegetables, like mushrooms, onions, bell peppers, and cauliflower, rinsed and drained | 1 can or bottle beer | 1 1/2 tablespoons apricot jam | 1 cup diced ham | 1 mango chutney, or more to taste ( optional )
instructions: Spread tortilla chips on a serving platter. Arrange heated vegetables evenly into a microwave safe bowl. Spray skillet with cooking spray. Pour beer into the skillet, and cook in the heated oven until the beer is absorbed and heated through, 20 to 30 seconds. Transfer skillet to a warm serving platter, and keep warm until about halfway set, 2 to 3 minutes. Spread apricot jam onto the tortilla chips, and arrange the sliced ham evenly over the jam. Spoon hot beer mixture over ham, and spread mango chutney over and around.

Random Ingredients: white sugar,greek dressing,tomato,beef sirloin steak,cake flour
title: Best Grilled Beef Roll Ups
ingredients: 1/2 cup cake flour | 4 ounces beef sirloin steaks, finely chopped | 4 tablespoons greek dressing | 1/2 cup white sugar | 1/2 medium tomatoes, thinly sliced
instructions: Stir flour and steak seasoning ingredients together until well blended. Heat a nonstick frying pan over high heat. Dredge both sides of steak in batter mixture. Brown on all sides. Remove steak to serving plate, and top with tomato.

Random Ingredients: sultana,splenda granular,prosciutto,poblano pepper,phyllo dough,bacon,red pepper flake
title: Bacon Wrapped Poblano Puffs [the #1]
ingredients: 16 slices smoked bacon | 8 large poblano peppers, roasted peeled seeded and chopped about 1/8 inch | 1 tablespoon splenda granular | 1/2 cup sultana, chopped ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes | 1/4 cup prosciutto, chopped or 1/4 cup bacon fat, and cut into small pieces | 1 package phyllo dough, thawed if frozen
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350. Spray a large oven proof skillet or baking dish with cooking cooking spray. Slice the bacon slightly, 1 side and the other across the middle. Place on a piece of foil, bacon side down. Place the poblano peppers in the pan and bake 1 hour. Remove the bacon. Let cool and chiffonade the poblanos. When cool slice them into small pieces. Combine the pepper flakes and sugar and add to the bacon fat. Heat until the mix thickens a bit. Remove from heat. Combine the pepper mixture with the sultanas and prosciutto. Cut the phyllo dough into 6 squares. Lay 3 rounds out on a board and lay some more filling down the center, then make a triangle. Wrap the top with a foil strip to make a sealed edge around the edge. Place in boiling water for 3 minutes. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towel. Serve warm with your favourite toppings. Tip when wrapped this way you have to take 1 puff and roll that round until it's completely wrapped. It's easier this way, and also, when it ends up all in the pan without falling apart, you can get the bottom to the center. Bacon wrapped poblanos add to the top of a pastry layer that you have simply folded. I have never actually tried doing that, but my friend is a professional one.

title: Chicken Toddy
ingredients: 4 lbs chicken wings, skin on ( i had a little trouble handling the wings. ) | 2 ounces anise | 1 pint single cream
instructions: Place the wings and the anise in a large mixing bowl. Pour a little cream in a pan and turn to bring cream up to the boil. Turn the heat down and stir until sauce turns a pale dark brown color. Remove and pour the sauce over the chicken. Serve with noodles and a green salad.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,green chilies,green grape,curry paste,lime zest,chili seasoning mix,beef bouillon cube,yogurt
title: Indian Tomato Mince Soup
ingredients: 1 can crushed tomatoes and green chilies ( with liquid ) | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies ( with liquid ) | 1/2 cup yogurt | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 1 tablespoon chili seasoning mix | 1 cup green seedless grape ( with a little bit of juice ) | 1 inch lime, zest of | 1/2 teaspoon curry paste
instructions: Put all ingredients in a large pot. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat, stir and simmer 30 minutes. Serve with chappathi.

title: Ginger-Lime Jelly
ingredients: 4 young ginger root ( peeled and sliced thin ) | 20 small dried lime leaves | 2 -3 slices lemon zest
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large jar and shake vigorously to mix. Cover and store in refrigerator for at least 2 weeks before using.

Random Ingredients: margarine,salsa verde,ice water,cream mushroom soup,sunflower oil,turnip,orange liqueur
title: Salsa Verde Turnip Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs turnips | 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 2 tablespoons orange liqueur ( or a couple dashes of pineapple liqueur ) | 4 tablespoons salsa verde ( or your own ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup ice water
instructions: Boil the turnips until barely barely tender and fork them a few times they should still be slightly tender but not mushy. Remove from hot water and let cool down slightly. When they are cool enough, peel the turnips and cut them into 1/2 inch slices. In a large bowl, combine the turnips, 3/4 t of the sunflower oil, the soup, the orange liqueur, and the salsa verde. Stir to combine. Cover and let stand in the fridge for at least an hour. In a separate bowl, add 1/2 cup ice water and stir well to dissolve. Add the turnip mixture and top off the bowl with ice. Refrigerate for at least an hour to let the flavors blend.

Random Ingredients: white sugar,superfine sugar,salmon fillet,mexican cheese,nutritional yeast,bouquet garni,grand marnier
title: Cherie's Awesome Gravlax
ingredients: 2 cups shredded mexican cheese blend ( velveeta ) | 2 lbs salmon fillets | 1/2 cup bouquet garni | 1/4 cup superfine sugar | 1/4 cup golden marnier | 1 1/2 teaspoons granulated sugar | 1 tablespoon nutritional yeast
instructions: Cook salmon in boiling water for 5 minutes and set aside. Drain fish and reserve. Put cheese in food processor and add 1/2 cup of the cheese along with remaining ingredients. Blend until smooth and adjust seasoning as desired.

title: My Chunky Red Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans rotel, hot sauce ( mild, med or hot ) | 4 -6 slices bacon, cooked till crisp ( optional ) | 1/4 - 3/4 cup chili oil ( i don't usually do it ) ( optional )
instructions: Put all the ingredients in a slow cooker with about 1/2 cup water on it. Cover and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours. If you want it to thicken, add some hot bean liquid or even a little chicken stock. Sauce is done when everything has warm, but not hot or runny. Note, if you have a can of rotel and want to double the amounts, double the chili oil. If you like a thinner sauce, use more water.

title: Yummy Paleo Baked Veal Scallops
ingredients: 2 teaspoons xanthan gum | 2 lbs top sirloin steaks or 2 lbs top loin veal scallops | 1 cup virgin olive oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Sprinkle a little more than 1/4 cup of olive oil on the bottom rack. Line baking sheet with parchment paper, spray with cooking spray. In a small bowl, combine xanthan gum and 1 cup of warm water. Dip the scallops in the batter and transfer to baking sheet. Using back of a meat spoon, press down to flatten slightly. Place on the prepared baking sheet with no excess oil. Bake for 7 - 10 minutes. To serve, cut in diagonal lines about 1/4 inch deep. Serve with remaining olive oil drizzled over the top.

title: Beef Sosaties With Black Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 fresh hot cherry tomatoes, cut into thin wedges | 1/4 watermelon, cut into thin wedges | 1/4 cup molasses ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon molasses ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon beef gravy
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together watermelon, plums, molasses and gravy. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Serve with the sosaties. Store unused portions refrigerated.

Random Ingredients: green onion,baby carrot,beef sausage,pam cooking spray
title: Beef Sausage Dogs
ingredients: 10 beef sausages | 1/2 cup green onion, sliced | 1 package baby carrots | pam cooking spray | 2 tablespoons sliced green onions
instructions: Place sausages on a plate. Spray with pam. Layer green onions and baby carrots on the sausages, sprinkling green onions. Bake at 400 for 15 - 20 minutes, or until cooked.

title: The Artichoke Dip
ingredients: 1 avocado, ripe, peeled, pitted, and diced | 1 small spanish onion, minced | 2 jars artichoke heart, drained and chopped | 1 1/2 cups braggs liquid aminos
instructions: Place everything in a bowl, stir together and refrigerate for at least 3 hours, up to 3 days.

Random Ingredients: shrimp,rice wine,flour,lemon juice,spinach leaf,daikon radish,green chilies
title: Niku Jushi( Shrimp Ball)
ingredients: 1 large shrimp - peeled, deveined, and finely chopped | 32 ounces frozen chopped spinach leaves, or | 16 ounces fresh julienned daikon radishes ( about 10 cups ) | 6 green chilies, seeded and chopped | 1/3 cup fresh lemon juice | 3 tablespoons rice wine | 1 1/2 tablespoons flour
instructions: Combine chopped shrimp and spinach leaves in a large bowl. Combine the chopped shrimp/spinach mixture and 1/4 cup of julienned daikon in a separate bowl using some of the lemon juice. Stir the mixture with your hands until the shrimp are thoroughly coated with the lemon juice lemon juice mixture. Prepare 1 1/2 quart sealable plastic bag for refrigeration. When ready to serve, make sure the bag has been floured and sprinkled with flour. Place a large sauté pan over high heat to heat for 1 minute. Add rice wine and heat until the wine has almost completely evaporated. Remove from the heat and drop one tablespoon of mixture into the pan with the daikon/peeled shrimp/spinach mixture. Place the pan back on the heat, close the lid of the pan, and cook the mixture for three minutes. Remove from the pan and roll the ball around the sausage to form a large round ball, adding an additional 1/4 cup of julienned daikon in the pan at the very end. Serve with more julienned daikon and green chilies on the side if desired.

Random Ingredients: ice water,mango nectar,caster sugar,pimiento,garlic salt,passion fruit juice,gooseberry,stewing beef
title: Stoofvlees - Honeyed Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef, cut in 1. 5 cm-pieces | 1 cup pineapple, unsweetened dried | 2 tablespoons mango nectar | 1 cup passion fruit juice | 1/8 cup lime juice | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 1 tablespoon garlic salt | 1/4 cup ice water | pimientos, sliced, garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Combine all ingredients in crockpot. Cover and cook on high for 3 hours, reduce heat to low during that time, and cook for 1 - 2 hours until beef is tender. Serve immashed with hoisin sauce and garnish if desired with paprika curls. Variation, replace honey for pomegranate with a mix of honey and passion fruit juice.

title: Grenadian Stew
ingredients: 1 rutabaga, peeled and cut into bite-sized pieces | 1 lb kidney bean, well-rinsed | 1 cup frozen tiny peas and carrot | 1 cup shredded napa cabbage | 1 lemon, cut into wedges
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350f degrees. Cook 1 rutabaga in boiling salted water for about 40 seconds, until tender. Remove from heat and drain well. Add the kidney beans and peas and carrots with 1/2 cup water. Simmer for 10 minutes, until vegetables are tender. Meanwhile, heat a small amount of oil in a small skillet. Pour 1/2 cup of hot liquid into the pan and place over medium heat. Stir until hot. Sprinkle with lemon wedges and serve.

title: Aussie Beef Burger
ingredients: 500 g sirloin | 400 g shredded cheese ( we like coombel reg ; that's about 2 slices of cheese )
instructions: Slice the sirloin very very thinly, and place into a flat dish or even a flat plate. Cover with cheese, and place in the microwave until heated through, approximately 30 seconds to 1 minute. Stir, and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,pistachio nut,chili sauce,oatmeal,chickpea flour,sunflower seed
title: Vegetarian Sunflower Seed Patties
ingredients: 3 tablespoons chickpea flour | 1 1/4 cups oatmeal ( plain or quick-cooked ) | 1/2 cup sunflower seeds | 1/3 cup chopped pistachio nuts | 3 tablespoons sweet chili sauce | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 tablespoon chopped pimento-stuffed sunflower seeds
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Form into patties. Grill until golden and puffed.

title: Fried Ravioli with Bean Sprouts
ingredients: 16 wonton wrappers | 1 package thin fresh bean sprouts | 1/2 cup finely chopped saffron | 3 cups hot cooked angel hair pasta
instructions: Preheat a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Place a wonton wrapper on a napkin roll wrapper, keeping a 2 inch margin around the edge. Place about 1 tablespoon bean sprouts on the left edge of the wonton. Brush about ½ cup bean sprouts with water. Bring the edge nearest you over, meet in center with a toothpick and pinch around the edge to seal. Repeat until you have 16 wrappers. Heat the skillet over medium heat.

title: The Anti-Zard
ingredients: 1 can black beans | 1/2 cup apricot jam | 1/2 cup hot sauce | 1/4 cup beer
instructions: Drain and rinse black beans, remove any excess water. Transfer them to the slow cooker. Combine the jam and hot sauce in a jar until blended and pour over the beans. Mix well. Cook on low for about 5 hours. You can stir in some chopped parsley. Cover and cook for an hour to thicken the mixture.

Random Ingredients: olive oil,rice,green chili salsa,dill,cardamom,tapioca starch,cardamom seed
title: Gramma's Sofrito
ingredients: 8 -12 cups raw rice ( about a pound ) | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 3 green chili salsa ( store-bought or homemade ) | 1 teaspoon freshly ground cardamom | 1/2 teaspoon lightly crushed cardamom seed | 1/2 teaspoon crushed fenugreek lentils or 1/2 teaspoon thai green chili salsa ( store-bought or homemade ) | 1 teaspoon tapioca starch or 1 teaspoon cornstarch | 1 teaspoon finely shredded fresh dill or 2 teaspoons parsley
instructions: Put rice in a bowl with cold water and soak for 30 minutes to 1 hour. Drain and set aside. Heat oil in large skillet over medium heat. Add chile, cardamom, and fenugreek, stir fry two or three minutes. Add rice, stirring until each grains become shiny and golden, which means that you still have some texture left. When you are done, turn off heat. Add water, and mix well. Cover and wait at least 15 minutes. Uncover, and stir well. After 15 minutes, take off heat. Add starch, mix well. After 15 minutes, check to see if you think the mixture has a little moisture clinging to it and that you've got a lovely consistency that takes on the appearance of rice cake. If needed, uncover and mix well. You can add a little bit more water and/or salsa, as needed to make things go smoother. If it seems a bit dry, add more rice. Cover. Turn stove to low and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes until all liquid is absorbed. Add fresh dill or parsley, mix well, or serve in a small dish and serve to your taste.

Random Ingredients: curry leaf,chipotle pepper adobo sauce,chicken breast half,watercress,tahini,nutritional yeast,apricot,butter
title: Chilled and Spicy Chicken Skewers
ingredients: 1/4 cup apricot, chopped | 3/4 cup boiling watercress or 3/4 cup green onion, chopped | 2 teaspoons low-fat buttermilk or 2 teaspoons soy yogurt | 2 teaspoons unsalted butter, melted | 1 1/2 teaspoons nutritional yeast | 1/4 teaspoon chipotle pepper in adobo sauce | 4 sprigs fresh curry leaves ( optional ) | 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves, about 12 ounces each
instructions: Place apricots, watercress or green onions, melted butter, buttermilk, yeast, chipotle chili sauce and curry leaves in a food processor and process until almost smooth, about 30 seconds. Spread into an 8x8x2 inch glass dish and refrigerate until completely chilled, about 2 hours. Place chicken in a shallow dish and pour marinade over. Cover and let marinate in the refrigerator at least 6 hours, turning meat twice. Preheat a grill or broiler. Thread 3 to 4 skewers per skewer, depending on height of meat, lengthwise. Place skewers on a grill rack over medium hot coals. Cook, turning, until chicken is cooked through, 6 to 8 minutes or grill over medium medium hot coals 10 to 12 minutes, turning and brushing with melted butter and remaining marinade.

title: Italian Meatball and Peppers
ingredients: 12 small green peppers, halved lengthwise | 2 -3 tablespoons sesame seeds | 1 1/2 cups italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 3/4 cup raw caster sugar | 3/4 cup dry sherry
instructions: Cut the green peppers in half lengthwise, lengthwise, remove seeds. Preheat a shallow ovenproof skillet over medium high heat before starting any meat. Sprinkle the sesame seeds onto a cookie sheet. Roll the peppers into 8 large meatballs. Sprinkle the breadcrumbs onto a second sheet of foil to coat. Sprinkle the sugar and sherry on top. Arrange the meatballs on top. Cover and cook for 30 - 40 minutes for large meatballs and 15 minutes for smaller ones.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,yeast,plum,red currant jelly,rye bread,part mozzarella cheese,ham,pomegranate
title: Pomegranate Cheese Bread
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry bread, such as durkee's, plus 1 tablespoon bread | 7/8 cup coconut milk, warmed | 1 tablespoon dry yeast | 4 cups unbleached all-purpose flour, plus more as needed | 4 ounces smoked ham, cut into 1/3-inch dice | 1 1/4 cups pomegranate, seeds from 6 ounces ( red pomegranates ) | 1/2 cup red currant jelly | 1 3/4 cups shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese
instructions: Cover the inside of a large bowl, sprinkle with the bread, and proof the yeast with 7/8 cup of the coconut milk. Cover, and let stand in a warm area for 30 minutes. Stir in the yeast and 1 1/4 cups of the flour.

title: Spiced Spanish Onions
ingredients: 4 tablespoons kosher salt | 2 large red bell peppers, stemmed cut on bias into 1/2 inch strips | 1/2 teaspoon sugar | 1/2 hard-cooked egg, peeled and coarsely chopped
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix 2 tablespoons of the salt together. Place the remaining 2 tablespoons of salt in a heavy bottomed nonstick skillet over medium low heat. Add the peppers and sugar. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the peppers and sugar are lightly brown and caramelized. Add the egg and cook, stirring, until most of the liquid is evaporated. The onion will be caramelized but not dark inside. Use slotted utensil to transfer onions to paper towels to drain.

title: Muesli With Pear
ingredients: 2 bunches lettuce, torn into 1/2 inch pieces | 3 pears, pared and diced | 1 serrano pepper, diced | 2 tablespoons orange juice | muesli ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients, including juice in a bowl, and toss well to combine. Serve immediately.

title: Baked Pineapple
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground beef | 1/2 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese | 1 teaspoon crushed garlic | 2 tablespoons unsweetened pineapple juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a large nonstick skillet, cook beef over medium high heat until browned, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: green food coloring,anisette,bell pepper,tahini sauce,vanilla bean,ziti pasta
title: Tahini Ziti with Pepper and Ziti
ingredients: 8 ounces ziti pasta, uncooked | 1 large bell pepper ( sliced ) | 1 medium ziti pasta ( uncooked ) | 2 -3 whole green food coloring, drops | 1/2 anisette, pimento-stuffed or 2 -3 candy sprinkles, crushed | 2 tablespoons tahini sauce
instructions: Cook ziti and pasta according to package directions. Cook each of the following in large covered saucepan over medium heat, bell pepper, ziti, green food coloring, anisette and crushed candy sprinkles. When cheeses melts remove from heat. Sprinkle with cool topping. Enjoy.

title: Mexican Sweet and Sour Meat Loaf
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs boneless meat, cut into 1-1/2-inch cubes ( i like to use 3 cut it, 1 pound ) | 1 lb sliced ham | 2 -4 tablespoons hot pepper sauce ( i use tabasco brand ) | 2 teaspoons dark brown sugar | 2 teaspoons cornstarch | 1 serrano chili ( seeded if u like spicy, or more ) or 1 jalapeno ( seeded if u like spicy, or more )
instructions: Soak meat, ham slices in cold water for about 1/2 an hour. Pat the meats dry with paper towels, removing and discarding any fat. Mix sauce ingredients and spread over the meat. Cook at 325°f for 1 hr or until the meat is completely tender, stirring every 15 - 30 minutes so the sauce doesn't stick. Remove meat and ham with a slotted spoon and cover loosely with foil. You can add some fresh jalapenos to your sauce and this gives flavor. You can also stuff the meat if desired. We like lots of stuff and usually don't bother stirring it, just to get the good stuff into the meat. We eat it with a loaf recipe as a starter, or eat it as a side dish. Also, if you want it to have some of its leftover you can just saute it in oil with the jalapenos and use for flavor.

title: Grilled Indian Tea
ingredients: 1 cup green cardamom pods, split | 1 teaspoon dried sage | 2 teaspoons italian seasoning
instructions: In a small skillet over medium heat, toast the cardamom pods until fragrant, about 5 seconds. Remove them from heat, cool and stem, then split lengthwise. Remove the stems and any loose seeds from the cardamom pods. Combine the cardamom, sage and italian seasoning in a bowl. Place split cardamom pods in the bowl and toss with about 2/3 cup of the flavored seasoning. The tea should be warm but not hot.

title: Beef Bavarian
ingredients: 1/2 cup sauerkraut packed in milk, well drained, reserve juice | 1/8 teaspoon crushed savory | 1/4 teaspoon paprika | 1 beef flank steak, trimmed | 1/2 cup thickened cream or 1/2 cup milk | 2 tablespoons hot sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons unsweetened chocolate milk
instructions: Combine sauerkraut, savory and paprika in medium bowl. Add beef. Allow to sit at room temperature 30 min, or refrigerate until ready to grill. Meanwhile, mix cream, hot sauce and chocolate milks until well blended. Brush onto both sides of steak. Grill over medium heat, turning once for medium rare, or until desired doneness.

Random Ingredients: pine nut,cayenne,nut,large shrimp,coconut milk,swiss cheese,baking chocolate
title: French Shrimp on a Baked Mole Pone
ingredients: 1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne | 1/2 cup unsweetened coconut milk | 1/2 cup shredded swiss cheese | 1/4 cup toasted pine nuts | 1/4 cup chopped candied mixed nuts
instructions: Line a baking sheet with foil, then place shrimp on baking pan and set aside. Bake at 375 degrees fahrenheit for 15 to 18 minutes, or until pink and firm. Remove shrimp from oven and set aside to cool until easy to handle. Meanwhile, in a separate saucepan, over medium high heat, combine coconut milk and sugar and bring to a boil. Add the shrimp, cayenne, toasted pine nuts, toasted nuts and toasted pine nuts and return to a boil. Turn off heat and add the shrimp to the saucepan and cook for a few minutes to blend the flavors. Spoon sauce mixture over shrimp and sprinkle with the toasted pine and candied nuts for garnish.

title: Avocado Cheese Spread
ingredients: 4 avocados | 1 cup mayonnaise | 1 1/2 teaspoons catsup | 1 tablespoon ginger juice | 1 teaspoon coriander seed, crushed | 1 teaspoon mace | 1/4 cup pesto sauce | 1 lb velveeta cheese
instructions: Grate cheese and put in plastic bag and microvave on high for 1 minute drain off the excess water and place cheese in mixer and puree all ingredients in a blender and beat until smooth and creamy. Chill until cold. Spread on a greased bread roll and broil until slightly golden on both sides then slice into squares, top with a little cheese and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,cumin seed,orange bell pepper,cream tartar,lime wedge,mustard powder
title: Mexican Holiday Dressing
ingredients: 2 teaspoons chopped fresh orange bell peppers or 2 teaspoons red bell peppers | 1 teaspoon dry mustard powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin seeds | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 2 small limes, juice and zest of | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Shake the dressing in a clean jar with a tight fitting lid. Stir in all remaining ingredients. Chill.

Random Ingredients: pecan,white wine vinegar,pecorino cheese,pistachio nut,wheat spaghetti,honey
title: Cold Nuts With Pistachios, Carpaccio, and Nuts
ingredients: 1 cup walnut pieces ( or macadamias ) | 1/2 cup toasted pecorino cheese or 1/2 cup gruyere cheese, grated | 1/2 cup dry white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons honey | 3 cups loosely packed coarsely ground whole wheat spaghetti ( or linguine ) | 1/4 cup toasted pecan pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f coat a baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray. In a large bowl, toss together walnuts, pecorino, cheese, vinegar, and honey. Stir in ground whole wheat pasta. Sprinkle with toasted pecans.

title: Bean & Tofu Sandwich
ingredients: 1 cup white chick-peas | 4 ounces tofu, chopped | 1 cup wheat bread flour | 2 tablespoons guacamole | 1 jar pasta, warmed
instructions: Boil peas in water. Cool slightly and mash. In separate bowl mix tofu and rice until it is crumbly. Mix in bean and mash. Divide on to two plates and spread guacamole on the top. Place bread on top and eat immediately.

title: Spicy Cheese Fonduta
ingredients: 5 bananas ( yellow, green or sweet ) or 5 peppers ( yellow, green or sweet ) | 1 bunch sharp cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: Pre heat oven to c. Place cheese in a small pot and cook over a medium flame, stirring constantly until the cheese has melted and becomes a creamy brown color. Turn off heat, but leave the cheese in the pot and keep warm. Using two forks, gently scrape the inside of the pot out of the pot. Place the drained cheese into a bowl with a lid that reaches an inch or two on the top. Place the fried cheese over the heated cheese and pour in the desired amount. Serve while hot or warm.

Random Ingredients: potato flour,yukon gold potato,cilantro,hot mustard,bean sprout,yam
title: Mashed Potato Salad (Sinangag-Yaya)
ingredients: 450 g yukon gold potatoes, boiled and mashed | 225 g yam, peeled and diced | 115 g mixed bean sprouts | 4 tablespoons potato flour | 20 g fresh cilantro, chopped | 2 tablespoons hot mustard
instructions: Mix potato flour, ground mustard and chopped cilantro. Combine potato, yam and mixed bean sprouts. Mix cabbage and mustard/cilantro mixture together. Pour dressing over potato/bean sprouts mix. Season with salt and pepper. Toss.

Random Ingredients: red chilies,cake flour,white pearl onion,vegetable oil cooking spray,wheat pita bread,mango,sherry wine,white wine vinegar
title: Mango-Sweet Onion Strata
ingredients: 4 cups pitted white pearl onions | 1/2 cup dry white wine vinegar | vegetable oil cooking spray | 12 tablespoons dry white wine vinegar | 1 cup mango, peeled, seeded, chopped | 1/2 cup red chilies, chopped | 1/4 cup dry sherry wine | 2 cups cake flour, preferably all-purpose | 1 lb thin sliced sweet plain bread
instructions: Heat oven to 200 degrees. Spread onions in a single layer on a large baking sheet. Roast 25 minutes, turning often and adding a little oil if needed, until very pale gold. Cool onions completely and slice thinly. Combine first 3 ingredients in a bowl. Sprinkle onions with sherry and let stand 5 minutes. Add flour and mix well, just until the flour is absorbed. Spread the onion mixture in a greased 9 x 13 baking dish. Bake onions 10 minutes, stirring at least twice. Remove and cool to the touch. Spread mango over the top and bake an additional 5 minutes, or until the mango and onions are just lightly browned. Cool. Place the sweet toast and sliced onion together. Serve with dressing, raita, sour cream or salsa. Cooks note, i also served this with roasted red potatoes.

Random Ingredients: egg,red beet,salmon steak,mint leaf,green pepper,oregano leaf,lobster,soymilk
title: Grilled Lobster Salad
ingredients: 400 g fresh lobster, scrubbed and chopped | 40 g red beets, roasted chopped | 1 green pepper, chopped | 100 g salmon steaks, halved lengthways | 2 tablespoons of fresh mint leaves | 2 teaspoons fresh oregano leaves or 1 tablespoon dried oregano | 2 small eggs or 2 medium egg whites | 1 cup soymilk ( or almond milk if you wish to serve it chilled )
instructions: Whisk together the eggs, soymilk, oregano and mint mix, with seasoning. Combine with the lobster, vegetables, and salmon. Gently fold in the egg whites until just combined. Pour into a salad bowl, sprinkle with extra oregano. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,jalapeno,phyllo pastry,marsala wine,lamb shoulder,brown sugar,apricot
title: Sweet Lamb or Pork Phyllo Purses
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless lamb shoulder or 2 lbs pork butt, trimmed, cut into 1-1/2 x 1-1/2-inch strips | 1/3 cup marsala wine | 1 packet taco seasoning mix ( optional ) | 1 cup minced fresh apricot | 1/2 cup brown sugar | 1 tablespoon chopped pickled jalapeno, drained ( optional ) | 3 packages frozen pastry sheets ( i use frozen and thaw in the refrigerator ) | 1 cup melted fat-free sweet paprika or 1 cup taco sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In large bowl, combine lamb strips, marsala wine, 2 teaspoons seasoning mix, apricots, sugar, and jalapeno. Transfer mixture to a 13x9 inch baking dish sprayed with nonstick cooking spray. Lay in 1 layer of phyllo on lightly greased baking sheet. Brush phyllo with remaining oil. Cover phyllo with remaining phyllo sheets, brushing each with oil. Cover with plastic wrap and lightly spray with remaining oil. Bake covered for 45 minutes. Uncover and bake until phyllo is golden and crispy and meat is browned, about 25 minutes longer. Sprinkle with paprika and heat until hot, about 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chive,thyme sprig,rice noodle,chocolate square,pineapple tidbit,yellow squash
title: Noodle-Vegetable Kabobs
ingredients: 4 ounces pineapple tidbits, fresh | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprig | 3 medium yellow squash, very thinly sliced | 4 ounces rice noodles, dried ( vietnamese ) | 1 chocolate square, chopped | 1 tablespoon chives, minced
instructions: Place pineapple, thyme, and squash in food processor.

Random Ingredients: chipotle powder,parmigiano reggiano cheese,french bread italian,cucumber,mint leaf,corn kernel,sea scallop
title: Seared Scallops Parmesan
ingredients: 2 tablespoons grated fresh parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/2 teaspoon chile powder | 4 large sea scallops, well trimmed | 1 cup fresh corn kernels | 1/2 medium cucumber, peeled seeded and cut crosswise into very thin slices | 1/4 cup fresh mint leaves | 1 tablespoon coarsely chopped fresh mint leaves, for garnish
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the parmigiano reggiano and chile powder to blend. Dredge the scallops in the parmesan mixture on all sides, shaking of the excess. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat until hot. Add the scallops and sear until golden brown, 1 to 2 minutes per side. Transfer the scallops to a plate. Add the corn, cucumber, mint, and mint to the skillet. Reduce the heat and simmer the mixture, stirring, until it begins to lightly brown. Return the scallops to the pan and remove them from heat. Divide the sauce among 4 large plates.

title: Vegetable-Noodle Bake
ingredients: 8 ounces egg noodles, uncooked | 1 cup spanish onion | 1/3 cup green pepper, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon savory | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f degrees. Cook egg noodles according to package directions.

Random Ingredients: cayenne,shallot,mandarin orange,shrimp,macadamia nut,cold water,tomato juice,fennel seed
title: Soy Chilli Prawns
ingredients: 1 kg peeled shrimp | 1 tablespoon sugar | 1 teaspoon chopped fennel seed | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne | 50 ml tomato juice | 8 shallots, minced | 2 mandarin oranges, peeled drained and chopped | 1 tablespoon macadamia nuts, chopped
instructions: Heat oil in a heavy based frying pan over high medium heat. Add fennel seed, chilli and cayenne and stir often, until fragrant. Place shrimp in pan and stir fry for about 2 - 3 minutes until curled and pink. Transfer to plate, pour in juices and shallots. Wipe pan from heat and return to stove. Stir fry for 30 seconds or until sauce is dark brown and shrimp are just cooked through. Season with salt and pepper. Remove from heat and stir in orange segments and nuts. Serve.

title: Homemade Dark Beer (Beer Recipe)
ingredients: 1/2 of a cup dark beer ( stout or beer can ) | 2 1/2 cups flour
instructions: Mix the rest of the ingredients together. Knead on a floured surface and divide into 3/4's, or whatever size you would like to make.

title: Griddled Aubergines With Creamy Aubergine Sauce
ingredients: 4 small aubergines | 1 1/2 cups low sodium chicken broth | 1/4 cup butter | 1/4 cup finely chopped mixed pickle relish | 2 tablespoons whole wheat bread flour
instructions: Cut the tops off each aubergine and slice them lengthwise into 3 cm slices. Cut the slices into 3cm pieces by cutting between the base and inside of the slices, but not cutting through the bottom to the top. Brush the slices lightly with a little water, season well and cook on the barbecue or in a griddle, browning on all sides. Remove and reserve on a dish. Add the broth and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer gently for 15 - 20 minutes, or until aubergine is very tender. Stir in the butter until melted. Add relish, and return to the boil. Remove from the heat. Transfer to a bowl and serve with the aubergine. Note, cook time does not include time to soak the aubergines. This could also be made into one of several variations using just chicken broth.

title: Pickled Clams
ingredients: 1 gallon clam juice | 1 1/2 tablespoons prepared mustard seeds | 1 pound fresh beets, cut into 1 inch cubes | 4 kaiser rolls, split lengthwise
instructions: Bring clam juice to a boil in a large pot using a bottle with a tight fitting lid. Grind mustard and seeds in a spice grinder until fine. Drain juice and set aside. Place beets in a saucepan with about 1/2 inch water with enough water to cover, and bring to a boil. Cook until tender, about 10 minutes. Reserve 1/2 cup of beets for dipping. When clams have opened, drop beets into sauce. Remove from heat and mix with the strained juice. Cover, and let stand about 30 minutes. Serve on rolls.

Random Ingredients: nonstick cooking spray,tapioca flour,broccoli floret,chorizo sausage,vegetable stock,chunky peanut butter
title: Thai Chorizo & Broccoli Stew
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tapioca flour, sifted | 1/2 lb chorizo sausage, sliced | 1 1/2 cups vegetable stock ( or use broth ) | 2 cups broccoli florets, halved | 1/2 cup chunky peanut butter | nonstick cooking spray
instructions: Spray a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Add chorizo and cook until brown, breaking up clumps. Stir in stock and cook until thickened, about 5 minutes. Add broccoli and cook until crisp tender, about 3 minutes. Stir in peanut butter and simmer until completely warmed. Pour into a bowl.

Random Ingredients: rye flour,green peppercorn,star anise,red bell pepper,burrito flour tortilla,plain yogurt
title: Spicy Grilled Bell Peppers and Yogurt Enchilladas
ingredients: 4 green bell peppers, seeded and chopped | 3/4 cup plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons rye flour or 2 tablespoons cornmeal | 1/2 teaspoon ground star anise | 2 teaspoons whole green peppercorns, crushed | 12 burrito-size flour tortillas | 1 red bell pepper, seeded and finely diced
instructions: In a small saucepan over medium heat and bring to a simmer, stirring often, the green peppers and yogurt. Season with black pepper and star anise. Let sit and cool to room temperature. Meanwhile, sprinkle the green peppercorns on a plate. Sprinkle on 2 teaspoons water. Dip each burrito-size tortilla in sauce, then arrange them on a baking sheet coated with cooking spray. Pour about 1/4 cup sauce into the center of each tortilla. Spoon about 3/4 cup of pepper mixture down the center of each tortilla. Roll and slice the burritos and arrange on a plate. Repeat with the remaining tortillas and remaining sauce. Garnish with red bell pepper.

Random Ingredients: yellow onion,seasoning salt,cannellini bean,accent seasoning,citron,salt,self raising flour
title: A Very Victorian American White Bean Bread
ingredients: 1 cup white bean flour | 1 tablespoon salt | 2 teaspoons sugar | 1 teaspoon accent seasoning | 1 1/4 cups canned cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 large yellow onion, chopped | citron, to decorate
instructions: If you are using canned beans, reserve the liquid. In a large bowl, mix together with enough bean liquid to mix so that it forms a thick batter. Add the salt, sugar and accent seasoning. Add the cannellini beans, onion and enough water to just cover. Mix thoroughly to mix everything in the batter. Knead by hand until the batter is smooth. If necessary, cover with a piece of greaseproof paper and a damp cloth. Roll out to a thickness of approximately 2 thick. Cut into desired shape and top with desired decorations. Pre heat oven to 180c / 350f / gas mark lightly dust breads with flour and place on a baking tray with a lip or lightly greased cling wrap on top. Bake at 180c / 350f / gas mark 3 for approximately 25 - 30 minutes.

title: Treasure Chest Gummies
ingredients: 100 g fresh rhubarb | 400 g firm tofu | fresh cilantro | fresh sage | black greshly ground coriander leaves | 1 graham cracker ( about 250 g ) | freshly chopped cilantro
instructions: Remove and discard tough outer leaves from rhubarb stalks with a vegetable peeler, using a knife or a small shredding tool. Peel away the soft outer part from the tender meat and chop to 1cm cubes with a knife or a processor. Cut tofu, coriander and sage into chunks. Finely grind cracker and coriander leaves together in a food processor. Add water to ground spices and blend well. Toss rhubarb with half of the spice mix in a large bowl. Place tofu in the centre of a round of hot graham cracker crust. Sprinkle with half of the herb mixture. Cover the crumb layer with the rest of the crumbs and serve with wedges of fresh cilantro to dip into the extra spice. Eat or forget the trimmings from theTreasure Chest store.

Random Ingredients: parsnip,lasagna noodle,serrano chile pepper,mango chutney,grape,tortilla chip,chili sauce,elbow macaroni
title: Indian Spicy Macaroni and Parsnips
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked elbow macaroni | 1 can chili sauce | 4 serrano chile peppers, minced | 15 ounces uncooked lasagna noodles | 1/2 cup chopped fresh parsnips | 3/4 cup chili sauce | 2 cups grated mozzarella cheese | 4 thin grape tomatoes | 4 thin tortilla chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Filling for Pasta
ingredients: 2 cups farfalle pasta | 1 can water chestnuts, drained | 1 (.7 ounce ) package refrigerated filling
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook the farfalle pasta at a boil, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 12 minutes.

Random Ingredients: bamboo shoot,ladyfinger,tomato paste,cream mushroom soup,orange juice,bay leaf,tabasco sauce,nutmeg
title: Quick and Easy Easy Bamboo Shoot Trifle
ingredients: 2 cans sliced bamboo shoots, drained | 2 cans chopped tomato paste | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 package ladyfingers | 1/2 cup orange juice | 1/4 cup tabasco sauce | 1/4 teaspoon freshly grated nutmeg | 1 dash tabasco sauce | 2 bay leaves
instructions: Drain bamboo shoots. Combine all ingredients except ladyfingers, orange sauce, and nutmeg in large bowl. Mix well. Place ladyfingers in bottom of 4 x 1 1/2 quart glass bowl or 1x1 1/2 quart round baking dish. Spoon approximately one third of bean mixture over ladyfingers, then spread remaining bean mixture on top. Top bean mixture with remaining ladyfingers, then spread remaining bean mixture on top. Cover and refrigerate 1 hour. Remove from refrigerator, uncover, and let stand 10 minutes before slicing.

Random Ingredients: mesclun,ginger garlic paste,watercress leaf,amaretto,mayonnaise,yellow bell pepper,rosemary,active yeast
title: Amaretto - Parsley Tea Rolls
ingredients: 1/2 cup warm water | 1 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh rosemary | 1/2 cup warm water ( not hot ) | 2 tablespoons amaretto | 2 tablespoons fresh sage ( minced or 1 tsp. grated fresh sage ) | 6 tablespoons mayonnaise | 3/4 cup grated yellow bell pepper | 1 tablespoon minced peeled fresh ginger-garlic paste | 4 -6 cups finely chopped fresh mesclun | 12 fresh mint leaves
instructions: Sourdough starter, stir first 4 ingredients in a large mixing bowl. Let stand 5 minutes. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cover and refrigerate until bubbly, about 1 hour. Filling, stir bread mixture into starter mixture. Cover and let rise until mixture becomes bubbly about 1 hour. Add optional ingredients.

title: Marjoram and Thyme Vinegar
ingredients: 1/4 - 1/2 cup vinegar | 1 tablespoon dried thyme | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram
instructions: Combine all ingredients, and heat well. If desired, serve immediately and refrigerate for up to 2 days.

title: Easy, No Bake, Blackberry & Hungarian Cheese Blend
ingredients: 1 1 cup strong sweetened coffee granules | 1 tablespoon hungarian sweet paprika | 1/2 lb sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 1 cup sliced blackberries
instructions: Place the coffee granules in a small heat proof bowl. Sprinkle the gorgonzola and paprika over the top. Micro wave on high power for 1 to 2 minutes, or until cheese is melted and fragrant. Stir well. Stir in the blackberries. Store in an airtight container away from light and heat, for 6 to 8 hours or in the freezer for up to 5 days.

title: Real Indian Barley Mix
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley | 3 -4 drops green food coloring | 2 teaspoons liquid smoke
instructions: Rinse barley until water goes clear. Bring to a boil then boil. Boil for another 10 minutes then drain. Add green food coloring to the barley mixture. Add liquid smoke and mix well. Transfer to air tight container. Keep in fridge.

title: Spicy Sesame Oil
ingredients: 1/2 cup sesame seeds | 1/3 cup mirin | 1 red chile, finely chopped
instructions: In a bowl, mix sesame seeds, mirin, and chile. Allow to sit for at least 15 minutes before shaking out the excess seeds.

title: Lobster and Radish Saute
ingredients: 1/2 lb pinto beans, rinsed and picked over | 1/2 white radish, peeled and diced ( about 1/2 cup ) | 2 small lobsters, split in half lengthwise and deveined ( about 1 1/2 lb. ) | 1/2 cup whipping cream | 2 small shallots, finely chopped ( about 1 1/2 t ) | 12 slices prosciutto, cut into 1/4 slices | kosher salt
instructions: Place pinto beans and radish in a medium saucepan and add water to cover. Bring to a boil, skimming off any foam, reduce heat to a simmer, cover and cook until pinto beans are very tender, about 30 minutes. Remove from heat. Meanwhile, cover a 12 inch skillet with cooking spray and set over moderately high heat. When it is heated, add lobster and prosciutto and stir fry until lobster is just cooked through, about 3 minutes. Spread pinto bean mixture over the skillet and scatter shallots over the top. Raise heat to moderately high and fry until shallots are lightly browned and lobster is cooked through, a few minutes. Serve with salsa.

Random Ingredients: golden brown sugar,red capsicum,turmeric powder,basmati rice,black bean,beet
title: Sydney Style Beet and Rice Salad
ingredients: 300 g black beans ( can be bought canned ) | 150 g basmati rice | 1 can beets | 1 red capsicum ( deseeded and sliced ) | 2 tablespoons golden brown sugar | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Drain off any excess water. Boil the beans, and let them simmer with water to cover until tender. Drain and rinse the beans well. Cook the rice in lightly salted water. Drain and cool. Slice the capsicum thinly. Tear the beet into strips and combine with the beans and capsicum in a serving bowl. In a small saucepan, add the sugar and turmeric and warm gently, this will cook the turmeric. When it starts to colour, gradually add the warm sugar and oil and warm through. When the sugar is completely dissolved, add the beet mixture. Remove from the heat and pour the dressing on top, stirring well to combine.

title: Faux-Easy Roast Beef Appetizer
ingredients: 1 rump roast | 20 toothpicks | 4 tablespoons apricot jam | 1 envelope onion soup mix | 2 teaspoons ground cardamom | 10 ounces frozen spinach, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Remove the rump roast from packaging, and make sure it has completely shaved off excess fat. Lay the toothpicks on a cutting board and cut the meat in half. Place the rump roast on the toothpicks and using the tines of a fork, poke about one inch deep holes all over the roast. Dredge meat in the jam, mix the onion powder with the cardamom and spread a thin layer of the onion powder mixture on the meat. Then spread a layer of the spinach. Next, drizzle the apricot jam over the spinach. Place the meat under the roast and make sure it is completely covered with the jam mixture. Make sure you end with a thin layer of gravy on all sides of the meat. Cover tightly with foil and place in the oven. Bake in the preheated oven for 10 minutes. Remove from oven, uncover foil, and let rest for 5 minutes. After 5 minutes, spread some more of the gravy on the meat. Cook for 10 more minutes. Turn rack to broil and broil until browned.

title: Chinese Pepper Tea Bread
ingredients: 1 (.25 ounce ) package active dry yeast | 4 3/4 cups water, divided
instructions: Combine the yeast and 2 cups of warm water in a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,whipping cream,pine nut,red chile,cream mushroom soup
title: Papa's Red Chile and Pine Nut Rolls
ingredients: 1 package frozen puff pastry, defrosted | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup pine nuts, chopped | 1 cup whipping cream | 1 small red chile, seeded and minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Roll out one package of puff pastry into a 10x15 inch rectangle. Mix mushroom soup, pine nuts, cream, and chile in a bowl. Spread half of the soup mixture on the dough. Spoon half of the mushroom mixture evenly over the soup layer. Roll dough up like a jelly roll. Tightly roll dough into a crescent, and place on an ungreased baking sheet. Cut slits into the top of rolls with a sharp knife, being careful to not cut all the way through. Bake at 425 degrees for 25 to 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: fennel seed,chuck,garam masala,almond milk,orange zest,corn oil,pizza sauce
title: Moroccan Baked Mini Meatballs (From Alton Brown Weiners)
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs whole lean ground chuck | 1 tablespoon finely minced orange zest | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 1 container refrigerated pizza sauce | 3 tablespoons corn oil | 2 tablespoons orange juice or 2 tablespoons water
instructions: In a large bowl, blend the meat, orange zest, fennel seed and garam masala. Add enough of the pizza sauce to bind the spices and coat well. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour. Pre heat oven to 350° and position a rack in the center. Roll the meat mixture into meatballs about 1 1/4 in diameter. Dry on paper towels. Place the meatballs on a foil lined baking sheet. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes, until meat is cooked through and cooked through. Meanwhile, make the orange sauce. In a medium saucepan, mix together the oil, orange juice and the remaining sauce. Bring to a boil and reduce the heat to a simmer. Cook for 5 - 10 minutes or until thickened and syrupy. Serve hot along with the meatballs.

title: Glazed, Dry Apricot and Black Peppercorns
ingredients: 3 large apricots | black peppercorns | 2 -3 teaspoons coarse black pepper ( coarsely ground black pepper is the key )
instructions: Cut apricots in half. With a spoon, scoop out and discard the core. Roughly chop the flesh and set the pits aside. In a skillet over medium heat, combine apricots and pepper. Sprinkle with coarsely ground black pepper and brown, about 2 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: gold tequila,wooden skewer,salt black pepper,mozzarella cheese,confectioner ' sugar,baking powder
title: Pancho Villa Margarita or Relish
ingredients: 2 tablespoons brown sugar or 2 tablespoons white sugar | 8 ounces mozzarella cheese, shredded ( or monterrey jack ) | 12 wooden skewers, soaked in water | 12 large garlic cloves | 1 cup gold tequila ( not the `` unfiltered '' variety ) | 1 teaspoon baking powder | coarse salt and black pepper
instructions: Preheat oven 300°f. Slice cheese into 12 equal pieces. Thread cheese pieces onto skewers, alternating with one piece of cheese. Place skewers on greased foil lined cookie sheet. Rub outside of rolls with some of the sugar. Bake 15 minutes. When cool remove from foil and place on the counter to cool to room temperature. Place the garlic, tequila, baking powder, salt, and pepper in a blender and puree. Store in refrigerator. Pour the mixture through a fine mesh sieve. You should have about 1 - ½ cups of loose liquid.. Shake away the excess solids with a long handled spoon until liquid is completely absorbed into margarita. Pour into a nonaluminum bowl, cover and refrigerate until ready to serve. Makes 5 to 8 servings. Enjoy.

title: Garlicky Mint Chips
ingredients: 1 3/4 pounds tortilla chips | 16 sprigs fresh mint
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Line a 9x13 inch baking dish with a kitchen towel. Spread the tortilla chips on the paper towels and place in the oven. After 1 to 1 1/2 minutes, carefully shake the pan and flip chips. Once chips are lightly browned and brittle, remove from oven and set aside. Repeat with remaining chips and mint leaves. Spoon some mint into each of the mint sprigs. Serve immediately for dipping.

title: Tasteful and Simple Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup packed fresh horseradish ( not creamed ) | 3 tablespoons grated onion | 1 tablespoon all purpose greek seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla bean, split lengthwise ( or 1-1 1/2 tablespoons of dry vanilla ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme sprig ( optional )
instructions: Dissolve the grated onion with the horseradish in the 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a small bowl. Transfer to a small bowl, cover, and refrigerate until thoroughly chilled. While the mixture will chill, prepare the tropical paradise, invert a serving bowl over a glass serving dish and set aside. Toast the bitter bitter fruit of your choice and stir into the cooled mustard. Serves 3 to 4 with pita bread as an accompaniment alongside.

title: Low Cal French Courgette (Sweet Potato) Salad
ingredients: 6 medium courgettes ( about 3.5lbs ) | 2 teaspoons sugar substitute, splenda ( optional )
instructions: Peel the courgettes and slice on the diagnonal cuter. Place them in a shallow earthenware bowl. Sprinkle with a little salt. Pour the rest of the ingredients over the courgettes and stir to mix. Cover and refrigerate until chilled and juicy. This can be served with any meal.

Random Ingredients: mayonnaise,cumin,spring onion,rose water,turmeric powder,pork roast,garlic paste,carrot
title: Ma'arash (Fiery Pork Roast Sandwich With Green Mayonnaise)
