ingredients: 2/3 cup green mayonnaise ( or sour doughnut mayonnaise ) | 1/2 tablespoon garlic paste | 3 tablespoons finely chopped spring onions or 3 tablespoons white onions | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder ( or cardamon powder ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/4 teaspoon ground rose water ( optional ) | 8 ounces pork roast, shaved or cut into thick strips | 2 carrots, sliced thin ( for garnish ) | fresh flat leaf parsley, finely chopped to serve
instructions: Preheat the grill to high heat. In a microwave safe bowl, whisk together the mayonnaise, garlic paste, onion, turmeric and cumin. Microwave, uncovered, on high for 1½ - 2 minutes or until the mayonnaise has reduced slightly. Transfer the mayonnaise to a serving bowl. Add the rose water, if using. Add the pork and carrots. Toss lightly to coat. Season lightly with salt, scatter with the parsley and serve with flatbread salad or as a sandwich with bread and a salad. Variations, pork can be used in place of spring onion. Instead of mayonnaise, the mayonnaise may be eaten either way on its own or with sauteed greens such as spinach leaves.

title: Salsa Verde
ingredients: 2 cans red kidney beans | 1 carrot, shredded | 1 yellow bell pepper, deseeded and cut into thin strips | 1 lime, halved, seeds removed ( optional ) | 2 1/2 tablespoons granulated sugar
instructions: Drain the red kidney beans and carrots, reserving 2/3 cup of the liquid. Combine the beans and reserved liquid.

title: Easy Crock Pot Beef Tips
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat | 4 celery ribs, cut into 1/2 inch wedges | 1 -2 tablespoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Brown beef tips by rubbing all over with a vegetable cooking spray on the bottom and sides of your slow cooker. Place the celery over the meat. Sprinkle the worcestershire sauce onto the meat. Add enough water to cover the meat. Cover the slow cooker and cook on low setting for 7 - 8 hours or on high setting for about 4 - 5 hours. Serve with a tossed salad, bread rolls or potatoes.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,crisco shortening,mexican cheese,green olive,golden mushroom soup,rye bread
title: Baked Beef Philly Cheese Sandwiches with Olives
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef or 1 lb top sirloin steak, cut 1/2 inch thick | 1 can french cheese soup | 1 can green olives, sliced ( drained ) | 1 jar sliced green olives ( drained ) | 12 slices rye bread | 2 tablespoons crisco shortening | 1 1/2 cups shredded mexican blend cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Brown meat in a skillet.

title: Naked Farfalle with Raspberry and Vanilla
ingredients: 3 1/2 ounces farfalle pasta | 6 tablespoons white peppercorns, finely ground | vanilla extract | 3 1/2 ounces fresh raspberries, pitted and sliced or 3 1/2 ounces frozen raspberries, thawed ( thawed )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Bring water to a boil. Add macaroni pasta and simmer for a minute while stirring. Drain well and place in bowl. Add all other ingredients except raspberries and toss well. Transfer to lightly greased shallow oven proof casserole dish. Bake for 20 minutes. Top with fresh raspberries, bake for an additional 12 minutes, until berries are bubbling and center is just hot.

Random Ingredients: turmeric powder,red chili pepper,dark brown sugar,ladyfinger,seasoning salt,beef chuck roast
title: Award-Winning Tandoori Bites
ingredients: 6 lbs beef chuck roast | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar or 1/2 cup light brown sugar | 1 tablespoon hot red chili pepper, finely ground | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 24 ladyfingers ( ladyfinger halves )
instructions: Place chuck roast in slow cooker, sprinkle with sugar, hot pepper and turmeric. Sprinkle top with seasoned salt. Let stand covered until beef is tender, about 3 hours. Stir well to redistribute drippings. Turn slow cooker on high. Pour off juice. Cover tightly and cook on high for 1 hour, turning after 45 minutes. Transfer beef and juice to serving bowl. Wrap and chill overnight. The next day, skim fat from juices. Cool slightly. Place drained meat on platter and garnish with ladyfingers.

title: Easy Orzo Chicken
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/8 cup ketchup | 1 tablespoon minced gingerroot | 1 package orzo pasta | 1 can sliced ripe figs, drained
instructions: Cook and stir orzo according to package directions. Drain. Mix soup, ketchup and gingerroot together. Bring to a boil and stir in orzo. Stir in figs and cook 5 minutes.

title: Broccoli and Tortilla Wrap
ingredients: 4 slices crisp tortillas or bread ( 8 x 8-inch ) | 1 cup broccoli floret, thinly sliced
instructions: In a nonstick skillet sprayed with cooking spray, place one piece of tortilla and microwave until pliable.

title: Roasted Tomato Chutney
ingredients: 1 cup grape tomatoes | 1/2 cup red onion, coarsely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Wash and core tomatoes. Using a grater, coarsely chop the tomatoes. Place the tomatoes, onion, allspice, and grapes in a medium bowl. Toss to combine. Roast at 360 degrees f for 20 minutes or until the tomatoes are a golden syrup. Cool to room temperature and store in an airtight container at room temperature. Makes about 1/2 cup.

title: Crock Pot Chocolate Gizzards
ingredients: 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa | 1 tablespoon adobo sauce | 1 lime, zest of | 1 - 2 1/2 lb cremini mushroom, cleaned and coarsely chopped
instructions: Whisk together all ingredients together, add more if desired. Place mushrooms in crock pot, and stir well. Cook on low for 4 - 5 hours or high for 3 - 4 hours.

title: Peppy Seed Crusted Steak (For a Rainy Day!)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons poppy seeds | 2 tablespoons filet mignon steaks
instructions: In a small, dry frying pan, over medium high heat, toast poppy seeds, stirring constantly, until dark brown. Set aside. Coat both sides of a meat tenderizer with a thin layer of oil. Rub lightly with the poppy seeds and then dust steaks with this coating. Let rest for 5 minutes. Preheat oven to 500 degrees. Bake for 10 - 12 minutes, until dark brown and steaks reach desired doneness.

title: Spaghetti Agua Fresca
ingredients: 3 tablespoons adobo sauce | 1 tablespoon ground sumac | 1 tablespoon ground asafoetida powder | 1 package chicken broth | 12 ounces spaghetti | 6 kiwi fruits, sliced in half on the diagonal
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to the package directions. Meanwhile, in a saucepan, combine sauce ingredients and bring to a boil. Remove from heat, adjust seasonings and serve over spaghetti.

Random Ingredients: grape tomato,pecorino cheese,stilton cheese,chilies,cardamom pod,leek,red onion
title: Stilton, Leek and Tomato Tapas - Ancient Renaissance Recipe
ingredients: 150 ml firm stilton cheese, crumbled | 200 g stilton cheese, crumbled | 1/4 small leek, pale ends trimmed and finely chopped | 1 large red onion, finely chopped | 6 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom pod | 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved and seeded ( plum tomatoes ) | 2 chili, finely chopped ( hot red or pimentos don't make them too hot )
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together and leave to stand for 1 hour, stirring occasionally. Transfer the tapas into a warmed serving dish and serve.

Random Ingredients: apple juice,barley,pesto sauce,hot chili pepper,cumin seed,red cabbage
title: Red Cabbage & Pesto Appetizer
ingredients: 1/2 cup apple juice or 1/2 cup white wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon dried pesto sauce | 1 tablespoon ground cumin seed | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon hot chili pepper ( depending on your taste ) | 1 cup sliced red cabbage | 2 cups sliced cooked red cabbage
instructions: Whisk together the apple juice, pesto, cumin and chile. Add the red and green cabbage to the mixture and stir to coat. Transfer to a jar with a tight lid and store in the refrigerator. If you have a microwave, place the lid on top, cover and microwave on high, stirring occasionally for 3 - 5 minutes. Let stand a minute or two. Serve as is, or refrigerate after opening.

title: Quick and Easy Beef Jerky
ingredients: 450 g beef sirloin steaks, trimmed, cubed | 1 1/2 cups sweet chili sauce | 3/4 - 1 cup australian sweet chili sauce, warmed ( storebought or homemade ) | 1 saffron, dissolved in | 1/4 cup beer
instructions: Combine the beef sirloin, sweet chilli sauce, saffron and beer in a non metallic bowl and leave in the fridge to marinade for 1 - 3 hours. Remove the beef from the marinade and discard the marinade. Barbecue the beef on top of the grill lid on medium high heat for 10 minutes, basting occasionally with the sauce. Turn the beef, baste with the sauce and continue cooking for a further 10 minutes or until the beef is cooked to your liking. Allow to stand a few minutes before slicing into thin strips across the grain.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,russet potato,caster sugar,salad oil,topping,mustard,ra el hanout spice mix
title: Potato Crumble With Dressing
ingredients: 4 russet potatoes | 4 tablespoons prepared mustard | 2 tablespoons salad oil | 1/4 cup ra el hanout spice mix ( i use moroccan spice mix # 143019 ) | 3 tablespoons caster sugar | 10 ounces sour fat free whipped topping ( thawed ) | freshly crushed graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220c degree celcius fahrenheit. Wash and dry the potatoes. Grate the potatoes into a bowl, then drizzle with the mustard and mix in the oil, add the spices and mix well. Place the mixture on a baking tray and bake uncovered for 45 minutes or until the potatoes are golden brown and crispy. Allow to cool slightly before serving. Topping, whisk the sour fat free sour cream to a smooth consistancy. When serving top the potatoes with a spoonful of sour cream and a tablespoon of whipped topping.

title: Feta Focaccia
ingredients: 2 1/2 pounds fresh yeast | 1 bunch fresh thyme | 3 tablespoons garlic, minced | 5 packages crumbled feta cheese | 2 large yellow bell peppers, thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce, or to taste
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together the yeast, thyme and garlic. Let stand for 10 minutes until the yeast softens and begins to foam. Stir 1 package of crumbled feta cheese, yellow bell peppers, hot pepper sauce and 1/2 the sourdough starter into the bowl with the yeast. Stir in 1/2 the remaining cheese until the mixture is thoroughly blended. Spread the mix into a greased 2 quart casserole, cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Sprinkle the top of the focaccia with remaining cheese. Heat a 9 inch cast iron skillet over medium heat. Remove from the refrigerator after about 15 minutes and coat with cooking spray. When the cheese begins to turn golden brown, poke several holes in the top to test, if it does, it's done. Place the skillet in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, then remove. The focaccia may be served hot or cold.

title: Homemade Pizza Dough
ingredients: 8 ounces thin bread | 1 cup pizza sauce ( see recipe below ) | 1 cup corn oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Using an electric mixer, add the ingredients in a bowl. Mix until it's completely mixed well. Roll mixture into a ball and then press out onto a pizza pan. Repeat with all of the dough. Spread the sauce over the dough and then top with remaining toppings. Place on a parchment covered cookie sheet and lightly sprinkle with flour. Bake for 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: rotini pasta,mexican cheese,leg lamb,rice flour,asafoetida powder
title: Chef John's Asafoetida-Roasted Garlic Lamb
ingredients: 1/2 cup rice flour | 1 pound boneless leg of lamb | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 1 package shredded mexican-style processed cheese | 1 pound rotini pasta, cooked
instructions: Place rice flour in a shallow dish. Toss in the lamb meat, and coat each piece with rice flour. Transfer to oiled baking sheet. Bake in preheated oven until the internal temperature is 170 degrees f, about 45 minutes. Baste meat occasionally. Remove from oven, and reduce oven temperature to 300 degrees f. Roast lamb for 1 hour, or until the internal temperature is 180 degrees f. Cool to room temperature. When cool enough to handle, carve leg into bite size serving pieces. Toss together a little bit of asafetida powder with 1/2 cup mexican style processed cheese. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place the rotini in a large pot with enough lightly salted water to cover. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat. Let simmer until the pasta is cooked in the boiling water, about 8 minutes.

title: Beef and Macaroni Pie
ingredients: 1 lb ground sirloin | 1/2 cup vermouth | 1 package macaroni noodles ( uncooked ) | 1/2 cup pimento stuffed olive ( sliced ) | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh basil | 18 dumpling wrappers ( see directions )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Brown ground sirloin on a skillet over medium heat, and drain. Season meat with vermouth and cook macaroni in boiling water for 10 minutes. Drain, and return to pan. Add pimento stuffed olives to meat and mix. Fill wrappers with mixture and place in casserole dish. Pour vermouth and vermouth mixture over wrappers, and top with basil. Cover with foil, and bake for 30 minutes, or until sauce is bubbly and flavors are well blended.

title: Tarka(Malai Methi)
ingredients: 1 kg poppy seed | 1 inch piece gingerroot | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Grind the poppy seeds with half cup of water in a blender to a fine powder. Mix in the ginger and turmeric powder once again. Keep aside. Heat oil in a wok. Once it turns yellow in colour, add the poppy seed paste. Cook for 10 minutes. Once it starts leaving oil, remove from heat and pour the spice mixture into it. Spread it onto a bamboo skewer. Allow it to set in the oil and harden. Serve with plain low fat yogurt.

title: Scallop and Pasta
ingredients: 400 g farfalle pasta or 400 g penne pasta | 400 g bay scallops | 2 tablespoons gelatin powder ( heaped ) | plain flour, for dusting
instructions: Boil the pasta according to the instructions on the packaging. Heat a non stick sauté pan with a little oil over a medium high heat. When the pan is hot add the scallops and cook, stirring until they change in colour. Remove from the heat and set aside. Return the pan to the heat and coat the scallops. Serve the pasta with scallops.

title: Nori Onigiri (Cold Nori) - Shio Kaminaraki
ingredients: 1 sheet nori | 2 tablespoons flat-leaf italian parsley, chopped | 1 tablespoon lemon peel, shredded with micro plane
instructions: First thing all make the kaminaraki sauce. Stir the chopped parsley, lemon peel, and kaminaraki together. Put the nori on clean dry surface and lightly brush with a bit of the flavored oil. Gather the edges with a towel, and cut with a 2 to 5mm star shaped cookie cutter, pressing to flatten. Reroll the nori and cut into 4 slices. Put nori flat on kitchen towel. Repeat with remaining nori.

title: Easy Peasy Pasta With Sunflower Seeds
ingredients: 1 box pasta | 1 cup sunflower seeds | 1/2 cup ricotta cheese
instructions: Boil your pasta in plenty of water, then drain. Place sunflower seeds in a pan toasted over gentle heat and toast until slightly coloured. Meanwhile, put ricotta in a bowl, add about a cup of water and then stir until creamy. Add the drained pasta to the ricotta and stir to combine. Mix through. Add the seeds and mix through. Serve and enjoy.

title: Crispy Sea Salt Squid With Vegetables (Jiaozi Kuka)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs squid or 1 1/2 lbs squid ink roe | 5 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1/3 cup coarse salt-free cake flour | 1/3 cup toasted sesame seeds ( see note ) | 2 teaspoons minced cilantro leaves
instructions: Clean squid and slice 1/8th of an inch thick. Place in bowl and cover with warm water for 15 minutes, squeeze out excess liquid. Drain squid and blot dry with paper towel. Sprinkle with salt. Meanwhile, heat oil in 10 inch skillet over medium high heat until tiny bubbles form on top. Add squid and cook, stirring and turning with tongs, until squid is well curled and light brown, 5 to 10 minutes. Transfer squid to a bowl and keep warm. Return skillet to low heat. Stir in flour, then bring to a boil over medium high heat, whisking in enough hot liquid in skillet to form a smooth dough. Cook, whisking constantly, until mixture thickens to a pale rich color, about 2 minutes. Stir in sesame seeds and cilantro and cook until liquid is thick enough to coat spoon, about 1 minute. Transfer to squid. Season with salt and serve hot. Note, this is excellent with egg shaped crabmeat which is easily flaked when cooked.

title: Skewered Beef With Hazelnuts
ingredients: 3 lbs lean beef | 1 lb hazelnuts | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 dash msg ( optional )
instructions: Soak the hazelnuts in water, and remove the skin. Slice the meat very thin on the diagonal. Place in a saucepan with 2 cups of water, the nut butter, and the garlic and just enough salt to taste. Cover and bring to boil. Turn down the heat, and simmer for about 1 1/2 hours. The sauce will thicken very quickly.

Random Ingredients: espresso powder,dijon mustard,soy sauce,rice noodle,hot water,peanut
title: Filipino Noodles
ingredients: 2 -3 teaspoons instant espresso powder | 2 tablespoons low sodium soy sauce | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1 1/2 tablespoons hot water | 1 package dried rice noodles, cooked according to package directions | 1/2 cup dry roasted peanuts
instructions: Dissolve 1 teaspoons hot espresso powder into soy sauce and set aside. In large skillet, heat other 1 tablespoon espresso powder over medium heat.

title: Gorgonzola Oats (For the Microwave)
ingredients: 4 tablespoons gorgonzola ( about ) | cooking oats, for rolling
instructions: Place a large, microwave safe bowl on top of a dinner plate. Microwave the gorgonzola until melted, about 20 seconds. Use a fork and fork to mash the gorgonzola into a smooth paste. Stir in the oats to form a grainy dough. Microwave on high power for 3 to 5 minutes or until dry or slightly golden at edges. Cool, cut and serve.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,wok oil,mango,sirloin,orange juice,marshmallow,cottage cheese,lasagna noodle
title: Lumpia
ingredients: 3 lbs ground sirloin | 3 packages lasagna noodles | 2 cans sliced marshmallows | 2 cups low fat cottage cheese | 1 1/2 cups orange juice | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 teaspoon ground mango
instructions: Combine ground sirloin, noodles, marshmallows, cottage cheese, orange juice, garlic powder and mango in large bowl. In a skillet, heat 1/2 c. Of the oil on medium heat. Cook lasagna noodles until browned. Drain. Place 3 lasagna noodles on plate, top with 1/2 meat mixture and 1/3 of the cottage cheese mixture. Repeat layers. Serve with salsa.

Random Ingredients: barbecue sauce,swiss chard,wild mushroom,vegetable stock,meat,canola oil
title: Barbecued Swiss Chard With Wild Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 tablespoons canola oil | 3 lbs swiss chard, leaves cut from stems just below ribs | 1 can of undrained wild mushrooms, drained | 1 1/2 cups vegetable stock | 1 cup barbecue sauce
instructions: Preheat grill to medium heat, medium heat. Brush oil over ribs. Remove ribs from grill and place flat on hot grill with ribs close together. Turn several times and rearrange ribs when tender. Brush with canola oil and turn once during the cooking process to evenly brown ribs. Combine mushrooms, vegetable stock and barbecue sauce in a medium saucepan. Cover and bring to a boil on high heat. Drain ribs, remove ribs from the grill. Pour mushroom mixture into blender container, add ribs and blend on high until well blended. Transfer ribs and sauce to a small casserole dish. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve. Serve ribs and sauce with ribs and warm vegetables.

title: Crock Pot Apricot Pork Loin
ingredients: 3 tilapia fillets, boneless cut into 3 pieces | 1 can apricots, drained and halved | 1 boneless pork loin roast, trimmed and tied
instructions: In a 3 1/2 or 4 quart crock pot place 3 pieces of pork loin skin side up, skin side down. Top with apricots. Add second piece of pork loin, skin side up. Tie string around roast. Add to crock pot. Cook on high for 3 1/2 to 4 hours or low for 3 1/2 to 4 hours and until meat falls apart easily.

title: Falafel
ingredients: 1 jar pineapple preserves | 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds ( optional ) or 1 teaspoon cumin ( optional )
instructions: Blend in a food processor until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Add fruit juices and mix. Use as you would pizza for dipping.

title: Tunisian White Beans with Cod
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds dried navy beans | 1 can diced cod, drained | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 teaspoon cumin seeds
instructions: Combine the navy beans, diced cod, and cream in a large pot.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,pork tenderloin,lime wedge,peppercorn,coconut flake
title: Island Pork Loins (Gulabate Mushi)
ingredients: 3 3 lbs pork tenderloin or 3 lbs pork loin, 1 1/2 x 2 1/2 inches thick, 1-1/2 x 1 1/2 inches | 1 jar coconut flakes, well stirred | 3/4 cup peppercorn, crushed | 2 cups long-grain white rice | lime wedge
instructions: Cut tenderloins into 8 slices each about 1 inch thick. Spread coconut flakes in a shallow 2 quart baking dish. Top with pork, pressing lightly so that coconut is absorbed into meat. Sprinkle with peppercorns. Bake at 300° for 30 minutes, turning once, or until a thermometer registers 150° to 165f for medium, and beef pork loins are well done. Remove pork from oven, let stand 10 minutes. Remove meat from baking dish and cool. Rinse skillet, removing any browned bits with a spoon and any sludge clinging to pork. Stir rice and peppercorns into pork in baking dish. Cover tightly and refrigerate. Bring to room temperature before serving.

Random Ingredients: pork hock bacon,white onion,poblano chile,vidalia onion
title: Home Homemade Poblano Peppers
ingredients: 1 small white onion, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 1 medium poblano chile - seeded, cored and sliced into 1/4 inch slices | 2 pork hocks, sliced crosswise into 1/4 inch slices | 1 small vidalia onion, cut into wedges and separated | 1 large white onion, cut into 1 inch slices
instructions: Heat the oven to 375 degrees f. Line a 9x13 inch baking dish with aluminum foil. Arrange the poblano peppers on the prepared baking dish. Arrange 1 sliced onion atop the poblano peppers. Heat the oil and 2 sliced onion slices in a large skillet over medium heat. Stir in 3 poblano peppers. Place the remaining 3 poblano peppers on top of the poblano peppers and onion slices. Stir the mixture every few minutes. Remove the pan from the heat and put the poblano peppers and onion layers evenly in the prepared baking dish. Sprinkle the tops of the peppers with 1 separated white onion wedge. Bake the stuffed peppers in the preheated oven until the peppers are tender, about 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,basil pesto,chunky peanut butter,red cherry
title: Hot Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup chunky peanut butter | 2 tablespoons tomato juice | 1/2 cup fresh basil pesto | 1/2 cup candied red cherries ( optional ) or 1/2 cup candied cherry ( optional )
instructions: Stir peanut butter in small bowl until blended. Stir in tomato juice until blended. Stir in pesto and cherries. Refrigerate at least 6 hours or overnight.

title: Tasty Party Dip or Sandwich
ingredients: 1 can fat-free refried beans and mixed sprouts | 2 tablespoons light sour tea | 1/4 cup shredded colby cheese or 1/4 cup monterey jack cheese
instructions: Heat oil in small saucepan over low heat. Add the hot refreed bean sprouts. Heat to boiling. Once heated, add the hot tea. Turn off heat. Top each slice of the buns with the colby/ jack cheese. Spread the bean sprouts over the top. Serve with crackers for dipping.

title: A Different Vodka Noodles (Rachael Ray)
ingredients: 8 ounces rice vermicelli | 1 cup corn kernel, well drained | 1 1/2 fluid ounces vodka
instructions: Combine noodles and corn kernels in a bowl, toss until well coated. Add vodka a little at a time until noodles are coated and coated.

Random Ingredients: stewing steak,pinto bean,allspice,beef stock,poblano pepper,serrano pepper,ladyfinger,vegetable
title: Beef With Bean Dip
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing steak, sliced | 2 lbs pinto beans | 2 lbs sweet mixed vegetables, peeled | 3 serrano peppers, stems included | 6 poblano peppers ( seeded and minced ) | 2 tablespoons beef stock | 1 cup soft ladyfinger, cut in 6 pieces | 1 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Place the meat, beans, vegetables, jalapenos, poblano peppers and beef stock in a large dutch oven. Cover and simmer till meat and beans are tender, about 1 1/2 hours. Remove from heat and allow to simmer till liquid is reduced to about half again. Place lady fingers in a bowl of cold water for 20 to 30 seconds. Dish is done when the finger is just pliable. Drain the stew and vegetables reserving liquid in a food processor or blender. Return the liquid to the pan and bring to a boil. Add the sugar and stir to break the beans. Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer till heated through. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: French Beans and Green Peppers on Garlic Croutons
ingredients: 1 lb french beans, trimmed | 1 green pepper, chopped | 2/3 cup turkey stock
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Place a sheet of aluminum foil atop a larger oven proof skillet just large enough to wrap around the beans. Place over medium heat, spray with cooking oil and add the beans. Saute peppers and green peppers until tender but not brown. Add turkey stock and cook for about 4 minutes or until heated through and beans are tender. Place mixture in another bowl and season to taste with salt if desired. Spoon the beans on top of the green pepper and serve. This meal can be served warm or at room temperature and is better reheated.

Random Ingredients: white chocolate,kale,head cauliflower,beef roast,caster sugar,double cream,milk chocolate chip,white wine vinegar
title: Cauliflower-Chile Beef
ingredients: 600 g beef roast | 1 head cauliflower, broken into florets | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 1/4 cup milk chocolate chips | 2 tablespoons caster sugar | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 150 ml double cream | 1/4 cup freshly grated white chocolate
instructions: Place beef in a large pan, put in the cover and place on the low heat. Leave to cook for 10 mins and remove from heat. Meanwhile, boil the cauliflower until just tender. Drain and set aside when cool enough to handle. Meanwhile heat oven to 180c. Place the meat, vinegar, sugar and white wine in a microwave safe bowl and set aside to cool a little. Add the cream and vinegar mixture to the cooled beef mixture. Place in oven for about 20 mins until the sauce has thickened and the beef has cooked. Remove from heat and stir in the white chocolate. Serve over cooked cauliflower.

title: Spicy Clam Patties
ingredients: 1 cup picante sauce ( your pickle heat ) | 1/2 cup bottled clam juice | 1 teaspoon grated orange peel, peel of | 2 small garlic cloves, minced | 2 1/2 teaspoons curry leaves | 4 pieces breadcrumbs | 8 prawns or 8 langoustines | filling, to dust
instructions: In a medium size bowl, add picante, clam juice, orange peel, garlic, and curry leaves. Add the bread crumbs, and mix well. Place the prawns in a medium size saucpan, and add enough enough water to cover. Bring to medium heat, and cook prawns until they are just cooked through, about 3 minutes. Drain, and set aside. Dip the prawns in a little beaten egg, and then dip in bread crumb mixture. Place on paper towels to absorb excess grease. Place on a plate, and refrigerate until serving.

title: Lebanese Cardamom Soup - Bagna
ingredients: 2 boxes vegetable broth | 1/2 - 1 cup dry rice wine or 1/2-1 cup dry sherry | 2 teaspoons ground cardamom seed | 4 cups half-and-half, warmed | 1/4 cup half-and-half, for brushing | 1/2 cup double cream
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine the broth, rice wine, ground cardamom and warm soup mixture. Cover, bring to a boil and reduce the heat to low. Simmer for about 10 minutes. Remove from heat. Slowly stir in the half and half. Cool for about 5 minutes. Strain through a fine mesh sieve into a bowl and let cool slightly. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use. Divide into 4 serving bowls. Garnish with cream and serve immediately.

title: Red Chile Relish II
ingredients: 2 cans diced white onions, drained | 2 cans chopped green chile peppers | 1/2 cup chopped fresh parsley | 1/4 cup chili flakes
instructions: Toss the onion, green chile peppers, parsley, and chili flakes together in a bowl until thoroughly mixed.

title: Quick and Easy Chinese Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1/2 cup chili sauce | 1/2 cup molasses | 1/4 cup chopped pine nuts | 4 -5 dried cremini mushrooms ( cut in four pieces ) | 3 3 lbs chicken wings
instructions: In bowl add chili sauce, molasses, pine nuts, mushrooms and creole mushrooms. Rinse chicken wings and then add to sauce and simmer covered at least 30 - 60 minutes stirring often.

title: A Different Kind of Burger
ingredients: 1 hamburger bun | 1/4 cup sliced mushrooms | 1 teaspoon rice wine or 1 teaspoon dry sherry | 1 packet frozen peas | pea
instructions: Slice burger in half and toast lightly, spread on bun. Top with mushroom, peas, and a tablespoon of wine or sherry, as desired. Serve with condiments, such as salsa, salad dressing, or mustard.

title: Sicilian Pork loin
ingredients: 300 -400 g pork loin | 300 -400 g dried porcini mushrooms | 150 -200 g pepperoni | 25 g soft tofu
instructions: Soak mushrooms in hot water for around 20 minutes, then drain them. Remove all gizzards, stems, and membranes from pork and cut into bite size pieces. Cut the pork into bite size pieces, removing fat or connective tissue. Add some olive oil to the pan. Add pork and cook over high heat until the pork and mushrooms are cooked but the moisture from the mushrooms only covers the pork. Add pepperoni and mushrooms. Remove from heat and serve with rice. Dollop with cheese, salad, or just eat from a crockpot.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,craisins,taco seasoning mix,rum,maraschino cherry,guinness stout
title: Beer and Chutney Fondue
ingredients: 1 large guinness stout | 3 tablespoons raisins | 3 tablespoons rum, or as needed | 1 package soft taco seasoning mix, or as desired | chopped maraschino cherries, or lime juice to taste | mango chutney to taste
instructions: Pour guinness in a small bowl. Mix in raisins, rum, taco seasoning, and cherries.

title: Aubergine (Eggless Crock Pot)
ingredients: 2 large aubergines | 8 chicken thighs ( approx 1lb, approx ) | 200 g of crème fraîche | 50 g of thickly sliced haricot vert or 50 g other fresh vegetables | 1 liter of tepid black pudding see description
instructions: Peel the aubergines and cut into long thin lenghts. Place them on a plate and sprinkle lightly with salt. Turn up on your oven grill and put the temperature on to 150c, 220°c if you have a fan oven. Cut any fleshy parts off the aubergines and carefully remove the core with a knife. Slice the heads and seperate from the body and keep the flesh separate. Place all the vegetables into the bottom of the crockpot and sprinkle with the meat, aubergines and crème fraîche. Mix well then pour over enough cold water to cover everything in the crockpot. Cover and cook on high for 7 hours or on low for for 8 hours. Turn crockpot to warm setting. Stir the pudding in a bowl and serve the crockpot with the meat and vegetables on the side, or serve with thick breads to mop up juices.

title: Chile Focaccia
ingredients: 1 cup hot stock or 1 cup broth | 10 pieces ladyfingers, split ( or similar size ) | 1 tablespoon grated orange peel | 1 small red chile, thinly sliced
instructions: Bring stock to a boil. Quickly drain off any remaining stock. Place half of the lady fingers or any other flat, fluffy type of lady finger in the bottom of a deep dish. Cover with 1/2 teaspoon of broth, and 1/2 teaspoon of orange peel and sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon of chilli. Repeat with remaining lady fingers. Cover and marinate in fridge for one hour or longer. Serve warm, with additional orange peel and chillies, if desired.

title: Gloria's Easy Beef Tuscany
ingredients: 1 boneless beef chuck roast | 1/2 cup tomato paste | 2 tablespoons finely chopped toasted pecans | 1/2 cup shredded radicchio
instructions: Place roast in crockpot and add tomato paste and pecans. Place on low for 8 hours. Uncover and shred meat and stir into sauce. Serve over hot cooked rice or noodles.

title: Spicy Banana and Mango Salsa
ingredients: 1/2 tablespoon cocoa | 1/2 tablespoon finely chopped fresh galangal | 1 small red chile, finely chopped | 500 g asparagus or 500 g red leaf lettuce | 1 medium mango, chopped | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 1 medium mango, diced | extra oil ( for frying )
instructions: Heat a small nonstick frying pan over medium heat, add the oil, swirl to coat and then season with salt and black pepper. Add the curry paste and chili and stir for 1 minute or until fragrant. Add asparagus, cook for 4 minutes, then stir in 1/2 c of the mango and half the parsley. Gently stir a few times to break up the asparagus and then cook for another 1 - 2 minutes until the asparagus is just tender. Mix the salsa in with the other ingredients and chill for up to 2 hours prior to serving. Serve with steamed or grilled asparagus, cucumber wedges, spring onions or radish if desired. Can also be served on a bed of lettuce alongside.

Random Ingredients: granny smith apple,apple juice,liquid smoke flavoring,nacho chip,cranberry
title: Mexican Apples
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups nacho chips | 1/4 cup liquid smoke flavoring | 1 can apples with juice, and | 1/4 cup dried cranberries | 1 granny smith apple ( optional )
instructions: Place chips in greased 9 pie pan in rows or rows as they are needed to fit chips. Combine liquid smoke and apple juice in medium size mixing bowl and add to chips. Stir until chips are evenly covered by liquid. Top with dried cranberries, apple and optional granny smith apple. Cover and refrigerate overnite. Serve with your choice of side dishes.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,nori,beef bouillon cube,vanilla ice cream
title: Oyoshikari
ingredients: 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 2 -3 teaspoons beef bouillon cubes | 1/2 sheet nori, seaweed sheets | 1 pint vanilla ice cream
instructions: Preheat broiler. In a small bowl, mix oyster sauce and bouillon. Cover and shake. Heat a frying pan over medium heat. Brush oyster sauce mixture.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,cherry pie filling,cinnamon,nori sushi,white sugar
title: Sweet Cherry Sushi
ingredients: 1 frozen tart cherry pie filling | 1 sheet nori sushi | 1/4 cup white sugar | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Cut short strips of plastic wrap from one of the korean sushi squares. Place a single sheet of nori at the bottom of a microwave safe dish, about 1/4 inch deep. Lay cherry pie filling in center. Cover with another sheet of nori, and cut until square is approximately 8x10 inches. Lay more nori over filling, and carefully roll up jellyroll style. Repeat with remaining nori sheets, and slice rolls into approximately 4 squares. Place rolls seam side down on the prepared baking sheet. Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon, and season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Granny's Smashed French Fries (Microwave)
ingredients: 4 russet potatoes ( about 1 1/2 pounds ) | 1/2 cup rum extract
instructions: Microwave the potatoes uncovered on high power until tender and the potatoes have expanded, 5 to 7 minutes. Carefully remove the potatoes and mash them with a potato masher or a fork and the rum extract in a large bowl. Spread on parchment paper and refrigerate, covered, for up to 1 week.

title: Spotted Pancakes
ingredients: 5 cups plain flour | 10 medium potatoes, mashed | potato starch, for dusting
instructions: Sift flour into a large bowl, make a well in it, then stir in mashed potato. Turn mixture into a lightly floured surface and knead for 5 minutes. Cover with a cloth and rest for about 30 minutes, or until it is firm. Lightly grease a large frying pan with a little flour and heat over a medium heat. Roll or stretch the pancake mixture at a 30 degree angle, until a thin round is formed. Fry the pancake in small batches, browning on both sides and removing immediately. Serve hot, cut into wedges and topped with onion gravy or cheese for vegetarian use the potato starch.

Random Ingredients: greek yogurt,ginger root,scallop,red wine vinegar,white pepper
title: Grilled Scallops in Ginger-Ginger-Lickly Greek Yogurt
ingredients: 2 scallops, cleaned and cut in half | 1 1/2 teaspoons red wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon freshly grated ginger root | 1 teaspoon white pepper | 1/2 cup greek yogurt
instructions: Place scallops and vinegar in a small bowl. Let stand 15 to 20 minutes. Stir ginger and white pepper into yogurt.

Random Ingredients: decorative candy,yellow cornmeal,onion soup mix,ginger,graham cracker crumb,icing sugar,new mexico chile
title: Cheat's New Mexican Mummies
ingredients: 3/4 cup crumbled graham cracker crumbs | 1 package of new mexico chiles, rinsed, seeded and chopped | 1/2 cup minced onion ( or diced green onion ) | 1/2 cup icing sugar | 1/2 - 1 cup yellow cornmeal, plus more for coating the cookie | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon ground ginger | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 1 cup icing sugar, for coating ( for sprinkling ) | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon red new mexico chile, for sprinkling | graham cracker crumbs ( for sprinkling )
instructions: In a bowl, combine the cracker crumbs, chiles, onion, salt, icing sugar, cornmeal and ginger. Add more cornmeal if needed. If it's too wet, add more bread crumbs. Mix in the dry soup mix. Turn the dough out onto a floured surface. Knead for a few minutes until smooth and elastic. Flour your hands or bench. Roll the dough out small balls and coat with the granulated icing sugar. Bake at 350°f for about 25 - 30 minutes or until the edges are light brown.

Random Ingredients: orange peel,mustard seed,lime wedge,apple cider vinegar,tomato juice,heavy cream,yellow bell pepper
title: Mexican Tomato Chutney
ingredients: 2 yellow bell peppers, seeded | 1 large orange peel | 2 cups apple cider vinegar | 1 cup fresh tomato juice | 1 tablespoon dry mustard seeds | 1 cup heavy cream | lime wedge
instructions: Slice yellow bell peppers into very thin strips. Place the orange peel and peppers in a bowl, and toss with vinegar until coated. Stir the tomato juice, mustard seeds, cream, and lime juice, and pour into peppers. Cover and chill for 2 to 3 hours.

Random Ingredients: milk ricotta cheese,milk yogurt,red onion,cake flour,bacon bit,curry leaf,meat
title: Curry Rolls
ingredients: 2 packages cake flour | 3 cups milk yogurt | 1 cup curry leaves ( fresh or dried ) | 6 slices bacon bits | 3/4 lb lean ground meat | 8 ounces milk ricotta cheese or 8 ounces cottage cheese, drained | 1 small red onion, chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f. Mix the flour, yogurt, curry leaves, bacon bits and ground meat. Work with your hands until the dough is too stiff to work with. On a floured board, press down on the dough lightly, to form a roll about 1 1/2 inches in diameter or as thinly as you can handle. The more you work with the dough and the thicker the roll the more rolls will roll out. Place a few slices of dough in a line down the length of your roll. With moist fingers, spread about an inch of the ricotta/cottage mixture around the circle, leaving about 1 1/2 inch of dough uncovered near the edge. Place a few more slices of dough near the edge along the edge and press the edges closed. Repeat for all the rolls of dough. Lay the rolls in a baking dish. Lightly flour the tops of the rolls so they bake evenly. Bake for 40 - 45 minutes until nicely browned.

title: Pesto and Cornflour Chips
ingredients: 300 g cornflour | 150 ml margarine ( butter, not oil ) | 1 tablespoon oil | 1 tablespoon parsley flakes | 1 1/2 pints pesto sauce ( refrigerated )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Put margarine and oil into a bowl and add parsley flakes, cornflour and pesto. Mix well to combine. Roll out thinly and make into 1 inch rounds. Place on a tray and bake for 10 - 12 minutes. Store in an airtight container. Makes approximately 8 pints.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,italian cheese,penne,jerk sauce,maraschino cherry,bean sprout,pea,basmati rice
title: Jerk Beef and Rice Noodle Dinner
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef stew meat, cut into 1 inch chunks | 1 can sweet refried beans with peas | 1 jar jerk sauce | 1 jar pickled jerk sauce | 1 lb penne, cooked and drained | 1 bag frozen peas | 1/2 cup bottled maraschino cherry, cut in 1 inch pieces | 2 cups shredded italian cheese blend
instructions: In a large pan, cover the beef with just enough water to cover. Add the beans, jerk sauce, and jerk sauce, bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer 10 minutes. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a large frying pan cook the pasta until only slightly firm, drain. Place a few pieces of pasta on a large serving plate, cover with the sauce, top with the beef, peas, and cherry pieces. Top with italian cheese, put the baking dish on the rack, and bake 10 minutes, or until the cheese is bubbly.

Random Ingredients: cottage cheese,bok choy,lamb,rose water,caramel ice cream topping,orange bell pepper,wheat flour
title: Lamb Sliders With Sweet and Sour Goat Cheese Sauce
ingredients: 1 3/4 lbs 80 % lean ground lamb | 1/2 cup whole wheat flour | 1 cup low fat cottage cheese | 2 tablespoons freshly grated orange bell peppers ( or green or red bell pepper ) | 1 tablespoon rose water or 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1/2 cup low fat whipped cream and 1 tablespoons caramel ice cream topping ( or fat free ) | 1/2 medium bok choy, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Heat large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Spray pan with cooking spray. Add lamb, and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks. Sprinkle flour over lamb to coat. Stir in cottage cheese. Place in a medium size mixing bowl. Mix in bell peppers, the orange/lemon juice, cream and caramel topping. Transfer mixture to a 9x10 in baking dish. Bake, covered, 30 to 35 minutes or until meat is no longer pink in center and sauce thickes. Serve with sweet and sour goat cheese sauce, and garnish with the chopped bok choy.

title: Noodles and Rice
ingredients: 4 tablespoons risotto rice | 3 extra large ice cubes | 3 whole eggs, beaten
instructions: Place 2 ice cubes into a glass or ceramic bowl. Add the rice and stir to coat. Add 1 whole egg and gently beat together. Repeat 3 times, until the egg is white. Pour the egg mixture into a shallow dish for tossing. Drain the noodles well. Place onto a platter and sprinkle with more cubes of ice. Serve immediately.

title: Simple Seasoned Nori
ingredients: 1 package nori ( dry seaweed ) | 3 cups seasoning mix
instructions: Wash nori seaweed, and pat dry with hands. Cut nori in half, and slice each half into thin strips across the width of the seaweed. Transfer strips to a bowl, and mix in seasoning seasoning until well combined. Place strips on a non stick skillet, and fry in soybean oil until crispy.

title: Cheater's Pinto Bean Chips(No Salt)
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans | 1 tablespoon lemon juice, and zest of | 1/8 cup corn chips or 1/8 cup slivered almonds, crushed
instructions: Drain the beans, but do no rinse. Place the beans and the zest in the bowl of a food processor fitted with the steel blade. Process all ingredients, including sugar, until you have a smooth, medium thin consistency, about 1 minute. Pour into a medium baking dish or platter and let cool. Note, if not using a processor, you may need to add 1 teaspoons of sugar or 1/2 teaspoons of water. Store in the refrigerator. Store covered in the freezer. It's called thermostat, and can also be eaten at room temperature as a condiment.

title: Rose Water Mushroom Soup
ingredients: 7 tablespoons rose water ( fresh ) | 1 bunch wild chestnut mushrooms or 1 bunch other mushroom, cut in pieces | 3 quarts hot water
instructions: Wash and thoroughly dry mushrooms, removing any tough stems. Tie the stem and leaves together and put into a large container. Sprinkle hot water over all. Cover, and put in a warm place for about 8 hours. Use a stab or a blender for this step. Strain through a strainer, pressing on the solids to extract as much liquid as possible from the stems, and then pushing down through a fine mesh sieve. Discard the solids. The clear juice of the mushrooms can be used in recipe.

Random Ingredients: english cucumber,agave nectar,rice vinegar,mace,sherry wine,pork chop,shrimp paste,chicken stock cube
title: Pork Chops in Mango Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pork loin, cut into 1 inch pieces | 2 tablespoons shaoxing wine or 2 tablespoons sherry wine | 4 tablespoons rice vinegar | 2 tablespoons agave nectar | 2 tablespoons sherry wine or 2 tablespoons honey | 1 chicken stock cube | 1 teaspoon shrimp paste | 1/2 teaspoon mace | 1 english cucumber, cut into thick rounds
instructions: Place pork pieces in a heavy skillet large enough to hold them all. Sprinkle with paprika. Pour wine over pork, cover and cook over medium heat for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Dissolve the chicken stock cube in the water in skillet. Stir in all remaining ingredients except pork pieces. Bring to a boil over high heat. Cover.

title: Homemade Marsala Wine Mousse
ingredients: 1 gallon marsala wine | 1 jar sliced olives
instructions: Pour the marsala into a large bowl. Pour the olives around the bowl and push the olives down through the glass. Stir well. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate over night for best flavor.

title: Pimiento Scones
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups self raising flour | 1/2 cup pimiento, chopped ( fresh, not canned ) | 1 cup buttermilk
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Add butter. Pat into a greased or floured tin. Bake at 180°c for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Chinese Shrimp and Zucchini (Microwave)
ingredients: 1/2 cup warm water | 3 cups zucchini, sliced | 1 lb peeled and deveined medium shrimp | 4 tablespoons rice wine or 4 tablespoons dry sherry | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 2 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1/4 cup hot water | 1 teaspoon salt | 2 tablespoons snipped chives
instructions: Place ingredients in bread machine in order listed and cook on raw or manual setting. Remove shrimp and reserve heads and tails. Cut zucchini lengthwise into 1 1/4 inch wide slabs and cut each into 1 1/4 inch lengths. Place zucchini slabs in a bowl. Add reserved shrimp heads, shrimp, wine, and golden syrup. Stir to combine. Add yeast. Stir to mix. Pour over shrimp. Insert a sliver of chives into each shrimp shell. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes or until shrimp are opaque and white juices run clear.

Random Ingredients: chili paste,chicken bouillon granule,steak,grainy mustard,coriander powder,dark soy sauce,hickory bacon
title: Roti With Chicken and Bacon
ingredients: 1 tablespoon low-sodium chicken base or 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon granules | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon grainy mustard | 2 teaspoons mild spicy chili paste | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 2 slices hickory smoked bacon, cut in half, crosswise | 1 lb flank steak
instructions: Pound or grind the chicken base or bouillon granules, soy sauce, mustard, chili paste and coriander to a paste, set aside. Brush both sides of sliced meat with the chicken base paste and then sprinkle both sides lightly with salt and pepper. Grill or broil meat until meat achieves internal temperature of 180 degrees f or to your liking. Remove meat from heat.

Random Ingredients: hamburger,orange bell pepper,gold tequila,pizza crust,button mushroom
title: Orange Tequila and Beef Sandwich
ingredients: 10 slices of thin crusty french bread | 2 tablespoons olive-spice dried bread crumbs | 1 large hamburger | 1/2 small orange bell pepper, thinly sliced | 4 -8 button mushrooms
instructions: First remove crusts from both sides of bread. Combine meat, cheese, peppers, and spices. Spread thin layer of cheese mixture onto both side of bread slices. Cover filling with another slice of bread and press together to make a sandwich. Brush outside edges with egg yolk if desired. Place on cookie sheet and brush tops with egg white. Bake at 400 degrees about 15 - 20 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before cutting and serve with beer.

Random Ingredients: egg white,chestnut puree,yellow bell pepper,fine breadcrumb
title: Chestnut Muffins
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chestnut puree | 2 tablespoons fine dry breadcrumbs | 2 egg whites | 1 red or yellow bell pepper, skin removed, seeded and chopped
instructions: Heat oven to 200°c degrees. Heat the mustard oil in a frying pan over medium heat and add the chestnut puree. Stir through to mix, then cook briskly for 3 - 5 minutes, until thickened, stirring often. Stir in the breadcrumbs and egg whites, then transfer to a lightly greased 24 hole muffin pan. Bake for approximately 40 minutes, until the custard is set. Serve hot, warm, or cold.

title: Vanilla Panna Cotta
ingredients: 12 leaves baby spinach or 12 leaves kale ( 4-6 inches long. green portions ) | 1 quart milk
instructions: Place the spinach in a large, microwave safe bowl or plate. Pour enough milk over the spinach to cover. Microwave on high power for 5 minutes, stirring once halfway through the cooking time. The spinach should be just tender but still bright green and bright with the cooking process. Remove the spinach from the microwave and stir in the vanilla. Remove immediately from heat, cover and refrigerate for 1 and 1/2 hours, or overnight. Turn out and serve warm.

title: Jamaican Style Okra Salad
ingredients: 4 heads okra, cut into 2 inch pieces ( fresh or frozen ) | 2 celery ribs, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 cup cooked rice powder | garlic salt | oil | 1/2 - 3/4 - 1 cup dried cranberries
instructions: Place fresh okra pieces into a large bowl of water and allow to soak overnight. The next day drain the okra and rinse well, discarding any damaged pieces or chunks of okra. In a non reactive bowl, mix the celery, rice powder, oregano and garlic salt. In a frying pan heat an appropriate amount of oil, approximately 1/4 cup or less of each ingredient and brown okra pieces on both sides, approximately 3 - 5 minutes each side. Remove okra from skillet to a plate and place into the bowl of rice to marinate. After turning over several times while you are frying the okra, remove the cooked pieces of okra and set it aside. Dredge in 1 cup of the dried cranberries and arrange them on the plated okra pieces to serve as a garnish.

Random Ingredients: cheese,almond,jalapeno juice pepper,bread flour,chili pepper flake,clam,garlic salt
title: Mexican Style Clam Balls
ingredients: 3 cloves garlic salt, minced | 1/4 cup jalapeno juice or 1/4 cup pepper flakes | 1 lb bread flour | 1 cup bread flour | 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1/8 teaspoon ground cloves | 12 fluid ounces canned shrimp or 12 fluid ounces can canned clams, drained and reserving liquid | 1/2 cup grated cheese
instructions: Heat a frying pan or other high temperature. Saute garlic, jalapeno or pepper flakes, and flour. Stir until light and well blended. Add bread flour, chili pepper flakes, and cloves, stirring until blended. Remove from heat and add shrimp or clams. Form balls about 6 ounces. Roll balls into cheese and set aside. Heat oven to 375°f. Place balls in oven for about 20 to 30 minutes or until the crust is a rich golden brown. Serve with salsa con queso, guacamole, sour cream, chopped cilantro.

Random Ingredients: parmesan cheese,vegetable broth,angostura bitter,navy bean,egg white,kalamata olive,cardamom pod
title: Hajar's  White Bean Soup
ingredients: 500 g navy beans, soaked overnight | 120 g kalamata olives | 6 egg whites | 4 cardamoms, slightly crushed | 1 pinch angostura bitters | 4 tablespoons parmesan cheese | 1 liter vegetable broth
instructions: Boil the beans for 1 - 1½ hours until they start to split open. Drain the oil and put to one side. Add the olives, egg whites, cardamom, bitters and ½ teaspoon of angostura bitters to the beans. Boil for 2 minutes. Add ½ of parmesan cheese and half of vegetable broth. Add 1 cup of white bean cooking water and cook for about ½ hours or until the mixture becomes the consistency of soup. Garnish with parmesan cheese and serve.

title: Potato Broccoli-Habanero (Giant Broccoli) Parfait
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups diced young broccoli | 3 medium russet potatoes, peeled, quartered and sliced ( about 2-9 ounces ) | 3 3/4 ounces broccoli steamed al dente | 1/2 cup double cream | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh herbs, of your choice | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla | nutmeg, pinch ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325° convection. In a nonstick baking dish, toss potatoes with 1 teaspoon salt and 1 pound broccoli in large bowl and toss to coat well with seasonings. Cover dish with foil and bake about 30 minutes. Meanwhile, in a small pan, melt sugar on medium heat. Stir occasionally then turn heat down to very low and simmer 5 - 7 minutes. Stir in cream, herbs and vanilla and remove from heat. Place broccoli in a colander and press out as much liquid as possible. Discard solids and return potato mixture to potatoes. Add broccoli to potatoes and stir well. Spoon potato mixture into serving dish and garnish with nutmeg if desired.

title: Tartar Sauce
ingredients: 1 quart light cream of tartar | white pepper to taste
instructions: Whisk cream of tartar and white pepper together in a bowl. Serve warm.

title: Spicy Ethiopian Seasoning
ingredients: 1/8 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1/2 1/2 tablespoon black gram or 1/2 tablespoon brown sugar
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a small bowl. Keep in an airtight container. To use, mix a pinch or two of salt into 1/4 cup cold water. Serve it cold on rice, beans, bread, etc.

title: Beef Rib Eye Roast
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs center cut beef roast ( rib steak ) | 2 1/2 ounces hazelnut-flavored liqueur | 10 ounces beef short ribs ( trimmed )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees fahrenheit. In a large bowl, mix 2 1/2 ounces hazelnut liqueur and 1 1/2 pound of short ribs. Place beef rib eye roast in the mixture and coat well. Place fat side up on a rack in the pan, which should be in a roasting pan. Place a small roasting pan over top. Place rack in the oven and roast for 2 - 8 hours. When beef roasts are done, remove from oven and allow to rest in the pan for 15 minutes. If sauce is too thin, loosely cover with foil. Cut into thick slices between the bones or slices of meat and serve hot with mashed potatoes.

title: Chili Pepper Beef Pies
ingredients: 1 kg stew meat | 1 can chili, drained ( hot peppers or chipotle ) | 1/4 cup chopped cilantro leaf | 3 sheets puff pastry
instructions: Brown meat and drain excess fat from pan. Add chilli, cilantro and 1/3 of the cream. Line 4 - 12 rocky sized pie tins with pastry cut outs. Fill each of the terracotta shells with 1/4 of the meat mixture. Cover with remaining pastry and place on top of pies. Lightly brush with egg and bake at c for 25 minutes.

title: Homemade Coffee (Steep and Steam)
ingredients: 9 cups strong black coffee ( brewed to 1/2 cup ) | 9 tablespoons anise seed, lightly crushed
instructions: Place 1 cup of brewed, cold black coffee in the bottom of the brew basket or coffee jar with some of the anise seed in it. Set the jar in a warm area, but not too hot. Allow the anise seed to infuse the coffee for 30 mins or until it smells aromatic, then remove it and discard it. Immediately pour the remaining coffee from the brew through a fine mesh sieve into the coffee.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf italian parsley,cardamom seed,marsala wine,parmesan cheese,yellow pepper,coconut,shaoxing wine,pimento olive
title: Mixed Champagne and Macaroon
ingredients: 1 cup flat-leaf italian parsley | 1 cup pimento-stuffed olives | 1/8 cup unsweetened coconut | 4 tablespoons ground yellow sweet pepper | 2 tablespoons shaoxing wine | 6 1/2 teaspoons cardamom seeds | 1/2 cup marsala wine | 1 cup shredded kikoman sweet basil cheese or 1 cup shredded fresh cilantro
instructions: Grill or roast the parsley, olives, and coconut over medium heat until lightly toasted. Cool, then blend in a food processor. Using a small spoon, scrape the chunky bits from the bottom of the processor. Stir in sweet pepper. Combine mirin and cardamom in a small saucepan. Cover and heat gently over low heat. Stir constantly when heating begins. Remove from heat, stir in basil, and serve immediately.

title: Mango Bites
ingredients: 2 mangoes, peeled | 4 ounces blue cheese or 4 ounces goat cheese
instructions: Finely dice mangoes. Mix cheese with mango and refrigerate, covered, in refrigerator for up to 3 days. Cut small pieces from chilled cheese with a pizza cutter. Top with bbq sauce or other favorite bbq sauce. Enjoy with some green salad and fruit.

title: Eggplant (Aubergine) Salad
ingredients: 3 medium japanese eggplants | 1/2 cup unsalted organic icing sugar | 1 tablespoon lemon juice or 1 tablespoon lime juice zest | 1/3 cup fresh lemon juice or 1/3 cup lime juice | 3 ripe large bananas, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Place sliced eggplants on baking sheet and bake for 15 minutes, or until very tender when pierced with a fork. Let cool. Use a very sharp paring knife, knife, knife or melter knife to slice eggplants into very thin rings. Place cut eggplants in a large mixing bowl and add icing sugar and lemon juice. Stir to combine. Add sliced bananas and toss with the dressing evenly in the bowl. Sprinkle with chopped fresh mint leaves and serve.

title: Mole Chicken
ingredients: 8 boneless skinless chicken breasts | 1 package sliced pepperoni | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1/2 cup shredded italian cheese blend
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cheese. Sprinkle cheese on the chicken.

title: Homemade Beef Jerky
ingredients: 1 cup minced onion-infused onion ( about 14 large ) | 1/4 teaspoon finely crushed hot pepper sauce | 1/8 teaspoon ground cloves
instructions: Place everything in a small bowl and thoroughly mix. Coat with olive oil. Wrap well, place in a glass jar or other container that has a lid. To smoke, move the jar on a metal rack over a burner or wood burner set to medium high. Watch very closely to make sure that the burners do not burn. The oils may not get all over. The oil is ready when the first bubbles appear and the outside of the bag feels slightly soft but not dripping. If the fumes are escaping when you do this, the oil is too hot. Remove from heat to cool slightly, then refrigerate, covered, for up to two weeks.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,green curry paste,wheat pastry flour,japanese eggplant
title: Indian Eggplant Roll
ingredients: 1 lb japanese eggplant | 1 -2 teaspoon green curry paste | 1 tablespoon green chilies, finely chopped | 1/3 cup whole wheat pastry flour
instructions: Wash eggplant well and slice into ½ inch squares. Boil cubes until the skins are completely peeled away and there are no clear liquid inside the cube of potato. The potatoes should be cooked the same way the eggplant was boiled in. Drain, rinse under cold water and remove the skins. Cut the flesh into thin strips. Sprinkle the ground green chilies over the eggplant cubes. Place flour in a deep bowl. Dip the eggplant strips into the flour and coat on all surfaces of the strips. Shake off excess flour and set aside. Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a wok, add the remaining oil and add the egg plant pieces and fry in batches until deep golden brown and firm up a bit. Drain on paper towels, sprinkle with salt and allow to cool completely. When the eggplant is cool, store in air tight containers to keep the oil hot. Serve with a yogurt sauce if desired.

title: Mexican Cornichons
ingredients: 20 cornichons | 7 -8 ounces grated mozzarella cheese | 2 tablespoons diced green chili | 1/2 cup port wine | 2 tablespoons diced green chili powder
instructions: Pour port into a small skillet and heat on medium heat until liquid is mostly evaporated. Turn down heat and add cornichons. Continue cooking until the cornichons are cooked and starting to darken up, but will not stick to your skillet. Remove from stove and add the grated mozzarella cheese. Stir to mix together. Add green chili powder and chili powder. Enjoy.

title: Fish Soup
ingredients: 1 lb boneless stewing beef | 1 bag thawed snow peas | 1/2 1/2 cup nonfat plain yogurt or 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1 can of drained whole canned fish ( i prefer the pacific cod, halibut or flounder type )
instructions: Brown meat in pot. Add snow peas and cook 30 minutes. Add yogurt and simmer 10 minutes or until desired thickness is achieved. Note, i have also had this soup with whole pine kernels.

title: Chicken and Noodle Lasagna
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts | 12 uncooked lasagna noodles ( i used kroger brand about 6 pieces )
instructions: In large skillet, place chicken breasts and enough water to barely cover. Bring to boil.

title: Coconut Beef Kebabs
ingredients: 2 lbs beef chuck, cut 2cm cubes | 1/2 lb red cabbage, shredded | 2 english seedless cucumbers, sliced into 12 thin half-moons | 1 cup salsa | 1/2 cup shredded coconut | 1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper | 1/4 lb skewers, lightly oiled
instructions: Combine beef cubes and cabbage in a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: ricotta cheese,mustard,curry paste,lasagna noodle,chicken breast,pita bread
title: Simple Chicken Lasagna Rollups
ingredients: 12 uncooked lasagna noodles | 1 jar pickled hot rotisserie chicken breasts, sliced | 1 can ricotta cheese | 1 cup light sour cream or low-fat greek yogurt | 2 tablespoons prepared mustard | 2 tablespoons curry paste
instructions: Cook lasagna noodles according to package directions. Let cool slightly and run under cold water to cool. Drain and set aside. In blender container, combine chicken, ricotta cheese, yogurt, mustard and curry paste. Blend until smooth. Spread about half of cheese mixture over bottom of ungreased baking dish. Lay 3 noodles over the cheese sauce. Spread the remaining cheese mixture over the noodles. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours. Cut into 16 squares.

title: Paneer (Indian Coconut Adai)
ingredients: 14 ounces unsweetened coconut milk | 1 teaspoon dried sage, crushed
instructions: Bring to a boil over medium high heat. Mix in the coconut milk. Reduce heat to low, and simmer until it thickens. Remove from heat, and stir in the sage. Serve immediately.

title: Cauliflower Cheese
ingredients: 2 heads cauliflower, sliced 1/8 inch thick | 1 cup unsweetened peach juice | 4 ounces blue cheese, finely crumbled | 3/8 teaspoon ground allspice berries | 4 -5 slices baguette ( toasted and cut into 1/4 inch slices )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Spray a large deep 9x13 pan with pam. Place cauliflower on the bottom of the pan, and lightly sprinkle the bottom with blue cheese and allspice berries. Repeat layers. Garnish with toasted slices of baguette. Cover tightly with foil or a tent of aluminum foil pressed on the surface of the cheese. Bake uncovered 1 hour. Remove the foil/deer, if desired.

title: Spanish Eggplant (Aubergine) Dip
ingredients: 4 medium eggplants, medium, cut into 3/4-inch-thick slices | 2 tablespoons creme de cassis
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place the eggplant on the rack in a shallow baking pan. Bake until blackened and soft, 40 to 50 minutes or until tender. Let cool. Heat the creme de cassis in a small skillet over medium heat until very warm. Spread on top of the eggplant. Serve with bread or crackers.

Random Ingredients: fenugreek leaf,sea salt,pine nut,bamboo skewer,plain flour,curd cottage cheese,confectioner sugar
title: Paneer Stuffed With Pine Nuts
ingredients: 150 g plain flour | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 150 g small curd cottage cheese ( i used cottage cheese ) | 200 g pine nuts | 200 g confectioners'sugar | 2 teaspoons fenugreek leaves | 4 bamboo skewers or metal skewers, soaked in water
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees celsius. Whisk together the flour and salt in a bowl. Add the cottage cheese and nuts and mix to make nice and homogenous. Stir in the confectioners sugar and fenugreek leaves and then stuff the mixture in your hands into mini balls. Place the balls on a tray lined with baking paper. Lightly brush the tops with water. Bake for 12 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Tarte Flambée
ingredients: 3 tablespoons capers | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom pod, divided | 1/2 teaspoon lemon pepper | 2 tablespoons sliced dried peaches | 1 tablespoon whole wheat bread, crumbled | 1 package frozen puff pastry, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f in a medium bowl, mix the capers, 2 teaspoons of the cardamom, and the lemon pepper. Set aside. Brush the peaches with a little olive oil and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Place in the oven. Cook for 5 minutes, turn, and cook for an additional 2 minutes. Remove from the oven, place in a baking dish, and toast for 1 minute on each side. To serve, spread the bread crumbs on the pastry, top with the peaches, and finish with the remaining cardamom. Serve with the caper caper dip.

title: Cauliflower Frittata
ingredients: 1 large cauliflower, cut into florets | 4 large egg whites | 1 egg white, beaten
instructions: Steam the cauliflower in the salted water for 10 minutes, then drain. Place 1 cup of warm water in a 9 inch nonstick skillet with a lid. Place over medium heat. Lightly scramble the egg, then stir in the cauliflower. When the frittata rises to the top, brush with an egg white and sprinkle with additional florets. Place skillet in the center of the micro wave and cook on high for 15 minutes, til bottom is set and frittata is golden brown.

Random Ingredients: turkey breast,red chile pepper,spanish olive,vegetarian bean,basmati rice
title: Tibetan Turkey and Beans
ingredients: 2 cups spanish style brown rice | 1 can vegetarian baked beans | 1 jar spanish olive pieces | 1 1/2 pounds turkey breast, thinly sliced | 1 red chile pepper, seeded and chopped
instructions: Place the brown rice and beans into a rice cooker. Set to cook, or cover with a lid to keep warm while cooking turkey. Mix the olive pieces, turkey, chile, and sliced red chile in a bowl. Continue cooking turkey in rice cooker until turkey is no longer pink in the center, about 20 minutes. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees f.

title: Corn Tortilla Skins
ingredients: 2 corn tortillas ( medium size ) | 1 1/2 cups chopped chutney | reynolds wrap foil
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees. Using reynolds wrap foil, spray the griddle with non stick spray. Arrange 1 tortilla, 1 1/2 tablespoons of chutney, 1/2 tablespoons of the corn tortilla, and 1 1/2 tablespoons of the remaining chutney on the lower half of the corn tortilla. Fold the other 2 tortillas over and tuck both sides in, as you would fold an envelope of a cheese cloth. Put on the griddle and cook the top half until lightly browned, 2 - 3 minutes. Turn down heat to medium. Turn the tortillas over and sprinkle 1 tablespoon of the chutney on each.

title: Artichoke and Daikon Kimchee (Artichoke and Sumac Kimchee)
ingredients: 2 lbs daikon radishes, peeled and halved | 2 tablespoons sumac | 1/3 lb dried artichoke heart | 1 teaspoon diced onion
instructions: Place daikon halves on a tray and put in the oven. Bake until softened and softened, 7 - 9 minutes. Turn once to redistribute color evenly. Remove from oven and cut into slices. Place daikon slices on plates or a serving bowl. Sprinkle sliced radish with sumac. Dice onion. Pour warm kimchee over radish. Serve immediately, or refrigerate.

title: Green Cardamom and Watermelon Fondue
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs seedless watermelon, cubed ( about two pounds ) | 2 tablespoons pimientos, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon capers, drained | 1/2 teaspoon fresh green cardamom pods, coarsely crushed ( or 1/8 tsp. ground cardamom ) | 8 hoagie rolls, split lengthwise
instructions: Place watermelon cubes in a colander in a wide bowl.

title: Oyster Sauce Glazed Corn With Diced Corn
ingredients: 1 cup canned baby corn, drained | 1/3 cup red wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 3 teaspoons red wine vinegar | 1/8 teaspoon red chili pepper flakes ( or to taste ) for sweeter corn
instructions: Combine all of the dressing ingredients in a small bowl, mixing well. Set aside. Drain and rinse the baby corn and toss it together in a large straight sided casserole dish with the dressing. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes and up to 24 hours before serving.

title: Cod in White Gravy
ingredients: 1 can vegetable broth | 1 pound cod, peeled and cubed
instructions: Place the cod in a pot with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, and cook for 15 to 20 minutes, just until slightly tender. Strain, but reserve the broth. Meanwhile, heat the vegetable broth until hot, and pour over the cod. Cover, and return to a boil. Reduce heat, and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes, until the broth reduces to thick gravy and cod is heated through.

title: Kofte Salad
ingredients: 3 ounces aged gouda cheese, cut into 1 cubes | 1 pomegranate | 3/4 cup ripe olives, pitted, halved | 1 serrano chili, halved and deseeded | sea salt
instructions: Dry the cheese in a clean & dry frying pan. Place it in a bowl, add the pomegranate, olives, chili and a sprinkling of salt. Toss to combine and serve.

title: Nanny's Vinegar Pudding
ingredients: 4 cups white vinegar | 2 teaspoons baking soda
instructions: In a covered, deep pan, combine the vinegar and baking soda.. Heat over medium heat until temperature reaches 320 degrees f, or until a light thread of steam forms on top. Let the pan stand for 5 minutes before removing it. Pour the hot vinegar into a large metal bowl. Remove the crusts from the baking soda, and quickly press the soda to extract the juices. Set the pudding aside to cool for 15 minutes, then remove the ring of threads. Use a teaspoon to smooth out and release any large pieces of the baking soda. Add the hot vinegar to the pudding, and stir vigorously to blend.

title: Sauteed Swiss Chard and Mushrooms on French Bread
ingredients: 1/2 lb swiss chard, trimmed | 3 ounces fresh shiitake mushrooms, stemmed | 2/3 cup walnuts, toasted | 1 baguette
instructions: Cook the swiss chard and mushrooms in a 5 quart pan until chard is wilted.

Random Ingredients: farfalle pasta,mascarpone,white vinegar,parmigiano reggiano cheese,sprig rosemary,oriental sesame oil,feta cheese
title: Pasta With Feta and Herbs
ingredients: 1 lb farfalle pasta | 1 1/4 cups mascarpone | 3 tablespoons white vinegar | 1/2 lb feta cheese | 1/4 lb freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 teaspoon oriental sesame oil | 1/2 teaspoon dried rosemary
instructions: Cut farfalle in half with a knife or knife. Place on a floured board and stretch it until it becomes very thin. Cut into 1 inch pieces.. Combine mascarpone, vinegar, and chopped cheese in a large bowl. Add sesame oil, rosemary, & drained pasta and toss. Cover and let sit in refrigerator for 1 to 2 hours. Serve with toasted, freshly grated romano and some freshly shaved parmigiano reggiano at the table.

title: Spinach Leaves (Kuka)
ingredients: 4 -5 spinach leaves | 2 tablespoons demerara sugar ( to taste ) or 2 tablespoons brown sugar ( to taste ) | 2 tablespoons dried fenugreek ( to taste )
instructions: Wash the spinach, removing any leaves that are old or hard. Drain the leaves, rinse and place in a bowl with some water to cover. Let the greens soak overnight. Add sugar to taste. Drain. Put a large kettle on the stove and add the spinach. Stir and cook, stirring, for a few minutes until the spinach wilts.

Random Ingredients: cumin powder,rosemary leaf,jeera powder,curry powder,cod,walnut,rump steak
title: Spiced Cod
ingredients: 5 kg fresh cod, in bite size pieces ( e.g. haddock or other fish ) | 100 -150 g walnuts | 12 -15 curry powder | 1 teaspoon jeera powder ( known as `` madras '' in hindi ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin powder | 1/2 teaspoon rosemary leaf | 1 teaspoon gri rump steak or 1 teaspoon other thick fatty steak
instructions: Boil the fish in water for 10 - 15 minutes drain. Chop walnuts into 1/4 inch size pieces. Dry fry in a pan with little oil until golden brown. Keep aside to cool. Boil curry powder in a little water until slightly thickened. Set aside. Take fish in a large bowl, add all the spices and coat well with the curry gravy. Stir in the walnuts and marinated fish. Keep on leave for 20 minutes. Serve chilled with basmati rice or kulcha.

title: Caldillo
ingredients: 4 lbs roast | 10 ounces guajillo quail | 1 cup white mushroom, chopped | 1 can beer | 1/2 teaspoon paprika | 1 can chopped green chilies | cooked rice wine | cooked white mushrooms
instructions: Mix all ingredients in crockpot. Cook on low 10 - 12 hours.

title: Perfect Country Baked Rotini
ingredients: 2 cups rotini pasta, uncooked | 1 cup yellow cornmeal | 1/2 cup cider vinegar | 1 medium onion, chopped | 1 tablespoon salt
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Grease a 2 qt. Soup dish. Cook the pasta to desired tenderness.

title: Sweet Potato Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 3 sweet potatoes ( peeled and cut in half ) | 6 hot dogs ( cut in half ) | 3 tablespoons catsup | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/3 cup light beer | 1/4 cup fish sauce
instructions: Add catsup, vanilla, and fish sauce into a medium skillet over medium heat. Cover skillet and stir occasionally, then allow to simmer until the sweet potatoes are soft and have a little bit of texture. Set aside and allow to cool slightly before serving.

title: Kumara Indian Lentil Salad
ingredients: 2 cans red lentils, drained | 2 large green chunky salsa, like trader joes's | 1 cup texturized mixed vegetables, like cauliflower | 1/2 teaspoon grated ginger paste | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 1/8 teaspoon dried sage | 1 teaspoon sugar
instructions: Mix ingredients. Refrigerate any leftovers over dressing for up to 3 days.

Random Ingredients: arborio rice,garlic clove,tri color spiral pasta
title: Risotto Alla Romana
ingredients: 1 lb fresh tri-color spiral pasta | 2 garlic cloves, crushed | 1 lb arborio rice
instructions: In a large pot of boiling, slated water, cook the pasta until it is tender but firm to the bite. Drain it and reserve. In a separate pot of boiling, slated water, cook the garlic until it turns golden. Add the rice to the garlic. Drain the pasta and add it and the garlic to the rice.

title: Crack Cornmeal
ingredients: 4 cups cornmeal | 2 teaspoons rosemary, crushed | 4 cups crackers ( optional )
instructions: Crack cornmeal into a deep pot. Add rosemary and crackers. Stir until cornmeal is covered. Place lid on top and put on medium low heat. Stir once every hour, and check frequently to make sure the bottom is golden brown. Serve and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,pizza crust,coleslaw mix,almond extract,white pepper,cauliflower floret,cooking wine
title: Cauliflower Coleslaw
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups coleslaw mix, coarsely shredded | 10 ounces pizza crust | cooking wine ( use white wine if possible ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1/4 cup prepared pizza crust | 12 ounces cauliflower florets | 1 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Combine coleslaw mix and baking soda in medium bowl. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and let stand 30 - 60 minutes. Drain well. Set coleslaw aside. In large bowl, dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup cold water. Add remaining cup cold water and stir until dissolved. Add to coleslaw and stir well. Cover and let rise in well buttered 2 1/2 3 quart or larger baking dish until very bubbly, about 45 minutes. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cover and let rise. Bake in 325 degree oven until crust is light golden brown, about 30 to 35 minutes. Makes about 3 cups.

title: Beef Lentil-Lentil Croquettes
ingredients: 500 g minced beef tenderloin | 1 1/4 cups lentils, rinsed and drained | 150 g green lentils, rinsed and drained | 500 g panko breadcrumbs ( japanese breadcrumbs ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons yeast
instructions: Place beef and lentils into pot. Add water, enough to cover the meat, bring to boil and cook until meat is cooked, about 45 minutes. Remove meat and cut into fine shreds. Strain broth. Place in bowl and let cool for 15 minutes. Place panko evenly over meat. Dissolve yeast in water and then add to broth. Beat the mixture on low until well combined. Shape into 1/2 inch diameter loafs. Heat 1 cup bread to hot and then place onto cookie sheet. Set aside for 15 minutes. Remove from oven and place under broiler to brown the top. This only takes about 15 minutes. Serve with a mixed salad and/or a light beer.

title: Pasta Fingers (Fried Almonds)
ingredients: 1 package farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 3 tablespoons lardons or 3 tablespoons bacon fat | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 8 whole almonds | 1/2 cup chopped nuts
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Place the bow tie pasta in the pot and cook uncovered, stirring occasionally until tender but still firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain. Place the lardons in a skillet over medium heat and cook, stirring constantly until golden brown and crisp, about about 15 minutes. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Season with ground cardamom. Reserve 2 tablespoons of the lardons and set aside. Continue cooking the remaining lardons and drain. Remove the cardamom pods. To make the fingers, cook the almonds in a skillet over medium heat, stirring often, until golden brown, about 5 minutes.

title: Homemade Salt Free
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dried oregano leaves | 2 1/4 cups tamari
instructions: Put all ingredients into a clean dry, non stick pan, or a bowl of water and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat, simmer 10 to 15 minutes, or until liquid has reduced and has a very thick consistency. Remove from heat and cool. Once cool completely, store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: farfalle pasta,macadamia nut,sun tomato oil,pita bread,shortening
title: Macadamia Nuts and Sun-Dried Tomatoes Pizzas
ingredients: 1 lb shortening | 1 box pita bread | 1/2 cup macadamia nuts | 3/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained ( i use kikoman, see description ) | 1 lb farfalle pasta or 1 lb bow tie pasta, cooked and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°. Melt shortening, then cool completely. Split pita bread in half and cut each half into 5 pieces and then into thirds lengthwise. Place cut surfaces of bread on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for 5 to 6 minutes or until warm to the touch. Remove bread from oven and cut each piece into 8 triangles, then triangles once again lengthwise. Toast macadamia nuts in a skillet for 2 to 3 minutes. Spread macadamia nuts on 1 side of each pita bread triangle and then lightly toast to desired darkness. Place 3/4 cup drained sun dried tomatoes in oil, then drizzle with remaining oil. Set aside. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente. Drain pasta and season with salt. Spoon pasta on toasted bread triangles and top with macadamia nuts and sliced sun dried tomatoes. Sprinkle with remaining sun dried tomatoes and serve right away.

Random Ingredients: chicken meat,butter,rice vinegar,flour,milk ricotta cheese,taco seasoning,panko breadcrumb,irish cream
title: Microwave Nacho Meatballs
ingredients: 1 box milk ricotta cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons butter | 1 1/2 teaspoons rice vinegar | 1 -2 tablespoon taco seasoning | 1/4 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup flour | 1 can cooked turkey meat ( optional ) | chicken meat, to cover meat during final cooking time, in taco's | irish cream, a splash for top
