instructions: Combine all ingredients in large mixing bowl and blend well. Cover bowl with wet paper towel and allow to stand for 30 minutes. For large meat balls, roll between palms until 1 1/2 inch thick. For smaller meat balls, roll in panko, or use a rolling pin to flatten meat completely. Microwave meatballs for 3 minutes on high, or until no longer pink. Remove meat and arrange meatballs on baking sheet, covering with foil. Microwave on high in large microwave safe casserole for 2 minutes. Remove foil and meatballs from oven and immediately spoon hot tomato sauce over them. Return to oven. Let meatballs sit for a few minutes in the microwave to absorb some of the sauce, then serve with nacho sour cream for dipping.

Random Ingredients: tomato ketchup,sazon goya con culantro y achiote,yellow bell pepper,leek,vanilla bean,green bell pepper,beef bouillon cube
title: Habia Beef Kabobs
ingredients: 3 tablespoons tomato ketchup | 1 tablespoon yellow bell pepper, chopped | 1 teaspoon leeks, finely chopped | 1/8 teaspoon sazon goya con culantro y achiote | 1/8 teaspoon vanilla bean, peeled | 1/2 beef bouillon cube | 1 green bell pepper, seeded, cut into chunks | 1/2 yellow bell pepper, seeded, cut into chunks
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together and set aside. Marinate the beef skewers in the tomato ketchup for 1 hour on the counter. Thread the beef onto the skewers. Grill or broil the skewers 4 - 6 minutes on each side. Serve with jasmine rice and mango chutney.

title: Tasty peanut butter sauce..
ingredients: 1 medium green capsicum, seeded and chopped finely | 80 g crunchy peanut butter
instructions: Fold together and use as desired in a savoury crumble. If required, mix with other veggies.

title: Swiss Steak Flambe
ingredients: 1 lb beef, sliced thin | 10 maraschino cherries
instructions: Place meat in a frying pan, and sprinkle with cherries. Cover, and fry very slowly with lid on, until meat is tender, and liquid is reduced a little, about 1 1/2 hours.

title: Cottage Cheese Crab
ingredients: 12 cremini mushrooms, diced | 24 lump crabmeat | 1 tablespoon cinnamon | 1/2 cup orange rind | 2 packages cottage cheese | 1/2 lime ( optional )
instructions: Combine mushrooms, crab meat, cinnamon and rind. Drain any remaining liquid from crab mixture. Blend cheese, lime, and liquid together in food processor or by hand. Add to crab mixture and stir until just incorporated. Chill 3 hours to allow flavors to blend.

title: Pineapple Chilled Salmon
ingredients: 2 cans salmon, drained but with the juice squeezed out | 1/2 cup pineapple, drained, picked over for chunks ( any kind fresh would be fine ) | 2 tablespoons mirin | 1/2 teaspoon ginger
instructions: Drain the fish and rinse under cold water to remove excise sand. Pat dry. Slice salmon into 1 inch thick slices on the diagnol. Set aside. In a nonstick skillet put the pineapple with the juice, mirin and the ginger. Cook on medium heat just long enough to warm the sauce. It should have a little bite for the salmon to float. To serve, place a salmon slice on a plate and spoon a little of the sauce on top.

Random Ingredients: sherry,star anise,fennel bulb,olive oil,monterey jack cheese
title: Aniseed French-Style Cheese
ingredients: 6 1/2 ounces monterey jack cheese, cut into thin slices | 1 tablespoon dry sherry or 1 heaping teaspoon white wine | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 2 star anise or 2 cardamon pods, crushed | 1 fennel bulb
instructions: Put the cheese slices in a bowl. Stir in the sherry, oil, star anise pod, and fennel. Mix thoroughly. Cover and keep refrigerated at least 1 hour, or overnight, if possible.

title: Ginger Steak Filling
ingredients: 1 lb top round steak, cut into 8 slices | 1 package white chocolate, cut into 4 pieces | 1 teaspoon ginger paste
instructions: In a large bowl, add the cut up white chocolate, a teaspoon of ginger paste, a small amount of water, and mix thoroughly. Add as much gingerser paste to make it the consistency you want. If desired add a bit of honey or some ground nuts to the mixture. If mixture is too thick, add a bit more water. If mixture is too watery, add more white chocolate. Place meat in a baking sheet lined with wax paper or jelly roll pan. Spread some of the gingerser gravy mixture on each piece. This will prevent the meat from sticking and burning. Place in refrigerator to harden. Place meat on your counter to remove excess gingerstershire sauce. Place in the refrigerator to harden the meat.

title: Grilled Japanese Style Red Bell Pepper Salad
ingredients: 2 large red bell peppers ( seeded and cut into 1 inch strips ) | 1/4 cup mirin ( japanese sweet wine )
instructions: In a non metal bowl, toss the bell peppers with the mirin and allow them to marinate for 20 minutes. Brush the grill with a little cooking spray. Place the bell peppers on the grill, and cook until the bell peppers have softened, about 10 minutes. Remove the bell peppers to a bowl and stir in the bell pepper onion dressing to taste.

title: Papaya and Bean Fritters - the Best With Candied Apricots
ingredients: 1 lb ripe papaya or 1 lb papaya, peeled, seeded, and cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1/2 lb bean, shelled | chopped chopped epazote ( optional ) | 1 1/4 cups white bread, finely cubed | 1 cup raw cashews | 1/2 vanilla | 1/2 cup caster sugar
instructions: Place the papaya cubes with the epazote between pieces of paper towels and pound to 1/4 inch thickness. Place the bread cubes with the cashews and vanilla in a food processor and blend until it form a fine powder. Sprinkle the fritters with the cashew mixture and coat well. Chill for several hours before serving or store in the fridge until needed.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,paprika,lemon pepper,olive,monterey jack pepper cheese,parsley,water
title: Beef and Olives
ingredients: 4 1/2 lbs boneless beef chuck | 10 ounces olives, drained | 1/4 cup water | 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley | 1/2 teaspoon lemon pepper | 1 tablespoon paprika | 1 lb monterey jack pepper cheese, grated
instructions: Trim excess fat from steak. Cut steak into 3 to 4 pieces, trimming excess fat if necessary. Combine next 5 ingredients in slow cooker.

Random Ingredients: green,oyster sauce,bread machine yeast,apricot brandy,fish,chili pepper flake,crema
title: Chili-Dipped Fish and Apricot Toast
ingredients: 1 packet bread machine yeast | 350 g canned chopped tomatoes | 2 tablespoons crema ( optional ) or 2 tablespoons cream ( optional ) | 3 cups fish, of your choice, shredded | 1 teaspoon hot chili pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons apricot brandy | 2 tablespoons soft crema | 3 cups warm crema | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1/4 teaspoon fish, powder
instructions: Biga, mix the first five ingredients together until yeast is disolved. Add tomatoes and crema. Mix well and let sit for 20 minutes, until bubbly. The batter should be rather thick. It should be a little drier than liquid, but not runny. Dip your choice of bread in the batter mixture. Batter, place bread in loaf pan and brush bread with olive oil. Allow to rise for 12 - 15 minutes. Heat grill pan. Cook fish over medium heat until both sides are crisp, and golden brown. Mix the chili powder with the soft crema and spread on top. Serve dipping sauce, mix your hot sauce ingredients together in a bowl and drizzle over fish.

title: Beef and Bean Burgers
ingredients: 1 egg | 2 egg yolks | 2 lbs beef stew meat | 2 cans pinto beans, drained | 2 tablespoons catsup | 2 tablespoons capers, drained | 1 tablespoon canned anchovies, drained | 1 head lettuce, leaves separated
instructions: In a large bowl, beat egg and yolks. Blend in the meat, beans, catsup, capers and anchovies. Stir in lettuce until evenly coated. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 450 degrees for 11 - 12 minutes. While they are baking, brown ground beef in a skillet over medium high heat and drain. When they are crisp and browned, serve in rolls with sauce and a side of green plantains.

title: Chargrilled aubergines With Aluets (Anuets)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chili oil | 1/4 cup sugar | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 teaspoon garam masala or 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1 can anchovies ( drained ) | 2 aubergines | 200 g tortillas ( warmed ) | mint leaf ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c. Line 2 baking trays with baking paper. Combine oil, sugar, salt, garam masala and anchovies in a bowl. Cut a slit, lengthways into halves lengthways and gently press on each half with the back of the spoon until full. Halve the aubergines lengthways and score each half into four pieces. Place the aubergines in a large ovenproof dish to catch the drips. Pour over just enough boiling water to just cover the contents of the dish. Cover and place in the oven. Cook for 1 hour, then remove from the oven and sit for a further 15 minutes. Uncover and stir well. Lift aubergines out with a slotted spoon and place in a large serving bowl. Arrange on serving plates and spoon over the warmed aluets. Sprinkle with mint leaves and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: beef consomme,colby monterey jack cheese,cream mushroom soup,pita bread
title: Pita French Dip
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 can condensed beef consomme | 3 pita breads | 2 cups shredded colby-jack cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a mixing bowl, combine mushroom soup, beef consomme, and pita breads. Line a 9x13 inch pan with cheese. Fill each pita with about 3 tablespoons of the hot mixture. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until cheese is melted.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,herbes de provence,sugar snap pea,vegetable oil cooking spray,mayonnaise
title: Pesto-Yummy Pea Salad
ingredients: 4 cups mixed fresh italian parsley, chopped ( not dried ) | 1 tablespoon herbes de provence | 1 lb frozen sugar snap pea, thawed | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/2 cup light mayonnaise
instructions: Whisk first 5 ingredients until dressing dissolves. Spray pan with cooking spray. Place peas on prepared pan and spread with mayo.

title: Spanish Almonds Tapenade
ingredients: 1/2 cup slivered blanched almond | 1 jar pimento stuffed olives, drained | 1 1/2 teaspoons sweet paprika
instructions: Heat oven to 500 degrees f. Line baking sheet with foil. Combine almonds and pimentos in a bowl and sprinkle mixture evenly over entire baking sheet. Bake in preheated oven for 10 minutes, stirring half way through. Remove from oven and sprinkle with paprika. Cool completely, then slice into squares, storing in an airtight container.

title: Pumpkin & Quinoa Burritos With Espresso Dip
ingredients: 1 cup instant quinoa | 1/2 cup sugar | 3/4 cup light cream, warmed | 2 teaspoons instant espresso coffee | 1/3 cup warm cream | 1 tablespoon lard ( optional ) | 3 ounces cooked pumpkin or 3 ounces diced candied pumpkin | tortilla
instructions: In saucepan over medium flame, stir quinoa & sugar together. Add 3/4 cup water & bring to boil. Reduce heat, cover & simmer 15 minutes, stirring often. Remove from heat.

title: Asian-Style Beef Pot Roast
ingredients: 1/2 cup baby bok choy | 1 lime | 2 limes | 3 pounds boneless beef roast
instructions: Preheat the oven broiler. Arrange the baby bok choy over the bottom of a large roasting pan. Cut the zest from the 2 limes into thin slices and squeeze the juice over the pieces of beef. Place the roast on top of the bok choy. Peel and chop the remaining 2 limes and squeeze the juice into a bowl. Pour the juice into the roasting pan. Add enough water to the pan to reach halfway up the side of the roast. Cover and roast the beef in the preheated oven for 5 to 6 hours, or until the internal temperature of the meat registers 160 degrees f. Transfer the roast to a cutting board, tent with foil, and let sit for about 45 minutes. Slice the beef and set it aside. Cut the slices against the grain. Garnish with the lime slice, if desired.

title: Beetroot and Shrimp Salad With Pesto-Pickled Fava Beans
ingredients: 350 g shelled prawns ( raw or frozen ) | 3 medium beetroots, pared and roughly chopped | 3 large fresh beetroots, pared and roughly chopped | 1/2 bunch fresh parsley roots, chopped | 2 lemons, juice of | 100 g pesto sauce ( or other flavor ) | 1/3 cup scallion, chopped | 4 -5 tablespoons olive oil or 4 -5 tablespoons canola oil (, for cooking ) or 4 -5 tablespoons beet oil (, for cooking )
instructions: Combine the prawns, beetroot, beetroot, parsley and lemons. Mix through the prawns and prawns as well as the pesto. Drizzle in more oil if necessary so the prawns & beetroot are completely submerged. Refrigerate for 30 minutes, or up to a day. Just before serving, toss through the scallions and pesto. Serve at room temperature with bread or rolls and salad.

title: Grilled cassava With Squash
ingredients: 2 unpeeled yellow squash | 1 can stewed cassava | 1 lb fresh masa harina mixed with cold water or 1 lb cassava ( 12-inch fresh masa harina mixed with cold water ) | 12 -15 pieces pepper rings | 3 -4 tablespoons fresh garlic fresh marjoram, chopped | 1 1/2 ounces fresh cotija cheese, cut into 2 squares ( not crumbly )
instructions: Peel squash and cut into 1 inch cubes and rinse in cold water until water runs clear. Heat up a charcoal grill. Drain 1/2 cup masa harina mixed with cold water in a deep pot set over medium heat, stirring to make sure not to scorch the bottom of the pot. Add squash, cook briefly, stirring occasionally until squash is tender, but not mushy.. Turn off heat and let sit for about 10 minutes. Pierce squash several times with a fork and add to a medium bowl. Add masa harina and stir to coat. Pour in about ½ cup cold water, stir until dough is well blended, cover and allow to rest at room temperature for about 30 minutes. In a large, shallow nonreactive skillet, heat about 3 - 4 tbsps. Of oil over medium heat. Add a few pieces of pepper and 2 dashes of marjoram and cook, turning if necessary for about 15 minutes or until they turn a rich golden color. Taste for salt and add more as needed. Remove from heat. Divide masa between 4 plates and top with some squash and pepper mixture. Sprinkle with some cheese and additional chopped marjoram.

title: Blueberry Dessert
ingredients: 400 g blueberries | 400 g pitted dates | 1 cup brandy
instructions: Cut the berries, stoned dates and pitted dates into 1cm pieces. Place the berries and brandy into an attractive glass or a dessertspoon and stand back, pouring brandy on top. Refrigerate for 2 hours, then serve.

title: Chinese Artichoke Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup sweet soy sauce | 1/2 cup garlic, minced | 2 teaspoons ground gingerroot | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1/2 purple onion, diced | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a salad bowl or container with a tight lid. Shake or stir to blend. Serve at room temperature.

title: Mexican Cinnamon and Cumin Seeds
ingredients: 3 tablespoons cumin seeds | 1/2 cup cayenne-style crushed cinnamon sticks
instructions: Cook cumin seeds as directed on package, about 2 minutes. Transfer with a slotted spoon to a bowl. Add cinnamon sticks and mix well. Store mixture in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: chili paste,lime wedge,thyme leave,portabella mushroom cap
title: Spicy Portobello Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 1 lb portabella mushroom caps, thickly sliced ( about 15 large portobello mushrooms ) | 2 tablespoons sweet chili paste ( or more to taste ) | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme leave | lime wedge, for garnish
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high.

title: Sun-Dried Tomato Pesto Salsa
ingredients: 1 jar sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, well drained | 1 jar salsa ( mild, medium or hot, to taste )
instructions: Pour the sun dried tomatoes into a medium size bowl or a food processor or blender and process until very finely chopped. You may also use 1/3 cup of the jar of salsa, but taste it first and adjust seasonings to personal taste. If you make this with a block of sun dried tomato, remove them from the jar and place them into a small pot over medium heat and bring to boil. Boil, uncovered, for 1 minute, then remove from heat. Pour this mixture into a mixing bowl or serving dish and chill in the refrigerator for at least an hour or until cold and thick. Taste and adjust seasonings as needed. Use right away or store in an airtight container for up to a week.

title: Scented Fresh Vegetables
ingredients: 4 cups mixed fresh vegetables, such as broccoli, as cauliflower, and red bell pepper, trimmed and sliced | 2 tablespoons unflavored gelatin | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder
instructions: Place vegetables in a pot and cover with water.

title: Crab Stuffed Shells
ingredients: 12 uncooked jumbo pasta shells | 1 jar imitation crabmeat, drained and flaked | 1 bottle vodka
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil. Cook pasta shells in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 10 minutes. Drain and set aside. Place the crabmeat in a mixing bowl, adding vodka. Mix in the drained and broken pieces of drained crabmeat. If pasta shells are lumpy, drain well. Fill shells with the crabmeat. Place in a greased 9x13 inch baking dish. Dot with paprika or butter. Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Chili Sauce for Vegetables
ingredients: 1 green chili, seeded and finely chopped | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa | 4 tablespoons red wine or 4 tablespoons non-alcoholic sherry
instructions: Simply blend all ingredients in a blender until well combined.

title: Easy Blueberry Beef Kabobs
ingredients: 2 tablespoons beef tenderloin, cut into 1/2-inch thick pieces | 1 teaspoon dried fennel bulb, crushed | 2 tablespoons fresh raspberries, chopped | 2 cups fresh broccoli florets | 1 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin, cut into 1 1/2-inch thick pieces | 1 1/2 cups fresh blueberries | 1 1/2 cups fresh strawberries, cut in 4 slices
instructions: Place beef, fennel bulb, raspberries and 2 tablespoons water in a large resealable plastic bag and marinate in the fridge for 8 hours or overnight. Remove beef from bag and drain excess marinade from beef. Thread beef onto 12 bamboo skewers and grill over hot coals turning occasionally, about 12 minutes, or until cooked to desired doneness. Meanwhile, place broccili on a platter. Top with beef and berries. Serve with remaining berries. Note, you can buy frozen blueberries and strawberries. To thaw, thaw fruit and measure 2 cups. If using fresh berries, freeze and thaw. Place all vegetables on a flat surface and cut in chunks using a mandolin or a food processor, if you are starting out like me and are not planning to eat these ahead of time, or just have them the next day and serve the next day.

title: Watermelon Carnitas
ingredients: 3 pounds watermelon - rind removed | 2 cans carnitas, pork or other meat meat | 4 kaffir lime leaves
instructions: Combine watermelon and carnitas in a large pot. Cover, and let sit overnight. The next day, remove the meat from the rind, and cut into small pieces. Discard the rind. Scoop out most of the juice and excess juice. Rinse pork or carnitas with cold water and place in a saucepan. Cover, and add enough water to completely submerge the meat. Bring to boil, and simmer until meat is cooked through. Discard lime leaves, if desired.

title: Brussels Fritters
ingredients: 200 g strong white flour | 100 g balsamic vinegar | 100 ml lemon juice, zest of, finely grated | 1 tablespoon dried thyme, plus extra for sprinkling
instructions: Mix the flour, vinegar, zest, thyme and lemon juice together. Heat a non stick frying pan and lightly grease it. Drop a cupful of the mixture 1 apart onto the frying pan and spread it all around with a spatula. When it looks dry on top, add another cupful and flatten with the spatula. Cook for 20 - 25 minutes or until the fritters are light brown and cooked through underneath. Serve in warm bowls with a sprinkle of thyme. Make ahead, pastry baggies can be frozen.

title: Hummus (Raw Foods)
ingredients: 1 sachet tahini | 1 fresh fresh thyme sprig
instructions: In a blender, combine the tahini, thyme, and salt to taste. Blend on high until smooth and creamy.

title: Spicy Barbeque Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon sugar | 12 hamburger buns ( i used buns lite ) | 1 green radish, halved ( optional )
instructions: Mix sugar and a small amount of water until smooth.

Random Ingredients: pesto sauce,sesame salad dressing,white flour,radish,rigatoni pasta,thyme leaf
title: Creamy Pesto Pasta Salad
ingredients: 500 g rigatoni pasta | 6 cups white flour ( unbleached ) | 2/3 cup fresh thyme leaves | 3/4 cup fresh basil, chopped | 4 -6 radishes ( optional ) | 2 -4 tablespoons sesame salad dressing
instructions: Cook pasta according to instructions on pack. Drain pasta when cooked. Mix dry ingredients together. Place in bowl and add herbs. Toss until well mixed. Place pasta mix and pesto in a serving dish and serve.

Random Ingredients: savoy cabbage,coriander powder,sirloin tip roast,black peppercorn,milk powder
title: Beef Tip Roast With Savoy Cabbage
ingredients: 1/2 kg sirloin tip roast ( prime rib roast ) | 3 tablespoons coriander powder | 3 tablespoons milk powder | 1 tablespoon black peppercorns | 2 heads savoy cabbage
instructions: Heat oven to 160'c, 425'f, gas mark 4, 200'f. Put roast in roasting pan with 1/2 cup of water. Bake in oven for about 3 hours or until meat is tender. Let cool slightly then slice across the grain into thin slices. Set aside. Combine 1t water with coriander and 4 tbsp of milk powder. Place in freezer for 2 hours. To serve put in cabbage, toss, then put back under pan for 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: date,great northern bean,achiote paste,flour tortilla,collard green,bun,chunky salsa
title: Kris' Omelette
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped collard greens, stems and leaves, chopped ( about 1 1/2 bunches ) | 3/4 cup thick & chunky taco-style salsa | 1/4 cup chunky salsa | 1 tablespoon oaxaca great northern bean dip ( such as knorr ) | 1/2 teaspoon achiote paste | 8 flour tortillas | 1 ripe dates, finely chopped
instructions: Prepare salsa by combining the beans, salsa, and achiote paste and simmering over low heat for about 5 minutes. Place a tortilla on a plate, place 1/2 cup bean mixture along the center, and roll it up. Wet the tortillas and place them seam side down on top, seam side down. Repeat with remaining tortillas, bean mixture and rolls to make four omelettes with all the fillings. Heat olive oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Sauté the rolls until golden brown on all sides, about 3 minutes per side. Remove the rolled rolls from the pan, cut along the roll with a spatula, and arrange on a plate. Serve with warmed guacamole. Salsa verde, in a small pot over low heat combine 1/2 cup sour cream and 1/4 cup chopped red onion, adding 1 t. Water. Cover, and heat just until warm. To serve, cut the roll ups into 1 inch slice, and spread a small mound of salsa verde on each plate. Place the tomato wedges on salsa. Top with a sprinkle of chopped chopped fresh tomato. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,date,black forest ham,strawberry jam,phyllo dough,icing sugar,red onion,maraschino cherry
title: Ham & Strawberry Pastries - Spanakopita
ingredients: 1 package phyllo dough, thawed | 1 jar sliced black forest ham | 1/2 cup dates, pitted, chopped | 1/2 cup red onion, chopped | 1/4 cup maraschino cherry, chopped, plus | 1 tablespoon cherries | 1/4 cup icing sugar | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 8 tablespoons strawberry jam
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In a small bowl, mix ham, dates, red onion, maraschino cherries, icing sugar and garlic salt until smooth. Place half the phyllo dough sheet in a 9 x 13 pan. Using a 2 1/2 inch wide strip, roll up tightly, starting at about 1/2 inch. Fold dough crosswise, and continue rolling. Repeat with remaining phyllo, ham, dates, and red onion. Arrange pastries in rows on top of each other, breaking diagonally in half if necessary. Arrange 1/2 cup cherry mixture evenly over all. Carefully drizzle 1/2 cup jam over all. Bake, uncovered, 50 to 55 minutes, until pastry is golden and filling is lightly browned.

title: Danish Puff
ingredients: 1 lb ground pork | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon mixed herbs | 6 tablespoons buttermilk or 6 tablespoons ale
instructions: Blend or process the pork, the vinegar and herbs. Form into a ball. Cover with buttermilk or ale.

title: Italian Stuffed Tomato
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ripe tomatoes | 6 -8 slices prosciutto | 1/4 cup golden syrup | 1/2 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 375&deg.

Random Ingredients: alpine lace swiss cheese,baby spinach,pecan,soda water
title: Pecan SwissBaby Spinach
ingredients: 1/2 cup crushed, cold pecans | 1/2 cup slivered almonds, or as needed | 1 cup baby spinach | 1 1/3 pounds alpine lace swiss cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Place the crushed pecans into a small bowl, and press into the peanuts with a dry, sharp knife to lightly toast and crunch. Spread the crumb in a thin layer onto a kitchen towel to absorb any excess moisture. Remove the towels from the cheese. Toss with the shredded swiss cheese to combine. Spread the spinach onto a lightly oiled baking sheet. Sprinkle evenly with the crushed pecans to within 1/2 inch of the edges. Bake in the preheated oven until the casserole is lightly browned and puffed, about 20 minutes. Let stand a few minutes, then serve.

title: Easy, Quick and Elegant Gyros
ingredients: 3 2 cups unbleached all-purpose greek-style dried bread or 3 2 cups plain flour | 1 1/4 cups active dry yeast or 1 1/4 cups white bread flour | 1 teaspoon mixed mexican seasoning or 3 -5 teaspoons italian seasoning
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1 1/4 cups warm water. Sift 3/4 teaspoon dry spice blend. Add 1/2 cup bread flour to yeast mixture. Mix well until combined. Stir in 1 t. Soyner sauce. Grease the inside of a 4 x 14 inch glass baking dish or a jelly roll pan. Stir 3/4 cup cold water, greek style dried bread or flour, and other seasonings into yeast mixture. Beat the mixture until bubbly and well combined. Stir in 2 tablespoons of cold water at a time until dough starts to form. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface. Knead dough slightly on a floured rolling pin or floured surface until dough is smooth and elastic, about 5 minutes about 8 minutes. Place dough in lightly greased, covered bowl. Let rise until double. Punch down dough. Cover and let rise. In the meantime, lightly oil bottom of baking dish. With lightly floured hands, stretch dough slightly to make thin round slices. Place dough into oiled baking dish. Cover baking dish or bread pan tightly and let rise until 1 hour longer. Preheat oven to 500 degrees f. Bake in preheated 450 degree oven until golden brown, 12 to 15 minutes. Let cool on a rack for 5 minutes, then serve.

title: Choc-Yard Parfait
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs parsnips, peeled finely grated | 1/2 cup margarine or 1/2 cup vegetable shortening | 1/2 cup unsweetened coconut, shredded | 1/4 cup grated coconut | 1/4 cup oats | 1 tablespoon brandy ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon lime rind ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons self-rising flour
instructions: Crumble the parsnips coarsely. In a bowl combine the grated coconut, grated coconut, oats, brandy and lime rind. Add the flour until the mixture just holds together. Form the mixture into 2 inch rounds. Preheat griddle or frying pan. Place the rounds on top of each other, and brush the griddle or frying pan with the melted margarine. Briefly flatten. Serve right away. Note, use coconut, grated coconut, shredded coconut, grated coconut or any other flavourful flavouring of your choice. If this does not hold, add a little almond meal or brandy to the flour mixture or mix all together. If all your ingredients are not ready to use now, press a piece of greaseproof paper or parchment paper between towelling to prevent sticking. Bake the parfait over a fairly low heat, stirring occasionally until the top is lightly browned, but firm around the edges. Leave to cool. Enjoy.

title: Tomato and Spice Salsa
ingredients: 1 roma tomato, diced | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 1/2 teaspoon dried chili, crushed
instructions: Serve over a bed of romaine lettuce.

title: Pommes De La Garrigue
ingredients: 2 pints half-and-half | 8 large floury potatoes | 4 ounces self raising flour | 2 tablespoons mint, finely chopped ( optional, i use fresh mint leaves to give a kick ) | 8 ounces uncooked medium dry pasta
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c. Grease a deep baking dish. Cook the pasta until al dente. Cut into 6 to 8 wedges, and toss the potato wedges in their juices into the sauce. Place potatoes into a bowl of cold water to stop the cooking. Drain and steam them until crisp. Stir the flour, mint and pasta into the sauce until the potatoes are thoroughly coated. Pour the potato/toast into the dish and bake for 30 minutes or until the dish is warmed through and the potatoes are soft.

title: Fig and Sweetcorn Fritters
ingredients: 1 lb raw sugar snap peas or 1 lb sweetcorn | 1/2 cup canned sweetened fig, chopped | 2 tablespoons canola oil ( or olive oil ) | 2 tablespoons panko breadcrumbs | 1 can chopped figs, drained and rinsed | 1 tablespoon brandy
instructions: Cook and stir sugar snaps in salted water for 5 minutes. Stir in figs and brandy. Serve over pita chips.

title: Beer and Spanish Sausage for the Crock Pot
ingredients: 1 package pol polska kielbasa | 20 ounces barbecue sauce | 4 tablespoons instant espresso powder | tortilla chips
instructions: Trim sausage of any fat and cut sausage into 3/4 inch slices. Place on the bottom of a crock pot or other deep platter. Spread the barbeque sauce over the kielbasa and sprinkle with espresso. Set aside for 2 or 3 hours on high, or 5 to 8 hours on low. Garnish with tortilla chips before serving.

title: Fresh Fruit Salsa
ingredients: 1 can ranch style beans | 1 can crushed pineapple, drained | 2 tablespoons dried currants | 2 tablespoons pine nuts
instructions: Place drained, crushed pineapple in bowl.

title: Portuguese Baked Pot Sticker Bread (Abm)

instructions: For the stuffing, mix the meats together in a mixing bowl.

Random Ingredients: chicken thigh,serrano pepper,red pepper,almond extract,chili powder
title: Nuclear Nuts
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chili powder | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 10 chicken thighs | 1 serrano pepper, seeded and minced | 1/4 teaspoon ground red pepper
instructions: Whisk chili powder, almond extract, and chicken thighs together in a bowl. Pour into another bowl until no lumps are present. Place a nonstick frying pan over a medium high flame.

Random Ingredients: porterhouse steak,sunflower oil,puff pastry,soya sauce,chocolate frosting,glutinous rice
title: Teriyaki Beef Rolls
ingredients: 2 porterhouse steaks | 1 cup glutinous-rice, thawed | 1/2 cup soya sauce, reduced sodium | 1/2 cup sunflower oil | 1/2 cup chocolate frosting | 2 sheets puff pastry, thawed
instructions: Slice steaks across the grain into very thin slices. Combine glutinous rice and soya sauce in a small bowl. Toss steaks in rice mixture and let stand for 20 minutes. Heat oil in a wok over high heat until just smoking. Add beef and cook, turning once, until browned about 2 minutes. Serve steak on top of pastry, garnishing with glaze.

Random Ingredients: turkey,soymilk,lettuce,tuna,chicken bouillon granule,beef broth,cream celery soup,clove
title: Tuna Turkey Salad
ingredients: 2 cans tuna, drained | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 1 can condensed chicken broth | 8 tablespoons soy milk | 2 teaspoons instant minced chicken bouillon granules | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cloves | 2 1/2 cups chopped cooked turkey | 8 leaves lettuce
instructions: Toss together the tuna, soup, broth, soy milk, bouillon granules and cloves in a large serving bowl until well blended. Cover and chill. Remove turkey mixture from the refrigerator 35 minutes prior to serving. Drain tuna mixture and mix with turkey mixture. Stir in lettuce. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

title: Hummus
ingredients: 1 can garbanzo beans, drained | 1/2 cup shortening, melted | 4 slices rye bread
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Place the garbanzo beans in a bowl or food processor and pulse until the beans are finely chopped. Add butter, bread pieces and 1 to 2 tablespoons hummus.

title: Baked Stuffed Baked Chipotle
ingredients: 1 eggplant | 3 cups chipotle chiles, canned ( in adobo sauce ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons anise extract | 3/4 cup pure maple syrup | 2 teaspoons ground cumin
instructions: In a medium size bowl, combine chopped and cleaned chipotle chiles, anise extract and maple syrup. Stir to combine. Using very clean hands, peel eggplant from underside and carefully remove seeds with fingers, taking care not to mash it. Then with an paring knife or a teaspoon, carefully scrape skin from around eggplant in bowl and smash the cloves in small, evenly sized pieces with your hands. Fill eggplant with mixture and place in an oiled nonstick baking pan, about 2/3 of the way up. Sprinkle baking pan with 1/4 teaspoons anise extract and 1/4 teaspoons cumin. Bake at 400f for 30 - 40 minutes or until eggplant is soft and golden brown and liquid filling has almost evaporated. Serve with a nice salad or bread of your choice.

Random Ingredients: colby monterey jack cheese,salt,parmigiano reggiano cheese,celery,herb,lemon juice zest,corn oil
title: Tortoni Di Riso (Cold Tortillas)
ingredients: 8 tablespoons corn oil | 1/2 cup minced celery | 1 tablespoon grated lemon zest | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1 teaspoon chopped dried herbs | 1/2 teaspoon chopped fresh herb, such as parsley, dill, chives or 1/2 teaspoon cilantro | grated colby-monterey jack cheese or pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Heat all ingredients together in skillet on medium high heat. Heat until butter or margarine starts to bubble. Reduce heat to low, place margarine/oil in small bowl. Use tongs to dip tortillas in, coating both sides. Keep warm while cooking rest. Serve warm.

title: Japanese Oil - No Oil?
ingredients: 1/2 cup dark sesame oil | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice ( to be bottled with a shake ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried tarragon
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and pour into shaker, shaking well. Let stand 10 minutes before using, shaking the shaker at intervals. Shake well and strain into a sterilized container. Keep indefinitely in the refrigerator.

title: Snow Pea & Horseradish Soup
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups fresh snow peas ( or 1 15-ounce can of snow peas, drained and rinsed ) | 2 1/2 cups boiling broth | 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 3 -4 teaspoons prepared horseradish | 2 chicken bouillon cubes ( or salt )
instructions: Blanch the snow peas in boiling water for one minute, remove and plunge into cold water. Drain immediately and set aside. Place all ingredients except the peas in a large saucepan and bring to simmer over medium heat. Cover and simmer for 5 minutes.

title: Simple Mexican Salsa
ingredients: 1 jar chunky salsa | 1/4 cupumaq, crumbled
instructions: Mix all ingredients in small bowl, and refrigerate for 4 - 6 hours.

title: Goat Cheese- Mushroom Quesadillas
ingredients: 3 ounces goat cheese | 1 package softened cream cheese | 1 jar sliced mushrooms | 1 can mushrooms, drained | 1 -2 tablespoon chili-garlic sauce ( or more depending on taste )
instructions: Cut goat cheese into small pieces and place in mixing bowl, add cream cheese and mix until smooth. Stir mushrooms into the cream cheese mixture. Dip tortillas in sauce and then press into a lightly greased pan. Allow to rest about 10 minutes or until tortillas are lightly browned to your liking. Cut into quarters and then into pieces or pieces and serve with your favourite toppings.

title: Quick Beef N' Vegetables
ingredients: 2 tablespoons oil | 1 lb top round steak, trim to the same thickness | 24 ounces frozen stir fry vegetables
instructions: Heat oil in a heavy skillet over medium high heat. Place steak in the skillet and sear on all sides. Remove from skillet and set aside in a bowl.

title: Shrimp Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs raw jumbo shrimp | 1/2 cup rice wine or 1/2 cup dry sherry | 1/2 cup white vinegar | 1 jar roasted sweet peppers, sliced | 1 jar julienne-cut pimiento, drained | 1 can maraschino cherries, drained
instructions: In bowl, toss shrimp with rice wine or sherry, vinegar and peppers. Chill 1 - 2 hrs. Drain shrimp, pat dry with paper towels and cut into 1 inch pieces. Remove seeds. Arrange shrimp on a serving platter and surround with strips of pimentos strips, cherry tomatoes and pimento pieces.

Random Ingredients: pineapple chunk,rom tomato,parmesan cheese,puff pastry,lettuce,purpose flour
title: Quick Italian Vegetable Tart
ingredients: 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 1/2 teaspoon grated fresh parmesan cheese | 2 packages frozen puff pastry sheets, thawed according to package directions | 2 cups romaine lettuce, julienned ( about 6 ) | 12 -16 ounces canned pineapple chunks, drained | 1 roma tomato, thinly sliced ( about 1/2 cup )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. In a bowl, combine flour and parmesan cheese. On a lightly floured surface, roll or pat pastry into a 10 circle. Transfer pastry to a 10 inch tart pan or baking sheet. Unfold pastry, keeping the remaining pastry as flat as possible. Pat the pastry into the pan. Using the pastry tips of your fingers, make 8 indents around the edge of the pastry crust. Using your fingertips, spread the crust with the flour to coat. Arrange the lettuce over the pastry crust. Carefully slide the tart pan on top of the lettuce. Slice the tomatoes in half and arrange over the vegetables. Cover with foil and bake for 20 minutes. Remove foil and bake an additional 5 minutes or until the crust is golden brown. Carefully, remove tart pan from oven and remove tart from oven. Serve tart warm or at room temperature. Note, if you have a pizza crust, prepare individual tart shells and place them on a baking sheet, greased side down, and bake for 8 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 450°f, remove foil and bake another 7 minutes or until puffed and golden brown.

title: Perfect Breakfast for One - Please Make One - You Breakfast Spanish Rice
ingredients: 1 cup long grain white rice or 1 cup carnaroli rice | 1 cup orange juice
instructions: Cook rice according to directions, pour over oranges, cover and let stand for at least 30 minutes until all liquid has been absorbed.. Serve, drizzle each slice or two with 1 tbsp of orange infused butter before you eat.

title: Chef John's Special Saffron Buttermilk
ingredients: 1 pound green bell peppers, diced | 2 teaspoons saffron, divided | 1/2 cup buttermilk for staining
instructions: Toss bell peppers with 1 teaspoon of saffron in a bowl. Let marinate at least 15 minutes. Stir buttermilk, 1/4 teaspoon of saffron, and 1/2 teaspoon salt together in the bottom of a 4 quart or larger pot to loosen the browned peppers. Bring the pot a boil over medium heat. Cook peppers until softened, about 5 minutes. Drain peppers, remove seeds. Place peppers and remaining saffron onto a large plate or platter. Stir 1/4 teaspoon of saffron into buttermilk along with the remaining 1/4 teaspoon saffron, and pour over the peppers.

Random Ingredients: caraway seed,red currant jelly,shrimp,anise seed,ginger juice
title: Spiced Shrimp - Norway
ingredients: 4 lbs fresh shrimp, shelled and deveined | 6 slices pickled ginger, cut in thin strips | 1/4 cup red currant jelly | caraway seed, to sprinkle | 1 teaspoon anise seed
instructions: Soak shrimp in cold water for 15 to 20 minutes. Drain shrimp. Arrange shrimp in a large, deep nonmetal baking dish. Arrange ginger over top. Combine jelly with caraway and anise. Pour over shrimp. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 3 days, stirring or shaking dish as necessary. Turn shrimp about occasionally. Remove marinade and pat dry. Grill shrimp, uncovered, over high heat for about 20 minutes or until shrimp turns pink. Cover with foil while grilling. Serve shrimp hot from the pan with mustard on the side.

Random Ingredients: stock,lemon pepper,chinese rice wine,tamarind pulp,lime wedge
title: Thai Sweet Chilli Paste
ingredients: 5 cups stock | 1 cup preserved lemongrass, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon tamarind pulp | 1 tablespoon shaoxing chinese rice wine | 2 teaspoons lemon pepper
instructions: Boil the stock, place all the ingredients in a saucepan and bring. Boil over low heat for 5 - 7 minutes or until slightly thickened. Pour into a heatproof container and cool. Refrigerate until cold or serve.

title: Easy Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 medium head cauliflower, trimmed and cut into smaller florets | 4 teaspoons dried oregano
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Place cauliflower florets in a saucepan with water to cover. Bring to a boil, then transfer to a bowl of cold water to stop the cooking. Drain, and transfer to a roasting dish or baking sheet. Sprinkle the oregano all over the cauliflower. Cover the dish, and bake for 1 1/2 hours in the preheated oven.

Random Ingredients: white flour,mustard seed,red chili,margarine,mushroom,white button mushroom
title: Indian Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 tablespoon margarine | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 3/4 cup white flour | 1 tablespoon crushed red chili, crushed | 2 tablespoons mixed white mushrooms, roughly chopped | 1 large white button mushroom, sliced
instructions: Heat the margarine in a frying pan over a high heat. Meanwhile, using a pestle and grater, mix the mustard seeds and flour. Add this mixture to the wok with the crushed chilli and mix well to combine. Allow to cool. Stuff the mushrooms, cut side up and place into a greased ovenproof dish. Pour the gravy over the mushrooms and bake in a moderate oven about 40 minutes or until the mushrooms are very tender. Serve.

title: Chef John's Pinto Bean Burritos
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans | 1 can mexican-style corn, drained | 2 serrano peppers - stemmed, seeded, and minced | 1 tablespoon sugar | 1 bay leaf | 1 tablespoon minced green olives | 6 large flour tortillas, warmed
instructions: Mix pinto beans, mexican style corn, serrano peppers, sugar, and bay leaf together in a bowl.

instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f in a small bowl, mix cinnamon, mustard seeds, pepper, peas, garam masala and 2 teaspoons itian seasoning. Brush a large baking dish with oil, then layer cod and pea mixture in a single layer. Spoon or pipe pea mixture over cod and bake, uncovered, for about 20 minutes or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork.

title: Cajun-Stuffed Jalapenos
ingredients: 1 cup chicken broth | 1/2 cup whole almond butter ( not margarine ) | 1 cup crushed pistachios | 4 tablespoons cajun seasoning | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh pistachios
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine broth and next 3 ingredients.

title: Chinese Grilled Butternut Squash
ingredients: 1 butternut squash | 2 cups water | 1 can mandarin oranges, drained | 1 tablespoon ginger powder | 1 container frozen whipped topping, thawed ( optional )
instructions: Cut squash lengthwise into 1/2 thick wedges. In a bowl, cover squash halves with water.

title: Puff Pastry Lasagna
ingredients: 1 package frozen puff pastry, thawed according to package directions | 14 ounces plain yogurt ( about 1 cup ) | 2/3 cup non-fat milk | 1/4 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Line a heavy baking sheet with parchment paper or plastic wrap. Unfold pastry on a lightly floured work surface.

title: Quick Spinach and Tomato
ingredients: 2 packages frozen spinach, thawed and drained | 4 tablespoons liquid smoke flavoring | 1 can diced tomatoes with garlic and olive oil | 1 drop red food coloring
instructions: In a large bowl, toss the spinach, liquid smoke, tomatoes with garlic and olive oil, and water.

title: Fruit and Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 asian cabbage ( or any similar cabbage ) | 2 small dried fruits ( optional ) ( optional ) | 1/2 cup lemon, juiced ( i used 2 tbsp lemon juice )
instructions: Chop cabbage into thin rounds. Place in large bowl. Add dried fruit, stir to combine. Drizzle with lemon juice.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,orange peel,brown rice,baby dill pickle,ice water,almond extract,tamarind juice
title: Tamarind Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup finely chopped baby dill pickles | 1 1/2 cups freshly squeezed tamarind juice | 2/3 cup orange peel, minced | 1/4 cup white vinegar | 1/2 cup packed brown rice | 1/4 teaspoon tamarind extract | 1 cup ice water | 1 cup slivered almonds ( optional )
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine the pickles, 1/2 cup of the tamarind juice, orange peel, vinegar, rice, tamarind extract and 1 cup of the ice water. Heat to boiling.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,cooking spray,self raising flour
title: Thai Red Curry Snack Bread
ingredients: cooking spray | 2 cups self-raising flour | 2 teaspoons red curry paste
instructions: Pre heat the oven to 190c. Lightly spray a 5 x 3 loaf tin with oil and line with baking paper. Combine the flour, curry paste and seasoning. Make a well in the centre. Place the dry ingredients into the well of the dry ingredients followed by the curry paste on top of the curry paste. Using a flat bladed knife, carefully mix everything together until evenly blended. If there is a very small amount of liquid in the mix you may need to add more later or else the bread will not hold together when you squeeze it. Slide the pastry mixture into the tin and smooth it out slightly using a spatula. Spray a little more oil onto the top and spread the mixture evenly with a palette knife. Bake 25 minutes.

title: Mustard - Herb-Mustard Spread
ingredients: 15 g fresh herbs ( dried herbs such as savory, dill, rosemary, savory or dill ) | 1/4 cup stone ground mustard ( coarse mustard, such as gulden's. or your favourite. ) | 25 g gherkin slices ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients into a small frying pan. Mash the mixture with a potato masher until desired consistency is achieved.

title: Medley of Edamsame Salad
ingredients: 2 cups shelled edamame | 60 ml marsala wine | 60 ml water chestnuts | 1 pinch ground mace | 1 teaspoon sumac
instructions: Wash Edamame and cook in a pot for 5 minutes. Drain, saving a few tablespoons of the cooking liquid. Heat remaining cooking liquid, marsala, and water chestnuts in a bowl with edamame. Toss with reserved cooking liquid. Sprinkle with sumac and serve.

title: Quickest Eggplant
ingredients: 2 large eggplants | 1 liter chicken stock or 1 liter broth | 2 tablespoons lime rind ( optional ) | 2 apples ( optional )
instructions: Slice eggplants lengthwise into 1/4 slices. Place slices in a colander and leave to drain for an hour. Slice apples into small cubes or chunks. In a large saucepan, bring stock to boil. Add eggplant and cook over low heat for about 20 minutes, turning occasionally. Add lime rind if using. Serve over rice.

title: Anchovies
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh anchovies | 1 1/2 cups tomato ketchup
instructions: Shell anchovies by placing the heads and the tail end toward you on each end of a long, thin skewer. Skewer anchovies can be made by dropping into boiling water and then turning. As soon as the anchovies float to the top, remove with a slotted spoon and place in bowl lined with ice water. Toss gently about 10 minutes. They should still have a coating of ketchup, but they will be less crunchy when they cool. Store in an airtight container. Bake at 140°c until they are golden and crisp, about 2 hours.

title: Malti Burger
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger bun | 1 eggplant, grated | 1 lb meat, any shape | 5 -6 slices ham | 1 teaspoon coriander | 1/2 cup cashews | oil ( for frying )
instructions: Cut any fat into small pieces. Mix it with the ground meats. Put on a plate and spread it with the meat mix. Make sure it is thick enough that it doesn't burn. Grill the eggplant or fry them in a little bit of oil. Make sure they are not too crisp. Spread the eggplant with a little bit of oil, fry them briefly. Put on a paper towel to get a dry clean tissue from them. Keep the hamburger bun on it. Put the cashew nuts in a bowl. Put a piece of ham on it and a piece of eggplant or one slice of ham. Spread this with the ground mix. Put the nuts on the hamburger bun. Put the nut pieces on top. Put the other hamburger bun on top. Close the seal. Let it rest for 5 minutes. You can cut it to eat it all day.

title: Spanish Fried Chorizo With Pasta
ingredients: 1 small chorizo sausage or 1 small other fresh sausage, casing removed | 2 teaspoons corn oil | 12 ounces pasta, such as ditalini, linguine, linguine, chorizo | 1 tablespoon caldo pimento pepper, chopped | 1 1/2 cups chicken bouillon, divided | 8 slices bacon
instructions: Preheat your broiler, and line a baking sheet with foil. Cut the chorizo into chunks about 1 inch in diameter, and fry them in a small, nonstick frying pan over medium heat until the pieces no longer show any signs of pink inside. Remove the chorizo from the pan, and drain it on paper towels. Place it aside. Cut the cheese into small cubes.

title: Spicy Root Veggies on the Barbie With Fennel, Fennel and Onions
ingredients: 2 packages radishes, peeled | 2 medium parsnips, halved lengthwise | 1 cup kalamata olives or 1 cup other good black olives | 2 tablespoons chopped seeds from a mixed pimento ( fennel ) | olive, pitted and minced | dried currant or plain yogurt, for dipping
instructions: Cut a horizontal slit on the root end and remove the peel. Then, using a vegetable peeler, cut the carrots and parsnips diagonally into thin slices about 1/4 inch thick. Toss the strips in a large bowl with the olives, seeds and fennel. Thread 3 strips on 2 bamboo skewers and grill, turning once, until the veggies are tender, about 15 minutes.

title: Fish in Whiskey Sauce
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh fish, cut into 4 pieces | 2 ounces whiskey
instructions: Put fish in a baking dish and cover with whiskey. Cover with foil, sealing tight. Bake in a 350 degree oven for 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: garlic,mushroom stem,kernel corn,yellow squash,yellow bell pepper,chili paste,mustard
title: Spicy Chili Veggie Thing in a Jar
ingredients: 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 1 can mushroom stems and pieces, drained | 1 yellow squash, chopped | 1 yellow bell pepper, chopped | 1 teaspoon chili paste | 1 teaspoon dry mustard | 1/2 teaspoon garlic, minced
instructions: Put everything in a bowl, except for the garlic, and let it sit for 15 minutes. Stir to blend well. Pour into a jar and refrigerate. Note, i put the jar in the fridge right away and it gets better with age.

title: Chinese Coleslaw
ingredients: 2 cups packaged coleslaw mix | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained and chopped | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Toss coleslaw mix and water chestnuts with pepper in a bowl. Refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight to blend flavors.

Random Ingredients: chuck roast,chorizo sausage,garam masala,mango chunk,lemon zest,farfalle pasta,onion powder,vegetable stock
title: Spicy Mexican Chili
ingredients: 2 lbs chuck roast | 2 cans mixed vegetables ( vegetable broth, peas, red wine, etc ) | 1/2 cup mango chunk ( fresh or frozen or canned are ok too, just be sure to buy a large tin of it ) | 3 tablespoons lemon zest ( finely grated, no real zest ) | 1 teaspoon garam masala ( i use mccormick's masala ) | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 3 tablespoons vegetable stock | 1 package farfalle pasta ( bowtie or spiral or macaroni etc )
instructions: Trim excess fat from meat. If you are using an electric knife, this will make slicing easier. Cut meat lengthwise into 1/2 inch strips and then into strips about 1/2 inch thick. Place beef and vegetables into crock pot. Sprinkle with lemon zest, garam masala and onion powder. Pour vegetable broth or vegetable stock over all. Cover and cook on low for 8 hours, or up to 9 hours depending on how thick the meat and vegetables are. Remove meat and vegetables from crock pot using a slotted spoon and set aside. Discard vegetables in crock pot. Shred meat with two forks and return to crock pot. Add lemon zest, garam masala and onion powder. Cover and cook on high for 15 minutes. Add farfalle pasta and cook on high for an additional 10 minutes. Adjust seasonings to taste. Serve with warm bread or a hearty snack. This chili can also be frozen in 2 or 4 ounce ziploc bags. This would be great as a meal for the kids to eat. It's just sooo good.

title: Taste for Hotness
ingredients: 500 g cubanelle peppers | lemon juice, 3 drops
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees celsius or 300°f. Wash and thoroughly dry the peppers, removing seeds and stems. Place the peppers in a single layer on 2 baking trays. Drizzle with a little olive oil. Sprinkle with lemon juice. Bake in oven for 1 hour. Be sure not to open the oven until 1/2 way through the cooking time.

title: Apricot and Parmesan Crackers
ingredients: 2 hard-boiled eggs | 3/4 cup parmesan cheese, grated | 1/4 cup dried apricot, finely chopped
instructions: Cut the eggs in half lengthwise. Remove the yolks, reserve for later use. Peel the egg whites and set the whites aside. Place the egg whites in a bowl and whisk until very thick. Fold in the parmesan.. Fold in the apricots. Pour into 2 or 3 buttered ovenproof ramekins. Cook in a 350 degree. Oven for 15 minutes or until puffed and golden.

title: Enchiladas Verde
ingredients: 10 slices bacon drippings | 8 1/2 ounces dry enchilada sauce | 1 1/2 cups shredded mozzarella balls
instructions: Cook bacon in a skillet over medium low heat until evenly browned. Break bacon pieces into a bowl, and set aside. Pour enchilada sauce over the bacon. Sprinkle mozzarella pieces over mixture. Continue to cook and stir until cheese is melted and enchiladas are warmed throughout. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,tortilla chip,prawn,fire tomato,cornstarch,orange juice,lime wedge
title: Tortilla Mollie
ingredients: 30 g plain flour | 310 g prawns, thawed and patted dry | 310 g tinned whole fire-roasted tomatoes | 310 g tinned diced fire-roasted tomatoes | 1/3 cup orange juice | 4 teaspoons cornstarch | lime wedge, to serve
instructions: Heat 2 tsp oil in a large non stick frying pan over medium heat. Sprinkle flour over tomatoes, stir well and cook for 2 minutes, stirring frequently. Stir in prawns and cook, stirring for 2 - 3 minutes or until pink and cooked through. Remove from heat. Add remaining ingredients and stir well. Transfer to ovenproof dish. Broil, 3 - 4 inches from heat for 2 - 3 minutes or until golden brown and bubbling around edge. Serve immediately, garnished with lime wedges.

title: Mushroom and Ham Steak Rolls
ingredients: 2 slices hamburger | 2 sheets whole wheat pastry flour | 2 ounces dried shiitake mushrooms ( soaked in warm water for 20 minutes, then chopped or sliced ) | 2 tablespoons olive, chopped | 1 tablespoon sesame oil
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325°f. Mix the filling ingredients together. On a floured surface, roll out the pastry to 1/8 inch thick. Cut a 2 inch round from the thick dough. Use a sharp knife to score the dough in a crisscross pattern. Make 2 slits in the middle of the pastry for venting, and top each with a slice of ham to meet the opposite point of your pastry, so that they meet at the outer edge of your pastry. Brush the dough with sesame oil. Using a knife or pastry wheel, cut a cross in the dough. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, checking once to bake for the first few minutes. Serve hot.

title: Homemade Shortbread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups wheat flour | 1 cup soymilk
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, sift together the flour and soy milk. Mix well with hands. Cover with a clean cloth and let rest for ten to twenty minutes. Preheat oven to 300 degrees and line two cookie sheets with parchment paper. Add the shortbread mixture and lightly press down with your hands. If it does not stick to the parchment paper, press again until it starts to stick together. Bake for an hour and ten minutes. Then remove the parchment and turn off the oven. Wait five minutes for the shortbread to dry, then remove the parchment and enjoy.

title: Sweet Tamales
ingredients: 1/4 cup masa harina | 2 tablespoons raisins | 1 tablespoon light soy sauce
instructions: Whisk the harina, raisins and soy sauce together in a medium sized bowl. Divide into 12 portions and form tamales in the shape of large corn husks. Place on a medium hot skillet. Cook for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: tabasco brand chipotle pepper sauce,yoghurt,virgin olive oil
title: Yogurt Spicy Pepper Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup full fat yogurt | 1 tablespoon virgin olive oil | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco brand chipotle pepper sauce | 1 teaspoon tabasco brand chipotle pepper sauce
instructions: Dissolve 1/2 teaspoon tobasco pepper sauce in 1/2 cup yoghurt and set aside a few spoons full for dipping.

title: Spice-Baked Lentils & Pimentos
ingredients: 1/2 cup green lentil | 2 sprigs fresh rosemary | 1/4 cup dried pimiento ( or more ) | 2 tablespoons brown shavings mirin | 1/2 teaspoon grated dark chocolate | 1/4 teaspoon freshly grated rosemary | 1/4 teaspoon freshly grated dark chocolate
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Place lentils in a medium bowl.

Random Ingredients: golden syrup,beef suet,tea,fish sauce,caster sugar,gorgonzola,wine vinegar
title: Faux Tangy Tea Salad With Gorgonzola
ingredients: 1/3 cup golden syrup | 1 tablespoon light tasting wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 1/2 teaspoon caster sugar ( superfine sugar ) | 1/2 lb beef top suet, thickly sliced | 2 ounces gorgonzola | fresh tea, to serve ( i prefer french's or colavita )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c and lightly grease 2 ovenproof dishes. In a small bowl combine the golden syrup, vinegar, fish sauce and sugar until very well blended. Put the beef in a bowl and coat it with the mixture. Put into the oven and bake for 20 - 25 minutes. Remove the dishes from the oven and set them at least 30 minutes before serving. To make the gorgonzola, slice the suet into 3 4cm lengths, then slice diagonally. Sprinkle over the tea and toss everything together. Serve cold.

title: Homodirla (Filipino Noodle Pancakes)
ingredients: 1 cup raw sugar | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 2 envelopes unflavored gelatin | 4 tablespoons flat rice noodles, rinsed and patted dry | 1/2 cup finely chopped onion | 2 tablespoons chili oil
instructions: Beat sugar, salt, and gelatin in a bowl with an electric mixer until smooth. Combine rice noodles and onion in separate bowl, and stir in sugar mixture and chili oil. Heat 1/2 to 1/3 cup vegetable oil in a skillet over medium low heat, or in a crepe pan. Spread 1/4 cup of batter in the bottom of the pan, tilting the pan to spread evenly. Cook until browned on the top, 2 to 5 minutes. Be careful not to burn the topping.

Random Ingredients: key lime juice,mango chutney,coriander,tabasco sauce,liquid smoke
title: Mango Chutney
ingredients: 1/2 cup mango chutney ( pure ) | 1/2 cup key lime juice ( or other lime juice ) | 2 teaspoons liquid smoke ( or other flavourful liquid smoke ) | 2 tablespoons ground coriander | 1 dash tabasco sauce ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and blend well.

Random Ingredients: phyllo pastry,broccoli floret,tomato green chilies,egg yolk,chili powder,potato starch,almond paste,apple cider vinegar
title: Spanish Potatoes in Almond-Poached Egg Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup chili powder | 1/4 cup potato starch ( sifted ) | 1 package blanched slivered almonds ( optional, but i like lots ) | 7 ounces broccoli florets | 1 1/4 cups chopped peeled apples ( optional ) | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chilies, drained | 1 egg yolk | 2 sheets phyllo pastry | 1/3 cup almond paste ( optional )
instructions: For the sauce, in a small, heavy skillet, cook chili powder and potato starch over medium heat for 2 minutes, stirring constantly. Reduce heat, add almonds and cook for 2 minutes more, stirring constantly. Remove from heat and cool to room temperature. Saute broccoli, apples and chili in remaining sauce for 3 - 3 minutes, until broccoli is slightly tender. Remove from heat and cool slightly. Stir through cooked vegetables, egg yolk and almond paste. Place a 9x13 inch sheet of aluminum foil on a baking sheet. Brush with an egg wash/light mistum. Place 3 phyllo sheets down on top of each other. Brush the sheets with an egg wash as well. Brush a small amount of oil on top. Repeat with 2 more phyllo sheets. Place 3 sheets sheet of phyllo on top of each other. With the phyllo in between the 2 sheets, lightly brush top pastry sheet with olive oil. Place 2 more sheets of phyllo on top. Frost phyllo with egg wash/light mistum. Repeat with all 3 sheets of phyllo and 2 more sheets of phyllo. Cook in oven at 400 f for 5 - 7 minutes, until golden.

Random Ingredients: mirin,corn tortilla chip,spring onion,cumin seed,cream tartar,tofu,simple syrup,ravioli
title: Soft Tofu Dipping Sauce - Vegan
ingredients: 300 g firm tofu | 1 tablespoon cumin seed | 2 tablespoons light sour cream or 2 tablespoons low-fat sour cream ( i used part cream and part low fat ) | 2 spring onions, chopped finely, white and green parts, chopped finely | 1/4 cup mirin or 1/4 cup sherry wine, to taste | 1 teaspoon dried instant gravy ( see ingredient note below ) | 1/4 teaspoon light cream of tartar | corn tortilla chips, for decoration ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c or 400°f. Using a sharp knife, cut the tofu int 1 inch cubes, about 5 cm or 1 inch. Transfer tofu to a plate and combine with the cumin seeds, 1 tablespoon of the sour cream or plain sour cream, spring onion, mirin, gravy, cream of tate and salt and pepper to taste. Mix well, cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes, stirring once. Remove tofu from the marinade. Roast tofu for 30 - 40 minutes, stirring often, or until golden brown and fragrant. Drain well and sprinkle with chopped spring onion, set aside and keep warm. Serve the tofu on a bed of tortilla chips, sprinkled with onion, if using, sprinkled on a little more of the sour cream if using.

title: Coconut Curry
ingredients: 1 tablespoon herbes de provence | 7 tablespoons of good coconut milk | 1 medium head of shredded cabbage
instructions: In a sauce pan, add the coconut milk and simmer for 15+ minutes, stirring so it doesn't stick to the bottom. Add the shredded cabbage and cook for 4 - 5 minutes until cabbage is cooked. Serve over steamed jasmine rice.

title: Aubergine and Walnut Surprise
ingredients: 500 g rump roast | 2 tablespoons bicarbonate of soda | 125 g marinara sauce | 125 g sliced almonds or125 g walnut halves | 1 large aubergine, cut into chunks, to serve ( optional )
instructions: Cut the roast into 6 wedges and using a sharp, meat knife, slash the centre on the meat, cutting into 4 equal lengths. Add the bicarb soda and marinara sauce to the meat, turn it over and leave to marinate in a cool place for 1 hour. Heat a little oil and brown the aubergine, turning it often. Remove the meat and fry the walnuts, then add it to the aubergine with any meat juices and serve scattered with the almonds and walnuts just before serving.

title: Bejeweled Kielbasa and Mussels
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 cup soymilk | 6 cups linguine, cooked | 1 - 2 1/2 lb kielbasa, sliced 1/4 in. thick ( or other sausage ) | 1 jar of dark chocolate, chopped | freshly grated pecorino cheese | whipped cream | kirschwasser ( optional ) | chopped nuts or pecorino cheese ( optional )
instructions: Pour soymilk in a large bowl and set aside. Cook pasta according to package directions and drain. While pasta is cooking, chop sausage into chunks and set aside. Place soymilk, sausage, chocolate and kirsch in a small saucepan and set over medium low heat. Bring just to boiling and cook stirring constantly until chocolate is melted and mixture is smooth but not liquified. Remove from heat and allow to sit just until lukewarm. Add pasta and toss. Transfer to serving bowls or decorative serving dishes and top with pecorino or other desired garnish. Note, this is a really easy pasta dish and the amount of time it takes to make is determined by your soymilk used. I will calculate the time to how well the dish is cooking and how full it will take to cook.

title: Sweet Chilli With Wild Rice
ingredients: 6 ounces wild rice ( or rice in stores, if your grains are not available ) | 4 -8 tablespoons sweet chili sauce | 1 tablespoon wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Rinse and drain the wild rice and boil it in a pan containing enough water to cover, until it is cooked but is slightly softer in appearance. Drain the rice in a sieve and reserve it. Place the rest of the ingredients in a saucepan and stir until the rice is coated lightly. Heat but do not boil, stirring constantly, until the mixture is hot. Serve the warm wild rice on small to elegant plates, or on top of hot rice. I sometimes serve with a fried egg.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,oriental vegetable,red pepper flake,cocoa,sofrito,turmeric,corn oil,tarragon
title: Kung Pao Chicken
ingredients: 5 tablespoons corn oil, divided | 1 pound bone-in skinless chicken breast halves, cut into bite-size chunks | 2 cloves crushed red peppers flakes | 1 large ( or 1 tablespoon ) package dried oriental-style vegetables, sliced | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 jar sofrito | 1 cup unsweetened cocoa, divided ( optional )
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add chicken.

title: Ditalini Pasta
ingredients: 1 package shell pasta | 1 pound pork neck bones | 1 teaspoon salt
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook shell pasta in boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 10 minutes. Drain. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook pork neck bones in boiling water, stirring occasionally, for about 10 minutes. Drain. Place onion into the saucepan of pork neck, and cook, stirring occasionally, until onion is translucent and pork neck is lightly browned. Mix pasta with pork neck mixture in the pot. Continue to cook and stir until pasta is coated with sausage flavored oil, about 1 to 2 more minutes.

Random Ingredients: basil pesto,white miso,cooking oil,green cardamom pod
title: Miso Sauce for Pasta and Vegetables
ingredients: 4 cups prepared italian-style miso, or as needed | 1 1/4 cups quick-cooking oil | 1/2 teaspoon green cardamom pods | 1 cup basil pesto
instructions: Heat miso and oil in a saucepan over medium low heat. Pour miso mixture into a bowl.

title: Vegetarian "spaghetti"
ingredients: spaghetti | 4 tablespoons rice flour | 2 small bell peppers
instructions: Cut spaghetti in half. Cut peppers in half. Place in large pot with enough water over them to cover. Bring to a boil and cook on low until it is cooked. Drain spaghetti and return to pot. Mix in rice flour and veggies. Cook and stir till all vegetables are cooked.

title: Pizza Appetizer
ingredients: 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | 1 tablespoon prepared gravy | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh dill
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spread the cheese evenly in a medium sized baking dish. Heat gravy and dill in a small saucepan over medium high heat. When heated through, pour over the cheese. Sprinkle over the mozzarella. Bake in the preheated oven until bubbly and the cheese is lightly browned, 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Lettuce and Ricotta Salad
ingredients: 2 heads bibb lettuce, very thinly sliced | 1 cup ricotta cheese, preferably whole-milk type is good, chilled
instructions: In a large serving bowl, toss the lettuce with the cheese.

title: Baked Egg Substitute (For Vegetarian)
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon crushed saffron | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala powder | 1/8 teaspoon basil | 1 egg substitute ( optional )
instructions: In a small dish, combine saffron with garam masala powder, basil and egg substitute.

title: Guava and Apple Stew
ingredients: 2 tablespoons shortening | 1 lb beef stew meat, cut in 1/2-inch cubes | 1 small tart apple, peeled, cored and cut in wedges | 1 cup canned guava juice | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 1 tablespoon tarragon | 1 can chickpeas
instructions: Heat shortening in heavy skillet. Sprinkle stew meat with salt. Cook over high heat until browned on all sides. Transfer meat to clay cooker. Add apple, guava juice, and vinegar to skillet and bring to boil. Reduce heat to low.

title: Easy Basic Chinese Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 package uncooked dry whole grain basmati rice | 1 1/2 quarts vegetable oil for frying | 1 1/2 tablespoons coffee | 1 1/2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1/4 cup minced fresh basil ( optional )
instructions: Place a large pot of water over high heat. Add rice, cover, and cook until done, about 15 minutes. Drain, and set aside. Heat oil in a skillet over high heat. Drain rice, and set aside. Place rice and coffee in a large mixing bowl, and mix well. Stir in rice vinegar. Stir in basil, if using. Mix thoroughly, and pour into an 8x8x2 inch baking dish. Cover, and chill for at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Apricot Red Bean and Dill Spread
ingredients: 1 can red beans, drained and rinsed | 1/3 cup apricot flavored marmalade | 1/4 teaspoon dried dill weed
instructions: Mix all together until smooth. Cover and refrigerate overnight for best results.

title: Cranachan Hot Rub
ingredients: 1 sprig mint extract | 1 1/2 teaspoons curry powder | 1 teaspoon chopped dried red chile, or more to taste
instructions: Stir mint extract, curry powder, and chile together in a bowl. Brush onto skin of hot chile.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage,pasta,white chocolate chip,lemon juice zest,green onion
title: Gino's Italian Sausage Salad
ingredients: 2 links white chocolate chips | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1 green onion ( white part only ) | 1 cup good quality pasta ( i use bowties ) | 9 links sweet italian sausage
instructions: First take your pasta and cut it in 3/4's lengthwise, or however small you want your salad to be. Cook the pasta in boiling water. This will be done in the microwave, usually a couple minutes. Drain the water off then toss into your salad bowl. Now chop the green onion, and chop it into bite size pieces. Cut the sausage in 1/4's lengthwise. Mix this all up in the salad bowl. You can serve right away or leave out on the counter later to chill the salad. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: asparagus spear,whipping cream,vodka,bacon grease,ha avocadoes,liquid smoke,extra oil,water artichoke heart
title: Avocado and Asparagus Antipasti Dip
ingredients: 3/4 ounce vodka | 2 tablespoons reduced-fat whipping cream | 12 asparagus spears, trimmed | 2 slices cooked bacon ( optional ) | 1 1/2 ounces water-packed anchovies packed in oil ( drained, about 2 cans ) | 1/4 avocado, halved, pitted, peeled and chopped | 2 drops liquid smoke | 1 teaspoon good-quality vodka ( optional ) or 1 teaspoon lemon juice ( optional )
instructions: Combine vodka, cream and asparagus in a bowl. Cut the bacon into 2 inch bits and scatter over the top of the asparagus. Arrange the anchovies over top of the bacon and serve.

title: Beer and Wheat Germ Snack Balls
ingredients: 1/2 cup wheat germ | 1 ounce lager beer | 15 slices pepperoni | 1 tablespoon sweet golden syrup
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375ºf. Line baking sheet with parchment paper. In a large bowl, combine wheat germ, lager and pepperoni. Form the mixture into small rounds. Place the rounds on the lined sheet and bake for 10 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from the oven and cut into rounds. Dip cooled cookies into bran mixture and sprinkle with additional bran mixture if desired. Keep sandwiches from drying out if not served immediately.

Random Ingredients: pea carrot,parsley,raspberry jam,hard egg,dark soy sauce
title: Nando's Peppered Rice and Egg Salad
ingredients: 1 -2 hard-boiled egg, sliced into rings | 1/2 cup frozen peas and carrots | 1/2 cup frozen raspberries or ( 15 ounce ) can blueberries | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce | parsley
instructions: Place all of the ingredients in a 9 inch deep frying pan and bring to simmer over moderate to high heat just until the water is boiling, taking care not to let the veggies become mushy. Pour into individual plates and sprinkle with parsley.

title: Steamed Rice Chips
ingredients: 2 cups warm potato | 3 whole cloves | 2 tablespoons kekoman teriyaki sauce ( or 2 tablespoons soy sauce ) | 2 eggs | mint leaf, for garnish
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c / 375°f. Place the warm potato on a flat surface. Place the cloves in the centre of a square of silicon paper, wrap the paper in foil and put on a baking tray. Place the tray inside the oven and cook for 45 minutes. Turn the potato half way through cooking. This should give you a good golden colour. Remove the foil and continue to cook the chips in the oven. Remove the chips from the oven, leaving a little gap between each one. Using a fork, mash the potato until it is fairly runny, adding a little kikkoman teriyaki sauce or tamari to help mash. Place the chips on serving plates or plates. Place in the fridge until needed, or for 30 minutes. Heat a griddle pan for a few seconds and coat with oil. Remove from the oven and place in a shallow plate. Place the chips on the griddle and cook them until golden brown and crispy, about 2 - 5 minutes. Transfer the cooked chips to a dish and serve with freshly made mint leaves.

Random Ingredients: ham,orzo pasta,pineapple tidbit,black olive,lemon juice zest,manchego cheese,habanero pepper,coconut
title: Gobble on a Baked Ham and Orzo
ingredients: 16 ounces orzo pasta, cooked and drained | 1/2 - 3/4 cup ham, cooked & cut up | 1 can pineapple tidbits, drained | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1/2 cup black olives | 1 habanero pepper, chopped | 12 ounces manchego cheese, grated | 1/4 - 1/2 cup fresh grated coconut
instructions: Pre heat oven to 350 degrees. Boil orzo for 25 minutes, drain. While that cooks mix the other ingredients together except for the garnish, the garnish, and cheese. Add cooked ham to pasta mixture and toss until combined. Spray a 2½ quart baking dish with cooking spray. Pour pasta mixture into baking dish. Sprinkle with cheese. You can top with a sprinkle of panko, if desired. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes until bubbly and topping is nicely browned.

Random Ingredients: curry leaf,apple cider vinegar,raspberry vinegar,yellow mustard,watermelon,pepper
title: Watermelon Salad
ingredients: 1 lb seedless watermelon, cubed | 1/2 cup apple cider vinegar, vinager sweet | 1 tablespoon raspberry vinegar, wildflower | 1 tablespoon yellow mustard, dijon | 1/2 cup curry leaf | fresh ground pepper, to taste
instructions: Place the cubed watermelon and vinegar in a bowl and mix well. Allow to stand for 30 - 45 minutes. While the watermelon is sitting, add the mustard to the remaining vinager. Dip the curry leaves into the vinegar mixture, then add to the watermelon cubes. Remove seeds from the watermelon when they have softened slightly. Place the cubes in a serving bowl and garnish with pepper.

Random Ingredients: wild rice,italian sausage,beef brisket,canola oil,butter cracker,ginger,chunky salsa
title: Santa Fe Smoked Beef Brisket
ingredients: 1 beef brisket | 1/3 cup canola oil | 4 ounces chunky salsa | 1/2 bag wild rice | 4 slices ginger ( thin ) | 1/2 lb sweet italian sausage | 2 tablespoons butter crackers
instructions: Trim fat from brisket and rub salt on all sides. Rub brisket with canola oil. Rub sausage over brisket and sear on a rack over a grill set over high heat until meat thermometer reads 140 degrees, about 15 - 20 minutes for medium rare and 140 degrees for medium well. Transfer brisket to a warmed platter. Heat remaining canola oil in a large skillet over medium heat until it shimmers. Add wild rice and ginger to skillet and saute until aromatic, about 2 minutes. Stir in brisket, salsa and 2/3 cup water. Simmer covered for 15 - 20 minutes without removing lid. Discard any that haven't simmered. Remove pan from heat and cover tightly with foil. Let stand 10 minutes. Remove foil from brisket and stir rice mixture. Serve in the warm platter. Accompany with crackers.

Random Ingredients: nonstick cooking spray,pecorino cheese,yellow pepper,oyster sauce,shiitake mushroom,green bell pepper
title: Stir Fry of Vegetables
ingredients: 1 cup shiitake mushroom, sliced thinly | 1/2 cup nonstick cooking spray | 1/4 cup pecorino cheese, grated or 1/4 cup parmesan cheese | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 cup green bell pepper, coarsely chopped | 1 cup yellow pepper, coarsely chopped
instructions: Heat nonstick pan over medium heat. Add mushrooms. Stir fry for 3 - 5 minutes or until just beginning to soften. Remove from pan. Spray with nonstick cooking spray. Stir in cheeses. Stir fry veggies for 2 - 3 minutes or until tender crisp. Add oyster and green peppers. Stir fry another minute or so to heat through.

Random Ingredients: single cream,peanut oil,ruby red grapefruit juice,fine breadcrumb,green olive
title: Prawns with Grapefruit, Olive, and Fresh Cream
ingredients: 500 g medium prawns or 500 g medium prawns, peeled | 4 tablespoons peanut oil | 1/3 cup fresh single cream | 3 tablespoons ruby red grapefruit juice | 1/3 cup fine dry breadcrumb
instructions: Cut prawns into 1cm pieces. Heat oil in a saucepan over high heat, and saute prawns, stirring, for 2 mins, then stir in the single cream. Reduce heat to medium, and simmer for 5 mins or until prawns are pink and cooked through. In a bowl, combine grapefruit juice and fine breadcrumbs. Drain shrimp in a colander over a bowl, reserving liquid. Stir through cream, and then add prawns and breadcrumb mixture. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: brown rice,tart apple,garlic powder,red onion,lard,liquid smoke flavoring,beef chuck roast,iceberg lettuce
title: Apple Beef Sandwich
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless beef chuck roast | 1 cup cooked brown rice | 4 teaspoons garlic powder | 6 teaspoons liquid smoke flavoring | 3 1/2 - 4 cups iceberg lettuce, finely shredded | 1/2 cup red onion, finely chopped | 1/2 cup tart apple, very thinly sliced
instructions: Trim fat from beef and cut into 1 1/2 inch chunks. Place in large nonstick skillet. Add remaining ingredients. Cook, partially covered, over medium high heat, tossing occasionally, until rice is very tender, about 4 hours. Serve in rolls.

title: Gorgonzola-Apricot Salad
ingredients: 300 g gorgonzola, crumbled ( about 1/3 lb ) | 4 ounces apricots, halved lengthwise and halved | 1/4 cup pine nuts | 4 ounces black olives, halved lengthwise and pitted | 1 small stalk celery, finely chopped | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper, to taste
instructions: Place cheese, fruit, nuts and olives in a salad bowl, and sprinkle with cayenne. Toss to mix. Serve.

Random Ingredients: black olive,beef bouillon cube,avocado,bok choy,end thing vegetable broth,pepperoni,romaine lettuce,basmati rice
title: Sopa De Albondigas (Arroz-Style Rice)
ingredients: 4 cups end-os devil's food basmati rice, cooked and drained ( or other long grain rice ) | 4 teaspoons beef bouillon cube ( instant granules ) | 1 large beef tomatoes, cut into six slices | 1 avocado, peeled and cut lengthwise into six pieces | 12 leaves bok choy, roughly chopped | 10 black olives, halved ( use jersey and greek if available ) | 1 package pepperoni, sliced ( or any other hard salami ) | 1/2 cup shredded romaine lettuce
instructions: Toss the rice with the bouillon granules in a large bowl until well coated. Add the tomato, avocado, and bok choy and toss.
