Stir the bulgogi into the rice mixture, and serve immediately. In a large salad bowl, pour boiling water over the pepperoni and lettuce. Cover and refrigerate for at least one hour before serving. Serve the rice over the pepperoni.

title: Sauerkraut
ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter, plus more to dot | 12 ounces ground meat, browned and drained ( see notes above ) | 6 -12 ounces beef gravy | 4 kaiser rolls, split
instructions: Preheat grill to high. Grease a 3 1/2 to 4 quart sauerkraut. Form the meat into 12 patties. Lightly brown the patties on both sides in butter. Transfer patties to the grilling pan set over medium heat. Turn the patties over as needed to brown on all sides. Once cooked through serve the sauerkraut along with the meat on the kaiser rolls.

Random Ingredients: rom tomato,coriander leaf,cucumber,tomato green chilies,ham,pepper sauce
title: Hara Bhara Kebab
ingredients: 5 roma tomatoes, chopped | 4 tablespoons chopped fresh coriander leaves | 3 tablespoons chopped cucumbers, peeled and finely chopped | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1/2 teaspoon finely chopped seeded tomatoes with green chilies | 6 tablespoons cooked ham, crumbled
instructions: Mix the tomatoes, coriander leaves, cucumber, hot pepper sauce and ham together. Pour into a serving bowl and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chipotle pepper,veal,almond extract,allspice,red enchilada sauce,lemon wedge,mint leaf
title: Mexican Meatballs With Lechos Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 lb ground veal | 1/4 cup chopped mint leaf | 1 tablespoon chopped blanched almond ( optional ) | 3 -4 canned chipotle peppers, minced | 3 tablespoons red enchilada sauce | 1 teaspoon pureed chipotle pepper | 1/4 teaspoon allspice | lemon wedge ( to garnish )
instructions: In a bowl, combine the ground veal, mint, almond, chipotle peppers, chile enchilada sauce, pureed chipotle enchilada sauce, and allspice. Mix well. Form into 1 1/2 inch diameter meatballs and arrange on a lightly greased baking sheet covered with parchment paper. Bake at 350ºf for 25 - 30 minutes, or until cooked through. Serve with lemon wedges.

Random Ingredients: oat,beef bouillon cube,sea salt,msg,apple,fennel bulb,romaine lettuce heart
title: Roasted Beef, Fennel and Apple Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 lb apple, thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 3 cups romaine lettuce hearts, torn into bite size pieces | 1 teaspoon ground fennel bulb | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 1/2 teaspoon msg | 1/4 cup oats
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees. Place apple slices on baking sheet.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,vegetable broth,cheese,clear honey,orange peel,red bell pepper
title: Honey Veggie Soup
ingredients: 2 ounces red bell peppers, seeded and halved | 4 tablespoons vegetable broth | 1 tablespoon clear honey | 1 orange peel, finely chopped | cayenne pepper, to taste | grated cheese, to serve
instructions: Place the bell pepper, vegetable stock, honey & orange peel into a saucepan. Bring to the boil then reduce to a simmer. Simmer a few minutes until the peppers are just tender, season to taste with cayenne pepper then taste. Serve with grated cheese on the side.

Random Ingredients: cider vinegar,radish,active yeast,extra virgin olive oil,rump roast,blueberry,caster sugar
title: Cider Glazed Beef and Cranberry Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 2 1/4 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 1 1/2 cups cider vinegar | 1 1/2 cups caster sugar | 2 1/2 ounces fresh rump roast ( about 1-1/2 a chuck ) | 4 -6 large radishes, trimmed, halved, halved and very thinly sliced | 1 1/2 cups cranberries
instructions: Put oven rack in the middle position and preheat the oven to 450°f heat the oil in a medium saucepan over medium high heat until foaming, 8 to 10 minutes. Add the yeast and sugar, whisk to combine, then whisk in the vinegar, caster sugar, and 2 - ½ cups of water. Stir until the liquid has dissolved. Add the roast and bring to a boil. Cover and remove from the heat. When cool enough to handle, break off pieces into 1½ to 2 inch pieces and transfer to a shallow metal bowl. Brush or spray the beef lightly with olive oil and sprinkle with salt. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside in a warm spot without drafts or drafts, until all of the water has cooled to room temperature and the beef is tender enough to stretch but not break, about 1½ to 1 - ¼ hours. Toss the mixed salad with 1 ­tablespoon of the glaze and arrange on a platter. Cover with plastic wrap and transfer to the oven. Roast until the corned beef is medium rare, 3 – 5 minutes. Transfer the roast to a cutting board and set aside to rest for 15 minutess. Shred the meat coarsely, discarding any excess fat, if any remains, and serve on the mixed salad. Note that the salad will seem like it is too crumbly.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,cinnamon,green cardamom pod,bread crumb,italian sausage,maraschino cherry,black bean,lemon peel
title: Italian Sausage and Bean Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh bread crumbs | 1 pound sweet italian sausage | 3 green cardamom pods, slightly crushed | 1 lemon peel, grated | 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed | 12 fresh maraschino cherries | 1/3 cup white wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons ground cinnamon
instructions: Place bread crumbs in a large bowl, stir in sausage. Add cardamom, lemon peel, black beans, cherries, vinegar and cinnamon, toss until evenly coated. Cover and refrigerate several hours to develop flavors. Stir before serving.

title: Taco Seasoning for Vegetables
ingredients: nonstick cooking spray | 2/3 cup fat free frozen whipped topping, thawed | 1 tablespoon fat-free low-sodium taco seasoning, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Spray the inside of a 3 1/2 or 4 quart baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Spread thawed whipped topping into the prepared dish. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon taco seasoning over the hot whipped topping. Bake for 15 minutes. Remove from oven.

title: Texas Shrimp
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs shrimp ( peeled, thawed, tails on ) | 1 can pico de gallo picante sauce | 1 lb stewing beef, trimmed
instructions: Place beef in large skillet. Cover and cook over medium high heat on top of the stove for 15 minutes. Remove from heat. Drain juices, reserving liquid. Place shrimp in a large slow cooker. Pour picante sauce over the shrimp. Cover and cook on low 7 - 8 hours or on high 4 - 5 hours. Serve over rice. The shrimp can be frozen in plastic bag in the freezer. To defrost, transfer the shrimp to a bowl and cover with hot water. This will keep the shrimp moist and pliable overnight. Do not drain the shrimp. Note, i prefer to serve the shrimp on the side. I use fresh pico de gallo sauce as a garnish, but my husband assures me that i will use the pico de gallo sauce that is in the pantry. It does not recognize the name of the pantry.

title: Guatemalan Pork and Cheese Rolls
ingredients: 1 package fresh yeast | 3/4 cup green salad | 1/4 cup sugar or 1/4 cup splenda granular | 1/2 cup serrano chilies or 1/2 cup canned jalapeno chilies, minced | 1 vanilla bean ( optional )
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in 1/4 cup warm water. Add the sugar or Splenda. Dissolve the chilies in the water, then add to the yeast and sugar solution and mix well. Add the remaining 2 cups warm water. Mix well and set aside 1 hour or until bubbly. Scrape off the yeast and discard, then put in a medium sized pot. Add the chilies and vanilla bean, if using, and stir together. Add the remaining 1 3/4 cups warm water, stirring gently until smooth. Scrape down the side of the pot as needed to prevent the mixture from drying up. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and leave a warmium temperature over night. Turn the dough out onto a floured board. Roll to about 1/4 inch thick. Use a sharp knife to cut into 4 inch long strips.. Place the bread on wax paper or parchment paper and cover. Let rise again in a warm place until doubled in bulk. Heat grill to medium heat. Brush rolls with warm oil and grill until light brown on both sides. Serve hot.

title: Chocolate Chip-Havana Dip
ingredients: 1 container chunky chocolate chip | 3 tablespoons low-fat yogurt | 1 tablespoon low-fat worcestershire sauce | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1/2 teaspoon taco sauce | 1 cup cheese, shredded ( i use colby jack )
instructions: Scoop chips into small glass bowl, and crush chips with flat side of knife or fork. Pour in yogurt, worcestershire, cardamom and taco sauce. Stir well, and top with cheese. Heat in microwave for 15 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Curried Pastry for Sunchhi
ingredients: 2 packages frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1 -2 teaspoon curry powder
instructions: Remove the frozen puff pastry sheets from the freezer. Heat the oven to 375°f. Unfold the thawed pastry sheets and using a 2 1/2'' fluted cookie cutter, cut out round circles from the pastry sheets to make 6 rounds. Place the rounds on a baking sheet. Sprinkle the curry powder over the top of the pastry. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes. Serve immediately with lemonade, or sweet and sour sauce. Variation, add a little raisins or chopped peanuts to a few pieces of choped or sliced pistachios when the pastry is baking. I've had luck at the curry.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,safflower oil,philadelphia cream cheese,beef steak,lime,port wine,ricotta cheese
title: Safflower Beef Roll-Ups
ingredients: 2/3 cup safflower oil | 1 package philadelphia sour cream cheese | 3 tablespoons port wine | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1 tablespoon finely diced lime rind | 1 package shredded sirloin steak | 1/4 cup grated deli-style ricotta cheese
instructions: Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. In a medium bowl, combine sour cream, port and tomatoes with chilies. Add lime rind.

title: Brandy Pizza
ingredients: 1 homemade pizza crust | 1/4 cup brandy | 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 1 teaspoon spicy tomato sauce
instructions: Preheat oven according to pizza crust instructions. In a small bowl blend brandy, garlic paste and tomato sauce. Brush onto pizza crust with brandy or olive oil. Place in a preheated oven and cook for five minutes, then remove to baking sheet. Cut pizza into four squares and serve.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,white mushroom,monterey jack cheese,philadelphia cream cheese,spring onion
title: Mushroom Cheese With Mushroom Crumb Topping #6
ingredients: 4 ounces philadelphia cream cheese, softened | 8 ounces grated monterey jack cheese | 1 bunch chopped spinach leaves, cooked or 1 bunch butter | 1 -3 tablespoon chopped spring onion ( to garnish ) or 1 -3 tablespoon scallion ( to garnish ) | 3 cups graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat broiler to high and position a rack 6 inches from heat. In a large mixing bowl combine cheese and cream cheese until well blended, add in mushroom filling and mix until filling is smooth. Stir in sour cream if using as a filling. Sprinkle chopped spinach over filling. Spoon onto 9 x 9 inch pan and sprinkle with spring onions or scallions. Broil at 450 degrees for 3 - 4 minutes, or until golden brown and bubbly. Let cool and serve with pita chips and tomato salsa for dipping.

title: Tortilla Triangles
ingredients: 1 tablespoon white onion, very finely chopped | 1 hard-boiled egg, very finely chopped
instructions: In a small, dry measuring cup, combine onion and boiled egg. Stir to blend. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto hot fat which has just melted. Leave to set then remove fat by pressing the taquitos with the back of a spoon. Fry over high heat until tortillas turn golden. Be careful to not turn too fast or they will brown too quickly.

Random Ingredients: pita bread,tabasco sauce,mccormick seasoning,spanish onion,water,plum tomato,nonfat milk
title: Spicy Spanish Rice With Dumplings
ingredients: 1 small spanish onion, diced | 1 plum tomato, seeded and diced | 1 cup fat-free evaporated milk | 1/4 cup nonfat milk | 1 tablespoon mccormick's montreal brand steak seasoning | 4 pita bread, cut in half | 1/3 cup boiling water ( for the dumplings )
instructions: Place rice, onion, tomato, evaporated milk, and seasoning in a 3 qt. Dutch oven and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and cook for 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: snow pea,jalapeno chile,salmon fillet,golden rum,marshmallow,yellow bell pepper
title: Jambalaya
ingredients: snow pea | yellow bell pepper | marshmallows | bamboo skewer | sliced jalapeno chile
instructions: Heat grill pan with enough oil to thinly coat it. Seed snow peas, and cut them into 1” lengths. Place 1 tablespoon of snow peas on the hot griddle. Place 1 teaspoon of snow peas on the snow peas. Place 1 teaspoon of sweet bell pepper on the bell pepper, and add approximately 1 - ¼ teaspoons of snow peas. Cover the jalapeno, and close the grill. Cook until snowpeas are bright green, about 20  30 minutes. Remove from heat. Serve jambalaya with your favorite sweet pickle.

title: Sausage and Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 4 links hot italian sausage | 1 cup oyster sauce
instructions: Heat a wok over high heat until very hot. Cook the sausage until browned, breaking off pieces as they cook. Add oyster sauce and cook for 2 more minutes before removing from the heat. Serve with steamed baby potatoes.

title: Carnitas (Carnitas)
ingredients: 12 ounces country style ground pork | 1/4 minced cooking onion | 24 ounces salsa verde | 1 package refrigerated ladyfingers | 12 flour tortillas
instructions: Cook pork& onion till meat is no longer pink. Drain. Add salsa verde and cook till heated. Meanwhile, wrap and refrigerate ladyfingers. Spoon pork mixture over ladyfingers. Place in plastic bag and press to remove air. Refrigerate. Unwrap and serve.

title: Crab Kebabs
ingredients: 1 lb fresh crabmeat, picked over | 3 green bell peppers, chopped | 1/2 cup lime wedge | salt and pepper ( to season )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and mix well. Cover tightly and set aside for 1 hour. Thread crab on skewers and grill over hot coals until lightly browned on both sides.

title: Taste of Home Sweet BBQ Sauce for Chicken Burgers
ingredients: 2 tablespoons barbecue sauce | 1 tablespoon white grape juice | 1 tablespoon curry paste
instructions: Shake ingredients together until well blended and pour over your favorite meat patties. Serve with your favourite bread, vegs or vegetable veges.

title: Tasty Applesauce
ingredients: 2 cans sliced fuji apples | 1 cup apple juice | 1 bottle tabasco sauce
instructions: Remove any core from apples. Drain apple slices well. Place apple slices in a saucepan with apple juice and tabasco. Cook over medium heat for about 3 to 4 minutes, just to warm up apples. Serve over brown rice or brown rice noodles. Can also be consumed as an appetizer with hot mustard or served as a side for other dishes.

title: Indian Breaded Flour Tortillas
ingredients: 3 cups whole wheat flour or 3 cups cornmeal | 1/4 cup white vinegar | 1 egg | 1 serrano chili, minced or 2 teaspoons dried chili flakes | 1 sprig mint leaves
instructions: In a large bowl, mix the flour, vinegar, egg and chile. Add the mint sprig.

title: Peppered Pumpkin (Or Beef) Steak Skewers
ingredients: 600 g chuck steaks, thinly sliced | 4 cups mixed pumpkin or 4 cups winter squash, chunks, cut into chunks | 2 tablespoons oleo or 2 tablespoons soy butter | 12 lemon wedges
instructions: Soak skewers in hot water for about 10 minutes. Place in non metal skewers, and set aside. Cut a small slice from the end of each pumpkin or squash quarter. Make a slit at the back of each to end of the skewer. Make a small cross or other small cut around the meat with a skewer bone about 1cmx 1cm. Pour 2 tablespoons oleo in a large frying pan or saucepan. Heat over medium high heat until bubbling, then add pumpkin and cook for 2 minutes, stirring frequently, or until browned. Stir in remaining ingredients, then cook, stirring, for a further 2 - 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,green cabbage,tomato juice,iceberg lettuce,greek yogurt,edamame,barley,cocoa powder
title: Mexican Barley Cheese Salad
ingredients: 14 1/2 ounces stewed tomatoes with green chilies | 8 ounces edamame, shelled | 1 head green cabbage, shredded | 1/4 cup barley | 1 1/2 cups low fat greek yogurt | 1 1/2 cups tomato juice | 2 tablespoons cocoa powder | 1/2 head iceberg lettuce, shredded | 1/2 cup low fat greek yogurt
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil over high heat. Add barley and stir to toast. Remove from heat and set aside to cool while preparing the rest of the salad. Dice green cabbage and slice edamame, making sure they are about 3/4 inch diameter long. Place cabbage and edamame on a large serving platter. Toss together in small bowl the diced green cabbage, tomatoes, green cabbage/ edamame in with the barley, beans and greek yoghurt. Arrange shredded lettuce in another large serving platter or bowl for a full presentation, as you wish. Pour tomato juice and cocoa powder into the serving platter. Drizzle a small amount of oil into the tomato juice.

title: Baked Beef Tips & Rice
ingredients: 1 jar beef bouillon, liquid reduced to 1 cup | 1 tablespoon butter | 8 ounces cooked rice, uncooked | 1 cup tahini | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | sliced bacon, for a topping ( optional )
instructions: Mix together bouillon and water. Melt butter or margarine in 2 quart casserole or soufflã³ casserole bowl over low heat. Add the rice and beef bouillon liquid to rice and stir, making sure to stir. Spread the tahini on a plate. Place in a 350f oven until slightly browned, about 8 minutes, stirring after every minute. Stir in cream of tahini, a tsp of salt, bacon and seasonings if desired. Spoon rice on plate with some of this sauce on top.

Random Ingredients: mineral water,chunky salsa,grain white rice,serrano pepper,chicken stock powder,kaiser,raisin,tofu
title: Spicy Spanish Rice and Tofu Sandwiches
ingredients: 4 1/2 cups chicken stock powder ( i recommend swanson maggi brand ) | 2 cups long-grain white rice ( jasmin style ) | 14 ounces firm tofu, cut crosswise into 1/2-inch rounds ( abura ) | 6 ounces firm tofu ( abura ), drained cut crosswise into 1/2-inch slices ( abura ) | 1/2 cup raisins | 2 ounces chunky salsa | 2 tablespoons filtered light tasting mineral water | 4 kaiser rolls | 4 serrano peppers, seeded and thinly sliced ( may use red jalapeno peppers )
instructions: Cook rice according to package instructions. Drain and put rice in a bowl, leaving some oil in it. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add 3/4 cup water to the skillet and once it boils, stir the rice around for about 1 - 2 minutes or until it begins to soften but not melt into lumps. Add the rice, stirring to evenly coat the bottom of the skillet. Place the abura bread on a plate or baking sheet. Sprinkle a few grains of white rice over the bread and place a row of slices of firm tofu or abura each on top of the rice. Spoon some chunky salsa over the tofu and sprinkle with raisins. Cover the tofu with a line of sliced chile peppers. Cover with a line of sliced serrano peppers. Using a metal spatula, spread 1/4 cup water into both the baking sheet or baking sheet. The water will not dissolve.

Random Ingredients: clove,sea scallop,white miso paste,mussel,marsala wine,oatmeal,colby monterey jack cheese,vodka
title: Scallops and Mussels in Miso and Marsala
ingredients: 6 large cooked mussels | 1/3 cup oatmeal | 6 sheets rolled oats | 1 1/2 ounces vodka | 3 1/2 ounces good quality unseasoned white miso paste | 12 clove, unpeeled | 8 ounces colby-monterey jack cheese, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup sweet marsala wine
instructions: Place mussels in a large saute pan with enough water to cover. Add oatmeal and oats. Cover and cook over medium heat for 5 minutes. Remove mussels from pan with a slotted spoon and place in a serving bowl. Add vodka, miso paste and cloves to pan. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes, stirring frequently. Meanwhile, divide cheese evenly among mussels. When cheese is melted, spoon sauce over mussels, spreading evenly. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: barley,bamboo skewer,nonstick cooking spray,topping,cranberry,miracle whip,rye flour
title: Cranberry BBQ Beef Kebabs
ingredients: nonstick cooking spray | 1/4 cup barley, uncooked | 1/4 cup raisins or 1/4 cup dried cranberries | 1/4 - 1/2 cup miracle whip or 1/4-1/2 cup corn syrup | 4 cups fat-free whipped topping | 12 thin bamboo skewers, soaked in water for 30 minutes, drained
instructions: Heat grill plate to medium high. Coat grill with cooking spray. Combine barley, raisins and syrupy miracle whip. Divide the filling into 12 portions. Thread skewer pieces onto skewers. Brush with cooking juice. Grill kebabs, brushing occasionally with any remaining marinade, 7 - 8 minutes. Serve on hot buns.

title: Nori Bento
ingredients: 12 pieces tortillas | 8 cooked chicken wings | 1 bunch nori ( seaweed ), cut in half
instructions: Heat up a pan using low to medium heat. Place one piece of nori in the pan. Turn the nori once so it is face down. After a few minutes, turn the nori to the side. Wash the chicken wings and slash the skin all over. After a few minutes, turn again. Wrap the nori around the wings, covering it completely. Add the nori in to the pan with the chicken. Add salt and chili powder to taste. Cook uncovered until the chicken wings are tender.

title: Lettuce & Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 small aubergine, peeled & cubed | 2 leeks, white part only, diced | 500 g red potatoes, unpeeled & diced | 500 g ricotta cheese | 1/4 cup prepared horseradish | 1 tablespoon prepared horseradish | 1 head iceberg lettuce, to serve | 1 lemon peel, to garnish
instructions: Boil the aubergine & leeks for 10 - 12 mins until tender. Drain & cool. Drain potatoes & place into a large bowl with the leeks & drained aubergine. Mix well, season well & refrigerate covered for 20 mins before serving. To make the horseradish cream, combine the ricotta, horseradish & freshly grated lemon peel. Add the chopped iceberg lettuce & chill. Wash & dry the lettuce & cut into chunks. Serve a wedge of lemon on a bed of dressed lettuce, then drizzle over the horseradish cream.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,raspberry,curry powder,green chilies,spanish onion
title: Lighter Raspberry Curry
ingredients: 2 cups fresh raspberries or 2 cups frozen raspberries ( 30-40 raspberries depending on size ) | 3/4 cup spanish onion ( or a small onion ) | 1 can diced green chilies | 1 tablespoon curry powder | salt and black pepper
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine sour cream, green chiles, curry powder and raspberries, stirring until well mixed. Add seasoning mix and mix well. Serve at once.

title: Cheese Toasts
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tomato puree | 1 1/2 teaspoons five-spice powder | 1 cup aged cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat the broiler. In a small bowl, stir together the tomato puree and the spice powder. Pour half the tomato puree mixture into a shallow baking dish just large enough to hold all the pieces of cheese. Spread the cheese on top of the tomato puree. Arrange the rest of the tomato puree in a single layer and place under the broiler until the cheese has melted and begun to turn brown. Allow the toasts to cool slightly, then cut in half and serve.

title: Korean Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 lb steak | 1 package rice vermicelli | 1 package frozen mixed nuts, thawed | 1/4 cup golden raisin, minced | 1/4 cup finely chopped onion | 1 1/2 tablespoons ketchup | 1/4 teaspoon tarragon
instructions: Cut steak into thin strips. Cook in a skillet until the desired doneness is achieved. Let meat cool before trimming. Boil vermicelli according to package directions. Drain, rinse well and set aside. Coat a large salad bowl with cooking spray. Add all of the rest of the salad ingredients and toss to coat. Serve on lettuce leaves with a sprinkle of the spice mixture.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,curd,plum tomato,salmon,enchilada sauce,eggplant,sesame seed,corn syrup
title: Chilean Fish Ceviche
ingredients: 1 eggplant, peeled | 1/2 cup corn syrup | 1 can diced plum tomatoes, drained | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 5 ounces canned enchilada sauce, any flavour | 1 tablespoon light dry curds, any flavour | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Wash eggplant and slice into 1/4 in rounds. Spray a shallow baking dish or round serving dish just as it heats up. Cut tomato into quarters and add to baking dish. Add 1 1/2 tbsp of curry paste to the tomato mixture then pour half into the dish. Add the rest of curry paste over the tomato mixture then add enchilada sauce to the dish. Mix the dark and light dresed ceviche sauce with the curd. Spread it over the tomato mixture mixture then sprinkle sesame seeds across the top. Bake for 25 minutes.

title: Stoup Pot's Spring Rolls
ingredients: 12 volpi fresh egg noodles | 1/2 cup cucumber, chopped | 1 turnip, chopped | 1/4 cup mixed dried porcini mushrooms ( available in speciality grocery stores )
instructions: Cook noodles in salted boiling water until al dente and drain well. In a medium bowl of cold water, rinse noodles. Mix thoroughly with cucumber, turnip, and mushrooms. Heat in microwave for a few seconds until hot but not boiling. Do not allow pan to smoke. Spoon a little into each bowl. Serve while piping hot.

title: My Favorite American Pizzaiola
ingredients: 1 lb round steak, round or 1 lb chuck | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 package pizza crust | 1 jar vinegar ( either red or white )
instructions: Cut meat into slices or chunks, and season with salt and pepper to your tastes. Preheat oven to 500 degrees f. Brush pizza crust with oil or melted margarine and line them with meat. In small bowl combine vinegar and garlic powder until well combined. Pour mixture over meat and bake in preheated oven for approximately 20 minutes, or until meat is browned and no longer pink inside.

Random Ingredients: chili garlic sauce,salt,spaghetti sauce,cheese,beef,kernel corn,shiitake mushroom
title: Chinese Spaghetti
ingredients: 3/4 pound lean ground beef | 1 jar spaghetti sauce | 1 teaspoon dry chili-garlic sauce | 1 package shiitake mushrooms, sliced | 2 cans whole kernel corn, drained | 1 teaspoon salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a 9x13 inch baking dish, mix ground beef, spaghetti sauce, chili garlic sauce, mushrooms and corn. Bake in preheated oven for 35 to 40 minutes, or until hot and bubbly. Stir corn mixture.

title: Salmon for 2
ingredients: 2 lbs salmon fillets | parsley
instructions: Pre heat oven to 300 degrees. Cut salmon fillets approximately 1/2 inch thick. Rinse with cold water. Bake for 35 minutes for rare or 30 minutes for medium. Turn fish and continue baking for 40 minutes, turning a few times. It will get slightly puffed out because the salmon is usually quite soft when it flakes easily with a fork remove from heat. Drain any fat of the pan off of the fish using a spoon. Mix the 2 tablespoons with a tablespoon or so of the oil from the salmon cooking pan and then divide evenly among the four plates. Sprinkle the chopped parsley and serve.

Random Ingredients: granny smith apple,allspice,beef bouillon cube,curry paste,artichoke heart,cake flour
title: Apple Curry Soup
ingredients: 2 cups cubed granny smith apples | 32 ounces marinated artichoke hearts, drained | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 1 teaspoon curry paste | 1 teaspoon allspice | 3 cups cake flour
instructions: Place all ingredients in a heavy bottomed pot. Bring to a boil then cover. Set to simmer for 25 hours until the curry is fragrant and the apples are tender. Remove all solids, except for the artichoke hearts, and add artichoke hearts to pot. Puree mixture until smooth in a blender or food processor. Place back on top. Serve with warm pita bread.

title: Italian Bread Coated With Broth and Pecorino
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups bread flour | 1 cup pecorino romano cheese, shaved | 6 cups boiling broth
instructions: In an 8 or 12 cup pot with a steamer insert fitted with a basket, place the flour, cheese and boiling broth. Whisk until very smooth. Place pot over medium heat. When bubbly add the cheese mixture, whisking constantly until well combined. Continue to simmer for several minutes. To check for readiness, pour out of the pan and pour into a large casserole dish. Use this time to warm up your favorite bread.

title: Easy Baked Italian Chicken
ingredients: 1 can chicken or ( 10 ounce ) can pinto beans | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 1 tablespoon sliced almonds, if desired | 1 roma tomato | 1 banana
instructions: Place chicken/beans in skillet and add remainder of the ingredients. Cook on medium heat until lightly browned. Turn heat to low and cook for about 45 minutes covered with lid, if not cooking right away you may use your lid on pan for some other reason. It might not cook all the way down, if it doesn't, let it cook uncovered for another 15 minutes or until chicken/beans/pinto can be browned. Cut tomato into large chunks and place on top of chicken/beans. Re cover and let cook for 10 minutes. Serve with bread or french bread slices.

Random Ingredients: cake flour,ranch dressing mix,beef rib,half cream,black sesame seed
title: Slow Cooker Oriental Short Ribs
ingredients: 2 pounds beef short ribs, cut in half | 1 cup half-and-half cream | 1 cup ranch dressing mix | 1/4 teaspoon ground black sesame seed | 1/4 cup cake flour
instructions: Combine short ribs, half and half cream, ranch and sesame seeds in a slow cooker. Cover and cook on high until the short ribs are tender, 4 to 6 hours. Dust with cake flour. Turn slow cooker to low.

title: Gramma's Tomato Raisin Sauce
ingredients: 15 ounces canned tomato sauce ( like san marzano brand ) | 1/2 cup raisins | 1/4 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Mash raisins with ginger and garlic paste. In a 2 1/2 quart saucepan, mix tomato with raisins. Bring mixture just to a boil over medium flame, stirring occasionally. Reduce heat and cover. Simmer gently 20 minutes. Uncover, stirring occasionally. Serve warm.

title: Spicey Caesar Salad
ingredients: 1/3 cup all-purpose flour | 2 cups lettuce, torn | 1 container cappatappi pasta | 1 lime, cut in wedges | 2 cups romaine lettuce | 1/4 cup grated romano cheese
instructions: Mix flour and dressing ingredients well. Refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours, tossing occasionally. Line serving platter with lettuce, top with pasta and romaine. Sprinkle with romano just before serving.

title: Creamy Creamy Pea and Pear Dip
ingredients: 300 g frozen small peas ( thawed ) | 200 g cream cheese
instructions: Put the frozen peas into a microwave safe bowl, cover with cling wrap, and microwave on high for 45 seconds. Mix the cream cheese with a fork to combine. Spoon the cream cheese into a microwave safe bowl, and microwave on high for 2 full minutes until it starts to thicken. It should take a minute or two on high to thicken. When fully heated, remove the cling wrap, place it in the fridge, and leave until the cream cheese is completely cold. Stir the peas into the cream cheese mixture until coated well. Serve immediately.

title: Paprika and Corn Salad (South Africa)
ingredients: 2 corn, whole, unpeeled ( i use frozen, defrosted, unsalted ) | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 -2 jalapeno, deseeded and diced | 1 tablespoon smoked paprika ( sweet or hot ) | 1/2 teaspoon good quality cavados ( optional ) | 5 -6 ounces goat cheese
instructions: Place chopped fresh corncobs in a bowl with cold water to prevent them from bleeding, then rinse with cold water to remove some of the water. Cut kernels from cobs with a grater or in a food processor or blender.

title: Easy Lasagne
ingredients: 600 g beef mince | 30 -35 pre-made flour tortillas
instructions: Place oven proof lasagne dish in oven until very hot.

title: South African Sinterk Family Breakfast Mince Patties
ingredients: 450 g raw mince | 300 g bread, crumbs | 200 g self-raising flour, mixed with | 300 ml of simmering water
instructions: Place the bread crumbs in a bowl. Add the mince and mix with your hands until it is completely coated. Knead in the flour. Turn onto a lightly floured surface and form into 8 small balls. Heat a flat non stick frypan with a bit of oil. Roll out each ball of mixture into a thin round, about 6 inches in diameter. Cook over a moderate heat for about 2 - 3 minutes on each side until light brown. Serve hot.

title: Potato Parfait
ingredients: 50 g potato | 4 -5 tablespoons milk chocolate
instructions: Drain the potatoes and, using a large spoon, press out tiny browned bits from the bottom so they can get to the bottom. Do this on kitchen paper and place in a dish covered with plastic wrap or wax paper. Preheat the oven to 180°c or 180°c if you have a fan oven but i used my convection oven. Bake for around 50 minutes, checking when the top of the potatoes are soft and starting to give off steam. Remove and allow to cool, then cut into finger sized pieces. You will need to let the parfaits cool just a minute or two before removing them from the paper. Melt the chocolate then either pour the melted chocolate onto them or spread over the parfait and spread them around before serving. They can be served with ice cream if you want, just dip into a bowl of warm plain whipped cream.

Random Ingredients: tabasco sauce,tomato green chile,milk,fish fillet,raspberry,salt pepper,baby carrot
title: Baked Fish With Raspberries
ingredients: 2 fish fillets, cut into serving pieces | 2 cans diced tomatoes with green chiles | 125 g baby carrots, peeled and thinly sliced | 1 cup fresh raspberries | 1 can evaporated milk | salt & pepper, to taste | tabasco sauce, to taste
instructions: Place fish in a large pan or baking dish and pour over water to just below boiling point. Cover and cook slowly for about 10 to 12 minutes, depending on the size of fish. Check occasionally, adding more water if necessary. If the water level drops too close, cover loosely and set aside for five minutes uncovered. Place carrots in a saucepan with water and a tbsp of salt and bring to the boil. Boil for 5 to 10 minutes or until just tender. Drain and set aside. Remove fish from pan and place on a serving platter. Add tomatoes, raspberries, milk, salt, pepper, and tabasco sauce to the pan. Stir, then pour over fish. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: farfalle pasta,irish whiskey,fennel seed,kiwi fruit,extra virgin olive oil,coffee powder
title: Kiwi Berry Feijo
ingredients: 12 ounces dried farfalle pasta | 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1/2 cup irish whiskey | 1/4 cup instant coffee powder | 1 teaspoon dried fennel seeds or 1 teaspoon dried fennel seed | 1 kiwi fruit, peeled and cut into segments
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling salted water for 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,cherry tomato,milk powder,green pepper,caper,mirin,vegetable
title: Tomato-pepper Spread
ingredients: 1/4 cup drained capers | 1/4 cup cherry tomatoes, cut in half | 1/2 medium green pepper, diced | 1 teaspoon vegetable or 1 teaspoon butter | 1/3 cup milk powder | 1/3 cup grated pecorino romano cheese | 1 tablespoon mirin
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in a mixing bowl. Add milk and cheese. Mix well. Chill well before serving.

title: Cheese Quesadillas or Tampiquues and Chips.
ingredients: 1 1/3 cups part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded ( or more of the same quantity ) | 1/2 cup tamari, sauce made into a paste with water
instructions: In a small bowl, add the mozzarella cheese and tamari.

Random Ingredients: rom tomato,dill,granny smith apple,egg noodle,hard egg,tilapia fillet,bay leaf,hot water
title: Tilapia in Apple Juice
ingredients: 2 lbs tilapia fillets or 2 lbs sirloin fillets, cut into bite-size chunks | 14 fluid ounces chopped roma tomatoes | 14 fluid ounces canned diced fire-roasted tomatoes | 1/4 teaspoon dried dill | 2 bay leaves | 1 package of cooked medium egg noodles or ( 5 ounce ) package egg noodles | hot water | rom tomato
instructions: Start cooking your egg noodles. In a large saute pan, add just enough of your favorite vegetable oil to coat the pan. I use a ziploc bag for this. Brown your tilapia in oil on both sides, then dump into pan. Sprinkle each piece with dried dill and let cook until fish is browned. After fish is browned, stir in your sauteed tomatoes, fire up chopped dill, and bay leaves. Let simmer in a low simmer for 30 minutes until the liquid has reduced and everything is bubbling. When your fish is done, drain off any excess oil. Place your cooked egg noodles in a large serving bowl. Add your cooked tilapia, sauce and roma tomatoes. Toss and let it all stand for a few minutes, then top with plenty of hot water. Serve in individual soup bowls with grated roma tomatoes and lemon wedges. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: enchilada sauce,farfalle pasta,pea,five spice powder,greek olive,mozzarella cheese,chicken stock powder,chicken bouillon
title: Gourmet Noodle Salad
ingredients: 3 ounces farfalle pasta or 3 ounces elbow macaroni | 1 cup frozen peas, thawed or 2 cups fresh peas | 2 -3 tablespoons chicken stock powder | 2 -4 tablespoons chicken bouillon, to taste | 1 teaspoon five-spice powder or 1 teaspoon allspice | 1 container enchilada sauce, any size | shredded mozzarella cheese, garnish | 10 pitted greek olives, garnish
instructions: In a large cooking pot, add the pasta and peas into boiling water to cover. Cook for 5 - 6 minutes or until soft. Drain, rinse with cold water and drain again. Place cooked pasta in large serving dish. Combine remaining ingredients in saucepan. Turn heat to low.

Random Ingredients: breakfast sausage,chicken tender,rice,red wine,black olive,bourbon,corn oil,mozzarella cheese
title: Chicken, Sausage, & Rice Ole Ole
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked instant rice ( i use instant ) | 1 1/2 lbs ground chicken tenders | 1 1/2 lbs breakfast sausage, crumbled | 4 ounces dried black olives, sliced | 1 1/2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese | 2/3 cup bourbon | 1/2 cup corn oil ( or sunflower seed oil ) | 1/4 cup red wine
instructions: Prepare instant rice according to package directions. In a large skillet, cook sausage over medium heat until browned. Add cooked rice and toss until combined. Stir in chicken, olives, and cheese. Cook over medium heat until cheese is melted. Add bourbon and mix. Pour mixture into a 9x13 inch baking dish and spread evenly. Top with red wine. Cover and bake in a 325° oven for 45 - 50 minutes, or until rice is tender and hot. Let stand for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Macaroni With a Curry Flavor and Crunch
ingredients: 2 cups macaroni, uncooked | 2 teaspoons garam masala, divided | 4 teaspoons pepper | 1 -2 teaspoon almond extract ( depending on taste ) | 1 packet graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Cook macaroni as directed on package. Do not overcook. Set aside to cool. In a medium bowl, put the other 2 teaspoons garam masala, pepper and almond extract and mix well. Set aside. Put the macaroni into a bowl and pour in the mixture. Stir to coat the pasta well. Sprinkle graham cracker crumbs on top. Top with more graham cracker crumbs. Tastes better when the last minute is up.

title: Texas Oktoberfest Sausages
ingredients: 2 lbs medium sauerkraut, drained and rinsed | 8 fluid ounces sweet and sour sauce | 8 fluid ounces irish whiskey | 2 fluid ounces vinegar | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 tablespoon minced fresh italian parsley
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large mixing bowl, mixing with your hands. Mold into 1 inch slices. Arrange on a baking sheet and bake in a preheated oven until lightly browned, about 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: mango powder,vegetarian bean,new mexico chile,penne pasta,anise oil,dill
title: Pasta With Lentils and Mango
ingredients: 10 ounces dried penne pasta | mango powder ( store bought or bought ) | red new mexico chile | dill | 1 teaspoon anise oil | vegetarian baked beans
instructions: Put a wok on medium high heat. Add anise oil to the wok. Add lentils and chile anise spice. Sauté on high for 5 minutes. Meanwhile cook the penne pasta in plenty of water. Add the penne to the wok and mix. Add lentils and chile anise to the pasta. Toss until pasta is al dente and lentils and chile anise infused are hot and starting to turn golden. Serve with some bread or enjoy with a cold beer.

Random Ingredients: provolone cheese,artichoke heart,brown bean sauce,white flour,bread,molasses
title: Baked Artichoke Hearts with provolone
ingredients: 10 artichoke hearts, fresh | 2 tablespoons white flour | 4 tablespoons brown bean sauce | 1 tablespoon molasses | 2 slices low-fat provolone cheese, sliced thin | 1/4 cup bread, finely chopped ( rye bread, such as ciabatta )
instructions: Puncture fresh artichoke hearts in two, and set aside. In a small bowl, combine flour and brown bean sauce, and molasses.

title: Sweet Apple Salsa
ingredients: 1 green apple - peeled, cored and shredded | 1 banana pepper, chopped | 1 jar chunky salsa | 1 cup apple juice
instructions: In a bowl, mix the shredded apple, banana pepper, salsa and apple juice. Cover and refrigerate in the refrigerator for at least 20 minutes to let flavors blend.

title: Roasted Parsnips With Lentils
ingredients: 1 kg parsnip, peeled and cut into wedges | 1/3 cup light maple syrup | 1/2 cup low-fat half and half cream ( to taste ) | 125 g brown lentils, rinsed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c/fan 160c/gas slice the parsnips on the angle into 1cm/thick rounds on a baking tray. Place onto oven trays lined with baking paper, bake for 20 minutes then remove from the oven when the parsnips have softened. Whilst the parsnips are baking, place a saucepan the maple syrup and half and half in a small pan and bring to the boil, simmer for about 1 minute, and keep warm. Boil for 5 minutes, remove from the heat and drain any liquid from the cooked parsnips. Stir the cooked lentils into the maple syrup and then transfer to a large bowl. Spoon the cooked parsnips over the lentil mixture and scatter over the parsley. Serve warm.

title: Papas a la Huancaína
ingredients: 3 tablespoons corn oil | 3 -4 tablespoons grated cotija cheese ( or other mild white cheese )
instructions: Heat the oil and comal over low heat in a frying pan. When pan is hot, stir in the cheese and keep stirring until the cheese has almost completely melted.

title: Yemenite Naan Bread for the Bread Machine
ingredients: 1 teaspoon instant yeast | 2 tablespoons warm water | 1 tablespoon dried jalapeno chile ( chopped ) | 4 cups bread flour, divided | cooking spray | 1/3 teaspoon saffron
instructions: Combine yeast and warm water. Let proof 10 minutes. Add chilies, 1 cup flour, and yeast mixture to bread machine in order to make the bread into a loaf. Cover with a light sprinkling of flour, cover, and set on the dough cycle. When cycle is finished, preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Spray baking sheet with cooking spray. On a floured board, roll out the remaining 1/2 cup flour to make a thin patty. Cut into 6 pie shaped pie shaped naans. With floured fingers, press the thin patties into the prepared bread pan. Brush top of crust with an egg wash. Sprinkle with saffron, if desired, then bake at 450 degrees f for 7 to 10 minutes or until lightly crusty. Remove and cool.

Random Ingredients: avocado,taco seasoning mix,bird eye chile,red chili powder,cocoa,olive,dark rum
title: Holy Mexican Guacamole
ingredients: 1 avocado, peeled, pitted & sliced | 1 1/2 ounces dark rum | 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 4 -6 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa | 1 -2 tablespoon mild red chili powder | 1 bird's eye chile, minced | 1 -2 tablespoon olives or 1 -2 tablespoon sliced pimento stuffed olive, minced
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Mix well. Serve.

title: Solo African Okra and Spinach
ingredients: 18 okra, chopped | 1 cup arborio rice | 2 teaspoons ground poppy seeds | 1/2 cup tomato sauce | 1/2 cup cocoa
instructions: Bring a pot of water to a boil. Cook okra in boiling water until tender, about 5 minutes. Drain. Heat tomato sauce and cocoa over low heat until hot. Pour tomato sauce over okra.

title: Portuguese-Style Black Beans & Pork Loaf
ingredients: 1 jar black olives, drained and finely chopped ( not in season ) | 2 lbs country-style sandwich bread, cut diagonally into 6 thick slices | salt pork | 1 1/2 cups canned kidney beans, drained & washed, well-rinsed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Grease 9 by 5 by 3 loaf pan with pam. Tear bread slices into 1 inch pieces and lightly coat with pam. Toss pork pieces in bread and roll in olives until coated with bread/olive mixture. Toss in beans and then arrange in a single layer in pan. Cook on middle rack of oven for 1 hour, or until meat thermometer reads 170°f and loaf is light golden brown and crusty on top.

Random Ingredients: macaroni,dijon mustard,orange juice zest,yellow pepper,blackberry,chicken breast half,wine vinegar,kahlua
title: Blackberry, Macaroni and Chicken Salad
ingredients: 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 1/2 cup dry macaroni | 2/3 cup orange juice, freshly squeezed | 1/4 cup dry wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons dijon mustard | 1 teaspoon grated orange zest | 3 whole hulled blackberries | 2 large yellow peppers, cut into thick strips
instructions: Cook the chicken breasts in a skillet over medium heat until no longer pink in the center and the juices run clear, about 20 minutes. Cool the chicken, reserving the cooking liquid, and slice into strips. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Bring a saucepan of lightly salted water to a boil. Add in the pasta and cook until tender, about 12 minutes. Drain the pasta and return to the pan with the chicken. In a bowl, whisk together the orange juice, vinegar, mustard and zest. Pour over the chicken and pasta, and toss to coat. Sprinkle with blackberries and peppers to serve.

Random Ingredients: apple,vanilla bean,avocado dip,corn oil peanut,ginger paste
title: Applesauce Avocados
ingredients: 1 large ripe avocado | 4 tablespoons prepared apple-flavored dip | 2 teaspoons corn oil or butter | 2 teaspoons ginger paste | 1 vanilla bean, split down center
instructions: Peel the avocados, remove the pit. Slice 1/2 inch from the other end of the avocado and pull out the inside and skin. Cut the avocado in 1/4 thick slices. Using a tablespoon or so, scoop out the pulp from the avocado's exterior to a medium size bowl. Stir together the dip and ginger paste in small bowl. Pour about 1/2 cup of the dip mix into the avocados and toss to coat evenly. Fill a medium large skillet with lightly salted water and bring to a boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the vanilla bean and return to a boil. Once the water is boiling, stir in the remaining dip mix and remove from the heat. Toss the avocado slices with the remaining dip and serve with whipped cream, ice cream or sour cream. Yum.

title: Red Onion Rings and Anchovies
ingredients: 1 small red onion | 2 tablespoons anchovy fillet, mashed
instructions: Finely dice the onion. Place the onion into a sieve, sprinkle with salt and weight up with a large mixing bowl. Shake the bowl to squeeze out the excess water. Put back on the sieve over the onion and use your hands to mix inches. Put the anchovy into a small bowl to use as a table garnish.

title: Guatemalan-Spiced Harissa
ingredients: 2 1/2 tablespoons ground caribbean habanero pepper ( habanero powder ) | 1/4 cup cilantro | 1/4 cup ground mace | 1 1/2 tablespoons amaretto ( almond flavored liqueur ) | 1 can chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 1/4 teaspoon chipotle chile, minced
instructions: Combine habanero, cilantro, mace, amaretto, chickpeas, and chipotle chile in a blender or food processor and process until smooth. Store in refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,lemon peel,pastry crust pie,button mushroom,self rising flour
title: Mushroom Tarts
ingredients: 1 ready-made pastry, for a 9 inch double crust pie | 1 1/2 cups button mushrooms, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon peel, grated, divided | 3 tablespoons fresh italian parsley, minced | 1 cup self rising flour, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Place 1 ready made pie crust into a 9 inch tart pan. In a mixing bowl, combine mushrooms, 1 tablespoon lemon peel and parsley and set aside. Sprinkle flour over mushroom mixture, then stir 1/2 cup cold water into flour mixture until dough comes together. Turn out onto a clean countertop, knead several times and form into a ball. Place 1 dough ball into crust and lightly press dough out to a 5 inch circle. Bake in preheated oven until golden brown, 15 to 20 minutes. Remove from oven and place into a serving bowl. Cut remaining pastry dough into 1 squares and place on top. Cut steam vents in the pastry by using a sharp knife. Spoon mushrooms, lemon peel, parsley and 1/2 cup cold water over each tart. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: celery root,pistachio,pecorino romano cheese,cooking oat,icing sugar
title: Pistachio Biscuits
ingredients: cooking oats | 1/2 cup icing sugar | 1/2 cup unsalted pistachio, finely ground | 1 piece celery root, peeled and finely grated | 1/2 cup chopped pistachios
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In a large bowl, whisk together the icing sugar and pecorino romano until well blended. Stir in the dry ingredients. Spoon equal amounts of the biscuit mixture onto a greased cookie sheet. Use your hands to press them firmly together. Bake 20 - 25 minutes or until tops are nicely browned. Cool on wire rack. Store biscuit in an airtight container.

title: Mexican Green Bean and Broccoli Quesadillas
ingredients: 1/2 lb green beans | 1/2 lb fresh broccoli, cut into florets | 4 flour tortillas | 2 1/2 tablespoons sugar
instructions: Put the green beans and broccoli in a blender and process for a minute or two on high. Add the sugar and process for 30 seconds on high to reduce the sugar and add the broccoli/broccoli mixture. Spread the mixture on one half of each tortilla and top with the other half of the tortilla. Cut into quarters and serve with sour cream and salsa.

title: Tomato Paste
ingredients: 14 fresh thyme sprigs | 28 ounces chopped tomatoes
instructions: Remove the stems of the thyme by smashing the leaves first. Bring all ingredients to a boil in a large pan. Reduce heat, and stir often to prevent sticking. Allow to boil 15 - 20 minutes until thick paste consistency. Transfer the paste to a jar with a tight fitting lid. Let mellow for up to a week.

Random Ingredients: palm sugar,bamboo shoot,sultana raisin,bicarbonate soda,fusilli,wine,clear honey,green bean
title: Pastira Salad
ingredients: 10 ounces fusilli | 6 ounces mixed green beans | 10 ounces bamboo shoots | 7 ounces mixed fresh herbs, chopped | 2 ounces sultana raisins | 2 tablespoons clear honey | 1/4 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1/4 cup wine
instructions: Cook the pasta till cooked, drain, then place in a large bowl with the beans, sprouts, herbs and raisins mixed with the honey, the soda and wine. Toss well. Serve warm or chilled.

title: Ginger and Bacon Glazed Porks
ingredients: 6 ounces salt pork ( minced ) | 6 ounces ginger juice | 2 tablespoons caster sugar ( superfine )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the pork and ginger in a large skillet and slowly bring to boiling point stirring continuously. Reduce to simmer gently and briskly cook for about 1 hour or until reduced and pork is well browned and tender. Allow to stand for 10 minutes before carving thinly.

Random Ingredients: chicken thigh,asiago cheese,arborio rice,banana,mexican oregano,rice noodle,cherry,prosciutto
title: Chicken With Fruit Salsa - Rachael Ray
ingredients: 1/2 cup asiago cheese, finely grated | 1 cup arborio rice | 1/2 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut into thin bite sized strips | 1 medium banana, cut into thin bite sized slices | 1/2 teaspoon mexican oregano, freshly ground | 1 tablespoon fresh diced fruit ( like raisins, chopped fresh cherries, chopped peaches, bananas, etc. ) | 1/4 cup asiago cheese, finely grated | 1/4 cup dried cherry ( optional ) | 1/4 cup cooked rice noodles
instructions: In a heavy saucepan, heat up the asiago until it becomes smooth, stirring as each step of the rice begins to melt into a light golden brown color. Add the chicken and cook for 3 minutes. While chicken is cooking, combine 1/2 cup of the red cheese, rice, and oregano. When the chicken has finished cooking, add it to the rice mixture and stir until it is well mixed and the rice is evenly distributed. Stir in the banana. In a small bowl, combine the additional 1/2 cup of red cheese and 1/4 cup of chopped dried cherries, or just enough to moisten the mixture evenly, and stir until creamy. After the chicken has finished cooking, add to the rice mixture. Cook until heated through, stirring occasionally. Serve immediately over fresh, warm rice noodles.

title: Homemade Crumbs
ingredients: 12 ounces fresh italian breadcrumbs | 2 teaspoons italian seasoning
instructions: Combine the bread crumbs and seasoning in a medium bowl and stir until fully incorporated. Spread onto a board and divide into 36 pieces. Roll each piece out to 1 inch thickness on a floured board. Cut into 4 or 5 small squares, then cut each circle with a sharp knife or drinking glass. Repeat with remaining pieces. Spray a cookie sheet with nonstick spray and set up your hot frying pan. Drop your dough squares into the hot pan. Cook each piece for 2 to 3 minutes on each side, they should not turn golden brown. Remove from the hot skillet and immediately roll in a bag of confectioners' sugar. Store in a plastic bag that has been lightly moistened with a light coating of oil until ready to use.

title: Crescent Pinwheels
ingredients: 1/2 - 2/3 cup goat cheese | 1/2 cup fresh mushrooms, sliced | 12 crescent dinner rolls, warmed | 2 teaspoons prepared horseradish | kosher salt, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degree f. Using a 10 x 15 inch greased sheet pan, generously grease the bottom and up the sides with butter or margarine. In a small bowl combine cheese, mushrooms and horseradish. Using a large fork spread horseradish mixture onto the crescent roll dough making sure to spread out evenly. Lay out the dough in an even rectangle, top with cheese mixture and place crescents on top of cheese. Starting about 1 inch from the outside edge, roll up crescents and pinch the ends tightly. Transfer to a parchment paper lined baking sheet and bake for 8 - 10 min or until golden brown. Serve hot with your favorite garnishes.

title: Wasabi and Shrimp Chicken
ingredients: 8 ounces boneless skinless chicken breasts | 8 ounces shrimp paste | 1/4 cup wasabi powder | 2 cans artichoke hearts
instructions: Heat your oven to 400'. Spray a dutch oven or oven safe nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Cut chicken and shrimp into bite sized pieces. Remove most of the fat from the pan. Mix wasabi powder and shrimp paste until the shrimp paste dissolves. Add chicken and shrimp, and stir to coat. Pour 1/2 of broth into pan, then pour the rest. Put the pan in your freezer for 30 min or longer, or if you are planning on eating it right away. Put on lid, and bake in 350' oven for 1 hour, then turn off the oven and allow to sit for 30 min or longer. When i take it out, i drain the broth with a fork, then transfer to a measuring cup and put into freezer, then wait until hard, and then slice.

Random Ingredients: cardamom,olive oil,rice wine,cremini mushroom,chickpea,cashew half,brown rice flour
title: Cashew and Mushroom Fried Rice for One!
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice flour | 1/2 cup rice wine, sherry or 1/2 cup mirin, warmed to warm | 1/4 cup cashew halves or 1/4 cup almonds | 1 pinch ground cardamom | 1 pinch ground turmeric. can use less | 3 1/2 ounces cremini mushrooms ( or button mushrooms ) | 1 tablespoon olive oil
instructions: In a large bowl mix all ingredients together well. Heat a skillet and add the olive oil, then add mushrooms and cook for about two minutes. Remove the pan from the heat and add the rice mixture and mix well. Let the mixture sit for about 20 minutes. Then make sure the rice has enough time to absorb the flavors.

Random Ingredients: apple cider vinegar,apricot,active yeast,brown rice,corn chip,sesame seed,italian plum tomato,black bean
title: Zesty Italian Black Beans
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups dried black beans, sorted and rinsed | 1 can italian plum tomatoes, crushed in a little food processor | 5 1/4 tablespoons apple cider vinegar | 2 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 4 1/2 cups brown rice, uncooked | 4 1/2 tablespoons corn chips | 4 1/2 tablespoons sesame seeds
instructions: Combine first 8 ingredients, stirring well. Cover and let rest at room temperature for 2 hours, or until ready to use. To serve,. Drain and rinse beans. Add to rice mixture, and mix well. Toss in the corn chips and sesame seeds.

title: Faux-French Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf bread | 2 cartons chicken stock | oregano
instructions: Toast bread. Rub with oil. Sprinkle with oregano.

title: Grilled Yellow and Red Pepper Chips
ingredients: 16 yellow bell peppers | 8 tablespoons lemon pepper
instructions: Preheat grill. Brush both sides of peppers with lemon pepper. Grill peppers over indirect heat for 15 to 20 minutes, or until charred. Serve warm.

title: Pistachios With Sherry or Pecans
ingredients: 8 ounces shelled pistachios | 4 tablespoons dry sherry
instructions: Peel and chop pistachios into 2 inch pieces. Mix with 1 tablespoon sherry. Heat a frying pan or skillet. Sprinkle pistachios with sherry and toast about 2 minutes, shaking the pan once or twice.

title: Sicilian Beef Noodle Crock Pot Recipe
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef chuck, trimmed and cut into 3/4 inch cubes | 1/2 cup liquid honey | 2 teaspoons lemon peel, grated | 4 ounces dried farfalle pasta, cooked and drained
instructions: Place all ingredients except beef in crock pot. Cover and cook on low 8 - 10 hours. When ready to serve, stir and serve.

title: Gingerbread Spice Mix
ingredients: 1/2 cup unsweetened chocolate | 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder, sifted
instructions: Combine all ingredients well. Store in a tightly closed jar in a dark place.

Random Ingredients: no salt tomato paste,baby spinach,beef roast seasoning,red curry paste,raspberry,green chilies

title: Beef Steak Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons peanut oil or 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 3/4 cup superfine sugar | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 1/2 teaspoons white sugar ( optional )
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet. Remove from heat and stir in 3/4 cup of the superfine sugar. Stir until dissolved. Put the beef bouillon cube into the skillet and add in sugar. Stir so the bouillon cube covers the meat enough to almost pat any browned particles off of the beef. Allow the bouillon to dissolve, then leave to simmer for 15 minutes. Drain meat well of any excess grease from the skillet and discard the bouillon cube. Cut meat into slices, then set aside. instructions: In a large bowl, combine the ketchup, parsley, cardamom, lemon juice and pepper. Add the tomatoes and ham. Toss lightly to coat the salad.

instructions: In a large bowl, cook pasta according to package directions. Drain, and rinse with cold water. Cover, and refrigerate. In a large bowl, combine the lettuce, cucumber, carrot, goat cheese and walnuts. Stir in alfredo sauce. Add cooked pasta, and toss well.

title: Spiced Fig Jam

title: Easy Onions

instructions: Place sliced onion in a microwave safe bowl. Cover with aluminum foil.

title: Beef Stew in Pasta Shells

title: Zippy Cucumber Salad

instructions: Cut the cucumber lengthwise into thin slices. Sprinkle with water and leave to soak for 30 minutes or longer drain. Place the cucumber slices in a colander and leave. Toss the cucumber with the tahini and flour, then add the dill to your liking. Serve straight away.

title: Snow Pea and Pernod Appetizer

title: Agua

title: Spicy Fried Chile Prawns

Serve with ketchup or barbecue sauce in. Serve with butter and a salad.

instructions: In a large bowl, mix the warm water.

title: Choco-Mate'

Place on a jelly roll pan and bake for 25 minutes. Sprinkle ¾ cup of the shredded potatoes on top and let stand for 3 minutes. Spread ¾ cup of the shredded potatoes on top and fold up.
