Random Ingredients: beer,ketjap manis,cannellini bean,aioli,masa harina flour,sirloin,yellow pepper
title: Beef Hash (Anguilla)
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin | 1 1/2 ounces masa harina flour | 1/2 cup aioli, sauce | 1/3 cup ketchup | 1 small yellow pepper | 1 jar of undrained cannellini beans | 1/4 cup beer or 1/4 cup water
instructions: Cut sirloin into cubes. Heat a medium saucepan over medium high heat, add oil. Brown beef. Pour in aioli sauce, then add the beans, cook for 2 minutes. Place meat and bean mixture with aioli sauce into a crockpot and add beer or water. Cover and cook on high for 2 to 3 hours.. Serve with homemade corn tortillas.

title: Toasted Corn Chips
ingredients: 1 tablespoon crushed corn flakes | 1/2 teaspoon sweet paprika | 1 teaspoon ground coriander leaves | 2 large ripe avocados, peeled cut into thin wedges | 1/2 cup peanut oil | 12 slices rye bread | 1 cup torn coriander leaves
instructions: Toast corn flakes in a dry nonstick skillet over medium heat, stirring, until golden brown. Set aside on a plate lined with paper towels to cool. Toast paprika in skillet until fragrant, 30 - 60 seconds to 1 minute. Add coriander and toss to mix well. Serve drizzled with avocado.

title: Tangerine Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 2 tangerine juice | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Let the flavors blend.

Random Ingredients: nut,white bread,rum extract,avocado,asafoetida powder,apple,parmigiano reggiano cheese,cooking spray
title: Smooth Asafoetida Toast
ingredients: 1/4 cup white bread, stale ( crust removed ) | 1 tablespoon rum extract | 1 1/2 teaspoons asafoetida powder ( optional ) | cooking spray | 1 small apple, finely chopped | 1/4 cup mixed nuts, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons parmigiano-reggiano cheese, freshly grated
instructions: Position broiler rack 5 inches from heat and preheat broiler. In bowl, soak bread in rum extract for 3 minutes. Place bread on paper towels and rub to remove excess moisture. Place on cookie sheet and lightly toast in preheated oven until golden, about 3 minutes, and transfer to a plate lined with paper towels to drain. Toast can be made 2 hours ahead and kept, loosely covered, at room temperature. Makes 2 servings.

Random Ingredients: ener egg substitute,chipotle pepper,portabella mushroom cap,dijon mustard,ricotta cheese,limeade concentrate
title: Creamy Risotto
ingredients: 1 portabella mushroom cap | 3/4 cup ricotta cheese | 2 packets hidden valley & reg ; original ranch & reg ; dijon dressing | 1 egg substitute | 1 teaspoon chipotle pepper | 1/2 tablespoon ener-g egg substitute ( for egg wash )
instructions: Rinse the mushroom cap, and pat dry. Cut the cap into 3/8ths, lengthwise, then slice each quarter in half to expose the stuffing inside. Combine the ricotta cheese, salad dressing mix, chipotle pepper, and eggs in a small bowl, stirring well. Divide the stuffing between the 3/4 cup ramekins. Arrange the mushrooms in the ramekins, spoon in more stuffing if desired, and top with more stuffing if desired.

title: Brunch in the Wine
ingredients: 1 cup riesling wine | 1/2 cup fresh blueberries or 1/2 cup frozen blueberries | 1 teaspoon prepared horseradish | 1 tablespoon fennel seed, toasted
instructions: Pour all the ingredients except the fennel seeds in a saucepan and bring to a boil, reduce the heat, simmer 5 minutes. Strain into a small bowl, cover, set aside to keep warm. To make the bruchetta, combine the fennel seeds and franks in a dry frying pan, toast over moderate heat, stirring, for 1 to 2 minutes, then remove from the heat. When cool rub the berries all over the bruchetta, shaking off most of the excess. Cover and store in an airtight dish at room temperature for 2 days. Bring to room temperature before serving.

Random Ingredients: no salt tomato sauce,red wine,black pepper,swiss chard,mint leaf,mushroom,garlic paste
title: Swiss Chard Chard Saute
ingredients: 1/2 cup red wine or 1/2 cup beef broth | 2 cloves garlic paste | 8 ounces swiss chard or 8 ounces other greens | 1/2 lb mushroom | 1/2 cup no-salt-added tomato sauce ( i use no added tomato paste ) | 2 tablespoons fresh mint leaves, minced | freshly ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat the broth with garlic in a large skillet or wok over medium to medium high. Add mushrooms and chard. Simmer until chard is tender, about 3 to 5 minutes. Add the tomato sauce and cook for 1 minute. Add mint and pepper. Cook one minute longer, or until desired consistency is achieved.

Random Ingredients: parsley,flat leaf parsley,beef bouillon granule,baby portabella mushroom,apple cider vinegar
title: Sauerkraut
ingredients: 2 lbs baby portabella mushrooms | 1 tablespoon parsley | 1 tablespoon flat leaf parsley | 1 teaspoon apple cider vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon beef bouillon granules
instructions: Clean the mushrooms and rinse thoroughly under cold running water. Remove and discard outer caps. In a small bowl, combine the mushrooms, parsley, parsley, vinegar, & bullion, stir to combine. Cover and refrigerate for 8 hours or overnight. Serve warm, or refrigerate for up to 2 days before serving.

Random Ingredients: brown onion,red pepper,cheese,clam,brownie mix,pork roast,vanilla bean,cream chicken soup
title: Grilled Pork Sandwich
ingredients: 1/2 lb pork roast | 1/2 lb clams | 16 slices cheese ( mozzarella, provolone, cheddar ) | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 3 tablespoons soft brownie mix | 2 tablespoons brown onions, chopped | 1 tablespoon red pepper, chopped or 2 teaspoons chili powder | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla bean ( optional )
instructions: Combine cream of chicken soup, brownies, onions, chili powder and vanilla bean. Stir well and pour over meat in a shallow dish. Cover and refrigerate 8 hours or overnight. Remove from oven, uncover, and allow to rest at room temperature about 30 minutes. Grill meat and serve with sauce.

title: Gorgonzola Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb gorgonzola | 2 -3 cups vegetable oil
instructions: Cut the cheese into small cubes. Heat a large frying pan and add the oil, add in the cheese and keep stirring until the cheese turns golden brown, then remove and put on a plate covered with paper towels to drain off the excess oil. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: ketchup,icing sugar,basil pesto,baking powder,vegetable stock,gelatin,filet beef,self rising flour
title: Grilled Fillet of Beef for Two
ingredients: 4 sheets veggegan icing sugar | 4 teaspoons ketchup | 400 ml vegetable stock, heated | 1 tablespoon icing sugar | 1 teaspoon gelatin, dissolved in | 1 1/2 tablespoons boiling water | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 375 g filet of beef | 200 g self-rising flour | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1 tablespoon basil pesto
instructions: Cut the beef lengthways into 3 cm slices, brush with the ketchup. Place one piece on a piece of clingfilm and cover with the icing sugar, leaving enough space to spread. Fold the cling film over and place in the fridge for 10 minutes or until the beef is well chilled. Heat the vegetable stock and dissolve the icing sugar in the heated vegetable stock. Spread half of the mixture over the beef slices and place on a foil lined baking tray and sprinkle with half the biscuits. Repeat the layering process with the remaining beef, making 4 stacks. Whisk the icing sugar and gelatin, place the flour in a bowl and make a well in the centre. Pour in all the stock from the beef and pour the mixture into the well. Mix to combine and use your hands to make a sticky dough. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes to set. Dust the beef with icing sugar and grill for 8 - 10 minutes or until just cooked through. Serve with pesto.

Random Ingredients: marzipan,wide egg noodle,cilantro leaf,celery rib,yellow squash,icing sugar
title: Noodle Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces wide egg noodles, rinsed and drained | 1 yellow squash, thinly sliced | 1 large celery rib, thinly sliced | 1/3 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 2 tablespoons marzipan or 2 tablespoons other dairy-free spreadable cheese spread
instructions: Cook noodles in salted boiling water 3 minutes,. Drain and cool slightly. In a large bowl, combine squash, celery, cilantro and icing sugar. Add cooled noodles and cheese spread. Toss. Refrigerate 30 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: zucchini,bean,grain rice,broccoli floret,garlic salt,yellow pepper,cream tartar,italian parsley
title: Italian Veggie Rice Bowl
ingredients: 1 cup short grain rice, i use brown rice | 1 large zucchini ( sliced into rounds ) | 2/3 cup broccoli floret | 2/3 cup zucchini ( sliced into rounds ) | 1 yellow pepper ( sliced into rounds ) | 2 tablespoons fresh parsley ( chopped ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 2 tablespoons italian parsley ( chopped ) or 2 tablespoons fresh basil ( chopped )
instructions: Saute diced tomatoes in a saucepan or large frying pan. Cook zucchini, broccoli, and red pepper on medium heat for about 3 minutes. Add rice and vegetables and cook for an additional 3 - 5 minutes stirring to mix frequently. Remove from heat and add cream of tartar and or italian parsley. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: oil,walnut,chili pepper flake,caper,coffee,chicken broth,ra el hanout spice mix,pepper
title: Ras El Hanout Moroccan Hot Sauce
ingredients: 3 tablespoons oil | 1/4 cup raisins ( optional ) | 1/4 cup walnuts ( toasted and coarsely chopped ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground pepper ( or more to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes ( crushed pepper, or to taste ) | 2 tablespoons strong brewed coffee | 1 1/2 tablespoons hot capers ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon ras el hanout spice mix ( more or less to taste )
instructions: In a small skillet, toast the walnuts over low heat, shaking the skillet frequently. Remove the walnuts, and grind in a food processor with the hot pepper. Add the remaining ingredients and process until smooth, about 20 seconds. Transfer about 1/4 cup of sauce into a small saucepan, and bring to a simmer over medium low heat. Do not boil. Simmer until slightly thickened. Serve at room temperature. Store remaining sauce in a bowl, covered, in the refrigerator. Do not freeze/heat sauce.

title: Barbequed Meat from Scratch
ingredients: 3 lbs of your favourite cuts of beef, or use 4 pounds of sliced deli meat | 1 red onion, cut into large chunks | 1 bottle of la victoria steak spice tabasco sauce
instructions: Cut beef into large chunks or whatever sized you want. Place in crockpot with onions. Mix in tabasco. Cook on high for 4 hours. Serve with mashed potatoes or a salad. Enjoy.

title: Terrific Oatmeal
ingredients: 1 cup quick-cooking oats | 1 cup chicken stock or 1 cup vegetable stock | 2 bunches romaine lettuce
instructions: Mix oats and stock. Bake 350f for 15 minutes let cool. Wash lettuces and tear. Place lettuce on tray. Place tater tots on lettuce. When slightly cool, pile onto lettuce and bake for 1 - 2 minutes until lettuce just starts to crisp, remove from oven.

title: Radicchio Relish
ingredients: 2 lbs radicchio | 2 tablespoons whiskey | 1 pinch asafoetida powder
instructions: Trim the radish and discard the hard stems. Slice the radish into slices about 1/4 inch thick, 2 - 3 inches long. Combine the whiskey and asafoetida powder. Brush this mixture on the radish slices, then pour the mixture over the radish slices. Let stand for 10 minutes, then refrigerate for at least 1 hour.

title: Shrimp and Tacos
ingredients: 1 lb shrimp, peeled, deveined and rinsed | 7 taco shells
instructions: Bring a small amount of water to a boil. Add shrimp and shells and boil 1 - 2 minutes. Serve with guacamole and sour cream for dipping.

title: Indian Ricotta Soup
ingredients: 1 can whole skim milk ricotta cheese | 2 large green cardamom pods
instructions: Combine all ingredients in pot and cook at medium heat until all ingredients are hot and cheese is melted. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: cornmeal,yeast,flat leaf italian parsley,lemon juice zest,cinnamon raisin bread
title: Stout Bread
ingredients: 1 cup cornmeal ( plus a little extra for the baking sheet ) | 1/4 cup flat-leaf italian parsley ( plus extra for serving ) or 1/4 cup fresh flat-leaf italian parsley ( plus extra for serving ) | 2 1/2 teaspoons dried yeast | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1 cinnamon raisin bread ( cut into 1-inch slices ) or 1 other bread, loaf ( cut into 1-inch slices )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Butter a large baking sheet or cake pan, and scatter with cornmeal, then add the bread slices. Sprinkle with the dried thyme and any optional herbs. Cover loosely with a towel, and let stand for 10 - 15 minutes. While the bread is standing, mix the lemon rind and juice with a fork, and add to the bread, tossing to coat well. Remove the bread from oven, and bake in a preheated oven for about 15 - 20 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly. Serve with cinnamon raisins, if you have them on hand. Also good spread with butter or margarine, if you like.

Random Ingredients: jasmine rice,taco seasoning mix,lime juice,sherry wine,red chili pepper,bamboo shoot,blueberry,beef
title: Beef & Berry Stuffed Red Bell Peppers
ingredients: 1 package of chopped beef | 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 2 cans blueberries, drained | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained | 2 tablespoons lime juice | 3 tablespoons sherry wine | 12 large red chili peppers ( green or yellow can be substituted ) | 1 cup jasmine rice
instructions: Brown diced beef in a large skillet. Drain. Add taco seasoning mix. In a large bowl, mix meat with blueberries and bamboo togther and set aside. Slice the peppers into 1/8´´´´´´ rounds. Toss the rice into bowl containing meat and cheese and coat with tortilla wrap and bake in oven @400°f for 10 minutes. Remove from oven. In a hot skillet, add some oil, chili, lime juice and sherry and saute until slightly thickened. Add a 1 packet of taco seasoning, salt and pepper to taste. Add 2/3 of the sauteed veggies with meat. Fill peppers with the beef mixture. Cover and place in oven on low, for 15 minutes. After 15 minutes or until peppers are done, add remaining chopped veggies and bake for 10 more minutes.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno chile pepper,cardamom,wheat bread,black pepper,trout,tomato puree,lime wedge,pie crust
title: Trout Encrusted (Oamc)
ingredients: 2 fresh jalapeno chile peppers | 4 slices whole wheat bread, cut into small cubes | 1 pie crust | 1 cup canned crushed tomatoes in tomato puree | 1/4 cup coarsely ground black pepper | 1/2 cup chopped seeded peeled fresh tomatoes | 3 tablespoons chopped seeded unseeded fresh jalapeno chile peppers | 2 tablespoons lime wedges, for garnish | ground cardamom, for garnish
instructions: Trim ends of jalapeno chili peppers, and remove seeds. Slice peppers lengthwise. Line a 9 inch rimmed baking sheet with 2 or more of the sliced peppers. Cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate pepper slices until chilled, about 30 minutes. Line two 9 inch glass pie pans with half the of the pie crust. Place the bread cubes in a large bowl and add the tomato puree, 8 cups water, black pepper, 1/2 cup jalapeno chiles, lime juice, fresh tomatoes, 1 tablespoon jalapeno chile pepper flakes, 1 tablespoon jalapeno chile powder, and the remaining 1 tablespoon jalapeno chile powder. Mix well and pour mixture into the prepared pie crust, filling to within 1 inch of the rim. Cover the pan with plastic wrap, and refrigerate overnight. Pour the remaining tomato puree into a large skillet over medium heat. Bring to a boil, then remove from heat and stir in the remaining jalapeno chile powder, 1 tablespoon jalapeno pepper flakes, 1 tablespoon lime juice, 1/8 teaspoon cardamom, and the remaining 1 teaspoon jalapeno pepper flakes. Place the partially opened pepper halves into the prepared pie crust and cover with plastic wrap, then foil. Refrigerate until all the tomatoes are pulverized, at least 1 hour. Remove the pastry from the refrigerator and cool before serving.

title: Black-Eyed Pea Dip
ingredients: 1 can condensed tomato juice | 1 package processed cheese, cubed | 1 cup sour cream | 1 1/2 tablespoons molasses | 1 package frozen black-eyed peas
instructions: Place the tomato juice, processed cheese, sour cream, and molasses in a microwave safe bowl. Mix well. Place the black eyed peas into a microwave safe bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Microwave on high for 3 minutes, or until hot and bubbly. Remove the microwave and pour the dip into a serving dish. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: curd,italian sausage link,parmigiano reggiano cheese,lemon,pizza crust,lemon zest
title: Elegant Pizzas
ingredients: 1 lb italian sausage link, casings removed | 1 tablespoon grated lemon zest | 1 loaf frozen puff crust, thawed | 2 tablespoons prepared grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese ( about 1/2 to 1/2 cup ) | 1 lemon, cut into slices, for garnish | 1/2 cup small curd
instructions: Preheat the pizzas pan on the stove top or preheat the pizza stone at 500 degrees f. Grease one side of each pizza crust. Place the italian sausage in a large skillet over medium heat. Remove the casings from the sausage and crumble into the skillet, breaking them into pieces as they brown. Add the lemon zest and reduce the heat.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,coconut oil,onion,apple cider,apricot jam,broccoli floret,ziti pasta
title: Cabbage-Ziti
ingredients: 4 tablespoons apple cider | 1 tablespoon coconut oil | 1 small onion, diced | 1 small yellow bell pepper, diced | 2 cups broccoli florets | 1 ziti pasta | 1/3 cup apricot jam
instructions: Mix cider and coconut oil together in a skillet. Add onion, bell pepper, and broccoli.

Random Ingredients: mint,mustard,mustard powder,sesame seed oil,rice vinegar,coconut milk,fettuccine
title: Coconut-Rice Noodles With Mustard
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 cup light coconut milk | 1/4 cup mustard, wholegrain, wholegrain or 1 tablespoon mustard powder | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/2 teaspoon sesame seeds oil | 1 teaspoon bread salt or 1 teaspoon coconut powder | 2 teaspoons mustard ( wholegrain or mustard powder ) | 4 tablespoons rice vinegar ( or sweet rice vinegar ) | 1 teaspoon sesame seed oil | 12 ounces fettuccine
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk coconut milk with 2/3 cup water. In a small cup, stir together mustard, sesame seeds and 1 tsp mustard powder until combined.

title: Homemade Ricotta Cheese
ingredients: 2 cups homemade ricotta cheese or 2 cups homemade cottage cheese | 1 tahini ( sesame oil or similar )
instructions: Place the ricotta block in the refrigerator covered, stirring occasionally until its fully drained. In a food processor mix the sesame oil and 1 cup of the cream cheese blend until creamy, adding up to 1/2 cup more cream cheese, until you have a smooth cheese consistence you want. Add the salt to taste. Once creamy, pour it over your drained ricotta. If you need more of the cream cheese, just add it back in to thicken. Store in the refrigerator, it will harden as it sits but it does turn a darker green color.

Random Ingredients: corn tortilla chip,beef roast,button mushroom,green olive,vanilla essence,mango
title: Aussie Peppercorn Beef Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup green olives, pitted, chopped | 1 tablespoon mango, chopped | 1/4 cup button mushroom, chopped | 1/4 cup corn tortilla chips | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence | 3/4 lb beef roast, sliced thin
instructions: In bowl, combine all ingredients except roast and tortilla chips. Add beef and coat well. Heat medium skillet, add beef and brown well. Pour off fat. Pour over chips and garnish with tortilla chips.

title: Turon (Persian Sausage) for Christmas Kebabs
ingredients: 1 lb sweetcorn, frozen | 3 dried mint, soaked overnight soaking sprigs in warm water and finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice
instructions: Place thawed sweetcorn in shallow container with a lid. Cover with warm water and let stand overnight. Using your fingers or a rolling pin, remove the pulp from the drained sweetcorn and mash with a grinding fork. Return mash to container and stir in the dried mint. Cover and refrigerate overnight, stirring every so often. Cut into 1½ inch thick slices. Thread onto metal or soaked wooden skewers. If using metal skewers, place on a tray, cover and chill for an hour. Brush with oil and brown on both sides. Serve hot with bread.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,kaffir lime leaf,spice,cumin,dark brown sugar,sun tomato oil,topping
title: Creamy Toasted Saffron Soup
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup diced sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 1/4 cup chopped kaffir lime leaf ( about 1 large kaffir lime leaf - 4 small whole kaffir lime leaves ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/2 teaspoon spice mix ( your favourite ) | 1 1/2 cups dark brown sugar | 1/2 cup thickened cream or 1/2 cup light cream
instructions: In a blender or food processor combine all but the cream with the brown sugar and cream, and whirl until combined. Stir into soup in a saucepan over medium low heat. Heat until hot but not boiling, stirring often. Serve with toast points, assorted crudites, or a roll of fresh bread to dip into the soup.

title: Pimiento and Romaine Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup chopped pimiento | 2 bags romaine lettuce or packages spinach leaves
instructions: Mix the pimento and lettuce in a bowl. Add desired amount of dressing. Variation, to add a bit of onion or other citrus to the salad, add sliced olives before serving.

title: Anchovy Eggnog
ingredients: 1 container egg yolk | 3 tablespoons sugar | 1 teaspoon anchovy paste ( optional ) | 1 cup sifted powdered sugar | 3 tablespoons rum
instructions: Beat egg yolks sugar & anchovy paste together, add sifted powdered sugar & mix thoroughly. Serve over crushed ice.

Random Ingredients: thai chile,pork tenderloin,walnut,flour,pecorino romano cheese,chocolate chip,chicken breast half
title: Baked Chicken Chili With Pork
ingredients: 1/2 lb pork tenderloin, cut into 1/8 inch thick strips | 1/4 cup flour | 2 tablespoons ground walnuts | 8 ounces chocolate chips | 2 fresh thai chiles, sliced | 6 whole boneless skinless chicken breasts, halved ( about 1 1/2 pounds total ) | 1 cup dried pecorino romano cheese or 1 cup grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to in bowl, toss pork with flour, walnuts and chiles. Arrange in an ungreased 13x9 inch baking dish. Bake, turning once, for about 45 minutes, or until done. Transfer to serving platter. Wrap loosely and keep warm. Add chicken to baking dish.

title: Crock Pot Mac and Beef
ingredients: 1 package mac and beef penne | 2 cans campbell's tomato soup | 1 box frozen peas ( fresh or frozen ) | 2 pears ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons cocoa | 1 -1 green cardamom pod ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon hot sauce ( to taste )
instructions: Set crock pot to high, then dump all ingredients into crock pot. Stir. Turn crock cooker to low and continue to let it cook for about 8 hours or until mac and beef is falling apart. Drain any fat from the meat and keep it in the crock pot. Topping is now a must. It's the best to set it on warm setting until cooled down to the point where the edges start to curl around the meat and the sauce bubbles. Keep warm until ready to serve with toasted bread.

title: Mock Devonshire Hot Chocolate
ingredients: 400 g dark chocolate | 1 1/4 tablespoons dark red kidney beans ( or other beans ) | 1 cabbage or 1 green cabbage, finely shredded | 2 tablespoons catsup ( ketchup )
instructions: Break up the chocolate into small pieces and place in a microwaveable bowl with a lid, microwave on full power for about 3 minutes or until melted. Pour over the cooked coleslaw and stir. Serve immediately.

title: Pear and Chips
ingredients: 2 pears, halved and cored | 1/4 cup breadcrumbs | 1 package tortilla chips, for topping | 1 tablespoon cooking oil
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Prepare an 8x8 baking dish with cooking spray. Place the pears in a bowl. Crush the chips and combine them with bread crumbs. Roll the pears in crumbs until coated. Heat the oil in a skillet over medium high heat. Place the pears in the skillet, and cook, just long enough to heat through. Place the breaded pears in the oil. Continue cooking until the breaded pears are crisp on the outside. Place in the oven, and serve at once.

title: Quick and Easy Pizza Crust
ingredients: 1 tablespoon instant yeast | 1 unbaked 9-inch pie crust
instructions: Stir yeast into 1/2 cup of water in a small bowl and set aside. Heat the remaining 1 1/2 cups water in a large saucepan over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until warm, about 5 minutes. Stir the yeast into the warm water, add the dough, and set pan over medium heat until bubbly, about 10 minutes. Remove from the heat and let stand 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Stretch out one of the pie crusts on a lightly floured surface, using the remaining 1/2 cup of dough as sculpting it. Spread the dough into the bottom and up the sides of the prepared crust. Poke holes all over the dough with a fork, then brush it with water. Place on a pizza peel. Stretch the edge of the crust and the holes over the dough. Press the crust with a fork, then pull away the crust from the sides of the crust. Repeat until the dough is gone, working with dough to create a round, even circle in the center. Dust lightly with flour, cover with a clean towel, and let sit 30 minutes. Turn the pizza over and stretch remaining dough, pressing down on the rim with a fork to release air pockets, to make a round crust. Transfer pizza to a baking sheet, place in the preheated oven, and bake until light brown and crust is slightly wet with brown, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: sugar,parmigiano reggiano cheese,walnut,lemongrass,graham cracker crumb,lime wedge,anise flavoring,cocoa
title: Lemongrass Pudding
ingredients: 4 cups graham cracker crumbs | 1 cup sugar | 4 tablespoons fresh lemongrass, minced | 1 1/2 teaspoons unsweetened cocoa | 2 cups walnuts, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons anise flavor enhancer ( if unavailable, use 1 tablespoon anise flavored extract ) | 3 tablespoons fresh lime juice or 3 tablespoons lemon juice | parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line a 6 cup soufflé dish with non stick foil and set aside. Combine graham cracker crumbs, sugar, lemon grass, cocoa, nuts, and anise flavor enhancer in a bowl. Make sure each bowl has room for the walnuts, or the walnuts will sink to the bottom. Transfer nut mixture to the soufflé dish. Pour half the lime juice, remaining lime juice, and cheese into the soufflé. Seal dish and place in a baking dish. Pour remaining juice into dish and bake for 45 - 50 minutes or until slightly puffed and lightly browned. Note, if using anise flavoured extract instead of anise, omit the additional 2 tbsp anise flavored extract.

Random Ingredients: white rice,jasmine rice,baking potato,lipton onion soup mix,vegetable oil,red lentil,grain white rice
title: Delicious  Delicious Rice & Lentil Scented Red Lentils-Rice Bake
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 large baking potato, peeled ( medium-sized ) | 6 tablespoons minced fresh rinsed onions or 6 tablespoons onion soup mix | 1 cup jasmine rice | 1 1/4 cups red lentils, rinsed | 1 1/4 cups basmati rice ( yellow or orange, uncooked ) | 2 teaspoons bijol seasoning or 2 teaspoons lipton onion soup mix | 2 cups hot cooked white rice
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f. Heat the oil in a large nonstick frypan over medium high heat. Add the potato and cook, stirring, until it just holds its shape and begins to turn golden, about 2 minutes. Add the onion and cook until it is starting to wilt, about 1 minute. Add the rinsed rice and 2/3 of the lentils, rinsed and sauté until the lentils have turned a dark golden brown color, about 15 minutes. Stir in the remaining lentils, half of the cheddar or monterey jack cheese, and 1/2 cup water. Cover and place in the oven for 15 minutes. Remove the cover, stir, and cook until the lentils are heated through, about 5 mintes. Spoon into a bowl. Spread the lentils on a serving platter and top with the remaining cheese and lentils. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: orange juice concentrate,orange juice,broccoli,cider vinegar,carrot,egg yolk,italian salad dressing
title: Delicious Low Fat Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 1 head broccoli, cut into bite size flowerets | 1 carrot, grated ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons orange juice concentrate, frozen concentrate thawed | 1 egg yolk ( optional ) | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 2 tablespoons orange juice | 1/4 cup fat-free italian salad dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Rump Roast Fajitas
ingredients: 2 lbs rump roast | 0.5 can artichoke hearts, drained and halved | 1 cup dark raisin | 4 -5 flour tortillas, warmed
instructions: Place roast on rack in roaster. Bake at 350°f. While roast bakes, mix raisins and artichoke halves in small bowl. Cut roast into thin slices, about 3/4 inch wide. Arrange on top of raisins and artichokes. Pour about 1/2 cup water into roaster. Cover and bake for about 1 1/2 hours, until meat pulls apart easily with fork. To serve, remove roast from pan. Place cooked meat on a warmed tortilla and top with raisin mixture and guacamole. This fajita can also be served with sour cream and refried beans.

title: Quick & Easy Refried Beans
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 can kidney beans
instructions: Put a pan into the microwave with enough oil to cover the bottom. Once on the pan, add the beans and cook for about 1 minutes or until heated through. I usually watch it and turn it once so it doesn't burn until the bottom side is golden brown. Serve hot and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: salmon steak,vegetable oil cooking spray,msg,bread flour
title: Easy Oven Fried Salmon
ingredients: 1/2 kg wild pacific salmon steak ( fillet in one piece ) | 2 tablespoons bread flour ( or gluten-free flour mixed with 5g bread flour ) | 2 teaspoons msg | 1 -2 teaspoon vegetables oil cooking spray ( or veg oil )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220c/425&deg.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,pineapple,cream chicken soup,pumpkin puree,raspberry,dark soy sauce,cake flour,currant
title: Pumpkin Pizza
ingredients: 3 cups prepared pizza dough | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 cup pumpkin puree or 1 cup pumpkin pie filling | 1/2 cup currants, chopped | 1 -2 tablespoon dark soy sauce ( more if necessary ) | 1 teaspoon celery rib | 3/4 cup raspberries ( fresh or frozen ) | 2 tablespoons cake flour ( cake flour for pizza crust )
instructions: Spray pizza pan with nonstick cooking spray. Mix the soup, pumpkin and currants together. Add soy sauce and mix. Spread on the bottom of the pizza pan. Spread pumpkin filling on the pizza. Sprinkle raspberries on top of pizza. Bake in 425f degrees oven for 20 - 30 minutes. Turn heat down to 375f degrees.

title: Taquitos
ingredients: 8 dried tomatillos | 4 -5 lb pork roast | 8 -12 green tamales | 16 ounces cheese, grated ( or your favorite fillings ) | 24 medium size steamed white fish fillets
instructions: To make the tamales, heat a skillet on medium heat and roast the whole tomatillos until they are soft. Remove them from the heat and place them in a bowl, covering with a damp towel. Place one whole tamales in a microwave safe dish and microwave them on high until they are soft, about 15 minutes depending on size of tamale. This should take no more than 30 - 45 seconds. Remove the skin from the tamales and remove the stem and most of the seeds, if not easy. Place the tamales on a plate covered with a paper towel. The skin will be damp so you may need to wipe the paper towel very thoroughly. Place the tamales in a deep bowl so that each one gets a little of their soaking liquid. Drain the tomatillos and put them in the bowl with the tamales. Use hands to squish the tamales to keep them from sticking together. Place the green tamales on a piece of wax paper and use them in the traditional way, making sure to squeeze your fingers into the soft pulp, and to remove any remaining seeds. The green tamales should take on that look as if they're pesticide free. Place the entire piece of tamales on a cutting board and flatten or pat with your hand. Place a slice of cheese or some other fill in the center of each tamale, then place 2 - 3 chopped tomatillos on top of the cheese. Roll the tamales up like little cigar shaped tortillas and place them side by side on a platter with the cheese/fill. Pour some of the remaining soaking liquid on the tamales over the tamales. Top the tamales with your favorite fillings, if desired. Put a toothpick in the middle of the toothpicks and wrap them up loosely around the meat mixture. You can leave the toothpick in just this way also, if you want, but be sure to leave a little of the tomatillo flavor behind when you remove it to avoid accidents or burns. Place the tamales in a steamer and cook for about 10 - 15 minutes, depending on their size. Remove and let them sit for a few minutes, then serve. I like to serve this with guacamole, sour cream, salsa, grated cheese whatever you like.

You can buy the white from the grocery store, and you can do anything else. Get all the oysters, and refrigerate them. This step also allows for the seafood to be cooked for 5 minutes apiece in a waterbath. Set up the filling for the oysters, and fill them with the mixed rice and potato traditional. I recommend 3 pieces of oysters per pound, and a little water, to help them hold their shape. Soak a piece of saran wrap in cold water for 10 minutes while you sit and preheat the oven to broil. Remove the oysters from the plastic wrapping, and line a baking sheet with a silicone baking liner or parchment paper. Set the oysters in a single layer, and place under a preheated broiler until the top is lightly browned and beginning to crackle. This will take about 25 minutes. Do not be surprised if the oysters don't crackle right away, as they should have the same temperature already. Carefully place on a dish to cool completely. You can also use a knife to cut the white in half so they would be able to see through. Spoon the white flesh onto a tray, and chill for 2 hours, to set. To serve, slice the oysters on the diagonal across their meat about 1/4 thick. To serve, place a scoop of the traditional rice onto a plate, place two oysters over the rice, and fill with the spicy tomato mixture.

Random Ingredients: tortilla chip,green bell pepper,asafoetida powder,turbinado sugar,coconut cream
title: Mixed Veg Fritters With Spiced Coconut Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 containers firm coconut cream, drained | 1 tablespoon turbinado sugar ( or other sweetener ) | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 3 green bell peppers | shredded tortilla chips
instructions: Blend all ingredients in blender or food processor till smooth. Cover and store in fridge till needed. Serve over noodles garnished with shredded cheese and crumbled tortilla chips if desired. Variation, 1 small green bell pepper, diced and roasted, diced tomatoes can be added along with the coconut cream for an additional kick.

title: Lazy New York Style Appetisers' Tiramisu
ingredients: 1/2 pound sliced fresh ladyfingers, divided | 1/3 cup dry breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup dry breadcrumbs, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees f. Line shallow 2 1/2 cup trays with parchment paper. Place half of the ladyfingers in a bowl of cold water to soften. Spread on 2 - 3 tablespoons of crumb mixture. Layer remaining ladyfingers on top. Invert trays so that butter side is up. Bake in preheated oven for 12 to 14 minutes, or until lightly browned, and cooked through. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: mushroom,garam masala,plum sauce,penne,curry powder,pine nut,italian parsley
title: Spicy Curry Penne With Mushrooms and Pine Nuts
ingredients: 16 ounces penne | 2 ounces pine nuts, lightly toasted | 2 tablespoons curry powder | 1/2 cup plum sauce | 12 ounces mixed mushrooms, with liquid | 2 teaspoons garam masala | 1/4 cup chopped fresh italian parsley
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions, drain. In a small skillet over medium heat, toast pine nuts until brown, 2 - 3 minutes. Set aside to cool, then stir into cooked pasta. To make pappadums, bring mushrooms, garam masala powder, 3/4 cup water and remaining 4 teaspoons water to a boil. Boil 1 minute without stirring, until mushrooms are tender and liquid is reduced by half. Stir in pine nuts, cook 3 minutes more. Remove from heat, stir in parsley.

title: Quick and Easy Sweet Bread
ingredients: 20 ounces raisins | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons cayenne pepper | 2 packages goya sazon goya | 2 cups flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degreesf. Prepare the raisins by straining them by washing them under running water, and removing any foreign matter that might be inside them. Mix them with a tablespoon of cooking oil. Set aside. In a bowl, add all the dry ingredients. Mix well with your hands and mix them into the dough. Knead for five minutes on a floured surface or place in a large oiled bowl. Roll out to approximately 12 x 8 x 2 inches. Cut out a 3 inch circle. Cover with wax paper and let rise for 15 minutes. Heat up the remaining tablespoon of oil, and fry the bread circles on both sides. It should be dry but not brown. Do not over bake the bread. Remove with paper towels and eat hot. Makes about 4 servings.

title: Strip Beef Jerky
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs stewing beef | 8 -12 cremini mushrooms, quartered | 1 tablespoon ground cacao | 5 radishes, cut in half | 0.5 can pine nuts
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Store in refrigerator for up to a week.

Random Ingredients: clear tequila,flat leaf italian parsley,dark molasses,salt black pepper,creme de cacao,worcestershire sauce,white hominy,lettuce leaf
title: Authentic Mexican Gallo
ingredients: 2 cans white hominy, drained | 32 fluid ounces clear premium tequila | 32 fluid ounces creme de calabao | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons dark molasses | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh flat-leaf italian parsley | 2 tablespoons coarsely ground salt and black pepper | 2 cans white hominy, drained | 2 leaves shredded lettuce leaves
instructions: Place canned hominy, tequila, creme de cacao, worcestershire sauce, molasses, parsley, salt, black pepper, and 2 cups water in a blender. Blend until smooth. In a large bowl, gently mix 1 can white hominy, 1 can black hominy, 1 white hominy, 1 white hominy, 1 white hominy, 1 white hominy, 1 white hominy, 1 white hominy, and 2 black hominy tortilla tortillas. Arrange layered salad ingredients in layers in the order suggested by the manufacturer. Each salad should top with a mound of the garnishes listed above. Serve in large bowl and garnish with additional parsley.

Random Ingredients: chili sauce,water,green chili pepper,self raising flour,salt substitute,ginger garlic paste,coleslaw mix,ginger root
title: Ginger Stir-Fry
ingredients: 100 g self-raising flour | 1 pinch salt substitute | 150 ml ginger-garlic paste | 450 g coleslaw mix ( or packaged packaged salad mix ) | 1 chili sauce | 2 tablespoons water, or as needed
instructions: Mix flour and salt together in a bowl. Blend the ginger garlic paste with a little bit of water to get a paste like consistency. Mix ginger garlic paste, coleslaw mix, chili sauce and water together. Gradually add the flour paste to the mixture to make a smooth batter. Cook in the microwave for about 2 minutes at 600 watts or high power, stirring regularly. Stir before each stir fry. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: yellow squash,parsnip,cornstarch,whipping cream,jalapeno jack cheese,cherry tomato,ladyfinger,egg white
title: Jalapeno Jack and Squash Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 package jalapeno jack cheese, grated | 1/4 cup whipping cream | 1 egg white | 1/4 cup cornstarch | 1/2 cup baby dill pickles | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsnips | 4 ounces yellow squash, cut into 1/4-inch cubes | 1 tablespoon minced pickled jalapeno jack cheese | cherry tomatoes, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spray a 9 inch springform pan with nonstick cooking spray. In a medium bowl whisk cream with 1/4 cup cornstarch until smooth. Remove 1/2 cup of grated jack cheese to a small bowl. Add cream and 1 egg white to cream, then fold in remaining grated jack cheese. Divide mixture evenly among the prepared crust, and bake for 35 minutes or until golden brown. To make the pickled jalapenos, place 1/2 cup of sliced jalapeno jack cheese on each of 4 plates, and top with 1 - 2 cherry tomatoes. Sprinkle sliced jalapeno pepper chips over the cream mixture. Garnish with additional cherry tomatoes.

title: Lobster Thermidor
ingredients: 300 g lobster meat | 2 cups vanilla ice cream | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Cook lobster meat in a skillet until it is cooked, then add turmeric powder. Remove lobster meat from skillet and put on absorbent paper to absorb excess oil. Cut icecream into 4 portions, then put one portion of the ice cream mixture on each plate. Top with lobster meat.

title: Cannoli Shells (Shiitake Pearl Balls)
ingredients: 4 -5 large shiitake mushrooms ( optional ) | 3 -4 cannoli shells ( small )
instructions: Place a pot of water on high heat. Once it comes to a boil, drop in the shiitake mushrooms. They should sink to the bottom of your pan. They'll be cooked by the time the shells are done. Once they're cooked, remove it from the pan and plunge with a strainer to get the juices. Remove the shiitake mushrooms from the pan as soon as they are cool enough to handle and slice into small pieces. Add the cannoli shells to the pot of water and bring to a boil. Once they're fully cooked drain the shells and divide in half. Form each half into a ball and gently toss them into a small bowl. Serve immediately with more shiitake shiitake flavored seasoning.

title: Sweet Potatoes-Pork (Gyu) Salad
ingredients: 1/8 lb pork ( optional ) | 1 -2 leek, minced | 5 tablespoons fat-free mayonnaise | 1 -2 tablespoon dried oriental fish sauce | 1 tablespoon teapsoon asian mixed spice
instructions: Cut up the meat and sautee in a frying pan on medium heat in the fat free mayo. Add leeks and sauté for five more minutes, stirring often. Add the oriental mixed spice and serve immediately.

title: Almond Crunch
ingredients: 4 cups flour | 1 cup almond meal | 1 bunch fresh chives, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 360 degrees f. In a medium bowl, thoroughly mix together the almond meal and chives. Add flour a little at a time until the dough is workable enough to form a ball. Roll out into a rectangle about 12x16 inches and cut into 8 slices. Place on an ungreased baking sheet. Using a brush, cream butter or margarine and spread over each slice. Sprinkle with almond meal and chives. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes in preheated oven, until golden. Serve warm.

title: Taco Seasoning Mix in Fried Fritters
ingredients: 1 tablespoon taco seasoning | 1 tablespoon fennel powder
instructions: To make fritters, add 1 tbs taco seasoning and 1 1/2 tsp fennel powder. Combine well and cook or fry at 500 degrees till slightly brown on the outside and crispy. Remove from skillet and roll each fritter individually and enjoy serve.

title: Thai Chili Paste
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chili oil ( like sesame ) | 1 can vegetable broth
instructions: In a small saucepan, heat oil over medium heat. Pour in chili oil while whisking with a wooden spoon until the oil is well flavored. Stir in the broth.

Random Ingredients: spring onion,white wine vinegar,kielbasa,salmon,purpose flour,cornstarch,milk ricotta cheese,monterey jack cheese
title: Crusty Smoked Kielbasa Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces smoked kielbasa | 1 1/2 teaspoons cornstarch, dissolved in 2 tbsp water | 3 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 3 cups whole milk ricotta cheese, well shaken | 1/2 cup freshly grated monterey jack cheese | 3 stalks minced spring onions | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar
instructions: Cut the kielbasa into 4 chunks. Sprinkle 1 1/4 tbsp water over and toss. Cover and refrigerate 1 hour. Drain the kielbasa and reserve it. In a mixing bowl, combine the cornstarch dissolved in the water. Gradually add the flour stirring until it is completely incorporated. In a medium bowl, blend the ricotta with the cheese and parmesan cheese. Fold in the cooked kielbasa and season with spring onions. Cover mixture and chill at least an hour or longer serve on salad leaves.

Random Ingredients: brandy,cilantro,cotija cheese,red chili pepper flake,cream tartar,filet mignon,vegetable bouillon granule
title: Filet Mignon With Caramelized Cotija Cream
ingredients: about 6 ounces filet mignon ( about 2 lbs ) | 1 pinch cream of tartar | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ground red chili pepper flakes | fresh cilantro ( a big handful ) | 1 tablespoon cream of tartar | 1/3 cup dry aged grated cotija cheese ( to taste ) | 1/4 cup grated cotija cheese ( to taste ) | 2 tablespoons vegetable bouillon granules | 2 tablespoons brandy or 2 tablespoons cognac
instructions: In a small bowl whisk the cream of tartar, red chile flakes, cilantro and cream of tartar until blended. Season to taste with salt. Place the filet mignon on a heavy duty foil lined baking sheet and flatten it out in the shape of a flat pancake. Spread the chile cream over the filet. Sprinkle generously with cotija. Roast in a 375° oven until the surface is crisp and the underside of the fillet is seared, about 25 minutes. Allow the fillet to cool slightly on the foil and serve at room temperature. To make the cream, in a small sauce pan combine the Cotija, cotija and bouillon granules and warm over low heat, stirring until the cheeses melt and the dish is heated through but not browned. Serve the cream with the pilau.

title: Sweet Corn and Capsicum Mousse
ingredients: 2 large yellow capsicums | 1 red chile | 1 can sweetcorn | 1 2/3 cups milk chocolate, chopped | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 2 teaspoons ground almonds
instructions: Cut off the green tops of the capsicums by leaving them intact. Cut off and discard the flesh from the capsicum and discard any seeds. Cut the capsicum flesh into thin strips and then cut each strip in half diagonally. Rinse, dry, and finely dice the remaining capsicum. Place the capsicum strips in a bowl of lightly salted boiling water for a couple of minutes and then drain. Wash, dry and finely chop the chili. Drain the sweetcorn. Melt the chocolate with the curry powder and ground almonds and mix thoroughly. Stir in the sweetcorn mixture and finally the capsicum strips. Serve and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,clear honey,greek yogurt,white bread,thyme,adobo seasoning,steak,chili flake
title: Spiralized Flank Steak
ingredients: 1 lb flank steak, cut across grain into 4 steaks | 1 tablespoon salt | 1 1/2 tablespoons clear honey | 3/4 - 1 tablespoon chili flakes ( to taste ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon thyme | 1 1/2 teaspoons adobo seasoning | 8 slices white bread
instructions: Prepare all your ingredients first. Marinate steak with all your ingredients. Grill over medium high heat, turning once until steak is fully cooked, 6 - 8 minute to get nice and brown color and juices run clear. Serve on your choice of side. Serve with roasted red potatoes and other desired vegetable of your choice.

title: Tangerine Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 large tangerines | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 pinch dried dill weed | 1 medium tomatoes
instructions: Cut the ends off the tangerines and carefully remove the seeds. Cut into quarters and set aside. Place the tangerines in a blender container with the soup, dill and a pinch of salt and process until smooth. Cut the tomato into half moons and place into a medium to large size bowl. Spoon the soup into the tomato halves and serve along with a dollop of sour cream.

title: Garnishes and Dry Rub
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried sage | 2 tablespoons white sesame oil
instructions: Put all ingredients in a small bowl.

title: Baked Veggies
ingredients: 3 large plum tomatoes | 1 large cauliflower | 2 teaspoons seasoning mix | 1/2 cup frozen peas | 1 tablespoon cornmeal ( fine or coarse ) | 1/2 cup red wine ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f cut up the tomatoes in the small sections, place on a parchment lined cookie sheet and bake for approximately 30 minutes, turning once, until soft and the skin has blushed slightly, remove and let cool on a towel. Remove and discard the stem from the cauliflower. Slice up the cauliflower. Mix corn meal with any optional ingredients you may have on hand in a bowl, sprinkle with flour and mix with your hands until all is well combined. In a microwave safe casserole dish, add the vegetables, pour in the wine, and then the tomato paste. Mix thoroughly, cover and place in oven for 20 minutes, or until vegetables are tender crisp, and most of the liquid has been absorbed..

title: Beef Grits for the Grill
ingredients: 3 cups cooked grits, cooled | 1 medium ground chuck | 2 1/2 cups shredded carrots ( from the deli ) | 1/2 cup diagonally cut celery rib | 1/2 cup chopped parsley | 1 baguette | 1 cup maraschino cherry, sliced
instructions: Preheat grill. Place uncooked grits in a large bowl. Add ground chuck, carrots, celery and parsley. Stir to mix. Grill for 10 minutes while grilling. Meanwhile, cut baguette slices in half lengthwise, then cut into 3/4 inch slices. Wrap in foil. Place on heated grill, and cook for 6 - 8 minutes, turning once. Drain grits, and place in a large bowl. Add shredded chicken, then maraschino cherries. Toss to combine. Serve with baguette slices.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,seasoning salt,vegetable oil,ricotta cheese,green curry paste
title: Spicy and Creamy Fried Green Curry Paneer
ingredients: 1 package vegetable oil fryer noodles ( such as paneer ) | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt or 1/2 teaspoon salt substitute | 2 tablespoons peanut oil ( i use a little less ) | 1 1/2 1 1/2 tablespoons green curry paste or 1 1/2 tablespoons regular curry paste | 8 tablespoons ricotta cheese or 8 tablespoons sour cream
instructions: Using paneer, cut into pieces about 2 inches long and 1/4 cup long. You may be able to buy thin pieces at a special foods Market. This is one of the keys for making your curry, as it will make it a quick and easy to fry the noodles. Deep frying, put noodles into a wide mouth bowl, add salt mix, a tablespoon peanut oil and then 1 inch of oil with enough water to cover noodles and stir. This will help to bind well together, and cook noodles until al dente. Drain well. Drain again. To make creamy curry, place 1 teaspoon peanut oil in a small, shallow frying pan and fry until very hot. Use 1 tablespoon peanut oil for each fried noodle, and then spread curry on top. Note i usually add a bit of cayenne to my curry, or hot sauce to taste. Drain noodles in a colander when finished and sprinkle with cayenne and then spread sour cream on top, then add your creamy curry.

title: Frozen Artichoke & Spinach Salad
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped spinach, thawed | 2 tablespoons bottled marinated artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 1 russet potato, sliced | 1/4 cup tequila
instructions: Cook frozen spinach according to package directions.

Random Ingredients: pimento pepper,red chili pepper,brown sugar,picante sauce,catsup,cooking oat,white mushroom
title: Picante Mushroom Salad
ingredients: 1 package white mushrooms, cleaned, sliced | 1 jar catsup | 3/4 cup picante sauce | 3 tablespoons brown sugar, packed | 1 large red chili pepper, minced | 1 jar pimento pepper, chopped | cooking rolled oats
instructions: Cook mushrooms in boiling water for 10 minutes. Drain and rinse mushrooms. In a large mixing bowl, add the catsup, picante sauce, brown sugar, chile, pimento peppers and cooked mushrooms. Toss to coat well. Serve warm or chilled.

title: Roasted Spicy Fried Peanuts
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 36 large whole raw peanuts ( skins on or off )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f. Line roasting pan with aluminum foil with the vegetable oil spray. Using a rolling pin, carefully pound the peanuts until evenly ground. Stir ground peanuts into ground peanuts until evenly mixed and no lumps are remaining. Spread peanuts out onto a non stick jellyroll pan lined with parchment paper so that they are about 1/2 inch thick. Bake for about 20 minutes until peanuts are golden brown, stirring frequently. Remove from oven and set aside to cool. Store in air tight container. When cool, break up any large clumps. Store in airtight container with a tight lid.

title: Chicken Tagine With Rosemary
ingredients: 4 tablespoons lemon zest, thinly sliced | 3 1/4 lbs bone-in skin-on chicken breasts, quartered | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried rosemary | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cumin
instructions: Combine zest, 3 tablespoons lemon zest, and chicken, pressing them into the coating evenly. Stir in the rosemary and cumin. Cover and refrigerate, tossing a few times, for 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 300°. Place chicken in a nonstick ovenproof dish. Cook, turning frequently, for 2 to 2½ hours, or until golden brown and juices run clear when pierced with a knife.

Random Ingredients: cannellini bean,turkey,balsamic vinegar,sauerkraut,red chile,coleslaw mix,whipping cream
title: Easy Turkey and Cabbage
ingredients: 1 bag coleslaw mix | 1 cup sliced smoked turkey | 1/2 cup bottled sauerkraut, drained | 1/3 cup balsamic vinegar | 1 cup cubed cooked sweet peppers or 1 cup canned red chiles, drained | 1 cup reduced-fat whipping cream | 1/4 cup chopped red chile
instructions: In a bowl mix together sausage, turkey, sauerkraut, vinegar, sweet peppers, and whipping cream. Pour mixture over salad and stir gently until mixed. Garnish with fresh chilies.

Random Ingredients: cocoa,white sugar,salsa,gingerroot,bacon dripping,self rising flour,salad oil,pesto sauce
title: Pesto and Bacon Cakes
ingredients: 3 cups mixed salad leaves | 2 tablespoons dry salsa, such as arroz | 3/4 cup bacon drippings | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 2 teaspoons grated fresh gingerroot | 1 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa | 1 1/2 cups self-rising flour | 1 3/4 cups white sugar | 1 teaspoon grated fresh gingerroot
instructions: Prepare the salad leaves according to the directions on the package and set aside. In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Stir in the bacon and 1 teaspoon of ground ginger. Cook until the bacon just begins to cook, about 45 seconds. Stir in the salsa and continue cooking until the mixture has heated through, 30 seconds to 1 minute. Cool slightly. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Whisk the salad leaves, salsa, and 1/4 cup of the bacon drippings into the salad leaves. Stir in the oil, 1 teaspoon grated fresh ginger, cocoa, and flour. Transfer to a bowl, cover bowl, and refrigerate until the batter is firm and thick, about 30 minutes. Lightly grease a baking sheet. Use a 2 1/2 inch round cookie cutter to cut the batter into 1/2 inch squares. Arrange each circle on the prepared baking sheet. Sprinkle with the remaining 1 1/2 tablespoons of ground ginger if desired. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes in the preheated oven, until the tops are lightly browned. Cool 5 minutes before removing from the baking sheets.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,part mozzarella cheese,spinach,peppercorn,bread dough
title: Crusty Spinach Fingers
ingredients: 1 loaf frozen bread dough, thawed ( frozen bread dough can be used ) | 2 packages of thin sliced spinach | 1 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded | 1 jar roasted crushed peppercorns | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Place the thawed frozen bread dough in a large bowl. In a small bowl, combine the shredded spinach, roasted crushed peppercorns and red wine vinegar.

title: The Bestest Veggie Stock Ever
ingredients: 6 celery ribs, diced | 3/4 cup fresh basil leaf
instructions: Place the celery and basil in your food processor with a few grinds of garlic and a small handful of salt. Pulse until the celery is finely chopped. You may need to adjust the saltiness if your machine is to thick.

Random Ingredients: cashew nut,filling,canola oil,coconut milk,brandy,tomato sauce,yellow onion
title: Cashew Nut Pastries
ingredients: 3 tablespoons canola oil | 1 1/2 cups yellow onions, finely chopped | 1/4 cup cashew nuts, finely ground | 1/4 cup brandy ( optional ) | 1 cup tomato sauce | 2 cans coconut milk | filling, for coating ( optional )
instructions: Heat canola oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Stir in the onions. Reduce heat to medium, and cook until onions are golden, about 5 minutes. Add cashews, and cook until nuts become dark golden brown and liquid evaporates, about 3 minutes more. Pour brandy over the hot onions, and stir to combine. Reduce heat to medium low. Stir in the tomato sauce and coconut milk, and continue cooking until sauce thickens slightly, about 10 minutes. Let cool 10 minutes. Season with salt to taste, and allow to cool completely. Form cashew nut pastries into 1 inch balls, and coat with filling. Chill at least 10 minutes before serving.

title: Pork and Pies  #5FIX
ingredients: 1 can sweet potatoes traditional mashed potatoes | 1 1/2 lbs ground pork | 1 cup frozen peas, thawed | 1/2 cup ketchup | 8 1/2 ounces frozen bread, sliced into 8 triangles
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium mixing bowl, mix the mashed potatoes and ground pork. Stir in the peas and ketchup. Transfer mixture to a lightly greased 9 x 12 square baking dish. Arrange bread triangles on top. Bake in a preheated oven for 45 - 50 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: red chili powder,chocolate syrup,yellow pepper,sesame oil,sesame seed,chinese egg noodle,plum tomato,baby green
title: Chinese Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup sesame oil | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 1 tablespoon chinese roasted red chili powder ( or fresh chili flakes ) | 1/4 cup chopped red chili powder ( or fresh chili flakes ) | 2 lbs mixed baby greens, washed and chopped | 1 pint plum tomato, chopped & peeled | 1 yellow sweet pepper | 2 links semisweet chocolate-covered egg noodles
instructions: Combine sesame oil, chinese red chili powder, and 1/4 cup of the chili flakes in a large bowl. Add the green salad. Arrange the salad in a decorative pattern on a platter. Break the tomato into bite sized chunks, or dice them and mix with the green salad. Dip the egg noodles into the remaining 1/3 cup chili soaking powder and let drain for 30 to 45 seconds before adding to the salad. Serve the salad in a decorative bowl.

title: Giri’s Prawns - Prawns with Tomatoes and Prawns
ingredients: 500 g prawns, uncooked, peeled
instructions: Shell and devein the prawns by making a whiter slit across the back vein, then cutting down along the vein. The prawns will remove back in a few seconds by gently pushing them through a natural whitting. Reserve the juices in a large bowl. Stir the tomato paste into the remaining juice in the bowl and season to taste with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Place the prawns in the tomato mixture and gently toss. Scatter paprika over the top and simmer for 2 to 3 minutes or until the prawns are tender. Serve straight away.

Random Ingredients: mirin,sage leaf,green cardamom pod,self rising flour,salt black pepper
title: Aromatic Sage Dumplings (Aromatic Style)
ingredients: 8 ounces self rising flour | 1 pinch salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste | 1/8 teaspoon dried sage leaves, or more to taste | 4 green cardamom pods | 1 tablespoon mirin ( japanese sweet wine )
instructions: Combine the flour, salt, pepper, sage, and cardamom pods in a mixing bowl and stir in the mirin or sweet wine until it’s evenly mixed into the flour mixture.

title: Homemade Enchilada Crackers
ingredients: 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 can enchilada sauce
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Lightly grease or spray a baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray. In a large bowl, mix crumbs and asafetida powder. Add 1/2 cup enchilada sauce and stir to mix. Form dough into 8 patties about 2 - 3 inches tall. Place on the prepared baking sheet and bake for 25 - 40 minutes, until just firm and golden brown. Allow to cool.

Random Ingredients: roast beef,cornflour,baby spinach,coconut milk,black cardamom pod
title: Coconut Beef
ingredients: 500 g roast beef, thinly sliced | 15 g shredded coconut flour | 1 teaspoon ground black cardamom pod | 350 g fresh baby spinach | 14 1/2 ml cornflour
instructions: Combine coconut flour and cardamom in a small bowl. Sprinkle over the roast and toss to coat. Place in the fridge for 30 minutes to marinate. Preheat a wok until hot. Add the meat and stir fry for 3 - 4 minutes, or until golden brown. Add the baby spinach and cook for another 1 minute. Transfer the beef to a serving dish. Sprinkle with the coconut flour mixture and serve.

title: Candy Cashews
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs raw cashews, well washed, drained and rinsed | 1 1/4 cups cashews | 2 teaspoons fennel seeds, ground | 2 teaspoons almond liqueur
instructions: Toast the cashews in the oven until lightly darker brown and fragrant. Place the cashews in a food processor and grind enough cashews to measure 7 ounces. Add the fennel seeds and almond liqueur. Process to a coarse paste. Store in a dark, dry place.

title: French Onion Soup
ingredients: 1 package onion soup mix | 1/2 cup apple juice
instructions: Place soup mix in a saucepan with apple juice. Cook over low heat for 30 minutes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: sirloin,shaoxing wine,green bean,guacamole,graham cracker,jelly,brown mustard seed
title: Chinese Roast Beef
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin, trimmed of fat, cut into 4 pieces | 1/2 tablespoon brown mustard seeds | 2 cups peanut butter or 2 cups natural peanut butter | 2 tablespoons shaoxing wine or 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons prepared prepared green bean-stuffed shrimp | 2 tablespoons prepared guacamole ( optional ) | 1/4 cup graham cracker ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Heat a wok over high heat until hot, but not smoking. Add mustard seeds. When mustard seeds pop, add beef and sear meat quickly, in a matter of seconds, and then drain off any excess fat. Add peanut butter, shaoxing or rice wine, green beans and shrimp. Stir to scrape up any browned bits around the outside of the pan. Cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until meat is tender, 3 to 4 minutes. Transfer meat to a platter and top with the guacamole, if desired.

title: Homemade Semolina
ingredients: 1 lb semolina | 1 can frozen limeade concentrate, thawed | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 1/4 cup ground coriander seed
instructions: In blender container combine, semolina, limeade concentrate, onion soup mix and coriander seeds. Blend until smooth. Pour into large plastic freezer bag or bowl and freeze up to 2 months.. Transfer to serving dish and refrigerate. To serve, thaw overnight in refrigerator or until firm.

title: Ginger Paste(Ginger-Lok)
ingredients: 1/2 lb gingerroot ( minced fine ) | 3 teaspoons canola oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons vegetable shortening | 2 -3 teaspoons cooking oil
instructions: Place all ingredients into a blender and blend well. If there are lots of bits of ginger that haven't yet been completely mashed, add water and pulse grind some more. Add more oil if necessary, although you don't want it as oily. Store in a tightly closed tin at room temperature on the counter for up to 3 months or up to 6 months, and it last to a year, or freeze.

Random Ingredients: peanut butter,horseradish,chicken broth,parsley,applesauce,brown lentil,almond extract,ranch dressing mix
title: Lentil Pate
ingredients: 2 cups dried brown lentils | 1 package ranch dressing mix, such as good seasons | 1/2 cup chicken broth | 1/4 cup light cream or 1/4 cup unsweetened applesauce or 1/4 cup milk | 1/4 cup thawed old fashioned dried peanut butter | 3 tablespoons parsley, chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons horseradish, peeled and minced | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Sort through lentils. Transfer any foreign objects to a large pot. Place lentils, ranch dressing mix, broth, cream/applesauce, peanut butter, parsley, horseradish, and almond extract in the slow cooker. Stir to combine.

title: Indian Bread Crumbs
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dry rye bread, finely diced | 2 3 tablespoons parsley sprigs ( optional ) | parsley sprig ( optional )
instructions: Using your hands, mix the bread and parsley together. Using less than ¼ cup of this mixture, add a few drops of water to the rye bread crumbs, making sure all the bread is well coated. If necessary, use the reserved bread liquid, making sure all of the bread crumbs are wet. Shape into small balls about the size of whole wheat or walnuts. Place the rye bread balls on waxed paper and refrigerate for an hour. Preheat oven to 350°f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Line a strainer with a damp towel, or lightly oil the parchment paper. Place the crumbs in a medium bowl. Add a pinch of salt. Add about a tablespoon of chopped parsley if desired. Dip each crumb into the parsley for a second coating. Sprinkle with more of the salt and serve. Repeat to make additional servings.

title: Homemade Mexican Rice Pizza
ingredients: 1 pizza dough ( homemade or frozen, thawed ) | 1 1/2 ounces cotija cheese ( grated ) | 2 1/4 cups long grain rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Stretch out dough to 4 x 8 inch rectangle. Spray pizza pan or pizza pan with pam. On one half of the rectangle spread 1/4 of the cheese. Then place 3/4 of the rice on top of the cheese. Repeat with other half of dough, rice and cheese. Use the crust to make a lid. Press the edges firmly together. Lightly sprinkle with a little bit of any remaining cheese. Bake about 12 minutes or until dough starts to brown. Remove pizza pan from oven. Slice pizza into two layers by using a pizza cutter or an 11 x 15 inch pizza cutter. Make sure you use the crust so it will cook while hot.

Random Ingredients: fusion liqueur,taco sauce,chicken stock,granny smith apple,breadcrumb
title: Apple Fondue
ingredients: 8 granny smith apples, peeled, cored, quartered ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 1/2 cup taco sauce | 3/4 cup chicken stock | 1/2 cup fusion liqueur | 1 tablespoon dry breadcrumbs
instructions: Place all ingredients except the crumbs in fondue pot or large bowl. Stir to combine. Using a wooden spoon, crush the chunks of apples until they are coursely crushed. Then stir in crumbs until you have a coarse crumb like consistency that holds its shape. Remove the lid and stir while fondue is heating up for a second while before serving..

title: Crock Pot Mexican Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless sirloin, cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces | 1 can tomato paste | 1 lb mexican cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup yogurt | cornmeal | 1/3 cup plain yogurt
instructions: Place beef, tomato paste, and cheese into medium slow cooker and mix well. Set low cover cooker on for 2 to 3 hours. Before serving, make cornmeal topping by combining cornmeal and yogurt, stir well. Turn crock pot onto high and cook for 1 hour. Serve with warm cornbread.

title: Kadai Raita
ingredients: 100 g ground pork ribs | 100 g dal | 100 g urad dal, soaked till soft | 1 dash cayenne | milk | chopped walnuts
instructions: Grind the meat, dals, pinches of spices and half the quantity of walnuts. Mix with rest of the quantity of milk. Put meat on a baking tray or bread dish. Put the mixture for 15 minutes at 180°c.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,french bread,green chilies,puff pastry,pecorino romano cheese,poppy seed,butter,ginger
title: Chilies Stuffed French Bread
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups whipping cream | 1 cup grated pecorino romano cheese | 2 cans chopped green chilies, drained, reserve 1/2 cup juice | 1 package frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1/4 cup butter, melted | 1 teaspoon ground ginger | 1 can chopped green chilies, drained, reserve 1/2 cup juice | 1/4 cup poppy seed
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Butter 13x9 inch glass baking dish. Stir whipping cream, cheese, green chilies, reserved 1/2 cup juice, and one cup cheese mixture in large bowl to blend until soft dough forms. Place pastry on work surface,. Cut a 1 1/2 inch cross on top with 2 knives. Starting at wide end closest to you, cut through pastry to bread 1 inch from edge nearest you. With serrated knife, cut 1 1/2 inch deep slits in top of pastry about 1 inch deep. Combine remaining cheese mixture with oil. Spread 1/2 the cheese mixture into a 3/4 cup deep dish and sprinkle with 1/4 cup cheese mixture,. Repeat layers with remaining cheese mixture, cheese mixture and sliced chilies. Bake uncovered 25 minutes or until golden brown and filling is hot and crisp when inserted in center of loaf.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,garlic,maraschino cherry,extra virgin olive oil,lime wedge,raspberry,apricot preserve,sesame oil
title: Easy Green-Chile Raspberry Dipping Sauce - W- Vegan Option
ingredients: 2 green chili peppers, minced | 2 -3 tablespoons fresh minced garlic | 2 tablespoons maraschino cherries, chopped | 1/3 cup apricot preserves, drained ( or preserves of your choice ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon sesame oil | 1 teaspoon extra virgin olive oil | lime wedge | fresh raspberry ( to garnish )
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the green chilies, minced garlic and apricot preserves with the sesame oil to make a vinaigrette. Drizzle on top of the raspberry sauce, as desired.

Random Ingredients: cold water,turnip,garam masala,lychee,green grape,flat,lemon zest,lime juice
title: Kadai (Yemenite Turnip Soup)
ingredients: 2 lbs firm turnips | 1 1/2 cups fresh flat grapes | 2 quarts cold water | 2 teaspoons lemon zest, grated | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 1/2 cup lime juice ( freshly squeezed is best, but bottled is ok ) | 1 bunch green grapes, stemmed and quartered | 1 bunch flat, green giant greens ( optional )
instructions: Peel the turnips and cut into halves, then into half again lengthwise. Cut each halt into a thick slice. Place the cut turnips in a large pot of water and barely cover. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for about 30 minutes. Turn off the heat and cover the pot loosely with a damp kitchen towel and let stand for about 10 minutes. Transfer the turnips and the water to a pot. Add 1 cup of fresh flat, green grapes and the lemon zest. Cover and cook over very low heat for one hour. Add 1 teaspoon of garam masala and taste for salt. Just before serving, taste for additional salt.

title: Authentic Italian Grits
ingredients: 4 cups grits | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 2 tablespoons anchovy paste | 1/2 cup dry-roasted black habanero pepper | 1 tablespoon cake flour
instructions: Bring the stock to a simmer in a pot over medium high heat, about 5 minutes. Meanwhile, bring the cream and anchovy paste to a boil in a large skillet over moderate heat. Remove the pan from the heat. Add the grits and return the stock to a simmer, then stir in the black habanero pepper until just cooked through. Pour the grits into a colander set in a bowl and let cool until warm. Place the grits in the bowl with the anchovy paste, then slowly ladle in the hot cream and simmer until thick, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: lamb shank,vanilla sugar,maple syrup,tarragon,tamari,corn tortilla chip
title: Lamb Shanks With Maple Chips
ingredients: 6 lamb shanks | 4 teaspoons maple syrup | 2/3 cup tamari | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 box corn tortilla chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Put a rack in the middle of the oven. Rinse the lamb shanks, and pat dry with paper towels. Place the lamb shanks in a roasting pan. Combine the maple syrup, tamari, maple syrup, vanilla sugar, tarragon, and 3/4 cup water in a small saucepan, and bring to a boil. Pour over the shanks, and cover with a tight fitting lid. Cook in preheated oven until a meat thermometer reaches at least 140 degrees about 1 hour. Turn the shanks halfway through, and continue roasting until the lamb is very tender, 2 to 3 hours. Remove and let cool in pan. Slice meat into strips, and serve with the maple chips.

Random Ingredients: fruit preserve,fontina cheese,rose water,beetroot,blueberry,red pepper flake,swiss cheese,olive
title: Swiss and Beetroot Salad
ingredients: 4 large beets | 1 cup swiss cheese, grated | 1/2 cup fontina cheese, shredded | 1 green pepper, chopped ( i prefer red or green ) | 1 can mixed fruit preserves | 1/4 cup black olive, sliced | 1/4 cup roasted red pepper flakes ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon dried rose water ( optional )
instructions: Scrub beets and place in a large saucepan, add boiling water to cover. Bring to boil, cover and cook until fork tender. Remove beets, cool slightly and slice, discard stem and beets. Set aside in ice water to stop the cooking. In a large bowl, combine greens, then layer cheeses in the order listed. Top with beet slices, olives, crumbled red pepper flakes and rose water. Toss together and serve.

title: Amarula Banana Roll-ups
ingredients: 250 g bananas | 6 tablespoons amarula cream liqueur | white breadcrumbs
instructions: Peel and slice bananas. Heat over a medium fire until skins blister, turning to evenly coat with oil. If using banana sticks, scrape out the skins with a small spatula if necessary. Place in a bowl. Heat the amarula in a saucepan with a little water and heat gently for just a few seconds. Place 1 - 2 banana sticks on each slice of breadcrumbs. Place under a hot grill or a grill and cook, turning until crisp and golden.

title: Easy Mushrooms
ingredients: 12 fresh white mushrooms ( try with fresh baby bella or shitake mushrooms-prego your favorite ) | 1/4 cup chopped fresh italian parsley
instructions: Remove the white mushrooms stems and mushrooms from the stems. Wash the mushrooms in a sieve, removing the outer layer, with some of the mushroom juices clinging to them. Chop the caps into quarters. Bring a 6 cup enameled or nonstick pan about 1/4 1/2 turns of the pan up, over medium heat. Add the caps and the parsley and toss until the liquid is reduced by half. Increase the heat to medium high and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, to dry out the liquid, then set the pan aside and let cool slightly. Repeat with the mushrooms. The mixture should be dry and have a thick, velvety texture. You can adjust seasonings if necessary. Remove the filling from the pan when completely cooled. This can be made ahead and reheated, just before serving.

Random Ingredients: topping,cilantro leaf,white pepper,pickling spice,baking potato,pimiento,barbeque sauce
title: Texas Potatoes
ingredients: 1 1/4 pounds baking potatoes | 1 jar sliced pimientos, drained | 1 jar barbeque sauce | 3 tablespoons chopped pickling spice | 1 tablespoon white pepper | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro leaves | 1/2 cup sliced fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add the potatoes, and cook until tender enough to pierce with a fork, about 20 minutes.

title: Gruyere Appetizers
ingredients: 4 gruyere, thinly sliced on the diagonal, about 2 1/2 cups ( for australians ) | ground celery ( optional, to serve ) | hot sauce ( optional, for serving )
instructions: Place each piece of gruyere directly on to a piece of foil, about 1 1/2 cups. Sprinkle with a few drops of hot sauce and roll up, securing with a toothpick, to make a bundle. Serve at once with celery leaves for dipping.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce,breadcrumb,garam masala,walnut,white wine vinegar,red cherry,extra beef,cocoa
title: Warm Croquettes
ingredients: 2 lbs ground beef | 1/2 cup dry breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa | 2 teaspoons garam masala | 1 head romaine lettuce, torn | 1 red cherries, pitted | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 1/4 cup finely chopped walnuts or 1/4 cup pecans, toasted
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a large bowl, combine ground beef with 1/2 cup bread crumbs, cocoa, garam masala and half the romain lettuce. Form into 1 1/4 inch balls and place on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until meatballs are cooked through. Transfer to a serving platter. Top with remaining romaine lettuce, cherries and remaining bread crumbs. Make a salad by whisking together vinegar and remaining 1/4 cup bread crumbs. Dredge meatballs in the vinegar mix then roll meatballs into nuts. Arrange the meatballs on top of the lettuce, drizzle with crumb mixture and serve.

title: Safflower Oil(For Beef)
ingredients: 500 g safflower oil | 2 -3 cm gingerroot, grated | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 1 teaspoon dry gingerroot, grated
instructions: Stir fry the grated ginger. Heat safflower oil. Take it to near smoking point and add the ginger and the chilli powder. Stir fry for about a minute. Remove from fire. Serve hot.

title: Moroccan Pork and Vegetable Stew
ingredients: 1 small red capsicums or 1 small brown capsicum, chopped | 4 ribs, thickly sliced | 300 g canned chick-peas, drained | 2 tablespoons harissa | 1 teaspoon cinnamon
instructions: Place the garlic, capsicum and the chickpeas in a saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring to the boil over high heat, then reduce the heat to simmer and simmer for about 30 minutes. Drain and discard the garlic. Place the stew in a large pan, add 50ml boiling water and bring rapidly to the boil. Simmer for about 20 minutes or until the meat is tender. Add all the remaining ingredients, except the cinnamon, to the stew and stir until the vegetables are coated with the spice. Bring to the boil, reduce the heat and simmer for about 30 minutes, until thickened. Sprinkle with the cinnamon and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: butter flavor crisco,red kidney bean,cherry tomato
title: Red Beans & Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 cup dried red kidney beans | 1 cup butter flavor crisco | 10 -11 cherry tomatoes
instructions: Sort and rinse the beans. Place beans in saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil over high heat then reduce heat to medium. Simmer, covered, about 2 - 3 minutes or until beans are tender. Drain beans and set aside. Melt crisco in a shallow ovenproof dish. Pour beans, butter flavor, tomatoes, and salt and pepper to taste over crisco. Turn and bake in preheated oven until crisp and lightly browned, about 15 - 20 minutes.

title: Mushroom Spinach Quesadillas
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried onion flakes | 2 tablespoons dried onion flakes | 1 teaspoon fajita style fajita style tortillas | 2 cups baby spinach, shredded | 1/8 - 1/4 fluid ounce reduced sodium feta, crumbled
instructions: Spread a thin coating of cooking spray on a large baking sheet. Place 1 tortilla on the baking sheet, and spread the onion and fiesta style fajita style tortilla evenly over top. Spread chopped spinach evenly over top. Sprinkle the remaining 1 t. Of crumbled feta over the spinach. Grill on high 3 - 4 minutes, just until hot. Cut into 8 wedges.

Random Ingredients: tarragon,vermicelli,nonstick cooking spray,olive oil,deli roast beef,hungarian paprika
title: Savory Italian Beef
ingredients: 1/2 cup olive oil | 1 tablespoon sweet hungarian paprika | 2 teaspoons dried tarragon | 12 ounces thinly sliced deli roast beef | 1 package vermicelli, cooked per package directions | nonstick cooking spray
instructions: Preheat grill to medium heat. Toast vermicelli according to package directions and place on a plate. To make sauce, heat oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Add paprika and tarragon. Stir to coat and allow to melt over low heat. Add beef and cook 3 - 4 minutes or until beef is browned and sauce is syrupy. Cook vermicelli according to package instructions, drain and set aside. Spray grill with nonstick spray and heat to medium, spray with nonstick spray. Place steak on grill and cook 2 - 3 minutes or until desired doneness.
