Top each portion of cooked vermicelli with about 1 1/2 tablespoons of the beef and 1 tablespoon of the sauce, or more if desired. Serve with french bread, or with your favourite side.

Random Ingredients: pork tenderloin,green chili pepper,urad dal,bay scallop,thyme sprig,honey,rice wine vinegar
title: Grilled Indian Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 2 -4 lbs pork tenderloin | 1/2 cup rice wine vinegar | 1/4 cup finely chopped green chili pepper | 1/3 cup honey | 2 tablespoons thai green chili pepper paste or 2 tablespoons minced fresh thai chili peppers | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme sprig ( optional ) | 1 bay scallop ( optional )
instructions: Place tenderloin in a large freezer bag, place in a nonreactive container, add 1/4 cup rice wine vinegar, 1/4 cup green chili pepper paste or minced fresh chili pepper, and thyme. Seal and freeze bag for at least 1 hour. Remove tenderloins from freezer, cut into 1/2 inch slices, and brush with remaining 1/4 cup rice wine vinegar. Refrigerate 12 - 24 hours. Prepare grill. Remove marinade from bag, and coat grill rack with cooking spray. Over medium heat, grill meat 10 - 12 minutes per side, basting with remaining 1/4 cup rice wine vinegar and sliced chilies and/or the optional thyme. If using the scallops, remove from grill and serve with grilled beef and/or seafood, or serve as a side dish with rice pilaf or naan bread.

title: Linguine & Chunky Kiwi Salad
ingredients: 6 ounces linguine ( or other long pasta ) | 1 onion, sliced very finely | 1 ripe kiwi, roughly chopped | 1 tablespoon mayonnaise ( miracle whip does good ) | 3 -6 tablespoons sweet rum ( optional ) | 1 large potato, thinly sliced
instructions: Cook pasta according to instructions on package, drain& set aside. In medium frying pan, fry onions and kiwi gently until just beginning to soften add mayo and rum if using. Meanwhile, spear potato slices, cut in half and grill, until crisp. Remove kiwi from sauce& toss with pasta until coated. Pile salad onto plates and top with kiwi.

title: Choclovers Chocolate Turnips With Yoghurt (Or Hard Chocolate)
ingredients: 2 medium turnips | 500 ml thick sheep's milk plain yogurt | 50 g dark chocolate
instructions: Preheat oven 200°c. Halve & core the turnips then cut into thin matchsticks. Wrap about half a teaspoon of yoghurt or black currant jam in cheesecloth and tie shut with kitchen string. Place all the turnips in a baking dish & cook slowly for 1/2 hour till they feel soft but not mushy on the inside. Serve warm or chilled.

title: Mango and Pistachio Salad
ingredients: 1 cup mango | 1/2 cup pistachios | 3/4 cup ruby port | 4 tablespoons white vinegar | 1 -2 tablespoon sesame seeds
instructions: Prepare the pesto ingredients in a blender, except sesame seeds, until smooth. Add remaining ingredients to blender and blend for 30 seconds, scraping down sides of bowl occasionally. Pour the pesto into a clear glass bowl. Top with sesame seeds to serve.

title: Smokin' Sweet Beef
ingredients: 1 beef round sirloin, trimmed | 1 can crushed pineapple | 2 tablespoons catsup | 1 1/2 teaspoons liquid smoke flavoring
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat.

title: Grilled Peppers With Shallots and Peppers
ingredients: 16 shallots, peeled | 4 yellow bell peppers, roasted ( hot roasted peppers can be purchased in any or all supermarkets )
instructions: If roasted peppers have pith, trim off tops. Place shallots, 2 inch pieces of roasted hot peppers, on a parchment lined or lightly oiled grill pan. Over medium heat grill may take from heat. Grill, turning once or twice, for 10 minutes or until tender and lightly toasted. Immediately, arrange on a sheet of plastic wrap or foil and allow to cool. Slice shallots vertically into thirds. Serve with roasted green peppercorn brine. Enjoy.

title: Scallops in Coconut Sour Cream
ingredients: 3 tablespoons coconut cream ( unsweetened ) | 10 small whole scallops
instructions: Put the coconut cream in a small skillet. Add the scallops and let cook over medium heat until the scallops appear opaque, 10 - 15 minutes. Remove from heat and serve.

Random Ingredients: peppercorn,worcestershire sauce,sole fillet,green bean,beef bouillon cube,mexican tomato
title: Spanish American Platter
ingredients: 1 lb sole fillet | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1/8 teaspoon peppercorn | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 can mexican-style stewed tomatoes, undrained | 1/3 cup green beans, cut into 1 inch pieces
instructions: Rinse fish. Cut into serving pieces and pat dry. Coat bottom of a shallow dish with cooking spray. Arrange fish, skin side down, on dish. In medium bowl, combine bouillon cube, peppercorns, and worcestershire. Place tomatoes on top of fish and pour the mixture over fish. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Remove fish from refrigerator 15 minutes before cooking. Rinse off any remaining liquid. Cover and continue to bake in preheated 325 degree oven until fish is just cooked through, about 45 minutes.

title: Pasteles de Piemontes (Pasteles with pearl onions)
ingredients: 4 cups white pearl onions, divided | 2 cups spelt flour | 1 cup half-and-half
instructions: Rinse 1 cup of pearl onions under cold water and then place them in a saucepan with about 1 1/2 cups water. Cover and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Add about 1 1/2 cup pearl onion mixture to the saucepan and set aside. In a separate saucepan, bring a potful of the pearl onions and their liquid to a boil. Drop in more pearl onions and their liquid as necessary and gently boil for 5 minutes. Mix in the spelt flour and cook over low heat, stirring often with a fork, for 5 to 7 minutes. Stir in the half and half and heat through. Remove pot from heat, remove onions and flour from the spelt flour and roll out onto a floured board until it is about 2/3 inch thick. Cut the rolled out dough into the desired size pieces and arrange on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper or aluminum foil to cool. Store covered in the refrigerator.

title: Ziti With Ziti
ingredients: 2 cups ziti pasta, dry from the box | 3 cups ice water
instructions: Bring water to a boil. Add ziti to boiling water. Add ice. Cook for about 40 minutes until ziti is done floating to the surface. Drain ziti. Serve with sauce.

title: Passionfruit Juice
ingredients: 2 ounces passion fruit juice, with pulp | 1 pinch salt and black pepper
instructions: In a glass jar with a lid, mix together the passion fruit juice and salt and pepper. Seal the lid and shake vigourously. Pour into chilled glasses and serve.

title: Cheesy Red Onions
ingredients: 1 large red onion, sliced | 1/4 cup shredded cheddar cheese | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Sprinkle the onion with a teaspoon of the cheese. Sprinkle evenly with pepper. Cook over medium heat for five minutes or until the cheese has melted completely.

title: Gerry's Key Lime Refresher
ingredients: 500 g unbleached white bread flour | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom | 2 teaspoons salt | 2 teaspoons yeast
instructions: Combine all ingredients and knead to smooth dough. Divide dough into two portions and form into balls slightly smaller than you want. Place on floured tray and place in a warm place with a dough hook on top. Cover and let it double in size for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Knead and cut into pieces. Let it double again until you get a nice firm dough, but not too stiff that you need to knead it by hand before you put the oven on low. After about 45 min you will notice that you feel all the dough is starting to stretch around the edge. If this happens, it means that the dough has absorbed all the air from the air and is no longer sticky. After 45 mins let stand until you are able to shape the dough enough to eat. After 30 mins remove dough from the oven and immediately sprinkle with cardamom powder or any other spice of your choice. If it doesn't seem to be quite enough spice, sprinkle with a little sugar.

Random Ingredients: cherry,candy,oregano leaf,garlic powder,graham cracker crumb,french mustard
title: Finger-Licking French Cherry Balls
ingredients: 12 ounces refrigerated graham cracker crumbs | 2 tablespoons granulated unbleached cane sugar or 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons prepared french mustard | 1/8 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/8 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 can sour cherry halves in heavy syrup | 1 jar sweetened condensed milk and whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Place graham cracker crumbs, sugar, mustard, oregano, and garlic in small bowl, breaking up larger piece of bread with fork. Roll bread in crumb mixture until all crackers are coated. Spread 1 cup cherry mixture evenly in ungreased 9 x 13 inch baking dish. Chill at least 1 hour. Spoon remaining half of cherry mixture evenly over bread, smoothing mixture, evenly. Cover and chill 3 to 4 hours. Remove cover and discard remaining mixture. Cut cherry mixture into wedges if using, if using. Spoon reserved tomato sauce over cherry mixture. Cover and chill about 3 hours.

Random Ingredients: bean,pine nut,rice flour,italian salad dressing mix,hoisin sauce,frisee
title: Italian Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 cup cooked rice stick ( i prefer sushi rice sticks ) | 2 cans baked beans | 1 envelope italian salad dressing mix | 1 1/2 cups hoisin sauce | 1 cup of crushed fried frankfurters ( drained ) or 1 cup crushed nuts ( drained ) | 1/4 cup pine nuts ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients except nuts in a large bowl and toss to evenly mix. Top with reserved crumb topping. Sprinkle additional crumble topping and nuts, if desired.

title: Lebanese Eggplant and Poached Avgolemono
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs small eggplant | 1/2 cup green olives | 1/4 cup dried apricot, chopped | 2 tablespoons dried guava, chopped | 1/8 teaspoon anise seed | 3/4 cup whipping cream | 1/4 teaspoon dried marjoram, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon ground anise seed
instructions: Cut eggplant and olives into 1/4 inch slices. Combine stuffing ingredients, then mix in eggplant and olives, coating evenly. Arrange stuffing in a greased 2 quart casserole. Bake uncovered in a preheated 350 degree f oven until center is puffed and lightly browned, about 35 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Sautéed Onion Soup -- Dutch Crock Pot Recipe
ingredients: 2 lbs medium to large onions, peeled, washed and chopped | 4 cups cold water
instructions: Sauté onions over medium heat in soup pot just enough water to cover and allow to steam for 15 minutes or until tender. Do not let this water boil as this will make the soup water cloudy and not the sweetened water that will be in the vegetables. Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Papas Con Squash Chips
ingredients: 1 lb yellow squash, sliced into thin chips | 1 -2 tablespoon dijon mustard, if desired | 2 cups corn chips
instructions: Combine all ingredients and toss to coat all the vegetables and chips. Serve immediately or refrigerate overnight.

Random Ingredients: bisquick,egg noodle,red chile pepper,nonfat plain yogurt,escarole,pear,romaine lettuce,green cardamom pod
title: Pear Tandoori Noodle Kugel
ingredients: 1 package uncooked dry egg noodles | 1 package uncooked nonfat plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon bisquick | 2 green cardamom pods, crushed | 5 whole dried red chile peppers, crushed | 1 pound shelled, toasted pear slices | 1 head escarole, cleaned and chopped, divided | 1 package leaves romaine lettuce
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Prepare noodles according to package directions and drain.

title: Jamaican Steamed Orange and Brown Rice
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef, cut into cubes | vegetable oil or other cooking spray ( for steaming ) | 2 packages frozen mixed vegetables | 1 bag collard greens | 1 cup orange juice | 2 cups arborio rice ( or other short grain rice )
instructions: Place rice into a 2 quart casserole dish with enough oil to cover. Place meat in preheated oil and bake for 2 hours at 300°f. After 2 hours, put vegetables, and the orange juice into a dutch oven and heat. When meat has been in, add brown rice and stir to coat ingredients with the sauce.

title: Quick and Easy Chicken Cacciatore
ingredients: 6 ounces skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into strips | 1 pound italian sausage | 1 package prewashed baby carrots | 12 ounces canned sliced cooked cod
instructions: Place chicken in a skillet large enough to accommodate all the chicken pieces and sausage. Cook over medium high heat, turning often, until evenly browned, 4 to 5 minutes. Remove from skillet and drain on paper towels. Remove sausage from casing and crumble into skillet and cook over medium high heat, stirring frequently, until browned and crumbly, 5 to 6 minutes. Drain oil from skillet. Arrange carrots in a large, shallow baking dish. Spread 1/2 the sausage in the center of each carrot. Spread cod over sausage and top with remaining sausage, carrots, and cod. Cover baking dish with plastic wrap, and refrigerate overnight. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Uncover casserole and bake in preheated oven until hot and bubbly, about 45 minutes to 1 hour. Remove from oven and top each portion with a slice of fresh tomato, if desired.

title: Quick and Easy Moroccan Beef
ingredients: 1 kg chuck roast, cut into 1 inch cubes | 2 tablespoons harissa | 2 tablespoons soya sauce | 2 tablespoons lime zest, finely grated | 1 teaspoon cinnamon | 2 cups frozen peas
instructions: Coat meat with harissa, then toss in the zest and cinnamon. Cook the meat in the oil in a large pan for 30 minutes until it is starting to brown on the edges, turning often. Add the peas and cook for another 5 minutes.

title: Tahini Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 1 tablespoon tahini | 2 teaspoons cold water | 1 dash tabasco sauce
instructions: Brown hamburger. Mix with other ingredients. Serve over pasta or crackers.

title: Sausage Sticks
ingredients: 12 links sweet italian sausage links | 1 lb leftover cooked egg roll dough ( a little over 1/2 cup dry weight ) | 12 ancho chiles | 1/3 cup wine
instructions: Peel the hard casing from the sausage links and cut each link into halves or thirds. Wet both edge with water and pinch shut. Set sausage aside. Slice the chiles or to preference. Roll dough into long strips about 3/4 inch wide at each end. Wrap each sausage link with about a teaspoon of chile. Roll dough up from long side and tie it with kitchen string. Place on greased cookie sheets and let rise about 1 hour. Bake, uncovered at 375 degrees f for 30 - 35 minutes or until golden brown. Add wine at the end of cooking.

title: Easy Crockpot Drambuie
ingredients: 1/8 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 1/2 cups cold beef bouillon | 2 tablespoons snipped fresh italian parsley | 1/2 cup drambuie, liquor
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in the slow cooker. Cover and cook on low 8 - 10 hours. Serve with hot cooked italian noodles.

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,garam masala,chutney,brown sugar,mustard seed,maple syrup,garlic
title: Churrasco Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup maple syrup | 2 tablespoons chutney ( your favorite ) | 2 teaspoons packed brown sugar | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/2 teaspoon garlic | 1/4 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: In a blender, combine all ingredients. Blend for 1 minute until slightly combined. Add more chutney, if desired. Keeps in refrigerator an tabbouleh consistency.

title: Corrobata (Brazilian Beef Mince Stew)
ingredients: 500 g beef mince | 1 tablespoon raisins | 1 tablespoon molasses | 8 tablespoons mayonnaise | 2 tablespoons sweet paprika | 1/4 teaspoon dried tarragon | 2 -3 tablespoons fresh cilantro, chopped for garnish
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well to combine. Serve with bread, crusty, italian bread or toast. Variation, for a thinner mince, mix equal amounts of cornstarch and cold water to obtain a paste. Add to meat and braise on the barbecue, approximately 10 minutes. Serve with white rice and sliced tomato. Note, can also make thick mayonnaise by melting the oil, vinegar and sugar together, stirring well and mixing in half of the mixture to form a paste.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,red pepper,gruyere cheese,beef chuck,sharp cheddar cheese,grape tomato,canadian bacon,corn tortilla
title: Chef Julian's Favorite Mexican Pizza
ingredients: 2 lbs thinly cut boneless beef chuck | 4 slices canadian bacon ( or other bacon ) | 1 cup grape tomatoes, cut in half | 1/2 cup finely chopped red pepper | 2 cups shredded gruyere cheese, divided | 1/2 cup grated sharp cheddar cheese, divided | 1/4 cup canadian bacon, diced, drained | 1/2 vanilla bean, split lengthwise | 1 dozen corn tortillas
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Using 2 tblsps. Of canola oil in a large skillet over medium high heat, add beef, reduce heat to medium and add canadian bacon, grape tomatoes, red peppers, 1/2 c. Of the gruyere, and 1/2 c. Of the cheddar cheese. Stir and roast beef for 45 to 60 minutes or until cooked. Remove meat and bacon and discard fat. Return mixture to skillet and mash. Simmer for 5 minutes to heat through. Using a mortar and pestle, mash the vanilla bean with the remaining gruyere and cheddar. Slice meat and return to skillet, mix, then stir. Top with bacon, tomato, and red pepper mixture. Warm corn tortillas on the counter, or use a heavy skillet. Spoon some of the meat sauce in the tortilla. Top with remaining tortillas, then top with the rest of the cheese. Serve at once. Cooks note, canadian bacon can be sliced. You can get away with using the slices of bacon instead of canadian bacon, or you can substitute other smoked bacon.

title: Baked Cheese Fingers
ingredients: 18 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, grated ( a sharp cheese of your choice will do ) | 4 teaspoons baking powder ( use heaping tsp if you like )
instructions: Pre heat the oven to 325f & grease a baking sheet or a cookie sheet. Mix the baking powder & sprinkle or pat of the grated cheese. Drop the mixture by heaping tsp or so in the hot oven, bake for approx 10 mins or till the tops are golden. Allow to cool before eating as the cheese melts & is easy to scoop out of the cookie sheets. If the top is too dark, leave the top as is for a few mins before eating.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti,baking powder,gingerroot,chunky salsa,maraschino cherry,onion salt,pineapple juice,cottage cheese
title: Pesto Spaghetti With Sweet Home Filling
ingredients: 1 package spaghetti | 1/2 tablespoon baking powder | 1 teaspoon onion salt | 2 teaspoons gingerroot, crushed | 1/4 cup chunky salsa | 1 can crushed pineapple in juice | 1 cup low fat cottage cheese | 1 jar maraschino cherries, drained
instructions: Cook pasta according to directions. Cover to prevent over cooking, and keep warm. Drain juice from pineapple into a sauce pan. Add salsa and stir. Let simmer for 3 - 4 minutes. Drain and cool. Fold cottage cheese and cherry into sauce. Fold in drained spaghetti. Pour into a shallow serving bowl. Sprinkle with onion salt.

Random Ingredients: olive oil,lima bean,tomato puree,soy sauce,caster sugar,vanilla yogurt,batter
title: Tasty Hummus
ingredients: 1/4 cup soy sauce | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 2 teaspoons tomato puree | 2 teaspoons puree ( tomato sauce ) | 1 -2 teaspoon ground vanilla yogurt | 1 pinch salt | 1 1/4 cups frozen lima beans, thawed
instructions: In a small shallow bowl combine all the ingredients and mix well. Place the frozen lima beans around the edge of the bowl to resemble a nest. Heat a small, non stick frying pan over med. Heat and then add olive oil. Place the pan over a med high, heat and when the oil is hot, add the frozen lima beans, shaking the pan to coat. When the beans are cooked, remove from the heat. Spoon the bean mixture into a bowl and pour over the yogurt. Chill the bowl in the fridge overnight and serve with pita chips.

title: Spicy Kielbasa
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs kielbasa, cut in 1 `` slices | 2 cans chicken stock | 1 dried red chilies, coarsely chopped
instructions: In a large crock, combine the chicken stock and dried chilies or black chilis. Add the kielbasa and allow to stand at room temperature for about 1 hour prior to cooking. The kielbasa will be cooked through and tender, with the flavors of your choice and can also be grilled over charcoal for an extra smoke flavor.

title: Pecorino and Tomato Soup
ingredients: 1 cup tomato | 250 ml coconut milk | 1/3 cup pecorino romano cheese | 1 loaf italian bread
instructions: Boil water in a large pot, add pecorino romano and mix well. Add tomato and salt and cook until it starts to become slightly thickened. You can either leave it on stove until it reaches desired consistency for the soup and eat with your favorite meal. Serve and enjoy ps, you can also leave it on the stove and serve it chilled. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: pistachio nut,black olive,chicken breast half,corn oil,ketchup,bean sprout
title: Faux Pistachio Chicken
ingredients: 1 cup shelled pistachio nuts | 1/2 cup corn oil | 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1/3 cup ketchup or 1/3 cup tomato ketchup | 16 ounces fresh bean sprouts | 1/2 cup chopped black olives
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In food processor, pulverize pistachios with pistachios until coarsely ground. Pour oil through a sieve into a small bowl. Dip chicken into oil, then dip into pistachios, pressing nuts onto paper towels. Place chicken in a heavy 12x18 pan, reserving any excess oil. Arrange in 2 rows of 6 overlapping. Top with 1/2 cup ketchup. Bake, uncovered, 30 minutes, brushing occasionally with ketchup and adding 1/4 cup water if necassary. Top with beansprouts, olives and remaining pistachios. Increase heat to 400 degreesf and bake, until chicken is no longer pink inside and juices run clear, about 30 minutes longer.

Random Ingredients: sea bass fillet,club soda,flour,cumin seed,escarole,chili pepper flake,vegetable oil cooking spray,beef rib
title: Seafood in Red Wine With Beef
ingredients: seasoned flour, for dusting | 1 teaspoon cumin seed ( or to taste ) | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons cooking spray | 1 head escarole, cleaned and chopped roughly ( about 1 pound ) | 3 -4 ounces beef short rib or 3 -4 ounces cod, cut into bite size pieces ( about 3 to 4 ounces ) | chili pepper flakes, for garnish | club soda, for serving | dried whole chili pepper flakes, for garnish
instructions: Preheat broiler. Lightly coat 1 gallon plastic zipper bag with flour, then set aside. In medium saucepan, lightly toast cumin seed on both sides until fragrant and slightly darkened, 1 - 2 minutes. If using dry chili peppers, remove them from the pan and set aside. Add oil to pan and heat over medium heat. Add escarole and saute 2 - 3 minutes, until wilted. Transfer to bowl and set aside. Add beef and cook until browned, about 4 minutes. Add 1/4 cup of chili pepper liquid and season with additional salt to taste. Drain excess fat. Stir in cumin seeds. Divide among 6 plates. Top each with a generous spoonful of the white and red wine mixture, then garnish with a chili pepper flakes. If using fresh chili peppers, remove stems and seeds. Note, if using dried whole pepper flakes, do not add as the flavour is too intense.

Random Ingredients: pizza crust,mozzarella cheese,jicama,fettuccine,beef broth,fenugreek seed,vegetable oil cooking spray,oregano
title: Fettuccine With Pesarattes and Pecan Cheese
ingredients: 8 ounces dried fettuccine | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 jar jicama, cut into matchsticks | 2 tablespoons minced fenugreek seeds | 1 tablespoon dried oregano | 1 can beef broth | 1 prepared pizza crust, sliced 1/4-inch thick | 1 package shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: In a large pot, cover the fettuccine with boiling water and let stand for 8 to 10 minutes until al dente. Drain, then transfer to a bowl. Meanwhile, heat 1 teaspoon of vegetable oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the jicama and fenugreek seeks and cook, tossing, until fragrant, about 1 minute. Transfer to a bowl and stir in oregano. Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. Spread the pasta on a large baking sheet coated with cooking spray. Top with the jicama mixture and pour beef broth over pasta. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until the mozzarella is melted and the noodles are warm and beginning to crisp, stirring once and then returning to the oven. Place the prepared pizza crust on a cookie sheet and top with shredded mozzarella. Let sit for 5 minutes. Cut and serve.

Random Ingredients: ladyfinger,cannelloni tube,rice,beef bouillon cube,green bell pepper,tamarind concentrate
title: Rice Salad
ingredients: 30 ladyfingers | 1 lb lean ground beef round | 1/2 green bell pepper, chopped | 1 package frozen cannelloni tubes, thawed | 1 cup cooked rice | 1 can tamarind concentrate | 1 beef bouillon cube
instructions: Lay out a 13x9 inch pan and layer ladyfingers into pan.

title: Coconut Cream
ingredients: 2/3 cup coconut cream | salt & pepper
instructions: Blend in blender or food processeor till smooth. Store in freezer. Can freeze to serve over ice cream if desired. Sprinkle with extra coconut if desired.

Random Ingredients: splenda sugar substitute,vanilla,sage,dark sesame oil,corn oil,pita bread,crabmeat,egg yolk
title: Crispy Baked Pita Breads
ingredients: 1 egg yolk | 2 1/4 cups light corn oil | 3/4 cup splenda sugar substitute | 2 teaspoons vanilla | 2 tablespoons dried chopped sage | 24 ounces canned crabmeat | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 6 pita bread, cut in half crosswise
instructions: In a glass or plastic pie plate, whip egg yolk until a pale yellow. Stir in oil, splenda, vanilla, saffron, and sage. Place bread halves, rough side up, on rack of grill or broiler pan. Brush tops lightly with sesame oil. Grill or broil 3 to 4 minutes, until light brown. Turn on oven to 450 degrees f. Wrap a cookie sheet with plastic wrap, and invert onto a rack to cool for 20 minutes. Cut into 6 wedges. In a small dish, combine crab, sesame oil, and 1 tablespoon of the spanish smoked paprika. Cover and refrigerate crab mixture for 5 hours or overnight. Line a baking sheet with foil and spray with cooking oil. Remove crab mixture from the refrigerator, unwrap, and sprinkle with smoked paprika mixture. Using a spatula, toss well. Serve on plates topped with 1 to 2 wedge of bread.

Random Ingredients: red wine,rump roast,purpose flour,apple juice,goya extra virgin olive oil
title: Pot Roast With Apple Wine and Garlic
ingredients: 1 rump roast, cut into 1-inch chunks | 1 cup diced fresh apple and juice | 1/2 cup dry red wine | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 1 tablespoon goya extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Combine apple juice, wine, 1/2 cup flour, and 1 tablespoon olive oil in a large bowl and whisk until combined. Place beef in a shallow dish or roasting pan and pour tomato mixture over beef. Cover tightly and refrigerate overnight. Remove beef from refrigerator 30 minutes before cooking and place in cold oven. Preheat oven to 475°f and cook about 20 minutes or until meat is tender crisp.

title: Perfect Roast Chicken
ingredients: 1 box graham cracker crumbs | 1 can chicken broth
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Drain the chicken, removing any excess fat and skin. Mash or mix crumbs, chicken broth and shredded chicken until well combined. Use about 3 tablespoons crumb mixture to apply to entire cavity. Place in a roasting pan. Cover with aluminum foil, crimping it to create a seal on the top. Bake in the preheated oven for 1 hour and 45 minutes, basting occasionally with the gravy. Baste with gravy if necessary to brown.

Random Ingredients: orange juice concentrate,red pepper,saffron strand,parmigiano reggiano cheese,italian sausage link
title: Pagertino All'Amatriciana (Italian Sausage, Peppers and Penne)
ingredients: 2/3 cup saffron strands | 1/3 cup orange juice concentrate | 12 hot italian sausages ( mild or hot ) | 2 sweet peppers, thinly sliced | 1 sweet red pepper, thinly sliced | freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese, for garnish
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place the saffron strands in a small bowl and pour 1/2 cup boiling water over them. Let the saffron soak, stirring occasionally, until soft, about 15 minutes. Drain the sausages in a strainer and transfer to a medium bowl. Add the orange juice concentrate, sweet peppers and rinsed saffron and gently mix until blended. Line a 1 1/2 quart baking dish with the sautéed sweet peppers. Place 1 sliced sausages into the baking dish, then top with a few slices of red pepper and a small sprinkling of parmigiano reggiano cheese. Bake until heated through, about 15 minutes, or until garlic is golden.

Random Ingredients: beer,sirloin,poultry seasoning,spinach leaf,taco seasoning mix,orange peel,lettuce leaf,escarole
title: Mexican Steak Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 teaspoon minced orange peel | 1 lb lean ground sirloin | 1 envelope taco seasoning mix | 1 bottle beer | 1 head green leaf lettuce leaves | 1 head escarole, rinsed and patted dry | 1 package frozen chopped spinach leaves, thawed and squeezed dry | 4 hoagie rolls or 5 hoagie rolls, split
instructions: Combine the orange peel and ground beef in a large skillet, and brown over medium heat, breaking up the meat with a wooden spoon, until mostly cooked through but not browned, about 6 minutes. Spread taco seasoning evenly over the beef and set aside. Pour beer into the skillet, and whisk in the taco seasoning mix, stirring to combine. Pour half of the sauce over the beef. Stir in the green leaves, lettuce, escarole, and spinach, and then spoon remaining sauce over everything. Serve over hoagies.

Random Ingredients: pizza crust,dark sesame oil,buttermilk,spring onion,date,herbes de provence,spaghetti sauce
title: French Onion Pizza
ingredients: 1 cup fresh dates | 1/4 cup buttermilk | 2 spring onions, trimmed and sliced | 2 cans spaghetti sauce | 1/3 cup dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon herbes de provence | 1 pizza crust, pre-baked, or
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Place dates, buttermilk, and spring onions in a small baking dish. Cover with a lid or roasting pan if possible and roast in preheated oven for 15 to 20 minutes. Cool to room temperature. Mix spaghetti sauce, sesame oil, and herbes de provence in a bowl until smooth. Uncover pizza crust with tomato and onion mixture and smooth to desired texture. Slide pizza onto top of tomato and onion mixture, or press onto top of other pizza in pan if desired. Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, 10 to 25 minutes.

title: Harmonade Flambe
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh lavender | 1/2 teaspoon thyme | 4 ounces ghee | 4 ounces pineapple rings ( or other dark fruits ) | 4 ounces beer
instructions: Wash and pat dry all the lavender with kitchen paper. Finely chop the lavender and thyme. Melt the melted ghee on low heat in a frying pan. Drop in the crushed lavender and thyme and toss lightly with the palm of your hand to loosen all the bits of lavender. Pour in the beer and simmer gently until the mixture reaches the thickness of honey. Do not allow to boil remove from the heat. Leave to cool completely. The rum should have sunk to the top, if it does, transfer the rum to a clean dry vessel. Serve.

title: Apricot Jelly
ingredients: 1 can apricot jam | 3 tablespoons rice wine vinegar
instructions: In a small bowl combine apricot jam and rice wine vinegar and mix well. Place jelly in a small saucepan over a medium heat and bring to a boil stirring constantly. Remove from heat and cool on the counter. Pour into jars, leaving 1/4 headspace.

title: Simple Baked Chicken and Spinach
ingredients: 4 skinless chicken cutlets | 4 cups baby spinach | 4 cups self-raising flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Place chicken in a baking dish. Sprinkle with salt and pepper and place in oven for 40 minutes, turning once or twice. The chicken and spinach should just start to colour, remove chicken from oven and cover with a lid or baking paper. Place in a warm room for 15 minutes, then remove from oven. Place a large handful of spinach on each plate and top with a piece of chicken. Top with remaining spinach, then a piece of baking paper.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,bean,tilapia fillet,ra el hanout spice mix
title: Tilapia with Chickpeas
ingredients: 4 frozen fat-free refried beans | 3 tablespoons ras el hanout spice mix | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/2 lb tilapia fillet
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Open cans of chickpeas and drain them. In a medium bowl combine the refried beans, ras el hanout, garlic salt, and ½ cup water. Cut the tilapia fillet into 4 pieces and place them in the bowl with the spice mix. Add more water if necessary. Place tilapia pieces on a foil lined baking pan or large plate. Bake approximately 20 minutes for a medium internal temperature. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,kalamata olive,pear,greek yogurt,russet potato,baby carrot
title: Greek-Style Rice Casserole
ingredients: 8 ounces lowfat greek yogurt | 1 lb fully-cooked small russet potato, cut into 2-inch pieces | 3 ounces canned pears, cut into 1/2-inch dice | 2 teaspoons dried pimentos kalamata olives, finely chopped ( optional ) | 1/2 cup baby carrots, cut in half lengthwise ( about 2 cups ) | 1/4 cup whole grain white rice, uncooked
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°. Line an 11 by 7 inch baking dish with parchment or waxed paper. Combine the yogurt and yoghurt in a medium size bowl and blend in the potato, pears, olives and carrots. Transfer the contents of the bowl to a medium size, nonstick saucepan. Add the rice and stir well. Bring to a boil, then transfer to the oven. Bake until the center of the casserole is hot and the rice is tender, about 30 minutes. Remove from the oven. Stir occasionally while the casserole is in the oven. Cool the casserole for 20 minutes. Transfer to a cutting board and cut into squares.

title: Quick Taco Meat
ingredients: 1 envelope taco seasoning mix | 1 cup marinated marinated white beans ( i use pinto beans )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Mix all ingredients well and put in a sealed, non stick baking dish. Bake for 30 minutes, then take out and let stand 5 - 10 minutes. Cut or serve.

title: Hawaiian Pineapple Rice Nuts
ingredients: 2 cups bread crumbs | 2 cups finely chopped pineapple | 3 -4 limes, juice of | 1/2 cup tamarind pulp ( optional ) | 8 ounces rice noodles, cooked
instructions: Blend all ingredients in a food processor until well blended and no chunks of pineapple remain. Refrigerate until completely cold, then cut into desired size pieces. Serve with your favorite dipping sauce, or eat your rice noodles and dip them in your favorite dipping sauce. Store in refrigerator.

title: Brown Rice and Beef Casserole
ingredients: 4 large potatoes | 1 1/2 lbs lean stewing beef, cut into bite size pieces | 3 cans chickpeas, drained | 1 can condensed golden potato liquid ( chickpeas, or canned chickpeas if you're feeling extravagant ) | 1 box frozen sweet potatoes ( not instant ) | 1 pint buttermilk | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1 tablespoon dried butter or 1 tablespoon cinnamon
instructions: Preheat your oven to 350 degrees. Put all ingredients except except the butter into a casserole dish. Cook for 1 hour in the oven, stirring halfway through, or until potatoes are tender. Stir butter and buttermilk and vanilla together in a bowl. Pour over warm potatoes and bake for about 1 hour.

title: Manchego Stuffed Okra
ingredients: 1 package frozen okra, thawed | 2 ounces soft mild goat cheese, crumbled | 2 slices manchego cheese
instructions: Remove and discard ends and strings from okra. Cook okra with goat cheese until lightly browned, about 5 - 8 minutes, stirring to loosen. Place on baking sheet. Spoon cheese mixture and okra onto each okra. Cut slit in half diagonally and serve.

Random Ingredients: pear,avocado,soymilk,wasabi powder,feta cheese,orange juice concentrate,garlic clove
title: Guacamole
ingredients: 6 -8 avocados | 1 tablespoon orange juice concentrate | 1/4 cup soymilk | 1/4 cup reduced fat feta cheese | 1/4 teaspoon wasabi powder | 1 garlic clove | 1/4 cup sliced pears, optional
instructions: Combine the avocados and orange juice in a bowl. Add the remaining ingredients and mix well. Note, as i was unable to find wasabi, i added garlic powder and then added 2/3 tsp of wasabi powder along with the cheese. It didn't make it quite a smooth puree and was very good. Great either way. You can also serve this cold or cold, as is.

Random Ingredients: italian tomato,rum,clam juice,fine sea salt,turmeric powder,brown sugar,cumin powder,chicken bouillon granule
title: Clamato (Mexican Style Clam-Lobster Stew)
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh clam or 2 lbs canned lobsters, cleaned of all shells | 1/4 cup light rum | 1 cup clam juice, made with 2 cups crushed canned italian tomatoes | 1 1/4 cups light brown sugar | 1/4 cup fine sea salt | 1 1/4 tablespoons chicken bouillon granules | 1 1/4 teaspoons cumin powder | 1 1/4 teaspoons turmeric powder
instructions: In a deep pot or dutch oven, combine all ingredients, except clams, and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat to low and simmer, tightly covered, for one and half to two hours, skimming most of the foam from the top at regular intervals. Do not boil. Just before serving, ladle into bowls. Garnish with fresh parsley or scallions to your liking.

Random Ingredients: red onion,sauce,green grape,chuck,red lentil,yellow cornmeal,ruby port
title: Red Lentil Pie
ingredients: 14 ounces red lentils | 15 ounces red lentils | 1 red onion | 4 tablespoons red gold hot sauce ( such as tabasco ) | 1 tablespoon yellow cornmeal | 2 tablespoons ruby port | 2 ounces mixed greens, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Cook lentils in 2 1/2 cups of water until soft. Mix in onion, hot sauce, yellow cornmeal and port. Combine well and pour into a pie dish. Cover and bake for 35mins or until crust is browned and lentils are hot. Slice red onion thickly and serve with crust.

title: Ziti Almonds
ingredients: 1/2 lb ziti pasta or 1/2 lb penne rigate | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract | fresh thyme sprig ( as desired )
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions, drain and set aside to cool. In a blender jar combine ziti and almond extract and puree the mixture until smooth, adding fresh thyme and more almond extract if desired. Serve sprinkled with additional sugar if desired.

title: Lobster Barley Potato Salad
ingredients: 4 cups small-mashed potatoes starch | 1 package frozen cooked lobster ( or fresh deli ) | 2 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese | 1/2 cup pearl barley | 1 medium banana | 1/2 cup dressing ( bottled )
instructions: Cook and stir potatoes for 5 minutes in a bowl coated with cooking spray until just tender. Drain and cool. Halve lobster. Remove shells and any meat from lobster and cut into smaller pieces. Stir potatoes and lobster. Spread potato salad in a shallow, rectangular baking dish. Arrange bananas on top, then sprinkle with parmesan cheese. Combine dressing and pour into a glass jar. Cover with plastic wrap and microwave on high for 2 minutes to heat.

Random Ingredients: egg white,sesame oil,teriyaki sauce,creole mustard,mayonnaise,chili pepper flake,toor dal
title: Egg Salad II
ingredients: 2 large egg whites | 2 tablespoons mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon creole mustard | 3 drops bottled hot chili pepper flakes ( or to taste ) | 1 teaspoon toasted sesame oil | 2 tablespoons teriyaki sauce
instructions: Using a fork, lightly beat the egg whites on a large platter. In a small bowl, combine the mayonnaise, creole mustard, chili flakes, sesame oil and teriyaki sauce until blended. Pour over the egg whites, folding gently until incorporated. Sprinkle with more toasted sesame oil, if desired.

title: Tuna Wrapped in Banana Leaves
ingredients: 1 can tuna ( not canned ) | 1 banana | 1 can bamboo shoots
instructions: Mix all the ingredients in a bowl. You can serve on banana leaves. You can enjoy.

Random Ingredients: apple juice,rocket,cherry tomato,cream tartar,cornflour,graham cracker crumb,chicken stock,vinegar
title: Apple and Honey Mustard Pie
ingredients: 375 g crusty round graham crackers, crushed | 1 pinch cream of tartar | 1/2 teaspoon vinegar | 310 g condensed chicken stock | 440 g canned low-fat apples, drained and juice drained | 310 g reduced-fat sour cream | 310 g fresh cherry tomatoes | 310 g rocket
instructions: Line a 20cm springform cake tin with baking paper and set aside. Combine the crumbs, cream of tartar and vinegar in a bowl. Add the condensed chicken stock, apples, sour cream, cherries and rocket and mix well. Spoon mixture into prepared crust and bake in the oven on medium for 30 to 35 minutes. Serve asap.

title: Aussie Onion and Garlic Tarts
ingredients: 2 sheets puff pastry | 1/3 cup dry nonfat beef broth
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Unfold puff pastry sheets.

title: Zesty Cheese Chicken Toasts
ingredients: 1/2 onion, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon reduced-calorie mayonnaise, or less to taste | 1 dash chicken bouillon | 1 tablespoon grated romano cheese | 1 dash low-calorie mayonnaise, or more to taste | 1 dash low-calorie mayonnaise, or more to taste | grated romano cheese, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Mix 1/2 onion, 1 tablespoon mayonnaise, 1 dash chicken bouillon, and 1 tablespoon romano cheese together in a bowl to make the dressing. Stir in 1 splash lowfat mayonnaise until smooth.

Random Ingredients: almond paste,white rum,curry paste,parsley leaf,beef tenderloin steak
title: Beef Tenderloin Steaks With Almond Paste
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin steak | 6 tablespoons sweet curry paste | 2 teaspoons almond paste | 2 teaspoons white rum | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley leaves
instructions: Sprinkle steaks with half the curry paste and half the almond paste. Roll steak in remaining curry paste and place in a shallow baking dish. Bake at 350° until tender, about 30 minutes per pound. Remove from oven and cool. Stir rum, remaining almonds paste and parsley into steaks, adjust seasonings and serve.

Random Ingredients: double cream,prune,onion,yellow bell pepper,dijon mustard,allspice,pumpkin seed,feta cheese
title: Grecian Pea and Feta Salad
ingredients: 200 g dry prunes | 200 g yellow bell peppers | 200 g feta cheese, bulgarian | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon dried onion | 1 teaspoon ground allspice | 150 ml double cream | 2 tablespoons pumpkin seeds
instructions: Roast prunes by preheating the oven on 190 c until blackened on all sides. Cool completely. When ready to use, remove and discard skins. Chop prunes into small pieces and coarsely chop yellow bell peppers. Combine crumbled feta, mustard, onion and allspice.

title: Quick and Easy Corn
ingredients: 1 can whole kernel corn | 1 cup chopped orange | 4 ounces catsup | 2 tablespoons dried tarragon | 1/2 tablespoon dried fennel seed | 1 teaspoon dried sage | tabasco sauce or hot sauce | 1/2 cup half-and-half cream | 1 tablespoon dried fenugreek seeds
instructions: In a medium sized mixing bowl combine all of the ingridients. Whisk or stir to combine. Serve immediately. Note, we like this with pita chips and grilled hamburgers.

title: Kielbasa and Tomatoes
ingredients: 1/2 lb kielbasa | 1 can whole tomatoes with juice | 1 dash pepper
instructions: In a skillet cook kielbasa over medium heat till no longer pink.

title: Japanese Style Scallion Triangles
ingredients: 2 scallions, white and green parts cut on half | 20 toothpicks | 2 teaspoons sesame oil
instructions: In a large skillet over medium heat, fry the scallions in the sesame oil for 10 minutes, stirring frequently. Remove from heat and arrange the scallions on a plate. Spoon about 1 tablespoon of scallion mixture onto the top of the scallion and roll up. Serve hot.

title: Aphrodisiac Pea Parathas (Peach Treats-Takes)
ingredients: 1/2 cup rice flour ( not glutinous rice flour ) | 2 tablespoons grated oats, preferably | 1/3 cup green peas ( frozen or fresh ) | 1/4 cup peach, in syrup, chopped | 1/8 cup grand marnier or 1/8 cup orange liqueur
instructions: Mix rice flour, oats and green peas together and add the grand marnier or orange liqueur. Form into small balls, then coat lightly in grated parathas. Refrigerate for at least 15 minutes or up to 4 hours.

title: Mushrooms & Raisins
ingredients: 4 ounces mushrooms | 2 tablespoons golden raisins ( or to taste ) | 2 tablespoons artificial sweetener ( optional )
instructions: Cook & stir mushrooms in hot water for about 5 minutes or until soft. Stir in raisins & sugar if using, cook one minute longer. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: cumin,jeera powder,meat,cod,rosemary sprig,red pepper flake,serrano pepper
title: Cod in the Crock Pot with Garlic and Herbs
ingredients: 4 1/2 lbs cod, cut into 6 pieces and skin removed | 4 lbs meat of your choice | 3 serrano peppers, quartered ( mild red pepper flakes can be substituted ) | 4 sprigs fresh rosemary sprigs | 3 cups roasted cumin, unseasoned | 2 tablespoons red pepper flakes | 3 tablespoons gebhardt ground cumin
instructions: Place the cod, skin and bones, peppers, and rosemary sprigs in a 4 quart crock pot. Pour the roasted cumin, red pepper flakes, and gebhardt on top, making sure it is well incorporated into the meat. Cook on high for about 4 hours, then stir. Cook for an additional 5 hours on low or high, until done.

title: Grilled Salmon With Cheese for Two
ingredients: sauce : | 1/4 cup freshly grated pecorino romano cheese | 4 salmon fillets, each about 1 1/2 pounds
instructions: Stir together the pecorino cheese and freshly grated romano cheese in a bowl. Place the salmon fillets on the preheated grill and season with salt and pepper. When the grate is nearly to the max, place the salmon fillets on top of the cheese, close the cover, and grill until the fish flakes easily with a fork, about 5 minutes per side.

title: Braised Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 beef tenderloin | 2 chicken stock | 8 ounces parsnips | 2 ounces lemons | 1 tablespoon dried marjoram or 1 tablespoon fresh marjoram | 2 tablespoons peanuts, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Cut beef in half lengthwise and crosswise. Sprinkle meat with coarse salt, if desired. Place beef, fat side up and in a shallow roasting tin. Bake for 30 - 35 minutes until cooked through and an instant read thermometer inserted into the thickest part of the meat registers 140f for medium rare. Transfer beef to a warmed serving platter and cover with foil to keep warm. Increase oven temperature to 450f. Meanwhile, mix together parsnip, lemon juice, marjoram, and peanuts. Serve.

title: Rabo Encendido
ingredients: 1 small beef brisket | 1/4 cup whole-grain rotel ( i used mild, hot ) | 1/2 teaspoon whole peppercorn | 2 tablespoons orange peel, finely minced
instructions: Place brisket in a 3 - 4 quart saucepan. Place remaining ingredients in sauce pan. Bring to a boil over high heat, stirring. Reduce heat to medium low and simmer, covered, until brisket is tender, about 3 hours.. Transfer brisket to a platter and strain broth through a sieve into a bowl. Skim off thickened sauce and discard solids.

title: Fruity Vegetable Pasta
ingredients: 1 package spaghetti noodles | 2 cups frozen raspberries | 1/2 cup sweet potato traditional mango slices | 1/2 cup wild rice wine ( or your favourite white wine vinegar ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/3 cup raspberry jam ( optional ) or 1/3 cup apricot preserves ( optional ) | 3/4 cup cooked rice cooked from fruity foods | 1 1/2 cups diced cooked sweet potatoes
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions, but keep warm. In a bowl, combine the raspberries, sweet potato, rice wine and vanilla extract. Set aside. In a large bowl, combine the jam, cheese and cooked sweet potato. Stir in sauce until blended. Drain pasta and serve immediately.

title: Nip Chips
ingredients: 4 parsnips, coarsely grated | 1/4 cup fresh sage leaves
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f or slightly lower, and line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper. Using kitchen shears, cut a deep x in the bottom of the chip to allow steam to escape while baking. Put a handful of grated parsnips in the baking sheet, and drizzle with sage. Dot with a little water if the chips don't adhere easily, and bake until crisp and crisp on the edges but firm and slightly browned, about 10 minutes, turning and sprinkling with more sage.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf italian parsley,bamboo shoot,parmigiano reggiano cheese,nonfat milk,picante sauce,salami,cauliflower floret
title: Picante Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 medium cauliflower floret | 2/3 cup picante sauce | 1 1/4 cups nonfat milk | 1/3 cup pitted canned bamboo shoot, cut in 1/4-inch dice | 1/4 cup dry cured salami, cut into 1/4-inch dice | 2 tablespoons fresh flat-leaf italian parsley, snipped | 1/4 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated
instructions: In a medium saucepan of boiling, salted water, cook the cauliflower 3 minutes. Add picante sauce.

title: Dynamite (Canned Corn)
ingredients: 1 can sweet corn, drained | 1 can pineapple with juice, drained | 1 bottle catsup | 1 can orange-flavored extract | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cumin | reduced-sodium tomato sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large storage container, cover, and refrigerate for at least 8 hours or overnight, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: ice water,loaf french bread,tomato sauce,white sugar
title: Tomato Sticks and French Bread
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs loaf french bread | 6 tablespoons white sugar | 1 cup canned tomato sauce | all-purpose ice water
instructions: Preheat grill. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil then spray with nonstick cooking spray. Slice bread in half lengthwise then in 1/4 inch thick slices. Spread each with sugar. Place pieces on foil on grill rack and cook until slightly browned and tender. Remove from grill using slotted spoon then place on cookie sheet, bake in a 300°f oven for 10 - 15 minutes or until lightly browned. While still hot, use slotted spoon to remove bread from foil and place on prepared cookie sheet. Spread tomato sauce over bread pieces and sprinkle top with a few tbsps. Of sugar. Allow to stand 1/2 hour. Gently remove from cookie sheet and cut into pieces or slices to serve.

title: Bacon Caesar Salad
ingredients: 1 package whole wheat penne | 2 large eggplants | 1 cup shredded romaine lettuce | 1/4 cup reduced-fat sour cream | 2 tablespoons bacon drippings
instructions: Cook penne in boiling water until al dente, 12 minutes or according to package directions.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,tortilla,lemon peel,steak grain,confectioner ' sugar,beef steak
title: Lemon Pepper Steak Frites
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs flank steaks or 1 1/2 lbs rib eye steaks | 1 1/4 cups fresh lemon peel, washed, trimmed and cut into thin strips | 1 1/2 cups confectioners'sugar | 1/4 cup quick-cooking oil | 12 -16 slices sweet tortillas | cooking oil ( for frying )
instructions: Cut the steaks at 1 inch intervals, about 1/4 inch wide, making sure they have been pounded to 1/4 inch thick. Soak the slices in the lemon peel for 20 minutes and then peel and cut strips into strips about 1 inch wide. Reserve the lemon peels and lemon strips for the garnish. In a separate bowl, combine 1 1/4 cups of the confectioners' sugar and the oil. Dip the steaks into the glaze and then into the tortilla strips to coat. Let stand for 15 - 30 minutes while you preheat the grill. Preheat 1/4 cup cooking oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Fry the steaks for 8 - 10 minutes, brushing them with the oil as they cook, until they are browned and crisp on the outside, they look firm when pressed on the bottom. Transfer them to a platter and cover with foil to keep warm. Remove the foil and continue to fry the remaining steaks, adding more cooking oil to the frying pan, as they are done. Cut the frites into 6 - 7 portions. Garnish each serving with the lemon strips and the reserved lemon slices. Serve with a dipping sauce and green salsa.

title: Corn Fritters
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cornflour | 2 fluid ounces dry sherry
instructions: Sift the cornflour and dry sherry into a bowl, and stir well until it is well combined. Using wet hands, form the mixture into patties or patties to suit your own tastes. Heat a non stick frying pan, then turn the heat on, or, lightly grease or oil lightly. Use a pastry brush or a large spoon to lightly brush with the sherry. Gently lift the cooked patties out of the pan, and fry on a hot griddle or frying pan, turning once. This will depend on the thickness of your patties and how you like your patties cooked. The patties may be kept warm in a 200 degree preheated oven, until all your batter runs.

Random Ingredients: maple syrup,pork loin,cheese,chicken bouillon cube,plum tomato,green pepper
title: Pueblo Smoked Pork Loin
ingredients: 6 -8 pork loin, skin removed ( country style loin, about 1 lb/1. thick ) | 2 -3 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon cube | 1 plum tomato, halved lengthwise ( optional, i've never used ) | 1 green pepper, cut in thin half moons ( optional ) | 1/4 cup pilsner style maple syrup ( `` or '' any syrup with 1/2 cup water ) | cheese, shredded
instructions: Place the lo of pork back in the freezer to get frozen. If using a whole tomato and green pepper, remove the seeds and juice. Place the loins in a large ziploc bag, and put the bouillon in the bag. Peal the bag, and remove the air from the bag. Squeeze the bag over the pork, close, and place in the fridge. At least one hour before you want to eat. Place the tomatoes and green pepper pieces with the juice and bouillon in a blender, and puree. It will take about 30 - 40 minutes to complete puree. While that does it is also a good time to throw in some oregano if you have it on hand. You want the marinade fairly thick. Slice the loins into strips, 3 - 5 inch wide and 2 long. When you are putting the pork in the oven, heat the broiler on high, and melt the cheese on the grill. Drain some of the fat if you are using them, but i don't recommend burning the cheese. Place the loins in a baking dish, and top with the tomato puree and puree. If you leave the loins in the pan, bake on a cookie sheet at 400/350/mark 3 for about 45 minutes, broil until well browned and bubbly, stirring every 10 - 12 minutes to keep the bread from forming a crust. Remove from the broiler and serve in big bowl. Enjoy this recipe makes about 1 1/2 servings per serving.

title: Tortellini Wrapped Tomatoes
ingredients: 14 1/2 ounces tortellini | 1 -2 canning ring
instructions: Rinse tomatos thoroughly then place in saucepan with water. Bring to boil then simmer slowly, covered. This should take about an hour. Remove from heat and carefully unwrap the canning jar. Pour out a 1/2 can of water and submerge tomatos into it, drain. Wipe can with a damp paper cloth. Set aside. Can also be stored in the freezer for use later. Bring to boil and simmer 5 - 10 minutes. Drain water then dip tomatos into the water one at a time. Drain well and slice. Place on serving platter and top with desired amount of cheese & tomato.

title: Easy Mushroom Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 4 large fresh mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the mushrooms and saute until just tender, about 5 to 6 minutes. Pour the warm dressing into the skillet. Toss to combine and serve.

title: Swedish-Style Rye Bread
ingredients: 1 cup shredded rye bread | 1 cup whipped topping | 3/4 cup mayonnaise, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Mix rye bread, whipped topping, and mayonnaise together in a bowl. Spread in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Cover bread with plastic wrap, and refrigerate until cold, 30 minutes to 1 hour. Slice bread in half horizontally.

title: Japanese Shoyu Beef Salad
ingredients: 3 -4 1/2 lbs sirloin steaks in one single layer, cut in bite-size pieces | 1/2 gallon mayonnaise | 1/3 cup mirin ( japanese sweet wine ) | 1/2 cup pineapple juice | 2 teaspoons crushed hot pepper flakes | 4 leeks, white and light purple parts only
instructions: Place beef in large bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate overnight. Remove meat from marinade and pat dry with paper towels. Drain and reserve marinade. Combine mayonnaise, mirin, pineapple juice, and hot pepper flakes in blender. Cover and blend until smooth. Place beef and reserved marinade in large bowl. Slice leeks.

title: Faux French Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread | cinnamon ( as much or little ) | black cumin
instructions: Cut the french bread into approximately one inch slices. Place the slices on a baking sheet. Sprinkle cinnamon and cumin on top. Bake at 300 degrees for fifteen minutes. Serve with fresh fruit juice, cold dips, etc.

Random Ingredients: lemon cake mix,lemon zest,chili oil,guacamole,beef broth,white pepper
title: Tex Mex Beef Cake
ingredients: 2 lbs ground beef or 2 lbs sirloin | 2 packages instant lemon cake mix | 1 can condensed beef broth | 1 tablespoon lemon zest | 1 teaspoon white pepper | 1 tablespoon chili oil
instructions: Heat a frying pan to high heat. Spray with nonstick cooking spray and brown ground beef or sirloin. When done, season with lemon peel, chili oil, and dash of white pepper. Add beef mixture, beef stock, lemon zest, and mix well. Bring to a boil and reduce heat to low. Cook for approximately 10 minutes or until cake mix turns from wet to moist. Pour mixture into a 2 quart casserole dish. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight. Remove from refrigerator 15 minutes before serving.

title: Almond-Crumb Cricks
ingredients: 2 cups dry bread crumbs | 1 cup ground blanched almonds
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line baking sheets with parchment paper. In a medium bowl, mix the bread crumbs, almonds and cajun seasoning ingredients together. Shape the crumbs into logs using 1 1/2 inch diameter biscuit as a guide. Place on prepared pans and bake in preheated oven for 20 to 30 minutes, or until the tops are lightly browned and crackers have turned golden with a toasted effect.

title: Chocolate Bavarian Sauce
ingredients: 1 ounce german sweet chocolate, chopped | 4 tablespoons sweet vermouth | 1/4 cup half-and-half | 1 tablespoon sweet vermouth | 1/4 teaspoon ground lemon wedge | 2 teaspoons sweet vermouth | 3/4 cup sweet vermouth | 2 teaspoons sweet vermouth
instructions: In a small bowl combine 3/4 cup vermouth and 1/4 cup of sweet vermouth. Microwave at full power on high for 2 to 3 seconds.

title: Apple Butter - Easy!
ingredients: 3 small apples | sea salt
instructions: Wash and peel the apples. Cut them into thick slices or wedges and place them into a mixing bowl. Sprinkle sea salt over the apples and mix thoroughly with your hands. Let sit for 1 hour or more and then mix in your favourite dry spice. Take a tablespoon of apple butter and gently spread all over the apples, or place them on a baking sheet in a single layer and bake in a preheated oven at 180c/350f/gas 3 for 25 - 30 minutes until crisp and golden brown.

title: Homemade Creamy Corn Salad
ingredients: 1 can frozen whole kernel corn, thawed | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup, undiluted | 1 can chickpeas, drained
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine corn, soup and chickpeas. Serve over cooked hot, chilled noodles or other vegetables.

Random Ingredients: mini chocolate chip,sirloin,couscous,soba noodle,yellow pepper,green cardamom pod,corn oil
title: Kheema Matbukha
ingredients: 2 teaspoons corn oil | 1 lb lean ground sirloin | 1/2 cup instant couscous | 2 green cardamom pods | 2 yellow peppers, cut in 1/2inch slices | 1/2 cup mini chocolate chip | 1/4 cup soba noodles, prepared according to package
instructions: Heat oil in large nonstick fry pan over high heat until sizzling. Add beef.

title: Olive Paste
ingredients: 1 cup spanish olives ( good quality, they should be pitted ) or 1 cup mixed olives ( good quality, they should be pitted ) | 2 tablespoons fresh ground mace
instructions: Place all of the above ingredients in a small food processor and process until finely chopped or to your desired consistency, about 1 minute or so. Add a pinch of salt, to taste or if desired, to give it one last stir before serving.

title: Mexican Barbecue Beans
ingredients: 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 1 jar barbecue sauce | 1 can kidney beans, drained
instructions: Combine the taco seasoning mix, barbeque sauce and kidney beans in a saucepan. Cover and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer until heated through, about 5 minutes. Do not boil. Serve over rice.

title: Avocado Salad (Ww 10 Points)
ingredients: 1/2 cup yellow split peas, rinsed | 1/2 cup chopped celery | 1/4 teaspoon dried sage | 1 avocado, peeled and cut into small chunks
instructions: Place peas, celery and sage in a bowl and toss with salt. Toss lightly. Place avocado chunks in a large bowl. Toss with peas and cook, tossing often, over medium heat for 2 - 3 minutes or until slightly softened.

Random Ingredients: fish,beef tenderloin,cooking oat,wonton skin,taco seasoning mix,spice,prosciutto
title: Tacos Beef Tacos
ingredients: 1 lb fresh lean ground beef or 1 lb ground turkey | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 3/4 cup quick-cooking oats | 2 slices prosciutto | 1/4 cup chopped smoked fish ( optional ) | 1 package wonton skins | wontons ( i use about 50 toothpicks )
instructions: Combine ground or turkey with taco seasoning mix and oats in a bowl. Divide between sheets of plastic wrap on a flat surface. Using a rolling pin, roll flat and stretch until the mixture is about 1/4 thick. Transfer mixture to a platter or baking sheet. Top each with a slice of proscuitto, if using. Cover each with plastic wrap.

title: Baked Mango Swiss Cheese Balls
ingredients: 4 cups shredded swiss cheese | 1 cup peeled seeded, finely diced ripe mango | 1 1/4 teaspoons baking soda, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 375ºf. Line a baking sheet with foil and spray with cooking spray. In medium bowl, stir together swiss cheese, mango, and 1/2 teaspoon baking soda until well blended. Roll into 1 inch balls and arrange on prepared baking sheet. Brush tops of balls with remaining 1 teaspoon baking soda.

title: Shanghai-Style Cashews (Shanghai Chao Qeema)
ingredients: 6 1/4 cups water-packed shanghai-style cashews, with skins ( mung bean sprouts ) | 6 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 2 tablespoons white peppercorns, cracked ( optional ) | 1 can water chestnuts, drained
instructions: Soak the cashews on a baking sheet in the refrigerator, uncovered, for at least five minutes, but no more than 10 minutes on the first day. Preheat an oven to 300 degrees f. Heat a skillet over high heat. Whisk the sesame oil and black pepper into the water using a pastry brush and spread evenly over the cashews. Remove from the oven. Use a slotted spoon or slotted spoon to remove the cashews from the cashews. Set aside. Spread the peanuts out in a single layer on a baking sheet. Bake in the center of the oven until the nuts turn a golden brown color, about 20 minutes. Use a slotted spoon to transfer to a wire rack to cool. Serve the shanghai style cashews at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: marsala wine,chicken broth,strawberry ice cream,coriander powder
title: The Ultimate Marsala Wine Broth Sundae Salad
ingredients: 1 cup chicken broth | 1/2 cup marsala wine ( not cooking wine ) | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder | whole strawberry ice cream
instructions: Add chicken broth to a pot in a 2 inch burst. Add marsala. Stir in coriander powder. Slowly add enough to barely cover base of glass container with sauce. Stir vigorously until desired consistancy is achieved. When serving, place 3/4 cup of ice cream inches of boiling water over ice cream and stir vigorously. Drain, rinse with cold water and remove ice cream from container. Place a scoop of ice cream over ice cream and garnish with remaining slice of fruit.

title: Sauce for Veggies and Chips
ingredients: 12 slices plum tomatoes | 1 can pitted black olives, drained | 1 package taco seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place tomatoes and olives in a single layer on a baking sheet. Sprinkle taco seasoning evenly over the tomatoes and olives. Bake in preheated oven for 15 to 20 minutes, or until heated through and hot, stirring frequently.

Random Ingredients: pasta sauce,arrowroot,chili paste,chili flake,chicken breast half,cake flour,golden raisin
title: Chilli Chicken With Sweet Nuts
ingredients: 6 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1/2 cup cake flour | 2 tablespoons chili paste ( i use an asian-style, or use 1-2 teaspoons of sweet soy sauce ) | 1/2 teaspoon chili flakes | 1/2 cup golden raisin ( or brown ) | 1/4 cup hot new zealand pasta sauce ( i like `` heinz italian sausages '' brand ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons arrowroot
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c, grease a baking sheet. Pound chicken breast, and then cut in half. Roll each piece in flour. Add to a non stick pan and cook on each side until browned. Remove chicken from pan. Place drained chicken in a bowl and keep warm. Add to onions on the chicken. Add sauce. Stir in raisins. Spoon chicken onto the onions. Combine arrowroot with a little cold water to form a paste and sprinkle into the pot. Seal mixture in well with cold water. Bring to the boil, stirring constantly. Reduce heat to low and simmer uncovered for 1/2 hour, or until thickened. I like mine thick, and it is so, so, you may vary the thickness of the gravy depending on your taste preferences.

title: Easy Low Fat Cabbage and Carrots
ingredients: 8 baby carrots, in matchsticks | 2 teaspoons garlic paste | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 teaspoon finely chopped white onion
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and leave to stand for an hour or so. If required, add more oil or water. Serve hot or at room temperature.

title: Finger-Lickened Sourdough Apple Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sourdough bread, toasted | 1 1/2 lbs ground apples ( i use granny smith apple in season ) | 2 inches gingerroot, peeled and grated coarsely
instructions: Mince the ginger. Squeeze the ginger to extract juices. Place ginger in bowl. Grate bread finely and mix into bowl. Add 1 1/2 t. Cider vinegar and mix again. Add more to taste and mix to make mixture dry but not mushy. Place bread mixture on cookie sheet and cook in oven at 350°f till golden about 15 to 20 minutes. It may be necessary to put the tray back in the oven for the second half to dry out some of the excess liquid. If the bread is not toasted and sticky, turn it out onto a paper towel lined plate. Cover with plastic wrap and let cool slightly about 10 minutes. Spread the bread mixture on a serving platter and cut into triangles or squares using a cookie cutter works best. Note, these can also be made in a nonstick frying pan, by coating with vegetable oil and turning over once or twice so they brown evenly. Also, use a spatula to cut the bread into squares or squares and place in individual bowls, so as not to burn the sandwich.

title: Garlicky Vegetable Chips
ingredients: 350 g plain flour | 1 teaspoon dried italian seasoning ( or any flavour of your choice ) | 1 teaspoon dried basil ( or parsley flakes ( if your flavour is strong ) | 300 g mixed vegetables ( broccoli, zucchini or cauliflower ) | 1 cucumber, chopped very finely | 1 radish, chopped very finely | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil or 1 tablespoon ghee, to fry
instructions: Sift flour into large bowl, seasonings and herbs into a big bowl. Toss through vegetables to coat the flour. Then drop into the bowl oil or ghee and toss all together until it has been evenly coated & has soaked up all the flour. The dough will be stiff. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Remove from fridge about 15 minutes before rolling. Preheat grill or griddle with oil if you have it. Oil grate, then place oil on grate and lightly press all the vegetables down. Grill on the griddle for 4 minutes each side then set aside. Roll each dough sheet out to a 4 cm thickness on a tea towel. Brush with a little oil and repeat with all the other dough shapes. The dough is now ready to be sliced or slobbed & deep fried. Variation, you can use plain flour that has been floured prior to rolling out & using as a lid for the chips. If so, pre season with water to ensure that it's all wet before adding to dough. Dollop the oil over the chips allowing for a few to swell up. Variation 3, to make the crispness on the crispness, use a teaspoon or two of water. If necessary, add 1/2 tablespoon of vegetable oil. Variation 3, add a little milk to help soften the crunchiness. Variation, for a crisper crisp texture try adding a little hot water to the oil after rolling out the dough using the tines of a fork & adding a little water after rolling out the dough again. Variation 4, when pinching the dough with your fingers, flatten the dough to form a circle approximately 30cm in diameter & 8cm thick. Cook over hot coals for 5 - 10 minutes or until golden brown or use a pizza cutter to cut out shapes. Variation 5, for a crispier taste, cook in a frying pan for 2 - 3 minutes or until crispy & lightly golden. Variation 6, heat a little oil in a frying pan for frying the garlicky vegetable chips, as you would a cake cook.

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,thai red chili pepper,malt vinegar
title: Homemade Chilie Vinegar
ingredients: 1 tablespoon whole fresh oregano leaves | 2 pods thai red chili peppers, halved and seeded | 1 1/2 cups malt vinegar
instructions: Place the oregano and chilie peppers in a heavy medium saucepan over low heat. Cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 2 minutes. Stir in the vinegar. Bring to a simmer, reduce the heat to low, and cook, uncovered, 5 to 7 minutes, until thickened. Taste and adjust the seasoning before serving.

Random Ingredients: marsala wine,broccoli floret,marjoram,rosemary sprig,halloumi cheese,habanero pepper,dark soy sauce
title: Broccoli-Stuffed Halloumi
ingredients: 2 ounces halloumi cheese | 3/4 cup low sodium white balsamic vinegar or 3/4 cup dark sherry wine vinegar | 1/2 lb broccoli floret | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon fresh marjoram or 1 tablespoon mint | 1 tablespoon fresh rosemary sprig | 2 habanero peppers, thinly sliced
instructions: Cut the cheese in the shape of a diamond. Wrap each cheese square with the length of one ham strip and secure with kitchen twine. In a steamer set over boiling water, steam the broccoli for about 5 minutes. Remove. In a medium saucepan of boiling water, cook broccoli for 2 - 3 minutes, until tender crisp. Drain, cool and finely chop. In a microwave safe bowl or a serving dish, combine the remaining ingredients. Microwave on high power, uncovered, for about 45 seconds. Stir, then reheat, stirring once or twice. Spoon the broccoli into an 8 ounce serving dish. Arrange the halloumi in a single layer on top. Pour the hot marinade over the halloumi and turn the dish to coat. Cover and cook on high power until the cheese has melted and begun to roll. Remove the dish from the microwave, cover, and set aside in the refrigerator for about 5 minutes to help set the cheese. To serve, remove the cheese and slice on the diagonal into strips about 1 1/2 inches wide. Serve with some crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: almond,ladyfinger,vegetable oil cooking spray,jumbo pasta shell,chili oil,carrot
title: Truffle Pasta Shells
ingredients: 8 ounces jumbo pasta shells, cooked and drained | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 medium carrot, shredded | 8 ounces cooked fresh lasagna noodles ( about 10 ) | 8 large ladyfingers | 1/4 cup sliced roasted almonds | 1 teaspoon chili oil ( optional )
instructions: Place uncooked pasta in a large bowl. Spray lightly with veggie spray. Top with carrot, noodles, noodles, and half the lettuce. Drizzle with chili oil, if using. Sprinkle with almonds on top of lettuce, or scatter with remaining lettuce.

title: My Best (Slow Cooker No-Cook)
ingredients: 1 beef tenderloin | 1 chuck | 1 jar diced beef | 1 packet beef bouillon
instructions: Slice beef, chuck, and pork into 1, 1 chunks. Layer in slow cooker along with the 1 jar of beef bullion. Put cooker on high and cook for 4 to 5 hours. The beef broth will be mostly absorbed. Remove from the heat. Cover and let stand for 30 minutes before serving.

title: Green Masala
ingredients: 2 tablespoons green chilies | 1/4 teaspoon onion powder | 2 tablespoons thai basil leaves or 1 teaspoon dried basil, crushed
instructions: Place onions and chilies in blender/food processor. Add basil leaves/toothpick. Pulse/blend to desired consistency and pour into jar. Keep in fridge. To serve, remove lid.

Random Ingredients: anaheim chilies,tilapia fillet,kosher salt,pork shoulder,tea,egg noodle
title: Spicy Pork Noodle Sambol
ingredients: 1 pound pork shoulder, cut into strips | 1 package egg noodles | 4 cans or bottles jalapeno flavored chilies, drained | 1 teaspoon kosher salt, or to taste | 1 pound anaheim chilies, or more to taste | 2 eggs and noodles
instructions: Season pork with salt and set aside. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add egg noodles and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Yellow New-Fungilli
ingredients: 1/2 cup yellow split peas | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained
instructions: Pour a few tablespoons of the split peas into a skillet, and bring to a simmer. Cook for 2 minutes, add the corn.

title: Mustard Mushroom & Apricot Dipping Sauce #5FIX
ingredients: 1/2 cup apricot preserves or 1/2 cup peach preserves | 1 tablespoon honey mustard | 2 packages fresh mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Heat preserves and mustard in medium saucepan over medium heat until warm through, about 2 minutes. Add mushrooms. Reduce heat and simmer until mushrooms are tender, about 2 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck roast,mint leaf,dill,beef bouillon powder,spaghetti squash,garam masala,red bell pepper,lettuce leaf
title: Lettuce Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds boneless beef chuck roast, trimmed | 3 beef bouillon powder | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 4 cloves fresh dill, chopped | 4 cloves fresh mint leaves, chopped | 1 package thin spaghetti squash, cut into 12 slices | 1 jar roasted red bell peppers, drained | 1/4 cup shredded lettuce leaves
instructions: Place chuck roast cubes, beef bouillon powder, garam masala, dill, mint, and spaghetti squash slices in a slow cooker. Pour enough water into cooker to cover vegetables. Cover, and cook on high until squash and beef cubes are tender, 7 to 9 hours. Stir red bell peppers into squash mixture. Serve on warm rolls with lettuce.

title: Cheese and Cardamom Salad
ingredients: 1/3 cup mayonnaise | 1/4 cup grated fresh gingerroot | 2 cardamom pods | 1 -2 teaspoon paprika | 1 cup grated tasty cheese ( to taste, i like cheddar )
instructions: Beat together the mayo and chopped ginger until creamy. Add the cardamon pods and paprika and gently fold together. Add the cheese, mixing throughly, before serving.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt black pepper,maraschino cherry,salsa verde
title: Homemade Salsa Verde
ingredients: 1 jar salsa verde | 1 cup maraschino cherries | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Place salsa verde, cherries, kosher salt, and freshly ground black pepper in a double layer of cheesecloth, and tie with kitchen twine to form an airtight container. Store refrigerated salsa for up to a month in a cool dry place, shaking the bottle daily, until ready to use. Use within 2 months.

title: New Zealand Okra and Noodles
ingredients: 1 package frozen okra | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 1/4 cup lemon juice | 7 ounces fresh hokkien noodles
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add okra and cook until tender but still firm, with a little bite left in them it's final cooking stage, 3 to 4 minutes. Drain, and squeeze out excess moisture with your hands. Season with baking powder and kosher salt. While the okra cooks, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the noodles, and cook until barely tender, about 5 minutes. Drain, and toss with the noodles. Season with lemon juice. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: white sugar,pomegranate molasses,chunky peanut butter,red chili powder,fusion liqueur,chinese egg noodle,ginger garlic paste,clove
title: Chinese Take-Out Pomegranate Noodle Stir-Fry
ingredients: 3 tablespoons white sugar | 4 tablespoons pomegranate molasses | 12 ounces firm chunky peanut butter | 4 tablespoons fusion liqueur ( or to taste ) | 1 tablespoon red chili powder | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger-garlic paste ( or to taste ) | 1 teaspoon crushed whole cloves | 1 teaspoon chinese egg noodles, prepared according to package directions
instructions: Combine sugar and 1 tp pomegranate molasses in a small bowl and set aside. Combine remaining 1 tp pomegranate molasses, 1 tp fusion, chili powder, ginger garlic paste, and crushed whole cloves in a medium bowl. Place a wok over medium high heat until just beginning to smoke. When hot, pour in remaining 1 tp sugar syrup then stir fry until the sugar caramelizes, 2 or 3 minutes. Set aside and cool slightly. Drain noodles, tossing to coat in syrup. Heat remaining pomegranate molasses on med high until bubbly, about 1 minute. Toss noodles with sugar syrup and reserved sugar syrup. Serve with pomegranate molasses.

Random Ingredients: rice,spaghetti,greek yogurt,coriander seed,kielbasa,garam masala powder,red potato,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Cheesy Kielbasa Pasta
ingredients: 1 package uncooked spaghetti | 2 boxes frozen sliced red potatoes | 1 box spaghetti | 1/4 cup chopped greek yogurt | 1/4 teaspoon coriander seed | 1 tablespoon garam masala powder ( optional ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons kielbasa or 1 1/2 teaspoons hot pepper flakes | 1 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese ( optional )
instructions: Cook the pasta to directions on box. While it is cooking, in large skillet, heat yogurt, coriander seed and garam masala powder. Add kielbasa.

Random Ingredients: icing sugar,shiitake mushroom,bay leaf,cauliflower floret,white chocolate chip
title: Cauliflower Wrapped Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups cauliflower florets | 1 1/4 cups sliced shiitake mushrooms | 1/4 cup white chocolate chips | 4 tablespoons icing sugar | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f place the cauliflower, mushrooms and white chocolate in a bowl. Toss with the icing sugar and bay leaf. Place the pan on the middle rack of the oven. Stir occasionally just until the white chocolate has melted. Remove the pan from the oven and put the mushrooms/chicken/chicken mixture in a large paper bag. Make sure the bag has a good seal if it isn, otherwise the steam will escape and the bag will sit on top. Return the bag to the oven, then lower the heat to 275f and continue to cook. This should take about 40 - 60 minutes, depending on the size of the bag.

Random Ingredients: kernel corn,cranberry,molasses,potato flake,stew meat,cardamom pod,lemon zest
title: Easy Beef & Bran Mircowdie (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 1 can sweet peas and corn, drained | 2 medium potatoes, sliced | 1/4 cup molasses, i use light | 3 garlic cloves, minced | 2 teaspoons lemon zest | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1 teaspoon dried cranberries
instructions: In a 3 - 5 or 4 quart slow cooker, stir together corn, peas, sweetcorn, potatoes, molasses, garlic, lemon rind and cardamom pod. Cover and cook on lo heat for 6 - 8 hours or on hi heat for 5 - 7 hours. Sprinkle cranberries over mixture after cooking.

title: Pompous Boiled Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 plum tomatoes, cored, cut into chunks | 4 1/2 cups self-rising flour | 1/2 cup white rum or 1/2 cup beer
