instructions: Place the tomatoes in a colander and sprinkle with salt. Cover and allow to drain in the sink for 30 minutes. Combine the flour, rum or beer and tomatoes in a bowl. Mix well and set aside for 1 hour to marinate. Preheat oven to 375°f. Pour marinated tomato pulp into a baking dish. Bake at 375°f for 15 minutes, stirring frequently. Check sauce should be slightly thickened.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning,cooking oat,cream celery soup,tomato paste,black eyed pea
title: Cowboy Caviar
ingredients: 1 can black-eyed peas, rinsed and drained | 1 can chopped stewed tomatoes with juice | 2 packages taco seasoning | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 1 package quick cooking oats
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl. Cover and chill. Stir occasionally. Serve with tostitos.

title: Anticuchos (Artichoke Dip)
ingredients: 15 large artichoke hearts | jalapeno chile, minced | 1 vidalia onion, chopped
instructions: In a bowl, combine sour cream, minced garlic, minced onion and chilies, and mix well. Place artichoke hearts into the bottom of a large serving dish and pour the sour cream mixture over them. Serve immediately.

title: Indian Vindaloo
ingredients: 2 tablespoons curry paste | 2 teaspoons apple cider vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons cornflour
instructions: Blend curry paste, vinegar and cornflour until smooth. Toss curry paste with coconut for serving.

Random Ingredients: baking powder,sherry,soya sauce,golden syrup,mayonnaise,chile powder,water chestnut
title: Japanese Ahi-Gohan Sauce (Ahi Goya)
ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1/4 cup golden syrup | 1 tablespoon dry sherry | 1 tablespoon chile powder | 2 tablespoons canned water chestnuts, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 1 -2 tablespoon sherry, to taste ( optional )
instructions: Mix ingredients together in a small bowl and add to the mayonnaise. Season with sherry if needed. The sauce can be refrigerated for up to 1 week.

title: Korean Beef and Daikon Chips
ingredients: 1 package tart shells | 1 lb boneless sirloin steak, cut 1/2-inch thick ( or you could use a flank steak, like london broil ) | 2/3 cup dried breadcrumbs, slightly toasted | 1 tablespoon ketjap manis | 1/2 - 1 tablespoon mirin | 6 tablespoons kelp-stuffed tart korean radishes ( you can also use cherry tomatoes if you got them )
instructions: Preheat oven to combine 1/4 cup bread crumbs and 1 tablespoons of the ketjap manis in a bowl. Set aside. Slice the beef into thin strips.. Combine remaining 1/4 cup bread crumbs, 1 tablespoon kelp and the other 1/4 cup bread crumbs in a bowl. Dredge each piece of meat in the crumbs. Spread half of the kelp stuffed tart korean radishes on the tart shells, leaving about 1/2 inch clear on one side. Place the beef strips over the radishes. Top the beef with 1/4 cup of bread crumb mixture and cover with remaining kelp. Pour 1 cup water into a baking dish and bake for 20 - 25 minutes, checking after 15 minutes to make sure the topping is not burning at the bottom of the dish. It may take longer for the beef to cook than 15 minutes. Variation, for a change of pace and toasting, instead of ketjap manis add a little dry sherry to the soaking liquid and mix well before adding beef. When beef is ready, it can be sliced thinly against the grain.

title: Pistachy-Baked Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 4 lbs beef tenderloin | 1 jar prepared pistachios, chopped | 1 cup chopped walnuts, toasted | 1/2 cup sugar snap pea ( optional ) | 2 cups prepared sweetened condensed milk | 8 tablespoons prepared syrup | pistachios, sliced ( to top for topping )
instructions: Place meat in a large shallow baking pan. Combine pistachios, walnuts and sugar snap peas, if using. Top with meat. Drizzle with sweetened condensed milk or syrup. Garnish with sliced pistachios. Cover tightly.

Random Ingredients: alfredo sauce,green curry paste,chocolate sandwich cooky,mushroom,black olive,date,couscous,extra turkey breast
title: Easy Mini Meatball Ties
ingredients: 32 precooked frozen black olives | 16 -20 green curry paste, blend ( or 1-2 tsp. to taste ) | 1/4 lb extra lean ground beef or 1/4 lb lean ground turkey ( not too lean ) | 2 packages refrigerated cooked couscous | 2 jars marinated mushrooms, drained and cut in half ( can use more if desired ) | 1 can sliced mushrooms, drained ( can use more if desired ) | 1 jar alfredo sauce ( i use newman's own light sauce ) | 1 1/2 lbs chocolate sandwich style cookies, crushed into small bits and toasted, i like keebler
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a large bowl, combine olives, curry paste and ground meat. Add couscous, mushrooms, sliced mushrooms and alfredo sauce. Mix until well combined. Put in 11x17 pan or 11x6 dish and bake until top is lightly browned.

title: Arroz Guatemalina (Black Beans and Rice)
ingredients: 2 cups long grain white rice | 1 1/2 cans black beans, drained
instructions: Place the rice and the black beans in a large, deep skillet. Cover and set over low heat. Let steam for 15 minutes. Then, uncover and stir once. When the rice is tender and the bean liquid is absorbed, the dish will be creamy and the rice will have a creamy texture.

title: Homemade Sweet and Hot Moghur (Side Dish Recipe)
ingredients: 2 teaspoons garlic paste | 1 tablespoon mango chutney ( or your favourite brand ) | 1 tablespoon vanilla-flavored syrup | 1/2 tablespoon dried herbs, mixed ( any combination of dried herbs, crushed tomatoes, chopped shallots, chopped fresh fruit, etc. ) | herbs, extra to garnish ( to garnish )
instructions: Blend all ingredients together in a food processor or blender until smooth and creamy. Taste and add more salt and sugar if desired, remembering to add more sugar if it seems a little on the sweet side. Top with extra chopped herbs and herbs. This recipe can be made as well.

title: Homemade Sour Oranges
ingredients: 10 medium oranges, ripe | 1 cup sour orange blossom water | 1 1/2 teaspoons sweet pepper, freshly ground | 1/2 teaspoon chili oil, for stir frying
instructions: Wash the orange and cut in half lengthwise. Remove each section with melonballer, a peeler, or zester. Remove all the pulp and seeds. Place the orange halves between 2 sheets of wax paper and press so that the skins are touching the bottom and sides of the orange. Place a plate over the oranges and tightly close the lid, making sure the paper stays in place. Freeze overnight. In a medium sized pot, mix the orange blossom water with the sweet pepper. Stir in the chilli oil until the orange blossom water is dissolved. Add the orange halves and coat with the sauce. Let stand in the refrigerator overnight to set up.

title: Tomato Asiago Meat Sauce #2
ingredients: 1 can tomato sauce | 3/4 cup grated asiago cheese | 2 pinches black olives
instructions: In a food processor combine all ingredients with ¾ cup water. Pulse a few times. I like to scrape the sides, pulse a few more times and adjust the balance of asiago and it should form a sauce that is thick enough to coat with a layer of the cheese. I sometimes cook until the sauce reaches the desired consistency.

Random Ingredients: grain rice,spaghetti,flour tortilla,green cardamom pod,self raising flour,cilantro,sharp cheddar cheese,chicken leg
title: Chicken and Rice Burritos
ingredients: 4 skinless chicken legs, jointed | 4 green cardamom pods | 3 tablespoons fresh cilantro, chopped | 225 g long-grain rice | 2 1/2 cups self-raising flour | 3/4 cup sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 1 package spaghetti | 12 flour tortillas, 10 x 10 x 2
instructions: Preheat oven to 180&#8260.

title: Amaretto Gravy
ingredients: 1 can tomato soup | 1 can beef stock or 1 can beef broth | 3 tablespoons amaretto | 2 teaspoons tarragon vinegar | soymilk, as needed
instructions: Combine tomato soup and broth in a medium saucepan. Add amaretto and vinegar. Heat until bubbles break the surface. Be careful not to burn the mixture, as this can cause severe burns trust me, this is one of the secrets that makes it so tasty. Reduce heat and simmer until mixture is reduced and thickened. You can add a splash of milk if you like.

Random Ingredients: corn chip,coleslaw mix,vanilla extract,oil,irish whiskey,meat,brown sugar
title: Cowboy Sliders
ingredients: 1 lb meat, lean | 2 packets coleslaw mix | 1/4 cup brown sugar | 1/4 cup oil | 1/2 cup irish whiskey | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | corn chips, for dipping
instructions: Brown the meat in a skillet with the brown sugar, then drain off the excess fat. Add the coco bean mix, the corn chips, and the remaining ingredients. Heat, and roll up, securing with toothpicks.

Random Ingredients: olive oil,tahini,currant,hot chili sauce,sesame seed,chocolate,cooking spray,mirin
title: Tahini-Sesame Spiced Bar Cookies
ingredients: 1/2 cup tahini | 1/4 cup sunflower seedless olive oil | 2 tablespoons mirin ( sweet rice wine ) | 1 tablespoon hot chili sauce | 1 package semisweet chocolate | 1/4 cup sesame seeds | 2 cups crunchy semisweet chocolate | 1 teaspoon olive oil | cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Stir tahini into oil, mirin, and chili sauce. Melt chocolate and sesame seeds in hot oil. Spray cookie sheets with oil, and set aside. Combine melted chocolate with olive oil, and stir until well blended. Roll dough into 1 balls, and then space evenly between sheets 1 1/2 inches apart. Bake on prepared cookie sheets in oven until firm and lightly golden, about 12 minutes.

title: Marinated Beef and Vegetables
ingredients: 1 lb beef sirloin ( sliced very thin ) or 1 lb veal ( sliced very thin ) | 1 small yellow pepper, cut into thin strips | 1/4 cup olive, coarse chopped | 1/2 cup sliced green olives | 3/4 cup unsweetened applesauce | 1/3 cup low fat ricotta | 1/2 teaspoon garlic granules or 1/2 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour over beef in ziplock or glass dish. Marinade over night in the fridge. Preheat grill. Remove beef and vegetables from marinade and shake off any excess. Skewer vegetable pieces and cook on grill until they are cooked.

title: Couscous With Anchovies and Calamari (Raw Vegan Meal)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dry couscous | 12 anchovy fillets, rinsed and patted dry | 1 pinch liquid smoke, such as sesame oil ( optional ) | 1/2 cup choy sum, leaves chopped
instructions: Pick out your equipment, and place a steamer basket on the rack above the rimmed rack. Bring the water to a boil in a pan, and cook the couscous, stirring occasionally, until it is cooked but still loose. Remove the colander from the steamer. Spoon the couscous onto a serving plate. Remove and discard any excess water from the anchovies and sprinkle over the couscous. Set aside, and set aside 2 cups of the cooking liquid to use in another dish. Stir in the liquid smoke and then set it aside for the squid. Meanwhile, if the fish has been refrigerated, remove it from the refrigerator 2 hours before use. Cut the squid into 1/2 inch rings. Sprinkle on the choy sum leaves to serve. Place the squid on a serving dish and top with the reserved anchovies. Serve alone or with warm flat bread.

Random Ingredients: asparagus spear,red lentil,chicken,corn flake,salt black pepper,hard egg
title: Corn and Coriander Salad
ingredients: 1 package asparagus spears, trimmed | 14 -16 corn flakes, crushed ( about 4-6 ) | 1/2 cup dry red lentils ( or green ) | 6 cups cooked chicken, diced | 1 hard-boiled egg, sliced | 1/2 - 3/4 cup low-fat plain yogurt or 1/2-3/4 cup mayonnaise | salt and black pepper
instructions: Steam asparagus or green beans until crisp tender, 2 - 3 minutes. Cool slightly. Cut asparagus in half and place in a salad bowl. Toss with corn flakes and lentils. Add chicken, egg, and yogurt dressing. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Refrigerate for 5 - 10 minutes to develop flavors.

title: Sausages, Chips, and Fingers
ingredients: 1/2 kg saffron strand | 550 g kipfler potatoes ( potatoes unpeeled, cut into chunks ) | 1 kg sweet italian sausage
instructions: Preheat the oven to 150°c line a large baking tray with non stick baking paper. Put the saffron strands, potatoes and the sausage into a small saucepan then add in 5 cups boiling water. Bring to the boil, cover with a lid and put on the lid for 25 minutes. Remove from heat, take off the cover then leave to macerate for 10 minutes to swell. While that's cooling, take them out of the water and place on a baking tray lined with baking paper. Bake for 2 hours, then remove from the oven and leave on the baking paper. Remove potatoes from the water and put into a bowl. Place the sausage back into the saffron water and boil until the fat has been absorbed. Slice the sausage in half and then add into the potato mixture. Put the sausage back in the pan and fry for 1 hour and add 5 cups more boiling water and simmer for 10 minutes. Add the saffron into the potato mixture and fry for 15 minutes. Take off the fire and let sit for 10 minutes before serving.

instructions: Heat oven to 400°f remove pie crust from pouch.

title: Hot Pepper Sauce

instructions: Place the hot pepper sauce & ground white pepper in a small heat proof bowl & microwave on high heat 1 minute, to thicken slightly. Add the green cardamom & cayenne, stir well & keep warm till served.

title: Italian Rice Baked Potatoes
ingredients: 1 lb large baking potato | 3/4 cup arborio rice | 1/2 cup chopped of fresh mint
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Coat 2 quart baking dish with cooking spray. Rice, place potatoes in greased baking dish. Add 1 tablespoon of cold water to baking dish. Place uncovered in preheated oven. Bake for 45 minutes, stirring every 20 minutes or so. Remove from oven and turn into a medium bowl. Allow to cool. Cut potatoes into 1/2 inch slices, then spread rice on top of potatoes. Return potato slices to oven and bake 10 to 15 minutes longer until crispy. Garnish with mint.

Random Ingredients: blue curacao,green chili pepper,wheat pita bread,red onion,roast,vidalia onion
title: Vitello Pizza
ingredients: 1 whole wheat pita bread, split in half | 1 -2 teaspoon roasts, spicy beef ( optional ) | 1 small vidalia onion, sliced thin | 1 -2 fresh green chili peppers or 1 -2 jalapeno pepper, thinly sliced | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon blue curacao | 1 tablespoon red onion, chopped
instructions: Place pita on ungreased cookie sheet and spread with roasts, pepper, red onion and cheeses. Bake at 450 for 5 - 10 minutes or until cheese is melted. Note, if desired, you may substitute red onion. Serve pita chips as a spread to pizza.

title: Grilled Lemony Lamb Tortellini With Grilled Clams!

instructions: Place lamb between 2 pieces of plastic wrap and using your hands, pound to 1/4 inch thickness. Repeat with remaining beef. Cut lamb into 2 inch pieces and place in a bowl. Prepare tortellini according to package instructions. Drain and set aside. Prepare grill to medium heat. Combine 2 1/2 cups clam liquid and the reserved clam liquid in a medium bowl and set aside. Spray grill with cooking spray and preheat grill. Remove pork from marinade and place on grill. Grill until medium rare or to your liking. Remove from grill and slice. Add the 2 cups clam liquid mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish. Set aside. Place a medium saute pan over medium heat with 1 tablespoon of the reserved clam liquid, ginger, and reserved clam liquid. Stir until warm. Cook baguette slices for about 5 minutes or until golden brown on both sides, turning once. Place a single layer of tortellini and a slice of grilled lamb on each plate. Top with a piece of grilled clam and a piece of pickle and orange slice. Spoon clam liquid/sauce mixture around the plated platter.

title: Curried Chicken, Cabbage & Curry for Two.com
ingredients: 4 boneless chicken breasts | 4 tablespoons curry powder | 4 cups red cabbage, shredded
instructions: Remove chicken from skin. Trim fat from cabbage, wash and dry. Slice chicken into small squares and put in a large mixing bowl. Pour in remaining curry powder and pour over chicken in bowl. Mix well. Add cabbage to bowl and stir gently just to combine. Let sit for a few minutes, to allow the cabbage to be coated with the curry. Serve as is or as a side dish with your favourite curry dishes.

Random Ingredients: sunflower oil,taco seasoning,seafood,peanut oil vegetable,bay scallop
title: Mexican Seafood

instructions: Mix all ingredients except seafood in a large bowl. Remove scallops from the skillet and place on top of the fried seafood. Heat the remainder of the oil over high heat and fry the seafood until all the seafood is cooked. Serve hot.

title: Meatball Mango Pork
ingredients: 3 lbs meatballs or 3 lbs sirloin tip roast, cubed | vegetables or fruit, of choice | 1/4 cup flour | 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds ( optional... i like to use a mix of 1/4 cup each ) or 1/4 cup crushed dried fenugreek seeds ( optional... i like to use a mix of 1/4 cup each ) | 6 mangoes, ripe, cubed ( fresh-smoked ) | 2 teaspoons mace | 2 teaspoons vanilla
instructions: Put meatballs in large kettle and cover with water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes. Drain liquid and let cool. Remove meatballs from kettle and set aside. title: Crock Pot Lasagna (From Food For Can)

instructions: Spray or lightly flour a 4 1/2 by 4 1/2 by 2 3/4 inch or 9x13 ovenproof baking dish.

instructions: In a wide, shallow bowl, whisk together sesame oil, onion, and asafoetida. Place chicken in marinade, and turn to coat. Let chicken marinate in marinade at least 30 minutes, turning to coat. Let mixture stand at room temperature 30 minutes before grilling.

Random Ingredients: italian cheese,white chocolate,eggplant,romano cheese,prego spaghetti sauce,cotija cheese,pizza crust
title: Pizzas
ingredients: 1 unbaked pizza crust | 6 ounces white chocolate | 1 lb romano cheese, freshly grated | 1/2 lb cotija cheese, coarsely grated | 1/2 lb italian cheese, shredded or finely shredded | 1 jar prego spaghetti sauce | 1 eggplant, cubed
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Combine the cheeses together in a mixing bowl. Mix in the eggplant and then transfer to a pizza pan. Spread 1/3 the sauce and a little bit of cheese mix on the crust. Repeat the layers. Bake for 7 to 10 minutes, or until bubbly.

instructions: Pulse the bread in a food chopper until finely crumbed. In a large bowl, toss the bread crumbs with the sweet potato slices, egg noodles, pickled ginger ale and egg whites. Beat the egg white with an egg white and brush over the top of the muffins. Bake at 425°f for 40 minutes, or until golden brown and a toothpick inserted in the centre comes out clean. Let cool for five minutes on a wire rack. Remove and cool on a wire rack. I like to serve them with a dollop of whipped cream.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,yellow bell pepper,vinegar,cottage cheese,lime juice zest
title: Grilled Egg-and-Pepper Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup white vinegar | 1/4 cup white vinegar | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice and zest | 1 tablespoon distilled white vinegar | 12 ounces cottage cheese | 8 yellow bell peppers, seeded and cut into 1-inch squares
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together the vinegar, vinegar, lime juice, and zest until smooth. Gently stir in the cottage cheese, yellow bell peppers, and cottage cheese mixture until blended, then refrigerate until cold, at least 30 minutes.

title: Easy Green Curry (for Canning)

instructions: Place everything except the ice water into a large pot or dutch oven. The cans that have not been covered with ice water yet are probably not being used. Bring to a boil. ingredients: 1 lb chicken thigh | 1 teaspoon apple juice | 8 ounces gruyere cheese, grated ( about 1/4 c ) | 2 ounces yellow split peas | 3 -4 teaspoons mango chutney ( optional )
instructions: In a bowl, combine the apples with the cheese and split peas. Toss with the chicken pieces and season with salt and pepper. Marinate for 30 minutes. Cook over hot coals or nonstick griddle until browned, 2 - 5 minutes per side.

title: Baja Tacos

title: Crispy Pork Cuke Salad
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce ( or boston bibb lettuce- leaves ) | 1 lb ground lean pork | 2 english cucumbers
instructions: Wash and dry lettuce, removing any leaves that are large outside. Separate the head of lettuce leaves. Cut off the top portion of the leaves and cut the head into 6 sections. Place the pork in a small skillet, breaking up pieces as it cooks, and use as a side dish for the pork. Add the cucumbers to the meat, and cook over medium low heat to warm through. In large bowl, combine the lettuce, onion, and cucumbers. Toss with pork, lettuce, and cucumbers.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,black peppercorn,dark corn syrup,sesame seed,gruyere cheese,broad bean,brown rice,mushroom broth
title: Lazy Mansaf
ingredients: 1 ounce sesame seeds | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds | 8 ounces mushrooms, chopped | 2 tablespoons plain flour | 7 ounces black peppercorns | 3 tablespoons dark corn syrup | 4 ounces gruyere cheese, grated | 4 1/4 cups rich vegetarian stock or 4 1/4 cups mushroom broth
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°c. Put the sesame seeds in a roasting tray and roast them in the oven for 12 minutes, until toasted and aromatic. Reduce the heat and allow to simmer for 10 minutes. Pour the sauce into a bowl, stir and add the sesame seeds and grated cheese. Strain the contents into an ovenproof, greased bowl and pour over the sauce. Put the bowl onto a baking sheet. Bake the dish for about 50 minutes.

instructions: Preparation cook pasta according to package directions. Drain. In large bowl, pour boiling water over cornmeal. Stir until well moistened. Stir in sour cream and pineapple juice. Bake, uncovered, in a 350 degree oven for about 45 minutes or until heated through and slightly browned. Serve with any side of your choice.

title: Hawaii Pineapple Hamburger Helper

ingredients: 2 cups cream-style cottage cheese | 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 1 tablespoon tequila | 3 tablespoons butter flavor crisco | 3 -4 granny smith apples, unpeeled | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, sliced ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons diced drained canned peaches, drained ( optional )
instructions: Place cottage cheese in a small bowl. Stir in 2 tablespoons lemon juice, the tequila and 1 1/2 tablespoons crisco. Place granny smith apples in a large salad bowl. Layer with remaining ingredients. Chill until serving.

title: Creamy Cilantro Pasta Shells

instructions: Fill a saucepan with lightly salted water. Bring to a rolling boil.

title: Chunky-Instant Polenta
ingredients: 1 cup coarse cornmeal | 8 ounces canned green chilies, chopped | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon tomatoes with green chilies, chopped ( i prefer v8 brand ) | 1/8 teaspoon nutmeg, to taste ( optional )
instructions: Combine the cornmeal, chiles, green chilies, tomato with green chili liquid, and nutmeg, if using. Cook in a nonstick pan over medium low heat, stirring constantly, until mixture thickens and colors to a light amber color.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,lemongrass,whipping cream,mango juice,clam,pizza crust
title: Cambodian Style Curry Pizza
ingredients: 1/4 cup mango juice | 1 teaspoon lemongrass, finely chopped | 1/2 cup canned chopped clams | 1/2 teaspoon red curry paste | 4 prepared pizza crust, such as boboli | 4 tablespoons whipping cream or 4 tablespoons sour cream
instructions: Combine mango juice, lemongrass, and clams in a shallow dish. Stir in curry paste until well blended. Refrigerate while making dough. Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Spread cream over one side of the pizza crust. Arrange tomato slices and red pepper slices over cream surface. Top with a spoonful of curry sauce and pizza toppings. Bake until the crust is toasted and bubbly and the topping is lightly browned, about 10 - 12 minutes. Let cool slightly.

title: Swiss Orange Peppercorn Spread
ingredients: 4 ounces reduced-fat swiss cheese | 2 tablespoons light malt vinegar | 2 tablespoons grated orange peel | 1 teaspoon cracked pink peppercorns or 1 teaspoon cracked dark peppercorn
instructions: Shred cheese and mix with remaining ingredients except pepper.

title: The Perfect Rice for Sizzling Seafood
ingredients: 3 cups arborio rice sticks or 3 cups long-grain rice, rinsed well
instructions: Rinse noodles under cold water. Drain well. Set aside. Place rice on a cookie sheet covered with foil. Using a rolling pin, firmly press it over the entire baking sheet. If using uncooked seafood, it will crack. If using seafood, it will crack during cooking process. Drain well. Using a slotted spoon remove all seafood from baking sheet without disturbing. Transfer all seafood to a large bowl and immediately pour off the oil. Set aside. Place reserved oil and rice in a large skillet. Heat oil and rice over medium heat, stirring constantly until the rice is toasted. Immediately remove from heat. Serve immediately and enjoy.

title: Soup Base
ingredients: 2 tablespoons beef stock, or more to taste | 2 cubes chicken bouillon, or more to taste | 1 1/4 pints buttermilk
instructions: Pour the beef stock into a blender, and blend until it tastes creamy. Add the chicken bouillon cubes, and blend again until smooth. Pour into a large, heavy, narrow pan, and set over moderate heat. When hot enough for the soup to boil, and bubbling slowly, simmer the soup and buttermilk whisked together for 5 minutes.

title: Kafta
ingredients: 500 g minced beef tenderloin | 175 g semolina or 175 g flour ( or other fine dry flour ) | 150 ml heavy cream | 100 g grated cheese
instructions: Heat the meat to 170c or 150f. Add salt and pepper to taste. Stir in semolina and cream. Fold through grated cheese. Bake in a 200°c oven for around 45 mintues or until cooked.

Random Ingredients: chinese mushroom,balsamic vinegar,double cream,french onion soup mix
title: Chinese Mushrooms With Balsamic Cream & French Onion Gravy
ingredients: 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 300 g french onion soup mix | 300 g chinese mushrooms, in rings | 150 ml double cream
instructions: Pour 2 tbsp of oil in a pan, add the onion soup mix, and bring to a simmer. Allow to simmer for about 10 minutes, or until the soup mix has reduced by half. Add the mushrooms, and cook uncovered until they are beginning to soften. Add the cream, and keep simmering until the cream has reduced a little. Stir, and serve. I prefer to serve this cold on a cold winter afternoon, such as a cold winter day.

title: Lori's Togar Pork Kebab
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless pork shoulder ( cut into 1-inch cubes ) | 1 lb fresh broccoli floret | 2 tablespoons parsnips ( shredded ) | 4 -5 cardamom pods
instructions: Put pork in bowl, add water until meat is half of the way covered. Add veggies and spices and mix to combine. Cover well and let sit for at least 30min. When meat is fully covered, drain any excess water. Put in refrigerator to marinate for 30+minutes. Cut meat and veggies into cubes, discard any pieces you don't like.

title: Beetroot With Smoked Sausage and Kielbasa Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 large beetroot, tops trimmed | 2 links smoked kielbasa | 4 teaspoons red wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh red chile peppers | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 2 tablespoons brandy | pepperoni, slices to serve
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c/400f/gas 3 and put the beetroot on a baking tray, then put on the oven shelf. Roast for 45 mins, then set aside to cool slightly for 5 mins, then remove the skin and finely finely shred, leaving some larger stalks. Cut kielbasa into 3cm thick slices, then cut into 3 equal wedges. Line a slice of toast with the chopped chilies. Wrap the sausage in the sausages, leaving enough to fry in a frying pan on the hob. Sauté over a low heat until golden brown, about 15 mins, until cooked to your liking. Spoon a few handfuls of beetroot onto the bread and top with kielbasa, then spoon on the smoked sausage. Sprinkle with the vinegar, chopped chiles and ketchup and drizzle with the brandy. Scatter with pepperoni and serve.

title: Smoked Irish Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin | 1 teaspoon ground cumin powder | 1/2 teaspoon msg | 1/2 cup irish cream
instructions: Score the back of the tenderloin with a sharp knife making sure you do not cut all the way through. Spray lightly with canola oil cooking spray. Rub cumin powder on the surface of the pork. Place the tenderloin on the oiled rack of a broiler pan or grill over medium heat for about 7 minutes per side for medium rare, longer if you want your pork well cooked. Remove the tenderloins from the pan or grill and let rest for 5 minutes before slicing thinly and serving. Note, if cooking on the grill then you have to place a roasting rack on top of your pan to catch any drips. Remove the pan from the heat and let sit until the pork has cool and the fat separates from the surface. Use a sharp knife and remove all visible fat. Combine some of the whiskey or brandy in a small bowl. Slice or shred your pork and place in the flavored whiskey/brandy mixture. Pour the brandy sauce over and serve. Note, if serving the pork with vegetables, you may substitute 1/2 cup of your favorite vegetables for the veggies as follows, thinly sliced red onion, celery, carrots, jicama, cucumber, mushrooms, baby corn, tomatoes and green peppers. Serve with side of green salad.

Random Ingredients: brown mustard,liquid smoke flavoring,carrot,salmon fillet,american cheese
title: American Smoked Salmon
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs salmon fillets | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke flavoring | 1/2 teaspoon brown mustard | 6 slices american cheese | 1 carrot, finely sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°. Cover salmon with dampened towel and leave under cold water. Pat dry. Place half of the cheese on each of 2 medium baking sheets. Put one piece of salmon on each sheet of cheese. Sprinkle salmon with mustard and carrot and top with remaining cheese. Bake at 375° for 20 to 30 minutes, until cheese is lightly browned.

title: Easy Beef Stock (For Beef Sirloin)
ingredients: 1 cup beef stock | 2 1/2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a crock until thoroughly blended. Let sit overnight in refrigerator to ferment.

title: Quickly Cooked Rice With Hot Corn
ingredients: 2 cups cooked rice ( or any long grain or white rice ) | 1 can whole kernel corn ( drained of all liquid ) | 1 -2 teaspoon chili-garlic sauce ( optional )
instructions: Mix first three ingredients thoroughly. Microwave on high for 1 - 2 minutes, stir, cover, and cook on 50% power for 3 - 5 minutes, or until hot and bubbly.

title: Sweet Sugar Snap Pea Snack With Easy Tofu Sauce
ingredients: 1 package firm silken tofu | 32 ounces sugar snap peas
instructions: Drain the block of tofu and cut into 1 inch cubes. Place in a microwave safe bowl and microwave on high for 10 minutes stirring twice in between, it should be pretty soupy. Add the sugar snaps and microwave for another 5 minutes. To serve, place 2 slices of bag of sweetn crunch peas on a plate and microwave on high for about 30 seconds or until it is nice and hot and the peas are softened. Spoon the sweetnam sauce over each plate and serve. Variation, make the sachet of your choice.

Random Ingredients: red potato,mustard,red tomato,haddock fillet,chickpea,chuck roast,green onion
title: Baked Haddock and Potatoes #RSC
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs chuck roast, boneless, 3-4 cutlets | 2 cans chickpeas, drained | 1 can red ripe tomatoes, drained and chopped | 6 medium red potatoes, halved if large | 1 bunch green onion | 4 teaspoons prepared mustard | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard
instructions: Preheat oven to 400^f. In a large roasting pan, arrange meat and chickpeas on bottom, top with tomatoes. Sprinkle green onions, then dry mustard on top. Cover and bake 2 hrs. Uncover and bake 25 minutes longer. Remove from oven. Uncover and flake potatoes. Return to oven and bake an additional 45 minutes.

title: Homemade Enchilada Sauce With Shells
ingredients: 1 whole wheat tortilla | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chilies | 3 cups small shell pasta
instructions: Cook the shell pasta as per package directions.

title: Cake Crust
ingredients: 1 package lime gelatin ( found in the bulk section of each tube ) | 9 cups sifted white flour | 2/3 cup baking powder
instructions: Line a 17x28 inch pan or jelly roll pan with parchment paper. In a bowl, sprinkle jello powder over flour. Add baking powder to dry mixture and stir to blend well. Add limes gelatin mixture and beat until the gelatin is dissolved. Press mixture into pan or jelly roll pan and allow to set. After removing jelly roll paper, cut into bite sized pieces.

Random Ingredients: consomme,shallot,green onion,beer,salad oil,grain white rice,grain rice,fish
title: Smoked Salmon Paella
ingredients: 6 cups light beer ( can use dark ) | 1/2 cup mustard greens ( green spring onion ) | 2 1/2 cups long grain white rice | 1 can consomme ( can sub 2 cups chicken stock or mushroom stock ) | 1/4 cup chopped shallot | 1/8 cup salad oil | 6 ounces smoked salmon ( diced ) | 1/2 cup green onion, chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees. Heat the beer and mustard greens in a skillet over medium heat, stirring until heated through, about 5 minutes. Pour into a 9 by 13 inch baking dish. Stir together the rice, consommé, shallots and 1/8 cup salad oil in a large bowl. Add the salmon and then evenly distribute the salmon mixture in the baking dish. Top with the green onions. Bake 30 minutes, until the salmon is bubbling and lightly browned on top.

title: Cabbage Oysters
ingredients: 24 oysters | 1 leek, white part only, chopped | 1 red cabbage, sliced ( about a pound )
instructions: Open oysters, place in pot and leave in steamer. Steam for 10 - 15 minutes until the cabbage starts changing color. Garnish with leeks, green part only and red cabbage.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice,corn tortilla chip,picante sauce,thyme leaf
title: Easy Microwave Sopaipillas
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried thyme leaves ( mccormick ) | 1 cup picante sauce | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1/4 cup corn tortilla chips
instructions: In a small saute pan heat oil on high. Add thyme leaves and picante sauce and mix to combine. Microwave on high until bubbly, about 1 minute. Remove from heat. Add lemon juice to taste. Sprinkle tortilla chips on top and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,cucumber,asafoetida powder,oregano,pork shoulder,soy sauce,fruit,vanilla ice cream
title: Pork Vindaloo
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pork shoulder | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried oregano | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 2 teaspoons reduced sodium soy sauce | 1 pint vanilla ice cream | 1 cup whipping cream, light | 1 cucumber, peeled and very thinly sliced | 1/3 cup diced dried fruit ( pineapple )
instructions: Cut meat into cubes. Combine with oregano, 1/4 tsp saki and soy sauce in a large ziplock freezer bag. Toss in the ice cream to coat. Refrigerate overnight. In a small bowl, whip the cream til soft peaks form. Fold in the cucumber, fruit and 1 tbsp of cream. Cover and refrigerate the meat mixture for at least 4 hours. Before serving, remove from refrigerator and scoop into serving bowls. Sprinkle with the remaining saki to taste.

title: Easy Chocolate Lassi
ingredients: 4 ounces chocolate bars, chopped | 2 cups plain yogurt
instructions: Place the chocolate in a blender and process until smooth. Place the yogurt in a strainer lined with cheesecloth, and pour the yogurt into the strainer over a bowl. Gather up the corners of the cheesecloth and twist it like a claw. Allow the yogurt to drain for 1 hour.

title: Gambas Al Laranjas
ingredients: 1 pound bulk sweet italian sausage | 1/2 cup palm sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Wrap sausage in aluminum foil and place in a small baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven 20 minutes. Turn and bake an additional 15 minutes. Drain and set aside to cool slightly. Stir sausage and palm sugar together until well blended. Spread mixture out on waxed paper and refrigerate until firm.

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,rice wine,sesame oil,green chili,cherry,garlic flake,pork tenderloin
title: Sesame Spicy Pork
ingredients: 2 lbs trimmed pork tenderloin, cut in 1/2 inch cubes | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 2 teaspoons garlic flakes, minced | 1 1/2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 can chopped green chili, drained | 2 tablespoons rice wine | 1/2 cup sweet green chili, strips with seeds | 1/2 cup sliced cherry
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp sesame oil in a dutch oven or heavy skillet over medium high heat. Add beef, in 3 batches, and sauté until browned and tender. Remove meat and set aside. Heat 2 tbsp sesame oil over medium heat. Add garlic, rice wine, green chile, and pork. Stir fry. Add remaining sesame oil, cherry strips, and green chile strips and stir fry for 2 minutes. Return meat to skillet with sauce and heat through, about 4 minutes.

Random Ingredients: seasoning salt,string bean,salmon,spring wrapper,mace,quinoa,oat,chicken bouillon granule
title: Smoked Salmon and Pea Snack Wrap
ingredients: 1 cup smoked salmon ( flaked or sliced ) | 10 green string beans ( chopped depending on size ) | 2 tablespoons chopped smoked salmon ( flaked or sliced ) | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 dash ground mace | 1 dash fresh ground mixed spice ( e.g. old bay & pisker ) | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon chicken bouillon granules, to taste | 1 package quick rolled oats | 1 package spring roll wrappers ( egg roll, not egg roll )
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together except the wrappers in a large bowl, and knead until the mixture becomes smooth and resembles soft play dough. Lay 1 wrapper on a lightly floured surface, and place a couple of tablespoons of the seafood mixture on the wrapper. Place the 2 wrappers in a steaming dish, or a shallow bowl or platter. Repeat until you have finished filling your wrappers with all of your filling. Place the fish wraps, close together, on a lightly floured surface. Place in the refrigerator covered while making your filling. Fill and wrap the wrappers with the moist moist, warm fish. Repeat until the filling is set. Place any leftover filling or wrap on top of the fish wrap, and press down firmly. Remove the wrap before serving.

Random Ingredients: ra el hanout spice mix,vegetable oil,cream,red chilies,ricotta cheese
title: Cheese With Ra el Hanout Queso
ingredients: 600 g ricotta cheese ( or cottage cheese ) | 1/2 cup cream | 1/2 teaspoon el hanout spice mix | 1 teaspoon dried red chilies or 1/2 teaspoon dried hot red chili | 1/2 - 3/4 cup olive oil
instructions: Mix together the ricotta and cream. Add the red chile and mix well. Add the oil a little at a time if using. Keep stirring until it is nice and smooth. Keep aside for at least an hour. Serve by spreading with a bit of a bit of the cheese. You might need to add some more oil. Some folks like to cover the cheese with the raisins or sprinkle with any of the raisins and chilies after they've had a few days of stirring.

title: Dad's Favorite  Indian Snack Mix Recipe.
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups grated parm cheese or 1 1/4 cups buttermilk | 3 green cardamom powder, crushed with the cardomom pods ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees fahrenheit. Combine 1½ cups of grated parm with the worcestershire sauce and the crushed cardamom, if using them. Pour buttermilk and ¼ cup of grated parm onto a non stick sprayer and spread evenly. Bake at 325 degrees fahrenheit for 20 minutes or until brown. Note, the parm can be left in the oven longer and it will crisp up a bit.

title: Grilled Hazelnut Wedges
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs potatoes ( use small if possible ) | 12 hazelnuts | 1 lime, zest of ( large ) | 1 -4 teaspoon basil ( optional )
instructions: Cut the potatoes into 12 wedges each. If your shaker has a hole on the bottom you can use that to cut the wedges for easier serving, but if you don’t your shaker is the dish for fish. The water will help bind the wedges. Wash the nuts, pat dry, and make the wedges fit into the potato holes. Grill the wedges a few minutes on each side until lightly browned. Remove and let cool. To make the gremolata, drizzle a little gremolata over the toasted hazelnuts and scatter with the lime zest. Add in a little basil, if using.

title: Kiwohayaki Salad
ingredients: 1 kalamata olive ( pitted, quartered or sliced ) | 1 kiwi fruit, peeled and sliced | 2 teaspoons dark soy sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients and toss to combine.

title: Italian Plum Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 can italian plum tomatoes ( i used italian-style ones ) | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano flakes | 1/2 teaspoon whole cloves
instructions: Place all ingredients in a medium saucepan and cook over medium heat for 2 minutes, stirring to coat. Cover and cook until tomatoes are reduced to approximately 2 cups, about 30 minutes. Note, if making this recipe for 2 people, double the tomato servings and use the 2 cups for up to 2 people.

title: Grilled Oyster Mushroom Oyster Mushrooms and Bacon
ingredients: 7 ounces oyster mushrooms | 1 small head cauliflower, separated into florets | 4 slices salami | 7 ounces small head cauliflower, separated into florets | 6 slices reduced-calorie bread, toasted
instructions: Place mushrooms on a baking tray lined with baking paper. Bake at 450 f for 10 minutes, or until mushrooms are tender and lightly golden. Let cool until easy to handle. Remove mushrooms from baking tray and cut caps into half. Rinse and separate the stems from the cauliflower florets.

title: Picante Mutton
ingredients: 500 g lamb, diced | 1 jar picante sauce ( your favorite brand, homemade, your favorite brand, or a mix of your favorites ) | 1 can chickpeas, drained | 2 teaspoons vanilla | 1/2 teaspoon anise extract | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 1/2 teaspoon chili oil ( or use a bit of anise extract for milder flavor )
instructions: Slightly thicken the mix with olive oil, chili oil, vanilla, ginger, and spices.

Random Ingredients: thai red curry paste,reynolds wrap foil,chilies,salt pepper
title: Red Curry Veggies #RSC
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs chilies, fresh or hot ( your choice of heat ) | 1 tablespoon thai red curry paste ( or one of each, one to each of you 'ns mommores ) | 1/4 cup chopped red onion | 2 teaspoons salt and pepper | reynolds wrap foil
instructions: Trim the chilis. Remove stems and cut the caps into thin strips. In a small bowl, mix chilies with the curry paste, salt and pepper. Set aside. Take a piece of reynolds wrap and place a generous 1/4 cup of mixture inches spread over one side of the wrap. Fold the bottom up over mixture and the open edges towards the middle. Fold the long sides over mixture. Repeat until you reach the end of the wrap. Place wrapped bundles on a foil lined baking sheet, cover and let stand in the fridge for a few hours or so. Heat oil over medium high heat. Add bundles and fry for about 3 - 5 minutes or until tender, not dark. Remove and drain on paper towels or a plate lined with paper towels. Sprinkle with paprika. Serve on a hot plate with extra crunch, such as mint and cucumber dressing.

title: Pine Coleslaw
ingredients: 1 cup white cabbage, thinly sliced | 1 cup fresh green beans, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup unsweetened buttermilk | 1 teaspoon coconut extract | 1/4 cup canned sliced green olives
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the cabbage, beans, buttermilk, coconut extract and olives. Cover and chill for 2 to 4 hours before serving.

title: Little Asiago "Cheese" Balls
ingredients: 1 cup asiago cheese, shredded ( may sub monterrey jack or swiss ) | 2 tablespoons cornflour ( cornstarch ) | 2 tablespoons grand marnier
instructions: Combine the cheese, corn flour and grand marnier in a bowl. Mix until a dough is formed. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface. Press the dough out to 1/4 inch thickness. Cut into desired shapes with cookie cutters. Bake on a paper lined baking sheet at 200°c/400°f/gas 3 for 10 to 12 minutes. Set the pan on a wire rack. Cool and store in an airtight container.

title: Chile Dry Rub
ingredients: 1 cup roasted peanuts | 1 poblano chile, chopped
instructions: Grind the peanuts and poblano chile together with a mortar and pestle. Store in an airtight container.

title: Blueberry Crunch
ingredients: 1/2 cup self raising flour | 1 1/4 cups fresh blueberries
instructions: Combine all ingredients with an electric mixer. Turn into a greased, lined 2lb loaf tin. Bake at c for 50 - 60 minutes.

Random Ingredients: raspberry,baking soda,sultana,pico de gallo,chinese cabbage,rigatoni pasta
title: Raspberry and Pico De Gallo With Crispy Parsley
ingredients: 5 ounces dried rigatoni pasta | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 2 ounces pico de gallo | 1/2 english cabbage, shredded | 1/2 cup sultanas or 1/2 cup golden raisin | 1/3 cup raspberry vinegar or 1/3 cup red wine vinegar
instructions: Cook pasta in large pot of boiling salted water until al dente. Drain. Transfer pasta to large platter. Return pot with pasta water to a boil. Remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: pizza crust,mint leaf,tequila,ice water,italian bread crumb
title: Grapefruit Margarita pizza
ingredients: 1 can refrigerated pizza crust, divided | 3/4 cup italian seasoned bread crumbs, divided | 1/2 cup dried mint leaves | 1 cup ice water | 1/2 cup tequila
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Remove 1/2 cup bread crumbs from 1 package of pizza crust.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,orange bell pepper,vegetable stock
title: Roasted Oranges (Ww 4 Points) With Taco Seasoning
ingredients: 4 medium oranges ( i had the eye of the tube ) | 1/2 cup vegetable stock ( i used beef stock ) | 1/2 teaspoon taco seasoning mix, packet
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f, place orange slices on a sheet of aluminium foil, spray with cooking spray and drizzle with 1/2 tbsp of remaining olive oil. Wrap tightly and place in oven for 30 - 45 minutes or until skin is charred. Carefully loosen skins with a sharp knife, run over a bowl and press orange flesh into flesh. Cut peel of orange into thin slices and place in a bowl. Add stock and spice packet. Stir to combine. Pour onto orange peel and cover with foil. Put in fridge until ready to serve. Note, i served this as a side dish with mexican rice and red cabbage salad.

Random Ingredients: garlic paste,monterey jack cheese,purpose flour,shiitake mushroom,red pepper,parsnip,nonstick cooking spray
title: Ranch Parsnips, Shiitake-And Shrimp Mini Brik
ingredients: 2 ounces unsmoked shiitake mushrooms, chopped ( about 1 1/2 ounces, or more depending on their size ) | 1 medium parsnip, peeled, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 1 teaspoon parsley, minced | 1/4 teaspoon garlic paste, minced | 1/8 teaspoon crushed red pepper, minced ( about 1/4 teaspoon ) | 3 tablespoons all-purpose flour, divided | nonstick cooking spray | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Combine mushrooms, parsnip, parsley, garlic paste, and crushed red pepper.

title: Easy Peppered Yellow Pepper Salad
ingredients: 6 yellow peppers, halved and seeded | 1 cup orange marmalade | 1/2 cup light coconut, shredded
instructions: Bake the peppers in an oven preheated to 400 degrees f. Combine the peppers with the marmalade, and sprinkle with the coconut. Serve.

title: Grilled Chorizo, Portuguese Style
ingredients: 2 lbs chorizo sausage | 1 tablespoon ketchup ( portuguese-style basting sauce ) | 1 tablespoon guacamole | 2 tablespoons fresh thyme sprigs
instructions: Spray grill rack with nonstick spray. Remove sausage casings. Using clean hands, gently pound chorizo into an even 1/2 inch thick patty. Spray grill rack and grill patty on both sides until well browned. Slice into thick slices about 1/4 inch thick. Mix ketchup, guacamole and thyme and spoon onto burgers. Let sit for 5 minutes.

title: Beef Stuffed Cauliflower
ingredients: 3 heads small cauliflower florets | 4 ounces part-skim mozzarella cheese, cut into 4 slices | 1 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup grated part-skim mozzarella cheese | 2 tablespoons scallions, chopped ( white parts only ) | 1 teaspoon mixed herbs, chopped
instructions: Pre heat oven to 350 degrees. Cut stem end off cauliflower. Break off the base around the core of the leaf so that it will stand upright. Discard core and any remaining attached to the head. Break out the small stuff inside the head of cauliflower and trim off the base of any remaining head in smaller pieces. Combine in a bowl 1 lb. Of the mozzarella, bread crumbs, 1/2 cup of the parmesan, scallions, herbs, and remaining 1/2 cup cheese. Spoon 3/4 into the thick end of the sliced cauliflower and roll up. Then repeat, forming a tight cylinder shape. Place in a baking dish lined with parchment paper. Place the baking dish filled with cauliflower on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake for 25 minutes or until nicely browned and tender. Cool for 15 minutes, then serve immediately.

title: Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1 chicken wings, split | 1 tablespoon fresh salad oil | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger, grated | 1/2 cup mixed fruit, sliced | 1/2 cup mixed salad oil, for brushing
instructions: Clean wings, removing the joints and tips. Dry the wings thoroughly on paper towels. Heat 1 tablespoon of salad oil in a frying pan over medium high heat. Add ginger and fry for 1 minute, then turn the heat down to low and add the chicken wings. Cover and cook for 20 minutes, turning half way through. Remove the chicken wings from the pan and set aside to cool. Turn the heat under the pan up to high, and add remaining 1 teaspoon of salad oil. Stir fry the fruit and chicken wings for about 5 minutes, or until cooked thoroughly. Sprinkle with a little powdered sugar.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,salmon fillet,pear,italian sausage,salt cod fish,caper
title: Salmon Nicoise
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 12 ounces salmon fillets ( about 6 ounces each ) | 1 1/2 - 2 ounces mild bulk italian sausage | 1 pear, peeled, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 2 teaspoons capers, drained | coarse salt, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f scatter sesame seeds on a baking sheet and toast in center of oven until skins crackle, about 6 to 8 minutes. Transfer to a bowl and rub off skins. Rinse salmon and pat dry with paper towels. Place on baking sheet. Bake in lower third of oven, 12 to 15 minutes, or just until cooked through. Cut into 2 inch pieces. Meanwhile place sausage in a skillet and cook over medium heat, stirring, until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and add pear slices.

title: Provencale Tomatoes
ingredients: 3 -4 large ripe tomatoes | 1 teaspoon dried herbes de provence or 1 teaspoon dried thyme
instructions: Preparation, cut tomatoes into wedges with a vegetable peeler, removing as many seeds as possible. Arrange alternate slices of tomatoes in a well buttered baking dish. Sprinkle with herbes de provence. Sprinkle with dried thyme. Broil tomatoes until they turn golden brown and curl slightly, about 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: kernel corn,italian plum tomato,apple juice,head romaine lettuce,baking soda,green
title: Mexican Veggie Salad II
ingredients: 2 cups whole kernel corn ( frozen or fresh corn kernels, not canned ) | 2 cups medium head romaine lettuce, chopped | 1 1/2 cups canned italian plum tomatoes, drained ( plum tomatoes with jalapenos ) | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained ( optional ) | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1 1/2 cups apple juice
instructions: Thaw and drain corn if using fresh, then coarsely chop kernels. In a large bowl, mash corn with potato masher or fork. Toss in lettuce, tomatoes, corn and baking soda. Add juices, if desired, mixing well to prevent sticking. Sprinkle with salt to taste, if desired.

Random Ingredients: brown rice,pizza crust,cold water,vanilla essence,french onion,icing sugar,chicken
title: Crazy Chicken Pizza!
ingredients: 1 pre made pizza crust | 1 large cold chicken | 2 cups cooked brown rice | 1 cup french's onion, chopped | 4 tablespoons icing sugar | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 30 g icing sugar | 1/4 cup cold water
instructions: First, prepare the crust. First, rub icing sugar in the cold water to form a paste and place in a pie dish. Then, take the chicken and chop it up using a meat mallet or a rolling pin. Once the chicken has roughly chopped up and the knife has come out roughly the same size as the chicken pieces, then place in fridge for an hour to ensure a good coating of flour. Make sure the flour is all absorbed, otherwise the dough will stick. Once the dough has drained off a little, spread out and put onto a clean, flour free pizza peel. Poke holes on the dough with a fork. Spread half the chicken, then half the brown rice, then half the onions. Add the last layer of the crust, then top that off with the second layer of dough. Sprinkle with half the icing sugar. This method will make 2 layers of tasty meaty tasty toppings, ie, a mixture of chicken, rice, onion, brown rice and rice. And a drizzle of vanilla. Bake under your grill.

Random Ingredients: allspice,chicken breast half,angostura bitter,peanut oil,cucumber,chili pepper flake
title: Chicken Massaman - Thai Cape Style Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken breast halves | 4 dried chili peppers or 1 fresh chili pod, seeded and cut into small sticks | 1/2 small cucumber, peeled and sliced into thin rounds | 2 tablespoons crushed allspice | 1/4 - 1/2 cup peanut oil | 1 teaspoon allspice | 1 teaspoon angostura bitters, to taste ( optional )
instructions: If using dried chili, place in a small heavy duty bowl and cover with hot water.

Random Ingredients: curly leaf parsley,teriyaki sauce,chestnut,sun tomato,sauerkraut,taco cheese
title: Beef and Chestnut Tacos in a Bag
ingredients: 1 lb ground sirloin or 1 lb lean ground beef | 2 tablespoons teriyaki sauce | 1 bag of your favorite taco cheese ( can also use store bought taco meat ) | 1 tablespoon dried chestnuts ( optional ) | 1 can sauerkraut, drained | 3 sun-dried tomatoes, chopped | 1/4 cup curly-leaf parsley
instructions: Place everything except the bread in the bag of your favorite taco cheese, chestnuts, sun dried tomatoes and parsley in a baking dish, and mix well until the meat resembles an egg and is evenly distributed. If using sun dried tomatoes, break them into pieces, sprinkle with more salt, and place the garlic in between them. Bake 350 degrees for 15 - 20 minutes or until the desired doneness of the meat, and the garlic is browned. Remove from oven, and leave in the oven for 5 - 10 minutes while the meat cools slightly before slicing against the grain. Shred the cheese, and spread over your taco shell. Top with the meat. Serve with fresh tomato slices.

Random Ingredients: pepperoni sausage,mace,cream tartar,hard egg,sesame oil,egg,rosemary leaf
title: Hot Pepperoni Bites
ingredients: 3 hard-boiled eggs | 1 pepperoni sausage | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/2 teaspoon rosemary leaf | 1/2 teaspoon mace | 1/2 teaspoon mace | 1 egg, lightly beaten ( for glaze )
instructions: Remove crusts, peel egg, cut egg in half and remove yolks and whites. Cut slit on top of pepperoni and snip off. Use a knife to cut a pocket in top of 1 egg, fill with egg yolk, press mixture so egg covers egg completely, sprinkle with sesame oil, bake at 400f for 10 minutes, flip and broil for 3 - 5 minutes or until light golden brown. Remove from oven, turn egg whites over and brush with oil. Sprinkle with nutmeg and fresh rosemary leaves. Place pepperoni slices on plate, top with pepperoni and remaining egg whites.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,pork loin chop,steak,sharp cheddar cheese,cayenne pepper,shiitake mushroom,bread flour,balsamic vinegar
title: Steak Au Gratin
ingredients: 4 thick boneless pork loin chops, 1/2-inch thick | unsweetend bread flour, for dredging | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 1/4 cup grand marnier | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper ( optional ) | 2 cups steaks, thinly sliced, such as rib eye steaks, sirloin, and flank steak, 1-inch thick | 4 ounces shiitake mushrooms or 4 ounces chanterelle mushrooms, stemmed and sliced | 1 1/2 cups shredded sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f in a small bowl, stir the vinegar, grand marnier, cayenne pepper, and salt and pepper to taste until blended. Remove the loins from the plastic wrap and lightly coat with the flour. Lay half of the chops on a lightly floured sheet of parchment paper. Evenly place the mushroom slices and steak on the chops, leaving about 1 inch between. Drizzle the vinegar mixture over the chops, making sure the seams are totally closed and to the side of the pork chops. Add half of the cheese. Bake 45 minutes or until the cheese has melted.

title: Peanut Butter Slice
ingredients: 375 g mozzarella cheese | 4 tablespoons chunky peanut butter | 1 teaspoon cider vinegar | 1 teaspoon sounf
instructions: Take half the mozzarella and half the peanut butter and put on a slice of mozzarella on each slice. In a bowl mix the vinegar and sounf. Put on top of the cheese slice.

title: Labrang
ingredients: 3 1/2 teaspoons harissa, plus additional for drizzling | 3 1/2 teaspoons orange rind
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl.

title: Sausage and Yukon Gold Potato Breakfast
ingredients: 2 lbs yukon gold potatoes, cubed | 8 ounces sausage | 1 cup soymilk ( i used light ) | 1 jar picante sauce | sliced rumple or sliced sauteed mushroom ( optional )
instructions: In a large non stick skillet or wok place sausage, potatoes and enough water to cover by one inch on high heat. Once water boils place potato mixture on the lower heat. When it begins to boil turn down heat and simmer slowly for 25 minutes stirring often. Add soy milk and picante sauce stir it around and turn down to simmer for 20 to 30 minutes stirring every few to ensure that the sauce does not burn. Note you only need to add a couple ladles of the mixture to your skillet. Add sliced mushrooms and top with rumple or a layer of sliced mushrooms. If you have any left over sausage you can add it to the pan right before putting in your eggs. It will make a great hash by itself. Enjoy.

title: Texas Tomato and Pecan Dip
ingredients: 28 fluid ounces plum tomatoes, canned | 1 1/2 - 2 teaspoons light or dark mayonnaise | 1 1/2 teaspoons seasoning salt ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups grated pecan nuts
instructions: Process all ingredients in a food processor or blender. Serve hot or warm with crackers which have been lightly toasted. I recommend using a slightly moistened sour cream in place of the mayonnaise. Also, for added flavor, a pinch of ground nutmeg or crushed red pepper flakes can also be added, and the pecans for added flavor. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: roast beef,mung bean sprout,cayenne,oregano leaf,pork liver,orange zest,chicken meat,sugar
title: Mung Bean and Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 cup mung bean sprouts, lightly toasted and chopped | 1 cup coarsely chopped roast beef | 1 cup sliced raw pork liver | 1/4 cup chopped fresh oregano leaves | 1/4 cup finely shredded orange zest | 2/3 cup granulated sugar | 1/4 teaspoon ground cayenne | 2 cans rotisserie-cooked chicken meat, undrained
instructions: Combine bean sprouts, roast beef, pork livers, oregano, orange peel and sugar in slow cooker top with cayenne. Cover.

title: Onion Gravy
ingredients: 5 large onions, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup cornstarch | 2 3/4 cups cold water
instructions: In a bowl dissolve cornstarch in water. Add onions to the cornstarch and toss to coat well and coat. Cook on medium heat, stirring frequently until softened, 3 - 5 minutes. Reduce heat to low, stir in sugar and stir until dissolved. Continue to cook on low about 3 - 5 minutes more. Remove onions and serve.

title: Quick Wonton Salad
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked arborio rice or 1 cup arborio rice | 1 cup chopped romaine lettuce or 1 cup watercress | 16 wonton skins
instructions: If using dry rice, use 3/4 teaspoon baking powder. Add uncooked rice and stir well until completely absorbed. Stir in desired amount of romaine or watercress. Keep filling in mind w/remaining ingredients. To steam, line baking sheet with parchment paper. Place wonton skins on baking sheet. Place under broiler just until tops of wontons begin to turn brown. Cool on cookie sheet 5 minutes. Carefully open and take away paper.

Random Ingredients: rice wine vinegar,rose petal,classic stir fry sauce,curry,salmon fillet,puff pastry,orange bell pepper,biscuit mix
title: Rice Vinegar and Orange Peel Salmon Rolls
ingredients: 1 packet dry puffed pastry | 1 packet classic stir-fry sauce | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons instant rice wine vinegar | 300 g salmon fillets, skin removed | 1/2 orange bell pepper, cut into 1cm dice | 12 -15 fresh rose petals, to taste | 4 sheets frozen puff pastry, thawed, each sheet halved
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Prepare pastry per packet instructions using puffed pastry, pastry flour and rice wine vinegar in a resealable plastic bag. Add the salmon, pepper, orange rind and rose petals & seal with plastic wrap. Place in the oven for 15 - 20 minutes until the salmon is cooked & the salmon is golden & springy to the touch. Meanwhile, to thaw and thaw the pastry sheets. Take each sheet of pastry and cut into half diagonally to make 8 - 12 strips. Roll each strip of pastry onto a lightly floured pastry roller. Place about 1/8 of an inch of the salmon mixture onto the centre of each pastry strip. Fold over the pastry over the salmon mixture and roll from the centre to the edge to seal the salmon rolls to form a roll. Place wrapped pastry on a lightly floured pastry sheet. Once the water goes into the bottom of the pastry sheets, gently pinch the ends together and pinch together. Repeat process with all of the pastry. Once the salmon rolls are made, slice each into 2 - 4 pieces. Serve the salmon rolls warm or cold, with a tossed salad if desired.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,red chili pepper,vanilla essence,pork shoulder
title: Roasted Chilli Pork
ingredients: 2 red chili peppers, deseeded and cut into small cubes | 250 g pork shoulder, fat trimmed of fat and cut into strips | 1/4 cup pure vanilla essence | salt and pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees c. In a small bowl combine the chillies and pork. Spread the pork mixture on a baking tray and bake for about 20 minutes. Remove from oven, stir through the puree and season with salt and pepper. Serve.

title: Lebanese Serrano Pepper Sauce
ingredients: 4 serrano peppers | 2 tablespoons lemon juice
instructions: Peel and deseed the julienned peppers. Combine in a blender jar with 1 cup water and process till smooth.

title: Spanish Rice - Great Alone or Class
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cornflour | 100 ml hummus | 30 ml italian stewed tomatoes | 1 small green chilies | 2 limes | 1 vanilla bean
instructions: Pour hummus, olives, and chili in to a pan. Heat & stir until boiling & simmer while preparing other ingredients. Serve with rice.

title: Lidia's Italian Barley and Cheese Stuffed Shells
ingredients: 32 large pasta shells, cooked | 6 ounces ground lean pork | 12 ounces pistachios, roughly chopped | 9 ounces pimento stuffed olives, roughly chopped | 7/8 cup ketchup | 2/3 cup breadcrumbs | 2 -3 tablespoons ketchup, for drizzling | 1 cup pimento stuffed olive, roughly chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Cook the pasta shells according to package, drain and set aside to cool. Brown the ground pork in a large frying pan with the pistachios, olives, ketchup, breadcrumbs and pimentos. Drain pasta and sauce and place in a casserole dish. Add the crumb mixture and chopped olives to the meat mixture and then mix again. Bake in preheated oven for 20 minutes or until the casserole is bubbly and crumb topping is golden.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice,green bell pepper,half,wheat pasta,rice noodle,broccoli,no boil lasagna noodle,stewing beef
title: No-Boil Beef and Vegetable Lasagna
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, cut into 2 in. thick pieces and cut into 3/4 in. inch cubes | 1 can no-boil lasagna noodles, whole grain | 3/4 cup fat-free half-and-half | 1/4 cup lemon juice | 1 green bell pepper, chopped | 1 package uncooked whole wheat pasta | 1 1/2 cups sliced broccoli | 5 cups hot cooked spaghetti or 5 cups jumbo cooked rice noodles | 4 1/2 teaspoons lemon juice | 3/4 teaspoon no-boil lasagna noodle, broken in half
instructions: Meat, drain fat from stew meat, and return contents of crockpot to crockpot. Add remaining ingredients except noodles, broth, and lemon slices, to crockpot. Cover and cook on high for 7 hrs, stirring once an hour. Noodles, meanwhile, cook pasta of your choice according to package directions. Place in casserole dish, top with meat mixture. Bake at 350 for 20 minutes, stirring once, and noodle topping should be lightly browned. Serve over hot cooked spaghetti or jumbo cooked noodles.

Random Ingredients: thai basil,chili paste,cherry,chili oil,currant,salad green,kielbasa,bay leaf
title: Quick  Thai Sweet and Sour Kielbasa Salad
ingredients: 1 lb kielbasa, sliced into rounds ( cut in half ) | cherries | 1/2 cup dried currant | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 2/3 cup thai basil ( cut in thin strips ) | 3 bay leaves | 1 teaspoon of sriracha chili paste ( or kacha sauce ) | fresh thai basil, shredded
instructions: Combine ingredients. Refrigerate 3 hours or overnight, tossing now and then to coat and coat, and serve. This makes enough to refrigerate for 2 days. Will keep refrigerated up to 2 days. Great with pita chips.

Random Ingredients: french onion soup,salt black pepper,center pork chop,szechuan peppercorn,yellow bell pepper,tapioca,beet,oatmeal
title: Pear Stew
ingredients: 1 large yellow bell pepper | 1 can sliced beets, drained | 1 can french onion soup | 1 teaspoon szechuan peppercorns | salt and ground black pepper to taste | 1 teaspoon tapioca, or as needed | 1 thick cut bone-in center-cut pork chops
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Halve the bell pepper halves lengthwise, and slice into 1 inch cubes. Mix the beets, french onion soup, peppercorns, salt, and black pepper in a bowl, and pour over the bell peppers. Cover, and place in the oven | Bake in the preheated oven until beef shreds form and the bell pepper is tender, about 35 minutes. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read 1 or 1/2 cups.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,english muffin,lard,yellow squash,apple cider,chipotle chile adobo
title: Maggie's Yellow Squash With Chipotle Muffins
ingredients: 1 kg small-diced yellow squash | 3 chipotle chiles in adobo, sliced | 2 tablespoons lard | 900 ml hot vegetable stock | 1/4 cup apple cider | 1 bread french bread ( such as foreman's ) or 1 loaf buns, toasted, brushed with olive oil, to serve
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees celsius. Toss the squash, chillies, and lard in a microwave safe bowl with the chipotles. Place on a rimmed baking sheet and sprinkle over about 2/3 of the chipotles and chipotles on top. Bake for 20 minutes until the squash is tender and lightly browned. Puree the remaining chipotles with the stock in a food processor until smooth. Pour into a jug, season with the cider and season to taste with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Toast the bread under a grill or on a baking tray in the oven until golden. Divide the squash between 2 plates and top with the chipotle ments and toasted bread.

title: Mustard & Honey Crisper
ingredients: 1 lb self-rising flour | 2 tablespoons horseradish honey | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 lb meat, of your choice
instructions: Heat barbecue grill and brush with oil. Lightly flour and sift all dry ingredients together. Pour 1/2 the honey and mustard over flour, then mix until well blended. Add meat, and mix on lightly floured surface to form a ball. Flatten to a 6 inch circle and pinch edges firmly with fork. Brush hot barbecue griller with oil from a small dish or spray with cooking spray and place on hot barbecue. I serve this with steamed carrots, or broccoli.

title: Chef's Sourdough Chicken
ingredients: 1 bag frozen sourdough bread | 1/2 cup lemon juice, or to taste | 1 pound fresh chicken meat, cubed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper. Break the bag of sourdough bread into cubes. Press bread into a 9x13 inch baking dish to cover the bottom and up the sides. Drizzle with lemon juice and lay chicken cubes on top. Cover with a tent of aluminum foil. Bake in the preheated oven until a knife inserted into the center of the chicken comes out clean, about 45 minutes. Allow chicken dish to cool, about 5 minutes. Refrigerate any remaining sourdough. Once cool, refrigerate the dish between layers of plastic wrap for up to 2 days to blend flavors. Sourdough chicken recipe, cut 2 slices of the bread to make 2 loaves. Layer 1 loaf with 1/2 the chicken and 1/2 the sourdough. Top with second loaf. Cut out the sides of the crusts, and arrange on a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until bread is lightly browned and juices run clear, 5 to 10 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Grilled Hamburger with Raspberry and Chickpeas
ingredients: 400 g good quality hamburger | 2 slices good quality honeyed ham ( i use a honey-roasted ham ) or 2 slices habanero pepper ( i use a honey-roasted ham ) | 8 -10 raspberries in light syrup | fresh chives, chopped | fresh fennel bulb, chopped | 400 g canned chickpeas, drained | 1 -2 tablespoon strawberry jam, to pass at table ( optional )
instructions: Grill the meat until well cooked. Leave to rest 5 minutes before moving onto the rest of the steps. Place the ham on a grill tray and broil 10 mins, turning as necessary, until it is golden brown and slightly crisp. When ready, place on to a plate and set aside to rest. Now prepare your gf. Raspberry glaze by buzzing the chick peas with a little olive oil and a little sugar and a dash of water until it starts to dissolve. This will take roughly 30 minutes. It should still be a little runny. Pour the honey and olive oil, mixed with the chives, on to the ham and scatter a few chives on if you wish. Pour the raspberry glaze onto the ham and serve with fresh fruit.

title: Cherry Verveè
ingredients: 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 8 ounces bittersweet chocolate, chopped | 2 cans canned chickpeas, rinsed and drained ( in the can ) | 1/2 cup triple sec | 4 -5 tablespoons dried cherries | lemon zest, for sprinkling
instructions: In a small bowl, combine lemon juice, lime juice and bittersweet with an immersion blender or a handheld handheld blender. Microwave chocolate until it melts, 4 - 5 minutes. Stir into chocolate mixture. Mix in chickpeas and triple sec. Transfer to a serving dish and sprinkle with lemon zest. Let set for 5 minutes. Use a long spatula to break chocolate into pieces and scatter over the top, and serve.

title: Coconut and Rum Cornmeal
ingredients: 1 cup coconut, flaked | 1 cup cornmeal | 1/2 cup dark rum
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place coconut, cornmeal, and rum in a glass bowl and stir until thoroughly combined. Place half of mixture and remaining mixture on bottom of a lightly greased 9x5 inch loaf pan. Sprinkle top with coconut. Bake in the preheated oven until crumbs are golden and coconut is melted, about 45 minutes.

title: Almond Horchata
ingredients: 3 cups blanched, unsalted almonds | 2 1/2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar
instructions: Put the almonds in a heavy skillet with a lid and toast them over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until they have turned a deep, golden brown color. Watch them carefully, as they can easily burn. Transfer the almonds, toasted and cooled, to a food processor and process the almonds until they are finely ground. Add the rice wine vinegar to the ground almonds and process again. Transfer mixture to a glass jar, seal to the refrigerator and chill. Transfer to an ice cream maker and proceed according to manufacturer's instructions.

title: Couscous Basics
ingredients: 1 cup couscous | 1 1/2 - 2 1/2 cups chicken broth ( may need to use water ) | 2 tablespoons spring onions, sliced ( more or less to your taste ) | 3 tablespoons fresh lime juice
instructions: Begin by heating the stock to 100°f in a medium sized bowl add the couscous and 1 tablespoon of chopped spring onions. Cover and set aside. Bring 2 more cups of broth to a boil. Add the couscous and stir quickly with a wire whisk, allowing the couscous to dissolve some. Cover and set aside until the broth comes to a boil. Fluff up all the couscous with your spatula, adding more broth or water if needed. Then mix quickly with a fork and serve with your favorite garnishes. Makes 2 servings.

title: Holiday Ham and Salami (Or Appetizer Platter)
ingredients: 10 -12 ounces salami, cut into large chunks | 1/4 cup brown sugar, packed
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Put in a 9x13 inch pan on top of the ham or other side you are using it to serve.

Random Ingredients: turkey,chipotle chile adobo,tamarind pulp,white onion,stew meat
title: Caldillo Enchipotlados
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs stew meat, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 tablespoons tamarind pulp | 1 tablespoon chipotle chile in adobo, chopped | 1 teaspoon white onion, chopped | 1 bag dried tamarind pepsi ( about 6 cups pepsi cones, soaked in water for 15 minutes )
instructions: Place meat in a bowl and mash with a potato masher or the back of a large spoon. Stir in 2 tbsp tamarind pulp and chile. Stir in the onion. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 day or up to 3 days, turning 3 or 4 times. Drain tamarind pulp thoroughly and place pulp in a small saucepan covered with 1 cup cold water. Bring to a boil over moderate heat, stirring often, and pour into a food processor. Add chipotle and pulse till a chunky paste forms. Stir in the pepsi and process till fine but not smooth. Place the meat mixture in a baking pan and coat with the pepsi paste. Let stand at room temperature for 1 hour. Preheat the broiler or set a casserole dish in the middle of a preheated broiler. Line the bottom of the dish with 6 of the soaked tamarind cylinders, buttered sides uppermost. Sprinkle the top with 1/3 of the meat mixture. Arrange 6 pepsi cones on top. Arrange 5 more cones on top of the meat. Cover the dish tightly with foil or aluminum foil and broil for 18 to 20 minutes. Remove foil or foil and continue to broil for 5 more minutes or until the top is brown and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,barley,cream,yellow squash,white wine vinegar,biscuit,balsamic vinegar,habanero pepper
title: Barley and Squash With Balsamic Vinegar
ingredients: 1/3 cup white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 2 lbs small yellow squash, halved lengthways and cut into 1/2-inch wedges ( about 2 medium ) | 1 1/2 lbs small white zucchini, halved lengthways and cut into 1/2-inch wedges ( about 2 medium ) | 1 1/2 cups light cream | 3 tablespoons barley, cooked, drained and chopped | 1 jar refrigerated biscuits, such as pepperidge farm crackers | 1 habanero pepper, chopped ( wear rubber gloves )
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients in a small, nonreactive bowl and set aside 2/3 cup marinate in a bowl. Add squash to the reserved 1/3 cup marinade and toss to coat evenly with marinade. Cover bowl and refrigerate 8 hours. Cook rice and set aside, covered, in a saucepan of boiling water for 8 minutes. Add zucchini and rice and toss to coat evenly with marinade. Remove skillet from heat. Drain biscuits. Divide biscuits among 4 serving dishes. Add toasted balsamic vinegar mixture, about 1/3 cup reserved marinate and chopped habanero pepper and toss to combines. Spoon the rice and squash among the biscuits, mounding more rice and squash on top. Serve. Accompany with green salad or crostini.

Random Ingredients: cilantro leaf,angostura bitter,green chilies,cocoa powder,kale,tarragon,chicken wing
title: Maurice's Chicken Wings
ingredients: 4 -5 chicken wings, each split at the joint | 1 bunch fresh tarragon, leaves picked | 1 bunch fresh tarragon, leaves picked | 6 -12 green chilies, roasted | 1 bunch fresh culantro leaves | 1/2 cup cilantro leaf | 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 dash angostura bitters
instructions: The night before, place the wing joints in cold water. If possible, put them in the refrigerator overnight or several hours depending on how strong you like your wings. The next morning drain off the fluid and place the wings in a plastic bag and add the tarragon leaves, chilies, culantro leaves and cilantro. Toss thoroughly with 1 cup cocoa powder to coat. Add the remaining 1 cup cocoa powder, and stir to mix. Store in the refridgerator over night and shake vigourously so it is evenly blended. The next day marinate the birds, in a plastic bag, for about 3 hours and then in one bowl. Then add some more cocoa and vinegar if you like. Slightly marinate the birds or serve them whole, skin on or with the marinade poured over them. The chocolate coating recipe. To make chocolate coating pour 1/2 cup cocoa and vinegar into a pot of hot water and heat until melted, whisking constantly until thick and dark. You can also dip the birds into the chocolate mixture and serve with biscuits to dip.

title: Radish and Cheese Spread
ingredients: 16 ounces ricotta cheese | 4 ounces part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup sliced radish
instructions: In a large bowl with a knife, mash ricotta cheese with a fork until creamy. Gradually add shredded mozzarella, followed by radishes. Turn onto wax paper and pat into a log shape approximately 1 1/2 inches long. Wrap log in wax paper and refrigerate until chilled, about 3 hours.

Random Ingredients: ice water,green chili pepper,cream cheese,baking potato,banana,pepper sauce
title: Mexican Potato Cheese Bread
ingredients: 1 lb baking potato, scrubbed, peeled and cut into chunks | 2 teaspoons hot pepper sauce | 3 ounces cream cheese | freshly ground pepper and hot sauce, for serving ( like tabasco ) | 1/3 cup ice water or 1/3 cup water | 1 sliced banana
instructions: Put the potato chunks in a large frying pan with the hot pepper sauce. Turn over in to coat well and cook about 5 minutes until tender and well done, stirring frequently. Mix the cream cheese in with the potato and pepper sauce and season with hot pepper sauce to taste. Turn up the heat to low. Add the ice water or water, cover and simmer for about 5 minutes. Stir and let cool slightly, then pile on a piece of plastic wrap slightly larger than the bread. Serve with warm banana slices.

title: Braised Pork Shoulder
ingredients: 3 pounds pork shoulder, cut into large cubes | 1 package thick slab bacon
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Place the pork shoulder pieces in a large dutch oven or roasting pan. Pour water into the bottom of the pan until all of the pieces are covered. Bake pork shoulder in the preheated oven until very tender, about 1 1/2 hours. Remove pork with a slotted spoon, leaving the juices in the pan, and strain the juices into another large pot. Return the juices to the dutch oven or roasting pan, and bring to a boil over high heat. Cover and reduce heat to medium low. Simmer until the pork is very tender, about 3 1/2 hours. Pour off most of the excess fat. Cool meat in the broth until cool enough to handle, about 15 minutes. Shred meat using two forks. Use pork with skin from belly, if desired. The broth can be used as a dipping sauce for meat and vegetables.

title: Chinese Herbed Fish
ingredients: 1 2/3 teaspoons pectin | 1/4 cup fish sauce | 1 can chinese beans ( drained, liquid reserved ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves ( or to your taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried mint | 1/2 lb white fish fillet
instructions: For test fish, pierce entire surface with a sharp knife. In a small glass or plastic bowl, make a paste with fish sauce.
