Rinse and drain beans, pat dry, and slice 1/4 inch thick around the bone. Stir beans into fish mixture until just heated through. Place cod fillet in a shallow pan, skin side down of fish to coat, and coat with pectin paste until well coated. Place fish in oven, and bake at 400 degrees for about 15 minutes, until fish flakes easily with a fork. Note, if you like, instead of fish sauce, you can omit fish sauce. Also, for a spicier fish fillet, remove fish from oven, and spread fish slices on top of bean mixture.

title: Veal & Bean Shrimp "gumbo's"
ingredients: 4 large peeled whole jumbo shrimp | 2 teaspoons minced celery | 1/3 pound ground veal | 1 can small red beans, drained and rinsed | crushed ice
instructions: Shell the shrimp, leaving the tails intact. If using shrimp with shells, place them under running water. Toss shrimp with celery and veal in a medium size bowl. Add beans and mix. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Gently crush the shrimp with a fork, removing any muscle or fat. Toss with the shrimp mixture. Serve on a platter with plenty of crackers.

title: Prawns W Coriander
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/2 cup romano cheese ( grated )
instructions: Combine turmeric and coriander in a bowl.

title: Spanish Rice
ingredients: 2 cups long grain white rice, rinsed | 2 cooking onions, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup finely chopped green sweet pepper
instructions: Cook rice in 2 cups boiling salted water until tender, about 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: velveeta cheese,milk,salmon,potato water,head cabbage,pork roast,egg yolk
title: Creamy Smoked Pork and Potato Cabbage Soup
ingredients: 3 lbs smoked pork roast, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 cans condensed potato water | 1 large head of cabbage, sliced 1/4-inch thick | 16 ounces evaporated milk | 1 1/2 cups cubed velveeta cheese | 4 large egg yolks | 3 -4 tablespoons milk
instructions: Place potato soup cans into a 4 1/2 qt stock pot and add potato water. Bring to a boil, then reduce to simmer. Place cabbage and salmon in a blender with potato water. Cover and blend until all ingredients are completely smooth. Place velvetta cheese cubes into a baking sheet and place on top of the soup. Bake in a preheated 350 degree oven for 5 minutes. Stir eggs into soup in the baking sheet and pour mixture into soup cans with soup cans. Place a large pot filled with water on the stove over high heat. Bring soup mixture to a boil, then reduce to simmer. Serve with your choice of optional toppings, such as cucumber slices, dill pickles, rye bread cubes, crabsticks, sour cream.

title: Lek Kebabs
ingredients: 1 small leek | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 tablespoon dry sherry ( or to taste )
instructions: Wash and trim leeks, removing the tough part of the root. Cut away and discard the ends, and trim away the tough outer layer. Cut the leeks into 3 - 4 thick rings, or else if desired, 1 large onion. Make one lengthwise slit into each piece of leek using a sharp knife. Tie the turmeric and sherry into a small, narrow piece of kitchen twine. Brush the turmeric and sherry mixture into each piece of leek. Thread one piece onto each skewer, lengthwise.. Grill the skewers 3 - 5 minutes on each side, or until the leeks just begin to turn light yellow. Serve hot.

title: Cheddar Tomato Spread With Rose Water
ingredients: 8 ounces cheddar cheese, grated ( about 1 cup ) | 1 1/2 cups canned italian-style tomato paste | 1 tablespoon rose water ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together until well combined. Store in a covered container for up to 1 month.

title: Herby Pork Chops
ingredients: 1 package fresh bean sprouts | 3 fat free pork loin chops | 1 teaspoon grapeseed oil | 1/2 teaspoon fresh grated nutmeg | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage
instructions: Boil the bean sprouts in salted water 30 to 45 seconds or until slightly tender. Remove from heat and drain. Trim excess fat from the chops. In a nonstick skillet, heat the oil. Lightly season the chops with salt and pepper. Cook the chops until they are browned on both sides and cooked through, about 12 minutes. Transfer the chops to a plate. Stir in the beans and sprouts, sprinkle with the nutmeg and sage.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,pork chop,egg white,chili,yeast,tap water,chicken bouillon cube
title: Slow Cooker Pulled Chicken and Pork
ingredients: 3 -3 lbs boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 3 1/2 lbs pork chops | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon cube ( or equivalent ) | 1 can of la passina chili ( drained ) | 2 -3 egg whites | 1 tablespoon dried yeast | 4 cups hot tap water
instructions: Place chicken breasts in a greased 2 - 5 qt slow cooker. Dissolve chicken in a cup of hot tap water, stir with a fork, until well browned. Reserve. Cut pork chops into small pieces, trimming off as much fat as possible from outside of meat. Place cut pork, pork, and chicken in slow cooker. Stir together the remaining ingredients in a mixing bowl. Pour mixture over pork and chicken. Cover, set on low for 5 days, or for 3 hours on high. Remove meat in the morning, discard juice. If you like, use a slotted spoon to place meat on the top of meat a few slices at a time for a more full effect.

title: Tiramisu
ingredients: 3 ounces mascarpone or 3 ounces cream cheese | 1 teaspoon dry sherry
instructions: Combine mascarpone and sherry in a small bowl and whip until light and fluffy. When ready to serve, spread the mascarpone mixture on top, cover and refrigerate for at least an hour or up to 3 days.

Random Ingredients: marjoram,chickpea,cilantro leaf,okra,nam pla,brown rice,lime leaf,tomato paste
title: Fried Okra With Tomatoes and Cilantro (Palau
ingredients: 1 tablespoon nam pla ( fish sauce ) | 1 lb broiled okra | 1/2 lb tomato paste ( or 2 tsp. salt + 1 tsp. sugar mixed in 2 tsp. water ) | 1 1/2 cups cooked brown rice | 1/2 cup fresh cilantro leaves, packed | 2 lime leaves, finely shredded or 1/2 lime, zest of | 1 -2 dried hot thai chiles or 1 -2 red hot chili pepper, seeded and finely chopped | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram ( optional ) or 1 teaspoon oregano ( optional )
instructions: Fry okras in 1/2 cup of oil until they are golden brown. Drain on absorbent paper.

Random Ingredients: corn,turmeric powder,baking potato,sage leaf,orange zest,cardamom seed,fennel bulb
title: Baked Sweet Corn With Orange and Sage
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1 teaspoon baking potato, peeled and coarsely torn into small pieces | 1 medium fennel bulb, trimmed and thinly sliced | 1 small orange, zest of, halve the x cut into 12 thin wedges ( approx 1/4 cup, rind only ) | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 8 fresh sage leaves
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°. Spread the cinnamon and cardamom seeds evenly over the inside edde dde leche or baking dish. Sprinkle the potato pieces evenly over the spices and bake for about 20 minutes, or until aromatic but not burnt. Meanwhile, rinse the fennel with boiling water, drain and dry on a paper towel. Heat a cast iron or your favourite vegetable oil on a non stick griddle or frying pan. Stir fry the fennel slices for about 4 or 5 minutes, or until golden, turning several times. Remove the fennel to a bowl, season with salt, and keep warm. Return the griddle, or pan, to low heat and spray lightly with oil. Add the oranges and turmeric and fry for about 1 minute, or until fragrant and zest starts to darken slightly. Pour orange mixture into the griddle, add the sage leaves, and mix well. Continue to toss and add a little hot water if needed to help loosen the mixture. Cook for a further 2 or 3 minutes, or until the mixture has darkened more than has to be, but is still moist. Serve warm. Serve immediately. Variation, the amount of cinnamon depends on the type of fennel. If you prefer softer, hotter or creamier cakes, stir a pinch of salt with a little of the orange mixture.

Random Ingredients: chili paste garlic,cardamom,ditalini,red wine vinegar,flat leaf parsley
title: Ditalini with Parsley and Spices
ingredients: 11 ounces ditalini | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons chili paste with garlic | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1/4 cup fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: Cook 3 cups of cooked ditalini according to package directions. Drain pasta and run under cold water. To make sauce, in a small bowl stir vinegar, chili paste, cardamom and parsley to blend. Add to hot pasta and toss to coat. Serve.

title: Chocolate Cherry Tomato Salsa
ingredients: 2 cups cherry tomatoes, cut in half | 2 tablespoons dry salsa | 2 tablespoons cocoa powder | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh thyme leave
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl and mix to combine well. Place in a sealed jar and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.

title: Pastel De Broccolte (Pastel de Broccolle)
ingredients: 3 ounces uncooked elbow macaroni | 1 can cod, drained and flaked | 2 ounces broccoli, chopped | 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 1/4 cup minced fresh cilantro stem | 2 eggs | 1/4 cup white cheese | 2 tablespoons brandy
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Combine macaroni, cod and broccoli in a large bowl. In a small bowl, beat eggs and maple syrup.

title: The Australian Meatloaf (With Mango and Corn Filling)
ingredients: 1/2 kg fresh pork shoulder | 100 g sultanas or 100 g dates | 100 g mushrooms | 100 g corn | 100 g pork chutney | 2 tablespoons mozzarella cheese | 1 teaspoon oregano | 1/2 cup whipping cream or 1/2 cup cream
instructions: Line the bottom of a loaf tin with non stick baking paper. Place the sultana on a plate. Wash and coarsely chop the dates and mushrooms into large pieces. Place the chopped sultanas and mushrooms in a large bowl with most of the pork shoulder and chop the chutney into small pieces. Chop and mix the corn, pork and chutney. Add to the bowl with the soaked sultanas, mushrooms, dates and dried oregano. Add the cream or whipping cream. Mix well. Place the loaf tin on a baking tray and bake at 200°c/400°f/gas2 for 1hrs. Remove from oven and allow to cool in the tin.

title: Hot Dogs With Creamy Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb pork sausage | 2 tablespoons yellow mustard | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 2 teaspoons minced onions | 2 tablespoons mascarpone cheese | 1/4 cup fresh green
instructions: Brown the sausage lightly and then transfer to a plate. In a bowl, with mustard, turmeric and onions mix well and add the mascarpone cheese and set aside. Slice the green onions into 2 - 3 inch lengths and fry in a little olive oil until golden on the outside and quite dry on top. Arrange on top of the sausage, cover and place in preheated 400 degree f oven for 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cherry tomato,rhubarb,fish sauce,italian plum tomato,chinese sausage
title: Rhubarb, Sweet Italian Sausage and Peppers
ingredients: 1 lb sweet chinese sausage | 2 lbs rhubarb | 1 pint cherry tomatoes | 1 tablespoon fish sauce or 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 1 1/2 lbs italian plum tomatoes
instructions: Slice sweet italian sausage and peppers lengthwise and sauté in a skillet sprayed with pam for 5 minutes on each side. Remove to a bowl, add chopped tomatoes to sautee and stir in fish sauce or soy sauce, and mix well until tomatoes are soft and mixed through. Spoon tomato mixture over sausage and peppers and serve.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,ricotta cheese,cold water,mortadella,tomato juice,dark sesame oil,cherry
title: Wild Mushroom and Mortadella Sauce
ingredients: 10 large button mushrooms | 2 1/2 cups cold water | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 4 medium ripe tomatoes with juice ( or about 15 ounces canned tomatoes ) | 4 ounces ricotta cheese | 1/2 lb mortadella ( or other sausage of your choice ) | cherries, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Trim off the ends of the mushrooms and slice each one into 3/4 inch slices.. Bring the water to a simmer in a medium pot and add the mushrooms, cover and cook until just tender, about 5 minutes. Drain, rinse and dry mushrooms, and set aside. In a blender or food processor, whirl the tomatoes and ricotta cheese until smooth. Fold in the mushrooms, mortadella and cherry tomatoes until combined. Serve warm, garnished with a cherry.

title: Creamy Irish Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 package velveeta cheese, cut into small cubes ( mild or hot, to taste ) | 16 ounces tomato sauce | 1 tablespoon light corn syrup | 2 tablespoons light mayonnaise ( mayo is optional ) | 1/3 cup irish cream
instructions: Place cheese, tomato sauce, light syrup, mayonaise, and irish cream in the bottom of a greased crock pot. Mix well. Cook on low 3 hours or until cheese mixture has melted. Serve with crackers or vegetables.

title: Eggs and Shred Pork
ingredients: 4 slices bacon | 2 tablespoons baby carrots | 2 tablespoons celery, thinly sliced | 4 tablespoons frozen artichoke hearts, thawed ( optional ) | 7 cups homemade chicken stock or 7 cups homemade pork stock | 1 orange
instructions: Boil 3 quarts of stock. Add carrots, cook until tender, about 3 minutes. Drain. Heat a large non stick frying pan, add 2 tbls. Salad oil, cook bacon until brown. Remove from pan with slotted spoon and reserve. Add remaining oil and cook all carrots. Stir in artichokes and saute until they are crisp tender. Remove from pan and place on a paper towel to pat excess moisture. Add chicken stock to bacon drippings. Bring to boil, reduce heat and simmer, stirring occasionally until reduced by half. Squeeze all of the juice from the oranges into stock and stir until heated through. Season soup with salt and pepper and adjust seasonings. Add orange slices to soup and serve.

title: Tibetan Drunken St Lucia (Beer Can)
ingredients: 14 ounces beer | 7 ounces tomato puree | 1 tablespoon palm oil ( or vegetable oil, or other other neutral oil )
instructions: Mix the oil and tomato puree with the beer and pour it in a mixing bowl. Add the palm oil if you're using it. Let it sit in this way for at least an hour. Serve as is, or with a loaf of sweet bread, or crackers, or on top of roast potatoes.

title: Grilled Corned Beef With Maple Syrup (Grilled)
ingredients: 1/4 cup maple syrup | 1/4 cup seasoned rice vinegar | 5 ounces corn beef or 5 ounces lamb meat, from the deli ( 1/4 1/2 pounds ) | 1/2 cup chopped dates ( optional )
instructions: On hot grill, in hot grill surface, toast maple syrup 3 to 4 minutes on each side or until lightly golden. Let cool. Place the roast on the rack of a broiler pan and place 3 to 4 meaty side by side. On each side, lay 1 to 2 teaspoons of chopped dates or 1/4 teaspoon paprika on the end of each meat piece. Wrap tightly in foil and grill indirectly for about 40 minutes. If the meat is done near the meaty side, continue with cooking until done.. Serve on hot platter with maple syrup.

title: Easy Mushroom Mushroom Stock
ingredients: 1 gallon button mushroom | 1 pinch nutmeg
instructions: Wash mushrooms under running water, cut off stems if larger ones. Heat up the pot of mushrooms and heat until all is hot and soft and mushy. Place stock in a crock pot or soup ladle with about 1 pint of hot water or water, stir and add nutmeg to taste. The soup may be served to add flavor to beef, pork, ham or sausage meat, or to make mushroom soup, or can be served in soup bowls as hors d'oeuvres.

title: Fondue for French Fondue
ingredients: 1 french baguette, cut into 1/8-inch slices | 2 tablespoons dry white wine or 2 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar
instructions: Heat oven to 450 degrees f. Arrange slices of bread on sheet of foil. Coat generously with sherry. Wrap in foil and place on cookie sheet. Bake until toasted approximately 10 minutes or until golden brown. Pour off excess sherry. Cool to warm. Refrigerate until ready to serve to avoid breaking bread.

Random Ingredients: idaho potato,onion powder,yellow bell pepper,white fish,season salt,olive
title: Aussie Fish Stew
ingredients: 1 package white fish, cut into 1 1/2 inch pieces | 1 onion powder | season salt to taste | 1 package frozen french fries prepared in a pouch | 1 yellow bell pepper, cut into 1 inch pieces | 3 tablespoons olives, sliced
instructions: In a dutch oven or large saucepan, combine fish, onion, season salt and pepper. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium and simmer 25 minutes, or until fish is cooked through. While fish mixture is cooking, make fries according to package instructions. While fries are cooking, heat olive in a small skillet, stirring to spread a layer of oil over the top of the dutch oven.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,mustard seed,tomato green chilies,sugar syrup,heavy whipping cream,yellow bell pepper,lemongrass
title: Tomato Cream Sauce With Apples
ingredients: 1 lb tart apple, peeled, cored and diced in small cubes | 1/2 cup sugar syrup | 1 green chilies or 1 red chili, chopped | 1 stalk fresh lemongrass, minced | 2 tablespoons mustard seeds | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 yellow bell pepper, seeded and diced
instructions: In a large saucepan, heat the sugar syrup, chilies, lemongrass and mustard seeds until the chilies are fragrant and the oil has started to smoke. Add the whipping cream, mix well and bring to a boil. Lower the heat and simmer 10 minutes. Add the bell pepper and simmer 5 minutes longer. Cool. Serve hot or cold, with the optional mustard.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon powder,star anise,tomato soup,italian sausage link
title: Italian Sausage and Veggies
ingredients: 1 lb hot italian sausage link, sliced | 1 beef bouillon powder | 8 ounces tomato soup | 1 star anise, pod
instructions: Place the sausage in a dutch oven with about 1 teaspoon of oil on it, turning to brown evenly. When it's cooked through, drain it. Pour the soup into the pan. Add star anise pods. Simmer for about 20 minutes over low heat, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,red chilies,shiitake mushroom cap,extra virgin olive oil,marinara sauce,japanese soy sauce,thai fish sauce
title: Cocoa-Glazed Mushrooms
ingredients: 8 fresh shiitake mushroom caps, trimmed ( not caps ) | 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1/2 cup japanese soy sauce | 1 tablespoon japanese fish sauce | 2 -3 teaspoons cocoa powder | 1/4 cup fresh marinara sauce | 4 -6 pieces red chilies
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees. Wipe the mushrooms clean with paper towels, and place on a baking sheet. Place a heavy ovenproof skillet on top of the mushrooms to weigh them down or put the heavy skillet in the oven to roast them for about 1 hour. Watch for them to change color from a medium to dark brown, and be shriveled. Once soft they are done, remove the skillet from the oven. Place the mushrooms in the center of a warm platter and set aside to cool. Prepare the sauce by combining all the ingredients and stirring them up with a whisk until well blended. Pour the sauce over the mushrooms and serve.

Random Ingredients: white pepper,chili pepper,self rising flour,tilapia fillet,liquid smoke,lemon myrtle,chipotle powder
title: Smoked Fish Tacos
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | 1/4 teaspoon hot chili pepper | 4 tablespoons self-rising flour | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper or 1/8 teaspoon crushed chile pepper | 24 ounces tilapia fillets | 1/3 cup of chopped onion | 8 -10 leaves lemon myrtle, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon dried chipotle powder ( optional )
instructions: Dry fry the fish in a little olive oil and spices for a couple of minutes in 2 tbsp of oil and seasoning. Cut the fish from top shell on one half of the fish and place in the center on a flat surface. Mix onions, lemon myrtle and chipotle powder together and pour over fish. Roll up the fish and secure with tooth picks. Fry in 1 tbsp olive oil and salt and pepper and when the fish turns opaque, remove toothpick. Remove fish onto a warm serving plate and put a few pieces of tin foil over the top. Spoon some lime myrtle over fish, it will serve as a topping for the taco. It is suggested for those of you who like it spicy.

title: Mock Party  American (Or Great American) Cheese & Macaroni Skillet
ingredients: 2 tablespoons elbow macaroni | 1/2 cup shredded american cheese
instructions: Prepare macaroni per pkg directions. While macaroni is cooking, slice up the american cheese and set aside. When macaroni is done, drain and set aside in a medium bowl. While macaroni is draining, heat 1 t. Of the oil in a large non stick skillet until hot but not smoking. Add 1/2 cup of the cheese and stir until melted. Put macaroni back in the pan and add about 1 t. Of the cheese. Let macaroni melt. Put the other 1/2 cup of the cheese on top and continue cooking. After two minutes, let cheese get some color, then take off heat. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: bulk italian sausage,flour tortilla,rotel tomato chilies
title: Spanish Tortilla Chips
ingredients: 2 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil | 2 cups bulk italian sausage | 2 cans rotel tomatoes & chilies
instructions: Heat the oventime or skillet over medium high heat with the olive oil. Add the sausage and stir fry until browned, breaking it up. Remove sausage from the skillet and drain. Add the tomatoes with chilies and boil for 10 minutes or until thickened. Spoon sausage into warm tortillas and top with shredded cheddar cheese or guacamole.

Random Ingredients: teriyaki marinade sauce,corn chip,orange zest,red pepper,gingerroot,potato starch,chocolate syrup,sausage
title: Melt Down Sausage With Chips
ingredients: 4 sweet sausages | 1 tablespoon corn chips | 3 tablespoons potato starch or 3 tablespoons rice flour | 2 tablespoons orange zest | 1 tablespoon gingerroot, grated | 1/2 tablespoon red pepper, crushed | 1 tablespoon teriyaki marinade sauce | 1 tablespoon maple syrup
instructions: Wash and dry sausages, trim ends and discard. Cut into 1 inch wide slices. Preheat grill/broiler and lightly oil grate. Place sausage in baking dish and sprinkle with corn chips, then coat with potato starch/rice flour mixture. Mix remaining ingredients, tossing until well incorporated. Spoon mixture onto sausages. Cook for about 20 minutes, or just until golden brown on top. Serve warm.

title: Low Fat aubergine (Eggplant) Loaf
ingredients: 4 large aubergines | 2 large onions, peeled and finely chopped | 500 g good quality pork loin, finely chopped ( can sub lamb ) | 2 tablespoons sage, chopped | 1 packet dry onion soup mix
instructions: Pre heat the oven to 190c/fan 200c/gas mark 2. Grease 4 x 3cm loaf tins/loaves. Carefully peel the aubergines and cut them in half lengthways. Use a melon baller to flatten out the flesh so that it is like mashed potato. Then remove the seeds and the pulp, as well as any excess membrane. Mash the flesh in two batches using a fork and adding all the remaining ingrdients. Spoon into the tins, being sure to leave a little of the aubergine flesh in this shape. Cook for 40 - 50 minutes, checking on the progress regularly to make sure it doesn’t burn. Remove from the oven and leave on top until room temperature. This also tastes good as long grain sticky bread or toast with a bit of garlic and butter. You can also spread the aubergines with a little oil and bake in a pre heated oven for 20 mins or until golden brown on top. Icing, to make a simple icing, melt the sugar in a small saucepan over a low heat or in the microwave. Stir until its dissolved and then stir through the rest of the flavourings that have dissolved. When the aubergines have cooled a little, spread icing lightly on to one side of the loaf tins, then cut into 6 pieces or a similar size slice. Serve warm with tea.

title: Aqua Verde
ingredients: 1 liter commercial sparkling orange vodka
instructions: Strain the orange vodka into a bottle, then pour over cold cracked ice until it has frozen. If you serve immediately this is the recommended amount. The longer it stays in the freezer, the more the content develops. Aqua verde is preferred for a tropical flavored drink. Note, the best way to obtain authentic orange vodka is to buy precooked vodka, then cut off the cord and continue to refrigerate for a day.

Random Ingredients: duck,parmesan cheese,southern comfort,cooking oat,green chilies,chicken bouillon cube
title: Duck Rattle
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated cooked duck | 3 cups cooked cooking oats ( about 1.25 pats ) | 2 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese | 2 tablespoons chopped green chilies ( about 2 green chili peppers ) or 2 tablespoons jalapeno peppers, for the brave | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 1/2 tablespoons all-natural southern comfort
instructions: Cut duck meat into 6 slices. Scoop the stuffing from the underside of each slice of duck meat and stuff the stuffing into the meat. Place the rolled oat puffs on a foil lined baking sheet. Spray with nonstick cooking spray and bake at 350 f for 35 - 40 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese and top each serving with chopped green chili, jalapeno peppers or pepper strips. You may need a toothpick to keep the cheese inside them. Duck rattle may be frozen until ready to use, or you may use defrosted rattle. You may also add a vegetable to the stuffing if you desire.

title: Saliq
ingredients: 1/2 cup red bell pepper, finely cut | 2 cups vegetable broth or 2 cups low-sodium chicken broth | 4 teaspoons fresh vanilla almond milk | 2 teaspoons ground cardamom
instructions: In a medium saucepan over medium heat, bring the broth to a boil. Stir in the peppers and the cardamom. Return to medium heat. Cook, stirring constantly, until slightly thickened, about 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: black coffee,pinto bean,cashew nut,pizza sauce,sherry,scallion,fettuccine pasta
title: Vegan Fettuccine Pasta
ingredients: 4 ounces dry fettuccine pasta | 16 ounces dried pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 4 scallions, sliced | 8 ounces low-sodium pizza sauce | 12 ounces black coffee | 1/4 cup dry sherry | shredded cashew nuts ( optional )
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.

title: Spicy Cottage Cheese
ingredients: 1 kg small curd cottage cheese | 2 tablespoons tamarind paste
instructions: Put the cottage cheese in a mixing bowl. Add water, salt to taste and beat until smooth. Dab in some oil or with a teaspoon. Cover tightly in plastic wrap and refrigerate for minimum 1 hour, then serve with bread of your choice.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper,basil,popeye bread,rigatoni pasta,dark brown sugar
title: Spinonesse
ingredients: 13 ounces frozen ravioli pasta or 13 ounces spaghetti | 150 ml sweet chili pepper, paste | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1/4 cup basil, chopped
instructions: Place the ravioli in boiling salted water & cook until al dente, when cooked drain & set aside to dry on a towel. Saute the chilli in the olive oil or a tablespoon of the chilli oil in a frypan. While the chilli is rendering, in a separate pot add chilli paste & sugar, keep stirring till the sugar dissolves. Add the rinsed ravioli, mix thoroughly until heated through. Serve the spinonesse with plenty of basil & plenty of napkins.

Random Ingredients: streaky bacon,butter paper,baby lima bean,barbecue sauce,ajwain
title: Baby Lima Beans With Ajwain
ingredients: 1 tablespoon butter foil, lightly greased | 150 g baby lima beans | 25 g streaky bacon | 1/2 - 1 small head garlic, cloves peeled and sliced thinly | 2 teaspoons light ajwain, spice ( see note )
instructions: Heat a small amount of oil in a frypan over medium low heat. Brush the foil lightly with the oil and allow to cook. Meanwhile slice the bacon into about 25 gms thick slices. Toss the lima beans in toasty little tin foil, then fry them on all sides until they are golden brown all over. To serve, remove the foil carefully, place one piece of bacon on top of 1/2 of the lima beans, and top with an even layer of the remaining beans. Sprinkle over the sliced garlic and serve immediately.

title: Curry Powder Powder
ingredients: 1/4 cup coriander seed | 3/4 cup fresh ginger root, peeled and grated
instructions: Place coriander seeds in a skillet over medium heat. Cook and stir until fragrant, about 5 minutes. Cool seeds.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile,gingerroot,self raising flour,chicken stock,lemon,vanilla bean,purpose flour,paprika
title: Spicy Fried Rice
ingredients: 500 g self-raising flour ( sifted ) | 1/2 teaspoon smoked paprika | 1/2 teaspoon ground gingerroot | 2 teaspoons ground chipotle chiles | 300 ml chicken stock ( or water ) | 500 g raw carrots ( grated ) | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 1 lemon, juice and rind of | 2 -3 teaspoons pure vanilla beans ( optional ) or 2 -3 teaspoons vanilla extract ( optional )
instructions: Whisk together flour, paprika, chiles, stock, carrots, lemon rind and juice.

title: Irish Breakfast Scones
ingredients: 6 ounces mixed vegetables, chopped ( broccoli, potatoes, and cauliflower ) | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 3/4 cup tea ( i use decaf )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Mix together the veggies. Place on a large baking sheet which has been sprayed with cooking spray. Mix together the cream and tea. Spoon mixture onto the veggies, and bake for 15 - 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pillsbury crescent dinner,turkey,white breadcrumb,mustard powder,ruby port,salmon fillet,marjoram
title: Crispy Salmon With Port and Mustard Crumbs
ingredients: 3 tablespoons mustard powder | 1 2/3 lbs salmon fillet, cut into 6 pieces | 2 1/4 cups white breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup ruby port or 1/2 cup other dark-wine flavored cooking wine | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram | crescent dinner rolls
instructions: In a dry, wide ovenproof skillet, evenly sprinkle mustard powder onto both sides of salmon. Place 1 cup breadcrumbs in a shallow bowl. Place in a food processor and pulse until finely crumbs are formed. Spread bread crumbs evenly over salmon. Cook until lightly golden brown, about 5 minutes, turning to brown evenly, about 1 minute per side. Transfer salmon to cutting board, cover loosely with foil, and let stand 10 minutes. Toast bread crumbs in broiler until lightly browned, 15 - 20 minutes. Meanwhile, in saucepan, combine wine with marjoram and marjoram. Bring to boil, then reduce heat and simmer until liquid is reduced by a third, 5 - 6 minutes. Place a 12 nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Remove salmon from pan and place in skillet with the crumbs. Stir until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Transfer to plates, top with salmon, and serve hot. Serves 4.

Random Ingredients: maple syrup,red chili pepper,red curry paste,green olive,vidalia onion,red lentil
title: Spicy Red Lentil Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 3 cans red lentils, rinsed | 1 large vidalia onion, sliced | 1 red chili pepper, chopped | 1 jar stuffed green olives
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the maple syrup, red curry paste, lentils, onion and chili. Combine and chill for at least 1 hour until the flavors develop. Arrange the salad on serving plates, top with olives.

title: Baked Cauliflower and Fresh Veggies
ingredients: 1 small head cauliflower, separated into florets | 1/2 cup vegetable broth
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Place cauliflower in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Sprinkle with vegetable broth, cover with aluminum foil, and bake for 30 minutes in the preheated oven. Remove from the oven and arrange the cauliflower in a pattern over the roasted cauliflower. Bake for an additional 15 minutes, or until cauliflower is crisping and beginning to brown.

title: Black Mushrooms Vodka
ingredients: 1 ounce vodka | 12 black mushrooms
instructions: Add vodka. After 10 minutes, add black mushrooms on top. Let cook for 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: nutritional yeast flake,green chilies,beef sirloin,paprika,button mushroom,lemon juice zest
title: Seared Beef Tips With Mushrooms & Green Chile
ingredients: 6 ounces dried button mushrooms, soaked in cold water 20 minutes | 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef sirloin, with the tenderised fat trimmed, cut into 1 1/2 inch slices | 4 teaspoons paprika | 1 can green chilies, drained ( can use one of sanitarium brand ) | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1 teaspoon plain nutritional yeast flakes ( i just use dried )
instructions: Put mushrooms, ginger and chilies in a large bowl and add water to cover, stir well to combine everything and let sit for 5 - 10 minutes so that spices soften together. Add meat to the marinade and stir well to coat. Cover and marinate in refrigerator over night turning pieces several times if you can, or over night. Preheat grill or broiler over medium high heat and oil lightly. Cook meat for 10 - 15 minutes, turning to brown well on all sides. If you're using the gf sauce listed above, increase heat to high and brown beef. Cook for 3 - 5 minutes or until meat is cooked as desired. Stir in lemon zest and nutritional yeast flakes and cook for another 2 - 3 minutes to thicken sauce. Serve, drizzling extra sauce on top for dipping. Serve immediately.

title: Macaroni and Cheese Salad
ingredients: 1 1/3 cups macaroni | 1 cup seasoned bread crumbs | 1/2 cup shredded lettuce leaf
instructions: Cook macaroni in 2 quarts of boiling water until just tender. Drain and cool. Transfer to large bowl. Add bread crumbs and 2 cups of the cheese. Toss gently, or toss until well blended. Add macaroni and remaining 2 cups cheese. Toss gently. Serve.

title: Spinach and Pineapple (21 Day Wonder Diet : Day 7 )
ingredients: 8 ounces fresh baby spinach | 4 ounces fresh pineapple chunks, drained | 2 tablespoons mexican oregano ( or 1 tbs dried )
instructions: Place the spinach, pineapple and oregano in a large bowl and toss with a pinch of salt and some pepper. Sprinkle with some additional oregano as you serve.

title: Italian Quinoa Balls (Vegan)
ingredients: 2 cups cooked quinoa | 1 cup bisquick reduced fat baking mix | 1/4 cup dried breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place quinoa and baking mix in a bowl. Stir in quinoa mix. Cover and refrigerate for 2 to 24 hours. Roll mixture into small balls and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake for 12 - 12 minutes until firm and golden brown. Makes about 24 quinoa balls. I usually bake mine for about 20 - 30 minutes before my family arrive home. Enjoy.

title: Easy Indian Turnip and Turnip Tarts With Paneer
ingredients: 4 small turnips, peeled and cut into 3/4-inch slices | 2 tablespoons garam masala, curry powder | 4 tablespoons canned pimiento, drained | 1 pastry crusts, for a double-crust pie | 24 cherry tomatoes, halved
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Spray a 9 inch quiche dish generously with nonstick cooking spray. Combine turnips, garam masala, and pimientos in a bowl. Squeeze juice from pimentos into mixture and add a little water or more if needed to coat vegetables. Spoon mixture into the bottom of the prepared crust lined quiche dish and sprinkle the top with cherry tomatoes. Bake until crust is deep golden brown and turnips are tender, about 20 minutes. Let cool, and cut into 16 squares.

title: Almond and Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 small cauliflower, washed, trimmed and cut into florets | 1 tablespoon cumin seeds | 3 tablespoons sliced almonds
instructions: Heat a little oil and fry the cumin until it starts giving off a aroma. Remove from heat and add the cauliflower. Mix thoroughly. Add the almonds. Serve immediately.

title: Tropical Pineapple
ingredients: 1 whole pineapple ( about 1 lb ) | 1/2 cup dried currant
instructions: Using a sharp knife, cut an x into the pineaple, cutting 4 x 2 deep crosswise slices, cutting a horizontal slit down each x and slicing again, being careful to cut all the way through the pineaple.

Random Ingredients: celery salt,oregano leaf,dark rum,dark brown sugar,pork loin,icing sugar,sage,chicken stock
title: Pork Loin With Rum
ingredients: 1 lb pork loin | 1 glass dark rum | 7 fluid ounces chicken stock | 1/2 ounce dark rum | 3/4 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/4 teaspoon dried sage | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 1 tablespoon icing sugar | 1 teaspoon celery salt
instructions: Mix the rum, chicken stock, rum, oregano, sage and sugar together in a large mixing bowl and slowly add the pork. Let stand at room temperature for 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 275 degrees f. Pour the marinade into an ovenproof casserole dish and place on a baking sheet. Roast uncovered for 5 hours. Remove the loin from the oven and allow to cool completely. Slice across the grain, about 1/2 inch thick, and place back in the oven for about 30 minutes, until a crust forms on the top of the meat. Dust rosette with icing sugar and serve with bread. Note, if you like a little kick to the gravy, add 4 tablespoon of hot dark rum to the rum.

title: Naked Beans with Macaroni (Pastel De Macaroni)
ingredients: 1 cup elbow macaroni | 1 can fat-free refried beans | cooking oil, for frying | ground cinnamon ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Cook macaroni according to package directions. Drain and rinse with cool water. Heat oil in a deep fryer to 360 degrees f. Drain the macaroni and beans well and toss with the fried beans. Sprinkle with cinnamon, if desired.

title: Apricot Beef Nests With Hickory Chips
ingredients: 1/4 cup paprika | 1 tablespoon cumin | 1 teaspoon grated mace | 1 can condensed beef broth | 12 large mushroom caps, thinly sliced | 12 apricot jam, heated
instructions: In a small bowl combine paprika, cumin and mace. Add broth. Cover and chill. In a 8x8 inch square baking dish, layer pepper jelly and mushroom caps. Top with apricot jam. Pack any remaining jam on top to form a tight nest atop nests, pressing lightly. Cover and refrigerate at least 3 hours or overnight. Bake at 375 degrees covered for 35 min until very hot. Serve with favorite rice.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,italian,cream mushroom soup,mustard powder,walnut oil,pineapple,parsley flake
title: Italian Pineapple Spread
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup walnut oil | 1/3 cup shredded parmesan sharp cheddar cheese or 1/3 cup romano cheese, blend | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 tablespoon dried parsley flakes | 1 can pineapple slices, drained ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon italian seasoned blend spices ( optional )
instructions: Place 1/2 cup of the soup mixture in the slow cooker. In a small bowl, mix the remaining soup and the walnut oil until blended. Sprinkle the walnut cheese and cheddar cheese mixture over the soup mixture. Stir in mustard, parsley flakes, and optional optional dried basil or other seasoning to taste. Cook on medium for 4 to 5 hours, or on high for up to 8 hours.

title: Easy Borscht
ingredients: 1 pound beef tenderloin, cut into 2 inch cubes | 1 can reduced-sodium chicken broth | 1 can crushed tomatoes | 1 cup nonfat milk | 1/4 cup chopped fresh dill
instructions: Combine beef cubes and chicken broth in slow cooker. Cover.

title: Australian Mango Cured Pork Skewers
ingredients: 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh mango chutney | 2 tablespoons sweet mango chutney | 1 pork fillet, trimmed ( about 150g/7oz ) | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 400 g dashes malt vinegar or 400 g mild mango chutney
instructions: Combine the mango chutney, mango chutney and salt in a small bowl. Spoon over the pork and rub in completely. Leave to marinate at room temperature for 2 hours. Thread 4 skewers. Grill under a moderately hot grill untill the pork is golden. Turn and brown the other side, then remove from the grill and leave to stand briefly before skewers. To serve, scatter with the malt vinegar or chutney.

title: Prosciutto Wrapped in Provolone
ingredients: 1 ounce prosciutto, cut into 12 slices
instructions: Lay one prosciutto slice on each piece of provolone cheese. Rub the provolone with the five spice powder. Wrap in wax paper.

title: Soy Cakes (Japanese Snacks) #5FIX
ingredients: 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 1 package of plain gluten free breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Mix soy sauce and breadcrumbs with hands. Roll the dough into a flat circle, about 1 inch and 4 inches in diameter. Spray a little olive oil onto the top of each piece, dip in oil and place on a baking sheet. Bake 12 - 15 minutes, until crispy and golden. Remove from oven and remove excess oil. Add sweet chili sauce, or any optional ingredient that pleases your taste.

Random Ingredients: broccoli,dark molasses,jarlsberg cheese,kaffir lime leaf,heavy cream,pepper,marsala wine
title: Napa Dave's Broccoli With Marsala
ingredients: 1 head broccoli, cut into florets | 1/2 cup sweet marsala wine ( or use any dry white wine ) | 1 cup heavy cream ( or add 2 tbsps. dijon mustard if using dry white wine ) | 1/4 cup dark molasses | kaffir lime leaf | freshly ground pepper | 1/2 lb jarlsberg cheese ( or other comparable firm cheese )
instructions: Steam the broccoli until it is slightly tender but still somewhat crisp. Rinse with fresh water.

title: Korean Steak Seasoning - Microwave
ingredients: 1/4 cup soy sauce | 2 teaspoons ground celery salt | 3 stalks celery salt, finely chopped
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together soy sauce, celery salt, and celery. Add onions and mix well. Marinate the steaks for 1 hour at room temperature, or overnight if you prefer. Spread on beef slices.

title: Focaccia Di Salvia (Italian Pizza Dough)
ingredients: 200 g cornflour ( stone ground or fresh is fine ) | 1 egg, beaten | 1 1/2 teaspoons yeast ( rapid action ) | 6 -7 -8 garlic cloves ( minced or pressed ) or 6 -8 garlic cloves ( minced or pressed ) | 7 -10 leaves fresh sage ( or 1/2 cup dried sage )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. If dough is too dry, add a bit more of the cornflour or flour. If dough is too dry, add a bit more of the cornflour or flour. If dough is too fluid, add a bit more of the cornflour or flour. If dough is too hard, add a bit more water or flour. Turn dough onto a lightly floured surface and knead until smooth, but not elastic.. Place dough in a greased bowl and leave to rise until it has risen approximately one hour... Using a large biscuit glass, press dough out evenly with the bottom of the glass. Add filling to desired shape and spread evenly on dough. Top with sage and make an indentation in center of foccacia with fingers and thumb. Place on a pizza tray and leave to rise again for another hour or more. Enjoy.

title: Crazy French Diners, "Peppered" Appetisers
ingredients: 4 ounces wide egg noodles | 1/4 cup molasses | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard
instructions: Cook the noodles drain& stir in molasses add dijon when the noodles are done serve.

Random Ingredients: no salt tomato,sesame,self raising flour,creamy peanut butter,hazelnut,golden syrup
title: Hazelnut Rolls
ingredients: 1 cup nuts ( i use hazelnuts ) | 5 ounces sesame ( i use almond ) | 14 ounces no-salt-added whole tomatoes | 1 cup natural creamy peanut butter | 1 cup self-raising flour | 1 tablespoon golden syrup
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200°c line a 20 x 30cm baking tin with baking paper and arrange the nuts across the base so they are level. Blend the sesame and nuts in a food processor until finely crushed. Reserve 1 cup of the sesame and nuts and pulse remaining nuts into the sesame mixture. Finely chop 3/4 cup of the remaining sesame seeds. Reserve the remainder for decoration. In a bowl, combine the chopped sesame, peanuts, remaining reserved sesame mixture, peanut butter and flour. Mix lightly to form a soft dough. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface and shape into a roll about 1cm thick. Arrange slices on the prepared baking tray, then brush with the reserved sesame mixture. Bake in a pre heated oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until crisp. Remove from the oven and cool for 5 minutes. Remove the biscuits from the tin and cut each roll into 18 pieces. Place the icing on a tray, fill each with the nuts and sesame mix, and roll up like a jelly roll.

Random Ingredients: brandy,wheat pastry flour,red wine,pineapple chunk,jalapeno chile,almond extract,cheddar cheese
title: Pineapple-Jalapeno Cheese Mince
ingredients: 4 tablespoons whole wheat pastry flour | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1 1/4 cups medium cheddar cheese | 2 tablespoons brandy | 1 1/2 cups red wine | 1 can pineapple chunks ( reserve juice ) | 1/4 cup slivered almonds ( reserve juice )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Lightly mix flour, almond extract, and grated chees using a fork. Add brandy and combine well. Add wine and pineapple juice and stir to combine. Stir in almonds and combine well. Shape into 24 patties. Place on ungreased nonstick baking sheets, and bake in oven until cheese is melting and beginning to brown. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,tortilla,cooking oil,dark raisin,cumin seed,leg lamb
title: Tunisian-Style Lamb
ingredients: 450 g butterflied boneless leg of lamb, trimmed of visible fat and cut into 2. 5 cm thick slices, rind removed | 1 garlic clove, finely minced | 250 g dark raisins, soaked in hot water for 30 minutes and drained | 2 teaspoons cumin seeds | 2 teaspoons vanilla beans | 600 ml cooking oil | tortillas or flat bread, to serve
instructions: Using a sharp knife, make four diagonal slashes in a leg of lamb. Combine lamb with minced garlic, raisins, cumin seeds and vanilla beans in a large, shallow, roasting pan. Drizzle with 1 1/2 tablespoons oil. Add a pinch of salt and the remaining oil to the pan. Cover and cook in the preheated oven at 180°, basting twice, for 1 hour. Remove from oven and leave to rest for 10 to 15 minutes before serving with a selection of accompaniments, cut in pieces, on a pool of butter, and accompany with toasted rice.

title: Creole Seasoned Peas and Octopus - 5pts Pressure Cooker
ingredients: 1 tablespoon creole seasoning | 2 quarts water or 2 quarts beef stock | 1/2 cup raisins, dried | 1/2 cup currants or 1/2 cup dried cranberries | 1 teaspoon flax seed | 1 1/2 lbs octopus
instructions: In pressure cooker, add creole seasoning and water. Close lid and bring to high pressure, then bring down heat and cook for 45 minutes. Remove from heat and open lid. Remove all entrails from pot and set aside. Rinse and separate entrails and discard entrails. Set aside. If using stock instead of water, make sure the water covers the base of the pot if the stock does not reach the top of the pot. If using liquid, bring stock back to high pressure, then cook as directed. If a little water remains, add currants and raisins or cranberries, if desired. Allow to cool slightly then remove entrails from pot and place on serving platter. Remove entrails from pot with slotted spoon and arrange on plate. Place a bowl of ice cubes on top.

Random Ingredients: cabbage,shrimp,taco sauce,butter lettuce,marinara sauce,angel hair pasta,pineapple juice
title: Sweet Mexican Salad
ingredients: 1 -2 lb shrimp, halved if large | 1 head cabbage | 4 cups marinara sauce ( i prefer chi chi's pina colada ) | 1 bottle pineapple juice ( juice from can drained if no juice ) | 1 cup butter lettuce or 1 cup iceberg lettuce | 1 package fresh uncooked angel hair pasta ( or whatever flavor you prefer ) | 1 cup taco sauce ( i prefer chi's pina colada brand )
instructions: Heat grill to high and grill shrimp until pink and cooked through, about 2 to 3 minutes per side. Slice the shrimp and set aside. Bring cabbage to a boil in a large pot of salted water. Add shrimp and cook until cabbage is limp but still crisp. Remove cabbage from water with a slotted spoon or spider and cut into bite sized pieces. Set aside. Cut the cooled shrimp into bite sized pieces. Bring marinara sauce and pineapple juice to a boil, stirring constantly. Add dressing and stir often until heated through. Top shrimp with shredded cheese and lettuce. Serve in shallow bowls with warm or warm pasta.

Random Ingredients: shallot,steak,feta,acorn squash,active yeast,chocolate chip,anaheim chilies,white sugar
title: Choco-Balls #5FIX
ingredients: 2 tablespoons active dry yeast ( rapid-rise or rapid-rise ) | 1/2 cup white sugar | 1 cup shredded schnitzel dried tomatoes and chilies | 1 cup crumbled feta | 1/4 cup chopped anaheim chilies, or to taste | 1 shallot, minced | 1 cup shredded skirt steak, or to taste | 1/4 cup semisweet chocolate chips, or as desired, or as desired. ( optional )
instructions: Combine yeast and sugar in a large bowl, and stir in the tomatoes, feta, chilies, and minced shallot. Beat the mixture very well, scraping down with a wooden spoon as needed. Stir in the skirt steak and cheese until the mixture becomes slightly creamy, and forms lightly but crumbly patties. Cover bowl and set aside in a warm area to rise, about 2 hours or overnight. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or waxed paper. Lightly grease the sides of the baking sheet with olive oil spray. Place patties on the prepared baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through, coating the inside with olive oil spray. Sprinkle top with chocolate chips before serving if desired.

title: Quick and Easy Pico De Gallo
ingredients: 2 fresh medium tomatillos salsa ( pico maria flavor ) | 2 -3 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley leaves | 1/2 - 2/3 lb cooked ground round
instructions: To serve, fill a bowl with ice and cracker. Spoon the pico de gallo onto the ice, add parsley, and spoon ground round over the top.

title: Wasabi Cucumber Rolls
ingredients: 1 cucumber ( peeled, sliced into 12 thin strips ) | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/2 teaspoon dried dill weed | 1/2 teaspoon wasabi paste
instructions: Prepare wasabi paste by combining the wasabi paste and wasabi, and refrigerating until serving time. Cook the cucumber in boiling water until tender.

Random Ingredients: thyme leave,parmigiano reggiano cheese,cod fillet,porcini mushroom,yellow bell pepper
title: Broiled Cod With Roasted Yellow Pepper Strips and Porcini Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/2 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh thyme leave | 1 large yellow bell pepper, halved and thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 4 cod fillets ( about 1 1/4 pounds in diameter ) | 1 -2 ounce fresh porcini mushrooms, stems removed
instructions: Preheat broiler element to 375°f. Combine 1/4 cup cheese, thyme and 1/2 tablespoon oil in small bowl. Sprinkle both sides of cod with salt and pepper mixture. Arrange fish on sheet of plastic wrap and sprinkle with cheese mixture.

title: Mexican Dry Whole Wheat Chapati
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups wheat flour | 1/4 - 1/2 cup red wine | 1 can chopped green chilies | 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper flakes
instructions: Mix ingredients together with spoon. Dough should be firm but soft. Divide into 4 balls or 1 1/2 inch size pieces. Roll each ball to about 1/4 inch thick. Cook until lightly browned on all sides. Serve with your favorite spices or tomato salsa. You can do this with other dried chile, or make your own by mashing all the dried chiles in a hot frying pan and adding 1 tablespoon olive oil and a pinch of salt. Add a bit of the chile oil to help bring out the flavors.

Random Ingredients: fruit,pear,sambal oelek,red chili pepper flake,salmon fillet
title: Grilled Salmon With a Tropical Fruit Salad
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets | 1 tablespoon sambal oelek ( to taste ) | 1 tablespoon dried fruit, chopped | 1 pineapple | 1/4 medium sweet red chili pepper, deseeded and finely chopped
instructions: Whisk together the sambal oelek, dried fruit, & red chile. Lightly oil the grill & grill salmon for 4 minutes on each side, or until just cooked and then set aside to rest. Meanwhile, roughly chop the bibb lettuce leaves & arrange them in a flat dish. Cut up the pineapple & red pepper then cut it into small chunks. Combine the chilli & fruit in a small bowl & set aside. Drain the salmon fillets then gently rub them with the sambal olek. Grill the salmon for 5 minutes on each side, basting frequently, until cooked through & golden.

Random Ingredients: yukon gold potato,beef tenderloin,extra virgin olive oil,egg noodle,cardamom seed,chicken breast,wild rice
title: Yukon Gold Potato and Chicken Skillet
ingredients: 4 large yukon gold potatoes | 2 1/2 cups reduced-sodium beef tenderloin | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil ( evoo ) | 2 cups cooked egg noodles ( i used whole wheat ) | 2 large boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 2 teaspoons cardamom seeds | 1 cup wild rice, cooked
instructions: Place potato in large pot with enough water to cover by 2 inches.

Random Ingredients: golden syrup,shrimp,anchovy oil,chicken drummettes,cheese tortellini,beef chuck
title: Quick and Easy Beef Tortellini
ingredients: 4 pounds boneless beef chuck, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 jar anchovy packed in oil, drained | 1/2 cup golden syrup | 1 pound frozen cheese tortellini | 1 pound cooked shrimp, peeled and deveined | 3 cans chicken drummettes, drained
instructions: Simmer chuck in a pot with anchovies in olive oil and golden syrup until tender, about 25 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside to cool. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add tortellini and cook for 10 to 12 minutes until al dente.

Random Ingredients: cannellini bean,broth,baking powder,ladyfinger,white pepper,yellow pepper,water chestnut,linguine
title: Linguine With White Pepper Sauce, Cannellini Beans, and Water Chestnuts
ingredients: cooking spray or 1 teaspoon olive oil | 1 package frozen sliced water chestnuts | 2 tablespoons white pepper, minced | 1/2 yellow pepper, minced | 1/2 cup canned cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 1/2 cups low sodium chicken stock or 1 1/2 cups canned low sodium broth | 1 lb linguine | 1 package ladyfingers
instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Coat pan with cooking spray, then add the water chestnuts and chiles to the pan. Cook, stirring now and then, for about 2 minutes, or until the water chestnuts begin to brown. Add the white pepper, beans, chicken stock, and linguine to skillet and reduce heat to low. In a small bowl, mix the cooked mixture with a fork until creamy. Serve with the lady fingers.

title: Warm Fruit Salad
ingredients: 3 cups fruit, such as strawberries, peaches, melon, grapes, blueberries, raspberries, cherries, red strawberries, and oranges | 3 tablespoons bacon grease | 1 teaspoon balsamic vinegar | 1/2 cup whole wheat germ
instructions: To make fruit salad, slice the fruits up as if you were going to cut up your salad. Add bacon grease to a large nonstick pan. If the fat is too high, just sprinkle with olive oil. Pour in the balsamic vinegar, increase the heat to medium, and cook for another 4 - 5 minutes, just until warmed through and slightly sizzling. Add your warm salad, and top with whole wheat germ and bacon. Serve immediately, or refrigerate until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: pecan,pecorino romano cheese,peach,white truffle oil,tomato soup
title: Baked Tomatoes
ingredients: 3 medium tomatoes | 2 slices white truffle oil | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 2/3 cup pecans ( finely chopped ) | 3 tablespoons pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Grease 13x9 inch pan with non stick cooking spray. Cut out the top 1/3 of each tomatoes and scoop out seeds. Slice tomato slices 1/2 inch thick with a serrated knife or the other end. Place each slice in a 1 quart dish. Mix tomatoes and truffle oil. Spoon tomato mixture over tomatoes and sprinkle romano cheese and pecorino cheese over each tomato. Bake 30 minutes.

title: Noodle Salad With Peanut Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup roasted peanuts, finely chopped | 4 ounces uncooked noodles, broken into 2-inch pieces ( thin ) | 1/2 cup sweetened coconut, finely shredded | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 1/4 cup brown sugar
instructions: Mix together the peanuts, noodles, coconut, vinegar and sugar. You can also add chopped raw peanuts if you want, but i like them crunchier. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: peppermint extract,cherry,chicken breast fillet,cooking apple,vanilla,lemon peel
title: Dutch Oven Baked Chicken With Peppers
ingredients: 1 large chicken breast fillet | 1/2 teaspoon lemon peel | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 2/3 cup quick-cooking apple juice, heated to boiling | 1 teaspoon peppermint extract | cherries
instructions: Combine chicken breast, lemon peel, vanilla, apple juice and peppermint extract in 13x9 baking dish. Wrap dish with foil and bake 1 1/2 hours turning once or twice. Remove fish and drain off fat. Remove foil and drizzle with remaining juices.

title: Zucchini Spinach
ingredients: 1 lb fresh spinach, washed, drained and chopped | 4 ounces fresh kiwi fruits | 1 1/2 cups zucchini, finely sliced, but firm | 2 cups tomato juice | 1/2 cup beet juice | salt and pepper
instructions: Heat a medium saucepan over medium heat. Stir in spinach, kiwi, zucchini, tomato juice and beet juice. Season with salt and pepper and bring to a boil. Cover and cook 3 minutes longer.

Random Ingredients: curd cottage cheese,beef chuck,oriental sesame oil,water chestnut,ice,red potato,currant
title: Japanese Style Beef and Potato Casserole
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless beef chuck, cut into about 2-inch cubes | 3 tablespoons oriental sesame oil | 2 packages frozen cut red potatoes, thawed or 2 lbs fresh red potatoes, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 can water chestnuts, drained & chopped | 2 containers small curd cottage cheese | 1 jar watercress or 1 -2 tablespoon water | crushed ice ( optional )
instructions: Set oven to broil or 550 degrees fahrenheit. Line a rimmed baking sheet with foil. Toss beef in vegetable sesame oil until coated. Spread potatoes over the baking sheet. Broil or 550 degrees fahrenheit for about 10 minutes until browned. Spread beef on top of mixed potatoes. Place watercress or watercress on beef. Place cheese on top. Broil or 550 degrees fahreneheit for 8 minutes. Serve with crushed ice if desired.

title: Beef Patties
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 1 egg substitute | 1/3 cup pine nuts ( toasted and finely chopped ) | 2 tablespoons cointreau liqueur | 3 tablespoons orange rind, freshly grated
instructions: In a large bowl, combine ground beef, egg substitute, pine nuts, cointreau, and rind. Mix well. Form into six patties. Grill or broil until well browned.

title: Choy Bao
ingredients: 1 package white bread | 1 package chinese egg noodles | 1 cup chopped fresh italian parsley | 1 1/2 cups brewed tea
instructions: Cut bread slices in 1/2 inch slices.

title: Paneer Macaroni With Cashew and Cashew Nests
ingredients: 1 packet frozen small shell pasta ( like macaroni ) | 500 g chopped fresh cashews ( about 1 cup ) | 200 g fresh panir ( firm, cut into 3 cm cubes ) | 2 -3 tablespoons white balsamic vinegar
instructions: Cook the macaroni in salted boiling water until just tender, about 7 minutes. Meanwhile, bring a pan of water to the boil and cook the cashew nut paste, stirring occasionally until golden. Drain the macaroni and return it to the pan, add the cashew nuts and toss together. Add the balsamic vinigrette to the pasta and toss lightly until coated. Serve immediately.

title: Moroccan Mushroom and Potato Salad.
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh cremini mushroom | 1/2 lb fresh mani-style mushrooms | 4 cups potatoes, boiled, peeled and cut into bite-sized pieces | 3 tablespoons papayas seasoning salt | 1/3 cup chopped hazelnuts ( salted ) | 1/3 cup chopped pimiento | 2 meyer lemons, juice of, squeezed
instructions: Heat hazelnuts. In a deep, non stick skillet, heat hazelnuts. Saute mushrooms and manila mushrooms until just tender. Place over medium heat in blender container. Add papaya seasoning salt and chopped, salted, pimento and lemon juice. Blend into a smooth paste. Add lemon juice and blend again, just until no lumps are left. Place in serving dish and serve. Add salt if desired, and garnish with nuts and whipped cream if desired.

Random Ingredients: fenugreek,chicken stock,cardamom,matzo meal,lettuce leaf,white bean,fish ball,potato starch
title: Indian Tacos
ingredients: 1 can white beans, drained and rinsed | 1/4 cup potato starch | 1 teaspoon cardamom | 1/2 teaspoon ground fenugreek | 12 lettuce leaves | 10 medium fresh hot fish balls | 1 cup chicken stock | powdered coconut
instructions: Place potatoes in a bowl and add enough water to cover them. Let stand for a few minutes to soften slightly, then drain and set aside. In a saucepan, combine beans, potato starch and cardamom and let stir. Place a lettuce leaf on a plate, shiny side down, then top with the bean mixture. Top with the hot fish balls and sprinkle with a few daddiso leaves, if using. Pour over the chicken stock and sprinkle with coconut.

title: Grilled Massaman - Vietnamese Sandwich With Mango Liqueur
ingredients: 1 cocktail mango ( small ) | 4 hamburger bags ( vietnamese is best ) | 1/2 ounce premium vodka
instructions: Wash your giant bag of dry hamburger in the sink to get rid of the sand. Remove the top of the bag of dry hamburger. Using your hands, tear your hamburger into small pieces and place in a container with one of the cocktail mango's. Add the vodka. Close your bag of dry hamburger into place, close the bag and move it around so the dry hamburger gets inside the other bag. Place the plastic bag in the refrigerator for about 1 hour to set. Take your bag of dry hamburger from the refrigerator, open it up and lay it in the sandwich to form the meat and veggie mix. Place on another plate, close the sandwich. Slice the sandwich, serve the drink hot on a chilled plate with the meat wrapped in a lettuce leaf and drizzle with the mango liqueur.

Random Ingredients: lime zest,salt water,rye bread,coconut extract,bamboo shoot,chocolate syrup
title: Brazilian Bread and Butter Pops
ingredients: 1 loaf rye bread | 1 can unsweetened bamboo shoots, drained | 3 tablespoons chocolate syrup | 1 teaspoon coconut extract | 1/2 teaspoon lime zest | salt
instructions: Preheat a broiler. Slice the loaf lengthwise into 2 equal slices. Place in a medium mixing bowl. Sprinkle each slice with a pinch of salt. Place bamboo in a microwave safe bowl on the baking sheet and heat on high for 4 minutes or until hot. Remove bamboo shoots from bowl, shaking off any excess. Spread 1 teaspoon of chocolate syrup on each slice of bread. Sprinkle evenly with coconut extract and lime zest. Place the slices on the broiler pan. If desired, drizzle with chocolate syrup. Broil in the preheated oven for 4 to 5 minutes, or until golden brown. Serve warm.

title: Cheese Puffs
ingredients: 3 ounces prosciutto, chopped into squares and sliced thinly | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/2 teaspoon parsley, chopped | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | hot water
instructions: Melt 1 tablespoon light olive oil in a nonstick pan. Place the prosciutto into the pan and cook on one side til it starts to colour. Flip and cook the other side. Add the cumin powder, parsley & flour and a little of the hot water to make a thick paste. Stir to mix then pour over the meat. Leave a small gap of space to allow steam to escape. Cook on medium heat for about 5 8mins until the mixture is bubbly & crispy on the top.

title: Pineapple Bacon Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 large pineapple, peeled & cubed | 1 can pineapple tidbits, drained | 12 slices bacon, chopped | 1/4 cup single cream | 1/4 cup catsup
instructions: In a large skillet, combine bacon, pineapple, and pineapple tidbits. Bring to boiling, then simmer for 10 to 15 minutes until heated through. Remove from heat & stir in cream & catsup. When ready, pour sauce over pineapple. Serve immediately.

title: Carnation Fish Packets
ingredients: 2 lbs bottlegourd, skinned fillet, boned | 1/2 cup coconut, shredded | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper | 8 -12 corn chips ( corn chips are best )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375f degrees. Cut fish fillets fillets into slices 1/4 thick. Sprinkle each with coconut and pepper. Divide fish between 8 - 10 sheets of parchment paper. Place 5 corn chips in the middle of each mound. Fold one end of parchment over, then the other. Seal the edges with a fork or toothpick. Put on a parchment lined baking sheet. Bake in oven for 12 - 18 minutes.

title: The Best Dressing - Ever!
ingredients: 4 cups vegetable juice | 5 cups greek yogurt | 3 teaspoons prepared horseradish | 1 green chili, minced
instructions: Place yogurt into a large container, and stir in horseradish throughly. You will want only about a half cup. Stir in minced green chili. Taste and adjust for desired sweetness. Keeps in a covered container for several days, shaking it a few times. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: sea salt,italian seasoning,soymilk,baby carrot,mozzarella cheese,orange section,ice water,white bean
title: Italian Veggie Mix
ingredients: 6 baby carrots, halved | 1 cup cold pressed white beans ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons sea salt | 6 cups ice water | 1 cup frozen chopped orange section, thawed | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning | 1/2 cup natural low-fat soymilk | 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese, shredded
instructions: Place carrots and white beans into a plastic bag, close the bag, and shake until everything is evenly coated. Place frozen oranges in a medium saucepan.

title: Spiced Spanish Peanuts - Low Fat!!
ingredients: 1 can fat-free refried beans ( fat-free ) | 1/2 cup broken iceberg lettuce | spanish peanuts, toasted
instructions: Drain beans and rinse thoroughly. Lay out lettuce on a large plate and layer bean sprouts on top of lettuce. Sprinkle with peanuts. You can store in refrigerator up to 24 hours.

title: Baked Stuffed Peppers
ingredients: 4 large yellow sweet peppers or 4 large orange sweet peppers | 1/2 cup of freshly squeezed citrus juice | 4 slices thick french bread | fresh fruit peel, strips ( optional ) | cinnamon, and | cardamom, to taste ( optional ) | ground cardamom, to taste ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. Cut off tops of the peppers, and remove pith from inside pepper. Place peppers in baking dish, pour the hot citrus juice into the peppers, and then top with bread slices, sprinkling some cinnamon and a little good cardamom over the bread. Bake in oven for 30 minutes or until bread is crisp. Serve with a side salad. Note, it's pretty good served with whipped, unsweetened yoghurt.

title: Beet Salad With Asparagus
ingredients: 1 bunch asparagus | 3 medium beets | 1 head boston lettuce | 2 tablespoons chopped olive | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon seasoned salt | 1/2 teaspoon season salt | 1/4 teaspoon pepper | 1 teaspoon fish sauce | 1 cup sparkling water
instructions: Clean and rinse the asparagus and beet, removing the beet and asparagus from their skins. Thinly slice and place in a colander over some ice cubes. This will help rid them from dirt and bitter taste. Rinse and pat dry. Cut the beets into 4 sections. In a large bowl, combine the asparagus, beet slices, chopped olives, seasoned salt, seasoned salt, pepper, fish sauce and sparkling water. Toss to combine. Place 2 plates of lettuce on a work surface. Arrange the beet salad on the lettuce. Place 2 more plates on top. Serve immediately or cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for an hour or so.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,yellow onion,celeriac,leek,limeade concentrate,plain nonfat yogurt,oregano,horseradish
title: Celeriac-Raita Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil ( or other fat-free cooking oil ) | 2 cups chopped celeriac | 4 cups sliced yellow onions or 4 cups sweet onions | 1 leek ( white and light green parts only, chopped, or both of the three ) or 1 green onion, sliced ( white and light green parts only, chopped, or both of the three ) | 8 ounces frozen limeade concentrate, thawed and undiluted ( not concentrated ) | 3/4 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 3 tablespoons prepared horseradish or 3 tablespoons prepared horseradish sauce | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh oregano
instructions: To make dressing, in a blender puree the concentrate with yogurt and horseradish. Whisk in a little of the reserved yogurt or lemon juice. Season with oregano. Add more to taste. Toss all with olive oil. Serve, allowing diners 1/2 cup per salad.

title: Moroccan Beef Kebab
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef top sirloin steak | 2 tablespoons almond meal or 2 tablespoons cake flour | 3 teaspoons coriander seeds | 1 teaspoon cayenne ( or red chili powder ( sub a pinch of cayenne ) | 2 teaspoons orange rind, freshly grated | 1 bunch fresh coriander, leaves picked up and coarsely chopped ( use flat leaf )
instructions: Cut the beef lengthwise into 1 inch pieces, then crosswise into 1 inch cubes. Combine the flour, coriander seeds, and cayenne.

Random Ingredients: olive,lemon,broth,pea,butter bean,red bell pepper,self rising flour,fruit
title: Pea and Lemon Bean Bake - Vegetarian
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups vegetables or 2 1/2 cups beans, cut into small pieces | 1 1/3 cups vegetable cooking oil or 1 1/3 cups broth | 1 1/3 cups white rice and butter bean cooking rice mix or 1 1/3 cups cooked brown rice | 1 bag frozen peas | 1 orange/4 cup mixed dried fruit, chopped | 2 small red bell pepper, quartered lenghtwise and chopped | grated lemon rind | 2 tablespoons butter, melted
instructions: Preheat oven to heat oil or broth to boiling, then add rice. Boil gently about 5 minutes or until all water is absorbed and rice is cooked, stirring occasionally, cool slightly. Meanwhile, boil peas and fruit. Drain and rinse vegetables well under hot water and drain again. Put veggies and reserved cooking liquid in food processor or blender and process until just about smooth. Put about 1/2 cup or so in large bowl and then add in rice and stir together. Spoon rice mixture into casserole dish, top with peas and fruit mixture. Dot with butter and bake for 20 - 25 minutes, or until golden.

title: Macadamia Nuts
ingredients: 6 tablespoons macadamia nuts | 3 packages dried red chili peppers, broken into thin strips
instructions: In a skillet over medium heat, saute chilies in 1 tablespoon of water for 2 to 3 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Brazilian Style Steamed Asparagus
ingredients: 1 lb asparagus | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1/2 teaspoon coconut extract
instructions: Steam asparagus until tender crisp, about 3 minutes depending on size. Drain on paper towles and set aside. Combine cocoa, chile powder, and coconut extract together in a small bowl. Spread cocoa mixture over asparagus and serve.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,orzo pasta,italian herb,self raising flour
title: Orzo Pasta
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups orzo pasta | 4 1/2 - 5 cups self raising flour | 1 vanilla beans, split or 1 tablespoon dried italian herbs | 1 tablespoon dried italian herbs
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to the boil. Add one tablespoon orzo to the boiling water and cook for about 10 minutes or until done. Drain and cool.. Place flour, dried herbs and vanilla seeds in a food processor and process until you have a coarse paste. Add the orzo, a little at a time, and process until your desired consistency is achieved. If the paste is too dry, add 1/2 cup or more of water. The mixture should be slightly sticky, but not wet. If it is too dry, add more flour. You may have to add a little more flour. Divide the dough into four portions, roll out into balls and then flatten very slightly. You can use a knife or a fork. Place on an ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 350 degrees for 25 - 40 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Pizza Cheesecake With Mozzarella
ingredients: 1 cup mozzarella cheese | 2 tablespoons finely shredded orange peel
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375f degrees. Combine the mozzarella and the orange peel and pat it into the bottom and sides of a 9 inch square cake pan. Sprinkle the dough over the mozzarella and bake for 20 minutes. Serve hot or cold.

title: Spicy Bluefish
ingredients: 1 lb bluefish, cleaned | 1/4 cup frozen water chestnuts, thawed | 2 tablespoons irish cream ( i used light ) | 1/4 teaspoon green food coloring
instructions: Remove bones and skin from fish. Place fish in a greased baking pan. Broil 3 - 4 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork. Place fish back into pan and heat through. Add water chestnuts and irish cream. Heat thoroughly.

title: Balsamic Glaze
ingredients: 1/3 cup balsamic vinegar | 1/3 cup chili powder | 1/3 cup chopped chives | 1 tablespoon chopped anise ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons chopped ham
instructions: Stir together the vinegar, chili powder, chives, anise and ham. Brush on cooled ham slices.

title: Broccoli Shrimp Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 1 large baking potato, peeled and cut into 2-inch pieces | 1/2 cup chopped broccoli floret | 1/2 cup chopped jumbo shrimp ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon dry mustard oil | 1/3 cup chopped onion | marshmallows, to garnish ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees. In a medium size mixing bowl combine the potato, broccoli, shrimp, mustard, oil and onion.

Random Ingredients: chive,corn kernel,duck,serrano chilies,tamarind juice,anise seed,tomato paste,barley
title: Duck Rice (Zwt2)
ingredients: 1 kg duck, cubed | 4 teaspoons tomato paste | 1 tablespoon tamarind juice | 1 tablespoon chives, chopped | 1 serrano chilies, seeded and chopped | 2 cups barley, uncooked | 2 corn kernels, sliced into rounds
instructions: In a large sauce pan brown duck in anise oil. Return to pan and add the tomato paste, tamarind syrup and chives. Bring this up to a boil, reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 30 - 40 min, stirring occasionally. Add the chilie and barley. Stir, cover and cook for another 30 - 45 min or until barley is cooked through. Place a circle of tin foil over the meat, pack some rice in, seal the edges and continue cooking. The rice should be moist but the liquid will not reach the top or bottom of the dish. After about 30 minutes remove foil and bake for 20 - 30 mins more or until the meat is thoroughly cooked. Serve with sour cream.

Random Ingredients: currant,jumbo shrimp,cooking sherry,clam juice,rice noodle,grenadine,garlic clove
title: Jamaican Shrimp and Clam Jambalaya
ingredients: 4 garlic cloves, sliced thin, about 2 per shrimp | 1/3 cup cooking sherry | 1/3 cup bottled clam juice | 1 1/4 cups bottled clam juice | 2 tablespoons grenadine | 1/2 cup currants | 8 ounces rice noodles, cooked and drained
instructions: In a blender, combine garlic, cooking sherry, clam juice, clam juice and grenadine. Blend until smooth. Add currants. Pour sauce over clam shrimp. Marinate at least 1 hour and up to overnight. Cook rice noodles according to package directions in a steamer over boiling water. Drain. Garnish with chives and serve with noodles.

Random Ingredients: marjoram,chili garlic sauce,heavy cream,mint leaf,nut,celery,beef meat
title: Spicy Spiced Beef and Fresh Mint Cabbage
ingredients: 500 500 g beef stew meat | 1 stalk celery, with the leaves ( leaves only ) | fresh mint leaves | chopped fresh marjoram | salt and pepper | 3 tablespoons fresh heavy cream | 1 tablespoon chili-garlic sauce ( a taste of asian chilli is a must to find, but if you use the chilli sauce which i had previously posted, you may want to use some more )
instructions: Put the beef and celery into a saucepan over a high heat and brown the meat a little at a time all over. Remove the meat with a slotted spoon or slotted spoon onto a plate. Leave to cook, uncovered, while you stir fry the mint leaves and the marjoram and a pinch of salt and pepper until the leaves are beginning to wilt. Return meat to the saucepan, cover and leave until the beef and celery have cooked through, about 10 to 15 minutes. Add the cream, chilli sauce, and the mint. Serve.

Random Ingredients: shallot,basmati rice,chicken bouillon cube,catsup,beef tenderloin,spaghetti sauce mix,champagne vinegar
title: French Quarter Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 package beef tenderloin | 2 tablespoons catsup | 1 1/2 tablespoons champagne vinegar | 1 jar spaghetti sauce mix ( spaghetti flavor ) | 1 chicken bouillon cube, dissolved in | 1 pint chicken stock or 1 pint beef broth, if liquid is not enough | 2 shallots, peeled and sliced thin
instructions: Combine all ingredients and marinate overnight. Cut meat into strips or strips as desired. Place in a 9x13 baking dish. Bake in hot oven 30 minutes, then reduce heat to 350. Bake for another 15 minutes before removing from oven. Turn off oven and allow to cool. Do not remove meat from marinade. Place meat on platter and top with sauce.

title: Homemade Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 2 -3 large ripe tomatoes | 1 cube chicken bouillon | 2 tablespoons orange rind, grated
instructions: Finely dice tomato in chopper or food processor. Measure out 2 tbs. Of rind from the grated orange. Place tomato in processor bowl. Crush the other 2 tbs. Orange. Add to processor bowl. Blend until smooth. I like to stir every few seconds or so, then do as many turns as desired while blending. I also like to add a little bit of orange flavoring like paprika to the paste. Place tomato mixture in a pan with a lid and bring to boil. Then lower heat to med low. Cook for approximately 35 - 40 min. Check, adding salt if necessary. It should be a thick consistency. It will thicken up if cooled a bit. Remove from heat and enjoy. This recipe makes about 8 cups.

title: Chinese Sichuan Peppercorns, China Style
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs pork shoulder ( butt or leg ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons szechuan peppercorns ( see note )
instructions: The peppercorns should be thoroughly washed and soaked overnight, then added to hot wok or large skillet. Stir fry them briefly, or lightly grind them with a mortar and pestle. Note, if you are grinding the pork shoulder rather than grinding it before doing so, do not add any salt, as the sichuan peppercorns will be bitter and unpleasant. Otherwise, if you use pork shoulder with some of the peppercorns, you might have some coarsely ground peppercorns, but don't grind it all. When the pork shoulder has been added to the hot wok, stir fry it briefly, if necessary, so that it cooks all the same way. Note, if you use whole peppercorns, it should probably take about 20 minutes total cooking time than whole peppercorns.

title: Pine Nut Pudding
ingredients: 1/2 pound pine nuts, chopped | 1/8 teaspoon asafoetida powder
instructions: Put pine nuts in a bowl, and pour boiling water over. Mix well, and let stand for 10 minutes. Remove pine nuts to a serving dish. Discard water. Stir fry asafoetida in the same skillet until it turns brown.

title: Swiss Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1/2 lb hamburger | 1/4 cup margarine | 1/4 cup of grated chocolate | 1 container low fat yogurt
instructions: Dice hamburger until hamburger is crumbly. Saute until golden brown. Cool. Put margarine, grated chocolate and bread on crockpot. Add hamburger. Stir. Slowly stir in yogurt until smooth. Pour into crockpot. Cook 10 to 15 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Serve with vegetables or fruit and bread for dipping.

Random Ingredients: seasoning salt,chunky salsa,thyme sprig,yellow pepper,turnip,chinese rice wine,salt,walnut
title: Sweet-Chunky Spanish Veggies
ingredients: 12 -14 large turnips ( peeled or large red sweet peppers ) | salt ( for rubbing ) | 1/2 cup chunky salsa ( homemade, your preference. ) | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 medium yellow sweet pepper | 1 medium sweet red peppers or 1 medium yellow sweet pepper, seeded and cut lengthwise in 8 wedges ( or 2 cans mixed sweet peppers ) | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprig ( or 2 tsp.diced fresh minced thyme or 1 tsp.diced fresh dill weed, may be substituted ) | 3 tablespoons walnuts, chopped
instructions: Quarter the sweet peppers lengthwise. Sprinkle each cut side with salt. Place the cut side down on paper towels and towel dry for 30 minutes. Combine the salsa, seasoning salt, chopped red or yellow hot peppers, sweet peppers, and thyme. Place the walnuts on a cookie sheet under the broiler to toast and keep them crispy and golden. Remove from broiler and spread out so the nuts can cool. Serve the vegetables, drizzled with the salsa, over toast or fried bread.
