title: Italian Peanut Butter Pizza-Pizza Bianco
ingredients: 2 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1/4 cup sherry wine | 2 tablespoons peanut butter | 2 cans italian-style stewed tomatoes, drained and coarsely chopped
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 2 ounces of hot water in small bowl. In mixing bowl, combine sherry and peanut butter. Add tomatoes and stir with a spoon until evenly mixed. Spoon mixture into a 10 x 14 inch baking pan. Cover the pan with a towel and place in a warm spot to rise until doubled in bulk, about 1 hour. Bake at 400 degrees f for 10 minutes. Reduce temperature to 400 degrees f, and bake for 25 minutes longer, or until a deep golden brown crust is formed.

Random Ingredients: red enchilada sauce,pineapple chunk,season salt,cod,spaghetti,chicken base,yellow squash,lettuce leaf
title: Mexican Skillet Dinner
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chicken base | 1 tablespoon yellow squash, chopped | 1 1/2 lbs cod, cut into large bite size pieces ( boneless, skinless ) | 1 can pineapple chunks, undrained | 1 1/2 cups cooked spaghetti | 1 can red enchilada sauce | 3 cups lettuce leaves | 1/2 teaspoon season-all salt
instructions: Heat skillet on burner over medium heat. Add chicken base and squash until chicken is fully cooked, stirring to separate chicken. Add onion mixture.

title: Tuscan Quinoa Spinach and Beans
ingredients: 1 package frozen puff pastry, thawed ( about 2 packages ) | 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 small onion, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground quinoa | 1/4 teaspoon ground vanilla extract | 1 teaspoon dried mint
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Place thawed pastry in a 9x13 inch baking dish coated with cooking spray. Unroll frozen puff pastry, place in a 9x13 inch pan, and pat pastry into a rectangle about 1/8 inch thick. Spread kidney beans over pastry.

Random Ingredients: beef broth,arborio rice,chicken breast meat,jalapeno pepper,beet,papaya
title: Pepperjack Risotto for Two
ingredients: 4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts, boiled until almost cooked through | 8 ounces canned beef broth | 1 cup arborio rice | 1/4 cup diced canned beets | 1/4 bunch fresh, chopped jalapeno peppers, or to taste | 2 papayas, peeled and seeded, or to taste
instructions: Place the chicken breasts into a saucepan in the single layer, and fill with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer until no longer pink in the center, 15 to 20 minutes. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees f. Transfer the chicken to a bowl, and refrigerate until cool enough to handle. Shred the cooled chicken and dice it. Bring the beef broth to a boil in a medium skillet over medium high heat. Stir in the rice. Place a wok over medium heat, and swirl to coat with oil. When the wok is hot, pour in about 1/4 cup of the hot broth.

Random Ingredients: pineapple,puff pastry,asafoetida powder,chicken broth,whipping cream,salt pepper,range chicken,corn oil
title: Chicken-Pineapple Fusion Pasties
ingredients: 12 sheets frozen puff pastry, thawed in refrigerator | 4 tablespoons corn oil, divided | 1 free range chicken | 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 carton low-fat whipping cream | 1 cup canned reduced-sodium chicken stock or 1 cup canned low sodium chicken broth | 3/4 cup finely diced pineapple | salt & pepper
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Spray a sheet of parchment paper on a nonstick baking sheet. Roll out each pastry sheet to a 6 inch square. Cut each pastry square into two 3 inch squares. Using a 3 to 4 inch round cookie cutter, cut each square into 12 wedges. Repeat with remaining pastry squares and triangles. Set wedges aside. Spray 4 pieces of parchment paper on a nonstick baking sheet. Line the rounds with each square making sure you don't cut in the pastry too thin or it will not stick together when baking. Using a small, sharp knife, make four cuts in each pastry wedge. Rmove the rim of each wedge and place them on the parchment. Repeat with all 12 pieces. Set aside. Cut out the heart of the chicken. Cutting through the thick muscle sac in the thickest part of the thigh bone. The breast bone will partially freeze. Place the chicken, thickest part of the thigh bone, asafoetida and one carton of whipping cream in a nonstick 8 inch skillet. Bring to a simmer over medium high heat and then cook, stirring and pressing the chicken with a spatula to break it, breaking apart any chunks of meat with a fork, until it is no longer pink and the juices run clear, about 5 minutes. Add the broth and cooked chicken. Remove from the heat. Stir in the pineapple. Spoon about 1/3 of chicken mixture onto each pastry wedge. Season with salt and pepper. Bake in preheated oven until golden brown, 15 to 20 minutes, basting once or twice with pan juices.

title: Baba Au Beurre (Red Pepper Basting)
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons active dry yeast | 2 1/4 teaspoons red pepper flakes
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in a 1/4 cup warm water. Sprinkle the red pepper flakes onto the top of the dissolved yeast and stir. Place in a warm place and let rise for 20 minutes. Punch down in a large, lightly flour, or a lidded bowl and form a rough ball. Place in a floured or oiled bowl, cover and leave in a warm place for 2 to 2 1/2 hours until doubled in bulk. Use 2 teaspoons to form patties. Cook on your favourite bread or toast.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,ginger paste,baking soda,hot pepper sauce,bagel,black tea,tofu
title: Spicy Tofu and Bagels
ingredients: 1 package firm tofu, drained | 1/4 cup hot pepper sauce | 2 teaspoons ginger paste | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom seed | 2 teaspoons baking soda | 3/4 teaspoon ground black tea | hot pepper sauce to taste | 4 bagels
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Blend tofu, hot sauce, ginger paste, cardamom powder, baking soda, black tea, and hot pepper sauce in a blender or food processor until smooth.

title: Creamy Orange Dip or Chicken
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 clove garlic, finely minced | 1 teaspoon orange zest, minced
instructions: Stir soup, garlic, and zest together in a bowl. Spoon into a glass serving bowl.

title: Acapulco Green Chili and Watermelon Bread
ingredients: 500 ml bread flour ( or 1 kg ) | 1 stalk green chilies | 200 ml watermelon
instructions: Cut two slices out of each other then tear out the string and dice into 1cm pieces. Cut the remaining 2 slices into small cubes. Lightly crush the chile skin and stir through the chile flesh into the flour until the mixture forms a workable dough. Stir in the watermelon and set aside for 10 - 15 minutes then knead into a soft dough using enough dough to make a rollable dough. Roll out into a rectangle about 200cm/about 15cm/8 inches thick and stamp or cut out as many as you can using a large heart/bread machine. Repeat to make more rolls. Set aside for about 30 minutes so that the bread can prove during the oven. Preheat the oven to 200c/gas put a metal tray about 6cm/2 inch tall on your oven's lid. Place half a dough circle onto the tin's base. Press the dough through the holes you've made in the dough with your fingers, making sure it's well sealed and doesn't come all the way up on the tray's handle. This could actually happen in the oven but the chile mix will eventually come to the top of the bread. Bake 15 minutes, or until the bread starts to golden. Once done, remove the tray from oven and let it stand for five minutes. Cut into 8 equal portions. Warm the beans at the table. Serve alongside the bread.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,cremini mushroom,american cheese,arugula,rice wine,rye bread,chicken broth
title: The Perfect Cheesy Sandwich
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sour cream or 2 tablespoons greek yogurt | 1 lb thinly sliced cremini mushroom or 1 lb shiitake mushroom, stems trimmed | 1/2 - 1 cup low sodium chicken broth | 1 tablespoon rice wine or 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 2 slices rye bread, lightly toasted | 2 slices american cheese | 4 cups arugula, cut in half
instructions: Lightly brush the sliced mushrooms with olive oil and toast the rye cheese. Heat the chicken broth in a small sauce pan over medium heat and add the rice wine vinegar. Bring this mixture to a boil and reduce the heat to simmer. Add the sliced mushrooms and simmer until the liquid is reduced by about half, about 5 minutes. Remove the mixture from the heat and stir to combine, about 1 minute. Divide the mushroom mixture among four toasted slices of toast. Slice the american cheese into small thick slices and place in a separate dish on top of the mushrooms and cheese. Heat the broiler to high. Place the cheesy toasted bread sandwiches on a baking sheet and broil until it golden brown on both sides, 3 - 5 minutes per side. Move to a large platter and serve immediately.

title: Bacon and Olive Tapenade
ingredients: 12 ounces canadian bacon, sliced into 1/2 thick rounds | 1/2 cup green olives, pitted and sliced | 1/2 cup pitted prunes, pitted and sliced | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves | 5 tablespoons canadian bacon fat ( for tapenade )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Place 3 slices of bacon, one slice of green olives and 1/2 the prunes in a small, cast iron skillet. Cook over moderate heat until bacon is browned and most of the liquid in the skillet has evaporated, turning once, but not breaking up the pieces of bacon. Drain bacon and olives on paper towels. Transfer bacon and olives to a shallow bowl. Add 1/4 teaspoon of ground cloves and stir together the remaining prunes, remaining 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves and 1/2 cup of canadian bacon fat. Spoon over the tapenade and sprinkle with the remaining 1/2 teaspoon of ground cloves. Bake 30 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: white balsamic vinegar,white chocolate,baking soda,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: White Chocolate Balsamic Peppered White Balsamic Vinegar Cookies
ingredients: 2/3 cup white balsamic vinegar | 1/2 cup vegetable oil ( i use cooking spray ) | 1 3/4 cups white balsamic vinegar ( white balsamic vinegar ) | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1/2 cup white chocolate, melted
instructions: If using white balsamic vinegar, use regular balsamic vinegar. For a darker colored vinegar, you need to reduce by half to 1 cup of vinegar. Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. In a large bowl, whisk together 2/3 cup white balsamic vinegar, vegetable oil, and 1/2 teaspoon baking soda. Add in 1 cup of white balsamic vinegar and stir until incorporated. Gradually whisk in the melted white chocolate. Drop tablespoon sized bits of the white vinegar into the melted white balsamic vinegar. Return coated cookies to a nonstick baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Sprinkle the remaining 1/3 cup white balsamic vinegar onto the tops for garnish. Bake for 7 to 8 minutes.

title: Acapulco-Style Sandwich Fritters
ingredients: 1 package oaxaca cheese, cut into chunks | 1/4 cup tuna packed in oil, drained | 1/4 cup white american cheese | 1/3 cup tapioca starch
instructions: Combine the oaxaca cheese chunks, tuna and white american cheese with a pinch of tapioca starch in a saucepan. Bring the mixture to a boil and remove from heat. Form fritters into patties and coat with tapioca starch. Refrigerate.

title: Thai Beef and Peanut Curry
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin, cut into very thin bite-size strips | 1/2 cup light corn syrup | 1/2 cup molasses | 1 tablespoon curry | 3 tablespoons cooked quinoa | 2 cans whole kernel corn
instructions: Combine the first 9 ingredients in a large resealable plastic bag.

title: Thai Green Salad
ingredients: 1 leek, halved and sliced | 2 cups chopped fresh or frozen topping, thawed | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh lemon rind | 3 tablespoons fish sauce | 5 cups loosely packed arugula or 5 cups torn of fresh spinach
instructions: Boil salted water for 2 minutes.

title: Yumurt Rice & Vegetables
ingredients: 2/3 cup brown basmati rice | 1 3/4 cups light-colored honey | 1 cucumber | 1/2 red bell pepper
instructions: Cook brown basmati rice in 2 cups water and set aside to cool completely. Meanwhile, peel the cucumber, and cut into cubes. De seed bell pepper and cut into 1/4 inch pieces. Remove rice from refrigerator and add to the bowl with the vegetables. Pour honey into a shallow 2 quart casserole. Put the rice mixture into the casserole and stir to combine. Cover and refrigerate for 4 hours or overnight, stirring rice a few times. If using overnight, stir it once during the cooking to make sure it is well mixed. Remove from fridge and stir well. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: coriander,pork loin roast,water,cumin seed,parchment paper,goat cheese
title: Goat Cheese Samosas
ingredients: 4 ounces goat cheese | 1/2 cup fresh coriander | 3 tablespoons ground cumin seeds | 1 1/2 lbs boneless pork loin roast, trimmed of fat | 12 fresh parchment paper, squares ( about 8 x 10 inches ) | 4 cups water, divided
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Place the goat cheese, coriander, cumin, and 1/2 cup water into each of the baking sheets. Bake for about 15 minutes, or until golden brown. Remove from the oven and cool slightly. Trim the pork of all visible fat and cut into 1 inch cubes. Set aside. Place the meat into a large, heavy bottomed roasting pan. Spread half of the goat cheese evenly on it. Spread the meat with the remaining goat cheese. Bake for about 30 minutes, or until tender. While the meat is baking, gather the remaining coriander and cumin ingredients in a mortar and pound with a pestle. The mixture should be crumbly and slightly lumpy. Drain the meat in a sieve over a bowl, reserving the grease and any liquid that remains. Put a piece of meat on each piece of meat. Wrap the meat around the cheese, pressing the paste under it. Wrap each samosa in a damp towel, and put a piece of paper on a rimmed cookie sheet that has been sprinkled with a few drops of water. Microwave on high for 3 to 4 minutes, or until warm and dry. Cut open the samosas and serve.

title: Easy French Onion Soup
ingredients: 3 cans cream of mushroom soup | 1 1/4 pounds large purple onion sauteed ( vidalia )
instructions: In a large dutch oven, combine the onion with soup.

title: Linguine With Corn and Pickles
ingredients: 8 ounces dried linguine | 3 ears fresh corn, cut from cobs ( about 12 ) | 3 dill pickles, cut in wedges | 1 -2 pinches tabasco sauce
instructions: Soak the corn in cold water. Drain and cut off cob kernels from cobs. Remove tough silk from pickle wedges and cut diagonally into 3 slices. Slice pickles into thin rings. Break apart corned corn and cut kernels from cob in 2 or 3 pieces. Cook linguine per box instructions. While the pasta is cooking, add pickles with all the water to a large skillet and saute' corn. Cook corn until desired consistency is accomplished, about 2 or 3 minutes. Toss with remaining ingredients and adjust salt, pepper, if needed. Serve over cooked linguine.

title: Broiler Onions
ingredients: 3 lbs shallots | 3 cups boiling water
instructions: Wash the shallots and slice into 1/8 thick slices, about 2/3 inch thick lengthwise. Lay out in a 13x9x2 inch baking dish. Sprinkle the shallots lightly with flour and pour on the boiling water. Bake the onions over high heat, uncovered, in a 400°f oven for 45 minutes, basting with the water, until they are tender.

title: Tamari-Tamari Slaw
ingredients: 1 lettuce, coarsely chopped ( can leave whole, rinse well ) | 4 teaspoons tamari, low sodium
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients together in a bowl. Toss well with any salad ingredients.

title: Fast N' Spicy Pasta
ingredients: 6 ounces uncooked farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 3/4 cup thick & chunky salsa | 2/3 cup shredded fresh pepperoni | 1 small onion ring, minced | 1/2 cup chunky salsa | 1 teaspoon salt and pepper
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling water until al dente. Drain and return to pot. Meanwhile, combine the 2/3 cup salsa, 1/2 cup pepperoni, onion, 1/2 the 1/2 the salsa, and salt and pepper. Add the cooked pasta and remaining salsa. Heat through thoroughly.

Random Ingredients: parsley flake,fish sauce,balsamic vinegar,tahini,baking chocolate,rom tomato,adobo sauce,caper
title: Tahini Tomato and Chips
ingredients: 1 cup finely shredded roma tomatoes | 1 tablespoon capers, rinsed and drained | 3/4 cup unsalted dry baking chocolate | 3/4 cup tahini | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar, plus | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley flakes | 2 -4 teaspoons chipotle hot sauce, < a href= '' https : //www.geniuskitchen.com/recipe/cilantro-adobo-sweet-spot-482872 '' > cilantro chipotle sweet spot < /a >
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. In a large bowl, combine the tomatoes, capers, and 1/4 cup of the chocolate and mix until well coated. Arrange the chips on a large baking sheet and bake 20 minutes, or until the edges are lightly browned, stirring occasionally. Remove the chips from the oven, transfer all the chips to a large bowl, and cover with aluminum foil. In a small bowl, combine the remaining 1/2 cup chocolate, tahini, vinegar, fish sauce, parsley flakes, and hot sauce. Pour this dressing over the chips, toss to coat evenly, and serve.

Random Ingredients: asafoetida powder,monterey jack cheese,marjoram,almond extract,rose water
title: Dees Red Rose Cheese
ingredients: 10 ounces monterey jack cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup almonds, coarsely ground | 2 teaspoons fresh marjoram, chopped | 1/2 cup rose water | 2 pinches asafoetida powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground marjoram
instructions: In medium bowl, mix together all ingredients. Spread onto ungreased jelly roll pan. Sprinkle with additional marjoram. Cover and refrigerate until cheese is firm, about 2 hours.

title: Homemade Roast Pork
ingredients: 5 lbs roast or 5 lbs pork, in 1 inch cubes | 1/2 cup fresh chicken or 1/2 cup duck fat
instructions: Place roast or meat in a large pot and cover with hot water to reach 1/2 inch from top of the meat. Place on burner on medium heat. Turn burner to warm, cover and simmer for 15 minutes per pound or 1 hour for frozen. Remove meat from the pan. Cut into cubes or slice meat and arrange on a platter. Cover with foil to keep warm. You can also leave the meat in the hot roaster. Add more hot water to the roaster for flavor. When the roast is done, drain the fat out if desired. Serve with boiled carrots, white or red potatoes, and gravy for dipping. A favorite with carrots and other vegetables.

title: Chocolate Colcannon #5, #6…
ingredients: 5 cups cabbage ( shredded ) | 4 teaspoons curry | 3 tablespoons chocolate frosting | 2 teaspoons red peppers ( minced ) | 2 ounces dry irish cream
instructions: Mix coconut frosting and curry together in medium bowl. Add shredded cabbage, red pepper, and chopped chive. Place bowl in refrigerator for 2 hrs.

title: Gruyère-Turnips (Gruyere Turnips)
ingredients: 1 lb small turnip, peeled and halved, leaving stem intact | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh herbs or 2 tablespoons fresh coriander ( cilantro ) | 1/2 cup grated gruyere ( may sub emmenthal, if preferred )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Fill a medium size bowl with water.

Random Ingredients: pattypan squash,icing sugar,onion salt,monterey jack cheese,thyme,currant,chinese sausage
title: Chinese Calzone (Sweet Potatoes)
ingredients: 2 cups pattypan squash, cut in half lengthwise and then into 1 1/2-inch slices ( about 1 1/2 pounds ) | 1/8 teaspoon onion salt | 1 teaspoon herby chinese sausage, crumbled ( or any other seasoning and filling combination to taste ) | 6 slices monterey jack cheese | 1 tablespoon icing sugar | 1/4 teaspoon thyme ( chopped ) | 1/4 cup currants
instructions: Spray a 12 in skillet or wok with cooking oil spray.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,parsley,cider vinegar,orange juice,shark fillet,pork rib,leek
title: Lobster Bisque
ingredients: 2 racks pork ribs | 3 large leeks | 3 lbs shucked lobster meat ( preferably in shell ) | 2 celery ribs ( with leaves ) | 2 teaspoons minced fresh parsley | 2/3 cup fresh orange juice | 1/3 cup cider vinegar | 1 orange, juice of
instructions: If you are planning to use a crock pot, wash the leeks and wash them under running water, until the skin chars. Cut away the hard green parts of the leeks, and wash them in cool water until the skin is loosened, then remove the hard ends, scrape off the burned and bitter root, and slice on the diagonal. Cut the leeks down the center into 1 inch slices and put them in a bowl of water, and let sit for at least 3 hours. Slice the lobster in half lengthwise and set aside. Cut the meat of your choice into 1 inch cubes and put it into the bowl of water, add salt to taste, and set aside. Preheat the osh grill or broiler. Arrange your ribs skin side down on cutting board, and press them gently against the cutting board to flatten them slightly. Grill the meat over the hot coals, until the flesh is medium rare, about 5 to 7 minutes, and set aside. Meanwhile, prepare and clean your lobster bones, and set aside. Chop your celery, parsley, and orange, and set aside in separate bowls. When the meat is ready, remove it from the hot grill or broiler and put it aside. In a clean bowl, combine the juice from the orange and vinegar, and pour it into the same bowl. Heat the juice mixture over medium heat until the vinegar boils and begins to thicken. Pour the hot juice mixture in the bowl into the bowl with the other citrus juices. Stir, scraping all the bits of juice into the pot, and then stir into the sauce mixture. The heat is very low, and this will thicken the liquid. Add the pork, lobster, and chopped leeks, and stir to mix. Add the parsley, and mix well. It is best to leave some of the sauce for up to one hour prior to serving, to allow flavors to develop. Serve with lots of good, crusty bread for dipping.

Random Ingredients: mint sprig,strawberry,natural peanut butter,farfalle pasta,asafoetida powder,clam,penne,sandwich bun
title: Spaghettini
ingredients: 2 tablespoons natural-style peanut butter | 1/8 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 2 jars sliced strawberries | 3 cloves clams, minced | 1 box penne | 12 sandwich buns, split | fresh mint sprig ( optional ) | 4 -6 mint sprigs ( optional )
instructions: Place peanut butter in a small bowl. Mix in and stir in asafetida. Set aside. Place strawberries on paper towels or towel. Set aside. Mince the garlic. Drain the rinsed and drained strawberries. Set aside. Cook the penne in boiling water until al dente. Drain, reserving 1/2 cup of the cooking liquid. Drain back into spaghetti pot. Cut the sandwich buns in half lengthwise. Place cut sides down on a baking sheet. Heat on range or in microwave until slightly crusty on the outside. Toast the bread halves until golden brown, 3 - 5 minutes. Remove to a plate. Cut the inside of the toasted bun halves in half. Set aside. Spoon half of the peanut sauce over the pasta. Spoon half of the strawberries over the sauce. Spoon the remaining peanut sauce over the strawberries. Garnish with mint sprigs, if desired. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,bread flour,salt pepper,apple juice,rhubarb,onion soup mix,brown rice
title: Baked Easy French Onion Rice With Apples
ingredients: 2 cups brown rice, cooked | 1/2 - 1 cup frozen rhubarb, thawed | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 envelope onion soup mix, dry | 1/2 teaspoon salt and pepper, to taste | 1 cup apple juice | 2 teaspoons bread flour or 2 teaspoons rice flour
instructions: Mix well the two soups together. Add rice and fruit and combine well. Line a baking dish with greased parchment paper or aluminum foil, sprayed with cooking oil. Spread rice mixture on foil. Add the corn or apple juice to the soups in a microwave safe bowl. Dip your fingers in the water when making sure the edges of the mixture are wet. Sprinkle on salt and pepper. Dip fingers again in the water and then in the rice to make sure the excess water is absorbed. Place the prepared pan in a larger pan or an oven proof skillet and add enough hot water to just below the top of the rice mixture. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour or until desired tenderness. Remove from oven, drizzle the rice with more cooking oil if needed. Serve with a salad or veggies.

title: Asparagus and Date  With  Herbs  (Cederina)
ingredients: 1 lb asparagus, trimmed | 1 teaspoon tea | 1 granny smith apple, quartered | 1 teaspoon dates, finely chopped
instructions: Steam the asparagus for 8 minutes, then plunge into ice water. The asparagus is cooked when it's just crisp tender. Drain and cool. Mix the herbs together and season to taste. Place on a platter and spoon over the herb.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,baking soda,clove,anise seed,floury potato,honey
title: Goulash (Peppery Hot Potatoes)
ingredients: 4 medium baking potatoes ( about 1 1/2 pounds total ) or 4 large idaho potatoes ( about 1 1/2 pounds total ) | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 10 small whole cloves | 3 tablespoons all purpose greek anise seeds ( whole pods, optional ) | 1 large yellow bell peppers or 1 large green bell pepper, cut into strips
instructions: Scrub the peeled potatoes well.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,leek,red onion,teriyaki sauce,garlic powder,red potato,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Potato Leek & Cheese Casserole
ingredients: 2 medium leeks, sliced | 2 medium red onions | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder ( or garlic powder equivalent ) | 2 chicken bouillon cubes | 400 g red potatoes or 400 g yukon gold potatoes, unpeeled | 1 small red onion, sliced and fried crispy | teriyaki sauce | shichimi togarashi ( toenjabi sauce )
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees c. Slightly butter one large, deep oven proof dish. Cut red and yellow onions into half then slice into half again lengthways. Wash and slice leeks, keeping separate. Dissolve the chicken bouillon in 1/2 c water and place in dish. Cut the unpeeled potatoes into chunks. Dissolve garlic powder and chicken bouillon into 1/2 c water. Dip potato chunks in mixture and place in dish. Layer with potato, onion and fried crispy onions. In separate fry off 3 - 5 dumplings, drop into the frying pan with a bit of teriyaki sauce, the dish will take about 10 - 15 minutes, depending on how thick you prefer your potato dish to be and how big the potato chunks are so you really don't have to stir them in the next 5 minutes of frying. Take a large spatula and gently pat the potato chunks down, and place them into the casserole dish. Bake in oven for around 45 minutes or until golden.

Random Ingredients: salami,mint,chili pepper flake,marinara sauce,plain yogurt,mango,beef tenderloin,flat rice noodle
title: Tartar Sauce for Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin | 2 teaspoons flat rice noodles | 2 tablespoons plain yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 1 cup thinly sliced cooked beef tenderloin | 2 tablespoons marinara sauce | 4 slices salami | 1 jar mangoes, drained and sliced | 4 dashes mint
instructions: Cook rice noodles according to package directions, drain. Cut tenderloins into 1/2 inch thick slices. Set aside. Place noodles in a large bowl, cover with boiling water. Allow noodles to soften slightly and about 1 minute. Drain, rinse with cold water, and drain again. In a small bowl, stir the yogurt, chili flakes, and beef until well blended. Dip the beef into the yogurt marinade to coat well. Set aside the marinara. Grill or broil beef for 3 - 5 minutes each side or to desired doneness, or to desired doneness. Arrange on a warmed platter. Cover with the mango slices and drizzle with the reserved marinara sauce. Sprinkle with mint to serve.

title: Easy Crumbed Phyllo  Rolls
ingredients: 2 packages refrigerated thawed phyllo dough | 1 tablespoon crushed cracker crumbs ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Unroll phyllo. Cut into 4 equal lengths. Wet a piece of wax paper and roll each strip into a long strip. Roll a strip in the cracker crumbs for color. Transfer roll to cutting board and cut into equal sized pieces. Cut each piece into 4 equal pieces to make 4 triangles. Working with 1 piece at a time, brush each end with melted margarine or with shortening. Place on a lightly oiled cookie sheet. Place in the freezer until frozen solid, about 20 minutes. Meanwhile, place 1/2 cup of boiling water on the ungreased cookie sheet. Place a pastry cube or other object on the cube. When it starts sizzling, remove the cube with a slotted spoon onto the cooking sheet. Repeat with the remaining phyllo strips and filling. Place 1/2 cup of cold water on your working space and use your fingers to press one direction on the pastry cube. Then, with the same spatula, spread the dough around the cube or cube creating a diamond shape approximately 12 inches across the cube. Repeat with all phyllo strips. Brush on with melted margarine or shortening if desired. Cut pieces when almost completely cold. Transfer to a freezer container or tray, cover and set aside for several hours, or overnight if convenient. Heat a large skillet over high heat, add enough olive oil to coat the bottom. Place 1 frozen phyllo in the skillet, and fry 5 seconds on each side, or until browned.

title: Tortellini Wrapped in Chilies
ingredients: 4 ounces of cheese tortellini | 4 dried anchovies | chili sauce | cornflour
instructions: Fry the tortellini in batches. Drain the anchovies and pat dry. Sprinkle the anchovies into the tortellini. Pour on the chili sauce. Sprinkle on the cornflour and mix. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,green chilies,rotel,coconut rum,feta cheese,onion soup mix,brussels sprout
title: Feta Chicken
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 1 can rotel | 1 can diced green chilies | 1 can coconut rum | 1 package brussels sprouts, trimmed and sliced | 1 package crumbled feta cheese
instructions: In a large pot over medium heat, combine the chicken breast, onion soup mix, rotel, green chilies, coconut rum, and brussels sprouts. Simmer until the chicken is cooked through, 25 to 30 minutes. Remove the chicken, reserving broth, and stir in the cheese. Heat until the cheese has melted, stirring constantly. Serve.

title: Chew Nuts
ingredients: 16 cashew halves | 1 tablespoon sage
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly grease a shallow baking dish with oil or butter. Spread the cashews evenly in the baking dish, breaking off any pieces that don't crack. Sprinkle with sage. Bake at 350 degrees f for 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: green lentil,lasagna noodle,lemon juice,asafoetida powder,savory,cornstarch,beef stew meat
title: Lentils in Lemony Brown Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat, such as sirloin, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1/2 cup green lentil | 1/2 cup cornstarch | 1 pinch asafoetida powder, for dusting | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice | 1 sprig savory | 12 uncooked lasagna noodles
instructions: Combine beef, lentils, cornstarch, asafoetida, lemon juice, and savory in a large bowl. Toss to combine. Cook lasagna noodles according to package directions. Drain on paper towels. title: Dinner and Cream Sauce
ingredients: 2 packages frozen dinner rolls, thawed | 1 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Cut each package of frozen rolls in half, creating 4 sections. Separate each section into 4 pieces. Roll each half into a ball. Place on a baking sheet, and chill for 2 hours. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. When the rolls are chilled, place in a bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Microwave for about 1 1/2 minutes, or until cold. Place the chilled dough ball in a bowl, and using your hands, coat completely. Roll the ball out to about 1/6 inch thickness. Place cream into a saucepan over medium heat, and bring to a boil.

title: Mixed Chocolate

instructions: Heat the oven to 300°f. Stir the olives, chocolate and cocoa together in a medium size bowl. Stir in the marshmallows and remove 1/2 cup of the mixture. Allow to cool and serve.

Random Ingredients: clam juice,heavy whipping cream,white rum,italian sausage link,lemon juice,pork butt,garlic powder
title: Clams and Sausage

instructions: Cover a baking sheet with plastic wrap and spray with cooking spray. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Place the sausage links in the pot and cook about 10 minutes. title: Spanish Sotranos

instructions: Wash the outside of an open flameproof casserole or baking dish that's about 2 inches deep. Cut each chile lengthwise into 1/2 inch pieces. Place the chiles, cut side up, in the baking dish. Pour both cans of tomato sauce into the dish. Smooth out the top. Sprinkle the top with the marsala/white wine. Cover loosely with a heavy towel or a lid so that the sauce can steam while the chiles bake, stirring occasionally, for 1 hour, or until the sauce has thickened and is bubbling. Serve piping hot.

Random Ingredients: salad oil,fennel seed,anise seed,ghee,plain flour,vanilla extract,broccoli

title: Ginger Pizza

instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Cut thin slashes from bottom of crust all over with a sharp knife or razor blade. Place in a 9x13 inch baking dish, or smaller if desired, and cover with pastry. Beat egg white just until soft peaks form, then brush over pizza crust. Sprinkle ginger over egg white layer. Bake at 375 degrees f for 40 minutes, or until golden and bubbly. Meanwhile, cook spiral shaped pasta according to package directions or package directions.

title: Peperonata (Drunken Pepperonata)
ingredients: 3 cups peperonata ( greek pepperonata ) | 16 fluid ounces white wine vinegar | 16 fluid ounces beer ( your favourite type, e.g. schuhbullar or tecate )
instructions: Dissolve the wine vinegar and beer in a pot, stir and simmer for 1 to 2 minutes.

instructions: Cook ziti following package directions. Drain. Add ziti, ziti sauce with ziti, raisins and ziti baking powder to a deep 1 1/2 quart casserole dish or 2qt gratin pot. Cover and bake at 325 for about an hour.

title: Vodka-Rice Crusted Bell Peppers
ingredients: 32 ounces v8, chilled | 1 1/4 cups coarse grain white rice | 2 tablespoons cointreau liqueur | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed | 3 cinnamon sticks | 2 bell peppers, cut lengthwise in half crosswise | 6 cups frozen corn flakes, thawed
instructions: Drain vodka through cheesecloth and set aside. Combine rice, cointreau and cardamom in 13x9x2 inch glass baking dish. Add bell peppers, cover with plastic wrap, and microwave on high heat 1 to 1 1/2 minutes or until rice is crisp tender, stirring twice. Microwave uncovered until warm, about 1 minute. Random Ingredients: pine nut,adobo seasoning,poblano pepper,white rice,sea salt,paprika
title: Pepazza With Poblanos and Rice

title: Calico's Italian Tomato Spinach Pie
ingredients: pastry for double crust pie | 1 package frozen sugar snap peas | 2 cans tomato juice | 1 1/2 teaspoons sugar ( optional )
instructions: Cook and stir sugar snap peas and tomato juice until sugar is disolved, about 4 minutes. Place about 1/2 cup of the tomato mixture into pastry shell. Top with 1/3 each of the frozen peas and spinach mixture. Repeat procedure with the rest of the tomato mixture and peas and spinach mixture.

title: Port With Port
ingredients: salt | 1 1/2 cups port wine
instructions: Fill a saucepan with water and bring to a boil over high heat. When a small piece of fresh cheese float to the surface of the water, pour the water into a bowl and stir in a little salt to taste.

title: Beef and Zucchini on Feta Salad
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs stewing beef, cubed | 1 head romaine lettuce, torn into bite sized pieces | 2 zucchini, sliced | 1 package feta cheese | feta cheese, crumbled
instructions: Combine beef, veggies in crockpot. Top with feta cheese. Mix feta cheese into stewed beef, and put on top of veg. Cook on low on high 2 hours. Serve immediately or let rest 15 - 20 minutes to blend flavors.

Random Ingredients: cumin seed,salt pepper,mango,ancho chile powder,pinto bean,wheat flour,poppy seed
title: Guatemalan Pinto Bean and Mango Pizza
ingredients: 1 teaspoon whole cumin seed | 2 teaspoons ground ancho chile powder | 4 cups whole wheat flour, can use white if available | 2 cups pinto beans, soaked overnight in cold water, cooked, drained, and cooled | 2 tablespoons poppy seeds | 2 large ripe mangoes, seeded and quartered | salt and pepper
instructions: In a large skillet roast the cumin seeds and ancho chiles over medium heat, stirring often. When they give off a roasted aroma, remove from the heat and set aside. Allow the pizza to sit out in the refrigerator for at least 20 minutes. Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. Turn the oven on to broiler. Place the pizza on a large baking sheet and bake it for 5 - 6 minutes. Remove, and top with mango pieces, dividing them evenly among the eight pitas. Slice the tops off the mango and drizzle on pizza dough. Return to the oven for 5 more minutes, or until the pizza is golden brown.

instructions: Wash your rice and dry it well. Add 1 tbs of cheese to the rice. Spread some rice on two side of 1 tortilla. title: Southern Style Tilapia (Clams or Fish)
ingredients: 18 ladyfingers | 1 cucumber - peeled, seeded, and chopped | 3 parsley sprigs, chopped | 7 peppercorns | 6 tilapia fillets | 1 onion, finely sliced
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f in a bowl stir together the ladyfingers, cucumber, parsley sprigs, peppercorns, and sliced onion. Arrange on a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until warmed through, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: hot chili sauce,serrano chilies,jalapeno,cornmeal,lager beer,green olive
title: Brunezas ( Drunken Hard Sauce)
ingredients: 3 -6 serrano chilies ( optional ) | 2 cups raw cornmeal | 3 cups lager beer ( like beer, but we like to use beer so i take a big spoon and a pint ) | 7 cans sliced green olives | 1 1/2 cups hot chili sauce ( more or less depending on heat preference ) | 2 cups jalapenos, chopped ( optional )
instructions: First, soak jalapenos in water with enough beer to cover for at least one hour. Chop into strips and then rinse the peppers. Heat the oil and fry the serranos over medium heat, until the are a bit crispy and soft. If your chilis are large, cut them into strips and fry. Add the cornmeal to the bowl. Add the beer and mix the cornmeal all at once. Do not work the mixture. The cornmeal will form small lumps. I add the water to the mixture the last time you add the beer and beer. If you need to add more beer/beer, add more. Do not make the mixture too stiff. Serve immediately or store in refrigerator in refrigerator for longer if desired.

title: Homemade Vietnamese Chips

instructions: Slice lettuce leaves into thin slices. Mix iceberg lettuce, dressing and curry powder if using, and then put a slice or two on top of each piece of cheese. Cover tightly and refrigerate. To serve, unwrap and eat.

Random Ingredients: farmer cheese,apple cider,serrano chilies,garam masala,rosemary,tomato paste,kalamata olive
title: Farmer Cheese With Kale (Aka Farmer Cheese)

instructions: Mix all ingredients well and let sit for 1 hour uncovered. Skewer cheese onto a 12 inch bamboo steamer that has been lined with tin foil. Bring to a boil, cover and reduce heat to low. Random Ingredients: chili paste,maple syrup,plum tomato,pita bread,lemon juice zest,raisin
title: Saheen, plums and raisins (Serveers)

instructions: Thread plums onto small skewers about 3 inches long and 1 inch wide and 1 inch deep. Grill the plums over direct medium heat until beginning to blacken and pluck. Meanwhile combine remaining ingredients except pitas in bowl and stir well to blend. Serve plums with glaze on plums.

Random Ingredients: grape,taco seasoning mix,onion powder,taco sauce,mango,lemon lime beverage,beef chuck
title: Barbecue Machaca

instructions: Place beef in a large, heavy roasting pan. Combine remaining ingredients except lemon lime beverage.

title: Saurkraut Patties (Dumplings)
ingredients: 2 containers nopales, drained | 1/2 cup yogurt ( i use low fat ) | 2 tablespoons beef bouillon granules | 1 tablespoon sugar cube ( i use mccormick ) | 1 lb ground meat ( i use ground deer ) | 1 lb pizza dough | 1/2 - 1 cup sauerkraut ( drained )
instructions: Cook meat until no longer pink. Drain any excess fat. Add yoghurt, boullion, and sugar. Simmer 3 - 4 minutes, until warm. Roll meat mixture into 12 balls. title: Beetroot Dip

instructions: Peel, dice, and put peels and meat into food processor. Pulse to gether. Add remaining ingredients. Process until smooth and creamy.

instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. Drain, rinse with running water, and drain again.

instructions: In a small bowl combine the first seven ingredients and blend until well blended. Transfer to a glass jar, cover and chill for two hours.

title: Wasabi Apple Milkshake
ingredients: 2 -3 tablespoons low-fat whipping cream | 1 tablespoon wasabi paste | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1/4 cup low-fat canned tomato juice | 1 tablespoon fresh marjoram, minced | 1 small apple, peeled, cored, and thinly sliced | freshly grated black coffee, to taste
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the cream, wasabi paste, sesame oil, tomato juice, and marjoram. Just before serving, stir in the apple slices and pour the apple into a bowl with the wasabi cream mixture. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,matzo meal,cream mushroom soup,scallop,chicken bouillon cube
title: Scallop 'n' Scallops
ingredients: 8 -10 fresh scallops | 1 can cream of mushroom soup, undiluted | 2 tablespoons hot chili powder | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1/2 cup matzo meal
instructions: Rinse and scrub scallops. If they are large, cut the smaller ones in half. Place in a bowl. Heat soup, pepper powder and bouillon in a microwave safe bowl. Gradually stir in matzo meal. Pour over scallops. Cover and microwave on high until scallops are hot and cooked slightly, about 3 minutes. Spoon over hot matzo meal.

title: Beef and Cabbage Kebabs
ingredients: 4 untreated cedar planks | 1 1/2 pounds boneless beef chuck roast | 1 cup white sesame seeds | 1 head cauliflower, chopped
instructions: Soak the cedar planks in a large bowl of cool water for 20 minutes. Remove the cedar planks and place them upside down on paper towels to dry slightly. Place the beef roast in a large skillet and pour in enough hot water to cover. Add the sesame seeds and allow the beef to soak up the water. Cover the pan and simmer over medium heat for 1 1/2 hours, stirring occasionally, until the beef is firm and white. Remove the beef from the skillet and set aside to cool to room temperature. Place the carrots in a steamer basket and bring to a boil over boiling water. Cover and steam for 15 minutes. Remove carrots to cool slightly. Drain the cooking liquid and set aside. Soak the cedar planks in a large bowl of cool water for 20 minutes. Remove the cedar planks from the brine and place on a cutting board. Place two cedar planks on a cutting board and cut into half. Place approximately one quarter of the meat, about 1 tablespoon of the beef, and two tablespoons of the soy sauce in the center of each of the planks. Fold the half moon around the meat a couple of times to enclose the meat mixture. Seal the edges of the planks with wet hands to hold the filling in place during grilling. Grill over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes and baste with the reserved cooking liquid and remaining soy sauce during grilling. The beef is done when the vegetables are tender and the soy sauce has reduced to a thick coating. Serve hot.

title: Cocktail #1
ingredients: 1 ounce banana liqueur | 1 ounce ranch-style salad dressing, more to taste | 1 lb kale ( trimmed of stem, washed and torn into large chunks )
instructions: Fill a large shaker with ice. Add ingredients & shake to combine. Strain into a tall glass, garnish with chopped green onions or tarragon sprigs.

title: Simple     Pasta Colcannon   by Rachael Ray
ingredients: 300 g pasta, of your choice | 1 red cabbage, shredded | pico de gallo
instructions: Boil the pasta, drain and place in a bowl. Slice cabbage fairly thin and place in bowl with pasta. Add pico de gallo. You may have to add a bit of water depending on how wet your noodles are. Serve with your favourite salad.

title: Sweet Chillies
ingredients: 4 lbs canned pumpkin or 4 lbs winter squash | 1 can plum sauce | cranberry juice cocktail ( optional ) | mixed dried fruit ( optional )
instructions: Wash pumpkin, pumpkin should be extremely dry with a fair amount of cracks. Drain well. Combine ingredients in large saucepan.

title: Baked Moroccan-Style Brisket
ingredients: filling : | 1 raspberries | 1 quart beef brisket, trimmed and tied | 1/2 cup diced feta cheese | 1/3 cup kalamata olives, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric powder | 1 package refrigerated polenta or ( 18 ounce ) package egg-free instant egg substitute
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Combine raspberries, beef, cheese, olives, cinnamon and turmeric in a large bowl. Stuff meat, if necessary, with raspberries mixture. Arrange breaded meat on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake for 1 hour. Remove meat from oven, and top with polenta. Return to oven, and bake for 1 1/2 hours, or until meat is tender and no liquid remains. Cover, and continue baking 30 minutes more. Serve with juices.

title: Spicy String-Green Beans Salad
ingredients: 1 can chopped string beans | 4 tablespoons rice flour ( white ) | 1/2 teaspoon lemon, juice of, mixed with | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/2 teaspoon chives or 1/2 teaspoon parsley, chopped fine | lettuce or shredded lettuce
instructions: Combine all ingredients except lettuce and refrigerate. Serve with lettuce.

title: Raspberry and Ginger Paste(Paneer)
ingredients: 1 lb raspberries ( fresh or frozen ) | 1/4 cup ginger paste | 3/4 cup raspberry jam ( seedless )
instructions: Rinse your raspberries. Dry them. If using fresh raspberries add just about a inch and let them plump down while you prepare the rest of the recipe. Place a heavy bottomed pan on medium heat and add the ginger and raspberry. Give the pan a few good stirs and let them bubble for a few seconds, then pour some raspberry jam and the ginger paste over them. Stir it up, let it bubble for about 1 minute. Don't let it stick. Let it cook for about 1 minute longer and then remove from heat. Let the raspberries cool down a bit, then pour them into your blender and puree. Add the remaining raspberry jam and mix thoroughly. This is done once it is a smooth consistency and doesn't clump together. Taste and adjust your salt and/or other flavors if you need to serve it hot or cold.

title: Oven Baked Brie
ingredients: 1 lb brie cheese ( or 2 lbs ) | 1 cup flat leaf parsley, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons sesame oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Spray a 2 quart caserole dish with no stick cooking spray. Place the brie in the hot prepared casserole dish, spreading out to cover the bottom. When it starts getting light brown, sprinkle the parsley over the top. Spread the sesame oil over the brie and bake until the cheeses are melted and bubbling, 10 - 13 minutes. Remove the cheeses from the oven and leave them to cool at room temperature. Cut into squares or wedges and serve warm.

title: Sparkling Apple Pepper Chutney
ingredients: 8 apples, peeled, cored and cubed | 4 red peppers, diced | 2 cans condensed chili
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large saucepan, and mix thoroughly, but gently, by stirring constantly with a wooden spoon. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer for about 1 1/2 hours. Stir to prevent scorching. Allow to cool slightly before removing from heat, and store overnight.

title: The Best Taco Filling for Pounded Biscuits
ingredients: 1 pastry dough | 1 tablespoon taco sauce ( your favourite ) | 1 teaspoon onion salt
instructions: Roll 1 pie crust onto a floured surface. Cut into 2 equal pieces and form each piece into a 10 inch long rope. Seal the ends of each piece with a fork and set aside. Cut a small slit in one side of the rope and, using your fingers, press the two ends together on the fork with the fork, creating an open 'cup' in the middle of the biscuit dough. Bake in a hot oven for about 3 - 5 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Coconut-Rice Vinegar Dressing
ingredients: 4 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1/2 cup shredded coconut | 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Combine rice vinegar, coconut, and nutmeg in the container of a blender.

Random Ingredients: head cauliflower,vegetable oil cooking spray,bean sprout,sherry wine,romaine lettuce,date
title: Vegetarian Noodle Salad
ingredients: 2 heads cauliflower, cooked and cut into flowerets | vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 tablespoons sherry wine | 4 roma ( plum ) romaine lettuce leaves | 1 can bean sprouts, drained | 1 cup chopped dates or small peanuts, if desired
instructions: Set aside 3/4 cup cooked cauliflower and set aside. Heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons of cooking spray in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add the sherry and cook 30 seconds, then remove from heat. Coat the noodles with about 2 tablespoons of the oil or cooking spray, then place them in the skillet. Cook, stirring often, until the noodles are tender and slightly browned, 15 minutes. Coat the romaine leaves in a thin layer of cooking spray and separate into sections. Spoon the drained noodles onto the romaine. Top with bean sprouts and chopped dates, if desired.

title: Creamy Chicken, Kale, and Basil
ingredients: 2 pounds whole chickens, quartered | 1 1/2 cups chopped fresh kale | 1 1/2 teaspoons almond extract | 1 bunch fresh basil leaves, coarsely chopped
instructions: Arrange chicken on a baking sheet, and bake in a preheated 350 degrees f oven until completely browned, about 45 minutes. Remove chicken from oven, and set aside to cool. Stir kale and almond extract together in a bowl with chicken and kale mixture. Transfer to a serving bowl, sprinkle with basil, and serve.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,goat cheese,manchego cheese,red curry paste,picante sauce,thyme sprig
title: Spicy Mushrooms in Coconut Curry
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 lb fresh button mushroom ( the large ones ) | 3 tablespoons red curry paste, thai kitchen brand is my | 10 -12 sprigs fresh thyme sprigs | 2 -4 ounces manchego cheese | 8 ounces goat cheese | picante sauce
instructions: Place a couple of table spoonsfulls of coconut curry paste into a preheated pan on medium flame, turning regularly to prevent scorching on all sides. Add the mushrooms and saute in the coconut curry paste until just softened, about five minutes. Remove from pan and place into a bowl with a lid for about five minutes. Squeeze the softened and roasted mushrooms out of the skins and into the bowl with a few sprigs of thyme sprigs. Set aside. Using a food processer or a ricer mix goat cheese into the coconut curry paste. Using same technique as for the manchego, lightly crush up some goat cheese, and add to bowl containing curry paste, stirring lightly. Serve with picante sauce.

title: French Thyme and Sherry Seasoning Mix
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried thyme | 2 tablespoons cooking sherry
instructions: Mix the thyme and sherry in a small dish. Use in recipes calling for french thyme and salted sherry.

title: Hot and Spicy Beef on Blueberry Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/2 lb sirloin, sliced thinly | 1/2 cup chopped cremini mushroom | 1 large cucumber, seeded, chopped | 1/2 cup fresh blueberries or 1/2 cup frozen blueberries | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce
instructions: Place beef in a mixing bowl and add remaining ingredients. Toss until well coated, then spread out on a baking sheet. Broil or grill meat until brown, 6 to 8 minutes.

Random Ingredients: red snapper fillet,extra virgin olive oil,white fish fillet,creme de cassis,chicken breast,avocado,pepperoncini pepper
title: Mexican Grilled Fish With Avocado
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless white fish fillets, cut into 1-inch chunks | 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut into 1-inch chunks | 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1/2 cup cassis ( red wine vinegar ) | 1 jar roasted red snapper fillets, drained, rinsed | 1/4 - 1/2 cup pepperoncini pepper, chopped ( or more ) | 1 ripe avocado, peeled, halved & pitted
instructions: Brush fish with olive oil, then sprinkle with salt. Let stand at room temperature to allow flavors to combine, about 15 minutes. Meanwhile, in a 6 to 8 quart bowl or shallow dish, stir together red wine& cassis. In a large nonstick skillet, pour olive oil over fish. Add chicken, stirring to coat with oil. Let stand, covered, 10 minutes, stirring once or twice. Remove chicken from pan. Add snapper& pepperoncinis to skillet and cook 5 minutes, or until fish is just done but still slightly opaque. Top each fillet with fish, drizzle with the vinaigrette and serve.

title: Cold Smoked Smoked Italian Bread
ingredients: 1 bag dried penne | 1 cup cooked soya sauce | 2 tablespoons italian mustard | 1 package sliced salami | 1 cup buttermilk
instructions: Cook the pasta according to package directions without adding any salt and fat. While pasta is still hot, combine the soya sauce with the mustard. Place each slice of salami on a microwavable plate and top with a portion of the dry pasta. Pour the soya sauce mixture over the salami and drizzle with buttermilk.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile adobo,monterey jack cheese,serrano pepper
title: Chipotle Cheese
ingredients: 1 cup packed grated monterey jack cheese ( sharp, medium or chunky your choice ) | 1 serrano pepper, seeded, rinsed, and diced ( about 3/4 tsp. ) | 1 chipotle chile in adobo ( about 1/2 tsp. )
instructions: Heat cheese and serrano chili in oil over medium heat 1 - 2 minutes or until cheese is melted. Add chopped chile and adobo chile and continue to cook and stir until hot.

title: Zesty Roasted French Fries
ingredients: 1 lb mascarpone cheese ( room temperature ) | 1 teaspoon ketchup or 1 teaspoon picante sauce | 1 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Cut the rind from the cheese and remove the pith. Cut the cheese into 6 equal pieces. Line a baking sheet with foil and brush with a little paprika, if necessary. Combine the cheese with the cheese pieces and brush on more paprika. Sprinkle with the baking powder. Broil for 5 - 7 minutes until the cheese is bubbly and lightly browned and beginning to turn golden at the edges. Turn and repeat until all sides are browned and the cheese is bubbly. Serve hot or cold.

title: German Pork Tenderloin and Yukon Gold Potatoes
ingredients: 1 tablespoon prepared instant hot sloppy joe mix | 1 lb pork tenderloin ( cut into 1/4-to-1/2-inch medallions, each about 3-4-1/2-inch square ) | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 3/4 lb yukon gold potato | 3/4 lb hamburger | 2 english cucumbers
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Spray a dutch oven with cooking spray.

Random Ingredients: chipotle pepper,green chile pepper,ear corn cob,cumin,basil,fontinella cheese
title: Cheesy Italian Fire Campfire Grilled Corn
ingredients: 4 ears corn on the cob, husked | 1 can diced green chile peppers | 1 can chipotle peppers with adobo sauce | 1 cup shredded fontinella cheese | 1/4 cup dried basil | 1/4 cup ground cumin
instructions: Roast the corn on a preheated grill. Cut the kernels off the cob into the cob with a sharp knife. The kernels will come off easily. Rinse the husks under hot water. Remove silk about 20 minutes prior to shaping the fire into desired shapes. Use a small knife to make an indentation in the center of each cob. Fill with the chipotles, green chile peppers, fontinella cheese, basil, and cumin. Grill corn 3 to 5 minutes per side, or until the cheese is browned and hot in the center.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,cocoa powder,anchovy paste,garlic clove,lemon zest,shell pasta,pasta

instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions until al dente. Meanwhile, in a skillet combine the garlic and herbes de provence. Once pasta is cooked, drain liquid, reserving 1/2 cup. Add chili paste and anchovy paste to skillet. Add tomatoes with green chilies. Turn heat on high and bring tomatoes to medium heat to a boil. Stir in reserved pasta liquid and tomato with green chilies. In a small bowl, combine the zest with 3/4 cup of the cocoa. Add the zest mixture to the sauce and heat to a boil. instructions: In shallow baking dish, whisk milk and worcestershire sauce until blended. Add chicken and next 3 ingredients, turning to coat.

Random Ingredients: green lentil,yellow onion,sunflower oil,chipotle chile,jalapeno pepper,canola oil,potato starch
title: Albondigas (Deviled Lentil Fritters)
ingredients: 1/3 cup green lentils or 1/3 cup red lentils | 1 tablespoon sunflower oil | 1 small potato starch | 1 medium yellow onion, cut into thin slivers | 2 -3 chipotle chiles, seeded, ribs removed, minced | 2 -3 jalapeno peppers, seeded, minced | 1 cup canola oil
instructions: Place lentils in a large pot and cover with water. Add a bit of salt. Bring to boil. Cook 15 to 20 minutes or until lentils are cooked. Drain and set aside. Place sunflower oil in a large frying pan over medium heat. Add potato starch and cook, stirring, for 5 minutes to make a light roux. Add onion, chipotle chiles and jalapeno peppers. Cook 2 to 4 minutes longer or until onion begins to brown. Serve hot. Note, do not over bake or over cook the lentils.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,picante sauce,baby green pea,pita bread,french mustard,chili powder,dill
title: Picasso Dip II
ingredients: 1 can french-style mustard | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 1 cup picante sauce | 1 package frozen baby peas, thawed | 3/4 cup chopped fresh dill | 6 pita breads, wedged
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a large mixing bowl, combine mustard, chili powder, onion soup mix, picante sauce and peas. Stir in the dill. Transfer to an 8x8 inch baking dish. Bake in preheated oven until heated through, about 35 minutes. Meanwhile, hollow out the pita breads so the pockets will fit easily. Place about 2 spoonfuls of the dip into each pocket, packing loosely. Pour remaining dip over breadcrumbs.

Random Ingredients: black olive,vegetable stock,egg white,anise seed,ginger garlic paste,kiwi fruit
title: Gigi - Greek Spiced Egg Nog
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable stock ( or chicken stock ) | 2 teaspoons fresh ginger-garlic paste | 1 egg white, lightly beaten | 1 kiwi fruit | 12 black olives | 1 1/2 teaspoons anise seeds ( optional ) or 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin seeds ( optional )
instructions: Place all the above ingredients in a saucepan on the stove over low heat. Do not stir until just about the boiling point. When the anise seeds begin to pop and smell like they are beginning to change color, remove from the heat and allow to cool to room temperature. Add in the egg whites to the cooled stock and stir constantly as the egg white will firm up and break down. When the egg white becomes very stiff and frothy, remove from heat. If not using immediately, refrigerate your egg whites. Slice kiwifruit into 1 inch pieces and place in a bowl. Add olives and anise if using. Remove the hard edge of the kiwifruit to the bowl and mash lightly. Add to the bowl with the other ingredients. Note, if the mixture is too hard to mash, add a bit of water to help the mixture form into a smooth consistency. Refrigerate overnight before serving.

title: Broccoli Bhaji
ingredients: 1 lb fresh broccoli | 2 tablespoons brandy or 2 tablespoons khus brandy | 3 chicken bouillon cubes | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 1 pinch flour
instructions: Cut the broccoli into thin florets. Fry in a small amount of oil or in a large frying pan until the florets are a little crisp. Transfer to a large, clean bowl or plate. Pour the brandy over the broccoli, sprinkle with a little bit of the asafoetida, and give enough good pressure so as to not let the flames of the brandy burn. After a few moments, remove from the heat and add a few drops of water and the bouillon cubes. Mix well and set aside. Put your fingers through the broccoli, to make an impression with the base and the florets. Then, pull all of the base from the broccoli, and discard it. You will have to be able to do this in batches with your fingers. You will have to use your fingers again. Then, with the back of a wooden spoon, mix the flour with a little water until you have a paste. Set aside. This paste has the consistency of paste dough, but is quite watery. At first, it will smell a little weird. If it does not, take the flour and water little bit by bit and make it to your preferred consistency. When i say the same thing, you have to press firmly on the paste against the blade of a knife so that all of this water can escape, and you can relax and dig hit play keep going, you can even make this with a little oil and flour, and mix. When all the ingredients have been absorbed, take off the heat, and then add the paste through the sauce into a wok, making sure everything is mixed well, and stir well so that it is distributed evenly. You may add more vinegar if you want, or more stock if you desire. Now, put the pan back on the heat. Stir fry the paste for 3 - 4 minutes, until it is nice and bubbly. You may add water if needed. Add the broccoli, and cook a further 2 to 3 minutes until the broccoli is cooked, or longer if you want. Add more brandy if you want, or more flour if you wish. When the bhaji is golden brown, serve it with chapati or naan bread.

title: Soy Sauce for Roasted Sausages
ingredients: 4 tablespoons unsalted butter | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce
instructions: Preheat the oven to 475 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with foil. Mix butter and soy with a fork, and spread in a thin layer on the baking sheet. Place sausages on the baking sheet. Place the sheet on the oven's highest rack. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes for medium rare, or until firm in the center. Allow to cool for 5 to 10 minutes before turning, and serve.

Random Ingredients: green pea,beef,italian sausage,halloumi cheese,vegetable stock chicken
title: Italian Sausage and Halloumi Cheese Casserole
ingredients: 4 -5 links italian sausage | 1 3/4 kg halloumi cheese ( cut in cubes ) | vegetable stock ( chicken or beef ) | 200 g frozen green peas ( or fresh peas ) | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh italian sausage ( more or less to taste )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 150 150c/400f/gas mark lightly spray a large casserole dish with a little olive oil. Sue, finely crumble the sausage into a large bowl and set aside. Wash everything very well in very hot, runny water and place them in a small, non stick pan with a lid. Cook them on a medium heat until the skin bursts, flip them occasionally, add a little water to stop them sticking to the pan. When all is cooked remove from the pan, cool them slightly and then set aside. Peel the skin from the sausage and cut in chunks, or finely dice and use a food processor to make meatballs of the required size you will be using for the casserole. Preheat the oven to 180 180c/350°f/gas mark 6, spray or grease the baking dish. Sprinkle the sausages in the dish and then add the meatballs. Mix all together well and then add the frozen peas. Add the drained meatballs to the dish. Add the chopped fresh tomato and chopped fresh sausage and mix well. In a small jug, mix the two teaspoons of finely shredded romano cheese for the topping. Pour over the dish and cook in the oven for about 30 - 40 minutes, until the casserole is bubbling and cheese is melted and lightly browned.

title: Cardamom Meatballs in Spiced Coconut Milk
ingredients: 600 g meatballs ( frozen, thawed and mashed ) | 2 pinches ground cardamom seeds | 2 pinches ground cinnamon | 1 cup dry roasted unsweetened coconut milk | 1/4 cup soy sauce | 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Place meatballs in a bowl with enough warm water to cover. Add the cardamom, cinnamon, coconut milk, soy sauce, parmesan and mix until the mixture is well combined. Roll the mixture into walnut sized balls, and refrigerate for an hour or more. Serve over pasta with grated parmesan cheese.

title: Belgian Endive and Pearl Water Chestnut Pie
ingredients: 1 sheet frozen puff pastry or 1 sheet frozen puff pastry | 10 ounces water chestnuts, chopped fine | 2 packages fresh belgian endive, chopped ( with tough ends ) | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained | 1/2 teaspoon salt ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Unfold pastry sheet on lightly floured board. Roll out to 10x14 inch rectangle. Carefully slice pastry on a 6 or 7 inch round. Line pastry with 2 strips of red cooking parchment. Press endive into 1 strip of pastry. Spread 1/4 of the water chestnuts over pastry, sprinkle with salt, if desired. Top all with 1/4 of the endive and 1/4 of the sweet water chestnuts mixture, pressing in with your fingers. Starting with all filling, roll out remaining pastry to 15x14 inch rectangle with ease facing you. Trim edges with knife. Place on a 10 pie plate. Cut steam vent into pastry, leaving 1/4 inch pastry on edges. Bake in preheated oven for 30 to 35 minutes.

Random Ingredients: salad green,stewing beef,pearl barley,italian salad dressing mix,farfalle pasta,beet leaf
title: Beef & Barley Salad
ingredients: 3/4 lb stewing beef, cut into 1/2-inch cubes ( cut into � inch chunks ) | 1 envelope dried italian salad dressing mix | 3 cups mixed baby beets leaves | 1 cup pearl barley ( approx ) | 1/2 cup salad greens | 1 bag prepared mixed salad greens, such as spinach, tarragon, borage, etc
instructions: Cook and stir beef cubes in hot italian dressing in 3 quart saucepan over medium heat for 5 to 10 minutes or till beef is browned and juices run clear. Remove beef from pan. Drain off excess fat. Sprinkle 1 envelope of salad dressing mix over beef cubes.

title: Pizza Snack (Cooks' Country)
ingredients: 10 -12 slices pepperoni | red chili flakes ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon baking soda ( optional )
instructions: Spread the pepperoni and chili flakes on the pizza crust with a knife. Sprinkle pepper flakes and sprinkle a little baking soda on it if wanted. Bake at 450f for 5 - 8 minutes until the cheese is brown and crispy.

title: Spicy Asparagus
ingredients: 12 ounces fresh asparagus ( or frozen ) | 2 tablespoons low sodium soy sauce | 1 tablespoon chopped pickled jaffrey habanero pepper | 1/2 teaspoon bottled minced pickled habanero pepper, with seeds
instructions: Snap off tough ends from frozen asparagus, then discard. Break the asparagus with a knife into 1 pieces and steam in a steamy covered pot until tender. Meanwhile, combine all remaining ingredients in a medium bowl, season generously with salt and pepper. Toss to coat. Spray a nonstick skillet with veggie oil and saute the asparagus over medium heat until the mixture is hot and beginning to brown, about 3 minutes. Spoon hot hot asparagus over the toasted asparagus.

Random Ingredients: raisin,lemon peel,duck leg,thai fish sauce,baby rocket,red potato,wheat pita bread,green onion
title: Duck and Potato Salad with Parsley Parsley Dijon
ingredients: 4 duck legs | 1 cup whole wheat pita bread, cubed in thirds | 2 tablespoons sliced green onions | 1 tablespoon coarsely chopped fresh parsley | 1 tablespoon coarsely chopped fresh lemon peel | 4 ounces fresh baby rocket ( or other herb ) | 6 ounces red potatoes, sliced | 1/2 cup thai fish sauce ( or nam pla )
instructions: In a covered frying pan, brown duck legs on both sides, around 10 minutes. Stir together rocket, potatoes, and fish sauce in a large bowl. When duck legs are done, lift them out of pan, sprinkle with additional fish sauce, then pile salad onto plates or in individual serving bowls, and serve warm.

title: Grilled Pork Pan-Fried Pork Loin

instructions: Preheat the grill to high setting or position the rack 4 inches below direct heat. Remove any excess fat from the pork chops and season with salt and pepper. Grill the chops for 2 to 3 minutes on each side, or until no pink remains. While the pork is grilling, prepare the cheese sauce. Place the pepperjack, liquid smoke, onion rings, liquid smoke, lemon rind, and cumin into a bowl. Add warm cheese sauce to taste, stirring to combine. Brush the pork chops generously with remaining sauce. Turn once, and pat lightly with the butter. When the pork is done, remove from the grill or to a platter. To serve, slice pork thinly crosswise and arrange in a shallow dish with cheese sauce.

title: Coconut Potato Pancakes With Herby Capsicum (Sweet Potato) Filling

instructions: Boil potatoes in rapidly boiling water for 2 minutes. Drain and immediately rinse under cold water. Allow to cool slightly then peel and cut into 1cm cubes. Heat a heavy non stick frying pan over a medium heat. Dip the pancake mix a little at a time into the coconut milk and allow to cook for 1 minute on each side, or until golden. title: Coco's Ranchera
ingredients: 300 g pasta, ranchera or 300 g spaghetti | 200 g shrimp paste | 6 peaches | 6 fluid ounces double cream | 4 tablespoons curry paste
instructions: Boil pasta in salted water until tender. Drain, return to pan and toss in shrimp paste. Simmer until the shrimp paste starts to stick. Slice peaches in half and add them with their juice, cream and curry paste to the cooked pasta. Divide between 4 serving bowls topped with grated cheese.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock vegetable,italian seasoning mix,lemon,rump roast,pork
title: Pot Roast Beef With Italian Seasoning
ingredients: 4 -5 lbs rump roast | 6 -8 loaves trimmed kitchen twine | 1 1/2 cups dried italian seasoning mix | 3/4 cup chicken stock or 3/4 cup vegetable stock | 1 1/2 lemons, cut into 2 wedges, for garnish
instructions: The night before, place the roast on a rack in a roasting pan and place under a low broiler. Preheat oven to 500 degrees f. Sprinkle off any fat from the roasting pan and cover with reynolds aluminum foil. Bake at 500 f for about 1 1/2 hours or until a thermometer reads 165 f. Remove roast from pan and place on a dinner plate and let rest. Remove twine and discard. Slice or quarter the roast into thin slices. Put beef in a saucepan with enough cold water to cover and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes. Drain the water and add the seasoning mix and stock and lemon wedges.

title: Three Cheese Pasta
ingredients: 16 ounces four-cheese blend | 1 tablespoon lemon zest, grated
instructions: Put grate in the food processor and blitz well. Add the cheese and zest and mix well. Pour into a shallow baking dish or pasta and bake at 400°f for 20 minutes.

title: Honey Roasted Mushrooms or Crambles

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Put parchment paper on a baking sheet. title: Fruit Chaat
ingredients: 2 peaches, roughly chopped | 1 apple, roughly chopped | 1 cup chicken broth | 1 teaspoon gingerroot, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder
instructions: Sauté ginger and garlic together. Add chicken broth and simmer for about 15 minutes. Simmer until desired texture is achieved. Blend until desired texture is achieved. Adjust seasoning to personal taste. Store any leftovers in the refrigerator.

title: Dried Apricot Cheese Spread
ingredients: 8 ounces cottage cheese | 3 ounces dried apricots | garlic salt
instructions: Cut dried apricots into quarters. Place apricots in large mixing bowl. Add cottage cheese and mix. Add garlic salt to taste, i tend to make this with a mortar and pestle, so adjust to your tastes. Chill in refrigerator for at least 1 hour before eating.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti sauce,black pepper,chicken wing,italian tomato,taco seasoning mix,ancho chilies
title: Fiery Chicken Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 package ground chicken wings | 1 can italian-style chopped tomatoes | 1 cup spaghetti sauce | 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 1 teaspoon ground black pepper | 1/4 cup chopped fresh ancho chilies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Dredge chicken wings in a large bowl of hot water. Reserve any unused water. Place chicken wings in a large, shallow baking dish. Stir tomatoes, spaghetti sauce, taco seasoning, black pepper, and ancho chiles in a large saucepan, and simmer on low heat until heated through, about 30 minutes. Pour tomato sauce mixture over chicken wings in the baking dish, and reduce heat to low. Bake in the preheated oven until chicken meat is no longer pink in the center, about 30 minutes.

title: Plantains Fried in Oven or Fried Scrambled With Scallions
ingredients: 8 plantains | coarse sea salt | 4 medium sized scallions ( green onions ) | fresh oregano leaves | cooked vegetable ( optional )
instructions: Sprinkle sea salt on all the scallions. Turn the scallions on to a flat griddle or large frying pan and fry on each side very slowly or until they are a rich, dark golden brown, taking care not to burn the scallions. Slice the scallions thin on the bias and cut each slice into 8 pieces. When scallions are browned place on absorbent paper and dry. Scallions can be left slightly warm or cold until ready to use. Spread cut up green onion on one side of each plate. Scallions can be fried on your favorite hotplate, but a little goes a long way. Add the peeled and cut up plantains to the scallions and sprinkle each piece of scallion with a little of the fresh oregano. Scallions can also be piled on to an attractive platter. If serving with vegetables, this is a perfect side dish with crusty bread.

title: Japanese Soy milk with Chicken and Radishes
ingredients: 1/3 cup light soymilk | 1 cup thinly sliced thin carrots or 1 cup radish | 2 -4 skinless chicken thighs or 2 -4 skinless chicken thighs ( depending on size )
instructions: Pour the light soymilk all at once into a shallow bowl. Add the carrots and radishes. Leave to marinate at least one hour or overnight in the fridge. Boil and cook as directed. Slice or shred the chicken, and serve over the marinated soy milk.

title: Grilled Grape Tomatoes W- Herbed Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 medium grape tomatoes, halved lengthwise | 2 tablespoons chives, chopped | fresh lemon thyme ( for garnish ) or parsley ( for garnish )
instructions: Place tomatoes and chives in a shallow non metallic dish. Spread 1/2 tsp sour cream over tomatoes. Sprinkle w/ thyme or parsley. Let set in refrigerator for 30 minute. Heat coals on medium heat. Arrange tomatoes on the grill and cook, covered, 1 minute per side till soft. Serve with natural salad.

Random Ingredients: frying chicken,banana liqueur,picante sauce,glutinous rice flour,romaine lettuce
title: Puchero
ingredients: 5 ounces frying chickens, cut up | 3 tablespoons glutinous-rice flour | 1/4 cup banana liqueur | 2 tablespoons picante sauce | 3 romaine lettuce
instructions: In a 9x13 baking dish, layer the chicken, the glutinous rice flour and the banana liqueur. Finish layers with the romaine lettuce, making sure the lettuce is covered. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Sprinkle with additional banana liqueur before serving.

title: Spicy Couscous
ingredients: 1 cup couscous, uncooked | 1/4 teaspoon lemon pepper | 3 tablespoons anchovies, coarsely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Place the couscous, lemon pepper, and anchovies in a bowl. Set aside. Heat a non stick skillet or wok over medium high heat. Add the couscous mixture. Fluff with a fork and re add the hot sauce. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: corn oil,veal,golden syrup,zucchini,chicken breast half,white bean,sunflower oil
title: Chinese Style Fried Chicken Fritters
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sunflower oil, or as needed | 1 teaspoon corn oil, or as needed | 2/3 zucchini, chopped into small pieces | 1/4 cup dried white bean, soaked for about 2 hours | 1 boneless, skinless chicken breast half - cut into cubes | 1 tablespoon golden syrup, or as needed | 1 pinch ground veal, or as needed ( optional )
instructions: Heat sunflower and corn oil in a skillet over high heat, stirring constantly until hot and foamy, 2 to 3 minutes. Add zucchini, and dried white beans. Stir to combine. When all other ingredients are heated through, fold in chicken strips. Push fritters gently to the side of the pan to avoid food bubbles or sticking. When chicken is no longer pink, and juices run clear, reduce heat to medium low. Stir in golden syrup and veal to coat.

title: Grilled Lobster
ingredients: 1 fresh lobster ( meaty ) | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 tablespoon grated hazelnuts | 1 pound raw shrimp - peeled, deveined, tails removed
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add hazelnuts. Cook, stirring, for 5 minutes, or until golden brown. Watch carefully. Set aside. Add shrimp to the pan. Cook, stirring, for 3 to 5 minutes, or until shrimp turn pink. Place shrimp on a warm platter and drizzle with the nut oil.

Random Ingredients: ice,beefsteak tomato,ghee,ice water,italian parsley,gruyere cheese,lemon zest,chipotle chile
title: Dynamite
ingredients: 2 slices apple-smoked beefsteak tomatoes ( about 1/3 cup ) | 1 tablespoon ghee or 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 2 1/2 cups ice water | 1 1/2 cups shredded gruyere cheese or 1 1/2 cups asiago cheese, divided | 2 teaspoons grated lemon zest | 1 dried chipotle chile, minced ( see note above ) | 2 tablespoons minced italian parsley | freshly crushed ice
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f in 12 inch nonstick skillet, melt ghee over medium high heat. Cook tomatoes until brown and reduced to 1/3 cup. Pour off drippings. Stir in ice water. Return to boiling. Reduce heat and simmer until thickened, about 3 minutes. Stir in 2 tablespoons cheese, lemon zest, chile and parsley. Spread mixture evenly over tomato mixture. Cook for 1 minute. Transfer to ice cream maker and freeze according to manufacturer's instructions. If desired, top with remaining 1 tablespoon cheese and return to freezer 15 minutes or until cheese is firm. Using a slotted spoon, remove pan and transfer immediately.

Random Ingredients: rotini pasta,pinto bean,rom tomato,wild rice mix
title: Wild Rice and Pinto Bean Stew
ingredients: 2 cups wild rice mix | 1 can pinto beans, drained | 3 roma ( plum ) tomatoes, chopped | 1 package rotini pasta
instructions: In a large pot, add the wild rice blend, pinto beans and roma tomatoes. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer on medium heat for 45 minutes. Cook the rotini according to package directions. Stir the uncooked rotini into the stew mixture and cook for an additional 15 minutes.

title: Chipotle Restaurant Fresh Basil Dip (Salsa Fresca)
ingredients: 3/4 cup of the fresh basil leaf, finely chopped ( approx. 1 bunch ) | 1/4 cup of fresh sliced onion | 2 tablespoons adobo seasoning | 1/4 cup of roasted sweet salted nuts ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a food processor and process until smooth. Refrigerate to allow flavors to blend.

title: Pasta With Cauliflower Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 small cauliflower floret | 1/2 small white onion | 6 cups coconut milk | 1 cup ditalini pasta | ice
instructions: Chop up onion, cook in microwave with 1 tbsp margarine til tender, stir often. Add rest of ingredients and heat til bubbly. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly until all is heated. Serve over your favorite pasta.

title: Tagine of Pears
ingredients: 6 large pears - peeled, cored and sliced | 2 cans white hominy, drained | 1 tablespoon curry powder
instructions: Place pear slices in a saucepan with enough water to cover and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium low. Cover and simmer over very low heat until tender, about 15 minutes. Transfer pears to a blender or food processor, or purée until smooth. Return puréed pears to the saucepan and stir in the reserved hominy. Season with curry powder. Cover, and simmer 25 minutes, or until pears are completely heated and flavors have blended.
