title: Roast Beef and Oat
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 cups oats, uncooked, quick cooking | 12 rosemary leaves or 1/4 ounce fresh rosemary | 1 tablespoon white peppercorns | 1 lb roast beef, fat trimmed
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Combine the oats, 2 rosemary leaves and the white peppercorns and toss lightly in a dish. Trim fat from roast. Arrange beef in single layer on the oats. Sprinkle with reserved rosemary sprigs. Turn so that rosemary is seen through. Cover with foil. Place it in oven and roast in middle of oven for 30 - 35 mins., or until done.

Random Ingredients: parsley leaf,mint leaf,tea,baby lima bean,orange juice,swiss chard
title: Baby Lima Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 lb baby lima beans, soaked overnight in cold water and drained | 2 bunches swiss chard or 2 bunches sorrel leaves, washed, washed and torn into bite sized pieces | 1 cup fresh orange juice | grated parlsey flavored salt or dried mint leaves | fresh parsley leaves, for garnish
instructions: Bring the lima beans to a boil in salted water. Meanwhile in a large heavy saucepan bring the chard or greens along with the orange juice to a boil. Turn down heat and simmer until it is almost tender. Add the greens to the soup along with the salt or mint leaves. Let the soup return to a simmer and cook until the greens are tender and heated through. Ladle soup into soup bowls and garnish with grated parlsey or parsley leaves.

Random Ingredients: salsa,maraschino cherry,thai basil,chicken stock vegetable,goat cheese
title: Fiesta Cheese Soup
ingredients: 8 ounces goat cheese | 1 1/2 cups fresh salsa | 1 cup chicken stock or 1 cup vegetable stock | 1 teaspoon maraschino cherry, chopped | 1 - 1 1/2 bunch fresh thai basil, stemmed, stems discarded
instructions: Place goat cheese and salsa in a small bowl, and beat with an electric mixer until creamy. Stir in the stock, and bring to a simmer. Cover, and set aside. Puree the soup in batches in a blender or food processor, or use a stick blender. Return soup to the pan, and stir in the cherries. Garnish with chopped basil. Serve with extra virgin slices of fresh bread to soak up the broth.

Random Ingredients: green,sole fillet,tomato sauce,black forest ham,white onion,jalapeno,catsup,beer
title: Crock Pot Ham and Black Olives
ingredients: 4 lbs sole fillets ( i've also substituted other white fish ) | 1/2 - 3/4 cup ketchup ( depending on how thick your meat is, i like it a bit runny ) | 1/4 cup heinz catsup | 1/4 cup tomato sauce ( use your favorite ) | 1 can black forest ham ( or other ham ) | 1 white onion, chopped | 1 -2 jalapeno, chopped ( depending on your taste ) | 1/2 cup beer or 1/2 cup apple juice
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except for the beer and jalapenos. Place fillets in the bottom of the crock pot. Pour 1/3 of beer/catsup mixture over fillets. Top fillets with remaining beer mixture. Cook on low for 4 - 5 hours. You may add a spoonful of water to the crock pot if sauce is too thick. Serve over white rice.

Random Ingredients: orzo pasta,edible flower,kosher salt,parmesan cheese,green onion,fennel seed,russet potato,hamburger bun
title: Italian Potato Salad
ingredients: 5 tablespoons dried minced hamburger bun | 1 tablespoon chopped green onion | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh mixed minced fennel seed | 1 1/2 tablespoons orzo pasta, uncooked | 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt | 2 cups grated russet potatoes ( about 1 medium ) | 3/4 cup grated parmesan cheese | 4 tablespoons finely chopped fresh edible flowers ( optional )
instructions: Place the hamburger buns in a small bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Microwave the green onions, fennel seeds, orzo, for 2 minutes on high, stirring to mix. Allow to cool to room temperature. Combine the potatoes, parmesan cheese, and fresh edible flowers in a large bowl. Gently stir in the hamburger.

title: Sticky Rice (Aka Forbidden Rice or Forbidden Rice)
ingredients: 1 1/2 2 1/3 cups converted long-grain rice ( white, brown or brown rice ) or 1 1/3 cups brown rice ( white, brown or brown rice ) | 3 cups yellow squash, cut in 1-inch cubes ( about 2 medium ) | 2 1/2 teaspoons baking powder | 1 bag and or ( 1 1/2 inch ) bag masaretto or ( 18 ounce ) bag roasted plain sweetened condensed milk | 3 lbs dry sifted confectioners'sugar or 3 lbs powdered sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 °f. Lightly grease bottom and sides of a 9x13 inch baking dish with butter or margarine. Place rice in a medium bowl. Cover rice with cold water or so that it’s about 1 inch below the bottom of the bowl. Let stand 3 to 4 hours or until clear and slightly moistened. Pour enough water in microwave safe container to measure 1½ inches into a microwaveable bowl. Place squash cubes in water and microwave on high for 2 minutes. Drain squash and place in a small bowl. Cover squash with cold water or so that it’s 1½ inches below the top of the bowl. Let soak 3 to 4 minutes, drain and set aside. Spread out squash on a cookie sheet. Sprinkle squash with 1 teaspoon baking powder. In a large bowl, mix yellow squash and remaining 1½ teaspoons baking powder. Place rice on the baking layer and pat into a rectangle and about ½ inch thick. Spread squash out on baking sheet. Spread yellow squash and the confectioners’ sugar on, 1 to 2 teaspoons, leaving about 1 - ½ inch over edges of the rectangle of rice. Starting at 2 opposite ends, make a 2 inch long crisscross. Cut through each rectangle of rice with a very sharp knife in 2 or 3 even concentric circles. With a spatula or slotted spoon, remove rows of crisscrosses on top of squash rows and sugar on baking sheet. Place baking sheet on upper rack of oven. Bake until rice is golden and filling is bubbling, about 50 to 55 minutes. Let cool 10 to 20 minutes. Cut into ½ inch squares and set aside. Sift 1½ teaspoons baking powder from a 1½ pound bag onto a large plate. In a large bowl, stir confectioners’ sugar with remaining 1 - ¼ cups water. Remove 2 cups rice from sheet with spatula. Sprinkle evenly with 1 pinch baking powder. In a medium, heavy bottomed 4 to 5 cup saucepan, heat the 1½ cups water over medium high heat until boiling. With a long matchstick bladed long paring knife, or a candy thermometer, carefully move the bladed short side of the matchstick bladed long side of the knife to the center of the saucepan. As soon as the water boils, add half the rice and continue cooking, stirring frequently, for 2 to 3 minutes until a small amount of rice turns brittle. Using a slotted spoon, immediately place the rice bowl in a large bowl of water. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside at room temperature until cooled, about 1 hour. Meanwhile, line a 9x9 dish with parchment paper. Line the bottom and sides of the dish with a layer of rice. With a slotted spoon, remove and discard parchment. Dollop 1½ cups of rice lightly in center of rice and smooth it down until the rice is completely smooth. Transfer to a plate.

Random Ingredients: part mozzarella cheese,brandy,red chili powder,mustard powder,sun tomato oil,rice noodle
title: Cheese and Sun-Dried Tomato Platter
ingredients: 1 package dried rice noodles | 1 package sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained and oil reserved | 1/3 cup seasoned rice noodles | 1/2 cup freshly grated part-skim mozzarella cheese | 1/4 teaspoon dry mustard powder | 1/4 teaspoon red chili powder
instructions: Cover a large, rimmed baking sheet with reynolds wrap heavy duty aluminum foil. Spray foil with a nonstick cooking spray. Spread rice noodles out on prepared baking sheet. Sprinkle sun dried tomatoes over the noodles. Dunk your hands under cold water and pat the noodles down with back of a spoon. Sprinkle evenly with half of the cheese. Sprinkle mustard powder and red chili powder over cheese. Place under a preheated broiler for 1 minute or until cheese is bubbly. Cut in slices and serve.

Random Ingredients: penne,horseradish,thai fish sauce,coriander powder,chili pepper,oregano,corn tortilla
title: Penne With Horseradish and Corn Tortillas
ingredients: 1 cup prepared horseradish | 2 cans thai fish sauce | 1 tablespoon coriander powder | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper | 1 lb penne | corn tortilla
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In a medium bowl, mix horseradish, fish sauce, coriander, oregano and chili. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil over high heat. Add pasta and cook, stirring occasionally, until 'al dente', about 8 minutes. Drain. Toss pasta with horseradish and sauce mixture and divide among 4 plates. Sprinkle tortillas on top and serve.

Random Ingredients: lime juice,white fish fillet,orange liqueur,pizza dough
title: Lime and Orange Grilled White Fish
ingredients: 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice | 1 tablespoon orange liqueur | 1 pound medium white fish fillets, cut into 2x2 inch pieces | 1 can refrigerated pizza dough ( or your own )
instructions: In a bowl, mix the lime juice and liqueur. Add fish.

Random Ingredients: beer,monosodium glutamate,scallion,parsley sprig,red curry paste,penne,red chile,red chilies
title: Thai Curry Pasta
ingredients: 5 scallions, chopped small | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh parsley sprigs | 1 teaspoon monosodium glutamate ( msg ) | 2 teaspoons red curry paste | 1 -2 whole dried red chile | 1/2 cup red chile chopped | 3/4 cup beer | 3/4 lb penne
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions until al dente and drain. Meanwhile, in a non stick skillet saute scallions, parsley and monosodium glutamate, for 2 - 3 mins or until softened and starting to brown. Mix in red curry paste and chilies. Continue to cook for 1 minute or until fragrant. Stir in beer, simmer for 2 - 3 minutes, stirring constantly. Serve with hot cooked drained pasta and garnish with chopped scallions.

Random Ingredients: chicken broth,onion,pumpkin pie spice,kaffir lime leaf,cayenne,cardamom
title: Easy Scented Pumpkin Soup
ingredients: 2 teaspoons pumpkin pie spice | 2 cups low sodium chicken broth | 1/2 cup minced onion | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne | 2 teaspoons kaffir lime leaves, finely chopped fresh
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine the pumpkin pie spice, chicken broth, onion, cardamom, cayenne and lime leaves.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese,vanilla pudding mix,ginger garlic paste,active yeast,green chilies,ladyfinger,beer,head garlic
title: Barefoot Contessa's Greek Feta Pudding
ingredients: 1 bottle light beer or ( 12 ounce ) bottle other lager-based beer | 1 package active dry yeast | 1/2 cup crumbled dried greek feta cheese or 1 large regular-strength feta cheese | 1 can diced green chilies, drained, seeded, diced fine ( i like hot chilis, and drain on paper towels ) | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 3 packages ladyfingers | 1 small head of garlic, cut into thick slices ( not whole ) | pam light cooking spray or oil, for brushing
instructions: In a medium sized sauce pan, combine the beer and yeast and let sit until foamy, about 5 - 15 minutes. Add the cheese, chilies, ginger garlic paste and 2 cups of hot water to the yeast mixture and mix well. Cover with a lid and place in the kitchen into a warm spot. Let sit until the dough rises, about 1 1/2 hours. On a floured board, knead the dough for 10 minutes. Cover with a dish towel and set aside to rise for 40 - 45 minutes. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f and spray a 9 x 13 inch baking dish with pam. Place a couple ladyfingers in the bottom of the baking dish. Spread the feta mixture evenly over the ladyfingers and then spread the green chilies and a little garlic on top of the feta mixture. Drain some of the liquid from the cheese, it should be a bit oily. Pour the yeast mixture over the cheese and place the baking dish into the oven. Bake the pizza for 20 minutes, then cut the pizza into quarters and serve.

Random Ingredients: plain white flour,coffee creamer,vegetable stock chicken,ham,cheese
title: Quick and Easy Cheesy Mince Pies
ingredients: 450 -800 g premium minced ham | 1 tablespoon instant coffee creamer | 150 ml vegetable stock or 150 ml vegetable stock | 1/8 - 1/4 fluid ounce low-fat cheese, grated ( depending on your taste ) | plain white flour, to coat
instructions: Place ham in a large, microwave safe bowl/container. Pour hot coffee over the ham, stir, and microwave on high for 3 - 4 minutes, until well combined, still stirring. Remove from microwave and stir in the stock and cheese.. Scoop up mince into 6 - 6 equal sized, ovenproof, muffin tin moulds that are just large enough to insert the mince. Push a toothpick through each mould, or place them on a non stick baking tray. Using the flat of your thumb, gently press the mince to ensure it penetrates the breadcrumbs. Sprinkle over the top of the moulds. Put on the microwave for 12 mins, or according to the instructions on the packet, at 600 watts. Leave to cool completely. Turn out onto a plate, cut into slices to serve or put in a container to chill for up to a couple of days.

title: Tunisian Beef (Covered and Stove Top)
ingredients: 6 -8 lbs stewing beef, cut into 2 inch pieces | 1 teaspoon coriander seed, cracked or 1 1/2 teaspoons crushed coriander seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Spread beef onto an ungreased metal foil and sprinkle with coriander.

Random Ingredients: harissa,red chili pepper,stew meat,sage,lime,chili pepper flake
title: Seal the Meat!
ingredients: 2 lbs stew meat, cut in 3 inch cubes | 2 tablespoons salt | 4 chili peppers, seeded & chopped | 2 limes, sliced in half | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage | 1/2 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: Season the meat with salt. Place in a plastic bag or large mixing bowl and add the chopped peppers. Squeeze the juice of the limes on the meat. Add the dried, chili flakes and salt/chili flakes and mix together. Seal and refrigerate for 24 hours. Remove from the refrigerator 30 minutes before cooking or place in the freezer for up to 6 hours in advance if you want to thaw the meat at this point. Heat the olive oil or canola oil over medium heat, brown the meat on all sides.

title: Baked Bean and Veggie Pancakes
ingredients: 3 cups beans, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup mixed fresh herbs, such as chives, parsley, and basil | 4 baby bok choy, each cut into about 3 pieces | 2 tablespoons fine semolina | 4 teaspoons crushed fine semolina
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Grease 2 1/2 inch diameter baking or baking pans and set aside. Combine the beans and herbs in a large mixing bowl. Add the bok choy and toss gently until the bean mixture begins to wilt. Stir in the fine semolina and then add enough semolina to form a dry pancake batter consistency. Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Sprinkle half the pancake batter into the pan, spreading with the back of a spoon so there are 4 pieces of batter for each pancake. Cook for 2 to 4 minutes on each side, until the pancake has browned. Repeat with the remaining batter, reheating skillet between batches until all the batter is used. Serve with the remaining pancakes on the side.

title: Easy, Light Lentils
ingredients: 1 bag red lentils | 2 celery ribs, diced | 1 package frozen okra | 3 cups ice water
instructions: Pick through the bag of lentils for stones, dirt if necessary. Rinse the bag and place it in the freezer overnight. Next day drain off all of the water and rinse away any excess water from the dumpling bag. Place back in the freezer. Prepare the vegetables, put 1/2 c water in a 4 liter crockpot. Add the celery and okra. Cook on low for 6 - 9 hours until the lentils are very soft. Remove lid and stir for a few minutes until the okra is hot. Discard any remaining moisture. If there is any remaining water in the pot, boil off a little of it. Stir through the frozen dumpling bag and serve.

Random Ingredients: chicken thigh,red chili sauce,brown rice syrup,fruit,havarti cheese,apple,zucchini
title: Rice Salad With Chicken and Apple
ingredients: 4 pieces chicken thighs | 2 apples | 2 zucchini | 1/2 cup brown rice syrup | 1 tablespoon red chili sauce | 100 g havarti cheese | 1/3 cup mixed dried fruit
instructions: Rinse dried fruit and dice. Wash chicken, tear into bite sized pieces and set aside. Boil and steam the chicken and chop. Cut the zucchini into thick julienne with cleaver cutting. Cut apple into thin julienne. Place chicken, zucchini, apple, sugar syrup and chilli sauce in a large saucepan. Add enough water to cover, simmer and cook for about 15 minutes or until all the water has evaporated. Pour mixed fruit into a bowl and put over high heat. Bring the sauce to boil so that if it boils too quickly, it will boil over. Remove from heat. Serve on bed of rice.

title: Smoky Beef N Lentils With Chipotle
ingredients: 1/2 lb sirloin, trimmed, thinly sliced into strips | 16 ounces green lentils, drained | 16 ounces guinness stout, undiluted | 1 -2 chipotle chile, canned | 2 tablespoons canned chipotle chiles, sauce from canned chipotle chile | 1/4 teaspoon mace, ground | 1 1/2 cups corn chips, coarsely crushed
instructions: Place slices of beef into a 9 by 13 by 2 inch x 3 inch metal loaf pan. Combine the lentils, guinness, chipotle chiles, chipotle sauce, ground mace and 1/4 teaspoon salt in a saucepan over medium heat. Simmer until beans are tender and most of the liquid has been absorbed, 15 to 20 minutes. Transfer the beef and sauce mixture to a serving platter, and garnish with the corn chips.

Random Ingredients: green cabbage,sea scallop,french,simple syrup,green chile pepper,bacon dripping
title: Sea Scallops and Cabbage
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons bacon drippings | 1 teaspoon minced green chile pepper | 2 large green cabbage, cored and shredded | 1 pound sea scallops | 2 teaspoons simple syrup | 1 bunch french
instructions: In a skillet over medium heat, melt the bacon drippings and green chili pepper. Cook and stir until the onion is translucent and tender. Place cabbage in a large bowl. Add the scallop to the skillet and sprinkle with the simple syrup. Cover skillet. Cook and stir until the cabbage and scallops are bright green, 7 to 10 minutes. Serve the scallops on a platter with the bacon drippings and sauce.

title: Black Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 tablespoon plain yogurt | 1 can canned black beans in paste
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the yogurt, beans, and pepper. Use a fork to mix well until everything is fully combined.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock vegetable,ice,sun tomato oil,curry powder,ham,yellow food coloring
title: Indian Chilli Hot Chocolate - Like Spit Roasted and Spicy Hot Ham!
ingredients: 375 g honey bar real hot ham | 375 g ice cream or 375 g cream | 375 ml chicken stock or 375 ml vegetable stock | 375 g dried yellow food coloring | 1 tablespoon curry powder | 125 g sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, well drained and coarsely chopped
instructions: Cut ham into small squares, about 3 to 4 x 1 cm depending on their size. Place in a large, self sealing container with a lid. Add the water or stock. Seal container with lid. Refrigerate for at least 6 hours and up to 1 day. Heat oven to 160c. Pour boiling water or stock into a heavy based pan. Place over medium heat and bring to the boil, stirring until thickened. Add food colouring and curry powder. Bring to the boil, lower heat, and simmer 15 minutes, stirring often. Return to the pan, and heat through. Transfer mixture to a heatproof container. Chill in the fridge for at least 6 hours and up to 4 hours before serving. Spoon into warm soup bowls and serve topped with chopped sun dried tomatoes.

Random Ingredients: cheddar cheese,grape leaf,plain flour,pancetta,barbecue seasoning,alfalfa sprout,chapati flour
title: Spicy Bacon and Pancetta Saute
ingredients: 300 g pancetta | 120 g green bresaola or 120 g british streaky pancetta | 50 g plain flour | 4 teaspoons barbecue seasoning | 225 g alfalfa sprouts | 1 tablespoon dried arabic basil or 1 tablespoon dried chepati flour | 300 g cheddar cheese, grated or 300 g grated tasty cheese
instructions: Chop pancetta finely and cook gently til just translucent and crisp. While you're waiting for your pan to dry out, blitz up your pancetta and bresaola or streaky pancetta till you have a fine paste. Add the flour, barbecue seasoning and basil together and mix. Add the pancetta mix to the pancetta. Tear up your brita leaves and scatter round them into the pan to keep them from discoloring. Spread your cheese evenly over the top of the pancetta and bresaola mix, then spoon the batter along the sides and fold together. Cook over a medium heat until bubbles form and the bottom starts to brown, then turn out onto a plate until all of the pancakes are cooked. Remove from pan and cut through with a sharp knife, and eat with your favourite salad, crusty bread rolls or fresh vegetables.

Random Ingredients: bacon,grain brown rice,rye flour,kosher salt,fennel,horseradish,fennel seed,mortadella
title: Robust Brown-Rice Rye Crisp
ingredients: 3 slices bacon | 1 teaspoon kosher salt, plus more for sprinkling | 2 teaspoons fennel seeds or 2 teaspoons fennel powder blend | 2 ounces mortadella ( thinly sliced leaves, 1 slice per slice-for 2 slices ) | 1 pinch fresh horseradish, for serving | 1 pinch fresh fennel seeds ( for seasoning ) | 1 1/2 cups uncooked long grain brown rice | 2 cups rye flour | 1 cup rye flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper, then spray with cooking spray.

title: Kielbasa Steamed Scallops
ingredients: 12 sea scallops | 1 pound smoked kielbasa, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 2 cans beef consomme | 2 cans chopped hot red chile peppers, or to taste
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Place the scallops into the pot, and cook uncovered until the scallops are opaque in the center, 2 to 3 minutes. Remove the scallops, and reserve. Return the pot to high heat, and bring to a boil. Cook the kielbasa slices in the boiling water until lightly browned, about 5 minutes per side. Drain, and remove the sausage slices to a bowl to keep hot. Pour the contents of the soup into a saucepan over medium heat, and heat until bubbly. Stir in the beef consommé, and heat to a boil. Pour soup over the scallops in the bowl, and mix lightly so that the soup incorporates the seafood. Continue cooking and stirring about 5 minutes, or until scallops are heated through. Remove from heat, and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: beef,salsa verde,tapioca flour,allspice,chocolate,curly endive lettuce,cream chicken soup
title: The Real Deal Authentic Mexican Meatball & Tasty Chili Verde Casserole
ingredients: 1 tablespoon taco seasoning ( can make in advance if needed ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice | 1 lb lean ground beef | 1 jar salsa verde ( mild or hot ) | 8 ounces condensed cream of chicken soup | 8 ounces sliced curly endive lettuce | 8 ounces shredded semisweet chocolate | 1 tablespoon tapioca flour ( optional )
instructions: Mix taco seasoning with allspice and set aside. In a large deep skillet heat the beef and 1/2 jar salsa verde to a medium heat and stir in the seasonings. Cook until beef is thoroughly cooked and is no longer pink in the middle. Drain and set aside. Wash and dry lettuce and place in bottom of a greased 9 x 13 inch baking pan. Cover the meat with the sour cream then the lettuce. Place dollops of the reserved spicy salsa verde on top. Top with the shredded chocolate. Sprinkle the tapioca flour over the top and spread evenly. Bake for 1 hour at 350 degrees.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,tangerine zest,salmon steak,sausage,baby carrot,jalapeno pepper,yellow bell pepper
title: Ajiaco (Tangerine Sausage and Rice)
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs skinless salmon steaks, cut into 8 pieces | 1 can sliced pickled jalapeno peppers, drained and coarsely chopped | 2 cups diced baby carrots | 1 large yellow bell pepper, cut into thin strips | 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded and thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon tangerine zest | 1/2 cup uncooked medium-grain white rice, washed ( sushi rice )
instructions: Heat a dutch oven or large, deep skillet over medium high heat. Add salmon and cook 5 minutes. Remove with a slotted spoon and set aside. Add jalapeno pepper, carrots, yellow pepper, and 3/4 cup water to dutch oven.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,chicken stock cube,beef chuck,szechuan peppercorn,beer
title: Beef With Yellow and Pepper Strivers in Beer
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless beef chuck, cut into 1-inch slices | 2 large yellow bell peppers, cut into 1-inch slices | 2 chicken stock cubes | 1 ounce szechuan peppercorns, soaked in | 1 tablespoon boiling beer
instructions: Heat a large, heavy based flameproof dutch oven. Add beef and cook over high heat until it loses its pink color, 8 to 10 minutes, turning once. Stir in bell peppers and stock cubes, then season with saffron flavored salt. Cover with a lid and cook over moderate to low heat for 1 to 3 hours. Remove lid and cook for a further 45 to 60 minutes or until beef and bell pepper strips are tender, stirring from time to time. Remove from heat and leave on one side. Serve beef and peppers sprinkled with remaining beer.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf italian parsley,cucumber,green bean,tomato soup,cocoa powder,tomatillo salsa,beef chuck,sunflower seed
title: Crock Pot Spanish Green Bean Chili
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless beef chuck, trimmed of all visible fat and cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 3/4 cup flat-leaf italian parsley, chopped | 3/4 cup sunflower seeds, toasted | 1/2 cup raw unsweetened cocoa powder ( optional ) | 2 cups fresh green beans, trimmed and cut in half | 1 cup thinly sliced cucumber or 1 cup finely diced potato | 8 ounces tomatillo salsa
instructions: Place beef in a large nonstick skillet or electric frying pan. In a large bowl, combine the tomato soup, parsley, sunflower seeds, cocoa powder and half the beans, reserving the rest of the beans for later use. Spread half of the onions in the slow cooker along with all of the remaining beans. Stir with a spoon or spatula until evenly distributed. Cover the meat with the chili mixture. Cover and cook on low for 8 hours. Add the remaining beans, stir, cover and cook on high for 30 minutes. Add cucumber and reserved tomato juice and stir to combine. Turn the slow cooker to high, stir and cover. Cook for 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: bay leaf,pork tenderloin,cream chicken soup,meat,hot chili sauce,button mushroom,saffron thread
title: Saffron Pork Chops
ingredients: 1 teaspoon saffron thread ( you can find this in the oriental food section ) | 1 lb pork tenderloin, trimmed of all visible fat | 1 can cream of chicken soup, undiluted | 1 cup sliced button mushroom, quartered | hot chili sauce, if desired | 3 bay leaves
instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add saffron and toast to a light color, about 1 minute. Remove to a small bowl. Repeat with remaining pork. Add the soup to the skillet along with the mushrooms, and return pork to the skillet. Heat to a boil, and then reduce heat. Cover, and simmer over low heat about 20 minutes until the pork is tender. Sprinkle with the saffron strands. Stir in hot pepper sauce just before serving. The saffron will keep well, covered and refrigerated up to 3 days.

title: Spaghetti Sauce II
ingredients: 2 cans whole peeled tomatoes with basil, oregano and garlic, with liquid | caraway, crushed
instructions: Empty contents of two medium pint jars into a large pot, and stir in the whole carrots. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer 2 hours, stirring occasionally, until the sauce has thickened slightly.

title: Mexican Pasta
ingredients: 3 packages dry pasta, or any other small pasta | 1 1/3 pounds chopped, roasted green peppers | 15 ounces stewed diced tomatoes with green chile peppers
instructions: Cook pasta in a large pot of boiling water for about 15 minutes. Drain pasta, and rinse with cold water. Combine pasta, roasted green peppers, stewed tomatoes with green chilies in a large pot, and cook over medium heat for about 5 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice,italian sausage,steak,gruyere cheese,strawberry,flour tortilla,sun tomato oil,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Grilled Beef Roll-Ups With Sour Cream, Sun Dried Tomatoes, and Gruyere
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs top round steaks or 1 1/2 lbs sirloin steaks | 2 teaspoons lemon juice | 2 tablespoons flour or 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 4 slices gruyere cheese | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, slivers, drained | 1/2 cup fresh strawberries, cut into strips | 1 tablespoon grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 2 large soft tortillas, cut in half
instructions: For the beef roll ups,. Trim any fat from the steak.

title: Fried Cinnamon Chips
ingredients: 4 large tortillas | 1/4 cup cinnamon, divided
instructions: Lay tortilla on counter. Spread a generous 1/2 teaspoon of cinnamon on the tortilla. Sprinkle 1/4 teaspoon of cinnamon on the tortilla. Sprinkle top with 1/4 teaspoon of 1/4 teaspoon of cinnamon. Roll and cut into 1/4 inch slices. Spray a large skillet or fry pan with cooking spray.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,apple juice,oregano,chow mein noodle,ladyfinger,extra virgin olive oil,savoy cabbage,chicken breast
title: Chopmeat Chinese Chicken Salad
ingredients: 1/4 savoy cabbage | 3 ounces chow mein noodles ( any other chow mein noodles. not the crunchy ones ) | 1 can mango chutney | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 8 ounces boneless skinless chicken breasts, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon fresh oregano, chopped | 8 ounces ladyfingers, cut diagonally into thirds | 3 tablespoons apple juice
instructions: Place savoy cabbage, chow mein noodles, mango chutney and oil in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium heat and remove from heat. In a medium saute pan over medium high heat, add chicken and oregano and saute until chicken is cooked through. Set aside to cool. In a large bowl mix together the chow mein and the cooled chicken mixture. Place the lady fingers side by side in the bottom third of a large platter or serving dish. Top with approximately 2 tablespoons of chutney mixture, 3/4 of the chicken, and 1/2 of the chopped lettuce. Repeat layers, ending with the remaining shredded lettuce. Drizzle with the apple juice. Serve.

title: Blood Orange Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 1 lb seedless cucumber, chopped | 1/3 cup blood orange juice | cinnamon, for sprinkling
instructions: Place the cucumbers in a bowl. Cover with orange juice and sprinkle with cinnamon to taste.

title: Jamaican Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup margarine or 1 cup butter | 1 can plum tomatoes, pureed | 4 -6 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes, finely chopped ( dried tomatoes ) | 1 -2 jalapeno pepper, minced ( the ones in the jar ) | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon nutmeg ( or to taste )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender and blend well until combined.

title: Quick and Easy Vegetable Linguine
ingredients: 1 package linguine | 3/4 cup mixed vegetables, frozen, chopped | 1 cup red cabbage, chopped | 2 packages chicken bouillon granules | 1/2 cup fresh lemon juice
instructions: Cook the linguine on a large saucepan of boiling salted water until al dente. About 8 minutes. Drain, reserving 1 cup cooking liquid. Put pasta back in pot. Meanwhile, to the cooking water, add remaining 1/2 cup of cooking liquid, the vegetables, chicken bouillon granules. Simmer until vegetables are crisp tender. Mix in lemon and return to a boil. Add noodles and salt, to taste, to taste. Serve immediately.

title: Italian Marinated Artichoke in Spinach and Strawberries
ingredients: 2 packages frozen artichokes, thawed, drained and cut into 1/2 -inch pieces ( such as baby artichokes, baby artichokes, tender baby artichoke, or black artichoke ) | 1/4 cup fresh basil, chopped | 1/4 cup fresh italian parsley, chopped | 1 cup strawberry, hulled, cut into thin wedges | 1/2 cup olive oil | 2 teaspoons ground cumin | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 cup fresh basil, chopped | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh italian parsley | 14 ounces spaghetti, cooked, drained
instructions: Place the artichokes and 1/4 cup of the chopped basil in the bowl of a blender, and pulse until finely chopped and evenly chopped. Combine 1/4 cup chopped fresh basil with the remaining chopped basil, parsley, strawberries, oil, 1 teaspoon cumin, and 1/2 teaspoon cumin in a large bowl, stirring. Add the remaining chopped basil and 1 teaspoon of cumin, stir well. Place the remaining marinade in a resealable plastic bag, and refrigerate 1 hour to overnight. Reserve the remaining marinade. Prepare the pasta according to the package directions. Drain. Place the artichoke mixture in a serving bowl, and toss to coat. Pour the reserved 1/4 cup of reserved marinade over the top, and toss well. Serve at once.

title: Quick & Easy Calzone (Danish)
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon jam ( any kind ) | 2 ounces pumpkin seeds
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Take the seeds out of the pods, and place on a cookie sheet. When the oven stops it's hot enough for you to see puffed tops of the seeds yet, pop them out onto a paper towel covered cookie sheet. Spread them out on the cookie sheet with the back of a spoon. Place a fork or a knife in the top of the seeds. Bake for 10 minutes, then remove from the oven and quickly spoon the jam on the seeds. Let stand for 10 minutes, then sprinkle with freshly ground pepper and chopped chives. Serve with pita bread for a breakfast or snack.

Random Ingredients: rosemary,plain flour,ginger garlic paste,seasoning salt,romaine lettuce heart,cornstarch,peanut,corn
title: Nam Sod Toss (Vegetarian-Food Network Crunchy)
ingredients: 150 g corn | 100 g plain flour | seasoning salt, to taste | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 6 leaves fresh rosemary | 1 romaine lettuce hearts, to serve | 1/2 cup roasted peanuts, crushed ( optional, to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon cornstarch, mixed with 1 tbsp water, for dusting
instructions: Wash and cut the corn into thin slices. Heat up a wok over medium heat. When hot, add half a tablespoon of the oil. Toss the corn slices with the flour to coat. Cook as directed on the packet, then set aside. Repeat with the rest of the oil. When the corn is hot, mix in the ginger garlic paste. Cook for a few seconds, then toss in the remaining coriander, spring onions and drained peanuts. Toss over a low heat, until well mixed. Serve with warm romaine and crispy coriander leaves. Variation, use chickpeas or red beans instead of the corn and peanuts if using plain flour and seasonings.

title: Lebanese Tomato Salad
ingredients: 2 large ripe tomatoes, each cut into 8 wedges | 3 -4 tablespoons prepared pesto sauce, from a jar of garden garden fresh frozen garden garden fresh peperoncinis | 3/4 cup low-fat greek yogurt ( plain or lite ) | 1 fresh chili pepper, seeded and sliced thinly
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Place tomato halves, cut side down, on baking tray, and bake for 8 - 10 minutes or until just beginning to caramelise. Place remaining ingredients in bowl and stir until combined. Arrange tomato halves over the top. Serve warm or cold.

title: Homemade Cheese (Paneer)
ingredients: 1 quart whole milk | 1 pint half-and-half | 2 cups grated romano cheese
instructions: In a large heavy bottomed saucepan, bring milk, half & half and romano cheese to a boil over medium high heat. Remove from heat and stir vigorously until cheese has completely melted. Let cheese mixture cool to room temperature, but do not boil. Place cheese mixture in refrigerator to set up, preferably, for 3 - 4 days.

Random Ingredients: rigatoni pasta,flat leaf parsley,graham cracker crumb,cardamom,spaghetti sauce,lemon peel,bamboo shoot
title: Rigatoni with Shredded Zucchini and Bell Peppers
ingredients: 4 cups coarsely chopped, cored zucchini | 1 jar spaghetti sauce, divided, or as needed | 1 jar bamboo shoots, drained and sliced | 1 teaspoon freshly grated lemon peel | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom | 2 1/2 tablespoons graham cracker crumbs | 1/4 cup chopped flat leaf parsley
instructions: Combine 1/4 cup spaghetti sauce with lemon peel and cardamom in a medium saucepan over low heat.

title: Pear Puree
ingredients: 1 pound pears, peeled and sliced | 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic salt
instructions: Place pears into a saucepan, and sprinkle with garlic salt. Cook over medium heat until tender. Cool completely, and transfer to a blender or food processor. Process until smooth, or to desired consistency.

Random Ingredients: tortilla chip,onion,yellow onion,vinaigrette dressing,shallot,american cheese,ghee,sesame seed
title: Mexican Grilled Cheese Dip II
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 2 tablespoons ghee | 3 cups thinly sliced yellow onions | 3/4 cup chopped shallot | 1/2 cup crumbled tortilla chips | 1 tablespoon vinaigrette dressing | 8 thick slices processed american cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Coat a large cookie sheet with cooking spray. Spread sesame seeds onto cookie sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until lightly toasted, about 5 minutes. Place sesame seeds in a bowl with plain water to cover, and allow to cool. Mix together in a small bowl, sesame seeds, ghee, onions, shallots, bread crumbs, and vinaigrette dressing. Spoon mixture into a bowl with cheese and place on a cookie sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until cheese is melted, 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Squash With Yogurt
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs squash | 16 ounces greek yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon cajun seasoning | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 1 sprig fresh rosemary
instructions: Peel the squash. Cut it into 2 inch pieces about the size of a quarter. Place it in a saucepan of hot water and boil for 15 minutes or until the skin begins to wrinkle. Remove from the water and let it rest for 5 minutes. Remove the squash pieces with a slotted spoon and transfer to a serving bowl. Reserve the cooking water. Place the yoghurt in a large bowl and add the 1/4 teaspoon cajun seasoning. Mix well. Bring the saucepan of cooking water to a boil. Arrange the asafetida into a circle out of the squash and pour about 1 1/3 cups of the cooking liquid over them. Place the yoghurt in a serving bowl. Add the squash pieces to the yoghurt and toss to coat them with the juice. Sprinkle with rosemary. Serve hot.

title: Shrimp Salad (Camarao Salada Di Tonno)
ingredients: 1 lb baby shrimp ( cooked, peeled, and tails left on ) | 1 cup mayonnaise | 1 cup malt vinegar
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Cover and refrigerate 3 - 8 hours.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,phyllo pastry,banana,tortilla chip,chili pepper flake,puff pastry,green salsa
title: Vegetarian Banana-Spicy Sausage Rolls
ingredients: 1 packet phyllo pastry | 500 g puff pastry | 3 green salsa or 3 chipotle chili pepper flakes | 1/2 cup plain flour | 1/2 cup crushed tortilla chips | 2 bananas, sliced | 2 teaspoons vegetarian chili pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°c line a baking sheet with cooking paper. Roll out one packet of pastry so you have a 12 x 2 rectangle. Spread with a thin layer of salsa. Evenly scatter over the green salsa/chipoltes which you have used to sprinkle over the top of the sausage. Cut a 1cm slice from each long side of the pastry sheet towards the centre of each strip to form your border. Repeat with the other packet of pastry. Roll the sausage up in the pastry strips so they are completely covered. Place onto the baking sheets in a single layer, leaving a 5cm space between each roll. Tuck the pastry strips lengthways and prick with a fork to make a hole in the centre. Repeat with the other packet of pastry. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes, and allow to rest for 5 - 10 minutes before using. If desired, spoon the banana salsa/chili flake onto the surface of the rolls. If desired, slice the bananas as thinly as possible. Drizzle with some remaining salsa. Serve warm accompanied by sour cream and plain boiled rice.

title: Quick and Easy Chili Brown Rice Mix
ingredients: 6 ounces brown rice | 3 -4 tablespoons red chili peppers, chopped
instructions: Cook rice according to pack instructions. Once cooked, remove from heat and stir in all other ingredients. Serve immediately. Use in recipes calling for 'chili hot pepper'.

title: Dressed Nips With Walnuts and  Avocado Cream
ingredients: 6 medium nips | 3 tablespoons gram flour | 2 tablespoons chopped walnuts | 2 tablespoons walnut pieces | 1 serrano chili, seeded, peeled and chopped ( or any other chilli ) | 1 tablespoon sweet chili paste | 2 slices avocados | salad topping, as required | parsnip, as required
instructions: Peel the nips from their skins using your fingers. Cut away just the stem from the nips leaving the peel in tact. Slice them in half length ways, removing the ends which give the nips more rounded shape. Place all the peel in a bowl and mix with gram flour, walnuts, chilie and sweet chilli paste. Make the avocado cream. For best results allow a few dollops of prepared avocado cream to be served. In a frying pan put some oil and when hot add the nip slices. Fry till golden on both sides and cooked through. Serve the nip with salad, chopped parsnip or cucumber.

title: Napa Dave's Kimchi
ingredients: 6 daikon radishes ( shoga ), diced | 6 hard-boiled eggs, diced
instructions: Slice the daikon in half diagonally. Place the slices into a bowl. Add diced egg and salt and mash with a fork over medium heat until egg is just beginning to thicken. Toss the fried rice with the daikon mixture and serve warm. Recipe variation, the idea is to place a slice of egg in a mound of gogi and slice through the skin, making it look like an egg shape.

Random Ingredients: cream cottage cheese,green onion,seasoning salt,chili powder,corn tortilla chip,pecan
title: Baked Beef (Or Chicken) Fajitas
ingredients: 1 package corn tortilla chips | 1 package reduced fat cream-style cottage cheese | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 1/2 cup finely chopped green onion | 1/2 cup chopped pecans
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Spread broken chips out on baking sheet. Bake until crisp and lightly browned. In bowl combine cottage cheese, seasoned salt, chili powder, green onion and 1/2 cup pecans. Spread cheese mixture evenly over chips and top with remaining 1/2 cup pecans. Bake in 400f. Oven for 10 minutes or until hot.

title: Jamaican Coconut Candy
ingredients: 3 cups sweetened dried shredded coconut | 4 tablespoons fresh orange juice, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Roll about 1 cup of the coconut into a ball, then press around the inside of a 9x13 inch glass baking dish. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of the orange juice. Repeat with remaining coconut. Bake until golden brown, about 15 minutes.

title: Coconut Calamari
ingredients: 1 pound calamari, cut into 1-inch rings | 1 cup unsweetened shredded coconut | 1/2 teaspoon freshly grated orange zest | 1/4 cup sweetened condensed milk | 1/2 cup molasses
instructions: Spray a large skillet with cooking spray. Place over medium high heat. Cook kabobs in the hot skillet until no longer opaque in the center, 3 to 5 minutes per side. Remove from heat. Mix in coconut, orange zest, sweetened condensed milk, and molasses. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: artichoke heart,tomato basil garlic oregano,pine nut,black mustard seed,pineapple chunk,sea salt,oyster sauce,thyme
title: Grilled Ham and Pine Nut Platter
ingredients: 12 artichoke hearts | 1 can pineapple chunks in tomato basil garlic oregano | 1 can artichoke hearts | 2 tablespoons pine nuts, roasted lightly | 1/2 cup chopped fresh thyme | 3/4 cup pine | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 1 tablespoon black mustard seeds ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce
instructions: If necessary, remove the artichoke hearts from the can to prevent sticking. Cut the hearts in half and remove the center part of the hearts leaving the remaining pieces intact for another use. Discard the remaining hearts. Trim the artichoke heart and the can of artichoke hearts if using the artichokes. Set all of the remaining ingredients aside for sauce. Heat grill to medium high heat. Place artichoke hearts on grill and cook about 2 minutes per side, until golden brown and heated through. To serve, cut artichoke hearts from hearts and place on a serving plate. Spoon the pineapple and artichoke hearts over the artichoke hearts.

title: Clams Parmesan
ingredients: 24 medium clams, scrubbed | 1 lb mozzarella cheese | 1 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated | 2 cups mixed bell peppers ( such as red bell pepper or green bell pepper )
instructions: Heat a heavy skillet over medium heat which will cause the clams to swell during cooking. If using a larger depth of clams, soak them in hot water for five minutes per side. Arrange the clams in a single layer on the hot skillet. Sprinkle the cheese over the clams. Bake, turning once, until the cheese is melted and the clams have opened. Remove from the heat and place the clams in a large mixing bowl. Drizzle the pan with a little olive oil and toss to coat. Sprinkle the top of the shells with the chopped sauteed green bell peppers and serve.

title: Spicy Polish Kielbasa
ingredients: 1/2 can or bottle polish beer | 1 pound kielbasa, sliced | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 4 slices swiss cheese | 1 jalapeno pepper | 1 french baguettes, cut in half, lengthwise, and toasted
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Place the beer and kielbasa slices in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Sprinkle garlic powder on the sausage and add to the beer. Stir to coat everything evenly. Bake for 30 minutes in the preheated oven. Top with the swiss cheese slices. Bake for an additional 5 minutes, or until the cheese is melted.

Random Ingredients: bread machine yeast,herb,honey,corn flake,salmon,onion soup mix
title: Salmon Cornbread II
ingredients: 2 cups corn flakes, crushed fine | 1/4 cup honey | 1 tablespoon minced onion soup mix | 1 1/2 teaspoons bread machine yeast | 2 1/2 tablespoons dried herbs | 1 teaspoon salmon or 1 teaspoon salmon paste, mixed with | 1 tablespoon water
instructions: Dissolve soup mix in 1/4 cup broth or enough to mix well without diluting. Stir in corn flakes. Add yeast and herbs and mix well. Beat in fish, mix well. Dump into an oiled 8 x 8 or 9 x 9 pan and spread with butter. Let rise in a warm place until doubled. Bake in moderately hot oven, 350 degrees f, about 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until golden brown and crisp.

title: Barley Pilaf
ingredients: 1 lb pearl barley | 4 teaspoons turmeric powder | 1 fennel or 1 star anise, peeled and crushed
instructions: Bring 5 cups of water to the boil. Add barley and turmeric powder. Stir, partially cover and simmer on low heat for 1/2 hour or until most of the water is absorbed. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: pomegranate,self raising flour,wheat tortilla,black pepper,grain rice
title: Wheat Tortillas
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups self-raising flour | 3/4 cup uncooked long grain rice | 1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper | 1/2 cup pomegranate, frozen and seeds removed | 4 whole wheat tortillas
instructions: Mix flour and rice. Mix pepper and pomegranate seeds in small bowl. Dip each tortilla into flour, shaking off excess. Put one sixth of the pomegranate mixture on centre of tortilla and fold in half. Wet edge of tortilla with cold water and press to seal. Lightly brush a pan with oil and add the tortillas. Fry 2 to 3 at a time for 10 to 15 minutes over medium heat until golden brown, turning once. Serve hot with fresh salsa.

title: Tikka Apple �ureen (Pork Balls With Apples)
ingredients: 600 g plain flour | 200 ml greek yogurt | 200 g sliced peeled apples | 200 g sliced bamboo shoots
instructions: Sift flour and mix well, knead lightly. Roll out into a circle shape and use a spoon to make small indentations in it and fill each indentation with 1 tsp greek yogurt then insert the apple slices. Seal them with water and let rest for 20 minutes. Bake on the grill till lightly browned on the top. Serve on a plate decorated with parsley.

title: Devil's Shrimps
ingredients: 16 fluid ounces clam juice | 1 can tomato juice ( cocktail or stew )
instructions: Shake clam juice& tomato juice in a large cocktail shaker half filled with ice. Strain through a nylon sieve into a clean glass bowl. Ladle in the clam juice, stir and serve.

title: Okra and Peas With Sweet Dill
ingredients: 1 lb okra, cut into 1-inch slices ( or 1 lb frozen okra ) | 1 green bell pepper, cut into thin strips | 1 cup frozen peas | 1 cup frozen okra | 1/2 cup frozen peas | dill sprigs ( for garnish ) | salsa ( for garnish ) | dill sprigs ( for garnish )
instructions: In a large skillet, saute okra in oil until just crisp tender. Remove from skillet and set aside. Add bell pepper. Saute for 3 minutes, and then add okra, peas, okra and peas. Cook 5 minutes or until veggies are heated through. Taste and add salt and pepper if needed. Serve over rice or noodles with lots of dill sprigs. Garnish with dill.

title: Easy Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 1 cup rice ( short grain, medium or long grain ) | 2 ounces shiitake mushrooms, chopped | 1/4 cup sweet pepper, diced | 2 scallions, sliced | 2 ounces canned pineapple in juice ( juice packed ) | 2 -4 tablespoons liquid smoke | 1/4 teaspoon fresh ground pepper, to taste
instructions: Cook rice in a skillet with 1/3 cup water over low heat, stirring occasionally until tender but firm. Drain, reserve cooking liquid. To rice, add mushrooms, peppers, scallions, pineapple juice, liquid smoke & remaining 1/4 cup water, stirring well. Remove rice from heat, stir in pepper.

title: Oma's Heirloom Tomato and Heirloom Tomato Kebabs
ingredients: 4 -5 medium heirloom tomatoes or 4 -5 medium tomatoes, sliced very thin | 2 -3 tablespoons cooking sherry | 2 packages active dry yeast | 1 ounce ground mace ( i like mace better. ) | 4 -8 large eggs | 1 package mahi mahi fillets, very thinly sliced and cut into 1 in. cubes ( one pound. ) or ( 3 lb ) package all-beef steaks, cut the same size ( one pound. ) | 1/2 large radish ( halved ) or 1/2 large bibb, if using fresh, halved and very thin, if using frozen, if using frozen, if using fresh ( one pound. )
instructions: To make your kebabs, preheat oven to 500 degrees. In a large bowl mix together tomatoes, cooking sherry, yeast, mace and eggs. In a separate medium bowl, or a large measuring cup, mix the mahi mahi cubes with the sliced bibb or radishes/bamboo. Make sure they're all covered in liquid. On a baking sheet spread out tomato/egg mixture. Add kebabs or bruschetta mixture on top of tomatoes. Place in oven and cook about 15 minutes or until bubbly and starting to darken slightly. I let the baking sheet rest about 5 minutes and then check to make sure its done. It should take a few more minutes depending on how thick your tomato slices are. Serve warm with a side of yogurt or other dip of your choice.

Random Ingredients: olive oil cooking spray,mint leaf,sirloin steak,iceberg lettuce,dark soy sauce,soy sauce,wheat bran
title: Beef Burger Bites
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin steak | 1/4 cup wheat bran | 1/4 cup soy sauce | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce | 1/4 cup olive oil flavored cooking spray | 8 large green leaf lettuce leaves | 4 fresh mint leaves
instructions: Trim fat from steak. In a medium bowl, combine wheat bran and soy sauces. Mix thoroughly. Put steak on a cutting board and cut into 10 strips. Place one strip on a work surface. Place 1 leaf of lettuce on the center of the steak, then 3 mint leaves on the meat and roll up. Secure roll with butcher's twine. Transfer to a grill basket or on a plate. Repeat process with rest of steak and lettuce. Place beef rolls between 2 skewers and lightly coat with cooking spray. Grill until heated through and cooked through, 8 to 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: breadcrumb,corn chip,chicken stock,tequila,walnut oil,ancho chile powder
title: Tequila-Walnut Oil Smoked Chicken and Chips
ingredients: 3 cups chicken stock | 1/2 cup tequila | 1/2 cup walnut oil | 1 teaspoon ground ancho chile powder ( more or less as desired ) | 1 teaspoon breadcrumbs, fine, fine | corn chips, crushed
instructions: In a medium sauce pan combine stock and tequila. Bring to a boil over high heat. Remove from heat and stir in walnut oil, ancho chile powder and bread crumbs. Mix well. Spoon sauce into shallow baking dish. Preheat broiler. Dip chicken in marinade.

title: Zucchini Chips
ingredients: 1 zucchini | 1/2 cup chopped pecans
instructions: Peel zucchini. Cut into 1/2 x3 strips. Place zucchini in a single layer on a well buttered baking sheet. Bake at 375° for 10 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Shrimp or Beef Burgers
ingredients: 1 hamburger | 1 - 1 1/4 lb cooked shrimp ( or 1/4 pound cooked ham ) | 1 - 1 1/2 cup quick-cooking onions
instructions: Grill or broil meat to preference. Shrimp or meat should be cooked when done. Toast to taste i prefer to let cool while i prepare other ingredients to add to hamburgers.

title: Lebanese Mock Crab Barley Pancakes
ingredients: 6 egg yolks | 1 cup molasses | 3 1/2 cups pearl barley | 1/2 cup unsalted dry roasted peanuts | 3/4 cup chopped roasted unsalted dry-roasted peanuts
instructions: Preheat a nonstick frying pan over medium high heat. Combine the egg yolks and molasses in a bowl and whisk until blended. Bring 3 cups water to a boil in a saucepan over medium high heat. Remove from the heat. Add the barley to the broth and cook, stirring constantly until all the liquid has been absorbed. Transfer the barley to a shallow plate. Add half of the peanuts to the peanuts in the bowl, and toss until thoroughly coated with the molasses mixture. Fold in the remaining peanuts, mix well. Scrape the bottom of the pan with a spoon into a bowl. Add 1 teaspoon of batter and tilt it until just barely wet from the edge. Cook for about 8 minutes, or until the top is dry and the underside slightly golden. Repeat with another 1 1/2 cups of barley. Top with the remaining pancake, spread it with the peanut butter and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: white bean,granny smith apple,onion powder,coriander leaf,italian herb,red jalapeno chile,large shrimp,italian tomato
title: Mexican Shrimp Appetizer (Camarones Rellenos a La Gringa)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs large shrimp | 1 large onion, chopped medium | 6 tablespoons fresh coriander leaves, chopped | 1 small hot red jalapeno chile | 2 cans white refried beans, spicy ( we use bush's ) | 1 can italian-style tomatoes | 1 teaspoon mixed italian herbs | 2 teaspoons white pepper ( optional )
instructions: Peel shrimp, remove tails if desired. Cut in half lengthwise.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,pork chop,chicken,white sugar,bread,green pepper,lemon juice zest,cod
title: Cod Fish Soup and Chicken Stew
ingredients: 4 boneless pork chops, cut in chunks | 2 cans vegetable stock | 2 cans white sugar | 1/2 lemon, juice and zest of | 8 slices bread, 1 `` thick | 8 ounces cod, cut in chunks | 3 green peppers, cut in 1 in pieces | 14 ounces chicken, in chunks or 3/4 pound cooked chicken
instructions: Combine the pork, vegetable and sugar in a large pot. Bring to a boil and simmer for 25 minutes, adding the lemon juice, lemon zest, bread, cod and green pepper. Simmer for another 5 minutes or until the cod is cooked.

Random Ingredients: italian herb,cold water,pecorino romano cheese,feta cheese,iceberg lettuce,banana liqueur,chinese mushroom
title: Faux Fresh Vegetable Slushes
ingredients: 1 lb baby lettuce, washed, dried and dried | 8 medium chinese mushrooms, stems discarded, caps thinly sliced | 8 ounces crumbled feta cheese | 1 ounce fresh pecorino romano cheese, finely grated ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 1/2 cup chilled water | 1/2 - 3/4 cup banana liqueur | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon mixed italian herbs
instructions: Tear or tear the cleaned lettuce into bite sized pieces, preferably with the broad leafy greens. Rinse mushrooms and dry well. Place in bowl of ice water to keep them from drying up. After 1/2 hour, drain the water from the mushrooms and remove the caps with a slotted spoon or fork. Rinse and dry the mushrooms lightly with paper towels. Set aside. Drain the liquid from the mushrooms by placing them in a small nonreactive bowl and pouring a few inches of very hot water over them, turning to get rid of any sand and sand. When all the water has been used, add mushrooms and let them marinate uncovered for 1 hour. Combine all the ingredients in a large bowl and season to taste with salt, if desired. Place the lettuce in a serving bowl, top with the cheese mixture, then the mushroom mixture and serve.

Random Ingredients: baking potato,lime juice zest,phyllo pastry,ham,cajun seasoning,linguine,flat rice noodle,red chilies
title: Linguine With Ham and Salsa Verde
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cooked ham, diced | 3 tablespoons lime juice, fresh | 1/2 lb phyllo pastry, frozen double-rolled, thawed ( from a 17-oz package ) | 1/2 lb linguine, frozen double-rolled | 1/2 lb phyllo pastry, frozen double-rolled, thawed ( from a 17-oz package ) | 4 thawed cooked ham, diced | 2 cans chopped red chilies | 1 1/2 tablespoons cajun seasoning | 4 limes, zest of, minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 375ºf. Combine ham, lime juice, and minced ham in a large bowl. Reserve 3 tablespoons lime juice. Place phyllo on a flat surface. Place another sheet of phyllo on top of the layered phyllo. Using a 7x6x2 glass baking dish, press down with your fingers so that it is about 12x16 inches. Spread the phyllo with a thin layer of ham. Arrange the 3rd sheet over the ham, trimming it into strips of 6 inches wide and 2 inches long. Repeat with the remaining sheets and ham, placing a layer of ham in the middle of the phyllo. Add the diced linguine to the phyllo and top with the 1/2 cup ham. Place 3rd sheet on top, trimming it into strips of 6 inches wide and 2 inches long. Use more phyllo if necessary. Cover the pasta with the remaining 3 strips of ham and 1/2 cup of guajillo verde. Using 3 strips of ham and guajillo verde, place the 3rd sheet on top. Working toward the edges of the phyllo, lightly spray the top edge of phyllo with oil and lightly spray with oil. Cut a 1 x 1 inch slice from the top of the phyllo sheets. Add the cut dough to the phyllo. Make all the phyllo strips this way, separating the strips from one another so they measure exactly 6 x 4 inches on each sheet. Cut the phyllo dough into 3 strips crosswise, making a total of 6 squares. Working from the bottom, spray the phyllo dough with oil. Spread 1 tablespoon of lime zest onto the phyllo dough. Spread 1 tablespoon of cajun seasoning on top of this. Place a second phyllo sheet under the phyllo, and add 1 more tablespoon of lime zest. Continue this process until all the phyllo is layered and arranged in the dish, being careful not to tear it. Top with 1/3 of the verde verde. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of cajun pepper. Add the ham and 1/4 cup of the lime juice. Scatter 1/4 cup of the verde verde on top. If you have any of the remaining ingredients to go, place in a pie pan of your choice. Cover with aluminum foil and bake for 45 minutes. Take out of oven, remove foil and top with the remaining verde verde. Increase temperature to 375ºf. Cook another 25 minutes, until golden brown. Let stand for 10 minutes before slicing. Serve warm. Note on ingredient, i have found that these measurements can sometimes overfill the dish, so that the filling does not fall out. If i can't find the 3rd sheet of phyllo pastry, i can do 3 sheets of phyllo dough and freeze one of them. Then, if i get this step, i just add a 5x5 inch rectangle of unthawed phyllo in the same order i can find a 5x5 inch rectangle

Random Ingredients: green food coloring,pepper,rosemary leaf,thyme leaf,hoisin sauce,green pepper,lemon zest
title: Savory Chinese Hoisin Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 12 ounces fresh green sweet pepper | 2 ounces fresh sweet pepper | 1/4 cup hoisin sauce | 1 tablespoon finely grated lemon zest | 2 teaspoons grated fresh lemon zest | 1 sprig fresh thyme leaves | 1 teaspoon finely chopped fresh rosemary leaf | 1 -2 drop green food coloring
instructions: Place the peppers on a piece of foil.

Random Ingredients: cooking wine,vanilla pudding mix,icing sugar,red chilies
title: Cherry Ice-Cream
ingredients: 300 g vanilla instant pudding mix | 100 g cooking wine | 200 g icing sugar | 4 tablespoons ground red chilies
instructions: Place the pudding mix in the bowl of a stand mixer with the chopping blade on high speed. Sift the icing sugar and chilli. With the mixer on low speed, add the chillies and continue to mix. Add the dry pudding mix and mix for 2 minutes until the dough has the consistency of light pudding. Remove the mixture from the bowl onto a lightly floured surface. Use a teaspoon to scrape the dough onto a lightly floured board. Roll or pat the dough until it is about 5 centimeters thick. Using scissors, cut the dough to make the desired size and shape. Place the cookies on a lightly greased baking sheet and freeze in an ice cream freezer bag until firm. Remove, and place the bag in the freezer. Once the cookies are firm, transfer with a metal spatula to a baking sheet. Let stand for 10 minutes. In a cup, mix the icing sugar and red chillies. Once the icing is completely solid and smooth, pour over the tops of the chilled cookies.

Random Ingredients: topping,cherry tomato,chicken meat,tart apple,arborio rice,teriyaki sauce,cantaloupe,beef stew meat
title: Cherry Roasted Cantaloupe and Chicken With Rice
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked arborio rice | 2 1/4 cups frozen fully cooked chicken meat | 1 can reduced-sodium teriyaki sauce ( or your favorite brand ) | 1 cup cubed fully cooked beef stew meat ( or lamb ) | 1 package frozen pitted tart apples ( 1 1/2 cups ) or 1 package applesauce ( 1 1/2 cups ) | 1 packet frozen whipped topping, thawed ( about 8 1/2 oz ) | 2 cups halved cantaloupe or 2 cups other winter melon | 12 cherry tomatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 250°f. Cover a 13x9 inch or larger baking dish with foil.

title: Cranberry-Hazelnut Jam
ingredients: 250 g cranberries | 3 tablespoons hazelnuts, finely chopped
instructions: Place cranberries and hazelnuts in a small saucepan over medium heat and cook, stirring, until hazelnuts just begin to turn golden. Transfer to a bowl and allow to cool to room temperature. Break into pieces and store in an airtight container.

title: Spicy Tamarind Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup tamarind juice | 1/2 cup worcestershire sauce
instructions: Mix tamarind juice, worcestershire sauce and hot tamarind pods together in a jar with a lid. Cover tightly and shake to combine.

title: Cashew Crunch
ingredients: 1 cup unsalted cashews | 1/8 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/8 teaspoon salt | 2 tablespoons mixed italian herbs
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Combine cashews, cream of tartar and salt in a food processor. Process until finely ground. Pat mixture into a sheet of well greased foil and transfer the nuts onto a cookie sheet. Spread them all over the nuts so they resemble large chunky nuts. Sprinkle with mixed herbs and press on the nuts gently with your hands to make sure they've been pressed into the nuts. Broil the nuts for 1 - 2 minutes, until lightly golden. Allow the nuts to cool, but stay crisp. Store them in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: green curry paste,marmite,anchovy paste,vegetable,tortilla,chunky peanut butter,white kidney bean
title: Savoury Sausage Salad
ingredients: 2 links sausage, casings removed | 2 cans white kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can mixed vegetables | 4 ounces chunky peanut butter | 1 tablespoon marmite | 1 teaspoon anchovy paste | 6 tablespoons tortillas
instructions: Place the first 5 ingredients in a large bowl. Combine sauce ingredients. Pour over the sausage mixture. Chill in the fridge for 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: chili bean,milk chocolate,gingerroot,rye bread,vegetarian oyster sauce
title: Rye Bread Pudding
ingredients: 4 slices rye bread, crusts removed | 2 tablespoons milk chocolate | 1 pinch gingerroot, finely chopped | 1 vegetarian oyster sauce | 1 can chili beans
instructions: Preheat the broiler to high. Brush a baking sheet with oil. Put the bread slices on a foil lined baking sheet and broil them for 2 minutes, turning them over. Remove the bread from the oven and spread a thin layer of chocolate over the buttered toast. Sprinkle the ginger and micro agin over the toast and return it to the oven for 8 minutes. Remove the tray from the oven and scatter the oyster sauce over the toast and return it to the broiler for 2 to 3 minutes longer or until the chocolate melts. Allow the toast to cool to room temperature. Cut into wedges and serve at room temperature or chilled.

Random Ingredients: green bean,linguine,chicken thigh,sharp cheddar cheese,garbanzo bean,cornstarch,steak
title: Chicken and Pasta Salad With Chickpeas
ingredients: 1 lb boneless chicken thighs | 2 teaspoons cornstarch | 1/2 package linguine | 16 ounces garbanzo beans | 2 cans chicken thigh | 8 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, slices | 1 ounce green beans ( fresh or frozen-optional )
instructions: Cut chicken up into bite size chunks then toss with 1/2 tsp of both corn starch and 1/3 c water. Heat oven to 325ºf. Drain garbanzo beans, then rinse and set aside. Slice green beans diagonally in half. In 9x12 x 2 inch baking dish, layer half of the pasta, half of the beans and 1/3 of chicken. Then sprinkle remaining pasta and beans over that. Sprinkle top with cheese and remaining chicken. Cover with aluminum foil and bake until bubbly, about 45 min to 1 hour. If using frozen peas and green beans, thaw and drain. Serve warm. If using frozen cut up green beans, thaw and drain. If using freshly cut up chicken thighs, let stand a few minutes before using.

title: Penne With Confectioners' Sugar
ingredients: 16 ounces penne | 1/4 cup confectioners'sugar, or as needed
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the penne, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 11 minutes.

title: Hot and Spicy Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 3 tablespoons hot red curry paste ( or more, if desired ) | 1/2 teaspoon minced fresh lime rind | 3 tablespoons lime juice or 3 tablespoons white vinegar
instructions: Mix curry paste and lime rind in small bowl. Toss with salad greens. Salad dressing may also be substituted for the red curry paste. Chili oil can also be substituted for the lime juice.

Random Ingredients: maple syrup,red wine,wheat bread,mustard seed,farfalle pasta,escarole
title: Quick and Easy Scaloppine
ingredients: 1 lb uncooked farfalle pasta or 1 lb penne pasta | 2 cups escarole, cut into bite-size pieces ( about 2 c. ) | 2/3 cup maple syrup | 1/3 cup red wine | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 2 teaspoons maple syrup, if desired
instructions: Cook pasta in large pot of boiling salted water until al dente.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,cilantro,grand marnier,sausage,ginger,thai peanut sauce,streaky bacon,mirin
title: Hibachi Ribeye
ingredients: 3 slices streaky bacon, chopped | 2 links pork sausages, roughly chopped | 1 1/2 cups pineapple juice | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 1/2 cup sweetened rice vermicelli ( rice noodles ) | 1/2 cup mirin | 1/2 teaspoon chopped fresh ginger | 1/2 cup thai peanut sauce | 1/4 cup minced fresh cilantro
instructions: Heat a large frying pan over medium high heat. Add the bacon and sausages.

title: Real Queso Dip -- Mexican Style
ingredients: 1 lb asadero cheese or 1 lb mexican style cheese | 1 whole dried red chile, seeds and ribs removed
instructions: Remove all of the hard outer rind from the chile with a small sharp knife. Cut the chile with a sharp knife into a long strip and place in a bowl. Grate the asadero cheese into a blender and add the chile strips, dried red chile seeds and a little water to obtain a semi smooth mix. Mash with a fork or potato masher into a smooth paste and set aside. Note, you can store the dip in the refrigerator in small, resealable containers for up to 3 months.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,soda water,lemon wedge,chicken stock powder,rice vinegar,milk,coriander seed,vanilla syrup
title: Rice Vinegar Coriander Soup
ingredients: 2 tablespoons coriander seeds | 1 quart chicken stock powder | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 teaspoon hot chili oil | 1 quart milk | 1/2 cup soda water | 1 teaspoon real vanilla syrup or 1 teaspoon molasses | lemon wedge
instructions: Combine the coriander seeds and stock powder in a mortar and pestle. Add vinegar and hot oil. Process for 45 seconds, or until fine crumbs form. Return to pan, and add milk, soda water and vanilla. Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly. Add coriander.

title: Portuguese Pizza Dough
ingredients: 1/2 cup picante sauce | 1 (.25 ounce ) envelope active dry yeast
instructions: Combine the picante sauce and yeast in a mixing bowl. Stir to dissolve the yeast, then pour into a resealable plastic bag set in a gallon size zipper bag. Seal the bag, then turn the dough out onto the counter and knead for 15 to 20 minutes, or until dough is smooth and elastic. Shape the dough into a round, 6 to 8 inch round. Transfer the dough to an oiled bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and let it rise in a warm draft free place for 1 hour, or until doubled in bulk. Punch dough down, then divide into eight equal pieces. Roll each piece into a ball, place into a lightly greased bowl, and cover with a cloth. Allow the dough to rise until doubled, about 1 hour. Divide the balls into six equal portions. Roll each ball into a 12 inch circle on a lightly floured work surface and place a circle onto the work surface. Spread the olive paste evenly over each pizza, then cover. Allow the pizza dough to rise until doubled in bulk, about 45 minutes. Preheat the oven to 500 degrees f. Remove 1 dough ball from the bowl onto a lightly floured work surface, place 1 pizza on the lightly floured work surface, then spread with 1/2 the olive paste. Repeat with the second dough ball. Place the pizza into the preheated oven, and bake for 5 minutes. Use the spatula or knife to pierce the top of the rolled up dough.

Random Ingredients: grape tomato,black olive,pasta,beef sirloin,lemon zest,black sesame seed
title: Greek Steak Salad
ingredients: 12 ounces thin pasta, shaped into four equal portions ( i used ziti ) | 1/4 cup black sesame seed, freshly roasted, hulled, and crushed with the back of a spoon | 1 lb boneless beef top sirloin, thinly sliced and cut into 4 thin slices ( or 1 lb. beef tenderloin ) | grape tomatoes, for garnish | fresh black olives, for garnish | lemon zest, for garnish
instructions: Cook pasta according to instructions on the package, reserving 1 cup of the water. When pasta is al dente, drain and set aside. In a large bowl, combine pasta with remaining ingredients and toss lightly to mix, adding more reserved pasta water as desired.

title: Easy Greek Kalamata Olive Fondue
ingredients: 1/2 pound kalamata olives - pitted and coarsely chopped | 1 1/2 cups buttermilk, warmed
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the pitted olives and buttermilk. Season to taste with salt. Serve in small bowls with a sprinkling of dried oregano.

Random Ingredients: red kidney bean,italian breadcrumb,bosc pear,chicken breast fillet,green bell pepper,camembert cheese,fine sea salt
title: Italian Breadcrumbed Chicken
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast fillets, cut into 1 1/2 cm chunks | 1 pinch fine sea salt | 1 cup italian style breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1/4 cup green bell pepper, chopped | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped ripe camembert cheese | 1 bosc pears, halved cored and finely shredded
instructions: Put bread crumbs in a shallow dish. Dredge chicken in crumbs, shaking off excess. Toss in beans, bell pepper and cheese, reserving any remaining crumbs. Place pears, cut side down, on a baking tray. Place under a hot griller for 2 to 3 minutes or till slightly golden. Turn chicken, sprinkle with crumbs and serve with bread crumbs, if desired.

Random Ingredients: english cucumber,kaffir lime leaf,italian bread,golden syrup
title: Spicy Slice
ingredients: 1 english cucumber, halved lengthways, deseeded, cut into chunks | 2 kaffir lime leaves, shredded | 8 slices italian bread, crusts removed, cut into chunks | 1 tablespoon golden syrup
instructions: Turn oven fan down to fan 160c or 140c if fan is 160c / 250f. Place cucumber and lime leaves in an ovenproof dish. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until cucumbers are soft and lightly charred. Remove from oven and pour golden syrup in. Serve slice warm.

title: Quick Beef Fajitas for One
ingredients: 1 lb ground chuck | 1 package sirloin | 1 can diced tomatoes with mild green chilies | 8 ounces diced avocados, chilled
instructions: Combine ground chuck and onion in large skillet. Saute until beef is brown. Turn heat to medium and add tomatoes until softened slightly. Turn heat down and add chilis. Cook and stir gently. Heat through and serve immediately on flour tortillas.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce,palm sugar,tahini,kernel corn,nonfat beef broth
title: Homemade Tahini and Corn Salad
ingredients: 2 heads romaine lettuce, washed and dried | 1 - 1 1/4 cup tahini ( or plain sesame seed paste, to taste ) | 1 1/2 cups nonfat beef broth | 1/4 cup palm sugar | 1 small can whole kernel corn
instructions: Place lettuce, soy sauce, tahini and broth in a blender. Add sugar, process until thick and smooth. Remove from blender and refrigerate until ready to use. This can be kept in the refrigerator for up to 6 weeks. Note, this should be stored in an airtight container.

title: Cajun Seasoning for Fish
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried cajun seasoning, crushed or 1 tablespoon dried ground cayenne pepper | 2 garlic cloves, pressed or minced
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the cajun seasoning, garlic and the cayenne pepper or black pepper. Grind in a spice grinder or mortar and pestle or grind in batches using a mortar and pestle or hand held grinder. Keep refrigerated.

title: Smokey Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup molasses | 1/4 cup coconut milk ( unsweetened ) | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 4 teaspoons liquid smoke
instructions: Combine ingredients in a saucepan and cook over medium heat until heated through, about 10 minutes. Cool for 20 minutes. Stir and store in an airtight container.

title: Crispy Chocolate Rice Wine Ice Cream Float
ingredients: 1 pint chocolate ice cream, crushed | 4 tablespoons rice wine, divided
instructions: Blend 1/2 cup chocolate ice cream, 4 tablespoons rice wine, and 4 tablespoons red wine in a blender until smooth.

title: Sue's Kiwi Burger
ingredients: 100 g hamburger | 2 tablespoons kiwi, finely diced | 1/2 seedless cucumber, very thinly sliced | 1 lemon wedge
instructions: Mix the m&w first. Then spread on bun to make the kiwi burger. Put the cucumber on top, squeeze a wedge of lemon onto the burger, cut into quarters and serve.

title: Zucchini, Bacon and Fruit Salad With Mango chutney
ingredients: 1 medium zucchini ( about 2lb/750 ml ) | 10 slices bacon, cooked and sliced 1/4 inch thick | 1/4 cup mango chutney, from a mango chutney shop | 1/3 cup fruit, your choice of fresh, apricot, pineapple, figs, pears, red grapes, kiwi | 1 tablespoon small capers, drained | 1 tablespoon lemon zest, grated | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Cut the zucchini into 1/2 inch slices across the grain. Cook in a lightly salted pan, in batches if possible until golden, about 2 minutes per side. Drain on absorbent paper. Meanwhile, warm the bacon and cook the sliced fruit in a small non stick skillet over a medium low heat, stirring, until the fruit is warmed through but still sizzly. Remove from heat. Arrange the zucchini slices in a serving platter. Pour the warm fruit, mango chutney, and capers over, and mix well. Sprinkle with lemon zest and turmeric. Serve warm.

title: Low-Fat Whole Wheat Chapati
ingredients: 2 cups whole wheat flour | 1 1/2 cups plain nonfat yogurt | 1 can condensed beef broth
instructions: Preheat your oven to 350 degrees f. Combine the flour, yogurt and beef broth in a medium bowl. Add your dry ingredients and knead to form a dough ball. Roll out on a floured surface. Grease a skillet and heat over medium high heat. When your skillet is hot, cook 1 cup or less of the dough to the edge of your skillet. Slide onto a flat surface. Fold out the thin center to form a half circle. Press to flatten the center into a 7 or 8 inch circle. Place each circle on a greased baking sheet. Flip over when the second side is toasted. Cook until it has browned, or the entire inside of the patties are browned. Turn the patties over and brown the other side. Slice and serve with your favorite plain nonfat sauce.

Random Ingredients: artichoke heart,pimiento,english muffin,lobster meat,corn syrup,pea carrot,beef tenderloin,maple sugar
title: Lobster & Beef Melts With Peas & Caramelized Onions
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin, sliced thinly | 1/2 cup maple sugar or 1/2 cup brown sugar, to taste | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained and quartered | 2 cups frozen peas and carrots | 1 jar pickled artichoke hearts, drained and quartered | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 1 tablespoon corn syrup | 1 jar sliced pimientos, drained | 5 english muffins, split and toasted
instructions: In a shallow dish, combine the pea carrots, artichoke hearts, & maple syrup and marinate the pork for 24 hours. Heat the maple syrup and corn syrup in a small sauce pan. Add the pimentos and cook over very low heat, stirring constantly so that the sauce does not burn. Spread the pimentos equally on the toasted halves of the english muffins. Place the pork slice on the muffins, pour sauce evenly over the top and serve immediately.

title: Pancake in Japanese Wine
ingredients: 1 package chinese rice wine | 1 can italian plum tomatoes
instructions: Combine the rice wine and tomatoes in a medium sized saucepan on high heat. Bring to a rolling boil then reduce to a simmer for 15 minutes. Turn off heat and let stand for 5 minutes. Remove and ladle into plates. Use a slotted spoon to drain off excess liquid.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,chorizo sausage,greek vinaigrette salad dressing,leek,dark rum,ginger,wheat tortilla,orange zest
title: Stacked Oranges With Chorizo and Gruyère Cheese
ingredients: 6 whole wheat tortillas, torn into roughly half inch pieces | 2 ounces swiss chorizo sausage | 1 cup gruyere cheese | 1/2 leeks or 1/2 white mushroom, chopped | 3 oranges, juice and zest of | 1/4 cup dark rum | 1 tablespoon minced fresh ginger | 3 tablespoons greek vinaigrette salad dressing
instructions: Place the tortillas on a plate, or in a small bowl, and place on a cookie sheet. Bake at 350°f/180°c for 10 minutes or until crisp. Allow to cool. Remove from heat. Lightly spray another cookie sheet with nonstick spray. Drain chorizo and crumble into small pieces. In a mixing bowl, combine the chorizo, cheese, leek, chorizo and mushrooms. Toss in the oranges and juice, rum and ginger. Season with black pepper, to taste. Lay the tortilla pieces on the plate with or without the tortilla. Spoon the chorizo mixture onto each tortilla, or roll it up. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: nuoc nam,limeade concentrate,butternut pumpkin,romaine lettuce leaf
title: Pumpkin Slaw
ingredients: 7 ounces frozen butternut pumpkin, thawed, peeled, seeded and cubed | 1/4 lb romaine lettuce leaf | 2 1/2 tablespoons low-sodium nuoc nam | 2 tablespoons frozen limeade concentrate, thawed
instructions: Combine pumpkin, lettuce, nuoc nam and limeade in mixing bowl.

title: Coconut Shooter
ingredients: 1 can coconut milk | 1 can sliced bamboo shoots ( drained )
instructions: Blend all ingredients in a blender and serve.

title: BBQ Ham Hocks
