ingredients: 4 ham hocks | 1 tablespoon sake flour or 1 tablespoon cornflour | fresh red chili pepper
instructions: Dry roast all sides of the ham hocks at medium heat until nicely browned about 5 minutes for medium rare. Transfer the meat to a plate and add the flour to the fat remaining in the hocks. Stir the flour into the fat. Add a good pinch of ground red chili to the flour and fat mixture. Stir the mixture into the fat and bring to the boil until a sticky paste forms and the fat is smoking away, do not allow this to burn. Transfer the pan juices and the chili pieces to a plate and put it under the grill, turning regularly until the meat is lightly browned. Transfer the browned meat to a warm serving platter, serve with your favourite mashed potato or mash with a splash of tomato sauce or sweet cream. Please note that there is enough tomato sauce in the recipe to leave out the possibility of sicking the meat. When i was a meat lover, i tried my own version of this, using a bit of tomato sauce, instead of green chilies.

Random Ingredients: salt,green pepper,blue cheese,kaffir lime leaf,orange section,splenda sugar substitute
title: Blue Cheese Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces blue cheese, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 tablespoons splenda sugar substitute or 2 tablespoons other sugar substitute | 1 green pepper, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon kaffir lime leaf, thinly sliced | 1 -2 teaspoon orange sections, finely chopped ( optional ) | salt
instructions: Put the blue cheese into a microwavable bowl, cover, and microwave on high power for 3 to 4 minutes, or until melted and bubbly then stir in the splenda or other sugar substitute. Add the pepper and lime leaves if using. Stir to combine then season with salt and serve at room temperature.

title: Cafe Vienna Noodles
ingredients: 2/3 cup cellophane noodles | 1/2 - 3/4 cup unsalted peanuts | 1/3 cup chili powder | chili powder or cayenne, to taste ( optional )
instructions: Drain noodles well, place all ingredients in a bowl and mix. The noodles must be of a even thickness and should not be sticky. Add salt or chili powder to taste. If allowed to rest for 15 minutes before serving, it will be quite hot.

title: Tuna and Grape Raita
ingredients: 1 3/4 kg plain flour | 1 liter cold water | 200 g chilled tuna in brine | 3 cups seedless grapes
instructions: Sift the flour into a large bowl and rub in the water until it resembles fine breadcrumbs. Add tuna and mix. Tip out and knead lightly. Divide the dough into 12 equal balls. Turn out on a floured surface and roll out on a flat surface into a rectangle, about 10cm x 20cm. Cut into 6 wedges, placing each wedge at the base of a ramekin. Sprinkle grapes with salt. Repeat with the other portions of dough. Place ramekins on a tray and bake at 200c for 20 minutes or until the ramekins are beginning to brown. Transfer to a cooling rack and leave to set until you are ready to serve it.

title: Apple Currants
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs apples ( i use granny smith apples ) | 3 spring onions, chopped | 3 tablespoons simple syrup | 1 teaspoon oyster sauce | 3 ounces currants
instructions: Mince apple and place in a crock. Add remaining ingredients and stir until combined and apple is slightly softened.

title: Easy and Delicious Beef Stock
ingredients: 2 lbs beef heart ( or tenderloin ) | 3 cups vegetable stock
instructions: Remove and discard the tough outer skin and tender fat that escapes from the meat. Thoroughly trim the heart and pull the meat of the bones into small pieces about 1/2 inch square. Combine all the ingredients in a large saucepan with a lid, bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer the stock for 2 hours. Remove the lid, add salt and pepper to taste. Replace the lid and simmer, shaking the pan as necessary, for 1 hour. Serve.

title: Filipino Nuts Stew
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin ( or round steak or rib eye fillet ) | 8 ounces fresh fava beans | 3 tablespoons creamy peanut butter | 1 tablespoon coconut oil | 1 shallot | 1 pinch msg | 3 -4 leaves fried shallots ( to garnish )
instructions: Slice beef or roast across the grain into about 3/8 thick or thinner pieces. In a steamer cook beef or beef to taste, depending on thickness of meat, about 15 - 20 minutes in microwave and about 3 - 4 minutes if you like it extra thick. Slice fava beans into 3/8 thick pieces. In the meantime make peanut sauce, add peanut butter to a pan and allow to melt, not until it begins to brown. Remove from heat. Dip vegetables into peanut sauce. Return to heat if desired. Add in okra and serve.

title: Escarole and Cornstarch Soup
ingredients: 1 bunch escarole, washed ( or other mild green lettuce ) | 2 limes, zest of | 1 lb red pepper, sliced | 2 teaspoons cornstarch | 1/2 cup small curds
instructions: Wash the escarole, remove the hard stem, and cut in to bite size pieces. Add to a large pot and add the cornstarch. Mix together, and cook over medium heat until clear to the touch. Add the red pepper, and cook for about 3 minutes. Stir the cornstarch to incorporate the water, and return to a boil. Cook, stirring, until it thickens, about 2 minutes. Add the grated lime zest. Serve hot with fresh bread.

title: Port Beef Brisket
ingredients: 1 beef brisket ( flat ) | 8 ounces port wine ( or use a dry sapphire sauce ) | 8 ounces white chocolate or 8 ounces semisweet chocolate, mixed with 1 pkg white chocolate
instructions: Cut brisket across the grain into 3 or 4 slabs about 1/4 thick. Place beef in a roaster with 1 cup wine. Cover & roast at 325 for about 3 hours. When done remove from pan & cool in roaster. When cool enough to handle, remove meat on skewers. Remove meat from broth & place in refrigerator for 1 hour. Remove the meat from broth and slice very thin. Use a long serving knife to tear the meat into strips. Put meat on serving dishes & dip with white chocolate sauce or melted chocolate.

Random Ingredients: shrimp,tomato green chilies,green pea,banana,hard egg,red chili pepper flake,chicken breast
title: Jungle Pad Thai
ingredients: 1 lb chicken breast | 1 can diced fire-roasted tomatoes with green chilies | 1/2 - 1 banana, sliced | 1 -2 small shrimp | 1 green peas, thawed | 2 -3 hot red chili peppers, crushed ( optional ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon crushed red chili pepper flakes
instructions: Rinse chicken, pat dry completely. Slice chicken in 1/2 in strips. Place all ingredients into a deep skillet or a large pot. Cook over medium high heat until the chicken is cooked, about 7 to 9 minutes, adding hot pepper and crushed red pepper in between to keep the pieces moving in the skillet throughout the cooking process. Serve hot over jasmine rice.

Random Ingredients: black bean,ham,gruyere cheese,yellow pepper,tomato,beef chuck roast,pineapple,golden syrup
title: Sweet and Sour Crockpot Swiss Steak-And-Peppers
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef chuck roast, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 can crushed tomatoes | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed | 1 cup shredded gruyere cheese | 1 medium yellow sweet pepper, seeded and cut into 1-inch squares | 1 can crushed pineapple, drained | 3/4 lb country-style ham, roughly shaved
instructions: Toss meat in crockpot with tomatoes, syrup, beans and cheese. Stir in sweet peppers, diced pineapple and ham. Cover and cook on low heat setting for 8 to 10 hours.

title: Vietnamese Salt and Pepper Mix
ingredients: 2 tablespoons coriander seeds | 1 tablespoon sriracha hot sauce | 1 bag maraschino cherries
instructions: Place coriander and sriracha in a spice grinder and grind until very fine. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,corn husk,pumpkin,greek yogurt,vanilla wafer,aniseed
title: Pumpkin and Corn Mould
ingredients: 3/4 cup low-fat greek yogurt or 3/4 cup low-fat sour cream | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla wafer, crushed | 3/4 cup frozen corn husk | 3 green cardamom pods | 1/2 teaspoon aniseed | 1/2 teaspoon ground pumpkin
instructions: Place yogurt in a small bowl. Add vanilla wafer to yogurt and combine until well blended. Tear corn husk with pods. Toast aniseed in a skillet over med heat until fragrant. Do not burn. Strain yogurt mixture through a fine mesh strainer directly into bowl with yogurt. Refrigerate until cool. Place 2 teaspoons of ground aniseed into each cup of cooled mashed pumpkin to form a hollow. Spoon 1 teaspoon of ground aniseed into each square to form a hollow in the middle. Dust each square with a few drops of anise oil in a decorative pattern before serving.

title: Crock Pot Stampede Beef and White Chocolate
ingredients: 2 lbs bottom rump steak | 1/2 lb white chocolate chips | 1 cup coconut milk | 1/2 cup finely chopped onion | 1 tablespoon dried oregano | 1 package dried cherries, chopped
instructions: Cut steak into strips and place in bottom of crock pot. Sprinkle beef with chocolate chips, coconut milk, onion, and oregano. Pour cherry juice equally over meat. Cook on low 7 - 9 hours. About 30 minutes before serving time, remove meat from crockpot and cut into strips.

title: Rama's'manila' Prawns
ingredients: 50 g finely chopped serrano chilies | 20 g corn oil | 20 g boiled king prawns, chopped
instructions: Add the corn oil and chopped prawns into the saucepan and cook for a little while stirring constantly to thicken. Serve immediately or serve in a bowl lined with a towel.

title: Chinese Mandarin Oranges
ingredients: 8 mandarin oranges or 8 small mandarin oranges | 1/2 teaspoon msg ( optional ) | 1 can baked beans ( optional )
instructions: Wash mandarin or mandarin oranges and drain well. Discard orange end. Cut oranges into quarters, remove skin, peel and seeds. Cut the skin off of the mandarins. Rinse off the skin, and slice finely. Place mandarines in a saucepan of boiling water for a few seconds to soften. Add the can of baked beans, and let them boil for 10 seconds. Plate up or serve on a large platter.

title: Auntie Heather's Texas Chili Powder
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chili powder | 1 1/2 cups orange juice
instructions: Combine chili powder and orange juice in a medium resealable plastic bag, then shake well. Store in refrigerator for up to 1 month.

title: Chutney Mint Carrots
ingredients: 3 large carrots, peeled and sliced | 500 g fresh minced meat | 2 tablespoons mango chutney | 2 teaspoons chili paste with mint, or to taste | 1/4 cup beer, divided | 15 fresh mint leaves
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add carrots, and boil for 5 to 7 minutes. Drain, and set aside to steam dry. In a food processor, finely blend carrot chunks to a coarse puree. Stir in mango chutney and chili paste. Transfer to a bowl, and stir in 1/4 cup beer. Spoon mixture into four serving dishes, piling the carrot mixture on top. Spoon hot mint leaves on top to serve.

title: Chicken Tingers
ingredients: 1 chicken tenders | 1/2 teaspoon gelatin | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Cook chicken tenders in boiling water for two minutes. Drain and allow to cool completely. Sprinkle gelatine over tenders and bake for ten minutes at 400. Place on serving plate and garnish with almond.

title: Italian Wedding Soup
ingredients: 1 package crumbled tortilla chips | 1 package sliced pepperoni | 1 can cranberries, drained | 1 1/2 cups buttermilk
instructions: In the container of a food processor, toss together the chips and pepperoni until well blended, about 1 minute. Pour buttermilk into the processor, and pulse just until the mixture resembles chopped pea size paste.

title: Chilli Black Bean Dip for British Chefs
ingredients: 410 g canned black beans, drained and rinsed | 1 tablespoon chili sauce | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 125 ml coconut cream ( light fat )
instructions: Put all ingredients together in a food processor and whiz for 1 minute.

title: White Beans
ingredients: 1 can white beans, drained well ( white kidney beans or great northern beans ) | 2 -3 tablespoons catsup | 2 tablespoons sugar-free apricot jam
instructions: Combine beans, catsup and jam. Mix well. Pour over beans in a shallow baking dish. Cover and bake at 350°f for 1 hour, uncovered.

title: Potato-Nigella
ingredients: 2 lbs potatoes, peeled and cut into bite sized pieces | 1/4 cup nigella seeds | 1 vanilla bean, scraped from skin | 8 ounces picante sauce
instructions: Scrub potatoes and place in cold water, add nigella seeds and simmer until tender, drain. Remove cinnamon from vanilla bean and add to potatoes. Add picante sauce to taste.

title: Fried Fish with Onions
ingredients: 6 white fish fillets | 2 spring onions, cut into 2 cm lengths | 300 ml skim milk | pepperoni, finely diced ( optional )
instructions: Cut the fish up into serving pieces. Separate the thick green leaves from white and green part of spring onions. Cut away the stalk and white parts of the spring onions from the spring onions, leaving the root end intact. Cut each piece in half horizontally. Heat the milk in a large frying pan set over fairly high heat. When the milk is just beginning to boil, add the spring onions and stir rapidly so that none of them are browned. Turn down the heat and add the sliced pepperoni. Stir until the pepperoni is well cooked, about 2 minutes. If you don't like your onion sour, stir in a few drops of tobasco to the hot milk. Cook the pieces of fish over high heat. The idea is to keep it slightly chunky, not soupy. Scoop out the vegetables with tongs, add to the milk, and serve at once. Some people like to serve this with a crusty fresh bread, like a traditional omelet, but i have found it is equally good with white bread.

Random Ingredients: chinese five spice powder,dill weed,salmon,mexican cheese
title: Chinese Five Spice Salmon Appetizers
ingredients: 4 salmon, cleaned and boned | 1 tablespoon chinese five spice powder | 1 teaspoon dried dill weed | 4 teaspoons shredded mexican cheese blend
instructions: Thoroughly coat the salmon with 5 spice powder, and set aside. Mix dill and cheese together. Sprinkle salmon pieces with 2 teaspoons of the spice mixture, and coat with the cheese mixture over top. Place under broiler and broil for about five minutes, or until crust is golden brown.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,red kidney bean,rye flour,graham cracker crumb,skewer,sun tomato puree
title: Chef John's Soda Bread
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups self-raising flour | 2 1/4 cups rye flour | 1/4 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1 cup sun-dried tomato puree | 1 can red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | skewers
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Line baking sheets with parchment paper. Combine the self raising flour, graham cracker crumbs and sun dried tomato puree in a medium size bowl. Add red kidney beans, toss to mix. On a lightly floured surface, roll the dough out to 1/4 inch thick. Cut out 16 circles with a 3 inch round cutter. Place about 2 tablespoons of the mix on the center of each circle, and pinch the edges closed. Place on the prepared baking sheets. Repeat with the remaining mixture and dough for 3 remaining dough. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes in the preheated oven until golden brown, and hollow when tapped. To serve, immediately remove from baking sheets, and cut each round into quarters with a pizza cutter.

Random Ingredients: bay seasoning,feta cheese,kalamata olive,za'atar spice mix,parmigiano reggiano cheese,white mushroom
title: Baked Mushrooms and Feta Cheese With Za'atar (Rachael Ray)
ingredients: 4 large white mushrooms, sliced | 1 -2 tablespoon dried za'atar spice mix, to taste ( optional ) | 1/4 cup crumbled feta cheese | 1/4 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, freshly grated ( optional ) | 1 -3 kalamata olive, pitted and sliced | 1 bay seasoning
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Place half of the mushrooms in a baking dish just large enough to hold the mushrooms in a single layer. Sprinkle the za'atar over them. Sprinkle the feta over the za'atar. Top with the parmigiano. Top the feta with the olive slices. Sprinkle the za'atar over the mushrooms. Add the bay seasoning, to taste, and top the mushrooms with remaining olive slices. Bake, uncovered, in the middle of the oven about 40 minutes or until the mushrooms are soft and crisp.

title: Vegan Fettuccini With Guacamole
ingredients: 4 ounces cooked dried fettuccine pasta | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 2 teaspoons chili spice blend ( from a packet ) | 10 1/2 ounces guacamole | 2 teaspoons fenugreek seeds
instructions: Cook fettucini according to package direcions. Meanwhile, heat soy sauce and chili spice blend in a small saucepan over high heat until warm. Add bean and fenugreek and warm through. Drain fettuccini and return to large bowl and add guacamole and soy mixture. Serve immediately.

title: Grilled Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 cup freshly grated romano cheese | 1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger-garlic paste | 3 slices brown bread, such as ciabatta
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together romano cheese, ginger garlic paste, and bread crumbs. Place bread in a shallow dish. Top with cheese mixture.

title: Beef Salsa
ingredients: 1 package coleslaw mix | 1 can beef gravy | 2 ounces orange rind twists
instructions: Combine coleslaw mix with gravy.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,taco shell,cherry tomato,garlic,basil leaf,beef stew meat,bragg liquid amino
title: Health-Like Beef Taco Fillings
ingredients: 1 cup lowfat beef stew meat or 1 cup steak, cubed | 1/2 cup chopped fresh basil leaf | 1 teaspoon minced garlic | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 1/4 teaspoon basil leaves | 1 envelope low-fat braggs liquid aminos | 1 can diced cherry tomatoes, drained ( optional )
instructions: In a skillet, brown meat and basil and stir in garlic. Drain off fat. Pour in bragg's and liquid aminos. Heat to boiling and boil until most of the liquid cooks off. Stir in tomatoes and continue to cook until heated through.

Random Ingredients: crisco,pecorino romano cheese,pea,chunky salsa,pearl barley,plum tomato
title: Salsa and N Peppers Stuffed in Pecorino!
ingredients: 1 lb pearl barley | 3 plum tomatoes | 1 can del monte spicy red pico-salsa | 6 ounces frozen peas | 1 cup crisco, finely chopped | 1/2 cup pecorino romano cheese, divided
instructions: Cook barley in 2 cups boiling water over medium heat until tender, about 25 minutes. Drain well and place in large bowl. Add canned pico salsa and remaining ingredients. Stir and adjust seasonings. Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours and up to 2 days. Serve warm from the fridge or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,dark chocolate,cilantro leaf,dill pickle,mozzarella cheese,sea salt
title: Chicken Aztec Dip
ingredients: 1 bag shredded mozzarella cheese | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup finely chopped cilantro leaf | 2 tablespoons finely chopped dill pickles | 1/4 cup dark chocolate, melted | 1 1/2 teaspoons sea salt
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the mozzarella cheese, cream of chicken soup, cilantro, pickles, dark chocolate and sea salt.

title: Guacamole With Cheddar
ingredients: 3 avocados, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup cheddar cheese ( shredded or grated ) | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Combine avocados together with kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper. Serve immediately or refrigerate for up to 2 days.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,kosher salt black pepper,bean sprout,tomato,garlic clove,barbeque sauce,grain rice,teriyaki sauce
title: Bean Sprout and Rice Bake
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil ( or olive oil ) | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 medium garlic clove, minced | 2 cups cooked long-grain rice | 1 cup barbeque sauce ( we used hunt's redpack brand ) | 1 can crushed tomatoes, undrained | 1 tablespoon teriyaki sauce | 1/2 lb bean sprouts
instructions: Position a rack 4 inches from the broiler element and preheat to 425 degrees. Coat a 13x9x2 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Place oil in a small skillet over medium heat. Add garlic and season with salt and pepper. Saute for about 1 minute and then set aside. Rice. Heat oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Add rice and stir to coat rice with oil. Cook, stirring, until rice is dark golden and sticky, about 1 minute. Stir in barbeque sauce and simmer, uncovered, until liquid is absorbed, about 5 minutes. Drain excess liquid. Stir in tomatoes, teriyaki sauce and bean sprouts. Spoon mixture into prepared baking dish and cover with foil. Bake until heated through and bubbling, 25 to 30 minutes. Uncover and bake another 10 minutes to brown slightly.

title: Ginger Wonton Pillows
ingredients: 12 large spring roll wrappers | 10 teaspoons grated fresh ginger | 24 spring roll wrappers
instructions: Heat a small wok over high heat until a bead of water vaporizes on contact. Place two spring roll wrappers lengthwise in the wok, and lower center of wrapper so it points towards the center of the wok. Spread the ginger evenly over the wonton wrapper. Using a moist paper towel, press a 1/4 pound piece of ginger over the ginger, and reshape the wrapper to enclose all of the filling over the wrapper, leaving the rounded end uncut. Repeat until remaining wrappers and filling are used up, placing each wrapper on a flat surface to avoid drying out during cooking. Heat a heavy skillet or griddle over high heat while the pan is heating or until a bead of water vaporizes on contact. Remove wontons from pan, place on paper towels, and allow to dry until cool, at least 30 minutes. Heat a skillet or griddle over medium heat, and add wontons. Cook until lightly browned but still moist inside, about 1 minute per side. Transfer to a platter. Place warm pan over medium low heat, and add enough hot water to completely immerse the wontons into the hot water. Allow wontons to soften and expand, about 4 minutes. Remove from pan, drizzle with water from the skillet, and sprinkle with ginger. Serve while hot.

title: Leche Ham
ingredients: 1 ham | 2 tablespoons dried tarragon | 1 tablespoon dill weed
instructions: Slice ham into 1 inch slices. Mix salt, herbs, and tarragon and spread over ham slices. Roll each slice like a jelly roll. You may fry in medium hot frying pan, turning once.

Random Ingredients: golden raisin,soya sauce,grain rice,heavy cream,kidney bean,chipotle chile adobo
title: Red Kidney Beans and Rice (No Oil)
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried kidney beans ( soaked for approximately 8 hours ) | 2 cups cooked long-grain rice | 1 tablespoon soya sauce | 3 tablespoons golden raisins | 2 chipotle chiles in adobo, chopped ( use chipotles in adobo, not minced ) ( optional ) | 1/4 cup heavy cream
instructions: Soak beans in water for approximately 8 hours. Drain and discard soaking water. Meanwhile, pulse rice, soya sauce, raisins and chilies in a blender. Add beans and cream to rice mixture and combine. Let stand at room temperature 15 minutes, then chill, covered and serve.

Random Ingredients: paprika,orange,cream chicken soup,liquid smoke,mexican cheese,sea salt,salt black pepper,tomatillo
title: Taco Tomatillo Green Hell
ingredients: 8 medium tomatillos, husked, rinsed and coarsely chopped | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/4 cup sour cream ( i used greek yogurt ) | 0.5 can mexican-style cheese blend, drained ( or substitute grated ) | 1 teaspoon smoked paprika | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke ( optional ) | sea salt, to taste | freshly ground coarse black pepper, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Spray a baking dish with non stick cooking spray. In a bowl, combine tomatillos, soup, sour cream, cheese, paprika, if using, liquid smoke, and salt and pepper. Mix lightly until well blended and transfer to baking dish. Bake, uncovered, for about 20 minutes, or until topping is lightly browned and bubbly. This can be served warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: anchovy paste,kidney bean,phyllo dough,green bean,corn tortilla
title: Mom's Kidney Bean Tacos
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans | 1 green beans, cut into halves, or | 1 corn tortillas | 4 anchovy paste | 1/2 package frozen phyllo dough or ( 16 ounce ) package frozen phyllo dough
instructions: Preheat your oven to 300 degrees f. Cook the beans, green beans, garlic and anchovy paste in water to cover over med heat or in microwave for at least 6 minutes. Turn off heat and stir. Cut tortillas in 6 inch squares and put bottom of a casserole dish on the stove. Cover with the beans mixture and top with a sheet of phyllo. Cover with other phyllo and dampen edges with a little water so that they don't curl. Add about 1/3c water in a line across the phyllo. Then cover with the rest of the phyllo and cover with last phyllo sheet. Make sure sheet is completely covered with phyllo, then trim to fit your dish as needed. Put in oven and bake, covered, for about 1 hour 15 mins, stirring every 15 minutes in the last 15 minutes, which will give you a crispier and flanier finished product. Allow to cool for about 10minutes before cutting and eating, or eat immediately. This recipe makes quite a bit, but you can refrigerate your filling. It can freeze up to 3 months.

title: Cashew-Orange Peel Macaroon
ingredients: 3 tablespoons corn oil | 1 egg white | 1/2 teaspoon finely grated orange peel | 2 tablespoons cashew halves, toasted | 2 tablespoons parsley, finely snipped
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Lightly coat a nonstick baking tray with cooking oil. Beat the egg white with a pinch of salt in a small bowl until soft peaks form. Gradually beat in the rest of the oil then fold through the orange peel, cashew halves, parsley and egg white until completely combined. Spoon into a small baking dish, spacing 8 macaroon sized mounds slightly apart on the baking tray. Bake until golden, about 15 - 20 minutes.

title: Easy Chick Pea Flour Whole Wheat Parloaf
ingredients: 2 cups chickpea flour | 1 teaspoon red hot pepper sauce | 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl. Spread on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake at 400' for 5 - 10 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: hot italian sausage,walnut oil,mango chutney,rice wine,chunky salsa
title: Sweet 'n Chutney Stuffed Mozzarella
ingredients: 16 ounces boneless sweet italian sausage | 1/2 cup low-fat chunky salsa | 1/4 cup smooth mango chutney | 1/4 cup walnut oil | 2 tablespoons rice wine or 2 tablespoons apple cider
instructions: Slice the sausages crosswise into 1/4 inch thick slices. Mix the chutney and salsa. Tear off a piece of plastic wrap. Take one end of a slice and press it, flat, into the oil. Dip the bread into the chutney mix and continue coating until all of the bread is covered. Fill with the sausage, swiping it around the sausage in the mixture, so the ends of the slices overlap the stuffing. Roll in the reserved plastic wrap. Repeat with the remaining slices. Place the rolls on a plate, cover with the plastic and place in the fridge. After several hours, remove the rolls and let them sit for about 10 minutes. Slice them on the diagonal and arrange all around the rim of a shallow serving platter, or arrange the mozzarella on a platter.

Random Ingredients: asafoetida powder,vanilla extract,vegetable stock,cream cheese,tomato juice,asiago cheese,cod,baking soda
title: Fishcakes(Bangladesh)
ingredients: 1 lb cod | 3 tablespoons goat's milk light cream cheese ( neufchatel ) | 2/3 teaspoon baking soda | 1 cup vegetable stock | 1/3 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( hing ) | 1/2 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 1 cup diced tomato with juice | freshly grated asafoetida ( hing ) | freshly grated asafoetida powder ( hing )
instructions: In a small bowl, mash cream cheese with a fork and stir in goat's milk. Cover and keep refrigerated until ready to use. Combine baking soda with the stock and set aside to be used as a basting liquid. When ready to use the fish, cut cod into 3 inch chunks or triangles. Lightly flour a large rimmed baking sheet.

Random Ingredients: parsnip,black olive,chicken thigh,red potato,salad oil,heavy cream,cilantro stem,picante sauce
title: Chicken, Potato, Parsnip Dip
ingredients: olive oil | 8 skinless chicken thighs | 1 lb red potato, peeled and diced | 1/2 cup pickled parsnips, diced | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro stems | 1/4 cup heavy cream | 1/4 cup picante sauce | fresh parsley stem ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f coat a shallow baking dish with olive oil. Place chicken thighs in dish, pressing in any excess air. Bake 40 - 45 minutes or until chicken is cooked through and completely cooked through. Cool completely. Place chicken thighs on cutting board and cut into 3/4 inch pieces about 1/4 inch thick, and set aside until needed. Dice potato, parsnip and cilantro and arrange on a serving plate. In a saucepan over medium heat, bring cream to a boil and cook for 2 minutes or until reduced slightly and thick. Transfer sauce to bowl and stir in picante sauce. Arrange chicken, potatoes and cilantro on a serving platter. Spoon sauce over chicken. Garnish with parsley sprigs.

title: Greek Chard Potatoes and Swiss Chard
ingredients: 1 bunch swiss chard, bottom stems removed | 5 potatoes | 2 teaspoons salt | 3 tablespoons rice powder | 1 tablespoon greek oregano | 1 teaspoon all purpose greek seasoning
instructions: Cut chard stems into 3 inch lengths. Set aside. Cut potatoes into thick slices or chunks and set aside. Wash leaves, and slice crosswise into 3 inch lengths cut crosswise into thirds. Chop leaves with cleaver. Set aside. Stack swiss chard leaves on clean kitchen toweling. Cut or chop with cleaver into chard stems.. Place potatoes in a large pot with lightly salted water to cover and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer, stirring occasionally until tender, 15 to 20 minutes. Drain. Place potatoes with water in a large bowl. Sprinkle with salt, and toss until coated. Dissolve rice powder with greek seasoning in 2 tablespoons water. Add half of oregano and remaining oregano to potatoes. Stir potato and chard mixture, adding chard mixture and remaining 2 tablespoons water. Cover, and refrigerate until chilled, at least 8 hours. Transfer potatoes into a bowl, sprinkle with remaining oregano, and stir to blend.

Random Ingredients: purpose flour,asiago cheese,gruyere cheese,vegetable oil cooking spray,leg lamb
title: Roasted Asiago Focaccia
ingredients: 2/3 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, well drained | 2 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, plus more for dusting | 2 1/2 lbs leg of lamb, cut into 2 1/2-inch cubes | vegetable oil cooking spray | 3 ounces asiago cheese, coarsely grated | 1/2 cup gruyere cheese, coarsely grated
instructions: Place oven rack in upper third of oven and preheat to 500°f in a large bowl, stir sun dried tomatoes lightly with their oil, then stir in flour. Pat lamb dry and dust with flour. Place lamb in a single layer on a rack in a roasting pan, then toss with a fork to coat evenly, then bake for 30 minutes, or until thermometer reads 155f on the outside and still moist inside. Remove lamb from oven and set it on a rack over a baking sheet. Return it to oven and roast until an instant read thermometer inserted into the thickest part of the lamb registers 125f for medium rare meat, about 45 minutes longer. Transfer lamb to a plate and tent with foil. Skim fat from the top in the roasting pan. Toss lamb cubes with asiago filling and set aside. Spoon filling into a pastry bag fitted with a 1/2 to 1 inch star tip. Pipe filling atop asiago cream and gruyere, then drizzle over lamb and sprinkle with cheese. Bake until cheese is melted, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: macaroni,asafoetida powder,bulk italian sausage,angel hair pasta,chocolate,lemon juice,pork tenderloin,almond
title: Asafoetida Italian Pork and Chocolate Pasta
ingredients: 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 1 1/4 lbs pork tenderloin, trimmed and cut into 1/2-inch slices | 1/4 lb italian sausage, casings removed, sliced | 2 1/2 cups uncooked angel hair pasta | 1/2 cup toasted almond, coarsely chopped | 1 package semisweet chocolate ( or real milk chocolate ) | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder or 1/2 teaspoon other mild-mung bean sprouts | 1/8 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( optional )
instructions: Dissolve the lemon juice in a 3 quart saucepan of boiling water. Add the meat and boil, uncovered, 3 minutes. Add the sausage and cook over low heat, stirring occasionally, 3 to 5 minutes or until the meat is no longer pink in the center. Drain the fat and discard.

Random Ingredients: cider vinegar,currant,cinnamon sugar mixture,avocado,white sugar,marinara sauce
title: Curtido Maratho's Canned Avocado Sauce
ingredients: 4 avocados - peeled, pitted and diced | 1 cup white sugar | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1/4 cup dried currants | 1/2 cup marinara sauce | 2 teaspoons ground cinnamon sugar mixture
instructions: Place the avocados, sugar, vinegar, currants, and marinara sauce in a saucepan over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: lebanese cucumber,cardamom pod,rice bran oil,hot chicken broth,glutinous white rice
title: Rice Bran With Cucumber and Pickled Carrots
ingredients: 2 cups glutinous white rice, washed and soaked in water for 20 minutes | 4 tablespoons rice bran oil | 2 cups pickled lebanese cucumbers, sliced in 1/2-inch slices | 4 cardamom pods | 2 cans hot chicken broth, preferably homemade if possible ( preferably heinz )
instructions: Soak the glutinous rice in warm water for 20 minutes until it doubles in bulk. Drain and place in a saucepan with a tight fitting lid. Add the drained rice, add 4 1/2 cups hot chicken broth, stir to mix and let sit, covered, for 3 hours at room temperature. Place a plate on top of the rice, pour in a little water, wrap the lid, and refrigerate for 10 minutes. Stir occasionally. Remove the lid, fluff up the rice with your finger and check to see if the sticky liquid is clear, if not, repeat.

title: Pickled Onions
ingredients: 1 large red onion, peeled and sliced thin | 5 drops red food coloring
instructions: Cut the slices of onion in half, and place in a bowl. Place 2 t. Water in microwave for 30 seconds, then stir. Cover the bowl and microwave for 5 minutes, stirring half way through. Remove from microwave and stir. Cover and leave for 10 minutes longer, stirring half way through. Remove onions to serving dish, and sprinkle with food coloring to serve.

Random Ingredients: brown mustard,green chile pepper,taco seasoning mix,yellow onion,orange peel,amaretto,rum,burgundy wine
title: Taco Burgundy
ingredients: 1/2 cup butter, softened | 3 small yellow onions, finely chopped | 2 cans green chile peppers, finely chopped | 1/2 cup burgundy wine | 1 1/2 tablespoons light rum | 1 tablespoon ground brown mustard | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning mix | 1 orange peel, finely chopped
instructions: In a skillet, over medium heat, melt the butter. Cook and stir the onions until tender. Stir in the green chile peppers, Burgundy wine, rum, brown mustard, and taco seasoning mix. Simmer for 30 minutes. Remove orange peel and stir into sauce, to serve.

title: Orange Tilapia
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried tarragon vinegar with parsley | 1 tablespoon orange juice | 1 1/2 lbs uncooked linguine or 1 1/2 lbs other long-cut pasta shells | fresh water | 4 boneless fish fillets, cut into 2 inch pieces
instructions: Cook the pasta according to package directions. Meanwhile, in a small skillet, combine the tarragon vinegar with the orange juice and simmer over moderate heat until the vinegar is reduced to half, about 5 minutes. Drain and set aside. Bring a large pot of water to a boil while the pasta cooks. In a large skillet, combine the linguine and 1/4 teaspoon salt. Add the fish and the tarragon vinegar mixture, about 2 cups water, and bring to a simmer. In a large skillet, heat the remaining 1/4 teaspoon salt until bubbling. Transfer the pasta to boiling water for one minute, then drain. Transfer the linguine to a serving bowl. Toss with the warm sauce, adjusting seasoning with salt and pepper. Serve immediately.

title: Beef Stew With Orchiette and Peas
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground beef chuck | 1 package frozen peas or ( 16 ounce ) package fresh peas | 1 box orchiette, prepared according to the directions on the box
instructions: Brown meat in a large skillet.

title: Swiss Chops and Asparagus with Herring
ingredients: 1/2 cup icing sugar | 2 tablespoons minced fresh dill | 3 boneless pork chops | 4 large asparagus, stalks trimmed | 1 1/2 cups fat-free ranch dressing
instructions: In medium bowl, combine icing sugar and dill.

title: Italian Olive Paste
ingredients: 10 tablespoons kalamata olives, pitted and chopped, divided | 1 cup minced garlic
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together half of the pitted olives, minced garlic, and remaining olives. Spread paste onto a serving dish and set aside to let flavors mingle. Enjoy.

title: Mushroom Beetroot and Beetroot Salad
ingredients: 2 large fresh beets ( about 10 oz. ) | 12 slices cremini mushrooms
instructions: Peel and slice beets into 1/2 inch wedges and then into 1/8 inch slices. Spray a large baking dish with cooking spray and arrange 2 beef slices over it. Sprinkle with salt. Top with two slices of each sliced beets, with a pinch of salt if you wish. Cover with a large sheet of aluminum foil or a small piece of parchment paper or a silpat. Place in 450f oven for 15 minutes. Remove foil and allow to rest in a warm area for 5 minutes. Remove and allow to cool, approximately 15 minutes. Transfer all ingredients from baking dish to a platter. Place the rest of the beef on top and serve with beetroot and mushrooms.

title: Hot Chili Snack Mix
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, drained | 1 cup quick cooking hot salsa ( i like pace )
instructions: Drain and rinse the chickpees. Transfer to a small bowl, and add the salsa. Mix well. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: vanilla,mozzarella cheese,steak,milk,cream chicken soup,celery seed,orange juice
title: Crock Pot Chicken Philly Steak
ingredients: 2 stalks celery seeds | 2 cans condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 cup milk | 1/3 cup orange juice | 1 -2 lb round steak, cut into 1-inch chunks | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1 -2 cup shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Mix together celery seeds and 2 cans of cream of chicken soup, mix until blended. Place in slow cooker and add remaining ingredients except cheese. Cook on low setting for 7 - 8 hours. Top with cheese and broil until cheese is bubbly.

title: Ouzo and Ouzo Linguine
ingredients: 1 package linguine | 1 fluid ounce ouzo | 2 fluid ounces caramel, preferably hazelnut-flavored ( optional )
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook the ouzo in the boiling water until reduced to 2 tablespoons, 5 to 10 minutes. Transfer to a bowl and let cool. Cook the linguine according to the package instructions. Drain. Transfer to a serving bowl, drizzle with ouzo and caramel if using, and toss to coat.

title: Spiced Rum Burgers
ingredients: 1/2 kg beef chuck, cut into 4cm cubes | 1/3 cup hoisin sauce | 1 tablespoon grand marnier | 1 tablespoon demerara sugar | 2 tablespoons rum | 2 teaspoons dried rosemary | crouton, to serve
instructions: Place the beef cubes in a resealable plastic bag. In a frying pan, combine the remaining ingredients. Heat over low heat, stirring often, for 5 - 10 minutes, or until the marinade has reduced to a thick paste. Pour into the bag with the meat cubes and marinate for at least 3 hours. The longer the better. Lightly toast or grill the buns in the oven for 5 minutes per side. Serve the sliced buns with the spiced rum sauce and croutons.

title: Smoked Salmon Chowder
ingredients: 300 g smoked salmon, cut in half | 2 medium baby carrots, chopped | 600 g smoked ham, cut in long thin strips | 1 bunch english waffles ( or use sandwich bread ) | 1 liter thickened yoghurt or 1 liter sour cream | 1 tablespoon white vinegar | 1 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon ( or granules )
instructions: Wash and dry the waffles. Heat some oil in a large, non stick pan, add the onions and cook until translucent. Add the carrots, ham and chicken bouillon. Cook until carrots are lightly browned. Remove with a slotted spoon. Add the yoghurt to the pan and stir with a wooden spoon until it dissolves. Add sugar stirring to dissolve. Add the veggies and mix together. Transfer to a small serving bowl, sprinkle the top with crumbs. Serve immediately and reheat in oven as suggested.

title: Molasses Glue (Hot)
ingredients: 4 tablespoons molasses ( i like dark, use brown sugar, or maple flavored if desired ) | 2 cans condensed beef broth | 1 cup port wine ( optional )
instructions: In a large heavy skillet over medium heat, warm the molasses and beef broth. Stir in the port and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low.

Random Ingredients: fennel bulb,chicken bouillon,garlic,cooking spray,hamburger bun,bread,italian turkey sausage
title: Italian Turkey Sausage and Fennel Sandwiches
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 lb sweet italian turkey sausage - casings removed | 1 fennel bulb, trimmed | 4 cloves crushed garlic | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon | 4 toasted bread | 8 hamburger buns, split, toasted
instructions: Preheat grill to medium. Coat grill grates with cooking spray. Grill sausage and fennel over medium hot heat 4 to 5 minutes or until sausage is cooked through. Slice sausage into 1 1/2 inch pieces. Stir sausage, fennel, garlic, and bouillon into hot sausage mixture. Transfer mixture to a large bowl and toss with sauerkraut and bread. Serve sandwiches with remaining sausage mixture.

title: Portuguese Macaroni With Beans
ingredients: 4 -5 cups dry macaroni, fresh | 7 ounces macaroni or 7 ounces other pastas, prepared | 3 garlic cloves, finely sliced | 1 can red kidney beans, drained | 2 tablespoons port wine
instructions: Place macaroni in a large bowl and cover with cold water. Heat a large nonstick frying pan, add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring, or until fragrant. Add the macaroni and half the beans and simmer until just tender. Drain and mash with the remaining beans. Add the port, then cook for 1 to 2 minutes.

title: Spiced Pepper Focaccia
ingredients: 1 teaspoon ground allspice | 1 cup all-purpose flour | 1 cup yellow bell pepper, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. In a small bowl, combine the allspice and flour. Add the yellow bell pepper and mix lightly. Shape the mixture into two 6 inch diameter rounds. Place on a greased biscuit plate and bake for 12 to 15 minutes, or until the top is lightly golden.

title: Green Chile Tuna
ingredients: 1 can tuna in water and drained | 1 can diced green chilies
instructions: Combine and chill until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: orange peel,cashew,red bell pepper,cremini mushroom,taco seasoning mix,chunky salsa,sirloin,nori
title: Beef Tostadas
ingredients: 1 pound ground sirloin | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 red bell pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup chopped cashews | 1/2 cup chunky salsa | 8 nori | 1 package sliced cremini mushrooms | 1 orange peel
instructions: Preheat an oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place sirloin into a skillet over medium high heat.

Random Ingredients: breadcrumb,thyme sprig,chicken breast fillet,chicken fillet,vegetable,tea,extra virgin olive oil
title: Grilled Chicken and Vegetables for One
ingredients: 2 chicken breast fillets, skin on | 2 chicken fillets, skinned and fillet on | fresh thyme sprig | 1/4 cup plain breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup vegetable oil or 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1/3 cup tea | 1 tablespoon mixed vegetables, finely chopped
instructions: Place chicken, thyme sprigs and breadcrumbs on the breast fillets. Lightly coat with oil and then press between sheets of waxed paper to get breadcrumbs into each of the chicken fillets.. Place on grill, brush with oil and grill till golden brown. Turn and brush with more oil. Grill the vegetables till tender.

title: The Easiest Turkish Sandwich
ingredients: 4 slices bread | 1 lemon, thinly sliced thin | 1 tablespoon dry mixed spice | 1/2 teaspoons red red cayenne pepper
instructions: Take 2 slices of bread and cut into halves or quarters and then slice into quarters again. Lay slice or piece of the bread on your work surface. Spread on lemon slices. Top with mixed spice and red cayene pepper. Serve hot or cold enjoy.

title: Roasted Butternut Squash Muffins (Pumpkin
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs butternut squash, peeled and cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 large sweet red sweet pepper, julienned | 1/2 teaspoon ground red pepper | 3/4 teaspoon ground cumin powder | 1/8 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 5 tablespoons honey | 1/2 cup malt vinegar ( or white vinegar ) | 12 graham crackers, 1/2 in | 1/4 cup honey, divided
instructions: Set oven to 400f degrees. Remove from heat and allow to cool to room temperature. Measure 1/4 cup and set aside. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Place 2 tbsp warm milk into each hollowed out pumpkin. In another bowl mix together remaining tablespoon warm milk, vinegar, and remaining tablespoon warm milk. Spread milk mixture into hollowed pumpkin and place on a cookie sheet. Coat pumpkin with sauce. Bake at 350 for approximately 20 minutes or until golden.

title: Kaffee Ki Raita (Indian Cardamom Butter)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cream of tartar ( ghee or butter is best ) | 2 whole cardamom seeds
instructions: Mix in a small mixer with a pinch of salt. Keep mixing for a minute. Take a coffee mug, fill it with a quarter cup of water.

title: Pam's Lime Coleslaw

instructions: Add all ingredients to jar. Shake well to combine, and store in refrigerator. Before serving, add extra lime zest to make it spritz green cabbage.

instructions: Place your ingredients in your bread machine in order suggested by the manufacturer. Select dough cycle, and press start. Allow bread cycle.

title: Salsa Verde
ingredients: 3 cups bottled sliced cherry tomatoes | 3 cups low sodium chicken bouillon | 1/2 cup amaretto | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce
instructions: In a slow cooker combine the tomatoes, bouillon, amaretto, soy sauce and 1/2 cup water. Cover tightly and cook on high setting 4 hours or low setting 6 hours. Stir well before serving. Serve with tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: semolina,yukon gold potato,superfine sugar,mint leaf,veal stock beef,green chilies,yellow bell pepper,fennel seed
title: Veal Fennel and Green Peppers With Yukon Gold Potatoes
ingredients: 600 g of cubed yukon gold potatoes ( about 1 1/4 pounds ) | 3 tablespoons of chopped fresh mint leaves | 4 small green chilies | 1 large yellow bell pepper ( or any other colour of choice ) | 2 tablespoons superfine sugar | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 1 tablespoon fennel seed, crushed | 4 cups veal stock ( or beef stock )
instructions: Cut bell pepper into 1/4 inch thick strips. Place potatoes in a microwave safe dish and cover with boiling water. Cover with plastic wrap and microwave on high power for 2 1/2 minutes, or until tender but still slightly firm. Drain and set aside and set aside to cool completely. Cut reserved bell pepper strips into 1/4 inch wide strips. Heat olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat. Add fennel seeds and cook for 2 minutes, or until golden brown. Add bell pepper strips and fry. Remove pepper strips and fry green chilies until they are soft and slightly aromatic. Add bell pepper strips, mint leaves, extra virgin olive oil and sugar to pan and heat through. Stir in beef stock. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring constantly until sauce thickens. Divide between serving bowls. Allow guests to add a pinch of fennel seeds to each serving. Garnish with fresh mint leaves. Serve with pappadums or fresh crusty bread.

title: German-Style Hot Dogs
ingredients: 1/2 cup sweet potato flour | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper | 1 1/2 teaspoons apple cider vinegar | 2 tablespoons honey mustard | cooked turkey
instructions: Mix together sweet potato flour, white pepper and apple cider vinegar in a small bowl. Stir honey mustard and turkey into flour mixture. Spoon batter into two small heavy duty paper liners. Press turkey into batter. Place one turkey at the top of the hot dog and press lightly to flatten to edges of pan. Cook 5 minutes on each side, until golden brown.

title: Quick Kiwi Fritters
ingredients: 2 kiwi | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 1 tablespoon white vermouth ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon grated orange zest
instructions: Peel the kiwi and discard the seeds. Cut into thin strips across the side of the kiwi, removing the tough end and slicing the flesh. Combine the kiwi, flour, vermouth and orange zest in a large bowl. Using your hands, work the dough with your fingers, gradually incorporating the kiwi. Heat a large non stick frying pan over medium heat. When hot, drop small tablespoons of the fritter batter in at a time. Cook about 3 - 5 minutes each side, or until golden brown.

title: Zeytoofetakia Babi Kebab With Pork Tahini Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 kg pork tenderloin, with bone | 1/2 kg dried prune ( pitted ) | 1/2 bunch scallion, finely chopped | tahini | 2 sheets phyllo pastry ( phyllo )
instructions: Chop the pork into small pieces. Pound it until it is about 3/4cm thick. Spread out some tahini between two sheets of filo. On one sheet place 1/4 of your pork meat mixture in a corner. Roll up in your hands, pinching at all joints to produce a piece of pork on each long sheet. Repeat with remaining sheets. Take one sheet of filo and place over the other and fold the bottom of the pastry over the meat. Take a second sheet of filo and place on top on top. Put the meat in between your sheets of filo and roll the pastry over the meat. Repeat with all sheets. Cut the rolled filo in half, to make two long rectangles. Brush the strips with a little olive oil to keep it from sticking. Cook the pastries on a preheated hot grill for approximately 20 minutes or until they are lightly browned on the top and are crispy on the outside. Place on a plate and let them cool before eating. Don't be alarmed if they sizzle. It may be painful to roll the pastry over and over when it is cold. When cooked, remove it from the griddle, place on a plate and let it cool slightly. After a while, you may cut it in four squares and eat it with the pork.

Random Ingredients: sage,cumin,italian sausage,garlic powder,drambuie,thai fish sauce,chicken stock cube,corn kernel
title: Spiced Sausage & Corn Dip in a Jar and
ingredients: 8 links sweet italian sausage | 1 can corn kernels, drained well and roughly chopped | 1 packet chicken stock cubes | 1/2 cup thai fish sauce | 1 teaspoon cumin | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 teaspoon sage | 1 packet drambuie

Let cool completely, then cut into desired shape.

instructions: Mash avocado with a fork. Add in yogd, adding more if necessary.

instructions: Cut zucchini lengthwise into 1/4 inch slices. Toss with fish sauce and garlic. Let stand 20 minutes, then spoon onto a baking sheet. Bake at 450° for 20 minutes.

title: Tomatillo Salsa Roja
ingredients: 6 fresh tomatillos ( ripe style ) | 1 can chicken broth | 1 cup prepared guacamole ( i use la parra real salsa fresca ) | 1 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Cut the tomatillos in half lengthwise, scoop out the seeds and place the halves on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper or waxed paper. Cut the tomatillos in half again and remove the pulp with a spoon. Bake the skins and the seeds in an oven preheated to 325 degrees f, for about 20 minutes, turning over. As they get nice and soft and they turn a nice dark color, remove the skins, chop and set aside. Pour chicken broth into large skillet with tomatillo pulp. Add 1 cup of rice and cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the broth has reduced to about 1/3 cup – this won’t take very long for the tomatillos. Remove from heat when almost all the broth has gone. When the liquid is reduced, remove from the heat and start making the salsa – this can be done in a blender or food processor by bringing the diced tomatillos to a boil, then straining, reserving the liquid, and then return liquid and the reserved tomatillo pulp to pot and bring mixture to a simmer over medium heat. You don’t want that to boil over and too fast, stir, and reduce until almost dry. Transfer to food processor and process into smooth puree. The salsa and the puree should have been slightly chunky at first – it will start to thicken and will thicken slightly as it cools. You may add up to 1/8 cup or so of reserved tomatillo liquid or water if needed. Stir in guacamole and cook over medium heat until heated thoughtaste and adjust seasoning. If you like, you may mix in a teaspoon of shredded parmigiano reggiano cheese at the table alongside the salsa.

Random Ingredients: galliano,lemon wedge,island dressing,egg white,kiwi,taco seasoning,puff pastry
title: Kiwifruit Tarts
ingredients: 1 sheet frozen puff pastry, thawed to room temperature | 1 egg white | 2 teaspoons taco seasoning, divided | 1 cup island dressing | 2 ripe kiwi ( if not eating right away, use a can of juice ) | lemon wedge | island dressing ( optional )
instructions: Defrost pastry according to package directions. Place pastry on a baking sheet, brush top with egg white and 1 teaspoon taco seasoning, and press evenly into a tart pan with your finger. Bake for 10 minutes at 350f degrees, or until very lightly golden, stirring halfway through. While pastry is baking, prepare kiwifruit filling. In a medium bowl, combine kiwis and remaining 1/2 teaspoon taco seasoning. Set aside. Remove pastry from oven and place on a serving plate. Spoon fruit filling on top, and top with remaining taco seasoning. Serve with lemon wedges.

title: Roasted Bell Pepper Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb uncooked wide egg noodles | 1/4 lb neufchatel cheese, drained | 1/2 cup walnut oil | 2 chipotle chiles in adobo, halved lengthwise | 1 yellow bell pepper, roasted, peeled and cut into bite-size pieces | 4 medium basil leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Cook noodles in rapidly boiling salted water for 10 minutes.

title: Guilt-free (Gelly Bean) Creamy Sweetened Granola-S
ingredients: 250 ml soymilk | 125 g palm sugar ( castor sugar or superfine sugar )
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a pan and whisk until the mixture begins to thicken around the edge. Switch over to the burner and let the mixture boil gently for 20 - 30 minutes stirring frequently, until the mixture becomes light and frothy. The mixture should be fairly thick, almost like a creamy caramel. Turn off the heat. Cool completely and whisk in some ice cream or semisweet chocolate chips if you like.

title: Quick and Simple Spinach (Kirak Namul)
ingredients: 1 lb fresh spinach leaves | 1 teaspoon crushed fennel seed | 10 bamboo skewers, soaked in water for 1/2 an hour
instructions: Clean the spinach. Remove as many outer leaves as possible, or it won't matter much if it leaks out of the leaves. If you leave too many leaves, squeeze them all together, and pat dry with paper towels to remove a little moisture. Slice off any big, very tough stems that float to the surface and then slice each leaf crosswise into 1/2 inch slices. Place all the leaves in a large, shallow dish. Sprinkle in the fennel seeds. Put the skewers on top, or in a large resealable plastic bag if you prefer. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Drain the spinach at least 30 minutes, preferably overnight. Line a steamer basket with one of the bamboo skewers. Use 1 of the bamboo skewers for each person.

title: Homemade Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 3 cups chicken bouillon powder | 1/3 cup canola oil
instructions: Measure the chicken bouillon powder into a jar, and pour half of the canola oil in it. Shake the jar and canola oil around the contents so that the oil is mixed with the powdered bouillon. Add a pinch of salt and a pinch of ground black pepper to the jar. Store the canola oil covered in the refrigerator for one week.

Random Ingredients: double cream,sugar snap pea,red pepper,cream mushroom soup,nigella seed,sultana
title: Nigella's Crunchy Nachos & Sultanas

instructions: Heat oven to place ground venison in a mixing bowl, add taco seasoning and mix to combine and then add egg whites and mix until well mixed. instructions: Wash and core tomatoes. Place in a bowl. Add half the golden syrup, rum, vanilla sugar and remaining golden syrup. Mix well. Cover and place in the refrigerator for 1 hour. title: Gravlax

instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees f. Fill a large heavy saucepan with water and bring to a boil. Combine sausage, aniseed, and salted water in a large plastic food storage bag and freeze for 2 weeks on the same day. Remove sausage from the freezer. Slice into bite size pieces. title: Gran's Easy Sponge Cake

instructions: Mix all the ingredients together. Using a sharp knife beat with a metal spoon to obtain a smooth, thick batter. title: Tomato Crumble (Vegan and Good)

title: Potato Sourdough Soda Bread
ingredients: 8 large potatoes, peeled and cubed ( yukon gold or golden circle golden ) | 2 tablespoons mayonnaise | 1/4 cup parsley, chopped | 3 -4 tablespoons rye bread, broken up
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Mix potatoes and mayonnaise well with a wooden spoon. Add parsely and bread. Mix well. Bake in a small oven proof skillet over medium heat until bread has absorbed the flavors and is bready and crisped up, about 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: white bread,rice noodle,pizza crust,black bean sauce
title: Quick and Easy Black Bean Grilled Pizza
ingredients: 1 package rice noodles | 1 can black bean in chili sauce, drained | 2 loaves white bread, cut into 1 inch squares | 1 pizza crust
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add rice noodles and cook until tender, about 4 minutes. Drain and set aside. Preheat the grill to medium high heat. Brush 1 side of the crust with some of the bean chili sauce. Cook the bread until lightly browned and puffed, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Place the bread, browned side up, on the pizza crust. Spread the remaining bean chili sauce over the bread and top with the cooked rice noodles. Sprinkle with more sauce if desired.

title: Italian Sausage and Fruit Skewers
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs italian sausage, remove casings | 1 1/2 lbs red cherries, rinsed, drained | 1 package firm tofu, drained | 1/4 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg, freshly grated | 1/4 cup fruit, chopped ( cherry or grape )
instructions: Preheat the grill. Lightly oil the grill grate. Cut the sausages crosswise into 1/2 inch thick slices. Remove the sausage from casings. Cut the cherries into bite sized pieces and rinse in a sieve in cold water for several minutes. Remove the pits and cut in half while they are still wet, then coarsely chop. Cut each slice in half again lengthwise. Pat the sausages dry with a paper towel. Thread the sausage, cherries and tofu onto three soaked wooden skewers, securing with toothpicks. Combine the spices and sugar in a dish and stir. Dip the sausages into the spices and sugar. Place on the prepared grill and cook them for 15 - 20 minutes, turning as needed until golden brown. Serve from skewers.

Random Ingredients: cayenne,hazelnut,chicken breast,orange flower water,sea scallop,vegetable juice,prosciutto,chicken bouillon cube
title: Prosciutto Wrapped Chicken With Hazelnut and Orange
ingredients: 600 g skinless chicken breasts | 1/2 cup hazelnuts, toasted and finely chopped | 2 slices prosciutto, thinly sliced | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 100 ml vegetable juice | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | 4 tablespoons fresh orange flower water | 1 can vacuum-packed orange segments with liquid, in natural juices, drained
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°c slice the chicken into 8 slices, making slits about an inch thick. Combine 1/4 cup toasted hazelnuts and one of the prosciutto slices. Spread mixture evenly over each chicken slice. Place remaining prosciutto and toasted hazelnuts over chicken slices. Wrap chicken in prosciutto ensuring that the nuts adhere. Place chicken on two large baking trays. Bake for 12 minutes then remove from the oven and arrange remaining prosciutto slices on top. Bake for 20 minutes or until chicken is just cooked through and tender. Meanwhile, place the chicken, orange juice, bouillon cube, vegetable juice, cayenne and orange flower water in a saucepan. Cover and bring to the boil, stirring until chicken is cooked through. Remove from heat and cool for 10 minutes. Cut chicken into pieces, stir through the orange and serve,.

title: Honey Green Tea Salad
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon dried porcilia ( if you're in spain, you can use green tea leaves or use fresh green leaves instead ) | 3 tablespoons green tea, steamed | 3 tablespoons brewed tea, cooled | 1 tablespoon honey | nonstick cooking spray
instructions: Place the porcili powder and steamed tea into a small mug. Let sit. In the meantime, combine honey and green tea. Slowly add the heated tea mixture to the mug. Taste and add more tea or honey if desired. Spoon into a pretty tea platter or individual serving bowls. Garnish with green onion flakes or cilantro sprigs.

Random Ingredients: radish,kaffir lime leaf,beef chuck roast,yellow squash,chicken wing,button mushroom,plain yogurt
title: Quick and Easy Thai Chicken Stew
ingredients: 4 pounds beef chuck roast, cut into 1-inch cubes | 32 ounces chicken wings, split | 8 ounces yellow squash, sliced into rings and cut into chunks | 8 ounces button mushrooms, sliced | 2 containers plain yogurt | 2 pounds radishes, sliced into thin circles | 1 kaffir lime leaves
instructions: Place the chuck roast in a large, deep pot, add enough water to cover the meat, and bring to a boil. Turn the heat to medium low and simmer until the meat is cooked through, about 25 minutes. Once the meat is cool enough to handle, discard any remaining fat and shred the meat using a fork or potato masher or a hand held blender. Return the meat to the soup pot along with the wings, yellow squash, mushrooms, and yogurt and stir to combine. Heat through and serve with radish strips, kaffir lime leaves, and raw vegetables for a complete meal.

Random Ingredients: bread,american cheese,grain white rice,guacamole,vanilla extract,dark rum,philadelphia cream cheese
title: Fiesta Rice Ball
ingredients: 1 package long grain white rice | 1 package philadelphia cream cheese, softened | 1 cup shredded american cheese | 1/2 cup chopped dark rum | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 2 cups diced white american cheese | 4 tablespoons dark rum | 1 loaf toasted bread
instructions: Combine the rice, cream cheese, american cheese, 1/2 cup of american cheese, dark rum, vanilla, and 2 cups of diced white cheese in a large bowl. Fold in to form a soft dough that holds together without breaking or breaking. Chill at least 1 hour. Cut the bread into cubes. Roll into 1 inch balls and arrange on a baking sheet. Chill until ready to serve. To serve, spread 1 tablespoon of dark rum over each ball and dust with remaining remaining toasted bread.

Random Ingredients: water chestnut,sage leaf,tomato green chile pepper,floury potato,heavy whipping cream
title: Potato Dumplings with Sage
ingredients: 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 pound floury potatoes, peeled and cut in half | 2 tablespoons flour, or as needed | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers, drained | 2 tablespoons dried sage leaves, or amount to taste
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Place heavy whipping cream in a large bowl. Add potatoes.

Random Ingredients: tomato sauce,cherry tomato,canadian bacon,yellow onion,grain white rice,mint leaf,marmalade
title: Bacon, Tomato and Rice Salad With Mint
ingredients: 250 g cherry tomatoes | 60 g sliced chard leaves or 60 g berry stems | 60 g sliced canadian bacon | 1 medium yellow onion, sliced | 3 1/2 ounces tomato sauce | 2 1/2 tablespoons of fresh mint leaves | 1 1/2 tablespoons of fresh mint leaves | 1 1/4 cups cooked long-grain white rice
instructions: Heat the grill pan or a barbecue on the high. Place the cherry tomatoes and chard leaves in a saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring to the boil. Decrease heat to low and leave to simmer, partially covered, for about 5 minutes or until aromatic. Meanwhile, fry the bacon over low heat, in a non stick frying pan, turning occasionally, until lightly colored and crisp. Add the onion and fry for about 3 minutes or until softened. Add the tomato sauce and 2 1/2 cups water and simmer, partially covered, for about 5 minutes and then remove from the heat and stir through all of the mint leaves. Remove the lid and stir through the rice. Season with salt and pepper to taste, then stir through, and serve with the bacon and mint.

title: Chicken & Noodles (Low Fat)
ingredients: 5 lbs chicken wings | 16 ounces noodles | 8 ounces bean | 3 tablespoons chicken bouillon | 2 cups cellophane noodles
instructions: Cook noodles in boiling water for 7 min.

Random Ingredients: rice wine,swiss cheese,salt pepper,seasoning mix,whipping cream,anchovy paste,mayonnaise,leg lamb
title: Jansson's Irish Lamb
ingredients: 12 small boneless leg of lamb | 8 slices swiss cheese | 1 cup whipping cream | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1/3 cup rice wine, white | 1 -2 tablespoon anchovy paste | salt and pepper, to taste | seasoning mix
instructions: Trim all fat from lamb legs. Remove lamb to a shallow roasting pan and cover with slices of cheese. Place a row of bread slices on cheese, then a row of meat. Close cheese with toothpicks to hold the bread in place. In a bowl, mix the remaining ingredients. Pour over lamb. Cover with plastic wrap and chill for 3 to 1 hours. Preheat oven to 375°f and bake for 2 hours, basting meat with the pan juices occasionally.

title: Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 300 g risotto rice | 1 red onion | 1 tablespoon vanilla sugar
instructions: Finely sliced red onion. Mix 2 t of dry rice powder with red onion, 1 t of vanilla sugar and 1 cup of milk. Simmer slowly, till milk thickens. Leave 1/2 cup of milk in the pot, so it can cool down a bit. Strain mix through strainer and use as required.

title: Quick & Easy Pasta Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces pasta, such as ditalini | 12 ounces tomato-vegetable juice cocktail | 1/2 teaspoon dried basil
instructions: Add tomato vegetable juice cocktail to 1 cup hot water and drain water from pasta. Set pasta aside. Add basil. Stir well. Put pasta and vegetables together in a bowl. Sprinkle with basil.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper,pace picante sauce,soya sauce,trout,galangal,jumbo pasta shell,green olive
title: Thai Shellfish With Green Olives and Chili Pepper
ingredients: 24 jumbo pasta shells | 2 cups mild chili peppers, diced | 2 tablespoons light soya sauce | 2 tablespoons pace picante sauce | 2 tablespoons chopped galangal | 1/2 cup chopped fish, such as monk fish, mahi-dahi, etc | 2/3 cup pitted sliced green olives
instructions: Preheat broiler. Place shells on a baking sheet and place under broiler. Roast 3 - 5 minutes, flipping shells halfway through. Meanwhile, place thai peppers, soya sauce, picante, galangal, and 2/3 cup water in a small sauce pan or small skillet over medium heat. Cook, stirring occasionally until slightly thickened, 1 to 2 minutes. Remove and set aside sauce. When peppers are done, remove from skillet and remove stems and seeds. Stir reserved sauce with remaining ¼ cup water in skillet. Stir in fish and olives and adjust seasonings to taste. Spoon sauce mixture into shells, and serve warm.

title: Chicken Korma
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken pieces | 1 large tomatoes, diced | 1 cup low-fat yogurt, plain | 1 parsnip, chopped ( optional ) | 1 1/4 cups wheat flour ( or plain cornmeal )
instructions: Mix the first 5 ingredients together. Roll out dough thin and cut into strips about 3 inches long. Heat a nonstick skillet. Add the chicken and cook on all sides for about 3 - 4 minutes. Remove the chicken and put on a serving dish. Put the tomato on top and use a spatula to scrape it around the tomatoes and chicken. Put in the microwave for another couple of minutes to get the tomatoes and chicken cooked through. Serve with warm milk.

title: Plum Bruschetta Pasta
ingredients: 1 1/8 kg plum tomatoes | 3 tablespoons cinnamon | 1/2 cup breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 3 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 loaf italian bread, cut in 2 cm cubes | 1 1/4 kg rigatoni pasta | 1 tablespoon cinnamon, for colour
instructions: Put the tomatoes through a food grinder, then pass it through a sieve. Pour the tomato pulp through a sieve and blend with the cinnamon in a bowl. Mix together the breadcrumbs and oil together. Toss together the pasta, bread crumbs and oil in a bowl. Spread a tablespoon of the tomato mixture in the bottom of an ovenproof dish. Arrange the pasta on top of the tomato sauce, then arrange the reserved crumbs on top of the tomato mixture. Place in a preheated 180 c oven for 25 - 30 minutes. To decorate, sprinkle extra cinnamon over the top of the breadcrumbs before serving. Cook's note, toast the breadcrumbs will not be crisp but will firm up as they cool.

title: Lebanese Twigs (Sharkling Oil)
ingredients: 1 cup dark corn syrup | 1 cup ghee
instructions: Put the corn syrup and ghee in a saucepan with some water over a medium heat. Bring to the boil, and boil for a few minutes. Remove from the heat and pour into a clean tea towel or muslin lined jelly cloth lined tubs. When cool rub out the excess moisture by rubbing the outside rim of the tubs with the palms of your hands. Break into pieces, place into storage jars & store in the fridge for up to a couple of months after making.

title: Swiss Pol Polish Sausage and Dates
ingredients: 16 white potatoes ( about 1 lb ) | 1 ounce rice flour | 1 tablespoon polsh or 1 tablespoon chow mein noodles | 1 tablespoon dried tarragon | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 2 teaspoons smoked paprika | 1/3 cup chunky cocoa powder ( optional ) | 4 polish sausages
instructions: Wash potatoes and slice into rounds. Slit lengthwise, about 1/4 inch thick. Slice sausage into 1 slices. Place potatoes in strainer, place potato slices under running water, and let drain. Cut slices crosswise 3/4 inch thick and place slices on baking sheet sprinkled with cocoa. Sprinkle with the tarragon, marjoram, paprika, and tarragon. Place on center rack of oven and bake, stirring occasionally. After 5 - 7 minutes, turn slices over and bake until dark brown, another 5 - 7 minutes. Let cool slightly and store in glass container, this will keep the casings from sticking and becoming brittle. These can also be frozen. When you are ready to make these, let the sausages cook about 15 minutes in a pot filled with about 1 1/2 quarts of water. Drain. Pour over noodles and mix well. Serve and enjoy.

title: Pecan Noodles
ingredients: 2 packages of regular noodles ( preferably chow mein noodles or linguine, about 12 minutes and should be about 16 ounces per package. ) | 1 1/2 gallons peanut oil ( for frying ) | 1/2 cup corn oil | 1 1/2 cups vinegar
instructions: Soak noodles in water overnight or for about 15 minutes, until they are softened but not yet tender. Drain and place in a deep pot of boiling water. Turn off heat. In a heavy skillet/skillet heat 1/2 c peanut oil. Add 1/2 cup corn oil and 1/2 cup vinegar.

title: Fiesta Tomatillo Salad
ingredients: 1 can tomatillos, drained and halved | 4 tablespoons french dressing ( use low-fat or low-fat ) | 1 yellow squash or 1 white squash, cooked and diced
instructions: Combine tomatillos, french salad dressing and pepper into a medium sized serving bowl. Toss gently until well blended. Add squash or turn into salad. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: swiss chard leaf,mexican cheese,red lentil,provolone cheese,horseradish,red chile powder,seasoning salt,tabasco sauce
title: Baked Lentil Swiss Chard Casserole
ingredients: 1 bunch swiss chard leaves ( or 1 lb regular chard stems and about 3 cups chopped and packed leaves, such as kale and mustard greens ) | 1/2 cup red lentil | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce | mexican cheese | crusty horseradish ( to taste ) | 1/2 cup crumbled shredded provolone cheese | 1 teaspoon crushed red chile powder ( or to taste ) | 1/4 teaspoon fresh minced red chile powder ( or to taste ) | 2 teaspoons prepared horseradish ( to taste )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f in a large baking dish, wash and chop the chard greens and place in a large bowl along with the lentils. Toss until the greens are coated with chard and lentils. Toss in 1/2 teaspoon of tabasco and mix well. Cover tightly with foil and transfer to the refrigerator to chill for 30 minutes, or overnight if more time permits. Combine the second 1/2 teaspoon of tabasco and the horseradish in the bowl of a food processor and, with a few turns, blend until smooth. Spread the cheese mixture in the bottom of a lightly greased 9 x 13 baking dish or quiche dish sprayed with cooking spray and sprinkle with the chard greens and red chili powder. Dot the top with the horseradish cream. Bake the casserole for 25 30minutes, covered and then uncover and bake for an additional 10 minutes, or until the top is crispy and browned. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Spinach Ricotta
ingredients: 2 bags fresh baby spinach | 1 container part-skim ricotta cheese | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1 container low-fat thawed whipped topping
instructions: Place spinach in a large serving bowl. In a small bowl, combine ricotta, lemon juice, and salt and pepper. Cover, and refrigerate at least 1 hour. Sprinkle with whipped topping just before serving.

Random Ingredients: thyme leaf,agave syrup,breadcrumb,suet,chicken breast half,dark soy sauce,self raising flour
title: The King's Chicken
ingredients: 2 kg boneless skinless chicken breast half | 1/2 cup self-raising flour | 1/2 cup breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons agave syrup | 2 teaspoons dark soy sauce | 2 teaspoons thyme leaves | 2 slices suet ( thick slices )
instructions: Preheat oven to 190c. Place the chicken breast halves between sheets of polythene and pound lightly with a meat mallet to flatten slightly. Place the flour in a plastic bag, then make a well in the centre of the flour, fill with the breadcrumbs, agave syrup, soy sauce, thyme and suet. Place in the oven for 45 - 50 mins or until cooked and golden. Serve with steamed greens.

title: Avocado-Lentil Pasta Salad
ingredients: 4 ounces rigatoni pasta, uncooked, whole grain | 5 ounces red lentils, rinsed | 2/3 cup tomato juice | 3 avocados, halved, pitted, and sliced | club soda ( optional )
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.

Random Ingredients: salad green,celery seed,kielbasa,grand marnier,bean,corn oil,parsley flake,spinach leaf
title: Spinach Salad
ingredients: 1 package mixed salad greens | 1 package spinach leaves, rinsed and torn | 4 ounces kielbasa, cut in 1 inch pieces | 1 teaspoon celery seed | 1/2 cup chopped fresh parsley flakes | 2 tablespoons grand marnier | 1/2 cup oil | 2 tablespoons corn oil
instructions: Wash lettuce and spin dry with paper towels. Place in a serving bowl. Slice kielbasa into 1/8 inch thick slices, leaving half inch thick. Dice spinach into 1 inch squares. Place in a large bowl with spinach, and sprinkle with celery seed, parsley and grand marnier. Whisk together oil, and corn oil and brush onto salad greens. Stir dressing and pour over greens and spinach. Serve immediately.

title: The Great Garlic Muffuletta
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 tablespoon fresh yeast ( or 2 1/2 teaspoons dry yeast flakes ) | 1 pinch dry sherry vinegar | 1 bay leaf ( or 1 medium-sized clove ) | 4 cups shredded mexican blend cheese
instructions: Mix the oregano and yeast together in a small bowl. Use a spoon to mix in the vinegar. Set aside. Sprinkle the bay leaf or cloves into a large bowl of a mixer. Add the mexican blend cheese and the yeast mixture. Beat until smooth, about 3 minutes using a mixer or large spoon. The dough will be quite moist. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured bread board. Gather 1 to 2 small balls of dough with a rolling pin, about the size of a walnut and then roll them into a 5 or 6 inch circle. With a very sharp knife, make 4 to 5 inch rounds on the dough. Poke some holes in the bread with a fork. Gently press between the rim of the circle and the edges of your hands so that your mashing action will spread evenly. Gently pull the dough circle and the crust from the center out to the edge and pinch off some of the dough with your fingers. Repeat on the second side of the crust. Repeat with the other pieces of dough. Place the loaf on a tray, loosely packed or well oiled and let stand until doubled, about 1 1/2 hours. Preheat the oven to 375°f. Place the bread on a baking sheet. Bake until the bottom is light gold. If you have difficulty getting the crust to color, place a baking stone in the oven to heat up for 5 to 10 minutes. Cool. Slice in 1/2 slices.

title: Smoked Sausage, Potatoes & Pepperonios
ingredients: 500 g breakfast sausages | 10 small yukon gold potatoes ( unpeeled ) | 1/2 cup peppercorn ( crushed ) | 3 slices white bread ( crusty, crusty wholemeal bread )
instructions: Preheat pan over med high heat. Add sausage meat and brown meat on both sides, drain excess fat. Add potatoes with half the pepper corns and bread to pan. Place lid on pan, reduce heat to med low and cook for about 30 - 40 minutes or until potato is almost tender.

title: French Bread Pizza
ingredients: 1 french bread dough ( frozen, not purchased ) | 1 cup frozen peas | 2/3 cup kalamata olive | 2/3 cup frozen french bread dough ( thawed )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees fahrenheit. Roll out frozen bread dough on a floured surface to the thickness of 1 inch. Bake frozen bread dough in the preheated oven until it is lightly golden, about 10 minutes. Stir peas and olives into frozen bread dough, then spread out evenly on a pizza pan. Bake in the preheated oven for 5 minutes, then cut into wedges using a pizza cutter. My note, i had a hard time combining the peas and olives in this recipe, and it was very easy. I took one out, and i had 2/3 of the recipe. I didn’t have a pizza cutter, it made the bread crumbs easier to work with. The peas were also very tasty the next day and just had no subsitutions when it was time to serve, it was the only time i could cook the peas and olives and olives. They were a little more tender this way. I just can't describe how much better i made them.

title: Chicken Tequila Grilled Skirt Steak
ingredients: 4 chicken breast halves, cut 1 1/2 inch thick | 1/2 green pepper, sliced thin | 1/4 ounce white tequila | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish
instructions: Pound slits in breasts, set aside. Place peppers, and remaining ingredients into a plastic bag.

Random Ingredients: nonfat milk,bacon,white rice,vanilla essence,white wine,corn oil
title: Rice With Bacon
ingredients: 1 can white rice | 500 ml nonfat milk | 200 -300 ml white wine | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 5 slices bacon | vanilla essence
instructions: Cook rice according to your specific recipe. Set aside. Over medium heat, melt corn oil in a skillet and cook bacon. Drain bacon pieces. In the pan, pour in the nonfat milk and rice and stir until creamy. Now add white wine and vanilla. Stir for 3 - 4 minutes.

title: Green Beans With Mexican Seasoning
ingredients: 2 lbs frozen green beans, thawed | 1/2 tablespoon mexican oregano
instructions: Heat 2 - ½ inches of water in large skillet or dutch oven over medium high heat. Sprinkle oregano on top. Add beans, cooking 3 - 5 minutes or until slightly browned.

title: Quinoa Pesto
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa ( uncooked ) | 1 cup cabbage, finely shredded | water | 1/4 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated
instructions: Soak the quinoa until water has been plump and fluffered. Combine the quinoa with the cabbage. Add water and cheese, and stir. Let flavors meld overnight.
