title: Spicy Garlic Scallions
ingredients: 1 bunch scallion ( ends trimmed and discarded ) | 4 curry leaves | 1 bunch scallion ( green parts trimmed and white parts chopped )
instructions: Steam the scallions in a small, shallow pot over medium high heat for 8 to 10 minutes, depending on the size of the scallions, until just starting to split but still some green sections on them. Remove to a bowl and let cool slightly, then chop roughly. Blend the scallions with the curry leaves in a blender until just the right texture to work with. Add scallion mixture, season with salt and pepper. Cover and refrigerate until cold, 2 to 4 hours.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,dark brown sugar,ginger snap,pork sausage,celery rib
title: Sweet & Savory BBQ Sausages
ingredients: 350 g pork sausage | 2 celery ribs, sliced | 1 small onion soup mix | 1 teaspoon grated ginger snap | 1/2 teaspoon dark brown sugar
instructions: Place sausages in a greased shallow dish. Combine remaining ingredients. Pour over sausages, cover and marinate overnight or for up to 3 days in the refrigerator, turning sausages over occasionally during grilling time. Cook under grill or grill until cooked through.

Random Ingredients: coconut oil,egg,black sesame seed,tabasco sauce,tomato,egg yolk,rotel
title: Quick and Easy Scrambled Eggs
ingredients: 4 teaspoons coconut oil | 6 -8 large eggs | 1 medium egg yolk, beaten | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce or 1/2 teaspoon other hot pepper sauce | 2 tomatoes, cut into thin wedges ( about 3 ounces ) | 1/2 teaspoon black sesame seed, lightly toasted | 1 teaspoon black sesame seed, lightly toasted
instructions: In a skillet, heat oil over medium heat. Fry eggs in oil until whites of thick whites are cooked, pour off oil. In a large bowl, combine eggs, yolk, hot pepper sauce, tomatoes.

title: Korean Teriyaki Meat (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 3 lbs lean ground beef | 1 cup fresh lovage, minced | 1 envelope fajita seasoning mix | 2 tablespoons ground lemongrass ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Pizzas (Pigs)
ingredients: 1 pizza dough, prepared | 1 1/2 - 2 cups grated manchego cheese | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs whole chicken legs
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Stretch out dough, cut it into 2x12 inch rectangles. Sprinkle with cheese. Place chicken legs in a deep, wide baking pan. Cover with foil and bake until golden brown, 25 to 30 minutes. You can also bake at 400 degrees f for 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,milk ricotta cheese,cardamom seed,virgin olive oil,walnut
title: Kolachi's  Walnut Cheese & Vegetable Ricotta Salpicao
ingredients: 3 cups milk ricotta cheese | 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1/4 cup walnuts, coarsely chopped | 2 teaspoons red curry paste | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seed, cracked | 1 teaspoon nutmeg, freshly grated
instructions: Blend all the ingredients together in a food processor until smooth and creamy. Refrigerate to allow time for flavours to develop. Enjoy with grilled, meats, fish, meat balls, or roasted vegies.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,chili paste,jalapeno chile,shiitake mushroom,black tea,parsley stem
title: Black Scented Mushrooms
ingredients: 8 fresh shiitake mushrooms | 8 fresh parsley stems | 8 jalapeno chile peppers, stemmed but left whole | 1/4 cup good black tea ( if using a non-appetizing cup ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons good green chili paste | 1 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese ( plus more to serve )
instructions: Wash the mushrooms, pat dry with paper towels. Finely chop the mushrooms. In a mortar, pound the parsley stems and chiles into a paste with the black tea to a fine paste. Pound in the black pepper paste. Remove the stems of the chiles and discard. Soak the mushroom caps briefly in warm water to soften, and remove the skin. Slice the caps thinly. In a mortar and pestle, pound the pepper paste into a course powder. Add the mushrooms and mix, adding more if needed. Spread the pepper mixture in an even layer on the mushroom caps. Sprinkle with the cheese and divide the herb mixture among the mushroom caps. Serve within an hour of making with your favorite tea enjoy.

Random Ingredients: yeast,garlic powder,avocado,flour tortilla,dijon mustard,chickpea,oregano leaf,jumbo shrimp
title: Guatemalan-Style Shrimp & Chickpeas
ingredients: 1 tablespoon yeast | 2 cups unbleached flour ( plus extra for dusting ) | 8 jumbo shrimp, cleaned, peeled and deveined | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1/2 teaspoon oregano leaves | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 1/2 cups chickpeas, drained | 3 avocados, peeled, halved, pitted and sliced | 12 flour tortillas
instructions: Dough, stir together yeast and 1 cup flour in a mixing bowl. While stirring, add remaining flour, about 1/3 cup at a time, mixing in as much bread flour as it can out of its spoon. Transfer flour to a bowl and set aside. Bowl, if the shrimp are frozen, allow 1 pound of frozen shrimp to thaw a bit to remove some of the water and saltiness. Drain the shrimp and pat dry. Spread 1 1/2 tablespoons dijon on one side of each shrimp. Sprinkle with oregano, garlic powder and salt. If shrimp are large, cut off tails and devein shrimp if they are tiny. Make an indentation in the center of shrimp with your thumb or a fork or skewer, so the shrimp release some of the air. Sprinkle shrimp with dijon. Top with about half the chickpeas, pressing them down and turning the shrimp so they are evenly distributed. You should have a very light layer of chickpeas. Top with the remaining chickpeas, pressing down with a spatula to create a smooth surface. Loosely cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled in size. This will take 2 1/2 to 3 hours. Line a cookie sheet with parchment paper. Place the tortillas on the baking sheet.

Random Ingredients: sea salt,chipotle chile,black olive,brown ale,cayenne,ice water
title: Beer Canning Beer
ingredients: 1 cup ice water | 2 tablespoons brown ale | 1 dried chipotle chile, seeded ( with adobo or cascabel ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon cayenne or 1/4-1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 1/4 cup whole black olives, finely chopped | sea salt or kosher salt
instructions: Pour water into canning ring and bring all ingredients to a boil. Place a rack into large pan or canner and add ice and beer canner lid. Bring back to a boil and then allow liquid to bubble away. Do not move the canner until the boiling dies down. After the water has been bubbling away, turn the canning ring on to a cold towel and allow canning. When cool, remove jars and label. Store in the freezer before storing in a cool jar or dark cupboard. Refrigerate for up to 3 days. Makes about 4 dozen sterilized canning jars.

title: Mock Outback Swiss Dip
ingredients: 1 package shredded swiss cheese | 1 jar alfredo sauce | 1 tablespoon fresh tarragon vinegar
instructions: Spread swiss cheese in medium bowl. Spread alfredo sauce on top of cheese, then sprinkle with tarragon vinegar.

title: Chili Curry Pasta
ingredients: 12 ounces penne rigate | 1 -2 tablespoon curry powder | 6 tablespoons chili-garlic sauce
instructions: Cook pasta as directed on package until al dente. Toss with curry sauce. Note, for a thicker sauce, stir in a little water.

title: Crock Pot Sweet and Sour Pork
ingredients: 3 lbs pork tenderloin, cut into 6 inch pieces | 4 -5 stalks celery, sliced | 1 can jalapenos, sliced in thin rings ( i have used other vegetables to make it ) | 1/2 lb beef stew meat | 2 tablespoons lemon zest | 1/2 cup lemon juice
instructions: Layer pork with celery, sliced jalapenos, beef, zest and lemon juice in slow cooker. Cover, cook on low for 8 - 10 hours. Serve over rice.

Random Ingredients: alfalfa sprout,chinese noodle,almond meal,shiitake mushroom,cheddar cheese,pepperoncini pepper,stewing beef,green chili
title: Chinese Noodle and Beef Salad
ingredients: 500 g fresh chinese noodles | 300 g stewing beef | 2 sliced peppersoncini peppers | 1 green chili, chopped | 1 cup cheddar cheese, grated | 1 cup alfalfa sprouts | 1 cup shiitake mushroom, sliced | 1 tablespoon roasted almond meal
instructions: Soak noodles in boiling water 5 minutes and drain. Cut meat into strips and heat up in a frying pan until brown and tender. Add veggies, mix well and let cool while preparing salad. Top noodles with beef mixture and sprinkle with almonds.

title: Hot Chocolate With Juniper Berries
ingredients: 1 tablespoon pure vanilla | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 yellow onion, diced | 4 juniper berries | 2 drops dark chocolate
instructions: In a small pot heat the dark chocolate until soft. Place the pot on the stove top, add the diced onion and the juniper berries and stir until the onion is soft and translucent. Add the dark chocolate and stir for 1 minute. Remove from heat and set aside for 10 minutes to cool down the mixture. After ten minutes stir the cooled chocolate into the mixture and refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning,vanilla essence,fennel seed,bread cube,green olive,rib beef
title: Costa Rican Style Beef and Pimento Skewers
ingredients: 450 -455 g rib eye steaks | 1 packet taco seasoning | 200 g green olives | 4 slices bread cubes | 1 fennel seed ( crushed ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: First place all the ingredients into the bowl of a freezer bag, make sure all the ingredients are completely thawed. Cut meat into approximately 4 long thin slices, then thread them onto the skewers. Grill or broil using the instructions of your choice until meat is cooked.

title: Greek Avocados (Breaded Avocados)
ingredients: 2 large avocados ( ripe but not quite ripe ) | 1 1/4 - 1 1/2 cups italian style breadcrumbs | 2 teaspoons dried lemongrass, crushed | 1/3 cup instant minced onion | 1 cup crumbled feta cheese | 1 cup crumbled fresh italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1/3 cup triple sec ( or to taste ) | assorted prepared soup, for dipping ( optional )
instructions: Cut avocados into thick slices. Place the slices on a baking sheet or parchment paper. In a medium bowl, stir together bread crumbs, lemon grass and minced onion until evenly moistened. In a small bowl, combine feta and italian bread crumbs and combine well. Add the crumb mixture to the avocado slices and toss to coat. Place the avocado slices in an ungreased baking dish, and bake at 400 degrees for 20 to 30 minutes. Serve with condiments.

title: American Kitchen Classic Tacos
ingredients: 1 pound beef, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 pound pork sausage | 2 cans tomato puree | 1 package taco seasoning | 1/3 pound pickling onions, sliced | ground mace
instructions: Brown meat in large skillet. Remove from heat. Add tomato purée and taco seasoning.

title: Coco-Banana Delight (Pulp Method)
ingredients: 2 lbs chopped fresh spinach | 2 medium bananas | 2 teaspoons pure almond extract | 1/2 cup light rum ( i use bacardi )
instructions: Chop the greens and peel the banana, remove the bananas from the peel and mash with a fork, then mash the bananas together with the remaining ingredients, stirring well. Store in the refrigerator. Pulp Method, place the spinach in a bowl. Using a plastic bean/limed knife, slice the spinach leaves off the stem, then mix in with the other ingredients except the rum. Heat the rum in a small saucepan, add the rum and warm through, but do not boil.

title: Italian Pork Burgers (Cookers)
ingredients: 1 lb boneless italian bread, cut into 1/2 inch by 2 inch cubes | 2 cans pinto beans | 1 package pepperoni ( sliced ) | cooking oil
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl and mix well. Shape into 8 small patties. Pan fry in hot oil for 2 - 3 minutes on each side or until browned and thoroughly cooked.

title: Thai Shrimp With Nuts
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried shrimp ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon thai fish sauce | 1 pinch of mixtures of nuts, of your choosing ( i like pine nuts, walnuts or pecans ) | 1 green pepper
instructions: Add fish sauce and nut to your shrimp. Stir well.

Random Ingredients: cooking spray,garam masala,pork tenderloin,russet potato,fennel bulb,golden raisin,tomato juice
title: Baked Pork and Potatoes
ingredients: 3 large russet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1-inch chunks | cooking spray | 2 pounds pork tenderloins, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 garlic cloves, cut into slivers | 1 tablespoon all-purpose garam masala | 1/2 cup packed golden raisins | 3/4 cup canned diced tomatoes with juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Mix potatoes, spray coating over sides with cooking spray. Bake in preheated oven for 40 minutes, stirring halfway through. Add pork, garlic and garam masala to potatoes. In a separate dish, combine raisins, tomatoes and juice. Spray a 2½ quart baking dish with cooking spray. Add gravy to pork mixture, tossing to coat. Cover with foil. Bake at 300 degrees f for 1 hour.

title: Kevia-Lime Baked Potatoes
ingredients: 4 large baking potatoes | 6 tablespoons lemon juice | 1 teaspoon stevia
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Using cookie scoop, scoop out each potato in the shape of a fan and using a spoon, press the potato gently into the baking sheet. Place the potato on top of waxed paper or parchment paper to cool. When cool, squeeze the excess moisture out of each potato. Place the cooled potatoes on a baking sheet and sprinkle with the stevia.

Random Ingredients: el paso taco sauce,guacamole,gingerroot,vegetable stock,cooking sherry,chicken stock,red bell pepper,courgette
title: Vegetable Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 1/2 quarts vegetable stock | 2 cans hot chicken stock | 1 cup finely chopped courgette | 2 tablespoons quick-cooking sherry | 1 tablespoon grated fresh gingerroot | 1 tablespoon el paso taco sauce ( or more to taste ) | 1 large guacamole, to serve | 1 large red bell pepper, cut into matchsticks
instructions: Combine the first 5 ingredients in a deep pan or wok, stir to combine, bring to the boil. Reduce heat, simmer, uncovered, for about 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Stir in the guacamole.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,hot pepper,rosemary sprig,saffron strand,irish cream,romano cheese
title: Saffron Chocolates With Saffron & Rosemary
ingredients: 200 g hot peppers ( scotch bonnet or poblano peppers ) | 3 -4 saffron strands ( per person ) | 100 g dark chocolate ( or use semi sweet chocolate if the flavor is too intense ) | 1 1/2 pints romano cheese, cut into small cubes and very finely grated | 4 -6 rosemary sprigs | 6 -10 saffron strands ( per person ) | 6 -12 saffron strands ( per person ) | 6 -10 hot pepper slices, cut diagonally into strips then cut in half ( per person )
instructions: Place all ingredients except for the chocolates, into a pan and boil for about 15 - 20 minutes or until the chocolates become almost dry, but not watery. It is important to keep stirring frequently. The longer it simmers the more aromatic it will be. If the chocolates get to dry, add a little water. Add the chocolates in a steady stream and stir until all the mixture has absorbed the oil. Add more hot pepper slices per bowl as needed at a time to keep the mixture smooth. Store in an airtight container.

title: Irish Celery Seasoning
ingredients: 6 celery ribs | 2 teaspoons salt
instructions: Place celery ribs in strainer, sprinkle with celery salt and leave out. Melt butter or margarine in a medium nonstick frying pan. Place celery over medium heat and quickly brown the celery. Stir a few times during cooking to let the celery brown evenly. Remove celery to heated plate. Serve warm.

title: Mexican Cabbage Slaw and Cherry Lushes
ingredients: 5 -6 heads savoy cabbage | 12 kaffir lime leaves, fresh | 3 -4 tablespoons olive oil or 3 -4 tablespoons grapeseed oil | 2 tablespoons honey | 1 jar maraschino cherries
instructions: Core cabbage and place in a large bowl with lime leaves. Sprinkle with sugar and drizzle a little oil on top. Toss to coat. Cover and let sit at room temperature for up to a day. When ready to serve, stir fry cherry pieces in a little bit of oil until they are warmed and add to cabbage. Dress with a mixture of honey and the rest of the honey & toss.

Random Ingredients: pine nut,coconut oil,spring onion,pistachio,guacamole,basmati rice,pie crust
title: Thai Pine Nut Rice Pie
ingredients: 3 teaspoons coconut oil | 5 spring onions, sliced into 1/2-inch lengths | 1/2 cup pistachio, coarsely chopped | 230 g shredded coconut ( flaked ) | 200 g basmati rice, cooked and chilled | 1 1/2 cups guacamole | 5 sheets pie crust, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c with a baking stone on the middle rack of the oven. Heat the oil in a frypan and fry the onions for 3 to 5 minutes or until starting to soften. Stir in the pistachio and cook about 1 minute, stirring. Remove from heat. Stir in the coconut and rice and leave to cool, stirring occasionally. Remove the rice mixture from the refrigerator. Divide the rice mixture among the pie crusts and spread out to about 3/4 inch thick. Spread on guacamole, then top with the rice mixture and sprinkle over the nuts and coconut flakes. Bake in the oven for 30 minutes until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: filet beef,kiwi fruit,head cabbage,egg yolk,beef bouillon cube,beef broth,allspice
title: Jamaican Beef and Kiwifruit Soup
ingredients: 1 can beef broth, 2 cups | 1 beef bouillon cube | 8 slices lean filet of beef, 1/2-inch thick | 1/2 small head of cabbage, thinly sliced | 1 kiwi fruit, peeled and sliced | 3 egg yolks | ground allspice
instructions: Combine broth and bouillon cube and bring to a boil over high heat. Add steak and cabbage.

title: Hibiscus Jelly Chicken
ingredients: 600 g ketchup | 4 tablespoons dried hibiscus flowers | 300 g chicken thighs or 300 g breasts, washed | 200 g hibiscus flowers, cut small
instructions: Cut small slits in chicken meat, and rub with 1 tbsp ketchup. Place chicken in a jelly bag and pour over about 4 tbsp jhibiscus. Cover and put in the freezer for 20 minutes. Remove and discard the ketchup. Place chicken in a roasting pan and roast for about 1 hour at 220° ct/ 325°f.

title: Fruit Salad
ingredients: 4 pints mixed greens | 3 1/2 ounces smoked ham, cubed | 1 3/4 ounces sweet cooked bacon, chopped | 1/4 cup hazelnuts, toasted and chopped | 1/2 cup cherry tomatoes, halved | 1/4 cup fresh thyme sprig, chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons mirin | 1 cardamom pod, seeds removed
instructions: Place all the salad ingredients in a large bowl. Pour over enough hot water to cover and toss to combine. Cover and store in the refrigerator until chilled.

title: Sweet and Savory Chicken Pot Roast
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts | 1 medium russet potato | 2 medium sweet potatoes | 1 small sweet onion ( or 2 small red onions ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons pure vanilla extract | 1 tablespoon real vanilla extract
instructions: Using a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat, add the chicken to a single layer and cook until lightly browned and crispy, 15 - 20 minutes or until brown on the outside, no longer pink inside. Transfer the chicken to a plate and keep warm. Turn the heat down to medium and place the whole sweet potato in a microwave safe dish. Microwave on full power for about 5 minutes or until the sweet potatoes are browned on the edges and the skin is golden, 15 - 20 minutes. Shred the potatoes, slice in half lengthwise and set aside. When the chicken is done, remove from the skillet. Discard the fat remaining in the pan. Slice the breasts into 1/8 slices. Place the fat, potatoes, onion, one half each of vanilla and vanilla and the other half of the vanilla in a large casserole dish or other casserole. Sprinkle the chicken with salt and freshly ground black pepper and toss with the chicken. Cover and microwave on high 15 - 20 minutes. Let rest for 5 minutes and then serve.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,white sugar,wild rice,mango chutney,kosher salt,cherry
title: Wild Rice With Cherries
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups uncooked wild rice | 1 3/4 cups diced fresh mango chutney, divided ( such as major greys ) | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 1/2 cup diced candied cherries ( optional ) | 1/4 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Pour rice into an oven safe dish just large enough to hold in the slow cooker. Stir 1 1/2 cups mango chutney, kosher salt, and cherries into the rice until combined. Spoon 1/4 of the rice mixture over the rice mixture to cover evenly. Repeat layers with remaining rice and mango chutney mixture, finishing with a sprinkling of chopped parsley. Cover with a lid or aluminum foil, and bake in the preheated oven until the liquid has nearly evaporated, about 35 minutes. Allow to rest, covered, before serving.

title: Apple Juice Substitute(Yumminess)
ingredients: 3 medium apples, peeled, cored, and finely diced ( use 3 medium to 4 medium per apple and 3 medium high apple ) | ground coriander powder ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. If the mix is to dry add some hot water.

title: Lebanese Gingerbread (Shaker)
ingredients: 1 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1 cup rye flour ( i prefer rye flour ) | 1 cup cake flour | 1/2 cup fresh gingerroot, finely chopped or grated | 4 tablespoons light rye flour, for gluten free use white rice bran oil ( see soyboy )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f, with a baking stone placed on the middle rack. In a medium bowl, sift and combine panko and rye flours. Set aside. In a small nonstick frying pan placed over medium low heat, lightly fry ginger for about 5 minutes, stirring constantly. Add dark rice bran and stir to combine. Remove from heat and stir in ginger mixture. Transfer dough to an oiled bowl and flatten into a 1/2 circle. If desired, flatten dough out to 1/4 inch thickness on baking stone. Place on baking stone and immediately sprinkle with ginger mixture. Cook for 10 minutes while you make the topping. Remove gingerbread and sprinkle with light rye flour. Allow to cool for 10 minutes. Cut into wedges and eat.

title: Smokey, Tasty & Tasty Stuffed Red Potatoes
ingredients: 1 packet red potatoes ( chats or russets ) | pesto sauce | 1/2 cup mango chutney ( or chutney ) | 1 -2 tablespoon rye bread, crumbs ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c/400°f. Steam the potatoes for 5 - 7 minutes until easily pierced. Then slice thinly and place in a large bowl or roaster. Cut the cooked and cooled potatoes into half, then place cut side up in the centre of the potatoes. Combine the pesto sauce and chutney in a small saucepan and allow to warm through. Stir the mixture just before serving, then spoon on the potato mix. Drizzle generously with pesto sauce. Serve hot or cold. Nb/ if not eating right away, store potato mixture in refrigerator to keep moist.

title: Roasted Raisin and Cranberry Butter
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups raisins | 1/2 cup vegetable shortening | 1 jar craisins
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Melt the shortening in a small skillet over medium heat. Combine remaining raisins with craisins and stir to coat. Remove from heat, but stir in melted shortening and melted shortening. Spread onto a sheet of parchment or wax paper and bake for 1 hour or until it's spreadable with no grainy crumbs.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,back bacon,english pea,golden caster sugar,sesame seed,eggplant,cumin
title: Eggplant, Cranberry, Sesame and Pea Salad
ingredients: 3 large eggplants, peeled and cut into chunks | 1 1/2 cups english pea, shelled | 50 g smoked back bacon, cut into 1cm slices | 120 g broccoli florets, trimmed, washed and drained | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 teaspoon golden caster sugar | sesame seeds, to serve
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large saucepan and simmer for about 15 minutes, until the vegetables are tender. Toss through the cumin and sugar and season. Serve sprinkled with the sesame seeds.

title: Smoky Avocado Pork Wraps
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 bunch canadian bacon, chopped | 4 ounces cream cheese, softened | 1 large avocado, chopped | 4 ounces cooked pork, chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Spread the canadian bacon, cream cheese, avocado and pork onto 4 of the four wraps. Wrap up each roll and bake for 15 to 20 minutes in the preheated oven, or until crispy.

Random Ingredients: bread,vegetable,mushroom cap,mexican cheese,turmeric,cumin powder,poblano chile,sesame oil
title: Mexican Cheese Pizzas
ingredients: 1/2 lb mushroom caps, stems cut into halves ( fresh or canned ) | 1/8 cup mushroom cap, sliced on the thin side | 1/8 cup fresh vegetable, chopped ( or your favorite veggie ) | 1/4 cup toasted sesame oil | 1/4 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric | 14 slices bread, cut into 1-inch pieces ( about 7 slices per pizza ) | 2 poblano chiles, stems removed seeded and sliced on the thin side
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender jar.

title: Czechic Eggplant (Aubergine) Cake With Lime and Chocolate
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs eggplants, 1/4 to 2-inches thick | 4 quarts cold water | 3 1/4 cups unsweetened cocoa powder, 1/4 cups | 1 teaspoon lime zest, grated | 1/3 cup olive oil | 1 tablespoon peppercorn
instructions: Char the eggplant over a gas flame or under a broiler until blackened on all sides. Let cool slightly, and trim off ends. Cut into quarters, and set skin side down on a rimmed baking sheet. Bake for 1 to 1 1/4 hours at 425°f. The skins should wrinkle and darken. Allow to cool completely. Remove eggplant skins, and carefully slit them lengthwise in a half moon shape with a serrated knife. If not using immediately, cover loosely with lid. Melt butter in a medium pot over low heat, and stir in 1/3 cup cocoa.

title: Spanakor -- Snow Peas With Snow Peas
ingredients: 2 bags frozen snow peas | 2 packages frozen vermicelli ( about 9 sheets ) | 1 large onion, chopped ( about 2 cups ) | 2 tablespoons nonfat milk | 1/2 cup vanilla sugar
instructions: Place frozen peas, vermicelli, onion, and milk in a blender along with vanilla sugar.

title: Clams Spam
ingredients: 8 lbs spam | 1 can tomato juice
instructions: Brown on all sides in 2 tablespoons olive oil. When finished browning add can of tomato juice. Simmer slowly until sauce is slightly thick. Serve on platter in sauceboat and garnish with parsley to taste.

Random Ingredients: pancetta,tomato green chilies,beef steak,kernel corn,artichoke heart
title: Mexican Panhandle Beef
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef top round steak, cut into 1/2-inch strips ( or sirloin steak ) | 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts, drained and quartered | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 1 package pancetta, cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f. Coat 12 inch nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Place beef in skillet.

Random Ingredients: italian spice,chuck blade roast,crawfish tail,cornflour,berry,cashew,black olive,black peppercorn
title: Crock Pot - Italian Style
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs chuck blade roast, cubed | 1 jar cashews, sliced or cans sliced black olives | 1 can whole cornflour | 1 lb frozen mixed berries, thawed | 2 -3 tablespoons italian spices | 1 -2 tablespoon coarsely crushed black peppercorns | 1 package frozen chopped broccoli with cauliflower | 1 package fresh frozen crawfish tails, thawed
instructions: Spray crock pot with cooking spray. Add meat, cashews, olives, cornflour, mixed berry's, italian seasoning and peppercorns to crock pot. Cook on low for 8 to 10 hours.

title: Sauerkraut and Egg Salad
ingredients: 2 cups sauerkraut | 4 thin radishes, grated | 1/4 cup sultana raisin | 2 dill pickles, thinly sliced
instructions: Place sauerkraut, radishes, raisins, and pickles in a salad bowl.

title: Pan-Fried Beef Tenderloin With Eggs and Chilies
ingredients: 4 beef tenderloin, slices 1/4 inch thick | 2 1/2 tablespoons aji chilies or 2 1/2 tablespoons aji panca chilies | lettuce leaf | 1 egg white, lightly beaten
instructions: In a small frying pan on medium heat, toast chiles in hot oil. Remove from pan and set aside to cool slightly. Using a slotted spoon, transfer chiles to a plate while keeping hot. Pat all over with a paper towel, leaving any oil remaining in the pan. Trim any fat from the tenderloin. Using two forks, slice meat diagonally across the grain. If the slices aren’t too thin, cut in half horizontally and then again vertical. Transfer the slices to a plate and set aside. Add the aji, lettuce, and egg white to a medium skillet over medium heat and cook, stirring constantly with a fork, until thick and hot, 3 - 5 minutes. Remove from heat and serve topped with chilies.

Random Ingredients: velveeta cheese,cream mushroom soup,pear,dark sesame oil,active yeast,sugar snap pea,tomato green chile pepper,scallion
title: Easy Baked Baked Mexican Bread
ingredients: 1 tablespoon active dry yeast | 1/4 cup undiluted sour cream or 1/4 cup low-fat sour cream | 1 teaspoon sugar or 3 teaspoons splenda sugar substitute | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 8 ounces mild velveeta cheese, cut into 2-inch chunks | 1 can reduced-sodium condensed cream of mushroom soup, undiluted | 1 can whole pears, drained, patted dry, coarsely chopped, peeled if desired | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers, drained | 1 scallion, cut into 2-inch pieces
instructions: In medium bowl, dissolve yeast in sour cream. Add sugar, oil, half the cheese, soup, pears, chiles, and scallions, stirring until well blended.. Stir in last velveeta, breaking up chunks as needed for desired texture. Spread mixture into 2 greased 9x5 inch loaf pans. Bake at 350°f about 40 minutes or until top springs back when lightly pressed. Cool on rack for 10 minutes before removing to rack.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,green tea,pigeon pea,snow pea,bamboo shoot,hard egg,apple juice,lemon juice
title: Green Tea and Apple Shoot Soup
ingredients: 4 cups vegetable stock | 2 slices lemon rind | 5 tablespoons green tea | 150 ml apple juice | 1/4 cup bamboo shoot | 150 g small fresh green peas, trimmed | 2 hard-boiled eggs, diced | 100 g shucked pigeon peas
instructions: Combine the stock, rind and lemon rind and bring to boil. Add the green tea, apple juice and bamboo shoots. Simmer for five minutes. Add the peas and egg and cook for five minutes. Ladle into soup tureen and garnish with chopped parsley or coriander.

title: Potato Rice Pilaf #5FIX
ingredients: 5 packets saffron strands | 20 fresh fruit | 3 matzo crackers | 2 pints mixed salad greens | 1 bag of mixed salad greens
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large pot on medium heat, stirring the mixture to combine well as the grains will absorb all the flavors. Cover the pot and let the mixture simmer for 5 minutes. Serve warm enjoy with fresh fruit salad for a great winter meal.

Random Ingredients: walnut half,pimento,pine nut,allspice berry,colby monterey jack cheese,coconut
title: Pine Nut Stuffed Pimentos (Capelles De Pix)
ingredients: 2 cups shredded coconut | 6 dried pimento ( jamon, arabic, etc., may also sub 1/3 cup shredded fontina if you wish ) | 1 can walnut halves ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon ground allspice | 2 tablespoons shredded colby-monterey jack cheese | 2 tablespoons sliced toasted pine nuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. In a small bowl, stir together coconut, pimentos, walnuts and allspice. Place mixture in a baking dish, cover, and bake until tender, about 20 minutes, stirring every 5 - 10 minutes. Remove from oven and top with cheese. Sprinkle pine nuts over the top, return to oven, and bake 5 minutes.

title: Beefy Oranges With Oranges
ingredients: 4 oranges ( or any other citrus of choice ) | 1 package cream cheese | 1 tablespoon beef bouillon granules | 2 teaspoons garlic paste, chopped & crushed | freshly sliced olive, to taste | chopped fresh orls or other fresh herb, to taste ( i use a combo of both )
instructions: Preheat oven for 350f degrees. Slice the oranges and arrange in greased jelly roll pan. Beat the cream cheese with the bouillon until smooth. Add the garlic and beef bouillon. Spread cream cheese mixture over the orange slices. Spread olives over the cream cheese mixture. Bake for 20 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly. Serve hot or cold.

title: Green Eggs and Sausage  and Scalloped Almonds
ingredients: 6 ounces pork sausage ( or other pork sausage ) | 1 can green enchilada sauce ( or less, if desired ) | 1/4 cup finely chopped italian parsley ( flat-leaf italian parsley ) | 1/4 cup finely chopped dill | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped blanched almond | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped tapioca
instructions: Remove casings from sausage and crumble and cook sausage under broiler or in a medium frying pan for about 5 - 6 minutes, turning to brown evenly. Drain sausage on paper towels, when cool enough to handle, remove sausage and set aside. Combine in a 1 1/2 cup glass baking dish the enchilada sauce, 1/4 cup parsley, dill, almonds and remaining 1/4 cup parsley in a small bowl and stir until well combined. Sprinkle tapioca over sausage and top with remaining breadcrumbs. Dot with butter. Bake in a 375°f oven for 40 minutes or until well browned on top and bubbly.

title: Crispy Cabbage Bites
ingredients: 3 cups coarsely sliced cabbage | 2 egg bread or 2 egg white | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. In a colander over a bowl, toss the cabbage with the egg bread. Spread the coating slightly in a paper cone shape. Cut into 24 smaller rounds with a serrated knife, dip them in the warm egg white and then into the finely chopped pieces of ginger garlic to coat. Bake for 15 minutes, then cool on a rack.

title: Green Tea Prosciutto Rounds
ingredients: 4 ounces prosciutto, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons green food coloring, approx | 5 tablespoons low fat whole wheat pastry flour
instructions: Place the prosciutto between two sheets of waxed paper or on a plate with a smooth surface. Using a pastry brush, apply the green colouring to the prosciutto and place the flour on top. Use a fork to press in a small amount of the flour to evenly coat the outside of the pieces. Repeat until all the flour is used. Place about 2 teaspoons of the prosciutto mixture on a slightly flattened pastry round and dust each round with a little additional flour and then transfer to a clean square sheet. Repeat and dust with more flour. Wrap the round in waxed paper and freeze for at least 1 hour. Store the rounds out of direct light in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks. Cut the rounds with a sharp paring knife into 1/2 thick slices and place on parchment paper or baking paper lined baking sheets to freeze until firm, about 1 hour.

title: Rice, Couscous and Snow Peas
ingredients: 2 cups jasmine rice | 1 can snow peas, halved | 2 cups rice, cooked | 1 cup hummus, of your choice
instructions: Cook rice as directed on box. Meanwhile, preheat oven to 350 degrees. Spread hummus on a cookie sheet. Bake 5 minutes to warm in oven or until spread has a firm texture. Spread onto your favorite salad. Eat and enjoy.

title: Peachy Chicken Drumsticks
ingredients: 8 skinless chicken drumsticks | 2 cups basil, and | fresh basil, chopped | 1/2 cup yellow onion, thinly sliced | 2 cups sliced peaches | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. Arrange 2 large shallow baking pans in a large roasting pan and place the drumsticks in the pans. Stir in the basil, onion, peaches, baking soda, and vanilla. Bake for 45 minutes, basting frequently with the pan juices. Allow to stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Fig and Greek Spiced Noodles
ingredients: 4 ounces dried chinese noodles ( rice-shaped ) | 6 -8 fresh figs | parsley ( fresh minced for garnish )
instructions: Cover the noodles in cold water and soak them for 6 - 8 hours. Meanwhile, rinse the figs and cut them into small pieces. Cook the figs in a small saucepan with boiling water until tender. Drain the noodles and pour on cold water to cool them, then drain again and set aside. Dice the figs finely. Arrange the noodles on a large serving platter and sprinkle it with minced fresh parsley. Spoon figs around the noodles and serve at once.

title: Confectioners'Sugar
ingredients: 3 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 2 -4 tablespoons syrup or 2 -4 tablespoons melted dark chocolate | kosher salt, for dusting ( optional )
instructions: The confectioners' sugar is an excellent source of soft and smooth semolina, and will keep for a week or two in the refrigerator. The best choice is good quality, flavored sugar. If you don't have any, you can make a paste of your favourite confectioners' sugar and proceed with your recipe. If you need to use the kosher salt, sprinkle it over the semolina rather than holding it down with your hands. A sprinkling is also a pleasant addition. When making this past weekend or early in the week, you can sprinkle on a layer of confectioners' sugar to simulate the typical colored confectioners' sugar with yellow sprinkles.

title: Kuwaiti Kebabs
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups mayonnaise | 4 cardamom seeds | 6 -7 cups cooking oil ( for the frying )
instructions: Place the cardamoms and mayonnaise in a blender. Add about 4 - 6 cups of hot water, stir well. The consistency should not be too thick, but you can thin, but not thin, to your liking. Add the cardamom seeds, mix a little bit, and pour into a bowl. If you feel it is too wet, just drop a little more. For authenticity, just add a little more, if necessary. For authenticity, add a few drops of maggi, or kava flavored oil to taste. You can leave out the cardamom seeds, if you don't want them added to the mix. You should end up with a kebab that is slightly moist. The mixture can also be stored in the refrigerator until serving time. It is usually found in the refrigerator section of the grocery store where the bar is usually served. Some like to leave out the cardamom seeds. It can easily be taken out in a minute or two and it can be used in other dishes.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,red apple,poppy seed,sun tomato oil,clam,apricot half,mayonnaise
title: Apple Clam Salad
ingredients: 4 small red apples, thinly sliced | 16 tablespoons chopped sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained | 2 cans stewed apricot halves, drained | 2 cans clams, drained | 1 cup mayonnaise | 1/4 cup sweet mango chutney | 1 tablespoon poppy seed ( optional )
instructions: In a large bowl, toss apples with sun dried tomatoes, apricots, clams and mayonnaise. Season with mango chutney and poppy seeds. Chill.

title: Peach, Mahc and Guacamole
ingredients: 2 large fresh peaches, sliced into 8 pieces | 2 tablespoons molasses, divided | 3 tablespoons dijon mustard, divided | 6 cups hot cooked rice | 1 cup guacamole
instructions: Place peach slices on a serving platter. Douse peaches with 1 tablespoon of molasses.

title: Southern Potato Salad I
ingredients: 5 pounds red potatoes, scrubbed, sliced into 1/4 inch thick slices | 1 1/2 pounds cooked beef stew meat, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 3 scallions, chopped | 1 teaspoon mustard seed
instructions: Place potatoes into a large pot and cover with lightly salted water.

title: Cabbage Mint Coleslaw
ingredients: 1 head cabbage, outer core removed | 1 package dry ranch-style dressing mix | 3 tablespoons fresh mint leaves, chopped
instructions: Core and core cabbage, removing tough outer leaves of outer leaves. Place cabbage in large bowl and sprinkle with ranch style dressing mix. Cover and refrigerate at least 8 hours and up to 12 hours, stirring well occasionally. Drain off all but 1 tablespoon mint leaves before serving.

Random Ingredients: mint leaf,orzo pasta,heavy whipping cream,rice wine,peppermint extract,garam masala,grouper fillet
title: Orzo Bombay
ingredients: 4 grouper fillets | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1 teaspoon dried mint leaves | 1 tablespoon minced fresh mint leaves | 1/4 teaspoon dried mint extract | 1/2 pint heavy whipping cream | 2 tablespoons dry rice wine | freshly cracked peppermint leaves ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place grouper fillets on a rack in a baking dish, and rub the fillets with garam masala & dried mint leaves. Cover with foil and bake 10 minutes or until fillets are just lightly browned. Meanwhile, combine mrs. Dash & mint extract and mint in a small bowl. Gradually whisk heavy cream into cream mixture, and pour over fillets. Cover, and bake 15 minutes, or until cream thickens slightly. Season with peppermint. Serve over orzo.

Random Ingredients: asiago cheese,ketchup,prosciutto,golden superfine sugar,white bean,tequila,romaine lettuce
title: White Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 pound dry white bean | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1/2 cup tequila | 1/3 cup light golden superfine sugar | 2 tablespoons grated romaine lettuce | 8 slices prosciutto | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh asiago cheese
instructions: Wash and drain the white beans. Place them in a large pot and cover with lightly salted water. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium low and simmer until tender, about 35 minutes. Remove with a slotted spoon and rinse in cold water to remove as much water as possible. Drain. In a medium bowl, combine the ketchup, tequila, sugar, romaine, pepperly jack cheese and the cooked beans. Toss to coat. Refrigerate until serving.

title: Easy Spicy Crab Burritos
ingredients: 1 package spaghetti | 1 lb imitation crabmeat | 1 package burrito-size flour tortillas
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Prepare spaghetti per package directions. Drain. Boil spaghetti as directed on package. Drain, add crabmeat. Heat burrito style in a 10 inch skillet over medium heat until hot. Roll warm tortillas, and place in a single layer on a baking sheet.. Bake 20 minutes, or until crisp and warm.

title: Italian Green Peas
ingredients: 2 cups cooked green peas | 5 tablespoons confectioners'sugar
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together the feresh sugar and the confectioners' sugar.

title: Balsamic Jam-Tomato Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs plum tomatoes, finely chopped | 1 1/2 lbs watermelon, finely diced | 1 can tomato juice | 1 1/2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped walnuts
instructions: Put the chopped tomatoes in a large saucepan with the watermelon, tomato juice, vinegar and walnuts. Heat gently, stirring to mix and break up clumps of tomato. Bring to a boil, then simmer for 30 minutes, until thickened. Allow to cool, then refrigerate and serve.

title: Tex Mex Fried Veggies
ingredients: 2 cups corn kernels, fresh ( the frozen corn may be used ) | 2 cups guacamole, mild, low fat | 2 teaspoons gingerroot, grated fresh | 1 1/2 ounces polenta ( multicolored cornmeal )
instructions: Toast the corn kernels by placing them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Place under a broiler and let burn for 2 minutes. Remove and spread out on a baking sheet. When they're cool enough to handle, break off any fibers with your fingers and transfer them into a medium bowl. Heat 1/2 cup of oil in a large nonstick pan over medium heat. When hot, add the ginger and stir fry until golden, about 20 seconds, stirring frequently. Then add the corn kernels and stir fry for 2 more minutes. Stir in the guacamole and heat until warm through, 5 to 10 seconds. Sprinkle the polenta over the hot corn, and cook, stirring, until the polenta turns light brown, about 2 minutes. Spoon the oil into a bowl and then add the corn to the center. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,head cabbage,olive oil,fenugreek seed,tart apple
title: Apple and Seed Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 2 tablespoons tart apples | 2 tablespoons olive oil or 2 tablespoons canola oil | 2 tablespoons fresh fenugreek seeds | 2 teaspoons dried fenugreek seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Toss the sesame seeds, apples, oil, fenugreek seeds toasted and cooled fenugreek seeds in toasted slivered almonds or hazelnuts.

title: Tomato and Oyster Crumbs
ingredients: 450 g tomato, sliced | 2 tablespoons butter | 2 tablespoons caster sugar | 1 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 4 cups fresh blueberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Grease a 8x2 inch oven proof ramekin dish with butter. Place tomatoes on bottom of dish, piling on each layer with tomato. Sprinkle with caster sugar, then breadcrumbs, pressing crumbs into edges of dish. Cut a 1 inch slit down 1 side of each tomato and place 1 inch apart on tomatoes. Pour oyster sauce over the tomatoes. Cover pan with foil and lightly with a piece of baking parchment paper and bake for 45 - 60 minutes until crust is golden.

title: Chunky Mexican Taco Salad
ingredients: 1 package hidden valley & reg ; original ranch & reg ; dressing | 1 cup margarita mix ( or to make this vegetarian if you like ) | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric ( or to taste ) | 1 fresh chilies ( can use canned diced jalapeno ) | shredded romaine lettuce leaf ( garnish )
instructions: Place all ingredients except lettuce in a blender and process until smooth. Place in a covered container and refrigerate for 1 hour. Right before serving, stir well. Top with desired amounts of lettuce and serve.

title: Basil Rice Noodle Meal
ingredients: 1 cup quick-cooking rice noodles, prepared according to package directions | 1/2 cup basil, chopped | 1 cup canned corn kernels | 1 cup long grain rice
instructions: Prepare rice noodles according to package directions.

title: Viva Espagnola  (French Toast)
ingredients: 14 -10 sandwich bread ( sandwich size, 3-inch to 4-inch thick ) | 10 slices beef roast | 10 -10 frozen vegetables ( corn, peas, beans, carrots, peppers, mushrooms, scallions ) | 1/8 cup cointreau liqueur ( to taste ) | oil ( to fry )
instructions: To fry, take the oil to 300 degrees. Place two slices of bread flat side down on the hot oil. Turn only once or twice so they brown evenly. Keep them turning and browning.. While the bread is browning, soak a bag of frozen vegetables for about 5 minutes in warm water. Drain, rinse and pat dry. When the bread has been toasted, turn the temperature up to 300 degrees. Remove the slices of beef and place a piece of beef and a piece of frozen vegetables on top of the bread. Close the sandwich with a toothpick, starting at one end and working your way down the slice of beef. Continue to work the slices of beef in several lots until the slices are nice and square. If the whole thing is still not as square as you want, you may need to work in batches. In a medium hot pan, heat the cointreau until warmed, about a minute. Brush a little oil on the bread until lightly browned and toasted. Take a large plate and invert one piece of bread on the platter and invert the other. Pour the cointreau over the slice of beef. Serve hot.

title: Tasty Saubergine and Garlic Diced Green Shrimp on Skewers
ingredients: 800 g saardines | 3 green shrimp | 400 g aubergines | 1 vegetable bouillon cube ( maggi brand )
instructions: Soak the saardines for 30 - 40 mins or until softened. Peel off the skins and slice them into 1 cm thick strips. Clean the shrimp and clean thoroughly. Grind the aubergines into long semi circles. Mix the shrimp with the garlic with the vegetable bouillon. Brush olive oil on the skewers. Place into a baking tin or similar container with a tight fitting lid. Add two pieces of sardine in a layer. Sprinkle the top with salt. Bake until the shrimp are pink in the middle and cooked through. Serve with pitta bread.

Random Ingredients: red wine,dressing mix,olive oil cooking spray,garbanzo bean,apricot,tofu,pepper,cucumber
title: Lite and Healthy Banana Salad
ingredients: 1 can garbanzo beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup chopped dried apricot | 1/2 cup red wine ( optional ) | 4 ounces soft tofu | 2 teaspoons olive oil flavored cooking spray | 1 package dry tostitos | 1/2 teaspoon pepper ( optional ) | dressing mix
instructions: Place garbanzo beans, apricots, red wine, tofu. Spray with cooking spray. Place in refrigerator for 30 minutes to 1 hour. Mix dressing mix and pepper in small serving bowl. Serve on romaine lettuce lined plates. Serve with lettuce sprouts.

title: Filled Pastry Rolls
ingredients: 1 sheet frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1/2 cup spaghetti, your favourite pasta | 1/2 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese ( shredded )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f cut pastry sheet to 6, 3 or 4. Using a sharp knife, lightly score each sheet of pastry in a 2 inch wide strip. Arrange pastry in a circle about one inch high on a lightly floured work surface. Working with 1 border near you, arrange pastry in a circle of 1 1/2 inch depth. Spoon 1/4 cup of pasta on top, about 1/4 cup at a time if using. Place 1/2 cup of mozzarella on top of pasta, then sprinkle with another 1/4 cup of cheese. Seal pastry edges with a fork. Transfer pastry to a lightly floured pastry cloth. Repeat with remaining pastry and filling. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes, or until pastry is golden brown. Serve immediately.

title: Nana's Fresh Lime Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 lime, seeded | 2 -4 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | all purpose seasoning salt
instructions: Finely grate 1/2 cup freshly grated lime zest and squeeze remaining 1/2 cup juice. Add lemon juice, zest and season with salt. Using clean hands, squeeze lime juice out of lime into a bowl and gently stir in reserved lime zest. Let lime mixture rest 5 minutes. Then mix again. Serve immediately or refrigerate and stir until chilled completely before serving. Yield, about 1/4 cup.

Random Ingredients: mint,vegetable oil cooking spray,farfalle pasta,leek,vidalia onion,thyme sprig
title: Leek and Vietnamese Noodle Soup
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 large vidalia onions | 6 cups leeks, sliced | 3 teaspoons chopped fresh thyme sprigs | 4 cups lowfat vietnamese farfalle pasta, cooked and drained | 6 mint, slices for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Coat a large pot with cooking spray over medium low heat. Add onions, then leeks and thyme sprigs. Sweat onions, leeks and thyme over medium heat until they're lightly browned and fragrant, 7 to 9 minutes. Place cooked farfalle pasta and 1 1/2 cups water into the pot over medium heat. Cover and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium low and cook covered until farfalle is tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in mint, if desired.

title: Sauza® Pound Cake
ingredients: 3 cups milk ricotta cheese in cheese | 13 ounces poundcake, cut into cubes | 1/2 cup sweet hot sauce | 1 teaspoon minced lime zest
instructions: Stir ricotta cheese, hot sauce, and lime zest together in a bowl. Pour 1/4 cup milk in a shallow 1 1/2 quart baking dish. Place the cake cubes in the bottom of the baking dish, covering 1/2 of the dish. Spoon the ricotta mixture over the pieces, breaking as needed. Scatter 1/2 cup hot sauce over the top when finished baking. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bake in the preheated 400 degrees f oven until lightly browned, 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Pound
ingredients: 1 jar peppered beef bouillon cubes | 5 -6 peppercorns | fresh mint sprig
instructions: Dissolve bouillon in boiling water and shake vigorously until dissolved. Add peppered peppers to bouillon. Pour mixture into hot sterilized jars and seal.

title: Irish Soda Bread
ingredients: 1/4 cup bulgur ( cracked wheat or grains with 1 tbsp wheat ) | 1 tablespoon mustard powder | 1 1/2 cups irish cream, room temp ( or whipped vanilla yogurt )
instructions: Stir the bulgur with salt, then add mustard and 2 tbsp liqueur. Spread in an ungreased loaf pan. Cut cross in 3 diagonal slices and bake at 350f for 30 - 40 minutes. Serve piping hot, ice cold or at room temp.

title: Chipotle Marinade
ingredients: 1/2 cup lemon, juice from | 1/4 cup adobo sauce, from chipotle chipotle peppers | 1 tablespoon cajun seasoning
instructions: Combine all ingredients and whisk or process until blended and refrigerate for up to 3 days.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,taco seasoning,polenta,mushroom stem,egg substitute,yellow mustard,peanut butter,chickpea flour
title: Chickpea Fritters With Spicy Taco Veggies
ingredients: 1 can chickpea flour | 1/2 cup yellow mustard | 1/2 cup reduced-fat peanut butter | 1/3 cup egg substitute | 1 packet taco seasoning | 1 tablespoon whipping cream | pimento-stuffed mushrooms ( optional ) | 2 -3 cups cooked rice or 2 -3 cups cooked rice
instructions: Combine dry ingredients in a mixing bowl with a fork. Whisk until thoroughly blended. Add peanut butter and egg substitute, mix again. Add taco seasoning and mix again. Combine whipping cream and pimento stuffed mushrooms if using. Pour 1/3 cup of mixture into a separate medium sized bowl. Dip a few pimento stuffed mushrooms into this. Heat 2 inches of oil in a frying pan over medium heat until smoking hot. Add as many mushrooms as you can, being careful not to crowd the pan. Cook until golden brown, turning once. Drain on absorbent paper, keep warm in a low oven until ready to serve. When cooked, place on serving plate and top with spicy taco veggies. Spoon remaining sauce over & enjoy.

title: Thyme and Mung Dal Muffins
ingredients: 1 cup mung dal | 1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger root | 1 package orecchiette | 1/4 cup peanut butter | 3 fresh thyme sprigs ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place mung dal in a bowl, cover with water, and allow to soak for 30 minutes. Drain the mung dal and spread on a paper towel. Pat dry with the paper towel, and place onto a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until the lentils are tender and water has dried slightly, 7 to 10 minutes. Remove from the oven, and transfer the lentils into a bowl. Allow to cool. Place the orecchiette in a large pot over medium heat, and cover with water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until the orecchiette rises from the top of the pot, about 6 minutes. Pour the softened pasta into a large bowl and gently fold in the softened peanut butter. Tear the thyme sprigs into large chunks, and stir into the pasta until well combined.

title: Steamed Sea Salt Cod With Dark Chocolate
ingredients: 500 g sea salt cod, in half ( sea salt ) | 100 g baby spinach | 300 g dark semisweet chocolate
instructions: Put the sea salt cod, a steaming basket on to a piece of foil and drizzle 100g of water over it and leave for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, wash the spinach in a colander, then run under cold water, washing until you have a clean cloth ready. Put the spinach and the cod fillets in a steaming basket over the pan of simmering water, cover and set aside for 10 minutes. When the steaming starts, remove the cod fillets and pour off as much water as you can. Leave for a further 5 minutes until the fish has cooked, then remove the steamer basket and place it back over a high heat. Swit the sea salt to ensure the sea salt gets flakey, then place a clean plate on top and put the steaming basket under the plate and leave for another 5 minutes to dry out the sea salt. Take the sea salt off the plate, remove the sea salt and set aside. Put the chocolate in a large heatproof bowl and stir in 1 tablespoon of water to form a paste. Take the bowl out of the heat and, holding back the cheese to make it easier to stir, slowly pour it into the chocolate, stirring until its combined well. You’ll need to stop and scrape down the sides with a rubber spatula to make sure the melted chocolate coats the back of a spoon. Add a few spoonsfuls of the sauce back over the top of the pot of chocolate, which should melt, then spoon more chocolate into it, then drizzle more sauce around the chocolate in a thin stream. Tip, this will make it easier to remove from the ice crystals, if the sea sea salt starts to get too hard and the sauce becomes too dry, you’ll have to add water.

title: Coriander and Hazelnut Oil
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups coriander seeds | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1 1/2 - 2 ml honey
instructions: Grind the coriander seeds and salt with a pestle. Add the honey and mix well then store in a clean dry jar.

title: Hors D’oeuvre
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat | 1 1/2 lbs halibut, in steaks
instructions: Rinse and pat dry the meat and cut into slices 1 - ½ thick. Arrange in a shallow glass pan. Add the water to just below the top of the meat and the top of the meat. Cover tightly. Place on a trivet or a large plate. Weight it down with a heavy dish and refrigerate overnight, or for 8 hours. Dry meat and place on a broiler tray. Grill for 15 minutes per side or until meat is browned and opaque.

Random Ingredients: irish cream,parmesan cheese,hot water,clam juice,rhubarb,lemon juice
title: Rhubarb Clam Chowder
ingredients: 1 lb rhubarb, cut into 1 inch pieces or 1 lb beet leaves, trimmed | 6 cups chilled clam juice or 6 cups bottled clam juice | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 2 cups hot water | 1/4 cup irish cream | 1/3 cup shredded parmesan cheese
instructions: In a large saucepan over medium low, stir together the rhubarb, clam juice, and lemon juice. Add hot water, bring to a boil, cover and simmer for 25 minutes. Add the irish cream and cook for 5 - 10 minutes longer, or until thick enough to coat the back of a spoon. Ladle into bowls, sprinkle with parmesan cheese and serve.

Random Ingredients: vegetable bouillon cube,sushi rice,chicken thigh,tart apple,creme de cacao,apple,orange juice,red wine
title: Apple-Apple Sizzle Stuffed Chicken
ingredients: 4 pieces chicken thighs | 1 teaspoon vegetable bouillon cube | 6 large tart apples | 1 tablespoon red wine | 1/3 cup orange juice | 1 tablespoon creme de cacao | cooked sushi rice | tart apple slice, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Preheat your oven's broiler. Rinse chicken and pat dry with paper towels. Rub chicken inside and out with the bouillon cube. Cut 2 tablespoons of the sliced apples into quarters and cut out the core. Slice the apples crosswise into thick, thin shreds. Discard outer 1/2 inch hole from the core then discard the rest. In a nonstick skillet, melt half of the orange juice over medium heat. Add the chicken and cook, turning once, until juices run clear, about 4 minutes. Remove the chicken from the pan, reserving pan drippings. Stir in the red wine, orange juice, and creme de cacao. Bring to a simmer over low heat, then add apple shreds, cover, and let cook until the apples are tender, 30 to 40 minutes, turning the chicken halfway through. Set the chicken aside. Place an aluminum foil basket in the oven's broiler to catch any excess grease. Place the chicken in the basket and place under the broiler for about 5 minutes, or until browned and crispy on the outside. Place the chicken legs on top of a serving platter, spoon some of the caramelized juices at the side, and garnish with slices of apple.

title: Beetroot Smoothie
ingredients: 2 small beet, tops removed | 2 cups soymilk
instructions: Remove beetroot tops, and cut into small chunks. Bring a pot of water to a boil, and add beetroot. Cook for 5 to 10 minutes, or until beetroots float to the top. Remove from water, and stir in soymilk. Serve immediately.

title: Pimento Olive Twirls
ingredients: 1 package frozen puff pastry, defrosted according to package directions | 1/2 cup vodka | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon | 5 large pimento stuffed olives, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. On a floured counter, roll out one sheet of pastry dough to a thickness of about 25 inches, and then cut into rounds. Repeat process with the remaining sheets of pastry dough until all of the rounds are used. Place each round on a lightly floured sheet of wax paper, and using a sharp knife cut into 8 to 12 circles. Place 12 of the rounds on a lightly floured sheet of wax paper, and using a pastry brush, brush tops of each with vodka. Dot each round generously with the pimento stuffed olive slices and place on an ungreased baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until the undersides of the pastries are golden brown, about 20 minutes. Let cool to room temperature, about 5 to 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: mace,beef gravy,lime powder,mozzarella cheese,tomato green chilies,marsala wine
title: Easy Chili Con Carne
ingredients: 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, drained | 1 jar beef gravy | 1 package mozzarella cheese, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 tablespoon maple powder | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 1/4 cup dry marsala wine
instructions: In a 2 to 4 quart slow cooker, combine the tomatoes with chilies and 1/2 the beef gravy. Cover and cook on high setting until the liquid has reduced by about half, about 3 hours. Mixture should be thick enough to coat the back of a spoon. Add the remaining gravy and mozzarella and stir until melted. Place mounded mace in the center of a warm serving dish and arrange evenly with the remaining salsa mixture. Let stand 20 minutes before serving.

title: Fiesta Rice and Beef Casserole
ingredients: 5 roma tomatoes, chopped | 3 -4 ounces hamburger meat, crumbles | 3 cups cooked rice | 1 package white cake mix
instructions: In a sauce pan, combine the tomatoes, hamburger meat and rice. Heat slowly until all liquid has been absorbed and is starting to thicken. Add your favorite spices and stir until mixed. Pour into a casserole dish, and cook in a preheated oven 325 degrees for 1 hour, or until hot and bubbly. Let sit for 5 minutes before removing from oven.

title: Creamy Miso Soup
ingredients: 1/4 cup good quality white miso | 1/4 cup chicken bouillon, preferably homemade | 1 minced serrano pepper ( to taste ) ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon low-sodium instant chicken bouillon, preferably homemade
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a pot with a lid on it and bring to a boil and then lower heat to a simmer for 20 minutes, until the liquid is reduced to a thin paste. Remove from the heat and serve with bread. Miso shavings vary from 1/2 cup to 1 cup and from 3 to 4 tablespoons in fact, this recipe lends itself nicely to make soup that will keep in the refrigerator and keeps for at least 4 hours.

title: Quick and Easy Spicy Catfish
ingredients: 2 fillets catfish | 1/2 teaspoon pepperoni | 1/2 jalapeno pepper | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1/4 teaspoon saffron
instructions: Coat catfish with paprika, hot sauce, olive oil and ground pepperoni. Arrange catfish onto greased grill plate. Grill for 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: tahini,tomato green chilies,blueberry,plain yogurt,green bean,pork loin roast
title: Lazy Day Pulled Pork
ingredients: 2 -4 lbs boneless pork loin roast | 1 can petite diced tomatoes and green chilies, undrained ( muir glen preferred ) | 1 can chopped green beans, drained | 1 can sliced canned tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 1/4 cup tahini | 1 container plain nonfat yogurt, plain or 1 container low fat sour cream
instructions: Place pork in a large skillet that has been coated with cooking spray over medium high heat. Brown pork well on all sides. Remove pork from skillet and place in slow cooker. Pour tomatoes with green chiles, green beans, and tomatoes with green chilies into slow cooker.

title: Green Chili Mexican Corn Dip
ingredients: 2 packages frozen mexican-style corn | 1 cup green enchilada sauce | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 teaspoon vinegar | 2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Microwave frozen corn kernels for 3 minutes in small bowl, or until slightly warmed. In a medium bowl, combine enchilada sauce, cardamom, vinegar and green chile enchilada sauce mixture. Spread corn mixture into the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish or crock of your choice. Sprinkle cheese over sauce. Bake in the preheated oven for 15 minutes. Allow to cool for 5 minutes. Serve with warm tortilla chips.

title: Chile Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef, cut into 1 inch pieces | 2 cans bean sprouts, drained | 1 1/2 lbs chile, minced ( seeded and finely chopped, we use hot ) | 1 bay leaf | 1 cup steak's stock or 1 cup canned chicken broth, if necessary ( 1 cup )
instructions: Place stew meat in crockpot. Add rest of ingredients. Cook on low 8 hours.

Random Ingredients: chocolate baking square,taco seasoning mix,dark sesame oil
title: Uncle Bill's Deep Fried Nuts
ingredients: 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 chocolate baking square, melted | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil, or as needed
instructions: Heat a deep fryer or deep heavy pot to 350 degrees f. Line a fine mesh strainer with cheese cloth or paper towels to drain excess oil from the package of taco seasoning mix. Pour melted chocolate into a large bowl and stir in taco seasoning mix. When the oil reaches 300 degrees f on a candy thermometer, pour the seasoning mixture into the bowl with chocolate.

Random Ingredients: olive oil,parmigiano reggiano cheese,broccoli floret,sauce,red food coloring,saffron
title: Broccoli Pasta
ingredients: 1 cup broccoli floret | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 teaspoon saffron ( saunfalograviera ) | 1 drop red food coloring | 1 pinch saffron ( saunfalograviera ) | 1/2 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/4 cup hot sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a large pot of boiling, salted water, blanch the broccoli for 3 minutes. Cover, and immediately plunge into ice water. Drain, and set aside. Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Stir in the saffron, then cook 1 minute. Turn heat down to low, and sprinkle on 1/2 cup parmigiano reggiano cheese. Break up with a wooden spoon, and stir while heating for 1 minute. Turn off heat, and stir in 2 drops red food coloring until mixture is evenly creamy. Set aside. In a large pot of boiling water, blanch the broccoli for 1 to 2 minutes. Drain, and set aside. Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in the skillet over medium heat. Stir in 1 teaspoon saffron and cook 1 minute, stirring constantly. Turn heat off, and stir in 1/2 cup of parmigiano reggiano. When the mixture is creamy, stir in 1/4 cup hot sauce, and blend. Add 1 to 2 drops red food coloring, or as needed for desired shade. Pour the hot broccoli mixture over pasta.

title: Ciabatta, French Style (Cucumber Pancakes)
ingredients: 3 large potatoes, peeled | 3 lbs ground chicken | 4 cloves of diced potatoes | 2 teaspoons paprika | 2 tablespoons virgin olive oil | 1 cup soymilk | 1/2 cup gruyere cheese, shaved
instructions: Scrub and boil half the potatoes for 10 - 20 minutes drain and let cool. Cut into small dice. Set aside. Meanwhile, mix together the ground chicken, 1/4 teaspoons paprika, and 1/4 cups of soy milk. Set aside. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees and make crepes, spray a 13 x 9 rectangle baking pan with cooking spray. Cut 2/3 of the potato into bite sized strips, about 1/2 inch square x 1/8 inch. Place the sliced potatoes in a large mixing bowl and add the ground chicken mixture. Blend well using your hands to combine all the ingredients. The mixture should be a little dry, but moist and fluffy. Take 2 tablespoons chicken mixture and form into a ball about size of an index finger. Repeat using the other half of the potato. Place the balls on the pan and flatten slightly. Top with the rest of the potato, pressing the potatoes down to make the center of the pancake. Sprinkle the remaining 1/4 teaspoon of paprika over the top of the pancakes. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes, or until crispy on the top and nicely browned on the edges. Serve with a side of guiness and slices of gruyere cheese in an eye catching pattern. This recipe can also be made in the oven. Variation, add 1/4 cup of chicken and 1/2 cup of soymilk into the potato mixture.

title: Fried Onion & Coconut Saffron Rice Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups raw white onions ( about 10 ounces ) | 1 cup white rice, uncooked, not quick cooking, may need a bit additional cooking time | 5 cups self-rising flour | 1 pinch saffron | 1 can coconut, drained ( optional )
instructions: Cut small holes randomly into the onion with a sharp knife, making sure to get all the slices the inner way. Add rice & cook covered on low in a microwave oven, for 20 minutes. Remove lid and fluff up with a fork, making sure the rice stays on the onion. Add flour & knead until dough is not sticky & doesn't require any additional flour. Cover with a cloth & let rest 15 minutes. In a medium sized pot or a wok on medium to medium low heat, add the saffron, coconut & drained coconut if using. Stir until the coconut has absorbed the oil from the coconut & has begun to turn golden in color. Turn down the heat & simmer covered on low for ~15 minutes or until the rice is tender & the liquid is absorbed. Turn off the stove, remove the lid & fluff up. Serve warm or cold. I have also done this in the oven and served it warm.

title: Anise Flavored French Fondant
ingredients: 1 tablespoon anise seed ( optional ) | oil, for deep frying
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together 1 tablespoon of anise seed and 1 tablespoon of anise seed. The oil should be about 1/2 inch deep in the fryer. Dip small pieces of the french fondant into the oil and allow to fry until golden brown. Remove the fried french fondant to a rack and allow to rest while you complete the final step of cooking the final product. You can serve the fondant warm while still hot and can drizzle the flavored oil over it.

Random Ingredients: farina,shallot,dark rum,pimiento,ginger root,beef chuck steak,cocoa powder
title: Cincinnati-Style Steak
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dark rum ( optional ) | 3 pounds bone-in beef chuck steak | 1 shallot, chopped | 1 teaspoon chopped peeled fresh ginger root | 1 jar chopped pimientos, drained | 2 tablespoons dried farina | 1 cup cocoa powder
instructions: Pour the rum into a large, heavy skillet, and set over medium high heat. Add the beef, shallot, ginger, pimentos, and farina.

Random Ingredients: cajun seasoning,arborio rice,apple pie filling,red curry paste,back bacon,lettuce,shallot,enchilada sauce
title: Red Curried Bacon Wrapped in Rice
ingredients: 1 package back bacon | 1 tablespoon red curry paste or 1 tablespoon curry powder | 4 shallots, chopped | 4 packages frozen apple pie filling | 2 cups arborio rice | 1 jar enchilada sauce | 1 envelope cajun seasoning | 1 head lettuce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In a skillet over medium high heat, cook the bacon until crispy, 10 to 12 minutes. Remove bacon and drain drippings. Saute diced shallots in bacon grease until shallots are tender. Remove shallots and set aside. Bring the stock and rice to a boil. Reduce heat to low and add curry paste and curry powder. Stir, cover and let rice absorb flavor, about 15 minutes. Remove lid and add enchilada sauce. Stir, cover and let simmer until heated through. In a large bowl, combine rice and bacon, making sure all bacon fits in the rice and liquid. Gently fold in sliced apples. Place the mixture on a baking sheet and bake 30 minutes, or until cooked through and bubbly. Remove foil and top with shredded lettuce. Roll up the wrap and return to oven for 5 minutes.

title: Pot-Roasted Plantain Casserole - Vegan
ingredients: 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 tablespoon prepared english mustard | 2 lbs peeled plantains | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh rosemary | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh rosemary
instructions: Drain the plantains and cut into 2 inch lengths. Place them in the bowl of a food processor or electric blender and process until smooth. Put the soup in a dutch oven over medium high heat. Add the mustard, stirring constantly. Add the plantain mixture and the rosemary and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer, uncovered, for 30 minutes. Put the drained plantain into a large bowl and pour the soup over it. Toss to coat evenly and chill it for at least an hour before serving. You can also do this in the microwave by hand, then reheat it in the microwave over medium heat for 5 minutes. Remove from the oven with a skimmer, shaking the bowl, and serve.

Random Ingredients: vanilla sugar,pork butt,napa cabbage,red currant jelly,potato
title: Sweet Potato and Lion's Head (Beef Head) Pot Roast
ingredients: 1 large sweet potato, peeled and cut into 1 1/2 inch chunks | 4 large napa cabbage, cored and shredded | 1 roasted pork butt, thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 1/2 cup red currant jelly
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Mix sweet potato, napa cabbage, roasted pork butt, and vanilla sugar in a large roasting pan. Stir red currant jelly into roasting pan liquid. Bake in the preheated oven until tender and beginning to fall apart, about 1 hour 15 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Bread Crumb Topping for Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups peanut butter | 4 slices white bread | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Cut 4 slices of bread on the diagonal. Combine peanut butter and garlic powder and spread evenly onto the cut surfaces of 4 slices of the bread. Place bread onto a baking sheet and bake for approximately 15 minutes or until lightly browned and crisp.

title: Rosemary and Olive Cookies
ingredients: 1 cup cake flour or 1 cup all-purpose flour | 2 teaspoons icing sugar | 1 cup pitted ripe olives | 1 tablespoon rosemary leaf, finely chopped
instructions: Sift flour into a bowl and stir in icing sugar. Stir in olives and rosemary. Using your hands, form the mixture into walnut sized balls. Place on a greased tray. Bake in slow oven 450 degrees for about 12 minutes.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,coriander seed,pine nut,chicken wing,cranberry,white flour,grenadine syrup,italian parsley
title: Oriental Chicken Wings
ingredients: 8 lbs chicken wings | 1/2 cup white flour | 2 cups tomato juice | 6 tablespoons grenadine syrup | 2 tablespoons coriander seeds, crushed | 3 tablespoons fresh italian parsley, chopped | 3 tablespoons pine nuts, toasted | 1 cup dried cranberries, crushed
instructions: In large freezer proof dish place chicken wings and coat evenly with flour. Combine tomato juice and remaining ingredients and stir. Pour mixture over chicken. Sprinkle top with pine nuts and cranberries and set at room temperature for 2 hours stirring occasionally to insure even drying of cranberries.

title: Green Beans & Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb fresh green beans, trimmed | 1 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs
instructions: Cut the green beans into 3 in sections, removing any strings or other unwanted pieces. Cut the chicken in 1/2 inch cubes. Place the beans in a steamer basket containing water, and steam for 10 - 15 minutes, until tender. Combine the chicken with the green beans, cooking for 8 - 10 minutes, stirring the chicken. Serve warm.

title: Red Beans and Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 lb red beans, cleaned | 1 teaspoon thyme
instructions: Soak beans in water about an hour. Place the beans in a pan with enough water to cover them. Cook until done. When they are done, add the thyme, reduce water and continue cooking.

title: Colombian Corn Dip
ingredients: 5 anaheim chilies, chopped | 8 ounces linguica sausage, cooked and crumbled | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 2/3 cup plain yogurt | 1/4 cup maple syrup
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine chilies, linguica and corn. In a small bowl, combine yogurt, maple syrup and maple syrup. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: paprika,serrano pepper,italian tomato,french bread lengthwise,swiss chard,yellow squash,malt vinegar,white sesame seed
title: Grilled Swiss Chard With a Mixed Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon minced green serrano pepper | 2 teaspoons distilled white sesame seeds | 1 tablespoon malt vinegar | 2 cups chopped swiss chard | 1 cup chopped yellow squash | 1 cup canned italian tomatoes, chopped, drained | 3 sprigs fresh paprika | 1 loaf french bread, cut lengthwise into 1-inch thick slices
instructions: In a large skillet, heat the green peppers, sesame seeds and vinegar over medium high heat, stirring often, until the pepper is fragrant and the sesame seeds turn golden, about 3 minutes. Add the swiss chard, squash, tomatoes, paprika and the french bread.

title: Spicy Covered Sweetcorn With Feta
ingredients: 1 can full-flavored coconut milk | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 2 teaspoons adobo seasoning | 1/2 pint cherry ( preferably baby ) | 6 feta cheese | 4 -5 dashes beer, dash
instructions: Place coconut milk and corn flour in a saucepan and blend well. Add adobo seasoning. Bring to a boil and reduce heat to low. Cook, stirring constantly, about 15 - 20 minutes. When the mixture is bubbly, cover, reduce heat slightly and simmer, stirring from time to time, about 10 minutes. Add cherries. Cover and continue simmering, stirring frequently, until thickened and cherries are softened, about 3 - 5 minutes. Remove from heat and sprinkle feta on top. Serve warm.

title: Grilled Halibut
ingredients: 1 pound skinless halibut fillet | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh sweet white onion | 2 tablespoons chopped peanuts | 2 tablespoons chopped romaine lettuce | 1 toothpick
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium high heat. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the halibut fillet, then cook the fish for about 4 minutes per side, or until the fish flakes easily with a fork.

title: Spanish Style Sweet Potato Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs medium red potatoes, scrubbed, diced | 1/3 cup worcestershire sauce | 1/4 cup molasses | 1 tablespoon paprika | 2 teaspoons orange juice | 14 ounces pudding, powder
instructions: Boil potatoes until tender, drain and mash. Add remaining ingredients to potatoes. Mix well. Let cool completely. Store in fridge in tightly lidded container.

Random Ingredients: vinegar,olive oil cooking spray,mustard seed,beef stock cube,brown sugar,chicken breast,dark red kidney bean,beef brisket
title: Barbecued King Prawns (Shrimp)
ingredients: olive oil flavored cooking spray | 2 teaspoons mustard seeds | 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef brisket | 1 tablespoon olive oil or 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 2 tablespoons dark red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 4 tablespoons brown sugar | 2 ounces beef stock cubes | 4 tablespoons raw peeled deli-stiffly-cooked cooked chicken breasts
instructions: Heat an oven to 350°f sprinkle the meat with the oil. Cook for 25 minutes or until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. Place the vinegar, kidney beans, sugar and beef stock in a small saucepan. Place over a medium heat and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat and simmer for 5 minutes, or until reduced. To serve, place the meat on a warmed serving plate. Brush the sauce over, sprinkle with the mustard seeds and serve.

title: Spanish Red Potatoes and Garlic Hoagies
ingredients: 1 lb small red potato, unpeeled ( about 6 medium sized red potatoes ) | 1/4 lb red cheesecloth ( about 14 1/2 ounces ) | 1/3 cup double cream ( thick, chilled )
instructions: Place potatoes in a large pot of boiling, salted water. Cook until tender. Drain, return to pot. Heat oven to 400°f. Insert a peeler into center and twist in the center of a potato to insert garlic. Place potatoes on a rimmed baking sheet and bake 20 minutes or until tender. Place potato and cheesecloth inside of a clean saucepan. Heat over low heat until cheesecloth loosens.

Random Ingredients: purpose flour,dark soy sauce,picante sauce,red chilies
title: Quick Chile-Infused Fried Brownies
ingredients: 24 long red chilies, finely chopped | 4 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 3/4 cup picante sauce | 1 1/4 cups all-purpose flour | 1 1/4 cups all-purpose flour
instructions: Lightly oil rack in middle of oven. Toss together chiles and soy sauce and set aside. Lightly mix flour and picante sauce with fingers and shape into small balls, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter. Bake in a preheated 450° oven until brown, about 8 to 10 minutes. Cool 5 minutes and transfer to wire racks. Serve warm.

title: Homemade Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 1 can mexican-style stewed tomatoes | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/4 cup shredded romano cheese
