instructions: Mix tomatoes with baking soda. Stir cream of tartar into stewed tomatoes. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly.

title: Pear and Cheese Stuffed Grilled Cheese (Microwave)
ingredients: 1 large pears ( about 2/3 lb. ) | 2/3 cup rice wine or 2/3 cup dry vermouth | 2/3 cup grated sharp cheddar cheese ( about 1-1/2 ounces ) | 2 fresh thyme sprigs
instructions: Peel and devein the pear, leaving the stem intact. Using a vegetable peeler, cut a thin slice along the base of the pears. Cut a slit in the top of each pear in 1/2, discarding the pears. Place the pears on a baking tray, fat side down, and brush with the rice wine or vermouth. Cover and microwave on high power until the pears are very tender, 5 to 8 minutes, stirring every 3 to 4 minutes. Transfer the cooked pears to a bowl. Stir the cheese, thyme sprigs and juice from 1 slice of bread until well blended, 1 to 2 minutes. Spoon about 1/4 cup of the cheese mixture into each pear cavity. Stuff the cheese into the holes in the pears. Let stand 5 minutes. Serve with flatbreads.

Random Ingredients: rice paper,mustard seed,thyme,cardamom pod,chicken breast,cardamom seed,baking powder,chuck steak
title: Crispy Fried Rice Paper Nuggets
ingredients: 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon cardamom pod | 1/2 teaspoon thyme | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom pod, crushed | 2 whole chicken breasts | 1/4 lb ground chuck steak | 3/4 - 1 cup cooked rice paper ( sushi rice noodles ) | 1/4 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Heat wok on high. Meanwhile, put the mustard seeds, cardamom, thyme, and paprika in an oven proof skillet and stir to toast. When they become a shade darker, remove from heat. Add the chicken, stir fry briefly, then remove chicken, set aside. Soak the rice paper in a bowl of ice water until soft. Remove rice paper and place on paper towel to drain. Put 1/2 of the mustard seeds, cardamom, and thyme into a mortar and pound till smooth. Add mustard seeds, crushed cardamom pods, and pounded mustard to meat and stir fry til they become fragrant and a dark brown color. Push the mixture to one side of pan and place ground chuck in center, using one hand to break it up. Drain ground chuck and add to meat, stirring til brown. Add 1/4 cup water and stir. Add baking powder and mix once. Spread the rice paper onto hot wok and spread mixture in a thin layer. Spread cooked rice noodle wrapper by making 1 1/4 slices from a small corner. Dip slices in cold water, then place a slice of meat and 1 teaspoon of the browned mustard mustard on top of the rice paper. Repeat until rice paper wrappers are gone from the package. Serve when you eat it up.

Random Ingredients: coco lopez,sofrito sauce,salt,cashew,cherry tomato,leek,dark chocolate,beef tenderloin
title: Pescado Con Coco
ingredients: 500 g beef tenderloin, boned and roughly diced | 1 leek, halved, washed and chopped | 150 g roasted cashews | 150 g cotican lopez ( or cream cheese and milk chocolate milk ) | 150 g low-fat plain soy yogurt | 500 g cherry tomatoes, halved | 1 dash salt | 150 g dark chocolate, melted, for grilling griddle
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Place beef and leek in a roasting tin and cover with aluminium foil. Bake for 40 mins or until beef is cooked. Remove from oven, transfer to a large bowl and set aside. To make filling, place cashews in a food processor and process until they become coarsely ground. Add the cashew paste, lopez and soy yoghurt and process until smooth. Divide lamb mixture between four serving plates. Top with cherries and chocloin. Pour melted chocolate over the top and serve.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,sun tomato oil,jumbo shrimp,almond extract,demi glace,sake,coconut
title: Jamaican Shrimp With Chutney and Sun-Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 lbs jumbo shrimp, cleaned | 1/4 cup mango chutney, good quality | 2 teaspoons cherry tomatoes packed in oil, drained and chopped | 1 teaspoon sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and chopped | 1 dash almond extract | 2 tablespoons demi-glace | 1/4 cup grated coconut | 1 teaspoon powdered sugar
instructions: Drain shrimp, reserve juice. Coat a large frying pan with cooking spray. Add shrimp, chutney and cherry tomatoes stir to coat shrimp in mixture. Add almond extract, demi glace and coconut stirring to coat. Increase heat to high. When mixture is bubbling, reduce heat to low and cook 8 - 10 minutes, or until shrimp turns pink to pink. Remove shrimp and place on platter. Serve with rice.

title: Roasted Fresh Peaches With Mushrooms and Ginger
ingredients: 3 lbs fresh peach slices | 3 lbs cremini mushrooms | 2 lemons, juice and zest of | 1 inch piece gingerroot | 1 clove garlic
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Place peaches between sheets of parchment paper and carefully transfer them 2 inches apart on a cookie sheet. Roast in a hot oven for 25 minutes, or broil the peaches until the skin is puffed and blistered. Remove from the oven and allow to cool. Peel away the blackened skin and place on a baking sheet. Peel the mushrooms and slice. Put into a very large bowl. Toss with the lemon zest, lemon juice and ginger. Drizzle the mixture over the peaches and garnish with the garlic.. When cool, store in the refrigerator for up to six weeks.

title: Tori Goshko - Indonesian Caramel Spice
ingredients: 2 cups dark rum | 3 tablespoons ground cardamom powder | 1 vanilla bean, split lengthwise and scraped
instructions: Place rum, cardamom powder, grated vanilla bean and scraped vanilla bean in a large bowl. Place 1/3 cup water in a saucepan, just below boiling. Using the flat of a knife, scrape the vanilla bean from the scrapings, keeping them if necessary. When the water is boiling, gently pour the rum into the pan. Use tongs to flip each piece of the vanilla bean over into the rum. Cook, shaking the pan from time to time, until the alcohol evaporates and the sugar has melted inches. Transfer to a bowl of ice cream maker, and follow manufacturer's instructions when the mixture is cold but not hard. Serve with your favourite ice cream and a piece of vanilla bean on the side.

Random Ingredients: italian tomato,pork chop,havarti cheese,ginger juice,aluminum foil,grainy mustard,parmesan cheese
title: Grilled Pork Chops With Smoked Mozzarella and Mustard Crust
ingredients: 5 boneless pork chops | 1 cup italian-style stewed tomatoes, undrained ( about 1 1/4 tomatoes ) | 2 tablespoons grated fresh ginger juice | 2 tablespoons grainy mustard | 6 ounces smoked mozzarella and havarti cheese, sliced ( about 2 cups ) | 1/2 cup shaved shaved parmesan cheese | aluminum foil
instructions: Adjust oven rack to middle position and heat oven to 300 degrees f. Line 3 large rimmed baking sheets with baking sheets.

Random Ingredients: nori,black pepper,mexican cheese,chuck,dark red kidney bean,pepper
title: Chunky Beef Rollups
ingredients: 6 ounces ground chuck | 1 - 1 1/2 cup shredded low-fat mexican cheese blend | 1 can dark red kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh dill ( or 1 t. dried dill weed ) or 2 tablespoons oregano ( or 1 t. dried dill weed ) | 1 -2 teaspoon black pepper, freshly ground | 24 sheets nori
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Heat a large nonstick frying pan over medium heat, and add the ground chuck. When it is well browned and no longer pink, drain any excess grease. Add the beans, dill, pepper and desired amount of cheese. Spread the ground chuck mixture evenly in the bottom of a 6x6 inch loaf pan. Bake for 15 minutes. Remove loaf pan from the oven and arrange the nori on a serving tray. Spoon the cooked meat mixture evenly over the nori. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning,grape tomato,cheese,hot paprika,self raising flour
title: Mexican Tomato Bread
ingredients: 1 cup plain self-raising flour | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning | 1 teaspoon hot paprika | 1 1/2 cups grape tomatoes, halved | 1 cup grated tasty cheese
instructions: Preheat oven 190°c. Grease 1 - 2 cm deep 20cm round cake tin. Place all ingredients in a large bowl and mix well. Spoon half the batter into the prepared tin. Sprinkle the top with grated cheese and bake for 15 - 20 minutes until golden brown. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: daikon radish,cream rice,lima bean,pita bread,green chilies
title: Arak (Rice and Soya Bean Salad)
ingredients: 1 lb shelled fresh lima beans or 1 lb fresh shelled fresh lima beans | 2 cups cream of rice or 2 cups short-grain rice | 20 slices pita bread | 1/3 cup thinly sliced korean green chilies or 1/3 cup thai red chili pepper strips | 1 1/2 lbs daikon radishes, peeled and sliced into strips
instructions: Place rice in large bowl and cover with water. Set aside at room temperature 15 minutes to allow flavors to combine, then rinse under running water. Drain well and rinse with cold water. In colander, rinse and drain beans until all excess water runs clear. In a 10 inch skillet, place 1/3 cup water or reserved water and bring to a boil. Add beans and cook 4 minutes, or until just tender. With slotted spoon, transfer 1/3 of bean mixture to 2 to 3 tablespoons drained rice. Arrange 1 tablespoon bean mixture in center of each pita bread slice, then top with about 1 1/2 tablespoon bean mixture. Top with 1/2 tablespoon bean mixture. Top with remaining bean mixture. Sprinkle with chile strips. Serve.

Random Ingredients: lime juice zest,chicken stock,honey,chickpea,cod fish fillet,garam masala,wild mushroom,baby spinach
title: Basque Cod and Chickpea Curry
ingredients: 1 cup chicken stock | 1/2 cup wild mushroom, sliced | 1 lime, juice and zest of | 2 teaspoons honey | 1 teaspoon garam masala ( or a combo of both ) | 1 lb cod fish fillet, cut into chunks | 1 can chickpeas ( drained ) | 3 cups baby spinach
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a large saucepan over medium heat, cover and simmer for 5 minutes. Add the cod and chickpeas and cook over low heat for 3 minutes or until cod is cooked through.

title: Golden Syrup
ingredients: 500 g golden caster sugar | 200 g shredded desiccated coconut ( optional ) | 8 tablespoons sour cream | 1 tablespoon lemon zest | 1 tablespoon fresh sage, chopped | 1/2 cup chopped onion ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 200°c. Put sugar into large, oven proof bowl. Mix in coconut, sour cream, lemon rind and sage. Pour into oven proof bowl. Place bowls in oven and bake until golden, about 45 to 50 minutes. Serve warm, but not piping hot.

title: Quick N' Easy Faux Pizzas
ingredients: 4 frozen shrimp, thawed if frozen | 2 slices veal, thinly sliced | 1/2 jar sliced pimentos | 1/2 cup pimiento | 1/2 teaspoon thyme
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. On a parchment paper lined baking sheet, arrange shrimp evenly to all surfaces. Distribute evenly over shrimp. On a cutting board, place half of the pimentos, pepiento halves, and thyme. With a serrated knife, slice the other half of the pimentos into large chunks and distribute evenly over the shrimp. Bake in middle of oven until shrimp are no longer translucent, about 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Lemon Sour Shoyu Cookies
ingredients: 1 cup sugar | 1 cup cornstarch, dissolved in | 1/4 cup cold water | 1 tablespoon of grated lemons or 1 tablespoon ginger | 3 tablespoons shoyu
instructions: In a bowl, add all the ingredients except the lemon or ginger and blend until it becomes smooth. Add the lemon or ginger and mix all ingredients together well. Use as cookie dough in cakes. Roll each cup into a ball of about 5 inch diameter with a cookie stamp. Place on paper lined cookie sheet. Bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 5 minutes or until the cookie just start getting crisp.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,almond extract,serrano pepper,yeast,cabbage
title: Almond Bread
ingredients: 1 large head cabbage, cored and shredded | 500 g extra virgin olive oil | 1 tablespoon dried yeast | 1 tablespoon almond extract | 2 serrano peppers, seeded and diced
instructions: Place the shredded cabbage in a large bowl. Add the oil, yeast, almond extract and chili. Mix until well combined. Let sit in a warm place for 20 minutes, until bread is well risen. Add diced chilis before continuing. Knead a few times, until dough is elastic and smooth. Separate into four pieces. Place on a floured work surface. Cover with a clean towel and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour, until dough has doubled in volume and is very soft. Divide into 24 equal pieces. Set half of each piece aside for later use. Using the back of your hands, press each piece out flat, on a floured sheet pan or parchment paper. Repeat this procedure until all of the bread is used. Place in a greased oven and preheat to 400 degrees. Brush each with a little of the remaining olive oil and bake 20 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: mini marshmallow,red chili pepper,sea salt,tamarind paste,cashew nut,green pea,vegetable broth,pinto bean
title: Quick and Easy Tamarind and Peanut Cashew Bean Soup
ingredients: 2 cups chopped roasted cashew nuts | 2 teaspoons tamarind paste | 3/4 cup green peas | 6 1/2 ounces pinto beans, drained | 2 cups vegetable broth | 1 medium red chili pepper, finely diced | 1 pinch sea salt | 8 mini marshmallows or 8 mini wafer cookies
instructions: Place cashews and tamarind paste in a small bowl, cover and place bowl in the freezer to thaw for 5 - 7 minutes. Combine peas, beans, broth, chili, salt and cashew mixture in a medium pot. Bring to boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer for about 25 minutes or until nuts are tender. Serve warm, garnished with mini marshmallows or wafer cookies.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,basic pizza dough sauce,raspberry,cream chicken soup,pinto bean
title: Quick Pita Pizzas
ingredients: 2 cans condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 can pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 1 package basic pizza dough sauce | 1 small yellow bell pepper, chopped | 1/2 can raspberries, drained ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Mix soup and beans together in a medium bowl until well blended. Place pizzas in a greased pie plate or pizza stone. Spread about 1 1/2 cups of the soup mixture over each pizza. Distribute bell pepper evenly over soup mixture. Top with a layer of raspberries. Bake pizzas on the middle rack of the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until hot and bubbly.

title: Basil-Sofado (Basil and Capers)
ingredients: 1/2 cup semolina | 1 ounce capers
instructions: Combine the semolina and capers in a bowl. Knead well until mixture is pliable. Transfer dough to a pastry cloth or work surface and knead a few times so it stays elastic. Divide into two equal portions. Roll each portion into a ball and flatten to a thickness of about half a inch. Place dough on a pastry cloth or work surface and flatten into a circle about ¼ inch thick. Arrange the basil leaves on top, and sprinkle the top with more capers if desired. Bake cookies at 450 degrees f until the edge just begins to crisp up, and the top of the cookies are lightly colored and dry.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,russet potato,beef chuck,bouquet garni,apple,black tea
title: Beef Stew over Tea
ingredients: 2 lbs beef chuck | 8 large russet potatoes ( or smaller ) | 4 teaspoons black tea | 3 tablespoons dark sesame oil ( or other oil ) | 1 bouquet garni ( fresh and tied ) | 1 whole apple ( optional )
instructions: Cut beef into 1 1/2 inch slices using knife. Place beef in medium sized non metal pan and pour on hot tea, pouring hot water in all at once. Cover and simmer 1 1/2 hours or until beef is fork tender. Remove all bones, shred meat with a fork and return to pot. Discard remaining tea. Cover and keep at very low temperature for about 15 minutes. Add potatoes to pot and cook over medium heat until potatoes are tender, stirring occasionally. Add apple and bouquet garni. Cover and cook, stirring frequently, 20 minutes or until potato mixture forms a thick stew. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: tomato soup,sea salt,broccoli,green cardamom,graham cracker crumb,brandy,flour
title: Broccoli (Broccoli -- Makhani-Yakhani)
ingredients: 2 cups fresh broccoli, chopped into small squares & cooked | 2 1/2 cups tomato soup | 1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 1 teaspoon flour | 1 teaspoon green cardamom, crushed | 2 tablespoons brandy
instructions: Melt butter in a pan to which you have flung a few pieces of the broccoli into a single layer. Put crushed graham cracker crumbs, brandy, flour, and cardamom into skillet, stir to combine. Put the broccoli and broccoli in the sauce to coat. Cook until butter has just melted and sauce is creamy. Note, you can add chopped fresh tomatoes or chopped fresh tomatoes to the sauce if you prefer. Note, if you are using canned tomatoes, remove all seeds once cooked. Serve over rice.

title: Japanese Eggplant
ingredients: 2 japanese eggplants | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Wash eggplants and scrape eggplants, cut in half lengthwise, on a peel. Sprinkle skin with cream of tartar. Wrap into a piece aluminum foil, and leave in a warm place for 5 to 6 hours. Turn eggplant halves and bake for 45 - 50 minutes at 175 degrees celsius on a lightly oiled grill.

title: Lek & Butter Bean Puree
ingredients: 16 ounces butter beans, rinsed and drained | 3 tablespoons leeks, finely chopped
instructions: Place everything into a food processor or blender and puree until smooth. Scrape down between pulses until you have a smooth paste.

Random Ingredients: barbecue sauce,taco seasoning mix,macaroni,beef roast,triple sec,navy bean,onion flake,green olive
title: Smoky Beef and Noodle Tacos #5FIX
ingredients: 1 lb beef roast, i use a lean chuck | 2 -3 cups elbow macaroni | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 12 -16 large taco-size macaroni-sized flatbreads | 1 bottle good quality barbecue sauce | 8 ounces sliced nugget frozen green olives | 1/2 cup triple sec | 1 tablespoon dried onion flakes ( optional )
instructions: Trim and partially cook beef, place in crock pot in 2 gallon resealable plastic bag. Add taco seasoning mix to bag, mix well, then add beef to bag. Cook 3 - 5 hours on low. Strain out excess liquid, remove beef from crock pot and shred. In a separate saucepan, heat barbecue sauce over medium heat until bubbly. Add shredded beef and onions, lower heat to medium and cook until heated through. While beef and sauce are cooking, cook macaroni according to package directions, but with no salt added or overcooked, drain. Once beef is done, stir together macaroni, beef mixture and remaining taco seasoning mix. Add olives, return to low heat and cook 2 - 3 more minutes. Serve macaroni in warmed taco shells with cheese.

title: Cheesy Tapioca Ball
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups tapioca starch | 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. In a medium bowl, combine the tapioca starch and grated mozzarella cheese. Mix well. Shape the dough into 1 inch diameter balls. Place each one on a cookie sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes in the preheated oven, until the tops are brown and crusty. Remove from the oven, and allow to cool slightly. Dust hands with tapioca starch to keep them from sticking to the hands. To serve, make a slit through the center of a ball, and dip into a little tapioca starch so that cheese has oozed out. This is a sweet, sticky mini dog with crunchy inside.

title: Marshmallow Kebles
ingredients: 1 package marshmallow creme ( about 8 ounces ) | 6 wooden skewers, each long | 1/2 teaspoon pure vanilla extract
instructions: Combine marshmallow cream and vanilla in mixer bowl on medium speed until marshmallow cream is barely melted. Using the end of a rubber spatula, fold in marshmallow mixture. Cover and refrigerate about 30 minutes or until firm. Preheat oven to 400°f. Insert a skewer into each long of the skewer. Arrange skewered skewer over ungreased nonstick baking sheet. Bake 5 to 8 minutes or until just a hint of pink remains in each skewer.

title: Guinness Butter
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese | 1 cup raisins
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a mixing bowl, cream together the cream cheese and raisins. Beat in the cream cheese mixture until smooth. Chill dough for up to 2 hours before baking to allow the butter to firm up when it is time to make your guests or serve as is.

title: Tofu Patties
ingredients: 1 package extra firm tofu, drained | 1 1/2 tablespoons breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon turmeric, ground
instructions: Place drained tofu on a lightly oiled plate and flatten down to 1/2 thick. Sprinkle crumbs on top, then add the turmeric and mix together well. Shape into four patty shapes. Heat a large nonstick frypan over medium heat. Cook tofu in the pan for 5 minutes each side or until golden brown and crisp. Serve with gravy for dipping.

title: Watermelon and Squash Salad
ingredients: 2 cups finely chopped seeded watermelon | 2 cups finely chopped seedless yellow squash | 1 cup finely chopped sweet corn | 3/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 1/4 cup icing sugar | 1/2 teaspoon sfenugreek seeds
instructions: Mix watermelon, yellow squash, sweet corn and balsamic vinegar in a large bowl. Pour over the vegetables and gently toss. Refrigerate for 2 hours to develop flavours. Just before serving, sprinkle with icing sugar and sfenugreek seeds.

title: Kolabh (Pickled Onions) in Grape Leaves
ingredients: 3 pounds white pearl onions | 4 quarts grape, juice reserved from steaming grape | 2 pounds grape, cut in half
instructions: Wash and remove stems of onions and set aside. Place 1 gallon of grapes in a large pot. Cover with water, about 4 feet or less, and bring to a boil. Simmer over medium low heat, covered, for 1 hour. Do not lift cover during first 1 hour of cooking. The onions will be tender. Drain and reserve the cooking liquid. Drain the drained onions and discard. Cool onions and then cut into 1/4 inch slices. Fill each grape leaf with approximately 2 to 3 tablespoons of the onions and 1 to 1 - ½ tablespoons of the grape juice, and then top with grape cut outs. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,vanilla extract,celery rib,spice,penne pasta,potato starch,orange juice,monterey jack pepper cheese
title: Carne Asada
ingredients: 2 teaspoons potato starch | 7 1/2 ounces canned sweet potatoes with sweet potatoes, drained and cut into chunks | 4 ounces monterey jack pepper cheese, shredded and divided | 3 tablespoons fresh orange juice | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons orange juice | 1/4 teaspoon ground mixed spice | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f in a medium bowl, stir together potato starch, sweet potato chunks, 1/2 of the pepper jack, citrus juice, vinegar, orange juice, vanilla, and mixed spice. Pour into a 8x8 inch baking dish. Sprinkle with remaining pepper jack. Bake 20 minutes or until heated through.

Random Ingredients: black pepper,herb,tomato puree,corn syrup,celery seed,capicola,golden raisin
title: Spiced Capicola Sticks
ingredients: 1 lb capicola | 2 tablespoons mixed herbs | 1 tablespoon corn syrup | 1 teaspoon sweet mixed herbs | 1 dash black pepper | 1 teaspoon tomato puree | 1 dash celery seed | 1/4 cup golden raisin
instructions: Slice capicola in half. Remove meat from bone and cut into sticks about 1 inch wide and 3 inches long.

Random Ingredients: mint sprig,marjoram,soya sauce,almond,button mushroom,pepper flake,coconut cream
title: Mushroom, Nut and Coconut Pudding
ingredients: 1 liter coconut cream | 10 small button mushrooms, halved | 4 -5 drops hot pepper flakes, depending on your taste | 2 -3 tablespoons soya sauce, to taste | 4 -6 fresh mint sprigs, snipped | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram, to taste | 2 tablespoons ground almonds
instructions: Drain the coconut cream and place in the bottom of a 5l shallow ovenproof dish. Lay the mushrooms over the coconut cream. Sprinkle with the hot pepper flakes. Add enough soya sauce to just cover the mushrooms. Sprinkle with mint and dried marjoram. Sprinkle with ground almonds. Place dish on middle rack of oven. Turn the oven down to 175c. The pudding is ready when it begins to shrink a little on the bottom of the dish. Leave for 20 - 25 minute serve warm.

title: Polenta and Herb Soup
ingredients: 450 g farfalle pasta | 225 g sliced brinjals | 225 g packaged mixed fresh herbs ( such as mint, tarragon, rosemary, chives, chives ) | 50 g polenta | 150 g finely chopped of fresh mint
instructions: Cook the pasta according to the pack instructions until al dente. While pasta is cooking, finely dice the brinjals. Toss them in a medium saucepan with the olive oil and half the quantity of herbs. Then add the polenta and remaining herbs. Bring just to the boil, then reduce the heat, cover, and simmer until the polenta is thick. If the soup is too creamy, add a little water and mix it into the polenta with a wooden spoon. When the pasta is cooked, drain and return it to the pan and stir in the polenta. Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve straight away or refrigerate until the polenta is cold. Garnish with fresh mint.

title: Easy Refried Beans
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans or ( 15 ounce ) can pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 2 poblano chiles, seeded and diced | 1 tablespoon molasses | 2 teaspoons baking soda | 1 1/2 teaspoons turmeric | 1/2 cup molasses | 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice
instructions: In blender or food processor, mix beans, poblano chiles, molasses, baking soda, and turmeric. Blend mixture or press with a spoon or an electric mixer. Transfer to a large casserole dish or heavy serving pot. Stir in molasses and lime juice. Cover tightly and refrigerate overnight.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,mar bar,vegetable shortening,mint leaf,pistachio,parsnip,ancho chile powder
title: Parsnips with Pistachios
ingredients: parsnips, peeled and cut in half lengthwise | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar, packed | 1/2 lb margarine or 1/2 lb butter | 1/8 cup dark brown sugar, packed | 4 tablespoons vegetable shortening | fresh mint leaf | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder | 1/2 cup toasted shelled pistachios, lightly salted
instructions: Heat oven to 300f degrees. Place parsnips on two rimmed baking sheets, then toss with 1/4 cup brown sugar. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes, tossing a few times, until browned lightly. Meanwhile, melt 1/4 cup brown sugar until golden and creamy. Remove from heat and mix in 1/4 cup lard, 1/8 cup oil, mint leaves and chile powder. Set aside 1/3 cup pistachios. Remove and discard the parsnips. Dip the remaining parsnips in the reserved brown sugar mixture. Dredge them in the remaining pistachios. In a nonstick skillet, melt the reserved pistachios until a little crisp. Add the coated parsnips.

Random Ingredients: white pepper,feta cheese,romaine lettuce,vegetable oil,chunky peanut butter,rye bread
title: Peanut Butter & Feta Salad With Crisped Rye
ingredients: 4 -6 cups romaine lettuce, chopped | 1/4 cup chunky peanut butter | 1/3 - 1/2 cup chunky peanut butter ( to taste ) | 1 -2 cup crumbled feta cheese | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 1 -2 teaspoon vegetable oil
instructions: Add the peanut and peanut butter to a food processor and pulse until the peanuts are broken down, then add the feta cheese, white pepper and vegetable oil mix well. If the mixture seems runny, or too thick, you may need to add more oil. Place onto a serving plate, drizzle with dressing and serve immediately.

title: Apple Kugel
ingredients: 2 cups finely chopped peeled apples | 1 cup pecans, coarsely chopped | 8 saffron threads, soaked in 1/4 cup hot water for 10 minutes and drained ( about 2 teaspoons ) | 24 cardamom pods, whole | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1/8 teaspoon saffron thread | 1/2 cup unsweetened apple juice | 2 large egg yolks
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f place the apple, pecans, saffron, cardamom, cardamom, saffron mixture, apple juice and egg yolks in a bowl and mix well. Shape into walnut size balls and place on a parchment lined baking sheet. Bake until brown on top, about 20 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Mascheries
ingredients: 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 teaspoon grainy mustard | 2 tablespoons chopped sumac | 1 package ladyfingers
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly grease a small baking sheet. In a bowl, mix together canola oil, grainy mustard and sumac. Set aside. Place a ladyfinger on a pastry towel. Place 1/4 cup of the oil mixture in a small bowl. Dip the ladyfinger in the oil. Place in a single layer over the top of the ladyfingers. Bake in the preheated oven for 15 to 20 minutes, or until golden and crisp.

title: Spinach Toss
ingredients: 3 cups fresh baby spinach | 1/4 cup fish stock | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric powder | 2 teaspoons fennel seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons cornstarch | 8 tostadas, prepared as desired | 1/4 teaspoon tamari or 1/4 teaspoon soy sauce
instructions: Cook spinach in the fish stock, turmeric powder and fennel seeds until just tender, about 1 minute. Meanwhile, mix cornstarch with 1/4 cup water in a small saucepan. Stir into spinach.

title: Fennel, Celery and Walnut Patties
ingredients: 1 large celery rib, chopped | 6 tablespoons walnuts, chopped | 2 medium garlic | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1 1/2 cups bisquick, plus more | ice water or 1 1/2 cups flour, for sandwich crashers | fennel, to garnish
instructions: Chop celery very finely or grind it in a food processor. Place nuts, garlic, lemon rind, turmeric and lemon juice in a bowl. Stir in the mixture until well blended. Add 1 tablespoon of mix at a time just to make it as chunky as your fingers. On an ungreased griddle or skillet, make the patty into patties and brown quickly. If you don't have a griddle, use a nonstick skillet. To serve sprinkle the patty with flour, if desired. Garnish with fennel.

title: Spicy Omelete from the House of Ome
ingredients: 4 hard-boiled eggs, peeled | 2 fluid ounces triple sec
instructions: If you are using an upright omelette, remove the outer ring and slice the center, allowing room for each piece to slip into the fluid. Place the omelete onto an oven proof tray and fill with plenty of olive oil. Place under a hot grill and bake the omelete in an oven for 7 - 10 minutes or until the outside is golden brown. Place onto a warmed serving dish. Use a fork to mash the eggs, using a fork in a criss cross pattern.

title: Pepperoni Wrapped Lettuce
ingredients: 3 leaves medium cabbage | 3 ounces pepperoni | 1 1/2 ounces sun-dried tomatoes, roughly chopped | 4 ounces prosciutto | 3 tablespoons fresh coriander or 3 tablespoons fresh parsley, roughly chopped | 2 teaspoons cardamom seeds | 40 large lettuce leaves
instructions: Cut each stalk diagonally into three. Wrap each of the three strips into a loose strand of cheesecloth with a strip of kitchen string, securing it with the string. Remove the string and wrap each slice with a second strip. Secure the ends of the wrapped bundles with a toothpick if necessary. Cover a baking tray with foil and preheat the oven to 200 c / 350°f line a baking sheet with baking paper. Cut each bundle in half crossways. Place on the lined tray. Cut the pepperoni into four 1 x 2 cm long pieces with a scissors or with kitchen scissors. Place the remaining ingredients in a bowl. Cover and set aside in a cool spot. Remove each bundle from the paper and roll it up tightly, securing it with kitchen string using kitchen string. Unwrap the bundles. Lay out bundles on a board and scatter over the pepperoni slices. Dip the ends of the bundles into the dressing, one at a time. Arrange on the baking tray. Bake for 30 minutes, toss and check they are done. Serve with additional dressing if desired, or with a green salad.

Random Ingredients: lentil,chervil,italian plum tomato,baking potato,pepperoncini pepper,coffee liqueur,orange peel
title: Lebanese Tomato Soup
ingredients: 2 cups baking potatoes, diced ( about 1-3/4 ) | 1/2 cup dry lentils ( red or yellow, such as arabian or other small green beans ) | 6 tablespoons coffee liqueur | 6 medium red italian plum tomatoes | 1 orange peel, diced | 1/4 cup chopped fresh chervil | fresh ground pepperoncini pepper, garnish
instructions: Spray a 6 quart saucepan with veggie oil. Heat over medium high heat, and stir in potatoes. Cook, stirring frequently, for 5 minutes, or until potatoes are tender. Stir in lentils, cook 2 minutes, and stir in 3/4 cup of water. Cook, covered, stirring occasionally, for 15 minutes, until lentils are tender. Meanwhile, place tomatoes, orange peel and chervil in a saucepan.

title: Brown Sugar and Salt Cranberry Bark
ingredients: 2 packages bittersweet chocolate | 1 cup firmly packed light brown sugar | 1/4 cup yellow onion, minced | 1 cup celery, minced | 4 cups fresh cranberries, chopped | 1 2/3 cups kirsch or 1 2/3 cups cherry preserves | 1 1/2 teaspoons kosher salt | 1 tablespoon dry mustard
instructions: Cut off top rind of chocolate and carefully remove rind. Cut in half lengthwise. Pour the chocolate into a large heavy duty aluminum bowl, and set one half aside. Line a sheet pan with a double thickness of aluminum foil and coat with cooking spray. Place chocolate bowl in bowl. In heavy large saucepan, heat sugar, onion, celery and brown sugar over medium heat, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes. Add cranberries, kirsch or preserves, salt and mustard. Heat 2 to 3 minutes or until mixture comes to a boil. Pour hot mixture onto chocolate in bowl and stir until all chocolate is melted and mixture is smooth. Transfer to a glass baking dish. Chill for 2 hours or until firm. Cut reserved chocolate into small strips. Line a 9 inch square baking pan with foil and lightly spray with cooking spray. Spread chocolate in a thin layer on foil. Dip baking dish into hot raspberry kirsch or cherry syrup and sprinkle with chocolate. Carefully place on rack of a broiler pan large enough to contain Bark in a single layer. Broil approximately 8 inches from heat until chocolate is bubbly and brown, about 10 minutes. Chill 4 hours or overnight in an airtight container, stirring occasionally, until firm. Cut Bark into 12 squares or rectangles.

title: Campfire Ham Salad
ingredients: 1 sheet nori ( dry seaweed ) | 2 tablespoons mayonnaise | 2 tablespoons half-and-half | 8 medium basil leaves | 1/2 cup chopped cooked ham
instructions: Place nori onto grill rack, about 5 inches from heat. If using dry seaweed, brush with olive oil. Grill until lightly toasted and blackened, about 2 minutes per side. Let cool. Remove seaweed. Combine mayonnaise, half & half and basil in a large bowl. Add ham.

Random Ingredients: garlic paste,beef brisket,thyme leaf,sherry wine vinegar
title: Roasted Sweet & Sour Glazed Corned Beef
ingredients: 8 -10 lbs boneless corned beef brisket | 3 tablespoons garlic paste | 3 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons minced fresh thyme leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 275°f place brisket on a rack in a shallow roasting pan, fat side up. Combine garlic, vinegar, and thyme in a small bowl. Spread paste evenly on top of brisket. Roast in a 375°f oven for 2 hours per pound of meat.

title: Raclette With Nicoise Olives and Feta Cheese in Pressure Cooker
ingredients: 1 teaspoon ground ginger root, minced | 2 cups nicoise olives, pitted and sliced | 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese | 1 wheel raclette cheese
instructions: Seal pressure cooker lid. Heat on high until hot. Pour olive oil into pressure cooker. When oil is hot, add ginger root and stir fry 1 minute. Mix in olives, feta cheese, and 1/2 c. Water. Close lid of pressure cooker. When pressure reduces, release pressure on high pressure setting. Close lid of pot and bring up temperature to high pressure on vent pipe. Close lid and bring pressure up to high pressure. Reduce pressure according to pressure pipe instructions. Remove from heat and wait for 2 minutes before releasing pressure. Carefully remove lid and slice raclette into pieces. Serve with remaining olive oil.

title: Brazilian triple sec
ingredients: 4 fluid ounces milk | 2 tablespoons triple sec
instructions: Pour 2 teaspoons of triple sec into a shaker. Pour the milk. Shake vigorously and pour into a chilled glass half filled with ice cubes. Garnish with a cherry and green onion if desired.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,red wine,mozzarella cheese,pork shoulder,nutmeg,green chili pepper,beet,raisin
title: Spanish Pork Salad
ingredients: 5 lbs pork shoulder, cut into 2 '' pieces, skin removed | 1/4 lb green chili pepper, seeded sliced ( hot or mild to your choice ) | 1 1/2 cups red wine ( a good red, but not too dry ) | 1 cup raisins | 1/2 cup dried beets, cooked | 1 small yellow bell pepper, roasted, peeled and sliced into thin matchstick-sized strips ( green or red ) | 1/2 cup fresh grated mozzarella cheese | 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg, grated
instructions: Place pork in a heavy dutch oven. Add chile, wine, raisins and beets. Stir to mix. Cover and heat to boiling, then reduce heat to low and continue to simmer, turning occasionally, for 90 minutes. Add bell pepper strips and cheese and heat through about 5 minutes. Cool slightly before serving. If the salad is too thick, stir 1/4 cup hot water in to the salad.

title: Easy Mexican Pork & Ziti
ingredients: 1 package ziti pasta, uncooked | 1 lb pork tenderloin | 1/2 cup chunky salsa | 1 celery rib, thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f spray a 9x13 glass baking dish with cooking spray. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add ziti and cook until almost tender but still firm to the bite, stirring often, about 10 minutes. Drain and transfer pasta to a cutting board. Cut pork into 1/4 inch cubes and stir into skillet. When pork is fully cooked through, stir in salsa and bring to a boil. Add ziti and toss until heated through. Spoon pasta into prepared baking dish, cover and bake 25 minutes.

title: Baked Farfalle With Bulgur
ingredients: 1 lb uncooked farfalle pasta ( bowtie pasta ) | 1 1/2 cups bulgar wheat ( or other grains ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons paprika | 1 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to boil. Add farfalle, and cook for about 8 to 10 minutes, until al dente. Drain, and set aside. In a large bowl, mix together wheat and paprika. Mix in the garlic powder. Lightly grease a 13x9x2 inch baking dish. Add the cooked farfalle, and mix lightly. Place farfalle in the baking dish, and pour the bulgur over the farfalle and bulgur. Mix lightly. Cover with foil, and bake in the preheated oven, for 30 to 40 minutes, until the farfalle is cooked and the dish is golden.

title: Spicy Fish Balls
ingredients: 450 g firm white fish fillets ( such as monk fish or similar ) | 175 g plain flour | 1/4 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 1 2 1/2 teaspoons dijon mustard or 1 2 1/2 teaspoons other strong thick mustard | 2 -3 finely diced green chili
instructions: Cut fish fillets into 1cm cubes. Measure 1 1/2 cup of fish and put into a pan with about a cup of water and bring to the boil. Reduce heat and simmer fish for 2 minutes, uncovered, then drain and cool slightly. Place flour into a small bowl and add breadcrumbs, mustard and green chilli. Mix well and add to fish in pan, stirring until all ingredients are combined. Divide mixture into balls the size of walnuts and drop onto a plate. Preheat oven to 200c/fan 160c/gas 4, line shallow oven trays with baking paper. Cook balls in batches in batches for 4 - 5 minutes, then transfer to oven trays and cook fish balls in batches, turning regularly until brown outside and fish is cooked through. These can also be served with cream or custard.

title: Lemony Meatloaf
ingredients: 2 lbs ground veal | 1 lb ground veal | 1 package frozen mixed vegetables, with juice ( i've used frozen ) | 8 ounces sliced genoa salami, in strips | 1/2 cup sliced sliced green olives | 8 ounces evaporated milk | 1 tablespoon lemon juice, fresh | 3 tablespoons raspberries, fresh in their juice, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a bowl combine the ground meats with the vegetables. Mix well. In a separate bowl mix the liquid ingredients. Add this mix to the meat mixture, mix well. Bake meat loaf in the oven for 1 hour, or until no longer pink. If there is any juice remaining on the meat loaf it should be no longer liquidy. Remove loaf from oven, tent with foil, and let sit for about 10 minutes before serving.

title: Aunt Jenny's Spinach Bow Ties
ingredients: 1 lb bow tie pasta | 1 cup fresh spinach leaves, rinsed, dried and chopped
instructions: In a large pot of boiling, salted water, cook the bow tie pasta until al dente. Drain well. In a saucepan of boiling, salted water, cook the hot pasta to desired doneness. Drain, and rinse with cold water to remove the excess water. Drain again. In a large pot of boiling, salted water, cook the spinach until bright green and wilted, about 3 minutes. Drain the spinach, and chop. Set aside. In a large bowl, toss together the cooked pasta, spinach, and the cooked liquid. Chill in the refrigerator at least 30 minutes before serving to firm the mixture.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,red onion,vanilla essence,thyme,chili sauce,galangal,butter,flour
title: Thai Style Curry Sauce
ingredients: 375 -500 g fresh steamed flour ( for dredging ) | 1 small red onion, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1/4 teaspoon chili sauce | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon ground galangal | 2 -3 drops vanilla essence ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon butter
instructions: Place steamed flour in a large bowl. Mix flour with onion, thyme, chilli sauce, dark soy sauce, galangal, and vanilla essence. Add just enough cold water to make a firm dough. If necessary, add a little more cold water to stop dough from forming. Knead dough with your hands for 10 minutes, adding more water if dough becomes too dry. Cover with cling film and place somewhere warm for around 1 hour. Divide dough into 12 portions. Roll each portion out thinly on floured surface until thin. Flatten each portion of dough onto a lightly floured surface, and then cut into thin strips approximately 2cm wide and 15cm long. Repeat, cutting strips into strips as before, until there is at least 12 layers of pastry in base of mixture. Keep stacked pastry strips chilled in a large container until ready to use. Spray tray lightly with oil. Remove pastry from refrigerator and bring to room temperature. Lightly coat a large, deep pan with oil. Place pastry strips in pan and fry on both sides until golden brown, about 3 - 5 minutes. You can then place fried strips in air tight container for later use. Store cooked strips in a airtight container in the refrigerator.

title: Quick & Easy Basic Garlic Roasted Olives
ingredients: 1/2 cup finely diced sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil ( or other roasted flavor ) | 1/3 cup shredded olive oil | sea salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Pour the mixture into a shallow baking dish or on a cookie sheet lined with parchment paper, and roast in a 400f oven for 25 minutes, or until bubbly and lightly browned. Keep an eye on it, i often watch it take several minutes to dry it up. It burns very easily remove from oven & cool completely before slicing very thin. Store in tightly covered container in the fridge. This will last up to 5 days, turning occasionally. The olives are delicious eaten straight from the oven. Store frozen in an airtight tupperware container at room temperature for up to 1 week.

title: Sopa Baked in Banana Syrup
ingredients: 1 cup long-grain white rice | 2 sweet bananas, sliced 1/4-inch thick | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 tablespoon triple sec
instructions: Preheat oven to 400ºf. Grease a 13x9 inch baking dish. In a medium mixing bowl, combine the rice, bananas and baking soda. Stir and stir in triple sec. Pour into the prepared baking dish. Cover with aluminum foil and bake 20 to 25 minutes, or until the center is set.

Random Ingredients: vanilla vodka,spanish onion,soy sauce,ha avocado,poppy seed,spaghetti,couscous
title: Avocado Couscous Salad With Poppy Seed Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup couscous, cooked | 1 spanish onion, small, cut into rings | 3 hass avocados | 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 1 -2 tablespoon soy sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons vanilla flavored vodka | 1/2 tablespoon poppy seed
instructions: Cut the onions and avocados into cubes and fry them in 1 - 2 tablespoons of soy sauce and vanilla for about 5 minutes. Mix the cooked rice with the onion mixture in a large bowl. Chop the avocado and pour the rest of the soy sauce and vanilla flavoring in to the bowl and mix together. Pour the yogurt in and mix it together. Chill the salad for 30 minutes. Serve with the poppy seeds on top.

title: Dairy Free Shrimp Rolled in Nori
ingredients: 1 sheet nori | 1/2 cup of prepared macaroni | 1 teaspoon table salt | 3 teaspoons of dashi or 3 teaspoons fish sauce
instructions: Preparation, fill a large bowl of hot tap water. Add the salt, seaoning and dashi to the cold water. Take off the heat and stir in the nori to coat the pasta. Once the pasta is coated, transfer it to the hot water, and quickly take two sheets of plastic wrap. Take the towel from around the bowl, put a pinch or two of salt on them, and squeeze the pasta to remove any excess water. Roll the nori until it is coated with salt and pinch off excess. This can take anywhere from two sheets, to eight sheets. Place the nori on a plate, spoon the mixture onto it, and roll it up. You can slice it into four squares, or you can make it into three even size balls, like a small eggroll. If you want to keep it longer, freeze the rolls for up to 2 weeks. Bring the dashi to a boil, reduce, and simmer for a few minutes for the seasoning to become a creamy sauce. Add your shrimp, stir to coat with the seasoning, and serve.

title: Toffee Rings (Lazy Pig Method)
ingredients: cooking spray | 4 eggs
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Line baking sheets with aluminum foil. Spray the tops and bottom with cooking spray. Separate and form 4 smaller oval shaped slices, lengthwise. Place in the pan about 1 inch apart. Using a metal spatula, carefully lift one cake at a time and poke holes in the outer layer with a fork. Repeat with remaining cake. Push the cake gently into center with spatula. Brush with beaten egg and sprinkle with salt. Bake in preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until crust is golden and toothpick inserted into center comes out clean. Remove from oven, and let cool 10 minutes. Remove toothpicks. Serve warm, or allow to cool completely.

title: Hamburger Steak
ingredients: 1/2 lb steak, cut into four thin steaks | 5 -6 drops tabasco hot pepper sauce
instructions: Pound steaks.

Random Ingredients: cocoa,cooking spray,italian parsley,crescent dinner,cod,italian salad dressing mix
title: Cod Croquettes
ingredients: 12 tubes crescent dinner rolls | cooking spray | 1 package dry italian salad dressing mix | 1/2 cup italian parsley, chopped | 4 lbs fresh cod | 1/2 cup unsweetened dutch-processed cocoa
instructions: Cook and bake as directed on box. Separate rolls and unroll crescent rolls. Roll out each tube approximately 2 inches larger than the other and place on a greased baking sheet. Bake at 350°f 8 - 9 minutes or until light brown. Place 1 cod in a large pot of water. Bring water to boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium and simmer for 8 to 10 minutes or until cooked. Drain. Cut the cod into 6 - 8 pieces. Add to the boiled water. Cook 5 more minutes or until cod is crisp and fish flakes easily with a fork. Drain and save the fish bones for use in a gravy. Drain excess oil and serve cod with the reserved fish broth and warm italian bread.

Random Ingredients: tomato ketchup,whipping cream,cream cheese,vegetable bouillon cube
title: Frozen Cream Cheese and Tomato Soup
ingredients: 1 can tomato ketchup | 1 vegetable bouillon cube | 3 tablespoons whipped cream ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon whipping cream ( optional )
instructions: Blend ketchup and bouillon cubes to gether, mix with cream and freeze well. Add whipped cream if using for the future. You can also pour the soup into bowls and freeze until solid, then remove from freezer. Serve with lots of grated parmesan cheese.

Random Ingredients: potato starch,leg lamb,plain flour,raspberry liqueur,cilantro leaf,cilantro,artichoke heart
title: Raspberry Crusted Lamb and Artichoke Pasta
ingredients: 2 tablespoons potato starch | 2 tablespoons plain flour | 1 leg of lamb, butterflied | 300 g fresh artichoke hearts, chopped | 2 tablespoons fresh cilantro leaves, coarsely chopped | 300 ml raspberry liqueur | fresh cilantro or basil leaves, to garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c/180c. Spray the inside of a 1 kg oven proof dish with oil spray, lay in a single layer and top with the potato flour. Dust the lamb with the flour. Using a knife slash the pieces of lamb and artichoke over the surface forming a marbled design and cutting to fit if desired, place in a single layer on the potato flour. Drizzle over the raspberry liqueur. Scatter the cilantro and raspberries over the meat followed by the top sizzling sound followed by a piece of cilantro or basil. Set the dish in the oven for 45 minutes. Remove from the oven and turn the heat down to 160c/300f. Leave for a further 20 mins so the garlic could be cooked through the meat. Turn off the oven and leave the oven door for a further hour to cool slightly before serving.

title: Roasted Poblano Bell peppers
ingredients: 2 pounds poblano peppers | 1/2 cup chili powder | 1 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place the poblano peppers on the prepared baking sheet. Drizzle chili powder and mace over the peppers, and season with salt.

Random Ingredients: chinese rice wine,allspice,chipotle chile,dark rum,balsamic vinegar
title: Chipotle Chili Jam
ingredients: 1/2 cup chipotle chile ( canned chipotle chilies or equivalent ) | 2 cups light dark rum | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 teaspoon ground allspice | 1 1/2 - 2 liters chinese-style cooked rice wine ( chinese rice vinegar is best )
instructions: In a small frying pan or saucepan, toast the chillies over a low heat. Stir often for about 5 minutes until fragrant. Pour the chilies into a heatproof cup, add the rum, vinegar and ground allspice. Stir well. Pour in the wine or rice wine and stir until thoroughly mixed and the jam has a good consistency. Do not refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Furitas
ingredients: 1 lb green pepper ( in one piece, cut in strips ) | 1 tablespoon fresh dill weed
instructions: Put the green pepper into a bowl and mash until very fine. Add the dill and mix it in well. Serve plain or make your own. Great with refried beans or rice.

title: Auntie Lori's Indian Spicy Masala
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon garam masala | 2 teaspoons dark soy sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Store airtight in refrigerator.

title: Pasta With Rice Crescannon II
ingredients: 1 pound rigatoni pasta | 1/2 cup rice wine
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook rigatoni in boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, 12 to 16 minutes. Drain. Transfer cooked rigatoni to a large bowl. Stir rice wine into the pasta.

title: Quick & Easy Chunky Indian Bread -
ingredients: 2 cups self rising flour | 1 teaspoon chili flakes | 1/2 teaspoon dried clove, crushed | 1 tablespoon raisins ( optional )
instructions: Stir together the flour, chili flakes and raisins if using. Turn out onto a lightly floured surface and knead lightly until smooth. Divide the dough in half. Take one half of the dough and lightly oil the griddle. Heat griddle until very hot, then turn the dough and bake until it doubles in size. Turn in the other half of the dough and bake until it doubles in size. Cut into wedges when cool and serve with any indian snack recipe.

title: Strawberries for Two
ingredients: 4 -6 large strawberries | 1/2 cup fine semolina ( or coarse wheat ) | 1/4 cup drained capers, for sprinkling ( or 2 tablespoons of fresh minced capers )
instructions: Pit the strawberries and discard the ends. Slice the flesh and arrange them in a shallow bowl, sprinkling each slice lightly with salt, if desired. Sprinkle the semolina over and toss lightly to coat all sides, then turn each slice in the semolina to coat completely. Put the capers into a bowl, scatter over the strawberries and scatter some more capers over. Let stand 30 minutes to allow the flavors to blend. Serve right away or cool and serve at room temperature. This is delicious when served right away.

Random Ingredients: red enchilada sauce,baby bella mushroom,dark sesame oil,olive oil,poblano pepper
title: Beef Fajitas
ingredients: 2 lbs skirt steaks | 1/4 cup olive oil | 5 poblano peppers, coarsely chopped | 8 ounces baby bella mushrooms, coarsely sliced | 1 can red enchilada sauce | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil
instructions: Brush skirt steak with a mixture of the olive oil and dark sesame oil. Cook steaks in hot oil, about 5 minutes per side in a pan sprayed with pam. Remove from pan and set aside. Cook poblano peppers, mushrooms and enchilada sauce over medium low heat for 5 minutes. Slice steak thinly and serve with mixture.

title: Clams & Pears
ingredients: 1 tablespoon oil | 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves, cubed | 2 skinless, boneless pears, cored and cubed | 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger ale | 1 clove garlic, chopped | 2 pears - peeled, cored and diced | 7 peeled and diced potatoes
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat, and cook the chicken and pears until the chicken is no longer pink and juices run clear, about 15 minutes. Stir in the ginger ale and garlic, and cook for about 1 more minute. Mix in the pears and potatoes, and gently toss to combine. Reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,water chestnut,chicken,fennel seed,wasabi paste,tomato paste
title: Wasabi Chicken
ingredients: 1 cup water chestnut | 1 cup chopped chicken | 1 tablespoon wasabi paste | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed ( optional ) | 1 large serrano pepper, seeded and chopped
instructions: Place the drained water chestnuts in a strainer, and rinse with cool water. Pat dry with a paper towels. Cut the chicken into 1/2 inch cubes. Place the wasabi paste, tomato paste, and fennel seed in a food processor, and process until smooth. Add the chilie. Process until the chicken is well coated. Place the chicken in a medium skillet over medium low heat. Cook the chicken in the sauce, turning occasionally.

title: Potatoes (Alsatian, Russian, French, Peruvian, etc.)
ingredients: 3 -4 medium yellow potatoes, peeled | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon anise seed | corn oil ( for frying ) or canola oil ( for frying )
instructions: Slice potatoes into 1/8 inch slices. Cut the slices into 1/8 inch wide slices, as this will be the base of the potato slices. In a large skillet, heat enough oil until it reaches about 1/4 inch. Fry potato slices till golden brown. Drain on paper towels. When finished, place fried potato slices in a large bowl, mix with a good coating of anise seeds. Allow potatoes to cool to room temperature. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: coconut cream,sage leaf,prosciutto,chicken bouillon,green onion,soy sauce
title: Prosciutto Wrapped Chicken
ingredients: 1/4 cup soy sauce | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon | 2 green onions, chopped | 1 pinch sage leaf, or | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh sage | 1 cup coconut cream ( or coconut milk ) | 1/4 lb thinly sliced prosciutto
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the soy sauce, bouillon, green onions, sage and coconut cream. Add prosciutto and mix together well. Pour the mixture into a plastic bag with a corner or a regular panni press. Marinate the chicken for at least one hour or overnight. Boil the marinade for 10 minutes in a large pot with medium high sides. Remove the chicken from the bag and pour in the marinade. Cook over medium heat for 15 minutes or until the chicken is cooked and the sauce thickens. Serve the chicken on a bun with fresh tomatoes, sweet pepper strips, and shredded cheddar cheese or with steamed brown rice.

title: Smoked Fish Platter
ingredients: 1 kg fish fillet, in 1 kg portions | 1 kg new potato | 500 ml barbecue sauce | 25 cardamom seeds | 2 -3 kg meat, cut into 6 portions
instructions: To prepare the platter, remove the skin from fish. Slice the fish into 6 portions to form an oblong shape. Place 1 portion of fish on each piece of fish. Sprinkle cardamom seeds and 1 quantity of the barbecue sauce on the fish. Roll up each piece securely with the palm of your hand. Place platter on platter. Cut 1 onion in thin slices. Arrange onion on platter. Place 2 large tin foil dishes on top of the platter. Smother the platter with the remaining barbeque sauce. Heat the smoker. Place the potato pieces on the smoker, and allow to stand for 15 - 20 minutes before removing. Place remaining fish portions on top of the platter. Place 2 onion slices on top, and spoon over remaining barbecue sauce. Remove from fire and place onions on platter. Serve with potato bread. The platter can also be sprinkled with chopped nuts or serve with steamed vegetables.

title: Irish Potato and Hazelnut Soup
ingredients: 1 potato, peeled and chopped | 1 1/2 cups soup stock | 1 whole hard-boiled egg, chopped | ground cinnamon, to taste | 1/2 cup hazelnuts, toasted, skinned and chopped
instructions: Place potato and soup in a heavy pan and bring to a boil. Add egg and pepper to taste and simmer for 40 minutes. Garnish soup with nuts and cinnamon.

title: Mango Salad (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 10)
ingredients: 1 can coconut milk ( not condensed ) | 1/8 cup red onion, finely chopped ( small ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh oregano, chopped
instructions: Place coconut milk and onion in a medium bowl and mash with a fork until mixed well. Add oregano and mix well. Serve.

title: Roast Peaches
ingredients: 2 kg sliced fresh peaches or 2 kg frozen peaches | 2 chicken bouillon cubes
instructions: Pre heat oven to 190 deg celsius. Slice peaches in half and remove the stones. Place on a lined oven tray or baking tray, leaving the stalk on, and bake for approximately 40 minutes, or until the peaches are soft. Dissolve the chicken stock cubes in some water, and add to the pan, bring to the boil, then simmer for 10 minutes until the sauce reduces slightly. Strain, and serve with warm toast.

title: Japanese Shoyu Crackers (Kabudana)
ingredients: 10 teaspoons cornmeal | 1/2 teaspoon ground fennel seed | 3/4 teaspoon cooking oil | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 1 teaspoon shoyu
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Place the cornmeal in a bowl, and season with fennel. Heat oil in a nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Saute the onion powder, and sprinkle on the cornmeal. Immediately pour the shoyu into the pan, and shake to combine. Drop by rounded tablespoons onto the parchment, and toast for 20 to 25 minutes, until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: ginger paste,pearl barley,orange juice,sprite,chili oil,rigatoni pasta,parsley leaf,worcestershire sauce
title: Rigatoni With Parsley Sauce
ingredients: 1 package rigatoni pasta | 1 teaspoon ginger paste | 2 teaspoons orange juice | 3 tablespoons sprite | 3 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1/4 cup pearl barley | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 2 tablespoons fresh parsley leaves, minced
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain pasta, toss with orange juice, ginger paste, sprite and worcestershire sauce. Garnish with barley and parsley.

Random Ingredients: pork loin,tofu,ham,onion salt,tarragon vinegar,tomato puree,liquid smoke
title: Cajun Style Pork Stuffed Tomatoes (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 24 large firm tomatoes | 100 g thick slab pork loin | ham ( ham bone ) | tarragon vinegar | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke | 1 teaspoon onion salt | 1/2 teaspoon tomato puree
instructions: If using thick slab of pork, cut into 2 inch cubes. Bake pork loin for 3 hours at 350f/180°c. Taste meat for salt. If using thick slab of pork, take a sharp knife and cut a cross in the top 2 minutes as far as possible, removing the top bone at the 1st joint if using thick slab. Trim off excess fat. Use the tip of a sharp knife to slice the top two thirds. Remove from oven and let stand 20 minutes. Slice thick slab into 5 thin slices. Place ham on the thick slab and using the point of your knife slice through it, being careful not to cut all the way through the slice to the edge of the thick slab. This will make the glaze easier to coat. Spread 1 tablespoon of the glaze onto the thick pork slices, keeping the slices as flat as possible. Place the slices of ham in a baking dish. Sprinkle ham with 1 tablespoon of vinegar. Add 1 tablespoon liquid smoke and 1/2 teaspoon of onion salt, mix thoroughly and pour into the baking dish. Cover with aluminium foil and bake in a 350f/180°c oven for 45 minutes or until bread is browned. Remove from oven and spoon remaining glaze over the tomatoes. Let stand for 10 minutes or until glaze is absorbed. Serve with hot cooked rice. The rice is usually served with a salad of green veegrette.

title: Easy Coppa Coppa
ingredients: 10 slices bacon drippings | 1 can orange juice concentrate ( orange liqueur )
instructions: Cook bacon until well done. With a slotted spoon, remove bacon grease from skillet and set skillet aside. Place drained bacon, orange juice concentrate and orange liqueur in 2 quart sauce pan. Heat and stir, cooking over low heat until heated through.

title: Baby Corn (or Spinach)
ingredients: 1 bunch baby corn, cut in half ( or frozen ) | 1/2 inch fresh gingerroot, peeled and cut into 6 thin slices
instructions: Put a generous amount of water on the bottom of a steamer or on a cookie sheet. Place the baby corn halves on the water and sprinkle generously with ginger slices. Add about a teaspoonful of water per piece of corn. Place under a hot broiler or on the baking sheet. Let the edges burn. You should hear the first popping sound around the edge.

title: Cherry Rabe
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups fresh cherries, pitted, rinsed and drained | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1 cup fresh, shredded lettuce leaves
instructions: In small bowl, mix together cherries, vinegar and 1/4 cup water. Refrigerate 30 minutes to marinate. Spoon cherry mixture on lettuce leaves and serve.

title: Curried Okra (Applesauce)
ingredients: 1 lb okra, trimmed | 2/3 cup applesauce | 1/2 cup sliced almonds ( optional ) | 1/2 cup mixed nuts, such as oats, cashew and pistachios | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Fry the okra over medium heat in a pan of hot water just until they are tender, but firm, just crisp tender. Drain over a bowl, leaving as much of the water in the pan as possible, and allow to cool. Squeeze out the excess moisture from the okra and set aside. Cook the applesauce in a large pan over medium high heat until they are very hot. Add the almonds and nuts, and continue cooking until they are lightly coloured, about 5 minutes. Add the turmeric, white pepper and toss well. Spoon this sauce over the cooked okra, and serve.

title: Slimming World Friendly Beef and Beans
ingredients: 3 lbs rump roast, trimmed of excess fat | 2 tablespoons seasoning salt | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 large green beans or 1 large green beans, trimmed | 1 can cannellini ( white kidney beans ) | 2 -3 green cardamoms, whole ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon tamari
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a slow cooker. Cover. Cook on low for 5 - 6 hours or on high for 4 - 5 hours until desired degree of tenderness. Stir meat.

Random Ingredients: lemon zest,caraway seed,dark brown sugar,water chestnut,zucchini,chipotle chile adobo,red pepper sauce,oregano leaf
title: Zucchini With Water Chestnuts and Chipotle
ingredients: 3 zucchini, trimmed and cut into 1/4 inch rounds | 2 water chestnuts, trimmed and cut into 1/4 inch rounds | 1/4 teaspoon caraway seed, crushed | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1 pinch ground red pepper sauce | 1/4 teaspoon freshly grated lemon zest | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 1 -2 tablespoon red pepper sauce
instructions: Bring a pot of salted water to a boil. Drop in the zucchini, the green water chestnuts and caraway seeds. Cook 2 minutes, drain. Combine the oregano, red pepper sauce, lemon zest, and brown sugar in a small bowl. Brush the zucchini with the hot glaze. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: bottom roast,baby spinach,salt black pepper,spaghetti,mango,tomato green chilies
title: Spaghetti Soup for Two
ingredients: 1 package dried spaghetti | 1 lb bottom roast | 1 can chopped tomatoes and green chilies | 1 bag baby spinach | 1 cup fresh mango, chopped | salt and black pepper
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook the spaghetti in the boiling water for 8 to 10 minutes, or until al dente. Drain well. Place the pork roast in a crockpot. Pour remaining liquid over the pork, then pour the tomatoes with chilies and spinach over the roast. Cover and cook on low until the pork is very tender, about 6 hours on low. If the soup is too thick, stir in a little water. Taste soup and adjust seasonings if necessary. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: neufchatel cheese,chicken bouillon cube,chunky salsa,tofu,lemon peel,coriander
title: Spicy Tofu Quesadilla
ingredients: 1/3 cup neufchatel cheese, diced small ( or a combination of 2 to 4 c. ) | 1 -2 chicken bouillon cube ( or use 1 packet ) | 1 box firm tofu, drained and crumbled | chunky salsa ( to taste ) ( optional ) | lemon peel ( optional ) | coriander ( optional )
instructions: Dice tofu or crumble it into small puffs. Add cheese, bouillon cube, salt and lemon peel until desired consistancy is reached. Spread on quesadilla, and top with salsa if you like. Let cool in refrigerator. May be cut into 3 wedges or 4 pieces to serve.

title: West Indian Vinaigrette
ingredients: 5 fluid ounces tomato puree | 1 1/2 fluid ounces hot chutney
instructions: In a screw top jar, combine the tomato puree and hot chutney. Cover and seal. Shake until the chutney resembles salad dressing.

title: Sweet Island Salsa
ingredients: 1 large fresh tomato-onion ( about 1 large-1/4-1/2 cups ) | 1 kiwi fruit, peeled seeded and smashed | 1 cup cooked jicama, broken into medium chunks | 1 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Prepare tomato onion salsa, place tomato onion and kiwi in a bowl and stir to combine. Place jicama, salt, and tomato onion salsa in a blender.

title: Raspberry Scones
ingredients: 12 ounces raspberries | 1/3 cup self-rising flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Pour the raspberries and flour in a bowl, and mix. Sprinkle a large baking sheet with parchment paper or wax paper. Using your hands, work the raspberry flour into the flour. Using your hands, work the raspberries into a ball in the pan with the flour, shaking off any excess flour. Sprinkle the top with more flour. Using a fork, poke several holes in the surface of the dough. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes in the preheated oven. Remove from oven, and place on a wire rack. Allow to cool. Best if eaten right away.

title: Cheesy Pork and Raspberry Au Gratin
ingredients: 4 thick slices pork roast, 2 1/2-1/2-inches ( i use boneless deli pork chops ) | 2 cups veal stock | 8 ounces fresh mushrooms, sliced | 2 ounces currants, soaked for 30 minutes in cold water and drained | 3 ounces gruyere cheese, thinly sliced | 1 pinch turmeric
instructions: Set oven to 375°f. Place a rack in center of oven and heat oven to 400f. Place the roast pieces in a shallow ovenproof casserole dish, fat side up. Add veal stock and mushrooms to dish and cover tightly. Place dish in oven and bake 45 to 50 minutes, until pork is cooked and vegetables are tender. Uncover and set aside to cool slightly. Place cheese over meat. Return dish to oven and bake 10 minutes or until cheese is melted and browned. Turn out and let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Bethany's Chips
ingredients: 24 corn tortilla strips | beef bouillon powder, or to taste | 1 teaspoon dried dill, or more to taste ( optional )
instructions: Arrange tortillas in a single layer on a plate or tray. Sprinkle with beef bouillon powder, dill, or more to taste, if desired. Place under a hot grill until chips are crisp and golden brown, about 5 minutes.

title: Sesame Dal With Channa Dal
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups sesame oil | 2 teaspoons channa dal ( indian yellow lentils )
instructions: Wash sesame in a few changes of water. Drain before using. Combine sesame oil and channa dal in a saucepan and bring to simmer over medium heat. Cook to thicken, about 5 minutes. Cool to room temperature before serving.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,corn oil,littleneck clam,chicken breast half,marzipan,chicken,red capsicum
title: Chicken, Corn and Capsicum
ingredients: 1 tablespoon corn oil | 400 g chicken breast halves, cut into strips | 50 g lelittleneck clams, drain and coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon marzipan | 150 g roasted red capsicums, quartered | 1 slice rye bread
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a wok over medium high heat, then cook chicken in batches until lightly browned on the outside and the juices run clear. Transfer to a plate. Heat remaining oil in wok. Add lelttooms and capsicum. Stir fry until crisp, 1 - 2 minutes. Add chicken and stock. Bring to boil. Reduce heat to medium and simmer for 2 - 2 1/2 minutes, until stock has reduced by half. Meanwhile, toast the rye bread until golden brown on each side. Top each piece with the rosti mixture. Replace the chicken in the wok, spooning extra rosti over.

Random Ingredients: white bread,almond extract,spanish onion,mint,beef brisket,onion powder,blueberry,active yeast
title: Blueberry Spiced Brisket
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups fresh blueberries ( or frozen ) | 4 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1/2 cup white bread, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 tablespoon onion powder | 1 teaspoon fresh mint, finely chopped or 1 teaspoon dried mint | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract | 4 1/2 lbs lean meaty beef brisket | 2 medium spanish onions, chopped
instructions: Place the blueberries in a small bowl.

title: Vinegar for a Crowd
ingredients: 1 tablespoon fresh lime zest | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 1/4 cup dry rice | 1/4 cup water
instructions: Finely grate lime zest. Combine lime zest with vinegar and rice in a glass bowl & mix quickly. Add the water and mix quickly enough to mix the ingredients.

title: Mashed Potatoes in Shaoxing Wine - Hong Kong Style
ingredients: 2 lbs yukon gold potatoes | 2 teaspoons shaoxing wine | 16 corn tortillas, cut into 8 wedges
instructions: Wash and peel the potatoes. Slice on the diagonal. Place them in a saucepan with the wine and bring to a boil. When the potatoes are just under soft, drain them and mash with the potato masher. Add the tortilla wedges and toss. Serve immediately.

title: Creamy Pecans, Wheat-Free Pilaf
ingredients: 3 cups buttermilk | 1/3 cup virgin olive oil | 2 tablespoons rice wine or 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 1 teaspoon butter or 1 teaspoon oil | 2 -3 pecan nuts, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Stir together buttermilk and oil in a saucepan and heat to boiling. In a small bowl whisk together rice wine and butter. Pour into milk mixture and whisk thoroughly. Add nuts and stir. Cook over low heat just until heated through.

Random Ingredients: oil,acorn squash,italian flat leaf parsley,pepperoni,peanut oil,tomatillo,hoisin sauce
title: Chilean Squash With Hoisin Sauce
ingredients: 1 medium acorn squash, halved lengthwise, seeds removed | 1 lb tomatillo, husked and rinsed | 1 tablespoon oil | 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce | 4 slices pepperoni | 1 tablespoon fresh flat leaf parsley, chopped | 1 teaspoon italian flat leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: Place squash halves on a foil lined baking sheet. Cut a slit in each half.

Random Ingredients: walnut oil,seasoning salt,brown sugar,chicken stock,italian salad dressing
title: St. Louis Fry Bread
ingredients: 2 tablespoons walnut oil | 1 1/4 teaspoons brown sugar | 1/4 cup chicken stock | 2 teaspoons good seasonings salt | 1 1/4 cups italian salad dressing
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. In a large heavy duty skillet, heat walnut oil and brown sugar over medium high heat until the sugar melts, 2 to 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Add stock, seasoning salt and salad dressing to hot skillet and stir until well blended. Spoon about 1/4 cup of the mixture into an 8x8 inch baking dish. Stir until bread is evenly coated with the sauce. Spread to cover and bake in the preheated oven until brown and bubbly, about 30 minutes.

title: Chef Flower's Risotto With Seared Veal
ingredients: 2 lbs thin risotto veal, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 6 tablespoons plain greek yogurt, divided | 1 teaspoon lemon zest, finely grated | 2 cups cooked rice | 1/2 teaspoon salt and pepper | 1/2 small goat cheese, cut into small cubes
instructions: Drain the veal very well and pat it dry with paper towels by layering in a cheese cloth. In a medium stainless steel skillet heat 3 tbls of the yogurt until it is beginning to foam. Add the lemon zest and stir with a wooden spoon until the zest has been evenly distributed. Add the rice, a little at a time, tossing well until all the rice grains are slightly moistened. The rice should not have any lumps. Add the remaining tbls of yogurt and stir until well combined. Transfer the risotto to a large bowl or platter or plates and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Garnish with the cheese. Serve immediately.

title: Mexican Green Chile Pepper Relish
ingredients: 1 cup dried cranberries ( about 1/3 cup per cup ) | 4 -5 small green chili peppers | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon
instructions: Place chiles in a small bowl, cover with hot water, allowing enough to soften, 20 - 30 minutes. Drain. Place drained chiles in the serving bowl of a food processor or blender, cover and process until finely ground. Add chile mixture all at once and process. Stir in cinnamon and refrigerate 1 to 2 hours, stirring once or twice. Store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 2 weeks.

title: Tahini Popsicles
ingredients: 1/2 cup tahini | 1 cup chopped bamboo shoots
instructions: Preheat your oven's broiler. In a blender or food processor, sieve the tahini into a bowl, and stir in the cayenne pepper. Add the bamboo shoots and mix until you have a smooth, creamy, green paste. Scrape the mixture into a baking pan coated with cooking spray and spread the paste evenly over the top. Place in the oven and broil until the puffs of melted and bubbly.

title: Hot Beef Tenderloin Lasagna
ingredients: 3 lbs beef tenderloin | 3 cups thinly sliced celery | 16 lasagna noodles, cooked and drained | 1 teaspoon dry mustard | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/8 teaspoon ground cayenne ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place beef tenderloin in heavy skillet. Cook 2 to 3 minutes. Remove beef from skillet. Cook celery 5 minutes or until tender crisp. Remove beef. Combine celery with remaining ingredients except meat. Pour mixture over beef in skillet and let stand 1 minute. Transfer mixture to shallow baking dish. Cover tightly with foil and bake 30 minutes. Bake uncovered 15 minutes longer or until golden brown.

title: Peach Melba
ingredients: 1 peach, sliced | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh mint | 2 tablespoons shaved smoked gouda cheese
instructions: To serve, arrange a peach slice onto each warmed platter, sprinkle with mint, and mince cheese.

Random Ingredients: escarole,tomato green chilies,cooking oil,dark raisin,almond extract,green bean,rock salt
title: Mexican Green Beans and Almonds
ingredients: 10 ounces fresh green beans, topped and tailed | 2 -3 tablespoons cooking oil | 2 cups thinly sliced raw almonds | 1/2 teaspoon rock salt | 3 ounces slivered almonds ( about 1 cup ) | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1/2 teaspoon deloued almond extract | 1 1/2 teaspoons bottled rock salt
instructions: Cook the beans in a large pan of boiling salted water for 5 minutes, or until barely tender. Drain and set aside. Heat the oil in a large skillet, and saute the almonds over low heat for 3 - 4 minutes. Remove the skillet from the heat. Combine with the tomatoes with chilies, almond extract, and rock salt and mix thoroughly. Serve over beans.

title: Lemon Grass Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 ounces white mushrooms, chopped | 3 tablespoons bread crumbs | 1 teaspoon finely chopped lemongrass | 2 tablespoons grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Preheat the broiler. In a food processor, process the mushrooms with bread crumbs, lemon grass and cheese until finely chopped.

title: Homemade Yogurt with Peppercorns
ingredients: 8 fluid ounces nonfat yogurt | 1 tablespoon kitchen bouquet | 1 clove fresh ginger root, peeled and minced | 2 peppercorns, crushed
instructions: In a small bowl mix together the yogurt, kitchen bouquet, ginger, and peppercorns. Chill in refrigerator until serving.

title: Mock Devone
ingredients: 1 carton yoghurt | 1 tablespoon metaxa brandy | 1/4 cup plain yogurt | 1 teaspoon vanilla-flavored soymilk | 1 slice prosciutto | 1 teaspoon poultry seasoning ( i use tony chachere's )
instructions: Blend everything together. Serve over ice.

title: Chunky Plum Tomato Pasta Sauce
ingredients: 8 ounces plum tomatoes ( tinned ) | 1 ounce plain flour
instructions: Place the plum tomatoes on a baking sheet with plenty of good black bread around them. Sprinkle them with a little of the flour, then give them a quick whack with a rolling pin, you do not want them to fall apart. When all the tomatoes are crushed, place them on a clean plate and leave them to chill while you make your sauce. Once the tomatoes are well chilled, then gently slip them out of their skins into a bowl. Add the flour and give them a quick, quick whack again. Add a bit of water if you need to if the sauce is too thick. Serve the sauce on the plates with a salad of fresh chopped herbs and chopped parsley.

title: Faux Nutella
ingredients: 4 walnut sized raw cashews | 1/2 - 3/4 cup icing sugar ( depending on taste, i have tried it on 1/8c of sugar ) | 1/2 cup dark rum or 1/2 cup scotch whisky | 1/2 teaspoon salad oil
instructions: Break cashews into small pieces. Heat in a pan of salted water until they begin to soften. Stir in icing sugar and rum gradually and stir continuously until icing is thick and shiny. Spread the icing with toasted nuts. Keep in mind a little goes a long way. If you have to use Scotch, it will add a lot to the icing.

title: Hot Curry Powder
ingredients: 2 tablespoons curry paste | 8 -10 fresh thyme sprigs | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon saffron or 1 -1 1/2 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Mix all ingredients together to make a fine paste.

title: Baked Fruity Bread and Pine Nut Pudding
ingredients: 6 slices white bread, crusts removed | 12 fluid ounces jam or 12 fluid ounces apricot jam | 4 ounces pine nuts | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1/2 cup toasted bulgur ( cracked wheat )
instructions: Set oven to 375f degrees. Grease a 6 cup shallow loaf pan. In a large bowl mix the bread with half the jam. Spread on 1/3 of the bread mixture. Top with 1/3 the pine nuts and cover with the rest of the bread. Dry on a baking sheet using a baking cloth or parchment paper. Sprinkle the remaining jam around the bread. Bake approximately 45 minutes until golden brown. Remove from oven and cool for about half an hour. When completely cold, cover with a serving plate and the remaining sliced bread. Break the baked loaf into pieces and place into the bowls. Makes about 10 servings, depending on what bread portion and fruit you’d like to make extra sandwiches.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,peanut butter,red chili pepper,yellow pepper,asafoetida powder
