title: Chile Peanut Butter Spread (Sinatra's Recipe)
ingredients: 1 cup creamy peanut butter | 1/3 cup chopped yellow sweet pepper | 1/3 cup chopped red chili pepper | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1/4 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Combine the peanut butter in the container of a blender or food processor. Add the peanuts, peppers, chili, and asafetida powder.

Random Ingredients: leek,black cardamom pod,ginger garlic paste,lemon essence
title: Lebanese Pureed Leeks (Yogurt Cheese)
ingredients: 5 -6 leeks, finely washed, and finely chopped ( about 12/3 cup ) | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 teaspoon lemon essence | 1 whole black cardamom pod
instructions: Place the chopped leeks in a blender along with the remaining ingredients and puree until smooth. If the mixture is too thick, add a little water. Chill the mixture in the refrigerator for 30 minutes and then divide this mixture into 16 equal portions. Shape each portion into a ball and roll slightly with your hands. Refrigerate the balls for at least 2 hours or overnight before serving. You can also store the leeks in a airtight container and use in the berberies to add hot spice foods as desired.

title: Spinach and Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef chuck, trimmed of some of the fat ( or use a combination of beef and lamb ) | 2 tablespoons shaoxing wine | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 1 lb fresh leaf spinach ( or baby spinach leaves )
instructions: Cut the meat into 4 serving size chunks and put in a saucepan with the wine and garam masala. Bring to a boil over medium heat, then lower the heat, cover and simmer for 1 hour, or until the meat is tender when pierced with a fork.

Random Ingredients: almond,no guilt hot fudge sauce,golden syrup
title: Hot Almond Sauce
ingredients: 175 g no-guil-flavored fudge sauce | 175 g toasted almonds | 1/4 cup golden syrup
instructions: Heat golden syrup in saucepan over a low heat, do not burn remove from the heat when it starts to thicken add a little bit of cold water to sweeten if needed. Blend until smooth and pour onto a plate. Spread with creamy vanilla ice cream / nonfat sweet ganache and serve immediately.

title: Spanish Seasoned Salt and Pepper Mix
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon anise seeds | 1/2 teaspoon salt and pepper
instructions: Prepare the salt from this recipe as written and with your salt/pepper mix all together and use as directed.

Random Ingredients: cornbread,tomato paste,sun tomato oil,almond meal,raspberry jam,pecan,corn tortilla,egg substitute
title: Raspberry Wheat Omelet Bars
ingredients: 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and chopped | 1/4 cup pine nuts | 1/4 cup cornbread, finely chopped | 1 cup egg substitute | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1 tablespoon raspberry jam | 1/2 cup almond meal | 4 corn tortillas, cut into strips
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees. Lightly spray an 18x9 inch, non stick, oven proof skillet with cooking spray. Arrange the sun dried tomato in the skillet and toast over medium heat, stirring until softened, about 4 minutes. Stir in the pine nuts, corn bread, egg substitute, tomato paste and the almond meal over medium low heat until blended and well blended. Spread the tortillas in a single layer in the prepared pan. Spread the omelet mixture over the tortillas and spread evenly in the pan. Arrange the sliced tomatoes on top. Bake in oven until the edges are golden, about 20 minutes. Let cool in pan for 10 minutes. Cut into squares.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,peanut oil vegetable,yukon gold potato,eggplant,onion salt,orange juice
title: Eggplant Potato Salad
ingredients: 8 medium yukon gold potatoes, halved | 3 medium eggplants, halved lengthways | 1/3 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and cut crossways into strips | 1/2 teaspoon onion salt | 2/3 cup orange juice | 2/3 cup peanut oil or 2/3 cup vegetable oil
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f prick potatoes all over and bake in an ovenproof dish for 25 minutes or until tender, then cool. Shred potatoes with a fork and set aside. Heat oil in a large non stick frying pan on medium heat. Add the eggplant and onion salt and fry for 1 - 2 minutes, or until tender. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towel. When cool enough to handle, chop roughly. Add orange juice to frypan and bring to the boil. Drain potatoes and eggplant and add to frypan. Cook over medium heat for 8 minutes or until potatoes begin to soften and eggplant begins to soften. Season to taste. Mix orange juice and oil in a small jug. Drizzle over potato mixture to serve.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,toothpick,corn,egg yolk,white vinegar,apple,white bread
title: Baked French Toast Apples With Warm Corn on the Cob and French Toast
ingredients: 1 large apple, cut into thin wedges ( such as fuji ) | 4 -5 medium ears fresh corn, shucked, with husks attached | 2 tablespoons white vinegar | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 5 egg yolks, slightly beaten | 1/4 cup dry white bread | 1 -2 tablespoon white vinegar | wooden toothpick ( optional )
instructions: Arrange corn and apple on work surface. Cut corn from cob and arrange, cut side down, in a 13x9x2 inch glass baking dish. Drizzle corn and apple with 2 tablespoons vinegar and the oil. Top with egg yolks and remaining tablespoon vinegar, and then place the bread slices on top. Cover and let stand in the refrigerator overnight. Preheat oven to 350°f place toothpicks in a little bag with a corner snipped off. Pour 1 to 2 tablespoons vinegar into a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add 3 cups water and the bag of bread to the water, and cook until the slices are golden on both sides. This should take 3 - 5 minutes. Slip off the toothpicks. Arrange bread on serving plate, drizzle with remaining 2 tablespoons vinegar, and serve with pickled.

Random Ingredients: dark rye flour,agave nectar,range egg,taco seasoning mix
title: Baked Eggs Ole
ingredients: 1 free range egg | 1 cup dark rye flour | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning mix | 1/4 cup agave nectar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 120c. Crack the free range egg and gently wobble it in a bowl. Add the rye flour to the egg and mix well. Add the taco seasoning or any other taco seasoning you like. Add the agave nectar and mix. Line a baking tray with parchment paper. Dip the beaten egg into this, then place on the tray. Bake for approximately 10 - 12 minutes. Remove when golden brown and crispy on top and a skewer will come out clean, and the whole house smells more fragrant.

title: Iraqi-Style Lamb Shish Kebabs
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg lamb, trimmed | 1 1/2 teaspoons sea salt
instructions: Score the kebabs in a criss cross pattern using a knife to make several shallow cuts. Place the oil in a large bowl, and sprinkle over the lamb to coat. Cover with clingfilm and leave in the fridge for 1 - 2 hours, or as long as 3 hours. Prepare a high heat grill. Remove the meat from the fridge, pat dry with kitchen paper and cut into strips about the same size as the lamb. Thread the meat onto skewers. Put the kebabs on a large preheated grill and cook over high heat for about 15 - 15 mins, turning frequently until cooked to your liking, turning a few times. Serve with sesame seeds.

title: Hot Raspberry Pudding
ingredients: 1 large yellow onion, thinly sliced | 5 ounces raspberry jam
instructions: In a small saucepan or crockpot, combine the onion and jam. Cook on high for 3 to 4 minutes. Pour the hot jam mixture into the bowl of an electric mixer fitted with the whip attachment, and whip until the ingredients form soft mounds of heavy whipping. Stir in the sliced onion and blend on low speed for 5 to 6 seconds.

title: Beer Fizz Beer Spread
ingredients: 5 ounces ala jus mix | 1/2 ounce beer, preferably pacifico
instructions: Combine all ingredients well and either stir or shake away.

title: Easy Cheesy Pizza Pastries
ingredients: 500 g savoury mushrooms | 300/3 g strong white flour | 1 packet savoury fresh cheese ( daiya ) | 40 g low-fat tasty cheese
instructions: Prepare your savoury mushroom filling as directed on package. Then cut up savoury cheese into small cubes and start to prepare your pizza dough. After chopping up the savoured cheese add to a bowl with the sliced fresh mushrooms and mix well together. Add some salt to taste, grated cheese to taste. Once your dough is ready add it to a pizza pan and start placing a piece of pizza dough on top of the pizza and spread slightly. Repeat steps 3 - 4 until all your dough is gone. Cut the pizza into desired shapes and lightly sprinkle some chopped savoury cheese over the pizza and spread it around a little bit to cover it evenly. Take one piece of pizza dough and press it around the edge of the pizza and spread it out a little bit to make a border on top and sides of the pizza. Then take your healthy mushrooms and spread with the remaining slices of mushroom and cheese on top of the dough. Place it in the fridge for an hour or longer until its ready and has time to set up before eating. Eat up and enjoy it's a wonderful snack for a great lunch or dinner.

title: Aceitun
ingredients: 1 1/4 teaspoons paprika ( or a mixture of paprika and cayenne ) | 1/2 teaspoon green cardamom pods | 5 -6 ounces dark rum
instructions: In a small mortar, grind the cardamom pods to a fine powder. Add the rum and grind until very fine, mixing in well. Serve in small mugs.

Random Ingredients: egg yolk water,green bell pepper,cream mushroom soup,cream chicken soup,flour,pepperoni,harissa
title: Hungarian Noodles
ingredients: 6 tablespoons flour | 6 tablespoons cream of mushroom soup | 6 tablespoons cream of chicken soup | 1 green bell pepper | 1 1/2 teaspoons harissa ( or more to taste ) | 1 small pepperoni ( sliced or chopped ) | 1 egg yolk with 1 tablespoon water
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Add some flour, it should not be too much, but it's good. Put mixture into skillet and cook over medium heat for 6 minutes, or until done. Serve over noodles.

Random Ingredients: velveeta mexican cheese,bell pepper,herb,salsa,chili sauce,part ricotta cheese
title: Velveeta Mexican Lasagna
ingredients: 4 ounces velveeta mexican cheese, cut in pieces | 4 ounces sweet creamy salsa ( i use herbed salsa! ) | 8 ounces part-skim ricotta cheese ( i use low fat ) | 4 ounces chili sauce ( i use chunky green ) | 2 teaspoons mixed herbs ( i use herb or dijon ) | 1 medium bell pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Dice bell pepper and set aside. Slice velveeta and place in a large bowl with salsa, ricotta, chili sauce and herbs. Spray a 9 x 13 baking dish with non stick cooking spray. Place peppers in dish, pour cheese mixture over peppers in dish. Cover dish with foil and bake for about 45 minutes or until heated through about 10 to 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: salad oil,salt black pepper,bosc pear,brown sugar
title: Pears Provencale
ingredients: 4 bosc pears | 4 tablespoons salad oil | 1 teaspoon sugar | 1 pinch salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: Rinse and dry the pears. Make sure to blot dry the juice before slicing them into thin wedges. Cut each wedge into 1/2 pieces. Heat oil in a large skillet until just smoking over medium heat. Add sugar and the pears, stirring to make sure each piece is coated evenly with glaze. Cook, stirring often, until the pears are just barely softened. Turn the pears over and continue cooking the juice mixture until it reduces by 1/ transfer the pears into a serving bowl and season with salt and pepper.

title: Chinese Lime Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups self rising flour | 1 1/2 cups mirin | 1 cup oyster sauce | 1 lime, quartered
instructions: Grease two 8 inch pans with margarine. Sift flour, mirin and oyster sauce into a bowl and set aside. Remove lime wedges from juice of the quartered lime so they will be ready to use later. Place the lime pieces in the prepared pans. Sprinkle the top with a few pinches of salt. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Bake bread for 45 minutes, or until crust is lightly golden brown.

title: Spinach and Apple Salad
ingredients: 2 tart apples, cored and chopped | 1 bunch fresh asparagus, trimmed | 1 quart orange juice, chilled | 1 pinch ground nutmeg
instructions: Toss apple, asparagus, orange juice, and nutmeg in a medium bowl until apple chunks are evenly coated.

title: French Sponge Cake Appetizer
ingredients: 6 rregular sponge cakes or 6 other sponge cakes, cut into squares | 24 slices reynolds wrap foil | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Cut a cone shape out of the rregular sponge cakes and lay them on the foil. Bake in a 350 degree oven for 25 - 30 minutes or if using the store bought sponge cakes the oven time is 1 hour of cooling. Make them while the cake is cooling so as not to cut off the cakes and soak them in cool water for at least 20 minutes. After 5 - 10 minutes or until the cake have turned a nice dark golden brown, remove from the tray and let them cool on a rack. Make up the frosting by mixing together the cream of tartar with the regular icing which is just a little bit thin. You may need a little more or a little less than the recommended amount. Once the cakes have cooled you can frost the cake and fill with frosting and eat or they will keep for at least 2 weeks in a sealed container.

Random Ingredients: plum,dark soy sauce,guacamole,stuffing mix,chutney,cream chicken soup,green cardamom pod
title: Sweet and Sour Anything
ingredients: 1 cup cooked stuffing mix | 1 can chopped plum, drained | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 cup guacamole | 2 tablespoons hot chutney | 1/2 teaspoon dark soy sauce | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom pods or 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice, to taste
instructions: Mix well and make your own tasty chicken salad. This goes great with chips too. For the dip, mix all the ingredients together in a bowl. This goes great with warm corn or chicken salad.

title: Italian Tomato Charred Dates With Orange Dressing
ingredients: 1 orange, zest of, from two oranges | 2 tablespoons good italian salad dressing, i find the zesty type too | 6 medium tomatoes, seeded, cut into 4 or 5 chunky sized chunks | 6 medjool dates, pitted, cut into 1/2 or 2 pieces each ( i love these with a twist of jalapeno to kick things up )
instructions: Finely grate the zest from 2 of the oranges. Place zest in bowl with the 3 tablespoons of good italian dressing and refrigerate for about 15 - 30 minutes or longer to let the sugar in the juices and really let the flavors of the zest meld. Meanwhile toss the tomatoes, dates, orange peel and sugar in a bowl until coated then add the zest and mix well. Serve warm or cool and cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to let the flavors of the orange blend into the sauce. Serve over angel hair pasta.

title: Roasted Tenderloin and Rutabaga
ingredients: 2 1/2 pounds beef tenderloin | 2 pounds rutabagas, peeled and sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a roasting pan roaster, combine the pork and rutabagas, cover, and roast for 15 minutes. Uncover, and cook until heated through and tender. Serve with mashed potatoes.

Random Ingredients: tabasco sauce,rigatoni pasta,pistachio nut,lemon juice,cumin seed,soy yogurt
title: Vegetable Yogurt Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 lb rigatoni pasta | 2 cups low-fat soy yogurt, plain | 1/4 cup dried roasted peanuts | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1 teaspoon ground cumin seed | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Cook pasta until al dente, drain. Whisk together all ingredients except noodles. Add cooled pasta to yogurt mixture. Chill several hours to let flavors blend.

Random Ingredients: rosemary,ranch dressing,vanilla extract,leaf lettuce,black pepper,carrot,nectarine,brown rice
title: Healthy Nectarine Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cooked brown rice, chilled | 1 cup carrot, finely grated | 2 nectarines, segmented, chopped & peeled | 2 tablespoons skim-milk ranch dressing | 1 tablespoon vanilla extract | 1/2 teaspoon dried rosemary, crushed | cracked black pepper | leaf lettuce
instructions: Combine rice, carrot & nectarines in a salad bowl. Combine dressing ingredients.

title: Italian Macaroni Salad
ingredients: 3 cups cooked macaroni, chopped ( or any other pasta ) | 1 can sweet vegetables ( peeled and diced or use 2 cups of leftover vegetables ) | 3 tablespoons italian dressing, mixed with | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Put pasta, vegetables, and dressing in a large bowl. Stir to mix well, then chill and serve.

title: Chicken With Nicoise Olives (Shami Haddie Kayedee)
ingredients: 3 cups uncooked short-grain white rice | 1/2 cup light ghee, divided | 6 -7 large green birds eye chilies, finely sliced ( i use 3 ) | 20 nicoise olives, finely sliced, such as a combination of red and green, halved ( optional ) | 1 lb chicken wings, tips discarded
instructions: In a pot with a tight fitting lid, bring 1 cup water to a boil. Add the rice and return to a boil. Cover and simmer over low heat for about 20 minutes or until the rice is just tender and the water has been absorbed. With a slotted spoon, transfer the rice to a bowl and set aside. In a large skillet, melt 2 tablespoons ghee over medium heat. When the ghee is hot, add half the chilies and stir fry for about 30 seconds or until they are soft and fragrant, about 1 minute. Add half the sliced olives, then half the chicken wings.

Random Ingredients: cilantro leaf,chicken liver,ice water,chicken breast fillet,mango chutney,wonton wrapper
title: Chicken & Mango Dumplings, Samosas
ingredients: 1 lb chicken breast fillet, chopped | 2 tablespoons mango chutney | 1 tablespoon fresh cilantro leaves | 1 package wonton wrappers | 2 cups ice water | 1 tablespoon minced cilantro leaf | 1 jar mango chutney ( sweet and sour )
instructions: Combine chicken, 2 tablespoons mango chutney, cilantro, and wonton wrappers in a bowl, then moisten edges with water. Add 1 teaspoonful of filling to the center of each wrapper. Moisten edges of wrappers with water. Seal edges with moistened fingers and bring opposite points up under to meet, forming the triangle. Pinch edges together. Repeat with remaining filling and wrappers. Bring water to a boil in a large pot. Cook 12 minutes, until dumplings float to the top. Stir in 2 teaspoons of finely chopped cilantro and 1/2 cup mango chutney.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck roast,egg yolk,kosher salt,tomato sauce,quinoa,mango chutney,pineapple juice,green chili salsa
title: Indian Shredded Beef
ingredients: 1/2 cup mango chutney | 1/2 cup tomato sauce | 1 can mango chutney | 6 ounces beef chuck roast | 6 ounces quinoa | 4 large egg yolks | 1 1/2 cups pineapple juice | kosher salt
instructions: Prepare grill and heat for high heat. Spray an 8 x 8 inch square baking dish with nonstick spray. Combine mango chutney, tomato sauce, mango chutney, 1/2 cup each of the prepared mango chutney and quinoa in a bowl. Combine the egg yolks and pineapple juice in a medium bowl. Pour yolk mixture over half of the quinoa mixture.

Random Ingredients: lime juice zest,garlic clove,sugar,yellow onion,flour,cream mushroom soup,baby carrot
title: Tilapia's Lime and Garlic Carrots
ingredients: 8 slices limes, juice and zest of | 1 large yellow onion, chopped ( approx. 1 cup ) | 1 bag baby carrots ( approx. 10 baby carrots, depending on size ) | 1 carton low-fat sour cream ( approx. fat free sour cream ) | 1 teaspoon sugar ( approx. ) | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 minced garlic clove
instructions: Cut the ends off of 1/4 the bag of carrots and peel the rest of them. Slice them lengthwise in long slices if you want to cut them smaller. Bring 2 - 3 t. Water and 1/2 of the sugar to a boil. Drop carrots in boiling water, blanch for 2 - 3 minutes or until crisp tender. Drain and set aside to cool. In a medium sauce pan, add diced onions and 1/2 of the carrot's in it's water. Cook over medium high heat about 5 minutes. Add 2 t. Of the fresh juice. Add soup, garlic and remaining carrot's. Cover, reduce heat to medium low and simmer 3 - 5 minutes. Serve as a starter dish or top your favorite meal with this. Note, for an ever better savory dish, substitute with 1/2 of the can of mushroom soup on top of the vegetables.

Random Ingredients: vegetable broth,tart apple,white poppy seed,paprika,stir fry vegetable,sherry wine,american cheese,ice water
title: Paprika and Cheese Soup
ingredients: 3 cups hot tapioca vegetable broth ( such as swanson ) | 1/2 cup sherry wine | 1/2 teaspoon paprika | 1/2 cup frozen stir fry vegetables, thawed ( such as french fries or onions, if desired ) | 1 2 cups frozen stir-fry vegetables, thawed | 4 crusty round american cheese, sliced ( such as velveeta ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons white poppy seeds | 1 pint ice water
instructions: Combine paprika and chicken broth in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Combine sherry and paprika in a small bowl and slowly whisk in the liquid.

Random Ingredients: white breadcrumb,italian sausage,water chestnut,ginger ale,salt pork,chutney
title: Homemade Sausages
ingredients: 6 thick sausages | 60 g salt pork, chopped | 1 can water chestnuts, roughly chopped | 2 tablespoons chutney | 3 tablespoons breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon italian sausage soup mix ( i use maggi brand ) or 1/2 cup white breadcrumbs
instructions: If using bread crumbs, crush finely to make crumbs. Place salt, pork and water chestnuts in a large bowl, using your hands. Toss with chutney and mix through crumbs. Remove skin and bones from sausages and roll in crumbs. Heat non stick frying pan until very hot. Cook sausage rolls until cooked through and golden. Alternatively, bake on baking paper lined tray in a moderate oven for 30 minutes, or until crisp.

title: Nori Rolled Crepes
ingredients: 2 sheets nori | 3 cups crepes | 3 tablespoons sweet hungarian paprika
instructions: Cut or tear the nori into pieces. Roll each piece out on your countertop or cut with a rolling pin until very thin. Mix the paprika and paprika with a little water. Spread about 1/4 tablespoon of the paprika/paprika mixture onto each crepe. Fold the crepe in half and then the entire roll up. Serve immediately or let sit for a few hours before frying in oil. These may also be reheated in the microwave.

Random Ingredients: fritos corn chip,chicken breast half,anaheim chilies,gelatin
title: Bobby Flay's Creamy Chicken With Chiles ( Pollo Con Elote
ingredients: 1 tablespoon gelatin | 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1 can anaheim chilies, drained | fritos corn chips
instructions: Sprinkle gelatin over chicken.

title: Rice Cooker White Beans and Rice
ingredients: 200 g white beans, drained | 400 g long-grain white rice, rice- soaked overnight
instructions: Put all the ingredients into your rice cooker according to its manual specifications. Program for half white rice and half brown rice, stir to combine. Turn the cooker on and wait for the steam to beeps between the rice cooker and the steam to escape into the cooker. Allow it to set for 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: green olive,salt black pepper,crisco,turnip,sesame seed,dark rum,chili pepper flake
title: Turnips With Rum and Olives
ingredients: 20 -25 big turnips, unpeeled | 2 tablespoons grapeseed oil | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1/4 cup dark rum ( optional ) | crisco or other vegetable shortening ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons toasted sesame seeds, if desired ( optional )
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil, add 2 tablespoons oil and turnip and cook until fork tender, about 15 minutes. Remove turnip and drain. In a small fry pan with a rack in the middle, heat 1/4 cup rum and stir till melted, about 5 minutes. If using with nuts, toast almonds or sesame seeds. Season to taste with salt and freshly ground pepper. Remove turnip and discard rack and rack to drain. Transfer to a platter and drizzle olive oil over turnip and serve with rum and sesame seeds if desired.

Random Ingredients: safflower oil,italian seasoning,green bell pepper,green olive
title: Italian Green Peppers and Olives
ingredients: 1 lb green olives, washed | 1 1/2 lbs red peppers or 1 1/2 lbs green bell peppers, washed | 1/4 cup safflower oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons italian seasoning
instructions: Drain the olives and peppers, if using, and pat dry with paper towels. Remove the stem and seeds. Cut the peppers in half lengthwise and core the peppers, then cut lengthwise into 1/4 inch slices. Put the sliced peppers into a bowl and add the oil, safflower oil, italian seasoning and salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste. Toss together until the peppers are coated. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Mexican Cucumber Fruit Loaf
ingredients: 1 lb self rising flour | 1 lb cucumber, peeled, quartered, and sliced into thin rounds | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder ( or more depending on desired heat level )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a large bowl, mix flour, cucumbers, and chili powder until well incorporated. Spread into a greased 13x9 baking pan. Bake in the preheated oven for 30 - 35 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,quail,fruit pectin crystal,golden delicious apple,black eyed pea,vegetable broth,black bean sauce
title: Black and Bleu Black Bean Soup - W-Dairy Free Recipe
ingredients: 3 cups vegetable broth | 1 package quail, frozen | 3 golden delicious apples, peeled, cored and diced | 1 can black bean sauce ( vegetarian can use black bean brand ) | 1 can black-eyed peas, drained | 1 bunch mixed dried fruit ( peaches, bananas, mango, prunes, etc ) | 3 tablespoons quick-made fruit pectin crystals ( optional ) or 3 tablespoons digestive powder ( optional )
instructions: Boil vegetable broth for about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and place frozen quail in a bowl. Add 1 cup soup base to broth and stir until well mixed. Bring broth back to a boil and add peaches with liquid. Add black eyed peas, fruit pectin, and sugar or spices to taste. Simmer, stirring often to prevent sticking, for about 10 minutes. Do not boil, but allow soup to thicken slightly during next 15 minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,peanut oil vegetable,lime peel,marsala wine,extra virgin olive oil,pepperoncini pepper,peanut
title: Peppers in Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons freshly grated lime peel | 2 tablespoons dry marsala wine | 3/4 lb fresh pepperoncini pepper, seeded and cut lengthwise into strips | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 8 jalapeno peppers, sliced thinly crosswise | 4 tablespoons roasted peanuts | pepperoncini pepper, slices ( optional )
instructions: Combine lime peel, marsala and 2/3 cup water in small bowl. Add remaining 1/3 cup water and stir. Let stand 3 minutes. Combine pepperoncini in second small bowl, drizzle with oil and stir in until coated. Place pepperoncini on plate with lettuce. Top with pepperoncini, slivered peanuts and additional pepperoncini. Garnish with more pepperoncini, if desired..

title: Chinese Mushrooms
ingredients: 3 cups button mushrooms | 1/2 cup rice flour | 1 tablespoon coriander leaves or 1 tablespoon lemongrass | 1 tablespoon granulated garlic and 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 2 leaves lemongrass | 1 tablespoon malt vinegar
instructions: Soak the mushrooms in hot water for 2 hours. Shake dry. Remove stems and cut the caps into about 1/2 inch wide strips. In a small bowl, mix the rice flour and herbs. Add the mushrooms, lemongrass and 2 tablespoons of the vinegar and mix lightly. Place in a serving dish and set aside to marinate.

Random Ingredients: chickpea flour,egg,white sugar,orange,oat,self rising flour,pinto bean
title: Cocktail & Chickpea Flour Croquettes
ingredients: 2 cups self-rising flour | 3/4 cup pinto beans | 1/2 cup chickpea flour | 1/2 cup egg | 1/4 cup grated orange rind | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 1/2 cup rolled oats
instructions: Combine all ingredients into a large bowl. Add water until dough is easy to handle. Mix well. On a lightly floured surface roll out dough until 1/4 to 1/2 inch thick. Cut into 2 inch wide strips. Cook in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat until lightly browned on cut edges. Serve with cocktail sauce.

title: Chunky Sausage and Pineapple
ingredients: 1 lb italian sausage | 1 1/2 cups chunky salsa, i like pace ( mild, medium or hot ) | 1 can pineapple slices in juice
instructions: Slice sausage into 1/4 inch slices. Remove casing from sausages. Place sausage in large fry pan and brown over medium heat. Drain off fat. Add salsa and pineapple and cook over medium heat until heated thoroughly and pineapple is hot. Serve.

title: Savoury Skewers
ingredients: 250 g mascarpone cheese, softened | 5 tablespoons natural goat's milk or 5 tablespoons mascarpone cheese | 1/2 cup soft white breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup arrowroot ( arrowroot is preferred ) or 1/4 cup cornstarch ( arrowroot is preferred ) | 2 1/2 cups self raising flour
instructions: Combine soft mascarpone cheese and goats' cheese, then beat in the breadcrumbs. Stir through arrowroot mixture. Cover and refrigerate for about 4 hours or overnight. Pre heat oven to 230c/140c fan forced. Grease 8cm x 8cm baking tin with cooking spray. Sift flour into a bowl, then make a well in the centre. Place milk in centre and stir with a wooden spoon. Stir over heat until mixture triples in volume and boils. Remove from heat and slowly stir through curd. Spoon mixture into tin and gently press down to compact. Cook in oven for 10 minutes, then cool on wire rack. Serve with salad dressing.

title: Holy Mole Hot Sauce
ingredients: 3 canned chipotle chiles | 1/2 green chili, chopped ( the hotter the chilli, the milder it will be )
instructions: Rinse the chilies and put in a medium saucepan with plenty of water. Bring to the boil, then put on the lid and simmer for 2 minutes until the skins blister and begin to break down. Meanwhile, chop the chilies and put into a large bowl. Add the chopped chipotles to the bowl and put in the bowl. Pour the chilies over the chipotles and mix. Put the lid back on and simmer until the mixture thickens. Remove from heat, but do not boil. Add the chopped green chilies and serve immediately. Enjoy.

title: Mexican Fish
ingredients: 2 lbs cod ( or haddock fillets ) | 2 teaspoons mild creole seasoning | 2 cans jalapeno chiles ( drained and julienned ) | 1 1/2 lbs other firm white fish fillets ( i prefer haddock or cod )
instructions: Clean cod and remove any bones it has had. Rinse fish filets. Sprinkle creole seasoning all over fish. Refrigerate for 1 hour, then wrap in plastic film and refrigerate over night. Before cooking you can refrigerate any extra pieces of fish if you want to. Heat julienne chiles in frying pan til they have about the color of peanut butter. Cut fish in pieces and fry in batches. Drain fish and serve with chile sauce. Note, i use the canned jalapenos for flavor when cooking the fish.

title: German Christmas Chili
ingredients: 1 can of your favorite vegetarian beef broth | 2 teaspoons fresh minced ginger or 1/2-1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 pint guacamole | 1 cup alfredo sauce | 1 - 1 1/2 cup fresh cranberries ( optional )
instructions: Mix broth, mushrooms, ginger/garlic powder, and turmeric in a sauce pan. Heat through and stir in guacamole and alfredo. Sprinkle cranberries for garnish.

title: Mushroom Quesadilla
ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter or 2 tablespoons margarine | 1 package sliced porcini mushrooms | 1 jar salsa | 1 package miniature marshmallows
instructions: Melt butter in skillet. Saute mushrooms until tender, 3 to 5 minutes.

title: Lentil and Brown Rice Falafel
ingredients: 250 g brown rice | 3 cups lentils | 150 g cashews | 3 tablespoons dill | 1 teaspoon mustard fenugreek seeds | cayenne pepper | 1 egg, beaten | pasta, of your choice
instructions: Boil water, add brown rice and lentils, bring to boil, cover and reduce heat & simmer for 30 minutes. While rice & lentils are cooking, mince pistachios, chop the nuts, drain rice & lentils. Remove 5 tbsp of water from the heat & add spices and cashews & mix with rice until just moist. Allow to cool slightly. When cooked, add to rice mix & mix well. Form mixture into balls approximately the size of small walnut sized walnuts with a small spoon. Fry balls in a non stick pan until golden brown & cooked through. Remove from pan & serve.

title: Tzatziki
ingredients: 1 3/4 lbs italian turkey sausage ( can use sweet italian sausage ) | 1 cup yogurt | 1 cup cake flour
instructions: Mix the meat and yogurt well. Add flour to thicken it up slightly bit. The batter will be too thick. It will hard to mess it up, but don't worry, it will keep a long time covered at all times. Keep refrigerated. Keep in a plastic bag or in a refrigerator.

title: Slow Cooker Chocolate Lamb Shanks
ingredients: 2 lamb shanks, fat trimmed | dressing : | 1 square unsweetened chocolate squares | 1 pinch onion salt
instructions: Place the lamb shanks in the crock of a slow cooker. Pour the chocolate into the dish and sprinkle with onion salt. Cook on high until hot, 6 to 8 hours.

title: Smoked Beef and BBQ Skewers
ingredients: 12 ounces shredded steak, fresh or frozen | 2 tablespoons honey | 1/8 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 2 tablespoons bbq sauce | 6 small bunches fresh chives | 1/8 teaspoon nutmeg, grated | 6 ounces rolled oats
instructions: Place the meat in a plastic zipper bag. Mix the honey, asafetida, bbq sauce, and chives in a large bowl. Thread 3 skewers onto 12 long bamboo skewers. Season with nutmeg.

title: Almond Bread
ingredients: 1 baguette | 1 tablespoon almond extract | 2 slices fresh lime | 1/2 cup slivered almonds
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Cut baguette into 4 pieces and butter both sides. Combine almond extract and slivered almonds and spread on top of the baguette slices. Place bread on a cookie sheet and bake 25 to 30 minutes or until crust is browned.

Random Ingredients: quinoa,russet potato,heavy cream,shiitake mushroom,chicken breast,rice wine,sugar substitute,poblano chile
title: Mexican Chicken With Quinoa Gratin
ingredients: 3 boneless skinless chicken breasts, sliced into strips | 2 russet potatoes, peeled and sliced into sticks | 1 poblano chile, deveined, seeded, and deveined | 20 dried shiitake mushrooms | 1 1/2 cups rinsed quinoa | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 2 tablespoons sugar substitute | 1 teaspoon rice wine ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 °f spray a 9x13 pan with nonstick spray or grease with a little of the cooking spray. Put half of the chicken and half of the potatoes in a large bowl. Pour half of the cream in the same way. Cut the remaining chicken and potatoes into thin strips. Sprinkle chicken with half of the sugar substitute. Mix together the quinoa and mushrooms in a large bowl, stirring to remove and any clinging liquid. Layer the chicken in the pan, and top with all of the mushrooms and cream. Top with the rest of the chicken and potatoes. Place the pan in the oven and bake until the chicken and potatoes are very tender and the top is dry. If the cream starts to run, remove and discard. Stir in the remaining cream and sugar substitute, and cook until creamy. Remove from the oven. Cover and let sit for ten minutes to heat through. Serve.

Random Ingredients: poundcake,panko breadcrumb,cream mushroom soup,vermouth,bisquick baking mix
title: Punchy Sour Cream Cheese French Bread
ingredients: 1 package poundcake, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 1 can cream of mushroom soup ( or your preference ) | 1/4 cup vermouth or 1/4 cup dry white wine | 1/2 cup bisquick baking mix | 1 cup panko breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. In 3 - 9 or an electric 1 1/2 quart casserole dish or other casserole dish sprayed with pam, layer 1/2 of the bread slices in a single layer, overlapping as necessary. In a bowl, combine the soup and vermouth and beat until smooth. Pour half of this over the bread and stir well to coat. Top with remaining bread, pressing down to submerge and not break layers. Bake uncovered about 35 to 40 minutes or until golden brown. Cover with foil and cool for approximately 10 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle with bisquick and bread crumbs. Serve with fruit, or sour cream if desired.

title: Easy Crunchy Jalapeno Chicken
ingredients: 5 chicken thighs ( skin left on ) | 1/4 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1/2 cup chopped cilantro leaf | 1 sliced pickle
instructions: Bake these until tender and crispy around edges.. Meanwhile, combine crumbs, cilantro, and pickle. Place in large bowl and roll up. Place chicken on an oven rack and broil for about 6 min to brown. Serve alone or on top of a bed of hot jalapenos.

Random Ingredients: italian bread crumb,vidalia onion,dill pickle,serrano chilies,baby spinach leaf,grain rice,hazelnut
title: Dill-Soy Rice Salad With Burrata
ingredients: 1/2 cup hazelnuts or 1/2 cup sliced almonds, toasted | 1 lb vidalia onion, cut into 1&1/2-inch thick slices | 3 serrano chilies, seeded and minced ( about 1 3 tbs ) | 1/2 cup italian-style bread crumbs | 2 bunches fresh dill pickles, cut into 1-inch pieces | 8 cups baby spinach leaves | hot cooked long grain rice or warm cooked bulgher rice, for serving
instructions: Toast whole hazelnuts in a single layer in a 400° oven until golden brown, about 8 minutes, shaking the pan once or twice. Remove from the oven and let cool. Meanwhile, toast chiles in a dry medium skillet over moderate heat, stirring, until just softened and beginning to color slightly, about 1 minute. Transfer to a metal bowl and let cool. Toast bread in a 400° oven, or until golden. Transfer to another flat nonaluminum pan and let cool. Heat oven to combine onion slices and chiles in a medium bowl and toss with bread crumbs in a large bowl. Add spinach, peanuts and hot cooked rice and let combine. Serve warm.

title: Mexican Restaurant Nachos
ingredients: 6 slices green fatback | 3 romaine lettuce leaves | 3 pints store-bought frozen guacamole
instructions: Arrange 1 tortilla on each of the four baking sheets, using approximately 1 1/2 teaspoons of the green fatback per chip. Top the tortilla slices with approximately 4 or 5 leaves of the lettuce. Repeat with another tortilla and remaining fatback. Spread guacamole on top and lightly sprinkle with the remaining green fatback.

title: Nudel
ingredients: 1/2 cup natural-style peanut butter | 3/4 cup milk, warmed
instructions: In a bowl stir together peanut butter and milk.

title: Banana Amaretto
ingredients: 1 banana, peeled and cut into chunks | 2 teaspoons amaretto
instructions: Place bananas in a bowl and mash with a fork. Beat until almost like fine bread crumbs. Stir in amaretto. Transfer to an ice cream cone or a small tray, cover, and freeze.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke,red pepper flake,ice water,vodka,canadian bacon,coconut extract
title: Red Pepper Vodka
ingredients: 10 fluid ounces canadian bacon, in one strip | 4 fluid ounces vodka | 1/4 cup canadian bacon, diced | 1/4 cup liquid smoke | 2 teaspoons coconut extract | 3 drops red pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: Put the canadian bacon, vodka, canadian bacon in a blender, and blend. Add in liquid smoke and coconut extract. Blend until well incorporated. Strain into tall glass.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,celery rib,garlic,yoghurt,beef stew meat,garam masala,guacamole,ra el hanout spice mix
title: Beef Curry Crumbs
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat | 1 container refrigerated reduced-fat yoghurt | 1 cup crushed graham cracker crumbs | 2 tablespoons minced garlic | 2 tablespoons garam masala | 1 1/2 tablespoons ras el hanout spice mix | 1 -2 teaspoon minced garlic | 2 tablespoons minced celery ribs | 1/2 - 3/4 ounce guacamole
instructions: Place all ingredients in large slow cooker. Stir to cover completely. Cook on low 5 hours. When ready to serve, stir in any left over gravy ingredients. Note, prep time does not include cooking time for lamb.

Random Ingredients: colby monterey jack cheese,white vinegar,pearl barley,cooking oat,cointreau liqueur
title: Cabbage and Pepper Oatmeal
ingredients: 1 cup quick-cooking oats | 2 1/4 cups shredded colby-monterey jack cheese | 2 1/3 cups finely chopped yellow split pea pods ( i've used frozen pea pods ) | 1/4 cup cointreau liqueur | 2 tablespoons white vinegar or 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar
instructions: In a large bowl combine the oats, cheese, split pea pods, cointreau and vinegar. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate to allow the flavors to develop, about 12 hours. Enjoy.

title: Frozen Sweet Pork and Beans (Honeymoon)
ingredients: 4 cups frozen pork and beans | 1/2 cup chopped fresh cranberries with juice | 1/4 cup coffee flavored liqueur
instructions: Place the frozen pork and beans in the freezer. Add cranberries and coffee liqueur.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,lamb,red pepper,black pepper,stewing beef,cooking oat
title: Barbecue Lamb & Pepper Tenderloin
ingredients: 4 lbs lean stewing beef | 4 lbs lamb | 1/3 cup brown sugar | 1/2 cup quick-cooking oats | 1/2 cup roasted red pepper, coarsely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon black pepper
instructions: Cut meat into 8 equal pieces. Combine sugar, oats, red pepper& pepper. Coat evenly with mixture. Place meat in large pan and cover with remaining sugar mixture. Add water to just cover the meat. Bring to boiling, then remove from heat and let stand. Cook in a 300 degree oven for 3 hours, basting occasionally.

Random Ingredients: tamarind pulp,pork tenderloin,ranch dressing mix,chunky peanut butter,ketchup
title: Southern Style Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 lb pork tenderloin | 1 1/2 teaspoons paprika | 1 package dry ranch dressing mix | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1/2 cup yellow chunky peanut butter
instructions: Score the pork with tines of a fork or sharp knife in several places. Sprinkle with paprika. Combine the ranch dressing mix and ketchup in a resealable plastic bag.

title: Hawaiian Hot Chocolate
ingredients: 1 scotch bonnet pepper | 1/4 cup black oats | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil
instructions: Place all ingredients in a small saute pan. Heat over medium heat, stirring often until the mixture starts to boil. Pour into mugs to serve.

Random Ingredients: rigatoni pasta,vanilla bean,lamb shank,bean sprout,ginger garlic paste
title: Cousin Lamb Shank Ravioli
ingredients: 8 lamb shanks | 2 cups bean sprouts | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 vanilla bean, split | 3 cups medium-grind rigatoni pasta, about | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Bring 3 quarts to a boil in a large pot of lightly salted water. Remove from heat, and stir in bean sprouts, and set aside. Place 1 tablespoon ginger garlic paste in a small bowl, and add just enough water until it is pasty to coat. Heat oven to 325 degrees f. Place lamb shanks in a roasting pan, and rub ginger garlic paste generously all over the shanks. Rub the marinade into the meat, then spread bean sprouts and garlic paste all over. Arrange the shank meat on the rack. Roast in the preheated oven until the meat falls off the bone and the internal temperature has reached at least 160 degrees f, 30 minutes to 2 hours. Check the flavor of the lamb after 20 minutes, and add more garlic, ginger garlic paste, or just a little bit of ginger juice to get a good flavor boost.

Random Ingredients: rom tomato,head garlic,rump roast,white onion,cherry tomato,cheese,arborio rice
title: Baked Beef on a Saucisson
ingredients: 4 lbs lean rump roast | 1 small head of garlic, cut in half crosswise | 1 small white onion, sliced | 6 -8 roma tomatoes, sliced | salt & fresh ground pepper | 1 1/2 cups arborio rice ( can sub any short time-grain white rice, use short-grain long-grain i've used both ) | 1/2 cup cherry tomatoes, leaves ( or 2 grape tomatoes, halved )
instructions: Cover the bottom with foil and heat the grate on medium, about 1 minute. Season the roast with salt and pepper. Wrap each piece of meat around a slice of garlic, and slice half the onion in half lengthwise. Place each slice, fat side up, in the bottom of a dutch oven with lid. Heat the roast the next day, or place in a slow cooker, fat side down. Pour the rice over the meat, and set the cover on. Cook for 3 to 5 hours. Remove the lid and cook for 1 more hour. Turn the heat off and let sit, covered and undisturbed for 1 hour longer. Remove meat from the pan and set the oven on broil. Place the tomatoes, sliced onions, a layer of sliced garlic, the tomatoes with juices, and 1/2 teaspoon salt at the bottom of the oven. Broil on high 1 or 1/2 minutes, or until the tops of the tomatoes are softened and lightly browned. Remove the pot from the oven. Place the rice back on, and cover with aluminum foil. Place in refrigerator overnight or for up to 24 hours. Before serving, take the meat out of the pot, and slice thin. Spoon the tomato sauce over the top, and serve hot or warm.

title: Beer
ingredients: 1 can condensed onion soup mix | 1 bottle hot sauce
instructions: In a medium bowl combine soup mix and hot sauce. Mix in cans of beer. Cover and refrigerate for 1 to 3 days to develop flavor. Serve over cooked egg foo yung eggs or noodles.

title: Maine Jardiniera
ingredients: 1/4 lb italian turkey sausage, cut into 1-inch slices | 1/4 lb salmon, cut into 1-inch slices | 1/4 lb rack of lamb, trimmed of fat and frenched | 1 lime, cut into wedges | 2 tablespoons grenadine | pepper jelly, for garnish
instructions: Grill or broil the sausage until lightly browned. Remove from heat and cut into ½ inch sized pieces. Combine the turkey slices and salmon in a bowl. Place the lime on top of the rack of the lamb racks and arrange the salmon slices close beside the rack of meat. Sprinkle each the jerk with freshly ground pepper, if necessary. Combine the grenadine with enough water to just cover the meat. Place on a heated grill or broiler rack about ½ inch below the heat. Grill for 30 to 40 minutes, turning once, or until cooked through. Serve at once.

title: Harissa Salmon
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 1 teaspoon harissa, or to taste | 1 teaspoon tamarind paste | 12 sprigs fresh seaweed | 3 pounds salmon fillets, skin removed | 1 quick-cooking apples - peeled, cored and cubed | 1 can shelled edamame, drained
instructions: Stir tomato paste, harissa paste, tamarind concentrate, and seaweed together in a microwave safe bowl until well blended, about 2 minutes. Place salmon in the bowl, pour water over, and cover. Microwave for 6 minutes on high, then flip over. Microwave an additional 2 to 5 minutes, or until opaque throughly. Spoon some sauce over fish and top with a cherry, apple, and edamame.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,spanish onion,wild rice,single cream,vegetable broth,bread,cider vinegar
title: Wild Rice Pilaf With Swiss Cheese
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked wild rice ( preferably wild rice or 2/3 cup cooked rice ) | 1 medium spanish onion, 1/4-inch dice ( about 1/2 cup ) | 1 can low sodium vegetable broth | 1 cup single cream | 1/2 cup cider vinegar | 1/2 cup shredded swiss cheese | 4 slices country bread, cut into 1-inch cubes
instructions: Wash wild rice thoroughly under cold running water and drain, tossing with onions and 1/3 cup of the broth and set aside. Over low heat, combine the remaining broth, cream, vinegar, cheese, rice, the reserved wild rice and 1 tablespoon of the onions in a medium saucepan. Increase heat to medium and bring to a simmer, stirring the rice to distribute the cheese evenly. Reduce heat to low and cover. Cook for 25 minutes. Remove from heat and keep covered to keep warm until serving time. Remove the top layer of onions by sprinkling the tops with the remaining 1 tablespoon of cheese. Serve the pilaf topped with bread.

title: Pita Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lamb meat, cut into 1/2-1 strips, or more to taste ( leg and shoulder ) | 2 cups self-rising flour
instructions: Line the bottom of a heavy, large, nonstick skillet with a round of parchment paper. Sprinkle the meat with flour and shake it around so that the flour coats the meat. Cook the meat over medium heat, turning with tongs, until browned, about 15 minutes. The meat should be browned all over. When browned, remove from heat and set aside. Wrap the pitas in foil and set on a plate. Pour 1 - 2 cups hot water over the pitas to soak up excess grease. Serve warm with pita bread, if desired.

title: Grilled Norwegian Fish (Melon) Sandwich
ingredients: 1 melon | honeydew melon
instructions: Rinse and peel melon and cut lengthwise into 8 slices. Spread slices with honeydew melon honey mixture. Roll up and serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Homemade Belgian Endive
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs belgian endive | 3 -4 dried sweet chili peppers ( to taste )
instructions: Preparation, wash endive with cold water. Cut endive in half lengthwise and then crosswise into 1/2 inch/2 inch pieces. Put in colander in sink and sprinkle with pepper flakes and let drain until all dry.

Random Ingredients: cognac,serrano pepper,chili sauce,serrano ham,sharp cheddar cheese,cherry pepper,goat cheese
title: Pesce Crouton Wedges With Goat Cheese (Croque Monsieur)
ingredients: 4 -6 ounces sharp cheddar cheese | 4 ounces goat cheese | 2 tablespoons finely minced serrano peppers | 1 1/2 tablespoons sweet chili sauce | 1 serrano pepper | 1 teaspoon cognac or 1 teaspoon rum | cherries and pepper ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Place 4 - 6 oz of sharp cheddar cheese in 8x8x2 dish. Cut goat cheese into 8 wedges. Tear serrano chilies into 2 smaller pieces and place them in a small bowl as well. Slightly crush serrano pepper using your pestle and mortar then add a small amount of the chopped chilies. Combine with remaining ingredients, place a wedge of goat cheese on top, then top with chilies and cherries and/or green pepper slices if desired. Bake the wedges in the oven 15 - 20 minutes or until the cheeses is bubbly and golden brown.

Random Ingredients: roast beef,cheddar cheese soup,beef chuck,sugar snap pea,white wine vinegar,sausage
title: Crock Pot Sausage and Beef on a Bed of Sausages
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb roast beef | 1 - 1 1/2 lb beef chuck | 1 -1 1/2 lb mild italian sausage | 1 can condensed cheddar cheese soup | 3 cups sugar snap peas | 6 -8 tablespoons white wine vinegar
instructions: Put the roast, beef chuck and sausage in the crock pot and season with salt and pepper to taste. Pour soup over the meat and vegetables until it just covers everything. Cover and cook on high for 4 hours, stirring occasionally. Turn out meat onto plate and slice very thin and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,green bell pepper,ice water,irish cream,thyme sprig,cocoa powder,beef chuck,whiskey
title: Guinness Beef Fajitas (Quick and Easy)
ingredients: 4 lbs beef chuck, cut into thin thin strips | 1 ounce good quality cocoa powder | 2 cups guinness stout or 2 cups other dark stout beer | 1 1/2 cups ice water | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprig | 8 flour tortillas | 1 cup green bell pepper, diced | 1 cup bailey's irish cream
instructions: In a large fry pan, add the oil and heat over medium high heat. Add the meat and brown on both sides. Drain and repeat process two more times. Add the vinegar and beer. Bring to a boil, lower heat and simmer until meat is tender. Meanwhile, wrap tortillas in damp paper towels to remove excess oil. Remove the meat from the pan and stir into the warm guinness mixture. Spoon into tortillas and garnish. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: wasabi powder,rhubarb,beef tenderloin,coriander,greek yogurt,rom tomato,french fry,pepper sauce
title: Stuffed French Fries
ingredients: 1 cup greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon wasabi powder | 2 tablespoons ground coriander | 1/4 teaspoon hot pepper sauce ( tabasco ) | 20 large beef tenderloin, trimmed, cut diagonally into 1/2 inch cubes | 4 -6 roma tomatoes, cut in half | 2 tablespoons prepared wasabi powder | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ground pepper sauce | 1 cup fresh rhubarb, cut in 1 inch pieces | 1 bag french fries, prepared according to package instructions
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the yogurt, wasabi, coriander, hot sauce, and ground pepper sauce. Set aside. In the center of each beef piece, place a cube of beef. Top with some of the yogurt mixture. Add a little bit of the tomatoes and arrange on top of the beef. Garnish with the wasabi mixture, and press the yum mixture under the beef. Close the beef with toothpicks or a toothpick to hold the slices together. Place on a baking tray and sprinkle each with a little extra wasabi and pepper sauce, if desired. Bake at 400 degrees fahrenheit for 20 minutes, then lower heat to 450 degrees fahrenheit and continue cooking for another 20 minutes, or until internal temp of beef reaches 135 degrees fahrenheit, or slightly more, depending on your desired degree of tenderness. During the last five minutes of cooking, remove toothpicks and serve with french fries mixed with additional wasabi, and additional mustard, if desired.

title: Grilled Chicken & Mango Ravioli With Mango-Cheese Pudding
ingredients: 1 mango, ripe peeled and sliced | 4 -5 boneless chicken thighs | 1 french bread, sliced thick ( or regular ) | 4 -6 ounces cheese ravioli | 1 -2 tablespoon lemon ( or lime juice ), to taste
instructions: First, make the sauce by pureeing mango into a blender. You can start by pulsing this in the mixer on the lowest setting, and then gradually adding in the cheese ravioli. If using a regular blender, be sure to scrape it down the sides of the bowl before pulsing the entire thing. Otherwise, this will burn your blender. I always buy the frozen cheese ravioli, but i'm sure they can be done in advance. The dough is easier to work with though, and it's quite easy. If it bothers you, you can work in small batches. Once you've tried your recipes, you can put some mango in a blender and whir until smooth and incorporated into the mango. If your mango cheese resembles chunks of mango, you can use a little water to thin it a bit. Pour the sauce and mango mixture into a frying pan or skillet, and on medium heat place the chicken thighs. This should take about 7 - 8 minutes. Put the slices of bread on a plate, then top with a slice of mango. Place on another plate or two of bread. Pour some of the sauce over the top, put a few dollops of cheese or yogurt on top of it, and enjoy.

title: German Style Cream Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 container sweetened condensed milk | 2 tablespoons sweet pickle relish | 2 tablespoons triple sec or 2 tablespoons orange juice
instructions: In medium bowl, stir condensed milk, relish, and triple sec until well blended. Transfer to serving bowl. Refrigerate uncovered overnight. Serve with crackers, crackers, or crackers of your choice.

title: Prawn Sticks
ingredients: 12 prawns | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato oil | 1/2 cup cornflour | 8 ounces cool whip, thawed
instructions: Crush the prawns with a rolling pin. Heat the sundried tomatoes in a pan, mix well, until they just begin turning colour. Put in cold water mix in cornflour and bring to boil, simmer 5 mins remove from the heat, stir in the sun dried tomatoes, cool whip and chill until needed.

Random Ingredients: caster sugar,rosemary leaf,italian parsley,graham cracker crumb,dark chocolate,pork rib,steak
title: Rich and Tartender Italian Pork Ribs
ingredients: 3 lbs country-style boneless pork ribs | 3 ounces dark chocolate, roughly chopped | 1/2 cup italian parsley, roughly chopped | 2 tablespoons caster sugar | 1 tablespoon fresh rosemary leaf, finely chopped | 1/2 cup italian parsley, roughly chopped | 1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Place pork ribs and chopped chocolate in a roasting tin. Place in the oven for 30 minutes. Meanwhile, combine 1/2 cup parsley, caster sugar and rosemary in a bowl. Stir to combine. Remove ribs from oven and add the remaining 1/2 cup parsley mix. Spread pork on a baking sheet and bake for 2 hours or until browned on all sides. Remove pork from oven and keep warm. Return roasting tin to oven and mix with remaining 1/4 cup parsley. Sprinkle over crumbs. Return to oven until crumbs become firm.

title: Portuguese Caper Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cornflour | 3/4 cup cider or 3/4 cup water | 1 tablespoon turmeric | 1/2 cup drained capers
instructions: Place cornflour in a wide saucepan and blend it with the cider. Add turmeric, capers, and water. Bring mixture to boiling. Boil rapidly until thickens, and remove from heat. Serve.

Random Ingredients: buttermilk biscuit,vegetable,half,pasta,monterey jack pepper cheese,black cumin seed,orange zest
title: Monterey Muffins
ingredients: 1 lb dried multigrain cooked pasta | 1 tablespoon fresh orange zest, minced | 3/4 teaspoon whole black cumin seed, crushed | 1 1/2 cups low-fat buttermilk biscuits | 1 cup shredded monterey jack pepper cheese | 1 cup vegetables, coarsely chopped ( such as broccoli, baby carrots, cauliflower, bell pepper or corn ) | 2 tablespoons half-and-half
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f grease a 12 cup muffin tin. In a large bowl, mix together the pasta, orange zest, cumin, buttermilk biscuits, pepper jack cheese, and vegetables. Spoon into the prepared muffin cups and bake for 20 to 25 minutes, or until the tops are golden brown. Serve with a dollop of half and half.

Random Ingredients: english cucumber,potato,guinness stout,sauce,wine vinegar,chunky salsa,sugar,thai basil
title: Mexican Simply Potatoes & Cucumbers
ingredients: 3 medium english cucumbers | 2 cups potatoes, diced | 2 cups chunky salsa | 1 1/2 cups guinness stout | 4 tablespoons sugar | 2/3 cup wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons hot sauce | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh thai basil
instructions: Halve the cucumbers lengthwise. Remove seeds. Slice lengthwise, then slice crosswise. Place in a bowl. Add potatoes and salsa, and let stand at room temperature for 2 hours. In a small bowl, whisk together sugar, vinegar, hot sauce and basil. Pour over cucumbers, mix well. Serve.

title: Beef With Nuts
ingredients: 4 lbs lean fat-trimmed beef brisket, with spice packet | 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 can unsalted mixed berries, chopped, drained | 3 cups red potatoes, cut in 1/2 inch dice ( about 8 medium ) | 2 cups uncooked penne ( about 8 ounces )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Pat brisket dry and generously sprinkle with nutmeg. Cut potatoes into 1/2 inch cubes. Place beef in a roasting pan and sprinkle with potatoes. Cover with foil and bake for 2 hours. Stir nuts and juice until it boils. Bake, uncovered, for 1 - 1 1/2 hours. Add water as needed, if necessary. Remove beef from pan. Skim fat as it rises to surface. Cook pasta according to package directions.

Random Ingredients: red wine,beef stock,chipotle powder,salt pepper,green olive,flour tortilla,italian sausage
title: Baked Sausage & Green Olive Enchiladas
ingredients: 3 lbs sweet italian sausage, casings removed but rind & meat crumbled | 2 cups dry red wine | 2 cups beef stock | 1 tablespoon chili powder, divided | salt & pepper | 1 cup chopped stuffed green olives, drained | 6 flour tortillas, warmed ( i like to spray mine with a nonstick cooking spray for the last minute of baking )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Remove sausage of casings & set aside. Cut the sausage into 1/2 inch slices. Pour half of the wine into a large bowl & pour in the remaining wine. Stir to loosen the meat, then add the meat and the rest of the wine & stock. Add 1 tablespoon chili powder, salt & pepper, 1 tablespoon of chili powder & mix well. Set the tortillas aside. Layer the enchiladas in an 11x13 baking dish with about 1 cup of the meat mixture, 2 tablespoons of the olives & 1/2 teaspoon of salt. Repeat layers twice. Top with remaining 1/2 cup olives & salt & pepper. Cover baking dish with foil and bake for 35 - 40 minutes. Uncover & bake the last 30 minutes or until the sauce is bubbly & the tortillas are a little charred..

Random Ingredients: arborio rice,hard,icing sugar,bamboo skewer,orange zest,harissa,carrot,green onion
title: Tunisian Rice Balls
ingredients: 100 g arborio rice | 40 g icing sugar | 1/2 cup grated fresh orange zest or 1/2 cup limes | 1/4 cup harissa, plus extra spoons for drizzling | 1 large carrot, chopped | 1 bunch green onion, trimmed, finely diced | hard, freshly boiled whole bamboo skewer | 60 g broken tricolor sugar or 60 g mixed glace nuts
instructions: Prepare your rice and keep aside. Place rice and sugar in a large mixing bowl along with 1/2 cup water. Cover and leave to soak 15 minutes. While the rice is soaking, place a large frying pan over a medium high heat, pour in the oil. When hot, add the orange zest, harissa and carrot, stirring often. Turn the heat down to low and add the rice and green onion. Cover and leave to cook, stirring often, for 15 minutes. Stir in 3 tablespoons water and check the rice for doneness, adding more water if necessary. Add the remaining water and simmer for a further 5 minutes until thick and sticky, adding more water if the mixture looks dry. Set aside to cool. To make the balls, put a bamboo skewer in the palm of one hand, a small piece of chopped green onion on the skewer and a few broken pieces of tricolor sugar in the other. Roll the ball into walnut sized balls. Dip the balls into the rice batter and leave in a cool place for 30 to 45 minutes to dry them out. To cook the balls, remove them to a baking sheet and cook them in a preheated oven at 190 degrees c until a light golden colour. Serve warm, sprinkled with more sugar and extra harissa or glace nuts.

Random Ingredients: scotch bonnet pepper,key lime juice,golden raisin
title: Hot Key Lime Snacks
ingredients: 1 package gold medal dry spices, such as mccormick's montreal brand | 1/4 cup key lime juice | 1 scotch bonnet pepper, seeds and membrane removed, minced ( habanero can be substituted )
instructions: Mix 1/4 cup of the key lime juice with the grated chile pepper.

Random Ingredients: new potato,salmon fillet,broth,farfalle pasta,cardamom powder,pork butt,duck leg,beetroot
title: Farfalle Soup (Beef, Pork & Potato)
ingredients: 1 lb fresh farfalle pasta ( farfalle or broad egg noodles ) | 2 lbs smoked pork butt or 2 lbs smoked pork chops | 1 large beetroot, peeled, cut into 1/2-inch dice ( canned ) | 4 small new potatoes, scrubbed clean and cut into 3/4-inch dice | 1 teaspoon whole cardamom powder | 1 can broth | 1 duck leg, with bone ( or 2 pork legs with bones ) | 1 can tiny new potatoes ( in water and a little salt )
instructions: Preparation,. Cook the farfalle or broad egg noodles according to package directions. It also may be wise to add the duck and bone to the farfalle. Otherwise, the soup may be cooked in 2 quarts of water.

title: Picante Salad I
ingredients: 2 cans crushed tomatoes with pineapple, drained | 1 jar corn syrup or 1/4 cup picante sauce | 1 tablespoon capers | 2 tablespoons peanuts
instructions: Place all ingredients into a bowl and toss. Chill.

title: Goat Cheese With Ginger and Caramelized Ginger
ingredients: 3 ounces goat cheese | 2 ounces caramelized ginger, cut into very thin matchsticks | 1 tablespoon white vinegar
instructions: In an ice cream maker, melt the goat cheese on the setting indicated in the manufacturer’s guidelines, about 4 – 5 minutes. Stir frequently to avoid cheese from breaking and sticking. When the cheese has melted, stir in the caramelized ginger and vinegar. Serve at once or cover with plastic wrap and store in the freezer for up to one week, or until ready to use.

title: Crab Couscous Pilaf
ingredients: 1 cup couscous | 1 green cardamom pod | 1/2 pound fresh crabmeat
instructions: Combine couscous and cardamom pods in a large bowl. Mix in crabmeat. Cover.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,italian bread french,stewing beef,parsley leaf,barley,boston lettuce,topping
title: Barley Beef Burgers
ingredients: 1 lb lean stewing beef, cut into 4 pieces | 2 cans diced tomatoes with mild green chilies | 1/2 cup uncooked barley | 1 head boston lettuce | 3 tablespoons fresh parsley leaves, chopped | 1/4 cup italian style bread or 1/4 cup french bread, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 cup frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: In 4 - 6 quart slow cooker, combine beef, tomatoes with green chilies, barley, 1 head romaine lettuce and parsley. Cover tightly and cook on low setting 4 - 6 hours, or until beef is tender but not browned. With slotted spoon, transfer cooked mixture to large bowl, discarding celery and parsley stalks. Serve beef mixture on top of lettuce. Cover and refrigerate up to 1 day.

title: Easy and Delicious BBQ Chicken Pie
ingredients: 1 unbaked pie crust | 2 cups shredded cooked chicken or 2 cups cooked beef
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix the shredded chicken and the barbecue sauce together and spread on the pie crust. Bake in the preheated oven for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Baharat Aka Middle East Style Seven-Layer Hot Red Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chili oil or 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 3 cardamom pods, crushed
instructions: Heat the chili oil or vegetable oil in a pan. Do not allow the oil to smoke. Stir in the crushed cardamom pods and cook for about 1 minute. Pour the hot sauce into a clean bottle.

Random Ingredients: cremini mushroom,orange blossom water,peanut butter,pork steak,rhubarb,fruit,sunflower oil,button mushroom
title: Rhubarb, Pork &  Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 -3 tablespoons dark soy peanut butter | 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 2 tablespoons orange blossom water | 1 tablespoon rhubarb, peeled and sliced | 250 g mixed dried fruit | 1 1/2 kg pork steaks, cut into thin strips | 500 g cremini mushrooms, sliced | 125 g button mushrooms
instructions: For the sauce, mix together the soy peanut butter, oil, orange blossom water & orange blossom water, then add rhubarb strips. Place pork strips in a non metallic dish & pour over the sauce, coating evenly.

title: Frozen-Beef for the Crock Pot
ingredients: 2 lbs lean beef ( from a chuck roast ) | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary leaves
instructions: Combine all ingredients in crock pot. Cover and cook on low 8 - 9 hours. For thicker results, allow crock pot to thaw overnight in refrigerator. To thaw, place on serving tray, cover loosely with foil and refrigerate for 6 hours. Remove beef from crock pot.

Random Ingredients: chocolate ice cream,sea scallop,turmeric powder,wheat bread,rice vinegar
title: Seared Scallops on Rice Crackle
ingredients: 10 ounces sea scallops, cleaned | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 tablespoon plain whole wheat bread, crumbled | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1 pint chocolate ice cream, softened
instructions: Sprinkle the sea scallops with the turmeric and toss them in a pan in a single layer to brown evenly. Remove from heat and place on a plate to cool. Spread the crumbled bread onto a plate. Dip each scallop in the crumbs, coating evenly. Arrange the scallops in the base of a foil lined 8in cake tin, skin side down. Spoon 1/2 teaspoon of ice cream over each scallop and press gently. Drizzle with 1/2 teaspoon of lime juice and dot with 1/2 teaspoon of lime sugar.

Random Ingredients: bleu cheese,granny smith apple,jumbo shrimp,chipotle chile adobo,black pepper,pancetta
title: Grilled Chipotle Shrimp With Apple and Pancetta
ingredients: 4 slices pancetta, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup granny smith apple, thinly sliced | 1 -2 lb jumbo shrimp, cleaned | 1/4 cup crumbled bleu cheese | 3 1/2 teaspoons chipotle chiles in adobo, coarsely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon fresh coarse ground black pepper
instructions: Grill shrimp over high heat for 2 minutes on each side with lid closed for even cooking. Place skillet on a griddle or other grill directly on burner for about 2 minutes on each side for medium rare shrimp. Remove shrimp from grill to a plate and set aside. Grilling the pancetta over medium high heat, over low heat, until crisp, about 5 minutes. While pancetta, apple, cheese and chilies cook, heat grill pan. Spread chipotle pepper slices on both sides of the shrimp and serve. A side dish with dipping sauce is to dip the shrimp in.

Random Ingredients: turmeric powder,chicken breast half,parmigiano reggiano cheese,cauliflower floret
title: Cauliflower Stuffed Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 4 chicken breast halves | 1/8 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/2 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese ( about ) | 4 cups cauliflower florets, steamed and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Score both sides of each breast half lengthwise with a paring knife. Place in a medium bowl and sprinkle with the turmeric and cheese. Add 3/4c of the cauliflower and toss to coat evenly. Repeat with remaining cauliflower and chicken. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Place stuffed chicken breasts on the baking sheet. Bake 15 mins or until heated through. Garnish with remaining cauliflower and serve.

Random Ingredients: coriander seed,stove stuffing mix,pepper,kosher salt,basil,celery rib,baby lima bean,red cabbage
title: Bean Cabbage Salad With Stove Top
ingredients: 16 ounces baby lima beans, canned | 1 cup chopped celery rib | 1/2 cup chopped red cabbage ( or similar ) | 1 cup chopped fresh basil | 1 container stove top stuffing mix | 2 teaspoons coriander seeds | 2 teaspoons fresh cracked pepper | 1 1/2 teaspoons kosher salt
instructions: Pare the head of cabbage leaving the stalk like the core. Cut off the root and stalk at the base of the cabbage. Cut out of the leaf like the core. Set aside. In a medium bowl mix the stuffing mix with the coriander, pepper & salt. Add the lima beans with the celery, cabbage, dressing and mix well. Chill well overnight. When ready to serve, add 1 - 2 cups water to the stuffing/veggie mixture. Bring it to a boil.

title: Creamy Chilie Nuts
ingredients: 1/2 cup hazelnuts | 1 serrano chili, minced ( or other chile ) | 1 pinch nutmeg | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar ( i used vanilla extract )
instructions: Grind nuts. Combine with spices and let flavors blend for 2 - 3 minutes to allow flavors to blend the nuts. You may need to add more cream. Spread on toast or as a topping for crackers.

Random Ingredients: anchovy paste,salad oil,cold water,grape,green chili pepper
title: Salad of Grape Leaves
ingredients: 4 lbs grapes, washed | 1 cup salad oil | 1 tablespoon hot green chili pepper, chopped | 1 tablespoon anchovy paste | 1 1/2 cups cold water
instructions: Cut the grapes in half. Remove the seed and the ribs. Sprinkle grapes with salt, drain off excess salt. Place grapes and the water in a large heavy saucepan.

title: Calypso for the Lazy
ingredients: 2 lbs hamburger | 3 tablespoons sultanas | 1/4 cup slivered almonds | 3 tablespoons apricot preserves | 2 tablespoons prepared alfredo sauce | 1/2 tablespoon cardamom
instructions: Brown hamburger and drain well. Add onions, saute till translucent, drain grease. Mix preserves, bayleaf, and spices. Add to hamburger. Cook until heated through. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: japanese soy sauce,yeast,peri,sesame oil,no boil lasagna noodle,bamboo shoot,green cardamom,bread crumb
title: Jamaican-Style Ramen Rolls
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried yeast | 2 1/4 cups bread crumbs, divided | 1/3 cup japanese soy sauce, divided | 1/4 cup sesame oil, divided | 2 cans sliced bamboo shoots, drained and sliced | 1 can no-boil lasagna noodles, rinsed and drained | 1 teaspoon crushed green cardamom | 1 teaspoon instant minced fresh onion tops ( optional )
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 2 cups bread crumbs in a large mixing bowl. Stir in 1/3 cup soy sauce, sesame oil, bamboo shoots, noodles, cardamom, and instant minced onion tops.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,mini chocolate chip,italian turkey sausage,penne,bratwurst,plain yogurt,hazelnut,plum tomato
title: Holiday Penne With Bratwurst and Yogurt
ingredients: 16 ounces penne | 1 1/2 lbs hot italian turkey sausage, casings removed | 1 teaspoon canola oil | 1 package frozen chopped bratwursts, drained | 1 cup plain yogurt | 1 bag mini chocolate chip | 2 tablespoons ground hazelnuts, toasted
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions, omitting salt and fat. Meanwhile, in a large nonstick skillet, cook the sausage over medium heat for 8 minutes, until browned, stirring to crumble. Add the canola oil to the skillet and cook bratwurst for 2 minutes. Stir in the browned sausage and drained pasta. Stir in the yogurt and chocolate chips.

Random Ingredients: chicken thigh,vegetable shortening,cracker crumb,fruit,large shrimp,kiwi fruit,thyme leaf,nutmeg
title: Kiwifruit Crusted Chicken
ingredients: 1 cup cracker crumbs | 1 cup assorted dried fruit | 1 pound boneless, skinless chicken thighs | 1 pound kiwi fruits, peeled and cubed | 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 1 quart vegetable shortening for frying | 12 large shrimp in water, drained and deveined
instructions: Combine cracker crumbs, dried fruit, chicken, kiwifruit, nutmeg, and thyme in a large bowl. Dip chicken into shortening until completely covered, then dredge in cracker mixture. Set aside on a plate. Melt 1 quart vegetable shortening in a large skillet over medium heat. Place shrimp in skillet, and cook about 3 minutes per side, until the coating is browned. Do not overcook.

Random Ingredients: vanilla,dark sesame oil,mustard seed,graham cracker crumb,cinnamon,champagne,mirin
title: Chilled Champagne Crumb Mix
ingredients: 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1 teaspoon ground mustard seed | 1 1/2 tablespoons prepared vanilla | 1/4 cup sweet champagne or 1/4 cup sparkling wine, chilled | 1/4 cup mirin | dark sesame oil
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together the cinnamon, graham cracker crumbs, mustard seed and vanilla. Add the champagne, mirin and sesame oil. Mix until thoroughly combined and add sugar if needed. Mix again until mixture is just firm enough to hold together. Turn out onto a parchment lined sheet tray. The crumb mixture will settle on your hands rather than your hands. Chill until firm. Chill before serving.

Random Ingredients: lime,brown mushroom,green onion,blueberry,orange juice concentrate,wheat flour
title: Blueberry and Mushroom Parfait
ingredients: 1 cup whole wheat flour | 2 tablespoons brown mushrooms, chopped | 2 tablespoons frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed | 2 teaspoons thawed frozen lime, juice and zest | 1/2 cup green onion | 1/2 cup fresh blueberries
instructions: To make topping, combine flour, mushrooms, orange juice concentrate, lime zest, green onions and blueberries. Dough will be sticky. Knead on floured board 2 minutes. Form into 2 balls. Roll balls in topping and let rest 5 minutes. Place on a lightly greased baking sheet and cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate until ready to use. Cut into halves or wedges. Serve at once or store in plastic bags.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,basil pesto,garlic salt,bamboo shoot
title: Italian Pesto and Vinegar
ingredients: 1 cup basil pesto | 1 cup bamboo shoot, diced | 1 tablespoon lemon juice zest | 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: In a food processor, blend the pesto, bamboo shoots, lemon juice, and garlic salt together until smooth.

title: Garam Masala Tomato Salad
ingredients: 4 -5 grape tomatoes | 1/2 cup garam masala powder ( or less to taste )
instructions: Pit the ripe tomatoes and slice them very thinly as possible. Take the grape tomatoes and slice them as thinly as possible. Pour some water into a non stick frying pan and heat it. When the tomatoes are sizzling but not browning, pour 1/4 cup of the garam masala into the frying pan. Turn the heat to a low medium heat. Add 1 tablespoon of water and let the mixture boil for a minute or two. Turn off the heat. Add the remaining 1/4 cup of garam masala and turn the mixture into a serving dish. Cover it with plastic wrap and let sit for 2 hours. Towards the end of the 2 hours this can be served cold as well. Grape tomatoes should be served warm. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,cream mushroom soup,cottage cheese,white mushroom,curry paste,beef,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Cottage Cheese and Mushroom Curry Beef Rollups
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/4 cup cottage cheese | 2 tablespoons curry paste | 1/4 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 tablespoon white mushroom pieces, sliced
instructions: Blend cottage cheese, cream of mushroom soup, curry paste, parmigiano reggiano, coriander powder, and white mushrooms in a blender or food processor until smooth. Shape the beef into 20 roll ups, and place on a cutting board. Roll with the sides touching, to make a neat rectangle, about 12x2 inches. Serve with plain boiled rice.

Random Ingredients: nigella seed,flour tortilla,pineapple juice,fast rising active yeast,cola
title: Pineapple Cheese Fajitas
ingredients: 3/4 teaspoon fast-rising active dry yeast | 1 cup shredded cola | 2 tablespoons pineapple juice, divided | 1/4 cup canned cola-flavored carbonated beverage or 1/4 cup cola-flavored carbonated beverage, such as sprite or 1/4 cup pepsi | 12 10-inch flour tortillas
instructions: Stir yeast into ½ cup warm water, set aside for 10 minutes to blend the yeast. Stir cola and 1 tablespoon pineapple juice into cola beverage. Set aside remaining ½ cup warm water. Pour cola beverage into a medium bowl and stir in dissolved yeast. Scoop cola mixture into tortillas, leaving at least ½ inch uncovered at outside edges. Serve hot with guacamole and salsa. Enjoy and, passing toppings the fajita, recipe#45358,.

title: Cranberry Pears
ingredients: 1 lb dried cranberry sauce | 1 tablespoon peanut oil ( or oil of choice )
instructions: Soak cranberry sauce for at least 30 minutes, overnight if possible. Drain sauce and reserve the liquid. Heat the oil in a large heavy pot. Add cranberry sauce and reserved liquid along with the cranberry and bring to a boil. Boil, occasionally stirring and watching constantly, for about 30 min or until sauce thickens. Serve, or cool, cover and store on the counter to keep hot.

title: Fettuccine Arrabiata
ingredients: 1 pound fettuccine pasta | 3 cloves garlic, peeled and roughly chopped | 5 japocino chiles, roasted and seeded
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the fettuccine, and cook uncovered until cooked through but still firm to the bite, stirring occasionally, about 11 minutes. Drain. Place the roasted poblano chiles under the broiler and grill, or until the skins are darkly blackened, turning and turning until charred on all sides, about 5 minutes per side. Drain, and cool. Peel and chop the chiles. Place the garlic and roasted chiles in a blender with enough water to make a sauce. Puree until smooth. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the fettuccine and cook uncovered until tender, about 12 minutes. Drain. Place the fettuccine in a large serving bowl, adding the poblano chiles, garlic, and blackened chile sauce.

Random Ingredients: mandarin orange,port wine,pork belly,cocoa,marjoram,scotch bonnet pepper
title: Bergie's Bodacious Pork and Belly
ingredients: 3 lbs pork belly | 1 cup sugar | 2 tablespoons cocoa | 1 cup mandarin oranges | 1/2 cup port wine | 2 tablespoons scotch bonnet peppers, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Trim away excess paper fat, remove from bones and cut into chunks. Combine together sugar, cocoa, mandarin oranges, port and chile peppers in a large saucepan and bring to boil, stirring constantly. Let boil for 2 minutes. Add pork and return to boil. Cover and simmer for 90 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove cover and simmer for an additional 15 minutes or until pork is tender.

Random Ingredients: virgin olive oil,soy sauce,dark soy sauce,cilantro leaf,kaffir lime leaf,yellow pepper,vanilla extract
title: Cambodian Yellow Pepper-Pepper Stir-Fry
