ingredients: 1/2 yellow pepper, cut into thin 2 inch long pieces | 1 tablespoon virgin olive oil | 2 firm kaffir lime leaves, thinly sliced lengthwise | 1/2 cup soy sauce | 1/2 cup dark soy sauce | 1/4 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Place the pepper in a large bowl, add the oil and toss well to coat. Marinate in the refrigerator 1 hour or more. Drain the pepper mixture and reserve the marinade. In a medium bowl combine the soy sauces, vanilla and cilantro. Whisk together to combine and set aside. Prepare hot or ungreased skillet by heating the oil, swirl, or brush it onto the bottom. Add the pepper, and cook 3 minutes or until crisp and lightly browned. Remove and from skillet and stir the pepper mixture. Remove, discard the stem side. If there is any oil remaining in the skillet, wipe down with paper towels to remove excess. If there is no oil left in the pan, stir in about 1 tablespoon of the reserved marinade and mix. Tip, if making ahead, transfer to a container, cover and refrigerate. To cook in a wok, cover and keep warm over low heat. When ready to serve, slice as thinly as possible with a knife. Serve with the peanut sauce.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,table salt,chicken bouillon,black,worcestershire sauce,red curry paste,pesto sauce,chicken meat
title: Easy Chicken Pockets
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh chicken meat, cut into strips or 1/2 lb frozen cooked chicken breasts, defrosted and cut into strips | 1 can fat-free evaporated milk or 10 ounces evaporated low-fat milk | 1 cup self rising flour | 2 teaspoons green pickled pesto sauce ( or less if desired ) | 1 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon, powder ( i recommend knorr ) | 2 teaspoons red curry paste ( i recommend konriko ) | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1/2 teaspoon table salt
instructions: In a medium size bowl combine the dry ingredients. Put the chicken, pith side up, on a work surface. Spoon 2 tablespoons of the evaporated milk in the center of the chicken on all four sides, forming a pocket. Pinch the pocket shut with one hand, and place the filled, unused pocket on your work surface. Spoon any remaining filling into the pockets. Combine the remaining evaporated milk with 1 cup of the evaporated milk and stir into the mixture, and then pour over the chicken. Sprinkle the worcestershire sauce on top. Dip your hands into the flour and coat them with the milk/flour mixture. Wrap the chicken in waxed paper or plastic wrap and transfer to the refrigerator for at least 2 hours or overnight. The longer it sits, the better. When ready to cook, preheat the oven to 400 degrees f for the chicken to cook. Lightly oil a small roasting pan or other medium sized oven safe pie plate. Line the bottom of the pan with parchment paper. Remove the chicken slices from the refrigerator on the parchment paper and place them on the bottom of the prepared pie plate. Add the pesto sauce, chicken bouillon powder, and curry paste to the pan, stirring until well mixed. Pour the pan liquid over the chicken, and poke a few holes in the chicken with the back of a knife or wooden spoon. Place the pie plate in center of the oven and bake for 40 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through and the juices run clear. Allow to set for 20 minutes before removing from pan.

Random Ingredients: rice vinegar,red chili powder,date,fish fillet,chocolate shaving,asiago cheese,kale
title: Crispy Goat Cheese and Dates Skewers
ingredients: 2 lbs goat cheese, block cut into 1 by 1/2-inch chunks | 4 ounces unsweetened chocolate shavings | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried red chili powder | 2 cups kale, finely chopped | 1/2 cup rice vinegar | 14 ounces fish fillets, raw, boneless, skinless | 1/4 cup shaved asiago cheese ( optional ) or 1/4 cup monterey jack pepper cheese ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Toss goat cheese with chile powder. Spread in one layer on wax paper. Coarsely chop chocolate. Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add chopped chocolate and curry powder. Cook, stirring constantly until chocolate melts and mixture just begins to bubble. Remove from heat. Place drained goat cheese in a large bowl. Drizzle with chocolate, and set aside and wait for it to cool slightly before serving, or refrigerate and serve straight away. Alternate layers of goat cheese and chocolate mixture, alternating sides of kale, sprinkling each layer with shaved asiago or monterey jack cheese.

title: Thai Hamburgers (Sirloin)
ingredients: 1/2 cup buttermilk | 1 teaspoon garlic paste | 1 bunch fresh thai basil, stems included | 2 lbs sirloin, cut into thin patties
instructions: Pour buttermilk into a shallow pan. Stir in garlic and basil. Add beef and marinate at room temperature for 2 hours or refrigerate up to 4 hours. Heat a grill or broiler. Brush grilling or broiling surface with oil. Grill each steak 4 to 6 inches from heat, brushing with buttermilk. Turn and continue grilling 7 to 10 minutes or until done.

title: Tortilla Chips
ingredients: 1 bag corn tortillia or ( 12 inch ) bag mexican style bread, torn into large pieces | 1/2 cup apple cider vinegar or 1/2 cup balsamic vinegar
instructions: Arrange tortillas in ungreased 12 inch skillet. Sprinkle with vinegar. Bake in 350 degree oven until golden brown and crisp.

title: Faux Parsi Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 small head cauliflower, cut into florets | 4 whole cardamom seeds
instructions: Place cauliflower in a steamer basket or other container with 1 inch of water in the bottom. Cover and bring to a boil, then cover and steam over medium heat for 45 minutes, or until cauliflower is al dente and easily pierced with a fork. Remove cauliflower from steamer, strain cauliflower, then cut into 3 or 4 florets. Cover and steam 1 to 2 minutes more, or until cauliflower is tender. While cauliflower is steaming, toast cardamom seeds in a dry small fry or nonstick skillet, stirring constantly, until golden, 3 to 5 minutes.

title: Thai Homemade Sour Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup prepared horseradish | 3 tablespoons grated fresh gingerroot | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil ( i use olive oil ) | 1 clove garlic paste ( i use pressed or minced, or garlic powder and onion slivers ) or 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder ( i use pressed or minced, or garlic powder and onion slivers ) | 1/4 cup soymilk | 1 lb sour mix | 1/4 teaspoon nam pla
instructions: Combine all ingredients and store in refrigerator for best results.

title: Snow Peas and Rice
ingredients: 1 cup long grain white rice | 1 2/3 cups snow peas
instructions: Scoop out rice and snow peas with teaspoon and place in casserole dish. Cover with water. Cover with lid and cook slowly for 50 - 55 minutes.

title: Deviled Clove
ingredients: 2 quarts hot chili sauce | 4 whole cloves, plus more at the top of the chili sauce
instructions: In a deep skillet, warm the chili sauce over medium heat. Add the cloves, and cook on low until cloves are fragrant but not harsh smelling. This should take about 5 minutes. Remove cloves. When the garlic is fragrant but not harsh smelling, pour off any remaining sauce. Cool to room temperature. Store in the refrigerator in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: avocado,cherry tomato,icing sugar,vegetable protein,sparkling water,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Vegetarian Mincemeat - No Added Sugar!
ingredients: 2 cups textured vegetable protein | 1 cup cherry tomatoes, halved | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 175 g sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 150 g avocados, diced
instructions: Place the textured vegetable protein into a pan on the stove and heat slowly, stirring continuously. Turn down the heat to low and leave for a couple of minutes. Meanwhile, peel, pit and dice the avocados and mix them with the cooked tvp in a bowl. Add more sugar, if you wish, and stir until dissolved. Stir in the grated cheese, return to the heat for a few minutes, until melted and slightly bubbly. Serve warm with toasted bread to make a sandwich, or with tortilla chips or steamed veggies.

Random Ingredients: caper,bulk italian sausage,rigatoni pasta,guinness stout,oil,white raisin,stewing beef,oat
title: Irish Beef and Guinness Stew
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 lb bulk italian sausage | 8 ounces white raisins | 2 tablespoons oil | 2 cans guinness stout | 1 1/2 cups uncooked rigatoni pasta or 1 1/2 cups penne pasta ( 8 ounces ) | freshly snipped capers | cooked oats ( optional )
instructions: Brown meat in a large skillet. Add raisins and cook until liquid evaporates. Add oil and stir for 2 minutes. Add stout and bring to a boil. Simmer until meat is tender. Add pasta and stir to coat with mixture. Cover and simmer 30 minutes or until pasta is tender. Season to taste with salt, pepper and/or oats. Serve with freshly made oats, if desired.

title: Bacon, Chilli & Baby Bok Choy
ingredients: 500 g baby bok choy | 1 slice bacon | 300 ml strong tea
instructions: Bacon or fish stock are two different ways to prepare stock. One way you can boil the bok choy for a two min in the stock and the other way you cook them. Bake at 150 grades celsius. The idea is to leave them until the bacon is crispy. While this is doing, cut your bok choy into 2 cm lengths using a knife, so that they dont get slimy. Fry bacon/fish in a pan, if you like. Remove the bacon from the pan and add to the pan. Fry together the bacon and the bok choy. I find cooking the bacon on your plate gives the better results. Drain the bacon pieces from the pan onto a paper towel lined plate or plate to drain excess oil out. Enjoy it makes a lovely taste and smell wonderful.

title: Chicken Wings in Crispy Broccoli
ingredients: 8 chicken wings | 8 sheets of waxy cheese, made from the same cheese you used for the cheese, such as pecorino, picholine, ricotta, dalla-parma or other cheese, cut into triangles | 1 head broccoli, cut into florets | 1 bunch spring onion
instructions: Using oil as needed to shallow fry the chicken wings, fry the broccoli for 4 - 5 minutes, or until just barely cooked. Drain on kitchen paper. Preheat oven to 200°c. Grease a baking tray. Lay the broccoli, topped equally with the chicken, and then the fried broccoli in the tray. Place cheese triangles on top. Place chicken wings on top and cook in oven for 20 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through.

Random Ingredients: seasoning salt,stilton cheese,cheese,splenda brown sugar,chicken soup base
title: Stilton Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 lb stilton cheese | 1/3 lb low-fat monterey jack cheese | 1 tablespoon chicken soup base | 2 teaspoons splenda brown sugar blend | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: Cube cheese and place in food processor. Add 1 tbs. Of soup base. Blend well. Add rest of soup base and sugar. Process until mixture is well mixed. Spray pan with nonstick cooking spray. Pour mixture into pan. Sprinkle top with salt. Bake in 350f oven 45 min. Or until cheese is bubbly or to your liking.

Random Ingredients: amaretto,extra virgin olive oil,fresno chile pepper,mango chutney,cider vinegar
title: Champutéed Mango Chutney
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped fresh mango chutney | 1/2 teaspoon pure ground fresno chile pepper | 2 teaspoons apple vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon extra virgin olive oil | 2 teaspoons amaretto, or more to taste
instructions: Combine mango chutney, fresno chile pepper, apple vinegar, olive oil, and amaretto in a blender until smooth.

title: Spanish Rice
ingredients: 1 cup long grain white rice | 1 small red onion, minced
instructions: Put the rice, onion and enough water to cover into a saucepan. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer until all the water is absorbed and the rice is tender, about 20 to 30 minutes. Remove from heat. Allow to stand for 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork.

title: Cream Cheese and Ouzo Halves
ingredients: 8 ounces ouzo | 2 cups bread flour, sifted | 2 1/2 tablespoons ouzo for the rim of a 9 pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 375f. Combine the flour and ouzo in a medium bowl. Cut the ouzo with a fork in a circular motion until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Stir in the flour 1 tablespoon at a time, blending well. Pat into the rim of a 9 inch tart pan with a removable rim. Bake for 20 minutes, then turn onto a baking sheet. Poke holes in the top with a fork. Bake for an additional 10 minutes, then remove from the oven. Let cool.

Random Ingredients: vegetable bouillon cube,ladyfinger,fig,cardamom seed,ice water,baking powder
title: Fig and Cardamom Ice Cream
ingredients: 250 g dried figs | 1 vegetable bouillon cube | 4 -6 cups ice water, depending on cubes | 500 g ladyfingers | 4 -5 teaspoons ground cardamom seeds | 1 -2 tablespoon baking powder
instructions: In a pan put the figs and pour over the bouillon. Pour in the water. Boil for 5 minutes. Put the lady fingers in the pan and put the boiling point on. When they start bubbling, add the baking powder. When the skin starts breaking, remove the pan from the heat and put on a towel to remove the skins. Once dried, cut them up roughly and set aside. After 5 minutes, put the figs back in the ice cream and blend them. Leave aside for 20 minutes. Once softened, put back into ice cream and blend again. Pour into ice cream tray and set out for a few hours. Remove and serve.

title: Lancaster Clam and Clam Fritters (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 3 )
ingredients: 4 ounces chicken livers, trimmed and chopped ( or 10 ounces frozen, defrosted ) | 7 ounces fresh clams, scrubbed clean | 3 tablespoons plain white flour | 1/4 cup yellow cornmeal | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram, or ( 1 1/2 - 2 ml dried ) | 1/8 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Combine the chicken livers and clams in a large, dry frying pan over medium low heat and cook, covered, for 5 to 6 minutes or until the clams open slightly and have opened. Stir in the flour, cornmeal, marjoram and allspice, and cook, stirring, for 1 minute each side or until smooth. Serve immediately.

title: Rhubarb & Garlic Dip
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups diced rhubarb | 1/3 cup grape tomatoes, seeded | 1/3 cup fresh parsley, chopped | 2 teaspoons thyme | 1 1/2 teaspoons smoked habanero peppers, chopped, plus more for garnish | 1/4 cup fat-free whipped topping, thickened with 2 tablespoons of fat free sour cream and additional 1 tablespoon of fat free sour cream
instructions: In food processor, add the rhubarb and tomatoes. Pulse until coarsely chopped, no chunky chunks. Stir in parsley and thyme. Transfer to serving bowl. Add habanero pepper and fat free sour cream to bowl. Process until well blended. Spoon mixture into serving dish and garnish with whipped topping. Serve with tostado di chanco.

title: Corned Beef and Cabbage
ingredients: 2 pounds beef round steak, cut into strips | 1 head cabbage, cored and shredded | 1 jar lemonade, or to taste | 1/2 pound cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: Arrange slices of the beef and cabbage in a large heavy skillet. Pour lemonade over the beef and cabbage to cover. Cover, and simmer over low heat for about 1 hour. Cover, and continue cooking over low heat until the beef and cabbage are tender, and the flavors have blended. Continue to stir the contents of the pot every 30 minutes, or until the vegetables are cooked through. Continue to cook and stir the contents of the skillet until the contents of the skillet have blended into the mixture. When the mixture has blended, turn off heat. Remove the beef and cabbage from the skillet and slice to desired serving size.

Random Ingredients: green curry paste,pie crust,vidalia onion,beer,red bean
title: Beer & Beef Curry-Onion Bites
ingredients: 1 frozen pie crust ( pie crust, ready-made ) | 2 cans red beans, drained ( or 1 3/4 & 1/2 cups of prepared beef, drained -1 1/4 & 1/4 ) | 3 large vidalia onions, chopped ( about 1-1/2 cups, about ) | 1 bottle beer ( non-alcoholic ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons green curry paste ( or to taste )
instructions: Slice pie crusts lengthwise in half and place 1/2 cup or more of the prepared beef, along with the onions, and remaining ingredients in a large bowl. Toss to combine. Place remaining 1/3 cup of prepared beef in a small bowl that is large enough to dip the pie crust in. Dip the prepared pie crust halves in the beer batter and arrange them on a large, nonstick cookie sheet. Cover with foil and refrigerate several hours or overnight. Remove beef and onions from marinade & allow to stand at room temperature for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, pre heat the oven to 425°f transfer beef and onions with a slotted spoon and any accumulated juices to a large bowl. With a slotted spoon or spatula, press any remaining marinade through a fine sieve, discarding solids. Slice beef thinly and spread a thin layer of onions on the bottom of each pie shell. Place a small dollop of beer in each pan. Place 2 pie crust halves on top of each other. Press lightly around the edge of each pie crust. Place pie in centre of oven and bake 25 - 30 minutes, or until crusts are golden brown.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,dark soy sauce,monterey jack cheddar cheese,lemon juice,caraway,peanut,spanish onion
title: Spicy Yummy Cheddar Spread
ingredients: 6 tablespoons sweet kosher dijon-style caraway | 1 1/2 - 2 tablespoons roasted unsalted peanuts | 3 small spanish onions, peeled and quartered | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 teaspoon fresh lemon juice | 1 teaspoon minced chile caraway ( caraway seeds in canada ) | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend
instructions: Mix the caraway seed, peanuts, onions, soy sauce, lemon juice, chile caraway and pepper in a small food processor or a blender and process until smooth.

Random Ingredients: kahlua,tuna steak,green bell pepper,walnut,salt pepper,tarragon,salt black pepper
title: Tunisian Tuna Spread
ingredients: 6 tuna steaks, chopped into bite size pieces | salt and pepper to taste | 1 green bell pepper, chopped | 1 dash kahlua | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1/3 cup finely chopped walnuts | 1 dash salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Cover, and refrigerate for use over the course of serving.

title: Peanut Butter Spinach Salad
ingredients: 4 cups fresh spinach leaves ( not thawed ) | 4 large fresh spinach leaves | 2 tablespoons chunky peanut butter | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla | 1 lemon wedge
instructions: Whisk ingredients together until creamy. Drizzle over salad leaves.

title: The Cuban Artichoke Bread
ingredients: 1 baguette, cut in 1/2 inch slices | 1 can artichokes, drained | 1 cup water chestnut, sliced | beer
instructions: Combine artichokes and can of water chestnuts and 1 cup water in a small bowl. Brush beer over the top and cover. Let stand 15 minutes at room temperature.

title: Potato and Smoked Salmon Cakes
ingredients: 600 g russet potatoes, peeled boiled and sliced thinly | 300 g smoked salmon, sliced very thinly | 1/2 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 1 cup rice
instructions: Combine the potato slices, salmon and bread crumbs in a mixing bowl. Dip your hands in boiling water then take a measuring tablespoon of the potato and mash with a fork, ensuring all the potato slices are covered lightly with breadcrumbs. Using your wet hands take a teaspoon or two of the potato mixture and roll around firmly with your hands until it is about 5cm long and about 3 1/2cm thick. Repeat with the remaining potato mixture. Cut each one into 8 5cm cubes. Bring a saucepan of water to the boil, add the potato cakes and boil for about 5 minutes or until crisp on the outside. Do not overcook or they will toughen the cakes. Drain on paper towel and cool slightly. Meanwhile, bring the rice to the boil in a saucepan of salted water, then reduce the heat to medium and simmer for 10 minutes. Drain the potatoes and return them to the pan and allow to cool to room temperature. When the rice is cold, divide between 8 bowls and allow to cool completely. Serve the salmon cakes with your ruset potato cakes, if desired.

title: Smoked and Dried Salmon and Baked Beans
ingredients: 1 cup jasmine rice, uncooked | 1/2 cup dried apricot | 1/2 teaspoon ginger powder | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage | 4 ounces smoked salmon | 2 ounces parmigiano-reggiano cheese, shredded | 1 can fat-free refried beans
instructions: Prepare rinsed jasmine rice according to package directions using an 8” x 8” non stick cooking spray. Meanwhile, cover rice in cold water. Let stand 10 minutes. Remove and drain and discard any excess water. Rinse and drain apricots using a strainer, reserving juice. Reserve liquid. Heat reserved skillet over medium heat. Add smoked salmon, apricots, ginger powder, sage, rice, and reserved liquid from raisins. Spoon mixture into casserole dish. Arrange salmon over rice. Spread refried beans on top of salmon. Spread rice over beans and cannadel cream mixture. Bake 35 minutes or until top of rice is light golden.

title: Italian Inn Pepper Potatoes
ingredients: 2 lbs broccoli | 1 jar green olives | 2 tablespoons cocoa | 3 tablespoons rosemary | 1 tablespoon vanilla essence | 1 cup sweet irish whiskey | 1 tablespoon vinegar or 1 tablespoon apple cider | 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts
instructions: Boil, steam, or microwave broccoli until tender. Drain well, place in a large bowl. Add all other ingredients including marinated artichoke hearts. Toss. Chill thoroughly before using.

Random Ingredients: dill,arborio rice,wine vinegar,broccolini,parsley sprig,cilantro leaf,cold water
title: Broccolini and Garlic Risotto With Fresh Herbs
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dry arborio rice | 1 1/2 cups cold water, divided | 1 bunch broccolini, ends trimmed, halved lengthwise and cut into pieces about 2 x 1-inch | 3 cups packed fresh coriander or 3 cups packed cremini cheese | 2 cups packed fresh parsley sprigs | 1/2 cup minced cilantro leaves | 1 tablespoon wine vinegar
instructions: In a small pot melt the butter over medium low heat.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,cumin powder,white peppercorn,french dressing,chutney,date
title: Chutney Sticks
ingredients: 1 cup dates, chopped | 2 tablespoons french dressing | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 teaspoon ground cumin powder | 1 teaspoon white peppercorns, crushed ( or black ) | any dark sweet chutney, of your choice ( like tru whip )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and store 1/2 cup mixture in an airtight container.

title: BBQ Caribbean Pork Loin and Avocado Appetizers
ingredients: 1/2 lb boneless pork loin, cooked and cut into 1/2 inch to 1/2 inch cubes | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 2 hass avocadoes, halved lengthwise and pitted | 2 tablespoons chopped leeks | 1/4 cup dark amber-flavored liqueur or 1/4 cup mayonnaise | 1 1/2 teaspoons finely grated orange rind | 1/3 cup fireball whiskey
instructions: In a bowl, combine mayonnaise, avocados, leeks, rum and orange rind. Mix together thoroughly and set aside. Spread some of the mayonnaise mixture on cut loin and roll up. Secure with toothpicks. Place in a greased 13x9 inch baking pan and chill. Bbq, cook the pork loin for 20 - 25 minutes on each side, or until internal thermometer reaches 130°f serve pork with guacamole or salsa, and a sprinkling of your choice of topping.

title: Protein Mix (Tasty OAMC)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon onion powder | 1 tablespoon peppercorn, crushed | 3 tablespoons powdered dry onion flakes ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a dry skillet. Heat over medium heat. Keep stirring until well mixed. Let it cook for 4 - 5 minutes, or until the contents are a very dark brown, and slightly crispy. Turn out onto an oven tray, and let cool. Use as directed for meat, or on sandwiches with any vegetable you like. You can also just sprinkle over some cheese, and drizzle over a salad, or serve on its own. Some other spices you can add too, such as garlic powder, salt, pepper, ginger powder, etc. To make fennel powder, add 1 tbsp of the garlic powder into the same skillet and mix well before adding the fennel. Serve. Note, i usually use a tablespoon of dry onion croutons to make my fennel powder, and when making the meat, i spray olive oil in with the fennel powder, after placing in a hot skillet, and stirring until the mixture is lightly golden.

title: Quick and Easy "Italian Bread"
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups rotini or 1 3/4 cups other spiral pasta, drained | 3/4 cup chopped bread ( rye, pumpernickel or white bread )
instructions: Heat large pot of water to boiling. Add the pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until tender but firm. Drain pasta. Return to warm pot. Add other ingredients except pasta and serve.

title: Gordita Con Queso (Grilled Cheese With Tequila)
ingredients: 6 tablespoons tequila | 5 serrano peppers ( seeded if you like ) | 5 tablespoons grapeseed oil | 3 -4 ounces gruyere cheese
instructions: Heat 1 or 2 tablespoons water to boil in a medium sauté pan. Stir the tequila into the water, then reduce the heat and simmer, and simmer for about ten minutes until the tequila has reduced and thickened. Halve the serrano peppers lengthwise and seed them. Place the peppers on a grill or hot griddle pan, cover, and grill on the medium low heat for about 20 minutes until they are blackened. Remove the peppers from the pan and put them on paper towels to drain. Brush the peppers with 1 tablespoon of the grapeseed oil, and cover them. In another pan, heat the remaining grapeeed oil. Place the cheese into the pan and cook for 2 or 3 minutes, watching for it to turn a light golden brown. Transfer the cheese to plates, and top with the blackened pepper on top. Serve immediately.

title: Elegant Fruit Preserve
ingredients: 1 packet dried fruit preserves | 1 can onion soup mix ( any flavour )
instructions: Spray a loaf pan or pan with cooking spray. Sprinkle the fruit preserves on the bottom of the pan or pan. Place the pan in the freezer for 5 minutes. Take out from the pan. Pour contents of onion soup mix into the pan and allow it to defrost for about 30 minutes. When ready to serve cut with a knife to serve.

Random Ingredients: lime wedge,french fry,hoisin sauce,raspberry vinegar,red pepper
title: Lime Fries With Roasted Red Pepper, Prosciutto, and Raspberry Vinegar
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs cooked french fries | 1 lb fresh ripe raspberries | 4 tablespoons hoisin sauce | 3 tablespoons raspberry vinegar ( or other vinegar of your choice ) | 1 lime wedge, for garnish
instructions: Bring 1 inch of water to boil in a small pot over high heat. Meanwhile, cut fries in half lengthwise. Remove seeds with a potato masher. Place half of the fries in a single layer on a large cookie sheet. Bake at 400° for about 15 - 20 minutes, or until crisp. Drain on paper towels. Meanwhile, mix the hoisin sauce and vinegar. Place the remaining fries on a serving platter and spoon on the sauce. Garnish with fresh red pepper and lime wedges.

Random Ingredients: tomato paste,corn oil,sun tomato oil,cucumber,walnut,cilantro leaf,yellow mustard
title: Tomato, Walnut & Cumin Spread
ingredients: 3 cups diced ripe cucumbers | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons tomato paste | 1 teaspoon yellow mustard | 1 teaspoon fresh cilantro leaves, chopped | 2 tablespoons walnuts, coarsely chopped ( optional ) | cocumber, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Blend all ingredients in a food processor until the texture is somewhat chunky, about 3 - 4 pulses. Transfer to a medium bowl and serve with crackers and veggies of your choice. Slices of cucumber can be added to the spread.

title: Avocado Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 avocado | 1/2 cup cooked japanese rice wine ( japanese rice or sake ) | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 -2 teaspoon hariyaki hijiki ( or soy sauce )
instructions: Cut the avocado in half and scoop out the pulp. Mash with a fork and add the rice wine and dark soy sauce. Mix well and serve either chilled or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: oregano,beef bouillon,beer,red pepper flake,tomato paste,tarragon,white vinegar
title: Tangy Tomato Gravy (For Beef or Lamb Kebabs)
ingredients: 1/4 cup tomato paste | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 3 1/2 teaspoons white vinegar | 3/4 cup beer or 3/4 cup red wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons beef bouillon | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together, and heat through but do not boil. Ladle into your favorite container, and serve with meat.

Random Ingredients: shallot,cumin seed,maple syrup,vanilla sugar,taco shell,yellow squash,courgette
title: Sweet & Tasty Vegetable Tacos
ingredients: 1 medium yellow squash, halved lengthways | 2 medium courgettes, halved lengthways | 1 tablespoon vanilla sugar | 1 teaspoon whole cumin seed | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 4 taco shells, warmed | 2 shallots, finely sliced
instructions: Place the squash into a lightly oiled shallow casserole dish and add the courgette, sweet potato and courgette quarters with the sugar, cumin seeds and syrup. Cover the dish and cook in a preheated oven on medium heat for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally until the vegetables are tender. Divide the vegetable mixture among the taco shells. Sprinkle with shallots and serve.

title: Pepper-Horseradish Salad
ingredients: 1 parsnip, peeled and chopped | 3 hard-cooked eggs, chopped | 1 tablespoon prepared horseradish | 7 tablespoons vegetable oil, warmed at room temperature | 2 teaspoons grated fresh horseradish | 4 -5 large lettuce leaves | fresh ground pepper
instructions: Arrange the parsnip, eggs, and horseradish on a serving platter and spoon the vegetable oil and horseradish over.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno chile,brown rice,chervil,tuna oil,baking mix,salt pepper,date,cajun seasoning
title: Tuna Stuffed Chilada
ingredients: 1 can canned tuna packed in oil, chopped | 1 cup cooked brown rice | 1/2 cup chopped fresh chervil | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh tarragon | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh jalapeno chiles | 1/2 teaspoon cajun seasoning | salt and pepper to taste | 1 package baking mix
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Combine tuna, rice, chervil, tarragon, jalapeno chiles, cajun seasoning, salt and pepper in a bowl. Roll mixture into 6 inch cylinder. Place stuffed cylinders onto a lightly greased baking sheet. Bake at 375 degrees f for 20 to 22 minutes, or until evenly browned.

title: Mulholland's French Fried Shallots
ingredients: 2 shallots, peeled | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning, or to taste
instructions: Arrange shallots on a plate or frying pan.

title: Mexican Bean Omelet
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans | 1 large eggplant | 2 tablespoons chopped vegetables | 1/4 grape, halved | 1/4 lime, rind of | cheesecloth
instructions: Mash and fry eggplant and veggies in a frying pan add a few tablespoons of cold water in the bottom of the pan. Once water starts to boil, pour over eggplant and veggies, and let sit for about 5 minutes. Sprinkle top with lime peel to serve, or, you can let them set up in your Omelet pan and put in a plastic bag in the oven while you work and eat with fingers.

title: Cucumber Pork Chops
ingredients: 3/4 lb pork loin chop | 2 medium cucumbers ( halved lengthwise )
instructions: Place pork chops on a rack in a large shallow casserole. Insert two cucumber halves into each chop. Rub pork chops with 1 teaspoon of salt and 1 teaspoon of pepper. Place in 400°f oven for 30 minutes or until cooked through.

title: Potato Pistachios
ingredients: 6 large baking potatoes, unpeeled | 1/2 cup dry red wine | 1/2 cup finely chopped italian herbs | 3 tablespoons coarsely chopped pistachios
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Cut each potato lengthwise in half to make 2 inch slices. Place on a large baking sheet.

title: Baked Cod in Mustard Sauce
ingredients: 6 cod fillets ( about 1 1/2 pounds in all ) | 1 3/4 cups plain yogurt | 1 1/3 cups breadcrumbs ( breadcrumbs, regular ) | 2 tablespoons yellow mustard seeds | 4 large eggs, lightly beaten | 1/3 cup half-and-half
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Arrange cod fillets in a shallow baking baking dish or roaster. In a medium bowl, combine yogurt and sour cream. In a large skillet, toast mustard seeds for 1 to 2 minutes, taking care not to burn the seeds. Add the toasted mustard seeds and cook over medium heat just until the mustard seeds are fragrant, 3 to 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Place bread crumbs in a separate shallow bowl. Dip cod fillets in yogurt mixture, then dredge fillet in bread crumbs. Transfer coated fillets to a platter or on a baking sheet lined with foil. Arrange coated fillets on top of the soaked bread crumbs. Add eggs to yogurt mixture. Pour half and half into shallow pot.

title: Gingery Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil | 4 ounces beef tenderloin ( about 3/4 lb. ) | 2 tablespoons brandy | 1 tablespoon chopped ginger | sage leaf
instructions: Sprinkle beef with 1 t. Beef drippings. Brown in oil. Arrange on greased rack of an aluminum foil roaster. In small saucepan, combine remaining beef drippings and brandy. Cook, stirring until warm. Sprinkle beef with ginger. Top beef with brandy glaze. Sprinkle with sage. Bake at 350 degrees f, basting frequently, until tender, about 20 minutes.

title: Beef Buns
ingredients: 3 tablespoons almond butter, melted | 1/2 cup bisquick | 1 3/4 cups beef broth | 1 cup shredded coconut or 3/4 cup pecans, toasted | 2/3 cup dried red beans, soaked in water for 10 minutes and drained | 1/3 cup sliced strawberry | 1/2 cup chopped cashews or 1/2 cup peanuts, toasted | 1 teaspoon dried summer squash, soaked for about 10 minutes and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a large bowl combine first four ingredients. Drain and rinse dry beans. Spread dry beans in a single layer on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Make sure beans get completely dry. Bake until golden, about 20 to 25 minutes. Serve buns topped with toasted coconut, mixed nuts, and summer squash.

Random Ingredients: butter bean,poblano pepper,pecorino romano cheese,ice cube,confectioner sugar,chocolate curl,red potato,pumpkin
title: Pumpkin & Poblanos Gratin
ingredients: 2 tablespoons unsalted butter, melted | 1 1/2 pounds sweet red potatoes, cut into 1-inch dice | 4 poblano peppers, stemmed and quartered | 1 can pumpkin, drained | 1 1/2 cups confectioners'sugar | 2 cups shaved pecorino romano cheese | ice cubes | 1 pound poblanos pepper slices, cut into 1 inch strips | 1 1/2 tablespoons butter | 1 teaspoon confectioners'sugar, for dusting
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f. Brush the inside of a casserole dish with 1 tablespoon of the butter. Layer the sweet potatoes, poblanos, pumpkin, and 1 tablespoon of the confectioners' sugar in the bottom of the dish. Cover with more cheese and continue layering the layers, sprinkling on the remaining confectioners' sugar. Melt 2 to 3 tablespoons of the butter in a skillet over medium heat. Stir in the shaved pecorino romano cheese and cook, stirring constantly, until the cheese has melted. Spread the melted cheese mixture over the top of the gratin mixture.

title: Green Chili Refritos
ingredients: 1 cup refried beans | 2 tablespoons green chili salsa ( or other favorite salsa ) | 1/4 teaspoon capers | 1/8 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Microwave beans in a small dish in 50% power for 3 minutes, stirring after 2 minutes, until hot and bubbling.. Heat refried beans in microwave in a small dish in 50% power for 2 minutes, stirring after two minutes, until hot and bubbling. While beans are heating, combine remaining ingredients in a small bowl. Microwave on high for 15 seconds, stirring after about 1 minute, until hot but not boiling.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,clam,chili pepper flake,chunky peanut butter,breadcrumb,basmati rice
title: Peanut Butter-Lime Baked Clam
ingredients: 400 g clams, well-shelled ( with juice, about 36 ) | 2 cups breadcrumbs | 300 g cream cheese ( room temp ) | 1/4 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 2 teaspoons chunky peanut butter | basmati rice ( steamed to serve )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Place the clams in a shallow ovenproof dish, making sure they are all in the shell. Crush the clams with a rolling pin, and sprinkle over a little of the breadcrumbs. Set aside. Combine remaining breadcrumbs, cream cheese and chilli if using, and season. Spread cream cheese mixture evenly over the breadcrumbs. Bake in oven for 15 - 20 minutes or until golden and set. Serve hot with steamed basmati rice and extra crunchy peanut butter.

title: Cheese-Filled Flank Steak With Roasted Green Chili Peppers
ingredients: 1 flank steak, trimmed of any excess fat | 1/3 cup double gloucester cheese | 8 ounces jalapeno chiles | 1/3 cup alfredo sauce
instructions: Preheat the oven to 500°f place the flank steak on a rack in a roasting pan, and arrange the jalapenos and cheese evenly over the meat. Roast for about 15 minutes, or until the cheese starts to melt and the jalapenos are browning around the edge of the pan. Remove the steak from the oven, and allow to rest for 5 minutes. Invert onto a carving board, and slice into strips. Serve with pasta.

title: Jambo (Wooli) Beans
ingredients: 3 ounces dried wax beans, rinsed and picked over | 2 cups water | 3 1-inch square pieces fresh curry leaves | 1 piece fresh sage leaf
instructions: Combine the soaked beans, water, and curry leaves in a large pot.

title: Chewy Roasted Eggplant Salad
ingredients: 4 medium eggplants | 1 can artichoke hearts | 1 can mixed fruit, drained ( your favorites ) | 1 1/2 cups italian salad dressing, any flavor, your favorite vinaigrette- you're happy | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 2 tablespoons horseradish, drained | 6 tablespoons spice world spices
instructions: Peel eggplants and slice crosswise 1/4 inch thick. Combine eggplant slices with the remaining ingredients in large bowl, toss to combine. Bake at 350 degrees f. For 40 - 50 minutes or until crisp and brown. Cool, transfer to containers, refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: vanilla,phyllo dough,lemon zest,garlic butter,eggplant,bread,dark creme de cacao,beef
title: Roast Eggplant Rolls
ingredients: 2 large eggplants | 2 teaspoons lemon zest | 15 ounces sliced lean ground beef | 1/4 cup dark creme de cacao | 2 tablespoons garlic butter, melted | 1/4 cup dark french-fried eggplants | 8 sheets frozen phyllo dough | 1/2 cup butter, melted | 1/4 cup dark mexican dark creme de cacao | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1/2 teaspoon ground lemon zest | 1/2 teaspoon ground oregano | 1/2 cup bread, crust removed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Cut eggplant in ½ inch thick slices. Drizzle with lemon zest and place on a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes. Let cool, then cut lengthwise into ½ inch thick slices. Set aside. Brown ground beef in a large skillet over medium heat. Drain and set aside. To make filling, in the bowl of a food processor, add chees, eggplant, lemon zest, 5th cup of creme de cacao, garlic butter, fried eggplant slices, fried eggplant slices, and ground beef. Pulse until combined. Transfer to a 9x13 inch baking dish. To make toothpicks, drizzle with melted butter and dust top with crème de cacao, mexican dark creme de cacao, vanilla, lemon zest and oregano. Bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes. Remove toothpicks so that they don't bleed over and continue to bake until toothpicks are golden brown and interior temperature reaches 180 degrees f. Remove baking dish from oven and turn oven off. Let cool until cool enough to handle. Cut pastry into 3 strips, then cut strips into 2 inch pieces. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Place 5 strips at a time on top of each other in a single layer, slightly overlapping each other. Starting at the wide side of each strip, roll up to form cigar shapes of a length that’s about ½ inch wide. Repeat with another 5 strips until you reach the end. Make sure oven is just about covered so that pastry doesn’t dry out, as needed. Heat the butter in a small skillet over medium heat. When melted, add bread sticks, allowing bread stick pieces to crisp, turning them over after 1 minute. Lay bread sticks in a single layer onto baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven for 15 minutes. Make sure the bread sticks are completely dried out at this point. Remove from oven and allow bread sticks to cool.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,bay leaf,turmeric powder,vanilla,milk ricotta cheese
title: Vanilla Ricotta Cheese
ingredients: 1 kg whole milk ricotta cheese | 1 tablespoon turmeric powder | vegetable oil ( for frying ) | 1 bay leaf | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Mix the ricotta with the turmeric. Heat oil and fry the nutmeg and bay leaf lightly. The nutmeg will release water when baking. Fry the ricotta on both sides. Serve warm with powdered sugar, vanilla, or whatever sugar you would prefer.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,dark sesame oil,white fish fillet,onion powder,pickling salt,ancho chile powder,lemon essence,pizza crust
title: Django's Authentic Mexican Pizza
ingredients: 14 -16 ounces solid white fish fillets, bones removed, cut into bite sized pieces | 2 teaspoons dried ancho chile powder | 2 tablespoons white fish fillet seasoning | 2 tablespoons pickling salt | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 3/4 teaspoon lemon essence | 1/4 teaspoon onion powder | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1 unbaked crust ( i use boboli )
instructions: Note ~ i prefer ancho for authenticity & the chili powder for smoky taste, but not for a milder taste. Pre heat oven to 400 degrees. Combine fish seasoning, onion powder, cocoa powder & lemon essence and stir to blend. Add the fish pieces & toss until evenly coated. Sprinkle with the sesame oil & mix again. Spread the mixture evenly over your pre baked crust, then bake for 10 minutes. Turn the broiler on & carefully place your pizzas on top of the bread so your broiler stays on the flame. Cook for approximately 10 more minutes. The crust should be brown & puffed. Carefully remove from oven & allow to rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Fish With Cilantro (Moroccan Style)
ingredients: 3 medium trout fillets, about 3 ounces each | vegetable oil or cooking spray | 8 teaspoons sweet mango or 8 teaspoons apricot puree | 1 1/2 teaspoons marmalade or 1 1/2 teaspoons lemon juice | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro leaves, torn
instructions: Brush the fish fillets generously with oil and sprinkle with salt, if desired. Cook under a hot grill until just done. Do not overcook. Meanwhile, combine the mango puree, marmalade and cilantro in a small bowl. Heat oven to 200c or 400°f and arrange fish on a serving platter. Spoon the mango mixture over the fish. Serve.

Random Ingredients: cucumber,dill weed,tomato green chilies,american cheese,liquid smoke,pizza crust marinade mix,lemon peel
title: Pizza-Gramma's Easy Cheesy Mexi Cucumber Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 cans diced tomatoes and green chilies, drained ( about 2 cups ) | 1 teaspoon finely shredded lemon peel | 1 teaspoon dried dill weed | 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke | 2 packages dry pizza crust or ( 6 ounce ) packages marinade mix | 1 1/4 cups shredded american cheese or 1 1/4 cups mozzarella cheese | 1 can sliced pickled cucumbers, drained
instructions: Combine tomatoes and next 5 ingredients in 3 1/3 cup glass measure.

title: Creamy Low Fat No-Fry Veggies (Cauliflower) With a Tropical Flavours
ingredients: 1 cup pumpkin ( cubed ) | 1/4 cup cauliflower ( chopped ) | 1 lime | 0.5 can crushed pineapple ( drained of juice ) | 1 teaspoon onion salt | 1 teaspoon lime rind | 2 teaspoons unsweetened applesauce
instructions: Combine all the vegie/veggie ingredients with the pineapple. Blend and heat until heated through. Serve with rice or noodles.

title: Vegan Thai Basil Macaroni and Beans
ingredients: 16 ounces macaroni ( i use barilla large seashells ) | 1 can black bean sauce | 1/4 cup thai basil
instructions: Add your thai basil to a food pro and get it started. Boil the water. Add your thai basil to your macaroni and boil until done to your liking. Add your black bean sauce totop macaroni for a few minutes. It should be slightly soupy but will firm up as it sits.

title: Roasted Herbed Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs skinless chicken, boneless and meaty | 1 1/2 lbs chicken breasts or 1 1/2 lbs chicken thighs | 6 teaspoons dried tarragon | 5 teaspoons chicken bouillon
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Remove skin from chicken. Pat dry of chicken breasts with paper towels. Starting at one end of leg bone attached to breast, tie legs together tightly with string. Place chicken in shallow roasting pan. Place chicken in a large roasting pan and put in oven. Roast 45 - 50 minutes, to the chicken's internal read thermometer 165 degrees f. Turn over and roast about 15 - 20 minutes longer.

title: Grilled Beurre Mushrooms (Kababobs) With Prosciutto (Yogurt Sauce)
ingredients: 7 shallots | 8 lbs marinated beurre mushrooms | 4 ounces prosciutto ( about 2 ozs ) | 1/2 teaspoon pickling salt | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 3 tablespoons yogurt | 16 spring onions, minced ( white and green parts )
instructions: The mushrooms are best washed and allowed to dry. Slice the mushrooms. Place the mushrooms into a bowl and pour about half of their liquid over them. Allow to drain over night. Strain the liquid once the mushrooms are cool enough to handle. Cut each mushroom into 6 pieces and sprinkle with salt and sesame oil. Set aside. Slice the prosciutto into 2 pieces and place on a cutting board. Cut them into 2 inch long pieces. Heat up one teaspoon of sesame oil in a 10 inch nonstick skillet over medium heat until very hot but not smoking. Working in batches, carefully place one piece of prosciutto in the hot skillet and cook until slightly softened, 2 to 3 minutes, then turn so prosciutto is on the other side. Transfer the beurre mushrooms to a bowl. Using tongs or a slotted spoon, turn the mushroom over and remove the sesame oil. Repeat until all the mushrooms are cooked. Serve the beurre mushrooms with prosciutto and sprinkled with onions. Note, for a more rustic look, place breads in a plastic bag and pour in about half of the beet marinade and allow it to marinate for about 20 minutes. Shake off any excess marinade. Grill the mushrooms on a preheated grill until they begin to char on the underside, with the beurre mushrooms still slightly charred and slightly crisp still holding their shape. If you're not using wooden skewers, soak them in warm water to keep them from burning to the bottom as you cook them. Note, after making the beurre mushrooms, you can add a small amount of chopped btb. Battered marinade to the beurre mushrooms to give it a more rustic look, but leave all the stems intact. Note, beurre mushrooms can be refrigerated, or frozen.

title: Mini Sizzlers
ingredients: 1 pumpernickel rye bread | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning ( or more )
instructions: Preheat your oven to 450 degrees f. Lightly oil your hands or a metal pann cooking spray or line your cookie sheet with parchment paper. Cut a circle out of each slice of rye bread. Using a sharp knife, cut the bread in half.

title: Pear and Pear Soup
ingredients: 1 large ripe pear, peeled, cored and roughly chopped | 2 large fresh sage leaves, chopped | 2 tablespoons ginger paste | 1 -2 cup beef stock | 1 tablespoon chili oil | herbs ( optional )
instructions: Finely chop the pear, sage and ginger in a food processor. Combine the stock and chili oil in a saucepan, bring to the boil, stirring all the time. Add the pear and sage mixture to the pan. Cover and simmer gently for 30 - 40 minutes or until the pear is cooked and the soup has thickened slightly. If you want a thicker soup, leave the pot uncovered for a few minutes to allow the soup to thicken. You may serve this topped with any herbs, if desired.

title: Frozen Strawberry-Strawberry Slice
ingredients: 1/2 cup strawberry | 1/4 cup dried currant
instructions: Line a slice tin with baking paper. Place strawberries & dried currants in a large bowl & stir to combine. Spoon strawberry mixture into tin. Freeze 15 minutes before serving.

title: Bunya Dogs
ingredients: 1/2 pound beef, cut into strips | 1 piece eggplant, cut into chunks | 1 teaspoon tandoori paste, or to taste | 1 dried red chile pepper
instructions: Season beef strips with salt and pepper.

title: Herbed Slaw
ingredients: 1 head cabbage | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: Remove any hard outer leaves from the cabbage. Rinse the leaves well. Core and thinly slice. Place the cabbage into a bowl and sprinkle with the oregano. Toss to mix.

Random Ingredients: orange juice,paprika,chinese five spice powder,confectioner sugar,vegetable shortening,lamb chop,coffee
title: Chinese Five Spice Lamb Chops
ingredients: 4 lamb chops | 1/4 cup coffee | 1/4 cup orange juice | 1/4 cup vegetable shortening, softened | 2 teaspoons chinese five-spice powder | 1 teaspoon paprika | 1 cup confectioners'sugar
instructions: Place lamb chops between plastic wrap and pound to an even thickness of 1/4 inch. Place 1/4 cup orange juice, shortening, and 5 spice powder in a shallow dish. Dip chops into marinade and place in the marinade. Seal well, coat and refrigerate overnight. Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Place marinated chops on a rack and bake in preheated oven until golden brown and the juices run clear, about 25 minutes.

title: Braised Beef
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs stewing beef, cut into chunks | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 500°f with a medium heavy duty dutch oven over medium high heat, brown meat in some large chunks. Cook meat until it is a deep rich brown color about 15 minutes. Transfer meat to a medium bowl. Pour drippings, such as gravy from dutch oven into a small oven proof measuring cup and set over a small rimmed baking dish. Stir drippings/vasses into stewed beef and season with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Bake on top rack of oven until meat thermometer reaches 130°f, about 2 hours. Transfer stewed beef to cutting board and slice against grain. Serve stewed beef at once.

title: Finger Fry Beef Tips and Gravy
ingredients: 2/3 cup rice flour | 2/3 cup beef base
instructions: Combine all the ingredients and mix until the sauce is to your taste.

title: Peanut Butter and Tomato Pies
ingredients: 1 sheet puff pastry | 1/2 lb fresh spinach leaves ( trimmed of stems ) or 1/2 lb dried tomato leaves | 1/2 cup creamy peanut butter
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f roll out puff pastry to a 12 round. Transfer pastry to a baking sheet and prick pastry with a fork. Cook spinach until it collapses, about 10 minutes. Cool. Finely chop the spinach. In a bowl, combine the spinach and peppered peanut butter. Add minced hot juniper berries. Press mixture evenly onto prepared pastry. Brush tops with beaten egg white.

title: Paneer Cheese Balls
ingredients: 500 g mashed potatoes | 200 g panir, crumbled ( use low fat cheese if you like ) | 3/4 - 1 cup beef stock | 1/2 teaspoon sugar ( optional ) | 2 -3 tablespoons ketchup | 1 lemons or 1 lime juice | 1 cup green onion, chopped | 1/2 cup glace cherries, chopped
instructions: Combine the mashed potatoes with the cream cheese, browned onion, ketchup and lemon or lime juice in your mixer or food processor. Add salt, pepper and sugar if using if you would like. Roll dough into small balls and place on your floured board for flattening/shaping the ball around your palm. Place the meatball in your cheese mixture with the side of your knuckles. Make sure you roll them around so the cheese mixture is in the cheese. Place on a baking tray and cover with plastic wrap and leave to rise about 45min. Bake on 190c for 20 - 25 min or until browned. Remove from oven and transfer to a dish and leave to cool slightly. Roll the balls in cornflour to coat well. Serve with sliced tomato and salad as desired.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,chicken stock cube,ketchup,rice flour,quinoa flour
title: Rice Flour Balls
ingredients: 2 cups dry rice flour | 2 cups chicken stock cubes | 4 tablespoons ketchup | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 2 teaspoons quinoa flour
instructions: Mix together flour, ketchup, garlic powder& quinoa. Make balls the size of a ping pong ball. Heat cast iron skillet on the stove and make a couple small holes in the middle using a fork. Place balls on skillet. Cook on medium heat for about 10 miuntess until golden on all sides.

Random Ingredients: green olive,grape,parmigiano reggiano cheese,scallion,breadcrumb,black cardamom pod
title: Green Olive and Oranges on Breadcrumbs
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs green olives, coarsely chopped ( i leave the pit in for better presentation ) | 8 ounces parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/4 cup coarse fresh breadcrumb | 1/4 teaspoon black cardamom pod, crushed | 6 scallions, white and light green parts only, finely chopped | 4 large pints grape, or | 20 black dried long beans
instructions: Heat a dry pan over medium heat and add olives. Stir often for at least 2 minutes or until the olive oil is slightly browned, stirring from time to time. Remove pan from heat and reserve. Discard or slice olives ¼ inch thick, then place in a bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Store in refrigerator. Place bread crumbs in a bowl and set aside. Place all the topping ingredients in a saute pan and melt over very low heat, whisking continuously, until the cheese is melted. Stir in the olives. Turn the heat up to high and add grape, stirring until the grape is tender. Scoop the mixture into a bowl and serve warm. Note, if using canned or frozen whole grapes, place them in a small saucepan with 1/2 cup hot water and cook for around 15 - 20 minutes until tender.

title: Pureed Turkish Pumpkin Seeds
ingredients: 2 cups whole pumpkin puree | 2 ounces dried apricots, diced
instructions: In a medium bowl combine the pumpkin and apricots. Mix well to ensure no lumps form and form dessicated parchment paper. Spread evenly into a 9 x 5 inch ovenproof bowl.

Random Ingredients: parsley leaf,coriander seed,vegetable oil,wine,onion salt,sugar,ice water,cardamom
title: Ras El Hanout (Indian Parsley Salad)
ingredients: 1 cup fresh coriander seed ( or cilantro ) | 1/2 teaspoon onion salt | 1 cup fresh breadcrumb | 1/3 cup finely chopped fresh parsley leaves ( or cilantro ) | 1/3 cup water | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1/2 teaspoon sugar | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom ( optional )
instructions: Combine coriander and onion salt and let sit in refrigerator for 1 hour. Wash and dry bread crumbs. Pound or process until mixture resembles coarse meal. Fry bread crumbs in oil. Remove from heat and drain off excess oil. Mix bread crumbs, parsley, water, oil, cardamom, and sugar in noncorrosive bowl. Stir in 1/4 tsp of onion salt. Serve salad chilled.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,raisin,prawn,stuffing,beef hot dog,chicken bouillon granule,garlic salt,chunky peanut butter
title: Quick Hot Dogs With Peanut Sauce...
ingredients: 8 beef hot dogs | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped raisins | 12 cooked prawns | 3 tablespoons chunky peanut butter | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon granule | 1 tablespoon seasoned stuffing | italian chili pepper flakes | 3 teaspoons instant minced garlic salt
instructions: Remove cords from each hot dog, leaving a 4 inch piece of the fat open at the top of each. Sprinkle each hot dog with a pinch of salt, then coat with a small amount of the peanut butter. Heat a heavy skillet over medium high. Remove hot dogs from skillet as they are done, then carefully slice into 1/2 inch slices. Combine remaining ingredients in a small bowl, then set aside. Place 2 hot dogs in the skillet. Add remaining sauce, then stir to coat. Cook until hot dogs are heated through, 2 minutes. Remove from heat.

title: Chinese Cabbage
ingredients: 4 lbs unpeeled chinese cabbage ( not in or on the stem ) | 1 tablespoon celery salt | 1 tablespoon premium vodka
instructions: Place all ingredients in a 3 quart dutch oven or other heavy pot. Bring to a boil. Cover. Turn down to medium setting and cook for 3 hours, stirring occasionally, or until cabbage is well cooked.

Random Ingredients: chestnut mushroom,lettuce,pumpkin seed,chicken soup base,mango,bean sprout,soymilk
title: Mango Chicken
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chicken soup base | 1 mango, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon pumpkin seeds | 1 cup canned chestnut mushrooms | 250 g lettuce | 200 g bean sprouts | 1 cup soft soy milk
instructions: Put into saucepan soup base and turn up flame. Add mango and chestnut mushrooms. Heat through, cover and let rest for few minutes. Serve either cold or warm.

title: Coconut Ice
ingredients: 6 ounces desiccated coconut | 5 ounces sherry wine
instructions: Line a 26 cm lamington pan with baking paper. Combine the coconut and sherry in a bowl, mixing well. Spoon the mixture into the pan and sprinkle with the dried coconut. Seal the edges with an upturned spoon or use a knife to remove the excess coconut air bubbles. Put into the freezer & leave in the freezer as per your normal method to harden for 30 - 45 mins, remove when nearly firm, but still lable. Remove from the freezer & sit in the pan for 15 - 20 mins for the ice to harden further. Remove the blade of the knife and slice. Serve in thick slices.

title: Spaghetti With Sweet Apples, Okra, and Okra
ingredients: 400 g spaghetti | 3 granny smith apples, cut into wedges | 1/4 cup golden syrup | 75 g sweet baby okra or 75 g green beans, trimmed
instructions: Cook spaghetti until just tender, drain. Meanwhile, heat golden syrup, then fry okra or beans in syrup until just tender. Add hot spaghetti to hot apples, tossing gently. Serve immediately.

title: Homemade Saffron Saffrans
ingredients: 8 pieces saffron | 1/4 cup finely minced fresh onion
instructions: Toast saffron in a dry pan on medium heat. Keep the pan over low heat. Keep it moving with a wooden spoon to stir until the color darkens almost completely all the way. Stir the saffron into the onion in the pan. Turn off the heat and serve hot. Serve.

title: Fruit Baked in Banana's
ingredients: 1 can garbanzo beans, drained ( chickpeas ) | 1 1/2 cups fruit ( fresh or frozen )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Drain garbanzo beans and discard water. If your beans are drying out during the baking process, keep an eye on them. Place the drained garbanzo beans in an 8 cup casserole dish and top with fruit, pressing them into the bean pockets with a spoon. Bake in the preheated oven for 25 to 30 minutes, until the fruits are soft and the edges are golden.

title: Bahama Risotto (Rice With Pine Nuts)
ingredients: 4 cups unsalted sun-blushed tomatoes | 1/2 cup unblanched whole almonds or 1/2 cup pine nuts | 1 teaspoon fennel seed, crushed | 1 cup arborio rice or 1 cup carnaroli rice | 2 tablespoons sugar | 1 1/2 tablespoons coconut rum
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees f. Line 6 quart baking dish with parchment paper or a silpat. Line baking dish with foil and dampen the foil. Place rinsed and lightly salted tomatoes in pan. Bake 40 - 45 minutes, basting twice, until dry. Toss sunblushed tomatoes with almonds or pine nuts. Place rice in a colander, sprinkle with fennel seeds, and press firmly so that sunbeasts adhere. Let cool. Place rice on a serving platter and sprinkle with rum. Cut into fingers to serve.

Random Ingredients: wonton skin,black peppercorn,dark rum,sauce,romaine lettuce leaf
title: Rum Gau Gee
ingredients: 20 dried wild ducks, gutted ( a few pounds ) | 1 large romaine lettuce leaf, washed, dried and torn into bite-size pieces | 1 jar sauce, such as hoegaarden sweet and spicy | 12 fresh whole black peppercorns | 1/4 cup dark rum
instructions: Rinse the ducks, or put them in a large pot the night before. The duck can be cooked on the grill. Grill the ducks either over a charcoal grill or under the broiler until the meat is cooked as desired, 4 to 7 minutes per side. Place the romaine lettuce, about 30 to 45 inches in diameter, on a large serving platter. Drain the duck and place it in a salad bowl with the lettuce, tossing to ensure even distribution of the lettuce, and set aside. Pour the sauce over the salad, and season to taste with salt and freshly cracked black pepper. Sprinkle the rum over the top and serve.

title: Easy Thai Coconut Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1 cup coconut milk | 1 pinch saffron | 4 -6 lettuce | 1/4 cup smooth peanut butter
instructions: Put coconut milk and saffron in a small sauce pan. Stir over medium low heat till the saffron is all dissolved. Add chopped lettuce, mix well and allow to simmer for about 5 minutes on low. Remove from heat and set aside for 5 minutes. Remove the coconut milk from the heat. Stir in the peanut butter and add it to the lettuce mixture. Serve immediately.

title: Kiwi and Kiwi Salsa
ingredients: 1 can bush's no-salt-added chili without beans | 1 1/4 cups finely chopped leeks | 1 teaspoon lemon zest, finely grated | 1 kiwi fruit, peeled and sliced
instructions: Cook the chilie and leeks in boiling water for two minutes until leeks are just softened. Drain and cool to room temperature. Place in blender with remaining ingredients and process until smooth. Chill.

Random Ingredients: walnut,pie crust,triple sec,hot italian sausage,self rising flour,pinto bean,five spice powder,black eyed pea
title: Italian Sausage Bean Sausage and Walnuts Pie
ingredients: 1 lb hot italian sausage | 3 cups self rising flour | 1/2 cup triple sec | 1/2 teaspoon five-spice powder | 3/4 cup dark brown walnuts ( chopped ) | 3/4 cup pinto beans, frozen and thawed | 3/4 cup black-eyed peas, frozen and thawed | 1 pie crust
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large mixing owl. Mix thoroughly using your hands to form a well in the center of the mixture. Push the edges into center using your thumb and forefinger. Turn onto a non stick tray. Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Line a 9 pan with parchment paper. Roll out the pie crust into a circular cookie cutter using a round cutter, 3 inches in diameter. Arrange the cookie cutter on the pastry and top with the sausage. Using the back of your spoon, press in the dough. The dough should be even and somewhat thinner than the surrounding edge of your baking pan. If it is too small add water slightly to the edge of the pastry, it will absorb this liquid and your sausage will have the tart texture of a pastry dough. Bake in the preheated oven for 40 - 50 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Easy Vegan Portuguese Spice Scones (Dairy Free, Vegan)
ingredients: 2 cups cooked brown rice ( portuguese sweet rice, if you can find it pre-cooked, sweet rice will do ) | 2 cups cake flour, all purpose | 1 tablespoon cumin powder
instructions: Mix dry ingredients in a bowl. Add wet ingredients. Mix until all the flour is covered in flour. Use a fork and your hands to mix the mix until evenly distributed. If it sticks to the side, turn over to knead the dough. Place on an ungreased baking sheet.

Random Ingredients: broccoli stem,dark soy sauce,onion powder,chili garlic sauce,chicken leg
title: Easy Broccoli Chicken
ingredients: 6 chicken legs with thigh, with thigh bone attached | 5 ounces frozen fresh broccoli stems, thawed and drained | 1/4 cup reduced sodium soy sauce | 1/4 cup chili-garlic sauce | 2 teaspoons onion powder
instructions: Preheat an oven to 325 degrees f. Line the bottom of a roasting pan with aluminum foil. Cut a lengthwise slit 1/4 inch deep along the bone top of each chicken leg. Reserve remaining marinade. Place chicken legs in a large baking dish, cover, and refrigerate for at least 8 hours, but up to 1 day. Bring the reserved marinade and broth to a boil in a saucepan over high heat. Boil until reduced to 1 cup, about 5 minutes. Toss in the broccoli stems, cover, and set aside to steam until tender, about 5 minutes. Transfer the chicken legs to a clean work surface and add enough remaining broth to make 1 cup. Remove foil from the oven and sprinkle chicken legs with onion powder. Cover roaster with foil and bake in the preheated oven until the chicken juices run clear when the chicken is pierced, about 25 minutes.

title: Sausage & Seafood Salad
ingredients: 4 links sausage | 2 cups shrimp, cooked peeled deveined and coarsely chopped ( from a cooked sausage ) | 1/2 cup crabmeat, cooked or canned or 1/2 cup shrimp, shredded | 1 can water chestnuts, drained and chopped | 1 can canned clams with juice | 1 cup unsweetened coconut, flaked | rice, cooked according to directions ( optional )
instructions: Cut sausage in half crosswise, remove sausage from casings. Cut sausage in 3 pieces. Combine sausage, shrimp, crab meat, water chestnuts, and canned clams. Mix together. Chill at least 2 hours. Add coconut to salad just before serving.

title: Avocados with Italian Parsley and Lime
ingredients: 1 large avocado - hulled, peeled, and sliced 1/4-inch thick | 1 bunch chopped italian parsley, about | 1/4 cup confectioners'sugar | 1 tablespoon finely chopped lime zest
instructions: Place the sliced avocado slices in a large bowl. Stir in italian parsley.

title: Grape Leaves
ingredients: 600 g grape leaves | 4 teaspoons black peppercorns
instructions: Remove outer layer of leaves that are not coated with peppercorns by rubbing in a bowl. Use a spoon to scrape out hard inner cellaromolks that float on the surface. Pour 5 or 6 cups boiling water into bowl with a leaf, or pour through a strainer into a bowl and allow to drain for 20 minutes. Spread leaves on your bench, making them about 1 inch long, then spread out again. Cut out a hole in the centre of each leaf and fill with about 3 tbsp of the reserved peppercorns filling. Roll the leaves, a little at a time, into long strings, then tie the leaves with kitchen string. The string will provide a little extra support while cooking. Preheat the grill to medium and put a little oil in a shallow baking dish. When hot, place rolls in the dish. Leave for 1 - 2 minutes until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,anchovy paste,pimiento,olive,tomato sauce,apricot jam,ginger root
title: Pigs in Tomato Sauce- German Style
ingredients: 3 tablespoons canola oil | 1 pound beef stew meat, cubed | 8 ounces canned apricot jam, divided | 2 tablespoons minced fresh ginger root | 1 jar pimientos, chopped | 1 can anchovy paste, crumbled | 1 can sliced olives, drained
instructions: Heat canola oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Working in batches, add beef and saute until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove from skillet and set aside. Reduce heat to medium and pour half the jam into the skillet. Heat until jam begins to bubble. Stir in ginger and saute 1 minute. Pour half the warm jam into the skillet. Place sauteed beef back in sauce and return to heat. Mix in pimentos, anchovies and olives. Continue cooking about 10 minutes, stirring constantly until meat juices have mostly reduced. Serve over noodles or rice.

title: Raisin Scones
ingredients: 1 tablespoon raisins | 1 tablespoon green pepper, minced | 1 tablespoon brandy
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. In bowl, toss together 1 heaping tbsp raisins and 1 tbsp green pepper. Roll raisin mixture in remaining mixture. Place on a lightly greased baking sheet. Bake 15 - 20 minutes on each side.

title: Lamb and Couscous With Green Peppers and Herbs
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs fresh lamb or 1 1/4 lbs lamb fillets, cut into bite-size pieces | 2 medium green peppers, seeded and cut into strips | 2/3 cup fresh cilantro or 2/3 cup parsley, washed well and dried | 2/3 cup fresh oregano or 1/3 cup fresh marjoram, washed well and dried | 1 1/4 cups couscous, mixed with | 1/4 cup of fresh parsley | 2 tablespoons fresh cilantro, snipped, for garnish
instructions: In a large oven proof skillet over medium heat, fry the lamb just until browned. This will take up to 5 to 10 minutes. Add the green peppers and mix well. Cover the skillet and heat on low for 5 to 10 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes. Remove from the heat, let stand at room temperature for 10 to 15 minutes. After 10 minutes, add the couscous, 2 or 3/4 cup water, parsley and oregano, stirring to combine. Cover and cook on low heat for 5 minutes. Stir in the meat, cover and continue cooking, shaking the pot a few times, until the meat is tender and the liquid is absorbed. About 10 minutes longer.. Fluff with a fork and garnish with more fresh parsley and cilantro, if desired.

title: Krioticu
ingredients: 1/4 cup green curry paste | 1/4 cup sweet chili sauce | 1 tablespoon curry
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl and serve.

title: Guisseur's French Dessert Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup white wine | 2 teaspoons savory, chopped | 1 teaspoon irish cream ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender and blend until smooth.

Random Ingredients: salt pork,feta cheese,xanthan gum,extra virgin olive oil
title: Feta Cheese Patties
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs crumbled feta cheese | 2 teaspoons xanthan gum | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 1/2 teaspoon salt ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients and blend until smooth.

title: Homemade Italian Sausage (Pigs)
ingredients: 4 links italian sausage | dried savory ( enough to sprinkle over meat ) or dried thyme ( enough to sprinkle over meat )
instructions: Remove casings from sausage and slice very thinly crosswise. Put a layer of sausages in a large pot and cover with savory, and sprinkling with dried, or granulated seasonings. Put into the preheated 325 degree oven. Bake for 2 hours and check when they are soft. Turn pieces halfway through.

title: Bridies
ingredients: 8 ounces dry spaghetti, broken into 2-inch lengths | 1/2 cup chopped maraschino cherry | 1/2 cup unsweetened flaked coconut | 1 pound bulk pork sausage, cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 1 tablespoon seasoning ( pampered chef ) | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 packet muscatel ( sweetened condensed milk )
instructions: Prepare the baking soda and set aside. Place the bread crumbs in a medium bowl and add the sausage, pine nuts, coconut, sweetened condensed milk, and baking soda and stir gently to mix.

Random Ingredients: brown rice,apricot,half,rum extract,korean chili flake,rice noodle,focaccia bread
title: Korean Sizzling Noodle Baked in Apricot Rum Sauce
ingredients: 1 package crumbled rice noodles | 1 1/2 tablespoons spiced rum extract | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 1/2 cup instant rice noodles | 1 dash ground korean chili flakes | 3/4 cup chopped dried apricots | 1 slice focaccia bread, cut 1/2-inch thick
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees f. Place rice noodles in a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,caper,black mustard seed,apple,white sugar
title: Red Curry Apples
ingredients: 6 apples - peeled, cored, and sliced | 1/4 cup red curry paste, or more to taste | 1 teaspoon white sugar, or to taste | 1 teaspoon black mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon capers, drained ( optional )
instructions: Line a baking dish with aluminum foil. Combine apples and curry paste in a food processor or blender. Blend until smooth. Stir sugar, mustard seeds, and capers into the apple mixture. Cover baking dish with aluminum foil. Bake in the preheated oven until apple mixture is hot and bubbling, 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Beef and Blueberry Salad
ingredients: 3 cups cooked bow tie pasta | 1/4 lb filet of beef, cut in 1/4 inch slices | 1 cup blueberries, rinsed, drained or 1 cup strawberry, coarsely chopped
instructions: Combine the pasta, beef, and berry or strawberries in a serving dish. Toss over low heat 3 - 4 minutes.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,colby monterey jack cheese,oat,seasoning salt,bread machine yeast,maraschino cherry
title: Tex Mex Pizza
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons oatmeal | 1/2 teaspoon yeast | 3 1/2 cups bread machine yeast | 2 cups colby-monterey jack cheese, shredded | 3/4 cup picante sauce, divided | 1 can maraschino cherries, drained | 2 teaspoons seasoning salt
instructions: Put ingredients except cheese and cherries in bread machine. Set bread maker for dough setting. Remove from machine and punch dough down. Divide dough into 3 pieces. Roll to 1/4 thickness. Cut each into 4 pieces. Place on lightly greased cookie sheet and brush tops with 1 teaspoons picante sauce. Sprinkle top with cheese. Let rise in a warm place for at least 20 minutes. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Bake 25 minutes or until edges are light brown, and bottom of crust is golden brown. Cut in half and serve with remaining picante sauce. Sprinkle with cherries.

title: Lettuce, Bacon, Tomato and Cheese Rolls
ingredients: 1 lb pasta, cooked and drained | 1 lb chopped cooked bacon or 1 lb chopped cooked turkey | 1/2 cup chopped lettuce | 1 container fat-free topping ( or use 1/2 and 1/2 )
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees f. Stir cooked pasta, bacon, lettuce and topping together until combined. Place 1 tablespoon of mixture into center of each pastry tube. Cut into 12 squares. Bake for 10 minutes. Top with cheese if desired.

title: Black Bean Dip - Easy
ingredients: 2 cans black beans, drained and rinsed | 3/4 cup natural yoghurt | 1/2 cup cashew nuts, ground
instructions: Combine ingredients in the bowl of a food processor or blender and process until smooth. Serve immediately.

title: Panda Express - Mexican Festa Dip
ingredients: 1 pint sour cherry tomatoes | 2 teaspoons corn syrup | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1 bag ritz crackers
instructions: Dice the tomatoes, corn syrup and vanilla. Mix all ingredients in blender except crackers. Sprinkle with crackers. Serve with tortilla chips, crackers or whatever toppings you like.

Random Ingredients: red food coloring,shallot,plum,purpose flour,almond paste,wheat bread,blue cheese
title: Blue Cheese and Plum Rounds
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups plum, coarsely chopped | 3 tablespoons slivered almonds | 1 teaspoon red food coloring | 5 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 3 tablespoons unsweetened almond paste | 1/2 medium shallot, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons soft low-fat blue cheese
instructions: Combine plum, almonds and food coloring in a small bowl and set aside. Combine flour and almond paste in a small bowl. Cut in shallot. Add to flour mixture and stir until it just begins to bind. If mixture looks dry add more water and flour.

Random Ingredients: chunky peanut butter,lima bean,garlic,lamb shoulder,pita bread
title: My Favourite and Simple Lamb Pita Fajitas
ingredients: 1 medium lamb shoulder | 2 tablespoons chunky peanut butter ( peanut brand or home made blends works also ) | 2 teaspoons chopped garlic ( about 2 tsp. ) | 1 can lima beans, drained ( about 1/2 a 15 oz. can ) | 1 medium pita bread
instructions: Trim fat from lamb, cut into 1/2 inch slices. Place lamb in a bowl and add peanut butter, garlic, and beans. Toss to coat, taste, and let sit for 20 minutes. Heat grill pan to medium. Grill lamb until cooked through, about 6 - 8 minutes per side, turning once. Meanwhile break up pita bread into smaller pieces and warm under broiler. Spoon equal amounts of lamb onto pita. Serve warm with remaining sauce.

title: Coconut Oil and Onion Soup Mix
ingredients: 3 packets dry onion soup mix | 1/4 cup coconut oil
instructions: In a medium bowl add dry soup mix and coconut oil. Combine well. Heat.

title: Jalapeno and Kidney Bean Ceviche
ingredients: 1 cup pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 1 cup jalapenos, diced | 1/2 cup ginger root, peeled, diced | 1/4 cup gin, or to taste | 1/4 cup brandy, or to taste | 1 tablespoon lime juice, or to taste
instructions: Combine the pinto beans, jalapeno, ginger, gin, brandy, and lime juice together in a blender.

Random Ingredients: candy,vermouth,pine nut,red curry paste,baking soda,chocolate,italian parsley
title: Spicy Spicy Chocolate Pastries - Skewers
ingredients: 1 lb semi-sweet chocolate, chopped | 8 -10 sweet unsweetened chocolate, chopped | 1/4 cup pine nuts, toasted | 1 tablespoon italian parsley, chopped | 2 tablespoons dry vermouth or 2 tablespoons dry white wine | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 2 -3 teaspoons red curry paste or 2 -3 teaspoons curry flavoring
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f degrees. Line metal skewers with aluminum foil. In metal bowl melt semisweet and unsweetened chocolates, pine nuts and parsley in the vermouth, and stir until well mixed. Add baking soda, stir well. When mixture is well blended add chocolate mixture and stir until just mixed. Divide this mixture into small balls, then roll each ball in chopped italian parsley and pine nuts. Place on skewers. Brush tops with cooking oil. Bake about 12 minutes, or until golden brown. Serve warm.

title: Honey and Onions
ingredients: 6 tablespoons honey | 1/2 cup yellow onion, finely diced | 1/2 teaspoon dried cilantro, crumbled
instructions: Heat honey in small frying pan on low for 5 minutes. Stir in onion and cilantro. Cook on low, stirring frequently, until onions are tender, stirring occasionally, about 15 to 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: white breadcrumb,nutmeg,chili paste,rye bread,golden raisin,green chili paste,green cardamom
title: Sweet Raisin Breadcrumb Balls
ingredients: 1 lb firm white breadcrumb | 1/4 lb fresh sourdough breadcrumb | 1 lb green chili paste | 1/4 lb hot mustard or 1/4 lb spicy red pickle relish | 4 -5 teaspoons green chili paste | 1 -4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 2 teaspoons golden raisins
instructions: Mix together all remaining ingredients. Form into walnut sized balls. Keep refrigerated until ready to eat.

title: Kibbee Nyzi
ingredients: ice water | 1 cup ice cubes | 10 pounds pickling spices | 2 tablespoons saffron
instructions: Fill a large heavy pot with ice and enough water to cover. Let soak until very cold, about 3 hours. Add 1 cup ice and 10 pounds pickling spice to the boiling water. Let steep until ice is completely melted, about 4 hours. Transfer pickling spice mixture to a jar, cover, and refrigerate until completely cold. Melt saffron in the top of a double boiler over simmering water, stirring constantly. When the flavor begins to deepen, increase heat to medium and bring to a boil. As soon as the saffron begins to color, remove from heat and drain any remaining water from pickling spice bag. Add saffron flavored water to the pickling solution and then stir in cold water. Bring back to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer 15 minutes. Strain liquid into a container and refrigerate until cold.

title: Cafe Rio Fried Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken cutlets | 6 ounces frozen green peas | 1 teaspoon sugar | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper ( optional )
instructions: Boil chicken cutlets in water for 12 minutes. Drain. Place peas in saucepan on medium high heat with chicken cutlets. Cook 5 - 10 minutes until the juices run clear. Add sugar and pepper.

Random Ingredients: artichoke heart,kernel corn,dill,lemon,red chile pepper,cayenne pepper,thyme sprig
title: Artichoke Corn Chichoke Dip
ingredients: 1 cup whole kernel corn, drained | 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 2 lemon wedges | 2 tablespoons fresh thyme sprigs, minced | 1 fresh red chile pepper, minced | 1/2 teaspoon dried dill, or to taste | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper, or to taste
instructions: Mix corn, artichokes, lemon wedges, thyme sprigs, red chile pepper, dill, and cayenne pepper together in a bowl.

title: Chilled Espresso, Raspberry & Raspberry Frappe
ingredients: 1 cup espresso | 2 raspberries, frozen or 1 handful fresh raspberry, for garnish
instructions: In a coffee grinder, combine the espresso with 1/4 cup cold water. Cover and blend until frothy. Strain through a fine mesh sieve until no lumps remain. Fill stemmed glasses and chill in the freezer for about 10 minutes before topping up with more cold water.

title: Saffron-Glazed Oatcakes
ingredients: 1 cup fresh bread crumbs | 1/4 teaspoon saffron | 1 pinch salt | 1 cup oat flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix together bread crumbs, saffron, and salt in a medium bowl. Add flour and mix thoroughly. Cut a circle out of the oat flour with a cookie cutter.
