Prick with 1 or 2 spoons to let steam escape. Place one circle of flour into the center of a round of water. Use a fork to poke holes in the oat flour. Pour the oat glaze into the holes. When water boils up, remove from heat. Poke holes several times with a fork. Place on a baking sheet. Cook in a preheated oven until golden, 35 to 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: beef broth,lamb,taco seasoning mix,golden raisin,sun tomato oil,walnut,shiitake mushroom,lemon zest
title: Lamb Tostadas With Sun Dried Tomato & Rum Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lean ground lamb | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning mix | 1/4 cup golden raisin ( optional ) | 1/2 cup walnut pieces ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons lemon zest, grated | 1 package shiitake mushrooms, chopped | 1/2 cup beef broth ( optional ) | 1 can sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained and chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,french onion soup,corn,egg wrap,chili oil
title: Fiesta Egg Rolls
ingredients: 1 can french onion soup | 2 cans mild picante sauce | 15 egg roll wraps | 20 corn or 20 flour tortillas | chili oil
instructions: Mix soup and picante sauce together. Set aside. Wrap 6 corn tortillas in damp towel. Microwave 2 at a time on high until warm and pliable. Place a tablespoon of soup mixture on tortillas. Roll up and place seam side down in a large baking pan sprayed with sesame oil. Repeat until all 12 tortillas are filled and arranged. Pour picante sauce mixture over top. Cover with foil and bake at 325 for 20 minutes. Uncover and bake uncovered for 15 minutes.

title: Black Beans and Cherry Dessert
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups green pinto beans | 1 cup cold water, or as needed | 1 cup black beans ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon allspice
instructions: Place pinto beans in a large saucepan with the cold water, then cover and bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: steak,beef bouillon granule,white bread,turmeric powder,fennel bulb
title: Khbebi Tajine
ingredients: 1 cup fresh ground white bread | 1 lb lean steak | 2 tablespoons beef bouillon granules | 1 fennel bulb, chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons turmeric powder
instructions: Wash and cut the bread into chunks. Pound the steaks and fry them with the beef bouillon. Add fennel and turmeric powder. Keep for 2 - 3 hours in a refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,lemon peel,lobster tail,mint leaf,hoisin sauce
title: Lobster Stuffed Sole
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds fresh lobster tails | 1/2 pound salmon fillets | 1/2 cup hoisin sauce | 1 tablespoon finely grated lemon peel | 1/4 cup chopped fresh mint leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place lobster tails in a baking dish. Bake lobster in the preheated oven for 5 to 10 minutes, turning once. While shells are baking, melt hoisin sauce and lemon peel in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Remove lobster tails from oven, and cool slightly. Dip each shell into the hoisin sauce mixture to coat. Garnish with mint leaves, and serve.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,turmeric,xanthan gum,cilantro leaf,oil,dark soy sauce,asafoetida powder
title: Xanthan-Glazed Red Peppers
ingredients: 1 large red bell pepper | 2 teaspoons dark soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 2 teaspoons xanthan gum | 2 teaspoons agave nectar ( or other neutral tasting soy sauce ) | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro leaves, finely chopped ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1/4 teaspoon xanthan gum | oil, for frying
instructions: Wash and dry the bell pepper. Slice the stem from the pepper and remove the inner membranes to prevent the pepper from exploding. This will prevent the pepper from exploding if you put the peppers in your food processor. In a small bowl, mix together the soy sauce, dark soy sauce, 2 teaspoons of the turmeric, xanthan gum, agave and cilantro. Set aside. Heat the oil in a large, heavy skillet over medium high heat. When the oil is hot, add the ginger and 1 teaspoon of turmeric. Stir until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Add the bell pepper and continue to stir until the peppers are bright red in color and tender crisp, about five minutes. Remove from heat and stir the soy sauce mixture into the pan. Taste, and add more soy sauce if needed. Serve over cooked white rice. Note, sometimes i add grated raw carrots and/or cucumber. You can even add mushrooms and/or beans to the mix.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,limeade concentrate,red curry paste,cauliflower
title: Red Curry Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower ( spirals ) | 12 tablespoons sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 1/4 cup frozen limeade concentrate
instructions: Set oven to 300. Grease a 5 cup baking dish. Core cauliflower of any woody stem parts and cut into 8 florets. Spread all ingredients in baking dish and bake for 45 to 50 minutes. Serve with rice or noodles.

title: Healthy Broccoli and Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 head broccoli | 250 g low fat cottage cheese | 1 cup low-fat plain yogurt
instructions: Wash and boil the broccoli until cooked. Drain. Peel and boil the cottage cheese until creamy. Mix with the broccoli, add yogurt and stir until you get a thick, creamy consistency, or serve with warm baguettes.

Random Ingredients: ranch salad dressing,tabasco sauce,season salt,tomato sauce,date
title: Coco - Copycat from Cafe Central's Copycat Recipe
ingredients: 1/2 cup ranch salad dressing | 1 cup tomato sauce ( i prefer `` generic '' ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup date, chopped, from a jar | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce, spice | 1/2 teaspoon season-all salt
instructions: Combine all ingredients on low to maintain a low temperature. Refrigerate until needed. Note, i use a coffee cup so the temperature stays at low for all of the liquid to escape.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,pomegranate juice,lamb,white bread,fruit,cider vinegar
title: Fruit Lamb in a Coat
ingredients: 4 slices white bread | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 1 teaspoon dark brown sugar | 1 kg lamb, diced | 2 tablespoons pomegranate juice | fruit, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Mix pomegranate juice and cider vinegar together, making sure the sugar and brown sugar have dissolved. Soak the slices of white bread in this mixture, for about 5 minutes. Spread the slices of lamb on a tray, and place into a glass dish. Slice the soaked slices, and lay them on top of the lamb slices to cover the lamb. Drain the bread from the vinegar mixture. Cover the tray, and marinate overnight. Bring the meat to room temperature. Drain the meat and pour over the pomegranate juice marinade. Sprinkle the extra brown sugar over the meat. Put into preheated oven and cook for about 2 hours, or until the meat is cooked through and the bread is very lightly golden. Serve with thick slices of tomato and apple, if desired.

Random Ingredients: green,white bread,chicken thigh,pine nut,red chili pepper,garlic clove,phyllo pastry,yellow squash
title: Pastel De Phyllo (Chicken and Squash)
ingredients: 12 sheets phyllo pastry | 8 chicken thighs, bone in | 2 ounces pine nuts | 2 ounces diced pimentos-type red chili peppers | 1 garlic clove | 1 small yellow squash or 1 small zucchini, chopped into 3/4 chunks. | 4 tablespoons grated white bread or 4 tablespoons arabic bread, crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to brush a large baking sheet with oil or melted butter. Slice bread lengthwise into 12 strips. Place each strip on baking sheet. Bake 10 - 13 minutes or until golden brown and crisp. Meanwhile, in the food processor, mix nuts, chili peppers, garlic and squash. Process until mixture is finely chopped. Add remaining chopped vegetables and process 3 - 4 minutes or until smooth. Place half the chicken in a bowl and add bread crumbs. Mix until well blended. Spoon 1/2 the nut mixture onto a pastry strip. Fold one edge over to form a triangle and fold other one over to form a triangle. Roll up pastry tightly and place on baking sheet. Repeat steps 12 and 13 until all chicken has been used. Brush oven with oil while baking and top each servi with remaining nut mixture. Bake in the preheated oven for 10 minutes or until pastry is puffed up and browned.

title: Mushroom, Fennel, & Garlic Salad
ingredients: 2 large red pepper mushrooms, halved, caps sliced into ribbons | 2 large fennel bulbs, halved lengthwise, core remaining | 1 can sliced mushrooms | 1/4 cup salad oil | 1 cup picante sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 2 teaspoons crushed dried mushrooms, or to taste | 12 leaves arugula
instructions: Place mushrooms, fennel, oil, picante sauce, worcestershire sauce, and dried mushrooms in a salad bowl. Toss to combine. Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes or up to 2 hours. Just before serving, arrange arugula leaves on salad, toss with salad dressing, and serve.

title: Easy Microwave Chilli Vegetarian Refried Beans
ingredients: 2 ounces low-fat refried beans | 4 tablespoons chopped fresh coriander | 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 1 tablespoon icing sugar
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a microwave safe bowl and cook on top of the stove top for about 2 minutes or until heated through. Serve hot with indian breads.

title: Berbere Spread
ingredients: 1/3 cup browning sauce | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 teaspoon clove | 1/4 cup finely chopped coriander or 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh dill | 1 teaspoon tomato relish | 2 teaspoons berbere
instructions: Combine ingredients and mix well. Chill for 30 minutes before using. Serve with crackers or raw vegetables.

title: Simple White Bean Tacos - White Beans and Nests
ingredients: 2 cans navy beans, drained and rinsed | 1/4 cup salsa ( mild or medium ) | 1 lime, zest of
instructions: To make the beans in a bowl of your blender, pour 1/4 cup of salsa in the top of the can and swirl. Start layering the bean mixture starting with a can of drained navy beans, and ending with the rest of the salsa. To make the taco shells, dip a spoonful in cold water, drop in the bean mixture to coat and coat. Serve with corn chips and guacamole if desired.

Random Ingredients: kalamata olive,sea salt black pepper,worcestershire sauce,mushroom
title: Grilled Mushroom and Olive Tapenade
ingredients: 1/2 cup coarsely chopped fresh mushrooms | 1 pinch sea salt and freshly ground black pepper | 1/3 cup pitted kalamata olives, chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce
instructions: Combine mushrooms, salt, pepper and worcestershire sauce in a bowl. Spread into an 8 inch square piece of heavy duty aluminum foil. Top with olive oil and grill until hot and bubbly, about 5 minutes.

title: Chinese Pancakes With Strawberries and Sun Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 cups bok choy, chopped | 300 g raspberries, fresh or frozen | 3 hard-boiled eggs, chopped | sun-dried tomato packed in oil
instructions: Heat up oil in large non stick skillet. If pan is large enough to handle the 2 eggs put in 2 pancakes. Turn and fry the other side. Remove from pan and place in a bowl. Clean the pan, then place the bok choy in the pan over medium heat. Shake the pan a few times until the leaves are crispy. Cut up bok choy into bite sized pieces, place in bowl with bok choy. Break eggs into bowl, then add drained and chopped sun dried tomatoes. Stir egg mixture into egg mixture and then fry or grill the two pancakes together until both sides are cooked. Cut the two pancakes open to check the freshness of the egg mixture and then spread the top with a dollop of the egg mixture and place on plates.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon granule,nonstick cooking spray,ice cream,chunky salsa,bacon grease,caper,allspice
title: Jamaican Creamy Brazilian Dressing
ingredients: 1 teaspoon bacon grease | ice cream | 1 tablespoon capers, drained | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules, granules | 1 teaspoon allspice | 2 tablespoons chunky salsa | nonstick cooking spray
instructions: Place ice cream, capers and chicken bouillon granules in the container of a blender or food processor.

title: Fried Onions and Onions
ingredients: 4 large red onions, thinly sliced | cayenne pepper, or to taste
instructions: In a small mixing bowl, combine red onion slices and cayenne pepper. Fry onions on high in vegetable oil until golden brown, about 15 minutes.

title: Chipotle Coconut Adobo Snack
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups dry unsweetened coconut | 1 3/4 cups chipotle peppers in adobo sauce
instructions: Toast the dry coconut in the oven and when it is light golden brown, turn your oven on to 350 degrees. Spread the dry coconut on a cookie sheet and let it cool until slightly sticky. When it is cool, crumble the coconut with a fork in a food processor or with a mortar and pestle. Add the chipotle peppers from the can over the toast and stir well. Store in an airtight container.

title: Honeycomb Pizzas With Cherries
ingredients: 2 teaspoons sweet butter | 1 tablespoon rosemary needles, crushed | 5 ounces dried cherries, soaked until they are plump | 5 ounces dried cranberries, soaked until they are plump | 1 cup cranberry tea, cooled | 1 tablespoon margarine | 1/4 cup honeycomb candy, sliced | peppermint tea, for serving, warmed
instructions: Place the butter in a food processor or blender with the rosemary. Add the chopped cherries and dried cranberries and process until well mixed. Pour the cooled tea into a medium bowl and add the softened margarine and honeycomb. Cover and chill for 1 hour until ready to use. Dip the pizzas in the warm tea and allow to drain. Serve immediately. Garnish each pizzas with a mint tea sprig.

title: Cashews in a Creamy Mushroom Sauce
ingredients: 2 ounces cashews, roughly chopped | 15 ounces fresh mushrooms, cleaned, sliced and lightly rinsed | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | lettuce leaf, to serve
instructions: Melt the cashews in a medium saucepan over a moderate heat, stirring occasionally. Increase the heat if the cashews begin to darken, and continue to stir for about 4 minutes, then remove the pan from the heat. Combine the cashews, mushroom slices, cream of tartar and some salt and pepper in a blender, or in a food processor. Blend until smooth, and store in the refrigerator.

title: Green Olives
ingredients: 2 cups ripe green olives | 2 -4 anaheim chiles, seeded ( about 6 to 8 ounces ) | 2 tablespoons white sugar | 1/2 cup whiskey ( or scotch, or scotch all made in one or two days ) | 1 tablespoon fresh tarragon, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl. Stir very well. Cover and store in a refrigerator until needed.

Random Ingredients: plum tomato,cardamom,aromatic bitter,red potato,gouda cheese,allspice,golden raisin
title: Gouda Cheese & Raisin Salad
ingredients: 5 medium red potatoes, scrubbed and shredded | 3 ounces gouda cheese, finely grate ( about 4 ounces ) | 3 tablespoons golden raisins | 3 plum tomatoes, seeded and diced | 2 tablespoons aromatic bitters ( try hermit brand bitters and try chardonay ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom ( or try lavender ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Combine the gouda, raisins and tomatoes in a medium bowl. Whisk together the bitters, cardamom, allspice and vegetable oil. Pour the oil over the cheese mix and toss well. You can let sit for at least an hour before serving, it will absorb the flavors. My family likes them to color well, so feel free to let me know what you do ahead. Serve chilled.

title: Baked Spaghetti Roulades With Quinoa
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa ( whole grains ) | 2 medium carrots, grated | 1 hard-boiled egg, quartered | 2 tablespoons caraway seeds | 2 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil | 3 cups spaghetti sauce or 3 cups chicken broth
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°. Place quinoa in a colander and sprinkle the carrot pieces over the quinoa. Place under the broiler for two minutes. Place quinoa in a large bowl, add the egg, carraway seeds, and olive oil. Toss to coat well and place bowl on a baking sheet. Bake 50 to 55 minutes, stirring often. Remove pot from the oven and pour spaghetti sauce immediately, stirring to ensure there are no clumps. Serve immediately.

title: Potatoes With Prosciutto
ingredients: 6 small potatoes | 4 slices bacon, cooked, chopped | 4 teaspoons whole wheat germ | 1 cup button mushroom, chopped | 1/2 cup prosciutto, chopped, diced
instructions: Preheat broiler. Scrub potatoes, prick with a fork.

title: Cornmeal
ingredients: 2 cups cornmeal | 1/2 vanilla bean, split | 1 fennel seed | 1/4 cup anaheim chilies
instructions: Heat large pot on high heat with a lid placed so it doesn't burn and splatter. Place cornmeal powder, vanilla bean and fennel seed in separate small dish. Pour a bit of water in the pot into help dissolve. Turn heat down to medium and mix till dough starts to stick. At this point test the dough with a spoon to see if it is done. Do not over add water as it will become dry.. Turn heat to low and cover with lid.. Slightly press dough so it will rise slightly. Do not let top dry. Leave till dough is cool. Do not worry if dough doesn't rise but it will deflate as it cools. It is safe to make a hole in the crust if this happens. If dough begins to float, turn the heat down and stir once or twice. Leave till it cools and turn out on greased cookie sheet. Cut into squares or wedges. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: sauerkraut,plain yogurt,sesame oil,pork loin,garlic,tamari,tomato green chilies
title: Pork Lo Mein With Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 3/4 lb pork loin, cut into about 6 or 8 pieces ( ask butcher to slice into about 8 pieces ) | 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1/4 cup tamari | 3 cloves garlic, chopped | 1 medium tomatoes and green chilies, chopped | 1/2 cup sauerkraut, drained and rinsed | 3/4 teaspoon sesame oil
instructions: Season pork with salt and pepper. Mix together yogurt, tamari, garlic and chiles, and stir into the pork. Marinate the pork in the refrigerator for about an hour. Preheat grill or prepare a fire in an oiled grill pan, on high heat. Brush the pork with a little oil. Place the pork over close and close lid. Cook about 1 minute then turn and bake for another 3 - 5 minutes. Transfer to a warm platter. Serve with mustard and german style mustard. Dish should be eaten with sauerkraut as a dipping sauce.

title: Hot Smoked French Celery Ribs
ingredients: 4 celery ribs, in a single layer, with leaves attached
instructions: Preheat the grill or broiler. Brush the celery and loose any remaining fat. Grill or broil until tender.

title: Beer & Smoked Salmon Dip
ingredients: 2 cups beer, divided | 1 package of shredded velveeta cheese | 1 teaspoon onion salt | 1 can diced black olives, drained | 1 can sliced smoked salmon, drained
instructions: Heat 1/4 cup of the beer in a saucepan over medium heat until bubbles start to form around the edges. Add cheese, onion salt and black olives.

Random Ingredients: pizza crust,chili flake,butter,corn chip,beef tenderloin,sauce,parsnip,oregano leaf
title: Crock Pot Corned Beef Tenderloin Pizza
ingredients: 1 lb pizza crust, baked | 4 lbs beef tenderloin, with or without inygolds | 12 tablespoons unsalted butter | 2 1/2 - 3 teaspoons dried oregano leaves | 1 1/2 tablespoons hot sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili flakes | 1 1/2 lbs parsnips, peeled and cut into large chunks | 1/4 cup corn chips, toasted
instructions: Cut pastry into 10 equal squares. Set aside. Cut beef into thin slices and then into 1/2 pieces. Lay beef on pie crust squares and spread evenly with butter. Sprinkle beef with oregano, hot sauce, and chili flakes. Bake at 220 deg c for about 20 minutes, or according to package directions. Allow to cool slightly before serving. To serve, top each slice of pizza with a few parsnip chunks and a few chunks of beef.

Random Ingredients: green banana,tabasco sauce,peanut butter,chicken liver,vanilla sugar,pork baby back rib
title: Peanut Butter Pork Ribs With Banana & Green Banana
ingredients: 1 lb pork baby back ribs, membrane removed & cut into 4 ribs | 1 lb fresh green banana | 1/2 lb pork liver | 1 cup smooth peanut butter | 3/4 cup vanilla sugar | 1 dash tabasco sauce | powdered sugar ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: If using pork baby back ribs, remove excess fat& place in crock pot in order given. Cut up green bananas into wedges. Remove membrane from liver, cut into 1 chunks& place in crockpot. Chop 1/2 of each pork baby back rib, add to crock pot. Cut up 2 ribs, add to crockpot & toss well. If using fresh pork baby back ribs, place on cutting board, place between plastic wrap and gently pound with meat mallet until meat mallet holds its shape. You will probably have to work with your mallet during this phase. You can roll the mallet as you desire. Chop banana into about chunks& place in crockpot. Add 1/2 cup peanut butter and 1/4 cup of vanilla sugar. Mix well. Sprinkle tabasco sauce on top of pork baby back ribs & toss in peanut butter mixture. Cover and let rest for 10 minutes. Serve with a generous sprinkle of powdered sugar sprinkled on top.

title: Yummy Greek Skewers
ingredients: 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/4 cup pine nuts | 1/4 package feta cheese, cut into cubes | 12 skewers
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix tomato soup, oregano, pine nuts, feta cheese, and skewers. Cover, and chill in the refrigerator at least 30 minutes. Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat, and lightly oil the grate. Cook skewers until the cheese is melted, about 5 to 6 minutes.

title: Sydney Sunset (Hot and Spicy!)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice or 2 tablespoons lime juice | 1 tablespoon orange juice | 2 jalapeno | 2 tablespoons oil
instructions: Place the jalapenos on the bbq flat side first, then place the lemon/lime/orange juice and orange juice in a tea pot. Slice the jalapenos long ways, and place the pepper halves on the surface of the hot pepper halves. Cover loosely with a lid, and turn burner on. Boil for approximately 5 minutes, or until the pepper is soft and the peppers feel like they are roasted but not burnt. Place under the grill to blacken the top slightly, until the juices have turned deep red. This will cause some of the pepper to darken in color and taste. Remove the pan from the heat, and let the hot peppers cool for 10 minutes. Poke holes all over the pepper with a fork, and drizzle with the oil. Note, i usually roast this in the oven on the broiler setting for a couple minutes, watching the flame carefully, so as not to offend others, you take the pepper off the grill. Once the peppers are cool enough to handle, remove the meat carefully from the skin, which will take a few minutes. Cut the peppers in half, remove the seeds, and veins, then place in a large glass jar. Wash well in a sieve or colander, then fill up with boiling water until completely covered. Put the jar in the fridge for 2 - 3 days. After that, wash again in a sieve, drain again, and dry. Shake off the water, then store in a screw top jar or bottle for at least 3 months before using. Note, i prefer my peppers slightly charred, so as to not burn them, i use a torch to roast them, but you can decide how they do. I roast the peppers in a hot, dry pan with the peppers moving slightly, or you can grill in the oven on top of the coals, turning frequently, for a smokey, spicy flavor..

title: Artichoke Puffs
ingredients: 2 cans artichoke hearts, drained | 1 cup apple juice
instructions: In a medium bowl, mash the artichoke hearts with a fork. Stir in apple juice until a soft dough forms. Roll dough into a ball, and cut into 8 pieces. Place a dough piece, covered with a damp cloth, into each of the 8 tart pans. Spoon artichoke mixture into the crusts, leaving at least 1/2 inch of an inch around the edge. Roll dough from the edge of the dough, being careful not to break the crust. Bake in a 375 degree f oven until crust is puffed slightly, about 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Lime & Italian Holiday Trifle
ingredients: 4 ladyfingers ( each 6-8 inches long ) | 1 jar sliced pimientos, drained | 14 ounces frozen limeade concentrate, thawed | 1/4 cup italian seasoning
instructions: Split ladyfingers lengthwise and spread bottoms with canned concentrate. Sprinkle both sides of ladyfingers wiil they look dry. Arrange about 5 pimientos on top of ladyfingers in a 3 quart glass bowl. Cover with half the limeade. Sprinkle half the italian seasoning on top of the limeade. Repeat layers. Cover and refrigerate until serving.

title: Jalapeno Beans for Burritos
ingredients: 1 can butter beans ( do not drain ) | 1 package dry sloppy joe seasoning mix | 1 jalapeno chile pepper, seeded and minced
instructions: Open the beans and rinse thoroughly. In a saucepan, combine butter beans, sloppy joe mix, and minced chile. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for about 30 minutes, until the beans are tender and the jalapeno chile is very tender.

title: Souvlakia (Red Vinegar Sauce)
ingredients: 6 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 4 tablespoons of minced parsley or 4 tablespoons chopped cilantro
instructions: For the sauce, combine vinegar, parsley, and pepper in bowl. Whisk well. Add to saucepan and reduce heat. Let simmer over low heat for about 3 minutes before adding more. Cover and simmer for further 15 minutes. Serve with meat, baked potato, etc..

Random Ingredients: flour,baby bok choy,cooking oil,apricot preserve,chipotle chile,catsup,bean sprout,turkey sausage
title: Tropical Noodles (Beef or Pork)
ingredients: 2 slices turkey sausage | 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 2 packages baby bok choy, quartered | 1 can bean sprouts | 1/2 cup sweetened apricot preserves | 1/2 - 1 tablespoon catsup | 3 canned chipotle chiles, minced | flour, for coating
instructions: Brown italian sausages with the cooking oil. Add the cabbage, bean sprouts and 1/2 the apricot sauce. Turn them over until all are wilted. Cover and simmer for 2 minutes. Add chipotle chillies and remaining apricot sauce. Stir well and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: parmesan cheese,asiago cheese,chuck steak,tagliatelle pasta noodle,milk
title: Tagliatelle With Beef and Asiago Cheese
ingredients: 4 medium meaty chuck steaks | 9 ounces tagliatelle pasta noodles | 1 3/4 ounces asiago cheese, grated | milk | 3 ounces parmesan cheese, grated
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f/190°c or gas mark place meat and noodles in a baking dish and season with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Mix together the cheese and a little milk and spread on top. Cover with foil and bake for 45 mins or until cooked to your liking. Serve immediately.

title: Thai Peppered Vegetables
ingredients: 3 -4 tablespoons vegetable stock | 1 tablespoon lime gelatin ( i use penzey's golden circle jello-lime jelly or gello, but any gelatin flavour will do. ) | 1 tablespoon ground galangal | 1 parsnip, cut into small chunks | 1 green tomato, cut into small chunks
instructions: Combine all the ingredients. Place into a ziplock bag and keep in the refridgerator for up to 2 days.

title: Simple Vietnamese Spinach
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh spinach, rinsed | 2 tablespoons fish sauce
instructions: Place spinach in the container of a blender or food processor. Add fish sauce.

Random Ingredients: chilies,green olive,habanero pepper,cooking oil,whipping cream,pecorino romano cheese,asafoetida powder,enoki mushroom
title: Luscious Vegetarian Hamentashen
ingredients: 100 g asafoetida ( known as 'hing'in hindi ) | 10 slices fresh cheese ( known as feta, or any other cheese of your choice ) | 1/2 kg green olives ( known as pimento stuffed olives ) | 25 g grated pecorino romano cheese | 4 dried red chili peppers ( optional ) | 4 -5 small fresh anaheim chilies ( known as `` cumin '' in hindi, available in the asian food section of indian grocers ) | 200 ml whipping cream | cooking oil
instructions: Cut off one end of the asafoetida and keep piercing it with a sharp knife. Place 1/2 tspbs. Of the filling on one side of the asafoetida and 1/2 teaspoonbs. Fold over the filling and pinch well. Sprinkle cheese and chopped olives on top. Press edges firmly to compress the cheese. Heat oil in a skillet and deep fry the stuffed asafoetida in it till it turns to a golden brown colour. Remove from heat and drain on clean kitchen paper towels or absorbent paper towels. Slice the asafoetida into bite sized pieces. Serve hot with lemon wedges and green mixed vegetables. Enjoy.

title: Gluten-Free Aromatic Pecans for the Grill
ingredients: 1 bag pecans, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high. Combine pecans, soy sauce, vinegar, and garlic salt in a medium bowl. Place the pecan mixture in small saucepan over medium low heat.

title: Irish Cauliflower and Guinness draught
ingredients: 2 cups boiling chicken stock ( or other stock ) | 1 cup pearl barley | 1/2 cup quick-cooking oats | 2 cups chopped cauliflower florets | 1/2 cup light beer
instructions: Pour boiling stock on top of barley and oats. Let stand 10 minutes. Stir cauliflower into barley and return to pan. Add beer and stir gently until just incorporated. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: sea salt,cauliflower floret,cherry brandy,squid,arugula,yellow bell pepper
title: Sweet Penguins in a Pink Salt
ingredients: 1 can of whole prawns, peeled, deveined and chopped | 1 lb of small cauliflower florets, cut into thin spears | 1/2 lb yellow bell pepper, seeded, cut into thin strips | 3 bunches arugula | 1/2 cup cherries flavored brandy | sea salt
instructions: Place the prawns in a large bowl and dump in the cauliflower florets. Add the red bell peppers, arugula and cherries. Pour the brandy over all and stir gently to coat. Season with salt to taste. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes, or until the bell peppers and arugula start to wilt. This will make it easier for diners to stir the seafood if they like or if they like to eat them the next day.

title: Coconut-Salsa Ice Cream Concoction
ingredients: 2/3 cup thick & chunky salsa | 2/3 cup light whipped cream | 2/3 cup coconut cream | 2 tablespoons whipping cream
instructions: Combine sweetened condensed milk, cream and 3 tablespoons whipping cream in a 2 qt glass baking dish. Microwave on high for 1 - 2 minutes or until hot. Swirl around a few times while heating for 2 minutes or until warm but not bubbly. Stir in remaining ingredients. Chill until well chilled. Serve cold in a plastic container, covered, with plastic wrap pressed directly down onto surface of ice cream. Refrigerate for 3 hours or until firm.

Random Ingredients: half cream,cilantro stem,grapeseed oil,nut,vegetable oil cooking spray,green bell pepper
title: Roasted Pepper Puree(Vegan)
ingredients: 1 green bell pepper ( fresh, cut into 1-inch squares ) | 2 tablespoons grapeseed oil | 2 tablespoons half-and-half cream | 1/2 tablespoon cilantro stem, minced | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon salt-free vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 tablespoons nuts, roasted ground ( for garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Roast the bell pepper in the oven for 15 - 20 minutes or until crisp tender. Remove from oven. Cool slightly and cut into 1 1/2 cubes. Heat a small amount of oil in medium skillet. Add the pepper and cilantro. Saute for about 10 minutes, stirring occassionally. Cool slightly and pour into a bowl. Add the half and half, cheese and nuts to the pepper mixture. Mix thoroughly. Pour into a shallow casserole pan, sprinkle top with the raw nuts. Allow to cool completely..

title: Fried Rice With Bacon and Cream
ingredients: 2 slices bacon, cut into 3/4 inch pieces | 2 tablespoons oil | 1 1/3 cups uncooked rice, i use basmati, long grain | 2 1/4 cups chicken stock with 2 tb butter | 1 1/3 cups whipping cream
instructions: In a large deep frying pan, heat the bacon over medium heat. Pour in oil and swirl the pan. Cook till most of the bacon fat melts, about 10 minutes. Add the rice and stir till it turns golden brown, about 1 minute. Drain the rice evenly on paper towels. Stir stock into rice to yield 1 1/3 c liquid, if you wish. Heat till stock is absorbed. Stir in the bacon and cream. Serve immediately.

title: Irish Honeyed Pork and Broccoli
ingredients: 2 lbs extra lean boneless pork loin | fresh broccoli floret, ends trimmed and stalk cut into chunks | clear honey, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f place pork in a baking dish, add water to a depth of 2 1/2 1/2in and season. Cover and bake for 1½ hours or until the fat is fat and top is browned. Turn and bake for further 30 minutes or until cooked. Meanwhile, steam or steam broccoli in a large saucepan of boiling salted water for 3 - 4 minutes or until just tender, drain. Place pork, broccoli, honey and remaining 2 tbsp of honey in a heavy based frying pan over moderate heat and cook, stirring occasionally, for 2 - 3 minutes or until liquid is reduced and sauce syrupy. Pile onto serving plates and serve.

title: How to Make Liquid Breakfast!
ingredients: 3 tablespoons dry millet ( or barley ) | 1 tablespoon lime juice
instructions: Dissolve millet in lime juice and slowly add cold water, stirring well. Bring to a boil and simmer uncovered over medium low heat until liquid is boiled away from millet. Let cool at least 20 minutes and skim off any remaining foam. Strain through a fine mesh sieve or into a glass bowl. Refrigerate several hours until very cold.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,curd cottage cheese,sharp cheddar cheese,corn muffin mix,irish cream,saffron thread,asafoetida powder
title: Mashed Corn Pudding With Asafoetida(Mashed Cheese) Recipe
ingredients: 12 slices sharp cheddar cheese | 1 cup small curd cottage cheese | 1/2 teaspoon saffron threads | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 1/2 teaspoon saffron oil ( also known as canola oil ) | 1 package corn muffin mix
instructions: Place the block of corn muffin mix in a baking bowl and set aside. Drain the excess water from the cheddar cheese and reserve. Mash the cheese with an electric mixer. Add the cottage cheese and drained cream cheese and mix well to combine. Add saffron and asafoetida and mix well to combine and make sure all ingredients are well distributed. You can use a wooden spoon to incorporate all the cream cheese and asafoetida. Spread the mixture evenly throughout the prepared baking dish. Place a sheet of aluminum foil on a microwave safe plate. Place the baking sheet on the microwave, heat on high power for a maximum period of 2 minutes. Remove the baking sheet from the microwave and place the pan in a microwave safe bowl. Stir the cheese with a spoon occasionally until it is a smooth, creamy consistency. Spread the cheese evenly over the cooled corn bread mixture. Cover the baking sheet with a microwave safe cling wrap. Cover the baking sheet with a microwave safe plastic wrap. Microwave on high power for 4 minutes, or until the mixture is hot. Remove cheese bowl from microwave and place on a chopping board. Use a spoon to combine the asafoetida with the saffron threads and mix well. Spread the asafoetida mixture evenly over the hot corn bread mixture. Place the baking sheet in a microwave safe bowl. Microwave on high power for 4 minutes, or until the mixture is hot. Remove from microwave and place in a microwave safe bowl. Cover and microwave on high power for 2 minutes, or until the asafoetida mixture is hot, stirring the mixture occasionally. Allow the asafoetida mixture to cool, then cover and refrigerate it for at least 1/2 an hour before serving. After cooling, mix through a spoon or fork until well blended. Serve warm with a dollop of sour cream.

title: Mango Chutney Mussel
ingredients: 1/2 cup mango chutney, chopped ( or to taste ) | 1 cup peas, frozen | 2 medium carrots, peeled and cut into sticks | 1 cup baby spinach, rinsed and dried ( or 1 baby mixed sprouts ) | 1 - 1 1/2 lb mussels, cleaned and debearded ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon vinegar ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a glass mixing bowl. Marinate overnight or for 2 hours at room temperature, stirring occasionally. Note, do not skip this step. This chutney can be served at room temperature or refrigerated for later use.

title: Almond Brittle Loaf
ingredients: 2 lbs pork tenderloin | 1 jar mushrooms | 1 dash almond extract ( optional )
instructions: Clean pork, trimming any undesirable portions of fat. Put pork in medium sized bowl and cover with mushrooms. Add almond extract to mixture if desired. If using, sprinkle with white pepper to taste. Cover and refrigerate for 12 to 24 hours. Using a paring knife remove marinade prior to using the meat. If using, allow it to marinate a longer time. Meat will be dry when done. Using a fork, poke several holes in the meat with a fork, then place on pan. Using hands, pierce each loaf of pork, making sure the meat is no longer on the bone, then place on a parchment paper lined or wax paper lined baking sheet. Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Bake in hot oven 30 minutes or until internal temp reads 160 degrees. You may also baste with egg glaze during cooking of meat. Cool on the pan on a rack.

title: Tomato Halva
ingredients: 2 cups finely chopped plum tomatoes | 2 cups almond meal | 1 sprig fresh rosemary
instructions: Place the plum tomatoes on the top of a double thickness of cheesecloth in a cloth or muslin bag. Press down on them until they become completely covered with a towel. Place the bag under a stream of warm water for 2 minutes, this will stop the garlic from clumping. When you remove the bag, the tomatoes will be soft and the water inside them clear. This should take approximately one hour. Drain the tomatoes and discard the solids. Place the tomatoes in a blender with the almond meal and rosemary. Puree together for a few minutes until they are a smooth consistency. Pour through a sieve lined into a wide glass or ceramic dish or bowl to serve.

title: Chutney Spread
ingredients: 250 g chutney | 25 g chili paste
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill for 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,blueberry,beef cube,turnip,black eyed pea,black olive,vegetable,chestnut mushroom
title: Mushroom and Beef Broth
ingredients: 1 box beef cubes | 1 can sliced black olives and green beans, drained | 1 can chestnut mushrooms, drained | 1 can frozen mixed vegetables | 2 cups frozen baby carrots and turnips, cut into 3/4-inch pieces | 3 cups cold whipping cream | 1 can diced black olives | 1 package frozen blueberries
instructions: Place beef cubes in crockpot and lightly season with salt. Pour olive juice and onions over everything and stir to combine. Cook on high for 5 - 7 hours or low for 7 - 8 hours. Add vegetables, cream and olives and cook 5 - 10 minutes longer until vegetables are just tender. Stir in frozen blueberries about 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: green pea,ketjap manis,saltine cracker,italian salad dressing,beef sirloin,tabasco sauce,baking potato
title: Crispy Potato and Beef Fries
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs boneless beef top sirloin, cut in 3/4 inch strips | 1 teaspoon saltine crackers | 1/4 cup ketjap manis | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 12 12 large baking potatoes, scrubbed | 1 cup frozen green pea | 1/4 cup light italian salad dressing, low sodium
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Toss strips with chipotle adobo.

title: Simple Carrot Pudding
ingredients: 1 cup carrot, grated | 1/2 cup parmesan cheese, grated
instructions: Pour grated carrots and half of the grated swiss cheese into the bottom of a buttered oven proof serving dish. In a small bowl mix the remaining grated swiss cheese with the grated carrot. Sprinkle on top of the carrot. You may add more grated swiss cheese if desired. Bake the dish in a preheated oven at 200°c for 30 - 35 minutes.

Random Ingredients: mint leaf,season salt,malt vinegar,rhubarb,caster sugar,coffee,velveeta cheese
title: Grpa® Irish Grill Cheese
ingredients: 1 pint strong coffee | 500 500 g velveeta cheese or 500 g cheddar cheese | 1 small rhubarb | 2 tablespoons malt vinegar | 1 tablespoon maggi seasoning salt ( optional ) | fresh mint leaves, to garnish ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender. Process for approximately 1½ to 1½ minutes, stopping when cheese is very smooth and forms small mountains on the sides of the blender. Refrigerate until served garnished with fresh mint leaves if using. Serve chilled, or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: green olive,nutmeg,cream mushroom soup,italian breadcrumb,serrano chili,lasagna noodle,vegetable juice,tomato ketchup
title: Mashed Potatoes Santa Fe
ingredients: 1 lb lasagna noodle | 15 ounces tomato ketchup | 1 lb v8 vegetable juice | 1 teaspoon nutmeg | 2 green olives | 12 ounces sour cream and mushroom soup | 1 serrano chili | italian breadcrumbs
instructions: Cook lasagna noodles in boiling water until al dente. Drain then transfer noodles to bowl of ice water to stop the cooking. In a separate pot add in tomato ketchup, vegetables juice, nutmeg and serrano chilies chili. Cook over medium heat for two minutes. Take out a small ladle of tomato ketchup and put it in the pot. Put the noodles in the pot. Spoon in 1/2 cup of sour cream and 1/2 cup of italian style breadcrumbs. Cook over medium heat for 45 minutes or until the noodles are no longer 'al dente' and the cheese is bubbly.

title: Clam Fritters & Bread Crumbs
ingredients: for the filling : | 1/4 cup parsley flakes | 2 tablespoons sherry, or more as needed | for the sizzling : | 32 large littleneck clams, scrubbed and well-shucked | guacamole : | 2 cups dry breadcrumbs | for the rice : | 1/3 cup flaky breadcrumbs, or as needed | 2 1/2 cups cooked long-grain rice, or as needed
instructions: Combine 2 tablespoons chopped parsley flakes, 2 tablespoons sherry, and 2 tablespoons sherry in a bowl. Cover, and refrigerate until needed. Fill a large pot with water and bring the water to a rolling boil. Add clams and cook until barely opened, 3 to 5 minutes.

title: Quick French Bread
ingredients: 200 ml bread, stale | 3 teaspoons yeast | 2 packets bread, starter ( i use all-bread starter, but 5 tsp would be a healthier option too )
instructions: In a large bowl, mix the starter with the 3 teaspoons of bread starter. Dry the starter with a tea towel, then divide it into 3 equal sized portions. Toast the 4 portions of bread, about 5 minutes, then cool slightly and place the 2 portions on a cutting board with some bread rounds about 1/2 inch thick on the sides. Then flatten the rounds a bit on the top of the rounds, until as thin as bread. Warm the remaining portion of bread on the floor of your kitchen, so it takes some practice. Place the 3 loaves on a pizza pan or baking sheet, cut side up, and cover the breads with a clean tea towel. Let them rise 20 minutes, then let the second loaves bake until they reach the desired, dark brown color.. This gives them a golden brown look, but if your oven isn't preheated to 450 f, you might need to bake for 40 - 50 minutes, depending on the oven.

Random Ingredients: white rice,hot green chili pepper,italian sausage,virgin olive oil,marjoram,pie crust,saffron
title: Spicy Sausage Empanadas
ingredients: 1/2 lb sweet italian sausage, casings removed | 1 tablespoon virgin olive oil | 1 pinch saffron | 1 pinch marjoram | 2 cups cooked white rice | 1 dash finely chopped hot green chili pepper | 1 frozen pie crust, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. In skillet over medium heat, add sausage and saute until sausage is no longer pink, breaking into small bits when done. Set aside. In a saucepan, heat oil over medium heat. Add saffron, marjoram, rice and chilies. Cook until rice is creamy, about 3 - 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Remove sausage mixture from skillet. Roll out half of pastry to a 1 inch thickness. Using reamese cutter or sharp knife, cut circles to fit pie pan. Put half of the cooked sausage mixture in each circle, pressing edges firmly. Pinch the edges together with fingers, sealing with 1/2 a water. Place half of the pies in the deep casserole. Top with half of the rest of the sausage mixture. Cover with remaining pastry and pastry. Top with remaining sausage mixture. Bake 30 minutes. Remove from oven and serve.

title: Simple and Easy Chicken Fajitas
ingredients: 350 g cooked boneless skinless chicken breasts | 1 package low-fat lumpia skins | cayenne or other favorite hot spice ( to taste )
instructions: Place breasts in large bowl. Add spices of choice and mix together. Lay pheasant fingers on side in rows of 8 fingers. Roll up and place them in a large pan. Continue until all fingers are inside, placing a bed of coals on top. Cook fajitas over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: vegetable chicken stock,cremini mushroom,baby bok choy
title: Easy Mushroom Soup
ingredients: 2 cups vegetable or chicken stock | 15 ounces cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1 bunch baby bok choy, chopped
instructions: In a large pot, bring the vegetable or chicken stock to a simmer over medium high heat. Add the mushrooms and cook over medium heat until tender. Drain the mushrooms, discarding the liquid. Stir in the bok choy and heat until hot.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,turnip,mustard,dark beer,rice wine,canadian bacon
title: Smokin' Canadian Canadian Drunken Turnips
ingredients: 4 medium turnips, peeled and cubed | 1/2 lb canadian bacon, coarsely chopped ( or diced ) | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup dark beer | 1/2 cup rice wine | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard
instructions: Place the turnips into a 9x13 inch baking dish. In a medium sized bowl combine the cream of mushroom soup, dark beer, rice wine and mustard. Pour mixture over turnips and bake, uncovered for 2 minutes on 350 degrees. Turn mixture again and bake for an additional 1 minute to melt the mustard.

title: Cape Cod With Noodles
ingredients: 6 ounces milk chocolate chips | 1 lb kielbasa, cubed | 4 eggs
instructions: Combine milk chocolate chips and cubed polish kielbasa in a bowl. Dip kielbasa in egg, then back into chocolate mixture. Refrigerate covered for 3 - 24 hrs. Bake or steam in a covered pan at 375 degrees for 15 - 20 minutes. Top with your favourite kind of dip or fresh fruit as desired.

Random Ingredients: lime juice zest,tomato juice,green pepper ring,lemon,cardamom seed
title: Hot Tomato Chutney (Aka Vepdi)
ingredients: 10 ounces hot tomato juice ( vepdi brand ) | 3 ounces lemon rind ( or orange, if you don't like orange use lemon or orange rind ) | 2 ounces lime juice ( or lime ) | 1 lemon | 1 cardamom seed
instructions: Pour the tomato juice into blender with all ingredients and blend till smooth. Use as required.

title: Crispy Ricotta With Blueberry Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sunflower oil | 2 tablespoons superfine sugar | 3 tablespoons ricotta | 1 raspberries | 2 teaspoons lemon peel, finely shredded | 4 tablespoons light taco sauce
instructions: Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium to high heat. Slowly add the sugar, stirring. Stir until the sugar has dissolved. Add the ricotta and stir until all the ricotta has mixed in. Gently coat your hands in rice flour or water using a tablespoon, then add the raspberries to the pan. Season with a little salt & freshly ground ground pepper and stir together. Continue shaking the pan, adding the oil and stirring, until the ricotta is smooth and creamy. Transfer to a serving dish. Sprinkle with the lemon peel and taco sauce. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,tomato green chilies,orange juice,egg yolk,pineapple juice,red leaf lettuce,tapioca flour
title: Pineapple Infused Crema De Pina
ingredients: 1/2 lb pineapple - peeled, cored and diced small | 3 large egg yolks | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 2 tablespoons tomato and green chilies, chopped ( or to taste ) | 1 teaspoon tapioca flour | 2 tablespoons orange juice | 1 cup chopped red leaf lettuce
instructions: In medium bowl beat egg yolks until light and lemon colored. Mix in cream, chilies, and tapioca. Place yolk mixture in a small bowl. Sprinkle 1/4 cup cream mixture over cream mixture. Gently fold, then fold another 1/4 cup cream mixture in, stirring only after each addition until mixture is smooth. Add orange juice and continue to fold. Pour into a small bowl. Cover and refrigerate until very cold, at least 3 hours or overnight. Just before serving, garnish with red leaf lettuce.

Random Ingredients: double cream,chicken,self raising flour,red chili paste,red potato,vanilla
title: Cornflour Free Chicken
ingredients: 1 kg chicken | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1/4 cup double cream | 3 1/2 ounces red potatoes | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1/4 cup red chili paste | 4 teaspoons self-raising flour
instructions: Mix the vanilla with 1/4 cup of cream and blend into the double cream. Slice the chicken into pieces of about 1 1/2cm thick. Pour some of the cream and cream mixture into a small baking tray and place chicken pieces in it on high oven shelf. Bake 20 - 25 minutes until the chicken is a nice golden brown and cooked through. While the chicken is cooking, boil the potatoes for about 10 mins drain. In a big bowl, mix the red potatoes with the sugar, salt and pepper and then stir in the vanilla and cream. When the chicken is done, place on top of the potatoes and mix with tongs. Put back in the oven and bake for about 25 - 30 mins until the potatoes are golden brown. Meanwhile heat the butter on the stove until melted, add the chile paste and stir until fragrant and aromatic. Take the chicken out of the oven, take out potatoes and add the roasted red chilly paste and the flour. Mix the flour into the pan, stirring constantly until the mixture comes together.

title: Simple Fried Green Chile Chips
ingredients: 1 green chilies | 1 chipotle pepper, or more to taste -- minced, seeded, and seeded | 1 tablespoon canola oil, or as needed
instructions: Grill chile peppers on a cast iron skillet until skin is blackened, about 10 minutes per side. Place chile peppers into a cloth to loosen the skins. Heat canola oil in a skillet over medium heat. Cook chile peppers in hot oil until tender and beginning to soften, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: salsa,red curry paste,cooking spray,coriander seed,chicken broth,marinade
title: Kevin's Thai Chicken
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 2 tablespoons chopped marinated chicken broth | 1 -2 teaspoon coriander seed, crushed | cooking spray | 1 tablespoon salsa ( preferably sweetened ) | 1 tablespoon low sodium soy sauce
instructions: Place ingredients in a large non stick pan and bring to the boil, whisking to mix, over high heat. Reduce heat to medium and cook, covered, stirring often with a flat spoon, until the sauce is reduced and the chicken is cooked, about ten minutes. Serve immediately with white rice.

title: Tasted Sunflower Seeds Tomato Spread
ingredients: 1/2 cup sunflower seeds | 1 teaspoon sunflower seed oil | 3 tablespoons tomato paste | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 sprig thai basil, to garnish
instructions: Toast the sunflower seeds in a dry frypan until golden. Remove from heat and leave to cool. Place in a blender along with the oil, tomato paste and cream of tartar. Blend until smooth. Transfer to your serving bowl. Garnish with basil.

title: Crock Pot Cebiche (Lamb Fricot)
ingredients: 2 lbs lean lamb, cut in 1-inch cubes | 1 tablespoon finely minced garlic | 3 canned chipotle chiles | 1 cup chopped fresh escarole ( or any combination of different leafy greens ) | 1 serrano pepper, seeded, deveined and minced | 1/2 cup white wine | 1 banana, cut into 3/4-inch cubes
instructions: Place the lamb in the bottom of a greased crock pot. Top with garlic, chipotle, escarole, serrano pepper and wine. Cover and cook on high for 8 hours,. Stir in the banana about 45 minutes before cooking is done. Serve on italian hoagies.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,mint sprig,catsup,beef stew meat,onion soup mix
title: Crock Pot Sweet and Sour Beef for Two
ingredients: 3/4 cup catsup | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 2 lbs beef stew meat | 4 tablespoons heavy whipping cream | fresh mint sprig ( to garnish )
instructions: Combine the catsup and onion soup mix. Place beef in the bottom of a 5 - 5 quart crock pot. Pour catsup mixture over the beef. Sprinkle evenly with cream. Cover and cook on low 9 to 10 hours but no longer than 6 hours. Uncover and sprinkle with mint.

title: Warm Sausage, Mushrooms & Hot Italian Sausages.
ingredients: 7 -8 links hot italian sausage | 8 cups button mushrooms, cleaned and cut in half | white pepper, to taste
instructions: Cut a slit in the tops of the sausages.

title: Hot Samosas
ingredients: 2 lbs habanero peppers | 2 ounces jalapeno slices | 1 ounce habanero pepper | 1/2 ounce ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 teaspoon allspice | 12 ounces beer | 1 tablespoon jam ( optional )
instructions: Clean habanero peppers, wash thoroughly, slit peppers crosswise, remove seeds and membrane, discard stem and veins, and scrape out the seeds and membrane, if you do not like spicy food. Place habanero peppers, jalapeno slices, habanero pepper, ginger garlic paste, and allspice in a deep heavy pot. Pour beer over all. Stir and bring mixture to boil. Lower heat and simmer covered 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, adjusting heat as needed to prevent burning. While mixture simmers, make samosas, in a bowl mix jam with 2 teaspoons water to make a slightly runny thick paste. When samosas are simmered, warm them in the liquid for 2 to 3 minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: beef broth,green chile pepper,flat leaf parsley,orange zest,vegetable,lemon zest,dinner,black tea
title: Spicy Party Soup
ingredients: 12 cups beef broth, warmed | 2 green chile peppers, diced | 2 oranges, zest of | 2 lemons, zest of | 1/2 cup flat leaf parsley, chopped | 2 packages frozen mixed vegetables, cut into pieces | 12 fresh dinner rolls, halved | black tea, warmed, to serve
instructions: Combine the beef broth, chile peppers, orange zest, lemons, and parsley in a large pan. Bring to the boil over high heat.

Random Ingredients: russet potato,liquid smoke,taco seasoning,cannellini bean,vanilla,oat,beef tenderloin,pasta shell
title: Tostones #RSC
ingredients: 4 beef tenderloin | 1 lb russet potato, peeled | 12 ounces cannellini beans, rinse and drained | 1 1/4 ounces taco seasoning | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke ( optional ) | 0.5 package old fashioned oats | 3/4 cup small shell pasta shells | to taste tres la famiglia sour cream or to taste your favorite taco-flavored pasta sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f and grease a 6 quart or larger, cast iron or other heavy bottomed nonstick ovenproof skillet. Slice the steaks diagonally in 1/4 inch thick strips. Cut russets potato into 1/8 inch wide, 12 inch cubes and place in a large, nonreactive bowl. Cut the beans into small pieces and put in bowl with steak. In a small bowl or small jar, whisk the taco seasoning and liquid smoke. Set aside. Add the oats and stir to blend. In a large, heavy skillet, heat 1 tbs. Oil over medium high heat until shimmering. When the oil shimmers, add 1/2 the bean mixture in a single layer, spacing evenly. Cook, moving the beans around with a spatula, until the meat just begins to brown, approximately 8 minutes. Reduce the heat to medium and toss in the remaining bean mixture, the potatoes and the rest of the beans. Cook, breaking up any large clumps, until the meat begins to brown, approximately 8 minutes more. Transfer the steak to a plate and tent loosely with foil. Repeat with the remaining beef. Towards the end of cooking, reheat the skillet over medium heat, adding the remaining tbs. Oil if needed. Transfer the steak to a plate and tent loosely with foil. Remove all but 1 tbs. Of the oil from the skillet, wipe out the skillet with paper towels and then return the skillet with the steak to the stove top and cook on med. High heat until the bottom begins to dry out, about 2 minutes. Place a large serving plate on top of the skillet. Carefully add the steaks and vegetables.

Random Ingredients: honey,grain white rice,grainy mustard,bean sprout,apricot jam,triple sec
title: Rice and Apricots
ingredients: 1 lb long-grain white rice, washed and picked over | 4 1/2 - 5 1/2 cups water | 2 teaspoons coarse grainy mustard | 1/4 cup apricot jam | 8 ounces dried apricot sprouts | 2 teaspoons honey
instructions: Bring rice and water to boil in 3 quart saucepan. Cover and simmer over low heat 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand 3 minutes or until the grains are tender. Stir in mustard, apricots, and honey. Cover and chill 4 hours or overnight. Remove the rice mixture from the heat, stir rice and spoon into a shallow 2 inch non metallic baking pan. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate several hours or overnight. Remove plastic wrap and place a heavy ovenproof nonreactive dinner plate or pan on top of the rice. Set aside. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Cook rice over low heat until dry and begins to steam, about 15 minutes or until the rice is tender. Fluff rice with fork and serve.

Random Ingredients: spanish onion,green cardamom pod,cornstarch,kiwi,broccoli floret,beef chuck steak,flat leaf italian parsley,beef chuck
title: Beef Kebabs and Kiwi With Fresh Broccoli - Kormel
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef chuck steaks | 4 ounces kerrygold irish gold beef steaks | 1/2 lb broccoli floret | 1/2 lb spanish onion, halved and quartered | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon cornstarch ( i use 2 t & 1 c ) | 6 -8 green cardamom pods, split in half | 1 tablespoon flat leaf italian parsley, chopped | 2 kiwi, peeled, halved lengthwise, and seeded
instructions: Cut beef steaks crosswise into 1/2 inch wide strips on cutting board. Rinse and drain beef well. Trim thick layer of all visible fat from beef strips, then cut strips crosswise into 1/4 inch wide sticks. Soak, steam, or microwave onions to tender crispness. Cut beans crosswise into 1/8 inch thick slices and steam or microwave as directed above, until crisp. Rinse and drain broccoli florets. Cut broccoli crosswise into 1/8 inch thick slices. Chop kielbasa into 1/4 inch wide strips. Place 1 beef steak strip and 1 kerrygold irish gold steak strip in a large bowl. Drain beef and steak strips on paper towels, patting to remove excess fat. Thread beef and steak strips onto individual skewers. Place 1 beef steak strip and 1 broccoli floret spear on each skewer. Arrange green cardamom pods on each skewer and top with remaining kielbasa and sauteed vegetables. Set aside. Meanwhile, combine cornstarch and green cardamom pods in 1 quart saucepan and cook over moderate heat, stirring, until thickened and bubbling. Remove from heat and stir in parsley and kiwi. Brush sauce over kebabs.

title: Potato Romanoff
ingredients: 2 lbs baby potatoes ( about 2 medium ) | 1 cup ricotta cheese | 1/4 cup neufchatel cheese | 4 tablespoons chopped fresh tarragon | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh tarragon ( or 1 teaspoon dried ) | 1/2 teaspoon pepper | 12 slices thinly sliced prosciutto ( or more ) | 1 can 98 % fat-free cream of mushroom soup
instructions: In a large pot, cover potatoes with water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer until tender, about 1 hour. Drain and set aside. In a large bowl, mix together ricotta cheese, neufchatel cheese, tarragon, 1/2 tarragon, pepper, and mushroom soup. Preheat broiler. Place potatoes in a 9x13 inch baking dish, and spread cheese mixture evenly on top. Broil until heated through, about 1 1/2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: honey mustard,garlic salt,vanilla essence,alfalfa sprout,black pepper
title: Roasted Baby Greens With Vanilla, Mustard, Honey
ingredients: 1 lb fresh alfalfa sprout | 1 tablespoon honey mustard | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and spray with nonstick cooking spray. Place sprouts on baking sheet. Mix remaining ingredients in a small baking dish. Brush all over sprouts, then pour over the marinade. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes or until wilted. Remove from oven and serve.

title: Turnip and Olive Gratin
ingredients: 6 medium turnips | 350 g icing sugar | 2 -3 oranges | lemon zest, finely grated | 20 g green olives, stoned and chopped | 18 slices rye bread
instructions: Peel, and grate turnips and place in a small saucepan with 250ml water. Bring to the boil and simmer for 10 minutes until just tender. Drain, then cool completely. Whip icing sugar until light and fluffy. Add juice from two oranges and zest, then beat again until combined. Place slices of bread on a work surface, then pile the turnip and olive mixture onto them. Starting from each end, roll each slice to form a log. Place into a lightly greased and lined ovenproof dish and sprinkle with olives. Bake in a preheated oven at 190c / 375f for about 30 minutes or until golden.

title: Rosemary Corn Muffins
ingredients: 1 box corn muffin mix | 1/2 cup dried rosemary leaves
instructions: Mix in a 2 1/2 pint molding dish. Place molding dish on a cookie sheet. Sprinkle rosemary on mold. Bake in a 350 degree f oven for 8 to 10 minutes. Let cool on cookie sheet for 2 minutes before unmolding onto serving plate.

Random Ingredients: corn kernel,wild rice,yellow pepper,salt black pepper,sea scallop,fennel bulb,clam
title: Scallop Soup
ingredients: 2 cups frozen corn kernels, thawed | 5/8 cup thawed wild rice | 4 lbs fresh clams, scrubbed, frenches and shucked | 1/2 cup chopped fennel bulb | 1 whole yellow pepper, cut into very thin strips | chopped salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: To prepare soup, place corn kernels and rice in a 6 to 8 quart pot. Add the clams and fennel.

title: Portuguese Kidney Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans | 1 tablespoon anchovy paste | 3 teaspoons french thyme, crushed
instructions: Mash the drained kidney beans with the anchovy paste. Add 1 tsp to the mashed beans, it is not necessary. Add the thyme as desired. Serve immediately.

title: Green Beans & Green Beans (Coconut Baked in Coconut)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs green beans, sliced | 1/2 cup sweetened flaked coconut ( or regular coconut if you prefer )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Boil green beans until crisp tender, about 4 minutes. While waiting for the beans to cook, mix the coconut with a little water to make a slurry about 2 minutes or so. Rinse/drain beans and place in a casserole dish. Sprinkle generously with coconut. Return to oven for about 5 minutes until coconut is golden.

title: Baked Green Pea Soup
ingredients: 1 cup fresh green peas, shelled | 6 cups good quality chicken broth | 1 tablespoon brown mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh chives | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh chives | 1/2 tablespoon apple cider
instructions: Heat oven to 300°f degrees. Combine peas, chicken broth, mustard seed and chopped chives. Cover with foil or parchment paper and bake 25 to 30 minutes, until peas are soft. Serve.

Random Ingredients: mustard,chicken stock,queso fresco,orange bell pepper,crabmeat,kalamata olive
title: Kosher Crab Cakes
ingredients: 1 can crabmeat, drained | 2/3 cup queso fresco | 2 tablespoons mustard | 3 tablespoons kalamata olives, chopped | 2/3 orange bell pepper, chopped | 3/4 cup chicken stock
instructions: In food processor, combine crab, cheese, mustard and olives. Process until mixture resembles coarse meal. Add stock. Stir until smooth. Season with salt and pepper. Form 12 patties out of the crab, 1/8 inch thick. Spray 12 nonstick skillet with cooking oil. Heat over medium high heat until hot. Place the patties in skillet. Cook 6 to 7 minutes per side or until lightly browned.

title: Greek Kale Salad
ingredients: 1 bunch kale | 1/2 cup kalamata olives, pitted
instructions: Place kale on a serving plate. Sprinkle with olives. Crumble over 1 tablespoon of minced orange peel.

Random Ingredients: shortening,raisin,red bell pepper,seasoning salt,liquid smoke,curry powder
title: Caribbean Curried Raisins
ingredients: 4 cups raisins ( i used craisins ) | 1/2 - 3/4 cup shortening | 3 tablespoons curry powder | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | red bell pepper, chopped ( i used red bell pepper ) | 1 package liquid smoke, divided ( i used knorr brand )
instructions: Drain raisins. Place raisins, shortening, curry powder, seasoned salt, and bell pepper in a deep skillet. Over medium high heat, heat up the liquid smoke until it begins to smoke. Immediately, add raisins.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,cheese,ice water,baby carrot,golden syrup,rosemary leaf
title: Caramelized Rosemary Carrot and Pepper Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs baby carrots | 3/4 lb baby bell pepper | 6 ounces cheese, in the block or 6 ounces goat cheese | 4 tablespoons golden syrup ( can use low-sodium maple syrup if you don't like any! ) | 3/4 cup ice water | 1 tablespoon rosemary leaf
instructions: Peel carrots and slice into rounds 1/4 thick. Combine with peppers in a large bowl. Cube cheese to make bite size pieces. Mix cheese with sugar, syrup and ice. Add rosemary. Chill completely before serving.

Random Ingredients: brown rice,orange juice,vanilla,herring fillet,salt pepper,tomato juice,orange zest
title: Sauce-Braised Herring
ingredients: 5 pounds fresh herring fillets | 1 bottle tomato juice, about 2 ( optional ) | 1 can whole peeled tomatoes with juice, crushed | 1 tablespoon orange zest, minced | 1 1/2 tablespoons orange zest, minced | 1/4 cup brown rice | 1 tablespoon salt and pepper to taste | 1 cup orange juice, or as needed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Arrange the herring fillets in a roasting pan and pour tomato juice over the fish.

title: Pueblo Beans
ingredients: 1/2 lb dried red beans, rinsed and picked over | 1 small green chili peppers, chopped or 1 teaspoon dried chile flakes
instructions: Combine the beans and liquid in a saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Cover and cook, stirring often, until tender, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Transfer the beans and liquid to a large serving bowl. Add the chile pepper and stir to coat. Let stand until ready to serve.

title: Homemade English Pickled Onions (Junkar)
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh onions ( about 2/3s. ) | 1 1/4 cups mashes green onions ( scallions ) | 5 cups water | 2 -3 tablespoons malt vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f place onions in a small roasting pan or jelly roll pan that has been coated with cooking spray. Drizzle with vinegar. Bake until onions are very tender, about 30 minutes. Pour remaining vinegar over onions and place roasting pan into oven. Roast until onions are very dry and beginning to pick up brown color, 20 to 30 minutes. Cool onions and transfer to sterile jars. Pour 1 cup boiling water into jars, removing any air bubbles. Store in a cool, dark place for up to one year.

Random Ingredients: red onion,tahini,grapefruit juice,yogurt,dark sesame oil,chick pea,romaine lettuce,palm sugar
title: Shish Kebab Salad
ingredients: 1 bag romaine lettuce, washed ( or other lettuce ) | 1 cup frozen grapesfruit juice ( or can ) | 1 cup dry roasted peanuts, finely chopped or 1 cup cashews | 2 tablespoons tahini | 1/3 cup palm sugar, grated ( or other light/nutty part of your choice ) | 1/3 cup dark sesame oil | 1/3 cup red onion, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil
instructions: Toss salad ingredients together and cover, refrigerate for 4 hours or overnight. Serve in a bowl with lettuce leaves.

title: Rutabaga and Crab Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb rutabaga, peeled, cubed | 1 package fresh shell pasta, dry | 3 -4 drops chili paste with garlic
instructions: In a large pot of boiling, salted water, cook rutabaga until tender, but still firm, about 15 minutes. Drain well. In a medium saucepan, cook crab in hot water until just tender, about 1 minute. Drain well, and return to the pot. Add pasta and hot chili paste, and toss mixture well. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: bread flour,chicken wing,apricot jam,almond meal,pesto sauce,eggplant,fenugreek seed,pimento pepper
title: Roasted Wings and Almond Paste
ingredients: 1 large eggplant ( yellow or green ) | salt or pepper ( to taste ) | 1/4 cup bread flour | 1/2 cup pimento pepper ( sliced into strips ) | 3 tablespoons almond meal | 1 cup almond meal ( whole almond, coarsely chopped ) | 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce | leftover roasted chicken wings ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f wash eggplant well and cut into quarters lengthwise. Sprinkle liberally with salt and pepper. Pierce several slits in the skin all over and add to oven. Roast for 45 minutes, until tender and a bit crisp. Allow to cool, then peel and break into pieces. Make almond paste in blender or processor. You will need 1/4 cup each almonds, pesto, and fenugreek. The mixture will begin to cling and cling while baking, so be very careful, as almond paste tends to stick. If this does happen, add a little bit more almonds, pesto, or fenugreek powder. Remove skin from eggplant and cut into pieces. Put eggplant and pimento strips on cookie sheet and bake in oven for 15 - 20 minutes until golden brown. While this ovens, mix all coating ingredients in a medium bowl. Spread almond paste on the baked eggplant pieces before serving. The almond paste will swell just a bit and be nice and creamy. Serve with the chicken wings for dipping.

title: Irish Whiskey Cream
ingredients: 1/2 cup half-and-half | 2 tablespoons brandy, preferably irish, or to taste | 3 tablespoons irish whiskey | 1/2 cup toasted shelled pistachio nuts, chopped
instructions: In a small bowl, stir half and half, brandy, and whiskey together until combined.

title: Ginger Fruit Jam
ingredients: 1 quart blackberry syrup ( or any other jam ) | 2 inches ginger-garlic paste | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | ground cardamom
instructions: First make the syrup. Bring all ingredients to boil over medium heat, stirring regularly to avoid sticking.. Boil briskly until thick, remove and place in ice cream buckets or other container. Freeze. Once ready to use, remove from freezer, and store in freezer for up to 2 weeks. Note 1, this can also be frozen. Once frozen add the cream of tartar to jam, and stir until well mixed. Do not puree the jam but mix in a mixer, this will loosen it a little and add more of your favourite syrup. Note 2 if you have a jam jar, add more of the cream of tartar to the cream of tartar. If not, use ice cream scoop and remove the carton of cream that covers the top of the jar. Store in refrigerator for up to 3 months.

title: Apple and Blueberry Parfait
ingredients: 1 gala apples | 1/4 cup orange juice | 1 1/2 cups fresh blueberries, washed and drained | 2 tablespoons fresh cream | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 3 tablespoons rolled oats
instructions: Wash, core and grate apples. Combine apples with orange juice and apple mixture in a medium bowl and mix together gently. Chill well. Stir berries lightly in the cream. Combine turmeric powder and oats. Sprinkle spice mix over fruit, mix well. Place mixture in a well oiled 3 quart casserole or dish. Sprinkle with oats. Bake at 180ºc, uncovered, for 30 to 35 minutes, until well heated and starting to brown around the edge.

title: Mexican Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1 lb chicken wings | 1 1/2 cups salsa | 1 cup cremini mushroom, sliced | 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 12 ounces chopped fresh parsnips
instructions: Cut chicken wings from the wingbone joint.

Random Ingredients: kalamata olive,cardamom,oyster sauce,paprika,vinegar,white wine,water chestnut,stock cube
title: Kalamata Olive Tapenade
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups kalamata olives or 1 1/2 cups similar fine olives | 1/2 - 3/4 cup light stock cube | 1/2 cup white wine | 1/2 cup water chestnut | 1/2 cup water | 1/2 teaspoon paprika | 2 teaspoons oyster sauce | 1 teaspoon vinegar | 2 teaspoons cardamoms ( optional )
instructions: Drain the olives and add to food processor to finely grind. Add water chestnuts and puree. Add all ingredients, except paprika, and process till smooth. Add paprika now if using, if not using at this point use in another dish. Serve over bread or pita. Great cold or warm.

title: Chinese-Lemon Beef Wraps
ingredients: 1 lb fresh beef stew meat | 4 slices prosciutto or 4 slices deli ham | 1/2 lemons or 3 lemons, juice of | 1 medium onion powder | 1/2 small chinese cabbage, cut into 8 wedges
instructions: Cut meat into thin strips, and cut each slice into 4 wedges. Place on a serving platter with prosciutto or ham and a little lemon juice. Sprinkle onion powder on meat wedges and serve with sliced cabbage and more lemon juice.

title: Australian Chilli Puffs
ingredients: 4 sheets puff pastry | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 2 tablespoons lemon zest | 1/4 cup cocoa | 1/8 teaspoon chili flakes | 2 tablespoons dried pecans ( or almonds ) | 1 1/4 cups chopped frozen yve
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees celsius. Combine chilli flakes, zest, cocoa and chilli flakes in a bowl. In a bowl, combine ketchup, zest, pecans. Stir mixture into dry ingredients with a fork. Cut the pastry sheets in half lengthways and roll each half up like a swiss roll. Place pastry into a lightly greased & floured baking tray and prick dough all over with a fork. Bake on top of preheated oven for approx 45 mins until golden.

Random Ingredients: scallion,bay seasoning,kalamata olive,simple syrup,lemon,cayenne pepper,white balsamic vinegar
title: Lebanese Barbecue Bites
ingredients: 4 scallions, coarsely chopped | 1/2 - 1 lemon, juice of, grated rind of | 1 bay seasoning, crumbled ( i use mccormick's montreal brand ) | 1/4 cup good white balsamic vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper ( or season salt to taste ) | 1/2 cup kalamata olive, pitted | 2 tablespoons simple syrup
instructions: Combine the scallions, lemon rind and juice, and seasonings in a large bowl. Drain the olives, keeping them whole. Stir well. Toss with the marinade and chill for 30 minutes to an hour. Grill the barbecue over low heat for 10 - 15 minutes. Stir and adjust the salt if desired, brush with the syrup and serve.

Random Ingredients: fast rising yeast,ricotta cheese,pumpkin puree,clear honey,canola oil,baking powder
title: Baked Pumpkin Loaf
ingredients: 2 cups pumpkin puree | 1 cup low-fat ricotta cheese | 4 teaspoons baking powder | 1 tablespoon clear honey | 1 1/2 teaspoons fast rising yeast ( see note ) | 1 tablespoon canola oil
instructions: Dissolve yeast in the 1 t water. Stir in 1 t of canola oil. Stir in pumpkin, ricotta, remaining 1 t of oil and honey. Mix well. Turn into a generously greased deep bowl, turning to coat. Cover and set aside in a warm place at warm temperature until doubled in bulk, about 1 hour. Brush the top of the loaf with water and sprinkle with baking powder. Bake at 425f for 35 - 45 minutes or until a knife inserted comes out clean. Remove from oven and cool on a wire rack. This loaf can be frozen.

title: Rice & Lychees with Black Olives (Arroz a la Huancaina)
ingredients: 1 package glutinous rice | 3 cups frozen peas and pea pods | 3/4 cup chopped black olives | 1/4 cup finely chopped squash | 3 cloves garlic, minced | freshly made topping, prepared with a little olive oil and balsamic vinegar | 1 package frozen whipped topping, thawed - divided
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. When water reaches a boil, stir in the rice. Turn heat to low and cover, just a minute or two. Cook until the lid is firm and the rice can be fluffed with a fork, about 30 minutes. Drain the rice through a colander into a bowl, and allow to cool for at least 10 minutes. Meanwhile, rinse the peas under cold water. Cut the ends from the peas, and scrape out the strings with a spoon. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil, and cook the peas for 3 - 4 minutes. Drain, and pour into the bowl of chilled rice. Rinse and drain the peas again. Place the peas into a medium bowl. Place the black olives, squash, garlic, and about 1/4 cup of the sliced olives in a food processor. Pulse until finely minced. Remove 1/2 cup of frozen whipped topping, and stir into rice mixture. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a casserole dish with 1/3 of the frozen whipped topping. Place a layer of rice on top. Pour the vegetable mixture on top, and spread evenly in an even layer. Spread the remaining whipped topping on top. Sprinkle on the remaining sliced olives. Cover with the remaining 1/3 of the frozen whipped topping and continue layering the rice, peas, shrimp, scallops or beans. Cover the dish with aluminum foil, and bake 45 minutes 45 minutes. Uncover, and continue baking for 15 minutes. Remove foil, and bake 10 minutes more.

title: Coconut Milk Delight
ingredients: 1 cup coconut milk | 200 g vermicelli | 1 tablespoon corn oil
instructions: Heat coconut oil in a deep pan or wok. Add vermicelli and fry well. Remove from heat. Add coconut milk in a steady stream. Add the cooked vermicelli to the coconut milk and continue cooking till the sauce becomes thick. Serve hot.

title: Soup Macaroni Salad
ingredients: 200 g tostado ground macaroni or 200 g elbow macaroni | 150 -400 g shiitake mushrooms | 1 hard egg ( optional ) | 100 g topping | chili oil, to taste | 1/4 cup bread, toasted
instructions: Cook the macaroni or pasta in a boiling water on medium heat, drain, and let cool completely. Break the mushrooms up and fry them in a frying pan, adding a few drops of oil to flavour them. When the cooked macaroni is cool, break into chunks and add to the mushrooms, breaking up the pieces with a spoon as you go. Break off any clumps, chop the egg into small pieces and add to the soup. Mix together until the soup is mixed well. Chill the soup in the fridge or serve at room temperature. Sprinkle some topping, like shredded cheddar or paprika, on top and serve with a sprinkling of chili oil on top.

Random Ingredients: turkey breast,beef steak,white bread,baby green,honey,white bean,kernel corn
title: Holiday Turkey Sandwich
ingredients: 2 turkey breast | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 1 can white beans, rinsed and drained | 2 tablespoons honey | 2 pieces white bread | 1 bag mixed baby greens | 1 package baby mixed vegetables with red onion, halved lengthwise
instructions: Place turkey breast in a 1 1/2 to 2 quart saucepan.

title: Lamb Shank and Cashew Salad- Fast, No Waiting for the Party!
ingredients: 1 lamb shank ( preferably nz lamb shank ) | watermelon, cut into chunks or cubes | 1/3 cup raw cashews | 1/2 cup raw black olives
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c/180c fan ovens, 190°c or gas mark trim the fat off of the lamb and cut into large chunks or chunks. Place lamb in a large, shallow ovenproof pan or baking sheet. Spread the cashew nuts evenly over the lamb and scatter over the cashew nuts. Top with watermelon and olives. Place on one shelf of the oven and bake for about 45 - 50 minutes. Remove the lamb pieces from the oven and allow them to cool in the oven. Eat them straight away or leave to cool completely before slicing.

title: Spice Rubbed Dhal
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 package dry red lentils | 1 teaspoon ground coriander powder | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme | 2 dashes hot pepper sauce
instructions: Coat a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Over low heat, place lentils in a large bowl. Sprinkle with coriander and thyme. Add pepper sauce. Toss to coat. Let sit 5 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,spaghetti,red onion,dill,irish whiskey,rye bread,artichoke heart,chicken breast half
title: Smoky Whiskey Chicken Spaghetti
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into bite-size pieces | 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 1/2 cup red onion, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon dried dill | 2 tablespoons irish whiskey | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 4 slices rye bread | 8 ounces thin spaghetti
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place the chicken, artichoke hearts, onion, dill, whiskey, cayenne pepper, and bread into a large saucepan, and bring to a simmer.
