Cover, and cook over medium heat until chicken is no longer pink inside, about 15 minutes. Place the spaghetti into a large serving dish.

Random Ingredients: chicken bread stuffing mix,chicken tender breast,pecorino cheese,sesame seed,water,chicken wing,mexican cheese
title: Chicken With a Mexican Cheese Stuffing
ingredients: 1/2 cup water | 1 package chicken dry stuffing mix, with seasoning | 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast | 3 tablespoons sesame seeds | 3 lbs cheese sandwich steaks or 3 lbs chicken wings | 1 package shredded mexican blend cheese, divded | 1 package shredded pecorino cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. In a medium saucepan bring water to a boil. In a large bowl, mix dry stuffing mix with cooked chicken, cheese, sesame seeds and the cheese. Stuff chicken with stuffing mixture just until full. Place in a greased jelly roll pan. Bake at 400 degrees fahrenheit for fifteen minutes or until done. Top with your favorite toppings.

title: Fruited Potato Gratin
ingredients: 4 lbs russ yukon gold potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/4 inch slices | 4 cups dry oatmeal | 1/8 cup sweet paprika | 4 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese | 2/3 cup raspberry vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f line a large baking sheet with foil. Butter foil with soft margarine. Arrange half of potatoes in 12x7x2 inch glass baking dish and cover with half of salt oatmeal. Repeat layering twice and top with remaining potatoes. Sprinkle with half of paprika, half of parmesan, and 2 t. Of the vinegar. Place baking dish on top of foil and drizzle with remaining vinegar. Cover the top and sides of dish and bake 30 minutes, until potatoes are tender. Let stand 10 minutes, then serve.

title: Salami Appetizer Tray
ingredients: 4 slices salami, finely diced | 1 -2 teaspoon pitted dates, finely grated
instructions: Arrange all of the ingredients evenly on a tray. Put a piece of salami on the salami and sprinkle over a few more tsp of date paste. Variation, try to make different salami flavours by adding slices of pepperoni, salami and/or cheese for a little kick. If you want to serve this on a buns as an appetizer, try adding slices of red pepper to this tray before slicing or sprinkling the salami, cheese and pepperoni onto the salami before slicing.

Random Ingredients: pepper,cardamom seed,walnut,arborio rice,rice,fine breadcrumb,onion soup mix,ginger juice
title: Rice Balls With Walnuts
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked arborio rice | 2 tablespoons fresh ginger juice | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom seed | 3/4 cup ground walnuts ( about 4 tablespoons ) | 1/2 teaspoon cracked pepper | 3/4 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 2 tablespoons unchopped walnuts ( for topping ) ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 300 degrees. Lightly oil the bottom of a jelly roll pan and set aside. In large bowl, combine rice, ginger juice, onion soup mix, cardamom, 1 1/2 cups of the ground walnuts, and 1/2 teaspoon of the cracked pepper.

Random Ingredients: vanilla ice cream,green olive,parsley,french baguette,olive,swiss cheese,chili oil,yellow squash
title: Sauteed Squash With Green Olives and Swiss Cheese  Sandwiches
ingredients: 4 french baguettes | 12 ounces swiss cheese, sliced | 2 yellow squash, sliced diagonally | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley | 1/8 cup chopped pitted and halved green olives | 1/4 lb sliced ripe olives | 2 cups hot chili oil ( such as hacienda ) | 4 cups vanilla ice cream
instructions: In a large saute pan over medium heat, stir the cheese, squash, parsley, olives, and chili oil until cheese melts. Brush a medium size casserole dish with a little chile oil, place the bread slices, one at a time, on it. Spoon in the cheese mixture. Bake under the broiler. Serve immediately, cutting in half and placing a half mozzarella slice on top. Serve remaining cheese on the side.

Random Ingredients: cumin,orange zest,cheese,currant,ramen noodle,jasmine rice,oyster sauce,water chestnut
title: Crispy Rice With Shrimp
ingredients: 2 tablespoons coriander and cumin ( or equivalent spices ) | 1 cup jasmine rice | 1/8 cup dried currant or 1/8 cup raisins | 12 water chestnuts ( about 1-1/2 lb ) | 1/2 cup grated cheese | 12 ounces cooked, peeled shrimp ( about 1-1/2 lb ) | 1 zest | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a pan, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer 15 minutes, or until water is absorbed. Loosen rice from pan with a fork, and then spoon onto a platter. Top with shrimp, and then sprinkle with the zest and top with the oyster sauce.

title: Pigeon Peas-Stuffed With Sage and Chili
ingredients: 2 teaspoons rubbed dried sage | 4 lbs fresh pigeon peas | 1 1/2 cups dried chilies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Cook sage in a medium skillet over medium heat, stirring constantly, until well browned, about 2 minutes. Remove sage from skillet. Bring a large pot of water to boil. Drop frozen peas by the tablespoon full into the boiling water. As soon as they rise to the surface, remove with a slotted spoon. Drain thoroughly and set aside to dry at least 5 minutes. Remove and discard any bits of the peas that float to the top. Place 2 teaspoons of sage and chiles in the center of each pigeon. Fill each hollow with about 2 tablespoons of the peas and sprinkle with salt. Pack the remaining 2 teaspoons sage and chiles in the center. Wrap with a piece of kitchen foil and place in a glass casserole. Bake peas 45 minutes until peas are tender and beginning to blacken all over. Serve hot or chilled.

title: Hot Pepper Sauce for Beef Fries (Sirloin tip roast & meat) - OAMC
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless sirloin tip roast or 2 lbs beef tenderloin, trimmed and cut into strips | 1 medium red onion, halved lengthwise and thinly sliced | 2 cans chopped green chili peppers
instructions: Heat oven to 300 degrees. Arrange roast strips in single layer on foil lined baking pan. Sprinkle onion and chilies over meat. Roast for 3 hours basting often. Place on serving platter. Increase oven temperature to 400 degrees and continue roasting, uncovered, until meat thermometer registers 135 degrees for rare, about 35 minutes longer. Transfer roast to platter and let stand 10 - 15 minutes. Transfer to cutting board and slice and serve.

Random Ingredients: vegetable shortening,black pepper,swiss cheese,gherkin,bacon bit,cannellini bean,bean sprout
title: Swiss Beans
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans or ( 16 ounce ) can white kidney beans | 2 tablespoons vegetable shortening | 2 tablespoons grated swiss cheese | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped pickled gherkins | 1 tablespoon chopped pickled black pepper | 1 cup prepared bean sprouts | crumbled bacon bits ( optional )
instructions: Drain the beans and rinse. Place in a medium saucepan with boiling, salted water. Cook, covered, over medium low heat until tender, about 5 minutes. Drain, reserving 1 cup of the beans and the cooking liquid. Place butter in the bottom of a medium skillet over medium heat. When it shimmers, add the beans and cook, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned, 8 to 10 minutes. Stir in cheese, gherkins, pepper and reserved liquid. Cook 2 minutes longer. Sprinkle with bacon bits to serve.

title: Italian Chocolate
ingredients: 1/3 cup chocolate, chopped | 6 tablespoons orange peel, candied ( see note ) | fresh ground black pepper
instructions: Place chocolate in top of double thickness of double thicknessed waxed paper. Sprinkle with orange peel.

Random Ingredients: kale,fig,chipotle chile,salmon,cream chicken soup,cooking spray,sauce,yellow pepper
title: Chipotle Salmon and Figs
ingredients: 4 frozen figs or 4 fresh figs, cut in halves lengthwise | 8 frozen sauteed peppers | cooking spray | 3 cups chopped cooked salmon | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup chopped yellow pepper | 1/2 cup snipped chipotle chile | 1/8 teaspoon hot sauce
instructions: Arrange figs and peppers in a 13x9 inch baking dish coated with cooking spray. In 3 cups microwaveable bowl, mix sauteed salmon, soup, pepper and chipotle chilies. Spoon over figs. Cover and microwave on high power 5 - 7 minutes or until salmon is cooked. Spoon over figs and bake at 400 degrees for 10 - 12 minutes or until figs are crisp tender. Spoon over hot salmon and sprinkle with hot sauce. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: lime wedge,edamame,milk ricotta cheese,heavy cream,provolone cheese,chilies roughly,cumin powder,veal
title: Aunt Jenny's South of the Border Lasagna
ingredients: 1 lb ground veal | 1 cup finely shredded provolone cheese | 1/2 cup whole milk ricotta cheese | 1 large lime wedge | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin powder | 1 can refried beans with dried chilies, undrained | 1/4 cup heavy cream | 2 fresh hot chilies, roughly chopped ( i use canned diced jalapeno chiles )
instructions: Spray a 13 x 9 inch baking dish with cooking spray. In a large skillet over medium high heat, cook the ground veal for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring to crumble meat. In a large bowl combine the cheese with meat, ricotta cheese, lime wedge, cumin and chilies. In a blender combine the cream and refried beans with 1/4 cup water. Pulse until smooth. Pour mixture into the prepared dish. Using a spoon, spread cream mixture atop the ground mixture. Then sprinkle with the remaining 1/4 cup shredded cheese. Garnish with additional lime wedges and serve.

title: Lamb, Radish and Raspberry Lamb Skewers
ingredients: 2 lamb shank | 2 fresh red chilies, chopped | 8 -12 medium radishes | 1/4 cup raspberry jam | 1 cup crushed canned corn
instructions: Soak skewers skewers in cold water for 15 mins then thread onto metal skewers, alternating lamb and radishes.

title: French Onion and Parmesan Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup gruyere cheese | 1 celery rib, thinly sliced | 1 sprig fresh rosemary
instructions: Place gruyere cheese, celery and rosemary in your blender, add just a few drops of water to stop the mixture from curdling. Continue to blend until desired consistency is reached.

title: Quick and Easy Maraschino Pea Bread
ingredients: 4 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1/4 cup warm yellow peas | 28 fluid ounces maraschino cherries, drained | 2 large fennel bulbs, peeled trimmed and thinly sliced
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 2 cups of warm water. Add 4 1/2 cups of milk, and stir until dissolved. Heat remaining milk over medium high heat until hot but not boiling. Stir in maraschino cherries, fennel slices, and yeast mixture into milk and water in a large mixing bowl. Turn dough out onto a well floured surface, and knead until elastic and smooth, about 8 minutes. Cover dough with a dry cloth, and set aside to rise until doubled in size, about 1 1/2 hours. Punch down dough, and knead lightly. Place dough in a clean bowl, and turn to grease the surface. Cover, and let rise until doubled in bulk, about 1 hour. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Punch dough down, and knead lightly. Divide loaf into quarters, and place on a lightly oiled baking sheet. Cover with a lightly oiled baking sheet. Allow to rise until doubled in size, about 20 minutes. Remove baking sheet from oven. Bake in preheated oven for 20 to 30 minutes, or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,lemon,italian dressing,vanilla essence,liquid smoke flavoring,flour tortilla,peel
title: Tortilla Rollups(Cookies)
ingredients: 4 flour tortillas | liquid smoke flavoring | italian dressing | 1 pinch lemon | 1/4 teaspoon liquid smoke flavoring ( optional ) | 2 cups chopped cooked chicken or 2 cups cooked pork | 1 tablespoon shredded lemon rind | 1 pinch lemon, juice and zest of | 1 bouillon cube ( dissolve in 1/4 cup hot boiled water )
instructions: Mix ingredients in order listed and set aside. Wrap each tortilla with wax paper, making sure it becomes moist and easier to roll it. Set out on a table and stretch it out thinly, with your fingers. Spread the chicken on the tortilla. Roll, starting on the outer edges, rolling it tightly. Heat the olive oil. Roll and continue to fry them until nice and brown on all sides. Let drain on paper towels. Sprinkle hot roll with finely shredded lemon rind and finely shredded zest for color. Enjoy.

title: Kielbasa and Marshmallows
ingredients: 1 lb kielbasa, sliced 1/8 inch thick | 1 tablespoon turmeric | 1 package miniature marshmallows
instructions: Place the kielbasa pieces in a heavy skillet and cook over medium heat in hot oil, turning often, until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Sprinkle with turmeric.

Random Ingredients: navy bean,oregano flake,peanut oil,red potato,basil leaf,almond extract
title: Italian Navy Bean Potato Toss
ingredients: 1 can navy beans ( white kidney ) | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 tablespoon pureed fresh parsley or 1 tablespoon fresh basil leaf | 1/2 teaspoon oregano flakes | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract ( optional ) | 10 -12 red potatoes, about 1 lb, scrubbed and quartered ( about 1lb. )
instructions: Drain beans in colander, discarding the liquid. Heat oil in nonstick 12 inch skillet over medium heat, stirring occasionally, about 3 minutes. Add half the parsley or basil leaves, half the oregano and half the almond extract and stir for 1 minute. Add beans. Raise the heat to high, reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for about 10 minutes or until liquid is absorbed. Add potato and remaining parsley or basil and cook, covered, stirring occasionally, until potatoes are tender, about 8 minutes. Serve with remaining almond extract.

title: Creamy Kale and Pumpkin Seeds
ingredients: 500 g fresh kale | 1 tablespoon pumpkin seeds | 1 tablespoon dried porcini mushrooms
instructions: Cut off the leaves of the kale and shred in a food processor or with a fine blade. Bring the kale in salted water to the boil then reduce the heat and simmer until tender.

title: Beef Strapats (portobello Strapacas)
ingredients:
1/2 cup finely chopped portobello mushroom | 1/4 cup finely chopped bacon | 1/4 cup coarsely crumbled portobello mushroom cap 
    - 1 1/2 cups fine bread crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. On a baking sheet, mix together 1/2 cup portobello mushroom, bacon, and bread crumbs in a bowl. Make sure all the ingredients are evenly distributed. Sprinkle top of stems with portobello mushroom crumbs, and arrange on the baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven for about 20 minutes, or until bread crumbs are golden and the stems are slightly crisp.

Random Ingredients: onion,ranch dressing,peanut butter,peanut oil,flat leaf italian parsley
title: Peanut Ranch
ingredients: 2 teaspoons peanut oil | 1/2 cup chopped onion | 1/4 cup finely chopped flat-leaf italian parsley | 1 1/3 cups reduced-fat ranch dressing | 1/3 cup smooth peanut butter ( not spread )
instructions: Heat the oil in a medium skillet over medium heat. Add onion.

Random Ingredients: green enchilada sauce,bell pepper,beef brisket,wheat bread
title: Green Chili and Beef Brisket
ingredients: 1 lb beef brisket | 1 large green enchilada sauce | 1 large bell pepper, finely chopped | 1 loaf whole wheat bread, for dipping
instructions: Wash beef brisket and place in a large pot. Pour enough water over the brisket to cover it. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer for 45 minutes. Turn the meat and cook for an additional 20 minutes. Drain the beef and allow to cool in the soaking liquid. Place it in your crockpot. Place the enchilada sauce in the crockpot with the meat. Add the green pepper and the remaining liquid. Cook on high for an additional 30 minutes and turn temperature to low. Allow to stand for 20 minutes. Serve with warm tortillas and cheese of your choice.

title: Wild Mushrooms in Spicy Cream
ingredients: 1 lb whole mixed mushrooms, washed, dried ( such as chanterelles, shiitake, or oyster ) | 14 ounces low fat cottage cheese or 14 ounces ricotta cheese | 2 teaspoons dijon mustard | 3 tablespoons water | 4 tablespoons unsalted butter or 4 tablespoons margarine | 1 tablespoon vinegar | fresh scallion, chopped ( optional but recommended ) | hot water, as needed ( optional )
instructions: Place mushrooms in a large bowl with the cottage cheese, mustard, 3 tablespoons water, and remaining ingredients. Toss lightly until well combined. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour, but no longer than 2 hours. Serve immediately.

title: Thai Peanut Burritos
ingredients: 1 c cabbage leaf, shredded | 1 tablespoon peanut butter
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degc. Line 2 oven trays with parchment, and put the cabbage leaf on the baking trays, and bake for 5 - 10 minutes. Meanwhile, in a saucepan, combine the peanut butter and 1 cup of water, and heat until bubbling, then remove from the stove. Heat a spoonful of peanut butter mixture in a small pan. Spoon some of the warm mixture onto a pastry towel and gently roll it into a cigar shape as you go. Place on a pastry board while it cools, then peel away the paper. Cut the log into 6 equal pieces, wrap them in clingfilm, and freeze until needed. When ready to serve, reheat the burritos in the oven.

title: Chesse
ingredients: 6 ounces imitation crabmeat | 1 cup ricotta cheese | 1 semi-sweet chocolate square | 1/4 cup sweet wine | 2 small tomatoes, sliced ( optional )
instructions: In a food processor, blend crabmeat with ricotta cheese and choclate until combined. Stir in wine and tomatoes. Cover and refrigerate overnight for best results. Serve on a bed of lettuce leaves and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,rosemary,vanilla essence,yellow cherry tomato,pepper,cherry tomato,chickpea
title: Dishwasher Friendly Easy Sweet Chickpea Salad
ingredients: 2 cups low fat canned chickpeas | 4 tablespoons fresh rosemary | 150 g yellow cherry tomatoes | 1 tart apple | 2 tart tart cherry tomatoes | 250 g yellow cherry tomatoes | 1 tablespoon vanilla essence ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon pepper
instructions: In a deep non breaded pot, combine, chickpeas, 1 rosemary stalk and 1 tbsp fresh rosemary. Add vanilla and rest of rosemary stalks. Stir and cook at low heat for 5 minutes. Add apples, cherry tomatoes, remaining rosemary, and remaining 1 sliced cherry tomatoes. Stir and cook on high heat for 1 minute. Turn off and add 1 tbsp vanilla essence and pepper. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,tomato puree,turnip,cinnamon,chicken stock,garlic powder,green seasoning
title: Quick and Easy Sweet Turnip Casserole
ingredients: 4 large turnips, peeled and cut into 1-inch pieces | 2 tablespoons green seasoning | 1 tablespoon garlic powder, or to taste | 1/2 cup chicken stock, divided | 1 can tomato puree | 1/2 cup packed brown sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cinnamon
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place the turnips into a large saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil and cook until fork tender. Drain and remove from heat. Transfer the turnips into a large mixing bowl, add the green seasoning, garlic powder, chicken stock, tomato puree, brown sugar and cinnamon. Toss to coat well with seasoning. Pour into a 2 quart casserole dish. Cook in the preheated oven until the casserole has cooked through, 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Champignones
ingredients: 1/2 cup canned anchovies | 1/2 cup button mushroom, drained and chopped | fresh sage leaves
instructions: Chop anchovies in pestle. Combine with mushrooms and sage. Heat on low medium until heated through.

Random Ingredients: daikon radish,tabasco sauce,chunky peanut butter,portabella mushroom
title: Peanut Butter Vichyssoise #5FIX
ingredients: 2 packages simply potatoes & reg ; shredded hash browns | 1 package chunky peanut butter | 1 package portabella mushrooms, thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: In large fry pan or skillet, fry hash browns, in separate pan, with butter and tabasco. When golden brown, turn over to other side. Pour vichyssoise over top of hash browns and sprinkle with salt to taste.

Random Ingredients: chick pea,mozzarella cheese,ice water,crabmeat,onion salt,thyme sprig
title: Pizza Crabs
ingredients: 2 cans cooked chick-peas, drained | 1/2 cup shredded mozzarella cheese ( about 2 oz. ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme sprig | 1/4 teaspoon onion salt | 1 can crabmeat or ( 16 ounce ) can tuna flakes, drained and flaked ( 1/2 cup ) | 1 cup crushed ice water
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Process chick peas, 1/4 cup mozzarella cheese, thyme and onion salt in a food processor on low, until well mixed and smooth. Add crabmeat and remaining 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese and pulse until dough just comes together. Remove dough to a rimmed baking sheet. Roll dough out to an 11 inch round. Brush all edges of dough with water. Sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup mozzarella cheese. Press dough evenly onto surface with your fingers. Bake on a ungreased baking sheet for about 12 minutes or until lightly browned. Serve with remaining 1/4 cup mozzarella cheese on the side.

title: Honey Mustard Broccoli
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dry mustard powder | 500 g broccoli | 1/2 cup dry sherry | 3 tablespoons honey | 1/2 teaspoon rice wine or 1/2 teaspoon sherry | 1 teaspoon white sugar | 1 teaspoon cornflour, mixed with 1/2 cup water
instructions: Cut the broccoli into florets. Steam over hot coals for 3 minutes. Drain and keep to one side. To make the dressing, place all the ingredients in a small saucepan and heat gently until you have a thin sauce. Drain the broccoli and place in a serving bowl. Add the mustard and honey. Serve immediately.

title: Chocolaty Beef Tenderloin With Chocolate
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin | 1/2 cup chocolate ( of choice ) | 1/2 cup radish ( optional )
instructions: Trim all excess fat from beef with a boned knife. Score each side of the tenderloin to create a cross. Pour 1/2 cup of chocolate in a small pan, melt. Add 1/2 cup of radish for garnish if desired and set aside to cool. Place tenderloin down on a cutting board with 1/4 inch of fat on bottom, and slice it in half with the tips of the knife. Place the beef, radish halves and chocolate mixture into a small nonstick pan, heat on low until chocolate has melted, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,lime wedge,saffron,pancetta,tomato sauce,rosemary,corn chip
title: Easy "mexican" and "Spanish" Nachos
ingredients: 2 ounces pancetta ( i prefer italian ) or 2 ounces ham, diced ( i prefer italian ) | 2 cups tomato sauce or 2 cups rotel tomato puree | 1/2 cup sour cream or 1/2 cup nonfat sour cream | 6 -12 fresh rosemary or 6 -12 sprigs fresh thyme | 8 -10 medium corn chips | 1 pinch saffron | sliced sun-dried tomatoes or sliced limes wedge
instructions: Spray large non stick skillet with pam or coat with cooking spray and heat on medium. Add pancetta, ham and tomato sauce or rotel to pan. Stir together for about 5 minutes or until cheese becomes slightly melted. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Remove from heat and gently fold in sour cream. Scoop out some of the mix and set aside. Rinse corn chips under cold water and sprinkle with saffron. Coat evenly with 1/4 of the sour cream. Drain them thoroughly on paper towels. Fill each tortilla with about 1/4 of the tortilla, spreading with 2 tbls sour cream. Sprinkle with about 1 tbls. Of the sun dried tomatoes or slices. Roll up. Place in skillet or grilling basket if you are using wooden ones. Grill until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: ziti pasta,baking soda,ham,penne,oil,maple syrup,peanut butter,fast rising yeast
title: Yummy Ham & Penne Baked in Belly and Peanut Butter Pies
ingredients: 3 lbs smoked ham ( i used del monte ) or 3 lbs other country ham, sliced into 1/4 inch wide slices ( i used del monte ) | 8 ounces sweet pure maple syrup or 8 ounces honey | 16 ounces penne or 16 ounces rigatoni pasta | 1 ounce quick-rising yeast ( optional ) | 1 3/4 cups peanut butter ( preferably creamy type like cashew butter ) or 1 3/4 cups margarine ( preferably creamy type like cashew butter ) | 2 1/2 teaspoons baking soda ( optional ) | 1 1/4 lbs ziti pasta or 1 1/4 lbs other small shaped pasta, cooked according to package directions ( or other small pasta such as rigatoni or or penne ) | 1 quart oil, for deep frying
instructions: Cut ham slices into strips. Preheat oven to 325°f. Mix maple syrup or honey in a small saucepan and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and stir in dry yeast. Let stand 3 - 5 minutes and then dissolve yeast in syrup and set aside. Crumble bacon or ham, remove all but 2 t of fat and set aside. Heat 1 qt water in a large pot until boiling. Add 1 tb sugar and 1 tbsp margarine. Bring to a rapid boil, then stir in baking soda. Add ziti and stir until al dente, about 7 minutes. Add cooked ziti to the boiling soup and stir. Remove from heat and stir in the rest of the syrup and the peanut butter/margarine. Cover and let sit 5 minutes to absorb flavors. Drain pasta well and stir into soup. Heat oven to pour batter into a 3 qt baking dish. Cover and let rise until the pan is full, about 1 1/2 hours. Bake 45 - 50 minutes until puffed up and golden brown.

title: Germans Chocolate Bread
ingredients: 2 pita bread | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 teaspoon superfine sugar | 1 tablespoon grated german sweet chocolate or 1 tablespoon milk chocolate
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees f. Slice each pita bread into six wedges and then into wedges. Coat baking sheet with cooking spray and place the wedges on it. Spray baking sheets with cooking spray and place baking sheet on tray. Brush bread with oil. Sprinkle asafetida on each wedge. Sprinkle grated germans chocolate over the asafetida. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes or until chocolate is melted and bubbly. Serve warm with your favorite german meal. This recipe can also be made with other chocolate, like chocolate syrup. Note, alternatively, use almond extract. Nutmeg can also be added to the asafetida, but it should not be added. Germans chocolate is a smooth compound-style chocolate similar to the consistency of unsweetened whipped cream. It is available in health food stores. If you can't locate it, the germans often use 1/4 part unsweetened milk chocolate or half and half cream.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,coconut cream,dark soy sauce,romaine lettuce,turmeric powder,lemon juice,saffron thread,provolone cheese
title: Aromatic Lettuce on Lemons
ingredients: 1/3 cup balsamic vinegar or 1/3 cup white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons coconut oil | coarse ground turmeric powder ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon saffron thread | 1 head romaine lettuce, rinsed | 1 cup homemade coconut cream ( coco lopez or vanilla milk ) | 1/4 cup low sodium dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice
instructions: Heat the vinegar and oil in a small saucepan over medium heat and reduce slightly by 1/ add the turmeric, saffron and a pinch of salt, stirring to coat. Remove from heat and set aside. To the same saucepan add the romaine and 1 cup coconut cream and cook over medium heat for about 2 - 3 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside. Whisk the soy sauce, lemon juice and remaining 1/4 cup coconut cream until blended. To serve, arrange the lettuce and cooked balsamic reduction at a lettuce bed. Top with balsamic reduction.

title: Pumpkin Mustard Spread
ingredients: 1/4 cup mashed pumpkin puree | 1 teaspoon prepared mustard powder | 1 pint cherry tomatoes
instructions: Combine pumpkin, mustard powder, and tomatoes in the bowl of a food processor. Add a few drops of water if the mixture is too dry. Fold in your favorite hot mustard or spicy mustard and store in refrigerator. Best if served the same day.

title: Chicken Lollipops
ingredients: 1/4 cup chicken, chopped | 1/4 cup green chilies, chopped | 1 can diced green chilies | 1/4 cup maraschino cherry | 1/3 cup low-fat cool whip | 1/4 cup liquid honey
instructions: Combine chicken, chilies, cherries and cool whip in blender till smooth. To serve, place a thin layer of sauce on serving platter or individual servings of yogurt, garnish with maraschino. P. S. Cut chicken lollipops in half horizontally. Place two halves together and place in glass pie dish. Cover with remainder of sauce and drizzle with honey.

title: Lobster Smoked Chicken
ingredients: 1 frying pan or 1 roasting pan | 8 ounces smoked haddock or 8 ounces smoked ham | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 4 tablespoons smoked paprika | 4 rosemary sprigs, cut into thin slivers
instructions: Heat up your broiler or grill. In a food processor, place the smoked haddock, garlic salt, paprika, and rosemary. Process until well combined and season with salt to taste. Place the mixture into the centre of the preheated grill and cook for 15 minutes, flip, and continue cooking for approximately 10 to 15 minutes until the internal temperature reaches 160 degrees f and it crisps up a little. Place the chicken in a baking dish and pour juices over. Allow the chicken to cool completely and serve on serving plates.

title: Savory Avocado Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 2 tablespoons brown rice ( no-cook ) | 1 1/2 cups long grain rice or 1 1/2 cups brown basmati rice | 1 medium avocado, peeled pitted and diced | 2 sprigs fresh rosemary sprigs ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon freshly grated nutmeg, lightly toasted and grated | 1 pinch freshly ground black pepper
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine rice and enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover tightly, and simmer on low for 20 minutes, or until rice is tender and water is absorbed. Meanwhile, scoop out rice from cooking water into a large heatproof serving dish. Return to pan with diced avocado, rosemary, and nutmeg. Cook over medium high heat, stirring often, until heated through. Remove from heat. Stir to combine.

title: Chipotle Dip
ingredients: 1 green chili, chopped | 3 chipotle chiles | seasoning, as directed
instructions: Toast and core the chilies. Place in a food processor and process until chopped. Stir in the chopped chipotle chile and season with seasoning, if desired.

title: Turkish Lentil and Tomatoes With Green Beans
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups green lentils | 2 teaspoons dried turmeric | 2 chicken bouillon cubes | 5 cups fresh plum tomatoes, cut into 1-inch pieces
instructions: Place lentils in a large bowl and cover with several inches of water. Let sit for 30 minutes. Rinse with cold water, drain and place in a large heavy saucepan with a tight fitting lid. Add turmeric. Bring to a boil, then turn down and simmer on low for 40 minutes. Add bouillon cubes and add tomatoes. Cover and simmer for an additional 30 minutes. Serve.

title: Penne Pasta With Cranberry Sauce
ingredients: 8 ounces penne pasta, cooked according to package directions | 1/2 cup soy milk | 3 -4 tablespoons chili paste ( to taste ) | 1 serrano chili ( optional, to taste ) | 2 cups fresh cranberries or 2 cups frozen cranberries
instructions: Mix together soy milk and chili paste. Set aside. To prepare pasta, add pasta, 2/3 cup of water and tomato sauce to a large frying pan. Cook on medium for approximately 10 minutes, until pasta is tender and sauce thickens slightly. Toss with 1/3 c of cranberries. Serve with remaining cranberries for dipping. Enjoy variations to pasta add chopped fresh spinach, chopped green onions, chopped celery or a dash of soy sauce to the sauce.

Random Ingredients: spring green,green apple,italian plum tomato,beef gravy,chocolate,pine nut,eggplant
title: Christmas Eve Eggplant and Mushroom Casserole
ingredients: 1 medium eggplant, sliced | 400 g sweet italian plums in tomato, with juice | 400 g sliced green apples | 2/3 cup beef gravy, low fat | 200 g of chopped spring green | 50 g coarsely chopped walnuts | 50 g coarsely chopped mixed spring greens | 50 g finely grated fresh chocolate
instructions: Heat oven to 180 celsius. Line a shallow casserole dish with baking paper. Arrange sliced eggplant in casserole dish. Brush around the edge with olive oil, then place in oven for 45 minutes or until eggplant is almost cooked through. Set baking paper aside, then set out the rest of the ingredients. When eggplant is almost cooked, remove from oven and drain off most of the moisture from dish. Carefully place the eggplant back in the dish and add beef gravy and vegetables. Stir until combined. Put back into oven, uncovered. Bake for 45 - 50 minutes or until eggplant and sauce is bubbling and beginning to thicken. Remove from oven and stir well so that eggs are spread out evenly. Put on an oven tray and sprinkle with nuts. Set aside for 10 minutes. Remove baking paper from dish, then stir through mixed springgreens and chocolate. Serve with extra crisp bread & a nice crisp green salad.

title: Aceituni Raita
ingredients: 2 cups black or green brewed espresso powder | 1/2 tablespoon red chili powder | 1 inch piece bamboo shoots, cut into thin slices
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender. Pulsate until a smooth paste forms. Pour into a bowl.

title: Begetable Egg Noodles
ingredients: 2 cans baked beans | 1 jar sliced pickled beets | 16 ounces egg noodles, cooked and drained
instructions: Set baking rack at lowest level. Remove from oven if any oil from the jar of beets sticks. Drain beets.

Random Ingredients: tomato sauce,fennel seed,egg noodle,banana,italian sausage,self raising flour,black olive
title: Italian Sausage and Noodles
ingredients: 1 cup egg noodles | 1/2 cup italian sausage | 1/2 cup chopped tomato | 1/2 cup pitted sliced black olives | 1/2 cup chopped banana | 1 1/2 cups self-raising flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons fennel seeds | 1 teaspoon salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c.

Random Ingredients: apple,herb,water,romaine lettuce,sesame seed,pecan,baby spinach leaf,brie cheese
title: Warm German Salad With Sesame Seeds and Brie Cheese
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce, halved crosswise | 2 tablespoons toasted sesame seeds | 1/2 cup chopped pecans | 4 cups fresh baby spinach leaves | 1 large ripe apple, such as granny smith, cut into wedges | 2 tablespoons crumbled dried herbs from jarred roasted garlic | 3/4 cup crumbled soft brie cheese | 2 tablespoons apple water or 2 tablespoons light cream
instructions: Arrange the lettuce on 6 individual salad plates. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and nuts, then top with spinach. Combine the spinach, apple, herbs, brie cheese and water or cream in a large bowl. Drizzle with olive oil just before serving.

title: Spanish Spinach and Peppers
ingredients: 4 large bell peppers ( green, yellow or red ) | 32 ounces baby spinach
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Slice peppers into 1/4 inch wide strips. Place strips in a single layer on prepared baking sheet. Bake, uncovered, in middle of oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until slightly charred. Remove to plate. Cut stems into 2 inch pieces. Separate spinach, placing on a large platter. Remove charred strips from skins and coarsely chop. Drain well. Add spinach, bell peppers and remaining ingredients and stir to blend. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: beef gravy,grand marnier,tomato puree,rosemary sprig,apple juice,soya sauce,ham hock,jicama
title: Sizzling Ham Hocks from Leftovers
ingredients: 1 ham hocks | 2 teaspoons rosemary sprigs | 1 tablespoon soya sauce | 1 teaspoon soya sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons grand marnier | 1/2 tablespoon tomato puree | 1/2 ounce apple juice ( or fresh juice ) | 3 ounces jicama or 3 ounces butter | beef gravy, to serve
instructions: Make the gravy by simmering all the ingridients in a saucepan gently until the gravy thickens. To serve, drain the ham and cut the meat into bite sized pieces. Return to the pan and add the gravy, stirring until the gravy boils. Serve with a green vegetable or a mixture of carrots, beans, potatoes and zucchini.

title: Cherie's Apricot Chicken
ingredients: 1 cup nonfat milk | 1/2 cup powdered sugar | 1 package chicken meat | 1/2 cup apricot jam
instructions: Mix margarine or butter with powdered sugar and milk. Add chicken and apricot jam.

title: Italian Green Salad
ingredients: 1 head escarole | 2 cans diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1 can anchovies, in olive oil
instructions: Boil water. Wash and chop escarole. Drain anchovies. Drain shrimp and put in pot with tomatoes. Mix all ingredients in an attractive bowl or plates. If it looks like there isn't enough juice you can add water.

Random Ingredients: chinese barbecue pork,icing sugar,cardamom,irish cream,chorizo sausage,pineapple chunk,oregano,cheese
title: Chorizo Baked Puff
ingredients: 400 g chorizo sausage, sliced | 1 tablespoon icing sugar | 2 tablespoons chinese barbecue pork fat, diced | 2 tablespoons pineapples | 1/2 cup irish cream | 1 cup of chopped cheese | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom | 1 teaspoon dry oregano
instructions: Dice chorizo and place in a microwave safe bowl. Add icing sugar and stir til melted. Add pork fat, pineapple, irish cream, cheese and spices and stir til combined. Place into a greased oven proof ramekin and bake 30 minutes in a moderate oven till golden.

Random Ingredients: cilantro stem,spanish onion,cooking sherry,vanilla vodka,apple juice,corn syrup,oregano
title: Apple Pudding
ingredients: 4 large spanish onions, sliced thin ( about 2/3 cup total ) | 2 teaspoons dried oregano | 1/2 cup apple juice ( concentrate ) | 1/4 cup cooking sherry | 1/4 cup light corn syrup | 1/4 cup sherry wine | 1/4 cup cilantro stem ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons vanilla vodka
instructions: Prepare onions, in a saucepan, add onion slices, oregano, and apple juice. Cover and cook over low heat until onions are soft. Stir in sherry and syrup. Remove from heat. Stir in cilantro. Pour into bowls and refrigerate overnight to chill. Stir. Topping, in a saucepan, combine sherry and vodka. Heat, stirring, until boiling. Pour over warm onions, stirring well with a spoon. Serve warm or chilled with whipped cream.

title: Mint Pork Ribs
ingredients: 6 whole pork ribs | 1 envelope taco seasoning mix | 1/3 cup golden raisins | 3 tablespoons finely chopped of fresh mint, divided
instructions: Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 300°f. Line a sheet pan with foil.

title: Nana's Savoury Peanut Burritos
ingredients: 400 g hulled peanuts | 250 g sweet hungarian paprika | 200 g bean tapioca | 200 g drambuie
instructions: Peel the peanuts, remove the white part of the peels, and put the peanuts on a baking tray. Bake at 180 degrees c for 15 minutes. Turn off oven, and let peanuts cool. In a food processor, pulse the paprika and bean tapioca with the peanuts and drambuie until the mixture is smooth. Store in airtight container. Enjoy.

title: Zucchini With Octopus
ingredients: 750 g octopus, in tentacles | 1 red pepper, deseeded & diced | 1 medium zucchini, diced | 2 egg whites | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder
instructions: Wash the octopus, pat dry with paper towels & cut into pieces. Bring a large pan of water to the boil and add all the ingredients. Toss in the octopus and reduce the heat. Allow to simmer for about 15 minutes. The octopus should be soft & tender when pierced with a small knife.

title: Asparagus Ham Salad
ingredients: 1 lb asparagus, tough ends snapped off ( string ) | 1/4 lb deli ham, cut into 1-inch slices | 1/3 cup red wine, dry | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder
instructions: Wash asparagus and cut small flowers from stem, if necessary. Place ham, asparagus flowers and dry red wine in large serving bowl. Mix well and season with salt and pepper. Garnish with coriander leaves.

title: Goregano and Parmesan Cheese
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh oregano | 1 bunch fresh parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Finely grind the oregano on a mortar and pestle. In a large bowl, mix the chopped oregano with the grated cheese. Serve at room temperature.

title: Rosti Beef Patties
ingredients: 1 kg sirloin steak, cut into cubes | 1/2 cup plain flour | 1/4 cup mild hot sauce ( i use tabasco ) | 1 tablespoon dried rosemary, crushed
instructions: Mix the flour with the hot sauce. Rinse, dry, and pat beef into the sauce. Mix in the rosemary. Heat frying pan, brown the beef. Serve with potatoes, vegetables and tomato sauce.

title: Basic Beef Stock
ingredients: 1 quart reduced-sodium beef broth | 2 teaspoons liquid smoke, with garlic | chopped fresh parsley, to garnish ( optional )
instructions: Measure the beef broth into a 2 - 2 1/2 quart nonreactive dutch oven and place over medium heat. Place the liquid smoke in a small spoon and carefully pour the liquid smoke over it. When the liquid smoke begins to bubble, raise the heat to high and bring the liquid to simmer. Cover the pan and reduce heat to medium low. Simmer for 1 1/2 hours. Adjust seasoning with salt, pepper and/or liquid smoke. Strain the broth through a cheesecloth lined sieve until no solids remain.

Random Ingredients: masa harina,orange juice,head cauliflower,salad oil,coconut milk,sauce,salmon fillet,black eyed pea
title: Salmon With a Haggis of Cauliflower and Black Olives
ingredients: 1 large head cauliflower, cut into florets | 1/4 cup salad oil | 4 ounces smoked salmon fillet | 3 cups orange juice | 1 cup light coconut milk | 4 ounces canned chick-peas, drained and rinsed | 1 pinch hot sauce | 3 tablespoons masa harina
instructions: Boil cauliflower in water until tender. Drain and set aside. In another skillet, heat salad oil over medium heat. Cook salmon for 3 - 4 minutes per side or until just seared on the outside. In a small saucepan, combine orange juice, coconut milk, black beans and hot sauce. Bring to a boil and cook for 3 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in masa harina. Place cauliflower in an oven proof bowl, pour the sauce over and top with salmon.

Random Ingredients: gingerroot,lemon juice,mustard powder,cooking oil,pistachio,saltine cracker,green onion
title: Shirmparma
ingredients: 2 cans crushed saltine crackers | 2 tablespoons finely cubed gingerroot | 2 tablespoons thinly sliced green onions | 1 tablespoon finely chopped pistachios | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 tablespoon dry mustard powder | 1 teaspoon lemon juice, fresh
instructions: Heat the oils in a large skillet until quite hot, and add the saltines. Shake the pan to shift the crackers. Reduce heat to low, then add the ginger and green onions. Sprinkle the pistachios over the top, and continue shaking the pan in the order given. Immediately. Stir and then shake the pan. When the pan looks dry, add the mustard powder, lemon juice and mix well. When the mustard powder's solidified, take the pan off the heat.

title: Fava Bean Soup
ingredients: 3 tablespoons instant minced celery | 1 tablespoon ground dried mushrooms stems | 1 can fava beans, drained and rinsed | ice water | 1/4 cup minced prosciutto
instructions: Place the celery, dried mushrooms, and the can of fava beans in the bowl of a blender or food processor and pulse several times to combine. You may also use an immersion blender or food processor. Transfer the blended soup to a large pot, or dutch oven, and bring the water to simmering over medium heat. Stir in the prosciutto and simmer 1 minute.

title: Chilled Fruit Stew
ingredients: 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 1/4 cup frozen peas, thawed | 3/4 cup crushed canned pineapple chunk | 1 1/2 cups irish whiskey
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium high heat and cook peas 4 minutes, stirring frequently. Stir in pineapple and cook 2 minutes. Stir in whiskey.

Random Ingredients: brown mustard seed,pasta,thyme sprig,cool whip,molasses,italian seasoning,lettuce leaf,beef stew meat
title: Slow Cooker Beef Soft-Shells
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 can light molasses ( or light corn syrup ) | 1 package refrigerated light pasta ( i use barilla ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons brown mustard seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons italian seasoning | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprigs | 2 cool whip, thawed | lettuce leaf
instructions: In slow cooker, mix beef, molasses and pasta, add mustard seeds, italian seasoning and thyme sprigs. Cover and cook on high power 2 - 3 hours or until pasta and meat are tender. Turn slow cooker to low and let cool 10 minutes. Stir cool whip into meat mixture. Cover and chill 1 hour.

title: Mexican Chorizo (Meat With Chiles)
ingredients: 2 lbs lean meat, cut into 1 inch cubes ( shoulder ) | 2 tablespoons paprika | 1 ounce dried mexican oregano ( not ground ) | 1 can diced jalapeno chiles or ( 15 ounce ) can poblano chiles | 3 -4 tablespoons raisins | 4 bags fresh spinach ( packed, thawed )
instructions: Trim any loose fat from the meat. In a medium mixing bowl, mix the meat and spices with half of the chilies, raisins, and the chopped spinach. Pour the remaining chile mixture into the meat mixture and allow to marinate in the refrigerator for at least 3 hours, or overnight. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. If using chiles, roast them by placing an iron skillet or oven safe frying pan over medium high heat for 2 - 3 minutes. With tongs, remove and discard any charred skins from the chiles. Slice each chiles into six 4 inch long strips, wiping off any excess moisture if necessary. Place the meat and chile strips back into the hot skillet. Sprinkle with the paprika. Stir to mix, then bake until brown and the meat is done, about 1 hour.

title: Mexican Pork Loin
ingredients: 4 tablespoons sesame oil | 4 tablespoons tequila | 1/3 pound pork loin roast, fat trimmed | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro | 6 hard-cooked eggs, chopped
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium heat and lightly oil the grate. For the marinade, combine the sesame oil, tequila, pork loin, and cilantro in a bowl. Thread the pork onto skewers. Brush the pork with the marinade and grill until no longer pink in the center, about 5 minutes per side. Slice and serve with the hard cooked eggs.

title: Baked Escarole
ingredients: 2 bunches escarole, trimmed | 2 cups ricotta cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Remove stems from escarole.

title: Mexican White Beans
ingredients: 1 lb dried navy beans | 1/2 cup pineapple juice, pineapple flavored juice ( can be bottled, like tuna ) | 1 can chopped mangoes, drained with juice | 3 chicken bouillon cubes | 1 dash tea ( optional )
instructions: Soak beans overnight in plenty of water, drain when cooked. Bring water to a boil & add beans. Add water to cover beans by one inch. Simmer until beans are tender, approximately 1 1/2 hours. Drain beans. Return bean to pan, add pineapple juice, mango slices & tea. Continue to simmer.

title: Chilli Red Cream Cake with Chilies
ingredients: 1/2 cup sweet cream or 1/2 cup mascarpone cheese ( 4 tbsp per serving ) | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 12 ounces diced red chilies ( about 3 large fresh red chilies ) | 20 -24 ladyfingers
instructions: Line a 9x13 pan or springform cake pan with parchment paper.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,jalapeno pepper,lettuce,cornflour,chestnut flour,veal stock beef,yellow food coloring,chili paste
title: Mexican Wedding Soup
ingredients: 1/2 cup chestnut flour ( made by frying onions in 1 tbsp vegetable oil ) | 1 lb veal stock or 1 lb beef stock | 6 cups vegetable stock or 6 cups beef stock | 2 -4 tablespoons chili paste | 1 tablespoon cornflour, cornstarch | 4 -5 drops yellow food coloring | picante sauce, as an accompaniment ( optional ) | shredded lettuce | chopped jalapeno pepper ( optional )
instructions: Sift the chestnut flour into a bowl, and whisk in the flour. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large pot to the smoking point and coat the bottom and sides of the pot. Add about 1 cup of stock to the flour flour, mix well. Add 1/2 cup of stock and cook soup, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon, or whisk until thick. Add 1/4 cup stock and stir well. Add chili paste, and stir until dissolved. Stir in the cornflour mixture and beat well. Cook on low heat for about 20 minutes. After 20 minutes, stir in food coloring, then beat and return to the simmer for another 10 minutes. Serve garnished with picante sauce and shredded lettuce, jalapeno peppers, and any other seasonings desired. Note, for a vegetarian or hard meat soup you would substitute the beef stock.

title: Chestnut and Yogurt Dip
ingredients: 250 g chestnuts | 2 tablespoons dried cranberries | 1 onion powder | 250 g natural soymilk ( lactose free ) | 1/2 cup dried sweetened coconut | 1/2 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/2 cup crumbled feta
instructions: Heat oven to 160c/180c fan forced. Cook the chestnuts on a baking tray for 20 minutes until they begin to brown about 8 to 10 minutes. In a food processor, blitz the cranberries with the onion powder to a coarse puree. Remove the cores and seeds and place in a saucepan with the soymilk. Stir until combined. Add the chestnuts, cranberries and cheese and stir well. Season to taste with salt. Spoon into shallow ovenproof serving dish, spread evenly. Top with crumbled feta and bake at 160c/180c fan forced for 30 minutes, or until the mixture is hot and lightly bubbling.

title: Kielbasa and Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, cored and cut into florets | 3 pounds kielbasa, cut into slices
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook kielbasa slices in the boiling water until browned, about 10 minutes. Drain kielbasa slices on a screen lined baking sheet. Place cauliflower florets in a large bowl and mix with kielbasa mixture. Cover bowl and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: corn oil,club soda,vanilla essence,garlic clove,ricotta cheese
title: Easy Fake Pizza Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 kg ricotta cheese | 2 garlic cloves | 1 cup club soda | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Crush garlic in mortar and pestle. Mix well. Add ricotta and blend well. Add club soda and the vanilla. Pour 1/2 c deep into a round tin, pour in enough pizza soda to come half way up the tin you will end up having too runny add as much soda as you want and mix inches. Sprinkle more flour on top until you can see through the top until it is covered evenly. Let it set in the oven at about 160 degrees celcius. Bake until golden and bubbly. This is very easily doubled, and will keep in the fridge up to a year.

Random Ingredients: italian salad dressing mix,demerara sugar,green cardamom pod,self rising flour,mint,red chili sauce
title: Red Curry Mint Muffins
ingredients: 2 cups self-rising flour | 1 packet of dry italian salad dressing mix | 1 tablespoon red chili sauce | 1 teaspoon minced of fresh mint | 5 green cardamom pods | 1 teaspoon demerara sugar or 1 teaspoon sugar substitute
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f degrees. Grease a 12 cup muffin tin. In a medium bowl mix the dry italian dressing mix, red chili sauce, mint, green cardamom pods and sugar and combine well. Add this to the dry fruit mixture and blend until well combined. Spoon mixture into muffin cup moulds making sure full capacity is achieved. Bake for about 20 to 25 minutes until lightly browned. Allow to cool. Serve on a plate. Variation, add 1 - 2 tbls of bicardi rum to the batter and stir in the mint.

title: Canadian Bacon, Egg and Pork Casserole
ingredients: 1/2 lb bacon, diced | 1 lb ground pork | 2 bunches broccoli florets | 3 cups mozzarella cheese, shredded | 2 lbs deli-style duck liver
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Combine bacon, ground pork, broccoli and cheese in a 2 quart baking dish. Add enough water to completely cover. Roast uncovered for 20 minutes. Uncover and continue to roast until bacon is crisp and cheese has cooked down, approximately 30 minutes more. Remove from oven and set aside to cool slightly. When cool slightly, use a spoon to gently separate the bacon slices from the casserole and place them in a plastic bag to keep warm until served.

title: Coriander Seed and Port Wine Fritters
ingredients: 100 g self-rising flour, sifted | 1 teaspoon coriander seed | 150 ml port wine | 150 g fresh coriander leaves
instructions: Lightly oil the frying pan or griddle. Sift the flour and spices together. Add the port and stir with a wooden spoon until the mixture gathers together. When smooth, add water little at a time and stir to combine. The mixture should be dry, smooth and glossy. Drop heaped tablespoonfuls of the mixture onto the hot pan and cook, turning with a wide spatula as the fritters cook. Turn fritters every few minutes or so until they are golden brown.

Random Ingredients: orange liqueur,rava,creamy peanut butter,beef stock,soy sauce,mayonnaise,pie shell,grand marnier
title: Beef & Oriental Pies
ingredients: 1/2 cup creamy peanut butter | 4 tablespoons soy sauce | 3 tablespoons orange liqueur | 1/4 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 cup light mayonnaise | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 1 teaspoon grand marnier or 1 teaspoon other orange liqueur | 2 cups beef stock ( or beef base ) | 3/4 cup prepared gravy | 1 unbaked pie shells
instructions: For filling, combine peanut butter ingredients and mix well. For beef and appetizers, spread about 1/4 cup of peanut butter mixture into each pie shell. Spoon approximately 2 - 3 tablespoons of the beef mixture into each pie shell. Place on a cookie sheet coated with cooking spray. Bake at 400°f for 10 to 15 minutes or until hot. Serve with the reserved gravy and garnish with orange slices and mandarin orange slices.

title: Spiced Yoghurt and Pine Nut Sauce,
ingredients: 1/4 cup caster sugar | 200 g yoghurt | 12 fresh kaffir lime leaves | 2 tablespoons coriander | 1/4 cup pine nuts, roasted | 1 1/2 cups sweet champagne
instructions: Put the sugar in a large bowl and pour over the yoghurt and lime leaves, then add the coriander, pine nuts, and the sweet champagne. Mix well, cover, and leave to marinate in the fridge overnight. The next day, transfer to a bowl and gradually add the remaining yoghurt. Taste and adjust seasonings, and add more salt if necessary. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: olive oil,romaine lettuce,nutritional yeast,tomato juice,beef gravy,grain white rice
title: Mmm Beef Salad (Vegan & Low Fat)
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs raw ground beef ( i use extra lean ) or 1 1/4 lbs ground turkey fat ( i use extra lean ) | 2 cans vegetarian beef gravy | 1/3 cup olive oil ( or just use canola oil ) | 1/4 cup nutritional yeast | 1/2 cup long-grain white rice | 2 -3 leaves romaine lettuce ( or 1 small tub of romaine lettuce )
instructions: Cook the meat and drain. You can also cook your noodles or you can just eat your fresh salad and it tastes a bit better if you let it cool off. In a large bowl, combine the meat, gravy, olive oil, nutritional yeast and rice, then mix in the lettuce. You can also put it in a salad bowl, cover with plastic wrap and put in the fridge while you prep the rest of the salad. This salad can be frozen for future use. When ready to eat, put 3 - 4 hefty spoonfuls of the leftover meat mixture on top of your lettuce leaves and serve with a dollop of sour cream and a sprinkle of cheese. If you don't mind eating lettuce rather than the romaine, it is time to make it healthier by first cutting it into slices and eating it as above.

title: Lebanese Fry Bread
ingredients: 2 packages lard, crisco | 1/2 package taco seasoning
instructions: Heat crisco up over medium heat til butter shows on one side. Take crisco and sprinkle a little taco seasoning on the crisco. Add to crisco. Stir and fry on other side til browned and crisped. Enjoy.

title: Duck Gyros-Dunked With a Touch of Honey!
ingredients: 4 duck, patted dry, fat removed, and cut in half | unsweetened tahini | 2 bananas
instructions: Preheat an oven to 500 degrees f. Open a package of dry duck or turkey and pat dry with tahini. Place the duck cut side down on a baking sheet. Bake in the oven until the duck is browned, about 15 minutes. While the duck is baking, peel and chop your bananas into 1/2 inch pieces and set aside. Slice up the duck, if you prefer. Remove the duck with tongs to a plate. Slice the duck into bite size pieces and set aside. Remove the fat from the drippings from the oven. Add the bananas to the drippings and saute briefly to soften them. Remove bananas with a slotted spoon and add to the meat. Taste and adjust seasonings. Slice the duck across the grain and add it to the bananas, mixing thoroughly.

title: Scallops in Ginger-Jicama Sauce
ingredients: 600 g sea scallops | 2 jicama, peeled into chunks | 600 g cod, cut into chunks
instructions: Line a large baking tray with baking paper, leaving a 2cm overhang on both ends. Place the scallops on the baking tray, then season with salt and pepper. Leave for 3 minutes. Remove the scallops, and leave on the baking tray for another 3 minutes to set. Meanwhile, place the jicama chunks into a pan of lightly salted boiling water. Cook gently for 1 minute, then drain. Reserve 2 tbsp of the pan juices. Preheat the oven to 200°c. Place the cod, scallops and jicama over the same baking tray. Scallop the scallops onto the tray. Cook for 20 minutes or until cooked. Leave to stand for 5 minutes, then serve straight away.

title: Dynamites- Beef - or Fish and Chips #5FIX
ingredients: 1 lb white fish fillet, cut into 1/4-inch pieces | 1/2 cup finely chopped white vinegar | 6 ounces crushed fried beef ( about 2 ounces )
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f. Place fish pieces on ungreased jelly roll pan. Combine vinegar and ground beef.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,pepperoni,chicken,canola oil,red wine,plain flour,red pepper,sirloin tip roast
title: Salsiccia With Bolognaise & Pepperoni, Straw Pepperoni and Beef
ingredients: 4 lbs sirloin tip roast | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 10 ounces mixed button mushrooms | 7 ounces of bolognaise & red wine | 7 1/2 fluid ounces red peppers | 1 ounce red waxed pepper | cracked pepperoni | 2 cups unbleached plain flour, sifted
instructions: Cut sirloin tip roast in half, then make two thin slices. Place in the freezer and freeze. Pre heat oven to 400 degrees. Heat oil in the oven until fairly hot. Coat the chuck round with the flour. Cook in hot oil for 20 minutes. Remove meat from the pan and put to one side. Brown mushrooms in the fat in the pan. Put contents of the pan back into the pan. Add the bolognaise and red wine and bring to boil. Lower heat. Add pepperoni stir and cook for 30 minutes. Put meat back on the beef and pour the bolognaise mixture over it. Bake 40 minutes. Turn it over and cook for extra 25 minutes. The sirloin tip roast should be just set and well cooked, not falling apart let meat rest for at least 10 minutes. Serve sirloin tip with sauce.

title: Tarragon-Rice Crisp
ingredients: 2 cups cornmeal | 2 1/2 teaspoons dried tarragon
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Mix cornmeal, 1 tablespoon dried tarragon sprigs, and 1 teaspoon dried tarragon in an 8x8 inch baking dish.

title: Baked Beetroot
ingredients: 1 lb fresh beetroot, peeled and grated | 1 tablespoon brandy ( a good one ) | 1 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1 teaspoon celery, finely diced | 1 tablespoon fresh cherries or 2 teaspoons dried cherries
instructions: Put the grated beetroot in a colander and sprinkle over 1 tablespoon of the brandy. Leave to cool. Press out any excess liquid and drain well. Preheat the oven to 325°f whisk together the remaining ingredients in a bowl. Place the beetroot in an ovenproof frying pan and pour over the marinade. Cook for 30 - 40 minutes or until tender. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: arrowroot,icing sugar,parmesan,kaffir lime leaf,yellow onion,tzatziki,sea salt,cardamom pod
title: Easy  Thai  Sweet Onion Torte
ingredients: 1 yellow onion | 1 bunch tzatziki ( asian store ) | 2 tablespoons arrowroot, dissolved in | 1/2 cup icing sugar | 1 cardamom pod, crushed | sea salt | kaffir lime leaf ( optional ) | 1 cup icing sugar | grated or grated parmesan
instructions: Grate onion on the grater or food processor, and toss with the tzatziki. Spread the mixture onto a cookie sheet covered with clingfilm, and place under a hot grill until it begins to caramelise. This should only take 15 minutes, but up to 2 hours will do. Add more sugar if desired, and add optional cardamom or kaffir lime leaves. Spread mixture onto the hot tzatziki, and return to the preheated oven for just a few minutes. Cool, and cut into squares, making them larger if desired.

title: Salsa Mexicana
ingredients: 1 pint grape tomatoes | 1 tablespoon chili powder
instructions: Place tomatoes in a bowl, sprinkle with chili powder and stir to coat. Cover with plastic wrap and marinate in the refrigerator at least 4 hours, stirring occasionally.

title: Homemade Horseradish Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 2 vanilla pod, scraped
instructions: Put the horseradish into a plastic bag, using the scrapings of the vanilla pod. Add the scrapings of vanilla pod over the top, close the bag and shake to coat the surface of the hasters. Cover with plastic, let marinate for 3 days in the refrigerator, shaking the bag every so often and allowing the surface to become rinsed of any remaining liquid. Keep the bag covered at all times to let the food dry out, and use as a spread, garnish, or serve as an horseradish sauce for grilled vegees.

title: Nam Sod (Chilli Bean Dip)
ingredients: 250 g mung beans | 60 g soft cream cheese | 1 -2 teaspoon chili paste ( depends on chilli paste ) | 2 slices salt pork
instructions: Soak beans for 1 - 2 hours in plenty of cold water. Add cream cheese to cooked beans and mix well. Add chilli paste to taste to prevent it from getting soggy. Add salt pork and mix well. Serve with fresh coriander leaves.

title: Gorgonzola Wrapped in Lettuce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons gorgonzola | 1/4 cup almond milk | 1 head lettuce
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f. Rinse the lettuce and remove the hard rib outer leaves. With a paring knife, cut the inner layer as thinly as possible. This can be done in advance, but should the lettuce become limp by the time it is ready to be served and the oil oozed out of the lettuce just before the assembly of the dish. Spread the gorgonzola evenly over the base of a small ovenproof serving dish. Place the lettuce on top of the gorgonzola and pour the almond milk over the top. Sear the dish in the oven, for 15 minutes or until the cheese has melted. Cut each slice of lettuce into wedges and serve immediately.

title: Pappardelle With Parsley and Oil
ingredients: 500 g pappardelle pasta | 2 tablespoons oil | 1 bunch flat leaf parsley, leaves picked
instructions: Cook the pasta in a large pan of boiling water for 12 - 15 minutes until al dente. Drain. Toss the pasta with the oil, parsley and seasoning. Serve immediately.

title: Italian Cheese Bread (Bread Machine)
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast ( 1 packet ) | 2 tablespoons raisins | 1 cup cheese, grated ( parmesan, romano )
instructions: Stir together yeast, raisins, cheese, and 2 1/2 cups water in a large mixing bowl. Let stand in a warm place until bubbly, about 30 minutes. Stir to blend ingredients. Pour into 2 greased 5 x 3 loaf pans or two 7 x 1 inch loaf pans which have been greased or sprayed with pam. Cover. Let rise in a warm place until doubled in size, about 1 - 2 hours. Bake in 400f oven for about 25 - 30 minutes or until browned and loaf sounds hollow when tapped on the bottom. Let cool 5 - 10 minutes, then remove the crusts. Turn out onto a cooling rack. Slice and serve warm with slices of bread.

Random Ingredients: enchilada sauce,cilantro,pizza sauce,oregano leaf,green chili salsa,dill
title: Easy Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 1 can enchilada sauce ( mild | 1 jar taco sauce | 1 can green chili salsa ( hot ) | 2 tablespoons fresh dill, minced ( or cilantro ) | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves ( or cilantro ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried dill ( or cilantro )
instructions: Mix enchilada sauce, taco sauce, green hot sauce, dill, oregano, and dill with wire whisk, refrigerate for at least one hour or for up to 4 hours.

title: Zesty Italian Bread
ingredients: 1/2 lb swiss cheese | 1 serrano pepper | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Cut cheese into 1 cubes. Cut pepper in small strips. Spray with cooking spray. Bake 5 to 7 minutes or until cheese is melted. Serve topped with cheese.

Random Ingredients: simple syrup,orange zest,corn muffin mix,island dressing,snow pea
title: Island Nachos
ingredients: 1 package corn muffin mix | 1 package snow peas, frozen, chopped, thawed | 1/3 cup thousand island dressing | 1 teaspoon grated orange zest ( optional ) | 1/2 cup simple syrup
instructions: Prepare corn muffin mix according to package instructions and set aside. If using frozen snow peas skip these steps and proceed to make dressing. Combine dressing, zest, and zest in saucepan and cook over medium heat until sauce thickens and zest is lightly browned, approximately 5 minutes. Add peas and stir to combine. To serve, spoon sauce into 8 inch square glass baking dish and bake at 400 degrees for approximately 15 minutes or until crisp and lightly browned on top.

title: Spinach Salad
ingredients: 1 pound baby spinach, washed well and dried | 1/2 cup olive oil or olive oil | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh italian parsley | adobo seasoning | 1 package flour ( seasoned with salt and pepper )
instructions: To make salad dressing, mix together oil, parsley and seasoning in a blender or food processor. Refrigerate 30 minutes to allow flavors to develop. To make breadcrumbs, dry spinach in a clean kitchen towel for a few minutes, squeeze to remove excess water, and squeeze again so excess moisture is removed. Sprinkle over salads and toss. Sprinkle with bread crumbs and serve.

Random Ingredients: macaroni,bok choy,oyster sauce,chili oil,gingerroot,almond extract,pea,graham cracker crumb
title: Vegetarian Nanami
ingredients: 12 ounces macaroni ( i use small package ) | 4 ounces bok choy | 3 ounces pea pods | 2 ounces gingerroot | 2 tablespoons shaoxing oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 3 graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Peel shiitake and slice thinly. Clean wok and dry fry pea pods until crisp tender. Remove peas from the wok and cut into halves or quarters if they are smaller. Chop ginger and combine with oyster sauce. Bring water to boil and add macaroni and stir to separate. When pasta is about half cooked, add remaining ingredients and stir until mixed well and vegetables are cooked to desired texture. If vegetables aren't cooked to desired texture, add another 1/4 cup water. Serve with brown rice.

title: New Orleans Steak and Crab
ingredients: 2 tablespoons margarine | 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef chuck, cut into chunks | 1 lb boneless pork chop, cut int 1 inch pieces | 6 ounces green chili peppers, seeded and chopped | 1 1/2 cups lemonade | 2 1/2 ounces crabmeat | 16 ounces refrigerated roll dough
instructions: To make the dipping sauce, in a small saucepan, melt the margarine over medium low heat. Add the beef, pork, and green chilies. Cook and stir until the beef is cooked. Add the lemonade and crabmeat. Continue to cook and stir for about 5 minutes or until the liquid is reduced. Cut the roll dough into 12 long rectangles. On a lightly floured surface, roll out each rectangle to a 12 inch circle about 8 inches across and 1/8 to 1/4 inch thick. Cut these into triangles and arrange triangles in a circle on a serving dish that has been lined with plastic wrap. Place 1 1/2 cups of the dipping sauce in a small bowl and refrigerate until ready to use. Serve with bread and crackers.

title: Tropical Mango Chutney
ingredients: 1/2 medium white onion, roughly chopped | 2 medium mango chutney
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a microwave safe bowl. Warm the top until it just starts to melt, about 1 minute.

title: Potato Gratin With Cheese and Coconut
ingredients: 3 lbs potatoes, peeled and very thinly sliced | 4 ounces fontina cheese or 4 ounces grana padano | 4 ounces grated coconut
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. In a large, heavy bottomed pan, lay out a layer of thinly sliced potatoes, then top with a sprinkling of cheese and coconut. Continue until the layer is full. Bake until the top is golden brown and crisp and beginning to turn crispy on the edges. Cut into squares when the top is a golden brown color.

Random Ingredients: no salt tomato paste,basmati rice,yellow onion,black sesame seed,watercress,cream chicken soup,lettuce,bay leaf
title: Easy Baked Rice III
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 cup uncooked basmati rice | 1/2 cup diced yellow onion | 1/4 cup no-added-salt tomato paste | 1 1/4 cups watercress, chopped | 2 bay leaves | 1 tablespoon chopped black sesame seed | chopped lettuce | no-salt-added tomato paste
instructions: Combine condensed soup, rice, onion, tomato paste, watercress, bay leaves, sesame seed, and chopped lettuce in a greased 13x9 inch baking dish. Cover and refrigerate until chilled, about 4 hours. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Uncover dish. Bake at 350 degrees f for 35 to 40 minutes, or until rice is tender and sauce is bubbly. Cover and top with tomato paste.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,rustic white bread,saffron,leek,cream tartar,corn chip
title: Saffron Cream
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons saffron ( can be bought canned in jar ) | 4 slices rustic white bread, crusts removed | 2 leeks, white parts only, sliced thin | 2 cups sour cream ( low fat works best ) | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes ( to taste ) | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar ( optional )
instructions: Place saffron in a medium bowl and stir in enough water to make a pourable paste. Let stand 2 - 3 mins to infuse flavors. Pour into a small bowl and set aside. Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Pour off water from saffron bowl into another large bowl. Place bread on a flat surface and cover with the saffron water. Using your fingers, lightly rub the bread. Place bread on an ungreased cookie sheet and bake 10 - 12 minutes, flipping once, until the bread has just begun to color. Toast the leeks over medium heat in about 1/4 cup oil in a medium sized saucepan. When leeks are golden about 3 - 4 mins, pour in sour cream and sprinkle with the crushed red pepper flakes and cream of tartar. Cover pan with a towel and microwave on high for 2 minutes. Pour mixture over the untoasted bread and serve immediately. Store in an airtight container up to 2 3 months.

title: Smoky Beef and Pork Loin Burritos
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless chuck roast | 1 boneless pork loin | 5 cans button mushrooms | 1 red onion, cut in half, then chopped | 1 -2 teaspoon ground cumin | 2 lbs boneless pork loin
instructions: Remove the inner roast from the packaging, rinse well with water and drain. Trim all visible fat from the roast, and cut it into 3/4 inch cubes. Place meat in a gallon sized freezer bag. Add mushrooms and spices to bag, and shake to mix thoroughly. Add onions to bag, and squeeze handfuls of mixture into bag. Close bag, and place in refrigerator overnight. Remove meat from refrigerator, and discard the bag contents. Place meat on a flat pan, and place in freezer to let it freeze. Place the sliced pork on top of the meat, and set aside in fridge. Preheat grill to medium. Grill meat over low heat, turning meat occasionally, for approximately 75 minutes, or until all sides of the meat have a nice brown color on top of the meat.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,vanilla ice cream,stew meat,ancho chile powder,butter,baking potato,clove,yeast
title: Beef & Potato Gyros
ingredients: 6 ounces yeast | 2 tablespoons unsalted butter, melted | 6 ounces stew meat, minced | 2 cloves garlic salt, minced | 1 tablespoon ground ancho chile powder | 8 small baking potatoes, peeled | vanilla ice cream or yogurt, as desired
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together yeast, butter, chile powder, garlic clove and beef. Stir in potato, garlic salt and ancho chile powder until well blended. Let stand for 5 - 10 minutes, until potato mixture is creamy. Place potatoes on greased foil. Bake in a preheated 400f oven for 1 hour, stirring after 15 minutes, until potatoes are tender. Serve with your favorite toppings and additional toppings.

Random Ingredients: white flour,maraschino cherry,sirloin steak,kale,topping,maple syrup,garlic paste,rigatoni pasta
title: Beef With Kale and Topped Orzo over Rigatoni
ingredients: 4 sirloin steaks, 1-1/2 to 2-1/3-1/2 inch thick | 1/3 cup white flour | 5 tablespoons olive oil or 5 tablespoons bacon drippings | 2 bags kale, cut in 1-inch pieces ( stems removed ) | 1 tablespoon minced garlic paste | 4 cups rigatoni pasta ( small tubular pasta, broken into 3rds ) | 1 jar maraschino cherries, drained ( can use drained cherries if they are not available ) | freshly whipped topping ( optional ) | maple syrup, warmed ( optional )
instructions: Sprinkle steak with flour on both sides. Melt 2 tbsp oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add steak and cook 3 minutes on each side or until no longer pink. Remove and cover. Add remaining 3 tbsp oil. Add kale and garlic. Cook and stir 1 - 2 minutes or until kale is tender crisp. Add pasta and kale mixture to skillet. Toss to coat. Remove from heat. Top with crumbled bacon or drippings if desired. Serve immediately over toasted toasted toasted toasted pistachio nuts, if desired. To serve, ladle rice into shallow bowl and top with beef or sliced mushrooms or sliced mushrooms if desired.

title: Pesto Biscotti
ingredients: 3 packages gingernap cookies | 2 cups purchased pesto sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly grease a 9x13 inch pan. On a lightly floured surface, combine ginger cookies and pesto sauce. Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls onto the prepared pan. Bake in preheated oven until golden brown and crispy, about 30 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Hummus
ingredients: 2 teaspoons tahini | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 2 teaspoons tomato paste or 2 teaspoons chunky peanut butter
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a food processor or blender and process for 1 - 2 minutes. If more sauce is needed, add more peanut butter to the mixture. Taste and adjust the seasoning.

Random Ingredients: plain nonfat yogurt,red curry paste,corn flake
title: Cornflake-Yogurt Curry Crackers
ingredients: 1 cup corn flakes, finely ground in a blender | 1 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1 1/2 teaspoons red curry paste, or more to taste
instructions: Mix cornflakes, yogurt, and curry paste in a bowl to form the crumbs. Use a pastry bag fitted with a star tip to make crumbs into croutons.

title: Jicama Patties
ingredients: 1 3/4 pounds jicama, cut into 2-inch chunks | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 4 slices sourdough bread
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for grilling and lightly oil the grate. Sprinkle the jicama chunks with turmeric powder then place them on the grill. Cook until just about firm. Drain the jicama onto a paper towel lined plate and set aside. Cut away all of the excess moisture from the bread slices. Slice the bread into small slices and set aside. Serve the jicama chunks over the toasted turmeric bread pieces.

title: Cauliflower and Strawberries
ingredients: 1 cauliflower, cut in florets | 8 ounces fresh strawberries | 3 tablespoons mascarpone cheese | 1 tablespoon coconut oil | 1/2 teaspoon lemon peel, grated | 1/4 teaspoon allspice | 1/2 lb asparagus spear, cut julienne | fresh toasted sliced apple ( to garnish )
instructions: Place cauliflower, strawberries, cheese, mascarpone, coconut oil and lemon peel into a medium size serving bowl. Mix to combine. Toss to coat with cheese. Cover and chill for 2 hours at room temperature or 30 minutes at room temperature. Garnish with asparagus, sliced apple. Enjoy.

title: Homemade Korean Shortbread
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups white flour
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix the flour and sugar. Add the sesame seeds, and mix. If the mixture crumbles onto the flour, it will form a fine crumb. Add more flour if mixture is too wet and dry. Cover, and refrigerate for a minimum of 3 hours or overnight. If desired, form into an ungreased 9x5 inch loaf on a floured surface.. Cut into 24 pieces or 1 inch long pieces. Press a piece of parchment or wax paper between each piece so they won't stick together. Let stand for 30 to 45 minutes. Preheat oven to 400 degrees farenheit. Line two baking sheets with tin foil, letting the foil overhang the two pans. Sprinkle with extra flour if desired. Bake for 45 minutes. Remove from oven and remove foil. Slice crosswise into 3/4 inch slices or use for cookie cutters. You should have approximately 9 pieces. Cool completely before storing. Note, this recipe freezes so much that i can't wrap it up.

title: Spice Blend
ingredients: 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/2 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Use as directed on the spice mix.

Random Ingredients: taco sauce,cannellini bean,fish sauce,french baguette,ngo om,lemon,turnip,parsley
title: Soupa(Vegetarian Sandwich)
ingredients: 1 french baguette, cut 1/2 inch thick | 1 1/2 tablespoons fish sauce, or to taste | 1 1/2 tablespoons taco sauce | 1 tablespoon fresh parsley, chopped | 1 tablespoon minced fresh lemon rind, or to taste | 1 can cannellini beans, drained | 1 small turnip, cut into large chunks | 1/2 cup taco sauce
instructions: Preheat oven broiler. Arrange bread slices in a single layer on a baking sheet. Broil in the preheated oven until beginning to brown, 3 to 5 minutes per side. Transfer to a serving bowl. Combine fish sauce, 1 1/2 tablespoon taco sauce, parsley, and lemon rind in a bowl. Add beans, turnip, 4 tablespoons taco sauce, and remaining 1 teaspoon tomato paste. Stir to mix.

Random Ingredients: oregano,seasoning salt,rice wine,lettuce leaf,turmeric powder,parsnip,duck breast
title: Baked Duck and Parsnips With Moroccan Seasonings
ingredients: 6 whole duck breasts | 1 1/2 - 2 cups rice wine | 1 -2 teaspoon ground dry oregano | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | lettuce leaf, to serve | 1 parsnip, trimmed and cut into slices ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375f. Remove fat from each duck breast. Sprinkle with salt, then rub over the cavity, then rub the cavity cavity cavities with the seasoning. Place each piece in a deep casserole that is large enough to hold them in one layer. Pour 1 cup rice wine around them to cover the chicken and marinate for 30 minutes. Bake for 40 - 50 minutes, until cooked through and skin has wrinkled and blistered. Cut off any feathers with a sharp knife, if any, removing the giblets and white meat. Garnish with parsnips. Serve in a wide shallow dish on the side.

title: Tunisian rosemary Spraices
ingredients: 1 tablespoon harissa ( to taste ) or 1 tablespoon mild chili sauce ( to taste ) | 2 fresh rosemary sprigs
instructions: In a mortar or small bowl mash together harissa and rosemary to make a very small dip. Spread dip on the top of the spra before chopping any meat you would like.

title: Nargwa - Minted Peppers
ingredients: 2 cups thinly sliced peppers | 6 mint leaves
instructions: Fry the peppers in hot oil over low heat, turning once until crisp and golden on all sides. The peppers will take 1 minute or so when done. Place the peppers in the bottom of a bowl and cover with a layer of sliced mint. Spread pepper slices on top and squeeze lightly until saturated. Sprinkle with a little cold water and serve while hot. This can be served with any dip, such as pita bread or dip.

title: Agua Fresca De Atun (Cucumber Salad)
ingredients: 1 english cucumber | 1 1/2 cups brewed teabags ( guava or pineapple flavored ) | 1 cup cantaloupe, diced | 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg, to garnish ( optional )
instructions: Cut the english cucumber lengthwise into about half rounds. Remove the center core of the cucumber. Shake out the coarse outer skin. Cut the cucumber into thin slices. In a large bowl, combine the teabags, cantaloupe, and cucumber. Stir in the nutmeg, if using, and serve garnished with the toasted guavas.

title: Tortilla Potatoes With Dried Fruit & Tahini
