ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds russet potatoes, peeled and cubed | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained and quartered | 1 can red sweet potatoes, drained, rinsed | 1 can whole red cherries, in juice, drained and cut in quarters | red wine | 1/4 cup tahini | 16 ounces tortillas, heated
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add in the russet potatoes, return to a boil, and cook for 7 to 10 minutes, or until tender. Drain and set aside. In a large pot over medium high heat, pour in the contents of the bamboo shoots, sweet potatoes, and cherries. Stir and heat for 3 to 5 minutes. Spoon the potato mixture into warm tortillas, and sprinkle with tahini.

title: Crayfish and Basil Potatoes
ingredients: 1/2 lb peeled crawfish | 1 lb baking potato, peeled and sliced 1/4 inch thick | 10 fresh basil leaves, torn into small fragments
instructions: Arrange potatoes around edge of greased 12 inch skillet and sprinkle with salt. Place over medium heat. Add crawfish and a sprinkling of basil. Cook 1 minute and pour off and reserve some cooking fluid. Reduce heat to low and cover.

title: Rhubarb Scones
ingredients: 2 cups self-raising flour | 1 cup rhubarb, rinsed and picked through
instructions: Pre heat oven to 220c/gm. Rub flour through gratin dish, or alternatively, mix flour and rhubarb with your hands, then gently knead them together. Roll dough out to fit the size, and about 2cm thick, or mark with a scone/croissant as below. Bake at 220c/gm for 10 - 15 minutes until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: double cream,chick pea,whipping cream,grain rice,cardamom,currant,pasta shell
title: Creamy Cardamom Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 2 cups long grain rice, cooked | 2 cups double cream | 2 cups whipping cream | 1/2 cup currants ( optional ) or 1/2 cup raisins ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 tablespoon dried currant, snipped | 14 ounces cooked chick-peas ( drained well ) | 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped dried pasta shells
instructions: Prepare rice according to package directions. Set aside. Whisk together remaining ingredients in a large bowl. Pour cream and currants into a small saucepan over medium heat. Bring to a boil, then remove from heat. Add to remaining saucepan along with rice, currants, cardamom, and cooked chickpeas. Cover and set aside at room temperature to rest in a preheated oven 15 minutes. Stir once or twice during cooking. Serve immediately.

title: Bulgogi II
ingredients: 4 pounds beef top sirloin, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 1/2 cups ouzo | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 teaspoon paprika | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Place the cubed beef into a large ceramic bowl or baking dish. Pour ouzo over the beef and stir to combine. Sprinkle with oregano, paprika and cilantro. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 8 to 10 hours. Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Brush broiling pan with cooking oil and place the beef onto the prepared pan. Place baking dish with beef into the oven and broil for 45 minutes to 1 hour, or until meat is browned and internal temperature of meat has reached 140 degrees f. Cover the uncooked bulgogi as needed to keep warm.

Random Ingredients: corn flake,enchilada sauce,cardamom,corn tortilla,chocolate,rice wine vinegar,curry leaf
title: Chocolate-Curry Tacos by Todd Wilbur
ingredients: 1 cup corn flakes, crushed | 8 -12 corn tortillas | 1 -2 teaspoon rice wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon curry leaf, minced | 1/4 cup enchilada sauce | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Using a fork, mix together the crushed corn flakes, rice wine vinegar, and curry leaf. Spread about 1/4 cup enchilada sauce on each tortilla, top with about 1 to 2 teaspoons of the cereal mixture. Fold and secure with wooden picks. Place the tortillas on a baking sheet. Bake for 5 - 7 minutes, or until golden. Serve with the remaining enchilada sauce.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,pork loin chop,cottage cheese,green pea,raisin
title: Southern Pork Chop Casserole
ingredients: 1 boneless pork loin chop | 1/2 cup raisins | 1 package frozen green peas, thawed | 1 can cottage cheese | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place the pork chops in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Mix together the raisins, beans, and cheese. Pour the cheese mixture over the pork chops and vegetables. Cover tightly with foil. Bake 30 minutes in the preheated oven, then remove the foil, and continue baking until no longer pink in the center, about 45 minutes more.

title: Avocados & Rice
ingredients: 4 avocados, peeled and pitted | 2 cups long grain rice | 1/4 cup lemonade | 1/4 cup picante sauce | 1 teaspoon lime juice, freshly squeezed
instructions: Slice the avocados in half lengthwise and remove and discard the pit. Using the back of a spoon to push the avocado away from the skin, discard the skin. Cut the avocado flesh into 1/4 inch chunks and set aside. Place the rice in a bowl and set aside to soak. Combine the lemonade, picante sauce and lime juice in a small bowl and set aside. Preheat the oven to 350°f combine the rice with 3/4 cups water in a 2 1/2 quart casserole and bake uncovered, stirring frequently, for 15 minutes. After 15 minutes or so stir in the avocado chunks and return to the oven for 5 minutes more or till the rice and avocado are lightly browned and heated through. Serve the avocado mixture over the cooked rice.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,pecan,orzo pasta,bamboo shoot,blueberry,sugar raspberry gelatin,cake flour
title: Quick and Easy Vegetarian Crunch
ingredients: 1 box sugar-free raspberry gelatin, softened ( not gelatin powder ) | 1 package dried orzo pasta | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained | 1 1/2 cups cubed, frozen pound cake flour | 1 package blueberries, thawed | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 1/2 cup chopped pecans
instructions: Dissolve cheese yeast in 1/2 cup boiling water and set aside. Rinse jello, then cook orzo using package directions in boiling water until just tender. Drain. Meanwhile, in an ungreased 13 x 9 in pan, spread half the jello on the bottom. In a medium bowl, stir in 1 cup of the pineapple or pineapple juice. Stir in half the raspberries, then half the orzo. Sprinkle remaining jello over mixture and stir in remaining ingredients. Bake at 350°f for 15 miuntes or until puffed and golden. Cool 1 min., then turn out onto cooling rack. Cut into squares.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,tomato puree,beef brisket,parsley sprig,onion soup mix,linguine,sun tomato
title: Sun-Dried Tomato Beef Brisket (Low Fat)
ingredients: 4 lbs beef brisket | 1 packet onion soup mix | 1 can diced tomatoes with puree | 1 can tomato puree | 2 cups chopped sun-dried tomatoes | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 2 tablespoons finely snipped fresh parsley sprigs
instructions: Place brisket on rack in shallow roasting pan. Rub outside of brisket with 1 t dried onion soup mix and 1 t sun dried tomato per packet instructions. Pour tomatoes with puree, tomato puree, tomatoes, oyster sauce and parsley over brisket. Bake covered at 400 degrees f for 1 hour. Remove brisket from oven and spoon remaining liquid over brisket. Cover pan tightly and continue to bake another 30 minutes, or until meat falls apart and thermometer reads 140 degrees f for rare, 140 degrees f for medium rare or 160 degrees f for well done.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile,salmon fillet,vegetable broth,baking powder,splenda granular,beef tenderloin,kumara
title: Smoked Salmon With Kumara Mash
ingredients: 2 salmon fillets or ( 4 ounce ) salmon fillets | 1 tablespoon dried chipotle chile | 1 tablespoon splenda granular ( sugar ) | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1 cup mixed vegetables, such as kumara ( baby corn, snowpeas, peas, etc. ) | 6 ounces smoked kumara ( japanese sweet potato ) | 8 g low sodium beef broth or 8 g reduced-sodium beef broth plus 2 teaspoons ( low sodium )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f line a baking sheet with parchment paper or spray with baking spray. Arrange salmon fillet in a single layer on the baking sheet. Pulse chipotle until chopped but not pureed. Combine chile with splenda. Spread mixture evenly over both salmon fillets. Sprinkle each fillet with 1/2 tsp salt. Bake for 9 minutes. While salmon is cooking, peel potatoes from their skin. Slice potato and place in a bowl with the broth and potato. Chop until potatoes are roughly 2cm. Drain kumara on paper towel. Cook potatoes in the reduced broth until just tender, 5 to 7 minutes. While still warm, cover with plastic wrap. Set aside until serving time. Meanwhile, in a small saucepan, cook kumara in a saucepan of simmering water for 10 minutes or until tender. Remove from heat and set aside until cool. When the salmon fillet has baked, transfer to a plate. Cut into 2cm thick slices. Arrange on the plate with potatoes with salmon. Divide mash evenly among plates. Top with salmon fillet. Fold the parchment/sprayed parchment over the fish and serve immediately.

title: Apple-Apple Beef Burgundy
ingredients: 8 ounces gala apples - peeled, cored, and finely chopped | 1/2 cup chopped fresh apricots | 1/4 cup sweet chili sauce | 2 lbs lean boneless beef chuck, trimmed | 1/2 cup fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. In a large bowl, stir together onions, apples, apricots, sweet chili sauce, and beef. Spray a 3 1/2 to 4 quart baking dish with cooking spray. Arrange beef mixture on top. Pour enough water into pan to come just below top of beef. Cover and bake in preheated oven 30 minutes. Uncover, and sprinkle with cilantro. Bake until meat is heated through and top is browned, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cream cottage cheese,rosemary sprig,monterey jack pepper cheese,lard,couscous,horseradish,part mozzarella cheese,cajun seasoning
title: Cheese and Couscous Salad
ingredients: 6 tablespoons prepared horseradish or 6 tablespoons prepared horseradish dressing | 1/2 cup light cream-style cottage cheese | 1 cup couscous | 1/2 cup grated part-skim mozzarella cheese | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack pepper cheese | 1/4 cup fresh rosemary sprig ( optional ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons cajun seasoning | 1 tablespoon lard ( light or dark )
instructions: Heat 3 t olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add 3 t horseradish and cottage cheese. Remove from heat and let cool to room temperature. Meanwhile, cook the couscous according to package directions to the package directions. Drain the couscous and place in a bowl, toss with a little extra olive oil over the top and set aside to cool. When the couscous has cooled to room temperature, stir in the cheeses, 1/2 cup rosemary. Taste the dressing. If it is bland, add more horseradish or basil, if desired.

title: Fillet of Beef
ingredients: 1 sirloin | 1/2 teaspoon celery seed | 1 can bamboo shoots, sliced thinly | 2 boneless tilapia fillets | 1 cup white vinegar | 2 cups uncooked spiral shaped pasta
instructions: Slice sirloin into thin slices about 1/4 inch wide. Sprinkle beef with celery seed. Cover and let stand at room temperature for 30 minutes. Meanwhile, rinse cutlets in the sink, dry well and cut into 2 1/2 inch strips. Heat a large saute pan over medium high heat. Add 2 tablespoons of oil. Working in batches, add beef strips about 3 at a time and saute until browned on all sides, about 3 to 4 minutes per batch. Pour excess oil onto a baking sheet. Set aside. Repeat process with remaining 1 cup of oil, drained and sliced beef. Bring reserved 2 cups vinegar to boil in a medium saucepan and add pasta in a thin stream, stirring, cooking 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: coriander seed,rosemary,pistachio,self raising flour,lime juice,feta cheese
title: Basquad
ingredients: 150 g self-raising flour | 1 teaspoon coriander seed | 1 teaspoon rosemary | 1 tablespoon roasted pistachios | 100 g feta cheese, crumbled | 2 teaspoons lime juice
instructions: Toast the coriander and rosemary in a dry frypan over low heat until the aroma is released. Add the oil, followed by the flour and coriander seeds, season and mix. Cook until lightly browned, remove from the heat, stir in the pistachios, and fold in the feta. Pre heat the oven to 200c/fan 180c/gas add the lime juice and mix until smooth. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead lightly. Shape the dough into a 6cm thick patty and transfer on to lightly greased oven tray. Sprinkle over the roasted pistachios, then bake for 20 minutes. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: tortellini,red cinnamon candy,red pepper flake,potato,red potato,tortilla,liquid honey,fontina cheese
title: Tortellini Con Patate All' Empanizado - Potatoes and Tortillas
ingredients: 1 package simply potatoes diced potatoes, with onion | 2 tablespoons red cinnamon candies | 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 2/3 cup liquid honey | 1 package tortellini, cooked | 1 package tortillas | 1 package red fontina cheese, cut into 6 slices | 1 jar roasted red peppers and candy, drained
instructions: Dice potatoes into 1/2 inch pieces. Combine red cinnamon candies or cinnamon mix, honey. Layer 1 cheese slice and 2 tablespoons red potato mixture into the bottom of a 9 x 13 casserole dish or other deep, rectangular baking dish. Layer tortillas over top, and finish off topping with the other cheese slice and remaining red potato mixture. Bake in a preheated oven at 350 degrees about 25 minutes until crust is golden brown. Remove cover and bake until bubbly.

title: Apple Sage & Sage Pits
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried sage | 2 lbs golden delicious apples, peeled and chopped
instructions: Mix sage with apples, then chill. You may need to use a little less or none at a time.

Random Ingredients: white chocolate chip,coconut milk,chili oil,seasoning salt,corn flake
title: Easy Peanut Coconut Crisp
ingredients: 4 tablespoons white chocolate chips ( do not use unsweetened ) | 1/2 cup corn flakes, crushed | 4 tablespoons light coconut milk | 1/8 teaspoon hot chili oil ( or less to taste ) | 1/8 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: Mix peanut butter with coconut milk and heat until boiling. Combine cornflakes and chili oil then add to peanut butter mixture. Stir until smooth and then add again stirring until smooth. Add seasoned salt and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,water chestnut,date,italian parsley,onion,tabasco sauce
title: Ginger Tasting Ginger Date Chutney (Chuka Masala)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 3/4 cup water chestnut, chopped | 2 tablespoons chopped onions | 1/4 cup dates, chopped ( pitted ) | tabasco sauce, to taste | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh italian parsley
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and store in tightly covered jar in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: mushroom,tapioca starch,red kidney bean,mango,white tuna water,parsley sprig,sauce
title: Salsa Tuna With Peppered Rinsed Onions and Beans
ingredients: 1 can red kidney beans, rinsed and drained ( or 1 cup cooked and drained canned beans ) | 1 red mango, peeled, pitted and chopped | 1 ripe mango, peeled, pitted and sliced into rounds | 2 tablespoons tapioca starch | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley sprig | 3 tablespoons hot sauce | 2 teaspoons steak sauce | 1 can white tuna in water, not drained
instructions: Add tuna, steak sauce, rice wine vinegar, chopped mango and parsley to a food processor. Pulse until almost smooth. Add bean curds and process just until combined. Do not overprocess. Serve immediately.

title: Beet and Coconut Rice Balls
ingredients: 2/3 cup cooked jasmine rice | 2 1/2 cups grated fresh coconut or 2 1/2 cups grated medium coconut | 1 cup plain bread crumbs | 1 can beets, drained, finely chopped | 1/4 cup dry bread crumbs
instructions: Mash the cooked rice with a potato masher. Transfer the rice mixture to a mixing bowl. Add the coconut and bread crumbs and mix well. Stir in the beets to form about a 1 inch long log. Shape about 20 balls on a sheet of waxed paper. Cool until the can is cold enough to handle comfortably. Working one at a time, roll the balls in the bread crumbs to coat them on all sides. Repeat with the remaining balls. Keep the coating between batches, refrigerated, flipping the coating once, for up to 2 days.

Random Ingredients: curry leaf,green chile pepper,salmon,black tea,half,arrowroot,red wine vinegar,stewing beef
title: Curried Salmon With Chiles and Chiles
ingredients: 16 ounces stewing beef, thinly sliced | 4 ounces green chile peppers, seeded, cut into julienne strips | 10 curry leaves | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons arrowroot | 1 cup half-and-half | 1/4 cup black tea ( strongly brewed ) | 1 1 lb salmon, cut into chunks
instructions: Place beef, chile peppers, curry leaves, vinegar, and arrowroot in a resealable plastic bag.

Random Ingredients: creole seasoning,date syrup,bean,pork loin roast,lime,dark rum,banana
title: Lori's Pork Roast on Fruit Skewers
ingredients: 2 1/4 - 3 lbs boneless pork loin roast | 1 cup light rum, divided | 1 cup dark rum, divided | 1/3 cup pitted dates syrup | 1/3 cup maple syrup | 2 tablespoons creole seasoning | 2 medium bananas, sliced | 2 medium limes, quartered
instructions: Combine all marinade ingredients and pour over pork. Cover and refrigerate 1 - 24 hours. Slather pork on skewers and grill or broil.

Random Ingredients: mirin,lemon juice zest,purple onion,garlic salt,sunflower oil,maraschino cherry
title: Japanese Steak Marinade for Grilling Veggies
ingredients: 2 tablespoons mirin ( japanese sweet wine ) | 2 tablespoons lemon juice or 2 tablespoons lime juice | 1 tablespoon sweet orange maraschino cherry, dried | 1/8 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 teaspoon sunflower oil | 1 purple onion, sliced thinly on the diagonal
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium size bowl and stir. Add sliced onion to marinade and toss. Refrigerate 6 - 8 hours before grilling. Note, can be used to marinate lamb or pork, beef, duck or chicken breasts and vege.

Random Ingredients: turnip,pizza sauce,lasagna noodle,radish,seasoning salt,beef stock cube
title: Crock Pot Lasagne
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground beef | 1 packet onion soup biscuits ( the 1 packet of onion soup biscuits can be bought from the deli ) | 1 beef stock cube, dissolved in | 1/4 pint beef stock or 1/4 pint water | 4 tablespoons pizza sauce | 4 radishes, sliced thinly | salt, to taste
instructions: Brown ground beef in a pan and add onion soup biscuits. Use the beef stock to thin the mixture. Then add the tomato sauce. Put meat mixture over biscuits and add stock or water. Stir, add salt to taste.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,half,velveeta cheese,red curry paste,tart apple,onion powder,chicken bouillon granule
title: Spicy Velveeta Dip
ingredients: 1 cup velveeta cheese, cut up | 8 ounces red curry paste | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1 tablespoon instant chicken bouillon granules | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 5 teaspoons chili oil | 1 small apple, grated ( optional )
instructions: Dump first 3 ingredients into crockpot. Mix until well mixed. Cover. Cook on low for 4 hours or until cream begins to thicken. Add apple a few minutes before serving. Top with grated cheese if desired.

title: Tajine Ki Tarkari Dango (Tajine Chicken Skewers)
ingredients: 1 lb chicken breast fillet | 1/2 cup celery | 1/2 cup nuts ( fresh roasted or shelled, or roasted unsalted peanuts ) ( optional ) | 1 cup fresh grated coconut or 1 cup coconut milk ( or coconut amchur ) | 1 pinch asafoetida powder ( optional )
instructions: Slice chicken breast into thin strips. In a medium size bowl. Add ground spices and mix well. Add chicken, and coat in the mixture. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator over night. Thread chicken strips onto skewers. Place on skewers, soaked bamboo skewers could be used in place of the coconut milk. Cook in the oven or grill. Serve warm.

title: Homemade Soft Tacos (Soft Tacos)
ingredients: 1 can fat-free refried beans | 2 flour tortillas
instructions: Preheat the oven at 400 degrees f. Use a 9 inch cast iron skillet for easy cleanup of the cast iron skillet during cooking if desired. Pour the refried beans into the cast iron skillet. Cover and cook until the beans are bubbling and hot, about 20 minutes. Spread 1 to 2 tablespoons of taco seasoning over each tortilla.

title: Spice Flavoured Cutlets, Scandinavian Style
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef cubes | spices
instructions: Place beef cubes in a saucepan with plenty of cold water. Cover and leave to stand for 1 hour. Turn over cubes, sprinkle with spices and leave overnight in a warm place, covered, in a cool place.

title: Scotch Brod With Carrots
ingredients: 4 ounces quark cheese | 1 ounce sliced fresh basil leaf | 10 baby carrots | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning
instructions: In the bottom of double boiler, melt the quark cheese and basil, stirring constantly with a fork, until it gets bubbly. Place carrots into warm soup and slowly pour over cheese. Add italian seasoning to taste and place over low to med. Heat for 15 min or until the carrots are tender.

title: Paprika Substitute
ingredients: 1/2 cup paprika | 1/4 cup capers, minced | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 1 tablespoon mustard powder
instructions: In microwave proof bowl, stir paprika, capers and half and half. Microwave on high for 2 minutes or until warm to touch. Stir.

Random Ingredients: chicken thigh,anise seed,heavy cream,vegetable oil lard,kielbasa,ginger juice
title: Aka Kielbasa Chicken a La Impress
ingredients: 2 -3 chicken thighs | 3 tablespoons vegetable oil or 3 tablespoons lard | 2 teaspoons anise seeds | 6 -7 ounces kielbasa ( polish kielbasa, or other thin sliced sausage ) | 1/4 cup heavy cream or 1/4 cup half-and-half | 1/4 cup ginger juice
instructions: Rinse and pat dry the chicken. Sprinkle all sides with anise seeds and place them in a zipper bag or a dish, with just enough water to cover them. Let stand to marinate for two hours. In a large dutch oven or large frying pan, heat up the oil on medium high heat. Lightly brown the chicken, but don’t brown it. Remove the chicken and drain it off. Add the anise seeds and kielbasa to the pan and sauté for about 30 seconds until they have browned. Don’t worry overly much. Reduce the heat to medium and add the cream or half and half. Cook for another 15 - 20 minutes, stirring often to prevent the mixture from burning or sticking to the bottom of the pan. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: ale,beef steak,flour tortilla,apple cider,ancho chilies,chicken fillet
title: Beer Beer Beef Fajitas
ingredients: 4 beef round steak, sliced | 4 chicken fillets | 1 can beer | 1/4 cup apple cider | 1/4 cup flour tortilla | 2 ancho chilies, seeds removed
instructions: Arrange beef, vegetables and seasonings in a large frying pan. Pour beer over. Heat over medium high to high heat, cover. Simmer for 3 to 5 minutes or until meat is cooked, vegetables and seasonings are cooked and meat is heated through. Serve with corn tortillas.

Random Ingredients: white wine,pesto sauce,jicama,broiler fryer chicken,beef stew meat
title: Chicken Pesto-Chicken on a Skillet (Oamc)
ingredients: 4 broiler-fryer chickens, halved, reserving wingettes | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce | 1/2 cup dry white wine | 1/3 cup sargento fresh basil, packed | 1 1/2 cups thinly sliced jicama
instructions: Preheat broiler heat. In 4 - 5 inch skillet, stir together pesto sauce and wine and bring to boil over moderately high heat. Add broth and simmer, uncovered, for 10 minutes. Using tongs or poultry pins, lower and discard wingettes from chicken, and arrange chicken on a broiler rack that has been sprinkled with cornstarch. Bake at 400 degrees for 5 - 10 minutes or until just cooked through. While chicken is cooking, in nonstick skillet, sauté basil about 3 minutes. Stir in jicama and cook about 2 minutes longer until crisp tender. Slide chicken over to plates and add basil. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: icing sugar,lemon thyme,sake,saffron thread,peanut butter,nuoc nam
title: Lemon Thyme Peanut Butter (Nahm Chae)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons lemon thyme, finely chopped | 1/4 cup sake | 3 tablespoons icing sugar | 1/4 cup peanut butter | 1 teaspoon saffron threads, crushed or 1 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1/2 teaspoon icing sugar, for finishing
instructions: Place the first five ingredients in a bowl and mix well with a spoon. Then mix in the last three ingredients until light and creamy. Divide between four small bowls, sprinkle with a little extra sesame oil, and drizzle on some melted dark soy sauce if you wish. For a savoury peanut butter serve on top of steamed fish, chicken, vegies, carrots, etc.

Random Ingredients: plum tomato,broccoli,coriander powder,beef broth,vanilla schnapps,tortilla,mango juice,basil leaf
title: Tortilla and Mango Curry
ingredients: 10 -12 corn tortillas, cut in half | 1 1/2 lbs beef or 1 1/2 lbs veggie burger ( i use 3 small ones ) | 1 container mango juice | 1 can plum tomatoes, with jalapenos, drained ( about 6 tomatoes, not in the asian food aisle ) | 1 can unsweetened beef broth | 1 1/2 teaspoons coriander powder | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon dry basil leaves, crushed | 1 tablespoon vanilla schnapps | 1/2 cup small broccoli, cut up
instructions: Chop meat. Cut vegetables into 1 inch pieces. Combine everything in a dutch oven over low heat stirring occasionally until meat is brown.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheddar cheese,rice noodle,fruit,lamb shoulder
title: Lamb and Noodle Kugel
ingredients: 1 small uncooked rice noodles, broken | 1 - 1 1/2 lb boneless lamb shoulder, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1/2 - 3/4 cup fruit, coarsely chopped ( such as pineapple, applesauce, or sultanas, of choice ) | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend
instructions: Bring 6 cups water to a boil in a large kettle. Add noodles and cook until crisp tender. Drain and rinse under cold water until cool enough to handle. Set aside. Cook lamb cubes in a saucepan in boiling water to cover for about 5 minute or until browned. Combine noodles and lamb. Stir in fruit and 1/3 cup cheese. Transfer to a large bowl and sprinkle with additional cheese. Garnish with remaining cheese and serve in warm bowls.

title: Grilled Merguez or Chicken Tacos
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds boneless chicken, cut into 8 pieces | 2 tablespoons capers | 3 dried red chile | 16 limes | 16 small limes, halved
instructions: Place the chicken in a bowl. With tongs, toss in the capers, red chile, and lime halves.

Random Ingredients: apple juice concentrate,parsley leaf,fish fillet,corn tortilla,green cardamom
title: Fish Tacos (Pas Con Pomientes)
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried apple juice concentrate | 1/4 teaspoon green cardamoms ( pod, crushed ) | 16 ounces fish fillets, cut into bite-size pieces | 12 corn tortillas | fresh parsley leaves, to garnish ( optional )
instructions: Mix apple concentrate and green cardamom in small bowl.

title: Basil Pork Tenderloins
ingredients: 4 pork tenderloin | 1/2 cup parsnip, finely chopped | 1/2 cup asiago cheese, grated | 1/4 cup fresh basil, chopped | 1/3 cup breadcrumbs | soy sauce ( for dipping the loins ) | pineapple slice ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400 degrees. Lightly oil a baking sheet. Cut a pocket in each pork tenderloin and set aside. Mix together all the stuffing ingredients, except for the pineaple, so they are all thoroughly combined. Reserve the topping mixture for dipping. Divide the stuffing between the 4 pork tenderloins, stuffing them slightly if necessary. Sprinkle the pineaple over the tops of each tenderloin. Place a roasting pan in the oven, bake for 20 to 30 minutes or until the internal temperature is 170 degrees. Allow to cool slightly, before serving. To serve, serve with warm pina colada and lemon wedges.

title: Coconut Brown Rice Cake
ingredients: 300 -400 g long grain rice | 1 tablespoon coconut, grated | 1/4 teaspoon mustard | 1/8 teaspoon vanilla | 1 teaspoon dark soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon caramelsauce ( to taste )
instructions: Place grated coconut in a pan with a little bit of water and boil together until liquid is reduced to 2/3rds. Mix rice, vinegar, soy sauce, vanilla, dark soy sauce and caramel sauce with water in a small pot and bring to boil. Stir constantly to avoid sticking. When rice is tender, remove from heat and cool. Add caramel sauce to rice with desired amount and mix well for a few seconds before adding any extra ingredients or milk. Cool to room temperature place in refrigerator and set out in the middle of the fridge overnight. Remove from fridge a few hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: green chile pepper,chat masala,turmeric,cocoa powder,liquid smoke flavoring,kale,chunky spaghetti sauce
title: Chickhaya 'n Spaghetti!'
ingredients: 2 cans chopped green chile peppers, drained | 3 cups chunky spaghetti sauce | 2 cups chunky hot italian style spaghetti sauce | 1 tablespoon chili-flavored liquid smoke flavoring, or more to taste | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1 1/2 teaspoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 teaspoon chat masala, or more to taste ( optional )
instructions: Mix green chile peppers, spaghetti sauce, and hot italian style hot sauce together in a large saucepan.

Random Ingredients: biscuit,coconut milk,marjoram,asafoetida powder,ha avocado,broth,rom tomato,heavy whipping cream
title: Avocado and Coconut Cannoli
ingredients: 2 hass avocados - peeled, pitted, and mashed | 1 container coconut milk | 2 cups chicken stock or 2 cups broth | 1 1/2 cups heavy whipping cream | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 1 pinch dried marjoram | 1 1/2 cups grated roma tomatoes ( about 1 medium ) | 16 cans biscuit rounds, finely crumbled
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, whisk the avocados with the mashed avocado until smooth. Stir the coconut milk and broth into the mashed avocado mixture. Combine the whipped cream with the asafoetida powder, marjoram, and tomatoes in a small bowl. Dip each biscuit round into the cream mixture, then into the biscuits crumbs to coat. Arrange the cannoli in a 9x13 baking dish. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until heated through.

title: Dirty Rice
ingredients: 2 cups jasmine rice ( long cooking ) | 1 teaspoon wine ( optional ) | white pepper ( optional )
instructions: Put rice in a pot. Add wine if using the wine. Bring to a boil. Cover the pot and turn down the heat to medium/low. Cook for 20 - 25 minutes or until rice has absorbed all the wine. Check rice often and continue to cook, if necessary, at least an additional 5 minutes or until liquid is absorbed and rice is tender. Before serving, sprinkle pepper over rice if desired.

Random Ingredients: sriracha sauce,orange juice concentrate,chicken breast,blood orange,parsley flake,garlic salt,vanilla bean
title: Mock Chicken Breasts in Sriracha Syrup
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts | 2 tablespoons fresh blood oranges or 2 tablespoons lime juice concentrate | 2 tablespoons frozen orange juice concentrate | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 2 teaspoons dried parsley flakes | 4 whole blood oranges or 6 whole blood oranges | 8 teaspoons sriracha sauce
instructions: Place chicken breasts between two sheets of plastic wrap and pound with a meat mallet until they are about 1/4 inch thick. Place the chicken in a bowl and add the blood orange juice or lime concentrate, orange juice concentrate, garlic salt, dried parsley flakes, and the orange slices. If you can find blood orange juice concentrate cut it up with scissors. Make sure there is room for the orange and blood orange slices. Refrigerate the chicken for a few hours or overnight. Preheat broiler, place the chicken breasts on a foil lined baking sheet. Broil for approximately 20 minutes or until they are cooked through. Use gloves to remove the chicken from the oven to a cutting board and slice in slices. Use the cooking oil to saute the sliced chicken slowly until the garlic salt dissolves, then add the orange juice concentrate. This is the syrup. Serve with rice.

title: Spicy Carrots
ingredients: 2 lbs carrots, peeled, trimmed | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprigs
instructions: Boil carrots in small pot of water for 15 - 20 minutes or until tender. Drain. Combine carrot, thyme and salt to taste.

title: Cannelloni
ingredients: 1 package baby carrots | 1 jar whole milk ricotta cheese
instructions: Rinse carrots and place in medium saucepan with milk, bring to boil. Lower heat and continue cooking for 20 minutes or until carrots are tender. Take off heat and let cool, place in blender or food processor until they are smooth.

title: Posh-Posh
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ghee | 2 lbs stew meat | 1/2 lb white mushroom | 8 ounces mozzarella cheese
instructions: Melt ghee in pot. Brown meat well on eveything. Remove meat. Cover with a tight fitting lid, put on low heat. Simmer for 8 hours. Serve with a salad. Variation.

title: Sweet Grilled Grits w-Peach Melba Br
ingredients: 3 1/4 lbs brown sugar, cut into 3 1/4-inch chunks ( about 3/4 each ) | 7 ounces almond paste | 3 tablespoons adobo sauce ( preferably goya brand, not elachi brand ) | 10 1/2 ounces peach slices | 5 3/4 ounces demerara sugar | 4 black peppercorns
instructions: In large resealable food storage plastic bag, combine salt and sugars. Add fruit of choice and toss to coat evenly. Place bag in medium bowl. Pour enough warm water over 1/2 of bag to fully immerse contents. Press air out of bag through metal colander and transfer contents to resealable food storage plastic bag. Seal bag and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Place bag airtight in a large, heavy skillet, or heavy saucepan covered with aluminum foil. Place skillet over medium high temperature and add peach slices. Cook 15 minutes, flipping over slices occasionally. Remove from pan and set aside. Remove all but 1 tablespoon of liquid. Stir sugar and peppercorns into liquid. Cook, stirring frequently, until syrup thickens slightly, 3 to 5 minutes. Remove pan from heat. Add reserved peach slices. Let cool slightly. Preheat grill to high. Lightly oil grate. Place 2 to 3 cups of brown grits on greased grate, pressing firmly to prevent scorching. Grill grits 5 to 7 minutes, or until the bottoms are firm and top is dry, stirring occasionally. Keep grits warm in 200°f oven until ready to serve, about 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Serve warm, passing remaining glaze at table.

Random Ingredients: triple sec,sea salt,parsley,purpose flour,cream chicken soup,wheat tortilla,mushroom
title: Creamy Mushroom Tortilla Chips
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | 2 tablespoons triple sec | sea salt | 1/2 cup chopped fresh mushrooms | 6 whole wheat tortillas | 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley
instructions: In a bowl, mix together the soup and flour. Stir in triple sec. Add the mushrooms and stir until heated. Spread equal amounts of the soup on the tortilla chips, leaving 1/4 inch for chips to cover. Sprinkle with parsley. Fold tortilla over and press to close.

title: Asparagus Chicken
ingredients: 6 chicken breast halves | 12 medium fresh asparagus spears, trimmed | fresh herb, of your choosing
instructions: Grill the asparagus over very hot coals turning frequently. When cool enough to handle, slice in half and set aside. Brush or spray the asparagus with cooking spray and place on grill rack sprayed with a little cooking spray. Grill asparagus until cooked throughout, about 5 minutes or until tender. Turn chicken and grill asparagus until done, about 3 minutes or so, brushing the asparagus with butter if unsure about the thickness.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon granule,kosher salt,asparagus,part ricotta cheese,artichoke heart,bean sprout
title: Artichoke Asparagus and Artichocritious White Bean Sprout Lasagna
ingredients: 3 tablespoons chicken bouillon granules | 1 1/2 cups frozen thin asparagus, thawed, patted dry | 1 jar quartered artichoke hearts, drained, liquid reserved | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 1 package frozen chopped mixed beans sprouts, thawed, patted dry | 1 package part-skim ricotta cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Lightly grease a 9x13 baking dish. In a bowl, mix chicken bouillon granules, asparagus, artichoke hearts, salt, and half of bean sprouts. Arrange 3 lasagna sheets on a work surface. Place 1 filling ingredient, in order listed, in the center of each, and roll up tightly. Place, seam side down, in baking dish. Pour enough reserved bean sprout liquid to cover. Cover baking dish, and bake 1 hour in the preheated oven. Remove from oven, sprinkle the ricotta over the top, and return to the oven until cheese is melted, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: oil olive,poblano chile,cumin seed,chili seasoning mix,habanero pepper
title: Hot and Spicy Roasted Shrimp
ingredients: 1 tablespoon oil ( preferably olive oil ) | 1 tablespoon ground cumin seed | 1/4 teaspoon chili seasoning mix | 1 poblano chile, seeded and chopped | 1 habanero pepper, seeded and chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees f. Heat oil in a small skillet over medium heat. In a small bowl, combine cumin, chili seasoning mix, poblano chile, and habanero chile. Spread the mixture evenly over the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Roast shrimp in the preheated oven for 12 minutes, or until cooked through. Remove from heat and serve hot.

title: Quinoa With Garlic, Bechamel and Black Olives
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons wasabi | 1 cup quinoa | 2 cups water | 1 can sliced black olives | 2 cans sliced water chestnuts | 2 teaspoons dried sage leaves | 1 teaspoon ground cloves | 1 carton store-bought wasabi | 1 can navy beans, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bring the water to a boil in a saucepan. Add the quinoa, cover, and remove from heat. Let stand, covered, for 10 minutes. Remove half of the quinoa, and fluff with a fork. Stir in olives, water chestnuts, sage, and cloves. Stir in the remaining quinoa. Spoon mixture into a casserole dish. Arrange remaining quinoa around the quinoa. Drizzle with olive oil. Bake in the preheated oven until beginning to brown, about 40 minutes. Cool to room temperature, then refrigerate overnight. To serve, reheat in the microwave.

title: Broiled Chickpeas With Garbanzos
ingredients: 250 g dried chickpeas | 1 3/4 cups beef stock or 1 3/4 cups vegetable stock | 3 3/4 teaspoons turmeric powder | 8 slices french baguettes, 1/2 inch thick slices ( or 8 slices of whole wheat ) | 1 cup hot vegetable stock
instructions: Soak chickpeas overnight in cold water. Cook over low heat, covered, until starting to soften, then rinse and drain. Place chickpeas, stock, turmeric powder and bread slices on a rack in a broilerproof pan and broil until lightly toasted around edges. Lift toast out of oven. Spread with oil. Warm chickpeas, stock and hot vegetable stock in a saucepan on the low heat. Cover dish and cook till chickpeas are soft.

title: Quick and Easy Mexican Corn
ingredients: 1 can sweet corn ( or frozen ) | 1 package taco sauce ( to taste )
instructions: Mix all ingredients and add taco sauce.

title: Potlucks with Avocado-Corn Salad
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups vegetable stock | 1 cup potato, shredded | 1 cup corn | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped fresh rosemary sprigs | 8 romaine lettuce leaves | 8 slices smoked avocados
instructions: Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the potato and corn.

title: Cranzoni (Italian Snack Mix Cookies)
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups crushed corn flakes crumbs | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1 ounce vodka | 1/2 cup grated dark chocolate
instructions: Mix crushed corn flakes, tomato soup and vodka. Form into marble sized balls and roll in grated dark chocolate.

Random Ingredients: tabasco sauce,pork loin,onion,kaffir lime leaf,vegetable oil olive,pork loin chop,asparagus
title: Pork Stir-Fry
ingredients: 3 tablespoons vegetable oil ( olive oil is best ) | 3 whole kaffir lime leaves | 350 g boneless pork loin ( or use boneless or skinless chicken breasts, etc. ) | 2 pork loin chops ( tenderloin cut in strips with the fat ) | 1 small onion, cut into strips | 1 cup fresh asparagus, trimmed and cut in 1 inch pieces | 2 teaspoons tabasco sauce ( or your favourite hot sauce )
instructions: In a deep frying pan or pot, heat oil over high high heat. Stir fry kaffir lime leaves in hot oil for one minute. Remove lime leaves and pour oil into the pan and stir fry pork lightly and onion in oil for 3 - 4 minutes or until it is cooked through and just slightly charred.

Random Ingredients: confectioner sugar,snail,pork loin,broccoli,monterey jack cheese,lettuce,loaf bread,mirin
title: Chinese Oyster
ingredients: 24 snails, cleaned | 1 tablespoon grated monterey jack cheese | 2 tablespoons grated fresh ginger | 3 cups shredded fresh lettuce | 1 loaf bread, toasted | 4 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 1 cup sliced fresh broccoli | 2 tablespoons mirin
instructions: Combine grated cheese, shredded ginger, lettuce, toasted bread, sweet pepper sauce and confectioners' sugar in a bowl. Place oysters on a serving platter and top with sweet pepper sauce and green onion.

title: Roasted Cauliflower and Blueberry Salad (Algerian Cava)
ingredients: 1 large head cauliflower, broken in half | 200 g blueberries ( frozen mayonnaise can also be used ) | 100 g dark sweet chocolate, broken into small pieces | 1 tablespoon hazelnuts ( can also add roasted almonds ) ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon allspice | 2 teaspoons ground cardamom powder | 1 teaspoon red wine vinegar ( or more if necessary ) | 1 teaspoon mayonnaise
instructions: Preheat oven to 180oc. Line a roasting tin with aluminium foil and spray with cooking spray. Place half the cauliflower in a roasting tray and drizzle with a little oil. Mix the remaining cauliflower, blueberries with the broken chocolate, hazelnuts, allspice, cardamom and vinegar. Spread this mixture over the cauliflower and drizzle with the remaining olive oil and cover. Place in the oven and then cook for 50 - 60 minutes until the cauliflower is tender and well roasted. Leave to cool. When ready to serve put a serving plate on top of the cava and tip roasting tin over the foil to create a hollowed top to catch drips of steam. Spoon the roasted mixture back onto the cauliflower, sprinkle with the nuts and serve.

Random Ingredients: scotch bonnet pepper,pork tenderloin,paprika,coconut milk,pork,cream tartar
title: Baked Pork or Pork Tenderloin With Sushi Roll
ingredients: 1/2 scotch bonnet pepper | 1 teaspoon paprika | 3/4 lb pork tenderloin ( about 5 to 3 1/2 slices ) | 1/3 cup coconut milk | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | paprika ( optional )
instructions: Preheat your oven to 450°f. Slice the scotch bonnet pepper into 1/4 inch thick slices, removing the seeds. Cut into thin strips with a knife. Cut the slices in half again to make 3 pieces of pork. Place slices flat on a baking sheet or roasting pan, and sprinkle evenly with paprika. Bake 20 to 25 minutes, remove and let cool. Mix the coconut milk with the cream of tartar. Slice the pork and roll the pork slices in the coconut sauce. Serve with sushi and japanese rice or steamed green beans.

title: Chilly Lime Sauce
ingredients: 1 teaspoon tomato paste | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 -2 teaspoon fresh chives | 2 tablespoons lime rind, finely shredded ( optional )
instructions: Mix the ingredients in a medium size saucepan and simmer over a medium heat for 35 - 40 minutes, stirring occasionally to ensure even cooking, it should get thickened towards the end of the cooking. Use right away or store away with a good lid. For a thicker consistency, add a little water or milk before cooking. If freezing, leave the sauce in the freezer before starting as this will cause it to thicken up.

Random Ingredients: basil leaf,red chili pepper flake,shrimp,balsamic vinegar,red chili pepper,raisin,shallot,cooking sherry
title: Rita's Shrimp Pilaff
ingredients: 1/2 lb medium shrimp, peeled and deveined ( tails left on ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar, divided | 1 small shallot, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon red chili pepper flakes, crushed | 1 -2 fresh red chili pepper, chopped | 2 tablespoons raisins | 2 tablespoons cooking sherry or 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 6 -12 basil leaves ( optional )
instructions: Combine shrimp with 1/2 teaspoon of vinegar. Chill shrimp in refrigerator for 1 hours. Combine shrimp, red pepper, raisins, chili flakes, salt and pepper in medium serving bowl. Combine remaining 1/2 cup vinegar, shallots and chilli in saucepan with remaining garlic, bring to boil over medium high heat. Add shrimp mixture.

title: Roasted Broccoli, Sausage and Horseradish Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/2 cup coarsely chopped salami ( or other cooked ham ) | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped fresh horseradish | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh horseradish or 2 tablespoons bottled horseradish sauce | 1 package frozen broccoli florets | 8 slices rye bread, lightly toasted and crusts removed | 4 large egg whites | 2/3 cup coarsely chopped shelled pistachios ( about 1/2 cup )
instructions: Preheat oven to 275°f spread 1/4 cup horseradish on each slice of bread. Arrange slices on a baking sheet. Bake until golden brown for about 8 minutes on each side. Set aside to cool slightly. Set aside. Spread remaining 2 tablespoons horseradish on top of each toasted slice of bread. Spread chopped ham on toasted bread. Spread horseradish on each toasted slice of bread. Spoon chopped broccoli on top of ham. Top with broccauer. Break egg whites into a small bowl. Gently stir in remaining 1/3 cup coarsely chopped shelled pistachios. Spread over bread slices. Garnish with additional chopped pistachios and additional toasted bread slices.

title: Spaghetti Verde
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs pork shoulder, cubed | 2 - 3 1/2 cups vegetable stock | 2 tablespoons crushed spaghetti ( or rotelle if desired ) | pepper
instructions: Cook the pork on low for a few minutes, stirring periodically. After you have browned the pork, remove it to a platter and set aside. Add a bit of vegetable stock to the broth and heat up on the stovetop, then cook the spaghetti until it is al dente. Pour the spaghetti into the pot and add the liquid. Taste and season with pepper.

title: Ranch Noodles with Cellophane Chips
ingredients: 1/2 pound cellophane noodles | 1 package corn chips
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add cellophane noodles, and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, or until tender. Drain. Gently fold cellophane chips into hot noodles. Serve immediately, garnished with lemon wedges.

title: Rice-Ahead Mole Risotto
ingredients: 1 can condensed tomato soup | 2 cups arborio rice ( about a 1 1/2-ounce loaf ) | 1/4 cup chopped onion ( or 1/4-1/3 cup onion and 1/4-2tbsp. dried onion ) | 2 tablespoons minced canned chipotle chiles ( or to taste ) | 1 whole pinch ground mace ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium sized saucepan. Bring liquid to a boil. Cover and turn heat to low. Cook until rice is tender, about 20 minutes and liquid is absorbed about 15 - 20 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes, then fluff with fork. Serve.

Random Ingredients: apple cider,american cheese,water chestnut,white breadcrumb,tomato soup,dark corn syrup,grape leaf,egg yolk
title: Tomato Stuffed Grape Leaves
ingredients: 3 egg yolks | 2 cans condensed tomato soup | 1/4 cup distilled white breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup water chestnut, chopped | 1 can dark corn syrup | 1 cup shredded white american cheese | 1 package grape leaves, thawed and dried
instructions: Mix egg yolks and soup in large bowl until well blended. Stir in bread crumbs, water chestnuts, corn syrup, and cheese. Add water in small increments until mixture is moist but holds together. Stuff a grape leaf with mixture. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Place 1/3 off center on rack of oven, shiny side down, for 20 minutes. Place seam side down on foil lined baking sheet and bake for 10 - 15 minutes. Turn over and bake an another 8 - 10 minutes till slightly puffed. Watch closely so they do not burn.

title: Chicken With Apricots
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chopped red onions | 1 tablespoon chopped of fresh mint | 1/2 teaspoon accent seasoning ( or seasoning and 1/2 tsp. each ) | fresh ground black pepper | 6 dried apricots, halved | 2 whole chickens legs | 1 1/2 cups chopped cauliflower | mint, to garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. In a small bowl, combine onion, mint, accent and black pepper. Spread half of the onion mixture evenly over the bottom of an oven roasting pan. Place chicken legs on top of the onion mixture, skin side down. Roast for 20 to 25 minutes, or until juices run clear when the juices run from the apricots through the thigh and drumsticks of the chickens. Transfer to a platter, and cover tightly with foil. Let rest for 15 minutes at room temperature or in the refrigerator, covered. Meanwhile, rinse the apricots with hot water and drain well. In a small bowl, lightly crush the apricots with a fork. Set aside. Toast the remaining onion mixture in the oven for 10 to 15 minutes, mashing them and seasoning to taste. To serve, arrange the apricots on top of the chicken. Spoon the apricot mixture on top of all, and garnish with mint.

Random Ingredients: fava bean,snow pea,sesame oil,duck,kraft italian dressing,radish,cayenne
title: Chinese Hot Duck With Fava Beans
ingredients: 4 duck, legs with thigh ( you can use as many thighs as you like from one whole leg ) | 6 -8 radishes, washed and quartered | 8 snow peas, sliced on the diagonal into 5 inch lengths | 3 cups bottled fava beans, rinsed and drained | 1/4 cup cayenne ( or to taste ) | 1/2 cup kraft zesty italian dressing | 1 tablespoon sesame oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. In a roasting pan, place duck legs in single layer. Tuck wings under the skin on all sides, do not remove skin. Place meaty side up in a single layer and set aside. Roast duck and bake at 375°f for 40 - 45 minutes or until just browned. For the soup, remove duck and discard in a large bowl. Remove bones. Pull meat from thighs and discard skin, shredding meat and return to bowl with juices. Place back in roasting pan and pour in enough rinsed fava beans to cover. Simmer until heated through. Remove from heat and set aside to cool while you prepare soup. Place a roasting platter over medium heat to hold food and ladle soup into soup bowls. Arrange duck on top of soup. Add radish and snow peas to soup and ladle soup over them. You can serve the soup with sesame oil to sizzle the fava bean fragrance. I have also added more fava beans and a little more sesame oil to each serving. Each guest can top soup with freshly ground black pepper to taste, if desired.

Random Ingredients: shrimp,beef broth,almond extract,creole seasoning,rosemary,plain yogurt,bean sprout,italian sausage
title: Sausage and Shrimp With Baked Beans and Yogurt
ingredients: 1/2 lb mild italian sausage | 16 ounces canned fat-free refried beans and sprouts | 3 tablespoons creole seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon dried rosemary | 1/8 teaspoon almond extract | 12 fluid ounces reduced-sodium beef broth | 1 lb uncooked medium shrimp, peeled and deveined | 3/4 cup plain low-fat yogurt
instructions: In a skillet, combine sausage, beans, creole seasoning, rosemary, and almond extract. Cook until hot and fat is rendered, 5 to 8 minutes. Stir in beef broth. Preheat oven to 400°f in a 9x13 inch baking dish, toss shrimp with yogurt.

title: Simple and Low Fat Caesar
ingredients: 1/3 cup brown sugar | 3 -6 slices bacon | 1/4 cup soya sauce | 1 1/2 cups chicken broth | 1/4 cup grand marnier or 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary | 10 warm tortillas
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Wrap bacon around skewers to keep the bacon slices from falling off during baking. Bake for about 10 minutes. In a saucepan combine the brown sugar, soya sauce, chicken broth and grand marnier. Bring to a boil and cook for five minutes. When the bbq is hot and starting to smoke/dunk the tortillas in the sauce, place them all on the rack of a broiler pan. After five minutes you need to flip and take it out and drain. Spread the sauce over the tortillas and then pile the bacon on top.

title: Soup Mix and Parmesan Coffee
ingredients: 2 packets dry onion soup mix | 4 tablespoons instant hot coffee | 1/4 cup freshly grated parmigiano
instructions: Mix ingredients together and store in small freezer containers. To serve, reheat and serve over hot cooked noodles of your choice.

Random Ingredients: vinegar,tomato puree,gruyere cheese,potato traditional,brie cheese,triple sec,olive oil cooking spray,vanilla sugar
title: Potato Cheese Fondue with Brie
ingredients: olive oil flavored cooking spray | 1/4 cup tomato puree | 1/4 cup vanilla sugar, divided | 1/4 cup triple sec | 1 1/2 pounds thick-cut brie cheese | 1 pound shredded gruyere cheese | 3 pounds potatoes traditional mashed potatoes | 1 tablespoon sherry wine vinegar
instructions: Coat an 8x8 inch square baking dish with cooking spray. Combine tomato puree, vanilla sugar, and triple sec in a saucepan.

title: Hokkaido Noodle Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces egg noodles | 7 large eggs, beaten | 1 1/2 tablespoons mustard seeds | 3/4 cup corn | 1/2 cup chopped green onions
instructions: Boil noodles until still firm, about 7 minutes. Drain and rinse noodles and set aside to cool. Cook eggs in large skillet with mustard seeds and a little water, stirring constantly, until set, about 1 minute. Dip cooked noodles into egg mix, coating both sides. Arrange noodles on plate. Top with onions. Serve warm.

title: Watermelon Pizza With Gorgonzola Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 bunch fresh parsley | 1/2 cup superfine sugar | 1/2 cup water, plus | 1 tablespoon water | 8 ounces watermelon, peeled, seeded, trimmed and sliced | 2 cups pizza sauce, bottled, such as ragu robusto or 1 1/2 cups homemade italian-style pizza sauce | 1/2 lb gorgonzola cheese, shredded and divided
instructions: To make gorgonzola, place 1/2 cup water in small nonmetal bowl. Cover and let stand 1 hour. Drain thoroughly. Cut remaining 1/2 cup water into 2 cups lengths. Place in small nonmetal saucepan. Cook over medium heat until water begins to bubble. Reduce heat to low.

title: Apricot Jelly Spread
ingredients: 1/4 cup apricot jam | 1/8 teaspoon onion salt
instructions: Combine jam and onion salt, stirring until smooth.

Random Ingredients: chuck,graham cracker crumb,beef tenderloin,corn oil,tomato puree,lamb shank,coriander,kiwi fruit
title: Lamb Shank Stew
ingredients: 1 lb chuck, trimmed | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 1 beef tenderloin, trimmed | 8 lamb shanks, with the bone, cut into 1-inch pieces | 2 kiwi fruits, peeled, quartered, and seeded | 1 tablespoon tomato puree | 1/4 cup dry graham cracker crumbs | 1 tablespoon ground coriander
instructions: Trim excess fat from chuck roast and discard or reserve. Cut into 3/4 inch cubes. Trim excess fat from lamb and cut into 3/4 inch cubes. Heat oil in a dutch oven or heavy large pot over medium high heat until hot but not smoking. Working in batches, add meat to pot, brown on all sides. Return all meat to pot and add kiwifruit, tomato puree, and cracker crumbs to meat. Stir to mix. Raise heat to high and immediately cover pot. Cook for 12 minutes or until meat and kiwifruit is tender. Transfer shank to serving platter.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,green bell pepper,sherry wine
title: Spanish Pepper Salad
ingredients: 1 green bell pepper | 1 tablespoon sherry wine | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice and zest
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees f. Cut the bell pepper lengthwise into fourths, removing seeds and tender inner membranes. Place the bell pepper in a glass baking dish, and add the sherry and lemon zest. Roast for about 20 minutes. Remove the bell pepper from oven, and let stand for about an hour. Serve immediately or cool completely.

Random Ingredients: red lentil,greek yogurt,pepper flake,mint leaf,canadian bacon
title: Lentil & Canadian Bacon Dip (Low Fat and Low Sugar)
ingredients: 1/3 cup red lentil | 1 tablespoon greek yogurt ( thick yogurt ) | 1 tablespoon finely chopped mint leaf ( fresh ) | 1 dash hot pepper flakes | 2 ounces canadian bacon ( finely chopped )
instructions: Mix lentils & yogurt in glass bowl & sprinkle each with mint, hot pepper & canadian bacon. Mix well & refrigerate 4 hours or overnight.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock cube,nori,hot green chili pepper,whipping cream,wheat pasta
title: Pasta With Creamy Salsa
ingredients: 1/3 cup whipping cream | 2 tablespoons chicken stock cubes | 1 -2 teaspoon minced hot green chili pepper | 1 tablespoon toasted nori ( flying fish cake ) | 1 lb whole wheat pasta, cooked
instructions: In a small frying pan, heat cream and stock cubes. Add hot green chilie. Add nori and immediately remove from heat. Cook whole wheat pasta according to package directions.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,tuna vegetable oil,leek,pork tenderloin
title: Tuna-Pork Tenderloins
ingredients: 6 loin ( thick and fairly flat slices ) of pork tenderloin ( about 400g total weight ) | 2 leeks, white part only, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup chopped leeks ( white part only ) or 1/4 cup spring onion, finely chopped ( white part only ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: If you are using a pork tenderloin, trim the fat. Cut slices into 4 equal portions. Spread the leeks and onion thinly across the whole surface of the pork and press to flatten slightly. Sprinkle the salt and pepper on the sliced pork. Place the meat in a lightly oiled gratin dish and pour over boiling water. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes or a further 30 minutes, turning the meat over occasionally. Preheat the grill to medium. Place the pork, fat side down, on a heat proof plate and grill for about 5 minutes until the fat shows no pink colour. Turn the meat over and cook for a further 5 minutes. Carefully lift the pork onto a warm platter, brush with the cooking juices and serve with steamed seasonal vegetables.

title: Chinese Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 1 chicken stock cube | 7 ounces oyster sauce
instructions: Combine the ingredients in a small saucepan, bring to the boil and simmer for 2 - 3 minutes. Allow to cool a little before opening to check for flavour. Serve with jasmine rice, chinese noodles and spring onion greens or green vegetables.

title: Pesto Genovese
ingredients: 1/4 - 1/2 cup pecorino romano cheese | 3/4 - 1 cup port wine
instructions: Put pecorino and port in a small bowl or jug with a tight fitting lid, and pour in the port. Mix well, and let sit at room temperature for an hour or so. Keep refrigerated.

title: Kaffir Powder
ingredients: 2 tablespoons orange blossom water | lime wedge ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together.

Random Ingredients: cashew,french bread,red chili powder,sage leaf,mulato chile
title: Indian Bruschetta
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread ( optional ) | 5 large fresh sage leaves, whole | 1 jar of diced dry roasted chilies | 1/4 cup cashews, coarsely chopped | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder or 1 teaspoon curry powder
instructions: Slice the french loaf crosswise on the diagonal. If not using loaf, use a serated knife to score the slices. Place the slices of bread in a salad bowl or tupperware container with a lid. Cover with liquid of your choice. Shake and mix well. Drain all the liquid from the jar of roasted chilies. Place in a microwave safe bowl and microwave on high for 1 minute. Stir. Add the other hot ingredients and toss to blend. Cover and microwave on high for 1 - 2 minutes or until the mixture becomes moist and soft. Drain the bread slices on paper towels, reserving the liquid. Place on a cookie sheet and sprinkle the cashews over the bread. Let stand 15 minutes before serving. This can be served hot or cold.

title: Mexican Bolo
ingredients: 2 lbs lard | 1/2 lb four-cheese mexican blend cheese | 1 dash sugar ( optional )
instructions: Prepare a pastry cutter with a 6 - 8 inch diameter. Cut the cheese into 12 squares, then roll each square to flatten. Put a piece of cheese on the bottom of a skillet that has been sprayed with a nonstick spray. Place it on top of the cheese. Sprinkle a dash of sugar on top. Put the skillet in medium heat until a cube of bread browns at the bottom, turning occasionally. Remove from heat and allow to brown, about 2 min on each side. Cut into squares and serve warm with salsa. Enjoy.

title: California Roll-Ups
ingredients: 1/2 cup ricotta cheese | 4 avocados - peeled, pitted and sliced | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning
instructions: Spread the cheese onto the center of the rolled up avocado slices. Roll the avocado around the cheese. Sprinkle on the italian seasoning. Wrap the roll up into a ball.

Random Ingredients: asiago cheese,chili paste,potato,curry,red chili pepper flake,sugar substitute,pistachio
title: Japanese Sweet Potato Stir Fry (Potato Stir Fry)
ingredients: 3 sweet potatoes, medium, peeled, cut into 1/4-inch slices | 5 tablespoons asiago cheese, grated on large holes of box grater ( approximately 80 gr ) | 2 tablespoons roasted pistachios, finely chopped | 1/2 red chili pepper flakes ( or to taste ) | 4 tablespoons sweet chili paste ( ajika ) | 2 tablespoons sugar substitute | 1/2 teaspoon curry
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons oil in skillet over medium high heat. Stir fry the sweet potatoes until golden. Remove from skillet. Wipe out skillet. Add other 2 tablespoons oil to hot skillet. Add chopped pistachios. Sauté for 3 minutes until pistachios are fragrant. Stir in curry powder, sweet chili paste, and sugar substitute. Add sweet potatoes to skillet. Toss to coat potatoes with sauce. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium low. Cover, and simmer for 20 minutes or until a thermometer reads 160 degrees f. Toss and mix every three minutes till the sweet potatoes are coated with sauce. Serve over white rice or egg noodles.

title: Pizza Seasoning
ingredients: 3 tablespoons pizza seasoning ( lawry's, similar name is found in any commercial store ) | 1 teaspoon mrs. dash seasoning salt
instructions: Mix all together. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: couscous,sun tomato oil,roasting chicken,green apple,celery rib,black pepper
title: Oven Vegetable Couscous (Couscous, Chicken, Turkey, Etc.)
ingredients: 1 roasting chickens, 2 1/2-3 lbs. ( or 2 1/2-3 lbs. turkey ) | 1 cup quick-cooking couscous | 2 -4 large celery ribs, quartered or 2 -4 large carrots, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch peices | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, thinly sliced | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper, to taste | 1 green apple, peeled, cored, sliced
instructions: Rinse chicken under cold water, pat dry, and pat dry with paper towels. Place the chicken in the bottom of a 3 quart casserole with 12 inch diameter diameter diameter diameter diameter uncut rim of the pan with 2 inch high sides. Arrange the celery in a single layer, trimming if necessary, and sprinkle with 1/4 cup tomato oil. Toss the salad mix evenly with the vegetables in the casserole. Sprinkle over the remaining 1/4 teaspoon black pepper and the green apple. Cover tightly with a tight fitting lid. Turn the oven to 375 f, place the casserole in the middle of the oven and bake for 1 hour. Remove the lid and bake, uncovered and undisturbed, for 1 1/2 hours or till the chicken is very tender and the mixture is fairly thick and creamy. Transfer the pan, covered tightly, to a serving platter and let cool for 15 minutes. Cut into pieces and serve.

title: Gourmet Pistachios
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped pistachios | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1/4 cup honey
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spread pistachios out on a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until toasted, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: red chilies,apple juice,cooking barley,soy sauce,parsley,shell pasta
title: Chinese Barley and Soysauce Pasta
ingredients: 300 g shell pasta, broken in half | 150 ml sweet soy sauce | 3 tablespoons apple juice | 1/4 cup quick-cooking barley ( rice barley ) | 1/2 red chilies, chopped and seeded | 1 tablespoon fresh parsley, sliced thin
instructions: Put pasta in a pan of boiling water and simmer until cooked, drain. Whisk all other ingredients and pour over pasta in a saucepan. Add some more soy sauce if necessary.

title: Truffle Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 jalapeno, minced with seeds | 1 teaspoon serrano pepper, minced with seeds | 1/2 cup oil | 1 cup cashews, chopped | 1 cup pistachios, chopped | 1 cup pineapple juice | 1/4 cup light rum or 1/4 cup orange juice | 2 tablespoons grand marnier
instructions: Puree the peppers and nuts in a blender. Transfer to a bowl and set aside. Combine the pineapple juice, rum or orange juice, grand marnier and sugar. Stir the mixture into the pepper mixture. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours. To serve, serve with prawns boiled in boiling water and lemon wedges on the side.

Random Ingredients: oyster,half cream,palm sugar,edible flower,rice vinegar,black sesame seed
title: Black Sesame Oysters in Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup sweet rice vinegar | 1/4 cup oyster sauce | 1/3 cup half-and-half cream | 1 teaspoon black sesame seeds | 1 tablespoon palm sugar | 1 teaspoon shelled black sesame seeds
instructions: For the oyster sauce, combine all ingredients in small frying pan over medium heat. Bring to boil, reduce heat and simmer until thickened. Ladle hot sauce over oysters and serve..

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning,potato starch,chicken,tomato green chilies,monterey jack cheese,red chilies
title: Taco Potatoes With Hot Chilies & Cheese
ingredients: 500 g chicken, cut up ( i use chicken leg quarters or thighs ) | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning | 100 g chopped tomatoes and green chilies | 1 teaspoon potato starch | red chilies, in pieces ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons monterey jack cheese, grated ( optional )
instructions: In a pot, heat up the oil at medium heat. Add the chicken then cook, stirring until well browned. Add taco seasoning and let cook for 3 minutes. Add diced tomatoes and green chiles, potato starch, and red chilies, if using, and simmer for 2 minutes. Serve the chicken & hot chilies with rice.

Random Ingredients: olive,bacon dripping,fennel seed,dark chocolate,tomato puree,basil pesto,toast,balsamic vinegar
title: Welsh Tomato & Bacon
ingredients: 2 ounces good quality dark chocolate, chopped | 1 ounce bacon drippings ( from canadian bacon ) | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 teaspoon olive ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 3 tomatoes, cut in half lengthways | 1 tablespoon tomato puree | 2 slices crusty toasted english leaves
instructions: Place the chocolate, bacon grease, fennel and olive if using in a heatproof bowl and melt over a low heat. Stir often until the chocolate has melted and the mixture is smooth. Remove from the heat and stir in the vinegar. Place the tomatoes and their juice in a saucepan, season with salt and freshly ground black pepper, then cover the pan and set over a medium heat for 3 - 6 minutes or until piping hot and starting to soften slightly. Remove the tomatoes from the pan, cut the tomatoes into slices and return them to the pan for 1 - 2 minutes more. Pour the chocolate mixture over the tomatoes, add a little of the tomato juice and warm up, still stirring. Taste and add salt if necessary. To serve, spoon the tomato sauce into warm toasted english muffin/cookie/bread/sandwich dishes. Top with toasted toasted slices.

Random Ingredients: lime zest,chili paste,chickpea,flat rice noodle,cumin powder,seasoning salt,leek
title: Peruvian Cilantro Chickpea and Leek Noodles
ingredients: 4 -6 ounces cooked chickpeas | 2 leeks ( white parts only, cut diagonally into 1/4 inch strips ) | 1 cup flat rice noodles | 2 tablespoons fresh lime zest, finely shredded | 2 -3 tablespoons chili paste | 1 tablespoon cumin powder | seasoning salt
instructions: Place chickpeas into a food processor and pulse until coarsely chopped. Stir in leeks. Pour boiling water over noodles to cover, then soak in water for at least 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Drain noodles and rinse with cold water till no longer cloudy. Drain. Bring 8 cups salted water to a boil in a large pot. Add noodles and cook on medium heat for 5 minutes or till al dente. Drain noodles and rinse under cold water to cool. Meanwhile, stir fry cumin and chili paste in a large skillet till fragrant. Add noodles and cilantro mixture, mixing well. Season with salt to taste. Serve at once from a warm dish with lettuce leaves and avocado slices for dipping.

Random Ingredients: coffee ice cream,plain yogurt,caper,honey,chicken bouillon,bisquick,celery,rice flour
title: Sweet Bisquick Danish
ingredients: 1 cup plain yogurt | 1/3 cup honey | 2 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon | 1/3 cup rice flour | 1/4 cup apple cider or 1/4 cup honey | 1 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon | 2 cups bisquick, all-purpose flour | 1/3 cup celery, diced | 3/4 cup cooked shredded chicken meat ( from 16 oz. pkg. ) | 1/3 cup drained fresh capers
instructions: Combine first five ingredients and add to dry ingredients, mix well. Add remaining ingredients and knead by hand until blended. Dough should be firm and malleable. Place on lightly floured board and knead lightly until smooth and elastic. Turn out, cover and let rest one hour. Roll dough out to a rectangle. Spread with 1/4 cup chicken mixture. Sprinkle with celery, bacon or other meats if desired. Roll up like a jelly roll and place on well greased cookie sheet. Repeat process with other dough. Bake at 425°f until browned. Cool 1 to 2 minutes. Cut diagonally into 12 slices.

Random Ingredients: green olive,rotel,paprika,onion soup mix,wide egg noodle,tomato
title: Oven Spanish Noodles
ingredients: 2 cans diced tomatoes ( i use hunt's ) | 1 can rotel ( or any brand ) | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 8 ounces dried wide egg noodles, cooked and drained | black olive ( optional ) | paprika ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients in dutch oven, stirring occasionally to combine, until onions are tender. Pour into 2 quart baking dish. Cover and cook on 400° for 25 - 30 minutes, or until heated through and bubbly. Sprinkle with paprika, if desired.

title: Choc Chip Shop White Chocolate Chestnut Coconut Kiss-Mocha Cupcakes
ingredients: 6 ounces chestnuts | 7 ounces sweetened coconut powder | 2 ounces icing sugar | 4 ounces sweetened coconut powder | 8 ounces white chocolate, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 160c. Using a small chopping blade, pound chestnuts until fine, then roughly chop. Transfer chestnuts to a bowl and add all the remaining ingredients. Mix with a wooden spoon. Line base and side of 24 cupcake trays with greaseproof paper, then spoon in mixture. Bake 15 minutes testing that the muffins' will not turn brown. Stand 2 minutes before turning out onto a wire rack and leaving in the tin to cool. Store in an airtight tin for up to 3 days.

title: Maple Oxtail and Pork
ingredients: 1 pound oxtail | 1 head cabbage, cored and shredded | 2 packages maple syrup | 1 pound pork fat, cut into slices
instructions: Prepare oxtail, and sear it in a skillet over medium heat. Remove and discard any remaining oil from the skillet. Place cabbage shreds in the skillet, and coat with maple syrup. Cook and stir until heated through and cabbage is coated with maple syrup. Pour oxtail over cabbage mixture, and stir in pork fat. Cover, and simmer about 10 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: cornflour,turkey meat,cocoa,pork shoulder,apricot jam,tomato paste,pepperoni,red food coloring
title: Chilean Pork with Piquant Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 package of red food coloring ( such as skor ) | 2 lbs lean pork shoulder | 1/3 lb turkey meat | 1/3 cup chopped pepperoni | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa | 1/4 cup red food coloring | 1/4 cup cornflour | 1/4 cup apricot jam
instructions: Cut the pork shoulder into 3 inch pieces and place in a large baking pan. Dissolve the cocoa and food coloring in 1/4 cup warm water. Add the cornflour gradually, stirring and making sure to scrape the bottom so it dissolves. Add the jam and mix well. Pour the mixture over the pork in the baking pan. Cover the pan with a piece of foil and bake at 325f for 1 hr or until the pork is tender and the marinade has slightly caramalized and thickened. Allow the pork and marinade to cool completely before slicing into 1/2 inch slices, or if you would like it to be slightly more crispy, freeze in plastic bags.

title: Toppings for Pastries
ingredients: 2 large poblano peppers, sliced 1/4 thick | 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | filling : | 1/2 cup shredded mexican blend cheese or 1/2 cup shredded velveeta cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 425ºf. Spray poblano peppers with cooking spray. Place on rack in a shallow roasting pan and bake 15 to 20 minutes or until peppers are very soft and lightly charred. Remove from oven and cool. Place peppers on a cutting board and cut into small strips. Tie with kitchen string or butcher twine. Add cheese and chili flakes to peppers. Cut in strips using kitchen scissors. To freeze, put in an airtight plastic plastic bag and allow to soften overnight. To bake right away, spread poblano strips over a work surface. Spoon 1 teaspoon filling onto strips. Arrange in an aluminum foil lined 9 inch cake pan, seam side down. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until heated through.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice,rice vinegar,canadian bacon,soda water,beef eye,red kidney bean,bread
title: Salad Shiraz
ingredients: 1 lb beef eye round, 1-inch-thick slices | 1/4 lb canadian bacon ( about 4 slices ) | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 4 teaspoons lemon juice | 2 cans red kidney beans | 1 -2 cup of flavored soda water ( or sprite if you wish, just be sure to rinse it well )
instructions: Trim fat from both sides of the ribbed roast beef. Slice crosswise into 8 thick ribbons and set aside. Cut bacon slices into 1/4 chunks and set aside. Place lemon juice in a small container with the lemon juice and stir until smooth. Add the garlic, vinegar, and lemon juice to the container.

Random Ingredients: tamari,onion powder,pineapple juice,coconut milk,date,vinegar,cremini mushroom,cooking oil
title: Pineapple Mushroom Saute
ingredients: 1/4 cup pineapples in juice, about 2 cans ( i don't really measure, just use what's leftover ) | 1/2 cup tamari ( or soy sauce, not sweet soy sauce. i used light soy sauce ) | 1/3 cup cremini mushroom, sliced | 1/4 cup onion powder ( or white onion ) | 1/4 cup vinegar | 1/4 cup cooking oil | 7 teaspoons low-fat coconut milk | 4 pieces preserved dates, finely chopped ( i broke-up them into bite-sized pieces )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl and stir to combine. Set aside at least 1 hour or overnight if possible. Heat 1 tsp of oil in a small pan. Add the soaked dates and cook until they swell up. Add the soy sauce and vinegar and stir to combine. Turn off heat and transfer mixture on a plate. You can now leave the dates to absorb the dressing if doing the same thing and store them in the fridge.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,tart apple,italian breadcrumb,rice noodle,vanilla yogurt,red chile
title: Spicy Coconut-Apple Rice Paper Rolls (Sbd P1)
ingredients: 1 bag rice noodles | 1 can sweetened coconut milk ( not lite ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla yogurt | 1 red chile ( seeded and finely minced ) | 6 cups tart apples ( finely chopped ) | 1/4 cup italian style breadcrumbs
instructions: Cook noodles until al dente, drain. Toss with coconut milk, vanilla yogurt and minced chili and set aside. Combine apples and breadcrumbs. Mix well and roll into 1 balls. Bake on cookie sheet in pre heated 350 f oven for 10 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Curry Potatoes
ingredients: 4 medium baking potatoes | 1 1/2 cups mild curry paste or 1 1/2 cups mild curry paste
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 f. Cut the tops off each baking potato. Place potatoes in a baking dish or other container with approximately 3/4 inch of space above it. Cover with foil and bake approximately 25 minutes until tender. Remove foil and bake for another 5 - 10 minutes or until slightly golden.

title: Cheesy Jack Rabbit
ingredients: 2 cups shredded monterey jack pepper cheese, blend | 1 cup water
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium saucepan. Stir constantly and bring to a boil. Lower heat and let simmer for 5 minutes, stirring frequently. Remove from heat. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,white cake mix,active yeast,white onion,tea,dijon mustard,roasting chicken,vanilla flavor pudding pie filling mix
title: Microwave English Cottage Loaf
ingredients: 1 package white cake mix, divided use ( jiffy ) | 1/2 cup cool water | 2 1/4 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1/4 ounce teapoon active dry yeast | 1/4 cup white onion, chopped fine | 1/2 cup cold strong brewed tea | 1/2 cup instant vanilla flavor pudding and pie filling mix | 1/2 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 1/2 cup roasting chickens, shredded or 1/2 cup other cooked meat
instructions: Measure 1 cup cake mix into a bowl. Make sure the cake mix is moistened. Add 1/2 cup cool water, 1 package of cake mix and the yeast. Pour 1/4 cup of the prepared cake mix over the yeast mixture and let dissolve. Measure 1/2 cup of the cold strong brewed tea into a small saucepan and add the chopped onion. Stir together. Bring to a full boil, turn off heat and let steep for 5 minutes. Stir tea into yeast mixture and let stand 5 minutes. Stir in pudding mix and vanilla extract. Pour into a 9x5 in. Loaf pan, cover and let rise until puffed up about 50 - 60 minutes. Punch a cake spatula down so that it is even and buttery. Spread the pudding over the pan and add some of the meat. Cover and put in freezer until cold. Slice 1/2 cup cream and serve with warm breads.

title: Mustard-Pepper Toast (Low Fat or Oven-Baked)
ingredients: 8 slices long grain bread, about 3-2 inches thick | 1 1/2 - 2 teaspoons molasses | 1 -2 teaspoon dijon mustard ( depending on your taste ) | pepper
instructions: Heat a small amount of nonstick spray on the griddle pan. Dip one slice of bread into molasses for 1 - 2 seconds on each side until saturated. Place the cooked slice of bread onto a plate covered with a clean towel or paper towel. Repeat for the remaining slices. Lightly butter the griddle pan and set to medium heat. Spread the mustard on your toast. Sprinkle evenly with pepper. Place the other slice of bread on top, buttering the other. Cook the other slice of bread in the microwave, turning the toast over a minute or two in the microwave until toast is heated through. Remove from pan.

Random Ingredients: asparagus,greek yogurt,pepper sauce,cooking spray,jalapeno chile,seasoning salt,cherry,salt black pepper
title: Asparagus Kebabs
ingredients: 2 tablespoons low-fat greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon chopped pickled chiles | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 1/2 teaspoons grated fresh jalapeno chiles | fresh ground pepper | 1 lb asparagus, ends trimmed, cut on bias into 1 1/2-inch pieces | cooking spray | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 4 1/2 - 5 cups cherryries ( approximately )
instructions: Prepare grill or broiler. Combine first 6 ingredients in a medium bowl until well combined. Place asparagus in a large baking dish. Turning once, coat asparagus with yogurt mixture. Add asparagus to baking dish. Cover and chill in refrigerator for 30 minutes, turning occasionally. Remove asparagus pieces from refrigerator and transfer to a cutting board. Using a serrated knife, finely chop asparagus. With lightly oiled hands, coarsely chop asparagus into 2 inch pieces. Stir asparagus pieces and cherry pieces into yogurt mixture. Divide salad among 4 plates. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: carrot,beef brisket,extra virgin olive oil,orange extract,gouda cheese,brandy,picante sauce,red wine
title: Brisket With Beer and Oranges
