ingredients: 6 -8 lbs beef brisket, cleaned | 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 2 carrots, julienned | 1/4 cup brandy | 1 teaspoon orange extract | 1 jar picante sauce | 1/4 cup red wine | 1 3/4 cups gouda cheese, grated
instructions: Heat oven to 300°f place brisket in foil lined roasting pan, fat side down. Brush with 1 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil. Bake 30 to 45 minutes or until brisket is tender and fork tender. Remove brisket to a platter, remove foil and let cool to room temperature. Heat reserved oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Add carrots and cook until lightly browned, about 5 minutes. Stir in brandy and orange extract. Cook, stirring constantly, for 2 minutes. Stir in 1/2 cup picante sauce and 1/4 cup red wine. Cook until liquid reduced, about 5 minutes. Stir in remaining picante sauce. Pour sauce over brisket and sprinkle with cheese. Continue baking, covered with foil, until bubbling and lightly browned, about 30 minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: thyme honey,za'atar spice mix,bread,red curry paste
title: Sizzlin' Toast With Yoghurt
ingredients: 4 cups bread | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 1 tablespoon thyme honey | 1/2 teaspoon za'atar spice mix
instructions: Bread pieces should be well toasted on one side, but not crusty. While bread is toasting, combine all the ingredients for the yoghurt. Serve with warm, buttered cucumber sticks, mint sprigs and fresh herb sprigs.

Random Ingredients: black bean,egg white,zucchini,pecan half,mint,beef broth,beef gravy
title: Beef Patties With Zucchini With Beans
ingredients: 2 lbs zucchini, coarsely chopped | 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 1 container frozen beef gravy | 1 can beef broth | 1 egg white | 1 1/2 tablespoons of fresh mint, minced | 1/2 cup pecan halves or 1/2 cup walnut halves, chopped
instructions: In medium non stick skillet, cook zucchini 8 minutes or until desired doneness. Transfer to bowl, cover and set aside until cool enough to handle. Meanwhile, in a 1 1/2 quart heavy duty freezer cooker combine zucchini with black beans, gravy, beef broth and egg white.

Random Ingredients: tarragon,beef bouillon cube,white wine,sun tomato,clove,fillet,cornflour,flour tortilla
title: Beef Fajitas
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fillets, any type | 4 cups beef bouillon cubes | 1 cup dry white wine | 14 ounces sun-dried tomatoes, in oil, drained | 8 cloves | 4 cornflour tortillas | chopped fresh tarragon or basil
instructions: Heat the oil in a large frying pan until very hot. Dust the fajitas in the corn flour, shaking off any excess. Fry the fillets until browned on the outside and tender when pierced with a knife. Set aside to drain on kitchen paper. Add the bouillon cubes, wine, sun dried tomatoes and chopped basil to the frying pan, stir and bring to the boil. Lower to a simmer and cook, uncovered, for 15 minutes or until reduced to half. Spoon fajitas onto a serving platter and sprinkle top with chopped herbs.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,black olive,orange zest,pumpkin seed,cream tartar,cinnamon,bouillon cube
title: Spanish Olive Tapenade
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sour cream or 2 tablespoons greek yogurt | 2 tablespoons black olives, halved pitted | 1 bouillon cube, of your choice ( i like knorr ) | 1 teaspoon orange zest, grated | 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/4 teaspoon italian parsley, chopped | 1 pinch black pepper
instructions: Make tapenade, in bowl, combine sour cream or greek yogurt, olives, bouillon, orange zest, cinnamon, parsley and pepper. Mix well. Pour over tapenade, stir, and serve.

title: Jicama Stuffed Shrimp
ingredients: 16 -24 medium shrimp paste | 2 cups bisquick | 1 cup hoisin sauce | 1/2 cup miso | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 2 cups jicama, julienned
instructions: If using raw shrimp, remove the gills and peel. Otherwise julienne shrimp, peel and devein and set aside. Preheat oven to 450°. Mix the next seven ingredients together in a bowl, until well blended. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Remove shrimp paste from shells and put in bowl. Add a little sauce mixture to shrimp paste and mix well. Pour over shrimp paste and mix to coat. Place shrimp on the parchment paper. Bake 35 - 40 minutes, or until the top is slightly crispy but not dried out. Serve with green salad and steamed vegetables.

title: Breaded Lamb Cutlets
ingredients: 4 medium lamb cutlets | 1 tablespoon bicarbonate of soda
instructions: Heat a non stick frying pan on medium and cook the cutlets for 3 - 4 minutes on each side until browned. Serve with yoghurt and salad.

title: Garlic-Cardamom Glaze for Chicken
ingredients: 2 cups bottled garlic juice | 3 cardamom pods, crushed
instructions: Combine all of the ingredients in an airtight container.

title: Tortillas
ingredients: 1 package tortillas | 1 1/4 cups olive ( pitted, if desired ) | 1 1/4 tablespoons saffron threads or 1 1/4 tablespoons turmeric, for spice
instructions: Heat oven to 450 degrees fahrenheit. Place tortillas flat on counter and place a baking sheet on top of them. Place in the oven, or bake in oven on a cookie sheet. Heat olive oil over medium heat. Add saffron threads. Remove from oven and crush with back of fork. Mix well. Spread saffron olive oil on tortillas.

title: Swede and Bacon Goulash
ingredients: 2 slices bacon drippings | 1 large yellow cornmeal, such as cornstarch | 1 3/4 lbs swedes, scrubbed, cleaned and diced very small | 1 cup pearl barley | 2 large egg yolks, beaten | 1/2 cup walnuts | 1 cup coarsely chopped walnuts
instructions: Put the bacon drippings in a large pot and add the cornmeal. Stir in a circular motion until the mixture resembles coarse cornmeal. Add the swede and carrots, turn the heat to low, and cook, stirring often, for about 15 minutes, or until the swede is tender. Pour off any excess liquid. Make a well in the cornmeal and add the eggs. Blend well and pour into the well. Cook over very low heat, stirring until the mixture thickens slightly but does not curdle. Remove from heat and stir in 1/2 cup chopped walnuts. Sprinkle with the remaining chopped walnuts. Serve drizzled with melted butter, if desired.

Random Ingredients: beef rib,dill weed,cinnamon,pumpkin seed,raspberry vinegar,caper,hazelnut liqueur,espresso
title: Slow-Grilled Spiced Beef Rib Roast With Capers and Raspberries
ingredients: 1 lb beef top round roast | 1/4 cup hazelnuts ( toasted & coarsely chopped ) | 1 pint fresh raspberry vinegar | 1/2 cup espresso | 1 tablespoon capers ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon dill weed ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon, plus more as needed for garnish | 1/4 cup pumpkin seeds, toasted ( optional ) or 1/4 cup hazelnut-flavored liqueur ( optional )
instructions: Toasting nuts. Mix hazelnuts, hazelnuts, vinegar, espresso, capers, dill, cinnamon, and pumpkin seeds in a food processor and process until blended. Place roast in a large freezer bag and chill for at least 2 hours, or overnight. Preheat grill to high and cook roast 20 minutes for medium rare or to your desired degree of doneness. Remove the roast to a carving board and let stand for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, remove beef from giblets, discarding the bones and fat. Pour the fat into a medium sized saucepan and add the raisins and heat until warm, about 5 minutes. Add 1/4 cup hot water and bring to a simmer. Stir in the honey and honey and continue heating until mixture is syrupy and reduced to about 2 tablespoons, about 3 minutes. Trim the end of the rib roast. Place the beef back in a small roasting pan, add the capers and a little more hot water if necessary, and roast until the beef is easily pierced with a fork, about 35 minutes. Sprinkle over the roast with the nuts and cook until the sauce reduces a little and thickens slightly, about 5 - 10 minutes more. Cut into 8 equal portions. Serve warm.

title: Quinoa and Maple Fritters
ingredients: 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 1 teaspoon golden syrup | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 2/3 cup uncooked quinoa | 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 2 slices kielbasa, cut into matchstick-size pieces | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 1 pinch white pepper | 2 1/2 cups cooked kielbasa, drained | 1/4 cup dried dates, coarsely chopped
instructions: Mash maple syrup, golden syrup, 1/8 teaspoon white pepper, whole kernel corn, quinoa, and 2/3 cup rice in a bowl. Stir corn mix, 1 tablespoon maple syrup, 2 1/2 cup maple syrup, kielbasa, golden syrup, and 1 pinch white pepper into creamed quinoa mixture until well blended. Set aside. Heat 1 tablespoon maple syrup and 2 tablespoons maple syrup in a skillet over medium high heat. Saute kielbasa in 2 tablespoons golden syrup until sausage begins to brown, 3 to 4 minutes. Remove sausage and kielbasa with a slotted spoon, leaving some of the sausage drippings in the skillet. Pour remaining 1/4 cup maple syrup into skillet. Spread cooked sausage and kielbasa over quinoa mixture.

Random Ingredients: red rice,oyster sauce,meat,spring onion,radish,asafoetida powder,caraway seed
title: Vietnamese Fried Rice (Vietnamese Food Network)
ingredients: 1 cup medium or white rice | 14 1/2 fluid ounces meat, preferably lean | 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( vegetable or potato cooking spray or other frying oil, see note ) | 1/2 bunch radish | 6 spring onions | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce ( light or dark, for flavor ) | 1/4 teaspoon caraway seed
instructions: Rinse rice well.

title: Simple Beef Ribs
ingredients: 4 -6 lbs beef short ribs | 1 jar marinara sauce ( i use kraft meat and vegetable ) | 1 cup shallot, cut in strips | 1 cup black olives, whole, sliced in thin wedges | 1 teaspoon dried italian spices
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees. Slice meat into 1 cubes. Place on roasting pan with sides. Place meat over meat. Brush top of meat with marinara sauce. Sprinkle with shallots. Add olives. Sprinkle italian seasoning over all. Cover with 2 foil roasting pans. Bake for 7 hours at 250 degrees. Remove foil roasts and meat.

Random Ingredients: simple syrup,calvados,coke,baking powder,italian flat leaf parsley,beef brisket,brandy
title: Baked Brisket With Cava-Flavored Coke
ingredients: 1 lb sweet italian flat-leaf parsley ( about 1 2/3 pounds ) | 1 lb mustard brisket, trimmed of excess fat | 2 cups coke | 1/2 cup simple syrup | 1/2 cup calvados | 2 tablespoons brandy or 2 tablespoons whiskey | 1 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Cut parsley into thin strips, then into 1/8 inch wide strips. Brush brisket generously with oil and lightly sprinkle with salt. Place in shallow 2 to 4 quart baking dish. Pour coke over brisket and let stand overnight or, at least, 8 hours before using. Drain. In a medium bowl, stir together remaining ingredients. Stir in brisket. Spoon half of coke into large rimmed baking dish. Pack brisket mixture on top of coke. Cover tightly, refrigerate overnight or at least 3 hours. Bake, uncovered, in preheated 350°f oven 20 to 25 minutes, or until brisket is thoroughly heated. Remove brisket from oven and discard foil. Cool slightly. Serve with additional coke. Note, baking time does not include overnight cooling.

title: Pear Taco Chips
ingredients: 5 large ripe pears, peeled, cored and very thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons finely crumbled pancetta | 2 tablespoons coarse breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon parsley, chopped | 1/4 cup pimento-stuffed taco sauce ( see my ketchop's taco bell home tacos ) | crushed tortilla chips | shredded sweetened pretzel or finely crumbled tortilla chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. Prepare a 9x13 baking dish with cooking spray. Combine 1/4 cup pimentos, bread crumbs, parsley and taco sauce.

Random Ingredients: salsa,margarine,red wine,cooking sherry,green cardamom pod,onion soup mix
title: Spicy Onion-Salsa Dip  (Aka Spicy Spanish Green Drink)
ingredients: 1/4 cup margarine ( not tub type ) | 1 cup mild salsa ( i use pace medium and hot ) | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 1 tablespoon wine, spanish cooking wine is my favorite | 1/4 teaspoon crushed green cardamom pods | 1 tablespoon cooking sherry ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in medium sized bowl. Add salt and pepper if desired. Enjoy with crusty rolls.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,cannellini bean,saffron strand,peanut oil,meat,lettuce leaf,oatmeal
title: Saffron Beef Burritos or Burritos
ingredients: 1 lb minced meat | 2 teaspoons olive oil | 4 saffron strands ( or 1 tsp. turmeric ) | 4 -6 cups cooked cannellini beans ( about 1 pound ) | 2 cups oatmeal | 2 cups heavy whipping cream | 5 -6 lettuce leaves
instructions: Brown minced meat in oil in saucepan and drain. Add saffron and cook one minute. Add beans and cream. Cook over low heat until mixture thickens. Add cooked meat and oatmeal. When serving, mix well. Top with shredded lettuce leaves. To freeze, place meat mixture and oatmeal in freezer plastic bag with a hole cut in top of mixture. Label and freeze. Keeps up to 1 month in the freezer.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,large shrimp,chili pepper,liquid smoke,rosemary sprig,coconut milk
title: Smokey Spicy Pork Carnitas
ingredients: 1/2 lb large shrimp, shelled | 1/2 lb pork shoulder, cut into 3 inch pieces | 1 3/4 cups coconut milk | 1 -3 tablespoon canned chopped rosemary sprig, plus | fresh rosemary sprigs, to garnish, < a href= '' https : //www.geniuskitchen.com/recipe/spicy-spicy-spice-mix-4824 '' > spicy spice mix < /a > | 2 chili peppers, seeded and chopped | 2 teaspoons liquid smoke
instructions: Place shrimp and pork pieces in large resealable food storage bag and add coconut milk, rosemary, and chili peppers. Close bag, pressing out excess air. Refrigerate until pork is well flaked and flavors are blended, at least 2 hours and up to overnight. Remove pork, shrimp, and shrimp mixture to shallow dish. Drain shrimp, discard shrimp soaking liquid, and reserve liquid. Discard shells. Heat reserved liquid in large heavy skillet over medium high heat. Add reserved shrimp liquid, if desired. Reduce heat to medium, simmer 5 minutes or until shrimp are heated through. Remove shrimp mixture with slotted spoon to bowl of ice water. Discard shells. Serve with spiced rice and garnish with sprigs of rosemary and slices of peeled lime.

title: Tart Apples
ingredients: 5 tart apples, pared, cored and cut into 1/2-inch wedges | 2 packages miniature marshmallows | 9 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f mix the apples, marshmallows & cheddar to coat the apples by rinsing a little of the water out. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured work surface. Roll out to ½” thick, using a floured rolling pin. Cut into 8 wedges. Bake, covered, 40 - 50 minutes or till apples are tender. Serve hot or keep the apple wedges warm. They may be served warm or at room temperature.

title: Beef & BBQ Mushroom Skillet
ingredients: 2 tablespoons barbecue sauce | 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat, cut into 1-inch pieces | 8 ounces mixed mushrooms, sliced ( the type with the mushrooms, not in the jar )
instructions: In a 12 inch skillet or dutch oven brown meat in barbecue sauce. Add mushrooms and cook 2 minutes or until tender crisp. Serve over rice.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato,balsamic vinaigrette,white potato,crisco,matzo meal,tomato paste,sirloin
title: Passover Beef Matzoh
ingredients: 6 small white potatoes, scrubbed and halved lengthwise | 2 -3 tablespoons crisco | 1 - 1 1/2 lb ground sirloin | 1 can tomato paste | sun-dried tomato, to taste | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato ( packed in oil, drained ) | 1/2 cup balsamic vinaigrette
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to boil. Add salt and potatoes and cook until barely tender, about 20 minutes. Strain, rinse with cold water and set aside. Meanwhile, put the crisco in a large, deep skillet. Using your fingers, push the crisco down into the skillet, coating the crisco as evenly as possible. Add the ground beef and cook over medium high heat until the meat is lightly browned and cooked through, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks. Drain off any excess grease. Drain the meat and return it to the skillet and add the tomato paste, sundried tomatoes, sun dried tomatoes and balsamic vinaigrette. Bring to a boil, scraping the bottom of the pan to release any browned bits. Cover and simmer over low heat until potatoes are tender. Add salt to taste. Serve as is.

title: Irish Misty Potato Dips
ingredients: 1 large russet potato | 1 tablespoon coarse mustard | 1 tablespoon kahlua ( optional ) | 12 tablespoons dry white wine | 1/4 cup raisins
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f with rack in middle. Grate potato directly into a large bowl and sprinkle with coarse mustard. Kahlua should not be added. Add raisins. Add remaining ingredients and stir with a wooden spoon until ingredients are moistened. Serve warm from the oven.

title: Thick Chili Carrots
ingredients: 2 lbs carrots | 1 teaspoon dried red chili pepper, crushed
instructions: Peel carrots and cut into 1 slices, 1/4 thick.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,orange bell pepper,guinness stout,cumin powder
title: Stuffed Peppers
ingredients: 1 guinness stout or 1 beer | 1 teaspoon ground cumin powder | 12 button mushrooms | 3 orange bell peppers ( halved )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 400 degrees. Prepare a baking sheet by spraying with pam. Slice off the tops of the mushrooms but leave the stems on. Stuff the peppers with the guinness and sprinkle a little more on the top. Bake in a preheated oven for 45 - 90 mins.

Random Ingredients: tuna,pecorino cheese,thai red curry paste,lebanese cucumber,tamari
title: Tuna and Peeled Cucumber (Moor-Batata)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons thai red curry paste ( thai kitchen brand ) | 2 cups tuna | 1 lebanese cucumber ( or a mixture of both ) or 1/2 english cucumber, peeled, cored and finely-grated ( or a mixture of both ) | 3 tablespoons tamari ( light or dark soy sauce ) | 1/2 cup freshly-grated pecorino cheese
instructions: Put on a cutting board and chop up finely with either the sharpest knife or the knife of a knife. Put the curry paste in a bowl and stir in the tuna. Put in the fridge for about 15 minutes. Put the grated cucumber in the food processor or blender as well, along with the tamari and just enough water to process the mixture into the paste, but don’t process it to mush it. The tuna mixture will be a little chunky. Turn into a bowl and add the cheese and mix well. Eat with plain white breads as an appetiser or on its own for a refreshing lunch.

Random Ingredients: anaheim chilies,soy sauce,black eyed pea,madras curry powder,cocoa powder,worcestershire sauce,pork loin
title: Crock Pot Mild Chinese Pork and Beans
ingredients: 3 lbs skinless pork loin, cut into strips | 1/2 cup butter | 1 cup chopped anaheim chilies | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried minced fresh black-eyed peas ( may use pinto ) | 3 tablespoons soy sauce | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon cocoa powder | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder
instructions: Cut pork into strips and brown in butter. Add chilies, black eyed peas, soy sauce, worcestershire sauce and cocoa. Cook until pork is cooked through. Sprinkle with curry and cook on low 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

Random Ingredients: brandy,almond extract,grapefruit juice,cardamom seed,farfalle pasta,snow pea
title: Pasta Primavera or Pesto for One
ingredients: 1 package farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 3 tablespoons freshly squeezed grapefruit juice | 3 tablespoons brandy | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom seed | 1/4 cup slivered almonds, toasted
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Meanwhile, mix grapefruit juice, brandy, almond extract, cinnamon, and cardamom in a medium bowl. Stir in pasta. Remove 1/3 cup of the pasta cooking water and reserve.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,coconut cream,jalapeno chile pepper,butter,mango chutney,vegetable stock
title: Spicy Mango Chutney (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups vegetable stock | 1/2 cup unsweetened coconut cream | 2 teaspoons canned chipotle chutney, or to taste | 2 tablespoons sweet mango chutney ( optional ) | 1 jalapeno chile pepper, seeded and minced | 1/4 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 tablespoon butter
instructions: Bring the vegetable stock to a boil in a stockpot. Slowly whisk the coconut cream, chipotle chutney, mango chutney, jalapeno chile pepper, and parmigiano reggiano cheese in a bowl until the cheese is melted and the mixture is smooth.

Random Ingredients: italian plum tomato,onion,corn syrup,chili flake,jalapeno chile,topping,phyllo dough,hamburger
title: Mexican Pizza Pie (Baked)
ingredients: 1/2 lb hamburger | 1/2 cup chopped onion | 1/4 cup canned italian plum tomatoes | 2 tablespoons italian plum tomatoes, chopped | 1 teaspoon fresh jalapeno chile, diced or 1/2 teaspoon canned chili flakes | 2 tablespoons corn syrup | 2 packages frozen reduced fat thawed phyllo dough, thawed and risen, buttered | 2/3 cup light corn syrup | 2 ounces reduced-fat reduced-fat baked hamburger | 1/2 cup chopped onion | 1 tablespoon light corn syrup
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet, cook ground meats 2 minutes or until done. Drain off fat. Stir in onions, tomatoes, jalapenos, and chilies. Spoon into a 10x6x2 inch baking dish. Sprinkle top with corn syrup. Bake 375 degrees for 8 - 9 minutes or until edges are golden. Meanwhile, microwave phyllo for 5 minutes or until just beginning to soften. Remove from oven and top with 2 sheets phyllo. Brush with 2 tablespoons corn syrup. Bake at 375 degrees for 9 minutes or until phyllo is golden. Meanwhile, prepare pizza topping. Stir together hamburger and remaining 1 tablespoon corn syrup, breaking up any lumps. Spread topping over the pie. Arrange on top of topping. Top with hamburger mixture. Sprinkle with onion. Dot with light corn syrup. Cut into squares to serve.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,espresso powder,beef tamale,cauliflower,green cabbage,golden delicious apple,lemon twist
title: Beef Casserole with Spicy Apple Mash
ingredients: 3/4 head green cabbage, cleaned, thinly sliced | 1 jar beef tamales, cut into fourths | 1 golden delicious apple, cored, thinly sliced | 1 head cauliflower, separated into leaves and cut into bite-sized florets | lemon twist, for garnish | garlic salt, for garnish | 1 -2 teaspoon espresso powder, for garnish
instructions: Combine all ingredients except for the corriander and stir gently. Place the corriander in a large serving bowl or baking dish, pour over the cheese. Spread to coat.

Random Ingredients: clove,corn flake,green chilies,beef stock,chili paste garlic
title: Easiest Steak in the World
ingredients: 2 lbs steak ( cut to your liking, or any thick cut you like ) | 1 can green chilies ( i used mild, but you can use jalapeno if you like ) | 1/2 cup beef stock | 1 -2 tablespoon bottled chili paste with garlic | 2 -3 tablespoons crushed corn flakes
instructions: Slice your steak across the grain into 1/4 slices. Add chiles and beef stock. Cover and let marinate in the fridge for several hours. After marinating, grill on high heat. When the steaks are done, use a fork to poke some holes in the meat. If you find some of the liquid in the pan, just add them. Sprinkle cornflakes on the meat and serve.

title: Rosemary Rice
ingredients: 1/4 cup raisins | 3 sprigs rosemary | 1 cup uncooked white rice, rinsed and drained | 1/2 pound cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1/2 pound chopped spinach leaves | 2 packages ladyfingers | 1 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Place raisins in a bowl and cover with ice cubes. Let stand while preparing other ingredients. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add rice, mushrooms, spinach and half of the rosemary sprigs. Cook until rice is tender and mixture is slightly thickened, around 5 minutes. Drain rice mixture, reserving broth. Add mushrooms, sweeten, and remaining rosemary. Cut ladyfingers crosswise into 1 inch pieces. Arrange in a casserole dish for a first layer. Place some of the cooked rice on top. Pour in rosemary broth and spread. Chill in refrigerator at least six hours or overnight to absorb flavors. Remove rosemary sprigs before serving. Sprinkle with remaining rosemary sprigs.

title: Sensational Pies for a Rainy Day Lunch
ingredients: 1 pastry for double-crust pie ( recipe included ) | 16 ounces frozen sliced snow peas | 1 large yellow bell pepper, coarsely chopped | 1 large zucchini, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup raisins | 1/2 lb salt pork, diced | 1/2 lb chicken, diced | 1 large onion, chopped
instructions: Place the frozen peas in a microwave safe bowl with 1/2 cup of water, heat the microwave, stir, cover and microwave on high for about 20 minutes. When peas are partially thawed, drain into a large mixing bowl with all other ingredients. Add salt, pepper mix well until all ingredients are coated, and set aside. Place the cooked pastry in 2 large pie dishes, cover and microwave on high for 7 - 10 minutes. Take out of the oven and let cool completely on a wire rack. Remove the pastry from the pie dishes, place on your work surface and using your fingers, remove the pastry from the pie dishes and pat dry. Roll the dough between your palms until it is about 8x8 and then cut into 4 equal pieces. Put the pastry squares on a baking sheet and cover with foil and bake on 400 for 15 minutes or until dry. Remove the foil and let rest for 5 minutes. Remove the pastry squares from the oven. Use a fork to poke several holes in the pastry squares. Place 4 pie plates on each plate, add 1/4 cup of water into each pie and cover with parchment. Bake for another 15 minutes or until the bottom is golden.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,salt pork,snow pea,sazon goya,red onion,rigatoni pasta
title: Puerto Rican Fried Rigatoni With Sausage
ingredients: 2 boxes rigatoni pasta | 1 lb salt pork, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 cup onion, coarsely chopped | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon sazon goya | 1 package frozen snow peas, cut into thirds | 1 cup monterey jack cheese, shredded
instructions: Fill a large pot with water and cook the rigatoni to al dente. Drain and set aside. In a large skillet, heat 1 tbs of olive oil with 2 tbs of salt pork over medium heat. Cook, stirring, until it is browning on all sides. Set aside and drain the pork.

title: Easy Greek Sauce
ingredients: 30 g capers, chopped | 5 -10 g yogurt ( thick is best )
instructions: Add yogurt to the chopped capers and caper. Mix well. Will keep refrigerated in the fridge for 5 days.

title: Linguine With Grape Yogurt
ingredients: 1 lb linguine | 3 tablespoons yoghurt | 3 tablespoons crumbled queso fresco | 3 tablespoons bacon drippings or 3 tablespoons other bacon drippings | 1 cup grapes, halved
instructions: Cook linguine according to directions and drain. Heat oil in a non stick skillet. Add bacon and fry until crisp. Add grapes and cook until grape pieces have started to turn light green. Add linguines and stir until warm. Top with feta cheese.

title: Salsa Alla Romana
ingredients: 1 package frozen asparagus or fresh asparagus spears | 2 ripe roma tomatoes, seeded, diced
instructions: Cook asparagus as directed on package. Drain, reserving aspargus liquid.

Random Ingredients: tequila,tart apple,coconut oil,baby carrot,gelatin,cream mushroom soup
title: Devil's Food
ingredients: 1/2 cup sweetened flaked coconut oil | 2 fresh tart apples, peeled, cored and chopped | 1 can reduced fat cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup tequila | 4 eggs, lightly beaten | 2 tablespoons unflavored gelatin
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Coat a 9x9 inch pan with cooking spray. Cook coconut oil in a skillet over medium heat until fragrant, 5 to 7 minutes. Stir in apples and cook until soft, 2 to 3 minutes. Stir in soup, tequila and eggs and continue cooking until thickened and apples are tender, 15 to 18 minutes. Sprinkle gelatin over gelatin and continue cooking, stirring until gelatin is dissolved, about 5 minutes. Pour pudding into prepared pan and bake in preheated oven for 15 minutes. Garnish with coconut flakes and serve with pineapple wedges for added color.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,phyllo pastry,ra el hanout spice mix,stew meat,tortilla chip,carrot,egg yolk,flat leaf parsley
title: Moroccan Beef and Carrot Casserole
ingredients: 1/4 cup ra el hanout spice mix | 1 lb stew meat, cut into 1-inch chunks | 1 small carrot, grated coarsely | 4 large egg yolks | 1 can cream of chicken soup, undiluted | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 8 cups packaged whole meal frozen phyllo pastry sheets, thawed | additional ra el hanout spice mix, for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f in a large bowl, combine spice mix and beef and toss until well coated. Transfer meat mixture to an 11x13x2 inch baking dish. In a medium bowl, whisk egg yolks with soup, parsley, half of the spice mix and half of the reserved spice mix until mixture is smooth. Spread meat mixture over meat in dish. Cover dish with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 2 hours and up to 3 days. Unwrap phyllo sheets onto a clean, dry surface and, using scissors or scissors, cut sheets into 6 inch squares. Place 3 sheets diagonally across top of meat mixture on top of each other in a 7 x 10 inch rectangle on top of each other. Fold the squares over and gently press to compact meat mixture. Repeat with remaining 7 sheets and remaining dough square squares. Cut into 6 triangles and arrange 2 triangles over meat in dish, overlapping edges of triangles. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until pastry is golden brown. Serve with additional sauce, if desired.

Random Ingredients: chili flake,cinnamon,monterey jack cheddar cheese,roquefort cheese,coconut,cream tartar,beef stew meat,white chocolate
title: Crock Pot Beef Rolatas
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat | 1 can reduced-fat sour cream | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/8 teaspoon chili flakes | 2 tablespoons white chocolate, melted | 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/2 lb monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend, shredded ( about 4 cups ) | 1/2 lb roquefort cheese, shredded | 1/2 lb white chocolate, melted
instructions: Brown beef in skillet with sour cream and cream of tartar. Sprinkle chili flakes on top as it cooks. In crockpot, combine browned beef and next 5 ingredients. Place in crockpot. Cover and cook on low for 7 - 8 hours. Add cheese in the last 5 minutes. To serve, pour cheese sauce over rice pilas.

title: Coconut Beef
ingredients: 8 ounces boneless sirloin, thinly sliced | 2 stalks celery, chopped | 2 cans coconut milk | 1 teaspoon turmeric ( optional )
instructions: Combine coconut milk, beef, celery and tumeric.

title: Kielbasa Balls With Savory Brown Rice
ingredients: 8 ounces kielbasa | 2 cups uncooked long grain rice | 2 large eggs | 4 teaspoons soy sauce | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 2 1/4 teaspoons cocoa powder
instructions: Fry kielbasa till well cooked then drain.

Random Ingredients: haddock fillet,flour tortilla,sugar,rosemary,cream cheese,jalapeno chile,puff pastry,bread
title: Baked Fish Enchiladas
ingredients: 12 flour tortillas, cut in half | 1/2 lb skinless haddock fillet, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 3/4 lbs puff pastry sheets, thawed | 2 packages cream cheese, room temperature | 2 -3 teaspoons dried rosemary | 1/2 - 1 jalapeno chile, stemmed, seeded and chopped | pinch sugar | pinch salt | fresh rosemary ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Stack tortillas and cut into 1 inch pieces. Bake in oven, turning once, until crisp and starting to brown about 8 - 10 minutes. Using slotted spoon, transfer to paper towels and blot with paper towels. Arrange on baking sheet, let sit about 5 minutes, then pat dry.

Random Ingredients: vegetable bouillon cube,jeera powder,thyme leaf,guinness stout
title: Guinness Soup Mix
ingredients: 3 vegetable bouillon cubes | 1/2 tablespoon jeera powder | 1 teaspoon thyme leaves | 12 ounces guinness stout
instructions: Stir the bouillon, jeera powder, thyme and guinness together in large saucepan. Bring to a boil.

title: Thai Noodles
ingredients: 1 small lemongrass | oil or 1 tablespoon oil
instructions: Finely chop the lemongrass. Heat skillet or wok over high heat. Stir fry the sliced lemongrass until fragrant, about 1 minute. If using oil, add it 1/2 cup at a time. When the juice seeps through, add the oil. Add chinese noodles, stir fry over medium heat about 3 minutes. Pour onto a plate lined with paper towel to drain grease. Note, if the noodles are dry, add 1/2 cup water while stirring, to create the steam.

title: Puff Pasta
ingredients: 2 large roma tomatoes, sliced 1/4-inch thick | 1/2 cup roasted peanuts, chopped | 3 tablespoons freshly ground black coffee | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar
instructions: Line a serving platter or baking sheet with parchment paper, letting excess paper extend above pan. Sprinkle tomatoes with peanuts. Brush lightly with vinegar. Sprinkle with coffee. Drizzle with balsamic vinaigrette. Refrigerate until serving time. Note, if making ahead, keep wrapped well in plastic wrap in refrigerator for up to 2 days.

Random Ingredients: quinoa,lasagna noodle,dijon mustard,pork loin chop,anise seed,green chile pepper
title: Auntie Lori's Risotto
ingredients: 1 pound boneless pork loin chops | 2 green chile peppers, chopped | 1 teaspoon ground anise seed | 3 tablespoons dijon mustard | 2/3 cup dry quinoa | 3 lasagna noodle, broken into 4 pieces
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat.

title: Sweet Red Beans
ingredients: 2 cans dark red kidney beans | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 4 lbs pork tenderloin | 2 tablespoons catsup or 2 tablespoons tomato sauce
instructions: Drain and discard liquid from cans of beans. Place pork tenderloin in large frying pan and add remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil.

title: Mashed Potatoes, Mexican Style
ingredients: 5 russet potatoes ( about 1 lb. ) | 2 quarts good quality canned whole white beans, drained ( about 2/3 cup liquid )
instructions: The day before the party, place the russet potatoes in a large stainless steel pot or dutch oven. Cover and cook over medium heat until tender and a brown crust has formed, about 2 hours. Mash the potatoes well before using, then add the drained beans. Mix thoroughly. Allow to cool for about 10 minutes then refrigerate.

title: Vegemite-Stir Fry Vegetables for Two
ingredients: 2 bunches spring onions | vegemite | 1 cup broth
instructions: Heat 1/2 cup vegemite in a pan over a medium heat. Wash and dice spring onions, then add. Stir fry until lightly browned, about three to five minutes. Stir in broth and stir until heated through, around 1 minute.

title: Chipotle Cheese
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast | 1 cup yogurt | 1 3/4 tablespoons chipotle chiles in adobo, finely chopped ( canned, patted dry seeds removed if canned ) | 1/2 cup lime juice
instructions: Poke holes in the yeast with a fork and place in a large mixing bowl, or lightly oil a medium stainless steel bowl and pour in about 2 cups of the yogurt. Mix to combine and let sit at room temperature for 3 to five hours. When the yeast begins to froth, add the remaining yogurt, chipotle chiles, lime juice and the remaining 1/4 cup yogurt. Mix well. Transfer the mixture to your mixer and beat on medium speed until very smooth. You may need to add some flour to prevent the dough from sticking to the sides of the bowl. You may need to add more or less. Transfer the dough to a clean surface and turn out onto lightly floured surface, about 2 centimeters. Knead for 10 minutes. Place in an oiled bowl, cover and let rise at room temperature until doubled, 1 1/2 hours and about 1 1/2 times its volume, about 1 1/2 hours. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface, divide the dough into 25 - 35 pieces and form balls, about 2 inches in diameter, about 4 1/2 inches in diameter using a danish dough roller. Let rise uncovered about 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 400°f. Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper. Place dough balls onto the sheet. They should be spaced about 1 inch apart and should not touch each other. Bake until golden, about 18 minutes, about 22 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock,picante sauce,green curry paste,red wine vinegar,wide rice noodle,vanilla pod,littleneck clam
title: Spicy Thai Seafood Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 package wide rice noodles, small package ( or linguine ) | 3 ounces littleneck clams, rinsed and well-cured, and coarsely chopped or can littleneck clams, drained | 1/4 cup picante sauce | 1 teaspoon green curry paste | 1/2 tablespoon red wine vinegar or 1/2 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons chicken stock | 1/4 teaspoon pure vanilla pod ( optional )
instructions: Place rice noodles in a bowl and pour boiling water over them. Add the clams or shellfish if using, and cover. Set aside to plump for 5 minutes. Drain, then rinse with cold water. Drain again. Dice the cooked seafood as desired. Place in a large bowl with the picante sauce, curry paste, vinegar, stock and vanilla, if using. Toss to coat, then refrigerate for at least 1 hour for flavors to combine. Serve immediately or chilled.

title: Grilled Swiss Cheese Dogs
ingredients: 1 package smoked ham | 1 can refrigerated crusty ham rolls | 4 garlic cloves | 2 cups shredded gruyere cheese | 2 beef bouillon cubes
instructions: Heat the bbq to high.

Random Ingredients: cumin seed,kimchi,red curry paste,kaffir lime leaf,bechamel sauce,artichoke heart,baking soda,coriander
title: Sweet & Savoury Kimchi Beetroot Slice
ingredients: 2 cups kimchi, cut into small pieces ( fresh or frozen, thawed ) | 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts | 1/3 cup red curry paste | 8 teaspoons beetel hot sauce ( or to taste ) | 2 tablespoons kaffir lime leaves | 1 teaspoon kaffir lime leaf | 2 teaspoons cumin seeds, toasted | 1/4 teaspoon ground coriander | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Preheat oven to 160 degrees, line a 16 x 10 x 1 inch pan with baking parchment. Combine first six ingredients in a small bowl and mix well. Add baking soda to the mixture, stir and transfer to a 9 x 13 inch baking dish. Sprinkle top of mixture evenly with grated coconut, pressing down lightly. Bake uncovered 30 - 35 minutes or until a knife inserted in centre comes out clean. Let stand 10 minutes before cutting. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: sesame ginger marinade,snow pea,peanut butter,brown sugar,flat leaf parsley,self rising flour,garlic
title: Nama's Peanut Butter and Snow Pea Griddle Biscuits
ingredients: 2 cups self-rising flour | 4 teaspoons sesame ginger marinade | 1 teaspoon minced garlic | 1/4 cup dry roasted peanuts | 2/3 cup crunchy peanut butter | 1/3 cup packed brown sugar | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium, and lightly oil the griddle. In a medium bowl, stir flour, marinade, garlic and peanuts together. In a small bowl, mash peanut butter into peanut butter with a fork, or press with a fork into a fine powder. Stir brown sugar and parsley into the peanut butter mixture. Gently fold in the flour mix. Scoop 1/2 tablespoon of biscuit dough onto the preheated griddle, and pat or press the biscuit flat with your hand into a large circle. Cook until bubbles form all over, then flip over and brown the other side. Repeat with the remaining biscuits. Transfer biscuit mixture to a serving plate, decorate with a small slice of the biscuits and serve.

title: Country Style Chicken and Sausage Soup
ingredients: 1 lb turkey sausage or 1 lb other sausage, sliced | 1 1/2 lbs chicken thighs or 1 1/2 lbs other meat | 1 can chicken and peas, drained | 1 cup buttermilk or 1 cup sour cream | 1/2 cup dried dill | 2 fresh kaffir lime leaves, cut into thin strips ( optional )
instructions: Cook sausage in a large pot for about 5 minutes, turning once, until meat is no longer pink. Drain excess fat from pot, return sausage to pot and continue to cook, turning occasionally, until most of the fat is rendered and sausage is light brown about 10 minutes. Transfer sausage to a plate. Add the remaining ingredients to the pot and bring to a boil. Reduce to a simmer, cover and cook for 20 minutes to blend flavors. Ladle soup into shallow bowls and garnish with the lime strips, if desired. For maximum flavor, let the soup cool completely before chilling in the refrigerator. Reheat before serving.

title: Pineapple Chiller
ingredients: 4 -5 large pineapple chunks ( i use fresh pineapple chunks ) | 1 green chili pepper | club soda or sparkling wine, to complete
instructions: Place pineapple chunks in a microwave safe glass bowl, cover with plastic wrap and microwave on high for 3 minutes. Remove from microwave, slice on a bias and place in glass chiller/dish. Top with green chili pepper and club soda or sparkling wine just before serving.

Random Ingredients: chicken wing,gouda cheese,beef tenderloin,beef stew meat,pineapple,champagne,rice paper
title: Hamburger Filled Rolls
ingredients: 2/3 lb beef stew meat, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1/4 lb fully cooked gouda cheese, cut into 1/4 inch cubes | 4 sheets rice paper | 1 cup shredded bamboo steamed pineapple ( drained ) | 1 1/2 cups steak shredded beef stew meat, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1/4 cup chilled champagne | 4 teaspoons beef-flavored cooked champagne
instructions: Heat grill to high. Arrange rice paper on work surface. Layer beef, cheese and pineapple on the paper closest to you. Brush top of dough edge with champagne. Bring together right before closing edge with a fork.

title: Baked Edamame & Goat Cheese
ingredients: 1 package frozen shelled edamame | 1/4 cup goat cheese ( optional ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons italian seasoning | 1 beef bouillon cube
instructions: Defrost frozen edamame in microwave. In a medium size bowl, combine chopped edamame with goat cheese, italian seasoning and bouillon. Stir to combine. Place in a lightly ungreased baking dish and bake in the microwave for 15 - 20 min, or until heated through.

title: Quick & Easy Masala Chicken
ingredients: 1 tablespoon curry paste ( or a mixture ) | 1 can chili sauce, or 4 chicken parts, cooked | 1/2 cup salsa
instructions: In a small saucepan on low heat, heat the curry paste until the water evaporates and it smells fragrant. Remove from heat and stir in the chili sauce, salsa and chicken pieces. Cover and let stand for 5 minutes. Uncover and serve with your favorite vegetable, such as jasmine rice or basmati rice.

title: Tahini Spiced Spread
ingredients: 1/2 cup soy sauce | 1/4 cup tahini ( sesame paste ) | 2 tablespoons ground cardamom pod | 1 cup black walnuts
instructions: In a cup or small bowl, mash the soy sauce and tahini with a fork until smooth. Stir in cardamom and ground walnuts. Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator.

title: Onion Feta Feta Cheese Dip
ingredients: 2 packages lipton dry onion soup mix | 1 package feta cheese
instructions: Mix well. Slice cheese into 1 thick slices. Spoon onto cheese. Top with other thick slice and cut into 1/4 cubes or chunks.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,basmati rice,walnut,steak,chorizo sausage,poblano pepper,onion soup mix
title: Caribbean Rissoles (Baked Beans)
ingredients: 2 lbs flank steaks, cut into 1-inch slices | 2 boxes onion soup mix | 2 poblano peppers, seeded and chopped ( or green ) | 1 package chorizo sausage, ground | 1/2 cup finely chopped walnuts | 1 box graham cracker crumbs | 2 cups hot cooked basmati rice ( i recommend mahatma's wheat mill brand )
instructions: Mix together the onion soup mix, poblano peppers, chorizo, walnuts and graham cracker crumbs in a large bowl. Add the beef slices and mix thoroughly with your hands. Divide the mixture into 8 equal portions. Place equal portions on each of the 8 bamboo skewers. Preheat your oven to 325 degrees. Brush the tops with water and sprinkle lightly with cornstarch. Bake for 1 hour, or until meat is cooked through and crumbs are slightly browned. Serve on hoisin or buns with salsa, sour cream, or a side of guacamole.

title: Fig and Pecorino Stew
ingredients: 2 bunches figs | 3 medium firm figs, peeled & cubed | 1 cup chicken stock | 3 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 cup pecorino romano cheese, grated
instructions: Cut off stems from figs & cut into quarters. Place figs in boiling water for 2 minutes, drain. Place figs & 1 cup stock in a blender or food processor & process to make fine puree. In a saucepan heat remaining stock & cornstarch over medium heat until slightly thickened, add figs & simmer for about 3 minutes. Remove from heat & stir in cheese.

title: Veal, Asparagus, Artichoke, and Veal Casserole
ingredients: 1 tablespoon liquid smoke, divided | 1 tablespoon dried savory | 2 pounds veal, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained and halved | 1 pound fresh asparagus, trimmed and cut into 1 inch pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Coat a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Place a small amount of liquid smoke in a small bowl and stir in the savory. Spread the veal cubes over the bottom of the dish and roll up like a jelly roll. Spread each slice with some of the artichoke heart marinade, then top with the asparagus. Pour the remaining liquid smoke mixture over the asparagus, then spread the remaining artichoke slices over. Place casserole in the preheated oven and bake until bubbly, about 1 hour.

title: Easy & Delicious Mexican Radish & Cheese Salad
ingredients: 3 -4 radishes ( i love the ones on the green ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup mayonnaise ( to taste ) | 1 chicken stock cube | 1 tablespoon tabasco sauce ( to taste ) | 3 -4 tablespoons grated mexican manchego cheese ( to taste ) | 3 -4 large radishes ( to garnish )
instructions: Peel and cut your radishes into strips about 3/4' wide, and 3/4 wide. Place the mayonnaise in a bowl and add a good pinch of tabasco, some chopped fresh cilantro or whatever you like, but we like lots of discretion. Use whatever it suits your tastes. Add all the radishes and mix. Taste, and adjust spices if necessary. Serve with grated cheese and other salad ingredients.

Random Ingredients: parmesan cheese,red chili pepper,sesame oil,brown rice
title: Rice With Smoked Paprika
ingredients: 2 cups cooked brown rice | 1 tablespoon smoked paprika with red chili peppers | 2 teaspoons toasted sesame oil | 1 tablespoon fresh red chili pepper, sliced
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a dish, cover w/foil, and place in the refrigerator for an hour or two to chill up a little, but don't let it sit. Serve at once.

title: Festive Nacho Cheese Pasta Bake
ingredients: 1 lb tortilla | 1 lb farfalle pasta or 1 lb penne, cooked al dente | 16 ounces alfredo sauce | 3 -4 slices provolone cheese | 1 package frozen broccoli florets, thawed and drained | 3/4 cup chopped fresh tahini or 3/4 cup miracle whip | cooked rice
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f. Grease a 13x9 inch glass baking dish or a glass 9 by 5 x 3 inch baking dish. Heat a large nonstick skillet. Coat pan with cooking spray. Add pasta and cook on both sides until browned. Spoon enough pasta/vegetables in dish to cover bottom and up the sides of dish. Spoon a few teaspoons of the alfredo sauce into the middle of the pasta. Layer pasta/veggies over alfredo sauce and top with a slice of provolone cheese. Pour remaining sauce over cheese mixture. Bake until heated through, about 25 - 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: sherry wine,white flour,ricotta cheese,white wine,french baguette,curry powder,rotini pasta,cherry
title: Cheese-Crusted Vegetable Bruschetta
ingredients: 3 ounces tri-colored rotini pasta | 2 ounces dry white wine ( i used a bit of grape ) | 10 ounces fresh ricotta cheese | 2 teaspoons curry powder | 1 tablespoon sweet white wine | 1 tablespoon sherry wine | 1 tablespoon white flour | 1 small french baguette | 1 pint cherry
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f. Cook the pasta according to package. When cool, drain and dry. In a large bowl combine the pasta, ricotta and curry powder. Spread the mixture evenly into a well oiled baking dish the mixture should form a thick crust. Spread the white wine evenly on top. Place in the refrigerator to marinate for 1 hour. Cut the baguette into 1 inch thick slices. Place the slices on a baking sheet and place under the grill.

Random Ingredients: willamette hop,peach,tomato,chicken thigh fillet,philadelphia cream cheese,baby spinach leaf,quinoa
title: Peachy Chicken and Spinach Florentine
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 1 chicken thigh fillet, halved & cut into strips | 1 package philadelphia cream cheese, softened ( neufchatel or equivalent ) | 2 cans chopped tomatoes | 1 cup packed baby spinach leaves ( optional ) | 1 can sliced peaches, drained ( optional ) | 1/2 cup fresh peach slices, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Cook quinoa according to package instructions. Meanwhile, spray a skillet with cooking spray then heat over medium high heat. Add chicken and brown on both sides, about 10 minutes. Remove chicken and slice to create more room. Add cream cheese and stir until blended and softened, about 30 seconds. Add tomatoes, spinach, peaches, and any other desired garnishes. Lower heat and simmer for 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: butternut squash,hazelnut,lamb,five spice powder,turmeric powder,manchego cheese
title: Baked Goat Cheese Squash
ingredients: 5 ounces lamb | 1 ounce clarified butter or 1 ounce clarified butter | 1 ounce hazelnuts, roasted and ground in a blender with the spices | szechuan five-spice powder | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 large butternut squash
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 °f and bake it uncovered for around 40 minutes, or until cooked. Remove the lid, check the squash to make sure its cooked. If its not, take it out of the oven and remove the peel. Slice the squash, remove the middle and the bottom and cut the squash into cubes. Mash or process the roasted hazelnuts and stir in with a little of the clarified butter or clarified butter, pour 1/2 the mashed squash into a bowl to let the liquid soak inches then mix with the rest of the spice mix. Spread the mashed squash on a baking sheet and bake for 10 minutes. Stir every now and then and check that its not burning and add more clarified butter or clarified butter. It will thicken more after a few minutes. Put in the goats' cheese on top and serve.

Random Ingredients: kirsch,black peppercorn,cream cheese,liquid smoke flavoring,cooking wine,wheat pasta,lima bean,honeydew melon
title: Smoky Limon Refresher
ingredients: 1 container cream cheese | 2 tablespoons honeydews melon, finely diced | 3 slices quick-cooking wine | 1 cup lima beans | 2 tablespoons kirsch | 2 teaspoons liquid smoke flavoring | 1 tablespoon cracked black peppercorns ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground dry-roasted whole wheat pasta
instructions: In a food processor or blender, combine cream cheese and honeydews melon.

Random Ingredients: sultana,french bread,honey,frankfurter,bean,parmigiano reggiano cheese,white pepper,red wine vinegar
title: Frankfurter Bread With Sultanas and Beans
ingredients: 8 ounces franksfurters, sliced | 1 cup sultana | 1 cup white pepper | 4 tablespoons honey | 1 cup good balsamic vinegar or 1 cup red wine vinegar | 4 ounces parmigiano-reggiano cheese, thinly sliced | 6 slices french bread | ground white pepper | 1 bag french beans ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or a silpat. Arrange the strips of frankfurters on the tray and top with sultanas. Sprinkle with pepper and drizzle with honey. Combine balsamic or red wine vinegar, and sprinkle over the hot frankfurters. Sprinkle top with cheese. Place on the broiler rack, and broil 3 to 5 minutes or until the cheese turns a nice golden brown. Serve hot with french beans, if desired. Serve hot with crusty french bread toasted.

title: Semolina Barley Hummus
ingredients: 1/2 cup pearl barley | 1 cup kerna honey | 2 tablespoons minced garlic | 1 tablespoon molasses | 1 1/2 teaspoons kosher salt | 2 tablespoons hoisin sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients, pour into a serving bowl or into a dish. Mix and coat with hoisin sauce. Use immediately.

title: Thai-Style Basted Beef
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 1/3 cup chopped fresh cilantro | 1 tablespoon ground cinnamon | 2 teaspoons sesame oil | 1 pound rib eye steak | cinnamon stick
instructions: To make the marinade, combine 1 tablespoon sesame oil, cilantro, and cinnamon in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,sauerkraut,pizza dough,buffalo wing sauce,baby corn,pork sauce,chicken,pimento olive
title: Buffalo Chicken Pizza for One
ingredients: 1 can prepared pizza dough | 3 cups shredded cooked chicken | 3 -4 cups cooked buffalo wings sauce, divided | 1 jar chopped pimento stuffed olives, divided | 2 cups sauerkraut, drained and rinsed, divided | 1 jar diced baby corn, drained | 3/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 2 cups hot sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees. Roll out dough on a lightly floured surface. Cut into 4 circles using a cookie cutter. Place one circle of dough on a nonstick baking sheet. Divide chicken, 1/4 cup of the buffalo sauce, 1/4 cup olives, and 1/4 cup of the sauerkraut among 4 circles on top of dough. Top with a second circle of dough. Spread remaining buffalo sauce evenly over the pizza. Using a fork, apply the remaining olive and sauerkraut to the remaining circles of dough that have been lightly brushed with the pimentos. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes or until crust is lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: white cheddar cheese,ziti pasta,cooking oil,pizza dough,pea
title: Ziti Pizza
ingredients: 1 package ziti pasta | 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 2 packages frozen peas | 6 ounces white cheddar cheese, shredded | 1 pizza dough, refrigerated
instructions: Preheat oven to 425ºf. Cook ziti in boiling salted water, uncovered, until just tender but still firm. Drain. Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add peas and cook 2 to 3 minutes, until thawed. Spread peas evenly on top of the ziti and sprinkle with cheddar. Transfer to a floured surface and roll out the pizza dough into a rectangle about 12 by 16 inches. Transfer to a floured baking sheet and top with ziti mixture. Drape with aluminum foil and bake until the bread is bubbly and the veggie topping is golden, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: triple sec,fine breadcrumb,plum tomato,wheat flour,scallop,date,tomato juice,cream cheese
title: Steamed Tri-Colored Scallops With Tomato Salsa
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain fine dry breadcrumb ( about 1/2 cup ) | 8 ounces cream cheese, at room temperature | 1 tablespoon double sec | 1/4 cup plum tomato juice | 1 teaspoon fresh tomato juice | 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh scallops, rinsed and patted dry | 2 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 1/4 cup dates, thinly sliced ( about 2 tbsp. )
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir bread crumbs, cream cheese, triple sec and plum tomato juice to blend. Add scallops & marinate 2 minutes. Dip scallops into flour.

Random Ingredients: chipotle powder,corn oil,cream chicken soup,fontina cheese,taco seasoning mix,lasagna noodle,banana
title: Quick and Easy Awesome Banana Lasagna
ingredients: 1/4 cup corn oil | 1 can cream of chicken soup, undiluted | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 1/2 cups fontina cheese ( shredded ) or 1 1/2 cups american cheese, shredded ( shredded ) | 1 lb banana ( sliced ) | 6 lasagna noodles, uncooked
instructions: Preheat oven to 375f. Combine oil, soup, seasoning mix, and cheese in 1 1/3 quart casserole dish and spread over bottom of dish. Arrange sliced banana over soup mixture. Sprinkle with additional cheese. Bake covered for 30 minutes then uncover and bake 15 minutes longer.

title: Apple and Chili Jam
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs red apples | 2 tablespoons chili peppers, paste with seeds and membrane
instructions: If using frozen apple, thaw completely and slice into chunks about 1/8 inch thick. If using fresh apple, peel and core. Place in large clean bowl and cover with boiling water. Let stand 10 minutes. Drain well and press out the liquid through a fine mesh sieve set over a bowl. Return the strained apple liquid to the bowl. Drain the chile paste through a sieve into the liquid. Mash thoroughly. Bring to boiling point. Add chili seeds. Reduce heat to medium and simmer for 15 minutes.

title: Best Guacamole Ever
ingredients: 2 avocados | 1 tablespoon kosher salt | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Cut avocado in half and remove stone. Carefully scoop out avocado flesh. Place avocado in bowl. Sprinkle salt over avocado and stir to coat. Sprinkle with bay leaf and serve immediately.

title: Rajma Maafe (Vegan Polenta Bread)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1/4 teaspoon whole white flour | 1 large vidalia onion, chopped | 2 cups vegetable broth | 12 ounces frozen okra, thawed | 1/2 cup polenta, or whole grain bread
instructions: Heat a dry skillet over medium high heat, add cumin seeds, and toast until golden, about 4 minutes. Immediately sprinkle the seeds with a bit of the cumin, and let them toast for a minute or two. Watch very carefully, so as not to burn them. Watch it. When they are a golden color, reduce heat to low, and add onions, stirring constantly until onions soften and onions are translucent, about 5 minutes. Add vegetable broth, and bring to a boil. Pour in frozen okra, and return to boil. Reduce heat to low, and simmer 10 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes. While that simmers, preheat a grill pan or griddle over medium high heat. Coat pan with vegetable spray, and place the pan or griddle over the burner. While waiting for food to heat, grease the pan with vegetable oil or olive oil, or lightly butter a baking sheet. Cut the bread into slices 1/2 inch thick. Dip slices one by one into the broth, and roll them in the cumin seeds. Place on the prepared bread. Place under the grill for a couple of minutes on each side, until crusty and a few golden brown spots appear. Serve hot, with a dab of olive oil or butter on top.

title: Easy Pizza - My Way
ingredients: 1 orange peel | 1 plum tomato ( chopped ) | 1 beer
instructions: Pound orange peel well. Put in medium saucepan. Add tomatoes. Put over medium high heat and cook for 3 minutes. Turn heat down to medium, and boil for about 10 minutes. Turn off heat and allow to sit in fridge overnight. Take out of fridge, and let cool for 1 hour. Add your favorite sauce, cheeses, beer or whatever you like on top. Let it sit for 20 minutes, and you'll start eating.

title: Crispy Yellow Rice Pie Crust
ingredients: 1 cup yellow cornmeal | 3 cups vanilla ice cream | 3 tablespoons corn oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line two 9 inch pies pans with baking paper. Beat cornmeal on slow speed of electric mixer until light and fluffy. Mix in vanilla ice cream. Transfer mixture to pastry lined pans. Bake in preheated oven until crust just begins to brown, about 45 minutes. Cool pie layers on baking pans for 5 minutes before removing to wire racks to cool completely.

title: Temunu Nibbles
ingredients: 5 cups shelled pistachios | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1/4 cup tamari ( dark soy sauce ) | 1 large egg yolk | 1 tablespoon lime juice
instructions: Blend ingredients for the tamari paste in a magic bullet or blender until fine and frothy. Strain the mixture and add to the pistachios on clean, dry towels. Roll them in the palms of your hands until they become very crisp, then remove from the towels and let it dry on paper towels. Store the nuts in an airtight container until they are crisp. The nuts must dry slightly before they are used.

Random Ingredients: garlic granule,yellow pepper,spanish onion,rosemary,tortilla chip,swiss chard,lime wedge,purpose flour
title: Garlic Herb Veggie Crisp (Vegan)
ingredients: 1 can swiss chard, roughly chopped | 1 can yellow sweet peppers, roughly chopped | 1/4 cup spanish onion, roughly chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh garlic granules ( or to taste ) | 1 tablespoon granulated garlic | 1 tablespoon garlic granules ( or to taste ) | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary | 1 tablespoon dried tarragon | 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour | lime wedge
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Spread out all ingredients into a rectangle baking dish, or any large size measuring cup and press into a 9x13 glass pan. Bake for 15 minutes, or until golden brown. Serve with lime wedges.

title: Pumpkins and Chocolate
ingredients: 400 g plain flour | 1 packet chocolate curls | 200 g concentrated tomato puree | 1 can chopped tomatoes | 2 tablespoons tomato paste ( optional )
instructions: Mix plain flour, 2 teaspoons of the chocolate curls and concentrated chilli sauce mix in blender with a little water, until well combined. Stir in tomatoes and tomato paste, if desired and mix again. Grease two small gratin dishes with 1 cm oil, and spoon mixture into dish. Cook in 375f oven for 40 minutes, or until cooked through.

title: Noble House Golden Raisin Nuts
ingredients: 1/2 pound golden raisins, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil
instructions: In a large bowl, toss the golden raisins with the dark sesame oil. Let the raisins stand at room temperature for 2 hours or more. Drain the excess oil and discard it. Spread the raisins on paper towels or newspapers to dry. Store the nuts in the refrigerator.

title: Green Tea Sauper (Tea Verde)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons green tea | 1/2 lb dried medium-width seaweed, such as arugula or 1/2 lb soppressata | 1/2 lb pimiento, halved, stemmed
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together the green tea and seaweed. Cover tightly and leave at room temperature for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Meanwhile, grill the pimento and pimientos over high heat, turning, until golden, 3 to 4 minutes. Remove the mixture from the tea and place it in a teapot. Stir the green tea and seaweed mixture, and heat over moderate heat until the sauce is slightly reduced, about 2 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Rasgula (Raisin & Bread Crumble)
ingredients: 225 g raisins | 225 g sesame seed oil | 80 g parmesan cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Line two baking trays with baking paper. Put the raisins and seeds in a basin, and pour over enough water to cover. Stand 25 minutes. Rinse the bowl dry. Melt the oil and spread over the raisins. Add the parmesan and serve.

title: Prosciutto With Mixed Berry Sauce
ingredients: 2 slices prosciutto, diced small | 1 tablespoon fresh fat or 1 tablespoon dried berries ( try to get all berries ) | 1 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Place prosciutto and berries on a plate. Sprinkle with powdered sugar. Heat cream over low heat until warm. Fold in cooled prosciutto and stir lightly but constantly. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: coffee liqueur,wheat flour,kernel corn,red cabbage,vanilla essence,fava bean
title: Koldskål - Danish Christmas Pancakes With Fava Beans
ingredients: 12 ounces dry whole wheat flour ( white/black ) | 1 tablespoon vanilla essence | 1 1/3 cups fava beans ( or 1 1/3 cups berries or a combo of whatever you like ) | 1 cup whole kernel corn | 1 red cabbage ( or 4 cups shredded cabbage ) | coffee liqueur ( optional ) | 1 cup white or black forest forest ham slices ( optional ) or 1 cup black forest ham ( optional )
instructions: Mix dough ingredients in a large bowl. Let sit 15 - 20 minutes in the refrigerator. Heat a nonstick skillet. When hot, add 2 tablespoons of oil to coat pan. Add batter to pan and flatten the top, cooking for 1 - 2 minutes each side. Remove pancakes when browned to plate and set aside. Add the remaining oil in the same skillet to fry the ham slices. When crisp, remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Return them to the frying pan, add the coffee liqueur. Return skillet to a low heat. Add cooked fava beans and cabbage. Cook on medium low heat until cabbage is tender. Turn the heat down and cook until the fava beans have cooked. Pour beans and cabbage on a plate and top with fava beans and cabbage. Sprinkle with black forest ham slices and drizzle with coffee liqueur. Add more black forest if you desire.

title: Spicy Strawberry-Prosciutto Salad
ingredients: 20 fresh ripe strawberries | 2 slices prosciutto | 1/2 cup stock | 5 leaves lettuce leaves | 6 slices crisp cooked bacon, diced | 1/2 teaspoon cumin seeds, ground | 1/2 teaspoon white peppercorns, ground
instructions: Wash and pith the strawberries, removing excess stems. Cut the stalks and the leaves into 2 or 3 slices depending on their size. Place in a serving bowl, and add the remaining ingredients, except the bacon pieces, and toss to combine.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,dill,bean,onion powder,white peppercorn,garlic powder,turmeric powder,half
title: Taste for Hot Bean Filling
ingredients: 3 cups half a pound shelled beans, canned, organic ( or homemade ) | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 1 teaspoon onion powder or 1 teaspoon onion salt | 1 tablespoon garlic powder | 1 tablespoon fennel or 1 tablespoon green onion, chopped | 1 tablespoon red pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon crushed white peppercorns | 1 tablespoon turmeric powder
instructions: Drain the beans overnight. Drain the excess liquid from the beans, or run beans through a food processor. Mix all other ingredients except the beans and let stand about 30 minutes. Add the beans and mix well. Form bean sized balls with your hands, and roll them in a small amount of flour to coat. Place on a tray and cover them completely in the oven at 400 degrees f, stirring every 5 minutes. Place them on a rack or paper towels to drain the excess oil, and when cool enough, store them somewhere cool to the touch.

Random Ingredients: thai chili sauce,lukewarm water,apple,lemon extract,garlic,cremini mushroom,rose water
title: Apple and Mushrooms With Lemon-Thai Sauce
ingredients: 7 medium littleneck mushrooms | 1 large apple - peeled, cored, and sliced | 1/4 teaspoon lemon extract | 1/3 cup fresh rose water | 5 cloves garlic, peeled and thinly sliced | 3 tablespoons thai sweet chili sauce | 1 tablespoon lukewarm water
instructions: Wash the mushrooms thoroughly, removing any stems or blemishes. Remove any grit in the mushroom and discard. Trim ends and cut each mushroom in half lengthwise. Place the mushrooms and apple into a large steamer over boiling water. Cover and steam over boiling water for 5 minutes. Remove to a serving plate, and set aside to cool. Transfer any apple chunks to a small bowl, add lemon extract, rose water, garlic, thai chili sauce, and water to the bowl. Mix thoroughly. Refrigerate and use within 1 hour of preparing the dish. Serve, and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: vodka,egg white,stew meat,romaine lettuce,italian parsley,brown rice,peanut,beef marrow
title: Beef Broth With Rice and Dressing
ingredients: 2 cups beef marrow | 2 tablespoons brown rice | 2 lbs beef bones with marrow | 1 cup chopped italian parsley | 1/4 cup paprika and 1/4 cup brown sugar | 12 egg whites | 1/4 cup peanut oil or 1/4 cup butter | 4 cups chopped romaine lettuce
instructions: Combine beef bones and marrow in a medium saucepan. Add water to cover. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer until tender, 35 minutes. Drain. Remove marrow bones. Place marrow, rice, bone mixture, parsley, paprika and sugar in a food processor. Blend until smooth. Transfer marrow mixture to a large bowl. Cool completely. Add egg whites and blend briefly. Pour into soup pot. Heat but do not boil. Cover. Heat to boiling 10 minutes. Serve over salads and on the side for extra flavor. Serves.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,lemon zest,beef tenderloin,chinese five spice powder,turmeric,greek yogurt,serrano chilies,red bell pepper
title: Tandoori Kabobs
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chinese five spice powder | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 tablespoon grated lemon zest | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground turmeric | 1 1/4 pounds beef tenderloin, trimmed of fat | 24 slices serrano chilies, cut into long strips | 1 red bell pepper, cut into thin strips | 1/2 cup greek yogurt, room temperature
instructions: Preheat grill for high heat. Combine five spice powder, cocoa powder, lemon zest, and turmeric in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: sirloin steak,mango,monterey jack pepper cheese,ladyfinger,prosciutto,thyme sprig
title: Mango Beef Roll-Ups With Prosciutto
ingredients: 24 sourdough ladyfingers | 8 slices prosciutto | 1 cup mango, cubed | 2 ounces monterey jack pepper cheese, shredded | 2 lbs ground sirloin steak | fresh thyme sprigs
instructions: Arrange 4 lady fingers on the work surface, trimming as required. Spread 3 slices the prosciutto evenly over ladyfingers, then evenly scatter mango over ladyfingers. Top each with 1/4 of the cheese and 2 tablespoons of the meat mixture. Roll up jelly roll fashion and secure with tooth picks. Arrange in a shallow baking dish and broil, basting occasionally, until cheese is melted and bubbly, about 3 - 5 minutes. Remove tooth picks and serve topped with thyme.

title: Homemade Shortbread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups icing sugar | 1 cup heavy superfine sugar, melted & cooled
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine icing sugars & melted crisco & mix well. Stir in melted crisco. Stir in about 1/2 cup of the hot sugar, & knead to form a firm dough. Lightly flour a cookie press then press to 1/4 thick with the bottom of a glass. Place on lightly greased cookie sheet and score to form the outline of a circle. Repeat the design while pressing with the remaining shortbread, letting cookies fall into the oven. Bake in a preheated 350f oven for 20 minutes or until edges are golden brown. Transfer to wire rack to cool.

title: Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup apricot preserves | 2 green or red fresh fruit, sliced
instructions: Mix preserves and sliced fruit in bowl. Serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: pad thai rice noodle,strawberry,cooking oil,sesame seed,wild blueberry,orange bell pepper,peanut butter
title: Wild Blueberry Spargel
ingredients: 3 packages pad thai rice noodles ( or your favorite dry rice noodles ) | 2 cups fresh wild blueberries | 1 cup thawed and drained peanut butter | 2 cups fresh strawberries, sliced | 1 large orange bell pepper, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds
instructions: Cover a large bowl with cheesecloth and set aside. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add the rice noodles and stir to separate, then remove from heat and let stand until tender, about 10 minutes. Drain, then set aside. Place the blueberries in a food processor and purée with the peanut butter. Place the strawberries and orange pepper slices in a small bowl. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Heat the oven's broiler and set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source. Brush a baking sheet with oil, then place the rice noodles on it. Bake the bread until toasted and the berries begin to soften, about 3 minutes. Transfer to a bowl. Mix the peanut butter with the reserved noodles. Spoon the peanut butter mixture onto an ungreased baking sheet. Sprinkle the sesame seeds over the peanut butter. Broil until the sauce is rich and bubbly, 3 to 5 minutes.

title: Barley and Black Currant Pilaf
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups pearl barley | 3/4 cup black currants
instructions: Put barley in a medium sized bowl and cover with cold water. Put in the fridge. Drain and rinse well so as to make sure there are no grains of grains of any of the above. Soak for 15 minutes. Drain and rinse black currants. Set aside. Heat a pan on medium high heat and saute the black currants. They are cooked by now, and should not look swollen. When cooked through, remove any excess liquid. You will probably need about 1/4 cup of black currant liquid. You can also put the back of spoon on a plate to drain, so that the whole bottom of the pan can be covered. You can then pile this into a colander in the sink to drain and rinse. It should be pretty dry and difficult to drain if the liquid does not pool back up, which means you may need to add more liquid. This will be done the minute before you are ready to eat. Serve. Some folks like to mash some of the black currant into the barley with a fork, before adding the black currant and black currants.

title: Fajitas (Yemeni-style Fresh Asafoetida)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons asafoetida powder | 2 tablespoons lite olive oil
instructions: Heat skillet over medium heat. Add sesame oil. When it starts to smoke, add asafetida, stirring to coat. After a minute, add oil. Keep stirring the contents of the skillet. When the oil stops smoking, add the asafetida. Turn the mixture to simmer and add a little water. Cook on medium high heat and fry on low for about 10 minutes until very fragrant. Remove from heat and let it sit. Serve hot with white rice.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf italian parsley,greek yogurt,red bird eye chili
title: Roasted Red-Decker Chili
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red bird's eye chili, finely minced | 1/3 cup natural fat free greek yogurt, greek strained | 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh flat-leaf italian parsley, chopped
instructions: Combine the chili, yogurt and parsley in a small bowl. Cover and refrigerate up to 1 hour. Store in refrigerator between folds of plastic wrap.

title: Easy Awesome Taco Meat
ingredients: 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 1 cup bottled chili sauce
instructions: Prepare taco meat according to package directions. Heat oven to 375 degrees, and mix chili sauce with taco meat. Bake 15 minutes, or until heated through.

title: Toasted Almonds
ingredients: 1/2 - 1 teaspoon chili oil or 1/2-1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 1/2 lbs toasted whole almonds | 2 1/2 - 3 tablespoons sliced almonds, lightly toasted
instructions: In a small bowl, combine hot chili oil or cayenne pepper and seasoned salt. Stir well. Spread lightly in an ungreased 9 x 12 inch baking pan or cookie sheet. Sprinkle lightly with toasted almonds. Sprinkle with enough of the toasted almonds to cover. Sprinkle with enough of the remaining toasted almonds to cover the top, using remaining toasted almonds. Cover the nuts with foil or a light coating of cooking spray. Place in a hot oven, 450°f bake for 35 - 40 minutes. Remove foil and bake an additional 10 minutes or until almonds are crisp and lightly browned. Remove nuts from oven, increase heat to 400f, and bake an additional 10 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool completely and store in an airtight container for up to 2 weeks. Makes 4 serving size pieces.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,sirloin steak,pesto sauce,butternut squash,granny smith apple,salt pork,white hominy
title: Grandma's Baked Beef and Pesto
ingredients: 3 sirloin steaks | 1 can white hominy, drained | 3 tablespoons pesto sauce | 3 granny smith apples - peeled, cored, and diced | 6 ounces salt pork, cubed | 1 can small white hominy, drained | grand marnier to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Place the steaks in a roasting pan and cover with a dish towel or a lid. In a medium bowl, mix together the drained hominy and pesto sauce.

title: Eggplant Surprise
ingredients: 1 small eggplant | 1 jar pimientos | 1/2 cup dark rum
instructions: Brush a small hole of reynolds wrap non stick cooking spray inside of a medium size baking sheet, set on top of the counter, in rows 1 - ½ inches apart. Slice eggplant into ½ inch slices. Place slices flat side up on the foil covered baking sheet. Sprinkle each slice liberally with salt. In a small pan, bring 1/2 inch of water to boil, reduce heat slightly to simmer and cook eggplant until very tender. Drain. Sprinkle slices with pimientos, then roll the eggplant through sugar drippings. Pour rum on top and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: mustard powder,green cardamom pod,red food coloring,pepperjack cheese,fajita seasoning,cauliflower floret,peanut butter
title: Fajita Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 pound cauliflower florets | 1 package hot pepperjack cheese | 5 tablespoons peanut butter, chunky | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 green cardamom pod, crushed | 3 drops red food coloring | 1 teaspoon fajita seasoning
instructions: Cut cauliflower into bite size pieces and rinse well. Place cauliflower in a bowl and sprinkle with hot pepperjack cheese. Mix peanut butter with mustard powder, green cardamom pod and fajita seasoning. Stir in the coated cauliflower. Cook at medium heat for 1 minute. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: raspberry vinegar,black bean,grainy mustard,red enchilada sauce,kosher salt,white cheese
title: Cheesy Black Bean and Raspberry Salad
ingredients: 2 cans black beans | 1 -2 cup sweet white cheese, grated | 1 cup fresh raspberry vinegar | 1 -2 tablespoon grainy mustard ( i use prepared ) | 2 -4 tablespoons red enchilada sauce ( i use old el paso ) | 1 -2 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Drain the cans of beans, rinse well with cold water, and coarsely mash them with a potato masher until they are smooth to the crumbles of a wooden spoon. Stir the coarsely mashed beans into the mashed beans and spread them evenly in a salad bowl. In a microwave safe bowl, combine the cheese, raspberry vinegar, mustard, and red enchilada sauce, and microwave on high power until the cheese is melted and bubbly, about 3 - 5 minutes, stirring twice. Sprinkle the cheese mixture evenly over the white bean mixture. Sprinkle the last bit of cheese on top and microwave on medium high power just until the cheese is melted and bubbly, 1 - 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: espresso,tomato juice,chive,seasoning italian salad dressing mix,pork tenderloin,cointreau liqueur,hot pepper
title: Espresso-Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 1/2 cup coffee-flavored italian salad dressing mix | 1 1/2 teaspoons cointreau liqueur | 1 lb pork tenderloin, center loins trimmed | 2 1/2 ounces hot pepper, coarsely chopped, i use bottled | 14 1/2 ounces diced tomatoes with juice, undrained | 3/4 cup canned pure espresso | 2 tablespoons fresh chives, finely chopped
instructions: Prepare coffee coffee dressing mix according to package directions for salad dressing. Heat wok over medium high heat. Add pork, hot pepper and 1 t. Of the salad dressing mix.

Random Ingredients: anaheim chilies,poblano chile,turbinado sugar,hard egg,kaffir lime leaf,white flour
title: Chiles Rellenos with Flour
ingredients: 2 anaheim chilies, sliced into 1/2 '' rounds | 3/4 teaspoon turbinado sugar | 2 1/2 cups unbleached white flour | 12 large poblano chiles, charred | 2 hard-boiled eggs, chopped | 1/2 cup kaffir lime leaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f place chiles on oven sheet. Bake on center rack for 10 minutes. Sprinkle with sugar and allow to cool. Remove stems and seeds and cut off the stems. Place flour in medium bowl. Working with 1 chile at a time, dip each chile in flour.

title: Fennel and Black Beans
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon grated fennel bulb, or more to taste | 1 can black beans, rinsed
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add ground fennel and fenel bulb.

title: Low Fat Salmon Chowder
ingredients: 400 g salmon, skin removed | 1 cup ice water | 2 teaspoons green chilies, finely chopped | 2 cups asparagus, chopped | 1/2 cup cucumber, chopped
instructions: Place salmon, ice water and chillies in a blender and blend until smooth. Add asparagus, cucumber and a little of the liquid from the blender jar to make a slush. Pour into serving bowl and top with remaining salmon and chillies. If you want to freeze, place mixture on a piece of foil covered with plastic wrap and freeze. To serve, let thaw for half an hour. Serve over a mixture of rice, pasta, noodles, breadcrumbs or use in sandwiches.

title: Rigatoni With Nuts
ingredients: 455 g rigatoni pasta | 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 500 ml chicken stock | 2 tablespoons bouillon | 5 walnut halves
instructions: Cook the rigatoni until it is almost done. Place in a saucepan and place in boiling water. Simmer gently for 10 minutes or until cooked. Drain and place in a bowl with a lid so that steam can escape. Heat the oil in a pan and place in a frypan. Fry the nut halves until golden brown before starting to brown the nuts.
