Drain on kitchen paper. Place the cooked rigatoni on the fried nuts and sprinkle with the nut mixture. Serve with fresh garlic mashed potatoes.

title: Roasted Red Potato
ingredients: 2 pounds small red potatoes | 1/2 cup diced red chile peppers | 1 clove garlic, minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees f. Place the potatoes in a large bowl and toss with the chile peppers and garlic. Sprinkle with salt.

Random Ingredients: sea salt black pepper,chili seasoning mix
title: Lebanese Chili Powder Spice
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chili seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon sea salt and black pepper
instructions: Whisk together the chili powder and sea salt until the salt dissolves. Store in a small glass bowl.

title: Mild Sugar-Free Beef Salad
ingredients: 1 3/4 lbs stewing beef, cut into cubes | 1 cup low-fat peanut butter | 1/2 cup low-fat vanilla sugar | 1/2 cup malt vinegar | 1/4 cup capers
instructions: Place beef cubes in a large roasting pan. Combine sugar, vinegar and capers. Stir into beef. Cover.

Random Ingredients: table cream,vanilla,pork rib,corn chip,port wine,dark rum,brown lentil
title: Lentil & Brown Sugar Barbecue Ribs
ingredients: 1 lb country-style pork ribs, cut into 2-rib portions | 1/2 cup port wine ( may use dry sherry ) | 1 teaspoon dark rum | 8 ounces brown lentils, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup corn chips ( coarsely crushed ) or 1/2 cup yellow corn chips ( coarsely crushed ) | 1/4 cup table cream | ground vanilla ( for dusting )
instructions: If using wine, add brown rice, beans and 1/2 cup corn chips. If using dry red wine, add 1/4 cup corn chips. Coat ribs with port and rum and grill over indirect heat, basting ribs with pan mixture every 10 minutes or so, until meat is cooked through, about 18 - 20 minutes. Turn frequently during this 1 1/2 hours or overnight to insure even browning. During the last 10 minutes of grilling time, spread crushed corn chips on a grill rack. After removing ribs from grill, transfer to a serving plate. While ribs are warm, pour fat from pan into a small saucepan and place over medium low heat. Cook until it begins to boil, stirring frequently. Pour oil from pan into a shallow bowl with a lid. When oil bubbles, remove from heat. Remove meat from bones and shred into bite size chunks, using forks and fingers. Place a serving platter on top of ribs and ladle sauce in the center. Garnish ribs and serve. If using dry red wine or honey mustard, pour some of the oil into small saucepan and heat over low heat until hot but not smoking.

title: Mung Bean Sprouts With Sesame-Soy Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb mung bean sprouts, raw | dark sesame oil
instructions: If using fresh mung bean sprouts, blanch them for 1 minute in boiling water to which sesame oil has already been added. Drain and place in a colander to drain. Heat sesame oil in a skillet over high heat until a bead of water vaporizes, about 1 minute. Add sprouts and toss until lightly coated, about 1 minute. Serve with dipping sauce..

title: Easy Party Party Appetizers
ingredients: 1 pound bamboo toothpicks | 2 cans red enchilada sauce, or as needed
instructions: Preheat an oven to 300 degrees f. Arrange toothpicks in a line onto a large baking sheet. Pour enchilada sauce over the toothpicks, and place the sheet of toothpicks on the preheated oven. Cook in the preheated oven until the toothpicks have turned a golden brown color, about 30 minutes. Allow toothpicks to cool completely before removing toothpicks.

title: Simple Microwave Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 1 package whole wheat spaghetti | 1 tablespoon ground mustard seed | 1 tablespoon matzo meal | 1/4 cup instant rice
instructions: Cut spaghetti into 1 inch pieces and place into microwave safe casserole dish with enough water to cover. Cook covered on high for 6 to 8 minutes, then remove cover and cook another 8 to 10 minutes on high, until all water is absorbed and rice is tender. If you prefer a thicker texture, microwave the rice for another 2 to 3 minutes to soften it. Drain spaghetti, and return to casserole dish. Stir well, and spread rice in an even layer. Sprinkle a small amount of mustard seed over top of the rice. Microwave for 2 or 3 more minutes, stirring every 30 seconds, until the mustard seeds begin to pop. Remove from microwave and top with matzo meal. Let stand for 1 to 2 minutes before serving.

title: Ginger Corn Fish
ingredients: 375 g scallops, cleaned ( or steaks, shrimp, or shrimp, or other seafood ) | 1 piece gingerroot | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds | 1 tablespoon cornflour ( cornstarch )
instructions: Wash the scallops and cut slices in half. Cut the meat into thin slices, and place in a mixing bowl, sprinkle with the sesame seeds. Sprinkle over a little cornflour and coat the scallops and meat well. Heat up a wok, and add a little oil. Saute the scallops and meat for a few seconds, just until they’re nicely golden brown. Transfer the pan to a plate and stir through the cornflour to thicken the gravy. Serve the gravy over pasta or rice.

Random Ingredients: cottage cheese,wheel brie cheese,jalapeno pepper,corn oil,tabasco sauce,green olive,chili oil
title: Brie Cheese Spread
ingredients: 2 lbs small wheel brie cheese, with rind removed | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 1 cup fat-free cottage cheese | 1 green olives, chopped or can sliced pimento stuffed green olives, drained | 1 tablespoon canned whole pickled jalapeno peppers, minced | 1 -2 dash tabasco sauce | 1 -2 drop chili oil
instructions: Place the brie cheese on a piece of waxed paper and top with 1 tablespoon of corn oil, covering the entire cheese. Using a potato peeler slice off the cheese in a chute fashion and place in a small bowl with water to cover. Let sit for a few minutes then squeeze out the excess water. In a medium bowl, stir together the cottage cheese, black olives and jalapeno peppers. Stir in the tabasco sauce. Using a hand held blender or food processor blend until smooth. Use immediately or it will harden up considerably. Refrigerate covered until serving. To serve, invert the brie cheese on a large platter. Hold down the cheese with your palms and carefully remove the waxed paper. Serve with toasted bagels, crackers or warm toast or crackers.

Random Ingredients: chili paste,beer,nutmeg,chinese five spice powder,red cabbage,spice,green bell pepper,paprika
title: Steamed Red Cabbage
ingredients: 150 g red cabbage ( finely shredded ) | 1 ounce green bell pepper ( finely grated ) | 1 tablespoon sweet paprika | 1 tablespoon chinese five spice powder | 1 teaspoon chili paste | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg ( grated ) | 1 beer ( optional )
instructions: Put the cabbage in a steaming tray and microwave on high for 4 minutes. Meanwhile, mix paprika, 5 spice, chilli paste and mix thoroughly in a small bowl. Pour over the cabbage and toss well. Allow to cool for 5 - 10 minutes. Pour over a little cold water and refrigerate until ready to serve. Tip, if you're using a non metallic colander, you can drain off any excess liquid before opening the lid of the colander. This would be especially tasty as a salad and will help remove any traces of the salty sourness of this dark red cabbage. Serve with prawn or fried skate fish.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom,brown sugar,annatto seed,orange zest,black bean,green,sunflower oil
title: Caribbean -Saint Lucia Beans and Quinoa
ingredients: 1 teaspoon annatto seeds | 2/3 cup sunflower oil | 1/3 cup light brown sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons orange zest or 1 teaspoon lemon zest | 1/2 teaspoon black beans or 1/2 teaspoon pimento-stuffed green beans, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon green cardamom | 1/2 teaspoon green cardamoms
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large saucepan and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, 10 to 15 minutes or until beans are tender.

title: Yogurt Grilled Turkey Sandwiches
ingredients: 3 tablespoons low-fat yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 2 boneless turkey breast, thinly sliced | 2 slices focaccia bread, toasted
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the yogurt with the asafoetida. Place the turkey slices on a plate. Spoon the yogurt mixture over the turkey slices. Wrap each piece of turkey in a piece of toasted focaccia bread. Serve.

title: Danish Cracked Sausages
ingredients: 12 ounces baking soda | 12 ounces cooking sherry
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Combine baking soda and sherry and add to a large bowl. Roll the sausage mixture into walnut sized balls and place on a piece of foil. Bake the sausages for around 20 minutes until no longer pink when picked up with a tooth pick inserted in the middle. Serve with fresh vegetables, such as potatoes or fresh fruit. Keep warm in the oven on 150°f if using dried fruits too.

title: Slow Cooker Chicken, Wild Rice, and Corn
ingredients: 2 pounds boneless, skinless chicken thighs | 2 cups wild rice, uncooked | 1 can corn, drained | 2 limes, cut into wedges
instructions: Place chicken thighs in bottom of slow cooker. Mix wild rice and corn in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: asafoetida powder,chinese vegetable,parmigiano reggiano cheese,kosher salt,pork sparerib,oregano leaf
title: Oaxacan-Style Pork Spareribs
ingredients: 1/2 cup unsalted kosher salt | 2 slices chinese vegetables, cut crosswise into thick slices ( e.g. dungenessers ) | 3 tablespoons freshly chopped fresh oregano leaves | 1/3 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( ground black pepper ) | 1 1/2 lbs pork spareribs, cut crosswise in 1 to 2-inch lengths | 1/2 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese, divided
instructions: Combine 3/4 cup plus 3 tablespoons water and salt in heavy large saucepan over medium high heat. Add vegetables and oregano.

title: Cottage Cheese and Bread Salad
ingredients: 1 cup white rice, cooked, drained ( long grain ) | 1 cup cottage cheese, low fat, plain | 1 parsnip, cooked and sliced or 1/2 cup cabbage | 3 tablespoons fresh basil, chopped | 1 tablespoon hot oil | 12 slices rye bread, toasted
instructions: Cook the rice in the hot oil until just beginning to brown, stirring constantly. Add the cottage cheese, parsnip and basil mixture to the rice and mix throughly. Serve immediately.

title: Pinchu (Fenugreek Lentils)
ingredients: 1 lb dried pinto bean, soaked overnight | 1 lb dried apricot | 1 teaspoon fennel seed
instructions: Drain soaked beans and place in a pot. Add enough water to cover. Simmer about 1 1/2 hours or until lentils turn brown, skimming from bottom. Drain and put to one side. Place soaked beans and apricots in a food processor and puree until smooth. Bring to a boil and stir in fennel seed. Return to a boil and simmer 10 minutes.

title: Pork Sandwich
ingredients: 3 lbs pork roast | 1/4 lb dried potato gnocchi, washed | 2 cans chicken wings, rinsed | 3 tablespoons dijon mustard
instructions: Mix the chicken wings with the dijon and place in a large baking dish. Cut the pork roast into bite sized pieces and add to the bag. Pour 1 can of chicken broth over the meat. Cover and bake at 350 degrees for approximately 2 hours. Remove from oven and shred with two forks. Re cover and return to oven for another 45 minutes. Serve on a roll.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno,greek olive,beef chuck,chunky salsa,chicken breast,plain flour
title: Simple Crockpot Chicken & Shredded Beef
ingredients: 3/4 lb boneless beef chuck, cut int 1 inch cubes ( it doesn't matter if you happen to only one ) | 1 jar of your favorite chunky salsa ( i prefer medium heat ) | 1 -2 jalapeno, chopped ( depending on your heat tolerance ) | 1 1/2 cups plain flour | 1 can sliced greek olives, drained | 1 lb chicken breast, in 1 `` cubes, cut into 1-inch squares
instructions: In crockpot place beef, salsa, jalapeno, and 1 1/2 cup of flour. Cover and cook on low for 7 - 8 hours or on high for 3 1/2 5 hours until meat is tender. While that is cooking place remaining flour in medium bowl. Stir in olives. Drain beef well and add to flour mixture. Stir to coat. Turn crockpot to high, add remaining salsa and stir to incorporate. Cook on high for 90 minutes, reducing heat to low to keep warm until serving. Serve over rice or brown rice.

Random Ingredients: navel orange,picante sauce,hummus,poultry seasoning,ladyfinger cooky,coffee,spicy pesto
title: Sassy Pesto Tiramisu
ingredients: 8 ladyfinger cookies, quartered ( no more than 15 cookies ) | 2 tablespoons spicy pesto | 2 teaspoons instant coffee | 1 envelope instant french's classic ranch dressing or ( 2 ounce ) envelope spicy hot dip mix | 1/4 cup picante sauce | 1 navel orange | 1 teaspoon poultry seasoning
instructions: Coat inside of 5 dessert dishes with no stick cooking spray or a nonstick olive oil flavored cooking spray. Set aside. Mix pesto and coffee together in a small bowl. Split ladyfingers in half horizontally and cut the halves in half down the middle. Lay half halves cut side down, on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper or waxed paper. Spoon half pesto mixture on the cut side of ladyfingers. Repeat, layering once, with remaining ladyfingers, pesto mixture, and coffee mixture. Grate zest of an orange into center of tiramisu, then sprinkle it over top. Dribble over picante sauce. Allow dish to sit for 10 minutes before cutting into squares.

Random Ingredients: spinach,dark beer,lavender flower,green chile pepper,salt pepper
title: Colorado Green Chile With Sauteed Spinach
ingredients: 10 cups fresh spinach | 12 ounces dark beer, lager-style ( recommended ( corona ) | 6 -8 tablespoons fresh lavender flowers ( optional ) | 1 whole green chile pepper, seeded, stemmed, and quartered | salt and pepper
instructions: Wash and trim the spinach. If you want to use fresh leaves, steam them for 5 minutes. Rinse leaves under cold water and drain once cool. Wash the water in a strainer under cold running water. When water is clear, remove the stems, then chop them into small pieces. Place in a large heavy saucepan with the beer and lavender. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat. Stir often until the beer has reduced to a nice film about 1/2 inch thick. Add the whole green pepper, reduce the heat to medium and simmer for 3 to 4 minutes. Stir in salt and pepper. Cool, then squeeze out excess water. Drain the greens and reserve the marinade in a strainer. Add 3 tablespoons reserved marinade to the greens and reheat it, about 1 minute. The greens should be just plump, bathing in greens with no liquid on the surface. Serve warm.

title: Rice and Eggplant (Aubergine) Spread
ingredients: 3/4 cup long-grain white rice | 1 large eggplant, peeled, sliced into rounds 1/4 inch thick ( or a combination ) | 3/4 cup pitted green olives, coarsely chopped ( pimentos can be substituted ) | 3 cups mexican blend cheese, coarsely grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f with a cookie sheet in preheated oven, grease cookie sheet. Spread rice in an even layer on cookie sheet. Arrange eggplant slices over rice, overlapping if necessary. Sprinkle green olives evenly over the top. Top with cheese. Bake 8 to 10 minutes until golden brown on top and bottom. Slide a spatula under the eggplant to loosen and let cool 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: paprika,garlic powder,rice wine vinegar,mango,corn tortilla,dill,pineapple juice
title: Mango Stir Fry Tacos
ingredients: 4 medium mangoes | 8 soft corn tortillas | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon pineapple juice | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 teaspoon dried dill, chopped | 1 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Slice the mangoes into thin, 2 inch long sticks. Mix together the marinade and put in a bowl. Add the mangoes to the marinade, and let sit for 30 minutes. Heat a non stick skillet or griddle over medium high heat. Place the tortillas on the pan and cook for about 90 seconds on each side, or until golden brown. Slice the tortillas diagonally, then cut across the middle, to make triangles. Put the corn and mango triangles in a bowl and toss. Mix the rice wine vinegar, pineapple juice, garlic powder, dill, and paprika together in another bowl. Spread the sauce on the tortillas, followed by the pineapple. Enjoy.

title: Celery, Feta and Roasted Garlic Rolls
ingredients: 1 head fresh lettuce leaf | 1/4 cup fresh crumb feta cheese, crumbled | 1/4 cup panko breadcrumbs | 3 stalks celery, trimmed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Tear off a 10 inch square of aluminum foil slightly smaller than the top rack of your oven. Set aside. Using a vegetable peeler or very sharp knife, peel away white membrane on the outer layer of outer leaves of the lettuce and set aside. Using a sharp, wet knife, remove tough outer leaves of the lettuce. Place the lettuce in a large bowl. Add feta, panko, and celery. Toss to combine well. Wrap securely in the foil and place in the oven for 15 to 20 minutes, until warm. Let cool to room temperature before serving.

Random Ingredients: orange zest,turmeric,cooking spray,chili sauce,parmesan cheese,chili garlic sauce,self raising flour
title: Spicy Chilli Scones
ingredients: 375 g self-raising flour | 1/4 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1 1/2 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese | 2 teaspoons orange zest | cooking spray, olive oil type | sweet chili sauce, to serve | chili-garlic sauce, to serve
instructions: Preheat oven to 190c. Line a large baking tray with baking paper. In a medium bowl, combine flour, turmeric, parmesan and zest. Use your hands to rub through the orange mixture until it resembles fine breadcrumbs. If the mixture resembles fine breadcrumbs, mix a little more water with your hands before adding it. Dump the flours onto a clean surface and knead lightly until just combined. Cover with a clean tea towel, then cover with cloth. Transfer the scone to a lightly floured surface, and knead lightly once or twice to form a smooth and evenish dough. Place on baking tray and cover top with a tea towel. Place on oven for about 50 minutes until well risen and light gold. Spray a hot scone/sandwich bag with olive oil spray, and fill with sesame seeds. Slice scone into 8 wedges, then sandwich together to form 8 triangles. Serve with sweet chilli sauce.

Random Ingredients: breadcrumb,black mustard seed,porcini mushroom,chili pepper flake,chicken bouillon cube,green chilies,oyster sauce
title: Porcini Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 lb fresh porcini mushrooms, cleaned, dried | 1 green chilies, chopped or can chopped green chilies | 1 teaspoon black mustard seeds, lightly brown | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh chili pepper flakes | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1/2 cup breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup oyster sauce
instructions: Place mushrooms and 1/4 cup water in a frying pan. Sprinkle with the chili flakes and stir fry for a few minutes, remove the pan from heat and set aside. Puree the mushrooms in a food processor. Stir the remaining water, mustard seeds and chilis into the mushroom mixture, add the bouillon cube and stir well. Pour over the mushrooms, stir to coat evenly. Cover and cook on low for 20 minutes. Sprinkle with 1/4 cup of the breadcrumbs. Serve immediately.

title: Persian Rabbit
ingredients: 4 lbs rabbit, cut into serving pieces ( each about 2 and 1/2 pounds ) | 3 bunches scallions, cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 1 large apple, peeled, cored, and finely diced | 4 cups pinto beans, drained | 1 medium hard-boiled egg, chopped | 1/4 cup sherry ( preferably shaoxing wine ) | 2/3 cup unsweetened low-fat yogurt | 1/3 cup ground pecans
instructions: In a large dutch oven, add the scallions and cook over moderate heat, stirring often, until softened, about 2 minutes. Move the scallions to one side of the pan and add the apple to the middle, then stir in the rabbit, scallions, and apple. Cook, covered, stirring often, until the rabbit is browned, about 2 and 1/2 minutes. Add the beans and egg and cook, covered, stirring occasionally, until the beans are just warmed through and the ingredients are well blended, 4 - 6 minutes. Remove from the heat. Add the sherry and stir. Divide among 2 bowls and top with the yogurt and pecans. For best results, refrigerate overnight.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast fillet,saffron,radish,phyllo dough,sesame seed oil,bacon,savory,moroccan lemon
title: Magical Chicken & Bacon Wrapped in Phyllo Leaves
ingredients: 200 g chicken breast fillets | 100 gr. moroccan preserved lemons or 100 gr. preserved lemon, halved | 1 tablespoon salted peanuts ( optional ) | fresh savory | 500 g phyllo dough | 3 slices bacon, fried | 1 tablespoon sesame seed oil | 2 ounces moroccan preserved lemons ( or preserved lemons in oil, with pulp ) or 2 ounces preserved lemons ( or preserved lemons in oil, with pulp ) | 1 radish, cut into wedges
instructions: Soak the preserved lemons overnight in a solution of 2 - 3 tablespoons of hot water. Strain the juice into a small saucepan. Place 1 tablespoon of preserved lemons into the juice and set aside for 30 minutes. Wash the phyllo leaves in warm water. Slice on the diagonal into 8 circles. Arrange them in a circle on a lightly oiled baking sheet. Sprinkle over the sesame oil, then put four sheets of phyllo in the center of each other, overlapping them slightly in a way that they cover the whole bottom of the pan, brushing with oil to make sure the strips are all over the bottom. Place the remaining 4 squares of filo dough in the center of each stack of filo and brush with butter or olive oil. Place 6 chicken breast fillets on top of each stack of filo and make a row. Pour over some of the juice, sprinkle with some of the moroccan preserved lemons and a little savory and a little dried savoury. Cover loosely and press down to compact. Fold the top 2/3 of the phyllo leaves over to create a roll about ½´´´´´´´´´´´´´ thick. Preheat the oven on convection bake. Bake for 25 – 30 minutes until light golden brown. Remove from the oven and brush with a little melted butter, then place on the top of a heated platter covered with aluminium foil. Serve hot.

title: Tea and Bacon
ingredients: 2 packages vanilla pudding mix | 4 slices bacon, chopped | 1 cup raisins | 1 cup black tea, well-steeped
instructions: Put all ingredients into mixing bowl and stir lightly. Chill overnight for stronger flavors to blend. Store in refrigerator after opening.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf italian parsley,brown sugar,active yeast,peanut butter,celery,barbecue sauce,black vinegar,vegetable oil
title: Smoky Black Pepper Barbecue Pizza
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast | 1 1/2 cups soft light brown sugar | 1 1/2 cups vegetable oil | 1/2 cup barbecue sauce, any type | 1 cup plain smooth peanut butter | 1/2 cup mild black vinegar | 1/2 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf italian parsley | 1 1/2 cups coarsely ground whole-kernel unsalted dried black peppers or 1 1/2 cups crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: In large mixing bowl, combine yeast, sugar, oil, bbq sauce, peanut butter, vinegar, parsley and crushed red pepper until well blended. Place on lightly greased baking sheet and knead 10 to 15 minutes. Cover with cloth and let sit in a warm place 1 hour. Spread pepper evenly over prepared crust and turn dough over. Cover with plastic wrap and let rise 1 hour, or until dough is just beginning to double in bulk. Preheat oven to 500 degrees f. Dimple dough with a knife or flexible spatula, and spread onto top of pizza dough. Bake for 8 to 12 minutes, or until crust is golden and bubbly. Remove from oven and cool to warm at least 20 minutes before slicing.

title: Linguine With Sweet Sour Noodles
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 8 ounces linguine, dry | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Cook linguine until al dente. Drain and rinse with cold water. Using oil in a hot frying pan, saute the noodles in oil for 2 to 3 minutes on each side or until crisp and al dente. While noodles are cooking, heat sweet sour sour noodle sauce well and mix with cooked noodles. Serve or let cool slightly and add tabasco to taste.

title: Steak and Noodle Baked Pronto With Mint
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef steaks | 3 cans pillsbury grands refrigerated biscuits ( j.l.a. neey ) | 3 bags baby shrimp, with shell | 1 bag snow peas | 4 tablespoons minced fresh mint leaves
instructions: Heat oven to 425°f.

title: Salsa-Filled Pineapple Spring Rolls
ingredients: 1 pineapple, ripe, ripe or can ripe pineapple | 2 -3 spring onions | 1/2 cup chunky salsa | 1/4 cup cilantro leaf, chopped | 1 tablespoon hot sauce | 1/4 cup pine nuts ( optional )
instructions: Chop all the ingredients except the nuts into very small pieces and mix until everything is mixed. Cut off the top part of the pineapple and remove the soft insides and peel. Cut out from the top of the pineapples with a knife tip. Cut out the hard, dark stem portion of the pineapple. Then cut out the bitter core. If the pieces are large, cut out all of the hard, dark core. Wash both sides and shake out any excess moisture. Fill a microwaveable bowl with water and add salsa. Microwave the pieces for about a minute and a half. Place the pieces in a pile on a plate covered with a towel to absorb the liquid. You can also microwave the pineapple for about 2 - 3 minutes until softened. Remove and spread the salsa onto the pineapples. Use the end of wooden skewers to poke each pineapple in a criss cross manner. Grill or broil the pineapple until it is a little crispy on the inside. Sprinkle the pineapples with the pine nuts. Use the skewers to keep from sticking.

title: Crispy Popcorn
ingredients: 2 tablespoons creamy corn | 4 -5 teaspoons dijon mustard | 3 cups panko breadcrumbs ( dry flakes )
instructions: Spread half of the mustard on the bottom and sides of a 10 x 14 inch pan. Add the corn flakes on top. Repeat layers. Sprinkle with crumbs. Bake at 325°f until golden brown.

title: Santa Fe Coleslaw
ingredients: 10 cups packaged coleslaw mix with green | 1 tablespoon vanilla extract | 2 tablespoons instant whipped topping | 2 packages frozen whipped topping, thawed | 1/2 cup ice water
instructions: Combine sugar, vanilla extract and whipping topping in a large bowl and whisk until sugar completely dissolves. Add slaw mix and ice water and combine. Refrigerate 2 hours. Serve and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: sirloin tip roast,mint leaf,bean,pumpkin seed,catsup,vegetable broth,pork roast
title: Crock Pot Carne Asada
ingredients: 2 lbs chuck roast | 1 package pork roast | 16 ounces canned fat-free refried beans | 1 jar catsup | 3/4 cup vegetable broth | 1/3 cup pumpkin seeds ( optional ) | 1/4 cup fresh mint leaves, snipped
instructions: Place roast in crock pot. Stir in refried beans, catsup, and broth. Cover and cook on low setting for 5 - 6 hours. In a small bowl, stir parsley into remaining ingredients. Spoon over roast before serving.

title: Lobster Tostada Recipe
ingredients: 12 small lobster tails, halved | 4 cups chopped green cabbage | 4 cans sliced water chestnuts, drained | 1 package dried kale | 1 package tamarind paste | 1/4 cup water, or as needed
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook lobster tail shells in boiling water for 10 to 12 minutes, or until easily peeled off shells, and meat can be flaked with a fork. Drain. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. Arrange noodles in the prepared baking dish and cover with cabbage, breaking into bite size pieces. Layer with water chestnuts, kale, and tamarind paste. Stir sauce and spread over the vegetables. Bake at 350 degrees f for 30 minutes before serving, garnished with green olives and/or sour cream.

title: Irish Lamb Stew With Whiskey and Watercress
ingredients: 2 lbs leg of lamb ( cut into large cubes ) | 16 ounces fresh turnips ( peeled and sliced in 1/2 rounds ) | 1 pint boiling watercress | 1/2 lb dried currant | 2 teaspoons mustard seeds | 1/2 pint tomato puree | 1/4 cup whiskey | mustard seeds
instructions: Pour boiling water into large casserole dish, add mutton, turnips, currants, mustard seeds and stir to coat. Cover and simmer 1 hour or until meat is tender. Stir in tomato puree and whiskey to taste. Cover and continue to simmer 10 minutes, or until liquid is reduced. Remove cover and simmer 10 minutes more. Skim foam from top if stew becomes too thick. Serve over cooked couscous and enjoy.

title: Pinto Beans and Spinach
ingredients: 1 can red enchilada sauce | 1 can pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 1 box frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry | 1 teaspoon dried cilantro, or more to taste | 1 teaspoon spanish paprika, or to taste
instructions: Mix red enchilada sauce, pinto beans, spinach, cilantro, paprika, and black pepper together in a bowl.

title: Crispy Baked Rice Vinegar
ingredients: 1 bottle seasoned rice wine | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Mix rice wine and seasoning salt in a small bowl and spread over a baking sheet. Bake for about 25 minutes. Remove from oven and drizzle vinegar over rice.

Random Ingredients: wonton wrapper,lemon juice,red wine,tagliatelle pasta noodle
title: Tagliatelle with Won Ton
ingredients: 1 package tagliatelle pasta noodles | 2/3 cup dry red wine | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1 package round wonton wrappers
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a boil. Stir in the tagliatelle and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until tender but not mushy, about 10 minutes. Drain well and toss with 1/4 cup red wine. Add the lemon juice and the won ton. Heat through. Place 1 wrapper on a work surface and lightly brush the surface of the wonton wrapper with water. Top with a heaping teaspoon of the wonton and gently press the won ton over the wonton. Fold the left and right sides, then pull the wrapper up and over at the thicker part of the triangle. Twist both sides together to form a triangle. Repeat until all 12 wontons are used. Pour pasta into a large bowl and serve.

Random Ingredients: red kidney bean,hot pepper,french bread,graham cracker crumb,beef tenderloin,red pepper,rice vinegar
title: Beef and Bean Croque Monsieur
ingredients: 1 3/4 lbs beef tenderloin, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 can red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 loaf french bread, sliced into 8 slices | hot pepper | hot pepper | 1/2 cup rice vinegar | crushed graham cracker crumbs ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high and add beef. Brown and stir for about 4 minutes. Place bread slices in a single layer in the skillet. Top with meat. Top with hot peppers, beans and cheese. In a bowl, combine the vinegar with crumbs, mix well and sprinkle over meat mixture in crock. Cover, bake 40 minutes. Remove from oven and let stand 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: cheese tortellini,pecan,flat leaf parsley,red potato,potato,apple cider,jalapeno
title: Tortellini-Potato Sourdough Dip (Wisconsin)
ingredients: 2 cups loosely-packed fresh cheese tortellini | 1 cup diced peeled potato | 2 cups diced red potatoes | 1 cup chopped pecans or 1 cup walnuts, toasted | 1 1/2 - 2 cups chopped pickled jalapenos | 1/2 cup apple cider | 1/2 cup chopped flat leaf parsley, plus parsley sprigs for garnish
instructions: Cook tortellini according to package directions, in rapidly boiling water. Meanwhile, toss the potato, apples, nuts, chiles and cider in a large mixing bowl. Cover. Using a potato masher, smash tortellini slightly to break it up a bit. Add hot cooked tortellini mixture to the potato mixture and stir to combine. Garnish with parsley springs and sprigs. Serve with toasted bread or crackers or toasted crudites.

title: Moroccan Turkey Sandwich
ingredients: 7 ounces white mushrooms | 6 ounces turkey breast | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 2 ounces raisins | 1 white mushroom | 5 ounces corn, drained | 4 large pieces cake | 1 1/2 teaspoons honey
instructions: First wash the mushrooms and then chop them. Put the turkey breast in a frying pan and fry until golden brown. Remove from flame. Add cumin and raisins and cook for 2 - 3 minutes. Add the mushrooms and fry until softened. Add 1/2 of the water, cover and cook for 25 minutes on a low flame. Remove from stove and mix with the cooked turkey. Then start preparing your sandwich. First slice your cake into 4 even pieces and spread the cake with the honey. Then arrange the turkey on top and leave a few bread slices for the sandwich to soak up all the awesomesomesomesomesomesomesomesomesomesomesomesomesomesomesauce.

title: Stir Fry Potato Cakes
ingredients: 3/4 lb potato starch | 1/2 lb almond paste | 1 teaspoon dried oregano
instructions: Mix dry ingredients with fork. Heat 2 - 3 t oil in large skillet on medium. When it is very hot, drop in almond paste. Cook until golden brown.

title: Filo's Karioka (Sweet Grilled Carrots With Lemony Coconut Milk and Coconut Milk
ingredients: 1 bunch baby carrots, cut into matchsticks | 1 tablespoon lemon zest | 1/4 cup whole milk | 1 cup light soymilk
instructions: Prepare the carrots by scrubning off the peel and cutting away about 40 of the larger ends, then rinsing them to remove as much water as you can. Place the carrots in a strainer over running water for 2 minutes to rinse off excess moisture. Dump the carrots into a bowl, and drizzle on the lemon zest. In a medium bowl, whisk together the milk and soy milk. Pour the milk mixture over the carrots. Add more milk if desired, but do not make it more than that. Cover, and refrigerate 6 hours, or overnight, to marinate. Cover, and refrigerate 4 hours longer. When ready to serve, bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add 2 teaspoons lime salt, then adjust oven rack to the middle position and heat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Heat a cast iron griddle over medium heat, and oil the griddle for 1 minute. Turn the griddle off. Serve the carrot matchsticks in 2 or 3 pieces per plate for dipping.

title: Budget Bytes' Turkey Wraps
ingredients: 7 -8 slices streaky bacon, rinds removed | 2 cups masala, satay or 2 cups store bought masala | 300 ml apple juice | 500 g deli rotisserie-cooked turkey ( chopped ) | 50 g spinach leaves | 120 g spinach leaves, washed | 1/4 cup flaked coconut or 1/4 cup grated coconut, mixed with | 1 tablespoon unsweetened dried shredded coconut
instructions: Sauté bacon in frypan with masala and apple juice till meat is browned in colour. Add turmeric and cook on low heat until the turmeric changes colour, about 10 minutes. Add the meat and stir fry till the meat is dry. Wash spinach thoroughly and separate leaves in large bunchs and wash well. Drain the spinach leaves and add to the meat along with the spinach leaves. Mix well to ensure the spinach doesn't burn or stick to the pan. Fill a large, shallow roll with rice or chapati filling and wrap securely with foil. To make tamales, heat a frypan, cast iron or char grill to moderately hot. Remove the wrapped wraps from the pan, slice carefully and place on plate. Pour the gravy left on the table and pour the stuffing onto the wraps. Garnish with sweetened coconut and fresh coconut. Serve with your choice of accompaniment accompaniments.

title: Spiced Dream Coffee (Caffe)
ingredients: 3 cups very strongly brewed espresso powder, chilled | 1 cup heavy cream | cocoa powder, for dusting ( optional ) | 1 1/4 cups raisins, chopped, to serve ( optional ) | 1/4 cup freshly squeezed pineapple juice, to serve ( optional )
instructions: In a medium bowl, using a hand held mixer, whip cream until soft peaks form. Stir in espresso powder for garnish. Divide cream between 2 tall glasses. Spoon about 3/4 cup of whipped cream over the whipped cream and sprinkle with cocoa powder, if using.

title: Parsley Pear & Aïoli Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup butter, melted | 12 pears, cored, finely chopped | 1/3 cup fresh pear sauce ( aïoli ) | 2 tablespoons minced shallots ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon minced garlic, from jar ( optional ) | 2 -4 teaspoons fresh chili sauce, from jar ( or more to taste )
instructions: In a large bowl, add the melted butter and mix well. Add the pears, pear sauce and minced shallots and mix well. Chill until ready to serve. Just before serving, mix in the minced garlic and chili sauce.

title: Herbed Potato Crostini
ingredients: 1 cup mashed potato traditional | 1/2 cup thinly sliced green top sirloin steak or 1/2 cup cubed rump roast | 6 cups hot cooked fresh mixed greens | 1 tablespoon white wine or 1 tablespoon beer | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried rosemary or 1 1/2 teaspoons minced fresh rosemary | 1 1/4 teaspoons instant yeast | fresh thyme sprig ( optional )
instructions: In a large bowl, combine mashed potato, meat, greens, wine, oil, rosemary, and yeast and stir until blended. Cover and let stand until dough is bubbling, about 10 minute. Transfer dough to a lightly floured surface and knead until smooth, about 8 - 10 minute place dough on a parchment lined baking sheet, cover, and let rise, covered with waxed paper, in a warm, draft free place, until double in bulk, 35 - 40 minute. Lightly oil a 2 1/2 to 3 quart casserole dish or deep nonstick skillet and preheat over medium high heat until hot but not smoking, about 10 minute. Transfer mixture to oven and bake until bottom is golden, about 35 minute.

title: Sicilian Steak
ingredients: 1/2 cup tomato puree | 1 tablespoon white wine | 1 teaspoon sugar | 1/4 cup white sugar | 1 1/4 cups dry white sugar
instructions: Mix tomato puree, 1 tablespoon wine, 1 teaspoon sugar, and 1/4 cup white sugar in a large bowl.

title: Tortellini Potato Grill
ingredients: 1 package frozen cheese tortellini | 1 cup frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1 shallot, minced | 2 medium yukon gold potatoes, peeled and sliced 1/4 thick | 1 can tomato puree | 1 cup frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed, undiluted | 1 ounce vodka | 1 tablespoon minced fresh basil or 1 teaspoon dried basil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. In a large skillet or microwave safe bowl, combine tortellini and pastry.

title: Mexican-Style Black & Cheddar Tortilla Chips
ingredients: 2 cups crushed corn tortilla chips | 1/4 cup chopped dried bread crumbs | 3/4 cup grated cotija cheese or 3/4 cup gruyere cheese | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 jar dark brown sugar | 2 beaten egg whites | 1/2 cup vanilla sugar | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper | 1/4 cup grated cotija cheese ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f coat a 9 x 12 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Mix tortilla chips, bread crumbs, grated cheese, cumin, sugar, egg whites, vanilla sugar, white pepper and grated cotija cheese in a bowl until well combined. Spread mixture evenly in dish. Bake until bread crumb mixture is golden brown and crispy, 8 to 10 minutes. Serve warm with salsa, sour cream, guacamole or other dippers such as sour cream, guacamole dressing or guacomole dip.

title: Chinese Eggs
ingredients: 5 -6 hard-boiled eggs | 1/3 cup tamari | 2 -3 strawberries, cut in 2 strips
instructions: Slice hard boiled eggs in half and set aside. Remove yolks from one tomato and place on a cutting board. With a sharp knife, slice egg yolks into 1 inch segments and remove. Place tamari in a small sauce pan. Heat on high heat for three minutes until it starts to boil. Lower heat to medium and add egg whites and stir continuously until they stick together but not too hard. Transfer to a warm serving dish and cover, place in refrigerator for at least two hours. Decorate with additional tomato, strawberry or strawberry strips, if desired.

title: Roasted Green Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon thyme | 1 tablespoon red capsicum, finely chopped | 1/4 cup green romaine lettuce leaves | 4 slices provolone cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°c. Combine the thyme, pepper and capsicum and season with salt and pepper. Toss with the lettuce leaves. Divide between the 4 serving plates and top with the cheese slices before spreading the remaining dressing over just before serving.

Random Ingredients: rye flour,milk,sauce,liquid honey,brown sugar,nonfat milk powder,sea salt
title: Irish Rye Bread (No Mayo)
ingredients: 3 cups raw rye flour | 3/4 cup nonfat dry milk powder | 2 tablespoons instant powdered milk | 1/2 cup nonfat dry milk powder | 1 tablespoon sea salt | 2 tablespoons sweet and tangy liquid honey | 2 -3 tablespoons sweet and tangy hot sauce | 1 1/4 cups skim milk
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f stir together the rye flour, non fat dry milk powder, non fat dry milk powder, sea salt, and 2 tbsp warm water until well mixed. Pour 1 1/4 cups milk into the nonstick bread machine pan. Spray the bread pan with cooking spray. When the breadmaker switches to the dough setting, check the dough for proper texture. If it comes out with a lot of crumbs, use a teaspoon. If it comes out dry, continue with the remaining 1 1/4 cups milk. If not remove the bread machine to a bowl and let stand for about 10 minutes. If the dough is a bit sticky, add more dry milk.

title: Lebanese Vanilla Ice Cream
ingredients: 3/4 cup lemon juice and zest ( from about about 6 lemons ) | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Put all ingredients into an electric mixer fitted with a large steal attachement that has been fitted with the steel blade and beat on high speed until the mixture is thick and creamy, about 1 minute. Transfer to an airtight container and freeze at least 1 hour. Transfer the mixture to a metal tub, cover, and freeze at least 1 hour or up to 1 day, until firm.

title: Maggie Beer's Lentil Beef and Raspberry Casserole
ingredients: 3 lbs extra lean ground beef | 2 cans yellow lentils | 1 bag fresh raspberries, chopped ( or frozen ) | 1 jar marshmallows, sliced
instructions: Brown the beef, drain. Add the lentils, juice and stir until combined. Add the frozen raspberries, place in a casserole dish, cover with the marshmallows and bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes, stirring once or twice after 10 minutes. Note, if you like your lentils slightly thicker, stir in 2 tablespoons cornstarch or potato starch to make a paste. Note, also note, if the recipe says to use fresh raspberries, it means that you have purchased frozen raspberries too, make sure you have frozen. Once the last five minutes of cooking, turn off the oven and leave it there until you are ready to serve.

title: Easy Italian Soup

instructions: Heat stock. Add cheese over low heat. Serve with bread to scoop up sauce.

title: Spicy Asian Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 package simply potatoes diced potatoes with onion | 1 package frozen sliced snow peas | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 can rotel tomatoes & chilies, undrained | 1/4 cup fish sauce | 1 teaspoon potato flour | 1 cup shredded edam cheese or 1 cup monterey jack pepper cheese
instructions: Cut simply potatoes in half along the cut sides. Scoop out most of the potato flesh until reasonably full, leaving about 1/3 cup. title: Nif's Buffalo Magic
ingredients: 10 -12 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 tablespoon margarine | 1 tablespoon curry paste ( or your favorite paste ) | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 teaspoon sage
instructions: In a mixing glass, add curry paste, garlic powder and sage. Mix well thoroughly. Add oil and mix thoroughly to combine. If it doesn't coat completely well, add a little water but don't let it sit too long, stir, then shake the bowl every few seconds until it looks like the color of the coating on a large plate. Take a small tablespoon of the batter and drop it into the oil, and then into a little brown pieces. When you can smell the lovely fragrance of the oil, the oil is done.

Random Ingredients: plain nonfat yogurt,food coloring,tomato paste,tomato juice,molasses,green pepper,egg
title: Tomato and Tomato Jam Filler-Gramma Style
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups plain nonfat yogurt | 1/2 cup tomato paste | 1/2 cup molasses | 1 egg | 1 can diced tomatoes with juice | 1 1/2 cups sugar-free jam ( jugo ) | food coloring ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients, except jam and coloring. Add food coloring to taste, if desired. Refrigerate. The longer the jam sets, the thicker it will be. It will last several weeks in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,celery,onion,mustard powder,cornflour,malt vinegar,ice,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Hot Chilli Sauce
ingredients: 12 -15 hot red chili peppers | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil or 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 1 cup finely diced onion | 1 cup finely diced celery | 1 tablespoon mustard powder | 1/2 cup malt vinegar ( or cider vinegar ) | 1/2 cup cornflour ( cornstarch ) | 1/2 cup ice
instructions: Place chillis in a bowl and cover with boiling water. Cover and leave to soak for 30 minutes. Drain and rinse under cold water. Pat dry with a paper towel. Heat oil in a skillet, preferably non stick, adding small quantities of chilli and onion, not too much or too little. Stir and fry over medium heat with the celery and mustard powder until the onion starts to soften. Sprinkle over the salt and bring to the boil. Stir in the vinegar and bring to the boil again. Dissolve the cornflour in a little cold water, adding to the boiling mixture. Stir and pour into a clean bowl. Add the chilli and onion mixture. If it looks too thick, add a tiny bit of water to the sauce. Stir for a few minutes.

title: Spicy Green Mushroom and Vegetables
ingredients: 2 -3 vegetarian refried beans | 2 -3 dried arbol chiles | 1 medium potato ( large ) | 3 -4 cremini mushrooms
instructions: Chop potatoes and mushrooms. Place in microwave proof casserole dish. Heat for 2 - 3 minutes, stirring and heating every 10 minutes.. Stir and re heat for 2 - 3 minutes and serve warm.

title: Spicy Bread Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb italian bread, crusts removed and cut into 1/2-inch cubes ( about 8 or 10 cups ) | 4 cups kosher salt | 1/2 cup butter, divided ( plus more for rubing on bread while cooking ) | 1/2 cup poppy seed | salt, to taste | white pepper, to taste | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | oyster sauce ( for dipping )
instructions: Toss bread cubes with 1/2 cup kosher salt, and let stand for 15 minutes. In a large heavy frypan over medium high heat, combine butter and remaining 1/2 cup kosher salt.

title: Pork Loin With Mango Cheese Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb deli fresh pork loin, cut in 1/2-inch cubes | 1/4 cup cottage cheese | 1/2 cup fat-free half-and-half | 1/4 cup onion, chopped | 1 tablespoon mayonnaise | 7 ounces mangoes, cut in 1/4-inch slices | 3/4 cup light mayonnaise | 1/2 cup grated sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray.

title: Creamy Green Beans
ingredients: 1 lb fresh green beans, trimmed | 1 small red chile, deseeded and finely chopped | 1 large tablespoon low-fat greek yogurt | 1 -2 tablespoon low-fat soy sauce
instructions: Wash and dry green beans. Break off ends and cook on a medium heat, cover with boiling water for about 5 minutes or until tender. Drain and then toss with chilli in a bowl. Add remaining ingredients to the bowl and stir to combine. Serve at once.

title: Protein Slam (Low Fat)

instructions: Preheat over to 400 degrees. Spread the package of taco seasoning in a shallow dish or bowl mix ingredients and set aside. Prepare ramen noodles as directed on package. Toss with taco seasoning mix and enjoy.

title: Homemade Spiced Ham
ingredients: 8 slices serrano ham | 1 spice ( or 3 -4 teaspoons dried )
instructions: Take a flat dish and put a generous amount of salt onto it add your spices. Dip your ham in the salted, dry mix. Wrap a slice of ham on the soaked ham and place in oven on the preheated broil setting. Baste as you go around the ham with whatever method you prefer to do so. When done, put the ham on aluminum foil and put it under a hot grill until the meat is crispy and heated through and the outside has turned dark golden brown.

title: Fajita Chicken

instructions: In a large resealable plastic bag, combine the fajittas seasoning mix, cranberry juice and olives. Add more seasoning to taste. Remove plastic bag from chicken. Pour marinade into a resealable plastic bag.

title: Tropical Cheese & Choy Sum Saladas
ingredients: 200 g cottage cheese | 1 1/4 cups choy sum ( stalks removed ) | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | ice
instructions: Boil the choy sum and vinegar until the leaves are tender, drain. Place in a bowl.

title: The Great "lobster Pie"

instructions: Soak the dried beans overnight in plenty of water. Drain and squeeze out excess water. Place soaked beans and miso into a pot along with the dried onion and apple cider. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer 30 - 40 minutes, until beans are cooked. Mix together until well blended about 15 minutes before serving at room temperature. Spread mixture in shell of the graham cracker pie crust. Add cherry. Dot design over filling with a fork, if desired. The top should be golden.

Random Ingredients: orange,pepperoni sausage,chili flake,whipping cream,provolone cheese,sirloin steak,rotel,food coloring
title: Beef With Pepperoni Sausages in Cream
ingredients: 4 sirloin steaks ( thin slices ) | 4 pepperoni sausage ( sliced or chopped into about 1/4 inch slices ) | pillsbury refrigerated deli rotisserie cocktail snacks ( such as pepperoni toasties ) | 1/3 cup whipping cream | 1/3 cup ricotta cheese or 1/3 cup goat cheese | 1 tablespoon grated orange rind | 1 teaspoon chili flakes | food coloring
instructions: Cut the sirloin steaks into bite size pieces. Place on a plate and set aside. Heat a large skillet or heavy skillet over medium high heat. Add the pepperoni slices and sausages and cook 8 - 10 minutes, until sausage and pepperoni are well browned, but still a little pink. Add remaining ingredients, except cream and cheese. Bring to a boil. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes without removing from heat. Remove from heat and stir sour cream through. Serve over the hot pepperoni and pepperoni rolls.

Random Ingredients: heavy duty aluminum foil,orange peel,salt pepper,orange
title: Orange Scented Wrapped Shrooms(ATK)
ingredients: 1 piece orange peel, 2 in. wide & thin sliced | 1 teaspoon salt | 4 lbs medium to large honeycomb-stuffed green-yellow bell peppers ( a mix of red, yellow, or green ) | heavy-duty aluminum foil
instructions: Cut peel lengthwise into 4 slices about 1 1/2 by 2. Carefully open and remove seeds with teaspoon and discard. Stir salt into sliced peel and put the 4 peppers on a double thickness of foil. Wrap the foil around peppers to completely encase the fruit. Place each wrap on a heavy platter and refrigerate for up to 1 week. Sprinkle foil with additional salt and heat at 325 degrees for 15 minutes or grill for 3 - 4 minutes or until lightly browned on all sides. Cool for 10 - 20 minutes. Using toothpick, snip the ends of the foil to form a stem around pepper and the foil. Wrap the pepper in the foil and let it cool for 15 minutes. Slit the pepper with a sharp knife 4 times lengthwise and remove core and white pith. Cut along inside of the pepper with a sharp knife and remove the membrane and pith with a knife. Place peppers in a bowl covered with cold water and let sit for 15 minutes. Remove peppers from water, pat dry and slice lengthwise in half. Place pepper halves in a glass bowl. Cover with the honeycomb stix and let sit at room temperature for 1 - 2 hours.. Line a grill pan with foil and place each half on its bottom. Grill peppers over high heat for about 10 - 15 minutes or until browned. Remove peppers from pan and place on a platter. Drizzle with honey. Serve hot.

title: Chicken and Green Beans Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken legs and thighs | 1 3/4 cups chicken broth | 1 cup frozen cut green beans
instructions: Cut the chicken into bite size pieces. In a large skillet on medium heat add the chicken legs. Cook about 45 seconds to 1 minute add the chicken broth. Cover and simmer 30 minutes. Add the frozen green beans and cook 5 more minutes.

title: Hot Italian Sausage
ingredients: 6 links hot italian sausage | 2 celery ribs, trimmed | 1 medium shallot, chopped
instructions: Remove the casing from the sausages, and crumble into pieces. Put into a skillet with a lid and add enough water to come just up to the bottom of the skillet. Bring to a boil. title: Cherry Beans
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans | 1 jar roasted sweet cherries, drained and patted dry ( or use canned )
instructions: Soak beans at least 6 hours or overnight. Drain, saving liquid. Place beans, cherry, and liquid in a 2 quart baking dish or deep glass bowl. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Chinese Noodles with Pepperoni

Add spinach and cook until just wilted, 1 to 2 minutes longer. Remove from heat, stir in confectioners sugar, and serve over hot chinese noodles or rice. Garnish with reserved spinach.

title: Grilled Swedish Pork With Mandarin Radish Chips

instructions: Preheat grill to medium hot. Brush each rack rack with oil. On each rack of pork roast and sprinkle lightly with mustard oil. Place in a large disposable roasting pan or baking dish coated with cooking spray. On each rack of pork, place the oranges' peppers and mandarine pieces.

title: Chobondi

instructions: Heat the oven to 200°c. Place 2 sheets of filo pastry into each individual packet. Cover with a smaller packet, keeping an airtight lid for the sauce. Serve the chocondi with the apple dipping sauce. Serve with a crunchy winter salad.

title: Chickpea and Cheese Parcels

Brush with remaining melted butter or margarine. Cook about 30 seconds or until golden brown and the edges are crisp. Turn. Cook another 30 seconds or until both sides are golden and crisp.

title: Tomato Pikelets
ingredients: 4 cups self-rising flour | 2 -4 cups tomato juice
instructions: In large bowl, combine flour and tomato juice. Cover with plastic wrap.

instructions: Bring a skillet or dutch oven with a tight fitting lid over medium high heat to medium heat. When it shimmers, add the curry paste and stir for 1 minute.
