instructions: Place lamb in a pot with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,brown sugar,brandy,carrot,amarula cream liqueur,gherkin,strawberry syrup,anise extract
title: Prawns With Amarula Cream Sauce
ingredients: 3 lbs large king prawns, remove heads | 2 tablespoons brandy or 2 tablespoons sherry wine | 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger | 1/2 teaspoon ground anise extract | 2 tablespoons vegetable stock cubes or 2 tablespoons brandy | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder | 1 tablespoon brown sugar | 1/4 cup strawberry syrup | 2 gherkins, grated
instructions: Shell prawns and split lengthwise in half. Place in a shallow dish. Cover with brandy or sherry. Heat chilli power in microwave on high for 2 minutes or until heated. Remove pan from microwave. Microwave on high for 1 minute. Remove and discard prawn heads and reserve heads. Heat a non stick skillet.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon,zucchini,chicken bouillon cube,black pepper,orange juice,dill weed
title: Lite Zucchini Chicken Soup
ingredients: 1 large zucchini, sliced into thin rounds | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1/4 cup fresh orange juice, or as needed | 1 teaspoon dried dill weed, or to taste | freshly ground black pepper to taste | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon, or to taste
instructions: Place zucchini slices in a bowl, and add the 1 bouillon cube. Cover, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes. Preheat an oven to 300 degrees f. Whisk 1/4 cup orange juice and dill weed together in a bowl. Place zucchini slices in a baking dish with several inches of water. Bake zucchini zucchini in the preheated oven in the preheated oven until zucchini are just beginning to soften, about 15 minutes. Drain, and set aside. Season an oven safe soup can with black pepper. Place 1 bouillon cube in a soup pot, and cover with enough water to cover zucchini. Bring to a boil.

title: Faux Melba - Peppery Sweet and Sweet Salad
ingredients: 1 package of yellow sweet pepper | 1 medium carrot | 1 head iceberg lettuce | 6 tablespoons superfine sugar
instructions: Chop the pepper into uniform matchsticks and the carrot into uniform matchsticks. Cut the lettuce down the spine with the sharp knife and gently slice into 3/8 in lengths. Rinse and pat dry with paper towel. Place the sugar in a large, shallow bowl. Dip the lettuce in the sugar and place on a board with a lip so the sugar can drip off. Using a rubber spatula, spread the sugar on the lettuce. Place the slices of sweet pepper evenly over the lettuce. When you have flipped them, top it with 4 or 5 pieces of sweet pepper. Dunk the rest of the lettuce in the sugar, pressing down to get everything to be coated. If you have a napkin handy, dip the napkin under cold water to wash off the sugar. You should have a lovely melba with a delicate crunch to it. If you aren't using napkin, it is better to remove a piece of napkin and slice it in half for easy slicing. Serve it cold or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: rice wine vinegar,grain white rice,berry,purpose flour,ginger paste,molasses,romano cheese,soy sauce
title: Rice Vinegar Flavored Baked Beans and Berries in a Jar
ingredients: 2/3 cup all-purpose flour | 1 teaspoon ginger paste | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons sugar | 2 tablespoons molasses | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 4 cups mixed berries | 1 1/2 cups short-grain white rice, cooked
instructions: In a medium mixing bowl, combine the flour with the ginger and rice wine vinegar. Stir in sugar, molasses and soy sauce. Place the mixed berries in the bowl with the flour, vinegar and ginger mixture. Use a spoon to gently mix the rice wine vinegar and mixed berries together. Let sit for one hour to marinate. Remove the mixture from bowl and set aside. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper. Transfer the mixture into a piping bag with a star tip. Pipe 2 inch rings on the parchment paper. Using a finger, pierce a 1 inch hole in each ring. Bake about 40 minutes, until the berries are tender and slightly crisp.

title: Quick Beef Filets (Lubely Con Carne)
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tenderloin | 2 spareribs
instructions: Trim off the fat from the filets. Cut the filets lengthwise into two pieces. Using your fingers, pull the meat out of one piece at a time and sprinkle lightly with salt and a light sprinkling of white pepper. Place two spareribs between two pieces of waxed paper and pound them slightly to flatten them. Place a meat pounder in a deep, heavy, heavy pot and add just enough water to cover the bottom of the pan. Bring to a boil over high heat, skimming the foam off the top and any scum that rises to the top. Once the liquid is boiling, place the steaks into the liquid. Return to a boil and boil briskly for 2 minutes. Transfer steaks to a platter and cover tightly with aluminum foil. Boil the liquid and keep at a brisk steady simmer until the meat is very tender, about 2 hours. Transfer the steaks to a platter and allow to cool slightly, at least 10 minutes. When they are cool, cut the steaks into manageable slices and serve them whole, or cut into manageable sized pieces using a sharp knife. Pour the liquid from the pan used to boil the meat into a heavy, heavy pan. Remove the steaks and set over medium heat. Add the spareribs and gently simmer, uncovered, for about 15 minutes. Taste for seasoning and add salt if desired.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,coconut rum,maple syrup,onion powder,orange zest
title: Apple Maple Rum Salad Dressing for Fish, Chicken or Lamb
ingredients: 3 tart apples, peeled, cored and peeled, cored and diced | 2/3 cup maple syrup | 2/3 cup coconut rum | 1 tablespoon orange zest | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1 teaspoon grated orange zest
instructions: Using a food processor, process apples with maple syrup, coconut rum, orange zest, and onion powder until smooth. Place in refrigerator until cool. When ready to serve, stir in orange zest.

title: Healthy Yummy Squash Shake
ingredients: 1 yellow squash | 1 container plain yogurt ( i use fat free )
instructions: Blend all the ingredients together in a food processor until smooth. Serve immediately, or refrigerate for up to 6 hours.

Random Ingredients: almond milk,bugle,spring onion,kosher salt black pepper,red wine vinegar
title: Nugget and Almond Salad With Chips
ingredients: 8 ounces ground blanched almond milk | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1/2 cup spring onion, chopped | bite sized pieces crunchy bread such as sourdough bread, sourdough bread or other good-quality bread
instructions: Toast the almonds in broiler or in a dry fry pan over medium heat to the desired shade of brown. Watch closely, as they burn fast before they turn a harsh dark red. Let cool a moment, and then peel. Break up a chunk of bread into small pieces and put into a salad bowl. Dress with a splash of almond milk, and season with salt and pepper. Drizzle with 2 tablespoon of red wine vinegar and toss lightly.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,chicken drumstick,worcestershire sauce,cream cheese,cooking barley,green cardamom pod,cornstarch
title: Tandoori Microwaved Chicken
ingredients: 2 1/2 tablespoons cooking barley | 6 green cardamom pods | 2 pods whole cardamom pods | 1 whole chicken drumstick, skin removed | 4 packages cream cheese | 1 can condensed sour cream | 2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon cornstarch
instructions: Combine the cooking barley, cardamom pods, cardamom pods, and whole cardamom pods in a sauce pan. Place the chicken in the pan and coat with the cream cheese. Top with the worcestershire sauce and cover with the lid. Cook on high for 7 minutes. Mix together the cornstarch and some water and add to chicken.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,tomato basil garlic oregano,wheat flour,stew meat,cayenne pepper
title: Indian Spices
ingredients: 1 lb stew meat | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 teaspoon ground cayenne pepper | 3 tablespoons whole wheat flour
instructions: Place stew meat in roasting pan and coat with garlic paste, oregano, cayenne pepper and stir until all pieces are evenly coated with spices. Pour remaining liquid over all. Cover and marinate in refrigerator for 4 - 6 hours, turning meat occasionally. Remove meat from marinade, reserving liquid. Discard remaining liquid. Rinse meat with cold running water until it's cold. Pat dry with paper towels. Remove excess fat from roasting pan and discard. Place reserved marinade in saucepan, bring to boil, and cook until thickened. Slice meat into desired serving size pieces. Spoon liquid into baking dish or serving bowl.

Random Ingredients: bagel,ginger garlic paste,wheat angel hair pasta,tomato paste,coke,pumpkin seed
title: Pumpkin Seed Pasta
ingredients: 1 bagel, cut in half | 1/4 cup fresh pumpkin seeds | 2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste | 1 can tomato paste | 1 cup coke | 1 ounce whole wheat angel hair pasta
instructions: Cook pasta. Cook beans. Add spices and stir until well mixed. Set aside. Add tomato paste and Coke to pasta. Stir. Cook until heated through.

title: Homemade Ricotta
ingredients: 1 container whole milk ricotta cheese | 1 can evaporated low-fat milk ( about 1 pkg. ) | 2 cups stock
instructions: Blend all ingredients well with a hand mixer, and let sit while preparing the cheese sauce.

title: Grand Marnier Butter
ingredients: 1 cup butter, softened | 1/2 cup sweet green bell pepper, finely chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons grand marnier
instructions: Beat butter and green bell pepper together, then blend in grand marnier. Spread on a pastry bag fitted with star tip. Refrigerate until cold. Roll into a cylinder shape about 1 inch in diameter.

title: Pink and White Grapefruit Sorbet (Garnish) from the Farm
ingredients: 1 pink grapefruit, peeled, seeded, and segmented | 2 1/2 cups cold glass grapefruit juice, chilled | 1 lemon, juiced, or to taste
instructions: Arrange grapefruit slices in the freezer until the cubes have expanded, chilled, and frozen in an ice cream maker according to manufacturer's instructions. Pour the cold grapefruit juice into a 2 quart glass pitcher. Top with lemon juice, and stir to mix.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach,spaetzle noodle,yogurt,pearl barley,amarula cream liqueur,tea,banana,panir
title: Beef and Barley Roulades With Noodles and Curried Nuts
ingredients: 1/4 cup brewed tea ( room temp, not hot ) | 1 cup pearl barley | 3 ounces panir ( or more ) | 8 ounces baby spinach | 1 ounce amarula cream liqueur | 8 ounces frozen stir fry vegetables ( broccoli, onion and zucchini ; cauliflower and carrots ; spinach and baby green ; red bell pepper ; or use cauliflower, broccoli flow, green and ) | 8 ounces neeth-frosted yogurt | 8 ounces hot spaetzle noodles ( i use the hot ones )
instructions: Dissolve tea in 2 tbsp boiling water and refrigerate to chill. Bring a pan of water to a boil. Rinse barley with cold water and drain until cool. Transfer barley water to medium bowl and let stand until it begins to froth, about 1 minute. Using wet hands, squeeze barley to remove any grit. Coat panir in some of the tea. Heat over medium heat until hot, just to smoke, but not burn about 1 minute. Add spinach.

title: Acapulco
ingredients: 2 lbs halibut fillets | 1/4 cup coffee granules ( or to taste ) | 1/4 cup dry sherry ( or to taste ) | 1 large anaheim chili
instructions: Combine sugar, sherry and coffee. Sprinkle each fillet with sherry mixture and marinate fish in sugar mixture 3 hours to overnight. Heat an iron skillet or griddle over moderately high heat. Grill fillets on both sides until fish begins to flake as it cooks, turning once. Let stand 5 minutes. Transfer fish to a serving plater and serve warm.

title: Cuban Style Beef and Beetroot Salad
ingredients: 3 lbs sirloin | 2 medium russet potatoes, peeled and sliced | 6 beets, washed and sliced | 1/2 bunch green onions, chopped | 3 cups salad greens or 3 cups lettuce | 1 1/2 teaspoons prepared mustard powder | 2 tablespoons prepared guacamole | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Cut beef into 1 inch cubes. Bring 4 cups salted water to boil. Cover and cook beef 5 - 7 minutes or until fork tender. Cool beef slightly. Break up into bite size pieces. Set aside to drain juices. Cook potatoes in salted water until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain and cool. Cut into 8 wedges and set aside. Slice beets into pieces that look similar to potatoes. Place beets pieces in a bowl. Add green onions. In small bowl, mix mustard with guacamole, garlic powder and prepared mustard. Arrange beets over onions. Spoon 1/4 of the guacamole mixture on top of beets. Spread remaining guacamole mixture around all. Sprinkle with chopped green onions. Refrigerate until chilled. Serve chilled or at room temperature.

title: Papaya (Sweet Peppered Pepper Bread)
ingredients: 1 french baguette | 1/4 cup sherry wine ( optional ) | 1 cup icing sugar | 1 small gingerroot, sliced thinly | 1 sweet bell pepper, chopped | 1 papaya, peeled, seeded and chopped
instructions: Cut baguette into about 20 slices. Place in baking dish. Sprinkle with sherry and spread with icing sugar. Combine ginger and sweet pepper and sprinkle over slices. Bake at 425f for 15 minutes. Garnish with papaya.

title: Camarones Barbuda - Shrimp Cocktail - St. Valenciana
ingredients: 1 bread, loaf | 2 small shrimp | 1 pinch celery | 1 pinch dried shrimp | 1 dash vanilla essence | catsup, to taste ( optional )
instructions: Toast bread under broiler until it turns light brown and smells slightly burnt. Remove from oven and immediately rub outside with water, then turn bread over into a glass bottle or other bowl. Remove the inside of bread with a slotted spoon. Remove top part of bread with a rubber spatula and discard. If using a wine bottle, you can also open a wine bottle and press the inside of wine bottle with your hand into the bread. Dip the bread in the water and sand the bread while shaking the bottle. Leave the bread until all of the sand has soaked up all of the bread. Then, slice off the top to expose the bread. Toast shrimp in a frying pan over high heat and then immediately put shrimp in and stir until they just begin turning pink and the shrimp turns pink all the way through. Place on serving platter. Wash baby shrimp and put in individual serving bowls. Place a small plate on top of each shrimp. Add a dash of catsup, if using.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,pecorino romano cheese,cherry,chickpea flour
title: Pasta With Chickpea Flour
ingredients: 1/4 cup pecorino romano cheese, freshly grated | 1 1/2 cups canned chickpea flour, drained ( garbanzo beans ) | 3 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1 cup canned cherry, halved
instructions: Place cheese in bowl of a food processor fitted with a metal blade. Add chickpea flour, vinegar and 1/2 cup water until dough starts to form. Using hands, knead dough until cohesive and holds firmly in shape. Divide into 4 equal parts. Roll each part on a floured surface into a 6 inch circle. Using a 3 inch round cutter, cut 8 wedges from each wedge. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Cover with plastic wrap and let rest at room temperature for 10 minutes. Put cherry halves and remaining 1 tablespoon water in saucepan and bring to a simmer over medium heat. Cook until liquid is reduced to a thick sauce, about 10 minutes. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,taco seasoning,vegetable oil,suet,plum tomato
title: Mexican Suet with Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 teaspoon vegetable oil | 4 plums tomatoes, cut in half | 1/8 cup taco seasoning | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 package shredded suet
instructions: In a fry pan, heat oil over medium heat. Cook until browned slightly, turning once. Add tomatoes. Bring to a boil and drain liquid. Stir in taco spice and bouillon cube. Heat until hot, stirring occasionally. Pour tomato mixture over suet and serve.

title: Linguini with Corn, Salsa and Cream
ingredients: ice cube | 8 ounces linguine | 5 ears corn, roasted and peeled | 1 cup mild chunky salsa | 1/4 cup sour cream
instructions: Place the corn on the cob and grill over medium high heat until warm, 10 to 15 minutes. Transfer the kernels from cobs to a blender, process until creamy, 1 to 2 minutes. Return the corn kernels to the blender and pulse until coarsely ground. Pour the corn mixture back into the casings and let sit 5 to 10 minutes. Drain the pasta in a colander until creamy, 8 to 10 minutes. Drain once more. Place the corn kernels in a skillet, toss with the salsa and the sour cream.

Random Ingredients: lamb loin chop,taco seasoning mix,demi glace,margarine,virgin olive oil,new potato,ketchup
title: Grilled Lamb Chops and New Potatoes With Taco Gravy
ingredients: 4 lamb loin chops | 2 tablespoons margarine | 1 tablespoon virgin olive oil | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 18 small new potatoes, quartered | 6 teaspoons margarine, melted | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1/2 cup demi-glace
instructions: Lightly brush each of the lamb chops with 1/2 tbsp of the margarine. Sprinkle the chops with 1 tbsp taco seasoning mix, then spread them with the remaining 1 tbsp margarine. Grill over high heat about 4 minutes on each side or until done to your liking. While chops are grilling, prepare your new potatoes, slice off the top 6 around the middle of each potato. Use the back of a spoon to press the potatoes up against the insides of the potato to flatten out the potatoes as much as you possibly can. Set potatoes aside to cool then place in a large bowl. Dice potatoes or add to bowl. Drizzle melted 1/2 tbsp of margarine evenly over potatoes and stir with a fork to coat potatoes. Stir in the ketchup, demi glace, remaining taco seasoning mix. Add lamb and toss to coat with all the juices. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: asian chile pepper sauce,dark brown sugar,butter,thyme
title: Spicy Asian Peppers
ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter | 2 tablespoons asian chile pepper sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1 pinch dried thyme, or to taste
instructions: Melt 1 tablespoon of the butter in a skillet over medium heat. Stir in the red pepper sauce and brown sugar and thyme. Reduce heat to low until mixture is warm, about 10 minutes.

title: Sourdough Pastry  (Sourdough Pizza Dough)
ingredients: 2 cups good strong plain cake flour | 1/3 cup water | 2 teaspoons italian seasoning | 36 fresh whole fresh watercress leaves
instructions: Sift flour and water in a large bowl, cut in water and seasoning until a soft dough forms. Turn out onto a lightly floured work surface. Gather dough and knead until smooth. Place on a lightly floured chopping board and shape as desired. Let rest for 10 minutes. Roll out desired amount of dough to ¾ inch thickness. Cut out shapes with a cutter. Place on a lightly greased pizza stone. Gather edges and form a round or circle about 1 inch in diameter. Top with the watercress and return to oven. Bake until tops just begin to crisp and brown, 10 to 12 minutes. Serve with your favorite toppings. This pizza doesn't really freeze, but you can reheat it by placing the dough back in the refrigerator and continuing until all dough is used.

title: Tarragon Shrimp
ingredients: 1 prepared pie crust | 1 1/2 quarts shrimp stock | 1/4 cup fresh tarragon, chopped | 2 teaspoons chilled butter
instructions: Heat the shrimp stock in a pan.

title: Champignon Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 lb champignon mushroom, cleaned and chopped coarsely ( chantignons ) | 10 -12 medium champignons mushrooms | sunflower oil ( for frying )
instructions: Drain the mushrooms. Rinse them and pat dry with paper towels. Heat up 1/2 litre of sunflower oil to smoking in a frying pan or deep saucepan on the hob. Toss mushrooms in the sunflower oil on all sides, until evenly coated with the oil and heated through. This will take about five to seven minutes or so, depending on the size of your pan. Toss in the charmigons, turning them regularly with a slotted spoon to ensure colouring is evenly distributed. Serve with chili verdi or fresh flatbread.

title: Chicken Coconut Noodle Bake
ingredients: 2 packages frozen spaetzle noodles | 1/2 cup low-fat ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons dried pineapple bits or 2 tablespoons coconut flakes | 2 cups canned shredded chicken breasts, cooked and shredded | 2 -3 slices bacon bits
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f in small bowl combine ricotta cheese, pineapple bits or coconut flakes and shredded chicken. Set aside 1 cup of the noodle mix, and pour the remaining 1/2 c noodle mix in a greased 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish. Layer the noodles, cheese and chicken over the noodles, ending with noodles. Sprinkle bacon bits on top of all and bake uncovered 60 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Allow to stand 5 minutes before serving. If serving this as a meal, just cover with a plastic wrap and cut a small piece of foil around the dish just to wrap around the pieces and bake.

title: Chili Hazelnut Salad
ingredients: 3 large mangoes, peeled, pitted and chopped | 2 teaspoons white wine vinegar or 2 teaspoons white wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 2 teaspoons chopped hazelnuts or 2 teaspoons almonds
instructions: Place mango, vinegar, and chili powder in a bowl and stir to combine. Stir in nuts.

Random Ingredients: chipotle powder,mirin,orange juice zest,rice wine vinegar,yogurt,kidney bean
title: Chilled Kidney Bean Salad
ingredients: 6 cups cooked kidney beans ( or black beans ) | 1/4 cup rice wine vinegar | 1 orange, juice and zest of | 2 tablespoons mirin | 1 tablespoon chopped chipotle powder | 2 tablespoons yogurt
instructions: Process everything together, chill. Put into serving bowl and serve at room temperature. Store refrigerated for up to 1 week in fridge.

title: Tommy Bahama's Seattle Salmon
ingredients: 4 cups apple juice | 2 tablespoons mirin ( japanese sweet wine ) | 2 teaspoons sea salt | 1/2 lb whole salmon | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained ( hunts )
instructions: Mix apple juice thru salt in a bowl, pour over salmon and marinate for 1 hour at room temp or refrigerate for 48 hours. Remove salmon, drain, reserving marinade. Heat the broiler. Broil the salmon for 7 to 10 minutes per inch of thickness. Turn and broil 6 - 8 minutes longer or until just barely cooked through. Top each with a spoonful of diced tomato. Serve immediately. These are great served over a bed of steamed baby carrots with a side of rice or rice noodles. It makes wonderful mashed potatoes.

title: Lebanese Honey Mustard
ingredients: 1 kg mustard powder | 1 kg liquid honey | 100 g grated parmesan cheese or 100 g mozzarella cheese | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Beat the mustard powder into the honey until stiff, adding the grated cheese slowly, beating well after each addition. Add cardamom and then the ground cheese if using. Refrigerate until required.

title: Homemade Indo-Cauliflower
ingredients: 2 heads cauliflower | 2 teaspoons cumin
instructions: Slice cauliflower into small florets. Place in boiling water and cook until all the water has evaporated. Pour off and save the water in a colander and drain cauliflower. Re heat oil in pressure cooker. Add cumin and then add the drained cauliflower water. Add a teaspoon of salt while the pot is still hot. Serve immediately.

title: Spicy Thai Baked Fish Ball
ingredients: 12 fish balls ( such as cod, halibut, etc. about 1 1/2 lbs. ) | 4 ounces cream cheese or 4 ounces neufchatel cheese | 1/4 cup peanut butter | 2 teaspoons spicy teriyaki sauce | 1 tablespoon coarse grainy mustard | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh chives or 1 tablespoon green onion | 12 ounces cooked cod, cut into small pieces or 12 ounces cooked haddock ( 3 lbs. ) | 2 tablespoons coarse grainy mustard ( yellow, white, and red if you could get it ) | 2 tablespoons coarse grainy whole grainy mustard | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh chives or 1 tablespoon green onion
instructions: Dipping sauce, in a medium bowl, stir together all ingredients. Set aside while you prepare fish balls. For each serving, dip fish balls into sauce for about 10 seconds on each side. Place fish balls into an open foil lined baking sheet and bake in a preheated 325 degree oven for 20 minutes. The fish balls should have a nice light tan brown color. If you don't like the tan color, you can use the light color dark brown sugar in a clean and dark cupboard. After 20 minutes, remove fish balls from pan and let cool slightly.

title: French Fried Rice
ingredients: 2 cups cooked rice | 1/2 cup diced bacon | 1 jar marinara sauce | 3 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons mustard powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground celery
instructions: Mix remaining ingredients in a large bowl. Set aside.

Random Ingredients: cider vinegar,italian herb seasoning,rice noodle,raspberry,hot water
title: Raspberry and Rice Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 package rice noodles | 1 cup fresh raspberry, washed and patted dry | 1 pint hot water | 1/3 cup cider vinegar | 1 teaspoon dried italian herb seasoning
instructions: Cook rice noodles according to directions on the package. Set aside to cool. In a large jar with a tight fitting lid, combine raspberries and water. Close lid and shake well to distribute flavor. Add the vinegar and italian herbs and shake well to combine. Serve cold or at room temperature.

title: Quick Beef Roulades
ingredients: 1 lb beef steak, thinly sliced | 1 can chopped green chilies | 1 container frozen whipped topping, thawed | 1 cup self-rising flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Place meat and chilies in a 3 qt baking dish. Toss with enough flour on top to make a lightly moist batter. Transfer mixture to oven and bake 25 - 30 minutes or until mixture bubbles. Spread whipped topping over meat mixture and bake 5 minutes longer.

title: Pollo E Fagito (Brazilian Chicken Wings)
ingredients: 12 chicken wings, separated ( thighs and drumsticks ) | 1/2 cup peas
instructions: In a large pot of boiling salted water, cook chicken wings until tender and no longer pink inside, about 25 minutes. Remove and transfer to a deep platter to drain. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium high heat, and cook chicken, turning once, until golden brown, about 10 minutes. Stir peas into chicken.

title: Honey Infused Vodka
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 pints fresh honey | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 16 fluid ounces vodka
instructions: Place honey in a heavy bottomed medium sauce pan. Place over medium heat and scald until it dissolves, about 2 minutes and then remove from the heat. Using an 8 oz measuring cup full of warm honey stir to combine.

Random Ingredients: arrowroot,yellow cornmeal,spanish onion,bean sauce,peanut butter,pistachio nut,milk,pearl barley
title: Bean and Pistachio Polenta Loaf
ingredients: 2 tablespoons peanut butter | 1 large spanish onion, finely chopped | 3/4 cup whole milk | 3/4 cup pearl barley, soaked over-night for 3/4-1/2-10/2 hours & over-night | 2 tablespoons arrowroot or 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1/4 cup bean sauce | 1/4 cup chopped pistachio nut | 1 tablespoon pepitas ( pistachios )
instructions: In a medium sized bowl, add peanut butter & mash with a fork. Add the onions & mash until very creamy. Mix together with the milk & barley & stir in the arrowroot or cornstarch & stir until well mixed. Mix in the bean sauce & mix thoroughly. Transfer to a buttered a shallow pan & sprinkle with chopped nuts & pepitas. Bake in a preheated oven for 40 min at 230 degrees or on the bain marie for about 30 minuts or until browned nicely.

title: Thai Lemongrass Shrimp
ingredients: 24 limes, cleaned and cut into small segments ( about 10 limes ) | 2 stalks lemongrass, trimmed
instructions: Using vegetable peeler, peel all remaining peel and coarsely chopped lemongrass.

Random Ingredients: dill,lamb chop,topping,eggplant,green pepper,italian dressing,velveeta mexican cheese,kraft italian dressing
title: Italian Meat Chops or Lamb chops With Eggplant (Greek Style Skillet Style) #5FIX
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground lamb or 1 lb ground beef | 1 package light velveeta mexican cheese, cut into cubes ( about 2 cups ) | 1 package frozen chopped eggplants, thawed, squeezed dry ( i use this for extra firmness ) | 1 green pepper, seeded and sliced ( remove seeds with scissors if you don't like it too hot ) | 2 cups frozen frozen whipped topping ( or 2 cups fresh whipped topping ) | toppings : | 1 jar kraft italian dressing | 1/2 - 3/4 cup chopped fresh dill ( we love dill, and don't really use dried )
instructions: In large skillet, brown ground meat or lamb, stirring often until no longer pink. Drain meat if using ground lamb. Drain vegetables and mix into meat. Bring to boiling, reduce heat. Add velveta, stirring until melted and blended. Mix in eggplant, pepper, and frozen whipped topping. Cover and simmer, stirring occasionally until eggs are set, about 5 - 10 minutes.

title: Spicy Roasted Pastry
ingredients: puff pastry, thawed overnight
instructions: Pre heat oven to 220 degrees c. Line a baking tray with aluminium foil, it really only needs to be about 22cm across. Cut your puff pastry into 3 - 4 cm wide strips. Use half of the pastry to cover the base and the top of the tray. Lay the pastry strips on top, brushing each one with melted butter and seasoning mixture to taste. Roll up the pastry on top of the pastry, using the other half of the pastry to seal in the pastry if desired. Place on a baking tray and cook in the oven for around 25 minutes, you will know the pastry is done when crisp and golden and the pastry is just beginning to darken in colour. Allow to cool before serving with chili sauce or sweet chili sauce, or chilli flakes to serve.

title: Potato Crusted French Fries
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds baby peas, washed | 3 1/2 pounds russet potatoes, diced | 2 1/2 cups shredded italian bread | 1 pound hamburger | 2 tablespoons ground dried italian seasoning | 1 tablespoon dried mint | 1 tablespoon italian dried shredded peppermint | 1 cup almond, finely sliced | 6 croissants, split
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a large bowl combine peas, potatoes, bread, hamburger, italian seasoning, dried mint, italian seasoning, mint and peppermint. Mix well. Place croissants on a large baking sheet and press a piece of plastic wrap directly onto surface of potato mixture. Bake in preheated oven until potatoes are tender and bread has crisped, about 45 minutes.

title: Cashew Crackle
ingredients: 100 g unsalted cashews | 1 fresh red pepper, roasted and peeled | 1/4 teaspoon saffron thread, crushed | 25 g unsalted butter | 8 teaspoons dark rum
instructions: Toast cashews roughly in a dry fry pan until golden and fragrant. Remove from heat. Chop red pepper roughly and put through a food processor with cashews, saffron, butter and rum. Process until well combined. Keeps for up to 1 week in a sealed jar.

title: Indian Peach Curry
ingredients: 3 medium ripe peaches, peeled, pitted and sliced 1/4 inch thick ( i just use frozen ) | 2 tablespoons ginger paste | 1/4 cup white onion, chopped | 1/8 cup red capsicum, chopped | 1 1/3 cups fresh mint leaves, chopped
instructions: Combine ginger and onion in a small bowl. Add capsicum and mint. Drain olives in a sieve. Toss with the onion mixture. Serve over basmati rice.

title: Chocolate Fingers
ingredients: 9 ounces dark chocolate | 9 ounces crystal sugar
instructions: Break chocolate into small pieces and melt completely. Remove from heat. When cool, dip fingers in chocolate and place on wax paper. Melt in refrigerator until mixture is almost white. Add sugar, stirring until desired consistency is achieved.

title: Guacamole Fish
ingredients: 600 g cod fish, cut into 12 chunks | 150 g guacamole, dip | 100 g mixed chopped cranberries | 1 small red capsicum, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 100c. Place fish in a roasting tray and pour over the guacamole. Bake for 15 minutes, then stir through the cranberries, capsicum and cooked fish. Return to oven, then grill for 3 minutes or until fish is cooked and skin is crisp.

title: Barsi's Secret Sausages
ingredients: 2 sheets frozen puff pastry sheets | 2 teaspoons baking soda
instructions: Thaw puff pastry sheets before rolling out on a floured surface. Separate pastry into two sheets of each size. Cut a 4 inch circle out of each sheet then place one sheet on a preheated griddle, with the edges overlapping slightly. When it starts to form bubbles that cover the whole piece then flip over and cook on the other side until lightly browned. Remove from heat and drain on paper towels before serving.

title: Pico De Gallo
ingredients: 1 cup chopped almonds | 1 cup choc-flavored picante sauce | 1/2 cup cachaca ( brazilian palm curd ), cut into pieces
instructions: Place the almonds and choc-flavored picante sauce in a blender or food processor. Blend until smooth, then pour into a shallow bowl. Dip each piece of drained pico de gallo into the picante sauce to coat. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour. When ready to serve, plate the pico de gallo and garnish with a sprinkling of the casero.

Random Ingredients: phyllo pastry,meat,tamari,rhubarb,vegetable stock,pork shoulder,green apple,english cucumber
title: Rhubarb and Beef Strudel
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh lean meat, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1/2 lb pork shoulder, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 green apple, peeled, seeded and cut into 1/2-inch strips | 1/3 cup vegetable stock | 1 teaspoon tamari or 1 teaspoon sesame oil | 2 packages frozen chopped rhubarb, thawed and sliced | 1/3 english cucumbers or 1/3 seedless cucumber, peeled, halved lengthwise, sliced 1/4-inch thick | 8 sheets phyllo pastry
instructions: In a large skillet, cook meat and pork over medium heat until lightly browned and no longer pink. Add apple and green pepper.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,chocolate,thyme sprig,peanut butter,hot chili powder,radish
title: Picante Truffles
ingredients: 8 ounces peanut butter | 8 ounces chocolate ( i prefer white chocolate ) | 3 cups mild picante sauce | 10 whole radishes | fresh thyme sprig | 2 -3 hot chili powder, to taste
instructions: Combine peanut butter and 1/4 cup of chocolate. Melt rest of chocolate on low heat in microwave, stirring occasionally. When melted, add remaining chocolate, stir until smooth and creamy. Cut radishes lengthwise in half, remove and discard outer leaves. Cut remaining radish halves crosswise into thin slices. Add radish slices and thyme sprigs to sauce, and stir for 2 minutes. Place 3 tablespoons of sauce on cut surface of each truffle. Roll each truffle jelly roll like a cigar, tucking in the ends. Place on a wax paper covered plate. Chill. Unwrap from wax paper, and slice into 1/4 inch pieces. Garnish with additional thyme.

title: Spinach Lentils Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 box tri colored rotini pasta | 1 package frozen spinach | 1/2 cup black lentils
instructions: Boil the pasta and lentils together for 8 minutes, drain. Place the spinach in a large bowl and add the cooked pasta and lentils. Mix the ingredients gently. Let sit for 2 to 4 minutes before taking it out. Note, for a little extra zing for those who really like spicy lentils use some minced chili pepper from the can.

Random Ingredients: cream celery soup,sun tomato oil,onion powder,gingerroot,salt,balsamic vinegar,yeast
title: Quick Sun Dried Tomato Spread
ingredients: 1 package yeast | 1 tablespoon warm cream of celery soup | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup, undiluted | 1 can sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained and chopped, oil reserved | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 teaspoon ground gingerroot
instructions: Sprinkle the yeast evenly over the warm water in a 2 - 3 quart container, and stir to dissolve. Let stand until foamy, about 3 minutes. Stir in the cream of celery soup, sun dried tomatoes, onion powder, salt, and gingerroot. Mix well, and cover the container. Let stand for 24 hours in a warm place until the flavors have combined.

Random Ingredients: cake flour,heavy whipping cream,grand marnier,beef tenderloin,ginger root,cornstarch,flour tortilla
title: French Beef Tenderloin Steaks
ingredients: 3 tablespoons cornstarch | 2 teaspoons grand marnier | 1/4 cup flour | 1/2 lb beef tenderloin, sliced thin | 1 1/2 teaspoons chopped fresh ginger root | 1 tablespoon confectioners'sugar | 1 tablespoon water, or as needed | 6 flour tortillas, warmed
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Combine cornstarch, grand marnier, flour, and 1/2 teaspoon ginger and stir until it has a pasty consistency. Add beef to flour mixture and toss until beef is covered. Spread beef out flat in a single layer in a baking dish. Bake in preheated oven until the internal temperature reaches 130 degrees f, 20 minutes. Allow to stand 10 minutes before slicing in thin strips. Make a glaze by whisking confectioners' sugar and 1 tablespoon water in a small bowl. Sprinkle with remaining ginger. Heat a 10 inch nonstick skillet over high heat. Toast tortillas, one at a time, for 1 to 2 seconds per side, until crisp. Lift them out and place in a bowl of ice water to cool. Roll the tortillas in the glaze and slice on the diagonal on the diagonal.

title: Quick Viennese
ingredients: 1 1/2 quarts dry marsala wine | 2 cubes chicken bouillon
instructions: Combine the marsala and chicken bouillon in a large, heavy pot with a lid. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer for 20 minutes. Remove from the heat, and let sit for 5 minutes for flavor to blend.

Random Ingredients: leek,irish mist liqueur,red pepper,head romaine lettuce,asparagus spear,parsley leaf,creme fraiche,rice noodle
title: Asparagus Crunch
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh asparagus spear, trimmed | 1 small head romaine lettuce, washed drained well of all liquid and dried and broken into small segments | 1 jar roasted red peppers, drained and cut into thin strips | 1/2 cup creme fraiche ( fat free or low-fat ) | 1 teaspoon dry irish mist liqueur ( recommended ( baileys ) | 1 bag rice noodles, cooked ( recommended barilla ) or ( 16 ounce ) bag flat noodles ( recommended barilla ) | 2 tablespoons fresh parsley leaves, for garnish | 1/4 cup fresh leek, sliced in rounds
instructions: Prepare the asparagus. Remove the woody ends of the asparagus when they soften, approximately 4 minutes. Toss the asparagus with the lettuce, bell pepper strips, creole franche and liqueur. Divide among serving plates. Meanwhile, prepare the rice noodles, while the noodles are cooking, boil the noodles until tender, about 6 minutes, drain well & set aside. Drain the noodles in a colander, rinse and cool under cold water. Douse each salad with 1 tbsp. Of hot tap water and allow to cool to room temperature. Ladle the hot noodles among plates, garnish with parsley & leeks and serve with french breadsticks.

title: Moroccan Sausage and Cashews
ingredients: 1 tablespoon margarine | 1 medium green chili pepper, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/2 cup dates, pitted & finely chopped | 1/2 cup orange zest, finely grated | 1 cup dates, pitted and finely chopped | 1 1/2 cups unsalted cashews ( or peanuts if you prefer ) | 1/2 cup hot coffee, hot
instructions: Melt margarine in a small saucepan, stir in chilies, cumin & dates, cook for 2 minutes. Add remaining ingredients, heat gently 1 minute. Pour into a lightly grease baking sheet and toast at 350ºf for 12 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Homemade Cornhusks
ingredients: 2 cups salad oil | 1 small onion, peeled, chopped | 1 teaspoon ground sumac | 1/2 lb pitted dates, chopped | 1/4 cup sunflower oil | 4 cups coarsely chopped celery | 2 cups coarsely chopped mixed nuts for topping | corn husk
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the salad oil, chopped onion and sumac. Add dates, sunflower oil, celery and nuts.

title: Harry's Lazy Day
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups egg noodles | 2 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 3 large eggs, room temperature | 7 carrots, cut into sticks ( about 1lb ) | 3 3/4 cups mixed sprouts ( i use baby lima or baby beet leaves ) | 2/3 cup light golden syrup, warmed
instructions: Put the noodles in a large bowl, sprinkle lightly with salt and let soak for 10 minutes, then rinse out and drain and run under cold running water and the drain off any water that leaks out. Place the yeast in a bowl and, with a wire whisk, beat the eggs with a large splash of water. Now add the noodles, carrots, sprouts and golden syrup. Mix until well combined. Spoon the mixture into an oiled 8 cup oven safe bowl and bake in a 200c oven until the top is golden and crispy about 25 minutes.

title: Sweet and Sour Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 5 tablespoons fish sauce | 12 ounces medium raw peanuts, roughly chopped
instructions: Put the fish sauce in a small bowl and stir until the sugar dissolves. Add the peanuts and the fish sauce and combine thoroughly. Serve.

Random Ingredients: pepperoni,beef liver,molasses,irish cream,chicken thigh,tabasco sauce,virgin olive oil,star anise
title: Spiced Baked Chicken & Beef Liver
ingredients: 1/4 cup olive oil | 3 chicken thighs, trimmed | 2 slices pepperoni | 12 slices deli-style hot beef liver | 5 inches cube pepperoni | 6 star anise | 1/2 cup molasses or 1/2 cup maple syrup | 1 1/2 cups irish cream | tabasco sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees fahrenheit. In a small bowl combine the remaining ingredients, except for pepperoncinis. In a gallon size ziplock bag combine the liver, pepperoncinis, star anise, and molasses. Add the spice mixture. Squeeze out air, close bag, and transfer to an oven proof dish. Bake for 1 hour. Uncover and bake for another 30 minutes or until the peppers are toasted.

title: Quick and Easy Sauteed Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/3 cup cold water | 1/3 cup corn syrup | 3 large shiitake mushrooms | salad leaves ( optional )
instructions: Mix water and corn syrup in a shallow bowl. Cover and set aside. Trim and wash mushrooms, but leave stems on if using. Place mushrooms in a medium saucepan. Cover and cook over medium heat for 5 minutes, until softened.

title: Easy Beets
ingredients: 2 lbs beets ( or 1 large ) | 1/2 cup flat-leaf italian parsley
instructions: Wash and trim beets. Cut into 1/4 inch slices and put into a well oiled pot.. Cover and simmer about 30 minutes over medium heat. When beets are soft, drain the water. Let beets cool enough to handle, then boil in plenty of water until tender. Drain and return to pan, skimming off as much of the foam as possible. When cool enough to handle, cut into 1/4 thick slices. Place in a pan and cover with fresh water. Bring to a boil and reduce heat to medium. Cover and simmer gently for 10 minutes or until tender. Drain. Place the beets in a lightly oiled bowl and add some of the cooking liquid. Beat vigorously until well mixed. Place in serving dishes, sprinkle with parsley.

title: Cheat's Yummy Vegetable Shanghai Noodle Salad
ingredients: 350 g shanghai noodles | 1 medium cucumber | 1 medium swede | 1 pepperoncini pepper | 1/2 cup shredded pepperoni | 1 container yoghurt
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. Dice potato and swede into 1 inch cubes. Split pepperoni in half lengthwise. Place noodles and veggie mix on plate and sprinkle with pepperoni. Sprinkle cheese over noodles and top with yoghurt. Enjoy.

title: Shave Bruschetta
ingredients: 12 ounces baguette, cut very thin | 1/4 cup chives, chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh dill, chopped | 1 lime, zest of ( or 2 small tablespoons dry ) | 1 pinch cardamom
instructions: Slice baguette very thin. In a small bowl, stir together the chives, dill, lime zest, and cardamom. Spread one side of each baguette slice with the chive mixture. Put into the refrigerator until ready to serve.

title: Irish Boiled Dinner
ingredients: 2 lbs country-style boneless country-style boneless pork ribs | 1 1/2 gallons of heavily salted water | 12 ounces country style lamb prime rib | 12 ounces pork country style smoked cod or 12 ounces cooked deli smoked smoked pork | 3 1/2 lbs small baking potatoes, shillot | 15 ounces belgian endive, thinly sliced | 10 ounces provolone cheese, cut into eighths lengthwise and then into 3/4-inch lengths
instructions: Bring the water to a boil, and then add the ribs into the water. Add the meat, discarding any bones, fat or salt. Return to a boil, reduce the heat to low, and cover completely. Simmer for 30 minutes, skimming any scum that rises to the top. Skim off any fat that rises to the top every 15 to 30 minutes. Remove the ribs from the water and allow them to cool before refrigerating overnight. In a large dutch oven, or other large, deep pot, layer the potatoes evenly over the meat and cover with more water. Bring to a boil, cover and simmer over medium heat for 45 minutes, skimming any scum that rises to the top every 20 minutes. Remove the lid, and simmer for 30 minutes more. Skim as needed to prevent the potatoes from drying out. Meanwhile, remove the meat from the bone and cut into bite size pieces, and refrigerate for at least one hour. Preheat the grill. Remove the endive leaves from their stems and, when ready to serve, cut into about 1/4 inch slices on a bias. Stack them and cut them into 3 or 4 equal pieces. Arrange a portion of the meat into the center of a piece of the endive. Top with some of the smoked cod or deli meats. Top that with a portion of the provolone cheese. Place another piece of the endive on top of the cheese. Wrap the potato slices around the meat, tying them with a piece of cheese. Put the wrapped ends onto the grill. Close the lid and grill for 20 minutes at 50 percent relative humidity, turning the potato slices occasionally, until the meat is piping hot and the cheese is brown. Variation, when making the bisque, simply tear off a piece of heavy smoked smoked pork into the bowl of a blender and cut the sausage into 1/4 inch slices. You will have to wrap in plastic to shred it into crumbs when transferring it to the bisque.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,baking potato,sauerkraut,brown sugar,green pepper,wheat flour,beef bouillon cube
title: Slow Cooker Potato, Sausage and Kraut
ingredients: 3 lbs baking potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 2 green peppers, cut into 1 inch pieces | 8 -10 sauerkraut, drained | 5 beef bouillon cubes | 1 cup brown sugar | 2 garlic cloves, chopped | 1 teaspoon whole wheat flour
instructions: Combine all ingredients in crockpot. Cover and cook on low 5 hours.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,tomato puree,pork tenderloin,pork shoulder,onion powder,sea scallop
title: Steamed Pork, Scallops and Oyster Teriyaki
ingredients: 4 pork tenderloin, cut into 3-inch pieces | 1 1/2 lbs oyster sauce | 1 1/2 lbs pork shoulder, cut into 3-inch cubes | 2 1/2 tablespoons onion powder | 2 1/2 tablespoons dry-roasted tomato puree | 1 cup pints large black iron grillers, such as foster farms
instructions: Place pork and oyster sauce in a large bowl, and let stand until the pork is cool. Season pork with onion powder and tomato purée. Place the pork, pork shoulder and oyster sauce in a large steamer basket and steam over boiling water for 15 minutes, or until most of the water evaporates. Bring pot of water to a boil and remove pork slices after 5 minutes. Drain. Stir a few times while steaming water, to prevent it from boiling over, and let cool until the pork is cool enough to use. Place plastic wrap over the top of a wok or large skillet to keep the moisture for steaming. Place a steamer insert into the wok or skillet and steam over boiling water until it begins to steam. Remove the steamer insert, and place the pork pieces in the center of the wok or skillet as directed in the package. Arrange the scallops on top of the pork. Push a wooden or metal spatula under the scallops to help them stand upright. Cover tightly and steam over boiling water for 8 - 10 minutes, or until pork is just cooked and slightly pink on the outside but tender and the scallops are firm and easily flaked with a fork. Serve with steamed rice.

title: Apple Salad With Oregano
ingredients: 1 large tart apple, such as a mcintosh, peeled and thinly sliced | 2 teaspoons dried oregano leaves | lettuce leaf | papaya ( small ball ), thinly sliced ( cherry )
instructions: In a bowl, toss apple slices with oregano. Place apple slices, about 1/2 inch from each edge, on lettuce leaves. Garnish with papaya and serve.

Random Ingredients: saffron thread,garlic,garam masala,thai red curry paste,shiitake mushroom
title: Spiced Sauteed Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 tablespoons thai red curry paste | 1/2 cup sliced shiitake mushrooms | 1/2 teaspoon garlic, minced | 2/3 cup saffron threads or 2/3 cup garam masala | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon garlic, granulated | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet, stir fry mushrooms, 1/2 tbls. Of garlic, salt, curry paste, and saffron for 10 minutes until mushrooms are softened, about 3 more minutes. Stir well. Remove from heat. In separate small bowl, combine remaining garlic, garam masala, and 1/4 tsp. Of salt and stir. Set aside. With a heatproof 2 1/2 quart or larger saucepan, heat remaining 1 1/2 tbls. Oil over moderately high heat until hot but not smoking, then stir in spice mixture, 1 tbsp at a time, stirring until mushrooms are soft and hot but not boiling, about 1 minute. Immediately add garlic mixture, then stir over moderate heat for about 3 minutes, stirring, until curry is fragrant. Add 1/4 tsp. Salt and 1/8 tsp. Of pepper and stir. Return mushrooms to skillet, lower heat, and cook, stirring occasionally, for 1 minute, to heat through.

title: Chinese Orange Custard Squares
ingredients: 3 tablespoons smooth prepared custard powder ( see note ) | 6 tablespoons orange zest ( from a 1-oz orange ) | 1/2 1/2 cup sesame oil or 1/2 cup peanut oil
instructions: Make sure your custard powder is of a thick orange color and not a yellow coloring. Line an 11 x 7 x 2 inch pan with waxed paper. Whisk about 2 tablespoons of the custard powder with 1/2 cup of hot water in a bowl. Drizzle the paste over the waxed paper, taking care not to let the mixture curdle. Use a slotted spoon to lift the paste out of the paper. Cool in the refrigerator 10 minutes, to allow the starch to settle, then stir in the remaining powdered sugar. Line an 11 x 7 inch pan with plastic wrap and grease with a little of the oil you just set to prevent a skin from forming while baking. Spoon enough of the custard mixture into the pan to cover the top, and sprinkle with half of the grated orange zest. Spoon enough of the custard over the zest to nearly cover. Sprinkle with half of the sesame oil or peanut oil and continue to layer the orange custard mixture over the custard, pressing down on the paste slightly to avoid it sticking to the sides. The crust should just come up above the custard layer. Sprinkle over the remaining orange zest and drizzle with more of the sesame oil or peanut oil. Press down on the paste slightly to prevent a skin from forming while it bakes. Allow the crust to cool in the fridge. Cut into squares once cool and cut into squares. Use as a snack item, or serve on a cold winter's day.

title: Quick and Easy Mushroom Cheese Ball
ingredients: 1 pint light cream of tartar | 6 ounces shredded mozzarella cheese | 1 tablespoon garlic, minced | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce
instructions: Place cream of tars and shredded mozzarella cheese in a bowl. Mix until creamy. Add garlic and oyster sauce. Mix until it is well blended.

title: Irish Colcannon Salad
ingredients: 2 cups whipping cream | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1 jar capers packed in salted coffee, drained, patted dry and finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 1 medium green cabbage, shredded | 1 small red cabbage, shredded | 1 jar chopped pimientos, drained
instructions: Note, the baking soda may be made without adding sugar, and added to whipping cream along with the baking soda. The mixture may be stored, covered, in the refrigerator up to 3 days, stirring occasionally. Just before serving, stir in the chopped capers and allspice. If desired, drain the cold capers, and stir into the salad. If needed, stir in the shredded cabbage, red cabbage and pimientos. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,dark raisin,cayenne pepper sauce,sharp cheddar cheese,paprika
title: Cheese-Chile Rellenos

instructions: Slice chiles lengthwise. Slice off the ends to remove seeds. Place chiles in a small bowl. Finely chop the green chilies and add along with all ingredients, stirring to mix well. Microwave on high for 2 minutes. Stir and microwave 2 to 3 minutes more.

title: Greek Style Beef Ribs
ingredients: 6 large beef short ribs | 12 sheets frozen lasagna noodles | 1 1/4 lbs shredded greek yogurt ( greek is the best brand ) | 1/2 lb crumbled blue cheese | 1/2 cup kalamata olive, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Combine ribs and remaining ingredients. Arrange in baking pan and bake 45 minutes or until meat is fork tender. Spoon off fat, reserving 1/2 cup, let ribs cool 15 minutes. Slice meat in serving size pieces. Arrange on warmed plates and top with reserved crumbled cheese.

title: Easy and Healthy Pizza Rolls
ingredients: 1 premade pizza | chopped fresh cilantro ( to garnish ) or chopped green onion ( to garnish ) | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, finely chopped | 1/2 cup finely chopped onion ( to garnish ) | lettuce ( to garnish )
instructions: Pre heat the oven to 425°f. Place an oven proof plate on your pizza maker machine, or tray. Place your desired amount of pizza base ingredients onto the plate. Note, you will probably need a small piece of parchment paper to help sandwich up the slices from corner to corner. It helps make the crust crisp and to keep the sauce on the inside. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chow mein noodle,white pepper,dark soy sauce
title: Chef John's Chow Mein
ingredients: 12 ounces chow mein noodles ( white-meat chow mein noodles ) | 3 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Fill a heavy pot with water and bring it to a boil. Add chow mein noodles and return to a boil. Cook the noodles, stirring occasionally until tender, about 5 minutes. Drain and transfer to a serving dish. Whisk dark soy sauce and white pepper together in a small bowl until the mixture is evenly blended. Sprinkle sauce over the hot noodles and toss, until flavors blend, about 2 minutes.

title: Onion-Free Lasagna
ingredients: 1 package lasagna noodle | 3 cups onions soup mix | 1/2 cup marsala wine | 1/4 cup poppy seed | 1/4 cup lemon juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add lasagna and cook for 8 minutes or until al dente.

title: Broccoli With Prosciutto and Provolone
ingredients: 1/2 lb broccoli | 1/2 lb prosciutto, cut into 1/8-inch strips | 1/4 lb romaine lettuce, torn into 3-inch lengths | 1/4 cup buttermilk | 1/4 cup fresh rosemary, chopped | 12 bamboo skewers or 12 bamboo skewers, presoak
instructions: Broccoli,. Cut the ends off of the broccoli stems and broil it in the boiling water with the prosciutto for 3 minutes. Let cool slightly, then cut the broccoli into 1/2 inch pieces. Let the broccoli cool completely and the prosciutto cut into thin strips. Sofrito,. Combine the buttermilk and rosemary in a small saucepan and bring to a boil. Pour the hot buttermilk sauce over the slices of salad and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: glace cherry,pink salmon,garam masala,bibb lettuce,chicken meat,chili sauce
title: Tikka Boti
ingredients: 1 teaspoon chili sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons garam masala | 2/3 pound bone-in, skinless, boneless chicken meat - chopped | 1 can pink salmon, drained and cubed | 1/2 can glace cherries, drained | 1 head bibb lettuce, torn into large pieces
instructions: Stir the chili sauce and garam masala together in a glass bowl or resealable plastic bag until the mixture is well combined. Add chicken and turn to coat. Marinate in the refrigerator 1 to 2 hours, turning occasionally. Preheat grill for high heat and lightly oil the grate. Drain and discard marinade. Grill chicken until no longer pink but not cooked through, about 45 minutes. Stir in the salmon. Transfer the chicken and salmon to the bun.

title: Horseradish Chickpea Salad
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 1 teaspoon dried onion flakes | 1 1/2 teaspoons prepared horseradish | 2 tablespoons dry sherry | sliced lettuce leaf ( optional )
instructions: Drain chickpeas, reserving liquid. In a bowl, combine chickpeas with onion, horseradish, sherry and remaining liquid. Toss to combine. Garnish with lettuce leaves, if desired if desired.

title: Gramma's Favorite Chicken and Rice Crockpot

instructions: Place half of the pork, half of the chicken, half of the chicken, and half of the onion in the bottom of an 8 quart slow cooker. title: Beer-Maker Thin German Flat Fakes
ingredients: 1 cup rye flour | 3 tablespoons taco seasoning mix or 3 tablespoons coarsely cracked rye breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon anchovy paste | 2 cups watermelon, cut into thin strips | 7 ounces beer ( a german beer, such as german cheek ale ) | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 1 tablespoon vodka | 1/4 cup extra tapioca flour ( approximately ) )
instructions: In a bowl, whisk the rye flour, taco seasoning mix or coarse cracked rye bread crumbs, anchovy paste, and watermelon until the mixture is thoroughly combined and forms a loose paste. Transfer the mixture to a bowl, cover, and refrigerate until it firms up, about 15 minutes. Form 1 1/2 ounce portions out of the batter, and drop them into the hot beer.

title: Cheese Rosti With Capsicums and Sherry

instructions: Finely grate the zest from half the mozzarella, remove the seeds with your fingers and wash it, put the zest in a bowl, with 100g grated cheese and 250ml sherry. title: Asian Ramen Salad
ingredients: 1/4 lb of thin sliced ramen noodles | 1 head fresh basil or 2 bunches fresh daikon radish, sliced into half a long strips | 3 tablespoons vegetable oil | 2 cups of sliced oriental mixed fruit ( fruit of your choice ) | 1/2 orange or 2/3 lemon pieces, zested and juiced ( if using orange ) | 3/4 cup rice wine or 3/4 cup dry sherry | 2 cups of cooked basmati rice | 1/2 - 1 cup crouton ( optional )
instructions: Arrange the prepared salad on a platter. Add the oriental fruit and orange zest, mixing well. Set aside. Prepare the rice according to the rice package directions. Drain. Add the mixed fruit to the salad in the bowl and serve along with the croutons if using. Enjoy.

title: Green Curry With Cabbage and Pistachios
ingredients: 2 tablespoons thai green curry paste | 1 can refrigerated ice cream, softened | 1 tablespoon finely grated lemon peel | 1/8 teaspoon caraway seed | 1 tablespoon thinly sliced green curry paste | 1 1/4 cups shredded cabbage | 1 cup finely grated carrot | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh coriander leaves | freshly chopped pistachios
instructions: In small bowl, stir together curry paste, ice cream, lemon peel, caraway seeds, and green curry paste. Mix well. Spoon into 2 or 3 bowls. Layer cabbage, carrot, and coriander over top. Sprinkle with pistachios. Serve over hot jasmine rice.

title: Black Bean Cheesy Quesadillas
ingredients: 4 1/2 tablespoons sour cream or 4 1/2 tablespoons plain yogurt | 4 slices monterey jack cheese, 1/2 inch thick | 8 ounces black beans, drained and rinsed | 16 -20 slices cheddar cheese, 1/2 inch thick ( from a cheddar bag )
instructions: Mix together sour cream and black beans in a medium bowl. Spray a large non stick skillet with cooking spray, or grease with butter.
