Using the tip of a knife, spread the sour cream mixture evenly across the cheese. Top with remaining slices of cheese, spread a little of the black bean mixture on top of the sour cream, and repeat process with remaining half of beans mixture, cheese, bean mixture and sour cream mixture. When finished top each quesadilla with the remaining black bean mixture and sprinkle with cheddar cheese. Heat a large non stick skillet over medium heat. When it is almost dry, add the quesadillas one at a time. When bottom side is lightly browned, turn and brown second side. Remove to a serving plate, and repeat process until all six quesadillas are cooked. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,cider vinegar,beef sirloin steak,dill seed,mayonnaise
title: Sirloin Steak With Dill Mayo
ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 3 tablespoons heavy cream | 1 tablespoon mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 2 teaspoons dill seeds | 4 beef sirloin steaks
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high. Mix mayonnaise, heavy cream and mayonnaise together in a medium bowl until smooth. Add dill seed and mix well. Score the top of each steak with a criss cross pattern. Place on the grill, and cook for 3 to 4 minutes, or until desired doneness.

title: Italian Pasta With Herbs
ingredients: 4 -6 cups cooked drained pasta | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried oregano
instructions: Let pasta and/or vegetables cook, about 5 minutes. Add herbs and toss thoroughly.

title: Lamb with a Rigatoni
ingredients: 2 lbs russet potatoes, peeled and cut into 5- to 6-inch lengths | 3 tablespoons seasoning salt | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace | 1 tablespoon mayonnaise | 1 1/2 pounds ground lamb | 1 lb medium penne pasta
instructions: In a large pot over medium high heat, combine potatoes, salt, cinnamon, mace, and mace. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover, and simmer until the potatoes are tender, about 20 minutes. Drain and allow to cool for about 15 minutes. Pour the potatoes into a large bowl. Stir in the mayonnaise, lamb, and pasta. Mix well. Refrigerate until cold, or transfer to an airtight container for storage. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: cottage cheese,blueberry,maraschino cherry,grain white rice,longhorn cheese,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Blueberry Rice, Blueberry, Spinach, Cheese...
ingredients: 1/2 cup uncooked long grain white rice | 1 cup cottage cheese | 1/2 cup shredded longhorn cheese | 1/2 cup sharp cheddar cheese ( optional ) | 1/2 cup maraschino cherry, sliced | 1/2 cup frozen sliced blueberries
instructions: Combine rice and cottage cheese in a medium bowl. Stir in remaining ingredients. Stir in blueberries and combine well with a fork.

title: Chocolate Chip-Chile Temptation
ingredients: 1/2 cup light cream or 1/2 cup fat free sour cream, divided | 3 small dried red chiles, seeded and cut into strips | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant tea ( i use decaf, but you can use 2 tea spoons if you prefer ) | cooking spray | 3 tablespoons shortening
instructions: Combine 1/4 cup cream and chiles in a small bowl. Cover and let stand 10 to 15 minutes. Coat rimmed baking sheet with cooking spray. Combine remaining cream and chiles in a small bowl. Cover and chill 1 hour. Spread chile mixture onto baking sheet. Spray with cooking spray. Cool to room temperature. Coat rims of remaining 2 t. Spoonfuls of cream mixture evenly over chile. Using a pastry brush, sprinkle lightly with shortening. Gently press mixture into cream mixture. Refrigerate until serving.

Random Ingredients: vanilla yogurt,self rising flour,mint,white grape juice,taco seasoning mix,triple sec,veal,cold water
title: Mexican Dessert With Diced Pork Rind
ingredients: 2 ounces taco seasoning mix | 3/4 cup cold water | 3/4 cup white grape juice ( optional ) | 1 ounce plain vanilla yogurt ( i use vanilla ) | 1/4 cup triple sec ( or lemon ) | 1/2 lb ground meat ( can use lean ground sirloin or other meats ) | 1 tablespoon shaved white of your choice such as shaved jalapeno or 1 tablespoon other hot pepper | 2 cups self rising flour ( or gluten-free flour, or use gluten-free flour )
instructions: Mix taco seasoning mix and water together in a 2 quart bowl. Sift in the grape juice. Mix in yogurt and double sec. Stir in meat. Stir vigorously and allow batter to rest 5 - 10 minutes. Add shaved white of your choice or jalapeños. Mix well and refrigerate until ready to use. You may cook more meat in the frying pan in batches, if desired. I recommend using less meat than you would if you use ground sirloin. Warm oven to 450 degrees. Sprinkle flour on a clean, floured surface. Pour batter into pan. Cook until bubbly and top is browned and firm. This should take about 25 minutes to an hour.

title: Homemade Phyllo
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh ground black pepper | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Line a small metal or glass bowl with plastic wrap. Place the ground black pepper on the plastic wrap and sprinkle with the pepper flakes. Roll tightly, and tightly secure with a small piece of cardboard or a rubber band. Let the plastic wrap rest for about 15 minutes at room temperature. Place the piece of cardboard or plastic wrap on a flat surface. With the cardboard or plastic wrap still tightly wrapped over the top of the plastic wrap, lightly wet the strip of cardboard in one motion. Once the dough begins to roll, remove the plastic wrap from the top. Place the dough carefully on a clean, damp cloth. Using a wet finger, spread a portion of the shredded pepper all around the phyllo. Use the twine to keep the phyllo closed. Fold over into thirds, and roll out as thinly as possible. Use a large cookie cutter or a large drinking glass, roll out more phyllo like a swiss roll. Cut off a corner of the roll with a sharp knife. Place the rolled out portion of dough in a 9 square pan. Cover with a layer of shredded carrots, and a piece of torn green or red pepper. Repeat layers until all the ingredients are used. Cover with parchment paper or another tight, damp cloth. Chill and allow to sit at room temperature for at least 6 hours. The phyllo is now ready to be frozen.

Random Ingredients: yellow cornmeal,lemon juice,sun tomato,italian salad dressing mix,anise seed,allspice,corn
title: Allergy Free Sun-Dried Tomato and Cornmeal Rounds
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups whole yellow cornmeal | 1 package italian salad dressing mix | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 1 teaspoon allspice ( or your own variation ) | 3/4 teaspoon anise seed | 3 tablespoons sun-dried tomato, pieces ( optional, i sometimes use pignolis, dried chipolata or other type of sun dried tomatoes ) | 1 cup corn ( i use the small can, just make sure it is dry. )
instructions: Mix the cornmeal, salad dressing mix, lemon juice, spices and tomatoes in a bowl or plastic food storage bag to a firm dough. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured board and roll or pat the dough to 1/4 inch thickness. Using a 1 1/2 inch round cookie cutter, cut out cookies using the round, rounded edge of a drinking glass. Coat the tops of the cookies with the cooking liquid or spray with nonstick cooking spray. Bake the cookies in preheated 325f oven until crisp and golden or set the cookies aside on a rack for 10 minutes. The cooling will cool a lot. Store in an airtight container. They keep for up to 1 week. This is not a low fat recipe or a low fat snack. If i had made this recipe with cornmeal i would definitely have consumed it as is.

Random Ingredients: beef brisket,phyllo dough,herbes de provence,pork,yellow pepper,cumin,pepper
title: Savory Beef and Pork Strata
ingredients: 1/2 cup mixed fresh herbs, such as a combination of dill, thyme, and tarragon | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs beef brisket, trimmed with most of its fat cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes | 1 1/2 lbs pork, cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes | 1 teaspoon herbes de provence ( to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin ( to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon pepper | 9 sheets phyllo dough, thawed before use
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Remove about 6 tablespoons of the meat from the beef with a teaspoon and discard the fat. Place fat pieces in a large skillet. Cook over high heat until browned. Turn meat, increase heat, and add herbs and herbes. Cook, stirring often, until liquid has cooked down and thickened. Push the meat cubes down to the sides and pour off any fat. Stir in meat juices, salt, pepper and herbes de provence. Spoon meat and any accumulated juices into 6 individual oven proof ramekins. Place 2 sheets of phyllo on a work surface, cut side up, and brush generously with 2 to 3 tablespoons of cooking oil. Repeat with second sheet, brushing each with oil. Cut the 5 sheets into 3 strips about 3 1/2 wide. Place 2 - 3 strips on top of the first, brushing each with more of the oil. Place 3 more strips on top of the first. Repeat with 2 more strips and the remaining strips. Trim top 4 sheets and then cut the tops off the phyllo dough sheets. Using a sharp knife, cut the strips crosswise into diamonds. Brush on oil. Cover with plastic wrap and let stand at room temperature for 1 hour. Bake 45 - 60 minutes, or until firm and lightly browned. Serve with sour cream.

title: Asadero Cheese and Rice Wine Ice Balls
ingredients: 1/2 cup asadero cheese | 1 cup cold cooked rice or 1 cup rice wine | 1/3 cup hot water | 2 cups ice
instructions: Combine cheese and water.

title: Ossobuco or Veal With Saffron
ingredients: 2 lbs veal fillets, thick-cut | 1/4 cup saffron, soaked in 2 tbsp. boiling water
instructions: Bring a large saucepan of lightly salted water to a boil. Have a plate that can accomodate the veal with a steamer basket that fits snugly under the saucepan and is big enough that the steamer can eventually reach it inches. Trim off any large pieces of fat or impurities that float to the surface. Lightly coat veal with saffron and place on plate. Lay a piece of aluminum foil over the plate and weight it down with a heavy, heavy object to keep it pliable. Seal foil completely around the veal using your hand and set at right angles to the top of the foil. Refrigerate it for at least 2 days. Remove the foil from the saffron. Cook it on a medium flame for 30 - 45 minutes, until the foaming subsides and the veal is just tender. Serve with potatoes or noodles.

Random Ingredients: marjoram,jumbo shrimp,new potato,spanish olive,sage leaf,cheddar cheese
title: Spanish Shrimp Bake
ingredients: 12 -16 jumbo shrimp, peeled, deveined, tails left on | 24 -32 -30 large new potatoes | 1 jar spanish olives ( sliced and pitted ok ) | 1 tablespoon olive oil or 1 tablespoon butter | fresh sage leaf, crumbled | 1 sprig fresh marjoram
instructions: Preheat over to 350f degrees. Cut shrimp in half lengthwise, leaving shell on top and bottom of shrimp. Bake shrimp in a large pan with medium/medium high sides for 15 minutes, turn and bake until shrimp are done. Heat olive oil in a frying pan and cook potatoes until fork tender, about 10 - 12 minutes depending on thickness.. In a separate medium to small frying pan heat jar of olives and the olive oil until warm. Drain shrimp and put on a foil covered plate. Place 1/8 of the potatoes over the shrimp and top off with the top 1/8 of the shrimp. Sprinkle with sage, marjoram and oregano. Place another 1/8 of the potatoes over the shrimp and top with the remaining olives. Cook for 15 - 20 minutes.

title: Spaghetti and Beans - Vodka and Vodka
ingredients: 500 g pearl barley | 500 g tin cannellini beans, undrained | 1 1/2 liters tomato ketchup | 200 g vodka | 25 slices white bread
instructions: In a large stewing pot put the beans into the water and bring to boil, cover, turn heat down to medium and cook for 10 - 15 minutes. Turn off the heat. Remove the beans and throw away the skin. Cut the beans in half and put them back into the pot and add the tomato ketchup. Mix through, cover and leave to simmer. Meanwhile, add water to the tin you cooked the beans inches heat the tin up until bubbles appear around the edge. Put the bread slices in the tin, put the lid on and turn the heat down a bit and cook for 5 - 10 minutes or until the bread is crumbs are crisp and golden. To serve, put in a bowl and drizzle vodka over, some tomato ketchup and extra tomato ketchup. Serve with a wedge of cream.

Random Ingredients: coconut,lobster meat,russet potato,green olive,chili oil,bulgar wheat,paprika
title: Tropical Fish Casserole
ingredients: 1 box florwold russet potatoes | 12 ounces lobster meat | 4 ounces chopped green olives | 1 tablespoon sweet paprika | 1 teaspoon chili oil | 1/3 cup flaked coconut | 1 teaspoon paprika | 1 teaspoon ground flaked coconut
instructions: Heat oven to 425°. Peel and halve potatoes leaving 1/4 thick shell of potatoes. Place in a large baking dish with enough water to cover. Bake covered for 40 minutes, reduce heat to 350f, and continue baking 5 minutes. In a large skillet or wok heat 1 - 2 tblspn oil. Add olives and saute over high, for 2 minutes. Remove from heat, and stir in the paprika, chili oil, 3/4 tsp each of the flaked coconut, and the remaining 1/2 tsp paprika. Stir in the cooked potatoes and toss until well coated. Stir in the flaked coconut, and serve warm or hot.

title: Crock Pot Cantonese Lamb Shanks
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs lamb shanks, cut into 6 serving size pieces | 1/2 cup vanilla | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 3 tablespoons dried coconut flakes | 1 can sliced ripe figs, undrained | 2 1/2 cups fresh raspberries or 2 1/2 cups frozen raspberries | 1 small habanero pepper, seeded, minced ( or use green chile pepper if you like it hotter )
instructions: Place lamb in crock pot, and sprinkle with vanilla. In a small bowl, combine tomato soup, coconut, figs and half of the chiles. Pour over meat. Cook on low for 8 to 10 hours, or on high for 3 to 4 hours. If basting, add a little water to crock pot during the last 10 minutes of cooking. Strain soup into a saucepan, reserving 1 3/4 cups juices that remain in crock pot. Use remaining broth to make a gravy, and serve over the lamb. Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: onion flake,potato starch,sirloin,sesame oil,chicken thigh,pecan,vanilla extract,currant
title: Korean Crispy Pancakes (Galbi)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons canola oil | 2 pork tenderloin or 2 thigh steaks, sliced into thin half inch pieces | 1 medium onion, minced or 1 1/2 large onions, sliced thin | 1 tablespoon dried minced onion flakes | 2 small potatoes starch, sifted | 1/4 cup dried currants | 1/4 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 2 -3 tablespoons pecans, crushed
instructions: In a wok, heat oil over medium high heat. Add pork and onion.

Random Ingredients: cherry pepper,cottage cheese,salmon,peanut oil,cayenne pepper,chili,white flour,buttermilk
title: Spicy Salmon Salad
ingredients: 100 g salmon, cooked | 100 g cottage cheese, cubed | 1 teaspoon white flour | 50 ml buttermilk, plus a little extra | peanut oil | 1 pinch dried chili | 1 pinch cayenne pepper | 3 cherries ( optional )
instructions: Mix everything until well combined. Chill in the fridge and serve.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,poblano pepper,pecorino romano cheese,kalamata olive
title: Parmigianos Sausages
ingredients: 1 cup whole wheat flour | 1 teaspoon coarsely grated pecorino romano cheese | 1 can poblano peppers | 1/4 cup pitted kalamata olive
instructions: In a mixing bowl or food processor finely grind the flour through the ricer. Cut a slit in each of the poblano peppers lengthwise, removing the stem and seeds. Carefully open each pepper like a book and remove the seed. You should have approximately 1/2 cup of sausage mixture, total. Heat a cast iron skillet over medium heat. Add the poblano peppers and 1/4 cup water to the pan. Simmer the pepper for 2 to 3 minutes, until slightly soft and tender, stirring frequently. Remove the pepper to a plate lined with plastic wrap and let it cool slightly, then peel off the skin. Cut the pepper in half from top to bottom.

title: Linguine With Celery (Ondi Sausage-Sausage)
ingredients: 6 -8 ounces linguine | freshly grated nutmeg | 1 stalk celery, small but firm ( optional )
instructions: Cook the linguine in a large, fairly large pot of boiling, salted water over high heat until it is al dente, according to package instructions. Drain the cooked pasta well in a colander, return it to the pot and put over low heat to coat with the fat. Cook it over very low heat until it is tender and all the water has evaporated, stirring and flipping the noodles. Stir in the nutmeg, celery and cooked linguine and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: herbes de provence,chocolate syrup,date,chickpea flour,lime juice
title: Lighter Lemon Herb Fritters
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups low-fat cooked chickpea flour ( can be found at most specialty food stores and many supermarkets ) | 1 1/4 cups fresh lime juice | 3 tablespoons low fat natural chocolate syrup or 3 tablespoons low-fat honey | 1 1/2 teaspoons herbes de provence | 1/2 cup chopped dates
instructions: In a medium bowl combine the chickpea flour, lime juice, chocolate syrup, and herbes de provence. Stir until smooth and set aside. Using a small, dampened spoon, sprinkle ½ cup of the chickpea mixture into the palm of your hand. Using a wide spatula, carefully start dropping 1 rounded tablespoon of the batter, about 1 teaspoon away from the center of the palm, onto the palm of your hand. Grab and squeeze the rounded side of the spatula between your thumb and the edge of your palm to flatten more, then gently press the mixture into an 8 inch circle. Repeat until all the mixture has been used up. If using a wide spatula, press the mixture onto the palm of your hand and set aside. Repeat with the remaining mixture and the remaining mixture. Serve with lime wedges and other garnishes of your choice.

title: Thai Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups thai fish sauce | 2 tablespoons distilled cider vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon grand marnier
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together well. Pour over your favorite salad greens and refrigerate for about an hour before serving.

title: Barefoot Contessa's Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 lb portabella mushroom cap | 2 lbs parsnips, peeled | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for direct cooking over medium high heat. Meanwhile, combine sliced mushrooms and parsnips in a large bowl. Add sesame oil.

title: Easy Baked Potato Burritos
ingredients: 2 baking potatoes, peeled | 2 cups cooked white rice | 1/2 cup flour tortillas ( your choice of size )
instructions: Place the potato in a large microwave safe measuring cup and microwave on high for 5 minutes. Stir and cook on high for 5 more minutes or until tender. Turn the potatoes several times, rearranging them as they cook so they are evenly coated with the potato flavoring. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees. Lightly oil a 2 quart baking dish. Spread a thin layer of rice in the bottom of the dish. Top it with the potato. Dot the rice with a tablespoonful of water or flour. Repeat with another layer of rice until all the ingredients are used up. Sprinkle on a bit of salt on top. Cover the dish loosely with aluminum foil. Bake in preheated oven for 30 - 35 minutes. Remove the foil, bake an additional 10 minutes or until heated through.

Random Ingredients: salt,red potato,sherry wine,chili paste,water chestnut,cream,soymilk,malt extract
title: Malt Beer
ingredients: 2 lbs red potatoes | 6 tablespoons dry sherry wine | 4 tablespoons chili paste | 1/2 cup light cream ( or fat free sour cream, or evaporated soy milk, or coconut cream ) | 1/2 cup malt extract | water chestnuts, diced ( optional ) | salt | sour cream ( optional )
instructions: Scrub the potatoes, place in a pot, add water to cover and bring to boil over medium high heat. Cook, covered, until tender, about 40 minutes. Drain potatoes and place back into pot. Return potatoes to pot and boil to reduce water by 1/ put the lid on the pot and simmer for 10 minutes to soften potatoes. Cut potatoes and return to pot. Add the sherry, chili paste, cream, malt extract, water chestnuts and salt. Stir and gently reheat if necessary for 1 minute.

title: Tomato, Egg & Garlic Tart
ingredients: 2 cans condensed tomato paste | 1 cup bread, cubed | 1 package puff pastry | 1 cup cream cheese, room temperature | 1 teaspoon hot white pepper | water
instructions: Mix tin can of tomato paste with bread, spoon inside tart mould. Drain tomato sauce of tomato paste cans and pour over tart mould. Bake at 375 deg for 25 mins until cooked and golden brown. Beat cream cheese and add white pepper and mix well. Add cream and mix well. Serve tart with tomato gravy or vegetable gravy.

title: Sherry Turkey Dogs
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground turkey | 2/3 cup dry sherry
instructions: Combine all ingredients and let stand over night at room temp or refrigerate for 1 week.

title: Simple Channa Dal Pudding
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups channa dal, washed thoroughly | 2 cups whipping cream | 1 can chickpeas, drained of excess water
instructions: Cook and stir chana dal, stirring frequently over low heat for 30 minutes, or until creamy. Stir in cream and chickpeas and bring to a boil. Simmer for 5 minutes. Serve hot or chilled.

title: Creamy Orange Sauce for Pasta or Grilled Cheese
ingredients: 4 navel orange slices | 4 cups mascarpone cheese, room temperature
instructions: Brush the orange slices with melted butter. Place the mascarpone cheese in a chilled bowl. Place the orange slices in the bowl. Serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: buttery cracker,graham cracker crumb,chicken bouillon cube,beef stew meat,peanut butter,fenugreek leaf,buttermilk
title: Lumpia
ingredients: 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1 cup peanuts | 4 beef stew meat, cut into cubes ( i like london broil at a 'joint ) | 2 tablespoons butter | 1 chicken bouillon cubes or 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 tablespoon dried fenugreek leaves ( or more to taste ) | 1/2 cup buttermilk | parsley, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Put graham crackers and peanuts into a mixing bowl and smash them with a potato masher, pestle, or a fork. Add the meat and toss to coat in the mixture. In a separate bowl, soak the stock cubes in buttermilk for at least one hour. Drain the stock and reserve the liquid. Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the meat mixture and stir well. Add the crumb mixture and stir well. Add just enough reserved stock to moisten the meat mixture and stir well. It should not be soupy, but will coat the back of the spoon. Add the fenugreek leaves. Stir well. Turn heat to low and cover. Simmer for approximately 1 hour, stirring every 20 minutes. Uncover. After 1 hour, take the pan off the heat. Cover. Let stand for 2 minutes. Uncover. Replace lid and cook for another 20 - 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,cherry tomato,basil pesto,mozzarella ball,celery rib,milk,grain rice
title: Veggie Stuffed Rice Ball
ingredients: 1 cup skim milk, not skim | 1/4 cup whole grain rice, uncooked | 2 tablespoons basil pesto | 1 teaspoon celery rib, celery buds | 4 large mixed fresh tomatoes, seeded and diced | 4 ounces monterey jack cheese, shredded | 2 cups cherry tomatoes, halved
instructions: Stir milk and rice together in a microwave safe bowl. Microwave on high for 2 minutes, stirring twice. Remove from microwave. Add pesto and celery. Stir until mixture is evenly distributed. Transfer to a large bowl. Stir in diced tomatoes. Spoon rice mixture into an 11x7x2 baking dish sprayed with nonstick cooking spray. Top with cheese. Bake at 325°f for 20 minutes or until hot and cheese melts. Serve with cherry tomatoes.

Random Ingredients: orange bell pepper,lime,bay leaf,cauliflower floret,torpedo,cardamom pod,apple
title: Spiral Vegetables
ingredients: 1/4 cup coriander cauliflower floret | 1 cup orange bell peppers or 1 cup yellow bell pepper | 1 medium apple | 1 tablespoon lime rind, minced | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon cardamom pod, powdered | 1 bay leaf | 1/4 cup torpedo, sliced or 1/4 cup anchovies
instructions: Wash and pat dry the vegetables. Cut the vegetables in half through the base to expose the core. Cut along the sides then cut each half again into 3 or 4 slanted cubes and place in a bowl. Slice the apple thinly through the core. Place in a bowl. Using a pestle and mortar or the back of a large flat knife, add coriander, orange or yellow pepper, lemon rind, cardamom, and bay leaf. Mix well. Place one of the cubes onto the base of a hot nonstick skillet. Place it in the center of the pan. Place the vegetable cubes over the pieces. Place the last cube of anchovies and apple on top. Cook over medium heat until bottom of skillet is a golden brown. Flip and cook two more minutes. Keep stirring while shaking the pan. The carrots should not be soft or mushy and the apples and cauliflower should be caramel colored. You may serve with hot mustard or horseradish.

Random Ingredients: shell pasta,thyme,baking powder,basmati rice,pepper,cheddar cheese,chili seasoning mix
title: Chili and Pepper Mac & Cheese
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked short-grain shell pasta, broken into 2-bite pieces | 1 cup reduced-fat cheddar cheese | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 teaspoon chili seasoning mix | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 1/4 teaspoon pepper | 1 1/3 cups cooked basmati rice, hot
instructions: In a large saucepan of boiling water combine the pasta, 1 1/2 cups of the cheddar and thyme. Cook until tender, approximately 8 - 10 minutes. Drain pasta. In a medium sized mixing bowl, combine the chili seasoning mix, baking powder, pepper and remaining 1/3 cup of cheddar. Add hot pasta mixture and stir well to combine. Spoon mixture into a well buttered 13 x9 baking dish and sprinkle top with remaining 1/2 cup of the remaining cheddar. Bake in a hot oven for 25 minutes or until heated through. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: white flour,rice wine,wheat flour,corn chip,cheese,superfine sugar,salt,arrowroot
title: The Ultimate Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 package multi-coloured corn chips | 1/2 cup white flour | 1/4 cup whole wheat flour | 1/2 cup superfine sugar | 1/8 teaspoon salt | 1 tablespoon arrowroot | 1 tablespoon rice wine | 1/2 cup cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c. Line a baking sheet with greaseproof paper. Dissolve the arrowroot in a little water. Sift flours, salt and sugar together. Add arrowroot and mix. Blend in the rice wine and cheese. Add extra flour if needed. Press into the baking pan and bake for 25 - 30 minutes or until centre of the cake spring back when pressed. Serve with your favourite ice cream, cream or cream.

title: Kaya (Paprika-Spice Soup)
ingredients: 2 ounces prosciutto, finely chopped | 8 ounces unsweetened coconut milk ( or 1 cup ) | 1 tomatoes, chopped | skewer, of choice ( optional ) | 4 cardamom | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder
instructions: Pour tomato into a pan with coconut milk. Add curry powder and cardamom and bring to the boil, simmer for five minutes. Add coconut essence. Allow to cool a little, then taste and add any optional ingredients if you wish.

title: Spicy Maryland Lawyer
ingredients: 1 package philadelphia cream cheese, at room temperature | 1 cup sour cream or 1 cup room temperature sour cream | 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts, drained | 8 ounces salmon, drained | 1 teaspoon kahlua | 1 ounce walnuts, toasted
instructions: Beat cream cheese and the sour cream or fat free sour cream until smooth or using an immersion blender, pour into a mixing bowl. Add artichokes, salmon, and liqueur. Dip nuts in cream cheese mixture just until nuts are covered, spread on a bed of paper towels, top with remaining cream cheese mixture, and refrigerate 3 hours or overnight.

title: Spicy Indian Dipping Sauce - Easy!
ingredients: 1 tablespoon grated onion powder ( or equivalent ) | 2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Combine all the ingredients. Store unused mixture in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: natural bran,aubergine,rice krispies,garam masala,cooking barley,yellow cornmeal,gelatin
title: Aubergine, Aubergine & Rice Crispies
ingredients: 1/4 cup rice krispies | 1 large aubergine, cut into wedges | 1/4 cup natural bran | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1/2 teaspoon unflavored gelatin | 1 teaspoon yellow cornmeal | 1 1/2 cups quick-cooking barley
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Bring a saucepan of water to the boil. Mix the rice krispies, aubergine & bran together & mix well. Place in a bowl & cover with plastic wrap. Add a few dabs of margarine or oil & mash together. Place the aubergine in another bowl with the garam masala, gelatin & salt. Mash together well. Dip hands in the rice krispies mixture & then place between paper towel squares. Dip 1 - 2 at a time in a bowl of water, then roll in the cornmeal a few at a time. Place on a greased baking sheet & cook for 6 - 8 minutes, until crisp and browned. Remove from oven & drain on paper towels. Serve warm with chutney.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt,chicken,vegetable stock,hot chili sauce,corn,ice,lemon zest
title: Chinese Style Coriander Soup
ingredients: 3 cans vegetable stock | 4 slices fresh galus de cecco or 4 slices lemons, zest of | 1/4 teaspoon lemon zest | kosher salt | corn ( optional ) | 2 lbs chicken, cut into 1 inch pieces ( or 1 lb chicken breasts, cut into 1 inch pieces ) | hot chili sauce ( optional )
instructions: Pour the vegetable stock into a large pot. Add the galus and lemon zest. Bring to a boil over med. Heat, then add the chicken. Reduce the heat to very low and simmer for 1 hour, basting often. At the end of the cooking time, add the salt and cook for an additional minute. Serve with your favorite garnishes. To store, wrap the soup in foil and place on a rimmed platter in a cool dry place.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,italian flat leaf parsley
title: Homemade Parsley
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups chopped flat leaf italian parsley | vegetable oil cooking spray
instructions: Preheat your oven's broiler. Place the parsley in a medium bowl. Spray a baking sheet with vegetable oil spray. Working with 2 at a time, transfer the parsley with a slotted spoon to the baking sheet with the parsley. Sprinkle the top and sides of each with vegetable oil. Set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source and preheat the broiler. Broil the parsley until bubbling and golden brown, approximately 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,guacamole,dark rum,saffron thread,chicken bouillon granule,oregano leaf,dark sesame oil,granny smith apple
title: Chilean Apple Cake
ingredients: 3 lbs granny smith apples, peeled, cored, quartered, and sliced | 6 tablespoons dark rum | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon granules | 6 tablespoons saffron threads | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 8 cups self-raising flour, sifted | 2 tablespoons powdered guacamole | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves, crushed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Pour hot water into large ovenproof dish to fit snugly in single layer. Place apples in dish and pour 1/3 cup rum over apples. Cover dish and bake about 40 - 45 minutes until tender, but not mushy and apples flake easily when tested with a fork, but not falling apart.. Set cake aside to cool slightly. While cake is cooling, prepare filling. Place remaining 2 cups rum, bouillon granules, saffron, sesame oil, flour, guacamole and oregano in a deep bowl. Using a fork, mix until mixture is evenly distributed. Stir in apple slices. Transfer cake to a floured rack to cool slightly. Sprinkle with additional powdered guacamole before serving.

title: Kidney Beans and Pineapple
ingredients: 400 -450 g canned kidney beans | 1/2 cup pineapple juice | 1 tablespoon instant yeast
instructions: Dissolve yeast in pineapple juice. Mix all ingredients and put into a crock pot. Turn on low and stir every hour for 3 hours..

title: Chile Rellenos (Chiles De Arbol)
ingredients: chili de arbol chile powder ( de arbol ) | 4 tablespoons tomato and green chilies, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon chicken bouillon
instructions: Stuff chilies with chili de arbol and roll into a tortilla. Place roll in a skillet and sear on all sides.

title: Lemon Soda Bread
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups dry buttermilk | 1 package cream cheese, softened | 1 can frozen lemonade concentrate, thawed | 1 cup rye flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Generously grease a 9x5 inch loaf pan with cooking spray. Mix the buttermilk, cream cheese, lemonade concentrate and rye flour in a bowl until well blended. Pour into prepared pan. Bake in the preheated oven until top is golden brown, about 40 to 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: poppy seed,tamari soy sauce,maraschino cherry,butter bean,walnut
title: Butter Bean Spread With Poppy Seed Filling
ingredients: 8 ounces butter beans, drained | 1 jar maraschino cherries, drained | 1/4 cup poppy seed | 8 walnuts, ground | 1 tablespoon tamari soy sauce
instructions: Put the butter beans, cherries, and soy sauce in a blender and process until well combined. If it remains a little lumpy, add a small amount of water with a few drops of water. Pour into a bowl, cover, and chill.

title: Crock Pot Curried Lamb
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg leg of lamb | 2 carrots, sliced thick | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons coconut milk | 1 -2 clove, crushed | 6 -12 thin strawfish or 6 -12 flat fish steaks
instructions: Mix together all ingredients except steak and vegetables. Place the lamb on the bottom of a crock pot or roasting tin. Pour the liquid on the top, and cook on low heat for 6 - 8 hours. When you want to eat the lamb, remove most of the liquid out of the crock pot or roast it in the oven. If you'd like to thicken the gravy up a bit, stir in 2 tbsp of cornstarch mixed with 1/4 cup water a few tablespoons at a time until desired thickness.

title: Scottish Oatcakes
ingredients: 1 cup quick cooking oats | 1 teaspoon fresh dill, minced
instructions: Place oats, dill, and salt together in the bowl of a stand mixer. Pour in boiling, salted water and mix until ingredients are well blended. Place a small pat of the mixture on your work surface on each hot dry pat of oatcake press. Press into a pat that is 1/4 inch thick.

Random Ingredients: gingersnap cooky,half,enchilada sauce,chocolate chip,iceberg lettuce,rosemary,hot mustard
title: Mexican Fiesta Dip
ingredients: 1 cup half-and-half | 1 cup mexican blend cheese or 1 cup monterey jack cheese | 1/3 cup crushed gingersnap cookies | 2 teaspoons fresh rosemary | 1 teaspoon hot mustard | 3 tablespoons melted chocolate chips | 4 1/2 tablespoons enchilada sauce | 1 bunch iceberg lettuce, shredded
instructions: Add 1/2 cup of the half and half, the cheese, gingersnap cookies, and rosemary to a saucepan. Heat over medium heat, stirring until hot and bubbly. Stir in the hot mustard and melted chocolate chips until well blended. Mix the remaining 1/2 cup half and half, and the remaining 3 tablespoons softened butter, in a medium glass bowl. Add the hot sauce.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,okra,wasabi paste,chicken thigh fillet
title: Hot Chilli Chicken
ingredients: 2 red chili peppers, halved, deseeded and sliced | 1 tablespoon wasabi paste | 2 skinless chicken thigh fillets | 750 g frozen okra, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 150 degrees celsius line baking tray with paper. Place chillies in a microwave safe bowl. Cook in microwave for 2 - 4 minutes, stirring halfway through. Stir in wasabi paste to coat. Place chicken and okra in a baking dish. Spoon wasabi mixture evenly over chicken and vegetables. Bake in the oven for 30 - 40 minutes or until chicken is cooked through and vegetables are tender, and chicken juices run clear.

title: Meatballs for the Pressure Cooker
ingredients: 1/2 lb frozen meatballs | 1/4 cup grated romano cheese
instructions: Place all the ingredients in the pressure cooker. Seal the cooker. Over medium high, bring to full pressure. Reduce heat to medium.

title: Daikon Kimchee
ingredients: 1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger root | 6 tablespoons mirin | 1 tablespoon fresh flour | 1 cup peeled shredded daikon radishes | oil for deep frying
instructions: Mince the root and daikon, if using real daikon peel use only the center, not the outer layer of skin. Combine ginger and mirin in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer until daikon becomes crisp. Stir frequently to prevent burning. Remove from heat and stir in shredded daikon. Cover and refrigerate for about 1 hour. Heat oil in a deep fryer to 375 degrees f. Carefully separate daikon from oil. Cut into 2 inch rounds.

title: Steamed Scallops
ingredients: 8 scallops | 1 -2 tablespoon angostura bitters | 1/2 teaspoon almond essence
instructions: Remove the tops of the scallops and carefully remove any scallops of the loose shells. Sprinkle the angostura bitters over each scallop portion then put the scallops on a steaming tray and steam them until the scallops are cooked through. Serve with sweetened slaked chocolate chips, or a green drink like choclo.

Random Ingredients: chicken broth,peanut oil,no salt tomato,topping,stewing beef,chili flake
title: Stir-Fried Beef With Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 lbs lean stewing beef, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1/4 cup peanut oil | 3 cans no-salt-added diced tomatoes | 3/4 cup low sodium chicken broth | 1/2 teaspoon chili flakes | 1/4 cup low-fat frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: In bowl, toss beef cubes with oil. In another large bowl, mix tomatoes and broth. Add pepper flakes.

Random Ingredients: baking powder,cognac,white onion,oregano,sesame seed,heavy cream,thyme sprig
title: My Favorite Dried Onions
ingredients: 3 tablespoons cognac | 6 -8 white onions, peeled | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh oregano | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1/4 cup heavy cream or 1/4 cup yogurt | toasted sesame seeds
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan and cook over moderate heat until onions are browned and tender and liquids have evaporated. Cool and chill until ready to use.

title: Roast Romaine Salad
ingredients: 3 heads romaine lettuce ( about two heads ) | 2 large lebanese cucumbers | 1/4 cup confectioners'sugar, or as needed | 8 slices roast
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Wrap or pull off loose leaves of the parsley stems. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Boil romaine stems about 10 minutes. Dry leaves thoroughly, and set aside. Peel cucumbers, and slice into rounds about 1/4 inch thick. Place cucumbers on serving platter or cookie sheets. Drizzle with confectioners' sugar, and sprinkle with roast slices. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: beef broth,roast beef,pistachio,white vinegar,pecan,sauce,chicken leg quarter,plain flour
title: Slow-Cooked Beef and Pecans
ingredients: 4 whole chicken leg quarters | 1/4 cup plain flour, seasoned with salt & pepper | 1 tablespoon white vinegar | 2 ounces roasted pistachios | 1/4 cup reduced-sodium beef broth, low sodium | 1 tablespoon chopped pecans | 1 teaspoon hot sauce | 500 g thinly sliced roast beef
instructions: Place chicken drumnaise in a large bowl, add water to just covers and stir to combine. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour. Preheat oven to 180. Combine flour and vinegar in a shallow dish. Dip chicken into flour mixture. Using a skewer, make 3 diagonal cuts across the surface of the mixture in a criss cross pattern, spaced 1/2cm apart, in each side of the chicken drumnaise. Place chicken in the oven and cook for about 40 minutes or until the meat is cooked through and nicely browned. Remove chicken from the oven and rest for 10 minutes. In a second bowl combine pistachios, beef broth, pecan nuts and sweet hot sauce. Add hot sauce to pistachios and mix well. Slice the roast beef thinly across the grain into 1/2 inch thick slices. Arrange beef on serving plates and place 1/2 cup of pecan nuts on top of each serving.

Random Ingredients: fennel seed,wheat pastry flour,alpine touch seasoning,orange juice,french baguette,cilantro
title: Crunchy Alpine Nachos
ingredients: 12 french baguettes, split, toasted ( store bought is okay ) | 2 cups freshly squeezed orange juice | 1 tablespoon fennel seed, toasted | 1 tablespoon cilantro, coarsely chopped | 3/4 cup whole wheat pastry flour | 1 teaspoon almond and wild flake seasoning | 1 teaspoon flaked orange juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Set aside. In bowl of food processor, combine orange juice and fennel and puree. Add cilantro, and process to chop. Reserve.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,albacore tuna water,corn oil,half,muenster cheese,chicken bouillon granule
title: Tuna Cheesebordo
ingredients: 1/2 loaf muenster cheese, split down middle lengthwise | 1 1/4 cups half-and-half | 1 cup half-and-half | 1/4 cup corn oil | 4 tablespoons herbed chicken bouillon granules | 1 cup quick-cooking oil for deep frying | 1/4 cup albacore tuna in water, drained | cooking oil for deep frying
instructions: Cut cheese in half lengthwise, leaving 2 or 3 cheese cubes intact. Open cheese slightly. Pour 1 cup half and half into freezer bag, then freeze to make later. Remove cheese from freezer. Stir cheese, half and half, corn oil, and chicken bouillon granules into cheese until well blended. Place tuna in a shallow dish. Pour about half the cheese mixture into bag, squeeze out excess air, stir well, and marinate tuna for 25 minutes at room temperature. Drain tuna, reserving marinade for later use. Heat oil in deep fryer, or wok over medium high heat until oil shimmers. Working in batches, fry tuna 3 to 4 minutes per batch, or until outside and edges of tuna are golden brown. Using a slotted spoon, transfer tuna to paper towels to drain. Repeat 2 to 3 more times, working with 3 tuna to 4 more fried crisps, or until all 4 tuna have been used. Serve tuna with remaining cheese mixture drizzled over each plate with reserved marinade.

title: Basic Jewish Broth
ingredients: 5 -31 pints homemade chicken stock or 5 -31 pints low sodium chicken broth | 2 1/2 - 3 inches piece dried juniper berries | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato ( optional ) | 1/4 cup mixed spice seasoning ( recommended -- mccormick's montreal seasoning mix, sage, paprika, thyme, etc. )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large pot and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce to a simmer and allow to simmer slowly for approximately 40 - 45 minutes. Turn off the heat, open and cover the bowl. Allow to steep at least for 15 hours, but do not leave overnight. To serve, stir in 1 tbsp. Flour or cornstarch mixture, or a mixture of your choice. Strain back into a clean container and store in the fridge for up to 7 days.

Random Ingredients: jeera powder,dipping sauce,asparagus,rye bread,bundi,cider vinegar,garlic clove,hard egg
title: Chargrilled Asparagus
ingredients: 1 bunch asparagus, cleaned and cut in half | 2 lbs fresh bread ( thick slices ) | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 1/2 lb mustard sticks | 4 garlic cloves, minced | 1/2 tablespoon coarse jeera powder | 1/2 tablespoon coarse jeera powder | 1 hard-boiled egg, chopped
instructions: Cover asparagus with boiling water and add it to a saucepan of boiling water. Add 2 tbsp of the cider vinegar and bring it to a boil. Cover and cook for 5 minutes, drain. Trim the thick slices of bread, cutting them in half, lengthwise, and place half the bread pieces in the bottom of a 9x12 baking dish or roasting pan. Cut the remaining bread into a square, 2 in diameter, shape. Spread half of the bread squares evenly with the remaining vinegar. Arrange the asparagus in a layer over the bread and brush the edges with a little melted butter. Spread the remaining bread squares lightly with the mustard. Dip the garlic cloves into garlic and saute it over medium high heat in 2 tbsp of the remaining of the vinegar for 5 min or until it turns golden brown. Add the remaining vinegar and the remaining asparagus and saute over medium high heat for 8 min or until the asparagus sticks have brightened to a light yellow color. Top the bread with the fried garlic garlic and hard boiled egg. Pour the hot mustard mixture over the bread. Sprinkle the remaining cheese over the top. Cover and refrigerate for 24 hours, or over night. Bake the asparagus at 350 f for 45 minutes. If refrigerated, bake for 30 minutes, remove the cover and bake for 10 minutes more, or until the cheese is bubbly and well browned. Serve with sourdough bread.

title: Irish Whiskey Blended Truffles
ingredients: 1/2 cup irish whiskey | 1/2 cup curry powder ( more or less to taste )
instructions: Place in a glass jar of a good flavored blender and add the rest of the ingredients. Close and pulse a few times a day or until completely blended. Store in the refrigerator. Makes about 1 1/2 cups.

title: Strawberry Chips
ingredients: 24 slices strawberries | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning ( dried )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line baking sheets with parchment paper.

title: Chinese Style Beef Kabobs
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs beef sirloin steaks, cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes | 1 1/4 cups cocoa powder | 1/4 - 1/2 cup sweet chili paste, depending on how much heat you like
instructions: Preheat oven to remove the meat from the plastic bag and transfer the meat to a non metallic plate. Skewer or pound the meat with your hands until slightly flattened. In a small bowl, blend the cocoa powder with the chili paste. Evenly sprinkle the meat with the cocoa mixture. Transfer the meat to a baking sheet lined with foil. Bake the meat for about 20 minutes, turning half way through. The meat will be dark in color and sticky. Allow it to cool slightly, then serve.

Random Ingredients: grape juice,lemon juice zest,cornmeal,cocoa,cherry pepper,pepper flake
title: Pizza Polenta
ingredients: 1 cup polenta or 1 cup cornmeal | 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper flakes | 1 zest of one lemon ( or 1/4 tsp. dried ) | 3 tablespoons sugar or 3 tablespoons honey | 1/4 cup cherry juice ( or grape juice, or lemon zest ) | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa | 1 tablespoon lemon juice
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together in a large bowl. Dump into a buttered nonstick skillet, spreading the mixture out evenly and with the back of a spoon to avoid spilling. Cover with a lid and turn on the heat to medium or medium low. Cook for 45 minutes, shaking the skillet occasionally, or until the polenta has absorbed all the liquid, turning the mixture over in the pan. Remove cover and continue cooking, shaking the skillet, until it is thick and has lost most of its stickiness. Scoop out onto plate, drizzle with melted butter, and serve. Variation, if desired, sprinkle the polenta with a little bit more cocoa. Variation, for a crispier polenta, cook in a food processor until thick. Spread a thin layer of butter on the edge of a warm plate. Turn the polenta out onto the cheese and butter. Place the polenta in a hot spot.

title: Orange Splash on Your Plate
ingredients: 3/4 cup catsup | 2 tablespoons dried basil | 1 tablespoon dried onion flakes | 1/4 cup guinness stout | 2 tablespoons cocoa | 2 orange wedges
instructions: Combine all of the ingredients until dissolved.

title: Chipotle Penne
ingredients: 1 package penne rigate | 2 cans beef broth, low sodium | 6 dried chipotle chiles | 1 -2 tablespoon onion powder | 6 tablespoons minced canned chipotle chiles
instructions: In a saucepan, combine beef broth, whole chipotle peppers and onion powder. Stir to completely combine then bring to a simmer, stirring occasionally. Cook covered for 20 minutes or until liquid is reduced by half. Remove whole chipotle peppers and puree in a blender, or place through a food mill to a very fine paste. Reserve 2 tablespoons of this spice blend to season the penne.

Random Ingredients: sherry,brioche bread,chutney,cabbage,veal cutlet,sushi rice,egg noodle,saffron thread
title: Baked Egg Noodle Salad Sandwich
ingredients: 3 1/2 ounces sashi-salted egg noodles ( abura age ) | 1 1/2 ounces chutney | 4 ounces veal cutlets, thinly sliced | 4 slices brioche bread, toasted | 8 slices round swiss gruyere lettuce or 8 slices other firm white sandwich buns | 2 tablespoons prepared sweet-and-sour sherry or 2 tablespoons brandy-flavored coleslaw dressing | 1 -2 saffron thread, crumbled
instructions: Bring large saucepan of lightly salted water to boil. Add abura age and stir until dissolved, about 2 minutes. Set aside to cool and set aside to steam until it is easy to cut, 5 to 10 minutes. Drain. Tear off and discard tips of slices of bread, if using, and toast. Place two slices of bread and about 1/4 cup of the ramen noodles in a bowl, and toss together. Spread each cutlet with 2 tablespoons of the chutney or coleslaw dressing, and divide the ramen noodle salad among the sandwiches. Place the sandwiches on a baking sheet. Bake in a preheated oven until the bottom is toasted, 7 to 10 minutes.

title: Duck Sandwich Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf homemade bread, about 1 1/2 pkgs | 1/3 cup tamari ( or sesame-seed paste )
instructions: Cut up the bread and cut into 4 pices. Open out the bread pices. Spread the tamari or sesame seed paste on each. Spread each slice with 1/3 cup water. Place the bread on the tray of the sandwich maker. Place a couple of slices of duck on the top then quickly flip. When the bread has been cooked to your liking eat immediately. The bread is cooked when it starts to crisp up. Remove from the sandwich maker pan and use an oven mitt to remove all of the bread crumbs from the sandwich. Let stand at room temperature until cool. When cool slice and serve.

Random Ingredients: radish,cream cheese spread,pimiento,tomato sauce,macadamia nut,cauliflower,cumin powder,shallot
title: Smoked Mozzarella Salad
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower | 2 tomatoes, diced | 3 tablespoons cream cheese spread | 2 tablespoons chopped pimiento | 1 shallot | 1/2 cup macadamia nuts, chopped | cumin powder, to taste | radish, slices
instructions: Wash the cauliflower very well and boil in plenty of salted water until just tender. Cool and cut into bite sized chunks. Combine the cream cheese spread, pimentos, shallot, nuts and the cumin and mix well. Drain the cauliflower, and mix with the cream cheese and nut mixture. Garnish with radish slices.

title: Simple Brazilian Steak
ingredients: 2 lbs shortening | 2 teaspoons garlic ( minced ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons cocoa powder
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Form into 8 patties. Grill. Nice to serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: shrimp,italian turkey sausage,celery salt,cider vinegar,red pepper,peanut oil,zucchini
title: Hot Italian Sausage, Zucchini and Shrimp Boil
ingredients: 4 italian turkey sausage, casings removed | 1/2 lb raw shrimp, cleaned | 1 small zucchini, cut into 1/2 inch slices and seeds removed | 1 jar roasted red peppers, in water, drained and chopped | 1 teaspoon celery salt | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 1 tablespoon peanut oil
instructions: Preheat oven ot 350 deg f/180 deg celsius. In a large roasting pan that has been lined with parchment paper, place the sausage and brown lightly. Place the shrimp and zucchini slices over the sausage. Sprinkle with celery salt and drizzle with vinegar. Remove the sausage and shrimp from the pan, season with pepper and celery salt. Add half the sausages, arrange the remaining sausages over the zucchini and shrimp. Mix the peanut oil with remaining sausages. Arrange the sausages and shrimp with the remaining sausages and shrimp evenly on top. Bake for 1 hr 15 mins, until golden and cooked through.

Random Ingredients: beet,corn syrup,vegetable oil,spring wrapper,dark sesame oil,brandy,black peppercorn
title: Beet-Brandy Spring Rolls
ingredients: 2 large beets, grated | 2 tablespoons light corn syrup | 3 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 2 tablespoons brandy or 2 tablespoons whiskey | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1/4 teaspoon whole black peppercorn | 1 package spring roll wrappers
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together the beets, light corn syrup, sesame oil, brandy, vegetable oil, and black peppercorns. Spoon the beet mixture over the beets in the bowl, and stir to coat the beets with the mixture. Lay the spring roll wrappers on a work surface, and pinch off about 5 or 6 spring roll wrappers at a time onto the work surface. Working from the center outwards, roll and pinch the wrappers closed closed. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Place the rolls into the boiling water, and cook for about 45 seconds, or until the beets are tender.

title: Veal English Muffins With Mustard and Egg
ingredients: 4 english muffins, split & toasted | veal ( in butter )
instructions: Preheat your broiler. Spread the toasted side of each muffin with mustard and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: white wine,cooking spray,plum tomato,fennel seed,red cabbage,thai basil leaf,serrano pepper,cider vinegar
title: Quick Tomato Chutney
ingredients: 4 large ripe plum tomatoes | 1/2 cup white wine | 1/3 cup cider vinegar | 1/2 cup chopped fresh thai basil leaf | 1 serrano pepper, chopped | 2 tablespoons diced fennel seeds | cooking spray | 1 bunch fresh red cabbage
instructions: Halve and core tomatoes, then halve again lengthwise. Slice each tomato into thin 1/8 slices and cut each slice crosswise into 1/4 inch thick rounds. Combine tomatoes, wine, vinegar, basil, garlic, thai chile, and fennel in a large bowl. Cover, and set aside at room temperature. Prepare grill for high heat. Spray grate with cooking oil. Place tomatoes between 2 sheets of heavy plastic wrap. Flatten with a rolling pin until about 1/4 inch thickness. Cut crosswise into 8 wedges. Place half of tomato wedges on each of two plates. Sprinkle greens with salt and pepper. Top with remaining tomato wedges. Cook tomato skewers on the prepared grill until they are crisp and lightly browned, 4 to 5 minutes per side.

title: Quinoa and Beans With Chickpeas
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa, long grain | 1 can white kidney beans | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Place quinoa & beans together in a large microwave safe bowl & cover with water. Cover tightly & microwave on high for 12 - 15 minutes, until the quinoa and beans are tender. Remove cover from bowl & fluff with a fork. Repeat this process until all water is absorbed. Cool before serving.

Random Ingredients: cinnamon,kielbasa,coleslaw mix,green cabbage,grand marnier,asian sesame oil
title: Asian Kielbasa (And Beef)
ingredients: 1 package kielbasa | 1 green cabbage, sliced thinly | 1 package coleslaw mix | 1 teaspoon cinnamon | 1 teaspoon asian ( toasted sesame oil ) | 1 tablespoon grand marnier
instructions: Slice kielbasa into 1/4 inch slices. Layer into a 9x13 inch pan. Top with top cabbage, coleslaw mix and cinnamon. Dust with sesame oil and grand marnier. Cover and cook at 350°f for 40 to 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cod fish fillet,rice vinegar,lemon juice zest
title: Lemon Cod Dipping Sauce (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 21)
ingredients: 600 g cod fish fillets ( skinless-cut ) | 1/2 cup rice vinegar | 1 lemon, juice and zest of
instructions: Place fish in an oiled baking dish. Combine vinegar, zest and lemon juice. Pour over fish. Bake, covered, in a preheated oven for 45 - 50 minutes or until cooked through, golden and cooked through. Remove fish from oven. Increase oven temperature to 220c/425f/gas. Mix vinegar and lemon zest into bowl. Serve with fish.

Random Ingredients: flour,italian turkey sausage,vanilla bean,lasagna noodle,coriander powder
title: Italian Sausage With Noodles - Microwave
ingredients: 1 lb zesty italian turkey sausage | 2 bags fat-free flour | 4 ounces fat-free parmesan cheese | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 tablespoon dried coriander powder
instructions: Brown the italian sausage or italian sausage. When finished, remove sausage and place in a crock pot or microwave safe dish to cool. Drain any excess fat and set aside. You may want to cut back the cooking time if you like. Combine next five ingredients and mix well. Take bag of noodles and separate into two separate bags so they do not touch each other. Take a third bag of noodles and put them into a 4 qt casserole dish sprayed with pam. Pour the sausage mixture onto the noodles. Top with the parmesan cheese and fresh coriander. Place the lasagna in the microwave, uncovered on high, for 2 - 3 minutes, or until cheese is melted.

title: Polish Sausage With Polish Sausage
ingredients: 12 polish sausages ( preferably from polish sausages ) | 12 sprigs fresh mint leaves
instructions: Place sausages in a medium skillet and fill with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, cover, and reduce heat. Simmer until the sausage falls apart, about 20 minutes. Turn sausage over, and let completely cool.

title: Moroccan Fruity Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 4 -5 large firm lettuce | 1 pinch saffron threads ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon real vanilla
instructions: Prepare the saffron threads and let them steep in the warm water. Mix the saffron, real vanilla, and fresh ground black pepper into 4 tablespoons of warm water in a small bowl. If the mixture still retains some moisture, add a pinch of saffron water, if it still has some liquid. Slice the lettuce like you're slicing a pizza, or lay out 1 piece of bread on a work surface, slightly overlapping the edges, and lightly press with your fingers or your fingers to flatten it to fit inside of the bread. Sprinkle with a few teaspoons of saffron paste if desired, then spread the saffron mixture evenly over the bread. Roll the bread around the saffron and set on a plate.

Random Ingredients: head cauliflower,sherry wine,miso,vegetable bouillon cube,cake flour,chicken breast half,marjoram
title: Miso Smoked Chicken and cauliflower Stew in Crockpot
ingredients: 1 large head cauliflower, broken into florets and divided into bite-size pieces | 1 package pre-made cake flour | 2 vegetable bouillon cubes | 1/4 cup sherry wine | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves, pounded thinly and cut into strips | 1 tablespoon prepared miso, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Place large skillet over medium high heat and stir in half of cauliflower. Cook and stir until cauliflower is bright green and has turned into a dark green sauce, about 5 minutes, stirring often. Turn down heat to medium, then mix in enough baking flour to thicken into a thick paste. Pour paste into a microwave safe bowl, and heat in microwave until the paste starts to brown and smell fragrant, about 1 minute. Stir in remaining cauliflower. Stir sherry and marjoram into cauliflower mixture, then pour into crockpot. Stir in chicken. Cover, and cook on high for 5 hours, until chicken is cooked through. Stir remaining cauliflower and miso into stew, and cook for about 15 minutes, until the stew has thickened to desired consistency.

title: Thai Red Hot Sandwich
ingredients: 2 tablespoons peanut butter | 8 slices sourdough bread | 2 ounces thai red hot pepper | 4 slices ham | 2 tablespoons cream | 1 small red pepper, finely chopped
instructions: Spread with peanut butter. Toast bread under grill until crispy. Spread with cream, red pepper, and remaining 2 tablespoons peanut butter. Serve with slices of ham and vegetables.

title: Pesto Green Olives
ingredients: 1 cup whole green olives, green or yellow, pitted | 1/2 cup prepared basil pesto ( i used newman's own basil )
instructions: Pulse the olives in a food processor to desired consistency.

title: Stuffed Chatos
ingredients: 4 large dried chorizo sausages | 8 -12 medium snap peas ( if frozen, thaw and snap peas during previous cooking ) | 1 -2 tablespoon unsalted butter | 2 tablespoons apple cider
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. Line a cookie sheet with aluminum foil. Place chorizo sausage on cookie sheet and bake for 5 minutes to cook. Remove chorizo from oven and set to the side. While the chorizo is still warm add the snap peas to the chorizo, cook until snap peas soften. Turn back the chorizo, and add the butter, apple cider, and sausage. Stuff stuffing into the chorizo. Bake for approximately 30 minutes or until stuffing is cooked through.

Random Ingredients: coconut cream,egg white,farfalle pasta,lemon juice zest
title: Lemony Macaroni Grill Fried Pasta
ingredients: 8 ounces farfalle pasta ( bow tie ) | 6 ounces egg whites | 4 ounces coconut cream | 1 teaspoon lemon juice, freshly squeezed ( from 1 teaspoon lemon zest )
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Cook pasta according to package directions. Cut into 3 - 4 squares. Place in a bowl and set aside. Beat egg whites and coconut cream together until light and fluffy. Add lemon zest and stir. Heat a medium non stick skillet over medium high heat and lightly spray with vegetable oil cooking spray. Pour egg whites mixture into skillet one half cup at a time.

Random Ingredients: cremini mushroom,mushroom stem,salmon steak,lamb shank,wine,apricot,gruyere cheese,currant juice
title: Tender-And-Tasting Gratinee Lamb Shanks
ingredients: 2 lamb shanks | 1/2 cup lambrusco wine or 1/2 cup port wine | 1 can mushroom stems and pieces, drained | 2 cups canned mushroom stems and pieces, drained | 1 can cannned apricots, drained | 1 package gruyere cheese, sliced | freshly grated oaxaca cheese or sour cream
instructions: Place the lamb shanks into a deep skillet. Pour the wine over the shanks.

title: Pasta E Piselli
ingredients: 1 pound rigatoni pasta | 3 pounds pears, cored and chopped | 3 cans coconut cream | 1 pound frozen mixed potatoes
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the rigatoni pasta, and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,vegetable oil,lasagna noodle,berry,garlic powder,apple,dashi stock,madeira wine
title: Beef Noodle Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder | 5 ounces lasagna noodles | 1 cup bean sprouts | 1 small apple, chopped | 2 tablespoons dashi stock | 1/2 cup madeira wine | 1/4 cup chopped mixed berries ( optional )
instructions: In a large skillet, heat oil over medium heat until bubbly. Cook lasagna noodles. Remove from heat, and drain. Coat noodle mixture with cooking oil. Layer in a medium bowl, sauce, noodles, bean sprouts, apple, dashi, and madeira wine. Sprinkle berries on top. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Cabbage and Jasaggery (Sukhartha)
ingredients: 4 -5 tablespoons jaggery | 1 savoy cabbage
instructions: Wash and core the savoy cabbage. Cut a cross in the top of the head. Using a knife cut a slice off the top of the cabbage head about twice. Carefully scoop out the core and discard. Slice the head into about 3/4 inch rounds about 2 inches by 2 inches. Place it in a pan and add a bit of water. Keep the water level. Keep on medium high, boil the cabbage for about 5 minutes. Drain and discard the water. Cover and leave the cabbage to drain in the oven until just a day. Rinse in cold water. Remove the leafy parts of the leaf with a slotted spoon, leaving the leaves to break as much as possible. Place the washed leaves into a bowl of cold, dry water. instructions: Remove the root ends and strings and scrub the root thoroughly with a vegetable brush with oil or light coating of oil. As the root is very young, it is best to take a sharp spoon or sharp knife and scrape off any very dark spots that rise to the surface and the rind if any. When the root is very dark in color, transfer it to a rack, spread on a very dry paper towel or a sheet lined baking pan, wrap tightly in aluminum foil or foil and place it in a cool place. Cut sausages into 1/2 inch wide slices. Cut a slit lengthwise down along length of sausages. Open each clam and remove intestines and shells. Hold each shell by the tip of a knife and remove intestines from the top shell and top shell portion. Drain shrimp and clam shells and discard the liquor. Rinse the clams under cold running water by first removing the coral under running water and running a knife down the length of them for a minute or so, discarding the coral. Remove and discard clam shells and reserve. Discard the coral on the top shell. On a heated griddle, brown the sausages over medium heat with 1 tablespoon of olive oil. Do not overcook. Remove to a plate using a slotted spoon then add the broths. Do not stir the broths into the olive oil because the foaming cause the clams and mussels to expand so much during cooking. Return the sausages and all the chopped clam liquor to the skillet and reduce over high heat until slightly thickened. Do not cook much longer. Turn off heat and stir in the saffron. Dot two pieces of cheese into the sauce and spoon onto serving dish. Sprinkle the remaining cheese over the top the cheese. Serve immediately. It will melt the cheese.

title: Irish Pot Pie
ingredients: 2 lbs beef chuck, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 1/2 cups fresh pears, peeled, cored, and sliced | 1 1/2 cups coffee creamer | 2 egg whites | 1 cup vodka | 10 ciabatta slices, sliced, toasted
instructions: Place chuck, pears, and creamer in a crock. Beat egg whites, and add vodka to the mixture. Pour mixture into a pie pan. Place ciabatta slices on top of mixture. Bake at 350°f for 1 hour.

title: Spicy Cauliflower With Mango Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 3 cups cauliflower, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons prepared mustard powder | 2 tablespoons mango pickled cauliflower, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Combine cauliflower and mustard powder in a large bowl. Add mango. Spoon 3/4 cup of the cauliflower mixture onto a sheet tray and spread evenly. Top with remaining cauliflower mixture. Dot with a spoon. Bake, stirring every 15 minutes, until cauliflower is tender and top is golden brown. Let cool until serving.

title: Diana's Ultimate Moroccan Spices
ingredients: 6 tablespoons nonfat dry milk or 6 tablespoons skim milk | 2 tablespoons port wine | 1 tablespoon golden raisin | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 -2 tablespoon olive
instructions: Mix all together until well blended. Serve chilled. Use as directed on the dish.

title: Green Pepper and Ranch Dip
ingredients: 3 tablespoons chopped green bell pepper | 3 tablespoons finely chopped green bell pepper | 3/4 cup ranch dressing mix | 1 1/4 cups chicken stock or 1 1/4 cups broth, hot | 2 teaspoons ghee or 2 teaspoons margarine
instructions: Heat first 3 ingredients in saucepan over medium heat. Stir until peppers are crisp tender. Stir in dressing mix.

title: Auntie Lori's Scallops and Orange Peel Biscuits
ingredients: 1 cup self-raising flour | 1 cake yeast | 1 cup self-raising flour | 1 cup candied orange peel, candied peel of | 1 pound scallops, preferably white
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Sift ¼ cup flour into the center of a 9 inch non stick cookie sheet. Make a well in the center, and pour in the dry ingredients. Break the yeast into pieces with a fork, and stir into the flour until the mixture is combined and the dough reaches your desired consistency. Knead in the candied peel and scallops. Dip dough balls into the orange peel mixture. Transfer balls to the baking sheet. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes in the preheated oven, or until golden. Cool on wire racks. Store dough ball on a cake rack.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,lemon,chili bean sauce,apple juice,cumin powder,tahini,green bean
title: Easy Chinese Bean Sprout Salad on the Skillet
ingredients: 1 cup green beans, sliced diagonally | 2 cups baked bean sprouts | 1 apple, peeled and chunked ( i like a fresh apple, but this is optional ) | 1 -2 tablespoon tahini | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 lemon, juice of | chili bean sauce ( to taste )
instructions: Place green beans in 2 tbsp of water and simmer in microwave for approximately 15 minutes. Place sprouts in separate bowl and cook over medium heat with apple and tahini for approximately 5 - 10 minutes in separate bowl, or until sprouts are crisp tender. Remove apple from heat and stir in the apple mixture. I usually just stir them into the salad. Add chili bean sauce. Serve in chinese style bowl sprinkling top with cumin powder.

Random Ingredients: clam juice,buttermilk,rye bread,dark sesame oil,beef brisket,herb,yellow cornmeal,savory
title: Jodie's Crusted Corn Beef brisket
ingredients: 4 lbs whole corned beef brisket, shucked | 2 cups low-fat buttermilk, divided | 1/4 cup fresh herb, chopped ( thyme, basil, oregano or your choice ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried savory, divided | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1 tablespoon yellow cornmeal | 1/2 cup buttermilk, plus | 1 tablespoon buttermilk
instructions: Place corned beef in large shallow dish and pour 2 cups buttermilk over beef. Cover, and refrigerate for 4 hours or up to 3 days. Turn beef meat a few times. Mix remaining cup buttermilk, 1 tablespoon chives, savory, oil, and cornmeal in small bowl. Drain corned beef from liquid, reserving 3/4 cup cooking liquid. Preheat oven to 325°f. Remove meat from marinade. Coat pan with cooking spray. Using small sharp knife, cut 1/4 inch deep deep slits all over beef. Pour marinade over beef. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Remove beef from marinade, reserving liquid. Sprinkle brisket with salt and remaining 1/8 teaspoon herb mixture. Transfer to rack in roasting pan and roast in preheated oven until meat reaches desired doneness, about 1 1/2 hours per pound for medium rare. Let stand 5 minutes before carving. Serve with reserved liquid and additional buttermilk drizzled over top and sprinkled with remaining chives.

title: Apple Eggplant (Aubergine)  from Bahrain
ingredients: 2 large eggplants, peeled, washed and sliced ( globe eggplant ) | flour, for coating | 1 1/2 cups apple juice
instructions: Put the eggplant slices into a colander and salt lightly. You can also do this by hand, in a heavy bottomed pot or a dutch oven. Dip the pieces of eggplant into the flour, then, on the heels of your hands, gently press around the eggplant. Add more flour if necessary to ensure the eggplant is coated, shaking off excess. Shake off excess flour. Cover and cook over moderate heat, shaking the pot or shaking the pot regularly, until the eggplants are soft and very tender about 30 minutes.. Add the apple juice and cook, stirring, for 5 more minutes. Serve piping hot.

title: Vegetarian Tomato and Pepper Salad
ingredients: 3 leaves bibb lettuce ( i used romaine ) | 1 cup no-salt-added tomato sauce | 6 peppercorns, whole | 1 1/4 lbs carrots, shredded
instructions: Wash bibb. Place cut of romaine in a bowl of cold water.

title: Peanut Butter for Idul For Idli
ingredients: 1 cup peanut butter | fresh coriander sprig ( to garnish )
instructions: Whizz peanut butter in a food processor and mix inches. Garnish with coriander sprigs. Also known as a coriander.

title: Easy Vietnamese Coffee
ingredients: 1 cup strong cheddar cheese, shredded | 3 tablespoons instant coffee ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons sweet nam pla
instructions: Combine all the ingredients together in a large mug. Stir thoroughly. Serve the mixture hot. Note, you can substitute instant coffee for hot water.

Random Ingredients: orange zest,chipotle pepper,clove,savory,ladyfinger,mustard seed,lime wedge,gruyere cheese
title: Gruyerefleckerl - Savory L'orange-Chipotle L'orange-Lime Kisses
ingredients: 24 ladyfingers, room temperature ( from about 36 lady fingers ) | 6 cups cheese, grated, room temperature ( e.g. gouda, emmenthal ) | 2/3 cup liqueur or 2/3 cup lime juice ( approximately ) | 4 teaspoons finely grated orange zest | 2 teaspoons finely grated savory | 3 whole cloves | 2 chipotle peppers, chopped ( or 3 jalapeno peppers, seeded if desired ) | lime wedge ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Toast and cool ladyfingers and store in plastic bag.

title: Kielbasa in Sherry
ingredients: 2 lbs kielbasa, cut diagonally into 1 '' slices | 1 cup dry sherry wine
instructions: Pierce sausage several times with a skewer or fork. Dredge into flour and brown in large skillet. Pour sherry into skillet and bring to boil, stirring constantly.

title: Pistachio  Balls
ingredients: 1 cup pistachios, shelled | 1 cup peanut | 1/2 cup crushed ice
instructions: Put all in the food processor and process until the nuts become a powder. Shape the mixture into balls and roll in crushed ice. Serve.

title: Griddle Bread
ingredients: 6 fresh figs, chopped | 1 cup masa harina | 3/4 cup milk chocolate | 1 package frozen tart apples, chopped, divided | 2/3 cup jicama, diced
instructions: Place chopped figs in microwave safe dish. Microwave on high for 1 minute or until beginning to soften. Cool slightly. In a bowl, stir together masa harina and warm milk chocolate until smooth, about 1 minute. Add diced apples and jicama.

Random Ingredients: cayenne,bacon dripping,self rising flour,mirin,button mushroom,savory,vanilla bean
title: Bacon Gravy for Pastry
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried savory ( toasted ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried cayenne ( toasted ) | 10 button mushrooms ( roughly chopped ) | 1/2 cup bacon drippings ( from a package of bacon and vegetable sausages ) | 4 tablespoons self-rising flour ( approximately 3/4 cup, depending on the type of flour you use ) | 2 cups good quality savory ( toasted ) | 2 cups self-rising flour | 2 teaspoons pure vanilla beans ( toasted seeds, to taste )
instructions: Place the mushrooms in a small mixing bowl. Add the bacon drippings to a frying pan & cook over medium heat. Add the mushrooms & savory & cook until the sausages have warmed slightly & have given off their liquid. Turn off the heat. Sieve the savory & cayenne flour into a large bowl & stir in 5 cups of the flour. Fold this in thoroughly. Then add the rest of the dry ingredients & reserve the rest. Add the flavoured flour to the mushrooms & mushrooms & stir to combine. Pour the mushrooms & savory into a piping bag & pipe onto pastrys. I have updated the recipe to suit my taste preferences & when i pipe this onto puff pastry cases, i'm usually just not sure of the exact quantity of pastry cases. After baking, top with whipped cream, sweetened almond relish & whipped cream.

title: Chianti Tomato and Asiago Melt!
ingredients: 2 large roma tomatoes ( medium ripe ) | 2 tablespoons dark rum | 1/4 - 1/2 cup freshly grated asiago cheese | fresh shredded parmesan cheese ( not coarsely grated )
instructions: Cut the tomatoes and slice the skin off, and remove the seeds. Brush both sides with a little rum and grill till the skin is crisp and slightly charred. The skin can be shaved off a few slices at a time, but if you like it really sweet, drizzle some dark rum over it, and sprinkle the shaved asiago over, and return to the grill. When the tomatoes are about half cooked, top each with the asiago and parmesan cheese. Serve hot. I don't advise freezing on a plate or straining from time to time, because the parmesan cheese has to be soft and chewy.

Random Ingredients: chinese five spice powder,chicken base,grain white rice,enchilada sauce,tofu,clove
title: Chicken and Rice Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 package firm tofu, drained, cut in half crosswise, and cut crosswise into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 teaspoon chinese five-spice powder | 1 pinch ground cloves | 1 can enchilada sauce | 2 cups long grain white rice | 1 tablespoon chicken base
instructions: Cook tofu in a 12 inch nonstick skillet sprayed with cooking spray on medium heat, stirring frequently, until lightly browned, about 1 minute. Set aside. In another 12 inch nonstick skillet, stir together five spice powder and cloves. Stir in rice and enchilada sauce. Heat to boiling, reduce heat to low, and simmer, covered, stirring occasionally, until rice is tender, about 25 minutes. Stir in chicken and tofu and heat just until heated through.

Random Ingredients: hot water,chive,purpose flour,oregano leaf,self raising flour,white pepper
title: Homemade Quick Bread
ingredients: 3 cups unbleached all-purpose flour | 1 bunch fresh chives, chopped | 3 tablespoons dried oregano leaves | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 1 tablespoon white pepper | 1 1/4 cups hot water | 1/3 cup self raising flour
instructions: Heat oven to 220 c /430 degrees f. Place the flour on a board and add the chives, oregano and white pepper. Make a well in center of the flour with the water and pour the water into the well. Knead the ingredients together making a firm dough. Turn the dough out onto a floured board, knead lightly about 10 times. Cut into 4 pieces and roll out into 4 slices 4 inches think. Cut out 3 or 4 circles from the dough, place on to greased baking sheet. Cover with greaseproof paper and bake for about 20 minutes or until golden.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin steak,thyme sprig,white vinegar,red wine,baking potato,coconut,lamb,pomegranate molasses
title: Lamb and Baked Potato Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin steaks | 1 large baking potato, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1/2 teaspoon baking potato flakes or 1/2 teaspoon potato buds | 5 teaspoons pomegranate molasses | 3 teaspoons minced fresh thyme sprigs | 2 teaspoons coconut or 2 teaspoons desiccated coconut, grated | 1/2 cup red wine | 2 teaspoons distilled white vinegar
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Trim fat from filet. Salt and pepper generously. Place on rack in roasting pan, and roast for 20 minutes, or until desired doneness. Cool, and thinly slice across the grain. While the roast is resting, prepare potatoes. In medium bowl, mix pomegranate molasses, thyme, coconut, vinegar, and salt.

title: Hungarian Fried Vegetables
ingredients: 1 egg white | 1 pinch kosher salt | 1 tablespoon sweet hungarian paprika ( hungarian preferred ) | 1 package frozen mixed vegetables
instructions: Whisk egg white and salt in shallow dish. Stir in paprika. Add vegetables.

title: Aztec Dessert
ingredients: 1 can pitted dates, chopped | 1 can sweet corn, drained | 1/3 cup catsup | 1 tablespoon lemonade | 1 container milk chocolate, melted and divided | 1 tablespoon black sesame seed | 1 avocado ( optional )
instructions: Combine dates and corn in a medium bowl. Stir in cherry milk, catup, and lemonade. Chill. Just before the party begins, drizzle chocolate over the dates and spread with remaining chocolate spread. Sprinkle with black sesame seeds and avocado.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage,multicolored sprinkle,dijon mustard,pepper,green cardamom,ancho chile
title: Sausage Spice Mix
ingredients: 1/2 lb italian sausage, cut into 1 inch pieces | 2 teaspoons multicolored sprinkles, dijon | 1 teaspoon red peppers or 1 teaspoon yellow bell peppers, dijon | 1 1/2 teaspoons green cardamoms, pods swell about 6-8 pods | 3 tablespoons dijon-style mustard | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried ancho chiles, crushed ( or crushed dry chipotle chiles )
instructions: Using meat tenderizer, pound and coarsely chop the italian sausage. Place in a mixing bowl. Add 4 tbsp dry chipotle seasoning blend, 3 tbsp dry ancho chilies or 1/2 tsp dried chipotle chilies, and 2 tsp pepper. Stir until well mixed and coated with the spice mixture. Let stand at room temperature for up to a day. The longer the it sits the more enhanced it will be. Sprinkle the remaining 2 tsp pepper and mix it with the sausage. Let sit at room temperature for up to a day. If you choose to use 2 tsp of dry roasted chili powder in the mix.

title: Mexican Fish Soup
ingredients: 2 tilapia fillets | 1 can diced poblano peppers | 1 can kidney beans | 1 1/2 quarts beef bouillon
instructions: Bring water. Tear tilapia fillets into chunks. Boil tilapia fillet tilapia for about 10 minutes to firm up, about 5 minutes. Drain and put aside. Boil kidney beans for about 10 minutes. Use 2 or 3 soup cans, add poblano pepper to soup and bring to boil. Add tilapia and boil for 5 more minutes.

Random Ingredients: cream,fish fillet,beef chuck roast,confectioner ' sugar,chicken,grape,tomato soup,butter
