title: Italian Beef Pot
ingredients: 4 -6 lbs beef chuck roast with bones | 3 teaspoons butter or 3 teaspoons extra virgin olive oil | 2 cans condensed tomato soup, undiluted ( or equivalent amount of soup and water ) | 1 lb stewing beef, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 jar grape ( drained ) | 1/4 cup sour cream or 1/4 cup plain yogurt | confectioners'sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 325f degrees. Cut the stew meat into 1 inch cubes and heat oil over medium high heat in a dutch oven or ovenproof kettle. Saute meat until lightly brown on outside but still pink inside. Pour tomato soup over meat. Add meat and vegetables to soup. Cover and bake in oven for 90 minutes. Uncover and bake for 5 more hours. Remove meat and vegetables to a platter and skim off some of the fat. Return vegetables to the pot. Stir in sour cream and sprinkle with confectioners' sugar. Serve with your favourite cheese or eat plain. Also great cold as a meat or pork dish.

Random Ingredients: enchilada sauce,bay leaf,flat leaf parsley,balsamic vinegar,serrano pepper,dill,chocolate
title: Mexican Chocolate and Balsamic Glaze
ingredients: 16 ounces bittersweet chocolate ( for baking, chopped into small pieces, about 2.5 oz ) | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 1 jar enchilada sauce ( or other brand of spicy enchilada sauce ) | 1 fresh bay leaf | 1/2 cup minced flat leaf parsley | 1/2 cup minced fresh dill | 1/2 cup minced fresh dill
instructions: Chop the 2 1/2 oz of chocolate into 2/3 inch chunks and put them into a medium saucepan. Place the saucepan over medium heat. When water begins to boil, pour the boiling water away and stir in with the chocolate. Return the heat to med high and continue to stir every so often and cook until completely melted and bubbly, 10 - 20 minutes. Stir the chocolate into the melted chocolate. Meanwhile, combine the balsamic vinegar, enchilada sauce, and bay leaf. Pour the glaze into a small saucepan. Stir in the remaining 1/2 cup of chocolate and the parsley and dill and bring to a boil over medium heat. Reduce the heat.

Random Ingredients: gouda cheese,red wine vinegar,coriander powder,confectioner ' sugar,pistachio,parsley flake
title: Gouda Salad III
ingredients: 1 lb gouda cheese ( cut into 1-inch cubes ) | confectioners'sugar | 1/2 cup chopped parsley flakes | 1/2 cup toasted pistachios | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon ground coriander powder
instructions: In a medium size bowl, combine the cheese, parsley, and pistachios. In a small bowl, combine the vinegar and coriander powder. In a medium size bowl, add the vinegar dressing to the cheese mixture. Add the cheese mixture to the cheese mixture and toss until evenly mixed and coated. Taste and add more vinegar dressing if desired.

title: Faux Pibil (Pork Medallions), Caribbean-Style
ingredients: 2 teaspoons ground mahatma tamarind paste ( found in asian markets ) | 2 teaspoons triple sec | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh basil | 3 tablespoons chopped walnuts | 4 pork tenderloins
instructions: Mix mahatma tamarind paste, triple sec, basil, walnuts and pork tenderloins in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,baby spinach,potato starch,topping,lukewarm milk,dark soy sauce
title: Chai-Style Spinach, Chocolate & Potato Knead for a Supper
ingredients: 2 cups simply potatoes stix | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1/2 cup dark chocolate, baking bar | 300 ml non-dairy milk ( skim is ok ) | 1 box frozen spinach, thawed and drained | 40 g baby rocket or 40 g frozen spinach | 2 teaspoons glutten soy sauce or 2 teaspoons dark soy sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 190c. Line a baking tray large enough to fit your wok with greaseproof paper. Combine potatoes starch and soy sauce in a large bowl and use your fingers to push everything into the wok. Heat the milk to boiling and add the chocolate bar. Boil, stirring constantly, until the chocolate has melted and then remove from the heat. Pour the warm chocolate into the wok and spread to cover the surface evenly, leaving lots of space for the steam to escape. Sprinkle with more salt if necessary. Pour the spinach onto the hot potato mixture and pour over just enough milk to reach a thickness of 1/4 inch. Leave to soak for 5 minutes, then spoon into the lined tray. Smooth the top and bake at 190c for 5 minutes, or until the top is crispy and golden and the potatoes are cooked. Set aside to cool. Slice the spinach thinly, with the back of a knife, and spread out evenly on one side of the slice of potato knead. Arrange a spoonful of spinach at the centre of the potato knead. Scatter with as little baby spinach as possible and a sprinkling of extra baby spinach. Place a large handful of rocket or baby spinach on top. Slice the stack in half and serve.

title: Mediterranean Quesadillas
ingredients: 2 flour tortillas | kalamata olive
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium high heat. Spread each tortilla with olive oil. Place a quarter kalamata olive in the center of the tortilla. Top with other piece of the tortilla.

title: Sizzlin' Easy Beef Sandwiches for 2
ingredients: 2 pounds sliced deli roast beef | 2 tablespoons garlic paste | 3 cans bamboo shoots, drained and sliced
instructions: Spread the garlic paste all over the top of the roast beef slices. Layer the beef slices in the following order, bamboo shoots, roast beef slices, garlic paste. Cover with a cloth and secure with toothpicks.

title: Blackberry Coconut Salad
ingredients: 400 g blackberries | 350 g roasted peanuts oil | 100 g shredded coconut | 50 g dried sweetened coconut ( pecan or golden ) ( optional ) | 100 g dried flaked coconut ( pecan-stuffed ) ( optional )
instructions: Toss the fruit with half of the coconut until well combined. Heat the peanut oil in a small pan in a small flameproof bowl and toss the fruit until coated with the oil. Add the remaining coconut to the fruit. Sprinkle with half of the coconut, and toss lightly until well combined. Spread the fruit on a large serving platter and scatter over the remaining coconut with the pecan or golden coconut.

title: Mincesticks - Cashew Nut Balls
ingredients: 1 lb raw cashews | 2 teaspoons dried basil | 1 1/2 lbs mincemeat, cooked & drained | topping | breadcrumbs ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried chili, crushed
instructions: Soak cashews in 3 cups boiling salted water for 15 - 30 minutes. Drain well & set aside with basil. Place mincemeat in a bowl with basil & cool. Wipe cashets dry w/paper towels. With hands, roll mince into walnut sized meatballs. Dip into salamander to coat, then coat with breadcrumbs to coat. Repeat process until all meat balls are coated. Spray an 8x8 inch pan w/cooking oil. Place meatballs in dish in a single layer. Cover & bake on 350 for 30 minutes to an hour, til cooked through. Top w/extra cheese topping & continue baking until lightly browned. Serve warm.

title: Corn Fritters
ingredients: 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 1/4 cup dry mustard powder
instructions: Combine corn, dry mustard, and prepared mustard powder in a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,portuguese bread,orange juice,gin,white sugar,chicken breast meat,mackerel,beef stock
title: Smoked Mackerel and Orange Soup
ingredients: 6 ounces smoked mackerel, rinsed | 5 ounces smoked chicken breast meat, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 cup distilled white sugar | 1 can beef stock | 1 cup orange juice | 1/8 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1 loaf portuguese country bread, cut in 1 inch cubes | 1/4 cup gin ( optional )
instructions: In a slow cooker combine the mackerel, chicken, sugar, beef stock, orange juice, oregano and bread slices, stirring to combine together. Cover and cook on high until the mackerel mixture is heated through and the bread is warmed through, 5 to 6 hours.

title: Quick and Easy Apricot Jam
ingredients: 2 jars apricot jam | 1/2 teaspoon orange peel, finely minced
instructions: Pour jam into a jar with a tight fitting lid. Add orange peel. Close lid and heat on top of the stove over medium heat stirring to spread the jam. Remove the lid and turn the heat back down to low. Keep heat low for 15 - 20 minutes until the jam starts to boil.

title: Faux Easy Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb ground chuck | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 package dry pasta
instructions: Combine the chuck, seasoning salt and pasta. Lightly brown the meat in a frying pan, or using a skillet with a tight lid to protect yourself. Add to meat and mix well. Simmer about 15 - 20 minutes or until pasta and meat are tender. Add more seasoning or salt, depending as desired.

title: Baby Spinach Leaves (Italian Spinach) Salad
ingredients: 1 lb frozen baby spinach | 1 bunch fresh parsley flakes
instructions: Fill a large bowl with cold water and add the spinach. Thaw the bag of spinach so that it is easy to remove and put it in the salad bowl. Put in the parsley flakes. Toss the salad and serve.

title: St. Michael's Alley-Tenderloin
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tenderloin | 3 tablespoons vinegar | 4 cloves, peeled and smashed | 2 large stalks celery, sliced | 4 slices soft white bread, crusts removed
instructions: Put the meat in a large, heavy skillet. Add water to barely cover the meat. Add the cloves, celery, and vinegar and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer slowly for 2 1/2 hours. Remove the skillet from the heat and let sit for about 20 minutes. Drain the meat and spread on a warm serving dish. Slice the meat very thinly and arrange on a heated serving dish.

Random Ingredients: curry paste,chicken breast half,anaheim chili,lemon pepper
title: Spicy Thai Coconut Curry Chicken
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1/2 cup hot curry paste | 1/2 cup chopped anaheim chili | 1/2 teaspoon lemon pepper
instructions: Cut chicken in half crosswise, pound to 1/4 inch thickness. Combine curry paste ingredients and press evenly into chicken cutlets. Marinate in the refrigerator for 1 hour or more. Preheat a large nonstick skillet, medium heat, add marinated chicken, cover and cook for 4 minutes or until chicken is browned, stirring frequently. Flip chicken and continue cooking for 2 minutes longer or until chicken is no longer pink on top and juices run clear.

title: Mustard and Sea Scallops
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon mustard | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/4 teaspoon sea scallops
instructions: Mix mustard, coriander and sea scallops and coat scallops. Grill scallops 2 - 3 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: triple sec,soy sauce,pork sparerib,beef bouillon cube,lemon peel,ladyfinger,strawberry
title: Steamed Beef Ribs in Strawberry Lemon Sauce
ingredients: 3 lbs pork spareribs | 3 beef bouillon cubes | 1/4 cup soy sauce | 1 tablespoon triple sec | 1 lemon peel, thinly grated | 1/2 cup strawberry jam or 1/2 cup strawberry preserves | 16 ladyfingers
instructions: Soak 8 bamboo skewers or large wire racks or metal skewers in water for at least an hour, or overnight if possible. Prepare beef rib skewers by soaking them in cold water for at least 30 minutes and up to 1 day ahead. Rinse with cold water and pat dry with paper towels. Cut each pork rib steak into 3 pieces and the spareribs into 1 inch chunks. Place in a large saucepan, or dutch oven. Add boiling water to cover, about 2 1/2 inches over the rib pieces. Bring to a boil, and simmer for 1 hour. Dissolve the bouillon cubes in 1/4 cup warm water, and pour over the ribs, making sure that they are completely submerged. Bring back up to a boil, and skim off any foam that rises to the top. Cover, and simmer for 1 hour, then remove cover and cook another 30 minutes. Stir in the soy sauce, triple sec, lemon peel, and 1/2 cup of jam or preserves. Transfer to a large serving dish, and garnish with a few ladyfingers. Note, if you like, serve at room temperature over hot steamed rice.

Random Ingredients: tomato puree,white peppercorn,garlic salt,baby spinach,bamboo shoot
title: Veggies on the Runza
ingredients: 1 can bamboo shoots ( or any vegetable of your liking ) | 1 package fresh baby spinach | 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt or 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder, more to taste | 1/4 teaspoon white peppercorns | 3 tablespoons tomato puree, for a more intense flavor
instructions: Open the can of bamboo shoots & slice them. Heat a nonstick or cast iron skillet over a medium high heat. Add the pieces of spinach, garlic & white peppercorns to the skillet. Sauté for 2 minutes or until the spinach wilts. Add the sliced bamboo shoots, tomato puree & dash of salt. Sauté another 2 minutes or until the spinach is heated through. If desired, add a little water to prevent the spinach from drying out.

title: Paneer
ingredients: 1 cup baby peas | 7 -9 medium cooking apples | 1 tablespoon paprika
instructions: Cut apples up like you would any other apple. Toss everything together in a bowl or ziplock bag. Toss the apple around in the paprika and chill.

title: Gorgonzola Cheese Stuffed Pasta
ingredients: 3 cups rotel ( about 2 3-canned variety ) | 2 teaspoons oregano leaves, crushed ( mexican oregano may be substituted for italian if you wish ) | 12 ounces gorgonzola cheese ( can use regular blue cheese if preferred )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Squeeze all excess moisture out of the rotel cheese until it is very dry, adding 1/2 can of rotel at a time depending on how stiff or crumbly you want the pesto. In large bowl, combine remaining 1 1/2 1 cup rotel, oregano, and about 1 cup of cheese. Add the salt and pepper to taste. Stuff inside of pasta with this mixture. Toss with remaining cheese. Place stuffed pasta into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake for approximately 12 minutes or until cheese is melted and starting to brown.

Random Ingredients: golden raisin,peanut butter,spanish onion,poblano chile,kosher salt,cucumber
title: Spicy Raisin Salad With Peanuts
ingredients: 1/2 cup golden raisin, coarsely chopped | 1 large spanish onion, halved, thinly sliced | 2 large poblano chiles, halved vertically, seeded and cut into 1-by3/4-inch-wide strips | 2 cups peanut butter | 1 large cucumber, peeled, halved lengthwise, seeded, cut crosswise into 1/4-in. wedges | kosher salt
instructions: In a bowl, toss raisins, onion, poblano chiles and 1/3 cup of the peanut butter with oil to coat. Toss with remaining peanut butter, salt and remaining 1/3 cup peanut butter and cucumber wedges. Spread in shallow dish and refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight.

Random Ingredients: steak,vanilla extract,cumin,curd cottage cheese,superfine sugar,pudding,coriander root
title: Steak Ripe Cubes With Custard
ingredients: 20 ounces small curd cottage cheese | 1 pinch superfine sugar | 4 medium steaks | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 2 teaspoons ground coriander root | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon turmeric | 2 -4 teaspoons vanilla extract or 2 -4 teaspoons fresh vanilla | 1/4 cup fresh coriander root, finely chopped ( a small bunch of the stem )
instructions: Mix up the cottage cheese until it is a smooth paste. Spread the cottage cheese on a clean cloth and then press to remove excess moisture. Place about two teaspoons of this mixture along the center of each slice of steaks then roll up in the spiced cottage cheese to enclose the meat. Set aside and let marinate while you finish preparing the custard. To make the custard, put the cinnamon, coriander root in a mortar and pound until smooth. Combine the spice paste with the vanilla and set aside. Skewer the steaks and poke with a toothpick in the thickest part of the rinds to make short cuts. Place each skewer on a well oiled rack of a steamer. Pour in the custard. Sprinkle with the reserved cinnamon/cumin/turmeric/green onion/shrimp mixture. Steam the steaks over plenty of gentle simmering water until done, 8 - 10 minutes, depending on the thickness of the steaks. Remove the meat and serve with the custard. Variation, instead of stuffing the moulded meat, stuff the cheese with prawns, then roast or fry the prawns whole in olive oil until nice and browned. Variation, the recipe for the spiced custard can be altered to suit your personal tastes. A nice quantity of prawns can also be added to the mixture.

title: Faux Phad Thai
ingredients: 1 cup salad greens | 1 teaspoon chicken liver, finely chopped
instructions: Whisk together all ingredients in a small bowl. Serve immediately, or store covered in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,coffee powder,broccoli floret,shell macaroni,spice
title: Macaroon Pakistani Style
ingredients: 200 g shell macaroni | 450 g broccoli florets | 150 g small shell macaroni ( optional ) | 2 green cardamoms ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons hot coffee powder
instructions: Cook the macaroni in plenty of water till soft. Drain and set aside. Slice the broccoli florets finely, if using them. Cook the shells macaroni, if using them, and if using them, microwave them till soft with the lid on. Drain very well and set aside. Chop the spices and mix well. Cook the broccoli florets in plenty of water till they are partially cooked and softened, adding more water if necessary. Mix the coffee powder with 1 tbsp water to taste, then add to the pan and stir until the soup thickens a little, adding a little water if needed. Do not overcook these or they will taste raw. Add the macaroni and mix well. Add the chopped macaroni and stir until heated through.

Random Ingredients: italian bread,mayonnaise,black eyed pea,port wine,chicken bouillon,yogurt,sherry
title: Cuban Poached Eggs With Port Toasted Bread
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups dried black-eyed peas | 8 large eggs | 2/3 cup hellman's mayonnaise | 2/3 cup low fat plain yogurt | 1/3 cup port wine | 1/4 cup dry sherry | 1 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon
instructions: Place peas in a large bowl and cover with water. Soak 20 minutes. Drain 1/4 of peas, then rinse. Drain back into large bowl, cover with cold water and set aside. When peas are softened, add eggs. Break eggs up with fork, and let sit, while adding mayonnaise, yogurt, port, sherry and bouillon to peas and eggs. Mix well with a spoon or strainer. Transfer mixture to a large ovenproof skillet. Use a spoon to place whole eggs in skillet and sprinkle with the toasted bread. Cover with greased aluminum foil. Place in 350°f oven for 40 minutes.

title: Hawaiian Rice and Pineapple
ingredients: 1/2 pound ground beef chuck | 1/2 cup long grain white rice | 1 can crushed pineapple, drained | 1/4 cup slivered almonds, or as needed to cover
instructions: Place beef chuck in a skillet with water, bring to a boil, and reduce heat to medium low. Cover, and simmer until beef is cooked through, about 1 hour. Drain beef, and reserve broth. Return meat to skillet, and add rice, pineapple, and almonds. Mix well, and continue cooking until heated through.

title: Tikka Marinade for Beef Cutlets
ingredients: 2 tablespoons yogurt ( plain yogurt doesn't taste as good ) | 1 -2 lb steak, cut into thin slices
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl. Add beef, and marinate in refrigerator, allowing about one to a half hour or longer for flavors to infuse into meat. Keep chilled over night, and marinate meat on grill to desired doneness, but make sure the grill is on a low setting, not the broiler setting.

title: Cabbage Rolls - Dutch Savoy Cabbage
ingredients: 1 head savoy cabbage ( about 5-6 ounces, depending on size ) | 2 tablespoons lard ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: Core the cabbage very thinly, cutting off the stem at the bottom as well. Bring the large leaves together, leaving just enough leaves to wrap around the cabbage. Heat a dutch oven over medium high heat, add the lard and when it is very hot, add the cabbage and cover. Cook, covered, for 3 - 5 minutes. Uncover the cabbage and cook for about 5 minutes, or until soft but not mushy. Stir the cabbage frequently to encourage it not to stick. Stir the cocoa into the cabbage just before serving, if desired.

title: Quick and Easy Tomato Gravy
ingredients: 1 can tomato paste | 1 teaspoon hemp seeds
instructions: Blend tomato paste and hemp seeds until smooth and slightly chunky.

title: Simple and Easy Sweet Potato Fries
ingredients: 3 large sweet potatoes | 1 tablespoon ground walnut, or as needed
instructions: Pierce the surface of a small hole in the bottom of each potato 2 or 3 times with a knife. Fill holes with water, about 1 tablespoon per potato. Bring water to a boil in a large saucepan over high heat. Add sweet potatoes. Cook until potatoes are tender, easily pierced with a fork, and easily pierced with a knife or skewer. Allow to cool slightly before resealable bag or containers. Sprinkle sugar over potatoes.

title: Pasta Rustica
ingredients: 1 package dried farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 1 jar dried fidelina ( wild fennel, bulb )
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add farfalle pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper,tea leaf,cracker crumb,chickpea,black currant,beef tenderloin
title: Trini Burgers
ingredients: 2 medium beef tenderloin, cut 1 inch thick | 20 fresh cracked cracker crumbs | 1 can chickpeas, drained | 1/4 cup black currants, soaked in water for 10 12 minutes and then drained | 1/4 cup minced jalapeno peppers or 1/4 cup serrano pepper | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon finely chopped seeded pickled jalapeno pepper seeds ( to garnish )
instructions: Trim ends and outside of the meat. Cut 6 - 8 thin slices and press 1/4 bread crumbs in each slice. Spread chickpeas evenly on a nonstick cookie sheet. Sprinkle with blackcurrants, black chiles, and pickled jalapeno peppers. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes or until internal meat temperature reaches 160 degrees.

Random Ingredients: cod,tomato sauce,olive,chipotle chile adobo,chicken bouillon cube,french green bean,yoghurt
title: Mexican Cod Fish Casserole for the Crockpot
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs cod ( or any white fish, of your liking, can be left out ) | 1 1/2 lbs portuguese style green beans ( may also use other green beans as well ) | 1 can diced tomatoes with green beans | 1 can tomato sauce ( or more ) | 1 tablespoon olive | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon paste ( see step 1 below ) or 1 tablespoon tomato sauce ( see step 1 below )
instructions: Remove bones and skin from fish. Cube fish into bite size pieces and place in crockpot. Add remaining ingredients. Cover and cook on low for 7 - 8 hours or high for 3 - 4 hours. Do not check for salt until 20 - 30 minutes prior to eating the fish. Serve in bowls with tortillas or tortillas to dip if desired. Serve with hot cooked rice. Note, i like to put the fish into my crock pot with the other ingredients except for the green beans. If you would like to serve as a main dish with the finished dish, you can add a bit of cheese and/or sour cream.

Random Ingredients: olive,spanish onion,tomato green chilies,white pepper,lemon,tarragon,beef brisket,water chestnut
title: Spanish Canned Beef With Preserved Lemons and Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 jar sliced olives | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, drained ( or fresh tomatoes if you prefer ) | 1/2 cup extra-virgin olive oil | 1 cup diced spanish onions or 1 cup walla walla onion | 1 teaspoon white pepper, coarsely ground | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon or 1 teaspoon crushed fresh tarragon | 1 1/2 tablespoons grated lemons, rind of | 12 lbs beef brisket, trimmed
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoons olive oil in 12 inch skillet over medium high heat. Add onions. Sprinkle with pepper. Cook, stirring frequently, until golden, about 4 minutes. Stir in olives, tomatoes, olives and 1/2 cup water. Cook, stirring constantly, until boiling, about 2 minutes. Lower heat to medium and simmer uncovered for 5 minutes or until thick enough to coat the back of a spoon. Stir in the tarragon, lemon rind, and remaining 1/2 cup water. Strain liquid to remove salt and any fibers from meat. Spread mixture onto a rack in a shallow roasting pan and cover loosely with foil. Chill for 4 to 6 hours. Remove meat and discard foil. Remove beef from liquid. Cook uncovered, turning meat over every 15 minutes with tongs, until well browned and just cooked through, about 1 hour and 15 to 20 minutes per pound for rare or longer for well done. For tender, meat will be tender when pierced with a fork. Transfer to platter, cover and let stand 10 minutes. Slice and serve hot. Note, to freeze, place meat in an airtight container and let stand for 6 hours to overnight to soften slightly and cool a little bit. Transfer to a freezer plastic bag and place in freezer. After it is frozen, transfer contents to a crockpot. Add remaining liquid and meat. Cover, turn on low and cook 6 to 8 hours. Remove meat from crockpot to a plate and cover loosely with foil. Skim off any fat that rises to the surface and discard. Cover loosely with foil or a lid during the final 15 minutes of cooking so that juices do not run. If the sauce is too thick or if too thin, thin out with a little more water. Serve over rice or noodles.

Random Ingredients: kiwi fruit,mandarin orange section,corn syrup,steak,cream cheese
title: Mandarin Kiwi Steak
ingredients: 2 lbs round steaks, cut into 4 strips | 1 package cream cheese | 2 cups mandarin orange sections, cut into 4 strips | 1/2 cup light corn syrup | 3 kiwi fruits, peeled, halved lengthwise and then cut on the diagonal into 3-4 slices
instructions: Spread cream cheese onto one side of each round steak slice and then wrap each slice with a strip of mandarin orange sections, allowing each to stand on the cream cheese. In a heavy duty baking pan just large enough to hold the steaks, combine the corn syrup and kiwifruit slices. Bring the mixture just to a boil over medium high heat. Cook the steaks for 8 - 10 minutes or until easily pierced with a fork and the cream cheese has begun to thicken. Serve with the warm kiwifruit and warm corn syrup mixture.

title: Simple Mexican Pinto Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 cup pinto beans ( soaked overnight ) | 1/2 pint cream topping, thawed | 1 cup cantaloupe, cut up ( or any other tropical fruit ) | 2 teaspoons sriracha hot chili sauce
instructions: Place all ingredients into crock pot. Mix well and crock pot on high for 1 - 2 hours or low for 4 hours. Note, do not mix. The dip will separate while crock is cooking and it can become soggy. You may need to add water or cheese cloth to prevent mixture from sticking together. You may also put a piece of plastic wrap directly on top of the dip if the dip gets too thick. For me, this turned out like salad dressing with little shreds of fruit and butter.

title: Zucchini Fritters
ingredients: 1/2 medium zucchini, sliced and well scrubbed | 2 tablespoons kahlua or 2 tablespoons orange liqueur | 1 tablespoon sunflower oil
instructions: Heat wok until hot. Dry zucchini slices quickly in a clean towel, then transfer to serving bowl. Make kahlua, by combining the kahlua and oil mixed with a little cold water. Brush over zucchini and serve with french fries.

title: Eggplant and Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 8 ounces eggplants ( about 2 small to medium ) | 8 ounces salted peanuts | 3 ounces mixed nuts, such as cashew pieces | 2 tablespoons salad oil | 2 tablespoons low sodium soy sauce | 4 ounces red cabbage, shredded ( about 3 cups ) | 9 cups cooked medium-grain rice ( about 15 ounces total weight ) | 4 hoagie rolls ( optional )
instructions: Peel and cut eggplant into 1/2 inch cubes. Place in a colander and sprinkle with peanuts. Toss to coat. Let stand 30 minutes. Rinse eggplant with cold water, drain and pat dry. Cut into 1/2 inch cubes. Set aside. Heat oil over medium high heat in a large nonstick pot. Add eggplant, peanuts, nuts, and salad dressing. Stir fry 3 to 4 minutes. Add cabbage and rice and stir fry 5 minutes or until golden. Spoon about 1/3 cup rice mixture onto a wooden surface. Using a long sharp knife, cut 3 diagonal slits across the top of the rice mixture. Spoon 1 tablespoon of eggplant mixture in center. Fold diagonally to seal. Repeat with remaining eggplant mixture and filling. Serve rolls with rolls.

title: Aunt Alma's Lentils in Rice & Nuts. Friendly Dessert
ingredients: 1/4 dried lentils ( can add extra ) | 1 cup beef stock | 1/2 cup rice | 1 dried chipotle chile ( optional ) | 1 vanilla bean | 1 tablespoon instant rice ( optional )
instructions: Rinse lentils, add to saucepan on low heat in enough boiling water to cover. Once boiling add rice to cover and cook until soft and translucent about 10 minutes. About 2 minutes meanwhile boil chipotle in the microwave for about 20 seconds, or until very soft and very fragrant. Drain and remove skin from chipotle using a slotted spoon. In a separate pot place beef broth, bean, chipotle, and vanilla bean and bring to boil. Add salt to taste and put aside to cool about 5 minutes. Taste and adjust seasoning with additional salt, if needed. Serve over ice cream or vanilla.

title: Spicy Chicken
ingredients: 6 -10 chicken drumsticks, and wings ( depending on the size of drumsticks ) | 3 -4 tomatoes, chopped | 1/2 cup lime rind, grated ( orange rind varies in amount used, i use lime leaves ) | 1 red chili pepper, deseeded and roughly chopped ( not super-hot ) | zucchini ( optional ) | 1/2 cup lardons ( optional ) or 1/2 cup other fat ( optional )
instructions: Dice chicken up or buy sliced and chicken wings.. Put in a mixing bowl, or in a ziplock baggie add rind, chili, tomatoes and lardons, if using the latter. Add enough lime juice to cover. Add chicken pieces, toss, refrigerate and leave to marinade for about 4 hours, tossing every once in a while. Cook a large pan on a medium heat, add a little oil. Put in chicken or thighs and fry until done and the oil starts to sizzle, about 5 - 10 minutes depending on size. Remove chicken from pan, drain all the fat. Put in large oven dish or casserole dish, put on a bed of fried bread, sprinkle with paprika, if desired.

title: Vietnamese Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup fish sauce | 1/4 cup white sugar
instructions: Stir fish sauce, sugar, and sugar together in a small bowl. Cover a large, glass baking dish with plastic wrap, and refrigerate dipping sauce for up to 5 days.

title: Domingos (Hot Chocolate) Philippines Cocoa Mix
ingredients: 100 g caster sugar ( or superfine sugar ) | 50 g cocoa powder
instructions: Combine sugar, cocoa and cocoa powder together until mixture is creamy. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,white chocolate chip,milk ricotta cheese,brown lentil,red potato,potato starch,red pepper flake,chicken breast
title: Lentil and Mashed Potato Cheese Crusted Chicken With Black Peppers and White Chocolate Chips
ingredients: 1 kg red potato, diced | 2 tablespoons brown lentils | 350 g sweet potatoes, diced | 500 g chicken breasts, diced | 2 teaspoons dried red pepper flakes | 1 cup skim milk ricotta cheese, crumbled | 80 g good white chocolate chips | 3 cups skim milk chocolate chips | 1/2 teaspoon salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Place the diced and peeled potatoes, lentils, sweet potato, and chicken in a large bowl and season generously with black pepper. Add a splash of water and combine. Allow to sit for about 10 minutes. Add a pinch of salt in your hands as your holding the mixture together. Divide into four equal portions. To make the white chocolate coating, combine the ricotta cheese with half the grated chocolate chips and milk choc bits until smooth. Sprinkle over the chicken mixture. Dry the black pepper over your hands and scatter over the remaining chocolate chips. Preheat your oven to 200 degrees centigrade. Spray an oven tray with cooking spray and place the prepared dish on the tray. Place in the oven and bake for 40 minutes until golden and crusty. Remove from the oven and allow to rest for five minutes.

title: Moroccan Style Banana
ingredients: 1 medium banana | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon ras el hanout spice mix
instructions: Peel and slice the banana about 3/4 inch thickness. Rub salt and pepper into the banana slices and sprinkle the ras el hanout on top. Set aside and wait 10 minutes. Toast under a preheated broiler, or you could toast it in the oven on a paper towel. It'll taste very different from normal because of the salt. But it's delicious.

title: Crazy Oven Fried Pork Belly Rolls
ingredients: 1 lb pork belly, cut in 1/4 inch slices, skin on | 2 egg whites | 2 3/4 cups tortilla chips
instructions: Coat a 2 quart casserole with pam. Place all of your pork belly slices onto a paper towel. If the slices are large, cut them lengthwise into 1 1/2 inch slices. Spread the slices evenly across the bottom of the casserole. Whip egg whites until stiff peaks form. Gently fold beaten egg whites into the beaten egg whites. Cover with the crushed tortilla chips. Cover with a lid and place in the oven. It will take about 1 hour to set your oven to 375 degrees. Remove from the oven, let the biscuits cool a minute or so then carefully remove those crispy chips, and eat them hot.

title: Tart Apples
ingredients: 1 can rotel tomatoes & chilies | 1 tart apple, peeled & diced | 1 cup of chopped fresh fruit
instructions: Mix everything together in a casserole dish. Cook over low heat until apples are tender.

title: Grilled Pork Loin Chops
ingredients: 4 bone-in pork loin chops | 1/3 cup white vinegar | 1/4 cup grated lemon peel | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning
instructions: Combine vinegar, peel, and seasoning in a small bowl. Add pork and turn to coat. Place on grill over medium heat and cook 8 minutes, or to desired doneness.

Random Ingredients: rice krispies,nonstick cooking spray,sun tomato,head cauliflower,part ricotta cheese
title: Rice Krispies Cauliflower Cheese Treats
ingredients: nonstick cooking spray | 1 medium head cauliflower ( about 1lb ) | 1/2 cup instant rice krispies | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato, packed without oil | 1/2 cup part-skim ricotta cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Spread a large baking sheet with spray. Trim most of the cauliflower from its stem and break up into small pieces. In a large bowl, toss cauliflower pieces with rice krispies until coated. Scatter pieces in one even layer on top of sheet and drizzle with a small drizzle of oil. Bake about 25 minutes, or until cauliflower is golden. Cool. Drain kasseri mixture completely and combine with sun dried tomatoes. Transfer to a serving bowl or serving plate and combine ricotta cheese with remaining 1/2 cup kasseri mixture. Sprinkle over top of casseriflower and garnish with chopped fresh parsley if desired.

Random Ingredients: ghee butter,thai fish sauce,asafoetida powder,tamari,cranberry,cheddar cheese,gelatin,whipping cream
title: Creamy Cranberry Gluten Free Cheesecake
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tamari ( gluten free soy sauce ) | 1 tablespoon unflavored gelatin | 2 tablespoons coconut & flaked coconut ( toasted ) | 1/2 cup low-fat cheddar cheese ( grated ) | 1/2 cup light cream | 1/2 cup ghee ( not butter ) | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( or 1/2 tbsp. vegetable oil ) | 2 teaspoons thai fish sauce | 1 cup cranberries
instructions: Preheat oven with a pizza stone on the middle rack. In a small bowl, sprinkle gelatin over warm water in microwave safe bowl.

Random Ingredients: allspice,head garlic,shallot,white wine vinegar,cannellini bean,vanilla essence
title: Low Fat White Bean Salad
ingredients: 2 cans cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 large shallot, thinly sliced and separated into rings | 4 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 4 tablespoons low-fat vanilla essence | 1 teaspoon ground allspice ( optional ) | 1 head garlic, sliced or 1 head garlic
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a bowl. Place the sliced garlic in the dressing and serve.

title: Linguine and Sausage Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs italian sausage | 1/3 cup dry tea | 1 lb russet potato, peeled and cut into chunks or small cubes | 3 tablespoons dried mint | 6 ounces uncooked linguine, cooked | 12 ounces spaghetti
instructions: In a large dutch oven, brown the sausage. Drain. Stir into sausage. Add the tea. Bring to boil for 5 minutes, covered simmer for 30 minutes. Add the potatoes, mint and noodles. Cook for 10 more minutes, or until vegetables are tender and pasta is done.

title: Namibian Peanut Polenta
ingredients: 2 cups yellow cornmeal | 1 tablespoon peanut oil, for frying polenta polenta | 1 small maui onion, finely chopped ( about 2 tablespoons ) | 1/4 cup sugar
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the cornmeal with the oil, onion & sugar. Toss in the polenta, coating it in the mixture well but not crumbling it. Let stand until all of the polenta is absorbed. Using a long, shallow sieve, sieve the mixture to remove any lumps. Preheat an unoiled wok over a high heat until a bead of water vaporizes within 1 - 2 seconds of contact. Swad the pan to remove any extra liquid, then pour in enough hot water to come 1/4 inch up the side of the pan. Transfer the entire mixture so that it reaches 1/4 inch up the side of the pan & set the pan over the wok. Cover tightly w/cling film or lid. Raise the heat to 400f & cook the polenta for 4 - 5 minutes, or until firm in the center. Drain on paper towels to cool. Serve at once, or refrigerate covered.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella cheese,cocoa powder,vegetable broth,rye flour,artichoke heart,brown lentil
title: Mujadarra (Lentils With Artichokes)
ingredients: 8 ounces brown lentils | 6 -8 artichoke hearts | 3/4 cup vegetable broth or 3/4 cup canned low sodium vegetable broth | 2 1/2 tablespoons cocoa powder or 2 1/2 tablespoons dark cocoa | 0.5 package shredded mozzarella cheese | 1/4 cup cocoa powder
instructions: Rinse lentils and artichokes. Place lentils, artichokes and vegetable broth in the crock pot. Cook on high, stirring occasionally for 2 hours, or on low for 3 1/2 4 hours. Turn crock pot on high and stir every 10 minutes. Add 1 1/2 tbls. Mix and continue cooking on low for 1 to 2 minutes. Transfer to cutting board and finely chop. To serve, spread 2 tablespoons of the cocoa in the bottom of a plate and place the 3/4 cup of cheese on top. Spoon lentil/artichoke mixture over the cheese. Sprinkle 1/2 tspn of cocoa over the top and garnish with remaining 1/2 tspn of cocoa or dark cocoa.

Random Ingredients: swiss chard,apple cider,salt black pepper,egg yolk,green chilies
title: Green Chile With Swiss Chard
ingredients: 1 lb swiss chard, stems removed, leaves coarsely chopped | 2 medium apples, ripe, cored, peeled, coarsely chopped | 6 green chilies, deseeded, seeded, trimmed and finely chopped | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 6 large egg yolks
instructions: Place chard leaves in a large salad spinner and set out on a plate. Grate the chard leaves into chard leaves. Add the apples and chiles to the top of the chard. Season with salt and pepper. In a small bowl, beat the egg yolks with a pinch of salt and pepper until pale in color. Using a slotted spoon, lift the whites of the egg yolks and stir into the chard mixture, then pour over the greens. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Serve chilled.

title: Guinness Beer Dip
ingredients: 1 bottle guinness stout | 1/4 cup rice wine vinegar ( or more )
instructions: Shake bottle of guinness into a small jar. Add in the rice wine vinegar. Cover and shake. Store in fridge. Enjoy with crusty baguette, crackers, or assorted chips.

title: Kielbasa and Oregano Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces kielbasa sausage, sliced into 1/8-inch slices | 1/4 cup chopped fresh oregano leaves | 1/2 cup chopped coarsely | 1 1/2 cups coarsely chopped arugula | ice
instructions: Tear off a few large chunks of dried arugula. On small plates, arrange the chunks of dried kielbasa atop the arugula and drizzle with the oregano dressing.

title: Japanese Salad
ingredients: 4 teaspoons walnut oil | 4 teaspoons butter, cut into pieces | 1 tablespoon instant chicken-style ramen noodles ( dried ) | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 1/2 cup chopped canned beets | 1 cup chopped green onions | 2 cups water
instructions: Mix all ingredients together.

title: Spicy Halibut
ingredients: 1 1/2 quarts water | 1 cup hulled semolina | 1 cup smoked ham, sliced | 1 piece smoked halibut fillet, pounded to 1/2 inch thickness | 6 fresh asian pear slices, cut into 1/4 inch wide strips ( about 3/4 to 1 inch thick ) | 2 whole juniper berries, crushed | 8 portabella mushrooms, sliced
instructions: In a large dutch oven, combine the water, semolina, ham, salmon, and pear slices. Bring to a boil.

title: Grilled Peppers
ingredients: 2 tablespoons crumbled feta cheese | 1/2 cup crumbled or toasted pine nuts | 1 small yellow bell pepper, coarsely chopped
instructions: Mix feta cheese, pine nuts and yellow bell pepper together. Lightly oil grill. Grill mixture 2 to 3 minutes per side, until cheese is melted and slightly crisped.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,rom tomato,pine nut,sirloin steak,no salt tomato,spinach
title: Sirloin and Spinach Roll on a Hawaiian Roll
ingredients: 4 roma tomatoes | 2 tablespoons pine nuts, toasted and cooled | 2 tablespoons heavy whipping cream, whipped | 12 ounces sirloin steaks, cut 2/3-inch thick | 1 package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained | 1 can no-salt-added stewed tomatoes, drained
instructions: Preheat grill to medium heat. Place tomatoes on the grill. Grill, cut sides down, until slightly charred, about 8 minutes. Transfer tomatoes to a bowl with tomato juice. Cool slightly, then core tomatoes and coarsely chop. Spread pine nuts on a microwave safe plate. Heat in the microwave until the pine nuts start changing color, 30 seconds to 1 minute. Spread about 2 tablespoons whipped cream on each tomato and roll up. Place steaks on a platter, drizzle with remaining whipped cream, and sprinkle with spinach and sun dried tomatoes. Serves that's it.

title: Broccoli and Bacon
ingredients: 2 tablespoons bacon grease | 2 bags fresh broccoli or steamed broccoli
instructions: Place grease in a skillet or wok with a lid or pan. Cook broccoli until tender crisp drain and add broccoli to bacon grease. Cook until heated through serve warm over rice.

title: Namibian Shredded Jalapenos
ingredients: 6 fresh large green jalapenos ( about 9 ounces total weight ) | 5 tablespoons low sodium soy sauce | 1 tablespoon fresh marjoram or 1 tablespoon fresh cilantro, leaves chopped | 1 package white frosting
instructions: With a sharp knife, trim the stem and bottom of the jalapenos. With a sharp knife, split open the top of each jalapeno. Place the jalapenos in a microwave safe dish with the soy sauce, marjoram or cilantro, and white frosting. Cover, and cook on high until the frosting begins to thicken, 5 - 7 minutes.

title: Ribs W- Sugar Snap Peas & Sugar Snap Peas
ingredients: 2 lbs pork spareribs ( i make my own from a butcher ) | 1/4 cup sugar snap pea
instructions: Cut ribs at diagonal into large serving size pieces. In an 11x7 inch baking dish, mix the ribs, snap peas and sugar snap peas. Cover with plastic wrap and gently press down on vegetables with your fingers. Refrigerate at least 2 hours, but no more. Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Bake uncovered 40 - 45 minutes, turn ribs, sprinkle with more sugar snaps, and bake 20 minutes more.

Random Ingredients: cherry,asafoetida powder,hash brown,black cumin seed,curd,red pepper flake
title: Spicy Indian Vegetable Stew (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 6 cups diced frozen hash browns | 1/2 cup dried curds | 2 tablespoons indian red pepper flakes ( adjust to taste ) | 2 teaspoons black cumin seeds ( or anise as well ) | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( adjust to taste ) | 1 tablespoon black cumin seeds ( or anise )
instructions: Mix all ingredients in pressure cooker. Pressure cook on high heat. Once cooker is filled, reduce pressure to medium low flame. Cook uncovered and steam for 15 - 20 minutes to steam the bottom of the cooker. Let pressure cool completely.

title: Nuked Fresh Fennel (St. Nicholas) Tomato Jam
ingredients: 2 lbs firm roma tomatoes or 2 lbs cherry tomatoes | 4 tablespoons sesame seed oil | 5 lbs of fresh fennel
instructions: Wash, peel and core the tomatoes, and slice them in 1/8 th inch slices. Arrange the slices in a sterilized 3 quart jar and fill with the sesame seed oil. Add a few fronds from the fennel to the sauce and cover tightly with saran wrap, sealing all the way around. Store a jar in the usaly and bring it to the next market. In a hot, dry skillet set to med high heat, fry the fennel pieces for 3 mins on each side until they are brown, but not burnt. Remove from the skillet and set aside on a heated paper towel to drain. Pour the jam into the warm jars and seal according to the manufacturer's instructions while still hot. Note, you can replace the tomatoes with plum tomatoes if desired for a different taste. If you use canned tomatoes it should measure 1 cup. It may also be frozen in plastic baggies. It lasts up to two weeks. Enjoy.

title: Smoky Hot Dog Dip
ingredients: 375 g ground hamburger | 1 can diced tomatoes with puree | 2 tablespoons pureed red chili powder | 1 can chopped green chilies
instructions: Combine ingredients and refrigerate at least two hours before serving. Serve with assorted raw vegetables, such as potatoes, chips or french bread rolls.

title: Dietetic Refresher
ingredients: 1 cup low-sodium pinto beans | 1 cup cold water | food coloring, as required
instructions: Blend the pinto beans with the cold water to get a paste. Bring to a boil. Reduce to a simmer and simmer for 5 minutes or until the texture is smooth, stirring continuously. Continue to stir and add a cupful of food colouring to the cooked mixture to deepen the colour and flavor. Serve hot.

title: Ancho Chiles and Rub
ingredients: 14 ancho chilies, stems and seeds removed | 1/4 cup roasted ground roasted ground almonds or 1/4 cup toasted slivered almonds | 1/4 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Grind whole ancho chilies with the stems and seeds, roasted ground unsalted almonds, turmeric and baking powder until blended. Transfer to a jar and store in the refrigerator for up to 5 months.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno,lamb stock,pork shoulder roast,orange liqueur juice,chicken breast half,spring onion,vegetable broth,bamboo shoot
title: Brazilian Pork and Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 1 boneless pork shoulder roast | 4 tablespoons vegetable broth | 2 spring onions, chopped | 2 tablespoons orange liqueur or 2 tablespoons lime juice | 4 ounces canned bamboo shoots, drained | 2 jalapenos, seeded and finely chopped | 4 ounces canned jalapenos, drained and minced | 4 ounces canned chicken breasts or 4 ounces pork shank, chopped
instructions: Pound the pork shoulder until thin. Strain the juice, discarding solids. Pound into a rough paste. Put the pork in a saucepan and pour in the 3 tablespoons of stock, onion, orange liqueur, bamboo shoots, jalapenos, and chicken. Simmer, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are tender. Remove from heat. Stir in the minced jalapenos. Let sit for 5 minutes. Serve topped with the remaining soup, if desired.

Random Ingredients: lamb loin chop,double acting baking powder,baby spinach leaf,anaheim chili,chick pea,taco seasoning mix,graham cracker crumb
title: Lamb Chops With a Kick, a Heart attack!
ingredients: 4 double-acting baking powder | 12 ounces lamb loin chops | 1 bunch baby spinach leaves, washed and spun dry | 1/2 can chick-peas, drained and rinsed ( garbanzo beans ) | 1/2 anaheim chili, chopped | 1 packet sweet taco seasoning mix | graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Sprinkle the top of each chop with the baking powder. Preheat the oven to 500 degrees f. Place the lamb chops in the oven on a rack and bake in the center of the oven for about 10 minutes. The top of the chops should be white. You don't want browned bits. Allow the chops to cool. When cool, remove the chops from the oven and reserve. Pull off the burnt membrane. Roughly chop the meat, discarding any bones or gristle. Add the spinach and chick peas to the food processor and pulse just until they are coarsely chopped but not pureed. The spinach may not be completely chopped but you want a paste. Place the reserved chopping board on top of the chopping board and place a cutting board down on the board. With the blade running, add about 2 tblsps cornstarch and a drop of water to create a thick paste. Repeat until all the chopping board and the paste is used. Add the chopped meat and chopped vegetables back into the skillet and gently stir to coat well with the paste. Toast the graham cracker crumbs in the oven for about 10 minutes or until golden brown. Set aside. Place the roasted chops on a broiler pan and toast under the broiler until golden brown on all sides and internal temperature reaches at least 145 degrees f. Turn and watch for burning. Be sure to watch them closely so they don't burn. Store in an airtight container.

title: Spanish Hamburger Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 lbs hamburger | 1 cup white wine
instructions: Brown hamburger with wine. Add salt, pepper, and a sprinkle of oregano to taste.

Random Ingredients: white mushroom,ice water,cooking spray,cremini mushroom,red chili pepper
title: Mushroom Hot Chili
ingredients: 1 lb cremini mushroom, trimmed and sliced | 4 cups sliced white mushrooms | 4 dried red chili peppers | 1/4 cup ice water | cooking spray
instructions: In a large pot of boiling water, cover mushrooms with ice water by 2 inches and return to a boil. Cover and remove from heat. Let stand for 15 minutes. Drain. Rinse with cold water. Drain mushrooms. Add chili peppers with 2 - 3 tablespoons of water and cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, until water is evaporated and chili peppers are hot, about 3 minutes. Spoon chili onto a warm serving platter and sprinkle with fresh salt. Serve immediately or store in refrigerator for up to one week.

Random Ingredients: coffee granule,gouda cheese,pearl onion,egg yolk,amaretto,chicken bouillon,olive oil,green chilies
title: Green Chile Pepper French Fried Onions
ingredients: 1 lb green chilies, sliced | 1 lb yellow wax sauteed pearl onion | 1 cup amaretto or 1 cup almond liqueur | 1/4 cup instant chicken bouillon | 2 cups cold gouda cheese, shredded | 1/4 cup amaretto or 1/4 cup almond liqueur | 1/4 cup instant chicken bouillon | 1/4 cup green tea powder or 1/4 cup instant coffee granules | 3 egg yolks | 1/4 cup olive oil
instructions: Heat fry pan or deep fryer to 325°f. In medium bowl, mix together all the ingredients except the oil. Place the oil in a medium size oven proof, shallow pot or deep fryer. Heat oil to 375°f. Dip the bell pepper slices into the oil to prevent the peppers from sticking. Fry the peppers, 3 at a time, until the brown, about 5 minutes on each side. Remove from the hot oil to a paper towel lined plate. Place the cooked peppers in a bowl. Toss the fried peppers with all the ingredients except the green tea powder. Cover and chill for at least 2 hours. Serve with your favorite french toast. Note, this recipe can be made ahead to this point. Cover and refrigerate for up to 24 hours.

title: Meatball Salad With Parsley and Potatoes
ingredients: 24 fresh meatballs ( or equivalent of frozen meatballs ) | 6 -8 medium russet potatoes | mayonnaise | 3 tablespoons minced fresh flat-leaf parsley
instructions: Boil potatoes until tender. Drain. While potatoes are cooking, mix mayonnaise and parsley. Set aside. Cut russet potatoes into 1/4 chunks. Cut a slit along one side of each potato, then into 1/2 chunks. Dry potatoes by placing between wax paper and towel. Spray potatoes with oil, then use a pastry brush to cover both sides. Place washed potatoes on paper towels. Sprinkle potatoes with parsley. Place in refrigerator for a couple of hours. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: angostura bitter,spring onion,malt vinegar,simple syrup,chicken drumstick,phyllo dough,wheat bread
title: Thousand Island Baklava
ingredients: 1 gallon malt vinegar | 12 chicken drumsticks or 12 chicken thighs | 8 ounces simple syrup | 8 ounces spring onions or 3 green onions, chopped | 8 ounces chopped fresh sweet greek leaves | 8 ounces whole wheat bread | 12 phyllo dough
instructions: Pour malt vinegar in a large pot and boil until dissolved, and then bring to a boil again.

title: Rice Flour Rice Pudding
ingredients: 5 cups white flour or 5 cups whole wheat flour, in the white of your choice | 5 cups rice vinegar | 1 1/2 - 2 cups yogurt | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 teaspoon ground cloves | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 cup of uncooked risotto rice
instructions: For the rice flours, in a blender put the rice flour, yogurt, seasoning salt, cloves, and 1 cup of water. Add a bit of milk at a time to obtain a dough. For the rice pudding, if using whole wheat flour, add 2 cups of water. After adding the water, knead the rice dough, adding flour a little at a time until it becomes firm enough to form into balls and cling to your finger. If using whole wheat flour, add the 1 1/2 cups of rice flour. For larger sized rice douches, add more flour and 1/2 cup of water. For larger ones, mix half rice flour with half rice flour and half rice flour. Knead well and start forming balls. Let the rice ball rest for 5 minutes. Take the ball out of the refrigerator and knead well. Cut the dough into 4 sections, or shape each section of rice flour into a ball. Roll each piece out into a circle or circle about 2 inches in diameter. Place these on a parchment lined cookie sheet and let it rest. Repeat until all rice flour or dough is used up. Cover with a damp cloth and let sit for 20 minutes. Then prepare your risotto rice pudding. If using rice douches, cook them on a steam pan at low temperature for 15 - 20 minutes until they float.

title: Giant Lobster Cakes
ingredients: 24 large lobster, shell cooked, chopped and oil and vinegar separated | 3/4 cup cottage cheese | 2 pints fresh mushrooms, chopped
instructions: Place the mushrooms in a large bowl of cold water and refrigerate for an hour. Drain the mushrooms and remove the hard stems by pressing them with your hands. Drain and mix with the cottage cheese. Place in a flat ovenproof dish, cover with foil and bake for 20 - 25 minutes at 460°f turning once. Serve immediately.

title: Quinoa Salad With Sage and Smoked Filet Mignon
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa, cleaned rinsed | 3 cups green, shredded ( or red ) | 1 large green apple, diced | 2 leaves red cabbage, chopped | 1 -2 teaspoon salt | 7 -8 leaves sage | salt and pepper | 1 cup smoked filet ( leave on the pith )
instructions: Pre heat your grill to high. Place the quinoa, greens, apple, cabbage and salt and pepper to taste in a large bowl. Mix well. Roll the smoked filet into the mixture. Place on sheet of non stick foil and place on the grill. Grill for 3 - 5 minutes per side depending on thickness and grill marks. Remove from grill.

title: Chinese Hot-And-Sour Chicken Sandwiches With Sauteed Shoyu
ingredients: 1 cup milk | 1 cup watercress, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon shoyu | 2 tablespoons shredded chicken parts ( approx 1 whole chicken ) | 8 hoagie rolls | 3 cups chicken meat, from the deli ( approx 1lb ) | 4 tablespoons shoyu ( to taste ) | 2 teaspoons shoyu, to taste ( to taste ) | 2 teaspoons roasted oyu ( to taste ) | 12 slices brioche bread
instructions: Put the milk, watercress and shoyu in a saucepan, bring to the boil and then simmer for 5 minutes, remove from the heat and stir in the chicken and oyu. Wrap the chicken mixture in the rolled rolls, secure with toothpicks or bamboo skewers and cook under a preheated grill or until golden brown on the top and cooked through. Serve on a lined tray with extra shoyu, salad leaves and toasted brioche leaves, drizzle with toasted soyu and enjoy.

title: Baked Italian Bread Cookies
ingredients: 1 loaf italian bread | 1 cup icing sugar | 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Cut a 1 inch width from the top of the bread loaf. Carefully hollow out the bread leaving the hollowed out shell shell. Spread the icing sugar into the hollowed out bread. Add hot pepper flakes & ground pepper & stir. Put on cookie sheet. Bake in oven for approx 30 minutes or until golden. Cool.

title: Southern Comfort!
ingredients: 4 ounces hot milk powder | 4 ounces southern comfort jack
instructions: Pour hot milk powder into a plastic dessert cup. Carefully pour Southern Comfort jack into cup. Using a tooth pick, poke holes all over the milk powder until it tastes right for you. You do not want the air to circulate in you mug. Serve warm, but if you can keep it chilled, it is okay.

Random Ingredients: cream cottage cheese,parmesan cheese,sirloin,black soy sauce
title: Homemade Spicy Sirloin With Creamy Dipping Sauce.
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground sirloin | 1/3 cup cream-style cottage cheese | 1 teaspoon cracked black soy sauce | 1 teaspoon fresh grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Brown meat over medium heat, breaking up. Do not over cook or this will make the meat tough. Add cottage cheese, soy sauce, and parmesan cheese to hot meat. Stir to combine. Cover and cook until heated thoroughly.

Random Ingredients: swiss chard,peanut,butternut squash,sherry wine vinegar,cauliflower floret,italian parsley
title: Cauliflower and Squash With Peanuts
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon sherry wine vinegar | 1 bunch swiss chard, stems removed, coarsely chopped | 1 butternut squash, ends trimmed, halved lengthwise and cut into 1/2-inch thick slices | 1 small cauliflower floret | 1/2 cup unsalted dry-roasted peanuts, chopped | 1/3 cup fresh italian parsley, chopped
instructions: In a large shallow baking dish, combine the vinegar and chili peppers. Add the chard stems and let stand for 10 minutes. Add the squash slices and cauliflower florets, tossing well. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator about 1 hour. Drain the vegetables and peanuts. Preheat broiler. Broil the mignon leaves 2 inches below the heat until the peanuts are fragrant, 2 to 3 minutes. Remove and place on paper towels to dry. Sprinkle the chard leaves with the parsley and serve.

title: Olive Garden Ranch Green Sauce
ingredients: 10 large olives, sliced in half | 6 tablespoons olive, in jar | 6 chicken bouillon cubes | 2 tablespoons ranch salad dressing
instructions: Place cleaned olives in crock pot. Add water to cover and simmer on low for 1 hour. Remove olives after 1 hour, or longer. Drain and reserve liquid. Put olives back in cooker and add reserved liquid in saucepan. Add olive oil, garlic, oregano, and ranch dressing. Cook on high for 1 additional hour. Serve over hot cooked rice.

title: Macaroni With Enzymes
ingredients: 10 ounces macaroni | 1 teaspoon cumin | 2 -3 wooden skewers
instructions: Clean and cook the macaroni as directed. Drain the macaroni in cold water. Toss with the cumin powder. Soak the skewers in cold water. Drain the macaroni in a clean new pan for 10 minutes. Thread the macaroni onto skewers. Grill the macaroni till the macaroni is browned and the skewers are browned.

Random Ingredients: rice vinegar,chicken stock vegetable,celery rib,extra virgin olive oil,green chilies
title: Napa Dave's Hot and Sour Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups chicken stock or 1 1/2 cups vegetable stock | 1/2 cup rice vinegar | 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1 teaspoon finely chopped green chilies | 2 celery ribs, diced
instructions: Rinse off excess salt. Place rice in a bowl, add 1 1/2 cup stock and pour into heated pan to simmer while preparing other ingredients. Heat olive oil over high heat in a medium saucepan until quite hot. Add the chilies and cook, stirring frequently, for 10 seconds. Add celery, cook another 3 minutes and add vinegar. Add rice mixture, stir to combine, cook over high heat for 5 minutes, or until rice is hot, stirring occasionally. Serve immediately.

title: Tahini Butter Balls
ingredients: 2 tablespoons fine dry bread crumbs | 1 whole black mustard seed, sesame seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Put the sesame seeds in a small skillet over medium heat. Heat the seeds, stirring constantly, until they darken about 10 minutes. Crush the seeds with a mortar and pestle. Transfer seeds to a bowl, add the bread crumbs, and stir until well mixed. Form the mixture into walnut sized balls, and place on the lined baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven 1 hour, until slightly browned.

title: Mexican Fiesta Noodles
ingredients: 6 dried ancho chilies | 3 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 2 cups milk | 3 bananas, peeled and cut into thin wedges | 1 package dried rice noodles | 1 package small shell pasta, such as ditalini
instructions: Place the chiles in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Drizzle with lime juice, and bring to a boil. Place the milk in a large pot, and heat to just below the boiling point, but do not boil. Stir in the bananas until heated through. Scoop the hot chile mixture into a bowl, and set aside. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook the rice noodles until tender yet firm to the bite, stirring occasionally, about 4 minutes.

title: Shrimp and Beef Gumbo
ingredients: 2 lbs large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 2 lbs beef roast, cut in 1/4-inch cubes | 1/4 cup dark sesame oil | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh thyme sprig | 2 tablespoons capers, drained
instructions: In a large pot, add shrimp, roast, sesame oil thyme and capers. Cover and set aside for 5 minutes. Strain shrimp liquid from liquid, keeping about 2 tablespoons for dipping.

title: The Perfect Simplest Bread Appetizers
ingredients: 1 cup white bread, diced very small | 1/3 cup red food coloring
instructions: Select about 20 small bread cubes, or smaller ones that measure a couple of centimeters in diameter at the center of a bread cube placed on a tray. Fill one tray half full with the coloured food coloring cubes. Place a little red food coloring into the remaining tray half full. This will give you a fine, clear round toasted colour with a lovely sheen.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,gruyere cheese,hoagie,jiffy cornbread mix,lasagna noodle,curry powder,mozzarella cheese,filling
title: Chicken Enchilada Casserole
ingredients: 12 slices jiffy cornbread mix | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1/4 cup light cream or 1/4 cup half-and-half | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 12 lasagna noodles, cooked and drained | 2 cups grated mozzarella cheese | 3 cups grated gruyere cheese | 1 1/2 cups grated mozzarella cheese | 1/4 cup flour from the top of the soup can
instructions: Preheat oven to brown noodles in a bit of oil for 3 to 5 minutes, drain. Layer ingredients in the following order in the following order, 1/2 noodle, 1/2 cheddar and 1/2 gruyere. Repeat, 2 noodles, soup, noodles, cheese and top with more cheese. Place in 13x9 pan bake for 20 minutes, or until hot and bubbly. Can be served with sour cream and salsa.

title: Fresh Berry Salsa
ingredients: 4 bunches mixed berries | 3 jalapeno peppers, seeded and minced
instructions: Combine berries and jalapeños in medium bowl. Chill in refrigerator.

title: Easy Low-Fat Quinoa
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 1 cup low-fat chicken-flavored dashi | 2 tablespoons light sweet chili sauce | 1 dash turmeric | 1 dash coriander powder
instructions: Rinse quinoa thoroughly and set aside. In a small pan, combine dashi, sweet chili sauce and turmeric, and bring to a boil over med high heat. When the dashi boils, reduce heat and simmer for 5min or until water is absorbed. Stir quinoa occasionally to ensure even cooking.

title: Sushi Pasta
ingredients: 1 cup dried linguine | 1 butternut squash, peeled and cubed | 2 cups sliced shiitake mushrooms | 2/3 teaspoon salt
instructions: Place the linguine in a large pot over medium high heat. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tender. Mix in the squash and mushrooms. Season with salt.

title: Spicy Red Chili Chips #5FIX
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated reduced-fat regular-fat flour tortillas | 1 can thai red chili peppers ( drained, chopped, undrained ) or 2 1/2 teaspoon ground red chili pepper ( undrained )
instructions: Spray a small pan with cooking spray. Heat over medium high heat for 3 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Add chopped chilies, and remove from heat. Spread 1/3 cup chile mixture evenly over each tortilla. Place 4 chips on a baking sheet, spacing apart. Bake in a 350 degree oven for about 3 - 5 minutes, or until cheese is slightly melted and chips are lightly browned. Remove from oven.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,extra virgin olive oil,chili powder,baby carrot,tomato soup
title: Baby-Cooked Shredded Carrots
ingredients: 12 baby carrots, peeled and cut into chunks | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 3 tablespoons canned tomato soup | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili powder
instructions: Add baby carrots, olive oil, tomato soup, soup and chili powder to a medium size pot, stirring to mix well. Simmer for 20 - 30 minutes, or until carrots are well cooked. Let cool, and place the shredded carrots into a resealable plastic bag with the remaining ingredients and shake until mixed. It will look curdled but in the end it will be. Store in the refrigerator up to 5 days. To serve, thaw just before serving.

title: Beef Noodle Bake
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat or 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite sized chunks | 1 jar sliced mushrooms | 1 package sliced pepperoni | 2 eggs, slightly beaten | 1 box frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained | 1/2 cup chopped of fresh mint or 1/2 cup basil | 3 cups cooked linguine | 1 loaf italian bread, sliced and toasted
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Spray a 9x13 dish with nonstick cooking spray. In a skillet, cook chicken over medium heat until no longer pink. Remove. Add mushrooms and pepperoni. Cook, stirring frequently, 3 minutes or until vegetables are tender crisp. Drain off fat. Stir in spinach, mint or basil. Arrange toasted bread, meat mixture, and spinach mixture in the bottom of the toasted pan. Top with broiled or baked linguine. Note, this dish can be prepared ahead. Prep time does not include 2 hours cooking time.

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,cumin,pork fillet,beer,orange zest,chorizo sausage,milk,white bread
title: Chorizo and Pork (Portuguese)
ingredients: 500 g pork fillets, cubed | 400 g chorizo sausage, sliced | 3 tablespoons white bread, crumb | 3 tablespoons milk | 1 teaspoon orange zest | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 2 tablespoons beer
instructions: Drain off any excess fat from the chorizo and sausage and combine with the bread on a plate. Preheat oven to 180c. Lightly grease with oil, then spread the bread into a shallow baking dish. Bake in the oven for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Meanwhile, make the rub by combining the rub ingredients and stir well. Combine all the ingredients, season with salt and pepper. Sprinkle the spice mix onto the pork, mix and pour into the baking dish. Smooth the top under the pork, add water to the oven, then turn the temperature down to 140c. Bake in the oven for 20 - 25 minutes until the pork is cooked through and falling off the bone.

title: Spicy Applesauce
ingredients: 2 g cornflour | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 teaspoon dried red chilies, crushed | 3 tablespoons chopped spring onions | 1 packet firm tofu or ( 700 g ) packet gluten-free range eggs
instructions: Place all the ingredients into a saucepan over a medium heat and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes until thick.

title: Radish and Radish Salad
ingredients: 1 bunch radish, washed and trimmed | 1 tablespoon mustard powder
instructions: Mix together the mustard and radish in a serving dish. Serve straight away.

title: Spicy Beef for Two (With Chilli & Pistachio)
ingredients: 500 g rump steak, sliced diagonally | 2 tablespoons sweet mustard, dijon ( gluten-free, if required ) | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 1 cup quick-cooking barley, uncooked | 1/2 cup pistachios, chopped ( optional )
instructions: In a large frypan, combine the mustard and oil and fry until fragrant. Add the beef and stir fry until brown. Sprinkle in the barley and pistachios. Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer for about 10 minutes, or until beef is tender. Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,ziti pasta,bailey irish cream,fish sauce,gruyere cheese
title: Baked Ziti With Cheese and Whiskey
ingredients: 300 g ziti pasta | 400 g gruyere cheese | 150 g basmati rice | 3/4 cup baileys irish cream | 2 tablespoons fish sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c cut the cheese and place in an ovenproof dish, pour over the remaining ingredients. Bake until the cheese softens and starts to set, 30 mins to an hour.

title: Lobster Tortilla Pie
ingredients: 1 1/4 - 1 1/2 lbs lobsters, cut in half lengthwise | 1 orange peel | 1 tablespoon anise extract or 1 tablespoon almond extract | 1/2 teaspoon flour substitute or 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 5 eggs | 16 ounces tomatoes, chopped | 10 -15 small flour tortillas
instructions: Cook the lobster and orange peel in boiling water to cover. Drain and cool. Remove meat from shells. Crumb the shells as fine as possible. Beat eggs and extract together and stir in the lobster. Add tomatoes and chopped green peppers and nuts. Place mixture in a buttered 9 by 13 inch pan, cover and bake in preheated oven 325°f for 40 minutes. Uncover and bake until golden brown and filling is puffed and browning. Let set for an additional 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: rum,phyllo dough,caster sugar,serrano chili,yellow bell pepper,pineapple,vegetable oil
title: Bahama Mama's Prawns Wrapped in Spicy Pineapple
ingredients: 500 g of small fresh prawns, raw, shelled and deveined ( prawns ) | 1/2 cup vegetable oil | 1 tablespoon rum | 1 small serrano chili, thinly sliced | 1 yellow bell peppers or 1 other sweet red bell pepper, finely diced into medium thick strips | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 2 sheets phyllo dough
instructions: Heat frypan on high. Add oil and let it heat up. Add prawns and sizzle. Let brown. Season with rum, chilli and sugar. Toss and remove from heat. Lay out filo on kitchen towel and brush with oil. Place the shrimp mixture on the bottom filo. Top with top filo and brush with oil. Fold over and brush with oil. Cook in a hot oven, 450 degrees fahrenheit or until brown.

title: Roasted Beef Jerky
ingredients: 1 pound chuck roast, cut into four | 1/4 cup red pepper | 1/4 cup garlic pepper seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place the beef jerky in a large resealable plastic bag. Combine red pepper, garlic pepper seasoning, and red pepper spice mix in a bowl.

title: Homemade Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 -3 canned plum tomatoes, diced | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | butter or oil | salt and chili flakes
instructions: Drain tomatoes slightly. Add tomato paste, salt and chili flakes. Melt butter or oil in a frying pan, and add diced tomatoes and tomatoes to fry pan. Cook over low heat for about 40 minutes. Serve warm in a bolillo type dish.

Random Ingredients: red food coloring,oil,rice vinegar,hoisin sauce,radish,marshmallow,chat masala
title: Roasted Radish Salad (Nhieu X
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs radishes | 3 tablespoons hoisin sauce | 2 green radishes | 1 tablespoon mild chat masala | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon oil | 1 tablespoon roasted sweet & creamy red food coloring
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl & mix with whisk or electric mixer until smooth. Transfer to a baking sheet & roast at 325 degrees f for 35 to 40 minutes or until tender and crispy. Serve at room temperature or slightly cooled. Variation, for a crispier salad, toast the radishes in a small pan of hot water, uncovered, for a minute or two to crisp. Rinse under cold water & drain. Immediately transfer to a serving bowl & mix with remaining ingredients. Chill.

title: Spicy Espresso Coffee
ingredients: 1 can condensed coffee ( espresso ) | 1/4 cup chili sauce | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Pour coffee into your coffee mug. Pour chili sauce into mug and pour coffee. Stir the living daylights out.

title: Crab Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/2 kg cremini mushrooms | 250 g fresh crab ( can take some of the imitation crab meat ) | 200 g goat cheese | 1/4 teaspoon black mustard seeds
instructions: Clean the mushrooms and wipe dry with a damp cloth. Clean the crab well, removing any shells or digestive flaps that have not been taken up with your fingers. Take the stems out, wash them, dry them and slit them lengthways. Place the crab with some of the goat cheese in the center of each mushroom stem and secure them with toothpicks. Brush the cavities with some of the oil from the crab legs. Add a pinch of black mustard seeds into the cavities. Fold the mushroom caps skin side up in a piece of breadcrumb sized aluminium foil, and pack over the goat cheese pieces. Place in the oven, 180 degrees celsius or 250 degrees fahrenheit. When the mushrooms have gone dark brown, remove from the oven. Let cool off so as not to burn yourself, then slice into quarters when cool enough to handle and serve.

title: Blueberry Sauce Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 package spaghetti sauce | 1 cup greek yogurt | 1 package fajita seasoning mix | 1/2 cup frozen blueberries
instructions: Place sauce in a saucepan, and bring to a boil over medium low heat. In a bowl, mix the crumbles of the spaghetti, greek yogurt, fajita seasoning, and blueberries. Return to boiling, and reduce heat to low. Simmer for 2 to 3 minutes, or until the sauce begins to thicken. Taste, and serve.

Random Ingredients: arrowroot,tomato green chilies,puff pastry,olive oil,basil leaf,green cardamom pod,kentucky bourbon,bacon
title: Easy Fish & Bacon Parcels
ingredients: 2 ounces pancetta or 2 ounces bacon, chopped | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 teaspoon arrowroot | 6 ounces kentucky bourbon or 6 ounces other good-quality dark rum | 1 green cardamom pod, pod | 2 fresh basil leaves | 1/2 cup chopped fresh tomato with green chilies or 1/2 cup chopped canned tomato | 4 ounces puff pastry, defrosted
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f cook the pancetta or bacon in olive oil over medium high heat, stirring until browned and crisp. Add arrowroot and heat through. Remove from the heat and discard the cardamom pods and green cardamom pods. Stir in the basil. Add the tomato, pour over the cognac and stir to combine. Lightly defrost for a few minutes, then divide into 2 portions. Roll each portion out on a lightly floured surface to about ¾ inch thick. Cut out 3 circles, about 10 per sheet of puff pastry, each about 5 inches in diameter. Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper. Place a small dab of filling on the centre of each round. Fold the pastry over at a point and crimp the edges with a fork to seal. Line the pastry sheets with parchment paper and bake in the oven for 5 minutes, making sure they have a nice, sharp edge when taken out of the oven. The puff pastry should have browned and risen slightly. Remove to a serving plate and keep warm. Repeat with the remaining puff pastry and filling. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: vinegar,water,basmati rice,chili powder,creamy peanut butter,monterey jack cheese,cottage cheese
title: Mexican Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups water | 1 cup basmati rice | 1 1/2 cups cottage cheese ( or ricotta if you prefer, but i think fat free feta would be yummy! ) | 1/4 cup creamy peanut butter | 3 tablespoons vinegar | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 1 cup grated monterey jack cheese
instructions: Add the water and rice to a saucepan and bring to a boil. Cover and turn off the heat. Let sit for about 10 minutes. In a large bowl, whisk together the cottage cheese and creamy peanut butter until combined. Add the vinegar and chili powder, mix well. Then add in the cottage cheese mixture. Turn off the heat. Cover and chill at least 2 hours. When ready to serve, toss together with shredded cheese.

Random Ingredients: irish cream,adobo seasoning,walnut oil,bamboo shoot,prosciutto,apple juice,italian seasoning
title: Baked Mexican Bacon
ingredients: 4 slices prosciutto, cut into 1 1/2 inch chunks | 1 cup unsweetened apple juice | 1/3 cup chopped walnut oil | 1/3 cup finely chopped prosciutto | 1 teaspoon adobo seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 1 can bamboo shoots, rinsed and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a 1 1/2 quart casserole dish, combine the prosciutto, apple juice, walnut oil, prosciutto, prosciutto, adobo seasoning, bamboo shoots, and wine. Mix well. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake, covered, 1 hour and 15 minutes, or until crisp.

Random Ingredients: wine,romano cheese,pinto bean,green pea,beef sausage,onion flake,pomegranate juice,linguine
title: Sausage With Pomegranate Nests and Noodles
ingredients: 12 ounces lean lean linguine, preferably whole wheat, preferably whole wheat | 1 tablespoon dehydrated onion flakes | 1 cup pinto beans or 1 cup pink beans, rinsed in a colander | 1 cup frozen green pea | 14 1/2 ounces low-sodium v8 beef sausage | 1/2 teaspoon dried parsley or 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/4 cup sweet wine or 1/4 cup water | 2 tablespoons pomegranate juice
instructions: Cook noodles, according to package directions. Drain. Reserve half of the cooking water. Drain remainder of the cooking water and toss with noodles. Rinse casings in a couple of changes of water. Slice sausage diagonally. Cut peas diagonally into 3/4 inch lengths. Cut noodles diagonally into wedges. Stir parsley into noodles. Put noodles in a serving bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate, covered, for up to about 6 hours. Drain meat, reserving 1/4 cup drippings, sausage drippings, and seasonings. Heat 1 teaspoon drained sausage drippings in a large, deep heavy skillet over high heat. Add noodle mixture, spreading it evenly. Cook 1 minute, stirring often. Reduce heat to medium. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cook, stirring constantly, until noodles are browned, about 10 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Easy English Cucumber Salad for One
ingredients: 1 english cucumber ( about 1 cup size ) | 1 1 cup ice ( or a small tin of soda or carbonated beverage ) | 6 tablespoons lemon juice or 6 tablespoons lime juice | 1 1/2 teaspoons vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Cut cucumber lengthwise into half moons. Boil or steam for 5 minutes. Set aside and repeat until ice is absorbed. Place cucumber in a small plastic bag with ice. Remove a few ice chunks or spoon out the ice and ice using a slotted spoon. Squeeze ice out of bag and put in bowl. Cut remaining ice in half and add with the lemon juice, vinegar, and baking powder to empty ice chunks or soda in bowl. Mix well. Serve immediately. Note, if using soda instead of lemon juice add 1/4 tsp of salt.

Random Ingredients: greek yogurt,food coloring,spring onion,cauliflower,red potato,orange peel
title: Low Fat and Colourful Vegetarian Fruity Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 8 small red potatoes, like english one | 3 spring onions, finely chopped | 2 medium cauliflower, broken into florets | 2 tablespoons orange peel, grated | 4 tablespoons fat free greek yogurt | food coloring
instructions: Boil potatoes until tender. In a separate pot, fry onions in the 1 tbsp of oil or in another pan, till fragrant. Add all vegetables except yogurt to potato pot, and mix well. Add yogurt. Mix well, and add colouring. Cook 10 - 20 minutes on low heat till veggie mixture is well cooked. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chickpea,tuna water,hard cheese,cake yeast,meat,pimiento,poblano chile,white wine vinegar
title: Pepapas With Tuna
