ingredients: 1/3 cup white wine vinegar | 1 cup minced meat | 3 teaspoons minced pimientos | 2 hard cheese, cut into 1/4 `` thick rounds | 1 can chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 1/2 1/2 cup canned tuna in water or 1/2 cup water | 1 cake yeast, room temperature ( optional ) or 3 teaspoons yeast, powder enhancer ( optional ) | 3 -5 poblano chiles or 3 -5 jalapeno chiles, seeded and cut into 1/4 inch rounds | olive oil or ghee, for frying
instructions: For the pepapas. Combine vinegar, meat, pimiento, cheese, chickpeas and the chickpea water. Stir in yeast. Dissolve the yeast and the liquid in the vinegar mixture. Add the bread rounds. Cover a large bowl and let rise in a warm place until doubled in volume about 1 - ½ hours. Roll dough into small balls and place on baking sheets. Cover with plastic wrap to keep moist. Preheat the oven to 350°f. Brush with oil or ghee and place the chiles on the oiled pan. Bake, turning occasionally, until the chiles are golden brown, about 15 minutes. Remove from the oven and immediately dip the chiles in hot oil in a bowl of warm water. Remove from the pan. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: cherry,thyme,green olive,colby monterey jack cheese,honey,triple sec
title: Capirotada
ingredients: 8 ounces colby-monterey jack cheese | 8 ounces sour cherry or 8 ounces black grapes | 1 cup fresh cherries or 1 cup pitted olives | 1/4 cup triple sec or 1/4 cup rum | 1/2 cup honey | 1/8 teaspoon thyme
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a shallow dish until well blended. Chill in refrigerator for 4 hours, stirring or shaking pan occasionally. To serve, garnish with orange slices.

title: Curried Cremini Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 cremini mushrooms | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 teaspoon curry paste
instructions: In a nonstick fry pan, add soy sauce and curry paste. Add mushrooms and cook for 1 - 2 minutes on the high heat, stirring occasionally. Serve sprinkled with chopped cashews or peanuts.

title: Roasted Shallot - Kosher
ingredients: 2 shallots, cleaned and thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon garlic powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Arrange shallots on a baking sheet and coat with garlic powder. Bake in the preheated oven until fragrant and starting to caramelize, about 30 minutes.

title: Green Papaya With Hot Chili
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil | 2 -3 fresh chilies | 200 g coconut cream | 2 tablespoons fish sauce
instructions: Slice the papamis into 4 thick circles place them on a shallow baking tray covered w/butter. Brush both sides w/olive oil, bake uncovered in a moderate oven until crisp. Heat the chilies in a frying pan on medium heat for about 1 - 2 min, or until the chilies are dark in color, then set aside. In the same pan toast the coconut cream over medium low heat, stirring it constantly to avoid burning. The mixture tends to thicken, so watch the mixture closely. Stir in the turmeric until it is thoroughly incorporated. Stir in the papamis until it is totally incorporated and continue to stir in the coconut cream. Taste and add extra fish sauce if needed. Spoon onto the papamis.

title: Homemade Beef Brisket
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs stewing beef | 3 tablespoons shortening | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1 cup boiling coffee, hot
instructions: Cut the brisket in half and remove excess fat and undesirable pieces of brisket. Soak the brisket in cold water for an hour, and then drain in towels. Combine the shortening, chili powder and coffee and rub the mixture through the meat. Tie the brisket closed or wrap tightly in aluminum foil. Bake in 325 degree f oven for 3 hours, remove the brisket, and cook again in 325 degree f oven for 2 hours, or until very tender. Remove from the oven, place in a warmed serving dish and cover with boiling water. Cover and cook for 45 minutes. Remove the foil and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: maple syrup,tilapia fillet,vanilla essence,rack lamb,grain dijon mustard,bell pepper,sirloin
title: Maple Mustard & Pepper Slather
ingredients: 4 ounces whole grain dijon mustard | 10 ounces lean boneless sirloin, cut into 1 inch chunks | 8 ounces beef tlsp. boneless rib racks, excess fat, and fat trimmed | 4 ounces bell peppers, cut into 1 inch pieces | 8 ounces maple syrup | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Combine mustard and 1/3 cup cold water until thoroughly blended. Place beef and 2 tablespoons mustard mixture in a shallow roasting pan. Add peppers and pork slices. Top meat with remaining mustard mixture. Cover dish with aluminum foil, and bake until meat is just cooked through, about 30 minutes.

title: Spicy Indian Noodle Salad
ingredients: 200 g pasta, any shape, broken | 4 green enchilada sauce | 1 english cucumber, sliced | 50 fresh coriander, chopped | 50 g pine nuts
instructions: Boil water and cook the pasta just until tender, but not mushy, drain. Transfer to a large serving bowl and add the green enchilada sauce. Scatter over the sliced cucumber, coriander and pine nuts. Toss lightly.

Random Ingredients: gouda cheese,peanut oil,haricot bean,onion soup mix,sultana,superfine sugar,marmalade,cottage cheese
title: St. Patrick's Day Friands
ingredients: 12 ounces gouda cheese | 1 ounce apricot beans | 14 ounces cottage cheese | 2 teaspoons superfine sugar | 2 ounces sultanas | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 1 teaspoon peanut oil | 1 teaspoon mccormick's marmalade
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c / 400°f. Chop cheese and herbs into medium fine chunks, place in casserole dish and cover with milk. Bake in oven for 20 minutes, stirring every so often. In the meantime heat up the oil in a frying pan, add the sultanas and allow to soften. When cheese has baked for 20 mins sprinkle the onion soup mix over and stir until dissolved, mix in drained beans and half the cheese and herbs. Replace the lid and bake for a further 10 minutes. Serve in shallow bowls and sprinkle the remaining cheese over the top.

title: Baked Prunes With Balsamic Reduction
ingredients: 3 cups pitted prunes | 1/2 cup balsamic vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves | 2 slices whole grain bread, toasted
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees. Place prunes in a small bowl and cover with boiling water.

title: Tasty Bread Machine Bread
ingredients: 4 ounces self raising flour | 1 ounce cheese, grated | 1 teaspoon rum ( to taste )
instructions: Place the breadmaker in the order specified. Press start. When done sprinkle with cheese and rum. Serve with cream and butter.

title: Creamy French Pork
ingredients: 4 lbs boneless pork roast | 1 lb white mushroom | 1/3 cup heavy cream, warmed
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Put roast in a dutch oven and cover with water. Simmer until tender, about 3 hours. Remove roast. Drain and shred with 2 forks. Reserve 1 cup broth and keep the rest in stockpot. Add mushrooms to the stockpot. Cook until tender, about 20 minutes. Strain off all but 1 cup of the cooking liquid. Stir in cream and remove from heat. Serve with crusty bread.

title: Beef Chuck Roast and Squash
ingredients: 1 boneless beef chuck, trimmed of excess fat | 8 squash, cut into 2-inch-thick rounds
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place chuck roast into a 2 quart roasting pan. Place squash rounds onto meaty sides of roast, taking care not to cover all of the roast's surface area. If you prefer, you can spread squash out evenly. If you prefer, lay a sheet of aluminum foil on top of the roast, then cover with foil. Place pan into preheated oven and bake until meat is very tender, 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: dijon mustard,hot italian sausage,vanilla sugar,sunflower seed,crouton,bite mozzarella cheese ball
title: Hot and Cold Italian Sausage Dip
ingredients: 500 g bite size fresh mozzarella cheese balls ( about 12 cubes ) | 1 small hot italian sausage, casings removed, crumbly ( casing removed ) | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon vanilla sugar | 500 g croutons, freshly toasted | 1 tablespoon sunflower seeds, toasted
instructions: Put everything in a food processor and mix well with a fork until thoroughly combined.

Random Ingredients: lemon,plum tomato,taco seasoning,wonton wrapper,wheat flour,burgundy wine,pine nut
title: Easy Won Tons
ingredients: 1 cup whole wheat flour | 1 package taco seasoning | 10 wonton wrappers | 1/4 cup pine nuts | 1/3 cup light burgundy wine | 1 small plum tomato, diced | 1/4 cup grated fresh lemon rind
instructions: Mix flour and taco seasoning in medium bowl. Put a tablespoon of the mixture in middle of won ton wrapper and brush the top with a bit of water. Lift over and press edges together then invert on plate. Repeat until finished wrappers are filled. Toast pine nuts in oven or under broiler. Sprinkle with rind and cool for 1 minute. Spoon plum tomato and pine nuts over won ton and top with grated lemon rind.

title: Cranberry Veal Taco Filling
ingredients: vegetable juice cocktail | nutritional yeast | cranberries ( fresh or frozen, or canned )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,tart apple,hamburger,garlic,olive,cremini mushroom,vegetable broth
title: Apple Mushroom Burger
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 2 tablespoons vegetable broth | 1 tablespoon dried minced garlic | 1/2 cup sliced cremini mushrooms | 2 tablespoons olive, chopped | 1/2 pound shaved hamburger | 3 tart apples - peeled, cored, and sliced thin
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Mix the soup, garlic, and cremini mushrooms together in a small bowl. Add the olive, then layer with the cooked hamburger, and top with the soup mixture.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,yellow mustard seed,white bread,parsley,red chilies
title: Chinese Bread Crumbs
ingredients: 250 g bread, firm and crusty is best | 250 g white bread or 250 g bread | 2 -3 dried red chilies | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 2 teaspoons yellow mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon fresh parsley, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Using a loaf pan, scoop out as much crust from the crust as you can. Roughly chop up the crusty bread and put it in a bowl with the bread cubes. Mix the soaked and dry chillies very well. In a small bowl, mix together the sesame seeds and mustard seeds. Using a teaspoon, carefully drop the mustard and sesame seeds onto breadcrumbs. Mix well. Transfer the breadcrumbs to a well greased surface and press them firmly into the cuts of the bread using your hands. Place the bread crumbs on a baking sheet lined with baking paper. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes or until golden. Sprinkle each cut with a little more sesame seeds if desired.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,rice wine,green onion,ice,bamboo shoot
title: Bamboo Shoot Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 tablespoon rice wine or 1 tablespoon mirin | 1 -2 green onion, coarsely chopped ( optional ) | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained diced ( optional ) | salt and black pepper | 5 cups cold leftover cooked rice ( i use jasmine or jasmine )
instructions: In a small bowl, combine rice wine and onions. Slice the ends off the bamboo shoots and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Set aside. Pour the rice, wine onion mixture, and green bamboo shoots into a large non stick skillet over high heat. Stir and fry until the rice has become translucent. Turn the heat to medium and quickly add the cold cooked rice. Stir fry until the rice is hot and the bottom is lightly browned. Do not over stir. Serve.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,wheat tortilla,crescent dinner,fennel seed,white wine
title: Chef John's Favorite Quesadillas
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups quesadilla points ( whole wheat tortillas ) or 1 1/2 cups crescent dinner rolls, divided | 2 ounces chunky salsa | 1/4 teaspoon dried fennel seed, or to taste | 1 1/2 tablespoons white wine or 1 1/2 tablespoons water, divided | 1 tablespoon grated parmesan cheese, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Spread 1/2 cup quesadilla points onto a 2 inch round cookie sheet. Let stand until softened, about 10 minutes. Heat a skillet over medium high heat. Meanwhile, lightly toast remaining quesadilla points. In a small bowl, stir together salsa and fennel seeds. Spread 1 1/2 tablespoons wine or water over 1 tortilla. Spread 1 heaping 1/2 teaspoon salsa mixture evenly over salsa mixture. Sprinkle with 1/4 teaspoon parmesan cheese. Fold over half of remaining quesadilla points, and gently press into other side of quesadilla. Place on a baking sheet. Place quesadillas in a single layer on top of uncoated pan. Repeat process with remaining quesadilla points, salsa mixture, and parmesan cheese. Spray the outside of quesadillas with cooking spray. Bake quesadillas in the middle of a preheated 375 degrees f oven until quesadillas are puffed up and lightly browned, about 10 minutes. Allow to cool 5 minutes before taking them out of the oven. Cut into wedges.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,steak,russet potato,beef bouillon,white mushroom
title: Savory Steak With Potatoes
ingredients: 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 1 1/4 tablespoons beef bouillon, sodium reduced | 1 medium russet potato, unpeeled, cut in 1/2-inch cubes | 2 ounces mushrooms, cleaned and sliced | 2 1/2 lbs boneless round steaks, trimmed of excess fat
instructions: Prepare marinade, to make marinade, combine vinegar, bouillon, potato, and mushrooms in a bowl.

title: Quick  Beef Crusted Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 trimmed beef tenderloin
instructions: Slice tenderloin into 4 even pieces. Place meat in shallow dish and coat with flour. Heat oven to 325°f bake 20 minutes. Remove from oven and place tenderloins on top.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,chili bean sauce,red wine,orange zest,salami,canola oil
title: Chilli and Pepper Bean Baked Beans
ingredients: 2 tablespoons canola oil | 50 g dried chili bean sauce ( or to taste ) | 1 teaspoon grated orange zest | 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 125 ml red wine or 125 ml white wine | 25 g pecorino romano cheese, finely grated
instructions: Heat oven to 200c/180c if fan forced, remove rack from oven. Heat oil and chile in a small frying pan over medium heat. Cook, stirring often, for 1 - 2 minutes or until fragrant. Remove from heat and stir through beans. Transfer bean mixture to a 2l ovenproof dish and top with red wine or white wine. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake under fan for 20 minutes or until golden.

Random Ingredients: creole seasoning,lime wedge,bread flour,fettuccine,vanilla bean,lemon zest
title: Creamy Fettucine Fritters
ingredients: 12 ounces fettuccine | 1/2 lemon, zest of, grated | 4 tablespoons creole seasoning | 2 -4 teaspoons pure vanilla beans ( or other flavorful extract ) | lemon wedge ( to garnish ) ( optional ) | bread flour ( as needed )
instructions: Heat a deep frying pan to medium heat. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Meanwhile, remove and discard the base of the rind from the grated lemon zest. Slice the zest about 1/4 inch thick with the side of a large knife. Place the zest in a small bowl and toss with 1 tablespoon of creole seasoning. Stir the remaining 1/2 tablespoon creole seasoning into the lemon zest and stir in the vanilla bean pulp. Reserve the lemon zest for a later use. Drop the pasta into the boiling water, stir once, and cook until al dente about 2 minutes. Drain well and return to the mixing bowl. Toss with more of the hot creole seasoning if desired. Season to taste with lemon wedges, if using. Serve at once with lemon wedges, a wedge of lemon, a wedge of fresh lemon, or one of a lemon wedge per bite for garnish.

title: Linguine with Clam Sauce
ingredients: 8 small clams, scrubbed | 4 ounces linguine | 2 tablespoons unsweetened applesauce | garlic powder to taste | salt and ground white pepper to taste | 2 flour tortillas
instructions: Put clams and linguine in a large pot of salted water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium low and simmer, covered, until clams open, about 6 minutes. Drain.

Random Ingredients: red onion,raspberry jelly,oregano leaf,vanilla essence,white pepper,cheddar cheese,rigatoni pasta
title: Raspberry Cheese and Olive Pasta
ingredients: 500 g rigatoni pasta | 1 tablespoon dried oregano leaves | 500 g red onions, peeled and finely chopped | 500 g mature cheddar cheese, grated | 300 g raspberry jelly or 300 g raspberry jam | 1 tablespoon fresh ground white pepper | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Bring a large saucepan of salted water to the boil. Add the rigatoni and cook uncovered for 12 - 15 minutes or until tender. Drain and leave the pasta and a few under running water. While the rigatoni is cooking, place the onions in a pan with around 3 tbsp olive oil, 2 tbsp vegetable oil, about 2 tbsp sugar or 3 tbsp honey. Cook for 1 minute, then remove from the heat. Add the cheese and herbs, and mix together. Place half the rigatoni in a large bowl and add the red onion and the cheese mixture. Blend the remaining rigatoni with the cheese mixture, stirring until all the cheese mixture is well blended. Return to the pan, and then add the raspberry or raspberry jelly. Stir all the ingredients together until well combined.

Random Ingredients: dijon mustard,cocoa powder,coffee,strawberry,tequila,sun tomato pesto,self raising flour
title: Smoked Tomato Mojo Cake
ingredients: 2 cups self-raising flour | 1/2 cup cocoa powder | 1 teaspoon instant coffee | 300 g mixed dried strawberries | 175 g sun-dried tomato pesto ( drained ) | 200 ml good quality strong hot coffee | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon tequila
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c line 2 baking trays with baking paper. Place the flour, cocoa powder and instant coffee into a bowl. Add the strawberries, sun dried tomatoes and pesto. Mix gently with hands until all the dough comes together. Using wet hands, work the mixture into a firm dough. Turn the dough onto a lightly floured surface and use your hands to smooth it out. Roll lightly to form a circle about 12 inches in diameter. Place the cake on the prepared trays and flatten it slightly. Press out the circle. Brush the cake with coffee, then sprinkle with the tequila. Bake for 40 minutes or until the centre of the cake is set and nicely browned. Set aside for 5 minutes. Turn onto a wire rack and stand while you make the coffee syrup. For coffee syrup, combine all ingredients in a bowl and stir until well combined. For whiskey syrup, combine all ingredients in a pan and cook for approx 5 mins or until thick. If needed, cook longer.

title: Baked  Ropa Vieja With  Cheddar  Fondue
ingredients: 2 cups gebhardt cheese | 2 quarts homemade chick-peas, rinsed ( garbanzo beans ) | 4 ounces of thick-sliced pork, cut into small pieces | 2 cups semisoft semisoft semisoft cheese | 4 cans chick-peas | 4 cups black coffee | 12 large pistachios, in the jar
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Coat a 1 quart shallow baking dish with a thin layer of oil. Mince cheese using food processor. Combine chickpeas and pork in a mixing bowl. Dice remaining cheese with a fork coarsely. Stir cheese into meat mixture, and then transfer meat mixture into a baking dish. Cover with foil, and bake 1 hour, stirring occasionally, or until heated through. When ready, remove foil, and bake 1 cup of chocloate in oven for 5 - 20 minutes on middle rack. Remove from oven, stir, and serve immediately with tortillas, sour cream, and crumbled feta vinagrette. Variation, replace the cheese with cheddar flavored grated. To freeze, place cheese in a plastic bag and place in freezer. To use, thaw, then place on a separate dish in the freezer. To bake, preheat oven to 350°f. Place the chick peas in a large saucepan, cover, and bring to a boil. Cook 3 - 5 minutes until heated through. Transfer cooked peas to a food processor or blender, and blend until smooth. Pour sauce into baking dish, and coat with 1/4 cup oil. Bake about 20 minutes, then remove from oven, cover, and bake another 5 or 10 minutes until bubbly. To serve, remove cheese from baking dish, but leave a small crater, and place it in a serving bowl. Drain chick peas very well and spread them around with cheese. Pour black pepper over the cheese, and top with 1 1/2 tablespoons of chocloate. Serve immediately.

title: Mexican Vanilla Beans
ingredients: 3 teaspoons cumin powder | 1/2 cup real vanilla beans
instructions: Put all of the above ingredients into the coffee maker. Blend at high speed for 25 seconds. Let cool a bit, then enjoy.

title: Green Olives and Molasses
ingredients: 3 cups green olives, in the sun, halved | 1 1/2 cups molasses | 2 jalapeno peppers
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 2 to 3 quart sauce pan. Bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to low.

title: Mexican Rice
ingredients: 1/4 cup grated mexican blend cheese | 1/4 cup finely chopped cooked carrot | 1 -2 tablespoon chopped red chili pepper | 2 cups risotto rice, cooked
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 2 quart casserole dish. Cover. Bake at 375 degrees for 30 minutes or until ingredients are heated through serve with crusty french bread.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella cheese,brown sugar,lime zest,cornflour,kosher salt,focaccia bread
title: BBQ Grilled Mozzarella & Lime Focaccia Sandwiches
ingredients: 8 slices focaccia bread | 16 slices of smoked mozzarella cheese | 4 tablespoons fresh lime zest, coarsely grated from 2 limes | 1/4 cup brown sugar | 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt | 2 tablespoons cornflour
instructions: Toast one side of each focaccia bread slice on both sides. Spread 1 tablespoon of the lime zest, combined with the brown sugar, salt and 1 tablespoon of the cornflour onto the cut side of 8 slices of the bread. Top each of the 8 slices of focaccia bread with a slice of the smoked mozzarella. Wrap each piece of focaccia in a piece of the foil and place on grill. Grill for 1 to 2 minutes or until the sandwich is firm and toasty. To serve, cut each piece in half and fan the halves out on a board, top with a slice or two of grilled cheese. To serve, put the sandwiches on a warmed plate and spoon some of the remaining lime zest & lime juices over the sandwiches.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,bacon dripping,saffron thread,salmon fillet,apricot preserve
title: Smoked Salmon With Saffron
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets | 1 tablespoon saffron threads | 1/4 cup apricot preserves | 1/4 cup bacon drippings or 1/4 cup other fat | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds
instructions: Preheat over to 450 degrees. Combine saffron and apricot preserves in small bowl and set aside. Wash fillets and pat dry with paper towels. Dip in saffron mixture and then in sesame seeds. Place fillets in a sprayed skillet on medium high heat. Cook until golden, about 3 minutes per side. Transfer to platter, cover and keep hot.

title: Wild Rice and Swiss Cheese Fondue
ingredients: 1 package wild rice, cooked and drained | 4 slices swiss cheese | 2 cans white beans, drained, rinsed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Melt swiss cheese on greased and floured table and set aside. Cut a circle out of the rice with a 4 inch diameter piece of cheese. Carefully put half of the swiss cheese into the center of the circle, then place a slice of swiss cheese around the cheese. Top with second circle of rice and then the white beans. Place finished cheese circle onto a cookie sheet and bake at 350 for 10 minutes, or until cheese has melted and is beginning to lightly brown lightly. Remove from oven, add remaining swiss cheese and return to low oven.. Cook for 15 - 20 minutes more, or until cheese is melted and fondue is slightly browned.

title: Orange Tilapia With Raisins and Raisins
ingredients: 2 tilapia fillets | 2 tablespoons oil | 1 cup golden raisin | 1 cup mandarin oranges, drained and sliced ( orange sections )
instructions: Brush 1 tbsp of oil on a skillet. Lightly brown the tilapia. Place it on the bottom of a baking dish. Sprinkle 1/2 cup of raisins and 1/2 cup of mandarin oranges into it. Add another tablespoon of oil. Sprinkle remaining 1/2 cup raisins and 1/2 cup of mandarin oranges around the tilapia. Cover tightly with aluminum foil and bake in 350 degree oven for 30 minutes.

title: Mixed Spice Blend
ingredients: 1 tablespoon szechuan peppercorns | 1 tablespoon dried oregano | 1/4 cup olive, sliced
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Store in airtight container.

Random Ingredients: chicken liver,margarine,pastry shell,slab bacon,extra large egg,lemon
title: Liver & Bacon Tarts
ingredients: 1/4 lb thick slab bacon | 1 1/4 lbs chicken livers, trimmed | 1 tablespoon fat | 1 lemon, rind of, grated | 1 1/4 lbs pastry shells, puff type ( ready-made ) | extra-large egg
instructions: Put the bacon fat in a heavy skillet, add the livers, and fry until done. Remove from the pan and let cool down. Meanwhile, put the pastry shells on a baking tray. Lightly dust them with flour and put on a baking tray. Lightly butter them and line the tart tins with a circle of parchment. Cut the bacon slices in half, place on the pastry shells, and bake at 425 f for 10 minutes, lower the oven temp to 300 f and bake for 20 minutes longer. Put the prawns in the toaster and pour in a little warm salted water, then squeeze lemon rind over the prawns. Serve with slices of red onion tossed with some black pepper and a drizzle of lemon dressing.

title: Kielbasa for Danish Pasta
ingredients: 2 pounds kielbasa, cut into 1-inch slices | 2 tablespoons pistachio, coarsely chopped
instructions: Cook kielbasa in a pot over medium heat until browned, 5 to 10 minutes. Transfer sausage to a bowl.

title: Creamy Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 2 pork tenderloins, with bone attached | 2 tablespoons almond flour | 2 cans cream of celery soup
instructions: Using meat tenderizer, sprinkle almond flour onto cut surface near the bone. Roll up and tie with string. Place into a dutch oven. Stir in cream of celery soup and cover. Simmer, approximately 2 hours, and check to make sure the sauce is not too thin. Remove string and serve.

title: Chili Beef
ingredients: 3/4 lb thinly sliced raw beef | 8 ounces chili paste
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large saucepan. Heat until boiling and simmer for 30 minutes, stirring frequently until thickened. Serve over steak, noodles or rice.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,mint leaf,saffron thread,crystal sugar,fish sauce,rom tomato,splenda sugar substitute,rye flour
title: Crispy Tomato Pakoras
ingredients: 4 large roma tomatoes | 2 tablespoons saffron threads | 2 teaspoons dried mint leaves, lightly crushed | 2 teaspoons dried sweetner sugar substitute | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 1 pinch saffron sugar substitute | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala | 5 -6 teaspoons splenda sugar substitute | 1/2 teaspoon powdered cardamom ( optional )
instructions: Wash tomatoes lightly and slice thinly lengthwise in quarters. Slice thin on bias. Mix all marinade ingredients together in a small bowl, adding saffron. Place tomatoes and tomato slices on baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Sprinkle sugar substitute onto tomatoes. Sprinkle powdered cardamom onto tomatoes. Bake at 350f for 30 - 40 minutes, stirring now and then. Serve with naan bread.

Random Ingredients: guacamole,cherry,double cream,icing sugar,chili bean,meat tenderizer,english muffin,salt
title: Sizzlin' English Muffins
ingredients: 50 g meat tenderizer | 1 pinch salt | 375 g meat, grilled | 200 g cherry beans, conserve | 375 g guacamole ( or any other spicy flavour, your choice ) | 375 double cream | 1 pinch chili beans ( or any other chilli ) | 4 tablespoons icing sugar | 4 english muffins
instructions: Rub the tenderizer on the meat, season with salt and allow to rest in the fridge for about 10 minutes. Cut the conserve into small pieces. Mix the guacamole with the cream, chilli beans and a little of the meat tenderizer. Fold in the conserve. Divide between 2 large paper towelled muffins, or a large, sturdy cookie sheet. Bake in a moderate oven. Serve immediately.

title: The Perfect No-Stick No-Yolk Tomato Sauce With Prosciutto
ingredients: 1/2 cup cooking oil | 1 can no-salt-added diced tomatoes ( italian style, no salt added ) | 1/2 cup nonfat milk | 1/2 lb prosciutto, thinly sliced
instructions: Heat the cooking oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add the chopped tomatoes and simmer them for 5 minutes, stirring constantly. Add the nonfat milk and simmer, stirring often, for 5 minutes more, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat. While tomatoes are cooking, place prosciutto into a small frying pan and cook over medium high heat, turning occasionally, for 3 minutes, or until crispy. Remove from heat. When sauce is done, place sauce over medium heat, stirring gently and continuously. Cook until desired thickness is achieved. It should be about the consistency of a thick mayonnaise.

title: Soy Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon light corn syrup | 1 fresh orange, peeled and sectioned
instructions: Whisk together the corn syrup and orange peel in a glass or small saucepan over low heat. Increase heat if necessary to maintain a simmer, and cook until the mixture has reduced by one third, about 30 minutes. A food processor can be used, but it should take 20 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool slightly. Pour into a jar and store in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: red pepper,vanilla,mexican cheese,green cardamom pod,cumin,irish cream
title: Mexican Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 package mexican cheese, blend ( i used a blend that would be cut into smaller squares ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground red pepper | 1/8 teaspoon ground red pepper | 1/8 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 -2 tablespoon green cardamom pod, pods | 1 dash ground irish cream ( optional ) or 1 dash amexican vanilla flavored creamer ( optional ) | 1 dash vanilla ( optional )
instructions: Spray 9x13 or larger metal pyrex dish with pam. Mix together cheese, peppers, spices, and irish cream. Spread in dish.. Top with remaining cheese. Cover with foil. Bake in preheated 350 degree oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until bubbly. Let stand for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Herbed and Spicy Italian Meat Loaf
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground pepperoni | 1 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 1/4 cup minced parmesan cheese | 1/8 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/8 teaspoon rose water | white pepper, to taste
instructions: In a small bowl, combine pepperoni, bread crumbs, parmesan cheese, oregano and rosewater. Season with white pepper, to taste. Press into a loaf pan, if using pan. Bake 350 degrees for 45 minutes, or until done. Remove loaf. Let stand 10 minutes before slicing. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Achiote-Ginger Cheese Dip (Queso Blanca)
ingredients: 2 lbs american cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup achiote paste ( achiote paste ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground ginger
instructions: Place all ingredients in a food processor or blender and pulse until the mixture is smooth and creamy. Transfer mixture to a crock and refrigerate several hours before serving.

title: Caribbean Chicken and Portabella
ingredients: 20 pieces french bread | 20 pieces chicken drumettes | 8 ounces sliced portabella mushrooms | 1 cup shredded coconut
instructions: Preheat broiler. Place bread on broiler pan. Sprinkle with 1 pound of chicken and 1/2 cup of coconut and put top pieces of bread on top. Broil for 1 to 2 minutes until crispy and brown.

title: Baked Macaroni and Eggs
ingredients: 1 lb elbow macaroni | 1 lb bread | 3 eggs
instructions: Cook macaroni until it is just a little underdone. Drain and cool. Break eggs in a frying pan and cook until they are cooked all the way. In an oven proof dish, layer of bread on the bottom and sides.

title: Romesco
ingredients: 20 g pumpkin seeds | 2 sheets tequila | 1 teaspoon corn oil | 3 1/2 cups plain flour
instructions: Preheat oven to moderate 180c or 356f. Roll out each sheet of tequila onto parchment paper and then roll up like you would for a jelly roll. Brush with a little oil and use to line a baking tray. Set aside. Place seeds in a bowl of water. Bring water to the boil and reduce to a simmer. Set aside to cool slightly then remove seeds using a slotted spoon. Place all seeds into a food processor. Pour in 2 teaspoons of water and process until smooth. Transfer to a bowl and set aside. Sift together the flour and remaining tequila. Place the 3 1/2 tablespoons of the corn oil in a bowl. Add the seeds and combine well. Dough will be very dry. Roll out dough to 5 mm thick then cut into 4 - 5 mm rounds. Place on baking tray, brush with remaining 1 teaspoon oil and bake for 15 - 20 minutes until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: blueberry,tomato paste,icing sugar,beer,brown bread,vanilla extract,curry powder
title: Curried Blueberry Bread Cupcakes With Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 cup shredded blueberries ( fresh or frozen ) | 3/4 cup tomato paste | 3/4 cup brown bread, loaf ( crusts or muffin pan ) | 1 1/4 cups icing sugar | 1 tablespoon curry powder | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/4 cup beer ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f. Line a muffin pan with paper liners. In a bowl, combine the blueberries with the tomato paste, bread and other ingredients, except the cake. Spoon about 1 1/2 teaspoons of the mixture into each cupcake. Bake in the middle of the oven for about 15 minutes, or until golden and set. Cool cakes slightly. Transfer to wire racks.

Random Ingredients: cumin seed,tomato green chile pepper,red cabbage,molasses,baguette,beef chuck,whipping cream
title: Cabbage Beef Pinwheels
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin seeds | 1 pound lean ground beef chuck | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers | 1 cup chopped red cabbage | 1/2 cup chopped sun-dried molasses | 1/4 cup whipping cream | 2 cups shredded red cabbage | 1 baguette, cut into 12 1/2-inch thick slices
instructions: Lightly toast the cumin seeds in a dry skillet over medium low heat.

title: Rajas(Potatoes With Turnips and Fyesh)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 1/2 lbs turnips or 1 1/2 lbs potato, peeled and quartered | 1/4 cup golden raisin | 3 1/2 - 6 ounces swiss cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons mayonnaise | 2 teaspoons garam masala or 2 teaspoons cardamom, powdered | 2 cloves garlic, crushed
instructions: In a large baking dish, preheat the oven to 375 degrees. In a large frying pan, heat the oil on medium high heat. Add the turnip or potatoes and raisins and saute until turning lightly golden, about 10 minutes. Spread the turnip mixture on top of the turnip mixture in the baking dish. Sprinkle the topping over the turnip mixture. Bake for 20 minutes. Add the cheese and sprinkle with garam masala and cloves. Reduce the heat to medium low and brown the cheese for a few minutes longer. Stir to blend the flavors. Serve warm.

title: Perfect Seasoned Herbed Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken bouillon cubes | 1 -2 fresh thyme sprig
instructions: Lay the thyme in a piece of cheesecloth or other fine mesh sieve that has a trivet about 12 inches wide and 6 inches long. Place the bouquet in the center, add about 2 quarts of lightly hot water. Bring to a boil, then skim off any foam. Add the bouquet to the water and simmer 5 minutes. Remove the bouquet from the water.. Allow the water to return to the top of the bouquet. If you are using the thyme on your hands rub a little of the thyme down the inside of the bowl, or press a tiny bit of it off. Use as you would french style chicken food. Transfer to a plastic bag or seal, squeeze out the excess air, and refrigerate for up to 4 days before using. You will have to let it sit and re massage the water for at least a few days. Use in recipes calling for brown or other poultry.

title: Grilled Scallops With Chick-Peas
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups canned chick-peas ( garbanzo beans ) | 3 1/2 lbs sea scallops
instructions: In a food processor, combine the chickpeas and liquid and process to form a thick paste. Place the scallops in a shallow bowl, just big enough to hold them. Pour the paste over the scallops in the bowl and gently rub to coat. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour or, refrigerated, for up to 12 hours. Light the grill with cooking spray or preheat the broiler. Discard the scallops before cooking. Cook the scallops on a hot griddle, about 2 minutes on each side for rare, or until done to your liking.

title: Bake Brownies
ingredients: 1 package brownie mix | 3 anaheim chili peppers, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Prepare brownies according to package directions. Insert a toothpick through the center of each browned square. Remove. Sprinkle top with chopped chilies. Bake until brownies are lightly browned, about 35 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chicken thigh,lemon juice zest,pork loin roast,vegetable,bell pepper,chicken part
title: Southern-Style Chicken
ingredients: 1 boneless pork loin roast | 1 can whole mixed vegetables, drained, drained and rinsed | 4 1/2 ounces chicken parts, cut in pieces | 1 can pork fat packed sweet bell peppers, drained | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 6 -12 assorted cooked vegetables
instructions: Place the pork loin in the bottom of your slow cooker and place the vegetables around it. Sprinkle with lemon zest and juice. Pour in the can of pork fat. Cover, and cook on low until meat is tender, 5 to 6 hours, but check on it after about 3 hours. Remove from slow cooker, and serve on a bed of noodles for sandwiches, or as a topping for cooked vegetables. For vegetarian, use only the vegetable juices.

title: Simple Long-Rice Rice
ingredients: 2 tablespoons shortening | 1 cup uncooked brown rice | 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Melt the shortening in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the brown rice and cook until a light golden brown color, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat, stir in the beans, and heat through. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: green olive,gruyere cheese,chunky salsa,garam masala,banana,turkey chili
title: Easy Turkey Burgers
ingredients: 5 bananas, sliced into 1/8-inch slices | 1 -2 tablespoon chunky salsa ( medium or hot, depending on your taste ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 1 turkey chili, to taste, seeded and chopped ( i used trader joe's brand ) | 4 ounces gruyere cheese or 4 ounces swiss cheese, shredded | 8 green olives, sliced, to taste
instructions: Preheat a grill pan to medium high heat. In a small pan, heat the salsa for about 30 seconds. Spread the salsa around the edges of a large plate, then add 1/4 to 1/2 teaspoons garam masala. Place the banana slices on the salsa, then top with about 1/4 to 1/2 teaspoons turkey or beef. Sprinkle about 1 and 1/4 teaspoons cheese over the burger. Place the remaining salsa, 1/2 teaspoon garam masala and the remaining ½ teaspoon garam masala, on the top. Place the plate on the grill until the cheese is melted, about 3 - 4 minutes depending on your heat tolerance. Transfer the plate of toasted salsa onto a plate, sprinkle with a few olives and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: beef brisket,kaffir lime leaf,dekuyper apple liqueur,sunflower oil
title: Beef Brisket With Apple & Mustard
ingredients: 4 corned beef brisket, fat trimmed, tied | 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 4 kaffir lime leaves | 2 tablespoons dekuyper apple liqueur or 2 tablespoons apple brandy, to taste
instructions: Heat a heavy based frying pan over a high heat. Add the oil, swirling to coat, then remove from heat and leave to one side. Heat a chargrill over a medium high heat. Fry the brisket for 2 mins each side, or until cooked as required. Taste and season with salt and pepper and set aside. Reduce the heat under the frying pan to medium. Add the lime leaves to the pan and stir to coat. Pour in the apple liqueur and warm through. Shave the brisket across the grain to serve.

title: Gouda Cheese Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar | 1/4 cup rice wine vinegar | 1/2 cup grated aged gouda cheese
instructions: Sift together the confectioners' sugar and rice wine vinegar in a small bowl. Mix in the cheese until well blended. Cover and refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: cilantro leaf,button mushroom,garam masala powder,polish sausage,feta cheese
title: Polish Sausage and Mushrooms
ingredients: 200 g polish sausage ( bulk ) | 1/2 cup of sliced button mushroom | 1 tablespoon cilantro leaf ( chopped and packed ) | 1 teaspoon garam masala powder | 4 tablespoons crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Cut the polish sausage in half lengthwise, like making burgers from a turkey. The long slice is the easiest and easier to slice. You'll also need 8 slices from the sausage. Place the sausage on a plate in single layer. Heat a pan with medium heat. Add the cilantro and fry until it starts to brown. Add the mushrooms and cook until they are all browned. Lower the heat and cook all the mushrooms for about 5 minutes. You want all the liquid to cook off, but the flavors aren't well integrated. You want to cook the mushrooms and mix the stuffing so the sausage is evenly distributed. Add a pinch of cayenne pepper. Turn the sausage over a time and stir. Add the feta on top of the stuffing, mix everything up and eat immediately.

Random Ingredients: icing sugar,cream chicken soup,maple syrup,matzo cracker,tomato sauce,white wine,beef sirloin,greek yogurt
title: Sloppy Ottos
ingredients: 2 lbs beef sirloin, cut into 1-inch strips | 1 cup sour cream or 1 cup plain yogurt | 1 cup greek yogurt | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup white wine | 1/2 cup maple syrup | 1 cup icing sugar | 1 1/2 cups matzo crackers ( crushed )
instructions: Pound meat with meat pounders until about 1 1/2 inch thick. Place meat in zip top bag, in a flat baking pan or casserole dish. Mix together sour cream, greek yogurt, soup, wine, maple syrup and icing sugar. Pour over meat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Drain marinade from casserole. Preheat oven to 350°f. Bake covered 45 - 50 minutes, checking at 15 minutes to not burn, or bake for about 30 minutes longer to a nice golden brown. Place meat in serving dish and pour soup over meat.

Random Ingredients: white hominy,chicken,egg yolk,herb,italian tomato,arborio rice,vanilla bean,mustard
title: Chile Con Arrabiata
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked acorn arborio rice ( you should use basmati rice ) | 1 cup chicken, chopped | 1 egg yolk, slightly beaten | 1 cup cooked white hominy, rinsed | 1 can white hominy, drained | 1 teaspoon herbed mustard | 1 -2 teaspoon dried mixed herbs, such as oregano, fresh or dried thyme, basil, basil, etc ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons vanilla beans, scraped ( optional ) or 2 teaspoons almond extract ( optional )
instructions: Place chicken, egg yolk, and rice in a large bowl, and toss lightly to combine. Stir in 1 cup of cooked chick peas or hominy. Stir in 1 teaspoon of herbs, if desired. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes. Drain beans and hominy well. Pour into a 6 or 8 quart crockpot, and simmer for 1 1/2 hours, or until rice is soft and broth is absorbed. Stir once or twice, then stir in more seeds or other seasonings, as desired.

title: Simple Microwave Biriyani
ingredients: 2 cups mixed vegetables, such as mushrooms, carrots and cauliflower | 1 cup long-grain white rice
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large microwave safe bowl, cover and microwave on high power until vegetables are soft, 5 to 7 minutes. Remove cover and continue to microwave on high power, uncovered, until rice is cooked through, 5 to 7 more minutes.

title: Prosciutto Wrapped in Prosciutto
ingredients: 10 slices prosciutto ( about 2 1/2 inches wide ) | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Cut prosciutto slices in half widthwise. Slice 2 1/2 2 - 3 thin slices on the bias. Wrap 1 piece prosciutto with prosciutto and roll one end toward you to make a tight roll. Seal with toothpicks. Combine cream of tarter and olive oil. Brush over roll. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: daikon radish,pie crust,southern comfort,caper,red pepper flake
title: Southern Comfort Daikon Appetizer
ingredients: 1/2 cup southern comfort | 10 fresh yellow daikon radishes | 1 tablespoon capers | 1/8 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1 prepared 9 inch pie crust
instructions: Cut daikon into 12 smallish size pieces. Place in medium bowl of ice water, stir to stop color. In the morning, drain and toss in hot sauce. In a separate bowl, toss in capers and crushed red pepper just to mix. On a lightly floured surface, roll or roll out pie crust to 1/8 inch thickness. Fit into 9x13 inch serving dish. Top pastry with sliced daikon, drizzle with melted butter. Sprinkle with salt and pepper, if desired. Refrigerate for 1 hours before serving to firm up the flavors and develop their flavors.

title: Crusader
ingredients: 2 slices day old white breadcrumbs ( approx 2 ounces, but not too dry ) | 1 1/2 cups canola oil
instructions: Put bread crumbs in a bowl, pour enough oil to coat each slice. Cut a long slit into bread crumbs with a sharp knife. Dip slices in crumbs, coating both sides. Heat oil in deep fryer to 375°f, or follow manufacturer's instructions. Fry until crisp and golden. Remove to rack and drain for 10 minutes before serving.

title: French Fries
ingredients: 2 large russet potatoes ( unpeeled ) | carbonated lemon-lime beverage ( such as sprite or 7-up )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Cut off unpeeled potatoes and place on a baking sheet. Bake for 40 minutes, or until tender. Turn potatoes halfway through cooking. Drain potatoes and serve with lemon lime soda on the side if desired.

title: Pasta With Saffron, Saffron and Saffron
ingredients: 1/2 lb rotini pasta | 8 teaspoons saffron threads | 1 tablespoon salt
instructions: Cook rinsed pasta until al dente. Add saffron to pasta & 1 cup water & mix well. Add salt, mix well & serve hot.

Random Ingredients: tapioca flour,black peppercorn,rice krispies,salmon fillet,stewing beef,turnip,pine nut
title: Scottish Beef & Rice Krispies Casserole
ingredients: 400 g lean stewing beef, diced | 1 packet rice krispies | 1 tablespoon tapioca flour | 1 teaspoon black peppercorns | 150 g frozen turnips, chopped | 250 g smoked salmon fillets, chopped | 2 tablespoons pine nuts, toasted
instructions: Spray a large casserole dish with non stick cooking spray. Place the diced meat into the dish and mix in the remaining ingredients. Tip the mix into the dish. Bake in an oven for 1 hour or until golden brown and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: pimiento,lemon lime beverage,canadian bacon,cold water,allspice,olive,cooking spray
title: Pimiento Canapes, Canadian Bacon, Olive & Canadian Lettuce
ingredients: cooking spray | 2 tablespoons minced pimientos | 1 tablespoon canadian bacon, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons lemon-lime beverage | 2 fluid ounces cold water | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice ( can make up to 1/4 tsp. with kosher salt ) | 2 tablespoons sliced ripe olives
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. Spray a nonstick 12 inch nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Spread pimento on one half of the pimento. Top with a layer of the canadian bacon, pimiento bacon, lemon lime beverage and cold water. Sprinkle with allspice and drizzle with olive slices. Bake for 7 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned and bubbly.

title: Simple Lime Garlic Pizza
ingredients: 1 pizza crust | 1 teaspoon arrowroot | 1 large garlic clove, finely diced | 1 lime, quartered & sliced
instructions: Heat oven to 200c, 220c, or gas mark preheat. On a floured baking tray, bake the pizza crust for 10 - 15 minutes depending on the size and shape of your pizzas. Turn the dough over if it seems to need it, as it will be baked in the oven. Turn the oven down to 200c or 140c. While the crust is baking, add the garlic and lime wedges to a pestle or food processor, and blitz until you have a paste. Spoon 1/3 of the garlic paste onto the pizza dough. Place another pizza crust on top, followed by another piece of pizza dough, and continue with steps 8 and 9 until all the pizza has been used. Place on a baking tray with your favourite toppings.

title: Clams With Asiago Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 lb asiago cheese | 8 clams, cut in half lengthwise | 1/4 cup bottled clam juice | 12 -16 green onions ( chopped )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. In saucepan, cover asiago with clam juice and bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,serrano chilies,milk,golden delicious apple,gingerroot,white flour,pineapple ring
title: Sweet Apple & Pineapple Indian Bread
ingredients: 2 golden delicious apples, pared ( like mango pears ) | 10 small pineapple rings | 1 cup white flour | 1/2 cup milk | 2 serrano chilies, seeded and minced | 1/2 cup firmly packed light-brown sugar | 1 piece gingerroot, peeled, roughly chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Cut a cross in the top of each pineapple. Use a spoon to scoop out fruit pulp. Place pineapple in a glass pie pan, add water and cover with foil. Bake in preheated oven for 30 minutes. Remove foil, bake another 30 minutes, or until tender, not mushy. Remove and set aside. Place flour, milk, chilies, brown sugar, and ginger in a blender and blend until very finely minced. Pour into a large skillet and saute for 2 minutes, being careful not to burn. Stir in 1 cup of the warm bread until completely blended and add mixture to bread. Simmer for a few minutes more, stirring constantly. Pour mixture back into baking dish and bake covered at 350 for 30 minutes. Remove from oven and let stand 15 minutes, then remove foil and cool it slightly for 10 minutes. Slice each pineapple lengthwise and serve.

title: Real Spanish Crunchy Ham Wedges
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs thinly sliced cooked ham, 1/4 pound will do, 3-4 slices | 1/2 cup fat-free jalapeno pepper, 1/2 inch dice | 1/2 cup fat free green bell pepper, 1/4 inch dice | 1/2 cup fat-free evaporated milk | 1/2 cup chopped nuts
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°. Mix all ingredients except nuts in a large skillet. Cook over medium high heat until all liquids evaporate. Spread mixture onto a parchment paper lined cookie sheet. Sprinkle evenly with salt. Bake 7 - 10 minutes, turning once. Serve hot or cool, right away.

title: Easy Chicken Wings
ingredients: 6 chicken wings | 1 can beets, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place wings on the prepared baking sheet. Remove fat from the bone. Cut chicken wings into pieces approximately 3x2x2x1. Arrange chicken pieces on the baking sheet. Drizzle beet slices over the chicken. Bake in preheated oven for 45 minutes.

title: Garlicky Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 pound dried white mushrooms | 1 teaspoon anchovy paste, or to taste | 1 sprig fresh rosemary, cut into thin strips
instructions: Place a skillet over medium heat. When the skillet is hot, sprinkle mushrooms with anchovy paste or salt. Cook and stir until the mushrooms are slightly browned, about 5 minutes. Stir rosemary into the mushrooms. Remove from heat. Serve immediately.

title: Roasted Beef and Peach Stuffed Potatoes
ingredients: 5 lbs russet potatoes | 3 1/2 lbs sirloin, cut into 1/2 inch thick slices | 4 medium peaches, peeled, pitted, sliced and cut into 1/2 inch wedges | 1 -2 jalapeno pepper, seeded and chopped | 1/2 teaspoon dried turmeric
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f grease a roasting pan, or shallow baking pan with nonstick spray. Cut large potates into wedges, then cut wedges in half lengthwise. Toss meat, sliced peaches and jalapenos in a bowl with turmeric. Line baking pan with potato wedges. Stick 1 tablespoon of meat mixture onto each potato wedge and arrange in a single layer. Place the pan in a roasting pan, then add enough hot water to come halfway up the sides of the pan. Bake about 1 hour, stirring and scraping bottom of pan. Remove meat and fruit and serve. Serve with warm bread slices for dipping.

title: Rice-Dusted Bananas With Vodka
ingredients: 12 medium bananas, ripe but firm | 4 tablespoons creole seasoning ( homemade preferred ) | 2/3 cup oatmeal | 2 limes, juice and zest of | 8 ounces vodka ( i used cola ) | 2 tablespoons creole seasoning ( homemade preferred )
instructions: Place bananas in a bowl or dish. Sprinkle mexican seasoning over bananas and toss them thoroughly. Cover and refrigerate overnight, turning the bananas several times. Next day, remove the bananas and refrigerate up to 2 days. Grill bananas until firm and crusty and golden, about 5 minutes per side, or desired doneness. Meanwhile, toast crumbs in a skillet. Remove from heat. In a small saucepan, combine 1 - 2 t. Vodka, 2 t. Creole seasoning. Bring to a boil over medium high heat. Remove from heat. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 day. Before serving, add more creole seasoning or salt and pepper. To serve, scoop some bananas on a hot plate, spoon vodka over, then top with the crumbed scallions or onions.

title: Easy Beetroot with Crab and Pickled Mustard
ingredients: cooking spray | 4 cups thinly sliced peeled raw beetroots | 1 1/4 lbs lump crabmeat | 3/4 cup dark soy sauce
instructions: Coat a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Add beetroot slices, breaking them off with a spatula or tongs. Cook over medium high heat until tender and browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Turn beetroots and transfer to a plate lined with paper towel. Repeat with remaining beetroot slices. When cool enough to handle, discard remaining beetroot slices. Slice off and discard any tough ribs or choke from the crab. Wipe out skillet. Heat skillet over high heat until hot. Add shrimp and crab to the hot skillet. Stir to combine. Add dark soy sauce.

title: Peopertowels
ingredients: 1 large pork tenderloin | 6 ounces cream cheese | 12 bananas ( peeled ) | 1 teaspoon liquid honey
instructions: Cut pork into very thin slices and sprinkle with salt. Preheat grill until quite hot. When grill surface is very hot, using a meat tenderizing brush, spread cream cheese in a large, heavy baking dish until just beginning to turn gold on one side. Transfer cream cheese side by side into ovenproof frying pan, being careful not to burn the cream cheese. Wash bananas and remove hard end and bottom with a serrated knife. Scoop insides of the bananas with a slotted spoon into saucer. Spoon 1/4 cup of banana and honey onto center of cream cheese covered loaf. Lay one or two slices of pork across banana and close with a spatula. Repeat layering to make twelve peaces. Place on prepared rack of grill and brush grill with remaining honey. Close and grill for 15 minutes. Turn and grill for 30 more minutes. Remove from grill by placing a heavy plate on top of the meat and turning the meat over for one or two minutes. Cut into 12 serving size slices.

title: Tropical Salmon
ingredients: 300 g white flour | 50 g fresh basil leaves | 150 g fresh shredded coconut | 1 cucumber, peeled, seeded & diced | 1 orange peel, rinsed, chopped | 200 g salmon, diced | 1 tablespoon golden syrup
instructions: Place all ingredients in food processor and process until well mixed. Divide dough in half and shape into balls. Place on lightly greased oven tray and bake at 180 degrees for 15 - 20 minutes until well cooked.

title: Pasta de Amatraciana
ingredients: 1 tablespoon celery rib, minced | 8 ounces farfalle pasta
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.

Random Ingredients: seasoning mix,polish sausage,thyme sprig,salt pepper,coffee liqueur,miso,white bread
title: Cafe Rio Smoked Polish Sausage Balls
ingredients: 12 links polish sausage | 2 tablespoons white bread, finely cubed | 2 tablespoons instant coffee liqueur | 1 tablespoon dried thyme sprig, crushed | seasoning mix | salt and pepper, to taste
instructions: Put your polish sausage back into the freezer for 30 minutes. Mix the bread with instant coffee liqueur, thyme, salt and pepper. Cut a hole down the center of each sausage link. Form each sausage link into a ball. Roll the sausage balls in the bread mixture. Let sit for 10 to 15 minutes while you cook the rest of the sausage balls and cook the rest.

Random Ingredients: rice noodle,teriyaki sauce,egg white,spaghetti,white flour,oregano leaf,mint leaf
title: Noodle Kebabs
ingredients: 170 g rice noodles | 1 egg white | 1 tablespoon white flour | 240 g spaghetti or 240 g cellophane noodles | 4 tablespoons teriyaki sauce | 2 tablespoons finely chopped mint leaves ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons chopped mint leaves ( optional )
instructions: Place noodles in a heatproof bowl with boiling water. Cover and leave for 10 minutes. Drain and then run under cold water until cold. Drain and set aside for 5 minutes. Remove and lightly beat egg white on high speed. Add flour and mix until mixture forms soft dough. Knead briefly, if dough is too dry, add water. Roll onto lightly floured board and cut into 4 cm/1 inch pieces. Line bamboo skewers with aluminium foil. Place kebabs on skewers and brush with teriyaki sauce. Cover with damp tea towel and place in a shallow casserole dish. Cover and refrigerate for 6 hours or up to 3 days. Drain noodles from bowl and run under warm water until cool. Meanwhile heat grill. Cook noodles in boiling water for 3 minutes or until tender.

title: Broccoli Quesadilla (Tortilla)
ingredients: 10 flour tortillas | 10 ounces broccoli florets, thawed | 1/4 cup dry white wine
instructions: Stack tortillas on flat cutting board.

title: Pear and Walnut Pie
ingredients: 1 pear ( about 1 kilo. ) | 1 graham cracker
instructions: Peel and core pear and cut into 1 cm chunks. Place the pear chunks in a large bowl with the graham cracker. Pour the pear juice in and bring to boil. Pour over the pie crust. Garnish with fresh finely grounded orange peel. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper flake,kosher salt black pepper,strawberry,ice cube,parsnip,sambal chili paste,sausage,raisin
title: Seared Sausage With Red Chile, Strawberries and Raisins
ingredients: 16 ounces sausage, fresh | 8 ounces small parsnips, peeled and julienned | 2 teaspoons sambal chili paste | 2 teaspoons crushed red chili pepper flakes | 1/4 - 1/2 cup raisins or 1/4-1/2 cup dark raisin, soaked in hot water for about 20 minutes, drained | 2 -3 tablespoons sambal chili paste | ice cube | 1/4 cup unsalted raisins or 1/4 cup dark raisin | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: The day before, remove the casing from the sausage. If using fresh, wash meat and pat dry. If using dried red chile flakes, add to meat and sprinkle with the chili paste. Add the raisins or dark raisins, and soak overnight in at least 2 cups of water. Cut out the core of the parsnips, then cut them into 1 inch pieces. Rinse off any dirt and pat dry. Cut each sausage link into 4 pieces. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Combine the raisins with 1/4 cup of water in a large sauté pan to make a light syrup. Over high heat, bring the syrup to a boil and stir in the sausage. Lower heat, cover, and simmer for about an hour until the sauce has reduced. Stir occasionally while simmering, and the sausage will be done in about 15 minutes. If the sauce is thicker than you like, cook for another 2 to 3 minutes. This makes the sausage and vegetables moist but not tough and shiny. Transfer the sautéed sausage to a serving bowl, and let cool for about 10 minutes then serve. This sausage is delicious served with steamed or steamed carrots and sliced cucumber or yellow squash. It also makes a great base for any of your chosen sides.

title: Liqueur and Spice
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 4 teaspoons grand marnier | 1 tablespoon lemon peel, freshly grated
instructions: Mix together the thyme, grand marnier and lemon peel. Store in an airtight container for up to 2 months.

Random Ingredients: leek,kidney bean,orange peel,pesto sauce,hungarian paprika,chipotle chile
title: Chili Burgers (Appetizer)
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1/4 cup leeks or 1/4 cup onion, thinly sliced | 2 teaspoons sweet hungarian paprika | 1/2 teaspoon fresh grated orange peel ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons sweet basil or 4 teaspoons dried basil | 2 teaspoons chipotle chiles ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce ( any flavour )
instructions: Place all the ingredients, except the pesto, in a food processor and process until smooth. Shape the mixture into four patties, each about 2 in diameter and about 1/2 inch thick. Heat a nonstick skillet over high heat and spray with pam cooking spray. Add the burgers, and cook about 4 minutes on each side or until browned.

Random Ingredients: peach,cardamom seed,raspberry,pimiento,matzo cake meal,green enchilada sauce,lime juice,wild mushroom
title: Wild Mushroom and Peach Squash Salad
ingredients: 3 -5 small wild mushrooms, sliced in half | 1 1/2 cups frozen chopped peaches, thawed | 1/4 cup sliced pimiento | 1/3 cup chopped green enchilada sauce ( optional ) or 1/3 cup salsa verde, heat ( optional ) | 1/2 cup sliced pitted ripe olives | 1/4 cup cold matzo cake meal | 2 teaspoons grated lime juice | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom seed
instructions: Pound the wild mushrooms and pimentos in a spice grinder or food processor until fine bits. Transfer to a salad bowl. Toss with the next 5 ingredients. Serve.

Random Ingredients: white onion,tortilla chip,cream celery soup,jalapeno pepper
title: Nachos
ingredients: 1 can cream of celery soup | 1 can diced jalapeno peppers, drained | 1 small white onion, chopped ( optional ) | 1/2 bag tortilla chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Drain soup, jalapenos, onion, and jalapenos. Mix with corn chips. Spread in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until hot and bubbly.

title: Lamb Liver Focaccia
ingredients: 1 focaccia bread, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 pound boneless lamb liver, cut into thin slices | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In a baking dish, arrange bread cubes in a uniform layer, leaving 1 inch of crust on top. Sprinkle lamb with flour, and drizzle with vinegar. Bake in the preheated oven until the liver turn to a nice golden brown color, about 20 minutes. Serve with warm bread and more red wine vinegar to drizzling over the top.

title: Spiced Peanut Butter(Bangar)
ingredients: 1 cup smooth peanut butter | 1 1/2 lbs green cabbage ( about 3-4 heads ) | 1 serrano pepper, minced | 1 -2 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( optional ) | crushed ice ( optional )
instructions: In a small bowl, combine peanut butter and stir until well mixed. Place in refrigerator, covered, overnight if possible. Next day, drain cabbage and cut into 8 wedges. In a large pot of boiling, salted water, blanch cabbage for 1 minute, drain and immediately rinse with cold water. Dry with paper towel. Spread 1 - 2 teaspoons peanut mixture on bottom of each wedge of cabbage, top with a few pickle bits, and serve immediately with ice& chili if desired.

title: Mild Beef Kebabs
ingredients: 800 g australian steak, thinly sliced ( round sirloin or beef stew meat ) | 50 g whole shelled cashew nuts | 4 dried anise seeds | 3 fennel, stalks removed | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained
instructions: Combine the steak with the cashews, aniseeds and fennel stalks. Thread the beef onto 3 skewers, and set at the bottom of a bamboo skewer. Cook under a hot grill for 5 minutes on each side until well browned. To serve, arrange the kebabs on plates and pour over the sauce.

Random Ingredients: savory,asparagus,cabbage,cream mushroom soup,pizza dough,lettuce leaf,orange peel
title: Mushroom Asparagus Rollups
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated pizza dough | 1 package frozen chopped asparagus, thawed ( or fresh ) | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 10 ounces fresh shredded cabbage ( the packaged salad kind ) | 2 cups shredded lettuce leaves | 2/3 cup shredded orange peel | 1/4 teaspoon ground savory
instructions: Unroll pizza dough on a lightly floured surface and cut into 15 equal squares. Cover dough with plastic wrap and set aside until ready to use. Combine soup and vegetables in a bowl and mix. Arrange a fourth of the asparagus on each dough square and roll up loosely into a tight cylinder. Repeat for the remaining dough and filling. Place seam side down in 11x7 inch baking dish. Spoon a little soup mixture over dough. Sprinkle with orange slices, savory, and remaining asparagus. Cover and refrigerate for at least 45 minutes. Bake at 400°f for 20 - 25 minutes, or until edges are golden browned. Allow oven to cool for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Arabic Spice - Aloo Kaala
ingredients: 6 whole black cardamom pods | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 2 tablespoons ground mixed tea and 2 tablespoons of ground green tea, or as directed on package
instructions: Crush the cardamoms with a mortar and pestle, then place in a medium size bowl. Pour 1 teaspoons of oil onto the bowl and mix it with the spices. Set aside for at least 1 hour to let the flavors marry. Mix well before serving. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: white chocolate,peanut butter,yellow cornmeal,mexican oregano,hickory smoke salt,fusilli,plum juice,picante sauce
title: Smokey Fusilli
ingredients: 2 cups yellow cornmeal | 1 cup hickory smoke salt | 1 cup mexican oregano | 1 can plum juice | 1 jar picante sauce | 12 ounces peanut butter | 1 lb fresh hickory smoked sausage ( about 2 cups ) or 1 lb smoked bacon ( about 2 cups ) | 12 ounces white chocolate, coarsely chopped | 12 ounces yellow cornmeal
instructions: Heat oven to 400ºf. Grease 13x9x2 inch glass baking dish. To make base of dish, toss cornmeal with salt. Stir in oregano, plum juice, picante sauce, and peanut butter. Spoon mixture into prepared pan. Top with smoked sausage or bacon. Bake until center is set, about 40 minutes. Cool about 10 minutes before serving. Run metal spatula under hot water to loosen. Melt chocolate in a heat proof bowl set over a pan of simmering water.

Random Ingredients: snow pea,golden syrup,salt pepper,chickpea,heavy cream,prosciutto,pork mince,ziti pasta
title: Rachael Ray's Leftover Baked Ziti With Prosciutto
ingredients: 500 g ziti pasta or 500 g other short pasta, cooked | 300 g thinly sliced prosciutto or 300 g ham, cut into 1 cm dice | 1/4 cup cooked chickpeas | 100 g snow peas, trimmed | 250 ml heavy cream | 2 teaspoons golden syrup | salt and pepper, to taste | 400 g left over roasted pork mince
instructions: Prepare the pasta according to pack instructions except for a little extra cooking water. Mix the prosciutto until just combined. Mix in the chickpeas to help them soften, if necessary. Add the snow peas and stir to combine. Pour the mixture into a lightly oiled, lined 19 x 28 cm baking dish. Cover and freeze until firm, then use the tip of a sharp knife to trim the sides, if it's exceedingly long place the ziti, ham, pasta and sauces into a large bowl and stir well until everything is coated. Pour over the cream and glaze well. Toss the meat mixture with the corn meal. Transfer to a lightly oiled 25 x 23 cm baking dish. Season and bake in a preheated oven at 180 degrees centigrade f for 45 - 55 minutes, until golden and heated through. Serve with parsley if you like.

title: Roasted Herbed Bread
ingredients: 2 pieces bread, crusts removed | 2 rosemary sprigs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Using a small bowl, combine 1 rosemary sprig and salt between each piece of bread. Brush each slice of bread with 1 teaspoon of the olive oil. Place bread on a baking sheet. Bake for 7 to 10 minutes, until toasted and golden. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: chocolate syrup,shiitake mushroom,black olive,beef stew meat
title: Beef Patties
ingredients: 2 pounds beef stew meat, cut into bite size pieces | 1/2 cup chocolate syrup | 2 cans sliced black olives, drained | 1 can shiitake mushrooms, drained and chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Place beef in a dish. Pour chocolate syrup over beef and toss to coat meat. Pour the black olives over the top. Sprinkle mushrooms over the black olives. Bake uncovered at 350 degrees f for one hour.

title: Scallops and Fennel
ingredients: 2 tablespoons fennel seeds | 5 dozen scallops | 1 can mandarin oranges
instructions: Heat the fennel seed over moderately high heat until it crackles, about 30 seconds.

title: Lamb and Prune Tagine
ingredients: 2 lbs lamb, cut into large cubes | 2 ounces dry pitted prunes, soaked in water overnight and drained | 1 tablespoon lemon rind, grated
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°f place the lamb in a large casserole dish. Add the prunes. Add the lemon rind. Cover tightly with foil. Put the tins in the oven and cook for 2 hours. Remove the foil and bake for the last 20 minutes to brown the meat.

Random Ingredients: yukon gold potato,vanilla extract,bailey irish cream,peppercorn,oregano leaf,red wine,english cucumber
title: Bilba
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs yukon gold potatoes | 1/2 english cucumber, thickly sliced ( about 3 cups ) | 2/3 cup red wine ( or sherry ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/8 teaspoon peppercorn | 1/4 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 1 tablespoon baileys irish cream
instructions: Place potatoes in a saucepan and cover with cold water.

title: Japanese  Spicy Spaghetti With Daikon Radish Salad
ingredients: 1 lb thin spaghetti | 2 tablespoons butter or 2 tablespoons margarine | 1/4 cup pickled daikon radish, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup slivered shelled pistachios | 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1/3 cup cider vinegar
instructions: Cook noodles in boiling, salted water according to package instructions. Drain. Meanwhile, melt butter in a medium size skillet over medium high heat. Add radishes and pistachios and sauté for about 2 minutes. Add the hot pasta and cook for an additional 2 minutes to allow pasta to get a little crispy on the bottom.

title: Corn and Olive Soup
ingredients: 4 ears fresh sweet corn, shucked | 1 cup chopped yellow onion | 1/4 cup black olives, coarsely chopped | 2 1/2 cups hot broth
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine corn, onion, olives and broth.

Random Ingredients: saltpeter,coleslaw mix,graham cracker crumb,pork shoulder,saffron,white wine
title: Portuguese Pork Roast
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless pork shoulder ( or pork shoulder ) | 3/4 cup dry white wine | 1 tablespoon saffron | saltpeter ( optional ) | 2 cups shredded coleslaw mix | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Trim fat off meat of any excess fat. Cut into 3/4 thick slices and pound slices with a meat mallet until 1/4 thick. Combine wine, saffron, and 1/2 tsp salt. Rinse the pork, dry it well with a paper towel and pat dry with paper towels. Arrange the pork in a shallow baking dish, fat side up. Place in a 350f oven and roast until an instant read thermometer registers 155f for rare, about 45 minutes. Cool. Using tongs, transfer the meat. Mix together coleslaw and crumbs in a large bowl.

title: Yogurt and Spices
ingredients: 1 can garbanzo beans, drained ( chick peas ) | 2 large summer squash, thinly sliced
instructions: Combine well. Refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving. Variation 1, sprinkle 1/4 cup plain yogurt with sesame seed, 1/4 cup finely chopped walnuts or 1/4 cup finely chopped almonds and 1 3/4 tsp. Ground flax seed for an aroma boost.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chile pepper,rigatoni pasta,yellow onion,mustard seed,vegan butter,cake flour
title: Vegan Scalloped Rigatoni
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked rigatoni pasta | 1 small yellow onion, chopped | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers, drained | 2 tablespoons mustard seeds | 3 tablespoons cake flour | 1 1/2 tablespoons vegan butter
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the rigatoni, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but still firm to the bite, about 13 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Meanwhile, in a saucepan over medium heat, stir together the onion, diced tomatoes, and mustard seed until heated through. Stir the flour into the tomato mixture. Mix in the cooked pasta. Place a tablespoon or two of the pasta mixture into each of 2 shallow 3 to 4 ounce ramekins. Dot each ramekin with about 1 tablespoon of the vegan butter. Set ramekins in a steamer over the simmering water. Cover, and steam until heated through, about 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Duck Breast of the Turks
ingredients: 4 duck breasts | 1 tablespoon dried chili pepper flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Remove skin and bones of duck, and discard or save your chicken flesh for another use. Sprinkle the chile flakes over the duck. Place a piece of parchment paper on the counter. Roll a duck breast over the top of the paper, and tuck the breast meat inches. Wrap around the paper so the belly is tightly contained. Place in the oven, and cook the duck in the middle of the oven for approximately 1 - 5 hours or until crisp and brown on the outside. Remove from oven, and cool to room temperature. The skin should have soaked up the juices. You can safely eat the duck after 1 hours, after which the skin will be crispy and a beautiful yellow color. Enjoy.

title: Lentil-Oriental Style
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 8 ounces dry lentils | 2 teaspoons instant espresso powder | 2 teaspoons instant espresso powder | 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh oyster sauce
instructions: In a saucepan, heat the oil over medium heat. Add the lentils and saute until the lentils begin to release their juices, about 5 minutes. Push the lentils down with a spatula. Stir in the remaining ingredients.

Random Ingredients: lime juice zest,broccoli stem,black bean,orange juice,chili powder,french bread,blueberry,corn chip
title: Berry Chip Veggie Burgers With Corn Chips
ingredients: 1 can fat-free refried black beans | 1/2 cup fresh orange juice | 1 tablespoon lime juice, juice and zest of | 2 tablespoons chili powder | 1 cup shredded frozen broccoli stems | 1 cup fresh blueberries | baked corn chips | 1 loaf french bread, cut into 1-2 inch slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f spread the refried beans on a large baking sheet. Stir the orange juice and lime juice into the hot refried beans. Add the chile powder and remaining ingredients and mix well. Divide the bean mixture among the bread slices and bake 10 to 15 minutes, or until hot and crumbly. Serve hot with sweet corn chips or crackers.

title: Shepherd's Lasagne
ingredients: 3 cups cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 1/2 lbs lamb, diced | 4 slices bacon | 8 ounces cannellini beans, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup chopped fresh thyme leaves | 2 tablespoons oregano leaves | 6 tablespoons vinegar | 1/2 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f in a small saucepan over medium low heat, cook the lamb in a small coating of oil until browned, about 10 minutes. Meanwhile, heat the remaining 2 tablespoons of oil in a medium saucepan over medium low heat. Add bacon and cook, stirring often, until crisp, about 10 minutes. Add the cannellini beans, thyme, oregano, and 1/2 cup of water. Bring to a boil, then reduce the temperature to a simmer. Cover and cook for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, arrange the meatballs on top of the cannellini bean mixture. In a small bowl combine the vinegar and the cheese and stir to blend. Stir the sauce over medium heat until the sauce is hot and the cheese is melted. Spoon the meatball mixture into a baking dish and top with the remaining cheese. Bake for 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: taco sauce,almond extract,chili paste,dill pickle,green cardamom pod,purpose flour,iceberg lettuce
title: Taco Salad
ingredients: 1/3 cup all-purpose flour | 2 green cardamom pods, cracked | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili paste | 2 tablespoons taco sauce ( or 2 tablespoons hot sauce ) | 1 1/2 lbs iceberg lettuce ( about 1 large head ) | taco sauce, to taste | 1/2 - 1 tablespoon dill pickle ( optional ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons almond extract
instructions: To crack the cardamom pods, scrape off the seeds and place in a heatproof bowl. Sprinkle the chili paste over the pods and let stand for 10 to 15 minutes until they're fragrant and slightly darkened in color. Combine the crushed cardamom, chili paste and taco sauce. Toss the lettuce in the mixture until thoroughly coated. Add more taco sauce to taste. Divide among four warmed salad plates. Garnish each serving with a pickle.

title: Oat Stuffing
ingredients: 180 g breadcrumbs | 1 large bunch spring onion | 2 -3 cooking oats, to sprinkle on
instructions: Place all of the filling ingredients into a food processor or electric blender and pulse a few times so that the mixture is combined nicely for the stuffing. Remove from processor and roll into small balls. Sprinkle extra oat or bread crumbs on and put aside until required.

title: Yummy Cashew Nut Nuts & Peppers
ingredients: 2 cups grated raw cashews | 1 cup diced yellow pepper | 1/2 cup diced red onion | 1/2 cup sweetened dried shrimp-eye cashews, soaked in hot water ( or roasted salted butter ) | 3 tablespoons fermented jaggery | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 teaspoon nigella seeds ( optional )
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the cashews, red onion, yellow pepper, jaggery, oyster sauce and nigella seeds. Taste to make sure they're sweet enough for your liking and adjust seasoning with more jaggery, oyster sauce and salt. Serve immediately.

title: Mexican Roasted Poblano Pepper Juice
ingredients: 2 large poblano peppers, roasted peeled, seeded and diced | 2 limes, juice and zest of | 2 ounces kahlua
instructions: Combine poblanos, lime juice and zest to make a slurry. Stir in kahlua and stir to combine. Taste and adjust seasoning.

title: Quick and Easy Curry Chicken
ingredients: 5 ounces broiler-fryer chickens, cut into 6 pieces
instructions: Preheat your broiler. Put your chicken pieces in a baking dish. Pour the curry paste over the chicken. Sprinkle with more curry paste. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake at 450 degrees f for about 45 minutes.

title: Crispy Cornucopia Lasagna
ingredients: 1 pound spaghetti or gorgonzola lasagna noodles | 1 tablespoon whole wheat flour | 1/2 cup spaghetti sauce or 1/2 cup spaghetti sauce with chiles | 2 tablespoons chocolate syrup | 1 dash hot mustard | 1 dash cayenne | 2 cups thinly sliced cabbage ( optional ) | 4 cups sliced fresh strawberries ( optional )
instructions: Cook spaghetti in boiling water until tender, or cover to keep warm. Drain and set aside. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. In a saucepan over medium heat, blend butter, flour, chocolate sauce, hot mustard and cayenne. Stir constantly in a few tablespoons of water, until thick. Remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: rum,dark soy sauce,genoa salami,onion soup mix,stove stuffing mix
title: Quick Italian Stove Top Stuffing
ingredients: 2 packages stove top stuffing mix | 1 can canned oriental mushrooms, drained | 1 package onion soup mix | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce | 1 1/2 lbs genoa salami, finely diced
instructions: Combine stuffing mix, mushrooms, onion soup mix and dark soy sauce in frying pan. Cook over medium heat. Stir until mixture comes to a boil. Stir in salami. Bake at 350 degrees, covered, 1 hour. Turn off heat and let sit 10 minutes before stuffing can be prepared.

Random Ingredients: orange peel,daikon radish,button mushroom,red chili powder,apple,cayenne,miso
title: Miso Soup
ingredients: 6 tablespoons miso ( gochujang ) | 4 cups daikon radish, shredded | 4 cups button mushrooms, sliced | 1 1/2 cups diced apples | 1 1/2 teaspoons red chili powder ( gochujang ) | 1 pinch cayenne ( gochugaru ) | 1/2 teaspoon orange peel, grated
instructions: Miso soup, to prepare miso, place 1 cup miso in a bowl and stir in 3 cups daikon radish. Let sit for about 15 minutes. Place mushrooms in a pot with 3 cups water. Bring to boil, and cook for 5 minutes. Add onion.

title: Cucumber Stir Fry
