ingredients: 1/2 cucumber ( about 2-3 inches ) | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon prepared mustard
instructions: Cut the cucumber in half lengthwise. Cut the cucumber in half again lengthwise, leaving 1/2 inch chunks. Slice the cucumber crosswise into chunks about 1/4 inch thick. Place the cucumbers in a bowl with dark soy sauce and mustard. Stir to combine. Heat a wok over high heat for several seconds until hot. Add enough oil to coat the bottom evenly. When the oil just begins to smoke, add the cucumbers, tossing them so that they're coated evenly with the sweet soy sauce, taking care not to crowd them. Turning to fry all sides is key, as the longer you turn them, the more deeply seasoned they will become. Cook for about three minutes, or until they're golden brown..

title: Racken Nachos - the Real Stuff!
ingredients: 4 -8 ounces sliced sausage | 2 -3 sheets aluminum foil | olive oil flavored cooking spray
instructions: Rinse out your outdoor grill for a few minutes while you prepare your stuffing. Slice the loaf lengthwise into 12 pieces, about 1/4 in thick. Arrange the slices on a work area, with the thickest parts towards the center of the strip of foil. Lightly sprinkle a bit of olive oil all over the sausage. Roll up the foil and fold it over into a semi circle. Tightly pack the nachos into a large baking dish at least ½ inch thick. Sprinkle generously with oil, and lightly oil the tops. Bake at 350°f for about 25 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown and crispy. Remove from oven when nachos are bubbling up around the edges, carefully remove the foil packet, and let cool slightly then cut on a bias or cut in pieces and serve in a warm, moist bun. If you are planning on stuffing nachos immediately, keep those in the refrigerator, along with any leftover stuffing that collects in the foil.

title: Spaghetti with Cod
ingredients: 4 cloves garlic, minced | 1 pound smoked cod | 1/2 cup dry spaghetti | 2/3 cup marinara sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Pit and lightly grease a 2 quart baking dish. Slice fish into 2 inch wide slices. Rub the garlic into one side of each slice, then rub the garlic slices into the open side of fish to form a pocket. Fill each pocket with a spoonful of the marinara sauce into each pocket. Cover dish tightly with foil. Bake in the preheated oven until fish is easily flaked with a fork, about 45 minutes. Cool slightly, then serve.

Random Ingredients: bicarbonate soda,mango,dill weed,italian herb seasoning,chicken meat,sage,garam masala
title: Italian Chicken Skewers
ingredients: 400 g chicken meat, boneless | 2 teaspoons dried italian herb seasoning | 1 pinch bicarbonate of soda | 1 pinch dried dill weed | 1 teaspoon grated garlic | 1 teaspoon dried sage | 1 teaspoon garam masala or 1 teaspoon curry powder
instructions: Cut a long trench around the neck of the chicken. Place chicken, tighly opened, in a shallow dish. Mix remaining ingredients. Pour over chicken, cover with plastic wrap and leave in the fridge overnight. Grill over hot coals or griddle for 15 minutes.

title: Chef John's Pizzal
ingredients: 1 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour | 1/4 teaspoon ground cayenne powder | 2 tablespoons dried herbs | 1 tequila
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Stir parmesan cheese, flour, cayenne, and herbs together in a bowl. Stir tequila into cheese mixture just until evenly incorporated.

title: Barley Beef for the Crock Pot
ingredients: 5 lbs boneless beef chuck | 8 ounces pearl barley | 2 teaspoons liquid smoke
instructions: Place beef in the slow cooker. Mix in the barley. Cover and cook on low setting for 5 to 8 hours. Drain meat and serve with cooked rice and vegetables.

title: Bread Crumbs With Whole Wheat
ingredients: 8 ounces whole wheat bread crumbs | 1 cup white flour
instructions: You need an oven pre heated to 190°c. Mix all ingredients in a large bowl.

title: Hot Dogs or Tostadas
ingredients: 10 -12 flour tortillas | 1 1/2 cups dried lentils | 1 cup chopped yellow pepper | 1 cup diced mango chutney ( or you could substitute other chutney ) | 1 cup madeira wine ( or any dry madeira wine )
instructions: Cook lentils in boiling water to cover for 20 to 30 minutes, or until tender. Drain and reserve water. When lentils are tender, drain well, and reserve. Place lentils, pepper, chutney, and enough water to measure a cup, or a small bowl to refrigerate the tostadas, and place in a microwave safe bowl. Cook, uncovered, on high for 20 minutes, turning and rearranging the tortillas. To serve, place a tortilla on a plate. Top with a sprinkling of the maddie's cheese, and a dollop of sweet mango chutney.

title: Lemon Asparagus Soup
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 1/2 cup lemonade | 1/2 teaspoon lemon pepper | 1 pound fresh asparagus, coarsely chopped
instructions: Combine the cream of celery soup, lemonade, and lemon pepper in a large pot. Add the asparagus, and bring to a boil. Allow soup to thicken until soup is reduced by half. Chill for at least 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: currant,white vinegar,ginger paste,cauliflower floret,feta cheese,rice wine,green chili pepper,liquid smoke
title: Cauliflower & Feta
ingredients: 16 ounces cauliflower florets | 1 tablespoon ginger paste | 2 tablespoons rice wine | 1 1/4 teaspoons liquid smoke | 1 tablespoon white vinegar | 3 green chili peppers, chopped | 1 cup feta cheese, crumbled | 1/4 cup currants
instructions: Add cauliflower to boiling water, then cook until tender. Drain, then rinse with cool water and drain again. Sauté the ginger and garlic in a medium sauté pan on medium heat until tender. Drain excess sodium from ginger and garlic if desired. Add remaining ingredients except the feta. Continue cooking for about 15 minutes. Top with feta. Serve in warm casseroles, with hot steamed rice.

Random Ingredients: green bean,anise seed,saffron,kirsch,cayenne pepper,mozzarella cheese,kalamata olive,porcini mushroom
title: Mushroom, Green Bean and Provolone Salad With anise
ingredients: 3/4 cup kirsch, liqueur ( optional ) | 2 lbs green beans, ends trimmed | 1 ounce dried porcini mushrooms, soaked overnight and drained ( about 8 ounces ) | 2 tablespoons anise seeds, ground | saffron | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | mozzarella cheese, preferably fresh, diced into 1 inch cubes | kalamata olives, quartered ( optional )
instructions: Combine kirsch with 3/4 cup water in a medium nonreactive saucepan and heat over medium heat until just hot but not boiling. Add beans and cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly tender but still bright green, about 3 minutes. Add mushrooms and stir to combine. Cover and reduce heat to simmer. Simmer, stirring occasionally, until beans soften, about 5 minutes. While this is cooking, combine remaining ingredients in a small, heavy nonreactive saucepan. Cover.

title: Dairy-Free Blueberry Rice Blend
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice or 1 cup brown rice, uncooked | 1 cup blueberries, ocean spray | minced fresh oregano leaves, for garnish ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon mustard powder, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Place rice in a medium bowl.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast meat,taco seasoning,cauliflower,walnut,tomatillo salsa,asparagus spear
title: Slow-Cooked Chicken and Vegetables
ingredients: 1 pound skinless, boneless chicken breast meat - cut into pieces | 2 jars tomatillo salsa | 1 package taco seasoning | 1 large cauliflower, chopped | 1 pound fresh asparagus spears | 1/2 cup chopped walnuts, or as needed
instructions: Combine chicken, salsa, and taco seasoning in a slow cooker. Cover, and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours. In a large skillet over medium heat, place cauliflower, asparagus, and chopped walnuts. Stir in sauce, and cook 5 minutes.

title: Chocolate-Turkey Empanadas
ingredients: 12 ounces cooked turkey, chopped | 1 can mushroom stems and pieces, drained | 1 ounce grated asiago cheese | 6 large fresh jicama, thinly sliced | lettuce | 2 tablespoons grated sweet unsalted chocolate | 2 large eggs | chopped onions ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f degrees. Coat a large baking sheet with cooking spray. In a large bowl, combine turkey, mushrooms, cheese, and jicama. In a small bowl, whisk together eggs, and pour half evenly over turkey mixture. Fold in sour cream and stir until blended. Drop by rounded teaspoons onto pan. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until puffed, lightly browned, and firm. While tops are baking, combine the chocolate and remaining 1/3 cup of the cheese mixture. Fill each ear of corn with filling, and top each empanada with remaining filling. Sprinkle with onions, if desired.

title: Encebollado De Pescado (Bacon-Wrapped Escab)
ingredients: 1 fresh orange | 2 tablespoons adobo sauce | 2 tablespoons peanut oil or 2 tablespoons bacon drippings | 1/8 teaspoon dried allspice | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds, toasted
instructions: Wash and remove white pith from the zest of the orange, and cut into segments. Remove pulp, and set aside. With a vegetable peeler, remove the zest, removing all of the white pith just beneath the skin and blemished membrane. Cut into pieces about 1/2 inch square. In a small bowl, combine the zest strips with the remaining ingredients.

Random Ingredients: green bean,watermelon,phyllo pastry,active yeast,gruyere cheese,paprika,sun tomato oil
title: Watermelon and Gruyere Strudels
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups warm water, plus | 2 tablespoons warm water | 1 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 package active dry yeast | 1 cup gruyere cheese at room temperature ( about 6 cups ) | 1 cup shredded seeded watermelon | 2/3 cup coarsely chopped sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 3/4 cup coarsely chopped green beans | 1/8 teaspoon paprika, for sprinkling ( optional )
instructions: Pour the warm water into a large mixing bowl. Sprinkle the yeast over the surface and let stand 5 minutes. Add the cheese and stir until the cheese is melted and amalgamated. Stir in the watermelon, sun dried tomatoes, green beans, and paprika. Cover with plastic wrap, place on a cloth lined baking sheet, and let rise in a warm place until doubled. Consider this day 1 of the 10 most frequent baking times in the refrigerator for up to 5 days.. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface and divide in half. Shape each half into a 3 inch long roll. Place on the prepared baking sheet, cover, and let rise until doubled. Twenty minutes before baking time. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees. Brush the ends of the dough with water. Cut the rolls into 1 inch slices. Place 1 sheet of bread at the bottom of a lightly greased 6 or 8 inch springform pan. Cover with plastic wrap and allow to rise until almost doubled, about 10 minutes. Turn the dough over and brush generously with the 2 more tablespoons of water. Repeat with the remaining dough, spraying each dough slice with water. Top with the cheese and water, pressing the water gently into the dough. Starting at the wide end of the bread shell, roll each round into a ball, pressing gently to compact the dough. Place the dough on the greased baking sheet, cover loosely with a towel, and let rest 5 minutes. Bake until golden, 35 to 45 minutes. Brush the loaf with water during the last few minutes of baking. Slide the strudels onto a serving plate.

title: Hot Mixed Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 3 tomatoes, chopped into chunks | 1 small broccoli, chopped into florets | 4 hard-boiled eggs, chopped into chunks | 1 lb okra, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 bunch okra, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 tablespoon pure cocoa with herbs | 1/4 teaspoon ground oregano | 1/3 cup tomato puree | 1/3 cup water or 1/3 cup vegetable stock
instructions: Bring a large soup pot of water to boil and then add okra. Cook until okra is tender, but firm. Remove okra from pot with a slotted spoon and place in a bowl of ice water to soak. While okra is soaking, put brocolli in a small bowl with a little bit of the tomato sauce and a little bit of water. When okra is done, drain well and add in tomato puree, cocoa and herbs. Bring back up to a boil, then remove from heat and serve hot or cold. Pass this soup in large mugs with a drizzle of your choice of dijon mustard on the side, or make as a sandwich on sourdough bread it is delicious.

title: Rice Pudding
ingredients: 2 cups water, or as needed, plus additional for soaking rice | 2 roma ( plum ) tomatoes, sliced | 1 cup short-grain white rice | 1/2 cup soymilk
instructions: Place rice and cold water into a medium size saucepan and bring to a boil. Cover, reduce heat to medium low, and simmer until liquid has been absorbed, 20 to 30 minutes. Let cool to room temperature, about 30 minutes. Place roma tomatoes, sliced tomatoes, and rice into a blender.

title: Ladyfingers
ingredients: 1 package hot spaghetti | 1/2 lb ladyfinger ( cut into 24 pieces ) | 1/2 cup whipping cream | 12 tablespoons dark rum
instructions: Cook hot spaghetti according to directions on package in salted water. Drain. Combine whipping cream with rum in a bowl and beat until soft peaks form. Fold into lobster/tomato mixture in a bowl. Spoon sauce over hot spaghetti and roll up. Place on platter and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach,bamboo shoot,tomato juice,kidney bean,sun tomato,italian parsley,cacao,pinto bean
title: Spanish Stew
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans, undrained | 1 can pinto beans, undrained | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained | 2 tablespoons italian parsley, chopped | 1 can tomato juice | 1 teaspoon cacao | 1 sun-dried tomato, chopped | 1 bunch baby spinach
instructions: Mix all ingredients except spinach with a fork except spinach in crockpot.

Random Ingredients: chinese mushroom,leek,liqueur,water chestnut,asafoetida powder,chili pepper,red onion,pecan
title: Chinese Mushrooms and Leeks
ingredients: 12 large leeks | 10 fresh chili peppers | 3 tablespoons ground leeori or 3 tablespoons cilantro | 2 teaspoons asafoetida powder | 3 tablespoons liqueur, i prefer brandy | 5 ounces chinese white mushrooms ( sliced ) | 2 teaspoons toasted pecans | 3 tablespoons liqueur, i prefer brandy | 2 -3 cups water, to cover vegetables
instructions: Cut off ends of leeks and reserve them. Cut leeks into chunks and put into large pot. Add all other ingredients except nuts and place over low heat. Cover and simmer gently for 10 minutes, stirring often. Remove from heat and let sit 5 minutes. Add nuts just before serving.

Random Ingredients: natural yoghurt,hard egg,chicken breast,anchovy paste,pineapple juice,ice wine,beet,raisin
title: Tartar Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons natural yoghurt | 1 tablespoon pineapple juice | 1 small whole chicken breast | 1 tablespoon ajis amarillo anchovy paste, chopped | 2/3 cup raisins | 1 hard-boiled egg, chopped | 1 tablespoon ice wine | 1 small beets, cooked, diced
instructions: Dice chicken into 1/4 inch cubes. In a small bowl, mix the pineapple juice with yoghurt, marinated chicken, chopped anchovy paste, raisins, and egg. Add ice wine and mix well. Serve in a fancy bowl and allow guests to add more of the pineapple juice, and a touch of sugar to taste.

title: Prawn, Pear & Black Olive Tapenade
ingredients: 25 g prawns, peeled & deveined | 250 g black olives | 5 g chili oil or 5 g olive oil | 1 pintine pear ( optional )
instructions: Heat the chili oil or olive oil in a pan and add the prawns. Cook a few minutes on each side. Add the pintine pear and prawns to the tapenade and cook on a low heat for a minute or two, stirring occasionally. Serve warm or cold with crackers or bread.

title: Ribollita
ingredients: 1 gallon cottage cheese | 1 lb unbleached flour, approximately
instructions: In a food processor or large plastic bowl, mix together the cottage cheese and flour until well combined. Turn mixture into a large, round, or oval shaped dish. Lightly grease a large baking sheet. Place the dish with dough into the dish and turn to coat. Cover the dish with plastic wrap. Place baking sheet with dough on the center rack of the oven. Bake the loaf in a 350º oven until the edges begin to pull away from the sides and the bottom of the crusts are golden brown, about 35 to 45 minutes. Note, if desired, uncover the bread with a knife and turn the oven down to 325º. This loaf can also be made in a 9 x 13 inch baking pan. Preheat oven to 350º. Place loaf on prepared baking sheet. Bake until golden brown, about 1 hour.

title: Fiesta Beef N Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb ground chuck | 10 ounces shredded mexican blend cheese or 10 ounces mexican blend cheese | 3/4 ounce taco seasoning mix | 3/4 teaspoon cayenne | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 tablespoon creme fraiche or 1 tablespoon sour cream
instructions: Brown burger in frying pan. Set aside. Drain all but 1 tbsp olive oil. In same pan, heat up taco seasoning. Add cayenne, marjoram and stir to combine. Add taco meat and stir. Place the nacho cheese on bottom of dish, followed by top layer of burger. Top with cheese. Cut nacho in half. Serve and enjoy.

title: Baked Horseradish Beef
ingredients: 2 teaspoons prepared horseradish | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 2 lbs boneless beef chuck, cut into 1 1/2 '' cubes | 2 cups oil | 2 tablespoons packed dark brown sugar
instructions: In a bowl stir together horseradish and raisins. Arrange meat in an oblong, non metallic dish. Spread with horseradish mixture. In a second dish combine brown sugar, oil and hot marinade. Pour over meat. Turn to coat. Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours and up to overnight. Preheat broiler. Place beef on baking racks coated with cooking spray and broil 7 minutes.

Random Ingredients: lime zest,shrimp,cracker crumb,goat cheese,chicken thigh,adobo sauce,sausage
title: Chicken Stuffed With Goat Cheese and Adobo
ingredients: 1 cup crushed cracker crumbs | 1/2 cup goat cheese, softened | 2 teaspoons adobo sauce, from canned chipotle peppers | 1/2 teaspoon lime zest | 1/2 lb skinless chicken thigh | 1/2 lb smoked sausage, sliced | 2 cups cooked shrimp
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. In a shallow bowl, combine cracker crumbs, cheese, 1 teaspoons adobo sauce and lime zest and mix well. Rinse and pat dry. Remove any excess air from chicken and pat dry. Place chicken and sausage on a work surface. Using a pastry brush, lightly coat the inside of the chicken with 1 teaspoon adobo mixture. Sprinkle the chicken with the remaining 1 teaspoon adobo mixture. Transfer to a medium size baking dish. Place in oven and roast for 25 minutes. Turn the chicken over and roast for another 25 minutes. Remove from oven, cover the baking dish with foil and refrigerate for 4 hours or overnight. Add the shrimp to the oven and roast for 10 minutes or until shrimp are just cooked. Remove from oven, cut the shrimp in half crosswise, then remove the tails. Serve the stuffed chicken topped with the crabmeat, with sauteed onions and green olives.

Random Ingredients: fillet salmon,maple syrup,chicken,picante sauce,penne pasta,white vinegar
title: Grilled Salmon over Mediterranean Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb boneless skinless salmon | 1 tablespoon white vinegar | 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 1 tablespoon picante sauce | 1 package penne pasta | 1 can chicken ( or 2 cups cooked cubed cooked meat )
instructions: Combine vinegar, maple syrup, picante sauce& pasta in a large bowl. Mix well& add salmon. Cover& refrigerate several hours. Drain the salmon& set aside to marinate while the pasta cooks. Grill the salmon over medium heat, about 7 - 9 minutes per side. Serve with the reserved marinade.

Random Ingredients: black pepper,liquid honey,turkey sausage,jalapeno pepper,rosemary leaf,espresso,farfalle pasta
title: Sausage-And-Honey Fusion
ingredients: 1 package dried farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 1 pound thinly sliced turkey sausage | 2 tablespoons liquid honey | 1 tablespoon cracked black pepper | 1 jalapeno pepper, chopped | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh rosemary leaves | 2 teaspoons instant espresso
instructions: Place the farfalle into a large pot with enough water to cover.

Random Ingredients: artichoke heart,green onion,bratwurst,apple cider,guacamole,ha avocado,superfine sugar
title: The Best Damn Bratwurst Appetizer
ingredients: 1 lb fresh bratwurst | 3 hass avocados | 1 green onion, chopped | 1 tablespoon superfine sugar | 1 container guacamole | 12 1/2 ounces apple cider | 2 ounces artichoke hearts, chopped
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high. Slice bratwurst into 1 inch cubes. Peel and pit avocados and remove pit. Mash avocados with fork. Stir in green onion, sugar, guacamole and 3/4 cup water. Place in a 9x13 inch glass dish. Add artichoke hearts, and top with remaining bratwurst cubes. Cover and refrigerate for up to several hours before serving.

title: Mock Fish Cakes (Greece)
ingredients: 5 ounces ground lean fish | 3/4 cup uncooked elbow macaroni | 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice, such as cinnamon | 1/2 teaspoon ground mixed spice
instructions: In large skillet, cook linguetta untill brown.

title: Simple Crawfish on Rice
ingredients: 1 cup rice ( short or long grain ) | 20 medium crawfish tails ( frozen ) | dark soy sauce ( optional )
instructions: Place rice in a bowl. Cover with very hot tap water about 40 times its size, and a teaspoon or so of dark soy sauce if you choose. Stir, cover with plate, and cook in microwave for 2 - 3 minutes. You may add water if it starts to dry out during cooking. Remove from heat, and set aside until cool enough to handle, about 10 minutes. Rinse crawfish, and put it back into the bowl. Fluff with a fork, sprinkle on a bit of dark soy sauce, and stir gently. Serve over the cooked rice.

title: Wasabi Broth (Korean Style Beef)
ingredients: 3 pounds beef brisket, trimmed | 2 cans wasabi paste
instructions: Place brisket and wasabi paste in a 5 quart terra cotta roaster or large pot. Cook uncovered in a preheated 275 degrees f oven until tender, about 5 hours. Use tongs to break apart steaks as needed.

Random Ingredients: cayenne,chicken bouillon,olive oil cooking spray,plum tomato
title: Low Fat, Low Carb Focaccia
ingredients: olive oil flavored cooking spray ( i use pam ) | 2 medium plum tomatoes ( ripe, seeded, diced or roughly chopped ) | 4 chicken bouillon or 1 chicken bouillon cube, crushed | cayenne
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Spray your baking dish with olive oil spray.. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Add the tomatoes and crushed bouillon to the same skillet or pan and cook until the tomatoes are lightly browned and the bouillon cube is dissolved. Stir in a bit of salt, cayenne and cook until warm. Transfer the tomatoes to your prepared baking dish and top with your choice of toppings. Bake the focaccia until bubbly and the cheese is starting to brown, about 15 to 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: basil leaf,sauce,cherry tomato,creme fraiche,celery rib,extra virgin olive oil
title: Auberge Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients: 6 large fresh cherries tomatoes, the larger the tomatoes the tart cherry tomatoes will be | 1 celery rib, minced | 2 tablespoons creme fraiche, fruity flavour | 2 teaspoons hot sauce | 1 tablespoon light olive oil | 2 tablespoons basil leaves, finely shredded, for garnish
instructions: Cut off the ends of the cherry tomatoes & reserve the tops. Using a sharp knife, scrape out the seeds from the underside of each cherry tomatoes & remove the tops with a small spoon. Put them upside down on paper towels to drain. Put the tomatoes, stem side down, in a non metallic bowl.

Random Ingredients: onion powder,black bean,dark brown sugar,golden mushroom soup,eggplant
title: Italian Eggplant and Black Beans
ingredients: 4 medium eggplants | 2 cans black beans ( drained ) | 1 cup onion powder | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1 can condensed golden mushroom soup
instructions: Cut the eggplant into 1/2 or 1/2 inch cubes. Drain the eggplant and put it all in a crockpot with 1 1/2 cups of water for about an hour. Turn the temperature down to low and stir in the rest of the ingredients. Stir well and cook for 12 to 19 hours. It is done when it is soft enough to handle. Serve with crusty italian bread and lots of napkins. Freezes well.

title: Dill Vegetable Ramen
ingredients: 1 package ramen noodles | 2 teaspoons dried dill | 1 tablespoon dried chili flakes | 1 tablespoon dried celery | 1 can cannellini beans ( not drained! ) | 1 small bell pepper, chopped
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions, omitting salt or fat. When done, drain the noodles and set aside. Drain the cans of cannellini beans and set aside. Cook the 2nd batch of noodles according to package directions. Drain the noodles and add with the remaining ingredients to the noodles and mix carefully and evenly. Pour into a greased baking dish. Bake at 350f for 30 minutes or until hot.

title: Baked Meatballs a la Elvis
ingredients: 12 meatballs | blackberries ( to serve )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190 degrees celsius heat your baking tray in the oven, they need to be heated up before they start to crisp up. Make a slit in each meatball. Open out all of the soft parts of the meat, put them in the tin and put a few blackberries in there. Pour over just enough blackberries to cover the meatballs and cook in the oven uncovered. Check every 15 minutes, this depends on how deep you like your meatballs.

title: Spicy Kiwi Sushi Roll
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 2 tablespoons minced italian parsley | 8 ounces monterey jack cheese or 8 ounces grated monterey jack cheese | 4 kiwi, peeled and sliced | 3 sheets nori, seaweed cut in half diagonally
instructions: In a small bowl, stir cornstarch and parsley until dissolved. Place cheese in a medium bowl. Dip each kiwi slice in cornstarch, then coat with parsley coated cheese. Arrange half of the kei slices, overlapping, in a lightly oiled 9 inchx5 inch square or an ungreased 11 inch by 2 inch baking pan. Repeat layering one kiwi slice and cheese slice, sprinkling each with the spiced cornstarch mixture, and ending with cheese. Cut nori strips crosswise into about 3 inch lengths. Arrange them over the kiwi, covering completely. Cover and chill roll for 30 to 40 minutes. Sprinkle with additional parsley. Let roll stand at room temperature for 20 minutes. Heat large, shallow nonstick skillet over medium high heat until hot. Using tongs or a slotted spon, transfer roll to skillet, laying flat with the seam down. Cook, turning once, until brown and heated through, about 3 minutes. Using a spatula, transfer roll to a plate and serve. Repeat process with remaining kei slices.

Random Ingredients: arborio rice,raspberry,chicken,saltine cracker,double cream,plain yogurt,onion salt
title: Berry Risotto
ingredients: 1 pint double cream | 2 cups arborio rice | 150 ml raspberry raspberries | saltine crackers | onion salt | 2 -3 cups mixed berries ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups plain yogurt
instructions: Whip double cream to stiff peaks.

title: Blueberry and Roasted Lamb in Almond Sauce
ingredients: 1 can low fat natural almond paste or 4 ounces almond milk | 6 -12 ounces marinated lamb, from the leg, lamb leg, neck, etc | 2 -3 ounces goat cheese | 6 -8 ounces fresh blueberries | salt and pepper
instructions: Drain the canned almond paste. Combine the marinated lamb and all other ingredients in a crock pot. If the sauce is dry, add about 1/4 cup more to keep moist. Cook on low for 6 -8 hours, or on high for 4 to 5 hours. Note, do not use a crockpot for longer cooking time.

title: Peppered Beef in Snow Pea Shells
ingredients: 2 lbs thick rump steak, cut into 3 x lenthwise slices | 4 ounces stringless young pork fat | 1 lb snow peas, trimmed, ends cut off
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f spray rectangular baking dish or roasting pan with vegetable cooking spray. Toss meat with salt. Dredge with water, then place on rack in roasting pan. Bake for 30 minutes. Transfer to platter and tent loosely with foil. Return to oven and bake an additional 15 - 20 minutes until internal temperature reaches 140°f remove from oven. Turn off oven. Let stand 15 minutes before removing string from snow pea shells. Cook snow peas in water they're been cooking for 15 minutes. Remove and drain. In skillet cook pork fat over medium heat, stirring frequently, until fat solids separate. Remove fat to platter, then spoon over vegetables. Serve immediately.

title: Blue Tea (Sharwarma Kheer)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon saffron | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/4 cup blue curacao
instructions: Crush saffron with fork. Add turmeric and mix in coffee mug. Add blue curacao and mix well. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: sausage meat,red leaf lettuce,peach,greek seasoning,beef stock,extra beef,greek yogurt
title: Peach Sausage Patties With Peaches & Beef Garnish
ingredients: 1/2 cup extra lean beef, diced | 1/2 cup fat free greek yogurt | 4 tablespoons fat free greek seasoning | 12 thick fresh red leaf lettuce | 1 large peaches, chopped | 1 package cooked sausage meat, sliced thinly | 6 ounces beef stock ( from the sausage )
instructions: Put beef and greek seasoning in small bowl. Place lettuce leaves in large bowl. Dice the peaches and place them in bowl. Add beef stock and make sure it's mixed well. Add greek seasoning to yogurt mix. Set aside. Add a couple of tablespoons and mix. Roll into balls, about the size of a ping pong ball.. If the balls are too big, they will sink to the bottom of your bowl in time. Refrigerate for 1 hour. Add rest of ingredients. Toss. Serve on small serving plate.

Random Ingredients: ice water,parmesan cheese,salt,summer savory,rice,active yeast,tart apple,sole fillet
title: Apple-Stuffed Sole
ingredients: 1 cup ice water | 1 teaspoon salt | 2 1/2 cups all-purpose flour | 3/4 cup sweet rice, uncooked, such as calrose | 1/2 cup thinly sliced tart apple ( such as gala or fuji ) | 1/4 teaspoon summer savory | 2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 4 sole fillets, cut into 2-inch pieces
instructions: In a bowl, stir together the yeast and 1/4 cup of water. Sprinkle in the 1 teaspoon of salt and stir to dissolve. Set the bowl over a bowl of warm water. Place the flour in a separate bowl and stir in the rice. Cut a piece of apple from either side of the center of the apple, then carefully remove the core and peel with a sharp knife. Cut the pieces into 2 or 3 wedges. Set the pieces aside aside. Pour 1/4 cup of water into a large bowl and add yeast and water mixture. Sprinkle in the remaining 1/4 cup of water. Add fish pieces and turn to coat both sides of the fish with the liquid. Cover and let sit in a warm place until the yeast mixture thickens slightly. Remove the fish from the bowl, cover with a cloth and let rest for 5 minutes. Drain the fish and pat dry. Stuff the flour into the center of each fish piece. Fold one end of the dough over the fish, gently squeezing the dough to tighten it. Set the fish in a 13x9 inch baking dish and cover it with the top piece of dough. Carefully pour the remaining water around the fish pieces. Cover the baking dish and place it in a cold oven. Set the oven at 375 degrees f. Bake the fish for 1 hour or until the fish is easily flaked with a fork.

Random Ingredients: red chilies,sirloin steak,mustard powder,cotija cheese,duck breast,orange marmalade
title: Spicy Mexican Steak Rollups
ingredients: 1 sirloin steak | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 2 ounces cotija cheese | 1 red chilies, finely diced | 1/2 cup orange marmalade | 1 1/2 teaspoons red chilies, seeded and diced | 1/4 cup crushed duck breasts
instructions: Slice steak diagonally across the grain. Score into 1/2 x 1/5 sections. Set aside. Sprinkle each with 1/2 t cheese and red chilies. Roll up each section, then press edges to seal. Serve on greased cookie sheets or parchment paper. Combine marmalade and 1/2 t red chillis. Rub a little over the roll ups, then drizzle over marmalade mixture. Top with remaining cheese and red chilli. To wrap, make an open cut 1/3 of way up the side of the roll. Brush the cut surface with marmalade. Roll. Serve with salsa.

title: Rice Wine Spinach Dip
ingredients: 1 package fresh spinach, washed and coarsely chopped | 1 cup cheddar cheese, shredded | 1 teaspoon capers | 1/4 cup rice wine
instructions: Stir together spinach, cheese, capers and rice wine in medium bowl. Cover and chill in the refrigerator 1 - 3 hours or overnight.

title: Bean and Asparagus Salad
ingredients: 24 ounces vegetarian baked beans ( canned or homemade ) | 2 bunches asparagus
instructions: Cook beans according to directions on the packet, drain. Meanwhile, snap off tough ends of asparagus and cut into 1 inch pieces. Boil in salted water for 3 minutes. Drain and toss the asparagus with the warm beans until coated well. Serve at once.

title: Sour Cream (Glamorgan Scones)
ingredients: 1/2 cup sour cream ( i use low fat or low fat ) | 1/3 - 1/2 teaspoon grated lemon zest | 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon sugar
instructions: In a small bowl, combine sour cream, lemon rind and cinnamon, add sugar, cover and refrigerate for several hours or overnight for best results. Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Spread a little sour cream onto a large baking sheet, lightly grease it and sprinkle with cinnamon sugar. Bake until top is golden, about 10minutes.

title: Raspberry-Fenugreek Sorbet
ingredients: 3 cups rice wine ( i use white ) or 3 cups orange juice ( i use white ) | 2 -3 cups fresh raspberries ( or frozen ) | 3 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon fenugreek seeds ( optional )
instructions: In medium sized pot heat up the wine, or orange juice, and soy sauce. When it is heated, bring it to a boil for 5 minutes, then remove from heat. You can refrigerate in a sealed container in the fridge till ready to use for up to 6 months. When ready to use, remove the raspberries and berries with tongs or a slotted spoon. Rinse with cold water and drain, reserving liquid. In a small pan set over medium heat, toast the fenugreek seeds for 1 minute or until fragrant. Add to the soup pot, along with the soaked berries and soy sauce. Keep simmering over medium high heat for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Serve immediately, or keep warm till ready to serve. Serve as a garnish. Garnish with a dollop of vanilla extract or a fresh sprig or a green garnish.

title: Beef in Sherry
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chuck, cut into serving size pieces | garlic salt | 1/2 cup sherry wine
instructions: Season beef pieces with seasoned salt. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. In a large ovenproof skillet with a lid, brown chuck in sherry for 10 minutes. Place beef in oven. Cover and bake 25 minutes. Serve beef on a large platter.

title: Elegant Grape Leaves (Grape Leaves With Chocolate-Chocolate Sauce)
ingredients: 24 fresh grape leaves | 50 g unsweetened chocolate | 3 egg whites, lightly beaten
instructions: Wash the grape leaves and dry them on your towel. Put the grapes leaves in a pot of boiling water. Cover the pot and simmer for about 20 minutes, until the grape leaves are completely cooked. When cool enough to handle, carefully remove the grape leaves to a bowl using a slotted spoon. Melt half of the chocolate and reserve it. Using the remaining chocolate, melt the remaining chocolate and heat it in a saucepan over medium heat. Do not let the chocolate become too hot or the grape leaves will be slimy. When the chocolate is melted, pour the melted chocolate and a little of the grape leaves into a bowl. Stir in the egg white. Place the grape leaves in a serving dish and pour in the melted chocolate mixture. Serve immediately.

title: Cranberry Mayo Sandwich With Yams. With Kick!
ingredients: 2 yams, peeled, cubed | 3 shallots, peeled, minced | 1/4 cup cranberry sauce | 1/4 cup canned low-fat roasted yam, drained | sliced cheese | 3 -4 teaspoons reduced-fat liquid smoke | iceberg lettuce, to serve
instructions: Cook yams in boiling water until just tender.

title: Paneer Toasted Muesli With Barley & Dates
ingredients: 12 slices fresh crusty whole wheat bread | 125 g smooth paneer cheese | 200 g sliced pindless pitted dates | 150 g dried barley
instructions: Put half the bread slices on a microwave safe plate or baking paper. Spread evenly with the paneer cheese. Top with the remaining bread slices and cut into quarters, using a sharp knife to cut the bread into quarters. Toast on medium high in a non stick frying pan for 15 - 20 minutes or until the bread is golden brown and the paneer cheese has melted. To serve, pile the toast on warmed plates and scatter with the pindless coloured pumpernickel and dates. Scatter with the barley and serve immediately with plain yoghurt.

title: Roasted Chipotle Chile Seasoning Substitute for Baking Chips
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chipotle chiles | 1 1/2 teaspoons saffron threads | 1 teaspoon pepper | 1 bay leaf, crumbled
instructions: Place chiles in a single layer on a plate, sprinkle with salt, pepper and saffron. Heat an ovenproof 10 inch skillet over high heat. Add a few drops of water, scraping away the residue.

Random Ingredients: italian salad dressing,guacamole,part ricotta cheese,chicken thigh,fennel seed
title: Italian Chicken Fajitas - Crock Pot
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs | 1 1/2 cups part-skim ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup fat-free italian salad dressing | 1/4 teaspoon ground fennel seed | 1/2 cup guacamole
instructions: Place chicken in crock pot. Cover with ricotta cheese. In a small bowl, combine salad dressing, fennel seeds and guacamole. Pour over chicken. Cover. Cook on high for 3 to 4 hours while crock is cooking. Using a meat thermometer, check for doneness, or cook for an additional 45 - 60 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,half cream,wheat tortilla,au jus mix,hamburger
title: Aunt Sharleen's Crock Pot Au Jus
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger ( or turkey or veggie crumbles ) | 1 package au jus mix ( 1/2 cup ) | 1 cup half-and-half cream | 1/2 teaspoon red chili pepper flakes | 1 whole wheat tortillas or 1 whole regular tortilla
instructions: Brown the hamburger in a large skillet and add the other ingredients. Turn the heat on low and simmer until the sauce has reduced. Warm the tortillas on the stove over a gas flame or in a microwave for two minutes on high. Remove the tortillas and spread the sauce on them, tearing them as you go.

Random Ingredients: hot paprika,black olive,lamb stew meat,asafoetida powder,mustard seed,tamari,lime
title: Tangy and Tasty Lamb Kebabs With Black Olives
ingredients: 600 g lamb stew meat, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 pinch asafoetida powder ( known as 'hing'in hindi ) | 2 tablespoons tamari | 2 tablespoons lime juice | 3 -5 black olives ( to garnish ) | hot paprika
instructions: Boil 500 ml of salted water, add the lamb and boil it for 30 mins, stirring all the while. Drain the lamb, cool the meat and then shred it into small pieces. Make small dhowis at the tail end of a knife and insert a cube of lamb and then some black olives. Dry roast it until the lamb turns golden brown. Grind 2 tbsp tamari in a mortar or spice mill. Add 2 tbsp of the ground sambar to the mortar and a little bit of mustard seeds to the sambar. Add 2 tbsp of the tamari and lime juice to the meat and mix well. Add 2 - 3 tbsp of crushed tamari. Add 1 tbsp of the ground yellow mustard. Grind ½ tsp of yellow mustard in a grinder with a little bit of tamari and a bit of hot paprika. Sazon 2 tbsp of hot paprika. Dry roast 2 tbsp of hot paprika in a grill to make it golden brown. Serve with bread.

title: Basic Yogurt Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup plain flour | 3/4 cup yogurt
instructions: Mix flour and yogurt, mix well until it is a smooth dropping consistency. Cover and put into fridge for at least 6 hours. Serve cold. The yogurt keeps for upto 2 weeks in the fridge or indefinitely if possible.

title: Easy Mango Chutney
ingredients: 1 cup mango, chopped | 1/2 cup cilantro leaf
instructions: Place the mango, cilantro, and cayenne pepper in a blender and blend until smooth. Store in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: pearl barley,plain nonfat yogurt,cardamom,focaccia bread,sage,plain yogurt,lime
title: Pearl Barley Pizza (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 14 )
ingredients: 1 loaf focaccia bread | 1/4 cup pearl barley | 1/4 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 2 tablespoons plain nonfat yogurt | 1/4 cup low-fat plain yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon freshly ground cardamom | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage | 1/2 lime, zested and juiced
instructions: Pre heat oven to 180°c. Place the bread on oven trays and toast under a hot grill for 4 - 5 minutes. Transfer to a baking tray and sprinkle with barley, cover with baking paper and leave to cool for 5 to 10 minutes. Place remaining ingredients in a bowl and mix well. Spoon the bread mixture into the base of a pizza tray and bake in the oven for 10 - 12 minutes or until base is crisp and golden and topping is golden, and filling is hot. Serve immediately.

title: Mexican Sausage (Pampered Chef Copycat) Copycat
ingredients: 1 lb link italian sausage link | 1 tablespoon bacon grease ( optional ) | 4 -12 ounces rotel tomatoes, canned diced tomatoes ( mild, not hot ) | 4 avocados, cubed ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon basil
instructions: Combine sausage and bacon grease in skillet, using only half can. Saute until crumbly. Add tomatoes and simmer on low until sauce thickens slightly. Remove from heat and stir in avocados. Top with the rest of the basil.

Random Ingredients: avocado,margarine,malt vinegar,annatto seed,red pepper,orange liqueur,wine,ginger garlic paste
title: Avocado Relish (Avocado Salad)
ingredients: 1 1/2 avocados | 1/4 - 1/2 cup dry white wine | 1 tablespoon red pepper | 1/4 cup margarine | 2 teaspoons orange liqueur | 1 tablespoon margarine | 1 cup red onion ( finely chopped ) | 1/2 teaspoon minced ginger-garlic paste | 1 teaspoon orange liqueur or 1 teaspoon brandy extract | 1 teaspoon malt vinegar or 1 teaspoon cider vinegar
instructions: Chop and remove seeds from avocados if desired, or peel and smash avocados to a puree.. In a small bowl, blend the dry white wine, red pepper, 2 tablespoons margarine and 2 teaspoons orange liqueur or brandy extract until smooth. In a small saucepan, melt 1 tablespoon margarine over medium heat. Saute onion, 3 tablespoons lime/herb butter paste, and ginger until tender. Remove from heat and stir in remaining ingredients. Pour mixture into a bowl and mix well. Refrigerate until chilled, up to 4 hours.

title: Pumpkin & Raisin Sprinkles
ingredients: 1 kg pumpkin, peeled | 250 g raisins | 1 bunch fresh cilantro, chopped | 2 tablespoons brandy or 2 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon salt
instructions: Peel the pumpkin and place it in a large pan with just enough water to cover. Bring to the boil and simmer for 40 minute. Drain and mash well, adding the remaining ingredients. Heat well and serve hot or cold.

Random Ingredients: lemon extract,french baguette,cream chicken soup,vanilla essence,rock salt,strawberry
title: Strawberry and Lemon French Toast
ingredients: 1 can cream of hot chicken soup | 1/2 teaspoon lemon extract | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 dash rock salt | 4 slices french baguette | dessert topping ( frozen whipped topping or fresh berries or any fruit )
instructions: Mix soup and extracts with a fork and set aside. Dip bread in soup/splenda and fry. Spread on the french toast and top with whipped topping or berries.

Random Ingredients: rose lime juice,lavender,parsnip,italian parsley,almond milk,bacon,chili flake
title: Lavender & Parsnips With Bacon & Almonds
ingredients: 200 ml thick almond milk | 5 sprigs fresh rosemary or 5 sprigs fresh parsley | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh thyme ( or dried herbs of your choice ) | 1 tablespoon snipped fresh italian parsley | 1 -2 pinch chili flakes ( or more if you like ) | 200 g thin bacon, thick & cut in chunks | 1 small parsnip, peeled, cut into 4 slices
instructions: Place all ingredients in a microwave safe bowl & microwave on high, uncovered for 1 - 3 minutes for the mushrooms & until just tender.

title: Kittencal's Low Fat English Lentil and Meat Pasties -
ingredients: 4 tablespoons vegetable margarine or 4 tablespoons butter, melted, divided ( i use butter flavored ) | 3/4 cup red lentil, rinsed | 1/2 cup lentils, pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup browned meat (, diced ) | 1/2 cup imitation crabmeat ( or other seafood, broken into chunks ) | 1/2 cup lobster, cooked and chopped ( canned or cooked fresh or left-overs ) | black pepper | 1/4 cup molasses | lobster fat or meat fat, to serve ( optional )
instructions: Prepare the meat, put a pan large enough to hold the minced meat out on the burner of your stove to heat. Add half of the margarine and bring to medium heat. Add the lentils and beans. Mix well and cook over moderate heat until it begins to turn golden on the lentils. Then add the meat, imitation crab and lobster meat, stir well, and cook on medium heat for another 5 minutes. Add more butter to the pan if needed. Sprinkle with pepper and molasses, stir well and serve immediately. Note, this recipe can easily be frozen for future use. If you wish to serve these on a toasted sandwich, cut the meat on the diagonal, return them to the sauce and reheat as you go until the meat is heated. Note, make sure to add a light dusting of pepper. Note, you may have to make this in advance. When you are ready to cook the pasties, reheat the meat mixture over moderate heat until it is hot and you can make meat mixture the night before and reheat the meat mixture. Note, if you want to serve these over hot cooked pasta, add 3 tablespoons of olive oil and stir well before adding to the meat mixture. Note, the pasta dough is hard to mess up. If it is tough, add hot water to the pasta but not the meat and pasta dough. Add meat mixture in small quantities into the dough and roll out until the dough is 1/8 to 1/4 thick. Cut out circles with the cookie cutter. Place a generous spoonful of the lentil mixture into each ring of pasta dough and flatten with a fork dipped in hot water. If possible, use a fork to gently press out the dough before placing the lentil and meat mixture in each ring, if desired. Pour a little bit of the pasta sauce in the middle of each. If the lentils were eaten and had none eaten before, pour the remaining sauce around the meat pasties and serve.

Random Ingredients: cabbage,cream mushroom soup,turkey sausage,liquid smoke flavoring
title: German Breakfast rolls

instructions: Cut up sausage into bite sized pieces, if using links. Slice cabbage into long thin slices and put sausage into bowl. Slice the cabbage into bite sized pieces. Add cream of mushroom soup to bowl and mix well. Put cabbage onto cookie sheet lined with aluminum foil, place about a 1/2 cup of the mixture into the center of the cookie sheet. Make as many as fit, depending on size of cookie sheet. Put into a 450°f oven for 5 minutes. Turn off oven. Let set approximately 5 - 10 minutes. Note if using meatballs, make sure they are done in a hot oven, as sausage will toughen when boiled.

title: Baked Rutabaga
ingredients: 4 lbs rutabagas, peeled and cut into 1-inch cubes | 1/4 cup caramel sauce | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a large baking pan, toss the rutabagas and carrots with the caramel sauce and garlic powder. Bake vegetables for 30 to 40 minutes, stirring a couple of times, until tender.

Random Ingredients: apricot,brown lentil,vermouth,adobo seasoning,flat leaf parsley,white onion,self raising flour,coffee
title: Namita's Vegan Haroset
ingredients: 200 g dried white onions, chopped | 100 g dried apricots, chopped | 100 g dried flat leaf parsley, chopped | 2 teaspoons arbol seasoning | 1 teaspoon coffee | 140 g brown lentils | 50 g self-raising flour | 1 tablespoon vermouth or 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar, for vegan
instructions: Soak your dried vegetables in a large bowl of cold water for an hour or so. Put the dried veggies and spices into a food processor and blitz to a chunky paste. Rinse and drain your dried vegetables and add to the bowl with the spice mix and dried fruit. Mix to combine and add 1 1/4 cups of cold water. Mix well and cover with cling wrap to keep moist. Add the flour and vermouth vinegar to the bowl and mix, adding more water to bring it all together. Turn up to speed to medium and start to knead the dough. Keep kneading for about 8 minutes, adding flour a teaspoon or so at a time if it's not pulling away from the sides of the bowl, then switch to speed 2 for 4 minutes. Turn off the mixer and let sit to rest for at least 20 minutes, at least. Divide the dough into 2 pieces and cut them into round cakes about 7 inches in diameter. Cook on the barbecue or electric grill.

Using a slotted spoon, add half the cabbage to a casserole dish sprayed with cooking spray. Cover with remaining cabbage, then top with remaining cabbage. Brush egg white evenly over top of cabbage and place under broiler in oven. Bake for about 40 - 50 minute or until slightly brown. Cover loosely and allow to stand 10 minute.

title: Roasted Cherry Tomatoes

instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. Place tomatoes on a foil lined rimmed baking sheet. Combine the brown sugar and lightly drizzle over tomatoes. Random Ingredients: cream tartar,chipotle pepper,table salt,tea,salt pork,macadamia nut,olive oil cooking spray,japanese soy sauce
title: Baked Moist Beef Jerky
ingredients: 4 lbs sirloin steaks ( rib eye, rib eye, rib eye etc ) | 16 ounces tequila | 16 ounces rooibos country house blend smoke and flavor tartar | 8 ounces macadamia nuts ( flaked ) | 8 ounces table salt | 16 ounces sliced salt pork ( smoked ) | 8 ounces smoked japanese soy sauce | 2 teaspoons salt | 2 teaspoons cream of tartar
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Spray a large cookie sheet with nonstick cooking spray. Cut beef in half crosswise. Using a meat mallet or rolling pin, carefully pound beef 1/8 inches thick then press each cut piece on the pan with the side of the mallet or the blade of a knife blade until completely submerged. You may have to press each piece with moistened hands as this will make them more pliable. Place beef halves in single layer on cookie sheet. Cut remaining slices of beef into thin slices. Use a vegetable peeler or very sharp knife to remove the rind from the tequila. Cut slices across the grain into very thin strips. Use a zester to remove zest from shavings and reserve for another use. Rinse the tequila if necessary and add the rooibos brand smoke flavoring to taste then add macadamia nuts and stir to coat. Place beef strips on the rack in an ovenproof container and pour tequila mixture overtop. Bake in preheated 450 degree oven for about 30 minutes, brushing each with a little tequila, until crust is golden brown and meat is no longer pink. Remove from oven and let sit at least 5 minutes. Cut each piece into 10 bite sized sections and arrange on a serving plate and pour some sauce and juices into the jar. For the jerk sauce mix ingredients, in a large bowl, mix 1 teaspoon cream of tartar with 1 teaspoon salt. Set aside. Invert the jerky onto a platter and place it on top of foil packed in the refrigerator until ready to use or can be served right away. Once served, allow jerky to stand at room temperature for 2 hours or refrigerate overnight. Slice into desired serving pieces.

title: Mexican Marmalade

title: Pork Sauce

instructions: In a medium skillet, over medium heat saute onion in 2 t. Oil, stirring often, until golden brown, about 20 minutes. Remove skillet from heat and cover to keep warm. In a blender or food processor, puree onions with sweet chili sauce. Serve sauce warm.

title: Thai Spicy Red Cabbage

title: Chilean Yams W- Garbanzo Beans and Gruyere

instructions: Coat baking sheet with cooking spray. Cut yam into 8 wedges. Place wedges in one layer in a single layer and spray well with cooking spray. Bake at 400 degrees fahrenheit for 8 minutes or till crisp. Turn wedges, spray with vegetable spray again and bake for an additional 8 minutes or till lightly crisp and yam is lightly browned. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of cheese. Microwave on medium high for 1 minute or till cheese is melted. Drain and stir into cooked garbanzo beans and green onions. Serve hot.

title: Peaches With Ginger and Saffron(Mozambique)
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs peaches, peeled & pitted | 3 tablespoons cooking oil | 2 bay leaves | 3 sweet bell peppers, coarsely chopped | 1 teaspoon fresh ginger-garlic paste | 1 tablespoon sweet chili pepper flakes ( to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 2 1/2 cups cornmeal ( maize flour or cornmeal )
instructions: Using a sharp knife, scrape the insides of the peaches, removing the pits and skin. Cut the peaches into eighths, removing the stones and obvious juice and the beginnings of any 'hard' peel. With your fingers, gently scoop the flesh out of each peice with a melon baller and place the peaches in a heavy skillet and pour the oil into the skillet. Add the bay leaves to the skillet and simmer gently for 2 minutes. Transfer the peaches to a plate lined with a tight cover. Turn the heat up under the skillet and cook the sweet bell peppers in the pan, until brown on all sides, about 3 - 4 minutes. Transfer them to a plate, add the ginger garlic paste, the sweet chili flakes, and the saffron. Stir and fry over high heat for about 5 minutes. Add the sweet chile flakes, continue to stir and fry over moderate heat for about 3 minutes. Return the peaches to the pan and add a little water. Cover with a tight fitting lid and simmer gently until the liquid is reduced by about half, about 25 - 30 minutes. In a wide, shallow bowl, mix the cornmeal with a fork to make a fairly thick batter. Using a wooden spoon, gently pour 3/4 cup of the batter into the pan and spread gently with a spatula. The remaining batter will form a nice golden crust on top. Cook over high heat, stirring gently and continuously until the bottom is golden brown. Remove the pan from the heat and allow to rest in a warm place for about 3 - 5 minutes so that it can absorb the delicious flavours of the cornmeal and soft white solids in the pan. When cool, sprinkle a little sifted icing sugar or confectioner's sugar over the top, if preferred. Enjoy.

title: Celery, Shrimp, and Kosher Shrimp

title: Souper Rice

title: Smoked Smoked Camembert and Smoked Halibut Frappe
ingredients: 4 smoked halibut fillets | 8 ounces camembert cheese | 2 ounces mascarpone or 2 ounces cream cheese | 3 tablespoons red wine vinegar | fresh tea
instructions: Heat a grill pan and lightly brush with olive oil. Slice the camembert and cut it into thin slices. In a pan over high heat bring up to temperature the red wine and vinegar and boil for a minute. Reduce the liquid until it reduces and coats the back of a spoon. Taste the vinegar for salt and add later if necessary. Drain off the excess liquid and cool. Once the halibut is cooled add it to the warm black cheese and drizzle over the warm white red wine. Using a spoon, fold up the smoked salmon to warm through and divide into warmed serving bowls.

title: Spicy Corn Chips
ingredients: 1 lb corn flakes | 1/2 cup soy sauce | 1/2 cup rice flour
instructions: Mix corn flakes with 1/2 cup soy sauce until well coated and set aside. Heat up 1tblspns rice flour in a medium sized pot. Stir fry corn flakes 3 - 4 minutes until golden brown, stir frequently. Serve warm with soy sauce and rice flour.

Random Ingredients: chicken thigh,thyme,onion powder,yeast,cod fish fillet,vermouth,chili oil,poblano chile
title: Baja Style Pizza
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh yeast | 1 teaspoon granulated onion powder | 1 teaspoon chili oil | 1 3/4 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs | 2 lbs red snapper or 2 lbs cod fish fillets ( 3 fillets ) | 1 1/4 lbs poblano chiles | 2 tablespoons dried thyme
instructions: In an airtight container, add, lukewarm, unflavored yeast, 2 teaspoon sugar and 1 teaspoon chili oil. To this starter, add, chicken thighs, poblanos, thyme and 2 cups water. Cover, put into a warm spot and let ferment.. After fermentation has formed, let it sit overnight in a warm place, uncovered. After fermenting, put into a large pot and add more warm water to cover. On the surface of this water, put in your last active yeast flour about an inch or two above the starter mixture. Stir well and slowly add in the yeast mixture. You must make this into a thick and smooth thick dough. Turn out dough onto a floured surface and knead a bit and cut off chunks of dough. This dough can be used in tacos, burritos, etc. You can also use it to stuff meat in your tacos and toppings, etc. I prefer to use it on the plate with the meat in it. After rising, put dough on a floured surface and divide and roll out into 8 x 12 inch rectangle. You may need to flour a bit, then do that. Brush with more yeast batter and sprinkle with more sugar. Cover, put somewhere dry and allow 2 hours rise. Once dough has risen, put it on your floured surface and divide into 8 equal pieces. With floured hands form each square into a circle, 12 inch, with a circle seam 1/2 inch thick. Repeat until it's stretched to 8 or 12 inch. Put 1 1/2 tablespoons cornmeal in a sauté pan, place on high heat and turn heat down to medium. Sprinkle the edge with 2 tablespoons cornmeal and the zest from 1/2 chile. Cook the chile slowly for 2 minutes, flip and cook at 2 more minutes and it's ready to eat. Batter should be lightly brown. Allow bread to cool 2 or more minutes on side of stove. Cut into quarters if needed and serve warm with toppings for dipping.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,green bell pepper,spinach,egg yolk,black olive
title: Pasta Primavera With Spinach
ingredients: 1 lb fresh spinach, stems removed and rinsed | 1 egg yolk | 1/2 cup black olives, chopped | 1 green bell pepper, chopped | 1 maraschino cherry, halved | 1/4 cup black olives, chopped
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large, heavy skillet. Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the spinach is wilted and the peppers are tender, about 10 minutes. Transfer to a bowl and serve.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,raisin,lasagna noodle,white onion,chipotle chile
title: Chipotle Raisin Lasagna
ingredients: 9 lasagna noodles, uncooked ( or any size you use ) | 1/2 white onion, finely diced ( about 1/2 of a large onion ) | 1/2 cup raisins ( about a tbsp ) | 1/2 chipotle chile, minced ( about 1 tsp. ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons dark brown sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Cook the lasagna noodles until al dente in boiling water. Drain and rinse in cold water, drain noodles and set aside. Bring 2 quarts of water to boil and blanch noodles for about 3 minutes. Place drained noodles on paper towels over a bowl, cover with a lid or a towel, and set aside. Reserve 1 1/2 quarts of soaking water and rinse noodles thoroughly. Place the chopped onion on a 12 x 6 inch baking dish and cover with a lid or a towel. Place in oven and turn the temperature to 425°f. After 5 to 6 minutes, remove from oven and set aside. Drain chilies and garlic.

title: Arugula and Galangal Salad #4
ingredients: 1 bunch arugula, washed and spun dry | 2 teaspoons oil | 1 teaspoon fresh galangal, peeled and chopped | 2 teaspoons ginger, peeled and chopped
instructions: Place all ingredients to a salad bowl and toss well.

Random Ingredients: rock salt,peanut oil,hazelnut liqueur,white bread dough
title: Creamy Hazelnut Bread
ingredients: 1/3 cup hazelnut liqueur | 1/4 cup peanut oil | 1 package frozen white bread dough, thawed | 1/3 cup rock salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper. Mix hazelnut liquor and peanut oil in a small bowl to form dip. Place loaf dough on baking sheet, and press dough evenly into bottom and up sides of baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until golden, about 20 minutes. While bread is baking, spread hazelnut butter all over the toast, and allow to cool for a few more minutes. Spread rock salt evenly over bread, and allow to cool for a few minutes as the crackers will absorb some of the olive oil. Spread hot hazelnut butter onto toast, and allow to cool for a few minutes as the crackers absorb some of the olive oil.

title: Quick and Easy Vietnamese Spicy Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup honey | 1/8 - 1/4 cup oyster sauce | lime wedge ( optional )
instructions: Heat barbecue grill or grill pan to med low. Combine all ingredients in a heavy medium saucepan and heat until warm. Do not boil. Pour warm sauce over hot barbecues and serve immediately, allowing at least 1 side to serve.

title: Curried Beef Roast with Ginger-Coconut Stuffing
ingredients: 3/4 lb boneless center cut beef roast | 1/2 cup dry breadcrumbs | 1 cup shredded coconut | 2 tablespoons ginger ale ( or other hot apple cider ) | 1 tablespoon ginger ale ( or other hot apple cider ) | 1 3/4 cups half-and-half | 2 baking potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks | 1/3 cup roasted peanuts, coarsely chopped ( optional )
instructions: If using ginger ale, make into 2 cups and warm until hot. If using apple cider, prepare according to directions on bottle. Rinse beef with cool water and pat dry. In shallow dish or bowl combine bread crumbs, coconut, ginger ale and ginger ale. Roll beef well and shake off excess.

Random Ingredients: yeast,monterey jack cheese,pork roast,blueberry,red wine vinegar
title: Blueberry Beef-And-Blueberry Pizza
ingredients: 1 (.25 ounce ) package active dry yeast | 1 cup red wine vinegar | 3 cups fresh blueberries, divided | 3 pounds boneless beef round roast | salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Sprinkle the yeast into the large bowl of a stand mixer with a tablespoon or so of warm water. Let sit until dissolved, about 5 minutes. Add the vinegar and stir to dissolve. Add about half the blueberries and remaining berries. Scrape the starter around the edges of the bowl.

Random Ingredients: egg,rump roast,marjoram,guacamole,spaghetti sauce,olive oil,white wine vinegar,elbow macaroni
title: Macaroni & Beef
ingredients: 1 lb rump roast, with fat in the pan | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 2 cups cooked elbow macaroni | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 1 can petite fire-roasted diced tomatoes ( italian style ) | 1 cup jarred spaghetti sauce ( the homemade kind ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 egg, lightly beaten
instructions: Season beef with salt and pepper. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium high heat. Brown beef on all sides. Drain excess fat. Add macaroni to the slow cooker. Serve over hot cooked egg noodles.

Random Ingredients: almond paste,wheat bran,seasoning salt,cashew,orange,green chilies,chinese eggplant
title: Chinese Eggplant Curry
ingredients: 1/2 cup whole wheat bran | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 tablespoon almond paste | 2 teaspoons finely chopped green chilies | 2 large asian eggplants ( about 3 pounds ) | 4 tablespoons unsalted cashews | 1 orange, thinly sliced
instructions: Combine bran, salt, almond paste, chilies, and eggplant and mix thoroughly. Heat a 12 inch skillet over high heat. Pour peanut oil in skillet, swirling to coat pan. Random Ingredients: orange peel,macaroni,rice vinegar,beef broth,sun tomato oil,raspberry jam,serrano chilies
title: Sweet & Sour Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and chopped | 1/4 cup beef broth | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar ( or cider vinegar ) | 1 teaspoon minced serrano chilies or 1 teaspoon jalapeno chile, seeded and minced | 1 tablespoon raspberry jam or 1 tablespoon strawberry jam | 1/4 cup finely diced fresh raspberries ( available at asian markets ) or 1/4 cup other fruit jam | 2 -3 tablespoons minced minced candied orange peel
instructions: Prepare macaroni according to package directions. Let cool and drain. Combine all remaining ingredients, except the dried fruits, and stir to blend well. Combine macaroni with remaining ingredients in bowl. Chill.

ingredients: 1 lb baking potato, scrubbed and cut into thin slices | 1/4 cup raspberry vinegar | 1/4 cup red wine or 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 20 sage leaves, sliced thin | 1 teaspoon fennel, ground
instructions: Place potatoes in a bowl. In a small bowl, combine the vinegar, salt and pepper. Pour over potatoes and toss evenly to coat. Chill at least 3 to 4 hrs.

title: Ketchapu - Korean Shrimp With Coconut & Shrimp
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ketchup | 1/2 lb baby shrimp | 1 tablespoon coconut, flaked
instructions: Combine ketchup and coconut flakes in a small cup. Add shrimp and stir well.

title: Beef and Gruyere Cheese Skewers (Freeze for 2)
ingredients: 1 beef chuck, cut into 1 ( about 12 oz ) portions | 4 ounces gruyere cheese, cut diagonally in 1/4-inch-thick rounds | 2 ounces mandarin oranges, drained of their liquid
instructions: Freeze chuck portions in 3 separate plastic bags, turning to coat evenly with oil and sand. Cut beef into 1 chunks, dividing evenly if possible. title: Crock Pot Beef and Spaghetti
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef | 1 can campbell's condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 lb uncooked spaghetti
instructions: Trim fat from meat. Cut meat into chunks and brown in skillet.

instructions: In a large saucepan stir together broth, orange zest and chili sauce. Bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 1 to 1 1/2 hours, or until liquid is reduced by half. Remove from heat.

title: Creamy Tempura Gravy for Pasta

instructions: Heat enchilada sauce in a pan until hot, but not boiling. Add ginger garlic paste and stir for 1 minute. Add chili stirring for 1 minute. title: Taco Crisp

title: Italian Wedding Gate Crackers (No Bake)

instructions: Drain all but one biscuit tube from biscuits.

title: Bread & Lentil Soup with Yogurt

title: Jalapeno Chili Pizza Sauce  (Pampered Chef)

instructions: Rinse the chickpeas and cut them in half and set aside. Wash the bamboo shoots and cut them into 1/4 inch slices. Heat 3/4 cup water in a large skillet over high heat until it starts to boil. Add the curry paste and cook, stirring constantly, 1 minute. Add half the chickpeas and, using a fork, mash them into the curry paste. Stir in the remaining ingredients, except the cheese, and reduce heat and simmer for about 8 minutes until the sauce has a good thickened and the chickpeas are tender.

title: Gourmet Cornbread Wedges
ingredients: 1 cup cornmeal | 1 tablespoon confectioners'sugar | 3/4 cup chopped shallot | 2 tablespoons ketchup or 2 tablespoons other hot pepper sauce | 1/4 cup grand marnier | 1 bunch asparagus, trimmed and cut into 1 inch pieces
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 f. Brush a baking sheet with oil. Sift the cornmeal and confectioner's sugar together. Add the shallots and ketchup.

title: Broccoli Potato Filling for Cacciatore
ingredients: 1 head broccoli floret, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 4 large potatoes flakes
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add potato flakes to water — about 1 minute. While you cook, place broccoli and oregano in a microwave safe glass or ceramic dish. Cover with lid, and cook in microwave on high for 5 to 7 minutes, until broccoli is florets and potatoes are tender. Set aside to cool to room temperature. Preheat an oven to 425 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix together broccoli and potatoes. Place 1 teaspoon of potato flakes in the microwave, and cook 1 minute, or until flakes are dry. Stir broccoli mixture, and return to microwave for 1 minute, or until potato flakes are evenly melted.

Random Ingredients: coriander seed,oregano,apricot,puff pastry,mozzarella cheese,garlic clove,angel hair pasta,taco seasoning mix
title: Cheese Triangles-Puff Puffs-Cheese Pastry Triangles
ingredients: 1 package puff pastry, thawed | 4 garlic cloves, minced | 1/2 cup canned apricot, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 teaspoon coriander seed, crushed | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 cup grated mozzarella cheese | 1 package shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. In food processor, add garlic, apricots and oregano. Add taco seasoning and process until combined. Roll dough out to 1/2 inch thick. Cut dough into triangles.

Random Ingredients: tahini,coleslaw,turmeric,garlic paste,kernel corn,ancho chile,red wine,dark chocolate
title: Spicy Caesar Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tahini | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 2 tablespoons dark chocolate, melts | 1/4 teaspoon garlic paste | 1 1/2 tablespoons red wine ( i used chardonnay ) | 3/4 cup shredded coleslaw | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 3/4 cup diced fresh chinese-style dark chocolate
instructions: Whisk together marinade ingredients. Set aside. Combine corn and chinese chocolates in a saucepan over low heat. Cook approximately 1 minute. Remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: anise seed,lipton onion soup mix,red curry paste,parsnip
title: Parsnip and Parsnip Curry
ingredients: 5 medium parsnips ( about 1kg ) | 4 tablespoons red curry paste or 4 tablespoons curry powder | 3 teaspoons anise seed | 2 tablespoons lipton onion soup mix
instructions: Wash, peel and chop parsnip. Place in a casserole dish. Make a paste of the curry paste with 2 tbsp water, blend well, and pour over the parsnips. Sprinkle with anise seeds. Bake in moderate oven 300 375, for 45 - 60 minutes or until tender.

title: Cake Style Chapati Bread
ingredients: 1 package philadelphia cream cheese, room temperature | 2 cups self rising flour
instructions: Preheat your oven to 450°f. Combine the cream cheese and the flour. Roll out onto a floured surface. Knead quickly to make sure the dough doesn't stick to your hands. You may have to do this with your hands. Cut in half and shape each half into a large round. Put each round on a greased cookie sheet and prick the top very lightly with a fork to make holes. Bake for about 10 - 12 minutes or until they are lightly browned. If not using all the dough, leave them in for a few minutes, then cut them into triangles and serve.

title: Chipotle-Ranch Mustard
ingredients: 3 tablespoons spicy brown mustard | chipotle chile in adobo
instructions: Mix and smear on a piece of bread or a bbq. Keep refrigerated until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: cheddar cheese,spring onion,french bread,olive oil,coconut extract,tarragon,zucchini
title: Baked Zucchini With Coconut Feta (Lite)
ingredients: 1 zucchini ( littleneck or split lengthwise, about 1/2 pound ) | 2 spring onions, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 2 teaspoons dried tarragon | 6 ounces reduced-fat cheddar cheese or 6 ounces monterey jack cheese, grated ( 1/2 cup, divided ) | 1/2 teaspoon coconut extract | 1/4 cup french bread, toasted ( optional )
instructions: Trim the ends and ends from the zucchini lengthwise and cut the ends on the diagonal into 1/2 in wide slices. Cut the slices crosswise into slices approximately 3/4 inch thick. Heat the oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add the zucchini and cook, stirring frequently, for 3 minutes, or until lightly browned. Sprinkle the with tarragon and sprinkle with 1 cup of the cheese and toss to coat. Remove the skillet from the heat. Dip the bread slices into the coconut extract and add to the cheese in the skillet. Toss gently until the slices are evenly coated with coconut. Top each serving with the remaining cheese. Tip, to toast bread, spread it on a flat surface and set aside for about 2 minutes. Set the skillet over medium heat. Add toast and cook, turning once, until lightly browned and crispy, 12 - 15 minutes.

title: Quick Penne
ingredients: 1 box penne | 1 1/2 cups chickpeas | 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour | 1 bouillon cube
instructions: Bring 4 cups water to boil in large pot. Pour into a sieve over a bowl. Drain chickpeas, discarding liquid, and coarsely chop. Place chickpeas in bowl with the 4 cups of water and bouillon, and stir to combine. Bring to a boil, add pasta and stir.

title: Welsh Bran & Straw Pea Salad (Cook's Country)
ingredients: 250 g sugar snap peas | 1 lb swede, rind & stringy portion, diced | 1 cup golden syrup | 8 slices bacon, chopped | 1/2 cup golden syrup | 1/3 cup dried mixed fruit | 1/3 cup chopped fresh basil | 1/3 cup raisins
instructions: Cook the sugar snap peas in boiling water for 3 minutes or until tender. Drain. Peel and trim the ends from the swede, removing the hard strings. Place the cut swede & golden syrup in a saucepan & bring to boiling point. Add the sliced and diced bacon. Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally until the bacon is just cooked. Drain the bran mixture from the liquid, reserving the cooking liquid, then place in a medium bowl. Add the chopped pea pods to the bran mixture. Pour the syrup mixture over the swede & sugar snap peas in a large dish. Sprinkle with the basil & raisins & mix well. Serve chilled or room temperature.

title: Plum Feta Dip
ingredients: 8 plums, halved and pitted | 1/3 cup dried basil, crumbled | 1/2 cup soft half-and-half | 1/2 teaspoon onion flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to in a bowl, mash plums with a fork. Stir in basil, half and half, onion flakes and toss to blend. Transfer to a shallow baking dish. Bake 35 - 45 minutes or until topping is deep golden brown and juices run clear.

title: Aussie-Style Salmon
ingredients: 1 teaspoon coconut extract | 4 salmon fillets, skin on | 1 tablespoon fruit juice
instructions: Place the coconut extract into a shallow dish. Add the salmon fillets and coat both sides. Cover and refrigerate for 15 minutes. Take the coconut off the fillets and shake off excess. Pat dry with a paper towel. Preheat grill or broiler. Heat on a bbq or grill pan. Place lid on to grill or broil for approximately 5 minutes or until the skin is flakey. Turn and cook on other side, approximately 5 minutes or until done.

title: Lobster Tofu Breakfast
ingredients: 3 cans lobster tails, drained | 1 1/2 lbs extra firm tofu, drained | 1/2 lb rhubarb, chopped
instructions: In a deep skillet, place the lobster tails on the bottom evenly. Place the rhubarb on top. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes. Taste and add salt as necessary.

title: Pancetta Wrapped Onions
ingredients: 6 heads pancetta, halved and split lengthways | 10 tablespoons golden syrup | 1 pinch white pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees centigrade and place 1 pancetta slice in each half. Combine golden syrup and white pepper in baking dish and pour over sliced pancetta onions. Cover with foil and bake for 1 hour. Remove foil, increase temperature and continue to bake for another 45 minutes until golden. Serve with fresh slices and lashings of thickened cream.

title: Basic Flour Tortillas
ingredients: 2 cups flour | water ( amount if necessary )
instructions: Heat a griddle. Sift flour into a bowl, add a little water if necessary to form a soft dough. Turn onto lightly floured surface and knead. Lightly oil a griddle or frying pan and heat over a medium heat. Knead dough for 1 minute or until it begins to show signs of plumpiness. Roll out or stretch onto greased griddle. Turn over and repeat process twice until dough starts to develop a firm texture. Remove from griddle and cut into 5 slices. Place a slice on top of each other and press down lightly. Turn the tortillas over once so that both sides are lightly golden on both sides. Keep the tortillas covered with a damp cloth or wax paper. Keep warm on a low heat until ready to cook time is complete. To use, heat 2 or 3 tortillas on one side only. Turn tortillas over. Fold and serve with favorite topping.

Random Ingredients: sherry,currant,corn tortilla,kidney bean,egg white,dark brown sugar
title: Bean and Egg Tacos
ingredients: 1/2 cup packed dark brown sugar | 1/3 cup dry sherry | 1 large egg white | 12 corn tortillas | 2 cans kidney beans, rinsed and drained ( or cannellini beans ) | 1 tablespoon of fresh currant, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 300 degrees fahrenheit. Combine the sugar and 1/3 cup water in a heavy saucepan over medium heat.

title: Homemade Thyme Seasoning Mix
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chopped celery seed | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh thyme sprigs
instructions: To make a seasoning, mix all ingredients throughly. Store in an appropiately covered container in an ungreased bowl or a zip lock bag.

Random Ingredients: maple syrup,cream tartar,coffee,lime peel,poblano chile,spinach,pinto bean
title: Vegan Refried Beans
ingredients: 2 large poblano chiles, stemmed seeded, slit side up ( or 3-4 large jalapeno chiles and 12-20 pepperoncini peppers ) | 1 bag fresh spinach ( or frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry ) | 1/4 cup low-fat sour cream or 1/4 cup fat free sour cream | 3/4 cup fat-free refried beans ( i have use homemade and it has a nice creamy flavor ) | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 1/4 teaspoon ground coffee | 1/4 teaspoon freshly grated lime peel | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Place the poblanos in a medium saucepan, add water to cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce the heat to medium and simmer just until the poblanos are tender, about 3 1/2 minutes. Cut the stems off the chiles. Place the chiles, cut side up, in a nonstick skillet. Heat about 1 1/2 tablespoons of the bacon fat in the skillet over medium high heat. Add the spinach and cook, stirring often, until the spinach has wilted and is beginning to brown and is starting to wilt, about 5 minutes. Transfer the spinach to a small bowl and set aside to cool, about 5 minutes. When the poblanos are cool, peel them and seed them. Cut the lengthwise poblanos in half. Remove the seeds and membranes from the pepperoncini's if using large chiles. Wash and dry the spinach according to the package directions. Drain well and set aside. Place the spinach and poblanos into the work bowl of a food processor fitted with a flat blade or food processor, add the sour cream, beans, maple syrup and coffee. Process until smooth approximately 4 - 5 pulses. Spoon mixture onto a plate and sprinkle with the lime peel and cream of tartar. Garnish with black olives if desired.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,graham cracker crumb,pimento olive,ketchup,greek seasoning,cherry,pepperoni,salad dressing
title: Grapefruit Biscuit
ingredients: 4 ounces plain flour | 2 teaspoons all purpose greek seasoning | 1 tablespoon ketchup | 1/4 teaspoon pepperoni, grated | 3 ounces crumbled pepperoni | 3 ounces drained sour cherry tomatoes | 1 ounce drained pimento stuffed olive | 1/4 cup salad dressing
instructions: Lightly oil and line base of muffin tin with muffin papers. Place flour in a bowl, add greek seasoning, ketchup, ketchup and pepperoni. Stir for 2 minutes. Stir in tomato, olives, dressing and pine nuts. Spoon mixture into the prepared muffin tin, then bake for 25 - 30 minutes at 190c.

Random Ingredients: lettuce,white flour,breadcrumb,currant,green bell pepper,chinese pea pod,aluminum foil,avocado
title: Chinese Pea Pods Salad
ingredients: 250 g chinese pea pods, washed, peeled, halved lengthways ( baby ) | 200 g mixed fresh salad leaves ( curly leaf ) | 2 green bell peppers, seeded, membrane removed, sliced thinly | 2 tablespoons currants or 2 tablespoons raisins | 4 tablespoons breadcrumbs | 4 tablespoons white flour | 2 avocados, halved, peeled, thinly sliced | aluminum foil
instructions: Place pea pods on an oiled baking sheet, bake, uncovered and under a very slow heat, stirring once or twice until they are tender and blistered. Cool, then roughly chop. Place in a bowl, add half of the cooked green pepper strips, half of the mixed salad leaves, half of the currants and half of the breadcrumbs. Toss lightly to combine. Place the flour on a plate, add the avocado slices, season lightly with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Add the rest of the mixed salad leaves to the bowl, toss. Lay the sprout mixture, avocado and remaining green pepper strips over the top. Drizzle with more of the olive oil if desired, sprinkle over with the reserved crumbs.
