Place under the grill to crisp up the top and allow extra to cook. Serve immediately. Alternatively, if you have leftovers the salad can be tossed into the dressing and served right before serving.

title: Homemade Lasagna
ingredients: 9 lasagna sheets | 1/4 cup white sugar | 6 ounces porcini mushrooms, sliced | 2 limes, zest of | 7 tablespoons fresh limes, zest of | 2 lbs dry cherries
instructions: Combine sugar and zest in medium bowl. Drain mushrooms. Place mushrooms over medium heat in heavy skillet. Cook, stirring, until sugar is dissolved and mushrooms are browned. Cool. Layer 3 ingredients, bottom of 9x13 glass baking dish, spread one layer of cooked mushrooms and 1/2 the lime vermicelli mixture, top with 1/2 the chocolate vermicelli mixture, second layer of mushrooms and 1/2 the lime vermicelli mixture, remaining third layer of mushrooms and vermicelli mixture, and last third layer of chocolate vermicelli mixture. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 3 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: red cabbage,romaine lettuce,veal,chili paste,pepper,chicken wing,pork shoulder,dark beer
title: Veal "pork in Beer"
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless veal | 1/2 lb pork shoulder | 1 lb fresh pork skinned beef or 1 lb fresh chicken wing ( about 2 small and quartered ) | freshly ground pepper | 1 teaspoon chili paste ( chili powder ) | 3/4 small red cabbage, finely shredded | 1 head romaine lettuce or 1 head boston lettuce, finely shredded | dark beer, to taste ( optional )
instructions: Cut veal and pork into bite size pieces. Heat oil for deep fat frying. When oil is hot, put veal and pork pieces into oil in batches if necessary. Using a slotted spoon, put meat pieces into paper bag. When all meat is cut into 1/2 inch pieces, fry slowly in batches to brown them on all sides. Remove pieces to paper bag, drain all the oil and set aside. Add chili to oil in skillet and stir fry until crisp and starting to pop. Add cabbage and continue cooking another 2 - 3 minutes. Add meat and cook until crisp and brown. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Remove meat, drain all excess oil. Put cabbage and meat back into the skillet. Toss until mixed. Serve over lettuce, with a splash of dark beer if desired.

title: Red Cherry and Calamari - Calamari Cakes
ingredients: 1 kg red cherries | 1/4 - 1/2 cup vanilla essence | 1 kg squid | mint sprig ( to garnish )
instructions: Prepare your squid. Cut the squid into large pieces and remove the tubes. Dont use any special equipment. Remove all blood tubes by gently running under cold water. You don't want to cut through the body but rather remove the dark membrane and keep the pieces of squid in the body. Cut two or three squid fingers into circular rings. Place the red cherries in a large bowl, and the vanilla essence in a separate bowl. Cover and leave to stand overnight. Bring a large pot of water to boil over a high heat. Reduce to a rapid simmer and throw in the squid rings and tentacles. Leave to boil a further minute or two only. Drain and set aside. Prepare your mint sprigs. Scoop the squid shells into the prepared shell. Sprinkle with mint and serve.

title: Tahini & Ricotta Spread
ingredients: 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1 orange, juice and zest of | 15 -20 ounces low fat ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup tahini
instructions: Squeeze lemon & orange zest & juice into a bowl & mix with the ricotta. Add tahini & knead for 5 minutes. Transfer to a bowl, refrigerate till serving time. Serve with bread.

title: The Devil's Food Pie
ingredients: 2 pounds pie shells | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 3 bay leaves | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Fit pie shells into an 11x7 inch baking dish. In a medium bowl, stir together the golden syrup, bay leaves, chili powder, and mace. Spread the brown syrup mixture over each pie. Cook in the preheated oven for 40 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is bubbly. Allow to cool for 5 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: beef oxtail,red cabbage,flour tortilla,yellow squash,grand marnier,black eyed pea,stewing beef,vegetable stock
title: French Stewed Oxtail and Vegetables
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef ( preferably a cut-up stew meat ) | 2 medium yellow squash | 2 medium red cabbage ( about 2-inches long ) | 4 tablespoons flour tortillas | 1 quart vegetable stock | 1 cup beef and oxtail soup stock | 1/2 cup dry black-eyed peas | 1/4 cup grand marnier
instructions: Slice the steaks into 1/4 inch wide and 2 inches thick slices. Heat a small amount of olive oil in a heavy skillet over moderate heat. Pat meat dry and season well with salt. Cook meat in skillet in batches until it is well browned on both sides and tender enough to fall apart, about 5 minutes per batch. Transfer meat to a bowl. Using the same skillet, cook the yellow, red and cabbage in the hot oil in the skillet until tender. Transfer vegetables to plate. To the skillet, add 2 tablespoons flour and stir well. Gradually stir in the soup and black eye peas and bring to a boil. Return meat to skillet, stirring gently until reheated, about 10 minutes. Transfer meat and vegetables to bowls, drizzle with remaining 2 tablespoons grand marnier, and serve. Discard vegetables used up. Serve accompanied by hot country time biscuits.

title: Cashew Nuts in a Flash
ingredients: 1/2 cup cashew nuts | 1/2 cup fish sauce ( a taste of gaeng kaffee to your liking ) | 1 tablespoon guacamole ( store-bought or home-made )
instructions: Roast cashews in a dry pan over medium heat until brown, about ten minutes. Remove from heat and set aside. Add fish sauce, and warm through a bit. Stir until incorporated. Remove cashews from pan and toss with hot sauce. Serve hot or chilled.

Random Ingredients: artichoke heart,canadian bacon,button mushroom,plum tomato,rice,gherkin,rice wine vinegar
title: Vegetarian Charred Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked instant rice | 4 1/2 ounces canadian bacon, diced ( about 1 cup ) | 1/2 cup sliced button mushroom | 1 ounce can artichoke heart, drained and coarsely chopped ( reserve liquid ) | 2 -4 plum tomatoes, seeded and diced into small pieces | 1 1/2 teaspoons rice wine vinegar | 4 platter style crispbread-cut green gherkins ( any flavor )
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions, omitting bacon fat or sodium nitrite. Drain rice and cool completely. Place rice, bacon, mushrooms, artichokes, tomatoes and vinegar on a platter. Sprinkle top with gherkins.

Random Ingredients: chile de arbol pepper,vegetable stock chicken,white mushroom
title: Mushrooms and Chile
ingredients: 8 ounces white mushrooms, thickly sliced | 7 ounces vegetable stock or 7 ounces chicken stock | chile de arbol pepper, finely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Place the mushrooms in frying pan and fry over high heat until browned and just cooked through. Add stock and chili to mushroom mixture, heat through and serve hot.

title: Guacamole Dessert With Garad
ingredients: 8 -10 fresh guajillo chilies | 1/2 cup guajillo paste ( can used fresh green chilies, use more for a `` heat '' ) | 1/2 tablespoon dried fenugreek seeds ( methi ) | salt | bottled low-fat topping ( optional ) | guajillo chilies ( optional )
instructions: Grind the chiles with a mortar and pestle or food processor until finely chopped and almost pureed. Transfer to a small bowl and mix well with the powdered seeds and salt. Top with the desired amount of hot fat or guajillo jam.. Serve with toasted sliced flatbread or crispos to soak up the flavor.

Random Ingredients: shell pasta,white vinegar,cumin powder,potato,salmon,alfredo sauce,tomatillo,chipotle chile adobo
title: Grilled Salmon and Noodle Salad
ingredients: 4 firm medium potatoes, peeled and diced in 1-inch pieces | 2/3 cup alfredo sauce | 3 tablespoons white vinegar, can use white vinegar extra | 1 tablespoon chipotle chile in adobo, pureed | 1 teaspoon ground cumin powder | 2 cups cooked white-fleshed salmon, cut into 1/4 inch pieces | 2 cups medium shell pasta, cooked, cooled | 1/3 cup sliced canned tomatillo
instructions: Place potato in a medium bowl. Pour tomato sauce over top and set aside. Combine vinegar, chipotle powder, and cumin. Add vinegar mixture and salmon to potato. Refrigerate 30 minutes. Taste and adjust seasoning and serve.

title: Corned Beef (Or Tenderloin) & French Croutons
ingredients: 1 french baguette, cut in half horizontally | 1/4 of an 8 inch (.75-inch ) thick-cut beef brisket | 1/4 of an 8 inch (. 75-inch ) thick-cut tenderloin | 1 large unpeeled lemon peel
instructions: Cut the baguette in half vertically, making an oblong cut crosswise. Cut the baguette into 1/8 thick slices, making about 8 slices. Rub the brisket all over with the lemon peel. Cover the brisket with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 2 hours. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Transfer the brisket to a rack in a roasting pan and place in the preheated oven. Roast for 15 to 20 minutes, or until it is cooked to your desired degree of doneness, and the slices are beginning to color around the edges. Do not brown it. If the slices turn to darken too quickly, cover loosely with aluminum foil and increase the heat slightly and stir in more liquid. Let the brisket cool slightly before slicing. This is very good served with roast beef soup and a tossed salad.

title: radish and bacon sandwiches (EASY)
ingredients: 12 slices bacon, cooked and crumbled | 1/2 cup thinly sliced radish | 3 3 slices rye bread ( thick ) or 3 slices bread ( thick )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f. Spread one side of each slice of bread with the crumbled bacon, then spread with radish. Top each slice with a second slice of bread, using the crumbled bacon and radish. Bake about 7 - 9 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Texas Style Midnight Slabs
ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1/3 cup hot packed brown & serve hamburger | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1/4 cup chopped brown and serve yellow fondue-style fondue-style fondue-style chutney, such as hines brand | 1/4 teaspoon yellow food coloring
instructions: Heat mayonnaise in microwave on high 1 minute. Stir in hamburger, cocoa, and baking soda. Divide mixture among metal skewers. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place 2 skewers on a wire rack set in a baking dish, and sprinkle with desired amount of food coloring. Bake 25 minutes in the preheated oven, or until desired doneness.

Random Ingredients: chorizo sausage,cantaloupe,thyme leaf,sage leaf,dark soy sauce
title: Baked Cantaloupe-Chorizo Pies
ingredients: 1 lb chorizo sausage, coarsely chopped | 1 lb cantaloupe, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce ( i recommend dark soy sauce, or tamari reduced sodium ) | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 1 teaspoon dried sage leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Spray a 13 x 9 inch baking dish with cooking spray or line with plastic wrap. In a mixing bowl combine chorizo, corn or frozen melon slices, soy sauce and seasonings, then press mixture into a 13 x 9 inch baking dish or jelly roll pan and bake for 12 minutes or until lightly browned and hot. Or bake in a 425°f oven for 15 - 17 minutes, reduce oven temperature to 250f and bake for 15 minutes more, or until melon is tender and puffy.

title: Spicy  Beef and Eggplant Casserole
ingredients: 1 bag zucchini | 1 eggplant | 2 cans sirloin | 1/2 lb sliced almonds ( optional ) | 1/4 cup flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Wash zucchini and eggplant and slice diagonally. Slice eggplant lengthwise and place in oven to warm. Once oven has reached 325f turn oven off and set zucchini as preferred.. Take the zucchini and eggplant out of the oven and place on a serving plate. Now slice the beef into small cubes. Add the slices into a bowl and lightly toss. On the plate, layer zucchini, eggplant and beef. Sprinkle almonds on top. Serve.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,ra el hanout spice mix
title: Swiss Cheese and Rail Hanoin Dip (Hanoos)
ingredients: 6 -8 ounces swiss cheese, shredded ( may use mild or light mozzarella ) | 1 tablespoon ras el hanout spice mix
instructions: Combine ingredients. Refrigerate about an hour to allow flavors to combine and soften slightly.

title: Ethiopian Mild Pepper Mix
ingredients: 1 large green bell pepper ( or 2 large ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons mixed spice ( e.g. 1 1/2 tsp dried, 1/2 tsp coriander, 1/2 tsp garlic powder ) | 1 tablespoon cardamom powder ( may use a pinch of cinnamon ) | 1/2 teaspoon clove, black powder
instructions: Wash and remove stem and seed from bell pepper.

Random Ingredients: white breadcrumb,english cucumber,pork,lamb,romaine lettuce,provolone cheese,porcini mushroom
title: Lamb and Provolone Sandwich
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground pork | 1/2 lb ground lamb | 1 ounce porcini mushroom, sliced thinly | 1 bunch romaine lettuce, torn | 1 english cucumber | 8 slices provolone cheese | 1/2 cup fresh white breadcrumb
instructions: Preheat grill to medium medium high. Mix together the ingredients for the filling in a medium bowl. Form into 4 hamburger sized patties and grill them until medium brown. Cut the lettuce into large chunks and lay them out on a plate. Put the patties on top of the lettuce and roll up. Place the roll on the grill and turn the heat to medium. When the patties are crispy and golden brown, spread each side of the roll with the bread crumbs. Serve hot.

title: Cajun-Spiced Chocolate Chicken Thighs
ingredients: 1 1/4 pounds boneless, skinless chicken thighs, halved | 1 green bell pepper, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Arrange the chicken thighs in the pan with the cut sides facing up, and brush with the cocoa. Bake in the preheated oven until the vegetables are browned and the chicken juices run clear, about 45 minutes. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees f.

title: French Toast Casserole
ingredients: 2 tablespoons corn syrup | 4 tablespoons cake flour | 1 cup whipped cream
instructions: Mix the corn syrup, cake flour, & sour cream. Heat skillet. Fry a couple of slices of the french toast on each side until lightly brown. Sprinkle a little more of the syrup on the slices to keep them from sticking, then place the french toast into the warm skillet & coat them with the syrup. Serve with maple syrup. The syrup will keep at least 2 week.

title: Baked Pear Kebabs
ingredients: 2 baking potatoes, peeled, cubed | 4 pears, cored and cubed | 1 cup yogurt | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Preheat oven to 450º. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Mix together the potatoes, pears, yogurt and parsley in a large bowl. Place potato and pear mix in a single layer in a large casserole dish. Bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes, or until tender.

Random Ingredients: phyllo pastry,soba noodle,salt black pepper,black peppercorn,chorizo
title: Sausage and Soba Pasties
ingredients: 2 ounces soba noodles | 3 ounces chorizo, sliced | 1 ounce black peppercorns | 9 ounces phyllo pastry | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Put the soba, chorizo and black peppercorns into a pan of boiling water. Return to the boil, drain well and season to taste. Take off the heat and allow to cool slightly. Unfold and line a baking tray with parchment paper. Lay out the pastry, allowing 4 - 5 sheets to be overlapped on each other over 2 - 3 sheets of baking paper. Cut the pasties into pieces about 5 x 3/4. Place the sausage mixture on the centre of each pastry piece and bring the edges up over the mixture. Using a palette knife, push down to make sure the filling is distributed evenly through. Brush with egg wash and sprinkle with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Bake for 10 - 15 minutes, until golden.

title: Spicy Red Curry Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 2 tablespoons good quality white flour
instructions: Heat your wok and add a good size ladle of plain flour. Add the red curry paste and fry for about a minute. Then pour over your sauce mixture and simmer for a minute or two until thickened. Stir and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: hazelnut,white wine,pepper,cream chicken soup,butter bean,veal,chicken breast half,heavy cream
title: Creamy Chicken and Nut Casserole
ingredients: 6 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 4 tablespoons melted butter beans | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup dry white wine | 1/4 cup heavy cream or 1/4 cup half-and-half | 3 boneless veal pieces | 1/3 cup hazelnuts, coarsely chopped | pepper
instructions: Coat the chicken breasts with vegetable oil.

title: Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 2 cups rice ( short, medium ) | 2 teaspoons peppercorns
instructions: Rinse and drain the rice, place it in a rice cooker or large pot. Add enough water to cover the rice by 1/2 inch. Stir the rice cooker or pot to break up the clumps. Turn rice cooker on to the lowest setting and set aside the rice and water, then cover and keep warm until ready to serve. After about 20 minutes, fluff rice with a fork and serve.

title: Quick and Easy Stove Top Chicken
ingredients: 1 whole chicken, rinsed | 10 fresh sage leaves | 15 frozen coconut cream | 3 tablespoons fresh chives, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350ºf. Arrange chicken on a large piece of aluminum foil. Place sage on top of chicken. Bring the ends together to make a pouch. Wrap the foil around chicken, then bake, rearranging foil every 45 - 50 minutes, for 30 minutes. After removing from oven, remove foil pouch and cook, uncovered, for 45 - 50 minutes, till juices run clear. While chicken is cooking, combine coconut cream and chives in a small saucepan. Cover and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Immediately pour over chicken and serve.

title: Cider Potato Salad.
ingredients: 1 large russet potato, peeled & amp, shredded | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1/4 - 1/2 cup apple cider ( we use white ) | 1/2 green pepper, chopped | 1 pinch cayenne
instructions: Put all ingredients except mayonnaise in food processor & puree until smooth. Put salad in decorative bowl or platter or individual serving bowls. Pour the rest of the mayo over top and serve.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,cardamom pod,pork loin,worcestershire sauce,allspice
title: Moroccan Pork Loin (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 -2 lb pork loin | 1/2 cup worcestershire sauce | 1/2 cup fresh lemon juice ( or juice from 2 lemons ) | 1 teaspoon fresh ground cardamom pod ( or 1/2 tsp. ground dried cardamon ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Trim fat from meat. Cube, rinse and pat dry. Cut slits on meat with sharp knife or cleaver at several places. Insert meat thermometer into thickest part of meat. Place pork in crock.

title: Sizzlin' Noodle Salad
ingredients: 7 -8 ounces rice vermicelli | 1/2 - 1 tablespoon coconut oil | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | parsnips ( to garnish ) or carrot, halved or sliced | 1/4 cup light soy sauce
instructions: Rinse vermicelli and cook in a wok until crispy. Drain, allow to cool. In a large bowl, stir fry coconut oil, dark soy, and dark soy sauce. Add cooked vermicelli. Garnish with sliced pears or carrots.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon,cooking spray,cranberry,spaghetti,new york,lime zest,heavy cream,beef brisket
title: Carniv® Slow Cooker Corned Beef With Fresh Cranberry Sauce
ingredients: 1 corned beef brisket, fat trimmed ( about 11 1/2 pounds ) | cooking spray | 15 ounces dried cranberries | 2 large yellow rock sugar-free range dried new york strip steaks | 2 1/2 cups beef bouillon | 1/3 cup heavy cream | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh lime zest | spaghetti
instructions: Preheat your slow cooker on high or 150 degrees f. When the cooker rings in 3 to 4 settings, place brisket in a single layer in the slow cooker. Spray a 10 inch cast iron skillet with cooking spray, and place skillet in preheated oven to 500 degrees f until rack is slightly browned on top. Arrange brisket in a circle in the center of the cooker. Add 12 dried cranberries to your slow cooker. Seed whole new York strip steaks of brisket and use your fingers to pierce the thin membrane from the meat with your fingers. Rinse out your cast iron skillet, and place it over medium heat. Pour beef stock over the brisket, and add 2 1/2 cups of beef bouillon. The broth should just cover the beef completely. Bring the beef to a simmer, cover, and cook until the meat is very tender, 3 to 4 hours. While the meat is cooking in the slow cooker, prepare your fresh cranberry sauce. Place cranberries and 6 to 7 red pepper sauce in a food processor, pulse until coarsely chopped or pulse until finely chopped. Add the remaining 1 cup of beef bouillon to the sauce to thicken the sauce slightly. Remove brisket from the slow cooker, place it in the slow cooker, and cover. Cook on high for 30 minutes. Remove corned beef from slow cooker and put on cutting board to rest while you prepare the spaghetti. Scoop your cooked spaghetti into bowls, top with the warm beef and fresh cranberry sauce. Serve with a side salad, a crisp loaf of bread, and a large piece of crème fraîche.

title: Sausage for Spicy Mexican Style
ingredients: 2 pounds sweet italian sausage | 1/2 medium onion, chopped
instructions: Place sausages in a large pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium low and simmer, uncovered, until tender, about 20 minutes. Remove sausages from sauce and chop into bite size pieces.

title: Brussels Sprouts and Potatoes
ingredients: 1 lb brussels sprout, trimmed | 1 lb red potato, scrubbed | 1 can ro-tel tomatoes | 1 gherkin
instructions: Place brussels sprouts in a pot and top with potatoes. Cover with water and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer 1 hour or until vegetables are tender. Meanwhile saute the gherkin in a little oil in a frying pan and add the tomatoes as well as the brussels sprouts. Cover and simmer 4 - 5 minutes. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

title: Simple Sauerkraut (Peerkraut)
ingredients: 4 medium pumpkin ( fresh or frozen ) | 1 tablespoon salt pork | 3/4 cup dashi stock | 1/4 roasted pistachios
instructions: Thaw the pumpkin. Cut it into chunks and microwave it for 1 minute. Take the pumpkin out and mash it using a fork and fork. Put the pumpkin pieces in a bowl, add the salt pork and mix well. Pour water to cover all of the pieces of pumpkin and soak until they're soft, about 20 minutes. Then drain them and put them back into the pumpkin. Heat the stock at high heat until it starts to boil. Add the soaked pumpkin and mix well. The pumpkin mixture is ready when it turns slightly translucent and begins to stick. Sprinkle the pistachios over the top and serve.

title: Fettucini With Fettuccine
ingredients: fettuccine | salt and black pepper
instructions: Bring a large saucepan of salted water to a boil and add the fettuccini pasta. Stir frequently to prevent sticking, then remove from the heat. Drain the pasta, place in a large bowl, and season with salt and pepper to taste. To serve, place a small amount of sauce in individual bowls and arrange the fettuccini on top.

Random Ingredients: pizza sauce,portabella mushroom,pork loin roast,yellow pepper,pepper,heavy cream,beef broth,chicken cutlet
title: Slow Cooker Grilled Pork Sandwich
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless pork loin roast | 1 cup beef broth | 1 cup pizza sauce | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1 cup portabella mushrooms, sliced | 1/2 cup yellow pepper, sliced | 1/4 teaspoon pepper | 2 small chicken cutlets, cut in half
instructions: Place pork, broth, pizza sauce, heavy cream, mushrooms, yellow pepper and pepper in slow cooker. Cook on low setting about 1 1/2 hours. Remove pork to platter and shred using 2 forks. Add back to slow cooker.

Random Ingredients: crepe,beef gravy mix,pumpkin,vanilla essence,taco seasoning mix
title: Pumpkin Beef Crepes
ingredients: 12 -20 crepes | 1/4 small pumpkin - peeled, seeded and cubed | 4 tablespoons beef gravy mix | 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 4 tablespoons taco seasoning mix, to taste | vanilla essence
instructions: Grease the bottom of a large pan with butter or margarine. Put a scant 1/4 cup of the meat mix on the bottom of the pan. Keep crepes in a close, lable way with the edges to let the steam escape at the top. Make sure you don't overlap them too much, or they will shrink during cooking. Pour in just enough gravy mix to fill up the pan. If it does get full, then it may need more water or gravy mix. Cook crepes until heated through. Remove, and top with additional gravy mix to make it your own. Top with more cheese and return to oven until golden brown on top.

Random Ingredients: filling,mango chutney,kernel corn,red chilies,oatmeal,purpose flour,panko breadcrumb,arborio rice
title: South African Mango Chutney Pie
ingredients: 1/2 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1/3 cup all-purpose flour | 1 cup panko breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 2 teaspoons crushed dried arborio rice | 1/2 cup quick-cooking oats | 1 can sweet whole kernel corn, drained and rinsed | 2 large fresh red chilies, chopped | 2 tablespoons mango chutney | filling : | 1 large mango, cubed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Coat a 9 inch pie plate or the interior of a casserole dish with cooking spray. Combine panko, 1/3 cup of flour, and 2 teaspoons of salt in a skillet over medium heat. Stir until thick, then turn off the heat. Stir the rice into the bread crumbs.

title: Ginger Vegetable and Rice (Chao Tome)
ingredients: 4 pounds ginger root, peeled and thinly sliced | 1 cup long-grain rice
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat until a bead of water sizzles on the bottom of the pan. Stir in the ginger, and cook and stir until the ginger turns golden brown, about 2 minutes. Add the rice and stir. Cook and stir until the rice is coated with oil and has begun to brown, 2 to 3 minutes. Reduce the heat to low, cover and simmer. Cook until the rice has absorbed the flavor and smell of the rice, 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Macaroni Salad With Green Chilli Sauce
ingredients: 3 cups macaroni | 1/2 cup green pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup green chilies, chopped | 1 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 cup short grain rice, cooked | 1/2 cup white flour | 1 dash piri-piri ( optional ) | 1 dash green chili
instructions: Cook macaroni till just done. Drain and cool for a few minutes. Mix all ingredient together with a little salt, mayo, chilli if using and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: azuki bean,pork shoulder,chicken thigh,dill,rye flour,fennel bulb,prosciutto ham,oil
title: Baked Boneless Fried Pork With Ham, Fennel and Ham
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless pork shoulder | 1 lb boneless chicken thighs | 4 slices prosciutto ham | 4 ounces dried azuki beans | fennel bulb | rye flour ( or cornstarch ) | oil
instructions: Pre heat oven at 425°f, cut pork shoulder, chicken thighs, prosciutto ham into 2 inch cubes. Boil in water for at least 15 minutes. Do not add any salt. Meanwhile cut the azuki beans into halves or thirds. Slice up the fennel bulb and add to a large pot. Add the ham. Bring water to a boil. Cook over medium heat for about 15 minutes or until meat has no blood. With a slotted spoon, remove and discard string from fennel. Carefully drain and set fennel aside. Cook the meat while in the oven until brown on all sides. In a small bowl, mix the cornstarch with the water and add to meat. Drain the meat when done and place back in casserole. Stir fry the sliced fennel until crispy. Then remove and place into a bowl of cold water. Drain. In a large skillet, put 2 tablespoons of oil. When hot, add the meat and cook until crisp on all sides. Add about 4 ounces of azuki beans to the meat and cook until it begins to turn golden. This will take about 5 minutes depending on the azuki beans, but you may also add a bit of water. This will give you a bit of a crunchy texture. Add the fennel and fennel to the meat and add the azuki bean filling. Pour the water from the pan into the pot and stir until it comes to a boil. Continue to boil until the soup is thick. Serve with bread or as a side dish with rice, or use to make a sandwich,. You can use cooked rice if you want.

title: Sauce for Beef
ingredients: 1 fresh jalapeno | 1 cup worcestershire sauce
instructions: Trim ends off jalapeno, then remove seeds. Cut jalapeno lengthwise into 1/4 slices. Place in a bowl with worcestershire sauce, cover, and marinate. The longer it gets, the more flavor it will have.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,lasagna noodle,banana pepper,rigatoni pasta,flat leaf parsley,turmeric,cheese,green bell pepper
title: Moroccan Style Spicy Tortilla Lasagna
ingredients: 1 package lasagna noodles | 1 green bell pepper, cut into thin strips | 1 medium banana pepper, cut into thin strips | 3 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric | 2 cups shredded cheese, divided | 12 leaves flat-leaf parsley | 24 sheets cheese spread, such as vigo or 12 slices provolone cheese
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente. Drain pasta and reserve 1 cup of cooking liquid. Meanwhile, in a large skillet over medium heat, sauté bell pepper and banana peppers in vinegar until peppers are tender, about 5 minutes. Pour reserved cooking liquid into skillet and stir in turmeric. Pour peppers and juice over hot pasta and stir. Add 1/2 cup cheese, parsley and 1 cup sauce and heat through, but do not boil. Preheat oven to 400°f. Line a large baking sheet with foil. Spread 1/2 of cooked pasta mixture on prepared baking sheet. Spread with 1/2 of the pepper mix. Top with 1/2 of remaining pepper mix and 1/4 of the cheese spread. Repeat layers twice, ending with the remaining 1/2 of pasta mixture, cheese spread, 1/2 of the pepper mix and 1/4 cheese spread. Cut with a serrated knife into four pieces each. Cover loosely and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, or overnight. The cheeses can be refrigerated for several hours, or overnight.

Random Ingredients: beer,mint leaf,butter margarine,coriander seed,tarragon vinegar,egg yolk
title: Pierogi  (Beer Pearls)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups beer | 1/2 teaspoon coriander seed | 3 tablespoons butter or margarine, melted | 1/2 teaspoon tarragon vinegar | 1 egg yolk | 1 bunch fresh mint leaves
instructions: Place beer and coriander seeds in a small skillet over medium heat and warm, until hot but not boiling. Remove from heat and let steep for 10 minutes. Strain the coffee grounds and pat dry with paper towels. Place the melted butter in a bowl. Stir in tarragon and egg yolk. Stir the hot melted butter into the yolk mixture and fold in the coriander mixture. Place in a small freezer bag. Gather edges of bag and use to store for up to 1 week in a cool, dark place. To serve, slice pears horizontally and place on a plate. Spoon the flavored beer over, garnish with mint sprigs and serve.

Random Ingredients: leg lamb,corn tortilla chip,sherry wine,enchilada sauce,brown sugar
title: Lamb  Tacos
ingredients: 1 lb boneless leg of lamb, trimmed of fat | 2 tablespoons sherry wine | 1 package soft taco seasoning or ( 28 ounce ) package taco shell chips | 1 can enchilada sauce | 1/3 cup brown sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. In a large nonstick skillet, melt remaining 3/4 t. Oil over medium high heat. Add lamb, saute 3 minutes. Add sherry, bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer 2 minutes. Add taco seasoning and stir. Remove from heat and stir in the crushed chips. Form into 8 patties and place on a nonstick rack.

title: Paleo Mexican Sausage
ingredients: 4 -5 lbs kielbasa | 1/2 orange bell pepper | 1/2 teaspoon taco seasoning | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar
instructions: Boil sausage in water until tender drain, put in mixing bowl and add all other ingredients. Add salt and pepper to taste. Cover and let sit for 1 hour or more at room temperature. Cut in 1 inch pieces or small patties bake in 350 degree oven for 30 minutes or until no longer pink.

title: Blueberry Strudels
ingredients: 250 g phyllo dough | 1/2 cup frozen blueberries | 1/3 cup reduced sodium broth, from jar | 1/3 cup corn flakes ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh scallion, for garnish
instructions: Put the phyllo sheets in a small microwave safe bowl, cover and microwave on high 9 minutes. Uncover and rearrange as needed with a spatula to fit. Cook for about 3 - 4 minutes. Remove from microwave and add blueberries, broth and cornflakes, if using. Place back in microwave, cover and cook on high, 1 minute. Spoon mixture onto phyllo sheets, drizzle with a little more broth if desired and sprinkle with chopped scallions.

title: Curry Flavoured Wine Cocktail
ingredients: 1 cup creamy whole natural yogurt | 3 tablespoons hot curry paste | 1/4 cup sweet red burgundy wine
instructions: In a small bowl, mix yogurt, curry paste and wine together. Chill before serving.

title: Tunisian Tuna With Pine Nuts, Parsley and Fennel
ingredients: 12 slices bread flour, 3 cm cube | 1 kg tangerine, in 1-inch pieces and rind removed | 2 spring onions, chopped ( white and green parts ) | 60 g pine nuts, in 1/2-inch pieces | 4 tuna steaks
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200 degrees celsius. Grease an oven proof dish with non stick spray. Place one slice of bread flour on your bench and gather together in a pile that is about the size of a melon ball, then press the flour over to make a large pile. Repeat the same with the remaining slice of bread flour, tangerine rind and spring onion. Dry the tuna with kitchen paper, pat dry then dip in the flour and shake off the excess flour. Add to the pile and press down firmly with your hands to flatten out and mix up evenly. Spread half the pine nuts on your dish and top with tuna and cover with the remaining pine nuts. Sprinkle with the remaining garlic, and bake until it starts to go crispy and golden.

title: Simple Goat Cheese Beef Noodle and Green Chile
ingredients: 4 cups quick rice noodles, cooked ( jasmine rice noodles also work great ) | 1 1/4 cups sweet white enchilada sauce | 1 1/4 cups crumbled goat cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f degrees. Mix everything in a 3 qt. Baking dish. Mix and bake for 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chili garlic sauce,gruyere cheese,vanilla pudding mix,meat,chorizo sausage,spaghetti sauce
title: Easy Cheesy Chorizo & Tomato Casserole
ingredients: 1 package frozen meat, thawed | 1 jar spaghetti sauce | chili-garlic sauce | 2 ounces sausages | 1 package instant vanilla pudding mix | grated gruyere cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees. Spray inside of a 9x13 pan with cooking spray. Arrange the frozen meat in a single layer in the pan. Spread the spaghetti sauce over the meat. Top with chili garlic sauce mix. Arrange sausages in a single layer over the cheese. Dissolve the pudding mix into the remaining package of instant vanilla pudding mix. Drizzle over the chili garlic sauce mixture. Bake for 30 minutes or until heated through. Sprinkle with cheese and return to oven for 5 - 10 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Simple Spicy Salsa
ingredients: 1 can picante sauce | 1 teaspoon dried oregano
instructions: Mix picante sauce and oregano together in a bowl.

title: Famous Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs stew meat or 2 lbs pork, such as roast | 1 teaspoon salt
instructions: Season meat, place in casserole dish and place in oven. Mix salt with water to make a 1 1/2 inches depth covering meat entirely. Place in 325 oven for 3 1/2 hours or until meat starts to 'fall apart'. Meat should be tender.

title: Peanut Spread
ingredients: 2 tablespoons raw peanuts | 2 tablespoons peanut butter | 1 tablespoon yellow mustard seeds | 1 -2 teaspoon chili powder ( optional )
instructions: Process peanuts in food processor until fine. Add all remaining ingredients and process briefly, or transfer to glass bowl. Cover and chill for 2 hours.

title: Fiery Cheese Spread
ingredients: 4 ounces old cheddar cheese, shredded | 1/4 teaspoon finely grated orange peel | 1 teaspoon white vinegar
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl, stirring lightly. Cover and refrigerate for at least 3 hours before serving.

title: Kidney Bean Pies
ingredients: 400 g brown lentils | 400 g kidney beans | 100 g minced veal | 100 g instant mashed chocolate cookies ( about 2 tbsps per patty )
instructions: Wash beans then place in an oven preheated to c for 6 to 8 minutes, or until just beginning to soften. Meanwhile, combine all ingredients in a large bowl mixing well with a wooden spoon. Using about 2 tbsp for each patty. Use a heaped tspoon to drop the mixture onto a baking paper lined baking tray lined with baking paper. Bake on a shelf lined with baking paper for about 15 minutes. Allow to cool on the baking tray and serve warm or cold. Store in an airtight container.

title: Malibu Mango Chutney
ingredients: 2 ounces mango chutney ( with or without unsweetened apples like pucker's chutney ) | 4 ounces malibu rum or 4 ounces malibu 151 | 3 teaspoons mango chutney ( or mango-honey dipping sauce like mango chutney, nam pla or applebee's chutney )
instructions: Fill a small pitcher with ice. Shake with malibu chutney. Transfer to a small pitcher to serve. Serve with a mango chutney straw.

Random Ingredients: red cabbage,cannellini bean,spinach leaf,dill pickle,dark rum,ricotta cheese,brown basmati rice,raspberry
title: Rice & Bean Salad With Rum-Dill Dressing
ingredients: 2 cups cooked brown basmati rice | 2 cups cooked cannellini beans | 1 cup red cabbage, shredded | 1 cup frozen chopped spinach leaves, thawed and dryed ( optional ) | 1 cup fresh raspberries, rinsed | 1/2 cup ricotta cheese | 1 tablespoon fresh dill pickle, chopped ( optional ) | 1/4 cup dark rum ( optional )
instructions: Combine all the ingredients and mix well.

title: Easy Beef and Apricot Ice Cream
ingredients: 1 lb beef round steak | 2 cans apricot halves, drained | 1/2 cup heavy cream
instructions: Cut steak in 1/2 inch diagonal slices. In 2 quart casserole dish, combine beef, apricots, cream and apricot halves. Microwave on high, uncovered, for 7 to 10 minutes or until beef is just tender.

title: Cashew Chicken and Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 2 1/4 lbs chicken pieces, skin removed | 1 cup white rice, uncooked | 1 carrot, peeled and grated | 2 teaspoons chives, chopped | 1/3 cup cashews | 1/3 cup pecorino romano cheese, freshly grated | 1 radish, sliced
instructions: Cover chicken with water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer for an hour until chicken is tender, about 1 hour, skimming away any foam that rises to the surface as it cooks. Drain chicken and reserve cooking juices, discarding skin and bones. Set chicken aside and keep warm. If you prefer a drier pilaf, remove fat from the chicken, discarding bones and skin, and shred chicken meat with your hands. If you prefer a coarse pilaf, remove skin and bones and shred the chicken into little shreds. While chicken is cooking, bring water and remaining ingredients to a boil in a medium pot over medium high heat. Add chicken and remove from the heat, cover and keep warm. To serve, place rice, sliced carrot and grated cheese in a medium size bowl. Toss with a spoonful of the chicken. Garnish with sliced radishes.

title: Green Chickpeas Filling for Roast Beef With Chili & Veggies
ingredients: 2 lbs chickpeas | 3 -8 tablespoons green chili
instructions: Soak chickpeas over night in plenty of cold water. Drain and place in large roasting pan. Add enough water to cover chickpeas & add enough water to cover the whole chickpea by 1 inch or just over. Cook over a low heat for 3 to 4 hours covered until chickpeas are tender. Turn often and add water to cover. Place on heavy duty greased aluminum foil and place on a baking sheet under moderately hot coals. Roast in 350°f oven for 30 minutes or until a light brown color.

Random Ingredients: coca cola,rump steak,lettuce leaf,sharp cheddar cheese,cream chicken soup,broth,gelatin,broccoli floret
title: Coca cola Steaks With Broccoli and Coca Cola
ingredients: 4 rump steak | 1 tablespoon unflavored gelatin | 1 cup chicken stock or 1 cup broth | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 package frozen broccoli florets, thawed and drained | 4 -6 ounces cola or 8 ounces cola-flavored carbonated beverage | shredded lettuce leaf | mixed mushrooms, sauteed
instructions: Cut steak crosswise into 1/8 inch thick slices. Place in a noncorrosive pan coated with nonstick cooking spray. Sprinkle each steak with 1/4 teaspoon unflavored gelatin. Pour chicken stock over the top, cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes or longer. Remove steak from refrigerator, uncover and let stand for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, prepare soup by stirring soup and 1 cup of cola/cola cola/broccoli liquid. Bring to a simmer, cover, cook for 10 minutes. Cook broccolini according to package directions and drain. Pour soup mixture over meat, spooning soup over each steak. Cover and return to refrigerator for 4 hours or longer. Serve over lettuce leaves and garnish with mushrooms.

title: Steak Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb round steak, 1 inch thick | 3/4 cup walnuts | 7 ounces frozen baby corn, thawed | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon | 11 ounces rice noodles, uncooked, but not drained
instructions: Slice steak crosswise into 1/8 slices and place into lightly greased 13x9 baking dish. Sprinkle with walnuts and corn. Bake uncovered at 375f for 25 - 30 minutes or until cooked. Meanwhile, cook rice noodles according to package directions and drain. Place rice noodles in 2 1/2 quart casserole. Top with meat mixture. Bake 3 - 5 minutes longer or until top is dry. Sprinkle with cinnamon and serve.

title: Braised Beef
ingredients: 10 ounces stewing beef, in one piece | 2 tablespoons tamari | 2 teaspoons parsley | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 2 teaspoons garlic powder | 1 tablespoon coconut oil | 2 tablespoons corn oil
instructions: Heat the corn oil in a pressure cooker pot. Add in the beef and saute for two minutes. Add tamari, garlic powder, coconut oil, parsley and salt and pepper to taste. Stir to mix. Close the lid, bring the pressure down and cook till the pressure reduces naturally. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: ham,salad green,orange juice,cauliflower floret,hamburger bun,balsamic vinegar
title: Orange Glaze Burgers
ingredients: 1/2 cup orange juice | 3/4 cup honey | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 2 hamburger buns | 1 1/2 cups cooked ham, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 12 ounces redleaf sweet cauliflower florets
instructions: Combine orange juice, honey, vinegar and beef in small saucepan over low heat. Cover and simmer, stirring often, until mixture is syrupy and reduced to about 1/4 cup, 1 to 2 minutes. Remove and discard any scum from sauce. Set aside. Spoon equal amounts of sauce onto each hamburger bun. Divide ham and cauliflower evenly among buns. Drizzle with orange glaze.

title: American Cabbage and Onions Salad
ingredients: 12 large lettuce leaves | 12 large yellow onions | 12 slices yellow onions
instructions: Trim onions and trim outer leaves. Place leaves in a colander. Rinse and dry onions. Arrange on a large plate. Sprinkle top with thinly sliced onions. Chill. Can be made up to 1 day ahead.

Random Ingredients: cherry,seasoning salt,mexican tomato sauce,cardamom pod,greek yogurt,dark brown sugar,jicama,raspberry vinegar
title: Tartarelli
ingredients: 1 cup greek yogurt | 2 tablespoons grated jicama | 2 teaspoons dark brown sugar | 1 teaspoon apple juice or 1 teaspoon rice wine vinegar | 5 teaspoons dark mexican tomato sauce | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/8 teaspoon cardamom pod | 1 cup frozen raspberries
instructions: Mix all ingredients except the berries with a mixer or food processor until creamy, about 30 seconds. Chill 1 hour. Pour the berries in a strainer and reserve juice. Place drained yogurt in food processor with the cheese, sugar, vinegar and cardamom, process, 1 minute or until smooth. Spoon the cream over the chilled yogurt, add 2 or 3 raspberries.

Random Ingredients: tomatillo,basil,black sesame seed,fennel seed,snow pea,yellow rice
title: Chinese Fried Rice
ingredients: 2 teaspoons black sesame seeds | 2 tablespoons fennel seeds | 1 small fennel bulb, thinly sliced and smashed with flat side of knife | 1 lb fresh snow pea, trimmed and cut in half | 2 cups cooked yellow rice | 3 medium fresh tomatillos, chopped
instructions: Place the sesame seeds in small dry skillet over medium heat and toast, stirring often, until they begin to pop a little and smell fragrant. Watch carefully as they burn easily, so watch carefully after 1 minute. Remove from pan and transfer sesame seeds to medium bowl. Dry roast the cumin in the same skillet used to toast the seeds, stirring often, until you smell fragrant and they release their aroma. Immediately remove and cool to room temperature. Scrape seeds and fennel into a large mixing bowl. Add the smashed nuts, 1/2 cup water, the soybean oil, and rice. Mix thoroughly to blend. Add the tomatillos, mix well, and set aside. Cover and let sit out at room temperature for 20 minutes. Stir rice well again and check for salt. Serve.

Random Ingredients: water,mostaccioli pasta,tomato paste,cardamom seed,lime juice,french bread
title: Mostaccioli with Spicy Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 1 package mostaccioli pasta, broken into 1-inch pieces | 2 pounds ripe tomatoes, coarsely chopped | 2 cans tomato paste | 1 can water, or more as needed | 1/2 cup fresh lime juice | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom seeds | 1 loaf french bread, cut into 1-inch cubes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Blend tomatoes, tomato paste, water, lime juice, and cardamom in a blender until smooth. Arrange half of the cooked pasta in the bottom of an 11x7 inch glass baking dish, breaking as necessary to fit dish. Place half the tomato mixture over the pasta, followed by half of the french bread cubes. Top with remaining tomato mixture and remaining french bread cubes. Pour tomato mixture over bread and bread. Cover dish with aluminum foil and bake in the preheated oven until top of mostaccioli is dry and top is golden, about 1 hour. Let rest for 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Chocolate Ziti With Sherry Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup dry sherry | 8 ounces uncooked ziti pasta | 6 ounces good semisweet chocolate, grated | 1/4 cup small curd, for dipping
instructions: Cook pasta in lightly salted boiling water for 10 minutes, or until it is al dente. Drain, reserving 1 cup of the pasta cooking liquid.

Random Ingredients: fettuccine,yellow onion,flour tortilla,lettuce leaf,sushi rice,white pepper,sauerkraut,fettuccini noodle
title: Creamy Sauerkraut Fettuccine Burritos
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated dry fettuccini noodles | 1 large yellow onion, sliced | 2 cups sauerkraut, drained | 3 cups prepared sushi rice | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 24 flour tortillas | 4 large lettuce leaves | 1 large plain flour tortilla, halved to form 4 burrito-size burritos
instructions: Cook and stir noodles in a saucepan of salted boiling water until tender, about 7 minutes. Remove from heat. Drain.

Random Ingredients: sirloin steak,cayenne,mexican cheese,worcestershire sauce,beef roast,onion powder
title: Mexican Style Steak
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sirloin steak | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef roast | 1 tablespoon dry onion powder | 1 teaspoon cayenne | 2 cups shredded mexican blend cheese
instructions: Trim any visible fat from steak, and cut into 3/4 to 1 1/2 inch thick slices. Place beef slices in a large resealable plastic bag or other container. In a small bowl, combine the worcestershire sauce, onion powder, cayenne and 1/2 of the cheese. Pour all the worcestershire sauce mixture over, or mix all the ingredients together. Add the remaining worcestershire sauce mixture to the sliced steak, cover tightly and refrigerate overnight. Preheat the grill to high. Remove steak from the bag and place on the grill. Close lid and cook for 3 to 5 minutes on each side or until no longer pink and cooked to your liking. Serve over the shredded cheese or tortillas.

Random Ingredients: rotel tomato chilies,quinoa,rice vinegar,tequila,parmesan cheese,onion powder,lump crabmeat
title: Mexican Quinoa Stuffed Creole Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 -6 medium uncooked quinoa | 3 cups cooked rice or 3 cups cooked rice | 1 can rotel tomatoes & chilies | 1 1/2 - 2 cups lump crabmeat, picked over | 1 tablespoon onion powder | 2 tablespoons tequila | 1/2 cup parmesan cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven at 350 degrees. Spread quinoa onto a greased cookie sheet or in a shallow metal pan. Bake about 40 minuts or until dry, but not browned. Let cool. Chop and set aside. In a mixing bowl, stir together rotel, tomatoes, crab, onion and tequila. Stir in drained quinoa and cheese. Spoon filling into reserved quinoa cavity, spreading evenly. Place on a cookie sheet and top with reserved quinoa. Bake 20 - 25 minuts or until golden brown and slightly crisp in middle.

title: Roasted Duck With Snow Peas
ingredients: 2 teaspoons kosher salt | 6 duck, halved | 1 cup self-rising flour | 1 1/4 cups snow peas
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Brush duck with melted butter and sprinkle with kosher salt. Roast duck 15 to 20 minutes, then remove from oven. Combine flour and snow peas. Remove and discard giblets and neck of duck. Place duck on serving platter and pour gravy over.

title: Homemade Fresh Fruit Salad
ingredients: 2 - 3 cups mixed fresh fruit, any fresh fruit works well | 3 tablespoons oil | non dairy topping | 1/2 teaspoon peppercorn
instructions: Wash and dry the fruit. Put all the ingredients in a food processor into a measuring cup and process until smooth, the consistency of thick pudding pie filling. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes, preferably overnight, for the flavors to blend well.

Random Ingredients: ziti pasta,black olive,pumpkin puree,bulk italian sausage,baby spinach
title: Ziti Primavera
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs ziti pasta, uncooked | 1 can petite diced tomatoes with basil, garlic, oregano, basil, and zesty tomato sauce | 1 can crushed black olives, drained | 1 bag baby spinach, rinsed | 1 large ground beef-fed bulk italian sausage link
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f generously grease a large, deep baking dish.

title: Fresh Pineapple Salsa
ingredients: 5 ripe plums or 5 golden plums, quartered lengthwise | 1 fresh pineapple | 1/4 cup vegetable shortening ( crisco ) | 2 teaspoons orange zest, grated | 1 can chopped canned plums or ( 16 ounce ) can crushed pineapple, drained
instructions: Cut plums in half, remove pit and scoop out flesh. Remove the pits, then coarsely dice fruit. Stem and core pineapple, then coarsely chop flesh. In a 6 to 8 qt saucepan, combine shortening, zest, and tomatoes. Mix well and cook over medium heat, stirring often, until sauce is heated through, about 5 minutes. Add drained pineapple, stirring to coat. Heat through, about 3 minutes. Cool and store in tightly covered container at cool room temperature.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,hot mustard,tomato sauce,beef brisket,eggplant
title: Easy Slow Cooker Beef Brisket With Eggplant
ingredients: 1 boneless beef brisket | 1 eggplant, cut into 1-inch slices | 1 jar medium tomato sauce | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 1 tablespoon crushed hot mustard
instructions: Place brisket and eggplant in bottom of slow cooker. Mix tomato sauce, curry paste, and hot mustard together in a bowl. Brisket is bed on tomato sauce mixture.

title: Tomato Lamb Gravy
ingredients: 5 plum tomatoes, roughly chopped | 2 cups lamb stock
instructions: Heat a small heavy based frying pan over medium heat. Add the tomatoes and cook for 15 - 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the tomatoes have turned a deep golden brown color. Add the lamb stock and bring to the boil. Simmer for 5 minutes, until the gravy thickens slightly and the lamb is cooked through, if it's not sufficiently tender, boil for a few minutes longer. Transfer the tomato and sauce back to the pan and reheat to serving temperature.

title: Quick and Easy Rottiboyaki
ingredients: 375 g rotini pasta | 1/2 cup oatmeal
instructions: Heat grill on high. Combine the pasta and oatmeal.

Random Ingredients: watermelon,sherry,summer squash,cashew,turkish bread,cajun seasoning,red bell pepper
title: Tunisian Summer Squash Bread
ingredients: 1 cup chopped watermelon | 1 cup chopped summer squash | 1 cup chopped red bell pepper | 1/4 cup chopped cashews | 3 tablespoons dry sherry | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground turkish-style dry bread crumbs | 1 teaspoon cajun seasoning, or as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Arrange the watermelon, squash, red bell pepper, cashews, sherry, turkish style bread crumbs, and cajun seasoning in a baking dish. Bake in preheated oven until filling in bubbles and melty bits begin to soften, about 15 minutes. Serve toasted.

title: Ziti With Mushrooms and Scallions
ingredients: 8 ounces ziti pasta | cooking spray ( olive oil or cooking spray ) | 1/2 cup sliced button mushrooms ( about 6 ounces ) | 3 scallions, trimmed and thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar
instructions: Cook ziti in large pot of rapidly boiling salted water until just tender but firm to the bite, stirring occasionally. Drain. Coat a 7 or 8 inch pie plate with cooking spray. Add mushrooms and scallions.

title: Cottage Cheese and Sesame Cheese Yogurt Dressing
ingredients: 1/4 cup low fat cottage cheese or 1/4 cup low fat cottage cheese | 1/8 cup plain low-fat yogurt | 1 tablespoon toasted sesame seeds
instructions: In a large bowl, stir the cheese, yogurt, and sesame. Cover and chill before serving.

Random Ingredients: fennel bulb,rice,beef tenderloin,vanilla essence,sun tomato,tomato soup
title: Easy Rissoles
ingredients: 250 g beef tenderloin | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons tomato soup | 1 -2 fennel bulb, finely chopped | 1 -2 tablespoon rice, cooked | 1 -2 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Mix the beef, sun dried tomatoes, tomato soup and fennel together. Dip the fennel bulb into the water then heat a non stick frying pan until hot. Place mixture in the pan and turn it until the fennel is coated well with the oil. Cook for 2 - 3 mins, just until the fennel starts to soften. Roll the meat mixture a handful at a time on heated frying pan. When completely browned flip over again and cook for 2 - 3 mins, again flipping each side. Remove from pan and place on paper towels to drain all the excess oil. Serve with lemon wedges and salad.

title: Peanut Butter Puffs
ingredients: 1 cup smooth peanut butter | 2 teaspoons hot sauce, or to taste | 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Stir the peanut butter, hot sauce, and parmesan cheese together in a bowl until completely blended, then pour into a baking dish. Bake for 30 minutes in the preheated oven until the puffs are browned.

Random Ingredients: garbanzo bean,kaffir lime leaf,dark sesame oil,milk ricotta cheese
title: Homemade Kaffir Lime and Ricotta Cheese Gelato
ingredients: 2 cups whole milk ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons chopped kaffir lime leaves | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1 can garbanzo beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Place ricotta cheese in a food processor and process until smooth. Return to the food processor and add kaffir lime leaves, sesame oil and garbanzo beans. Process until smooth. Scrape down the sides of the food processor and process again until smooth.

title: Crock Pot Cheese and Sour Cream Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 box spaghetti sauce mix ( or spaghetti fettuccine ) | 1 can sour cream or ( 8 ounce ) can yogurt | 1/2 cup sharp cheddar cheese, grated ( if you can't serve this, use a 1/2 cup )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 4 1/2qt slow cooker. Mix well, cover and cook on lo heat. Note, this makes approximately 6 quarts.

title: Sizzlin Steak and Eggs
ingredients: 1 tablespoon butter ( more if needed ) | 3 tablespoons miso | 3/4 cup chicken stock | 2 lbs beef top round steaks, cut into 1 inch slices | 1 can salsa ( mild or medium ) | 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
instructions: Melt butter in heavy large skillet over medium heat and add 2 tablespoons miso mix. Cook until mixture is hot. Add stock, bring to boil. Add beef and stir. Reduce heat to low and simmer uncovered until beef is just cooked through, about 15 - 20 minutes. Remove beef to cutting board. Stir in remaining miso mixture, salsa, and 1 teaspoon vanilla. Pour mixture into large bowl. Serve beef hot with salsa.

title: Spaghetti Olio
ingredients: 4 cans refrigerated spaghetti sauce | 1 package frozen sliced peaches | 2 -3 tablespoons ajwain, powder
instructions: Place frozen sliced peaches in a saucepan with a tight fitting lid.

title: Quick and Easy English Cucumber Bread
ingredients: 1 tablespoon yeast | 3 1/2 cups pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 3 tablespoons ketchup | 1 1/2 cups english cucumbers, peeled, seeded, and roughly chopped | 1 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1/4 cup tapioca, soaked in
instructions: Add pinto beans, ketchup, cucumber, baking soda, and tapioca. Combine. It will not stick to the bowl. Allow to rest for about 15 minutes in the refrigerator before proceeding to step 5.

title: Chocolate Lettuce and Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 head lettuce leaf ( such as chicory, leaf lettuce or boston lettuce ) | 12 1/2 ounces small shell pasta ( such as fettucine or tagliatelle pasta, about 1 cup ) | 8 ounces dark chocolate | 1/2 cup pearl barley, cooked
instructions: Line a large platter with lettuce leaves. Cook pasta to al dente stage, 7 to 9 minutes longer than the package directions indicate. Drain and set aside. Dot with a little of the chocolate, and set aside. Place remaining chocolate into a microwave safe bowl and melt it over moderate heat, about 30 seconds, or in the microwave on high, stirring every minute or so until it begins to melt. Stir in the cooked sweet pasta and gently toss to mix. If your pasta is still in the oven, place under the broiler a few seconds, until the chocolate is bubbly. Spread the chilled pasta or fettucine mixture over the lettuce leaves. Spoon over the hot chocolate sauce. Sprinkle with coarsely ground nuts.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,turnip,pork,flat leaf italian parsley,canadian bacon
title: Carnival Turnips With Canadian Bacon
ingredients: 500 g turnips, peeled | 500 g smoked pork, coarsely chopped | 8 slices canadian bacon | 2 teaspoons chopped flat-leaf italian parsley | 2 cans chopped green chilies
instructions: Boil the turnip until soft, drain, and mash with a potato masher until smooth. Mix together the meat, bacon, parsley, and chilies. Fill the turnip mixture into hot sterilized jars, top each with a slice of the Canadian bacon. Wipe the rims with a clean damp cloth to cover.

title: Blue Blender Mocktail
ingredients: 2 teaspoons quick-cooking oil | 1 tablespoon ginger | splash blue curacao
instructions: Cut ginger and 1/2 tsp of blue curacao into 1/4 strips. Pour in small glass over ice.

title: Lime Spinach Dip
ingredients: 2 cups plain yogurt | 3 cups sauerkraut, drained | 1 jar roasted poblano peppers, drained and chopped | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh spinach | 1/4 cup shortening | 1/2 teaspoon hot red curry paste | 1 tablespoon frozen limeade concentrate
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together the yogurt and sauerkraut. Stir in the poblano, spinach, peanut butter, hot sauce, limeade concentrate and hot pepper sauce. Chill well in the refrigerator for 6 to 24 hours before serving to blend flavors.

title: Scottish Oven Pork Loin
ingredients: 2 kg boneless pork loin roast, with some fat | 1 tablespoon plain flour | 1/2 teaspoon allspice or 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220°c. Mix the flour and allspice together in a shallow baking dish. Dip the pork in the flour. Cook the pork in the preheated oven, allowing about 1 hour a side, depending on height. Leave to rest, then slice across the grain. Serve with potatoes.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,rice noodle,pinto bean
title: Quick and Easy Spanish Rice Berries for the Microwave
ingredients: 3/4 cup drained canned pinto bean ( such as pinto beans with lime juice ) | 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 2 cups cooked rice noodles
instructions: Combine the pinto beans and oil, and let stand at room temperature for 15 minutes. Microwave the rice noodles in the microwave in 1 or 2 batches for 60 seconds on high, stirring halfway through cooking. Combine the rice noodles and beans, and serve.

title: Mexican Restaurant Cheese Appetizer - Freezes well
ingredients: 200 ml plain mexican cheese ( mild or medium ) | 1/2 cup mexican blend cheese | 1/2 cup prepared vanilla yogurt
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a food processor or blender, and pulse until smooth. Pour into a well buttered, freezer proof bowl, cover well with foil, and chill overnight or overnight. Unwrap cheese block, remove air bubbles, and serve with crackers for sandwich sticks, or toasted baguette slices.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,half,worcestershire sauce,heavy whipping cream,kielbasa,garlic olive oil,cottage cheese,oregano
title: Kielbasa and Cheese
ingredients: 10 ounces cottage cheese | 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried oregano | 1 -2 tablespoon minced garlic ( depending on taste ) | garlic olive oil | 1 lb kielbasa ( or your favorite sausage )
instructions: Boil water for cottage cheese and set aside. Meanwhile chop sausage and then sautee until well browned. Mix cottage cheese, whipping cream, worcestershire sauce, garlic, and oregano in a large bowl. Drain sausage and then add to the cheese mixture. Drain cottage cheese and mix well together. Spray baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray, layer cottage cheese mixture, kielbasa mixture, and top with remaining cheese. Lightly spray cookie sheet with nonstick cooking spray and then bake in a preheated 375 degree oven 15 minutes, or until bubbly and lightly browned. Allow to cool 5 - 10 minutes before slicing, garnish with sour cream and serve with salad leaves.

title: French Herbed Watercress
ingredients: 2 cups watercress | 1/2 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules | 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 1/4 teaspoon onion salt | 1/8 teaspoon sesame oil
instructions: Bring watercress leaves and chicken bouillon to boil in a medium saucepan. Remove from heat. Stir in saffron, onion salt and sesame oil. Cool for 5 minutes. Pour into a bowl.

title: Artichoke Beer
ingredients: 1 bottle dark beer | 14 ounces artichoke hearts, drained and chopped
instructions: In a large bowl of ice, add the beer and artichokes. Cover and freeze for at least 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: green cabbage,ice water,bread,grain rice,tofu,beef bouillon cube
title: Fried Rice (Cabbage) with Tofu in Clay Pot
ingredients: 3 cups long grain rice | 2 cups water, boiling or 2 cups beef broth | 2 beef bouillon cubes, finely crushed | 1/4 cup ice water | 1/2 teaspoon toasted bread, crumbs | 1/2 lb firm tofu, cut into cubes
instructions: Simmer the rice in the boiling water for 15 minutes. Dissolve the bouillon in the ice water. Drain and set aside. Place the tofu in a large skillet. Add 1/4 cup of the liquid and the tofu over medium heat. Cook, stirring, until the bottom of the tofu begins to brown.. Place the cubed rice on top of the tofu, cover with the remaining liquid and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: basil leaf,gingerroot,honey,vegetable oil cooking spray,double cream,mustard oil
title: Mustard Ginger Caramel Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup finely grated fresh gingerroot ( about 1 ounce ) | 1 tablespoon honey | 1 1/2 tablespoons mustard oil ( see note for cooking instructions ) | 1/2 cup double cream ( can use non sweetened reduced fat or milk ) | 3 tablespoons honey | 10 fresh basil leaves, finely chopped
instructions: Process ginger, 1 tablespoon honey, 1 tablespoon mustard oil, and cream in a food processor or blender until smooth, about 1 minute. Stir in remaining ingredients and pour into small, heavy saucepan. Cook over medium heat, stirring, until sauce reaches desired consistency, 15 to 20 minutes. Do not boil. Note, cooking times may vary depending on the heat of your pan.

title: Confectioners Beer
ingredients: 1/2 cup flour | 1 bottle light beer | 4 cups shredded monterey jack cheese | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar, or as needed
instructions: Stir flour and beer together in a large pitcher and pour into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Sprinkle cheese over the beer mixture. Cover, and refrigerate 2 hours. Before baking, preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Sprinkle confectioners' sugar over hot cheese. Bake in the preheated oven until cheese is melted, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: caper,beef stew meat,kidney bean,snow pea,red chile pepper,corn
title: Slow-Cooked Southwestern Beef and Beans
ingredients: 1 pound boneless beef stew meat | 1 can kidney beans | 1 can corn | 1 red chile pepper, chopped | 1 ounce capers | 1 package snow peas
instructions: Place beef into the slow cooker. Stir in the kidney beans, corn, red chile pepper, capers, and snow peas. Cover, and cook on high for 5 to 6 hours.

title: Quick and Easy Lamb Curry
ingredients: 2 tablespoons niter kebbeh | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 1/2 lb boneless lamb, thinly sliced | 1 medium onion, halved and thinly sliced | 1 cup raw shrimp, peeled, deveined and deveined, tails removed
instructions: Heat a large heavy skillet with a tight fitting lid over medium heat. Add niter kebbeh and curry paste. Stir and roast until fragrant, about one minute. Add lamb and onions and saute for 2 to 3 minutes, until golden brown.

title: Sweet Chili Balsamic Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sweetened condensed milk powder | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 -2 small hot red chili pepper, sliced
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together sweetened condensed milk powder and balsamic vinegar. Stir in the hot red chili pepper. Serve over warm noodles.

title: Quick & Easy Rice Noodle Salad!
ingredients: 4 -6 cups small lettuce leaves | 4 -6 cups mixed baby greens ( such as baby balsamic vinaigrette, pam or boston salad greens ) | 2 packages rice noodles, or | 1/3 cup honey
instructions: Separate 4 - 6 cups of lettuce and balsamic vinaigrette separately and set aside. Combine the rice noodles and 3 - 4 cups of mixed greens with 1/4 cup of honey in a large bowl, toss well to coat. Add the remaining 1/4 cup of honey to the bowl with the noodles. Serve with remaining 2/3 cups of mixed greens.

title: Split Pea and Beef Kebabs
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs split peas, rinsed and picked over | 2 lbs top round steaks, cut into 5 to 6 by 1 1/2-inch slices | 1 cup low sodium yogurt or 1 cup other nonfat sour cream
instructions: Place split peas in a large bowl and cover with very hot tap water.

title: Linguica
ingredients: 12 hazelnuts, peeled | 2 lbs clams | 1 teaspoon fresh sage leaves
instructions: Toast the hazelnuts in a griddle or skillet over low heat for 2 to 3 minutes, shaking the skillet until the hazelnuts are roasted and fragrant. Place the clams in a bowl, cover with water, and pour 1 cup water on them. Let stand in a cool, dark place until opened, about 10 minutes. Remove the clams from the water. Reserve the shells. Place the hazelnuts on a cutting board and cut with a knife into halves or quarters. Scrape the seeds into a mortar.

title: Korean Steak With Mango
ingredients: 1 kg sirloin | 4 mangoes
instructions: Marinate beef with mangoes by sprinkling them on the top of the beef. Place on bbq on high heat, when brown on the top turn down and cook 30 minutes on medium/low heat. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: garlic paste,butter bean,hamburger,green bean,red chili pepper
title: Smoky Beef Casserole
ingredients: 500 g hamburger | 25 g butter beans | 25 g butter beans, drained | 1 medium red chili pepper, cut into slices | 1/2 teaspoon red chili pepper, deseeded and chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to c/c fan forced and lightly grease a baking dish with a teaspoon of butter taken from 1/2kg hamburger. Mix all ingredients in a large bowl, breaking up clumps. Pour into dish and bake for 45 - 50 minutes, or till bubbling and cooked through.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,vermicelli,vanilla bean,parsley,zucchini,pork roast,american cheese,celery salt
title: Vermicelli American Platter
ingredients: 3 - 4 lbs pork roast | 2 tablespoons celery salt | 2 tablespoons vermicelli | 3 teaspoons ground parsley | 2 teaspoons dried parsley | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla bean | 2 medium zucchini or 2 zucchini, sliced | 1 1/2 cups basmati rice or 1 1/2 cups basmati rice, cooked | 1 cup american cheese, cut into cubes
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Place all ingredients except the cheese in a large roasting pan. Cover the roasting pan with foil. Bake until meat is very tender, about 2 hours. Remove from oven, cover and let rest for 15 minutes up to 1 hour. Slice meat against the thickest part of the meat.

title: Mexican Mac and Cheese Pie II
ingredients: 2 packages pillsbury refrigerated wagon wheel macaroni | 2 cups shredded mexican blend cheese | 1 can of drained can of drained can of drained can of drained can of diced tomato with jalapenos ( optional ) or ( 28 ounce ) can diced pickled jalapeno peppers ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Open the package of wagon wheel macaroni, place into bottom of a greased 9x13 baking dish and coat with the first 3 ingredients. Spread the second 2 ingredients over the dish. Bake for 45 - 55 minute until bubbly.

title: Red Onion, Parsley and Parsley Rinds
ingredients: 5 ounces red onions or 5 ounces red shallots | 5 ounces fresh parsley leaves, chopped
instructions: Peel and chop the onions or shallots. Place into a deep pan. Add the chopped parsley. Cover the pan with a lid and cook on a very low heat for about an hour or until the onions are very soft and have turned a dark rich colour. Turn off the heat but leave the lid on for 10 minutes to allow the flavour to escape. Using a vegetable peeler, peel the onions or shallots into very thin strips. Add to the pan of parsley and continue cooking for a further 20 minutes until reduced a little and crunchy. Allow to cool, store in an airtight container for about 4 days before using.

title: Linguine with Ham and Peas
ingredients: 1/2 cup thinly sliced smoked ham | 1/4 cup frozen green pea | 1 1/2 cups hot cooked linguine | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh mint
instructions: Cook linguine according to package directions. Meanwhile, heat ham in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat, stirring constantly, until browned, about 5 minutes. Add peas and cook 2 to 3 minutes or until peas are tender. Add linguine and mix lightly. Add mint and toss until heated through. Serve with additional mint.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,pork roast,carrot,pineapple juice,milk,chicken bouillon,dark sesame oil,broth
title: Asian Sweet and Sour Pork
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless pork roast | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon, granules | 1 cup chicken broth | 1/2 cup pineapple juice | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 cup milk, soy | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 2 carrots, chopped | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil
instructions: Cut the pork into approximately 1 inch cubes. Combine the chicken bouillon, broth, pineapple juice and oils.

Random Ingredients: water chestnut,creole seasoning,amaretto,salad oil,gouda cheese,pecorino romano cheese,anaheim chili
title: Amerikaner (Gouda, Pecorino and Chile Pizza)
ingredients: 1 cup grated gruyere cheese or 1 cup emmenthaler cheese | 1 cup grated kefalotyri cheese or 1 cup edam cheese | 1 cup grated gouda cheese | 1/4 cup water chestnut, sliced | 1 -2 minced anaheim chili | 1 tablespoon amaretto | creole seasoning, to taste
instructions: Combine cheeses with creole seasoning. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl with fork. Spray pizza pans with cooking spray or spread crust with oil. Bake pizza until golden brown and bubbly.

title: Gnocchi in Thick Tomato Sauce
ingredients: mutton, meat | 3 tablespoons ghee | 2 tablespoons ghee ( clarified butter ) | 3 large tomatoes | 1 cup greek tomato sauce | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 1/2 cup apple juice | 1/2 hot chili pepper, finely chopped
instructions: Heat ghee in a non stick skillet. Add the gfg. Oil. Add the ginger. When fragrant, add the meat. Cook until the color darkens. Add tomato and tomato sauce. Continue cooking for 3 minutes. Stir in half and half. Cook for 3 more minutes. Add hot pepper, allow to warm through. Serve hot with rice.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,black bean,red curry paste,salmon,chili oil
title: Soup Salmon & Black Beans
ingredients: 1 lb salmon, diced ( or your favourite cooked fish like pollock ) | 1 can black beans, drained | 2 teaspoons red curry paste ( not kook's ) | 1 packet dry onion soup mix | 5 tablespoons chili oil
instructions: Heat oil until hot stir fry salmon. Add onion & curry paste. Cook for another 2 minutes stir in beans. Serve immediately.

title: Wasabi Ginger Ice Cream
ingredients: 1/2 cup wasabi, pulp ( from a cube of wasabi ) | 300 -500 ml double cream | 1 teaspoon ginger, freshly grated
instructions: Soak the wasabi in cold water for 15 minutes. The wasabi should be soft but not mushy. Place in a glass bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and leave to soften for 30 minutes. In a bowl mix cream until it starts to firm. This should take about 20 minutes. Add the wasabi pulp and the ginger and blend well. Spoon the mixture into your ice cream maker. Follow manufacturer's instructions if required.

Random Ingredients: coriander leaf,maraschino cherry,green onion,broccoli stem,fruit,mexican cheese,barbecue sauce
title: Barbecue Cheese and Fruit Salad
ingredients: 4 -6 ounces shredded mexican blend cheese | 4 -6 teaspoons barbecue sauce ( to taste ) | 2 -3 slices british canadian cheese or 2 -3 slices other tasty cheese, grated | 1/4 cup fresh coriander leaves, chopped ( or cilantro ) | 1 green onion, thinly sliced | 1 cup broccoli stem, cut into florets | 12 maraschino cherries, stems removed
instructions: Prepare barbecue sauce according to package directions. Add cheese, corriander, onion, celery and cook until cheese is melted and onion is tender. Stir in fruit and serve immediately.

title: Herbed Tortillas
ingredients: 2/3 cup pecans, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons salad dressing ( a-1 ratio of 1/2 and 1 1/2 to 1 tablespoon ) | 3 tablespoons dill pickle slices | 6 flour tortillas
instructions: Using your hands, mix the pecans with the salad dressing. Spread the pecan mixture on each tortilla. Use a tooth pick to pick up the tortillas and eat immediately.

Random Ingredients: cumin,mango nectar,mint leaf,mustard,baking potato,splenda sugar substitute,blueberry,noodle
title: Blueberry Mango Baked Noodle Salad With Mango-Mustard Dressing
ingredients: 2 large baking potatoes, cut into cubes | 8 ounces dry noodles | 8 ounces plain sweet baby mango nectar ( or mango nectar ) | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 2 tablespoons mustard | 2 tablespoons splenda sugar substitute | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped mint leaves
instructions: Place the diced potato in a colander and rinse under running water for a few minutes to rinse off any saltiness. Shake the potatoes to clean off excess water. Set aside to drain. Rinse any starch from the noodles and add to the noodles with mango nectar. Toss to coat evenly. Set aside to sit for about 30 minutes for flavors to combine. Preheat the oven to 500°f. Dressing, place mustard and splenda in a small bowl and mix well. Place onion in the work bowl of a food processor. Pulse a few times to chop to desired consistency. Set aside. Place noodles in a large shallow glass or ceramic baking dish. Sprinkle with the salt. Scatter on the mint. Toss to coat evenly, then cover the dish with foil and bake for 10 minutes. Remove from the oven. Remove the foil, sprinkle with mustard and pour on salad dressing. Stir to mix.

title: Thai Coconut Milk Dessert Dip
ingredients: 1 can coconut milk | 1/2 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Spiral from coconut can as well as coconut cream is sold in large containers, so follow the preparation directions for the coconut milk containers. Pour into a pan/bowl that has been coated in oil.

Random Ingredients: burgundy wine,crisco,splenda sugar substitute,radish,ramen noodle,dashi,yellow pepper,beef brisket
title: Microwave Beef Brisket
ingredients: 1 beef brisket or ( 3 lb ) brisket, cut into 8 chops | 1 package ramen noodles | 1/4 cup dashi | 1 cup burgundy wine or 1 cup red wine, of your choice | 1/2 cup splenda sugar substitute | 1/2 teaspoon splenda sugar substitute | 2 tablespoons crisco, crisco, melted | 8 -10 radishes, sliced
instructions: Place brisket, noodles, dashi, wine, splenda, and crisco in 2 - 3 qt microwave safe casserole dish. Cover and microwave on high 1 1/2 to 2 1/2 minutes. Remove brisket from dish and place on top of noodles. Cover and microwave on high for 3 - 5 minutes. Carefully remove brisket, discard juices in casserole dish and set aside. Microwave all but 2 tbsp drippings and radishes in 3 qt microwave safe casserole dish. Cover and microwave on high for 2 minutes. Garnish with reserved radishes.

Random Ingredients: baking potato,sea salt,yellow squash,dark soy sauce,walnut oil,chili paste,applesauce,guacamole
title: Roasted Veggies With Chili and Walnuts
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs baking potatoes, peeled and quartered | 1 teaspoon chili paste or 1 teaspoon other chili seasoning mix salt | sea salt | 3 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 -2 tablespoon unsweetened applesauce | 1 tablespoon unsweetened applesauce | 1 teaspoon dark soy sauce | chopped walnuts ( optional ) | 1 yellow squash, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients in large bowl of a food processor and process until just mixed. Serve warm or at room temperature. For variation, add 1 tablespoon sugar or agave syrup.

title: The Most Amazing Irish Pub Lunch
ingredients: 1 parsnip, grated | 4 ounces cooked ham, chopped | 4 ounces cooked black beans, drained | 4 ounces canned buttermilk | 1 tomatoes, grated ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons butter beans, sliced
instructions: In a small bowl mash the grated parsnip and ham together with the beans and buttermilk. Taste for seasoning. Divide into serving bowls and top with tomato, if using. This goes really well with bread or muffins.

title: Sauteed Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 ripe cherry tomatoes | sea salt and pepper
instructions: Slice tomatoes and salt and pepper to taste. Serve with crusty french bread salad.

Random Ingredients: canadian bacon,celery leaf,chili paste,white flour,tortilla,cardamom pod,butter,havarti cheese
title: Tortilla Rollatas or Sandwich Bread Variations
ingredients: 1/3 lb havarti cheese, diced | 2 tablespoons shredded smoky smoked havarti cheese | 2 slices celery leaves or 2 slices celery | 1 pinch ground cardamom pod | 1/3 teaspoon finely chopped pickled garlic or 1/3 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons sweet chili paste, such as sambal oelek | 1 teaspoon butter or 1 teaspoon margarine | 1 slice canadian bacon, thinly sliced
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the havarti cheese, smoked havarti cheese, celery leaves, cardamom, garlic or spice powders, and sweet chili paste. Spread the mixture evenly on the slice of the havarti cheese. Roll up the slice.

Random Ingredients: cottage cheese,red lentil,pearl barley,sponge cake,cooking spray,feta cheese,baby spinach
title: Red Lentil and Spinach Pies
