ingredients: 1 cup red lentils | 1 cup pints natural baby spinach | 1 sponge cake, sliced | cooking spray | 1 cup cottage cheese | 1 cup crumbled feta cheese | 1/4 cup chopped fresh basil or 1/4 cup parsley
instructions: Bring lentils and water to a boil in a saucepan. Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, for 10 minutes. Cool, covered, about 1 hour. Remove pan from heat and let stand for 5 minutes. Transfer to bowl of a food processor fitted with metal blade. Add the spinach and purée. Cut the sponge into cubes. Heat a grill pan over medium high heat. Coat pan with cooking spray. Arrange half of the pudding in the bottom of the pan. Sprinkle with half of the cottage cheese and half the feta cheese. Repeat twice with remaining ingredients. Spread the spinach mixture over the cheese, then top with remaining cottage cheese and feta cheese. Place in the oven for 15 minutes or until puffed and lightly browned.

title: Peanut Bean Sprouts With Thai Basil
ingredients: 1 lb bean sprouts | 4 tablespoons peanut oil or 4 tablespoons other peanut oil | 5 thai basil | 1 serrano chilies or 1 red chili, seeded and finely chopped
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Boil the bean sprouts for about 3 minutes, remove and drain well. Slice the basil leaves vertically into shreds, lengthwise, and place in a large bowl.. Heat the oil in a wok, or deep skillet over medium high heat until just smoking. Add the basil. Stirring frequently, reduce the heat to medium high or just until the basil just starts to turn crisp. Add the bean sprouts and stir fry for 2 minutes. Return the bean sprouts and chilies to the wok. Stir well, then add salt and more chilies if you like. This dish is usually served with rice or noodles.

Random Ingredients: vanilla pudding,milk,arborio rice,vegetable oil cooking spray,tamari
title: Easy Rice Pudding
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups milk | 1 package instant vanilla pudding | 2 tablespoons tamari or 2 tablespoons soy sauce | vegetable oil cooking spray | 3 cups arborio rice, cooked
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Combine the milk, pudding, tamari, and vegetable oil in medium saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly, about 10 minutes, or until mixture starts to thicken. Transfer the rice mixture to a buttered 2 1/2 quart baking dish. Spray a small amount of cooking spray into a small bowl and place the rice around the pudding. Bake rice at 350°, stirring occasionally for 45 minutes or until pudding is firm and hot and top is golden. Serve with a scoop of ice cream if desired.

title: Oven Fried Smoked Haddock With Rice
ingredients: 1 broiler-fryer chickens, about 3 lbs | 4 ounces salt pork or 4 ounces bacon | 4 ounces small smoked haddock | parsley, for garnish | brown rice, for serving
instructions: The chicken should be cut up and skinned. Place the chicken, fat side up, on 2 x 1/4 inch baking sheets lined with foil. With fat side down, place in a preheated 375°f oven and cook over moderately hot coals for 1 1/2 hours, or until just white throughout. Trim fat. Meanwhile, cut the haddock in to thin slices and rinse under cold water. Pat dry with paper towel. Arrange the slices in a single layer on a foil covered baking sheet, fat side up. Grill the haddock over moderate heat until just cooked through, about 10 minutes. Cover the haddock with water and let sit for about 10 minutes. Slice fish or shred. Ladle into serving bowls and garnish with chopped parsley.

title: Blueberry Parcels
ingredients: 1 lb beans ( fresh or frozen ) | 6 ounces puff pastry or 6 ounces pastry for squares ( 10 inch ) | 2 teaspoons chili paste | 1 jar blueberries | salt & fresh ground black pepper
instructions: Rinse beans and place in a large sauce pan with enough cold water to cover them. Simmer for about 20 minutes, or until soft. If using frozen pastry, preheat oven to 400°f. Line baking trays with plastic wrap and set up the puff pastry rounds in one layer on the trays, keeping others covered. Fill the pastry cases with beans, top each with 1 teaspoons of chili paste and place them on the trays. Use the back of a spoon to push the beans slightly to the edges and corners of the pastry rounds. Sprinkle with sea salt, pepper and more chili paste if desired. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes or until pastry is puffed up and golden and browned.

title: Pan Roasted Orange Chicken
ingredients: 1 large navel orange | 5 medium chicken thighs ( from one chicken ) | 2 tablespoons pastry flour or 2 tablespoons rice flour | 1/4 cup chocolate syrup | 1/2 cup marsala | 1/2 cup dry roasted peanuts | 1 package uncooked linguine or ( 16 ounce ) package linguine
instructions: Slice 1/2 the orange in 4 equal segments. Place in glass bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Place in refrigerator to marinate while preparing other chicken parts. In bowl combine 1/2 of the orange zest and 1/4 cup of the orange zest, along with the chicken, with the remaining orange zest and cinnamon mixture. Coat the chicken with pastry flour or rice flour. Place in a deep, straight sided baking dish. In 2 - 4 batches, add 2 tablespoons of the chocolate syrup and set the chicken in the centre of the dish. Pour the remaining chocolate syrup around the chicken. Bake in a preheated 300 degree f oven for 30 - 45 minutes, until chicken is browned and sauce is thick and syrupy. While it’s cooking, boil the linguine in a large pot of salted boiling water for 10 minutes. Drain. Transfer cooked linguine to serving platter. Top with orange slices and reserved orange slices. Sprinkle with peanuts. Serve immediately.

title: The Best Honey Mustard Butter
ingredients: 1 cup honey mustard | 1 pinch cayenne pepper | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Mix everything into a soft paste with a hand whisk or blender. Keep refrigerated until ready to use. To store, simply wrap the paste in olive oil and place in a jar in the fridge.

title: Tropical Mango and Cheese Dip
ingredients: 800 g mixed cheeses, eg. velveeta, cubed | 1 medium mango, cubed | 1 small white onion, chopped | 1 pimento, chopped | 3 medium red potatoes, cubed | 100 g dark chocolate, finely chopped
instructions: Place a non stick pan on the stove and put on a small element to heat up stirring occasionally. Add cubed cheese. When cheese is melted add chopped mango and onion. Continue stirring until mixture is smooth. Add pimentos and potatoes. Cook for a few minutes stirring continuously. Turn off the element. Put mixture in a serving dish and chill for an hour or two so the chocolate begins to melt and become bubbly. Serve immediately.

title: Vegetable Pie
ingredients: 1 eggplant, peeled and cut into 1/2 inch pieces, then cut up into 1/2 inch chunks | 2 cups sliced canned peaches | 12 plum tomatoes | 3 serrano peppers, stemmed and seeded | 1/2 cup kernel corn | 1/3 cup grated gruyere cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Place the eggplant cubes in a large baking dish and bake in the preheated oven until lightly browned, about 40 minutes. Turn the pieces and roast on other side. Remove from oven and cool until easy to handle. When cool, transfer to a large bowl. Place the peaches in a food processor and process until smooth. Transfer the peaches to the bowl with the peaches. Cut tomatoes in half and remove top and seeds. Cut into thin slices. Remove seeds. Line a 9 inch pie dish with four strips of paper towels. Place the vegetables over the noodles and toss to coat. Sprinkle with cheese and toss to coat. Bake in the preheated oven until lightly browned but not burnt, 10 to 15 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Chinese Hot Pot
ingredients: 1 lb link italian sausage | 1 bag fresh snow pea ( or 3 packages frozen peas ) | 1 bunch watercress
instructions: Place sausage in your largest pot. Add enough water to cover the sausage. Bring to the boil. Lower heat and boil until the water is reduced to about 1 1/2 lbs or 8 cups. You may also add a bit more water depending on thickness. Remove sausage to a bowl, reserving cooking water. Put the rest of the ingredients in a crockery pot. Stir to combine. Pour sausage water around the peas in the pot. Cook on high for 1 hour with the lid on. Do not stir.

title: Lamb and Noodle Skewers - Kålade
ingredients: 1 lb lean lamb, cut into pieces ( or beef ) | vegetable oil cooking spray | 12 ounces rice stick noodles ( gluten-free if desired ) | 2 tablespoons guacamole | 3 teaspoons cherry rolls or 3 teaspoons cherry tomatoes | 1 teaspoon green bird's eye chilies, thinly sliced ( fresh or thai ) or 1/2 teaspoon thai bird's eye chile ( fresh or thai ) | 1/4 scallion, sliced, white and green parts separated, for garnish
instructions: Place lamb and vegetables in metal, glass, plastic or ceramic bowls about 2 inches wide and 1/2 inch high. Spray with oil, turning so meat is coated, and cover with saran wrap. Marinate in refrigerator for at least 12 hours, but preferably overnight. Drain meat, reserving marinade, and thread meat, vegetables and saran wrap onto skewers. Refrigerate skewers for at least 30 minutes. Prepare kebabs, wash grill surface and dry well. Place metal skewers on grill over medium heat and grill, turning occasionally, until meat is browned, about 20 minutes total. Serve kebabs with salsa, if desired. Serve with rice noodles, garnish with green chilies, scallions and tomato.

title: Almond Chicken
ingredients: 1 kg chicken | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 3 -4 dried red chili peppers
instructions: Combine almond and chili in a plastic bag, or in a ziploc baggie, and shake until smooth. Place chicken pieces in bag, with almond mixture, and close the bag. Refrigerate for about 4 hours, shaking and rearranging the bag. The longer the marinade sits, the easier chicken will be to remove from the marinade. Remove chicken from bag, pat dry with paper towel, wipe off marinade with hands. Place chicken on tray in a baking dish, sprinkle with extra almond extract, and bake at 180°c/350°f for approximately 45 - 50 minutes, until cooked through and crispy.

title: Spinach Gnocchi
ingredients: 250 g fresh spinach, washed and stemmed | 8 cups white flour | 1 teaspoon lemon zest
instructions: Heat milk and water to boiling in medium heat. Once hot stir in 1 tsp lemon zest. Place spinach in strainer and squeeze as much water as it can. Then add to boiling milk mix. Continue boiling for 15 minutes or until spinach is cooked. Remove from heat, place in bowl, cover, and refrigerate for 1 hour. Punch down and work out dough onto a floured surface. Turn onto floured board, knead briefly, and cut into 2 equal sized sections. On floured board, roll each section into a thin circle about 12 x 2 inches on each side. Using 1/4 tsp batter for each gnocchi, bring two opposite edges together, then roll each one in the remaining batter until completely enclosed. Put gnocchi onto oiled cooking sheet or fryer, and cook according to directions on sheet or fryer. When gnocchi float to surface, it is done. Serve hot. Enjoy.

title: Italian Sausage
ingredients: 4 boneless pork chops | 4 -5 tablespoons fennel seeds | 1 lb plum tomato, seeded, peeled and diced
instructions: Combine fennel and fenel seeds in a mortar, then work into a paste with salt to make a spice rub. Grill the pork on a rack in a broiling pan, and cook until done to your liking. You may have to do this several hours in advance to allow fennel flavor to develop.

Random Ingredients: plum tomato,mango,great northern bean,graham cracker crumb,champagne,flat leaf parsley
title: Gran's Amazing White Bean Rooibos
ingredients: 1 can great northern beans, drained and rinsed | 3 plum tomatoes, chopped | 6 tablespoons champagne | 4 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, chopped | 1/2 mango, diced | 1/2 graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Combine beans with tomatoes, champagne grape juice or sweetner and parsley. Refrigerate for 2 - 3 hours, stirring once or twice. Place the graham cracker crumbs in a shallow bowl. Dip the graham cracker in the crumbs and shake off any excess. Place on a plate and mound the white bean mixture alongside and serve.

title: French Lentil Pizza
ingredients: 7 cups green lentils | 1 cup mozzarella cheese | 12 ounces cheese, grated | 1 3/4 teaspoons active dry yeast
instructions: Place 6 cups water on the stove with the lentils, about 15 to 20 minutes. Warm the mozzarella and cheese. Add yeast. Set aside. When the lentils bubble, stir once or twice. Immediately take out the lemon and yeast as they are already frothy. Add 4 cups of the lentils, 1 cup of the mozzarella, and a 1/3 cup of the cheese. Blend. Grease a 2 quart baking dish. Put yeast and remaining lentils in saucepan with the rest of the cheese, the 1/3 cup of the cheese and enough water to just cover the lentils. When boiling, pour into the 3 quart baking dish and cover with a towel. Put on the lid and bake at 325 degrees for about 45 minutes, until browned on top and bubbly on the bottom. Serve warm.

title: Jicama-Jicama Salad
ingredients: 1 pound jicama, peeled and chopped | 1/3 cup heavy cream
instructions: Mix jicama with cream and refrigerate 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: ha avocado,red bean,cornmeal,raspberry,asafoetida powder,liquid smoke,tomato ketchup,balsamic vinegar
title: Mexican Cornbread
ingredients: 1 can red beans, not drained | 1 can canned corn ( not drained ) | 1 cup honey avocado, diced | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke, no substitutions | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar, good quality | 2 tablespoons tomato ketchup | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons cornmeal
instructions: Place first 5 ingredients into a greased casserole. Mix remaining ingredients and add to casserole. Bake in moderate oven 325ºf for 1 hour or until thick. While still warm, sprinkle with cornmeal and serve.

title: Lechon Eggs (Lechons)
ingredients: 1 lb lean pork, ground | 4 hard-boiled eggs, shelled
instructions: Grind the pork into small crumbs. Combine crumbs and meat together. Using a fork, press the eggs into the mixture. Place in shallow casserole and sprinkle with lemon juice. Bake at 325f degrees for one hour. Add more lemon juice if necessary.

title: Salsa Stuffed Asparagus
ingredients: 2 bunches asparagus | 2/3 cup mango salsa | 2/3 cup sweet chili sauce | 1/2 cup reduced-fat brie cheese or 1/2 cup low-fat sour cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 425f degrees. Prepare a baking sheet by spraying with cooking spray, or lining with parchment paper. Cut the asparagus in half lengthwise. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil over high heat. Add asparagus and cook for 2 minutes or until just cooked through. Drain and place on sprayed baking sheet, or in a baking dish lined with aluminum foil. Stir salsa and sweet chili sauce together in a small bowl, and spread over asparagus. Top with cheese. Bake in 400f degrees oven until cheese is golden.

title: Rice Noodle Beef
ingredients: 4 lbs steak or 4 lbs sirloin | 3 cups uncooked rice noodles ( i use rice dream brand ) | 1 cup green chili pepper, strips | 1 cup amaretto ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt ( or other season salt if you prefer )
instructions: Place steak in crock pot. Sprinkle with seasoning salt. Pour amaretto over top. Cook on low 7 - 10 hours. About 30 minutes before serving, place rice noddles in a large serving bowl and cover with hot water. Gently toss the noodles with the hot liquid to coat the noodles, removing them immediately. Cover with lid or a plate just large enough to place them under the boiling water and let stand for 2 - 3 minutes before serving.

title: Pan-Fried Thai Fish
ingredients: 400 g white fish fillets, cut into 2 cm cubes | 6 tablespoons soya sauce | 2 tablespoons thyme leaves | 300 g couscous
instructions: Put the fish, soya sauce and thyme leaves into a bowl. Mix well. Pour the mix into a flat pan. Turn the heat on to high and fry the fish until the skin is crispy. Turn the fish over, add the couscous and turn the heat back down to medium. Cook, covered, for around 10 minutes or until the couscous is cooked. Leave to sit for about 5 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: pasta,beef sirloin,squash,monterey jack cheese,port wine,italian bread,baking powder
title: Beef With Pasta
ingredients: 1/4 cup dry port wine | 1 lb boneless beef top sirloin, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 3/4 cup shredded monterey jack cheese | 1 small cooked squash, peeled and cut into 8 wedges | 1/2 cup sliced port | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 2 cups hot cooked pasta
instructions: In a large frying pan, cook beef over medium heat until no longer pink.

Random Ingredients: asiago cheese,golden syrup,basmati rice,chili powder,hamburger bun
title: Fried Asiago Burgers
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon chili powder | 1/2 cup cooked basmati rice | 1/3 cup grated asiago cheese ( or parmesan cheese ) | 2 tablespoons sweet chili powder ( or to taste ) | 4 slices cooked lean hamburger buns ( or your favorite spreadable )
instructions: In a small bowl stir together the chili powder and rice. Add the cheese and stir until well blended. Set aside. Pre heat a heavy skillet or griddle on medium high heat. Dip each burger into the chili cheese mixture and fry until lightly golden on all sides. Remove from the pan and serve.

Random Ingredients: roquefort cheese,coconut oil,yukon gold potato,english muffin,celery seed,butter margarine
title: Cheese Bangers
ingredients: 4 -6 yukon gold potatoes, depending on size | 1/4 cup roquefort cheese, crumbled | 1 teaspoon celery seed | 1 teaspoon coconut oil | 2 -3 english muffins, toasted ( i used wholemeal ) | 1 tablespoon butter or margarine
instructions: Peel potatoes if leaving skins on and slice into thin wedges. Slice the chayote into 1/4 inch wedges. Place 1/2 teaspoon roquefort cheese in the center of each potato slice. Sprinkle celery seed and coconut oil evenly over top. Wrap each potato with a little of the cheese. Bake at 400 f. For 12 - 15 minutes, or until potato is tender. While the potatoes are baking, heat your grill. While potatoes are baking, toast the english muffins. Melt butter then smear melted butter generously over each toast. Place a couple of chayote wedges under the broiler for 1 - 2 minutes until hot and starting to burn. Sprinkle with the remaining cheese as soon as the cheese is melted.

title: Vegetables Au Pancake
ingredients: 1 small head cauliflower | 1/4 lb cremini mushroom | 1 ounce sultana or 1 ounce sunflower oil | 1 ounce amaretti, crumbled | 4 ounces bittersweet chocolate, chopped | 3 -5 ounces bean sprouts ( optional )
instructions: Make a grid with water and a weight on top. Break cauliflower into bite size florets, cut mushrooms into 1/2 inch slices. Pour oil into fry pan and set over high heat. When it is just about to smoke, add a little saffron and stir for 1 sec then turn heat down until saffron is light gold, about 1 minute. Add mushrooms and stir to release oil. Add a handful of crumbled amaretti. Add mushrooms and stir to mix inches add more amaretti if needed and stir until it has melted. Then add the chopped chocolate, stir and remove to a plate. Continue to stir just until each addition is well mixed and is evenly coated with the sauce, about 1 minute more. This makes a great, simple, and tasty pancake with a little bit more of the air in it. It is important not to pour too much liquid into this and too much. You will miss out on some of the ingredients…it all depends on what type of veggies you have on hand.

title: Real Mexican Cheese Fondue
ingredients: 1/2 lb bacon, cut into small pieces | 1 cup mild mexican cheese ( shredded ) | 1 tablespoon coarse sea salt
instructions: In a large heavy saucepan, melt the bacon over medium heat. Stir in the remaining ingredients, except the fondue and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium low, cover, and cook, stirring occasionally, until a deep rich, rich red color appears, about 20 minutes longer. Transfer the fried fondue to a fonduepot and serve it hot.

title: Rice Cream
ingredients: 2 cups sodium-reduced vanilla-flavored soymilk, well stirred to blend | 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes ( optional or to taste ) | salt and pepper
instructions: In a medium sized saucepan or deep frying pan, combine all the ingredients and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes or until thickened, stirring occasionally. Let cool, then transfer to a large glass bowl and serve.

title: Pecorino & Pepper-Crusted Yogurt
ingredients: 1 cup corn chips, crushed | 1 1/4 cups plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons sweet pickling spice ( such as spice hunter ) | 1 tablespoon freshly grated nutmeg | 1 tablespoon freshly grated pecorino romano cheese | 2 tablespoons lemonade ( prepared )
instructions: To make lemonade, stir together yogurt, mustard powder, spices and cheese in a bowl. Whisk in lemonade until creamy. Pour over crushed chips and toss lightly. Let stand at room temperature 30 minutes so flavors marry.

title: Red Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans italian-style stewed tomatoes | 1/2 lb whole wheat, patted dry, rinsed, patted dry | 32 fresh cilantro stems, chopped ( preferably curly leaves )
instructions: Mix the stewed tomatoes and the whole wheat in a 3 - 4 quart saucepan. Cover and simmer over very low heat, stirring occasionally, until all of the liquid has been absorbed, 8 to10 minutes. Stir in the cilantro. Cool to room temperature before serving. Store covered until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: asafoetida powder,applesauce,flat leaf italian parsley,cream corn,red chilies,coriander seed,onion soup mix
title: Easy Corn on the Cob
ingredients: 2 cans cream style corn, drained | 1 can reduced-sodium unsweetened applesauce | 1 tablespoon red chilies, very finely chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons unsalted butter | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried onion soup mix | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 teaspoon coriander seed, lightly crushed ( optional ) | 2 -3 sprigs fresh flat-leaf italian parsley, stemmed and coarsely chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender and blend smooth.. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,pinto bean,mexican cheese,basil,caper,thai fish sauce,sesame oil
title: Easy Mexican Sesame Bean Dip
ingredients: 1/2 tablespoon sesame oil | 1/2 tablespoon plain flour | 1/2 cup pinto beans, drained | 1/2 teaspoon basil, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon thai fish sauce | 1/2 cup mexican blend cheese | 1 tablespoon capers, drained
instructions: Serve with salad and crusty bread.

title: Spiced Baked Legs of Lamb with Basmati Rice (Bihari
ingredients: 1/4 cup tomato paste | 2 1/2 lbs leg of lamb, butterflied, fat trimmed, and cut into 8 portions | 4 cups uncooked basmati rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Place the tomato paste in a small nonstick baking pan. Heat in oven until bubbling. Bake the lamb at 300 degrees f for 3 1/2 hours or until just brown and tender. Transfer the lamb to a platter and keep warm. Add the basmati rice to the pan and cook to loosen bits of bread stuck to the pan.

title: Quick Chickpeas With Peanuts
ingredients: 1 cup dry roasted salted peanut | 1 can chick-peas ( garbanzo beans ), drained and rinsed
instructions: In a food processor or blender, puree the peanuts to make a coarse ground texture. Return them to the food processor with the chickpeas and puree them to desired texture and consistency. You may serve them on a bed of rice or flat bread, drizzled with olive oil and sprinkled with chopped cilantro.

Random Ingredients: beef roast,lime juice,flat leaf parsley,lemon zest,tomato paste
title: Barbecue Beef
ingredients: 1/2 cup tomato paste | 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice | 1 teaspoon grated lemon zest | 1 tablespoon finely chopped flat leaf parsley | 2 lbs beef roast
instructions: Stir tomato paste with lemon zest, parsley, and 1/4 cup hot water until combined. Pierce beef with a fork, and transfer mixture to a baking dish. Pour marinade over beef, turning to coat. Cover, and refrigerate for at least 2 hours and up to 4 hours before basting. Bake covered in a preheated 450f oven for 1 1/2 hours, basting frequently with remaining marinade.

Random Ingredients: shiitake mushroom,ice water,mexican cheese,coconut cream,iceberg lettuce,pinto bean,orange juice concentrate,greek oregano
title: Fiesta Con Carne (Ww)
ingredients: 3/4 cup orange juice concentrate or 3/4 cup lime juice concentrate | 1 1/4 cups ice water | 3 tablespoons coconut cream | 1/4 cup mexican blend cheese ( shredded ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried shiitake mushrooms or 1/4 teaspoon dried creole, powder | 1/4 teaspoon dried greek oregano | 1/4 cup shredded iceberg lettuce, for topping | 1/2 cup shiitake mushroom, sliced ( optional for a kick ) | steamed shaved iceberg lettuce, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: In a medium mixing bowl add first 3 ingredients and stir to blend well. Cover and chill for 3 hours. Stir again before serving. To serve, place shredded lettuce on the bottom of one of several soup plates. Distribute shredded cheese over the lettuce and top with sliced shiitake mushrooms. Garnish with shredded arugula.

title: Pennsylvania Dutch Apple Pie
ingredients: 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 pie crust, unbaked | 1 cup apple juice
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f. Heat oil in a deep skillet over medium heat. Place pie crust in a medium bowl and drizzle the bottom with the peanut oil. Layer the crust with apples, then pour apple juice over them. Cover the crust with wax paper and bake about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: white fish fillet,canadian bacon,tomato puree,coconut milk,red wine,fennel seed
title: Coconut Fish and Bacon
ingredients: 1 package canadian bacon | 1 can light coconut milk or ( 12 ounce ) can coconut cream | 1 tablespoon canadian-style red wine | 2 tablespoons tomato puree | 1 teaspoon fennel seed, crushed | 1 1/2 lbs firm white fish fillets
instructions: Cook bacon in large saucepan over low heat, breaking up with back of spoon, until crisp. Drain bacon on paper towels.

Random Ingredients: pea,ham,half,italian seasoning,thai red curry paste,dark molasses,maraschino cherry,sunflower oil
title: Chefy's Savoury Peas Salad
ingredients: 2 cans frozen peas | 2 -4 slices ham, cut into thin slices | 1 -8 sunflower oil or 1 -8 any other neutral tasting oil | 2 -3 teaspoons italian seasoning | 1 tablespoon thai red curry paste | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 1 tablespoon dark molasses | 2 -3 teaspoons freshly grated maraschino cherries
instructions: Put the peas on to boil in the microwave for 1 to 2 minutes. Then drain and set aside, if not using immediately. In a small bowl, mix the oil, italian seasoning, thai red curry paste, half and half, and molasses together. Add the shrimp and the peas, and stir just to mix everything together. Heat just enough to warm through, but do not boil. Pour onto plates, and top with the cherries.

title: Mexican Cheddar Corn and kale Soup
ingredients: 1/4 cup dry polenta ( optional ) | 32 ounces vegetable stock ( low sodium ) | 10 ounces kale, leaves and stems removed | 4 corn on the cob, cut into 3-inch cubes | 2 teaspoons cajun seasoning | 3 cups chopped escarole | 1/2 cup distilled white vinegar
instructions: Prepare polenta according to package directions.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,fruit strawberry,white hominy,ranch dressing mix,pine nut,barley,wheat couscous,swiss cheese
title: Stuffed Whole Wheat and Swiss Cheesecake With Raw Yogurt
ingredients: 1 box whole wheat couscous | 1 box small white hominy, drained | 1 can white hominy, drained | 1/2 cup barley, drained | 1/2 cup self-rising flour | 1/4 cup light ranch dressing mix | 2 cups shredded swiss cheese | 2 cups toasted pine nuts, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Prepare an 8 inch square pan by rubbing the inside with oil. Combine the couscous with the 2 cups of water and set aside. Bring the 1 can of white hominy and 3/4 cup of water to a boil in a medium saucepan over medium high heat, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat and add 1 cup of barley to the hominy mixture.

title: Cranberry Sausages With Black Beans
ingredients: 8 -12 large sausages | 1 -2 chicken stock cube | 2 cans cranberries | 1 1/2 cups rinsed and de-seeded black beans
instructions: Bring the stock up to the boil, then add the sausage. Break the sausages up, and gently shake them around the insides of the pan until they're cooked all the way through. Add the drained cranberries. Turn the heat back down and stir the beans through the stock. Leave to simmer for about 20 minutes, or longer if you're in a hurry, and serve with crusty bread.

title: Prawns in Anchovy Sauce (Artichoke Hearts) With Shrimp
ingredients: 16 small prawns, prawns peeled | 1/4 cup canned anchovy packed in oil ( or anchovy paste ) | 1/4 slice white bread | 4 ladyfingers | 3 tablespoons chopped yellow peppers, assorted colors | 1/2 teaspoon chili paste
instructions: Place prawns in food processor. Add anchovies and bread and pulse until mixture is finely chopped. Divide into 4 portions. Place half shrimp mixture on each warm prawn skin. Wrap bread around prawns in one portion, forming a small bundle. Secure with toothpicks. Place bundles in a large, shallow ceramic baking dish. To form sauce, cut ends off of bread. Cut the bread into 1/4 slices. In a small bowl, stir water into anchovy paste until dissolved. Heat a cast iron skillet or wok over medium high heat.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,sunflower seed,pimento olive,pimiento,wine,almond extract,spanish onion
title: Spanish Onions With Raw Spanish Peanuts
ingredients: 6 large spanish onions, cut 1/4 inch thick | 2 tablespoons sunflower seeds | 2 tablespoons sunflower seeds | 1/2 cup shelled roasted pistilop olives, chopped | 3 tablespoons pimiento stuffed olives, chopped | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes | 1/8 teaspoon wine or 1/8 teaspoon white wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Place the onions in a large, heavy skillet with a small splash of olive oil and 2 t salt. Cook and stir until the onions just begin to brown. Set the onions aside and set the skillet over low heat. Add the raw pistils, chopped pistils and olives. Add 2 t salt and red pepper flakes.

title: Pasta Primavera
ingredients: 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 1 bag baby spinach
instructions: Place the sun dried tomatoes in a small saucepan. Bring water to a boil in a large pot. Drop the baby spinach in one pile onto the sun dried tomatoes. Cover and simmer over low heat for 15 to 20 minutes, or until the spinach is wilted. Drain off any excess liquid. Serve immediately.

title: Blue Cheese Balls
ingredients: 1/3 cup walnut oil | 1/3 cup cornflour | 150 g blue cheese, softened
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl, stir until well mixed. Roll into balls and drop onto an oven tray lined with baking paper covered baking paper. Chill. Bake at 180 c for 15 - 20 mins until golden, turning once. Can be made in advance and reheated in a microwave for 1 - 2 mins until warm.

Random Ingredients: sea salt,red curry paste,mozzarella cheese,white pepper,raisin,ketchup,barbeque sauce,harissa
title: BBQ Cheese With Rasameh and Black Pepper
ingredients: 200 g mozzarella cheese, sliced | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 1 dash white pepper | 1 tablespoon harissa | 4 teaspoons coarse sea salt ( or 1 tablespoon sea salt and some black pepper ) | 1/2 cup raisins
instructions: Make the bbq using a basting brush/flour/olive oil spray of your choice. Season the mozzarella with salt and pepper and set aside. Pour the ketchup into a bowl and add the curry/red curry paste. Mix well. Add the mozzarella slices and toss until they are thoroughly coated, add the raisins and toss again. Place in an ovenproof dish. Make sure the dish is fairly large. Place under a grill or over a hot coals. Grill for about 10 - 15 minutes, until the cheese is golden brown and bubbling. Leave to stand a few minutes if it's ready. Remove the basting/flour/olive oil and slice the cheese in half. Serve with the sauce and the rasameh.

title: Salsa Verde Minted Water Chestnuts in Vinegar
ingredients: 4 -6 ounces jarred roasted rice vinegar | 1 cup water chestnut, stems removed | 2 teaspoons dried mint sprigs | 1/4 - 1/3 cup salsa verde, with mint
instructions: Rinse water chestnuts under cold water, and pat dry using paper towels. Place water chestnuts, mint, and salt and pepper in stainless steel bowl, cover, and let sit at room temperature for 15 minutes. Discard water chestnuts, mint sprigs, and salt and pepper. Let mixture sit for 5 minutes prior to using. Store in refrigerator until ready to use. Use 1 1/2 1/2 teaspoons of salsa verde for a little heat or as a dipping sauce. As the mint was rehydrated, moisture released from the water chestnuts would be enough to make 3 cups of liquid.

title: Quick & Easy Veggies Salad
ingredients: 2 -3 large lettuce | 1 large veggie carrot | 1 large celery rib | 100 g cornflour ( corn starch ) | 2 tablespoons instant gelatin powder | 1/4 cup hummus | 1 tablespoon gluten free flour
instructions: Prepare a microwaveable bowl and microwave on high for 3 minutes. Heat vegetable and lettuce in microwave until just tender. Chop veggies, place in bowl and mix with cornflour. Let cool for 20 minutes. Stir into veggie mixture in bowl. Mix hummus and gluten free flour together in microwave safe dish. Microwave on high for 2 minutes or until the mixture is thick and the gluten is dissolved. Pour into bowl and refrigerate for at least 3 hours. Garnish with parsley if desired.

title: Lentil and Avocado Salsa With Tasty Noodles
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry lentils | 1/2 cup vegetable oil or 1/2 cup peanut oil | 1 envelope taco seasoning ( taco bell taco seasoning mix is my favorite ) | 1 lime, juice of | mint, fresh ( optional ) | 1 avocado, diced ( optional ) ( optional )
instructions: Place lentils in a large pot and bring to a boil, boil for about 15 minutes or until most of the water cooks away. Drain, set aside and let cool. In a large bowl, mix the lentils with oil, taco seasoning, lime juice and mint. Serve with the avocado if desired.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke flavoring,red chili powder,bean,pepper sauce,beef tenderloin,vodka
title: Hot V8
ingredients: 1 beef tenderloin | 1/4 cup liquid smoke flavoring | 1 bottle red chili powder | 3 -5 drops hot pepper sauce ( i use tabasco or equivalent brand ) | 1/4 cup vodka | 1 can refried beans ( optional )
instructions: Rub meat with oil, using whatever kind of seasoning you prefer. Place meat in a plastic baggie, and add all other ingredients except the refried beans.

title: Easy Marinated Aubergines
ingredients: 2 large aubergines | 1/4 cup catsup | 1 1/2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce
instructions: Slice each aubergine in half lengthwise, about 1/2 inch thick. Arrange half the aubergine halves in a single layer in a baking dish coated with cooking spray. Combine catsup, worcestershire sauce and half the sauce mixture. Pour over the aubergines.. Cover. Bake at 350 f. For 1 hour or until tender, basting occasionally with remaining sauce. Serve warm or cold.

title: Broccoli Bruschetta
ingredients: 3/4 lb fresh broccoli floret | 3/4 cup dry red wine | 8 slices baguette, day-old bread
instructions: Preheat broiler. Cut baguette in half lengthwise and cut diagonally to make 2 1/2 inch slices, 1/2 inch thick. Spray a jelly roll pan with pam or misthe. Arrange bread on pan and broil 5 minutes, or until slightly charred. Turn bread over. Spread 1/4 cup red wine on each of 4 bread slices. Scoop out broccoli, place on a plate, sprinkle with 1/3 cup red wine, and broil until crisp and browned, about 5 minutes, turning once. Serve immediately. Repeat with remaining butter and red wine, or keep warm until ready to serve.

title: Plantain Ham Hock With Sourdough Starter
ingredients: 1 lb plantain ( yellow plantains ) | 2 ham hocks | 1 cup sourdough starter | 2 cups skim milk | 2 teaspoons sunflower seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Wash plantains and cut into 3/4 chunks. Place in a bowl of cold water and soak until tender.. Remove peel and slice into 1/4 inch slices. Remove fat and any excess moisture from the meat and discard. Place meat in a large skillet with a pinch of salt and two pinches of pepper. Fry on all four sides. Transfer to oven and bake for about 40 minutes, turning once, until nicely browned and crisp on the top. Cool and grind with a cheese grater or mortar and pestle until smooth. Remove meat from skillet and strain the fat.

title: Greek Shredded Beef for Dip in a Bowl
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb shaved deli roast beef | 12 kalamata olives, drained and finely chopped | 1/2 cup brown sugar
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours or overnight. Serve over crudites or as a topping for a pita.

Random Ingredients: white cheddar cheese,hard egg,red wine vinegar,plain yogurt,breadcrumb,yellow cherry tomato,kahlua
title: Fiery Cheddar Souffle
ingredients: 2 hard-boiled eggs, peeled quartered | 2 tablespoons plain yogurt ( or sour cream ) | 1 tablespoon kahlua ( or your favourite sweet coffee ) | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 1/3 cup grated yellow cherry tomato | 4 slices white cheddar cheese ( or a combination of mozzarella and red pepper if you wish ) | 1 crusty bread, cut into 4 pieces, toasted ( optional )
instructions: Place the eggs into a small saucepan, cover with cold water, and bring to a boil over high heat. Cover and remove from the heat. Let sit for 5 minutes, then drain in a sieve set over a bowl. Cover with cold water and set aside. In a small bowl, whisk together the yogurt, kahlua, red wine vinegar, and cherry tomatoes. Set aside. Preheat the oven to 400°f/200°c. Place the eggs onto a baking tray in a single layer and bake for 10 minutes, just until just set. To serve, place the cooked eggs on a serving platter or bowl, cover loosely with foil. Set aside for 5 minutes. Remove the foil, then spoon the yogurt mixture over the top. Serve immediately with toasted bread pieces for a mopping up. Enjoy.

title: Rhubarb and Garlic Shrimp Chip-And-Bake
ingredients: 1 lb medium shrimp, peeled, deveined, and butterflied | 1 small head garlic, outer layer reserved for later use | 2 medium sized baking potatoes, peeled and sliced | 1 medium head of garlic, outer layer reserved for later use, reserved for later use | 1 1/2 cups coriander seeds, lightly crushed | 3 large baking potatoes, peeled and quartered | 1 large head of garlic, outer layer reserved for later use | 2 cups peeled whole rhubarb, ends trimmed | 1/4 cup fresh coriander, chopped | tortilla chips, for serving
instructions: Pre heat oven to 425°f. In the bottom of a roasting pan arrange 1/2 the potato slices overlapping in a thin lattice pattern around the outer edge of the pan. Sprinkle salt onto peeled garlic cloves. In a blender, process 2 cups of the coriander with the potato slices. Using a slotted spoon, place 1/2 of the tomato sauce from the second tomato sauce in the pan along with the shrimp paste mixture. Add the remaining 3 cups of canned tomato sauce along with the coriander and potato. Combine thoroughly. Spoon half of the shrimp mixture on top of potato slices on the tomato and shrimp mixture in the pan. Layer 2 cloves of garlic on top of the shrimp mixture. Place remaining potato slices over shrimp mixture and scatter with coriander seeds. Cover with remaining shrimp mixture in the pan. Place roasting pan under oven for 35 - 40 minutes or until shrimp are cooked and potatoes are tender. Remove from oven and cool for 15 minutes. Slice, serve and garnish with coriander and/or chopped fresh coriander.

title: Battered Fish With Pumpkin Toppings
ingredients: 2 large butternut squash | 1 medium size butternut squash | 1 bag frozen chickpea flour | 1/2 lb cooked ham | 3 tablespoons masala
instructions: Wash and scrub the butternut squash and butternut squash and split them into two chunks. Cut 1/4 from the top of each chunk to remove seeds. Put the butternut squash and butternut squash chunks in the crockpot and dump on about 2/3 cup of water. Cook on low 8 to 10 hours, then cook on high 5 to 10 hours. When ready to serve, remove the mashed butternut squash, butternut squash chunks and ham from the crockpot and mash until smooth. Stir 1 tablespoon of masala into the mashed mixture until coated. Sprinkle the rest of the masala on top. Serve with hearty biscuits, toast, or toast points.

title: Couscous and Pickles
ingredients: 3/4 cup instant couscous | 1 tablespoon instant onion soup mix | 1 tablespoon ketchup | 1 teaspoon icing | 1/2 cup icing ( optional )
instructions: Put your couscous in a serving bowl. Stir together the rest of the ingredients, mixing well.

Random Ingredients: tahini paste,self rising flour,artichoke heart,fenugreek seed,vegetable broth,lime zest,pearl barley,poblano pepper
title: Artichoke Pearl Barley Sopa
ingredients: 1/2 cup pearl barley, uncooked | 2 cups vegetable broth | 2/3 cup tahini paste | 1 cup finely chopped poblano pepper | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh fenugreek seeds | 2 pieces lime zest, or more to taste | 2 cans artichoke hearts, drained ( optional ) | 2 cups self-rising flour, or as needed
instructions: Bring the barley and vegetable broth to a boil in a pot. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until the barley is tender, 15 to 20 minutes, about 20 minutes. Transfer the barley to a fine mesh strainer, and repeat two more times, mashing or forcing the barley with your hands. Stir the drained barley into the softened soup, and bring the soup back to a simmer. Mix 1 tz. Of the tahini into the soup, and stir in poblano, fenugreek leaves, lime zest, artichokes, and barley. Continue simmering, stirring frequently, until the barley is very tender and the soup has thickened, about 1 1/2 hours, 10 minutes more. Taste the soup, and adjust seasonings with salt and pepper if necessary. Serve hot.

title: Rice Ramen
ingredients: 6 large frozen pound noodles | 3 cups finely shredded romaine lettuce | 1 package fresh rice stick
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Bring a small pan of lightly salted water to boil. Add the ramen noodles and cook according to package instructions. Drain well and cut noodles in the bowl in half. Place noodles in a shallow baking dish, piling them high. Drizzle each noodle with shoyu and sprinkle with lettuce. Re wrap dish and bake in preheated oven for 10 minutes. Turn onto serving plate and serve.

title: Melt-Over-The-Pot
ingredients: 600 g dark chocolate, grated | 4 shallots or 2 onions, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon kaffir lime leaf ( optional )
instructions: Heat the chocolate and shallots in a pan, until melted and smooth, around 5 - 10 minutes, depending on the heat of the chocolate. Remove from the heat and stir into the melted chocolate until smooth. Place in a bowl and leave for 2 - 3 hours, until cool. Stir occasionally to prevent melting. Strain the chocolate through a fine sieve lined with 2 layers of saran. Place in a dry, clean and airtight container and leave to set before use.

title: Couscous With Beets
ingredients: 2 medium beets | 2 tablespoons oil | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried italian seasoning | 1 1/4 cups couscous
instructions: Cut beets in half crosswise and slice into cubes. Cook cubes in oil in 10 inch skillet over medium high heat until lightly browned, stirring occasionally. Add soup, italian seasoning and peas. Reduce heat.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,balsamic vinegar,taco seasoning,cherry tomato,red chili pepper,macaroni
title: Mexican Macaroni and Tomatoes
ingredients: 8 ounces macaroni | 1 envelope taco seasoning | 3 1/2 cups cherry tomatoes | 2 teaspoons garlic powder | 1 1/2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 red chili pepper, very finely sliced
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions. Drain well and then toss with taco seasoning, cherry tomatoes, garlic powder and balsamic vinegar. Cover and refrigerate while the salad heats up. Garnish with a few slices of red chili pepper.

Random Ingredients: meat,chili bean paste,kidney bean,cumin seed,citron peel,wonton wrapper
title: Shami Chili Dogs
ingredients: 1 cup smoked meat, finely minced or 2 tablespoons lean hamburger | 2 teaspoons cumin seeds | 1/2 teaspoon dried chermoula chili bean paste | 1 can kidney beans, rinsed, drained | 3 tablespoons finely shredded citron peel | 1 package wonton wrappers
instructions: Preheat broiler. In a small skillet, toast cumminess. In another small skillet, cook meats until brown and crumbly. Drain in a colander, rinse with cold water and blot dry. Mix all ingredients except wrappers in a large bowl until well blended. Scoop about 2 tablespoons filling into the center of each wrappers. Moisten edges and fold over. Press edges together. Arrange on a baking sheet lined with foil. Bake in a preheated oven until golden, about 15 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Simple Beef and Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs cubed beef stew meat | 3 tablespoons oil | 1/8 teaspoon cardamom | 1 teaspoon onion salt ( go ahead ) | 3 cups uncooked basmati rice
instructions: Put all in a crockpot. Cook on low for 8 - 10 hours, or on high for 5 to 6 hours.

title: Fruit Butter for Frying
ingredients: 3 cups chopped fresh raspberries | 1 cup margarine, room temperature
instructions: Stir the raspberries with 1/2 cup water. Heat the margarine and water until it forms a smooth paste. Stir the hot mixture into the raspberries and simmer, stirring, for 2 minutes. Remove from heat, cool, and transfer to an airtight container.

title: Quick Onion Crust Cherry Salad
ingredients: 1 can prepared onion soup mix | 2 bags frozen pitted cherries, thawed | 1/4 cup chili powder | 1 package frozen crust topping, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Combine unprepared onion soup mix and cherries in a mixing bowl. Stir in chili powder. Spread a layer of crust topping over the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Spoon mixture over dough, and top with more pie crust. Bake in the preheated oven 30 to 35 minutes, until top is golden brown.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,cardamom pod,coconut oil,taco seasoning,anaheim chilies
title: Anaheim Coconut Curry Sauce
ingredients: 2 anaheim chilies, seeded and thinly sliced ( about 6 ounces ) | 1/2 cup light brown sugar | 1 1/2 cups coconut oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons taco seasoning | 2 cardamom pods, crushed
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Combine the chiles, brown sugar, oil, taco seasoning, and cardamom in a saucepan over medium low heat and cook, stirring occasionally, until bubbling and reduced, about 10 minutes. The sauce should be thick and the chile pieces should still be hot. The mixture should not burn but give off a nice sweet smell, not too strong. Transfer to a blender and puree until completely smooth. Set aside to cool. Use to season any dish that goes well with a coconut curry.

Random Ingredients: cremini mushroom,pork rib,monterey jack cheese,asparagus,jalapeno pepper
title: Jalapeno Pork Ribs
ingredients: 1 can or bottle beer | 2 pounds country style pork ribs, cut into pieces | 1 pound cremini mushrooms, sliced | 2 heads fresh asparagus, trimmed and ends cut into pieces | 1 jar jalapeno peppers, rinsed and sliced
instructions: Combine beer and pork in a large bowl. Cover, and refrigerate overnight. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange ribs in a large bowl. Pour beer over the ribs, and mix in cremini mushrooms, asparagus, and jalapeno slices. Cover, and refrigerate overnight. Lay the remaining 2 chops of pork onto a plate, and place into a baking dish. Pour marinade over everything. Cover, and refrigerate at least overnight. Bake in the preheated oven for 2 hours, basting every so often. Be sure to use a disposable foil pan, or any that will not stick to the oven.

title: Chocolate and Coffee Nougat
ingredients: 250 g dark chocolate | 250 ml strong coffee beans or 250 ml coffee beans, very hot | 1 -2 cup dates, finely chopped | 1 cup dates, finely chopped
instructions: Crush the choc and set aside in a heat proof bowl. Break the chocolate and cut out pieces about the size of a walnut. Mix with the coffee or coffee beans. Chop some sunflower seeds or other nuts as suggested in comments at the end of the recipe. Add the chocolate and stir until completely mixed. Chill until set serve with whipped cream. Makes about 2 cups.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,lemon peel,red capsicum,sea salt,shiitake mushroom
title: Mushroom Capsicum & Cardamom Sauteed on Australian Thyme Skewers
ingredients: 1 large red capsicum, cut into 1cm dice | 8 large shiitake mushrooms, stems removed, caps cut into 1cm dice | 120 g crystallized lemons or 120 g candied ginger, chopped coarsely | 1 pinch cardamom seed | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Grill or bbq pepper until charred. Drain on absorbent paper to leave a clear film on the surface for no longer any time. Coat capsicum with cooking oil and grill or bbq until golden and soft. Turn capsicum after 5 - 6 minutes and spread on absorbent paper to cool. Place capsicum, zucchini, capsicum, and candied ginger on serving plate. Sprinkle with cardamom and sea salt and serve with fresh salad and a green salad or salad dressing if you like.

title: Hague Bouillon for Meat
ingredients: 1/4 cup sugar | 1 beef bouillon cube
instructions: Mix sugar and bouillon in a glass or heavy pan. Bring to a boil and turn down to simmer. Simmer until bouillon thickens, about 1 hour. Strain the broth and use as directed.

title: Apple Tarts
ingredients: 3 tart apples | 1/2 cup sliced blanched almonds
instructions: Peel apples and slice thin. Sprinkle with almonds and toss lightly. Place tart shells on cookie sheet and bake at 375 degrees until lightly browned, about 20 - 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,lemon zest,hazelnut,beef roast,chinese wine,dill
title: Beef Roast With Chinese Wine (Chaw Gee)
ingredients: 4 lbs boneless beef roast | 1 1/2 cups chinese wine | 1/4 cup fresh dill, chopped | 1/2 cup hazelnuts, toasted | 2/3 cup long-grain white rice, washed and drained | juice 1 tablespoon lemon zest
instructions: Place the beef roast in a deep, heavy ovenproof pot. Stir the wine, dill, and hazelnuts just until coated with the wine. Cover the roast with an inverted roasting pan. Place the roasting pan on its side over a burner set to moderately low, and cook the beef, uncovered, about 4 hours, basting occasionally with the pan juices. About 1 hour before the roast is done, sprinkle the rice with water and bring it to a boil. Cover, lower the heat, and simmer for 15 - 17 minutes, or until the rice is tender. Remove the roast and turn off the heat. Let it rest on it's back rack for about 15 minutes. Using two forks, shred the meat into thin strips about 1/4 to 1/2 inch wide and 1 to 1 1/2 inches long.

Random Ingredients: black vinegar,dark soy sauce,parmesan cheese,asparagus,liquid smoke
title: Asparagus and Asparagus Salad
ingredients: 1 lb asparagus | 1/2 cup dark soy sauce | 1/4 - 1/2 cup black vinegar | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke ( to taste ) | 1/2 cup parmesan cheese ( to sprinkle on top )
instructions: Wash the asparagus and snap off the tough ends. Then place in a large bowl. Cut off the tips of the asparagus leaving a 1/4 to 1/2 inch section. Cut the tips into 1 1/2 to 1 1/2 inch lengths with scissors. Add the asparagus to the bowl and toss to coat with soy sauce, then sprinkle with dark soy sauce and black vinegar, liquid smoke and cheese. Stir to mix and cover with a lid or plastic wrap. Chill well before serving, or refrigerate up to a few hours. Variation, in a large bowl mix 1/3 cup of freshly grated parmesan cheese with 1/3 cup of finely grated parmesan cheese or mix with 1 1/4 cups of plain greek yogurt, 1/3 cup of chopped or 1/3 cup chopped spinach, 1/4 cup chopped red onion and 2 tablespoons of drained canned tomato.

title: Larb Salatasi (Green Olives With Kaffir Lime)
ingredients: 1 lb mixed green and olive salad | 2 cups vegetable oil | 1/2 cup kaffir lime leaf, thinly sliced
instructions: Pour the oil through a sieve into a wide saucepan. Discard the pulp from the kaffir lime leaves. Slice the olives in half crosswise, remove the ribs and seeds. Heat the oil over medium heat until almost smoking. Add the kaffir lime leaves. Remove from heat and pour over the greens and toss to coat. Allow to cool for 10 minutes, then serve.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,new potato,eye roast,black olive,mustard green,chunky salsa,black mustard seed
title: Roast Beef Wraps
ingredients: 2 -3 eye of round roast | 1 can black olives | 1 jar chunky salsa ( good quality ) | 1 jar mustard greens | 8 ounces gruyere cheese | 1 jar sliced black olives | 1 jar medium chunky salsa | 1 tablespoon mustard greens, chopped ( optional ) | 2 cups coarsely grated gruyere cheese | 12 -18 ounces new potatoes, small, boiled, peeled and quartered
instructions: Place beef between 2 sheets of plastic wrap and pound to 1/2 inch thickness. Lay each one on a board that has been dusted with cornmeal. Using the flat side of a meat mallet, or a rolling pin, pound the entire piece of meat until all of the meat is lifted off the board. The fat may be drained from the beef during this step. Spread 1/4 1/2 cup salsa on each piece of meat. Sprinkle cheese and sliced black olives on top of each layer of meat. Wrap tightly in plastic wrap and refrigerate until ready to serve. Drain olives and place in a jar with the remaining salsa and mustard greens until ready to serve. Drain the beef well and then add to the salad. Serve with crusty sourdough bread.

title: Zucchini Ribbons
ingredients: 1 lb zucchini, cut into halves lengthwise | 1 teaspoon golden syrup | 1 teaspoon vodka | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 teaspoon ghee ( clarified butter ) or 1 teaspoon butter ( clarified butter )
instructions: Fry all of the ingredients until the zucchini turns into ribbons. Remove from pan. Fry, stirring occasionally, for 2 to 4 minutes until the zucchini is lightly golded. Serve immediately.

title: Italian Parsley Vinaigrette
ingredients: 3 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh italian parsley
instructions: Combine vinegar and parsley in a small bowl and let stand 10 minutes. Add dressing to dressing and toss until blended.

Random Ingredients: pimiento,vegetable broth,asparagus,baby spinach,spinach leaf,tamarind paste,vermouth,extra virgin olive oil
title: Green Beans, Spinach, and Tamarind Soup
ingredients: 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 12 ounces fresh asparagus, cut crosswise into 1/4-inch slices | 8 cups vegetable broth ( or more ) | 2 tablespoons tamarind paste | 1/2 cup dry vermouth | 2 bags fresh baby spinach leaves | 1/2 jar sliced pimientos, cut into small pieces | 1/2 teaspoon chopped fresh spinach,, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: In a soup pot, heat oil over medium heat. Add asparagus and cook until lightly golden 2 - 4 minutes. Add broth, tamarind paste, vermouth, and enough water to cover the asparagus.

title: Colcannon
ingredients: 1 head savoy cabbage | 1 1/2 lbs deli ham ( or ham or turkey ) | 3/4 lb polish onion, peeled
instructions: Clean cabbage, remove head and leave in large pot. Cut meat into cubes ¼ thick slices. Boil ham and onion until meats are done. Remove meat and onions from heat. Add meat and onion to the cabbage. Boil 2 - 3 minutes. Drain cabbage. Serve cabbage in pita bread with lettuce, tomato, and other toppings.

title: Grape Onion Rings
ingredients: 2 lbs small red potatoes | 1/2 lb fresh small grape, or 2/3 lb winter grapes, halved | 1 ounce port wine | 1/2 cup whole wheat flour
instructions: Boil unpeeled potatoes in their skins until very tender, about 30 minutes. Drain and immediately return potatoes to cold water.

Random Ingredients: orange juice,peanut,sherry vinegar,brown lentil,green enchilada sauce
title: Green Lentils Yummiles (Cooking Light)
ingredients: 1 cup brown lentils ( approx. 50oz package ) | 1 cup green enchilada sauce ( use mild or medium ) | 3 tablespoons brown sherry vinegar | 3 tablespoons orange juice | 3 tablespoons dry roasted peanuts ( to garnish )
instructions: Cook the lentils in boiling water according to package instructions, about 20 - 30 minutes, until tender but still firm to bite. Drain and set aside to cool. When cool, run under cold water to clean. Peel the husk on the lentils and transfer to a small bowl. Cut off all of the ends of the enchilada sauce in half and scoop out a portion. Place half the enchilada sauce in a heat proof serving dish and top with half the cooked lentils. Spoon on half the remaining enchilada sauce and spread out evenly. Repeat with the remaining lentils and enchilada sauce. Garnish with the peanuts, if desired. Bring to room temperature, then chill 1 - 2 hours before serving. Store in refrigerator until ready to use. Note, prep time does not include chilling time.

title: Creamy Beef Broth
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese | 2 cans condensed beef broth
instructions: In a large saucepan over low heat, or in a microwave safe bowl, melt the cream cheese together. Stir in the beef broth and heat until thoroughly mixed. Refrigerate overnight.

Random Ingredients: sage leaf,almond meal,italian sausage,palm sugar,white wine vinegar,garlic chive,tamari,philadelphia cream cheese
title: Homemade Tamari Cheese Spread
ingredients: 2 packages philadelphia cream cheese | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar, distilled | 1 cup almond meal | 4 tablespoons paprika | 1/4 cup minced fresh sage leaf | 1/4 cup minced garlic chives | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 2 lbs italian sausages, casing removed | 2/3 cup browned, unsalted almonds or 2/3 cup chopped cashews
instructions: In food processor or blender, blend cream cheese, 1/4 cup white wine vinegar, almond meal, paprika, sage and garlic chives until smooth. Spread the mixture in a greased 13 x 9 inch baking pan. Bake until light golden brown and bubbly, about 40 - 45 minutes at cool 15 minutes. Cut sausages crosswise into 1/4 inch slices. Coat pan with cooking spray. Bring sauce to a simmer in a 2 quart saucepan over medium heat. Reduce heat to medium low, add sausages to sauce and simmer 3 minutes until cooked through. Pour hot sauce over sausage, sprinkle with almonds and remaining 1/4 cup white wine vinegar. Cover and simmer 10 minutes, stirring several times. Store tightly covered at room temperature for up to 3 days at room temperature.

title: Quick and Easy Mexican Beef Enchilladas
ingredients: 12 corn tortillas | 1 package cream of mushroom soup | 1 can tomato puree | 2 cans seasoned diced onion
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In a large bowl, mix together the mushroom soup, tomato puree and the enchillada mix. Lightly grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. Set aside. Fill each tortilla with 2 tablespoons of the mushroom soup mixture to the edge of the tortilla. Roll and place on the tomato puree side of the filled tortilla. Roll the tortillas up to enclose the filling. Repeat with the remaining tortillas. Arrange the enchiladas in the baking dish. Pour remaining sauce over the enchiladas. Cover with aluminum foil and bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour. Remove foil halfway through the cooking time, sprinkle chopped cilantro on top and let stand for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Blueberry and Spanish Onions
ingredients: 2 large spanish onions | 10 cups fresh berries | 2 cups ketchup | 2 cups red wine | 6 eggs, lightly beaten
instructions: Peel onions, cut into large wedges, and slice in half. Place onions in a saucepan, cover with water, and add enough extra cold water to cover onions by 1 inch. Bring to a boil and boil for 10 minutes. Drain. Place in a large mixing bowl and pour liquid mixture over the onions. Refrigerate overnight. Remove onions from liquid and place in a covered container tightly. Refrigerate at least 4 hours or over night. Turn in the oven to 400 degrees. Lightly grease a round cake pan. Place an inverted bowl of hot water on the bottom, on the side with the ketchup. Beat eggs and beat into the reserved cooking liquid. Spread ketchup mixture in the bottom of the cake pan until it reaches the top of the pan. Arrange the onions over the ketchup, then place in the preheated oven. Bake 30 - 45 minutes, or until very lightly browned. Reduce heat to 300 degrees, and continue cooking until desired degree of doneness. Serve hot, warm or room temperature.

Random Ingredients: banana,sage leaf,mushroom soup,green cardamom pod,pork loin,hot chili sauce,beef sirloin steak
title: Tandoori Pork Chops & Mushroom Soup
ingredients: 10 ounces beef sirloin steaks, cut into 2 x 1/2 cm chunks | 15 ml mushroom soup | 1 slice banana | 2 pieces dried paprika green cardamom pods, crushed | 1 dash hot chili sauce | 5 ml sage leaves | 5 ml hot chili sauce | 1 small hot chili paste from a bird or 1 small hot chili pepper, finely chopped
instructions: Place the pork chops in a large saucepan, cover with water and simmer for 5 min or until tender. Drain. To the pork, stir in the mushroom soup, banana, paprika, cardamom pods, chili sauce, sage leaves and chili sauce. Bring to the boil and simmer for 2 - 3 mins or until the pork is cooked through. Stir in the chilie. Serve with plain boiled rice.

title: Easy Onion and Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup diced brown onion | 1/3 cup picante sauce | 1 teaspoon packed dark brown sugar
instructions: Mix all ingredients until well combined and chill.

Random Ingredients: half cream,tomato basil pasta sauce,graham cracker crumb
title: Gran's Simple Homemade Alfredo
ingredients: 3 cups half-and-half cream | 1 package uncooked tub-style graham cracker crumbs | 1 jar tomato-basil pasta sauce, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Whisk half and half cream and graham crackers in a small bowl. Spread in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Spread 1/2 the cooked alfredo sauce over the cracker mixture in the baking dish. Evenly spread remaining alfredo sauce over the sauce.

title: Tacos (Beef)
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef | 3 tablespoons asadobo seasoning
instructions: Cut stewing beef into thin slices and sprinkle with the asadobo seasoning. Cover and fry in oil until well browned on all sides.

title: Beef N' Sausage With Stoplight
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, cut into cubes | 1 can old el paso chunky salsa | 2 cans sliced tart apples | 1 packet stifos n quick cook lasagna noodles | 1/2 teaspoon cumin | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1/2 cup thawed frozen peas & carrots
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 deg. Combine beef, salsa, and apples in a large dutch oven. Spread in a single layer on a 13x9x2 casserole dish. Bake at 350 deg. For 2 hours. Meanwhile cook lasagna according to directions. Drain and set aside. Cover noodles with boiling water and boil until al dente. Drain, then toss with a couple tablespoons of the bean. Chill, uncovered,. Toss with remaining bean mixture. Spread over noodles. Top with peas and carrots. Bake at 350 deg. For 15 minutes or until heated through. Remove from oven. Serve.

title: Clementine and Smoked Sausage Stew
ingredients: 8 ounces smoked kielbasa sausage, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 quart clementine, peeled | 1/3 cup sliced fresh serrano peppers or 1/3 cup green bell pepper | 1 tablespoon sliced bottled roasted seaweed ( optional )
instructions: In a large skillet over medium high heat, cook sausage, stirring to crumble, until meat is browned. Remove sausage from skillet. Add clementine, serrano peppers, and the sausage and pepper mixture to skillet. Cover, and simmer for 10 minutes, or until the clementine is tender. Drain solids from skillet and discard. Serve over stew with seaweed, if desired. Variation, use 3/4 pound of smoked sausage, sliced thinly against the grain. Add 3/4 pound or more of smoked sausage and sliced peppers in with sausage.

title: Peking Borseradish Coleslaw
ingredients: 1 bag coleslaw mix | 1 cup grated manchego cheese or 1 cup monterey jack cheese | 1 small beet, peeled and shredded | 1/2 teaspoon horseradish
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl. Chill in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,cherry tomato,lemon wedge,deep frying oil,kaffir lime leaf,quinoa
title: Kaffir Lime and Quinoa Salad
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups water packed quinoa | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 lemon wedge | 4 cherry tomatoes, halved | 2 kaffir lime leaves | 1/2 cup canola oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons deep frying oil
instructions: Mix quinoa and canola oil in a bowl. Sprinkle lemon wedge, cherry tomatoes, lime leaves, 1/2 cup of oil and kaffir lime leaves on top. Refrigerate 30 minutes.

title: Meatball and Spinach Balls
ingredients: 2 pounds meatballs | 1/3 cup bread crumbs | 1/4 cup garam masala | 1/4 cup melted ( rice butter ) oil | 1 package frozen mixed baby spinach, thawed | 1/8 teaspoon turmeric | 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 teaspoon oil for frying
instructions: Place meatballs in a large resealable plastic bag, and add bread crumbs, garam masala, melted oil, and spinach. Pound until the mixture has the consistency of ground pork. Add turmeric, nutmeg, and salt to taste. Squeeze out excess air, and seal. Marinate in the refrigerator at least 1 hour. Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat. Brown the meatballs in the hot oil. Add the stuffing to the meatballs, and cook a few minutes more. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: dark red kidney bean,wishbone italian dressing,oregano leaf,fig,baby bok choy,parsley,green bean
title: Italian Fig and Olive Salad
ingredients: 1 package baby bok choy, trimmed | 1 can dark red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 2 tablespoons wishbone italian dressing | 1/2 lb fresh fig, halved, chopped | 1/2 lb fresh green beans, trimmed, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 2 tablespoons fresh snipped parsley | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: In large bowl, toss salad greens with dressing. Divide evenly among 4 plates.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,tomato paste,cocoa powder,green bean,creole seasoning,vodka,jalapeno powder,teriyaki sauce
title: Creole Green Beans
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vodka | 1 can green beans, drained | 1 -2 tablespoon canned green chilies ( with or without seeds ) | 4 -6 ounces tomato paste ( one big can ) | 1 teaspoon creole seasoning ( original recipe called for a 1/2 tsp ) | 1 teaspoon jalapeno powder ( original recipe called for a 1/2 tsp ) | 2 teaspoons green chilies ( from a jar ) | 2 teaspoons teriyaki sauce | 1/4 - 1/2 cup cocoa powder
instructions: Combine all ingridients except cocoa powder. In a 2 to 3 qt sauce pot stir over moderate heat until boiling. Reduce heat to low and simmer until sauce thickens to desired consistency about 5 minutes. Stir in cocoa powder. Pour bean into serving dish lined with plastic wrap and chill before serving.

Random Ingredients: italian salad dressing mix,cauliflower floret,red wine vinegar,tomato juice,black pepper,ketchup,allspice,marjoram
title: Roasted Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower florets | 1 can stewed tomatoes with juice | 1/4 cup ketchup ( or to taste ) | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 1/4 cup italian salad dressing mix | 1 teaspoon oregano or 1 teaspoon marjoram | 1/2 teaspoon allspice | black pepper ( to taste ) | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place cauliflower in lightly oiled roasting pan. Combine all other ingredients into bowl. Pour mixture over cauliflower and toss to coat. Pour about 1 tablespoon of the tomato juice into a shallow casserole dish. Sprinkle the cauliflower with black pepper. Bake uncovered about 40 minutes or until cauliflower is slightly tender.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,lettuce,vegetable oil cooking spray,sumac,garlic salt,ham,espresso
title: Shredded Italian String Beans
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh string bean, string trimmed and cut into 1-inch lengths | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 slices ham, 1/3-inch dice | 1/4 teaspoon ground sumac | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh italian parsley | 1/4 cup freshly brewed espresso or 1/4 cup cold water | 1/2 - 3/4 cup shredded lettuce
instructions: Combine the first five ingredients in a large bowl and let stand 10 minutes. Rinse bean mixture under cold running water until no longer cloudy.

title: Crock Pot Chickpeas and Pork Chops
ingredients: 2 cans chickpeas, drained | 2 center cut pork chops, 1/2 inch thick
instructions: Pour chick peas into slow cooker. Cut pork chops crosswise into 3 pieces. Place the chops on top of the chick peas. Add enough water to cover all ingredients. Cover and cook on low setting 7 - 8 hours.

Random Ingredients: greek oregano,turkey meat,kosher salt black pepper,blueberry,macaroon
title: Roasted Turkey With Blueberries and Macaroon
ingredients: 2 tablespoons greek oregano, dried | 2 turkey meat, about 1 pound | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 2 cups fresh blueberries | 4 macaroon ( mini cookies )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f in a 2 quart pan or skillet, heat the dried oregano over medium heat. Rub the dried oregano lightly over the turkey, then brown the turkey in a large ovenproof skillet that has a lid. Season lightly with salt and pepper. Arrange the blueberries close beside the turkey. Add the macaroon, drizzle generously with olive oil, and stir to coat the entire dish. Cover the pan and cook for about 20 minutes, until the blueberries begin to wilt. Remove the cover, increase the heat to 350°f, and cook an additional 10 to 15 minutes, until the cranberries begin to release their juices. Remove from the heat, stir to combine, cover, and set aside. Uncover the pan, drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with the remaining oregano.

Random Ingredients: salsa,navy bean,vegetable broth,orange zest,sharp cheddar cheese,jicama,red potato
title: Mexican Potato & Bean Stew
ingredients: 2 cups dry navy beans, cooked | 4 red potatoes, cut into 1/2-inch dice | 1 cup navy beans, cooked | 1 cup diced cooked jicama | 1/2 cup vegetable broth | 3/4 cup mild salsa ( medium ) | 1 tablespoon fresh orange zest, grated | 1/2 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the dry beans, potatoes and jicama. Stir in the broth, salsa and orange zest.

title: Jeera Rice Point Cookies
ingredients: 1/2 cup sugar | 1 teaspoon ground cumin, or to taste | 1 teaspoon white sugar | 1/3 cup ice, finely crushed | 1/3 cup jasmine rice | 1 teaspoon lime ( optional )
instructions: Stir 1/2 cup sugar, cumin, and white sugar together in a small bowl. Cover bowl with plastic wrap until the mixture firms up, about 20 minutes. Press ice into a small bowl. Stir rice, lime peel, and lime juice together in the rice bowl.

title: Garnish - Prune Jam - Microwave
ingredients: 1/2 kg pitted prunes, such as red chilies, such as chanterelles, skins removed ( about 20 prunes ) | lime wedge ( optional )
instructions: Process the prunes in a microwave safe bowl until almost smooth. Spoon into hot sterilized jars, leaving 1/4 to 1/3 inch headspace. Cover and cook on full power for 8 minutes, stirring once or twice. Check that water remains clear if prunes are cooked. Remove and discard headspace and stir. Serve over your favourite jam, spooning into small jars once or twice.

Random Ingredients: mexican oregano,red jalapeno chile,chinese five spice powder,fettuccine,rose water,canadian bacon,spring onion,cocoa
title: Spicy Mexican Fettuccine With Canadian Bacon
ingredients: 1/2 lb canadian bacon | 2 teaspoons chinese five spice powder | 1 teaspoon dried mexican oregano | 1 tablespoon rose water | 1 red jalapeno chile, minced and seeded | 4 spring onions, minced | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa | 1 lb fettuccine ( fresh, uncooked, about 4 cups )
instructions: Cut bacon into 1 inch pieces.

title: Star Anise Pecan Pesto
ingredients: 1 cup pecans | 1 pint parmesan cheese | 2 cups ground sesame oil | 4 star anise, whole pods | 2 garlic salt
instructions: Blend all ingridients well. Let stand 1 hour, stirring frequently. Strain through cheesecloth lined strainer. Let cool completely, then refrigerate.

title: Mandarin Oranges (Low Fat)
ingredients: 4 mandarin oranges, peeled and segmented | 8 scallions, diced ( green onion ) | 1/2 cup reduced fat feta cheese ( smart balance )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Arrange scallions on a platter and top with mandarin oranges. Sprinkle with the feta cheese.

title: Quick and Easy Creamy Dill
ingredients: 2 cans cream of chicken soup | 1/4 cup ghee | 1 teaspoon mustard | 1 teaspoon mustard | 1 teaspoon annatto seeds | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme leaves
instructions: Put all ingredients in a blender or food processor and blend for several seconds. Serve with toasted french rolls or pita bread.

title: Tuna Macadamia Nuts
ingredients: 1 can tuna | 3 tablespoons butter or 3 tablespoons margarine, softened | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 1/2 cup macadamia nuts, finely chopped | 1/2 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | 2 teaspoons instant coffee | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seed, crushed | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning
instructions: Drain tuna.

Random Ingredients: vanilla ice cream,ice water,spicy pork sausage,black olive,meatball,applesauce,caster sugar,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Meatballs With Black Olives-Pork Sausage
ingredients: 600 g fresh meatballs | 1/4 cup ice water | 3 tablespoons mackerelspice-coated spicy pork sausage, shredded | 600 g caster sugar, for sprinkling | 600 ml applesauce | vanilla ice cream | grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Line the base of an 18cm x 18cm lamington mould with foil. Preheat oven to 200°c. Lightly spray with oil. In a large bowl, combine the meatballs, ice water and mackerelspice powder and mix well. Place 1/3 of the meatballs in the mould and sprinkle with half the sugar. Top with meatballs, the remaining sugar and half the applesauce. Cover with the rest of the meatballs. Cover with foil and bake for 2 1/2 hours, or until meatballs are cooked through and sauce is thickened and syrupy. Serve with a scoop of ice cream and grated parmigiana reggiano cheese.

title: Grown Ups Sour Cream Dressing
ingredients: 8 ounces sour cream | 1/3 cup molasses | 4 teaspoons dijon mustard | 4 teaspoons yellow mustard | 2 teaspoons minced candied orange rind | 2 teaspoons minced oranges, peel
instructions: Combine sour cream, molasses, dijon, yellow mustard, orange peel, and oranges.

title: Italian Black Beans in Chocolate
ingredients: 1 can black beans | 1 cup enchilada sauce | 1/4 cup kahlua | 1/2 teaspoon cocoa powder | 1 container frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Drain and wash black beans. Pour 1/4 cup enchilada sauce and 1/4 cup kahlua into a saucepan with a tight fitting lid. Stir the beans and sauce together and allow to warm. Stir the remaining enchilada sauce, cocoa powder and whipped topping into the bean mixture until smooth. Pour into a serving dish, cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Grilled Beef on Chickpeas - Steak for 2
ingredients: 400 g chickpeas, drained | 4 slices steak
instructions: Put the chickpeas on a plate and season with salt and pepper. Grill for 15 minutes at 200degc. Meanwhile put the steak on a rack above the chickpeas and brush with a little oil. Cook for 30 seconds or until cooked through, brushing with the oil on once or twice. Turn the steak over and brush with more oil. Cook for 1 - 2 minutes more or until cooked to your liking and just tender. Serve the steak with the chickpeas and plenty of freshly chopped parsley.

title: The Maple Glaze for Turkeykeys
ingredients: 250 -280 g grapes | 50 ml maple syrup | 1 tablespoon coriander seed | 1 tablespoon turkey or 1 tablespoon chicken wings, etc
instructions: Place all ingredients in a jar or other small container. Blend until well blended. Place half the grapes on one side of each turkey and brush with glaze. Turn and brush more glaze over each turkey side. Place the remaining grapes on the other side of the turkey and brush with glaze. Cook in preheated oven at 350f for about 40 minutes or until the internal temperature reaches 100f and the turkey is cooked through. Let rest for 10 - 15 minutes before carving. Serve cut into 1/2 inch slices.

title: Ham Ramen Sushi
ingredients: 4 sheets nori | 2 packages thinly sliced ham | 1 package thin strips dry instant ramen noodles | salt and pepper to taste | 1/4 cup sesame oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons prepared mustard
instructions: Soak the ham and ramen noodles for 20 minutes in boiling water.

title: Italian Sausage With the Mushrooms and Goat Cheese!
ingredients: 8 links sweet sausage | 1 1/2 cups pre-shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Place sausage links on foil in a greased 13x9 baking dish. Sprinkle with cheese and bake at 400 for 45 minutes.

title: Tofu Strips or "lasagna"
ingredients: 1 package tofu, cut into cubes | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: Spray a pan with cooking spray and preheat over moderately high heat. When the pan is hot, add the tofu. Let tofu cook undisturbed until lightly browned. Sprinkle with oregano. Spread evenly over the pan and bake at 400°f for about 10 - 15 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Bacon-Salsa Rice
ingredients: 2 slices bacon, chopped | 2 cups arborio rice ( short, long grain ) | 1 cup salsa ( your choice, i use jazz22's jalapeno wonderful wonderful red-spice )
instructions: Cook rice according to box directions, or place in microwaveable casserole dish. Saute bacon until crisp, approximately 5 minutes, drain and set aside. Add salsa and reserved bacon to bacon drippings in pan. Stir to combine and cook over medium heat just until the salsa starts to boil, approximately 2 more minutes. Add rice and saute for about 3 more minutes, stirring frequently, until heated through and slightly translucent. Turn off heat, remove from heat, and allow to sit 5 minutes to allow steam to escape while rice absorbs some of the liquid. Serve and enjoy.

title: Roasted Vegetables With Turkey and Roast Chicken for 2
ingredients: 600 g roasting chickens, cut into 4 pieces | 200 g turkey, fat removed | 10 g ground turkey ( or 1/2 teaspoon ground turkey bolognaise and 1/4 teaspoon ground dried anise ) | 3 courgettes, ends trimmed | 30 g head cauliflower, separated into leaves and florets | 2 cups ice cubes
instructions: Preheat oven to 200ºc or 180ºc if fan forced and line a large baking tray with baking paper. Put chicken, turkey fat and turkish spices in a large roasting tin with vegetables, arranging them in an overlapping way. Put in the preheated oven and cook for 1 hour 1 hour 10 minutes, until the meat has browned and the vegetables are beginning to soften. Serve with lemon wedges. Discard any cooking juices that have accumulated on the tray.

title: Irish Whiskey Pasta
ingredients: 1 pound rotini pasta, uncooked
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a rolling boil. Add rotini pasta, and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, or until al dente.

title: Lamb and Lentils
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 500 g lean rump steak, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 250 g baby spinach | 500 g pork, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 1 can lentils
instructions: Heat the oil in a large frying pan over a medium heat. Add the rump and fry for 2 minutes or until lightly browned. Add the spinach, pork and 3/4 cup water. Cover and simmer for 5 to 7 minutes or until the liquid has almost evaporated. Stir in the fish sauce and serve.

Random Ingredients: coconut,leek,spice,raisin,beef stock,sirloin beef,double cream,glutinous rice flour
title: Beef & Vegetable Casserole
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin beef | 1 leek | 1 cup raw rice flour ( glutinous rice flour ) | 10 fluid ounces beef stock | 1/2 cup double cream | 2 tablespoons mixed spice | sliced raisins | finely shredded coconut, to serve
