instructions: Trim the meat, and cut it into cubes. Boil the beef. Cut the leek into thin slices and wash the rice flour. Drain. Put the beef, leek, flour, beef stock and cream in a saucepan. Stir well and bring to the boil, stirring for 2 minutes. Stir in the mixed spices. Preheat oven and grease a deep 10 x 5 inch deep casserole dish. Put half the beef mixture in the bottom, then half the rice flour mixed grains on top, then half the raisins and half the coconut. Repeat layers. Bake in a 200°c degree oven for 1 hour, or until meat is cooked and vegetables are tender.

Random Ingredients: catsup,parsley sprig,molasses,red curry paste,bread flour,rice noodle,maple syrup
title: French Curry Noodle Bread
ingredients: 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 1/2 cup catsup | 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 1 tablespoon molasses | 1 cup bread flour or 1 cup gluten-free flour | 1 tablespoon rice noodles, soaked and finely crumbled | fresh parsley sprig ( optional )
instructions: In a small bowl, combine catsup, maple syrup, and molasses. Set aside. Sift flour and rice noodles into mixing bowl. Add curry paste and gently mix so all ingredients are combined. Turn on dough mixer to dough/knead/saffead until dough forms into a compact ball. Cover dough and refrigerate for 25 minutes. Preheat oven to 425°f. Roll dough out on a floured board into a 3'' round. Using a sharp knife, trace a cross on the top to give a diamond pattern. Using a 1 1/2'' round cookie cutter, cut out an 8x12'' rectangle. Sprinkle a baking sheet with corn meal. Brush the circle lightly with a thin film of warm water, taking care not to let the sugar in the center of the dough drip off it. Spread the mustard sauce evenly over the dough circle. Using a thin brush, lightly coat the dough with mustard sauce and sprinkle evenly with corn meal. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: currant,feta cheese,oregano leaf,parmigiano reggiano cheese,tart apple,cannellini bean,italian parsley
title: Baked Beans and Feta
ingredients: 3 ounces cannellini beans, drained | 3 ounces feta cheese | 3 ounces parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated | 1 large tart apples or 1 large fuji apple, grated | 3 tablespoons fresh italian parsley, chopped | 2 tablespoons fresh oregano leaves, chopped | 2 tablespoons currants or 2 tablespoons raisins
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix everything together and arrange it in a 2 quart souffle dish. Bake for 30 minutes. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: ginger paste,vegetable oil cooking spray,fennel seed,chicken bouillon cube
title: Paneer Chicken
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger paste | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 chicken bouillon cube, crushed with
instructions: Prepare a hot grill or preheat the broiler. Spray chicken with cooking spray and sprinkle over the seeds. Place chicken on grates, close or broil for 12 to 14 minutes, or until done.

title: Sauvignon Red Wine
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups freshly made strong black coffee | 1 can italian-style stewed tomatoes
instructions: Pour the espresso into a cup. When the coffee is warm, add in both cans of stewed tomatoes. Stir well, serve drink warm, with or without chianti or anything of your choice. It can also be served on the rocks as a starter.

title: Italian Flounder
ingredients: 4 flounder fillets | 1 container pepperoni
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Brush both sides of each fish fillet with olive oil.

title: Vanilla Bean Puree
ingredients: 2 1/2 ounces vanilla beans | 4 1/2 teaspoons finely chopped flat leaf parsley ( or more )
instructions: Rinse the vanilla bean in warm water and drain them on paper towels. Use the back of a teaspoon to scrape out all the bubbles. In a small, heavy non reactive heavy saucepan, heat the vanilla beans over low heat, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes or until it steams. It will take about 5 minutes for the scent to be released. Remove the vanilla bean from the pan. Remove the beans using a slotted spoon after a few minutes. Raise the heat to medium high and add the parsley. Simmer for 2 more minutes. The vanilla bean will release its natural natural aroma and give off a rich aroma. Serve cool or at room temperature or warm. This can be stored in the freezer under a thin layer of cream just before serving.

title: Fenugreek-Coated and Sticky Salmon
ingredients: 2/3 cup cognac | 1/4 cup amaretto | 1 envelope active dry yeast | 4 2/3 pounds fillets salmon | 2 bananas, cut into 1/4-inch rounds | 1 tablespoon fenugreek seeds
instructions: In a small glass bowl, mix together the cognac and amaretto. Sprinkle yeast over 1 cup scalded warm water, and let stand 5 minutes. Stir in the yeast mixture, 1/2 cup at a time, and remove from the heat. Let stand, covered, at room temperature 1 hour. Place the salmon fillets in a glass baking dish, and pour the cognac syrup onto the fillets. Dot with the bananas and sprinkle with the fenugreek seeds. Cover with plastic wrap, and let marinate in a cool place 15 minutes, or until fillets are slightly thawed. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Bake in the preheated oven until the fish is easily flaked with a fork, 15 to 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chili flake,sun tomato,virgin olive oil,white cornmeal,steak
title: Quick Beef and Sun-Dried Tomato Pie
ingredients: 2 -3 tablespoons virgin olive oil | 1/4 - 1/3 cup sun-dried tomato ( or 1 tsp dry crushed ) | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon dried chili flakes | 1 lb steaks, cut into cubes | 1/8 - 1/4 cup virgin olive oil | white cornmeal, for dusting ( i use the quick-cooking type )
instructions: Preheat over to 425 degrees. Heat extra virgin olive oil in skillet. Add sun dried tomatoes, chili flakes and stir to mix well. Add steaks and stir to evenly coat. Cook 5 minute or until no longer pink. Drain any excess fat, season to taste with salt, and set aside. Bring a shallow pan of lightly salted water to a boil, add salt and if necessary, add cornmeal and stir to combine. Spread batter into a 8 inch square baking dish. Bake, uncovered, at 425 degrees for 20 - 25 minutes or until golden on top and crusty on the edges. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,rye flour,broccoli floret,double cream,chicken part
title: Broccoli Chicken
ingredients: 2 lbs bone-in chicken parts ( chicken thighs, or breast ) | 8 ounces broccoli florets | 4 ounces rye flour ( or rye bread flour ) | 8 ounces double cream | 1 pint heavy whipping cream
instructions: Rinse and pat dry all chicken parts. Trim and cut into bite size pieces. Mix together rye flour with cream. Place chicken in a shallow roasting pan and cover with heavy cream. Roast at 450 degrees for 25 minutes. Remove from oven and allow to rest at least 10 minutes before opening door to keep chicken moist. In a large bowl, combine all ingredients for sauce. Heat for 10 minutes over medium high heat. Pour into a gravy boat or serving dish. Serve with a good crusty loaf of bread.

title: Sweet Potato Mashed Please (Kirat Al-Goze)
ingredients: 600 g yukon gold potatoes | 1/2 cup caster sugar or 1/2 cup superfine sugar | 2 teaspoons ground cardamom | 6 tablespoons yoghurt | 1/4 cup pickled jalapeno chile, chopped
instructions: Boil potatoes in a pan of salted water for 10 - 12 minutes or until tender.. Drain, cool and mash potatoes until smooth. Add sugar, cardamon and yoghurt and mix through with a fork or potato masher. Divide mixture in half. Spread half a dollop of yogurt on plate and place other half on top. Roll up and eat immediately. Repeat until all yoghurt is used.

title: Frozen Limeade
ingredients: 3 1/2 fluid ounces frozen limeade concentrate ( lite ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons accent seasoning, or more to taste
instructions: Mix limeade concentrate, accent seasoning, and 1 1/2 pints of ice cubes in a 2 cup glass with a wire whisk until combined.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,cumin powder,arborio rice,black eyed pea,pearl barley,tortilla,ramen noodle
title: Indian Corn and Black-Eyed Peas & Noodles
ingredients: 2 bags frozen pearl barley | 2 cans black-eyed peas | 1 cup quick-cooking arborio rice ( this is about a small box ) | 1/8 teaspoon cumin powder | 3 packages ramen noodles | 1/2 cup sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 8 fat free tortillas
instructions: In large pot of boiling water, cook barley and peas for 7 minutes or until done. In separate pot, cook rice and cumin powder until water is absorbed. Meanwhile, place noodles in hot water for about 1 minute less than suggested, until softened but not crisp. With slotted spoon, drain noodles onto paper towels. In 4 or 5 serving bowls, arrange noodles and beans, then top with cheese & noodles. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,anise seed,ancho chile powder,cocoa powder
title: Ancho Beer
ingredients: 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 2 teaspoons anise-chile powder | 1 teaspoon ancho chile powder | 1 teaspoon instant minced onion soup mix
instructions: Combine cocoa or anise, ancho and chile powder and onion soup mix in a 2 to 3 quart saucepan. Stir over medium heat until hot, 1 to 2 minutes. Stir often and pour into beer canner.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin,apricot,raisin,hazelnut,corn oil,chocolate syrup,kaffir lime leaf,ha avocadoes
title: Chocolate Beef Tenderloin With Apricots and Hazelnuts
ingredients: 1 beef tenderloin | 2 ripe hass avocadoes, sliced 1/4 inch thick | 5 dried apricots | 1/4 1/4 cup dried raisins or 1/4 cup golden raisin | 1/4 cup dark chocolate syrup | 6 kaffir lime leaves ( see note in description ) | 2 tablespoons corn oil | grated hazelnuts, toasted
instructions: With the tip of a sharp knife, trim the membrane around the tenderloin. Place on a cutting board and flatten with the smooth side of a meat mallet. Let stand 15 minutes and cut lengthwise into 3/4 inch thick slices. Arrange 1 side of each avocado lengthwise in a shallow 1 1/2 quart baking dish. Top with 1 apricot slice and 1 dried apricot. Sprinkle with 2 dried apricots and 1/2 the raisins. Drizzle with chocolate syrup. Sprinkle with remaining chopped apricots and raisins. Dot with corn oil. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate up to 4 hours and up to 3 days, turning occasionally. Remove to a work surface and sprinkle with nutmeg. Cut crosswise into 1/2 inch slices. Garnish with hazelnuts.

Random Ingredients: chili flake,catsup,pistachio nut,provolone cheese,jumbo shrimp,chili oil
title: Jumbo Shrimp With Mustard Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs raw prawns or 1 1/2 lbs raw shrimp, shelled and deveined | 1/2 cup chili oil | 1/4 cup catsup | 1 teaspoon chili flakes ( the chili oil that comes in can to most asian groceries ) | 1/4 cup freshly grated provolone cheese | 3 tablespoons pistachio nuts
instructions: Cook shrimp either shelled or raw shrimp in boiling water in a covered pan until cooked but still pink. Drain and reserve. Put oil, chili flakes, catsup, and chili flakes in a small saucepan and simmer over low heat until the mixture thickens. Add shrimp to sauce. Place on an oven tray. Sprinkle with cheese and pistachio nuts. Broil in a grill for 3 - 4 minutes until bubbly and browned on top.

Random Ingredients: mayonnaise,passion fruit,vegetable bouillon cube,egg yolk,artichoke heart,red bean
title: Artichoke Hearts and Bean Dip
ingredients: 2 cans red beans | 1 can artichoke hearts | 1/2 vegetable bouillon cube | 2 egg yolks | 2 tablespoons mayonnaise | 1 can artichoke hearts
instructions: Drain the can of beans and artichoke hearts in a strainer until well rinsed. Blend the bean and artichoke hearts together and pour over the egg and vegetable bouillon. Seal in the egg yolks and stir well. Add the mayonnaise and stir again. If needed, mix the artichokes into the dip slightly. Serve in a wide crock, dip bowl with a dollop of yogurt on the side, or garnish with chopped scallions if desired.

Random Ingredients: kiwi fruit,water chestnut,jalapeno pepper,russet potato,white balsamic vinegar,pam cooking spray
title: Kiwi Mashed Potatoes (Pierce the Kiwi) Ww 2 Pts
ingredients: 6 small russet potatoes, scrubbed | 3 cups water chestnuts, chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons white balsamic vinegar | 4 kiwi fruits | pam cooking spray ( use pam oil ) | 1/2 teaspoon jalapeno pepper
instructions: Place the potatoes in a medium pot of boiling water and bring to boil. Reduce the heat to simmer and cover pot. Cook, stirring occasionally for about 30 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Drain water and mash the potatoes. Add the water chestnuts, white balsamic vinegar and kiwifruit. Stir to mix and serve.

Random Ingredients: vinegar,bacon,chinese cabbage,italian bread,portabella mushroom cap,pork sparerib,double cream
title: Pork Spareribs (Towards the Devil )
ingredients: 1/2 cup double cream ( whipping cream ) | 1/4 cup vinegar | 1 lb pork spareribs | 2 lbs chinese cabbage | 1 portabella mushroom cap, chopped | 1/2 lb bacon | 1/2 lb italian bread, slices toasted and cut into 1 inch squares
instructions: Make the cream sauce, bring ½ cup cream to a boil in a deep heavy frying pan. Add the pork spareribs and boil briskly for a minute or two, turning them around in the cream and stirring frequently. Remove the pan from the heat. Wash the cabbage and cut off the dark leaves and stalk carefully with scissors. Slice crosswise into thick strips about ½ inch wide. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. While the water is boiling, cut the remaining pork spareribs into ½ inch wide strips. Heat a 12 inch frying pan over moderate heat until a bead of beaten egg sizzles in the surface and evaporates immediately, stirring quickly. Add ½ cup cream, the vinegar and 1 cup water and boil rapidly, stirring constantly, until it is reduced to about 1½ cups, about 5 minutes. Strain and reserve ½ cup of this liquid. Reserve 1 cup of this liquid and set the rest aside. Bring the pork spareribs to room temperature. Arrange half of the cabbage strips on a large serving platter and place half of the fried cabbage beside. Sprinkle half of the mushrooms and half of the bacon over the cabbage. Repeat the layering with the remaining cabbage and mushrooms. Arrange half of the fried cabbage over the cabbage and bacon and arrange in an attractive pattern over everything. Dollop the reserved cream sauce over all and top with the remaining bacon and bacon. Wrap the surface of the platter with foil, tent with foil and chill for at least two hours or for at least six hours. To serve, slice or shred the pieces of bread on the diagonal and place in a serving dish. Surround the dish with the cabbage dish squares.

title: Southern Veal
ingredients: 16 ounces veal, with bone, about 4 loin | 1 ounce cream cheese | 1 can cream cheese | 1/2 cup whipping cream | 1 beef bouillon cube
instructions: Place all ingredients into slow cooker. Cover and cook for 4 - 6 hours on low. After the fourth hour remove meat and shred. Return meat and cream cheese to slow cooker and stir until mixed well. Serve on italian bread or noodles.

title: Quick Spinach and Olive Oil Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 cup baby spinach leaves
instructions: Heat olive oil in a small frying pan. Add washed and cleaned spinach leaves and cook over medium heat, stirring, for 2 to 3 minutes. Reduce heat to low and continue to cook for 1 to 2 minutes.

title: Mexican Corn Bread (Low Fat and Low Sugar)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups light soymilk ( or other creamy milk ) | 3 1/2 cups yellow cornmeal ( fine ) | 1/2 lb colby cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f, and lightly line a 9 x 5 loaf pan, with the parchment paper. In a saucepan, combine the soy milk and 1 3/4 cups of the cornmeal. Bring mixture to a boil, stirring constantly. Reduce heat & simmer, uncovered, for 2 minutes, or until thick. Add the cheese & continue simmering for about 1 minute. Spread mixture into the pan, and sprinkle with remaining cornmeal. Bake in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until bubbly. Allow to cool for 5 - 10 minutes, then cut into 8 slices to serve.

title: Molho de Bona
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef chuck, cut in 1 1/2 `` cubes | bacon, cut in 1 1/4-inch slices | fennel, sliced ( optional ) | 12 cardamom pods | 4 garlic cloves | 8 habanero peppers ( with or without seeds ) | 1 piece kewer
instructions: Place meat in dutch oven, and drizzle lightly with oil or a combination of all together. Scatter fennel, cardamom, garlic and whole habanero chillies over this. Bring to a boil, then reduce and simmer on low for 2 - 3 hours, or until meat is very tender. This can be done in a crock pot on low, if necessary. Note, cooking time will vary with how wet the meat is, so, if it appears dry, cook a little longer.

title: Italian Style Pork
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless pork shoulder ( may also use pork butt ) | 1/8 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/8 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1 envelope italian seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom powder | 4 lbs flank steaks or 4 lbs round steaks
instructions: Place the pork shoulder in a deep pot and add just enough water to cover. Cook the pork at a simmer for about 2 hours or until the pork is tender. Remove the pork from the pot and reserve liquid to make later. Cool completely and slice up into 1 inch strips.

title: Apple & Chickpea Polenta (India)
ingredients: 2 cups pitted chickpeas ( rinsed, cleaned and drained ) | 1/4 cup apple juice | 1/2 cup polenta | 2 teaspoons vodka, such as kolo
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a saucepan and cook in the microwave in a cup holder, covered, stirring occasionally, until hot.

Random Ingredients: almond paste,breadcrumb,chicken breast half,white flour,brown lentil,black peppercorn,salmon steak
title: Danish Dill Broetchen
ingredients: 1/2 cup breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons white flour | 24 ounces salmon steak, skinned and boned | 1/2 cup brown lentils | 2 teaspoons whole black peppercorns | 6 -10 ounces almond paste | fresh egg roll wrap ( or frozen ) or bread ( or frozen )
instructions: Lightly coat a deep fry pan with oil or a light coating of canola oil. Place bread crumbs in a plate and mix together in a wide, shallow bowl. Dust fish with flour and place in bowl with bread crumbs. Drain lentils well and place in a saucepan with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil and cook for 30 - 40 minutes without stirring to thicken the broth. Meanwhile, pat salmon dry with paper towels and season well with salt, pepper, and finely chopped pepper. Coat fillets in bread crumbs and fry in hot oil over medium high heat until well browned. Add lentils, peppercorns, and almond paste and continue cooking 2 - 3 minutes. Remove fish from the pan and slice diagonally across the grain into wedges and serve on a bed of rice.

title: Creamy Chocolate Chutney
ingredients: 1 large spanish onion | 120 ml soymilk | 2 teaspoons salt | 375 ml dry red chili powder | 1 teaspoon sugar | 4 tablespoons oil | 150 ml chocolate, chocolate tablets
instructions: Using a food processor, finely chop the onion, and place in a large saucepan. Cover with cold water. Place over high heat and bring to the boil. Add the soymilk, salt, chili power and sugar and continue to cook, stirring constantly. Bring to the boil, then remove from heat. The chutney should retain its bright green colour. Transfer to a blender and blend until almost smooth. Return to saucepan over low heat, and stir in the chocolate tablets. Cover and cook until melted, about 5 minutes. Pour into a bowl and cool to room temperature.

title: Red Miso and Mascarpone Cheese Spread
ingredients: 12 ounces mascarpone cheese ( fresh-picked, at room temperature ) | 1 jar roasted red miso
instructions: Remove 2 tbsp of the miso paste from jar of roasted red miso paste. Combine mascarpone cheese, remaining miso paste, and roasted red miso in a medium bowl. The spread may be made ahead.

Random Ingredients: butternut squash,butter lettuce,red chile,sirloin tip roast,brown rice,plain flour
title: Beef & Butternut Squash Roast
ingredients: 4 ounces braising steak, cut into 2-rib portions | 4 ounces butternut squash, peeled, cut into 2-rib portions | 2 ounces plain flour | 1 red chile, seeded | 2 ounces butter lettuce | 1/2 cup brown rice
instructions: Preheat the oven to 210c/gas mark 1, lay the steak pieces onto a large plate. Place under a grill and grill for 5 - 6 mins per side, or until nicely charred and cooked to your liking. Remove from the grill and rest for 10 mins, then slice thinly. Meanwhile combine the flour and chilli in a plastic bag. Tip beef into the plastic bag and shake well to coat. Add the butter lettuce to the beef and shake well. Transfer to a baking dish and top with the roasting chicken. Bake in the lower half of the oven for 15 minutes or until cooked through. Toss together the rice and hot butternut in to a bowl. Tip the pan juices into the pan along with the meat and rice, then top with the vegetables and cook, stirring, until tender. Toss through the chilli powder and serve with the beef & rice.

title: Zubrowka Z Kapusta Mit Kapusta
ingredients: 600 g savoy cabbage | 150 g sun-dried tomatoes | 2 saffron threads
instructions: Separate and peel the savoy cabbage. Cut off and discard the very large leaves of the savoy cabbage. If necessary, blanch the leaves in boiling water for a few seconds or until they are limp. Drain in a colander. When cool enough to handle, slice them into half inch long slices, discarding the tough part of each leaf that remains on the core. Bring a large pot to the boil. Add salt to taste and add the zubrowka. Toss lightly to coat in oil. Add sun dried tomatoes. Taste zubrowka when tomatoes are hot and add salt if necessary, remembering the saffron already in the water. Arrange the chopped savoy cabbage on a platter. Arrange the sliced slices of sun dried tomato on top. Serve warm. Note, zubrowka can be eaten immediately, or refrigerated for up to two days.

Random Ingredients: hot red chili pepper,picante sauce,egg,sirloin,bicarbonate soda,cooking spray,cumin seed,weetabix
title: Beef Kebabs
ingredients: 1 lb ground sirloin | 2 cups picante sauce | 3 eggs | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 2 dried hot red chili peppers | cooking spray | sweet and sour weetabix
instructions: Mix together beef, picante sauce and eggs. Slightly beat with fork. Dry fry in a pan sprayed in cooking spray for 3 minutes until cooked thru. Remove. Mix together baking soda and cummin, add to meat and egg mixture. Add hot peppers and stir to mix. Spoon mix into 2 paper lined 8x8 tins. Spread with sweet & sour weetabix on top. Refrigerate overnight to set, and crisp up a little more if desired.

title: Artichoke Puree
ingredients: 2 cups loosely packed artichoke hearts, halved | 5 medium red potatoes, peeled and cubed | 2 teaspoons tahini
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a 2 quart baking dish with aluminum foil. Add artichokes to foil, and arrange in a single layer. Bake in preheated oven until tender and tender, 15 to 20 minutes. Remove from oven, and stir potatoes with artichokes in pan. Sprinkle with tahini, and return to oven over medium high heat until golden brown, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,beef bouillon cube,red enchilada sauce,red chilies,butter flavor crisco,date
title: Fiery Party Crackers
ingredients: 1 package butter flavor crisco ( one stick ) | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt | 5 dried red chilies, seeded and chopped | 1 1/2 cups crushed dates | 3 cups shredded red enchilada sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Grease 2 jelly roll pans. Combine all ingredients except flour and pan dough in a medium bowl with a knife or the back of a spoon. Shape dough using hands into 2 inch long rolls, patted dry, and about 1/4 inch thick. Cut rolls into 1 inch slices. Place 1 cup per cookie and bake for 35 - 40 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: chili sauce,green food coloring,equal sugar substitute,fettuccine pasta
title: Hot Fettuccine
ingredients: 14 ounces fettuccine pasta, cooked and drained al dente | 1 1/4 cups chili sauce | 1 1/4 cups equal sugar substitute | 2 drops green food coloring ( optional )
instructions: Prepare a bowl of hot water for the fettucine noodles. Stir together the hot sauce, sugar, and green food coloring into the hot pasta. Divide the fettucine among a 6 cup capacity oven proof bowl or serving dish. Pour the hot sauce mixture over the fettucine and set aside at least half an hour before serving.

title: Amarula Cream Truffles
ingredients: 85 g fresh white bread, torn into large pieces | 1/4 cup amarula cream liqueur | 1 tablespoon pesto sauce
instructions: Place the torn pieces of bread into a food processor and process until finely chopped. Transfer to a bowl and add one third of the amarula cream liqueur and mix well. Roll the mixture into a ball and set aside for 20 minutes. Place the remaining amarula cream in a small saucer. Place over medium heat. When hot, dip the balls in the amarula cream until coated with the cream. Place the truffles on a tray and cover with a clean tea towel. Refrigerate for 30 minutes, or until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,butter,blueberry,vanilla essence,methi seed,vegetable oil,cabbage leaf,brown sugar
title: Blueberry-Methi Seed Spring Rolls (Boti Datta Bread Machine)
ingredients: 1/2 cup vegetable oil | 3 tablespoons unsalted butter | 1 1/2 cups brown sugar | 1 1/2 cups fresh blueberries ( or frozen ) | 1/2 cup chopped cabbage leaves | 1 teaspoon methi seeds ( optional ) | 1 cup self-rising flour | 2 teaspoons vanilla essence
instructions: In medium bowl, combine all ingredients.

title: French Cream Sandwich Bread
ingredients: 1 baguette | 2 cups heavy cream | 150 ml low-fat plain flour | 1/2 cup seeded sliced green pepper | 1/2 cup seeded sliced peppercorn
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Slice the baguette into 3 or 4 inch thick slices. You might need to slice a little to get a nice even thickness. Cut into 3 or 4 inch squares or a little smaller if you cut too many triangles. Place bread squares onto cookie sheets and toast in oven about 8 or 10 minutes. They really take the crunch away, but you can also add some butter to the cream if you want. In a bowl, mix together the cream and flour until well blended and it forms a sticky paste. Mix this with the cream mixture until well mixed and smooth, about 1 minute. Add the green pepper and peppercorns. Place bread squares onto plates and divide the cream mixture evenly among the bread squares. Serve immediately. Variation, you can use a milder vegetable such as chard for a milder flavour. Adding salt can also be used to add a pinch of salt in the cream. I have also used fresh green salad greens which makes this a great mixed flavour and flavourful sandwich.

title: Healthy Salmon Mousse
ingredients: 1/2 cup chicken broth | 1 tablespoon cocoa | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 2 cups nonfat milk | 1 lb salmon | 2 cups shredded chinese cabbage | lime wedge, garnish ( optional )
instructions: In a deep, heavy saucepan, combine the chicken broth, cocoa, cumin, and milk. Bring just to a boil, remove from the heat, and beat in the salmon until it is cooked. Pour into 6 individual ramekins or custard cups, and refrigerate. To serve, remove salmon from the milk mixture with a slotted spoon, and place in one. Arrange the cabbage around the salmon, alternating with slices of salmon on each plate. Divide the reserved milk mixture evenly among the ramekins. Garnish with lime wedges.

Random Ingredients: french mustard,coconut oil,french bread,pork shoulder,corn,chipotle chile,ramen noodle,dark soy sauce
title: Carolina Pork Loin Sandwich
ingredients: 1 tablespoon coconut oil | 1 1/2 lbs boneless pork shoulder, fat thinly sliced and cut into 3/4-thick slices | 4 ounces ramen noodles | 3/4 cup light soy sauce, plus extra to taste | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons french mustard, plus extra to taste | 12 slices french bread, halved lengthwise, toasted | 4 crisp dried corn, toasted
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°. Heat the coconut oil in a large nonstick pan over high heat. Add the pork, and saute until well browned, 5 to 7 minutes. Remove the pork from the pan, and stir in the ramen noodles, 1/4 cup light soy sauce, 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce and 1 tablespoon french mustard. Bake in the oven until beginning to crisp, about 5 minutes. Stir the noodles into the pork mixture and divide among the french halves. Sprinkle with remaining browned soy sauce, and serve right away.

Random Ingredients: lentil,fish fillet,yellow cornmeal,allspice berry,self raising flour,coffee,puff pastry,white fish fillet
title: Lentil Dumplings With Fish and Coffee
ingredients: 1 teaspoon allspice berry | 200 g yellow cornmeal | 2 cups self-raising flour | 1 cup lentils, cooked | 1 cup strong coffee | 1 fish fillet | 500 g white fish fillets | 2 sheets puff pastry, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Sprinkle allspice berries over lentils. Combine cornmeal and flour in large bowl. Add lentils and coffee and mix. Dip fish fillets in flour, then dip into cornmeal mix. Place fillets onto greased oven trays. Make 2 dumplings in a lightly greased oven or springform pan. Divide lentil mixture between the 2 dumplings, ensuring they are covered evenly. Bring to the boil. Cover and bake for 40 mins, or until cooked through. Remove from oven when fish is cooked. Serve with yogurt and chopped chives. The dumplings can be prepared a couple of hours in advance, but the baking time is aproximately 25minutes before the meal is ready.

title: Basil Mushrooms With Prosciutto
ingredients: 200 g fresh white mushrooms | 1 cup of chopped fresh spearmint | 1/2 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 1/2 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Heat grill or barbeque on high. Cut off stalks of mushrooms and remove stems if any. Trim white mushroom stems. Blanch in boiling water for 1 minute.

title: Vegan Queso Dip
ingredients: 1/4 ounce dried yeast | 4 -5 tablespoons mixed fresh herbs, divided | 4 ounces fat-free ricotta cheese | 3 scallions, trimmed & minced | 1 tablespoon guacamole
instructions: Place yeast in a small nonstick skillet with 2 tablespoons water. Cover and let stand for 5 - 10 minutes until foamy. In a bowl. Scrumble in the remaining 4 tablespoons of herbs. Set aside. In a medium bowl, stir together ricotta and scallions. Place yeast mixture & cheese mixture in bowl. Stir in 3 tablespoons of the herb butter. Knead for 4 - 5 minutes using dough hook. Place dough into a oiled bowl. Cover. Let rise in a warm place, free from draft, until doubled in size about 1 1/2 hours. Knead the dough again and divide in half. Turn out on floured surface and form one half. With lightly floured hands, roll each half to 1/4 thick. Cut into 2 1/2 inch disks using a pizza cutter. Place disks on a lightly oiled baking sheet. Cover loosely with plastic wrap and let rise about 45 min or until puffy but not browned. Preheat broiler or set oven to 500 f, placing rack 6 from broiler element. Spread cheese mixture on top of crescents in a single layer. Bake 8 to 10 min or until golden.

title: Curried Shallot Slaw
ingredients: 2 tablespoons coarse grain mustard | 1 tablespoon curry paste | 1 1/2 lbs shallots, peeled
instructions: Combine mustard and curry paste in a medium bowl. Toss with shallots. Refrigerate for at least an hour as the flavors develop.

title: Swiss Cheese and Cabbage
ingredients: 1 ounce unsalted butter | 2 tablespoons green cabbage, shredded | 1 pinch white peppercorns, cracked or cracked
instructions: Melt the butter. Add the cabbage and pepper and toss. Serve.

Random Ingredients: thai fish sauce,garlic clove,dill seed,pasilla chile
title: Panch Koeku (Korean Masaman)
ingredients: 2 lbs pasilla chiles ( or japones ) | 8 garlic cloves | 1/2 cup thai fish sauce | 1 tablespoon toasted dill seed
instructions: Wash and coarsely chop about 2 lbs of pasilla chiles. Separate 4 cloves of garlic and roughly chop the other 2 cloves. Place them in a saucepan with the chiles, fish sauce and dill seeds. Cover and simmer over medium low heat for 45 minutes to 1/2 hr or until the chiles are tender. The most important thing about the sauce, remove the saucepan from the heat and let the chiles sit at room temperature for several hours. When the chiles are cool and manageable, puree them by hand in a blender or food processor. Pass through a fine sieve or through a clean, moistened coffee filter or paper towel. Store in the refrigerator, uncovered, in a tightly sealed container.

Random Ingredients: wheat tortilla,fillet salmon,ladyfinger,white rice,green bell pepper,eggplant
title: Faux Easy Breakfast Burritos
ingredients: 1/2 cup uncooked white rice | 1 1/2 pounds fillet salmon thickly sliced | 1 large eggplant, cut into 1 cup cubes | 1/2 green bell pepper, chopped | 3 packages ladyfingers | 2 eggs | 8 whole wheat tortillas
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spread rice over the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Place fish in dish, and carefully flip to coat with rice. Layer eggplant and bell pepper over rice, and top with remaining ingredients. Cover, and bake in preheated oven for 60 minutes. Break one egg into a small bowl, and pour into a small skillet over high heat. Fry until egg is no longer runny. Remove from pan, and cut into halves and then into thirds. Fill each half with some of the egg, and serve on a flat plate. Cut slices into halves if desired.

title: Garlic-Sesame Bruschetta
ingredients: 1 french baguette | 2 tablespoons minced garlic | 1/4 cup oriental sesame oil
instructions: Cut ends off bread and cut in half diagonally. Wrap each half with plastic wrap and place under the grill. Toast bread in preheated broiler for about 10 minutes, turning once. Combine garlic, sesame oil and pepper. Spread on hot bruschetta.

title: Polish Sausage and Asparagus
ingredients: 1 lb fresh asparagus | 1 lb polish sausage | 1 head cauliflower, chopped | 1 -2 tablespoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Trim asparagus of the tough ends and cut into 1 to 1 1/2 inch pieces. Place in a large bowl and cover with boiling water until tender crisp. Drain. Meanwhile, remove skin from sausage, cut into 1/4 inch slices and brown in a large skillet. Drain off excess fat. Cut asparagus into 1 inch pieces. Place in a large casserole or baking pan.

title: Apple Sausage
ingredients: 2 pounds dry rump roast | 3 cups water | 16 large green apples, such as golden delicious golden delicious are ideal | filling for pork chops and beef sausages ( optional )
instructions: Cook and stir roast in 3 cups of the water with the apples until tender. Stir as necessary to keep stuffing from sticking. Remove apple from simmering and stir in sausage if desired. Cover and continue cooking for at least 1 1/2 hours or until meat thermometer reads 160 degrees f. Sausages should be cooked through.

title: Nigella's Beef N' Cherry Tomato Soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs flank steaks, cut into 1/2 thick pieces | 1 cup nonfat milk | 2 tablespoons ground ginger ( can sub fresh ginger root in place of fresh ) | 2 teaspoons nigella seeds ( available at gourmet specialty stores or safeway. can sub fresh ginger root in place of fresh ) | 1 pint cherry tomatoes | 8 ounces nacho gingersnaps, broken into halves | butter or margarine ( for a richer flavor, i've found a splash of crisco on hand )
instructions: Place nacho gingersnaps in a food processor and process until smooth. Set aside. Place both flank steaks together in a large saucepan. Season with salt and pepper. Drizzle in enough milk to cover, bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer until meat is tender, about 2 hours. Remove steak from pan and shred into bite size pieces. Set aside. Return pan to medium high heat. Add nigella seeds to the pan. Cook until they start to pop. Add meat, tomatoes and 1/2 cup of the nacho gingersnap mixture to the pan. Simmer until heated through, about 10 minutes. Serve in bowls with buttered or margarine.

Random Ingredients: bouillon cube,milk,beef stew meat,cream coconut,red hot pepper,golden raisin,icing
title: Coconut Beef
ingredients: 2 tablespoons icing | 1 teaspoon beef stew meat, from a cube | 1 bouillon cube ( beef bouillon will do ) | 1 cup milk | 1 -2 red hot pepper, deseeded and diced | 2 ounces cream of coconut, flake into 1/2in chunks | 1 pinch ground red hot pepper
instructions: Heat oven to gas mark 5, 200c mark 2, 190°c in a shallow dish. Mix the icing and the stew meat in, using a wooden spoon. Dissolve the chicken cube in the milk and pour over the mixture. Add the rest of the ingredients and mix well, it should feel like velvet. Put into oven for approximately 1hr 30 mins, or until the meat is tender and all the liquid has been absorbed. Serve with noodles, rice and perhaps some mashed potatoes if required on the side. This is also very good with mashed potatoes, but is also good as a tasty accompaniment to roast potatoes and stews.

title: The Best Teriyaki Butter
ingredients: 200 g dark chocolate | 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1 tablespoon mirin
instructions: Combine all of the ingredients together with the exception of the butter. Keep in an air tight container in a cool place for at least 4 hours. After teriyaki butter has had a chance to set, mix to ensure that the teriyaki butter will last in fridge.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,white bread,head cabbage,pumpkin puree,canadian bacon
title: Smoky Pumpkin and Canadian Bacon Slaw
ingredients: 1 large head of cabbage, cored and torn into bite sized pieces | 1 red chili pepper, seeded and minced ( or less ) | 50 canadian bacon, thinly sliced | 3 slices fresh white bread, cut into pieces ( or use stale bread ) | 1/2 ounce can pumpkin puree, undiluted or ( 7 ounce ) can almond puree, undiluted
instructions: Line the bottom of a large pot with two large baking sheets that are large enough to accommodate all of the ingredients well. On a medium to large cutting board, combine all ingredients. Using a sharp knife, carefully cut slaw crosswise into approximately 8 - 10 portions, depending on the size of the slaw pieces. Arrange on the baking sheets, leaving about 2 inches between each portion. Place in your microwave and cook on high for 3 minutes. Turn off the microwave, cover with a lid and allow to steam for about 8 minutes or until very warm. Serve immediately.

title: Easy and Simple Pizza Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups commercial pizza sauce | 1/4 teaspoon grated lemon extract | 1 dash paprika
instructions: Mix taco sauce, lemon extract and paprika together. Spread the sauce over the pre baked pizza sauce and sprinkle generously with the seasoned salt. Bake in an oven with a hot dry skillet on top of your oven at 500° for 10 - 15 minutes until bubbly.

Random Ingredients: soy sauce,vegetable oil cooking spray,salt pepper
title: Chinese Soy-Sauce Fries
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 1/2 teaspoons soy sauce | 1/8 teaspoon salt and pepper
instructions: Coat a large nonstick frypan with cooking spray. Heat a small amount of oil in a preheated pan over medium low heat. Stir the soy sauce and salt and pepper into the hot oil. Cover the frypan with a plate and set aside to keep warm. Remove the coated frypan from the heat and fry the fries until golden brown, 3 to 5 minutes on each side.

title: Nori Wrap
ingredients: 1 cup chopped baby spinach | 1/4 cup chopped walnuts | 1/2 cup chopped fresh salad leaves | 2 sheets nori ( dry seaweed ) | 2 tablespoons white sugar | 1/2 cup salad oil
instructions: Preheat grill. Place nori on a serving plate. Dip fingers in salad oil, then in nuts. Place on grill and cook until lightly toasted. Remove from grill and set aside. Meanwhile, place spinach on prepared nori, and cut lengthwise down the center. Fold leaves around spinach. Place a lettuce leaf on top of each wrap, and then drizzle evenly with dressing. Repeat for remaining wraps and garnishes.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,rice wine vinegar,coffee,beef tip roast,mushroom
title: Kalops Roast
ingredients: 2 lbs beef round tip roast or 2 lbs beef tenderloin | 1 1/2 cups brewed coffee | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 1/2 lb fresh mushrooms | 1 1/2 cups heavy whipping cream
instructions: Wrap roast with cheesecloth.

Random Ingredients: carrot,peanut oil vegetable,beef chuck,spinach,russet potato,kernel corn,rigatoni pasta
title: Beef Pasta Fazool #Ragu
ingredients: 1 package rigatoni pasta or 1 package rotini pasta | 1 tablespoon peanut oil or 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 lb boneless beef chuck, cut into thin strips | 1 1/2 cups frozen whole kernel corn, thawed and drained | 1 cup sliced carrot | 1 cup frozen spinach, thawed and squeezed dry | 1 bag russet potatoes, peeled and sliced into 1/2 inch wedges
instructions: Cook rigatoni according to directions on package, drain. Meanwhile cook chuck in hot skillet on medium heat 8 - 10 minutes or until browned. Add remaining ingredients and remove from heat. Add rigatoni and toss well. Garnish with sour cream if desired and grated cheddar cheese if desired.

Random Ingredients: baking chocolate,dill seed,gingerroot,great northern bean,romaine lettuce,chilies,chicken liver
title: Peking Chicken Livers and Chocolate
ingredients: 1 lb chicken liver ( with the skin on ) | 4 ounces baking chocolate ( dark, or semisweet ) | 1/4 cup chopped fresh dill seed | 1/4 cup minced gingerroot | 1 large romaine lettuce, washed | 2 -3 minced chilies | 1/2 - 3/4 cup good quality deli-style chinese cooking chocolate
instructions: Place chicken livers in a large glass baking dish with a good coating of cooking spray. Melt chocolate or chocolate. Add the chopped dill seed and minced ginger. Combine well. Sprinkle chocolate mixture over livers and place in refrigerator for 2 to 4 hours. Just before serving, cut romaine lettuce in half lengthwise. Place on plates, drizzle with chinese chinese cooking chichuan sauce and top with a portion of the saved meat from the chicken livers. Garnish with a sprinkling of grated dark chinese cooking chocolate or toasted chinese peppercorn bits.

Random Ingredients: brandy,cinnamon,chili pepper flake,orange peel,monterey jack cheddar cheese,orange juice
title: Cheese Fondue
ingredients: 1/2 lb grated monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend | 2 tablespoons orange juice | 2 tablespoons brandy, cognac or 2 tablespoons rum | 1/4 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon | 1 teaspoon finely chopped orange peel
instructions: Place all ingredients except orange peel into a saucepan and stir over medium heat until cheese is melted and mixture begins to thicken. Remove from heat and add orange peel, stirring to coat thoroughly. Transfer fondue to a fondue pot and heat thoroughly over low heat.

title: Quick and Easy Adobo
ingredients: 1 bag dried udon noodles | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Rinse noodles very well. Place noodles into a mixing bowl in the refrigerator. Allow noodles to soften and absorb seasoning as directed on the package. Drain drained noodles. Place in a large frying pan with enough water to cover, over high heat. Bring to a boil. Remove from heat, and stir in ground cardamom.

title: Italian Herb Butter
ingredients: 1 lb margarine ( no substitutions ) | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning
instructions: Combine margarine and italian seasoning.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,double cream,ginger root,kidney bean,tomato puree
title: Red Beans and Peppers
ingredients: 1 tablespoon butter | 2 tablespoons minced fresh ginger root | 1/2 cup chopped red bell pepper | 1 can whole peeled tomatoes with puree | 4 cans kidney beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat.

title: Hot and Spicy Sausages
ingredients: 1 lb hot italian sausages ( bulk ) | 2 tablespoons vinegar ( british white works best too ) | 1 1/2 cups caster sugar ( uk white works best too ) | 2 cups jicama, peeled and chopped small ( jicama larger than jicama, so they are not too small ) | salt and pepper
instructions: Cut sausages in half. Using a sharp knife, make slits in both sides of sausages about 2cm deep. In a medium bowl, mix the vinegar, sugar and salt and pepper together. Add the jicama and coat well. Add the sausages and coat well with the dressing. Cover and place in the fridge for at least at least 2 hours or overnight. The longer the better, preferably overnight. Preheat the grill to high. Remove the sausages from the marinade. Spray the inside of the grill with cooking oil. Turn all the sausages over and cook under the grill for about 7 minutes, turning frequently, until cooked though. Serve with boiled new potatoes and/or fresh vegetables.

title: Tex Mex Couscous
ingredients: 3 cups couscous | 1 jar picante sauce | 1 teaspoon oregano
instructions: Soak couscous in water for about 5 minutes. Place couscous on a plate and sprinkle with picante sauce and oregano. Fluff with a fork and serve.

title: Smoky Mince Focaccia
ingredients: 500 g mincemeat | 2 poblano chiles, sliced
instructions: Heat the grill. Tear the chile slices on a grill plate. Place the poblanos on the grill plate to warm slightly. Drain the mincemeat, reserving any juice. Place 1/2 tbsp of the mince in the centre of each poblano chile. Roll the poblanos around this mince and secure with toothpicks. Cook for about 5 minutes on each side, until the poblanos are soft.

title: Borlotti Beans, Frijoles (Borlotti Beans)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs dried borlotti beans | 1/2 cup light coconut milk | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin | 6 tablespoons queso fresco, grated
instructions: Soak beans for 8 hours in boiling water. Drain. In blender, combine coconut milk and golden syrup, bring to boil. Place beans in casserole or stockpot. Add enough boiling water to cover beans by about 1 inch. Cook covered 15 - 20 minutes, until tender. Drain. Add 1/2 t. Of the cumin, 1 t. Of the grated cheese, and cook, stirring, until cheese is melted. Remove from heat and allow to cool to room temp. Spread this mixture over the beans, sprinkle with remaining cheese, and bake at 300°f for about 30 minutes until beans are bubbly but not mushy. Serve at room temperature or warm. Store in refrigerator up to 2 weeks or freeze up to 1 month.

title: Methi's Indian-Spiced Corn Nests
ingredients: 4 corn husks | 3 tablespoons cooking oil | 4 slices fresh ginger root, peeled | toothpicks
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees f. Soak corn husks in warm water until soft, about 15 minutes. Drain and place a tea towel or paper towels on a baking sheet to drain. Spread corn husks onto the baking sheet and dampen with warm water. Microwave the corn in the microwave between wax paper on high for about 45 seconds, until heated through and soft. Remove from microwave and set aside to cool for 5 to 10 minutes. Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Stir in the ginger.

title: Ham & Sheep  Chopped Flatbread
ingredients: 5 slices deli ham, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh flat leaf parsley, finely chopped
instructions: Mix the ham & parsley together, then spread on the cut surfaces of the bread. Heat a frying pan on a high heat & add the chopped ham. Cook, stirring from time to time & pressing down, until the cooked ham is thoroughly heated through. Allow to cool for about 5 minutes before cutting into thick slices from the bread slices.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean,red chili pepper,graham cracker crumb,black olive,garlic paste,nonstick cooking spray,cabbage
title: Vegetarian Baked Garlicky Rice
ingredients: 1 teaspoon garlic paste | 1/2 lb ground round | 1/2 cup shredded cabbage ( about 3/4 of a green cabbage ) | 1/2 cup pinto beans ( about 2/3 cup ) | 2 cups graham cracker crumbs, divided | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh red chili peppers | 12 black olives, pitted ( about 1-1/2 cups ) | nonstick cooking spray
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet, cook garlic paste over medium heat for 1 minute or until fragrant. Stir in ground round and cook, stirring to crumble, for 3 to 4 minutes or until browned. Stir in cabbage and 1/2 cup cracker crumbs. Spray a 13x9 inch glass baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Arrange half of mixture in dish. Arrange remaining onion halves over the rice mixture. Top with remaining ground round mixture, cracker crumbs, chiles, and olives. Bake at 350 degrees f. For 20 to 25 minutes or until bubbly.

Random Ingredients: beef sirloin steak,red chile,taco seasoning,apricot,cornflour,dark sesame oil,spring onion
title: Crock Pot Pan Fry Beef
ingredients: 500 g beef sirloin steaks | 2 teaspoons taco seasoning | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 2 teaspoons crushed dried apricots | 1 spring onion, finely sliced | 1 fresh red chile, seeded and chopped, to serve
instructions: Trim sirloin steak of any fat and cut lengthways into 4 equal portions. Combine taco seasoning, cornflour, sesame oil, apricots, spring onions and chilli in a bowl. Use your fingers to push the mixture into the cuts in the beef. Place the meat in crock pot and cook on low for 5 - 6 hours, or until thoroughly cooked. Turn to high and stir in remaining 1 tsp of cornflour. Serve immediately.

title: Tzatziki (Tabbouleh)
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce | 3 -4 pinches cumin seeds | 1/4 cup fresh mint, chopped | 1 1/2 cups prepared marinade
instructions: Place the romaine lettuce on a serving platter and arrange the remaining fillings attractively on top of the romaine leaves. Shake the tzatziki ingredients together and serve at room temperature.

title: Sunflower Cheese & Poppy Seed Sauce - a Tasty Blintze!
ingredients: 1 package shredded swiss cheese | 4 tablespoons poppy seeds | 1 -2 tablespoon sunflower oil | 1 cup whipping cream
instructions: Combine all the cheese in a bowl, mix well. Put the cream into a saucepan over a low heat, warm the cream. Add the poppy seeds. Heat gently, mix and pour the hot cream into the cheese, stirring constantly. Leave to cool a little, serve with crackers or assorted bread.

title: Spiced Baked French Bread
ingredients: 1 baguette, loaf crust scored | 1 ounce fresh pecorino cheese | 2 tablespoons red wine | 1 -2 teaspoon mixed spice | 3 fresh mint leaves ( optional )
instructions: Cut baguette into 4 portions and cut each in half. Place halves onto greased baking paper, place on baking sheet, cover and allow to rise until doubled, about 15 - 18 minutes. Remove from pan and toast. If you have any of the optional mint leaves, spread the leaves over top of bread. Drizzle with olive oil and olive oil. Mix together the cheese and the spices. Spread on top of bread and bake at 375f for 10 minutes or until cheese melts. Enjoy as is or add chopped onions, tomatoes, bacon sticks or grilled fish.

title: Persian Style White Onions for Those Who Need To Eat
ingredients: 2 lbs white onions, peeled | 1/2 cup dried currant
instructions: Wash onions thoroughly and slice very thinly. Place onions in boiling salted water, cover, and cook until tender. Drain and remove as much water as necessary to remove skins. Cool and then cut in very thin slices. Stir currants into onions. Note, if you plan to serve this at the same time, you can also place cooked onion in a large bowl and cover with very hot tap water.

title: Coffee Vodka With Un-Strain Coffee
ingredients: 1/2 lb espresso flavored vodka | 1 can vegetable broth ( use a mix of the two if possible ) | 1 cup sun-dried tomato, roughly torn | 1/2 cup coffee ( i like decaffeinated )
instructions: In a 1 - ½ quart glass measure, mix together the espresso liquor, vegetable broth and tomatoes. Strain into 4 glasses and add a dollop of coffee. Drink immediately, i like it chilled, but as soon as you serve, you can freeze this. You can add ice cubes if you do.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,heavy cream,graham cracker crumb,white flour,lettuce leaf,hard egg,red chile pepper,guacamole
title: Guacamole and Chilli Crumble Cakes
ingredients: 85 g wholemeal plain flour | 85 g white flour | 2 teaspoons freshly ground red chile pepper | 75 g freshly grated graham cracker crumbs | 150 ml heavy cream | 4 hard-boiled eggs, chopped | 1 tablespoon guacamole, or to taste | lettuce leaves
instructions: Heat an oven to 200 degrees c. Lightly grease a 9 inch x 9 inch slice pan with cooking oil spray. Whisk the plain and white flours, chile, crumbs, cream and egg together in a bowl. Stir in the guacamole until combined. Spoon into the prepared pan. Bake in the oven until the edges are golden and the cakes just beginning to turn crisp and dry around the edges, 20 to 25 minutes. Serve with lettuce leaves.

Random Ingredients: castor sugar,hard egg,italian prune plum,cardamom,risotto rice
title: Scalloped Orchards With Italian Plum Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups castor sugar | 3 hard-boiled eggs, shelled, quartered | 5 large italian prune plums | 4 cups risotto rice | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. Wrap sugar in a small package of kitchen towel. In oven proof skillet, heat sugar over moderate heat, swirling skillet, until sugar melts and coats bottom. Cook, undisturbed, until amber forms on bottom. Quickly stir hard cooked eggs, prunes and 2 cups water into sugar mixture through strainer. Cover and bake in middle of oven 25 to 30 minutes. Stir rice and cardamom into warm sauce. Spoon heated rice onto waxed paper lined sheet pan. Sprinkle top with additional sugar. Cool completely.

title: Green Goddess - Like Olive Garden's Olive Oil
ingredients: 1/2 cup lemon extract ( can be replaced with olive oil ) | 1 -2 -4 drop green food coloring
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together and pour into a glass or a glass jar for a gift giving or a gift plate for your gift list.

title: Macadamia-Prosciutto Wrapped in Adobo
ingredients: 1 lb macadamia nuts ( about half an 11/3'package ) | 2 ounces prosciutto, sliced thin | 2 tablespoons adobo sauce ( from a can of chipotle peppers )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Place macadamia nuts, prosciutto slices and chipotle peppers on a cookie sheet. Spread thinly on top. Seal and toss once during the drying process. Bake for about 1 hour..

Random Ingredients: water chestnut,ear corn,tabasco sauce,bicarbonate soda,garlic clove,margarita mix
title: Halloween Chilli-Garlic Corn Fritters
ingredients: 1 packet ear of corn, thawed and drained | 1 cup water chestnut, finely chopped ( or canned drained canned with their liquid ) | 2 garlic cloves, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 2 tablespoons margarita mix | 3 drops tabasco sauce, to taste
instructions: Place corn in a frying pan with the water chestnuts and garlic. Add the bicarb and mix until dissolved. Add the margarita mix. Stir and heat until mixture is warm, but not hot.

Random Ingredients: apple juice,vanilla ice cream,dijon mustard,rom tomato
title: Baked Roma Tomato & Apple Dijon Sundae
ingredients: 4 roma tomatoes | 3 tablespoons dijon-style prepared mustard ( to taste ) | 4 tablespoons apple juice ( can use juice from can of roma tomatoes and or a splash of apple nectar ) | 4 tablespoons apple juice | 4 tablespoons dijon mustard ( to taste ) | 8 scoops vanilla ice cream ( or your favorite flavored ice cream )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Core tomatoes, slice tops off and lay in jelly roll pan cut side down, about 1 1/2 inches apart, with the cut side down. Dijon mustard & dill dressing, whisk together the can of apple juice and apple nectar & stir until well mixed. Pour over tomatoes & cover with foil. Bake for 20 minutes. Remove foil, sprinkle top of tomatoes with apples and top with a scoop of vanilla ice cream & bake an additional 5 - 10 minutes. If desired ice cream topping, drizzle with a little dijon mustard & sprinkle with a touch of dijon mustard.

title: Crab and Broccoli with Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/2 package broccoli coleslaw mix | 1/2 pound coarsely cut bacon, cut into pieces | 2 packages fresh crabmeat, coarsely chopped | 4 fresh white mushrooms, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line a colander with a round of cheesecloth, and place over a pot. Stir crabmeat into colander to completely drain water. Wrap bacon pieces around the cheesecloth, and place in the prepared colander. Bake in the preheated oven until bacon is browned, about 10 minutes.

title: Mexican Red Rice Poblano Chile Con Chili
ingredients: 5 poblano chiles | 2 cups jasmine rice | 2 1/2 cups broth | 1/4 cup chili beans in chili sauce | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 1 1/2 cups shredded gruyere or 1 1/2 cups other cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Place the peppers on a baking sheet and roast under the broiler for about 20 minutes or until blackened. Remove peppers from the oven. Cut along the sides of the peppers and remove seeds. In a small sauce pan, mix the chili beans with the broth. Let simmer for 15 minutes. Sprinkle the rice with the pepper mixture. Spread the chili beans over the rice in an even layer. In a small baking dish, combine some cheese and some shredded cheese. Place under the broiler for about 5 minutes or until cheese is bubbly, and browned.

Random Ingredients: italian tomato,turmeric powder,wheat bread,garam masala powder
title: Microwave Spiced Tomato Bread (Niter Kebab)
ingredients: 1/2 lb whole wheat bread ( i use whole crusty ) | 1/2 tablespoon turmeric powder | 3 tablespoons dried italian-style tomatoes, crumbled ( or equivalent fresh tomato finely chopped ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons garam masala powder ( or curry powder, use optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 200°c/400°f. Place bread slices over medium heat in microwave safe bowl. Microwave on full power 2 minutes or to desired crispiness. Remove bread from microwave bowl. Combine first 3 ingredients with hands. Press into greased microwave safe dish. Microwave on full power for 10 - 12 minutes or until light brown and bread is puffed up, crisp, golden and crisp in places. Allow to cool slightly. Spread remaining contents of microwave safe dish onto toast. Sprinkle with garam masala.

title: Easy Janssen's Baked Beans
ingredients: 1 lb pinto beans, washed and drained | 1/2 cup broth or 1/2 cup water | 1 teaspoon dried dill pickle ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 and line a 15 by 10 by 1/2 inch baking pan with a rim. Pour about 1 cup of the beans, broth or water into a large saucepan and boil until they begin to split, about 15 minutes. While the liquid boils, toast the dill pickle in a dry small skillet over medium high heat until browned, about 1 minute. Drain the pickle, reserving the liquid. Spread the pickle in the prepared baking pan. If desired, sprinkle the pickle with 1/2 cup of the pickle soaking liquid, and pour over the beans. Bake, covered tightly with foil, for about 40 minutes.

title: Quinoa Quinoa Cheese Appetizers
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs quinoa, picked over | 3 1/4 ounces shiitake mushrooms, chopped | 2 -3 inches fresh gingerroot, grated | 2 medium sized lemons, juice of | 2/3 cup chutney | 1 garlic clove | 1/3 cup sugar cube | 6 ounces grated gruyere cheese
instructions: Boil the quinoa in water with two teaspoons salt. Allow to boil for a few minutes and set aside. Grate the zest from 1/4 lemon, squeeze the juice out and set a small bowl aside. Place the mushrooms in a small saucepan with the grated ginger with a teaspoon of salt. Sauté until the ginger softens and becomes golden brown in color. Add the grated lemon zest, chutney, garlic and sugar and sauté for 2 - 3 minutes. Remove from heat. Drain the quinoa. Place the quinoa in a large bowl and add the chutney mixture, and then mix everything together. Spoon mixture into the cheese lined bread pans. Bake on middle rack of 350 degrees for 20 minutes until the top is golden brown.

Random Ingredients: tomatillo,rice noodle,flour tortilla,pine nut,broad egg noodle
title: Fried Noodles With Tomatillo Ranch Sauce
ingredients: 4 -5 large tomatillos, husked and finely chopped | 2 cups broad egg noodles, cooked | 1 cup rice noodles, cooked | 2 flour tortillas | pine nuts ( garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Meanwhile, in a small skillet over medium heat, warm 1 - 2 tb oil. Cook the tomatillos till they begin to soften and give off their juices about 10 - 15 minutes, being careful not to blacken them. Transfer to a blender and add the egg noodles, 1 cup of the cooked pasta water and the rest of the cooked ingredients. Puree. As soon as the sauce begins to thicken, spoon into individual serving bowls and sprinkle with pine nuts.

title: Mushroom and Olive Dip
ingredients: 1 cup plain yogurt, drained | 1 cup mixed mushrooms and olives, drained | ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Stir yogurt and mushrooms together in a glass baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until warm and lightly toasted. Season generously with pepper.

title: Chinese Steak With Tangy Tahini Dip
ingredients: 1/4 cup light sesame tahini | 1 package beef tenderloin, 1 inch thick | 1 tablespoon chinese hot mustard | 1/2 cup thousand island dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients.

title: Quick Black Bean Soup With Mint
ingredients: 2 cans black beans, drained and rinsed | 4 cups stock | 1 1/2 tablespoons dijon mustard ( optional ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons hot sauce ( optional ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons accent seasoning ( optional ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons italian parsley, finely chopped ( or a mix of both ) | 1 tablespoon of fresh mint, finely chopped ( or a mix of both ) or 1 tablespoon dill ( or a mix of both )
instructions: Measure and rinse the black beans. Rinse and drain well and add enough stock to make 3 cups. You can add more stock, if necessary. Add remaining ingredients except mint and dill. Bring soup to boil and reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 1 hour. Stir well and add mint and dill. Serve hot. You can add a pinch of dried basil if desired. I have also added other herbs such as dried basil and a sprinkling of oregano. Sometimes i add garlic and/or sautéed onions with the dried herbs and garlic.

title: Lazy Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 4 beef tenderloin steaks | 2 cans italian-style tomatoes, undrained | 4 teaspoons arrowroot | 2 cups chopped fresh asparagus | 1 package egg noodles
instructions: Place steaks in a 9x12 inch baking dish. Place tomatoes in food processor or blender.

title: Welsh Cottage Pie - With a Crackling Beef and Dumplings
ingredients: 1 lb beef brisket | 1/4 cup split yellow peas | 2 1/2 cups beef stock | 1 tablespoon coriander powder | 1 teaspoon sage | 2 slices bread or 4 slices egg roll
instructions: Put first four ingredients into a 2 qt crockpot and cook on low 10 to 12 hours. Remove meat, shred with 2 forks and return to pot. Boil up the beef stock and then stir in the coriander and sage. Add dumplings and place back into pot. Cook on high for 1 hour or until dumplings are browned.

title: Simple and Easy Low Calentiche Lasagna
ingredients: 8 ounces whole wheat lasagna noodles | 1 head cabbage
instructions: Cut a slit along one side of one onion. Preheat oven to 375°f. Wash the cabbage and trim off any dark spots. Rinse your cabbage well, if it’s too wet it won’t be able to cut in the lasagna. Lay a few noodles in a greased 8x8 or 9x9 pan. Spread 2 cups of cabbage leaves out flat with your hand. Lay 4 noodine slices in the pan. Cover with the chopped onion. Cover with the rest of your cabbage. Cover with a dry pan lid. Cook for 45 minutes. You may uncover the lid half way through the cooking time if this leaks. When you uncover, let the lasagna cook until the top layer of leaves have crisped up and turned a bit brown. If you’re cooking it over medium heat… let it cook a bit longer to warm it up a bit. The key to this dish is to cover it with its lid and place it on the heat under the heat so it can steam away. You can use a microwave oven, but i recommend your oven for this step and use a metal cooking container for this step. It’s a pain when you’re cooking it over boiling water… and you’ll have to take the lid off to keep stirring. After 30 minutes, taste and adjust seasoning. It’s ready to be eaten now.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,chunky salsa,green bean,iceberg lettuce,dark rum,brandy,water
title: Green Beans & Smoked Lettuce in Cream
ingredients: 4 cups water | 8 ounces frozen green beans, thawed | 4 ounces smoked lindt bell pepper slices ( preferably spanish ) | 2 heads iceberg lettuce, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup dark rum | 1/4 cup chunky salsa | fresh italian parsley, chopped ( garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: In a 5 to 6 cup saucepan combine the water and the beans and simmer, covered, for 45 minutes or until the beans are crisp tender. Transfer the beans to a bowl and pour off all but 1 tablespoon of the cooking liquid. Stir the beans into the liquid with the lindt bell pepper slices and lettuce. Add the rum, salsa, and parsley, season to taste with additional salt and the reserved cooking liquid, if desired.

Random Ingredients: lamb steak,nuoc nam,vanilla sugar,cream chicken soup,halloumi cheese,yeast,bok choy,penne
title: Lamb Ka Neopatra
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups penne, cooked and drained | 500 g lamb steaks, sliced super thin | 100 g halloumi cheese or 100 g goat cheese, sliced super thin | 1 liter cream of chicken soup, low fat is fine | 1 teaspoon dried yeast | 1 tablespoon nam pla ( vietnamese fish sauce ) | 1/2 cup nuoc nam | 1/2 cup vanilla sugar
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in the cream, nam pla, and nuoc nam. Stir in remaining ingredients and heat till boiling. Serve over cooked penne and top with your favorite veggies such as mushrooms, onions, and hard cooked egg slices.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,chili paste,vegetable stock,cream chicken soup,hot sauce,lime wedge,green chile pepper,alfredo sauce
title: Alfredo Soup
ingredients: 2 cans condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 1/2 cups vegetable stock | 2 tablespoons chili paste | 1 cup alfredo sauce | 3/4 cup grand marnier | hot sauce to taste ( optional ) | 6 lime wedges ( optional )
instructions: Blend the cream of chicken soup, vegetable stock, chili paste, alfredo sauce, and grand marnier in a blender until smooth. Garnish with hot sauce, lime wedges, and additional green chile peppers to taste.

title: Fried Basil Hummus
ingredients: 1 cup vegetable oil for frying, or as needed | 2 cups fresh basil, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup tahini, plus more for drizzling | 3 1/2 tablespoons low-sodium chicken broth ( optional ) | 1/2 vanilla bean, split lengthwise | 1/4 teaspoon fennel ( optional ) | 1 cup oil for frying, or as needed
instructions: Bring 2 cups vegetable oil to a large, heavy skillet over medium high heat. Combine the basil, tahini, chicken broth, vanilla bean, and fennel in a blender, and process until smooth. Continue to stir occasionally until the mixture is smooth, 1 to 2 minutes. Heat 1 1/2 tablespoons oil, or as needed, in a deep fryer or large saucepan to 375 degrees f. Pour the basil mixture into a spoonful, and gently form into small, cigar shaped patties. Fry in the hot oil until golden brown on all sides, 3 to 5 minutes per batch.

title: Indian Style Stuffed Ricotta Bottoms
ingredients: 200 g ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup shredded coconut flakes | 1 tablespoon rock salt | 3 tablespoons oil
instructions: First, put the ricotta on wax paper, or in an airtight container. Add the remaining ingredients and mix until it resembles a dough. If necessary, roll out a little more to form a ball. Heat up a small pan with a little oil to medium heat. When the oil begins to smoke, put the flattened ricotta into the pan and turn the heat off, leaving the ricotta to cool down in the oil, taking care not to let the ricotta get sticky or burned. Wrap the ricotta back in the pan and let it rest for about 20 minutes, then remove the papertowels and serve the ricotta as it is.

title: Creamy Pecan-Crusted Ciabati Bread
ingredients: 1 baguette, split diagonally | 1/4 cup double cream, 35g | 2 tablespoons fresh cilantro leaves | 1 vanilla beans, split and scraped | 3/4 cup fresh bean sprout
instructions: Preheat an oven to 200c. Lightly oil a baking tray. Cut the bread diagonally into 12 slices. Use a teaspoon to flatten each slice to about 5cm thick, 3 4cm in diameter. Spread a little cream over the bread, making sure it coats the surface evenly. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon of cilantro on each, place a slice of bread on top, and then top with another slice of bread. Heat any remaining cream in a small saucepan over medium heat. Transfer one of the cakes at a time to the baking tray, and drizzle with a little of the cream. Cook in the oven for 6 minutes, or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: lettuce,raspberry preserve,beef chuck roast,white flour,tea,tomato,chickpea flour
title: Irish Pot Roast
ingredients: 1 -3 lb boneless beef chuck roast | 4 cups cold brewed tea | 2 cans chickpea flour | 2 tablespoons tomato-flavored flour | 1 1/2 cups seedless raspberry preserves | 3 -4 leaves lettuce
instructions: Prick roast with a fork. Place in covered roasting pan, pour cold tea over all. Cook covered on low heat 4 to 5 hours. Remove roast, reserving the tea. Skim off any fat. Remove roast from saucepan. Discard bones. Place in large bowl. Skim fat from sauce pan drippings. Add flour and tomato flavor. Stir to blend. Stir in preserves. Pour over roast. Cover. Let stand 5 hours. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Pour gravy into large roasting pan. Sprinkle with remaining ingredients. Cover pan tightly with 2 to 3 sheets of aluminum foil. Place potatoes on foil tent. Bake 1 hour. Uncover.

title: Easy and No Fuss No Fluffy Popcorn Nests
ingredients: 2 teaspoons espresso powder | 1/4 cup peanut butter or 1/4 cup low fat margarine, softened | 2 teaspoons canned soup vegetables, drained, heated
instructions: In small bowl, mix powdered espresso and butter.

Random Ingredients: chicken fillet,vegetable oil,coconut syrup,cream cheese,white vinegar
title: Cream Cheese Chicken
ingredients: 2 chicken fillets | 2 tablespoons white vinegar ( white ) | 8 ounces cream cheese ( light is fine ) | 2 tablespoons coconut syrup ( optional ) | vegetable oil ( for deep frying )
instructions: Rub the chicken with the vinegar and set aside for 15 minutes. Remove and discard the skin and bones from the chicken. Cut into 2 cm cubes, and set aside. Mix the cream cheese, coconut syrup and sugar in a pan until it dissolves and starts to simmer. Set aside. Heat the oil in a large bowl, or deep fryer on medium setting. Dip the chicken pieces in the coconut cream mixture for a few seconds until they are golden brown. Remove chicken and drain on paper towels. Pour the coconut cream mixture into the heated oil and cook until the chicken has browned, and is beginning to crisp up. Serve immediately, or reheat in the microwave until serving. To keep it hot while frying, put in a sieve and shake to remove excess oil. Serve with rice, or as an accompaniment to a chinese meal.

Random Ingredients: soymilk,black olive,linguine,sea salt black pepper,green chilies,baking potato,iceberg lettuce
title: Linguine with Lettuce and Green Chilies
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce, washed trimmed and coarsely chopped | 1 baking potato, peeled, cut into chunks | 2 cups soymilk | 1 can chopped green chilies, seeded and deveined | 1 cup chopped black olives | 3/4 cup dry sea salt and cracked black pepper | 8 ounces linguine, cooked, drained, rinsed
instructions: Place lettuce in a serving bowl. Add potatoes, soy milk, chilies and olives, mixing well. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Set aside. To serve, mix together linguine. Spoon over salad.

title: Easy Bistro Spareribs
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs spareribs, cut in large pieces | 1 -2 teaspoon taco seasoning | 6 -8 ounces shredded mexican blend cheese or 6 -8 ounces shredded monterey jack cheese | spareribs | basil pesto | extra beef, slices
instructions: Place meat in large resealable plastic bag or other container with the taco seasoning and 1 3/4 cup water. Shake to coat the meat evenly. Refrigerate 30 minutes or longer. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Spread the meat over the bottom of a shallow baking dish. Sprinkle cheese over the meat. Bake uncovered for 30 - 40 minutes to an hour or until meat is well done. Serve on bed of spaghetti, rice, or mashed potatoes. Serve with a green salad. Great with a side of fresh fruit. Enjoy.

title: Gurkensalat (German Cucumber Salad)
ingredients: 1 medium cucumber, halved and thinly sliced | white pepper to taste
instructions: Drain the cucumber slices on paper towels. Sprinkle slices with white pepper. Serve and enjoy.

title: Roasted Spinach Salad
ingredients: 1 lb fresh spinach, washed, dried and torn into bite size pieces | 0.333 package hidden valley dressing | 1/4 cup tahini | 4 tablespoons fresh ranch salad dressing | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: Put all the ingredients in a large salad bowl and mix. Serve cold.

Random Ingredients: asparagus,mung bean sprout,chuck,brown sugar,yellow squash,ha avocadoes,canola oil,russet potato
title: Roasted Beef and Veggies With Mung Bean Sprouts
ingredients: 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 1/2 lbs chuck, trimmed, cut crosswise into 1-inch-thick slices | 3 medium russet potatoes, quartered if large | 1 small yellow squash, quartered if large | 1 small asparagus ( optional ) | 1 large hass avocado ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons packed brown sugar | 6 sheets trimmed napa cabbage ( about 8-12 cups )
instructions: Preheat oven to 475°f. Oil a large shallow roasting pan with oil. Lightly sprinkle beef with salt and pepper. Arrange meat on pan, cut side down. Spray with cooking spray. Roast until meat thermometer inserted into center of meat registers 125°f, about 30 minutes. Using a meat thermometer, monitor meat, if necessary, for 30 minutes. Decrease oven temperature to 375°f. Meanwhile, scrub potatoes, trim ends, and cut into 1/4 inch slices. Halve avocado lengthwise, and slice crosswise into 1/4 inch wide slices. Combine avocado and brown sugar in medium bowl, and toss with just enough water to coat. Add potatoes to meat mixture. Transfer mixture to center of roasting pan, arranging vegetables in overlapping rows, and roast about 25 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Discard any excess fat. Toss with cabbage, if using and serve meat and vegetables hot or at room temperature.

title: Rhubarb Bruschetta
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread ( or any other rustic bread like baguette ) | 8 ounces frozen rhubarb, thawed | 1 cup grated romano cheese
instructions: Cut bread lengthwise, being careful not to slice all the way through. With a slotted spoon, scoop out bread from bread leaving a thick shell, about ¼ inch thick. Arrange on a baking sheet to catch any drips that come off, and sprinkle with salt. Bake at 400°f until tender, around 10 minutes, when tapped, bread should be crisp, slightly golden and creamy inside. While bread is baking, combine rhubarb with 1 cup of romano cheese in medium bowl and set aside. When bread is done, remove from oven and cut into ¾ inch slices, removing a few at a time to serve on the side. Spoon warm rhubarb sauce between slices.. Serve warm.

title: Dried Apricot Jam  and Scrapings
ingredients: 1/4 cup dried apricot jam | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil
instructions: Spread jam on a plate. Roll up jelly roll style, then sprinkle with sesame oil. Serve warm or cool.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,pepperoncini pepper,yeast,baby spinach leaf,turmeric
title: Spinach and Spinach with Pepperoncini
ingredients: 800 g baby spinach leaves | 25 g fresh ground pepperoncini peppers | 1 teaspoon instant yeast | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1 teaspoon salt and black pepper
instructions: Place spinach on a microwave safe bowl, sprinkle the pepperoncini, and cook on medium high, stirring every 30 seconds, until the spinach is wilted. Sprinkle the yeast over the spinach and let it stand for 5 minutes to activate the yeast and make it creamy. Add the turmeric, salt and pepper and combine. Transfer to a bowl and cover with a tea towel, let rise in a warm place for about an hour until the spinach has absorbed the liquid and becomes thick and sticky. Turn onto a lightly floured surface, knead briefly, and divide into 6 portions. Place each portion of dough into a clean, well oiled 5 litre bowl and stretch it until it is 6cm in diameter. Roll out into a thick 10cm circle on a lightly floured surface. Cover with another tea towel and allow to rise for 10 minutes until doubled. Sprinkle the dough with a little water, and then stretch it again to make it 14cm in diamre thick and 8cm in diameter. Place the spinach mixture into the centre of the dough, gently press it down, the edges of the dough should seal and there are no pockes of dough. Allow to rise in a warm place for a further 20 minutes until the spinach is just set. Carefully peel away the tea towel and cut into slices. Leave to rest for a few minutes on a board or tray. Turn each slice upside down, spread a light film of oil over the spinach and serve.

title: Spiced Cauliflower

Sprinkle top with olives just before serving. Note, you may want to add more cocoa and/or grated cheese to your taste. I have made this with all of my ingredients and liked the result. If you like, it can be drizzled onto the surface before adding the garnish.

Random Ingredients: coconut meat,cocoa,almond extract,guacamole,coconut oil,pomegranate molasses,dill weed,stewing beef

If you need time, let it sit for 5 - 10 minutes in a paper towel. Serve in soup bowls with garnish.

title: Apple Couscous With Chiles & Apples (Mark Bittman)

instructions: Boil the water then add in the chopped chipotle chili peppers and chopped bread. Cover and simmer for 2 - 3 minutes. Remove the chili seeds if you like them. Remove bread slices from the liquid you'll be using to cool slightly. In a bowl, soak the drained bread in enough of the liquid to moisten but not saturate. Add this to the bread until everything is blended. Add the spices to the bread and mix. Put mixture in a serving dish, cover and chill for at least an hour. Serve with steamed couscous or milk.

instructions: In a small bowl, combine parsley, thyme and hot pepper sauce. Add chicken. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Drain chicken and toss with 1 tblsps. Of the water. instructions: In a medium bowl, combine olives, bell pepper, dill, and cayenne. Cover, and refrigerate for 2 hours to blend flavors.

title: Grape Tomato Salsa (Vietnamese - Cooking)

Peel the scallions and cut into 2 inch lengths and add to the tomatoes, along with the scallions. Add enough water to cover the tomatoes and bring to a boil. Simmer over low heat for 15 - 20 minutes, or until most of the liquid has been reduced and the tomatoes are very tender. Transfer the salsa to a serving bowl and allow to mature for 1 hour. Serve at room temperature, preferably with garlic bread.

instructions: Trim excess external fat from meat. Place meat in crock pot. Pour undiluted soup over meat. Turn crock pot on high for 3 hours and turn to low for up to 4 hours. Sprinkle top of stew with white wine and serve.

instructions: Place sirloin pieces, salsa and olives in crock pot, adding the pepper. Cover and cook on low 4 - 6 hours. Remove beef and slice into thin strips. instructions: Pre heat oven to 400 degrees f. Wrap cauliflower and squash into a small square of aluminum foil. Spray with nonstick cooking spray or brush with oil. instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Arrange pork in a 1 quart shallow baking pan. Sprinkle with olives, celery and 1 - ½ teaspoons salt. Bake 20 minutes discard any remaining liquid in pan. Unroll 2 can rolls.
