title: Mushroom Chicken Wings
ingredients: 6 chicken wings | 1 can cream of mushroom soup, can use cream of chicken | 2 -3 fresh red chili peppers | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 2 tablespoons currants or 2 tablespoons raisins
instructions: Place chicken in a large, deep dish. Mix all other ingredients and pour over the chicken. Cover with plastic wrap and allow to marinate in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours, or in the refrigerator overnight. Drain chicken wings and cook in a deep frying pan or electric skillet over medium heat. When cooked through and lightly browned, place on a paper towel to drain excess grease. Top with your favorite sauce and sour cream or gravy, fresh tomato wedges, and crème fraiche or cheese if desired.

title: Beef and Vegetables With Safflower Oil
ingredients: 1 lb stir fry vegetables | 4 teaspoons safflower oil | 1 lb ground beef
instructions: Saute vegetables with 1 tsp of safflower oil. Spread on a baking sheet and place in 350 oven. Brown 1 tsp of safflower oil for 7 - 10 minuts or until tender. Roll meat and fry until thoroughly cooked. Top with sauteed vegetables.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,egg white,red cabbage,kielbasa,ginger root,wonton wrapper
title: Red Cabbage Dumplings
ingredients: 1 package wonton wrappers | 1 pound kielbasa with casings removed, diced | 1 egg white, beaten | 1 cup grated pecorino romano cheese | 1 head red cabbage, cored and shredded | 4 tablespoons grated fresh ginger root
instructions: Place a small bowl of water into a large pot and bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: hot green chili pepper,white sesame seed,dijon mustard,bamboo shoot,vidalia onion,phyllo dough,parchment paper,bread
title: Phyllo Salad Phyllo Roll with a Hot Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 small vidalia onion, very thinly sliced | 1 1/2 lbs fresh bread slices, cut on and away from crusts | 1/2 pint black bamboo shoot, sliced | 1/2 fresh hot green chili pepper, chopped | 1/2 lb white sesame seeds | 2 ounces white sesame seeds | toasted bread roll sheet | 1/2 lb phyllo dough sheets, thawed if frozen | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard
instructions: Place onion slices and the remaining ingredients except cabbage in the bottom of a large bowl. Place a sheet of phyllo dough in the refrigerator, and while still hot, roll it into a log and cut into four squares. Place on a cookie sheet and brush the surface generously with dijon. Preheat the oven to roll out the phyllo dough into a rectangle that is about 10 x 6 inches and about 10 x 12 inches. Sprinkle the dough with a little more dijon. Make a slit in the corner of each pastry square to create a cross. Place 1/3 cup of the vegetable mixture on the cut end of each square. Top with strips of phyllo, brushing generously with dijon. Bring the sides over the filling and roll up. Place on a cookie sheet, seam side down, and brush with dijon. Repeat with another layer of phyllo but then brush with dijon again. Bake for 30 minutes, until golden brown.

title: Homemade Romaine lettuce
ingredients: 1 head lettuce | 3 cloves salt
instructions: Wash the lettuce and dry it thoroughly in the sink. Pull of the tough outer leaves like the head of lettuce. Drain the lettuce well, and sprinkle with salt. Set the lettuce on a serving platter. Place a knife on top, and slice in 2 or 3 sections, depending on the size of the leaf.

title: Corn and Pepper
ingredients: 4 ears fresh corn | white pepper to taste
instructions: Boil all together for 10 to 15 minutes. Remove from heat and place in a small serving bowl. Add pepper to taste.

Random Ingredients: honey,roast pork,hard egg,broccoli floret,butter bean,mustard seed,pinto bean,brown rice
title: Brown Beans with Rice, Pork & Eggs
ingredients: 1 lb roasted sweet pork | 1 can pinto beans | 1 can butter beans | 3 hard-boiled eggs | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 1 box brown rice | 1 package broccoli florets | 2 tablespoons honey
instructions: Place brown rice, beans and pork in large pot with about 4 cups of water, bring to a boil, reduce and simmer for about 1/2 hour until most of the liquid has cooked away. While the beans are cooking, slice eggs hard boiled eggs, separate egg yolks and whites from yolks. When the rice is tender and it reaches the desired doneness, add the yolks and beat together well. Pour rice and pork into large dish and add egg yolks, mustard seeds, and rice with vegetables and honey. Stir to mix. Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: oil,shortening,garam masala,pear,lemon pepper,beef stew meat,salmon steak
title: Gharam and Kaftas
ingredients: 1 tablespoon lemon pepper, or to taste | 2 teaspoons garam masala | 2 pounds beef stew meat | 2 1/2 pounds salmon steaks | 3 tablespoons shortening | 2 tablespoons oil | peeled and diced pear slices
instructions: In a bowl, mix together the lemon pepper, garam masala, and ground beef. Place salmon in a baking pan, and coat with shortening and oil. Pour the beef mixture over the meat and marinate for 2 to 6 hours in the refrigerator. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Bring oil and salmon to a boil in a skillet. Reduce heat to medium low, and simmer for 40 minutes, or until salmon is easily flaked with a fork. Serve with pears and lemon wedges.

Random Ingredients: steak,black peppercorn,lettuce leaf,linguine,pumpkin pie spice,fettuccine pasta,sea salt
title: Spiced Beef & Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 lb lean steak, trimmed of fat | 4 ounces dried fettuccine pasta | sea salt | black peppercorns, freshly crushed | 1 tablespoon pumpkin pie spice | 2 ounces lettuce leaves, chopped | 12 crisp lettuce leaves | 1 cup torn fresh lettuce | 12 flat leaf parsley leaves ( to garnish )
instructions: Cut the steak into 3 - 4 lengths. Trim and thinly slice across the grain. Cook in a large frying pan over low heat, stirring, for about 12 mins, or until the steak is cooked, stirring or shaking the pan occasionally, and golden. Meanwhile, bring the pasta to the boil and simmer for 8 minutes or until just tender. Drain and return the to the pan. Add the steak and spice and mix together well. Toss together the lettuce, pasta and the steak mix. Add extra seasoning and season with salt and pepper. Scatter with parsley and serve.

title: Pepperoni Greek Pizza
ingredients: 1 cup strawberry, cut in a half | 1/2 cup greek yogurt ( fat free ) | 2 tablespoons ketchup, ketchup | 3 tablespoons sweet hungarian paprika | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ground pepper
instructions: In a bowl, combine all ingredients and allow to combine in the fridge until ready to serve. Place pizza onto a pizza pan or oven rack lined with parchment paper, sprayed with pam. Cook @ 400 f for 12 minutes. Remove from oven and spread top lightly with sauce.

title: Fresh Star Anise Tea
ingredients: 4 inches cube star anise | fresh ice water, to taste | star anise tea, to taste
instructions: Scrape the star anise, then pop a few inches of fresh ice into a mug and pour in enough ice water to cover. Pour in the star anise. Serve cold.

title: Easy Homemade Seasoning Mix for Fish and Chips
ingredients: 1/8 teaspoon ground black pepper | 3/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/8 teaspoon adobo seasoning
instructions: Add all ingredients into a food processor in this order. Process until mixture resembles course meal. Store in refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: vidalia onion,caper,vegetable oil cooking spray,sharp cheddar cheese,tomato,currant,curry powder
title: Curried Cheese
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 teaspoons curry powder | 2 teaspoons capers, minced | 1 1/2 cups vidalia onions, chopped | 1 large tomatoes, chopped | 1/2 cup currants or 1/2 cup raisins | 1/2 cup sharp cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Cook curry powder in a small nonstick skillet over medium heat, stirring constantly, 1 minute or until fragrant. Stir in the capers and onions. Stir until vegetables are tender 2 to 3 minutes. Stir in tomato, currants, cheese and curry mixture, breaking up clumps as it sputters. Cover and cook over medium low heat 7 - 8 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Hibachi Street Lamb Kebabs
ingredients: 1 pound extra firm tofu, drained and rinsed | 2 packages baby purple cabbage, cut into small wedges | 8 racks lamb, thighs attached
instructions: Place tofu on a plate and press it into the tofu so all the tofu fits snugly. Place a layer of purple cabbage onto the skewers, about 1/2 inch deep, or vice versa. Use scissors to slash each rack of lamb at 2 or 3 places, then skewer the lamb onto the skewers. Marinate the lamb for at least 10 minutes. Cook the lamb over high heat in a large skillet for 6 to 7 minutes, turning over once, or until it is cooked through. Serve the kababs with the curry sauce or use your favorite dipping sauce.

Random Ingredients: thyme sprig,green chili pepper,curry,pecan half,beef chuck,pecorino romano cheese
title: Cousin Pete's Fancy Grilled Beef
ingredients: 1 beef chuck, trimmed | 1 - 1 1/2 cup pecorino romano cheese, grated | 1 1/2 tablespoons curry ( capelli recommended ) | 8 fresh thyme sprigs | 1 green chili pepper, chopped ( optional ) | 8 pecan halves
instructions: Cut chuck into serving size pieces. Place into crockpot and sprinkle each piece with pecorino cheese and curry. Pour boiling water over the cheese, bring to the boil and turn down to low. Cook beef for 5 - 6 hours. Remove thyme sprigs and chili pepper and stir into beef. Turn and cook for another 45 minutes. The dish is done once the cheese is just melted and a bit browned on top. Top with pecorino. Serve with a side of pasta or fettuccine.

title: Pavlova
ingredients: 1 tablespoon savory ( a spice in the jar ) | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar
instructions: Pound savory and rice vinegar until evenly mixed into a paste. Serve on lettuce leaves for presentation.

title: Beef and Noodle Pot
ingredients: 4 slices bacon, cut into small pieces | 6 ounces uncooked rice noodles | 7 ounces stewing beef, cut into small pieces | 1 1/2 cups quinoa | 2 cups beef broth | 1 jar spaghetti sauce | 1/2 cup plain low-fat yogurt | 2 cups cooked jasmine rice
instructions: Fry bacon in a large skillet over medium high heat until crisp. Stir in noodles. Cook and stir until crisp, then remove from skillet to paper towels to drain. Spray bottom of a 3 1/2 quart slow cooker with nonstick cooking spray. Place the beef in the slow cooker. Coat the beef with cooking spray. Place quinoa in a large bowl and cover with very hot tap water. Set aside for 10 minutes. Pour boiling water over the quinoa until it's covered. Heat the beef broth in the skillet. Pour into the slow cooker. Mix in the spaghetti sauce and simmer for 2 hours, stirring occasionally. When ready, stir in the cooked bacon.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,cumin powder,double cream,lime juice,jumbo shrimp
title: Camarones En Salsa Di Camarones
ingredients: 400 g jumbo shrimp | 1 tablespoon lime juice | 1 teaspoon ground cumin powder | 2 -3 kaffir lime leaves | 200 ml double cream
instructions: Shell the shrimp and devein, leaving the heads and tails intact. Place the shrimp in a large saucepan with the lime juice, cumin and lime leaves. Cook for 3 - 5 minutes over a medium high heat. Remove from the heat. Add the cream and stir to combine. Heat, stirring for 2 - 3 minutes or until it begins to thicken. Pour into 4 cup moulds and refrigerate until firm, then serve.

title: Beef and Onion Dip from the 70's
ingredients: 2 lbs ground beef or 2 lbs ground chicken | 1 can pizza sauce | 1 cup dry shredded coconut flakes, divided | 1 small onion
instructions: Brown, crumble and drain ground beef, drain. Add pizza sauce and 1/2 cup coconut. Mix thoroughly. Chop onion finely. Combine with beef mixture and remaining 1/2 cup coconut in a large, shallow casserole dish or large roasting pan. Cover and bake in 325 degrees oven about 1½ hrs... Let cool slightly before serving.

title: Chomeur Street Salad Dressing
ingredients: 2 teaspoons german mustard | 2 teaspoons oil | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1 cup chicken broth | 1/4 cup hazelnuts, finely chopped | 1/4 cup chopped chomeur fresh oregano | 1/2 cup quick cooking spray
instructions: Spread the mustard and oil on a plate. Dissolve oregano in broth and add to mustard oil. Add nuts and chomeur cheese. Pour dressing over nuts and cheese. Cover and refrigerate several hours to develop flavor.

title: Sausage and Squash
ingredients: 1 small onion, chopped | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh turkish squash | 1 pound lean ground turkey meat
instructions: Cook onion in a skillet with a splash of cooking spray until golden brown. Add squash and turkey, and cook on high for 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cheddar cheese,prawn,lettuce,basmati rice,cotija cheese,shiitake mushroom,parmesan cheese
title: Mexican Prawn and Rice Bake
ingredients: 2 cups prepared basmati rice | 200 g shiitake mushrooms, sliced | 300 g cooked prawns | 1 cup cheddar cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup cotija cheese, crumbled | 1/4 cup fresh basil, chopped | 2 cups shredded lettuce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f and lightly oil a 2 cup ovenproof dish. Cook rice until just tender and drain well. Place mushroom in a bowl with cheddar, Cotija cheese, basil and prawns. Toss to combine and transfer to prepared dish. Cover with foil and bake for 25 minutes. Remove foil and bake for 1 to 5 minutes longer or until prawns are just cooked.

Random Ingredients: pastry crust pie,tapioca,picante sauce,pecorino romano cheese,grand marnier
title: Pecorino Pie
ingredients: pastry for double-crust pie | 2 tablespoons tapioca, crumbled | 1/8 cup grand marnier | 32 fluid ounces picante sauce | 1/2 cup grated pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Mix together the tapioca and grand marnier in a bowl. Mix the cheese and 1/4 cup of pecorino romano in a bowl. Spread a half cup of grand marnier mixture in the bottom of the pastry. Combine a second half cup of grand marnier mixture and a third quarter cup of grand marnier mixture and 1/2 cup of grated cheese. Spread over the mixture in the pastry shell. Dot the top with the remaining tablespoon of grated cheese. Bake in the preheated oven 25 to 30 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.

Random Ingredients: leek,kaffir lime leaf,liquid smoke,curry paste,italian breadcrumb
title: Simple Curried Leeks
ingredients: 4 leeks, cleaned but not peeled | 4 teaspoons reduced sodium curry paste | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke | 2 teaspoons italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 2 kaffir lime leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Wash leeks and trim root ends. Slice crosswise into 1/4 inch to ¾ inch thick slices. Combine curry paste, liquid smoke and bread crumbs in large nonstick skillet. Add leeks and cook over medium heat, stirring often, about 3 to 4 minutes or until softened. Transfer leeks to large bowl. Spoon curry mixture evenly into leeks and toss to coat. Transfer to baking sheet. Roast until leeks are crisp and starting to brown, about 6 to 10 minutes. Cool 5 minutes, transfer to cutting board. Sprinkle tops with lime slices.

title: Stir Fry Vegetables
ingredients: 2 lbs beet, sliced ( or use beet or beet leaf ) | 2 lbs turnips, sliced | 1 1/2 lbs beets, sliced | 4 -5 small red hot chilies, seeded and finely diced | 1/2 cup corn oil | 2 teaspoons grated ginger root | 2 sprigs chopped fresh rosemary | 1 tablespoon chopped of fresh mint
instructions: In a wok, heat 2 tablespoons water. Add beet and turnip, cover and cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, until vegetables are dark green, about 5 minutes. Heat oil in a wok, add ginger and chilies, cook, stirring constantly, for 30 seconds. Add beetroot, stir fry briefly until fragrant. Add vegetable mixture, return to heat and stir well. Cook for another 30 seconds. Remove and discard rosemary sprigs. Stir in mint leaves and serve.

Random Ingredients: greek yogurt,carrot,sage leaf,heavy whipping cream,active yeast,coriander seed
title: Tarte (Cheese Bread)
ingredients: 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 teaspoon active dry yeast | 1 tablespoon olive ( or vegetable oil ) | 1 teaspoon coriander seed | 1 teaspoon crushed carrot ( or onion seeds ) | 20 sage leaves, fresh
instructions: In small saucepan, warm the cream and place over medium low heat. Stir in yeast and set aside. Meanwhile toast the coriander seeds in skillet and remove from heat. In another saucepan heat oil over medium and saute the carrots until soft. Set aside. In a bowl, pour cream/water over the carrot mixture. Stir in the coriander seeds. Cool down and stir in the dry yeast. The dough should be slightly sticky at this point. Dough will be a thick, slightly soft ball. Turn out onto a lightly floured surface and knead in the sage leaves for 5 - 7 minutes. Place into a lightly greased bowl, cover with plastic wrap or an oiled cake pan and let rise in a warm place until doubled. Punch down and divide into 8 pieces. Stretch each piece to fit pan, using a 4 inch round cutter to make the 4 pieces more or less rectangular. Cover and let rise until doubled. Preheat oven to 425°f. Brush a large cookie sheet or pizza stone lightly with olive oil. Place dough on pan, top with grated cheese and spread evenly with a teaspoon of grated cheese. Bake 10 - 12 minutes, or until crisp. Serve hot for dipping.

Random Ingredients: hungarian paprika,basmati rice,extra virgin olive oil
title: Nasi Lemak (Peppered Rice Nairobi Style)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 2 teaspoons sweet hungarian paprika ( hot or sweet ) | 1 cup short-grain basmati rice
instructions: Set your oven on the lowest setting. Place the oil in a small, heavy ovenproof skillet. Spread the paprika over the bottom of the pan so that you’ll be able to see the bottom with the oil. Place the pan over medium heat until the oil is warm. When the oil is warm to the touch, add your rice. The grains will absorb most of the oil and the grains will be colored a light tan color.. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the rice to a platter. Sprinkle the paprika over the rice, and serve warm. Nasi leak can be served warm with lemon wedges or cold with sour cream or yogurt.

title: Sizzling Ethiopian Beef on Asparagus (Sook Ewa)
ingredients: 1 lb beef sirloin | fresh ginger, sliced | 1 lb asparagus or 6 ounces other woody vegetable
instructions: Soak the sirloin in enough water to cover for 1 hour. Cut up the meat into thin bite sized pieces. Drain the sirloin and set aside. Prepare 3 - 4 dinner buns for oamc or toasted bread on the stove with oil in it. Cover the bottom with a few slices of asparagus or woody vegetables. Next, put the meat on top of the asparagus spears, then add another piece of asparagus. Add a bit of oil on top of each piece, and flip over so all sides have been covered. The beef should be on top the asparagus and meat side of the meat. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,italian dressing,fish,asian sesame oil,cranberry,white flour,barley
title: Baked Fish Casserole
ingredients: 2 lbs fish, white or 2 lbs other firm flesh fish fillets, skin removed | 1/2 cup white flour | 2 tablespoons prepared italian dressing | 1 tablespoon dried cranberries | 1 tablespoon mexican fish dressing | 1 tablespoon ground dried italian sesame oil | 2 cups packed mexican blend cheese | 3/4 cup barley
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Rinse fish under cold water. Drain well and pat dry with paper towel. Place fish in 1 gallon ziplock bag and shake to coat evenly. Place the fish in a 1 gallon casserole dish and add the 3/4 cup shredded cheese. Add all other ingredients to the bag and shake to combine. Stir well to combine. Pour over fish. Bake, uncovered for 1 hour, uncover and bake for an additional 20 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: mix,dijon mustard,cilantro leaf,queso fresco,wonton wrapper,cream,whipping cream
title: Mexican Quesito Wontons
ingredients: 1 package wonton wrappers | 1 cup sour cream | 2 cups queso fresco, finely crumbled | 1/4 cup whipping cream | 1/4 cup dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon dried cilantro leaves | 1 teaspoon low-sodium instant dijon-style prepared horseradish cream ( optional )
instructions: Combine sour cream, cheese and cream in a medium bowl. Cover and chill until ready to serve. Spread 1 tablespoon horseradish cream in center of wonton wrapper.

title: Mexican Vegetable Saute
ingredients: 2 tablespoons salad greens | 4 ounces portabella mushrooms | 1/4 cup sunflower oil | 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 4 jalapenos ( optional ) | 1/2 cup refried beans
instructions: Mix salad greens and mushrooms, sunflower oil, and jalapenos in a non stick pan. Saute in non stick oil for 2 - 3 minutes or until tender. Transfer veggies to a plate lined with paper towel. Cover with vegetables and refried beans and toss. Serve.

Random Ingredients: baking powder,sherry wine,chicken stock,thyme sprig,parsnip,green cardamom pod,baking potato,chick pea
title: Potato, Parsnip and Chickpea Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs baking potatoes, peeled and cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 lbs large parsnips, peeled, halved lengthwise and cut crosswise into 1/4-inch thick slices | 1 cup chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup sherry wine | 3 1/2 cups chicken stock | 4 cups chicken stock | 1 1 tablespoon baking powder | 1 teaspoon dried thyme ( or to taste ) | 1 fresh thyme sprig ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In a large soup pot or dutch oven, combine potatoes, parsnips, chickpeas and sherry. Cover pot and bring to a boil. Decrease heat and simmer until the vegetables are tender, about 20 minutes. Stir in 1 cup of 4 cups chicken stock and baking powder. Remove from heat and stir in the thyme. Transfer potato mixture to a large baking dish. Cover with foil, and bake for 30 minutes. Remove lid and bake an additional 30 minutes or until stew is thickened. Scoop into serving dishes and garnish with thyme sprigs.

title: Chinese Style Broccoli
ingredients: 1 teaspoon ground gingerroot | 1 teaspoon tomato paste | 4 lbs small broccoli
instructions: Peel and cut the broccoli into bite sized florets, then steam for 7 to 10 minutes or until they wilt. Meanwhile, combine ginger, tomato paste and 2 cups water on high heat. The heat should be high enough to steam the broccoli, not to splatter. Stir the broccoli into the simmering sauce as it steams. Allow the broccoli to cook in the sauce for 4 or 5 minutes, or until the broccoli is just tender. Serve hot with rice.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,red bell pepper,anchovy paste,saffron strand
title: Roasted Red Peppers
ingredients: 1 red bell pepper | 1 teaspoon saffron strand ( saffron ) | 1 tablespoon anchovy paste | any other vegetables or oil cooking spray
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c/fan 200c. Cut the green and orange skin off the bell pepper and remove the membrane and seeds. Place the bell pepper on a sheet tray, and brush with salt. Drizzle the oil and a little salt on the skin and top with the pepper pieces. Place in the oven for 20 minutes. Roast for a further 20 - 30 minutes or until the skin is tender and lightly browned. Remove from the oven and allow to cool. When cool, remove the skin, cut away the seeds and dice. Place the chopped bell pepper pieces in a small bowl with the saffron and anchovy paste. Dress with a little more salt, if desired, but not too much as they will burn during cooking.

title: Sesame Balsamic Glazes
ingredients: 1/2 cup cocoa powder | 2 teaspoons liquid honey | 1 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: In a small bowl, combine cocoa powder, honey, and garlic salt. Stir until combined. Stir in 1 to 2 tablespoons water.

title: Pomegranate-Pork Jam (Algerian Pork Dish)
ingredients: 500 g pomegranate seeds | 500 g pork | 550 g cherry tomatoes ( chopped in half if large )
instructions: Pre heat oven on 200°c. Peal your pork and slice thin as possible, making sure it's relatively thin and so will fit into a pyrex dish. Soak your cherry tomatoes in lukewarm water and then rinse them and add to a pyrex dish with 100ml water. Place the pomegranate seeds into boiling water for about 5 minutes. Drain and place the pomegranate water on the skin of the pork and place the pork on top of the cherry tomatoes. Place in the oven at 200°c and cook for for about 30 minutes or until a knife can insert easily and the pomegranate water stops sizzling and the tomatoes are starting to brown. Take out of the oven and pour the pomegranate water into a bowl. After the pomegranate water is fully absorbed, remove from the oven and pour to the bowl you used to soak the pomegranate seeds. Allow to cool and place in your fridge. This will take about 10 hours. Once you have finished, transfer the pork back into the fridge with your cherry tomatoes to allow you to set at least 10 hours. This will take away any excess saltiness or acids. I normally do this for about 8 hours after removing from the fridge and removing from the fridge, let the pork soften for about 1 and a half minutes and then break apart using a fork. Return the pork to the fridge and chill out for about one hour. Serve with some pomegranate flavored rice on your side to keep it moist.

Random Ingredients: oregano,pizza dough,grapeseed oil,basmati rice,red paprika,arborio rice,rice wine,tea
title: Italian Rice Wine Pizza for Two
ingredients: 1 tablespoon grapeseed oil | 2 cups arborio rice | 1 cup dry arborio rice wine | 1 teaspoon red paprika | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 6 ounces tea, divided into 4 pieces | 4 cups prepared pizza dough, such as boboli | 6 tablespoons finely chopped fresh basil and chives mixed with | 1 teaspoon finely grated coarse salt ( omit salt if rice wine is not available )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees fahrenheit. Coat a baking sheet with the grapeseed oil and sprinkle half the breads onto the baking sheet using the tines of a fork. In a medium pot of boiling water, cook arborio rice until tender, about 12 minutes. Drain and reserve rice. Rice wine sauce, in a 4 to 6 quart saucepan, combine rice wine, sweetener, paprika, and oregano. Bring to a boil over medium high heat, then reduce heat and simmer, without stirring, until most of broth is absorbed, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat and mix in half of the tea. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Split the pizza dough onto 1 pizza pan or cookie sheet. Sprinkle with half the basil and chives mixture and mozzarella cheese. Top with remaining pizza dough, mozzarella cheese, and more basil and chives.

title: Apriko - the Indian Breakfast Dish
ingredients: 1/2 cup nonfat dry milk powder | 1 cup buttermilk | 2 teaspoons mirin ( sweet rice wine ) | 1/4 cup of blanched almond, sliced
instructions: Pour all the ingredients into the blender and blend till the mixture is smooth. Pour into a glass dish/bowl and stir through sliced almonds until well coated.

Random Ingredients: ice cube,pumpkin seed,ra el hanout spice mix,rosemary,dream whip,semolina,ginger,pumpkin pie spice
title: Hainan's Fall Harvest Pumpkin Seed Mousse
ingredients: 1 package frozen pumpkin seeds ( i just use red pumpkins, but the other flavours work just fine too ) | 10 ice cubes, divided ( i freeze them for easy and quick slicing. ) | 1/2 cup raisins, finely chopped ( i use extra to garnish ) | 2 teaspoons fresh rosemary, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons dream whip | 2 teaspoons instant powdered ginger | 1 teaspoon pumpkin pie spice | 1/4 teaspoon instant powdered ginger | semolina
instructions: Place the pumpkin seeds in a large bowl and cover with 4 ice cubes. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside at room temp for 1 hour. Drain, pressing out excess water. Combine the cranberries, raisins, rosemary, dream whip, powdered ginger and pumpkin pie spice. Stir thoroughly. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and set aside to chill. Remove the seeds from their pods, leaving a little on the bottom, if you like. Preheat the oven, and line the baking sheets with parchment paper or foil. Using 2 teaspoons, scoop out about a teaspoon full of the mixture and place it inside the parchment lined sheets. Add the reserved 2 tablespoons of ice and give it a very lightly toasted shape. Sprinkle some seeds over and press a little seeds through with a spoon. Spread the remaining teaspoon of pumpkin seeds on the baking sheet. Bake for 25 - 35 minutes, until slightly puffed and golden. Cool for 15 minutes then mix them together. Serve, garnished with a little extra raisins.

Random Ingredients: white pearl onion,vanilla extract,queso fresco,chickpea flour,egg yolk
title: Guiltless Cottage Cheese Ravioli
ingredients: 1 cup white pearl onion | 1 can chickpea flour ( chickpea flour can be purchased from specialty food stores ) | 15 ounces white pearl onions | 1/2 cup queso fresco ( mexican, farmers cheese ) | 2 large egg yolks | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla extract ( or 1 tsp each ) or 1 1/2 teaspoons almond extract ( or 1 tsp each )
instructions: Drain and rinse the pearl onions. In a large saucepan, bring a big pot of water to boil. Meanwhile, combine the flour and drained chickpea cans in a colander. Sprinkle 2/3 of the water over the flour mixture. Mix well. Drain and rinse the onions. Drain well and place them in a large bowl. Add the drained chickpeas into the bowl with the flour mixture, mixing well. Add the pearl onions and finally, queso fresco cheese. Mix to incorporate. Lightly beat the yolks and add to the above mixture. Continue to beat until the mixture is smooth, and thick. Add the vanilla extract and mix well. Put in the refrigerator. When ready to freeze, preheat the oven to 425 degrees f and lightly grease a 9x13 baking dish. Pour the cheese mixture into the baking dish. Place the 9x13 inch pan in the freezer. The amount of oil will depend on the size of the ravioli, but it's worth it if you don't have a ravioli strainer, pasta roller or pasta machine. Place the ravioli in the oven on center rack and bake for 20 minutes. The ravioli should be golden brown and the cheese bubbly. Serve with a green salad and a nice glass of white wine.

Random Ingredients: tamari soy sauce,fish stock,pork chop,chinese cabbage,tart apple,milk powder
title: Chinese Pork Chops
ingredients: 4 chinese cabbage | 2 tablespoons tamari sweet soy sauce | 1 -2 tablespoon chinese pickled apples ( kikoman style recommended ) | 3 tablespoons tamari sweet soy sauce | 3/4 cup milk powder | 1/2 cup fish stock
instructions: Prepare the cabbage for the marinade and allow to sit for 10 to 15 minutes so the cabbage is dry. Drain and cut into 2 or 3 segments. Cut each piece into three or four slices. Thread the meat onto four or five skewers, starting on one end and leaving the other end free range at the other end. Tear off the remaining pieces of meat and thread it onto the thread. Make the sweet soy sauce by mixing about 1/4 cup of sweet soy sauce with 3 tablespoons of tamari, 1/4 cup of pickled apples, 1/4 cup of sweet soy sauce and 1/4 cup water in a small bowl. Pour over the chow mein noodles and toss to coat thoroughly. Cover and refrigerate overnight. The next day, heat the chow mein noodles until they begin to puff up a little around the edges and turn slightly golden, about 15 minutes. Drain the noodles and stir in the rest of the sweet soy sauce and pickled apples. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chicken tenderloin,chicken wing,green curry paste,chicken strip,mexican chocolate,orange peel,russet potato,red chile
title: Spicy Chicken Stew
ingredients: 3 lbs chicken thigh pieces | 2 pounds chicken wings | 1 pound russet potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced | 6 ounces mexican chocolate, chopped | 2 packages chicken-flavored frozen stir fry vegetables | 8 ounces orange peel, thinly sliced ( pith removed ) | 1 large red chile, sliced | 1 tablespoon green curry paste | 1 1/2 packages chicken tenders, cut into 2-inch lengths
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine chicken, legs, potatoes, chicken wings, and onions.

title: Roasted Trout
ingredients: 3 whole trout, cleaned of dirt | 3 -4 cups fresh basil leaves
instructions: In a large plastic or glass bowl, place your trout and any remaining juices from the fish bag. Toss the basil leaves around the fish and allow them to rest in the bag overnight. In the morning, pre heat your broiler and place the trout on the rack over the broiler tray. Place in the centre of the oven and cook for 2 - 3 minutes until the flakes on the top are crispy and lightly browned. Turn the broiler off and leave the fish to rest in the oven for 10 - 12 minutes before carving and serving with lemon wedges and a side of your favorite salad.

Random Ingredients: cinnamon,active yeast,white button mushroom,caster sugar,tequila,tomato juice,vegetable,salt
title: Pueblo Style Mushroom Hot Dog
ingredients: 500 g fresh white button mushrooms | 250 g crushed tomatoes with juice | 1 liter tomato juice or 1 liter v8 vegetable juice | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1 teaspoon caster sugar | 2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 10 g ground cinnamon | 4 cups warm milk
instructions: Dice up white button mushrooms and chop roughly. Mix all ingredients and leave for 1 hour. Dish up and eat.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,papaya,cream cheese,fennel seed,rom tomato,red kidney bean,fish sauce
title: Fennel and Chilli Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 can red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 500 g cream cheese | 2 teaspoons chili oil | 1 teaspoon papaya, chopped | 1 teaspoon fish sauce | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 3 roma tomatoes, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190oc/ fan forced. Mix all ingredients together in an oven proof dish. Bake, uncovered, for 30 mins, or until hot and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: pistachio,cellophane noodle,tomato green chile pepper,chicken bouillon granule,red potato,ritz cracker,coriander powder
title: Pistachio and Potato Ritz
ingredients: ritz crackers ( plain or flavored ) | 1 packet chicken bouillon granules ( regular or gluten-free ) | 1/2 cup chopped coriander powder | 1/2 cup chopped pistachios ( optional ) | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers ( regular or gluten-free ) | 4 medium red potatoes, cooked and cubed | 4 tablespoons cellophane noodles ( plain or gluten-free )
instructions: Place all ingredients in medium large saucepan and bring to a boil. Cover, reduce heat, and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Serve hot or cold with pita bread.

title: Sweet Potato and Ginger Salad With Lemongrass
ingredients: 4 lbs yukon gold potatoes ( cut into 1-inch cubes ) | 1 stalk lemongrass, trimmed and cut into 1/2-inch chunks | 2/3 cup cashew nuts ( finely chopped ) | marshmallows
instructions: Bring salted water to boil. Add potatoes.

title: Quick Rice and Beans (Mexican Style
ingredients: 1 package yellow rice ( long grain and medium grain ) | 1 can tomato sauce, not chunky ( not liquid )
instructions: Combine rice, tomato sauce, and tomato sauce in saucepan. Stir and bring to a boil. Cover and reduce heat to low. Let stand 5 minutes. Turn off heat and let sit a further 10 minutes to allow steam to escape.

Random Ingredients: worcestershire sauce,edamame,pepper,liquid honey,ranch dressing,sirloin tip roast,coconut milk,sirloin
title: Baked Beef Jerky for the BBQ
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin tip roast, cut into 1-inch slices | 1/2 cup dehydrated edamame | 1 can coconut milk | 1 cup ranch dressing | 1 cup worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon liquid honey | 1/2 teaspoon pepper | 3/4 cup sifted powdered dried onion flakes
instructions: Soak the sirloin strips in water for at least 30 minutes to soften. Rinse and drain the strips, then place in a large ziplock bag with the edamame, coconut milk, ranch dressing, worcestershire sauce, honey, pepper and onion flakes. Seal, and chill the bag for at least 1 hour, turning pieces over once. Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Place the beef strips in a foil lined 9x13 baking dish. Bake in the oven for 30 minutes, or until the strips are nicely browned. This may also be done on the stove top and can be served hot or cold.

title: Walnut Filling for Oysters
ingredients: 1 lb fresh walnuts, shelled or 8 ounces unsalted walnuts, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup oyster sauce
instructions: Place nuts and oyster sauce in a mortar and pound with fork to a powder. Gradually add remaining ingredients and mix well. Spoon or pipe mixture into pastry cases. Place on a rack to dry until dry.

title: Beets in Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb beet, unpeeled, scrubbed and sliced | 2 tablespoons lemon juice, from 1 lemon | 1 lb dry pasta
instructions: Add the beet slices to boiling water for about 4 - 8 minutes, or until just cooked. Drain and rinse with cold water. Drain again. Toss together with rest of the ingredients in a deep casserole dish. Cover. Bake at 400f degrees for 20 minutes or until hot.

title: Cranberry Sausage
ingredients: 3 ounces uncooked dry shell pasta | 1 tablespoon horseradish | 3 tablespoons dried cranberries
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain pasta, stir in horseradish and cranberries.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce heart,grain rice,self raising flour,tomato,red chilies
title: Rice and Tomato Wraps (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 11)
ingredients: 1 cup cooked long-grain rice | 2 large ripe tomatoes, halved, deseeded, finely chopped | 2 fresh red chilies, finely chopped | 2 1/2 cups self raising flour | 2 romaine lettuce hearts, to serve
instructions: Preheat oven to 210°c line 2 baking trays with baking paper. Stir rice, tomatoes, chillies, flour and 1 1/2 cups boiling water in a medium bowl until well combined. Spoon 1 tablespoon into each of 2 large paper lined trays. Top with lettuce and 1 1/2 teaspoons rice mixture. Roll up. Place on the trays and discard paper. Sprinkle each with 1 teaspoon salt and remaining 2 teaspoons rice mixture. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes until golden. Serve as is or with your choice of accompaniments.

title: Cheese Dumplings - Old World Style
ingredients: 1 lb curd cottage cheese | 1 leaf sage leaves ( optional ) or 1 leaf fresh sage ( optional )
instructions: Put the cottage cheese in a large bowl and sprinkle with sage or rage. Cover the bowl with a piece of plastic wrap and press on the cottage cheese with your hands until the cottage cheese is well coated. You can sprinkle the cottage cheese with a little salt as you press it out, or keep on your hands. The amount of water needed depends on the size of the cottage cheese. You may need enough water to make it fit into the bowl and then leave to sit covered for an hour or two. Meanwhile, bring 4 - 5 cups of water to a boil. Drop a few dumplings into the boiling water and stir vigorously until they rise to the surface. Add more water if the dumplings are sticking to the bottom. When the dumplings rise to the surface, they are done and can be set as they are. If they stick, drain the water from the bowl, pour off the water and place the dumplings on a plate to dry before serving.

title: A Fully-Accompany Salmon Steak
ingredients: 2 salmon steaks | 1 fresh green pepper, cut into 1/2 inch pieces
instructions: In a non stick skillet, preheat the broiler. Place the salmon steaks in the skillet. Sprinkle the green pepper over the surface of the fish. Broil to your liking or until fish just flakes easily. Serve with rice or pasta.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,broad egg noodle,natural yoghurt,kahlua,cheese,cheddar cheese
title: Cheese and Noodle Bake
ingredients: 1 package broad egg noodles | 1 1/3 cups natural yoghurt | 2 tablespoons kahlua | 3 tablespoons natural ghee ( clarified butter ) | 1/2 cup grated cheddar cheese | 1 tablespoon peanut oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Cook the noodles according to the package instructions, then drain. Whisk the yoghurt with kahlua and 1 tablespoon of the ghee. Stir in noodles, cheese and oil and transfer to an oiled, 2 - 3 ovenproof dishes. Bake in the preheated oven for 15 - 20 minutes, until golden and bubbling.

title: Simple and Quick Sausage Pizza
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups homemade instant breadsticks ( not instant ) | 1/8 cup dried tomato-onion and garlic | 1 1/2 lbs fresh ground sausage | 1 large celery rib | 1 large onion, chopped
instructions: Put yeast in a large bowl, add about 3 cups of warm water. Let stand 1 - 2 minutes to dissolve the yeast. Add 4 cups breadsticks to the bowl and place 1 cup dough onto the workspace. Add 4 more cups breadsticks along the way. Add the rest and separate dough into fourths. Add all of the sausage on the workspace. Place all of the breadsticks on the same dough and place under a medium preheated oven until golden brown, about 15 minutes. Place onto a work surface and slice into thin rounds, about 1/2 inch thick, on the same lightly floured workspace as the first batch. Place the toppings on the baking rack in your oven and allow the breads to bake at 550° for 8 - 10 minutes. Remove the baked pizzas from the oven and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: beef steak,cardamom powder,anise seed,broth,yellow bell pepper,whipping cream,prosciutto,king prawn
title: Prawn and Pepper Stir-Fry
ingredients: 500 g beef round steak, cut diagonally into strips | 1 large yellow bell pepper, seeds removed | 1 tablespoon whole anise seed | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom powder | 500 ml broth | 125 g prosciutto, diced | 300 ml whipping cream | 1 -2 tablespoon whipping cream
instructions: Heat a large wok or a large frying pan. Add beef in batches and stir fry about 4 minutes or until beef is golden and cooked. Remove beef with a slotted spoon and set aside. Add bell pepper and anise seeds to the same pan, cook about 30 seconds a side and remove pepper and anise seeds with a slotted spoon. Add to beef mixture and cook 1 minute. Reduce heat to medium and boil 1 minute or until liquid reduces slightly. Add broth and simmer 1 minute or until reduced. Return beef to pan and stir until heated through. Return stir fry ingredients to pan. Remove from heat and keep warm. Pour cream into saucepan to just barely warm through, stir in cream. Divide meat between serving bowls. Spoon sauce over.

title: Almond Chicken
ingredients: 1 medium chicken | 5 ounces sliced almonds | 10 fluid ounces beef broth | 1 tablespoon caster sugar
instructions: Remove entrails from chicken. Pound chicken until flat. Combine with almonds and broth. Place chicken on baking tray and place in oven of gas mark 7 for 45 minutes. Turn off oven. Allow to stand for 15 minutes. Melt sugar in pan. Brush chicken with sugar and broil in oven for several minutes. Remove chicken from oven, brush with more sugar and broil a further 5 mins, until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: white pearl onion,feta cheese,clove,sugar,pimento,thai fish sauce
title: Stuffed Feta Onions (Dry)
ingredients: 8 ounces feta cheese | 12 ounces white pearl onions | 2 tablespoons chopped pimentos ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon sugar | 1/2 teaspoon thai fish sauce | 2 -3 whole cloves
instructions: Cut the ends off the onions, cut the tips off the onions just like you would for pickling, then slice the onions into rings and about an inch long. Place into a 9x13 inch baking pan with approximately an inch of room between the onions. Sprinkle the onions with about 1/2 teaspoon of the sugar and the fish sauce. Stuff generously with feta cheese and pimentos. Sprinkle the remaining tablespoon of sugar over the top. Cover with saran wrap and refrigerate for at least 1 hour to marinate. Unwrap the packages, shake off the liquid from the refrigerator and just leave any remaining. Place on the counter. Remove the cloves from the mixture and press out all the air. The more liquid in the container the better your feta will taste. If the feta has absorbed all the liquid and is beginning to stick, refrigerate for at least a couple of hours to let any liquid absorb into the feta. When ready to serve, remove the pan from the refrigerator and take out the cloves. Cut the mixture into chunks or even smaller wedges. Serve with a small bowl of cold water and some finely chopped mint, as well as some freshly ground black pepper. Also, you may want to add the extra feta for a spicier version.

Random Ingredients: courgette,phyllo pastry dough,butter,milk ricotta cheese,pepperjack cheese
title: Cherie Olya's Grilled Cheesy Courgettes
ingredients: 250 g whole milk ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons melted butter | pepperjack cheese ( optional ) | 1 bunch fresh courgette, ends trimmed and each end trimmed | 1 package phyllo pastry dough, thawed | 150 g salted butter | 1/4 cup milk or 1/4 cup cream
instructions: Combine ricotta, butter and pepperjack cheese in a bowl and mix well. Cut out 6 squares from each sheet of phyllo dough. Place 2 generous tablespoonfuls of cheese mixture on top of each square of pastry, leaving about 2cm between each. Brush with melted butter. Stack the remaining phyllo sheets on top of the cheese mixture. Working with one sheet at a time, lightly sprinkle 1 tablespoon or more of cheese mixture on top of the stack and roll up. Brush with melted butter. Repeat with 3 more sheets of pastry until all 4 layers of cheese mixture are used. Preheat a non stick griddle or large pan over a medium high fire. Add the rolled rolls, seam side down, and cook for 2 minutes on each side, or until golden on the underside. Serve immediately. Repeat with the remaining 2 sheets of pastry. To make a sauce, combine the milk and cream in a small non reactive saucepan and gently bring to the boil. Reduce heat and simmer while stirring constantly for 2 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in the courgettes. Serve immediately.

title: Baby Bok Choy Cups
ingredients: 100 g baby bok choy | 75 g parmesan cheese | 1 tablespoon superfine sugar | 1 teaspoon fresh dill | 40 g champagne
instructions: Chop the bok choy into 1 inch pieces. Preheat oven to 180°c. Combine the baby bok choy and herbs, except the bok choy and parmesan, in a bowl. Add the cheese, sugar and dill and mix well. Pour the mixture into each chilled glass, fill well with the bok choy mixture and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: marjoram,cilantro stem,green cardamom pod,cream mushroom soup,ricotta cheese,prune,parsnip,radish
title: Parsnip and Parsnip Hash
ingredients: 1 medium parsnip, peeled and cut into 2-inch cubes | 4 large radishes, trimmed and quartered | 8 ounces prawns or 8 ounces smoked spanish smoked paprika or 8 ounces smoked spanish chorizo sausage | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 2 green cardamom pods | 6 tablespoons finely chopped fresh parsley stems | 6 tablespoons pitted prunes | 1/4 cup snipped fresh cilantro stem
instructions: Set over medium heat an empty large saucepan to medium high heat. When hot, add parsnip and radishes. Saute for a few minutes. Remove the vegetables from the pan and set aside and cool slightly. When slightly cooled add prawns back to the pan, mix well and allow to heat through. When prawns are warmed through, add soup. Return vegetables back to the pan to combine. Add cardamom pods, parsley stems, prunes, herbs and spice mixture to the pan and mix well. Reduce heat to low. The mixture should be thick like soup. Serve warm.

title: Real Mexican Beer Dip
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups hellmann's mayonnaise | 1 cup beer | jalapeno pepper | black pepper
instructions: In bowl mix mayonnaise with beer. Add pepper to taste. Chill for at least 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,swiss cheese,beef rib,grain white rice,ra el hanout spice mix,bean sprout
title: Ras el Hanout Shabbat Party Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups long-grain white rice, rinsed well and drained | 2 lbs beef short ribs | 1 package ras el hanout spice mix | 1 1/2 cups swiss cheese, shredded | 1 1/2 teaspoons almond extract | 1/4 cup mixed sprouts, to garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place drained rice in a large, deep baking dish. Cut short ribs into about 1/2, 1/3, or less in size and place in dish. Cut a deep cross in top of the ribs so they will stand in a uniform, even layer. Dollop out any remaining blood and add a tablespoon or two of oil. Insert a meat thermometer through the membrane into the center of one side of the rib. Place uncovered roasting pan in the middle of the oven and bake at 400 degrees for 40 minutes. Then, uncover roasting pan and turn down oven temperature to 400 degrees for 35 minutes. Turn ribs over and bake an additional 25 minutes. Meanwhile, crumble cheese and almonds, then stir into the rice with a spoon. After 25 minutes, remove pan from oven and carefully stir in hazelnuts. Sprinkle the top of the rice with salt to taste, sprinkle the edges of the ras el hanout with them. Return pan to oven for an additional 15 minutes or until the top is brown and crispy all the way through. Fluff the rice with a fork and transfer it to a large serving dish, spooning some of the sauce over each serving.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,ginger paste,egg,onion salt,artichoke heart,skirt steak,salt
title: Artichoke and Skirt Steak Saute
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ginger paste | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/2 teaspoon salt, or as needed | 1 pound skirt steak, cut into 2 inch cubes | 1 medium onion, minced | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained and chopped
instructions: Mix ginger paste and cream together in a bowl. Mix salt, and green onion together in a separate bowl. Set aside. Sprinkle the cubes of skirt steak with salt. In a skillet, heat vegetable oil over medium high heat. Cook the skirt steak until well browned, and cooked through, 2 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: half,curry leaf,cucumber,vanilla,lotus root,port wine,cayenne pepper,allspice berry
title: Jamaican Vegetarian Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 2 large cucumbers, halved lengthwise, seeded | 6 whole allspice berries, crushed | 1/2 cup port wine | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 2 teaspoons vanilla | 1/2 teaspoon curry leaf, crushed | cayenne pepper | 1 1/2 pounds fresh lotus root, cut crosswise into 1/4-inch thick rings
instructions: In a saucepan over low heat combine cucumber, allspice berries, port wine, half and half, vanilla, curry leaves and cayenne pepper. Cover and let simmer until all of the liquid has evaporated, about 20 minutes. Add lotus root to pot and coat thoroughly with sauce, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: white wine,shallot,clamato juice,beef consomme,chicken wing,red wine
title: Dutch Oven Clamatoise
ingredients: 4 cans minced clams with juice | 1 can chopped clams with juice | 2 cans chicken wings | 8 ounces red wine | 1 can white wine | 3/4 cup shallot
instructions: Mix all the ingredients in a dutch oven, mix well, and place in hot oven. Cook until hot and bubbly.

title: Brown Onion and Pepper Fritters
ingredients: 1/2 medium brown onion, very finely chopped | 1/2 tablespoon sweet pepper, grated | 1 teaspoon chili oil | 2 tablespoons pita bread, sliced
instructions: Add onion and pepper to a medium frypan and cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, until soft and fragrant. Add oil and heat through. Toast pita to soften. Spoon mixture onto pita bread then top with onion and pepper.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,coffee ice cream,beef stock,chicken broth
title: Lazy Irish Pub Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 pint coffee ice cream | 1/2 cup white vinegar | 1/2 cup chicken broth | 8 cups beef stock
instructions: Combine all of the above ingredients in a slow cooker. Cover.

Random Ingredients: red pepper yellow,basil,serrano pepper,tabasco sauce,pepper sauce,shell pasta,red food coloring
title: Quick Red Pepper Pasta
ingredients: 2 -3 cans large shrimp ( or you want it spicy ) ( optional ) | 3 cups small shell pasta, uncooked ( penne or rotini, or macaroni ) | 6 -8 medium peppers, any color ( red, yellow, or green ) | 3 -6 serrano peppers ( red, or green ) | 2 -5 dashes hot pepper sauce ( try a splash tabasco or green chili sauce ) | 2 -3 drops red food coloring | 1 cup fresh basil or 1 cup fresh coriander
instructions: Rinse shrimp if using, then drain any excess water. Place shrimp in a medium size sauce pan with enough water to just cover. Bring to a boil, then simmer, with a dash of hot pepper sauce, for approx 8 - 10 minutes, or until shrimp are just cooked through. Drain and set aside. In a skillet, heat up the 3 - 4 peppers over medium heat, stirring continuously until all ingredients are soft and peppers are all slightly red. Remove from heat. Add the drained shrimp and any juice. Keep warm. In a different skillet, cook pasta according to package directions, with plenty of water to the same cooking temperature. Drain pasta when cooked, but don’t overcook it. Note, if using the shrimp, be sure not to rinse the shrimp since they're hot. Reserve remaining liquid. Add the drained pasta and the shrimp to the peppers, along with 1/2 cup of the hot pepper sauce. Add hot pepper sauce and remaining hot pepper sauce. Stir to mix all. Top with fresh basil or coriander, if desired.

Random Ingredients: lamb cutlet,beef broth,tabasco sauce,glutinous rice,vegetable oil,cooking spray
title: Lamb Cutlets With Rice
ingredients: 1/4 cup reduced-sodium beef broth | 1 1/2 teaspoons tabasco sauce | 2 tablespoons uncooked glutinous rice | cooking spray | 4 lamb cutlets | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
instructions: Combine first 2 ingredients in a medium saucepan.

Random Ingredients: orange blossom water,nigella seed,turnip,almond,phyllo pastry,italian sausage,tomato green chilies
title: Spanish-Spiced Pumpkin Pie
ingredients: 24 ounces frozen turnips, thawed in boiling water for 5 minutes, drain and set aside | 2 teaspoons ground almonds | 1 tablespoon nigella seeds | 1 1/2 tablespoons nigella seeds | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chilies | 3/4 lb sweet italian sausage, cooked, shredded ( about 3 cups ) | 1 tablespoon orange blossom water
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place turnips in a large bowl and pour boiling water over them. Toss to mix and transfer to large rimmed baking sheet. Roast until tender when pierced with fork, 12 to 15 minutes. Meanwhile, toast nigella seeds in a small dry skillet over moderate heat until golden, about 4 minutes. Transfer to a plate and let cool. Add nigella to turnips along with nigella seeds, nigella and tomatoes and chilies and season to taste with orange blossom water. Toss until mixed. Transfer to a serving dish and serve immediately.

title: Italian Sausage & Cheese Stew
ingredients: 4 italian sausage links, casings removed | 1 lb pinto beans, soaked overnight and drained | 1/2 cup gruyere cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat a medium to large pot over a medium flame. Poke holes in the sausage with a fork, place them in the hot pot and cook them on a preheated medium flame, breaking up the meat with the fork, until browned on the bottom, about 7 - 10 minutes. Add the cooked beans, then cover and reduce heat to a simmer. Cook for approximately 30 minutes, stirring occasionally until the beans have absorbed most of the residual grease. Remove from heat and sprinkle with cheese and serve warm.

title: Rice Noodle Sandwich Rolls
ingredients: 1 package rice noodles | 1 shallot | 2 slices french bread
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook rice noodles in boiling water, stirring occasionally until tender but firm to the bite, about 5 minutes.

title: Cauliflower Orange Focaccia
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast | 1/2 cup warm water | 1 cup orange juice or 1 cup white grape juice | 2 -4 cups coarsely chopped cauliflower ( about a 13-14-ounce head ) | 2 teaspoons cornstarch
instructions: In a large bowl, sprinkle yeast over water.

Random Ingredients: rosemary leaf,cayenne pepper,mango,white sugar,chile,kidney bean,egg substitute
title: Mexican Bean Omelet Rollatas
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 4 tablespoons egg substitute | 3 tablespoons mangoes, diced, seeded | 1/4 teaspoon chopped fresh chile, or to taste | 1 1/2 teaspoons fresh rosemary leaves | 1 pinch cayenne pepper | 1 pinch white sugar, or to taste
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Whisk together the kidney beans, egg substitute, mango, chile, rosemary, cayenne pepper, and sugar in a bowl. Pour about 1 tablespoon of the bean mixture into each rollat on a large baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until omelets are golden brown on top, 20 to 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cocoa,mint sprig,apricot preserve,lemon juice,chocolate square,rice flour
title: Mint Swiss Roll
ingredients: 1 cup rice flour | 3 tablespoons cocoa | 1 tablespoon of fresh mint sprig, minced | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 1/2 cup apricot preserves | grated chocolate square ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Stir together the rice flour, cocoa, mint, lemon juice, and apricot preserves and spread into a baking sheet. Bake on the middle shelf of the oven for about 25 to 30 minutes until the sponge springs back in the centre all the way around. Dust with grated chocolate before slicing and eating.

title: Mashed Potatoes Ole
ingredients: 2 large russet potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks | 4 tablespoons quick-cooking oats | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice
instructions: Place potatoes in a saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium low and cook uncovered until tender, 10 to 15 minutes. Drain.

title: Crispy Garlic Tofu
ingredients: 1 package extra firm tofu, drained, oil and cut into pieces | 8 cups green cabbage, shredded | fresh ground pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line a large baking sheet with reynolds wrap aluminum foil. Arrange tofu slices in a single layer in a single layer, then brush with oil and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Arrange cabbage around tofu, then top with remaining tofu slices. Pour water into one of the baking sheets to 12 inch depth. Cook for 35 - 40 minutes, or until tofu is browned and vegetables are crisp.

Random Ingredients: steak,chicken breast half,chili oil,curry leaf,beef consomme,vegetable oil cooking spray,white pepper
title: Spicy Curry Chicken With Beef and Peas
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray ( for the oven ) | 4 boneless chicken breast halves, 1/2 inch thick ( from the deli ) | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 4 slices beef top round steak | 12 fresh curry leaves ( i use curry seasoning mix that comes in the spice aisle ) | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | 2 cans condensed beef consomme | chili oil
instructions: Spray a 13x9x2 inch baking dish with vegetable oil, and arrange the chicken breasts in a single layer on the bottom. Place curry leaves on top. Heat a 10 inch skillet over medium high heat until hot, not smoking. Remove chicken breasts from pan and place in pan. Cook, turning once, until brown, about 3 minutes per side. Transfer chicken and curry leaves to a plate. Deglaze the skillet by adding consommé, bringing to a boil. Add chicken and curry leaves and reduce heat to low. Cover and cook at a simmer until the chicken is cooked through and tender, 1 to 2 hours, stirring occasionally.

title: English Soused Vinegar On Skewers
ingredients: 16 wood skewers, soaked overnight, rinsed and drained well | 10 cups sugar ( or to taste ) | 8 1/2 cups white vinegar | 1 small onion, finely diced | 1/8 teaspoon mace
instructions: Soak skewers a few hours in cold water to prevent sticking. Combine the sugar, vinegar, onion and mace together in a large jar. Cover and shake well to blend all the ingredients. Cover, and shake well to blend all the ingredients. Pack the marinade into a resealable bag. Place the skewers in a large glass bowl, making sure they are completely covered with the marinade. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 days and up to 1 week. Preheat your broiler. Turn the skewers occasionally for even browning. Drain the skewers onto metal skewers. Set wooden skewers aside to allow them to soak up as much of the remaining marinade as possible from the skewers. You want the wooden skewers to be dark and sparkle like. Place on a foil lined cookie sheet. Place in your preheated 375°f oven for 30 - 40 minutes, turning occasionally. Serve warm, or keep warm until serving.

title: Chocolate Chip Taco Sauce
ingredients: 3/4 cup mini chocolate chip | 1/4 cup sour cream | 1 packet taco seasoning mix
instructions: In a 2 cup glass measure, combine chocolate chips, sour cream and taco seasoning. Microwave 1 minute, stirring after 1 minute. Mix well and pour into a 2 quart glass measure or casserole dish. Microvave on high 30 seconds. Microwave 45 seconds, stir and microveave 60 seconds more. Let cool 1 minute.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,yellow cornmeal,red cabbage,rigatoni pasta,salt,duck breast,mexican cheese
title: Mexican Chicken and Cornbread Casserole
ingredients: 2 cups rigatoni pasta | 1 cup yellow cornmeal | 4 cups shredded mexican cheese blend | 1 large red cabbage ( about 3-4 cups ) or 2 cups zucchini, thinly sliced ( about 3-4 cups ) | 2 duck breasts | salt | 1 cup canned tomato juice
instructions: Cook rigatoni as directed on package. Reserve cooking water. Rinse with cold water and drain well. Meanwhile, prepare cornbread mix as described on package. Transfer cornbread mix and all other ingredients except tomatoes to a large bowl. Toss to blend. Spoon mixture into a shallow 2 quart casserole. Bake, uncovered, in a 350°f oven for 40 minutes or until heated thoroughly. Do not permit to brown. Cool 5 minutes. Spoon warm cornbread mixture over hot and bubbly mixture.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,mix,extra virgin olive oil,chickpea,anise seed,blue cheese
title: Chickpea Nests
ingredients: 1/2 lb canned garbanzo beansprouts | 2 teaspoons anise seeds | 2 ounces blue cheese, crumbed | 1 package fresh bean sprouts | 1 1/2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons prepared vegetarian prepared sweet-and-sour mix
instructions: Drain and rinse beansprouts. Slice 1/2″ thick on diagonal and set aside. In the bowl of a food processor or small mortar and pestle, grind the beansprouts into a paste with anise seeds and 1/3 cup of the blue cheese. Set aside. In a medium bowl, combine the chopped greens with the remaining 1/3 cup of blue cheese, olive oil, and sweet and sour. Cover and refrigerate. Prepare the pesto sauce for stir frying. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat and add the chopped greens. Sprinkle with the remaining 1/3 cup of blue cheese and the toasted anise seeds. Stir fry for 3 - 4 minutes, or until the nuts are lightly browned. Serve the greens hot.

title: Tamarind Sauce
ingredients: 1 bottle picante sauce or ( 1 liter ) bottle salsa | 1 cup dark brown sugar, firmly packed | 1 teaspoon tamarind paste ( found in asian markets )
instructions: Mix all ingredients well in a small saucepan and simmer over low heat.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,tuna water,baking soda,anaheim chilies,grain white rice
title: Santa Fe Green Chile Risotto
ingredients: 4 large mild green chilies | 4 large anaheim chilies | 1 can tuna in water, drained | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 2 cups cooked short-grain white rice
instructions: Cut off and discard stem ends from chilies and discard. Cut lengthwise in half and remove seeds and veins. Remove seeds and veins.

title: Vietnamese Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 teaspoons saffron threads, crushed | 1 cup coarsely chopped walnuts | 1/2 cup white sugar | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 2 teaspoons water | 3 cups oil for frying
instructions: Combine the saffron, walnuts, sugar, fish sauce, and water in a blender.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon,maraschino cherry,chocolate cookie crumb,chili oil,olive oil,corn tortilla chip
title: Taquito Dip

Random Ingredients: parmesan cheese,cumin,baking soda,broth,parsley,lard,cream chicken soup,chili pepper flake
title: Chili Con Cream Chicken
ingredients: 250 g lowfat cream of chicken soup | 100 g smoked lard ( or other additives. i use other oil ) | 100 g parmesan cheese ( grated ) | 1/2 tablespoon dried chili peppers flakes ( or to taste ) | 2 teaspoons ground cumin | 1/2 tablespoon baking soda | 1/2 tablespoon dried parsley ( chopped ) | 1/3 cup chicken stock or 1/3 cup broth ( or use broth )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except the chicken. Pour into a 9 or 10 cup capacity muffin tin. Top with a little of the chicken mixture. Place in a pan of hot, simmering water then reduce heat to medium. Simmer for 20 minutes or until lightly browned. Sprinkle with grated cheddar cheese, return to heat for a further 10 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Fasoulous Al Qibe (Shaking and Frying Chicken)
ingredients: 1 kg chicken, cut into 8 8 cm pieces | 1/2 teaspoon saffron
instructions: Put all ingredients in a heavy deep pan. Cover and bring to the boil. Cover and simmer very gently for 1/2 hour. Remove cover and cook very gently for 30 minute or until juices run clear when pricked. Cool. Serve with couscous.

title: Hungarian Nisiotiki
ingredients: 1 lb ground chuck | 1 can fat-free refried beans | 1/2 cup sweet hungarian paprika
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Mix all ingredients in a large bowl. Form into meatballs and place on cookie sheet. Bake at 375°f for 30 to 35 minutes. Turn meatballs a few times during baking.

Random Ingredients: ketjap manis,green bell pepper,chili bean paste
title: Stir Fried Chilli Peppers & Peppers
ingredients: 125 ml ketjap manis | 2 -4 tablespoons sweet chili bean paste | 2 green bell peppers
instructions: Combine all ingredients and marinate for an hour or more. Grill peppers over direct medium heat for 2 - 3 minutes until softened, turning frequently. Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: confectioner ' sugar,cheese tortellini,golden brown sugar,chicken thigh
title: Tortellini Wrapped Chicken
ingredients: 8 ounces cooked cheese tortellini | 2 boneless skinless chicken thighs, about 1 1/2 pounds | 2 1/2 teaspoons golden brown sugar | confectioners'sugar for dusting
instructions: Preheat the oven to in a large bowl combine the tortellini, chicken thighs, and brown sugar. Heat the 2 coats of a nonstick cooking spray in a saucepan over high heat for about three minutes, then place in an oven. Bake, basting once, for 35 minutes, or until chicken is browned and cooked through. Sprinkle with confectioners' sugar to serve.

Random Ingredients: chicken thigh,prickly pear,date,quinoa,chipotle chile adobo,mustard,cauliflower,apple juice
title: Quinoa Chicken With Cauliflower Salad
ingredients: 1 cup julienne fresh apple | 2 cups cauliflower, cut into florets | 2 teaspoons whole mustard | 1 sprig fresh cilantro or 1 sprig culantro, finely chopped | 1 whole chipotle chile in adobo, chopped | 16 ounces chicken thighs, bone in, skinless, boneless cuts cut into bite-sized pieces | 3/4 cup orange-flavored instant quinoa, dry-roasted and cooled | 2 cups pitted prunes, coarsely chopped | 1 cup preserved dates, halved
instructions: Prick chicken with a fork. Place chicken and vegetables in a large bowl, and toss with the orange marinade. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours. Combine all ingredients, except the prunes, in a food processor or blender until smooth and well mixed but not liquefied. If too thick, add more orange marinade. Spoon onto the chicken, and sprinkle with prunes.

Random Ingredients: kielbasa,dark sesame oil,prune,pimiento,cumin powder,nonfat milk powder,tea
title: Fried Kielbasa
ingredients: 1 cup kielbasa, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 ounce prunes, chopped | 1 tablespoon pimiento, green, sliced | 20 1/4 ounces nonfat dry milk powder | 6 ounces brewed decaffeinated tea
instructions: Place all ingredients except tea in a blender or food processor and blend until smooth. Store in the refrigerator in a screw top container. Add tea. Makes about 2 cups.

Random Ingredients: pico de gallo,peanut butter,marshmallow,green chili pepper
title: Hot and Spicy Pecan Slice
ingredients: 4 tablespoons crunchy peanut butter | 1 -2 green chili pepper, seeded, and finely sliced ( or more to taste ) | 1/2 cup pico de gallo ( see note below ) or 1/2 cup kraft spicy italian salad dressing ( see note below ) | 25 -24 large marshmallows, lightly toasted
instructions: Using a food processor, blend the peanut butter until mixture resembles fine breadcrumbs. Add a little hot water if mixture is too thick. Stir in the rest of the chile and pico de gallo. Press mixture into a slice tin. Refrigerate at least 6 hours or overnight. Note, if making ahead, store the biscuit mixture in an airtight container at room temperature and re heat as needed.

title: Cod Crunch
ingredients: 450 g good quality frozen cod | 2 cans low sodium chicken broth | 1/2 cup real maple syrup | 1 1/4 cups plain flour | kosher salt | plain flour, for coating
instructions: Place the frozen cod in a large saucepan with the chicken broth, maple syrup, baking soda and a pinch of salt. Bring to the boil over moderate heat, then remove the pan from the heat and cover to keep warm. Melt the remaining teaspoon of salt using a tablespoon of plain flour. Whisk the flour into the warm liquid and then whisk the flour from the pan into the saucepan of heated broth. Stir until smooth, then remove from the heat. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate 8 hours or overnight. Preheat the oven to 200c and line the tray with baking paper. Place the cod in a large heatproof bowl and cover with foil. Place in the oven and bake for 45 minutes, or until the fish flakes easily when tested with a fork. Remove from the oven, then set aside for 10 minutes to cool a little. Drain off the excess liquid, then place the cod in a heatproof serving bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Heat in the oven for 5 minutes, then remove from the foil and finish off in a warm oven for 15 minutes. To serve, spoon over any remaining broth and drizzle with the reserved syrup.

title: Potato and Asparagus Pizza
ingredients: 1/8 lb fresh asparagus | 1 large russet potato | 1/8 lb fresh medium pizza crust | 1 tablespoon tabasco sauce | 1 1/2 cups grape tomatoes, halved
instructions: Preheat oven to 425^f. Cut the potato into chunks, peel the asparagus, cut into bite sized pieces, and cut crosswise into 1/8 slices. Set aside. Place oven proof skillet on stove and bring to simmer until asparagus is bright green and tender crisp, about 5 minutes. Turn heat down and let simmer until asparagus is crisp tender and beginning to soften slightly, about 3 minutes longer. Meanwhile, cook the pizza crust for 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: white wine,turmeric,parmigiano reggiano cheese,fenugreek seed,baguette,sesame oil
title: Smoky Garlic Toast
ingredients: 1 medium baguette | 6 -8 cloves garlic, chopped | 2 tablespoons white wine | 2 teaspoons sesame oil ( see note in description ) | 1 pinch turmeric | 1/3 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Using a very sharp knife, cut through the baguette lengthwise in 1/8 inch slices. Spread out flat with a small plate and place in an ovenproof dish. Put on a rimmed baking sheet. In the bowl of a mortar, mash the garlic and sesame oil and turmeric, making sure that no clumps form. Spread garlic mixture over bread making sure to coat. Spread the remaining sesame oil and spread on bread making sure to cover completely. Sprinkle with half the parmigiano. Wrap top with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 1 hour. Preheat your broiler or grill. Remove from the refrigerator 30 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: taco shell,dressing,rye flour,baby carrot,sunflower oil,iceberg lettuce,brown sugar,parmesan cheese
title: Quick and Easy Vegetarian Taco Salad
ingredients: 1 packet taco shells, such as kraft's taco filling | 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning mix ( a1 dried taco seasoning blend is recommended, but i found my a1 with fresh a1 without dried ) | 1 bag baby carrots, with peel, finely grated | 1 bag raw iceberg lettuce, finely shredded | 1 tablespoon brown sugar | 1/3 cup parmesan cheese, grated | shredded iceberg lettuce, to garnish ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 200c/400f. In a large bowl, combine the taco, oil, and taco seasoning mix.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,red potato,cake flour,red chili sauce,grand marnier
title: Sweet Potato Puree
ingredients: 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 tablespoon cake flour | 2 large red potatoes, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1/4 cup granulated sugar | 1 1/4 cups red chili sauce or 1 1/4 cups sweet red chili sauce, sriracha | 1/2 cup grand marnier
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f coat the inside of a 3 pint ovenproof bowl with cooking spray. Combine the oil and flour in a medium size bowl, add the potatoes and stir to toss so the potatoes are evenly coated. Place the coated potatoes on a jelly roll pan with 3/4 cup water on top and bake, uncovered, until golden brown and tender. In a food processor, combine sugar and chili sauce or sriracha and pulse for 1 minute. Add the grand marnier and puree into a coarse puree – the consistancy should be thick and a bit creamy. Taste so that you know the sweet potatoes are done. Spread the puree over the potatoes and let cool to room temperature. Transfer to a serving plate and serve immediately.

title: Microwave Moist Irish Oats
ingredients: 3 tablespoons instant espresso | 1 tablespoon tomato puree | 1/2 teaspoon hot sauce or 1/2 teaspoon steak sauce | 2 -3 tablespoons oat, plain, toasted and coarsely ground | olive oil flavored cooking spray
instructions: Combine the espresso and tomato puree in a small microwave safe bowl. Heat on high for a few seconds or until heated through. Cover immediately with plastic wrap and leave in the microwave for a minute or two on high until hot. Stir. Add the hot sauce and stir. Cook on high for 30 seconds more. Spoon onto a plate and stir. Cool. When cool, store tightly covered for up to three days. When cold, reheat to serve, drizzle over a few ice cubes.

title: Chef John's Pea and Olive Bread
ingredients: 1 package fresh peas, shelled and thawed if frozen | 4 cups cooked rice wine vinegar, warmed until just warm ( i use homemade, not instant ) | 1 3/4 teaspoons cake yeast | 1/3 cup pesto sauce
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil.

Random Ingredients: chinese five spice powder,potato,chicken stock cube,basil leaf
title: Potato Basil Soup (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 1200 g potatoes, medium sized | 12 ounces chicken stock cubes ( i use low sodium broth ) | 2 teaspoons chinese five spice powder | 3/4 lb fresh basil leaf, cut into thin ribbons
instructions: Peel potatoes and grate into a fine shreds using a cheese grater, or with a hand held food processor, set aside. Bring stock and 5 spice powder to the boil in a saucepan. Add potatoes and return to the boil. Reduce heat to medium and simmer until tender, about 15 minutes. Meanwhile, warm a broiler if you have a bread machine. Stir in basil. Ladle into soup bowls, and add a few basil ribs to each soup bowl if desired. Serve warm.

title: The Best Tasting Pork Ragu
ingredients: 12 large kalamata olives | 1 pint water | 12 lbs pork | 12 lbs grapes
instructions: Place meat in large pot. Pour kalamata olives and water over top of it. Do not rinse the olives. Boil until meat is done, approx 45 minutes. Cool, remove fat and bones. Cut meat into cubes if desired. I often leave one portion intact and freeze the rest. After the pork is cool, cut into 2 - 3 portions and add the grapes. Do the same for the remaining portion of the bag. Place the bag in a 9x13 baking dish. Sprinkle with the olive mixture. I like to sprinkle with more olives or a little dried mint if desired, but you may need to add more later. Top with remaining salt and pepper. Cover with aluminum foil and put in a 350 degree oven for at least 2 hours, stirring occasionally. I sometimes remove the foil during the last few baking hours and just remove the lid. The last 15 minutes of baking, remove bag and toss with grapes until desired doneness. Serve on a nice bed of warm bread with plenty of crusty rolls and crusty french breads mixed inches.

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,arborio rice,creme de cacao,dashi,orange,leek,stewing beef
title: Arafura Beef Pilaf
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef ( or a mixture of 1-1 1/2 lbs ) or 1 lb chicken stock, if you prefer | 5 -6 ounces creme de cacao | 1 teaspoon dry oregano leaves, crushed | 1 tablespoon orange rind, grated | 4 -6 tablespoons arborio rice or 4 -6 tablespoons other medium-grain rice, washed | 4 teaspoons instant dashi | 2 leeks, trimmed ( white parts only ) or 2 green onions, trimmed, chopped
instructions: The stock, if beef is precooked in a heavy based saucepan, cover it with a tight fitting lid and heat it over a high flame for 15 - 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until it registers 120f degrees on a deep breath, if it is below 120f degrees and the fat rises to the top. The rice, stir fry the beef over a moderate flame with the creme de cacao, oregano and orange rind until it is evenly colored, 3 - 5 minutes. Sprinkle in the rice and stir well over a high flame for 2 minutes. Stir in the dashi, then reduce the heat and leave to simmer for 5 minutes, until the water is absorbed. The rice should become tender and there is only a thin, rich creamy layer of creamy liquid. Stir in the leeks, cover and leave to stand for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Curried Tofu
ingredients: 20 ounces firm tofu, drained | 1 cup couscous | 1 cup couscous | 1 medium head cabbage, cut up | 1/2 cup currants or 1/2 cup raisins | 1 tablespoon dill | 1 tablespoon cumin seed
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Coat a 9x13 inch baking pan with cooking spray. Slice tofu horizontally into 1/4 inch thick slices.

Random Ingredients: pineapple chunk,italian tomato,ginger,hot water,five spice powder,wheat flour
title: Spicy Tomato-Ginger Snack Mix for Fish
ingredients: 1 can italian-style stewed tomatoes | 1/2 cup fat-free pineapple chunk | 1/4 cup boiling water | 3 tablespoons five-spice powder | 2 teaspoons grated fresh ginger | 1/4 teaspoon five-spice powder | 1/8 teaspoon five-spice powder | 4 cups whole wheat flour
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the tomatoes, pineapple chunks, water, five spice powder, ginger, five spice powder and five spice powder until well combined.

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Pulse 2 or 3 green chilies in an electric blender or food processor until finely chopped. Mix in green chilies, potatoes, ancho chile powder, oregano, and curry paste. Spread stuffing in the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish.
