title: Korean Cabbage Beef and Broccoli
ingredients: 1 large head of cabbage | 8 ounces broccoli florets | 1/2 lb fresh skirt steak, thinly sliced | olive oil | sugar snap peas | shredded parsley | serrano pepper ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon ketchup
instructions: Remove outer leaves and ribs from cabbage. Remove and discard the stem portions from the cabbage. Core cabbage and cut into 1/4 strips or 2 by 1/4 strips. Heat 1 inch of oil in a heavy nonstick skillet over medium high heat. When hot enough, add the beef and cook, stirring to separate the pieces, until brown on all sides, about 3 minutes. Add seasoning mixture, vegetables and ketchup. Return beef mixture to pan. Cover and simmer over medium heat until beef is cooked through and vegetables are tender, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,beef bouillon cube,curry powder,plain flour,beef tenderloin,super fine sugar,sugar,lasagna noodle
title: Easy Slow Cooker Tiramisu
ingredients: 450 g beef tenderloin | 1 tablespoon plain flour | 400 g minced beef bouillon cubes | 1 cup beef bouillon granules or 1 cup chicken bouillon cube | 1 cup superfine sugar | 2 teaspoons curry powder | 32 sheets lasagna noodles | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Cut beef into 1cm slices. Dust with flour. Place in crock and add the rest of the ingredients. Stir well to combine. Cook for 6 - 12 hours on low. Serve with salad and slices of french bread.

Random Ingredients: fingerling potato,pico de gallo,jalapeno pepper,sirloin,beef tenderloin steak,pinto bean
title: Southwest Beef and Potato Tenderloin With Chili-Pepper Roasted Beans and Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 3 lbs sirloin or 3 lbs top round steaks, trimmed of any fat | 1/2 cup minced jalapeno pepper | 1/2 cup minced pinto bean | 24 ounces cooked pico de gallo ( spicy mexican style brand with jalapeno and garlic ) | 1 lb fingerling potato, halved | 6 beef tenderloin steaks
instructions: Place beef in a large nonstick skillet. Add jalapenos and cook over medium high heat 1 minute. Transfer beef to a resealable plastic bag. Cover and refrigerate about 20 minutes. Preheat oven to 475 degrees f. Remove beef from bag, discard marinade and slice beef across the grain. Place in an 11x14 inch baking dish. Cover and bake 20 minutes. Remove from oven. Cover beef with a large kitchen towel and transfer to carving board. Remove towel and towel from beef. Cut steak lengthwise in half. Season with salt and pepper and set aside. In a small saucepan, stir up pinto beans, mashed potato, salt and pepper and cook over medium heat until hot. Spread potato mixture over beef and top with beef. Return to oven and bake 20 minutes or until meat is cooked through. Slice, serve and enjoy.

title: Poblano Chips
ingredients: 2 poblano chiles | 2 teaspoons caster sugar | 1 french baguette
instructions: Heat oil in a heavy frying pan. Toast the chiles over a gentle heat, turning frequently until blistered, black and split. Cool and remove the seeds and stems. Place the chiles in a plastic bag. Using a sharp knife, split them open and dry them on paper towels. Remove as many of the black skin as possible. Sprinkle with sugar and chill for 20 minutes. Preheat the oven to 250f and line a baking tray with parchment paper. Cut the baguette into 3 thick slices. Spread each slice with some of the chilli and bread. Bake the chips for 10 - 15 minutes, or until crisp and dry.

title: Oats for Corned Beef or Pork
ingredients: 2 ounces quick-cooking oats | 1 tablespoon coriander seed, crushed | 3 tablespoons mirin | 1 tablespoon vinegar
instructions: Dry fry the oats in a frying pan or fryer with the coriander seeds until fragrant.

title: Kittencal's Yummiest Fondant
ingredients: 1/2 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips | 1/2 tablespoon sumac ( optional )
instructions: In a small bowl, melt chocolate chips and sumac. Stir in sweetened chocolate until desired coating consistency is achieved. Serve.

title: Paprika-Chickpea Filling With Chunky Chickpea Vinaigrette
ingredients: 540 ml chickpeas, drained and rinsed ( garbanzo beans ) | 1/2 cup light corn oil | 1 tablespoon margarine | 1/2 teaspoon taco seasoning | 1/2 cup chopped scallion ( white and light green parts ) | 1/4 cup good quality marsala wine
instructions: Place both the olive oil and the margarine in a mixing bowl and add the taco seasoning and scallions. Heat a skillet/pastry on medium heat and coat with 1/4 celsius melted margarine. Drain both cans of chickpeas and then drain the chickpeas of any excess marinade, reserving the rest of the marinade in a separate bowl. In a bowl, mash the chickpeas with the back of a fork. Slowly stir in the chickpeas, making sure each piece is well coated with the oil but not sopping and adding more marinade. Place the skillet/pastry on top of a flat, rimmed baking sheet and place pan/pastry on top of the baking sheet. Place an ovenproof dinner plate on top of the pie plate and place it in the oven. Watch your oven so it doesn't burn. Heat the reserved marinade in a small saucepan until it is at a boil in a small saucepan. Carefully stir in 3 tbsp of the heated olive oil into this mixture. Pour this mixture into the bottom of the pie plate and spread it evenly, or you may chill it until you are ready to fill the pie plate. Turn down the heat to lowest setting and place dish inside the oven allowing it to warm up slightly, then place your ovenproof glass plate on the top of the oven. Turn on your broiler and place your baking sheet/ovenproof glass bowl on top of the oven. Place your baking sheet on your oven rack and set your oven temperature for about 35 minutes at 200°c. Remove the cooking sheets and your baking stone from the oven and allow the dough to cool for 5 minutes. Turn the oven off and carefully remove the phyllo bag and the oven door. Allow the dough to sit for 10 - 15 minutes so it can rest and firm up a bit. Dust off the excess flour from the dough and pull apart into small pieces. Place your hands under normal thumb for a few seconds if your hand does not seem wet right after you put the dough in your hands. Place each piece of dough on the table and cut into four equal squares. Place each square on a small baking tray, cover and leave somewhere cool to room temperature. When the dough has rested, preheat the oven to 400°f and position your cookie sheet on top of the baking sheet. Using your fingers spread a thin layer of the chunky chickpea vinaigrette over each piece of dough. Place a heaping tablespoon of chopped green scallion on top of this vinaigrette, then sprinkle with extra chopped cilantro. Place your baking sheet/bowl with the dough in the oven and return to the oven. Depending on your oven strength, you may have to add a touch of water during the cooking process since the dough will continue to cook in the oven. Allow the oven to cook for 2 minutes before removing the cookie sheet/bowl. Allow the dough to sit for another 2 minutes after taking it out of the oven. With a sharp knife, carefully cut the chilled dough squares into 3 - 4 squares. Allow the dough squares to cool before filling with the chunky chickpea vinaigrette.

title: Basic Chapati Bread
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sugar cube, dissolved in | 4 1/4 cups whole wheat flour | 1 small garlic clove, minced, peeled | 1 tablespoon cornstarch ( plus 1 tbl. additional ) | 1/2 teaspoon fresh thyme leave, chopped ( or dried ) | 1/2 scallion, coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450. Combine the sugar and garlic. Place the flour in a medium size mixing bowl. Make a well in the center and add the sugar/garlic mixture, thyme, and scallions. Mix the flour into the mound with a wooden spoon until it forms a dough. Turn out onto a floured surface. Knead briefly until smooth, about 1 minute. Place dough in a greased bowl and cover with a kitchen towel. Cut dough in 8 pieces and shape like chapati. Lightly oil baking sheet. Place the chapati on the center baking sheet. Bake for about 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown on top and the edges just begin to crisp.

title: Green Beans With Saffron
ingredients: 4 ounces green beans, cut in 1 � chunks | 2 ounces couscous or 2 ounces couscous | 2 2 teaspoons red chili peppers or 2 teaspoons green chili peppers, hot | 3 saffron or 2 saffron strands, crushed | 1 bouquet garni ( thyme, oregano, bay leaf and rosemary ) | 2 -3 tablespoons fresh parsley, chopped ( garnish )
instructions: Fry the green beans and couscous according to the instructions on the pack. Add a little boiling water only if the couscous looks dry. Tip in the chili or peppers, season with salt and pepper, the saffron dissolved in a little boiling water and the bouquet garni. Cook until done, then cover with boiling water or steam for a minute or two. Spoon the veggies from the pan in the middle and swirl in the remaining saffron syrup.

title: Beef Noodle Soup
ingredients: 1 lb fettuccine | 4 tablespoons olive oil | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 4 shallots, diced | 2 tablespoons sliced napa cabbage, shredded | 3 beef stock cubes
instructions: In a large pot, saute the fettuccine in the corn oil and olive oil until cooked through. Add the shallots, cabbage and beef stock. Bring to a boil, then simmer about 2 mins until the fettuccine is tender. Serve with salt and pepper sprinkled on top.

title: Kafta Snoober
ingredients: 2 lbs ground lamb | 1 cup fresh yoghurt | 2 teaspoons hot sauce ( peri-peri or tabasco )
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Shape into small meatballs to dip in the sauce.

title: Sauerkraut Balls
ingredients: 1 jar sauerkraut, packed in water | 3 eggs | 3 tablespoons broth
instructions: Put sauerkraut in cold water so that it will soak up the water. Drain well, and squeeze out as much water as possible. Stir a dozen or twenty three times with a wooden spoon until fully incorporated. Combine sauerkraut and eggs in a large bowl or your mold on the stove. Stir broth in with the sauerkraut mixture. Drop sauerkraut Balls in and let rise again. After they rise, place on a tray, and refrigerate for at least an hour. Turn out on a pretty dish, and slice up and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: green capsicum,grape tomato,tabasco sauce,saffron,rigatoni pasta,coconut oil,miso paste,tomato puree
title: Bachelor Pasta Salad
ingredients: 250 ounces rigatoni pasta | 2 cups grape tomatoes | 3 green capsicum | 1 cup canned tomato puree ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon tomato puree ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon coconut oil | 1 tablespoon miso paste | 1 pinch saffron | 2 drops tabasco sauce
instructions: Boil rigatoni pasta until just tender with salt. Drain, rinse with cold water and drain again. Peel and cut capsicum into 1/4 inch cubes. Mix the tomatoes, capsicum and miso paste together. Put in a separate bowl and add the can of tomato puree. Add 1/2 teaspoon tabasco to the mix. Dressing, mix the olive oil, miso paste and 2 tablespoons of water to obtain a very thick dressing. Stir the dressing into the salad. Place the rigatoni in a large bowl or pasta salad bowl. Top it with the dressing and serve at once.

title: Garlicky Garlic Beef
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless beef chuck, tied ( such as chuck roast ) | 1 cup fresh parsley, chopped | seasoning ( morton's ) | cayenne pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat oven to place beef in a large ovenproof pan with a lid. Sprinkle with parsley, sprinkling generously with any seasoning and cayenne over beef. Insert a toothpick into the top of the meat to make a secure lid. Bake in 325, preheated oven about 3 hours until meat is browned and tender.

title: Homemade Beef Grap
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat | grap
instructions: Cut stew meat up and cook on the stove using 1/2 the water used for cooking. The water used for cooking makes a nice texture. It does not matter how much water is used on the meat as it will become solid. You can also cook it with your grill on medium heat and put on high heat, add meat and put on high heat to sear, turn once or twice, when meat is a bit brown. About five minutes before you like it you can add grape kernels or juice. Some like to mix grapes in juice with the stew. I like to add a little cornstarch mixed with water until is just mixed all the time, as it will cook grapes into the stew.

title: Apricot and Radish Lasagna Rollups
ingredients: 9 lasagna noodles | 1/8 cup apricot preserves | 8 radishes, cleaned and trimmed | 4 dashes triple sec
instructions: Place a large pot of water on to boil for the noodles. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place one noodle in the bottom of a 10x15 inch jelly roll pan. On top of the noodle, spread a generous layer of apricot preserves. Carefully place two radishes on top of this, then sprinkle with a few dashes of triple sec. Repeat until all of the noodle and preserves have been used. Place the sheet of parchment paper in a large roasting pan or on aluminum foil. Carefully transfer the pan so the lasagna and pasta are standing on the foil, and place in the preheated oven. Bake for 20 minutes, or until the noodles are tender and the top is lightly browned. Let cool for 10 minutes, and then transfer to a cutting board. Cut into desired servings.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,confectioner sugar,artichoke heart,tabasco sauce,pearl onion
title: Artichoke Pearl Onions with White Sauce
ingredients: 8 ounces frozen pearl onions, thawed | 4 ounces frozen artichoke hearts, thawed, coarsely chopped | 8 ounces frozen fresh bean sprouts, thawed and coarsely chopped | 8 drops tabasco sauce, or to taste | 3 tablespoons confectioners'sugar
instructions: Layer the frozen onions into a bowl and gently press them into the onion with a spatula. Then lay them onto a platter. Gently press the artichoke hearts into the onion, pressing them as much as possible into the onions. Top with bean sprouts and a few drops of tabasco sauce. You can mix the confectioners' sugar into just enough confectioners' sugar to spread the coating over the mixture to be more desired spread. To serve, dust with remaining confectioners' sugar.

title: Choco - Vegetarian Barley and Aubergine Breakfast
ingredients: 1/2 aubergine | 2 potatoes | 3/4 cup pearl barley | 3 tablespoons onions | 2 teaspoons unsweetened cocoa | 2 teaspoons sugar | 1/3 cup chocolate chips
instructions: Peel the aubergine and dice them into 1/2 inch cubes. Peel and dice potatoes into 1/4 inch cubes. Peel and finely dice onions. Heat oil in a cast iron or other heavy based pan. Add all the ingredients except the chocolate chips, stir well. When the mixture starts to bubble add chocolate chips and stir well until mixed. Turn heat down low and simmer until aubergines are tender.

title: Oats With Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/4 red onion | 1/4 ghee | 150 g cremini mushrooms, brushed clean ( about 6 ) | 1 bay leaf | 2 tablespoons mirin ( sweet rice cooking wine ) | 1/8 teaspoon cooking oats
instructions: Place a large frying pan on medium high heat. Add ghee. When it melts, add onion. Cook till onion is soft. Add cremini mushrooms. Cook 2 minutes, stirring for about 1 minute more. Stir in the sliced bay leaf. Turn up heat a little and pour mirin in the pan. Let it boil. Once it comes to a boil, add the cooking oats and stir. Lower heat and cover the pan. Cook for about 10 minutes, stirring a few times. After 10 minutes, remove from heat and serve.

Random Ingredients: bay leaf,bell pepper,ice,oil,bacon,basil leaf,dark sesame oil,roux
title: Chinese Muslim Bacon Salad
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 lb piece bacon | 1 1/2 tablespoons oil | 6 -8 cups ice, torn | 1/2 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1 bay leaf | 1 -2 teaspoon dried basil leaves | bell pepper, green onion | roux, to taste ( try chicken stock, for a little kick )
instructions: Slice the bacon thin. Fry bacon in a nonstick pan, on medium high heat, until cooked fully. Remove bacon from pan. Turn down the heat to medium or medium low to avoid burning bacon. When bacon is cool, tear into small pieces and add to the pan. Add 5 to 6 cups of ice. Stir until the ice melts about 1 minute. This will prevent ice crystals breaking into each other while baking. Stir in sesame oil. Add bay leaf, basil, and green pepper to the pan. Strain off most but not all water, and season. Keep in mind that if you plan on serving this as salad, you will need to stir it continuously. After several minutes of stirring, add the bacon with a few pieces of bacon and stir. Turn up heat to high, and stir until bacon bits are well coated with oil. Remove from heat to cool and serve in a bowl topped with roux, add basil if desired.

title: Tahini Tea Balls
ingredients: 2 cups slivered almonds | 1/4 cup salad oil | 1 small purple onion, grated | 1 teaspoon tea | 1/4 cup tahini
instructions: In food processor, grind almonds until fine. Add remaining ingredients and process until mixture is smooth. Stir in toasted almonds. Form ball using 1 teaspoon of mixture for each ball and roll in saran wrap. Chill.

Random Ingredients: turmeric,pimento olive,garlic powder,grape tomato,kirby cucumber,applesauce,corn cob
title: Tibetan Applesauce Stew
ingredients: 2 applesauce, applewood preferred | 2 tablespoons dried pimento stuffed olives ( kirby cucumbers ) | 3 garlic cloves, minced | 1 1/4 teaspoons turmeric | 1 teaspoon corn chips or 1 teaspoon corn flakes, crushed | 1 bunch grape tomatoes, halved | 3 medium kirby cucumbers, halved lengthwise, seeded, quartered lengthwise
instructions: In a bowl, mix together applesauce, pimentos, garlic, turmeric, and corn meal. Place tomatoes, cucumbers, olives into a large pot or pan. Pour applesauce mixture over vegetables. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer 3 - 4 minutes until vegetables are tender.

title: Apple Crumble (Dairy Free)
ingredients: 5 lbs apples ( golden delicious, granny smith ) | 1 quart apple, finely diced | 2 cups white flour | 3 cups urad dal | 1/2 cup crushed ice
instructions: Heat oven to 425 degrees f. Wash, peel, core and coarsely chop apples. Place apples in a large bowl and sprinkle with urad dal and ice. Mixture should be a slightly chunky consistency. Sprinkle with more flour if needed. Roll out into a round about 1/3 thick. Cut larger circles out of larger ingredients with cookie cutter, or with a 3 - 4 inch star shaped cutter. Place all crumbs on a baking sheet and bake 35 - 40 minutes until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,water chestnut,salt,cottage cheese,tilapia fillet,fast rising yeast
title: Chinese-Style Crusted Tilapia & Spicy Almond Cottage Cheese
ingredients: 1 tablespoon fast rising yeast | 1/2 cup water | 1 teaspoon salt | 1/3 cup cottage cheese | 6 -8 ounces tilapia fillets, very thinly sliced | 1 can sliced canned water chestnuts, drained well
instructions: Dissolve yeast and 1 teaspoon salt in 1/2 c warm water & allow to proof 10 minutes. Stir in remaining 2 3/4 c flour, cottage cheese, and 1/ 2 tablespoons water. Stir in tilapia & can of water chestnuts. Mix well & turn onto floured board. Knead & cut into 6 pieces. Turn each piece into an 8 x 8 pan coated w/ cooking spray. Cover tightly w/ clean cloth & rise in a warm spot until doubled in bulk, about 1 hour on greased cookie sheet. Bake in 375f oven for 10 minutes.

title: Cabbage & Chicken Loin - Crock Pot
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless pork loin | 2 tablespoons onion salt | 1/4 cup white cabbage, finely chopped | 24 chicken wings
instructions: Cut the pork loin into one inch pieces & sprinkle it with onion salt. Place the pork in the crock pot, add the cabbage and then place the chicken on top. Cook on low for 8 to 10 hours. About 20 minutes before serving place the cabbage in the oven to get it nice & hot. Serve on italian rolls & top with fresh garlic slices & shredded parmesan.

title: Savory Rosemary Shrimp Balls
ingredients: 3 tablespoons superfine sugar | 5 1/2 pounds large shrimp - peeled, deveined, and tails removed | 1 tablespoon dried rosemary leaves | 42 meatballs
instructions: Place the sugar and shrimp into a large container. Add rosemary, and stir to blend. Cover, and refrigerate overnight. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Roll each shrimp in sugar and shrimp to thoroughly coat. Arrange on a baking sheet, and sprinkle with remaining sugar and pepper. Bake for 30 minutes in the preheated oven, just until the shrimp are pink and starting to turn golden.

Random Ingredients: milk,salsa,chinese five spice powder,no salt tomato sauce,pistachio,sea salt,beef roast,beef tenderloin
title: Salsa-Pistachio Baked Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 beef tenderloin | 1/2 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 1/4 cup finely chopped pistachios, lightly toasted | 1 can no-salt-added tomato sauce | 1/4 cup salsa, sweet ( mild or hot ) | 1 1/2 cups low-fat milk | 1/8 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Rub meat with five spice powder. Heat a large nonstick frypan over high heat. Add meat and cook until browned all over, about 2 minutes. Add 1/4 cup milk and season to taste with salt and remaining 3/4 tsp five spice powder. Cover and bake for 15 minutes. Remove from oven. Let stand 10 minutes, then slice and serve.

instructions: Heat oil in a non stick pan. When oil is very hot, add one teaspoon of capicum and wait few seconds. Add the drained black beans and stir fry for an additional 3 minutes. title: Caerphilly Cheese and Anchovy Grilled Chicken

Serve with lemon wedges.

title: Red Pepper and Tarragon Grilled Empanadas

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 f. In a small bowl, mix tarragon and ginger. Place on plate with pie shell. Spread tarragon mixture on pie shell. Sprinkle tarragon mixture on top of tarragon. Roll empanada with fingers to seal. Brush top of empanada with horseradish glaze or glaze. Place on baking sheet with lip. Bake in 400 f oven for 16 - 18 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Chipotle Toast
ingredients: 8 slices rye bread, cut 1 inch thick | 2 teaspoons dry sherry or 2 teaspoons port wine | 1/4 cup apricot jam | 2 teaspoons snipped fresh mint or 1/2 teaspoon dried mint | 1/2 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1/2 teaspoon minced canned chipotle chile in adobo ( or you may use canned chipotle chiles ) | 2 teaspoons icing sugar | minced of fresh mint
instructions: Brush bread with dry sherry. Heat 2 teaspoons jam in small nonstick skillet over medium high heat to a temperature of 325°f or until slightly bubbly. Brush one side with warm jam. Top with another four slices of rye bread and repeat with remaining spread mixture and bread. Sprinkle bread with minced mint leaves. Serve immediately.

instructions: Place noodles and vanilla bean inside a medium sized saucepan with some water over high heat and bring to the boil. Boil for 3 - 5 minutes until noodles are soft.

instructions: Heat oil to 300 degrees.

instructions: Position oven rack in middle of oven. Preheat broiler. Place bread on an ungreased baking sheet about 1 inch thick. Broil until pale gold, about 3 minutes. title: Crispy Cheese Balls With Savoy Cabbage - Camarones de Leche
ingredients: 1/2 bag shredded savoy cabbage | 5 ounces american cheese | 2 ounces spanish rice | 4 cherry tomatoes | 3 tablespoons tamari | 1 package grits ( i like publix brand ) | 1 -2 drop green food coloring
instructions: In one bowl, combine shredded savoy cabbage and cheese. Cut american cheese into 3/4 inch pieces. Cut cherry tomatoes into 3/4 inch pieces. Spread each of 3/4 inch sections of american cheese evenly across the bottom of a casserole dish or cake pan. Spread 1 tablespoon of tamari in bottom of dish and sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of tamari. Next, layer 1/4 teaspoon each of green food coloring on top, 1 tablespoon each of soy and rice, and a row of rice sprinkled with green cheese. Add 1/2 1/2 an additional layer of tamari. Spread cherry tomatoes evenly across top of lid in 1/4 inch slices. Gently press the cherry tomatoes into a layer of green, tamari tomato slices with the back of a spoon or spatula. Cut lid in half and squeeze the excess water out. Cut lid in half again and squeeze juice into dish. If you feel like it, press the cherry tomatoes a little bit, then press all of that back into the dish and press juice back inches. Set dish aside to cool to room temperature. Prepare spanish rice as per package directions. Dissolve 1 - 2 tablespoons of tamari in 1/4 cup water, and refrigerate until rice is completely chilled.. Meanwhile, mix grits and water in a bowl. Add water by the tablespoon in a clockwise direction to make a sticky consistency. To do this, line a plate with wax paper, and spread a large bowl of water across it. Using your hands, break handfuls of spaghettiu into 4 equal sized balls. Roll them first into the grits and water, then into the wax paper, then press it again into a ball with the help of a wooden spoon. Repeat until you have used up all the dough. Transfer the balls to a plate lined with wax paper and refrigerate until ready to serve. After the rice has chilled, heat a skillet over medium high heat. Toast spanish rice. It should be puffed up like fondue forks. Place a grapefruit slice or two across top of each spaghettiu to resemble a stem. Sprinkle the top with 1 tablespoon of green, tamari and a little bit of scallions. Pour 3 - 4 tablespoons of rice into center on each plate and spread thinly, with a grapefruit slice or two across the top of rice. Place the serving platter, then flip top a little so the rice gets hot. Do not flip the bottom side of the platter. Serve right away. Note, you can make this ahead of time and place in the fridge before serving. Note, if you are making this ahead of time, it will not make it. Bring a pot of water to a boil, then add the spaghettiu balls and boil until the float. When the rice is ready, put a dish of the sauce on one of your plates or a portable heatproof plate, then place the spaghettiu balls onto the sauce. Serve immediately.

title: Shrimp and Bow Tie Pasta
ingredients: 1 package farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 1 pound medium shrimp - peeled and deveined | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 4 cups shredded lettuce
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add farfalle pasta and cook for 13 to 14 minutes or until al dente.

title: Green Peppercorn Mushroom Taco Shells
ingredients: 250 g cremini mushrooms ( sliced thin ) | 8 large water-packed tequila-flavored tortilla chips | 1/4 cup green peppercorn ( coarsely ground ) | 3 1/2 tablespoons tequila-flavored water
instructions: Microwave water in a microwavable dish on high for 1 minute. Cool slightly. Microwave mushrooms in the microwave on high for 20 seconds, then place in a medium bowl. Microwave tequila fluff for 2 minutes. Stir and then stir in peppercorns. Microwave tequila fluff on high 2 more minutes. Stir. Stir. Repeat with tequila fluff, tequila fluff, and green pepperon. Microwave in 2 more minutes. Cool completely. Serve with tortilla chips.

instructions: In a small skillet or blender combine the parsley, coriander, arise seeds, crushed coriander seeds, lime leaves and chicken bouillon.

instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f. Prepare 2 large baking sheets. Put the squash in a large roasting pan with a few tablespoons of water on the bottom of each, to steam them. Pour out the excess water and save the squash for the future use. Put the squash into a large, heavy roasting pan or baking dish with the bread cubes and roughly chop the cilantro. Drizzle with oil. title: Chicken and Noodle Casserole With Beans
ingredients: 10 ounces rigatoni pasta or 10 ounces penne | 1 packet frozen chicken tenderloins, thawed and cut into chunks | 7 ounces refried beans with chilies ( or black beans ) | 4 ounces shredded monterey jack cheese | 1 cup white flour | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon | 14 ounces white harina refried beans ( with liquid ) | 2 tablespoons self rising flour | 1 jar bean threads or ( 19 ounce ) jar corn threads, drained
instructions: Cook rigatoni until al dente only. Drain. Grease 13x9 inch baking dish with shortening or margarine. Coat chicken with flour and set aside. title: Nilaga's Fool Proof Spanish Green Beans  (Spain)
ingredients: 1 lb small flat-leaf italian parsley | 1/2 lb jaggery ( i use piloncillo sugar ) | 1 jar dry pimentos | 1 -4 cup of coarsely chopped pimento ( piquillo de la vera )
instructions: The best way to prepare this dish is to buy a bag with a pkg size lid or tupperware container and, ideally, the container is big enough to hold all the ingredients. If you use tupperware or a jar that's large enough, you'll have to split the lid halfway through your mixing. First wash your parsley in a collander and remove as much outer layer of leaves as possible. When the water starts to sputter at the top of the herbs, throw it out and throw out the remaining leaves. You'll have about 3 cups of leaves. If using tupperware or jar, pour the contents of the jar into the container. If using tupperware or jar, pour out as much oil as possible and empty contents back into the container with a tight lid. Use your hands to squish the lid a bit to push the air out of the jar, as well as the tight lid you have kept under the lid. If you use a jar you're not using, just pour off any excess liquid that may have come out of your squeezing jar. You may rinse out the jar with hot water, if necessary. You'll be adding about 1/3 to a 1/2 cup more oil, or more depending on how you want it, but i always skim the top of the oil so that it can collect in a small quantity.

title: Beef Breakfast Loaf
ingredients: 2 eggs | 2 tablespoons almonds, finely chopped | 1 beef bouillon cube, maggi 6-3 maggi | 1 loaf white bread, crusts removed ( optional ) | 2 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, grated ( optional )

Sprinkle the top with the remaining whole almonds and the grated cheddar cheese. Place under the broiler for 3 - 4 minutes or until the cheese has melted.

instructions: Heat oil in a pot. Cook onions until they are starting to soften. Add chorizo and beef. Brown, but don't burn. When meat is just about halfway done, add to pot. instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Break ramen noodles to manageable segments and separate noodles. Drain pineapples and then place in large shallow bowl. title: Apple Pain Perdu -- a French Toast Sandwich
ingredients: 3 tablespoons fresh orange juice or 3 tablespoons sour orange juice | 1 medium apple, peeled, sliced and sliced ( i use fuji ) | 5 slices firm white bread | 5 -6 tablespoons fresh squeezed orange juice or 5 -6 tablespoons sour orange juice | 1 tablespoon liqueur, such as grand marnier ( to taste )
instructions: If your apple is very sweet, you may substitute other citrus juices of choice. title: Cheesecake St. Valentines Chili Cream

instructions: I can't tell you how long it will take to boil this.
