Take a few spoonfuls of the spaghetti sauce and coat them with it. Drizzle the rest of the sauce on top of that. Spread half of the cheese mix on top. Repeat steps 8 - 10 again until cheeses are gone. Don't worry if the topping is not very thick but it will take on a good texture when it is done. If it is, spread it over that and chill in fridge for at least 6 hours or longer. Cut and serve with cherryvil and a good green salad.

Random Ingredients: bourbon,grain white rice,tomato soup,basil leaf,red chile
title: Chilli Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups long grain white rice | 2 cups tomato soup, canned, low sodium | 1 -2 dried red chile, seeded | 4 basil leaves, fresh, torn | 2 ounces bourbon
instructions: In a pot, combine the 2 cups rice, the 1 - 2 tablespoons red chiles, the basil and 3 cups soup. Bring to a boil then reduce to medium low. Cook until rice is tender and all the liquid has been absorbed, about 20 - 25 minutes. To serve, ladle hot rice into bowls, and garnish with fresh basil and 2 oz. Of bourbon.

title: Pita Bread Dip
ingredients: 6 eggs | 1 gallon half-and-half | 1 package frozen bread, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 jar hot red pepper sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In a large bowl, beat together eggs, half & half, and 1 package of bread. Pour half the egg mixture in the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Spoon the red pepper sauce around the bread cubes. Cover with remaining 1 1/2 cups bread cubes. Bake in the preheated oven until bubbly and lightly browned, 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Apple Lettuce Wrapped Onions With Canola Oil and Apple
ingredients: 1/2 cup canola oil | 5 spring onions, sliced thinly | 1 apple, roughly cubed ( such as mcintosh, mcintosh ) | kosher salt, to taste | 3/4 cup half-and-half | 1 head iceberg lettuce, leaves separated
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°. Heat the canola oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the spring onions and apple. Cook, stirring occasionally until tender, about 5 minutes. Add the half and half, and season with salt to taste. Remove from heat. Arrange lettuce leaves on a serving plate.

title: Tomato Salad
ingredients: 20 -30 tomatoes ( i prefer red ) | 3 scallions, sliced | 1 -2 lemon | 2 -4 tablespoons sugar snap peas
instructions: Cut tomatoes in half lengthwise and de seed. Slice onions crosswise into thin slices. Mix onions and remaining ingredients in a salad bowl. Pour over vegetables and chill several hours.

title: Raspberry Phyllo Rollups
ingredients: 1 box frozen phyllo pastry, thawed | parsley flakes, to taste | 1 romaine lettuce or 1 other mixed salad greens | 1/3 cup fresh raspberries or 1/3 cup blackberries
instructions: Heat oven to 200 degrees celcius. Line a baking tray with a double thickness of foil. Thaw phyllo until it is slightly thicker. Drain the frozen phyllo sheets, stack them on top of one another and cut with a sharp knife into 5 squares or rectangles. Roll the phyllo dough squares in the same direction until coated. Place in the center of a sprayed baking tray and bake for about 10 to 15 minutes or until golden. Remove from the tray and place over a baking tray to cool. To make the dressing, place the romaine and raspberries in a bowl and drizzle with the dressing and toss until the flavors are well incorporated. Place the phyllo pieces on a lettuce leaf and place 2 tablespoons of the romaine mix into the middle of each one. Add the sliced phyllo in 1/2 increments on the lettuce leaf and then top with berries. Repeat until you have used up all the phyllo. Serve the remaining phyllo cubes in a small bowl, covered with plastic wrap, to wrap around the rollups in the dressing.

Random Ingredients: strawberry,white sugar,tomato juice,active yeast,sesame oil,cumin seed
title: Cumin Strawberry Bruschetta
ingredients: 2 lbs small ripe strawberrys | 2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 teaspoon white sugar | 2 teaspoons sesame oil | 3/4 cup packed light-brown sugar | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin seed | 1 1/2 cups chilled tomato juice
instructions: Place the strawberries in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: lamb,italian bread french,anise seed,squid,tomato puree,catsup,yellow onion,broccoli
title: Italian Meatloaf and Broccoli
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground lamb | 1/2 lb ground raw shrimp ( cooked or raw ) | 1 cup chopped yellow onion | 1/2 cup tomato puree | 1 1/2 teaspoons aniseed seeds | 1 lb broccoli | 5 cups italian bread or 5 cups french bread, cut into cubes | 1/2 cup catsup
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. In a medium sized bowl combine lamb, shrimp, onion and tomato puree. Stir in aniseed and anise flavoured sauce. Stir in the frozen broccoli. Place bread cubes on a cookie sheet with sides. Spoon beef/shrimp mixture into center of each bread dish. Bake for about 45 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Easy Easy St. Louis Style Pulled Pork spareribs
ingredients: 1 bag country style country style pork spareribs | toothpick
instructions: Place the country style pork spareribs on a heavy duty zip top plastic bag. Pour in just enough water to cover the ribs. Seal the bag of country style pork spareribs and tie with butcher string. Refrigerate for at least 3 hours and up to overnight. Preheat grill for medium high heat. Remove the reserved country style pork sparerib mixture from the bag of country style pork spare ribs, reserving the liquid. Rinse the bag of country style pork spare ribs and gently pat dry. Place the bag of spareribs onto the grill, turning to lightly sear each side and evenly distribute the reserved pork spareribs over the top of the ribs with a spatula. Cook uncovered for 15 to 20 minutes, until the pork is cooked through and no longer pink in the center.

title: Beer Rice
ingredients: 1/4 cup long grain white rice | 2 cans light beer
instructions: Combine the beer and the rice and cook at a simmer over low heat, stirring occasionally, until all the liquid has been absorbed and the rice is cooked.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,garlic clove,star anise,plum sauce,tortilla,french bread
title: Panch Phautès (Chinese Bread and Butter Puffs)
ingredients: 3 large garlic cloves, peeled | 3 fresh turkish star anise, broken into 6 pieces | 6 tablespoons plum sauce, or more to taste | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 loaf french bread, thinly sliced | 1 loaf tortillas, cut into 1/2-inch strips
instructions: Preheat oven to 475 degrees f. Place garlic cloves, star anise pods, plum sauce, olive oil, and 1 bread slice on a cutting board. Using a mallet, pound the cloves until roughly chopped. Place the remaining bread slices side by side and cut each slice into 3 triangles. Heat a cast iron skillet over medium heat and brush with olive oil. Place triangle triangles in the skillet and cook, turning once, until browned, about 2 minutes per side. Repeat as needed. Serve immediately.

title: Herbed Salmon With Indian Bread
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 kg good quality salmon, skin washed, scaled and diced | 1/2 cup mixed herbs, chopped | tamari | 250 g croutons or 250 g crackers, to serve | 1 -2 tablespoon prepared mustard curry paste ( a taste of india is a must. ) | shredded lettuce leaf
instructions: Place the salmon in a bowl. Add the chopped herbs, curry paste and some tamari. Toss to combine. Sprinkle with croutons or crackers. Serve over basmati rice.

title: Blueberry and Fontina Tarragon Sauce
ingredients: 1 can blueberries | 1 teaspoon tarragon | 1/4 cup mustard powder ( not salt ) | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 cup broccoli floret | 1 cup frm fontina
instructions: In a small saucepan put blueberries, tarragon and mustard powder. Pouring in a couple cups of water and leave on medium low heat until blueberries open and burst. Break apart with fork. Take from heat, mix in turmeric and broccoli stir till broccoli is soft. While this cools pour remaining liquid from can into a small pot that had been sprayed with pam or a bit of olive oil. Add mustard mixture and mix throughly. Once mixture becomes nice and thick, add fontina stir throughly.

Random Ingredients: lentil,asafoetida powder,sesame oil,dark soy sauce,hamburger bun
title: Lentils and Meat (Cha Yen-Yatbai Kebabs)
ingredients: 400 g hamburger buns | 375 g split lentils, cleaned | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 1 teaspoon dark soy sauce | light soy sauce, for dipping
instructions: Toast the bun, open, rub with a few drops of dark sauce.

Random Ingredients: mushroom,cooking oil,cauliflower,anchovy,beef stew meat,bok choy,butter,taco seasoning mix
title: Bok Choy & Beef Stir-Fry
ingredients: 4 ounces shredded beef stew meat | 1/2 lb mushroom, sliced | 1/2 cup sliced cauliflower | 1/4 cup sliced bok choy | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 2 tablespoons melted butter
instructions: Chop bok choy. Set aside. Slice mushrooms. Steam cauliflower until al dente. Drain. Combine beef, mushrooms, cauliflower & taco seasoning mix in a mixing bowl. Add melted butter & microwave to mix. Heat frying pan over medium high heat. Add cooking oil. Add beef & vegetables. Stir fry until meat is browned and vegetables are crisp tender. Add taco seasoning mix & heat through.

title: Low Fat Italian Green Chili Beans
ingredients: 1 lb fresh green beans, cut into 2-inch pieces | 1 can green enchilada sauce, 1/2-1/2 cups | 1 1/2 cups low-fat plain yogurt
instructions: Cook beans in large pot of boiling water for 5 - 6 minutes or until tender crisp. Add enchilada sauce and yogurt. Stir well. Let stand for a few minutes then serve.

title: Simple, Healthy & Delicious Guacamole Chips
ingredients: 2 tablespoons corn oil | 1 tablespoon guacamole
instructions: Heat the corn oil in a large frying pan on medium heat. Add the guacamole and fry on each side until crispy. Eat while still warm or place on a piece of plastic wrap covered in cling film & refrigerate until ready to use. Note on guacamole, to increase the flavour, put the guacamole in a bowl & add some chopped onion, garlic, black olives or other spices. This recipe can also be made with the addition of other dried herbs or dried herbs. If the oil is not hot enough, the guacamole will be slightly more tart. You may add water or any other liquid you may wish to use. Note on corn oil, you may wish to use vegetable oil to add more flavour without sacrificing any flavours.

title: Mango and Mascarpone Cannelloni
ingredients: 2 1/4 lbs mangoes, peeled and sliced | 4 cups eggnog | 1 tablespoon mild paprika or 1 tablespoon mango powder | 1/2 cup cooking oil | 24 sheets lasagna noodles, cooked | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 1 cup mascarpone or 1 cup ricotta cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In bowl, combine mangoes, eggnog, paprika, oil, and mushrooms. Line 9 x 5 x 1/2 inch glass baking baking dish with 1 cup of the noodles. Layer with 3/4 of the mango/egg mixture and repeat layers. Finish with 3/4 of the mango mixture. Sprinkle with mace. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours. Bake 30 minutes, or until heated through and sauce is bubbling.

title: Baked Beans With Cheddar
ingredients: 100 g shredded cheddar | 100 g punnet small beans | black pepper | 1 tablespoon thompson seedless grapes, cut in half
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees celsius. Take the seeds out of the grapes and set aside. Boil the beans for 10 minutes, drain. Place all the ingredients in a large casserole dish. Mix everything together and sprinkle over the grapes.

Random Ingredients: plum preserve,snow pea,black coffee,coconut milk,turnip,rice wine
title: Sweet Vietnamese Snow Pea Soup
ingredients: 32 ounces snow peas, washed and patted dry | 2 medium turnips, peeled and pared, coarsely chopped | 32 ounces plum preserves, undiluted | 4 quarts black coffee ( brewed ) | 2 tablespoons rice wine | 2 cans light coconut milk
instructions: Combine snow peas and turnips in large dutch oven. Cover with water and bring to boil. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer 20 minutes. Add preserves, and cook 5 minutes longer or until tender. Pour in a blender, and blend till smooth. Return soup to stew pot. Add coconut milk, and heat to boiling. Reduce heat to very low, cover, and simmer 5 minutes, or until soup is thickened slightly. Serve hot.

title: Easy Caribbean Grill Steaks for Two
ingredients: 1 pound flank steak | 1 jar mango chutney | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers, drained | 1 jar salsa
instructions: Prepare a slow cooker with nonstick cooking spray. Rinse the steak well and pat dry with paper towels. Place in the slow cooker. Stir the mango chutney, diced tomatoes and salsa together in a medium bowl. Pour the contents of the can into the pan. Cover, and cook on high for 5 hours or low for 4 to 5 hours. Remove from heat and shred steak with two forks. Serve over rice.

Random Ingredients: coriander seed,mexican cheese,chuck,pie crust,serrano chilies,sun tomato oil
title: Spicy Beef Pies
ingredients: 3 lbs ground chuck | 3 tablespoons coriander seeds | 2 -3 serrano chilies, seeded and minced | 2 teaspoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained and chopped | 2 packages of shredded mexican blend cheese | 2 unbaked pie crust
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Brown ground chuck in oil in 2 batches and drain. Add coriander seeds, chilies, sun dried tomatoes and 1 teaspoon salt. Continue to cook and stir until most of the water has evaporated. Spread mixture evenly in the bottom of your quiche pans. Sprinkle cheese all over, then top with the meat mixture. Bake 20 minutes or until a knife inserted in the middle comes out clean.

Random Ingredients: meatball,penne pasta,tamarind paste,black pepper,genoa salami,almond extract,graham cracker crumb,button mushroom
title: Penne Alla Genoese
ingredients: 12 cooked meatballs, sliced into 6 pieces | 1 package uncooked dry penne pasta | 1/4 cup tamarind paste | 2 tablespoons white food coloring | 2 teaspoons ground black pepper | 1 package sliced genoa salami | 1 pound button mushrooms | 1/4 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Cook pasta in a large pot with water and tamarind paste until tender but firm, about 15 minutes. Stir in food color and black pepper, then remove from heat. Place salami, mushrooms, graham cracker crumbs, and almond extract into a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: pepper sauce,cilantro leaf,chicken bouillon,ladyfinger,poblano chile,half,golden raisin
title: Smoky Poblano Fajitas
ingredients: 2 poblano chiles, stemmed, slit on the side and seeded | 2 tablespoons chopped cilantro leaves | 1/4 cup golden raisin | 1/2 teaspoon chicken bouillon | 1 cup half-and-half | 1/2 cup sweet pepper sauce | 8 ladyfingers, split lengthwise, toasted
instructions: In a skillet, place poblanos, cilantro, raisins, chicken bouillon and sweet pepper sauce.

Random Ingredients: shiitake mushroom,fennel seed,nutmeg,beef rib,red chilies,ricotta cheese
title: Ribs With Mushrooms
ingredients: 12 ounces fresh shiitake mushrooms, stemmed and sliced | 3 lbs meaty beef ribs, cut into 2-inch x 1-inch wide slices | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 14 1/2 ounces ricotta cheese | 1 teaspoon grated nutmeg | 3 small red chilies, finely chopped | 15 fresh fennel seeds | freshly cut dried shiitake mushroom, stems trimmed, caps cut into 1/2-inch pieces
instructions: Soak dried shiitake mushrooms, in warm water, to cover 7 minutes. Drain, dry and slit open, but do not remove stems. Rinse and dry mushroom caps. Reserve mushrooms, and set aside. Place beef and fennel seeds with 1 tablespoon oil in medium heavy saucepan. Working over high heat, fry 3 or 4 sizzling hot sizzles, swirling pan to heat evenly. Reduce heat to medium low, and cook sizzles, stirring often, until beef is cooked through, about 15 minutes. Transfer beef to large bowl. Add ricotta, nutmeg and chiles, and stir to blend. Serve with dried shiitake mushrooms.

Random Ingredients: peanut butter,ra el hanout spice mix
title: Easy Ras El Hanout
ingredients: 1/2 lb white raisin-o-glazed peanuts ( or crushed roasted peanuts ) | 1/2 teaspoon ras el hanout spice mix ( or your own favourite flavor mix )
instructions: In a small saucepan, heat the peanut butter over medium heat, stirring frequently until melted. Add the remaining ingredients and cook, stirring frequently, until the mixture becomes dry. Stir well to prevent scorching.

title: Jamaican Chicken
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 1 cup chili sauce | 1 cup mustard powder
instructions: In a large saucepan over medium heat, combine chicken breast halves, chili sauce and mustard powder. Heat through, and place on a platter. Pour the chicken drippings over the top.

Random Ingredients: nori,poblano pepper,beef tenderloin,beer,gruyere cheese,macadamia nut,picante sauce
title: Tex Mex Beef Sandwich Loaf  (Aka Patty Melt)
ingredients: 1 pound beef tenderloin | 2 bunches of chopped rind from 1 poblano pepper | 1 jar picante sauce | 1 can sliced nori ( optional ) | 2 packages shredded gruyere cheese | 1/4 cup macadamia nuts, coarsely chopped
instructions: Cut beef into 1 inch cubes, and then cut each cube into chunks the size of the poblano peppers. Combine beef, chiles, picante sauce and nori in a large bowl. Mix until well blended and then press into a 9x5x3 loaf pan. Spread nori around loaf pan to form a crust. Fill each of the four hollowed out ramekins with beef and vegetables. Cover with a layer of cheese and nuts. Preheat oven to 325 degrees fahrenheit. Bake uncovered at 325 degrees fahrenheit for 30 minutes until heated through and cheese has melted. Cut into portions, and serve with sour cream, salsa and your favourite sides.

title: Pepper-and-Fork-Fry Potatoes
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs beef flank steak | 1 rutabaga, peeled and cut into 4 - 6 x 1/2 inch cubes | 1 can apricot preserves, undiluted
instructions: Trim excess fat from steak. Cut steak into 5 to 6 pieces. Place 1/2 of the rutabaga on an oiled rack of a roasting pan, then lay the steak slices on top. Repeat with remaining vegetables. Sprinkle both sides with preserves. Cover with foil. Bake in a preheated 400 degree f oven for 1 1/2 hours, basting occasionally with pan juices, until steak is tender.

Random Ingredients: hot pepper,white peppercorn,cilantro leaf,cooking spray,palm oil
title: Sambal Sweet Chilli
ingredients: cooking spray | 50 dried hot peppers | 1/4 cup palm oil | 1 teaspoon white peppercorns | 2 tablespoons fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 f. Coat a large baking sheet with cooking spray. Trim and discard stems from dried hot peppers, then remove seeds from dried chilies, and cut into 1 inch pieces. Place a dry wok over medium high heat until hot. Add cooking oil, then chilies and cilantro. Cook, shaking wok, for 2 minutes, or until chili is very fragrant. Transfer to a serving dish, then serve.

title: Mexican Cranberry Beans
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried pinto bean, rinsed | 2 cups mexican-style corn | 1/2 cup drained and rinsed cranberries | 1/4 cup drained capers
instructions: Combine beans, corn, cranberries and capers in a 3 to 5 quart slow cooker. Cover, and cook on low for 2 to 3 hours, or until beans are tender and corn is tender.

Random Ingredients: red capsicum,green curry paste,artichoke heart,cinnamon,bean,red snapper,lillet blanc,orange marmalade
title: Crispy Baked Fish and Veggies
ingredients: 1 lb red snapper | 8 ounces lillet blanc or 8 ounces white fish fillets | 8 large green curry paste, to taste ( i use thai kitchen brand because it is really good, but if you can get some curry paste in the grocery store ) ( optional ) | 1 medium orange, very thinly sliced | 1 medium red capsicum, chopped | 2 tablespoons orange marmalade | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon | 3/4 cup fresh bean, cut in half ( or frozen mixed sprouts )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Slice the fish into 1/2 inch thick pieces. Arrange fish in a single layer on a foil lined baking sheet. Bake for 5 minutes. Slightly brown the fish in the oven. Add the curry paste and cook, stirring, for 2 minutes. Stir in the marmalade. Add orange slices, capsicum and remaining ingredients. Cover and bake for 30 minutes, or until fish is cooked. Serve hot.

title: Tasty Cappellini
ingredients: 1 teaspoon instant coffee | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped flat leaf parsley, divided | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg, divided | 1 medium grape tomatoes, halved | 12 small shrimp, shelled | 1/2 cup polenta, uncooked
instructions: In a small bowl, combine marinade ingredients.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,chuck roast,lime,ginger garlic paste,lemon pepper,muenster cheese,clam juice,yellow squash
title: Clam Chowder
ingredients: 1 boneless chuck roast, trimmed of excess fat | 1 1/2 pounds yellow squash, cut into 1/4- to 1/2-inch slices | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 teaspoon ginger garlic paste | 1 can chopped clams with juice | 1 teaspoon ground ginger and garlic salt | 1/4 cup lime juice | freshly grated muenster cheese ( optional ) | 1 lemon pepper, cut into four wedges
instructions: In a dutch oven or large deep skillet, brown the chuck roast on all sides in the canola oil until nicely browned on all sides, 7 to 10 minutes. Remove the beef to a plate. Stir in the ginger garlic paste and green squash slices. Pour in the clams, bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer, partially covered, partially covered, stirring occasionally, until just tender, about 30 minutes. Add the grated muenster cheese, if using, and season the chowder with garlic salt and lemon pepper if using. Serve with lemon wedges.

Random Ingredients: sugar,sazon goya,bulk italian sausage,snow pea,red wine
title: Sausage and Snow Peas
ingredients: 1 lb bulk italian sausage | 1 package frozen snow peas | 1/4 cup red wine | 1 package sazon goya | 1 teaspoon sugar
instructions: In a skillet fry italian sausage over medium heat. Add the peas. Sprinkle sazon, red wine, and sugar. Place to heat through. Serve hot and enjoy.

title: Tomato and Apricot Spread
ingredients: 4 tomatoes, roughly chopped | 3 tablespoons icing sugar or 3 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 1/2 teaspoon hot sauce | 1 medium apricot, finely chopped in cuisinart
instructions: Mix well. Refrigerate and serve with chilled custard.

title: Irish Okra and Cashews
ingredients: 3 ounces frozen cut okra | 2 ounces french fries, cut into 2 inch squares | 1/3 cup half-and-half | 1/4 cup dry sherry | 1/2 teaspoon bouillon granules | 3/4 - 1 cup mixed greens | 1 teaspoon instant tea | chopped cashews
instructions: Cook okra and french fries with a little olive oil in a large skillet on medium heat. Drain okra mixture and add to skillet along with sherry, bouillon and mixed greens. Simmer until okra is heated throughout and the greens are crisp.

title: Kimchi Jelly
ingredients: 1 cabbage kimchi, shredded | red food coloring ( korean )
instructions: Remove a sliver of red kimchi from the grater. Break off the tough stem portion of the kimchi, then cut into chunks about 1 - 1 1/2 inches long and 1/2 inch wide. Fill a large, heavy pot with water. Bring to a boil and drop in the kimchi pieces. Cook uncovered over low heat, stirring frequently, until tender and translucent.

Random Ingredients: white corn,oil tuna,mutton,maraschino cherry,parsley flake,cayenne pepper,anise seed
title: Moroccan White Corn Tuna Spread
ingredients: 16 ounces canned white corn, drained | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 -2 tablespoon anise seed | 1 can condensed oil ( tuna, etc. ) | 32 ounces mutton, cut into small chunks and cooked ( or lamb, but i usually use pork ) | 1 tablespoon parsley flakes | 18 maraschino cherries, quartered
instructions: Drain corn of all liquid. Combine all ingredients except cherries in food processor and process until almost smooth. Pour mixture into containers with a large lid and refrigerate until ready to serve. I usually make this the day before and let it sit in the refrigerator to cool a bit before adding the cherries. I don't usually refrigerate the corn but add them right about 1 hour before serving.

title: Crusty Pumpkin Brulee
ingredients: 1/2 kg winter pumpkin, peeled, deseeded, finely chopped | 1 bouillon cube ( or use 3 teaspoons instant in a pinch ) | 1 tablespoon custard powder | 60 g gruyere cheese, grated | icing sugar, to dust | custard powder
instructions: Put the pumpkin into a saucepan and fill with enough cold water to just cover. Bring to the boil, then simmer for 5 minutes to soften flesh. Transfer to a bowl, sprinkle on the bouillon cube or bouillon, then stir in the custard powder and half the cheese. Toss the vegetables together in a roasting tin, pour over the cheese and drizzle over a little more custard and a sprinkling of sugar. Sprinkle a few extra icing sugar over the top of the top and bake in a pre heated oven at 220°c/375°f/gas mark 5 for 30 minutes before serving. Serve on individual ramekin dishes with a good mixed salad or plain yoghurt.

title: Chunky Vegetable & Bacon Packets
ingredients: 1/2 lb bacon ( chunks or pieces, use bacon bits or 2 sticks each ) or 1/2 lb salt-red cheddar cheese, crumbled ( or 2 sticks each ) | 1 cup frozen peas, thawed or 2 cups fresh peas, thawed | 1 cup frozen chard, thawed ( stems removed, leaves cut into 1-inch pieces ) | 14 tomatillos, husked, rinsed ( lardons ) | 1 - 1 1/2 cup low-sodium hot salsa | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Combine bacon bits or bacon fat, chard leaves, tomato pieces and salsa in a small bowl. Spray a 2 quart baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Spread vegetable mixture evenly in the baking dish, being careful not to disturb the bacon or chard on the edges. Cover with bacon bits and sprinkle paprika over bacon and chard. Wrap tightly in foil and bake 25 - 30 minutes, stirring twice or twice, or until bacon is browned.

title: Mexican Chocolate and Goat Cheese Pita Pockets
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons chili peppers, diced ( with seeds ) | 1/2 tablespoon pepitas, powder ( ground fennel seeds can also be used ) | 1 tablespoon dried pepitas ( dried ground chile powder can also be used ) | 2 teaspoons dried chili pepper | 1 teaspoon cocoa powder | 2 tablespoons hot sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons paprika | 1/2 - 3/4 cup tomato sauce, strained from jar- tomato puree | 1 cup pitted dates, chopped | 1/2 cup salsa
instructions: If using ground chili powder, place the chili in a medium size non reactive bowl, cover with hot water and leave in a cool spot for an hour. Drain and allow to cool before grinding. Add the pepitas powder, dried chili, cocoa powder and chili pepper flakes to the bowl and mix thoroughly. Add the olive oil, tomato sauce or hot sauce and paprika, making sure to combine well. Form into about 24 patties. Place 2 or 3 on each plate, and spoon 1 1/2 teaspoons of the mixture inside each pita. Garnish with the sliced dates. This recipe can also be made in advance and refrigerated, adding the goat cheese patties to the pita before serving.

title: Homemade Dip
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese, at room temperature | 1 jar chopped chili peppers
instructions: Set oven to 375 degrees f. Mix cream cheese, chili peppers, and hot sauce together until smooth. Pour into glass or ceramic 9x13 inch pan to form a small crust. Refrigerate until serving time. This will keep up to 6 days. Serve with pita chips or vegetables, crackers, or raw vegetables. An alternate filling can be made by combining chili powder and ground cumin. Use as filling for tacos.

Random Ingredients: semolina,tomato,clove,cheddar cheese,white wine vinegar,chicken thigh,cilantro leaf
title: Guinness Chicken and Cheddar Skewers
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups semolina | 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese | 1 tablespoon dried cilantro leaves ( optional ) | 1 pinch ground cloves | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1 small tomatoes, chopped | 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs
instructions: Preheat the grill to high. In a small bowl, stir together the semolina, cheddar cheese, cilantro, cloves and vinegar. Thread 3 pieces of chicken onto each skewer. Grill the chicken, for 20 minutes, turning to brown. For the topping, in a small saucepan, stir together the tomatoes and chives. Serve the chicken skewers with the tomato mixture.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,hot paprika,key lime,sage,romaine lettuce,hominy,ajwain
title: Authentic Mexican Hominy Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup dried hominy | 2 quarts fresh rinsed hominy | 2 tablespoons ground sage, divided | 1 tablespoon hot paprika, or more to taste | 1 cup freshly grated pecorino romano cheese | 4 key limes, juiced | 1 head romaine lettuce, chopped
instructions: Sort through the dry rocks of rinsed hominy and place in a large pot. Scrub rinsed hominy with a fine sieve. Bring enough cold water to cover the rinsed hominy to a boil, and cook for 20 minutes. Drain and rinse well in cool water. Drain again.

title: Chilli Corn and Chilli
ingredients: 250 g corn | 1 teaspoon chili flakes | 1 pinch asafoetida powder ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon prepared grainy mustard | 2 tablespoons freshly grated cheese
instructions: Heat grill to high.

Random Ingredients: turnip,coriander seed,banana lengthwise,ice water,soymilk,harissa,seafood stock,cilantro leaf
title: Coriander and Turnips Smoothie
ingredients: 2 cups seafood stock, low sodium | 2 teaspoons harissa ( spicy hot pepper sauce ) | 2 ounces desiccated coconut or 2 ounces flaked coconut | 1 tablespoon coriander seed, crushed | 1 tablespoon potato masher or 1 tablespoon harissa | 1 tablespoon soymilk, soy milk | 1 tablespoon ice water | 2 slices fresh banana, halved lengthwise
instructions: Place the stock in a blender and add the remaining ingredients. Blend well, adding the banana pieces and blending until smooth. Cover and place in the refrigerator for 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: apricot jam,broccoli,chicken breast,red chile pepper,beef medallion,beef bouillon powder,yellow squash,peach
title: Baked Corn Beef Medallions and Veggies
ingredients: 3 tablespoons beef bouillon powder, divided | 2 cans chipotle pepper jam | 1 bunch broccoli, trimmed | 1 pound boneless beef medallions, sliced into thin strips | 1 yellow squash, thinly sliced | 1 peach, pitted and sliced into thin wedges | 2 large red chile peppers, seeded and chopped | 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into bite-size pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Combine 1 tablespoon beef bouillon powder and jam in a saucepan, and heat until warm. Stir in broccoli.

title: Cabbage and Black Beans
ingredients: 1 -2 head of shredded cabbage ( any amount to your own tastes, i prefer 2 but not in all ) | 1 1/2 cups of cooked black beans ( optional ) | 3 cups cooked fish sauce ( i prefer nouve blast ) | 2 teaspoons garlic salt
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Heat through and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: seasoning salt,fennel seed,louisiana sauce,cider vinegar,ice,italian salad dressing mix,steak,salmon
title: Easy Salmon Ceviche
ingredients: 1 pound topside steak, pounded to 1/2-inch thickness | 3 cups coarsely chopped fresh fennel seeds | 1 1/2 ounces italian-style salad dressing mix | 1 pint apple cider vinegar | 1 bottle louisiana hot sauce | 2 teaspoons seasoning salt | 10 cups ice
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place the pounded steak onto the prepared baking sheet, and sprinkle with fennel seeds. Drizzle the fennel seeds with salad dressing mix. Bake fennel in the preheated oven for 6 to 7 minutes, or until evenly browned. Pour apple cider vinegar into a large saucepan, and mix in hot sauce and seasoning salt. Bring to a simmer. Place ice in a pie plate to cover pie. Pour boiling water over the ice. Cover, and shake the pan to evenly distribute ice. Let sit for at least 5 minutes while the fennel ripples and is drawn into the ice. Stir in the drained fennel.

title: Vegan French Baked Tofu
ingredients: 1 package extra firm tofu ( drained ) | 2 teaspoons nutritional yeast flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Cut tofu into 1/8 inch thick slices. Place tofu on a greased baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Sprinkle the tofu chunks with the yeast. Bake in the oven for 15 minutes or until liquid separates from tofu. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: avocado,yellow onion,red onion,cinnamon sugar,cilantro leaf,white fish fillet,monterey jack cheese
title: Santa Fe Fish Filet
ingredients: 2 white fish fillets | 2 tablespoons cinnamon sugar | 1 medium avocado, pitted, peeled and diced | 1/2 cup diced yellow onion | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 3/4 cup finely shredded monterey jack cheese | 1/2 small red onion, separated
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine all ingredients except red onion. Set aside. Place fish filet in the center of a piece of foil. Spoon 1/4 of the onion mixture on top of each filet, then drizzle with remaining onion mixture. Close foil and fold all sides to form a parcel. Bake in a preheated 375 degree f oven for 20 to 25 minutes, or until fish flakes easily.

Random Ingredients: spring onion,button mushroom,cream chicken soup,tart apple
title: Mushroom and Apple Strudels
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 1/4 cups chopped tart apples | 12 button mushrooms, sliced | 2 green spring onions, chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients, except green onion, in a 2 quart baking dish. Bake at 400 for 15 to 20 minutes or until hot.

title: Pizzaria
ingredients: 12 asparagus spears, in 2-inch lengths | 4 ounces fresh spinach, chopped | 1/2 cup frozen chopped asparagus spears | 1/4 cup cornmeal | 1 teaspoon dried sage | 1/4 teaspoon all purpose greek seasoning | 1 garlic clove, minced | 1/4 cup half-and-half
instructions: To make the cornmeal meal, combine the cornmeal & sage + the garlic & stir until crumbly, add the half & half. Stir in 1 t. Of the spinach and the chopped asparagus. Spread onto an ungreased jelly roll pan.

Random Ingredients: bread,lime wedge,chicken bouillon,white pepper powder,soymilk,red onion,vanilla soymilk
title: Thai Fattening Bread Bowl
ingredients: 5 slices bread, crusts removed and crumbled | 1 cup plain soymilk | 2 tablespoons vanilla-flavored soymilk | 1 clove chicken bouillon | 1 tablespoon dry red onion | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper powder or 1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper | 1 1/2 tablespoons lime juice or 1 1/2 tablespoons lemon juice | chopped fresh red onion, for garnish
instructions: Lightly spray an 8 x 4 square baking dish with cooking spray. Place crumbled bread in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: fennel seed,cake flour,coconut,white pepper,cucumber,dark chocolate,chipotle chile adobo,parmesan romano cheese mix
title: Naked Chipotle and Coconut Mini Fritters
ingredients: 2 cups cake flour | 1 cup desiccated coconut | 1 cup margarine or 1 cup butter, softened ( 2 to 3 tbsp ) | 1/2 cup grated parmesan and romano cheese mix | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 teaspoon pureed chipotle chile in adobo | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | 1 large cucumber, halved lengthwise and then crosswise ( about 1 1/2 cups )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f, then lightly grease 1 - 12 cup muffin tin. In large bowl, whisk flour and coconut with electric mixer, then mix in the butter, 1/2 cup of the cheese mix, 1/2 cup of the grated parmesan, fennel seed, chipotle chili, and pepper until just combined. Fold in the cucumber, tossing to coat well. Spoon mixture into lined muffin tins. Sprinkle with the remaining cheese blend. Bake 20 - 22 minutes until pale golden and firm to the touch. Remove, and cool completely on wire rack.

title: Pepper Pot Roast
ingredients: 3 lbs rump roast | 1 package chopped fresh onions | 4 slices sharp cheddar cheese | 1 large onion, sliced thin
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Mix all ingredients together in a large roasting pan. Cover tightly and bake 30 minutes. Uncover and continue cooking for 45 minutes, or until the meat thermometer reaches 120°f.

title: Apricot Ginger Glaze - Substitute
ingredients: 1 lb apricot, un-ripe, skin removed | 1 cup ginger, finely chopped
instructions: Remove the rind from the apricots then cut into bite size pieces. Place the apricots and ginger in a food processor with a small amount of water and process until smooth. Pour into a small saucepan and cook over low heat for 8 - 10 minutes stirring now and then. Pour into a small pan on top of the glaze and use to coat all the apricots and ginger.

title: Tex-Mex Beef With Olives and Tomatillos over Rice
ingredients: 1 - 1.5 lb stewing beef | 1 - 1 1/2 jar of spanish smoked tomatillos | 1 can sliced peaches | 2 cans chicken cutlets, undrained | 1 jar spaghetti noodles, with seasoning sauce | 1 bunch fresh cilantro, chopped | cooked white rice
instructions: Drain tomatoes with 1/2 of a can of juice into crock pot on high. Cut stew beef into 3/4 inch cubes and then into bit size chunks. Add all to crock pot. Cook on high setting until meat is browned. Drain liquid from crock pot, and add tomatillos and drained sliced olives. Cover, and let cook on low for 10 - 15 minutes or on high for 5 - 7 hours or until meat is tender and cooked through. Drain liquid from crock pot, stir into cooked rice according to package directions, and garnish with fresh chopped cilantro. This should be served over hot, fresh white rice.

title: Pumpkin Spice Mix
ingredients: 2 cups quick-cooking oats | 1 cup quick-cooking oats | 1 1/2 cups dried italian herbs ( or mix dried herbs and spices together ) | 1 tablespoon ground ginger | 1 tablespoon ground nutmeg | 1 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: In medium bowl, combine quickcooking oat meal, 1 cup quickcooking oats, dried italian herbs, ground ginger, nutmeg and almond extract. Stir to mix. Store in airtight container.

title: Cilantro Chips
ingredients: 4 cups fine white flour, such as king arthur | 1/2 cup cilantro leaf ( not dried, fresh is better )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Prepare a baking sheet by lining the sheet with parchment paper. In a large bowl, combine the flour and 1/4 cup cilantro leaves and stir together with your fingers. Create a well in the center of the pile of flour, pour in the dough and knead just until it forms a smooth, slightly sticky dough. If you are adding the garlic, do it gradually. If you are using the dough from the previous step and using the cilantro in place of the cilantro, roll out the dough until evenly square and about 1/8 inch thick. Cut out 6 1/2 inch rounds out of the dough, place on the parchment paper covered baking sheet and sprinkle with the remaining cilantro. Bake for about 8 minutes, turning once, or until golden.

Random Ingredients: cilantro leaf,za'atar spice mix,chili pepper flake
title: Za'atar Mix With Chilies and Fresh Spices
ingredients: 2 teaspoons chili pepper flakes | 2 teaspoons za'atar spice mix | 1 teaspoon fresh cilantro leaves, with stems
instructions: Combine the za'atar with the chilli pepper flakes and cilantro leaves. Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,fennel seed,black coffee,clam,coconut milk,eggnog,pineapple,spinach leaf
title: Green Smoothie
ingredients: 1 can or bottle hot dark rum | 2 cups fresh spinach leaves | 3 cups fresh crab or steamed shrimps, cleaned and chopped | 1 can diced pineapple, drained | 1 -2 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 2 eggnog | 1 tablespoon fennel seed ( a few small fennel seeds will give you the right spinginess ) | 1 cup carbonated light or regular milk | 1 can unsweetened coconut milk
instructions: In blender, add rum, spinach and crab. Process on low until thoroughly mixed and set aside. Combine grated cheese, egg nog with the fennel seeds in a small bowl. Pour in 1 cup liquid and 1 can of coconut milk, and stir. Add to blender. Process until smooth. Pour into a tall glass, and serve chilled.

title: Seafood Stew
ingredients: 1/2 lb sea scallops, quartered | 1 can vegetable broth | 3 medium carrots, cut into 2 inch pieces ( about 8 oz ) | 1 teaspoon catsup | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla essence
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large saucepan. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Cover. Simmer gently until scallops open, 3 to 5 minutes.

title: Garlicky Shiitake Mushroom Triangles
ingredients: 2 shiitake mushrooms, stems removed | 1 1/4 cups cheddar cheese, shredded | 1 package phyllo pastry, thawed | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar
instructions: Preheat broiler about 5 minutes. Place mushroom caps on a cutting board.

title: Easy Low-Fat Cavenders Greek Seasoning Mix #5FIX
ingredients: 1 can poblano chiles | 1 packet mccormick all purpose greek seasoning
instructions: In a small baking dish, sprinkle the greek seasoning on 2/3 of the poblano chiles. Add the greek seasoning and distribute evenly. Add the remaining poblano chiles on top. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight stirring occasionally. Turn the bag often to distribute all over.

Random Ingredients: tahini paste,italian breadcrumb,ricotta cheese,red jalapeno chile,beef steak,peanut butter
title: Oven-Baked Italian Roast Beef Strips
ingredients: 1/3 cup chopped dry roasted red jalapeno chile ( from a jar ) | 1/3 cup tahini paste | 1/3 cup fresh italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 1/2 lbs beef top round steaks | 1 1/2 cups ricotta cheese | 3 tablespoons peanut butter ( smooth-style unsweetened )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Combine the peppers, tahini paste, bread crumbs, and beef in a large rectangular baking dish or roasting pan. Toss to coat. Transfer the meat to a rack and let drain 5 minutes. Transfer meat to a baking sheet. Bake, uncovered, in the center of the oven for 20 minutes. Turn meat.

title: Quick Sauteed Cauliflower
ingredients: 2 cups small cauliflower florets, cleaned | 3/4 cup white mushroom, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons toasted sesame seeds ( optional ) | 1/2 tablespoon cinnamon
instructions: Dry thoroughly the cauliflower after placing it in a steamer basket over a pan of ice water. Over low heat steam the cauliflower just until it's bright green and tender, stirring the cauliflower occasionally. Remove cauliflower from steamer and add mushrooms, cook until tender. Sprinkle with sesame seeds if using. Add cinnamon to saute.

Random Ingredients: serrano chile pepper,rigatoni pasta,serrano pepper,guajillo chile
title: Rigatoni Con Chile or "Rise for " Devil Inside"
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon guajillo chile, chopped | 2 serrano chile peppers, seeds and ribs removed, minced | 2 serrano chile peppers, seeds and ribs removed, minced | 1 lb rigatoni pasta
instructions: Place all of the ingredients except the pasta into a stockpot over a medium low heat, stirring thoroughly. Bring to a simmer and cook for 30 minutes, or until the chiles are tender and the flavors have blended. Serve over hot cooked pasta.

title: Taco Blush
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups buttermilk | 1/2 teaspoon expresso powder | 12 thin jalapenos | 6 -12 ounces salsa
instructions: Beat buttermilk and espresso powder until creamy. Grate jalapenos and mix with buttermilk mixture. Add salsa and stir to coat. Pour into a large ziplock add plastic wrap and seal. Chill until firm serve on a lettuce leaf.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,tomato puree,tarragon vinegar,shortcrust pastry,grain white rice,wheat tortilla,champagne,pistachio nut
title: Tarragon Rice Rolls (Pistachios)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tarragon vinegar | 1 tablespoon tomato puree or 1 tablespoon pure cherry tomatoes | 1/2 tablespoon active dry yeast | 1/2 teaspoon dried tarragon leaves | 1/2 cup long grain white rice ( rice grains ) | 1/2 cup finely chopped toasted pistachio nuts, divided | 1/2 cup dry shortcrust pastry, approximately | 1 package active dry yeast, such as bobolis or ( 200 g ) package active dry yeast cakes, such as bobolis | 2 1/2 cups lightly salted fermented soybeans ( 1 can ) or 2 1/2 cups haricot beans, picked over and washed thoroughly | 6 -12 small whole wheat tortillas ( about 6 inches in diameter )
instructions: Sauce, meanwhile, place vinegar, tomato puree, and yeast in a small bowl, and stir to combine. Let soak 5 minutes until the yeast forms a creamy foam. Meanwhile, toast the pistachio nuts in a dry skillet set over medium heat 5 to 7 minutes, stirring regularly, until dark golden. Cool slightly, then chop. Place the rice, 3/4 cup pistachios, and remaining pistachios in a large bowl with the rice, shortcrust pastry, and yeast mixture. Mix to combine, and spread 1/4 cup sauce on a 10 x 10 inch pan to make a rectangle about 10 x 3 inches. Cover with plastic wrap, and let rise in a warm place until doubled in bulk, about 1 hour. Meanwhile, heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add the yeast mixture to the skillet, 1 cup of pistachios, and the beans. Stir and heat on medium high until thickened, about 10 to 15 minutes. Spread half the bean mixture evenly on the top of the pastry. Cover with the remaining bean mixture and spread evenly. Cover the pan and reduce the heat to low. Let this rise until doubled, about 25 minutes, depending on the thickness of the rice sheets, which should take 30 to 35 minutes. Cover and set aside in a warm place until the rolls are baked. Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Remove the plastic wrap, brush half of the rolls with soy tap water, and place in the oven to bake.

title: Spicy Cheese Beef Bake
ingredients: 1/4 lb stewing beef, cut in 1/4'strips | 1/4 lb cheese, cut in 1/4'strips | 5 slices pepperoni | 1 tablespoon margarine or 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 package of sliced pepperoni
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degree. Put the beef, cheese and the pepperoni in a 9 x 13 x 2 pan. Cut the margarine in small bits in a baggy ziplock baggie with scissors. Put in the freezer bag. When the fridge is cold, take out of the freezer. In a 9 x 13 pan pour margarine/oil on top of the beef. Then use the back of a spoon to scrape up the meat bits. Pour the jar of pepperoni over the beef. Now bake the beef for 45 min or until the cheese is bubbly. Serve.

Random Ingredients: pork neck,mango chutney,cherry tomato,turmeric powder,stir fry beef,baking powder,flour tortilla,extra oil
title: Stir Fry Burritos
ingredients: 3/4 lb stir-fry beef, cut into thin strips | 2 pints cherry tomatoes, cut julienne | 1 tablespoon mango chutney | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 6 burrito size flour tortillas | 2 tablespoons extra oil ( optional ) | 3/4 teaspoon baking powder | 1 package smoked pork neck bones ( can use pork in place for convenience ) or ( 11 1/4 inch ) package pinto beans ( can use pork in place for convenience )
instructions: If using neck bones with marrow, remove bones and set aside. Soak neck bones overnight in enough hot water to cover, or drain and save. In a wok or large skillet, heat extra oil over high heat until hot but not smoking. Add mango chutney and turmeric.

title: Champagne Balsamic
ingredients: 1 bottle of good wine | 2 -3 tablespoons oil | 2 bottles of good wine ( riesling or chablis will do )
instructions: Pour two bottles of good wine into a pot. Put the lid on and let the wine boil for about five minutes. Shut off the heat and let sit a couple of hours, then strain liquid into another bowl. Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in the pot until smoking, then add wine and let simmer with lid on for 15 - 20 minutes. Take mixture off heat and serve in a glass bowl with lots of ice cubes, a good helping of chopped vegetables and hot paprika.

title: Mexican Rice With Oranges
ingredients: 1 orange | 1 package shredded mexican cheese | 1 1/2 cups cooked rice or 1 1/2 cups other long grain white rice | 4 thinly sliced lettuce
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wrap orange in cheese, pressing seams tightly. In 9x13 inch baking dish, arrange orange slices in a spiral of slices, overlapping rice on each. Bake, uncovered, at 425 degrees for 10 - 15 minutes or until orange is cooked. Top with lettuce and remaining cheese. Bake for 5 more minutes, or until cheese is melted.

title: Spanish Tapas
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans | 1 medium yellow squash | 2 teaspoons guacamole | 2 tablespoons rice wine | 1/4 cup dry vermouth | 1 1/2 lbs yellow squash | 1 lb asparagus | 1/4 cup crumbled fat free yogurt
instructions: Place beans and squash in a medium saucepan.

title: Quick Gneflour Macaroni
ingredients: 250 g macaroni | 500 g lean ground beef | 1 1/2 cups gruyere cheese, shredded | 16 cooked peeled crawfish tails
instructions: Cook macaroni to packet instructions in a large pan of boiling water, until just tender but firm. Drain pasta in a colander. Place ground beef in a large microwaveable bowl, pour over water and microwave, covered, on high for 2 - 3 minutes or til beef is no longer pink. Stir to break up meat. Add gruyere, macaroni and crawfish tails.

Random Ingredients: gelatin,sun tomato oil,mexican chocolate,apple,catfish fillet,cardamom seed
title: Mexican Catfish Skewers (Ceviche)
ingredients: 14 sheets gelatin, 1 1/2 to 2 cups | 1 can whole catfish fillets, cut into chunks | 1 medium apple, peeled, halved lengthwise and cut into thin wedges ( or a mixture of both ) | 8 sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained and thinly sliced | 2 ounces mexican chocolate, chopped ( or less, to taste ) | 1 teaspoon cardamom seeds, crushed
instructions: Sprinkle gelatin over warm fish over barely simmering water. Let sit 10 minutes or until gelatin starts dissolving then chill for about 3 hours or in refrigerator overnight. Thread catfish onto 1 - 6 inch metal skewers and skewer them onto soaked bamboo skewers. Arrange skewers on a rack set in a glass dish or pan that is coated with cooking spray. Sprinkle fish with dried tomatoes. Melt choclate and cardamom seeds in a saucepan over low heat. Let cool to room temperature. When bubbling, whisk in choclate mixture. Drizzle over fish skewers when cool.

title: Tortellini With Saffron, Mexican Capsicum and Chile
ingredients: 150 g cheese tortellini, fresh | 1 teaspoon saffron thread, crushed | 1 teaspoon ground red chili pepper, crushed | 1/3 cup mexicorn, drained
instructions: Cook the tortellini in a large pan of boiling salted water until just tender.

Random Ingredients: tahini,nutmeg,red lentil,chicken breast half,pecan,chicken breast halve,honey
title: Baked Chicken With Red Lentils
ingredients: 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into cubes | 2 skinless chicken halve | 2 cups red lentils, rinsed | 1 cup chopped pecans | 1/2 cup tahini | 1/2 cup honey | 1/8 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place chicken and halved pieces in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Cover with lentils. Combine pecans, tahini, honey, and nutmeg in a bowl. Spread mixture over chicken. Bake chicken in the preheated oven for 30 to 40 minutes. Increase oven temperature to 375 degrees f.

Random Ingredients: bread machine yeast,white bread,yeast,asafoetida powder,kaffir lime leaf,cheddar cheese,sage leaf
title: Cheesy Herb Bread for ABM
ingredients: 1 large white bread, loafs or 1 large rye bread | 2 tablespoons dried yeast | 1 tablespoon asafoetida powder | 3/4 cup cheddar cheese, grated | 10 kaffir lime leaves, finely shredded ( i usually use limes ) | 8 slices white bread ( i use gluten-free ) | 1 dried sage leaf ( optional )
instructions: Slice off and save 12 of the kaffir lime leaves for later. In a medium size bowl, mix together the asafoetida powder and sourdough starter without overworking the mixture. Set aside. Using the bread machine method, place the bread in the loaf pan on the bottom rack of your bread machine and select the dough cycle. While the bread machine is running, combine the lime leaves and remaining ingredients in a small bowl. Place the whole bay leaves on top of the dough and begin to use the dough cycle on your machine's dough cycle. When the cycle is complete and the dough has risen, remove the loaf from the bread pan, place on a lightly floured surface and punch down. Using one of the suggested cooking sprayers, spray 12 more asafoetida or bread sprayers in each loaf. Using both of these hands, press the kaffir lime leaves on the top of dough, then place each slice on top of the cheddar cheese. Return slices to the bread pan on the bottom rack of your bread machine and bake for 45 minutes, or until the crust is golden and the cheddar cheese has melted. Allow to cool before slicing, and use immediately or store for an afternoons snack.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,plain yogurt,plum tomato,pecan,white mushroom,red wine,brie cheese
title: Swiss Chard With Plums and Brie
ingredients: 1 ounce olive oil | 1 lb firm white mushroom, sliced | 8 ounces brie cheese, cut in 1-inch cubes | 8 plum tomatoes, cut in quarters | 1 1/2 tablespoons red wine | 1/2 cup pecans | 1/2 cup plain fat-free yogurt | peanut oil or grapeseed oil
instructions: In a large sauté pan, heat oil over medium heat, sauté mushrooms until mushrooms are softened and golden, about 7 minutes. Remove mushrooms and reserve. Add brie to pan and cook 2 to 3 minutes. Add plum tomatoes and cook 3 to 5 minutes until slightly softened. Return mushrooms to pan. Add red wine and cook until reduced by half, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Spoon mixture into serving dish, sprinkle with nuts. Drizzle 1/4 cup of yogurt over chard and serve.

title: Cognac Beetroot
ingredients: 2 -3 large beets | 1/4 cup good cognac ( or brandy ) | 1 dash dried lemon pepper
instructions: Place beets in a medium size bowl with a piece of plastic wrap over them, then spray the wrap generously with vegetable oil cooking spray, you may also use butter flavored cooking spray. Pour the cognac over the beets. Wash the potato skins under cold running water.

title: Roasted Blueberry Lettuce Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb blueberries | 1 head iceberg lettuce or 1 head spinach, rinsed | 1/2 cup vegetable broth | 2 tablespoons rice wine | 1/2 cup packed fresh basil | crushed iceberg lettuce
instructions: Place berries, lettuce and broth in a salad bowl. Add sugar or other seasonings to taste sprinkle with basil. Serve immediately.

title: The Mad Kiwi Burgers
ingredients: 2 large beef sirloin steaks | 2 -3 kiwi fruits | 4 slices gouda cheese ( thin slices or 4 slices processed swiss cheese ) | 2 tablespoons rum ( optional )
instructions: Cut each piece of beef across the grain into thin slices. Using a grill pan large enough to place the beef and kiwi slices on grill, lightly sear meat on each side. Using grill pan, pour enough rum into the pan to just cover the surface of the meat. The rum will help to darken the meat slightly. Serve beef on pre heated plates. Sprinkle some gouda cheese on meat. Slice kiwi and top with kiwi slices. Spoon rum over slices of beef.

Random Ingredients: cashew,mushroom,rhubarb,part ricotta cheese,red curry paste,spanish mackerel,swiss chard
title: Rhubarb & Swiss Chard Raita
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 2 tablespoons part-skim ricotta cheese | 1 cup mushroom, sliced | 1 cup cooked swiss chard, chopped | 1/2 cup roasted cashews, toasted | 2 tablespoons fat free roasted cashews or 2 tablespoons cashews, chopped | 2 cups cooked rhubarb, cut into 3-inch pieces
instructions: Melt the yogurt in a mixing bowl in a small saucepan set over medium high heat, stir in the curry paste to coat. Stir in the ricotta and mushrooms and stir to combine. Cook for a couple of seconds over medium heat until heated through. Combine the swiss chard, roasted cashews and chopped rhubarb in the bowl with the yogurt mixture and stir to combine. Cover and refrigerate for at least 5 hours, stirring occasionally. Remove the bowl from the refrigerator and serve the raita immediately.

title: Crock Pot Brisket Recipe
ingredients: 5 lbs beef brisket, fat trimmed | 6 tablespoons cinnamon sugar | 2 tablespoons onion powder
instructions: Preheat your crock pot. Place beef in bottom of crock pot. Sprinkle remaining ingredients over the meat leaving some fat on the top, then place cover on crock pot. Cook on high for 6 hours. Shredded cabbage works best, but use fresh shredded cabbage or shredded carrots to make this delicious meal.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast fillet,apple,baby green,heavy cream,pastry crust pie,rye bread,chili pepper flake,adobo seasoning
title: Chili Pepper Chicken Appetizer
ingredients: 200 g frozen pre-rolled pastry dough, thawed | 2 chicken breast fillets, cutlets pounded out | 1 tablespoon adobo seasoning, crushed | 3/4 cup heavy cream or 3/4 cup half-and-half | 1 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 250 g mixed baby greens | 80 g sliced apple | 125 g rye bread, toasted
instructions: Unrolled pastry dough, on a floured surface, roll out half of pastry dough into an 8 x 14 inch rectangle, using a 3/4 inch wide rectangle cutter cut out as many circles as possible without the larger pastry dough sheets. Cut out 10 circles from the remaining dough. Spread half of the cream or half and half on each circle, then pinch the edges with a fork so they don't stick together. Place chicken breast in a small frying pan, add half of the adobo seasoning and saute for 3 - 4 minutes until chicken is cooked and no longer pink. Place half of the baby greens in a baking dish, spread with half of the chicken. Place tomato slices and a pinch of chili flakes on top of the chicken, and drizzle with remaining adobo seasoning. Bake in a 425f degree oven, covered, for 10 - 12 minutes, or until golden and bubbling. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chicken wing,tomato green chilies,channa dal,creamy peanut butter,tripe
title: Baked Tripe
ingredients: 500 g chicken wings | 250 g tripe ( or equivalent size ) | 300 g channa dal ( or split chickpeas ) | 1 can chopped tomatoes with green chilies | 125 g creamy peanut butter
instructions: Place chicken wings and tripe in casserole dish and pour enough water over to almost cover. Place in oven at 200c/400f for 45 minutes/. Meanwhile, soak chickpeas together with channa, cover and bring to boil. Place in a blender and process until well combined and smooth. Turn off heat. When chicken is nearly cooked, drain water and remove skin and bones if necessary. Rinse with boiling water and pat dry with paper towel. Place the thigh pieces in a pan over a medium heat. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. When chicken has cooked through, remove and reserve. Preheat the oven to 200c/180c fan forced. Spread the peanut sauce over one side of the tripe and place back in oven for 7 - 10 minutes. Bake on a baking tray for further 1 to 2 minutes, or until slightly crisp. Remove from the oven and let sit for 2 or 3 minutes. Carefully transfer the hot tripe to a plate, allowing any juices to run back inside. Return pan to oven for a further 5 - 8 minutes, or until warmed through and starting to colour/toss through. Serve with chopped fresh tomato to garnish the dish and peanut sauce.

title: Peppadews in a Bag
ingredients: 7 tablespoons peppadew pepper, chopped ( canned without juice ) | 10 -12 water chestnuts, finely chopped | 15 large slices ice
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a bag. Seal bag and shake until completely coated. Let sit for a couple of hours or overnight in a cool location.

title: Parmesan and Rosemary Pizzicles
ingredients: 2 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/2 teaspoon dried rosemary | 1/4 teaspoon paprika, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees f. Place the parmesan cheese, oregano, rosemary, and paprika in the bowl of a stand mixer. Turn the mixer to low, and mix until evenly incorporated. The dough should be sticky enough that you can break it up with your fingers. Roll the dough into balls the size of an orange, and place onto baking sheets, spacing about 1 inch apart. Bake in the preheated oven until evenly browned, 6 to 8 minutes.

title: Homemade Pears
ingredients: 4 anjou pears, pared, stalks removed ( or 2 pounds fresh pears, pared, halved diagonally ) | 2 can mexican-style stewed tomatoes
instructions: Place pears and tomatoes in a medium bowl. Add enough water to cover, and stir to combine. Cover and refrigerate overnight, or at least 4 hours. Serve at room temperature.

title: Maple Pancake Syrup (Caramelizing Sugar)
ingredients: 1 cup maple syrup ( i prefer maple syrup! ) | 1 cup coconut flakes ( flaked or slightly crushed ) ( optional )
instructions: Whisk the syrup, coconut flakes, and optional sugar for the syrup until the sugar is incorporated and the syrup becomes a thick, smooth consistency. The syrup should be smooth and foamy.

title: Lettuce, Chicken, and Romaine Rolls
ingredients: 2 head romaine lettuce or 2 heads kale | 2 pats chicken livers, cooked and chopped
instructions: Slice the heads of lettuce crosswise into eight even parts. Lay the heads on a baking board and place in a preheated 475 degrees f oven. Cook until tender, 10 to 15 minutes. Meanwhile, heat a skillet over medium heat. Place a small amount of chicken fat in the skillet and fry until crisp and beginning to brown, turning when necessary. Drain all but 1 teaspoon of fat from skillet. Remove from heat and toss in cooked romaine. Spoon the mixture into a 9x13 inch casserole dish. Sprinkle chicken liver over top. Bake in preheated 475 degree oven until heated through and rolls are crispy and brown around the edges, 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Enchiladas With Balsamic Vinegar
ingredients: 1 capsicum, diced ( bell pepper ) | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 20 wonton wrappers ( approximately 18 large ones ) | 1 can red enchilada sauce
instructions: In a medium frying pan, add 1 tab of oil and fry the capsicum until soft. Add the vinegar, then the wonton wrappers to thich the wonton wrapper. Place about 1/3 cup of filling in the won ton wrapper and seal it closed, sealing each end to give the sauce a little runnyness. Bake at 250 degrees for 10 minutes and then cool slightly and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: half cream,onion powder,beef brisket,fruit,pasta,green serrano chilies
title: Crock Pot Creamy Corned Beef Brisket and Pasta
ingredients: 6 lbs corned beef brisket | 1 can green serrano chilies | 1/3 cup half-and-half cream | 1/3 cup dried fruit ( dried cranberries, strawberries, peaches, or apricots ) | onion powder, sprinkle
instructions: Place beef brisket in crock pot, add rest of the ingredients, and stir to mix everything. Set on low for 7 to 8 hours. Remove beef and slice into slices. Serve with your favorite cooked vegetables.

Random Ingredients: bulk italian sausage,black olive,mozzarella cheese,corn kernel,beef bouillon cube
title: Italian Sausage and Corn Lasagna
ingredients: 1 lb bulk italian sausage | 1 garlic, minced | 1/2 package frozen corn kernels | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 cup mozzarella cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Combine all ingredients except the mozzarella in the bottom of a 9x13x2 baking dish with a lid. Slice cheese into 1/4 inch slices, then lay slices across the top of the sausage mixture. Cover top of the sausage mixture with the mozzarella cheese. Cover with foil. Bake for 1 hour. Remove foil and bake for 15 minutes more, or until heated through. Let stand for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Yogurt Salad (For Diabetics)
ingredients: 7 g dried plums or 7 g other plums | 1/4 cup plain yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon soy sauce | 1 slice italian bread, breaded thinly diagonally | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red currants
instructions: Wash the plums in cold water. Heat a non stick frying pan on medium high.

title: Chow Mein Junkita Beef Burger
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lean ground chuck, at least 80 % | 1/4 cup plain breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup canned garbanzo beans, rinsed ( about 2 cans ) | 1/4 cup canned pumpkin puree | 6 plum tomatoes, seeded and diced | 3 poblano chiles, roasted, peeled, seeded and chopped | 3 tablespoons chow mein noodles ( sesame-seed paste ) | 1/2 cup canned garbanzo beans ( about 4 cans ) | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/2 cup unsweetened coconut milk ( more if needed, see note before measuring or adding milk )
instructions: Preheat grill. Wash poblanos under cold water.

title: Pickled Mushrooms
ingredients: 24 large white mushrooms, wiped of dirt and cut into eighths | 12 large carrots, peeled and thinly sliced | 6 large white onions, peeled and thinly sliced | 1/4 cup whole black peppercorns ( optional )
instructions: Prepare the mushrooms, place the mushrooms, carrots, onions, and whole black peppercorns into a large saucepan or colander. Cover and place over high heat. Cook over high heat until mushrooms are softened and beginning to split, about 20 minutes.

title: Bifte & Perchi
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs rump steak | 2 cans italian plum tomatoes, 1/2-1/2-3/cubed
instructions: Spray pan with pam. Brown steak on both sides then remove to platter. Put tomatoes in large pot and heat on mid stire over med heat just till bubbly. Add 1lb of the beef to pot. Stir to loosen.

Random Ingredients: lemon pepper seasoning,red wine,liquid honey,ha avocado,bean sprout
title: Baked Beansprouts Salad
ingredients: 1 lb bean sprouts | 1/3 cup red wine vinegar or 1/3 cup rice wine vinegar | 1 1/4 cups liquid honey | 1 teaspoon lemon pepper seasoning, divided | 1 hass avocados or 3 other firm avocados, cut in 1/4-1/3/4 inch dice
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Place bean sprouts in a large bowl. Combine the vinegar, honey and 1/2 of the pepper. Stir well. Stir this mixture into the remaining ingredients, just until the beansprouts are evenly coated. Spoon mixture into a 8 or 9 inch square glass baking dish. Bake for 30 - 40 minutes until bubbly and golden brown.

title: Pesto Linguine
ingredients: 1 pound linguine | 1 yellow bell pepper, chopped | 3 tablespoons prepared pesto blend | 1 teaspoon ground cumin
instructions: Cook linguine in a large pot of boiling water until al dente, 8 minutes. Drain pasta, and transfer to a large serving bowl. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add bell pepper, cover, and cook until green color turns black, about 5 minutes. Drain pasta, and transfer to bowl. In a small bowl, stir together pesto with cumin. Pour over pasta, and toss to coat. Serve warm.

title: Spicy Bow Ties
ingredients: 2 cups bow tie pasta, uncooked | 2 teaspoons vegetable oil | 1 teaspoon caraway seeds
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the bow tie pasta, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 11 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Heat the vegetable oil in a skillet over medium heat. Stir in the caraway. Add the bow tie pasta and stir to combine. Cook and stir until the pasta has absorbed the oil, about 1 minute. Sprinkle with additional salt, if desired.

title: Creamy Italian Arugula Rice Bake
ingredients: 7 tablespoons soymilk ( may use skim milk ) | 1 box frozen whipped topping ( thawed ) | 1/3 cup arborio rice | 1/4 cup plums ( pitted ) or 1/4 cup dried apricot, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 f. Spray 9x9 casserole dish with cooking spray. Bring soy milk and thawed whipped topping to boil in a 2 quart saucepan over medium heat, stirring until blended. Remove from heat. Stir in rice until evenly coated. Spread rice evenly in casserole dish. Scatter plums on top. Cover with remaining whipped topping, spreading evenly and sprinkling with dried apricots. Bake in preheated oven until bubbly and beginning to brown, about 15 - 20 minutes.

title: Apple Meat With Amaretto
ingredients: 2 tablespoons amaretto ( almond flavoured liqueur ) | 1 red apple, cored, cored, chopped | 1/2 red capsicum, diced | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme sprig, finely chopped | 500 g stew meat, cut into large chunks
instructions: Place the apple, capsicum and thyme in a large bowl and stir in the amaretto. Add the meat and turn the mixture so everything gets coated. Cover and marinate in the fridge for two hours or up to six hours. To make a quick sauce of your own choice, leave the stew meat in the marinade overnight or for several hours to allow it to re coat with the sauce, if necessary.

title: Smoked Salmon and Eggplant Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 large eggplant, peeled, cut into 3-inch chunks | 4 ounces prosciutto, sliced | 2 ounces mushrooms, sliced | 1 1/2 cups cherry tomatoes | 3 tablespoons coarse grain mustard | 3 tablespoons vinegar | 1/2 cup shredded parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 6 ounces smoked salmon, cut into 3-inch chunks
instructions: Boil the water for your pasta.

title: Noodles and Potatoes With Pickled Mustard
ingredients: 2 lbs russet potatoes ( or small or medium sized ) | 8 cups chicken stock powder | 2 2 -3 tablespoons vinegar | 12 ounces small mixed noodles
instructions: Wash, peel and cut potatoes into 3/4 inch slices. Boil the chicken stock powder and vinegar in a covered pan. Add the potatoes, cook for 30 minutes, stirring once or twice. Add noodles and cook for 30 more minutes.

Random Ingredients: ra el hanout spice mix,chicken leg quarter,chicken leg,cardamom seed
title: Moroccan Chicken Korma With Ra El Hanout
ingredients: 6 bone-in chicken leg quarters | 6 bone-in chicken thighs with thigh meat attached | 4 teaspoons ras el hanout spice mix | 4 cardamom seeds, crushed | 4 whole dried ra el hanout spice mix
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Rinse chicken pieces under cold running water and pat dry with paper towels. Place skin side down in 9x13 inch baking dish. Cover with plastic wrap and 2 towels. Place dish on a rimmed baking sheet with at least 4 inch of water on bottom rack and bake until cooked through, about 80 minutes. Remove, discard plastic wrap, and cool 15 minutes. Remove chicken from pan with tongs and set aside. Remove excess fat from pan and discard. Increase oven temperature to 425 degrees f. Spread ras el hanout over chicken in baking dish. Place chicken on rack, skin side down, and coat with plastic wrap. Bake chicken until lightly glazed and golden brown and crisp, about 25 minutes. Remove from oven. While chicken is baking, place cardamom seeds in a small, dry skillet over medium heat and toast until fragrant, about 1 minute. Stir in raill spice and 2 teaspoons salt until well combined. When chicken is cool enough to handle, cut into halves or thirds and transfer to a serving platter, spoon warm ras el hanout over and sprinkle with remaining salt. Serve warm.

title: Coca Cola Con Chile, Feulet Con Chile And
ingredients: 2 cups coca-cola ( cola is fine ) | 1 lb dried cured ham hock | 1/2 cup chili sauce ( feulet con chile andel me chilie ) | 1 tablespoon turmeric ( feulet con chile andel ) | 1/2 cup heavy cream
instructions: Pound ham hocks to 1/4 inch thickness. Grind cola in blender to fine powder, then add to ham hocks. Boil 3 - 5 minutes, or until thickened. Stir in feulet con chile mexican, turmeric, and white sauce. Simmer 15 minutes.

title: Simple and Muffins
ingredients: 1 large shallots or shallot | 2 small chinese cabbage, shredded on diagonal | 1/4 cup mango chutney, preferably major grey
instructions: Cut shallots into small squares. Place shallots and cabbage into a medium size bowl and toss with all other ingredients to coat well. Line a muffin tin by lightly pressing the mixture down. Bake at 150 degrees f for 15 to 20 minutes, or until just tender. Serve topped with fruit if desired.

Random Ingredients: italian herb seasoning,garlic salt,coriander seed,madeira wine
title: Coriander and Madeira Seasoning
ingredients: 1/3 cup coriander seeds | 1 1/2 tablespoons minced garlic salt ( garlic and herb seasoning mix from the jar is the recommended thickness ) or 1 1/2 tablespoons mild paprika | 1 1/2 tablespoons italian herb seasoning | 3/4 cup madeira wine or 3/4 cup dry white wine
instructions: In a small skillet, toast the coriander and oregano over medium heat 1 - 2 minutes, stirring often, until fragrant. Transfer to a mortar and pestle and grind until they are a coarse powdered consistency. Combine with the paprika and italian herb seasoning, mix well. Using a small spoon, pour in the madeira or wine, mixing with a fork until all the mixture is moistened. Keeps in the refrigerator for up to two months.

Random Ingredients: white wine,broccoli,ranch dressing,italian salad dressing mix,green olive,fennel bulb
title: Fennel Pasta and Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 2 bags frozen broccoli | 1 box ranch dressing mix | 1/2 cup white wine | 2 green olives ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons fennel bulbs | 1/4 cup italian salad dressing mix
instructions: Thaw broccoli until easy to slice. Add remaining ingredients and toss until well coated. Refrigerate 30 - 60 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: chipotle powder,mushroom soup,dark brown sugar,black bean,chicken broth
title: Easy Black Beans I
ingredients: 1 can reduced sodium chicken broth | 1 can condensed mushroom soup | 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained ( or any black beans ) | dark brown sugar | 1 tablespoon dried chipotle powder
instructions: Stir all other ingredients together. Pour into crockpot, or crockpot on the lowest setting setting. Cook on low for 6 to 8 hours.

Random Ingredients: angostura bitter,arborio rice,monterey jack cheese,philadelphia cream cheese,marsala
title: Cheese-Filled Jerusalem Kodafa
ingredients: 6 2/3 ounces philadelphia cream cheese, room temperature | 3/4 cup arborio rice | 1 cup marsala | 1 -2 tablespoon angostura bitters | 4 ounces shredded monterey jack cheese ( to taste )
instructions: Grease your baking sheet with cooking spray. Prepare your baking sheet by lining with parchment paper, then butter the paper. Spread about 8 cups of arborio rice evenly over the parchment lined baking sheet, creating a well in the center. In a food processor, blend 2/3 cup of marsala with 2 tbsp of bittersweet bicarbonate of coffee liqueur. Next, with the motor running, gradually add 2 tbsp of cream cheese and blend just until blended. Add in the remaining marsala mixture and blend until smooth. Then pour over the arborio rice. Using the smooth side of a spatula, spread out the arborio rice as evenly as possible. Arrange the cheeses in a layer in the center of the rice. Dot the surface with a spoon, starting from the outside and working the arborio rice out to the center, starting in the center. When the layers are mixed and starting to fall apart, spread them out evenly. When it is about 1/2 cm from the edge of the pan, it will not brown well. Spread the remaining 3/4 cup of marsala evenly over the top of the pan, about a centimeter thick and smooth. With wet hands, carefully form the arborio rice into a tight cylinder and place on the parchment lined baking sheet. With wet hands, pat down the rice on the paper to ensure even. Cut into squares and transfer them to the prepared baking sheet. Pour 1 tsp of angostura bitters over each square. Cut with a sharp, serrated knife to make a small indention in the center of the bread. Preheat to 400 degrees and sprinkle baking sheet with about 2 tbsp of shredded monterrey jack cheese. Bake for about 20 - 30 minutes, until the kodafa is puffy and golden brown and crispy outside.

title: Farfalle from the Plaza Hotel
ingredients: 1 pound lean boneless pork shoulder, cubed | 1 package dry farfalle ( small round ) pasta | 3 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, chopped
instructions: Cook pork in a large pot of boiling water over high heat until lightly browned, 5 to 7 minutes. Using slotted spoon, transfer pork to a bowl. Continue cooking pork in same pot over high heat until browned, 5 to 7 minutes more. Return pork to same pot. Toss farfalle with sun dried tomatoes. Bring to a simmer, then cook until farfalle is tender, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: eggnog,cremini mushroom,guacamole,hoisin sauce,shaoxing wine sherry,chicken breast half
title: Peking Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into 1 1/2 inch pieces | 1/2 pound cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1/4 cup hoisin sauce | 1 teaspoon shaoxing wine ( sherry ) | 1 eggnog | 6 ounces guacamole
instructions: Place chicken in a large pot with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes. Add mushrooms, and continue cooking, uncovered for an additional 20 to 25 minutes, until chicken juices run clear. Remove chicken from pot and set aside. Strain broth through a sieve or cheesecloth and set aside. Strain broth through a mesh colander placed over a bowl. Chill, discard solids, and refrigerate until needed, up to overnight. Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat and lightly oil the grate. Whisk eggnog and sherry together in a small bowl to blend. Reserve 1/3 cup of the chicken cooking liquid until it will use in the sauce. Place chicken slices on the heated grill and cook, turning once, for 30 to 40 minutes, adding mushrooms after 25 minutes, until chicken juices run clear. Transfer chicken to a serving platter. Stir hot broth into the reserved chicken cooking liquid and pour over the chicken.

title: Stained Glassows (Pigs) for Consenting Adults!
ingredients: 2 ounces cashews, raw | 1 ounce fresh red cherries, pitted | 8 1/2 ounces stewing beef | 1 ounce candied green olives | 1 bunch fresh sage leaf
instructions: Place all ingredients in a jar with a tight fitting lid and shake it until everything is mixed. Remove the lid. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to develop the flavours. Remove the leaves from the sage stalks, then wrap each leaf around a fresh oak or rose. To serve, break any large leaves off the oak. Place a leaf, leaf or leaf of your choice, on a plate, and fill with water to cover the leaf. Add the sage leaves to taste and a pinch of salt. Top with the carved cashews, and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,gouda cheese,white corn tortilla
title: Gouda Quesadillas
ingredients: 4 soft white corn tortillas | 1/3 cup red curry paste | 1/2 cup shredded or grated gouda cheese
instructions: Preheat an oven to 375 degrees f. Place a tortilla onto a nonstick baking sheet. Sprinkle with curry paste and cheese. Spread the mixture on the tortilla. Bake in the preheated oven until cheese is melted, about 10 minutes.

title: Curried Veggie and Feta Cheese With Mushrooms and Avocado
ingredients: 5 mushrooms, sliced, stems removed, caps thinly julienned ( about 7 oz. ) | 1/4 cup sultana | 2 tablespoons fresh mints, chopped | 2 tablespoons fish sauce ( asian if you wish ) | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract | 4 large ripe california avocados, halved lengthwise and sliced crosswise in 1/2 inch half-moons | 2 tablespoons sultanas | 2 tablespoons thinly sliced arugula
instructions: In a large nonstick nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray, heat mushrooms, sultanas and mints for 2 - 3 minutes until mushrooms are tender.

Random Ingredients: peanut butter,phyllo dough,cooking oat,italian parsley,hamburger,black mustard seed,allspice,pork
title: Bulk Pork Bites
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped phyllo dough, thawed according to package directions | 1 lb ground chuck ( i use extra lean ) or 1 lb ground turkey ( i use extra lean ) | 1 lb lean hamburger, browned and drained if you want | 1/2 cup quick-cooking oats | 2 tablespoons peanut butter | 1/2 teaspoon black mustard seeds | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 2 tablespoons chopped italian parsley ( or flat-leaf parsley )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f degrees. Butter the sides and bottom of a 9 x 13 baking dish. Unroll phyllo sheet on a clean counter, and place it on a clean work surface. Spray lightly with nonstick cooking spray, then cover with a clean kitchen towel. Place a layer of phyllo dough on top of the parchment paper. Trim off the excess moisture and re roll the phyllo dough to about a half inch square. Repeat until all the phyllo is used, placing each in the baking dish. Brown meats, if using, in a large, deep skillet over medium heat, stirring to break apart meat. Drain and rinse with cold water to remove impurities that rise to the surface.
