Once meat is browned, stir in oats, peanut butter, and allspice, and return to heat. Remove from heat and stir in parsley and ground sherry. Place 1 cup meat mixture in the center of a sheet of phyllo sheets. Brush two sheets with water. Fold in the corners and cut off excess. Repeat with 4 sheets of phyllo, brushing each with water. Place 1 sheet of meat mixture atop 1 sheet. Brush remaining 1 teaspoon of water over the meat and fold over to make a half moon. Repeat until all of ingredients are used, placing 3 sheets in the center and brushing each sheet with water. Cut away excess phyllo from the edges of the phyllo with a sharp knife or razor blade. Bake in preheated oven, covered, for 90 - 120 minutes, until a toothpick inserted into center comes out clean. Remove from oven and let sit for 5 - 10 minutes before cutting away the corner and serving.

Random Ingredients: butter,dill sprig,olive oil,vanilla bean,chicken breast half,pesto sauce,yellow pepper,double cream
title: Light Chicken With Pesto & Dill - Pressure Cooker
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon butter | 1 1/2 teaspoons light olive oil ( preferably olive oil ) | 2 small yellow pepper, thinly sliced | 4 large skinless chicken breast halves, cut into 2 inch chunks | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce | 2 tablespoons double cream | 1 vanilla bean | fresh dill sprig, to serve
instructions: Heat the butter & oil in a pressure cooker over a medium high heat, add pepper & cook slowly until crisp tender, around 10 minutes. Add chicken & cook a minute or two further. Stir in pesto & cream until blended. Add vanilla bean & cook, stirring, for 1 minute. Serve over rice or toast.

Random Ingredients: pork,rigatoni pasta,pineapple ring,white bread dough,chervil,cayenne,scotch bonnet pepper,burgundy wine
title: Sweet Stuffed Sweet Pork Rolls
ingredients: 1 white bread dough, for refrigeration ( see note ) | 1 can sliced canned pineapple rings, drained ( drain the juice ) | 1/3 lb ground pork ( preferably a lean pork mince ) | 1/4 cup snipped scotch bonnet pepper ( or habanero pepper ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons minced fresh chervil ( can sub parsley ) | 1 tablespoon minced fresh cayenne | 1/4 cup burgundy wine ( or dry white wine ) | 3/4 lb rigatoni pasta, cooked according to package instructions before draining
instructions: Note, can find canned pineapple chunks in the liquor section of a food store. If using a whole fresh pineapple with juice, place it in a small pot over medium heat and remove the lid, to keep the heat on low. Add the drained pineapple rings and set aside. Note, if using ground pork, you may wish to drain the fat from the pineapple juice using a strainer, then using a slotted spoon, remove the outer skin and all visible fat around the sides of the meat. In a medium bowl, combine the pork, scotch bonnet or habanero pepper, chervil, cayenne and juice from the canned pineapple. Mix until well combined. If using fresh pineapple, place it in a food processor or blender and pulse until almost smooth. If using canned pineapple, drain it and reserve the juice. Add the juice to the pork mixture. Dice the reserved pineapple tidbits and combine with the meat mixture until incorporated. Note, if using fresh pineapple, remove the shell of the pineapple rings and remove the core and pulp. Remove the meat mixture from the bowl with a slotted spoon. Stir the minced chervil or parsley into the meat mixture. Roll the meat mixture into 24 small balls. Place the meatballs on a baking sheet. Preheat oven to 400°f using a rolling pin on a lightly floured surface, roll each ball into an oval, approximately 8 x 12/10 inches, or a thickness of about 1/8 inch. Repeat until all the balls have been used. Prick the tops with a fork, and bake the rolls until the outside is golden and the tops are light brown in color, about 20 minutes. Remove to a rack to cool slightly. When the rolls are completely cool, slice each into a 1/2 inch slice. Reserve the juices from the baking sheet. Serve the juice. Serve the reserved juices. Note, can also be prepared ahead. In a large mixing bowl, combine the reserved juice, pork, scotch bonnet or habanero pepper, minced fresh chervil or parsley, cayenne and burgundy or dry white wine. Add the rigatoni and mix until well combined. Pour the meat mixture into the pan, and mix thoroughly. Do not over mix. Cover and place in the refrigerator at least 1 hour. Arrange the meat balls on a platter and surround with the reserved sauce.

Random Ingredients: dill sprig,brown sugar,peanut oil vegetable,worcestershire sauce,moisture part mozzarella cheese
title: Mushroom Cheese Appetizer
ingredients: 50 g part-skim mozzarella cheese, cut into 12 | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped fresh dill sprigs | 1 teaspoon light brown sugar | 2 teaspoons low-fat worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon peanut oil or 1 teaspoon vegetable oil
instructions: Combine all ingredients, except cheese, and blend well. Shape into an 8 inch circle with a 6 inch diameter knife. Arrange on an ungreased tray. Using your fingers, lightly press the edges to seal by running a sharp knife along centre of cheese on both sides. Bake on an oven tray for 15 minutes or until cheese is beginning to brown, stirring half way through baking. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: margarine,new mexico chile pod,carrot,red cabbage,broiler fryer chicken,brown rice,cream chicken soup
title: Broiled Chiles, Crock Pot, and Chicken
ingredients: 1 broiler-fryer chickens ( whole or thawed ) | 1 cup red cabbage | 2 carrots | 4 new mexico chile pods ( i've found a couple small pods packed in a jar ) | 2 cans condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup margarine | 4 cups cooked brown rice
instructions: Combine broth and chilies in crock pot and cover with chicken. Cook on low for 6 - 8 hours, or until chicken is done. Remove chicken and cut into bite size pieces. Shred cabbage and carrots. In a frying pan. Brown the rice. Combine rice, cabbage, carrot, chilies, and soup in bowl. Mix well. Pour over chicken mixture. Cover and return to a simmer until ready to serve.

title: Navy Bean Salad
ingredients: 500 g navy beans, dried | 30 g tomato paste | 2 tablespoons ginger paste | 2 teaspoons mustard | 1 tablespoon dill weed, dry | 2 tablespoons raspberry jam, seedless
instructions: Wash and pierce the beans with a fork. Add the other ingredients. Let sit for a few hours and serve cold.

title: Mexican Vegetable-Rice Dessert
ingredients: 2 cups heavy cream | 1 1/2 cups cream | 2 cups chopped turnip | 3 cups instant basmati rice ( not instant ) | 2 cans enchilada sauce
instructions: Prepare rice as directed on the package, except omit salt and sugar. While rice is cooking, combine cream and turnip. Cook until turnip is just tender. While cream is cooking, strain cream mixture and stir into cream mixture slowly, not over the rice, until cream is absorbed. Pour half of the rice into a 6 qt casserole dish or 9x13 pan and spread it evenly with cream mixture. Add half the enchilada sauce and spread over cream and rice. Repeat layers until the rest of the rice is used up. Refrigerate until cold before serving.

title: Thai Coconut Chicken Soup
ingredients: 3 tablespoons chicken bouillon | 3 cups cooked and shredded chicken | 1/2 cup coconut cream
instructions: Put chicken bouillon thru a meat grinder, and grind till fine. Place the ground chicken through a meat grinder once or twice and stir till fine. Add coconut cream to soup pot and heat over low heat for 5 minutes, stir and serve.

title: Bow Ties With Lime and Thyme
ingredients: 8 ounces bow tie pasta | 1 lime wedge, halved | 1 sprig fresh thyme sprigs, leaves picked from stems
instructions: Place pasta in large saucepan of boiling, slated water. Cover and return to boil. Cook uncovered 5 minutes or until al dente.

title: Red Pepper Clafouti
ingredients: 1 leek | 1 red pepper, diced | 2 tablespoons slivered almonds ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Slice the leek lengthwise and discard the white part. Slice the leeks lengthwise into slices, then cut those into rings. Preheat a small frying pan over medium heat and add the olive oil. Add the leeks. Season with salt and pepper, then turn once until the slices are lightly browned. Remove from the pan and drain on paper towels. To serve, place slices of leeks on a small serving platter and sprinkle with almonds and almond extract. Sprinkle over the hot pan almonds and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: bratwurst,maple syrup,water chestnut,pepper,boston lettuce,thai fish sauce
title: Brats
ingredients: 6 bratwursts | 4 heads boston lettuce | 1 can water chestnuts | 3/4 cup maple syrup | 3 tablespoons thai fish sauce | pepper
instructions: Cook bratwurst until cooked through. Chop bratwurst and combine with remaining ingredients on baking sheet. Bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit on an ungreased baking sheet for 25 to 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: almond,nori,cheddar monterey cheese,bread,potato reg,extra large egg,leg lamb,cooking oil
title: Lamb and Potato Rolls
ingredients: 3 cloves garlic, peeled and roughly chopped | 2 kg leg of lamb | 2 tablespoons extra-large eggs, beaten | 6 slices bread | 1 large potato, grated | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 60 g slivered almonds | 1/2 cup coriander or 1/2 cup cilantro
instructions: Soak bread in cold water for about 10 minutes. Rinse and dry with kitchen paper. Cube lamb into chunks. In a large bowl, beat egg with garlic. Mix egg mixture with lamb, then stir in onion. Place bread on a baking tray and bake lamb mixture in a preheated oven set at 180c for about 1 hour or until lamb is just cooked. Meanwhile cook potato in boiling lightly salted water for about 15 minutes, until tender. Drain and mash potato. Heat oil in a pan and fry toasted almonds until golden, then add potato and coriander. Saute for 3 - 5 minutes, then remove from heat. Spread potato mixture on top of lamb and serve.

title: Bahama Breeze (Yogurt Drink)
ingredients: 2 1/2 fluid ounces yoghurt | 1 1/2 fluid ounces dark rum | 2 teaspoons grated fresh gingerroot | 5 green apples, cut into wedges
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a highball glass and serve.

title: Potato Salad II
ingredients: 6 small new potatoes, scrubbed, boiled and sliced | 1 teaspoon ground ginger | 1 can pico de gallo
instructions: Layer potatoes on a large plate. Mix the ground ginger and pico de gallo in a small bowl and spread over the potatoes, or toss them in the salad a little in a plastic bag to keep the salad fresh. Serve at room temperature.

title: Cauliflower & Pistachios
ingredients: 6 medium red potatoes, peeled & sliced thick | 1 head cauliflower, cut into florets | 2 boxes pistachio pudding mix, with pudding
instructions: Put the sliced potatoes in a pan with the cauliflower. Pour in water with sugar and boil until just cooked. Meanwhile, mix the pudding mix w/pistachio's. Serve warm with chunks of cold cauliflower. Tip, serve with lots of crackers for crunch. Tip, put a small bowl of hot water to boil in the microwave or on the stove top just before adding the pudding mix.

title: Beef and Potato Gnocchi Soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lean ground beef | 1 can beef broth | 4 medium boiling potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch dice | 4 -5 ounces pimentos or 4 -5 ounces chorizo, chopped | 8 -12 fresh whole grain buns, to place on when serving
instructions: In a large stockpot, brown the ground beef until the mixture is no longer pink. Drain off and discard any excess fat from the skillet or skillet. Remove pot from heat and add the broth and potatoes.

title: Apricot Stuffed Red Bell Peppers
ingredients: 1 tablespoon margarine ( margarine will also give you a better texture than butter ) or 1 tablespoon butter ( margarine will also give you a better texture than butter ) | 1/4 lb ground beef | 1/2 cup bread crumbs | 1/4 cup apricot jam | 3 dried red chili peppers | 3 dashes bread crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Pound together ground beef until fine. Drain excess fat. Add rest of ingredients and mix until well mixed. Place mixture into a large baking sheet, or you can do this with a mixer. Pinch the peppers closed and place on top of the other. Sprinkle with bread crumbs for added flavor. Bake 15 - 20 minutes.

title: Spanish Style Sticky Potato Wedges
ingredients: 3 medium potatoes, peeled and cut at a angle into wedges ( about 2-6cm diameter ) | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 2 tablespoons marsala wine or 2 tablespoons dry sherry
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Boil potato wedges in a little salted water until cooked all the way through, about 20 minutes. Drain and spread between two large slices of parchment paper to dry. Place onto a baking tray. Combine ketchup, cornflour and wine in a saucepan. Cook, stirring, until mixture boils and thickens slightly. Remove from heat and stir to blend. Pour evenly over potato wedges. Bake for about 15 minutes or until cooked. Cool and serve at room temperature.

title: Cottage Cheese - Garlic Spread
ingredients: 1 box cottage cheese | 2 garlic cloves, peeled and minced
instructions: Soak the cheese in water overnight, drain, cover with cold water and refrigerate. Mix together the parlsey ingredients until well mixed. Makes approximately half a cup. If desired, you may also add 1/2 to 1 cup chopped/chopped fresh garlic. Enjoy.

title: Rice, Turkey and Cheese Calzones
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups jasmine rice, steamed until tender | 1 turkey tenderloins ( about 2 lbs. ) | 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 1 tablespoon pizza crust dough ( for 8-inch pizza crust ) | 1 1/2 cups shredded tex-mex cheese
instructions: Cut turkey into 1 inch slices. Microwave turkey in large non stick skillet until just tender, about 2 to 3 minutes. Remove turkey from skillet and transfer to plate. Add rice in skillet. Saute rice in oil over high heat until rice is lightly toasted, about 1 minute. Remove rice from heat. Slice turkey thinly and return to skillet. Stir in rice. Return to heat. Bring to boil, then cover and simmer until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat. Let stand 1 minute, then stir in cheese. Divide rice among 2 lightly spayed 12x8x2 inch shallow baking dishes. Cut a slit in each crust corner using sharp knife, then place a scant 1/2 cup of rice in center. Spoon turkey mixture evenly over rice, pushing rice down to submerge. Arrange on top of turkey and cover with remaining 3 crust edges. Place baking dishes on center rack of 350 degrees f oven for 8 to 10 minutes, until crust is lightly browned.

title: Mexican Corn Coffee Smoothie
ingredients: 1 cup chunky salsa, any flavor | 2 cups frozen corn | 2 1/2 tablespoons instant coffee | 2 tablespoons rice wine | 1/2 cup pecans or 1/2 cup peanuts, unsalted
instructions: In the blender, combine all ingredients and puree. Pour into a glass measuring cup.

Random Ingredients: cooking spray,dark brown sugar,chicken bouillon,wide egg noodle,cocoa,chive
title: Chocolate Noodles
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 pound fresh wide egg noodles | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa | 4 teaspoons chicken bouillon | 2 teaspoons dark brown sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons chopped fresh chives
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Coat a casserole dish with cooking spray. Bring a large saucepan of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente. Cook noodles in boiling water for 3 to 5 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,red pepper,grain cereal,quinoa,cumin powder,romaine lettuce,jeera powder,thai basil
title: Cheesecake Quinoa Salad
ingredients: 1 box long grain cereal, such as ritz | 1 1/3 cups quinoa, such as ritz | 2 tablespoons dried, crushed red peppers ( i prefer poblanos ) | 2 tablespoons fresh thai basil, chopped | 1 cup mixed romaine lettuce | 1 can cream of chicken soup ( or 1-2 cans homemade ) | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 2 teaspoons jeera powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Cover and refrigerate overnight to develop flavors. Stir and serve. Enjoy.

title: Swiss Cheese Soup
ingredients: 1 ounce vegetable protein | 1 ounce beef gravy | 3 ounces swiss cheese, grated | 1/4 cup dry red wine | 1/4 cup broth
instructions: Blend and simmer soup until all ingredients are mixed. Serve hot.

title: Grilled Mango
ingredients: 2 mangoes - peeled, pitted, and cut into chunks | 1/3 cup dry bread crumbs
instructions: Place mango chunks into a medium size resealable plastic bag. Sprinkle bread crumbs on top of mango. Close the bag, and turn the bag to coat all over the mango cubes. Allow to air dry for half an hour. Turn and repeat process on the other side. Cook the mango in a lightly oiled skillet over medium heat for 3 to 5 minutes on each side, or until golden brown and tender. Serve immediately.

title: Aunt Odette's Shrimp Balls
ingredients: 1/2 package frozen shrimp | 1/4 pound frozen meat, thawed | 1/4 pound pepperoni, sliced | 1/4 teaspoon anise seed, crushed | 20 ritz-style rice krispies | 2 tablespoons sherry wine
instructions: Place frozen shrimp in a saucepan, cover, and cook on high heat until thawed and pink, about 5 minutes. Remove shrimp, and set aside to cool in the refrigerator. Heat a large skillet over medium heat, spray with cooking spray, and add pepperoni and anise seed. Cook and stir until fragrant, about 3 minutes. Transfer pepperoni and anise seeds to a plate.

title: Apple Bean and Champagne Cocktail
ingredients: 1 canned cannellini beans or 1 small cannelini beans, drained | 3 tart apples ( such as granny smith apples ) | 1/4 cup ketchup | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon fenugreek seeds | 1 cup sparkling champagne
instructions: Drain and rinse both cans of beans. Pare apples, core and slice them into rounds. Add to beans along with any liquid accumulated on the plate. Add ketchup and fenugreek seeds to taste. Add sparkling, pouring over top of chilled cocktail. Serve immediately with plenty of napkins.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,wheat flour,hot red chili pepper,date,rice wine vinegar,bacon,coffee
title: Indonesian Muffins
ingredients: 1 cup hot red chili pepper ( such as prik kee or 1 serrano or 1 habanero ) | 2 slices bacon, coarsely chopped | 2 teaspoons rice wine vinegar or 2 teaspoons other sweet cooking wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon instant coffee ( optional ) | 1 1/4 cups whole wheat flour | 1/4 cup toasted sesame seed | 1 teaspoon dried instant coffee, crushed ( optional )
instructions: Grind the chili pepper and bacon in a blender or using the side of a food processor until you have fine bits. Stir in the vinegar, coffee, sesame seeds and red pepper paste if using. Mix the flour and the salt in a separate large bowl. Make a well in the center and stir the liquid through the flour to make a batter like a loose batter. Strain through a fine mesh sieve into the well and stir to make a stiff but sticky batter.

title: Nutty Kiwi Pea Liqueur
ingredients: 500 g frozen peas | 2 tablespoons kahlua | 1 kiwi, small
instructions: Put the kahlua into a small cup or bowl with the peas it has created. Slice the kiwi in half and slice on the diagonal. Place the potato slices on top of the kahlua and cover with the peas. Then pour over the kahlua. Serve.

title: Pasta Salt
ingredients: 4 -6 ounces rice noodles ( medium size ) | 2 -3 tablespoons sesame oil | 1/4 onion ( chopped or grated ) | 1/3 container ricotta cheese | kosher salt
instructions: In a small bowl, saute the sesame oil on high heat for a minute or two. Add the chopped onion and saute until wilted. While the frying, add the garlic to a little extra virgin olive oil in a large fry pan on high heat. Saute the onion until translucent but not burned. While the onions are sauteing, put 4 quarts of salted water in a pot. When the water comes to a boil, add rice noodles. Bring water to a boil again. Add salt to taste. Once the water comes to a boil, then cover, reduce heat to simmer and cook for 5 minutes. Add the sesame oil and mix. Remove from heat. While the noodles are cooking, mix the ricotta cheese and onions until well combined. When pasta is finished, drain and add mixture. Mix until the pasta looks creamy and the cheese has melted.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper,tortilla,graham cracker crumb,sausage,soya sauce,oat,green chili,shell pasta
title: Sausage Wrapped Sausages and Pasta
ingredients: 1 package of jumbo shells pasta | 1 bag shell pasta or ( 12 ounce ) bag rotini rice, uncooked | 6 large sausages | 1/3 - 1/2 of chopped green chili | 2 tablespoons soya sauce | 1 cup oat, plain or 1 cup rolled oats, toasted | 1/3 - 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs, toasted | chopped green chili ( optional ) | chopped jalapeno pepper ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Cook shells pasta as directed and drain. Heat non stick vegetable spray or non stick wok or skillet over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,white onion,plain yogurt,creme fraiche,beef broth,pizza crust,spaghetti,cannellini bean
title: Pasta & Beans - Rustic Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb fresh whole wheat fusilli, cooked & drained ( about 9 ounces ) | 1 cup canned cannellini beans, drained | 1 white onion, diced ( about 1 cup ) | 2 teaspoons dried italian parsley | 2 cans italian beef broth ( about 14 1/2 ounces of broth ) | 2 tablespoons plain yogurt or 2 tablespoons greek yogurt | 2 tablespoons creme fraiche | 2 tablespoons italian parsley, finely minced ( for topping )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Combine cooked pasta & drained cannellini beans in a small bowl, reserving 1/2 cup of the broth. Cook onion in a 3 qt. Dutch oven until tender, not browned, stirring often to make sure it browns. Do not burn the onion. Remove from the heat. Combine the cooked italian mixture, drained drained, cooled pasta, onions, & dried parsley in a baking dish. Mix the beef broth & yogurt in a small bowl, then stir into the pot. Stir well, then pour mixture over the pasta & beans in the baking dish. Arrange the remaining sliced fresh parsley on top of the casserole. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes, or until bubbly around the edges. To serve, sprinkle with the creme fraiche and drizzle the hot crust with the remaining 1/2 cup of broth.

title: Crock Pot Chicken With Calzones
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1/4 cup white wine | 12 ounces refrigerated pizza dough
instructions: Set chicken in crock pot. Cut 4 pieces lengthwise and with a meat mallet or rolling pin, gently pound chicken until pieces are about 4 long. Place flour in a shallow bowl. Roll chicken in flour until completely coated. Place chicken in crock pot. Pour wine around chicken to cover chicken. Set crock pot on low heat, cover and cook for 9 - 10 hours or on high setting 3 - 4 hours. Remove chicken from crock pot and rest 15 minutes to thicken sauce. Place calzone dough on a flat surface and stretch it to fit your baking dish. Spread 1/3 of chicken sauce onto dough. Add an additional 3 tablespoons of sauce if desired. Cover and bake at 350°f for 15 - 20 minutes or until chicken is completely cooked and sauce is bubbling. Serve calzone with remaining sauce.

title: Chicken Stew
ingredients: 1 package elbow macaroni | 2 cans chicken thighs | 1 pound sausage, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook elbow macaroni in boiling water, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 13 minutes. Drain. Stir chopped sausage into cooked macaroni until thoroughly mixed. Stir chicken pieces into the macaroni mixture until evenly coated. Spread sausage to completely cover the chicken and vegetables. Place the covered roasting pan on top of the roasting pan. Bake in the preheated oven until the vegetables are tender and the chicken is no longer pink in the center, about 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: bean,parmigiano reggiano cheese,buttermilk ranch dressing,ginger root,tortilla,rice vinegar,parmesan cheese,chocolate
title: Pagashtida
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds small tortilla | 1 cup buttermilk ranch dressing | 1 1/2 cups grated parmagiano-reggiano cheese | 3 tablespoons rice vinegar, or as needed | 1/4 inch piece fresh ginger root, grated | 1 cup dried beans, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup chopped, unsweetened chocolate, or more to taste ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium heat. Cook and stir 1 tortilla in the hot skillet until lightly toasted, about 1 minute. Transfer the tortilla to a plate lined with paper towels and set aside. Add 1 1/2 cup pasta sauce to the pan and bring to boil. Continue cooking until heated throughout and bubbling, 1 to 2 minutes. Spoon 1/4 cup pasta sauce into a bowl.

Random Ingredients: english cucumber,pecorino romano cheese,rump steak,sherry,sirloin tip roast,wine vinegar,green cardamom pod
title: Beef Kabobs With Warm-Hot Cucumber Rind
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin tip roast, trimmed of fat, cut in half or 1 lb flank steak, cut into 2-inch cubes | 1 package baby english cucumbers ( or substitute 1 large english cucumber with 1 large english cucumber ) | 2 -4 whole green cardamom pods, split | 1/4 cup dry white wine or 1/4 cup dry vermouth ( or use 1/4 cup dry white wine and 1/4 cup chardonnay wine ) | 1 tablespoon sherry ( optional ) or 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon grated pecorino romano cheese | 1 tablespoon low-sodium sherry | 3 tablespoons coarse-grind whole-grain dijon mustard ( or your favourite dijon-based mustard )
instructions: In a large resealable plastic bag, combine the steak, cucumbers, cardamom, white wine, sherry and cheese. Close the bag and shake to mix thoroughly. Divide the mixture into resealable bags. Using wet hands, close the bags on top of the meat and let marinate in the fridge for at least 6 hours with the cover on. Heat the grill to medium. Preheat the grill to medium high. Discard the marinade from the steak. Brush the meat with the mustard in a few batches on both sides. Grill, brushing with the marinade, until the meat is cooked to your liking, about 4 minutes per side. Transfer the meat to a cutting board and let rest for 3 - 4 minutes before slicing thinly. Divide among warmed serving plates and serve.

title: Cherry Kebabs
ingredients: 3 small tart cherries, halved | 3 tablespoons brown sugar | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke, or to taste | 1 egg white | 2 pounds lean ground lamb
instructions: Place cherries into a small bowl. Stir together brown sugar, liquid smoke, and egg white until combined. Stir into cherries with a knife or metal spatulas until evenly mixed. Let stand until cool. Place meat in a large bowl, and thoroughly mix with cherry batter. Form meat into long 1 inch slices using your hands. Wet hands with cold water, and shape meat into 1 inch pieces. Soak in cherries for 10 minutes. Drain, and set aside to dry for 15 minutes. Preheat an oven to 425 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil, and spray lightly with cooking spray. Place meat onto the prepared baking sheet, and bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, flipping halfway through. Bake in the preheated oven until no longer pink, about 15 minutes more.

title: Chilies With Fennel and Sesame Seeds
ingredients: 2 anaheim chilies | 1/2 cup fennel seed | 1/2 cup cumin seed | 1 tablespoon fennel seed
instructions: Roast chilies over low heat on a baking tray, until dark and fragrant, about 30 seconds. Cool to room temperature, put in medium bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Chop chilies into 1/4 inch pieces, then rinse with warm water. Combine chilies, fennel, and cumin in small skillet, stirring, then bring to boil. Let boil 5 minutes, until seeds darken. Drain. Place chilies in shallow dry skillet over medium high heat and toast, stirring constantly until fragrant and sizzles, about 15 seconds. Remove from heat and stir. Sprinkle over cuminseed.

title: Coriander Seeds Mix
ingredients: 2 cups coriander seeds | 1 tablespoon oregano
instructions: In a spice mill or coffee grinder, finely grind coriander seeds. Use a wooden spoon to mix the coriander seeds with the oregano.

title: Spicy Pepperoni Rice
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 cup cooked rice | 500 g chicken bouillon cubes | 1 teaspoon curry | 8 slices pepperoni | 300 ml double cream | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard
instructions: Spray large frypan with cooking oil. Add rice, curry, pepperoni, cream and mustard. Fry quickly. Place rice on serving dish and spoon sauce over it.

title: Beef Soft Tacos - Rachael Ray
ingredients: 1 package uncooked sushi-style beef tenderloin | 32 asparagus spears, ends trimmed | 1/3 cup low sodium soy milk | 1/3 cup salsa | 1/3 cup rice wine ( japanese rice wine works too ) | 3/4 lb filet of beef
instructions: Place the beef tenderloin between 2 sheets of waxed paper and pound with a meat mallet until about 1/4 inch thick. Cut each tenderloin into 6 to 8 slabs against the grain.. Arrange beef on a wire rack set in a shallow pan and refrigerate, uncovered, for 30 minutes. Meanwhile, prepare asparagus spears.

title: Viking Hot Chocolate! (Hot and Cold from the Chocolate Shop)
ingredients: 1 cup red onion, finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard powder | 2 large egg yolks | 1 tablespoon vodka | 1 cup strong hot coffee ( brewed preferably ) | 1 chocolate square | chili, pieces ( or more, to suit your taste, or serve with whipped cream to make dipping )
instructions: Combine the onion, mustard powder, egg yolks and vodka with 4 tbsp of cold coffee and stir until the chocolate is mixed through it. Then stir half the mixture into the hot chocolate. Cover and freeze for at least 4 hours. To serve, place the chocolate into the top half of a double boiler, place on top of simmering water, cook over simmering water for 3 minutes. Allow to cool a little. Cut it into small bits and serve with a dollop of whipped cream if desired. Repeat a little more with another half of the mixture.

title: Grilled Scallions
ingredients: 4 large scallions | lemon zest ( to taste )
instructions: Wash the scallions thoroughly and cut down the center portion on the thick side of the stalk. Score the root end of the scallions vertically without cutting the stalk through them. Brush the scallions with lemon zest. Grill over high/medium heat on both sides for apprx 5 minutes or until softened and lightly browned underneath. Let cool for about 5 minutes before slicing into 1/2 inch pieces.

title: Greek Yogurt Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lean ground beef | 3 tablespoons fresh herbs ( i use mixed dried herbs such as sage, rosemary, oregano, and thyme. ) | 6 tablespoons low-fat greek yogurt | 1 teaspoon dried thyme ( optional ) | grated mixed herbs ( i use herbs and garlic ) | splash tequila
instructions: Brown beef in a medium skillet over medium heat. Set aside. Using yogurt as your base add to skillet the herbs and nut. Cook about 2 minutes until creamy and fragrant. Return beef to skillet. Add tog mixture and mix to coat and simmer about 3 minutes. Drain excess liquid/typs, add to your taste. Serve over plain or with crusty bread.

title: Thai Drip Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup chicken broth or 1/2 cup chicken bouillon | 1/2 cup minced fresh lemon grass
instructions: Whisk together the broth and lemon grass. Serve with meat.

title: Peanut Butter Sausages
ingredients: 500 g kielbasa sausage ( or hot sausage pieces ) | 500 -568 g baby carrots | 200 g unsalted peanuts ( or roasted ) | 1/2 cup peanut butter
instructions: Peel the carrots, slice lengthways into 3 lengths and place in a colander. Place a steamer tray on the surface. Wet the bottom of a non stick pan with about 50g of water, bring to the boil, then add the drained sausages. Cook for 6 - 10 minutes until cooked and browned, turning regularly. Remove the sausages to a plate lined with paper towel, remove any fat and slice into 3rds. Place the carrots on a paper towel and press to remove any excess water. Place the sliced sausages on the carrots and toss until coated with the peanut butter. Place the peanuts in a mortar and pound roughly until they are smooth. Spread the peanut butter on the sausages and top with the carrots and peanuts. Dollop the spiced peanut butter onto the sausages, spreading evenly. Note, if you have any bran, balsamic vinegar is a good substitute.

Random Ingredients: saffron,cider vinegar,basmati rice,lettuce,soya sauce,white fish fillet,french bread
title: Fillet of Beef With Basmati Rice
ingredients: 2 -3 slices french bread | 1/2 cup cider vinegar | 2 tablespoons soya sauce | 2 tablespoons white fish fillets, sliced | 1 pinch saffron ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups basmati rice ( or jasmine rice, soaked in warm water for 15 minutes ) | shredded lettuce
instructions: Soak rice in lukewarm water for 20 minutes. Wrap bread slices in absorbent paper, let soften for 1 - 2 minutes. Dip both sides of bread slices in vinegar then fry in oil until lightly golden brown. Set aside. Mix all other ingredients, except lettuce, in saucepan. Place chicken on top of bread slices in a single layer. Pour sauce over chicken. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck roast,coriander powder,italian bread crumb,chicken stock powder,ladyfinger
title: Herbed Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 boneless beef chuck roast | 2 cups chicken stock powder | 2 tablespoons coriander powder | 1/2 cup dried italian bread crumbs | 1 package ladyfingers
instructions: Heat a dutch oven until very hot. Brown roast on all sides. Place the roast into a slow cooker. Sprinkle with broth powder, coriander powder and bread crumbs. Cover, and cook on low for 7 to 8 hours. Remove meat, and discard fat from bones. Cover, and cook for 30 minutes. Remove meat from slow cooker, remove meat from bones, slice, and serve.

Random Ingredients: soy sauce,pineapple juice,red wine,french bread,dark chocolate,buttermilk,oregano
title: Sicilian Bread Salad
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread, sliced diagonally 3/4 inch thick | 1 quart buttermilk | 1 1/2 cups pineapple juice | 1/2 cup soy sauce | 8 ounces dark chocolate, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon dried oregano | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh oregano | 1 jar roasted red wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Arrange bread slices on cookie sheets spoke fashion. Bake bread 1 hour 15 minutes turning the bread every 10 minutes. Remove bread and let cool. Combine the pineapple juice, soy sauce and the dark chocolate in medium sized saucepan. Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, just until chocolate is melted and mixture is smooth. Remove from heat and place in a small bowl. Stir in oregano, oregano, and red wine.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,fruit,coriander seed,cumin powder,brown rice,hot green chili pepper,nonfat milk,hazelnut
title: Fragrant Hazelnut Rice With Dried Cherries and Fruit
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups dried fruit | 1 1/4 cups nonfat milk | 1/2 cup dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon dried coriander seed, lightly crushed | 1/4 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 hot green chili pepper, seeded and finely chopped | 1 cup short grain brown rice | 1/2 cup hazelnuts or 1/2 cup walnuts
instructions: Place dried fruit in a large saucepan. Add water to cover and bring to the boil. Cover and set aside for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, stir remaining ingredients together in 2 cup measuring cup.

title: Quick and Easy Chow mein, a Quick and Easy Spanish Rice Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 box barilla chow mein noodles ( dry, not oil packed ) | 1 plum tomato, seeded and diced | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the chow mein noodles and cook uncovered until tender, about 5 minutes. Drain. Meanwhile, in a large bowl, stir together the tomato and vinegar. When the noodles have cooled, pour them into the bowl with the vegetables. Toss and serve.

Random Ingredients: mexican rice,rice noodle,red kidney bean,beef sausage,chipotle powder,cauliflower
title: Rice Noodle & Sausage Chili
ingredients: 400 g beef sausage, cut into 1cm dice | 400 g sweet beef sausages, cut into 1cm dice | 1 can red kidney beans, drained | 2 teaspoons instant rice powder | 1 tablespoon chipotle powder | 400 g cauliflower, separated into small florets | 310 g mexican-style rice ( or any rice you like )
instructions: Put all ingredients into a large saucepan and add enough water to just cover the ingredients. Bring to the boil over a high heat, then simmer covered for a further 20 - 25 minutes, or until the meat is cooked through. Transfer the chili to a food processor or blender, and process until well combined and smooth. Leave the chili to cool, and stir in any remaining ingredients. Store in the fridge in portions that will keep for up to six weeks.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,corn chip,pecorino romano cheese,pear,vegetable oil cooking spray,mascarpone cheese
title: Pear and Cheese Fondue
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 large ripe pear ( peeled and sliced diagonally 1/2-inch slices, keeping slices as wedges ) | 3 cups vegetable stock, warmed | 1/4 cup mascarpone cheese | 3/4 cup freshly shredded pecorino romano cheese ( about 2 ounces ) | 1/2 cup coarsely crushed corn chips
instructions: Coat the inside of a wide braising kettle with cooking spray, then set over medium heat. Add the sliced pear and cook, stirring frequently, until the pan starts to turn golden, about 1 minute. Stir in the heated vegetable stock. Reduce heat to low and continue cooking until the pear is soft, 6 to 10 minutes longer. Remove from heat and cover the kettle and set aside until it starts to cool slightly, about 5 minutes. Stir the mascarpone cheese into the pear mixture until blended. Stir in the shredded pecorino and crushed corn chips. Serve immediately.

title: Rice Bubble Tea
ingredients: 400 ml single cream | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 1 cup rice bubbles, approximately
instructions: First, make the rice bubbles. You want an aromatic and slightly sweet mix of water and ice to create a liquid base and then combine with cream and almond essence. You can also add any other flavourings such as nutmeg. Add your rice bubbles and let them frok for a minute or two. Leave for 1 - 2 minutes. Garnish with finely chopped nuts or drizzle with melted ramekin pieces and serve.

title: Spaetzle II
ingredients: 2 1/2 kg veal, ground | 1 egg white, beaten | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence | of fresh mint, chopped
instructions: Place meat in a bowl with the egg white and vanilla essence and lightly mix. Put a tablespoon of the meat mixture into each spaetzle and roll it around the meat. Sprinkle each with fresh mint leaves. Place in the refrigerator for about an hour or until the meat is firm.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,beef consomme,grape,italian seasoning,cremini mushroom,hot red pepper flake,water
title: Mushroom Consomme and Hot Pepper Shroom Soup
ingredients: 2 tablespoons instant minced dried mushroom | 25 ounces beef consomme | 2 cans sliced cremini mushrooms | 3 tablespoons dried hot red pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon dried chili pepper flakes ( for added spiciness ) | 5 1/2 cups water | 2 1/2 teaspoons dried italian seasoning
instructions: Stir the mushrooms and hot pepper flakes in the consommé until the mushroom pieces release their liquid. Add the liquid. Stir in the hot red pepper flakes, chili flakes, and water. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 20 to 30 minutes. Add italian seasonings, reheat, and adjust seasoning with salt.

title: Greek Lamb & Ham Skewers
ingredients: 8 lamb, schnitzels ( cut in half crossways ) | 7 ounces spaghetti or 7 ounces tagliatelle pasta noodles | 2 tablespoons orange juice and zest | 4 tablespoons dry vermouth | 4 slices smoked deli ham | 2 mangoes, halved and thinly sliced
instructions: Thread schnitzels onto skewers.

title: Walnut Basil and Pecorino Pesto
ingredients: 3 cups walnuts, husked | 1 cup grated parmigiano | 1 cup pecorino cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Blend all ingredients together in a food processor or blender until smooth.

title: Basmati Rice Balls With Cream
ingredients: 1 cup white basmati rice, cooked and uncooked, sushi rice | 100 g dried linguine, sushi | 150 ml half-and-half cream or 150 ml heavy whipping cream | 1 tablespoon sweet chili paste | 1 teaspoon apricot preserves or 1 teaspoon sambal oelek | 1 -2 tablespoon plain flour
instructions: In a bowl, wash and dry the rice. Stir in a 1 - 2 tbs. Water and set aside for 30mins to soak. Place the sabeet in a steamer and heat over boiling water on the stove top. Break up any clumps or lumps with your wooden spoon. Cook the sabeet for 3 4mins until soft and sticky. Stir occasionally to prevent sticking. Add the rice, mix well and set aside. In a bowl, whip the cream until stiff and then fold in 1 teaspoon apricot conserve or sambal oelek. Dip a 1 - 2 tablespoon ramekin into the sabeet and roll to completely cover the ramekin. Repeat with the remainder. Dunk the stuffed ramekin into the sabeet and roll to seal it tightly. Then dip the ramekin in boiling water and continue to dip the ramekin into the sabeet and soak for 15 20mins. Heat the remaining 1 - 2 tbs. Of water and put in the sabeet rollers. Cook for about 5 6mins so as not to overcook, then turn the rollers when finished. Serve with soy sauce or dipping sauces that have been mixed together with fish sauces. To make the dipping sauces, place 1 - 2 tbs. Water into a heatproof bowl and microwave over the lowest possible heat for 45 seconds or until water is almost evaporated. Add in the chilli paste, apricot conserve or sambal oelek and mix together before adding any additional liquid you might may be using inches. Spoon over the rice ball and serve straight away.

title: Grilled Chicken Bowls
ingredients: 1/2 cup quinoa, rinsed | 1 teaspoon lime juice | 1/2 cup chicken, shredded ( optional ) | 1/2 cup marshmallow, thinly sliced ( optional )
instructions: Preheat grill to medium. Sprinkle quinoa lightly with lime juice and oil. Place chicken on grill and cover. Cook for 3 - 8 minutes or until almost cooked and fully cooked through. Stir quinoa and marshmallows into chicken if using. Serve.

Random Ingredients: caster sugar,irish whiskey,lime wedge,vanilla essence,cashew nut
title: Coconut Whiskey Cashew Nut Cake
ingredients: 2 cups fresh cashew nuts | 600 ml caster sugar | 500 ml irish whiskey | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | lime wedge
instructions: Place the cashewnuts in a pan with 300ml warm water over high heat and bring to the boil. Remove from the heat and drain off all the water, then coarsely chop roughly and place to one side. Combine the cashewnuts with the sugar, syrup, whiskey and vanilla in a pan and bring to the boil, stirring occasionally. Remove from the heat and add the caster sugar. Pour into a shallow 2 litre / 24 flan or ring tin and set aside to cool, then chill for 2 - 3 hours. When ready to serve, remove from the tin, sprinkle with the mint or orange zest and garnish with lime wedges.

title: Easy Beef Steak and Yummy Ladyfingers
ingredients: 600 g beef steaks | 300 g ladyfingers | 2 -4 tablespoons oyster sauce
instructions: Marinate steak with oyster sauce for one hour. Arrange ladyfingers on serving plate. Brush with a little sauce. Dip steak into remaining oyster sauce.

Random Ingredients: cream,bulk pork sausage,rosemary sprig,cayenne powder,black bean,vanilla vodka,red cabbage
title: Black Beans and Sausage Colcannon
ingredients: 1 lb bulk pork sausage | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne powder | 1 red cabbage, shredded | 1 bunch fresh rosemary sprig, leaves chopped | 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup vanilla vodka | 1 cup sour cream
instructions: Simmer sausage in medium saucepan over medium heat 7 to 10 minutes, or until cooked through. Drain. Stir in cayenne powder. Toss cabbage, sausage, rosemary, and black beans with sausage mixture, then cover and simmer until cabbage wilts.

title: Flambarian Red Potato and Bacon Sausage Skewers
ingredients: 8 red potatoes, scrubbed and sliced | 4 slices bacon, chopped | 1 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1/4 cup dry sherry ( not cooking sherry ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the potatoes, bacon, olive oil, sherry, and mace.

Random Ingredients: shrimp,dark brown sugar,hot red chili pepper
title: Chili Braised Shrimp
ingredients: 1 lb shrimp | 2 teaspoons dark brown sugar | 8 dried hot red chili peppers
instructions: Place shrimp in shallow pan. Bring water to boil, cover and simmer until shrimp turns pink, about 3 - 4 minutes. Remove from heat and drain shrimp. Wipe shrimp with damp cloth and add sugar. Heat 1 2min on med high in skillet. While sugar is heating, drain chilies and remove any seeds. Add chilies to sauce. Heat to boiling, add shrimp. Cover, reduce heat and simmer until shrimp turn pink, about 8 10min. Serve with warm rice.

title: Crispy Mustard Wedges
ingredients: 4 teaspoons finely ground whole grain mustard | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | 1 tablespoon white flour | 24 wooden skewers, halved | 1 head romaine lettuce, washed and dried | 1/2 cup chopped pecans
instructions: Combine the mustard and 1/4 teaspoon cayenne in a small bowl, stirring to blend. Set aside. Cut the ends off the the lettuce. Place in a medium bowl and toss with the pecans and remaining 1/4 teaspoon cayenne. Preheat the grill or broiler. Spread mustard mixture evenly on the skewers, leaving some room at one long corner. Brush the grill or broiler rack with oil and arrange the skewers on it. Grill or broil until the edges are lightly browned, about 3 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and cool slightly, about 10 minutes. Cut the wedge diagonally into wedges and serve.

Random Ingredients: pork tenderloin,mineral water,green chili,cranberry sauce,red wine vinegar,ginger juice,mascarpone cheese
title: Tasteful Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin | 1/4 cup bottled red wine vinegar | 1/4 cup bottled mineral water ( not water please ) | 1 tablespoon ginger juice | 8 ounces mascarpone cheese ( i prefer the non-fat ricotta or greek ) | 4 teaspoons green chili, minced ( optional ) | 8 ounces cranberry sauce, warmed
instructions: Trim all excess fat from the tenderloin. Pierce the tenderloin with a tenderizing fork about 1/2 to 1/2 an inch/thick, then insert a knife into the thickest portion of the tenderloin and flatten the meat until it is of even thickness. Place in a large zipper bag with the rest of the ingredients. Seal and refrigerate for 1 hour. Grill the tenderloin, covered, over indirect heat for 45 minutes, turning occasionally, then cover loosely and let stand 30 minutes, then cut into 2 medallions. Serve warm.

title: Curry Scallop With Marinara Sauce
ingredients: 6 bay scallops | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 2 tablespoons curry powder | 1 cup marinara sauce
instructions: Rinse scallops under cold water, pat dry with paper towels. Cut slits in one side of each scallop. Place in large non stick skillet. Add curry and onion. Saute over medium heat until scallops are barely opaque but not brown. Stir in sauce. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes or until scallops are just tender.

Random Ingredients: peach,celery,fruit almond,margarine,pineapple juice,red cabbage,chicken leg,lime juice zest
title: Quick Caribbean Chicken Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup freshly squeezed lime juice and zest | 2 tablespoons orange juice or 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 8 cups shredded red cabbage | 4 boneless skinless chicken legs | 2 medium pineapple slices, halved | 1/2 small red cabbage or 1/2 small savoy cabbage, shredded | 1 can sliced peach slices ( optional ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons margarine
instructions: In large bowl, mix lime zest and juice with zest mixture. Set aside. In large pot of boiling water, place chicken. Cook and stir until just no longer pink. Drain. Tear into pieces. In a large bowl, combine chicken, pineapple, cabbage, olives, butter and lime zest mixture. Toss well. Cover and chill up to 2 days.

Random Ingredients: milk,seasoning salt,tortilla,red wine vinegar,stewing beef,taco seasoning mix,heavy cream,coriander powder
title: Beef Carnitas in Creamy Rice or Burritos
ingredients: 1/2 cup red wine vinegar ( red wine vinegar is great for this... or more to taste ) | 1 can evaporated milk, drained ( do not use non-sweetened condensed milk substitute ) | 1 lb stewing beef, cut into bite size pieces | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon coriander powder | 1 tablespoon seasoning salt ( for beef carnitas ) | 5 dozen small tortillas | 2 cups heavy cream or 2 cups sour cream
instructions: Combine vinegar and milk in a heavy pot over high heat. Bring to a boil. Add meat, stirring to break it up into cubes and stir constantly. Season to taste with taco seasoning and coriander. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes or until meat is tender. Taste and adjust seasoning. In a bowl using a slotted spoon, skim off any fat from sauce pan. Add heavy cream, stirring constantly. Bring to a simmer over medium heat and add meat.

title: Kumara (Sweet Potato Salad)
ingredients: 1 large kumara ( sweet potato ) | 1/4 cup rice wine vinegar | 1/2 a packet sazon goya | 1/4 cup fresh thai basil, cut into 1-inch chunks
instructions: Cut sweet potato into chunks about 1/8 inch thick.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,peach,chickpea,carnation milk,peach schnapps,clear honey,onion powder
title: Spicy Baked Peaches
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 2 ripe peaches, sliced | 1 1/2 tablespoons clear honey | 2 teaspoons clear honey | 3/4 teaspoon onion powder | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/2 teaspoon bacon drippings or 1/2 teaspoon olive oil | carnation evaporated peaches | carnation evaporated peaches
instructions: Preheat oven to 250°f mix all ingredients except for the peaches in a microwave safe bowl. Place on a baking sheet and bake in the oven until tender, about 40 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes. Place on serving platter and serve with the peach flavored glaze.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,nutmeg,shallot,pepper sauce,pasta sauce,lovage,mexican cheese,kosher salt black pepper
title: Homemade Baked Pasta With lovage
ingredients: 1 box pasta sauce ( homemade or prepared ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup chopped lovage ( about 5 or 6 leaves ) | 2 chicken bouillon cubes, dissolve in 1/2 cup warm water ( this is quite a strong recipe for this imo ) | kosher salt and black pepper | generous pinch of grated nutmeg ( for sprinkling, i love lots! ) | generous pinch of grated lovage ( optional ) | generous pinch of grated nutmeg ( for sprinkling ) | one -minute fresh-pressed hot pepper sauce ( for smothering, i have used tabasco or anjou ) ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Line the bottom of a baking dish with pasta sauce and place the lovage leaves in a single layer in the bottom. Dissolve the bouillon in the warm water. Squeeze the water out from the water and pour over the lovage. Add a generous pinch of the nutmeg and seasoning. Cover tightly with aluminum foil, place in oven and bake for at least an hour, checking and stirring every 30 minutes or so and adding a bit or two of water if needed. Note, it has always been suggested that you cook pasta with lovage before adding the other ingredients, as if it has a too bland flavoring at all, don't fret or re use the lovage leaves after you add them and sprinkle them sparingly with the nutmeg. Serve this with a wedge of parmesian cheese, fresh french bread and a nice salad.

title: Spinach Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 2/3 lbs peeled washed potatoes | 8 ounces frozen chopped spinach leaves | 3/4 cup chopped pecan halves | 8 ounces prepared spinach custard | 4 tablespoons custard or 4 tablespoons cream
instructions: Boil the potatoes a large pan of water and then drain when tender. Meanwhile steam the spinach until it’s just wilted and cool a bit. When ready, drain and shake off any excess water and place the spinach into a large bowl. Add the spinach to the potatoes and mix together. Pour the custard over and mix well. Stir in the chopped nuts and add the pecan halves just before serving. Tip, to make this a little less runny, place cooked potatoes in a large bowl. Just before serving stir in the custard and mix well.

Random Ingredients: sherry,salmon,shiitake mushroom,vegetable oil corn,salt water,kernel corn,grain wheat flour
title: Winnipeg's Favorite Salmon, Shiitake and Corn Fritters
ingredients: 2 cups whole grain wheat flour | 1 pinch salt | vegetable oil or corn oil, for frying | 1 lb salmon, cut in strips | 1 lb shiitake mushroom, sliced | 1 cup frozen whole kernel corn ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon dry sherry
instructions: Combine sherry and a pinch salt in a bowl, and stir to blend, set aside. Put flour, and salt in a processor, and process until mixture resembles coarse meal, about 40 seconds. Turning and kneading the flour, add a little water, until dough forms a ball. Knead some more, if necessary, to work in flour from the top. Divide dough in half, roll out one half, and cut into strips about 12 inches long and 1 inch wide. Cut the strips into strips, and separate the strands of strips from each other while you are working with them. Heat oil in a deep fryer or heavy skillet over medium heat. Drain salmon, and transfer to a dish. Heat a few tablespoons of oil to a depth of 1 inch in the pan. Coat salmon strips with sherry, and fry in hot oil until golden brown, turning once. Drain on paper towels, and serve immediately with mushrooms and corn. Variation, cook rice, add a cooked egg to the meat mixture.

Random Ingredients: chili garlic sauce,palm sugar,grain rice,parsley,lemon juice,red bell pepper,banana
title: Thai Banana Salad
ingredients: 4 large ripe bananas, sliced lengthways | 40 g palm sugar, finely chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 1 -2 tablespoon sweet chili garlic sauce | 1/4 red bell pepper, deseeded | 2 -4 tablespoons fresh parsley, chopped | steamed rice, to serve
instructions: Place the bananas in a bowl, sprinkle with the palm sugar and pour over the lemon juice. Beat well with a fork, then pour over a little sweet chilli sauce. Grate the pepper and mix with all the chopped parsley. Serve over steamed rice.

title: Orange, Coriander and Cilantro roots
ingredients: 600 g fresh cilantro roots, roots trimmed | 1 1/4 liters fresh orange juice ( about 6 oranges ) | fresh coriander leaves
instructions: Put the root ginger and the 6 oranges in a large, deep pan with plenty of cold water to cover and cook until tender. Drain the roots and slice into 1cm thin strips. Place the orange juice, finely chopped coriander and the cilantro roots in a pan and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat and simmer uncovered until the coriander is fragrant. Take care not to allow the sauce to boil over. You may need to add a little water if you find it necessary. Pour over your chosen salad. Cook until the citrus is ready.

title: Polish Barley Beef Tenderloin With Dill Sour Cream,  (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin | 2 1/2 cups pearl barley | 1/3 cup ketchup | dill ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Combine all ingredients in a 2 quart baking dish and bake at 300 degrees until meat thermometer reads 140 and thermometer reads 165, basting several times with remaining 1/2 cup of liquid. Remove from oven, slice and serve with additional dill on top.

title: Lamb Exotic in a Tight
ingredients: 4 lbs lamb | 1 1/2 tablespoons kahlua
instructions: Trim off most of the fat from the lamb, but leave enough fat in the meat to absorb the flavors. Rinse the lamb under cold running water and pat dry. Cut into pieces 1 1/4 x 2. In a small bowl, combine the kahlua and sugar. Place the lamb inside a flat roasting tin. Pour half of the Kahlua/sugar mixture on the lamb. Pour the remaining kahlua/sugar mixture over, and roast at 325°f for 1½ hours, brushing with warm tinely egg white while cooking. When the lamb is tender, remove it from the oven, tent with foil, and chill in a cool place for at least 2 hours before barbecuing.

Random Ingredients: cumin powder,sunflower oil,pineapple chunk,cheddar cheese,lemon,tasting yeast,mirin,mozzarella cheese
title: MEXican Pineapple Pizza
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 1 large lemon, juice of, fresh squeezed | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 500 g low-fat cheddar cheese, thickly sliced | 1/2 cup low fat mozzarella cheese, shredded | 1 cup low fat pineapple chunk, canned | 1 tablespoon sunflower oil | 1 teaspoon tasting yeast | 2 tablespoons mirin
instructions: Set oven to 120c. Whisk together oils, lemon juice and cumin in a large bowl. Add cheeses and toss gently to combine. Stir in pineapple and transfer mixture to an oven proof 23cm × 5cm slice pan. Heat oil in a small saucepan over medium heat. Add yeast and stir to dissolve. Bring to boiling, then boil 2 minutes. Stir in mirin and boil until reduced to a thick glaze. Transfer to a baking sheet. Preheat oven to 200c and set aside for 15 minutes. Spoon pizza mixture into pan and spread to cover evenly. Bake in oven for 12 minutes. Remove and serve immediately.

title: Welsh Vegetables
ingredients: 450 g swedes | 2 oranges, peel of | 1 pear, peeled | 50 g rolled phyllo dough
instructions: Wash and peel your swedes. Slice them into 1 inch chunks. Put 2 tablespoons olive oil in pot, add swedes, pear and orange and stir fry over medium to high heat until swedes are soft. Add the rest of the contents and mix well.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,pecorino romano cheese,blueberry,egg,black cumin seed
title: Roasted Veggie Pizzas
ingredients: 3 tablespoons pecorino romano cheese, grated | 3 tablespoons blueberries | 3 tablespoons red bell peppers, chopped | 2 tablespoons black cumin seeds, toasted | 2 eggs, beaten | 2 tablespoons pecorino romano cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat your oven's broiler and position a rack 6 inches below the broiler element. Grease a cookie sheet with oil. In a bowl, mash the freshly grated pecorino romano with a fork. Stir in the blueberries, red bell peppers, black cumin, eggs, and 1 tablespoon of olive oil. Transfer to the pan, and flatten slightly. Bake in the preheated oven until the top is lightly browned, 8 to 10 minutes. Switch the oven's broiler setting, and broil for a few more minutes to crisp the edges. Cut into 4 pizzas, and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: navy bean,feta cheese,cauliflower floret,salt pepper,broccoli,jicama,cream mushroom soup
title: Hg's Vegetable Beef Bake
ingredients: 3 lbs sirloin steaks, cut in 1-inch cubes | 8 cups fresh cauliflower florets | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 10 ounces navy beans | 6 ounces jicama, peeled | 6 ounces feta cheese | salt & pepper, to taste
instructions: Prepare a 10 x 15 inch baking dish. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl, except feta cheese, and place in baking dish. Top with feta cheese.

title: The Fires of Hades -- Glamorgan Sausages
ingredients: 4 teaspoons grand marnier | 3 drops hot sauce | chili pepper, to taste
instructions: Combine the grand marnier, hot sauce and the chilli. Use to baste the sausages before cooking. Bake, basting, to your liking..

Random Ingredients: pork tenderloin,rice,flat leaf parsley,baby bok choy,extra virgin olive oil
title: Sweet Pork and Bok Choy
ingredients: 3/4 cup rice | 5 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | baby bok choy, washed | 4 3/4 lbs pork tenderloin | 2 tablespoons dried flat leaf parsley
instructions: Cook rice in boiling water for about 12 minutes. Rinse with cold water and drain. Heat 2 t oil in large frying pan over medium high heat. Cut pork into 1 - 2 pieces and toss with rice and parsley. Cover and cook 2 minutes or until pork is crisp and cooked through.

title: Coffee Crunch
ingredients: 1 cup coffee ice cream | 1/2 cup frozen cranberries
instructions: Fill an 8 ounce glass with ice cream and fill with cranberries.

Random Ingredients: ghee,banana pepper,wheat flour,fish stock,date,miracle whip,pecorino cheese
title: Fried Bananas With Dates and Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 cup low-fat yogurt ( plain ) | 1 tablespoon dried pepers or 1 tablespoon parmesan cheese, grated ( can use other greek cheese if desired ) | 1 teaspoon whole wheat flour | 3 tablespoons fish stock | 2 tablespoons miracle whip | 2 tablespoons ghee | 3 medium size bananas, sliced into 1/4-inch rounds and cooked in boiling water for 2 to 3 minutes, until slightly wrinkles and still slightly pliable
instructions: In a small bowl or strainer, mix the yogurt, cheese, pepers, flour and fish stock. Heat the ghee or vegetable oil. Dip the bananas in the mixture and fry in it on both sides over medium heat until golden brown. Drain on paper towels and serve hot or room temperature.

title: Spicy Cherry Molasses
ingredients: 1 tablespoon coarse grain brown sugar or 1 tablespoon light molasses | 3/4 cup water chestnut, drained and sliced | 1 1/2 lbs green cherries, quartered
instructions: In a small bowl, combine sugar and water chestnuts. Stir to mix until sugar is completely dissolved. Pour 1 1/2 cups water with molasses into a 2 1/2 quart saucepan, bring to a boil over medium high heat. Remove from the heat. Add cherry mixture, stirring constantly until blended. Cover and place on the lowest heat setting. Simmer, stirring once or twice, for 35 to 45 minutes or until cherry mixture is bubbly and slightly thickened but still pourable. Cool slightly. Discard solids. Makes a great gifts in a jar, keep in mind that it will get better with age. Makes 3 1/2 cups.

Random Ingredients: egg substitute,beef stock powder,avocado,penne rigate,harissa,chili pepper,italian herb seasoning
title: Buca Di Beppo Penne With Avocado Aioli
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper ( such as ancho or new mexico ) | 1 teaspoon dried italian herb seasoning, or more to taste | 1/2 teaspoon beef stock powder | 3/4 package dried rigatoni pasta with prawns, thawed if frozen and cut into half inch strips | 3 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil, divided | 1 large avocado, sliced | 1 cup egg substitute
instructions: Place the chile pepper, herbs, beef stock powder, and broken up prawns in a large, deep skillet. Bring to a boil over medium high heat, stirring often. Stir in the pasta and 1/4 cup of the olive oil. Cover and cook until the pasta is al dente, stirring occasionally, 15 to 20 minutes. Pour the skillet contents into a food processor. Add the remaining 1/4 cup of olive oil and egg substitute. Process until smooth. Sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cup of olive oil to serve. Enjoy.

title: Catfish Favourite
ingredients: 5 catfish fillets ( about 450g/6oz each ) | 2 tablespoons fresh chives
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c. Score 3 - 4 diagonal slices on the fish fillets and place in a non stick ovenproof dish. Mix together the chives and half of the remaining mix, then spoon over the fish. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Chilean Gumbo
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs gumbo file powder ( about 6 3/4 oz filet ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 2 jars grape ( jumbo size ) | 1 tablespoon flour
instructions: Cut the filet into 1 pieces. Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a medium skillet. Add the filet and sprinkle generously with salt and pepper. Saute on both sides for 3 to 4 minutes or until opaque in the center. Serve the chilean gumbo over flour mixed with water. The chili can be used for seasoning and soup or eaten plain.

Random Ingredients: ham,pumpkin pie spice,vegetable,prune,chinese five spice powder,garbanzo bean
title: Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 can pumpkin pie spice | 1 can garbanzo beans, drained | 1 can mixed vegetables | pumpkin pie spice | chinese five-spice powder | 3 cups cooked ham ( i used cubed ) | 1 cup dried prunes, chopped
instructions: Mix pumpkin pie spice, garbanzo beans, mixed vegetables, pumkin pie spice, and five spice powder into large bowl. Add ham and prunes and mix lightly. Put in fridge overnight.

Random Ingredients: chipotle pepper,peanut,egg white,aubergine,liquid smoke,guacamole,red chili pepper,sausage casing
title: Chili Filled Eggs With Aubergines (Aubergines)
ingredients: 7 egg whites | 250 g guacamole ( to make an avocado soft or sweet equivalent ) | 1/2 - 3/4 cup liquid smoke ( to taste ) | 3/4 cup cashews, coarsely chopped | 50 -75 g guacamole | 1 red chili pepper ( red, small size or small dried red chile flakes ) | 8 -10 chargrilled chipotle peppers | 100 g smoked sausage cashews | 50 -75 g roasted peanuts
instructions: Filling, combine a small fry pan with a small amount of oil and stir over a gentle heat until the oil is hot. Place a small dish of water on the stove and when it comes to a rolling boil, pre heat the oven to 120c/fan 110c/gas mark 2. Place the cashew nuts in a pan of water with a little bit of oil and leave them to soften slightly. Cut the sausage into small pieces, place them in the frying pan and fry until golden brown for about 5 minutes. Add the chili and dried chile flakes and remove from the heat. Leave the sausage in a piece of clingfilm, as much fat as possible. Drain the oil, cool some of it out but leave some of it if you wish. The sausage can then be left in the pan to cool down some more. The guacamole can now be stored in the fridge in an airtight container for up to 1 week in the fridge. It will last a long time. Eggs, beat the egg whites with a pinch of salt in a large sized bowl with a tablespoonful of liquid smoke until soft peaks form. Fold in 1/3 of the egg white mix and continue to fold in the rest of the egg white mix. Cut a piece of aluminium foil, place two or three pieces of egg on top. Pinch the sides to help keep the eggs from falling out. Add the sausages and cashews to the egg mixture and fold together.

title: Bechameli
ingredients: 1/3 cup finely diced fennel | 1 1/4 cups white wine | 10 egg yolks | 2 tablespoons finely diced drained capers
instructions: Cook fennel in 1 1/2 cups of the white wine until soft and beginning to brown. Set aside to cool. Beat egg yolks and capers in a medium bowl until light and fluffy. Add fennel mixture, stirring until blended, to temper, then stir in remaining wine. Cool to room temperature. Drain capers and pat dry. Spoon into a 1 1/2 quart baking dish. Bake, stirring occasionally, for 30 to 40 minutes, or until set and lightly browned. Note, the capers can be replaced with 1/4 cup red wine and 1/4 cup sparkling wine, also suggested using sparkling cider, which should fill about 1 1/2 cups.

Random Ingredients: worcestershire sauce,tomato puree,chicken bouillon,pesto sauce,mustard powder,romaine lettuce
title: Italian-Style Creamy Pesto
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups prepared pesto sauce ( see note in note ) | 2 1/4 cups tomato puree | 1 1/2 cups chicken bouillon | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons mustard powder | 1 head romaine lettuce, leaves washed and dried thoroughly ( can use red leaf lettuce )
instructions: Put all ingredients in a slow cooker. Cover, set to low and cook on high for approximately 6 hours, stirring once. Remove from heat and allow to sit 10 minutes. Stir.

title: Crock Pot Beef Pot Roast
ingredients: 4 lbs beef roast ( cut into pieces ) | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper ( or less ) | 4 large baking potatoes ( i prefer baking yummo )
instructions: Dry the meat out with paper towels and sprinkle with cayenne pepper. Add potato slices and cook on high for 3 hours, or until potatoes are tender. Turn meat.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,kaffir lime leaf,sunflower oil,corn oil,currant,sage leaf,cannellini bean
title: Tuscan Bean Bread
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans, rinsed | 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 1/2 cup plain flour | 3 kaffir lime leaves, torn | 1/2 cup chopped fresh sage leaf | 1 tablespoon dried currant, soaked in hot water to rehydrate the soaked beans
instructions: Heat the oil and corn oil in a large frying pan, add the beans and saute gently for 3 or 4 minutes or until well combined, shaking the pan to prevent sticking. Sprinkle in the flour and stir until a smooth paste forms. Stir in the lime leaves, sage and currants. Remove from the heat. Using a teaspoon, form a round loaf about 4 - 3 inches high, each about 6 inches in diameter. Arrange in a lightly greased shallow buttered ovenproof dish. Bake at 190°c for 25 - 30 minutes or until golden and crisp. Cut into 12 slices. Serve hot or warm.

title: Miso Burgers
ingredients: 1 zucchini, ends trimmed, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 3 medium onions, halved and thinly sliced | 1/4 cup brussels sprouts, lightly packed | 2 ounces unsweetened chocolate, coarsely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/2 cup dry breadcrumbs | 4 ounces snow peas | 2 ounces toasted macadamia nuts, coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat the grill or broiler. In a medium sized bowl, combine the zucchini, onions, sprouts and chocolate.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,orange blossom water,elbow macaroni,salt pork,broccoli stem,fenugreek,chive,lime zest
title: Macaroni With Orange Blossom Water and Veggies
ingredients: 1 lb elbow macaroni | salt pork, diced ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon minced chives | 1 tablespoon freshly grated lime zest | 2 teaspoons orange blossom water | 2 tablespoons orange blossom water | 1 cup fresh broccoli stem, chopped ( optional ) | 1 cup bell pepper, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Cook pasta according to the package directions. Meanwhile, cook salt pork in a skillet until the pork is halfway cooked. Mix chives, zest, and orange blossom water together in a bowl. Bring a large saucepan of water to a boil. Boil pasta until just slightly tender. Drain. Stir pasta with orange blossom water and vegetables. Serve hot.

title: Nacho Chicken
ingredients: 1 chicken, cut up in quarters | 1 jalapeno, chopped
instructions: Mix in food processor until mixture is smooth. Arrange in a 9x13 backing dish. Marinate chicken in mixture for several hours or over night bake 350 degrees for 30 minutes. Or bake 400 degrees for 45 minutes. Turn oven to broil. Broil for a few minutes until chicken is brown. Stir all together.

Random Ingredients: piri chile pepper,stewing beef,shallot,cilantro leaf,maple syrup,pork tenderloin,red chili pepper
title: Maple-Glazed Beef and Pork Tenderloin Filets for the BBQ
ingredients: 2 tablespoons pure maple syrup | 1 shallot, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons grated fresh cilantro leaves | 1 small fresh red chili pepper, thinly sliced | 1/2 teaspoon ground piri piri chile pepper | 1 1/4 lbs fresh pork tenderloin, trimmed of all fat | 2 pork tenderloin, trimmed and tied with kitchen twine
instructions: Combine the maple syrup, shallot, cilantro, chili, piri piri, and pork and marinate meat for 1 hour before barbecueing. Barbeque meat 3 to 4 minutes per side to medium rare for medium doneness.

title: Pasta With Uncooked Veggies
ingredients: 1 lb pasta ( any shape, shape, multigrain, whole wheat, spiral shaped, your choice, your choice ) | 1/2 chopped medium size onion | 1 teaspoon onion powder
instructions: Put salted water into a large pot for the boiling water to boil for your pasta. While the pasta is cooking, in a medium skillet over medium heat fry the onions in the onion powder until tender. Add the cooked pasta. Cook the pasta until it is al dente. Drain and toss it until you get a nice salad consistancy. Add a little bit of oil to the pasta and vegies or just mix everything together. If you want a little spice and bite or crunch you can sprinkle in the onion powder. Serve immediately and enjoy.

title: Italian Breaded Salami
ingredients: 1/2 cup italian breadcrumbs | 1/4 pound thinly sliced salami | 1/4 cup finely chopped green chile peppers | 24 ounces italian-style hot v8 | 1 cup tap water
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Lightly grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. In a bowl, mix the bread crumbs and salami. Mix in the green chilies. Transfer the mixture to a resealable plastic bag, and squish around to coat. Refrigerate at least 1 hour or overnight. In a large resealable plastic bag, combine the hot v 8, water, and papery coating. Add the salami mixture.

Random Ingredients: golden syrup,fruit,cream chicken soup,beef stew meat,apple
title: Beef Stew With Apple and Apple
ingredients: 2 lbs cubed beef stew meat | 3/4 cup canned cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup apple juice or 1/2 cup golden syrup | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon all purpose mixed dried fruit | 1 cup chopped apple ( optional )
instructions: Place stew meat and apple in a 2 quart slow cooker. For the topping, combine the cream of chicken soup with apple juice and brown the stew meat and apple in a saucepan for 20 minutes on low heat. Remove pot from the heat.

title: Bacon and Chilli Sausages
ingredients: 10 strips thick slab bacon, coarsely chopped | 5 garlic cloves, coarsely chopped | 1 lb crabmeat ( or kimchi with chilli ) ( optional ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons dashi powder or 1 1/2 teaspoons instant coffee powder | 1 chili pepper, seeded, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325°f heat a frypan over medium high heat. Add the bacon and chilli. Cook, stirring, for 2 minutes. Meanwhile, combine the ingredients in a large bowl. Sprinkle the sausage slices with the bacon and chili. Place on baking tray lined with baking paper, and bake for 30 minutes, or until cooked. Serve hot. Variation, add chopped scallions, or chinese parsley to the sausages.

title: Greek-Spinach Salad With Pumpkin
ingredients: 2 packages baby spinach, stems removed | 1 cup pumpkin puree or 1 cup pie pumpkin pie filling | 1/2 cup feta cheese, crumbled | 1 medium tomatoes, seeded and diced | 1/2 teaspoon whole cloves
instructions: Place the pumpkin in a medium bowl, then stir in the feta cheese, tomatoes, and cloves. Toss with the spinach. Cover and refrigerate for one hour to allow the flavors to combine.

Random Ingredients: gingerroot,white sugar,virgin olive oil,blackberry,cream chicken soup,toffee,beef chuck,chicken broth
title: Slow Cooker Ginger Braised Beef
ingredients: 2 tablespoons gingerroot, minced | 4 tablespoons virgin olive oil | 8 cups low sodium chicken broth or 8 cups water | 2 lbs boneless beef chuck, trimmed and cut into 2-inch pieces | 2 cans cream of chicken soup, undiluted | 1 can blackberries | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 12 ounces toffee ( optional )
instructions: In a large skillet, heat oil over medium high heat. Add chicken stock or water, bring to a boil, and then add beef. Reduce heat and simmer, covered, 15 to 30 minutes, or until beef is very tender and meat easily falling off the bones. Transfer beef to cutting board. Let stand, covered, 5 minutes. Strain the stock and skim off any extra fat. Reserve 3 cups of stock. Using a slotted spoon, remove beef from skillet, reserving any drippings and fat. Add reserved stock, cream of chicken soup, and blackberries to slow cooker. Cover and cook on low for 4 hours. Remove beef from slow cooker, reserving cooking liquid and discarding solids. Stir beef mixture into pan juices until thoroughly combined. Remove and discard ginger root and serve with toffee.

title: Lefse With Garlic and Lemon
ingredients: 1 liter stock | 1 leek, cleaned and sliced | 1 tablespoon olive | 1 egg yolk | 1 tablespoon chopped olives
instructions: Bring the stock to a boil, stirring constantly. Slice the leek lengthways and de vein. Heat the olive in a frying pan, and cook the leek for 2 minutes. Remove from the pan and set aside. Add the olive, egg yolk, and stir until the yolk sauce thickens. Heat the mixture up until warm. Add the sliced boiled leeks and continue to stir to combine. Serve the lefse in lettuce leaves, and garnish with chopped olives. Variation, for a greek effect, this is served with bread.

title: Gulab Jamun (Chicken in Cream Sauce)
ingredients: 1 chicken, cut into pieces | 1/4 cup ghee | 1 cup chicken broth | 1 pint heavy whipping cream | 6 saffron
instructions: Melt the ghee in a heavy skillet. Add the chicken pieces and fry over medium high heat until golden brown on all sides. Stir in the broth and bring to a boil. Cover and simmer over low heat until the chicken is tender, about 20 minutes. Remove chicken from the pan and keep warm. Remove the saffron strands from the sauce. Return the sauce to the skillet. Add the cream and bring to a boil, stirring frequently, until it thickens slightly. Do not boil. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon,hard egg,vegetable broth,seasoning salt,beef sirloin,heavy whipping cream,chili pepper
