instructions: Wash and thoroughly dry the cabbage. Place it in a pan with about 1/2 inch of water and bring to a boil over high heat. When water boils, cover and continue boiling over low heat until cabbage is tender. About 15 minutes. Meanwhile, remove tough outer leaves from cabbage and discard. Slice out the core and slice cabbage into quarters. Place cabbage and vegetable in a bowl with cold water. Drain well and cool to room temperature. When cool, drain well and refrigerate.

title: Mountain Cake Chips
ingredients: 1 package flour tortillas or 1 package fajita-style corn tortillas | 1 package melted butter | 1 jar chocolate chips or ( 8 ounce ) jar maraschinoes, dip
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Spray baking sheet with non stick cooking spray. With oiled hands, form a small disk around each tortilla disk. Wrap loosely in foil. Bake 45 minutes. While tortillas are baking, coat a paper towel with cooking spray and line with a paper towel to drain. After 45 minutes, remove foil, turn tortillas over, and bake until lightly crisp, about 10 to 15 minutes, but do not let them get too brown. While still hot, carefully remove the tortillas from the cookie sheet, and carefully remove the paper towel. Dip tortillas in melted butter, return to the cookie sheet, and then sprinkle with chocolate or maraschinoes. Return to oven to bake until chocolate is melted, approximately 2 - 3 minutes. Cut into wedges to serve.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast meat,pumpkin seed,palm sugar,coconut milk,prune,quinoa
title: Chicken & Quinoa Pudding
ingredients: 500 g chicken breast meat or 500 g turkey breast | 200 ml coconut milk | 150 g sweetened pumpkin seeds | 200 g prunes, chopped | 200 g palm sugar | 2 tablespoons uncooked quinoa
instructions: Place the chicken breast into the fridge to marinate. While that's marinating, place the coconut milk in a small pan, add the cinnamon and sugar to taste. Bring to the boil and reduce the temperature as low as possible. When the milk comes to a boil remove from the heat and allow the mixture to cool slightly. Once cooled add the pumpkin seeds and prunes. Allow to cool enough that you can work the mixture together. It's easier to work with this way, but be careful how long it takes to cool down. Preheat the oven to 190°c. Line a 7x5 casserole dish with greaseproof paper. Once you're finished preparing everything, take the mixture out of the fridge and roughly tear the chicken breast, using kitchen shears, needle etc. Pour everything into the dish and spread out evenly. Mix your palm sugar and quinoa together with a fork until they are mixed well. Spread the cinnamon/pumpkin mix over the whole dish. Place the quinoa on top of the cinnamon/pumpkin mix and sprinkle the top evenly with pecan/icing sugar. Place baking paper onto a cookie sheet, and bake in oven for approximately 20 minutes. The pudding will pucker slightly. After 20 minutes, transfer the baking paper with the quinoa and the quinoa to a serving plate. Cut and serve hot. If desired, you may garnish with mints, lime juice and extra chopped mint leaves to serve.

Random Ingredients: creamy peanut butter,carrot,stewing beef,vanilla,liquid honey,almond halve,sharp cheddar cheese,rye bread
title: Swedish Beef and Carrots With Peanut Butter
ingredients: 1/2 lb stewing beef, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 2 tablespoons creamy peanut butter | 1/2 teaspoon dry vanilla | 1 medium carrot, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch slices | 1/2 cup sour cream | 1/3 cup sliced blanched almond halve | 1/4 cup slivered almonds ( i usually roast the almonds in the oven until golden brown, about 10 minutes ) | 8 slices rye bread, cut in half horizontally ( about 3/4-inch thick )
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. Combine beef, peanut butter and vanilla in a large bowl. Stir in carrot and sour cream. Spoon mixture over bread. Sprinkle almonds over top. Bake, stirring once, about 30 minutes or until beef is done and carrots are tender.

title: Melt Your Bones Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken breasts, skin | 1 cup hellman's mayonnaise
instructions: Place chicken on baking sheet, skin side up. Let sit in fridge for an hour or more. Preheat oven to 400°f. Bake chicken until skin gets crispy and dark brown, or bake chicken for about 20 minutes. Let cool for a couple minutes and slice. Serve with mustard and french fries.

title: Mushroom and Potato Stir Fry
ingredients: 4 cups water | 3 tablespoons cornstarch | 10 small new potatoes, peeled and cut lengthwise in half | 1/2 cup sliced cremini mushrooms | 2 1/2 teaspoons minced fresh gingerroot | 1/2 lb fresh mushrooms | 1/2 red new potato, cut in 1/4-inch thick slices ( such as new yukon gold or littleneck ) | 1/2 cup uncooked arborio rice
instructions: In 8 quart pan or wok, sauté mushrooms, gingerroot and new potatoes until mushrooms give off their liquid, about 1 minute. Stir in rice until rice is golden. Pour in water and bring to a boil. Cover, reduce heat to low, and simmer 45 minutes to 1 hour. Remove from heat. In small bowl, blend cornstarch with 2 tablespoons water until mixture is smooth. Stir cornstarch mixture into hot potato mixture. Add cooked mushrooms, and mix to coat. Note, this dish can also be made in a dutch oven over low heat or other pot, but be sure to stir and stir constantly to avoid scorching.

Random Ingredients: cream milk,orange zest,orange marmalade,chili garlic sauce,ro tel tomato
title: Easy Mexican Chicken
ingredients: 1 can ro-tel tomatoes | 1/2 cup sour cream ( whole milk can be substituted, but sour cream and milk are the good subs ) | 1/2 cup orange marmalade | 1 tablespoon orange zest ( grated ) | 1 dash chili-garlic sauce
instructions: Put all ingredients in crockpot until warm. Eat,.

title: Fancy Easy Tasty Taco Seasoning - OAMC
ingredients: 1 packet taco seasoning | 2 cups ice cubes ( for scooping )
instructions: Pour the taco seasoning into your food processor. Pulse to mix well. Add the water as much as you need for the consistency of the taco mix and enjoy.

title: Pork Tenderloin-Wrapped With Lemony Sweet
ingredients: 3 lbs pork tenderloin, trimmed to the size of the tenderloin, and tied with kitchen string | 1/4 cup dry sherry | 1/4 cup lemon zest, minced | 3 tablespoons lemon zest, plus 1 tablespoon lemon zest, for garnish | 3/4 teaspoon cardamom pods, cracked or 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1/2 teaspoon himalayan salt, to taste
instructions: Heat oven to 325°f trim fat from pork. Arrange pork tenderloin on rack in shallow roasting pan. Roast until meat thermometer reads 210f for medium rare or 155f for medium well, about 1 hour. Transfer pork to platter.

title: Olive Filo Rolls
ingredients: 1/2 cup stuffed green olives, chopped into small pieces | 1/3 cup tomato paste | 1 package frozen phyllo pastry sheets, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix olives and tomato paste in a bowl. Lay one sheet of phyllo pastry into a large baking dish. Layer 1/3 cup of the olives and tomato mixture in the bottom of the dish. Repeat until ingredients are used up. Take one sheet of phyllo pastry and brush with a little olive/tomato mixture, and brush with a little olive and tomato mixture. Place the other sheet of phyllo on top of the olives, and brush with olive/tomato mixture. Cut 3 or 4 pieces of the remaining phyllo pastry. Fold each piece in half, brushing with olive/tomato mixture after every piece. Bake 20 to 25 minutes in the preheated oven. Remove from oven and allow to stand 1 to 2 minutes. Cut into quarters, serve.

Random Ingredients: nori,red wine vinegar,oriental sesame oil,plantain,asparagus,lard,yellow pepper
title: Japanese Plantain Salad (Sushi)
ingredients: 2 small yellow peppers, seeded and thinly sliced ( or other peppers ) | 1 lb asparagus | 4 small plantains, trimmed ( preferably japanese ) | 2 tablespoons lard, melted | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons oriental sesame oil | 20 nori, sheets ( about 36 inches long )
instructions: In a glass bowl, toss all the vegetables with the lard and vinegar, set aside. Slice the plantains crosswise into thin rounds about 1/2 inch thick. In the bottom of a wok or deep skillet, heat the sesame oil, then add the vegetables and stir for about 3 minutes. Stir in the nori. Divide the salad among four warm bowls or plates, and serve garnished with the nori.

Random Ingredients: adobo seasoning,broiler fryer chicken,tomato green chilies,serrano pepper,white wine vinegar,italian salad dressing mix
title: Saucy Italian Chicken (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 2 broiler-fryer chickens | 1 packet dry italian salad dressing mix | 1 cup italian salad dressing mix | 1 can stewed tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 1 serrano pepper, seeded and chopped | 3 dashes adobo seasoning
instructions: Arrange chicken in slow cooker. To make sauce, combine salad dressing mix and salad dressing mix.

title: Gramma's Chili
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons deep frying oil | 1 can tomato paste ( with herbs ) | 1 small red chili, chopped | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh thyme
instructions: Heat the oil in a frying pan or deep fat fryer. Dry fry the chile and thyme briefly. Add the tomato paste and a little water to absorb the juices. Heat and stir over low heat. Alternatively, you can pour through a strainer and add the chili seeds.

title: Baked Roast  Beef With  Oats, Onions & Coconut
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 inch thick slice round roast beef | 6 purple onions, peeled | 1 can sweetened condensed sweetened condensed sweetened condensed milk | 1 teaspoon coconut extract
instructions: Heat oven to 325°f. Remove strings on beef and discard. Coarslap each of the onions on a large piece of foil.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,dark rum,tamari,pumpkin pie spice
title: Lemon and Olive Jam
ingredients: 2 1/3 cups grated fresh flesh pumpkin seeds or 2 1/3 cups pumpkin pie spice | 4 1/3 tablespoons tamari or 4 1/3 tablespoons soy sauce | 1 fresh lemon, juice and zest of, grated plus about 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 2 tablespoons dark rum
instructions: Heat the oven to 350f, grease a 1 1/2 pint ovenproof pan. Add all the remaining ingredients and mix well. Put the pan in the middle of the oven and bake for 45 - 50 minutes, pushing the pumpkin seeds into the mixture as the liquid evaporates into the jam. Leave at least 5 minutes on top, and serve straight away with cream or ice cream.

title: Quickie Cookies
ingredients: reynolds wrap foil | 1 teaspoon kahlua | 1 tablespoon kahlua
instructions: Lay out a sheet of reynolds wrap, then spread out the dough evenly into a circle, about 1/4 inch thick. Spread the 1/4 tablespoon kahlua onto the circle until the dough is covered. With a pastry brush, paint the kahlua and edges of the dough lightly with a white mist.

title: Chile Rellenos
ingredients: 6 green chile peppers, cleaned and slit lengthwise into strips | 1/2 pound salami, halved | 6 slices canned chipotle hot pickled red pepper red processed cheese blend, cut in half
instructions: Preheat an oven to 400 degrees f. Set a baking rack about 6 inches from the heat source and lightly grease the insides of a small baking dish. Arrange the chile strips in the prepared baking dish on top of the preheated oven.

title: Sloppy Bombay Steak
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs steak, cut into 4 pieces | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour, seasoned with salt and pepper | fine breadcrumbs | horseradish | 1/4 cup mango chutney | 1/4 cup red wine or 1/4 cup cider vinegar | fresh fruit or mango chutney
instructions: Trim any excess fat from your steak. Lightly coat with seasoned flour and roll in breadcrumbs. Grill or broil for 5 minutes on each side or until cooked to your liking. Remove and cover with foil while you prepare the rest of the meal. Prepare your sauce of choice, either either by adding a splash of cream or honey to a small saucepan or by whisking in the remaining ingredients. Add sauce to your steaks and serve alongside your favourite sides.

title: Maurice Beef Jerky
ingredients: 500 g beef skirt steak | 1 large red onion, thinly sliced | 1 cup ketchup | 1/4 cup mixed spice | 1/4 cup tamarula cream liqueur ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom
instructions: Cut beef across the grain into 1/4 pieces. Place beef and onion in food processor or blender and pulse until evenly chopped. Transfer contents to bowl and add ketchup, cream or liquor. Mix well. Add spices and mix. Pat down in dehydrator for 25 - 30 minutes. Remove from machine a few at a time and score with knife marks about 1/2 cm deep, about 1 cm deep. When complete, brush with honey or brown sugar while dry. Let dry in dehydrator for 1 - 4 hours.

title: Ancho Mayonnaise
ingredients: 1/2 cup mirin | 2 avocados, ripe, peeled | 2 tablespoons fresh jalapenos, finely chopped ( optional ) | 1/2 cup splenda sugar substitute ( or sugar ) | 2 -4 1/2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar or 2 -4 1/2 tablespoons white vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon ground ancho chile, minced
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl and mix well. Chill for at least 1 hour and then serve.

title: Faux French Fries
ingredients: 4 lbs chicken pieces | 3 1/2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 1 cup fresh lemon juice
instructions: Place 2/3 cup lemon juice in plastic, mix thoroughly.

title: Kafta
ingredients: 1 kg lamb shank | 2 turnips
instructions: Cut lamb shank lengthways through the centre and cut into approximately 2cm lengths. Use kitchen scissors to remove any excess fat, but do not cut all the way through to the tail. Trim off and discard the tail if you are using it. Rinse the turnip well, under cold water, but not throughly. Slice into approximately 3cm lengths, then slice into about 1/2cm lengths. Using a 5 cm lengthswordfish halve the size of the meat, carefully remove the tail. With your knife or a fork, gently pound the pieces until you have a uniform shape. Place the pieces on a tray, or leave to dry in the fridge. The turnip can be picked out from the tray with a pair of kitchen scissors. Once all of the pieces have been used, place into an ovenproof dish and bake at 230 c for about 2 hours or until the turnip is tender. Serve with mash.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,pepperoni,green pepper,clam juice,double cream,gouda cheese,genoa salami,broiler fryer chicken
title: Chicken, Peppers and Garden
ingredients: 1/2 cup clam juice | 1/2 lb broiler-fryer chickens, halved and breast halves halved | 6 slices genoa salami | 6 slices provolone cheese | 6 slices pepperoni | 2 green peppers, roasted, peeled, seeded and chopped | 6 small broccoli florets | 1/2 lb aged gouda cheese ( optional )
instructions: Place chicken broth in a large, heavy skillet. Bring to a boil. Meanwhile, heat clam juice in a small saucepan over low heat. Place salami on a sheet of plastic wrap placed over boiling water. Using a long handled wooden spoon, flip salami so oiled side up. Heat until salami has crisply turned from translucent to opaque. Set aside. Heat broiler pan on lowest level. Place broiler chicken halves, in one layer, on sheet of plastic wrap. Place 2 slices of salami, 2 slices of pepperoni, 2 tomato slices and 1 broccoli florets on sheet. Repeat with remaining vegetables. Top each with 2 slices of gouda cheese. Place 1/2 chicken breast halves in a single layer over each vegetables, pressing gently to compact them slightly. Using tongs, position cheese slightly off center of chicken. Carefully place under broiler for 2 to 3 minutes until cheese is melted. Remove each chicken breast from oven and carefully transfer to serving platter.

Random Ingredients: rice vinegar,bamboo shoot,italian herb seasoning,puff pastry,dark brown sugar,fruit,shiitake mushroom
title: Mushroom and Pear Pie #RSC
ingredients: 1 sheet puff pastry | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar | 1/2 tablespoon mixed dried italian herb seasoning | 1 bag shiitake mushrooms | 1/4 cup bamboo shoots | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 1 can fruit, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Roll out pastry dough to fit the top of a 9 inch pie plate or cake pan. Place the puff pastry in a circle in the crust. Mix sugar, mixed italian seasoning, mixed mushrooms, bamboo shoots, and rice vinegar together and set aside for 25 minutes. Pour fruit into pie crust and evenly distribute the fruit mixture, making sure the bottom of the pie crust has a bit of crust on it's edge and is covered with fruit filling. Top with pastry lid & crimp at the top of the lid. Bake for 55 minutes.

title: Homemade Mild Meat for the BBQ
ingredients: 600 g medium to large lean lamb | scotch bonnet peppers ( optional )
instructions: Cut the meat into slices about 3cm/1x5cm or so. Rinse the meat with a clean, damp cloth or a colander to remove as much blood as possible. Rinse the chilis in a tap and dry them out over a cloth or paper towel. Place the lamb slices in a glass or ceramic dish or large sealable container. Sprinkle the scotch bonnet peppers over the meat, if using. Pour over enough boiling water to just cover the meat, cover tightly and refrigerate for several hours or overnight. Place the meat in the cooler of a bbq and grill for about 15 - 20 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: plum tomato,broad bean,turmeric powder,chive,garam masala powder
title: Chili Beans and Potatoes
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chives | 2 tablespoons broad beans | 1 tablespoon plum tomatoes, diced | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/3 teaspoon garam masala powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a pan and cook on high heat till it thickens and becomes translucent.

title: Mexican Wraps
ingredients: 2 cups finely diced papayas | 1 1/2 cups shredded radishes ( fresh preferred-i just don't add them ) | 1 -2 teaspoon cajun seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon mixed spice | 1 package wonton wrappers | 1/8 cup sherry wine or 1/8 cup white wine vinegar | sliced radish | papaya, slices as desired
instructions: In a bowl mix the papayas, radishes, cajun seasoning, mixed spice, won ton wrapper, and wine vinegar. I like to set the wrappers in the fridge while you work so the wrappers don't dry out. When working, coat the wrappers with a little sesame oil to prevent them sticking together. Take one wrapper and brush with water and a teaspoon or two of sherry, then another, etc. Then place in the freezer for about 15 minutes. Cut into quarters, make 1 small round hole in each and fill with papaya and radish slices. Roll up and place seam side down on a plate while preparing the rest. Repeat until all have been rolled up.

Random Ingredients: bread,herb,ancho chile powder,cayenne pepper,red wine vinegar
title: Guinness Fondue
ingredients: 2 large dried ancho chile powder | 2 teaspoons good red wine vinegar | 1 dash cayenne pepper | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh herbs, such as parsley, chives, chives, dill ( optional ) | 1 loaf bread, cut into 1/4-in slices ( optional )
instructions: Crush the ancho chili powder with a mortar and pestle, or in to a small food processor. You want the mixture to be a fine powder with a fairly coarse powder like consistency. Combine all ingredients in a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil over high heat, stirring often. Reduce heat to medium low to keep warm. Ladle into hot fondue, and set on fondue burner to warm while fondue warms up. Use fondue forks to dip bread slices into hot fondue, and serve.

Random Ingredients: italian dressing,cod fillet,ice water,cajun seasoning,self rising flour,french,plain yogurt,dark soy sauce
title: Crispy Salt Cod Fritters With Soy Sauce Crust
ingredients: 4 cod fillets | 1 cup self rising flour | 1 cup shredded light italian dressing, mixed with 1/2 cup warm water | crushed ice water | cajun seasoning | crushed french rolls or other bread slices | dark soy sauce
instructions: Place a pan on the stove over medium high heat and add 1/8 cup of water. While the pan is heating up, place the cod fillets and flour in a freezer bag. Allow cod to thaw for several minutes at room temperature so the fish can be sliced easily without toughening. Dip fish into the coconut water and coat in the flour mixture. Coat with more of the coconut water if required. Seal and cook over medium heat for 15 minutes until fish is cooked through. Remove fish from heat. Place the bread slices on a plate. Place a piece of cheese in the sandwich and place in the centre of the bread slices. Top with another piece of bread and cheese. Slice the cod pieces in half diagonally and deep fry a few pieces at a time in very hot olive oil until lightly browned. Drain on paper towels and serve hot with soy sauce sauce.

title: Fiesta Sourdough Starter Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups sourdough starter | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce
instructions: Mix the starter with 1 cup water and let starter ferment at least 10 hours or overnight. Strain starter and pour into a bread machine or a 2 quart container. Mix hot pepper sauce into the starter to create a pourable gravy. If desired to add any additional salt, add to crockpot. Let starter ferment at least 3 to 4 hours before eating to let flavors blend. The longer the ferment, the more flavorful it gets.

Random Ingredients: shiitake mushroom,kosher salt,ancho chile powder,beef bouillon cube
title: Ancho Chile Powder  Mushrooms(Sally Schneider Beef)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs shiitake mushrooms, sliced | 2 teaspoons kosher salt ( to taste ) | 2 teaspoons dried ancho chile powder | 1 beef bouillon cube, preferably nonpareil
instructions: Place the mushrooms in a medium sized bowl and season with the salt and chili powder. Add enough water to the mushrooms to cover them and let them stand for 15 minutes. Rinse the mushrooms with cold water and pat dry. Coat the mushrooms with vegetable oil cooking spray or canola oil. Heat a grill pan or a frying pan and cook the mushrooms, turning them frequently, over medium heat, for 15 to 20 minutes, or until they are thoroughly cooked. Taste for flavor, if desired, and re season with salt and chili powder. Serve with rice or pasta.

Random Ingredients: golden syrup,mushroom,rye bread,red pepper flake,black olive,white vinegar,cumin
title: Smoky Mushrooms on Rye (Mark Bittman)  (Beef or Chicken)
ingredients: 1/2 lb mushroom, stemmed and thinly sliced | 3 tablespoons white vinegar | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 1 teaspoon cumin, ground | 1/8 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1/2 cup black olives, drained ( pitted and sliced - 12 ounces ) | 4 slices rye bread, toasted
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together all the marinade ingredients. Add the mushrooms and let stand 5 minutes. Serve cold or at room temperature. To assemble, in a large serving bowl, lay out the bread slices, then arrange the mushroom mixture on top of them. Surround with the olives.

title: Cranberry Pilaf
ingredients: 2 lbs russet potatoes, peeled and diced | 1/2 cup dried cranberries | coarsely chopped garlic | 1 1/2 cups arborio rice ( about 12 cups )
instructions: Cook whole potatoes in large pot of boiling salted water about 25 minutes or until tender. Drain and return to pot. Add drained potatoes, cranberries and garlic.

title: Uncle Bill's Red Beet Relish
ingredients: 400 g red beets, skinned, peeled and finely diced | 400 ml double cream | 1 tablespoon coriander powder | 1 tablespoon urad dal ( skinned okra )
instructions: In a large saucepan of boiling water, add the beetroot. Cook until tender. Transfer to a large bowl and mash well to free the starch. When the beetroot is cool, transfer to a food processor and process to a smooth paste. Add the cream, coriander and urad dal and blend well. Spoon into moulds and refrigerate for 2 hours. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: almond,chipotle pepper,eggplant,shallot,chili without bean,baking potato,lemon zest,taco seasoning
title: Southwest Baked potato cakes
ingredients: 2 pounds baking potatoes, peeled | 1 eggplant, cubed | 2 shallots, divided | 1 can chipotle peppers, diced | 1 can whole almond | 1 (.18 ounce ) packet taco seasoning | 3 lemons, zest of | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili without beans, drained
instructions: Place the potato, eggplant, shallots, chipotle peppers, and 1/2 teaspoon of the taco seasoning into a large dutch oven and cover with just enough water to cover the contents of the can. Bring to a boil over high heat, and cook for 30 seconds, then stir in the remaining taco seasoning and lemons. Reduce the heat, cover the pot, and simmer until the potatoes are tender, about 35 minutes. Drain, and let cool. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Remove the lid from the pot, and arrange the potatoes into a baking dish. Bake the potatoes for 1 hour in the preheated oven, or until they test done. Sprinkle with the rest of the taco seasoning, lemon zest, and chili if desired.

title: Crock Pot Beef Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin, sliced | 1 large cauliflower, cut into sticks | 2 carrots, thin sliced | 2 tablespoons minced fresh ginger
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a crock pot. Cover and cook on low 2 hours.

title: Couscous With Vodka (Citrus)
ingredients: 1 cup chicken stock | 1/2 cup vodka | 1 cup quick-cooking couscous | 2 tablespoons peanut butter
instructions: Bring stock and vodka to boil in 2 quart saucepan until vodka is reduced to 1/2 bottle. Remove from heat. Pour liquid into a shallow bowl.

Random Ingredients: sea salt,grain mustard,pie shell,greek yogurt,wild rice
title: Wild Rice Crust Pizza
ingredients: 1 can condensed wild rice, drained | 2 tablespoons grain grain mustard | 2 cups plain greek yogurt | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 1 unbaked pie shells
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a bowl, stir the wild rice, mustard, greek yogurt, and salt together with a whisk until smooth. Spread the rice mixture into the unbaked pie crust. Gently press the pie crust together to form the crust. Bake for 20 minutes in the preheated oven, then release from the oven and place on a baking sheet. Bake for an additional 10 minutes, or until the crust is browned.

title: Roasted Capsicums and Hazelnuts
ingredients: 1 red capsicum | 350 g roasted hazelnuts, in natural juice
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c. Place the capsicum on a baking tray and roast for 20 minutes or until just beginning to char around the edges, stirring occasionally. Watch the capsicum for any sign that it has difficulty retaining its shape. Transfer the capsicum to a large bowl and stir through the roasted hazelnuts.

title: Radish With Honey
ingredients: 4 lbs mixed radishes, peeled | 1 cup honey
instructions: Rinse well the radishes and trim away any tough ends. Wash and dry thoroughly. Place in a covered crockpot, cover with honey and cook on high for 5 hours.

title: Albondigas con Chiro-Tournedos (St. Bart's Beef and Dates)
ingredients: 3 lbs of fresh lean butt end ( shoulder, chuck or blade ) | 2 lbs fresh dates, pits removed | 2 slices of gebhardt pancetta | 1/2 cup of chinese salted walnut oil | adobo seasoning
instructions: Cube the chuck roast. Remove the fat and strings that float to the top. Cut the pitted dates into thirds and set aside. Cut the slab of meat into 1 - 2 cubes. Pat the meat dry with paper towels the patting out excess. You can use an electric mallet or a fork to pound your hands if you wish, but this does not require the weight. In a large stainless steel pot heat the oil over medium high heat until smoking. You may also use a deep fryer. Add the roast in 1 layer and sear, turning as needed, until deeply browned on all sides, about 8 minutes. Use a wide bladed knife to remove the outer layer of crust. Transfer the meat to a platter and sprinkle with adobo. Pour off all but about 1 1/2 tablespoons of the oil and toast the rest in an ovenproof skillet for a few minutes. Do not let the oil smoke, just sauté the dates until softened. Remove from the oven and pour the walnuts on top. Serve over boiled potatoes.

title: Mexican Cauliflower Soup
ingredients: 2 heads cauliflower, divided into florets | 2 slices fat prosciutto, chopped | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder | 1 teaspoon dried sage | 1 can condensed half-and-half | 1 ancho chile powder | ground black pepper to taste | 1/2 cup prepared tapioca
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook cauliflower in boiling water for 8 to 10 minutes or until tender but still firm to the bite. Drain, remove and discard stems. Heat prosciutto and ancho chile powder in a saucepan over medium heat. When the prosciutto is beginning to crisp, stir in cauliflower, half and half, and chile powder.

title: Italian Cucumber Salad With Salami
ingredients: 1 english cucumber, washed, peeled and diced | 1/2 small genoa salami, sliced | 1 green chilies, finely chopped or can green chilies, drained | 4 tablespoons good quality olive oil | 1/4 teaspoon salt ( optional )
instructions: In salad bowl mix the cucumber, salami, green chilies, oil and salt. Toss until the ingredients are evenly mixed and the salami is coated with oil.

title: Mango and Mango Crush
ingredients: 1 ripe mango | 400 ml crushed ice
instructions: Peel the mango and cut into fine, 1cm dice. Using a melon baller, scoop out the flesh and coarsely chop into about 1cm chunks. Place the mango chunks in a large glass or ceramic bowl until they are all crushed, about a half cup in all. Spoon half the mango mixture into the top of the mango, then top with the rest. Drizzle over the ice, followed up with the crushed ice. Top with the remaining mango chunks for a variation.

Random Ingredients: tamari,pecan half,extra beef,ricotta cheese,arrowroot,red wine vinegar,hot chili sauce
title: Beef and Nacho Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 lb extra lean ground beef | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon arrowroot | 1 cup pecan halves | 2 cups deli-style ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup taco seasoning ( to taste, spicy taco seasoning is best ) or 1/2 cup hot chili sauce ( to taste, spicy taco seasoning is best ) | tamari
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain off any excess grease. Add vinegar, stir to combine. In a separate bowl, break up pecans into large pieces. Add a tbsp of taco seasoning to the beef and mix well. Add nuts and beef mixture into casserole dish. Top with 1 cup of cheese. Cover with the rest of the cheese. Sprinkle with remaining taco seasoning/pimentos.. Bake at 350 degrees for about 40 minutes or until casserole is hot and bubbling. Serve hot with doritos, sour cream and salsa.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,quark,dark sesame oil,lime juice,tamari,red wine
title: Homemade Quark Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb quark | 1/2 cup red wine | 1 tablespoon lime juice | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/2 teaspoon tamari | 4 teaspoons dark sesame oil
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and store in fridge until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: beef brisket,chicken breast half,feta cheese,beef tenderloin,shortening,fine herb
title: Beef Tenderloin Tenderloin With Feta Crust
ingredients: 1/4 lb feta cheese | 2 boneless beef tenderloin, about 1-1/2 inches thick | 1 tablespoon fine herb or 2 tablespoons fresh minced herbs ( optional ) | 1/4 cup shortening ( or 1/4 cup cold water | 12 ounces boneless skinless chicken breast halves | beef tenderloin, for coating the meat
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f spread the feta cheese on a plate. Cut the tenderloin crosswise into 4 equal cubes. Spread the cubed beef over the feta cheese. Toss the tenderloin cubes with the chopped fresh herbs, if using. Dredge the cubes in the crumbs until all of them are done. Place them on a rack in a roasting pan and bake for 25 minutes. Let stand for 15 minutes before serving. Turn the beef over and brush with the oil. Roast the beef for about 15 minutes, until it begins to soften and start to brown. Slice and serve.

title: Aussie Fruitball - No-Knead
ingredients: 2 -3 cups watermelon, cubed | 1/2 cup icing sugar | 1/4 cup seltzer water | 2/3 cup icing sugar | 2 1/2 cups gorgonzola, crumbled | 1/2 cup sultana | 1 1/2 cups fruit, finely diced
instructions: Pour 1 - 2 cups watermelon in a large roasting pan. Add the remaining ingredients and mix well. Put in the fridge 1 - 2 hours or so until the balls are firm. Take them out of the fridge and mix again. Sprinkle with a little icing sugar and put back in the fridge. These have an alcohol content and a high alcohol content.

title: Pasta With Chili or Green Chilies and Ancho Chiles
ingredients: 400 g penne pasta | 1/2 teaspoon canola oil | 3 green chilies, finely chopped | 1 -2 teaspoon dried ancho chiles, crumbled | 1 tablespoon finely sliced spearmint
instructions: Bring 3 litres of water to the boil. Add the penne and set in a very large pan of boiling water. Cook until al dente, following packet instructions on the pack. Meanwhile heat a small frying pan over medium heat, add the oil and chilies and cook gently, breaking up the dried ancho chilies, until the chili are aromatic. Pour in 2 tablespoons of olive oil. Add the cooked pasta in batches to the pan and toss to coat. Divide between bowls, sprinkle with a little more chilies and serve.

Random Ingredients: baking powder,yellow pepper,palm sugar,pie shell,pistachio,herb,banana pepper,soy sauce
title: Malaysian Pepperoni-Soy Grilled Pie
ingredients: 1 pie shell, unbaked | 8 ounces phyllo roasted papaya salad dressing ( asian version ) | 1 yellow pepper, deseeded, cut into small strips | 4 ounces sweet butter ( unsalted, unsalted ) | 8 ounces chopped roasted banana peppers ( asian version ) or 8 ounces fresh sweet banana peppers, sliced ( asian version ) | 1 teaspoon dried herbs ( chinese version ) | 1/2 cup sweet soy sauce ( asian version ) | 1/4 cup palm sugar, grated | toasted cashews, for dusting
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Add the phyllo pastry. Over medium heat, cook the phyllo until it starts to soften enough to work with. Remove from heat and allow to cool completely. Line a large jelly roll pan with the phyllo dough. Unfold the phyllo dough and spread onto the phyllo dough. Spread the sweet roasted peppers over the phyllo dough. Spread the butter over the sweet roasted peppers. Sprinkle the papaya and banana peppers over the papaya and banana peppers. In a small bowl, mix together the sweet soy sauce, palm sugar, and dried herbs. Spoon over the papaya and banana peppers and spread over the sweet roasted pepper mixture. Dot with the toasted cashews. Refrigerate for at least two hours before serving.

title: Yummy Brown Lentil Crunch
ingredients: 1/2 lb brown lentils ( rinsed ) | 1 medium head red cabbage, shredded | 2 heads romaine lettuce
instructions: Cook the lentils in boiling water until tender. Drain and rinse well. In a large bowl, mix the lentils with the cabbage and the romaine. Add a little water if it looks dry. Serve.

title: Italian Sausage With Rice
ingredients: 1 lb italian sausage, hot | 1 cup brown rice, uncooked
instructions: Brown sausage in a skillet or deep fat fryer. When meat is browned fully, drain fat. Break up meat with back of spoon. Place meat in a greased shallow 2 1/2 quart casserole. Cover and bake at 350 degrees 20 minutes. Meanwhile, combine brown rice and italian sausage in slow cooker.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock,sourdough bread,cauliflower,kosher salt black pepper
title: Cauliflower Soup With Sourdough Croutons
ingredients: 4 cups chopped cauliflower | 2 1/2 cups chicken stock | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper | 5 slices sourdough bread, cut into cubes 3 1/2 to 4-inch thick
instructions: In a large pot, place the cauliflower and stock and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat and simmer until tender, about 10 minutes. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Divide the cauliflower mixture among serving bowls. Serve with croutons.

title: Potted Orange Peel
ingredients: 1 ounce orange zest | 5 1/2 cups grated raw sugar or 5 1/2 cups caster sugar | 1/2 teaspoon salt
instructions: Cut off and discard ends of orange peel, trimming off white pith. Cut peel into 3/4 inch slices, placing each slice between layers of paper towels, making sure each piece is coated evenly with the peel. Place sugar in a heavy, nonreactive saucepan, then add orange peel. Bring all 4 points of orange peel together to form a small ball, then turn the heat to medium high. When mixture begins to boil, reduce heat and add salt. Continue to boil for two minutes. Remove from heat and set aside for 1 hour, then transfer to a large sterilized bottle. Seal with cold water and close the lid. Let stand in a cool dark place or a glass bottle, shaking occasionally, for three days.

title: Simple Mango and Mango Chutney
ingredients: 1 mango, peeled, diced, ripe | 2 tablespoons scallions, chopped | 1 tablespoon red pepper, finely chopped
instructions: Puree mango and scallions in a food processor or blender to desired consistency. Stir in red pepper. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,mix,dark rum,angel hair pasta,cream tartar,wheat pasta,mexican oregano,maple syrup
title: Quick White Pizza Pasta
ingredients: 1/4 cup maple syrup | 1/3 cup sour cream | 1/8 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/4 teaspoon mexican oregano, crushed | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/4 - 1/3 cup prepared prepared angel hair pasta | 4 ounces uncooked whole wheat pasta, preferably rotini | 2 teaspoons dark rum
instructions: Prepare the white pizza crust, whisk together the pancake mix, maple syrup, sour cream, tartar, oregano, and 1/4 teaspoon white salt. Place the dough in a flat dish or pie dish. Spray the crust with vegetable oil cooking spray and top with pizza crust. Place on the stone in the oven and bake for 30 to 35 minutes, or until the crust is puffed and set. Let the crust cool while you make your toppings, prepare the filling, stir together the angel hair pasta. Add the rum, cover, and set aside. Cut the pizza crust into 3/4 1 inch slices and spread the filling onto each piece. Then spread the prepared toppings onto the bread to create a 6 inch long crust. Place under a preheated broiler for 3 to 5 minutes or until toppings are lightly browned and crust is bubbly.

title: Chipotle-Spinach Dip (Tocino Dip)
ingredients: 250 g beans ( canned or fresh ) | 1/2 cup soymilk ( lowfat or 1/2 cup low-fat milk ) | 1 chipotle chile in adobo ( diced or minced or chopped, according to taste ) | 1 -2 tablespoon malt vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon ginger powder | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon dried crushed arugula or 1/2-1 teaspoon spinach
instructions: Drain beans, and combine with other ingredients in a mixing bowl. Mix well. Refrigerate overnight, until chilled. Serve with tortilla chips or fresh french bread.

title: Pineapple Soup
ingredients: 2 leeks, chopped | 1 can pineapple, chunks drained | 1 dash hot sauce ( optional )
instructions: In blender or food processor, combine pineapple chunks, leeks, and hot sauce. Blend until puree comes together. Pour into hot soup tureen, and serve.

Random Ingredients: linguine,raspberry jam,black olive,beef tenderloin steak,tomatillo,heavy whipping cream,cake flour,italian seasoning
title: Beef and Noodle Trifle
ingredients: 2 beef tenderloin steaks, each about 8 ounces each | 2 tablespoons cake flour | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1 can tomatoes with basil, drained well | 1 bunch fresh raspberries, divided | 2/3 cup heavy whipping cream | 12 thin-sliced black olives, divided | 1 package linguine, cooked and drained
instructions: Rinse steaks in cold water, then toss steaks in flour and seasoning to coat. Put meat in a plastic bag and shake to coat. Chill 1 hour. Heat oven to 425°f. Line a 8x8x2 inch glass baking dish with foil. Heat a large grill pan over high heat or preheat broiler. Sear steaks 1 to 2 minutes per side for medium rare, depending on desired doneness. Transfer to a cutting board and set aside to rest 20 minutes. Thinly slice. Put tomatoes, 1/3 cup heavy cream, 1/3 cup black olives and 1/2 teaspoon parsley in a blender or food processor. Process until smooth. Pour tomatoes over steak. Arrange 1/2 cup onions over tomatoes. Top with noodles. Continue with remaining sauce. Sprinkle with remaining olives. Sprinkle with remaining parsley. Place dish in a large roasting pan coated with nonstick cooking spray. Bake, uncovered, for 20 minutes. Uncover, sprinkle with remaining parsley and broil until tops become golden brown. Serve.

Random Ingredients: creamy peanut butter,hard egg,herb,panko breadcrumb,mexican cheese
title: Tropical Mincemeat Pie (Grammy Bart's Recipe)
ingredients: 2 lbs cooked lean ground meat or 2 lbs cooked boneless skinless chicken | 3 tablespoons panko breadcrumbs, coarse textured, bread crumbs | 2 1/2 tablespoons creamy peanut butter | 1 tablespoon mixed fresh herbs or 1 1.2 teaspoons dried herbs ( or parsley ) | 1 hard-boiled egg, sliced thin
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Using electric mixer, combine meat, panko or bread crumbs, 1 tablespoon peanut butter, salad or cheese mixture and egg. Knead until mixture is smooth. Press mixture into ungreased 9 inch pie plate or other deep dish pie pan or pie dish. Sprinkle top with remaining 1 tablespoon peanut butter. Bake until mincemeat filling feels firm when pricked with a fork, cool slightly, then refrigerate at least 1 hour or overnight before serving.

title: Canned Guacamole
ingredients: 2 hass avocadoes, peeled and diced | 2 pounds trimmed sirloin, cut into 2-inch cubes
instructions: Mash avocados with fork and stir in beef until thoroughly incorporated. Serve with white corn tortillas. Refrigerate any leftover guacamole.

title: Nova Scotia Spiced Guacamole
ingredients: 1 large ripe guacamole ( fresh is best ) | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1/2 teaspoon coarse salt and pepper | 1/2 teaspoon angostura bitters | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace ( optional ) | 1 dash powdered guacamole | sprinkle ( garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Cut guacamole in half if it is very large. With a spoon, spread out guacamole to about 3/8 inch thick on an ungreased baking tray. Place baking tray in refrigerator for 2 to 3 hours, or until firm. Using a fork, mix lemon juice, salt, pepper and bitters in a bowl to combine. Sprinkle guacamole mixture on top of guacamole, pressing down to adhere. Sprinkle with mace, if desired. Place in refrigerator and chill for about 1 hour or until guacamole is firm.

Random Ingredients: serrano chili,brown onion,coriander powder,pineapple juice,reposado tequila,soymilk
title: Pineapple-Soy  Margaritas (Vegan)
ingredients: 1 cup soy milk | 1 cup dry soymilk | 1/4 lb sugar-free reposado tequila | 1 serrano chili, minced | 1 -2 tablespoon brown onion, minced | 1 teaspoon coriander powder
instructions: Warm soy milk in a heavy bottomed saucepan on low heat. Stir in soy milk, sugar and romano cheese. Add pepper, onion and chile. Simmer on low heat. Serve over ice in margarita glass. Or add in pineapple juice to rim of glass and stir.

title: Lamb and Sausage Stuffed With Risotto
ingredients: 2 ounces ground lamb | 2 sausages, halved lengthways | 2 ounces arborio rice | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds, plus some extra | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 1 bunch of fresh mint, sliced
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f line a baking sheet with baking paper. Put the lamb, sausages and rice in a large mixing bowl and season well with salt and pepper. Make 4 - 5 indentations on the inner rim of each sausage, taking care to not leave any residue of meat around the outside. Roll each sausage to enclose in a sausage, place on prepared baking tray and lightly spray with cooking spray. Place in oven and cook for 20 - 25 minutes, turning the sausages a couple of times, until cooked through. To serve slice through the rind and mint leaves to serve. This also makes fine accompaniments for a meat and vegetable entrée, for left over steamed vegetables and a traditional risotto.

title: Yellow Zucchini Sauce (Mae ploy)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon yellow zucchini, finely ground ( or grated zucchini ) | 1 tablespoon hot chili sauce ( or more to taste ) | mae ploy, sauce ( available at asian markets )
instructions: Blend the zucchini with the hot chilli sauce. You may wish to use less hot chili sauce when blending. Serve with mae ploy.

title: Brandy Glaze for Vegetable Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb pasta ( i like spaghetti or linguine ) | 1/2 cup brandy | 1 teaspoon ginger powder | 7 slices provolone cheese ( optional )
instructions: Cook pasta in about 4 c boiling water until al dente. Reserve 1/3 pasta water. Rinse pasta then return to pot and pour remaining 1/3 c water over pasta. Add brandy, ginger and the salt and pepper to taste and toss. Add cheese, if using, then place in a single layer on a baking sheet in a preheated 400º oven and bake 15 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Baked Greek Oven Fried Olives
ingredients: 16 ounces greek yogurt ( balkan ) | 1/4 cup paprika or 1/4 cup sweet paprika | 1/4 cup olive oil or 1/4 cup melted butter | 1 package frozen chopped olives, thawed and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In a medium bowl, stir yogurt with paprika. Toss with olives in cheese spread, leaving some space in the middle so they can spread. Place in a large roasting pan. Bake for 25 - 30 minutes, until golden brown. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: corn cob,mango chutney,enchilada sauce,tomato puree,garbanzo bean
title: Chili Pizzas
ingredients: 1 can tomato puree ( not tomato puree ) | 2 tablespoons pure mango chutney, such as major greys | 4 corn cobs, husked and patted dry ( optional ) | 1 can garbanzo beans, drained | 1 can enchilada sauce
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400&deg.

title: Puerto Rico Beans
ingredients: 1 lb beans, fresh | 2 teaspoons butter | 1 teaspoon bouillon | 1 can of diced fire-roasted tomatoes
instructions: Place butter in saucepan or pan on med/low or till foaming. Add beans, boullion and tomatoes. Heat and add pepper and paprika if desired.

Random Ingredients: tomato paste,american cheese,red chili pepper,white flour
title: American Sausage Fingers
ingredients: 3 slices american cheese | 1/2 teaspoon tomato paste | 1 teaspoon crushed red chili pepper | 1/2 teaspoon white flour
instructions: On a well floured board, mix together the tomato paste, crushed red chilies, and flour. Using your thumb or a pastry brush, coat the surface of the sausage lightly with the mixture. Then knead lightly until the mixture is smooth and glossy. Place in an oven proof dish or muffin tin that has been greased and lined with greaseproof paper. Using a teaspoon, place thumb in centre of sausages, pressing the edges together to seal. Bake at 180c for 15 minutes or until golden brown and cooked through. Serve with any left over stuffing.

title: Fried Phyllo With Lime and Lime
ingredients: 2 tablespoons mayonnaise | 1 loaf frozen phyllo dough, thawed | 10 limes, divided
instructions: Using a sharp knife, slice phyllo dough into four portions.

title: Baked Kiwi Mussels
ingredients: 20 mussels, scrubbed | 1 pint milk | 1 cup seedless grapes, halved | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 cup kiwi fruit, diced ( can also use other fruits )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425f degressions place mussels in a bowl, pour over half the milk and toss gently to coat. Spray an oven proof dish with vegetable spray. Arrange mussels in the dish, top with grapes. Drizzle remaining milk over mussels and bake for 10 minutes. Cut kiwi into wedges and scatter around mussels. Return to oven and bake for 10 minutes or until beginning to caramelise and kiwi is cooked through.

title: Rajma-Sweet Mixed-Up Beans
ingredients: 1 packet mung beans | 1 teaspoon caster sugar | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/4 teaspoon freshly ground cayenne | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 1/4 teaspoon celery seed
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200c/400f/gas put the lentils into a large bowl and pour boiling water over.

Random Ingredients: star anise pod,pork shoulder,cream coconut,blueberry,white vinegar,monterey jack pepper cheese,ziti pasta
title: Cheese and star anise Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb ziti pasta or 1 lb penne pasta | 1 can cream of coconut | 1 can cream of coconut ( not condensed ) | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs boneless pork shoulder | 2 -3 star anise pods, pods, crushed | 6 -10 ounces shredded monterey jack pepper cheese or 6 -10 ounces your favorite cheese | 3 tablespoons white vinegar
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions using 1/2 to 3/4 cup water. Add cream of coconut to soup and mix. Set aside. Slice pork into thin bite sized chunks and place in dutch oven/skillet, over medium heat on the stove. Heat an entire bottle of wine or broth. After a minute, add cream of coconut to the wok. Add crushed star anise pods and the meat into the wok. Stir in the sauce as it comes to a boil, then simmer on low heat. Add a little salt and pepper to taste. When pasta is finished, mix with soup and serve topped with shredded pepper and cheese. Add more wine if desired.

title: Coconut Adobo for Crock Pot or Not
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs russet potatoes | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 1/4 cup coconut oil or 1/4 cup olive oil | 2 1/2 lbs italian sausage ( cut into 1/2-inch slices ) | 1/2 dried ancho chile ( crushed )
instructions: Cut potatoes into 2 x 1 inch pieces, removing seeds. Place in the bottom of the crock pot. Sprinkle with the vinegar and coconut oil. Add the sausage slices. Sprinkle with chili. Cook on high 5 hours or on low for 6 hours. Serve as is with a salad or rice.

title: Lamb & Noodles
ingredients: 1 bunch of fresh mint | 6 lamb chops, cut into thirds ( approx 1. 5-inch slices )
instructions: Remove the leaves from the mint and chop coarsely, discarding the large pieces of stems. Wash the noodles under cold water and drain. Trim and cut them into three or four even sections width wise. Place the noodles in a large casserole serving dish, top with lamb, cover and refrigerate overnight. The next day, preheat the oven to 200c/180c fan forced. Place the noodle sections side by side on a baking tray, in a single layer. Sprinkle with pepper. Bake for about 45 minutes, until lamb is tender. Serve lamb and noodles separately.

Random Ingredients: chilies,white pepper,enchilada sauce,boston lettuce,basil leaf,bamboo shoot
title: Bobby Flay's Spicy Beef Sandwich
ingredients: 1 lb ground round, 80 % lean | 1 teaspoon white pepper, coarsely ground | 1 1/2 cups chilies, fresh hot deli rotel and drained | 3 tablespoons fresh basil leaves, torn | 3 tablespoons canned bamboo shoots, drained, sliced | 1 can enchilada sauce, mild, medium | 10 large fresh basil leaves, torn | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper, coarsely ground | 2/3 cup boston lettuce, torn into 1-inch wedges
instructions: Preheat a large frying pan over medium high heat. Spray pan with oil spray, pour in beef and sprinkle with white pepper and let sear for 3 minutes. Remove beef from pan and set aside. Repeat with remaining beef and keep warm. Add chilies to the pan and cook gently 2 to 3 minutes, or until tender. Stir in basil, bamboo shoots and enchilada sauce, and simmer 3 minutes. Add torn basil and heat through. Serve beef on a lettuce leaf and garnish with a small amount of your choice of fresh basil. Serve sauce on the side.

Random Ingredients: soy sauce,broccoli carrot cauliflower mix,green capsicum,vanilla bean,enchilada sauce,arugula leaf,molasses,self rising flour
title: Vegetarian Maboondiga
ingredients: 300 g broccoli cawiflower mix | 200 g green capsicum | 1 can enchilada sauce | 1 -2 tablespoon light soy sauce | 1 tablespoon molasses | 2 -3 tablespoons self-rising flour | 1 small vanilla bean, halved lengthways | 225 g arugula leaves
instructions: Clean, wash and pat dry the broccoli and carrot. Cut the capsicum into thin matchsticks. Drain and blanch in boiling water for 2 - 3 minutes until bright green. Drain briefly, then cut into small pieces. Combine both sauces and molasses in a small bowl and heat gently in the microwave. Sprinkle the flour over the vegetables. Fold in the vanilla beans. Cover and cook in the microwave for one minute. Stir and cook until the sauce thickens. Remove the cover and fold in the arugula. Serve immediately or transfer to a container and keep warm for up to a day, or keep warm until serving.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile adobo,peanut butter,vegetable,wheat lasagna noodle,cumin,american cheese
title: Chipotle Sinalini Bites
ingredients: 16 ounces mixed vegetables, any kind ( broccoli, cauliflower, zucchini, or any other fresh vegetable ) | 1 cup american cheese, grated | 1 cup peanut butter | 1 tablespoon ground chipotle chile in adobo | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 32 whole wheat lasagna noodles, cooked and well drained ( or regular )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Spray a 13x9 inch baking dish with nonstick spray. In a medium bowl, mix the vegetables with the american cheese, peanut butter, chipotle, cumin and cilantro. Spoon half of the vegetable mixture evenly into the baking dish. Then top with the noodles and another half of the vegetable mixture, breaking up them into chunks as you go. Top with the remaining vegetable mixture and top with the remaining cheese. Cover and bake for 30 minutes. Uncover and bake for 15 more minutes or until bubbly.

title: Best Salmon
ingredients: 1/2 cup lemon wedge | 3 lbs fresh salmon fillets
instructions: Prepare charcoal grill with medium hot coals. Remove salmon from the can on paper towels. Place salmon on hot grill. Ladle lemon juice over salmon. Close lid tightly and cook until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork. Approx 25 minutes. Slide salmon onto heated platter and garnish with lemon wedges and an herb sprig.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,dark brown sugar,banana,ginger garlic paste,pork loin,hamburger
title: Sweet and Spicy Grilled Pork Loin
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 600 g pork loin | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 300 g barbecued pork loin ( or other white meat cured pork ) | 450 g chopped hamburger | 2 bananas | 4 tablespoons ground fermented tofu, for sauce
instructions: Combine ginger garlic paste and the brown sugar in a large dish and add the pork, barbecued pork and tofu. Heat your grill. Season the meat with salt and pepper and transfer to a rack over a baking tray or barbecue grill to cook. Turn over once after about 15 minutes. Serve the meat with the roasted sweet plantains and some sticky rice that have been prepared to accompany an antipasto salad.

title: Red Pepper Oil Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons mirin | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 2 red peppers, finely diced | 16 mint sprigs, to serve
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a small bowl and stir to combine. Serve as a dipping sauce for your chosen protein.

title: Spiced Indian White Bread and Butter for Gift giving
ingredients: 7 ounces sweet white bread or 7 ounces white bread, crusts removed ( 4.1/2-1/4 cups ) | 1 1/4 teaspoons garam masala ( indian spice blend ) | 6 whole cloves
instructions: Cut the crusts of your choice.

title: New Orleans Fish Stew
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds cod | 12 russet potatoes, diced | 1 pound frozen lima beans | 1/2 cup dry madeira wine | 1 cup plain yogurt | 1 fresh jalapeno peppers, seeded and minced | 2 radishes, diced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Arrange fish in a roasting pan, and toss with the potatoes, lima beans, madeira, and yogurt to coat. Cover, and bake in preheated oven until the fish is easily flaked with a fork, 40 to 50 minutes. Garnish with jalapenos and radishes, and serve.

title: Hakkavi(Macaroni and Meat Stew)
ingredients: 1 jar spanish olives or ( 16 ounce ) jar pimiento stuffed olives, sliced | 1 loaf sourdough bread, cut into 1-inch cubes ( about 16 cups ) | 1 1 lb ground meat or 1 lb ground turkey | 3 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 cup elbow macaroni
instructions: In a large saucepan of boiling water, cook macaroni until al dente, rinse under cold water and drain. Combine meat or turkey, olives, sesame oil and macaroni in dutch oven or deep frying pan. Cover and cook over medium heat until hot. Stir. Cover.

Random Ingredients: egg,sea salt,eggplant,rice wine vinegar,artichoke heart,chicken bouillon powder,marjoram,marsala
title: Eggplant and Artichoke Stir Fry
ingredients: 3 medium eggplants | 3 artichoke hearts | 1/4 cup rice wine vinegar | 1/8 cup marjoram | 1/4 cup chicken bouillon powder ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon powder ( optional ) or 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon cube ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups marsala | 2 cups cooked egg noodles or 2 cups cooked rice
instructions: Slice eggplants lengthwise into 3/8 inch thick slices. Cut artichoke hearts lengthwise into 1/8 inch slices. Place in a glass dish and cover with vinegar and place in refrigerator until ready to cook. In a shallow dish, mix together marjoram, chicken bouillon powder, and bouillon powder. Set aside. In a large nonstick skillet, stir fry eggplants until slightly browned. Remove from skillet and drain on paper towels. Cut artichoke hearts crosswise into 1/8 inch slices. Heat a 12 inch nonstick skillet over medium heat. Stir fry artichokes until tender, then remove from skillet. Remove from skillet. In same skillet heat wine or marsala until it is hot. Stir mixture into wok's contents until blended. Add vegetables, stir fry 1 - 2 minutes, then stir in the cooked egg noodles or rice. Serve immediately.

title: Homemade Ricotta
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups whole milk | 1 lb fresh ricotta cheese | 1/4 cup brandy ( optional ) or 1/4 cup rum ( optional )
instructions: Line the inside of a 1 1/2 gallon metal or glass jar with a cheese cloth or coffee filter, and hang the cloth over the jar for 1 - 2 days to infuse the flavors. Strain the ricotta through a sieve or cheesecloth lined with a clean tea towel and discard the solids. Pour the strained ricotta through a cheese cloth or cheese cloth and discard the remaining solids. Add the brandy or rum to the drained ricotta and let rest. Shake the jar or plastic container until the ricotta is well chilled. It should take at least 4 hours in the fridge.

title: Tomato & Sugar French Onion Dip
ingredients: 2 cans condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 tablespoon demerara sugar | 1/4 cup plain breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Mix all ingredients together thoroughly. Pour into a loaf pan lined with waxed paper. Place on top rack of preheated oven and bake for approximately 45 - 50 minutes until bubbly. Serve with your favourite fries.

title: Simple Green Onion Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 teaspoon sumac | 2 tablespoons chopped green onions
instructions: Heat whipping cream in large nonreactive salad bowl on medium high until almost simmering, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in sumac and green onions. Add dressing.

title: Cheese With Brie and Olive Oil
ingredients: olive oil flavored cooking spray | 4 ounces brie cheese, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Coat 2 large baking sheets with cooking spray. Place four slices of bread on each baking sheet. Spray each slice of bread with cooking spray. Divide cheese evenly among the 4 slices and top with remaining 4 slices of bread. Lightly sprinkle cheese with oil. Bake for 10 - 15 minutes or until toasted.

title: Italian Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, cut into bite size pieces | 1 envelope dry italian-style salad dressing mix
instructions: Place cauliflower in a large baking dish. Stir italian style with a fork in the sink. Cover dish loosely with plastic wrap. Refrigerate for 3 - 4 hours. Turn the cauliflower every 3 - 4 hours.

title: Apple Corn Meal
ingredients: 1 piece beef brisket, about a pound ( cut from the top if possible ) | 1 can tart apples, chunks, cut up | 1 curry paste | 1 1/2 cups cornmeal | 1/4 cup cornmeal
instructions: In a 4 1/2 qt slow cooker, place brisket, apples and curry paste. Cover and turn to high for 3 hours. Turn slow cooker to low and use a thermometer to keep temperature in cooker below 3/4 lb. When brisket and apple mixture are tender, remove beef and apples to warmed serving dish, leaving liquid in beef cooking liquid. Combine cornmeal, 1/4 cup cornmeal and reserved liquid in a small bowl. Bring to a boil in a 2 - 3 qt heavy saucepan over medium heat, stirring well. Boil 3 minutes or until mixture boils, stirring constantly. Drop spoonfuls of corn meal into hot liquid and cook, stirring constantly, until browned and bubbly, about 3 minutes or until corn meal is no longer cloudy. Season with salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: banana,escarole,vanilla extract,glutinous rice,vanilla bean,green tea powder,lemon zest
title: Quick and Easy Green Tea Bananas With Escarole, Cotte Escarole, and Banana Puffs
ingredients: 2 teaspoons vanilla bean | 1 teaspoon lemon zest | 1 teaspoon green tea powder ( or to taste ) | 2 cups green tea ( i used decaf yellow tea powder instead ) | 1/4 lb peeled chopped escarole ( about 5 c. ) | 6 bananas, each cut into 5 small bananas | 2 cups glutinous rice, cooked
instructions: Make a small slit in each bean to release the steam. If using green tea powder, dissolve in 1/4 cup warm water and allow to stand 5 min... Microwave green tea until warm and fragrant, 30 - 60 seconds or so. Let cool. Place 1/4 cup bean juice and vanilla bean in a small saucepan. Microwave 1 minute or until the juice reduces slightly and thickens a bit, stirring to prevent scorching. Remove from microwave and set aside. Cover bean with plastic wrap and refrigerate until ready to use. Prepare green tea shells according to package directions.. While shells are still hot, with a slotted spoon or tongs, slip off each piece of bean into a bowl. Place 1/2 teaspoon of vanilla on one end of each bean and roll up. Set each bean roll aside and let cool to room temperature. Make one puff using the egg wash indicated above or buy a plastic pastry bag with a hole in the middle of the pastry bag. Squeeze out as much air as possible and fill each puff with green tea. Cut each of the five bananas into 10 smaller rounds and fan the rounds in the center of the puff. Set aside. Heat 1 tablespoon of oil and cook a few banana rounds until golden, about 1 minute per side.

title: Shrimp and Corn on the Barbie
ingredients: 1 package jumbo shrimp - peeled, deveined, and tails left on | 1 can baby corn, drained
instructions: Preheat the grill for high heat. While the grill is heating, roll the shrimp, shrimp, corn, and corn off of the skewers into 12 skewers. Grill skewers on the preheated grill until the shrimp are opaque and the shrimp are fully cooked.

title: Chicken Legs with Rapadillas
ingredients: 4 chicken legs, with thigh attached | 1 cup triple sec ( or other liquid ) | 2 cups cornstarch
instructions: Place chicken legs in a large pot and pour in triple sec or other liquid. Turn the breast up on the chicken, and coat the chicken with cornstarch. Cover the pot, and cook over medium high heat until the chicken is cooked through, about 20 minutes. Move the chicken around so the cornstarch can gather up on the chicken to help thicken the sauce.

title: Simple Kielbasa
