instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f line a 1 1/2 quart baking dish with foil and grease with olive oil. Rinse the quinoa and add it to a large mixing bowl and toss with the tomatoes, bouquet garni, olive oil and 1/2 teaspoon white pepper. Bake 40 to 50 minutes or until very slightly soft. Let cool completely in the pan. Meanwhile, preheat grill on high. Wash and dice the remaining 4 tomatoes and brush with olive oil while grilling. When the quinoa is tender, stir well. Spread evenly on a 6 cup plate or baking sheet. Top with tomatoes, then sprinkle with crème fraîche, if using. Top with a sprinkling of oregano and grill until the crème fraîche has melted. Serve immediately.

title: Spinach Salad
ingredients: 16 ounces dried mixed fruit | 2 -3 tablespoons fresh baby spinach ( washed and dried works well ) | black pepper ( or lemon pepper )
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the spinach with fruit. Season with black pepper and toss to combine. Best served chilled or room temperature.

title: Mango Cabbage Salad With Dill Pickles
ingredients: 2 -3 large cabbage leaves ( approx. 16-24 ) | 8 -10 dill pickles, slices ( approx. 1/2-inch each ) | 3 cups mango juice | 1/4 cup white vinegar
instructions: Wash cabbage leaves carefully, removing the outer layer. Cut each cabbage leaf into thin strips, if necessary, so it fits easily. Using a very sharp knife, slice each leaf crosswise into thin slivers. Place cabbage slivers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, or arrange on a pretty plate. Using a slotted spoon, pickle slice from center of each cabbage slab about 1 1/2 inches/1 inch deep, and set aside. Pour mango juice into a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: cabbage,white rum,hamburger bun,pumpkin puree,garam masala,pinto bean
title: Pumpkin Burritos
ingredients: 500 -750 g cooked pinto beans | 1 head cabbage | 1 cup pumpkin puree | 1/2 cup white rum | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | hamburger bun
instructions: Cut cabbage head into large squares. Remove core and hard core of head then finely shred cabbage. Combine pumpkin puree, rum and garam masala in a medium bowl and mix well. Chop hamburger buns and heat in oven. Spread 1/4 cup pumpkin mixture over bottom half of bun to make a lid while preparing other half. Place lid on top. Spread remaining pumpkin mixture on lid and place in oven without opening the lid. Cook 20 minutes or until well heated through, turning half way through. Serve on top of warmed buns.

title: Prosciutto Wrapped Hazelnuts
ingredients: 16 slices prosciutto | 1/2 cup hazelnuts, toasted and coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Lay a sharp serrated knife in the center of a slice of prosciutto. Sprinkle with a few pepper flakes. Place hazelnuts on a baking sheet and top with the rest of the slice of prosciutto. Bake in the preheated oven until the tops are lightly browned, about 10 minutes.

title: Crock Pot Cantaloupe Steaks
ingredients: 2 lbs beef steaks | 1 jar dried pinto beans | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained | 24 cherry tomatoes, cut in half | 1 lemon, zest of | 3 -5 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 cup dry breadcrumbs
instructions: Cut steak into strips and put in slow cooker. Pour beans over meat. Drain artichoke hearts and cherries. Add lemon zest, cornstarch and breadcrumbs. Stir till blended and pour over meat and beans. Cover and cook on high 3 - 4 hours or low 7 - 8 hours. Note, i often serve this over a bed of chopped onions and celery.

Random Ingredients: tabasco jalapeno sauce,sumac,garlic powder,maple syrup,cocoa,grain rice,mint leaf
title: Mexican Rice Balls (Pirra-Mole)
ingredients: 1/4 cup mild unsweetened cocoa | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/4 teaspoon ground sumac | 2 tablespoons dried mint leaves | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon tabasco jalapeno sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground sweetened coconut | 1 cup short-grain rice or 1 cup jasmine rice | 2 tablespoons genuine maple syrup ( made from real maple syrup )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except rice in a medium bowl. Mix well.

title: Quick Microwave  Spiced Lasganara-Parmesan-Molasses
ingredients: 9 lasagna sheets ( store-bought ) | 2 containers whole milk and butter sauce ( i use campbell's organic brand ) | 2 chicken bouillon cubes | 1 tablespoon light molasses ( not table salt )
instructions: Place a wire rack over a foil lined 9 x 13 dish. Place a single layer of lasagna sheets over each of 3 pieces of foil, so they're evenly covered. Spread 1/3 of the milk mixture over the lasagna sheets, then top with another layer of lasagna sheets. Spread 2 tablespoons of the remaining milk mixture over. Next, sprinkle 1 tablespoon of light molasses over the lasagna. Microwave on high power for 10 minutes, stirring once at a time. Remove from microwave, then microwave on high power for 10 more minutes stirring after 6 - 8 minutes. Let stand for 5 minutes before serving as suggested.

Random Ingredients: chayote,olive,chicken breast half,icing sugar,horseradish,jasmine rice,white wine,oil black olive
title: Chicken Rissoles With Olives and Horseradish  (Arroz Con Cebola)
ingredients: 2 cups prepared horseradish | 3 -4 chicken breast halves ( halved and sliced thinly ) | 1 cup cooked white wine ( i prefer a sweet and sour mix, but i've made it ) | 1 cup ripe olives ( halved, kalamata recommended ) or 1 cup kalamata olive, roughly chopped | 1 medium chayote, cut into chunks ( read step 4 below ) | 3 cups cooked jasmine rice ( i like a light pumpernickel rice ) | 1/2 cup icing sugar | oil ( to fry, you can also add in a frying pan, i've also done this for a little over a cup of olive oil in step # 3 )
instructions: Preparation of chicken,. Soak the olives in the wine for 10 - 15 minutes to loosen the flavor. Set aside to cool. Dipping sauce. Place the chicken, olives, chayote, rice and sherry in a food processor or blender. Pulse until it resembles a course paste. Combine icing sugar and oil in a small bowl. Taste for saltiness, add more olive oil if it seems not to be able to mix with the ingredients. Note, i usually just dip the chicken into the icing sugar and oil, then i coat it thoroughly and i sprinkle the icing sugar on before dipping. Heat a few inches of oil in a skillet. Sear the chicken on each side just until golden, then remove on paper towels lined plate to drain. Note, you can also use the chicken breast for a chicken salad, but i find it's much too messy for me just add in the onions and olives.

title: Beer Peanut Butter Beer Spread
ingredients: 2 tablespoons peanut butter, creamy | 32 ounces lager beer, cold from refrigerator
instructions: Use an electric mixer with a blend attachment. Place the peanut butter in a bowl. Gradually add the cold beer, whisking to combine. Use a funnel to mix to the desired consistency as desired.

title: Nepalese Tofu Nachos (Tanzitos)
ingredients: 16 ounces soft tofu, drained of excess moisture ( such as cellophane ) | 8 ounces tamarind paste | 1/2 cup dried cranberries, soaked in warm water for 15 minutes | 1 box fritos corn chips
instructions: In a food processor, combine the tofu thru a fine mesh strainer and process for 1 minute to remove any excess moisture. Transfer the tofu to a cutting board and cut into 1/4 inch chunks. Add tamarind paste to the tofu and process till smooth. Add 1/8 cup water and cranberries and pulse till a uniform paste forms. Transfer the tofu mixture along with the corn chips to a parchment paper lined baking sheet and bake in preheated 375 degree f oven for 15 - 20 minutes, till the crumb topping is golden. Enjoy the nachos immediately.

title: Hot Chilli Beef
ingredients: 1 beef brisket | 1 liter champagne | 1 chili sauce | 200 g crabmeat | 1 teaspoon coriander powder
instructions: Heat oven 190°c/ gas cut brisket into small 5cm cubes. Place meat in a casserole dish, cover with wine. Place on oven truss and bake for 10 to 15 minutes. Remove meat from dish, uncover wine, add crushed coriander. Replace cover. Place in oven and cook for 90 minutes depending on how dry your wine is.

title: Pea Greens Wraps
ingredients: 1/2 cup frozen peas, thawed and drained | 1/4 cup sour cream | 1/2 cup chopped sunflower seeds | 1 flour tortillas, warmed or 2 -3 pita breads
instructions: Cook, thaw peas if frozen. In medium bowl, combine peas, sour cream and sunflower seeds.

Random Ingredients: tomato puree,salt,salt black pepper,marshmallow,marjoram,key lime juice
title: Margarita Mango Daiquiri
ingredients: 2 packages marshmallows | 1/4 cup key lime juice | 2 cups tomato puree | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried marjoram or 1 1/2 teaspoons dried thyme leaves | salt | salt and black pepper
instructions: Prepare the marinade, combine all ingredients in the order listed. Stir well to blend. Store in refrigerator until ready to use.

title: Macaroni Crabmeat
ingredients: 2 cups macaroni | 2 tablespoons chili oil | 4 teaspoons mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon ground ginger | 1/2 teaspoon ground dry cilantro | 1 pound crabmeat, picked for shells | 1/4 cup shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook macaroni in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until tender yet firm to the bite, about 8 minutes. Drain. Heat chili oil, mustard seed, ginger, cilantro in a large skillet over medium heat until fragrant. Pour tomato sauce and cook until thick, about 3 minutes. Mix macaroni with the macaroni, crabmeat, cheese and pepper sauce in a large casserole dish. Cover.

title: Sesame Oil Dressing
ingredients: 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato, oil packed, drained | 1/8 cup chopped canned onion | 1/2 teaspoon dark sesame oil
instructions: Place all ingredients in a food processor and process until smooth. Refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: currant,provolone cheese,mango chutney,fennel seed,flour tortilla,cremini mushroom
title: Mushrooms Con Queso
ingredients: 1 tablespoon fennel seeds | 3 tablespoons dried currants ( may not add enough to your taste, but they don't worry if they get eaten hot ) | 3 tablespoons mango chutney | 3/4 cup grated low-fat provolone cheese | 3/4 cup sliced cremini mushroom | 10 large flour tortillas
instructions: In a small skillet over medium high heat, toast the fennel seeds for about 1 minute or until fragrant and lightly browned, stirring often. Stir in 1 tablespoon of the chutney or preserves and cook about 1 minute longer. Transfer to a bowl and let cool to room temperature. Preheat the oven to 400 and spray a 10 inch cast iron or other ovenproof skillet evenly with nonstick cooking spray. In the skillet, combine the mushrooms and remaining 1 tablespoon chutney. Cook, stirring often, over medium heat until soft, about 3 minutes. Place one tortilla in the skillet and spread a heaping tablespoon of the mushroom mixture onto it and top with another tortilla, pressing down to make sure the filling is not sitting flat. Arrange the tortilla in a single layer in the skillet. Repeat with the remaining tortillas until the mushrooms are used up, placing them on top of each other. Lightly spray the top of the queso with nonstick cooking. Put in a hot oven. Cook, covered, for 15 to 20 minutes or until the tortillas are browned and crispy on the top. Cut and serve. Tip, sometimes i heat up a microwaveable bowl to get the moisture out. If not using electric bowl, you may need to microwave for a few minutes after it starts to cook up to 1 minute more.

title: Tofu Wraps
ingredients: 4 tablespoons firm tofu | 1 tablespoon prepared roasted red capsicum
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Slice tofu into 5mm thick rectangles. Drain roasted capsicum under cold water, drain, and cut into 5mm cubes. Combine tofu and capsicum in a bowl. Wrap tightly in clingfilm and place on a baking tray. Bake for 25 minutes or until warm, remove from the oven.

Random Ingredients: dark red kidney bean,seasoning,caster sugar,red chili pepper
title: Lamington Beans (Ranch Style Kidney Beans)
ingredients: 1 kg dark red kidney beans | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 2 -3 dried hot red chili peppers ( canning ) | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning
instructions: You will need a deep pan/pot. Large enough to hold all the ingredients. Cover with water and boil till tender. This should take approximately 3 hours. You may need to add more water during cooking and/or cook only when most of the water has boiled away. Pour off any excess water. Transfer into a large dish. Add caster sugar and chillies. Mix thoroughly and chill until chilled. Refrigerate till ready to serve.

title: Irish Spiced Farmer Cheese Spread
ingredients: 18 ounces farmer cheese | 1/2 cup irish cream
instructions: Add farmer cheese and irish cream to a food processor.

Random Ingredients: water,ginger garlic paste,taco seasoning,wine,trappey jalapeno,sun tomato oil
title: Hot and Spicy Restaurant-Style Turkey Gizzards
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomato packed in oil, chopped | 3 tablespoons taco seasoning | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 tablespoon sweet wine | 600 ml boiling water, or as needed to cover | 10 -12 smoked free range turkey gizzards
instructions: Place turkey gizzards into a food processor or mini chopper and process until finely ground. Stir in taco seasoning, ginger garlic paste, and sweet wine. Pour into a saucepan, bring to just under a boil, then simmer to blend flavors. Pour in boiling water, then simmer turkeygizzards until cooked through and easily pierced. You may also add chopped fresh tomato before serving at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: ladyfinger,vegetable broth,grapeseed oil,red enchilada sauce mexican restaurant
title: Red Enchilada Roll Ups
ingredients: 1 can red enchilada sauce ( i use mexican restaurant or el pato brand ) | 2 packages ladyfingers | 1 teaspoon grapeseed oil | 2 cups vegetable broth
instructions: Prepare the red enchilada sauce according to the instructions on the package. Prepare the lady fingers according to package. Prepare the enchilada sauce as directed above. Cut the lady fingers in quarters lengthwise and spread out on paper towel to dry. Spread out the bottom layer of sauce on counter and spread out the rolled up lady fingers. Top with approximately 1/3 cup of enchilada sauce. Repeat layering on the bottom layer of sauce and lady fingers. Cover the rolls with another layer of sauce and then top with the remaining enchilada sauce. Refrigerate for at least one hour before serving. Note, to make ahead, prepare according to the package instructions. Note, to reheat and serve, cover with foil and microwave for 10 minutes. If desired, prepare the rolls before serving in a pre heated oven at 400 degrees f for 30 minutes or according to package directions. If served in individual ramekins with shredded carrots, shredded cheese, sour cream, guacamole, salsa, etc, remove from oven, let cool then serve. Note, to cook in an electric skillet, heat the vegetable broth over medium high heat. Add a little vegetable broth at a time until desired consistency is reached. This should take about 15 - 20 minutes for a medium sauce to be cooked.

title: Green Lentil Pulao With Sorrel
ingredients: 1/2 cup green lentil, rinsed and picked over | 1 cup frozen peas, thawed | 1/2 cup sorrel, torn in small pieces | 1 cup arborio rice | 1 tablespoon oil or 1 tablespoon canola oil | 2 tablespoons mild brown mustard ( such as vh ) | 1/2 cup thai basil ( optional )
instructions: Bring 4 to 5 cups of water to boil, or just to boiling.

title: Prosciutto Crunchy Lentils
ingredients: 1 cup brown lentils | 1 cup cabbage, shredded | 1/2 cup shredded prosciutto | 1/2 cup bread crumbs, dry | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 2 tablespoons chocolate chips, toasted
instructions: Pour the lentils into a strainer and rinse under cold water.

title: White Bean and Bok Choy Stew
ingredients: 600 g white beans ( from frozen ) | 2 bunches green, white and bok choy, thick stalks, halved lengthways | 8 large fresh thyme sprigs | 300 g mixed greens, such as chard, kale, and red capsicum | 100 g aged cheese, shredded
instructions: Put the white beans in a large saucepan, cover with cold water and bring to the boil. Reduce to a simmer and cook for 15 minutes or until just tender.. Drain, reserving 2 cups of the cooking liquid. Allow the beans to cool. Dice the bokchoy stalks and green stalks into 1cm pieces. Place in a large saucepan. Wash the fresh thyme sprigs in a dry non stick frying pan or wok. Add about 1/3 of the chopped green stalks and half the bokchoy on top of the white beans. Cut out the tough ends of the thyme sprigs. Add the chopped leaves and any remaining green stalks to the cooking liquid. Cover. Cook over a medium heat for 10 minutes or until tender. Remove rosemary sprigs. If necessary, cook for a further minute before adding the shredded cheese. Serve soup garnished with the fresh thyme leaves.

Random Ingredients: white bean,black olive,chicken bouillon cube,white sugar,corn oil,beef brisket,radish
title: Mom's Beef and Bean Soup
ingredients: 3 whole beef brisket | 1 teaspoon corn oil, or as needed | 1 can white beans, drained and rinsed | 2 cans white sugar snap peas and yellow beans with liquid | 4 slices radish, or more to taste | 4 toasted fresh corn oil | 2 cubes chicken bouillon cubes ( optional )
instructions: Remove the beef from the corning board, and cut into 8 pieces. Heat 1 teaspoon of corn oil in a stock pot set over medium high heat. Rinse the brisket under cold water, and drain. Pat dry with some paper towels. Place the beef in the hot oil, and sear on all sides until browned, about 3 minutes. Pour the beans and sugar into the stock pot, and add the remaining 2 cans of white and yellow beans. Add small amounts of corn oil and chicken bouillon cubes, if using, to cover the contents of the pot. Cover the pot, and simmer over medium heat until the beef is tender, about 3 hours.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,aubergine,lemon juice zest,sun tomato,chicken bouillon,asiago cheese,tea,corn tortilla
title: Microwave Spicy Aubergine and Sun Dried Tomato Breakfast Burritos (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 4 large corn tortillas, cut into 1/2 inch squares | 1 large aubergine, stalk ends trimmed | 300 g asiago cheese | 300 g long grain white rice ( white ) | 300 g instant texas tea ( regular ) | 4 tablespoons lemon juice, freshly squeezed | 1 chicken bouillon | 3/4 fresh tomato, halved | 2 teaspoons lemons, juice and zest of | 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomato, chopped
instructions: Place the oven rack in to the center of the oven. Preheat the oven to 100°c. Place the tortillas on a large baking sheet and spray with oil. Bake on a baking sheet for about 1 hour, until crisp and dry. Cut the aubergine into 1½cm dice and place in a large bowl with the cheese. Place the rice in a large microwave safe bowl. Cover with a layer of boiling water and then microwave on high for 15 minutes, until tender. Stir the contents of the bowl and its contents, excluding the aubergine, into the rice. Set aside to let stand at room temperature for five minutes. Meanwhile, place the tea bag in a large microwave safe dish and add the lemon juice. Scratch out the bag, squeezing as much air as possible from the aubergine. Rinse out the tea bag. Add to the rice along with the tomatoes and lemon zest and mix. Place in the fridge for 15 minutes, stirring once or twice. To assemble, place one tortilla square on a microwave safe plate, shiny side down, and microwave on high for five seconds. The tortilla should get very hot and start to become crisp. Flip and microwave for one minute more until crispy. Repeat with remaining tortillas. Spread one tablespoon of the rice vermicelli mixture over the top of one half of each tortilla square. Then spread one third of the tomatoes over the top. Top with one third of the aubergine. Spread another tablespoon of rice vermicelli mixture on top, followed by one third of the rice vermicelli mixture, then cover with a third of the tomatoes. Repeat with a third of the aubergine, then top with rest of the rice vermicelli mixture, the remaining tomatoes and finally the rest of the rice vermicelli mixture, then cover with a lid and cook on high for five minutes. Repeat with the remaining tortillas, tomatoes and finally the remaining aubergine. Serve immediately.

title: Whole Wheat Pastry Flour Fingers
ingredients: 1 cup whole wheat pastry flour | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Preheat oven to 150°c mark sift flour and vanilla into a large bowl and knead gently in the pastry flour. Form pastry fingers into fingers and roll out onto a greased baking tray. Gently brush pastry fingers with milk or olive oil and sprinkle with sugar. Bake for 15 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from oven and cool on wire rack. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: san marzano tomato,tortilla flour,hazelnut,self raising flour,pork loin,saltpeter,lime wedge,red wine
title: Pork Loin and Heirloom Tomato Wraps
ingredients: 400 g pork loin, sliced thinly ( approximately 85 g in weight ) | 400 g tinned heirloom tomatoes ( tin ) | 2 tablespoons tortilla flour | 1 glass red wine, such as cabernet sauviz | 2 tablespoons hulled hazelnuts | 1 tablespoon self-raising flour | 1 teaspoon saltpeter | lime wedge ( to garnish )
instructions: Cut tomatoes into eight slices roughly the same size as the pork slices and leave until needed. Cut each slice into 5 - 8 slices. Heat the grill plate on high. Put the pork in one layer on the rack in the plate. Put each slice of tomatoes between sheets of paper towel and gently pound to flatten it out. Arrange two slices each of pork on each plate. Sift combined the flour and saltpeter over the pork and tomatoes and season generously. Dip each tomato slice, 1 thick, on the flour, then in the nut mixture, pressing slightly with your hands until almost completely covered. Place 1 tablespoon of the tomato topping into the centre of each plate. Pull one end of the tomato off the underside of the plate and set up, securing the roll with kitchen string or toothpicks to hold the roll in place. Grill or fry the rolls over high heat, turning with tongs so they brown on both sides and the tomatoes are cooked through. When cooked, they should be charred and slightly crisp and the tomatoes should have formed a hollow crust all the same size around the pork. Serve immediately, drizzling with the red wine. Serve with lime wedges.

Random Ingredients: yellow onion,white onion,nam pla,yellow cornmeal,black pepper,italian seasoning,soy sauce,vanilla sugar
title: Filipino Arepas (Cornmeal Arepas)
ingredients: 1 cup yellow cornmeal | 1/2 cup soy sauce, plus | 4 tablespoons soy sauce | 2 tablespoons nam pla ( fish sauce ) | 1 teaspoon nutmeg | 1 teaspoon white onion, minced | 1 teaspoon ground black pepper | 1 yellow onion, cut into eight rings | 4 teaspoons white onion, minced | 1/4 teaspoon italian seasoning
instructions: Heat wok and add 1 tablespoons oil. Place cornmeal in it and fry it until it looks like a meal. Then turn it onto a plate covered with a damp towel and set aside. In an oven pre heated to 400°, add 4 tablespoons of soy sauce and 2 tablespoons of fish sauce to the oil and brown the arepas briefly on each side. After the arepas have turned, place them back on the plate and cook for 3 - 4 minutes. Add 1 tablespoon of soy sauce to the fried arepas and mix well. Serve with onions, mushrooms, and green salad.

Random Ingredients: egg,picante sauce,chunky salsa,orange bell pepper,coconut flour,baguette,tamari
title: Baja Bread
ingredients: 6 slices baguette | 1 cup tamari | 1 1/2 cups yellow chunky salsa | 1 medium orange sweet bell peppers or 1 medium yellow sweet pepper, chopped | 1 cup coconut flour | 3 large eggs, beaten | picante sauce or hot sauce, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 200ºf. Brush the baguette slices with nonstick cooking spray and cut into 6 triangles. In a large bowl, combine everything but bread. Stir in bread crumbs.

title: Crock Pot Provolone Cheese-Melt
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs deli-style provolone cheese | 1 1/2 ounces unsweetened chocolate or 1 1/2 ounces semisweet chocolate, chopped | 1/2 cup crushed ice
instructions: Heat coiled crushed ice in a small saucepan until it just starts to melt. Pour into crock pot. With a slotted spoon, remove cheese from skillet and place on top of ice. Pour remaining melted chocolate into a small bowl, and melt into bowl over chocolate. Top cheeses with melted chocolate mixture and gently stir in any melted sauce that hasn't set. Cook on low at least 6 hours, but no longer than 2 hours.

title: Peanut Butter Pan-Seared Bread
ingredients: 7 -8 slices white bread, crusts removed ( crusts trimmed ) | 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 125 g sliced pepperoni ( or to taste ) | 125 g sliced deli-curd beef round steak, sliced | 1/4 cup pinot grigio | 2 tablespoons pinot grigio | 1 teaspoon cornflour | 2 1/3 cups peanut stock or 2 1/3 cups chicken stock | 2 hot dry chilies
instructions: Cut bread into 1cm wide strips and arrange on a plate. Brush with oil. Heat a heavy based frypan and add the pepperoni and cook over medium heat for 1 to 2 minutes, or until lightly browned, stirring continuously. Transfer to a bowl. Add sliced beef and pasta to the frypan, stir in pinot grigio, cornflour and stock. Bring to the boil, then reduce heat and simmer, uncovered for 15 to 20 minutes, or until beef is cooked through and pasta is just tender. Place slices of bread in a serving bowl pour over bean mixture and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: chickpea flour,tarragon,star anise,tomato juice,catsup,celery rib,sage leaf,white chocolate
title: French Chickpea-White Chocolate Chili
ingredients: 6 large ripe tomatoes, peeled and diced | 2 cups cooked chickpea flour ( or other chickpea flour ) | 2 teaspoons dried tarragon | 2 tablespoons ground sage leaves | 1 teaspoon whole star anise, crushed | 1 celery rib, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons catsup ( or other hot sauce ) | 2 ounces white chocolate, chopped
instructions: In a bowl, mix together the tomatoes, chickpea flour, ground spices and the chopped white chocolate. Cover and place in the refrigerator to chill. To serve, bring just to simmer while making and serve with toothpicks.

Random Ingredients: suet,hard egg,white miso,dill pickle,salami,horseradish,chipotle powder,red capsicum
title: Dill Salad
ingredients: 400 g chipotle-flavored relish | 300 g fine chopped suet, drained | 1 hard-boiled egg, cut into quarters | 1/4 small unpeeled radish ( about 1/4 cup ) | 1 small red capsicum, seeded and cut into very thin strips | 1 small dill pickle | 2 slices sandwich-style fresh horseradish | 1/3 cup white miso ( shirohi )
instructions: Dissolve half the chipotle in 30 ml/12 oz boiling water. Set aside to cool. Combine rest of the ingredients in a large bowl. Add miso soaking liquid and miso to the egg mix. Add salt and pepper to taste and chill. Garnish with fresh coriander leaves and sesame seeds just before serving.

title: Baked Lazy Day Breakfast Brown Rice
ingredients: 1 cup long-grain rice | 1 1/2 tablespoons german mustard | 1 1 teaspoon italian seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Rinse and drain rice, then set aside. Place mustard and italian seasoning in a small bowl, sprinkle the rice over the mustard mixture, then sprinkle the rice evenly over it to cover the mustard. Bake at 325f for 30 minutes, then raise oven to 350f and bake an additional 15 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Spiced Cheddar Cheese (Quiche)
ingredients: 3/4 lb french cheddar onion, sliced thinly | 4 tablespoons jam | 1/4 teaspoon baharat | 2 teaspoons moroccan mixed spice | 1 pinch mace ( optional ) | 1/4 cup chives, chopped | 1 1/4 lbs whipped topping, with fruit ( kiwi )
instructions: Place onion slices in a bowl and sprinkle the remainder of the ingredients over top. Leave overnight. Turn out, put on a hot dish and leave to set. Turn oven to 375 degrees, cook 30 minutes or until cooked. Serve with a dollop of whipped topping and a sprig of chives to serve on top.

title: Killer Nite Me Crazy Party Dip
ingredients: 2 lbs ground fish ( i've also used boneless chicken breast meat to make this recipe ) | 1 packet taco seasoning mix ( i used pampered chef taco seasoning mix ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon cardamom powder | 12 -15 ladyfingers
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Line a 9 x13 baking pan with parchment paper. In a large bowl, combine fish, taco seasoning mix, vanilla and cardamom powder, and mix well. Place lady fingers in bottom of pan, and then spoon fish/taco mixture over lady fingers, making sure to cover evenly. Cover with foil, and place in oven. Bake for 45 minutes, or until knife inserted in dip comes out clean. Serve with tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,beef stock,italian parsley,chicken thigh,passata,pork sausage
title: Sausage and Chicken
ingredients: 500 ml pork sausage | 500 ml beef stock | 2 chicken thighs | 4 tablespoons coriander powder | 1 can passata | 3 tablespoons italian parsley, chopped
instructions: Place stock and the sausages in a large pan. Cover and cook on medium heat for 20 minutes or until sausage is browned. Take stock off the heat and add remaining ingredients. Turn heat to low, cover and cook on low for another 45 minutes or until sausage tender. To serve, remove sausages from pan. Cut into slices. Stir in parsley.

title: Beef and Cauliflower With Butterscotch Chipits
ingredients: 2 lbs beef or 2 lbs chicken, cut across the grain into 1-inch pieces and seasoned lightly | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 2 large head cauliflower, leaves separated, rinsed, trimmed, and cut diagonally in 4 florets | 1/4 cup butterscotch chips ( optional ) | 3/4 cup basmati rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Arrange beef in single layer on rack in roasting pan.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,rosemary,hamburger,arborio rice,puff pastry,topping,rice vinegar,radish
title: Ham and Rice Bundles
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 1 package frozen puff pastry sheets, thawed | 1 cup rice vinegar | 3/4 cup white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons dried rosemary | 1/2 cup fresh sliced radish | 1 cup instant rice vinegar | 1 cup prepared cream, whipped topping
instructions: Place hamburger in a deep bowl. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cut pastry sheets in half, and then cut each half crosswise into 12 strips. Place one strip on work surface, then brush all around with 1/4 cup rice vinegar and 1 tablespoon oregano. Brush with 1/4 cup vinegar, and the second 1/4 cup rice vinegar, and the 2 tablespoons dried rosemary. Fold pastry strip over to enclose the filling, and place on an ungreased baking sheet. Repeat with pastry strips and filling for remaining strips. Bake at 400 until golden brown, about 18 - 20 minutes, brushing with the cream after 5 minutes. This could also be made in a small nonstick baking pot, with a lid. Makes about 8 bundles. Tip, the leftover hamburger mixture can be rolled into meatballs or as a topping for a meat loaf.

title: Scottish Barley Flour Muesli
ingredients: 1 ounce quick-cooking rolled oats | 1 teaspoon barley flour | whole milk or heavy cream
instructions: Dissolve the oats in the cream. Sprinkle the barley flour over the top and use to moisten the muesli. Serve with a green salad.

title: Artichokes for Tamales
ingredients: 1 can artichoke hearts, drained | 2 tablespoons palm sugar | 1 tablespoon light peanut butter | 1 teaspoon fresh tarragon
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a medium sized bowl and set aside. Skewer artichokes onto bamboo skewers and grill to your liking, about 3 minutes. Remove and allow to rest a minute. These are great warm or cold. Serve with tamale chips or as an appetizer.

title: Pasta With Chili and Peppers

instructions: Combine tomato sauce and vegetables and stir well together. Cook for additional hour.

title: Scallops and Apricots

instructions: In a small bowl, combine molasses and apricots.

instructions: Mix all ingredients in a container with plenty of water and chill before deep frying for at least three hours. This recipe can be made by dropping the chunks of tuna in a large amount of hot oil, stirring and tasting as it changes the texture of the tuna.

title: Quick Chinese Stuff

instructions: Heat 1 t of the oil or choc peanut oil in a heavy bottomed pan over medium heat. Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook until heated through, about 5 minutes.

title: Penne, Fresh Vegetables & Balsamic Vinaigrette
ingredients: 125 g penne pasta or 125 g other tubular pasta | 4 small escarole, trimmed and washed ( i use the large head ) | 2 oranges, zested & halved ( i substitute a pkg. frozen mixed vegetables for the baby ) | 50 g mixed fresh vegetables, such as as baby bok choy, baby bok choy, carrot or asparagus, chopped | 2 cardamom pods, pods with cracked cracked outer skin ( optional ) | 6 tablespoons low sodium balsamic vinegar
instructions: Place the pasta in a large saucepan of boiling water & return to the boil. Cook for 3 - 3 minutes or until just tender. Drain well & set aside. Meanwhile, using a slotted spoon, remove the zest from the oranges & halved oranges & set aside. Juice the oranges & place in a small dish with the remaining vegetables & orange zest. Cover with cold water & bring to the boil over a high heat & boil for 1 - 2 minutes or until the vegetables are just tender. Drain well. Transfer the vegetables to a small serving bowl. Add the drained pasta to the pasta bowl & toss to combine. Combine the citrus vinaigrette ingredients in a small screw top jar, & shake to combine. Pour the vinaigrette into the bowl & toss to combine.. Adjust the seasoning with salt & pepper if necessary to serve. Serve straight away.

title: Spicy Golden Raisin Patties
ingredients: 3 1/2 teaspoons crushed dark raisins | 1 curry leaf
instructions: To make the raisins, soak them in a bowl of warm water until soft, about 30 minutes. Squeeze out excess water. Fold 1/4 cup reserved raisins into the raisins. Mash into the remaining raisins. Preheat an outdoor grill for medium high heat and lightly oil the grate. Form the patties out of the raisins using a 1/4 cup capacity fork. Cook the patties on the prepared grill directly over the coals, turning over for about 3 minutes per side, or until golden brown and crispy.

title: Quick and Easy Lebanese Wheat Bread
ingredients: 1/4 cup brown rice, uncooked | 1 1/2 cups bulgar wheat
instructions: Cook rice in a 10 inch skillet. Meanwhile toast bulgur in a 300f oven until golden brown, about 55 minutes.

title: Pimentos With Seasoning
ingredients: 3 1/2 ounces pimento-stuffed olives, drained | 3 -4 tablespoons cooking wine | 4 leaves fresh dill weed, chopped | 1 -2 tablespoon grated fresh gingerroot | seasoning ( optional )
instructions: Place olive pimentos on a small plate with the stem pointing away from you. Sprinkle salt on inside, and then add the rest of the ingredients. Mix together well.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,purpose flour,xylitol sugar substitute,self rising flour,green chilies,chive,lemon balm leaf
title: Green Chilies Steamed Whole Wheat Chapati
ingredients: 1/4 cup green chilies, chopped fine | 1/4 cup chives, snipped fine | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon lemon balm leaves ( optional ) | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 1 cup self rising flour | 1/2 cup xylitol sugar substitute or 1/2 cup sugar | 1 tablespoon fresh chives, snipped 1-2 tsp
instructions: In a small bowl blend green chilies, chives and vinegar. Let cool to room temperature. In a large bowl combine the chopped green chilies with flour, lemon balm, gephardt's sugar, chives, and vinegar mixture. Mix with a wire whisk until well blended. Spoon onto steamed chapati dough, and let harden 10 to 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,bean sprout,beef eye,red curry paste
title: Beef With Red Curry Cream
ingredients: 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 600 ml light cream | 1 tablespoon beef eye gravy granular | 400 g mixed beans sprouts | 2 tablespoons heavy cream, heated
instructions: Stir red curry paste into cream and heat until boiling. Slowly whisk in cream and beef eye gravy granules. Return to boil and simmer for 2 minutes. Sprinkle with mixed spinach and hot cream.

Random Ingredients: red kidney bean,nutritional yeast,grape,italian sausage link,coffee,serrano chilies,red wine vinegar,celery salt
title: Vegetable and Smokey Red Beans With Chiles, Coffee and Grapes
ingredients: 24 ounces red kidney beans ( or other large dried red beans ) | 4 cups grape, cut in 8ths ( or other flavorful white beans, such as calamata ) | 1 cup celery salt | 4 serrano chilies, minced ( use gloves ) | 1/2 teaspoon celery salt | soup spices ( like emeril's essence, sage, leggo... or you can use an entire bottle of spicy chili essence... ) ( optional ) | 4 ounces jim beam italian sausage links, chopped | 1/4 cup red chili bean coffee ( not hot ) | red wine vinegar ( optional )
instructions: Sort and wash the beans, then add them to boiling water and cook for 10 - 12 minutes until soft. When beans are very soft, drain the water and add to your soup pot along with the celery salt. Add remaining ingredients and stir well. Place over medium heat and stir until all the ingredients are well mixed. Note that you can leave some chiles in if you wish, but i prefer them all. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,phyllo pastry,lemon zest,swiss cheese,red bell pepper,shell pasta,buttermilk,walnut oil
title: Greek Phyllo Pie
ingredients: 1/2 cup walnut oil | 1 small red bell pepper, chopped ( about 1/3 cup ) | 1/2 lb grated swiss cheese | 1 tablespoon finely grated lemon zest | 1 tablespoon all purpose buttermilk or 1 tablespoon 2 % low-fat milk | 1/2 teaspoon finely grated fresh lemon zest | 1 lb uncooked medium shell pasta ( macaroni, rotini, or spaghetti ) | 1 package frozen small whole wheat pastry sheets, partially thawed | 8 sheets phyllo pastry
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f. On a large, heavy based frying pans, heat walnut oil over medium heat. Add bell pepper, swiss cheese, lemon zest, and lemon juice. Cover the pan and cook, stirring occasionally, until pepper is tender and swiss cheese is completely melted, about 5 minutes. Meanwhile, prepare pasta according to package directions. Drain well and then transfer pasta to a large bowl. Place a large piece of dough on a pastry towel and dampen the outside edge of the dough with water. Cut a 1 inch wide strip off the top of the dough lengthwise. Make a 1 inch slit along the pastry to form a criss cross pattern on the edge, leaving 1/2 inch at the bottom. Repeat with 1/2 the remaining dough strip, filling and lining. Brush one sheet of pasta with oil and place 2 sheets of pastry in the bottom of the pan. Repeat with the remaining 3 phyllo sheets and remaining filling, topping off with remaining pastry. With a sharp knife, cut the stack of stacked phyllo sheets in half crosswise for a total of eight 4x8 squares. Spread half the pasta over the top of the stacked phyllo sheets in the pan. Top with 1/2 the shredded swiss cheese. Brush the top with remaining oil, then place remaining sheets in the pan with the last layer of phyllo, brushing each with oil. Cut the stacked stack of 8 into 4 equal squares and place 4 rows of 4 triangles on top of the cheese. Top with remaining swiss cheese and spread remaining 3 phyllo sheets evenly over top. Arrange 5 rows of 4 triangles on top of the layered pastry, brushing each ‘with oil. Top with remaining 5 phyllo sheets, brushing each with oil. Using a sharp knife, slice ‘yogurt. ’ into 4 wedges and serve.

title: Homemade Chiles (Adobong Machaca)
ingredients: 10 dried red chilies, broken into pieces | 3 cups long-grain rice | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke flavoring ( found in asian markets )
instructions: Remove stems and seeds from chiles and discard. Dry the chiles on absorbent paper towels or in a clean towel until the chiles become very dry and hard to break apart. Place in a large bowl, cover with cool water, and refrigerate for about 24 hours. Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Place chiles in the hot skillet, and fry, stirring often, until the chiles become browned and fragrant, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat and cool to room temperature. Place one half cup of the rice in the bowl with the chile mixture and the rice, reserving any liquid that remains in the bowl. Stir in liquid smoke until rice is coated. Transfer the rice mixture to a large pot and place over low heat. Cook covered, stirring often, until most of the liquid has been absorbed and grains are tender, about 20 minutes. Repeat the process, adding reserved liquid as needed to attain desired consistency.

Random Ingredients: yogurt,italian sausage,bulk pork sausage,fennel seed,yellow squash,baking soda,teriyaki sauce,kalamata olive
title: Lori's Yummy Sausage and Yellow Squash
ingredients: 1 lb bulk pork sausage | 1 lb yellow squash, sliced | 1 cup sliced kalamata olives | 2 tablespoons dried fennel seeds | 1 tablespoon baking soda | 1 cup prepared teriyaki sauce | 1 container plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons italian sausage or 2 tablespoons hot italian sausage powder
instructions: Brown sausage in large skillet for about 8 minutes over medium heat. Drain excess fat from skillet and set aside. Preheat oven according to package directions. While sausages are browning, place all other ingredients into a large bowl. When sausage has finished browning, place it out on paper towels. Mix the marinade ingredients in the bowl with the sausage. Add salt and pepper to taste. Place the sausage mixture in a lightly greased 13x9 baking dish. Spread italian sausage over italian sausage and sprinkle on kalamata olives. Bake in preheated oven until sausage is thoroughly browned.

title: Thai Beef Wraps
ingredients: 1 flank steak | 1/2 cup sweet red curry paste ( or to taste ) | 2 tablespoons tortillas | 1 dash salt
instructions: Marinade steak with curry paste, salt and other 2 tbsp of sweet green chili paste. Let marinade in fridge for at least an hour before cooking. Heat grill to high heat until desired level of saffron/green chili paste/heat/sugar/pepper turns slightly reddish. Meanwhile, grill or fry the cut steak until desired level of sizzlin/smokeyness is reached. Remove steak as soon as it cooks.

title: Elegant Corn Torte
ingredients: 8 ounces cake flour | 1 package unflavored gelatin | 1 teaspoon cold ground mace | 6 -8 ounces fresh baby corn, sliced ( canned or frozen, drained well ) | 4 cups sifted icing sugar | 2 packages dream whip, thawed
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in 1/2 cup boiling water and set aside. Beat cake flour and mace together in large bowl til well blended. Stir in milk and corn and fold carefully into batter. Gently fold in whipped topping until evenly blended. Pour into prepared springform pan and chill 2 hours. Turn onto oven rack, remove sides of springform pan and remove cake onto rack above pan. Turn pan upside down and place cake on rack. Chill torte while preparing filling. Poke 2 toothpicks through crown of cooled cake and poke corn slices about 1/8 inch apart. Brush top of torte with about 2/3 cup water, letting water drip off. Place corn between toothpicks and bake on rack for 45 - 45 minutes or till corn is hot and slightly browned. Remove from oven. Remove side of toothpicks. Place on cloth towel to cool. Remove from oven and sprinkle top of entire torte with icing sugar. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: soy sauce,pepper,each tomatillo,white sugar,rhubarb,dark soy sauce,pizza sauce
title: Rhubarb and Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 lb rhubarb, cut into 1 1/2 inch pieces | 1 can chopped no-soy sauce | 1/2 cup white sugar | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce | 1/8 cup pizza sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons soy sauce | 1 tablespoon ground pepper | 2 cans no-soy petite diced tomatoes
instructions: Trim rhubarb bottoms from rhubarb stalks, and cut into bite sized pieces. In a medium bowl, whisk together the sliced rhubarb and tomato with 1/4 cup sugar, dark soy sauce, 1/8 cup pizza sauce, and pepper until well combined. Cover, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. In a large skillet, saute the rhubarb and tomato mixture in remaining 1/4 cup sugar until rhubarb is limp. Spoon over rice pilaf and serve.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,nonfat beef broth,pork shoulder,sherry,cranberry,turmeric powder
title: Chinese Pork and Rice
ingredients: 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 1/2 lbs pork shoulder, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1/3 cup dry sherry | 2 cans nonfat beef broth | 1 1/2 cups long-grain white rice | 1/2 cup dried cranberries or 1/2 cup frozen cranberries
instructions: Heat a large dutch oven or pot over med high heat until hot. Season the turmeric powder generously with salt and pepper. Add the pork pieces and brown, about 8 - 10 minutes. Stir in sherry and reduce heat to low. Using a slotted spoon, remove and discard any stuck meat. Add the broth and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover and cook 25 minutes. Add the rice and cranberries and cook, covered, until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed, about 20 minutes longer.. Serve warm.

title: Spiced Mushrooms on Skewers
ingredients: 1/2 cup button mushroom, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons dark soy sauce
instructions: Mix the dark soy sauce and dark sauce together until they are fully blended. Add the chopped mushrooms and leave to marinate for 10 minutes. Barbecue the mushrooms until just cooked through, then cut into quarters and serve.

title: BBQ Tofu (Tofu) and Shredded Canned Sandwiches
ingredients: 3 lbs lean hamburger | 1 package firm tofu, drained cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 cup barbecue sauce | 1 cup catsup | 1/4 cup grated pecorino romano cheese | 5 garlic cloves, minced and pressed
instructions: Brown hamburger, drain. Combine soy sauce, barbecue sauce, catsup, cheese and garlic cloves in a sauce pan until boiling stir until it comes to a clear boil. Remove from heat and add drained tofu stir to blend. Place tofu on a slice of cheese and spread with sauce, top with croutons or your favorite sandwich bread.

title: Kidney Beans with Sesame Seeds (Mujadarra and Kafta Lahribhet)
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans | 2 -3 slices sage leaves | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke | 4 tablespoons raw rice or 4 tablespoons pearl barley, rinsed
instructions: Drain the kidney beans. Place in a food processor with the sage, sesame seeds and liquid smoke. Process until finely ground. instructions: Mix together apple mince, lime zest, fenugreek, sugar, garlic paste, grand marnier and 3 pints of the water. Stir well and leave for 4 hours. To serve, divide between 2 warmed serving plates or glasses, pour over extra lime juice, garnish each portion with a mint sprig.

instructions: Heat 1/2 inch of oil in a deep skillet or deep fryer to 365°f. Cut the sausages into large cubes. Brown the sausage and potatoes. In a large bowl, toss the warm chicken wings, remaining 1/2 cup oil, lemon pepper and vinegar. Add the browned sausages.

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place half the fish and rice in food processor. Blend or process until mixed. Stir in rest of fish, brown sugar, sea salt, cardamom and crumbs. title: Rice-Brewed Quark and Quark With Nuts (Czechoske
ingredients: 2 cups arborio rice, rinsed well and drained | 250 g quark, at room temperature | 250 g currants or 250 g cranberries | 250 g polenta, in 3 1/2 cm chunks
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c /350°f grease a 4l loaf tin and line with parchment paper. Set aside. Place rice in a large bowl and pour in enough hot water to cover it. Put the polenta in a pan of simmering water, and then add the polenta chunks a few at a time, stirring vigorously and continuously until the polenta is the consistency of porridge. Tip the mixture evenly into the prepared loaf tin and bake for 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,habanero pepper,pork,salmon,cinnamon,chili powder,red wine vinegar
title: Pine Coaled Green Rice for Two (Jhangora)
ingredients: 1 cup long grain basmati rice | 1 -2 habanero pepper, sliced into four pieces ( red or green ) | 1 lb smoked salmon, cut into four 6-1/2-inch squares | 1 cup diced cured pork ( fatty bacon bits may also be used ) | 2 teaspoons chili powder | 1 teaspoon cinnamon | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar
instructions: Rinse the rice under running water until the water runs clear. Heat a 12 inch skillet over medium heat. Add the habanero peppers.

title: Yorkshire Pudding
ingredients: 3 ounces self-rising flour | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 1 egg, beaten
instructions: Sift the flour into a medium sized mixing bowl and combine with 1 tablespoon of the corn oil. Make a well in the centre. Tip the beaten egg into the well and pour into the bowl of flour. Make a well in the centre. Gradually add the 1 tablespoon of corn oil, stirring with a fork to mix well. Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and knead gently about 7 times. The dough should be smooth and elastic. Cover and refrigerate overnight, or for no less than 2 hours. Divide and make 12 balls each about 2 inches in diameter. Flatten each ball slightly and roll out into a round about 1/8 inch thick. Heat a griddle or frying pan until very hot. Brush about 1 or 2 of the puddings on one side with half the egg, then flip over. Cook for about 2 minutes on each side. Remove to a cooling rack and cut into wedges. Serve sprinkled with jam if desired.

title: Pork Shrimp with Jalapeno Peppers
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 2 lbs of shelled medium shrimp, shelled and deveined | 1/4 lb ground pork shoulder | jalapeno pepper
instructions: Mix in a medium bowl the balsamic vinegar the shrimp and the pork shoulder. Toss so that the pork shrimps are evenly coated with the marinade. Cover and marinate in refrigerator for a minimum of 2 hours or overnight. Cook the shrimp on a heated grill on medium heat, turning as necessary, and basting with the marinade. Serve with a side of jalapenos.

instructions: In a small bowl, combine mayonnaise, honey and rosemary.

instructions: Prepare pasta per package directions. While there are no exacts on the amount of pasta and package size, you can adjust those cooking instructions as desired. Once the pasta is done draining it, add the white vinegar. Let it sit 5 minutes. While pasta is sitting, combine all your other ingredients. Add a little water to rinse off the pasta, if necessary, and put pasta in a large bowl. I like to add about 1/2 cup of water to the pasta to give a good consistency for my sauce.

title: Mild Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 1 tablespoon margarine | 1 cup white basmati rice ( i use basmati ) | 1/2 cup madeira wine
instructions: Heat margarine in a 10 skillet. Add rice, and fry until all liquid is absorbed.

title: Chipotle Hot Sauce
ingredients: 1 chipotle chile in adobo, chopped | 3 tablespoons chili seasoning mix | 1/4 cup chicken broth | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon salt
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Use less adobo if desired.

title: Pierogi (Garlicky)

instructions: Heat oven to in a saucepan, combine rice, pork fat or oil, cheese & wine, if using, and bring to boil over medium high heat. Cover and transfer rice mixture to a large baking dish or platter. Cover tightly with foil and bake 15 - 20 minutes or until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed, stirring once during cooking.

title: Crazy Good Chocolate Chip Patties #SP5

instructions: Prepare & dry stuffing as directed on package. Add chocolate chips to stuffing mix. Spray non stick fry pan with cooking spray. Place mix onto pan & heat over low heat stirring occasionally, about 3 minutes. Patties are done when they float to the top and are golden brown. Scoop the top & sides with a fork & serve warm.

Random Ingredients: watermelon,cooking apple,yellow squash,beef stew meat,salad green,flour,kitchen bouquet
title: Beef With Watermelon and Squash
ingredients: 1 lb lean boneless beef stew meat, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 2 -3 tablespoons flour | 1 1/2 cups water ( cold water ) | 1 jar salad greens ( not packed, mixed, large pieces ) | 1 medium cooking apple, peeled, cored, sliced | 1 medium yellow squash, seeded, thinly sliced | kitchen bouquet
instructions: Combine beef, flour, and 1 cup cold water in a medium dish, stirring at least once or twice to avoid lumps. Cover and refrigerate for up to 24 hours. Drain beef but reserve marinade. In a 7 1/2 qt. Dutch oven, cover beef with enough water to cover and bring to a boil. Cover and reduce heat to low. Simmer for about 3 hours or until beef is tender and no longer pink in center and juices run clear. Meanwhile, in a small skillet over medium high heat, cook green vegetables until crisp tender, about 5 minutes. Drain on paper towels. Stir beef into greens. Serve with hot cooked noodles, if desired.

title: Grilled Sliced Eggplant and Chipotle Sausage
ingredients: 2 lbs round steaks ( or ground sausage, or 1 1/2 pounds of the ground ) | 2 tablespoons dry italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup shallot, minced | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning ( or 1 packet of chipotle chipotle chipotles, crushed ) | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 large eggplant, sliced | rice ( optional )
instructions: Coat grill with cooking spray and preheat on medium to high heat. Slice beef diagonally across grain into 1/4 inch slices, then slice diagonally to make 1/4 inch wide slices. Stir together crumbs the crumbs, shallots, taco seasoning, and oil. Dip slices into crumb mixture and coat well, and set aside. Grill strips 3 minutes on each side, until slightly browned, but not cooked through. Grill eggplant slices one more minute, then place on hot grill to toast tops, and keep warm. Meanwhile, if using a charcoal grill, cover and lightly oil grate. If using a gas grill, place on range and let smoke until very dark and very crisp, about 1 1/2 minutes. If using a charcoal grill, place on grill and cook about 20 seconds. Turn and continue cooking for a few minutes, or until charred on all sides.

title: Nori Sushi Wraps or Wedges
ingredients: 1 jar macadamia nuts | 5 cups boiling-hot potato flour | 6 tablespoons catsup, divided | 1 tablespoon vanilla | 1 1/2 cups chopped asian salted vegetables ( like asparagus, broccoli, carrots, broccoli, or chard ) | 3 sheets nori, torn into pieces | 2 serrano peppers, sliced diagonally into thin strips
instructions: Remove nuts from jars. Set aside. Bring boiling water to a boil. Remove from heat.

title: Stove Top Steamy Chocolate Spam Patties #5FIX
ingredients: 1 cup eggnog | 4 links pork tenderloin | 1 package frozen chopped spinach leaves | 12 ounces cans of minced clams, in season ( use 2 large cans ) | 1 teaspoon canola oil or 1 teaspoon olive oil | cocoa powder ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons dried sage ( optional )
instructions: In a large pot, cook pork in canola oil over medium heat until meat is browned and crisp. Drain any excess fat and discard. Add back in spinach and clam juice and heat through. Drain pork and spinach mixture well in large bowl while still warm. Stir together, eggnog, and can of garlic clams. Add to pork in pot. Add cheese and optional spices to taste. Keep warm over low heat until ready to serve. Serve on a warmed tortilla, with grated parm cheese stirred into the sauce.

title: Tuna Gratinate on Toast
ingredients: 8 slices day-old white bread | 6 tablespoons grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 3 tablespoons vermouth | 400 g canned tuna in water, drained
instructions: Butter the bread evenly and generously on both sides. Put 4 pieces of bread on a plate. With tongs, place 3 pieces of tuna in each slice, sprinkle with half of the cheese, cover with the remaining slices of bread. Dribble vermouth over the top, then grate another 1/2tbsp of cheese at a time over each piece of bread. Wrap bread around the tuna, then return to the bread pan and cook on a hot, greased griddle or griddle for 2 or 3 minutes, until golden brown.

title: Focaccia Bread with Green Beans
ingredients: 1 loaf focaccia bread | 2 cans trimmed cut green beans
instructions: Slice bread into 3/4 inch thick slices across the top. Arrange on a large serving platter. Sprinkle 1 can of trimmed beans over bread. Slice remaining can of green beans across bread in an overlapping pattern. Spoon warm beans on top.

title: Cafe Rio Bread
ingredients: 1 cup jasmine rice, rinsed and drained | 1 cup shredded cabbage | 1 cup cottage cheese, drained on paper towels | 1 cup bottled strong coffee, cooled | 1 dash chili-garlic sauce | 1 baguette, toasted, sliced
instructions: Mix all ingredients, except baguette slices, together in a large bowl and stir to combine. Scoop mixture onto toasted baguette slices. Garnish with sliced baguette and serve.

Random Ingredients: spanish onion,bean sprout,purpose flour,tuna,shiitake mushroom,cooking spray
title: Tunisian Tuna Casserole

instructions: Spray inside of 13x9 baking dish with cooking spray. Thoroughly combine flour and tuna in a large bowl, mash up tuna and tuna in a large bowl until well incorporated. Place onion and mushrooms on top of tuna. Scatter bean sprouts over tuna mixture and cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight. Preheat oven to 425°f bake cassareepf for 20 to 30 minutes or until a golden brown crust has formed. Carefully invert casserole onto a serving platter and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: rigatoni pasta,sharp cheddar cheese,margarine,cardamom pod,sherry wine,stone mustard,dark brown sugar
title: Baked Rigatoni With Mustard Topping
ingredients: 2 tablespoons stone ground mustard | 2 tablespoons margarine ( no substitutes ) | 1 cup dark brown sugar ( packed ) | 1 1/2 cups sharp cheddar cheese, grated ( about 4 ounces ) | 1 can dark sweet sherry wine | 6 cardamom pods, cracked and ground ( about 1 teaspoon each, or more ) | 1 lb rigatoni pasta, dry or 8 ounces other tubular pasta, cooked
instructions: In a medium sauce pan, melt the margarine over low heat and stir in the brown sugar. Stir in the sherry, cardamom, and remaining ingredients. ingredients: 6 pita pockets | 2 teaspoons lime juice | 2 tablespoons snipped fresh marjoram or 2 tablespoons oregano leaves | 1 lime, juice and zest of | 1 1/2 teaspoons chopped fresh marjoram or 1 1/2 teaspoons oregano leaves | 1/4 teaspoon whole cloves | cooking spray
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Line a baking sheet with foil so the foil hangs over the edges. Arrange pita chips in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet. Toast the pita chips for about 3 minutes on each side or until lightly browned. Meanwhile, mix lime juice, marjoram, lime zest, marjoram and cloves. Place the chips in a small bowl and stir in the lime juice mixture. Spoon dressing over each chip to serve. Serve warm.

title: Wyoming on the Road (Pineapple Salad)
ingredients: 1 cup snow peas, cut in half | 1/2 cup pineapple juice | 1 teaspoon german mustard
instructions: In a bowl, place the snow peas, pineapple juice, and mustard, stirring to combine. Serve right away.

title: Maggie Beer's French Quarter Toasts
ingredients: 6 cloves garlic, peeled | 3 ounces superfine sugar | 2 tablespoons grand marnier ( optional ) | 2 baguettes
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Place garlic in oven rack. Cook for 10 minutes. Remove from oven, and allow to cool, then peel off outer shell of garlic cloves. Place garlic, sugar, and 1 teaspoon of grand marnier into a baking dish, and stir. Bake at 300 degrees f for 40 to 45 minutes, stirring every 15 minutes to keep garlic from burning. Split baguette diagonally in half. Place one piece on each slice of the toasted bread, and serve. Maggie is best when served alone on a hot plate.

title: Pine Nut Beans
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups pine nuts | 3 cups kidney beans | 1 teaspoon molasses ( optional )
instructions: Place pines, beans and molasses in a large saucepan. Fill with cold water to cover by 2 inches and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium low and simmer for 30 minutes, or until all the water has been absorbed and beans are tender. Remove from the heat and transfer the beans to small baking dishes. Cool them slightly and store in the refrigerator with the liquid. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: pomegranate juice,chili flake,lemon peel,chicken thigh,tomato paste,grape tomato,hot italian sausage,celery seed
title: Spicy Sausage Chicken
ingredients: 4 lbs chicken thighs, halved crosswise | 1/2 cup pomegranate juice, chilled | 1/2 cup grape tomatoes, halved | 1/4 cup tomato paste | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon peel, chopped | 2 tablespoons chili flakes | 1/2 teaspoon celery seed | 1/2 teaspoon hot italian sausage, casing removed, crumbled
instructions: Place chicken in 9 x13 inch metal roasting pan. Combine pomegranate juice, tomatoes, tomato paste, lemon peel, chili flakes, celery seed and sausage in saucepan. Stir to blend. Spoon onion mixture evenly over chicken. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and place roasting pan on top rack of oven. Bake, turning once, until chicken is golden brown, about 1 hour total.

title: Tres Leches- Fast and Easy
ingredients: 1 box instant vanilla pudding mix | 12 ounces refrigerated quick-cooking oats | 1/2 cup quick-cooking oats, not instant | 1/2 cup fat-free whipped topping, any flavor | 1/2 teaspoon lemon extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f & grease a 13 x 5 x 1 metal loaf pan with a paper liner or butter. Prepare the instant vanilla pudding mix according to package instruction. Place the 6 ounces instant vanilla pudding mix & 12 ounces cool water in a microwave safe bowl & cook over medium high for 2 minutes or till pudding is softened, stirring once or twice. Stir in the quick cook oats & spread evenly in the prepared dish. Spread the 6 ounces of whipped topping evenly over the pudding. Dot on the top with a wooden spoon. Cut several slits into the top of the cake & place in the oven. Cook for 2 to the 3 hours or till topping is bubbly. Cool for 2 minutes before slicing to expose the crisp 'lids'.

Random Ingredients: rack lamb,fine sea salt,herb chevre cheese

Random Ingredients: scotch bonnet pepper,half,jasmine rice,tea,english cucumber,vanilla ice cream
title: Creamy Thai Coconut Rice
ingredients: 1 cup jasmine rice ( or regular or long-grain rice, about 4 cups ) | 8 ounces scotch bonnet peppers ( substitute thai peppers if not available ) | 1 teaspoon teas ( preferably cultured soybean-canola ) | 0.5 cup half-and-half | vanilla ice cream or whipped cream | 2 english seedless cucumbers ( leave unpeeled, just remove core for crunch )
instructions: Preparation, rinse rice under tap water and transfer to a wide mouth container. Cover tightly and leave in refrigerator over night, stirring occasionally. After rice has re absorbed all liquid, drain and pat dry to remove excess moisture. Heat 1/2 cup of water. Split chilies open, remove seeds and veins. Break off large claws with a knife and slice them into thin strips. Remove seeds with scissors if you don't like your food spongy. In a pan over medium heat, heat 1/2 cup of water to boiling. Add noodles to boiling water and cook 1 minute. Drain and rinse with cold water. In a small bowl, stir scotch bonnet peppers with the water until softened, about 1 minute. Drain and rinse with cold water. Break apart into pieces as you go. Pour into rice container and add steamed vegetables and chilies. Cover tightly and refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight, stirring now and then. Just before serving, stir in ice cream or whipped cream. Garnish with peeled cucumbers just prior to serving.

title: Persian Pork Gravy
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs pork shoulder | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1/4 cup distilled white vinegar ( or white wine vinegar )
instructions: Mix the ingredients together in a large glass bowl or pan. Place the pork in the mixture and let it marinate overnight in the refrigerator. The following 5 days, remove the pork from the bowl and remove any excess fat. Shred the meat and serve.

title: Nana's Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, cut up | 1 package frozen peas | water | salt & pepper | 1 frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
instructions: Combine the beef, peas and salt& pepper. Cover& simmer until beef is done.

title: Vegetable Phyllo Rolls
ingredients: 1 tablespoon coriander seeds | 1/2 cup peanut oil | 1 cup green peas ( optional ) | 1 cup fresh milk | 16 sheets phyllo dough thawed | 1/2 cup fenugreek seeds, roasted
instructions: Make a spice mixture with the coriander seeds, 1/4 cup peanut oil, peas, and 1 cup of milk in a blender or food processor. Blend until smooth, add more milk if necessary. Pour 2 sheets of phyllo dough into a greased 9x13 inch baking pan, brushing each one liberally with a little of the spice mix. Repeat until all sheets are used. Spread half of the vegetable phyllo mixture over the phyllo sheets, cover with a second sheet of phyllo dough, brush with more spice mix, and repeat with the remaining phyllo and vegetables, placing phyllo sheets, 1/2 inch apart, on top of sheets. Spread remaining vegetable phyllo and spice mixture over phyllo, brush lightly with oil, and sprinkle with roasted fenugreek or other hot seasoning. Bake in a preheated 350 degree oven for 20 minutes. Cool and store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: dill pickle,chickpea,elbow macaroni,deli chicken,thai red curry paste,flat leaf parsley,meat
title: Beefy Indian Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb small elbow macaroni | 1/2 lb ground mallet or 1/2 lb deli corned beef, thinly sliced | 1 can chickpeas, rinsed drained and drained | 3 -4 tablespoons fresh flat-leaf parsley, finely chopped | 1/4 cup dill pickle, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon thai red curry paste or 1 tablespoon curry powder | 3 -4 tablespoons thai green curry paste ( hot, red pepper )
instructions: Cook macaroni in boiling salted water until al dente, about 10 minutes. Drain and place in a large bowl. Place meat in a skillet with reserved water to nearly cover and cook over medium high heat, stirring frequently. When meat is browned, add chickpeas, parsley, dill pickles, curry paste and 1/2 cup more of the hot curry paste powder. Let salad stand for 5 minutes before serving. Toss salad with remaining curry paste just before serving.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,scotch bonnet pepper,kale,pepperoncini pepper,cocoa powder,jalapeno,bean
title: Jamaican Green Beans With Peppers
ingredients: 4 -5 cups fresh kale | 1 bunch scotch bonnet pepper ( or habanero peppers from a can ) | 1 jalapeno, seeds & membrane removed and cut into rounds ( about a teaspoon worth, seeded for a mild heat and add more if desired ) | 1 can red chili peppers ( or use 3 serrano peppers from a can ) | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 10 -12 pepperoncini peppers, slices ( optional ) | 1 cup canned beans, drained
instructions: Steam the kale until tender. Reserve the stems for later, then cut the rest into a large bowl. Add all the other ingredients except the beans, mix well. Add the beans and stir. Serve.

title: Spiced Salsa
ingredients: 1 1/4 teaspoons cumin seeds | 1 serrano pepper, halved, plus more for garnish
instructions: Place the cumin seeds in a skillet, and add water, 1 teaspoon at a time. When it stops popping, place the pan into a steamer basket over simmering water and steam over medium low heat until seeds are fragrant and the color turns light brown, 7 to 10 minutes. Transfer cooked seeds to a bowl and add more water if necessary.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,pecan,port wine,vegetable broth,red bell pepper,cream tartar,cherry
title: Pepper and Cherry Chanten
ingredients: 1 teaspoon vegetable broth or 1 teaspoon chicken broth | 1/8 cup diced red bell peppers or 1/8 cup yellow bell pepper | 1 garlic clove, smashed | 2 tablespoons cherry blanched sliced pecans or 2 tablespoons walnuts, toasted and coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup port wine | light cream of tartar | fresh cherries, cut in half
instructions: Combine the broth, red bell pepper, garlic and pecans. Simmer until mixture is reduced to about 1 1/2 tbls. Using a blender process to puree the mixture until well mixed. Add the port, taste and add cream of tartar if desired.

title: Crostini
ingredients: 3 lbs beef, trimmed and cut into 1-inch cubes | 4 leeks, washed, chopped | 2 teaspoons dry gingerroot, peeled and grated | 1 loaf focaccia bread ( about 1-1/2 inches thick ) or 1 loaf sandwich buns, halved horizontally | 1 bottle dry buttermilk | 1/2 liter cider ( optional )
instructions: In a large dutch oven over high heat, sear beef and leeks, stirring frequently, until nicely browned, about 5 minutes. Stir in gingerroot. Transfer beef mixture to a bowl and reserve. Stir in bread and buttermilk, if using. Cover and reduce heat to medium. Cook until bread is golden, about 20 minutes. Transfer meat mixture to serving dish. Drizzle with cider if desired.

title: Sesame Bran Kebabs
ingredients: 250 g oat | 400 g cranberries | 1 teaspoon sesame oil
instructions: Place oats in a large bowl mix with sesame oil and cranberries. Add the sesame oil to coat the bowl. Preheat your oven to 200°c. Spray the kebabs with oil and rub the mix with your hands to coat and shape. Cook on a foreman type tray for 15 to 20 minutes, turning occasionally.

title: Steamed Green Leaf Eggs With Espresso
ingredients: 1 lb fresh baby spinach | 1 can water chestnuts, sliced | 3 tablespoons espresso, warmed
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large steamer basket and bring to a boil over high heat. Cover and steam for 4 to 5 minutes or until spinach is tender and water chestnuts are heated through. Carefully remove basket from steamer. Serve warm.

title: Hot Bavarian Gravy
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cold beef broth | 2 tablespoons vanilla essence
instructions: Put the cup of broth in a saucepan. Add the vanilla essence and simmer on a low heat for 20 minutes. Slowly add the cold beef broth. Stir and simmer for 10 minutes until thickened.

title: Cochochocho (Minty Bread)
ingredients: 1 pound masa harina | 3 mint leaves, chopped | 2 1/4 teaspoons kosher salt | 2 tablespoons mint leaves, for garnish
instructions: Place the masa harina, mint leaves, and kosher salt in a bowl. Gradually add just enough water to create a soft, sticky dough. Turn the dough out onto a clean work surface, and knead it briefly to form it into a compact round shape. Dip hands into hot water for a minute or two, and pat it dry. Shape the dough into a round loaf, and place on a parchment lined baking sheet dusted with cornstarch and sprinkled with mint leaves. Let rise until nearly doubled, 30 to 40 minutes. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Perfect Butter-Spread - Microwave on the Gooey Kind
ingredients: 250 g unsalted butter, at room temperature | salt and pepper
instructions: Using a butter slicer or sharp cheese grater, carefully slice the butter at a 45 degree angle to the thickness of your microwave wall a little over one quarter inch in height. You will be able to remove about half of the butter after 10 minutes. Spread the butter evenly in a flat dish until all of it has been used. Add salt and pepper and leave aside until the microwave wall has completely realken about one hour or more.. Leave in covered dish and refrigerate. Use within a couple of days or freeze.

title: Baba Ganouj - Indonesian chilies (Nigerian Version)
ingredients: 12 long fresh chilies ( about 6-7 in diameter ) | 1/2 teaspoon salt and pepper
instructions: Remove stems and seeds from chiles and slit open them lengthwise to make long strips. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Place in baking dish with stems and heat in a preheated 300f oven for 2 minutes, turn chiles and heat an additional 1 minute or until chiles are charred all over. Pour chiles out into a cloth bag and pour hot chile liquid through them. Refrigerate for up to 2 days. Note, you can freeze this mixture if desired just place it in a sealed container and re heat it in a 350f oven and continue cooking until all of the liquid is absorbed. This variation can be served warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: bread,flat leaf parsley,dill pickle,chili pepper flake,green bell pepper,chive,chili paste
title: Grilled Sushi
ingredients: 8 slices bread, crusts removed, bread quartered | 1 green bell pepper, cut into thin strips | 1/3 cup hot chili paste, such as sambal oelek ( sriracha ) | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh chives | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh dill pickle ( garnish ) or 1/2 teaspoon chopped pickle and onion ( garnish ) | 1 -2 teaspoon hot chili pepper flakes ( optional or to taste )
instructions: Combine chile paste, parsley, chives, dill, and pickle in a small bowl. Spread 1/4 cup herb mixture on four of the bread quarters and lay the tops on a serving platter. Place the remaining ingredients in a small bowl, or spoon over the bread, garnish with pickle and serve.

title: Apple and Onion Pizza Dough
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups apple juice | 2 1/2 teaspoons yeast
instructions: Dissolve yeast in water and let proof for 1 minute. Place 3 cups of hot apple juice into blender and process until smooth. You may need to scrape down sides with a spoon. Add yeast mixture to remaining apple juice and blend until thick and creamy. Pour into a bowl and let rise 2 hours in a warm place. Use the dough at this time to brush or drizzle pizza crust. Spread remaining 1/4 cup of dough onto pizza screen and place on pizza tray. Sprinkle tops with dried yeast mix and bake in 450 degree oven for 5 - 7 minutes. Bake 8 - 10 minutes more for a thicker crust.

Random Ingredients: black pepper,ra el hanout spice mix,cumin seed
title: Tunisian Spice Mix
ingredients: 3 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil or 3 tablespoons canola oil | 3 tablespoons ras el hanout spice mix ( see note at the bottom of recipe ) | 1 tablespoon ground cumin seed
instructions: In a shallow dish or baking pan, mix 3 tablespoons of olive oil or canola oil, 1 tablespoon ras el hanout and 1 tablespoon ground cumin. Cover loosely with plastic wrap and marinate in the refrigerator, at least 4 hours or overnight. Remove from refrigerator, and shake well to combine thoroughly. Drain and dry the marinated spice mix thoroughly. Grind the cumin seed to a powdery consistency in a spice mill or with a mortar and pestle. Add to the warm oil, stirring with a fork to combine. When the oil has reached the desired intensity of rancher, stir in the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil, and 1 teaspoon cumin seeds to remix.

title: Orange Baked Rice
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice, uncooked | 6 cups orange juice or 6 cups lemon juice | 1 cup mini chocolate chip | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary, crushed
instructions: Preheat your oven to 325f or 170c, gas mark 3/160 c if your oven is tending to hot, line a baking tray with parchment paper. Put the rice in a bowl. Pour the orange juice into another medium sized mixing bowl if your oven is tending to hot or not to use a thermometer. Grate the zest and mix it with the rice with the orange juice mixture. Take the mixture out of the fridge and, using a large fork, poke holes all over the rice using your thumb and forefinger to separate any white membrane from the grains. The rice will not absorb any of the orange juice and will be a bit sticky. Pour the rice into the lined tray and leave to cool for 20 minutes. Put the orange chips in a small microwavable bowl and cover with cling film. Microwave the chips on high for 1 - 2 minutes stir and leave to cool. When the rice have cooled slightly, stir in the chopped rosemary and place back in the fridge. You will be tempted to wait 10 minutes, then eat them straight away or store them in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: white flour,purple onion,greek yogurt,sage leaf,thai chili sauce,grain white rice,egg
title: Thai Fried Rice
ingredients: 3 cups cooked long-grain white rice | 1/2 cup purple onion, chopped small | 2 tablespoons purple onions, chopped small | 1 tablespoon plain thai sweet chili sauce or 1 tablespoon spicy chili sauce | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage leaves | 1 large egg | 3/4 cup greek yogurt or 3/4 cup sour cream | 1/4 cup white flour | 1/4 teaspoon dried sage leaves | 1/4 teaspoon white flour
instructions: Prepare your ingredients. Beat the egg and pour into a wide dish. Combine the white flour, dried sage and sage and mix in the yogurt to make a firm paste. Coat the purple onion with yogurt paste and set aside. Pour the oil into a large fry pan to come up one inch up the sides. Heat on medium high until oil shimmers, then add your purple onion, saute about two minutes, until onion is soft. Stir in the rice, add sweet chili sauce, and cook until fragrant. Spoon rice into a dish. Tear off a section of the bag of brown rice, and break up smaller pieces and lay in a second dish. Add about 1 teaspoon of dry sage. Drain rice, place rice into bag, seal, and shake excess oil off. Pour egg on top of rice and stir, cover, and cook one minute more. Place egg on top of rice and cook an additional 2 or 3 minutes, until egg starts to set. Remove from heat, and top with 1 tablespoon of purple onion sprinkled with dried sage. Top with a dollop of sour cream, if desired. Serve with your favourite sweet and spicy sauce.

title: Creamy Pistachio Mustard
ingredients: 2 tablespoons coarse grain mustard ( or to taste ) | 1 1/2 cups water chestnuts, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons green cardamoms ( or 2 tbs of ground cardamom ) | 3 tablespoons pistachios or 3 tablespoons cashews ( see note in description )
instructions: Heat a saucepan over medium high heat. Add mustard and nuts.

Random Ingredients: green onion,green tomato,parsnip,maraschino cherry,plain nonfat yogurt,mushroom,flat leaf parsley,dark sesame oil
title: Yogurt and Parsnip Kebabs
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs green tomatoes, cut into 1/4-inch slices | 1 1/4 lbs parsnips, peeled and cut into 1/4-inch slices | 2 green onions, cut into 1/4-inch slices | 1/3 cup mushroom, sliced | 2 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, roughly chopped | 1/4 cup light dark sesame oil | 1/2 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh maraschino cherry
instructions: Light your grill. Combine all the ingredients in a large bowl, and transfer to a sheet of waxed paper. Refrigerate the vegetables, covered, for at least 30 minutes or, for up to 2 hours. Thread vegetables onto 8 skewers, arranging them on soaked skewers. Cook kebabs on grill for 30 minutes, or until they are cooked to your liking. Serve with yogurt and cherries.

title: Totally Fried Rice Noodles & Curry
ingredients: 1/3 cup dried fenugreek seeds | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 2 tablespoons amaretto ( or other almond-flavored liqueur ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | enough uncooked rice noodles to cover
instructions: Soak fenugreek in warm water until soft. Drain. Combine in blender with all other ingredients except noodles. Blend till smooth. Heat about 1/4 of oil in large skillet or wok over medium heat. Add rice noodles. Stir fry noodles till light brown spots appear over surface, about 30 seconds or so. Remove from oil and drain on paper towels. Reheat oil over medium heat. Pour curry into oil and fry till hot, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: black mushroom,pork shoulder,filet beef,garlic,black bean,watercress,poblano chile
title: Tacitos Verde
ingredients: 1/2 pound smoked pork shoulder | 12 large dried black mushrooms, rinsed and sliced | 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 1 1/2 cups water | 2 cloves garlic, minced | 1 1/2 pounds filet of beef, cut into strips | 1/2 cup chopped watercress
instructions: Preheat an oven to 360 degrees f. Place pork shoulder in a large, deep skillet, and place over medium high heat. Cook, turning occasionally, until well browned, about 10 minutes. Stir in mushrooms and black beans, and cook 1 minute more. In a small mixing bowl, stir together half the water and half of the garlic. Pour this into the skillet with mushrooms and black beans.
