Toss with the pork and watercress. Spread pork and bean mixture on a baking sheet, and bake 3 hours in the preheated oven. Remove from the oven, and let stand 10 minutes, to allow juices to settle. Serve with tortillas and green vegetables.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper,milk chocolate,quinoa,mozzarella cheese,italian herb seasoning,flour,pancetta,ancho chile powder
title: Cheesy Quinoa Pizza-Quinoa Bake
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 0.5 can condensed milk chocolate | 1/2 - 3/4 cup sliced pancetta | 1 teaspoon italian herb seasoning ( or other seasoning ) | 2 teaspoons dried ancho chile powder | 1 -2 pinch chili pepper ( optional ) | 1/3 cup cheese, shredded | 1 1/3 cups shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Cook quinoa according to package directions. Meanwhile, melt chocolate and pancetta in small saute pan and set aside. When quinoa is done, mix with chocolate mixture and spread onto 11 inch pizza pan or your baking sheet. Sprinkle with cheese, then top with remaining cheese. Bake at 375°f for 15 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool.

title: Beer Pizza II
ingredients: 1/2 cup beer, or as needed | 1/2 package frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | 1 (.55 ounce ) package fast rising yeast
instructions: Pour beer into a 1 quart glass measure. Place thawed pastry on top of beer. Sprinkle mozzarella cheese on top of dough. Press the edges of the dough over the cheese, covering completely. Turn dough over and tap lightly on the counter. Gently stretch dough to form a 12x18 inch rectangle. Cover dough with a damp cloth, and let rise in a warm place until doubled in volume, about 1 hour. Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup water in a small bowl. Gently punch down dough, and allow to rest for 5 minutes. Turn out onto a floured surface, and shape into a 12 inch long pizza crust. Cover dough with a cloth, and allow to rise in a warm place 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Bake dough on a floured pizza screen for 15 minutes in the preheated oven. Turn out on a floured pizza screen, and stretch dough over the dough to form a 12 inch long pizza crust. Sprinkle mozzarella cheese on top of dough, and place 12 inch pizza on the center of the crust. Place dough over the cheese, and spread as necessary to cover the entire pizza.

title: Easy Banana Salad Dressing
ingredients: 2 bananas, peeled | 1 teaspoon marinade
instructions: Boil the bananas for 4 minutes. Take out of the water, remove the bananas and dice with a potato masher. To serve, place the bananas on top of a salad bowl. Sprinkle some of the marinade over them and serve.

title: Baked Beans for Two
ingredients: 1 lb dried pinto bean, washed, picked over, picked over to remove stones | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Place the beans in a large pan and cover with cold water. The water should just cover the beans. Add enough cold water to cover them by 2 inches. Bring to the boil over high heat, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 hour. Drain beans and transfer to a large oven proof dish,. Add all remaining ingredients to the pan. Cook over very gentle heat, stirring occasionally, until they are heated through. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: baking powder,white breadcrumb,basmati rice,tomato soup,bird eye chile
title: Yummy Baked Tomatoes
ingredients: 6 large tomatoes ( i like the ones in the freezer cut 1/2 inch slices ) | 4 slices white breadcrumbs | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 1 -2 fresh birds eye chile ( optional, depending on your heat tolerance ) | 1 can tomato soup, warmed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Place tomatoes on a lightly oiled baking dish. In a bowl mix together bread crumbs, baking powder, and chile. Spread one third of this topping on top of the tomatoes.

title: Dry Rub
ingredients: 1/4 cup chili sauce | 2 tablespoons sake | 1 teaspoon chili paste or 1 1/2 teaspoons dry crushed red chili flakes | 1 teaspoon herbes de provence | 1/4 teaspoon smoked spanish mixed spice | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 tablespoon fresh chives, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Store in an airtight container.

title: Broccoli in Oil
ingredients: 1 head broccoli | 1/2 cup oil
instructions: Wash the broccoli and separate into florets. Cut the florets into smaller pieces. In a wok or deep fryer, heat the oil. When the oil is hot, add the broccoli and fry for 2 to 3 minutes. Toss with a fork or stir fry in a separate pan or wok fry the broccoli with the oil. The broccoli should be crisp tender.

title: Easy Jalapeno Chicken
ingredients: 1 whole chicken tenders | 1 can diced jalapenos or 1 can diced jalapenos
instructions: Put a large skillet on medium high and add chicken tenders and chopped jalapenos. Spraying the chicken tenders with a non oil cooking spray on the outside of the tenders after turning over. Once the chicken is done flip over the tenders and then return it to the skillet. The goal is to coat all the chicken with the jalapeno juice. Cover and cook over medium heat or until chicken is thoroughly cooked and no longer pink inside.

Random Ingredients: serrano chilies,pork tenderloin,mace,orange marmalade,white sugar,whipping cream,spam,allspice
title: Spicy Spam and Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 4 pork tenderloins ( loin ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 1/2 teaspoon white sugar | 3 ounces cooked spam, finely chopped | 1/4 cup orange marmalade | 1 tablespoon whipping cream | 1/2 teaspoon minced serrano chilies
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f place beef tenderloins between 2 sheets of plastic wrap with meaty side up. Score deeply with sharp knife. Combine ground mace, allspice and sugar, and then rub spice mixture on both sides of meat. Rub mixture into meat and then place on greased baking sheet. Bake for 1 1/2 hours, basting every 10 minutes. Cool. Whisk orange marmalade, cream and chilies in small bowl. Remove meat and carefully slice, spooning sauce over slices. Serve at once.

title: Greek Style Capers
ingredients: 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 1/4 cup capers, drained
instructions: In a small saucepan, mix vinegar and capers. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat, and simmer 5 minutes. Cool capers slightly to make room for dipping.

title: Macaroni and Chicken Salad
ingredients: 3 cups dry elbow macaroni | 3 skinless, boneless chicken breasts | 1 cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes | 1 cup sliced ripe plantains | 1 jar sliced apple wedges, divided | 1 cup hot sauce, or as desired
instructions: Cook macaroni in a large pot of boiling water until tender yet firm, about 8 minutes, and drain. Drain.

title: Broccoli & Masa Mix
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb broccoli, cut florets and stalk chopped into bite size pieces | 1 cup masa corn flour | 1 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Cook broccoli pieces with water about 2 - 3 minutes. In a large bowl, mix masa, turmeric.

title: Bourekakia
ingredients: 1 medium roasting chicken, cut into 8 serving pieces | 10 ounces white wine | 1 package frozen phyllo dough
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place chicken on a sheet of waxed paper and coat the chicken pieces with white wine. Arrange in a shallow baking dish. Place in the oven and turn oven temperature to 400 degrees f. Bake 25 minutes, or until chicken is tender and juices run clear. Cover loosely with foil and reduce temperature to 300 degrees f. Continue to baste chicken 3 to 4 times during cooking. Remove chicken from oven, uncover and set aside. Increase temperature to 450 degrees f. Bake chicken an additional 5 to 10 minutes, or until chicken is opaque.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,canadian bacon,wasabi mustard,butter,sugar snap pea,chicken breast half
title: Smooth and Broiled Canadian Bacon Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter | 1 tablespoon wasabi mustard | 2 tablespoons scotch whisky or 2 tablespoons dry cider | 1 tablespoon sugar snap peas, chopped | 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves ( about 1lb ) | 1 cup broccoli floret, coarsely chopped
instructions: Heat oven to 375f degrees. In small saucepan, melt 1 tbsp of butter, blend in mustard, sugar, snap peas and remaining 1 tbsp butter. Spread wasabi mixture over both sides of chicken. Place in single layer on a baking sheet. Bake until cooked through, about 15 - 20 minutes. While chicken is cooking, place remaining 1 tbsp butter in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add the broccoli and cook, stirring often, about 3 minutes until crisp tender. Spoon broccoli broccoli over baked chicken. Bake until top is golden brown and sauce is bubbling, about 5 - 10 minutes longer. Transfer to a serving bowl.

title: Hominy Pie II
ingredients: 2 pounds yellow hominy, drained and rinsed | 3/4 cup mexican blend cheese, divided | 1 cup heavy cream | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar for dusting
instructions: Place the rinsed rinsed rinsed rinsed rinsed rinsed rinsed rinsed rinsed rinsed rinsed rinsed rinsed rinsed rinsed rinsed rinsed mexican cheese into a slow cooker, pour in the cream, and stir in the confectioners' sugar. Cover and cook on high setting until the rinsed rinsed rinsed rinsed rinsed rinsed rinsed rinsed rinsed rinsed rinsed rinses have turned light brown, about 5 hours. Turn off cooker and allow cooker to set for about 1 hour to absorb juice. Turn mixture into a pie crust, or a medium, deep dish pie shell. Refrigerate crust until cold, about 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: raspberry preserve,parmesan cheese,soya sauce,pecorino romano cheese
title: The Perfect Raspberry Cheese Dome
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups pecorino romano cheese ( dry grated ) | 1/2 cup soya sauce | 1/2 cup raspberry preserves | 1/4 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese, for topping ( optional )
instructions: Using a 1 cup size measuring cup, press the romano cheese, getting all the cheese in the cracks. You should have about 1/2 cup of crumbs. Add the soya and rasmi into a bowl and mix thoroughly with a spoon or the edge of a glass or your hands. Transfer the romano mixture to a 9 in. Fold out the sides of the ramekins and set them side by side, covered with plastic wrap, in a large baking dish or a deep roasting pan lined with aluminum foil. Fill it the rest of the way with cold water. Put the dish or pan in a cold oven. Heat oven to 450 degrees fahrenheit. Carefully but quickly, poke the ramekins with a fork a couple of times so the water will not run onto the cheese. Bake for 2 1/2 to 3 minutes more, until the cheese is completely soft and starts to turn golden. Remove from oven. Transfer the dish or pan to a wire rack to cool completely. Sprinkle generously with cheese and garnish with fresh parmesan if using. Enjoy.

title: Quinoa and Cheese Quesadillas
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups quinoa | 1 can peas | 1 lb asparagus, chopped | 12 flour tortillas, 6 inch | 12 ounces ricotta cheese | 1 small avocado, peeled, sliced | 1/4 cup red wine
instructions: In a small sauce pan boil quinoa for 5 minutes, remove from heat and cover to keep warm. To serve,. Heat oven to 375°f. Rinse quinoa, drain it and let sit for 3 to 5 minutes. Combine quinoa, peas, asparagus, and half the cheese in a bowl. To assemble,. Place one tortilla on an ungreased cookie sheet, and sprinkle with half of the quinoa mixture. Top with cheese, the second tortilla, cheese, and asparagus mixture. Top with remaining quinoa mixture. Top with remaining cheese. Bake in the oven until golden brown, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: portabella mushroom,courgette,chili flake,nonfat plain yogurt,italian sausage
title: Hot Italian Sausage and Portabella Vegetables - Vegetarian
ingredients: 250 g hot italian sausage | 1 cup portabella mushroom | 1 cup courgette | 2 tablespoons nonfat plain yogurt | 1/4 teaspoon chili flakes
instructions: Grill or cook sausage until browned. Cut mushrooms and courgettes into thin slices. Bring pan juices, mushrooms, and sausage to the boil in a pan. Reduce heat and simmer until sausage is cooked and vegetables are tender. Combine yogurt, and chili flakes in a small bowl. Toss with vegetables and serve.

title: Apple Turnip and Bean Cactus With Hominy, Garlic and Tart Apples
ingredients: 1 quart hominy, canned | 2 teaspoons garlic oil ( or other cooking oil ) | 1 package frozen tart apples, peeled, halved and sliced | 12 ounces dried beans sprouts | topping ( hominy, cheese and tuna ) | 2 peeled chopped garlic cloves
instructions: In a large pot over medium high heat, bring 1 quart of water to a boil and add the hominy beans and 1 tsp of the garlic oil. When it comes to a boil, remove the soup from the heat and cover until the beans are done. Meanwhile, in another pot, bring the remaining oil to a high temperature. Add the apples and remaining garlic and saute 5 minutes. Add the bean sprouts. When you are ready to serve the soup, put the soup, drained beans and the juice back in the pot, stir, and simmer the soup for 15 - 20 minutes or until it is heated through. The soup can be served warm or chilled.

title: Tofu and Tofu
ingredients: 500 g firm tofu, drained, rinsed, and cut into 12 squares
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180c/350f/gas put the tofu into a roasting tin, and bake them for 10 minutes and then put them into the oven for a further 10 minutes. Allow them to cool a little, then scoop out and let them cool. When you are ready to serve them, spread the tofu on bread/croutons/basil leaves and top with the tofu pieces. Serve with a mixed salad.

Random Ingredients: peach preserve,parsnip,single cream,white pepper,cream cheese,graham cracker crumb,cornmeal,thyme sprig
title: Southern Style Peppered Crisp Parsnips
ingredients: 4 ounces cream cheese, at room temperature | 2 tablespoons canned peaches in syrup ( reserve 1/4 cup of syrup ) or 2 tablespoons fresh peach preserves, slightly packed ( reserve 1/4 cup of syrup ) | 1/4 lb graham cracker crumbs | 2/3 cup cornmeal | 1 tablespoon fresh parsley, chopped ( flat-leaf, large-leaf, dried ) | 1 teaspoon fresh thyme sprig | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | fresh parsley sprig, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 f. In a large bowl, combine cream cheese and peaches with 1/4 cup reserved syrup. Add the crumbs, cornmeal, parsley, thyme, and pepper. Using your hands, work mixture to a firm dough. If sticky, knead for a few minutes. Place on an ungreased baking sheet and bake for 20 minutes or until golden brown. Garnish with parsley sprigs and serve warm.

title: Tropical Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 package spaghetti | 1/2 cup fresh pineapple tidbits | 1/2 lemon, juiced | 1 red bell pepper, chopped | 1 tablespoon crushed dried mint | 1 teaspoon orange zest
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook spaghetti in boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through yet firm to the bite, about 8 minutes.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,white cheese,rice wine,tilapia fillet,gruyere cheese,kielbasa,peanut sauce
title: Pan-Fried Tilapia With Gruyere Cheese
ingredients: 2 tilapia fillets | 1 teaspoon peanut sauce | 2 tablespoons hot peanut butter or 2 tablespoons ketchup | 1/4 cup white cheese, melted ( you can use swiss if you like ) | 1 teaspoon garam masala | kirby cucumber slices or white sliced lemons, to garnish ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon rice wine or 1 teaspoon dry sherry
instructions: Lightly coat a large nonstick skillet with oil. Place tilapia in pan and stir fry over medium heat until dark golden brown. Remove to paper towels to drain. Combine ketchup, cheese, and garam masala in a shallow bowl. Drizzle over tilapia and serve immediately. Garnish with cucumber if using.

title: Courgette and Brie Cheese Baked Rice Nests
ingredients: 2 courgettes | 2 cups chinese noodles | 25 g cheddar cheese | 150 g brie cheese, cut into small cubes | 1/4 cup rice vinegar
instructions: Cut ends off courgettes and cut in half lengthways and then crossways. Scatter celery cut straight across and then into a large microwaverowave proof bowl with the noodles. Drizzle over the vinegar and mix together until well combined and then microwave on high for 8 mins until tender and heated through. Spoon mixture into bowls and sprinkle over cheeses. Serve immediately.

title: Smoked Haddock With Baby Spinach
ingredients: 800 g smoked haddock fillets, skinned | 1 cup baby spinach
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Line a large casserole dish with foil and arrange the fish fillets on top. Cover tightly with foil and bake for 10 minutes. Carefully transfer fish to a board and set aside. Scatter the spinach overtop the fish. Return to oven and bake, uncovered for a further 15 minutes, or until the spinach has cooked through and the fish flakes easily with a fork.

title: Stuffed Aubergines (Australian)
ingredients: 4 aubergines | 1 pint whipping cream | 750 g good quality minced beef steaks
instructions: Peel off the beak and discard the hard skin from each aubergine but leave the flesh attached. Wash the aubergines under cold running water and remove the hard shell and cut in half lengthways. Remove the soft white portion of the flesh, and discard the rest. Place each half in a warm oven, with the cream, and grill for 15 minutes or until browned and soft and the juices run. Cut a slit lengthways in the side of each, and lay a small piece of beef inside each. Replace the beef, and replace the skin over, taking care not to burn the juices. Serve with boiled or steamed fresh potatoes and your favourite vegetable accompaniment.

title: Salsa II
ingredients: 2 apples, diced | 5 bananas, peeled and cut in half | 5 leeks, white and green parts, cut into 1-inch chunks | 1 package ortega taco seasoning | 1 package dark chocolate, chopped
instructions: Place all ingredients in a medium bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 1 hour. Serve warm.

title: Coco Leaf (Kale) English Kale for Breakfast or Dinner
ingredients: 6 leaves kale ( leaves only ) | 4 tablespoons sesame oil
instructions: In a nonstick frypan, heat the sesame oil. Fry the kale until limp. Stir often to prevent burning. Remove from frypan and drain on paper towels. Pour desired amount of sesame oil on kale. Serve immediately or refrigerate a portion of the mixture to keep from drying out.

title: Pasta Salad
ingredients: fresh vegetable | 3 tablespoons marinara sauce ( for those craving extra protein ) | 12 ounces fresh frozen mixed vegetables
instructions: Boil mixed vegetables in salted water until tender, about 5 - 10 minutes. Drain and mix well with the marinara sauce. Serve cold.

Random Ingredients: baby bok choy,oregano,red wine,monterey jack cheese
title: Baby Bok Choy and Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 bag baby bok choy | 1/2 cup red wine | 2 tablespoons oregano | 1/2 cup monterey jack cheese
instructions: Cook bok choy until tender add water if leaves start to crisp. Drain and remove leaves. Blend in a blender, red wine, and oregano. Pour into greased pie plate, and top with cheese. Bake at 350 for 20 minutes, until hot.

title: Roasted Poblano Peppers
ingredients: 6 poblano peppers | 1 pint cherry, pitted, halved | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Remove stems from peppers and halve peppers lengthwise, leaving peppers attached. Place peppers in a single layer, skin side down, on a foil lined baking sheet. Roast peppers in the preheated oven, turning often, until skin is mostly blackened, 30 minutes to 1 hour. Remove peppers from oven. Place peppers on a cookie sheet and roast in hot water for 15 minutes. Turn peppers and roast until skin is charred and peppers are charred all over, 15 to 20 minutes more. Transfer roasted peppers to a bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Let peppers sweat until cooled, about 15 minutes. Remove skins and seeds from peppers. Place peppers in a bowl and add the cherry halves, brown sugar and 1 cup water. Mix well. Line a baking sheet with foil. Spoon peppers into foil lined baking sheet, spreading the cherry mixture over the tops of peppers. Bake peppers in preheated oven for 1 hour and 30 minutes, or until peppers are tender.

title: Onion Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 1/2 lb emmenthaler cheese, cubed
instructions: Put the cheese cubes in a blender jar or colander. In a small bowl combine the rice vinegar and vinegar. Mix well. Add the onion and cheese. Blend until blended.

Random Ingredients: ricotta,enoki mushroom,vegan margarine,pork tenderloin,tomato,plum tomato,leg lamb,spice
title: Lamb with Smoked Lamb Gravy (Vegan Mmm Chee)
ingredients: 500 g lean leg of lamb, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon vegan margarine | 1/2 cup roughly chopped canned plum tomatoes | 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice | 1/2 cup shredded mixed dried herbs ( sage, oregano, rosemary ) | 8 -10 leaves enoki mushrooms ( small red mushrooms ) | 1 tablespoon vegan margarine | 2 tablespoons ricotta | 2 cups roughly chopped canned tomatoes | 2 tablespoons chopped mixed spice | 1 tablespoon dried mixed spice | 1/4 cup shredded vegan margarine | 1/2 cup chopped plum tomato | 2 tablespoons vegetarian ground beef
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180&#730.

Random Ingredients: beef,parsley flake,beef gravy,farmer cheese,tart apple,horseradish,rosemary sprig
title: A Scotsman's Pie
ingredients: 2 -3 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 1 -2 tablespoon dried rosemary sprig, crushed | 1 -2 lb shaved beef ( i use about 3 cups ) | 1/2 lb farmer cheese | 1 -2 lb sliced cooked apple | 1 -3 tablespoon dried parsley flakes | 1 1/2 - 2 cups beef gravy or 1 1/2-2 cups beef gravy, for dipping
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Heat 1 tablespoon of the horseradish paste in a skillet over medium heat for 2 - 3 minutes, stirring occasionally. Then, add the rosemary, stir and cook 1 - 2 minutes or until fragrant. Set aside to cool. Cut the beef into 1/4 thick slices and slice the farmer cheese thinly. In a mixing bowl, combine the cheeses, apples, and parsley. Combine the cooled horseradish mixture and the beef with the cheese, and pour over the beef mixture. Place the pie in a dish, cover loosely with foil, and bake for about 1 hour or until the center is bubbling.

title: French Pear Soup
ingredients: 4 pears | 1 soup bone | 1 teaspoon whole cloves
instructions: Remove the pears and place into a small pot. Add any other shell you like. Bring pears to a simmer. Add clove. Let simmer about 20 minutes. Take pears out and throw them into a blender and pulse til the texture is a little bit smoother. Return the pears to the pot and stir well. Add soup bone. Simmer 30 minutes over the lowest possible heat. Serve warm with toast.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chile pepper,button mushroom,tequila,banana,cumin,pickling spice,white bean
title: Cowboy Party Beans
ingredients: 16 ounces white beans, canned, drained with | 11 fluid ounces beer | 2 bananas, medium | 2 large pickling spices | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 15 ounces sliced pimento stuffed green chile peppers | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers, drained
instructions: Wash beans. In a large bowl, mash beans with beer until mixture is smooth. Fold in bananas, pickling spices, ground cumin, green chilies and tomatoes.

title: Nepalese Piri Piri Piri
ingredients: 2 tablespoons finely chopped serrano peppers | 1 tablespoon lime juice | 2 teaspoons bottled lime juice
instructions: Puree the chopped serrano peppers, lime juice, and lime juice in a food processor. Transfer to a bowl, and stir in ground piri³ until thoroughly combined. Cover, and refrigerate for flavors to blend, 2 hours to overnight.

title: Tibetan Munchy and Spicy Cabbage Salad #RSC
ingredients: 1 lb red cabbage, finely shredded | 1/2 cup green chili, chopped | 1/4 cup sweet ghee or 1/4 cup margarine | 1 1/2 tablespoons taco seasoning | 1 cup graham crackers ( optional )
instructions: In a large skillet, stir fry cabbage in hot ghee, stirring frequently until lightly browned. Remove from heat and stir in taco seasonings and remaining ingredients.. Serve warm or cool.

title: Diane's Pronto Pasta
ingredients: 1 medium sized ziti pasta ( or other short pasta ) | 1 -2 tablespoon mustard seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried onion salt | 1 teaspoon vanilla bean | 1 large cauliflower, cut into florets
instructions: Bring 6 quarts water to a boil in a large pot, then add the pasta and cook for 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Pressed Shallots
ingredients: 5 large shallots | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1/2 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Peel and cut shallots into 3 - 4 inch wide wedges. Arrange in a steaming basket or casserole dish. Add worcestershire sauce and paprika. Bring to a boil, cover and steam for about 20 minutes. Uncover and let steam for another 10 - 15 minutes, or until shallots are tender. You may want to make an'swiss roll' to ensure even cooking of the shallots when they have steamed. Let rest until cool, then refrigerate.

title: Sweet Soy Balls
ingredients: 1 package vanilla wafers | 2 teaspoons soya sauce or 2 teaspoons soy sauce | 1 green cardamom pod
instructions: Place the cardamom pods in the center of a piece of cheesecloth and snip about a inch off the top of the cardamom, making sure the core is removed. Place the whole stick of cardamom in the saucepan over medium heat and cook about 5 minutes, until the cardamom pods are fragrant. Remove the cardamom pods. Transfer the cardamom to a food processor or blender and blend until smooth. Add the soya sauce and pulse until the sauce is as smooth as you wish. If it’s thick, add a little water. Place the vanilla wafer in a small bowl and press a tablespoon of the soy mixture onto each. Sprinkle some more soy mixture over and knead until the dough is firm. Shape into walnut size balls. Let cool for about 20 minutes, and then roll in the remaining soy mixture and roll in coloured sugar. Cover with plastic wrap or a clean towel and refrigerate.

title: Grilled Rice Cracker Salmon
ingredients: 1 teaspoon minced garlic | 2 tablespoons chopped green olives | 1/4 green bell pepper, chopped | 1/4 orange, zested and juiced | 1 green olives, chopped | 1 orange, sliced | 2/3 cup cracked round crackers | 1 pound smoked salmon steaks
instructions: In a large resealable plastic bag, combine the garlic, 2 tablespoons green olives, bell pepper, orange zest, and olives. Add the orange slices, reseal, and seal. Refrigerate overnight. Preheat an outdoor grill for medium high heat and lightly oil the grate. Remove the salmon from the bag and arrange it on the prepared grill grate. Brush and spray the fish with cooking spray, then grill, uncovered, until the fish flakes easily with a fork, about 7 minutes. Serve the salmon steaks hot.

Random Ingredients: potato starch,vegetable oil,oregano leaf,radish,okra,parmesan cheese,brown mustard seed
title: Vegetables at Home With Parmesan and Mustard Seeds
ingredients: 2 tablespoons potato starch | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 2 -3 lbs fresh okra, ends trimmed and halved if large | 1/4 teaspoon brown mustard seeds | 6 -8 small radishes, peeled ( or 4-8 medium, green, red and or or yellow )
instructions: In a medium skillet, stir together the potato starch and oil over medium heat until mixture is smooth and no lumps form, about 2 minutes. Add the oregano, okra, mustard seeds and radishes and cook until heated through. Toss with hot pasta, adding a few tablespoons of water if necessary, and serve immediately.

title: Faux Dressing - French Style
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped fresh parsley | 1/2 cup season-all salt
instructions: In a small container, mix together the parsley and seasoning. Stir to coat. Use to let dressing develop. Store covered in refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: mayonnaise,tapioca starch,mustard powder,parsnip,flour tortilla,soymilk,chicken bouillon cube,curry powder
title: Curried Parsnips and Parsley Fajitas
ingredients: 2 cups parsnips, peeled diced | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 3 tablespoons flour | 2 tablespoons mayonnaise, regular | 2 teaspoons mustard powder | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1/2 teaspoon instant rice-style prepared tapioca starch | 1/2 cup soymilk
instructions: In a saute pan, add broth cube, parsnips and bring to a boil. Cover and reduce heat to medium low. Simmer for 30 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in mustard, curry powder and rice bran. Mix in the mayonnaise and keep warm until serving time. In a small bowl, mix the tapioca starch with a little soymilk until smooth. Add to the parsnips and stir to coat. Serve fajitas with pico de gallo and salsa for dipping.

title: Baked Salmon With Kidney Beans and Smoked Fennel Seed
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 2 teaspoons fennel seeds | 3 lbs fresh boneless meat ( smoked salmon ) ( optional ) | 1 salmon, halved and cut crosswise into 1/4 inch slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Combine first 4 ingredients in a food processor until a coarse paste forms. Spread paste in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Arrange salmon over bean mixture and top with remaining bean mixture. Bake until heated through and flake with a fork, about 20 minutes.

title: Spicy Fried Fish
ingredients: 4 white fish fillets | 1 egg | 1 tablespoon dried ancho chili, or more to taste | 1 teaspoon dried thyme ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons ground ginger | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke ( optional )
instructions: Cut fish fillets into smaller portions as desired. Whisk egg, ground ancho chili, thyme, ginger, and liquid smoke together in a small bowl. Dip fish in egg mixture.

title: Feta-trout and Feta Burgers
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh turkish-style trout, cleaned and scaled if possible | 1/2 lb fresh shelled pistachio-stuffed green olives, sliced thickly | 1/8 lb peshissofeta cheese, crumbled ( you can substitute with other feta cheese if you wish ) | 1/4 lb snow peas or 1/4 lb sugar snap peas, sliced diagonally | 8 -12 small warmed tortillas | 1/2 cup dark beer ( or milk ) | 1 -2 tablespoon sake ( optional, depending on your taste )
instructions: Grill trout and pistachios, about 5 or 6 minutes per side, or according to your preference. While trout is grilling, heat oil in a medium non stick skillet. Add to skillet 1/2 cup fetta and cook, turning, about 5 to 7 minutes. Transfer to a plate. Add 1/2 cups olives to skillet, cooking 1 minute. Sprinkle on snow peas or sugar snap peas and toss quickly to coat with pimentos. Toast tortillas on both sides under grill and keep warm, keep hot by covering loosely with foil for 5 to 8 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cashew nut,coconut oil,guava juice,kidney bean,picante sauce,orange peel
title: Fiesta Bean Dip With Cashew Nuts and Guava
ingredients: 1 can refried beans | 2/3 cup canned guava juice | 1/2 cup picante sauce ( your choice, mild or medium ) | 1/2 cup cashew nuts, roughly chopped | 1 grated orange peel | 1/2 cup coconut oil
instructions: In a medium sized skillet, saute cashew nuts in coconut oil over high heat until lightly charred about 2 minutes, set aside. In a large bowl, combine beans, guava juice, picante sauce, nuts, orange peel, and coconut oil. Stir until well combined and serve topped with cashew nuts.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,grand marnier,rice wine,ham,beef brisket,apricot,puff pastry
title: Crispy Hot Sandwiches
ingredients: 5 lbs trimmed trimmed corned beef brisket, with fat | 2 1/4 cups chunky salsa | 1/3 cup grand marnier or 1/3 cup orange juice | 1 tablespoon rice wine or 1 tablespoon dry sherry | 1 lb thinly sliced cooked ham or 1 lb bacon, cut into 1/2 inch dice | 1 package frozen puff pastry sheets, thawed ( 1 package ) or ( 11 ounce ) package frozen pastry shells, thawed ( 1 package )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Cut brisket into 4 portions and arrange in lightly greased 9 x 13 inch baking dish. Combine salsa, grand marnier, rice wine, ham or bacon and pour over brisket. Bake 1 hour. Remove from oven, cover and return to oven to bake at 325 degrees f for 1 1/2 hours, until meat is tender. Transfer meat to cutting board and let stand 10 minutes. Using sharp knife, cut brisket thin. Combine slices with reserved sauce. Use remaining sauce to serve sandwiches as desired. To serve, warm pastry shells as directed on package.

Random Ingredients: pancake mix,romaine lettuce leaf,pumpkin,red chilies,sesame seed,cumin,ham
title: Garlicky Pumpkin Pizza
ingredients: 200 g pumpkin, peeled & cubed | 1/2 cup sweet pancake mix | 1 tablespoon ground cumin | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds | 2 red chilies, seeded & cut lengthways into very thin slices | 4 romaine lettuce leaves | 20 ham slices
instructions: Place pumpkin in colander, & sprinkle with salt & leave for 30 minutes. Drain & toss with pancake mix & cumin. Grill pumpkin & chillies for 5 - 10 minutes or until very crisp. Cut lettuce into rounds & arrange the ham slices over the base of a pizza base. Scatter pumpkin & chillies over top. Cover with tomato ketchup. Bake in a moderate oven for 15 minutes. Remove from oven & cut through the centre.

Random Ingredients: spinach,bean sprout,pinto bean,water chestnut,mustard powder,wine,beef rib,star anise
title: Beef Ribs and Beans
ingredients: 2 lbs beef ribs, trimmed of fat | 2 1/2 cups pinto beans, soaked for 4 hours and drained | 1 cup fresh spinach, washed and chopped | 1/2 cup water chestnut, chopped | 1/4 cup pickled spinach - rinsed, dried and torn | 1/2 cup bean sprouts | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 star anise
instructions: Preheat the oven to 500 degrees f. Place the ribs on a greased baking sheet. Bake at 500 degrees f for 40 to 50 minutes, or until cooked. When meat is done, remove from oven and cut into 2 pieces. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of water to a boil. Drop in the beans, stir and cook one minute. Drain, rinse with cool water and drain again. Combine the beans, meat, and spinach in a large bowl for a gravy or soup. Sprinkle the mustard over the beans and meat.

title: Fried Masa Tacos
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried apricot, cut pieces about 3 cm | 7 -8 dried chili peppers | 3 tablespoons masa harina | 4 teaspoons wasabi paste
instructions: Place the apricots and chili peppers in a bowl and cover with water. Soak, covered, overnight. The following day, remove the peppers and stems and discard. Place the masa harina and wasabi paste in a small bowl. Drain the soaked peppers, making sure to squeeze out the excess water. In a large skillet heat 1 - 2 tbsps oil over medium heat, adding in 1 tblsps of oil. Fry the chilies until the chili pods are just starting to split open. Carefully remove the peppers, and let them cool. Place the dried chilies on a plate and cover with a wet towel. Place the cooked peppers in the heated oil, and let them sit for about 15 minutes. Drain off excess oil and remove the chili pods. Spoon the masa harina mixture into a large bowl in increments of about 5 balls. Flatten each ball into a disk. Toast each taco in a toaster oven or toaster oven until golden brown. Serve right away.

Random Ingredients: roquefort cheese,sun tomato oil,golden syrup,beef tenderloin steak,single cream,pineapple chunk
title: Beef Tenderloin - Croquefort
ingredients: 1 kg beef tenderloin steak, trimmed | 2 tablespoons roquefort cheese, crumbled | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 2 tablespoons single cream | 120 g pineapple chunks, drained | 6 sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained, rinsed
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Using a meat tenderiser, pound beef 1/2 to 1/2 inch thick between 2 sheets of baking paper and set aside. Combine cheese, golden syrup, cream and pineapple in a large bowl and pour over beef. Roll beef in cheese mixture, ensuring that the surface is completely covered. Secure with wooden picks, string or toothpicks and place on a wire rack in a roasting pan. Bake for 45 minutes or until cooked as desired.

Random Ingredients: chili flake,taco seasoning mix,white sugar,arborio rice
title: Taco Rice III
ingredients: 2 packages taco seasoning mix | 2 1/2 cups dry arborio rice | 1 cup white sugar | 1/4 teaspoon dried chili flakes, or to taste
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Pour the taco seasoning packet onto the bottom of the baking dish, and spread to cover the bottom. Cover the rice evenly with taco seasoning on top. Cover with a layer of sugar, and pour chili flakes over the rice. When the oven is hot, cover, and bake in the preheated oven until the rice is tender and the syrup has been absorbed, about 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: tart cooking apple,boston lettuce,black tea,anchovy fillet
title: Aphrodisiac Red Sausage Roll Ups
ingredients: 1/2 cup black tea, warmed to body temperature | 1 small tart cooking apple, such as fuji, peeled, cored and finely diced | 2 teaspoons anchovy fillets, drained | 2 leaves inner boston lettuce
instructions: Stir tea and hot apple until tea dissolves. Place a plate on a work surface and top it with a serving platter. Place the apple in the center, followed by anchovies. Cover with lettuce leaves and roll around the apple until the lettuce wraps are tightly closed. Roll up the sausages, starting at the short end and rolling each end in the same fashion as the plate until the rolls are well stuffed.

title: Elegant Easy Chunky Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 cup whipping cream
instructions: Empty soup can into a saucepan, stir in whipping cream, bring to a boil. Place over medium heat, stir and set aside until ready to serve.

title: Giada's Asiago Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1/2 cup grated asiago cheese | 1 teaspoon cumin seed
instructions: In a skillet over medium heat, toast cumin seeds until golden brown. This should take 2 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside. Place the asiago cheese into the bowl of a blender and process until smooth. Stir in the cumin seeds and process until mixture comes together. Cover and refrigerate for up to 2 days before serving.

Random Ingredients: cajun seasoning,lemongrass,vegetable oil cooking spray,ham hock,beef bouillon cube,red chili pepper
title: Lemongrass Beef (Thai Stir-Fry)
ingredients: 1 lb beef bone ham hock or 1 lb other lean meat | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 tablespoon crushed dried red chili pepper | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh lemongrass | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 tablespoon cajun seasoning
instructions: Cut meat into thin strips. Place meat strips in a resealable plastic bag& add chili, and lemongrass. Shake to coat. Refrigerate overnight. Spray a nonstick or nonstick fry pan lightly with pam. Add a few teaspoons of oil to pan.

title: Mexican Steak
ingredients: 3 lbs beef, cut into strips | 1 cup guacamole | 1 cup ranch dressing mix ( not tub of ranch dip mix ) | 1 tablespoon smoked paprika | 1/2 green bell peppers, finely chopped or 1/2 red bell pepper, diced
instructions: Pour oil into a large frying pan. In batches, saute the meat in the oil until browned on both sides.. Remove meat from the heat. Add the guacamole, ranch ranch mix, smoked paprika and bell pepper. Sprinkle with paprika if used. Place the entire mixture into a shallow baking dish. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,thyme,head cabbage,pineapple juice,tostada shell,cocoa,fine breadcrumb
title: Tostadas (Cabbage Rolls)
ingredients: 1 medium head of cabbage | 1/3 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh thyme | 1/4 cup unsweetened pineapple juice | 1 tablespoon soft unsweetened cocoa | 2 tablespoons heavy whipping cream | 12 large tortillas or 12 large tostada shells
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Remove and discard the outer leaves of the cabbage. Separate leaves from center of the cabbage by carefully slicing across with a mandoline or knife. Cut out the core and discard. Core only the center of the leaf and reserve. Place the torn leaves into a large bowl of cold water and drain for 10 minutes, then drain again. Repeat the process with additional leaves to yield 24 to 36 rolls. Place the remaining ingredients except tortillas and cream in a medium saucepan over medium high heat. When the mixture comes to a boil, reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 5 to 10 minutes to blend flavors. Remove from heat. Place tortillas on a work surface with raised sides facing each other. Place about 2 tablespoons of the cabbage mixture in the center of each tortilla. Roll the tortillas tightly around the filling and pinch ends to seal. Place the rolled tortillas on a rack in a glass baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven for 20 to 25 minutes, or until crisp. Serve warm.

title: Pancake Mushrooms(Cookers at Home)
ingredients: 6 -8 medium mushrooms | honey or sugar
instructions: Clean and trim the mushrooms. Using a pastry brush, spread a small amount of honey in the base of each mushroom. Place each mushroom on a plate. Sprinkle with sugar. Enjoy your meal.

title: Easy Hummus
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, drained | 1 large yellow squash, halved and sliced with the skin on
instructions: In a food processor or blender, puree the chickpeas with the squash until smooth. With the motor running, add the chickpea puree until well combined. Taste for salt, adding a little more if necessary. Serve with pita chips.

Random Ingredients: trout,italian plum tomato,redfish fillet,mango chutney,fruit,tabasco sauce,italian tomato paste
title: Tropical Grilled Fish
ingredients: 1/2 cup mango chutney or 1/2 cup plum tomato, chutney | 1 can italian plum tomatoes, chutney style, chopped with juice | 1 can tomato paste | 1 can truss italian cut trout, skinned and chopped | 1 tablespoon tabasco sauce ( or more if you like spicy ) | 1 can mixed fruit, drained and chopped | 1 lb frozen italian-style plum tomatoes (, cut into 1/2-inch chunks )
instructions: Mix the chutney, tomatoes, tomato paste, tom juice and tabasco to form a sauce. Add the truss italian cut trout to the sauce and allow to sit on low in the refrigerator for up to 2 hours. Place the diced plum tomatoes in a microwave safe bowl, cover with the chutney sauce and microwave on medium power about 1 1/2 minutes. Stir and simmer for 4 - 5 minutes longer. When ready to serve place the chopped tomatoes on individual serving plates. Spoon the shrimp/tomato sauce on the fillets and top with fruit. Serve with a hot crusty bread for dipping or a cracker for dipping.

Random Ingredients: bacon bit,yellow cheese,beef bouillon cube,rose water
title: Aussie Rose Dip
ingredients: 1 lb bacon bits ( real thick slices ) | 1 lb yellow cheese, cut into chunks | 1 1/2 - 2 beef bouillon cubes ( depending on cubes used ) | rose water, to taste
instructions: Crumble bacon bits into frying pan, add a bit of water if the bacon drips up. Boil until it reaches the correct texture. Add cheese, stir until it melts and is coated in crumbs. Add more water if needed, just enough to make a small dip consistency. Dip is ready to eat. Makes just over 1 cup, depends on how it is served. If you make it to a party, make sure the party plate is big enough to allow the dip to warm and hold together. Note, this can also be prepared in the slowcooker, and it just takes longer to complete. Note, as written, the yield will change depending on how much water is used. For example, the original recipe called for 2 cups of water, but i think 4 cups of water and 2 beef bouillon cubes make up this recipe.

title: Spinach Rolls
ingredients: 24 spinach leaves, chopped | 1/2 cup cheese, grated ( parmesan or colby jack are good for this ) | 1/4 cup peanut butter | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning | 3/4 cup low-fat plain yogurt
instructions: Combine spinach, cheese, peanut butter, and italian seasoning in a mixing bowl. Mix well. Shape mixture into 16 balls. Roll each in yogurt and roll in chopped peanuts. Chill several hours. These can also be refrigerated.

Random Ingredients: tofu,chicken breast half,basil leaf,half,rigatoni pasta,dill,ra el hanout spice mix
title: Moroccan Chicken & Tofu Rigatoni
ingredients: 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 1/2 pound uncooked rigatoni pasta | 1 container tofu | 1/3 cup half-and-half | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh dill | 1 teaspoon ras el hanout spice mix | 8 fresh basil leaves
instructions: Preheat an oven to 400 degrees f. Place the chicken breasts in a 9x13 inch baking dish, and sprinkle the ras el haneo over them. Cover the dish, and bake in the preheated oven for 60 minutes, or until no longer pink and juices run clear. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the rigatoni, and cook for 9 minutes, or until al dente. Drain, and stir into the cooked chicken. Return to the hot oven, and bake 10 minutes, or until the sauce is bubbly. Meanwhile, pour the tofu into a resealable baking dish that has been sprayed with cooking spray. Cover with lid. Heat in the preheated oven until the tofu is hot, and beginning to brown, about 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Cut the chicken into bite size slices. When the sauce is almost ready, pour into a blender, and blend until smooth. Pour into a gravy dish, and sprinkle with dill, ras el hanout, and basil leaves.

title: Beef Sausages With Hot Dog Dip
ingredients: 4 new york strip steaks | 4 fresh hot dog buns, toasted | 1/2 cup hot barbeque sauce | 1/4 cup peanut butter | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped coriander | 2 tablespoons mustard powder | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves
instructions: Brush steak with mustard powder. Brown slowly on both sides in remaining oil in heavy skillet. Remove from skillet and keep warm. To same skillet add barbecue sauce, peanut butter, coriander, mustard powder. Stir just until well mixed. Return to skillet. Bake at 475 degrees f for 5 - 7 minutes or until hot dogs are golden brown.

title: Green Pea and Feta Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 package frozen green peas, thawed | 1 package feta cheese, crumbled | 1 cup green olives, sliced | 2 tablespoons margarine, softened | 2 garlic cloves, minced
instructions: Place the peas, feta and olives in a bowl. Mash the cheese with a fork or potato masher. Add margarine, grated garlic. Stir in enough water to make a spreadable consistency. Place the mixture into a lightly greased 2 quart size baking dish. Bake in a 350°f oven for 15 - 20 minutes.

title: Pesto Tuna Fish Pasta
ingredients: 400 g fresh fettuccine | 400 g tuna, trimmed of fat and cut into 4 pieces | 120 g fresh pesto sauce | 30 g fresh sage leaves | 2 fresh thyme sprigs | 1 tablespoon olive, roughly chopped
instructions: Cook the pasta according to the instructions on the packet and set aside to cool slightly. Drain the pasta well, and return it to the pan with the tuna pieces and a small handful of chopped sage. Stir through the pesto and remaining chopped sage and thyme and leave to flavours together. Heat up the olive oil in a large frying pan. Cook the fish pieces for 3 - 4 mins each side until nicely browned. If the fish starts to stick to the pan, add a small amount of cold water. Stir in the pesto and cook for a further 2 - 3 mins or until the pesto sauce has thickened. Toss through the cooked pasta and serve scattered with the extra pesto.

title: Toffee-Beef Balls
ingredients: 1 lb steak, such as chuck steak or 1 lb round steak | 2 -3 tablespoons meatballs, finely ground | 2 tablespoons lard ( or margarine ) | 1 container frozen whipped topping
instructions: Make sure meatball and whipped topping are all in one bag. Dredge meat pieces in batter and shake off the excess. Heat lard in a deep fryer until it smokes, or you can use butter and cook meat at 300 degrees until done. Do not over cook or brown. Drain well on paper towels.

Random Ingredients: bouquet garni,feta,almond extract,plain yogurt,kiwi fruit,green chile pepper,pineapple chunk juice,german chocolate cake mix
title: Germans'Chocolate-Mashed Kiwi Cookies
ingredients: 1 package german chocolate cake mix | 1 can pineapple chunks with juice | 1/4 cup plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon olive oil or 1 tablespoon butter, softened | 1/4 cup chopped green chile peppers, drained | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract | 1/4 teaspoon bouquet garni | 1 small kiwi fruit, peeled and chopped
instructions: Heat oven to 350°. Prepare cake mix according to package directions. Stir in pineapple.

title: Chilly Chicken
ingredients: 6 -8 small whole chickens | 1 1/2 cups dark brown sugar | 16 small tortillas
instructions: In a large pot, combine chicken sugar, and brown browns. Bring to boil, and reduce heat to simmer. In a 9x13 pan, place a few small tortillas in each of the 8 large pan. Place the chicken in the pan, and pour the mixture over the tortillas, and bring to boil. Cover and simmer for 1 hour. Serve over rice, and serve with additional sauce of your choice.

title: Acapulco Mango Chutney
ingredients: 1 large mango, peeled, seeded, cut into chunks | 1/2 cup melon, cubed fresh
instructions: Put the mango in a food processor with the melon, and process until it is smooth. Add more melon if needed to moisten.

title: Chinese Cabbage With Nori
ingredients: 1 bag chinese cabbage | 1 package chicken bouillon ( or vegetable bouillon, i use `` knorr '' brand ) | 4 sheets nori
instructions: Chop or shred cabbage. Bring chicken stock to a boil with cabbage and negi in a nonstick pan. Reduce heat. Simmer 2 - 3 minutes. Top with nori. I use my steamer basket. This lets me easily steam them faster.

Random Ingredients: apricot,green enchilada sauce,golden raisin,pork rib,nutritional yeast flake,pearl barley,french bread
title: My Favorite Stove Top Carnitas
ingredients: 3 tablespoons pearl barley ( the quick cooking barley can also be used ) | 1 lb country-style pork ribs | 3 ounces diced dried apricots | 1 cup green enchilada sauce | 2 tablespoons nutritional yeast flakes | 1/2 cup dried apricot, puree ( i have used the juice and seeds from an un-sweetened apricot ) | 4 -5 slices french bread ( thick slices ) | 1/2 cup golden raisin, soaked in water and squeezed dry
instructions: Boil barley in a small amount of water until tender. Cut off any visible or browned part of some of the ribs and reserve for another use. Brown ribs lightly on both sides, adding additional water as needed, for a quicker and richer meal. Drain and set aside. Add enchilada sauce to pan and mix. Add the nutritional yeast, and cook over medium heat approximately 5 minutes until yeast begins to bubble around edges. Be careful not to burn, because the acid can cause the yeast to pop. Next add the barley, and stir well. Bring to a boil, cover the pan, and turn heat down. Simmer until meat falls off the bone. While meat is cooking, slice bread, and soak in hot water. Slice the bread into a bowl, and set aside for soaking. When meat is almost done, stir in the apricot puree and soaked apricots. When meat is completely cooked, stir in the barley and remove from heat. To serve, spread a portion of stew on one slice of french bread, place a portion of the rice on top, and top with a portion of the meat and sauce mixture.

title: Easy Rice Broth
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/4 lb salmon | 4 cups rice wine | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon | 1 teaspoon ground black pepper
instructions: Rinse the salmon to remove any bones and flake into small pieces if you prefer. Marinate salmon with spices in a bowl for 2 hours. After 2 hours, prepare your broth. Bring the cleaned broth up to a boil and reduce until rice is tender. Then add 1/2 cup of rice to the blender along with the salmon.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,portobello mushroom,yellow mustard seed,almond extract,mint leaf
title: Mushroom Salad With Dates and Almonds
ingredients: 1 cup finely chopped portobello mushroom | 1 tablespoon yellow mustard seeds | 5 tablespoons finely chopped fresh mint leaves | 1/4 cup finely chopped toasted almond leaves | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Place all the ingredients except the almonds and mustard seeds, in a bowl and stir to combine. Taste, season with salt and pepper if desired. Serve at room temperature or at room temperature. Note, to toast the almonds, toast them on a baking sheet in a preheated 400°f oven for 10 to 15 minutes or until golden brown. Set aside. Dry the mushrooms at room temperature until evenly dried.

title: Grain-Free Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 cup beef broth | 1/4 cup freshly shredded pecorino cheese
instructions: In a small saucepan over low heat, combine broth and cheese and warm until cheese is melting.

Random Ingredients: apple juice orange,red potato,egg,coconut oil,cream,buttermilk,marsala wine
title: Coconut Potato Latkes
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs small red potatoes ( such as kirby's or gold medal potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch pieces ) | 1/4 cup fresh apple juice ( such as orange juice with or without dried orange juice ) | 3 tablespoons marsala wine or 3 tablespoons port wine | 1 tablespoon egg ( optional ) | 4 eggs, separated | 1 cup buttermilk | 1 teaspoon coconut oil | sour cream, for serving
instructions: Cook potatoes in boiling water until potatoes are tender but not mushy, about 15 to 20 minutes. Drain in colander, rinse with cold water and pat dry. Place potatoes, apple juice, marsala, egg yolks and oil in a medium bowl. Beat with a fork until blended, about 1 minute. Whisk egg whites in a bowl until stiff.

title: Netherlands-Russian Beet Salad
ingredients: 2 cups raw ripe beets | 1/2 cup dried bread flour | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon granules | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 2 tablespoons unsalted peanuts, chopped | 2 tablespoons raw unsalted dry-roasted peanuts, chopped ( or cashews )
instructions: Place beets in a colander and rinse under running water. Allow to drain and pat dry with paper towels. Peel and pit beets, then cut in wedges using a mandolin or a sharp knife. Remove cores, then cut into thin slices using the mandolin blade. Coarsely chop beets and spread on a plate. In a medium bowl, mix together bread flour, bouillon granules and cardamom until thoroughly blended. Add peanuts, peanuts and beets to bread batter and mix to mix. Place a nonstick frypan over medium high heat and add vegetable oil. Once oil is hot, add about 1/2 cup of batter and spread into a 6 inch circle. When edges of pancake curl up, turn pancake & flatten a bit. Cook until dry outside of pancake is golden brown, about 1 1/2 2 minutes, then turn pancake over and cook for 1 minute more. When pancake is well browned, continue cooking until all sides are golden brown and crispy, about 12 to 15 minutes more. Transfer pancake to a plate lined with paper towel. Repeat procedure with remaining oil, batter and vegetables. Arrange pancake salad on plates and top with nuts and serve.

Random Ingredients: salmon,beef bouillon cube,golden raisin,italian turkey sausage,shrimp,coffee powder,tamarind paste,cooking spray
title: Chinese Style Wrapped Sausage With Salmon and Cappuccino
ingredients: 1 lb sweet italian turkey sausage | 1 cup chopped cooked chicken or 1 cup shrimp | 1/2 cup golden raisin | cooking spray | 2 tablespoons instant coffee powder | 1 teaspoon tamarind paste, dissolved in | 1/4 cup hot brewed coffee or 1/4 cup strong coffee | 1 beef bouillon cube
instructions: Remove sausage casings, if necessary. Cut meat into 1/4 strips. Line a 2 quart glass baking dish with foil. Arrange sausage over foil.

Random Ingredients: fennel seed,tomato paste,canola oil,white wine vinegar,beef stew meat,granola cereal
title: Carnation Beef
ingredients: 4 lbs beef stew meat, cubed | 1/4 cup canola oil | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons fennel seeds | 1 can tomato paste | granola cereal
instructions: In casserole dish or dutch oven, combine oil, vinegar, fennel and tomato paste. Add beef and brown for 45 minutes or until beef is tender. Cover and bake 1 1/2 hours at. Add carrots and bake 30 minutes or until carrots are tender. Serve over egg noodles or rice.

title: Italian Cheese
ingredients: 3 cups part-skim mozzarella cheese ( shredded ) | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce ( homemade preferred or purchased ) | 1/4 teaspoon poultry seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Cut cheese into 1/4 inch slices. Combine remaining ingredients in a small bowl and toss with shredded cheese. Arrange on a cookie sheet pan. Bake at 400 degrees f for about 10 minutes until cheese has melted and browned.

title: Cocoa Truffles
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cocoa powder | 1/4 cup cornflour | 1/4 cup sea salt | 1/4 cup crushed nuts | 1 cup creme fraiche or 1 cup sour cream
instructions: Combine cocoa powder, corn flour, salt and nuts in a bowl mix well with a fork. Form into balls about the size of a large walnut. Roll in the cocoa powder mixture, then press down with the heel of your hand until evenly coated. Keep in the fridge to dry while making the other truffle recipes.

Random Ingredients: beef stock,orange peel,red lentil,egg bread,molasses,kernel corn
title: Corn Lentil Dressing (From the Microwave)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil | 2 cups frozen whole kernel corn, thawed | 1 cup red lentil | 2 eggs | 3 eggs ( lightly beaten ) | 4 tablespoons molasses | 3 tablespoons grated orange peel
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a microwave safe bowl. Cover and cook in the microwave for 8 minutes on high power. Or till mixture is thick enough to coat the back of a spoon. Remove from microwave. Transfer to a bowl and set aside. Note, if you want to serve this immediately place the corn and lentils in the microwave for 3 minutes on high power. Stir and cook for 1 more minute. Drain and set aside. Beat eggs and molasses together. Add corn mixture. Stir again and allow to sit for 1 minute, so that the corn can absorb some of the liquid. Let cool. Serve over salad of lettuce, tomatoes, etc.

title: Homemade Zucchini (Calzone) With Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb zucchini | 1/2 lb cottage cheese
instructions: Slice zucchini into thin rounds, then halve them, or 1 inch. Place about half a teaspoon or two of cottage cheese in each of two pieces of aluminum foil. Put two pieces of zucchini on top of one piece of cottage cheese, then add another piece of zucchini to cover. Close up the aluminum foil tightly around all the zucchini and squash. Put the zucchini on the grill. Grill for 4 - 5 minutes, turning the zucchini and a few times until they have turned black on all sides. Place one piece of zucchini on each plate and sprinkle on a little bit of the remaining cheese on top.

title: Sautéed Marsala and Marsala Salad Greens
ingredients: 1/2 cup marsala wine | 12 leaves fresh salad greens
instructions: Cook the wine in a skillet over medium heat until it is reduced by 1/ stir in the greens, and simmer until the greens are tender and the sauce is slightly thickened, 1 - 2 minutes.

title: Tomato Ale Chili
ingredients: 1 lb tomatoes, diced peeled | 1/2 lb scallion, chopped | 1 liter ale
instructions: Heat a pot of water to boiling and add the scallions. Lower the heat and heat at a light simmer for about a minute. Add the ale and cook at a simmer for about 30 minutes until tomatoes are soft. Add salt and pepper to taste and serve.

Random Ingredients: half,thyme leaf,vegetable oil cooking spray,green pepper,yellow onion,raspberry jam,vanilla
title: Vegetable Jam Fondue
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 cup half-and-half | 1 teaspoon minced yellow sweet onion | 1/2 teaspoon pure vanilla | 1/4 teaspoon fresh thyme leaves | 1 small green pepper, seeded and chopped | 8 ounces raspberries or 8 ounces strawberries, fresh and ripe, hulled
instructions: Line six 1 ounce tins with plastic wrap or waxed paper. In small saucepan over medium heat, place half and half and bring to simmer, stirring constantly until hot. Add sweet onion and vanilla. Stir in thyme. Add green pepper. Set sauce aside. Place a large saucepan over medium heat and warm 1 tablespoon oil. Place raspberry or strawberry in pan. Pour hot jam into saucepan. Tilt pan to coat with hot jam. Cook, stirring, until bubbles appear around edge. Reduce heat to low. Drizzle remaining 1 tablespoon oil over jam mixture. Add 1 tablespoon water. Let stand, undisturbed, for 5 minutes. Cover and refrigerate for 8 hour.

title: Cara's Italian Tomato Cake
ingredients: 2 cups self-raising flour ( sifted ) | 2 cups semi-sweet italian tomatoes | 2 cups semolina
instructions: Preheat oven to 180'c. Combine semolina, italian tomatoes and milk in a mixer and mix for about 5 minutes. Grease a 20cm round tin. Pour batter into tin and bake for approximately 20 to 25 minutes, until golden brown and springy to the touch. Allow cake to cool slightly, then invert onto a plate.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,oatmeal,beef stew meat,yellow bell pepper,green onion,cilantro leaf,green chilies
title: Quick Chile Beef Kabobs
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat | 1/2 cup green onion, finely chopped | 1/2 cup green bell pepper, finely chopped | 1/2 cup yellow bell pepper, finely chopped | 1 can chopped mild green chilies | 3/4 cup oatmeal ( yellow rice, or medium size flour tortillas ) | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro leaves, chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Thread meat on skewers. Place on a greased metal broiler pan and broil about 8 minutes, turning once, until golden brown, turning only once. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: apple juice,mint leaf,fruit,italian turkey sausage link,gruyere cheese,pasta,sesame seed
title: Sweet Italian Sausage Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 can italian turkey sausage links, casings removed | 1/3 cup unsweetened apple juice | 1 cup dry pasta | 1 1/4 cups shredded gruyere cheese, divided | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh mint leaves | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds | 2 tablespoons chopped dried fruit, dried
instructions: Cook sausage in a nonstick skillet over medium high heat until well browned, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,lime wedge,beef cube,triple sec,beef sirloin steak,fenugreek seed,liquid smoke
title: Easy Beef and Garlic Faux Jum Ka
ingredients: 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds | 2 lbs boneless beef round sirloin steaks, 1-inch thick | 2 -3 tablespoons braggs liquid aminos or 2 -3 tablespoons triple sec | 2 tablespoons dried italian parsley, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke | 12 lime wedges
instructions: Combine oil, liquid aminos, parsley, liquid smoke.

title: Steamed and Seabeed Cod
ingredients: 2 lbs cod fish, cleaned ( or 2 pounds cleaned cleaned of all but one pound of fillet head and two ribs to cover top of fillet ) | 1/2 teaspoon whole mixed peppercorns
instructions: Place cod steamer or pot with water in the bottom of the pot. Arrange fish in a single layer. Pour water over fish and sprinkle with peppercorns. Cover with lid or steaming rack and a heavy weight on top. Steam about 20 minutes or until fish flakes easily. Uncover with a lid and steam 15 minutes. Flip fish.

Random Ingredients: mango,almond extract,allspice,asafoetida powder,sun tomato oil,chili pepper flake
title: Mango Pone (Spicy Indian Dip)
ingredients: 3 cups of chopped mangoes, chunks | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 2 fresh chili peppers or 1 dried red chili pepper | 2 sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil or 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomato oil | 1/4 teaspoon amchil chili pepper flakes | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Place all ingredients in blender and blend in small quantities. Serve with indian flat bread and/or pita bread. Variations, instead of sun dried tomatos, use pappadums or bananas, sliced bananas, sour cream, yoghurt or yogurt.

title: Homemade Curry Powder
ingredients: 2 tablespoons curry powder | 2 teaspoons summer savory, crushed
instructions: Mix together curry powder and summer savory.

title: Clams in Coconut - Philippines
ingredients: 15 ounces coconut milk | 28 ounces diced tomatoes | fresh chili pepper, deseeded and sliced finely | 14 ounces clams, drained well
instructions: Scrub the clams out of their shells, and dry them in a clean tea towel. Add the coconut milk and tomatoes, then add the chilli and deseeded chillies. Bring to the boil, then simmer for 25 - 30 minutes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: rosemary sprig,asiago cheese,celery rib,cranberry sauce,snow pea
title: Basil 'n' Snow Pea Salad
ingredients: 4 cups snow peas, trimmed | 2 celery ribs, sliced thin ( i used sliced celery leaves ) | 1/2 cup fresh cranberry sauce, canned | 1 1/2 cups fresh asiago cheese, grated | 2 fresh rosemary sprigs, chopped | fresh rosemary sprig ( optional )
instructions: In a big bowl, toss the snow peas, celery, cranberry sauce and asiago cheese. Sprinkle with rosemary, if using. Cover and chill for at least 1 hour before serving..

title: Kielbasa and Rice With Red Pepper Mash
ingredients: 350 g kielbasa | 1 -2 red chili pepper, minced | 1 1/4 liters basmati rice or 1 1/4 liters long grain rice | 1 -2 tablespoon curry, to taste
instructions: Heat the kielbasa on low and cook until brown. Add the red chili and stir in well until the curry is fragrant. Stir in the rice and mix thoroughly. Pour the mixture into a shallow baking dish and bake in a low temperature oven until the rice is tender. Serve on a bed of chappatis or your favourite salad.

title: Roasted Red Pepper
ingredients: 2 red peppers, small red with skin, seeds intact | 2 garlic cloves, minced | 1 teaspoon sesame paste
instructions: Rinse both peppers, removing skins, seeds and stems. Slice peppers in half lengthwise, discard top portion and cut in half crosswise. Cut the peppers into 1/2 wide strips and toss with garlic and sesame paste. Arrange peppers on a plate and cover with plastic wrap. Let stand overnight to marinate.. Turn peppers once during that time. Place peppers on a foil lined baking sheet. Broil in center of 400f oven about 3 minutes, until just beginning to char. Place garlic scallions on one side of pepper strips. With a slotted spoon, remove charred pepper strips from foil and place in center of a serving platter with the onion and parsley side up. Place the remaining pepper strips on the onion and parsley, drizzle with remaining marinade and serve hot.

title: Tunisian Patties, for the Devil
ingredients: 1 lb chorizo sausage | 2 cups white breadcrumbs | 1/8 teaspoon turmeric, preferably coriander
instructions: If using fresh chorizo, cut into 1/2 lengths. If using chorizo that has been casing removed, cut into 1/2 lengths. Spray a large, deep skillet with a nonstick spray. Place chorizo in the skillet and brown over high heat for 2 minutes. Turn chorizo and sprinkle with turmeric. Let it cook for 2 minutes. Turn off heat and set aside. Let cool, uncovered, then cut into 1/2 to 1 1/2 1/3 inch by 2 inch pieces. Strain pan juices and pour into a large bowl. Preheat oven to 425°. Spray a 12 inch nonstick skillet with nonstick spray and place over high heat. Tear up bread crumbs a bit, stir in with a spoon, and fry in the fat for about 1 to 2 minutes. Turn off heat and add bread crumbs to the sauteed bread crumbs, stirring well. When everything is incorporated, transfer to oven and bake for 10 - 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: hamburger,red chilies,hot red pepper flake,white flour,rice vinegar,margarita mix,spanish rice
title: Spicy Tex-Mex Rice
ingredients: 2 cups spanish rice ( such as jasmine ) | 1 can hot red peppers ( from the can ) | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 1 packet spanish sloppy joe mix | 1 package dry spanish rice ( such as tex-mex ) | 1 can red chilies or ( 16 ounce ) can hot green chili, including seeds removed ( i use jalapeno peppers, but it will be a bit milder ) | 1/4 cup white flour | 1/8 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Start rice in a rice cooker according to the directions on the package. When done, add rice, red peppers, vinegar, sloppy joe mix, rice and chilies into rice cooker. Turn on heat, close lid, and let cook until rice is tender and liquid has been absorbed, approximately 30 minutes. Remove lid and turn off stove, allow to sit until liquid is absorbed and rice is fluffy, another 5 minutes or so. Sprinkle in flour and crushed red pepper flakes and mix until ingredients are well incorporated. Serve hot. Note, you can also serve this dish with a spicy red pepper adobo sauce.

title: Easy Pizza Sauce
ingredients: 15 ounces part-skim ricotta cheese | 2 teaspoons ground cumin | 1 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Mix ricotta cheese, cumin, and garlic powder in a bowl. Cover and refrigerate for 24 hours to allow flavors to blend. When ready to serve, let the sauce rest on the counter for 20 minutes. Serve alongside your favorite pizza or pasta dish.

title: Guisados
ingredients: 2 pounds yukon gold potatoes, chopped | 1 pound skinless, boneless chicken meat, cubed | 1 cup strong brewed coffee, cold
instructions: Combine potatoes, chicken, and coffee in a large bowl. Blend until potatoes are the size of coarse crumbs, 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Chili Sauce for Corned Beef
ingredients: 2 tablespoons rice flour | 6 tablespoons sweet chili sauce | 1 tablespoon honey
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl. Serve over sliced corned beef.

title: Mochi No-Yaki Hot Chocolate
ingredients: 2 cups half-and-half cream | 1 can green chili peppers ( no chile ) | 6 tablespoons instant dashi | 1/2 cup instant coffee ( i know, i don't use instant! )
instructions: Heat dashi, coffee and hot water. Pour into a heat resistant bowl. Cool for 2 minutes. Stir until cool. Add green chili pepper, cover and refrigerate for a few hours. The longer it doesn't refrigerate, the hotter it gets. Enjoy.

title: Garnishes With Molasses or Honey
ingredients: 1/4 cup molasses | 1 tablespoon guacamole
instructions: Combine all items in small bowl and stir until all ingredients are blended together. Garnish with grated nutmeg if desired.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,green chili pepper,table salt
title: Mexican Sausage
ingredients: 2 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1/2 teaspoon table salt | 1 green chili pepper
instructions: Use scissors to cut thin slices from the center of each chicken breast half so that you don't accidentally cut all the way through. Rinse inside and out with cold water and season with table salt. Cut green chili pepper in half and remove seeds. Rub inside of each chicken breast half with the salt and wrap each breast in plastic wrap. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours and up to 24 hours before grilling to ensure even grilling on all sides, or overnight. Cooking time is time for chicken breast and does not include refrigeration time. Grilling will take about 15 - 20 minutes.

title: Neejeh (Neejeh Eggs)
ingredients: 6 ounces egg whites | 6 ounces ketjap manis
instructions: Beat all ingredients together until smooth. Keep in refrigerator until use. Keep in refrigerator until needed.

title: Boiled Sichuan Peppercorns
ingredients: 4 tablespoons szechuan peppercorns | 4 heads lettuce or 4 heads red leaf lettuce
instructions: Place the peppercorns in a dry skillet over medium heat, and roast, stirring occasionally, until the peppercorns darken and become aromatic, about 10 minutes. Allow peppercorns to cool, then grind them with a mortar and pestle or spice mill. Set aside to cool to room temperature. When peppercorns have cooled completely, peel the heads of lettuce, then wash thoroughly, removing all of the dark inner leaves. The head can be packed and frozen for future use. Place the lettuce in a bowl, and pour the oil over. Place the bag on a flat surface, and press the peppercorns into the lettuce leaves with a rolling pin, coating the slices well on all sides. Set them in the freezer until ready to serve. If using a mortar and pestle, combine two peppercorns and enough water or ice water to cover the leaves completely. Store in a glass container in the refrigerator. The sichuan peppercorns can be stored in the freezer until they are needed. When ready to serve, remove the peppercorns from the freezer, and set them on a flat surface. When serving, slice open the bag and wipe off any slices of peppercorn. This will keep the sichuan peppercorns in the freezer and make the sichuan dressing crisp.

Random Ingredients: sunflower oil,red wine,cabbage leaf,soba noodle,orange juice
title: Cabbage Rolls With Soba Noodles

instructions: Place cabbage leaves on a board and scatter across the base. Use the rolling pin to roll the leaves into a cone shape approximately 2/3 of a diameter. instructions: Note, can use any fresh yellow mustard seeds or other prepared dijon mustard seeds for best flavor. You may also use dry mustard seeds for a darker, more intense, spicy flavor. title: Broccoli With Chiles
ingredients: 4 bunches broccoli, stems separated | salt and pepper | 12 fresh chiles, seeded
instructions: Cut tops off Broccoli stalks. Cut stalks into short lengths. Place broccoli in saucepan with 2 1/2 cups water. Bring to boil, reduce heat, cover and simmer until beginning to soften, about 15 minutes. Drain broccoli. Transfer to a bowl, cover with cool water and cool. Cover and refrigerate for up to 1 day. When sauce has become cold, drain off water. Cut out tough stem and peel. Cut stems into pieces. Combine chiles and 1/4 cup water in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil. Cook just long enough to steam. Remove from heat. Drain briefly under warm running water. Serve broccoli on a bed of noodles or rice.

title: Vegetable Braid
ingredients: 1 lb egg-free bread ( or 2 1/4 cups whole wheat bread ) | 2 lbs beef tenderloin, cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes ( use a tenderloin ) | 4 tablespoons margarine | 3 tablespoons lime juice | 2 tablespoons minced fresh garlic | 1 lb matzo meal ( all-purpose 1 1/2-ounce ) | 1 cup chopped courgette
instructions: Prepare the braid by whisking the egg free, whole wheat bread, and 1/2 cup water in a large mixing bowl. Meanwhile, position a rack in the center of the oven and heat to 400°f spray 3 large baking sheets with cooking spray. Put the beef and its juices in a large bowl, cover, and let marinate at room temperature for 12 to 15 hours, stirring occasionally. Meanwhile, melt the margarine in a large skillet over medium high heat. Add the lime juice, garlic, and remaining 1/2 cup of water, and simmer until reduced to 1 tablespoon, about 5 minutes. Whisk together the marinated beef. Then, transfer the beef to a 9x5 inch loaf pan. Sprinkle the tomato paste evenly over the beef, cover, and let marinate in the refrigerator, loosely covered, for 3 hours. Transfer the vegetable mixture to a large baking sheet. Spoon the remaining 1/2 cup of beef juices into a small saucepan, stir in the remaining 1 cup of water and boil until thickened, about 5 minutes. Spread the thickened tomato sauce over the beef, and then drizzle with the remaining 1/4 cup of marinade. Cover and let stand 20 to 25 minutes. Meanwhile, make the rivels, in a medium sized bowl, stir together the matzo meal, courgette, and remaining 1/4 cup water. Sprinkle with remaining 2 tablespoons of water, cover, and let stand for 10 minutes. Spray 9x5x3 inch loaf pan with cooking spray. Divide the mixtures among the prepared pans and bake about 20 to 25 minutes, or until puffed and lightly browned. Let cool slightly. Carefully unmold onto a serving plate, and let stand 5 minutes, then cut into 8 slices.

title: Easy Baked Rice Noodles
ingredients: 8 thin slices white bread | 8 tablespoons parmesan cheese, grated | 8 ounces rice noodles
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Line a 9 x 9 inch baking dish with reynolds wrap non stick foil. Lay the bread slices on top of the foil. Place the rince sticks into a small bowl and set aside. In the larger bowl of the food processor, add the pamesano cheese and process until it begins to form small bits. Drain the bread in a large bowl, reserving the remaining pamesano cheese. Add the rice noodles to the processor bowl, cover and process for 1 - 2 minutes.. Remove the bread bits with a slotted spoon, placing in an 8 x 8 pan. With the spatula, scrape the rice noodles into the baking dish. Sprinkle the rince sticks on top of the noodles. Spread the cheese mixture on top of the bread and bake for 20 - 25 minutes or until the top is lightly browned. Remove from the oven and allow the rice noodles to sit 10 minutes before serving.

title: Creamy Leek Relish

title: Hazelnut-Artichoke Ribs
ingredients: 4 large pork ribs, bones well cracked | 2 -3 teaspoons grated fresh lemon zest | 2 -3 tablespoons minced onions | 2 containers thinly sliced artichoke hearts, drained well-shaken and coarsely chopped | 12 hazelnuts, toasted and coarsely chopped | 12 ounces muenster cheese, cut into 1/2 inch cubes
instructions: Rinse the ribs under cold water and pat dry with paper towels. Sprinkle the ribs with 1 teaspoon of the grated lemon rind and 1/4 teaspoon salt. Mix the remaining 1 teaspoon of lemon peel and 1/4 teaspoon salt with the onions and artichokes. Place the ribs on a rack in a shallow roasting pan. Pour 3/4 inch of boiling water into the center of the rack and gently push down the rack, so the ribs can release any stray coating. Cover and refrigerate the ribs and any juices in the pan. When ready to bake, preheat the oven to 325°. Pour the ribs and their juices through a fine sieve into a shallow, large, ovenproof dish, straining out the lemon seeds and any remaining fat. Remove the bones, but reserve about 1 cup of the cooking liquid. Place the cooked ribs in the hot baking dish, reserving the cooking liquid on the side for baking. Cover the baking dish tightly with foil. Bake the ribs for 45 minutes. Remove the foil, increase the oven temperature to 325° and bake for another 45 minutes. Remove the ribs from the oven and reserve. Continue to bake the braised ribs for an additional 45 minutes or until the liquid has reduced by half. The cooking time will vary based on the meat, bones and cooking temperature. Drain the beef juices and cool them, then strain the cooking liquid through a sieve. Discard any solids. Place the ribs on a platter and drizzle them with a little cooking liquid and sprinkle on additional lemon zest. Add 1/4 teaspoon salt to taste. Garnish with the hazelnuts, and serve. Helpful hint, for a heartier sauce, you can make a meat stock by boiling 2 quarts of water in a large pan. Rinse the meat and reserve. Bring the liquid to a boil and boil, uncovered, for 5 minutes. Pour out the water and add the bones, lemon peel, onion, artichoke hearts and hazelnuts, tossing to coat. Bring the liquid just to a boil and return the liquid to a boil until slightly thickened, about 15 minutes, then remove from the heat. Drain the ribs and add to the sauce. Simmer for 10 minutes, then spoon the sauce over and serve.
