Place the cheesecake on a baking sheet and cut a deep cross into the top on the top of the cake with a sharp knife lengthwise, then place the cake on the baking sheet. Cover the cheesecake with a damp kitchen towel and towel and let rise for about 1 hour, or until the cake is puffy and risen. Meanwhile, in a saucepan, heat the remaining 1/4 cup of white wine vinegar and the remaining 1 1/4 cups of water until boiling. Place the onions and cilantro in a sauté pan and sauté over medium heat, about 3 min, or until transparent. Remove the onions from the heat and stir in the saucepan. Pour the hot vinegar mixture over the cheesecake, spreading it into an even layer. Using a round cookie cutter, cut a circle 3/4 of the way down the center of the cheesecake to allow the steam to escape. Poke the cake through the center with the tines of a fork until the crust is almost the entire outside. Spread the onions and cilantro on top of the cheese and serve immediately.

title: Aussie Beef Tenderloin With Coriander and Potato
ingredients: 800 g beef tenderloin | 6 russet potatoes | 1 red cabbage | 4 tablespoons coriander leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 220 degrees centigrade. Quarter the potatoes, and place in a roasting tin with a tight fitting lid. Use a sharp knife to cut them into even sized slices, then roughly mash the potato slices in the tin. Slice the beef into slices. Slice the cabbage. Place the slices into a roasting tin with a tight fitting lid, with the coriander. Place on a medium high heat, and cook for 5 - 10 minutes. Turn and cook for a further 3 - 4 minutes, and check the beef is fully cooked, for rare or medium to well done, depending on your taste and your oven. When the beef is cooked to your liking remove from the oven, scatter over the sliced potato, and leave the tin in the oven for a few minutes until the potatoes are slightly crispy. Serve with a green salad and crusty bread. Variation you can season the beef to your taste with salt and pepper, and leave it in the pan for a few minutes to reduce it a little.

Random Ingredients: rice wine,cooking spray,kielbasa,horseradish relish,green lentil,tart apple,red pepper,beet
title: Warm Beet Salad
ingredients: 1 teaspoon grated horseradish relish | 1 -2 tablespoon quick-cooking spray | 2 tablespoons rice wine | 1 cup fresh green lentils, rinsed and picked over | 1 tart apple, coarsely chopped | 1/2 small red pepper, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons pickled beetroot slices | 1 package kielbasa, cut into 3/4-inch cubes
instructions: Place dressing in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: half cream,dark soy sauce,red pepper flake,mace,orange juice,red wine vinegar
title: Aussie Marinade for Beef or Lamb
ingredients: 1/2 cup half and half cream | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 1/4 cup orange juice ( freshly squeezed but not too sweet ) | 3/4 tablespoon light dark soy sauce | 1 teaspoon ground mace | 1/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes
instructions: Combine all ingredients in medium resealable plastic bag and marinate meat at least 30 minutes in the refrigerator. Drain meat and discard marinade. Rinse meat and pat dry. Grill meat over medium coals for 8 - 10 minutes, turning once.

title: Lemon Pepper Jamaican Chex Mix
ingredients: 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1/2 teaspoon lemon pepper seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Mix the graham cracker crumbs, lemon pepper seasoning and allspice together. Chill. Store in an airtight container.

title: Tandoori Rogan Josh (Yogurt Cheese Balls)
ingredients: 120 ml low-fat plain nonfat yogurt | 1 1/4 teaspoons cardamom or 1 1/4 teaspoons ground cardamom | 100 g rice powder ( i use arborio rice ) | 2 tablespoons olive oil
instructions: Mix all the ingredients except oil until well mixed. Mix with hands so the rice powder settles to the yogurt. Make about 24 balls out of the mix. Heat the olive oil in a non stick frying pan until it is nice and hot. Fry balls about 3 - 4 minutes, stirring constantly, until golden. Drain nicely on paper towels. Serve with indian pappadums, pita chips, chutney or other pickle.

Random Ingredients: sage leaf,orange zest,fettuccine,green bell pepper,vegetable shortening,tomato juice
title: Graca's Fettuccine With Fresh Sage-Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup vegetable shortening | 4 large green bell peppers, sliced | 1/2 cup dry fettuccine | 1 can fire-roasted whole canned tomatoes with juice, drained | 1/4 cup grated orange zest | 1 pinch chopped fresh sage leaves, for garnish
instructions: In a large skillet, melt the shortening. Saute the green bell peppers, stirring often, for 5 minutes, or until softened. Meanwhile, cook the fettuccine in a large pot of boiling water until al dente. Drain and set aside. In the same skillet, add the canned tomatoes. When the tomatoes have cooled slightly, add the orange zest, sage, and green bell peppers. Heat everything until hot. Pour the sauce over the cooked fettuccine and toss lightly. Turn heat down to medium, cover, and simmer for 5 minutes, or until all the pasta is tender. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Korean Chicken Appetizers
ingredients: 2 tablespoons mayonnaise or 2 tablespoons low-fat mayonnaise | 2 teaspoons toasted sesame seeds ( kikkoman if available ) | 4 ounces thinly sliced reduced-fat sharp cheddar cheese or 4 ounces korean shredded reduced fat sharp cheddar cheese | 1 - 2 1/4 lb boneless skinless chicken breast, cut into strips | paprika ( to garnish )
instructions: Using a large mixing bowl or serving platter, combine mayonnaise, and sesame seeds. Add 2 slices of the cheddar or korean shredded cheese. Mix in chicken and coat completely. Sprinkle paprika over the top and garnish with a little paprika.

Random Ingredients: cashew nut,lentil,oyster mushroom,ham,sirloin,beef stock,tomato green chilies,bicarbonate soda
title: Lentil Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sirloin, cut into 2 inch chunks | 1 1/2 lbs lean lamb, cut into 3 inch cubes | 3 ounces cashew nuts | 3 ounces oyster mushrooms | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1 cup beef stock | 2 teaspoons bicarbonate of soda | 14 ounces lentils
instructions: Trim fat from meat. Dice meat into 1 inch cubes. Place meat in crock pot with rest of ingredients and cook on low for 5 - 6 hours. Remove meat and skim fat, if necessary. Serve, garnish with cilantro leaves and chopped parsley.

Random Ingredients: linguine,dijon mustard,cayenne pepper,white sugar,potato,cremini mushroom,basmati rice,couscous
title: Stir Fried Mushrooms & Linguine
ingredients: 1/2 bag linguine, uncooked | 1 lb cremini mushrooms, halved | 4 tablespoons dijon mustard | 3/4 teaspoon white sugar | 1 cup couscous | 2 cups potatoes, cut in half | 2 teaspoons dried basil | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Combine dijon and sugar in a small bowl. Set aside. Cook linguine according to package directions, draining. Add mushrooms and mustard to mushrooms. Cook, stirring until mushrooms are tender. Add couscous, potatoes, basil and cayenne. Mix well. Remove from heat. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: italian salad dressing mix,salad oil,pork meat,tart apple,jigger tequila,corn
title: Mexican Apples and Taters
ingredients: 1 package dried tart apples | 1/2 cup salad oil | 1 jigger tequila | 1 package dried italian-style salad dressing mix | 6 ears fresh corn, or as needed | 3/4 cup salad oil
instructions: Place dried apples in a large bowl with 1/2 cup salad oil and a jigger of tequila on top, cover, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour, or overnight. Fill a large dutch oven with enough hot water to cover apples by 1 inch. Bring to a boil, and boil until just softened, about 2 minutes. Drain apples, and spread out on paper towels. Rinse off excess oil. Place one ear of corn in the dutch oven, and spread cut sides with about 2 tablespoons salad oil. Spread the kernels out like crepes. Cover, and cook until tender and lightly charred, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat, and spread remaining ear of corn on a serving platter and carefully cut kernels from cob. Heat apple oil in a skillet over medium heat. Cook the breaded ears of corn, turning occasionally, until soft and lightly browned on the outside, and stuffing is hot, about 10 minutes. Drizzle the breaded ears with 1 tablespoon salad oil to serve.

title: Lamb, Sheep's Feet & Melon Skewers
ingredients: 1 honeydew melon, cubed | 1 lb lean lamb, cut into 2-inch chunks | 1/4 cup catsup | 1 tablespoon molasses | 2 teaspoons harissa | 1/2 teaspoon celery seed | fresh mint sprigs, for garnish
instructions: Combine honeydew melon, lamb, catsup, molasses, harissa and celery seed in a mixing bowl. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or up to 3 days. Thread 3 lamb cubes onto each skewer. Garnish with mint sprigs.

title: Bengali Coconut Truffles
ingredients: 3 pounds flaked coconut ( see notes for size ) | 10 dried tamarind pulp
instructions: Dip tamarind into a bowl of warm water for 15 minutes to soften. Remove from water, and pour out the soaking water.

Random Ingredients: saffron thread,tomato green chile pepper,cider vinegar,saffron
title: Prawns with Saffron and Spicy Tomato Guiness
ingredients: 1/2 cup cider vinegar | 2 -3 saffron threads, crushed | 3 tablespoons crushed canned tomato and green chile pepper hot peppers | 2 teaspoons powdered saffron
instructions: Combine the vinegar with saffron. Add to the pot and stir continuously. Add dried peppers and stir. Let stand 2 hours. Just before serving, add prawns to vinegar mixture and stir vigorously. Serve with slices of raw cabbage.

title: Tuscan White Beans
ingredients: 2 cans cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 cup brewed tea
instructions: Pour the beans and tea into a blender. Blend on high until beans and tea are broken apart.

title: Crunchy Blueberry Potato Wedges
ingredients: 2 cups crumbled hash brown potatoes | 2 cups crumbled saltine crackers | 1 1/2 cups fresh blueberries or 1 1/2 cups frozen blueberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Combine the potatoes and crackers. Spoon into a lightly greased 9x13 baking dish, pressing all the crumb onto the surface of the potatoes. Sprinkle the crumb topping over the potatoes. Bake for 30 minutes or until crisp and golden brown. If desired, garnish with berries before serving.

title: French Cream on a Salad Plate
ingredients: 2 cups lettuce, finely shredded ( any type will work, i use iceberg lettuce ) | 3 tablespoons heavy whipping cream, to taste
instructions: Wash lettuce in a colander and dry them well using paper towels. Cut the large head of lettuce into 2 - 3 long strips. Combine the lettuce and cream in a medium bowl. Fold in the lettuce and serve at once.

title: Chipotles Flan (Korean Flatbread) #RSC
ingredients: 1 pizza dough, recipe for boboli | 3 scotch bonnet peppers, sliced ( not the jalapeã ole or piri-piri brand and not the habaneroã la ) | 1 tablespoon chinese chipotle chile, minced ( my addition )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400. Place dough in freezer for 10 - 15 minutes, then remove dough carefully from the freezer. Spray cookie sheet with vegetable spray. Take dough and make thin incissions on top of dough with the fingers, then lightly flour them. Place dough on the cookie sheet and bake at 400 until puffy and crust is tan in color. When dough is done, take off heat and remove dough from oven. Spoon off sauce from the pan over the dough. Scoop out desired amount. Fold in the ingredients and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,chicken bouillon cube,cooking oat,shallot,mirin,egg yolk,fennel
title: Fennel Oatmeal Drop Soup (Fatomaki)
ingredients: 1 package dried quick cooking oats ( about 3/4 cup ) | 2 cups fat free chicken broth or 2 cups chicken broth | 1 egg yolk | 1/3 cup shallot, minced | 1 tablespoon mirin ( japanese sweet wine ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves, crushed | 1 teaspoon fresh fennel, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large saucepan and bring to a simmer over medium heat. Reduce heat to low and cook until slightly thickened, stirring often, about 5 minutes. Serve hot, sprinkled with optional fennel.

title: The Perfect Mushrooms for feeding
ingredients: 12 chestnut mushrooms, cleaned and stemmed | 3 1/2 tablespoons clear honey | pistachio nut, chopped, to garnish
instructions: Wash the mushrooms very well, dry thoroughly, and dry on paper towels. Remove the stems and cut into quarters lengthwise. Remove the beak easily so as not to break open the mushroom cap. Combine the mushrooms and honey in a small mixing bowl and stir well. Spoon into the mushroom caps. Sprinkle generously with pistachio nuts. To shape into crescents, press a mushroom cap onto the tip of a small teaspoon and roll to form a cresent. Place in a casserole and bake for 15 minutes, then turn over and bake for 2 minutes more.

Random Ingredients: horseradish sauce,scotch bonnet pepper,chinese noodle,swiss chard
title: Swiss Chard Soup
ingredients: 3 swiss chard, stalks removed | 1/2 cup chopped scotch bonnet pepper | horseradish sauce | 4 ounces cooked chinese noodles
instructions: Blanch chard leaves, pressing them down with something on them to release their juices. Remove stalks and chop chard. Combine all ingredients in slow cooker, cover and cook on high setting for one hour or on low for 8 - 10 hours, until veggies are tender. Towards the end of cooking time, add more sauce, if desired and serve with warm chinese noodles.

title: Rhubarb Apples and Tofu
ingredients: 4 large green apples | 1/2 cup icing sugar ( sifted after measuring ) | 1/2 cup tamari | 1 -3 teaspoon green peppercorn | 1 tart green apple, cut into 8 wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f peel apple wedges. Cut wedges into wedges and place in baking dish. Sprinkle with icing sugar. Toss to coat. Bake 50 minutes or until warm, stirring once or twice. Cool on rack until cool. Place tart apple wedges onto a serving plate. Make your own tamari by combining the icing sugar and tamari in a saucepan. Cook over medium heat until mixture boils then cool to room temperature without stirring. Spoon over apples. Serve warm, or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: blue curacao,consomme,tart apple,chipotle chile,cotija cheese,poultry seasoning,cherry tomato
title: Apple Chili Piquant
ingredients: 8 cups apples ( pips, turnips, or peels ) | 1/2 cup consomme | 4 teaspoons poultry seasoning | 3/4 cup blue curacao | 2/3 cup cotija cheese, grated | 2/3 cup tart apples | 1/4 cup cherries or 1/4 cup cherry tomatoes, sliced
instructions: Cut all vegetables in large bowl and reserve. In a 4 quart saucepan combine, consomme, poultry seasoning, blue curacao, cotija cheese, grated cheese, and chopped apples.

Random Ingredients: pasta,rose water,green peppercorn,oil,white onion,bouquet garni,green chile
title: French Peppercorns Pasta
ingredients: 12 ounces whole green peppercorns | 2 green chiles | 1/4 cup oil | 12 ounces dry pasta or 12 ounces linguine | 1 white onion, sliced thinly | 1 tablespoon rose water | 1 bouquet garni or 1 tablespoon marjoram | 1 teaspoon rose water
instructions: Toast the whole peppercorns under the grill. Heat the oil in a large frying pan. Add the onion and cook until light brown. Add the wine and bring to the boil, cook for about 10 minutes, stirring. Add the rest of the ingredients, stir well and continue the cooking over a low heat for about 20 minutes, or until the pasta is tender. Serve over cooked pasta.

title: Cornflake Crusted Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin | 12 tablespoons tapioca flour | 3 tablespoons corn flakes
instructions: Trim of ALL of the visible fat from the tenderloin. Slice the tenderloin lengthwise into 3 thick, 2 x 3 long, 2/3 wide slices on the diagonal. In a shallow dish or plate, combine the tapioca flour and corn flakes and mix. Dip each slice of meat into the flour and corn flakes, coating evenly with flour. Set aside to rest and allow to sit until ready to cook. When ready, preheat your oven to 400 degrees f. Transfer the tenderloin to a roasting rack and arrange on a baking sheet or ovenproof baking dish. Roast for about 20 minutes or until the internal temperature reaches 155 degrees f for medium rare or 170 degrees f for well done. Allow the meat to rest for at least 5 minutes before slicing to serve.

title: Garlicky Baked Yellow Potatoes
ingredients: 4 large yellow potatoes, cleaned and scrubbed | 1 1/4 cups ricotta cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Set a large baking sheet on the stovetop. Using a sharp knife, cut a deep cut into the tops of the potatoes around the outside of the potatoes. Insert a spoonful of ricotta cheese into each potato. Pour a bit of water into a baking dish, about 2 tablespoons. Sprinkle the top of each potato with salt. Bake in the oven for 45 minutes.

title: Black Beans, Tamarind and Cucumber (indonesian Style)
ingredients: 1 lb black beans | 2 cucumbers, peeled | 1 container tamarind pulp
instructions: Wash beans, remove beans from skins by scraping with the blade of a knife or a knife. Soak the tamarind pulp in hot water for 5 minutes, drain then stir into bean water. Let stand overnight, then drain. Remove the hard shell inside of cucumber. Wash and pat dry. Cut cucumber in half through the stem and slice lengthwise about 1/2 inch thick. Place the cucumber halves and whole black bean halves in a pot and bring to a boil. Boil until cooked, about 30 minutes. Drain and discard the black bean skins. Stir in fresh cucumbers and black bean liquid. Heat on high until heated through and serve.

title: Bread Salad - for Dipping
ingredients: 9 slices white bread, firm and crusty | vinegar
instructions: Toast the bread at least a few minutes before serving, for about 2 minutes on each side. Remove and cool for about 45 seconds on a cutting board. Using a large sharp knife slice the bread into 4 slices. Cut a slit about 1/3 of the way down the each slice. Place the slices on a serving plate and sprinkle with a little vinegar and serve at once. Serve the cider vinegar on the side.

Random Ingredients: pita bread,spinach leaf,green,thyme sprig,baguette,white wine vinegar,chicken wing
title: Chicken Wings in a Bag
ingredients: 1 baguette | 8 chicken wings | 5 fresh thyme sprigs | 1 can chicken wings or ( 10 ounce ) can turkey wings | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | pita bread | spinach leaf
instructions: Cut baguette into 1/4 slices. Separate wings into sections to make more wings or larger pieces. Sprinkle wings with thyme.

title: Spanish Rice - Easy Version
ingredients: 1 cup short-grain rice | 32 ounces of cut green olives
instructions: Boil water for rice and pour into bowl. While waiting for the water to boil, you can drain the olives and place in a bowl. Add the olives to the rice, then pour in hot water. Stir until all water has been absorbed, about 5 minutes. Add the amount of rice remaining in bowl after rice is drained and stir. Cook rice for 15 - 20 minutes over medium heat until the top has turned deep golden brown color.

title: Apple and Avocado Salad
ingredients: 6 tart apples, such as granny smith, such as granny smith | 1/2 lb thinly sliced chinese cabbage | 1 medium avocado, peeled, pitted, and cut into bite-sized pieces | 1/4 cup light rum, warmed slightly | 2 teaspoons grated lemon peel
instructions: Toss apples and cabbage in bowl of a blender. Add avocado and rum and stir until avocado is slightly softened. Taste and adjust seasoning. Sprinkle with lemon peel.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,pork tenderloin,white bread,cooking apple,french onion soup,russet potato,beef base,bean
title: Crock Pot Normandy Pork Tenderloin and Potatoes
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pork tenderloin, cut into 4 medallions | 18 slices white bread, cut in half | cooking apple ( optional ) | french onion soup ( optional ) | 1 can low-fat refried beans ( optional ) | 1 package beef base | 6 medium russet potatoes, halved, about 3 cups | 1 carton whipping cream
instructions: Spray crockpot with cooking spray. Arrange 5 medallions of bread on the bottom of the crockpot. If using apple, arrange them first. Place 2 medallions of pork on bread. Top with 4 slices of bread to make 4 medallions. If using canola, remove pork from crockpot.

title: Chinese Restaurant Walnuts
ingredients: 1 -2 cucumber | 1/2 cup walnuts | 1 small chicken bouillon cube | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, with juice | 2 tablespoons garlic red hot pepper, minced | 4 tablespoons soy sauce | 3/4 cup rice, short-grain white rice, cooked
instructions: In microwave safe bowl, microwave rice. Cut cucumber, into quarters lengthwise & wash with water. Add to microwave and cook on high for 45 - 50 seconds, turn over & cook another 15 - 20 seconds. When done, place in a bowl & set aside. In a large bowl combine rice, water chestnuts, garlic chilies, soy sauce and walnuts. Mix well. Pour soy sauce mixture over rice mixture & mix well. Serve & enjoy.

Random Ingredients: asafoetida powder,olive oil,italian dressing,sherry wine vinegar
title: Tangy Italian Dressing
ingredients: 1/3 cup olive oil | 1/4 teaspoon hot asafoetida powder ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon dry sherry wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( optional )
instructions: Whisk oil, vinegar, and hot pepper in a large glass or vinaigrette mixing bowl. Add asafetida if you want. Stir to combine. Refrigerate 1 hour, stirring every so often. Store covered at least overnight in the refrigerator.

title: Skewered Meatballs
ingredients: 1 lb meatballs | 2 teaspoons ginger paste, fresh ginger, minced | cornmeal
instructions: Mix meat balls well. Marinate for at least 1/2 hr. Lightly coat metal skewers with corn meal. Thread meatballs on skewers. Brush with egg mixture, sprinkle with ginger. Broil for 8 - 10 minutes, turning frequently, or to desired doneness.

Random Ingredients: green bean,hard salami,daikon radish,apple cider,littleneck clam,broth,cucumber
title: Vietnamese Grilled Clams With Apples & Salami
ingredients: 4 hard salami, sliced thin | 2 cucumbers, thinly sliced | 2 bunches radishes, thinly sliced | 1 cup chicken stock or 1 cup broth | 1/3 cup apple cider ( optional ) | 1/3 lb littleneck clams, rinsed and patted dry | 1 1/2 lbs fresh green beans, trimmed
instructions: Heat grill or broiler to high. Arrange salami, cucumbers, radishes and chicen on prepared platter. In a bowl, add stock and cider if using. Cover and set aside. Grill or broil salami until crisp on all sides, about 3 - 5 minutes per side. Transfer to a cutting board. Add clams and greenbeans to the salami and toss. Place a platter over the top to keep clams from unrolling. Spoon clams over vegetables and serve.

Random Ingredients: peanut butter,balsamic vinegar,chorizo sausage,greek oregano,phyllo pastry,sun tomato oil,mango
title: Chorizo With Sun Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 package phyllo pastry | 2 chorizo sausage | 5 -6 ounces dried mangoes | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, chopped | 2 tablespoons peanut butter | 1 teaspoon greek oregano | 1 dash balsamic vinegar
instructions: In a large skillet over medium heat, cook chorizo until browned and cooked through. Remove from skillet and set aside to cool. Chop chorizo into 2 - 3 pieces each. In the same skillet add oil, sundried tomatoes and peanut butter. Add chorizo and mango, stir until heated through. To assemble, place one sheet of phyllo on counter and top with about 1/3 of the chorizo mixture spread evenly over phyllo. Wrap tightly and bake at 375°f for 20 - 30 minutes.

title: Shichimi Noodle Lasagna
ingredients: 12 fresh lasagna noodles ( about 1 pound ) | garnishes : | 2/3 jar shichimi togarashi | 2/3 cup finely chopped toasted pistachios | 2 cans sliced snow peas
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees f. Prepare lasagna noodles according to package directions. Arrange noodles on a baking sheet and arrange 1 cup of shichimi togarashi in an even layer over the noodles. Sprinkle with pistachios.

Random Ingredients: beef brisket,baby spinach leaf,glace cherry,shallot,enchilada sauce,olive oil cooking spray
title: Brisket at Home and Smoked Cherry Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 20 ounces of sliced smoked beef brisket or 20 ounces smoked boneless brisket, cut into 1-inch cubes | olive oil flavored cooking spray | 2 -3 tablespoons chopped shallots or 2 -3 tablespoons scallions | 10 -12 ounces enchilada sauce | 20 ounces frozen chopped spinach leaves, thawed | glace cherries, toasted
instructions: Coat the pan with cooking spray, sprinkle with desired amount of salt. Spray the meat with cooking spray. Set aside. In a 12 inch saute pan coated with cooking spray, add chopped shallots or scallions. Sauté until the shallots soften. Transfer to a bowl. Add 1 cup of enchilada sauce. Mix well and set aside. Add 1 - ½ lbs. Of spinach to remaining enchilada sauce and set aside. In a 13 by 9 inch baking dish, spread 1/4 of the enchilada sauce mixture in the bottom of the dish. Layer 3/4 of the meat and 2/3 of the spinach. Repeat until the 4th layer is used up. Top with reserved enchilada sauce. Cover and refrigerate, tightly covered, for at least 1 hour. When ready to cook, preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Remove meat from pan, pat dry with paper towels, and place on top of the partially cooked enchilada sauce. Arrange the remaining spinach in a large circle on top of the steaming meat. Arrange the cherry shavings on top of the meat. Cover and bake 40 minutes. Remove cover and continue baking another 30 minutes or so until meat cubes are hot and the sauce bubbling. Toss sauce with meat and serve.

title: Blueberry, Fruity Dessert - Vegan
ingredients: 8 -10 fresh blueberries | picante sauce ( your favorite brand ) | fresh fruit ( optional, i choose dannon's fruit whip which is a gourmet blend of fruit and veg. )
instructions: In a mixing bowl, mix blueberries with plenty of picante sauce. You can add fresh fruit to your bowl and mix well. It's best to keep the berries buried around you and do not use the berries to dip. Refrigerate a few hours or over night, until serving time. Note, add some or all of your seasonal veggies to the blueberry mixture if you like your veg. For best results, do not add any additional picante at this time. If you want your green, add some of your fruity fruit. You can add other veggies, veggies of your choice, or add your fruit before serving or just serve the dessert at room temperature.

title: The Easiest Mutton & Herb Curry Ever!
ingredients: 150 g mutton, cubed | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 teaspoon mixed herbs ( your favourite kind )
instructions: Sprinkle the garlic salt on the mutton. Heat up the curry in a pan. Add the mixed spices. Once fragrant turn up the heat & cook until all the liquid has been absorbed into the curry. Please note, this is a personal preference & does not include time to cook the mutton.

title: Tahini & Halibut Baked in Avocado With Mushrooms & Rice
ingredients: 4 teaspoons sesame tahini | 1 lb halibut fillet, cut in 2 inch | 2 portabella mushrooms, chopped | 1/4 cup tahini, sauce | 1 tablespoon fresh basil, roughly chopped | 4 portabella mushrooms, sliced | 1 large avocados, cut in half or 2 large hass avocados | 36 ladyfingers
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Combine the tahini and salt in a small bowl and set aside. Brush the halibut slices lightly with tahini and set aside. Combine the mushrooms and the pasta sauce in a medium bowl. Spread 1/4 cup of the pasta sauce over the bottom of an oven proof dish. Place the fish fillets on top and brush with some of the remaining tahini mixture. Top with mushrooms. Cover with the remaining pasta sauce and bake for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, prepare the avocado. Arrange the avocado halves on a serving platter and top with the mushrooms and the pasta sauce. Serve the fish, mushrooms and the pasta sauce on the side.

Random Ingredients: guacamole,bonito flake,lamb stew meat,balsamic vinegar,water,caper,bamboo shoot,italian herb
title: Aka Leg of Lamb Stew (Yoshinoya)
ingredients: 1 bone-in lamb stew meat | 4 tablespoons balsamic vinegar ( for flavour, i use white vinegar ) | 2 cans bamboo shoots | 2 cans whole drained capers | 1/2 - 1 cup water | 1 tablespoon mixed italian herbs ( optional ) | 1/4 cup dried guacamole | 1 tablespoon dried capers
instructions: In a large saucepan or dutch oven cook the lamb meat in the vinegar until it becomes slightly browned. Add the rest of the ingredients including the vinegar. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for one hour. Note if you would like to freeze, cover and place in freezer.

title: Beef and Beets
ingredients: 1 lb stew meat, cut into small pieces | 2 tablespoons ghee or 2 tablespoons margarine | 1 can canned white beans, drained | 1 box linguine, uncooked ( approx 1 1/2 cups ) | 1 cup creme fraiche or 1 cup greek yogurt | fresh beet, sliced | pesto sauce ( optional )
instructions: Brown stew meat in oil or margarine over medium heat in a large skillet. Add beans, pasta and cream fraiche stirring to combine. Simmer 15 - 20 minutes. If desired garnish with grated beet, if desired.

Random Ingredients: apple,chicken breast half,french bread,pita bread,custard,hamburger,trout,green chilies
title: Cordon Bleu Chicken Pita Burgers With Crispy Toasted Apple Meat and Beans
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 2 tablespoons custard, powder | 1/3 cup canned chopped green chilies, drained | 1 large apple, chopped | 4 -6 slices french bread, cut in half | 2 tablespoons cooked cubed chicken breast half | 2 tablespoons sliced cooked turkey breast halves or 2 tablespoons deli ham | 4 toasted pita bread rounds
instructions: Mix together first 4 ingredients. Dip bread in custard mixture to coat, then arrange on cookie sheet. Bake at 375°f for 5 minutes or until toasted. Top with meat, then turkey and beans. Serve on toasted pita with salad and a side salad.

title: Wedding Mushrooms for 2
ingredients: 1 lb button mushroom | 1 dozen clams | 1/2 cup cream cheese | 2 tablespoons tamari | 2 slices salt pork or 2 slices swiss cheese ( optional ) | 1 package dried wild mushrooms
instructions: Cut off any mushrooms stems and any dirt and wash the mushrooms. Wash the clams thoroughly under cold water and pat dry with cloth or paper towels. In a dutch oven, dissolve 1/2 cup salt pork into 4 tablespoons cream cheese. Add mushroom caps and cream cheese mixture to the pot. Wash and pat dry the dried wild mushrooms. Add the clams to the pot. Add the remaining cream cheese to the mushroom mix and stir until melted on low heat and mix well for 5 minutes. Serve with rice.

title: Sweet Potato and Mango Stir Fry #5FIX
ingredients: 1 package simply potatoes diced potatoes with onions | 1 package simply potatoes diced potatoes with onion | 1 cup dry pasta, such as linguine | 1 cup green mango, peeled and cubed
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees. Coat a 9x13 in baking dish with nonstick spray. In a medium bowl, mix together simply potatoes diced potatoes with onion. Spread mixture into baking dish. Bake 45 minutes, stirring halfway through. Meanwhile in oven, cook pasta according to package directions. Drain, add mango. Allow to cool slightly before serving.

title: Sake On-The-Rice Pizza - Japanese Style Style
ingredients: 1 ready-made pizza crust, such as boboli
instructions: Pour 1 tablespoon mirin into a small dipping bowl. Use the back of a spoon to press the mirin to the edge of the bowl. Turn the pizza crust and spread the saki sauce evenly over the crust. Dip your index finger into the mirin and press the soy sauce into the surface as well.

Top with 1/2 cup picante sauce. Grill on high heat 4 - 5 minutes to soften cheese.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,green bell pepper,soymilk,dark brown sugar,sage,salmon fillet,veal
title: Patsy's Swedish Gluten Free Creamed Salmon
ingredients: 3/4 cup gluten-free soy milk ( i prefer egg beaters ) | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar ( i use caster smart balance ) | 6 pieces salmon fillets | 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/2 teaspoon ground sage | 1/4 cup minced green bell pepper | 1/2 cup plain soymilk
instructions: Place soy milk, brown sugar, salt, sage, and chilies in a baking dish large enough to let all ingrdients touch. Place salmon fillets into dish, pouring soy milk mixture over fish. Add bell pepper and soymilk. Cover, and refrigerate at least an hour, or overnight. Preheat broiler and lightly brush top of fillets with olive oil. Broil until golden and flake easily before serving.

Random Ingredients: red delicious apple,yellow bell pepper,dark sesame oil,pork loin,catsup,apricot preserve,snow pea,chocolate
title: Spicy Pork and Apples
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1/2 lb pork loin, very thinly sliced crosswise ( about 3/4 lb. ) | 1 cup yellow bell pepper, strips | 1 cup red delicious apple, thinly sliced crosswise | 1 cup snow peas | 1/4 cup apricot preserves | 1/4 cup catsup | 1 tablespoon unsweetened chocolate, coarsely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Prepare all ingredients, in a large nonstick skillet, heat sesame oil over medium high heat, 1 minute. Add pork and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned, about 3 minutes. Stir in bell pepper and apples, cook 1 minute. Stir in preserves and chiaateate ingredients. Cook, stirring until glaze is heated through. Arrange pork and vegetables attractively on platter or serving platter. Pass sauce at table.

title: Homemade Cornflour
ingredients: 12 tablespoons cornflour, a good quality | 12 tablespoons fresh thyme leaves, chopped
instructions: Melt the cornflour in a heavy based saucepan. Slowly add the warm thyme leaves and stir continuously until the mixture turns light brown in colour. Remove the pan from the heat and leave it to cool whilst making the paste. Preheat the oven to 200c 400f degrees or 230c gas, then transfer the paste to a clean jar. Cover with a lid or aluminium foil and seal. The paste can then be stored in the fridge or frozen for up to 3 months.

title: Azerbaijani's Kielbasa and Spinach
ingredients: 3 tablespoons sriracha sauce | 1/4 teaspoon ground pepperoni or 1/4 teaspoon ground cayenne pepper | 6 ounces smoked kielbasa or 6 ounces polish sausage, sliced into coins | 1 lb fresh baby spinach, stems removed | 10 ounces baby spinach leaves
instructions: Combine ingredients in a bowl and set aside. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Place kielbasa slices in a large baking dish. Place the spinach leaves near the edges on foil. Bake 10 - 12 minutes, stirring halfway through until browned. Transfer keielbasa to a platter, pour sauce over, and serve.

title: Pam's Brown Rice Breakfast
ingredients: 1/2 cup brown rice | 1/2 cup buttermilk
instructions: Boil and cook rice. When rice just starts to stick on top pour buttermilk over rice/rice. Mix all ingredients in microwave safe bowl. Microwave on high for 2 minutes or until milk and buttermilk is well blended around rice mixture. Stir well.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed oil,lime,ham hock,cooking oil,kaffir lime leaf,pepper,hazelnut
title: Lime and Ham Hocks
ingredients: 2 lbs ham hocks | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds oil | 4 ounces ground hazelnuts | 16 kaffir lime leaves | 2 tablespoons sesame seed oil | pepper | 1 lime slice, for garnish | cooking oil | 4 dried limes
instructions: Scrub ham and prick with a fork. Put all ingredients except kaffir lime leaves and sesame seeds in a saucepan, and simmer until mixture thickens. Pour the mixture into a colander and squeeze the juice of 2 large limes over ham. Let drain for 1 hour. Remove ham hocks from liquid. Chop meat. Return ham to liquid and let cool then refrigerate several hours or overnight. Prepare grill and preheat broiler. Thread meat on metal skewers. Heat oil over med. Heat in a skillet that has been coated with cooking spray. Add cimes and cook until they are cooked through. About 1 minute per side. Drain on paper towels. Serve garnished with lime slice. Tips, marinating ham can be tricky and messy depending on how much you like a different flavor.

title: Mexican Spicy Mint
ingredients: 1 lime, sliced and cut into wedges | 2 tablespoons minced fresh garlic or 2 tablespoons fresh garlic powder | 1 dried red chili pepper ( or 1-1 1/2 t dried chili powder )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl.

title: Baharat Arawak (Island Tilapia)
ingredients: 1 tilapia fillet | 2 teaspoons saffron | 2 teaspoons rice wine
instructions: Rinse your tilapia fillet completely with water. Coat a heavy skillet with cooking spray and fry the tilapia on both sides until brown and cooked through. When the fish is finished cooking, drain any excess oil the fish may have and add the saffron to the skillet with the fish. Add the rice wine. Turn down heat a little. Transfer the fish to a platter and spoon the saffron sauce over it.

Random Ingredients: mint leaf,grain rice,salt pepper,anchovy fillet,halloumi cheese
title: Halloumi and Rice on the Half Shell
ingredients: 2 tablespoons split long grain rice ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 1 1/4 pints boiling water | salt and pepper | 1 -2 anchovy fillet, rinsed | 4 -6 slices halloumi cheese ( thin slices )
instructions: Rinse the rice thoroughly then place in a deep serving dish. Pour in boiling water. Add salt and pepper to taste then cover and leave to stand for 2 hours until it steams. Add the anchovy fillet and cover again. This makes steam holes in the rice that will allow for the heat of the liquid to penetrate. This should take 2 or 3 minutes. This should take only a little more cooking time than cooking the rice. Stir the rice so that the salt and pepper are evenly distributed, then add the cheese slices. Serve immediately. Makes about 2 1/2 cups.

title: Beijing Sprouts and Pine Nuts
ingredients: 1 small cauliflower, washed, separated into small florets, about 9 ounces | 1 can bean sprouts, drained | 2 tablespoons sherry wine or 2 tablespoons dry vermouth | 1 tablespoon toasted pine nuts
instructions: Place the blanching vegetable in a steamer basket over boiling water. Cover partially and steam until the vegetables are tender. Place rice in a bowl and set aside. Place the sprouts in a large bowl. Add sherry or vermouth and toss to coat. To serve, sprinkle prawns with toasted pine nuts and serve immediately.

title: Sweet Red Curry Paste for Salads and Brisket
ingredients: 10 tablespoons red curry paste | 10 tablespoons ground allspice
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and store in the container for up to 3 months.

title: Creamy Crushed Mushrooms
ingredients: 20 cremini mushrooms, stems removed | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme leaves
instructions: To facilitate the stuffing, remove the soft, tender stems from the mushrooms using your hands. Remove the tough stalks from the mushrooms using your fingers.

title: Oyster Shooters
ingredients: 4 -5 dozen oysters, shelled ( see note above ) | 1 cup tapioca flour ( see note above )
instructions: Wash her shells well, removing outer shells as they become difficult to clean. Rinse under cold running water and shell dry thoroughly. In a large pot or dutch oven, lightly fry the shells over high heat. As soon as they begin to change color, remove and discard any shells that float to the top. Drain the shell and keep them warm with a damp cloth. Place shells on a large plate. Fill each shell with 1 rounded tsp of tapioca flour. Note, tapioca flour is available at middle eastern and pakistani grocers, sometimes near the cream cone shape. It is available at most european health food sections and specialty foods shops. Note, if shelled the oysters, she will need to scrub a clean shot glass lightly with a hot dry rub. The shells will change color as the oysters become more opaque. Dry the shells after a few minutes so they will be easier to remove their tails when opened. They are hard to clean, especially if you have got a dark plastic head.

title: Homemade Perfect Coffee
ingredients: 4 1/2 - 5 cups freshly brewed strong coffee, cold | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil
instructions: In a large heavy bottomed pot, heat the olive oil and warm it over medium heat. Add the coffee and stir with a spoon until the foam dissolves. Add enough of the hot coffee to cover the surface of the coffee. Cover the pot and keep on very low heat. When the foam subsides, turn off the heat, and let the coffee infuse for about 15 - 24 minutes before ladling the coffee through a fine mesh sieve.

title: Mushroom and Chicken Bouillon
ingredients: 1 bag button mushrooms | 2 ounces chicken bouillon
instructions: Wash the mushrooms under running water. Dry them out, wash them in a clean towel and chop them up as you go along. Add the chicken bouillon and bouillon to the mushrooms in a bowl. Let the mushroom and bouillon sit in the fridge for about an hour and a half. Enjoy. Note, can be served toasted and reheated, by serving over rice, as a side dish for meat or poultry, or just serve over cooked noodles for an amazing, quick and elegant meal at a picnic.

title: Chicken Quesadilla
ingredients: 4 lbs chicken wings | 1 lb swiss cheese | 1 can pinto beans, undrained | 6 ounces thousand island salad greens | 1 bunch fresh cilantro, chopped ( optional ) | 1/2 cup sprite ( optional )
instructions: Place wings up in a large pot. Bring water to a boil, remove tips and pieces of wings and place on a plate. Turn stove down to low and cover. Simmer for 90 minutes to 1 hour or until wings are done to your liking. After the water has evaporated and wings are tender, remove wings from pot and place under a warm oven setting. Toast pinto beans in an ungreased skillet on low heat about 10 minutes, stirring several times till desired texture is reached.. Place cheese over top of all other ingredients, sprinkle with cilantro and drizzle of sprite if desired. Place under broiler for 3 - 4 minutes until bubbly and melted.

title: Black Bean Shake
ingredients: 1 can black beans | 2 large ice cubes ( use the block size in your blender ) | 1/2 cup strawberry yogurt
instructions: Drain liquid from can of black beans into a blender or food processor. Process bean mixture until smooth, stopping to scrape down sides. Add ice cubes and process until it begins to form solid, pouring through a mesh sieve. Add yogurt and process until smooth. Transfer to glass jar and refrigerate till ready to serve. Serve over ice from the jar filled with ice cubes.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile adobo,icing sugar,fenugreek seed,pork tenderloin,yellow pepper,lime juice,red pepper flake,confectioner sugar
title: Mama's Smoked Calamares
ingredients: 2 tablespoons lime juice | 1 chipotle chile in adobo, minced | 1/8 teaspoon red pepper flakes | 1 1/2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 1/4 teaspoon fenugreek seeds | 1 pound pork tenderloin | 1 large yellow pepper | 2 red peppers | 1/2 cup icing sugar
instructions: Preheat the oven's broiler and set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil, and spray with cooking spray. Stir together the lime juice, chipotle chile and red pepper flakes in a saucepan over medium heat.

title: Chicken and Beef Jerky Mix
ingredients: 1/2 cup orange juice | 2 tablespoons ground beef sirloin steak | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 12 leaves knox chicken or 12 leaves turkey
instructions: Combine orange juice, ground beef, ground nutmeg 1/8 tsp each, and turkey in a small bowl. Sprinkle over beef mixture. Place 1 turkey leaf, 1/8 tsp side by side, on each of four pieces of reynolds wrap non stick foil. Bring outside edges over in center of foil and place package on top.

title: Swiss Beans With Fried Beef Franks
ingredients: 1 package fresh spinach | 4 slices kosher beef franks, preferably center cut | 1 can navy beans, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Wear gloves to wash steamer basket and bring to a boil. Place a steamer basket into a large pot of water, and fill with water to just below the bottom of the basket. Line a strainer with cheese cloth. Bring spinach to boil in the bowl of a food processor or blender, or in a large bowl with lid, then turn off the heat. Pour spinach into colander or strainer.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,soba noodle,fenugreek leaf,clove,kalamata olive,fish sauce
title: Grilled Soba Noodles With Olives & Pesto (Phode Island)
ingredients: 1/2 cup kalamata olive, halved lengthwise | 6 tablespoons toasted sesame pesto ( found at asian market ( phode island foods ) ) | 2 tablespoons minced garlic | 2 -4 tablespoons fish sauce | 5 tablespoons minced fresh fenugreek leaves ( keshi methi ) | 1/8 teaspoon ground cloves
instructions: Combine olives, pesto, garlic and fish sauce in a small bowl. Season with salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste. Spread mixture on cut surface of noodles and roll noodles into a tight log. Grill log over high grill until crisp and light brown, about 3 minutes per side.

title: Chipotle's Ponzu
ingredients: 1 -2 chipotle chile | 1 -2 tablespoon ponzu sauce | 2 tablespoons miso
instructions: Wash, core and seed the chipotle chilies and place them on a hot griddle or skillet. Grill the chiles until the skin is blistered and black, then remove them from the griddle and put them onto a clean towel to loosen the blackened skin. Rub the skin with a clean, moist cloth. Slice the seeds into thin rounds, set aside. Place the ponzu sauce and miso in a mortar or a blender. When the ponzu is mixed well, stir in the chiles. Keep adding miso as needed, stirring until all the miso pieces have been dissolved.

title: Homemade Sour Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs tomatoes, in ripe, vine, hulled, stems removed, and cut into half-inch thick slices | 1 medium serrano chilies or 3 -4 small red jalapeno chilies, seeded, and minced | 12 -16 ounces buttermilk
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine the tomatoes, chile, and buttermilk. Bring to a boil, stirring once. Reduce heat, cover and simmer, stirring occasionally, until the tomatoes are very soft, about 30 minutes. Serve hot, warm, or cold.

title: Asafetida Burger
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs hamburger ( i use lean, but any combination of ground meat will work for me ) | 1/8 teaspoon saffron | 1 tablespoon lemon peel ( i use a grater ) | 1/8 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( optional ) | 1/8 cup corn chips | 8 slices hamburger ( i like keema, but i like the whole thing ) or 8 slices cheddar cheese ( i like the whole thing )
instructions: Mix everything together to form a large, well blended bun. I put one slice of bread on a plate, it should be in a triangle shape at the bottom so the hamburger can be separated from the other. Spread about 2 tbls of the topping on the bread, if desired. I then top with a slice of cheese, asafetida, if desired. Broil until the topping is bubbly, and the bun is lightly toasted. Cut into 8 wedges. Serve with hot fries or vegetables.

Random Ingredients: potato flake,beef,sugar,red pepper flake,liquid smoke,dark brown sugar
title: Cajun Style Hot Dogs
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground beef | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke | 1/2 cup granulated sugar | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon potato flakes
instructions: Brown hamburger with brown sugar, liquid smoke and pepper flakes about 10 minutes, or until well cooked. Add potato flakes and stir until coated. Serve with cooked egg rolls or crackers.

title: Spaghetti and Kielbasa (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 2 lbs smoked kielbasa, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 1/2 teaspoons whole cumin seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons black tea | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | cooked spaghetti
instructions: Place the kielbasa in the bottom of the crockpot. Sprinkle the cumin seeds over the kielbasa. Pour in the tea, cayenne pepper and black tea. Set crockpot to low and cook for 4 - 6 hours, or until kielbasa is cooked through and no longer pink. Serve with spaghetti.

title: Chicken-Shrimp Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb raw large shrimp | 3 tablespoons chicken bouillon granules | 1/4 cup chicken bouillon granules ( i use 2 tsp. )
instructions: Shell shrimp and split into two 1/4 to 1/2 inch pieces. Sprinkle shrimp on both sides with 1 tsp. Of bouillon. Cook in large skillet sprayed with cooking spray over medium high heat, stirring constantly for 1 minute or until shrimp turn white, stirring often. Stir in remaining 2 cups of chicken bouillon, stirring in any browned bits in skillet. Serve with your favorite cooked pasta.

Random Ingredients: lager beer,red cabbage,urad dal,green chili pepper
title: Shorbet Makhani - Red Cabbage & Beer
ingredients: 1 lb lager beer, of your choice ( you can sub other dark beer ) | 4 cups finely shredded red cabbage | 1 green chili pepper, finely chopped ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon red lentil ( optional )
instructions: Mix together all ingredients in a bowl, cover and refrigerate for 15 minutes or up to 4 hours. Remove from refrigerator, remove leafy center of cabbage and wash thoroughly with several changes of water until the leaves are clean. Place in the center of a large, deep platter and surround with rows of curly, flat pieces of tomato or red cabbage. Garnish with chives. If serving the next day, chill completely.

Random Ingredients: green chili,cognac,coconut milk,cabbage leaf,coffee granule,chicken broth
title: Coconut-Steeped Cabbage(Ribollita)
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs cabbage leaves, washed well | 1 can light coconut milk ( 398 ml ) | 1 - 1 1/2 cup low sodium chicken broth or 1 -1 1/2 cup water | 1/4 cup cognac, or additional to taste | 1 -2 teaspoon instant coffee granules, to taste | 1 -2 green chili, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Line 2 large colander with cheesecloth, and place atop colander. In a large saucepan over medium heat, combine coconut milk, chicken broth or water, cognac or splenda, and instant coffee. Bring to a boil, and simmer for 2 minutes remove coffee granules, and stir in the coconut cream. Add cabbage leaves, stir to submerge leaves, and simmer 8 - 10 minutes, or until cabbage is wilted. Serve hot, sprinkled with chili, if desired.

title: Great Feta Spread
ingredients: 8 ounces crumbled feta | cooking spray | 1 teaspoon spicy brown mustard
instructions: Spread the feta on a plate and crumble some or all of it. Spread with mustard, you can add more or less depending on your tastes.

title: Cherry Stuffed Chicken Tenderloins
ingredients: 8 skinless, boneless chicken tenderloins | 1 ounce kahlua | 1 ounce artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 teaspoon sesame seeds | 1/4 cup cherry, halved
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Cut a slit almost in each chicken tenderloin using the flat side of a knife or scissors, being careful not to cut all the way through to the other side. Mix together the kahlua and artichoke hearts in a bowl. Lay chicken tenderloins on a baking sheet, and cover with kahlua mixture. Sprinkle with thyme and sesame seeds. Place in the preheated oven, and bake 1 hour 15 minutes, turning the chicken every 15 minutes, or until the juices run clear. Serve stuffing warm with beans and green beans.

Random Ingredients: beef roast,fish,mango chutney,snow pea,filling,watercress,angel hair pasta
title: Vietnamese Beef and Snow Peas
ingredients: 4 ounces angel hair pasta | 1 package frozen snow peas, thawed, divided | 2 packages frozen sliced meat, thawed | 2 cans seasoned roast beef, with pepper | 1 jar mango chutney | 3/4 cup fish | 1 cup watercress, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Quick Cauliflower Spread
ingredients: 1 can cauliflower florets, drained and chopped coarse | 1 can sliced roasted peanuts | 1 mediumweet bix | salt & pepper
instructions: In a bowl, combine all ingredients. Mix well. Season to taste. Enjoy note,. May make ahead for later meal.

title: Feta Saganaki for a Crowd
ingredients: 200 g g feta, cut in small chunks | 1 papaya, cut in chunks ( ripe )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c put the feta chunks in a bowl. Add the papaya and mix together with your hands until the greek feta gets all the moisture in it. Scrape the papaya bits from the bottom of the bowl with a spatula or a spatula, then pour the feta mixture over the feta and mix together until combined. Put the mixture into a baking dish or roasting tin lined with foil and bake for around 20 - 25 minutes or until the papaya is soft and the feta is golden.

title: English Pea and Blue Cheese Salad (England)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon oil | 4 tablespoons blue cheese | 2 ounces white onions, coarsely chopped
instructions: Heat oil in small frying pan, add onions and cook until golden brown, about 2 - 3 minutes. Remove from heat and cool slightly while preparing salad/salad. Slice pea to 1/4 in thick rounds and arrange on serving platter. Top with cheese and onion.

title: Italian Flag Dip
ingredients: 1 cup crumbled mozzarella cheese | 2/3 cup chopped roasted pistachios | 3 large serrano peppers, halved and seeded
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Line large baking sheets with parchment paper. Stir together the mozzarella cheese, pistachios, and serrano peppers in the bowl of a food processor until well combined. Pour half of the cheese mixture into a 2 quart baking dish.

Random Ingredients: green pea,rib eye,chili pepper flake,chinese five spice powder
title: Five-Spice Beef Rib Appetizers
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 cup green peas or 1 -1 1/2 cup green beans, frozen | 1 tablespoon chinese five spice powder | 1/4 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 2 lbs rib eye, frozen
instructions: Mix all ingredients, except the frozen meat, in a small bowl, mix well. Place frozen meat in a freezer bag and coat evenly with the spice mix. Place frozen meat in a resealable zip lock bag with the contents of the bag, seal and shake. Repeat with the frozen meat in batches, refrigerate for no more than one hour, turning bag frequently.

Random Ingredients: panko breadcrumb,golden raisin,spicy brown mustard,kosher salt,coconut,pine nut,navel orange
title: Raisin Nuts
ingredients: 500 g spicy brown mustard | 4 navel oranges | 1/2 cup raw panko breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons pine nuts, lightly toasted | 1 tablespoon golden raisin | 1 teaspoon coconut, grated | 1/2 tablespoon kosher salt
instructions: Wash and dry the orange. Slice down the oranges so you have two thin sections. Peel the zest, place in a colander, and sprinkle evenly with kosher salt. Place in the sink and sprinkle with kosher salt. Leave for a half hour. While that is draining, prepare the sandwich. Preheat the grill. In a large bowl combine the mustard and panko. Add the oranges, pine nuts, raisins and coconut. Sprinkle evenly with kosher salt. Add more mustard if necessary. Place the bread crumbs on a plate. Form each orange section into a football shape. On the grilling grate, flatten each orange to ¼” thick. Grill until bread crumbs turn golden, and orange is tender and crispy. Serve the orange rolls warm as an accompaniment.

title: Carnation Oysters
ingredients: 1 quart oyster ( or other light tasting liquor ) | 1 small yellow bell pepper | 1 can cranberry beans
instructions: Clean and clean the shell of the oysters. Make sure to have an old piece of fresh skin on it so the oysters do not crack open while cooking. To remove the skin, rinse under cold water and pat dry with paper towels. Drain oysters and set aside. Open the can of cranberry beans and add the cranberries, and shake gently until cranberries have soaked inches. Place all the pieces of oysters and the drained can of cranberry beans into a large serving dish or appropriate serving container. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until cold, about 5 - 6 hours or overnight. Enjoy.

title: Gigot
ingredients: 4 yukon gold potatoes ( about 2/3 pound ) | 1 -2 tablespoon tomato paste
instructions: Scrub potatoes, place in a steamer basket over a pot of cold water and bring to a boil. Boil for about 10 minutes, until the potatoes are tender. Drain, let cool, then slice potatoes into 1/4 inch slices, or more if desired. Spread tomato paste on slices. Cook in a skillet over medium heat for a few minutes more, stirring occasionally to avoid burning. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock cube,extra virgin olive oil,cayenne,strawberry,banana,andouille sausage,horseradish
title: Andouille Sausage and Banana Soup
ingredients: 1 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 1/2 lbs mild chicken sausage, casings removed | 1 banana, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon horseradish, grated | 4 cups duck stock cubes or 4 cups vegetable stock | 1 1/2 teaspoons cayenne | 12 strawberries, washed and quartered | 8 tablespoons dry horseradish
instructions: Heat the oil in a heavy pan. Add the sausage and brown for 5 minutes. Add the banana, horseradish, stock cubes or vegetable stock and cayenne. Bring to the boil, reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes. Add the strawberries, then simmer for 5 minutes more. Remove from the heat and stir in the horseradish.

title: Texas  Hot  Sausages  (The Bahamas)
ingredients: 1 lb of assorted assorted meat sausages ( i like to use johnsonville `` hot '' brand all round sausages ) | 1/2 cup of minced green peppers ( with ribs )
instructions: Place sausages in frying pan to brown, flipping once, set aside and cover with foil to keep warm. Pour oil into frying pan and add pepper to taste and brown sausages on all sides. Place skillet on stove and simmer for 10 minutes. Serve hot on buns with shredded cabbage or fresh french bread and enjoy.

title: The Classic Australian Beef, Carrots And Au Gratin
ingredients: 450 g streaky steak, trimmed of all visible fat and shaved into thin strips ( rib eye ) | 1 large carrot, peeled and cut into thin sticks | 100 g baby carrots, halved | 250 g turnips | 125 g pickled potatoes | 1 cup low-fat coffee | 1/4 cup caster sugar | 1 artificial sweetener ( optional ) ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the grill to high. In a large bowl, toss the steak, carrots and turnips with the beans, peas, sugar and coffee until well coated. Thread the carrots, turnips and potatoes onto the skewers. Grill over direct heat for 8 minutes or until browned and cooked through. Serve.

title: Simple Thai Red Curry Paste
ingredients: 1 large green pepper | 3 teaspoons thai red curry paste ( i use kikkoman brand )
instructions: Take a deep frying pan or wok and heat until hot enough to sizzle a few drops of water. Add peppers and cook until tender, but still crisp. Remove peppers to a serving dish. Dry all but about a teaspoon of paste base. Add remaining paste base and stir to combine. Pile peppers into serving dish. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Crispy Onions
ingredients: 2/3 cup rice wine vinegar | 1 -2 tablespoon lime rind, finely grated | 2 packages semi-sweet tortilla chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°. Combine rice wine vinegar, lime rind, and crushed tortilla chips in a small bowl.

title: Cuban Black Beans (Frijoles Negros)
ingredients: 2 lbs dried black beans, sorted and washed | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 tablespoon molasses
instructions: Place beans in a large dutch oven with a large cover.

title: Hazelnut Smoothie
ingredients: 2 ounces hazelnuts | 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 6 ounces black olives
instructions: Pound hazelnuts on a cutting board until very finely ground. Add ground hazelnuts to a small bowl. Stir in 1/2 cup yogurt and 2 olives, and gently blend. Serve immediately.

title: Cassava - Potato Grilled Custard
ingredients: 4 cups cassava, grated ( cassava ) | 1 small fresh white onion, cut into wedges | 2 hard-boiled eggs, diced | 1 1/2 cups greek yogurt ( plain or vanilla ) | 1 cup heavy cream or 1 cup greek yogurt | 3/4 cup golden raisin, chopped | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon saffron, dissolved in 1 tbls. hot water | 2 teaspoons sugar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 250 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or oiled aluminum foil. Put the cassava in a colander and shake it so the corn stays loose from the edges. Discard the excess liquid. Stir the onion and eggs together in a large bowl in a small, shallow bowl to lighten the flavors.

title: Blue Cheese, Tomatoes, and Garlic Paste
ingredients: 5 medium plum tomatoes, preferably red, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 teaspoon garlic paste, or to taste | 1/4 cup crumbled blue cheese ( optional )
instructions: Place tomatoes in a bowl. Sprinkle with garlic paste.

title: Tamarind Fish Noodle Salad
ingredients: 4 ounces linguine | 1 small pineapple, cut into thick slices | 1/2 cup finely chopped kielbasa | 2 tablespoons tamarind paste, dissolved in a little water | 4 ounces hot sauce | 8 ounces garlic sausage, thinly sliced | 1 nutmeg, grated
instructions: Cook the linguine, according to packet instructions, but omit the salt until just tender, so it can be drained on kitchen paper. Chop the pineapple and kielbasa finely, mix with the cooked pasta, and add the tamarind paste. Pour over the hot sauce and season with freshly grated nutmeg, and mix well.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,oxo beef cube,stewing beef,tomatillo
title: Kaffir Lime Pot Roast
ingredients: 1 beef oxo cube | 1 lb stewing beef, cubes, cut in 1 inch cubes | 14 ounces tomatillos, cut with husks into half moons | 1 lime leaves, torn
instructions: Mix all ingredients except the lime leaves into crockpot. Cook on high for 3 hours or low for 8 hours. Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: hamburger,parmesan cheese,japanese soy sauce,rice,black pepper,lettuce leaf,tortilla
title: Japanese Beef Rolls (Sopa Goma )
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs hamburger | 1/2 teaspoon black pepper | 8 -12 lettuce leaves | 2 tablespoons rice ( or japanese's sake or mirin ) | 2 tablespoons japanese soy sauce | 5 1/2 2 1/2 teaspoons parmesan cheese | 4 -5 tortillas
instructions: Brown the beef and pepper. Drain the fat. Place 1 tbsp rice or sake in the freezer for about 10 minutes. Place 2 to 3 tbsp meat in each leaf and roll tightly. Arrange the rolls in a greased roasting pan. Place pan in preheated 375° oven and bake for 20 minutes. Remove from oven and top with soy sauce and parmesan cheese then return to oven for 10 more minutes. Serve with a green salad, warm tortillas.

Random Ingredients: milk powder,grand marnier,creme fraiche,tart apple,oil,romaine lettuce,vodka,butter
title: Apple & Lovage Creme Fraiche Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter | 2 tablespoons ground oil | 1 tablespoon grand marnier | 2 tart apples, diced | 1/2 cup milk powder | 1/2 cup creme fraiche or 1/2 cup sour cream, chilled | 1 tablespoon grand marnier | 1 packet romaine lettuce, rinsed, dried and torn | 1/2 cup oil-packed sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees celcius. Place all but 4 tablespoons of the butter and the oil in a frying pan and heat until aromatic. Add the grand marnier and cook 1 minute. Add the apples and continue cooking 5 minutes, or until slightly softened. Remove from heat and stir in the milk powder and creme fraiche or sour cream. Serve the apple mixture on a large lettuce leaf with the remaining butter.

title: Easy Parsnips
ingredients: 2 parsnips, peeled | 1/2 cup light ranch dressing
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Combine parsnips and dressing, and toss to coat. Spray a casserole dish with cooking spray. Arrange vegetables around the edge of the casserole dish. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes, or until just tender.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper,sake,garlic clove,mustard seed,tarragon vinegar,sherry wine
title: Shoyu Sauce (Japanese Shoyu Marinade)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dry sherry wine | 2 tablespoons tarragon vinegar | 1 -2 jalapeno pepper | 2 garlic cloves | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon sake
instructions: In jar, combine all ingredients. Shake until well blended and refrigerate for at least 2 hours before using.

title: Basic Shortbread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour | 1 can water chestnut, sliced ( i prefer drained )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425f, and line cookie sheets with parchment paper. In a medium size mixing bowl, stir together the flour and water chestnuts with a fork, just enough to work the water. Stir in the remaining ingredients until well incorporated and dough forms a ball forms. Turn out onto a lightly floured surface and level. Knead until it is smooth and shiny. Form dough into a ball. Lightly oil a 9 inch pie dish or round 8 inch square pan with a removable bottom. Roll out dough into a log onto the prepared cookie sheets. Trim all the excess dough from the log. Make an indentation in the center of the log. Press the dough into the indentation, leveling out the indentations. Cut a slit in the top of the crust to allow steam to escape. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes, or until dough is golden brown and crust is a nice, rich golden brown color. Let stand 5 minutes then transfer to a rack to cool completely.

title: Smoked Salmon Linguine
ingredients: 14 ounces red salmon ( in a little jar ) | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 12 ounces linguine
instructions: Combine ingredients and pour over hot, drained linguine. Serve with grated parmesan cheese.

title: Smoked Genoa Salami
ingredients: 3 ounces smoked genoa salami, cut into long strips | 1/2 ounce cashew nuts, toasted | 1 chipotle chile, minced
instructions: Place the salami and cashew nuts on a baking sheet and toast in oven, about 5 minutes. Watch carefully not to burn. Remove from oven and stir the chipotle chile into bread, adding a touch of water. Top with the salami and serve.

title: Borshch
ingredients: 2 lbs small beets, rinsed and cleaned ( or 3 pounds beets, quartered ) | 2 celery ribs, trimmed and chopped | 1 large white onion, peeled and chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place a 6 to 8 inch cast iron skillet in oven with a rack. Put the cleaned beets under the broiler. When lightly brown, remove beets to a large bowl.

title: Beef and Peppers With Beans
ingredients: 1 teaspoon soy sauce | 1/4 lb ground beef | 1/4 lb bell pepper, chopped | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 cup kidney bean, drained
instructions: In small bowl, mix together soy sauce, ground beef and bell pepper. Drain meat on paper towel. Set aside. Heat 1 tbs of sesame oil in wok or frying pan. In separate bowl, mix bean liquid and cornstarch until smooth. Add bean liquid mixture to the meat and pepper and stir fry for about two minutes or until meat and vegetables are lightly browned. Serve over rice.

Random Ingredients: burdock root,milk ricotta cheese,rose water,thai red chili pepper
title: Ricotta Dessert With Hot Red Chilli Peppers (Lihapyapa)
ingredients: 2 containers whole milk ricotta cheese | 3 sprigs fresh rose water | 1 fresh thai red chili pepper, halved and seeded ( optional ) | 2 1/2 tablespoons hot red chili powder or 2 1/2 tablespoons thai red curry paste
instructions: To make the creamy ricotta, stir together the ricotta cheese, rose water and chile powder or red curry paste in a mixing bowl. Spoon into four 4 oz ramekins and chill for atleast 1 hour but preferably overnight at room temperature or up to 1 day.

title: Pasta with Pecorino Nuts and Vinegar
ingredients: 1 bottle catsup | 1 cup freshly grated pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Pour in the catsup and stir to combine. Add the pecorino cheese and stir to coat. Add the pasta and cook until tender, about 6 minutes. Drain. Transfer to a large bowl, coat with a thin layer of mayonnaise, and serve.

title: Salsa Cracker (Nepal)
ingredients: 1 cup salsa | 1 piece fresh ginger root, peeled and thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon sour cream or ground soured cream ( optional )
instructions: Put all in a small mixing bowl. Chill for at least 2 hours, or up to 8 hours.

title: Salt Pork Mix
ingredients: 2 tablespoons anise seed | 1 package salt pork, cut into 1 1/2 to 2-inch cubes
instructions: Put the anise seeds in a small bowl and pour boiling water over them. Let the aniseed steep 5 minutes. Place the salt pork in a bowl of water. Squeeze the excess water from the salt pork into the aniseed. Drain the soaked salt pork, discarding the soaking liquid, and transfer the salt pork to a resealable plastic bag. Refrigerate, covered, for 2 to 3 days. Remove the salt pork cubes from the bag and place on a work surface.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,white grape juice,feta cheese,cucumber,egg yolk,garlic pepper seasoning
title: Grape Yogurt
ingredients: 32 ounces white grape juice, chilled | 8 ounces feta cheese | 2 medium cucumbers or 2 medium english seedless cucumbers, seeded and cut in half lengthwise, then cut in 1/2-inch slices | 4 large egg yolks | 1 teaspoon garlic pepper seasoning, your fav. garlic powder | vegetable oil cooking spray
instructions: Preheat broiler. Mix all ingredients in a blender. Blend at low speed for 30 seconds, until mixture is smooth. Pour about half of the yogurt into an oiled 10 inch cake pan. Place the egg yolks at the bottom of the pan, over the yogurt in all. Place the pan in the broiler and broil for one minute. Remove the pan from the broiler and turn the oven to 400 degrees. Continue broiling until the internal temperature is 120 f. Do not flip the gyros, but keep the oven closed. Turn off the oven.

title: Shortbread for the Grill
ingredients: 1 lb shortbread, unsliced ( or 3/4 pound ) | 3/4 cup whole wheat flour | 2 teaspoons vanilla
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium high. Using a sharp, clean knife, cut a circle from the shortbread that includes the center area on each piece of bread. Dip the bread in a bowl of water to prevent the bread from cracking. If it doesn't, just slide the bread from the circle onto the grill. Grill the shortbread until puffed and marked, 3 minutes. Remove from heat and turn into a 9x5 inch loaf pan, pressing down on the crust. If it doesn't seem to be completely baked, spread the crumb topping on. Let cool. Cut into 24 bars.

Random Ingredients: eggnog,chicken drumstick,thyme leaf,olive oil,romaine lettuce,white wine vinegar
title: Chicken Drumsticks in Eggnog
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups light olive oil | 2 cups finely chopped romaine lettuce | 2 large cooked chicken drumsticks, sliced | 3 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1 eggnog | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh thyme leaves
instructions: Combine olive oil, romaine lettuce, and chicken in a large bowl.

title: Couscous Mozzarella Cakes
ingredients: 2 cups couscous | 1/2 cup canola oil | 3/4 cup grated parmiggiano-reggiano cheese | 2 tablespoons cognac | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 14 slices mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Mix water, couscous and oil. Sprinkle cheese and cognac over the couscous and let sit 5 mins, then transfer couscous to ovenproof dish. Bake about 10 minutes, or until couscous is cooked and golden and chewy. Top with mozzarella and bake 3 - 4 min more.

Random Ingredients: ancho chile powder,extra virgin olive oil,thyme,cocoa,rosemary,baby leek,white flour,chicken thigh
title: Brazilian Grilled Lemek Kebab
ingredients: 4 chicken thighs ( about 3 pounds total ) | 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil | 6 yellow dried ancho chile powder ( or less, to taste ) | 2 sprigs thyme | 2 sprigs rosemary | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa | 1 carton whole white flour, plus extra for dusting | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil, for brushing
instructions: Preheat the grill to high. Trim the chicken thighs of excess fat and cut into bite sized pieces and set aside. Combine the 2 tablespoons olive oil with the the chile powder, thyme sprigs, and rosemary in a small bowl, then set aside. Combine the cocoa and flour in a second medium size bowl. Rinse the chickens under cold water and dry completely with paper towels. Pat them dry with paper towels to remove any excess moisture. Pat the chicken dry with more paper towels. Brush the chicken with 2 tablespoons oil to lightly coat the chicken with olive oil, then place the pieces on the skewers. Grill the chicken on prepared grill about 5 minutes on each side. The time will depend on if they are fully cooked and how well cooked to cook them on each side.

title: Chickpea and Lentils
ingredients: 400 g lentils | 400 g low-fat milk | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne | 1/2 teaspoon cornflour | 1000 g chicken or 1000 g lamb ( cubed ) | 200 g lentils | 400 g chickpeas
instructions: Rinse and then put the lentils in a pot with a medium size chicken/lamb cube. Boil about 15 minutes or so. Meanwhile heat 2 tbsp oil in a pot and fry the lamb with cayenne for about 5 mins or until golden brown on all sides. Put the drained water in the pot and bring to a boil. Add salt to taste. Add lentils and chickpeas and heat over a low heat for about 45 minutes. When ready put the lid on the pot and simmer for 30 minutes, stirring regularly. Note, serve with plain boiled or steamed veggies and some crusty bread or rolls.

Random Ingredients: black bean,nutmeg,swiss cheese,tortilla chip,cooking oil,balsamic vinegar
title: Cheesy Black Beans - Great Eats and Mash!!
ingredients: 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed ( reserve one cup of the broth ) | 3 tablespoons balsamic vinegar ( good quality! ) | 1 package shredded swiss cheese ( i.e., a blend of cheddar and swiss cheese ) | 2 -3 teaspoons cooking oil | 1/2 teaspoon grated nutmeg | tortilla chips or corn chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f in a bowl combine beans and vinegar and mix to combine. Heat oil in large skillet or microwave oven and spread out cheese into a circle about 2 by 2 1/2 thick and about 1/4 inch in diameter. Add bean mixture and cheese to cheese and mix until well distributed. Sprinkle nutmeg over top and bake until cheese is bubbling and starting to brown, about 10 minutes. Serve immediately with chips or corn chips.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,mustard seed,cardamom seed,guacamole,white onion,chile pepper
title: Guacamole Spread
ingredients: 1 white onion, diced small | 7 ounces guacamole | 15 -20 dried chile peppers | 2 teaspoons mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed | 2 kaffir lime leaves
instructions: Dice the onion and grind it finely in a grinder. Combine the onion/garlic paste, chile de arbol, mustard seeds, cardamom and kaffir lime leaves in a bowl. Mix well. Serve immediately. If preferred, make up a batch at a time of the basic guacamole and store them in a jar.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,green bell pepper,lemon juice,ha avocado,large shrimp
title: Cape Malay Shrimp Appetizer
ingredients: 1 lb large shrimp, peeled deveined, tails left on | 1 mango chutney, such as mae ploy brand | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice | 1 green bell pepper, seeded and minced | 1 hass avocado, peeled, pitted, and minced
instructions: Combine the shrimp, mango chutney, lemon juice, green pepper and avocado in a large bowl. Toss to coat, breaking up any lumps with a fork. Chill thoroughly before serving.

title: Garbanzos Bean Stew
ingredients: 1 cup dried garbanzo beans, soaked overnight | 1 medium spanish onion, chopped | 3 tablespoons instant coffee | 1/4 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon poppy seed
instructions: Drain all but 1/4 cup water. Place soaked beans, onion, coffee, and bouillon in crockpot. Add water to cover. Bake at 350 for about 1 1/2 hours. Serve over yellow rice. Note, if soaking beans for longer than 1 hour, you can also add 1 cup of soaked chickpeas at the end of cooking time. If using chicken, place in saucepan and cook on low heat for about 15 minutes.

title: Green Curry Party
ingredients: 3 tablespoons prepared green curry paste | 1 tablespoon powdered ginger in syrup | 1 tablespoon red fresno chambord champagne or 1 tablespoon other sparkling white wine | 3 -4 tablespoons thai green curry leaves, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon fresh cilantro, coarsely chopped | salt | 1 small cocktail onion, sliced thinly and toasted | assorted fresh curry leaves, to serve
instructions: Pour 1 tablespoon of curry paste into a fry pan or wok, add the remaining paste and fry over medium heat for 1 minute, then add the sherry and stir fry over medium heat for 1 minute. Add the green curry leaves, cilantro leaves and remaining 1 tablespoon of curry paste, stir and cook for 1 minute, then add the cocktail onion. Remove from the heat and garnish with curry leaves.

title: Spoonful Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 1 lb raspberries or 1 lb strawberry jam, softened | 2 tablespoons milk | 2 tablespoons grated jicama | 1 package frozen small asparagus, in bite sized pieces | 1 can condensed tomato soup, undiluted | 2 cups frozen red lentils, thawed and drained | 1/2 cup whipping cream
instructions: Combine raspberries, cream, milk and jicama in a medium bowl and mix well. Add asparagus, soup and lentils and stir well. Place mixture in a medium bowl. Pour hot vegetable soup evenly over top. Cover and refrigerate overnight to chill. Garnish with fresh fruit.

title: Spanish Beans and Romaine
ingredients: 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 1 can grape tomatoes, drained and coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1 head romaine lettuce, washed, dried and torn into bite-size pieces
instructions: Place black beans and grape tomatoes in a large bowl or salad bowl. Drizzle with mustard and mix to coat evenly. Add lettuce and toss to coat. Variation, this can also be served on a bun or corn bread and added to the salad while it's still warm.

title: Baked Tomatoes
ingredients: 450 g ripe tomatoes ( peeled ) | 2 teaspoons ketchup
instructions: Arrange the tomatoes on a lightly greased oven tray. Spoon over the ketchup. Bake at 180c for about 10 minutes.

title: Cumin-Grilled Beets
ingredients: 2 large beet, stems removed ( about 2 -3 lbs. ) | 2 teaspoons cumin seeds, lightly crushed | 4 slices white bread, crusts removed
instructions: Toast the cumin seeds, in a dry skillet over medium heat, stirring constantly, until fragrant and slightly darker in color, 4 - 6 minutes. Cool the cumin seeds slightly. Peel the beet stems and discard the tough leaves, cut off the stalks and any dark green. Slice the beet lengthwise into 1/4 inch thick slices. Stack the beet slices and set them side by side in a large skillet. Sprinkle the slices with salt. Grind the cumin seeds into a powder and add the cumin seeds to the skillet. Cook over medium heat until the seeds are light brown, 1 - 2 minutes. Remove the skillet from the heat and let the beets stand, covered, 20 - 30 minutes. Toast the bread. When ready to use, heat a grill or heat a griddle pan over medium heat. When hot, add the beets, sprinkle generously with the salt and grill them, turning once, until they are tender when pierced with a fork or fork, about 15 minutes. Remove from the grill and drain them well. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,spanish onion,purpose flour,cream celery soup,couscous,kosher salt,japanese eggplant
title: Japanese Eggplant and Onion Casserole
ingredients: 2 japanese eggplants ( medium-sized ) | 1 cup yellow wax paper, cut into 2-inch squares | 2 cups thinly sliced spanish onion | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup, undiluted ( or undiluted cream of potato and chicken soup, undiluted ) | 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour | 1 1/2 cups uncooked instant couscous | kosher salt
instructions: Set oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source and preheat the oven's broiler. Line a rimmed 2 1/2 quart baking dish with aluminum foil that's been lightly dipped with cooking spray. Cut the eggplant lengthwise into strips about 1/2 inch wide. Trim the ends and ends of the strips, and slice into strips about 1/2 inch thick. Arrange the eggplant in a single layer onto the prepared baking dish. Broil until charred and tender, about 3 minutes, turning and flipping occasionally. Slice the strips crosswise into strips in a single layer. Whisk the onion and soup in a bowl until smooth and creamy.

Random Ingredients: rice,berry,chinese five spice powder,gruyere cheese,half,sharp cheddar cheese,marjoram
title: Four Cheese Bread Pudding
