ingredients: 1 cup sour cream ( or plain yogurt ) or 1 cup greek yogurt, to taste | 1 1/2 cups freshly cooked rice | 3 tablespoons grated gruyere cheese | 2 tablespoons grated sharp cheddar cheese | 1 tablespoon dried marjoram or 1 teaspoon fresh marjoram | 1/2 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 1 1/2 cups mixed berries
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f spray an 8 square or round baking dish with nonstick cooking spray, set aside. Combine sour cream, rice 1 cup at a time, stirring well after each addition till smooth. Add the rest of the ingredients except the berry tops and stir to combine. Pour into prepared baking dish and top with berries. Bake at 350°f for 45 to 50 minutes or till the pudding is lightly browned. Serve warm.

title: Wild Rice and Zucchini Salad
ingredients: 1 bag frozen filling, thawed and drained | 1 cup cooked wild rice, kept hot | 2 tablespoons corn syrup | 1/2 cup guacamole | 21 ounces shiitake mushrooms, chopped | 2 medium zucchini, sliced
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Spread rice evenly on a jelly roll pan. In a small bowl, mix corn syrup and guacamole. Top rice with 1/3 of the filling, 1/3 of the mushrooms, and 1/3 of the zucchini. Spread evenly with guacamole. Slice remaining mushrooms and arrange on top. Chill 2 hours or over night.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,cheese food,green chile,shiitake mushroom,lamb chop,cream rice,quinoa,shallot
title: Sour Cream Lamb Stew
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 1 kg boneless lamb chop, cut into 1in. chunks | 1/3 cup finely chopped shallot | 4 tablespoons minced green chilies | 10 shiitake mushrooms, halved | 1 1/4 cups coarsely grated tasty cheese food | 1 cup light sour cream | 1 1/2 tablespoons grand marnier, cordial | 1 1/2 teaspoons grated dubliner cheese or 1 1/2 teaspoons other dry cheese
instructions: Spray 2 non stick frypan with veggie oil. Place lamb and vegetables in pan. Add stock, wine and herbs. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes or until lamb is tender. Blend sour cream with grand marnier until light and creamy. Stir in sour cream mixture until combined. Return to pan and heat through. Sprinkle topping with cheddar cheese.

title: Potato Macaroni and Radishes Pasta
ingredients: 1 russet potato, cut into 1-inch chunks | 1 package elbow macaroni | 2 tablespoons canola oil, divided | 2 cans sliced radishes, drained, divided | 1/2 cup dry breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon dry mustard | 1 slice thick bread, torn into pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place potato chunks, cut side up in a steamer over 1 inch of boiling water and cover. Bring to boil, then steam for 10 minutes. Drain and run potatoes under cold water until cold. Drain and mash. In a 9x13 inch baking dish, mix potatoes, half the macaroni, 2 tablespoons canola oil and 1/2 the radishes. Combine bread crumbs and mustard, then sprinkle evenly over potato mixture. Roll up slice of bread. Coat in remaining 1 tablespoon canola oil. Place bread crumb side down in baking dish, then top with remaining sliced radishes. Cover dish tightly and bake at 350 degrees f for 30 minutes, then spoon remaining macaroni over top. Continue to bake, uncovered, for an additional 15 minutes, or until tender. Remove from heat and let stand for 10 minutes before slicing.

title: Tortillas
ingredients: 2 lbs ground pork or 2 lbs ground turkey | 2 tablespoons coarse black salt
instructions: Mix well and store in refrigerator for up to 6 days this can be frozen or can be frozen.

Random Ingredients: marshmallow,black peppercorn,parmesan cheese,confectioner sugar,vegetable oil cooking spray,green cardamom
title: Aarsi’s Ultimate Marshmallow French Fries
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 16 marshmallows ( see footnote for recipe link ) | 6 green cardamoms, crushed | 2 tablespoons black peppercorns, crushed | 24 confectioners'sugar | 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Line baking sheet with foil. In a small bowl, coat marshmallows and green cardamoms with black peppercorns. Place in shallow bowl. Drizzle about 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese over each marshmallow and sprinkle on more. Heat in oven, set aside. In another 9 inch square baking pan, spray pam on all sides with pam or butter flavored cooking spray. Sprinkle marshmallow mixture over fries. Using vegetable oil, sprinkle more parmesan over frites. Bake in 400 degree f oven until golden brown, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: saltine cracker,alfredo sauce,ginger garlic paste,jalapeno pepper,brussels sprout,orange,tarragon vinegar,cauliflower floret
title: Cauliflower Sprouts and Franks
ingredients: 2 cups frozen brussels sprouts ( or a 1lb. package ) | 1/4 lb sliced jalapeno peppers ( about 7oz ) | 12 fresh saltine crackers | 12 ounces alfredo sauce, warmed | 4 tablespoons finely chopped fresh tarragon vinegar | 4 tablespoons orange rind, grated | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 teaspoon salt ( to taste )
instructions: Thaw brussels sprouts or fresh brussels sprouts. Slice jalapeños crosswise into 1/4 inch slices and set aside. Pulse crackers in food processor to coarse crumbs, about 1 1/2 tablespoons. Place all brussels sprouts or sprouts in baking dish. Sprinkle with salt. Pour warm alfredo sauce over sprouts just to coat. Sprinkle with tarragon vinegar, orange rind, ginger garlic paste and salt. Bake in 375°f oven until slightly browned about 15 minutes. Serve with warm pasta.

Random Ingredients: rice vinegar,turkey stock,cardamom pod,confectioner sugar,herb,shortening,clam juice,brown sugar
title: Rice Vinegar Clam Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons peanut oil or other shortening | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1 pound ground turkey ( optional ) | 1/2 cup brown sugar | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 1/4 cup bottled clam juice | 1 3/4 cups prepared minced fresh herb | 1/2 cup chopped fresh herb | 1/4 cup confectioners'sugar for dusting ( optional )
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Sprinkle cardamom pods over oil, and place the turkey meat in the skillet. Cook and stir until turkey meat is crumbly and evenly browned. Stir in brown sugar, rice vinegar, clam juice, 1 3/4 cups of minced fresh herb, and fresh herb, and simmer for 10 minutes. Continue to simmer uncovered until sauce is reduced and thickened, about 2 hours. Stir 1/4 cup confectioners' sugar into the sauce, and serve warm.

title: Italian Salad Greens
ingredients: 2 cups mixed salad greens | 1 tablespoon orange zest, finely grated ( italian )
instructions: Place a large pot of salted water on the stove over high heat, and place the mixed greens in the boiling water. Reduce the heat to medium and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, or until they are tender. Reserve 1/3 cup of the cooking water. Remove the cooked greens from the pot and toss with the reserved cooking water. Sprinkle the orange zest over the greens and toss to coat. Let stand for 5 minutes, tossing once.

title: Japanese Phyllo Rolls
ingredients: 2 packages frozen phyllo dough, thawed | 4 tablespoons confectioners'sugar, or more as needed | 2 tablespoons mirin ( japanese sweet wine )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Beat phyllo dough, confectioners' sugar, and mirin together in a large bowl with an electric mixer set on low speed until smooth, about 30 seconds. Increase speed to medium, and beat until phyllo dough becomes thick and pasty, 2 to 3 minutes. Increase speed to medium, and beat with an electric mixer until thick, about 2 minutes. Spread phyllo dough into a 9x9 inch glass baking dish. Cut a slit in the top of the dough with a sharp knife. Dampen fingers with water, and trace the phyllo dough with 4 or 5 short strips of phyllo dough in 4 or 5 strips perpendicular to the bottom edge of the baking dish. Repeat with remaining phyllo dough. Cover phyllo wrapped pastry with plastic wrap, and plastic wrap, and refrigerate for 24 hours. Bake in a preheated oven until phyllo has puffed and crisped, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven, and let stand for 10 minutes. Run a spatula under phyllo, and gently squeeze the excess moisture out of each strip. Cut strips into strips about 3x4 inch, then cut strips into small squares.

Random Ingredients: spanish onion,margarine,rice noodle,bay leaf,coconut milk,almond paste,red chili pepper
title: Maja Blanca (White Rice Pasta)
ingredients: 1 lb rice noodles ( mai fun ) | 2 tablespoons margarine ( or oil ) | 1/4 cup diced spanish onion | 1 -2 red chili peppers ( or green ) or 1 -2 jalapeno pepper ( or green ) | 1 can coconut milk | 1 bay leaf | 1 teaspoon almond paste
instructions: Wash the mai fun and drain water. Wash and add in oil to a deep pot or deep sauté pan. If the rice sticks to the bottom of the pan you can add a bit of water. While waiting on the water to boil, mince your sweet red/jalapeño pepper into small pieces. Set aside. Slice the chilies into very small pieces, and set aside. Add a splash of oil, and add the onion and sauté, while the onions are stirring occasionally, until the onion is lightly brown. Add to the pot with the rice noodles and mix. Add the bay leaf. Add in the coconut milk. When the pasta is almost ready, add the almond paste and mix through. Season with salt to taste. Serve hot.

title: Easy and Tasty Thai - Arroz Pongal
ingredients: 1/2 cup uncooked brown rice | 2 green cardamoms | 2 tablespoons rice wine
instructions: Soak the rice in a large bowl with cold water. When it starts to swell, drain, and rinse in a colander with cold running water. Dry off any excess water as you rinse it. Slice the green cardamoms thinly. In a small frying pan, heat oil over medium heat. Fry the green cardamoms, stirring frequently, until they turn brown in color. Remove cardamom from the pan.

Random Ingredients: coffee granule,cream cheese,chili paste,burgundy wine,red chile pepper
title: Chilli Cream Cheese Roasted Red Chile Peppers (No Eggs)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ground red chile pepper | 1 tablespoon chili paste | 1 1/4 teaspoons instant coffee granules | 1 1/4 cream cheese, room temperatured | 1 cup burgundy wine or 1 cup dry red wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Line a roasting pan with aluminum foil.

Random Ingredients: cooking spray,chickpea flour,pepperoncini pepper,phyllo dough,turnip,red capsicum
title: Chickpea Turnip & Peppers
ingredients: 4 medium turnips | cooking spray | 1 red capsicum, diced | 500 g chickpea flour ( from chickpeas ) | pepperoncini pepper, to taste | 50 g phyllo dough ( fresh preferably organic ) | 10 pepperoncini peppers ( optional )
instructions: Peel turnips, dice diagonally, and boil in slightly salted water with the capsicum until just tender.

Random Ingredients: cardamom powder,beef tenderloin steak,coriander powder,hash brown
title: Lebanese Beef
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin steak | 2 cardamom powder | 2 tablespoons coriander powder | 2 bags hash browns
instructions: Place beef in a nonstick pan. Add spices. Heat on medium for 10 minutes. Turn and heat for 5 minutes. Pierce with a toothpick and pour over sauce.

title: Rosemary Beans (Cameroon-Din)
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs bean fat ( soaked overnight in ) | 6 3/4 cups cold water | 3 fresh rosemary sprigs
instructions: Rinse bean fat. Cook in water until tender. Drain beans, and rinse with water, and drain. In a large saute pan, arrange soaked beans in layers. Add hot water, and raise heat to boil. Cover, and cook 3 minutes on low heat. Turn beans and cook 1 or 2 minutes more. Add rosemary sprigs and cover. Cook, stirring occasionally, 5 minutes more, or until beans are crisp or soft.

title: Rosti With Parsnips and Spicy Potatoes
ingredients: 2 tablespoons parsnips ( grated fresh or canned from a jar ) | 1 whole clove ( or two small whole cloves ) | 3 medium russet potatoes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Place the parsnips, clove and whole clove on a baking sheet. Roast these in the oven just long enough to make a crispy surface, then remove them from the oven. When they are cool enough to handle, peel and slice about 1/4 inch thick. Place them on a baking sheet coated with cooking spray. Bake in the oven, and cook on each side for 1 to 2 minutes. Remove from oven, let cool a bit on the baking sheet, and keep warm. This is wonderful served with crusty bread or crackers. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: coriander seed,creme fraiche,pistachio,yellow pepper,serrano pepper,creme de cassis,biscuit,hot green chili pepper
title: Chile Pepper Torte
ingredients: 1 dried hot green chili pepper | 1 3/4 ounces creme fraiche | 1/4 cup pistachios, shelled | 2 serrano peppers, halved and thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons whole coriander seeds, roasted | 1/3 cup coriander seed, roasted, coarsely ground | 1 1/2 tablespoons yellow peppers, finely sliced | 1 lb biscuit | 2 tablespoons creme fraiche
instructions: Rinse the chile and remove the stems. Heat 1tbsp oil in a small pan and fry the the pistachios and serrano until golden. Cool down. Process the chile, pistachios, chiles, and remaining coriander seeds in a pestle and mortar or other blender together with a little water so that they form a coarse paste. Spread the paste on the biscuit crusts cut a steamhole in the top of each biscuit and pipe the filling inches repeat with remaining biscuit.

title: Frankies
ingredients: 600 g thick pork chops, thin | 2 tablespoons instant coffee granules | 2 tablespoons amaretto ( almond flavoured extract ) | 2 tablespoons gelatin, unflavored | 500 g beef roast | 40 g corn chips, coarsely crushed | 1 tablespoon shortening ( approximately )
instructions: In a small bowl, combine all the ingredients except the beef and corn chips. Pour the liquid from the coffee bean into a large saucepan and bring to a boil. Make sure the liquid does not come to the boil and boil for several minutes. Reduce the heat and simmer for 20 minutes. Set aside. Slice the beef and roast thinly and return to the saucepan. Do not boil, but add the crushed corn chips when the meat is hot. Mix well and return to a boil. Cook for a further 5 minutes and remove from the heat. Put the shortening in a 9x13 inch pan and turn the heat under the meat over. The fat will separate from the meat and make a little sticky. When melted, remove from the heat and mix the corn chips into the meat. Arrange the meat meat on a platter or baking pan and pour warm syrup over. Allow to set up and cool for 2 hours. Slice and serve the hot, chilled or at room temperature.

title: Hot Cranberry Scented Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried cranberries | 1 teaspoon finely chopped orange peel | 1 teaspoon mixed spice | 1 tablespoon asian chili sauce | 1 dash hot pepper sauce
instructions: Place the cranberries in a small bowl, and sprinkle with the orange peel and mix well. Stir in the mixed spice, chili sauce, and hot pepper sauce.

title: Pineapple Fried Rice Burritos
ingredients: 2 cups plain jasmine rice | 1 yellow pepper | 12 burrito-size flour tortillas
instructions: Cook rice and yellow pepper according to package directions. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add 2 tortillas to the hot skillet and cook until light brown, about 2 minutes per side. Remove with a slotted spoon and set aside. Add more oil to skillet as needed and remove the fried rice and vegetables from skillet. Place the remaining tortillas in the pan, add the fried vegetables and rice, and stir to combine. Heat throughly, about 2 minutes.

title: Nuoc Cham (Vine Nuts)
ingredients: 4 cups of very finely grated raw almonds or 4 cups of very finely grated raw almonds | 2 cups of very finely grated unsweetened vanilla sugar | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1/3 cup shaoxing wine | 1/3 cup light cream or 1/3 cup water
instructions: If you are using fine grind almonds, skip this step, though i always do. Place all the nuts in a bowl and thoroughly mix with the sugar. Add the cardamom powder and mix thoroughly. Slowly add the wine and cream to make a thick paste. Divide into 4 equal parts and form 4 balls, each piece about 1/2 inch in diameter and 3 inches long. Heat oil in a deep frying pan, preferably deep enough to fry the balls, over a moderate heat or a gas stove. Fry the nuts gently just until they are a pale golden brown color. Carefully place each golden browned ball on a tray lined with buttered paper napkins. Roll them gently with the napkins until the outside is crisp, and remove onto paper napkins. Store in a airtight container and keep indefinitely. You may place the nuggets straight away in a bowl of hot water before deep frying or store them in the refrigerator. Variations, use very finely grated sweet bread crumbs, like bread sticks, rice crackers or finely crushed graham crackers or very finely crushed graham crackers. Variation, to make small balls, add 1 cup of finely grated orange, lemon or lime flavoured liqueur to your taste.

title: Minty Tomato Sauce for Fish & Chips
ingredients: 400 g hunts tomato sauce | 400 g egg yolks | 1/4 cup cornflour | handful mint leaf, to garnish
instructions: Place egg yolks, cornflour into a bowl and beat until pale and fluffy. Dip the fish in the egg and then roll in the cornflour mixture. Heat the tomato saucepan over a medium heat, add mint leaves just before serving if using. Place fish on a tray and serve drizzled with the tomato sauce.

Random Ingredients: cabbage,kangaroo mincemeat,hot dog,celery leaf,lemon peel,yellow bell pepper,orange peel
title: Kangaroo Mince Rolls
ingredients: 500 g kangaroo mincemeat | 1 green peppers or 1 red bell pepper | 1 1 purple kangaroo mincemeat or 1 pork mincemeat, of choice | 1 bunch celery leaves | 1 tablespoon lemon peel | 1 tablespoon grated orange peel | 1 large yellow bell pepper, finely chopped | 1/2 cup cabbage, shredded
instructions: If using pork mince, chop the vegetables finely and throw away any excess fat. Add all ingredients and shape into large rolls. Put them in a greased oven and bake at 200°c for 10 minutes, remove from oven and let rest for 5 mins before slicing. This is great served with your favourite veggies and salad, as is.

Random Ingredients: chipotle pepper adobo sauce,quinoa,water artichoke heart
title: Chipotle Quinoa
ingredients: 2 quarts water-packed artichoke hearts, drained and quartered | 1/2 cup canned chipotle pepper in adobo sauce, divided | 1 1/2 cups dry quinoa ( or more )
instructions: Place the artichokes, 1/4 cup of the sauce, and the quinoa in a heavy saucepan. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until quinoa is tender and the liquid is absorbed, about 20 minutes. Remove from the heat, fluff with a fork, and stir in the remaining 1/4 cup of the chipotle. Let stand, covered, for 5 minutes. Stir in the remaining 1/4 cup sauce. Serve warm or cold.

title: Lemon Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice, washed in several changes of water, drained | 1 cup plain yogurt | 1/2 cup fresh lemon juice
instructions: Heat your oven to 425°f/190°c. Soak rice in plenty of hot water for 15 minutes until it softens. Drain and rinse. Place in a large bowl, making sure each grain is coated with an oil and salt. Add about four tablespoons of yogurt and stir. Add lemon juice and enough more yogurt to bind it mixture together.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,half cream,garlic powder,ziti pasta,greek yogurt
title: Greek Ziti
ingredients: 15 ounces ziti pasta, cooked according to package directions | 1 cup greek yogurt | 2 tablespoons half and half cream | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/2 teaspoon red chili pepper, chopped | 1 dash garlic powder
instructions: In a large bowl, mix all ingredients together. Cover and chill 1 hour before serving. Serve cold. Note, may add or reduce amount of red pepper and garlic powder according to your own taste preference.

Random Ingredients: green capsicum,dark soy sauce,lemon peel,cottage cheese,self raising flour
title: Lightly Sifted Cheese and Vegetable Scones
ingredients: 6 medium free range fresh green capsicum, cut into thin strips | 2 teaspoons grated lemon peel | 8 ounces light soy sauce, reduced fat | 4 ounces cottage cheese, reduced fat | 2 teaspoons dark soy sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Grease a baking tray with oil. Using a sharp knife, cut a few slits into the side of each capsicum. Place capsicum, lemon peel and 2 tablespoons of the soy sauce into a food processor and blend, stopping and scraping down sides if necessary. Add cottage cheese to food processor and blend until smooth. Add remaining 10 - 12 tablespoons of soy sauce, 1 teaspoonful of dark soy sauce and all the green vegetables. Mix well. Spoon into large, shallow, plastic baking dish.. Cut diagonal lines around top of scone mixture, about 1/2 inch deep, allowing for a circle to rise above scone mixture. Gently lift scone mixture down and over the top. Bake for 15 - 18 minutes, until very lightly browned and puffed and crisp on top.

Random Ingredients: green bean,canola oil,portabella mushroom,radish,pork tongue,chicken stock vegetable,coriander leaf
title: Sweet Meat and Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 450 g pork tongue, rinsed well | 4 -6 cups chicken stock or 4 -6 cups vegetable stock | 2 large portabella mushrooms | 1 -2 handfuls green beans | 1 -2 handful coriander leaves | 1/2 cup canola oil or 1/2 cup olive oil | sliced radish
instructions: First make the meat and vegetables you will be using. I like to dice them up into nice chunks, but keep them rough and even. Cut the mushrooms into half and de vein if you like, then keep half there with the rest. I usually leave the leaves whole, but this also makes the stock a bit watery. If you are using a stick of pork, slice across the bone to release the flavour. Once your bones are removed, put them in a bowl and mash with a fork. If using chicken stock or vegetable stock, add a bit of water. If the stock is going to be watery, make a small hole in the thickest part with your mashed potato masher. If it is smaller than you want, leave about an inch or two clear at the top. Rinse the tongue well, and pat dry with paper towels. Place both in a pan with a cover, and slowly poach over medium/high heat for about 20 minutes, or until just cooked through.. When done, remove the tongue, put to one side with a lid, and continue to poach in this mixture while you poach the rest of the way, for 5 - 10 minutes to allow the flavours to develop. Meanwhile, you can steam the green beans or slice them on a diagonal, drain the stock from them, then remove the stems and any excess fat.. You want the stock to be just barely boiling at this point, so don't touch it a bit while you poach the tongue. Heat the oil over a high heat in a large pan or soup pan. Add the mushrooms and cook until they have given off their liquid and the mushrooms have given off their liquid. Add the beans and cook for 3 - 5 minutes, stirring the mushrooms, until they are beginning to brown. Stir in the stock and bring to boil. Add the tongue and cook for a further two minutes, until the tongue is cooked, and has reduced to a nice consistency. Add the coriander and coriander leaves, and cook for a minute. Serve with a handful of radish.

title: Baked Yellow Squash With Cumin Seeds and Yellow Squash
ingredients: 3 lbs yellow squash, about 2.5 pounds total | 2 tablespoons cumin seeds, lightly toasted and powdered
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450°f, on a roasting rack on the rimmed baking sheet, roast the squash for 15 minutes, or until slightly charred and tender. Turn the oven off. Place the squash in a roasting pan. Add the cumin and toss the contents.

Random Ingredients: daikon radish,mexican cheese,lamb,cornflour,oat bran,queso fresco,garlic powder
title: Mexican Cheese Filled Kuftas
ingredients: 1 lb ground lamb | 2 teaspoons mexican cheese blend, mexican | 50 g oat bran | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 1 tablespoon queso fresco | 1 small daikon radish, grated ( optional )
instructions: Brown lamb in a hot frying pan. When all the lamb is browned, drain most of the excess fat then add the rest of the ingredients. Mix well and allow to simmer for 10 minutes. Place mixtures in a greased loaf pan. Bake at 190 deg c for approximately 40 - 45 minutes until mixture is browned and puffy but is still wet. Serve with tortillas, chips, toast, etc.

title: Quinoa and Ranch Rice
ingredients: 1 cup arborio rice | 1 cup quinoa | 1/4 cup ranch dressing
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add arborio rice and quinoa. Bring to a boil, then cover, reduce heat, and simmer for 20 minutes. Remove lid, fluffing rice with a fork. When all the liquid is absorbed, stir in ranch dressing. Serve immediately. Store leftover quinoa in the refrigerator.

title: Mexicorn Seasoning Mix
ingredients: 2 teaspoons brown sugar | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 can of chopped green chilies, undrained in a saucepot | 1 cup water
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Refrigerate to use in other recipes. Great on tortilla chips too.

title: Flank Steak
ingredients: 1 flank steak, cut across the grain into 1/2-inch slices | 1 medium onion flakes | 1/4 cup dried onion flakes | 1 1/2 tablespoons crushed cinnamon
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees f. Place the beef slices on a rack in a roasting pan. Mix together 1/4 cup of the dried onion flakes and the cinnamon. Sprinkle over the beef slices, and rub the dried onion mix. Add 1 - ½ cups of water into a roasting pan and add the onion flakes. Cover, and place in preheated oven, and cook for 6 hours, turning once or twice, adding more water if necessary.

title: Spicy Coconut Dumplings
ingredients: 36 wonton wrappers | 4 cups unsweetened coconut cream | 3/4 cup hot sauce | 2 teaspoons garlic salt | 1/2 cup unsweetened applesauce
instructions: Mix your coconut cream, hot sauce, garlic salt and applesauce together. You can just put the mixture in the freezer for a few hours. Lay wrappers out on a lightly floured surface. Place about 1 teaspoon of the filling in the middle of each wrapper, and fold in half, sealing. Place the parcels in lightly sprayed baking pans. Bake at 375 degrees for 15 to 20 minutes, or until dumplings are golden and cooked.

title: Mango Popsicles(Kathi)
ingredients: 2 cups green mango, grated | 1 1/2 teaspoons garam masala powder
instructions: Mix grated mango well with 1/2 cup water. Keep aside. Heat grated mango in a small pan. Remove from heat. Keep aside. Dip the same in 1/2 cup of hot water. Dip balls in the water. Roll in the same. Allow to dry. Refrigerate. Serve.

title: Jolene's Empanadas De Muir Glen
ingredients: 1 fresh jalapeno, seeded and chopped fine | 1 tablespoon instant dried yeast | 2 cups shiitake mushroom, chopped | 1 flank steak, trimmed fat and cut into 1/4-inch slices | 4 cups sifted all-purpose flour | 2 tablespoons red food coloring
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water in large mixing bowl of a 5 quart electric mixer or heavy duty electric mixer bowl until mixture is foamy, about 10 minutes. Add jalapeno and mince.

title: Chile Con Queso - Salsa Mexi-Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1/2 lb mexican blend cheese, grated | 1/2 cup shredded cheese ( like queso blanco ) | 2 -3 tablespoons red chili peppers, finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon dried red chili pepper or 1/4 teaspoon black pepper | 2 -3 tablespoons fresh radishes, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Spray large baking dish with vegetable oil cooking spray. Mix it all together. Add any other ingredients your taste, such as tomatoes, peppers, onions etc.. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving. Serve with tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: red snapper,sage leaf,cardamom seed,red chili pepper flake,active yeast,basil leaf
title: Spicy Red Snapper With Basil
ingredients: 2 cups lukewarm filtered water | 2 tablespoons active dry yeast | 1 teaspoon cardamom seeds, crushed or 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cardamom | 1/2 teaspoon ground red chili pepper flakes | 1 3/4 lbs red snapper, cleaned or 1 3/4 lbs other white fish | fresh sage leaf | fresh basil leaf
instructions: Scrub and dry the fish. Place the water, yeast, cardamom and red chili in a large mixing bowl. If using any leaves, cover and let rest for 5 minutes. Transfer the yeast mixture to a large, heavy pot and warm it by pouring in 1 1/4 cups of the warm water. Allow it to proof and foam for 1 minute. Add the fish and coat it thoroughly with the yeast and water mixture. Cover the bowl loosely with a towel and allow it to rise until doubled in volume, approximately 1 hours. Place the fish in a steamer or a large, heavy bottomed saucepan weighted with at least 6 cups of more water. Cover and place the steamer over medium heat. When the fish is just about ready, place the pan with water on top of the fish. Cover the pot and place it in the heated water. Allow to steam for 10 minutes. Remove from heat and remove the fish from the steamer basket and set it aside. Allow it to come to room temperature. Place the fish on a serving platter. Place the basil leaves on top of the fish and serve.

title: Beef, Cod and Noodle Wrap
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground beef | 8 ounces thin sliced bacon | 8 ounces thin whole wheat tortillas | 14 ounces thin slices imitation ramen noodles ( or equivalent brand of ramen noodles ) | 2 cups steamed rice noodles
instructions: Cook first 3 ingredients over medium heat in skillet until beef is no longer pink. Cool slightly and slice into thin strips. Heat tortillas over medium heat on a flat rack. Place 1 tortilla on a microwave safe plate and place 1 piece of beef on top, sprinkle with rice noodle, and fold. Repeat, cutting tortillas into 8 triangular pieces or 4 - 5 round sections. Serve on heated plate, with ramen and salad.

title: Apple Sage Butter
ingredients: 1 cup apple juice | 3 tablespoons fresh sage, minced
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the sage and apple juice. Stir well until blended and chill for 30 minutes to 1 hour before using or for up to 1 week.

title: Pimiento, Roasted Red Pepper and Chilli Seeds
ingredients: 1/2 cup sweet red pepper | 1/4 cup mixed roasted salted melons or 1/4 cup mixed roasted deli-roasted red peppers
instructions: Combine the chilli, roasted pepper and melon halves and store in an airtight container.

title: Egg yolk Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 3 egg yolks | 3 cups strained broth from cooked el pato hard boiled el pato hard boiled el pato ( 1 can enchilada sauce ) | 1 can broths, canned enchilada sauce
instructions: In a medium sauce pan, pour broth from cooked el pato into a 2 to 2 1/2 quart stainless steel bowl. Beat the yolks and 2/3 cup of the strained broth into thick and creamy sauce, whisking thoroughly. Add the enchilada sauce and whisk thoroughly. Pour sauce mixture back into pan and add remaining broth, stirring very gently or constantly. Place over medium heat, whisking, and allow to boil, occasionally stirring. Remove sauce from heat and let cool to room temperature. If mixture is too firm, add more broth to thin it or use a food processor to form an emulsified sauce. Strain sauce through cheese cloth or paper towel lined colander. Refrigerate until completely cool.

Random Ingredients: corn kernel,sun tomato oil,beef brisket,bread flour,liquid smoke flavoring,broccoli floret,thai red chili pepper
title: Beef Brisket-Corned With Broccoli-Tamales
ingredients: 1 boneless beef brisket, 3-4 lbs | 1 package frozen broccoli florets, thawed | 1 can thai red chili peppers, chopped | 1 cup frozen corn kernels ( optional ) | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, chopped | 1/4 cup bread flour | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke flavoring
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Score meat with a 2 inch sharp knife. Arrange meat on a rack in a roasting pan and loosely tent the meat with foil. Roast meat until meat thermometer inserted into center of meat registers 125°f for rare or 145°f for medium rare, about 45 minutes. Transfer meat to a cutting board and cut into 2 inch cubes. Set aside. Remove and discard strings or seeds from chilies and chili peppers. Cut up meat. Drain and cool. Using an electric knife or meat tenderizer, slice strips, stopping about 1 inch apart, into 1/4 inch pieces. Toss meat, broccoli, chili peppers, corn and sun dried tomatoes in a large mixing bowl. In a small bowl, mix together the flour with liquid smoke. Using two spoons or your fingers, stir into the beef. Spoon the beef mixture into foil lined roasting pan and bake, uncovered, until meat thermometer registers 140°f for medium rare and 150°f for medium rare, about 1 hour. Serve with warm corn tamale bread.

title: Green Tea Leaf Tea
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups green tea leaves, washed in cold water and drained ( i used craisins ) | 3/4 teaspoon ras el hanout spice mix
instructions: Steam leaves in steamer over simmering water for 3 - 4 minutes or until limp. Cool. Store in air tight jar in the refrigerator. Will keep a couple of months.

title: Grape and Mango Salad
ingredients: 4 cups fresh grape and mango slices, halved | 2 english seedless grapes, halved | 1 mango - peeled, seeded and diced
instructions: In a large bowl, toss together the grapes, mango and chopped mango. Pour dressing over and toss to coat.

Random Ingredients: oregano,lemon juice zest,tomato puree,chili pepper flake,egg white,shallot,swiss chard
title: Swiss Chard in Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb fresh swiss chard | 1 tablespoon finely chopped shallots or 1 tablespoon chopped green onion | 2 teaspoons finely chopped fresh chili pepper flakes | 2 teaspoons finely chopped fresh oregano or 1/2 tablespoon dried oregano, crushed | 1 large egg white | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice or 1 tablespoon lime juice | 1 can tomato puree, undiluted
instructions: Rinse chard, removing all the hard green stem. Cut chard crosswise into 1/4 inch wide strips. Cut chard crosswise into 1/2 inch pieces and pat dry. Trim off any tough bottom bits that float to the top, if desired. If chard is large, cut to pieces of about 4 inches in width. Combine shallots, chile flakes and oregano in a large bowl. Beat egg white and juice in a cup until soft peaks form, gradually beat in hot tomato puree. Fold chard into egg mixture. Spoon mixture into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake in 400 degree oven till chard is tender and chard is browned and bubbling around edges, about 15 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Easy Basic Temaki Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup soya sauce | 1/2 cup coconut oil
instructions: Mix soya sauce, coconut oil into a sauce pan. Heat the mixture until it is heated through, then enjoy.

title: Puff Pastry Spice Mix for Fish or Chicken
ingredients: 1 package dry onion flakes | 1/4 cup cornflour | 1/2 teaspoon allspice | 1/2 cup whole kernel corn
instructions: On a baking tray spread dry onion flakes. Add corn flour and allspice to corn. Mix well. Sprinkle on top of onion flakes. Cook on medium heat with the lid cracked on. When the lid has turned off, let it simmer for about 10 minutes on low heat. Leave lid slightly opened while its cooking. Keep an eye on it with a large spoon when it starts to thicken you may want to drain off some liquid and make a clean liquid or just a splash of water. When it’s at your desired consistency it’s ready to be taken out of the pan. If you put the lid into the microwave it will heat up on power/electric element. If you put a spoon full on top of the cornflour mix it should turn out fine. You’ll have mixed in your own food product.

title: Quick Tzatziki
ingredients: 4 -8 lettuce leaves | 8 ounces yogurt ( sour cream or greek yogurt mix is good ) | 1/8 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 cup shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Slice the lettuce into thin strips. Place the lettuce on a serving platter. Place the yogurt in a bowl and add the ginger garlic paste. Mix. Gently pour the yogurt onto the lettuce. Top with mozzarella cheese. Serve immediately.

title: Homemade Mango Chutney
ingredients: 2 cups mango chutney | 1/2 cup orange juice
instructions: Mix 1/2 cup of mango chutney with 1/2 an orange. Stir in the juice and store in fridge. Yum.

title: Cauliflower with catsup
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower | 5 tablespoons lard | 8 fluid ounces yoghurt | 6 tablespoons catsup | 1 beet, sliced
instructions: Wash and boil the cauliflower for 20 minutes. Boil water for the yoghurt, boil for 5 minutes and cool for 5 minutes in water. Strain and cool. Chop the beet into small pieces and fry in a non stick fry pan until golden brown. Remove from pan and put to one side, but leave all the drippings in the pan. Dice up the beet and fry with the beet slices. Heat the lard until smoking. Add the yoghurt and the cauliflower and mix well. Mix in the catsup, pour over the beet salad and garnish with grated cabbage. Serve with fresh bread.

Random Ingredients: herb seasoning mix,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Herb Dipping Sauces
ingredients: 4 -5 tablespoons herb seasoning mix | vegetable oil cooking spray ( for frying )
instructions: Mix all together and refrigerate for an hour. Take out before using. This recipe will keep refrigerated and will last for about 2 years.

title: Cheesy Chicken and Beef
ingredients: 8 ounces chicken or 8 ounces turkey breast steaks | 5 ounces pepperjack cheese, grated | 2 ounces liquid smoke
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f place each steak between a sheet of waxed paper and pound with a flat bottomed mallet or rolling pin to 1/4 inch thickness. Place 2 slices cheese on each piece of steaks and set aside. Combine pepperjack cheese and liquid smoke in a small bowl. Spread cheese mixture on all sides of each steak. Roll steaks up and place on a baking sheet with 2 inch sides. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, or until tender.

Random Ingredients: basil leaf,red enchilada sauce,currant,grape tomato,peanut,milk powder,baking powder,penne pasta
title: Capellini and Grape Tomatoes
ingredients: 8 grape tomatoes, julienned ( medium ) | 1 teaspoon peanut ( not oil ) | 1 package dry penne pasta | 2 cups red enchilada sauce | 2 -3 tablespoons milk powder | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried basil leaves, chopped | 1/4 cup roasted salted peanuts, chopped
instructions: In a large skillet heat 1 teaspoon peanut oil over medium high heat. Add tomatoes. Saute until tomatoes begin to soften. Remove from heat and set aside. In a large skillet heat 2 - 2 tablespoons peanut oil. Season both sides of cooked pasta with a pinch of salt. Add the pasta and remaining sauce. Cover and heat on low until pasta is done al dente. Add 1 teaspoon of sugar in, if desired, for color. Remove from heat and sprinkle with basil and nuts.

Random Ingredients: kielbasa,clam,honey,orange liqueur,salt black pepper,plum tomato,pasta sauce
title: Clams W- Tomato Salsa
ingredients: 3 lbs kielbasa, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 can peeled plum tomatoes, drained and chopped | 1 cup pasta sauce | 1/4 cup orange liqueur, such as grand marnier | 1/3 cup honey | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 1/2 lbs large clams, well scrubbed and scrubbed
instructions: In a large frying pan, brown kielbasa over medium heat for about 10 minutes. Stir in tomatoes and tomato sauce. Lower heat and simmer, covered, for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally. Stir in orange liqueur, honey and salt and pepper to taste. Cover and simmer for about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Stir in clams just before serving.

title: Jasmine Rice on the Edge
ingredients: 1 cup jasmine rice ( long grain ) | 1/2 cup molasses | 2 fresh strawberries | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice, to taste | 1 sliced apple
instructions: Wash and dry rice. Place in a large saucepan, cover with water, bring to a boil and cook over high heat until just cooked, about 20 minutes. Turn off heat, fluff with a fork, and put aside to cool 5 minutes. Chop strawberries and stir into the rice. Sprinkle lemon juice over the top, and cut apple into thin wedges.

title: Spiced Hazelnuts
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs hazelnuts | 3 1/2 cups whole star anise | 2 1/2 - 3 lbs assorted fresh hawaiian, washed ( or other hot green chili )
instructions: Set oven to 350^f. Place nuts in a medium bowl and cover with boiling water. Set aside for 20 minutes, then drain. Place in a heavy skillet and toast, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes, or until lightly browned. Pour the nuts out of their shells and place in a sieve lined with cheese cloth, pressing onto the nuts. Place under a very hot broiler, about 4 inches from the heat, and toast for about 5 minutes, or until lightly browned. When cool, chop fine. Pack into sterilized jars and store in an cool place. Use within a year.

Random Ingredients: broccoli,nonstick cooking spray,chicken bouillon cube,marinara sauce,white bread
title: Quick and Easy Broccoli and Bread Soup
ingredients: 1 small broccoli, cut into florets | nonstick cooking spray | 5 cups cooked white bread, cubed | 5 cups prepared marinara sauce | 3 chicken bouillon cubes ( or 1 small vegetable bouillon cube dissolved in 4 cups water )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Coat a 3 quart pot or dutch oven with cooking spray. Place broccoli in pot and saute over medium high heat, stirring frequently, until tender crisp and slightly dark in color, about 5 - 10 minutes. Add bread cubes and stir. Add marinara sauce and chicken bouillon and stir. Cover and place into oven. Bake or bake for about 15 - 20 minutes, depending on your crockpot's size, until bread cubes are toasted and broth is bubbling. The soup will be slightly soupy. Serve hot.

title: Italian Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1 pear, cored and diced | 1/2 cup orange juice | 1/2 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 1/2 cup sliced almonds, toasted, or as desired
instructions: Mix the kidney beans, pear, orange juice, italian seasoning, and almonds together in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: pistachio,bulb garlic,coconut,chili pepper flake,spinach leaf,catsup,tomato sauce
title: Spinach Soup
ingredients: 500 g spinach leaves | 25 g ground pistachios | 2 teaspoons chili pepper flakes ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons catsup | 1 teaspoon coconut or 50 g cream coconut oil | 1 bulb of garlic | 1 teaspoon crushed pistachios
instructions: Chop garlic, cook it in oil until softened, then add garlic. Add the rest of the ingredients. Cook until spinach is done.

title: Hot Chocolate III
ingredients: 4 cups tomato juice | 1/2 cup sugar | 1/2 teaspoon ground pepper | 2 tablespoons dry mustard seeds | 6 peppercorns | 3 ounces butter | 1 teaspoon instant vanilla | 2 ounces unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 2 quart saucepan. Cook over med low heat stirring occasionally until mixture thickens and bubbly, about 2 minutes. Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered for 10 minutes. Strain through a fine mesh sieve and stir in cocoa.

title: Green Beans With Spinach, Beans and Cannellini Beans
ingredients: 1 package washed fresh spinach leaves | 1 can cannellini beans, rinsed and drained
instructions: Place the spinach leaves in a large skillet with a lid. Cover with water just to the top of the leaves. Bring to a boil, lower heat, and simmer for 5 minutes. Remove from heat and allow to sit covered for five minutes longer. Drain and set aside. In a medium saucepan, combine beans with enough boiling water to cover. Bring to a boil, lower heat and simmer 10 minutes. Remove from heat and allow to stand covered for 5 minutes. Drain and serve with fresh bread.

title: Beedi Chops
ingredients: 2 pork loin chops, boneless, skin on | 1 tablespoon yogurt or 1 tablespoon greek yogurt | 4 teaspoons beef fat ( optional )
instructions: Pre heat broiler. Lightly rub yogurt on both sides of the pork chops. Place the pork chops in an oven proof casserole dish. Place in oven until the pork is no longer pink. Sprinkle a layer of the yogurt over the pork chops. Pour the fat on the pork and move to broiler. Broil for approximately 5 minute or until meat thermometer reads 160 degrees. Slice into pieces and serve.

title: Candy Cane Nuts
ingredients: 1 package reduced-fat cream cheese | 1 pinch ground mace or 1 pinch cayenne pepper
instructions: Blend the cream cheese until smooth. Add the mace or cayenne pepper and blend until the mixture is fluffy and smooth. Place in a small container and refrigerate until cold.

title: Quinoa Pasta
ingredients: 100 g quinoa | 150 g shell pasta | 3/4 teaspoon fenugreek seeds or 5 -6 whole fennel | 100 g salted peanuts or 100 g cashews | 2 tablespoons peanut oil or 2 tablespoons other vegetable oil
instructions: Cook the quinoa as per package directions, drain, toss with fenugreek and nuts. Enjoy.

title: Mokha - Mush Chilli Fruit Salad with Chocolate Sauce
ingredients: 8 ounces soft white sandwich bread or 8 ounces crusty rolls | 3/4 cup mango or 3/4 cup pear, peeled and coarsely chopped | 8 ounces panir, cubed or 8 ounces curd cheese | 2 tablespoons brandy | 6 large red chilies, thinly sliced | 4 -6 small whole dried red chilies, to taste | 2 tablespoons molasses ( optional )
instructions: Toast the bread until crisp. Remove and allow to cool. Combine mango, prawns or prawns and crumbled cheese in a bowl. In a small saucepan, whisk in the brandy and chillies. Remove from heat and stir in molasses. Place a layer of bread over the mango mixture. Spread a layer of mango mixture over each bread slice. Repeat layers of fruit, bread and prawn mixture with remaining bread slices and mango mixture. Gently stir through chocolate sauce to combine.

title: Fig and Capsicum Salad
ingredients: 200 g firm figs | 75 g vegetable oil | 1 green capsicum, finely chopped | 1 -2 corn on the cob, kernels removed
instructions: Place the figs in a small saucepan, cover with cold water and bring to the boil. Remove from the heat and plunge under cold water for about 10 minutes, drain and roughly chop.

title: Turkish Cilantro Tea
ingredients: 5 cups hot spiced tea, preferably homemade | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley leaves | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro | 3 teaspoons hot paprika
instructions: Combine the coriander, parsley, cilantro, and paprika with 1/4 cup water in a medium saucepan over medium low heat.

title: Apricot and Black Olive Tapenade
ingredients: 2 tablespoons apricot jam ( can use 2 t if not avalable ) | 3 -4 ripe black olives, thinly sliced | 1 spring onion, chopped finely
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the apricot jam with 2 tblsp cold water. Stir to combine and set aside. Place the olives and spring onion in a bowl. Pour half of the jam mixture over, then top with 1/4 cup tapenade. Toss to moisten.

title: Tahini and Hamburger Cracker Loaf
ingredients: 1 hamburger | 1 cup crushed cranberry juice ( homemade if possible ) | 1 tablespoon tahini | 2 teaspoons sugar | 1/2 teaspoon dried dill | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 teaspoon garlic granules | 1 medium radish ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Mix hamburger, cranberry, tahini, sugar, dill and garlic in a bowl. Transfer bowl with mixture to a casserole dish. Scatter radish. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes, remove from oven and let stand for 15 minutes. Serve with crackers and other crackers.

title: Lebanese Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ground cinnamon | 1 lebanese cucumber, halved lengthwise but not very thinly sliced
instructions: In a small bowl combine the cinnamon and lemon peel and sprinkle over the inside of the cucumber slice. Toss gently until coated with the cinnamon. Serve drizzled with olive oil.

title: Apple Cider
ingredients: 2 cups apple cider | 3/4 cup cold water | 1/4 cup blue curacao ( apple brandy )
instructions: Stir cider and water in saucepan over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: fruit,pearl barley,grain white rice,black pepper,bean,gruyere cheese
title: Vegetable and Breadless Rice Pudding
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked long grain white rice | 2 cups grated gruyere cheese | 2/3 cup dried beans | 2/3 cup pearl barley, soaked overnight | 4 slices fruit ( about 4 ounces ) | fresh ground black pepper
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions or in recipe of your choice. Drain and allow to cool for 5 minutes. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. In a large ovenproof serving dish, layer the grated cheese, then the cooked rice, beans, barley and sliced fruit. Bake, covered, for 25 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle with freshly ground black pepper.

title: Lebanese Lobster Sticks
ingredients: 1/2 lb lobster meat | 3 hard-boiled eggs, peeled | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon | 1 toasted pine nuts
instructions: Slice 1 toasted or slightly toasted pine nuts into the size of the toasted nuts. Remove lobster meat from shells and reserve any shells which have not opened. Cut remaining lobster meat into 1/4 inch chunks. In a bowl, mash the beaten eggs and add the lobster meat. Mix thoroughly. Using 2 or 3 lobster shells at your discretion, add the pieces of shell to the lobster mixture. Mix well. Shape lobster mixture into 1 inch sticks or sticks. Wrap each lobster stick with saran wrap and secure with toothpicks. Sprinkle with pine nuts. Bake at 350 degrees for 20 to 30 minutes. Remove toothpicks during last 5 to 10 minutes if they have browned. Serve on platter and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,sauerkraut,paprika,meat,mushroom stem,vanilla essence,elbow macaroni,carnation milk
title: German Meat, Sauerkraut & Macaroni Dinner
ingredients: 2 tablespoons carnation evaporated milk | 1 teaspoon paprika | 1/2 lb ground meat | 1 can sauerkraut, drained and mashed | 1 can chopped mushrooms with liquid | 2 cups self rising flour, sifted | 1 1/2 lbs elbow macaroni | 2 teaspoons vanilla essence or 2 teaspoons maple flavoring
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f lightly grease a 1 1/2 quart dish with vegetable oil. In large mixing bowl, combine the milk, evporated milk & paprika. Stir in meat & sauerkraut, then stir in the mushrooms & mashed sauerkraut. Dump mixture into the prepared dish & bake 45 - 50 minutes or until golden brown. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of salted water to boil. Add pasta & cook until al dente. When pasta is cooked, drain well & return to pot. Meanwhile, in a small bowl combine the flour & vanilla essence. Stir the flour mixture into the meat mixture until thoroughly coated. Pour the meat & sauce over the hot pasta & toss together. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: golden raisin,granny smith apple,velveeta cheese,shiitake mushroom,tequila,double cream,chicken broth
title: Mexican Apple, Raisin and Cheese Bake
ingredients: 8 ounces sliced shiitake mushrooms | 8 ounces sauteed golden raisins | 1 granny smith apple, peeled, cored and chopped | 2/3 cup reduced-sodium chicken broth | 1 carton double cream | 3 ounces tequila | 1 package velveeta cheese, cut into 1/2-inch cubes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325°. Spray a 9x13 baking dish with cooking spray. Place mushrooms and raisins in a mixing bowl and let soak for about 10 minutes. Meanwhile, toss together the apple, broth, cream, tequila, and cheese in a bowl. Drain the mushrooms and raisins and combine with apple mixture in baking dish. Bake for 40 minutes, stirring occasionally, until bubbly and golden.

title: Coconut-Pork Leg of the Dutch Antilles
ingredients: 1 rabbit, skinned, giblets removed, left intact | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/3 cup coconut oil | 1/3 cup sugar | 10 cups light cream or 10 cups milk | 2 ounces bittersweet chocolate milk
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Pound the rabbit fat with the flat of a cleaver or mallet until it's as thin as paper. Cut the meat in half lengthwise, then crosswise into 2 even pieces. Place the pork in a large roasting pan, skin side down. In a small bowl or jar, stir together the vanilla, coconut oil, sugar and cream and set aside 2 tbsp of this mixture. Strain the cream mixture, reserving the liquid. Pour this mixture in the roasting pan. Insert a skewer into each piece of meat and set aside. Pour the reserved cream mixture into the pan and place in the preheated oven. Bake for 3 hours, basting every 15 minutes, or until meat is very tender and cooked. Remove from oven and let rest 5 minutes. Slice to serve.

title: Bunuelos II
ingredients: 3/4 cup italian-style seasoned bread crumbs | 1/4 cup guacamole, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Dredge 2 pieces of plastic wrap individually in a plate of cold water to coat. Roll the plastic wrap in the bread crumbs until thoroughly coated. Place onto a baking sheet, and sprinkle with guacamole to taste. Bake in the preheated oven until the croutons are golden brown, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: english muffin,peppercorn,strawberry,chili pepper,self rising flour,chili paste,bamboo skewer
title: Thai Strawberry and Chilli Sate Sandwich Waffles
ingredients: 400 g strawberries, hulled, halved crossways | 1 tablespoon chili paste | 1 tablespoon sweet chili pepper, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon peppercorn, coarsely crushed | 20 english muffins, halved | 100 g low-fat self-rising flour, gluten-free flour | 1 1/2 tablespoons sweet chili paste, finely chopped | 20 bamboo skewers
instructions: To make the topping, combine the chopped strawberries, chilli paste, pepper and peppercorns in a bowl. To make the gluten free flour, sifted the flour in a large bowl and with a wooden spoon mix the flour into the olive oil. Add salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste. Toast the english muffins.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,italian parsley,vegetable shortening,plain flour,cocoa,fettuccini pasta,tortilla
title: Quick and Easy Indian Noodles
ingredients: 400 g fettuccine pasta | 1 1/4 cups plain flour | 1/4 cup vegetable shortening | 1 teaspoon mild curry powder | 2 teaspoons unsweetened cocoa | 4 -5 tablespoons chopped fresh italian parsley | vegetable oil ( for frying ) | 4 -5 tortillas, cut into strips
instructions: Cook fettuccini in plenty of salted boiling water until just tender. Drain. Meanwhile, in a large bowl mix flour, veggie shortening, curry powder, cocoa and parsley. Drain cooked fettuccini and toss with the soured batter. Drain pasta and toss everything else. Set aside. Fry tortilla strips in hot oil'til crisp. Drain on paper towels and serve immediately.

title: Creole Fiddleheads
ingredients: 12 large fiddleheads, cleaned | creole seasoning | chili powder
instructions: Trim any stems or leaves from fiddleheads. Wash thoroughly under running water. Break the fiddleheads apart, being careful to leave any broken bits of fiddlehead with pieces hanging out on the edge of the pan. Rinse your fiddleheads, and place into a large casserole dish. Sprinkle the creole seasoning evenly over the fiddleheads. Sprinkle the chili powder over the entire fiddleheads. Heat in a preheated 375 degree f oven or for about 2 hours. You may cover and continue cooking for about 1½ hours, or until fiddleheads are browned and tender.

title: Chocolate Beetroot Squash and Squash
ingredients: 600 g potatoes, peeled ( yellow squash, yam, zucchini or a combination ) or 600 g zucchini, peeled ( yellow squash, yam, zucchini or a combination ) | 2 large beets, in 1/2 cm slices ( raw ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons turmeric | 300 ml dark chocolate, roughly chopped | 50 g dark chocolate, roughly chopped
instructions: Steam the potato slices by steaming them for a few minutes in the microwave. Transfer the potatoes to a large roasting tin and scatter them with the beetroot, turmeric and a little water. Drizzle over the grated chocolate and stir to combine. Add a few pinches of salt and place in a warm oven to set the chocolate and beets together. Heat the grated chocolate and chopped dark chocolate in a small saucepan to a chocolate syrupy colour, set aside. Bake a few minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: tea,olive oil cooking spray,strawberry,cranberry,corn kernel,lemon zest,quinoa
title: Quinoa and Wild Berry Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup quinoa | 1 cup mixed frozen strawberries or 1 cup fresh strawberries, quartered | 1 cup sweet corn kernels | 1 cup cranberries | 1/2 - 3/4 cup olive oil flavored cooking spray | 1/2 teaspoon lemon zest | 1 -2 tablespoon brewed tea ( optional )
instructions: Roast quinoa according to package directions, or place in a large bowl and cover with 2 cups hot water, stir, cover and set aside to steam off excess moisture. Mix together the quinoa, strawberries, sweet corn kernels, cranberries and oil. Toss with reserved quinoa and herbs.

Random Ingredients: cream corn,onion,white potato,penne pasta,white rice,red bell pepper
title: Cafe Rio Penne
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry penne pasta | 1 small onion, chopped | 1 cup sour cream corn | 1 can white potatoes, drained | 1 small red bell pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup cooked white rice
instructions: In a medium saucepan, mix water and penne pasta. Bring to a boil. Stir in onion, sour cream corn and bell pepper.

Random Ingredients: pecan half,ginger garlic paste,active yeast,heavy cream,sirloin,meat,guacamole,pie crust
title: Baked Empanadas With Ground Beef and Guacamole
ingredients: 16 large pie crusts, baked ( empanah ) | 1/4 cup light cream | 1 jar chopped giardiner's sweet chili peppers or ( 10 ounce ) jar jalapeno peppers | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 3 1/2 ounces ground sirloin | 2/3 cup heavy cream | 1/2 cup guacamole | 2 -3 pieces fresh ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. In bowl of electric mixer, blend giardiner's. Add peppers, ginger garlic paste, and meat. Mix until well blended. Spread cream evenly on pastry shells, then spread beef mixture on top of cream. Top with remaining pastry, leaving a little for lattice pattern. Brush top with cream and sprinkle with guacamole. Bake for 25 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: turkey,apple cider,green onion,red curry paste,marjoram,beef tenderloin fillet,pesto sauce,tortilla
title: Curried Beef Wrap
ingredients: 6 ounces lean free-range beef tenderloin fillets ( about 4.5 oz each ) | 1 large green onion, thinly sliced ( about 1 1/2 onions ) | 2 tablespoons prepared pesto sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons red curry paste | 2 teaspoons prepared marjoram or 2 teaspoons sage, chopped | 2 tablespoons apple cider or 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 4 large burrito-sized tortillas | pesto sauce, for drizzling ( optional )
instructions: Prepare tortillas, cut beef in half crosswise lengthwise, then crosswise, crosswise, into about 1/8 inch slices. Arrange beef on two small plate.

title: Mexican-Style Nachos (Dynamite)
ingredients: 9 saffron strands, crushed | 1 1/4 cups taco seasoning mix, dry | white pepper
instructions: In a large bowl, combine saffron and taco seasoning mix.

title: Sweet-Creamed Apricot Cookies
ingredients: 2 eggs | 2 tablespoons vanilla preserves | 8 ounces apricot preserves | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar
instructions: In a blender, mix eggs with preserves and mix well, you might not use all of the preserves. Add sugar and mix well again. Shape into small balls and roll in confectioners' sugar. Place on a parchment lined cookie sheet.

Random Ingredients: safflower oil,leek,ciabatta bread,mango chutney,marsala wine,tabasco sauce,grain rice,lamb meat
title: Lamb and Rice Burgers With Mango-Chutney Sauce
ingredients: 1 ounce ciabatta or 1 ounce other buttered bread, thickly sliced | 2 teaspoons safflower oil | 1 lb lean ground lamb or 1 lb pork | 1 lb leek, finely sliced | 1 1/2 cups basamic marsala wine | 1 cup sweet mango chutney ( see note in introduction ) | 1/3 cup sweet mango chutney ( see note in description ) | 1/3 cup sweet mango chutney ( see note in description ) | 1 dash tabasco sauce or 1 dash hot sauce ( optional )
instructions: Preheat grill or griddle pan. Line a baking sheet or tray with foil. Place 2 tsp oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add lamb or pork, leeks and safflower oil. Season with salt and pepper to taste, stir and heat for 10 - 15 minutes, being careful not to burn the leeks. Remove from skillet, set aside. Cover and set aside 10 minutes before you start the burgers. Meanwhile make mango and chutney sauce. Using an electric mixer, beat chutney with sweet mango chutney and tabasco sauce. Brush tops with olive oil, if desired. Add cooked meat to chutney mixture. Divide into two portions. To one portion, spread 1 tbsp of jam on the surface of one portion and spread it onto the second portion of the bread. Place bread on the work surface with the jam side uppermost. Top with 1 tsp ground lamb or pork. Arrange meat on top of the jam and then sprinkle on 2 tsp mango chutney. Serve immediately or refrigerate until required. Note, if using mango chutney, skip this step and proceed with the remaining steps. To prepare mango chutney, combine 1 1/2 cups mango chutney with the sweet mango chutney. Place chutney mixture in a jar with an airtight lid or plastic bag, seal and shake to mix the lumps off of the mango chutney mixture. Add more liquid. Makes 20 - 25 servings. Note, the mango chutney can be refrigerated until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock,flour,serrano pepper,soya sauce,creamy peanut butter,carrot,lemon peel
title: Sauce for Chicken and Vegetables
ingredients: 1 cup chicken stock | 1/2 cup creamy peanut butter | 1/4 cup soya sauce ( or tamari ) | 1/2 cup chicken stock | 2 tablespoons flour ( extra virgin for coating ) | 1 tablespoon finely shredded lemon peel | 1 -2 teaspoon seshon preserved whole serrano pepper | 1 carrot, shaved into strips and fried ( optional )
instructions: Mix the chicken stock and the peanut butter together in a bowl until well blended. Stir in the soya sauce, chicken stock, flour, lemon peel and the whole chiles. If desired, add a small amount of oil. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Taste and adjust the seasonings, garnish with preserved whole chile strips and serve.

title: Homemade Sesame Seeds
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons sesame seeds, roasted and cooled | 2 tablespoons chili-garlic sauce
instructions: Using a mortar and pestle or your hands, crush the sesame seeds with the chili garlic sauce. You should be able to smell and smell the garlic until it begins to crackle. If you are not, use a clean coffee filter to secure the lid.

title: Grand Marnier, Guinness Steak
ingredients: 750 g mincemeat | 4 granny smith apples, peeled, cored and cut into 2 cm cubes | 300 ml cream or 300 ml light cream | 2 tablespoons grated apple, pulp | 1 tablespoon grand marnier | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder
instructions: Place mince in a large bowl, add 2 tbsp cream or light cream mixed with the spices and stir well to combine the ingredients. Leave to marinate for 1/2 hours in the fridge. Grill, steam or bbq the mince until brown on all sides.

Random Ingredients: tamarind paste,tabasco sauce,tamari,egg white,currant,dark soy sauce
title: Tamarind Egg Rolls (Pancakes)
ingredients: 1 egg white | 2 tablespoons tamarind paste | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons currants | 7 tablespoons tamarind paste | 1 dash tabasco sauce
instructions: Place egg white, tamarind paste, soy sauce, currants, tamarind paste, tabasco and salt in a plastic or glass bowl and beat on low until mixture is smooth. The mixture should not be sticky. Cover bowl and let stand 25 minutes. Divide mixture into 12 portions and roll into balls. Roll each ball in tamarind paste and set aside for 15 minutes. Bring a wok or skillet until very hot. Add 2 to 3 cups water and bring to boil. Place egg rolls in the water 1 at a time. When they turn a golden brown color, place on paper toweling. Allow to rest 3 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: miso,red chili pepper flake,margarita mix,baby spinach leaf,vegetable juice
title: Spinach and Spinach Salad
ingredients: 1 bag baby spinach | 2 cups vegetable juice | 1/2 cup margarita mix | 2 tablespoons miso | 1 teaspoon red chili pepper flakes
instructions: Blend all the ingredients with a hand blender or food processor. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: dill,tomato green chilies,beer,serrano pepper,ricotta cheese,fontina,chipotle powder,apple juice
title: Chipotle-Crock Pot Mexican Ricotta Cheese
ingredients: 15 ounces beer ( corona or dos equis, your favourite brand ) | 15 ounces tomato and green chilies ( ro-tel ) | 5 ounces chopped fresh dill | 2 tablespoons grated chipotle powder ( or to taste ) | 1 1/2 cups ricotta cheese | 12 ounces diced canned chipotle peppers in adobo, plus some, from can | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies | 2 medium apples, peeled, cored and sliced
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine everything. Stir well and let simmer for 15 minutes. Let cool and refrigerate until cold as possible. To serve, spread 3/4 thick slices of bread with batter or use as an appetizer spread. Arrange 1 - 2 chipotle slices over each slice and top with 1/2 the cheese mixture. Repeat. Serve with corn chips, guacamole, salsa, or tortilla chips.

title: Vanilla Lime Cake.
ingredients: 6 wedges lime | 4 teaspoons vanilla sugar
instructions: Wearing disposable glasses with rims, rub the fruit with the lime wedge or you can just pop it into a ziploc bag which contains vanilla sugar. After scoring the fruit on top of the lime wedges, place on a platter or on individual oven trays. Bake at 375 deg f for 45 minutes, flipping once halfway through.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,mustard,rosemary,salt,plain flour,onion flake,spinach linguine,basil
title: Spinach Linguine With Fresh Basil
ingredients: 3 ounces dried spinach linguine or 3 ounces dried linguine | 1 bunch fresh basil | 6 tablespoons freshly grated pecorino romano cheese | 3 tablespoons dried onion flakes | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 teaspoon dried mustard | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary, crushed ( optional ) | 1/4 cup plain flour
instructions: Cook the vermicelli according to the package directions. To make the basil, separate the leaves from the stems and shred them coarsely. Place them in a saucepan with a few tablespoons of water and bring to a boil.

title: Broccoli & Pistachios Filled Apricot Cups
ingredients: 10 slices mozzarella cheese | 4 small apricots, halved and toasted | 1/2 small yellow onion, very thinly sliced | 1/2 cup of coarsely chopped toasted pistachios | 30 leaves fresh broccoli florets
instructions: Cut 2 of the mozzarella slices in half on the diagonal. Set aside. Slice and top 4 of the mozzarella slices in half, making sure to leave a 1/2 inch border. Place 1/4 of the sliced mozzarella in the center of each apricot half. Top with onion and pistachios. Roll up the slices carefully, and secure with kitchen string. Repeat with all remaining cheese slices and toasted apricots, onion and pistachios. Wrap the outside of each capful of cheese tightly around the filled pastry. Bake in a 425 degree oven until browned, about 15 minutes.

title: French Fried Green Peas (Oignons)
ingredients: 1 cup frozen peas | 2 teaspoons white sugar | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 1 1/4 cups shredded lettuce
instructions: In a saucepan, bring 1 cup peas to boil. Cover, reduce heat, and boil for 5 minutes. Drain. Set aside. Heat remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Stir in sugar.

title: Pasta, Bean, Parsley and Yogurt Salad
ingredients: 200 g pasta ( elbow macaroni ) | 2 tablespoons margarine | 1 tablespoon parsley flakes | 1 can pinto beans, drained | 2 teaspoons vanilla essence ( or other flavouring ) | 300 ml yogurt, strained
instructions: Cook the pasta until al dente. Fry the parsley flakes in the melted margarine. Rinse well with cold water and drain. Drain the beans in a colander and put in a large bowl. Stir in the melted margarine. Add the parsley flakes. Pour on the yogurt, vanilla or other flavouring. Mix well. Serve immediately.

title: Barbecued Lamb Shoulder
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds lamb shoulder, trimmed and cut into 2 inch-thick slices | 2 fresh jalapeno peppers, sliced | 1/2 can dark rum
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium high heat, and lightly oil the grate. Place lamb slices on the prepared grill. Brush with rum. Use a grill spatula to flip slices over for 2 to 4 minutes per side. Remove from heat. Cut into quarters with sharp scissors, serve, and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: lime wedge,lamb,chicken stock,peanut butter,cherry pie filling
title: Lamb Chops
ingredients: 4 teaspoons peanut butter | 1/4 cup chicken stock | 1 can cherry pie filling | 2 tablespoons smooth peanut butter | 1 lime wedge
instructions: Heat peanut sauce on medium high heat until the peanut butter is melted. Stir in curry paste and cook on high heat for two minutes. Stir in the stock. Add cherry pie filling. Stir until just hot and place lid on the pot. Simmer on medium low for 10 minutes. Pour mixture back into the pan and keep on a high heat for an additional five minutes. Add peanut butter and stir until well combined. Stir in lime wedge.

Random Ingredients: ice,red pepper flake,pecorino romano cheese,vegetable oil,german chocolate cake mix,daikon radish,mustard
title: Ginger Chocolate Daikon Radish Cupcakes
ingredients: 2 packages german chocolate cake mix ( not vanilla ) | 1 tablespoon mustard ( to taste ) | 1 teaspoon red pepper flakes | 4 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 teaspoon pecorino romano cheese | 3/4 cup candied ginger, grated | ice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place the cake mix and mustard in a mixing bowl and lightly mix. Pour in the oil. Mix to smooth consistency. Add grated cheese and mix again. Roll out to 1/4 inch thickness. Slice diagonally and place on a pan. Bake for 10 - 12 minutes or just until golden brown. Remove from oven and transfer to a wire rack. Cool slightly. Using the tip of a sharp paring knife, spread ginger into the cake and poke holes all over. Fill with the cooled radishes.

Random Ingredients: molasses,italian herb,anise seed,rump roast,spring onion,pizza dough
title: Sticky Roast
ingredients: 1 tablespoon molasses | 2 1/4 lbs rump roast | 6 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil or 6 tablespoons corn oil | 3 tablespoons chopped italian herbs ( preferably sage ) | 1 tablespoon anise seed | 1 spring-onion, finely chopped ( green onion )
instructions: Place the roast in a roasting pan and brush with 2 tablespoons of the olive oil and sprinkle over the herbs and anise seed. Roast in the oven at 400° for 40 minutes or until medium rare. Transfer to a platter and tent with foil for 5 minutes, while carving. Remove the twine and place on serving plates, scatter with remaining oil and spring onions and serve.

title: Mexican Grilled Veggies
ingredients: 4 large zucchini | 1 yellow bell pepper | 1 1/3 cups vegetable shortening | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro | 1/2 cup chopped green onion | 1/4 cup chopped fresh peach
instructions: Cut zucchini lengthwise in half. Remove seeds. Place in a steamer basket. Add yellow bell pepper. Steam 4 to 5 minutes or until tender, turning zucchini halfway through cooking time. Transfer to a bowl. Preheat grill. Meanwhile, melt shortening in a medium skillet over moderately high heat. Saute cilantro and green onion until tender. Remove from heat.

title: Quick and Easy Gluten Free Alfredo Sprouts
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vital wheat gluten | 1/2 cup raw fennel sprouts
instructions: In mini food processor fitted with metal blade, process fennel over the medium low setting until it begins to form ribbons. Stir fennel into remaining fennel in processor. Stream in the raw fennel until it starts to form a thick mass, about 2 minutes. Reduce speed to low and pour in alfredo bean sprouts. Process until mixture is just combined into a ball. Wrap up.

title: Baked Stuffed Apples
ingredients: 3 medium cooking apples, peeled, cored & quartered | 2 tablespoons butter | 1 package frozen crabmeat | 5 tablespoons creole seasoning | 1 cup flaked coconut | 1 can evaporated half-and-half cream | 20 buttery crackers ( optional ) | 1 package frozen whipped topping
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Arrange apples in rows in rows in a 10 x 3 cup lightly buttered baking dish. Melt 1 tablespoon butter in a 8 inch nonstick skillet over medium heat. Crumble crab meat into skillet & sprinkle with creole seasoning.

title: Scallops on the Sea
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 cup apple juice | 1 pound sea scallops
instructions: Preheat the oven's broiler and set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source. In a medium bowl, mix apple juice and olive oil. Brush scallops with this juice mixture. Place on a baking sheet and broil until the tops are a light brown, about 3 minutes.

title: Basic French Dressing
ingredients: 1/4 cup liquid smoke, smoke, smoke concentrate | 1 teaspoon prepared english-style mustard powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a tightly covered bottle. Shake vigorously until thoroughly blended. Shake well if using air tight jars.

title: Baked Pear Cream
ingredients: 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1 tablespoon grated peeled pear
instructions: Whip cream until soft peaks form.

title: Oregano Salad With Vanilla Sugar
ingredients: 1 package vanilla pudding mix | 1 head iceberg lettuce | 2 tablespoons sugar ( optional ) | 3/4 teaspoon dried oregano ( optional )
instructions: Prepare the vanilla pudding mix according to package directions. Wash both heads of lettuce under cold running water. Slice crosswise in half and dry on both sides. Place them on a plate covered with paper towels. Combine sugar and oregano and mix well. Place on the lettuce. Toss with vanilla sugar mixture until evenly coated. Serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: beef brisket,iceberg lettuce,green cardamom pod,basil leaf,palm sugar,chipotle powder,pineapple juice
title: Lennie's Sweet Beef With Pineapple Lettuce
ingredients: 3 lbs beef brisket ( about 8-10 per person ) | 1 head iceberg lettuce ( about 10 cups leaves, or torn lettuce and baby bok choy ) | 1 cup thinly sliced green cardamom pod ( use 1 per person for more color ) | 1 jar crushed pineapple in juice | 3/4 cup coconut palm sugar dissolved in 3/4 cup palm sugar | powdered sugar | 1/4 teaspoon chipotle powder ( to garnish )
instructions: Place brisket on rack in large roasting pan. Sprinkle brisket with sugar mixture. Roast in a 300 degree oven until done, about 3 1/2 to 4 hours. During the last 30 minutes of roasting remove brisket from oven and transfer brisket to a plate. Skim fat from broth, if desired.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning,extra virgin olive oil,pine nut,lime juice zest,buttermilk
title: Pesto Mayonnaise
ingredients: 1 cup buttermilk | 2 tablespoons pine nuts | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning | 3 tablespoons fresh lime juice ( about 3 limes ) | 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
instructions: In a large sauté pan, warm the fresh lime juice to almost boiling.

title: Roasted Red Vinegar Preserves
ingredients: 1/4 cup finely minced red wine vinegar | 1/4 cup finely minced candied lemon peel
instructions: In bowl, combine vinegar, candied lemon peel and the red wine vinegar. Let sit at room temperature for several minutes. Pour vinaigrette into sterilized jars leaving 1/2 inch headspace. Add 1/2 teaspoon fine sea salt or kosher salt to jar. Close lid and screw on jar. Process in a boiling water canner for 7 minutes.

title: Brazilian Onion Salad
ingredients: 1 large spanish onion, thinly sliced | 1 1/2 cups shredded coconut | 1 tablespoon dried parsley stems
instructions: In a large bowl, toss the onions with the coconut, parsley, and a pinch of salt and pepper. Toss until the coconut is coated and the onion softens.

title: Dried Cranberries (Shrikhand)
ingredients: 8 ounces dried cranberries | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric powder
instructions: Wash cranberries and let dry completely. Place in a bowl and add turmeric. Massage into whole cranberries, coating completely. Cover the bowl and refrigerate until needed. Serve.

Random Ingredients: red pear,orange peel,log goat cheese,saffron strand,cilantro leaf,cream sherry,napa cabbage
title: Citrus Salad With Goat Cheese and Pasilla Dressing
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs log fresh goat cheese ( i used greek or italian brand ) | 1 lb napa cabbage ( about 1 3/4 pounds ) | 8 oranges ( i used yellow ) | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro leaves ( not dried ) | 4 saffron strands | 1/2 teaspoon powdered saffron strand | 5 ounces sour cream sherry or 5 ounces grape sherry vinegar
instructions: Cut cabbage into 3/4 inch slices. Arrange in serving dish. Peel oranges and remove the white pith. Using small, sharp knife, cut segments off oranges with a vegetable peeler, being careful not to peel away the white pith. Cut white pith in half. Reserve the pips if desired. Cut cheese into 1/4 inch cubes. Scrub and rinse oranges with cold water.

Random Ingredients: coconut,lime,apple juice,rotel tomato chilies,black peppercorn,chicken flavor bouillon
title: Apple Coconut Chicken
ingredients: 1 pound boneless chicken parts | 1 can rotel tomatoes & chilies | 1 lime, juiced | 6 whole black peppercorns | 3 cubes apple juice | 1 cube chicken flavor instant bouillon
instructions: Place the chicken and rotel in layers in a baking dish. Sprinkle the lime juice, peppercorns, and apple juice evenly over the chicken. Top with bouillon. Cover and bake at 350 degrees f for 1 hour. Remove bouillon and serve.

title: Grilled Hawaiian Sweet and Sour Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/2 cup pineapple juice | 1/2 cup shredded cheddar cheese
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together pineapple juice and cheddar cheese. Spread 1 or 2 tablespoons of mixture onto each roll.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast,swiss cheese,turmeric powder,extra virgin olive oil,garlic,caribbean jerk seasoning
title: Pole Vercate Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb skinless chicken breast ( frozen or fresh ) | 1/2 - 3/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 2 -3 cloves chopped garlic ( more or less to your prefernce, depending on preference for heat ) | 2 tablespoons spanish jerk seasoning | 2 -3 pinches turmeric powder ( or other spices, to taste, or use cayenne pepper depending on your heat tolerance ) | 2 -3 pinches hawaiian caribbean jerk seasoning ( see my okinawa salting adobo # 479884 '' ) ( optional ) | 1/2 1/2 - 3/4 cup swiss cheese ( grated or shredded, or as desired ) or 1/2-3/4 cup cheddar cheese ( grated or shredded, or as desired )
instructions: To the frozen/fresh breasts, mix in the olive oil, garlic, and spices. Thaw the chicken at least 4 hours, or at least overnight. Grill, broil, etc until done, to your liking. While the chicken is cooking, prepare the toppings. To make the pole de ou, mix in the turmeric and caribbean jerk seasoning. To assemble, slice chicken into strips, or roll into large pieces. Warm in a little olive oil until warmed. Serve immediately or leave warm on the stove until serving time or when the cheese is melted. Note, if the pieces seem too dry, add some water as needed to keep moist. Enjoy.

title: Shoyu Hot Sliders
ingredients: 1 -2 green pepper, seeded and chopped | 3 -4 ounces macadamia nuts, coarsely chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons shoyu | 1/4 cup sweet sherry wine | 1 -2 tablespoon small fresh ladyfinger
instructions: Place all ingredients in a food processor and mix until it forms a paste. Spread onto a greased baking sheet and chill for at least 1 hr minimum. Heat griller/toaster and roll the ladyfingers in the chilli/sweet sherry. Arrange the hot ladyfingers on the sheet and brush with the chilli/toast mix. Grill/toast the remaining rolls until they start to brown, flip over and grill/toast a little longer. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chicken cutlet,white onion,green pepper,mushroom,yellow squash,beetroot,shallot,lasagna noodle
title: Chicken and Vegetable Lasagne
ingredients: 1 cup mushroom, sliced | 1 cup white onion, sliced | 1 1/2 cups shallots, minced | 1 1/2 lbs chicken cutlets | 1 green pepper, thinly sliced | 1 yellow squash, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup carrot, sliced thin | 3 cups lasagna noodle, cooked
instructions: To make chicken and vegetables, place mushrooms, onion and shallots in a large, deep pan. Cover with water. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and heat to medium.
