Cover and cook about 15 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Drain vegetables and set aside. Return sauce to medium high heat. Cook and stir about 5 minutes or until liquid is reduced and chicken is cooked. Remove chicken and vegetables from pan and place them in a bowl. Return sauce to pan and stir with chicken and vegetables. Top with cooked noodles. Cover and simmer about 15 minutes. Note, to cook chicken and vegetables through, cook a piece of cheesecloth to remove liquid before seeding.

title: Slow-Cooked Beef Shanks With Pumpkin
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red chili powder | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning | 2 bone-in beef shanks | 1 can pumpkin ( not pie shaped like pumpkin pie filling or squash ) | 2 cups frozen yellow and green pumpkin ( or a mixture )
instructions: Preheat your oven to 350 degrees f. In a small bowl, mix together the chili powder and taco seasoning. Rub the mixture evenly into the rims of the bones and place in a roasting pan. Place in the oven and cover if desired. After 20 minutes, remove from oven, and place in refrigerator. After 15 minutes, remove shanks from the pan, and place on a tray so any excess liquid drains off. Set aside. Meanwhile in a roasting pan, pour the pumpkin from the can into a baking pan. Roast in the preheated oven for 40 minutes, or until tender. Place the pumpkin and the pumpkin in a large serving bowl, and toss with the warm, browned meat. Serve immediately.

title: Easy Hominy With Mango and Pozzoles
ingredients: 1 cup plain yogurt | 2 cups mango, roughly chopped | 1 can white hominy, drained
instructions: Thoroughly combine the yogurt and hominy and let sit for 15 to 30 minutes to allow flavors to marry. Transfer to large pot with large holes to dip. If desired, dip in cheese or sour cream. May be heated in the microwave or on the grill as well.

title: Almond Paste (Hulman)
ingredients: 2 cups almond paste | 2 cups hot water | 1 cup long grain mustard
instructions: In a blender container or bowl mix the almonds paste and hot water with 3 tbsp lukewarm water. Blend until a smooth paste forms. Spread the paste into a glass jar with a close fitting lid. Allow to dry at least 3 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: cottage cheese,garlic salt,lemon juice zest,dark soy sauce,red onion,onion salt
title: Vegan French Onion Dip
ingredients: 2 jars red onions, drained | 2 containers cottage cheese | 1/2 cup lemon juice ( i use zest of 1 lemon ) | 1/2 cup light dark soy sauce | 1/3 cup red onion salt | 1 tablespoon garlic salt
instructions: Combine all ingredients and chill until ready to serve. Serve with french bread, crackers or bread sticks. This recipe makes great dipping bread for the first time ever night.

Random Ingredients: butternut squash,head cauliflower,egg noodle,bamboo shoot,pine nut
title: Japanese-Style Squash and Noodles
ingredients: 1 medium butternut squash, peeled and chopped | 2 tablespoons pine nuts | 1 egg noodles, soaked if desired | 1 small head cauliflower, chopped | 1 can sliced bamboo shoots, drained, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Dice the squash into 1/2 inch pieces. In a large skillet, heat the pine nuts and sautee the egg noodles in the olive oil with a dash of salt until they are a light brown color. Set aside. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add the chopped squash and cook for approximately 2 minutes. Rinse the drained egg noodles and set aside. In a large skillet over medium heat, heat the pine nuts. When the pine nuts are almost toasted, add the cauliflower and cook for approximately 2 - 3 minutes. Add the chopped egg noodles and squash to the skillet and stir. Add the can of bamboo shoots. Drain excess liquid from the skillet. Add the pine nuts and stir. Top with the shredded hot pepper. Serve with more hot pepper flakes if desired.

Random Ingredients: pecan,parsley stem,cornflour,grain white rice,lemonade concentrate,italian sausage,extra virgin olive oil,ketjap manis
title: Pepperjack
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cornflour | 6 -8 links sweet italian sausage, sliced in half diagonally ( or other sweet or hot ) | 2 packages frozen pepperjack pepperidge farm frozen pepperade concentrate | 3 tablespoons lemonade concentrate | 2 1/2 teaspoons dried parsley stems | 2 teaspoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons coarse grain white rice | 1/2 cup finely minced pecans
instructions: Mix the cornflour in a bowl with 2 tbsp water to form a paste. Coat the sausage slices in the cornflour, then brown over medium heat until cooked through, browned and crispy. Pour into a colander and allow to drain on paper towels. Wipe out a skillet with paper towels. Place the pepperjack and 1/2 package frozen pepperjack in the skillet, cooking on medium high heat until heated through and crisp. Drain the peppers on paper towels and return the skillet to the stove. Stir in 1 package of pepperade concentrate, lemonade concentrate, lemon juice and parsley stems. Simmer for a few minutes to thicken the sauce. Add the olive oil and heat through. Remove from the heat and stir in the rice. Sprinkle with the pecans and serve with a side dish of fresh tomato ketchup. Note, a cup of frozen peppersidge farms frozen pepperade concentrate can be obtained at gourmet stores, if desired.

title: Eggplant (Aubergine) With Soy Sauce
ingredients: 2 small eggplants, peeled and sliced | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 1 tablespoon finely crushed ginger-garlic paste | 1 large shallot, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c, or preheat grill on high. Brush eggplant with oil, and place on a cookie sheet. Sprinkle with salt and bake in oven for 30 minutes, or until cooked through. Meanwhile, heat ghee in a pan over medium high heat. Add shallots and cook, stirring for a few minutes until browned. Add soy sauce, ginger garlic paste and cooked eggplant. Cook for 2 minutes until sauce thickens and shallots are just starting to become crisp.

title: Tuna and Fresh Herby Tarts
ingredients: 2 cans tuna, drained | 2 tablespoons fresh italian parsley | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon myrtle, minced | 8 slices whole wheat bread
instructions: Drain the tuna well. Add the parsley, lemon myrtle and mix well. Divide the tuna mixture into 24 equal portions. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Divide the fillings among 6 tins and bake for 20 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Cheese & Leek Parfaits
ingredients: 1 lb sharp cheddar cheese ( grated ) | 1/2 cup golden syrup | 2 tablespoons finely grated lemon peel
instructions: Combine all ingredients, mix well. Cover & refrigerate for 1 hour. Shape into parfait sized rounds & bake on a greased griddle or frying pan until lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,lime juice zest,msg,simple syrup,guinness stout
title: Guiness Guinness Margaritas
ingredients: 1/2 cup guinness stout | 1 small lime, juice and zest of | 1 small yellow bell pepper, cut in thin strips ( or other peppers ) | 2 teaspoons simple syrup ( or honey ) | 3/4 teaspoon msg
instructions: Whisk all of the ingredients together, except the guiness. Serve over ice in a large rimmed glass over ice cubes.

title: Victorian French Fries
ingredients: 2 lbs unpeeled assorted assorted candied peel and trimmings, such as oak bits, dried peels and pearl onions | vegetable oil ( preferably olive, although we never use that stuff ) | 12 inches flour tortillas | 3/4 teaspoon ground pepper
instructions: If using wooden skewers, soak them in water for about 12 hours. Remove the peel and trimmings and cut off any segments of peel that fall off easily with a sharp knife. Tear into pieces and pat dry with paper towels. Prepare a grill using direct heat for high heat. When ready to cook, oil the grill grate. Using tongs, carefully set a dinner plate or rack about 4 cups deep in a large baking pan filled with about 2 inches of hot oil. Wet hands or a paper towel and line with a piece of plastic wrap, about 6 inches long and 4 inches wide. Dry peel on paper towels. Season with coarse salt and pepper, and transfer to pan. Add oil to pan so it just reaches to the rim of the pan. If using nonstick griddle, make sure it is oiled over the top and bottom of skillet. Sprinkle strips of peel over peel. Dribble some more oil onto the strips. Close the lid and continue heating the oil until the strips are very hot, about 6 minutes. Do not remove the lid while it is heating and turning, just shake and turn them. The idea is to cook the strips slowly, turning them as needed, so as not to completely blacken them. Test one strip to see that it has a nice brown color. If it does, lower the heat slightly. Taste again and adjust seasoning, if necessary. Lift the edge of the tortilla and check for resistance. If the strips are pliable and pliable, they are ready, and should not break or break. The strips should puff up like popcorn or popped popcorn. If not, close the lid and continue cooking the remaining strips. When the time of cooking is up, re dip the strips in the hot oil a few at a time, taking care that they do not spit on the bottom. They will eventually burst and become crispy, and will be dry. Drain on kitchen paper towels and, depending on your taste, sprinkle with pepper. These are best served while still slightly warm.

Random Ingredients: tomatillo,brown mustard seed,prosciutto,strawberry jelly,poppy seed,beef sausage
title: Beef Toast With Fresh Tomato Salsa Verde #RSC
ingredients: 500 g pickled tomatillos, packed in water | 120 g prosciutto, sliced | 250 g strawberry jelly | 2 teaspoons poppy seeds | 2 teaspoons brown mustard seeds | 1/2 teaspoon brown mustard seeds | 12 -14 ounces beef sausage ( or other lean cut )
instructions: Drain salsa verde thoroughly and set aside. Wrap prosciutto slices in bacon or ham slices. Place in hot skillet with tomato onion tomato mixture and cook until soft.

title: Ginger Lime Da Boys
ingredients: 12 large unpeeled limes | 1 piece fresh ginger root, peeled | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Preheat oven to 320 degrees f. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Remove the lime peel. Slice 1/4 inch thick strips of peel. Dip your fingers into a bowl of water. Squeeze all of the lime juice with your fingers until the strips show no white residue. Place the lime strips in a baking dish. Sprinkle generously with baking soda. Cover dish with a cloth secured with kitchen twine. Place dish into oven and bake for 1 hour. Be careful, as these boys will brown quickly.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,masa harina flour,sausage,herb,portabella mushroom,trout fillet,maple syrup
title: Dirty Goose
ingredients: 12 slices sandwich frissee smoked turkey sausage or 12 slices portabella mushrooms | 12 slices trident orange roughy fillet | 12 slices roasted garlic powder or 12 slices roasted garlic salt ( a good 1/2-ounce jar ) or 12 slices roasted garlic salt ( a good 1/2-ounce jar ) | 12 leaves masa harina flour ( or cornstarch-free flour ) | 3/4 cup maple syrup ( not watery style ) ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon mixed herbs ( such as thyme, rosemary or marjoram ) ( optional ) | garlic powder ( optional ) or chili powder ( optional )
instructions: Cut off as many bones as possible from the turkey sausage. In a 9 x 13 inch dish or cookie sheet that will fit the turkey, pour 2/3 of the sausage into the dish or pan. Top the hole with the turkey pieces, placing them snugly together in a single layer. Pour 1/4 cup of the maple syrup over the whole turkey. Top with 1/4 cup of the harina.

title: Coriander & Green Bean Snack
ingredients: 1 packet frozen green beans | 1 packet rye meal | 1 coriander leaves, chopped
instructions: Cut ends from beans but leave whole until next day. Boil water in a large pan and add frozen beans. Meanwhile, using a fork, stir the rye meal into just 125ml of boiled water until the water runs clear. Stir into the beans. Sprinkle with coriander leaves.

title: Aussie Chestnut Sausage and Spinach Salad
ingredients: 500 g fresh spinach | 3 chestnuts | 1/3 cup dijon mustard | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder | 4 sausages, thai style sliced ( i have used hot kang char siu )
instructions: Wash spinach under cold water, drain and dry with paper towels. Chop the chestnuts roughly. Mix all ingredients together. Serve and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: plain yogurt,walnut,coconut milk,macadamia nut,cilantro leaf,liquid smoke,artichoke heart,cranberry
title: Cocktail
ingredients: 6 ounces macadamia nuts | 1 cup dried cranberries | 1 can coconut milk | 1 package marinated artichoke hearts | 1/4 cup chopped walnuts | 1/2 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 2 tablespoons plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spread macadamia nuts onto a parchment lined baking sheet and toast in the preheated oven until lightly golden, about 10 minutes. Allow nuts to cool. Mix macadamia nuts, cranberries, coconut milk, artichoke hearts, walnuts, cilantro, yogurt, and liquid smoke together in a bowl.

title: Beef With Mustard & Mint Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces beef tenderloin, sliced 1/4-inch thick | 4 tablespoons mustard | 12 ounces veal, sliced in 1/4-inch strips | 1/2 seedless cucumber, sliced into thin sticks | 1 tablespoons chopped of fresh mint
instructions: To make the mustard dressing, in a small bowl, combine the mustard and the beef strips. Dry the beef well on paper towels. Coat the veal with the mustard dressing. Place on a greased grill rack over moderate heat and grill for 8 minutes. Turn the beef strips and grill until the pieces are browned on each side, about 10 minutes more. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, stir the cucumber with the mint leaves. When the meat is finished, remove the beef to a serving platter and sprinkle with the mint.

title: Pepper Mushroom Ragout With Snow Peas
ingredients: 1 lb fresh snow pea, trimmed | 1 1/2 cups sweet pickling salt | 1/4 lb fresh sweet pepper | 2 teaspoons sweet pepper | 3 tablespoons flour | 1/2 cup marsala wine | 1 teaspoon chili oil
instructions: Put all ingredients in a mixing bowl and let stand at room temperature for 20 minutes. Put mixture in an ice cream machine or large jar and process for 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pork loin chop,plum sauce,phyllo pastry,veal cutlet,caster sugar
title: Caramelised Veal Phyllo Tear Wagon Wheels
ingredients: 2 tablespoons caster sugar | 2 tablespoons low-fat veal cutlets, thinly sliced | 180 g plum sauce | 1 1/4 cups phyllo pastry | 3 lean boneless pork loin chops ( i prefer forequarter loin chops )
instructions: Stir sugar and veal in a large non stick frying pan over medium high heat for 1 - 2 minutes or until golden brown. Increase heat if you have an oven fan forced oven. Spread plate over phyllo dough. Lay strips of pork across half of phyllo pastry. Spread sauce over pork evenly. Lay 1 piece of pork on top of each veal strip and lay 1 slice of lemon on top of them. Roll up short sides and join at the join with the ends of the pastry. Repeat process with second short piece of pastry, the remaining veal and pork, lemon and lemon slices and sheets of phyllo. Trim excess pastry from pork. Bake in a moderate oven for 40 - 45 minutes, until pastry is crisp and golden. Serve with steamed vegetables and salad.

Random Ingredients: pistachio,apple,mango,red pepper flake,taco seasoning mix,farmer cheese,olive,chow mein noodle
title: Cottage Cheese and Fruit Nests
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive or 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 package cottage cheese | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 can sliced ripe olives | 1 cup fresh mango, chopped | 1 tablespoon crushed red pepper flakes, more to taste | 2 -3 cups shaved farmer cheese or 2 -3 cups chow mein noodles | 1 small apple, cut into thin wedges
instructions: In a large skillet, preheat the olive or canola oil over medium heat. Add cottage cheese and taco seasoning mix and cook at medium high heat until cottage cheese has melted into a smooth, creamy mixture. Do not burn the cheese. Add olives and mango. Increase the heat to low and cook for 5 - 7 minutes. To serve, place a handful of noodles in each plate. Spoon cottage cheese and fruit mixture over noodles. Garnish with shredded farmer cheese and a pinch of crushed red pepper. Serve as a burrito or appetizer.

title: Portuguese Onion Salad
ingredients: 10 spanish onions ( about 3 pounds ) | 3 tablespoons brandy ( or cognac ) | 3 tablespoons good-quality sour cream | 2 tablespoons kosher salt
instructions: Place a rack in the broiler and heat it until very hot, about 2 minutes. Trim and discard the root ends of the onions and the thick, flat tops of the onions. Slice the onions into 1/8 inch slices. Arrange the slices on a baking sheet. Sprinkle each slice with the brandy and let the flames subside. Broil the onions, 4 to 6 inches from the heat, stirring frequently until they are very dark brown and caramelized on top, 7 to 10 minutes. Let onions cool slightly. Mix sour cream, salt, and remaining hot onions and pour them over the sweetened onions.

title: Salsa for Chips, Chips, Fritters, Salad Dessert
ingredients: 1/2 small green chili pepper | 2 -3 tablespoons fresh chives, snipped into 1/2-inch pieces | 1 tablespoon fresh cilantro, snipped into 1 - 2 pieces
instructions: Blend the chili pepper and chives in a food processor. Add the cilantro and pulse a few times to mix. Store in an airtight container in a cool place up to a month.

Random Ingredients: seasoning salt,beef bouillon cube,cognac,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Sailors' French Fries
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 large beef bouillon cube | 5 dashes seasoning salt | 2 tablespoons cognac
instructions: Heat the oil in a pan to 375°f in the dry fry pan, pour in the bouillon cube, then add the seasoned salt, cognac, and enough water so that it's about halfway up the side of the pan. Cover and cook on medium heat for about 25 minutes, turn the heat off and stir. Let it sit for about ten minutes before serving.

title: Cherries and Coconut Burritos
ingredients: 1/2 cup shredded coconut | 1/4 cup chopped canned cherries | 1/2 teaspoon minced garlic | 10 flour tortillas
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spray a baking sheet with cooking spray. In a bowl, combine the coconut, cherries, garlic and salt and mix, until the cherries are coated. Spread the coconut mixture in a thin layer on a warm tortilla. Fold the tortilla over the mixture and place in the oven, turning once.

title: Alfredo - Portuguese Baked Fish
ingredients: 1 lb fish fillet | 2 cups seasoned dry bread crumbs | 1/4 cup grand marnier ( to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon pepperoncini pepper, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Cut fillet lengthwise into thick pieces and then crosswise into 1/4 inch thick pieces. Place in a well buttered baking dish. In a bowl, combine bread crumbs, grand amarnier, pepperoncini, and vanilla. Pour over fish. Sprinkle top with bread crumbs and bake in a 400° f oven for 15 minutes.

title: New Year's Eve Clam Sauce
ingredients: 1 white mushroom ( dried shiitake or other flavorful mushroom may be used ) | 2 cans chopped clams with juice ( such as mussels, shucked, and littleneck clams. if using the mussels, remove the center clove and discard and discard any shells ) | 2 tablespoons red curry paste ( optional and to taste )
instructions: Place dried mushrooms and cleaned clams in a heavy medium saucepan or dutch oven. Pour clam juice over them, being careful not to dislodge the sand that rises to the top. If using the mussels, place all the above in a bowl with ice water. Cover, and cook over medium heat for 15 minutes. Note, depending on the size of your clams, you may need to add up to 20 more fluid ounces bottled clam juice. Pour into a jar, and refrigerate at least 2 days. Bring clams to a boil, turn once or twice, and remove from heat. Remove from heat, discard any clams with juice, and pour clam mixture through a fine mesh sieve into a clean saucepan. Wipe mushroom clean and trim stems off. Slice, and sprinkle with curry paste. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,tuna water,green peppercorn,ghee,lettuce,potato starch,chive,golden raisin
title: Tuna Patties II
ingredients: 1 can tuna in water, drained well and flaked | 1 tablespoon green peppercorns, chopped | 4 fluid ounces sweet potato starch | 1 tablespoon potato starch | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 1 tablespoon dried chives | 1 teaspoon golden raisin | 1 tablespoon ghee, melted | lettuce, to serve
instructions: Combine tuna, peppercorns, sweet potato starch, potato starch, baking soda, chives and raisins in a bowl. Knead until the mixture forms a smooth dough, turning it out onto lightly floured surface. Shape the dough into 16 large patties, approximately 1 inch in diameter. Heat a non stick frying pan over low heat. Brush the patties with ghee, then fry the patties for around 10 minutes or until golden on both sides. Serve with lettuce.

title: Spicy Vinegar
ingredients: 2 quarts mustard oil | 2 teaspoons chili paste ( or other spicy asian spice )
instructions: Mix the mustard oil with 2 quarts of water and chili paste. Heat to boiling, then cover and simmer for two hours.

title: Creamy Italian Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts | 4 teaspoons mayonnaise | 1/2 cup heavy cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Place chicken in 13x9 baking dish. Cover with mayonnaise, tossing to coat chicken completely. Bake at 375 about 12 to 15 minutes or until cooked through, basting once or twice as needed. Add cream. Heat through.

Random Ingredients: flat porter beer,italian dressing,enchilada mix,green chile pepper,rotini pasta,taco seasoning,green curry paste
title: Creamy Mexican Rotini Pasta
ingredients: 8 ounces rotini pasta | 1 can enchilada mix | 1 can diced green chile peppers | 1 can mild green curry paste | 1 1/2 ounces italian dressing | 1 can flat porter beer | 1 package taco seasoning
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the rotini pasta, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about eight minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Meanwhile, heat the enchilada sauce in a saucepan over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until hot and bubbling, 3 to 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,green chile pepper,sesame seed,lemon juice zest,white wine,icing sugar
title: Chile and Garlic Green Pepper Dip
ingredients: 10 green chile peppers, cut into chunks | 3 green bell peppers, cut into chunks | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 3 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 4 1/2 tablespoons white wine | 1/4 cup icing sugar
instructions: Combine chiles, bell peppers, sesame seeds and lemon juice in a mixing bowl. Stir in wine. Mix until smooth. Chill until mixture is required. Serve with pita chips.

title: Green Chile Tamarind Chayote Soup
ingredients: 12 ounces tamarind juice | 6 ounces chayote, diced into bite size pieces | 1 ounce red wine, like merlot | 1 -2 small chilies, seeded and chopped
instructions: Soak tamarind in luke warm water for a couple of minutes and then push thru cheesecloth to remove the fibers of the fibers. Place into a blender or food processor and whizz on high until smooth. Add chayote and chayote and pulse until chayote is just mixed well. Add wine and chilies and pulse until chayote is well blended. You may need to taste the soup right before serving.

title: Faux Soussailgh (Warm Spinach Rolls)
ingredients: 1 kg fresh spinach | 1 kg fresh spinach ( or 3 lbs frozen chopped spinach, thawed ) | 3 -6 tablespoons white bread flour, depending on size of roll | 150 ml red wine | 300 -400 g dried apricots ( stoned and chopped ) | 3 tablespoons fresh lemon juice ( or to taste )
instructions: Wash and trim the spinach and cook in boiling water for about 5 minutes until wilted. Drain well and squeeze to remove all excess water. Bring the remaining liquid to a boil, and then add the spinach and chopped leaves. Reduce the heat and cook for about 5 - 10 minutes, until the spinach is just tender and the liquid reduced considerably. Drain well and stir in the flour to thicken the liquid. Add the apricots, lemon juice, salt and pepper to taste. Preheat the oven to 200°c. Roll out the pastry on a lightly floured surface and cut into 3cm squares. Place 3cm apart on an oven tray. Top each square with a tablespoon of spinach mixture, making sure the filling does not spill out. Bake in the oven for 10 - 15 minutes, until well risen and well browned. Serve with a simple green salad.

title: Egg and Olive Mini Breads
ingredients: 1/2 package yeast | 3/4 cup warm water | 3 large eggs, beat | 3 1/4 cups cooked chopped ham and cheese blend | 1/2 cup sliced kalamata olives | 1 dozen dinner roll, split | 3/4 teaspoon salt and pepper
instructions: Place the yeast in a mixing bowl and dissolve it in the water. Stir in 3 eggs, cheese, olives, and salt and pepper. Stir in the rest of the ingredients. Beat until smooth and set aside in a warm spot. Place the split rolls on a baking sheet. With lightly greased hands, pat rolls to flatten slightly. Brush tops of rolls with about 1/2 teaspoon each of the remaining olive oil. Sprinkle tops with salt and pepper. Bake in a preheated 400º f oven 40 to 45 minutes, or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: pie shell,pork loin,water chestnut,yellow pepper,baby portabella mushroom,green creme de menthe
title: Easy Microwave Pork Loin Pie
ingredients: 1/2 cup green creme de menthe ( green may be substituted ) | 1 1/2 lbs boneless pork loin ( cut into 1/2 to 1 inch cubes ) | 1 cup water chestnut ( chopped ) | 1 cup yellow pepper ( chopped ) | 1 can pie shells | 1 cup baby portabella mushrooms ( chopped )
instructions: Mix ingredients except mushrooms, cover and microwave on high for 1 minute. Mix in remaining ingredients. Microwave on high for 10 - 12 minutes. Uncover and microwave on high for 10 minutes, or until water is absorbed and sauce is bubbling. Mix all ingredients together in microwave safe bowl, cover, and microwave on 50% power for 7 - 9 minutes or until pork is cooked to desired heat and sauce is bubbly.

Random Ingredients: cardamom powder,basil pesto,corn oil,italian plum tomato,apple cider vinegar,fenugreek seed,guacamole,ham hock
title: Quick and Easy Indian Plum Salsa
ingredients: 1 can italian plum tomatoes | 1/2 cup chinese ham hock, cut into 3-inch pieces ( or turkey ham or turkey bacon, chopped ) | 1/4 cup basil pesto | 2 tablespoons apple cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon ground fenugreek seeds | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom powder | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon guacamole
instructions: Empty plums, tomato, ham hock, pesto and cider vinegar into food processor. With motor running, add fenugreek, cardamom, corn oil and process until well mixed. Transfer mixture to saucepan. Reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 15 to 20 minutes. Stir in guacamole until heated through.

Random Ingredients: croissant,asiago cheese,garlic red chile paste,beef sirloin steak
title: Philly Cheeseburgers With Sirloin
ingredients: 1 boneless beef top sirloin steak, thinly sliced | 1 clove garlic and red chile paste, finely minced | 10 slices croissants | 2 tablespoons shredded asiago cheese
instructions: Cook cheese on a hot griddle, until it melted. Spread beef evenly with cheese, leaving about 1 tablespoon of the mixture in the center. Place croissant slices on top of beef and press together lightly. Place beef on griddle and bake at 450 degrees for 10 minutes, turning once with a spatula or tongs. Let beef rest for 5 minutes and slice thick on the diagonal.

Random Ingredients: sauce,dressing,stove stuffing mix,chili oil,hot chili pepper
title: Sauce-Stove Top Frito® Chili Con Carne with Stove Top Fajitas®
ingredients: 1 package stove top stuffing mix | 2 tablespoons hot chili oil | 1 teaspoon hot chili oil | 2 cans or bottles cola-flavored carbonated beverage fritters | 2 cans or bottles cola-flavored carbonated beverage fritters | 1 jar sliced pickled hot chili peppers, with liquid
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f with a rack in the middle. Line a 9x13x2 inch baking dish with foil. Prepare stuffing according to package directions adding hot chili oil and cola flavoring to coat well. Spoon stuffing onto the foil lined dish. Carefully toss hot peppers with cola beverage fritters and chile peppers to coat well in mixture. Cover dish and bake in preheated oven until hot and bubbly, 20 to 25 minutes. Cut fritters into pieces and serve immediately.

title: Potato Cheese and Yogurt Mousse
ingredients: 3 lbs potatoes, peeled and diced | 3 lbs romano cheese, grated | 3 tablespoons arrowroot | caster sugar | 2 cups plain nonfat yogurt
instructions: Place the diced potato into a pan of boiling, salted water. Bring the water back to the boil, lower the heat, cover and cook for about 10 minutes. Drain, then immediately tip the potatoes into a bowl of cold water that helps to remove any excess moisture. Return the potatoes to the pan, reduce the heat, cover and cook over a low heat for about 20 minutes until the potatoes are cooked. Remove the potatoes from the water with a slotted spoon, reserving the cooking water,. Mash the potatoes until smooth. Add the grated romano cheese to the potato mixture, stir through the arrowroot or milk and then mash until all the ingredients are mixed, then stir in the sugar. Line a square baking tin with a sheet of greaseproof paper which has been non stick. Spoon the mixture into the lined tin, cover and bake in the oven at about 300f/180c for 30 - 35 minutes or until almost set. This cheese will keep in the fridge for a month or so, but at least 3 weeks before that keep in the fridge up to 5 months.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,sharp cheddar cheese,black treacle,lemon juice zest,cream cheese

ingredients: 6 tablespoons cream cheese, at room temperature | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice ( or to taste ) | 1 tablespoon black treacle ( treacle, treacle ) | 8 slices rye bread | 1 ounce sharp cheddar cheese, grated ( or finely grated )
instructions: Whisk together the cream cheese and the lemon juice until smooth. Spread this onto the base of each slice of rye bread. Sprinkle over the cheddar and a sprinkling of dried herbs, then top with other slices of rye bread. Slice into quarters. Serve and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: sunflower seed,rice flour,vegetable oil cooking spray,parsnip,ice cube,vanilla sugar,cardamom seed
title: Caps of Cardamom Parsnips Rice Crisp
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 parsnip, peeled and cut lengthways into 4 even pieces | 4 ice cubes, crushed | 100 g sunflower seeds | 1/4 cup rice flour | 1/2 cup vanilla sugar | 10 cardamom seeds
instructions: Coat a large frypan with the oil and heat on a medium high heat and add the parsnips and sunflower seeds. Spray the pan with veggie spray, then cook for 5 minutes or until the grains are light and golden. Remove the parsnips, add the rice flour, vanilla sugar, cardamom and crushed ice to the pan and stir. Cook for 15 minutes, until sticky and slightly thickened. Remove from the heat.

Random Ingredients: black eyed pea,cumin seed,chervil,amaretti cooky,arugula,chipotle pepper adobo sauce,molasses,penne
title: Spiny Black Bean and Penne Filling for Two
ingredients: 1 lb dried black-eyed peas | 2 cups fresh arugula, chopped | 1/2 cup fresh chervil, chopped | 6 cherrypops chipotle peppers in adobo sauce | 2 tablespoons molasses | 1 tablespoon cumin seed | 8 amaretti cookies | 8 penne or 8 other pastas
instructions: Place dried black eyed peas in large pot and cover with about 2 inches of water. Bring to boil and then slowly reduce heat and simmer uncovered for two hours, or until peas are tender. Meanwhile, to a medium bowl add arugula, chervil, chipotle peppers, molasses, cumin for color and flavor. Taste and adjust seasoning, adding more olive if necessary. After two hours taste and adjust seasoning. If too thick, if too thin, add water. Pasta should be cooked al dente and kept warm. Remove peas from pot and stir into cooked noodles. Place amaretti in a plate and top with 1/4 cup of sauce. Serve immediately with warmed pasta.

title: Greek Gravy
ingredients: 500 ml greek yogurt | 100 ml cognac or 100 ml orange flavored vodka
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well together. Heat in a pan and serve.

Random Ingredients: chestnut,hershey cocoa,beef bouillon powder,gingerroot,grape leaf,vegetable broth,candy sprinkle
title: Grape Leaves and Famous Beef Belly Backs
ingredients: 2 cups mixed chestnuts | 4 ounces good quality hershey's cocoa | 3 cups grape leaves | 1 tablespoon beef bouillon powder | 2 slices fresh gingerroot, peeled | 1 tablespoon instant gingery spices ( `` or '' a little bit of ground sichuan peppercorns ) | 1 1/2 cups vegetable broth, warmed
instructions: Soak the chestnuts in hot water for about 15 - 20 minutes, then remove and set aside to cool. Cut the hearts into quarters, leaving the tips intact. Slice off the lower ribs and place in a bowl or freezer bag using the flat of your finger tips. Drain the chestnut shells and set aside. In a 4 quart pot put in the cocoa, chopped chestnuts, hershey's cocoa, grapes leaves and beef bouillon powder. Stir and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and allow to simmer for about 1 hour and 45 minutes, or until the mixture is reduced by half. Stir in the ginger and gingery spice, which should be dissolved immediately. Add the broth a little at a time, stirring constantly until you have a thick consistency to you like. You want it to be just a little thinner than the paste consistency, but not runny.. It will soften slightly. Fill the jar and wrap and seal. Allow to mature for about 2 weeks, shaking the jar every 2 weeks. This keeps in the refrigerator for up to a year. When ready to use, use for sandwiches, place in a paper bag with small amount of extra virgin olive oil. Allow to sit at room temperature for about 2 weeks, then wipe off and re air before using.

title: Spaghetti Sauce (Appetizer)
ingredients: 16 ounces apricots | 1/2 cup onion salt | 1 tablespoon fresh parsley leaves
instructions: Grind apricots in a coffee grinder or processor to a fine puree. Add onion salt and parsley and mix well. Heat up a saucepan until boiling. Turn down heat and simmer for 5 to 7 minutes without removing the saucepan. Note, you can use store bought thin spaghetti sauce, like spaghetti sauce for dipping.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,pea,garlic salt,pork loin roast,self rising flour,anise seed,garam masala
title: Indian-Pourdized Pork Loin Au Jus
ingredients: 1 whole pork loin roast | 3 cloves garlic, cut into slivers | 1 pinch garam masala | 1 tablespoon anise seeds | 1 tablespoon grated sharp cheddar cheese | 1 teaspoon self-rising flour, or as needed | 3/4 cup frozen peas, thawed
instructions: Place the pork loin roast in a slow cooker. Place the garlic slivers in the slow cooker, and season with garam masala, aniseed, cheddar cheese, and self rising flour. Pour in enough water to cover the roast and pork. Cover, and cook on high until the pork falls apart, 3 to 4 hours. Once the pork is cool enough to handle, remove the pork to a cutting board, and cut thin slices.

Random Ingredients: cumin,dark corn syrup,dark chocolate,granny smith apple,mace,red cabbage,bread
title: Smooth and Colourful Hot Chocolate Tea Slice
ingredients: 1 granny smith apple, peeled ( or 250g grated apple ) | 1/2 tablespoon dark corn syrup | 1 dash ground mace ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon dark cumin, ground ( or 2 tbsp cumin seeds ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons dark corn syrup | 1/2 tablespoon ground mace ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon ground cumin ( or 2 tsp cumin seeds ) | 6 slices bread, crusts removed | 1 red cabbage or 1/2 yellow cabbage, leaves
instructions: First, prepare the tea, put the apple in a blender and blitz until smooth. Add the dark corn syrup, mace, and cumin seeds and blitz again. Spread the mixture in a single layer on a slice of bread, then top with shredded cabbage or other vegetable to make a sandwich. Cover and leave to stand for 10 minutes before removing the slice from the sandwich. Serve immediately.

title: Basil and Radish Margarita
ingredients: 4 radishes, coarsely chopped | 1 1/2 ounces tequila | fresh basil sprig
instructions: In a blender or food processor, pulse or blend radishes until finely chopped. Stir in tequila. Serve immediately.

title: Chinese Tea Oil
ingredients: 3 tea bags | oil ( for frying )
instructions: Pour enough tea into a pan over the heat to cover. Pour enough oil into a deep fryer to reach a depth of 3/4 to 1 inch. Heat oil over moderate heat to 375 degrees f. Using the back of a spoon or a slotted spoon, break the tea bags into the hot oil. Let the tea steep for about 1 minute. With a slotted spoon, lift out tea bags and drain on paper towels. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: broad bean,red chili pepper,cardamom,italian sausage,beef stew meat
title: CSA Swiss Steak Curry With Broad Beans
ingredients: 2 lbs cubed beef stew meat | 1 tablespoon cardamom, powdered ( ancho or cardamom powder ) | 1 package fresh broad beans | 1 dried red chili pepper | 8 mild italian sausages, casings removed
instructions: Combine all ingredients in crockpot. Cook on low for 8 to 10 hours.

title: Veal Cutlets Portuguesa
ingredients: 4 veal cutlets, pounded thin | 1 tablespoon horseradish, grated | 3 tablespoons ruby port or 3 tablespoons other port wine
instructions: Lightly season the velles in the cavities. Rub horseradish on each cutlet. Marinate in port or other flavourful port or other flavourful liquor.

title: Pepperoni Bites
ingredients: 1 package frozen peppersoni | 2 teaspoons liquid smoke flavoring, or more to taste | 1 shallot, finely minced to a glaze
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.

title: Mullehos Yniestos (Stuffed Parsnips)
ingredients: 1/2 lb parsnip | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1/2 teaspoon dark rum ( optional )
instructions: Clean parsnips, peel from stems and remove any dark green bits along the stem. Remove the parsnips from the stem end and cut on the diagonal into 3 inch pieces using a knife. Place the parsnips in plenty of boiling salted water for about 5 minutes to just cook them. Drain well and set aside. Place the salt into a small bowl and add the almond extract. Rub the olive oil into the parsnips, then stuff inside the parsnips by pouring the oil from the bowl into the pot. Cook the parsnips over a moderate heat until tender, about 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove the pan from the heat and transfer in a bowl of cold salted water. Set aside at room temperature about 20 minutes or until cold. Serve with rum.

title: Paste Spray for Mushrooms, Beef or Fish
ingredients: 4 tablespoons agave nectar | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 2 tablespoons ground coriander seeds
instructions: Mix everything together to make your delicious grill mates happy. Enjoy.

title: Italian Spinach With Hot Spinach
ingredients: 1 cup baby spinach | 1/4 cup coarse salt
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f.

title: Cannellini Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans, drained | 1 tablespoon watercress, minced | milk powder
instructions: Blend all together and pour into a large soup bowl or soup jug.

title: Baked Pork and Rice Skillet #RSC
ingredients: 8 pork tenderloin ( about 1 1/2 lbs ) | 2 cans chopped pimientos | 3 cups white long grain rice | 3/4 - 1 cup pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Put pork tenderloins in a 6 quart dish. Mix peppers and pimentos and pour over meat. Sprinkle meat with pepper and cover dish. Bake, covered, 30 - 45 minutes. Uncover and bake about 30 minutes more or until meat is tender.

title: Cabbage with Plums
ingredients: 9 plums, pitted, thinly sliced | 3 tablespoons flour | 2 pinches garam masala | 1 teaspoon ground marjoram | 1/2 head of cabbage, shredded
instructions: Mix together the flour, garam masala, marjoram and cabbage in a bowl, add the plums and mix. Put cabbage on the grill, cut side down, until crisp, about 6 to 8 minutes serve.

title: Lettuce and Bell Pepper Salad
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce, cleaned | 1 head bell pepper, cleaned
instructions: Wash, dry and tear all ingredients into the large bowl of a salad dressing machine. Pour dressing over salad. Cover and store in the refrigerator for 2 days or longer.

title: Russian Muffins
ingredients: 1 lb cabbage, finely shredded | 1 1/2 cups applesauce | 2 packages dry yeast | 1/4 cup tomato paste
instructions: Combine cabbage and applesauce in medium bowl with yeast. Allow to sit in a warm place for 3 hours, or until the mixture is bubbly. Stir in tomato paste. Allow to ferment in the refrigerator for 12 hours before using.

Random Ingredients: green olive,tomato,yeast,lemon juice zest,white bread,pecan,lettuce leaf
title: Greek Olives and Tomatoes on Toast
ingredients: 1 cup tomatoes ( chopped fresh or canned ) | 1 cup green olives ( pitted, cut in half lengthwise ) | 1 tablespoon lemon juice ( fresh is best ) | 1 1/4 teaspoons yeast | 1/4 cup chopped pecans | 12 lettuce leaves, preferably lettuce with stems, torn into pieces | 1/2 cup finely shredded cos lettuce leaf, preferably romaine | 1/4 cup finely diced tomato, preferably greek tomato
instructions: Prepare grill or broiler. Place tomatoes and olives on greased grill or broiler pan. Sprinkle with lemon juice. Toast until lightly browned. Sprinkle with nutmeg and let cool to room temperature before proceeding to next step. Stir together yeast, 3 cup water, and 1 tsp sugar. Allow to proof until foamy. Slowly add yeast mixture. Stir until dissolved. Spread mixture evenly onto sliced toast. Toast will rise and collapse if it hits your bread. Toast will become stale. Remove from heat. Drizzle with some of tomato glaze. Top with remaining bread slices. Sprinkle with crumbled lettuce on top. Toast should have a medium brown color and may be served with tomato and lettuce dressing. Add a little extra bread juice or olive oil if desired if desired.

title: Glogi (Yogurt Sauce)
ingredients: 2 cups yogurt | 2 yellow bell peppers, seeded and diced | 2 tablespoons port wine
instructions: In a saucepan mix yogurt, pepper, red wine and port. Cook over medium heat for 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: green pea,crescent dinner,apricot brandy,kaffir lime leaf,canola oil,tuna

instructions: Mix all ingredients except sesame seeds and roll up with the sesame seeds. Remove sesame seeds from sesame seeds before frying them. Place the sesame seeds in a bowl and pour hot oil onto a few before popping them into cold water to cover.

title: Devil's Food
ingredients: 1 ounce clam juice | 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | cooking spray
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl. Cover and marinate 1 hour in the refrigerator. Turn 1 - 2 times or more. To cook chilled chocloaf, cover and heat in a microwave on high for 1 - 2 minutes or until warm throughout. Serve on a platter with lettuce leaves.

title: Easy Chocolate  (Andile!) Mousse
ingredients: 1 tablespoon instant unflavored gelatin | 1 cup miniature semisweet chocolate chip | 1 cup brewed tea ( i use coffee )
instructions: Wet your fingers with cold water. Bring your water to a boil and mix the gelatin in it. When the water is hot and starts to melt stir in the chocolate chips until completely melted. Remove from heat and stir till it has totally mixed into the chocolate. Pour into an 8 inch spring form pan and refrigerate overnight. Cut into squares while the mousse is cooling.

title: Quick and Easy Yunnan Style Buns
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon green chili paste | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pods | 4 kaiser rolls
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl and mix well. Place 2 tablespoons of the mixture on the center of each bun and wrap around the bun using the seams. Heat in a non stick skillet over medium heat until it begins to smoke. Serve with jasmine green chutney.

title: Lime Sombrero Sauce
ingredients: 3 limes, juice and zest of | 1/2 cup hot sauce
instructions: Squeeze lime juice over all. Add hot sauce to the mixture right before serving.

title: Smoked Brussels Sprouts with Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs brussels sprouts | 3/4 lb smoked salami, finely chopped | 1/4 cup golden raisin | 2 tablespoons dates, pitted and finely chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons turmeric | 1 cup sour cream | 2 cups breadcrumbs | brussels sprouts, stems trimmed and lightly oiled
instructions: Heat a large heavy wok or frying pan at high heat. Remove the leaves from the sprouts and then cut the leaves into rounds about 1/2 inch thick. Remove and discard the stems and then cut out and discard the remaining leaves and set aside. In the same frying pan on high heat, add the brussels sprouts and sauté until the brussels sprouts are tender crisp and beginning to brown, about 3 minutes. Add the salami and sauté until the pieces are beginning to curl slightly, about 2 minutes. Add the raisins and dates and sauté briefly, about another minute or two. Add the turmeric and sour cream and cook over medium heat until the brussels sprouts are well coated with the curry sauce. Turn off the heat. Preheat the broiler. Place a large shallow oven proof dish on a baking dish large enough to accommodate all the brussels sprouts and the brussels sprouts. Spread the brussels sprouts with the curry and then arrange the brussels sprouts in a decorative pattern and top with the brussels sprouts. Dust with bread crumbs and broil until the brussels sprouts are hot and bubbling.

Random Ingredients: red currant jelly,vegetarian bean,beef steak,dijon mustard,caper,broth
title: Medallions of Beef with Beans
ingredients: 750 g beef steaks, trimmed of fat | 75 g vegetarian refried beans | 75 g red currant jelly | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 85 g drained capers | 3 -4 tablespoons broth
instructions: Heat a large frying pan and cook the steaks very quickly for 10 minutes or until the desired doneness. Transfer to a plate, cover and leave to stand for 5 minutes. In a separate pan heat the beans over a medium heat, stirring constantly in a low heat. Stir in the jelly and mustard. Return the steak to the pan and add the capers and the broth. Bring to the boil and simmer for about 10 minutes or until the beans are heated.

Random Ingredients: white button mushroom,dark soy sauce,olive oil,pearl barley
title: Barley Mushrooms and Fresh Pearl Barley (Chawan Mushi)
ingredients: 1 ounce pearl barley, rinsed | 3 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 3 tablespoons olive oil | 1/2 lb white button mushrooms, trimmed
instructions: Bring medium size saucepan of salted water to boil. Add barley and cook, uncovered, over moderately high heat 8 minutes or until just tender. Drain. Of soy sauce and mushroom in small skillet over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until just tender, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: applesauce,cream tartar,berry,cream mushroom soup,ricotta cheese,chocolate ice cream,phyllo pastry
title: Individual Phyllo Parfait (No-Bake, No-Shake) Parfait
ingredients: 1 container fat free cream of mushroom soup | 1 carton low-fat ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup low-fat sour cream or 1/2 cup light sour cream | 1/4 cup applesauce | 1/8 teaspoon cream of tartar | 2 tablespoons unsweetened plain chocolate ice cream or 2 tablespoons butter | 1 cup berries, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Combine all ingredients in a bowl and stir to blend with a wire whisk until well incorporated. Pour 1/4 cup soup mixture onto a large jellyroll pan or cookie sheet and spread evenly. Bake until heated through and bubbly, about 15 minutes. Allow to cool. Spread 1 tablespoon filling on one side of phyllo pastry, then spread to edges with a rubber spatula if desired. Top with 5 more phyllo sheets and brush lightly with melted butter. Sprinkle remaining 1 tablespoon soup mixture on top of phyllo layers. Fold phyllo sheets in half. Then cut each half into four diagonal slices, then cut crosswise into four triangles. Cut diagonally into six squares, or six triangles on a lightly floured board. Serve immediately.

title: Kielbasa and Mandarin Orange Salad
ingredients: 1 package kielbasa, cut into 1-in. slices | 2 packages yellow wheat cereal | 1/2 cup buttermilk or 1/2 cup malt syrup | 1/4 cup palm sugar | 1 can mandarin oranges, drained | 1 container low-fat plain yogurt
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine cereal, buttermilk.

title: Curry Sauce
ingredients: 1 can coconut cream | 1 teaspoon mustard powder
instructions: Mix together and serve over steamed rice.

Random Ingredients: grain rice,mango chutney,phyllo dough,cocoa,guacamole,parsnip,wild mushroom,thai basil
title: Wild Mushroom Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 1/2 lb wild mushroom, stems removed | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsnips | 1/3 cup chopped fresh mango chutney ( or chutney of your choice ) | 1 tablespoon dried guacamole ( or salsa of your choice ) | 1 tablespoon dried thai basil ( or basil of your choice ) | 2 sheets phyllo dough | 1/4 cup sweet mango chutney ( to drizzle on top before baking ) | 2 -3 tablespoons cocoa | 1 tablespoon fresh parsley or 1 tablespoon cilantro, chopped
instructions: Cut mushrooms in half if large, then set aside. Using a small spoon, scrape out the mushrooms from the stems but leave them whole if you wish. Set the stems aside. Rinse any remaining stems and chop the stems finely. Set aside. Combine the chutney, guacamole and basil if using. Lay a sheet of phyllo dough in front of you on your work surface with 1 sheet of phyllo in the middle of the sheet and 1cm from the sides. If using a sheet with a thicker side, use your fingers to gently fold it in half. Fold the phyllo in half again, then remove the sheet on top of the previous one and lightly brush with oil, then lightly brush with more olive oil. Use your fingers to lightly press the phyllo down and over the sheets with the palms of your hands to compact them tightly. Once you have a cohesive rectangle, place the mushroom mixture on top of the phyllo. Fold the edge of the phyllo over the mushroom mixture, then carefully wrap it in the phyllo like a swiss roll, making sure not to break it completely. Then use your hands to lightly press the wrap down so it is compact. Repeat with the remaining sheets of sheets. To prepare your topping, mix together the sweet mango chutney, cocoa and parsley. To freeze, place a small piece of parchment paper between layers of parchment paper and slice off a corner to prevent sticking. To assemble, place the tray in fridge and bake in oven at 180c for 20 - 30 minutes or until crispy.

title: Quick & Easy Shitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 -6 shiitake mushrooms, cleaned | 1/2 cup breadcrumbs | 3 teaspoons chili powder
instructions: Wash and dry shitake mushrooms. Preheat oven to 350°f. Place mushrooms in an ovenproof dish. Mix in bread crumbs. Sprinkle chili powder on each mushroom, and cover mushroom with bread crumbs. Place in preheated oven for 10 - 15 minutes, or until browned. Serve hot.

title: Cheats Nacho Dip
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 1/2 ounces tequila | 1/4 - 1/2 ounce taco sauce | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | 1/8 teaspoon dried dill
instructions: Combine all ingredients except dill in a large bowl. Chill mixture for at least 1/2 hour before serving. Serve chilled with tortilla chips.

title: Naked Vegetable Noodle Bake
ingredients: 2 ounces egg noodles, cooked and drained according to package directions | 1/2 teaspoon herbes de provence ( or herbes de provence ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup cheddar cheese, shredded ( depending on how smoky you want your dish )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degree f. Butter a 9x13 inch baking dish with the crumbled cheese. Combine cooked noodles, herbes de provence and cheese and spread evenly in the baking dish.. Bake 20 minutes or until heated through. Sprinkle with additional cheese of your choice.

title: Tahini and Yoghurt Balls - Instant Breakfast & Lunch
ingredients: 400 g raw milk tahini ( or cream sherry ) | 1 teaspoon baking soda or 1 teaspoon instant yeast | 200 g caster sugar ( fine sugar, to taste. i usually measure this and sprinkle it off ) | ice ( optional ) | 2 -4 cups crushed ice ( optional for the freezer )
instructions: Put everything together into a pan over a medium heat. Stir constantly until you get a silky soft dough, but not sticky. It may take a little practice but keep beating. Put a tablespoon or two of the dough in the freezer to speed up the process. Put the ice in a bowl or the ramekin tray and beat lightly. When the dough is almost frozen, take it out of the ramekin tray and knead it a few times. The dough may be quite dry but you will get a firm dough that you can roll out as well, i prefer to do this with my hands. Return it to the freezer. When frozen, put it directly to the freezer and leave to soften for about 3 - 4 hours stirring every so often. Then, transfer the chilled dough to a tray and defrost. It will be easier to handle. If you do this, let it set out overnight in the fridge. At the end of the third hour, when the dough has risen again, take it out and shape into balls around 15cm in diamater. Roll the balls until smooth about 20cm across, and the thickness of your thumb. This will depend on the thickness and if you place them on a non stick pan you will have to flatten them down a little or they will open up. The tahini should be firm, not just a little, but just flat. Roll them again in the ice crystals to give them a slightly grainy texture, and then roll them in the ice crystals. Allow them to cool slightly before serving if they have hardened too long. If you use tahini, be sure to use only plain yoghurt. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: sugar,chocolate,catsup,yellow squash,banana liqueur,pork chop,broiler fryer chicken

instructions: Score the outside of the chicken and prick with a fork, then rub each piece with catsup and sugar. Place chicken in a roasting pan. Add squash, bananas, and chocolate and pour the sauce over all, placing the bowl over the chicken. Sprinkle top with chocolate if using.

title: Black Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 250 g raspberries vinegar | 200 ml coconut milk | 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed | 1 pinch salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Combine the coriander powder and vinegar in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: beef gravy,blue cheese,rosemary leaf,rotini pasta,yoghurt,cumin seed
title: Cheesy Baked Rotini Risotto With A Kick
ingredients: 300 g rotini pasta, uncooked | 500 g blue cheese | 2 cups beef gravy | 1/2 cup low-fat yoghurt | 2 tablespoons cumin seeds | 2 tablespoons fresh rosemary leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c/180c/gas cook the meat and cheese in a pan until the meat, cheeses are all melted. Season. Add meat and cheese to rotini and cook for a few minutes. Add the yoghurt to the pan until incorporated. Toss well. Place into a casserole dish and add cumin seeds to the mix. Sprinkle over rosemary leaves. Bake in the oven for 25 minutes. Serve with white or brown bread.

title: Stem-Filled Yellow Bell Peppers
ingredients: 1/3 cup bottled sweet sherry | 2 large yellow bell peppers
instructions: Place the sherry in a small bowl, and pour the sherry into a large microwave safe bowl over the sherry. Cover and microwave on high power for 15 - 16 minutes. When a knife comes out clear, the peppers are ready. Remove the pepper from the microwave, and using tongs gently remove the peel and white membrane from the peppers. Slice peppers into 1/2 3/4 inch wide strips, keeping the remaining slices intact. Arrange the peppers in a warm serving bowl, cover and set aside for 15 - 20 minutes, turning peppers halfway through. Transfer the peppers to serving plates, and serve.

Random Ingredients: orange,chinese black mushroom,tamari soy sauce,blueberry,rutabaga,pearl barley
title: Rutabaga Berry & Garlic Soup With Nuts
ingredients: 1 lb rutabaga, peeled and diced | 1 head chinese black mushrooms, cleaned and sliced ( or brown fresh mushrooms, soaked 15 minutes for fresh mushrooms ) | 1 cup red boiling pearl barley | 1 large orange, juice of ( or 2 smaller oranges ) | 1/2 cup tamari soy sauce | 1/3 cup blueberries

title: Beef Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 8 fresh chanterelle mushrooms | 1/2 pound beef tenderloin, trimmed | 1 pound peeled and deveined shrimp
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Wipe out inside of the mushrooms with a damp kitchen towel. Place the mushroom caps on a clean work surface with a cut edge over the mushroom stems. Place a shrimp inside each mushroom and stuff the shrimp with the shrimp, leaving about 2 tablespoons of stuffing inside each mushroom. Place the mushroom caps onto a baking sheet, and sprinkle with reserved stuffing. Use scissors or sharp knife to slice the mushrooms in half after removing the papery membrane and all the white matter in the center. Bake in the preheated oven until very tender, about 1 hour.

title: Hamburger-Smoked Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 lb lean beef tenderloin, cut into 8 equal-size slices ( we cut ours in half ) | 2 tablespoons lard
instructions: In a small saucepan of boiling water, cook tenderloins until almost tender, about 1 1/2 minutes per side. Meanwhile, in an additional saucepan, melt lard over medium low heat, stirring frequently, until melted. Add cooked tenderloins to warmed lard.

title: Swiss Noodle Bake
ingredients: 500 g swiss cheese | 250 g channa dal | 1/2 cup chili sauce
instructions: Cut swiss cheese into cubes and place on a baking tray lined with aluminium foil. Cover with channa dal and pour chilli sauce over the cheese. Bake in a moderate oven for about 20 mins or until swiss cheese is melted and serve.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast fillet,lebanese cucumber,hot chili pepper,mexican chili powder,shrimp,bay leaf,brown gravy mix
title: Mexican Coconut Chicken
ingredients: 1 packet prepared brown gravy mix | 1 packet dried shrimp, rinsed and drained | 1/4 cup tasty's red hot chili pepper, seeded and finely chopped | 2 bay leaves | 1/2 tablespoon dry mexican chili powder | 1 medium lebanese cucumber, peeled and finely sliced | 4 chicken breast fillets, skin removed
instructions: Combine brown gravy mix, rinsed shrimp, chilies, bay leaves, and chile powder in a bowl. Stir in the sliced cucumber and chicken breast until coated with the mixture. Arrange the mixture into a baking dish and bake in a moderately slow oven for about an hour or until chicken is cooked through and vegetables are tender.

title: Lamb in Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb leg of lamb | 1 tablespoon mccormick's montreal brand steak spice | 24 cherry tomatoes | 24 -24 plums tomatoes ( cherry tomatoes have a distinct flavor )
instructions: Trim any excess fat from lamb and cut meat into 1 1/2 inch chunks. Sprinkle lamb with steak spice and refrigerate at least an hour and up to 24 hours, turning lamb occasionally to ensure it does not stick. If it seems to be drying out, preheat oven to place lamb, cherry tomato halves and plum tomato halves cut side up in a roasting pan. Pour remaining marinade over all and roast at 300 degrees for 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until meat is tender. Remove lamb from oven and serve. Variation, add 1 tablespoon of seasoning per serving.

Random Ingredients: rosemary sprig,chinese cabbage,nutmeg,mint leaf,marjoram,range egg,egg white
title: Cousin Pete's French Toast With Chinese Cabbage and Mint
ingredients: 2 free range eggs | 4 egg whites | 1 pinch nutmeg, freshly grated | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme or 1 tablespoon dried marjoram | 1 rosemary sprig, chopped | 5 chinese cabbage, shredded | mint leaf, to garnish
instructions: Lightly fry the eggs in a shallow frying pan. While the eggs are cooking, beat all the ingredients together in a bowl. Dip the bratwursts in egg mixture and fry until golden brown. Garnish with mint leaves and/or sprigs and serve hot.

title: Akoori Style Black Bean Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf bread | 1 leek | 250 g arugula | 250 g black beans | 1 bunch coriander
instructions: Slice the bread into small pieces and slice the leek thinly. Roughly boil the black beans and coriander. Slice the beans into thick slices as well. Heat the oven to 180°c. Line 4 x 6 inch flat ceramic baking dishes with foil. Place all of the bread ingredients in the baking dish. Put the dish in the oven. Allow to cool for 5 minutes, then turn out onto a serving platter with bread. Serve with lemon wedges.

title: Balsamic Apples
ingredients: 5 tart apples | 10 tablespoons balsamic vinegar
instructions: Wash apples and place in large bowl. Add balsamic vinegar. Toss apples to coat. Let sit 8 hours or overnight until apples are very soft.

title: Homemade Phyllo Wraps
ingredients: 2 serrano chilies, chopped | 1 lb ground veal | 1 box frozen phyllo pastry, thawed according to package directions
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. In a deep 12 inch heavy skillet, saute serrano peppers over medium heat until just tender, about 5 minutes. Add ground veal and cook 5 minutes. Add 1 cup of water. Cover and cook over medium heat until tender, about 10 minutes. While meat mixture simmers, place thawed phyllo pastry on work surface and lightly brush with melted butter. Working with 1 sheet at a time, spread 2 tablespoons meat mixture evenly along phyllo. Fold pastry over filling, pressing down gently. Place about 1 tablespoon of stuffing mixture about 1/4 inch from sides of dough. Starting at one end, roll up tightly, making sure the seam is tight. Repeat with 2 phyllo sheets for all 6 rolls. Place on lightly buttered cookie sheet seam side down. Brush with melted butter. Bake until phyllo filling is golden brown and phyllo is crisp, about 25 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Spanish Roasted Shanks
ingredients: 1 beef shank, trimmed | 1 jar pimento peppers, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Wrap the shanks in aluminum foil. In a small baking dish with a lid, spread the pimento peppers. Place the aluminum foil wrapped shanks onto the top. Bake in preheated oven 90 minutes, or until tender. Serve with salsa.

title: Tender Noodles
ingredients: 8 medium noodles | oil | 1/4 cup barbecue sauce ( texas pete red ) | 1/4 cup brown sugar | 1/4 cup soy sauce | assorted seasoning, for seasoning
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add noodles and cook according to package directions. While noodles are cooking, combine barbecue sauce, brown sugar, soy sauce and seasoning. Drain noodles and serve on large plate. Serve with barbecue sauce marinade.

Random Ingredients: egg noodle,chunk tuna,cumin seed,asiago cheese,banana,heavy cream
title: Tangy Kugel
ingredients: 1 can chunk tuna, drained | 3 bananas | 3 tablespoons heavy cream | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin seeds | 1 package egg noodles | 4 ounces grated asiago cheese
instructions: Preheat an oven to 400 degrees f. Spread the tuna on a plate, and carefully remove the shell from the can with a spoon. Scoop the tuna out into a small bowl. Slice three of the bananas into long, thin strips, and place over a small bowl of water. Drizzle with a small amount of olive oil, and then sprinkle liberally with cumin seeds. Set aside. Boil a large pot of lightly salted water. Turn off heat on the tuna until just warm, about half way through cooking. Drain the tuna, and set aside while you prepare the banana mixture. Cut the bananas in half lengthwise, and then, if you like, slice them crosswise. Fill a bowl with hot water until it just begins to stand up. Then stir in the cream, egg noodles, and asiago. Drain the tuna thoroughly, and return to the bowl. Add the cooked tuna mixture, and stir until well combined. Transfer to a baking dish, and top with the reserved banana mixture. Sprinkle additional grated cheese over the top, and bake in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until the bottom is golden brown.

Random Ingredients: pork,parmigiano reggiano cheese,wasabi paste,rice wine,hamburger,coriander seed,graham cracker crumb
title: Wasabi Meatballs & Rice Con Carne
ingredients: 3 lbs ground pork | 1/2 lb hamburger | 4 ounces parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/2 teaspoon wasabi paste | 1/2 teaspoon coriander seed | 6 graham cracker crumbs | 6 tablespoons rice wine or 6 tablespoons sake
instructions: Place all ingredients into a large bowl. Knead lightly. Roll into balls by rolling a toothpick in each and placing in the bowl with cold water. Keep in fridge until serving time. Preheat the oven to 500 degrees fahrenheit. Place a tray inside a larger pan. Bake for about 20 minutes. Serve, cut into smaller bites and drizzle with extra yummy wasabi sauce.

title: Lamb Stacks
ingredients: 500 g ground lamb ( nz lamb is best to use nz lamb if you can't find it ) | 2 tablespoons pumpkin pie spice | 125 g feta cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c/fan 180c/gas rub half the lamb onto the chopping board. Fold in the rest of the lamb and season with salt and pepper, stir to combine. Roll the lamb up into the palm of your hand and tie with kitchen string. Shape into 3cm rounds and place on an oven tray. Brush with remaining oil and sprinkle with the pumpkin spice. Bake for 20 mins or until browned and cooked through.

title: Veal Apple Fritters
ingredients: 1/2 pound veal, cut into bite-size pieces | 1 tablespoon margarine | 2 teaspoons all-purpose flour | 3/4 cup apple juice | 1/2 package sliced walnut halves | 1 teaspoon hot sauce
instructions: Cook and stir veal in margarine in large skillet over medium high heat until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Stir flour into veal mixture 1/2 cup at a time, stirring continuously. Pour apple juice over veal.

Random Ingredients: white wine,basil leaf,cabbage,green pepper,pasta,dark chocolate,spearmint,corn syrup
title: Wanda's Spicy Christmas Pasta &  Speculoos
ingredients: 400 g pasta ( stars or penne are best ) | 3 green peppers, sliced | 300 g cabbage ( small bits ) | 1/2 cup white wine | 2 tablespoons corn syrup | 2 tablespoons dark chocolate, roughly chopped | 1/2 cup fresh basil leaf, roughly chopped | 12 slices spearmint
instructions: Cook your pasta of choice according to the package's instructions. While pasta is cooking, heat a small pan and use a little cooking oil to crisp the green peppers. Once pasta is ready, add the green peppers and cabbage. Fry for 5 minutes, stirring to make sure everything is coated in oil. Stir frequently. Add wine and simmer until the vegetables are almost cooked through but still crunchy. Drain pasta and vegetables, return to the pan. Mix together the corn syrup and chocolate. Spoon into bowls and sprinkle with basil and spearmint leaves.

title: Tarragon Chocolate Balls
ingredients: 3 pounds bittersweet chocolate | 1 bunch fresh tarragon, leaves picked
instructions: Wash and chop the chocolate. Place in a large glass or metal bowl. Add the tarragon leaves, and stir until well mixed. Chill until easy to handle. Roll the chilled chocolate mixture into 1 1/4 inch balls, and roll in coarse sugar balls. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: chinese cabbage,vanilla ice cream,ice cream,red kidney bean,thai red curry paste
title: Thai Red Curry Soup
ingredients: 2 thai red curry paste | 1 can red kidney beans | 4 cups chinese cabbage, cut into 1 inch pieces | 2 liters vanilla ice cream ( chilled ) | 1 litre icelandic ice cream ( chilled ) | ice cream, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Pour thai red curry paste into a large pot with 6 cups of fresh water. Simmer until curry is fragrant and reduced to about 1/3 of the original quantity, approximately 10 minutes. Add red kidney beans, cabbage, and ice cream. Cover and simmer for about 20 minutes, until cabbage is tender and liquid has slightly reduced and soup is smooth.

title: Taste of Home Thyme Jelly
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh thyme ( about 12 leaves ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Rinse thyme leaves. Add 1 teaspoon of vanilla essence to 1 cup boiling water. Add 2/3 of the cleaned thyme leaves to the hot water. Bring to a boil. Simmer for 30 - 45 minutes. Drain and keep 2/3 of this liquid for jelly. You can use this liquid as a jam for the future jelly. The rest of the liquid can be used as a water bath for the last few days of jelly if you like. Note, the amount of thyme leaves can be changed depending on the taste of the jelly you use and the amount of your favorite dry ingredient. The amount of lavender leaves can be substituted. To remove excess lavender, rinse with cold water. The lavender is mixed with a couple of tablespoons of water and the lavender can be replaced with a teaspoon of lavender essence. This is optional and does not add anything to the flavor.

Random Ingredients: iceberg lettuce,halibut,dark soy sauce,vinegar,white wine vinegar,buttermilk,beef chuck steak,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Filipino Beef Salad
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef chuck steak, cut into 2-inch by 1-inch slices | iceberg lettuce, torn into bite sized pieces ( one large fist or two smaller handfulls, the other two smaller handfulls will also work ) | vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 teaspoons white wine vinegar | 1/4 cup buttermilk | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 -2 teaspoon vinegar | cooked pasta slices or cooked halibut, torn into bite sized pieces
instructions: Place steak in a medium saucepan. Bring water to a boil over medium high heat. Add meat and cook, uncovered, until no longer pink, about 10 minutes. Drain, reserving marinade. Cut steak into 2 thin slices. Place lettuce in a large bowl. Drain marinade. Add meat, vinegar, buttermilk and soy sauce. Toss.

title: Black Beans  With Chilli Sour Cream
ingredients: 16 ounces low-fat yoghurt | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 1/2 tablespoon dry mustard | 1/2 teaspoon black beans, rinsed | 1 small poblano pepper, deseeded and finely chopped
instructions: Combine ingredients in a bowl, cover, and refrigerate overnight. Bring to room temperature before serving.

Random Ingredients: molasses,lemon peel,vegetable oil cooking spray,fennel seed
title: Lemons in Syrup
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons cooking spray | 1 tablespoon molasses | 1 1/2 tablespoons fennel seeds | 1/2 teaspoon freshly grated lemon peel
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Combine first 5 ingredients in a heavy large microwave safe bowl. Microwave on high power on high power for 1 minute or until liqueur is almost evaporated and mixture is foamy, stirring twice. Stir mixture again. Repeat steps 5 - 6 until emmons are thoroughly coated with oil. Dip each emmonskin in syrup, turning them to coat them. Place on a rimmed baking sheet. Bake 10 - 12 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Green Onion, Basil  Grilled Sauce
ingredients: 3 tablespoons finely chopped green onions | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh basil leaf | 1 serrano pepper, seeded, ribs removed, minced
instructions: In a small bowl, combine remaining ingredients.

title: Easy Tasty Salsa
ingredients: 1/2 cup grape juice ( or you can use apple cider ) | 1/2 cup thick & chunky salsa | 250 g finely chopped red capsicums
instructions: Toss together in a jar with the grape juice or cider. Chill overnight to allow flavours to develop. Serve with your favourite chips.

title: Easy Mexican Quinoa
ingredients: 1 cup baking potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks | 1 can guacamole | 1 can bay leaves | 1 1/2 cups quinoa, rinsed
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. In a medium saucepan, cover quinoa with water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes or until quinoa is tender. Drain, reserving 1 cup of cooking liquid. In a medium bowl, mix baking potato chunks with guacamole and bay leaves. Bring 1 1/2 cup reserved cooking liquid to a boil. Stir half way into quinoa with reserved potato water. Pour into a 2 quart baking dish and top with quinoa mixture. Bake in the preheated oven 10 to 15 minutes, or until bubbly.

Random Ingredients: pine nut,red snapper,garam masala,orange juice concentrate,champagne,english muffin
title: Sydney Fish and Macadamia English Muffin
ingredients: 1/4 cup orange juice concentrate, thawed | 2 - 2 1/2 lbs red snapper, cut into bite sized pieces and skinned ( about 3 ) | 1/3 cup champagne or 1/3 cup sparkling wine | 2 teaspoons garam masala | 6 slices english muffins, toasted and split | 1/4 cup toasted pine nuts, chopped
instructions: Preheat broiler. Add fish and juice to a blender and puree. Stir in wine and paralamala. Spoon fish and marinade into a small casserole. Spoon topping evenly over fish. Broil until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork or a skewer, 10 to 12 minutes, basting occasionally. Serve with toasted english muffins and pine nuts.

Random Ingredients: horseradish,cream cheese,cheese,white bean,plum tomato,cider vinegar,vanilla essence
title: Warm White Bean Dip
ingredients: 400 g white beans ( white kidney beans preferred ) | 1 can plum tomatoes | 250 g cream cheese | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 teaspoon horseradish | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon grated cheese
instructions: Place all ingredients in a small bowl and mix well. Serve with sliced bread.

title: Oriental Cabbage Revelation
ingredients: 1/2 chinese cabbage, with some of the outer leaves removed | 3 tablespoons oregano leaves
instructions: Remove stems from cabbage and wash lightly.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,cashew,chocolate chip,lemon juice zest
title: Cashew Crunch
ingredients: 1 cup salted cashews | 1 envelope taco seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon lemon juice, freshly squeezed, from 1-2 lemons | 5 ounces bittersweet chocolate chips, melted
instructions: In a small saucepan on low heat, toast cashews until golden brown, stirring often. Transfer to a food processor or large bowl and add taco seasoning mix, lemon juice and chocolate chips. Process until smooth.. Transfer to bowl and store in refrigerator until needed.

title: Lemon Grass and Tomato Gravy for Fish, Seafood Etail, Etail
ingredients: 12 fresh basil, stems trimmed | 1 stalk fresh lemongrass, trimmed, smashed | 2 tablespoons cognac or 2 tablespoons brandy | 5 cups ice water | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage leaves | 1 cup mascarpone cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f rub the basil with the lemon grass or trim away any tough leaves. Place in a roasting pan. Add cognac and toss over high heat. Roast for 4 minutes. Add the ice water and sage and stir. Cover and roast for 7 minutes. Remove from the oven and stir in the cheese. Return to the oven until the cheese is melted and serve.

title: Pine Nuts
ingredients: 2 cups shredded mexican blend cheese, divided | 1/2 cup cornflour | 2 tablespoons pine nuts, toasted | 1 package frozen miniature marshmallows
instructions: Cook 1 cup cheese in a small saucepan. Stir in cornflour, cooking until sauce is smooth. Remove from heat and set aside. Stir remaining cheese and nuts in a skillet over medium heat until melted. Stir in marshmallows.

title: Easy, Healthy Nachos
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sunflower seeds | 1 hoagie roll | 1 can spaghetti sauce
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f. Roll the hoagie roll in the can of spaghetti sauce. Spread sunflower seeds on the hoagie roll. Place nachos onto the heated oven tray. Cook for about 5 - 8 minutes.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf italian parsley,ginger root,pecan,lemon wedge
title: Lemon Parsley Pecans
ingredients: 1 pound pecans, finely chopped | 1 head flat-leaf italian parsley ( chopped ) | 1 1/2 cups fresh lemon juice | 1 fresh ginger root, peeled and minced
instructions: Place the pecans into a large pot and cover with water. Bring to a simmer over medium high heat. Cover and reduce heat to low. Simmer until toasted, 5 to 7 minutes. Drain and place in a bowl. Place the parsley through the grater twice. Remove parsley from heat and stir in the lemon juice and garlic. Cover and let stand 10 minutes. Stir in the pecans until evenly coated. Let stand at least 5 hours in a cool dry place before serving, giving the parsley a quick stir after a day if desired.

title: German Relish (Schweizerblend)
ingredients: 200 g caraway seeds | 200 g red capsicums ( or yellow bell pepper ) | 300 ml vinegar, red | 1 teaspoon caraway seed
instructions: Grind the caraway seeds and capsicum coarsely in a spice grinder.

title: Swedish Pineapple in Spices
ingredients: 1 can pineapple chunks ( packed in juice ) | 1 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Empty can of pineapple into pan over medium heat.

title: Gluten Free Nori
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons gluten free soy sauce | 2 teaspoons gluten, powder | 1 teaspoon truffle oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons ketchup | 1 tablespoon grand marnier | 10 ounces corkscrew macaroni | 3 sheets nori, torn in half, toasted
instructions: Mix the soy sauce, truffle oil, honey and grand marnier in a bowl and set aside. Boil the macaroni according to the package directions. Drain. Mix the macaroni into the dressing and serve.

Random Ingredients: green enchilada sauce,cannellini bean,oregano leaf,corn oil,honey mustard,sausage,paprika
title: Sausage Chili Beans
ingredients: 1 lb brown ground sausage | 12 ounces cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can mild green enchilada sauce | 1 teaspoon smoked paprika | 1 tablespoon honey mustard | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | corn oil
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium high heat. Add the ground sausage and cook until no longer pink. Drain and set sausage aside. Drain and rinse the beans. In the same skillet using the drippings, combine the enchilada sauce with the cooked sausage and cook until the sauce is smooth and bubbly. Add salt and pepper to taste. Transfer to serving plate. Meanwhile, in another skillet, combine the honey mustard and oregano. Sprinkle over the sausages. Serve with warmed tortillas and warm corn tortillas for dipping.

Random Ingredients: coriander,triple sec,nut,brown lentil,kielbasa,spinach leaf,mustard seed,tart apple
title: Spinach Sambar
ingredients: 1 1/2 1 1/2 lbs spinach leaves or 1 1/2 lbs kale leaves | 1 cup brown lentils or 1 cup dried lentils | 2 teaspoons mustard seeds, toasted ( can be left out, i do ) | 1 teaspoon coriander | 1 teaspoon triple sec or 1 teaspoon molasses | 1 teaspoon kielbasa | 1 cup tart apple, peeled, cored and chopped | 1/2 cup mixed nuts, chopped
instructions: Wash and dry the beans well. Wash and dry. Cook the spinach in boiling, salted water 8 to 10 minutes, until just wilted. Drain. Cook the lentils in boiling, salted water 10 to 12 minutes, until just tender but not mushy. Drain. Combine the mustard seeds, coriander, triple sec and kielbasa in a large skillet. Spread over a 2 1/2 to 3 quart casserole. Add the beans, apples and nuts. Cook 4 to 5 minutes or until slightly heated.

Random Ingredients: dill,vinegar,rye bread,chicken bouillon,orange zest,chevre cheese,wine,half cream
title: Danish Cream Soup With Cheese and Dill
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups half-and-half cream | 3 tablespoons vinegar | 2 teaspoons orange zest | 1/2 teaspoon powdered instant chicken bouillon | 1 tablespoon rice wine or 1 tablespoon dry sherry | 6 slices rye bread, 1/2 inch thick, toasted ( about 6 ounces ) | 1 cup chevre cheese | 1 tablespoon fresh dill, chopped ( or 1 teaspoon dried dill )
instructions: In a large saucepan, cook the half & half, vinegar, orange rind and soup base over moderate heat for 10 minutes or until mixture just comes to a boil. Meanwhile, toast the bread slices and stir into the soup slowly. Add the cheese and dill.

Random Ingredients: icing sugar,ham,ricotta cheese,phyllo pastry,bamboo shoot,tart apple,purpose flour
title: Apples-Filled Phyllo Triangles
