ingredients: 4 tart apples, cored and sliced | 1 cup diced ham | 1/2 cup sliced bamboo shoots | 1/2 cup ricotta cheese | 3 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 6 sheets phyllo pastry | 1 tablespoon icing sugar
instructions: Combine ham, apples, pineapple, pancake mince, and 1/2 teaspoon of the flour in a large bowl. Using a pastry brush, coat two thirds of the phyllo sheets with the remaining flour. Working on the third sheet, coat with the remaining 3 tablespoons of flour. Place a scant 1 tablespoon of the filling at the bottom half of each phyllo sheet. Fold pastry over the filling and place on a tray. Repeat with 3 more sheets of filling and the remaining phyllo sheets. Dust with icing sugar. Preheat oven to 400°f. Bake for 35 minutes or until golden.

title: Salsa Verde Tomatillo
ingredients: 2 cans condensed tomato soup, divided | 1 can tomatillos, drained and chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Place 1 can of tomato soup, 1 can of tomatillos, and 1 can of chili salsa verde in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Mix well. Pour over top of other can of soup, and cover with foil. Bake in the preheated oven for 1 hour.

title: Easy Brown Rice
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice ( regular long grain white rice for me is okay ) | 1/3 cup lemon juice, fresh is preferred | 4 -5 ounces sweet white flavored crackers, of your choice | black salt, to taste
instructions: Begin by rinsing the rice in a fine mesh strainer. Once the water runs clear, drain the whey and rinse once more. Place your rice in a large heavy duty sealable bag, add all the remaining ingredients and shake to mix the ingredients. Taste for salt and adjust seasonings. The amount of crackers will depend on personal preference. Seal the bag, and refrigerate overnight, stirring two or three times. At serving time, take a piece of the bag, and turn it over several times so that the rice grains are evenly coated with the seasoning. If the bag breaks up, place the bag back into the rice cooker. Set your rice cooker to the quick brown setting. If the rice cooker won't go as quickly and easily, continue to turn the rice cooker for a few minutes on medium low heat. The longer it cooks, the more flavor it will have.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,cream tartar,cream chicken soup,self rising flour
title: Creamy Onion Soup
ingredients: 2 cans condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/3 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 3 1/3 cups self rising flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Oil two 9 inch cake pans, or one 10 inch round cake pan. Put soup and oil in a medium bowl, and beat in cream of tartar. Stir in flour. Put equal amounts of soup into each prepared cake pan. Bake in the preheated oven 20 to 25 minutes, or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: sage leaf,green chili pepper,pesto sauce,spring onion,lemon zest,orange juice,poppy seed
title: Pesto and Lime Juice Salad
ingredients: 1 medium green chili pepper, deseeded and chopped | 1 spring onions, sliced thinly | 3 tablespoons pesto sauce | 2 tablespoons green chili peppers, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons orange juice | 1 tablespoon lemon zest | 1 tablespoon ground sage leaf
instructions: Chop the chilli and spring onions to ¾ inch pieces. Place in a bowl with the pesto, chili, orange juice, lemon and sage. Mix well. Pour over the salad just before serving.

Random Ingredients: ouzo,cornflour,asparagus,black mustard seed,red food coloring,garlic powder,wheat flour
title: Ouzo Salad (Hokkaido Style)
ingredients: 200 g asparagus | 1 tablespoon wheat flour | 1 teaspoon ouzo | 1/4 teaspoon black mustard seeds | 1 garlic powder | 1/3 teaspoon red food coloring | 1 teaspoon cornflour
instructions: Chop asparagus into 4 cm. Shoots. Place the chopped asparagus into a bowl with cold water. Allow to sit for 15 minutes. Drain well.

Random Ingredients: ginger,glutinous rice,dark soy sauce,cotija cheese,red chili powder
title: Pistou (Indonesian Glutinous Rice)
ingredients: 12 ounces glutinous rice, uncooked | 4 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons red chili powder | 1/4 teaspoon ground ginger | 3 tablespoons grated cotija cheese or 3 tablespoons feta cheese
instructions: Pour the rice into a saucepan, stir well to combine, and bring to a boil. Cover a skillet with very low heat, and cook for 20 - 25 minutes until the rice is beginning to turn translucent, stirring constantly. Turn off the heat and let rice stand, covered for 15 - 20 minutes. Stir rice with a wooden spoon, and spread into 8 pie shaped dishes. Heat 4 tablespoons of dark soy sauce, 1 1/2 teaspoons red chili powder, and the ground ginger in a small nonstick skillet. Cook over medium low heat for 5 - 8 minutes or until heated through. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon of the cotija cheese on each dish, and place in the oven to melt the cheese. Watch carefully as hot cheese may burn before it melts.

title: Tequila Ice
ingredients: 1/2 cup light italian dressing | 1/4 cup triple sec
instructions: In a blender or a glass mixing on the gas for about 45 seconds or until the mixture begins to foam. Add the remaining ingredients and blend for about 10 seconds or until it becomes a smooth, thick ice.

title: Beetroot and Ham Barbecue
ingredients: 1 jar pickled beetroots, drained, reserving 2 tablespoons pickling liquid | 3 tablespoons catsup | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon rice wine | 1 ham, sliced ( deli-style with bone )
instructions: Place pickled beetroot in a large bowl, pour in reserved beet liquid, reserving 3 tablespoons pickling liquid. Stir in catsup, vinegar, and rice wine. Cover, and refrigerate for at least one hour to develop flavors. Place ham slices on grill over medium heat, and grill for about 10 minutes each side. Remove ham, and brush with reserved pickling liquid from bowl before serving.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,semolina,mandarin orange,bread,butter,orange juice concentrate,beef stock
title: Mandarin Sweet Bread
ingredients: 1 lb self-raising flour | 1/4 cup semolina | 2 tablespoons orange juice concentrate | 2 tablespoons butter | 1 cup beef stock | 12 mandarin oranges | bread
instructions: Mix the flour, semolina and 1 tbsp of the orange juice concentrate in bowl. Rub the butter into the flour with your fingertips until it looks like a mealy meal. Add all remaining ingredients, except the mandarin oranges. Pour mixture into oven proof dish, top with mandarin oranges, close oven & bake for 1 hr 15 minutes at 180°c. Serve with fresh seasonal salad.

Random Ingredients: tequila,kalamata olive,green bean,fish fillet,red bell pepper
title: Grilled Mexican Style Fish with Olives
ingredients: 2 lbs fish fillets, such as monkfish, cod or halibut | 1 lb fresh green beans, cleaned and cut into 2-inch lengths | 1 medium red bell pepper ( cut into 2 inch pieces ) | 1/3 cup tequila | 1/4 cup kalamata olive, pitted and sliced
instructions: Place a large cast iron skillet on the grill over high heat until very hot, about 2 minutes. Lightly spray the skillet with nonstick cooking spray. Remove the fish from the skillet, leaving the tail fin on and cut the fillet in 1 inch chunks. Place half the fish in the skillet over medium high heat. Add the beans and the bell pepper, turning with tongs for 2 minutes or until the vegetables are evenly browned. Remove from the heat. Brush any juices from the skillet with the tequila. Add the olives and 1/4 cup water to the skillet. Return to the grill. Return the fish to the skillet, and cover. Close the lid of the grill and let cook 3 to 4 minutes, or until fish flakes easily with a fork. Serve immediately.

title: Greek Orange Juice and Ouzo
ingredients: 2 cups orange juice ( i use the cheap stuff ) | 4 tablespoons ouzo
instructions: Mix all the ingredients and let the flavors meld for at least an hour. It is better consumed on ice cream.

Random Ingredients: hazelnut,cilantro leaf,lime wedge,avocado,tomato green chilies,green enchilada sauce,mustard seed
title: Easy Delicious Green Chili Salsa
ingredients: 2 cans green enchilada sauce ( mild ) | 1 lb ripe avocado, peeled, pitted ( or 1 large ) | 1/2 cup chopped toasted hazelnuts | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1/2 teaspoon ground mustard seeds | 3 tablespoons fresh cilantro leaves, chopped | lime wedge
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl. Cover and chill for at least 15 minutes to blend flavors. Serve with a lime wedge on top, if desired.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,potato starch,apricot nectar,red kidney bean,corn,baking soda,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Texana Style Chilie Dip
ingredients: 1 can red kidney beans, drained | 1 can sweet corn, drained well | 1 cup catalina or 1 cup picante sauce | 1/4 cup chopped dried apricot nectar | 1/2 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1/8 teaspoon baking soda | potato starch
instructions: Combine all ingredients & blend well. Add enough potato starch or water to make a thinner consistency.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,black bean paste,sirloin steak,walnut,strawberry,pine nut
title: Strawberry and Black Bean Meatball (Korean Nara Goma)
ingredients: 750 g sirloin steaks | 2 cups walnuts | 1 cup fresh prawns or 1 cup lobster meat ( 6 ounces ) | 10 1/2 ounces canned black bean paste | 1 can diced tomatoes with juice | 2 tablespoons sunflower oil or 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 3 tablespoons pine nuts, toasted
instructions: Cut the sirloin steak into bite size pieces. Grind the walnuts into coarse, powdery meal and add to the sirloin to moisten. Grind the prawns or lobster meat into fine, powdery meal. Add to the meat and mix. Form mixture into 6 balls. Place the balls in a shallow baking dish, covered with foil, and bake at 300° for 45 minutes stir occasionally to avoid sticking. While the meatballs are baking, place the black bean paste into a small pan and warm over low heat for about 10 to 15 minutes until thick. Remove from heat and beat in the diced tomatoes. Once the meatballs are cooked, drain and add to the pan, spreading in a thin layer. Continue to stir until the mixture is coated with the sauce, about 1 minute. Adjust seasoning with sea salt and black pepper. To serve, arrange the meatballs on individual serving plates, drizzle the hot black bean sauce over, and top with prawn and prawn meatballs. Sprinkle pine nuts around the side.

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,vegetable stock,sunflower oil,fingerling potato,beef bouillon cube,head cabbage,lettuce
title: Lengua Slice
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sunflower oil | 500 g beef bouillon cubes, crushed | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 500 g fingerling potatoes, sliced thinly | 1 small head of cabbage, sliced | 1/4 cup vegetable stock | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: In a large pan, heat the oil and cook the beef in batches. Add the worcestershire and stock. Cover and simmer for about 30 mins, stirring occasionally until meat is cooked. Stir the potato slices into pan, add the cabbage and cover. Cook for 10 mins until potato is just tender. Remove from heat and stir in the vanilla. Spoon into serving dishes and serve with fresh cream or ice cream.

Random Ingredients: egg white,green olive,pineapple tidbit,sambal oelek,beef mince,corn oil,chive
title: Spicy Pineapple Meatballs
ingredients: 500 g beef mince | 1 1/2 tablespoons corn oil | 1 large egg white | 1 tablespoon chives, chopped | 1 can pineapple tidbits, drained and finely chopped | 200 g green olives, roughly chopped | 3/4 teaspoon sambal oelek | 1 tablespoon olive oil
instructions: Mix mince, egg white, chives, pineapple, oil, sambal oelek, a little water and olives together. The mixture should form into a large ball. Chill in the fridge for 20 mins, until easy to work with. Take out from fridge and roll into a ball around your hands. Place on a tray and grill in batches over medium heat until cooked through. Serve immediately.

title: Taco Nests
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh asparagus spears, blanched and peeled | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning mix | 2/3 cup minced fresh italian parsley
instructions: Toss the spears with taco seasoning mix. Place 1 tablespoon of mixture in each indentation in the nests of the nests. Sprinkle with parsley.

title: Scalloped Rice (Prawns) With Parsley (Spain)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups long-grain white rice | 5 -6 prawns ( peeled and deveined ) | 1 bunch fresh parsley ( leaves only and finely chopped, about 1/2 c, about 3 )
instructions: Cook rice according to the package directions. While the rice is cooking, pat dry the prawns with paper towels and place in a baking dish lined with parchment paper. Sprinkle over the parsley. Dot the top with butter. Bake in a hot oven about 8 minutes until the prawn turns opaque. Transfer to serving plates.

Random Ingredients: date,pear,fruit,extra virgin olive oil,chicken stock vegetable,fine sea salt,jalapeno pepper,red bell pepper
title: Chermoula De Manzana  Brazilian Olive & Date Raita (Rosette)
ingredients: 1 lb mixed ripe vegetables, such as potatoes, zucchini, swiss chard, and arugula | 1 tablespoon chopped canned pears | 1/4 cup chopped red bell pepper | 1 1/2 teaspoons fine sea salt | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 can chicken stock or ( 14 ounce ) can vegetable stock | 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded ( optional ) | 18 fresh dates, roughly chopped
instructions: In large bowl, stir together the mixed ripe vegetables, pears, bell pepper and salt. Gradually stir in olive oil. Transfer to a large non metallic bowl and refrigerate at least 3 hours, but not more than 2 hours. Drain and reserve the raita. Heat oven to 400 degrees. Transfer the vegetable mixture to an 11 by 7 by 2 inch baking dish. Bake at 400 degrees for 30 minutes, or until the fruit and dates are slightly caramelized. Drizzle the warm raita around the rind and gently stir in the chopped jalapeno pepper. Return to oven for a few more minutes until the raita is well glazed and very hot.

title: Thai-Style Oyster Sauce Oyster Sauce (Nuoc Cham)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons coriander seeds | 1/2 cup oyster sauce
instructions: Pound the coriander roots until fragrant, about 5 seconds. Place the coriander in a pestle and mortar and grind to a fine powder. Transfer the ground coriander to a small wok or skillet, add the oyster sauce and stir briefly. Turn off the heat or leave the lid on before it starts to smoke.

title: Currant and Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1/4 cup dried currant, finely ground | 2 teaspoons ground coffee | 1 teaspoon dried currants | 4 beef tenderloin
instructions: Mix ground coffee and currants. Lightly coat the tenderloin with coffee mixture. Refrigerate 3 hours. Lightly salt and pepper the roast. Place the steaks on a rack in a roasting pan and place under broiler until browned, 7 to 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: bay leaf powder,vanilla ice cream,cannellini bean,american cheese
title: White Bean and Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 package american cheese, cubed | 1/2 teaspoon bay leaf powder | 1 pint vanilla ice cream
instructions: Process beans, cheese, bay leaf and 2 cups water in a food processor until smooth. Pour mixture into a deep dish 2 1/2 quart electric slow cooker with a lid or tight fitting lid. Cover crockpot and cook on low setting for 4 to 6 hours or on high for 1 1/2 to 2 hours, until mixture is hot and bubbling. Remove lid and turn slow cooker to high setting for one hour or until dip is hot and browned on the edges. Remove from the slow cooker carefully and carefully, using a spatula, transfer dip to a shallow bowl or fondue pot, stirring to coat with dip. Place in refrigerator for 1 to 2 hours before serving.

title: Mmmm Hot Mustard.
ingredients: 3 tablespoons margarine | 2 tablespoons toasted mustard powder | 2 tablespoons tahini | 1/4 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/4 teaspoon bay leaf | 1/8 black olives, crushed ( i like the drained ) or 1/8 green olives, chopped ( i like the drained )
instructions: Spread butter on plate. Spread mustard on second slice. Sprinkle with mustard powder and serve. This is good cold too.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,olive,flat leaf parsley,chili sauce,chili garlic sauce
title: Prawns-Shrimps
ingredients: 3 tablespoons vegetable oil | 375 g raw peeled prawns | 2 tablespoons finely chopped flat leaf parsley | 1 tablespoon coarsely chopped fresh chili ( or chilli flakes ) | 2 tablespoons sweet chili sauce
instructions: Heat a medium frying pan over moderately high heat. Add the oil and then the prawns and cook, turning the prawns, for 2 - 3 minutes until they turn pink. Transfer all the prawns to a plate and repeat with the parsley and chillies. Add the chilli sauce and cook until piping hot and the sauce starts to thicken, about 2 minutes. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: baking potato,tamarind paste,swiss cheese,oregano leaf,cheese curd
title: Tamarind Swiss Fries
ingredients: 4 medium baking potatoes, unpeeled and cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 cup cheese curds, divided | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste | 1 tablespoon dried oregano leaves, crushed | 1/2 cup shredded swiss cheese
instructions: Heat the oven to 400°. Pat potatoes dry with paper towels. Spray a baking sheet or cookie sheet with cooking spray. Place potato chunks on the sheet. Bake for 25 minutes, or until soft. Remove from oven and cool slightly. Mix remaining ingredients. Serve potatoes warm or at room temperature.

title: Mangolian Marinade for Chicken Pieces
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups water ( or more for basting ) | 2 tablespoons marmalade wine | 1 -2 tablespoon adobo sauce, from can
instructions: Stir together all ingredients. Pour over chicken pieces in an airtight container. Put in the refrigerator. To marinade meat, pour a bit of the wine on a piece of foil. Place meat in the foil so the marinade can soak inches. Cook over low fire for at least 3 or 4 hours, or until chicken is done. Serve with white rice or polenta.

title: Sauzgared Cherry Tomato Appetizer Appetizer
ingredients: 8 -10 medium cherry tomatoes ( depending on size ) | 4 tablespoons icing sugar ( confectioners sugar ) | 2 cans pizza sauce ( or a good bottled sauce of your choice )
instructions: Spread the icing sugar evenly over the top of each tomato in a large bowl. Cut each cherry into 6 smaller pieces lengthwise, and place them in each tomato on top of the icing sugar. Add the pizza sauce. Refrigerate for 10 to 12 hours. Cut into squares. Eat as it is or drizzle with a sweet and sour sauce.

title: Quick Russian Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb rotini pasta | 1/4 cup brandy | 1 tablespoon chinese seasoning | 1 1/2 tablespoons cornstarch | 3 -4 tablespoons extra strong coffee | 1 tablespoon coarsely ground powdered coffee
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Keep warm. Meanwhile, combine brandy, sonychchchthyme, and chinese seasoning in a small sauce pan. Heat until just boiling. Add 1 1/2 tablespoon of cold coffee to brandy mixture. Stir until mixed and boiling. Add cornstarch and keep stirring until mixed. Add remaining coffee and 1 tablespoon of the coffee powder to sauce. When pasta is done drain and place hot rotini pasta in serving bowl. Pour brandy mixture into pasta and top with other 1 tablespoon of coffee powder. Serve.

Random Ingredients: ketchup,cooking apple,onion soup mix,eggplant,celery,thyme sprig,vanilla bean,lime
title: Caribbean Eggplant (Aubergine) Applesauce
ingredients: 6 large eggplants | 4 stalks celery | 1 medium onion | 1 large cooking apple | 1 package onion soup mix | 3 tablespoons ketchup | 1 lime, juiced | 1 tablespoon dried thyme sprig | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla bean
instructions: First broil the eggplant on a cookie sheet or grill on the rack about 7 minutes per side or until soft. Remove to bowl and scrape as much flesh as possible from the eggplant, leaving one or two centimeters thick pulp. Peel back the eggplants and cut lengthwise into 4 inch chunks. Peel the onions and cut in half lengthwise. Place in food processor or blender, along with chopped celery, chopped apple, and onion soup mix. Add ketchup, lime juice, and thyme. Process until smooth, about 1 minute. Place the reserved eggplant, cooking liquid, and vanilla bean in a large skillet. Cover and bring to a simmer over medium heat.

title: Dumplings-Dumplings (Tonggwa)
ingredients: 4 ounces tomato paste | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Mix tomato paste and vanilla in a small pot with about 2 - 3 cups of water. Bring to the boil and keep on low until the sauce thickens to the desired consistency.

title: Black Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 can condensed black bean dip | 2 cans chicken broth | 1 can coconut milk
instructions: Pour black bean dip, chicken broth, and coconut milk into a blender.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,nicoise olive,lobster tail,turmeric,ra el hanout spice mix,tomato,pumpkin puree
title: Shorba Libiya
ingredients: 1 cup prepared canned tomato, drained | 2 tablespoons prepared crushed nicoise olives ( kalamata olives ) | 1 tablespoon pure red curry paste | 1/3 cup canned pumpkin puree | 2 tablespoons ras el hanout spice mix | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric | 2 1/2 lbs fresh lobster tails
instructions: Combine all ingredients except lobster in a medium sized saucepan. Bring to a boil, stirring gently. Add lobster and simmer gently until lobster is cooked through. Lobster will cook quickly so you may need to cook lobster in batches to ensure they don't overcook. Drain lobster of any extra liquid and serve with shorba.

title: Chinese Sticky Dates
ingredients: 24 small dates ( you could use small asian dates ) | 20 wonton wrappers
instructions: Wash and dry the dates and place half the filled wrappers on a baking sheet. Brush with melted butter and sprinkle with a pinch of salt. Bake at 350f, for 12 minutes. Allow the cool slightly, you want the skins nice and dry but not burned.. Enjoy.

title: Creamy Shiitake Nite
ingredients: 1 lb shiitake mushroom | 2 cups canned mushrooms | 1 garlic clove, minced | 1 teaspoon rosemary sprig | 2 tablespoons vodka | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1 container fat-free sour cream and light cream | 1 tablespoon irish cream
instructions: Pour boiling water into can of mushrooms and let sit for 2 minutes, remove stems and slice them thickly into rings. Remove mushrooms and set aside. Drain mushrooms, reserving liquid and mushroom liquid, and set aside. Remove stems and garlic, reserving liquid. Finely chop. Add mushrooms with all the juices back to mushrooms and simmer for 10 minutes. Add spices and mushrooms that were set aside. Mix with sour cream and light cream. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours or up to a week to develop flavor. Garnish with additional sprigs of rosemary.

Random Ingredients: lemongrass,vermouth,peanut,green bell pepper,pork loin,beef stew meat chili,beef bouillon stock,leek
title: Namurrah (Lemon Grass and Peppers Stew)
ingredients: 1/3 cup peanut, chopped | 1/3 cup lemongrass, stalk | 1/2 teaspoon beef bouillon or 1/2 teaspoon chicken bouillon | 1 green bell pepper, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1/2 lb beef stew meat ( cut into 1-inch cubes ) | 1 leek, slit, white and light green parts only, thinly sliced, washed clean, sliced into rounds | 1/2 cup dry vermouth ( may use non-alcoholic liquid ) | 1/2 cup beef stock
instructions: Soak lemongrass in 3 cups hot water, drain and finely mince. Combine lemongrass, bouillon, chopped pepper, and green pepper in bowl and stir well. Add meat, stir and set aside. Combine vermouth and 1/2 to 3/4 cup stock and boil until liquid is reduced to about 1/2 cup. Stir in stock mixture. Return to a boil, then stir in meat mixture. Cover and simmer until meat is tender and meat is tender, about 2 hours. Remove meat cubes and keep cooking meat. Stir in remaining 1/2 cup stock and heat, cooking until liquid evaporates, about 1 minute. Place on platter and pour sauce over. Serve.

title: Lentils With Garam Masala
ingredients: 3 ounces lentils | 1 teaspoon coriander seed | 2 ounces fresh white breadcrumbs
instructions: Soak lentils in plenty of water until they are soft. Mash the lentils in the bowl into a smooth paste using an apple or potato masher. Add a tablespoon of water and continue mashing as necessary to obtain a creamy consistency. If the lentils are too sticky, add butter. Add the spices and breadcrumbs to a deep frying pan and stir over a low heat, until the mixture becomes slightly creamy. If the desired consistency is too dry, add some of the warm liquid left in the pan. Stir in more breadcrumbs. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: bacon,olive oil cooking spray,italian bread,green capsicum
title: Quick Bread and Bacon Fingers
ingredients: olive oil flavored cooking spray | 1 teaspoon olive oil | 4 slices lean bacon, halved crossways | 2 tablespoons sliced green capsicums or 2 tablespoons red capsicums, roughly chopped ( 1 cup )
instructions: Preheat oven to 190 degrees c or 375 degrees f, gas mark spray a baking tray with oil. Put bacon in a frying pan, add the oil and cook over medium heat, turning until crispy. Remove and place in ramekin or ovenproof dish. Mix the capsicum with the oil and bacon and fill ramekin. Bake for 15 minutes, or until golden brown and crisp. Meanwhile, place the ramekins on a baking tray and return to oven on middle shelf. Bake for 20 minutes or until crisp. Makes 5 ramekin serves. Serves 6.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,cardamom seed,nonfat beef broth,mung bean
title: Mung Bean Ice Cream
ingredients: 1 lb mung beans | 1/4 cup nonfat beef broth | 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seeds or 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Put the mung beans into a soup pot. Pour the beef stock into the soup pot. Bring the mixture to a boil, then stir in the cream. When the cream is mostly absorbed, stir in the cardamom seeds or ground cardamom. Continue cooking for a few minutes if the water is very thick or long a few minutes if you have a very thick ice cream maker. Stir in the mung beans until they are hot and just warmed through. Transfer the ice cream to an ice cream maker and churn according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

Random Ingredients: lavender,golden raisin,self rising flour,pizza sauce,spanish onion,sesame oil,broth
title: Soy Sauce Onion Rings
ingredients: 1 spanish onion, sliced thinly ( about 2 cups, about 10 medium size ) | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 1/2 cup broth | 1 cup self rising flour | pizza sauce | sesame oil | lavender ( to taste )
instructions: Place sliced onion in a large bowl and add raisins, broth and flour. Mix well to combine. Let sit for about 20 minutes at room temperature to slightly absorb the brine. Sprinkle a little sesame oil on the top before baking. Bake at 400f or 200f for 15 minutes, stirring once. Cool to room temperature before serving.

Random Ingredients: iceberg lettuce,pea,creamy peanut butter,caster sugar,sherry wine,white onion
title: Pea and Peanut Salad
ingredients: 1 iceberg lettuce, washed and drained | 1/8 cup creamy peanut butter | 1 teaspoon caster sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons sherry wine | 1 white onion, sliced | 300 g frozen peas, thawed
instructions: To make the dressing, combine the peanut butter, sugar, sherry, onion and peas in a bowl. Toss well until the sugar has dissolved. Toss in the lettuce and pour over the dressing.

title: Corn-Oven Sweet & Sour Vegetables: a Taste of Home
ingredients: 2 corn on the cob, washed and cut off cob | 1/2 of an onion, peeled and sliced into small rings | 1 tablespoon of fresh coriander | 1 teaspoon chili oil | 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander | 1 cup ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup cheese, grated ( optional ) | 1/2 small rutabaga, cubed
instructions: Put corn cob in a large shallow tray/rack dish or on a cookie sheet and add the sliced onion. Place under the grill or oven. If you are using an oven it's nice and hot. Allow the onion to cook. Remove the corn from the skewers and dry on kitchen paper. Sprinkle with coriander, chilli oil and ground coriander. Remove onion rings from skewers. Stir fry the corriander and onion in a little oil until the onion is translucent. Add the cheese, stir to mix, and remove from the heat. Cut corn cob into 1 inch cube shapes and serve over the cheese and onions. Optional add some crushed red pepper to the cheese mixture if desired, before adding the ricotta cheese, mix and serve.

title: Pizza Crumbs
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/8 teaspoon crushed peppercorn ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Prepare cookie sheet with cooking spray. Mix oregano with peppercorns. Roll dough, with fingers or hands into 1 inch balls. Place on cookie sheet. Spray with cooking spray. Dip in remaining oregano. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: fruit chutney,tomato green chilies,hominy,cardamom,chicken breast half
title: Crock Pot Southwestern Chicken
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 14 1/2 ounces diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1 1/2 cups hominy | 1/2 cup dried fruit chutney | 2 teaspoons cardamom
instructions: Cut chicken into 1 inch cubes. Place chicken in a 5 quart crock pot and add all other ingredients. Turn to low and cook for 7 - 9 hours. Serve with tortillas and salsa of your choice.

title: Easy Coffee Wraps
ingredients: 2 burrito-size flour tortillas | 2 tablespoons instant coffee
instructions: Heat a griddle, stove or skillet for about one minute on each side. Place 2 burrito size tortillas together on the griddle. Top with instant coffee. Turn off the stove to keep the coffee from drying up. Use a fork to fold the tortillas into a loose cone shape. Let cool. Repeat until cool enough to touch. Store in a sealed container. Note, the coffee burritos can also be eaten as is, but they will be a bit messy. Variations, tortillas can also be eaten as an appetizer, with toppings like sour cream or guacamole.

Random Ingredients: mint,fish sauce,black eyed pea,coconut milk,self raising flour
title: Coconut Black-Eyed Peas - Vegan
ingredients: 1 kg dried black-eyed peas, washed ( black beans with normal black beans ) | 1 tablespoon of fresh mint, washed and washed | 3 tablespoons fresh coconut milk ( i prefer unsweetened coconut milk, i find it tastes really strong ) | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 1 tablespoon self-raising flour ( i use a mix of rice flour and soy flour, can use plain flour )
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Mix all the ingredients together. Pour into a baking dish and bake for 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pea pod,sauerkraut,white flour,corn chip,vegetable,cauliflower floret,asafoetida powder
title: Veggies Nachos
ingredients: 1 cup fresh peas pods | 1 cup fresh cauliflower florets | 2 cups raw edamagrosts | 1 cup sauerkraut | 2 tablespoons white flour | 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1/4 cup corn chips or 1/4 cup broken wheat cereal
instructions: Cook vegetables according to your taste. Drain and rinse until cool.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,broccoli floret,self raising flour,chorizo sausage,beef bouillon granule
title: Chorizo Sausages & Broccoli in Gravy
ingredients: 6 chorizo sausages ( approx 1 cup ) | 4 cups broccoli florets | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon granules | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 cup self-raising flour
instructions: Lightly spray fry pan with oil. Cook chorizo until crispy on the outside and then remove from pan with slotted spoon leaving the fat behind. Using the same pan, add broccoli and cook until just tender. Mix beef and vegetable mix and add to pan, cook for 2 minutes. Pour in soy sauce and serve.

title: Quinoa with Vegetables
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 1 1/2 cups black and red peppers, diced | 1 bouillon cube with 3 cups water | 1/2 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper | 2 teaspoons curry powder or 2 teaspoons curry paste
instructions: Rinse quinoa well and place in a large enough bowl to weigh it down. Bring water to a boil in a small saucepan and add vinegar, salt and pepper to taste. Add pepper and curry power and quinoa and mix well. Boil rapidly until water is absorbed. You might have to add water a little at a time until liquid is absorbed. Transfer mixture to a large bowl and allow to cool to room temperature. The mixture should be a little runny not liquidy when you place it on your serving plate. Variation, add curry or hot pepper strips to the liquid before serving the quinoa.

title: Spanish Sausage
ingredients: 3 lbs bulk kielbasa | 1 small spanish onion, chopped | 2 cloves garlic, minced | 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour
instructions: Slice sausage into 1/2 inch pieces, then into 1 inch pieces and set aside. In skillet, cook onion and sausage in hot butter over medium heat until onion is tender.

title: Thai Fruit Salad With Eggnog
ingredients: 100 g jicama, sliced thin | 100 g asafoetida powder | 20 g anchovies | 1 dash cooking oil | 1 tablespoon eggnog | cooking oil | 5 tablespoons watermelon, chopped into small pieces ( or any watermelon ) | 4 pieces watermelon, cut in cubes with stems removed | 2 slices pickled jalapeno peppers, chopped
instructions: To make dressing, mix ingredients. To make salad, mix all ingredients except watermelon, jalapeno and watermelon in a small bowl. Add diced watermelon and mix. Drain watermelon, slice into small pieces and place in salad bowl. Arrange pickled jalapeño slices on top of the salad. Drizzle dressing over salad and around the edges. Serve with sliced pickled jicama.

title: The Singed Man
ingredients: 2 lbs prepared marshmallows | 2 lbs powdered red hot chili powder | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce
instructions: Melt marshmallows, red chili powder and worcestershire sauce together. Roll into balls, about the size of a small walnut, and place on waxed paper or plastic wrap. Chill in refrigerator for 15 min.

title: Homemade Mango Lettuce & Punch Appetizer
ingredients: 6 cups fruit punch | 1 whole cumin seed
instructions: Wash and dry the fruit punch. Break the cumin seeds into a mortar & pestle and add to the punch. Stir in the seed cover with aluminum foil and put in a cool dry place for several hours or until the mixture begins to firm. Refrigerate when ready to serve. Break into small pieces and use as condiment.

title: Garden Pierogi (Czech)
ingredients: 5 large potatoes, peeled and cubed | 1 can pineapple tidbits, drained | 3 cups prepared horseradish | 1 cucumber, peeled and shredded | 3 tablespoons paprika | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 cup shredded hawaiian sweet roll mix or other breads, as desired
instructions: Place potato and pineapple tidbits in a large pot. Pour enough boiling water over to cover and bring to a boil. Cover and simmer until the mixture just begins to soften, about 15 minutes. Meanwhile, prepare horseradish sauce by stirring together the horseradish, cucumber, paprika, and baking soda in a small bowl. Dip both sides of the cubed potatoes and pineapple into the horseradish sauce. Arrange coated potatoes on a serving platter and top with the sweet roll mix. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: milk chocolate chip,chorizo sausage,beef tenderloin,golden raisin,artichoke heart,honey
title: Antipasti Sandwich
ingredients: 1/2 cup honey | 1/2 cup milk chocolate chip | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 1 -2 lb beef tenderloin, thinly sliced | 1/2 lb chorizo sausage, sliced | 12 ounces artichoke hearts in syrup, drained
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the honey with the cardamom, and add the chipits. Dip tenderloin slices into the melted honey mixture, letting excess drip off. Coat with chips, and refrigerate for 1 hour. Heat the grill to maximum. Remove meat from marinade, and grill for about 5 - 6 minutes or until desired doneness. To serve, place meat on serving plate, and top with chorizo and artichoke hearts. Serve with warmed maple syrup.

title: Hazelnut Boursin Dressing
ingredients: 100 g hazelnuts, ground | 150 g drambuie, flavourful | 200 ml mirin | 5 ml mixed fresh herbs, leaves
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together and refrigerate to develop the flavours. Remove 2 tbsp of the hazelnut paste before serving.

Random Ingredients: worcestershire sauce,cheese,great northern bean,mustard oil,parsnip,yellow squash,red potato,lard
title: Welsh Baked Vegetables
ingredients: 3 tablespoons lard | 2 large red potatoes, peeled | 1 large parsnip, peeled | 3 large yellow squash, peeled | 1 can great northern beans, drained | 12 ounces cheese, grated ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard oil | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Heat lard and add potatoes, parsnip, and squash. Cook on medium heat for 3 - 5 minutes until tender but not mushy. Add beans, and simmer 2 - 3 minutes until liquid is absorbed. Add cheese, and mix well. Drain vegetables and sprinkle with mustard oil. Bake in a 375°f oven on middle shelf until golden brown.

title: Quick Beef and Ziti
ingredients: 1 cup ziti pasta, uncooked | 2 cups deli beef, chopped | 1/4 cup pecans, finely chopped | 3 chicken bouillon cubes | 2 tablespoons dried basil
instructions: Cook ziti according to package directions. Drain well. In a 2 1/2 quart slow cooker, layer ziti, beef and pecans, seasoning in this order.

Random Ingredients: spanish onion,dill,pistachio,chicken leg,manicotti,artichoke heart,spaetzle noodle,italian sausage
title: Crazy Versatile Chicken Noodle Skillet
ingredients: 1/2 lb hot italian sausage ( casing removed ) | 1 cup diced spanish onion | 1 jar artichoke hearts, drained and chopped ( reserve 1/4 cup liquid ) | 1 lb chicken leg, cooked and sliced ( about 3 to 4 meaty legs ) | 12 manicotti | 1 package mixed frozen peas and noodles | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh dill ( optional ) | 1/4 cup chopped pistachios ( optional )
instructions: In an extra large skillet, cook sausage over medium heat, stirring frequently, until sausage is browned. Add onion.

title: Traditional Madras Dessert Sauce
ingredients: 50 ml heavy cream | 50 ml sugar | 1 tablespoon ginger paste | 1 tablespoon sweet rice wine ( also known as sineer )
instructions: Place all ingredients into a medium sized saucepan and allow to cook at a low heat. Stir constantly and allow to simmer slowly until the sugar has dissolved and the sauce has thickened slightly.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,soymilk,linguine pasta,pepperoni,red chili pepper
title: Creamy Italian Pasta Salad
ingredients: 2 cups linguine pasta ( ronzoni's is good ) or 2 cups other short pasta ( ronzoni's is good ) | 1 package pepperoni, sliced into long thin strips | 1 cup soymilk, low-fat is fine | 2 fresh red chili peppers, seeded and chopped | 1 teaspoon red pepper flakes or 1 teaspoon pepper, hot
instructions: Cook pasta till tender.

Random Ingredients: clove,french bread,black olive,sea salt,self raising flour,scallion,caraway seed,pizza sauce
title: Served Cold With Caraway Fritters for Sizzling
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups self-raising flour | 1 tablespoon caraway seed | 1 small clove, halved | 1/8 teaspoon sea salt | 1 small seedless black olives, chopped | 1 cup pizza sauce ( or bottled hot italian sauce ) | 1/2 cup chopped scallion | 4 slices day-old day old french bread, cut into thin slices
instructions: Pre heat oven to 220c/450f/gas mark sift the flour, caraway seeds, cloves and sea salt into a bowl. Add the black olives, mixing well before adding the pesto sauce. Stir in the scallions. Brush a baking tray with oil. Spoon the mixture into the tray and arrange the bread on top. Bake for 10 - 15 minutes, or until the fritters' are crispy and golden. Remove from oven and allow to cool slightly before serving.

title: Chicken in Tomato Sauce (Galinha Ensopada)
ingredients: 1 chicken wings, cut at joints if necessary | 12 ounces tomato puree | 1 sprig fresh tarragon | 1 zucchini, sliced
instructions: Place the chicken wings into a large saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring to the boil, then reduce heat to low, partially cover, and simmer gently for 30 minutes. Remove the chicken from the saucepan and remove the meat from the bones, but keep the thighs whole. Place the chicken into a large roasting tin. Cover with tomato puree and tarragon. Place the sliced zucchini on top of the tomato puree, cover and refrigerate for a further 2 hours. Remove the meat from the saucepan, discard the skin, and strain off all the sauce. Place the sauce back in the saucepan and reheat over a medium heat. Keep warm until ready to serve. To serve, remove the meat from the bones and shred with a little of the sauce.

title: Linda's Herbed Rice and Mushrooms Risotto
ingredients: 1/2 cup arborio rice | 1 1/2 cups milk ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup sliced cremini mushrooms | 1/4 cup chopped fresh mint | 2 sprigs fresh rosemary | 1 slice country bread, cut into long strips
instructions: Put rice and about 3 cups water in a 3 quart sauce pan. Cover and bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,steak,chicken tender,french baguette,white pearl onion,apricot jam
title: Grilled Onion Chicken Tenders
ingredients: 1 large french baguette, split lengthwise and toasted | 2/3 cup apricot jam or 2/3 cup apricot preserves | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/2 lb boneless skinless chicken tenders | 1 bag baby white pearl onions, thawed if frozen
instructions: Cut baguette into 3/4 inch thick slices, about 3/4 to 1/2 inches thick. Mix the jam and preserves in a small bowl. Spread mixture to edges of baguette slices. Cut chicken tenders into 4 - 5 inch lengths. Lay slices on top of jam mixture in a wide, even layer. Place the onion over the chicken tenders. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour and up to 8 hours. Heat coals or grates. Remove baguette slices from food warehouse and discard wrapping. Grill chicken and onions, covered tightly, and turning once, until chicken is no longer pink and onion is crisply browned, about 10 to15 minutes.

title: Strawberry French Toast
ingredients: 1 teaspoon strawberry liqueur | 4 slices yellow bell peppers | 4 slices whole wheat bread
instructions: Place bell peppers on baking sheet cut side up. Bake in preheated 400 degrees oven for 3 minutes or until slightly softened, stirring once. Turn peppers over and bake for another 3 minutes or until peppers are softened. Remove peppers from oven, remove skin and seeds and slice crosswise. Repeat steps 1 and 2 with remaining bell peppers. Toast bread. Top bread with remaining pepper slices, making sure to serve warm.

title: Kalbi (Zulu Noodles)
ingredients: 1 lb pork loin roast, cubed | 1 lb pork loin roast | 2 lbs veal bones ( optional ) | 1 lb pork loin roast, cubed | 1 lb ground beef | 2 tablespoons dried marjoram | 5 tablespoons dried crabmeat, crushed
instructions: If using a crockpot, turn on low, and wait 4 hours. Brown meat separately in a little olive oil, then reserve the meat in a separate pan. Place a layer of waxed paper in the bottom of the crockpot. If using a crockpot, follow the steps for a regular crockpot. You may also leave this out and keep on warm, depending on your loin and pork loin roast. After meat is browned, remove from crockpot and set aside. Drain excess fat, if any. Return meat to the crockpot, add more salt, and stir well to coat, then remove string and shred meat into fine, fine bits. If you are cooking for company, set meat aside and let warm slowly until dinner guests arrive. If you are cooking in the crockpot, leave meat to cool completely. If you are cooking in the oven, remove meat and put all the other ingredients in the crockpot, mix well and cook on low for a least 30 minutes. Before guests arrive, use a fork to poke holes in the bag to allow the meat to brown on all sides. This way, the noodles have a wonderful flavor and are easy to eat. Serve over noodles or rice, or let guests add to their own bowls.

title: Easy Polish Sausage
ingredients: 1 package dry ladyfingers | 1 package kielbasa
instructions: Lay kielbasa on baking sheet on lowest rack of oven. Bake 25 - 32 min at 375°.

title: Chicken Alfredo II
ingredients: 4 bone-in chicken breast halves | 1 container cottage cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place chicken breasts in a dutch oven or large bowl. Pour cottage cheese over the chicken, cover, and refrigerate. Heat the chicken in the preheated oven until it is no longer pink in the center, about 20 minutes. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees f. Allow the chicken to rest for 8 to 10 minutes before slicing. Serve with white rice, passing parmesan cheese on the side.

title: Naked Fish with Noodles
ingredients: 3 cups dried wide egg noodles | 1 tablespoon margarine | 2 teaspoons cooking oil | 3 cups shredded cooked fish fillet | 1/2 cup sour cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spread the noodles onto a baking sheet and bake in the preheated oven until tender and lightly browned, about 12 minutes. Melt the margarine in a skillet over medium heat. Add the fish and cook until opaque, 5 to 7 minutes.

Random Ingredients: rigatoni pasta,cake flour,cardamom seed,carrot,vegetable broth,turnip,chicken breast,provolone cheese
title: Creamy Pâté With Chicken and Turnips
ingredients: 12 ounces boneless skinless chicken breasts | 1 carrot, peeled and halved crosswise | 1 turnip, peeled and chunked | 1 1/2 tablespoons cake flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cardamom seed | 1 1/4 cups reduced-sodium vegetable broth | 8 ounces rigatoni pasta, cooked | 4 slices provolone cheese, about 1 ounce
instructions: Cut chicken into 1/4 inch wide strips. Trim and cut carrot and turnip into 1 inch lengths. Put flour, cardamom seeds in a large zip top plastic bag. Add chicken strips and shake to coat. Transfer chicken to shallow baking dish. Add carrot mixture to bag and shake to coat. Sprinkle mixture evenly over chicken pieces. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate 2 to 3 hours. Turn off oven and let chicken stand for about 15 minutes. Remove chicken from marinade. Bring vegetable broth to boil in medium heavy saucepan. Add pasta. Cover and cook over medium heat until pasta is tender, stirring occasionally, about 8 minutes. Strain pasta and return to small saucepan. Heat until sauce is simmering. Drain chicken reserving marinade. Return chicken and turnip to saucepan. Heat through, then transfer to serving platter. Sprinkle each serving with cheese. Serve with rice or pasta. If desired, place remaining reserved chicken marinade in small saucepan with reserved broth. Bring to a boil until mixture thickens. To make to your own broth, heat 1 1/4 cups of broth in small, heavy saucepan over medium high heat. Add reserved chicken and turnip, stir fry until heated through, about 5 minutes.

title: Homemade Arepas
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cumin powder | 1 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a gallon sized ziploc bag. Add the ingredients, seal and allow to cure on the counter for 3 - 4 days. Do not rinse the arepas while curing mixture. They do not need to be completely covered with liquid. The arepas should be completely dry when curing. Sauce can be used to stuff prawns, squid octopus, baby octopus or other seafood. I prefer the baby octopus. However, if using squid, i prefer the larger pieces and add to the curing mixture during curing. You may also use prawns which are large and slightly flattened, as the mayons will not be as tender as with any other seafood. I prefer large octopus. If you prefer a milder mixture, you can add some ground red pepper. You can use more or less of the cumin powder. I prefer to use less cumin that i use, and it is up to the personal preference. I prefer to leave out more cumin powder, as the arepas tend to be very dry. Allow to cure and use as required.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,grain rice,sage,banana pepper,butter bud molly mcbutter,vegetable protein,ginger,onion powder
title: Banana Stuffed Bell Peppers
ingredients: 1 banana pepper | 2 tablespoons butter buds ( or 1 1/2 tbsp molly mcbutter buds, 1 tbsp molly mcbutter buds, or whatever else you like ) | 1/2 cup converted long grain rice | 1/4 teaspoon ground ginger | 1 teaspoon grated fresh ginger | 1/2 tablespoon onion powder | 1 tablespoon vanilla essence | 1 cup low-fat vegetables ( your choice )
instructions: Cut the ends off of the pepper being careful not to remove the seeds. Melt 1 tbsp butter in a small pan and add pepper, rice and spices. Saute until peppers are soft, around 10 minutes, but not too soft. Remove from heat and mix in 1/4 cup of the veggies. Spoon into peppers, packing them down in an even layer, until peppers are completely stuffed, placing a toothpick through each end. Place peppers in a casserole dish or individual baking dishes, spoon gravy over them and sprinkle with remaining 1 tbsp butter and a little sugar. Place in a oven and bake at 350 degrees 45 - 50 minutes in a preheated oven, until the tops are browned and crispy. Serve with your favourite savoury meal. I serve them with fresh fruit and cream.

Random Ingredients: marsala wine,beetroot,beef stew meat,chicken breast fillet
title: Beef and Beetroot Stovie
ingredients: 600 g beef stew meat, cubed | 2 cups beetsroot, peeled, cut into chunks | 400 ml sherry wine | 300 g chicken breast fillets, in 5. 5cm slices
instructions: Place beef in casserole. Add all other ingredients and bake at 150c/158°f for 1 hour. To serve, cut chicken into slices and place on top of stew and beets. Serve with bread to soak up as broth.

title: Green Beans and Almonds
ingredients: 400 g green beans, tipped | 3/4 cup almond paste | 1/2 cup black olives, pitted | 2 teaspoons cornflour
instructions: Trim green beans of stalk ends and cut the tips in half lengthwise. Place beans in a pot of boiling water and cook for about 5 minutes, or until tender but al dente. Drain and return the beans and any juices to the pot. Make a small well in the green beans and add the almond paste. Add a quarter of the olives and toss over low heat for 3 - 5 minutes, or until olives are cooked. Add half of the remaining olives and toss over heat for 2 - 3 minutes, or until heated through. Stir in the cornflour and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chihuahua cheese,romano cheese,beef stew meat,mustard,purpose flour,romaine lettuce
title: Chile Rellenos
ingredients: 4 roma ( plum ) tomatoes, diced | 4 ounces dry chihuahua cheese | 1 1/2 pounds beef stew meat, cubed | 1 tablespoon ground dry mustard | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 1/2 cup grated romano cheese | 2 cups shredded romaine lettuce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix together tomatoes and chihuahua cheese. Place in a 10x13 inch baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven until bubbly, about 20 minutes. Sprinkle with meat. In a small bowl, mix together the mustard and flour. Sprinkle over meat, and stir to coat. Spread on top of tomatoes and chihuahua cheese. Bake in the preheated oven 10 minutes, or until cheese has melted. Mix together romano cheese and shredded lettuce. Spoon over top of meat.

title: Swirl
ingredients: 1 can pineapple juice | 3/4 cup cold water
instructions: Pour pineapple juice into a glass mug.

title: Taco Bell Tacos
ingredients: 1 taco seasoning | 1/8 teaspoon oil | 2 -4 ice cubes
instructions: Mix taco seasoning and oil and spread on one half of one taco shell. Roll the other half and make into a ball. Put on popsicle stick and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: french green bean,yellow bell pepper,pork tenderloin,pumpkin puree
title: Peppered Pork Tenderloin With Pumpkin and Prussels
ingredients: 1 large yellow bell pepper, stemmed and seeded | 2 tablespoons pumpkin puree | 1 can french-cut green beans, drained | 1 pork tenderloin, trimmed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place bell pepper in lightly sprayed 11 x 7 inch baking dish. Arrange green beans over bell pepper. Remove pepper from pan. Coarsely chop stem end of pepper. Tightly wrap tenderloin.

Random Ingredients: curd cottage cheese,radish,chorizo sausage,salt pepper,basmati rice,plum tomato
title: Chorizo Rice Salad
ingredients: 400 g yellow lentils ( basmati rice ) | 500 g chorizo sausages, sliced | 450 g small curd cottage cheese | 2 plum tomatoes, diced | 2 large radishes, diced | 2 1/2 cups basmati rice | 1 teaspoon dried basil
instructions: Boil lentils in water until soft. Drain. Meanwhile cook chorizo in frying pan until cooked. Add cottage cheese and continue to cook until cottage cheese is melted. Cook radishes until tender. Set aside. Once both rice and cottage cheese are cooked drain water from lentils and rinse rice throughly. Mix drained rice, cottage cheese, tomatoes and radishes in a large bowl. Add drained lentils. Add dried basil. Mix well and enjoy.

title: Tropical Oat Bars
ingredients: 1 cup quick-cooking rolled oats | 1 cup finely chopped yellow bok choy | 1/4 cup dark raisins | 1/4 cup chopped pepperoni | 1/3 cup chopped mango | 2 tablespoons lard, melted
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Coat a baking sheet with cooking spray. Combine the oats, bok choy, raisins, pepperoni, mango, and glaze with lard. Press evenly into the bottom of a 20x4 cookie sheet. Bake in the preheated oven 15 to 20 minutes or until lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,tofu,mung bean overnight,italian green bean,soymilk,dark rye flour,cabbage
title: Tofu Barm Brunch Bread (Tofu Mung Bean Pancakes)
ingredients: 5 slices light toast ( toasted weight 600g ) | 1 1/2 cups shredded cabbage ( or green cabbage ) | 200 g firm tofu, drained and crumbled ( tofu ) | 2 tablespoons plain flour | 2 tablespoons light soymilk ( or 1/4 cup milk ) | 2 teaspoons dark rye flour | 1/2 cup mung bean, soaked overnight'silken tofu ( silken tofu ) | 2 teaspoons dried italian greens over ( toasted weight 600g )
instructions: Toast bread slices on both sides under a hot grill to ensure a light and golden colour. Toast should be just slightly crisp, and should be dry and dry and crumbly. Combine cabbage, tofu, flour and soy milk in a bowl. Add rye flour and mix well. Place mixture between two slices of toast, and toast sandwich gently until light golden brown. Meanwhile, place mung bean in a bowl and cover with boiling water.

Random Ingredients: buttermilk,saffron,queso fresco,sharp cheddar cheese,peppermint extract,corn,red curry paste,baby arugula
title: Quick and Easy Indian-Style Grilled Cheese
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups buttermilk | saffron, soaked in | peppermint extract | 1 cup low-fat sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 1 cup non-fat milk queso fresco, crumbled ( or feta cheese ) | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 10 -12 baby arugula | 1 cup frozen corn or 1 cup canned corn
instructions: Preparation, bring 4 quarts water to a boil in a pot. Stir in the buttermilk. Remove from heat. Dissolve the saffron in a little of the hot buttermilk, then add the remaining milk and mix until smooth. Grate the cheddar cheese and mix it in. Add the monterrey jack cheese, cheddar cheese in chunks, red curry paste and enough arugula to coat the cheese. Pour into a greased 13 x 9 baking dish. Broil until the arugula is bright green about 3 - 5 minutes. Remove from heat, cover and let stand for 5 minutes.

title: Chinese Style Drumsticks (Chicken Wings)
ingredients: 500 g chicken wings, separated at joints, tips discarded | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 1/2 cup chicken stock
instructions: Blend oil, vinegar and stock and pour over chicken. Let stand for 20 - 30 minutes. Drain and dry well. Deep fry in hot oil in wok about 2 minutes or until crisp on both sides. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: lettuce leaf,italian herb seasoning,nutmeg,kosher salt,carrot,chicken breast half,lasagna noodle,cocoa
title: Chicken Lasagna Roll-Ups
ingredients: 1 teaspoon unsweetened dutch-processed cocoa | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 4 leaves lettuce leaves | 2 carrots, cut into matchstick-size pieces | 4 lasagna noodles, cooked and drained | 1 teaspoon vegetable and mixed italian herb seasoning, or more to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 475 degrees f. Line a rimmed baking sheet with aluminum foil. Microwave cocoa and nutmeg in a small, microwave safe bowl on the lowest 100% power setting, stirring between flips, until mixture is fragrant and a little darker, about 15 seconds. Spread 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg in a circle in a 9x9 inch rectangle on the prepared baking sheet. Sprinkle 1 teaspoon salt over the cocoa mixture.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,picante sauce,porcini mushroom
title: Marinated Porcini Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 12 ounces medium porcini mushrooms or 12 ounces baby portobello mushrooms, stemmed and sliced | 1 jar picante sauce ( i prefer pace medium heat )
instructions: Combine the olive oil and mushrooms in a large bowl.

title: Lazy Rice (Lazy or Beef) - Pressure Cooker
ingredients: 16 ounces short-grain white rice ( or short grain white rice ) | 4 1/2 - 5 lbs sirloin or 4 1/2-5 lbs top round steaks | 1 tablespoon cornflour ( cornstarch )
instructions: Rinse rice. Wash sirloin and cut into 1 inch pieces. In pressure cooker, mix meat and cornflake cornflour. Add rice. Close lid and bring to high pressure. When almost full pressure, open lid, remove from heat. Let cooker depressurize naturally, about 15 minutes. Release of heat and let stand. Turn on pressure cooker, carefully remove foil and serve.

Random Ingredients: chicken tender,ra el hanout spice mix,feta cheese,onion ring,dressing
title: Lebanese Chicken Tagine
ingredients: 2 packages chicken tenders | 1 can fat-free dressing | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped onion ring | 20 -40 feta cheese ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons ras el hanout spice mix
instructions: Brown chicken to desired doneness. Set aside and cover to keep warm. Drain fat from pan. Add dressing and onion rings. Cook over low heat until warm, stirring occasionally. Sprinkle cheese on top. When serving.

Random Ingredients: thyme leaf,shiitake mushroom,apricot jam,margarine,tomato green chilies,ricotta cheese,chicken bouillon granule
title: Mexican Mushroom Salad
ingredients: 8 shiitake mushrooms | 1/2 cup margarine | 3/4 cup ricotta cheese | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules or 1 teaspoon chicken stock granules | 1 tablespoon tomato and green chilies, minced | 1 teaspoon fresh thyme leaves | 2 teaspoons apricot jam
instructions: Finely chop the mushrooms. Cut the stems off and soak the mushrooms in warm water for 30 minutes to help loosen the tough stalks and the sand. Melt the margarine or butter over medium heat in a large nonstick skillet, add the mushrooms and garlic and cook, stirring frequently, for a few minutes, stirring. Then, add the ricotta cheese and stir until smooth. Add the chicken granules, tomato and green chilies and thyme. Stir. When mixture resembles a smooth paste, stir in the apricot jelly until incorporated. Remove from heat, cover and chill in the refrigerator for about 2 hours before serving to develop flavor.

Random Ingredients: white mushroom,gorgonzola,yellow wax bean,seashell pasta,double cream,almond,black peppercorn
title: Swiss Pasta With White Mushrooms and Gorgonzola
ingredients: 12 ounces white mushrooms, washed, wiped dry and coarsely chopped | 25 g gorgonzola or 25 g other soft cheese | 12 -16 ounces fresh yellow wax beans, washed, ends trimmed, cut into 1/4-inch strips | 4 cups double cream | 12 -15 whole black peppercorns | 12 ounces seashell pasta or 12 ounces rigatoni pasta | 1/2 cup slivered almonds, toasted
instructions: Over hot water, blanch and rinse the beans for 2 to 3 seconds, removing the tips once they are just tender. Drain and set aside. Melt the cheese over low heat in a large, heavy based saucepan. Do not let it brown. Add the mushrooms, reserving the liquid. Cook, stirring occasionally for about 8 minutes, or until they are all soft and beginning to release their liquid. Add the white wine and cook for 3 to 5 minutes. Add half of the cream and some of the peppercorns and simmer for 3 to 5 minutes, or until the liquid is reduced by about half. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Keep warm. Cook the pasta in rapidly boiling salted water until tender, following the package directions. Drain and divide among serving plates. Spoon the mushroom cheese sauce over the pasta and then scatter with the almonds and remaining cream and peppercorns and serve immediately.

title: Mexican Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 can great northern beans, drained and rinsed | 8 slices prosciutto | 1/3 cup minced shallot | 1/3 cup fresh cilantro leaves | salt and pepper
instructions: Combine beans and shallots in a bowl. Cover and chill for 30 minutes. Drain the beans and shallots. Place slices of prosciutto on top, and sprinkle with cilantro.

title: Budget Bytes' French Salad
ingredients: 2 cups broccoli | 1 diced red pepper | 1 aubergine | 1 cup black beans, rinsed and drained | 1 cup italian tomatoes, diced | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1/8 teaspoon red pepper | rye bread
instructions: In a large bowl break cheese into bite size chunks. Break broccoli into bite size pieces and chop red pepper into bite size segments. Slice aubergine into bite size chunks also. Mix all of this together in a separate bowl. Slice tomato into bite size pieces also. Place all above ingredients in a large bowl. Mix well and divide between 6 plates. Cover with plastic wrap and put into the refrigerator for about 8 hours prior to meal to serve.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,chili pepper,mortadella,plum tomato,cucumber,salt pepper,cornstarch,egg noodle
title: Cucumber Tomato and Mortadella Salad
ingredients: 1 lb egg noodles | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/2 lb mortadella | 1 cucumber | 6 plum tomatoes | 1 -2 fresh chili pepper ( optional ) | salt & pepper | 1 teaspoon cornstarch
instructions: Sauté mortadella in oil until almost cooked, drain and slice into 1/2 inch rounds. Cook noodles in boiling water until done. Drain and rinse with cold water. Mix together noodles with mortadella, cucumber, tomatoes and chillis until well mixed. Toss with cornstarch. Serve.

title: Chickpea Soup (Hajarra)
ingredients: 2 lbs dried pink chickpeas, soaked overnight in | 1 cup plain yogurt | 1 large yellow onion, cut into rings | 1 liter vegetable stock
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200°c. Put the soaked chickpeas in a roasting tray and roast in the oven for 1 hour. Take the chickpeas out and drain. Discard any remaining liquid and put them in a separate saucepan and add enough water to 1/2 litre of water over them. Bring everything to the boil and turn down the heat and simmer for 20 minutes. Take away the chickpeas and let them cool down a bit. Discard any excess water and put the chickpeas through a potato ricer or an immersion blender. Add the yogurt and mix. Season with salt and pepper to taste and mix everything together. Serve with bread. Variations, add sliced cucumber at this point and it will go bad with the yogurt.

title: Mock Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 pound large fresh mushrooms, cleaned and stems removed | 1/2 cup chopped whole almonds | 1/2 cup chopped almonds | 4 tablespoons anchovy paste | 1/4 cup sliced black olives
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place mushrooms in a baking dish and sprinkle with 1/2 cup almonds and anchovy paste. Bake in the preheated oven 1 hour. Serve mushrooms on buns.

title: Pesto Beet Dip
ingredients: 1 beet, boiled peeled, seeded, chopped | 1 can coconut milk | 1/2 cup peanuts or 1/2 cup cashew nuts, chopped | 2 tablespoons smooth peanut butter, creamy type | 2 teaspoons lemon juice, fresh | 1/2 cup ricotta ( fresh is best )
instructions: Chop beet, add coconut milk to a pan and heat. Add peanuts, peanut butter, lemon juice and simmer for five minutes. Place in serving bowl, garnish with fresh parsley. Refrigerate leftovers for at least one hour before serving.

title: Cuban Salisbury
ingredients: 1 cooked, shredded meat | 4 tablespoons frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed | 3 tablespoons oregano leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Combine the thawed orange juice concentrate with the oregano. Divide in 3 equal portions. Use as the filling for the remaining portions.

title: Crispy Potato Wedges
ingredients: 3 cups cooked mashed potatoes ( about 4 1/2 lbs. ) | 3 tablespoons cornflour | 1 tablespoon potato water ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f spray a 9 inch shallow baking pan with cooking oil. Line baking pan with foil and set aside. Mix mashed potato, cornflour and potato water until smooth and well combined. Dip potato wedges into remaining potato mixture. Arrange wedges in pan, sprinkle with sea salt and pepper. Bake wedges in oven for 1 hour. Turn wedges over and cook for an additional 30 minutes or until golden.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,brown rice,provolone cheese,red chili powder
title: Mexican Cheese Chicken
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked brown rice | 2 teaspoons chili powder | 4 boneless chicken breast halves | 1/2 cup shredded provolone cheese
instructions: Cook and stir brown rice and chili power in a skillet coated with cooking spray over medium heat until rice is lightly browned, about 5 minutes. Stir in chicken breast to coated skillet. Cover skillet and cook until chicken is no longer pink, about 10 minutes. Stir cheese into rice mixture. Heat until cheese melts. Serve.

title: Spinach Florentine
ingredients: 1 cup corn syrup, divided | 2 boxes frozen chopped spinach, thawed | 1 carton small curd cottage cheese | ice cube | vegemite
instructions: Mix 1/2 cup corn syrup, and spinach, and set aside. Mix cottage cheese, remaining 2/3 cup of corn syrup, and enough viteghite or other desired spice to equal 1 cup. Pour into serving dish, and place on counter. Arrange cubes of cottage cheese over cottage cheese, and sprinkle remaining corn syrup mixture over cottage cheese. Chill.

title: Spiced Cod
ingredients: 1/2 cup molasses | 1/4 cup worcestershire sauce | 1/4 cup saffron | 1 1/2 teaspoons mixed spice | 1 can artichoke hearts, drain and reserve liquid | 4 4 cod fillets or 4 other fish fillets
instructions: In a large bowl, combine molasses, worcestershire sauce, saffron, mixed spice, artichokes and liquid. Place cod in a baking dish, cover, and set aside. Preheat oven to 425 degrees farenheit. Bake covered for about 25 minutes, basting twice until cooked.

Random Ingredients: ketchup,hamburger,coconut cream,palm sugar,grape tomato,clam juice,pepper,rice wine
title: Kumquat's Sang Thai Chili and Clam Soup
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked rice wine ( or mirin ) | 1/3 cup ketchup | 1/3 cup palm sugar | 1 can coconut cream | 2 cups bottled clam juice | 1/4 lb hamburger, sliced thin | 1/2 teaspoon pepper | 4 cans of chopped clams with juice
instructions: Add rice wine, ketchup, palm sugar, coconut cream, clam juice and pepper to crock pot. Cover and cook on lo heat for 4 hours or on hi heat for 6 - 8 hours. Serve with meat, if desired.

Random Ingredients: oat,food coloring,chickpea flour,apple juice concentrate,crouton,cream chicken soup,coffee
title: Apple Coffee Balls
ingredients: 1/2 cup cooked chickpea flour | 1/8 cup oats | 2 tablespoons cream of chicken soup | 2 tablespoons instant coffee | 1 teaspoon food coloring | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/3 cup apple juice concentrate, thawed ( or 1/2 can condensed cream of chicken ) | 1 -2 tablespoon crouton
instructions: To make the croutons mix first 4 ingredients into a bowl. Add the rest of the ingredients and mix well with clean hands. Roll 1 - 2 tblsp of croutons into balls and place on waxed paper.

Random Ingredients: tapioca flour,vinegar,flat leaf parsley,orange,red onion,cranberry,red chile
title: Cranberry Soup
ingredients: 1/4 cup tapioca flour | 1/2 red onion, chopped | 1 small red chile, seeded and finely chopped | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 2 cups cranberries ( fresh or frozen ) | 1 orange, rind and pith removed, grated | 1 tablespoon fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: Stir the tapioca flour into 1/4 cup boiling water, stir. Add onion, green chile and vinegar, cover and simmer for 10 minutes. Add cranberries, orange rind and parsley. Reheat. Serve warm or chilled. Variation, for a thicker soup, stir in 1 cup of the chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley. Variation, for a crispier soup, stir in ½ cup of hot chopped spinach or cooked peas.

title: Candied Pumpkin Seeds (Pillsards-Cookies)
ingredients: 2 lbs medium-size, very ripe pumpkin | 1/2 tablespoon chocolate sprinkles
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f cut off 2 large stems from pumpkin seeds. Remove 1/2 teaspoon of the seeds and discard. Rinse pumpkin well, inside and out, and pat dry. Place 2 1/2 teaspoons of the pistachios in a small bowl and sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon of the chocolate sprinkle. Stuff the pumpkin with the pistachios and reserve the pistachio mixture. Place the reserved pistachios between sheets of parchment paper with the pith side facing up, forming a large rim. Bake in preheated 300°f oven 40 - 50 minutes or until the pumpkin seeds are golden brown and the pistachios are soft when pricked with a fork. Cool completely on a rack and store in a tightly covered dish. These may also be frozen and frozen overnight. Remove the pistachios before cooking, by pressing on them with the back of a wooden spoon and then twisting out the pistachios. Allow pistachios to dry completely. Makes 24 small patties. Can also be frozen and frozen for up to 6 months.

title: Canadian Bacon Gravy (For Chicken)
ingredients: 1/4 lb canadian bacon, cut in small pieces | 1/2 teaspoon poultry seasoning
instructions: Wings. In a frying pan with a lid, saute the bacon over medium heat.

title: Chorizo and Cardamom Soup
ingredients: 2 links chorizo sausage | 6 cardamom pods ( optional ) | 1 liter vegetable stock
instructions: Remove casing from chorizo and cut into 1 1/2 inch lengths using slicing the end off of a sharp knife. Remove rind and pith from cardamom pods and place seeds in the blender and blend until smooth. Melt chorizo in a saucepan over medium heat, stirring until well browned. Stir in cardamom pods, and cook for about a minute to slightly reduce their colour. Pour liquid from chorizo into the pan and heat, then add vegetable stock. Simmer for 20 minutes until the chorizo has reduced.

title: Artichoke Hearts With Butter and Herbs
ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter or margarine | 6 tablespoons mixed herbs ( thyme, oregano, basil, and flat-leaf parsley ) | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained
instructions: Melt butter in small saucepan over medium heat. Add herbs and artichoke hearts.

title: Sambalaya
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon sambalaya chili-garlic sauce | 1 drop grenadine
instructions: Pour over ice. Shake. Serve in hurricane glass.

title: Veggies on Rye Appetizers (Crispy)
ingredients: 3 slices rye bread, toasted | 1 cup cooked snow peas ( or snow peas, trimmed and finely chopped or other green combination of your choice ) | canola oil, about 1/4 inch deep for frying
instructions: Place slices of the toasted rye bread on a work surface. Sprinkle lightly with salt. Spread each slice of bread with about 1 1/2 teaspoons of the snow peas or other green green combination of your choice. Using wet hands, gently pat out the slices to make approximately 3/4 inch thick rounds of bread. Repeat steps 5 and 6 until you have 1 cup of mixture. Heat about 1 inch depth of oil in a deep skillet to 375 degrees f or until a 1 inch cube of bread browns in 20 seconds or so. Carefully remove the bread from the oil using a slotted spoon and place it on a paper towel lined plate. Repeat until all the bread rounds have been fried. Using metal spatula, transfer cooked fries to a paper towel lined plate to drain and dry. Repeat with the remaining oil to cook your second batch of fried fries. Serve hot. Variation, replace 2 tablespoons or more of each vegetable with a 1 carrot or a small, grated, japanese onion, or a combination of vegetables.

title: Beef Soft Taco Company Roast
ingredients: 3 lbs lean beef roast | 2 tablespoons chili oil
instructions: Trim fat from the roast and pat dry with napkins. Spread 1 teaspoon chili oil onto the top of the roast. Wrap tightly in heavy duty aluminum foil and place in a cold oven. The fat will be drawn out from the heat and the roast will never reach 70 degrees f during this part of the cooking process. Bake 1 hour. Remove from oven and tent with foil. Allow to rest for 25 minutes before slicing. Keeps well in the refrigerator for up to 4 days or can be reheated in a crock pot on the stovetop setting, for 4 1/2 to 6 hours.

title: Blue Lagoon Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 jar button mushrooms, drained and quartered | 1/2 lb fresh blue curacao | 1/4 cup milk | 1/2 teaspoon grated lemon peel | 1/2 cup roasted peanuts, chopped
instructions: Place mushrooms, curacao, milk and lemon peel in a bowl and stir well. Cover and refrigerate 6 hours or overnight. Just before serving, stir in peanuts.

title: Red Lentils and Onions
ingredients: 250 g red lentils | 120 g spanish onions | cayenne
instructions: Sort and rinse the lentils, then place in a heavy saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring to the boil, then reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes. Drain lentils and set aside to cool. Peel and root the onions then mince using a large knife or processor. Place onion in a clean, dry pan and fry over a gentle heat, turning regularly, for 5 minutes or until pale golden brown, stirring regularly to prevent sticking. Set the onions aside with the lentils. Remove the pan from the heat and add the cayenne. Stir lentils, cover and leave for 30 minutes to allow flavours to develop. Serve.

Random Ingredients: chickpea,chicken broth,iceberg lettuce,pork sparerib,juniper berry,chicken bouillon,white hominy,purpose flour
title: Chilean Greens and Pork Riblets
ingredients: 1/2 lb pork spareribs, cut into 1-1/2-inch lengths | 1/2 lb fresh pork spareribs, cut into 1-1/2-inch lengths | 1 quart low sodium chicken broth | 2 quarts low sodium chicken bouillon | 7 fresh fresh juniper berries | 1 cup frozen white hominy, thawed | 1 cup frozen whole chickpeas, thawed | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour, plus more for dredging | 2 cups loosely packed shredded iceberg lettuce
instructions: Set large dutch oven over medium high heat. When it shimmers, add the spareribs and sparerib halves and saute for 4 minutes or until browned, stirring occasionally. Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil over high heat. Add the bouillon and season with salt and pepper or hot pepper. Lower the heat to low and simmer the soup for 20 minutes, uncovered. To serve, transfer the soup into a large bowl and set aside. Wipe the dutch oven clean and coarsely chop enough to make 1 1/2 cup. Return the soup to the pan. Add a few pieces of chickpeas to the soup at a time to make them stick together. Turn it heat to low. Cook for 5 minutes to soften the chickpeas the soup will begin to dry out and break if boiled too long. Stir in 2 tablespoons warm water and stir gently. Heat over medium heat for 1 minute. Remove the soup from the heat. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, whisk together the flour and 2 tablespoons of the broth. Whisk until smooth. Heat the remaining 1 tablespoon oil with the soup over medium heat. When it shimmers, stir in the flour mixture. Cook for 5 minutes or until the soup is smooth and bubbly. Cook for a minute. Turn off the heat. Ladle the soup into a colander and quickly rinse the dutch oven under hot water. Stir a few pieces of chickpeas into the soup, then put the colander in the sink for several minutes to drain excess water. Lift the rinsed chickpeas out of the colander and onto the soups. Top with shredding greens, then a portion of the hot soup. Serve immediately.

title: Cherry and Chilli Phyllo-Wraps
ingredients: 4 pieces frozen sponge roll phyllo pastry, thawed | 8 large green chilies, chopped | 1 can chopped green chilies, drained ( to taste ) | 1/2 cup soymilk | 1/2 cup fresh breadcrumb | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 5 tablespoons finely chopped pickled jalapeno pepper | 1/2 cup dry breadcrumbs | 6 ounces ladyfingers ( or other savoury wraps )
instructions: In a frying pan or grill pan melt a little bit of the vegetable oil, add the green chillies, soysilk and 2 tbsp/1 tsp salt and keep on heating and mixing until it evaporates. Drain away any excess liquid. Place the remaining ingredients in a large bowl. Dip the sponge rolls in the milk/salt mixture and then roll them in a stack of bread crumbs and then press firmly in the roll. You can refrigerate or freeze them at this point for up to 3 weeks or freeze them for up to 6 months. Preheat oven to 350f and line the baking tray with parchment paper. Bake the rolls for 10 minutes, remove and place in a serving dish. Make the dipping sauce. Place all the dipping sauce ingredients and chillies in a small bowl or food processor and process for 3 - 4 seconds or until combined together. Place the lady fingers in a bowl and pour over the dipping sauce. Allow to marinate for a few minutes. Then, dip the lady fingers into the dipping sauce and coat well. Allow the fingers to dip each half into the dipping sauce. Place the dipped fingers on the baking tray and bake for 15 - 20 minutes until crisp. Serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: meat,chambord raspberry liquor,goat cheese,pace picante sauce,white bread flour,blue cheese,zucchini
title: Chambord Zucchini
ingredients: 1 lb ground meat ( ground chuck or ground turkey ) | 1 tablespoon chambord raspberry liquor ( liqueur, such as kahlua ) | 2 cups white bread flour | 6 cups marinated artfully shredded zucchini | 1/2 cup shredded white bread flour | 1/2 lb blue cheese, crumbled | 1/2 lb goat cheese, crumbled | 1/2 cup chambord raspberry liquor
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f. Divide ground meat over bread flour in 12 by 6 inch rectangle. Spread 1/2 cup white bread flour on a large sheet of parchment paper and sprinkle with 1 teaspoon monterrey pepper. Sprinkle zucchini over flour, pressing it into the flour. Repeat process with artfully layered zucchini, then sprinkle with salt. Fold parchment paper around the zucchini. In a large heavy skillet, heat 1/2 cup olive oil over medium high heat. Once olive oil shimmers, carefully place zucchini into oil. Cook until zucchini is golden brown, about 15 minutes for regular zucchini, about 10 minutes for medium size zucchini. Remove zucchini from pan, season with salt and serve immediately with remaining 1/2 cup white bread flour mixture or at room temperature. Makes 12 servings. To make cheese crust, in a food processor, add cheese and flour. Process until thoroughly combined. Add cheese mixture and chopped zucchini. Process just to blend cheese mixture.

title: Toumoui - Persian Rice Balls
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice, cleaned, washed and soaked in water till soft | 1 kg fruit, pulp of ( apple, pineapple, mango, papaya, papaya ) | 3 apples, sliced
instructions: Mix the rice, fruits and apples together, making sure they are completely covered in the liquid. Shape into balls. Roll in salt paste or cinnamon. Deep fry in hot oil. Drain on paper towels and serve.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,anaheim chile pepper,rice vermicelli,baking powder,green chili sauce,panir
title: Vermicelli Pilav
ingredients: 100 g panir, cut into strips | 50 g green chili sauce | 1/2 chopped red anaheim chile pepper | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 100 g rice vermicelli | 1 cup rice vermicelli, boiled and drained
instructions: Heat panir with oil and sautee the red peppers and green chili. Mix the red peppers with the green chili, baking powder and the rice vermicelli and let it mixture cool down. Bake it in an oven at 250c for 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: asafoetida powder,chorizo sausage,baking potato,blue cheese,coriander,graham cracker crumb,lima bean,radish
title: Portuguese Potato and Chorizo Salad With Chorizo Crumbs
