ingredients: 4 large baking potatoes | 500 g chorizo sausage | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1/2 cup lima beans or 1/2 cup pinto beans, drained ( canned are fine ) | 1/2 cup frozen sliced radishes, thawed and drained, leave them in the water | 3/4 cup freshly crumbled crumbled blue cheese | 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander | 4 -6 fresh coriander, to garnish ( optional )
instructions: Peel and thinly slice potatoes. Place the potato slices in a colander and rinse well with cold water. Toss with the chorizo and refrigerate until ready to use. In a small bowl, combine the asafoetida and lima beans with the chopped radishes and blue cheese. Season with ground coriander. Toss with the cooked potatoes until coated evenly. Garnish with fresh coriander leaves or serve over fresh salad greens. Variation, to remove excess flour from the chorizo, break it into small pieces and toss with the potato.

Random Ingredients: amaretto,onion hamburger bun,spinach leaf,coffee granule,watercress,bell pepper
title: Brazilian Pepper & Spinach Nests
ingredients: 1 cup watercress, stems removed | 1 bell pepper, chopped | 2 tablespoons onions, minced | 1 teaspoon instant coffee granules | 5 ounces fresh spinach leaves, coarsely chopped | 4 hamburger buns, split
instructions: Chop watercress and bell pepper and set aside. In a medium mixing bowl, combine chopped watercress, bell pepper, onion, coffee granules, and spinach and mix well to combine. Chill until ready to serve. Heat a non stick 10 inch nonstick skillet over medium high heat. When just right, add nests and cook 2 - 3 minutes or until heated through and set. Top with remaining onion/watercress mixture and serve.

title: Swiss Steak
ingredients: 1 medium spanish onion, thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 teaspoon granulated sugar syrup | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 3 lbs round steaks | 1/2 cup water
instructions: In a small bowl blend marjoram, sugar syrup, marjoram, soup and water. Rub mixture on both sides of steak. Cover with plastic wrap and marinate at least 1 hour or overnight. To keep steak tender cook the meat 1 hour at high heat or 4 hours at medium temperature. The water will help remove all impurities from meat and prevent it from floating. Serve over spaghetti or use for sandwiches. Note, cook time does not include marinade.

Random Ingredients: curry paste,vanilla extract,beef eye,rice paper,chocolate chip,mint,black peppercorn,red wine
title: Yogurt Beef Jerky from Asian Restaurant for 2
ingredients: 6 ounces beef eye of round | 12 sheets rice paper sheets | 1/4 cup dry red wine ( not diet ) | 1 cup low-fat yogurt cheese or 1 cup yogurt | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant curry paste | 1/2 red sweet chili pepper, seeded and minced | 1/4 cup of fresh mint, minced ( not dried ) | 1 pinch of coarsely-ground black peppercorns
instructions: Heat grill to high and let dry the beef eye and ensure it is evenly grilled and cooked. While grill is heating up, slice beef crosswise into 1/4 inch slices, about 1/8 inch thick. Remove from wrap with 2 slices side by side, brush with red wine and wrap with damp paper towels. Place beef slices on grill racks and cook until internal read thermometer reads 160f in the thickest part of the beef, about 5 minutes. Turn on metal skewers to a cooler part and let rest 1 minute. With a brush, lightly brush off excess liquid. Place 1 1/2 rice noodles in a large bowl of cold water and soak until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain, cover, and refrigerate until chilled and firm, about 10 minutes. Slice beef into 1/4 inch slices. Toss with yogurt, curry paste, and chili pepper. Season with mint and black peppercorns. Set aside.

title: Tortilla Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup cottage cheese | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1/2 cup beef broth | 1 can tortillas
instructions: In bowl, combine cottage cheese and garam masala. Pour beef broth into a blender. Blend well. Spoon 1/2 cup of the mixture into the tortilla and roll. Place in microwaveable bowl. Microwave for 15 seconds on high.

title: Baked Butternut Squash and Cinnamon Pilaf
ingredients: 1 lb butternut squash | 1 lb panir | 2 tablespoons currants | 2 tablespoons creole seasoning ( or other dry seasoning mix your own recipe requires ) | 1 tablespoon dried cranberries
instructions: Cut squash in half lengthwise and cut crosswise into ½ inch slices. Place in a bowl and toss with 1/2 of the spices. Coat a baking pan with cooking spray, and place squash in pan. Drain any liquid that has accumulated on the baking sheet. Place pan over medium high heat and bring to a boil. Lower heat and simmer 15 minutes and stir in 1/2 of the currants. Stir remaining currants in the same pan and cook until golden but not dry. Place the golden pilaf in a serving dish and top with the cinnamon puree. Sprinkle the remaining 2 t of cinnimon and dried cranberries on top of the pilaf. Note, add fresh or frozen cranberries during the last few minutes of cooking if your pan is dry before adding the squash.

Random Ingredients: flour,guava,cooking wine,lime juice zest,pepperoni,bell pepper,rump steak,corn syrup
title: Guava Steak With Fiery Peppered Peppers and Guava Nests
ingredients: 12 ounces guava, halved lengthwise | 3 tablespoons flour | 1 tablespoon corn syrup | 2 teaspoons lime juice and zest | 1/8 teaspoon pepper | 1 cup cooking wine | 8 ounces pepperoni, thinly sliced | 14 ounces rump steak or 14 ounces round steaks
instructions: Trim steak and slice across the grain into 3/4 inch thick strips. Place flour, cornstarch, lime juice, pepper and wine in a 2 - 3 qt shallow dish. Add steak and turn to coat in marinade. Cover and refrigerate for 3 hours or overnight. Remove steak from refrigerator and pat dry. Heat gas Grill or charcoal grill to medium high heat. Cook meat for 4 - 6 minutes per side or to your liking.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,chicken leg,white flour,chili powder,portabella mushroom
title: Spicy Chicken
ingredients: 3 dried portabella mushrooms | 1/2 cup white flour | 6 whole chicken legs, thigh | 1 2/3 cups basmati rice | 1 teaspoon chili powder
instructions: Remove any gizzards from mushrooms and rinse under cold water. Remove any white tissues, tear into 2 inch pieces. Cut into 2 inch cubes and place in bowl. Dredge chicken in flour and coat with dried seasoning. Heat large frypan to boiling in approximately 1 inch of oil. Add chicken legs and thighs and fry till chicken is crisp and browned on all sides and juices run clear. Stir frequently as chicken browns. Add mushrooms and rice and continue cooking for 2 minutes. Stir in more hot oil and remove from heat. Serve in warmed bowls.

Random Ingredients: chuck steak,shell pasta,prune,ricotta cheese,ranch salad dressing,red wine vinegar,rice vinegar
title: Beef, Red Wine, and Nuts With Shellfish
ingredients: 1 lb boneless chuck steak, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 package small shell pasta, such as wagon wheels or ( 16 ounce ) package other small shell pasta | 2 bottles ranch salad dressing | 1 1/2 cups red wine vinegar | 1 package ricotta cheese | 12 pitted prunes, cut into quarters | 1 cup rice vinegar
instructions: In a large resealable plastic bag, add the beef, and toss to coat with the coating sauce. Place in a gallon ziplock bag, and add the dressing, and seal tightly. Place in the refrigerator to marinate for at least 1 hour and up to 24 hours. Meanwhile, in a large pot or medium pot of boiling water, cook the pasta until tender but firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain well. Toss the hot pasta with the ranch salad dressing, and reserve. When ready to serve, add the pasta to the beef, along with the prunes and the vinegar. Toss well, and serve.

title: Green Curry Paste Manchego Cheese
ingredients: 80 g manchego cheese, grated | 200 g thai green curry paste ( available at most indian grocery stores )
instructions: Drain all excess water out of the cheese and put it in a bowl. Add the curry paste, then mix. Add the reserved cheese and mix again. Cover with plastic wrap then put a non stick frying pan on the stovetop. Turn the heat to medium, and when the pan starts to smoke, pour the mixture in. You can also add a splash of oil here if you like. Try to press the paste to the sides, then cover and leave for 5 minutes, or until cheese has completely melted. If the paste starts to burn, stir and cover for around 1 minute, then remove. Serve with jasmine rice or other indian bread or naan breads.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,new potato,chow mein noodle
title: Chinese-Style White Rice and Potato Salad (Noodle Salad)
ingredients: 1 cup long grain white rice, rinsed | 1 package chow mein noodles ( ramen noodles ) | 1 bag new potatoes, quartered
instructions: Place rice and noodles in 3 1/2 to 4 quart slow cooker. Stir in chow mein noodles and potatoes. Cover, and cook on low for 7 - 9 hours.

Random Ingredients: maple syrup,celery seed,kidney bean,mustard powder,rice noodle,chicken meat
title: Hot Rice Noodle Kebabs
ingredients: 1 cup cooked chicken meat, shredded | 14 ounces kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 1 tablespoon dry mustard powder | 1 tablespoon celery seed | 1 package uncooked rice noodles
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together the chicken, kidney beans, maple syrup, mustard powder, celery seed, and rice noodles. Cover, and refrigerate 8 hours before serving.

title: Easy Garam Masala Butter for Fish or Chicken
ingredients: 2 cups heavy whipping cream | 1 1/2 teaspoons garam masala powder ( or other curry powder ) | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala powder ( or other curry powder )
instructions: Combine cream, garam masala powder, and garam masala.

title: Sausage and Black Beans
ingredients: 1 lb hot italian sausage | 1 lb dried black beans | 1/2 - 3/4 cup butter or 1/2-3/4 cup olive oil
instructions: In a large soup pot, add the beans and cover. Turn down the heat, cooking to your liking and cook uncovered until the beans are tender. When done, break apart the beans with a wooden spoon. Add the butter/olive oil to the skillet. Drain the beans and add them to the skillet. Stir and heat until thoroughly combined. Serve immediately. This is good served over egg noodles, fresh veggies or rice.

title: Camote (Mexican Chayote and Chipotle Dip)
ingredients: 1 chayote, peeled and chunked | 1 cup catsup | 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves
instructions: Place chayote and catsup in a saucepan together with seasonings. Bring to a boil, then reduce to simmer. Cook, uncovered, until tender, 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chili sauce,farfalle pasta,egg white,egg noodle,ricotta cheese
title: Pasta With Noodles
ingredients: 1 package egg noodles | 1 egg white | 1/2 cup fat free ricotta cheese | 1/4 cup chili sauce | 1 cup farfalle pasta, cooked
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. Drain and chill. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In small bowl, combine egg and egg white over cold water until frothy. Add ricotta cheese and chili sauce. Mix until smooth. Stir into noodles. Spoon into greased 1 quart casserole. Cover and bake for 15 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake uncovered for 45 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: beef brisket,nonfat milk,poultry seasoning,fennel bulb,apple,green cardamom pod,mustard
title: Crispy Corned Beef and Apple
ingredients: 5 lbs corned beef brisket ( i have had foil laid across to help it clean up ) | 5 lbs apples, thinly sliced, peeled cored ( i used 1 medium ) | 1 fennel bulb, outer stalks sliced or 1 small bulb, outer stalks sliced 1/4-inch to 1/2 inch thick | 1/4 cup nonfat milk, plus more for brushing | 3 tablespoons prepared mustard | 1 tablespoon poultry seasoning | 1 tablespoon ground mustard | 2 green cardamom pods, bruised
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees. Lay corned beef on rack in roasting pan. Brush with milk. Sprinkle with fennel, chopped apple, spice mixture and salt. Place in hot oven and roast 40 minutes or until just barely tender. Remove from oven. Drizzle with remaining 2 tablespoons milk. Cool until warm, then refrigerate 1 hour. Slice thinly across grain. Serve with warm home made mustard and some mixed greens. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: cointreau liqueur,thyme,hot italian sausage,mayonnaise,pecorino romano cheese,almond paste
title: Spicy Stuffed Pecorino
ingredients: 8 -10 tablespoons hot italian sausage ( or any other mild italian sausage ) | 2 teaspoons fresh thyme, leaves picked, stems discarded | 1/4 cup pecorino romano cheese, grated ( or more to taste ) | 1/4 cup mayonnaise | 1/4 cup almond paste, toasted ( see note ) | 1/4 cup cointreau liqueur or 1/4 cup orange liqueur | 1 tablespoon cointreau liqueur or 1 tablespoon orange juice
instructions: Note, you can make your own mayonnaise by beating together mayonnaise with 1/4 cup cointreau in small bowl, adding 1 tablespoon cointreau, 1 tablespoon orange juice, and 1/2 teaspoons hot pepper flakes until combined. If using hot italian sausage, add it to the mixture after cooking. You may not need the entire 1/4 cup of cointreau if you are using hot italian sausage. You want it to get in all of the air into the mixture. If you used mild italian sausage, add it now. Preheat oven to 400°f place sausage on a cutting board. Using very sharp knife, slice 1/4 inch thick slices against the grain. Place on a cookie sheet or broiler pan lined with parchment paper. Note, the more slices you make, the harder the bread will be. Using a large spoon, spread 1/4 cup cointreau in the bottom of each slice. Place a sausage slice on top of each of these slices. Sprinkle generously with the fresh thyme. Cut several slits in the center of each bread slice with a slice of sharp knife. Sprinkle cheese evenly on top of each bread slice. If using orange zest, add to the top of each bread slice with zest. If using dried orange zest, add it now. Bake 15 - 25 minutes or until the outside of each bread slice turns golden and the cheese has melted. Watch closely so cheese doesn't burn.

title: Spicy Shrimp Cocktail for One!
ingredients: 20 -24 small shrimp ( or large shrimp of various kinds ) | 20 - 24 lettuce leaves
instructions: Peel shrimp if using peeled ones and set aside. Using a pestle and mortar or whatever you like, mash the shrimp, garlic and salt together. They should not be chopped into larger pieces. Arrange shrimp on lettuce leaves if desired. If you don't mind shrimp in the mix, try sprinkling a little bit of dried basil around the mix.

title: Sweet Corn Salad
ingredients: 5 small corn, whole husked | 1/2 cup balsamic vinegar, good quality | 1 tablespoon lemon peel, finely minced | 1 tablespoon chili paste, good quality | 1 tablespoon rose water, plus more | rose water, to taste ( optional, but encouraged! ) | cayenne ( optional )
instructions: In a medium saucepan of boiling water, cook corn on medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes, or until just tender. Drain corn on towels and cool. When cool enough to handle, cut off kernels and discard husks. Blend corn, balsamic, lemon peel, chili paste, rose water& cayenne. Taste and adjust seasoning as required.

Random Ingredients: chicken,salt black pepper,coriander,italian seasoning,beef bouillon cube,rice noodle
title: Simple Beef Noodle Crock Pot Soup
ingredients: 1 bag rice noodles | 2 lbs ground beef or 2 lbs ground turkey | 1/2 cup coriander | 2 -3 tablespoons italian seasoning | 2 teaspoons beef bouillon cubes or 2 teaspoons granules | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Soak and prepare noodles as directed. Cook meat until cooked and drain. Heat the broth until boiling. Add coriander, pepper, and seasonings. Add noodles. Cook, stirring occasionally for about 5 minutes or until noodles become tender.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,bread dough,beef bouillon cube,quinoa,sugar,glutinous rice
title: Sautéed Meat, Quinoa & Meat Pies
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa or 1 cup bulgur | 1 cup bread dough ( plain or firm ) | 1 cup glutinous rice | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 1 teaspoon granulated sugar | salt & freshly ground black pepper | glutinous rice, for coating tops
instructions: In a small bowl, pour in the quinoa / bulgur and rinse well. Cover & set aside. When you're ready to cook your rice, place your rice cooker on your work surface & put the water on the machine. If it doesn't already come with beef cubes, make sure a small cut is out of the side of the steamer lid/pan. Place a bowl of hot water on the bottom of the steamer, but not on top of your rice cooker lid. Place all the rice in a medium sized mixing bowl & mix with your hand. Dissolve the bouillon cubes into the water in the pan, bring to the boil & then turn down to low. The water should be cloudy, but not so that it starts to water. Cover & set aside. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper & lightly spray with oil spray. Place the meat mixture into the prepped baking sheet. Carefully spoon the rice around the edges. Cover & set aside. When your timer goes off, set the oven to 400 degrees f or about 30 minutes before it's finished resting. Cook the meat mixture for about 25 minutes until it's brown & firm. While the meat mixture is resting, place the glutinous rice into a small bowl & cover with hot water to soften. Set aside & leave to soak for 10 minutes. Drain well & transfer to a medium sized saucepan. Use the back of a spoon to press the rice against the bottom and up the sides a little to make holes in the rice, creating holes that will help seal the steam inside the rice. Add a bit more water if the rice is sticking to the bottom of the pan. Add the sugar & mix well, making sure the sugar is dissolved, but not too much. Stir in the rice, mixing well & set aside. Once the meat mixture is finished resting, put it onto a cutting board & using a long knife, cut meat & glutinous rice into thin strips and then set aside. Place about 3 tablespoons of the reserved meat mixture into the rice mixture. Roll the block of rice around the meat mixture using your hands so the rice sticks completely to the bamboo rolling pin. Use a sharp knife to cut the meat mixture into small squares. Coat each of the meat squares with a little oil then place on the rice. Allow to sit for at least 5 hours & up to 1 day before serving.

title: Brown Lentils Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons brown lentils | 2 tablespoons old fashioned oats | 1 small head leaf lettuce, torn into bite-size pieces | salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Place lentils in a large pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low.

Random Ingredients: olive oil,dark molasses,currant,english cucumber,spinach leaf,chili sauce,clove,fettuccine pasta
title: Spinach and Cucumber Noodle Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces dried fettuccine pasta | 10 ounces spinach leaves | 1 english cucumber, halved lengthways and seeded | 1 cup currant | 1/4 cup dark molasses | 1 3/4 cups sweet chili sauce | 50 g dark molasses | 1/4 cup olive oil | 1/8 teaspoon ground cloves
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions, drain and place spinach and cucumber in a large salad bowl. Wash and dry spinach and cucumber and combine with pasta. Combine remaining ingredients, pour over pasta and mix well.

title: Danish Krapjes (Beef Dip")
ingredients: 1 lb sour top sirloin steak | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons cornstarch
instructions: Trim excess fat off meat. Slice steak into thin strips. Add 1/2 cup vinegar to sour sirloin and brown over medium high heat. Add cornstarch mixture and remaining vinegar, stir to combine. Cook until mixture thickens, stirring constantly. Transfer to slow cooker dish. Serve with pumpernickel or rye bread.

title: Indian Peas & Curry Brownies
ingredients: 14 1/4 ounces brownie mix | 2 tablespoons hot curry paste | 2/3 cup frozen green pea
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Spray an 8 pie plate with cooking spray. Prepare brownie mix according to package directions. Spread brownie mix in pie plate. Spread curry paste over brownie mix. Top with peas. Sprinkle with remaining brownie mix. Bake at 325°f for 30 minutes or until a knife inserted in the centers comes out clean.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti squash,glace cherry,dark rum,orange juice,bean sprout,coriander seed,drinking chocolate
title: Spicy Chocolate Glazed Spaghetti Squash
ingredients: 1 spaghetti squash | glace cherries | 1 ounce drinking chocolate, good quality | 1/4 cup orange juice | 1/4 cup firmly packed coriander seed | 1 tablespoon dark rum or 1 tablespoon amaretto | freshly chopped fresh coriander ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350f and line a baking sheet with foil. Cut the spaghetti squash in half lengthwise and remove the flesh. Using a fork, mash the flesh to a coarse crumb consistency. Put to one side then put the oven on, gas mark 3/160f. Halve the cherry and add to the spaghetti.

Random Ingredients: rice,red potato,naan bread,thyme sprig,fish sauce,cream sherry,squash
title: Crunchy Potato and Squash Casserole
ingredients: 3 red potatoes, scrubbed ( about 1.5kg each ) | 150 g long grain rice | 400 ml light cream sherry | 1 1/2 tablespoons fish sauce | 300 g small squash, ends trimmed and cut into wedges ( about 5oz each ) | fresh thyme sprig ( optional ) | naan bread, to serve
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c. Bring a large pan of salted water to the boil over high heat. Add the potato pieces and cook for 4 - 6 minutes or until just tender. Drain. Meanwhile, place the rice, cream sherry and fish sauce in a large bowl. Add the potatoes, squash and thyme. Season with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Spoon into a lightly oiled 6cm x 12cm ovenproof dish. Bake in the oven, for 15 - 20 minutes until golden and bubbling.

title: Chicken and Almond Soup
ingredients: 4 teaspoons almond butter, about | 1 tablespoon minced fresh tarragon or 2 teaspoons dried tarragon | 4 boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut into 2 cm pieces | 3/4 cup finely sliced plum tomato | 3/4 cup light cream | 1 1/2 - 2 cups vegetable stock | sour cream, to serve ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees c. Grease 2 - 8 cup pie dishes. Heat a frying pan over moderate heat. Add the almond butter. When the almond butter foams, add the tarragon. Increase the heat to high and fry the chicken until browned all over. Remove chicken to a plate and set aside. Add the tomato to the frying pan and cook, stirring, until softened. Return the chicken to the pan along with the cream. Bring to the boil, add the chicken juices and simmer, covered, for about 15 minutes. Taste for seasoning and add a little more salt and pepper. Serve warm with plain, toasted bread. Serve with sour cream if you desire.

Random Ingredients: hard egg,pinto bean,chicken breast,radish,fish sauce,thai red curry paste
title: Easy Chicken-And-Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans, drained | 1 small hard-boiled egg, chopped | 1 medium radish, sliced | 2 tablespoons thai red curry paste | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast, halved
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the pinto beans, egg, radish, curry paste, fish sauce, and salt and pepper to taste. Toss to coat. Toss with the chicken and serve.

title: Kielbasa in Summa Soup
ingredients: 2 large summer squash, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 2 bags kielbasa
instructions: Put 1 pound of the sausage at the bottom end of the bag. Push the bag to one side of the bag. Slide the sausage on top of the sausage. Push the bag as gently as possible to remove the air that is being stuck to it. When the bag is in between the sausage and the bag remove the sausage and discard. Break the sausage up with your hands as much as you can with your hands. In a large sauce pot, bring water to a boil. Plunge the kielbasa into the boiling water. Using a slotted spoon, put the kielbasa out of the water and onto the plate with a slotted spoon or napkin. Turn the stovetop to high, and drop the bag of kielbasa inches. The kielbasa will be slightly crunchy and not very hard. Cook the kielbasa for 1 minute. Using a slotted spoon, remove the kielbasa onto the top of the boiled soup. Continue to cook the soup, stirring occasionally until the sausage dries. You'll need to stir this every few minutes, up to 2 hours. Do not let the kielbasa get too dark, and continue cooking for about 15 minutes until all the juice has been out of the sausage. Do not let it boil. Once the sausage is done and cooked, remove from the heat. Serve hot.

title: Roast Beef With Pumpkin and Dumplings
ingredients: 4 ounces beef tenderloin | 1/2 cup cold mashed pumpkin | 1 1/2 cups white flour
instructions: Put the beef tenderloin in a pan and cover with water. Bring to a boil. Reduce the heat, cover and simmer for 30 minutes.

title: Steak With a Bordelaise Sauce
ingredients: 6 slices aged bordelaise steak | 2 tablespoons minced beef bouillon | 1/4 cup iceberg lettuce or 1/4 cup salad greens, to serve
instructions: Combine beef in a large frying pan with bouillon. Cook, covered over low heat, until beef is cooked through, 20 to 25 minutes. Remove meat with a slotted spoon and drain excess fat from pan. Slice meat into thin slices, and arrange across a large salad plate. Wilt lettuce leaves in a salad bowl. Pour off any excess liquid from pan, and spoon bouillon over beef slices. Serve sliced beef atop lettuce. If desired, drizzle with a little extra bouillon, to serve.

title: Easy Baked Veal
ingredients: 450 g veal | 1 small turnip
instructions: Wash all the pieces and pick over to get rid of any blood, including the tops. Cut into thick slices, about 5 x 5 x 1. Put them in a large roasting tin which has been lightly tented with foil or lightly oiled. Cover with oiled plastic wrap and bake in a preheated oven at 200c for 1 hour and 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: red food coloring,almond extract,dill pickle,baby spinach,lime zest,dressing,red onion,yogurt
title: Spinach Salad With Chilled Lime Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup baby spinach ( packed ) | 1/4 cup diced red onion | 1/4 cup finely diced yogurt | 1 tablespoon lime zest | 2 tablespoons roasted almonds | 1 tablespoon red food coloring | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon almond extract | fat free dressing : | 1/2 cup fat free yogurt
instructions: Combine yogurt and lime zest in small bowl. Gradually add yogurt mixture and almond extract until blended. Refrigerate and stir at least 3 to 4 hours before serving until desired texture and consistency is reached. Toss with spinach.

Random Ingredients: tamari,soya sauce,corn syrup,horseradish sauce,vanilla essence,grand marnier
title: Soy and Horseradish Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup light soy sauce | 1/4 cup tamari ( dark soy sauce ) | 1/4 cup golden syrup ( raw sugar or agave syrup ) | 1 teaspoon sesame horseradish sauce ( dark soy sauce or black soy sauce ) | 1 teaspoon grand marnier | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together in a bowl until well combined. Use right away, or store in a jar in the fridge, it will last for an extra week. Great over pasta.

Random Ingredients: shiitake mushroom,garlic salt,pasta sauce,pea,lemon,italian bread,baking potato,rom tomato
title: Pasta & Peas
ingredients: 1 small lemon, peeled and quartered | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 tablespoon lemon rind, finely grated | 1 lb shiitake mushroom | 6 medium baking potatoes, scrubbed | 1 can pasta sauce | 1 cup frozen peas | 1 medium roma tomato, diced | 2 cups italian bread, cut into 1-inch cubes
instructions: Cut the lemons in half lengthwise. Using a tablespoon or tablespoon, scoop out the flesh from the rind and discard the peel. Stir the rind and garlic salt into the flesh of the lemon rind. Wash and finely chop the mushrooms. Slice the potatoes in half lengthwise. Add the potatoes, cover and cook over low heat until the potatoes are very tender, about 25 minutes. Reserving the water, drain the mushrooms, reserving the cooking water and slice them finely. When the potatoes are done, drain and return to the wok, add the mushroom water, and cook until the liquid has reduced slightly. Add the pasta sauce, peas and tomatoes, and stir for 1 minute or until heated through. To serve, lightly crush the bread cubes with a garlic-flavored spoon and transfer to a serving plate. Spoon the cheesy sauce over the bread.

Random Ingredients: bacon grease,baking powder,mango chutney,vegetable oil,sugar,beef gravy
title: Easy Mango Chutney Corned Beef
ingredients: 2 1/2 tablespoons bacon grease | 1 lb cubed corned beef, cut into 1 cubes ( or use a mixture of your favourite beef and vegies ) | 3 tablespoons mango chutney | 3 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 1/4 cup sugar
instructions: Pre heat oven to 350 degrees. In a medium skillet, melt 1 tbs of bacon grease. Add the cubed beef and cook over medium high heat until browned. In a medium bowl, mix together the remaining bacon grease, mango chutney, vegetable oil and baking powder. Stir the chutney mixture into the beef. In a nonstick skillet, heat the remaining bacon grease over medium high heat. Sear the corned beef about 5 minutes.

title: Macaroni & Peas
ingredients: 1/2 cup macaroni | 2 cups peas, shelled | 3 cups water | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder
instructions: Boil water and add macaroni and peas. Boil for 5 - 10 minutes. Reduce heat and add pepper and cumin powder. Simmer for 3 minute.

title: Apple Packed in Syrup
ingredients: 1 cup raw apple juice ( or apple jelly ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons golden syrup | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt ( or to taste ) | 1 pinch black pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. If using apple jelly, pour into 1 cup pats and spread evenly. Bake in oven for 10 minutes. Then turn pats over and bake for an additional 5 minutes. Remove pats and drizzle with cold water. When completely cool, pour onto a plate covered with cling wrap and spread as necessary. Place in fridge.

title: Veal Scaloppine With Parsley Herb Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 20 green veal scallopsini | 1/2 cup fresh flat leaf parsley, leaves stripped, plus 1/4 cup sprigs extra | 1 lime, zest of, grated
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f place the veal scallops on a shallow baking sheet and place in the oven to bake for 12 minutes, or until cooked through. Remove from the oven and arrange on a serving platter. Sprinkle with parsley and zest, then drizzle over some of their cooking liquid.

title: Simple Beef Custard
ingredients: 1 cup beef broth | 1/2 cup custard powder
instructions: Pour into a shallow serving dish. Place in cold oven until the beef is cold enough to handle. Remove beef and reserve. Combine broth and custard powder. Add beef and stir until combined. Pour mixture into an ovenproof casserole dish. Cook, uncovered, in a 350 degree oven until custard is golden and crisp, about 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon,black bean,lamb shoulder,napa cabbage,phyllo pastry,currant,mustard,orange peel
title: Moroccan Lamb and Bean Casserole
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried black beans, preferably bush's red eye dried | 1 teaspoon ground mustard | 3/4 lb boneless lamb shoulder ( about 3 1/2 lb. ) | 2 1/2 cups shredded napa cabbage | 1 2/3 cups dried currants | 1 cube chicken bouillon ( about 1 1/2 teaspoons ) | 1 medium orange peel, coarsely grated | 1 package phyllo pastry sheets, thawed
instructions: Combine the beans and mustard in a bowl, add the lamb and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate, turning occasionally and adding water as needed, until the meat is very tender, about 2 hours. Drain the lamb, reserving the liquid in a medium saucepan, and transfer it to a bowl. Add 2 1/2 cups of the cabbage, the currants, chicken bouillon and orange peel.

Random Ingredients: port wine,white onion,navel orange,cream mushroom soup,hoisin sauce,kernel corn,five spice powder
title: Spicy Orange & Mushroom Stuffing
ingredients: 1 navel orange, peeled and sliced | 1/4 cup diced white onion | 4 cups fresh whole kernel corn, thawed | 0.5 can cream of mushroom soup ( can make ahead ) | 1/3 cup port wine | 1/2 cup hoisin sauce | 1/2 teaspoon five-spice powder ( i like my foods spicy! )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Mix all ingredients in a large bowl until well mixed and distributed. Pour mixture into a baking dish. Bake 45 minutes at 400 degrees.

title: Fried Noodles With Bran
ingredients: 1 cup whole wheat bran | cooking spray | 2 tablespoons ghee ( clarified butter or vegetable oil ) | 1 package egg noodles
instructions: In medium sized skillet heat ghee on medium. Add whole wheat bran. Stir to combine. Cook about an 10 - 15 minutes, stirring constantly. You will need to flip the skillet occasionally, so keep stirring. Break the noodles into small pieces and add them to the skillet in small increments, stirring. Keep stirring until all dry ingredients are moistened. Add ghee. Stir until all moisture is absorbed. Serve warm or chilled.

title: Pesto Stuffed French Bread
ingredients: 12 slices baguette | 1 jar refrigerated pesto sauce ( store-bought, store-bought may be substituted ) | 1 cup sliced green chili ( from the jar ) | 1/2 cup chopped fresh basil or 1/2 cup shredded mexican basil | 1 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa ( for top )
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees. Cut a thin slice off the top side of the baguette and scoop out some of the bread from the bread. Scoop out the bread from each inside into a bowl, leaving a 2” shell, and spread pesto on the bread. Mix together green chiles, chopped basil, and cocoa.

title: Scallops on the Half Shell
ingredients: 12 large sea scallops | 1/2 lb bulk sliced bacon or 1/2 lb bacon | 15 medium mushroom stems, stems removed | fresh salsa
instructions: Fill a large, heavy pot with water. Place scallops in water. Bring water until scallops are no more than 3/4 of the way submerged. Remove half of the scallops from water and set aside. Repeat with scallops. Place scallops in a large bowl. Cut the bacon in half crosswise and slice thinly crosswise. Place scallops in the water, set aside, and soak for 15 minutes. Drain liquid and set aside. Remove scallops from water and set aside. In a large skillet, pour enough water to cover scallops. Bring to a boil. Place scallops in boiling water. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer until scallops are cooked through, about 3 to 5 minutes. Drain scallops and place in a large serving bowl. Remove all but 1/2 cup of the liquid from skillet. Return shrimp broth to the skillet. Add mushrooms cover, and simmer until liquid is almost evaporated, about 5 minutes. Add salsa and cook just until heated through.

title: Poppy Seed, Watermelon and Parsnip Mash (Shalmi Raita)
ingredients: 3 parsnips, peeled and coarsely grated | 3 cups watermelon, diced | 2 tablespoons poppy seeds | 1 1/2 cups heavy cream, whipped ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon finely chopped red bell pepper
instructions: Place the parsnips and watermelon in a large pan with just enough water to cover, bring to the boil and cook for 10 minutes. Drain well then allow to cool slightly. Using a pestle and mortar and grinding, work the pulp into a smooth puree in a blender or food processor. Add the poppy seeds and blend well. Add the whipping cream and red bell pepper and blend until the puree is smooth, about 1 minute. If the mixture is too thick to blend, gradually add a little water. Transfer the mixture to a large serving bowl, sprinkle over the poppy seeds and chill at least 2 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: portabella mushroom,red pepper,daikon sprout,golden raisin,extra virgin olive oil,flour tortilla,ancho chile,vanilla ice cream
title: Mushroom Wraps
ingredients: 1/2 cup golden raisin | 1/2 cup dried chiles | 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 small red pepper, de-seeded and thinly sliced on a grater | 8 large portabella mushrooms, sliced | 1/2 cup fresh daikon sprout | 1/4 cup vanilla ice cream, lightly whipped | 8 flour tortillas
instructions: Place the raisins in a dry wok over medium heat and toss with 1/2 cup water for 2 minutes. Set aside. Heat 2 tblsps. Of the oil in a 12 inch nonstick skillet over medium. Add the red pepper slices and stir fry for about 3 minutes, until just tender. Stir in the mushrooms and saute for about 3 minutes or until the mushrooms are tender and aromatic. Toss in the raisins and saute for 2 more minutes or until the mushrooms are tender but not darked. Stir in the radish sprouts. Spoon 1/8 cup of the mushroom filling into a tortilla, filling almost to the top. Roll up, and serve warm or warm.

title: Beef Poppers Au Jus
ingredients: 1/2 pint beef chuck, trimmed of all fat and cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 jar pepperoncini peppers, drained | 1 pint heavy cream
instructions: Place the beef chuck cubes into a large nonreactive stockpot over low heat and stir until the cubes are lightly browned on the outside and the outside, about 5 minutes. Stir the pepperoncini peppers into the pot. Pour the heavy cream into the pot and bring to a bubble over medium heat, then remove the pan from the heat. Let the cream stand for 10 minutes.

title: Irish Beef Casserole by the Canadian!
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef | 1 tablespoon turmeric | 2 ounces irish whiskey | 2 cans hominy, drained and rinsed | 1 onion, chopped | 2 ounces molasses | double cream, to cover
instructions: In an ovenproof dish, mix turmeric, whiskey, drained and rinsed hominy, onion and molasses. Add stew beef, cover and bake in a moderate oven for 7 hours. Serve with double cream.

title: Pumpkin and Sour Cream Desserts
ingredients: 3 cups peeled and cubed fresh pumpkin | 1/4 cup fresh horseradish, chopped | 1/4 cup sweet red pepper, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 2 tablespoons whipping cream | avocado, slices, to serve
instructions: Boil pumpkin until tender, strain and reserve liquid. Meanwhile, mix horseradish, sweet red pepper, cardamom and cream in a small bowl to make topping. Add pumpkin and gently stir until heated through. Serve with sliced avocado.

Random Ingredients: sherry,ancho chile powder,habanero pepper,ketchup,pace picante sauce,coconut flake
title: The Best Chili Con Carne!
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 habanero pepper ( habanero's are the closest in america and have a sharper point of juice that i can locate ) | 4 ounces coconut flakes, lightly toasted | 4 ounces coconut flakes | 1 -2 teaspoon pure ancho chile powder | 1/3 cup ketchup | 3 -4 tablespoons sprite or 3 -4 tablespoons other canned picante sauce | 12 ounces pace picante sauce
instructions: Grind habanero's toasted and deseed the chile de arbol, or buy chile de arbol with your chile powder. Mix the chopped chile peppers in a small bowl with 1/4 cup water and spread evenly in a 6 x 8 inch pan. Set aside. Place coconut flakes, coconut flakes, ancho chili powder, cocunut flakes and ketchup in a blender. Cover with a lid and blend.. Pour mixture over the chile mixture and top with picante sauce. Allow to sit for at least one hour before serving.

title: Adobo Lentils W- Breading and Grilling
ingredients: 1 cup lentils | 1 tablespoon chili pepper flakes | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon adobo seasoning, to taste | 1 -2 slice provolone cheese, thinly sliced
instructions: Boil the lentils in water until almost soft. Remove from heat and set aside. Drain the water well and rinse well. Return the lentils to a medium sized skillet and place over medium heat until hot. Add the chili flakes and adobo seasoning. Spread the mixture on the lentils. Top with the provolone slices. Let melt and then serve with tortilla chips and more bread.

title: Blueberry and Pecan Buttermilk
ingredients: 1/2 cup buttermilk ( or 2 tbsp. each ) | 1/2 cup shredded yellow pecorino cheese or 2 tablespoons other asiago cheese | 1/2 cup sliced bottled chopped blueberries or 1/2 cup red currant jelly
instructions: In a 2 to 3 quart bowl, combine buttermilk, pecorino cheese and blueberries or currants.

title: Cherry Danish
ingredients: 1 can cherry pie filling | 1 package pepperoni, sliced | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1 cup chopped pecans
instructions: Set oven to 350 degrees f. Line a glass baking dish with foil. Mix cherry pie filling and pepperoni slices in a bowl, and spread in the baking dish. Sprinkle pecans over the cherry filling, and dot with vanilla. Bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes. Allow to cool before serving.

title: Korean Sausage Rice Dish
ingredients: 2 links korean sausages | 1 piece fresh ginger root | 4 cups fine grain rice, rinsed and drained
instructions: Cut sausage into 2 inch lengths, and remove skin and thick strands of skin from ginger root. Cut ginger root into 4 inch lengths and rub ginger pieces into the korean sausages.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,sage,spring onion,double cream,kernel corn,orange liqueur
title: Creamy Baked Corn With Oranges
ingredients: 8 ounces whole kernel corn ( frozen or fresh, thawed ) | 1 tablespoon sage ( fresh or dried ) | 8 -10 spring onions or 8 -10 scallions, depending on size ( chopped ) | 3 -4 tablespoons double cream, for topping | 2 -3 tablespoons orange liqueur ( optional ) or 2 -3 tablespoons sherry ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons canola oil or 2 tablespoons grapeseed oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Grease an ovenproof baking dish and spread olive oil evenly across dish. Place corn on the baking dish. Sprinkle sage, onions and dried corn atop corn. Pour cream evenly over all. Gently mix everything together. Cover and bake for 40 - 45 minutes until corn is tender and golden brown.

title: Ham and Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs russet potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced | 2 lbs ripe fresh ham, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 lb fresh ripe bamboo shoot, cut into sticks | 1 1/2 cups grated aged gouda cheese | 2 cups hot cooked white basmati rice
instructions: In a large deep skillet, arrange vegetables except the ham and the cheese over medium low heat and gently simmer until the potatoes are tender. Drain the ham and bamboo and combine them with the vegetables in the skillet. Add the cheese and warm over medium heat until it has melted, about five minutes. When the cheese is melted, stir in the rice. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: guacamole,parsley,vegetable,rice wine,ranch salad dressing,red curry paste
title: Curried Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 cup mixed vegetables, such as broccoli, carrots, onion, & cauliflower, cut into small pieces | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 2 tablespoons rice wine, divided | 1/2 cup ranch salad dressing ( or ranch dressing ) | 1 - 1 1/4 cup guacamole | chopped fresh parsley, for garnish
instructions: In a skillet or wok cook vegetables over medium heat until crisp tender. Drain vegetables and set aside. To pan add curry paste and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute or until aromatic. Add 1/2 cup of rice wine, the salad dressing and vegetables. Stir to combine, then cook over medium low heat until warmed through, about 3 - 5 minutes. Spoon into a serving dish. Sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cup of rice wine. Top with guacamole and sprinkle with fresh parsley.

Random Ingredients: pork tenderloin,potato traditional,parsnip,graham cracker crumb,wheat flour
title: Irish Muffins #5FIX
ingredients: 4 cups simply potatoes traditional mashed potatoes or 4 cups mashed potato wedges | 2 lbs boneless pork tenderloin | 1 package simply potatoes traditional mashed potatoes | 1 lb peeled sliced parsnip | 1/2 cup whole wheat flour | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Slice pork tenderloins lengthwise into 1/4 inch thick slices. Slice potatoes into wedges and set aside. Melt butter in medium size mixing bowl in microwave. Cook potatoes on high 4 - 5 minutes or until just tender. Drain potatoes well in a colander, allowing excess liquid to drain back into the bowl. Place potato wedges in the pan and bake 7 - 8 minutes, until golden. Turn and bake 1 - 2 minutes. Place pork slices on a plate and allow to rest in the juices, and slice into 1/4 inch thin slices. Mash traditional hash and toss potatoes and sauce and add the garnish ingredients. Serve the mashed potatoes immediately and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: nutritional yeast,pasta,chocolate baking square,lime wedge,ginger garlic paste,chili pepper,walnut
title: Thai Chocolate Hazelnut Pesto Bites
ingredients: 2/3 cup of fresh chamomile peppers | 1/2 cup of fresh unsalted walnuts, toasted | 1 medium chocolate baking square ( use the type with a milk-free version in the asian aisle of the grocery store ) | 2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste | 1/3 cup nutritional yeast | 1/2 cup pasta ( of choice-hot cooked, drained ) | lime wedge ( to garnish )
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a food processor, chop the chamomiles and walnuts until coarsely chopped, then set aside. In a medium baking bowl, stir the chocolate, ginger garlic paste and nutritional yeast to incorporate. Add the chamomile mixture and combine until mixed well. Stir in the pasta and mix to coat the pasta. Turn the mixture out onto the parchment lined baking sheet and form into a 1 inch thick round with a 2 inch high edge all around. Bake until the edges are light brown, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool, then cut into 1 inch squares.

title: Italian Style Italian Vegetables
ingredients: 4 -6 medium eggplants | 1 package italian salad dressing mix
instructions: Clean eggplants, cut in pieces, with a knife make vertical cut in the stem of each. Cut slices in 1/2. Put both pieces into water with the package of salad dressing mix. Place on burner on medium heat for 3 - 5 minutes. Remove from heat, pour over veggies toss.

title: Portugese Adovada (Anchovy in Adovada)
ingredients: 1 kg anchovy fillet, fillet | 600 ml low sodium chicken broth
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a large pan, bring to the boil and simmer for 3 - 5 minutes. Remove and reserve the fillets for later use. Serve adovada with fresh mixed vegetables, and white rice.

title: Avocado Blossom
ingredients: 2 medium avocados ( ripe ) | 3 tablespoons hazelnuts ( chopped, roasted is great ) | 3 spring onions ( scallions, chopped fine, green onions ) | juice jalapeno pepper ( good quality ) | 1 tablespoon sweet maraschino cherry, chopped into large chunks
instructions: Chop avocado and hazelnuts coarsely. In a food processor combine hazelnuts and spring onions, jalepenos, cherry juice and avocado puree until smooth. Add diced plum or ice cold water until desired consistency. Pour into stemmed, tall glasses and serve warm.

title: Rice Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh rice noodles | 1 1/2 cups finely chopped red peppers ( may use jalapenos ) | 3/4 cup chopped fat-free whipped topping, any flavor
instructions: Cook rice noodles according to pkg directions, drain completely. Chop red peppers and toss in wettest dressing until coated well. Mix noodles and veggies into salad and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving.

title: Sweetcorn and Tomato Stuffed Turnips
ingredients: 6 medium turningips, peeled and thinly sliced | 500 g canned tuna steaks, chopped | 500 g canned chopped beefsteak tomatoes, drained well | 2 tablespoons ground cumin seeds | 1/2 cup icing sugar | 1/4 cup walnuts, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 190c/fan 160c/gas toss the sausages with the chopped tomatoes, ground cumin, icing sugar, walnuts, and salt and pepper to taste if mixture is too dry. Arrange the turnips evenly over 4 long oven trays or baking trays lined with baking paper. Spoon 1 rounded tablespoonful of the mixture into each turnip. Bake turningips for 30 mins until just cooked through. Serve warm.

title: Mandarin Noodle Tea Bread
ingredients: 1 package chinese noodles | 3 tablespoons plain marmalade | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | self rising flour | yellow pepper, slices
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400f degrees. Break the noodles into large pieces. Place the noodles into an 8x8 inch baking dish and sprinkle the top with the marmalade, cardamom and flour. Bake for 10 minutes. Serve hot with a little yellow pepper. Note, the noodles can also be mixed in a food machine and baked as directed.

Random Ingredients: cooking spray,red pepper flake,pork loin chop,russet potato,veal cutlet,chipotle pepper,tea,yellow squash
title: Slow Cooker Kentucky-Style Veal Steak With Yellow Squash
ingredients: 1/4 cup low-sodium black tea | 5 lbs bone-in veal cutlets | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes ( more is desired if you like a bit of spice ) | 2 cans chipotle peppers ( i use the hot, not the very hot ) | 1 medium red pepper flake ( or more, to taste ) | 6 large russet potatoes, peeled and cut into 2-inch wedges | 6 small yellow squash, peeled and cut into 2-inch chunks | cooking spray | 6 slices lean pork loin chops, with each cutlet weighing about 1/4 to 1/2 ( optional )
instructions: Place tea in a large bowl and let sit at room temperature for 10 minutes. Slice veal across the grain into 1/4 inch thick slices, then cut slices crosswise into 1/4 inch wide strips. Add beef, red pepper flakes and chipotles to bowl and stir to thoroughly mix. Add 1 cup hot water, cover and refrigerate for 5 hours to marinate. Place potatoes and squash into a large bowl with 1/2 cup cold water and toss to combine. Cover and refrigerate overnight.. Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Spray cooking spray on both sides of pork. Place pork on a tray, cover and place in oven for 30 minutes. Remove from oven and spray with cooking spray. Turn pork over and spray again. Return to oven for 30 minutes or until nicely browned, turning to brown all sides. Remove pork to a plate and cover to keep warm. In a 5 - 5 1/4 quart slow cooker, layer 1/4 of the potato mixture, 1 1/4 pork, 1/4 veal and 1/4 chipotle chile pepper. Repeat the layers and top with remaining potatoes, vegetables and chipotle chile pepper. Cover and cook on low setting for 4 hours.. Serve immediately, directly from the slow cooker with juices.

title: Wet Nori Breakfast Recipe
ingredients: 1 tablespoon rapeseed oil | 1 cucumber, peeled and finely chopped | 3 thick sheets nori ( dry seaweed ) | 1/2 cup fresh greek yogurt | salt pork, sliced thin
instructions: Whip the yogurt to soft peaks. Lightly drizzle the grapeseed oil into the nori. Place the nori, a pinch of salt, cucumber and a sprinkling of paprika onto the nori. Add the yogurt and drizzle a little more oil over the top. Serve with pita chips.

title: Beer and Turnips over the Bar (Irish Pub Pudding)
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups guinness light beer | 12 ounces dark rye beer | 1 medium turnip, cut into chunks | 1 large rindless raisin | 3 cups cooked rice, to serve
instructions: Combine the guinness, rye beer, turnip, raisins and rice, mixing well. Pour into 6 warmed mugs. Serve immediately.

title: Crazy Wine Broiler Chicken
ingredients: 1 chicken, broiler type | 1 1/2 cups dry white wine ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Spray the broiler pan lightly with cooking spray. Place chicken under the broiler just until it starts to brown. Turn once, and broil for 7 to 10 minutes, or until juices run clear and chicken is no longer pink inside. Cover with foil and rest for 10 to 15 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: ra el hanout spice mix,orange peel,marshmallow,thai red curry paste,pork shoulder
title: Ras el Hanout Spiced Rum Glazed Pork
ingredients: 2 lbs pork shoulder | 12 large marshmallows | 2 tablespoons orange peel ( finely grated fresh peel ) | 2 tablespoons madras red curry paste | 2 teaspoons ras el hanout spice mix
instructions: Trim fat from pork shoulder and discard, wash and dry the meat with paper towels. Using your hands or a knife cut all the way into strips. Place 1/2 of the pork strips onto one side of a sheet of wax paper and spread in thin layer of green papaer that has been covered with papaer. Using the paper, roll the pork into a cylinder shape approximately 12 inches long and 3 inches wide. Use the wax paper to roll out the other half of the pork strips. Keep the wax paper covered while you roll out the rest. Place the pork rolls on your work surface and spread out the green papaer. Using the wax paper to roll out the rest of the pork strips, spread out the green papayacean layer over the pork slices and sprinkle with the orange peel, curry paste and ras el hanout. Use the wax paper to roll the entire pork layer into a sausage shaped log. Using the wax paper to roll out the rest of the pork slices, spread out the green papayacean layer over the pork slices and sprinkle with the orange peel, curry paste. Using the wax paper to roll out the green papaya layer, roll the pork slices into a sausage shaped log. Using the wax paper to roll out the green papaya layer onto a baking sheet and sprinkle with the orange peel, curry paste and ras el hanout. Using the wax paper roll the pork slices into a cylinder shape approximately 12 inches long and 3 inches wide. Using the wax paper to roll the pork slices into a cylinder shape approximately 12 inches long and 3 inches wide. Using the wax paper to roll the pork slices into a cylinder shape approximately 12 inches long and 3 inches wide. Using the wax paper to roll the pork slices into a cylinder shape approximately 12 inches long and 3 inches wide. Using the wax paper to roll the pork slices into a cylinder shape approximately 12 inches long and 3 inches wide. Using the wax paper to roll the pork slices into a cylinder shape approximately 11 inches long and 3 inches wide and 3 inches wide by 4 inches. Using the wax paper to roll the pork slices into a cylinder shape approximately 11 inches wide and 3 inches thick. Using the wax paper to roll the pork slices into the cylinder shape until all of the pork slices are in the pan. You may need to refrigerate the pork rolls for at least an hour or at least for up to 48 hours to fully complete the browning process. Bake in a preheated 375 degree f oven for 45 to 60 minutes, until internal pork temperature registers 155 degrees f. Remove from oven and allow to rest for 15 minutes.

title: Cousin Pete's Slow Cooker Chicken
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 2 cans tomato puree | 2 tablespoons prepared adobo sauce
instructions: Pour the tomato puree into 2 to 3 1/2 to 3 1/2 quart slow cooker. Place the chicken thighs in the slow cooker. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon adobo sauce over the chicken. Cover, and cook on low until the chicken is tender, 6 to 7 hours.

title: Ginger Balls I
ingredients: 1 lb fresh ginger root | 2 teaspoons ground pepperoncini peppers | 1/2 cup finely chopped pimiento | 3 tablespoons minced pimento-stuffed green peppercorns or 3 tablespoons peppercorn pieces | 1 tablespoon chopped drained canned clarified butter or 1 tablespoon clarified oil | 1 tablespoon dry crushed graham cracker topping or optional garnish
instructions: Peel and mince ginger. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add ginger, reduce heat.

title: Tepid Afghan Burger (Pancake)
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | fenugreek leaves
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and make into patties. Bake on middle shelf of a bar grill until cooked and done.

Random Ingredients: apple jelly,wakame,coriander,lima bean,baby spinach leaf,jalapeno pepper,stock,feta cheese
title: Feta Bean & Spinach Salad With Wakame Elegant Feta
ingredients: 1 bag baby spinach leaves | 400 g wakame | 1/2 cup dried lima beans ( about 4 oz ) | 125 g feta cheese | 1 teaspoon ground coriander | 1 tablespoon pickled jalapeno pepper ( finely slice ) | 1 tablespoon apple jelly | 1 tablespoon stock
instructions: Cut wakame in half. Cook with water until tender. While this is cooking cut cheese into 1cm cubes, and set aside. Rinse wakame and set aside. Toss together drained, cooked eddies wakame, lima beans, feta, coriander, jalapeno, apple jelly and stock. Chill dressing for 3 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,kosher salt,ketchup,cornflour,dijon mustard,ham,tart apple,white flour
title: Taco Slider
ingredients: 2 tart apples, finely grated ( your favourite variety, i prefer golden delicious ) | 3 tablespoons kosher salt ( use more for taste ) | 1/2 cup cornflour | 2/3 cup white flour | 4 teaspoons taco seasoning mix, use more, i like my taco seasoning mix | 1/3 cup ketchup ( i use a spicy-sweetened ketchup ) | 2 teaspoons dijon mustard ( or less to taste ) | 1 -2 teaspoon taco-flavored ketchup
instructions: Mix the ketchup, taco seasoning, mustard powder and taco sauce. Add the grated apples, breaking any large chunks into the mix. Pour the batter into a large glass baking dish or bowl. Sprinkle the cornflour and white flour on top. Turn the ingredients over several times to coat evenly. I like to bake this on my baking sheet at 180c for approximately 30 minutes, turning the oven down a little after 20 minutes, and topping off with the ketchup mixture at the end of the 40 minute baking time, this will give it a glossy, slightly flattened finish. Serve with pita chips, as burritos with warm crusty bread, or with chips and sourdough bread.

title: Grilled Steak Mexi Style
ingredients: 3 ounces cheddar cheese, grated | 1 serrano pepper, seeded and finely chopped | 4 ounces beef tenderloin
instructions: In a small bowl, mash the cheese. Stir in the pepper and beef. Marinate beef at least 15 minutes before grilling as the beef rests it improves the flavor. Preheat a grill or broiler. Remove the beef from the marinade leaving about 1/4 cup remaining marinade in the bowl. Grill or broil beef 2 to 3 minutes per side for medium rare, but longer if you like your beef rare.

Random Ingredients: adzuki bean,red bell pepper,rigatoni pasta,fruit,anise seed
title: Pasta With Adzuki Beans
ingredients: 8 ounces anise seeds | 2 lbs cooked adzuki beans, drained | 1 red bell pepper, finely diced | 1 lb rigatoni pasta | fresh fruit, as desired
instructions: In a large saucepan combine 1 lb of adzuki beans with 1 qts. Cold water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer 30 minutes over low to medium heat. In large saucepan with tight fitting lid, combine 1 lb of cooked adzuki, the red bell pepper, remaining 1 lb. Of cooked adzuki, and remaining 4 qts. Of cooked adzuki, including liquid. Simmer 30 minutes over low heat. Cover and simmer until heated through, about 5 minutes more. Serve as is or over hot cooked rigatoni.

title: Namoura
ingredients: 1 cup golden raisin | 2/3 cup peanut butter | 1/4 cup half-and-half cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Spray a 2 quart baking dish with vegetable cooking spray. Place raisins in a large bowl. Pour in peanut butter until completely moistened. Stir half and half into th ecked raisins until evenly mixed. Stir gently but thoroughly. Spoon into prepared baking dish and bake 15 to 20 minutes, until raisins are lightly browned. Makes 10 to 15 servings.

title: Gingered Mexican Catfish
ingredients: 24 cleaned squid, rinsed under cold water | 1 cup self rising flour | 2 tablespoons minced ginger | 1 jar lemonade | 1 1/2 cups guacamole | cherries, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Cut cleaned squid into quarters lengthwise. Place half the squid and half the flour on each of 2 plates. Place the ginger on each plate. Mix the lemonade and the remaining flour with half the squeezed lemon to make a dressing. Pour dressing over fish and vegetables and serve with cherries.

title: Yogurt Rice Balls
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked brown rice, rinsed or 1 cup brown rice sticks | 1/3 cup low-fat yogurt, stirred | 1/2 cup asiago cheese, finely grated
instructions: Drain rice rice and mix in with yogurt. Chill till morning, serve on a platter, along with grated cheese or bread, fruit, etc.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,ham,mango chutney,plain flour,egg yolk,chili sauce,tamarind pulp
title: Tender Mango Chicken Nuggets
ingredients: 2 large egg yolks | 200 g jammati ham, chopped | 100 g mango chutney, chopped | 100 g maraschino cherries, chopped | 100 g plain flour | 1 teaspoon chili sauce | 100 g tamarind pulp, roasted and crushed
instructions: Mix egg yolks and jammetsi together and put into the fridge to cool. Add mango chutney, cherries, flour and chilli sauce to egg yolk mixture and mix well. Preheat oven to 200°c put mixture onto a lightly greased tray and bake for 15 - 20 min or until cooked and golden brown. Cut into small pieces. Serve with dipping sauces.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,greek yogurt,thyme leave,pesto sauce,part ricotta cheese,cocoa powder,wasabi
title: Pesto Greek Yogurt Pizzas
ingredients: 1/2 cup part-skim ricotta cheese | 2 cups plain wheat flour | 2 teaspoons dried thyme leave | 2 tablespoons cocoa powder | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce | 1/2 cup fat free greek yogurt | 2 teaspoons wasabi
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Combine ricotta cheese, flour, thyme, cocoa powder, pesto, yogurt, and wasabi, mix well, and divide into 5 - 6 pizzas. Bake at 400° for 15 - 20 minutes, or until heated through.

Random Ingredients: caper,turnip,dark sesame oil,green chile,chili powder,baby spinach leaf,kielbasa,rotini pasta
title: Spanish Noodle Salad II
ingredients: 8 ounces rotini pasta or 8 ounces linguine | 1 small turnip, peeled and sliced 1/4 inch thick | 1 can sliced green chiles, drained | 1/4 cup green capers, drained and chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili powder | 4 ounces kielbasa, cut lengthwise into 1/8 inch thick strips or 4 ounces mild sausage, cooked and chopped | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 2 ounces baby spinach leaves, rinsed and dried
instructions: Cook rotini in a pot of boiling water until al dente. Rinse with cold water and drain. In a large bowl, add pasta, turnip, chilies, capers, chile powder and sesame oil. Add pasta mixture, stir to combine well and pour into bowls. Sprinkle with chopped spinach just before serving.

title: Chocolate and Clam Chowder
ingredients: 2 2 ounces unsweetened chocolate or 2 ounces semisweet chocolate | 1 small onion | 1 clams or 1 mussel | 1 tablespoon plain natural yoghurt | 1 tablespoon golden raisin
instructions: Place the chocolate or semisweet chocolate and onion in a small saucepan and melt in the microwave. Add the clams, yoghurt and raisins. Bring to the boil, remove from the heat and blend until well combined. Alternatively, chill the soup for 30 minutes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: pork,strawberry jam,grain white rice,chili sauce,french bread
title: Chinese Style Pork and Rice Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb boneless pork, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 package long grain white rice, not instant | 1 jar french bread, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 cups sweet chili sauce ( see note ) | 1 jar strawberry jam, drained and chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Place rice and pork in large oven safe baking dish. Add enough water to dish to almost cover rice and pork. Bake covered 3 1/2 hours. Remove dish from oven. Combine rice and pork broth or water and pour over rice, bring to a boil then cover and bake until it is tender, about 35 minutes. During last 15 minutes of baking combine sweet chili sauce and apricot jam and stir into rice mixture.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,lemon juice,stewing beef,russet potato,flat leaf italian parsley,egg
title: Arabic Beef Stew With Parsley
ingredients: 3 lbs chuck stewing beef or 3 lbs round steaks, cut into cubes | 3 large russet potatoes, peeled, cut in 2-inch cubes | 1 egg, lightly beaten | 1/2 cup chopped flat-leaf italian parsley | 6 green cardamom pods | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice
instructions: In a roasting pan, combine the meat, potatoes, egg, parsley, cardamons, and lemon juice.

Random Ingredients: raspberry jam,chinese chili sauce,cheddar cheese,taco seasoning,angel flake coconut,lemon pepper
title: Hot Nachos
ingredients: 36 -36 inches whole dried angel flakes coconut ( or any other dried coconut you can find ) | 3 tablespoons mexican chili sauce | 1 tablespoon lemon pepper | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning | 2 tablespoons chinese hot chili sauce | 2 tablespoons shredded cheddar cheese ( optional )
instructions: Toast the flaked coconut on a cookie sheet with the rack at the highest oven rack on your oven, it will burn quickly. When the coconut is toasted, spread on a plate with a moist paper towel to remove some of the excess oil. Set aside. In small bowl, stir chili sauce with lemon pepper, taco seasoning and chile sauce to taste.

title: Tortellini With a Garlicky Cheese and Potato Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 250 g cheese tortellini | 1 tablespoon fresh black cardamom pods ( or 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom ) | 1 small new potato ( about 150g raw potato, peeled and coarsely grated )
instructions: Cook the tortellini in boiling, salted water for 5 minutes, then drain well. Place the potato in a large frying pan. Crush in the cardamom, then add the grated cheese and fry for 5 minutes over a medium heat, until the cheese melts. Serve the dipping sauce sprinkled with a little cinnamon.

Random Ingredients: baby bok choy,margarine,chicken stock,tart apple,loaf ciabatta,bisquick,yellow squash,pork chop
title: Pork Chop Casserole
ingredients: 4 boneless pork chops | 1 tablespoon margarine | 4 crusty round loaf ciabatta | 1 cup bisquick | 2 cups chicken stock | 1 cup yellow squash, cut in pieces | 1 tart apple, sliced 3/4 inch thick | 1 bag baby bok choy
instructions: Brush chops with margarine and place side by side in a lightly oiled 8 inch square glass baking dish. Cut loaf in half. Using 1/4 cup bisquick, coat pork with remaining bisquick. Spread half of bisquick, diagonally, around bread. Layer half of squash over bread. Top with half of apple. Layer remaining pork, squash, apple and pork with all remaining bok choy. Cover with top layer of bread and bake at 375f for 1 hour or until pork is no longer pink.

Random Ingredients: sage,black olive,savory,parsley,lemon,corn oil more,heavy whipping cream
title: Puffin Tarts
ingredients: 1/2 cup black olives, drained | 1/4 cup dried parsley | 1/4 teaspoon dried savory | 1/4 teaspoon dried sage | 1/2 teaspoon grated lemon rind | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/2 teaspoon corn oil ( to coat pan )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f grease a 15x10x1 inch jelly roll pan. In a small bowl, mix together olives, parsley, savory, sage, lemon rind, cream and enough oil to moisten. Spread mixture in prepared pan. Bake 45 minutes. Cut into squares when cooled.

Random Ingredients: raisin,pasta,peanut oil vegetable,grill seasoning,italian bread,mushroom,ra el hanout spice mix
title: Moroccan Bread and Butter Pasta
ingredients: 2 tablespoons peanut oil or 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 15 mushrooms | 2 medium grilled italian bread | 3 1/2 teaspoons grated grill seasoning ( mccormick ) | 4 cups pasta ( i prefer spaghetti, linguine, macaroni or your choice ) | 1 -3 tablespoon raisins | 1 teaspoon ras el hanout spice mix or 1 teaspoon other cooking spice
instructions: Pour a little oil to grease the pan or pan of the bread. Roughly tear the bread into bite sized pieces and place them in the pan with the bread. Sprinkle the grated cheese, salt and pepper as desired. Add the mushrooms, mix them well, and then add the grated spice and grill seasoning. Let it sit a few minutes, then serve. Note, i like to use the bread mixture for my couscous or other things. This is the best i have ever made.

title: Rotel Beef and Turkey Bake
ingredients: 1 large chuck roast ( cut in 4 pieces ) | 1 package rotini pasta or 1 package ziti pasta | 1 packet quick cooking rice | 1 can rotel ( original ) | 1/2 cup light molasses | 1 jar roasted red peppers, drained | 1 packet dried tart apples
instructions: Place meat in 9x13 pan with uncooked rice. Pour undrained tomatoes over meat. In a bowl, combine rotel, molasses, red peppers and fruit, mix well. Pour over meat. Cover tightly and bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour or until meat is tender.

Random Ingredients: bean,sugar snap pea,flax seed,cooking oil,mirin,russet potato,amaretto liqueur,dill
title: Sweet Potato Hummus
ingredients: 2 small russet potatoes ( about 2-1/2 lbs total ) | 1 cup fat-free refried beans | 1 teaspoon dried dill | 3 tablespoons mirin | 2 tablespoons amaretto liqueur or 2 tablespoons brandy | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh dill | 2 tablespoons unbleached cooking oil | 1/2 tablespoon sugar snap peas, rinsed ( fresh ) or 1/2 tablespoon snow peas ( fresh ) | 1/2 teaspoon crushed whole flax seed
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to boil. Meanwhile scrub potatoes and cut in half lengthwise. Boil potatoes in water 20 minutes until almost tender. Drain and set aside to cool. Cut potatoes crosswise into 1/4 inch slices. Transfer the cut potato slices to a bowl and toss with the refried bean, 1 teaspoon dill, mirin, and amaretto. Let stand 3 minutes. Add remaining ingredients. Process until smooth. Place the sweet potato mixture in a serving bowl and place on a serving platter. Garnish with the remaining 1 teaspoon dill, chopped dill, and pine nuts.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,italian dressing,dark brown sugar,oyster sauce,curry powder
title: Simple Polynesian Steak Spice
ingredients: 2 lbs top sirloin steaks | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon curry powder | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and add to meat. Marinate, covered, 8 hours or overnight. Grill or broil to your liking.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,sesame oil,tea,coriander leaf,red wine vinegar,chicken breast,salt
title: Oriental  Chicken Salad
ingredients: 12 chicken breasts | 2 tablespoons tea, concentrate ( see recipe id # 215538- # 4372710 or 2 tablespoons dry instant tea, powder ) | 3 tablespoons sesame oil | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1/2 cup coriander leaves, chopped | salt | 1/2 cup gruyere cheese, grated
instructions: Combine the following and marinate the breasts for 30 - 40 minutes. Prepare the dressing ingredients in a salad bowl and toss all the ingredients together. Rinse the marinated chicken and marinate for 20 minutes longer. Grill on the bbq until cooked through. Grill the chicken, cut into thin strips about 1in long. To serve, arrange chicken, chopped coriander and the dressing onto one of the plates. Garnish with cheese.

Random Ingredients: cheese,sherry wine vinegar,semolina,beef gravy,italian seasoning,tarragon vinegar,triple sec,bread dough
title: Baked Meat Pie
ingredients: 3 cans refrigerated bread dough, such as jiffy's | 2 pinches dried tarragon vinegar | 4 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 1/4 cup beef gravy, divided | 1/4 cup semolina | 1/4 cup finely shredded parmigiano-reggiano cheese ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons premium robust cheese ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Grease a 12 inch pie plate. On a lightly floured work surface, roll out one can of dough into a 10 inch circle using a 3 inch round cutter to cut out as many circles as possible. Spread on the bottom and about 1/4 inch up the sides of the pie plate. In a small bowl, mix together the tarragon vinegar, sherry, italian seasoning, 1/4 cup gravy and semolina. Spread evenly over the crust, leaving a 1 inch border. Sprinkle with parmigiano, if using. Using a fork, poke several small holes along the perimeter of the crust. Bake for 20 minutes in the preheated oven, or until browned and crumbly. If you want a smoother crust, bake longer. Let cool and serve warm, or at room temperature.

title: Chinese Beef With Asparagus
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin, flank steak | 12 spears asparagus | 2 tablespoons mirin | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 12 fluid ounces heavy whipping cream
instructions: Cut beef steak diagonally into about 1/2 inch slices. Cut asparagus sticks into 4 inch lengths. In a large skillet, cook meat slowly over high heat until browned, about 10 minutes for steak and about 25 minutes for asparagus and 15 minutes for asparagus. When cooked, drain meat onto a paper towel. Add mirin, vinegar, and turmeric in skillet and simmer gently for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Return meat to skillet, cover, and cook over medium heat until liquid has reduced and the sauce is syrupy, about 2 hours. Stir in cream.

Random Ingredients: mayonnaise,chipotle salsa,white wine vinegar,red pepper,onion powder,extra virgin olive oil,sea salt black pepper
title: Copycat Chipotle Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 3 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon finely chopped chipotle salsa ( chipotle preferred ) | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt & freshly cracked black pepper | 1/4 teaspoon red pepper | 1/4 teaspoon fresh coarse ground sea salt or 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | 1/8 cup extra virgin olive oil, for drizzling
instructions: Process mayo, vinegar, chili pepper, onion powder, salt, pepper and olive oil in a food processor until smooth, about 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cornflour,white onion,lime wedge,lima bean,alfredo sauce,simple syrup
title: Creamy Lima Beans
ingredients: 1 lb lima beans, frozen ( preferably fresh ) | 1 medium white onion, chopped | 1 cup alfredo sauce | 1/3 cup simple syrup ( see note below ) | 1/4 cup cornflour | 1 lime wedge
instructions: Cook lima beans per instructions on the package,. Rinse well under cold water and set aside. Meanwhile, place onions in medium bowl of a food processor or blender with some of the alfredo sauce. Process until smooth. Add cornflour and lime wedge and blend until smooth again. Pour lima beans back into pot of onions and bring to the boil. Reduce heat to medium and cook 20 minutes,. Stir in simple syrup and cook another 5 to 10 minutes. Remove from heat and. Transfer to serving bowl. Serve with creamy corn chips.

Random Ingredients: orange liqueur,corn oil,monterey jack pepper cheese,chili oil,catsup,curry powder,cilantro leaf
title: Curried Cheese Appetizers
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs monterey jack pepper cheese, grated | 1/2 cup chinese parsley, chopped | 4 teaspoons curry powder | 3 tablespoons catalina chili oil | 2 tablespoons orange liqueur or 2 tablespoons lime juice | 1/4 cup corn oil | cayenne and chili oil | 1/4 cup catsup
instructions: Line cookie sheet with waxed paper and set aside. In bowl of electric mixer, thoroughly mix cheese, parsley, curry powder, cataines, chili oil, orange liqueur, corn oil& cayenne or chili oil. Beat on high just until cheese is melted. Spoon into waxed paper lined cookie sheet& spread or pipe with small round cookie and cheese mixture. When cheese is completely melted, brush melted cheese with hot catsup& then roll into a cigar shaped object. Using small knife, make 4 toothpicks through cheese, then secure with toothpick. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: angel hair pasta,tamarind pulp,whipping cream,roasting chicken
title: Angel Hair with Chicken
ingredients: 1 roasting chickens, cut into 12 even parts | 1 can tamarind pulp, chilled ( in a glass container with a good lid ) | 1 cup whipping cream | angel hair pasta, cooked
instructions: Place chicken in roasting pan and add tamarind pulp. Pour cream over chicken. You can freeze the sauce separately. Bake in your favorite oven at 350 degrees for about 1 hour. When cool enough to touch, remove chicken from oven, place on serving platter and cover with plastic wrap. Let sit about 15 minutes to absorb some of the fat. While it bakes, prepare angel hair pasta as directed on package.

title: Pesto Gluten-Free Pizza Crust
ingredients: 1 tablespoon xanthan gum ( gluten-free if desired ) | 1 - 1 1/2 cup prepared pesto sauce, prepared as directed on package
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine 1 tbsp pesto and 1 tbsp gluten free pate. Stir until well combined. Roll crusts in pesto and place on pizza stone or sheet. Bake approximately 5 - 12 minutes or until light gold and crusts are crispy. Let cool for 5 - 10 minutes before eating.

title: Red and Green Chili Snack
ingredients: 2 cans green chilies, chopped in long sections | 1 1/2 cups soymilk or 1 1/2 cups yogurt, plain | 1 can frozen limeade concentrate, undiluted | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder
instructions: Place all ingredients in medium saucepan and bring to boil, stirring frequently. Boil 8 minutes, stirring often. Cool before serving.

title: Creamy Quinoa Pops
ingredients: 2 cups milk | 2 cups textured vegetable protein ( i used protein twin ) | 1 ounce canned anchovy fillet | 3 cups cooked quinoa | 1/4 teaspoon pure vanilla flavoring
instructions: Cook the quinoa according to package directions. While the rice is cooking, open the can of anchovies using a kitchen scissors, remove any bones, then drain the anchovies. Put all ingredients in a blender and process to fairly smooth and creamy consistency, about 2 minutes. Spread the mix onto a plate or small piece of aluminum foil and let it set for about 5 minutes so the anchovies can melt and flavors can combine. Flip the cakes over, coat in the remaining marinade and let them set for another 15 minutes, or until crispy on the outside and slightly firm in the middle. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: hellmann mayonnaise,grape,bean sprout,vanilla essence,almond paste,chicken tender breast
title: Chicken Salad With Egg Rolls in Honey Mustard Sauce!
ingredients: 1 chicken tenders or 1 large chicken thigh fillets | 1 cup shredded grape ( i use purple grapes ) | 1 can bean sprouts | 2 tablespoons almond paste | 1 2 tablespoons mayonnaise | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1/4 - 1/2 cup honey mustard paste or 1/4-1/2 cup other flavor dijon mustard ( i prefer using a coleman's mayonnaise or similar )
instructions: Cut chicken into bite sized pieces. Arrange in a shallow dish. For dressing, put honey mustard, mayonnaise, vanilla and mustard paste in a jar. Shake. Pour over the chicken pieces. Cover and refrigerate for at least and hour. Before serving, marinate salad for up to 2 hours. If the chicken is frozen or fresh, break off pieces and remove the skin and any remaining pieces. When ready to serve, drain the chicken pieces and pat dry with paper towels. Strain dressing. Return chicken pieces to pan along with the grapes. Toss to coat evenly with dressing. I prefer making the egg rolls with the egg rolls. This is a simple and delicious recipe. You might not use the honey mustard, but it's delicious and yummy with it.

title: Apple-Watermelon Chicken and Apple Tacos
ingredients: 2 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 4 cups apple juice | 1/2 cup watermelon, cubed and seeded | 3/4 cup chopped dill | 8 corn tortillas, warmed | 1 teaspoon pickled mustard or 1 -2 teaspoon prepared mustard
instructions: Place chicken in a 6 quart electric slow cooker. Add apple juice and watermelon cubes. Cover.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,hungarian paprika,bulk italian sausage,cumin seed
title: Grilled Sausages
ingredients: 1 lb bulk sweet italian sausage | 1/2 cup sweet hungarian paprika | 1 tablespoon cumin seed | 1 package sweet hungarian paprika ( hungarian ) | 10 vanilla beans
instructions: Toast the cumin seeds and grind lightly to release the flavor. Mix ground cumin and paprika in a small bowl. Add sausage and mix well. Grill sausages over medium heat in a small frying pan, turning once. Cool slightly and slice into 1/4 inch slices. Arrange on a platter and cover with sweet paprika. Garnish with the vanilla bean halves and serve.

Random Ingredients: mussel,almond extract,golden mushroom soup,beef tenderloin,lemon zest,confectioner ' sugar
title: Almond Beef Tenderloins
ingredients: 3 lbs beef tenderloin | 3 tablespoons light mussels, rinsed and drained | 2 cups chopped blanched almonds or 2 cups sliced almonds | 3 cans condensed golden mushroom soup | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1 teaspoon lemon zest
instructions: Cut tenderloin in half lengthwise, then into 1 1/2 slices. Place the meat between 2 sheets of plastic wrap and pound lightly with a meat mallet or other flat side of a cleaver to flatten. Transfer to a shallow heavy freezer container or deep skillet.
