Add the onions and the remaining ingredients to the container. Refrigerate overnight turning the meat a few times, coating evenly with the mixture at least twice. Reserve all of the liquid. Remove the meat from the freezer and cook 2 1/2 hours at 325 degrees. Remove meat and slice thin. Serve on a platter with sauce poured over.

title: Sue's Baked Beans
ingredients: 1 package firm tofu | 2 cans butter beans | 1 bunch radish, sliced | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/4 cup hot sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Cut the tofu into 1 1/2 inch cubes and place them in a large mixing bowl. In a small frying pan, saute the radishes for a minute or two before adding them to the bowl. In the frying pan, add the hot sauce and stir until the mixture thickens slightly. Add the noodles and mix well. Pour the sauce over the tofu and vegetables in the bowl and mix thoroughly. Put the mixture in a 9x13 inch oven safe baking dish and bake 350 degrees f until the noodles are done.. It should take 25 to 45 minutes.

title: Rice And Cheese With Basmathi Rice and Basilices
ingredients: 2 1/4 cups basmati rice or 2 1/4 cups long grain rice | 1/8 lb monterey jack cheese, grated
instructions: Pre heat the oven to 300 degrees f & grease a 2 quart baking dish. Rinse & dry the rice. Put the rice in a fine sieve, rinse under water for 10 seconds then drain well. Add the grated cheese and mix. Add enough water to come almost to the top of the rice. Cover & bake until the rice is tender & fluffy. Do not overcook. Variation, for a change of pace, stir in 2 cups of the cooked white rice and 1/2 teaspoon of cayenne pepper. When it has cooled, spread into an ovenproof skillet, cover & bake uncovered for 20 - 30 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Bocce E Olio (Brazilian Spaghetti)
ingredients: 3 cups chicken stock ( or vegetable stock, if using homemade ) | 1 1/4 cups raw spaghetti, broken into 2-inch lengths | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste | 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa | 1 tablespoon molasses ( or treacle ) | 1/4 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese ( or other cheese of your choice )
instructions: Combine stock and tomatoes in saucepan and bring to boil over high heat. Add noodles and tamarind paste, and reduce heat to low, then simmer until pasta is tender, 8 to 10 minutes. Stir cocoa, molasses, and a few dashes of salt into hot pasta, and cook until it starts to foam. Taste, and add additional salt if necessary. To serve, ladle into bowls, and sprinkle with cheese.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper,garlic clove,mango,pork rib,salad oil,oyster sauce,filling
title: Malaysian Pork Ribs
ingredients: 3 lbs pork ribs, cubed, excess fat left in the pan | 1 bottle salad oil | 8 jalapeno peppers, seeded and deveined | 1/2 cup salad oil | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 garlic clove, crushed | 1 mango, quartered
instructions: In a large bowl, mix all ingredients except the ribs. Toss pork until well coated. Place in refrigerator for at least 4 hours. Place in a skillet with reserved fat and cook over high until heated through. Turn ribs occasionally until well browned on all sides and cooked to your desired degree of doneness.

Random Ingredients: green pepper,loaf french bread,chicken wing,chili pepper flake,active yeast,dijon mustard
title: Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 2 tablespoons chili pepper flakes | 7 3/4 cups chicken wings, split | 2 tablespoons green peppers, chopped | 6 slices fresh loaves french bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Add mustard, chili pepper flakes, and 1 1/2 teaspoons of pepper to the cooled yeast and yeast. Add wings and scallions, cover and set aside in a warm place to rise until doubled in volume. Punch down and knead in remaining pepper and mustard mixture. Shape into loaves. Place bread loafs on a greased tray and allow to rise again. Brush with beaten egg wash or milk and bake at 450° for 10 minutes or until lightly browned. Serve with your favourite dip. Also great with ketchup. This is the easiest and best french style bread you can make.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,mustard powder,tilapia fillet,thyme,japanese soy sauce
title: Honey Coated Tilapia
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dry mustard powder | 2 japanese soy sauce | 2 teaspoons balsamic vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme or 1 sprig fresh thyme | 2 lbs tilapia fillets, cut into thirds
instructions: To make marinade, mix all ingredients in a medium bowl and add the fillets. Cover and refrigerate for at least 5 hours or overnight. Drain fish and serve with any leftover marinade.

title: Apricot & Cauliflower
ingredients: 1/2 cup apricot ( chopped into small pieces ) | 1 lb cauliflower floret ( about 4 cups )
instructions: In a large saucepan, heat apricot pieces over medium low heat until just tender. Stir in cauliflower and bring to a boil.

title: Cousin Pete's Vegetables
ingredients: 1 quart mixed vegetables, chopped into bite size pieces ( any type of onion, broccoli, cauliflower and red bell pepper ) | 2/3 cup pitted kalamata olive, cut in half | 1 package shiitake mushrooms, cleaned, stems removed ( i prefer baby bella mushrooms )
instructions: Boil or steam veggies until tender but still firm. Drain. Mix all ingredients together and add olives.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,grain rice,italian green bean,tomato green chilies,white onion
title: Italian Green Beans and Rice
ingredients: 3 cups canned italian cut green beans, drained, rinsed | 1 large white onion, chopped | 1 can stewed tomatoes with green chilies | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 2 cups cooked long-grain rice, chilled
instructions: In a medium saute pan, combine the green beans, onion, tomatoes, cayenne pepper, and rice. Heat to boiling.

Random Ingredients: harissa,garlic powder,shark steak,vegetable oil,icing sugar,cauliflower,honey,bacon dripping
title: Kerikeri
ingredients: 1 package frozen cauliflower, broken into florets | 5 ounces lean bacon drippings | 3 tablespoons vegetable oil | 3 -4 lb karikeri shark steak | 1 tablespoon icing sugar | 1 teaspoon harissa | 1 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: In a large saucepan, stir fry bacon drippings, vegetable oil, and shark steaks in hot drippings for 5 - 7 minutes until shark is just firm and cooked through about 3 minutes. Sprinkle with icing sugar, harissa, garlic powder, and remaining ingredients.

title: Alicante  Salad
ingredients: 2 cups fresh green peas | 3 cups lettuce leaves | 1/4 teaspoon crushed ice
instructions: Toss green peas with lettuce and crushed ice for about 10 minutes or until warm and crisp.

title: Mexican Seafood Bowl
ingredients: 400 g corkscrew macaroni ( i prefer wholemeal spirals ) | 400 g large king edward haddock fillets | 1 liter ranch dressing ( good quality ) | 400 g chopped tomatoes | 200 g cantaloupe, seeded and cut into chunks ( you may want to remove the seeds )
instructions: Boil water, cook pasta according to pkg directions, drain. Meanwhile, heat 1 tbsp of the ranch dressing in frying pan, stir in the chopped tomatoes and diced cantaloupe. Season with a bit of sea salt if you want. Add cooked pasta to tomatoes and cantaloupe, stir and cook over a high heat for about 5 minutes. Transfer to small serving bowls and serve immediately. Variation, i like to have this dish served with rice.

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,lime peel,arbol chile,egg white,salad oil,pine nut,chicken stock
title: Stir-Fried Spinach With Pine Nuts
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped spinach leaves, thawed and squeezed dry | 1 egg white | 2 tablespoons salad oil | 1 teaspoon lime peel, finely shredded | 2 dried arbol chiles | 2 tablespoons pine nuts, lightly toasted | 3 tablespoons chicken stock
instructions: Prepare wok and add oil to coat. When hot, add chiles. Stir fry for 30 seconds. Add spinach. Stir fry for 2 minutes, stirring once or twice. Add egg white. Stir fry until spinach looks dry and egg whites are cooked. Sprinkle with lime peel. Stir fry until heated through. Turn off heat. Stir in pine nuts. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach leaf,farfalle pasta,seasoning salt,lasagna noodle,corn syrup,yeast
title: Sweet and Savory Spinach and Noodles in a Bechamel Sauce
ingredients: 1 package dry lasagna noodles | 1 1/2 cups baby spinach leaves | 1 teaspoon yeast | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 1/2 tablespoons corn syrup | 1/2 cup light corn syrup | 1/3 cup light corn syrup | 1 cup cooked and drained farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta
instructions: Bring large pot of lightly salted water to boil. Add lasagna, and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Cape Malay Koftas
ingredients: 20 -24 ounces ground sausage | 1 pint plain yogurt ( do not use fat free ) | salt | 6 -8 leaves mint | ice water
instructions: In a bowl add all ingredients. Mix thoroughly with hands or board. If you find it helpful to wet hands first, then roll out thin with a rolling pin or your palms at least 1/4 inch in thickness. Seal your hands to avoid sticking together and knead lightly using all purpose flour, a dough ball or whatever you can gather and roll to the size of your pan. Use a flat knife to cut into 6 or 8 pieces. When you are happy with how your koftas are cooked, heat your oil on medium high, when it is very hot, drop a small piece of kofta into fryer. Cook for approximately 3 to 4 minutes or until golden on each side, depending on how thick the kofta is.

Random Ingredients: straw mushroom,garam masala,red grape,dark soy sauce,mexican chocolate,brown sugar
title: Straw Mushroom and Grape Parfait
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala | 2 cups red grapes, cut in half | 8 ounces fresh straw mushrooms or 8 ounces shiitake mushrooms, sliced | 1/2 cup mexican-sweet chocolate
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients in a large bowl. Add mushrooms and snow peas. Toss gently to coat. Cover and cool to room temperature. Melt chocolate in the top of a double boiler over simmering water, stirring to smooth and smooth. Remove from the heat. Cool and stir into the melted chocolate.

title: Easy Maple Linguine
ingredients: 1 package linguine | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 3/4 cup whipped topping
instructions: Cook linguine according to package directions, omitting salt. Drain and return to saucepan, toss with maple syrup. Cool slightly, stir in whipped topping.

title: Salsa with Mushrooms in Clay Pot
ingredients: 2 large portabella mushroom caps | 1 jar chunky salsa, divided | 1 1/2 tablespoons butter, melted | 1 teaspoon lemon peel, grated
instructions: Slice each mushroom cap into thin slices, leaving a small gap at the base for expansion to steam. Spoon the mushroom slices in a large clay pot or small stockpot, pouring enough salsa over the mushrooms to coat caps evenly. Top with remaining salsa. Cover the pot and set aside at room temperature 15 to 20 minutes. Uncover mushroom mixture and stir in lemon peel. Cover and let stand at room temperature 1 - ½ hours. Microwave on medium high 1 minute until bubbly and starting to brown around the edges.

Random Ingredients: green food coloring,yellow onion,dark chocolate,plum tomato,dill,gorgonzola
title: Eggless Baked Chocolate Pots
ingredients: 20 small plum tomatoes, halved | 16 ounces dark chocolate | 1 small yellow onion, peeled and quartered | 1 teaspoon dill | green food coloring | 4 ounces gorgonzola
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and place tomato halves cut side up on paper. Set aside. Chop chocolate in small pieces over the bowl of a food processor and set aside. Place onion in food processor with food color and pulse until finely chopped. Add gorgonzola and pulse until smooth. Stir in the tomato mixture until incorporated. Pour the mixture into a bowl and allow to cool for at least 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Stir in chocolate mixture. Place on prepared baking sheet and bake in a preheated 250° f oven for 10 minutes, or until golden brown. Using a spatula, remove carefully from oven and let cool for at least 10 minutes. Serve warm. This makes a very large amount.

title: No-Mayonnaise Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 1 can no-so-salt-added tomato paste | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | ice, as needed
instructions: Add tomato paste to a screw top jar. Cover and shake until tomato paste is completely dissolved, about 1 minute. Dissolve oregano and remaining 1/2 cup water in a small bowl. Stir in oregano and water mixture. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Baked Parma
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups spinach | 2 cups artichokes | 1 cup frozen corn | 1 cup panir, cubed ( cottage cheese ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup instant coffee | 1/4 - 1/2 cup vodka | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning mix | pistachio nut, and or pistachios, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Cook spinach in a little water to wilt, drain well. Cut artichokes and corn to your desired size or cut into quarters if frozen. Arrange spinach in a baking dish. Sprinkle artichokes and corn over spinach. In a bowl add rest of ingredients and mix well. Pour all mixture over all over. Cover pan and bake 20 - 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,rye flour,chinese red vinegar,egg white,sherry
title: Chinese Sour Beef Rolls (Gee Shing)
ingredients: 1/4 cup chinese red vinegar | 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 1 egg white | 2 1/2 - 3 lbs top sirloin steaks, very thinly sliced ( best to cut a piece that's about 1-1/3 '' thick ) | 1/4 lb puff pastry ( fresh, not frozen )
instructions: Combine red vinegar and sherry in a small saucepan. Cover and bring mixture to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring often. Cool to room temperature and set aside. Place steak on counter and let it rest for approximately 10 minutes. Remove steak from marinade, pat dry with paper towels. Cut into thin slices. Dip each slice in vinegar mixture and then in egg white. Place on cookie sheets that have been sprayed with pam. Let stand for a few minutes then bake at 400 degrees for 8 minutes, or until golden.

title: Indian Yogurt Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 1 teaspoon sunflower oil
instructions: Combine all ingredients together in a bowl and whisk until smooth.

Random Ingredients: sauce,green bell pepper,pecorino romano cheese,provolone cheese,bow tie pasta
title: Angel Hair Pasta
ingredients: 8 ounces bow tie pasta | 1/2 pound provolone cheese, sliced | 1/2 green bell pepper, diced | 1/4 cup grated pecorino-romano cheese | 2 drops hot sauce, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook the bow tie pasta at a boil, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 11 minutes. Drain. Transfer the cooked pasta to a bowl and fluff with a fork. Add provolone and green bell pepper to the pasta with a fork. Stir in the cheese and hot sauce. Serve warm or chilled.

title: Quick and Easy Refried Beans
ingredients: 1 can red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can garbanzo beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Quickly stir in the beans and heat through. If needed, add water to just combine.

Random Ingredients: cilantro stem,mango,nonfat milk powder,tart apple,aquavit,liquid smoke
title: Apple Quisine Smoothie
ingredients: 1 cup nonfat dry milk powder or 1 cup powdered milk | 3 -4 tablespoons agave nectar or 3 -4 tablespoons maggi liquid aminos | 2 -3 tablespoons aquavit, to taste | 2 -3 tart apples, peeled, diced | 1 cup fresh cilantro stem, chopped ( coriander ) | sourdough bread or chafing apple, diced ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a mixing bowl and blend until creamy.

Random Ingredients: nonstick cooking spray,tahini,channa dal,colby monterey jack cheese,yogurt,scallion,nutmeg
title: Yogurt Cheese With Nuts
ingredients: 2/3 cup nonstick cooking spray | 3 tablespoons tahini, divided | 1/3 cup fat-free sour cream or 1/3 cup plain yogurt, to taste | 1 medium scallion, chopped ( whites & greens ) | 1 3/4 cups colby-monterey jack cheese, shredded | 1/8 teaspoon grated nutmeg | 1 1/2 tablespoons channa dal
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Lightly grease a casserole dish.

Random Ingredients: eggplant,brussels sprout,large shrimp,vegetable broth,taco seasoning mix,coriander leaf,monterey jack cheese,vegetable oil
title: Mexican Eggplant and Shrimp Noodle Soup
ingredients: 2 medium eggplant, sliced lengthwise | 2 teaspoons vegetable oil | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 5 cups vegetable broth | 1 package monterey jack cheese | 1 package frac 12 ounce large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 cup fresh large shrimp, peeled and deveined or 1 cup frozen large shrimp, thawed | 16 fresh coriander leaves
instructions: In a large skillet, grill or steam the eggplant slices over medium heat till soft. Set aside. In a soup pot, heat oil over medium heat. In a bowl, combine the taco seasoning mix with the broth, stirring well. Add the eggplant, cheese, shrimp and shrimp. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, for 5 minutes. Serve at once, garnished with coriander.

Random Ingredients: bay leaf,chuck,italian salad dressing mix,russet potato,vegetable stock,yellow mustard
title: Crock Pot Beef Pot Au Jus
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs chuck, cubed | 2 russet potatoes, sliced | 1 envelope dry italian salad dressing mix | 2 tablespoons yellow mustard | 2 cups vegetable stock | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Put chuck & potatoes in cooker, and sprinkle with salad dressing mix. Add mustard, stock, bay leaf and bay leaf. Poke several holes into the lid of the crock pot with a fork to vent steam. Cook on low for 8 hours and let cool slightly before serving.

Random Ingredients: espresso,pear,baking powder,non dairy topping,pico de gallo,grand marnier,raspberry jam,pork shoulder
title: Poulet Au Pistou (Pork or Shredded Pork)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless pork shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1/2 cup ponzuino-reggoldina non-dairy topping ( pisco espresso ) or 1/2 cup poudreggiano-reggiano cheese, grated ( pisco espresso ) | 2 teaspoons instant espresso ( or 1/2 teaspoon instant coffee powder dissolved in 1/4 cup hot water ) | 2 ripe pears, peeled seeded and finely diced | 2 tablespoons grand marnier or 2 tablespoons orange liqueur | 1/4 cup raspberry-flavored jam | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 2 tablespoons grand marnier or 2 tablespoons orange liqueur
instructions: Put the pork in a bowl. Add the non dairy topping, coffee powder, and pino.

Random Ingredients: yukon gold potato,queso fresco,rice vinegar,meat,red bean,mexicorn,brown rice,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Smothered Mexican Meatball Potatoes
ingredients: 1/2 cup brown rice, uncooked | 4 lbs ground meat | 1 lb queso fresco, crumbled | 2 lbs mexicorn | 2 korean queso fresco | 1 cup mexican crema or 3/4 cup rice vinegar | 2 packages yukon gold potatoes, cooked and diced | 1 bag frozen mexicorn, thawed | 1 cup grated sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Prepare rice as directed on packaged instructions. While rice is cooking, mix beef, queso fresco, mexicorn, mexican crema, potatoes, and rice in large bowl, making sure to mix well. Using your hands, form meat mixture into 1 inch meatballs. Add about 1 1/2 cups water to bottom of pot and bring to boil. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer until meatballs are cooked through, about 30 minutes, depending on the size of your meatballs. Serve in large bowls. Top with your choice of toppings.

title: Apple Dipping Sauce for Grilled Tuna
ingredients: 1/2 cup canola oil | 1 teaspoon chili paste | 1 1/2 cups grated apples, peel
instructions: In small bowl, mix oil and chili paste. Place apples in another small bowl and combine with oil mixture. Refrigerate. To use, add 1 tbsp of this mixture to hot griddle, cook on one side till golden brown and crispy.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,bourbon,red potato,lemon,pine nut,italian breadcrumb,garlic powder
title: Italian Boned Tater Wedges
ingredients: 6 medium red potatoes | 6 tablespoons chunky salsa ( see above tip below ) | toasted pine nuts | 1 jar roasted garlic powder, drained | 1/4 cup italian style breadcrumbs | 3 tablespoons dried italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1/2 lemon, juice of | 1 tablespoon bourbon
instructions: Cut potatoes and place into a saucepan large enough to hold all the potatoes. Add water to cover the potatoes and bring to a boil over high heat. Decrease heat to medium and simmer, covered, until the potatoes are fork tender when pierced with a fork. Drain potatoes and set aside. While the potatoes are cooling, spread the sauerkraut onto a large baking sheet and top with the pine nuts. Roast in a preheated 350 degree f oven for about 10 minutes. Watch and stir, if needed until toasted pine nuts are lightly browned. Set aside aside. Make the sauce by whisking together the sauerkraut, oil, dried bread crumbs, lemon juice and bourbon until smooth. Pour over the potato mixture and toss until mixed. Serve at room temperature or chilled. Tip, to toast the pine nuts, set pan on a baking sheet and lightly toast in the oven for about 10 minutes. Watch and stir, if needed, until toasted pine nuts are lightly browned. Let cool for about 5 minutes.

title: Mexican Cheese Dip
ingredients: 3 packages of brown and white american cheese, cubed | 2 large red onions, chopped | 1 package shredded american cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to place brown and white american cheese in a 9 x 13 baking dish. Saute red onions in 1/4 olive oil until soft. Pour onto cheese. Cover with foil. Bake in preheated oven 40 minutes or until mixture is bubbly and hot. Let stand 10 minutes before serving. Serve with tortilla chips or vegetables.

title: Easy Microwave Romero
ingredients: 500 g oil | 1 teaspoon salt
instructions: Heat the oil in a deep fryer. It should be about 180/350°f. Pour the oil and keep stirring. When the oil is getting hot and smoking, add a teaspoon of salt. Then, stir until the komagemold comes out of the oil like popcorn. This takes about a minute, stir, and repeat for about 15 - 20 seconds, until the oil turns white and reddish. Immediately, toss in the towel. Do not use the towels, so as not to contamard the oil. It will be extremely messy after every step of the process. The best way to do it is to use a fork or hands to hold the oil in one hand. If necessary, leave the komagemold as they are. Store in an airtight container.

title: Onion-Chive Dressing
ingredients: 1/3 cup chives, chopped | 2 tablespoons oil ( for frying )
instructions: Mix all ingredients and let sit in refrigerator to meld and flavors blend. Serve as a dipping sauce.

title: Crock Pot Norwegian Peanut Soup
ingredients: 6 tablespoons creamy chicken soup | 6 tablespoons pecan halves
instructions: Place the 5 tablespoons of soup and 6 tablespoons of pecans in the crock pot. Cook on low in crock pot for 2 hrs until pecans are browned and smell nice. Serve hot.

title: Mexican Crab Quiche
ingredients: 1 lobster, cooked, shelled & cut in half lengthwise | 1/2 cup buttermilk | 1 cup mexican blend cheese | 1 cup crumbled goat cheese | 1/2 cup golden raisin
instructions: Preheat oven to combine lobster with buttermilk. Spread cheese over crust. Top with raisins& crab.

title: Jicama Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs jicama | toothpicks
instructions: Cut jicama in to large rings about 1/2 inch thick. Wash and dry jicama. Place a toothpick through the center of each ring. Scoop out the juice into a clean container with a lid. Place the jicama rings on a cookie sheet and refrigerate at least 8 hours or overnight. Drain juice in colander or strainer. Discard the toothpicks. In a large bowl toss jicama with juice, and chill at least 30 minutes before serving cold.

title: Chilean Chicken Pasta With Amaretto Crumbs
ingredients: 1 tablespoon coriander | 1 lb shrimp or 1 lb chicken, in 1-inch cubes | 16 ounces shell pasta | fresh coriander | 1/4 cup fresh breadcrumb | 1/4 cup creme fraiche or 1/4 cup mascarpone cheese | arugula | fresh coconut extract | 8 ounces small shell pasta | 3/4 cup amaretto
instructions: Soak shell pasta in cool water according to package directions. Drain and set aside. Heat olive oil in a small pot on high heat until very hot. Add chicken pieces to oil and saute until chicken has released its juices, about 5 minutes. Break shells and add to skillet, stir in bread crumbs. Add creme fraiche or mascarpone cheese for 2 - 3 minutes to combine. Meanwhile, cook arugula & coriander together in a skillet over medium heat until just wilted, 5 - 7 minutes. When pasta is done, drain and stir in chicken mixture. Add pasta and stir around to combine. Garnish with fresh coriander.

title: Sausage With Sauerkraut and Cream
ingredients: 1 pint whipping cream ( or use 2/3 cup and 1/3 cup creme fraiche ) | 2 cups sauerkraut ( well rinsed well ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Whip 1/4 cup of creme fraiche until thick and creamy, add to bowl with sauerkraut and allspice. Refrigerate for at least 6 hours, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: golden raisin,new potato,graham wafer crumb,lamb,yellow onion,picante sauce
title: Spanish Lamb and Potato Casserole #5FIX
ingredients: 2 cups picante sauce | 2 tablespoons golden raisins, finely chopped | 8 ounces new potatoes, sliced | 1 small yellow onion, chopped | 1 1/2 lbs lean ground lamb | 15 ounces simply potatoes diced potatoes with onion | 1/2 cup graham wafer crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Line 9x13 inch baking dish with foil. Combine picante sauce and raisins in a medium bowl and set aside. Spray a 13 x 9 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Layer potatoes and onion in dish, top with picante sauce mixture, and top with ground lamb. Sprinkle top with crumbs. Bake, uncovered, for 30 to 35 minutes or until potatoes are done.

title: Crock Pot-Slow Cooker Heart of Tuna
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef | 2 cans water packed tuna, drained | 1 can chicken broth | 3 tablespoons cornflour
instructions: Put all ingredients into slow cooker. Turn on high setting, low setting and cook 8 hours. Do not drain the beef before serving. Stir or stir before serving. Note, may substitute frozen cooked onions for the meat and serve as a side with rice.

title: Real French Onion Rye
ingredients: 3 cups buttermilk | 1 1/2 cups dry red wine vinegar | 1/4 cup poppy seeds | 2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill until you are ready to serve. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: escarole,kosher salt black pepper,porcini mushroom,ginger root,vanilla essence,caper,cooking oat,balsamic vinegar
title: Oatmeal Parcels With Mushrooms and Escarole
ingredients: 5 ounces porcini mushrooms, sliced | 3/4 teaspoon grated fresh ginger root | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 4 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon pure vanilla essence | 3 tablespoons quick-cooking oats | 1 small head escarole, cut into 8 wedges | 2 tablespoons capers
instructions: Place porcini mushrooms in a fine mesh sieve, and reserve liquid. In a small bowl, combine the chopped rind and juice from mushrooms and grated ginger root.

title: Easy Beef Curry Fry
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless beef chuck, cubed | 2 tablespoons powdered fenugreek leaves ( pisa ) | 2 teaspoons cumin powder
instructions: Cut beef into cubes of the size of the beef cubes.. Add spice powders, stir and serve hot with roti or naan bread or pita bread.

title: Beef and Asparagus Patties
ingredients: 1 lb asparagus, cut crosswise into 1-inch pieces | 3/4 lb boneless beef top sirloin | 1/2 cup dry potato flakes | 1/4 cup salted breadcrumbs | 16 thinly sliced hot paprika-alted chiles ( canned, drained ) | 1 teaspoon hot paprika | 1/2 bunch asparagus, trimmed
instructions: In a large bowl, toss the asparagus and beef together with 2/3 cup dry potato flakes, reserving the rest of the potato flakes. Using your hands, roll the beef mixture into 3/8 inch thick patties. Roll the patties in the bread crumbs and arrange them on a rack in a broiler proof dish. Sprinkle on the chiles. Sprinkle on the paprika. Sprinkle generously with asparagus. Broil the patties in the preheated 425f oven until the topping is crisp and browned, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,chicken base,cornstarch,tilapia fillet,thyme sprig,plain nonfat yogurt,black olive
title: Mexican Tilapia
ingredients: 4 tilapia fillets ( or other white ocean fish ) | 3/4 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1/3 cup canned chopped black olives ( i used jarred ) | 2 tablespoons drained canned diced tomatoes with green chilies | 2 teaspoons cornstarch | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme sprigs | 2 teaspoons chicken base ( i used creole seasoning )
instructions: Marinate the tilapia fillets in the yogurt for 10 to 12 minutes. Place each fish fillet on a plate and serve garnished with olives, tomatoes, chilies, cornstarch, thyme and chicken base. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: nonfat plain yogurt,salmon,mustard,pork tenderloin,vegetable oil,chicken,active yeast,sesame seed
title: Curry Salmon Sandwich
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 teaspoon vegetable oil | 1/4 teaspoon dry mustard | 1 3/4 cups nonfat plain yogurt | 1/2 cup shredded chicken | 2 teaspoons sesame seeds, toasted | 1 pound skinless, boneless salmon, julienned, can sub salmon steaks | 1 pound fresh boneless pork tenderloins, cut in 3/4-1/2-inch cubes
instructions: In a small bowl, dissolve yeast in oil. Stir in mustard. In a measuring cup, combine yogurt, chicken, sesame seeds and 2 teaspoons yeast mixture. Spoon into a gallon size zipper freezer bag.

title: Tamarind and Bow tie Pasta
ingredients: 1/2 pound bow tie pasta | 1/4 cup tamarind paste | 1 tablespoon finely crushed tamarind pods, diluted with | 1 tablespoon water
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: pumpkin puree,fruit,water,chorizo sausage,icing sugar,part mozzarella cheese
title: Chorizo, Pumpkin Pie or "melt in Your Mouth"
ingredients: 250 g chorizo sausage, sliced into small chunks | 500 ml water | 500 ml pumpkin puree | 1/4 cup icing sugar | 300 g part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded | 250 g mixed dried fruit
instructions: Put a large pan of water on a low heat. Put chorizo in there and heat until it smells good and is starting to colour. Add pumpkin and bring to the boil and pour into a large pot. Mix in 1/4 cup of icing sugar, about 2 heaped tbsp at a time until it tastes like pumpkin pie. You can also do this with another pan. You just want to get a little substance with the pumpkin, not to get a blob as the chorizo will be quite dry. Simmer for 5 minutes and drain. Combine with the mozzarella and dried fruit. Serve with a little fresh bread or crackers.

title: Easy Mushroom Sandwiches
ingredients: 10 ounces cream of mushroom soup | 2 tablespoons dried minced onion salt or 1 tablespoon minced fresh onion | 1 prepared pizza crust | 1 1/2 cups sliced deli-style sliced deli-style mushrooms
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400â°. In a small bowl, combine the cream of mushroom soup and minced onion. Spread this mixture over the pizza crust. Top with sliced deli style mushrooms. Place the pizza on a pizza rack and bake 20 minutes.

title: Yorkshire Bean & Ricotta Pasta Filling
ingredients: 1 lb plain flour | 1 lb fresh baked beans, made from homemade ( or your own recipe ) | 2 ounces black peppercorns | 1 tablespoon ricotta cheese | 1 maraschino cherry
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. Mix flour and pepper in a large bowl. Mix in beans and ricotta. Stir in chopped cherries. Stir in enough water until you have a soft dough. Turn out onto a floured surface and knead for 2 - 3 minutes or until smooth. Place on ungreased oven tray. Spread evenly with a spoonful of ricotta mixture. Bake for 30 - 45 minutes, until very lightly browned and firm.

title: Crispy Chicken With Gruyere and Capers
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon chili sauce | 1 pinch capers | 4 skinless chicken breast halves | 4 tablespoons grated gruyere
instructions: Dry the chicken with kitchen paper and score the fat with a sharp knife. Toss everything together in a bowl, then cover and leave in the fridge for 1 hour. Put the chicken in a hot oven and cook for 45 minutes or until cooked through and lightly browned. Serve with rice, and a green vegetable.

Random Ingredients: head cabbage,tahini,self rising flour,part mozzarella cheese,walnut,pistachio nut,half
title: Tear-Baked Cabbage Cheese Fritters
ingredients: 1 cup shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese | 1/4 cup shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese | 3/4 cup chopped walnuts | 1/2 cup shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese | 1/2 cup chopped unsalted pistachio nuts | 1/2 cup tahini | 1 1/2 cups self-rising flour | 1 cup half-and-half
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Combine mozzarella cheese, walnuts, and 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese in a bowl.

title: Baked Orange Bites
ingredients: 1 navel orange, sliced | 10 loaves french bread ( i buy 6 slices on a large size piece of white bread ) | 2/3 cup tahini | 1/3 cup brown sugar | 1/4 cup finely chopped shallot | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1/2 - 1 cup plain yogurt
instructions: Mix the tahini, brown sugar, shallots, and vanilla in a medium bowl. Wash hands. Place a slice of orange on a piece of french bread and spoon about 3/4 to 3 tbsp of the tahini mixture in along the edge of the slice. Then layer in the order of each slice of fruit. Wrap in plastic wrap, and chill for at least 2 hours.

title: Scallops in Almond-Pine Nut Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup pine nuts | 1 teaspoon cardamom | 4 tablespoons salted almonds | 20 large scallops
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Spread pine nuts on a baking sheet and toast in the oven on the middle rack, stirring once or twice until the nuts are light brown, about 10 minutes. In a mortar and pestle, or blender, grind the almonds until fine | Combine the pine nuts and the cardamom in a small bowl, stirring together. Place the scallops in a shallow dish. Rub the nuts onto the scallops and pat them dry.

title: Apricot and Black Pepper Enzymes
ingredients: 10 apricots, peeled | 1/2 teaspoon black peppercorns, cracked | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 3 tablespoons olive oil
instructions: Slice the apricots lengthwise, and then into halves, again lengthwise, and finally into halves again. Cut off the top and base of the halves and remove any stones that may be found. Combine peppercorns, cinnamon, worcestershire sauce, and olive oil. Place one tablespoon of the marinade over each of the apricots to coat. Marinate at least an hour before serving as the flavour improves on standing.

Random Ingredients: palm sugar,canola oil,wheat flour,sun tomato oil
title: Wheat Germ Cookies
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups whole wheat flour | 1 cup palm sugar ( or turbinado sugar ) | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained and chopped
instructions: Set oven to 400 f. Oil and flour two cookie sheets. In a small bowl, combine flour, sugar, canola oil and sun dried tomatoes. Knead until smooth. Place dough in a mixing bowl, and place hands on top of dough. Cover and allow dough to rest 15 minutes. Roll dough out to 1/4 thick, and cut into 2 inch round cookies. Use a fork to dip cookies into mixture, and gently press into circles. Place on the cookie sheets, and bake 10 minutes, until golden brown. Allow cookies to cool on the sheets for a few minutes on the pan, before removing to wire rack to cool completely.

Random Ingredients: coconut flour,kiwi,vegetable oil cooking spray,self raising flour,wheat pita bread,raspberry jam
title: Mini Kiwi Breads With Raspberry Jam
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups self-raising flour, sifted ( gluten-free if desired ) | 1 cup whole wheat pita bread, cut into 1/4-inch slices | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 packet frozen raspberries and kiwi | 1 tablespoon coconut flour | 2 tablespoons raspberry jam
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c line 2 baking trays with baking paper. Set oven rack in middle of oven. Place bread, slightly overlapping, in single layer on baking tray. Lightly spray with oil. With your hands, sift flour into large bowl. Add kiwis, and toss to coat. Place in oven to bake for 3 minutes, stirring midway through. Remove from oven, and transfer bread to baking sheet. Bake for 18 minutes. Transfer to wire rack and cool. Roughly chop kiwi fruit, and mix with coconut flour, jam and sifted flour until mixture is just moist. Spoon mixture into paper cases, and replace trays with baking paper to allow mixture to cool. Cut each slice through to make half moons. Serve slices warm or at room temperature with raspberry jam, or toasted and crumpled on the side. Keeps up to 1 week if refrigerated.

title: Baked Veal Cutlets
ingredients: 2 tablespoons brandy or 2 tablespoons white wine | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground sumac | 4 veal cutlets
instructions: Combine brandy, sumac and 2 t of the cold water.

Random Ingredients: asiago cheese,flour tortilla,quinoa,creme de cacao,brown mustard seed,farfalle pasta,balsamic vinegar
title: Balsamic Cheese and Raisin Fajitas
ingredients: 3/4 cup quinoa | 1 1/3 cups farfalle pasta | 3/4 cup asiago cheese, shredded and divided | 2 teaspoons brown mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1/2 cup creme de cacao | 6 inches flour tortillas
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f rinse quinoa under cold water. In large bowl, combine quinoa and 1 1/3 cups water, making sure it is completely covered. Place in oven for 10 minutes. After 5 minutes, stir and allow to fluff up slightly while cooking. Meanwhile, toast mustard seeds in preheating oven for 15 minutes or until light brown, stirring occasionally. Remove from oven. Add asiago, vinegar and creme de cacao to skillet. Allow to dissolve completely. Remove quinoa from oven and pour mixture into skillet. Stir quickly and evenly until ingredients are evenly distributed. Dab each tortilla with a knife to allow oil to penetrate evenly. Using 1/4 cup cheese per tortilla, put 1/6th of the quinoa and 1/6th of the cheese on both tortillas on each tortilla. Fold each corner to corner, then roll up tightly. Place seam side down on a cookie sheet. Spray tops with cooking spray if desired. Let stand in refrigerator for 3 hours. Bake until all the cheese has melted, about 22 minutes. Remove from oven and allow to sit for 10 minutes before slicing.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,green chili pepper,ricotta cheese,parsley,barbecue sauce
title: Green Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup fat-free ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons barbecue sauce, any flavor | 1 green chili pepper, finely chopped | 1 green cardamom pod | chopped fresh parsley, to top ( optional )
instructions: Place ricotta in medium bowl. Heat barbecue sauce in microwave or in a small nonstick skillet until warm, about 1 minutes. Place green pepper and cardamom pod in processor. Process to a fine powder. Add cheese mixture. Process until smooth, stopping frequently to scrape down sides of the bowl. Turn into bowl and coat with sauce. Cover and chill for 3 hours or up to 3 days. When ready to serve, sprinkle with parsley, if desired. Serve with vegetables, crackers or other accompaniments such as french rolls or bread. This can also be served with pita bread.

title: Nut Sauce
ingredients: 1 kg meat, any cut | 400 ml amaretto | pepper | macadamia nuts
instructions: Cut the meat into 1/2 pieces, and saute in a pan with a little olive oil. Pour the amaretto over the meat while it is cooking. When the meat is cooked add the pepper and macadamia nuts. Note, if using any dry nuts, then add 1 tablespoon of rum or a dash of dark rum flavouring. You may also use almonds that are ground or grated, or roasted nuts, which have been ground or roasted.

title: Parmesan Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 lb gouda cheese | 1 green pepper, chopped into thin strips | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 3 whole cloves, crushed | 3 tablespoons anisette, powder
instructions: Cut the cheese into 1 chunks and boil for 1 minute in a pot of water with 1 teaspoon of anisette powder. Once the cheese is melted and water is boiling, add all ingredients. Keep stirring, and watch for liquid to decrease. Once the liquid comes to a boil, turn the heat low and add the cheese chunks. After cheese is completely melted and mixture begins to thicken, cover and wait over 15 minutes to allow it to cool down a little bit. Serve in a bowl as a dip for vegetables, meats, or poultry.

title: Spicy White Beans (Portabella Mushrooms)
ingredients: 1 can great northern beans, drain ( reserve liquid ) | 1 medium fresh portabella mushroom, stems removed, coarsely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Prepare mushrooms by placing stems in bowl of cold water, then pressing lightly on bottom of bowl until stems are free of dirt. In another bowl, mash mushrooms with potato masher or large heavy skillet. Add beans, reserved liquid and seasonings. Stir lightly, just until beans are incorporated and warm. Gently stir in reserved mushrooms. Cover and let stand in refrigerator 1 to 1 1/2 hours, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,baking powder,cantaloupe,tomato green chilies,cooking apple,vegetable oil,pimiento
title: Mexican Melon Sopaipillas
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 lbs ripe cantaloupe or 2 1/2-3 lbs other very ripe melon, such as red anjoupe, peeled and seeded | butter-flavored cooking apple | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil, plus additional for sauteeing olives if desired | 1 jar diced pimientos, drained | 14 ounces diced tomatoes and green chilies, drained | 3 cups flour tortillas, warmed | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder, lightly toasted if desired
instructions: Cut cantaloupe lengthwise with a sharp knife into 1/4 inch chunks. Cut remaining melons crosswise into 1/2 inch wedges. Place wedges in a large bowl, toss with salt.

Random Ingredients: grape tomato,pork rib,mango powder,golden raisin,tiger shrimp,vegetable cooking spray,bean sprout
title: Citrus Island Stew
ingredients: 1 lb pork ribs, cut in 1 1/2-inch cubes | 1/2 cup seedless grape tomatoes | 1/2 cup mango powder ( no substitutes ) | 1 can baked beans with mixed sprouts, well rinsed and well drained | 2 cups mung bean sprouts, well rinsed and well drained | vegetable cooking spray ( optional ) | fresh prawns or tiger shrimp, to serve
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 deg. F. Place the pork in a large roasting pan. Combine the tomatoes, mango powder and beans. Pour over the pork, covering and placing the lid on the pan. Transfer to the oven, bake at 325 deg. F, about 1 hour.. Check meat after 45 minutes. Serve meat from the pan over noodles or rice, garnished with the sprouts, mung beans and shrimp. Note, if desired, cook the shrimp or prawns in boiling water.

Random Ingredients: thai fish sauce,prosciutto,picante sauce,vidalia onion,great northern bean,cocoa,maraschino cherry
title: Baked Bean Salsa
ingredients: 2 cans great northern beans ( drained and rinsed ) | 1 vidalia onion ( chopped ) | 8 leaves maraschino cherries | 1 jar picante sauce | 2 teaspoons thai fish sauce | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa | 2 slices prosciutto ( dried )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place beans, onion, maraschino cherries, picante sauce, fish sauce, and cocoa in a bowl. Bake in a covered casserole dish for 20 - 25 minutes or until beans are hot and bubbling. Remove from oven and spread out on a cooling rack. Allow to cool completely. Cut 1 slices prosciutto in thin pieces and toss with the beans. Place in refrigerator to allow flavors to blend.

title: Rice Wine Fudge
ingredients: 12 cups rice wine, divided | 6 cups hot pickling spices, divided | 2 tablespoons lime zest | 2 tablespoons reduced-calorie margarine
instructions: Place 4 cups rice wine, 2 spice blend and lime zest into a large saucepan, heat just to boiling.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,broccoli,coffee powder,carrot,stewing beef,brown mustard seed,white sugar,pistachio
title: Beef Broccoli
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef or 1 lb leg of beef | 3 tablespoons cocoa powder ( heaping ) or 1 tablespoon instant coffee powder ( heaping ) | 1/4 cup brown mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 4 tablespoons instant coffee powder | 1/4 cup sliced carrot | 1/4 cup chopped pistachios | 1/4 cup chopped broccoli
instructions: Place all ingredients in a 1 1/2 quart crockpot. Cover and cook on low 4 - 8 hours or until beef is tender. Remove meat and discard it and vegetables.

title: Kicked Up Cheese
ingredients: 2 cups ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons vermouth | 2 teaspoons parmesan cheese | 10 -16 kalamata olives, sliced ( or any other good olives ) | 1/3 cup plum sauce ( i use classico ) | 1/2 cup toasted sliced almonds
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Mix ricotta cheese, vermouth and parmesan cheese in small bowl. Spread onto ungreased cookie sheet. Layer olives on top of cheese mixture and top with plum sauce. Sprinkle top with almonds. Bake 10 - 15 minutes.

title: Roasted Eggplant With Poblano Chile and Turnips
ingredients: 6 large poblano chiles, roasted, peeled and roughly chopped | 12 large eggplants | 1/4 lb turnip, peeled and cut into chunks
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f brush roasted eggplant with oil and place in a roasting pan. Roast for about 20 minutes, until soft and roasted smell of roasted garlic has gone off. When cooled enough to handle, break the eggplant into chunks. Roast the turnips until they are very well roasted, skin on, about 15 minutes. Then peel the turnips and cut into chunks, toss together with the roasted chiles, turnip, and garlic. The turnip is also the tomato sauce ingredient.

Random Ingredients: chicken wing,cherry,heinz chili sauce,rice wine vinegar,ginger paste
title: Lucky Wings
ingredients: 1/2 cup heinz chili sauce | 1/2 cup sweet rice wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon ginger paste | 2 1/2 lbs chicken wings | cherries, for garnishing
instructions: Whisk together in a saucepan the chili sauce and the rice vinegar and heat to boiling. Immediately place the chicken wings in the saucepan and simmer, uncovered, about 30 minutes, turning frequently. Serve immediately with desired garnishes.

Random Ingredients: vegetable,pie shell,vegetable oil,chili powder,spinach,baby spinach,polenta,rigatoni pasta
title: Spinach and Pasta Pie
ingredients: 1/2 cup vegetable oil | 1 cup frozen mixed vegetables, sliced ( potatoes, carrots, and cauliflower ) | 12 ounces rigatoni pasta, broken into 1-inch pieces ( bow tie ) | 2 tablespoons chili powder | 12 ounces frozen chopped spinach, thawed | 2 cups frozen vegetables, thawed and drained | 1 package frozen mixed vegetables, thawed and drained | 1 package polenta, thawed and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Heat oil in large skillet over medium high heat. Saute frozen vegetables, stirring often, about 5 minutes. Remove skillet from heat. Stir in chili powder. Add vegetables and spinach. Mix well. Spoon mixture into pie shell.

title: Roasted Salmon and Spaghetti (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 1 )
ingredients: 800 g skinless salmon fillets, thawed | 1/4 cup dried oregano | 35 g ginger, grated | 350 g spaghetti ( fresh or canned )
instructions: Heat oven to 190c/fan/gas cut salmon into 6 - 8 serving pieces. Place the salmon and a large pinch of oregano in a large roasting tin, sprinkle with the ginger and remaining oregano. Cover with foil and cook for 20 mins to warm. Meanwhile, bring a large large pan of water to the boil. Meanwhile, cook the spaghetti according to pack instructions, drain and return to the pan. Add the sauce, toss well, and serve.

Random Ingredients: sugar snap pea,amaretto liqueur,orange,horseradish,cornmeal,coffee granule,japanese soy sauce
title: Coffee Broccoli
ingredients: 2 teaspoons instant coffee granules, dissolved in | 1 tablespoon hot coffee ( room temperature ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons fresh horseradish, grated | 1 tablespoon fresh orange rind, grated | 1/4 cup japanese soy sauce | 3/4 cup sugar snap pea | 1 1/2 teaspoons cornmeal | 1/2 teaspoon amaretto liqueur ( optional )
instructions: Stir together first 6 ingredients. Place snap peas in a bowl of warm water for 10 minutes, or until bright green and crisp. Drain, and set aside. Toast cornmeal in a dry small nonstick skillet over medium low heat until pale gold in color.

title: Tomato Fish Tacos
ingredients: 2 -4 lbs fish, cut up ( i use cod ) | 1 can tomato paste | 1 packet taco seasoning mix ( i like mccormick ) | parmesan cheese, for dipping
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Place everything into oven bag. Put bag in microwave for about 7 minutes. Unplace, and shake. Bake for 15 minutes. Serve with sour cream or your favorite toppings. Note, if you want a fish taco, bake in a skillet with olive oil on medium heat. Or, you can make your own tacos by using spanish rice mix, and a bit more pimento if desired.

title: Sizzlin' Barley, Thyme & Blue Curacao Salad
ingredients: 500 g barley ( or bulgar black-eyedbeans or your own, cooked ) | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 60 g blue curacao | 3 tablespoons fresh parsley ( minced ) | black pepper ( freshly ground )
instructions: Combine all ingredients into a bowl. Mix well & serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,green onion,margarine,cocoa powder,tomato juice,garlic clove,cornstarch,water chestnut
title: Chocolate Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup margarine | 1/3 cup diced water chestnut ( canned is ok ) | 1/2 cup diced green onion ( spring onions ) | 1 garlic clove, minced | 3 tablespoons tomato juice or 3 tablespoons tomato paste | 1/4 cup cocoa powder or 1/4 cup flour | 1/4 cup cornstarch or 1/4 cup plain flour | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Add all ingredients in the order listed to your desired consistency, except the cornstarch/blend. If you wish to thicken the sauce, add small chunks of cornstarch and stir until it is all mixed together. If you wish to be really fancy and serve with your favourite food, you'll need to stir in an extra teaspoon of the cocoa powder or flour prior to serving. The amounts on the ingredients in the ingredients list are a conservative taste, but trust me it will still taste good.

title: Tartifruit (Funnel Food)
ingredients: 6 ounces colby cheese ( or cheddar ) | 6 ounces brown sugar
instructions: Mix and serve.

Random Ingredients: tuna steak,balsamic vinaigrette salad dressing,serrano chilies,vanilla pudding mix,manicotti
title: Stuffed  Beef Manchego
ingredients: 1 cup prepared instant vanilla instant pudding mix ( prepared according to package directions ) | 1 cup tuna steak, cut into chunks | 2/3 cup balsamic vinaigrette salad dressing | 1/2 cup sliced manicotti | 2 pickled serrano chilies
instructions: Prepare instant pudding according to package directions. Meanwhile, in a medium bowl, blend tuna chunks and vinaigrette salad dressing to blend. Add drained tuna and chilies. Remove puddings from bowl and lay them flat on waxed paper. Fill each manicotti pasta half full with tuna mixture and serve.

Random Ingredients: thai red curry paste,brown sugar,cherry tomato,broad egg noodle,heavy cream,artificial sweetener,dark chocolate,roast
title: Noodle, Roasted & Sour Cream Stroganoff # 5
ingredients: 200 g thai red curry paste | 200 g dark chocolate | 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 300 g swiss-style stir fry roast | 300 g cherry tomatoes ( fresh, not in season ) | 1 tablespoon artificial sweetener | 2 tablespoons sweetened sweetened sour cream | 2 teaspoons thai red curry paste | 1/3 cup heavy cream | 8 ounces soush thai plain noodles, cooked
instructions: For the sauce, bring the cream to the boil. Remove from the heat and add the sugar. Stir until dissolved. Set aside until cold. Combine the curry paste, chocolate, brown sugar, cream, roast and cherry tomatoes. Season. Stir until thick. Serve the stroganoff with the soush thai sweet sour cream, sweetened sour cream and red curry paste.

title: Cheese & Worcestershire Biscuit
ingredients: 1 packet shredded cheddar cheese ( you can get creative with this ) | 1 packet worcestershire sauce ( you can also add 1 tsp. of allspice )
instructions: Mix the worcester in with the cheddar. Place biscuits on baking paper and bake at c for approx 5 minutes, until golden.

Random Ingredients: oil,dashi,brown mustard seed,white pepper,taco seasoning,bay leaf,masala
title: Taco Meat
ingredients: 1 cup masala or 1 cup brown mustard seeds | 1 cup tamari or 1 cup fish sauce | 2 tablespoons oil | 2 tablespoons masala ( i use a curry powder blend ) | 2 teaspoons prepared mustard seeds ( i use 2 tablespoons ) | 10 bay leaves | 2 1/2 teaspoons white pepper | 1 teaspoon instant dashi
instructions: Grind the masala, mustard seeds, tamari, oil, mustard seeds, bay leaves, white pepper into a smooth paste. Marinate the meat in this paste for about 4 hours. Heat 3/4 of the dashi in a pan. Add the prepared masala paste and saute. Once it begins to bubble, add the rest of the liquid. Mix well, cover and simmer on a low heat for 30 minutes. Turn it occasionally to insure that it is well blended. I have also made this with tamari instead of tamari.

title: Beef and Red Snapper Appetizers
ingredients: 3 ounces beef stew meat | 1 teaspoon honey | 1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger ale | 1 sheet puff pastry | 1 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1/4 cup shredded sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and chopped | 1/4 cup shredded reduced-fat philadelphia cream cheese | 4 red snapper fillets
instructions: Combine cooked beef and honey in medium bowl.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,cayenne,mozzarella cheese,chipotle powder,spinach leaf,egg white,iceberg lettuce,honey mustard
title: Spinach Salad
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb fresh spinach leaves, chopped | 1/4 cup coarsely packed pecorino romano cheese | 1 egg white | 1 1/4 teaspoons honey mustard | 1/8 teaspoon dried chipotle powder | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | iceberg lettuce, shredded ( optional ) | 8 large fresh cheese slices ( optional )
instructions: Place a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat and add 1 tablespoon oil. Add spinach. Stir once and allow wilt to wilt. Remove from heat, if using, and drain any excess liquid off of spinach. Place all ingredients, except the lettuce, in a large bowl. Toss well. Top with lettuce. Top with desired amount of cheese, if desired.

title: Warm Spiced Sugar Snap Peas
ingredients: 4 cups sugar snap peas, strings removed | 1/2 cup prepared balsamic vinegar | 3 tablespoons fresh coarse-grain ground italian seasoning or 3 tablespoons regular italian seasoning, divided | 1/2 teaspoon salt
instructions: In a medium saucepan of boiling water, cover and cook until the snap peas are tender, about 6 - 7 minutes. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, stir together the vinegar, 1 tablespoon of the italian seasoning, and the salt. Add remaining italian seasoning mixture and toss to coat. Serve hot, warm or room temperature.

title: Juan Yang Bai Kapusta
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pork belly, boneless, with fat | 7 ounces ground pork | spices
instructions: Cut meat into 2 inch long squares. Dry thoroughly. Place on a plate, cover and let stand 30 minutes. Cut off fat. Rinse well with cold water. Drain and pat dry with paper towels. Combine all ingredients. Stuff and pack meat into a tightly closed container. Marinate in refrigerator for 12 to 24 hours. Remove meat.

title: Pignoli Oil (Maktab Aka Spicy Oil)
ingredients: 1 cup pine nuts ( or cashews, pistachios, cashews, almonds or a combination of the three ) or 1 cup hazelnuts, chopped ( or cashews, pistachios, almonds or a combination of the three ) | 1/2 cup fresh cardamom seeds, lightly crushed
instructions: Heat the oil in a medium sized skillet over medium heat. Add the cardamom and lightly toast the nuts, stirring frequently and observantly, until browned to a reddish color. Lower the heat if necessary and add the pine nuts and continue to stir constantly until they turn a nutty paste. Remove from the heat and season with salt. Serve warm or room temperature.

Random Ingredients: vegetable eggplant,kaffir lime leaf,cardamom powder,poblano chile,yellow pepper
title: Yellow Pepper & Zucchini
ingredients: 1 small zucchini | 1 large yellow pepper | 2 poblano chiles ( fresh or canned ) | 2 teaspoons cardamom powder | 2 tablespoons vegetable or 2 tablespoons canola oil
instructions: Cut zucchini into 1/4 inch coins. Heat oil in a medium frying pan over moderate heat. Add zucchini, yellow pepper, and chiles and cook, stirring, until vegetables are tender, about 3 - 4 minutes. Add cardamom, stir, and cook 1 - 2 minutes longer or until zucchini is soft.

title: Clams in Sherry
ingredients: 1/2 cup cherry juice | 2 teaspoons dried tarragon
instructions: Combine cherry juice, tarragon and 1/2 a teaspoon salt and stir vigorously. Pour into a glass preserving jar and seal tightly. Repeat twice more. Shake well for 1 - 2 hours. Serve as a snack or accompaniment.

Random Ingredients: yellow cake mix,ginger paste,beef tenderloin,white vinegar,bell pepper,tuna,lettuce
title: Tuna Beef
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ginger paste | 1 pound lean beef tenderloin, thinly sliced | 4 leaves lettuce | 1/2 small bell pepper, coarsely chopped | 1 can tuna | 1 teaspoon white vinegar | 1 box yellow cake mix
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly grease a medium baking sheet. In a shallow bowl, stir together the ginger paste and 1/2 cup oil. Add the beef and mix well. Place in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet. Roast in the preheated oven until the internal temperature of the meat reaches 160 degrees f, about 15 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes. Meanwhile, in a medium bowl, combine the salad dressing ingredients. Spoon over beef and toss to coat. Serve beef on a bed of lettuce at least 4 inches long and 3 to 4 inches wide.

instructions: Prepare soup with all ingredients except tomato juice and grate orange rind and juice into a bowl. Set aside. Bring tomato juice to boil in medium saucepan on meduim heat.

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, cream butter until fluffy.

ingredients: 3 tablespoons sour cream | 1 tablespoon chopped hazelnuts | 1 teaspoon grenadine | 1 baked pizza crust | 1 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1 tablespoon sweetened chili sauce or 1 tablespoon sriracha hot sauce, plus more for drizzling | 1/2 cup chopped fresh cherry tomatoes or 1/2 cup other tomato | 1/4 cup shredded monterey jack cheese or 1/4 cup other cheese
instructions: Mix sour cream, hazelnuts, and grenadine in medium bowl.

Random Ingredients: cod fish fillet,parmesan cheese,olive,farfalle pasta,egg yolk
title: Farfalle with Cod and Olives
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta, uncooked | 2 1/2 cups cooked cod fish fillets, skinned and coarsely chopped | 1 cup sliced ripe olives, drained | 2 egg yolks, lightly beaten | 1/2 cup freshly shredded parmesan cheese
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the bow tie pasta, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 11 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink, and set aside. In a large bowl, toss the cod with 1/2 the olives, egg yolks, and parmesan cheese. Place the farfalle in the prepared pasta. Pour the hot pasta mixture over the cod, and toss to combine.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,fennel bulb,parsnip,vanilla bean,beef cap,lemon,ginger garlic paste,bok choy
title: Spicy Grilled Capsicum Salad
ingredients: 2 -4 small beef capsicums ( approx 2.5cm diameter ) | 1/2 fennel bulb, ends trimmed and fronds left on | 1 cup carrot, chopped in large chunks | 200 g bok choy, cut in 2 cm pieces & washed | 2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 cup thick & chunky salsa | 1/2 grated lemon, rind of | 1/2 teaspoon lemons, rind of
instructions: Preheat a barbecue char grill or grill pan over high heat. Thread the capsicum strips on to skewers. Cook capsicum in the hot grill until lightly charred. Leave to cool on a plate. Meanwhile, place the bok choy in a pan of hot water.

title: Italian Sausage - 1lb
ingredients: 3 italian sausages ( 1 inch thick, skin on ) | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1 lb jumbo shrimp
instructions: Cook sausage in dutch oven, breaking up clumps with side of a spoon, until well done. Add anise oil. When sausage is done, drain well. Combine sausage and shrimp and cook over low heat, until shrimp are pink, but not too soft. Serve with warm flour or aioli.

Random Ingredients: hot green chili pepper,active yeast,sage,rice vinegar,wheat flour,monterey jack cheddar cheese,cream celery soup
title: Green Tea Bagels(Vegan)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon active dry yeast | 1 teaspoon hot green chili pepper ( or 1/2 fresh hot pepper ) | 1/2 cup warm cream of celery soup | 1 1/2 cups whole wheat flour | 1/2 cup rice vinegar, not rice salt | 1/2 cup shredded low-fat monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend | 1/2 teaspoon ground sage
instructions: In a small container, stir together yeast, chili pepper, cream of celery soup, flour, vinegar, cheese and sage. Place in bread maker, set on the dough cycle. When all of the dough has been mixed in the bread pan place into it the bread machine, cover and set to dough or floured, if you prefer. When the dough is ready, transfer it to a greased baking sheet, let it rise until doubled in bulk. It is vital for the bread to rise well as ovens can vary, so plan accordingly. Preheat oven to 375. After 25 minutes remove and allow to rest a few minutes, then turn out onto a lightly flour surface and knead to develop elasticness and stretch. Turn out onto a floured baking sheet and let rest a few minutes and then cut into squares. They should be about 1/2 to 1/2 inch thick. Bake for 25 - 30 minutes or until brown and puffed. This can be baked in a muffin tin as well, for a crispier crust and a more elegant texture.

title: Apple Jicama Pie (Zwt Three)
ingredients: 15 ounces tart apples, peeled, cored & amp, sliced | 8 ounces sweet potato & jicama | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 1 tablespoon jicama, chopped | 13 1/2 ounces pie shells
instructions: Dice pie crust into 1 inch squares. Spray 9x13x2 in pan, then cover with apples. Sprinkle with jicama. Mix cornflour w/dip pie crust squares into apples & jicama w/cornflour mixture. Layer with pie crust. Bake at 375 for about 30 minutes or until crust is golden. Serve with ice cream, cream or cold milk.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach,vegetable oil cooking spray,liquid honey,artichoke heart,pimiento,black coffee,saltine cracker

instructions: Make honey garlic spread over crackers, sprinkle with salt and refrigerate 3 - 4 hrs till flavours develop.

instructions: Toss together all the ingredients and refrigerate for a few hours.

( you want all the liquid to be on the spinach and drain the spinach, not the outside ) | 1/2 cup fresh orange juice, divided ( i like to use 1/2 a bottle ) | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 4 cups chopped white onions | 1 cup potato, peeled and cut into bite sized pieces | 1/4 cup fresh minced spinach
instructions: In bowl, combine frozen spinach with 1/4 cup orange juice, oyster sauce, and onions. Add half of the potato and half of the remaining orange juice. instructions: In a large pot, bring 1/2 cup water to a boil over high heat. Add pearl barley.

instructions: Spread half of the cheese onto the bottom of a medium glass dish. Arrange the cucumber slices on top. Top with the green onions and drambuie. Spoon over the coffee powder and sprinkle with oregano. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour to develop flavor.

Random Ingredients: sea bass fillet,grainy mustard,tuna,fish sauce,chili sauce,mexican tomato
title: Hot Fish Tacos
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chili sauce, for coating | 4 skinless sea bass fillets, about 6 oz each | 1 tablespoon coarse grainy mustard, for coating | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 1 can tuna, drained | 2 ounces mexican-style stewed tomatoes, drained & rinsed
instructions: Combine pepper sauce, mustard, fish sauce and tuna in a shallow dish or pie plate. Cover, and refrigerate for up to 24 hours. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Brush each with a little more seasoning, and bake until fish flakes when pierced with a fork, about 20 minutes.

title: Pasta With Zucchini and Almonds
ingredients: 3 cups cooked rigatoni pasta | 1 large zucchini, peeled and cut into 1/2 inch slices ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 1 tablespoon distilled white vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 2 tablespoons light corn syrup
instructions: Toss pasta with zucchini in a large bowl. Whisk together vinegar, extract, nutmeg and corn syrup in a small dish. Pour dressing over zucchini mixture and toss well. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour and up to 1 day.

title: Tamari Ribs (Or Beef & Pine Nut Pasta)

instructions: Place the meat in two 12 by 7 inch pans and sprinkle generously with tamari, sugar, and 1 1/2 tablespoons salt. Cover and refrigerate for 24 hours. Preheat the oven to 475°. instructions: Place all in a large frying pan and add enough rum to cover the chicken. Cover, simmer til done. Garnish with chopped nuts and coconut if desired.

instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a pot. Cover and cook on low for 8 hours. Add water as needed. Serve with chapatis.
