ingredients: 1 1/2 cups parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons butter | 2 tablespoons green onions, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon allspice | 3 tablespoons maple syrup | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/4 teaspoon grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Using an electic mixer, add butter, cheese, and green onions. Mix until smooth and creamy. Sprinkle in spices. Pour onto a warm cake or cake baking tray and spread on a silpat to one side. When cold, cut into 6 squares. Store in an airtight container. ~note~if using a bundt pan or muffin pan, dust inside of cake with 1 1/2 teaspoons of grated parm, butter or margarine, spread, frosting, and spread on a warm cake.

title: Easy Low Fat Buttermilk Rusks
ingredients: 125 ml low-fat buttermilk | 1 -2 tablespoon tomato paste | 1 red capsicum, finely diced red pepper, diced | 1 -2 tablespoon confectioners'sugar
instructions: First combine all the ingredients in a bowl and mix well. Form the mixture into six rusks. Flatten the rusks with a rolling pin and decorate by sprinkling with coloured sugars. Cook on a non stick griddle or griddle pan over medium heat for about 3 - 5 minutes each side or until the rusks are cooked through. Serve warm from the oven with yoghurt or sour cream.

title: Avalatso (Blueberry Pasta)
ingredients: 14 ounces farfalle pasta | 12 ounces crumbled blueberries | 1/4 small white onion, chopped | 1 ounce crumbled cotija cheese | 1 tablespoon packed brown sugar
instructions: Cook farfalle according to package directions. While pasta is cooking, heat remaining ingredients in a non stick skillet on medium high heat for 5 to 6 minutes. Drain pasta and combine with blueberry mixture. Serve warm.

title: Southern Style Cabbage
ingredients: 2 large russet potatoes ( cut into chunks or use 3 medium sized potatoes ) | 1 medium onion soup mix | 1 1/2 lbs hamburger meat | 1 lb escarole ( optional )
instructions: Put 1/2 of the hamburger meat in the bottom of a pan. Cut the last 1/4 of the hamburger into thin strips when you take the pan off the heat. Put the hamburger strips on top of the hamburger and cook for about 15 minutes on medium/high heat. Add potatoes. Put in a little bag or container to marinate your meat while you are eating. When meat is done take the bag or container of meat and add to pot. Add the rest of the ingredients to the pot. Mix the meat and potatoes thoroughly so it doesn't stick to the bottom of the pan. Cook for about 5 - 5 more minutes. Serve hot. This recipe goes very quickly and takes a lot of patience. You may need to add a little more salt.

Random Ingredients: green food coloring,liquid smoke,beef,red currant jelly,pineapple juice
title: Crispy Baked Hamburgers
ingredients: 2 lbs lean ground beef | 2 teaspoons liquid smoke | 1 cup pineapple juice | 2 tablespoons red currant jelly | green food coloring
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Mix the ground beef with liquid smoke. Add pineapple juice and jelly and mix well. Divide the mixture into 16 portions. Shape each portion into a ball and place on ungreased baking sheet. Bake for 20 - 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Lentil Burgers
ingredients: 2 hamburger ( at least ) | 2 tablespoons lentils | 1 tablespoon seasoning ( heaping ) | 4 meatballs, diced | 1/2 cup sweet-and-sour mix
instructions: Cook hamburger. When the hamburger is done, mix in lentils, seasoned meat, and meatballs. Brown in skillet on med low heat. When done, spread sweet and sour on hamburger, and serve.

title: Berbere (Ethiopian Salad)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried onion flakes ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1/4 teaspoon caraway seed | 1 large radish, cut into 1/8 x 1/8-inch slices
instructions: In a mixing bowl, mix all ingredients together. Refrigerate for at least two hours before serving.

title: Pizza With Corn and Parsnips
ingredients: 500 g pizza dough | 3 cups corn, cut from cob, cut in half | 1 bunch parsnip, chopped | 4 -5 small hot peppers | 1 cup red wine | 2 tablespoons sweet tea | 1 cup oyster sauce | orange, zest of
instructions: Heat oven to 200 degrees celsius. Roll pizza dough on floured surface to about 8 - 10 inches long. Cover the dough with waxed paper and a tea towel and let sit about 20 minutes until it's puffy. Meanwhile, make filling, in a frying pan, heat 1 cup of water and 1 tbspn of sweet tea over medium heat, stirring occasionally until it boils. Add in the corn, parsnip, a few hot peppers and red wine, and bring to the boil, cooking for about 2 minutes. Mix the soup with a fork so it becomes smooth. Spread the cooled soup on the pizza dough and put it in to oven. Bake in oven for 10 - 15 minutes. Remove from oven.

Random Ingredients: red lentil,enchilada sauce,yoghurt,allspice,dark rum,herbes de provence
title: Lentil & Pomegranate Dip
ingredients: 1 cup red lentils | 1/4 cup yoghurt | 2 teaspoons herbes de provence | 1 can enchilada sauce | 1/4 cup dark rum | 2 teaspoons allspice
instructions: Place all ingredients in medium saucepan and boil for 2 minutes. Serve with a light sprinkle of sugar if desired.

title: Fish in Basil
ingredients: 16 ounces white fish fillets, cut into 4 pieces | 20 fresh basil leaves | 1/2 cup plain flour
instructions: Place flour in a shallow bowl. Spread fish pieces equally in the flour. Douse with a little cold water until coated. Lightly dust a surface with water. Dredge in the flour. Drop into the boiling water about 3 at a time. They may also be cooked in a frying pan. Cook until golden or cooked through.

Random Ingredients: cranberry,ginger,green bell pepper,italian herb seasoning,lemon,white sugar,vegetable oil peanut,kitchen bouquet
title: Grilled Whole Cranberry and Pepper Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup vegetable oil or 1/2 cup peanut oil | 1/2 cup white sugar | 1 tablespoon minced fresh ginger | 2 teaspoons vegetable oil or 2 teaspoons peanut oil | 1 teaspoon kitchen bouquet | 2 teaspoons italian herb seasoning | 1/4 cup chopped fresh coriander or 1/4 cup cilantro | 4 cups fresh cranberries, stems and pieces removed | 1 teaspoon grated fresh lemon rind
instructions: Add all ingredients except greens and lemon rind to bowl of food processor fitted with steel blade and process until mixture becomes thick and chunky. Cover and refrigerate at least one hour or overnight. When ready to serve, toss greens with lemon rind.

title: Simple Sausage and Pear Stew
ingredients: 2 italian sausages, skinned | 1 pear, cored | 2 tablespoons chili paste with garlic | 2 teaspoons garam masala | 1 pound crabmeat, peeled and cut into pieces
instructions: Place sausages in a large, deep skillet with a lid. Peel pear and slice around sausages so they will sit flat and almost fit into a food processor. Toss pear slices with chili paste until coated. Add garam masala. Cover with lid or steamer pot and cook over medium low heat for 30 minutes. Add crabmeat and cook for an additional 30 minutes, or until crabmeat turns opaque.

Random Ingredients: wheat lasagna noodle,lemon zest,flour,dill,ancho chile,marinara sauce,sea salt black pepper,flat leaf parsley
title: Spicy White Sauce with Chiles and Whole Laranja
ingredients: 2 3/4 cups prepared marinara sauce, homemade or 2 3/4 cups homemade if available | 1 1/2 cups whole wheat lasagna noodles ( i prefer the fresh varieties, from a package you bought when buying a whole box of noodles ) or 1 1/2 cups other noodle ( i prefer the fresh varieties, from a package you bought when buying a whole box of noodles ) | 1 package whole-wheat flour | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chile, crushed | 1 teaspoon lemon zest | 1 teaspoon sea salt & freshly ground black pepper | 2 tablespoons minced fresh flat-leaf parsley | chopped fresh dill ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. For sauce, cook the pasta in a large pot of lightly salted boiling water according to the package directions. Reserving 1/2 cup water, drain the pasta and return it to the pot. Meanwhile, place 1/2 cup of the tomato marinara in a small dish. For sauce, place remaining tomato marinara in a small jar with a tight fitting lid and shake. Set aside about 3 tablespoons of the tomato marinara sauce. Transfer to a small saucepan over medium heat. Add the crushed ancho chili and lemon zest and bring to a boil. Turn the heat down to low, cover, and cook for 2 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside. Using a mortar and pestle, grind the remaining tomato marinara until it is a coarse paste that can easily be broken into. Add the grated tomato paste back into the saucepan. Cook over medium heat, stirring often, until the sauce is thick and smooth. Remove from heat. Stir in the chopped parsley and season to taste. Add about ½ cup of remaining reserved tomato marinara sauce, and stir until the sauce is slightly thickened and the sauce is smooth. Serve over the hot cooked pasta and garnish with chopped dill.

title: Easy Cheese Filled Cheese
ingredients: 2 lbs cottage cheese | 3/4 lb feta cheese | 1/2 lb mozzarella cheese, grated
instructions: Mix all the above together and shape into large ball. Place on pizza tray and bake at 450 f for about 15 - 20 mins until cheese is nice and brown and crispy on the top.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,walnut half,pecan,caraway seed,basil leaf,chickpea,egg yolk,cream
title: Vegetable Kugel With Dried Walnuts
ingredients: 1 jar dried whole button mushrooms, reconstituted | 3/4 cup sour cream | 1/4 cup chopped walnuts ( use to taste, and save some to sprinkle on top ) or 1/4 cup toasted pecans, divided ( use to taste ) | 1/2 cup pecan pieces | 1/2 teaspoon caraway seed | 2 egg yolks, lightly beaten | 1 can chickpeas, drained & rinsed | 3/4 cup shredded fresh basil leaf
instructions: In large bowl, combine all ingredients but basil leaves. Stuff with basil leaves to make an open circle.

title: Saffron Infused Cream (Vegan )
ingredients: 1 ounce light cream | 1 pinch saffron | 2 ounces fresh fish sauce | 1/2 small celery root, thinly sliced
instructions: Put the cream, saffron, fish sauce and celery root in one bowl and add some cold water. Stir well. Pour the mixture over whatever you have on hand, it can even be poured straight through a colander. Cover with clingfilm and leave it to stand for 1 hour. Uncover the bowl and add more water if necessary.

title: Spicy Hungarian Meat Sauce
ingredients: 8 lbs ground round | 2 large yellow onions, peeled and halved lengthwise | 1 teaspoon dried dill | 2 cans chili
instructions: Place ground round in a large nonstick skillet. Add onion halves, then the dill. Pinch with a fork to break them apart while cooking, using small circular motions to keep them moist. Drain meat, then place it in a large stockpot or kettle. Cover the meat with ample cold water. Add chili, then bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer for 2 hours, until meat is very tender. Remove meat to a cutting board. Remove the onion from the skillet and keep warm. Continue cooking the meat mixture, stirring constantly and scraping the bottom of the pan with a wooden spoon, until it is thick and creamy. The sauce will thin as it stands, but it should not be the consistency of spaghetti sauce.

title: The Best Chicken Soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chicken | 1 1/2 lbs pinto beans | 1 lb chopped peanuts | crouton | fine sea salt
instructions: Heat the chicken until almost done then add the remaining ingredients. Let simmer for about an hour. Take out the chickens add salt if desired. Serve with pico de gallo.

Random Ingredients: vegetable broth,edamame,red wine vinegar,rice vinegar,peanut oil vegetable
title: Edamame & Peanut Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup frozen shelled edamame | 3 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 6 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 cup vegetable broth ( can add more ) | 1 tablespoon peanut oil or 1 tablespoon vegetable oil
instructions: Combine edamame, vinegar, broth & oil in a blender. Blend thoroughly.

title: Potted Drambuie
ingredients: 16 ounces sweetened drambuie ( british plum ) | 24 ounces grand marnier
instructions: Dip the drambuie into the grand marnier then roll over a bowl to completely coat the surface. Repeat until all the drambuis have been used. Dip into the grand marnier. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: corn kernel,dark sesame oil,cream tartar,white vinegar,strawberry
title: Strawberry & Sesame Glaze
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 2 cups fresh strawberries, chopped | 1 cup fresh strawberries, sliced | 2 teaspoons white vinegar | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the sesame oil and finely chopped strawberries. Set aside. In a small bowl, add the white vinegar, cream of tartar and the dark sesame oil mixture. Whisk to blend well. Stir in the cream of tartar. Place in a small saucepan, and gently heat over medium heat to warm through. Remove from heat, and brush over fresh fruit before serving.

title: Mexican Meatloaf
ingredients: 3 lbs ground beef or 3 lbs ground turkey | 1/3 cup lard, melted | 2 tablespoons onion powder | 1 can beef gravy | 1 can tomato sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients together, using a large loaf pan. Place in a 9x13 pan sprayed with pam. Bake uncovered at 325°f for 1 hour.

title: Crunchy Cashew Nut Relish
ingredients: 2 cups cashew nuts | 1 lb cauliflower | 1/4 cup ketchup | 2 -4 tablespoons cooking spray | 1 -2 teaspoon red chili powder ( depending on how spicy you like it )
instructions: Place cashews, cauliflower and ketchup in a pot. Cover with water.

title: Red Chili Dogs(Vietnamese Red Chile)
ingredients: 4 lbs pork shoulder | 1 tablespoon dried fenugreek seeds | 1 tablespoon dried hot chili sauce
instructions: Combine fenugreek and chili sauce. Cut the shoulder into 2 - 3 even sized cubes.

title: Onion Soup With Ground Beef
ingredients: 1 medium yellow onion | 1 lb ground chuck | 1 bunch fresh chives
instructions: Peel onion and grate into coarse grater and discard any dark outer skin. Combine meat and onion in a pan. Add 1 cup water and simmer for 45 minutes. Remove from heat. Gather the leaves out of the chives and finely chop coarsely. Put meat mixture into soup. Cook gently for 15 minutes and serve.

title: Roasted Parsnip Chips
ingredients: 1 lb parsnip, peeled | olive oil flavored cooking spray
instructions: Heat oven to 450°f. Cut parsnips in quarters. Arrange on large baking sheet. Coat with oil. Bake 5 min or until golden brown.

title: Champagne Mushrooms
ingredients: 5 large button mushrooms | 1 cup whipping cream
instructions: Clean the mushrooms well and slice thickly into quarters. Arrange them in a serving dish. Pour the cream over the mushrooms, sprinkle with sugar, and serve.

title: Spanish Sausages With Chicken
ingredients: 4 pork sausages, casings removed | 4 chicken breast fillets, cut into 2 pieces each | 1 ounce cornstarch or 1 ounce potato starch | 2 teaspoons garlic powder | 1 teaspoon smoked paprika
instructions: Put the chicken pieces in a heavy frying pan with a lid on over a high heat. Stir the chicken until they just start to turn golden brown and set aside. Sprinkle on one side of each piece of sausagemeat that is the size of the sausagemeat pieces. Repeat with the chicken until all are golden brown and set aside to side. Dry these in a clean towel for a few minutes. Mix together the marinade ingredients and pour over the sausages. Cover and let stand for 20 minutes and then bring to the boil. Take off the heat and set aside to cool. When everything is cool, add the cooked sausage pieces back to the mixture and gently mix together. Serve at room temperature or cold.

title: Green Tea Party Kaffe
ingredients: 2 packages refrigerated dinner rolls | 1 1/2 tablespoons green tea ( preferably ener kohl ) | 1/2 cup whipped cream ( optional )
instructions: Cut rolls into quarters, lengthwise. Remove 1 roll from pods and discard the other, discard remaining pods. Separate the rolls, place on a cookie sheet, and chill in the freezer. Flatten slightly with a fork, then dip rolls in the warm tea for 5 minutes. Turn rolls and freeze the rest. Split the rolls and spread the green tea, and top with remaining slice of roll. Serve chilled with whipped cream.

Random Ingredients: chipotle powder,red cabbage,broth,pie shell,vanilla extract,white wine vinegar,onion soup mix,rice wine vinegar
title: Quick and Easy Chipotle Veggie Pie
ingredients: 1 package onion soup mix | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar | 1/4 cup rice wine vinegar | 1/3 cup broth or 1/3 cup water | 1 -2 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 1 -2 teaspoon crushed chipotle powder ( to taste ) | 1 large refrigerated pie shell, partially baked | 1 cup shredded red cabbage
instructions: Prepare the onion soup mix according to package directions. Pour into pie shell. Dressing, combine all dressing ingredients in saucepan and heat until liquid is reduced to 2 tablespoons. Remove from heat. Stir in cabbage. Sprinkle sauce over pie. Cover and chill overnight before serving.

Random Ingredients: bread,grey poupon dijon mustard,pecorino cheese,sun tomato oil,ginger garlic paste,honey,plain flour,farfalle pasta
title: Sweet N' Savoury Pasta With Pecorino and Sun-Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 9 ounces farfalle pasta or 9 ounces penne pasta | 200 g sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained | 4 tablespoons grey poupon dijon mustard | 4 tablespoons fresh ginger-garlic paste | 3 tablespoons honey | 2 tablespoons finely grated pecorino cheese | 2 tablespoons plain flour | 1 1/2 cups plain flour | grated ginger and garlic to taste ( optional )
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook 2 to 4 minutes or until al dente.

title: Smoked Salmon and Chipotle Grilled Appetizer
ingredients: 4 ounces smoked salmon steak | 3 tablespoons chipotle chiles, finely chopped | 1 black cardamom pod or 1 green cardamom pod
instructions: Cut the salmon steaks into serving pieces. Grill salmon for 2 - 3 minutes on each side or until cooked through. Meanwhile, slice the cardamom pod into thin slivers. Toss with the chipotles and chilli, if using. Serve with the chipotled salmon pieces.

title: Beef & Pinto Chili
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin | 2 lbs pinto beans | 2/3 cup dry red wine, like cabernet sauvignon | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 1 ounce grand marnier
instructions: Cut sirloin meat crosswise into thin slices. Place in large dutch oven.

title: Jalapeño Corn and Coconut Bread
ingredients: 2 tablespoons lemons juice | 12 cups fresh or frozen whole corn kernels | 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded and chopped | 1/3 cup shredded coconut | 1/2 cup canned unsweetened coconut milk | 1 (.25 ounce ) package dry yeast
instructions: Cover a large baking sheet with parchment paper, and spray with cooking spray. Melt the lemons in a skillet over medium low heat. Add corn and chile. Simmer 10 minutes. Add the coconut and coconut milk. Dissolve yeast in the lemon/coconut mixture. Cool 10 minutes, then stir in enough of the reserved corn/chile mixture to form a stiff paste. Transfer to a large bowl. Gently stir in the cooled corn mixture. Cover and allow to sit in a warm spot 5 to 6 hours. Stir occasionally.

Random Ingredients: green onion,kernel corn,radish,manchego cheese,red pepper flake,cream,macaroni noodle,virgin olive oil
title: Corn and Green Onion Mac & Cheese
ingredients: 2 tablespoons virgin olive oil | 6 green onions, thinly sliced ( white and light green parts only ) | 1 lb macaroni noodles or 1 lb thin spaghetti | 8 ounces sour cream or 8 ounces yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1 1/2 cups shredded manchego cheese | 1/2 cup whole kernel corn, cooked | 1 -2 radish, thinly sliced
instructions: Place dutch oven over high heat. Add 2 tablespoons oil and 1/4 teaspoons seasoning.

title: Maryland Crab Burgers
ingredients: 20 ounces fresh crabmeat, picked over | 1/2 cup mango chutney | 1 hard-boiled egg, chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh snipped chives | 1/2 teaspoon lemon pepper | 1 pinch ground mace | 1 large whole mango, pitted and cut into 1/4-inch slices, and drained to remove egg
instructions: Combine crabmeat, chutney, egg, chives, lemon pepper and ground mace in a bowl.

title: Spicy Pistachio Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup shelled pistachios | 1/4 cup italian chili oil | 2 tablespoons dried oregano leaves | 1/4 teaspoon hot pepper sauce
instructions: In a mortar, pound pistachios with chili oil, oregano and hot pepper until smooth.

title: Fresh Peach & Sheep's Eyes
ingredients: 1 cup fresh peach, cubed | 1/4 cup radish, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup fresh peach, cubed | 1/4 lb pork roast or 1/4 lb pork sausage, diced | 20 ladyfingers
instructions: Combine the peaches, radish, & sausage. Cut the pork and peach into slices & place in an oblong dish. Add the peach mixture to the dish. Top with ladyfingers. Drizzle w/sauce. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 min or until hot.

Random Ingredients: white,kalamata olive,enchilada sauce,dark soy sauce,cream celery soup
title: White Beans and Kalamata Olive Dip
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 1 cup white or dark soy sauce | 1/2 cup kalamata olives, chopped | 1/2 cup canned diced white-wheat tortillas packed in water | 1 tablespoon enchilada sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Stir together the cream of celery soup and the soy sauce in a small saucepan over medium heat. Cook and stir until the soup is warmed through. Combine the soup mixture, olives, and tortillas in a serving bowl.

title: Steamed Spaghetti With Smoked Salmon
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti sauce | 3/4 lb sliced smoked salmon | 1/2 aubergine, sliced | 4 black peppercorns, crushed | 1 can black beans
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Prepare spaghetti according to package directions. Slice the sausage into 2 inch pieces. Arrange in a large baking dish. Arrange sliced smoked salmon on top of the bijolade on top of the spaghetti. Sprinkle peppercorns over. In a large resealable plastic bag, combine crushed black beans with 1/2 teaspoon salt. Seal and toss to coat salmon well. Spoon spaghetti into the baking dish with the sausage, smoked salmon, and pepper peppercorns. Cover dish tightly with aluminum foil. Bake for 25 minutes. Remove foil and bake 5 minutes longer or until golden brown and flakey. Serve over spaghetti.

title: Caribbean Coconut Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 can refrigerated pizza crusts | 2 egg whites | 1 1/2 cups canned sweetened coconut meat ( coconut milk works great as a substitute ) | 1 cup frozen sour cherry ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Remove any toothpicks from pizza crusts. Brush the crusts with egg whites. Spread 1 cup of coconut meat on each crust. Sprinkle 1/2 cup of cherries on each pizza crust. Bake 15 to 17 minutes or until lightly browned. Cut into wedges and serve.

Random Ingredients: head green cabbage,spanish onion,yellow pepper,sparkling water,vanilla essence
title: Easy Filipino Coleslaw (Pasamole)
ingredients: 1 large head green cabbage, shredded | 1 medium spanish onion, finely chopped | 1 medium yellow pepper, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 3/4 cup sparkling water
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl and stir fry over medium heat for about 1 minute. Turn the heat down to medium low and leave to stand for about 20 minutes to allow the flavors to develop. Add a little more sparkling water if you want to keep it smoother.

Random Ingredients: ricotta cheese,pita bread,sesame oil,ladyfinger,salt pepper,graham cracker crumb
title: Easy Phyllo Bars
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 1 cup ricotta cheese, canned | 2 packages ladyfingers | 1/2 cup sesame oil | salt and pepper to taste | 1/2 cup sesame oil for brushing
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly grease a 9x9 inch baking dish. In a medium bowl, stir together graham cracker crumbs, ricotta cheese, and ladyfingers. Pour 1/2 cup sesame oil into a small bowl.

title: Peanut Butter and Soy Enchiladas (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 250 g natural yoghurt | 1/4 cup chunky peanut butter | 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh nutmeg ( or 1 tbsp. dried ) | 1 1/4 cups tasty soy sauce | tortilla, warmed, to serve
instructions: Mix together yoghurt, peanut butter, nutmeg and soy sauce. Divide among plates. Spoon a spoonful of peanut butter mixture onto each plate, roll and eat while hot from the fridge. Alternatively, serve over a warm tortilla.

title: Lemon Broccoli Cauliflower and Broccoli
ingredients: 1 tablespoon fresh lemon zest, grated | 1 cup broccoli floret, halved | 1 head cauliflower, broken into florets | 2 tablespoons lemon juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Place the lemon rind in a large bowl with the broccoli and cauliflower. Sprinkle with lemon juice. Spread mixture in an 11x7 baking dish or roasting pan and bake about 30 minutes or until the cauliflower is tender when pierced with a fork.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,campbell tomato soup,sea bass fillet,swiss cheese,hot paprika,ghee,oat bran
title: Fried Fish With Tomatoes, Chiles & Swiss Cheese
ingredients: 3 tablespoons ghee | 1 red chili pepper, minced | 1 red chili pepper, minced | 1/2 cup low-fat campbell's tomato soup | 8 ounces swiss cheese, grated | 3/4 cup oat bran | 1/2 teaspoon hot paprika
instructions: To fry the fish, heat the ghee in a wok and fry the chile and red chili for 2 mins on med high, add the tomato soup to the wok and heat to simmer for 1 minute stir in the cheese and oat bran and season with paprika and salt and pepper. Add 2 cups of hot water, cover and simmer on med low for 6 - 8 mins until the fish is cooked through and the sauce thickened.

title: Tzatziki
ingredients: 3 yellow squash | 1 package frozen mixed vegetables | 1 teaspoon pumpkin pie spice
instructions: Slice the squash in half lengthwise, then cut each half into 1/4 inch slices. Place the sliced squash in a large mixing bowl, cover with water, let sit for 5 minutes, drain. Place the mixed vegetables in a frying pan along with the pumpkin. Mix the spice with the water until it becomes a creamy paste. Dip your cooked squash in sauce at this point and fry in 1/2 t. Olive oil. Serve warm.

title: Italian Bread and Butter (ABM)
ingredients: 8 ounces fat-free italian bread | 1/3 cup banana, mashed | 1 tablespoon fast rising yeast
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 4 cups warm water. Let stand 5 minutes. Turn bread out on baking sheet. Dough will release as it heats up. Combine mashed bananas and yeast. Add warm water and mix well. Divide dough into 3 loaves. Place in 3 greased 13 x9 inch baking pans. Let rise 1 hour in a warm place. Bake in 350 degree oven for 25 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,chunky salsa,red chilies,brown rice,pecan,tapioca,mace
title: Chicken and Spanish Rice
ingredients: 2 cups cooked brown rice | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 1 jar medium chunky salsa | 3 fresh small red chilies, halved | 4 bone-in skinless chicken breast halves, cut into bite size pieces | 1 tablespoon tapioca | 1/4 cup chopped pecans
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. In a medium bowl, combine rice, mace, salsa, red chilies, and chicken. Mix together well. Arrange chicken pieces in a large baking dish. Cook in preheated oven for 5 to 10 minutes, or until the chicken is no longer pink inside. Drain off any excess liquid. Sprinkle with tapioca and pecans to serve.

Random Ingredients: yellow capsicum,salmon,pinto bean,vegetable oil,sage,rice wine,pork shoulder
title: Linguica (Filipino)
ingredients: 300 g fresh pork shoulder | 100 g smoked pork shoulder | 250 g fresh pinto beans, washed and drained | 1 large yellow capsicum, washed and roughly chopped | 1 teaspoon dried sage | 3 tablespoons rice wine | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
instructions: In one frying pan, add the oil, add the ground pork and cook till brown. Add the pork and continue to stir fry so that both sides of the pork are coated in the olive oil. Add the yellow and green capsicum and continue stir frying for a minute or two. Once they are light brown, add the rice wine and continue stir frying till there are no traces of blood. Add 2 - 3 cups of water and stir to combine. Cover, reduce heat and simmer till pork is cooked, about 30 minutes. Add salt to taste and serve in small small bowls with lemon wedges and chopped parsley for garnishing on top.

title: Chicken-Beef Soup
ingredients: 1 chicken, whole | 1 beef stock cube | 2 tablespoons lemon
instructions: Combine all ingredients, except soup, in a large pot. Pour in the soup and bring to the boil. Turn the heat down and simmer for at least an hour. When serving, make sure you stir and adjust seasoning. Serve with some grated parmesan romano cheese.

title: Homemade Pesto Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups finely grated pecorino-romano cheese | 1/2 cup tomato sauce | 1/2 cup vegetable oil ( for frying )
instructions: Combine all ingredients and set aside. Refrigerate. Bring to room temperature before using. This sauce is good with freshly boiled or steamed white rice.

Random Ingredients: yellow pepper,flour,puff pastry,white rice,pumpkin seed,lime leaf
title: Puff Pastry Rice Wraps
ingredients: 1 package frozen puff pastry sheets, thawed | 1 lb cooked white rice | 1 yellow pepper, chopped | 2 tablespoons pumpkin seeds | 1 lime leaf | 1 tablespoon flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place thawed pastry sheets in a large mixing bowl and with your hands, pat pastry dough out into a rectangle about 18 x 12 inches. Cut remaining dough into four equal halves crosswise. Working with one rectangle at a time, line two parchment lined cookie sheets with strips of plastic wrap and place one strip of pastry across the strips of parchment and the other strip of pastry perpendicular to it to make a rectangle about 18 x 12 inches and about 4 inches wide. Spread 1 tablespoon of pumpkin seeds over each rectangle and 1 tablespoon of chopped yellow pepper over seeds. Fold up the long sides of the dough to form long, narrow strips of pastry across top of pepper and yellow pepper and roll up like a swiss roll and place seam side down on the cookie sheets. Repeat with remaining strips of pastry and filling. Using the thawed pastry sheet, cut steam holes in pastry and gently push down with fingers, cutting steam holes in the pastry. Cut steam holes in the top of the pastry and brush edges with lime juice. Bake for 25 minutes, or until filling is bubbly and filling is heated through. Allow to cool for at least 10 minutes before serving or storing in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,chicken bouillon,orange juice,baking soda,half,blue cheese,salsa,balsamic vinegar
title: Blue Cheese and Orange Chiles Fritters
ingredients: 1 tablespoon minced orange peel | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon, powder | 2 -3 tablespoons salsa or 2 -3 tablespoons picante sauce | 1 -2 cup half-and-half, can use low fat | 1/2 cup half-and-half or 1/2 cup heavy cream, heated | 1/8 teaspoon baking soda | 1/8 teaspoon hot maraschino cherry or 1/8 teaspoon chocolate chips, for garnish
instructions: In a microwave safe bowl, cover orange peel with 1 t melted butter, microwave on high for 30 second or till orange peel is fragrant, stirring once halfway through cooking. Add a few drops of orange juice to prevent burning. Stir again before opening. Add balsamic vinegar, chicken bouillon powder and salsa. Microwave on high for 2 - 3 minutes or till heated through, stirring once halfway through cooking. Add half and half, if using, and microwave on high, but microwave till hot enough to heat through. Stir in baking soda. In a small bowl, add chocolate chips. Stir until smooth. Add some of the hot sauce into the chocolate, stirring till smooth. Pour the hot chocolate into a small pastry bag fitted with a 1 1/2 opening, and pipe fritters into 1 balls. Serve in a small bowl. Or spoon some hot chocolate onto each plate and top with a ball of fritter and a cherry or a dab of remaining melted butter.

title: Horseradish Spread
ingredients: 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 2 tablespoons dill weed
instructions: Mix ingredients in blender or food processor, just until mixture begins to form a smooth paste.

Random Ingredients: rice wine vinegar,italian salad dressing mix
title: Italian Rice Vinegar Salad Dressing Mix
ingredients: 1 package italian salad dressing mix | 2 cups rice wine vinegar
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the salad dressing mix and rice wine vinegar. Store tightly covered in the refrigerator.

title: Chocolate-Flavored Butter
ingredients: 1/2 cup bittersweet chocolate morsel ( such as dark rum or brandy ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried savory or 1/4 teaspoon ground sage
instructions: In small microwave safe bowl, microwave chocolate morsel, stirring, about 30 seconds or until candy thermometer registers 140f on candy thermometer. Top of candy with savory and stir.

title: Lime Sausage and Chorizo Pasta
ingredients: 1 pound farfalle pasta | 1 pound chorizo sausage | 1 cup buttermilk | 1 jar diced pimiento, drained | 1 1/2 cups half-and-half | 1 teaspoon lime
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook the farfalle in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain and rinse under cold water. Cook the chorizo sausage in a skillet over medium low heat, turning often, until evenly browned, about 10 minutes. Cut the sausage into 1/4 inch slices. When the farfalle, chorizo, buttermilk, pimento, half and half, and lime juice together in a crockpot on high, stirring frequently, until the cheeses have melted. Random Ingredients: adobo sauce,red chili pepper,anaheim chilies,cilantro stem
title: Pescado De Pescado
ingredients: 2 anaheim chilies, roasted, peeled and slit lengthwise | fresh cilantro stem | 5 -6 poblano peppers ( about 1/2 pound total ) or 5 -6 green jalapenos ( about 1/2 pound total ) | adobo sauce
instructions: Grill the chiles skin side down until charred. Turn them as little or as much as you like. Allow to cool in a bowl, cover with a clean towel and place in the refridgerator.

title: Pineapple Loco Loco - Pineapple Infused Pumpkin
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh pumpkin, cut into 3/4-inch cubes | 1 can crushed pineapple, drained if necessary, can also use juice from can | 1 -2 clove roasted garlic, can use pureed, i use jarred roasted garlic | 3 -4 jalapenos, diced and seeded, can substitute with other peppers, i like it with other peppers
instructions: Place pumpkin cubes, drained pineapple juice and roasted garlic in large bowl and mix well. Refrigerate several hours to marinate. Remove from refrigerator one hour before serving. Serve on spiced or flavored crackers.

title: Easy Creamy Alfredo Veggies
ingredients: 1 package baby carrots or 4 baby carrots | 1 jar your favorite alfredo sauce
instructions: Bring water to a boil. Add carrots. Once carrots are floating, remove from heat immediately and rinse/turn heat down to low. Cover and simmer 25 minutes or until tender. Drain thoroughly again and serve with your favorite fettuccine recipe.

title: Lazy Fajitas
ingredients: 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 2 flour tortillas
instructions: Heat one skillet and the other on medium high heat. When the skillet is hot, but not smoking, place a tortilla in the skillet and fry until it bubbles then puffs some. Remove from heat and sprinkle the tortilla with salt. Using the same skillet, place the tortilla and the second skillet on top. When the tortilla crisps up, turn the tortilla, sprinkle with the same amount of salt and put in the warm oven for 10 minutes. When the second side is crisp, turn the tortilla over and crisp the other side about 10 minutes or until the temperature is at least 200 degrees f and the tortilla is a bit crispy.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock cube,sherry wine,chive,black tea leaf,ladyfinger,heavy whipping cream,quinoa,broiler fryer chicken
title: Chilled Chicken Tea Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 teaspoons chives, minced | 6 tablespoons chinese black tea leaves, finely chopped | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 9 ounces broiler-fryer chickens, skin removed and roughly chopped | 1 chicken stock cube | 4 ounces chinese rice wine or 4 ounces dry sherry | 1/2 cup hot chicken stock or 1/2 cup hot water | 1 ounce quinoa, soaked overnight in | chive, halves ( to garnish )
instructions: First make the tea. Place the chives and the tea leaves in a heatproof jug. Sit the cream and 1 ounce of the chicken fat in a small saucepan and bring just to boil. Stir in the rice wine and stir over a medium heat for 2 minutes until the rice wine is absorbed. Quickly stir in the stock cube and stir until dissolved. Pour this mixture into a heatproof bowl and add the remaining chicken fat, bring to boil and simmer for 15 minutes, until slightly reduced. Then stir into the tea and serve in warm tea bags with chives to serve. Repeat for all the remaining serving to serve.

Random Ingredients: pecan,baking cocoa,dark beer,greek yogurt,egg substitute,ketchup,purple onion
title: Beer and Pecan Taco Fries

instructions: Combine yogurt, egg substitute, pecans, ketchup, paprika, 2 - ½ tablespoons of sugar twin low salt cocoa, and the purple onion in a medium bowl. Stir reserved yogurt mixture, then pour mixture into prepared baking dish, spreading evenly. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes until topping is browned and fragrant. Sprinkle top with remaining 1 - ½ tablespoon sugar twin salt cocoa, and serve. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: cremini mushroom,banana,pork shoulder,couscous,breadfruit,chili pepper flake,farfalle pasta,pear
title: Spicy Pork and Bean With Banana on Toast - Crock Pot

instructions: Place pork, pears, and mushrooms into a 3 1/2 to 4 1/2 quart slow cooker. Combine farfalle pasta, 2 banana halves, 1 1/2 bananas, 1 1/2 cups pineapple slices, breadfruit, chili flakes, chopped chili peppers, and powdered sugar. Pour into slow cooker.

Random Ingredients: marshmallow,white onion,chicken bouillon cube,icing sugar,channa dal,canola oil

instructions: Soak chana dal for 15 minutes. Drain. Place in a large bowl and mix with icing sugar, cardamom powder, canola oil and chicken bouillon. Add in onion and marshmallows. Pour into an ovenproof dish. Cook in oven, about 30 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes. Garnish with channa dal.

title: Japanese Cheese Rolls

Random Ingredients: dark rum,flat leaf parsley,coconut extract,parsley,beer,tamari,creole seasoning
title: Tropical Beer Canning

instructions: Combine rum, soy sauce, 2 cups tajini, parsley, parsley, tamari, beer, coconut extract and creole seasoning together in a sealable plastic bag.

title: Cheesy Sage & Herb Crust

instructions: In a small bowl, combine yeast and stock.

title: Italian Black Beans
ingredients:
1 can of black-eyed peas | 2 plum tomatoes, chopped | 1 envelope dried italian salad dressing mix | 1 pinch cumin

instructions: Drain the beans. Put beans in a skillet. Add tomatoes and their liquid and the italian dressing mix. Bring to a boil and simmer for 20 minute. Serve hot.

title: Chef John's Salmon and Sausage

instructions: Heat the grill to high. Arrange the ingredients on the grill. Cook, turning the sausages once, until the fish is just cooked through, 3 to 4 minutes. Slip the sausages onto a preheated plate and cut them into 1/2 inch slices. Serve the smoked salmon and sausage onto a warmed individual platter with plenty of buttery bread.

title: Korma Style Beef Satay (Gkai Tom-Kom)
ingredients: 1 kg good ground beef round | 1 bunch spring onion | 1 bunch fresh kaffir lime leaf ( can also use 7 lime wedges ) | 1 bunch fresh courgette
instructions: Using a large bowl put the beef in the bowl with the spring onion, lemon juice and the kaffir lime leaves mix until everything is well combined.Using some scissors, trim off the ends and the ends of the korma stalk.Slice the wedge into 8 - 5 pieces.Add the courgette to the meat and mix well.Refrigerate for about one hour before serving.Serve as a snack or with plain boiled rice.

Random Ingredients: white bread,topping,pink peppercorn,asparagus,lemon pepper seasoning,cardamom seed
title: Asparagus Crumble
ingredients: 6 slices white bread, crusts removed | 1/2 teaspoon crushed pink peppercorns | 4 spears fresh asparagus, trimmed | 1 package frozen whipped topping, thawed | 1/4 cup freshly chopped lemons or 1/4 cup lime juice | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom seed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f spread the crusts of bread lightly with 1/4 teaspoons of the crushed pink peppercorns.Place the asparagus spears on top of the bread.In a bowl, mix the remaining 1/4 teaspoons of crushed pink peppercorns, the asparagus spears, thawed frosty cheese and lemon or lime juice.Dollop the topping onto the asparagus spears.Cut the crumbs into the crumbs.Arrange in a single layer on a baking sheet.Bake for 15 minutes or until heated through, stirring gently.Remove from the oven and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: shiitake mushroom,french baguette,sea salt,grain white rice,panir,gelatin
title: Panir Ke Kew
ingredients: 50 g gelatin | 4 slices thin french baguettes | 4 shiitake mushrooms | 150 g panir | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 100 g cooked short-grain white rice
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in a little water, then mix to a paste with a little water.Brush the bottom and sides of a large, non stick frying pan with one tablespoon of the gelatin paste.Wipe out the pan.Slice baguette into a thin round shape and sprinkle over the grated cheese.Line the bottom of the pan with two slices.Top with a layer of grated cheese.Repeat until all the bread and cheese has been used up then top with panir and finally top with rice.Cover and cook on low till rice is cooked.Leave for 2 or 3 minutes.Break into pieces and serve.

title: Mexican Cranberry Salad
ingredients: 4 cups mixed fresh fruit | 1 can sweetened dried cranberries | 1 cup cherry tomatoes, cut in half | 1/2 large spanish onion, peeled and chopped | 1/2 cup fresh orange juice | 1 1/2 tablespoons hot paprika | 1/4 cup fresh lime juice
instructions: Combine the fruit, cranberries, cherry tomatoes, onion, and orange juice in a large salad bowl.Sprinkle with paprika and lime juice to taste.Sprinkle with additional paprika if desired.

Random Ingredients: lemon zest,kahlua,tabasco sauce,coconut,tomato puree,chipotle chile,carrot,brussels sprout
title: Quick  Bombay Sapphire  Brussels Sprouts  With  Chili Nuts
ingredients: 12 brussels sprouts, peeled, halved | 1/2 cup ketjolé or 1/2 cup dark rum | 2 tablespoons heinz chili nuts | 2 chipotle chiles, minced | 1 teaspoon lemon zest, grated | 1 tablespoon tomato puree or 1 tablespoon cherry tomatoes, plus 1 teaspoon cherry tomatoes for garnish | 1/2 teaspoon grated coconut | 1 -2 pinch tabasco sauce
instructions: For brussels sprouts, in a large skillet, combine the ketjolé, chili peppers, zest, tomato puree, coconut and tobasco sauce.Heat to boiling over medium high heat.Add brussels sprouts and cook until softened and just beginning to color, about 2 minute depending on the size of your brussels sprouts.Garnish with additional cherry tomatoes.

title: Tomatillo Lentil and Beefsteak Soup

instructions: Cook ground beefsteak until light brown.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,tamari,chicken breast,raisin,shell pasta,apricot jam,garlic powder,beef shank
title: Cousin June's Asian Grilled Chicken
ingredients: 3 pounds boneless chicken breast, cut into 6 pieces | 3 tablespoons tamari | 3 tablespoons vegetable oil | 4 cloves garlic powder | 1 can sliced apricot jam | 1/4 cup raisins | 1 pound small shell pasta | 4 cloves garlic powder
instructions: Season chicken with 3 tablespoons tamari, vegtable olive oil, 4 cloves garlic powder, and sliced apricots with 1/4 cup raisins.Place chicken in a bowl and cover with plastic wrap.Refrigerate 1 hour before cooking or refrigerate overnight.Remove chicken from marinade, reserve marinade.Coat grill rack with vegetable oil.Grill chicken, flipping once to brown on both sides, until cooked through and well browned, 15 to 20 minutes.Remove from grill and set aside to rest on a cutting board to rest for 5 minutes.Remove chicken skin side up and cut into chunks.Return sauce to grill and cook until heated through and slightly thickened, about 5 minutes.Remove from grill and set aside.Cook pasta according to package directions.Remove from heat and drain.Arrange pasta and chicken in a large, shallow baking dish.Spread sauce over chicken.Mound sauce on chicken and serve.

Random Ingredients: cheese,clam juice,star anise,red chilies,corn kernel,lemon peel,thyme
title: Cambodian Corn Chowder
ingredients: 6 whole star anise | 2 tablespoons fresh thyme | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs small corn kernels | 16 ounces small clams, drained | 1 lemon peel, zest of, grated very fine | 1 -2 -3 chile, seeded ( depending on how spicy you want it ) | 16 ounces cheese, grated
instructions: Put the mustard seeds and whole star anise in a large frying pan and toast over medium heat, stirring often, until the mustard seeds are slightly darker, 3 - 5 minutes.Do not let the star anise get too dark.Stir in the thyme.Turn heat to medium high and add the corn, clams, lemon peel and chiles.Cover and cook just until the clams open and the clams open slightly.Discard any opened clams.Cover and cook just a few moments more.Remove the lid and stir in the cheese, allowing it to melt slowly, stirring very continuously.Serve hot.

title: Petit Gateaux (Figs Baked in Hot Chocolate)
ingredients: 5 ripe figs, patted dry and stoned ( or use dried plums ) | 300 ml hot stock | 125 g milk chocolate, finely grated
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c/400°f/gas prick the bases of the figs with a knife, and then bake for 25 to 30 minutes until softened.Remove from the oven.Warm the stock in a saucepan, then remove the figs from their shells, patting them dry with kitchen paper and then remove the skin by placing the strips of fig on a cutting board over a bowl of cold water.With a sharp knife remove the stems of 2 figs and carefully remove the ribs and membrane, then split open the centre of each fig down one side and slice along the underside of the skin as thinly as possible.Whip the chocolate until smooth.Dip the figs, 1 at a time, in the hot chocolate, wiping off the excess coating.Place on a lined baking sheet and bake in the oven for 10 - 15 minutes to crisp the skin and help to brown the figs.Turn out on to serving plates, sprinkle with grated chocolate and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: meatball,dill,beef bouillon cube,sage,ortega chile,phyllo pastry,turmeric powder
title: Albondigas Con Le Cerveza (Meatball Pastries With Oranges)
ingredients: 6 meatballs | 200 g ground orzo mixed green salad ( orzo is the closest thing ) | 1 tablespoon dried dill or 2/3 cup fresh dill | 3 teaspoons dried sage | 2 teaspoons turmeric powder | 1/2 beef bouillon cube | 1 ortega chile ( chile ), chopped into 2-inch long pieces
instructions: Heat a little olive oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat and place the meatballs.As many as will fit into the skillet should fit in one layer.Cook the meatballs for a few minutes on each side, until no pink remains and no blood is running out the meatballs can be cooked in batches.Remove meatballs from pan and set aside.Add the remaining oil to the pan and place the dill or 1/3 cup of dill or 1/3 cup of regular dill weed leaves and salt.Cook over medium high heat, stirring constantly, until the dill is fragrant and very aromatic.Add the arugo powder and toss to coat the leaves and leaves and remove from heat.Set aside and allow the liquid in the pan to cool.Add the meatballs back to the pan, orzo to the pan and mix thoroughly until all the ingredients are well mixed.The arugo should be soft and moist, but not dry and mushy.Pour the orzo mixture back onto the pan and mix thoroughly.If the orzo mixture is too wet, add a bit of the liquid left, and mix well, adding water if necessary.Add the meatballs and heat gently, but gently, until the meatballs are warmed through.Serve in warm individual bowls with orzo, and a sprinkling of paprika in the middle for added flavor.

title: Peppered Mushroom Caps
ingredients: 4 tablespoons cornstarch | 4 -5 large portabella mushroom | 1 package pepperoni | 1 teaspoon chili | 3 tablespoons black vinegar | 1 cup miniature marshmallows
instructions: Cut mushroom caps in half, remove stems and slice caps into 1/4 to 1/8 inch thick pieces.Mix together cornstarch and 1/2 cup water and add to mushrooms and pepperoni.Sprinkle on chili, vinegar and sprinkle with marshmallows, mix well.Chill well.This serves well with your favorite meal.

title: Welsh Rum Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups worcestershire sauce | 1 cup sherry wine | 1 vanilla bean
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a blender.Blend on high until thoroughly mixed.Season to taste.

title: Easy Italian Sauce

instructions: In a saucepan, stir together the stewed tomatoes and the cheese.Bring to a boil, and cook until heated through.

Random Ingredients: black olive,saffron thread,bamboo shoot,pearl onion,dungeness crabmeat,cocoa powder,sausage casing,beef tenderloin steak

ingredients: 1 lb sausages or 1 lb crabmeat | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 tablespoon paprika for spanish or hot spicy sambal oelek | 1 lb beef tenderloin steaks or 1 lb sirloin steak | 1 lb pearl onions or 1 lb white onions | 8 ounces canned bamboo shoots, drained | 8 ounces canned black olives, drained | 1 ounce saffron thread, crumbled | 4 cups prepared saffron-stuffed bean curd or 4 cups thick plain black beans
instructions: For the filling, combine all ingredients.Taste and adjust seasonings to taste.Set aside to marinate, covered in refrigerator for 15 minutes.Meanwhile, prepare the beans.Cook beans according to the package directions, drain.Make ahead, these can be prepared ahead, refrigerated, and frozen for up to 3 days.

title: Danish Pastry

title: Mexican Corn & Green Pepper Salad

instructions: Boil corn, drain.In a bowl, mix corn, green pepper, and salsa.Toss with radishes.Chill until ready to serve.Enjoy.

title: Spicy Refrigerator Baked Carrots with Chipoltle

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.Toss carrots with shortening in a plastic bag, then shake to coat.Bake until nicely browned and tender, stirring once halfway through.Meanwhile, combine orange juice, chipotle, and saltpeter in a small saucepan and bring to a boil over medium heat.Reduce heat to low and simmer for a few minutes.

title: Pimento Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 cup canned kidney beans, with liquid | 1/4 cup fresh pimento stuffed olive, chopped | 1 teaspoon lemon juice | 1/8 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Mix all ingredients until well combined.

title: Kielbasa with Dates and Lemon
ingredients: 1 lb kielbasa or 1 lb other sausage, cut 1 1/2 inch slices | 8 ounces chopped dates ( about 8 pieces ) | 1 lemon, zest of, finely grated
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f.Coat a large baking sheet with cooking spray.Spray the sausage with cooking spray and toss to coat.Arrange the sausage in a single layer on the baking sheet.Dividing evenly, sprinkle with dates and lemon zest.Bake, uncovered, stirring once, until brown and crusty on top, 20 - 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: mustard powder,italian herb,anchovy filet,celery,lime wedge,poppy seed
title: Homemade Caesar Salad

instructions: Chop anchovy fillets, celery, and garlic.Put ingredients into a mortar or a blender.Grind until desired consistency is achieved.If not using lime or water, add a little cornstarch and water while blending.Pour dressing into a screw top jar and refrigerate for several hours before serving, tossing often.

instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f.Pour the graham cracker crumbs onto a plate.Mix the sesame oil and crumbs in a large bowl.Spread the spaghetti sauce into a 9 inch pie plate.Layer in the dish the red bell pepper, chipotle pepper, oregano and crumbs.Top with the strawberries.Bake in the preheated oven for 40 minutes, until the strawberries are tender.

Random Ingredients: red chili powder,self rising flour,red curry paste,tomato,chayote squash,mustard seed
title: Vege's Quick and Easy Yummy Yummy Squash Curry
ingredients: 2 large tomatoes, chopped | 2 red chayote squash, cubed | 2 cups self-rising flour | 4 tablespoons red curry paste | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds ( optional ) | 1 -2 teaspoon red chili powder ( depending on taste )
instructions: Put the finely chopped tomatoes into a microwave safe bowl.Dice up the chayote squash and add into bowl.Add the red curry paste.Add all of the mustard seeds and mix.Add the flour and mix it all together.Add a little water if not enough.Cover with cling film and microwave on high 1 - 2 minutes until it is thick.Add as much water as you require for a thick batter.When you feel that the dough starts to come together add water a little at the time until it thickens.Serve over rice, noodles or noodles and enjoy.

title: Homemade Pizzelle
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 3 tablespoons white flour | 1 cup milk powder
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl.Pour a thin layer of batter on your pizzelle iron.Allow to cool slightly before removing.Use a funnel to fill into your pizzelle maker.

title: Quick and Easy Salsa Fresca
ingredients: 1 package bean sprouts | 1/3 cup thick & chunky salsa | 1 jar chopped jalapenos | 1/3 cup amaretto | 1/3 cup hot water
instructions: Place the bean sprouts in a pot with about 1/4 cup of water and bring to a boil.After about 5 minutes, remove the pot from the heat and cool for about a minute or so until the water is just warm.In a blender or food processor, combine all the ingredients and puree until smooth.Transfer to a bowl, cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours for best flavor.

Random Ingredients: beef rib,mandarin orange,alfredo sauce,chicken thigh,tart apple,rigatoni pasta,red food coloring
title: Apple Beef Ribs for 30
ingredients: 6 chicken thighs | 6 beef short ribs | 1 box rigatoni pasta | 1 jar alfredo sauce ( low fat & fat free ) | 6 -8 tart apples, cubed | 3 -4 tablespoons red food coloring | 12 -20 stuffed mandarin oranges
instructions: Mix sauce ingredients and place in refrigerator to marinate in refrigerator.Place meat on foil lined sheet pan & broil to brown lightly.Drain, slice & place in shallow baking dish.Place orange slices around and under meat.Pour sauce mixture over top of meat & serve with cooked pasta.

title: Spiced Tofu
ingredients: 4 tablespoons sultanas | 2/3 cup seasoned bread crumbs | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1/8 teaspoon pepper | vegetable oil cooking spray
instructions: Place sultanas in a bowl with the bread crumbs, turmeric and pepper.Spray bowl well with cooking oil, then turn out onto a board and knead with hands until mixture resembles breadcrumbs.Lightly coat a shallow nonstick frying pan with oil and place over medium high heat.When hot, add tuna.Cook until browned, 2 to 4 minutes, then transfer tuna to a baking dish.

Random Ingredients: black bean,tapioca flour,hot red pepper flake,crescent dinner,lobster tail
title: Lobster Tarts
ingredients: 1 can refrigerated crescent dinner rolls | 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 1 lobster tail, cooked and sliced | 1 teaspoon hot red pepper flakes, or to taste | 1 tablespoon tapioca flour, or as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.Roll out each crescent roll on a lightly floured surface to 1/8 inch thickness.Separate with floured hands.Separate into 2 triangles.Stretch out each to a 3 inch round.Place one triangle onto baking sheets, and spread with beans, lobster, hot pepper flakes and a tablespoon of tapioca flour.Carefully fold triangles together, being careful not to break the triangles.Gently press edges together with fingers.Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Kaffir Lime Chicken
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless pork shoulder | 3/4 cup unsalted cashews | 4 kaffir lime leaves, torn in half lenghtwise | 1/4 cup fresh italian parsley, chopped | 3/4 teaspoon fresh ground pepper
instructions: Soak the cashews and lime leaves in warm water for 30 minute drain, dry, and chop in food processor.Place the chicken on the rack of a broiler pan and roast at 425 for 20 minutes.Serve with the cashew lime chicken.

title: Orange Scented Scallops with Potato Potatoes

instructions: In a small bowl, mix extract with water chestnuts.Trim ends and ends of potatoes.Quarter lengthwise.

Random Ingredients: curry leaf,thai red curry paste,arborio rice,tomato basil,cayenne,chinese wine
title: Khao Plow
ingredients: 1/2 cup thai red curry paste | 1/2 cup chinese sweet wine, such as muscat | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh tomato basil | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | 4 large fresh curry leaves | 1 1/2 cups uncooked arborio rice
instructions: Combine curry paste and wine with 1/2 to 1 cup water in a small bowl and bring to a boil in a saucepan over medium low heat, stirring occasionally.Remove from heat, cover, and set aside.Heat remaining 1/2 cup water in a small saucepan over medium heat until boiling.Add tomato basil and cayenne.

title: Grilled Chicken Wings (Antilles)

instructions: Mix all ingredients.Place chicken wings on skewers.Grill on medium high fire, turning with fork as necessary, until chicken wings turn white.If chicken is on the skewers with holes, allow it to warm up before brushing with glaze.Serve warm, preferably with sauce.Note, this recipe could easily be made in advance.If not, cook the chicken wings on your grill with the marinade.

title: Quick and Easy Mango Chutney Prawns

title: Mustard Chicken With Cranberry Scented Cranberries
ingredients: 3 1/2 ounces skinless boneless chicken breasts, trimmed of fat, cut into 1-inch cubes ( about 2 1/2 cups ) | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 3 tablespoons coarse grain mustard | 1/3 cup cranberries, fresh ( about 1 cup ) or 1/3 cup black cranberries ( about 1 cup ) | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper | 2 tablespoons kosher salt ( or to taste )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit.Line a rimmed baking sheet with a silicone baking mat or parchment paper.Arrange chicken in a single, even layer.In a small bowl, dissolve the baking soda in 3 tablespoons water.Add the mustard and stir to dissolve.Sprinkle the chicken with salt and pepper.With your fingertips, rub 1 tablespoons mustard evenly over the chicken.Toss to coat evenly with a light coating of mustard.Repeat with the remaining chicken, mustard, cranberries, and salt.Transfer the chicken to the prepared baking sheet.Place in oven and cook until the chicken is just cooked through, 30 to 40 minutes.Remove from oven and allow to rest about 5 - 10 minutes before serving.

title: Sausage and Cabbage Bake
ingredients: 500 g beef sirloin steaks, cut into strips | 1/2 head cabbage, shredded | 1 cup shredded cauliflower | 1/2 chorizo sausage, sliced | 2 cups baked crackers
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c in a large bowl, toss together beef strips, cabbage, cauliflower and chorizo.Spread beef mixture into a shallow baking dish.Bake for 25 minutes, until cooked through.Serve with crackers.

Random Ingredients: ice water,spring onion,mushroom,wide egg noodle,red chilies,anchovy fillet,chicken,pork shoulder
title: Noodle Soup
ingredients: 8 -10 chicken pieces ( the bones and skins are best ) | 2 kg pork shoulder, with some | ice water | 1 -2 tablespoon anchovy fillet, crumbled | 1 bunch spring onion, chopped, plus | 2 spring onions, extra for garnish | 300 -400 g mushrooms or 300 -400 g button mushrooms, trimmed, washed and patted dry | 1 lb wide egg noodles | 1 red chilies or 1 green chili
instructions: Wash the chicken pieces thoroughly until the water is clear.Drain the chicken, discarding the skin.Place the chicken in a large saucepan, cover with cold water and bring to the boil.Skim off all the scum as the water rises to the top.Skim the scum as any more rise.Reduce the heat and simmer for 2 hours or until tender.Meanwhile, prepare the stock.Wash and wash the mushroom under cold water.Slice the mushrooms very thinly.Bring the stock to the boil.Add the cooked noodles, anchovies.Chop the spring onions and spring onion.Place the soup in a large serving bowl with a big spoon on the soup.Add the chopped chilli, stir well.Remove the chicken pieces when they are cool enough to handle and shred them.Drain the chicken and slice them.Bring the soup back to a boil.Garnish with the shredded chicken and spring onions.Serve in bowls decorated with the chopped chilli.Garnish with the chopped spring onion.

Random Ingredients: chive,wild rice,salt pepper,white wine,chicken breast half,parsley root
title: Chicken Vichyssoise (Chicken in Parsley and Wild-Rice Stew)
ingredients: 1/4 cup parsley roots, chopped | 4 tablespoons fresh chives, minced | 1/4 cup dry white wine | 1 cup wild rice, uncooked | 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves, cut into 1-inch pieces and lightly pounded to an even thickness | salt and pepper to taste
instructions: In a large pot, combine the parsley roots, chives and white wine.Bring to a boil over medium high heat, then simmer for 5 minutes.Strain any excess liquid and set aside.Preheat oven to 450 degrees f.In a 9x13 inch baking dish, toss rice, chicken, salt and pepper to taste and any accumulated juices from the pot and parsley.Pour reserved parsley sauce over chicken, cover loosely and bake in the preheated oven until chicken is tender and the liquid is absorbed, about 1 1/2 hours.Stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: coconut cream,chicken stock turkey,artichoke heart,tortellini,beef stock,orange,creme de cacao
title: Tortellini With Artichokes
ingredients: 1 jar artichoke hearts, drained, reserve marinade | 1/2 cup chopped orange | 1/4 cup chicken stock ( or turkey ) | 3/4 cup chicken stock ( or turkey ) | 2 ounces creme de cacao | 1 package tortellini | 0.|5 can coconut cream | 4 tablespoons creme de cacao | 2 tablespoons chopped orange rind
instructions: Preheat broiler.Pour marinade into medium saucepan with chicken stock.Add coconut cream, orange rind, and creme de cacao.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,cream tartar,tomato juice,vodka,celery rib,dark brown sugar,beef brisket,no salt tomato paste
title: Crock Pot Beef Romanov
ingredients: 3 lbs beef brisket or 3 lbs beef roast | 1 tablespoon no-added-salt tomato paste | 1/4 teaspoon no-added-salt tomato paste | 12 ounces no-salt-added diced tomatoes with juice ( petite garden brand ) | 1 1/2 cups beef gravy | 1 tablespoon fat free sour cream and tartar | 1 tablespoon white brown sugar
instructions: Remove brisket from slow cooker.

title: Beef, Okra, and Pepper Casserole
ingredients: 2 packages frozen sliced okra, thawed if fresh | 1 pound ground beef | 1 can petite diced pears, drained | 3 cups shredded mozzarella cheese ( optional ) | 2 chicken bouillon cubes | 1/4 cup white sugar | 1/4 cup grated semisweet chocolate
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.Place frozen okra into a large baking dish.Cook and stir ground beef in a skillet over medium heat until browned and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pineapple chunk,grain white rice,snow pea,espresso powder,monterey jack cheese
title: Santa Fe Rice With Snow Peas and Pineapple
ingredients: 5 cups cooked long-grain white rice | 1 can pineapple chunks, drained | 3/4 cup monterey jack cheese, shredded | 1/4 cup espresso powder | 1 package snow peas, trimmed
instructions: Preheat broiler to high.Combine rice, pineapple, cheese, and espresso powder in a 3 - 4 quart slow cooker.Cover and cook on broiler setting until cheese is melted, about 7 minutes.

title: Pesto Dipping Sauce for Chips (Vegan)
ingredients: 3 medium onions, chopped | 1/3 cup pesto sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients and refrigerate overnight.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,dill weed,onion powder,chestnut mushroom,pumpkin pie spice,chicken stock vegetable,cayenne pepper,cumin powder
title: Lighter Mushroom Soup
ingredients: 200 g chestnut mushrooms | 1 onion, sliced | 2 cans pumpkin pie spice | 200 g button mushrooms, sliced | 5 1/2 cups chicken stock or 5 1/2 cups vegetable stock | 2 teaspoons dill weed | 2 teaspoons cumin powder | 1 pinch cayenne pepper
instructions: Slice mushrooms into rings.Heat onions in oil until soft but not brown.Fry mushrooms and spices in the onions until translucent.Add stock and simmer for 20 minutes.Add chestnuts and cook for 10 minutes.

title: Shortbread
ingredients: 1 lb white flour | 1 lb soft ladyfinger | ladyfinger ( optional )
instructions: First, mix flour and soft lady fingers.Place on floured surface, knead until smooth.Cover and let rest for 30 - 45 minutes.Roll out until ½ inch thick and press on ungreased cookie tray.Cut into strips with a sharp knife and arrange on cookie sheet.Allow to sit for 15 minutes then brush or spread with butter and sprinkle with powdered sugar.If sprinkled with powdered sugar, sprinkle the top with white sugar and freeze.

Random Ingredients: cream celery soup,epazote,black bean,anchovy fillet,cherry tomato
title: Black Beans and Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 can reduced-sodium cream of celery soup | 1 can cooked black beans, rinsed and drained | 1 can cherry tomatoes | 1 small epazote or 1 teaspoon dried epazote | 7 anchovy fillets, rinsed and patted dry
instructions: Combine all ingredients except oil.Heat until bubbly, but do not boil.Taste, and add more salt or seasoning if desired.

title: Perfect Rice and Salted Dressing (A MUST)
ingredients: 1 cup raw rice ( uncooked ) | salad oil ( to cover salad oil container )
instructions: Place rice in bowl of cheesecloth.Cover the top of sink with several inches of cool water.Microwave the rice on full power to dry the rice about a minute or two in a microwave.It must be dry and the outside of the towels are wet by now.Drain.Note, rinse the rice with cool water in a strainer for a few minutes until all the water is out.When dry, toss rice with salad oil until coated.Refrigerate several hours.Shake towel and cover with new plastic wrap until ready to use.For a crisper rice cook, allow rice to chill in fridge for an hour to 1 day before serving.Store the rice in a cool dark, dry place and cover with fresh towel to dry.For a crisp rice cook, allow rice to cool in refrigerator for an hour to 1 day before serving.

Random Ingredients: apple juice,chicken breast half,walnut,pork baby back rib,egg,oil,herb
title: My Kids' Grilled Walnut Chicken
ingredients: 6 chicken breast halves | 1 teaspoon ground mixed herbs, plus | 1/4 teaspoon mixed herbs, for sprinkling | 2 tablespoons fresh apple juice | 2 eggs | 2 tablespoons oil | 1/4 cup walnuts ( optional ) | 4 -6 cups walnut-roasted baby back ribs ( optional )
instructions: Combine the ingredients for the sauce in a large shallow dish.Dip the chicken into the sauce, then coat with the walnuts.Set aside to marinate while you sleep for about an hour.Preheat the grill to medium.Remove the chicken from the refrigerator, and if you wish, scatter them with herbs.Thread the chicken onto the skewers.Grill, turning as needed, until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce is bubbly, about 10 minutes.Serve with your favourite side dish such as a pate or horseradish cream.

Random Ingredients: mint,raisin,vegetable broth,bay seasoning tm,lamb shoulder,cream tartar
title: Lamb Korma
ingredients: 2 - 3 lbs lamb shoulder, about 1 1/2 pounds total ( or leg ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/4 teaspoon old bay seasoning tm | 2 tablespoons crushed raisins | 2 tablespoons sour cream or 2 tablespoons yogurt | 2 cups veggie broth
instructions: Trim all visible fat from lamb.Cut crosswise, into 1 inch pieces.Place lamb pieces in roasting pan or dutch oven.Sprinkle evenly with nutmeg, old bay, raisins and sour cream or yogurt.Roast 30 minutes at 400 degrees fahrenheit.Bring to room temperature before serving, if desired.

Random Ingredients: parsley leaf,pork tenderloin,beef stock,currant,pork shoulder,apricot jam,salt,sun tomato oil
title: Tenderloins for Two
ingredients: 4 pork tenderloins | 1/2 lb beef stock | 2 medium beef pork shoulder | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 4 tablespoons apricot jam | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 4 tablespoons parsley leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°f.Rub salt and pepper into tenderloins.Place the tenderloins in baking pan.Cover with beef stock, bring to boil and then roast at 200 degrees until done, about 45 minutes total.Cool off bone and remove the meat from the bones.In a small sauce pan, add the apricot jam and cook for one minute.Pour jam into individual small oven proof serving dishes and add 4 tablespoons of parsley to the jam.Slice the tenderloins, 1/3 to 1/2 inch thick, arrange them on top of the jam.Return to oven and bake for 15 to 20 minutes.The internal temperature should be 160°f, or 140°f for medium rare.Remove from heat and sprinkle with remaining parsley before serving.

title: Cashew Nut Java
ingredients: 1 -2 cup cashews ( raw or salted ) | 1/4 cup dried onion flakes | 1 cup fresh coconut milk or 1 cup cream
instructions: Grind cashews to a fine powder.Add onion flakes and cashew powder gradually, blending well to a smooth paste.Add coconut milk or cream.Keep refrigerated until ready to use.

title: Beef Taquitos
ingredients: 3 lbs beef chuck roast, trimmed | 1 can diced chili | 1/2 cup chopped green pepper | 1/4 cup chopped celery | 1/4 teaspoon onion powder | 1/4 teaspoon chile | 12 soft tortillas
instructions: Spray 12 non stick large skillet with cooking spray or line with parchment paper.Cut roast into cubes in small pieces.Place in skillet and pour in chili.Sprinkle over all with green peppers, celery, onion powder and chile.Bring to boiling.

title: Chipotle Sage Cheese
ingredients: 8 cups grated pecorino romano cheese ( about 4-1/2 ounces ) | 2 tablespoons ground sumac | 1/2 cup margarine | 1 -2 tablespoon dried chipotle powder | 4 fresh mint sprigs
instructions: Position rack in center of oven and heat to 425 degrees.Whisk together cheese, sumac, margarine, and spice powder until it resembles loose crumbs.Fold in mint.Place on baking sheet and bake until top is lightly browned, about 10 minutes.Cool to room temperature and break into chunks.

Random Ingredients: almond paste,beef broth,chinese cabbage,cream cheese,chili paste,vodka,cardamom powder,savoy cabbage
title: Chinese Cabbage Soup
ingredients: 4 cans beef broth | 3/4 teaspoon cardamom powder | 3/4 teaspoon chili paste | 1 head savoy cabbage | 300 g cream cheese | 100 g almond paste ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon vodka | 200 g chinese cabbage
instructions: Wash cabbage and cut in shreds.Set aside to drain well.Slice the cream cheese into small sticks and place in a bowl.Pour beef broth into a soup pot.Add cardamon powder and stir.Chill until cheese is melted.Slice savoy cabbage thinly and place in the soup pot with cream cheese.Allow to heat through.Add chili paste and vodka.Serve cold.

title: Scottish Apricot Cake
ingredients: 12 ounces cake flour | 12 ounces dried apricots | 3 ounces heavy cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.Mix flour and apricots carefully so as not to make a solid block like crumble.Add cream and mix with pastry blender or two knives.Press dough through but do not overmix.Place in a floured cake tin lined with parchment paper.Bake for about 40 minutes until cake springs back when lightly touched.

Random Ingredients: coriander seed,broccoli floret,penne pasta,angel hair pasta
title: Spiced Broccoli and Penne Pasta
ingredients: 9 ounces penne pasta | 2 tablespoons coriander seeds | 1 lb broccoli floret | 7 ounces angel hair pasta
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400 degrees f.Cook pasta and drain pasta well.Meanwhile, toast the coriander over a medium heat for a minute or two till aromatic.Add the ginger and garlic to a sauté pan, and cook for a minute or two till they begin to color a little.Add the pasta and broccoli, and cook for another minute or two till done.Drain all your pasta, and place in a large glass or ceramic bowl.Toss together the sautéed vegetables, and pasta, and enjoy your delicious meal.

Random Ingredients: cumin seed,chipotle chili sauce,cilantro,sesame seed,salt pepper,pine nut,chicken fillet
title: Grilled Chipotle Chicken Skewers
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs chicken fillets, cubed | 1/2 cup sesame seeds | 1 1/2 tablespoons toasted pine nuts | 2 chipotle chili sauce or 2 pasilla chiles, minced | 1 1/2 tablespoons cumin seeds | 3 tablespoons cilantro, chopped ( a small bunch ) | salt and pepper | 1/2 cup chipotle chili sauce or 1/2 cup chili sauce
instructions: Place chicken in a bowl and add the all ingredients and marinade in another pan.Allow mixture to marinate, covered for 2 - 3 hours, stirring occasionally.Thread chicken onto skewers.Grill on a preheated grill about 6 - 8 minutes or until golden brown.Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: tofu,scotch bonnet pepper,hamburger bun,potato flour,sesame seed,cumin seed,gingerroot,pineapple preserve
title: Grilled Tofu Gyros
ingredients: 1/4 cup potato flour | 5 tablespoons gingerroot, grated | 1 teaspoon cumin seeds | 1 teaspoon finely chopped scotch bonnet pepper | 1 tablespoon dried pineapple preserves | 3 sheets hamburger buns | 2 teaspoons sesame seeds | 2 slices thick boiled tofu, cut into thin strips and lightly toasted
instructions: Mix potato flour, ginger, cumin with 1 tsp each chile and pineapple preserves.

title: Caribbean Glazed Pork With Nectar
ingredients: 3 lbs pork belly, skin on | 2 tablespoons dried parsley flakes | 1/2 cup agave nectar | 1/4 cup sweetened molasses
instructions: Place the belly in a large roasting pan.Cover with water, cover and put in a 325 degree oven, allowing to come to the very end of the day.Turn the temperature down to 325 degrees f to cook for 1 1/4 hours, or until the meat is very tender.While the meat is cooking, mix the dried parsley flakes, agave nectar, and molasses together until the glaze is thick and creamy.Drain all of the solids off of the meat and set aside.Serve warm from the pan or in the oven while waiting for the glaze to soak inches.This meat will stay together as it cools.This recipe can easily be turned into meatballs and eaten as is.

title: Sweet and Sour Chicken
ingredients: 1 cooked whole chickens, cut up | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 12 ounces sweet chili sauce | 1 packet chicken bouillon granules
instructions: Mix the cornflour with the chili sauce until dissolved.Place chicken, fat side down on a wire rack in a baking dish.Pour the sauce over.Cover with plastic wrap and leave to marinade over night at room temp, turning the chicken occasionally.Preheat oven to 180c.Bake for 30 mins, brush with glaze and bake for 15 mins, until golden.Serve with noodles or rice.

title: Grilled Chicken (Chili) Skewers
ingredients: 1 green hot chili peppers or 1 orange bell pepper, halved | 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes
instructions: Place the pepper and chili flakes in a bowl.Use your hands to rub the hot pepper on the pepper then transfer it onto a wooden skewer or grill.Cook for 30 - 45 minutes, turning occasionally.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,white onion,edible flower,chicken breast half,lemon pepper,egg,leek,green salsa
title: Easy Baked Chicken Kiev
ingredients: 1 cup chopped white onion | 2 leeks, sliced | 2 lemons, cut into thin rounds | 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - pounded thin | 1/2 cup chopped green salsa | 1/2 teaspoon lemon pepper | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1 egg, beaten
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f.Prepare a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray by mixing the onion, leeks, lemon slices, and chicken with 2 of the sliced lemons, lemon slices, and salsa.Transfer to the prepared baking dish.Bake 15 minutes in the preheated oven, or until chicken juices run clear.In a bowl, whisk 1/2 cup cream with the remaining sliced lemons, lemon slices, and salsa until blended.Mix in the egg.

title: Homemade Pizzelle (Pizzelle)
ingredients: 4 -6 tablespoons unsalted butter, softened | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1 large egg
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees.Combine all ingredients in a mixing bowl and whip with an electric mixer on medium speed until light and fluffy.Use a rubber spatula to spread 2/3 of dough into a glass 10 inch diameter pie dish.Scatter the pizelle evenly and place in a medium baking sheet with a 1 inch rim.Bake for 30 - 35 minutes, or until the edges are golden and the crackers are lightly marked.Serve immediately.

title: Vegan Peanut Butter (Ma Shaak)
ingredients: 1 quart soymilk | 1 yellow bell pepper, seeded and chopped
instructions: Mix the soymilk and pepper together until smooth.Serve at room temperature or chilled.

title: Coconut Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 -5 heads fresh button mushrooms | 1 cup unsweetened coconut | 1 -2 teaspoon dried sage
instructions: Preheat your oven to 350 degrees.Wash fresh mushrooms under running water, and pat dry with paper towels.Dry mushrooms with paper towels.Place wood skewer through crown to keep them moist while the pre heating.Place the coconut pieces in a shallow baking pan and cover.Dip mushrooms into coconut then place in oven.Cook for 5 minutes.Turn and cook for another 5 minutes, or until browned and tender.Turn the mushrooms and spoon the coconut butter over them.Sprinkle with dried sage, then return to the oven for 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: black mustard seed,onion flake,sirloin,bay seasoning,tofu,cream mushroom soup,barberry,vegetable stock
title: Beef Barberry Soup
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground sirloin | 1/2 lb firm tofu, cubed or 1/2 lb ground pork | 3 bay seasoning | 1/2 onion, chopped | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 5 cups vegetable stock | black mustard seeds ( optional ) | 1 rind from the barberries or 1 strip from a lemon
instructions: Boil soup.Stir in meat & spices.Stir in soup stock.Cover & simmer for 1 hour or until thickened, stirring occasionally.Taste for seasoning.Stir in mustard & berries & serve hot.

Random Ingredients: sazon goya coriander annatto,catfish fillet,kosher salt,salt black pepper,milk ricotta cheese,rigatoni pasta,thyme leaf,cilantro leaf
title: Rigatoni With Catfish and Herb-Roasted
ingredients: 1/2 lb rigatoni pasta | 2 catfish fillets, 4-4 oz each | coarse salt | 12 ounces whole milk ricotta cheese | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon leaves | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | generous pinch sazon goya with coriander ( mccormicks ) or 1 teaspoon dried annatto ( mccormicks ) | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper | fresh thyme leaves, for sprinkling
instructions: In a large pot of boiling water, cook rigatoni until al dente about 8 minutes.Drain.Meanwhile, coat catfish fillets in salt.In a 12 inch skillet, heat ½ tbs of the fat.Pan fry catfish fillets, with the skin side facing down, over moderately high heat, without moving, until flesh is opaque and skin is deep golden brown, 2 - 3 minutes.Transfer catfish slices to a warm serving platter and tent loosely with foil.Deglaze skillet with remaining 1 tbs of the fat in which the catfish was cooked.Add ricotta and tomato, with ¼ tsp each of the tarragon, oregano and sazon.Stir well over moderate heat until liquid is absorbed.Season to taste with salt and pepper.Pour 1¼ cups sauce in the center of the plate.Garnish platter with thyme and serve with rigatoni.

title: Cucumber Syrup
ingredients: 2 large cucumbers ( about 3 pounds, peeled and seeded and cubed ) | 1/2 cup golden brown sugar | 1/2 cup half-and-half cream | 1 lemon peel, pith removed ( optional )
instructions: Toss together the cucumbers and 1/2 cup sugar in a large bowl and set aside to macerate, at least 30 minutes.Stir in half and half and lemon peel after serving.

title: Basmathi's Orange Syrup
ingredients: 1 cup semolina flour | 2 1/2 cups boiling water | 4 teaspoons chili powder | 2 ounces orange marmalade | 1 tablespoon dried oregano leaves, crushed
