instructions: In a double boiler, mix semolina flour and boiling water, stir until smooth.Slowly add the chili powder, orange marmalade, and oregano.Cook over very low heat for 20 minutes.Stir often.

title: Granny's Salmon Baked Potatoes
ingredients: 4 baking potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks | 1 cup chicken stock or 1 cup beef broth | 1 package sliced smoked salmon fillet | 1 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Prepare idaho potatoes according to package directions.

title: Asparagus Gratin
ingredients: 36 frozen asparagus spears, thawed | 1 cup whipping cream | 4 ounces manchego cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.Cook asparagus in the boiling water until tender, about 3 minutes.Add the cream and bring to a boil.Pour cream over frozen asparagus.Sprinkle with cheese.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,mushroom,black bean,garlic salt,cream tartar,zucchini,baby spinach,ice water
title: Healthy Veggie Korma
ingredients: 2 large zucchini, sliced | 1 lb fresh baby spinach | 1 can sliced mushrooms, drained | 2 cups ice water | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 pinch garlic salt | 1/4 teaspoon black bean | 2 fresh kaffir lime leaves
instructions: Put a freezer bag in freezer.Toss frozen veggies, water, and spices together and put in freezer.Stir every couple of hours for a minimum of 5 minutes to thaw.Thaw and drain.Return veggies to freezer in freezer and stir every couple of hours.Serve with salsa, mango salsa, and corn salsa.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,chicken drumstick,black peppercorn,hash brown potato,sage,linguine pasta,fava bean
title: Grilled Chicken and Potato Linguine Salad
ingredients: 4 chicken drumsticks | 3 lbs potatoes ( peeled ) | 2/3 cup white vinegar | 1 teaspoon whole black peppercorn ( or sub green pepper flakes ) | 12 ounces linguine pasta | 1 can fava beans | 1/2 teaspoon rubbed sage
instructions: Slice the chicken drumsticks crosswise into 1/2 inch pieces.Place in a glass casserole dish, cover with water, and stir in 1/2 cup of white vinegar until mixed.Place the peppercorns in a zip top bag and add the chicken.Let soak for 20 minutes then drain the chicken.Pour the olive oil, 2/3 cup of vinegar, and salt and pepper over the chicken and add the potato slices and toss to coat.Cover with foil and refrigerate for an hour to marinate.Drain the potatoes and set aside.Preheat the grill to 400 degrees.When ready to cook place the chicken on the grill rack and cook 7 to 9 minutes on each side, until the juices run clear.Meanwhile steam or boil the beans according to package directions.When ready to serve add the cooked linguine and toss to combine.

title: Aphrodisiac Fruit and Nuts
ingredients: 125 g mixed fresh fruit, chopped | 2 star fruit, diced ( green mangoes, orange sections ) | 2 tablespoons mango chutney | 5 teaspoons wheat flour | 1 slice lemon | 1 teaspoon fresh black tea
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c.Place the mixed fruit in an ovenproof dish.Sprinkle over the chutney, cover with the lemon slice and sprinkle with pepper.Bake for 20 minutes.Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: vanilla sugar,tahini,shiitake mushroom,parsley sprig,kaffir lime leaf,chili seasoning mix,mayonnaise
title: Chinese Take-Out Baked Mushrooms
ingredients: 8 -10 fresh shiitake mushrooms | 1/4 cup mayonnaise or 1/4 cup salad dressing | 3 tablespoons tahini | 1 tablespoon chili seasoning mix | 2 tablespoons hot prepared chili powder or 2 tablespoons sriracha hot sauce | 2 tablespoons reserved kaffir lime leaves, finely minced | 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar | minced parsley sprig ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f brush a baking sheet with cooking spray.Tear or thinly slice the mushrooms.Place in a small bowl and mix with remaining ingredients.Place the mushrooms on the prepared baking sheet.Bake for 15 - 20 minutes, stirring mushrooms halfway through, or until brown and tender.To serve, arrange mushrooms on top of each other and then sprinkle with finely minced parsley.

title: Strawberry-Pravda
ingredients: 1 can italian plum tomatoes | 1 red chili, finely chopped | 1 cup strawberry preserves
instructions: Place each tomato in its own bowl with the chili.Add the strawberry preserves.

title: Peaches in Tarts
ingredients: 1/4 frozen puff pastry sheets, thawed ( thawed if using thawed pastry sheets ) | 1 peach, pared cored and cut in half lengthwise | 3 -4 slices pickled garlic pickled over the peaches | 2 teaspoons adobo seasoning ( from a jar of chipotle peppers in adobo )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f lightly flour two 12 muffin pans or line with parchment paper, cut a slit in the top of each pastry and place 1 peach half on top of each and using a sharp knife cut 3 - 4 slits in the top of the peach, about 1/3 of the way through the peach.Place a slice of pickled garlic over each peach.Sprinkle lightly with adobo seasoning and 1 tsp of adobo seasoning.Fold each pastry round over onto its edge and press with fingers until an even thickness.Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until browned.

Random Ingredients: tomato puree,san marzano tomato,pork chop,golden syrup,plain yogurt,chicken stock cube,vermicelli,red pepper flake
title: Pork Chops With Yogurt (Paleo)
ingredients: 1/2 lb boneless pork chops, trimmed, cut in half | 1/2 cup golden syrup | 1 can tomato puree | 1 can san marzano tomatoes | 1/2 chicken stock cube | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon plain yogurt | 7 ounces vermicelli, uncooked
instructions: In a large saucepan, mix pork with syrup, tomato puree, tomatoes, chicken stock cube, red pepper flakes, and yogurt.Bring to boil, and simmer for 45 minutes.In a separate pan, boil pasta for 7 minutes.Drain pasta, and return to pan.Add sauce to pasta, and reduce over the heat for 5 minutes.Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: limeade concentrate,english cucumber,self raising flour,sun tomato oil,nutmeg,dill weed
title: Easy Sun-Dried Tomato Muffins
ingredients: 2 cups self-raising flour | 1 tablespoon dill weed | 1 tablespoon dried limeade concentrate | 60 g sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil ( not oil packed ) | 1/4 cup mixed nuts, lightly crushed | 1/2 cup english cucumber, finely diced
instructions: Combine dry ingredients in a large bowl, stir together until combined.Stir in sun dried tomatoes & cucumber.Spoon mixture into well greased recesses from muffin tin.Bake at c for approx 15 minutes.

title: Tamarind Burgers
ingredients: 1 pound lean hamburger meat, trimmed of fat and cut in half
instructions: Preheat grill for medium high heat.Line the cavity of a large saute pan with foil and place over medium heat.Add the meat, then brush the inside of the pan with a little oil.Lightly mist the foil with cooking spray.Turn the meat over with the oil.Place the top of the foil over the pan.Cook until the meat has browned, about 5 minutes.Unwrap the meat onto a cutting board and cut in half lengthwise.Serve each piece hot.

title: Homemade Pasta Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups fresh tomato juice or 1 1/2 cups canned tomatoes, drained ( 2 28 oz.| cans ) | 1/2 cup dry milk | spices | 2 ounces prosciutto or 2 ounces parmesan cheese, grated | 2 large capers, drained
instructions: Blend all ingredients in blender or stand mixer until smooth, about 15 minutes.Transfer to saucepan and cook over low heat until heated through.Cook sauce through.Use immediately.

title: Pickled Red Chilies
ingredients: 2 cans whole red chilies, halved ( or hot ) | 2 pears, peeled, halved & cored
instructions:
Put the chilis through a grinder or food processor.The chilis should have a chivey sort of consistency and have a consistency similar to your pickled red chilies i.E.
    -, the hot green, spicy red.Pack into a pint jar, cap and label the jar.Keep refrigerated until needed.

title: Bourbon Dry Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 28 ounces hunts tomato sauce | 14 ounces cherry tomatoes and basil | 1 vanilla bean | 1 teaspoon dried italian spices | 7 1/2 ounces dry roasted peanuts
instructions: Puree all of the ingredients except for the nuts in a blender or food processor and transfer to a deep pot.Bring to a slow boil, then simmer for 1 hour.Remove from heat and cool.Transfer half the sauce to blender along with the nuts and stir well.Cover and refrigerate for up to 6 hours before using.

title: Pot Roast for the Grill
ingredients: 6 beef chuck, trimmed of excess fat ( or 3-4 pounds of stewing beef ) | 2 teaspoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 1 lb baking potato ( or two small, unripe ), scrubbed of excess moisture
instructions: Preheat the grill to its highest temperature and oil the grate.Cut the beef into large cubes about 1 1/2 inches in diameter.Use your hands to rub some salt into the beef.Place the cubed beef in a small plastic bag.Add the cocoa powder, salt, and 1/4 teaspoon of salt to the bag.Close the bag and shake to mix all of the pieces.The dough should be moist and silky.Transfer the dough onto the grill, about 5 to 6 inches from side of the grill.Close the lid and cook the meat for about 1 hour and 20 minutes.With tongs or two spoons, move the roast to the edge of the grill, leaving the lid slightly open.Close the lid and continue to cook for an additional 30 minutes.The meat should be very brown and crispy on the outside and quite dry on the outside.

Random Ingredients: head garlic,almond,cucumber,italian herb seasoning,ginger root,wheat pastry flour,cardamom seed
title: Crispy Whole Wheat Pastry (Gorki) for a Snack
ingredients: 2 tablespoons whole wheat pastry flour | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom seeds | 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger root | 1 teaspoon dried italian herb seasoning | ground almonds | 1 head garlic, peeled and crushed | 1 cucumber - peeled, seeded, and finely diced | 1 slice fresh ginger root, chopped
instructions: Mix flour, cardamom, grated ginger, and italian herb seasoning together in a bowl.Spread a thin layer of ground almond on 1 sheet of wax paper and place the garlic and cucumber in the center of the paper.Sprinkle the top with ginger, then top with the second sheet of wax paper, pressing the edges to seal.Carefully peel off some of the crust from the parchment paper.Place the parchment in the freezer until dough is firm.Cut a small slit in the top crust of the parchment paper and carefully scoop out ice.Remove the tofu sachet from the freezer and sprinkle with the reserved ground almond.Cut into 1 inch cubes.Serve with plain curries, snack meat, salads, or ice pickles.

title: Patska - Russian Snack
ingredients: 2 slices rye bread | 3 - 4 2 teaspoons seasoning salt or 3 -4 teaspoons white salt | 3 tablespoons marinara sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f place one slice of bread slightly larger than the other and place in the oven to brown quickly.Remove bread from oven and remove bread again immediately so it can cool slightly.Take the bread and add about 3 tbs of seasoning salt, marinara sauce and remaining slices.Mix well and spread over the rye bread.Cover the bread with aluminum foil and place in a baking dish.Bake at 350°f for about 30 minutes.

title: Chinese Style Pizza
ingredients: 1 lb pizza sauce ( or any tomato sauce ) | 5 teaspoons soya sauce | 1/8 teaspoon mustard powder
instructions: First, mix the ingredients together and pour over pizza bases.Bake for 5 minutes then turn out and bake for an additional 5 minutes.Enjoy.

title: Broccoli-Mustard Bun and Broccoli
ingredients: 500 g broccoli | mustard | 20 bunches mustard | rose
instructions: Chop broccoli into chunks and steam until tender.Grind mustard to a course crass.Mix together broccoli, mustard and rose to make a bun spreadable.Bake under grill until the top is well browned.

Random Ingredients: savoy cabbage,virgin olive oil,pasta,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Cabbage and Savoy Noodles
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 head savoy cabbage or 1 -1 1/2 head bermuda cabbage | vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 cups vegetable oil for cooking | 12 ounces dry pasta ( linguine or linguini )
instructions: Boil or steam the cabbage in water, until the outer leaves are clear.Set out the cabbage to cool and squeeze out the excess water, then finely shred the cabbage leaves by hand, discarding the tough core.Rinse the savoy cabbage and discard coarse outer leaves and cut into bite size pieces.Toss the cabbage with 2 cups of vegetable oil in a large bowl.Preheat a heavy bottomed pot or skillet over medium high heat.Lightly spray the bottom of the pan with veggie oil cooking spray.Add the pasta and stir fry until coated with oil, 1 to 2 minutes.Add the cabbage and toss to combine.Add the cooked pasta, seasoning and toss, cooking 1 minute more.Serve hot, warm or at room temperature.Note, you can also serve immediately, refrigerated, or at room temperature.

title: Roasted Lemons With Smoked Romano, Grated Romano, and Pepper
ingredients: 1/3 cup grated fresh romano cheese | 1/3 cup finely grated smoked smoked romano cheese | 1/3 cup finely grated fresh pepper ( coarsely ground ) | cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 500°f stir all ingredients together.Arrange slices on a foil lined foil covered baking sheet, spacing evenly.Bake for 20 minutes or until puffed and beginning to brown.Enjoy.

title: Yemeni Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 1 english cucumber | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1 egg, lightly beaten | 1/4 cup pomegranate seeds ( also called pepitas ) | 6 kaffir lime leaves, torn into pieces
instructions: Grate the fresh cucumber on the coarse side of a large grater.Heat up the griddle or dry skillet.Lightly brown turmeric, and then stir it into the grated cucumber.Mix in the beaten egg.Put the pomegranate seeds in a small bowl, and crush with your hands lightly with the flat of a small knife.Add to the cucumber mixture while continuing to toss.Transfer to a serving bowl, and sprinkle with pepitas.Chill for another hour.

title: Egg Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1 egg | 2 tablespoons salad dressing, or as desired | 1 tablespoon mixed salad dressing, or as desired
instructions: Place egg in a saucepan and cover with cold water.Bring water to a boil, then immediately remove from heat.Cover with a towel, and let egg stand in hot water for 10 to 12 minutes.Remove from hot water, then drain.Peel and chop.Place egg in a bowl.Stir in salad dressing until well coated.Sprinkle salads with desired amount of salad dressing.Cover salad with a towel, and refrigerate salad mixture overnight.

title: Thai Pepper Salad
ingredients: 2 cups yellow peppers, seeded and cut into thin strips | 1 cup plain low-fat yogurt, plain | 1 cup thai basil, finely chopped
instructions: In large bowl, combine all ingredients except basil.Mix well until dressing is well blended.Sprinkle with basil and toss to mix.

title: Beef & Cashews in a Baking Pot
ingredients: 2 sirloin tip roast, about � pound | 1/3 lb salted cashews, broken into large flakes | 1 lb baking potato, cut into chunks
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees.Place roast in a roasting pan, sprinkle with nuts, and bake at 450 degrees for 20 minutes, or until meat is medium rare.Remove roast and nuts from oven, transfer to a bowl, and loosely cover to keep warm.Skim off the excess fat.Place potatoes in a baking dish, cover, and place under the broiler.Broil until tender when pierced with a fork, about 10 minutes.

title: Persian Jam
ingredients: 5 -6 lbs whole seedless raspberry jam | pistachios or almonds
instructions: Heat oven to 325º.Line a loaf pan with a double thickness of paper towel.Wrap dough in foil and place it at the bottom of a roasting pan large enough to accommodate the jam and jam.Bake about 2 hours.Turn off oven and let jam cool.Carefully remove foil, place the pan on a flat surface and cover it with a heavy dish towel.Place a roasting pan on top of the pan and place in the oven.This will steam the jam.Boil and stir occasionally for about 1 or 2 minutes until most of the juices have become a deep amber color.Immediately remove the pan from the oven and carefully pour the hot jam onto a clean surface.Using the towel and towel, spread the jelly in an even layer evenly on top and sides of the jam.Sprinkle with pistachios or almonds.Chill until the jam is firm.Transfer the jam to a cloth lined container and refrigerate until it can be used within 2 weeks.

title: Sara's Rhubarb Rhubarb Kebabs
ingredients: 2 lbs rhubarb, sliced 1/2 inch thick | 10 ounces plain yogurt ( activated ) | 1 tablespoon ancho chili ( optional ) or 1 tablespoon chili powder ( optional )
instructions: Cut the rhubarb into 1 1/2 cubes.Cut the whey into 1 inch lengths and trim the ends off the stalks.Rinse and dry the rhubarb pieces.Place them in a bowl and add enough yogurt to coat.Cover the bowl and refrigerate overnight.Bring it to room temperature before using.Drain the rest of the yogurt and stir it into the rhubarb.Add the chili, if using, and serve.

title: Tunisian Beet Salad (Beet Salad)
ingredients: 12 small beets | 6 slices bread, crusts removed
instructions:
Wash and clean the beets carefully.Place them in a pot of cold water that covers them, and bring them slowly to a boil.Cook until they are tender when pierced with a fork.
    -.Remove the beets with a slotted spoon, and remove the beets with a slotted spoon.To serve, place them on a dish, and sprinkle generously with salt.Place a slice of bread on top, and let stand for a few minutes before flipping, so the slices don't break at the bottom of the bowl.Place a beet salad on the bread, and serve immediately.

title: Cumin-Spiced Romaine Leafs
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce, rinsed
instructions: Place lettuce leaves in a large pot of cold water until softened, about 10 minutes.Drain water and remove and pat dry with paper towels.Cover and refrigerate until serving.Remove lettuce from refrigerator and cut down center vein of leaf using a sharp knife and running under cold water.

Random Ingredients: salt,purpose flour,fennel,plum tomato,triple sec,deli turkey,russet potato
title: Tuscany Turkey and Dumplings
ingredients: 3 lbs sliced deli turkey | 1 lb russet potato, peeled and cubed | 1 1/2 lbs plum tomatoes, cored seeded, chopped | 1 teaspoon salt | 4 teaspoons fennel, chopped fresh | 1/2 cup triple sec | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour
instructions: Coat a large non stick frying pan with some margarine or oil.Add potatoes and cook on medium high heat for 5 minutes.Cook turkey in the pan until cooked through.Remove from the pan and cool slightly.While turkey is cooking prepare the dumplings.Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl.Fill cooked turkey with potatoes and stir to combine.Cover and chill for 30 minutes.Remove turkey from the pan and allow to rest for 20 minutes before adding to the dumplings.The sauce should have thickened slightly on the turkey and potatoes.When adding to the daummy potatoes, stir to combine.

title: Spanish Onions & Dates (Dees) - Microwave
ingredients: 12 dates, pitted | 1 spanish onion, very finely chopped
instructions: Wash and core the dates.Cut off ends & gently scrape centres of pitted dates with a teaspoon & gently press to separate from the pits.Place dates in a large bowl, cover with water & leave to soak.Microwave on high for 3 - 5 minutes or until the onions become very tender but still holding their shape.Drain well & return dates to the bowl.Mash well to combine & return chopped onion to bowl then mix in chopped onion.Spoon the mixture into small flat serving dishes or one large flat bread tray lined w/grated cheesecloth.Store in the freezer until required.

title: Crock Pot Beef Enchiladas
ingredients: 1/2 cup coconut milk | 1/3 cup condensed beef broth | 1 teaspoon chopped garlic | 1 teaspoon desiccated peppercorn | 2 cups shredded lettuce | 2 cups enchilada sauce, or other favorite flavor
instructions: Combine coconut milk, beef broth, garlic, peppercorns and shredded lettuce in the bottom of your slow cooker.Cover and cook on high 4 hours.Once the 4 hours is up, add 1 cup of enchilada sauce and stir, cooking 2 more minutes.Place remaining 1 cup of enchilada sauce in a bowl and pour over the beef.Cover and cook on low 10 minutes more.

Random Ingredients: brand rice,cranberry juice,ice water,mini marshmallow,sauerkraut,sherry wine,bread
title: Sauerkraut Toasted Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup brand rice or 1/2 cup short grain rice, uncooked, can use brown rice if desired | 1/2 cup sauerkraut, drained and rinsed | 3 tablespoons dry sherry wine | 1 can reduced-fat vanilla yogurt ( neufchatel if preferred ) | 1 2/3 cups water | 1/3 cup fresh cranberry juice or 1/3 cup bottled cranberry juice | crusty bread ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.Spray a small casserole dish with cooking spray.Stir rice, sauerkraut and sherry in a medium size bowl, then add vanilla yogurt and mix well.Pour into prepared casserole dish.Combine remaining water, cranberry juice and rice.Cover and bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until rice has been absorbed and flavors are combined and mixture starts to set.

Random Ingredients: mint leaf,cider vinegar,meat,puff pastry,jalapeno chile pepper,corn tortilla
title: The Puff Pastry Taco-Lasagna
ingredients: 1/4 cup minced jalapeno chile pepper, or more to taste | 1/2 cup finely chopped fresh mint leaves | 1/3 cup cider vinegar | 4 small sheets frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1 rotisserie-cooked, cooked meat, shredded, seasoned with salt | 4 corn tortillas, cut into quarters
instructions: Place jalapeno pepper, mint, and vinegar in a small bowl, and mix until combined.Place puff pastry sheets into a skillet over medium high heat, and let them puff out until browned, about 5 minutes.Lay one tortilla onto a plate, and spread with a thin layer of the jalapeno/mint mixture.Arrange equal amounts of beef, cheese and meat in a layer over the cheese.Repeat layering with remaining tortillas, filling, and meat, cheese, and meat, respectively, until all ingredients are used up.Spray a casserole dish with nonstick cooking spray, place lid over dish, and bake in preheated oven until top is golden brown, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: worcestershire sauce,yellow rice,self rising flour,lime wedge,basmati rice,kosher salt
title: Yellow Rice Waffles
ingredients: 1 cup dry yellow rice ( rinsed, soaked in water & drained ) | 1 1/2 cups self-rising flour | 1 1/4 teaspoons kosher salt | 1/2 cup limes or 1/2 cup lemon juice | 1 1/4 - 1 1/2 cups white basmati rice ( cooked according to package directions ) | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce ( optional )
instructions: Warm waffle maker using medium heat or lightly oil on one side.Combine rice, flour & salt in a large bowl, using a fork.Add juice & stir until fully mixed.Fold in rice, using fork to thoroughly combine.Close lid & keep warm waffle maker.After all of the waffle iron has been used, cook waffle or fryer until rice is puffed & golden.Serve immediately.Serve waffles with lime or lemon wedges for dipping.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,basil leaf,peach,dark soy sauce,pineapple,lime,basmati rice,baguette
title: Cambodian Baked Peaches
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh peach, cut in quarters | 1/2 cup fresh pineapple, cut in wedges | 1 teaspoon balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons minced basil leaves | 1 lime ( zest and juice ) | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce ( tamari ) | 1/2 lb semisoft baguette | basmati rice, for serving
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450°f.Arrange the peach, pineapple wedges and basil leaves in a single layer in a large shallow baking dish.To make the marinade, bring the vinegar, zest, lime juice and tamari to a boil in a small saucepan.Brush the marinade over the fruit and vegetables.Arrange the baguette in a single layer on a baking sheet lined with foil and bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until golden and crusty.Serve the fruit and vegetables with rice.

title: Lime Pasta
ingredients: 4 cups pasta, prepared according to package directions | 2 tablespoons margarine or 2 tablespoons butter, melted | 2 fresh fruit, sliced | fresh lime wedge | lime wedge, wedge
instructions: Cook pasta to desired doneness as directed on package al dente stage.Toss with margarine.

Random Ingredients: breadcrumb,gruyere cheese,basil leaf,plum tomato,great northern bean
title: White Bean & Tomatoes Breadcrumb Filling
ingredients: 400 g great northern bean ( dry ) | 2 large plum tomatoes ( chopped into bite size pieces ) | 4 slices gruyere cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons soft breadcrumbs ( to form a shell for the filling ) | 1/2 - 3/4 cup basil leaves, fresh, chopped
instructions: Boil the bean in water over a high heat until tender.Drain and refresh under cold water.Drain again, reserving 2 - 3 tbsp of cooked beans.Place the tomatoes, cheese and beans in a processor or by hand.Add 1 cup of the reserved bean cooking water from cooking beans.Blend, if you wish, then transfer to a bowl.Add basil to tomato mixture and gently stir.Add the breadcrumbs and mix.Por into a well oiled 20cm quiche pan.Bake in a pre heated oven at 160°c/325°f/gas 5 / until golden.

Random Ingredients: poblano chile,fennel seed,thyme leaf,corn oil,sirloin tip roast,water chestnut,tamarind paste,cider vinegar
title: Beef Roast With Tamarind Sauce
ingredients: 1 sirloin tip roast | 2 teaspoons tamarind paste | 2 tablespoons water chestnuts | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 1/2 teaspoon dried taro root chili fenel seeds | corn oil ( for frying ) | 1/4 cup cider vinegar
instructions:
Make tamarind sauce.Place 2 tablespoons tamarind paste, and 2 t water into blender and blend on high until paste is somewhat like breadcrumbs.Add chopped chestnuts, fennel, thyme and fenel, blend briefly.Heat about 2 inches of oil in heavy skillet with tight fitting lid.Place roast in skillet and sear 2 minutes.Place the roast in a deep baking dish and pour half of the tamarind sauce over the meat.Cover and cook 2 hours at room temperature.Heat remaining tamarind sauce in microwave.Remove meat from oven and discard remaining sauce.If the roast has a little oil on top, heat in oven.For best results refrigerate roast and cover completely with aluminum foil for at least 3 hours.
    -.Heat oil in skillet on medium high heat.Remove roast from baking dish and place on a serving plate.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf italian parsley,beef chuck,hard egg,skewer,lemon grass,marmalade,silken tofu
title: Korean Marinated Beef Satay
ingredients: 1 1 1/2 - 2 lbs boneless beef chuck | 2 hard-boiled eggs, halved | 4 tablespoons marmalade | 6 tablespoons soft silken tofu | 1 lemon grass, washed, chopped | 4 tablespoons fresh flat-leaf italian parsley, chopped | 8 skewers, soaked in water
instructions: Cut the meat into 1 inch cubes.In a bowl, combine the eggs, marmalade, tofu, lemon grass, parsley and mix well.Place the skewers between two sheets of wax paper and pound with a meat pounder or clean mallet to flatten.Using a sharp knife, score each slice of meat about 1/2 inch deep, beginning on the long side.Drain the skewers on paper towels.Place the meat on skewers and skewer with toothpicks.Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for one to three hours or overnight.Preheat a grill to medium heat.Remove the skewers from the marinade and thread onto the skewers.Grill the kebabs until just cooked through, brushing lightly with the reserved marinade.

title: Easy Chicken
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken legs | 2 tablespoons oil, for cooking | 2 lbs skirt steaks | 5 ounces biscuits | 1 cup brown sugar | 1 head cabbage
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.Wash, dry chicken legs and cut into halves.In a large roasting pan that is lined with foil or parchment paper place chicken legs in oven and bake for 60 minutes turn meat over and bake for 30 - 40 minutes, or until meat is browned.Cool meat removing bone and place back into the roasting pan and bake for 30 more minutes.Cool completely and cut into cubes.For the cabbage cut out core and cut out core.Cut into wedges and place in a saucepan with a bit of water and bring to a boil.Turn heat down and simmer for 15 minutes until cabbage has softened slightly, remove from heat and then place on a platter.To serve, place a piece of fresh chicken on plate, top with cabbage wedges.To serve, remove meat, cabbage and meat and place a cabbage wedge on top of each plate.

title: Sweet and Sour Rolls
ingredients: 2 sheets frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1 teaspoon light molasses | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 2 teaspoons minced celery | rice paper
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.Place thawed pastry sheets on a cookie sheet.Brush top of dough with molasses.Sprinkle with garlic salt and celery.Wrap each piece of pastry in a double thickness of paper towels.Bake in oven for 35 minutes.Remove pastry to a cutting board or cool completely on a rack.Roll up each piece into a log about 6 inches long and 3 inches wide.

title: Hot Hamburger Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 3 packages egg noodles | cherries
instructions: Brown hamburger.Drain hamburger.Boil egg noodles as directed on package for al dente, rinse and drain.In a large bowl, combine hamburger, noodles, cherry.Salad.Chill in refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: fennel seed,orange blossom water,golden syrup,chicken part,sharp cheddar cheese,mango chutney
title: Chicken Quesadilla
ingredients: 1/2 cup golden syrup | 1/2 cup orange blossom water | 2 tablespoons grated orange blossom water | 4 chicken parts | 1/4 teaspoon fennel seed | 2 1/2 ounces shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 2 tablespoons mango chutney
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together golden syrup, orange blossom water, and orange blossom water.Place chicken pieces in a resealable plastic bag and pour the golden syrup mixture over the chicken.Close bag, and marinate in the refrigerator for 30 minutes.In a food processor or blender, process the fennel seed and cheese until smooth.Drain the chicken, reserving marinade.Pat chicken dry with a paper towel.Grill chicken over medium heat until opaque in the center, and no longer pink in the center, about 10 minutes per side.Turn chicken over, drizzle with orange blossom mixture, and continue cooking until chicken is no longer pink on the outside, 10 to minutes.Top chicken with mango chutney.

title: Potato Mustard
ingredients: 2 pounds peeled whole red potatoes | 2 tablespoons french's prepared mustard
instructions: Layer 1/2 of the potatoes in the bottom of a large, heavy skillet.Sprinkle half of the mustard on top of the potatoes, then spread the remaining mustard mixture evenly over the top of the potatoes.Over medium high heat, cook, covered, for 15 minutes to allow the mustard to brown, and sprinkle the reserved half of the mustard on top of the mustard.Reduce heat to medium low, pour the mustard mixture, and cook for another 5 minutes.When the potatoes are tender, stir together the remaining potatoes, and spread the entire contents over the top of the mustard.Cover skillet, and allow to stand for 5 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: italian seasoning,hoagie,rose water,peach,flat leaf parsley,napa cabbage,cocoa,yellow cornmeal
title: Peach Scented Calzones
ingredients: 1 cup yellow cornmeal | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa | 3 teaspoons reduced sodium italian seasoning | 1/2 cup finely chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 2 teaspoons rose water | 2 cans sliced peaches, drained | 4 hoagie rolls, cut 1 inch thick | 1 large napa cabbage stick
instructions: Combine cornmeal, cocoa, italian seasoning and parsley in a 2 quart heavy saucepan and bring to a boil over moderate heat, stirring to combine.Boil, stirring, until liquid is absorbed, about 5 minutes.Add peaches and reduce heat to moderately low and simmer until thickened, about 3 minutes.Place rolls on work surface and season with salt.Using a slotted spoon, dip rolls in hot cornmeal mixture, then in cornmeal mixture and arrange on baking sheets.Cover and let stand just until rolls are warm, about 10 minutes.Meanwhile, remove peaches from shells and arrange peaches on rolls.Place on center rack of oven and bake until peaches are warm, about 2 minutes.Remove from oven and serve with napa.

Random Ingredients: broth,nonstick cooking spray,anise seed,green cabbage,confectioner sugar,bulk sausage,onion soup mix
title: Cabbage-Sausage Soup
ingredients: 2 cups shredded green cabbage | 1 can chopped green cabbage | 1/2 cup instant onion soup mix | 5 cups hot broth | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed, crushed | 1/3 cup confectioners'sugar | nonstick cooking spray
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large saucepan, and simmer over low heat.Remove the lid as needed.

title: English Style Steak Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup raw rice
instructions: Place rice in a steamer basket, and bring to a boil.Steam 2 minutes per side or until rice is tender and the steam is mostly gone.

title: Chickpea and Black Pepper Hummus With a Kick
ingredients: 2 cans chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a food processor and mix them together until fully combined.Taste and adjust seasoning before serving.Serve with pita chips, crackers, etc.

title: Paçoca Fish Stew
ingredients: 1/4 cup tapioca flour | 1 lb smoked hamburger | 1 can drained fish | 1/3 cup water | 1 teaspoon marjoram
instructions: In a large pan fry fish until lightly cooked.Cut into strips and add to fish.Sprinkle with marjoram.Add enough water to just cover the fish and simmer on medium low heat, with the lid slightly loose to avoid overflow, 10 min,.

Random Ingredients: egg wrap,chili pepper flake,five spice powder
title: Chinese Five Spice Omelette
ingredients: 5 -6 tablespoons five-spice powder | 8 -10 egg roll wraps | 2 small dried chili peppers or 2 small dried chile flakes
instructions: Mix together five spice powder and chinese five spice and set aside.Coat two small frying pans with cooking spray and place over medium high heat.Add five spice powder mix and fry one side of egg rolls in the pan until golden brown.Repeat with remaining egg rolls and chilli mixture.Serve.

title: Mexican Style Roast Pork and Broccoli,
ingredients: 1 pork roast | 4 cups broccoli florets | 8 ounces picante sauce, medium | 1 medium hot pepper, cut into chunks
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f.Place the roast in a slow cooker.Place the broccoli in the slow cooker.Pour in the picante sauce, hot pepper and mix well.Cover and continue cooking on high for about 2 1/2 hours, until the meat is falling apart tender.

Random Ingredients: red chili sauce,zucchini,hot chili pepper,meatball,tagliatelle pasta noodle,mirin,bicarbonate soda
title: Spicy Zucchini Meatballs
ingredients: 1 lb zucchini | 2 hot chili peppers | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 teaspoon dry crushed hot chili pepper | 400 g frozen meatballs | 450 g tagliatelle pasta noodles | 2 tablespoons mirin
instructions: Cut zucchini into 1cm thick slices.Cut chillies and peppers into long strips.Bring a large pan of water to the boil and add frozen meatballs.Cook for 7 minutes then drain and pat dry.Add meatballs and vegetables into a large saucepan of boiling water and cook for 2 - 4 minutes until tender, drain.Cook tagliatelle in a pan of salted water for 3 - 5 minutes until just beginning to soften.Drain and add to the meatballs, add the mirin and bring to the boil.Serve immediately.

title: Mom's Easy Microwave Lamb Ramen
ingredients: 2 -4 packages knox knox frozen ramen noodles | 5 tablespoons honey | 1 1/2 liters lamb stock ( depending on lamb stock ) | 1 onion, sliced | 3 carrots, cut into chunks | 1 red jalapeno pepper, seeded and quartered | 1/2 cup frozen corn | pickled radish
instructions: Place ramen noodles, in a large bowl, pour enough boiling water in to cover ramen noodles.Let macerate in microwave on high for about 5 minutes to soften noodles, drain and set aside.Place 2 tablespoons honey in microwave safe bowl and microwave on medium high for approximately 1/2 to 1 minute.Add lamb stock and microwave on high for approximately 2 minutes.Add onion, carrot, red and jalapenos.Microwave for approximately 10 minutes on high, stir frequently.Add noodles and stir well.Microwave for 6 to 10 minutes or until noodles are tender and liquid has been absorbed.Check seasoning and add additional salt, if desired.

title: Maple Sage Paste
ingredients: 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 2 tablespoons fresh tarragon leaves, fresh picked | 1 teaspoon maple flavored flavored, non-hydrogenated
instructions: In a small bowl mix together the maple syrup, tarragon, and 1/2 teaspoon of the maple flavored flavored olive oil.Set aside.In a small bowl, mix together the remaining 1/4 cup of maple flavored olive oil with 2 tablespoons of the maple flavored oil.In a small bowl, stir together the remaining 1/4 cup of maple flavored olive oil and remaining teaspoon of the maple flavored flavored oil.Stir into the maple flavored olive oil until just blended.Serve at room temperature or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: garlic,creole seasoning,hatch brand tomato enchilada sauce,black pepper,leaf lettuce,fish fillet,cotija cheese
title: Shannon's Shrimp and Baked Fish Enchiladas
ingredients: 12 shrimp - peeled, deveined and rinsed | 2 cups crumbled cotija cheese | 4 cloves garlic, chopped | 1 teaspoon creole seasoning | 1 teaspoon ground black pepper | 1 can hatch brand tomatoes with enchilada sauce | 1 cup torn fresh spinach leaves | 20 toothpicks inserted into the center of the pasta
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f.Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and spread the sliced cotija cheese on the prepared baking sheet.In a large bowl, mash the cotija cheese with a fork or potato masher.Stir in garlic, creole seasoning, and pepper, mixing in tomato.Spoon the shrimp mixture into 2 bowls.Place a toothpick into each one to hold a shrimp in it.Spoon 2 tablespoons of shrimp mixture onto each toothpick, close the corners of the toothpicks, and wrap the shrimp in the strips.Arrange toothpicks in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet.Bake in the preheated oven until shrimp are browned, firm, and no longer translucent in the center, 15 to 20 minutes.An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees f.Remove toothpicks, and top enchiladas with green salsa and/or tortilla strips.

title: Green Onion Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1 teaspoon green onion, finely chopped | 1/4 cup sliced leeks | 2 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar
instructions: In small bowl, mix green onion and leeks with sherry vinegar.Cover and chill for 2 hours.

title: Barley Beef Nuts (Aka Beef Barley)
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin ( thinly sliced ) | 2 cups pearl barley ( washed and drained ) | 1/4 cup peanut butter | 1/4 cup rice wine or 1/4 cup dry sherry | 6 ounces hamburger rolls | 1 bag chicken wings ( split in half )
instructions: Note, i like to cook all of the ingredient in the crockpot, but you may need to add more of whichever type of beef you're using.Once all ingredients are cooked, you're done to your liking.Meat is not cut in thin strips.If you're cooking on low, cook on high for 10 - 15 minutes before serving.

title: Cocktail with Raisins and Anchovies (Cocktail)
ingredients: 2 cups white rice, rinsed well | 1/2 bunch fresh onion flakes, minced | 5 tablespoons raisins | 1 anchovy, drained and chopped | 2 tablespoons pickling spices, to taste
instructions: Put rice in a pot with cold water and lid over it.This should cover the rice.Bring to a boil, remove from heat, and allow to sit for 20 to 30 minutes.Drain and reserve water from the pot.Place the onion flakes, raisins, anchovies, and pickling spice into a bowl.Rinse the pot with water, put into the sink, and rinse the drained rice once or twice.Drain well.To serve, place the drained rice in small individual serving bowls.Spoon in a small amount of the reserved water.Note, you can add 2 tblsp.Dried mustard to the rinsed rice.

title: Quick Shredded Beef for a Crowd
ingredients: 4 -5 lbs beef chuck, for beef soup | 4 -5 small tomatillos, if possible, cut in half, and de-seeded | 4 -6 green tomatoes, chopped
instructions: Put the beef, tomatillos and green tomatoes in a dutch oven or crock pot.Add water to nearly the top of the beef, or just enough to cover the meat.Cook on low for 8 hours, or high for 4 to 5 hours.Serve with boiled yummy bread.

title: Sherry and Scalloped Oysters
ingredients: 3 lbs tiny red new potatoes | 4 1/2 - 5 lbs fresh scallops | 2 serrano peppers, sliced thin
instructions: Scrub potatoes and cut into halves or quarters.Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.Cook scallops about 3 minutes, then remove to a cutting board and season.Heat a small amount of oil in an iron saute pan, preferably nonstick.Add the scallops.Sear on high heat until brown on the first side, but only a couple of minutes.Transfer scallops to a platter.Add the browned scallops to the hot pan.Turn down heat to medium and cook until they are well browned and slightly crisp on the edges.You don’t want the scallops to curl.If you notice as much brown, do a bit more.Transfer to a large serving platter.Sprinkle the hot scallops over the scallops and drizzle with a little additional oil.Garnish with slices of serrano chili.Serve warm.

title: Corn Relish
ingredients: 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 1/2 cup low fat, non fat sour cream
instructions: Mix corn and sour cream.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,spinach leaf,yeast,pork,italian seasoning,heavy whipping cream,tarragon vinegar,black bean
title: Sweet Italian Pork and Beans
ingredients: 1 lb ground pork | 2 lbs fresh spinach leaves, washed and finely chopped | 1 tablespoon dried italian seasoning | 1 tablespoon dried tarragon vinegar | 6 cups heavy whipping cream | 1/4 cup fresh pineapple juice | 1 tablespoon instant yeast | 1 can pinto beans, undrained
instructions: Combine all ingredients in pan of crockpot.Reduce cooker to low and cook for 6 to 8 hours until cooked through, stirring from time to time.

title: Tortilla-Wrapped Watermelon Salad
ingredients: 12 tortillas ( or regular flour tortillas, cut into 1-inch sticks ) | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1/4 teaspoon cumin seed | 1/4 cup fresh salsa ( we like pace medium ) | 1/2 cup diced ripe watermelon ( about 1 1/2 ) | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1/3 cup prepared whipped topping, thawed ( such as cool whip, can use more to taste ) | 2 tablespoons dry sherry ( can use more to taste )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f.Heat the oil on a cast iron skillet over medium high heat.Add the cumin seeds.When they pop, pour out immediately and discard the sputtering spices.Cool.Coat and flour the tortillas by layering them in the middle of a microwavable plate with the sides touching each other against your flat side of the plate.Add the salsa to the tortillas and roll them.Place the roll into a single layer on a sheet pan and refrigerate 30 - 45 minutes or up to 3 days.Mix the almond extract with the whipped topping.When ready to serve, arrange the watermelon, sherry, and sliced almonds in a shallow 1 1/2 quart baking dish.Bake for 12 - 15 minutes or until the watermelon is tender and the almonds are lightly browned.If you have a gas stove, you may use a broiler pan if you like your watermelon crispy.Variations.

title: Sauerkraut Relish
ingredients: 1 can sauerkraut | 1 jar roasted red peppers | 1 package powdered suet or ( 3 ounce ) package lemon peel | 1 -2 drop red food coloring ( optional )
instructions: Soak sauerkraut for about 30 minutes, then shred using a large shredder or food processor.Cut the red peppers into long strips, then cut them into thin strips, about 2 inches wide.Mix all of the ingredients together and stir well.The idea is to keep the salt in the sauerkraut because it will get diluted with water.Sprinkle in a drop of food coloring to sweeten to your liking.

title: Simple Mexican Chicken
ingredients: 1 jar chicken meat | 1/2 teaspoon paprika | ice water
instructions: Rinse your chicken in cold water, then drain and dry on paper towels.Heat a grill, a heavy skillet with lid over high heat, or just a small saucepan over medium heat for about 2 minutes.Place chicken in the pan and sprinkle with paprika.Sprinkle water over chicken and grill until chicken is no longer pink and juices run clear, about 10 minutes.

title: Kielbasa and Potatoes in Vinegar Sauce
ingredients: 4 -6 red potatoes, sliced thin | 1/2 lb kielbasa, sliced thin ( or other sausage ) | 1/4 cup sake | 1/4 cup mirin | 2 cups sauerkraut or 2 cups sauerkraut, drained | 1/4 cup hp steak sauce | 1/4 cup sweet and sour sauce
instructions: Brown sausage and kielbasa in a large skillet over medium high heat.Drain fat and season with sake, mirin and steak sauce if using.Add sliced potatoes, cover and cook on low for 5 minutes.Stir ingredients together and allow the vegetables to warm.Serve hot as a side dish.Serves best when allowed to chill at this point.

Random Ingredients: shrimp,artichoke,orange juice concentrate,peanut,tomato green chilies,marinara sauce
title: Hot Shrimp Cocktail
ingredients: 3 -4 medium shrimp, uncooked | 1 jar marinara sauce | 1 can of diced tomatoes and green chilies ( drained ) | 1 can frozen orange juice concentrate with pulp | shredded peanuts ( optional ) | chopped roasted peanuts for topping ( optional )
instructions: Clean the shrimp well and sprinkle the shrimps inside and out.Spray a large frying pan with non reactive cooking spray, heat pan over medium high heat.Shrimp can be eaten now or after a few minutes or they will be more difficult to handle in later.Place shrimp in pan and cover.When shrimp are well curled and pink, remove shrimp from heat.Toast the peanuts under broiler until golden brown.Drain on paper towel.Place shrimp in a small bowl.Place the rest of the ingredients in the sauce in the bowl and mix well.Pour sauce mixture over shrimp and stir until heated through and coated.Add peanuts, if desired.Serve in nice individual bowls garnished with a sprinkle of sesame seeds and extra chopped peanuts, if desired.Enjoy a nice snack, enjoy.

title: Asian Lettuce Salad
ingredients: 1 head lettuce, rinsed well, dried well | 1/2 cup rice vinegar | 1/2 cup white sugar
instructions: Wash, dry and tear lettuce into pieces.Place them into a bowl of ice cold water.Let sit 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,chive,english mustard,spanish rice mix,cherry tomato,snow pea,white wine vinegar
title: Spanish Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 cup dry spanish rice mix | 1 cup cherry tomatoes, halved | 4 cherry tomatoes, halved | 1 package frozen snow pea, thawed and drained | 8 teaspoons white wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons dry english mustard | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh chives
instructions: Place rice in a large strainer and rinse under cold water until water runs clear.Drain.

Random Ingredients: chicken,lemon zest,italian meatball,garlic paste,prune,lentil,red bell pepper
title: Garlic and Lemon Meatballs
ingredients: 1 lb dried lentils | 1 teaspoon lemon, zest of | 1 teaspoon garlic paste | 1 small red bell pepper, diced | 3/4 lb ground chicken | 2/3 lb frozen uncooked italian-style meatballs | 1/3 cup prune ( dried or prune pieces can be used )
instructions: Place the lentils in a saucepan and cover with water.Add lemon zest, garlic, and red bell pepper.Bring to boil then turn down and simmer, covered, for 1 hour or until meat is cooked.Remove the pan from the heat, cover, and allow to stand for 15 minutes.Add chicken and cooked meatballs, cooking until chicken and meatballs are cooked through.Remove the meatballs from heat and mix with the lentils until combined well.Stir in prune pieces.Cover and refrigerate several hours or overnight before serving.

title: Easy French Onion Toast
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread | 1 -2 tablespoon ginger paste ( depending on how chunky you like it ) | 1 -2 tablespoon guacamole | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Slice onions into thin slivers.I use a food processor if you don't have a processor.Mix everything together and let sit for at least 20 minutes.Heat a large skillet or griddle on high.Sprinkle on the bread and cook until nice and crumbly and golden.Serve with a dollop of sour cream, salsa and guacomole for dipping.

title: Churrasco Eggs
ingredients: 1/2 cup brewed coffee granules | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/2 teaspoon adobo seasoning | 1 dash ground sage leaves | 1 eggplant, sliced 1/4-inch thick
instructions: Crush the eggplant slices with a fork, then layer 1/2 the sausage on each of 4 slices.Sprinkle the remaining sausage on top and dot with cinnamon.Pour in the brewed coffee and adobo, then top with the remaining slices of eggplant.Place skillet on medium low heat, cover and cook for 12 minutes.

title: Chiles Rellenos for Two
ingredients: 20 chilies, re-seeded and cleaned | fresh lettuce
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees.Remove stems of each chile, reserving about 1 teaspoon of the seeds.In a small bowl, combine reserved chili seeds, and about 1 cup water.Place chilies in a microwave safe 9x13 inch baking dish.Bake until softened and browned, about 20 minutes.While still hot, drizzle with half reserved chili seeds and remaining water.Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Creamy Cashew Macaroni and Cheese
ingredients: 1 box uncooked mini macaroni and cheese | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 jar pasta sauce | 1 cup chopped cashews | 1/4 cup ground poppy seed ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/2 cup chopped walnuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.Place macaroni into a large pot.

title: Pistachio Beef Gravy
ingredients: 1/4 cup ghee ( butter or oil combination ) or 1/4 cup olive oil ( butter or oil combination ) | 1/4 cup pistachios, coarsely chopped ( use almonds in a pinch ) | 1 cup beef stock ( or milk ) | 1 tablespoon water chestnut, chopped
instructions: Heat the ghee in a pan and fry the pistachios until they turn light golden brown.Stir and sauté the nuts over medium heat until they're golden brown.Mix the stock through the nuts and serve, sprinkled with extra pistachios if desired.

title: Spiced Rice With Cannellini Beans
ingredients: 1 cup rice | 2 tablespoons cannellini ( reserve the liquid ) | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric | 1/8 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1/4 cup cooked cannellini ( reserve the liquid )
instructions: In a pot of salted boiling water, cook rice until just softened.Meanwhile, in a frying pan, saute the tumeric and the cardamon seed for a couple minutes until fragrant.Add the reserved liquid to the cooked rice, then cook for 5 minutes, or until all of the liquid is absorbed.Place the beans in a serving dish and stir the rice mixture.Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: black pepper,pork rib,beef sirloin steak,kielbasa,liquid smoke,pasta,egg,ziti pasta
title: Kielbasa and Beef Ziti
ingredients: 2 pounds boneless pork ribs, cut into 2-inch pieces | 1 pound kielbasa, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 9 hard-cooked eggs, chopped | 1/4 cup kielbasa-flavored liquid smoke | 5 tablespoons olive oil | 1/2 teaspoon ground black pepper | 2 cans pork and beef pasta with basil flavored seasoning | 1 package ziti pasta
instructions: Place pork and kielbasa in a large skillet over medium heat, and cook.Stir sausage into pork, and cook until pork is no longer pink.

title: Baked Ham Sticks (Potted Ham)
ingredients: 2 lbs ham, in 1-inch cubes | 2 tablespoons peppercorns, cracked in a mortar | 2 -3 lbs cured ham ( british or canadian )
instructions: Bake the ham cubes on a large rack.Place the peppercorns into a spice grinder and grind the peppercorns into fine powder.Rub the ham well with the crumb mixture.Spread the outside of the ham with the peppercorn cured ham sticks.To cook over direct heat, pour a little olive oil over the ham and allow it to stand overnight.Cook the ham slowly until the fat has rendered and the ham is very tender.Serve ham with any type of vegetables or stuffing.

title: Filipino Paa  Paa  (Sponge Candy)
ingredients: 2 1/4 cups thick coconut milk | 2 1/4 teaspoons unflavored gelatin ( gelatin powder )
instructions: Heat coconut milk with unflavored gelatin powder in an iron skillet.Once it has been warming, remove from heat and add gelatin.

Random Ingredients: anise seed,herb,fast rising yeast,coconut milk,banana,hot green chili pepper,horseradish,red food coloring
title: Killer Homemade English Muffins
ingredients: 1/2 cup coconut milk | 1 cup mashed banana | 1/2 teaspoon horseradish | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed | 2 teaspoons dry red food coloring | 1/2 teaspoon hot green chili pepper, minced | 1/2 teaspoon dried mixed herbs | 1/2 teaspoon fast rising yeast, dissolved in | fat, for greasing
instructions: Combine coconut milk and mashed banana.Add horseradish, anise seeds,, food coloring, chilies, sugar, and yeast and mix well.To grease muffins, pour mixture in greased muffin trays and bake at 350°f for 20 - 25 minutes.

title: Barley Pilaf(Rajma)
ingredients: 4 cups pearl barley, washed | 3 1/2 teaspoons salt | 3 1/2 - 4 cups shallots, minced | 2 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh thyme sprigs | 2 dried hot serrano peppers, finely chopped or 4 teaspoons crushed dried jalapeno chiles | 1 pinch saffron strand
instructions: Place barley in a large bowl.Add salt and stir to distribute.Cover and set aside for 30 minutes.In the meantime, heat a skillet, add shallots, then dried chiles and thyme.Saute over medium heat for 3 minutes, stirring constantly.Add saffron strand, cover pan and cook for 5 minutes.Stir in drained barley and cook, stirring frequently, for 3 minutes, until heated through.

title: Lazy Raspberry Jam Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup mayonnaise | 1 cup seedless raspberry jam ( or more if wanted ) | 1 teaspoon white sugar ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients into a blender and process until smooth.

title: Scottish Round Steaks
ingredients: 4 steaks or 6 short rib steaks | 3/4 cup oat, coarsely ground ( i use a blend ) | 1 egg yolk | 1 tablespoon grated oats ( you might have to sprinkle more if you want )
instructions: Preheat oven to 225°c / 425°f / gas mark cut the steaks into four equal portions.Put two tbsp oat in a bowl.Add the remaining teaspoon of oat and the grated oats.Mix well together.Dip each steak with half the oat mixture.Place each steak on a square of greaseproof paper.Spread with the remaining oat mixture.Wrap tightly in the oat mixture.Put the steaks away from the heat.Bake for 15 - 20 minutes, until cooked thoroughly on the desired level of doneness.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile,chick pea,peanut oil,flat rice noodle,stewing beef,brandy,blue cheese
title: Smoked Beef Noodle Soup With Chickpeas
ingredients: 2 tablespoons brandy or 2 tablespoons whisky | 1 teaspoon ground chipotle chile | 3 quarts beef stock or 3 quarts chicken stock | 1 lb stewing beef ( thinly sliced ) | 8 ounces dried flat rice noodles | 1/4 cup brandy or 1/4 cup bourbon | 2 teaspoons peanut oil | 1 container of crumbly blue cheese
instructions: In a large pot, add all the ingredients.Cover and bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer for 2 hours.Stir occasionally to ensure that there won't any sticking.Serve with some crumbled blue cheese and some green salad.

Random Ingredients: part ricotta cheese,enchilada sauce,taco seasoning,unsulphured molasses,chicken meat,chinese mushroom,hot italian sausage,panir
title: Pizza Nachos With Chinese Mushrooms and Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 cup part-skim ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons enchilada sauce, mild or hot | 2 tablespoons unsulphured molasses | 8 ounces fresh chinese mushrooms, cleaned and chopped ( about 30 ) | 1 1/2 lbs cooked chicken meat, shredded ( about 10 ounces ) | 1/2 lb hot italian sausage, sliced ( about 3/4-inch thick ) or 1/2 lb mild italian sausage, sliced ( about 3/4-inch thick ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup part-skim ricotta cheese | 2 teaspoons taco seasoning ( i like lawry's taco seasoning ) | 2/3 cup canned enchilada sauce
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f.Mix the first 3 ingredients together.Spread the mixture evenly in a 3 - 4 quart casserole and top with the mushrooms.

Random Ingredients: red chili,kaffir lime leaf,onion juice,ziti pasta,semolina,pimento olive,onion,corn oil
title: Ziti With Olives, Onions & Chili
ingredients: 2 teaspoons corn oil | 2 large onions, coarsely chopped | 2 teaspoons red chili, finely chopped | 20 1/2 ounces ziti pasta or 20 1/2 ounces penne pasta, uncooked | 2 tablespoons pimento stuffed olives, coarsely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon onion juice | 1/2 teaspoon fresh chili, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh kaffir lime leaf, finely chopped, plus additional for serving ( optional )
instructions: Heat oil over medium heat.Add onions and chilies and sauté until the onions are browned and begin to soften, about 10 minutes.Set aside.In a large pot of boiling, salted water, cook pasta until just tender but still slightly firm to the bite, about 10 minutes.Drain and then return pasta to the large pot.Stir in the olives, onion juice, chili and lime juice.Cook 1 minute longer and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper.Serve topped with additional pimento stuffed olives, if desired.

title: Microwave Blueberry Apricot Rice Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup apricot, chopped | 1/2 cup blueberries, flakeberries | 4 tablespoons plum sauce | 3 tablespoons rice vinegar | 2 pints apricots, halved crosswise and pitted
instructions: Combine apricots, blueberries and plum sauce in microwave safe glass casserole dish.Microwave, uncovered, on high for 2 minutes.Stir to combine.Stir in rice vermicelli or rice of your choice.

Random Ingredients: catsup,white vinegar,meatball,deep frying oil,green bell pepper,phyllo pastry,italian seasoning
title: Meatballs with Phyllo Pastry
ingredients: 7 frozen meatballs | 1 green bell pepper, chopped | 1 package frozen miniature phyllo pastry sheets | 1/2 cup catsup | 1/4 cup italian seasoning | 1/4 cup white vinegar | deep frying oil for frying
instructions: Place frozen meatballs and green pepper in a large pot, then fill with enough water to cover the meatballs by 5 inches.Bring the water to a boil, then reduce heat to medium low and simmer for 20 minutes.Remove from heat and let meatballs sit while preparing the pastry.In a medium bowl, mix together catsup, italian seasoning, and vinegar with a fork until smooth.Cover the bottom of a large, deep skillet with deep oil, approximately 1 inch deep.Heat the oil until hot, and carefully place approximately 20 frozen potato balls into the hot oil.Cook the meatballs in small batches until browned, remove with a slotted spoon, and drain on paper towels.Place the browned meatballs in a baking dish, then cover.Continue layering the pastry sheets to make 4 more deep layers of meatballs and green pepper until you run out of pastry dough.Remove all four layers and cover with another four layers of pastry dough.Sprinkle the top layer of pastry dough with catsup mixture.Continue layering until you have used all four layers.Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f.Place a frozen pie crust on top of the dough, and brush top of dough with some melted butter.Cover the pie crust with a towel and place in the oven.Bake until pastry is puffed and golden brown, around 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: basil pesto,orange juice,ajwain,apple juice,cayenne pepper,mint,parsley,macadamia nut
title: Macadamia Nut & Pesto Appetizer
ingredients: 1 cup unsweetened apple juice | 1 cup orange juice | 1/2 cup mint | 2 tablespoons finely chopped parsley | 1/2 teaspoon dried cayenne pepper | ajwain ( optional ) or salt substitute ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons dried basil pesto ( can use basil & garlic flavors if fresh ) | 2 tablespoons crushed unsalted macadamia nuts ( can use other nuts )
instructions: Put all ingredients in blender and pulse until desired consistency.Use with or without toothpicks or scissors as a dippers for meats.

title: Kheer (Indian Apple-Arrow Meal) With Noodles
ingredients: 8 ounces dried medium egg noodles, washed | 6 medium tart apples | 2 tablespoons arrowroot or 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder
instructions: Peel the apples if using an electric grater, and cut them into thin julienne slices.Toss them with arrowroot or corn starch and add an appropriate amount of water.Bring a large pot of water to a boil.Place the noodles in the boiling pot, and cook them 4 - 5 minutes.Drain the noodles, cut them into bite size strands, and add them to the skillet with the apple slices.Stir.Add 1/4 tsp asafoetida, or to taste, and continue stirring.Dish is served warm or at room temperature.Note, for those looking for more spice, add 1/2 tsp asafoetida.

Random Ingredients: taco sauce,red enchilada sauce,apricot,basil pesto,sage leaf,black eyed pea
title: Ancho-Pesto Black-Eyed Peas
ingredients: 1 can red enchilada sauce | 1 jar apricot-stuffed olives, drained, sliced | 1 jar taco sauce | 1/4 cup basil pesto | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh sage leaves | 3 tablespoons dried sweet basil pesto | 1/2 cup hot taco sauce from a jar
instructions: Mix enchilada sauce, olives, taco sauce, pesto, sage and basil pesto.Spoon into individual dishes on a large platter or to individual plates.Top with taco sauce.

title: Chinese Restaurant Sweet Sesame Oil
ingredients: 1 teaspoon oriental sesame oil | white sugar, to taste
instructions: Heat a small saucepan over medium high heat.Stir in the sesame oil.Once the sesame oil is warm, add sugar, as soon as the sugar starts forming a golden brown syrup, to sweeten.

title: Irish Cream (Lauki)
ingredients: ice | 1 1/2 fluid ounces irish cream
instructions: Fill a tall glass with ice.Pour irish cream over ice.Stir.

title: Kadai Charata

instructions: Wash artichokes and cut into small pieces.Dice the serrano and the ginger garlic.

title: American White Bean Dip
ingredients: dairy free crema : | 6 tablespoons reduced-fat sour cream | 3 tablespoons dried anise-flavored capers | 1 large can great northern beans, rinsed and drained | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 large red bell pepper, minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.In a small bowl whisk together sour cream and anise flavored capers, and spread on a foil lined baking sheet.Sprinkle with cayenne pepper.Roast in preheated oven, stirring after 20 minutes, until lightly toasted and lightly browned.Meanwhile, drain beans thoroughly and transfer to a medium bowl.Stir in roasted buttermilk, red bell pepper, and 1 tablespoon of cream cheese herb flavor enhancer.Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes.Makes 4 servings.

instructions: Rinse and drain cranberries.

title: Lori's Chunky Squashing Corn on Home
ingredients: 6 tablespoons fresh basil leaves, chopped | 1 kg swede, peeled and chopped | 1 small red onion, finely chopped | 1 cup white wine vinegar | 240 g mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste | 1 cup finely grated mexican cheese blend or 1 cup monterey jack cheese | 20 g graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl.Mix thoroughly with hands and form into small balls the size of a tennis ball.Serve on its own or with garlic butter, crackers or as an accompaniment to salads.

title: Curried Ricotta Pizza
ingredients: 2 tablespoons strong coffee | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves | 1 package reduced-fat ricotta | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried herbs | 1 teaspoon seasoning | 1 1/2 cups grated white cheddar cheese | 1 prepared pizza crust ( i use dreamfield's light crust )
instructions: Stir together coffee, curry powder, crushed cloves, and spices in a non metallic bowl or measuring cup.Set aside.In a small bowl, stir together ricotta and herbs.Preheat oven at 550°f.Spread the ricotta mixture over dough and sprinkle on the cheese.Bake in preheated oven for 15 minutes or until dough is lightly browned and cheese is melted.Cut into slices for serving.

title: Beef & Strawberry Skillet
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 vidalia onion, chopped | 3/4 cup chunk frozen strawberries | 1/2 cup chunky salsa | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 tablespoon diced pecans or 1 tablespoon pine nuts
instructions: Add meat, onion, and remaining ingredients to skillet.Cover and heat until meat is hot, stirring occasionally.

title: Rice with Grape Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 cup long grain rice | 1 cup grape tomatoes or 1 cup cherry tomatoes, halved | 8 tablespoons fresh basil leaves, torn | 8 tablespoons pine nuts, toasted
instructions: Spray a large skillet with nonstick spray.

title: Sicilian Olive Oil
ingredients: 24 large black ripe olives | 6 -8 fresh basil leaves, trimmed
instructions: Slice all the olives lengthwise.Place in a large bowl and pour the olive oil over it.Toss well and refrigerate.Leave to mature for at least 3 weeks.

Random Ingredients: spice,tequila,onion soup mix,graham cracker,taco seasoning mix,southwest seasoning
title: Smooth Enchilada Mix
ingredients: 1 medium onion, chopped | 2 cups crushed graham crackers | 1 envelope onion soup mix | 1 envelope taco seasoning mix | 1 cup tequila | 1 tablespoon southwest seasoning
instructions: In small bowl, combine crushed graham crackers, onion soup mix, taco seasoning mix, tequila, southwest seasoning and mix until well blended.On medium heat in a pan, add 3/4 cup of water.Place skillet and allow to simmer for 5 minutes.Once water is boiling, pour chili mixture over graham cracker/onion mixture.Enjoy.

title: Gramma's Turnip
ingredients: 2 lbs turnips | 1 pint whipping cream
instructions:
Peel turnips well.Place in a large kettle with enough water to barely cover or in to about 2 - 3 cups boiling, then cook until soft.
    -.Test for doneness by dropping a spoonful into a boiling glass of cold water and pressing hard with your finger.They will take about 1 to 3 minutes for them to turn tender but firm and tender.Drain well.When completely cool whip the cream.When almost ready to serve top with the turnip and serve with grated cheese.

title: Pine Nut Baked Chicken
ingredients: 4 lbs chicken thighs | 3 bay leaves | 5 ounces pine nuts, broken
instructions: Cut the chicken thighs at joints and discard the bone.Remove the skin and extra fat if necessary.Place in a pan over medium heat and add the bay leaves.Cover and cook for 1 hour.Remove the bay leaves and cook uncovered for a further hour.Remove the chicken from the pan and cut along the bone into strips about 3 in diameter.Heat the oil in a frying pan and fry the chicken pieces, a few pieces at a time, until dark brown, crispy and cooked through.This should take about 10 - 15 minutes.Serve with rice or other dish.

Random Ingredients: navel orange,gumbo file powder,sun tomato oil,basil leaf
title: Gumbo Florina
ingredients: 2 1/4 lbs gumbo file powder ( in the tube form ) | 3 -4 tablespoons sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained | 6 1/2 - 7 cups fresh basil leaves, packed ( about 12 large fistfuls, about 2 1/2-inch long ) | 1 navel orange, peeled and cut in half
instructions:
Preheat oven to 400 degrees.In a large resealable plastic bag, place the gumbo file powder, sun dried tomatoes and 1 1/4 cups water.Toss to mix well.Place in a large rimmed baking sheet.Transfer to the oven and immediately reduce the temperature to 300 degrees.Keep the oven door open for 1 hour and 15 minutes, or until the grouper is golden and the fish flakes easily with a fork.Meanwhile snip most of the basil leaves into a bowl and set them aside.Squeeze the juice from the orange into the bowl with the basil and set them aside.Discard any excess juice with your hands.Drain the fish but reserve the oil.Remove the fillet from the bag and pat dry with paper towels on paper towels.Arrange the fillet in a single layer on top of the basil leaves.Arrange the reserved basil on top the fish, pressing down to compact it slightly.Return the reserved oil over the entire fish.Slide the orange halves cut side down onto the fillet and bring the top of the fish down in the center.Turn over the fish over using the orange cut as a tripod to create a tripod.Return the fish to the oven and bake until the fish flakes easily with a fork, 50 to 75 minutes.
    -.Remove the fish from the oven and let it stand 10 minutes before carving.

Random Ingredients: cream celery soup,plain flour,pecorino romano cheese,pinto bean,orange,fennel seed

ingredients: 2 cans pinto beans, drained | 1 can cream of celery soup | 1 bottle roasted romano cheese | 1 red onion | 1/2 cup plain flour | 2 tablespoons fennel seeds
instructions: Put the beans, soup, cheese, onion, flour and fennel seeds in a medium size pan.Simmer gently for 15 minutes.Puree with a hand blender or by hand.Serve in large bowl, decorate with finely chopped coriander.

title: Foil Bag Polish Grilled Chicken
ingredients: 1 chicken leg ( wing tips removed ) | 2 tablespoons virgin oil | 1/4 cup soya sauce | 1/4 cup beer ( such as negra modelo can also be used ) | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 tablespoon liquid honey | 1/2 teaspoon dried dill weed | 1 tablespoon olive oil, divided
instructions: In a mixing bowl, marinate chicken with all ingredients for approximately 30 minutes.Place in refrigerator and cook for approximately 2 hours or overnight.Remove chicken from refrigerator.

title: Chili Shrimp
ingredients: 1 pound fresh shrimp, peeled and deveined | 7 tablespoons sweet chili paste, or more to taste
instructions: Place the shrimp in a skillet and pour in enough water to cover.Bring to a boil, and cook until cooked through, about 3 minutes.Remove from heat and stir in the sweet chili paste.Cool, and serve.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower floret,mascarpone cheese,cream celery soup,coleslaw mix cabbage carrot
title: Creamy Cauliflower Coleslaw
ingredients: 1/2 lb coleslaw mix ( shredded cabbage and carrots ) | 5 ounces mascarpone cheese | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 2 tablespoons sour cream or 2 tablespoons mayonnaise, to taste
instructions: In a large bowl mix together coleslaw mix, mascarpone cheese, and soup.Cover and chill overnight.Stir before serving with sour cream and additional dressing if desired.

title: Pasta With an Aztec Chili
ingredients: 1/3 lb penne | 1 can rotel | 5 ounces tomato paste | 1/2 ounce anaheim chili
instructions: In a large pot heat up some olive oil on medium.Add a splash of salt, chili and a can of rotel.Turn heat to low and let everything simmer while making your sauce.For the sauce just sautee chili in olive oil.Add tomato paste, mix well and let simmer for about 5 minutes.Cook pasta and add sauce to pasta and toss together.Serve with grated cheese, sour cream, and parmasan cheese.

title: Crock Pot Chinese Noodle Casserole

Prepare noodles according to package directions.Spread noodles in a 13 x 9 inch baking dish.
    -.Sprinkle mexican cheese on top.Bake at 375 degrees for 10 minutes.Serve.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,provolone cheese,cooking onion,shiitake mushroom cap,lime jell o gelatin,apple
title: Mushroom Salad With Avgolemono
ingredients: 3 cups sliced shiitake mushroom caps, cleaned, washed and stemmed | 1/3 cup quick-cooking onions, finely chopped | 1/3 cup sliced fresh apple, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh lime jell-o gelatin | 1/3 cup finely grated fresh provolone cheese | 1/3 cup maraschino cherries, chopped
instructions: Cook onion in 3 tablespoons water on medium high heat and cook just until tender, not brown.Add mushrooms and cook until liquid evaporates.Add apple, jello and 1/3 cup water and stir until completely mixed.Toss with celery.Sprinkle top of salad with cheese.

title: Luscious Ricotta Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup low-fat ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup grated pecorino romano cheese | 1 teaspoon fresh parsley ( or 2 tablespoons dried parsley flakes )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.In a medium bowl, combine ricotta cheese, grated cheese, chopped parsley flakes and dry sherry.Mix well.Heat in saucepot until bubbly.

title: Auntie's Candy
ingredients: 1 cup treacle or ¼ cup molasses | 4 lbs corn oil
instructions: Place treacle or molasses in a fine sieve or food mill.Sift with a metal spoon, and set aside in clear luke warm place until completely cooled and then throughly ground for a minute or two.In a 5 lb lamington container, place ¼ lb of ground treacle/molasses, and cover with an extra layer of ground treacle/molasses or molasses mix.When all the treacle/molasses is incorporated pour in more treacle/molasses as needed to cover the base.Refrigerate for up to 2 - 3 weeks to set.Once set, remove from container and store in a cool place for 20 days.Using the special mixture trick, it is easy to get every grain of nuts onto a greased, floured cookie sheet, and spread them out with a roller before popping them in the freezer so they become firm and smooth.This keeps well for several months in the pantry or at the dry setting.

Random Ingredients: half,beet,chocolate pudding mix,amaretto liqueur,double cream,peanut butter,ketchup
title: Amaretto Spiced Beet Dip
ingredients: 3 medium ripe beets | 1 ounce dry chocolate pudding mix, such as jello in syrup | 2 tablespoons amaretto liqueur or 2 tablespoons light rum | 1/2 cup double cream or 1/2 cup half-and-half | 1/4 cup peanut butter | 1 -2 tablespoon ketchup
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f.Cut the tops off the beets and scrub to remove all the dirt, and wash well.Slice the beets crosswise into thin wedges, about 1/4 inch thick.Spray a jelly roll baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray and set aside.Place the chocolate pudding mix, amaretto, cream or half and half and peanut butter in a food processor and pulse until well blended.Stir in the ketchup and blend until smooth.Spoon into a non reactive bowl.Place the beets in a single layer in the prepared baking dish, and sprinkle with a bit of the peanut butter.Bake the beets for 20 - 25 minutes or until tender.Serve with whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Tortilla Rice With Mashed Potatoes and Chipped Beef
ingredients: 1 lb minced meat | 2 medium turnips, sliced thin | grated cheese
instructions: Put half the chopped meat into a sauce pan.Layer the diced turnips and remaining meat.Cover with a layer of grated cheese.Pour a layer of cheese.Repeat step top with cheese.Put the dish in the microwave and microwave for 5 minutes until the cheese is melted and the dish is hot through.

title: Hot Chinese Rum Marinade for Pork or Beef
ingredients: 1 cup dark rum | 1 chili pepper, finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon ground savory or 1/2 teaspoon savory | 2 teaspoons sesame oil
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a saucepan and bring to boil.Simmer over low heat until the marinade thickens.Pour into meat, poultry or meat of choice and let sit for at least 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,apricot jam,orange liqueur,graham cracker crumb
title: Papa's Famous Apricot Fudge
ingredients: 2 cups of crushed graham cracker crumbs | 1 jar apricot jam | 3/4 cup orange liqueur | 2 serrano peppers
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly with a hand mixer.Pour in a 9x13 pan.Refrigerate, it will keep for months.

title: Cheese and Lemon Appetizer Appetizer
ingredients: 1/2 cup swiss cheese, grated | 1 lemon
instructions: Place cheese in your food processor with the lemon juice and process briefly.With the machine running, add swiss cheese in thin, steady lines and/or in thin slanted slanted lines until mixture reaches desired texture.Serve and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,taco shell,escarole,white wine,maple syrup,vegetable oil cooking spray,egg white,kielbasa sausage
title: Quick and Easy Caribbean Omelette
ingredients: 1 lb omelette ( i like the italian omelette-omelet type ) or 1 lb sirloin ( i like the italian omelette-omelette type ) | 1 large egg white ( or 2 large egg whites ) | 1 tablespoon maple syrup | canola oil cooking spray | 4 ounces low fat kielbasa sausage ( about 1 cup ) or 4 ounces sweet italian sausage, cut into 1/2-inch slices ( about 1 cup ) | 3/4 cup low-fat coconut milk | 3/4 cup chicken broth or 3/4 cup reduced-sodium chicken broth | 1/2 cup dry white wine or 1/2 cup dry vermouth | 1 -2 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro, if desired ( optional )
instructions: Brush pan or griddle with oil spray and heat over medium high until hot but not smoking.Meanwhile, cut omelette into 1/2 inch pieces.Place egg whites in bowl, and beat with mixer on high for 30 seconds, or until stiff peaks form.Add maple syrup slowly, beating constantly.Place 1 tablespoon in center of each omelette piece.Fold in sausage, then egg whites.Spread half of coconut milk on pan/griddle.Place 1/4 of the omelette pieces in pan or griddle with omelette, then the other half of coconut milk.If desired, sprinkle with cheese.Cover, and cook for 5 minutes on one side.Cut into four wedges and serve.

title: Tortas Di Pasqualini
ingredients: 2 cups fresh ricotta cheese | mint leaves
instructions: Place the ricotta in a large bowl and pour in the mint leaves.Work the mixture with your hands to break pieces of the ricotta down while working the mixture and knead the whole time, working the mixture and making sure the ricotta stays in the corners.Cover the bowl with a towel and refrigerate for 6 hours, or overnight.Working with about 15 at a time, break off small chunks of the ricotta and spread them flat in the tortillas.Roll them onto a flat griddle or a hot frying pan.Cook over medium low heat, turning and stirring with a metal spatula until cheese is bubbly, 2 to 3 minutes.Transfer to a platter and garnish with mint.

title: Taco Mix Snack Cookies
ingredients: 1 package taco seasoning mix | 2 cups panko breadcrumbs | 1 carton sour cream or ( 12 ounce ) carton plain yogurt
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.In a mixing bowl, combine taco seasoning mix and panko breadcrumbs.Stir in sour cream or yogurt in a circular motion until mixture resembles small bread crumbs.Roll 2 1/2 tablespoons of mixture into balls.Place on a cookie sheet lined with foil and bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: water,garlic clove,date,romaine lettuce leaf,chicken broth,rye bread pumpernickel
title: Mixed-Up Stuffed Rave "froganos"
ingredients: 2 slices rye bread or 2 slices pumpernickel bread | 1 cup low sodium chicken broth | 1 garlic clove, chopped | 1/2 tablespoon water | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped sun-dried dates ( optional ) | 1 romaine lettuce leaf
instructions: Toast bread.Drain fat and slice thinly.Cut off 1 1/2 inch thick end of bread and discard.Cut bread into 1/2 inch cubes.Set aside bread to form a pocket in shell.Add chicken broth, garlic, and water to bread and discard bread's soaking liquid.Spoon 1 tablespoon of mixture into bread pocket, top with desired amount of sun dried tomatoes, romaine leaves, and remaining stuffing.Secure bread closed with foil,.Heat broiler.Place each rack on a cookie sheet and broil 8 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: yellow onion,coffee,lemon juice zest,paprika,pork meat,canadian bacon,green pepper
title: Cafe Rio Cuban Pork Burger
ingredients: 1 lb cubed lean pork meat | 1 bottle strong coffee | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1/2 yellow onion, julienned | 3 slices canadian bacon, roughly chopped | 1 green pepper, seeded and julienned | 1 tablespoon ground paprika
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl and chill in the refrigerator overnight.When ready to serve, preheat an outdoor grill or a roasting pan of the meat.Remove meat from refrigerator, reserving marinade.Place meat on the grill over medium heat.Grill for 5 minutes, turning frequently, or until nicely browned, but not burnt.Serve with salsa and guacamole.

Random Ingredients: velveeta cheese,virgin olive oil,thyme sprig,green pepper
title: Texas Sour Cream Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1/4 cup finely chopped green pepper | 2 tablespoons finely chopped flat-leaf velveeta cheese | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme sprigs | 1/4 teaspoon virgin olive oil
instructions: Place the pepper, cheese, thyme, and olive oil in a medium bowl.Stir until well blended.

Random Ingredients: yogurt,tortilla chip,shell pasta,hot water,dark brown sugar,romaine lettuce
