title: Pasta Salad Imitation
ingredients: 1 lb shell pasta, cooked al dente | boiling hot water | 1/2 cup low-fat yogurt | 1/3 cup dark brown sugar, packed | 1 bunch romaine lettuce, torn into bite-size pieces | 1 jar tortilla chips, broken into small pieces
instructions: Put the pasta and a few cups of hot water in a bowl.Mix until they are well combined, and set aside.Mix the yogurt, brown sugar, and torn romaine until well blended.Add the chopped lettuce and mix well.Stir in the tortilla chips.Toss with the pasta until the dressing coats and coats.Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,american cheese,bread crumb,beef sirloin steak,cream tartar,graham cracker crumb,pecorino romano cheese
title: Philly Cheesesteak
ingredients: 2 pounds boneless beef top sirloin steaks, cut into 1 inch wide strips | 1 1/2 cups grated american cheese | 1 1/2 cups chopped pecorino romano cheese | 1 can green chilies, chopped, drained | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/4 cup italian-seasoned bread crumbs | 1 package graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Pound beef steak strips to 1/3 inch thickness.Combine the american cheese, pecorino romano cheese, green chilies, cream of tartar, and bread crumbs in a large resealable plastic bag.Add the beef to the cheese mixture.Mix well and coat the beef with the mixture.Roll the beef mixture in the graham cracker crumbs, coating all sides.Arrange coated strips on a sheet of reynold's wrap nonstick cooking spray or a wire rack.Refrigerate covered for at least 6 hours or overnight.Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.Bake beef in preheated oven until thoroughly cooked and no longer pink inside, 1 to 1 1/4 hours for the first 1/2 pound strips, 35 to 45 minutes for the second pound strips.Transfer meat to a platter and slice.To serve, arrange strips on a platter and serve with sauce.

title: Sooji Bhatia (Biscuit Soup)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups corn kernels ( about 40 ) | 1/2 cup pine nuts ( or almonds, hazelnuts or cashews or hazelnuts ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried orange peel | 8 ounces soy milk ( low fat is okay ) | 2 tablespoons light cream ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon chili oil | 2 teaspoons rice or 2 teaspoons jasmine rice | 1 teaspoon ghee ( optional )
instructions: Put all the ingredients except ghee into a pan and bring to the boil over medium heat.When it reaches 182°f, drain the water and allow to cool to room temperature.When chilled, stir a bit of the mixture with a fork or a whisk to break apart any lumps.Stir in the ghee, or melt butter if using it.Serve in large bowls with plenty of plain yogurt for a fuller flavour.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,picante sauce,navel orange,albacore tuna,red capsicum,lime wedge,poblano pepper
title: Smooth & Spicy Tuna Salad
ingredients: 400 g albacore tuna, drained rinsed in a bowl of cold water, chilled and cut into 4 pieces | 2 poblano peppers, deseeded, deseeded and cut into 4 pieces | 1 yellow capsicum, deseeded, deseeded and cut into 4 pieces | 8 tablespoons coconut milk | 150 -150 ml picante sauce | 1 navel orange, peeled and finely chopped | lime wedge ( to garnish )
instructions: Mix together in a large bowl the tuna, peppers, poblanos, capsicums, coconut milk, picante and orange rind and season with the salt and pepper and mix well.Gently stir in the chopped orange peel and then serve garnished with the lime wedges.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,cardamom,beef stew meat,italian sausage,tilapia fillet,bay leaf
title: Sausage-And-Meat Tinga
ingredients: 12 beef stew meat, cut into 1 inch chunks | 1 lb sweet italian sausage, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 1/2 lbs tilapia fillets, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 tablespoon cardamom | 1 bay leaf | 1 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Brown and drain italian sausage pieces.Brown and drain tilapia.Combine the italian sausages with the sausage and meat in a large pot.Add the spices and cream.Cover and simmer over low heat for 30 minutes.You can also cook it in the crockpot over medium heat.We sometimes add it to the crockpot on low or low and simmer for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.Stir and simmer for about 15 more minutes to thicken a bit.

Random Ingredients: mint sprig,tabasco sauce,pickle juice,rice flour,chocolate,chickpea flour
title: Chickpea-Flavored Chokos
ingredients: 2 cups rice flour | 3/4 cup sweet pickle juice | 10 -15 fresh mint sprigs | 3 drops tabasco sauce | 2 -3 tablespoons chickpea flour | 1 ounce bittersweet chocolate, chopped fine
instructions: Place rice flour, sweet pickle juice, mint, and tabasco in a processor.Cover and process until smooth.Add chickpea flour and process again until mixture becomes thick and pulls away from sides of food processor, 1 - 2 minutes.Scrape onto lightly floured board and knead briefly.Cover with plastic wrap and cool.To serve, form about 30 small chokos and place on metal tray in a single layer.Pour about 2/3 cup of hot water into a small bowl and set aside.Place chocolate in microwave and melt over high heat, stirring constantly, until chocolate is smooth and heated through, but still liquid.Spread chocolate mixture on chokos and grill over medium high heat, pressing gently until chocolate is melted and slightly dark brown.Remove from grill and dip chokos briefly into melted chocolate then return to baking sheet, seam side down.Cool until hardened and hard, at least an hour, stirring every 10 - 15 minutes.Serve at room temperature with extra chocolate drizzled on top.

Random Ingredients: tomato basil pasta sauce,pecan half,fast rising yeast,cocoa,golden raisin,duck breast,beef roast
title: Quick Italian Loaf
ingredients: 4 1/2 cups shredded beef roast | 1 cup diced cooked duck breast | 12 ounces tomato and basil pasta sauce | 1/2 cup golden raisin or 1/2 cup chopped seedless raisin | 1 envelope fast rising yeast | 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa, for coating | 2 1/4 cups pecan halves
instructions: In a large bowl mix the beef roast, duck, tomato basil pasta sauce and raisins.Set aside ½ cup of the mixture.In a small bowl, dissolve yeast in water.Let stand about 5 minutes, then stir in the cocoa.Let rest about 5 minutes.In a greased 9x5 loaf pan spread the mixture.Top with the remaining roast mixture.Sprinkle the pecan halves over the top.Cover with a towel and let rise in a warm place until doubled, about 45 minutes.Bake in a 350 oven for 65 to 75 minutes.Remove from pan and cool on wire rack.Remove foil, cool completely, then slice and enjoy.

title: Kabab
ingredients: 400 g dried kidney beans | 400 g shiso leaves, washed and picked through to remove the dirt | 1 slice fresh galangal, shredded | 1 piece fresh orange peel, finely chopped | 2 radishes, shredded | 50 g whole wheat flour | 1 slice bacon ( optional ) | 1 pinch kosher pickled radish ( optional )
instructions: Soak the beans in water overnight to expedite the cooking.The next day, drain out excess water, then put the soaked beans in a large saucepan over medium to high heat.Cover with water, bring to the boil and reduce to a simmer.Simmer until the beans are tender and the water has reduced considerably, 10 - 15 minutes.Drain and set aside.Place the shiso leaf in a mortar and pound lightly with the blade of a knife.Add the galangal, orange peel, radishes and flour to the beans and gently stir until all the flour is mixed in evenly.Simmer gently until the flour and shiso have absorbed the water about 5 minutes.Remove from heat, discard the zest and add the bacon.Serve garnished with radish slices.

title: Lemon-Parmesan Dressing
ingredients: 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1 teaspoon grated lemon rind
instructions: Combine all ingredients well.

Random Ingredients: black bean,stewing beef,lemon juice,ear corn,plum tomato,peach,lime
title: Beef and Black Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 package stewing beef, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1/2 cup lemon juice | 1/2 cup fresh lime juice | 1 can black beans, undrained | 1 cup frozen ear corn, thawed | 1/2 cup canned peach slices, drained | 1 plum tomato, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Place meat and 1/2 cup lemon juice in a large pot.Sprinkle with 1/2 cup lime juice.Bring to a boil.Reduce heat.

Random Ingredients: american cheese,cake flour,broccoli,salad dressing,yellow onion,romaine lettuce
title: Mexican Onion, Broccoli and Cheese Loaf
ingredients: 1 bag of shredded romaine lettuce | 1 bag frozen chopped broccoli | 3 cups bread flour | 1 yellow onion, sliced ( about 2 cups ) | 1/4 cup salad dressing | 1 1/2 cups shredded low-fat american cheese ( about 8 oz )
instructions: Place oven rack in middle of oven and preheat oven to 325°f.In bowl, stir 1 cup of the bread flour with 1/2 cup water until mixture resembles course meal.Add remaining flour mixture, stirring until combined, until mixture forms a ball shape.Shape dough into a rough rectangle about 1 1/2 inches thick.Cut rectangle into 2 inch strips, about 1 inch wide.Repeat with remaining strips.Place dough into a greased 13x9 inch glass baking dish, spreading to edges with a spatula.Arrange 1 slice of onion atop dough.Spread 1 1/2 tablespoons salad dressing over onion and sprinkle with 2 cups of cheese.Top with 1 minute longer.Bake uncovered about 30 minutes or until the top is golden brown and the loaf sounds hollow when nudged.Serve immediately.

title: Smooth Pork Chops
ingredients: 2 pork chops ( about 2/3 pound total ) | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 1 carton plain pork fat ( such as crisco ) | 1 tablespoon chopped shallot | 1 teaspoon baking cocoa
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.Line shallow baking pan with foil.Coat the inside of the pan with cooking spray.Place pork chops in pan.

Random Ingredients: bouquet garni,pickling spice,taco seasoning mix,feta cheese,dill,mini marshmallow
title: Easy Feta Cheese Taco Fondue (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 2 ounces feta cheese | 6 tablespoons pickling spices, divided, to taste | 4 tablespoons dried dill, divided | 3 tablespoons taco seasoning mix | 1 bouquet garni, tied with string | 1 package mini marshmallows
instructions: Crumble 1 ounce feta into a bowl.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,bay seasoning,salt,garam masala powder
title: Yule Log
ingredients: 2 cups self-raising flour | 1 cup garam masala powder | 1 tablespoon salt ( i use salt ) | 1 teaspoon old bay seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c line 2 baking sheets with baking paper.Set aside.Sift flour, salt and garam masala powder into a large bowl.Make well in the middle.Mix to a soft dough, adding water 1 tablespoon at a time if dough seems too dry.Knead dough briefly.Form into a large log.Flatten to 1/4 inch thickness and cut into 4 - 5 inch slices.Place slices on baking tray in a single layer.Brush each slice lightly with water.Cook in preheated oven for 12 - 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Cheesy Cheddar
ingredients: 1 cup cottage cheese | 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f.Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish.Mix cottage cheese and cheddar cheese together in a bowl until thoroughly combined.Spread cheese mixture in the prepared baking dish.Bake in the preheated oven until bubbly and lightly browned, 20 to 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,phyllo pastry,corn kernel,self raising flour,frisee
title: Sweet Corn Fritters
ingredients: 12 sheets phyllo pastry, thick | 3 cups frozen corn kernels, thawed, drained | 1 1/2 cups grated frisee ( can sub aniseed ) | 3/4 cup dark brown sugar ( can sub turbinado or sultanas ) | 1/2 cup self-raising flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 200f / 190c / gas mark put 2 sheets of the phyllo pastry onto a lightly floured surface.Bake for 8 minutes, then turn and bake for a further 7 - 8 minutes, or until golden brown.Meanwhile, make the sauce, in a large bowl, mix together the corn kernels, frisee, brown sugar, and flour.Set aside.When cool, cut each sheet in half diagonally.Spoon about ¼ cup of the corn mixture onto each half, then roll up.Serve warm.

title: Garlic-fenugreek Leaves
ingredients: 2 heads garlic
instructions:
Remove the heads and lower cloves of garlic.Rinse and dry the garlic cloves by placing them in a plastic bag or bowl of cold water.Cover and refrigerate overnight.The next day, remove the garlic cloves from the bag and place it on a cutting board.Using the blade of a knife, cut the cloves lengthwise into very thin slices.Reserve the garlic cloves for another use.Place the garlic and remaining garlic cloves in a stainless steel bowl covered by several inches of room temperature water for 1 hour.
    -.Reserved garlic water, gently squeeze excess liquid from the garlic cloves and place garlic head on cutting board with cut side of knife blade running through garlic heads.Using a knife again, scrape off garlic head and discard.Finely chop garlic and combine with reserved garlic water in a large heavy pot or dutch oven.Let sit, covered for at least 1 hour.Serve.

Random Ingredients: egg wrap,aniseed,ginger garlic paste,corn oil,beef bouillon cube,cilantro
title: Egg Rolls II
ingredients: 20 egg roll wraps | 1/3 cup corn oil | 1 tablespoon minced fresh ginger-garlic paste | 4 beef bouillon cubes | 1 tablespoon aniseed, powdered | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro
instructions: In a frying pan, heat corn oil.Brown ginger garlic paste.Dissolve bouillon in 1 t.Pour over ginger garlic paste.Dip egg roll wraps into hot oil.Turn, and fry until golden brown, about 3 minutes, turning to cook evenly.Repeat with remaining wrap and oil, adding oil as needed.

title: Linda's Prawns and Chips
ingredients: 1 teaspoon cornstarch | 1/2 cup breadcrumbs | 8 tiger shrimp, shell on | 2 tablespoons prepared pesto sauce
instructions: Mix cornstarch with bread crumb until crumbs are evenly distributed, and press crumbs onto the shrimp.Bake shrimp at 400 degrees until browned, 20 - 25 minutes, turning once.Cut into chips.Serve as appetizers.

title: Waldorf Style Swiss Chard
ingredients: 10 baby swiss chard | 1/2 lb fresh mushrooms | 1/4 cup toasted almond extract ( optional ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons mustard ( i prefer dry mustard ) | 2 dashes tabasco sauce or 4 dashes any other hot pepper sauce | 1 white onion ( optional ) or 1 green onion, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Wash and trim chard.Cut off tips and stem ends.Do not cut any part that is tough enough or you will lose the stems of the chard.Rinse and dry chard well.When ready to cook, preheat the oven to 350 degrees.Place chard stems in a roasting pan lined with foil.Place in oven, do not open.For about 15 minutes.If using, remove stem and leaves, wash and dry, removing sand sacs.Place mushrooms in a separate baking pan lined with foil, or in the pan with the chard stems and stems, leaving mushrooms in chunks of about 2 inches across.If using a tomato sauce, put them in a blender or food processor with a little of the olive oil and salt and place it in the saucepan with the rest of the ingredients and blend together to make a paste.Add salt to taste before pouring mixture over greens.Stir well before serving.

title: Cape Wings
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups raw potatoes, peeled and shredded | 2 1/2 cups quick-rising dry yeast | 1/4 cup dark rum | 2 1/2 cups cooking oil | 1/2 cup horseradish | 2 teaspoons cooking oil
instructions: Place shredded potatoes in a bowl and sprinkle with salt until the potatoes are thoroughly coated with salt and water and set aside.In a large bowl, stir together the yeast and 1/4 cup rum and set aside until the yeast starts to act, about 5 minutes.Whisk in 2 cups of the oil and set aside.In a separate bowl, stir together the remaining 1/4 cup rum, the horseradish, 2 tsp of the cooking oil and 1 1/2 cups of the potato mixture.Add the yeast and oil mixture to the bowl with the potato mixture and combine thoroughly.Knead the dough on a lightly floured board until the dough is smooth and elastic.Cut and shape the dough into 3 long cylinders about 8 inches long and 3 inches wide.Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover and set aside at room temperature for 1 hour until doubled in size.Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f.Place a large baking sheet on a flat working surface.Roll the dough out into a cylinder about 1/8 thick.Using the 2 - 3 tbls.Reserve, place 1/2 cup of the potato mixture on the dough and spread evenly.Cut the cylinder into 4 equal pieces and place 2 inches apart on the baking sheet.Roll them up and repeat with the remaining dough.

title: Shepherd's Pie
ingredients: 1 package frozen peas | 1 package frozen corn kernels | 1 package cream cheese, softened | 1 tablespoon fresh tarragon, chopped | 2 cups frozen whipped topping, thawed ( may use fresh, if desired )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.Mix all ingredients in a pie dish.Cover and bake for 45 minutes, or until heated through.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,grand marnier,salmon fillet,parmigiano reggiano cheese,vegetable oil cooking spray,parsley leaf,fajita seasoning mix
title: Baked Salmon With Fajita Seasoning
ingredients: 2 salmon fillets, 5 inches thick | vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 teaspoons fajita seasoning mix ( mccormicks montreal brand ) | 1 teaspoon dark soy sauce | 1 teaspoon grated fresh parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 teaspoon grand marnier
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.Place salmon in a large, heavy duty zip top plastic bag.Combine fajita seasoning mix and dark soy sauce in a small bowl, and add the cheese.Reserve 1 pkg.Shake bag until seasoning is evenly coated.Reserve remaining fajita seasoning mix.Place salmon in a large oven proof baking dish, and spray with vegetable oil cooking spray.Cover, and bake 30 to 40 minutes.Remove from oven.Pour reserved fajita seasoning into a blender, and mix until smooth.Divide salmon among four serving plates, and top with 1/4 of the fajita base mixture.

title: Rich Coconut Smoothie
ingredients: 1 cup light coconut, drained | 1 teaspoon baking chocolate | 1 tablespoon chocolate-flavored yogurt | 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 1 small fruit, sliced
instructions: Place coconut, baking chocolate, yogurt, and maple syrup in a blender.Blend until smooth.Pour into glasses and add sliced fruit.Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,coca cola,apple cider,green chile,cinnamon,flour tortilla,epazote,tortilla chip
title: Green Tea Apple Taco Filling
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese, softened | 1/4 cup apple cider | 1/2 cup flour tortilla chips | 1 tablespoon taco eepazote, dried | 2 cups coca cola, beverage | 1/4 cup canned diced green chiles | 1 dash cinnamon, for topping | 1/4 cup sour cream ( optional )
instructions: Mix cream cheese, cider, flour tortilla chips, epazote and cola.Fill tortillas with beverage mixture.Sprinkle with chiles and cinnamon, if desired.

title: Ww Core
ingredients: 2 cups low-fat soy milk | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/3 cup karo syrup | 2 cups chopped kale | 1 can crushed pineapple in juice, undrained
instructions: Combine soy milk, cream of tartar, karo syrup, and kale in a medium saucepan.Bring to a boil.Reduce heat to medium.Cook until mixture thickens, and karo syrup is dissolved.Pour into a large bowl, and mix in pineapple.Cool completely, and break apart.Store in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,tamari,anchovy oil,beef,bean,romaine lettuce
title: Tamari and Spicy Beef Salpicao Salad
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground beef | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1/4 cup tamari ( dark soy sauce ) | 1/4 cup anchovy oil | 2 romaine lettuce, leaves | 8 ounces refried beans
instructions: Brown ground beef until the meat is no longer pink.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,celery rib,chicken broth,veal,red chile pepper,mace,queso fresco,black bean
title: Albarina's Calabacitas (Chile Cheese Ball)
ingredients: 12 ounces queso fresco, crumbled | 8 ounces ground veal | 1/2 cup celery rib, chopped | 1/2 pound ground pork | 1/2 pound ground roasted red chile peppers, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 3 cans black beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Place half the cheese crumbles, the ground veal, celery, and pork in a bowl.Combine chile, mace, balsamic vinegar, and black beans in a separate bowl, pressing in reserved cheese crumbles.Using hands, mix into cheese mixture until well combined.Shape 1/4 of the cheese mixture into a ball.Repeat with remaining cheese mixture.To serve, place one ball of cheese mixture onto a plate with the other cheese ball on top.Serve with salsa fresca if desired.

Random Ingredients: basil leaf,lime juice zest,green olive,onion soup mix,french bread,marsala wine
title: Spanish Olives
ingredients: 3 cups black fresh basil leaves, lightly packed | 2 packages dry onion soup mix | 2 tablespoons marsala wine | 4 green olives, coarsely chopped | 1 lime, juice and zest of, grated | 3 tablespoons french bread or 3 tablespoons other breadcrumbs
instructions: In a large bowl, thoroughly mix together the basil, onion soup mix, marsala, olives, lime zest, and bread crumbs.Place the mixture on a cutting board and shape into a rectangle.Towards the edges of the rectangle, roll the mixture up like a jelly roll.Cut the roll into strips about 3 to 4 inch long.Wrap the strips in wax paper and refrigerate up to several days, and overnight if possible.Lightly fry 2 or 3 strips at a time in very hot oil, turning a few times so all sides are browned.Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: ancho chile powder,lettuce,bourbon,beef stew meat,milk chocolate,rice vinegar
title: Filipino Beef & Chocolate Wrapped in Spicy Chocolate Milk Sauce
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat, cut into small chunks | 6 ounces milk chocolate, roughly chopped ( or a 50/50 mixture of milk chocolate, milk chocolate, and vanilla extract ) | 2 tablespoons bourbon ( a 50/50 mixture of bourbon, almond, or coconut rum will work ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder | 6 leaves lettuce ( or 1 small bunches of fresh leafy lettuce ) | 1/4 cup rice vinegar ( if you don't like your sauce acidic, i'd advise using white vinegar )
instructions: Make sure your stew meat is at least an inch square, and not quite reaching the edges, as it will shrink when baking.Heat a wok over medium heat until hot, or just very hot, with a knob of butter or margarine.Sear the beef chunks in the heated pan on all sides.Drain any excess fat.Add the chocolate, and stir until melted.Add the bourbon or rum to the chocolate mixture, stirring until dispersed evenly.Add the beef, and stir until warm.Remove from heat.Place two leaves of lettuce in each of four serving dishes.Spoon the beef broth over the greens, then top with the warmed chocolate sauce.Serve right away or let cool on the counter for about 10 minutes to thicken it a bit.Serve with some white rice.

title: Crispy Bacon Pork Wrapped Pork Tacos
ingredients: 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 2 1/2 lbs pork loin | 8 taco shells | 3 cups marinara sauce | 4 slices thick-sliced bacon
instructions: Toast fennel seeds in a dry skillet over moderate heat, stirring, until fragrant, about 3 minutes.Let cool completely.Grind fennel in spice grinder.Trim fat from pork and cut into 1 inch cubes.Soak taco shells in water for at least 5 minutes.Combine pork and remaining ingredients in a medium bowl, cover, and refrigerate 1 hour.Remove pork from refrigerator 30 minutes before cooking.Heat a grill or broiler until hot.Add pork mixture and cook, turning occasionally, until done, about 15 minutes, basting with marinara sauce and cooked, at least 5 minutes.Serve with warm tortillas.

title: My Spicy Baked Pasta - Vegan
ingredients: 2 cups prepared pasta, of your choice | 8 -10 lime wedges ( to serve ) | chickpea ( pure olive ) or maple syrup ( to serve ) | spices ( to garnish ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | club soda, to serve
instructions: Cook pasta per package instructions.Drain pasta when done, but save the cooking liquid to make another use and throw with a little olive oil, chopped onion and some chopped fresh coriander.To serve, divide pasta among individual serving bowls.

title: Spicy Potato Casserole
ingredients: 2 lbs small red potatoes | 1 -3 teaspoon crushed red cayenne pepper ( or more if you like spicy ) | 2 cups mexican blend shredded cheese | 1 package simply potatoes diced potatoes with onion | 2 cans light cream of potato soup or ( 10 1/2 ounce ) cans light cream of mushroom soup | 3/4 cup half-and-half | 1 tablespoon curry paste ( hot or mild depending on taste ) | 1 tablespoon tamari or 1 tablespoon soy sauce
instructions: Bring a pot of water to a boil.Meanwhile, cut potatoes in half.Place potatoes in a large bowl, add 1 - 2 teaspoons of crushed red pepper and 1 1/2 cups of shredded cheese.Set potatoes in boiling water, lower heat to medium, and cook until potatoes are tender crisp.Drain potatoes, rinse with cool water and cut into cubes.Toss with red pepper mixture.In a skillet, combine the cream of potatoes soup, half & half, curry paste and tamari or soy sauce.Simmer until heated through.Pour over potatoes and sprinkle with remaining cheese.Makes 8 servings.Enjoy.

title: Toffee Balls (Zuccotto)
ingredients: 1 lb chicken liver, cooked and chopped | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs ( ground graham cracker crumbs ) | 1/2 cup cheese, shredded ( parmesan or asiago would work too, you may need to use more cheese )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.Pour 2/3 cup of melted butter into a small pot.Mix all other ingredients together.Then add the cooked chicken livers on top.Press mixture down well and flatten out.Bake in a small baking dish for 25 - 30 minutes, turning a few times.The balls will be firm.

Random Ingredients: apple cider,flour,beef bouillon cube,cucumber,grit,cilantro,dark soy sauce,baguette
title: Mongolian Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef or 1 lb round steak, of choice | 1 1/2 cups peeled finely shredded cucumbers | 1/2 cup fresh cilantro, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon dry crushed garlic or 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 cup apple cider or 1 cup distilled vinegar | 1 package cooked grits ( i prefer grits )
instructions: In a large frying pan, brown meat or beef in garlic and salt.Drain any excess fat.Add cilantro, crushed garlic and stock cube.Return to a simmer over medium heat, stirring often.Mix in soy sauce and vinegar, and simmer until thickened.To serve, place 2 cups of the cooked grits on a plate.Spread 1/2 the meat mixture on top and top with 1 cup of the shredded grits.Fold and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: sirloin,vanilla ice cream,heavy cream,tomatillo,egg bread,prosciutto,chicken fillet,salmon
title: Grilled Sliced Steak With Smoked Salmon and Tomatillo Cream Sauce
ingredients: 4 slices egg bread | 4 ounces smoked salmon | 2 ounces prosciutto | 4 ounces sirloin | 4 ounces smoked fish fillet | 2 vine ripe tomatoes | 1/4 lb tomatillo | 1 pint heavy cream | 1 tablespoon vanilla ice cream
instructions: Preheat grill.Toast the bread.Slice into four to four slices.On one side of each slice spread out four slices bread.Add one slice to the grilled toast, flip over and toast the other side.You may wish to set the four together once, or twice.Brush lightly with olive oil.Cut fish into thin strips and place on the toast, add one slice of grilled bread to plate and top with the slice of smoked salmon.Slice the tomatoes and place on top of the fish.Scatter over the smoked salmon.To build the tower, build on top of the tower the tomatillo cream sauce.Lay 4 slices of grilled bread over tomatoes, then place a row of grilled salmon on top of the tomatillo cream sauce and add a row of fish on top of the tomatillo cream sauce.Place 4 slices of smoked salmon over the tomatillo cream sauce and then place 4 slices of smoked fish on top of the salmon.Toast the last piece of toast under grill, remove the toast and allow to stand for approximately 3 to 5 minutes.To serve remove the bread, place 2 to 3 tablespoons cream on the plate, place on the side and serve with smoked salmon in slices.Note, this recipe will serve as a starter and keeps, refrigerated, for a few days.

title: Beef Kielbasa
ingredients: 750 g chuck, sliced in long slices | 4 yellow onions, sliced | 125 g kielbasa | 1 tablespoon prepared horseradish | 1 tablespoon bottled margarita mix | 1 teaspoon ginger paste
instructions: Preheat oven to 160°c.Put beef, onions, kielbasa, margarita mix, and ginger paste in a casserole dish.Bake in 160°c oven for about 2 hours.Serve with noodles.

title: Sweet Ginger Butter
ingredients: 600 g unsalted ghee | 800 g sweet curry paste ( i use masala but you can use mild indian style, or your favorite ) | 2 tablespoons ground cinnamon
instructions: Put the butter into a pan.Keep on low heat for 15 - 20 minutes until completely melted.Add the sweet curry paste and cinnamon.Mix thoroughly.Put into a glass container with a tight fitting lid and refrigerate overnight.It will keep indefinitely if stored in the fridge.The following day, the butter can also be frozen and this can be put into small freezer trays.

title: Mexican Chicken over Pasta
ingredients: 3 lbs uncooked chicken, cut into bite-sized pieces | 1 jar seasoned pasta sauce | 2 cans v8 vegetable juice cocktail, with chicken | 1 can chopped red chilies ( drained ) | 1 can chopped fresh fennel seeds | 1 jar salsa, mild | 1 can prepared chili sauce
instructions: Place the chicken and pasta sauce in a dutch oven.Heat the mixture to boiling.Reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes.Stir in the remaining ingredients.Simmer uncovered for 30 minutes longer, stirring often.

Random Ingredients: half,chorizo sausage,oil,italian salad dressing mix,lemon pepper
title: Italian Chorizo Spread
ingredients: 1 package chorizo sausage, crumbled | 3/4 cup half-and-half | 1 package italian salad dressing mix | 1/4 teaspoon lemon pepper | 1/4 cup oil
instructions: Place all ingredients in a medium bowl and stir until blended, but not smooth.Transfer to a medium sized serving dish and serve with crackers.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,artichoke heart,cashew,bicarbonate soda,chili powder,garlic
title: Artichoke Quesadillas
ingredients: 4 artichoke hearts | 1/2 cup cashews | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1 large garlic, chopped | 2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c.Place cashews and artichoke hearts on a baking sheet and cook in the oven for 20 - 25 minutes, until browned, crisp and cooked through.Drain and cool.Using a blender or food processor, whizz all remaining ingredients together.Spread mixture over the cooled cashews and artichokes and top with a little grated cheese.Return to the oven and heat for a few minutes until golden and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,ham,onion,corn syrup,scallion,onion soup mix,asparagus,sea salt
title: Asparagus Stuffed with Ham and Swiss Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb asparagus, chopped into 1 inch pieces | 1/4 cup chopped scallion | 1/4 cup chopped onion | 1 ham bone | salt and pepper | 1/2 cup water | 4 ounces onion soup mix | 1 tablespoon corn syrup
instructions: Wash and remove stems from the asparagus.Cook in boiling water until tender.Drain and cool down.Drain and set aside.Filling, put ham in a sauce pan and cook over med heat til no imprint remains.Let cool.Combine chopped scallions and onions.Saute in a separate pan until translucent.Add asparagus and ham.Combine soup mix and corn syrup.Pour mixture into a crockpot and cook on low heat for 5 hours.Enjoy.

title: Beef Under a Brick
ingredients: 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 2 lbs beef stew meat, cut into cubes
instructions: Mix the fennel seed and ground beef in a shallow dish and let stand for 10 to 15 minutes.Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f.Arrange the pieces of beef over the fennel mixture and bake, uncovered, for 2 to 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is well flavored and tender.Serve over hot cooked rice, vegetables or noodles.

title: Pears With Almonds
ingredients: 2 medium ripe pears | 1/4 cup marcona almonds, shelled and coarsely chopped ( about 2 almonds )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f.Cut a slit in both sides of each pear so they would sit flat in a flat baking dish.Cut a slit off the top of each pear, and set aside.Place the almonds on a rimmed baking sheet, and bake in the preheated oven until golden, about 10 minutes.Remove pears from the oven and pour hot marcona evenly over them.Return pear halves to oven, and bake until the almonds are crisp and just beginning to get brown, 12 to 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cream tartar,catsup,oregano,chinese five spice powder,potato chip,spring onion,rice vinegar,apricot
title: Chili and Apricot Chips
ingredients: 1 package sweet potato chips | 1/2 cup apricot, chopped | 1 tablespoon crispy rice vinegar | 4 spring onions, chopped | 2 teaspoons catsup | 1 g dried oregano | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 teaspoon chinese five spice powder
instructions: Put the chips in a microwave safe bowl.Pour over enough boiling water to cover, allow to stand 5 mins, drain and rinse thoroughly.Place in a single layer on a microwave safe plate.Repeat until all noodles are used, then cover.Microwave on high for 5 mins, shaking half way through to ensure chips are well coated.Mix together all ingredients for the sauce, pour over noodles and toss.Cool, then chill well then serve.

Random Ingredients: garlic granule,barbecue sauce,green creme de menthe
title: Lauki and Jerk Sauce
ingredients: 1 can green creme de menthe | 1/4 cup barbecue sauce | 1/2 teaspoon garlic granules ( optional )
instructions: Combine the creme de menthe, barbecue sauce, and garlic granules in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: porcini mushroom,feta cheese,tomato puree,chicken broth,basil leaf,caper,cream,mexican cheese
title: Portuguese Chicken Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry porcini mushrooms | 1 1/2 cups low sodium chicken broth | 1 can diced tomatoes with puree | 1 tablespoon capers | 4 ounces feta cheese | 6 tablespoons light sour cream | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh basil leaves
instructions: Drain the mushrooms and set them aside.Bring the broth to a boil in a medium saucepan, add the mushrooms, and cook for 3 minutes, or until the fungi are tender.Remove from the heat and set aside to cool slightly.Puree the tomatoes, capers, and feta in a food processor or blender and set aside.In a medium mixing bowl, stir together the sour cream and basil.Slowly stir in the mushroom mixture and the broth mixture.

title: Spiced Baked Beans
ingredients: 400 g pinto beans | 4 tablespoons lard | sambal oelek | 1 teaspoon instant coffee | 2 cloves garlic scapes, crushed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c/160°c spread some of the beans with the lard, place in a baking dish and bake for 15 minutes stir in the beans, coffee, garlic and season with the sambal oelek.Roast for 15 minutes until the beans are soft and the coffee has reduced.Serve with fresh mash, bread and a green vegetable.

title: Faux Orange Refreshing Thai Basil Caponade
ingredients: 2 pints fresh oranges, including peel including peel | 2 cups thai basil, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup capers | 1/3 cup honey
instructions: Puree half of the oranges and half each of the basil in a food processor until very fine.Mix in the capers.In a medium size bowl, stir together the honey and the remaining basil.Stir in the infused honey.Use immediately or store in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: hot water,natural peanut butter,golden syrup,red wine vinegar,stout beer
title: Nigerian Peanut Beer
ingredients: 2 tablespoons natural-style peanut butter | 3 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 3 tablespoons stout beer, like guinness | 5 tablespoons golden syrup | 1/2 teaspoon hot water
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together peanut butter and vinegar until smooth.Stir in stout beer, golden syrup and hot water until smooth.

Random Ingredients: poppy seed,teriyaki sauce,kosher salt,baby arugula,cayenne,chayotes,vegetable bouillon granule,pumpkin
title: Spicy Roasted Veggies
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable bouillon granules | 1 tablespoon minced fresh chayotes ( can use 2 chayotes, cut into 1/4-inch slices to equal 1 whole ) | 4 teaspoons fresh mashed pumpkin | 2 teaspoons instant chicken teriyaki sauce | 1/4 teaspoon ground cayenne | 1/2 teaspoon poppy seed | kosher salt | baby arugula, for lining bowl
instructions: Preheat oven to 550°f.In medium bowl, combine bouillon with chayote, pumpkin, teriyaki sauce, cayenne, poppy seeds and salt.Using damp hands, spread out mixed vegetables in one layer on parchment lined baking sheet.Roast vegetables in prepared pan until golden and crisp, 8 to 10 minutes.Add arugula to pan.

title: Chicken and Daikon (Japanese Style Chicken)
ingredients: 3 chicken thigh fillets | 4 daikon radishes, sliced
instructions: Combine chicken thigh and daikon in a large saucepan, pour over enough cold water.

title: Grilled Chicken with Canned Sausage and Cranberry Salad
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts | 4 thin sliced hard-boiled eggs | 1/4 cup dry cranberries | 6 slices salami | 6 teaspoons white sugar | 6 teaspoons honey | 1 teaspoon cinnamon | 1 jalapeno
instructions: Mix sugar and cinnamon together on a plate.Dip chicken in egg mixture then coat with cinnamon mixture on both sides.Grill chicken until done, about 6 minutes per side, flipping halfway through cooking.To serve, slice chicken and serve on plate with cranberry dressing or mixed salad.

title: Simple and Simple Lunch Wraps
ingredients: 100 g flour tortillas | 100 g olive oil, for dipping, divided | 3 tablespoons grated lemon, rind of
instructions: Put the olive oil in a shallow bowl and set aside.Heat a wok over a high heat until just smoking.To use the olive oil, heat two teaspoons of oil in it for 1 - 2 seconds.Pour in a tablespoon of lemon rind and use it to dip 2 of the tortillas into the oil, letting excess oil drip back into the bowl.Turn tortillas once so it covers all the oiled area.Cook for 3 - 4 minutes, turning once, or until golden brown and crisp.Repeat for remaining tortillas.Serve with dips or serve plain as a snack.Variation, for breakfast, use 50g of grated or parmesan cheese for its salad.For lunch, put some salad greens on plate and put 1/2 tsp of grated or grated cheese in the middle of the pile of salad greens.Put some grated or grated cheese on top of the cheese.Add a couple of tablespoons of lemon juice or olive oil to the salad.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,pie shell,champagne,mustard powder,cooking oil,cream mushroom soup,greek yogurt,tomato
title: French Stuffed Tomato and Beef Quiche
ingredients: 1 ready baked pie shell | 200 g champignons dry champagne ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons cooking oil | 4 medium firm tomatoes, thickly sliced | 1/2 cup reduced-fat cream of mushroom soup | 3 tablespoons greek yogurt ( low fat ) | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/4 cup reduced-fat sour cream | 2 teaspoons plain self-raising flour
instructions: Heat oven to 190c.Remove pie shell from shell and place in a pie plate.Pour half of the champagne into the pie shell.Heat oil in a saucepan over medium high heat, add tomatoes and sautee until tomatoes are soft, about 3 - 5 minutes add cream of mushroom soup, yogurt, mustard powder and mix well.Spoon mixture into pie shell and top with remaining champagne.Bake until cheese and top is golden brown and bubbly, about 45 - 50 minutes.Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,coffee,mirin,green olive,white wine vinegar,curry powder,bulgur,basil leaf
title: Spicy Turmeric Bulgur Salad
ingredients: 3 cups bulgur ( fine ) | 1 1/2 1 1/2 cups white wine vinegar or 1 1/2 cups cider vinegar | 1 cup brewed coffee or 1 cup hot tea | 2 tablespoons prepared hot chili oil | 1/3 cup chopped fresh basil leaf | 1/3 cup chopped green olives or 1/3 cup green salad dressing | 1/4 cup mirin or 1/4 cup sweet rice wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons curry powder
instructions: Combine ingredients.Refrigerate several hours before serving.Toss and refrigerate for up to four hours.

title: Pork with Pistachio Crumbs
ingredients: 1 cup pistachios, shelled | 1 1/2 pounds boneless pork shoulder, cut into small cubes | 1/2 pound fresh basil leaves | 1/2 pound fresh mint leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f.Spread pistachios on a baking sheet and bake in the preheated oven until lightly browned, 12 to 15 minutes.Remove pistachios from oven and allow to cool.Remove skin and coarse fibers from cooked pistachios.Rinse pork and pat dry.Place meat and pistachios in a large, resealable plastic bag.Mix pistachios and pistachios with basil, mint, and mustard powder in a blender and pulse until the mixture is the consistency of coarse meal.Roll into 1 inch balls.Arrange on a baking sheet and bake in preheated oven until meat is browned and fragrant, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,ham,apple,asafoetida powder,half,taco flour tortilla,potato,taco sauce
title: Taco Shepherd's Pie (Cooked)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ground meat ( i use ground turkey, sausage, pork or beef ) | 1 tablespoon plain flour ( or gluten-free gram flour ) | 2 medium sized potatoes ( approx 1 lb ) | 1/2 cup fat-free half-and-half ( or water ) | 1 cup taco flour tortilla ( or cornmeal or wholemeal cornmeal ) | 4 -6 taco size taco sauce | 1 tablespoon asafoetida powder | 1 tablespoon dried apple or 1 tablespoon dried chives
instructions: Preheat oven to 425f.Cut asafoetida in thin strips.Heat a large frying pan or casserole over high heat.Add the meat and stir fry until cooked through.Remove from heat.Add the flour and stir.Add the half & half or water and stir until well mixed.Add the mashed potato to the meat mixture and stir.Turn into a large greased casserole dish.Make criss cross marks across the top and bake for 10 minutes.Remove and sprinkle taco sauce over the top.Sprinkle dried herbs over the top.Serve with additional taco sauce if desired.

title: Ace's Cranberry Seasoning Mix
ingredients: 1 cup dried cranberries | 4 tablespoons dried oregano leaves
instructions: Place dried cranberries, dried oregano and dried cranberries in a mortar and pound into a coarse powder.Store in an airtight container.

title: Spiced Welsh Cucumber Tea
ingredients: 1 large seedless cucumber, peeled, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon dried basil | 1 juniper berries, crushed | 1 tablespoon sherry | 6 cups bread, cubes ( white ) | 1 1/2 cups wheat crackers ( cracked wheat snack crackers )
instructions: In a medium bowl combine cucumber and basil, then add juniper berries, sherry and crackers.Stir well.Cover and chill 1 hour, shaking bowl periodically.Serve.

Random Ingredients: bourbon,wheat flour,yellow squash,large shrimp,chicken bouillon,lemon zest,tabasco sauce,double cream
title: Shrimp and Squash Gratin
ingredients: 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon | 2 tablespoons bourbon | 1/2 teaspoon lemon zest | 1 lb large shrimp | 2 yellow squash | 1 tablespoon wheat flour | 1 cup double cream | tabasco sauce ( optional ) | 1/3 cup bourbon
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.In a small skillet, dry marinate the shrimp with the bouillon and lemon zest stirring well.Cut zucchini into strips about 3/4 inch long.Place squash in a medium bowl with water to cover and let sit 10 minutes.Then drain and set aside.Place flour in a zip lock bag, making sure not to shake off the extra flour.Place shrimp, zucchini and shrimp/squash in bowl, stir, coating shrimp evenly.Shake off excess flour.Bake for about 10 minutes or until shrimp are almost cooked through.

Random Ingredients: bay leaf,pumpkin pie spice,spinach,fish sauce,taco seasoning
title: Lomo Saltado
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon pumpkin pie spice | 1 can pumpkin pie spice | 3 ounces fish sauce | 1 bay leaf | 3 lbs fresh spinach
instructions: Squeeze out any moisture from the pumpkin pie spice with your fingers.Use a large dish.Add all the ingredients into the dish.Stir to mix thoroughly.Cover with plastic wrap and place in refrigerator for one hour.Preheat the oven at 350°f.Line a baking sheet with foil.Place the spinach on the pan and cover with the foil.Place on the middle rack of the oven.Cook, uncovered, for about 30 minutes, or until the spinach is wilted and beginning to brown on the edges.Remove from the oven, let it sit 5 minutes, then slice.Toss with rice and serve.

title: Microwave Chocolate-Pastry Pastries
ingredients: 2 sheets frozen puff pastry, thawed | 2 ounces dark chocolate | 1/3 cup white rice, steamed | 1/2 cup pasta, steamed ( from asian food stores )
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees.Line a baking sheet with waxed paper.Center one sheet of pastry on a work surface.Spread with a thin layer of chocolate and place 1/2 cup rice on top.Starting at one long side of the pastry, roll it up.Using a sharp, clean knife, cut the dough lengthwise into 4 equal strips.Wrap each strip in plastic wrap and refrigerate for 15 minutes.Cut remaining pastry into 4 triangles.Arrange triangles on baking sheet.Brush with chocolate.Scatter with remaining chocolate.Bake for 7 - 10 minutes, until golden.Cool on wire racks.Serve warm or cooled.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,almond paste,pastry,coconut cream,enoki mushroom,amarula cream liqueur,green onion
title: Prawn and Enoki Mushroom Pie
ingredients: 4 ounces abalone mushrooms | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 6 green onions, chopped | 1 ounce almond paste | 3 ounces coconut cream | 1 tablespoon enoki mushroom, chopped | pastry for an elegant pie
instructions: Heat ½ an inch of water in a saucepan over high heat.Add chopped enoki mushrooms and cook for 3 minutes.Remove from heat and add 1 table spoons of enoki mushrooms, chopped green onions and chopped almonds paste.Mix well until combined.Spread filling over pie shell and bake in a moderate oven for 8 - 10 minutes.Remove from the oven, slice and serve with a fresh salad.

title: Dynamite-Vanilla Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup pure vanilla-flavored hot sauce ( like valentina ) | 1/4 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract
instructions: Combine all the ingredients, and heat over medium flame until hot.

Random Ingredients: steak,cauliflower floret,salad oil,chili flake,part mozzarella cheese,lamb shoulder
title: Salsiccia With Meat Filling
ingredients: 800 g cauliflower florets | 200 g lean ground lamb shoulder or 200 g beef | 50 g shaved steak | 1 teaspoon chili flakes | 20 ml salad oil | 1 slice part-skim mozzarella cheese
instructions: Cook the cauliflower in 2 cups of salted boiling water until tender.Rinse under cold water and drain well in a sieve.Meanwhile mix the ground lamb, grated cheese, chili flakes and the oil.Shape the beef into small balls.Flatten each ball with your hands.Cook the meat balls in a little oil on a foreman type pan with a knob of garlic.If you have a gf grilling brush on the meat balls when they have cooked to an internal temperature of 180c.Drain off the oil and add the meat balls to the cauliflower.Put in a 200c oven for 15 - 20 minutes to really cook them through.Remove the meat balls and slice, drizzle on the reserved oil.If you don't really have a gf grilling brush you can fry it in oil on a foreman type pan.

title: Guacamole and Red Beans
ingredients: 1 can red beans, rinsed and drained | 1/4 cup guacamole, or to taste
instructions: Mix red beans, 1/4 cup guacamole, and 1 teaspoon ground dried chipotle pepper together in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: tomato basil pasta sauce,italian breadcrumb,american cheese,tamarind paste
title: Soy Sauce (Vegan Friendly)
ingredients: 2 cans tomato and basil pasta sauce | 1/2 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon tamarind paste | 1 1/2 cups grated american cheese ( i use kraft processed )
instructions: In a 1 1/2 quart covered casserole, mix all ingredients.Bake covered at 350° for about 45 - 50 minutes.Let sit about 5 minutes before serving to allow flavors to develop.

Random Ingredients: veal,pot barley,vanilla essence,beer,iceberg lettuce,lasagna,garlic clove,curry leaf
title: Veal Bolitas from Corfu
ingredients: 1 kg ground veal | 1 can beer | 1 tablespoon curry leaf ( optional ) | 1/2 head iceberg lettuce ( finely chopped ) | 250 g lasagna sheets ( boiled and drained ) | 1 garlic clove ( finely chopped ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | grated iceberg lettuce ( to garnish )
instructions: Combine meat, cheese, curry leaf, lettuce and beer.Divide stuffing between two serving plates, top with remaining stuffing and spoon over noodles.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,cottage cheese,ra el hanout spice mix,poppy seed
title: Sargento Nargisi (Cheese Spread)
ingredients: 500 g cottage cheese or 500 g ricotta cheese | 1/4 cup prepared picante sauce ( optional ) | 1/4 - 1/2 tablespoon ras el hanout spice mix | 1 tablespoon poppy seed
instructions: Combine the dry ingredients.Grate and mix well.Chill for 1 hour.Spread onto raw or toasted pita breads.Garnish with chopped lettuce and sliced tomatoes and/or chopped fresh herbs.

title: Homemade Grilled Mango Chutney
ingredients: 2 1/2 tablespoons mild chili pepper flakes ( or to taste ) | 1 tablespoon tamari ( or more to taste ) | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 packet mango chutney, finely chopped ( or use your favourite mango chutney )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together.Cover and store in the refrigerator to allow the flavours to develop.Use in your favourite recipe.Enjoy and/or store away.

title: Blueberry Grilling for the BBQ
ingredients: 1 lean bone-in pork shoulder | 2 tablespoons seasoning salt | 2 teaspoons fresh ground black pepper | 1 1/2 lbs fresh blueberries | 5 1/4 ounces black tea ( i use bush's brand ) | 2 teaspoons ground allspice
instructions: Place the pork shoulder on the counter.Sprinkle with the seasoning salt and ground pepper.Place the blueberries on top of the meat, trying to push and push the berries into the center of the meat.Sprinkle the tea over all and rub the salt and pepper evenly into the meat.Place the barbecue on medium low heat and cook for 2 hours, turning from time to time, until a meat thermometer reads remove the whole lot from the barbecue and allow to rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.

Random Ingredients: ketchup,grand marnier,anaheim chilies,spinach leaf,egg white,basil,garam masala,egg substitute
title: Spinach-Haddock-Bok Choy
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ketchup ( preferably heinz ) | 2 tablespoons grand marnier or 2 tablespoons other orange-flavored liqueur | 2 teaspoons toasted garam masala | 1 1/2 lbs fresh spinach leaves, packed | 6 large eggs | 2 egg whites | 1 2/3 cups egg substitute | 2 anaheim chilies, seeded, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons fresh basil, finely chopped
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium heat.In a small bowl, combine the ketchup, grand marnier, and garam masala.Add spinach in a single piece, tossing to coat well with sauce.Reduce heat and cook for 2 minutes.Transfer spinach to a bowl and set aside.In a large bowl, lightly beat the eggs together with a wire whisk.Transfer the beaten mixture to a small bowl.Add the egg whites and stir until just blended.Stir in the remaining ingredients.Using a slotted spoon, remove 1/2 cup of the mixture and set aside.Repeat with remaining mixture.When ready to use, transfer the spinach and sauce to a 2 1/2 quart baking dish or platter.Arrange the choy in a spoke pattern in the center of the mixture.Pour the remaining sauce over the choy.Serve.Note, to prepare and fry the choy, preheat the oven to 400 degrees f.In a cast iron skillet, cook the choy in hot oil for 9 to 10 minutes, or until the center is no longer translucent.

Random Ingredients: black olive,orange peel,coconut oil,lettuce leaf,cream cheese,bamboo shoot,mint leaf,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Aussie Black Olive Hummus
ingredients: 1 can sliced black olives | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 4 1/2 ounces cream cheese, at room temperature | 1 teaspoon unsweetened dried shredded coconut oil | 1 teaspoon grated fresh orange peel | 1/2 cup lettuce leaves | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh mint leaves | 1 -2 tablespoon chopped canned bamboo shoots
instructions: Combine 2 tbls.Of the olive oil with the cream cheese in a small bowl and stir well.Stir in the dried shredded coconut oil, orange peels, lettuce, mint, and bamboo shoots.

title: Lomo Saltado (Mexican Beef Rollups)
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin steak, cut in 1-inch wide sticks | 1 lb firm tofu | 1 package bucatini pasta, cooked | 1 lb firm tofu, drained | 12 ounces bok choy, cut in 6 sections and leaves separated lengthwise | 1/2 cup cooking oil | 1/2 cup unflavored gelatin | 1/2 cup cucumber, sliced thinly
instructions: Combine beef and marinade ingredients in a plastic bag and refrigerate, covered, at least 1 hour.While beef is chilling, steam bucatini until al dente.Drain.Bring water to boil for pasta.In a 9x13 baking dish, toss together noodles, meat mixture and tofu.Add 3 sections of bok choy and cheese slices.Dot with 1 teaspoon unflavored gelatin.Cover with remaining 1 cup of zucchini slices.Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes to chill, about 30 minutes.Uncover beef mixture and sprinkle with remaining cheese.Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes or until cheese is set.Serve with remaining zucchini slices.

title: Mixed Spinach Lasagna
ingredients: 1 package lasagna noodles | 1 package frozen | 2 cups sliced baby carrots | 1 package thawed fresh strawberries with juice | 1 jar maraschino cherries
instructions: Bring a large saucepan of lightly salted water to a boil.Add lasagna and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Spicy Mussels in Tortilla Chips
ingredients: 1 package frozen puff pastry, thawed | 24 large mussels | 1/3 cup capers, rinsed and drained | crushed tortilla chips
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degreesf.Bake the puff pastry until puffed and golden, about 20 minutes.Remove from the oven, and set aside.Break open the mussels with a spoon, and scrape the shells open.Discard beards any that haven't opened.Stuff the mussels with a tablespoon of caper, and a few crushed tortilla chips.Place the mussels in a large baking dish.Spoon the tortilla chips onto the top of the mussels.Bake for 10 to 15 minutes, or until hot and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper flake,soy sauce,extra virgin olive oil,green chile,fennel,bay seasoning,maraschino cherry
title: Fennel - Green Chile Relish
ingredients: 5 tablespoons soy sauce | 5 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 -2 red chili pepper flakes ( optional, this is not strictly necessary ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground fennel or 1/2 teaspoon chile powder | 1/2 teaspoon old bay seasoning | 1 dash dried maraschino cherries ( with juice ) | 1/2 - 1 cup green chile, sliced, i prefer the spicy ones
instructions: Whisk together soy sauce and olive oil in a small bowl and add peppers and mix.If you want to make it spicy, add more chili flakes and/or powder.Let set one to two hours at room temperature.Whisk up chili.Pour into serving bowl you will be serving this in.Pile in frisee on a plate and enjoy.

title: Sweet Lush
ingredients: 1 bunch kale | 2 tablespoons shallots, chopped | 1 teaspoon caster sugar | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Wash, clean and chop the kale into small pieces.Chop the shallots.Combine all ingredients in a bowl, mix together well and coat the base and the sides, refrigerate for 1/2 hour before cooking to allow flavour to develop.

Random Ingredients: mexican chili powder,beef tenderloin,green bean,caper,kielbasa,grand marnier,mint
title: Beef Filet With Green Beans  (South Beach Diet Friendly)
ingredients: 1 lb kielbasa | 3 lbs beef tenderloin | 2 packages frozen cut green beans | 2 tablespoons capers ( drained well ) | 2 tablespoons mexican chili powder | 1/4 cup grand marnier ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon mint ( optional )
instructions: In a large skillet, brown kielbasa in a tablespoon of olive oil.Place the beef on the bottom third of a crockpot.Lay a few beans at a time on the beef.Sprinkle the capers, chili powder and grand marnier on top of the beef.Pour the rest of the olive oil over all, stir and cook on low for 2 hours or high for 3 hours.When dinner rolls are done, shred the beef with two forks, serve on a bed of lettuce with green beans on the side.

Random Ingredients: parsnip,onion salt,self rising flour,chicken tender,ham steak,beef consomme,cumin,chicken breast
title: Easy, Amazing Ham and Swiss Strata
ingredients: 6 chicken tenders | 1 lb lean ham steak, finely diced | 3 large sweet onions, chopped | 1 1/2 lbs spiced pork or 1 1/2 lbs sausages | 2 -3 tablespoons dried parsley and cumin, to taste | 1/2 teaspoon onion salt or 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 3 cans beef consomme, undiluted | 1 1/2 cups self-rising flour or 1 1/2 cups rice flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.Line two 9x9 baking pans with aluminum foil, if they are wide.Place the ham in the bottom of the pan, the onions and the parsley on top.Next, remove the sausage from the casing, cut it into 1/2 inch slices and set aside.Using your fingers to work on the sausage to release the meat juices, mix the meat with the dried spices using your fingers, making sure to coat each piece with the spices.Place the meat mixture in the pans with the onions, onions and spices.Open one can of consomme, pour enough liquid inside to cover the meat, stir and top with some of the flour.Bake for about 1 1/2 hours, or until it is bubbling, stirring twice halfway through and sprinkling the top with more flour as needed.When it is done, remove the cover and place on a cutting board to let sit for about five minutes.Cut into squares.These can be stored in the freezer or warmed up in the microwave to save when ready to serve, or frozen for later use.

Random Ingredients: chocolate,madras curry powder,taco seasoning mix,chili paste,sesame seed oil,mandarin orange,lemon peel
title: Tocook & Go Go - Go Snack!
ingredients: 1 package taco seasoning mix | 3 tablespoons sesame seed oil | 3 tablespoons madras curry powder | 3 -3 tablespoons chili paste or 3 -3 tablespoons hot paprika | 1 can mandarin oranges ( or juice ) | 1 lemon, juice and rind of | 1/3 cup candied orange, slices ( for garnish ) | 2 -4 tablespoons chocolate, chips for garnish
instructions: Mix taco seasoning with oil, then add curry powder and chili paste.Drain mandarin oranges and reserve juice.Then mix oranges and juice with dry ingredients.Let chill in refrigerator for 1 - 2 hours.Serve with choc chips and a sprinkling of candied orange rind.

Random Ingredients: kalamata olive,red chili pepper flake,mayonnaise,trout,cake flour,chive
title: Spicy Grilled Trout
ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1/3 cup kalamata olive, chopped | 3 tablespoons snipped fresh chives | 2 tablespoons hot red chili pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons cake flour | 4 trout, about 1 pound each.|
instructions: Combine mayonnaise, olives, chives and chili flakes in medium bowl.Stir in flour until mixture turns thick.Spread over trout and refrigerate for half hour.Preheat grill to low.Grill trout 4 to 5 minutes per side and baste with dressing if desired.

title: Taco Ginger Noodle Salad
ingredients: 12 ounces udon noodles | 1 cup low fat sour cream or 1 cup fat free greek yogurt | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant minced ginger | 2 teaspoons taco seasoning mix | 2 tablespoons fresh coriander leaves
instructions: Cook noodles according to package instructions.

title: Saucepan
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups apricot jam, divided ( store-bought or homemade ) | 1 can whiskey, divided ( store-demo reduced cooking ) | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 tablespoon half-and-half
instructions: Combine 1 1/2 cup of jam with whiskey in small sauce pan over medium heat.Add dijon and coriander powders and half and half.Simmer for 20 minutes or until thickened.Stir constantly for last 3 - 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,balsamic vinegar,lime zest,udon noodle,mozzarella cheese,hoisin sauce,beef chuck roast,seasoning
title: Smoky Beef Noodle Bowl
ingredients: 1 tablespoon canola oil | 2 pounds beef top round beef chuck roast, thinly sliced | 5 cans muir glen noodles | 1/4 cup hoisin sauce | 1/4 cup julienned lime zest | 8 ounces shredded mozzarella cheese | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar
instructions: Heat canola oil in a skillet over medium high heat.Cook and stir beef in the hot canola oil until browned and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes.

title: Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 6 shiitake mushrooms | 3 tablespoons breadcrumbs | 1 ounce mushrooms, minced
instructions: Wash the mushrooms and trim off any tough stems and tough stems.Rinse under cold running water to remove sand, then slice the mushrooms in half.Put a tablespoon of minced shiitake mushroom on each mushroom piece and coat in the breadcrumbs.Gently press the mushroom pieces together so they absorb all the bread crumbs and mushroom flavour.Heat a skillet until very hot, but not smoking.Arrange the mushrooms in the pan.Cook, without stirring, for two to three minutes, until lightly browned, and the coating of the shiitake mushroom is crisp and bubbling.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,thai fish sauce,water chestnut,cumin powder,chicken drumstick,baby corn,red pepper,chicken bouillon cube
title: Thai Drumsticks With Peppers and Corn
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken drumsticks, skin on, whole | 2 lbs baby corn, cut from the cob | 4 small red peppers, cut into strips | 8 water chestnuts, chopped ( optional ) | 2 chicken bouillon cubes, crushed | 2 cups water | 1/4 cup fish sauce ( nam pla ) | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 2 teaspoons thai fish sauce | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Set oven to 425 degrees.In large pot place the drumsticks, corn, pepper strips, corn, water chestnuts and bouillon cubes.Add the water and fish sauce, stirring and bring to boil.Lower heat and simmer for about 30 minutes or until the chicken is tender.Remove from heat and stir in the cumin and thai fish sauce.Allow to stand at room temp for about 20 minutes.Remove chicken.Remove skin and the meat from the legs and discard.Slice legs into 1 inch cubes.Add to gravy with the vanilla and reheat gently for 15 minutes.Serve immediately.

title: Pan Bagels
ingredients: 2 1/3 cups stone-ground dried apricot jam | 1 package yeast ( one envelope ) | 3 3/4 cups coarse salt ( about ) | 1 3/4 cups oil ( i use sunflower or canola ) | 12 soft light sandwich rolls | 6 thin fat free tortillas | lemon zest, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: In a pan place apricot jam, yeast or powder, 1 3/4 cups of the kosher salt and 3/4 cup of the oil.Cover and let yeast soften about 10 minutes.Add flour and mix into a smooth dough.Turn out onto floured surface and knead until smooth and elastic adding more flour if necessary.Place in a greased bowl, cover and let rise about 1 1/2 hours or until dough has doubled in volume.Punch dough down on top.Preheat oven to 425 degrees, place tortillas on parchment lined baking sheet.Cover and let stand 15 - 20 minutes.Divide dough into 12 equal pieces.Form each into a ball and place on baking sheet.Cover and let rise about 45 minutes.Bake 15 - 20 minutes until golden.Cut into 6 rectangles.Garnish with zest and lemon zest, if desired.

title: Cauliflower Quesadillas
ingredients: 1 cauliflower floret, finely chopped | 1 medium onion, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons sherry wine | 8 flour tortillas
instructions: In a large skillet on medium high, saute onion.Mix sherry into onion and cook until it thickens and begins to boil.Add cauliflower and cook for 3 - 5 minutes.Place tortillas one by one on a microwave safe plate.Spread sherry sauce over one half of each tortilla and place plate on a microwave safe plate directly on the fire.Cook on high for 5 minutes, flip and cook on the other side.Let set 4 - 5 minutes and then cut into small wedges and serve.

title: Spicy Japanese Onions
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs spanish onions ( about 3 ) | 1 red chili paste | 3 tablespoons ginger juice
instructions: Peel off the hard outer layers, the very tops of the onions and wash well.Cut the onions into 1/2 inch slices to form the diagonal slices.Remove the hard outer layers.Using a small sharp knife slice the onions in 1/4 inch slices as thinly as possible.Lay the slices flat on a cookie sheet, place in a preheated oven at 300 to 300 degrees.Bake the onions in the preheated oven for about 1 inch to 1 hour, stirring regularly until they are soft and shiny.Remove the onions with a slotted spoon and place them in a serving dish or on paper towel until ready to serve.Pour the dark red chili paste or chilli oil over the onions and toss to coat well.Add the ginger juice at once.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,limeade concentrate,meatball,spanish onion,molasses,red chilli padi
title: Barbecue Style Meatballs
ingredients: 1 large spanish onion | 1 tablespoon flat leaf parsley | 2 tablespoons molasses | 1 tablespoon limesade concentrate, frozen concentrate | 1 red chilli padi, red finely grated | 8 meatballs
instructions: Preheat grill or high heat in a medium sized griddle pan.Finely chop onion.Mix all ingredients together.Add meatballs then put in a shallow dish or tin.Grill meatballs around 10 minutes.Brush or spray barbecue with oil.Barbecue or broil until cooked through.

title: Pasta With Broccoli and Sherry
ingredients: 1 lb farfalle pasta | 1 1/2 lbs head broccoli | 2 cups boiling water | 1/4 cup dry sherry
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil.While the water is coming to boil, cut the ends off the broccoli heads and shred each head to a smaller size.Rinse the broccoli with cold water.When the water comes to a boil, add the broccoli and cook for 1 minute.Strain the broccoli into a colander over a bowl to catch any remaining liquid.Place the pasta in the boiling water and cook according to package directions.While the pasta cooks, put a large saucepan of salted water on to boil.Cut the stems from the broccoli and break into bite size pieces.When the pasta is done, drain and toss with the broccoli.Stir in the sherry and remove from heat.Place a portion of the pasta on a large platter, sprinkle with the cheese.

title: Scallops With Moroccan Spices
ingredients: 6 tablespoons fresh flat-leaf parsley, minced | 1 tablespoon cumin seed | 2 lbs sea scallops
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.In a small bowl, mix the parsley and cumin seeds.Place the scallops on a baking sheet, and spoon the spiced spiced oil onto them.Bake 12 minutes, then turn once, and bake 8 minutes more.Serve over couscous.Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,angostura bitter,molasses,wild mushroom,vegetable broth,sesame oil,guacamole
title: Wild Mushrooms and Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 4 ripe wild mushrooms, sliced ( preferably chanterelles ) | 8 ounces fresh oyster sauce | 12 ounces vegetable broth | 4 ounces molasses | 2 teaspoons sesame oil ( or sesame oil plus 1 tsp.| sesame seeds and 1/2 tsp.| vegetable oil ) | 1 tablespoon guacamole ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon angostura bitters
instructions: Stir fry mushrooms in vegetable broth for 3 minutes, stirring occasionally.Combine mushroom mixture and remaining ingredients in an ungreased bowl.Makes a medium bowl, garnish with fresh cilantro if desired.

Random Ingredients: yellow pepper,rice noodle,marinara sauce,red pepper,french bread,prosciutto,coriander
title: Soupa's Fried Rice Nests
ingredients: 1/2 loaf french bread, cut in half lengthwise and cut on the length | 1/4 lb prosciutto, cut on the width, then cut lengthwise into 1/4 `` strips | 2 cups yellow sweet peppers, sliced or 2 cups green sweet peppers, sliced | 2 cups roasted red peppers, drained and chopped | 2 cups low sodium marinara sauce | 2 teaspoons ground coriander | 1 bag uncooked rice noodles
instructions: Cut loaf in half lengthwise and cut on the length.Scoop out inside of bread.Cut tops and bottoms into strips, then cut strips to create four rectangles.Place half of the prosciutto strips in each strip and top each with half the peppers.Add 3/4 cup marinara sauce to the empty bowl of your food processor.Pulse to mix with machine running until smooth.Spoon half of the rice noodles into each bowl and top with half the sauce.Fold bread over and press down firmly.Chill for an hour or two.To serve, break each rice noodle into 3 pieces and place on a plate.Cut 1/4 of the prosciutto strips and scatter over top of rice noodles.Serve remaining sauce on the side.Garnish with coriander.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,red curry paste,pork cutlet,mandarin orange segment,turkey,leaf thyme,clear honey
title: Thai Pork and Mandarin Sandwiches with Ginger-Fried Maple-Glazed Glaze
ingredients: 1/2 cup dark-roasted maple-glaze | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 1 teaspoon clear honey | 1 lean boneless turkey, trimmed of excess fat and sinew | 2 slices rye bread, thinly sliced ( or other rye bread ) | 2 mandarin orange segments ( with liquid ) | 4 leaves thyme
instructions: Whisk together glaze, curry paste and honey in a small bowl until combined, then pour over turkey and add enough pork to marinate.Cover and refrigerate 1 hour, stirring occasionally.Preheat the grill.Thread lamb onto 12 skewers and grill, turning frequently, until cooked to your liking, 8 to 9 minutes over a medium heat, brushing frequently with glaze.Serve with sliced rye and mandarin orange segments and thyme leaves on the side for squeezing over.

title: Baked Red Chili Risotto
ingredients: 1 red chili pepper | 2 cups arborio rice, cooked | 1/2 cup finely diced roasted red chili pepper
instructions: Cut chilli in half, remove seeds and veins, cut seeds back to centre.Fill chilies with rice, leave whole.Pour boiling water into a pan or casserole dish.Cook over medium heat for five minutes or until water bubbles.Pour risotto over chilli.Sprinkle with roasted red chilly.Cook in hot oven for 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: banana pepper,beef tenderloin steak,hot pepper,hoagie,vegetable oil,snow pea pod
title: Hoisin Steak Wrap
ingredients: 1 package hoagie rolls | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 pound beef tenderloin steaks, sliced | 1 package snow pea pods | 2 hot peppers, sliced in thin rings | 20 banana peppers
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees f.On a baking sheet lay out the hoagie rolls.Spread sliced beef evenly onto the hoagie rolls.Sprinkle vegetable oil over beef and spread slices of snow peas over the meat.Place hot peppers on peppers.Cover with the banana peppers.Close the roll and wrap in aluminum foil.Bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes.Slice and serve.

title: Mango Chutney Sticks
ingredients: 4 cups fresh baby spinach | 1/2 cup chutney | 1/2 cup light corn syrup
instructions: Prepare spinach, washing well under running water.Slice in half lengthwise, and then into 1/4 inch wide strips.Steam for 2 - 3 minutes.Heat rest of the ingredients in a frying pan and pour over greens.Stir fry at medium heat for 20 - 30 minutes, stirring occasionally until done.

title: Cabbage & Yams Salad
ingredients: 1 small yam, cubed | 8 ounces cottage cheese | 1 small red cabbage, cored and shredded
instructions: Spray a nonstick skillet with cooking spray and heat on medium high heat.Saute yam until it is beginning to soften in the skillet, about 2 minutes.Remove yam from skillet and stir in cottage cheese.Transfer yam mixture to a large serving bowl.Stir shredded cabbage into cheese mixture.

Random Ingredients: tabasco sauce,coriander,gherkin,olive oil,white bean,horseradish cream,anaheim chili
title: White Beans in a Horseradish Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil | 12 ounces white beans, cooked and drained | 1 small gherkin, chopped | 1 tablespoon coriander, chopped | 1 long anaheim chili, chopped | 200 g horseradish cream | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce ( i used a jalapeno-flavored tabasco sauce )
instructions: In a frying pan at low heat, add the oil, and keep on low heat.Add the beans, gherkin, and coriander.Cook over medium heat.Stir every now and then for about 15 minutes, the consistency of a thick paste.Stir in some tabasco sauce.Serve hot.

title: Lis'laurie's Famous Clam Cocktail
ingredients: 15 ounces finely chopped clams in juice | 1 cup self-rising flour | 1/4 cup finely chopped pancetta | 2 teaspoons dried chervil | 2 tablespoons reduced-fat mayonnaise | 3 teaspoons prepared rice
instructions: Mix the chopped clams with the flour, pancetta and chervil, and mix thoroughly.Add mayonnaise, stirring to blend.Add additional mayonnaise if desired.

title: Savvy Roast Beef - Crock Pot
ingredients: 2 lbs top sirloin | 1 can cream of celery soup | 3/4 cup rice, uncooked | 1 1/2 teaspoons rosemary, crushed | 1 1/2 teaspoons oregano, crushed | 2 1/2 cups roast
instructions: Turn on the crock pot to high.Put in the beef roast.Stir in the soup, rice, and rosemary.Stir until well combined.Cover and cook 6 hours on low.Slice the roast thinly and serve with crusty bread, and a side salad.

title: Vegan English Muffins
ingredients: 1 sheet frozen puff pastry, thawed according to package directions | 1 tablespoon vegemite | 1 teaspoon dried oregano
instructions: Heat oven to 425°f.Place the puff pastry on a parchment lined baking sheet, cut a 4 inch hole in the top of pastry and press the hole in the center of the pastry to form a lid.Sprinkle the vegemite and dried oregano all over the edge of the pastry and using a fork, poke a hole in the center with a knife.Bake for 14 - 18 minutes or until puff pastry and vegemite are golden brown.

Random Ingredients: red potato,chicken breast tender,pastry,pesto sauce,chili pepper flake
title: Parmesan Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken breast tenders | 8 small red potatoes or 8 small yam potatoes | 1 jar prepared pesto sauce | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon hot chili pepper flakes | 1 ready-made pastry for double-crust deep dish pie ( ready-made or homemade )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f.Using a mandoline or sharp knife, poke the tenders in a few places with a sharp knife.Cut the potatoes into bite size chunks and peel and cut them into 8 chunks or chunks.Peel the yams and dice.Cut the chicken into 1 1/2x2 inch strips by slicing one side into half and the other into strips about 2x2.Place the chicken strips in a glass pie dish and put the potatoes in an overlapping 1/8 inch overhang over the chicken.Add the pesto sauce, hot pepper flakes to taste, and hot pepper flakes to the bowl.The last bit of pesto will be added to the sauce later.The dish should be filled about halfway up with the pesto mixture.Sprinkle a little more pepper flakes on top of the pesto.Cover with foil and bake until the potatoes are cooked through, about 40 minutes.Remove the foil and bake until lightly browned, about 15 minutes more.Remove the top of the dish, sprinkle with the remaining parmesan cheese, and serve.

Random Ingredients: green chile pepper,cellophane noodle,cilantro leaf,worcestershire sauce,tomato green chilies
title: Sauce Mexicana
ingredients: 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 1 can chopped green chile peppers | 1 1/2 tablespoons minced fresh cilantro leaves | 1/4 cup worcestershire sauce | 1 package cellophane noodles
instructions: In medium skillet, combine tomatoes and next 4 ingredients.Bring to a boil.Reduce heat.

title: Cheesy Dip
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese | 1/2 cup tzatziki, < a href= '' https : //www.|geniuskitchen.|com/recipe/tzatziki-4084 '' > tzatziki < /a > | 2 tablespoons cheddar cheese, shredded | 2 tablespoons fresh cilantro, coarsely chopped | 1 teaspoon sugar ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f.Put all ingredients except for cream cheese and cilantro, in a food processor fitted with steel blade.Pulse until well blended.If you have a blender, run through a tube or regular box and add your cream cheese a little at a time until smooth.Transfer cream cheese to a glass bowl, cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate.Pour the dip into ovenproof serving dish, cover or wrap with foil and bake for 10 minutes.Remove foil and bake for an additional 5 minutes.

title: Greek Honey Glaze
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground lamb | 1/2 cup liquid honey | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Mix all together.Use to coat 1 kg, lamb or chicken.Allow to cool before freezing.For frozen chicken, remove from freezer 30 minutes before cooking, allow thawing to thaw overnight in the fridge if possible.

title: Beef Cubes With Zucchini
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 pound beef stew meat | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 can sliced zucchini, drained | 1/2 cup dry bread crumbs
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium high heat.Brown stew meat, breaking into bite size pieces.Drain off any excess fat.Stir in marjoram and zucchini.Spoon meat and vegetable mixture into a lightly greased 8x8 inch baking dish.Sprinkle with bread crumbs.Cover, and bake at 400 degrees f for 30 minutes, or until meat and vegetables are tender.

Random Ingredients: double cream,vegetable oil,white breadcrumb,dark chocolate,rice vinegar
title: Choc-White Breaded Sweet Truffles
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs valosteen dark chocolate, ground ( not unsweetened ) | 7 tablespoons white breadcrumbs ( not dry ) | 6 tablespoons rice vinegar | vegetable oil | 1 package double cream
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°f line a baking sheet with parchment paper.Using a food processor, process the chocolate until it is broken into fine 1 inch chunks.Add the bread crumbs plus the vinegar and process until almost smooth.Transfer the mixture to a bowl.Mix in the cream and process briefly so the mixture adheres together.Add the melted chocolate and mix until everything is evenly coated.With a tablespoon, drop the mixture onto the baking sheet about 1 1/2 inches apart, spacing the truffles by 3/4 inch apart.Using paper, smooth the truffles and then gently press each truffle so it is all evenly lined.Bake for 45 minutes, or until they are firm to the touch.Do not let them overcook.Let cool for at least 5 minutes, then transfer to a container or freezer bag.Store in the fridge.Note, for those that can't get the chocolate, you can grind chocolate with a mortar and pestle until it is smooth in a food processor.If you cannot find the chocolate you can use an electric blender for a smoother paste.

title: Brined Balsamic Vinegar
ingredients: 1 cup balsamic vinegar | 1 cup plain flour | 1 teaspoon hot sauce
instructions: Place all ingredients into a small saucepan and bring to the boil.Reduce heat, and simmer until thick, about 5 minutes.Remove from heat and refrigerate for at least 2 weeks.

title: Pisto Browned Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup long grain white rice | 2 ounces dried soymilk | 1/2 teaspoon ground green chile pepper, or more to taste | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla, or more to taste
instructions: Place rice in a bowl.Cover with saran wrap.Place in refrigerator.Let sit in refrigerator for 1 hour.Drain rice, then set aside.Place soymilk, green chile pepper, and vanilla in a microwave safe bowl, and place on high.Mix rice until the rice is evenly coated with soy milk.Microwave on high until the moisture is absorbed, about 10 seconds.Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,green enchilada sauce,chicken part,lemon extract,lime juice,cinnamon,golden raisin
title: Green Enchilada Sauce Chicken
ingredients: 4 cans green enchilada sauce mixed with 1 can red enchilada sauce | 1 tablespoon lemon extract | 1/2 cup lime juice | 1 tablespoon cinnamon | 1 teaspoon lemon extract | 1 1/4 cups golden raisins ( optional ) | 1 bell pepper, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Stir all ingredients together in a saucepan.Heat over medium heat, stirring occasionally until the filling is hot.

Random Ingredients: pepper,white corn syrup,turmeric powder,heavy whipping cream,currant jelly,fennel seed
title: Turbinado Sauce (For Dessert)
