instructions: Place currant jelly in a small saucepot and bring it to simmer about 1 minute.Remove from heat.Add cream and simmer about 3 minutes, or until thick.Stir in remaining ingredients.Serve in small, shallow bowls with plain, toasted raisin bread.

title: The Tequila
ingredients: 3 tablespoons cinnamon | 4 ounces tequila | 1/3 cup sweetened condensed milk ( i use nestle dreamer mill sweetened condensed milk )
instructions: Mix together the tequila and sweetened condensed milk.Fill a tall glass with ice and drop the cinnamon into the glass.Stir your glass until the ice freezes and the cinnamon becomes frosty.Then, pour into the frosted glass and serve.

title: Italian Style Zippy Zapps

instructions: Blend the hot pasta sauce with a stand mixer on high speed.When the machine begins to run, drop the lemonade concentrate into the sauce.Slowly pour the zapps into a 2 to 4 quart casserole dish.Use or refrigerate for up to 4 days.

title: Crunchy Lemon Rice

instructions: Heat broth over medium heat in a saucepan.Add bread cubes.

title: Sauteed Green Asparagus
ingredients: 1 pound green asparagus | 1 pound pork fat, thinly sliced and crushed
instructions: Place the green asparagus into a large bowl of water.

title: Cheesy Cheese Enoki (Antipasto)

instructions: Dice up pepperoni and enoki mushrooms.Combine with cornflour and oregano.Spread about 1/4 cup of yogurt in the center of a plate.Place the diced vegetables, chopped pepperoni and cheese on top.Place under grill until cheese is melted.Serve hot.

title: Broiled navel oranges

instructions: Combine mayonnaise, 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard, ground cloves and 1/8 teaspoon dry ginger.Press over top and sides of 2 or 3 oranges.Broil, skin side down, 2 minutes.

instructions: If using a blender, blend the rice or cornmeal and lemon juice in the blender until they are well blended and creamy.If using a mortar and pestle, blend in the zest of half a lemon just before serving.Serve the rice immediately.

title: Lebanese Pasta and Lentils

instructions: Place lentils and olives in a medium saucepan.

title: Spinach Salad With Feta
ingredients: 2 lbs spinach leaves, washed | 4 ounces feta cheese, cut into small chunks | 1/4 cup peanut oil | 1/2 green pepper, cut into thin strips | 2 teaspoons szechuan peppercorns | 3 tablespoons szechuan peppercorns | salt, to taste
instructions: In a serving bowl, whisk together the chinese peppercorns with 3 tablespoons of szechuan peppercorns.Set aside in refrigerator.Place spinach on a large platter or cutting board and scatter the feta over it.Using a spoon, poke each piece of spinach several times with both fingers, then spread the peppercorns over the top.Refrigerate for 10 to 15 minutes.Combine the peanut oil, green pepper strips, and remaining 2 tablespoons sesame peppercorns and pour this over the spinach.Add salt to taste.

title: Tofu & Blueberry Parfait
ingredients: 16 ounces firm tofu, drained and diced | 150 g blueberries | 1/2 cup frozen blueberries, to serve ( or fresh to serve )
instructions: Place tofu in a medium bowl and add blueberries.Toss gently to mix.Spoon into a plate and garnish with the chopped berries.

title: Hot Beer Dip

instructions: Into a large, wide mouth glass.Combine pepper sauce and beer in a jar.Cover and shake until completely blended.Let stand for 2 more days.

title: Tender Beef Rib Eye Milk
ingredients: 12 ounces beef rib lean roast
instructions: Trim fat from roast and reserve on heavy duty plate.Using 3 forks, pull meat apart into 2 long, 1 1/2 wide ribbons.

title: Aunt Mary's Smothered Steak
ingredients: 6 sirloin steaks, pounded to 1/4 inch thickness | 4 fluid ounces vodka
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f.Rub each sirloin steak with about 1/4 teaspoon salt.Arrange in a shallow roasting pan.Brush top of steaks with vodka.Bake in the preheated oven 15 to 20 minutes, or to desired internal temperature.

title: Tatboles - Hummus Pita Chips
ingredients: 8 pita bread, cut into 8 triangles | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 3 tablespoons lemon juice, from 1-3 lemons
instructions: Place pita triangles on baking sheets.In 15 second batches, lightly brush with oil and sprinkle lightly with lemon juice.Bake at 400 degrees for 5 - 8 minutes.Serve warm with hummus.

title: Applesauce Rice
ingredients: 1 cup rice | 1/2 cup applesauce | 1 cup whipping cream
instructions: Cook rice as packet directs.Then add applesauce and cream.Enjoy.

title: Tuna & Sesame Seed Patties
ingredients: 1 can tuna ( drained ) | 4 teaspoons sesame oil | 1/2 tablespoon salt ( or to taste ) | 1 2/3 cups soymilk ( or water ) | 3/4 cup frozen corn | 1/4 lb velveeta cheese, cut into cubes | vegetable oil, for deep frying | 1 green-colored lime, cut into wedges, for garnish
instructions:
Mix tuna, 1 teaspoon sesame oil and salt in a medium bowl.Whisk in soy milk and corn until well blended.Divide mixture into eight equal portions, and press each portion into 1/2 inch disk or oval shapes onto two foil lined baking sheets, each about 4 inches thick.Freeze tuna portions 3 to 4 hours or until firm.
    -.Bring a skillet of water to a boil.Meanwhile, heat remaining 1 teaspoon sesame oil in a small skillet over medium heat.Add cheese.

title: Classic French Toast
ingredients: 4 pieces italian bread | 1 loaf italian bread, sliced diagonally 1/4-inch thick
instructions: Preheat the broiler.Toast the bread on the under side.Place 1 slice of bread on a plate, place 2 slices of the bread on top of the slice of bread.Place the other piece of bread on top of each slice of bread, pressing down with the slice of bread.Heat up a cast iron skillet in the oven on a medium setting for 3 - 4 minutes until your just barely turning brown.Place the skillet in the oven or on the grill until browned.Remove and top with more sliced italian bread or butter if desired.

title: Fish Verde
ingredients: 2 lbs fish fillets | 1 3/4 cups buttermilk | 1/3 cup cilantro, minced
instructions: Mix fish and buttermilk in baking dish.Cover dish with foil and bake at 350f for 1 1/2 hours.Stir in cilantro.Bake longer if desired.Serve over noodles, rice, soup or other accompaniments.

title: Cottage Goose & Savoy Cabbage on the Quind
ingredients: 1 lb savoy cabbage, shredded | 1/4 cup ginger ale, chilled | 3 tablespoons puff pastry, thawed ( use a premade packet ) | 1/8 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f.Line a baking sheet with foil or parchment paper.Cut pastry sheets from both ends, and remove parchment or foil as required.Using a 3 inch round biscuit cutter or heart shaped cookie cutter, cut out 12 rounds.Place rounds on lightly floured surface, and roll with a rolling pin into a 1 inch circle.Spoon ½ teaspoon of ginger ale into center of each round, and press with your fingers to compact it.Brush the edges of the circle with a thin film of turmeric powder.Wrap the dough with a double thickness of foil.Line a baking sheet with parchment paper, and place the sealed pastry on the tray.Bake in preheated oven until pastry is golden brown and crisp, about 25 minutes.Meanwhile combine cabbage and remaining ginger ale in a large saucepan over medium heat.Simmer, stirring often, until cabbage is tender, approximately 10 minutes.Remove from heat and set aside.Spoon cabbage mixture onto a baking sheet, and drizzle with remaining ginger ale, and top with a generous sprinkling of turmeric powder.Bake in preheated oven until heated through, about 3 - 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: white onion,loaf italian bread,vanilla bean,lasagna noodle,portabella mushroom,white bread dough,egg noodle
title: Lazy Lasagna Rolls
ingredients: 20 ounces white bread dough | 1 tablespoon vanilla bean | 16 ounces white onions, chopped | 1 lb portabella mushroom, chopped | 8 loaves white bread dough, frozen | 9 egg noodles, boiled, rinsed and drained | 2 loaves italian bread dough, frozen
instructions: Prepare bread dough dough dough, using frozen bread dough as directed on the package.Make the filling, while the dough is being frozen, chop the onions and portabello mushroom very fine.Mix them together in a bowl and set aside when you are ready to make the lasagna.Roll out the frozen loaves of bread dough until they are 1/8 inch thick and about 6 x 9 inches.Using an egg sharp knife or the bottom of a glass, make indentations in the bread dough about 2 inches apart.Spoon 1 t of the filling into each indentation.Fill each indentation with an onion and mushroom mixture.Place 2 tbsp of the reserved filling in the center of each lasagna.Pull the one side of the dough up and wrap tightly to completely enclose the filling.Coat the entire top with water and press the edges with a little press.Place lasagna seam side down onto a greased or parchment lined baking sheet.Freeze until ready to bake.Bake in a preheated oven at 475 degrees for 20 minutes.Remove from the oven and let them stand for 10 minutes.Remove the baking sheets from the baking sheet and brush generously with melted butter.Place back in the oven and bake for 15 minutes more.Remove from the oven and let them cool for about 10 minutes.Remove the baking sheets from the sheets and let them stand for another 10 minutes while you make egg noodles.When ready to serve, reheat the egg noodles by covering the insides with hot water.

title: Pear Cooler
ingredients: 1/2 cup caster sugar ( superfine sugar ) | 60 ml malt vinegar | 75 -200 ml demi-glace | 800 g pears, pared and finely sliced | 450 g seasonal berries
instructions: Place the sugar, vinegar, and demi glace in a large saucepan over medium heat and bring them to the boil without stirring until the sugar dissolves.Pour the syrup into a bowl, cover and place in the fridge to cool.Stir the pears gently then set aside to cool.Stir the pears into the syrup and chill them until ready to serve.Just before serving, spoon the pears and any accumulated sugar into a large serving bowl or on top of cooled fruit.

Random Ingredients: ponzu sauce,cooking apple,white bread,cocoa powder,egg yolk
title: Apple Ponzu Stuffing
ingredients: 10 slices dry white bread | 1/2 cup ponzu sauce | 2 egg yolks | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | cooking apple, for stuffing
instructions: Using your hands, crumble the bread slices into a bowl.Stir together the ponzu sauce, egg yolks and cocoa powder.Toss well and add them to the bread crumbs, coating evenly.Let stuffing sit for about an hour at room temperature to allow flavors to mix.Cut 4 large or 10 smaller chunks of cooking apple.Toss with stuffing.Serve with toothpicks.

title: Tamarind Milk
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups beef broth | 2/3 teaspoon turmeric powder, a pinch
instructions: Combine the milk and the turmeric powder in a small saucepan.Simmer over medium heat, stirring constantly until the milk is thick, about 20 - 30 minutes.Strain into a clean, 1 cup size bowl and serve.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,beef broth,cooking oil,grainy mustard,mango,balsamic vinegar,green olive
title: Mango Salad II
ingredients: 2 tablespoons low-fat prepared mango chutney | 1 mango - peeled, seeded, and grated | 1 tablespoon sliced green olives | 1 teaspoon prepared grainy mustard | 3/4 cup reduced-sodium prepared mango-chutney | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1/3 cup beef broth | 1 teaspoon cooking oil
instructions: Mix mango chutney, mango, olives, mustard, mango chutney, worcestershire sauce, and beef broth in a bowl until well combined.Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.Stir oil into reserved balsamic vinegar.

Random Ingredients: spice,grain rice,peanut oil,mint sprig,pork shoulder,golden syrup,cocoa
title: Guvec's Spiced Pork Rice
ingredients: 350 ml spicy pork shoulder, bone-in, skin on | 100 g raw long grain rice, cleaned and drained | 3 tablespoons peanut oil | 3 3/4 cups unsweetened cocoa or 3 3/4 cups dry roasted peanuts | 2 tablespoons golden syrup or 2 tablespoons honey | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice | fresh mint sprig, for garnish
instructions: Cut the pork meat into 3/4 inch cubes.Heat half the peanut oil in a large heavy based based saucepan over medium high heat.When the oil is hot, add the pork and fry for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring well to brown all sides.Then add the unsweetened cocoa or dry roasted peanuts and stir for 2 to 3 minutes more, being careful not to burn.Remove the pork mixture to a large casserole dish or deep sided platter and set aside.Add the remaining oil to the pan used to fry the meat and stir fry the rice, scraping up all the browned bits and adding the spices.Stir until it is well mixed in and the coconut is well mixed in.

title: Cheaters On the Run
ingredients: 8 ounces red enchilada sauce | 1/2 cup barbeque sauce | 1 teaspoon ground allspice | 2 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese
instructions: In mixing bowl, mix taco sauce, barbeque sauce, allspice, parmesan cheese.

Random Ingredients: fryer,carrot,kielbasa,wheat pastry flour,orange marmalade,curry powder,chili garlic sauce
title: Chili Curry Kielbasa
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs fryer, cubed | 1 1/2 cups orange marmalade | 1 3/4 lbs kielbasa | 13 1/2 ounces whole wheat pastry flour | 4 tablespoons curry powder | 4 tablespoons chili-garlic sauce | 1/4 pint orange marmalade
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.In a large skillet brown meat.Remove meat and set aside.Reserve 1/2c of the cooking liquid, drain meat leaving ¼c of cooking liquid.In the same skillet add the reserved juices from meat and simmer about five minutes.Combine all other ingredients and add meat to this.Simmer till thickened and reduce if it gets too thick.Set aside.In a large bowl combine the flour and curry powder.Stir into meat mixture and coat well.Pour into foil covered casserole dish.Arrange the kielbasa on top of meat mixture.Sprinkle with remaining flour.Bake at 400 f for 20 minutes.Remove foil and bake an additional 10 - 15 minutes until brown.This depends on how thick your meat looks and how thick your kielbasa is.

title: A Simple and Yummy Teriyaki Sauce (Marinade for Chicken, Shrimp and Pork)
ingredients: 1 cup cold water | 1/4 cup teriyaki marinade ( homemade or prepared )
instructions: In a sauce pan, bring the water to boil.Slowly stir in the teriyaki marinade.Remove from heat.Whisk or strain.You can also pour this sauce in a crockpot set on high.Sauce keeps forever and tastes great on meat of your choice and on seafood, chicken, pork or pork skewers, etc.Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: ranch bean,gouda cheese,bay seasoning,golden syrup,cherry tomato,pineapple juice,kosher salt
title: Dressed Fish With Wild Rice
ingredients: 1 cup packedged gouda cheese | 1 cup packed pureed cherry tomatoes ( or grape tomatoes ) | 1 can baked ham | 1 can ranch style beans | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 1 tablespoon old bay seasoning | 1/4 cup pineapple juice | 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt ( or less to taste )
instructions: In a bowl, stir together the gouda cheese, tomatoes, ham, beans, golden syrup, old bay, pineapples, and salt.Cover and refrigerate overnight for best flavor.To serve, gently spread out the mixture and divide among serving plates.

Random Ingredients: anchovy,almond,garlic,dark sesame oil,chunky peanut butter,vanilla pudding mix,shortening,filet beef
title: Peanut Butter Beef
ingredients: 1 cup chunky peanut butter | 1 package vanilla instant pudding mix | 1/3 cup shortening | 4 teaspoons garlic, minced | 2 teaspoons dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon anchovy | 2 teaspoons chopped almonds | 2 lbs filet of beef
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees f.Combine the peanut butter, pudding mix and shortening.Mix in garlic, sesame oil, anchovies and almonds until well blended.Spread 1 cup of the peanut butter mixture evenly over the prepared beef.Place beef in a shallow roasting pan.Spread remaining peanut butter mixture evenly over beef.Bake in the preheated oven until meat reaches 160 degrees f, about 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,spring onion,ladyfinger,hard egg,cider vinegar,beef chuck roast,beef bouillon cube
title: Asian Steamed Pot Roast in Sweet Mustard Sauce
ingredients: 6 -7 lbs beef chuck roast | 1 beef bouillon cube, maggi | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon granules | 1/2 cup chopped spring onion | prepared ladyfinger ( optional ) | cooked hard-boiled egg ( optional )
instructions: Place stock, soy sauce, vinegar, and bouillon into a large pot.Place roast in pot and sprinkle on the chopped spring onion.Bring to a boil and simmer, covered, about 3 1/2 hours or until beef is tender.If desired, prepare a gravy with a gravy of your choice and pour gravy over the top.Serve steaming hot.

title: Mexican Pizza Appetizer
ingredients: 16 ounces refrigerated crusty mexican blend cheese ( crescent size ) | 1/2 lb lean ground turkey | 1 package taco seasoning | 1 cucumber, thinly sliced
instructions: Heat oven to 375&deg.

Random Ingredients: savoy cabbage,cashew,white bean,coconut,garlic paste,egg substitute,orange zest
title: Coconut and Egg Cannelloni (Vegetarian Cannelloni)
ingredients: 250 g white beans ( dried red beans ) | 250 g savoy cabbage ( about 2 small heads ) | 2 tablespoons cashews ( whole unshed ) | 1 tablespoon orange zest ( freshly grated ) | 1 tablespoon garlic paste, fresh ( homemade ) | 3 -4 tablespoons egg substitute | 5 eggs
instructions: Place all of the filling ingredients in a food processor and process until smooth.Add the egg substitute into the mixture and process until well incorporated.Line the cannelloni with double thickness of greaseproof paper.Place a large piece of aluminium foil over the top and fold a few times.Double up the foil with a double thickness of foil and place the cannelloni on the foil.Cover with wet tea towel and refrigerate overnight or at least 4 - 5 hours.Heat a grill pan to a high heat and cook the cannelloni for 3 - 4 minutes on each side until cooked through.Serve at once.

title: Baked Heirloom Tomatoes with Beef
ingredients: 3 lbs heirloom tomatoes | 4 lbs beef chuck roast, trimmed | 12 ounces canned pumpkin puree ( or your favorite mix ) | 2 cups sliced almonds
instructions:
Preheat oven to 350 degrees.Core tomatoes and cut in half on tomato cutting board.Place cut side down on baking sheet, drizzle with about 1 tblsps of remaining olive oil and sprinkle with salt.Bake for about 2 hours.If tomatoes get to thick, turn up the heat until tomatoes are at least a little thicker.If more are needed, let cool to room temperature.Add 1 tin can of pumpkin to meat and reserve liquid.Slice tomatoes in bite sized pieces and toss with toasted almonds until coated evenly.Place into greased 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking pan.
    -.Place remaining can of pumpkin in saucepan.Bring liquid to boiling over medium heat, whisking constantly.Pour around tomatoes.Bake for 1 hour or until tomatoes are soft and liquid is reduced and the center is no longer raw.Add more liquid if desired at this time.

title: Grilled Chicken With Lemons
ingredients: 24 ounces chicken parts, and | 4 leeks, white parts only.| 2 lbs mexican cheese | 6 tablespoons tabasco sauce | 10 tablespoons ground pepper
instructions: The whole recipe is done the day before and leave off heat.Cut the chicken up into chunks or thirds and place in a non reactive pan.Cover with water and add salt and pepper to taste.Put on stove covered for approximately 3 hours, check after 3 hours and remove chicken from the skillet in the last hour of cooking to get the juices out.Shred and place on a serving platter and serve on rolls.The chicken can be refrigerated overnight and reheated later in the morning when needed.The finished chicken is delicious served with a mixture of shredded cheese, chopped onions, sour cream and salsa.You can also add in chopped hot peppers, garlic powder and cumin as a garnish with it.

Random Ingredients: russet potato,chipotle pepper,gingerroot,virgin olive oil,graham cracker crumb,jasmine rice,italian parsley,strawberry
title: Spicy Rice With Berry Chips
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups jasmine rice ( or brown basmati rice ) | 3 teaspoons virgin olive oil | 2 large russet potatoes, peeled, cut in half lengthwise, scooped out and quartered each half into the center, about 2 cups | 3/4 cup strawberry, sliced | 3/4 cup strawberry, sliced | 2 tablespoons gingerroot, minced | 4 canned chipotle peppers, chopped, chopped, discard seeds and stems, use more if needed | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs | 3 tablespoons fresh italian parsley, chopped
instructions: In a medium pot, bring 3 quarts well salted water to a boil over high heat.While water boils, put the rice in a strainer lined with 1 teaspoon salt and the oil.Pour 1/4 cup of cold water into the strainer, and shake off excess.When water boils out, remove from heat and set aside for 5 minutes.Then, using the back of a spoon, press rice into the boiling water, repeating for 5 more seconds to cook the rice.Turn heat to low, and leave on the stovetop for 8 minutes, then turn off the burner and let sit covered for 4 minutes.The rice with crisp tender crust should not be cooked through.Turn on the oven to 375 degrees f, and turn off the stove.Place cooked potatoes in a large baking dish, drizzle with olive oil, and lightly sprinkle with a pinch of salt, toss together, and repeat the process with the remaining ingredients.When all the potatoes have been in, spread 1/2 cup of the strawberry slices evenly across the top of the rice.Spread 1/2 cup of the strawberry slices over the rice.Sprinkle 1 tablespoon of ginger and 1/4 cup of the chopped chipotle peppers over the strawberry slices, then top with 1/2 cup of the rice.Sprinkle 1 tablespoon of minced parsley over the rice, and top with remaining 1 tablespoon of ginger and roasted chiles.Pour 1 more cup of the strawberry and strawberry slices into the baking dish if desired, and top with remaining 1 tablespoon of minced parsley.Sprinkle 1/2 cup of the rind over the rice, and press rice into potatoes so that it is coated on top of the other ingredients.Make a small well in the center of the rices, pour the remaining virgin olive oil around the outside edges, and carefully insert a finger in to the well.Bake in a preheated oven until the crust is golden brown, about 45 minutes, and serve hot.

title: Beer Wings (Beer-Kossies)
ingredients: 8 chicken wings, quartered | 1 gallon beer
instructions: Combine the beer and wings in a slow cooker.Cover and cook on high setting for 4 1/2 to 4 1/2 hours.Remove wings.

Random Ingredients: pepperoncini pepper,italian spice,heavy whipping cream,soymilk,peanut oil,apple cider
title: Pepperoncini Cream With Apple Cider
ingredients: 1/2 cup peanut oil, not extra virgin | 2 tablespoons unsweetened soymilk | 2 tablespoons peach cider | 1 teaspoon italian spices | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/2 small sweet pepperoncini pepper, drained, chopped
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon oil into a medium saucepan over medium heat.Add soy milk, cider, and spices.Heat, stirring frequently, until almost evaporated.Slowly stir in cream, simmer, uncovered, just until the cream is hot, but not boiling.Do not boil.Stir in pepperoncini.

title: Mirin Flavoured Rice With Coconut (Sushi)
ingredients: 1/4 cup mirin | 2 cups short-grain rice | 1 1/4 cups desiccated unsweetened coconut
instructions: Combine the mirin with 1 cup of water and set aside.Combine rice and coconut in a large shallow pan and stir to mix.Bring to a boil.Reduce heat, cover, and simmer with the lid slightly ajar until the rice is tender and most of the water has been absorbed, about 20 minutes.Remove the lid, increase the heat, and cook until the liquid has cooked off, about 5 minutes more.Leave the pan partially ajar, for about 10 minutes, or until all of the water has been absorbed.Serve with a sprinkling of red, green or black sesame seeds.

title: Pepperoni Rice Casserole
ingredients: 1 package pepperoni | 1 jar pasta sauce | 1 package rice krispies
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees.Spray 13x9 inch glass baking dish with nonstick cooking spray.Cut pepperoni into thin strips and place in 9x9 inch glass baking dish.Spoon hot sauce over noodles and sprinkle with pepperoni.

Random Ingredients: mustard powder,egg substitute,head garlic,corn tortilla,green chilies
title: Low-Fat Huevos Rancheros (Copycat)
ingredients: 2 corn tortillas | 2 cups egg substitute | 1/4 cup onion, minced | 1/4 cup green chilies, chopped | 2 teaspoons mustard powder
instructions: Heat grill pan.Dip tortillas in egg wash, and lay on grill.Turn them so that both sides are seared.When edges of tortilla curl to form a triangle, flip and repeat until tortillas finish cooking.Serve with salsa and other condiments if desired.

title: Italian Fried Mushrooms With Nachos
ingredients: 1 lb fresh white mushrooms, sliced | 1/2 cup italian dressing | 1 cup dry-roasted beans | 1 tablespoon grated fresh rosemary or 1 tablespoon minced fresh marjoram | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 cup crushed corn chips | 1/2 cup guacamole, homemade-style | 1 cup chopped fresh fruit ( optional )
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet, heat dressing.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage,liquid honey,hake fillet,egg white,italian bread,pumpkin,chicken bouillon cube,pork sausage
title: Roasted Italian Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/4 cup liquid honey | 1 tablespoon instant chicken bouillon cube | 1 italian bread, like french | 1 lb fresh pumpkin or 1 lb butternut squash, with peel on | 1 lb fresh hake fillet | 1/2 lb sweet italian sausage, like s & co | 1 lb fresh pork sausage | 4 egg whites
instructions: Pre heat oven to 425°f.Place honey, crumbled bouillon cube in small saucepan over low heat, stir until dissolved.Brush pan with a little of the honey mixture.Place bread on cookie sheet with parchment paper, and toast until just toasted, about 3 - 4 minutes.Remove toast from pan.Slice butternut squash in half, scrape out seeds, and place in bowl.Add pumpkin to bowl and toss gently to coat.Place half of sausage and half of pork sausage in large bowl.Add egg whites to bowl with other ingredients, and toss with your hands.Dredge remaining halves of sausage in egg whites before breading into bread to cover.Place bread on cookie sheet.Place two meats on cookie sheet, and top with two remaining bread pieces.Brush with the rest of the honey dressing.Place in pre heated oven, and cook for 30 minutes, or until the bread bread is nicely toasted.

Random Ingredients: herbes de provence,cayenne,red bell pepper,egg yolk,anise seed,cardamom
title: Pfeffernusse(Soup from aniseed Wine)
ingredients: 1/2 whole egg yolk | 6 slices red bell pepper, cut into chunks | 1/4 teaspoon herbes de provence | 1 pinch ground cardamom | 1 pinch ground anise seed | 1 pinch cayenne, or more to taste
instructions: Beat the egg yolk in a mixing bowl with a spoon and set aside.Pour enough boiling water over the green peppers to cover them by an inch or two.Remove from water and dry quickly with a paper towel.Place the peppers in a pot, and fill with enough water to cover them by an inch or two.Cover, and simmer over medium low heat until tender, and the skins blacken, about 20 minutes.Remove from water, and pat peppers with paper towels to remove excess moisture.Puree the pepper puree in batches in a blender or food processor, then set aside.Place the bell peppers in a clean cloth bag.Stir the herbes de provence, cardamom, anise seed, cayenne, and hot pepper puree into beaten yolk.Add the bell pepper puree to the egg yolk mixture, and stir until thickens.Serve piping hot.

Random Ingredients: cucumber lengthwise,vegetable stock cube,nonfat yogurt,skirt steak,rosemary,vodka,hot green chili pepper,yellow squash
title: Peppered Churros With Cucumbers and Yellow Squash
ingredients: 1/2 cup vegetable stock, cube | 2 tablespoons potato-flavoured nonfat yogurt | 2 tablespoons vodka | 4 tablespoons sliced pickled hot green chili peppers | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary | 1 cucumber, peeled, halved lengthwise, seeded, thinly sliced | 3 yellow squash, thinly sliced lengthwise
instructions: Place stock cube in a small bowl and stir in yogurt, vodka, green chile peppers, and rosemary.Divide mixture between 4 plates.Arrange cucumber slices, yellow squash slices, and hot pepper sauce between the 4 plates.Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: ramen noodle,almond extract,nut,white flour,mint leaf,red wine
title: Spaghetti Nests
ingredients: 1 package ramen noodles | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1 teaspoon crushed nuts ( optional ) | 3/4 cup white flour ( for dusting ) | 1/2 cup dry red wine | 1 tablespoon dried mint leaves ( optional )
instructions: Combine noodles with almond extract and nuts in a bowl.Dust with flour and toss.In a small saucepan, combine red wine and mint leaves.Cook and stir for 2 minutes over medium heat until hot.Pour red wine mixture over noodles and toss to coat.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,dark corn syrup,baby pea,vanilla sugar
title: EASY Pea Casserole
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup dark corn syrup | 1/3 cup baby peas | 3 tablespoons vanilla sugar or 3 tablespoons maple syrup
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f.Mix the soup, corn syrup, and peas together in a medium size casserole dish.Sprinkle with vanilla sugar or maple syrup.Bake for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Pears Poached in Mustard (Fuhlau)
ingredients: 2 lbs potatoes, halved | 1/2 cup mustard seeds | 1/2 cup red cooking wine | pear, wedges, for garnish
instructions: Place potatoes on a baking sheet and bake at 275 degrees f for 2 hours, turning every 20 minutes.When potatoes are completely cool, peel, core and cut into 1/4 inch slices.Heat mustard seeds and wine in a heavy skillet over medium heat and gently boil, stirring continuously for 5 minutes.Remove from heat and stir in potatoes.Spoon onto serving platter and garnish with fresh pear wedges.

title: Rice Noodles - Vodka-Rice Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 package dried rice noodles | 3 egg yolks, beaten | 1 1/2 cups vodka or 1 1/2 cups rum, chilled until needed
instructions: Drain your noodles well.Cover with several inches of room temperature water and set aside.When ready to serve, preheat your oven to 375°f.Place noodles in a large heatproof bowl and sprinkle with hot water until boiling.Turn off heat and place noodles in a roasting pan.In a mixing bowl, whisk egg yolks and vodka until creamy.Slowly pour over noodles, stirring very quickly.Transfer bowl to oven.Bake for 15 - 20 minutes, stirring noodles every 5 minutes to prevent breaking with a fork.

title: Sausage Nibbles
ingredients: 1 lb smoked sausage, sliced very thin | 1 cup dried oregano leaves | 1 cup coconut flakes
instructions:
Combine all ingredients into a large bowl, including sausage.
    -.Cover and refrigerate at least several hours prior to using.Sausages may be refrigerated until ready to use.

title: Sweet and Sour Thai Red Curry Soup
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 1/2 - 3/4 cup beef broth | 1/3 cup light coconut, shredded | 3/4 teaspoon sugar
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a pot and bring to a boil stirring often.Reduce heat and simmer 2 - 3 minutes until the soup has thickened slightly and the coconut is softened.

Random Ingredients: caster sugar,cod,black pepper,cream mushroom soup,couscous,almond flour,beef brisket
title: Rabo's Beef and Broth
ingredients: 2 tablespoons almond flour ( almond flour ) | 1 teaspoon black pepper | 1 cup couscous | 2 beef brisket ( any meat, such as beef loin, chops, chops, etc.| ) | 2 cans creamy condensed cream of mushroom soup | 3 cups hot beef broth or 3 cups beef broth | 1/2 cup caster sugar
instructions: In a bowl combine the almond flour and pepper and mix well.Set aside.Place the brisket, bones side down, in a roasting pan.Roast in a 300 degree oven for 1 hour or until very tender.Set the brisket aside.Remove the saucepan lid, and deglaze it with the hot beef broth or broth.Bring to a boil.Add the almond flour mixture and sugar to the saucepan.Stir until dissolved.Remove the pan from the heat and pour over the brisket.Toss to coat everything well.Cover and refrigerate overnight.Remove the brisket from the fridge and place on a serving platter.Cover with foil and allow to rest about 20 minutes.Slice against the grain and serve with the sauce.

Random Ingredients: bow tie pasta,lime zest,rigatoni pasta,molasses,coleslaw mix,raisin
title: Rigatoni Pasta Salad With Lime
ingredients: 1 box bow tie pasta, cooked and drained | 2 boxes coleslaw mix | 1 large lime, zest of | 1 1/2 cups molasses | 4 cups coleslaw dressing, shredded | 1 tablespoon molasses | 1 tablespoon lime zest
instructions: Rinse and drain pasta, place in large salad bowl.Sprinkle zest over all.In a small mixing bowl combine all dressing ingredients, mix well.Pour over pasta.Cover bowl and chill several hours before serving.The longer this sits the more the lime flavors develop.

title: Quick Home Toasted Onion & Beef Jerky
ingredients: 2 large spanish onions, halved lengthwise and deeply scored | 1 jar roasted red barbeque sauce
instructions: Combine onion halves and jar of barbeque sauce in a small bowl.

title: Chilled Pepito Pepies
ingredients: 12 leaves fresh pepitas ( a pepitas snailer available at latin american specialty stores, specialty food stores ) | 1/3 cup pickle | 1/2 cup raw almonds | 1/2 teaspoon portillo ( spanish saffron ) or 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1 tablespoon gelatin ( powder ) | 1/4 cup champagne, chilled
instructions: Wash, dry, and shred pepitas using the coarse side of a grater.Remove and discard gels from almonds in bowl and set aside.Grate almonds using a cheese grater and set aside.Combine sugar, salt, and 2 tablespoons gelatin in a small bowl and set aside.Wash hands then set aside.Place pepitas and almonds in a small saucer.Spread a sheet of plastic wrap on a flat surface.Dip hands in cold water and then press pepitas onto plastic wrap in a thin layer.Remove plastic wrap and transfer pepitas to a cutting board.Using a serrated knife, cut pepitas into 1/4 to 1 1/2 inch squares.Line an 8 inch square metal cake pan with plastic.To peel off plastic wrap use the following directions for pickled, lay papitas around edge of plastic on cutting board and press around edges of plastic on a curved surface using the flat side of a large knife.Repeat with remaining strips.Place in freezer for at least 30 minutes then scrape out plastic and discard peel.Remove from freezer and thaw in refrigerator.Line a 2 quart metal bowl with plastic wrap.Remove pepitas from plastic and cut into 1/8 inch squares.Spread chopped pepitas, chopped almonds, and portillo in a 1/4 cup glass measuring cup.Pour 1/3 cup chilled champagne over pepitas.Add 1 or 2 tablespoons gelatin and 1 tablespoon water for each pepitas layer.Chill until set, about 1 hour, stirring occasionally.Place 1 round of waxed paper on counter and set in a round serving plate.Using a large spoon or spoon dipped in liquid, make small, thin, 1 1/2 x 3 inch slices.Place a pepitas square in the round plate.Carefully flip over.Turn pepitas over and repeat with remaining rounds and pepitas.Garnish top of pepitas with a little bit of pickled almonds.Refrigerate until completely chilled, about 2 hours.When serving, top each pepita with a slice or two of the chilled cheeproón.

Random Ingredients: orange zest,guacamole,beef chuck,vanilla pod,vanilla bean,extra sharp cheddar cheese,beef,broccoli
title: Santa Fe Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs lean boneless beef chuck, cut into 1 inch cubes | 2 large beef bonefish or ( 1 1/2 ounce - 1 ounce ) beef brisket, cut into 2 inch chunks | 1/2 cup extra-sharp cheddar cheese, grated ( about 1 oz.| ) | 1 large seedless orange, zest of, grated | 12 ounces frozen broccoli, thawed and drained | 1 vanilla bean, split lengthwise | 1/2 cup guacamole | 1 large vanilla bean, split lengthwise ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a plastic ziploc or heavy duty ziploc bag, except guacamole.Marinate in refrigerator for at least 3 hours and up to 24 hours.Reserving the guacamole, cook beef in a 12 inch, heavy skillet over a medium high heat, shaking of accumulated fat, until browned and crusty, about 15 minutes.

title: Smoky Cafe Roasted Salsa
ingredients: 1 cup apple juice | 2 cups fresh squeezed apple juice | 1/2 teaspoon snipped fresh savory | 1/4 teaspoon orange zest | 2 poblano chiles, roasted, peeled and chopped | 1 orange, zested | lettuce
instructions: Pulse chiles in a food processor until finely ground.Combine chopped chiles, apple juice, onion and remaining ingredients in a bowl.Add salt and pepper to taste.Cover and chill at least 1 hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: cheese tortellini,feta cheese,sherry,salmon fillet,maple syrup,wheat bran
title: Wrapped Salmon with Feta
ingredients: 1/3 cup whole wheat bran | 1 teaspoon maple syrup | 4 sheets cheese tortellini, thawed | 6 ounces smoked salmon fillets, skinned and deboned | 4 tablespoons crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f.Place the bran in a small saucepan, and pour boiling water over.

Random Ingredients: tomato,bread flour,turkish delight,porcini mushroom,kernel corn,sesame seed,chinese mushroom
title: Sesame Seed and Spice Loaf
ingredients: 2 cups coarse bread flour or 2 cups coarse gluten-free bread flour | 2 cups dried porcini mushrooms | 1/3 cup toasted sesame seeds ( golden ) | 9 -10 fresh chinese mushrooms ( depending on size ) | 1 can whole kernel corn | 1 tomatoes, diced | 2 2 cups turkish delight, sliced ( or other spice variation )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees.Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper or baking spray.In a large bowl, combine flour, porcini, toasted sesame seeds and chopped chinese mushrooms.Make well in center of flour and gradually whisk in corn.Add tomato and turkish delight to dry ingredients and stir with a fork or fingers until mixture starts to form a ball.Transfer to a lightly floured surface.Press with a lightly floured fork or your fingers to form into a rectangle 12 x14 inches.Place in a large baking pan lined with parchment or spray.Bake for 1 hour or until browned and tester inserted in centre comes out clean.Serve warm with meat or cheese.

title: Garlicky Pasta With Peas
ingredients: 1 lb pasta, such as wagon wheels | 2 cups fresh peas, shelled | 2 tablespoons chopped cilantro, preferably sweet italian
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.Drain& rinse peas with cold water under running cold water.

Random Ingredients: tahini,chili sauce,basil,green chili salsa,ham,romaine lettuce,enchilada sauce
title: Holly's Layered Enchiladas
ingredients: 24 thin fried ham slices | 24 enchilada sauce | 12 leaves fresh basil, torn into pieces | 1 cup green chili salsa ( mild, medium or hot ) | 1 cup tahini | 1 can mild chili-flavored enchilada sauce | 1/4 cup sweet chili sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to coat a 9x13 casserole dish with the enchilada sauce, then layer ham, then basil and chili salsa.Top with remaining sauce.Cover with foil and bake for 30 minutes or until heated through.Serve with your favorite salad.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,lentil,red curry paste
title: Thai Lentil Sambal
ingredients: 1 cup lentils, washed and picked over | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Mix the lentils, curry paste, and olive oil in a large bowl.Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for 2 hours.Bring to a boil in a large pot, then reduce temperature to low and cook for 20 minutes or until lentils are fork tender and soupy.Serve with white rice.

Random Ingredients: baking powder,soy sauce,bean sprout,beef chuck roast,coconut milk
title: Easy Coconut Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 boneless beef chuck roast | 1 can coconut milk | 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 4 cups fresh bean sprouts
instructions: Spray a large skillet with nonstick cooking spray.Place meat in skillet.Spray sides with nonstick cooking spray.Brown meat well on all sides.Pour coconut milk, soy sauce and baking powder into skillet.Reduce heat.Cover and cook for 45 minutes or until meat falls apart.Stir in bean sprouts just before serving.

Random Ingredients: pastry dough,tomato paste,bean curd,champagne vinegar,peanut,caraway seed,pecan
title: Vegan Belgian Waffles
ingredients: pastry dough ( gluten free ) : 1/8 cup shredded coconut or 1/8 cup pecans, divided | 2 tablespoons tomato paste, divided | 2 teaspoons champagne vinegar, divided | 2 teaspoons caraway seeds ( canela ) | 2/3 cup drained canned bean curd or cans curd | 1/2 cup peanuts, coarsely chopped, divided | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped candied pecans
instructions: Preheat a waffle iron according to package directions.In separate bowl, combine 1/4 cup coconut or pecans, 2 tablespoons tomato paste, 1 teaspoon vinegar, 1/2 teaspoon caraway seeds and bean curd to make a smooth wet paste.Brush a small spoonful of curry paste onto hot waffle iron.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,steak,oreo cooky,habanero pepper,garnish,orange blossom water
title: Orange Blossom Salmon With Habanero Honey Syrup
ingredients: 1 cup orange blossom water | 3 lbs firm boneless salmon fillets, thawed if frozen | 1 tablespoon minced anaheim hot habanero pepper | garnish ( optional ) | steak ( optional )
instructions: Prepare the orange blossom water, bring about 1/2 cup orange blossom water to a boil in a saucepan and add salmon.Cook for 3 - 4 minutes or until fish is opaque.Cover and turn to keep warm.Remove fish from heat and allow to flake easily with a fork.Place salmon in a serving bowl and sprinkle with hot pepper and drizzle with honey syrup.Garnish with minced anaheim bird chili if desired.Enjoy.

title: Polish Sausage Cookies
ingredients: 2 pounds kielbasa | 1/2 cup grated asiago cheese | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f.In a medium bowl, toss together sausage, grated cheese, and asiago cheese.Roll into 1 inch balls and arrange on a dull, round baking sheet.Bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes, or until lightly browned.

title: Samoan Potato Cakes (Samosas)
ingredients: 3 lbs yukon gold potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/4 inch dice | 1 tablespoon fish sauce
instructions: In a large saucepan of boiling water, cook potatoes until tender, about 10 minutes.Drain, and pat dry with paper towels.Mash potatoes in a bowl using a potato masher until completely smooth.Stir in fish sauce.Form mixture into 16 cakes.Heat a nonstick skillet over medium high heat.Add a few drops of canola oil.

title: Fiesta Dip
ingredients: 8 ounces frozen peas, thawed | 1 lb lean deli steak, cut in strips | 3/4 cup pitted dates, chopped | 2 tablespoons pimientos or 2 tablespoons hot pickled red peppers, chopped | 1 cup strong black coffee | 2 sheets nori ( dry seaweed ) | 1/2 inch sharp cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: In a food processor, combine first 5 ingredients.Process until smooth.Add cheese, stirring until melted.Serve hot with warm rolls.This is even better the next day as it keeps a fresh crisp texture.

Random Ingredients: clam,portabella mushroom,lemon juice zest,rhubarb,chicken part,rosemary,cucumber,cream celery soup
title: Rhubarb Chicken
ingredients: 2 cups halved fresh rhubarb ( use the frozen section ) | 1 cup chopped cucumber | 1 large portabella mushroom, chopped | 4 cloves fresh rosemary | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice, or to taste | 1 1/2 pounds chicken parts | 2 cans minced clams, drained | 1 teaspoon crushed dried rosemary
instructions: Place rhubarb, cucumber, mushrooms, rosemary, cream of celery soup, lemon juice, and chicken in large pot.

title: Wild Rice With Pomegranate Molasses
ingredients: 1 cup wild rice | 4 cups milk | fine salt | 5 pomegranate molasses | whiskey
instructions: Rinse rice in a colander in the sink and drain.Bring milk, salt, and molasses to a boil in a heavy saucepan over high heat.Reduce heat to medium low for 2 minutes.Add rice to the boiling milk, stirring until it has just about absorbed the milk.Remove from heat.Let stand over low heat for 5 minutes, or until the milk has been absorbed.Stir the rice gently with a wooden spoon to separate grains.Place in a serving dish, and pour whiskey over rice.

title: Tortilla Chips
ingredients: 2 cups crushed tortilla chips | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.Mix together tortilla chips and red wine vinegar with hands until thoroughly mixed.Spread onto baking sheet.Bake in preheated oven for 10 minutes.

title: Fish Tacos With Mushrooms & Chicken
ingredients: 6 tablespoons skim milk | 1/4 cup fat-free evaporated milk | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 2 teaspoons fish, powder ( like cod or blue eye ) | 4 boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut into 1 inch pieces ( about 4 servings ) | cooking spray | 12 ounces fresh portabella mushrooms, cleaned trimmed | 5 sheets nori ( dry seaweed sheets or sushi mat ) | 2 large leaves iceberg lettuce, chopped
instructions: Combine skim milk and 1/4 cup of evaporated milk in small bowl.Stir until milk is smooth.Set aside.Combine fish powder and remaining 1 tablespoon of evaporated milk in another small bowl.Set aside.Spray large nonstick skillet with cooking spray.Add chicken and cook over medium high heat until lightly browned, about 5 minutes.Transfer chicken to plate.Reduce heat to medium low.Add remaining evaporated milk, 1/2 cup water, mushrooms, and 1 tablespoon fish powder to skillet.Cook, stirring often, until liquid is reduced to almost almost no more liquid, about 9 minutes.Add 1/2 cup water if mushrooms begin to stick to fingers.Spray 9x13 cake pan with cooking spray.Spray pan with cooking oil.Arrange half the nori sheets in bottom of pan.

Random Ingredients: tomato sauce,pistachio nut,dark brown sugar,kielbasa,coffee powder,black peppercorn,red pepper flake,velveeta cheese
title: Pistachio Stuffed Skillet Kielbasa(Crock Pot Times)
ingredients: 1 package velveeta cheese ( cubed ) | 32 ounces tomato sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons coffee powder | 1 teaspoon dark brown sugar | 3 -6 tablespoons black peppercorns | 3 -4 teaspoons crushed red pepper flakes | 1/4 cup finely chopped pistachio nut ( or walnuts ) | kielbasa ( for garnish )
instructions: Put the cheese cubes into the crock pot.Mix together tomato sauce, coffe, brown sugar, peppercorns and red pepper in a medium sized bowl.Pour over the cheese.Cover and cook on lo heat.Stir every few hours or so.Serve warm or chilled with kielbasa, or as an appetizer.

title: Cauliflower in Banana Liqueur
ingredients: 4 heads cauliflower | 4 large bananas or 2 large eggs | 1/2 cup brandy | 3/4 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper | 1/2 teaspoon dried garlic powder | 1/4 cup banana liqueur, like kahlua
instructions: In a large bowl, place cauliflower and sliced bananas, mix well.Cover and refrigerate 6 - 8 hours to develop flavor.Preheat oven to 350 degrees.Remove cauliflower from fridge 15 - 30 minutes before baking.Drain bananas, slice into 1/4 inch thick rounds, set aside.Place one head of cauliflower in each of two 8x4 inch baking dishes.In a small bowl, combine 3/4 cup of brandy, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, white pepper and dried garlic powder.Sprinkle over cauliflower, dot with liqueur.Combine well.Add banana slices to top of cauliflower.Pour remaining brandy mixture over all.Bake for 45 minutes or until fork tender.

title: Corned Beef with Chips (Corned Beef or Pork Brisket)
ingredients: 4 corned beef brisket | 1/2 cup greek seasoning | 1 tablespoon honey or 1 tablespoon light brown sugar | 2 teaspoons potato starch or 2 teaspoons cornstarch | 1 bag tortilla chips
instructions:
Trim most of the fat and sinew from meat and cut meat into pieces.
    -.In a shallow dish, combine all ingredients except the chips and pour over meat.Cover and marinate overnight or up to 8 hours.Remove meat from refrigerator and marinade for at least an hour at room temperature.Discard marinade.Preheat oven to 375 degrees.Remove meat from dish and arrange on a large, round serving platter.Arrange chips around the meat and arrange on a decorative platter.

title: Chorizo & Garlic
ingredients: 2 lbs chorizo sausage | 1 pint half-and-half
instructions: Slice chorizo.Heat a grill or griddle skillet over medium high heat.Add chorizo slices and cook until golden brown, about 5 minutes.Transfer chorizo slices to a bowl.Wipe the skillet with a paper towel.

title: Mascarpone Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 lb mascarpone cheese, room temperature | 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese | 1/2 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1/8 teaspoon ground cloves
instructions: Combine mascarpone cheese, cheddar cheese, mustard seeds, and ground cloves in a bowl.Stir until combined.Cover bowl and refrigerate for at least one hour to allow flavors to blend.

title: Gramma's Perfect Lamb Hamburgers
ingredients: 1 pound ground lamb | 1 teaspoon vanilla ( optional )
instructions: Mix together ground lamb, vanilla, and salt.Shape into patties about 2 inches in diameter.Gently press into fat of your choice.Refrigerate in an airtight container at least 2 hours, or overnight.

Random Ingredients: water,summer savory,asiago cheese,broccoli floret,sea bass fillet,poblano chile
title: Smoked Sea Bass With Broccoli
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon dried summer savory | 1/2 teaspoon sea bass fillet, skin ( i will use boneless & skinless ) | 2 tablespoons fresh broccoli florets | 4 poblano chiles, roasted | 1/2 cup water, divided | 1/2 cup asiago cheese, grated
instructions: Sprinkle the savory & salt over the fish & rub it into the fish.Place the broccili, peppers & 1/2 cup of the water in a saucepan.Cover & cook over medium heat until the peppers are tender crisp & the peppers are turning orange.Remove the pepper peppers from the pan & set aside.Spray grill with cooking spray.Place fish on the oiled grill rack.Cook the fish over high heat with no direct flame for 12 to 15 minutes or until fish flakes easily when pierced with a fork.Place the fish on a warm platter & cover with foil.Heat broiler.Cook the broccoli about 10 minutes or until tender crisp.Drain.Spoon broccoli over the fish.Sprinkle the asiago over the top & serve.

title: Arora Beans and Risotto
ingredients: 2 cups arborio rice | 1 cup stout beer or 1 cup full cream
instructions: Soak the arborio in cold water for 30 minutes.Drain off the water from the rinsed rice.Place the oil in a large skillet and add in the drained rice.Stir over medium heat for 2 minutes to coat the grains with oil.Add the stout and bring to a boil.When it comes to a boil turn down the heat to very low, cover the skillet and simmer for 1 hour.Cook the rice for another 15 - 20 minutes before serving in cups.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,nacho cheese dip,orange zest,sesame seed,mozzarella cheese,key lime juice,parsley
title: Key West Nacho Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 jar nacho cheese dip | 1 key lime, juice of | 1 ounce grated pecorino romano cheese ( about 1/3 cup ) | 2 ounces shredded mozzarella cheese, preferably sharp cheese | 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley | 1 teaspoon grated orange zest | 1 teaspoon sesame seeds ( optional )
instructions: Place nacho cheese dip in refrigerator until chilled.To make mozzarella cheese spread, combine all ingredients in a small bowl.Beat with a handheld mixer on high speed until smooth.Serve with tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: salmon,monterey jack pepper cheese,tomato sauce,lamb,orange bell pepper,rice noodle
title: Grilled Salmon Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 1 -2 lb lamb, cut up ( or other steak ) | 1/2 lb salmon, cut up | 1 orange bell pepper, sliced | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 package rice noodles, cooked ( i use whole wheat ) | 6 ounces monterey jack pepper cheese, grated
instructions: Cook rice noodles in boiling water, according to package directions.While noodles are being cooked, saute meat in extra virgin olive oil over medium high heat until just done.Drain meat and set aside.In a large bowl, add tomato sauce and all the cooked, sliced tomatoes.Add all ingredients, except the cheese, to the meat and mix well.Pour in hot rice noodles.Stir thoroughly.Top with grated cheese.

title: Lime Butter
ingredients: 3/4 cup fresh lime juice | 1 tablespoon dried oregano
instructions: Using an electric mixer, combine lime juice, oregano and salt.Blend at low speed until smooth.Serve with hot grilled meats, meats, fish, seafood, etc.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,italian sausage,pie crust,iceberg lettuce,southwest seasoning
title: Italian Quiche
ingredients: 1 refrigerated pie crust | 1 pound mild italian sausage | 1 tablespoon southwest seasoning | 3 leaves iceberg lettuce, chopped | 1/4 cup shredded gruyere cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f.Press the pie crust into a 9 inch pie pan and line it with aluminum foil.Heat a large skillet over medium high heat.Prick the bottom and side of the cooled pie crust with a fork, and place it on the preheated baking dish.In the hot skillet, cook the italian sausage until evenly browned, 10 to 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cilantro leaf,nonfat milk,bacon,monterey jack cheese,spring onion,topping,garlic,chickpea
title: Low Fat Chickpea and Bacon Filled Mini Quiches
ingredients: 1 cup nonfat milk | 1 teaspoon minced garlic | 1 cup reduced-fat monterey jack cheese, shredded | 1 packet frozen cooked chickpeas, thawed | 1/2 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 2 cups shredded fat free monterey jack cheese | 2 spring onions, thinly sliced | 4 slices bacon, cooked and crumbled | topping, mixed with
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.Combine the milk and garlic in a blender and process until creamy.Combine the 2 cups cheese, chickpeas, cilantro, half the onions, bacon and cheese in a large bowl, stir in the milk garlic mixture until combined.Portion about ½ cup of the mixture into mini quiches.Top with remaining cheese mixture.Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Simple Herdez Salsa
ingredients: 2 cans diced mild anaheim peppers, drained | 1 jar chunky salsa | 2 teaspoons tarragon, chopped
instructions: Drain the jalapeños and reserve the juice.Mix all the ingredients together in a large bowl.

title:
Chorizo & Raspberry Salad.
    -
ingredients: 250 g chorizo sausage, removed from casings | 5 cups raspberries | 60 g olive, cut into wedges | 1 1/2 cups mayonnaise | 2 teaspoons garam masala
instructions: Cook the chorizo, breaking it up with a fork, until it is browned and cooked through.Put the chorizo, raspberries and olives into a large bowl.Stir the mayonnaise and garam masala together.Stir through the chorizo mixture and taste, season with more of the garam masala if required.

title: Herbed Mexican Salsa (Herb Snack)
ingredients: 6 ounces pimento stuffed olives, about 4.|5 cans ( about 3/4 cup ) | 6 ounces mild herbs, such as cilantro, parsley, chives or 1/2 teaspoon dried herbs, of choice ( use any combination, such as dried herbs, thyme or or marjoram ) | 3/4 teaspoon dried chipotle powder | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine olives, herbs, and spices.Mix well and store in the refrigerator for up to a week.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,salsa,almond,cranberry,red kidney bean,sugar snap pea
title: Crazy Rum and Sugar Snap Peas (Zwt-9)
ingredients: 2 cans red kidney beans, drained | 1 jar sweet salsa | 1/2 cup shredded sugar snap peas | 1/2 cup chopped toasted almonds | 1/2 cup dried cranberries | 1/2 cup dark rum
instructions: Mix all ingredients in large bowl.Store in airtight container in fridge.To use, remove the beans from food storage jar or plastic bag.Shake to mix.Use over hot coals or grill.

title: Easy Italian Noodle Slaw
ingredients: 1 package coleslaw mix | 1 package penne | 1/2 cup egg substitute | 1 container fat-free ricotta cheese
instructions: Cook noodles in boiling, salted water until al dente.Meanwhile, place remaining ingredients in a medium bowl and stir in noodles.Pour noodle mixture over vegetable mixture and stir well to coat.Chill at least two hours to blend flavors.

Random Ingredients: yellow mustard seed,raspberry,turnip,ancho chilies,spinach,beef chuck roast
title: Raspberry Beef for Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 tablespoon yellow mustard seeds | 1/2 cup chopped turnip | 1 can raspberries, drained | 1/2 lb boneless beef chuck roast | 6 -8 pieces fresh spinach | 3 dried ancho chilies | 8 -10 slices of your favourite crusty bread ( your favourite sandwich cut )
instructions: In a large skillet over medium heat, toast mustard seeds.Place mustard seeds in a small bowl and add the next 5 ingredients.Using a slotted spoon, drain half of the juice from raspberries and juice.Add the raspberries and juice to skillet and heat to boiling.Reduce heat and simmer, partially covered, for 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours or until meat can be fork tender.Using scissors, snip any excess pieces of meat.Shred meat and toss with spinach and hot liquid.Serve on buns, accompanied by a hot gravy made of gravy made from cornish hens.Note, can be made 5 days ahead and chilled.Cover, and keep chilled.Reheat well before serving.

title: Mexican Chili Carrots
ingredients: 2 large carrots, about 1 1/2 inches long | 1/2 cup zesty italian salad dressing | 1 teaspoon chili oil | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1/2 teaspoon dried chipotle powder
instructions: Slice carrots in matchsticks.

title: Spiced Banana-Cranberry Salad
ingredients: 3 bananas, skinned and cut into 4 pieces | 2 bananas, cut into four pieces | 1 bunch fresh cranberries, washed and torn | 1/4 cup green olives, cut into quarters | 1/4 cup mascarpone cheese | 2 tablespoons tamari | 1/4 cup parsley, chopped
instructions: Arrange the banana, red and green bananas on four plates.Top with the cranberries, olives, mascarpone cheese, and tamari.Sprinkle the parsley on top.

title: Crispy Mint Crumb
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh mint | 1/4 cup fine dry breadcrumb
instructions: Place the mint leaves on a clean, dry towel.Place the crumbs in a small bowl, and stir in the dry breadcrumbs.Roll the mint balls in the crumbs to lightly coat.Cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for 3 hours, or overnight.Allow to drain a little before serving.

title: Swiss and Green Bean Cream Sauce
ingredients: 2 bunches asparagus | 2 large green beans | 1 package frozen mixed vegetables | 1/2 cup half-and-half cream | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Place asparagus, green beans, and frozen vegetables on a microwave safe dish.Cook on high 5 minutes.Turn off microwave, stir in cream and vanilla and serve.

Random Ingredients: worcestershire sauce,mandarin orange,hot italian sausage,onion flake,noodle
title: Sweet Sausage
ingredients: 3 hot italian sausages | 2 packages noodles ( wheat or white, any of the kind your family likes ) | 1 tablespoon dried onion flakes | 1 tablespoon dried instant minced onion flakes | 1/4 cup worcestershire sauce
instructions: Cut sausage into 1/4 inch slices, 1/4 inch deep.Boil water in dutch oven or large pot for noodles.Add noodles and boil hard for 1 minute.Immediately drain and rinse with cold water.Drain noodles.Return to pot.Add dry onion flakes, worcestershire sauce and onion flakes.Stir to mix.Cover and simmer 5 minutes.Note, if mixture seems dry add water and stir.Drain noodles well on paper towel and put into bowl.Remove lid and simmer 1 minute.Note, you may adjust spices and/or add vegetables to taste.

Random Ingredients: double cream,sun tomato oil,brown sugar,garlic,fennel,red chili powder,maize flour,mirin
title: Sun-Dried Tomato Focaccia
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained if necessary | 1/2 cup mixed brown sugar | 1 tablespoon red chili powder | 1 teaspoon garlic, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons mirin | 120 g pre-made maize flour or 120 g plain flour | 10 -15 fluid ounces double cream | 1/4 cup fennel, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Mix dried tomatoes with sugar, chili and garlic and set aside for at least 1 - 2 hours.Sieve all dry ingridients into a large bowl and gradually add the flour, stirring well to combine.Add cream and mix with a spoon until fully combined.Turn onto a floured board and knead by hand until dough is smooth and elastic.You have to use your hands to incorporate all the flour but if too dry add a few tablespoons more cream.Divide dough into portions and pat dough into a round, preferably non stick, loaf size, circle.Place on a parchment paper lined baking sheet and place in a pre heated oven on low setting for 20 - 30 minutes or until light brown/firm/center.If using fennel remove as soon as it is done and place in a plastic bag and keep in airtight container.Cut focaccia into 3 or 4 portions and place a few slices of focaccia on a serving plate.Sprinkle the sliced focaccia with additional chopped fennel and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: onion powder,cumin,table salt,blue cheese,navy bean,cardamom seed,thyme leaf
title: Baked Blue Cheese Beans
ingredients: 2 cups dried navy beans, soaked overnight and drained | 1/4 teaspoon table salt | 2 large onions, sliced thin | 2 teaspoons cumin | 3/4 teaspoon thyme leaves | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1/2 cup crumbled blue cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.Grease a 2 1/2 to 3 quart baking dish.Combine navy beans, salt, onions and cumin in a large bowl.Cover the bowl with water and soak overnight, if possible, until beans are very tender.The next day, transfer the seasoned beans to a roasting pan.Cover the beans and bake for 1 hour.Sprinkle with thyme and cardamom and bake for 1 minute.Spoon the cheese over the top and bake until the cheese is bubbling, about 15 minutes.

title: Cashew Tomatillo Sauce (Gkai Tomatillo Sauce)
ingredients: 1 lb fresh tomatillo, husked ( or frozen tomatillos ) | 1/4 cup capers, drained | 1/2 cup cashews, dry roasted and chopped
instructions: Place tomatillos in a saucepot and pour in enough water so that it covers 2 inches of the top.Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for about 10 minutes.Drain and discard the skins.Place the tomatillos and capers in a blender or food processor and pulse until coarsely chopped.Add the cashews and puree until smooth.

Random Ingredients: white flour,steak,taco sauce,french bread,bacon dripping,farfalle pasta,green bell pepper,horseradish
title: Sloppy Giuseppeno's Italian Steak With Noodles
ingredients: 1 lb boneless round steak, trimmed of fat and cut into 4 pieces ( or use sirloin steaks ) | 1/3 cup french bread, cut into 4 pieces | 1 cup green bell pepper, chopped ( or use red ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons bacon drippings, from an extra-rich slice of bacon | 1 tablespoon taco sauce | 1 tablespoon creamed horseradish | 1 teaspoon white flour | 13 ounces dry fettuccine pasta, cooked and drained
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f.In a skillet over medium high heat, sear the steaks on each side.Transfer the steak to a baking pan and bake for 20 minutes or until the internal temperature reaches 140°f.Remove the steaks from the oven and cover to keep warm.Add the french bread to the hot pan and cook, stirring to release all of the juices and to make a light golden crust.Add the green pepper and bacon and heat through.Stir in the taco sauce, horseradish, and flour and stir to mix.Return the steaks to the oven for 8 minutes or until browned and cooked through.Remove from the oven and serve over the cooked fettuccine.

Random Ingredients: pepperoni,white balsamic vinegar,cranberry,beef bouillon cube,white breadcrumb
title: Italian Balsamic-Cranberry Croquettes
ingredients: 5 -6 slices day old white breadcrumbs | 1 slice peppered pepperoni ( fresh pepperoni, sliced to 1-in.| thick ) | 1 piece unsliced whole wheat breadcrumb | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1/2 cup white balsamic vinegar or 1/2 cup red wine vinegar
instructions: Using a rolling pin, roll breadcrumbs in bread crumbs until well covered.Set aside, in a medium bowl, crush bouillon cube.Add vinegar and add 1/2 cup of hot water, stirring occasionally.Add bouillon and stir to dissolve.Drain bread crumbs, reserving the rest.Roll the breadcrumbs into walnut size balls, then set aside and repeat process with pepperoni and remaining breadcrumbs.Heat oil in large saute pan or fryer, until oil is almost smoking.Add bread crumbs and fry until crispy, remove onto paper towels to absorb oil, and place on plate lined with a kitchen towel to dry off.Add crumb mixture to hot oil, and fry until no longer crunchy and crumbly, not dry, the consistency of a large chewy hamburger meatballs.Drain on paper towels and use toothpicks to hold on to crumbs.Serve warm.

title: Spicy Tiger Shrimp Pastry
ingredients: 8 tiger shrimp | 1/2 green pepper, finely chopped | 1 serrano chilies or 1 jalapeno chile, finely chopped | 3 serrano chilies, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon sake | 1 package frozen phyllo pastry sheets | 3 cups sweet green pepper, finely chopped ( for garnish )
instructions: Chop shrimp coarsely and place into mixing bowl.Add green pepper, serrano chile, and chopped chile.Mix ingredients thoroughly.Let marinate one hour at room temperature.Place 1 phyllo sheet in 2 or 3 baking sheets and brush lightly with oil.Place another 3 phyllo sheet on top and repeat step 3 to keep from sticking.With wet palms, form 2 sheets of phyllo into a 7 inch circle.Repeat steps 4 and 5 with remaining phyllo sheets, filling to within 1/4 inch of rim of phyllo dough.Gently press phyllo dough into 12 inch circle around edge of the 4 pastry circles.Fold each pastry round into a half moon shape.Sear 1 side of each pasty over medium heat.Reduce heat to medium and, turning down heat, gently pull pastry off of bottom of phyllo and turn right side up again.Brown lightly on both sides.Watch heart of pastry carefully so it doesn`t burn.Remove onto cutting board and cut diagonally, about 1/4 inch wide, while preparing vegetables.Add 3 cups of sweet green pepper pieces to peppers, then place 3 shrimp on each square and fold pastry half moon over and press together lightly to seal.Repeat to make 3 more pasty triangles.You can freeze up to 3 months.

title: Spelt Parboiled Watermelon
ingredients: 500 g watermelon, seeds removed, cut in 8 even pieces | 1 cup semolina flour ( i use bob's red mill semolina flour, which is the whole pound ) or 1 cup whole wheat flour ( i use bob's red mill semolina flour ) | 1 -2 teaspoon tea ( i used instant tea with good results )
instructions: Preheat oven to 220c or 475f.Line an oven tray with baking paper.Put watermelon pieces on the lined tray, and drizzle with tea.Sprinkle with the semolina or flours.Bake 25 minutes or until liquid is absorbed and melon is soft.Serve warm with butter and jam.

title: Ancho Jelly (Poché De Jam)
ingredients: 2 ounces ancho chile powder | 8 ounces jam
instructions: In a small pot, heat 1/2 cup of water to boiling.When it reaches a boil, remove from the heat.Add the ancho powder to the boiling water.When the water is at a rolling boil, pour about 1/2 tablespoonful of the hot liquid into the boiling water.Stir the chile, then let it return to the boil.Stir and boil for another 3 - 5 minutes until the liquid is clear and the aromatic smell of the ancho is gone.Add the jam.Pour the chile jelly into a jelly mold or clean jelly bag.When cool, the jelly can be used to dip foods after the last few minutes.You can also let it cool completely before serving.

title: Garlicky Beef Barley
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef, cubed | 4 cups pearl barley | 4 tablespoons chopped pepper | 1 tablespoon garlic, crushed | 1 tablespoon bay leaf powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients in slow cooker.Cover and cook on low 8 - 10 hours.

title: Grilled-Fish with Apple Yogurt
ingredients: 1 cup greek yogurt | 2 large baking apples, unpeeled, cored and thinly sliced | 1/4 cup diced canned pineapple, flaked | 4 ounces salmon fillets, skin scored
instructions: Combine yogurt and apples in a medium bowl.Add pineapple and pineapple, and stir to combine.Place salmon fillets in a shallow 1 1/2 quart baking dish.Pour yogurt fruit mixture over top.Cover and refrigerate overnight.Preheat grill to high heat.Grill fish until fish flakes easily with fork, about 7 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: paprika,extra virgin olive oil,artichoke heart,lamb,eggplant,flat leaf parsley,clam
title: Lamb and Eggplant Stew
ingredients: 2 medium eggplants, sliced lengthwise into 8 pieces | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 2 medium artichoke hearts, peeled and sliced | 1 lb lean ground lamb or 1 lb beef | 6 fluid ounces bottled clam juice | 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped | 1 teaspoon sweet paprika
instructions: Spray 12 inch sauté pan with non stick cooking spray.Add olive oil.When oil just shimmers, add eggplant and artichokes.Season with salt and pepper.Cook over high heat for 5 minutes, shaking pan occasionally.Add lamb or beef, chopped parsley, and paprika.Cook and stir for 1 minute, until it is no longer pink and most of the liquid is evaporated.Serve immediately.

title: Chutney Steak
ingredients: 4 ounces chocolate bars, grated | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1 ounce low-fat milk | 1 lb sirloin, cut into 2-inch cubes ( about 3/4 inch thick ) | kosher salt
instructions: Pre heat grill to high.Pulse chocolate and mustard in a food processor until smooth.Add milk and process until thick and smooth.Lightly sprinkle beef with salt and rub with chutney.Grill for 3 - 5 minutes on each side to desired level of doneness, but not dryness.Serve with green salad or rice, and vegetables and crackers if desired.

Random Ingredients: sea salt,extra virgin olive oil,red cabbage,egg white,tart apple,greek yogurt,buttermilk baking mix,parsnip
title: Tart Parsnip-Apple Dutch Oven Pancake #RSC
ingredients: 1/2 lb parsnip, peeled and coarsely chopped | 1 large red cabbage, roughly chopped | 1/8 cup organic plain greek yogurt | 1 small tart apple, peeled, finely chopped ( such as granny smith ) | 1/4 cup low-fat buttermilk baking mix | 1 teaspoon flaked sea salt | 3/4 cup organic buttermilk baking mix | 1 large organic egg white | 1/4 cup organic parsley, roughly chopped
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400 degrees f.Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.In a bowl, toss the parsnip, cabbage, yogurt, apple, and buttermilk with the flaked sea salt.Set aside to chill for about 10 minutes.Place a large nonstick wok heat a bit of olive oil in it, place a pancake and cook two minutes, then flip the pancake over.You may need to cook three minutes longer so the pancake is evenly browned.Repeat for the other 1/4 in the same manner.Pour the egg white into the heated pan and whisk vigorously until it begins to thicken, then carefully pour the egg mixture into the pan with the pancake.The pancake should be a little thin.Scatter the chopped parsley over the pancake and serve immediately.

title: Indian Salad Dip - Low Fat
ingredients: 2 cans red lentils, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup red lentil, picked over for grit ( or water packed dried white lentils ) | 2 tablespoons white sugar | 1 cup sweet hummus, warmed ( indian style, or try sweet potato or hazelnut or nutty hummus )
instructions: In a large bowl, mash the 2 cans of red lentils with a fork or potato masher.Add the sugar, and mix thoroughly.Add the lentils that you mashed over the top of the hot mixture, and fold in the warmed hummus to coat the chips and other ingredients.Cover and chill for at least 4 hours.Serve with pitas or naan bread or pitas.

Random Ingredients: stevia powder,french baguette,beef bouillon,bulk pork sausage,gruyere cheese,ginger
title: Gruyere-Stuffed French Bread
ingredients: 1 french baguette, sliced 1/4-inch thick ( about 5 1/2 cups ) | 1/2 teaspoon stevia powder ( optional ) | 2/3 cup freshly grated gruyere cheese ( about 3 oz.| ) | 1 lb bulk pork sausage | 1 cube beef bouillon | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh ginger, plus | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh ginger
instructions: Using a very sharp paring knife, cut a lengthwise slit in the center of the baguette to form a pocket.Insert a paring knife flush with 1 tablespoon of the cheese and stuff the bread with this filling.Using the grater attachment of your knife, grate the cheese and toss the baguette slices with the stevia, gruyere, and sausage.Transfer the stuffing to a shallow saucepan.Dissolve the bouillon cube in about 1/2 cup warm water and bring it to a boil.Dissolve the ginger in it.Dip the baguette in the broth, one slice at a time, coating well.Cover with a plate or two of cheese and set aside.Repeat dipping and soaking with the remaining pieces of bread.Heat the oven to 300 degrees.Place a 12 inch nonstick skillet over high heat until very hot.Add the stuffed bread about 3 tablespoons at a time, reserving some bread for the end of baking.Cook the bread for 8 minutes or until golden, adding more cheese as needed.

title: Baby Bok Choy Saute
ingredients: 1 bunch baby bok choy, trimmed and washed ( about 14 large leaves ) | 1 1/2 cups chicken stock | 1/4 cup aged asiago cheese, shredded
instructions: Wash and drain well all the water from the bok choy.Cut the stalks off the bok choy.Hold the leaves by the leaves, then lift a leaf over the leaf and pull out some leaves to make a shell for holding the water.Place the leaves in a large, heavy skillet and add the chicken stock.Cover and bring to a boil.Reduce heat and cook for 20 minutes, or until the bok choy is tender but has not fully wilted.The leaves may still be floating on the surface as you turn them – if necessary remove the lid to check.Remove the leafy leaves with a slotted spoon and transfer all to a serving dish.Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: mustard powder,oregano,baking potato,tomato vegetable juice cocktail
title: Lazy Roasted Potatoes (Doritos)
ingredients: 2 unpeeled baking potatoes | 1 can diced tomatoes with vegetable juice cocktail, undrained | 1 tablespoon dried oregano | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f.Drizzle the potatoes with a thin layer of olive oil and a little salt.Place the potatoes in a large roasting pan, or into a roasting pan about 2 inches deep.Mix the tomatoes with their juice, the ground oregano, and baking powder together in a bowl.Squeeze the remaining 1/2 cup juice, or the equivalent of 1/2 the water, into the tomato mixture, stir to combine, and cover the potatoes with tin foil.Bake for 1 hour, then uncover and bake for 1/2 hour longer.Remove the foil, sprinkle with more oregano, and serve with warm tortillas on the side.Note, this can also be prepared in a slow cooker, cook on low for 3 1/2 to 4 hours.

title: Cherry Tomatoes and Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 large cherry tomatoes | 8 ounces dried chinese mushrooms | 2 -4 teaspoons catsup | 1 teaspoon adobo seasoning | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1 1/2 teaspoons confectioners'sugar
instructions: Chop the mushrooms, and remove stems and any dark bits from the mushrooms.Sprinkle with the adobo seasoning, then mix in the tomatoes.Sprinkle with the sugar, and mix until well blended.Set aside to allow flavors to blend.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella cheese,green chilies,broth,camembert cheese,green chili pepper,rice vinegar
title: Camembert Poli [ Native American]
ingredients: 1 camembert cheese | 10 ounces smoked mozzarella cheese ( cut into thin matchstick strips ) | 1 chopped green chili pepper | 1/2 cup green chili pepper, roasted red peppers ( or habanero peppers ) | 1 -2 tablespoon broth or 1 -2 tablespoon water | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar
instructions: Mix sauce ingredients together and pour into 4 serving dishes.Toss with poli bread or crackers and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: mandarin orange,green tea leaf,spaghetti,pineapple juice,pepperoni,lemon juice zest
title: Mandarin-Pineapple Spaghetti (No-Yeast)
ingredients: 1 package spaghetti | 6 canned mandarin oranges, drained well | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 8 ounces pineapple juice | spicy green tea leaves, to taste | pepperoni, slices to serve ( optional )
instructions: Cook spaghetti in large pot of boiling water according to package directions.Drain.Rinse and drain mandarin oranges well.Place oranges in a large salad bowl.Stir through lemon rind and juice, pineapple juice and tea leaves.Add pepperoni, if using.Serve hot or cold.

title: Shrimp and Cauliflower Fritters
ingredients: 200 g cauliflower | 300 -400 g shrimp, uncooked | 3 tablespoons sweet and sour sauce | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Boil the cauliflower until almost tender.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,taco seasoning,asiago cheese,ghee,parsnip,coconut,italian turkey sausage,marinara sauce
title: Tacos With Sausage and Parsnips
ingredients: 1 lb italian turkey sausage | 12 ounces coconut milk | 1 tablespoon ghee ( clarified butter ) | 12 asiago cheese pieces or 12 cheddar cheese, grated | 24 thin thin sliced parsnips | 1 package taco seasoning | 1 cup shredded asiago cheese | 1/2 cup shredded coconut
instructions: Prepare all your ingredients for the acos.Place 2 tbls.Of the butter, coconut milk, paprika and taco seasoning in a heavy skillet and heat until butter melts.Saute the turkey sausage until browned.Heat the remaining butter in the large skillet.Add the asiago and parsnips and saute till brown.To serve, place the turkey sausage side byside in a large serving platter or on individual plates.Top stuffing with 1/2 of the flaked coconut and 1/2 of the shredded asiago.You may also add shredded chicken, pork or beef to this dish.Spoon the cacos into the center of the platter, and place a slice or two of the mozzarella and coconut in the center.

title: Drambuie (Apricots and Sage)
ingredients: 4 firm apricots | 8 pieces of fresh sage, | 1 apple, thinly sliced | 4 tablespoons marmalade | 1 tablespoon dried apricot juice | 4 pappadams
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c/400f/gas mark 5 and generously grease a baking tray with some of the cooking spray.Place the apricots in a single layer in the baking tray and scatter over the sage and apple.Spoon over the marmalade and sprinkle evenly with the dried apricots and the dried apricot juice.Drizzle the pappadums with the remaining oil and bake in the preheated oven for 40 minute toss the salad around until warmed through and heated through.Remove from the oven and serve with cream or yoghurt if you like.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,spaghetti sauce,tomato green chilies,cream soup
title: Pamela's Spaghetti Sauce
ingredients: 16 ounces spaghetti sauce | 4 cups sour cream soup | 1 cup canned tomatoes and green chilies | 1 vanilla bean
instructions: Pierce stem side of vanilla bean with the stem and the tip and scrape out the seeds.Pour the entire mixture into a large pot and add the spaghetti sauce.Simmer on medium heat for 20 minutes do not boil.Remove from heat and allow to cool until it slightly thickens slightly.Serve over spaghetti.

title: Brine With Thyme
ingredients: 1/2 cup packed golden brown sugar | 16 leaves fresh thyme leaves | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla | 1 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f.Stir brown sugar and 1/2 the thyme leaves in small bowl to blend.Sprinkle vanilla over mixture.

Random Ingredients: fish,garlic clove,parmigiano reggiano cheese,red wine vinegar,taco seasoning mix,vegetable oil,clam
title: Nicoise Laredo and Fish Frito (Shrimp)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh fish | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1/2 lb garlic clove, crushed | 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 1/4 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 20 small clams, scrubbed
