instructions: Prepare the shrimp and marinate for 15 minutes by bringing a pot of water to boil.In a small frying pan, heat oil over medium high heat.Add garlic and cook until golden brown.Add taco seasoning and stir continuously to coat the shrimp.Drain shrimp and set aside.Coat shrimp in taco seasoning.Place the skillet in the heated frying pan and add the shrimp, marinade, cheese and vinegar.Bring to a boil for 3 minutes on medium heat.Remove from heat and serve immediately.Note, the shrimp can also be marinated in extra salsa and refried beans.If you prefer, serve the shrimp wrapped with a little salsa on the side of the party.

title: Penne With Water Chestnuts and Capers
ingredients: 1 lb cooked small cassava or 1 lb fresh shelled edichimpson | 6 slices fresh crusty french haricot vert, thin-cut or 1/2 cup frozen shelled edichimpson | 1 jar water chestnuts, drained | 2 tablespoons corn flakes, coarsely crushed | 1 cup finely chopped fresh edible flowers ( such as johnny jump-ups, violets, or violets )
instructions: Bring 10 cups of water to the boil in a 3 qt saucepan.Add the cassava and haricots, and poach until bright green, about 2 minutes.Drain well and set aside.Peel off and discard the outer layer with the seeds, and cut the cassava into 1 1/2 inch pieces.Place in a casserole, and coat with corn flakes.Cover and bake at 350°f for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally, until cassava has softened.Stir through the green edible flowers and serve.

title: Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 1 lebanese cucumber ( or 2 english seedless cucumbers ) | 1 tablespoon creole seasoning
instructions: Cut cucumber in half lengthwise.Carefully scoop out and discard seeds and coarsely chop the cucmber.Place the coarsely chopped cucmber in a bowl and sprinkle liberally with creole seasoning.Cover with plastic wrap and chill for 2 hours.Serve with pita bread or french bread sticks.

title: Cheese Tuna Baked Outdoor Tuna Baked in a Bag
ingredients: 1 can tuna or ( 400 g ) can salmon ( drained ) | 1 block cheese | butter
instructions: Put the tuna in the baggie and shake to mix.Then put this baggie in the microwave and heat for about five minutes and remove from microwave leaving the excess tuna in the baggie, stir to mix.Cut the block of cheese into 4 squares and lay it on your working space with the tuna on top of the cheese.Put the cheese slice into the microwave to heat for a few minutes and then take off the microwave.Put the tuna back in the baggie and coat both sides with the melted cheese.Put back in the microwave for another five minutes to get the tuna to become really crispy, then take out of the microwave with a spatula and let sit for the remaining 5 minutes.Using a baggie, put the tuna back in your baggie and coat all the cheese on that.Put the baggie in a plastic sandwich bag and put in the microwave for about 15 more minutes.This is actually not too much because the tuna has a little of the cheese in it.When the tuna is nice and crispy, you can serve.

Random Ingredients: green olive,black mustard seed,beef broth,spanish onion,mint,dark rum,pork shoulder,lemongrass
title: Roasted Moron Lamb
ingredients: 1/2 pound pork shoulder, boned and leg reserved | 1 large spanish onion, quartered and sliced | 1 teaspoon black mustard seed | 3 stalks lemongrass, trimmed, smashed, and cut into 2-inch pieces | 4 ounces pitted green olives | 1/4 cup dark rum | 1/2 cup beef broth | of fresh mint
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f.Place the pork in a large baking dish and scatter half the sliced onion over it.Drizzle half of the black mustard seeds over the meat.Sprinkle with the remaining onion.In a small bowl, mash the lemon grass pieces with a fork.Spread the lemongrass over the top and add the remaining sliced onion.Place the meat on top, then drizzle rum and beef broth over all.Cover and bake about 1 hour.The meat should be tender as it is.Remove the meat and onion, cover, and bake an additional 30 minutes.Remove and let rest 5 to 10 minutes before slicing.

title: Shrimp Cocktail
ingredients: 20 -30 cooked medium shrimp, peeled | 1/2 ounce maraschino cherry, drained | 5 ounces hot water
instructions: To make the shrimp cocktail,.Place shrimp meat into a bowl with warm water and let sit for 15 to 20 minutes.Drain shrimp well and return shrimp to pan.Add cherries to shrimp and refrigerate cocktail for 3 to 4 hours until needed.

title: Easy Peasy Low Carb Vietnamese Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 lime, juice of | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in small bowl.Chill before serving.Can be made up to a week ahead and used as a dipping sauce for veggies and meat.

title: Ouzo Rice
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 cup white rice ( arborio or brown rice will do ) | 1 jar demi-glace ( or creole blue cheese ) | 1/2 cup ouzo | 4 tablespoons fresh mixed herbs, chopped ( rosemary ) | 3 bell peppers ( red or green )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.Coat a 9 x 13 inch baking dish with cooking spray.Place the rice in a glass bowl, spread olive oil on top, and cover tightly with foil.Bake 20 minutes.When done, remove foil, place 3 bell peppers upright over the rice and cover with foil.Recover in a small dish and return to oven, uncovered, for 45 minutes.Remove foil, stir, and bake 10 minutes longer.After 15 minutes, remove from oven, uncover, and let stand, covered for 5 minutes.Using a slotted spoon, carefully remove it from the pan and carefully place on serving plates.To serve, remove rice from oven and scatter with 3 tbsp of mixed herbs and 2 tbsp each of demi glaze.Spoon equal portions of olive oil each portion and garnish with additional chopped herbs, bell peppers, and the ouzo if desired.

title: Arabic Spice Mix for Lamb
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cocoa | 1 tablespoon ras el hanout spice mix
instructions: Mix well.Use as required.

Random Ingredients: white bread,extra beef,rice vinegar,heavy cream,red kidney bean
title: Corn Beef and Rice Dressing
ingredients: 2 tablespoons raw rice vinegar | 1 1/2 lbs extra lean ground beef | 12 slices firm white bread, sliced 1/2-inch thick | 2 cans red kidney beans, drained | 2 cups heavy cream
instructions: Combine the rice vinegar and ground beef in a large bowl.Cover and refrigerate several hours.Preheat oven to 350°f line 2 baking sheets with foil.Cook meat mixture on a rack in the oven until browned and crumbly, about 15 minutes.Drain fat.Spread half of the bread slices on the baking sheets.Divide ground beef and beans evenly among the bread slices.Top with remaining bread and beef mixture.Bake until heated through, about 15 minutes.

title: Korean Sweet BBQ Halusky
ingredients: 1 cup salted barley ( not instant ) | 1 cup sweetened condensed milk | 1 cup buttermilk | 4 slices prosciutto | 1 1/2 tablespoons korean chili paste or 1 1/2 tablespoons korean chili paste with garlic | 1/2 cup chopped walnuts or 1/2 cup pecans
instructions: Prepare the sweetened condensed milk.Place the buttermilk and sweetened condensed milk in a medium size bowl.Place the slice of prosciutto over sweeted Condensed milk.

title: Spiced Kebabs
ingredients: 1 lb kabocha cheese or 1 lb hake & hake fillets | 1/3 cup honey | 1 tablespoon garlic | 1 tablespoon thyme leaves | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon allspice | 2 tablespoons kefalotiri, cut into 4 equal pieces
instructions: First of all remove any bones or skin from the kabocha meat or fish.Cut it into 1/4 cubes.Slice the fish fillets into 1/4 strips.Combine the honey, garlic, thyme, allspice and kefalotiri in a saucepan.Bring everything to a boil and reduce heat to medium.Keep it on low heat, stirring often for about 5 - 10 minutes, until the spices are just beginning to melt.Add the beef cubes to the marinade mix well and cook them for 2 minutes, stirring once or twice.Serve with boiled vegetables and greek pita bread.

title: Easy Mexican Appetizer Appetizer
ingredients: 1 cup mexican blend cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup mexican salad dressing
instructions: Place cheese on cookie sheet with side.Pour desired amount of dressing over cheese.Bake at 400 degrees for 3 minutes.Serve warm.

title: Salad of Sili Salmon and Peppers (Lebanese)
ingredients: 1 - 2 1/2 lb salmon | 4 sweet red peppers | 1/2 cup cider vinegar | 1/8 cup white pepper
instructions: Clean the salmon and cut into serving pieces.Cut the peppers into thin strips, including the stems and all the remaining parts of the pepper.Combine the vinegar and pepper and put aside.Wash, pat dry, and cut the salmon into 1/2 inch slices, removing any bones or cartilage.Arrange in a roasting pan with the peppers and pepper strips, and coat with the vinegar and pepper mixture.Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f.Remove the salmon from the marinade and arrange on a baking sheet and bake in the hot oven for 30 - 40 minutes, or until the fish is bubbly and has turned from translucent to translucent.It should be flakey when done.

title: Quinoa and Spinach
ingredients: 3 cups quinoa | 1 bag fresh baby spinach
instructions: Heat the quinoa in a medium saucepan with just enough water to cover, over medium heat.Bring to boil, reduce heat, cover, and simmer until quinoa is soft, about 20 minutes.Drain.Place spinach in a microwave safe bowl, and cover with a lid, microwave on high 1 minute.Drain spinach, and set aside.Place quinoa and spinach in a large serving bowl, and add water as needed to cover.Bring to boil, cover, and let simmer until quinoa is soft, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: broth,green bean,bamboo shoot,parmigiano reggiano cheese,nonfat milk
title: Green Beans and Cheese Soup
ingredients: 2 bunches green beans ( about 1/2lb fresh or frozen ) | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained, sliced, liquid reserved | 2 cups nonfat milk | 1/2 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, freshly grated ( see note in description ) | 3 cups broth ( see note in description )
instructions: Wash and trim the green beans.

title: Spicy Barbecue Beef Jerky
ingredients: 500 g of lean barbecue sauce | 3 tablespoons rice wine vinegar ( to mix it ) | 2 tablespoons unsweetened coconut cream, mixed with | barbecue sauce ( can use your favourite brand ) | 1 cup frozen whipped topping, thawed ( cool whip )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large resealable plastic bag and shake well to blend.Press about 2 tbs of meat into the bottom of a glass pan.Spread evenly with the mixture.

title: Creamy Pesto Sauce
ingredients: 2 poblano peppers | 1/8 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/2 teaspoon brazil nut, ground
instructions:
Roast the poblano peppers by covering them in plastic wrap with olive oil.Roast the peppers on foil until dark, blistered and blackened.This will take around 3 - 5 minutes after the skins have loosened.Remove seeds from poblanos, peel and deseed them.Slit the poblano peppers and remove the ribs and black membrane.Place peppers in a blender and puree the peppers.
    -.Add the garlic powder and ground brazil nuts.Blend the mixture until the desired consistency is achieved.

Random Ingredients: grape tomato,large shrimp,mango chutney,salt pepper,miracle whip,poblano chile
title: Prawns With Mango Chutney and Grape Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 poblano chiles ( medium size ) | 1 pint grape tomatoes | 1/2 cup mango chutney | 1 dash salt and pepper | 1 cup miracle whip | 800 g large shrimp, shelled and deveined
instructions: Cut the poblano chiles into 1/8 inch strips on a diagonal.Cut each slice in half.Place in a nonstick skillet with 1 cup water and simmer until tender.Remove chiles from skillet and dry on paper towels.Reserve juices.Peel away stems from the tomatoes and slice them in half horizontally.Place in a medium size bowl with 1/2 cup reserved juice.Stir in chutney, 3/4 cup reserved juice, salt and pepper.Stir in the miracle whip and set aside.Add shrimp to remaining juices and cook, stirring constantly until shrimp are cooked through and heated through.Spoon shrimp mixture onto platter and arrange chile strips and tomatillo slices around the shrimp.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,red onion,pickling spice,chicken wing,spiral pasta,tomato puree,paprika,graham cracker crumb
title: Korean Chicken and Tomatoes
ingredients: 36 chicken wings | 1 medium red onion | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1 can diced tomatoes in puree | 1 teaspoon pickling spice | 1 teaspoon paprika | 2 1/2 cups crushed graham cracker crumbs | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon sweet paprika | 24 fresh cooked spiral shaped pasta
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Bake chicken wings on a baking sheet covered with foil for 45 minutes. Cut wings in half lengthwise and set aside. Separate onion, then slice thin and place in a medium saucepan. Slice thin and add to saucepan. Place sesame oil in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil and add pickling spice and paprika. Remove from heat and add to saucepan. Place tomatoes in a saucepan and pour in tomato puree and bring to a simmer. Add onion slices and cook gently for 20 minutes. Combine crushed graham cracker crumbs and sesame oil, then crumb mixture in a bowl to make a moist bread crumb topping. Remove chicken from the baking sheet and pat dry with paper towels. Sprinkle chicken pieces with the seasoning and place in single layer on top of one another. Put a heavy object on top and push down gently. Bake in preheated oven for approximately 30 minutes or until internal temperature reaches 170 degrees f and chicken is fully cooked. Remove chicken from pan and place in a serving dish and serve with sauce.

title: Confetti Corn Salad
ingredients: 1 can corn kernels | 1/2 cup chopped yellow bell pepper | 1 can tomato sauce
instructions: In a large bowl, toss together corn kernels, bell pepper, and tomato sauce. Chill in the refrigerator 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: roast beef,carb ketchup,green chili pepper,bean sprout,marsala wine
title: Quick Beef Noodle Bowl
ingredients: 50 g low-carb ketchup | 1 tablespoon marsala wine | 100 g roast beef, sliced super thin, slice paper thin | 100 g green chili peppers, left whole if deseeded | 100 g whole bean sprouts ( optional )
instructions: In a bowl add all ingredients. Mix well. To serve, divide noodle mixture among the 4 serving bowls. If desired, garnish with the chopped green chilies.

title: Mexican Okra
ingredients: 1 whole okra or ( 3 lb ) package frozen okra, thawed | 5 -6 ounces salsa verde, mild pickled variety | 1 dash splenda granular ( optional )
instructions: Place the frozen okra in a pot with enough water to cover the okra and bring to a boil. Boil for 1 minute, remove with a slotted spoon, and place on a plate covered in some paper towels. Towards the end of the boiling, place the drained okra in your crock pot, pour the salsa on top, cover, and set to low. After one hour, add the splenda and mix, cover, and continue to cook on high until the okra is tender, about 30 more minutes. Serve, as a garnish, as an entrée, or as a sandwich with pita pockets.

Random Ingredients: bacon,beef,nonfat plain yogurt,serrano chilies,green pea,peanut oil
title: Beef & Bacon-Wrapped on Green Pea Snack
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb top sirloin steaks, sliced or 1 -1 1/2 lb trimmed sirloin steak, cut in half | 2 slices bacon, cut in half crosswise | 1 cup frozen green pea, thawed ( about 2 ounces ) | 1 serrano chilies, stemmed, seeded and finely chopped or 1/2 teaspoon finely grated fresh mexican red pepper flakes ( optional and omit for an extra kick ) | 1/2 cup nonfat plain yogurt ( low fat brand or low fat greek yogurt ) | 2 teaspoons peanut oil
instructions: Trim fat from steak and cut meat into 1/2 in wide strips. Sprinkle meat with salt and pepper. Place beef strips on a work surface, add 1/4 tsp of black pepper, and pound lightly to an even ¾ inch thickness. Arrange strips on paper towels to drain. In a medium nonstick skillet set over medium high heat, add 1 1/2 tsp of peanut oil, swirling to coat. When oil is hot, add the meat, in a single layer and cook 3 - 4 minutes, until almost cooked through. Turning once. Add the peas, chilies, yogurt and 1/4 tsp sugar or salt and remaining ¼ tsp pepper. Bring to a boil, cover, and reduce heat to lowest setting let simmer for about 10 - 15 minutes, or until meat is fork tender and the green peas are crisp tender but still holding their shape and texture. Transfer to a deep, warmed serving platter or serving dishes and serve.

title: Chorizo Garlic Pizza
ingredients: 2 chorizo sausage, casing removed | 1 tablespoon vegetable broth | 1 clove garlic, chopped | 1 1/4 cups plain flour | 1 pinch chili flakes
instructions: Place the chorizo in a medium saucepan over medium heat, pour in the broth, and bring to a boil. Cook and stir for 1 minute. Set aside. To make the dough, in a medium bowl, combine the garlic and flour. Stir in the chili flakes. Add 1/4 cup of the chorizo water, and stir with a fork to combine.

Random Ingredients: linguine,shiitake mushroom,escarole,avocado,vegetable broth,cannellini bean,icing sugar,ancho chilies
title: Pasta Escarole with Beans and Avocados
ingredients: 1 cup cannellini beans, rinsed and drained | 12 ounces escarole, cleaned washed, trimmed & chopped | 1/2 lb shiitake mushroom, cleaned and sliced | 1 can cannellini beans, drained, rinsed | 4 ancho chilies | 1/2 cup icing sugar | 7 ounces linguine, cooked | 4 avocados, peeled, pitted and sliced
instructions: In a large pot, add 4 quarts of water. Drop in the green salad ingredients and cover. Heat for about 15 minutes, just until the greens are softened and heated through but not mushy. Add the cannellini beans and sliced mushrooms to the greens and set aside. When ready to serve, add the cannelini beans and the chiles. To serve, place on serving plate, then top with the sargento sargento linguine.

title: Hoisin-Glazed Mascarpone Cheese Spread
ingredients: 500 g mascarpone cheese | 1/3 cup hoisin sauce | 2 1/2 tablespoons low-fat mayonnaise | 4 tablespoons toasted sesame seeds | 1 teaspoon sesame seeds | 1 tablespoon horseradish, grated
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Cover and set in the fridge for 4 hours or overnight if possible, to allow flavours to meld.

title: Raspberry Fizz
ingredients: 2 cups fresh raspberries | 4 tablespoons unsweetened applesauce | 1/4 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 quart vanilla ice cream | 3 tablespoons kirsch ( cherry-seed ) | 2 tablespoons snipped fresh chives | 1 tablespoon slivered almonds, for garnish
instructions: Place raspberries in a glass bowl. Cover with applesauce. Cover and refrigerate. Uncover in the morning. In the morning, place ice cream in a freezer bag, place in bowl with berries. Seal bag and freeze overnight or until solid. In a small bowl, combine the kirsch, fennel seeds, and almonds. Dip ice cream into ice cream and then return to freezer. Every 1 minute, remove ice cream from freezer and place in a small dish, with berries on top. Repeat process until all berries are frozen. Garnish with chives. Serve right away at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: lettuce,apple,ham hock,sharp cheddar cheese,ciabatta,thyme sprig,beef broth,red wine vinegar
title: Country Style Bread Soup
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups cooked corned beef, coarsely shredded or 1 1/4 cups cooked ham, cut into cubes | 3 slices ciabatta | 1 1/2 cups cooked ham hocks or 1 1/2 cups dried ham hocks | 1 can beef broth | 1 teaspoon minced fresh thyme sprig | 1/2 medium apple, peeled, chopped fine | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons shredded reduced-fat sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to place bread slice into a large baking dish. Combine beef and the broth and pour over the bread slices. Cover with foil and bake for 15 minutes. Remove the foil and continue baking for 10 minutes until the bread is brown. Remove from oven and stir in the thyme and the apple. Puree soup in blender until smooth, season to taste and serve with a sprinkle of cheese on serve.

title: Baked Beans
ingredients: 300 g shredded smoked streaky bacon | 450 g kidney beans, soaked overnight and rinsed | 1 can diced tomatoes with juice
instructions: Pre heat oven to 190c/375f/gas mark grease a shallow, wide ovenproof dish. Fry bacon until crisp, breaking into small pieces as it cooks. Tip in beans then mix well. Scatter over the tomatoes then sprinkle with a little salt and pepper. Cover with foil and bake for 45 minutes, or until beans are tender and bacon browned on top.

Random Ingredients: yukon gold potato,garam masala powder,vinegar,flat leaf parsley,chili,cold water,green olive
title: Potatoes and Olives With Vinegar
ingredients: 2 lbs yukon gold potatoes, boiled and sliced thinly | 3 lbs green olives, pitted and sliced thinly | 1 tablespoon chili ( i've used jalapeno and habanero, but you still can use the chili ) | 2 teaspoons garam masala powder | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 1/2 cup cold water | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley
instructions: Place a small non stick skillet over medium high heat and add olive oil. When the oil is starting to smoke, add chili powder and garam masala and saute 1 minute. Stir in potatoes, olives and cold water. Cover and simmer 15 - 20 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Sprinkle with parsley, adjust salt and pepper to taste. Serve hot over your favourite vegetable of your choice.

title: Red Curry and Tripe (Aikens)
ingredients: 1 roasting chicken | 150 ml coconut oil | 1 medium roasting red pepper | 1 whole fresh red chili pepper, seeds removed
instructions: Cut the chicken into pieces and put into a pot. Heat the coconut oil. Turn the pieces over once or twice until evenly coated in the coconut oil. Add the whole red pepper and whole red chili pepper. Stir until chicken is well coated with the spices. Add enough water to the pot, cover and cook, adding more water as needed. Remove from the heat and allow to cool for an hour. Remove the chicken and the peppers. Cut the meat into small, bite sized pieces. Return it to the pot and heat through. Serve immediately over sticky rice.

title: Spanish Mushrooms and Leche
ingredients: 2 lbs large white mushrooms, sliced | 2 tablespoons sherry wine, divided | 1/2 cup brewed coffee beans | 1/4 cup drained canned bean curd, for topping
instructions: Combine the mushrooms and 1 tablespoon of the sherry in a bowl, and keep warm. Wipe out the bowl, adding the coffee and beans. Add the remaining sherry and the remaining sherry to taste, and mix well. Serve the mushrooms on platter.

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,italian breadcrumb,cheese,american cheese,caper,chili pepper flake,balsamic vinegar,parsley flake
title: Cheese Stuffed Vine Ripened Spinach
ingredients: 30 -35 fresh spinach leaves or 300 -35 spinach leaves, stems removed | 4 -6 slices american cheese ( or the 4 slices swiss or longhorn type ) | 4 tablespoons balsamic vinegar ( or white wine vinegar ) | parsley flakes ( optional ) | capers ( optional ) | chili pepper flakes ( optional ) | italian breadcrumbs | cheese, slices ( optional )
instructions: Note, if using fresh spinach leaves, steam until limp and wilted. Drain and squeeze dry with clean hands. Cut cheese in half longwise. Cut lengthwise and then crosswise into 1/2 slices. Sprinkle with parsley flakes and/or a pinch of cayenne pepper flakes if desired and mix. Set aside. Rinse spinach well. Wash and drain again and drain. Place a scoop of spinach filling between 2 slices of cheese on the spinach. Roll up and secure with toothpicks if necessary. Poke several holes in the cheese with a fork or skewer, just enough to hold cheese. Pour the balsamic vinegar over. Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate several hours or overnight to marinate. Prepare the rolls, slice the rolls as you want and serve with appetizers or salad greens. Top with grated cheese, sliced tomato, lettuce, and/or a small amount of pepper flakes if desired.

title: Homemade Mozzarella and Herbs (Polpette)
ingredients: 1 lb fresh mozzarella cheese, very finely crumbled | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram
instructions: In a skillet over low heat, melt the cheese, stirring and mixing until well melted. Stir in the marjoram. Serve as a side bread for a main course or with fresh vegetables for an appetizer. Variations add shredded or sliced romano cheese to make each pizza easier to manage.

title: Lemon and Chestnut White Bean Salad (Salatah)
ingredients: 4 ounces dried shiitake mushrooms | 4 ounces chestnut mushrooms, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon margarine or 1 tablespoon butter | 2 -4 teaspoons treacle ( optional ) | 1/2 cup skim milk ( or extra ) | 12 ounces small white beans, washed | 1-2 - 2 1/4 ounces dried chestnut mushrooms, halved lengthways ( optional ) | dried lemon peel, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Place dry shiitake mushrooms in a large bowl and add plenty of cold water to cover. Place the lid on and allow to soak while preparing the other ingredients. Drain the shiitake mushrooms and chestnut mushrooms reserving the water in the bowl. Using the back of a knife or knife, slice off and discard the woody stems and cut away any dark spots on mushrooms. Place the mushrooms and chestnuts in separate bowl and add the margarine or butter in small pieces. Place the treacle, milk and any of the reserved water in a medium saucepan and bring to the boil. Once boiling, pour over the fresh mushrooms and chestnuts, if using add the chestnut water to cover and stir. Once they are completely cool, strain the mushrooms and chestnuts. Cut the white beans in half lengthways, remove the hard, stem ends and slice or shred them into smaller squares. Transfer the sliced mushrooms and chestnuts to the bowl with the mixed white beans and optional dried chestnuts on top. Drizzle with the remaining melted butter or margarine if desired and refrigerate for one hour or until ready to serve. Garnish with dried lemon peel or fresh lemon peel and serve.

Random Ingredients: hot dog vegetarian,white wine,baby lima bean
title: Vietnamese Hot Dogs
ingredients: 1 cup baby lima beans | 1/3 cup dry white wine or 1/3 cup vegetarian beer | 1 cup hot dogs ( vegetarian-style of your choice ) or 1 cup vegetarian crumbles ( vegetarian-style of your choice )
instructions: Place lima beans in small pot and cover with water.

title: Pancake
ingredients: 1 cup baked beans | 1 cup toasted almonds | salt and pepper
instructions: Place baked beans, and almond in a food processor. Grind until smooth. Add salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,monterey jack cheese,beef,farfalle pasta,black peppercorn
title: Baked Beef and Onions
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground beef | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 tablespoon black peppercorns, freshly cracked | 2 cups grated monterey jack cheese, divided | 24 ounces farfalle pasta
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Cook beef in 10 inch skillet until lightly browned and crumbly, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks. Drain grease. Stir in cocoa and black pepper.

title: Trufflefontina (Farcis Paste)
ingredients: 2 cups fontina cheese, grated | 3 tablespoons orange flower water | nutmeg, grated
instructions: Grind the fontina and orange flower water together. Add grated nutmeg.

Random Ingredients: spring wrapper,lemon zest,phyllo pastry,sake,red cabbage,red lentil
title: Vege's Spring Baskets
ingredients: 500 g red lentils, rinsed and drained | 2 spring roll wrappers | 1 bunch red cabbage, shredded | 1/3 cup red lentil, rinsed and drained | 2 teaspoons lemon zest, grated | 1 tablespoon sake | 2 sheets phyllo pastry
instructions: Place the lentils and the flour into a food processor, add the zest, sugar, sake and enough water to make a thick paste. Place the mixture on a chopping board, and work with hands to form a rough paste. Place a tablespoon of paste on each sheet of pastry. Roll with your hands into a 1 1/2 cm thick log, and place on baking paper lined trays. Brush with milk. Bake on 190 c for 20 minutes, until the rolls are golden. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,onion powder,navy bean,rabbit,vermicelli,honey,spaghetti sauce
title: Rabbit With White Bean & Noodles
ingredients: 3 cups vermicelli ( cooked, dry or fresh is possible ) | 1 rabbit, cleaned and cut into 1 to 2 pieces | 1 onion, sliced thin | 3/4 cup honey | 10 1/2 ounces spaghetti sauce | 1 1/2 cups heavy whipping cream | 1 1/2 teaspoons onion powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Lightly grease a 9 x13 inch casserole dish. Place vermicelli into a large pot of cold water and cook until crisp and no longer translucent.

Random Ingredients: fennel seed,leek,kosher salt,superfine sugar,pasta sauce,olive oil cooking spray,chicken wing
title: Lek and Leek Grilled Wings
ingredients: olive oil flavored cooking spray | 3 leeks, cleaned and sliced on the diagnonal | 3 whole chickens wings, cleaned and patted dry | kosher salt, to taste | 1 teaspoon fennel seed, crushed | 1 cup spaghetti sauce, homemade or from a jar of your favorite jars | 2 tablespoons superfine sugar, plus more for sprinkling
instructions: Preheat a grill pan to 400 degrees. Line a large, rimmed baking sheet with reynolds wrap foil. Place the leeks on the baking sheet and sprinkle with salt. Drizzle both sides with olive oil spray. Roast in the center of the grill for 15 minutes, flip once, or until tender, and cool enough to handle. Remove the white pith from the leeks at the root end and trim the white root end, reserving the root and some for another use. Slice the leeks 1/2 inch thick. Place the chicken wings on the lined baking sheet and toast, flipping once, until just pale golden, 2 to 4 minutes per side. Remove the wings from the heat and cool completely. Arrange the leeks in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet, and sprinkle with salt and fennel seeds. Pour enough spaghetti sauce into the jar to cover the wings, leaving about 1 1/4 inches of headspace. Bring to a boil over medium heat and cook, covered, 1 minute, then lower the heat to maintain a simmer and cook, uncovered, 10 minutes. Turn off the heat and keep the sauce hot. Stir together the sauce and sugar in a small bowl. Remove and discard the wing tips from the chicken wings. Sprinkle the wings with salt. Transfer the wings to a serving platter or individual plates and serve warm or at room temperature. Garnish with reserved fennel root.

title: Chipotle Honey Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb chicken breast, sliced to 1/4 in thick | 8 ounces chipotle chiles | 3 tablespoons honey | 3 tablespoons vinegar | 2 teaspoons ajwain ( optional )
instructions: Drain canned chipotles in coffee filter set over 2 - 3 cups boiling water. Drain chipotles and place in blender. Add honey, vinegar, and ajwain, if using and blend to desired thickness. Place chicken in crockpot place on top of chipotle mixture. Pour remaining sauce over chicken. Cook on low for 10 - 12 hours. Serve with steamed rice. If desired, serve with a side salad.

title: Sweet Rice and Sage Rice
ingredients: 4 cups long grain rice | 2/3 cup brown sugar | 2 -4 fresh sage leaves | 1 teaspoon dried rubbed sage ( optional )
instructions: Wash rice thoroughly and drain. Place 3 to 4 cups boiling water over high heat in a large, deep heavy pot. When water boils, stir in rice, sugar, sage, and sage leaves. Return to boil, reduce temperature to low, and simmer with covered lid for about 35 to 45 minutes to 1 hr, or until rice is creamy and tender. Remove from heat, cover, and allow to stand for 10 minutes or longer to steam dry spots.

title: Italian Pork Chop, Spinach & Peppers Pizza
ingredients: 6 pork chops, about 3-4 ounces each | 1 package fresh spinach, washed and chopped | 2 cans pizza sauce | 2 tablespoons pepperoni, chopped | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 teaspoon salt | 1/2 teaspoon msg | 1 cup water, if using canned sauce
instructions: Using two forks, shred pork chops into 1/4 inch shreds and set aside. Place chopped spinach into a bowl then add a few tablespoons of water. Stir. Set aside. In a saucepan combine the pizza sauce, pepperoni, vanilla extract powder, salt and msg. Add cooked pork and cook thoroughly. Add sauce mixture to spinach and cook until sauce is slightly thickened. Pour over pork chops.

Random Ingredients: corn chip,mussel,irish cream,pork butt,baby spinach,cardamom pod,farfalle pasta
title: Scotch Steak Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb boneless pork butt ( or thick-cut loin ) | 1 lb farfalle pasta | 8 -10 large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 cup baby spinach | 2 packages of trader joe's corn chips ( i prefer the sweet and sour ) | 1 cup irish cream | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon ground cardamom pod
instructions: In a 9 x 13 inch baking dish, sprinkle the pork over the pasta and marinate in the refrigerator for one hour. Prepare the shrimp, lobster pieces and mussels by soaking in the shrimp/mussels for 5 minutes. When ready to use, drain and add to salad bowl. If using shrimp/mussels in sauce, rinse under cold water. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. When it comes to a boil, after about 7 minutes, put in the farfalle pasta and cook according to package directions. You may need to add a little water to prevent the pasta from sticking together while cooking. Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Remove the meat from the marinade and reserve. Using a meat mallot, or your fingers, make a slice on each shrimp or lobster piece. Insert a thin slice of the meat into each shrimp/mussel, then put a generous amount of spinach into each shrimp/mussel. Next, sprinkle with some of the baby spinach to cover. Pour enough ice water over the shrimp/mussels to just cover. Place the shrimp/mussels in the baking dish and cover with foil. Bake for 20 minutes. Remove from oven. You should have enough liquid in the pan to just cover all of the shrimp and lobster. In a small bowl, add the corn chips, the irish cream, the cardamon pod, and a cup of water. If you don't have an irish cream, substitute a light cream. After 20 - 25 minutes, test to see if the shrimp/mussels are done by piercing the center. If they don't open, take them out and put on another burner for another 5 minutes. Remove from burner and take off the oven. Let sit for 5 - 10 minutes, or until the shrimp/mussels are cooked through. Discard any unopened shells. Note, this is a great time to soak up the leftovers from the shrimp.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,sesame paste,lime juice,extra virgin olive oil,horseradish
title: Sesame Soy Dipping Sauces
ingredients: 1/4 cup sesame paste ( sesame ) | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 1/4 cup lime juice | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 3 tablespoons grated horseradish
instructions: Place sesame paste in bowl of a food processor fitted with the metal blade. Add onion soup mix, lime juice and olive oil, and process until smooth. Drain soy sauce and whisk in until well blended. Pour soy sauce mixture into a small bowl and stir in horseradish. Serve at room temperature.

title: Kartoshnik
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1 frozen pizza dough, thawed | 12 cubes ice
instructions: Place dough in a freezer bag. Freeze at least 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Remove dough from bag. Roll dough out onto a clean, lightly floured work surface. Cut out eight 2 inch long pieces to make 12 smaller circles. Working with one piece at a time, place a teaspoon or two of yogurt in the center of each circle. Fold over, and seal. Repeat until dough has been used. Place on a parchment paper lined baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven 10 to 15 minutes, or until golden.

title: Grilled Salmon on Refried Beans
ingredients: 2 cans baked beans | 1 1/2 lbs salmon fillets
instructions: Place beans in a shallow dish. Place salmon fillet, skin side down, over the beans. Spread beans evenly, with just enough to coat the salmon with a coating of coating of coating. Wrap in paper towels and grill, basting several times with baste, until fish is cooked through. Serve with additional salsa for dipping. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: lettuce leaf,chinese five spice powder,penne pasta,grand marnier,egg yolk,peppercorn,red curry paste,arugula
title: Quick and Easy Thai Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 lb penne pasta | 1 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 3 tablespoons red curry paste or 3 tablespoons curry powder | 3 tablespoons grand marnier or 3 tablespoons brandy | 2 egg yolks, slightly beaten | peppercorn | lettuce leaf | arugula
instructions: Cook pasta to al dente texture to your liking, drain in a large mixing bowl and place in the refrigerator. While the pasta is cooking mix together the five spice and curry powder and chill for 2 - 3 minutes to make a paste. When pasta is ready to go, combine with the curry paste/pancake mix and continue to toss until it is amalgamated with the contents of the bowl. Add the yolks, peppercorns and chilli and mix well. Place 1/2 of the pasta mixture in the centre of a large spring roll or salad plate and top with lettuce and arugula leaf. Sprinkle with reserved curry powder. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: mandarin orange,pepperoncini pepper,chili pepper flake,sesame oil,wheat flour,chickpea
title: Mandarin-Pear Sprouts With Peppers
ingredients: 3 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 2 tablespoons canned chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 2 tablespoons canned mandarin oranges, drained and quartered | 1 1/2 teaspoons sesame oil | 1/4 teaspoon dried hot chili pepper flakes | 1/4 cup pepperoncini pepper, drained and chopped
instructions: Whisk flour, chickpeas and oranges in medium bowl to blend. Heat oil in large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add chili and pepper flakes. Cook and stir until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Add sprouts and 1/4 cup water. Cook and stir 2 minutes or until coated. Serve sprinkled with pepperoncinis.

Random Ingredients: rom tomato,beef stew meat,beef bouillon cube,vinegar,beef liver
title: Liver and Beef Stew (For a Crowd)
ingredients: 3 lbs beef stew meat, cut into 1-inch chunks | 3 lbs beef liver, cut into 1-inch pieces ( optional ) | 1 can whole roma tomatoes, undrained | 1 1/2 tablespoons beef bouillon cubes | 3 tablespoons vinegar ( optional )
instructions: Brown meat on all sides in 1 t. Oil in stew pot. Add remaining ingredients and bring to a boil. Cover, reduce heat to lowest simmer and cook 3 hours, or until meat is tender. Stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt pepper,cumin powder,salt black pepper,ricotta,heavy cream
title: Lasagna Bites
ingredients: 5 tablespoons heavy cream, approximately | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 lb ricotta | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: The following day, place the heavy cream in a small bowl and microwave it for about 5 seconds to loosen the cream. You will know this is the authentic way of making lasagna. Turn the cream/cream out of the microwave then quickly stir in the cumin powder and 1/2 tsp of salt. Mix to combine. In a large bowl, mix the ricotta and remaining 1/2 tsp of salt and 1/4 cup of heavy cream. Using your fingers, gently mix the cream and ricotta till blended. Turn on the oven and let the mixture sit for 15 minutes. When the 15 minutes have passed, stir the mixture again and transfer it to your baking sheet.. Using a sharp knife, score the top surface of the ricotta mixture into six bite sized pieces. Put them on their sides and continue to score for another 5 minutes. Bake for 10 minutes at 375 degrees. Turn off the oven and set the lasagna aside in the refrigerator for 15 minutes. Serve on toothpicks, with butter, parmesan parmesan if desired.

title: Low-Fat French Onion Soup
ingredients: 4 tablespoons margarine or 4 tablespoons olive oil | 6 large dried sweet italian herbs | 32 ounces vegetable stock | 1 teaspoon lime zest, grated | 1 large bouillon, cube | 1 bag assorted fresh mixed berries | fresh ground mixed herb ( to garnish )
instructions: In a large soup pot, warm 2 tablespoons of butter or oil over medium high heat. Add chopped herbs, onion, stock and lime peel and bouillon cube. Bring to a boil and allow to boil for about 20 minutes. Stir in fresh berries and simmer for five minutes. Serve hot garnished with fresh mixed herb.

title: Guatemalan Bean and Pastry Parcels
ingredients: 1 sheet frozen puff pastry | 200 g green beans, cut on the diagonal into 2 pieces | 400 g cannellini beans, cut in half ( or great northern beans ) | 1 tablespoon espresso | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 200 g hass avocadoes, halved, pit removed, and flesh diced | spices, to taste ( such as garlic, ginger, salt, thyme, and other herbs. )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Take the pastry sheet out of the freezer and defrost it. Cut the pastry in half at an angle until you have half a sheet of pastry. Cover the bottom half of the pastry with a layer of beans in a crosswise pattern. Drain the beans from their liquid, if any. Pour water into a medium size pan. Over medium heat, gently melt the beans with the espresso. Add the cornstarch to the water and stir until thickened.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,hot chili pepper,orange juice concentrate,chickpea flour,plain yogurt,rye bread
title: Chickpea Flour Crunch
ingredients: 1/2 kg chickpea flour | 3 large red bell peppers, roughly chopped | 375 ml plain yogurt, well chilled | 300 ml orange juice concentrate, well chilled | hot chili pepper, to taste | 2 slices rye bread, toasted
instructions: Place the gram flour, bell peppers, and yoghurt into a mixing bowl, add hot chilli and finely grind until the mixture resembles fine breadcrumbs. Add the flour mixture to the yoghurt in the bowl and gently mix well, adding extra flour as necessary. Cover the bowl and leave to ferment for 24 hours at room temperature until it forms firm, sticky, batter like coating. Preheat the oven to 180 deg c/350 deg f/gas line a tray with baking paper and make sure the tray has a non stick baking liner or a removable bottom. Place the batter on the baking paper and flatten lightly with the bottom of a glass or metal spoon. Bake in the oven for 10 - 15 minutes, or until the breadcrumb mixture is golden, crisp and lightly browned. Leave the tray on a wire rack to cool before taking it off the oven. Leave the crispbread chunks on the tray in a serving platter, then leave them to cool completely. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage link,sazon goya seasoning,purpose flour,pancetta,fig,creole seasoning
title: Italian Style Crispy Pancetta Chips #SP5
ingredients: 4 tablespoons pancetta, chopped | 1 italian sausage link, casing removed and crumbled ( about 4 links ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 tablespoon creole seasoning | 1 teaspoon creole seasoning | 1 packet sazon goya with azafran seasoning | 1/2 cup chopped italian sausage, cooked
instructions: Preheat oven on broiler setting.

title: Chinese New Year's Eve Eggs
ingredients: 6 eggs | 4 ounces chow mein noodles | 1 small bell pepper, chopped
instructions: Place egg whites in the top of a double boiler. Set over boiling water. Heat just until the whites form a white foam.

title: Broken Okra
ingredients: 1 lb fresh okra, trimmed | 1 large beef stock cube | ice
instructions: Blanch the okra until cooked. Remove okra, and place into a shallow roasting tin. Place the okra on top of the okra, and drizzle with any sauce left in the pan. Squeeze the stock cube into the okra juices, and place into the oven on 350f for 1 hour, checking the okra after 20 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Roasted Red Chile Sesame Oil
ingredients: 2 dried whole red chilies | 4 serrano peppers, sliced lengthwise to yield 4 strips | 1/2 cup sesame oil ( sunflower or soybean oil ) | 1/4 cup shortening | 2 tablespoons hot dark hot sririchacha brandy ( vietnamese hot red chile powder ) | 1 teaspoon cajun seasoning
instructions: Using tongs or a wide shallow metal bowl, lightly toast the chilies with the serrano peppers until they begin to blacken and change color, 3 - 4 minutes per side. Turn off heat and set aside to cool. When cool enough to handle, remove the stems and chilies with seeds and ribs and finely dice them. Heat the oil in a small saucepan over medium heat. Add in the shortening, the chilies, brandy, and 1 teaspoon of the cajun spice.

title: Okinawa Style Noodles - Buchari Style
ingredients: 1 package kamaboko, cut into 1 '' squares ( dried fish from asian grocery aisle ) | 1 lb large baking potato | 3 1/2 cups uncooked rice noodles | 5 1/2 cups water | 1 1/2 lbs cabbage mix | 1 medium-large baking potato ( sliced ) | 1 large tomatoes, cut into 1 '' | 1/2 cup lime juice ( freshly squeezed )
instructions: Cut kamaboko into 1½'' squares then cut potatoes into 3/4'' pieces, boil covered kamaboko for 20 minutes then rinse with cold water. Boil rice stick noodles 1 minute then drain. Bring water to boil then boil covered kamaboko for 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,cumin powder,chili,onion powder,dark sesame oil,macaroni,ginger garlic paste
title: Dry Macaroni Snack Sandwich
ingredients: 1 -2 slice rye bread | 1 teaspoon chili ( i use 2 ) | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 teaspoon dry crushed cumin powder ( about 1/2 tsp ) | 1/4 teaspoon onion powder | 1/4 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1/4 cup macaroni
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f degrees. Place bread slices on a parchment lined baking sheet. Brush with some of the sesame oil. In a small bowl mix together the chilli, ginger garlic paste, cumin, onion and sesame oil. Sprinkle evenly over the bread. Bake on the middle shelf of oven for 13 minutes or until lightly golden. Cut into small squares and serve.

title: Sausage in a Yogurt Crumble
ingredients: 1 cup low-fat plain yogurt | 1/2 cup diced italian sausage | 3 -4 canned chipotle chiles
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or an aluminum foil. Stir together yogurt, sausage, and chiles. Spread mixture onto prepared baking sheet in a single layer. Roast for 30 - 40 minutes or till browned and sausage is cooked through.

title: Pixie Dust Rolls
ingredients: 2 slices ham hocks | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 2 ounces pimentos | 2 tablespoons self-raising flour | 4 tortillas, 5inch
instructions: Place flour in a bowl and season with salt and pepper. Finely chop ham hock and put in with raisins. Mix well. Roll the mixture into four long cylinders or 4 large oval loaves about 3 in diameter. Wrap each one in a slice of cheese or a pimento. Place on a greased oven tray and bake at 180c for 20 minutes until well risen. Serve warm with cream sauce or cream.

title: Creamy Tamarind and Potato Lettuce Salad
ingredients: 1 cup tamarind pulp, pulp, seeds removed | 8 medium red potatoes, thinly sliced | 12 ounces butter lettuce, torn into pieces | 1/4 cup malt vinegar | 1 tablespoon ground ginger | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Drain tamarind pulp and place in a bowl with the potatoes. Cover and refrigerate. Place lettuce in a large salad bowl with the butter, vinegar, ginger and vanilla. Toss until well coated. Serve at once or store in the fridge until required.

Random Ingredients: thai chile,berry,salt black pepper,egg yolk,marinara sauce,strawberry
title: Strawberry and Thai Chile Gratin
ingredients: 12 egg yolks | 450 g strawberries, cleaned, hulled and finely chopped | 6 thai chiles, whole and finely chopped | 1/2 cup marinara sauce | 450 g fresh strawberries, washed, hulled, diced ( approximately 4 cups ) | 150 g fresh strawberries, cleaned, hulled and diced ( approximately 4 cups ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven the 350 degrees f. Line the bottom and sides of a 7 x 11 glass baking dish with parchment paper. Whisk the egg yolks in a large bowl with a mixer until pale and creamy, 2 to 3 minutes. Add the remaining ingredients, a little at a time, and whisk until just incorporated. Transfer the mixture to the lined pan and spread evenly over the base and sides. Bake until the top is golden brown, 1 hour 30 minutes. Let stand for 10 minutes before releasing the sides. If you want to be more labor intensive and more labor intensive, try to slice and slice the vegetables. Serve the gratin in bite sized pieces.

Random Ingredients: tomato ketchup,cumin,soy sauce,hard egg,onion powder,celery,cayenne pepper,tomato juice
title: Chinese-style Deviled Eggs
ingredients: 1 large hard-boiled egg, chopped | 1/4 cup celery, chopped | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1/4 teaspoon cumin | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/4 cup soy sauce | 1 ounce tomato ketchup | 1 teaspoon tomato juice
instructions: Heat the broiler or frypan. In a medium bowl, combine the egg, celery, onion powder, cumin, cayenne pepper, soy sauce, ketchup, and tomato juice. Place half the egg mixture over the bottom of a 2 to 2 1/2 quart baking dish, covering the bottom and up the sides. Spread remaining egg mixture over the top. Broil until egg begins to set, about 10 minutes, watching carefully. Remove from broiler and place on a serving platter. Serve at once. The egg mixture can also be made ahead and frozen in an airtight container for up to 2 months.

Random Ingredients: red radish,dijon mustard,chicken,cherry tomato,green chili pepper,kahlua,poultry seasoning
title: Grilled Veal and Chicken Sandwich (Kahlua)
ingredients: 1 lb thinly sliced veal ( i prefer to use the deli type ) | 1 cup cherry tomatoes ( halves ) | 1/2 cup red radish ( thin strips ) | 1 green chili pepper | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1/4 cup kahlua | 1/4 teaspoon poultry seasoning | 1/8 teaspoon dried cherries or 1/8 teaspoon dill ( to garnish )
instructions: Place the cherry tomatoes on a plate so they don't open up while they chill up heat grill over medium heat place veal in the grill with tomatoes, red bell pepper and chili. Let cook about 5 minutes sprinkle with mustard and add remaining ingredients grill for 5 minutes or until chicken is cooked.

Random Ingredients: cannellini bean,canadian bacon,malt vinegar,orange juice concentrate,green food coloring,olive,veal,vegetable pepper
title: Veal Cannellini Beans
ingredients: 2 lbs veal pieces | 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can sliced ripe olives, with liquid | 2 -4 slices canadian bacon, chopped ( optional ) | 1 can frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed and undiluted | 1/4 cup malt vinegar | 2 -3 drops green food coloring | 1 package v8 vegetable oil or ( 6 3/4 ounce ) package canola oil
instructions: Sprinkle veal with salt and pepper and brown in oil on the outside in a skillet, about 5 - 7 minutes. Remove to a plate. Add orange juice to pan and heat to boiling. Add vinegar and food coloring to the pan and boil uncovered 2 to 3 minutes. Add veal and cover. Cook 5 minutes or until meat falls from bone. Remove meat. Remove fat.

Random Ingredients: lima bean,shell pasta,heavy cream,mirin,corn oil,brown lentil
title: Lebanese Three Sisters' Pasta With Corn Flour
ingredients: 2 cups brown lentils, washed and drained | 4 cups lima beans, cleaned and washed | 2 cups heavy cream | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 1 tablespoon mirin ( sweet japanese sweet sauce ) | 2 cups small shell pasta ( i used yakisoba noodles )
instructions: Place the brown lentils in a saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil and then decrease to a simmer and cook until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain the lentils and add to the pot of cold water. Bring to a boil again and then transfer to a colander and run under cold running water. Repeat this 2 - 3 times in another pot. Set aside and allow to cool. When the lentils are sufficiently cooled to handle, drain and mash very well with a potato masher or a hand held blender. Set aside. Heat a 6 cup of water in a large skillet over high heat. When hot, add the lima beans and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly. Then mix in the cream and bring to a boil. Boil another 2 minutes, stirring continually. Then mix in the corn oil and mirin and cook for 1 - 2 more minutes. While that is heating, pasta water should be boiling. Cook half the noodles in boiling water, drain and add to the sauce, stirring to coat the pasta. Keep the pasta hot and spoon the noodle mixture over the pasta before serving. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: extra tofu,cumin powder,tart apple,red chilies,sage leaf,sun tomato
title: Tofu-Spités
ingredients: 3 firm tofu, cut into 8 strips, lengthwise | 1 cup tart apple | 3 fresh hot red chilies, slit lengthwise ( or to taste ) | 2 teaspoons extra firm tofu, drained and chopped | 1 teaspoon cumin powder ( or a mixture of both ) or 1 teaspoon ground cardamom ( or a mixture of both ) | 1/3 cup chopped fresh sage leaf
instructions: Cut the tofu lengthwise into 8 strips. Toss with the chillies, then sprinkle with the cumin powder. Place the sage on a serving platter. Cover with the tofu and serve.

Random Ingredients: taco sauce,bread flour,mustard,onion white,almond,kosher salt black pepper,sugar,artificial sweetener
title: Bread Machine Spanish Chicken
ingredients: 1 large loaf crusty bread flour | kosher salt and black pepper | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard | 1 packet artificial sweetener | 1/2 cup sliced almonds | 2 -4 tablespoons prepared taco sauce ( low-sodium ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons dry onion seeds ( white or brown )
instructions: Slice the bread into 1/4 inch thick slices and set aside. Cut a slit on one side of each bread piece. Place flour in a large bowl, season with salt, pepper and mustard. Spread artificial sweetener on the top of the flour. Top with remaining bread slices, cut side down. Place a sliver of almonds on top of each slice. Sprinkle taco sauce and sugar over top. Toss with the dry onion seeds. Place bread in the order recommended by the manufacturer. Close machine and press start.

Random Ingredients: lemon twist,caper,kalamata olive,shrimp bouillon cube,szechuan peppercorn,self rising flour,parsley,golden raisin
title: Szechuan Shrimp Dumplings
ingredients: 12 ounces medium shrimp bouillon cubes | 1 1/2 cups self-rising flour | 1/2 cup fresh parsley, chopped | 1/3 cup golden raisin ( optional ) | 1/3 cup pitted kalamata olive, chopped | 1 pinch szechuan peppercorns, crushed | 1 pinch lemon twists ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon capers ( optional )
instructions: Place shrimp buillon cubes in a bowl. Pour water in bowl and add the flour, parsley, raisins and olives to the bouillon. Place small spoonful of the mixture in a well buttered bowl. Sprinkle with szechuan peppercorns. Gather the sides and bottom of the bowl. Roll dough into a circle shape about 2 in diameter until it is completely covered. Bring left and right corners around to bottom. Bring bottom and right corners to center and continue rolling the dough, moistening each side of the dough with oil and water as necessary. Bring two opposite corners together and pinch with a pinch on the rim of a small bowl. Repeat steps 2 - 6 until the previous step is finished. Cover the bowl and refrigerate overnight. Remove it from the refrigerator one hour before cooking. To cook, bring 2 qt water to a boil. Add 1/3 of the shrimp buillon mixture and boil for 3 minutes. Remove from heat. Take out shrimp and add more water if mixture becomes dry. Cover and let sit for 1 - 2 minutes. Strain shrimp water. Serve with sauce, if desired.

title: Chocolate Cheese Toast
ingredients: 3 slices rye bread | 1/2 cup milk chocolate | 1 piece cucumber, peeled and diced | 4 ounces fresh green chilies, chopped | 1 tablespoon flour
instructions: Place the rye bread in a single layer on a baking sheet. Combine the chocolate, cucumber, and chilies in a bowl.

title: Lebanese Style Smoked Salmon and Okra
ingredients: 1 lb smoked ham or 1 lb salami, cut into bite-size pieces ( about 2 pounds in total ) | 1/2 cup smoked okra, cut into 1/4-inch slices ( about 4 ounces ) | 2 quarts lamb shoulder, with bone, cut into bite-size pieces | 1 lemon, thinly sliced | 1 onion powder | 1/4 - 1/2 cup strong tea ( recommended -- earl grey ) | hard-boiled egg | onion powder, to taste
instructions: In a large saucepan, heat the smoked ham over medium heat until hot but not quite smoking. Remove ham from pan and saute in olive oil in 2 batches for 3 to 4 minutes or until browned. Remove ham, leaving 1/2 to 1 tablespoon drippings in pan. Combine the okra slices, lamb, lemon slices and onion powder in a large bowl. Add the ham drippings back to the pot and mix in well. Cover and cook 1 hour over low heat, or until meat is tender, stirring once. Add tea, stirring frequently until the tea dissolves. Serve with hard boiled eggs and onion powder.

Random Ingredients: italian plum tomato,dill,thyme sprig,arborio rice,thai fish sauce,chocolate
title: Fruit & Nut Risotto
ingredients: 1/2 cup arborio rice | 1/2 cup unsweetened chocolate, very finely chopped | 1/2 cup dried italian plum tomato, chopped | 1 tablespoon thai fish sauce | 4 fresh thyme sprigs | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh dill
instructions: Place arborio in a medium bowl, pour boiling water over, and set aside to soak about 15 minutes. Meanwhile, melt the chocolate in a small dry, heavy saucepan over high heat, stirring until smooth. Remove the pan from the heat and add the plum tomatoes and fish sauce. Return to a low heat. Garnish with thyme, and serve immediately with the arborio.

title: Sage & Kahlua Pie
ingredients: 4 sheets phyllo pastry, thawed | 4 -5 pieces leaves thyme or 4 -5 leaves sage | 1/2 - 3/4 cup kahlua
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c with the rack on the lowest level. Line a jelly roll pan with foil. Place phyllo pastry in the oven on a baking tray. Brush the pastry with some of the kahlua. Add a pinch of sage to the end of the pastry. Bake in the oven for about 20 min or until golden brown. Remove from the oven and allow to cool.

Random Ingredients: spicy sausage,chicken stock,cilantro leaf,cilantro stem,wonton wrapper,italian parsley,cumin,vanilla pudding
title: Puerto Rican Meat-Spice Bundles
ingredients: 2 links spicy sausage, casings removed, crumbled | 2 packages wonton wrappers | 1 package instant vanilla pudding | 1 1/2 cups chicken stock | 2 tablespoons fresh cilantro leaves | 1 tablespoon fresh italian parsley | 1 tablespoon fresh cilantro stem | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin ( or to taste ) | 1 teaspoon dried cilantro stems
instructions: Make the spice bundles, in a bowl, combine all ingredients except for the wonton wrappers. Place about a teaspoon of spice bundle lengthwise onto a wrapper. Moisten the edges of the wrapper with water and fold the wrapper in half diagonally, pleating the edges up and over the meat. Press together at the edges and pinch the ends to seal. Make ahead directions, wrap meat bundles in plastic wrap and place in refrigerator. Preheat the oven to 375°f. Bake for 30 minutes. If the meat is browning too quickly, cover with a piece of foil. If the meat freezes well, place foil over the meat and return it to the oven. Bake 10 more minutes or until the internal temperature reaches 165°f. Cool for a few minutes using aluminum foil on a rack. Unwrap the bundles and serve hot, dusted with the remaining spice mix. Note, can be frozen for up to three months. Cook times may vary based on the size of cashews used. Cooking time assumes the baking package is a preheated oven, oven temperature is 115°f.

Random Ingredients: beef brisket,pepper flake,extra virgin olive oil,hazelnut,almond butter
title: Swiss Baked Brisket With Hazelnuts
ingredients: 2 -4 lbs beef brisket | 6 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 3 tablespoons fresh ground pepper flakes ( optional ) | 1/4 cup hazelnuts, toasted lightly, chopped ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons almond butter
instructions: Heat oven to 450 degrees. Heat olive oil in heavy large ovenproof, heavy duty roasting pan over high heat. Season brisket with pepper flakes, if desired. Add beef to pan. Sprinkle with hazelnuts. Bake 10 minutes. Transfer meat to platter.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,potato,tahini,chicken bouillon granule,chicken bouillon,parsnip
title: Tikka Potatoes and Parsnips
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds potatoes, peeled and chunked | 12 small parsnips, peeled and chunked | 8 ounces red curry paste, or to taste | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon granules | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon liquid, or as desired | 1/3 cup tahini
instructions: Combine potatoes, parsnips, red curry paste, and chicken bouillon in a saucepan, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium low, and simmer until potatoes are tender but still firm, about 15 minutes.

title: Raspberry & Bread Stainer
ingredients: 2 liters mixed fresh raspberries ( drained and rinsed ) or 2 liters pitted ripe raspberries ( drained and rinsed ) | 250 g grated cheesecloth | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 small onion
instructions: Wash raspberries and remove any hard pieces or stones. Put them in a strainer and pour boiling water over until they float to the top. Remove from heat and allow to rest for 3 hours until cool. Drain and discard rinds and place raspberries in food processor, processing to smooth texture, add grated cheese and process until smooth. Sieve through a cheese cloth over a clean surface and discard rinds and any remaining juice. Add more cheese if necessary. Fry onion in olive oil until translucent and stir in berries. Place raspberries on a cloth for 10 minutes to drain excess water. Pour mixture through cloth and squeeze mixture through cloth to release liquid. Place in large bowl. Serve as is or top with cheese and chopped green olives. Garnish as desired with fresh parsley, or serve with crusty bread rounds.

title: Swiss Cheese & Green Onion Puffs
ingredients: 1 sheet puff pastry | 1/2 cup swiss cheese, shredded | 2 green onions, thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Roll pastry sheets until they are approximately 1/16 inch thick, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter. Cut sheets into 2 even circles, using 2 pastry cutter fingers. Place 1/2 cup cheese, 1 tbsp onions and 1/4 cup water in the center of each circle. Wrap dough around cheese and onion. Seal edges, using a fork. Place on baking sheet.. Brush tops with egg wash. Bake until puffed and golden, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven and carefully slide on foil to finish baking. Let stand to cool 5 minutes before slicing.

title: Quick & Easy Mexican Meat Loaf
ingredients: 1/2 kg frozen burger meat, chopped fine | 250 ml self-rising flour | 1 kg vegetable stock | 3 tablespoons chunky salsa | 1 teaspoon salt
instructions: Place meat in a mixing bowl and add the flour, salsa, salt and salt. Mix together until well combined. Transfer to a casserole dish and bake at 160°c for 1 hour and 30 minutes or until meat thermometer reads 180°c. Remove the loaf from the oven and let stand for 10 minutes then cut into slices or sticks and serve.

Random Ingredients: fruit,corn tortilla,vegetable oil cooking spray,apple,scallop,lemon zest,black vinegar
title: Fish Tacos with Apple and Scallops
ingredients: 2 corn tortillas or 1 flour tortilla | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 package scallops, halved crosswise and thinly sliced | 2 cups shredded apples | 1 lemon, zest of | 1/4 cup black vinegar | 1 cup fruit, chopped, any flavor
instructions: Lightly paint the bottom of a large nonstick skillet with oil spray. Place tortillas, one at a time, on the hot skillet. Cook, turning once, until lightly charred and slightly crisp, about 10 seconds per side. Arrange the tortillas on a plate, cover with foil and keep warm. In a skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of the oil over moderate heat. Add scallops, apples, juice of lemon and 2 tablespoons vinegar. Reduce heat to low, cover and cook, stirring occassionally for 5 minutes or until the scallops are cooked. Transfer the scallops to a serving platter and spoon over the fruit and sauce. Serve. Enjoy.

title: Pomegranate Chutney
ingredients: 1 cup pomegranate juice, freshly made | 8 fresh rosemary sprigs | 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg | 3/4 teaspoon crushed chili pepper flakes ( or more if you like a more spicy kick )
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together the pomegranate juice, rosemary sprigs, nutmeg, and chile. Cover tightly with plastic wrap, and allow to sit at room temperature for 2 hours, stirring occasionally to combine. Enjoy.

title: Sauteed Snow Peas With Crisp Cheese (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry white or wheat saffron or 2 tablespoons saffron-infused clarified butter | 4 ounces snow peas, halved lengthways ( or 2 bags frozen snow peas ) | 8 thin slices medium tart apples | 32 fluid ounces hot vegetable stock or 32 fluid ounces canned broth | 1/2 cup grated mature farmhouse cheese ( such as montracher ) or 1/2 cup queso fresco, coarsely crumbled | 2 green cardamom pods, seeded and crushed
instructions: Preheat broiler. In a heatproof bowl, cover the saffron threads with about 1 t warm water.

title: Kiwifruit Dip
ingredients: 1 kiwi fruit, peeled and sliced | 1 teaspoon tomato paste
instructions: Place kiwifruit into a small serving bowl and mash with a potato masher. Add tomato paste and stir to combine. Serve chilled.

title: Spicy Baked Fish
ingredients: 2 cod fish fillets | 8 ounces chili sauce ( kikkoman brand preferred )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Mix the chili sauce and the fish together. Slice in half and place on a baking dish. Bake for about half an hour, basting often with the chili sauce mixture, until cooked all the way through.

title: Penne With Beef
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 2 cans diced red chilies ( mild, hot ) | 1 medium red onion, chopped | 1 package penne, uncooked
instructions: Cook beef until no longer pink. Drain beef.

Random Ingredients: vegetable broth,spring onion,silver beet,ziti pasta,italian parsley,tamarind juice,molasses
title: Ziti With Winter Vegetables
ingredients: 2 cups vegetable broth | 1/4 cup tamarind juice, liquid | 2 tablespoons molasses | 500 g ziti pasta | 40 g silver beet, leaves, coarsely chopped | 2 spring onions, sliced | 1/2 cup italian parsley, coarsely chopped
instructions: Bring the broth and tamarind liquid to a boil in a large pan. Add the ziti and cook for 4 - 5 minutes until they are just tender, stirring occasionally. Add the silver beet and onions and cook for a minute, or two only. Add the molasses and parsley and cook for a further minute, or two just until the vegetables are tender. Add the ziti and cook for a further two minutes.

title: Eggplant or Eggplant (Aubergine) Chapati
ingredients: 1 eggplant, large | 1 tablespoon bread flour or 1 tablespoon bread flour | 1/2 cup cilantro leaf, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Peel the eggplant and slice very thinly. Combine the flour and cilantro in a cup or bowl and add the whole or sliced eggplant and mix well using a fork. Add a little water to coat the eggplant and form a patty like shape. Cook on a hot griddle or skillet until lightly browned on both sides. Turn over and brown all sides or drain on paper towels. Serve hot. Variation with dried chapatis or chapati bread.

title: Broccoli Rabe Spicy Curry Pasta With Coconut and Pistachios
ingredients: 3 tablespoons butter or 3 tablespoons shortening | 1/4 cup chopped onion soup mix, powdered ( eg. french's or french's ) | 1 lb broccoli rabe ( about 2 heads, not long ) or 1 lb red capsicum, sliced ( about 2 heads, not long ) | 1/3 cup shredded unsweetened coconut | 1 cup chopped coriander leaves
instructions: Heat the butter in a large saucepan. Add the onion soup mix. Add the broccoli or capsicum and toss to mix well. Cover and cook on low for 5 minutes, then stir in the coconut. Remove from heat and add the coriander leaves. Toss until they combine well and serve immediately. Variation, you can put the curry in with the spaghetti and make a great filling to accompany steaming pasta.

title: Pesto Sauce for Lamb
ingredients: 1/2 cup crumbled greek yogurt | 3 tablespoons pine nuts | 2 tablespoons onion powder | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke
instructions: Stir together the yogurt, pine nuts, onion powder, and liquid smoke. Rub into lamb meat, and set aside in refrigerator for 3 - 6 hours before cooking as desired.

Random Ingredients: green prawn,colby monterey jack cheese,salad oil
title: Prawns Quesadillas
ingredients: 2 prawns, cooked and peeled | 2 tablespoons salad oil | 2 teaspoons colby-monterey jack cheese, grated
instructions: Coarsely mash prawns in a bowl. Mix in cheese until thoroughly blended. Add a small amount of salad oil to coat. Heat a large nonstick saute pan on medium heat. Add prawns and cook about 3 minutes, or until shrimp are pink and prawns are lightly browned. Stir constantly to insure that mixture does not burn. Toast lightly in toaster oven or toaster oven if desired. Cut into small pieces and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: celery,cinnamon sugar,beef mince,strip steak,taco sauce,onion salt,summer squash
title: Beef and Spice Rollups - Beef
ingredients: 1 strip steak, cut into thin slices | 1 medium onion, cut into thin round slices | 1 small summer squash, cut into thin round slices | 1 cup shredded reduced-fat beef mince | 1 teaspoon salt | 1/2 teaspoon celery | 1/2 teaspoon low-fat taco sauce | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon sugar
instructions: In a large fry pay frypan large enough to hold 1 slice steak, saute the onion for 3 minutes or until tender. Add the squash slices, and cook, stirring frequently, until almost tender, approximately 4 minutes. Add the beef, salt, and celery, and cook until beef is cooked through. Serve over brown sugar, rice, noodles, or potatoes, and garnish with cinnamon sugar. To store leftovers, freeze in an airtight container until ready to use. To reheat, place a paper towel in the freezer 15 - 20 minutes until frozen. Pre heat oven to 200c. Place frozen steak on a large, deep oven tray. Spray with cooking oil spray. Dot with seasoning salt and put on top of steaks. Bake for 10 - 15 minutes, turning once.

title: Cajun Spiced Beef Shrimps
ingredients: 2 pounds boneless beef chuck, cut into 3/4-inch cubes | 2 cans minced clams with juice | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh dill
instructions: Add chuck cubes to a large pot and cover with cold water. Add minced clams and dill. Cover, and simmer over medium low heat for 45 minutes. Remove lid, reduce heat to low, and simmer for 1 hour. Shrimp are done when the shrimp turn pink, but are not cooked through. Season with additional salt if desired and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: yellow pepper,ancho chile,cannellini bean,extra virgin olive oil
title: Sizzling Cannellini Beans
ingredients: 4 ounces canned cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | chopped yellow pepper | ancho chile | 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Drain all the bean shells. Cut a circle from the bottom of the bean shell so that the shells can eventually be detached from the bean and other ingredients. Place all the ingredients into a large frying pan or a large earthenware casserole dish and gently toss over a high heat. Bring to the boil.

Random Ingredients: liquid honey,mace,tomato ketchup,puff pastry,chocolate,cardamom seed,nonfat plain yogurt,water chestnut
title: Indian Chilled Appetizers
ingredients: 2 sheets frozen puff pastry | 1/3 cup nonfat plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon reduced-fat plum tomato ketchup | 1 tablespoon water chestnut, finely chopped ( or sliced ) | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seed, crushed | 1/4 teaspoon mace | 1 teaspoon liquid honey | 1 -2 ounce bittersweet chocolate
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. On a lightly floured surface, roll out one sheet of puff pastry to fit into your nonstick 9x13 inch baking pans. Place on prepared baking sheet and lightly prick with a fork in 2 lines. Cover with plastic wrap while assembling the other sheet. Place baking pan on preheated oven rack and then immediately reduce temperature to 275°f. Prepare filling, stir together yogurt, plum tomato sauce, ketchup, water chestnuts, cardamom seeds and mace in a small bowl. Set aside 2 tbsp yogurt mixture for dipping. Spread 1/3 of the yogurt mixture over each pastry square and top with 2 oz of the bittersweet chocolate. Roll up pastry pastry like a jelly roll. Sprinkle with the remaining yogurt mixture and gently press. Cut each pastry roll into 12 equal strips. Arrange on a parchment covered baking sheet, seam side down. Bake about 20 minutes or until pastry is crisp and golden. Serve with dipping sauce. Dipping sauce, heat chocolate in a small saucepan over low heat. Stir constantly until smooth. Serve chocolate warm.

title: Chicken, Prunes, & Tarragon Rolls
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chopped fresh tarragon vinegar or 2 tablespoons mayonnaise | 12 -14 chicken tenders ( about 1 pound ) | 20 -36 slices peppidge farm rye bread or 20 -36 slices regular rye bread | 36 stuffed prunes | 3 -4 -12 cups leaf lettuce leaf
instructions: To make the dressing, combine all ingredients in a jar with a tight fitting lid. Add the bread slices and shake or toss until all are coated. Spoon off any excess dressing. Place the chicken tenders onto a large platter. Place the bread rounds on the platter. Spoon over the salad. Using scissors, snip off the bread rounds, being careful not to cut through to the bottom crust. Spread the roll around the salads, distributing the fruit evenly. Sprinkle the rolls with a little mustard or lettuce leaves or tarragon vinegar dressing.

title: Potato Noodles-Oven
ingredients: 7 eggs noodles, uncooked | 3 1/2 cups mashed potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Bring a large pot of water to a boil.

Random Ingredients: green cabbage,baby spinach,turkey breast,creme fraiche,cannellini bean,pine nut
title: Quick Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 400 g smoked turkey breast, sliced | 150 g green cabbage, shredded | 1 liter low-fat creme fraiche or 1 liter sour cream | 1 cup cannellini beans, rinsed and drained | 140 g baby spinach, rinsed | 80 g pine nuts
instructions: Toss the sliced turkey with the shredded cabbage. Whip the cream together with the cannellini beans and spinach. Add the shaved turkey, drained spinach and pineapple. Serve immediately.

title: Korean Cashew Beef (Slow Cooker) Version II
ingredients: 5 pounds chuck roast | 7 cashews, ground ( optional )
instructions: Place chuck roast into the crock of a slow cooker. Sprinkle cashews on top of beef, if using. Pour cashews on top of beef. Cook on high until beef is completely tender, and beginning to fall apart, 4 1/2 to 6 hours on high. Remove beef to a cutting board, and shred with two forks into long, thin strips. Remove all remaining bones, and fat, if using. Serve warm.

title: Korean Broccoli with Rice Cake
ingredients: 1 package korean rice cakes | 5 ounces fresh broccoli, cut into 1 inch pieces
instructions: Boil water in a large pot over high heat. Rinse and separate the rice cakes into smaller strips. When the water boils, carefully add the korean style rice cake to the pot. Stir, then cover, and boil for 2 minutes. Remove from heat, and let the korean style rice cakes drain in a colander until cool. Place the broccoli into the bottom of a serving platter, and gently mound the rice cake on top.

Random Ingredients: arborio rice,maraschino cherry,linguine,wild rice,pork loin,extra beef,mexican cheese
title: Pork and Wild Rice Arancini
ingredients: 1/2 lb extra lean ground beef | 1/2 lb boneless pork loin, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1/2 lb fresh wild rice, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup wild rice, rinsed and drained | 1/4 cup arborio rice ( long grain preferred ) or 1/4 cup carnaroli rice ( long grain preferred ) | 16 maraschino cherries | 8 slices mexican cheese
instructions: In a large, deep skillet, brown beef and pork until meat is no longer pink. Stir in wild rice and rinsed rice, making sure the meat is not crowded. The mixture will also look dry. Cover, reduce heat to low, and simmer 45 - 60 minutes, or until rice is tender and meat is fully cooked. Stir in cherries just before serving, and heat through. Serve sprinkled with cheese on top.

title: Fennel Mix
ingredients: 2 teaspoons dried onion flakes | 1 teaspoon dried minced fennel seed | 1/2 teaspoon crushed fennel seeds | 1/4 teaspoon harissa | 16 squares miniature marshmallows
instructions: Grind 1 teaspoon of dried onion flakes and 1/2 teaspoon of fennel seeds with a mortar and pestle or spice grinder. Mix the onion mixture and 1/4 teaspoon of crushed fennel seeds in a spice grinder until well blended. Coat the marshmallows in a small amount of softened butter or margarine. Pour the spice mixture over the marshmallows and coat thoroughly. Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,korean red pepper powder,fruit,pork shoulder,white wine,mustard,lamb
title: Yongnamomdang (Pork Stir-Fry With Fruit)
ingredients: 4 lbs pork shoulder ( cut in 1-inch cubes ) | vegetable oil cooking spray ( for frying ) | 1 lb assorted fresh fruit, peeled, halved and cut into 1-inch wedges | 8 dried fruit, peeled, left intact | 3 tablespoons dry white wine ( or shaoxing wine ) | 3 tablespoons korean red pepper powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons prepared dry mustard
instructions: Heat vegetable oil in a wok until smoking over moderately high heat. Add pork and fry until browned, about 5 minutes. Transfer to a bowl, cover with foil, and set aside. Add 1/2 cup water to wok. Return wok to high heat and add remaining 1 tablespoon of oil. Add dried fruit and boil, uncovered, for 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Dry meat with paper towels with an absorbent paper towel. Return meat to wok. Pour half of wine into wok and boil until syrupy, about 30 seconds. Return meat to wok and add remaining wine. Stir fry until dry, about 1 minute. Spoon meat and sauce over fried rice.

title: Penne With Roasted Chilli
ingredients: 1 package penne, broken into 2 inch pieces ( you can also use rotelle pasta ) | 1 cup cauliflower, diced | 1 tablespoon roasted red chilies, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place the uncooked penne in a large serving bowl and set aside while preparing the cauliflower. Add the cauliflower to the bowl with the cooked pasta. Stir in roasted chillies and season with salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: coconut extract,shallot,turbinado sugar,kalamata olive,cremini mushroom,jarlsberg cheese reserve
title: Caramelized Mincemeat and Mushrooms
ingredients: 3 tablespoons turbinado sugar | 1/4 teaspoon coconut extract | 3 lbs cremini mushrooms, caps | 10 shallots, halved | 3 lbs jarlsberg cheese ( reserve 2 cups reserved ) | sliced kalamata olive
instructions: In a large skillet, combine sugar and coconut extract. Add mushroom and shallots and sauté over medium heat for about 7 minutes. Add cheese and sauté for another 3 minutes. Sprinkle with olives. Remove skillet from heat and let cool slightly.

title: Beef Balsamic Peaches With Balsamic Strawberries
ingredients: 1 peach, peeled and halved if large | 1 tablespoon lemon peel, finely shredded | 4 teaspoons golden rum | 1 teaspoon sesame oil | 1 teaspoon balsamic vinegar | fresh toothpick, cut into 2 x 1 cm pieces
instructions: Combine peaches with lemon peel. Combine rum and sesame oil and pour over the peaches and marinate at room temperature for 2 to 3 hrs or in the fridge for 2 to 3 hours. Arrange the toothpicks on a serving dish. Preheat oven to 140°c/170°c fan forced and bake the peaches, uncovered, for 15 mins or until firm, basting occasionally with the marinade, turning and moving when necessary. Serve hot with balsamic straws.

Random Ingredients: hamburger,sea salt,sesame seed oil,wasabi,vegetable oil cooking spray,yellow pepper
title: Wasabi Burger With Yellow Pepper Strips
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon sea salt | 4 hamburger | 1 yellow pepper | vegetable oil cooking spray | asian wasabi, to serve | sesame seeds, to serve
instructions: Prepare wasabi by combining the wasabi paste with plenty of water and adjusting the salt as needed. You may add more wasabi, a little bit of wasabi paste or more wasabi paste if you feel more is needed. Cut peppers into about 8 to 12 wide strips.
