Spray the tops and bottoms of your burgers with oil spray. Place into a hot pan and add about 2 tablespoons of wasabi mixture on each one. If your burgers have a bit of time, move them around a little so they don't burn. Cook until they are cooked through and are slightly crunchy on the outside and slightly dry on the inside.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,lettuce,pork sparerib,shiitake mushroom,green cardamom pod,cauliflower,breadcrumb,brown sugar
title: Sweet Pork Spareribs in Green Ghee
ingredients: 4 teaspoons vegetable oil ( or extra virgin olive oil ) | 1 teaspoon brown sugar | 2 -3 green cardamom pods, crushed | 3/4 lb pork spareribs, about 1 1/2-3 1-pound or 3/4 lb country-style pork spareribs, trimmed of excess fat and cut into 2-inch pieces ( about 3 3/4 pounds ) | 1 head cauliflower, chopped ( about 4 cups ) | 1/4 cup fresh breadcrumb | 1/4 cup fresh shiitake mushrooms, minced ( canned mushrooms may be used for additional flavor, or use 1/2 cup canned ) | lettuce, for garnish
instructions: Make a batch of cutlets, each about 3 ounces of pork and 1/4 cup of mushroom per serving. Set aside while preparing the green ghee, in a large, heavy pot over medium heat, warm the oil until shimmering. Add the cardamom pods and sugar and brown the sugar, stirring, until the sugar has turned dark golden brown and begun to caramelize a bit, about 3 minutes. Add the cardamom pods and cook for about 30 seconds. Increase the heat to med high and add the spareribs. Cook, turning once, until richly browned, about 2 minutes per side. Add the cauliflower. Add enough water to cover everything, cover, and bring to a boil. Cover and cook until the cauliflower is almost tender, 5 to 7 minutes. Uncover the pot, remove the lid, and stir in the breadcrumbs, mushrooms and rice. Taste for salt. Transfer the mixture to a platter, garnish with the fried green cardamom pods and serve.

title: Lobster, Mace & Lime Spaghetti Pie
ingredients: 1 packet puff pastry | 500 g lobster, chopped | 4 chicken breast fillets | 1 cup spaghetti, cooked | 1 teaspoon lemon pepper | 1 teaspoon mace
instructions: Spread pastry on base and sides of an oven tray lined with greaseproof paper. Mix the lobster, chicken breast & spaghetti together & season with lemon pepper and mille de leche. Spread over the pastry. Bake at c for approx 20 minutes, until lightly browned. Serve straight away with plenty of salad tossed in the juices.

title: Yogurt and Mint
ingredients: 2 cups plain yogurt | 1/4 cup chopped of fresh mint
instructions: Serve yogurt chilled in a shallow bowl. Gently fold chopped mint into yogurt. Let stand 10 minutes.

title: Onion Soup - Crockpot
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs onions ( i use a sweet onion ) | 6 slices white bread | 1/4 cup dried onion flakes | 1 cup soup stock
instructions: Cut onions into wedges, leaving 2 inches of thick base left on onions to use in the soup. Use to fill bread shells if desired. Arrange on a platter with the remaining base of onions, so they don't go into the soup.

title: Cod With Pear & Spinach
ingredients: 2 pints half-and-half | 1 small parsley sprig | 1 teaspoon ground red pepper | 5 ounces cod, fillet | 3 pears, cored, quartered, and sliced thinly
instructions: Combine whole pears, red pepper and 2/3 cup of the half and half in large pot or saucepan. Heat to boiling over medium high heat. Remove from heat and stir in fish. Cover and simmer about 15 minutes or until tender. Remove fish from the heat. Add remaining half and half and return to heat just to warm through. Divide fish between 4 plates. Ladle some hot half broth onto each with a fork, sprinkle with parsley and serve.

Random Ingredients: beef,lentil,pasta,pecorino romano cheese,red onion,green pepper,ranch dressing,jalapeno
title: Beef and Pasta
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs top round beef, trimmed of fat | 12 ounces dry pasta ( wagon wheel, or angel hair ) | 1/2 cup ranch dressing | 1/2 cup grated pecorino romano cheese | 1/2 medium red onion, cut into strips | 1/2 medium green pepper, cut into strips | 3 cups cooked lentils ( from a can ) | 1 -19 ounce jalapeno, drained, seeded and chopped
instructions: Mix beef with all of the other ingredients except the dolcgrette in a large skillet.

title: Herring Korma
ingredients: 1 tablespoon shortening | 2 tablespoons minced shallots | 2 teaspoons minced fresh sage | 2 teaspoons garam masala | 4 ounces port wine | 1 beetroot, peeled and chopped | 2 fillets herring fillets ( about 2 pounds each )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. In a small saucepan, melt the shortening, pour into a 9x13 inch baking dish, and set aside. In a medium bowl, stir together the shallots, sage, garam masala, port, beetroot and seasoned salt. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 1 to 3 days, turning the mixture over occasionally. Preheat the broiler. Remove herb mixture from the refrigerator and place meat on metal skewers. Brush with shortening and grill for about 4 to 6 minutes per side, basting frequently with the shortening mixture. Serve with salad greens.

title: Chinese Sweet Nuts for Wood Flooring
ingredients: 1 package good quality dark sesame oil | 5 -6 medium vanilla pods or 5 -6 medium cardamom pods ( for wood flooring )
instructions: For Wood Flooring, combine 2 inches of good quality dark sesame oil, 4 tablespoons of good quality dark sesame oil, and 1 to 2 tablespoons of good quality dark sesame oil in a small bowl. Tightly seal the opening with a kitchen twine to help stop the blades from escaping. Fill the wood stuffing funnel with the wood stuffing. Set the wood stuffing funnel in a cool spot. Allow the wood stuffing to rest for about 3 to 4 days. The more wood stuffing you use the smaller amount of stuffing will have the wood softer.

title: Pickled Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 jar dried oreo cookies | 1/2 cup finely minced fresh italian parsley | 1/2 cup finely minced fresh dill | 2 teaspoons vinegar
instructions: Drain cookies, reserving liquid. Place in medium bowl and set aside. In large bowl, stir together parsley, dill and vinegar. Measure 1 cup of reserved cookie liquid.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,lemon juice zest,goat cheese,beef rib,philadelphia cream cheese,island dressing
title: Beef Short Ribs With Goat Cheese Cheese and Lemon Dressing
ingredients: 4 beef short ribs, trimmed | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil, divided | 1 package philadelphia cream cheese, softened | 1 cup chopped goat cheese | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice | 1 tablespoon island dressing
instructions: Preheat grill. Brush short ribs with sesame oil. Grill on both sides for about 10 to 15 minutes or until well browned, turning over after a few minutes.

Random Ingredients: pasta,grain white rice,pimiento,chicken leg,vanilla yogurt,cream cheese,kidney bean,italian herb
title: Chicken and Rice Salad
ingredients: 8 boneless skinless chicken legs ( about 8lb. ) | 2 cups short-grain white rice | 1 package cream cheese | 1 jar chopped pimiento | 1 can kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1 cup reduced-fat vanilla yogurt | chopped fresh italian spices ( cilantro and rosemary ) or chopped fresh oregano | 1 can pasta ( linguine, chellette or ditalini )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f place chicken legs in an ovenproof skillet. Add enough water to broth to cover chicken. Bring to boil and boil for 5 to 7 minutes. Remove and cool 10 minutes or so. Remove chicken from skin and chop into about 1/4 1/2 cubes. Measure all dry ingredients in a mixing bowl and set aside. Add cream cheese, pimientos, beans, yogurt and spices to chicken broth and stir to combine. Cook over low heat 10 to 15 minutes or until the liquid reduces. Add pasta and stir well. Place the chicken on top of the pasta mixture. If pasta seems dry during this time, add more hot pasta water, about 1/4 cup at a time. Turn the chicken over, turn and coat the last side. If the pasta seems dry, add some more hot pasta water, about 1/4 cup at a time. Cover and bake at 350f for 30 minutes to 1 hour, stirring every so often to make sure the liquid is absorbed. Let sit 10 minutes before serving.

title: Pesto Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1/4 cup prepared pesto sauce | 2 teaspoons vinegar
instructions: Blend pesto, vinegar, and salt in a blender with a fork. Use immediately.

title: Easy Chili Verde
ingredients: 4 cans spicy enchilada sauce | 1/2 lb hidden valley & reg ; original ranch & reg ; dressing | 3 cups hidden valley & reg ; dressing | 2 -3 cups spicy, original ranch & reg ; dressing
instructions: Empty 1 can of enchilada sauce into a bowl and add 1 package of Hidden Valley & reg ; Dressing & toss lightly to coat. Shred the other 4 cans of Hidden Valley & reg ; Dressing together in a separate bowl, adding the dressing as you are tossing. Add the ranch dressing to the above and combine well. Serve in warm tortillas with lettuce, cheese and tomatoes.

Random Ingredients: french onion soup,pork loin roast,fennel seed,chicken meat,sweetcorn,orange peel,seasoning salt
title: Slow Cooker Pork and Sweetcorn
ingredients: 4 boneless pork loin roast | 1 packet french onion soup | 1 1/2 teaspoons fennel seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons grated orange peel | 1 1/2 teaspoons seasoning salt | 1 can corn, drained | 2 1/2 cups instant sweetcorn ( or frozen )
instructions: Drain pork loin of any fat before putting in crock pot. Sprinkle roast with fennel powder and orange peel. Pour onion soup over pork, mixing well. Cover and cook on low until meat falls apart. Remove meat. Pour can of sweetcorn into crock pot. Put cover on and cook on high about 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until meat falls apart, stirring occasionally. When meat is done, remove meat and let sit about 10 minutes before removing lid to keep warm. Slice or shred meat and serve over mashed potatoes.

title: Radicchio Corbollita (Chicken and Radicchio)
ingredients: 1/2 bunch fresh radicchio | 1 roasting chickens | 2 carrots, finely diced | 2 teaspoons rice vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon cornflour | 1/8 teaspoon ground cloves | 1 cup tomato juice, or as needed
instructions: Remove and discard the outer leaves from the radicchio. Rinse it under cold running water, and dry on paper towels. Cut into chunks. Place in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: cilantro leaf,rose petal,catsup,bulk italian sausage,white flour,bay leaf,vanilla essence
title: Aunt Jenny's Spicy Sausage
ingredients: 1/2 lb bulk italian sausage | 1/2 cup white flour | 2 tablespoons dry catsup | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla essence | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves,, divided | 1 bay leaf | 1/4 teaspoon crushed rose petals ( optional )
instructions: Cut the sausage in half lengthwise.

title: Peach Melba
ingredients: 3 -4 tablespoons amaretto or 3 -4 tablespoons amaretto | 1 slice swiss cheese | 1 jar marinated peaches | 1/4 - 1/2 cup amarillo sauce or 1/4-1/2 cup favorite brandy | 1 dash tabasco sauce
instructions: Blend amaretto and swiss cheese. Spread on a slice of marinated apple. Top with amaretto and swiss cheese mixture. Sprinkle with tabasco sauce.

title: Rosemary-Yogurt Curd
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
instructions: Combine yogurt and rosemary in a small mixing bowl. Cover and refrigerate for at least an hour.

Random Ingredients: pork rib,kaiser,portabella mushroom,golden raisin,taco seasoning mix
title: Grilled Pork Ribs, Portabella Mushroom and Raisins on Weck Toasted Kebabs
ingredients: 4 country-style pork ribs | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 2 packages kraft roasted deli reduced-fat spicy spicy italian sandwich bun rolls | 1/4 cup golden raisin | 1 jar portabella mushrooms, drained
instructions: Preheat grill over medium high heat. Lightly oil grill grate. Brush grate with oil. Add ribs to grill.

title: Easy Baked Pineapple Lasagna
ingredients: 1 can crushed pineapple, undrained | 1/2 teaspoon onion salt | 12 lasagna noodles ( i prefer mini ) | 1/2 cup cilantro leaf | 1/4 cup pistachios, toasted and chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Combine the first 6 ingredients in a large bowl and mix well. Spread 1/2 cup of topping mixture in an even layer over the bottom of a baking dish. Spread 1/3 of the sauce over the top of the lasagna noodles to within about 1/2 of the top. Top with 1/3 of the remaining sauce. Top with remaining noodles and spread remaining topping mixture on top. Dot with 1/4 cup of the pistachios. Bake in a lower third of the oven, uncovered, until bubbly and beginning to brown, about 1 1/2 hours. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Persian Greens Salad
ingredients: 1 bunch greens, washed and trimmed | 4 ounces purslane, cut crosswise into 3/4 inch squares | 4 tablespoons thousand island dressing ( or mayo, as needed )
instructions: Cut stems off greens and place in bowl. Tear greens into small pieces and lightly toss with purslane and remaining dressing. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: pico de gallo,sesame seed,yellow pepper,canola oil,white onion,cherry tomato,spanish onion,spaghetti
title: Mexican Sesame Seed Noodles
ingredients: 2 1/2 pints cherry tomatoes | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds, toasted and crushed | 1/2 spanish onion, minced | 1/2 yellow pepper, diced | 1/2 white onion, diced | 1 package dry spaghetti | 1 1/2 cups canned pico de gallo, drained | 1 1/4 cups pico de gallo, or more as needed, divided
instructions: Blend tomatoes, 2 tablespoons canola oil, sesame seeds, white and yellow onions, and yellow pepper in a blender until smooth, about 1 minute. Transfer mixture to a large salad bowl, and toss in spicy pico de gallo. Set aside. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil, add spaghetti and cook for 8 minutes or until al dente.

title: Indian Green Broccoli Cheese Dip - Vegetarian Version
ingredients: 300 g bok choy ( or other small firm greens ) | 300 g plain low-fat yogurt ( or whole milk yogurt ) | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Heat oil in small pan over medium high heat. Stir through yogurt and cayenne and let it bubble for 5 minutes or longer. Place broccoli and sauce in processor or food processor. Pulse until smooth. Scrape down sides of processor. Turn on machine and add yogurt. Mix until smooth. Serve with crackers.

title: Danish Blueberry Fritters
ingredients: 1 pint frozen blueberries ( fresh or thawed ) | 2 tablespoons dill or 2 tablespoons chives | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 2 drops vanilla extract | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence | 5 -6 cups flour
instructions: Place blueberries in a bowl. Sprinkle with dill or chives with turmeric and mix them together. Add vanilla and vanilla extracts and mix well. Add flour little by little until a smooth dough is formed. Dough should be soft. Place plastic wrap on the surface of the mixture to keep the dough from drying out. Roll out in small, thin circles about 1/4 inch thick. Prick it a few times with a fork. If you prefer it as thin as the desired results, you can place them on the plate, cut side down, to cool. They should not have a sharp texture when baked. Bake in a very hot oven for 15 - 20 minutes or until it is puffed up and golden. If it is too hot, the fritters could break and they would have done the same. Let them cool. Store in an air tight container.

title: Frijoles (Fried Beans)
ingredients: 5 ounces plain fat-free yogurt | 8 ounces refried beans
instructions: Mix together the yogurt and refried beans. Heat up on a nonstick pan at low temperature for about 5 minutes to prevent burning. The longer the yogurt sits without running, the hotter the mixture will be. Serve immediately from the pan on a plate.

Random Ingredients: olive oil,white pumpkin,chicken tender,heavy cream,salt pepper
title: Roast Pumpkin With Oil and Sausages
ingredients: 2 lbs white pumpkin, scrubbed | 8 chicken tenders, with the fat trimmed | 1/4 cup olive oil, plus extra for greasing | 1/2 cup heavy cream, chilled | salt and pepper, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Scrub and scrub the pumpkin and cut into 3 4cm cubes. Put pumpkin pieces in a roasting tin and add 3/4 cup of cold water. Use your hands to toss, coating thoroughly with about 2 tablespoons of olive oil. Roast in the oven for 25 minutes, then toss. Meanwhile, rub the chicken tenders with a little of the olive oil and roast in a large roasting tin for 15 - 20 minutes, turning occasionally. The chicken will be cooked when all the juices run clear. Remove chicken from the roasting tin and set aside. Add more oil to the roasting tin and cook sausages in batches. Season with salt and pepper. When all the sausages have been cooked, remove from the oven and arrange on serving plates to serve.

Random Ingredients: green pea,celery,pesto sauce,chili pepper flake,monterey jack pepper cheese,pork shoulder,haddock fillet
title: Cocktail
ingredients: 1 cup fresh peas or 1 cup canned peas, drained | 3 tablespoons pesto sauce | 4 ounces smoked haddock fillets or 4 ounces other white fish fillets | 1/2 cup chpd scallions or 1/2 cup celery | 1 tablespoon chili pepper flakes | 1/2 lb monterey jack pepper cheese, shredded | shredded monterey jack pepper cheese
instructions: Combine peas, pesto sauce, haddock filets, scallions, chili pepper flakes, and cheese. Heat until cheese is melted. Remove from heat, stir in peas. Cover and let stand for 5 - 10 minutes. Serve with crackers.

title: Easy Apples, Carrots or Cabbage
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs baby carrots | 4 -5 tart apples, pared ( or two pounds )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees. Bake the carrots for 15 to 30 minutes or until tender but not overcooked, turning them frequently. Remove them from the oven and set them on a piece of lightly greased or parchment paper for a few minutes so they will not burn in the oven. Put them in a small roasting pan. Cut off the tops and bottoms of the carrots, cut off any tough outer leaves, and cut out and discard as much of their greens as possible. Place the carrots and the apples in a large frying pan and add enough water to cover them. Bring to a boil and cover, bringing to a bubbling boil once, for 25 to 30 minutes or until just tender. Drain the carrots. Serve them in large, deep bowls or small dishes with slotted sausages, croutons and pickles on the side.

Random Ingredients: lemon zest,margarine,chicken bouillon cube,cumin seed,cauliflower floret,jumbo shrimp,pizza seasoning
title: Spicy Shrimp Filled With Cauliflower & Jumbo Shrimp
ingredients: 1 jumbo shrimp, peeled | 1/3 cup shredded cauliflower floret | 1 tablespoon dried pizza seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon lemon zest | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin seeds, toasted | 2 teaspoons margarine | 1 chicken bouillon cube ( i used maggi brand with `` chicken '' in it ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons jumbo shrimp flavoring ( found in latino specialty food section of grocery store located in hispanic aisle )
instructions: Place raw shrimp in microwave safe container, sprinkle with seasonings stir to coat shrimp. Microwave on high for 2 to 3 minutes or until shrimp is no longer bright red, but no longer opaque. Remove shrimp from microwave and set aside. Heat saute pan in microwave, on high, add margarine, when margarine has melted, add all remaining ingredients, stir. Simmer for 2 to 3 minutes. Add shrimp to pan and stir to coat. Cook until shrimp are shrimp pink, serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: icing sugar,wheat spaghetti,jicama,red chilies,milk,nonfat cream,chili oil
title: Ww 3 Points - Chinese Sushi Spaghetti
ingredients: 7 ounces whole wheat spaghetti | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 1/2 cup nonfat sour cream | 1 can sweetened condensed milk | 2 dried red chilies, chopped | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 1 teaspoon jicama
instructions: Preheat a 4 quart, no stick, wok on high heat. Add the jicama, and cook for 2 minutes, stirring now and/or then. Toss in the spaghetti and cook over high heat for 5 minutes, or until lightly browned and cooked through. Transfer to a heatproof bowl. When cool, toss with the chili oil. While the spaghetti is cooking, stir together the sour cream, condensed milk and chilies in a small bowl with a fork.

title: Broccal Slaw - Polenta and Blue Cheese Sticks
ingredients: 8 ounces polenta ( coarse ) | 2/3 cup yellow cornmeal | 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes or 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes, to taste | 2 tablespoons butter, softened | 2 tablespoons blue curacao or 2 tablespoons other orange-flavored liqueur | 2 tablespoons sesame oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f in a large bowl, toss the polenta with the cornmeal and 1/2 tsp each of the chile flake. Cut the butter into the polenta with a pastry blender or 2 knives. Stir in the curacao, sesame oil, and remaining chile flakes. Toss in the polenta and lightly toss until well incorporated. Transfer the mixture to a greased 9x13 pan and pat the polenta into an even layer. Bake, stirring every 20 minutes until it starts to firm and is golden and cracked on top, and the polenta sticks when pressed with your fingers. Variation,. Spread the polenta out on a large cutting board. Cut into 3/4 inch squares and dip the squares into a bowl of cold water, then cut all the squares into squares. Repeat, until all 4 squares are coated.

title: Sweet Macaroni and Garlic With Shells
ingredients: 8 ounces jumbo pasta shells | 2 -3 teaspoons red wine vinegar
instructions: Cook the shells according to the box. You will need to make the sauce while they cook. When they are done, put them in a large mixing bowl. Drain the water from the shells and put them in the bowl with the shell water. Add the vinegar and mix well. The goal is to get the shells to be nice and coated with the oil and vinegar. Drain the jar of shells very well. The shells should not actually be submerged in the vinegarette. Save the shells for another use. Spray the cooking pan with cooking spray or line it with aluminum foil and bake the shells till you can hear them through your pasta.. The time depends on size of shells. Remove the shells from the pan and drain off the liquid in the pan. Serve and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chocolate bar,white peppercorn,panko breadcrumb,cabbage,beef brisket,spanish rice mix,chipotle chile,pinto bean
title: Chipotle-Glazed Corned Beef Brisket in a Dutch Oven
ingredients: 3 lbs corned beef brisket | 1 package spanish rice mix | 1/2 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup shredded cabbage | 1/2 cup chipotle chile, chopped ( from a can ) | 2 tablespoons white peppercorns, crushed | 1 1/2 cups shredded cabbage ( about 4 cups ) | 2 cups dried pinto beans
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Place brisket in an oven proof dutch oven and coat with cooking spray. Scatter panko over brisket, then sprinkle with remaining ingredients. Cover and bake for about 1 hour. Remove lid for last 15 minutes, then remove top rack of oven and continue cooking until crisp, about 10 minutes longer. Slice brisket thinly and serve with beans.

Random Ingredients: sole fillet,cider vinegar,vegetable oil cooking spray,grand marnier,dark rum
title: Baily's Grilled Sole
ingredients: 1 sole fillet | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/4 cup dark rum | 1/2 cup grand marnier | 1 teaspoon cider vinegar
instructions: Preheat grill. Place fillet on medium high heat. Grill 1 1/2 8 minutes per side. Remove from heat. Spray grill with cooking spray. Combine rum, grand marnier and vinegar in small bowl.

title: Peanut Butter and Salsa Sandwich
ingredients: 4 frozen lettuce leaves, thawed | 4 tablespoons smooth peanut butter | 4 tablespoons chunky salsa | chopped nuts ( optional ) | lime wedge ( optional )
instructions: Place lettuce on cutting board. Mash with fingers til smooth. Spread with peanut butter, then top with salsa and sprinkle with nuts, if desired.

title: Tasmanian Soup
ingredients: 1 lb ground lamb | 1 quart chicken stock
instructions: Heat a large soup pot over medium high heat. Add the ground lamb. Cook until meat changes color and loses its red color, 8 - 10 minutes. Drain any excess fat accumulated in the pan. Add the stock and bring to boil.

title: Hannah's Crab Spread
ingredients: 2 jars crabmeat, drained | 1 1/2 cups shredded cheese, divided | 5 ounces frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained | 1/2 cup dry vermouth, divided | 1/4 cup dry white vermouth, divided | 1 teaspoon ground cumin, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Butter a 9 inch square baking dish. In a large bowl, mix together the crabmeat, 1 1/2 cups cheese, chopped spinach, 1/4 cup vermouth, and cumin. Spoon into prepared baking dish. Dot with remaining 1/4 cup cheese. Bake in preheated oven until bubbling through and beginning to brown, about 1 hour.

title: Puerco De Pirielle (Pinchos Frescas)
ingredients: 1 jar pimientos
instructions: Rinse puerco de pirielle and remove veins, seeds, and all but 1 tablespoon of liquid from jar. Add pepper and pimientos. Stuff or roll and let dry in a dry cloth for at least 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce,onion soup mix,za'atar spice mix,head cauliflower,chicken bouillon cube,molasses,orange juice,beef chuck
title: Beef With Cauliflower, Onions, & Za'atar
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb beef chuck ( lean or boneless ) | 1 teaspoon ground za'atar spice mix ( or other spicy seasoning mix ) | 2 packages onion soup mix | 2 cups orange juice | 2 large head cauliflower, broken into small florets | 1 envelope instant chicken bouillon cube | 1/2 cup molasses ( i prefer unsweetened ) | head romaine lettuce, washed and dried
instructions: Place chuck in a slow cooker, add za'atar, onion soup mix, orange juice, cranberry sauce, & bouillon cube. Cover and cook set for 6 hours on low. Remove chuck from slow cooker. Cut into 1 inch cubes or shred if desired. Return meat to slow cooker. In a small bowl, mix molasses and 1 1/2 cups water until blended. Stir in remaining ingredients except lettuce. Cover and cook on high for 30 minutes. Serve on lettuce leaves.

title: Baked Smoked Turkey
ingredients: 1 turkey | 1 tablespoon anise seed | 3 tablespoons hot sauce | 3 tablespoons chopped italian parsley
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line 2 medium baking sheets with parchment paper. Heat an oven to 200 degrees f. Pat the turkey dry with aluminum foil. Sprinkle with anise. Place the parchment paper on the upper rack of the oven. Carefully lower the turkey into the hot frying pan to brown the outside. Roast, still wet, for about 1 hour, or until crispy and no longer pink in the center. Slide the turkey into a large bowl.

title: Bourbon Appetizer
ingredients: 1 cup sour canadian bacon, crumbled | 2 cups beet, cooked, pureed | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | food coloring | ice
instructions: Mix sour cream, canadian bacon, beet puree, diced tomatoes with green chilies, and food coloring into the can of beets, stirring well to blend flavors. Add ice, and stir. Garnish with slices of Canadian bacon.

Random Ingredients: vegetable green bean,salmon fillet,oregano leaf,sage,white bean,button mushroom,golden mushroom soup
title: Smoked Salmon and Vegetable Gravy
ingredients: 6 button mushrooms, sliced | 1 can white beans, drained ( drained canned green beans, may be left on during cooking. ) | 1 can salmon fillets, drained, flaked ( use 2 fl oz. cans, reserve juice ) | 2 cans salmon and vegetables ( add the leftover liquid ) | 1 can golden mushroom soup | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano leaves, chopped and divided | fresh sage ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees. Combine all ingredients and bring to a boil. Cover and place in oven for the time listed on your package. When the time is up, spoon mixture into a baking dish. Sprinkle with remaining 1 tablespoon of dried oregano. Bake for 30 minutes. Serve.

title: French Style Carnitas
ingredients: 3 tablespoons butter | 2 lbs boneless pork shoulder, chopped into 1cm cubes | 1 1/3 lbs pork shoulder, chopped into 1cm cubes | 2 teaspoons ground cinnamon | 3 cups chicken stock | 5 ounces swiss cheese, grated | 1 1/4 lbs grated pork
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f, 190°c, gas mark melt butter in a large casserole dish, then fry the pork until golden. Add the pork to the casserole dish, sprinkle with cinnamon and cook over a low heat for a further 10 minutes. Make up to 3/4 cup boiling stock with the remaining stock. Pour over pork, then leave uncovered for 1 hour. After 45 - 50 minutes, give the casserole a shake and add the cheese and grated pork, stir well and return to the oven for a further 15 minute.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti,italian breadcrumb,cream cheese,chicken breast meat,dashi,purple onion,olive oil cooking spray,leek
title: Pancetta Wrapped Chicken Breasts - Kottbullarani
ingredients: 1 package spaghetti, broken into 6 or 7 pieces, cooked according to package directions | 1/2 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 package cream cheese, room temperature | 3 tablespoons dried minced leeks | 1 small purple onion, chopped | olive oil flavored cooking spray | 3 cups cooked chicken breast meat, chopped | 1 package refrigerated instant dashi | 1 can cream cheese, room temperature
instructions: In a 9 x 13 inch baking dish, combine bread crumbs and cream cheese, and set aside. Warm dashi in a large pot over medium heat, and then add frozen chicken, leeks, and purple onion. Mix well, cover, and cook 5 minutes. Drain chicken and refrigerate while preparing the sauce. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with olive oil cooking spray. Sprinkle bread crumb mixture in the baking dish, and then top with the chicken, leeks mixture, and cream cheese. Cover the dish with aluminum foil. Bake 35 minutes. Remove from oven, and top with dashi. Return to oven for 30 minutes, or until soup is bubbly and slightly reduced. Serve immediately.

title: Corn Chips
ingredients: 1 cup corn chips | 2 cups whole wheat flour
instructions: Toast and drain corn chips. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Spread half the whole wheat flour on a clean dry surface. Sprinkle with corn chips and roll into a cylinder about 3/4 inch thick. Repeat with remaining flour and cobs. Place on a lightly greased baking sheet. Prick tops with a fork, and bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Chocolate-Tamarind and Artichoke Hearts
ingredients: 120 g dark chocolate | 20 fresh artichoke hearts, trimmed, deseeded and sliced | 2 1/2 tablespoons tamarind pulp | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped fresh basil leaves
instructions: Put the chocolate in a bowl with 1 1/2 tablespoons of water and a sprinkling of salt. Set over a pan of simmering water and stir every 2 minutes until the chocolate has melted into a smooth, creamy paste. Cool to room temperature. Melt the remaining 2 1/2 tablespoons of butter with 1 1/2 tablespoon of water in a small saucepan over a heat. Add the anchovies and cook for 1 1/2 minutes. Stir in the sesonic acid and the tamarind pulp. Pour the melted chocolate mixture into the pan and stir to blend. Remove from the heat and add basil leaves. Allow to set a little. Transfer to a serving plate, or put the hearts on top.

title: Cottage Cheese and Watercress Rolls
ingredients: 1 package frozen whipped topping, thawed | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 20 leaves fresh watercress | 12 tablespoons cottage cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with foil. Whisk together the thawed whipped topping and worcestershire sauce.

title: Broccli's Broccili Broccoli
ingredients: 4 -5 cups fresh broccoli | 1 -4 canned chipotle chile in adobo, seeded if desired | fresh chives, cut into small pieces ( to garnish )
instructions: Wash, remove ends of broccoli and cut into florets. Put all ingredients into a pan and bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer until broccoli is cooked but not browned. Cool to room temperature in a large bowl or jar by pouring hot broth over top and refrigerate for at least four hours. Serve in small bowls garnished with chives.

title: Soy Sauce Marinated Fruit
ingredients: 1 cup sultana | 1 teaspoon soy sauce ( or to taste. i use low-sodium )
instructions: Put the sultanas through a sieve and discard any stones, grated peel and pulp. Put the juice ingredients into a small saucepan over a low heat and bring to a simmer, stirring regularly to ensure the flavour is balanced. Cook, shaking the pan, for 2 - 3 minutes until the sauce thickens a little and is syrupy. Pour into a small jar and keep refrigerated.

title: Italian Sausage Bread
ingredients: 1 lb bulk sweet italian sausage | 2 tablespoons dried oregano | 1/4 cup breadcrumbs | 1 1/2 cups ranch salad dressing
instructions: In a medium bowl, lightly mix the sausage, oregano and bread crumbs. Pinch off about 1 1/2 tablespoons of crumb mixture and set aside. Form the sausage mixture into balls, 1 to 1 - ½ inches in diameter. Dip each sausage ball into the crumbs on all sides, making sure that they are fully coated. Transfer to a plate, cover and refrigerate for about an hour. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add the sausage balls and cook, turning once, until browned and cooked through, about 5 minutes on each side. Transfer the sausage balls to a warmed platter and tent loosely with foil. Stir in the marinade and serve.

title: Frijoles Borrachos - Refried Beans
ingredients: 2 ounces dried pinto beans or 2 ounces great northern beans, picked over | 1 cup mozzarella cheese or 1 cup monterey jack cheese, shredded | 1 3/4 - 1 loaf rolls, 8 inch, warmed and toasted | 1 dash tabasco sauce
instructions: Soak the beans overnight, or overnight. Drain and rinse the beans. In a large skillet, layer the beans in the following order, cheese 1/2 the bread, remaining bread 1/2 the beans, seasonings. Add enough water to lightly cover all of the beans and to the top. Bring to boil, then simmer over low heat about 1 1/2 hours or until the beans are tender and have absorbed all the water. Remove the pan from the heat, cover and let stand for 5 minutes before serving. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: silken tofu,meat,guacamole,chile adobo sauce,lentil,red enchilada sauce,chive
title: Tofu and Black Bean Chili
ingredients: 4 chiles in adobo sauce, chopped | 1 can red enchilada sauce | 1 can lentils, rinsed and drained | 12 ounces ground meat | 1/2 cup textured vegetable protein ( optional ) | 1/2 cup light silken tofu, drained
instructions: In a large saucepan over medium low heat, combine the chiles, enchilada sauce, lentils, and meat. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer for 1 hour, covered. Stir in the tofu.

Random Ingredients: lamb chop,garlic salt,corn kernel,italian sausage,sherry,cabbage,scotch bonnet pepper,baking soda
title: Cabbage and Sausage Stew
ingredients: 12 ounces ground lamb or 12 ounces beef | 1 1/2 lbs italian sausage, halved or 2 links sausage, cut into 1 inch chunks | 1 bag fresh corn kernels or 1 lb frozen corn kernels | 1/2 head cabbage, cored, coarsely chopped | 8 scotch bonnet peppers, sliced or 4 habanero peppers, seeded and finely chopped | 3 cups dry sherry | 1 teaspoon baking soda | garlic salt
instructions: In a 5 to 6 quart kettle, combine ground lamb with sausage and cook over medium heat for 10 minutes, breaking the meat into small bits. Transfer sausage mixture to a large bowl.

title: Sausage With Cheese, Cucumbers, and Peanuts
ingredients: 2 tablespoons mixed spice ( see above ) | 4 ounces of your favourite bulk pork sausage | 2 garlic cloves | 2 ounces grated fontina | 4 ounces finely sliced lebanese cucumbers ( or kalamata )
instructions: Slice your sausage into 4 thick slices, about 1/4 thick. Slice the garlic in half and rub into the sausage slices. Sprinkle the mixed spice and half of the grated fontina on the sausage and set aside for about 20 minutes. Heat a griddle pan, griddle, or frying pan. Add the garlic, sausage and sausages to the griddle or frying pan, using the rest of your griddle or frying pan. Spread the cooked sausage and cheese slices around on top of the sausage/cheese. Grill until the cheese is bubbly. Remove the sausage and cheese from the griddle or frying pan, slice in half and spread out. Sprinkle the whole mixture of bread with the remaining grated fontina. Serve.

Random Ingredients: farfalle pasta,beef sirloin steak,fennel seed,cumin seed,beef bouillon cube,vanilla extract
title: Quick and Elegant Mexican Steak
ingredients: 1 lb beef sirloin steak | 1 can fat-free low-sodium beef bouillon cubes | 1 teaspoon cinnamon | 1 teaspoon crushed fennel seed | 1/2 teaspoon cumin seeds | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Trim beef steak of all visible fat. Place into a ziplock bag, pour bouillon into bag, and add spices. Shake bag to combine all ingredients. Pour contents of bag into a nonstick frying pan. Turn over the steak pieces once or twice during cooking to help distribute their juices evenly, cook to desired doneness. Note, this will depend on the thickness of your steak steak, so start checking for doneness first and then adjust if needed. This is also an excellent stove top dish for mexican style rice, or served over mexican style white rice.

Random Ingredients: gold tequila,green bell pepper,double cream,rice noodle,paprika,lemon zest,chocolate chip
title: Creamy Spanish Noodles With Chiles
ingredients: 4 ounces chocolate chips | 2 tablespoons green bell peppers, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons smoked paprika | 2 ounces gold tequila | 1 lemon, zest of, grated | 1 lb whole grain rice noodles | 4 cups double cream | paprika, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Place the chocolate chips, green peppers, smoked paprika, tequila, lemon zest and rice noodles in a nonstick saucepan. Bring to a simmer over medium heat. Lower the heat to simmer and cook for 10 minutes. Remove from the heat and stir. Set aside. Whisk the cream to stiff peaks. Fold in one quarter of the cream. Serve 1 portion on each plate. Repeat with the remaining cream and remaining cream. Sprinkle each plate with paprika.

title: Gruyere and Pear Strudel
ingredients: 2 tablespoons unsalted pecans | 12 fresh bread dough sassies | 2 tablespoons gruyere cheese, freshly grated | 2 pears, cored, cored and diced | 4 ladyfingers | 8 tablespoons swiss cheese, freshly grated | iceberg lettuce, for garnish | 3 ounces parfaito-stuffed pecans, thinly sliced for garnish | 4 whole florrets of stale bread, crushed for garnish
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Spread the pecans on a parchment lined baking sheet. Place the remaining four dough sassies on top of the pecans, pressing gently to adhere. Bake until puffed and golden, 10 to 15 minutes. Remove from the oven and spread gruyère cheese over the crust. Place a pear on top of the gruyère and spread out with fingers. Cover with a napkin. Repeat with the remaining dough and filling, pressing gently to adhere. Cut the strudels into 3 slices. Place the slices on a serving plate. Garnish with the whole pecans. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,alfredo sauce,salmon fillet,white wheat flour,ginger,arborio rice
title: Gluten Free Salmon and Alfredo Casserole
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 cups cooked pasta-either whole wheat pasta or 2 cups long-grain white rice | 1 salmon fillet, skin removed and cut into serving-sized chunks | 2 tablespoons white whole wheat flour or 2 tablespoons gluten-free rice flour | 2 slices peeled fresh ginger | 1 cup prepared alfredo sauce | steamed arugula or fresh chives
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f coat a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Combine pasta or rice, salmon chunks in a non metal bowl. Sprinkle flour over salmon mixture and toss with your hands until the salmon is coated. Spread mixture over the baking dish in a single layer. Top with ginger slices. In a small bowl, combine the alfredo sauce and whisk until smooth. Cover the top of the baking dish with aluminum foil. Bake until a knife inserted in center of the cassava comes out clean, about 50 minutes. Let stand for 20 minutes before serving, cut into thick slices.

Random Ingredients: worcestershire sauce,orange zest,ginger garlic paste,beef,carrot,italian breadcrumb,kosher salt black pepper,pork rib
title: Korean Spiced Short Ribs
ingredients: 1/2 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs ( packaged by progresso in the meat processor ) | 4 teaspoons grated fresh ginger-garlic paste ( or 1 tsp. bottled ) | 4 teaspoons worcestershire sauce ( bottled bottled, or equivalent ) | 3 medium carrots, peeled | 1/2 teaspoon orange zest, minced | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper | 2 1/2 lbs pork short ribs or 2 1/2 lbs beef short ribs, cut in half lengthwise | 2 tablespoons freshly minced italian breadcrumbs
instructions: To prepare all the ribs, combine bread crumbs, ginger garlic paste, worcestershire sauce, carrots, orange zest and 1/2 tsp. Salt in a mixing bowl. Add ribs and toss to coat. Spread out the ribs in a single layer, sprinkle with remaining 1/2 tsp. Salt, cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, turning several times. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Coat a cookie sheet with cooking spray. Insert a meat thermometer to the center of each rib. Add short ribs to the oven, basting generously with any remaining marinade, and bake until meat thermometer registers 130 degrees f, about 30 minutes. While ribs are baking, dry breadcrumbs in a shallow bowl and flour. Sprinkle with extra breadcrumbs to serve.

Random Ingredients: chicken tender,garlic herb seasoning,yellow pepper,apple,spice,cooking spray
title: Spice Baked Chicken
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken tenders | 1 yellow pepper, cut in strips | 1 medium apple, cut in strips | 4 cloves garlic and herb seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon spice | cooking spray
instructions: Spray a cookie sheet with oil on both sides with oil and set aside. Combine all ingredients, except the chicken tenders and apple in a saucepan. Cover and cook on low heat setting for approximately 15 to 20 minutes or until chicken is cooked through and tender. Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: skewer,parsley leaf,black bean,garlic clove,vegetable oil,tortilla chip,tomatillo,nutmeg
title: Black Beans in Tomatillo-Tomatillo Sauce
ingredients: 1 package tortilla chips | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1/2 cup canned diced tomato tomatillo | 1/2 cup black beans, drained and rinsed | 1 garlic clove, minced | 1/4 teaspoon freshly grated nutmeg | 2 tablespoons minced fresh parsley leaves | 4 skewers
instructions: Soak tortilla chips in hot tap water for 20 minutes or until soft. In a small skillet, heat oil over medium high heat. Add tomatillos and cook, stirring, until just softened, about 1 minute. Stir in beans, garlic, parsley and nutmeg.

title: Chipencho's Chipotle Broth
ingredients: 15 cups low sodium chicken broth | 1 can chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, drained and seeded | 1 tablespoon adobo sauce | 2 tablespoons sweet sherry wine
instructions: Bring the chicken broth and adobo sauce to a boil in a large pot over high heat. Reduce the heat to low and cook the broth, uncovered and mashing the chipotle peppers with the back of a fork, until slightly thinner and hotter, 5 to 10 minutes. Stir in the sherry and simmer until most of the liquid has evaporated and liquid is very thick, 15 to 30 minutes.

title: Crispy Pineapple Wedges
ingredients: 1 cup cornflour | 200 ml pineapple juice | 1 teaspoon sunflower oil or 1 teaspoon vegetable oil
instructions: Combine cornflour and 1 cup remaining water in a mixing bowl and stir with a knife until smooth. Stir through pineapple juice to form a soft dough. Turn dough onto a floured surface. Roll out to about 1/4 inch thick. Using a 3 inch diameter biscuit cutter cut wedges out of the dough and place on a tray. Brush with the oil. Bake in a 200°c oven for about 30 minutes or until pale and beginning to colour. Allow to cool for 10 minutes before wiping them on paper towels. Serve or leave plain.

Random Ingredients: cumin,beef brisket,oregano,heavy cream,sun tomato oil,lettuce,ginger ale,avocado
title: Crock Pot Cantonese Shredded Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 corned beef brisket | 1/4 cup tomato and oil blend garlic fresh lime soda vinegar with | 2 tablespoons ginger ale | 1 teaspoon cumin, ground | 1/2 - 1 cup heavy cream, slightly thickened | 1 large avocado, sliced thin | 1 medium head shredded lettuce | 3 sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, chopped
instructions: Place brisket in crock pot, fat side up. Mix next 3 ingredients, pour over brisket and cover. Cook on low setting for 8 - 10 hours. Remove brisket from crock for serving. Shred with fork and reheat for 2 - 3 minutes. Stir and heat 2 minutes. Divide brisket among 4 rolls, and top with shredded lettuce, tomato slices, and sun dried tomatoes. Serve with a side of yogurt diagonally for dipping.

Random Ingredients: cabbage leaf,cinnamon,kaffir lime leaf,walnut half,mushroom stem,italian tomato,banana,anchovy paste
title: Anchovy-Walnut Stew
ingredients: 2 teaspoons anchovy paste | 4 large cabbage leaves, shredded | 1 medium napa cabbage leaf, shredded | 1 package fresh mushrooms stems, sliced | 1 package frozen banana slices | 1 can italian-style stewed tomatoes, undrained | 1/3 cup walnut halves | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place a pan of water on the stove. Cook anchovy paste in the boiling water, and let cool. Place 2 shredded cabbage leaves on a serving dish, and top with a row of napa cabbage leaves. Place mushrooms on top of the napa cabbage leaves, cover, and set aside in the refrigerator to marinate. Place the bananas and stewed tomatoes into a large, shallow baking dish. Add the walnuts and cinnamon, and stir to blend. Drain the marinade from anchovies into the sauce, and pour over the cabbage and bananas. Cover dish, and bake in the preheated oven 1 hour, or to desired doneness, or to desired doneness.

Random Ingredients: cumin,marsala wine,cooking oat,rice vinegar,cheddar cheese,tomato paste,tofu,tuna steak
title: Tofu Roulades
ingredients: 4 tuna steaks | 1/2 cup marmarsala wine | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon cumin | 1/4 cup low-fat cheddar cheese, shredded | 2 teaspoons tomato paste | 1/4 cup cooking oats | 1 1/2 teaspoons quick-cooking oats
instructions: Mix marmalade, rice vinegar, cumin and cheese together. Spread on tuna steaks and marinate for 30 minutes. Meanwhile, make patties in the form of a square mixture. Heat oven at 400 degrees. Combine patties with tomato paste and quickcooking oats. Roll in oat meal until well coated. Place on paper towels and let sit 10 minute before serving.

title: Bamboo Shoot Ceviche
ingredients: 3 cups bamboo shoots, stems and all, chopped ( or canned diced bamboo shoots ) | 1/2 teaspoon cumin
instructions: In a large bowl pour in the chopped bamboo and cumin. Mix thoroughly. Cover and refrigerate for at least one hour so the flavors can develop.

Random Ingredients: sauce,kidney bean,black mustard seed,lamb,vegetable oil cooking spray,white fish fillet
title: Baked Fish and Beans
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 lb white fish fillet | 1 lb lamb or 1 lb other white fish fillet, such as halibut | 4 teaspoons black mustard seeds | 3 -4 cups fresh kidney beans, boiled ( about 13 1/2 ounces ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon hot sauce
instructions: Coat grill with cooking spray. Remove and discard all bones from meat, except fish. Cut meat into 1 inch cubes. Drain beans if desired and rinse. In an ovenproof skillet, heat oil over moderately high heat until hot but not smoking. Add fish and meat, and cook until fish is just opaque in center, about 5 to 7 minutes.

title: English Muffin With a Crunch
ingredients: 1 english muffins or 1 hunk honey-roasted egg | 2 teaspoons dried tarragon, plus | 2 teaspoons fresh tarragon, divided use | 1 tablespoon fresh cilantro, divided use | 4 leaves iceberg lettuce | 4 sprigs fresh tarragon
instructions: Cut the muffins or hunk in half crosswise for easier eating. Cut a slit in each half with an oven mitt or scissors, and toast. Spread each half with 2 tsp tarragon, 2 tsp tarragon and 1 tsp cilantro. Garnish with the remaining sprigs of tarragon. Break the egg into the hollowed out halves and place, face up, in a small nonstick frying pan with 1/4 tsp tarragon and the 1/4 tsp cilantro. Cook over low heat until the egg is just set and opaque and the tarragon is fragrant.. Remove with a slotted spoon.

title: Real Simple Cheesy Velveeta Cheese
ingredients: 450 g velveeta cheese, cut into cubes | 4 saffron strands, soaked in
instructions: Add the saffron salt and the cheese to your vitamix and process on high for 15 minutes. Turn on to a greased baking tray. Spread cheese on top of dough and bake at 180 degrees, stirring every 7 to 8 minutes. You might need additional time depending on oven and the size of your vitamix. After cheese has baked at 180 degrees for 15 minutes, let cheese cool until you can handle it without burning your fingers. When all cheese is melted, spread on top of dough with your favourite butter.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile adobo,basil leaf,caper,green chilies,oregano leaf,cucumber
title: Chipotle Salsa
ingredients: 2 firm green chilies, stemmed | 3 canned chipotle chiles in adobo | 1/2 cup minced fresh basil leaf | 1 tablespoon capers | 1 tablespoon minced fresh oregano leaves | 1/4 cup peeled, seeded, and diced cuke cucumber, about 1/4 | 3 -5 dashes dried minced basil leaves
instructions: Prepare grill/broiler for direct heat. Grill chiles over direct high heat until blackened, about 5 minutes. Transfer to a food processor and grind to a chunky consistency. Combine with remaining ingredients until combined well.

title: Khandi
ingredients: 2 -3 cardamom pods | 2 tablespoons chat masala ( posted separately ) | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds
instructions: Boil the cardamoms about 2 minutes. Now add the mustard seeds and leave it for another minute or so, till the raisins smell good. Strain and serve.

Random Ingredients: flour,buffalo meat,french bread,nonfat plain yogurt,onion flake
title: Buffalo Meat
ingredients: 1/2 tablespoon dry onion flakes | 1 cup nonfat plain yogurt | 1/4 cup flour | 1 1/2 lbs smoked buffalo meat or 1 1/2 lbs ground buffalo | french bread ( optional )
instructions: Combine the onion flakes, yogurt and flour and mix well. Heat griddle to 350 degrees. Place meat if using in a fry pan and brown on both sides. Place in a casserole baking dish and put under the grill to brown it all over. To make into balls, put a ball of the meat mixture in the center of a casserole. Bake at 350 degrees for 10 minutes. Serve on a french loaf.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning,black bean,pinto bean,vegetable broth,golden caster sugar,balsamic vinegar,cracker
title: Black & Gold Refried Beans
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans | 150 ml black beans | 1 cup vegetable broth | 1 teaspoon balsamic vinegar | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning | 1 teaspoon golden caster sugar or 1 teaspoon regular sugar | 1 tablespoon cracker, crushed
instructions: Put first 4 ingredients in a non stick frying pan, stir through the rest, and simmer gently until thickened a minute or so. Pour into a shallow 2 litre capacity ovenproof dish. Sprinkle with crushed cheese or pate and pop into a preheated oven at 200°c / 300°f for around 5 - 6 minutes or until golden.

title: Kielbasa and Fennel in Sour Cream
ingredients: 8 ounces kielbasa | 1 pinch dried fenugreek seeds | 1 tablespoon dried italian herbs | 1 teaspoon dried fenugreek seeds | 1/4 cup sour cream | 3 tablespoons sliced almonds
instructions: Cut kielbasa or french fries into 2 inch wide strips. Sprinkle 1/4 teaspoon fenugreek and mezzarella over kielbasa. Sprinkle the 2 teaspoons italian herbs and 1/4 cup sour cream over all. Cover with plastic wrap and press down to submerge.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,karo syrup,gingerroot,tomato jalapeno,greek seasoning,parsley leaf,maraschino cherry,red chili pepper flake
title: Grilled Tomato Ginger Pastries
ingredients: 1 pint cherry tomatoes or 1 pint grape tomatoes, halved and deseeded, cut in halves | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 2 tablespoons karo syrup | 1 tablespoon gingerroot, grated | 1 red chili pepper flakes, deseeded and finely chopped | 4 teaspoons sun dried mediterranean seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon dried maraschino cherry ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons fresh parsley leaves, roughly chopped
instructions: Preheat the grill to high. Brush the tomatoes with the oil, pour on a pinch of the karo syrup, and grill for 8 - 10 minutes, turn and baste often, until the skin and tomato are soft and charred all over. Turn out onto a baking tray, let cool, then remove the skin and very dark flesh. Chop roughly and place in a bowl. Use a mortar and pestle to pound some of the seeds from the tomatoes into a coarse powder. In a small frying pan put the remaining karo syrup and ginger, red chili flakes, sambal oelek and sundried cherries and cook for about 5 mins over a medium heat, stirring, until the ginger is a pale, soft white colour. Add the parsley, stirring to combine. Set aside to cool. Cut a cross hatch slit in the underside of each tomato and stuff with 1/2 tsp of the ginger mixture. Put the pastries on the grill rack and brush again with karo syrup and season with any remaining oil. Grill the pastries for 6 - 8 mins, until the tomatoes are soft and the pastries are golden on top.

Random Ingredients: rice vinegar,superfine sugar,pastry double crust pie,asafoetida powder,cauliflower
title: Mashed Cauliflower Pie
ingredients: 1 pastry for double-crust pie | 1 medium cauliflower, cut into florets and then cut into florets | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 1 teaspoon superfine sugar | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder
instructions: Roll out pastry into a circle of about 11/2 to 12 inches in diameter until the circle is about 1/8 inch thick and about 9 in diameter. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. In a glass or ceramic bowl, combine the vinegar, sugar and asafetida. Make sure sugar is dissolved. Add cauliflower and toss to coat well. Transfer the cauliflower to a baking dish. Bake in oven for 15 minutes, or until the cauliflower becomes tender and crisp. This should not take longer than 45 minutes, or the oven is not preheated enough.

title: Grilled Cheese & Amaretto Skewers
ingredients: 1 cup chicken stock or 1 cup vegetable stock | 1/2 cup amaretto liqueur | 1/4 cup vegemite | 2 cloves ground cumin powder | 8 ounces cheese or 8 ounces other tasty cheese, grated
instructions: Place ingredients in a blender and process until smooth. Cut cheese into 16 squares. Thread cheese squares onto skewers. Brush with amaretto or any of the suggested marinating sauces and grill until cheese is melted and golden.

Random Ingredients: plum tomato,baby carrot,chicken bouillon,cumin,sea salt black pepper,coconut milk,rice,escarole
title: African-Spiced Rice With Escarole, Carrots, and Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 cup rice ( short-grain white rice could also be used ) | 1/2 cup green giant frozen baby carrots, defrosted in the microwave, and drained | 1/2 cup chopped escarole ( i like eckrich's organic white onions for this ) | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cumin | 1 cup chopped plum tomato ( plum with pith, about 1 large tomatoes-chopped ( if you like them ) or 1 cup kalamata olive ( plum with pith, about 1 large tomato-chopped ( if you like them ) | 1 cup light coconut milk | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt and black pepper
instructions: In a small bowl or saucepan, combine the coconut milk with the rest of the ingredients.

title: Spicy Plum Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 large fennel bulb | 2 plum tomatoes | 2 tablespoons dried pitted dates ( optional )
instructions: Cut fennel and tomatoes in half lengthwise, remove core. Using a spoon, scrape out the seeds with a teaspoon. Cut each half into thick slice at a 45 degree angle. Cut slices into 2 inch wide wedges. Drizzle the wedges with a bit of cooking oil and sprinkle lightly with salt. Cook, tossing once or twice for about 10 minutes or until tomatoes are tender.

title: Radish and Saffron Spread
ingredients: 350 g radishes, cleaned, peeled, cut into quarters, lengthways and then into 1/4 inch dice ( about 12 medium ) | 35 g saffron threads | 3 tablespoons mustard oil
instructions: Place radishes in a bowl, making sure they are all in contact with the water. Dissolve saffron in the water and pour it over radishes and toss lightly to coat. Cover with a clean cloth and leave to macerate at least 15 minutes. Drain and set aside. Heat the mustard oil in a small saucepan over high heat until smoking. Put the radish mixture into the hot oil and add saffron. Stir well about 30 seconds a minute or until the radish mixture turns shiny. Transfer mixture to a food mill or an electric chopper and whiz for one minute or until smooth. Add the mustard oil and whiz for another 30 seconds to blend, if required. Keep in mind that it will get thicker at first and will be less thickened. When serving, it will firm up and lose some texture and moisture. This is not an appetizer, because you may eat it raw.

Random Ingredients: red wine,dark soy sauce,chocolate candy,white wine vinegar,maple syrup,okra,red potato
title: Sweet Potatoes & Okra
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs small red potatoes, cut into chunks | 8 large okra, peeled | 2 tablespoons coarse ground dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 1 2/3 cups sweet white wine or 1 2/3 cups dry-cured black grape juice | 3/4 cup dark soy sauce | 1 1/2 cups hot dark-colored maple syrup
instructions: Place potatoes in a large saucepan, add water to cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat, cover and simmer until potatoes are tender, about 15 minutes. Drain and cool slightly. Cut potatoes into 1/4 inch cubes. Toss together okra, soy sauce, vinegar, sweet wine, half of the sweet wine or grape juice, the remaining sweet wine or grape juice and the dark soy sauce in a bowl, then set aside. Add sweetened sweet wine or grape juice mixture to potatoes and toss to coat. Makes about 2 3/4 cups. Sweet potato sauce,. Bring syrup to a boil, cook until reduced to 1/2 cup, about 15 minutes. Ladle hot syrup over potato mixture.

title: Sharing Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs rump roast, cut in 2 inch cubes | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon dry dijon mustard | 1 teaspoon ground coriander | 1 teaspoon dry chives | 2 tablespoons white flour | 1/2 cup creamed horseradish | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 3 ounces gouda cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to place meat in a shallow baking dish, and sprinkle with worcestershire sauce, mustard, coriander, chives and flour. Pour the half and half over top, followed by the grated cheese. Bake at 400° for 30 minutes, or until meat is tender and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: italian flat leaf parsley,demerara sugar,cashew nut,menudo spice mix,basil pesto,chili pepper
title: Fried Cashew Nuts (Menudo)
ingredients: 1 cup ground cashews | 1/4 cup dry basil pesto | 1/4 cup dry italian flat-leaf parsley | 2 teaspoons powdered chili peppers ( chili flakes preferred ) | 2 teaspoons ground menudo spice mix ( pinchos de menudo spice mix ) | 1/4 cup demerara sugar
instructions: Mix all ingredients by hand. Store in an air tight container at room temperature for up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: white breadcrumb,chicken wing,almond,cream chicken soup,bamboo shoot,green pepper,rotini pasta,salmon fillet
title: Smoked Salmon and Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons light cream of chicken soup | 1/4 lb smoked salmon fillet, cut into bite-sized chunks | 1/2 small green pepper, chopped | 1/2 lb fresh sliced bamboo shoot, chopped | 1/2 cup fresh white breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon dry instant coffee granules ( available at health food stores ) | 12 ounces uncooked rotini pasta, broken into bite-size pieces ( about 1/2 lb ) | 2 tablespoons slivered almonds, toasted ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Spray a shallow baking dish with cooking spray and set aside. In a small bowl, combine chicken soup, salmon, pepper, bamboo shoots, bread crumbs and instant coffee granules.

Random Ingredients: red pepper,lasagna noodle,ham hock,watercress,pecorino romano cheese,onion salt,heavy cream
title: Creamy Roasted Red Pepper Lasagna
ingredients: 1 tablespoon onion salt | 1 tablespoon watercress, chopped | 1/4 cup pecorino romano cheese, freshly grated | 2 packages fresh lasagna noodles | 6 ounces ham hocks | 1/2 roasted red pepper, sliced, drained | 1/4 cup heavy cream
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees. Combine the salt and watercress in a small bowl, and coat well with the cheese. Set aside. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add the lasagna pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, or until tender. Drain, and rinse with cold water, then drain again. Cut the ham hocks into pieces that are smaller than the red pepper slices, about half the width. Lay them in a roasting pan, and sprinkle with cheese. Put the roasting pan in the preheated oven for 20 minutes. Remove lid, and add the cream, roasted pepper slices, and hot red pepper slices. Cook for about 10 to 12 minutes, until hot and bubbly. Serve over your favorite pasta, and garnish with more cheese if you like.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,rom tomato,grain dijon mustard
title: Quick & Easy Chilli Tomato Chutney
ingredients: 5 roma tomatoes, seeded & chopped | 3 red chili peppers, chopped | 1 tablespoon coarse grain dijon mustard, to taste
instructions: Put the tomato pieces and chile peppers in a non stick pan, cook on low till the chiles are softened & turning dark & the tomatoes are breaking up. Add the mustard & stir to mix thoroughly. Tip into a bowl & leave to cool slightly before serving.

title: Meatball and Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 kg meat | 1/2 cup soft butter | 3 tablespoons rice vinegar | 6 tablespoons butter
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Grease an ovenproof dish. Line the dish with 1/2 of the butter/mrs. Peel the meat and dice into 1/2 centimetre cubes. Place in dish and sprinkle 1/2 of the butter/mrs. Add 1/2 of the rice vinegar and sprinkle with the remaining butter/mrs. Repeat with the rest of the ingredients adding the chopped meat. Pour over the remaining vinegar and butter. Cover and bake on oven tray for 2hrs. Remove cover and continue baking for a further 1 hour. Serve with salads.

Random Ingredients: green curry paste,jalapeno chile,linguine,icing sugar,active yeast,egg,blueberry,chocolate square
title: Spicy Blueberry and Chocolate Swirl Pasta
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast or 2 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 16 ounces fresh blueberries ( about 6 cups ) | 1/2 cup icing sugar | 1 egg | 1/3 cup green curry paste, like thai kitchen brand | 1 ounce unsweetened chocolate shavings ( use dark or brown semisweet or white chocolate chips or melt chocolate chips ) | 2 cups quick to eat red or wild al dente linguine | chocolate square, for dusting
instructions: In the bowl of your electric mixer, combine the yeast, sugar, egg and chile paste, and beat until smooth. Stir in the blueberries 1/3 cup at a time. Blend on medium speed. When the dough has become stiff and springy to the touch, turn it out onto a floured surface. Knead in the remaining blueberries and divide the dough in half. Place the half of each half on an oiled sheet of parchment paper. Cover the half with a cloth and let rise in a warm place until doubled in size, about 1/2 hour or until it has doubled. After the dough has doubled, press the rest down onto the sheets to 1/4 inch intervals. Sprinkle with icing sugar. Turn dough onto a baking sheet. Using a sharp knife score into 1/4 inch diagonal slices. Let rise until almost double in size, about 40 minutes. Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. Bake at 450 degrees f for about 10 minutes. Remove from the oven and bake in the oven for 3 minutes. Turn off the oven and set in a kitchen towel to drain off excess juices. In a small pot, melt the chocolate and whisk in a small amount of water. Remove from the heat and stir until smooth. To assemble, spread half of the noodles on top of a warm blueberry mixture. Top with slices of blueberry mixture. Add a second layer of noodles, then remaining blueberry mixture, then chocolate mixture. Dust with extra icing sugar and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,cumin powder,basil,cocoa,salsa,basil leaf,chicken bouillon cube,pork
title: Mexican Pork and Beans
ingredients: 1 lb country-style pork | 1 tablespoon hot chili oil | 1 -2 teaspoon cumin powder | 0.75 can of your favorite salsa | 6 -8 basil leaves | 1 chicken bouillon cube ( i have also used 2 oxo cubes ) | 1 -2 teaspoon dried basil | cocoa, to finish
instructions: Preheat your oven to 375 degrees. Wash and dry the pork. Slice into large chunks and sear them in the hot oil on both sides in a dutch oven or other oven safe pot. ingredients: 1 beef brisket | water to cover | 1/2 apple, cored and coarsely chopped | 1/2 white onion, coarsely chopped | 1 teaspoon coarse garlic salt | 1 teaspoon grated lemon peel | 16 hoagie rolls, split
instructions: Place brisket in a large pot with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil and add apple. Place onion, garlic salt and lemon peel in a food processor. Process until smooth. Brush mixture lightly over brisket. Cover and refrigerate 6 hours or overnight. Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat. Oil the grate. Remove brisket from refrigerator and arrange beef on the grill. Cook 15 to 20 minutes, turning occasionally, until an instant read thermometer inserted into the center of the meat reaches 135 degrees f. Transfer roast to a cutting board and slice thinly across the grain. Spoon apple mixture on toasted hoagie rolls and serve.

title: Chile Sauce
ingredients: 4 serrano peppers, seeded and chopped | 3 tablespoons dark brown sugar
instructions: Combine chiles, brown sugar, and salt in a mixing bowl and stir to combine. Scoop mixture into a clean saucepan and bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,rye bread,greek yogurt,vidalia onion,white potato,baguette
title: Lazy Potato Crostini
ingredients: 1 baguette, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 2 cups cooked tiny white potatoes, halved | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 2 cups shredded whole wheat greek yogurt or 2 cups plain yogurt | 1 small vidalia onion, sliced | 3 2 cups cooked crumbled rye bread or 2 cups bread crumbs
instructions: Preheat broiler. Cut bread slices in half horizontally. Arrange slices on a baking sheet. Broil, cut side down, about 3 inches from heat until golden brown, 3 to 5 minutes. Place soup in a 1 1/2 quart saucepan.

title: Baked Tortellini (Gourmet)
ingredients: 3 cups tortellini, fresh | 3 cups cheeses, shredded ( monterey jack, colby etc. ) | 1 cup fresh peppercorn ( cracked black peppercorns are my fav ) | 4 cups ice water | 1 teaspoon xanthan gum
instructions: Cook tortellini, rinse under cold water and drain. Add cheeses and peppercorns to boiling water. Remove from heat and add ice water to just loosen all the crusty bits before adding rest of ingredients. Pour into a large buttered casserole dish and bake at 325 degrees for 15 - 20 minutes. Serve warm, or refrigerate until ready to serve. Note, depending on how old the casserole dish is, you may have to cook it longer depending on how thick you like your cheese.

title: Beef Toast
ingredients: 3 small round steaks | 24 -30 slices sandwich bread or 24 -30 slices sourdough bread | 1/2 pint kaffir lime leaf ( or to taste )
instructions: In a small baking dish or other container with a lid, arrange the steaks, turning them over once or twice. Cover and refrigerate for at least one hour. Remove steaks from marinade. Spread cut surfaces of the bread with lime leaves. Cut sandwiches in half if needed. Place steaks back on the bread. Serve hot.

title: Maltese Pork Tenderloins
ingredients: 2 pork tenderloin, trimmed of visible fat ( about 1-1/2 inches in length ) | 20 g dark chocolate, coarsely chopped | 100 g shelled walnut pieces, coarsely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon cooking oil | 1/4 cup thinly sliced prosciutto ( cured ham )
instructions: Preheat oven to moderate. Place tenderloins in a single layer on a baking sheet with parchment paper touching, and brush surface with cooking oil. Bake at 220°c for 30 minutes, basting after 20 minutes, or until cooked throughout. Remove pork from oven and set aside. Place chocolate, walnuts and prosciutto in a microwave safe dish over low heat, stirring until chocolate is melted and smooth. Cool. Slice pork thinly into long slices using cleaver. Arrange on plates and top with melted chocolate. Garnish with a sprinkling of pepper. Serve from a large heated plate as desired.

title: Littleneck Leeks
ingredients: 4 leeks, cleaned, white and light green parts, sliced in 1/4-inch rounds ( about 1 1/2 pounds total ) | 3 radishes, peeled, cored, and sliced into 1 1/4-inch rounds
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil. Add leeks, and boil until just tender, about 7 minutes. Drain leeks well in a colander. Return leeks to boiling water, and continue boiling until all remaining liquid and leeks have cooked to your desired tenderness, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: ginger juice,pesto sauce,apple,egg yolk,chipotle chile,jalapeno pepper,miracle whip,apple cider
title: Chipotle Applesauce
ingredients: 3 tablespoons miracle whip | 3 tablespoons prepared pesto sauce | 3 chipotle chilies, seeded and minced | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh ginger juice | 2 large egg yolks | 2/3 cup apple cider or 2/3 cup water | 1 apple, cored and diced | 1 tablespoon jalapeno pepper, chopped | 4 teaspoons minced chipotle chiles
instructions: For dressing, combine all the ingredients in a medium bowl with a wire whisk or fork and mix well. For applesauce, combine all ingredients in a large saucepan. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Simmer for 5 minutes at the most. Add apple to dressing.

title: Black Rice
ingredients: 2 cups quick-cooking oil, or as desired | 2 teaspoons ground black rice, or as desired | 1 teaspoon ground allspice, or as desired
instructions: Heat oil in a saucepan over medium high heat. Cook and stir rice until it turns brown. Pour enough water to cover rice in the saucepan. Reduce heat to medium and sprinkle the allspice over the rice. Cover saucepan, and cook for 30 to 40 minutes. Uncover and cook for one more minute. Continue cooking rice, and fluff with a fork.

title: Fennel and Chai Tea
ingredients: 2 fennel bulbs | 1 tablespoon loose tea | 2 teaspoons loose tea
instructions: Cut away and discard the stalk. Trim off the root end of each fennel bulb and then slice it on the diagonal into 1/2 inch pieces. Place the pieces into a saucepan and add the loose tea. Cover and heat gently over low heat, until the fennel is just tender. Add the reserved fennel leaves and allow the heat to infuse for up to 30 minutes.

title: Chinese Scallops
ingredients: 12 scallops, trimmed | 1 slice apple | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon ground black pepper | 1/4 cup chopped cauliflower | 1 egg white | 1 1/2 teaspoons steak seasoning or 1 1/2 teaspoons marjoram, crushed
instructions: Combine ingredients except scallops. Arrange scallops in a lightly oiled casserole. Pour sauce over scallops. Cover with foil, bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes. Turn scallops over and bake for 15 to 20 minutes more or until done.

Random Ingredients: white potato,chicken stock cube,white onion,feta cheese,new potato,green bell pepper,maple syrup,yogurt
title: Warm Potato Stir-Fry
ingredients: 5 fresh white potatoes | 6 new potatoes | 1 small white onion | 1 green bell pepper | 2 tablespoons creamy maple syrup | 200 g frozen green potatoes | 1 teaspoon maple syrup | 1 chicken stock cube | 150 g feta cheese
instructions: Cut the potato halves into slices. Use a mandolin to slice the onion and place both into a large frying pan. Pour boiling water onto the onion and potato and allow to soften. Add the diced bell pepper and mix together. Add the chicken stock cube and maple syrup. Stir and allow to simmer until the redcurrent of the potato has evaporated. Remove pan from heat and allow to cool to room temperature. Cut the white potato slices into quarters and gently pull them apart using your fingers. Chop the onion and potato together in a food processor. Toss the potato slices together with the onion and potato mixture. Heat 2 - 3 tbsp of olive oil in a frying pan. Add the potatoes, stir fry for 5 - 6 mins until they are hot all the way through and a golden colour on the underside. Serve hot with kumara, pickles and pitta bread.

Random Ingredients: splenda sugar substitute,white sesame seed,beef stew meat,jalapeno chile,green cardamom pod,chicken thigh
title: Spicy Beef Satay With Chili
ingredients: 1 cup white sesame seeds | 1/2 teaspoon splenda sugar substitute | 1 lb boneless beef stew meat, cut into 3/4 inch cubes | 1/2 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut into 3/4 inch cubes | 2 cans diced jalapeno chiles | 4 green cardamom pods, split use
instructions: In a large resealable plastic bag, combine sesame seeds and sugar. Add meat, stirring to coat in the marinade. Refrigerate for 4 to 8 hours. In a small bowl, combine jalapenos with green cardamom pods. Remove meat from marinade and discard. Place 1 cup marinade in the freezer for later use. Meanwhile, prepare basting sauce, in a medium nonstick skillet over medium high heat, warm 1/4 to 1/3 cup of the reserved marinade. Add the sliced meat in batches and cook until browned, about 3 to 4 minutes per batch. Transfer to a plate and add remaining marinade. Simmer, uncovered, for 1 - ¼ hours, turning occasionally. If meat browns before sauce is thick enough, remove from heat and stir in reserved jalapenos and juice. Serve sauce over satays.

Random Ingredients: gelatin,basil leaf,red fresno chile,spring wrapper,dark rum
title: Evil Jungle Roll
ingredients: 1 tablespoon unflavored gelatin, dissolved in | 1 ounce dark rum | 2 spring roll wrappers | 1 1/2 - 2 ounces shredded dark chocolate, preferably 70 % cocoa solids | 6 -8 pieces fresh red fresno chiles ( julienned or seeded )
instructions: Place 1 tablespoon gelatin in bowl of an electric mixer fitted with a paddle attachment. Add rum and whip until smooth, about 10 minutes. Place 2 spring roll wrappers on work surface. Spread a scant teaspoon of the rum jelly in the center of each and top with a piece of chile. Working from the long side, wrap up each spring roll in the jam jelly jelly and tuck in the roll. Dip into a bowl of cold water then the other end of the spring roll wrapper. Repeat and dip again until dampened and covered. Set aside to dry at room temperature 30 minutes. Unwrap roll and slice crosswise into about 1/4 inch thick slices. Serve warm or at room temperature with cream or ice cream.

title: Tortelles De Feu
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless stewing beef | 2 tart apples | 1 pork loin
instructions: Wash the meat removing as much fat as possible from the top. Cut the meat into very thin slices. Tie the apple and pork loin pieces in bundles of 4 or 5 pieces that are the same size. Put the meat and apple together with remaining ingredients in a crockpot and add water to cover. Cover and cook on low setting for at least 5 to 10 hours, but longer, or longer will produce a better result. Remove meat and apples prior to serving.

Random Ingredients: corn,red pepper flake,red wine vinegar,squash,garlic clove,ranch dressing,sherry wine vinegar,kosher salt
title: Zesty Roasted Squash With Red Pepper Sauce
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs small squash, washed, ends trimmed | kosher salt | 1/4 cup sherry wine vinegar or 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 1/4 cup ranch dressing | 3 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1/2 cup corn, finely diced | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 garlic clove, chopped, minced | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Place all ingredients into a baking pan and spread them out evenly.

title: Duck Sausage With Guinness
ingredients: 1 duck, for double duck | 2 teaspoons celery salt | 24 ounces guinness stout
instructions: Preheat a 325°f oven. Rub inside of saute pan with celery salt. Wash and remove fat from duck and season inside of saute pan with celery salt. Place duck in dutch oven and place on middle rack of oven. Pour in guinness and place under the broiler, light the flames, and cook until duck fat melts, 3 - 4 minutes on each side. Slice sausages into thin slices and serve.

title: Creamy Grand Marnier
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dark rum | 4 ounces heavy cream | 1 1 ounce grand marnier or 1 ounce cointreau liqueur
instructions: Whip your cream with dark rum. Add the remaining ingredients, and mix well.

title: Pineapple Sweet and Sour Sauce With Marinade
ingredients: 1/4 cup lime zest, peeled and coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup grand marnier ( or other orange liqueur ) | 1/3 cup pineapple sauce | 1/2 teaspoon red pepper, freshly chopped | 1 stalk celery, finely chopped
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a blender, and process until fairly smooth. Sauce can be refrigerated until ready to use, then transferred to a sauce can.

title: Mirj's Grape Tomato Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 cup jasmine rice | 1 1/2 cups grape tomatoes, cut up ( canned tomatoes okay )
instructions: Place rice and tomatoes in a bowl of a food processor. Pulse for 2 - 3 seconds to mix well. Pour rice and tomato mixture into bowl with rice and tomatoes.

title: Halo-Ho. Hawaiian Style
ingredients: 1 lb pork sausage | 1 package large marshmallows | 12 chicken wings, split | 1 can crushed pineapple, undrained | 2 cups buttermilk | 1/4 cup dark rum | 12 ounces farfalle pasta or 12 ounces other tubular pasta | 1/4 cup hazelnuts, roasted, chopped
instructions: In a large saucepan, cook sausage over medium heat until no longer pink. Pour off grease, leaving about 1 tbs grease. Add marshmallows, and continue cooking, stirring constantly until marshmallows are light brown. Add chicken wings, pineapple, buttermilk and rum. Simmer 20 minutes, stirring frequently. Add farfalle and hazelnuts and heat through, stirring often. Serve warm.

title: Sliced Bamboo-Wrapped Wings
ingredients: 12 chicken wings, tips trimmed | 2 slices bacon, halved | 2 slices shiitake mushrooms | 1/2 cup fresh mint leaves, minced | 2 tablespoons dried sherry | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1 pound kielbasa
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat, add bacon, mushrooms, mint, sherry and turmeric. When the mixture begins to sizzle and smell dry and starts to smell fragrant, add the sliced kielbasa. Cook, turning occasionally, until the kielbasa is cooked through and the mushrooms are tender, about 10 minutes. Stir gently to avoid browning. Transfer the chicken wings to a covered bowl and refrigerate until they are cool, about 2 hours. Cut off ends of wings, and separate wings from tips. Slice wings crosswise across the grain about 1/2 inch thick. Line a baking sheet with a kitchen towel large enough to wrap wings in. Arrange wings on towel lined sheet and refrigerate until cold, about 2 hours. Remove wings from towel and pat dry. Cut slits into wings with a sharp knife. Fill a resealable plastic bag with wings, pressing down on the bag to flatten wings. Place bag in refrigerator, turning to coat wings with cooking mixture. Lay wings on baking sheet and freeze until solid, at least 4 hours. Transfer wings to a covered dish and place in refrigerator, turning occasionally, until cold, at least 15 minutes. Preheat grill for medium high heat. Lightly oil grate. Cook kielbasa slices on the preheated grill, turning, until lightly browned and cooked through, 3 to 5 minutes. Serve with sauce for dipping.

title: Sweet and Simple Curry Veggies
ingredients: 5 -6 large firm tender veggies | 1 small sweet green pepper | 1 -2 tablespoon mild curry paste
instructions: Cut veggies into 1 inch pieces, and put in pot of cold water so it wont be crowded.
