You may also leave whole, etc. Add a tablespoon of curry paste to water, if desired to keep it from sticking to veggies. Turn heat down as low as possible so it cooks at a slow simmer or high heat. Cooking usually takes about 15 - 30 minutes or so. You may add more water after about 10 minutes, as the curry paste takes on more flavor. Taste, and add more curry until the veggies are the right balance of crunchy and evenly coated with seasonings. The water should be plenty salty. Taste again, and add more salt. Some folks like more.

title: Coconut-Walnut Stew
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chuck or 1 1/2 lbs sirloin steak | 2/3 cup walnuts | 1/2 cup sweet hungarian whiskey | 2 cans coconut cream | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1/2 cup irish whiskey
instructions: Trim all visible fat and sinew from meat and slice into 1/4 inch slices. If using chuck steak cut it into 1 inch cubes or larger. Mix walnuts, 1/2 cup raisins, 3 tablespoons whiskey, salt and pepper in large heavy saucepan. Add meat and enough water to cover meat over medium high heat. Bring to boil and reduce heat to low. Simmer, covered 20 minutes, then stir to separate meat. Add cream, boil, uncovered, stirring occasionally, until thickened, about 1 hour, adding more liquid by 1 tablespoonfuls if necessary. Remove from heat and serve.

Random Ingredients: bread,coriander seed,chicken bouillon,kosher salt black pepper,coffee,lavender,prosciutto
title: Dirty Toast
ingredients: 4 slices of crusty bread | 2 dashes coffee | 1 chicken bouillon | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1/2 cup lavender, dried | 1/2 teaspoon coriander seed | 1/4 lb prosciutto, thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat broiler so that the heat is at its highest. Place 1 slice of bread at a time over a hot drip pan. Cover with hot coffee and let soak. Remove the lid and quickly toast, using tongs, the edges of the bread, into a dry, very tiny brown. If the bread will burn, transfer to foil covered tray and repeat until all the toast is removed, wiping out the pan between every toast. After removing bread from oven, sprinkle liberally with salt and pepper. Add 1/4 pound of prosciutto and 1/4 pound of lavender to the top of the toast, then finish with a splash of coffee and a little bit of the coriander and dried spices. Place on a large tray and place under broiler to brown a little bit. When done, the top should be bubbly and the lavender fragrant.

title: Quick Beef With Shrimp & Garlic Noodles
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 lb fresh roast beef, cut into thin strips | 1 can old elbow macaroni or ( 16 ounce ) can rotelle pasta | 2 tablespoons browning sauce ( or any other favorite sauce )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400f degrees. In a large skillet, heat the oil over medium high heat, add the roast beef.

Random Ingredients: lime sherbet,sugar,italian salad dressing,ice cube,lime juice,serrano pepper
title: Lime Margarita
ingredients: 2 cups frozen lime sherbits, thawed | 1 cup chilled italian salad dressing | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 1/4 teaspoon sugar | 2 -3 serrano peppers, minced | ice cube
instructions: Combine sherbits, salad dressing, lime juice, sugar and chiles in a blender. Cover and blend on high speed for 20 - 30 seconds or until well combined. Pour into glass. Add crushed ice cubes, stir. Serve immediately. Also excellent with a fresh green salad.

title: Lebanese Pancetta (With Pancetta)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons pancetta, finely minced ( bacon fat may be substituted ) | 1 teaspoon lemon juice ( to taste ) | salt and pepper, to taste
instructions: Saute the pancetta in a fry pan or skillet. If using pre warmed skillet, you may want to add more oil, if you like. When the pancetta is light brown, add lemon juice to pan and reduce heat to simmer. Season with sugar and salt and pepper if desired. Serve hot.

title: Pork Chops With Strawberries and Strawberries (Pavlova Me Melanzane)
ingredients: 4 bone-in pork chops | 12 fresh strawberries or 12 baby bok choy | 1 pint fresh strawberries or 1 pint fresh baby bok choy
instructions: In an airtight container with a lid, place the pork chops in a single layer and season on both sides with salt and pepper. Cover with plastic wrap and turn to coat both sides. Let sit for 15 to 30 minutes. Remove excess moisture by pouring out the liquid onto a kitchen towel. Rinse the pork chops and dry on paper towels. Place a layer on the bottom of a heavy nonreactive skillet, followed by a layer of sliced bok choy. Repeat with all the pork chops in the same manner. Pour the strawberries over the pork chops. Carefully pile the bok choy on top of the bok choy and strawberries. Cover and cook over medium to medium heat for at least 1 1/4 hours, removing the cover for the last 15 minutes, covering for the last 20 to 30 minutes to crisp the top. Serve with french fries, crusty bread or toasted pita triangles.

Random Ingredients: phyllo pastry,orzo pasta,rosemary leaf,cilantro leaf,garlic salt,romano cheese,picante sauce
title: Mexican Strudels
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs phyllo pastry | 1 can prepared picante sauce | 3/4 lb romano cheese, grated | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/4 teaspoon dried rosemary leaves | 1/4 cup cilantro leaf, cut into strips | 1 package frozen phyllo pastry, thawed ( 20 sheets ) | 1/2 cup orzo pasta, cooked
instructions: Brush two 8 1/2 x 4 inch pans generously with oil. On a lightly floured work surface, roll out both sheets of phyllo dough into two 14 x 9 inch rectangles. Cover with a piece of plastic wrap and a clean, damp towel, and allow to rise 15 minutes. Place one of the sheets of dough about 1 inch from the edge of the two sheets of parchment paper in the pan. On a clean work surface, spread one half of the phyllo sheets with about 1/2 the picante sauce. Top with the remaining philyllo sheets, picante sauce, cheese, garlic salt and dried rosemary leaves, and 1/4 cup cilantro. Bring the edges of the two sheets of phyllo together over the filling, overlapping the filling evenly for a tight seal. With a sharp knife, cut two 3/4 inch deep slits in the top of each strudel. Carefully transfer the strudels to the prepared pans. Cover with the remaining pastry sheets, and brush with oil. Place the pans in a preheated 350° oven. Bake 25 minutes, or until the cheese is bubbly. Using a spatula, remove the brussels from the sheets of phyllo, and transfer to a cutting board. Cut the strips crosswise into 3/8 inch thick slices. Place the slices cut sides down on a serving plate. Heat the remaining 1/2 cup of oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add the sliced brussels, and fry, turning once, until golden brown on both sides, 2 to 3 minutes. If the pan becomes too dry, add a little warm water. Serve with cooked rice, tortillas, or pico de gallo.

Random Ingredients: pine nut,natural peanut butter,spanish onion,veal cutlet,clam juice,cilantro leaf,salad oil
title: Marinated Sole
ingredients: 4 veal cutlets ( about 2 pounds ) | 1 small spanish onion, seeded and thinly sliced ( about 1/2 cup ) | 1/2 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 1/2 cup reduced-sodium clam juice | 1 cup natural-style peanut butter | 1 cup bottled clam juice | 2 tablespoons salad oil | 1/4 cup toasted pine nuts
instructions: Rinse cutlets and set aside. Arrange onions in a shallow 3 to 4 quart glass and plastic container or bowl on top of onions. Pour 1/2 cup clam juice over onions and let stand at room temperature for 15 minutes. Transfer juice to a bowl and set aside. Meanwhile, heat peanut butter in a medium saucepan over medium heat until smooth, about 2 minutes. Add clam juice, peanut butter mixture, and 2 tablespoons water.

title: Elegant Apricot and Mustard Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese, softened | 1/4 cup apricot preserves | 1/4 cup light corn syrup | 1/3 cup light corn syrup | 1/4 cup instant tea, warm | 1 tablespoon prepared mustard
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix cream cheese, apricot preserves, light corn syrup, light corn syrup, instant tea and mustard. Spread into a 9 inch springform pan. Bake in the preheated oven for 30 to 40 minutes, or until lightly browned and the center of the cake moves slightly when shaken. Remove from oven, and cool for 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Grilled Creole Ice Cream
ingredients: 30 ounces vanilla ice cream, softened | 2 cans chipotle peppers
instructions: Spread softened ice cream on bamboo skewers. Place chipotle peppers in a skillet over medium high heat and cook 2 minutes, until slightly blackened. Spread onto skewers and grill for 5 to 10 minutes, until lightly browned. Let cool completely. Slice into 4 to 6 pieces.

title: Chipotle Kielbasa
ingredients: 12 ounces dried kielbasa, cut into 1/2 inch slices about 1 3/4 inches long | 2 cans chipotle chiles, with liquid | corn oil, for deep-frying
instructions: In a large resealable bag, combine dried chiles with liquid and shake to combine. Stuff half the chipotle chiles with the kielbasa slices, pressing them into the chile filling. Repeat until all are stuffed. In a large heavy skillet, add half of oil to almost smoking over medium high heat. Fry coated kielbasa until golden brown all over, 12 to 15 minutes. Remove, drain and blot with paper towels. Repeat with remaining 2 cans of stuffed chiles and add drained and rinsed chiles to skillet with oil. Cook, uncovered, over high heat, stirring constantly until slightly charred and hot, 4 to 5 minutes. Serve warm. Serves the remaining can be reheated.

Random Ingredients: chili,mushroom,chive,dark soy sauce,sun tomato oil,tomato,ham steak
title: Sun-Dried Tomato and Chilli Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 500 g lean pork or 500 g ham steaks | 4 slices of your favourite tomato | 3 -4 chives | 2 -3 teaspoons dark soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon chopped dried chili | 1/2 cup fresh mushrooms
instructions: Slice the ham or veg into strips about 30 x 25 cm. Slice and then slice the tomatoes. Slice the chillies if using. Slice your chives and mushrooms. Remove any damaged bits with the edge of your knife. Put the sun dried tomato oil into a wok or large frying pan with a good pinch of salt. Tip in the oil stirring well and once it is well heated, turn down the heat and add the pork or ham. Cook for about 5 - 7 minutes or until the outside is golden brown, set to one side and then slice up and stir in the chillies and sundried tomatoes and stir again for 3 - 4 minutes. Tip, serve this with rice, bread and salads.

Random Ingredients: yellow pepper,cabbage,canola oil,white sugar,green enchilada sauce,steak,marjoram,rice wine
title: Quick Beef Enchilada Supper
ingredients: 3 lbs steak, flank steak or 3 lbs skirt steaks, cut across the grain into strips | 1 head cabbage | 2 -3 lbs yellow peppers | 3 cans green enchilada sauce | 2 jars of jalapeno stuffed enchilada sauce | 8 tablespoons rice wine | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 4 tablespoons white sugar | 1 tablespoon dried marjoram
instructions: The first step is to shred the vegetables. I use my hand shredded cabbage for the shredding part of the recipe. If you are worried about the size of the meat, just shred it. Cut the meat into strips the same width as the jalapenos. Combine the meat in a large glass bowl or bowl that has a tight cover, breaking it up slightly. Use your hands to mix well. Add the chopped vegetables and mix well.. I just make everything into this, even i can't get the cabbage into more than about 1/2 inch of shreds. Heat 1 tablespoons of canola oil in a large bottomed frying pan. You want it to hot so that the oil can get in the beef just right. Stir fry the meat over medium heat. This will produce a browned, blackened crust in the meat. It takes about 8 - 10 minutes. Once the meat is browned, remove it from the pan. I usually remove it from the heat. Reserve the browned bits of meat. I just put the pieces back in where they were left out of the pan. Return the browned bits back in to the pan to clean them up. When they are done, return them to the pan. In a medium bowl, add the 1 tablespoon of canola oil. Add in the rice wine to deglaze. I like to use a dry vermouth so that the wine is a little spicier but not too sweet. Just combine the rice wine and marjoram and set it aside. Once all the meat is in the pan, stir it a few times to coat the meat with the sauce. This will give it a chance to absorb some of the sauce. The longer you leave it in the sauce, the more flavorful the sauce becomes so that it can stick in the meat. Once the meat is done, drain the juice off of them. Add the rice wine vinegar to the meat and vegetables, mix well. If the sauce is too thick for your taste, you can add 2 tablespoons of water. It should be fairly thick and juicy. Return the meat to the skillet, add the green enchilada sauce. Stir to mix. Heat over medium high heat until the stew is very hot, about two minutes. I put a lid on the skillet and let all heat up for about about 10 minutes. The longer you let it cook, the thicker the sauce will be and the meat will be cooked all the time.

title: Chicken With Prawns
ingredients: 1 chicken | 30 prawns
instructions: Pre heat oven to 180c. Boil prawn shells in lots of water, and then put them all together in a roasting tin with plenty of seasoning. Cover the pan with foil and bake for 30 minutes. Remove the foil and cook for further 15 - 20 minutes or until golden.

title: Beef on the Rocks
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef roast ( deli or round ) | 4 slices mozzarella cheese | 5 lettuce ( iceberg cut, large, heart, romaine lettuce or mix lettuce lettuce and cheese together ) | 1/2 cup raw cashews, chopped
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. Place roast in a large, shallow casserole dish. Cut cheese over the top of the roast and toss in the cashews. Drizzle with remaining marinade. Bake uncovered for 1 hour, or until the meat is tender.

title: Coconut Balls (Shrikhand)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon capers | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 3/4 teaspoon vegetable oil | 3 slices bacon grease
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the capers with the turmeric, vegetable oil and salt. Set aside. Dip the bacon pieces in the egg batter and then fry on each side until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: russet potato,turmeric powder,green jalapeno pepper,worcestershire sauce,tamarind pulp
title: Tamarind Chutney
ingredients: 5 large russet potatoes ( peeled and very thinly sliced ) | 2 green jalapeno peppers | 1/2 cup tamarind pulp | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Put all ingredients in a wide, heavy skillet, and stir frequently over medium heat until all is mixed in nicely. Lower heat to low, and simmer for 20 - 30 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Naked Pear Cheese Appetizer (Microwave)
ingredients: 2 slices american cheese ( thin slices ) | 2 -3 pieces pears
instructions: Place the slices of american cheese in your microwave safe dish, and sprinkle slices with a little bit of the juice of the american cheese. Top this with the pear, and wrap it all up in microwave safe foil. Cook on high power for 3 - 4 minutes. Let cool slightly, and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: eggplant,manchego cheese,beef bouillon cube,chicken bouillon,italian salad dressing,ricotta cheese
title: Italian Roast Beef & Eggplant Roll-Ups
ingredients: 1 italian eggplant, about 1.5 lbs, halved lengthwise, then sliced 1/3 inch thick | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 2 ounces packages fat-free ricotta cheese or 12 ounces fat free cottage cheese | 16 slices manchego cheese ( thin slices ) | 12 chicken wingettes or 12 roll ups | 3 tablespoons fresh italian salad dressing
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Pierce eggplant several times with a fork, salt and pepper each side. Place eggplant in a lightly oiled pan and roast in the oven for 45 minutes or until tender. Remove from oven to a large platter, cover with foil and leave to cool on a wire rack. When cool enough to handle, peel away skin and cut into thin slices. Set aside. Combine ricotta and eggplant in a medium mixing bowl.

title: Shrimps Cream Pizza
ingredients: 20 ounces puff pastry, thawed | 2 ounces shrimp, cooked, peeled, chopped | 1 ounce large shrimp, cooked, chopped | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1 1/2 ounces pizza crust, thawed, cut into 6 6 pieces
instructions: Place pastry on sheet of heavy duty aluminum foil in 450 oven to warm. While the pastry is warming up, heat 3 to 4 fl. Oz. Of water in 12 inch nonstick skillet over high heat. When it starts to bubble, pour shrimp around the edge of the skillet, leaving a 1/4 inch border around the shrimp. Pour in shrimp and cook, stirring, 1 minute. Reduce heat to medium and spray pastry with cooking spray. Roll out dough on dough into 18 x 12 inch rectangle, beginning at 11/2 inch edge. Cover with damp kitchen towel and let it rest at room temperature 15 minutes.. Preheat oven to 400 f. Remove pastry from refrigerator and spread shrimp mixture on bottom half and roll out again, stretching it all the way around. Arrange empaned frozen shrimp in 11 x 9 inch rimmed baking sheet, seam side up. Place crust on sheet and brush top with milk. Brush top with egg wash and bake until crust just begins to crackle, 15 to 20 minutes. Remove from baking sheet. Top each rasher with 1/2 teaspoon whipped cream, 1/2 teaspoon dried shrimp, and 2 tsp. Diced dried rosemary.

title: Vegan Beer Bread Pizzas #2
ingredients: 18 slices english muffins | 1/4 cup unsweetened tikka soymilk | 1 tablespoon light beer | 1 teaspoon mixed herbs | 1 teaspoon tequila | spaghetti, bread rounds or crackers | spaghetti, bread rounds | herbs, to taste
instructions: Place the english muffins slices on a baking sheet and grill at 400 degrees f. For 10 minutes, turn, and grill for another 5 minutes or until browned and toasty. Remove all the muffins from the oven and set aside. In a medium sized bowl, stir together the soy milk and beer. Add the herbs, tequila and mixed herbs and gently stir to blend. Spread about 1 tbsp of the spiced sauce in the bottom of a 12 in pizza pan. Arrange about 1/3 of the bread in the pan on top of the sauce. Arrange another 1/3 of the bread on top of the bread and sprinkle the with additional spiced sauce. Spoon 1/4 cup of the the spicy soy milk mixture evenly over the bread. Top with remaining bread slices, toasting in the oven if you wish. Cover with aluminum foil and freeze for about 6 hours. Remove the foil and bake for 15 minutes at 400 degrees f, or until the crust is golden brown.

title: Yassa
ingredients: 2 medium mint sprigs ( about 3 mint sprigs ) | hot paprika ( for best results )
instructions: Cut the mint sprigs into three or four lengths. Place the leaves in a heavy pot with 1 1/2 quarts of water. Bring to a boil over medium heat. As soon as the water begins to boil, add the dried mint sprigs. Reduce the heat to low, cover, and cook until the mint is completely soft and all of the water has evaporated, about 1 hour 20 minutes. Remove the mint from the liquid and discard. Cool, pour into a clean, dry jar and store in a cool, dark place away from heat. Wash and dry the jar, and adjust the seasoning with hot paprika.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,bean sprout,whiskey,rice wine vinegar
title: Rice Jelly Bean Sprouts Salad
ingredients: 4 bunches fresh bean sprouts | 2 tablespoons whiskey | 2 teaspoons rice wine vinegar | 2 slices monterey jack cheese
instructions: Place the sprouts onto a cookie sheet and bake in the middle of the oven for 10 - 15 minutes, or until just beginning to soften. Make a slurry with the whiskey and vinegar, and then immediately toss together with the sprouts in a bowl. Sprinkle with the cheese.

Random Ingredients: enchilada sauce,sweetcorn,vanilla bean,icing sugar,pork sausage,saffron,self raising flour,tahini
title: Sausage & Sweetcorn Sizzle Bread
ingredients: 1/2 kg mince raw pork sausage | 1/2 liter enchilada sauce | 1/2 liter tahini | 1 vanilla beans, split lengthways | 250 g self raising flour | 250 g sweetcorn ( canned ) | 250 g icing sugar | 1 pinch saffron
instructions: Preheat oven to 190 deg c. Combine pork sausage, enchilada sauce, tahini, and vanilla, stir until combined. In separate bowl, combine flour, sweetcorn, icing sugar and saffron. Mix into mince mixture to form dough. Shape mixture into 4 equal size loaves, place in a 9 x 13 baking tray and bake for 1 hour 30 minutes.

title: Lemongrass Guacamole Salad
ingredients: 1 stalk lemongrass | 20 pitted black olives | 2 tablespoons vanilla sugar | 1/2 - 1 cup guacamole
instructions: Thinly slice lemongrass. Drain black olives, dice and mix with the lemon grass. Add the vanilla sugar and mix. Spread on bagels or fresh, sliced bread and refrigerate until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: plain yogurt,crescent dinner,fenugreek,shallot,savory,vanilla bean paste,serrano pepper,nacho cheese tortilla chip
title: Yogurt-Wrapped Crescent Rolls
ingredients: 2 cans crescent dinner rolls | 1 jar nacho cheese flavored tortilla chips | 1 tablespoon minced shallots | 2 tablespoons minced serrano peppers | 1 tablespoon minced fresh savory | 1/2 teaspoon dried fenugreek | 1 teaspoon dried epazote leaves | 1 carton plain yogurt | 1 -2 teaspoon vanilla bean paste
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees f. Unroll the crescent roll dough and separate into two rectangles on a lightly floured work surface. Place the dough rectangles on a baking sheet in the oven and bake for 15 to 20 minutes, or until puffed and slightly golden. Scoop out and transfer to a bowl, then place crescent rolls on a cutting board and cut a 1/4 inch deep crosswise slit lengthwise along the top of the triangles to form a crescent. Stuff with the chips and sprinkle shallots, minced serrano peppers, savory, fenugreek, and epazote over crescent rolls. Place the two tortillas on a parchment lined baking sheet and bake for 15 to 20 minutes, or until crisp. Remove from oven and top each with a dollop of yogurt and flaked vanilla bean paste.

Random Ingredients: ricotta cheese,monterey jack cheese,sherry wine,cucumber,flour tortilla,mango chutney,red chili pepper,whipping cream
title: Creamy Tropical Quesadillas
ingredients: 2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese | 2 cups shredded cucumbers | 1/2 cup crumbled lowfat ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup chopped mango chutney | 3 tablespoons sherry wine | 8 flour tortillas | 1 cup low-fat whipping cream | 1/4 cup red chili pepper
instructions: Combine cottage cheese, cucumber, ricotta cheese, mango chutney, sherry and 1/2 cup of the cheese mixture in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: thai fish sauce,escarole,worcestershire sauce,almond,water artichoke heart,turmeric
title: Quick Thai-Style Pasta Salad - Vegan
ingredients: 2 cups escarole, chopped ( or mixed greens ) | 1 can water-packed artichoke hearts, chopped ( undrained ) | 1/3 cup sliced almonds, toasted | 10 tablespoons thai fish sauce | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1/2 teaspoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl, tossing well. Cover and refrigerate at least 30 minutes. Enjoy.

title: Spicy Pork and Squid Sushi
ingredients: 1/2 lb dried calamari, cleaned, sliced | 1/2 lb pork spareribs, cut into 1 1/2 inch pieces | 1/2 lb lobster meat, cut into 1 cup pieces | 2 cups cooked couscous | 1/3 cup watercress | 1 nori ( dry seaweed ) ( optional )
instructions: Cook the spaghetti as per the package directions, omitting the salt and oil. Cut the calamari and pork into chunks and set aside in a large bowl and reserve. Add the lobster and shrimp meat to the bowl with the seafood and toss together. To prepare the sushi, bring 3/4 cup of water to a boil in a 2 quart saucepan. Cook the couscous in boiling water for 3 to 4 minutes, or until al dente. Drain in a sieve into a bowl, pressing out excess liquid. Transfer to a bowl. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and set aside in the refrigerator to cool to room temperature. Heat 1/8 inch of water in a 10 inch skillet over moderate heat. When the water is hot, add the nori and remove it from the heat. Put a nori sheet on a work surface. Brush it with water, then cover with another sheet and press on lightly with a rolling pin. Cut the nori into long strips about 2 1/2 inches long. Arrange a fourth cup of the shrimp and spaghetti near the center of each piece of nori. Add 1 1/2 cups of the shrimp and spaghetti. Place a fourth cup of the lobster meat over the seafood, then top with a third cup of the pasta and one fourth of the seafood and crab mixture — then season with the remaining seafood and sea topping. Sprinkle each serving with some of the nori and seaweed. Cut the seaweed sheets into 3 long strips. Arrange the seaweed slices over the seafood. Pick up one side of the nori and set it flat on its side on the hot bamboo mat in front of you. Fold the seaweed in half over the seaweed and, using scissors to make a cut off center of the seaweed. Turn the mat over and then continue folding once more so that the seaweed is just holding its shape. Slide the mat onto the bamboo mat, lift the bamboo mat and seaweed onto the nori, then cut it into four pieces. To serve, cut a wedge or two across the nori so that it fans a small amount of the nori around the bowl. Spoon the hot seaweed onto one side of the bowl. Pick up the other side and, holding the nori, slice it thinly against the nori to form a fan shape.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chile,balsamic vinegar,bok choy,chicken drumstick,pernod,chili oil,ajwain,bread
title: Chinese Chicken Sandwiches
ingredients: 4 cups lightly packed coarse country bread | 1 cup pernod ( or light rum ) | 1 cup balsamic vinegar | 1 teaspoon chili oil | 1 teaspoon garam masala balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon chopped pernod ( or light rum ) | 1 cup chopped fresh tomato with green chiles | 1/2 teaspoon ground ajwain, or to taste ( optional ) | 3 pounds chicken drumsticks | 2 bunches bok choy, chopped
instructions: Process bread crumbs and pernod in a food processor.

title: Mosaic's Lobster Tail
ingredients: 12 cooked lobster tails | 1/2 cup fruit preserves
instructions: Place lobster tails in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Mash lobster tails with a fork until mostly submerged. Spread fruit preserves on top. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 30 minutes. Bake in a preheated 375 degree f oven until lobster is hot and topping is golden.

title: Chinese Herbed Mint Oil
ingredients: 5 tablespoons dried mint | 2 tablespoons minced fresh ginger root
instructions: Pour mint into a mortar and pestle, then add ginger and stir until the ginger and mint are evenly blended. Store in a tightly covered container at room temperature until needed.

Random Ingredients: saffron thread,barley,yellow mustard,rosemary,pineapple,cream mushroom soup,sage leaf
title: French Canadian Sherry Mushroom Dip
ingredients: 250 g cream of mushroom soup | 1/4 cup light rum or 1/4 cup light rum | 1 tablespoon prepared yellow mustard | 1 tablespoon sage leaf | 1 tablespoon thyme | 1 teaspoon rosemary | 1/2 teaspoon saffron thread
instructions: Combine cream of mushrooms soup, rum, mustard and herbs in blender. Blend till smooth. Pour into serving dish. Top with saffron. Serve with crackers.

title: Couscous Crumb Mix (And Bread Crumbs)
ingredients: 14 1/2 ounces italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 cup couscous
instructions: Mix well. Put in bowl of a greased 2lb loaf pan. Press into pan with a 9x13 in, or smaller loaf pan. Bake at 375 for 45 - 50 minutes until cooked through and golden brown.

title: Gramma's Russian Meatballs
ingredients: 500 g ground chuck | 2 egg whites or 2 whole eggs | 2 tablespoons finely chopped pistachios | 2 tablespoons french mustard, dijon style | 1 cup beef bouillon cube | 2 tablespoons instant au jus instant powdered soup cube | 3 teaspoons instant english mustard | 1 egg yolk, mixed with | ground black pepper, for topping
instructions: Mix together the ground chuck, egg whites or whole eggs, pistachios, mustard and beef bouillon cube. Knead mixture until soft and the consistency of coarse breadcrumbs. Cover and place in the refrigerator for 2 hours to firm. Preheat oven to 180°c. Place meatballs in a baking dish or roasting tin. Using a 1/2 cup measuring or funnel with a 1/4 inch diameter bead spoon, make balls from your rounded palm. Use a teaspoon to scoop out the centre of the meatballs. Coat lightly with black pepper, then dip each in egg mixture. Place in the oven for 45 minutes until brown on the outside.

title: Raisin-Fennel Crackers
ingredients: 2 cups cracked crackers | 3/4 cup raisins | 2 tablespoons flounder liquid smoke flavoring | 1 tablespoon fennel seed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. In medium bowl, combine crackers, raisins, and liquid smoke. Place on a parchment lined baking sheet. Smooth coarsely. Sprinkle with fennel seed. Bake 10 minutes, or until lightly browned.

title: Tostones
ingredients: oil ( for frying ) | 1 package shredded lettuce | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes ( more or less to taste )
instructions: Heat oil for deep frying in deep fryer or large non stick skillet until it has reached 375 degrees. If using non stick skillet, add about a tablespoon of oil to the non stick skillet. In a bowl, mix the shredded lettuce with the crushed red pepper. Add about a tablespoon of the shredded lettuce mixture at a time to the oil before tossing to coat. Cook each batch in the hot oil, turning once, until crisp and browned on both sides. Remove from the oil to drain on paper towels.

title: Roasted Pork Tenderloin With Horseradish Dressing
ingredients: 2 tablespoons unsweetened coconut, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon grated fresh horseradish | 3 tablespoons apple juice | 6 lbs pork tenderloins | olive, if desired
instructions: Pre heat oven to 425°f mix the coconut, horseradish and apple juice. Rub the coconut mixture all over the pork tenderloins. Spray the slather onto the cut surface about ½” apart and refrigerate in an over proof dish for 30 minutes or longer. Place the pork between 2 pieces of parchment paper and flatten. Turn down the oven and roast until desired doneness, about 20 minutes. Brush the meat with oil and serve over greens, egg noodles or mashed potatoes.

title: Beet-Chicken Stew
ingredients: 1 can chicken bouillon | 1/3 cup japanese soy sauce | 1 package frozen beets, thawed | 1 can sliced pickled beets, drained | 1/4 cup watermelon, cut into thin strips
instructions: Place chicken bouillon in saucepan and add soy sauce, beets and water. Bring to a boil, then simmer for 10 minutes, or until beets and watermelon are tender. Serve over steamed rice, sprinkled with julienned beets.

title: Gundruhnaloru
ingredients: 1 cup short-grain rice | 1 teaspoon aniseed | 3 teaspoons ground aniseed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f grease a baking sheet or line lightly with parchment paper. Spread 1/2 cup water over the baking sheet, then sprinkle in the rice and aniseed. Bake for 40 to 50 minutes, stirring occasionally, until golden. Cool on the baking sheet or transfer to a wire rack.

title: Chunky Buffalo Soup
ingredients: 1 can beef broth | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 2 tablespoons bourbon | corn tortilla chips, crushed
instructions: Combine beef broth, cream of tartar, bourbon and crushed tortilla chips. Chill at least 2 hours before serving. Serve cold.

title: Mexican Flank Steak
ingredients: 1 pound flank steak, fat trimmed | 1/4 cup cold water | 2 tablespoons french dressing | 1 1/2 tablespoons golden raisins | 2 cloves garlic powder | 2 poblano chiles - chopped
instructions: Preheat grill for medium low heat. Place rack 3 inches from heat. Place the flank steak on the rack, and cover. Cook for 45 minutes. Cool slightly and cut into thick slices. Mix the cold water, french dressing, golden raisins, garlic powder and poblanos in a shallow dish. Place the steak slices on the rack and coat with the dressing. Arrange the pieces on the grill. Cover and cook for 20 minutes, or until desired doneness.

Random Ingredients: baby lima bean,cucumber,purpose white flour,chili pepper flake,apple cider vinegar,italian parsley
title: Baby Lima Beans With Apple Cider
ingredients: 2 quarts dry baby lima beans | 3 medium cucumbers | 1 tablespoon chili pepper flakes | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried italian parsley | 3 tablespoons all-purpose white flour | 2 tablespoons light apple cider vinegar
instructions: Rinse the lima beans and pick out any damaged bits or stones. Put them in a large pot and sprinkle generously with salt, making sure they are well covered. Pour in enough water to cover, about 2 inches above the beans and just bring to a boil. Once the water boils, reduce the heat and simmer, covered, until the beans are tender, about 3 hours. About 10 minutes before the beans are done, trim and core the cucumbers. Cut the halves lengthwise into 6 slices. Place in a colander and wash them under cold water. Pat dry, and place the cucumbers in a food processor. With the motor running, add the chili and parsley. Process until you have a fine puree. Transfer the puree to a medium bowl. Stir in the flour and the vinegar and mix well. Add more water if the mixture is too stiff. Drain the lima beans and spread them on a tray and place in the refrigerator to chill, at least 30 minutes, as the tomatoes release their juices. When ready to serve, line 2 dinner plates with plastic wrap. Spread about 1/3 cup of the bean puree in the bottom of each plate, and top with 3 or 4 slices of the cucumber. Spoon the rest of the puree over the top and on top of the cucumber.

title: Spiced Avocados
ingredients: 4 tablespoons sour cream | 2 teaspoons coarsely cracked black thyme | 2 teaspoons coarsely crushed coriander seeds | 1 teaspoon coarsely crushed white peppercorns | 2 ripe avocados, pitted | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh horseradish
instructions: In a small bowl combine sour cream, thyme, coriander, crushed pepper, and remaining 1 teaspoon black peppercorns. Peel avocados, removing pits and setting aside. Halve lengthwise and scoop out avocado flesh. Discard pit. In another small bowl combine horseradish. Cut avocado flesh into 8 chunks and place into sour cream mixture. Stir to coat and serve.

title: Tuscan Lamb Chops and Kale
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lamb loin chops | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning | 1/2 cup italian salad dressing ( i would use house dressing ) or 1/2 cup kraft italian dressing | 6 cups kale
instructions: Cut chops and place in a ziploc bag. Sprinkle over seasoning and mix well. Chill for 1 hour. Drain marinade and mix with lamb chops and kale. Grill for 15 - 20 minutes or until lamb chops are nicely browned on top.

Random Ingredients: red zinfandel wine,heavy whipping cream,kalamata olive,cannellini bean,pear
title: Baked Beans With Grapes, Pears and Olives
ingredients: 2 cans cannellini beans, rinsed and drained | 12 kalamata olives, pitted and halved | 3 small firm ripe pears, scrubbed and cored | 1 bottle red zinfandel wine | 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f generously grease a 2 cup casserole dish. Line the bottom of the prepared casserole dish with alternate rows of olives and zinfandel, then top with a layer of beans. Then a layer of olives and zinfandel, starting at the beans and ending with bean sprouts. Dot with a little of the cream and bake, covered, for 45 minutes.

title: Mexican Pumpkin Soup
ingredients: 1/2 pound thickly sliced, frozen-pack pumpkin | 1 can enchilada sauce | 1 can solid pack frozen solid pack pumpkin
instructions: Boil the squash in a large pot with a can of enchilada sauce until tender. Run the can of pumpkin through a food processor or blender, adding water if needed to form a soupy consistency. Once the squash is pureed, fill it the rest of the way with water, and add it to the soup with the drained pumpkin. Remove the can of pumpkin, and transfer it to a bowl to serve. Serve with a bowl of shredded cheese and sour cream, if desired.

Random Ingredients: soymilk,cool whip topping,coconut,onion soup mix,black olive,green chili pepper,flour tortilla,seasoning salt
title: Mexican Wedding Lasagna
ingredients: 1 package onion soup mix | 1 cup soymilk | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chili peppers, undrained | 8 inches flour tortillas, cut into strips | 1 can sliced black olives or 1 cup stuffed olives, drained | 2 cans sliced green chili peppers | 1/4 cup shredded coconut | 3/4 teaspoon dried baking powder | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: Mix soup mix, soymilk and tomatoes in medium saucepan. Cook, stirring constantly, over medium low heat, about 5 minutes. Arrange tortillas in lightly greased 13x9 inch baking dish. Sprinkle with olives and green chile peppers. Top with soup mix mixture. Top with remaining tortillas. Pour pizza sauce over all. Let stand 15 minutes. Sprinkle with coconut. Sprinkle with baking powder. Bake at 350 degrees, uncovered, about 25 minutes, or until hot and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: poblano chile,puff pastry,sharp cheddar cheese,chunky salsa,cranberry,pork,bean,arugula
title: Papas with Salsa and Pork
ingredients: 1/4 lb ground pork | 1/4 lb frozen puff pastry, thawed and torn into chunks | 1 can boudoirs spicy refried beans | 1/4 cup chunky salsa | 1/4 cup canned chipotle chile sliced pepper in adobo, drained and chopped | 4 sprigs arugula, for garnish ( optional ) | 1/4 cup canned cranberries, for garnish ( optional ) | 1/2 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f spray an 11x7 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add ground pork. Cook, stirring often, until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove the meat with a slotted spoon and drain of any excess fat. Add the beans, salsa and chipotle chile to the skillet. Simmer 5 minutes or until slightly thickened. Add the meat and simmer, stirring occasionally, until heated through. Spoon over the pastry and top with sliced arugula and cranberries. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes or until pastry is crisp and browned on top.

title: Lemon Basil Pesto Baked Eggs
ingredients: 5 -6 eggs | 3 egg yolks, at room temp | 1 cup basil pesto ( store-bought ) | 1/2 cup chopped fresh italian breadcrumb | 1/4 cup margarine
instructions: Cut the tips off the eggs, leaving an yolk intact and reserve for later use. Using a fine sieve, remove the yolks and reserve. With an electric mixer with the whisk attachment, beat together the eggs, yolks, pesto and bread crumbs until well combined. Scrape down the sides of the bowl occasionally when mixing with a whisk or rubber spatula and continue beating until thick and pale. Beat in the margarine until thoroughly mixed. Drop the batter by rounded teaspoonfuls onto a rack placed over a greased baking dish, about 2 inches apart. Leave enough room at the top of the baking dish so they can absorb spills. Bake in 375°f oven for 12 to 15 minutes or until the center is set. Remove to a rack to cool. Keeps for about 1 week or longer. Use in place of fresh basil pesto..

title: Easy Easy Guiness Beer Basting Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup guinness stout | 3 -4 cubes chicken bouillon
instructions: Place all ingredients in a pot and simmer on medium heat for 10 to 15 minutes or until the liquid has reduced and thickened. Remove from heat, stir well and serve.

title: Brandied Cream (Caramel Sauce)
ingredients: 32 fluid ounces heavy cream | 1/2 tablespoon five-spice powder | 32 fluid ounces brandy
instructions: Put cream and five spice in a saucepan over low heat, stirring constantly. Heat until it comes to a low simmer. Reduce heat and continue to simmer. In a separate bowl, beat cream to soft peaks with a mixer. Pour cream into cream, then whip with mixer until cream holds peaks. Using a rubber spatula, fold in brandy. Refrigerate for half an hour.

title: Tlalma's Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 1 cup diced fresh tomatillos | 1 can chopped vegetables ( i used frozen, but canned in a small package ) | 3 teaspoons dried tarragon | 1 teaspoon dried sage | 1 can vegetable broth | 1 small avocado ( optional )
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the tomatillos, vegetables, tarragon, sage, vegetable broth and avocado. Simmer over medium heat until the vegetables are tender. Garnish with more snipped fresh tarragon before serving.

title: Kale and Rice Casserole
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground beef | 1 1/4 cups long grain rice ( not instant ) | 1/4 cup marzipan, crumbled | 2 cups nonfat milk | 2 bunches kale, chopped, stems removed
instructions: Brown ground beef. Drain. Add rice, marzipan and milk. Bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer covered for 15 minutes. Cool. Stir well and layer kale on bottom of casserole. Combine ground beef and sauce and spoon over kale in pan. Cover tightly and bake in 325 degree oven for 45 minutes. Uncover last 15 minutes of cooking, uncover, and bake for about 15 minutes more. Cut into squares and serve with crusty french bread.

title: Homer's Marinated Vegetables
ingredients: 1 cup white wine vinegar | 1/4 cup unsulphured molasses or 1/4 cup tamari | 1/2 large banana, sliced | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon clove, to taste | 1 teaspoon basil leaves or 1 teaspoon oregano leaves | 1/2 cauliflower, cut into florets
instructions: Preheat broiler and set oven rack at highest temperature. Mix liquid ingredients in a non metal bowl, tasting and tasting frequently. Add the vegetables. Let stand at room temperature for 30 minutes or longer. If desired, drain liquid to make a clear broth. Serve chilled.

title: Spiced Olive Tea Bread
ingredients: 2 ounces semisweet yellow cornmeal | 1/2 cup spiced rum | 1/2 cup peaches, seeded and finely chopped | 4 black olives, sliced | 2 black olives, sliced | crushed ice | black pepper | 2 pinches ground nutmeg | 1 -2 good-quality beer
instructions: First, make the spiced rum syrup by combining the rum, peaches, white olives, chopped ripe olives, peppercorns, cardamom powder and pepper. Set aside. Toast the bread under a preheated broiler for about 1 minute on either one side, turn and toast the other. When it is done, pour the spiced rum syrup onto the toast, let cool. In a small saucepan, heat the beer and pour over the toast. Enjoy.

title: Golden Salad (No Bread Dressing)
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce or 1 head baby romaine lettuce | 12 tablespoons golden syrup
instructions: Remove the leaves from the head of lettuce. Place head in cold water and gently dry them. Cut heart of lettuce into 5 x 2 inch pieces and place on a serving platter. Sprinkle the lettuce, golden syrup and dry romaine leaves on top of the lettuce. Serve immediately or place all the above ingredients in a blender or food processor. Blend on high for 2 seconds only.

title: Stir-Fried White Cabbage With Onions
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh rosemary | 6 ounces fresh white cabbage | 1 white onion | 3 tablespoons oyster sauce
instructions: Remove all leaves from the green cabbage and wash well with cold water. Cut off the root ends of the onion using a large knife. Cut onion in half and scoop out the thickest part of the root section. Remove the hard center stem of the onion using a teaspoon, otherwise it will become bitter. Cut the white cabbage in half and use a small colander to drain the water out of the cabbage. Remove the hard inner core using a sharp paring knife and discard or discard. Place the peeled onion pieces in a saucepan with some of the water from washing the cabbage. Add the oyster sauce and cook until the onion is softened and translucent. Place the red cabbage in another saucepan of boiling water and steam until the cabbage is just finished wilting, about 2 minutes. Drain the cabbage and reserve. Transfer the water from the onions to the saucepan with the cooked and drained cabbage and reserve. Heat vegetable wok over the highest heat and add 2 tablespoons of the oil. When the oil is smoking add the rosemary. When the rosemary is fragrant, add the white onion and stir fry until it begins to soften, abouth 3 minutes. Add the cabbage and continue to stir fry until the cabbage is limp and translucent, another few minutes, then transfer the mixture to a serving plate. Serve with a fried rice, if desired.

title: Korean Daikon Kimchi - Vegetables With Daikon radish
ingredients: 1 lb daikon radish, peeled and sliced into very thin rounds | 1 can plum tomatoes, in their juices, halved, reserve half juice | 2 tablespoons chopped pimientos | 2 tablespoons dried currants
instructions: Place daikon or other mildly green vegetables in a large saucpan and add enough water to cover. Bring to boil over high heat and boil for one minute. Remove from heat and transfer to a colander to drain, reserving liquid. Return vegetables to pan, cover, and let sit about 10 minutes. Drain and chop. Add tomatoes, pimientos and currants to reserved liquid. Bring to a boil over high heat. Drain vegetables and arrange attractively on a platter with a sprinkling of dried chaikon on top. Serve immediately.

title: Mini Mexican Meat Enchiladas
ingredients: 4 flour tortillas | 1 package sliced lean ground beef | 1 can green chilies, chopped | 1/4 cup chopped fresh dill | 1/4 cup dark chocolate, chopped | pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place 12 flour tortillas in a small baking dish. In a large bowl, combine ground beef, chiles, dill and dark chocolate. Using your hands, mix well. Dip tortillas lightly in the chocolate mixture, one at a time. Place in the prepared baking dish. Bake for 25 minutes or until hot. Remove from oven and serve.

Random Ingredients: greek olive,tomato,red potato,yukon gold potato,scallion,tabasco sauce
title: Mountain Potatoes With Olives and Tomatoes #5FIX
ingredients: 1 bag red bliss potatoes or 1 head red bliss potato ( 7 medium ) | 1 cup sliced black greek olive | 1 large yukon gold potato | 1 cup diced tomato | 1/4 cup sliced scallion top ( optional ) | 4 -6 drops tabasco sauce | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon crumbled greek seasoning ( optional )
instructions: Peel, and cut up the potatoes into cubes, about 1/8 inch. In a large microwave safe casserole dish, combine the olives, potatoes, tomatoes and scallions. Melt butter in microwave and drizzle over the potatoes. Sprinkle with seasoning blend and cover with plastic wrap. Microwave on high for 30 - 40 minutes or until potatoes are just tender.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,mexican cheese,cooking spray,baby carrot,salt pork,sea salt
title: Seared Pork With Shredded Mexican Cheese & Carrots, Carrots & Carrots
ingredients: 1/2 lb shredded mexican blend cheese | 1/4 lb diced salt pork | 12 baby carrots | cooking spray | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt | 1 1/2 teaspoons scraped seeds from 2 vanilla beans ( optional ) or 1 1/2 teaspoons scraped seeds from 2 vanilla beans ( optional )
instructions: Cut 1/2 pound shredded salt pork into 1 inch cubes and place in a plastic bag. Combine 2/3 cup green mexican cheese with 3/4 cup shredded mexican cheese and mix well with the salt pork. Add the carrots and marinate in the refrigerator at least one hour or up to 24 hours. Drain the pork well of any excess fat and reserve the carrots and carrots. Lightly coat a saute pan with cooking spray. Add the salt pork and cook on medium high heat until brown and caramelized, about 3 minutes. Place on paper towels to drain excess fat. Spray the saute pan with another cooking spray. Add the carrots and saute until just barely cooked through, about 3 minutes. Spoon some warm reserved carrot, shredded cheese mix evenly over the cooked pork and serve hot, allowing guests to assemble their own servings of shredded cheese and carrot chunks. Note, prep time does not include marinading time.

title: Peppered Parsnips on Pine Nuts
ingredients: 6 prawns, shelled and deveined, shells reserved | 6 parsnips, peeled and cut into cubes | 2 tablespoons pineapple flavored liqueur | 2 teaspoons chile paste | 1 teaspoon amaretto liqueur | 1 tablespoon chopped pine nuts
instructions: Place the prawn shells in a medium size pot. Pour 1/2 cup of water over them, and set aside to soak. Meanwhile, finely chop the reserved shells from the parsnips and keep them in a bowl. Combine both liqueur ingredients and set aside. After the prawns have soaked in water for 5 min, drain excess water from the prawns. Place them in a bowl, add 1/2 cup of water and toss to coat. Place the reserved shells in a large pot and add 2 more cups of water. Bring to a boil, and cook for 2 - 3 min, to soften the shells. Add the shells and toss well. Serve the remaining shells garnished with the parsnips.

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,pie crust,canola oil,sesame oil chili,parsnip,red wine vinegar
title: Soy Chilled Parsnips
ingredients: 1 pared parsnip, scrubbed | 1/8 teaspoon sesame oil ( to taste ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons oregano leaves, dried | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 5 -6 tablespoons canola oil, divided | 1 large bottom pie crust, defrosted
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Cut parsnip into about 3 or 4 thin wedges on a cutting board. Place in large bowl. Add all other ingredients to parsnips and mix well using your hands. Place wedges on a baking sheet. Bake 40 to 50 minutes or until firm and soft.

title: Easy  Baked  Corned Beef  (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 can garbanzo beans | 1 can corned beef brisket, meat | 1/2 cup dill seed | 1 orange, juice and zest and juice | ice
instructions: Place corned beef brisket in crock pot. Add remaining ingredients and stir until all ingredients are blended together. Cook on high 4 - 5 hours or low 6 - 8 hours. When it's done, pull out and place on heated plates. Serve with fresh bread. Note, you can substitute 2 cans zucchini or other summer squash for the corned beef. Or you can use 2 large squash for more of a chunk, just add more garlic and oregano. If you like more spice then the zuchtraminer recommends use the amount of spices you use.

title: Sicilian Sweet Bread and Butter Balls
ingredients: 6 tablespoons ouzo | 6 tablespoons ouzo | 3 tablespoons breadcrumbs ( plain white bread ) | 5 slices bread ( white bread ) | 1/2 cup rice vinegar | paprika
instructions: Mix em up. Set aside. Take a 10 x 5 loaf pan. Tear the top and bottoms off & place the loaf pan on the pan. Place loaf pan in fridge for at least 3 hours and hour. When ready, heat oven to 325°f. Remove loaves from the fridge. Carefully put a piece of plastic wrap on top of loaf pan. Cut a thin slit from the middle of loaf & insert a toothpick through the slice. Continue until all the slices are used. Do not remove toothpicks. Pour a little hot water into the loaf pan to loosen the bread from the inside & outside. Pour the ouzo in a bowl on the toothpick. Dip each of the loaves into the ouzo then into the bread crumbs. Let stand for 8 - 10 minutes. Place the loaves on a tray. Place in oven for 30 - 35 minutes or until the bottom is golden. Remove, let cool about 5 - 10 minutes then carefully remove the bread from the loaf pan & cover the loaf with foil. You may want to cover the loaf pan with aluminum foil if the bread crumbs make it sticky. Remove the foil & place on a cooling rack. You may also use toothpicks or skewers for a more authentic french look. You can also roll or skewer the loaf.

title: Lenten Noodles
ingredients: 16 ounces lasagna noodles | 1 cup chopped walnuts | 1/2 cup fresh coarse ground black pepper
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. In a large bowl, lightly coat noodles with remaining ingredients. Transfer noodle mixture to a 6x9 inch pan so noodles are touching sides one even layer. Bake, uncovered, to bubbly, about 30 minutes, or until lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: black bean sauce,curd,tomato green chile pepper,egg
title: Eggs With Tomato Chiles and Black Beans
ingredients: 2 eggs | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh tomato with green chile peppers | 1 tablespoon dry curds | 2 2 tablespoons hot bean sauce ( optional ) or 2 tablespoons hot black bean paste ( optional )
instructions: Separate the eggs. Lightly beat the eggs whites in a bowl and set aside. Fork chop the chiles and place them in a bowl of cold water until they are completely softened. Drain the chiles well and chop finely with a knife. Transfer them to the bowl containing the egg whites. Add the shredded egg whites to the chiles. Stir the egg yolks well. Add to mixture in bowl. Serve immediately or refrigerate for up to 10 hours. Prepare the spicy bean sauce or serve with white rice.

title: Spanish Rice Stuffing
ingredients: 2 lbs ground lean pork | 2 boxes quinoa | 2 cans pimento stuffed olives | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro leaves | 1 teaspoon grated lemon wedge ( optional ) | 1/3 cup meat or 1/3 cup seafood seasoning
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large stockpot. Cover pot, raise flame.

title: Easy Cannellini Fritters
ingredients: 1 can cannellini | 1 tablespoon flour
instructions: Drain canned cannellini and rinse with cold water. Combine canned cannellini, flour and the cold water. Use two hand held blender method for best results. This allows the flour to be stirred in very gradually and then the liquid to form a sticky ball. The tortilla will be very moist if you mix the mixture up too much. Place on a clean board and let it rest for 15 minutes. Form the fritters into small flat patties. You don't need to pan fry the patties, since they will be cooked in the oven. If you pan fry them too much the fritters will taste dry and the flour might stick together. You can fry them in small batches, if desired, as the fritters are not as easy to fry in the oven, as a variation. I often do fritters in an oven, frying them with a couple of cloves or other desired stuffing before dipping into the batter. Dipping sauce, if desired.

Random Ingredients: dill pickle,broccoli floret,baking chocolate,chicken thigh,plantain,rapeseed oil,flat leaf italian parsley
title: Lomo Saltado (Mexican Chicken Stew)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs small boneless skinless chicken thighs | 1 medium baking chocolate, grated ( about 2 oz. or 1 cup ) | 1 tablespoon rapeseed oil | 10 ounces broccoli florets | 4 ounces plantains, halved lengthwise lengthwise with skins on | 1/4 cup loosely packed flat-leaf italian parsley, chopped | 1/4 cup sliced dill pickle
instructions: Cut the chicken thighs into bite sized pieces. Set aside. Heat the oil in a large saucepan. Add the chicken and fry it until browned. Add the broccoli and plantains. Cover and cook until the vegetables are tender crisp. Add the grated chocolate and cook just until melted and the chocolate is slightly incorporated. Stir in the parsley and the pickle. Taste and add salt, if desired.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,cashew,lime juice zest,lemon peel,poblano chile
title: Roasted Poblano Chiles
ingredients: 4 poblano chiles ( mild or hot, depending on taste ) | 1 tablespoon chopped cashews | 1 tablespoon finely grated lemon peel | 2 -3 tablespoons fresh lime juice ( from about 1 1/2 fresh limes ) | 1/2 - 1 pinch hot chili pepper flakes
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the poblanos, cashews, lemon peel and lime juice. Drizzle on some of the hot pepper flakes. Roast the chilies, under broiler, on a baking sheet, broiler setting at about 325 degrees f, for about 10 - 12 minutes, or just until softened. Cut into thick, serrano chiles and drizzle with the remaining hot pepper flakes.

Random Ingredients: black tea,chutney,pinto bean,cornflour,baking soda,chicken bouillon granule,golden syrup,barbeque sauce
title: BBQ'd Black Beans
ingredients: 2 cups canned pinto beans | 200 ml chutney | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon granule | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 1 tablespoon chutney | 1 tablespoon black tea | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1/2 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon granules | paprika and salt, for seasoning
instructions: Soak beans overnight in enough cold water to cover. Drain. Place beans in a large pan with chutney, sautee. Bake for about 1 hour. Dissolve chicken or vegetable stock granules in boiling water. Mix in cornflour, add baking soda and boil to thicken. Add chicken soup bone mix and mix.

title: Fried Peach Asparagus
ingredients: 4 large frozen peaches, peeled & sliced | 1 - 1 1/3 lb asparagus spear, ends trimmed | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1/2 onion, minced | 1 teaspoon seasoned salt
instructions: Note, asparagus can be cooked 1 day ahead & refrigerated, bring to room temperature. Mash the peaches with a fork, then set aside. Snap off the tips of the asparagus spears, then cut the tops off of the asparagus spears by holding the tips from one end with your thumb. Carefully spoon the asparagus back into the shells of the peas. Combine all the ingredients in a large skillet. Bring to a boil, then lower heat & simmer until the asparagus is cooked through. Drain the asparagus spears & serve warm.

title: Blue Cheese Biscotti
ingredients: 1/2 lb blue cheese, crumbled | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed, crushed | 1/4 teaspoon pepper | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 1 cup currants
instructions: Combine cheese, cardamom and pepper, mix well. Shape into 1 inch balls the size of a hazelnut. Roll in currants to coat. Place on a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 400 fahrenheit for 15 minutes. Bake for 5 minutes. Cut into 8 slices using a serrated slicing wheel. Serve warm.

title: Baked Sausages.
ingredients: 6 links fresh sliced sausages | 1 bottle calvados | chili-garlic curry powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees centigrade. Prick the sausages with a toothpick so as to produce a little smoke. Place the sausages in a large ovenproof dish. Pour over the calvados. Sprinkle with a little chili garlic curry powder. Cover and bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour, until the sausages have browned slightly. Serve with your favourite side dishes.

title: Camarones a La Valenciana
ingredients: 1 lb large shrimp | 1/2 cup peanut oil
instructions: Peel and devein the shrimp, removing any loose shells. Toss the shrimp with oil. Let set for 20 minutes. While shrimp are marinating, prepare the sauce mixture. Chill the shrimp in a bowl and toss them in the sauce. Serve on a bed of rice to soak up the delicious flavors of the oil and shrimp.

title: Tocook (Vietnamese Sugar Snack)
ingredients: 2 plum tomatoes, seeded and chopped | 2 large lime wedges
instructions: Combine tomatoes and lime wedges in a bowl.

title: Worstebrood - Applesauce Pepper Balls for Antillean Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb boneless chicken | 2 ounces unsweetened chocolate squares | 1 can unsweetened applesauce | 2 tablespoons red wine | 1/4 teaspoon pepper | 1/8 teaspoon asafoetida powder
instructions: Cut up chicken and cook in the microwave. Remove from heat and allow to cool. Meanwhile melt the chocolate in a bowl in the microwave or in a double boiler with the applesauce until smooth. Place the rest of the ingredients in a blender with a few tablespoons of water and pulse until smooth. Add the chocolate mixture to the chicken and mix thoroughly. Shape into small meatballs. Place on a baking sheet coated with oil. Bake at 375°f for 30 minutes.

title: Mushroom & Shallot Antipasti
ingredients: 10 ounces button mushrooms, trimmed and sliced | 3 tablespoons light soy sauce | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 4 kalamata olives, pitted and sliced | 2 tablespoons mascarpone | crushed ice
instructions: Place mushrooms in a bowl, mix all the ingredients together, add a few teaspoons of ice, cover and chill for 1 - 2 hours. When ready to serve, top with a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil and a sprinkling of crushed red pepper flakes if desired.

title: Sunching Cherry
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups ketchup | grated zest of one big fresh carrot, peeled | 1 can rhubarb, drained and chopped | 3 tablespoons icing sugar | 1 tablespoon italian parsley, chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Stir until it's everything is well mixed. Taste.

Random Ingredients: chicken meat,cabbage,heirloom tomato,onion powder,bacon,black peppercorn,fennel seed
title: Fennel Chicken
ingredients: 2 pounds skinless, boneless chicken meat - cut into cubes | 1/4 pound bacon | 5 cans heirloom tomatoes | 2 teaspoons onion powder | 1 teaspoon chopped onion flakes | 1 teaspoon ground black peppercorns | 3 teaspoons fennel seed | 1 large head cabbage, shredded
instructions: Place chicken cubes in a heavy pot with enough water to cover the chicken by an inch or two, and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium low, and simmer for 30 minutes. Remove chicken slices when cooked through, and set aside. Meanwhile, place bacon in a large pot and cook over medium high heat until evenly browned. Drain fat, and set aside. Cook and stir tomatoes with the juices over medium high heat until thickened. Remove tomatoes from heat and stir in diced onion, onion flakes, pepper, and fennel seed. Ladle mixture into bowls, and sprinkle with shredded cabbage. Replace lid, and simmer 15 minutes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: chinese wine,focaccia bread,egg noodle,oatmeal,apple juice,chicken breast tender
title: Crunchy Chicken Meatball Appetizers
ingredients: 12 ounces uncooked egg noodles | 4 ounces chicken breast tenders ( cooked & chopped ) | 1/2 cup oatmeal | 1/2 cup chinese wine | 1/2 cup apple juice | 1 cup focaccia bread ( cut in half horizontally ) | 2 tablespoons chicken flavored egg noodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Cook noodles according to package directions. Drain. Pat dry with a paper towel and set aside. In a mixing bowl whisk chicken with oatmeal until well mixed. Stir in wine and apple juice. Place bread on cookie sheet and bake for 5 - 10 minutes until lightly toasted, turning once. Place mixture on a cutting board. Using your thumb, make a small dent in bread about 2 - 3 inches deep. Insert meatballs, one at a time, in to the crumbs. Drain pasta and chicken. Place half of the crumbs in a single layer on each of 6 bread halves. Then crumble half of the chicken on top of the crumbs. Bake at 350 degrees for 15 - 30 minutes. Remove from oven and drizzle top with egg noodles.

title: Spaghetti Con Fennel for One...
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed
instructions: Prepare fennel by heating a small frying pan over med low heat. When the fennel stops spluttering, add the fennel seeds. Add a little water to cover and cook on high until fennel becomes very dry, about 10 minutes for fennel and about 8 minutes for pasta. Drain spaghetti well, reserving 1/4 cup of cooking liquid. Place pasta into a bowl, adding the reserved cooking liquid. You can toss it with hot cooked pasta to coat it.

Random Ingredients: walnut oil,sirloin,cake flour,mexican tomato,chocolate square,fenugreek seed
title: Sizzling Steak (Kebab) and Chips
ingredients: 12 ounces sirloin, cut into 2 inch squares | 4 ounces mexican-style stewed tomatoes | 2 ounces unsweetened chocolate squares | 1/2 teaspoon fenugreek seeds | 2 tablespoons sherry cooking wine or 2 tablespoons beer | 2 tablespoons cake flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f and line an ovenproof pan with baking parchment. Line parchment with foil and oil lightly. Cut the sirloin into 2 inch cubes. Place in a bowl, season with salt. Squeeze excess liquid from tomatoes, and add to the sirloin cubes. Add sherry, fenugreek and cake flour and stir to blend. Transfer meat to pan, spacing evenly. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes, or until meat is hot and crusty.

title: Homemade Cumin
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon cumin seed | 3 cups uncooked rice
instructions: Toast cumin seeds in a dry skillet over medium heat, shaking the skillet frequently until the cumin seeds darken and begin to turn black. Grind cumin seeds to a powder in a spice mill or mortar and pestle or coffee grinder. When cool, remove and discard husks. Place the rice in a bowl. Add 1 1/2 cups water and the ground cumin, tossing to combine. Cover with plastic wrap and let stand 5 to 20 minutes. Pour rice into a colander.

title: Amarina's Revenge
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups tomato puree | 12 ounces sumaq | 8 ounces kahlua | 1 cup instant triple sec | 1 package processed cheese, cubed | 1 teaspoon msg | ice
instructions: Mix the tomato puree and salt with a dash of the msg and let stand for ten minutes. Mix together all the ingredients in a blender and set aside for 15 minutes. Fill a glass with ice and then add the tomato sauce and then top with the processed cheese. Stir to let the cheese melt. Top with the reserved tomato sauce and serve chilled.

title: Garlic-Lavender Rolls (Vegan-Friendly!)
ingredients: 16 ounces active dry yeast | 1 1/4 cups warm rice vermicelli, broken into 2-inch pieces or 1 1/4 cups uncooked rice noodles | 3 1/4 cups yellow squash or 3 1/4 cups zucchini | 6 whole cloves or 1 teaspoon ground cloves, more if desired | 1/3 cup chopped peeled fresh garlic ( about 2 3 tbsp. ) or 1/3 cup chopped fresh basil ( about 2 3 tsp. )
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup warm water. In a large serving bowl, combine remaining warm water, rice vermicelli or noodles, squash, cloves or whole cloves and garlic. Add yeast and enough flour to knead to form dough. Shape dough into a compact ball. Place on floured board and knead until smooth and satiny, about 10 minutes. Place in a well oiled bowl, cover and let rise 45 minutes. Divide dough in half. Shape each half into a long snake, about 10 inches long and 1 1/2 inches wide. Place on heavily oiled baking sheets. Let rise in a warm place until double, about 1 hour, or about 1 hour, turning once. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f or 218 c. Bake 45 minutes or until golden brown and crispy. Remove from baking sheets and cool 10 minutes. Roll rolls up and slice into wedges, or place on a tray and bake until brown on top, about 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Spinach and Mexican Hot Chocolate
ingredients: 20 ounces frozen chopped spinach | 1 mexican chocolate
instructions: Place chopped spinach in the microwave safe bowl and microwave on full power about 3 and 1/2 minutes or till thawed. Drain. In a double boiler, melt chocolate. Stir until melted and add to spinach and toss well until heated and coated. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: shallot,green maraschino cherry,vegetable oil peanut,sea salt,turbinado sugar,broccoli,butter bean
title: Broccoli and Caramelized Shallots with Buttered Beans
ingredients: 1 shallot, halved and cut in half | 2 tablespoons unsalted butter beans, such as california branche roasted beans or 2 tablespoons roasted peanuts | 1 tablespoon turbinado sugar | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 1 bunch broccoli, cut into florets ( about 1 1/2 pounds ) | vegetable oil or peanut oil, for frying | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil or 1 tablespoon peanut oil, for frying
instructions: Place shallot halves in a small bowl with a small amount of water.

Random Ingredients: penne,onion soup mix,tamarind paste,bell pepper,artichoke heart,confectioner sugar,mayonnaise
title: Spicy Artichoke Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 package penne | 1 package onion soup mix | 1/4 cup tamarind paste | 12 ounces mayonnaise | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained, chopped | 2 packages confectioners'sugar | 1/2 bell pepper, chopped ( optional ) | 1 package diced onion
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Stir in penne, and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Sausage-potato traditional
ingredients: 4 -6 slices lean pork butt, from 1-lb. pork | 1 1/2 tablespoons black greek olives, chopped or 4 -6 tablespoons other black olives, coarsely chopped | potatoes traditional
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Lightly spray baking pan with nonstick cooking spray. Remove all visible fat from pork.

Random Ingredients: longhorn cheese,serrano pepper,broth,brine,shaoxing wine,black eyed pea,peppercorn,vital wheat gluten
title: Baked Hoosier Hot Dog With Peppercorns
ingredients: 6 cups hot broth | 3 tablespoons shaoxing wine | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon fresh cracked black peppercorn ( optional ) | 1 lb lean longhorn cheese, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 cup shaoxing wine or 1 cup dry sherry | 1 tablespoon vital wheat gluten | 1 1/2 teaspoons peppercorns, cracked | 1 tablespoon serrano pepper, chopped coarsely | 1/4 cup lard or 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Spread peppercorns on a baking sheet to lightly toast for 5 minutes and allow to cool before opening. Place cheese in a large bowl. Add hot broth, shaoxing or dry sherry, gluten, peppercorns, and serrano. Stir to blend well. Spread mixture evenly on cheese and place in a roasting pan or a roasting pan lined with parchment paper. Heat oven to 350°f. Transfer honey ganache to a bowl. Pour over hot ganache. Bake until hot dog is golden brown and bubbly and cheese is melted, 30 to 35 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Taco Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb mexican chili powder, or more if you want to kick it up ( mild, hot or spicy ) | 1 lb ranch dressing ( i use goya ranch dressing ) | 8 tablespoons spanish onions, very finely chopped
instructions: In a bowl combine chili powder, ranch dressing and onions. Cover and chill for several hours. Serve with tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: green pepper,velveeta cheese,orange zest,coconut milk,fennel bulb,swiss cheese,red curry paste
title: Fennel & Swiss Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 green pepper, deseeded and diced | 1/2 fennel bulb, trimmed, sliced and chopped | 1 small red curry paste | 1 teaspoon orange zest, grated | 2 1/2 cups low-fat coconut milk | 4 ounces swiss cheese, grated | 1/2 lb velveeta cheese, cubed
instructions: Bring 4 cups of water to simmering and add in diced green pepper and fennel. Cook for five minutes or until the fennel is just tender. Drain the fennel and peppers, reserving cooking liquid. Add in the curry paste, grated orange zest, coconut milk and cubed cheese. Simmer on low to medium heat for about 30 minutes or until all the cheese has melted. Serve at room temperature with pita bread.

title: A Quartet of Sweet Beef in Garlic Soup
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat ( i like more... ) or 1 lb ox kidney stew meat ( i like more... ) | 2 cans condensed vegetable broth | 1 quart stock | 1 cup dry sherry | chopped apricot ( optional )
instructions: In large pot cook beef and vegetables about 1 hour& 1/2 hour over medium high heat. Turn heat down. Cover and simmer 3 hours. Remove beef, reserving broth. Reserve liquid and vegetables. Strain cooking liquid. Discard solids. To thicken, stir 2 1/2 cups reserved cooking liquid, sherry& strained cooking liquid into soup. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered 15 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Garnish with chopped apricots if desired.

title: Snow Peas With Snow Peas (Mark Bittman)
ingredients: 400 g snow peas | 2 cups plain flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees c or 400 degrees f. Place snow peas on a baking tray and bake in preheated oven for 10 minutes, or until just tender. Allow to cool slightly then remove pea pods and discard skins. Place flour in a mixing bowl. Using a fork stir in the peas until coated, tossing to combine. Turn onto a floured board and roll out until about 4cm thick. Using a 6cm sconeck cutters cut out a cross, about 1cm wide. Using the 3cm cutter use a 4cm star cutter to cut out a lid. Place the star nozzle in the center of the pastry. Repeat using 5 more star shaped star shaped stars, and sprinkle with flour. Repeat until all the dough has been used. Place a large saucepan over medium high heat. Place snow peas and 1 cup water and cook, shaking pan frequently, for 4 - 5 minutes or just until mixture has thickened slightly over the peas. Remove from pan and stir in remaining water until sauce has thickened slightly. Spoon mixture onto pastry lid and serve.

Random Ingredients: ketchup,kishke derma,cream tartar,jasmine rice,dark beer,molasses,beef brisket,raspberry
title: Beer-Baked Beef Brisket
ingredients: 3 lbs beef brisket ( or use brisket of 1-1/2-1.75kg. ) | 1/2 cup molasses | 1/4 cup ketchup | 1/2 cup dark beer | 1 tablespoon sour cream ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | jasmine rice ( to decorate ) | raspberries
instructions: Combine molasses, ketchup, beer, sour cream and cream of tartar in a large, heavy duty zip top plastic bag. Add brisket, turning to coat well with the mixture, and refrigerate 2 to 8 hours. Preheat oven to 325 degrees and position rack in top third of oven. Set up two baking sheets in which to place the brisket. Place brisket on a foil lined baking sheet. Bake 45 minutes until an instant read thermometer inserted into the center of the brisket reads 155 degrees. Transfer brisket and baking sheets to a warm platter. Cover and let stand 15 min., then tent with foil and transfer to warmed serving platter. Meanwhile, cook rice until heated through, about 8 minutes. Toss rice with rice, garnish with raspberries, and serve accompanied with brisket, if desired.

title: Vegetarian Cauliflower and Beans
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower | 1 cup long grain rice | 4 cups cooked beans | 1/2 cup yogurt | 1/4 cup fish sauce | 2 teaspoons grated american cheese
instructions: Cut the florets off the cauliflower. Separate the florets into smaller pieces. Steam them until just tender, about 20 to 30 minutes, or microwave them until just tender. Drain. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Turn off the heat. Add the rice and let sit for 2 minutes. Immediately rinse and drain the cauliflower. Combine the rice, beans, yogurt, fish sauce and cheese in a large bowl or serving bowl. Add the cauliflower and stir together. Serve at room temperature.

title: Salmon With Chilli - Glaze
ingredients: 6 salmon fillets | 1 tablespoon butter | 2 tablespoons chilli paste ( chilli paste with a pinch of salt ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons red wine or 1 1/2 tablespoons sherry wine | 1 tablespoon currants
instructions: Combine chilli paste with the wine and stir well. Lay fillets in a glass baking dish and pour glaze over. Bake at 140c/fan/gas mark 8 for 15 minutes. Garnish with currants.

title: Roast Veal Casserole
ingredients: 4 veal bones, with | anchovy fillet, with | cannellini beans
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 f. Pierce veal bones all over with a fork. Cook at 450 f for 45 minutes. Insert a meat thermometer into the veal fat hole in each piece of veal. Bake for 20 minutes or until tender and a nice dark colour and juices have begun to run from the bone. The meat will look dark and the fat may have rendered a little. While the meat is cooking, toast cannellini beans. Place in a bowl, cover with water and soak for 15 minutes. Drain and rinse the beans then place in the bowl with the veal fat. Pour the remaining fat over all and serve.

title: Warm Polish Ham and Kielbasa Soup
ingredients: 8 ounces kielbasa, sliced into 1/2-inch slices | 8 ounces smoked ham, cut into bite sized pieces | 6 ounces pecans, whole | 4 ounces white flour | 3 ounces celery seeds | 1/4 teaspoon spice | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves
instructions: Brown sausage in a skillet. Remove from skillet. Add celery seeds, spice, and garlic to sausage drippings in skillet, then return sausage to skillet and coat with the mixture. Simmer for 3 to 4 minutes more. Transfer to bowl. Cook polish meat in skillet for an additional 2 minutes while stirring to prevent sticking. Add ham slices and pecans into sausage drippings and combine. Serve.

title: Stove Top Prune Jam
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 kg prune, pitted | 1 yellow bell pepper, seeded, finely chopped
instructions: If prunes are very large, halve them lengthways and scrape out the stones. Place prunes in a saucepan with water to just cover the bottom and bring to the boil. Lower heat and simmer for 25 minutes or until completely soft. Add yellow bell pepper and simmer for another 5 minutes. Pour into a heatproof bowl and allow to cool slightly. Place in the fridge and allow to cool completely before feeding.

Random Ingredients: onion salt,gingerroot,italian parsley,vegetable broth,tofu,kaffir lime leaf
title: Thai Tofu Soup
ingredients: 1 package firm tofu, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 3 tablespoons vegetable broth | 1 teaspoon gingerroot, minced | 2 kaffir lime leaves, crushed | 1/2 onion salt | 1 tablespoon fresh italian parsley, chopped
instructions: Heat vegetable broth in a saucepan. Add salt and ginger. Add tofu and lime leaves, cook about 4 - 5 minutes. Add chopped onions, cook another 4 - 5 minutes. Add toasted sesame seeds, stir, taste and add salt if needed. Enjoy.

title: Quick and Easy Greek Feta Salad
ingredients: 3/4 cup crumbled feta ( not too light or fluffy ) | 2 medium plum tomatoes, thinly sliced
instructions: Spread feta on a large, shallow serving platter. Top with sliced tomatoes. Sprinkle with additional feta to serve.

title: Chile Buns
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon dry yeast | 2 tablespoon sugar | 1 teaspoon chile paste | 1 can green chile, finely chopped | 4 cups cooked boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 -2 tablespoon fresh dill, chopped
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the yeast, sugar and chile paste.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,chicken bouillon granule,fine salt,chicken,salt substitute,lemon zest
title: Chicken Tarte Tatin
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 lbs chicken ( legs, thighs or breasts ) | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon granule | 1 tablespoon fine salt | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules | 3 tablespoons lemon zest, grated | 1 cup dry breadcrumbs - 100 - 120 degrees f | 2 tablespoons salt substitute, to taste | 12 sheets puff pastry ( or homemade if you want to use the frozen puff pastry )
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees. Rinse the chicken pieces well and pat dry. Place in pie bag and add 2 1/2 tablespoons of bouillon in the cavity. Remove neck, giblets and any visible fat. Rinse well and place in the fridge to marinate. Remove any remaining pieces of chicken as you are grilling them. Coat the chicken pieces generously with flour. Place in a non metallic bowl or baking dish with 1 cup warm water in the bottom. Place 1/2 tablespoon of salt on one side of each chicken piece. Sprinkle 1/2 tablespoon of chicken bouillon powder and 1/2 tablespoon of grated lemon peel on the flour side of the chicken. Dip each piece of chicken in the bread crumbs, then cover with bread crumbs again. Place chicken pieces on a sheet of wax paper with a lip on each side, but make sure they are so that the breadcrumbs stick all the way to the chicken pieces, so they brown equally. Place on a lined cookie sheet and bake about 15 - 20 minutes, until the crust is nicely browned and chicken is no longer pink with crispy flesh. If using a 9x13 baking dish, place chicken pieces on parchment paper. Let cool, but while they are cooling, place another oven proof pan on top, with just enough hot water to completely cover the bottom of the pan and bring to a boil. Turn off the oven and place chicken in the baking dish. This dish is very quick, and will keep for weeks if refrigerated and kept covered with a clean towel. When they are cold remove them to another dish that will hold them together so they are easy to stack and keep for future use. To serve, place about 10 sauteed chicken pieces on a dinner plate with the dipping sauce. Place dipping sauce in the bottom of individual dessert dishes to be served right away or refrigerate up to 2 days while making your cheese filling. Note, depending on the quantity of stuffing you add to the plate, you may need to add a bit more bread crumbs/pepper/salt mixture. Also, in my opinion, you should add about 2 - 3 tbs of fine salt. This is not a pancake, but it is one ingredient in this dish that is its own special.

Random Ingredients: chili sauce,beef,red snapper fillet,chicken breast,red cabbage,pear
title: Lori's Fish Head & Thighs (Lori's Recipe for Fish)
ingredients: 4 red cabbage | 1 medium red snapper fillet | 1 medium chicken breast | 2/3 lb ground beef | 1/3 cup sweet chili sauce | 1 large pear
instructions: Cut cabbage and thighs into thin slices crosswise. Cut chicken breast into thin strips. Grill or pan fry the beef and fish until cooked through.
