You want your beef to remain pink on the outside when you mix. Cut the apple into thin slices. Cut pear into thin slices. When cooked, take out of the grill and slice in half. This helps keep the fruit wedge shape from cracking. The fish heads should form packets in the head of the fish. Put fish heads in a pan with lettuce leaves and sweet chili sauce. Add sweet chili sauce to taste the top of each head. Add the grated apple into the leaves. The head should look similar to iceberg lettuce. Take out of the grill and separate the fish heads from the head. The meat head should be separated from its head of fish using a knife. Use a small spoon or tongs to separate the fish heads from each other. Do the same with the head of fish. Take the fish heads from the head. You do this in two batches. Cut any pieces using a sharp chef's knife until they are all broken up. If your house is big or wide it will be helpful to use a knife or spoon when cutting the fish heads. The heads should be separated from each other. You do this in 2 batches. After you've separated your fish heads and pieces, place on a plate. Slice the apple into thin strips and place on top of the fish heads. Serve with rice and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: sausage,chili pepper flake,mexican cheese,spaghetti,chipotle chile,golden raisin,rosemary,tomato sauce
title: Mexican Sausage Spaghetti
ingredients: 6 ounces uncooked spaghetti | 6 ounces canned tomato sauce | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 1/4 tablespoon chili pepper flakes | 1/4 tablespoon dried rosemary, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon ground chipotle chile | 1 lb mild sausage, of your own choice | 1 cup mexican blend cheese, shredded ( to top )
instructions: Cook spaghetti in boiling water, according to package directions. Meanwhile, heat tomato sauce, raisins and seasonings. Mix in sausage. Drain spaghetti. Toss with sauce. Sprinkle with cheese. Note, to freeze or reheating, let cool completely before using, allowing mixture to firm up a little before freezing or reheating.

title: Roast Beef and Onions
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs trimmed trimmed roast | 1/2 cup simple syrup | 1/2 cup minced scallion | 1 cup diced ripe olives
instructions: Rinse meat and pat dry with paper towels. Mix together dressing ingredients.

Random Ingredients: roasting chicken,milk,yogurt,brown rice,grape,sazon goya con culantro y achiote
title: Tasty Chicken With Rice (Pollo Con Arroz Con Puerco)
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 cups leftover roast chicken | 1 cup yogurt | 1 package sazon goya con culantro y achiote, chopped | 1 1/2 cups milk | 1/4 cup brown rice | grape
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a baking dish with a tight fitting lid. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. Remove from refrigerator and cook the rice as you prefer it or let it cook in the oven. Serve with white/chili/salsa/shredded cheese, black/fajita/cocktail slices and/or tortillas.

Random Ingredients: cheddar cheese soup,sauce,mint,virgin olive oil,rice noodle
title: Yummy Noodles Ole
ingredients: 1 tablespoon virgin olive oil | 1/3 cup sweet fresh mint ( use 1/4 cup regular mint if that suits you best! ) | 1 package dry rice noodles | 3 tablespoons hot sauce, more or less depending on your taste | 1 1/2 cups cheddar cheese soup ( or your favourite )
instructions: Saute mint in olive oil for only a minute or two. While mint is sauteing, in a large pot of boiling water add noodles and stir to coat. When noodles are ready, drain. Add hot sauce, soup, and cooked mint. Mix. Add 1 - ¼ to ½ c cheese, stir till cheese is melted. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: brazil nut,orange bell pepper,harissa,extra tofu,spanish onion,taco seasoning mix,celery,dark brown sugar
title: Tofu and Veggies
ingredients: 1 extra firm tofu | 2 stalks celery, chopped | 1 medium spanish onion, chopped | 2 teaspoons garissa or 2 teaspoons tabasco sauce | 1 -2 tablespoon harissa | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 2 tablespoons spanish rice and pepper food coloring | 1 tablespoon annatto or 1 tablespoon annatto powder or 1 tablespoon hot sauce
instructions: Cut tofu into 1 inch cubes. Place tofu and vegetables in a small pot with 1/2 c of water and 1/2 of the spices. Bring to boil. Boil for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove tofu and vegies and place in colander to drain. Place tofu and vegetables in a dish to drain extra liquid. Add 3 tbs brown sugar, 1 1/2 tsp harissa. Bring to boil, stir, cover and simmer for 5 minutes. Add 1 1/2 tsp food coloring or chili pepper powder to taste.

title: Chocolate Chipped Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs stew meat | 2 cans chicken broth | 2 cans dark baking chocolate | 1 cup golden raisin | to taste ground cloves | 1 bunch fresh spearmint or 2 teaspoons dried spearmint, minced to release flavor | to taste ground cinnamon
instructions: Brown stew meat in a large pot. Meanwhile, cut up your fresh spearmint in small pieces, add to stew meat along with the raisins and bring to a boil. Turn down heat and simmer until the spearmint is softened. The longer it cooks the better it gets. Stir occasionally. After that time, add the chocolate and stir thoroughly until it has melted completely. Add salt and cinnamon. Continue to stir until all of the chocolate is well mixed into the mixture. I usually make this in my electric coffee maker, which is used 2x4, or i use old fashioned, hot chocolate. If you are using a blender, add a little water to get the mixture slushy. Serve with warm, buttered jasmine rice, and fresh, bread slices.

title: Cajun Broccoli Chicken With Vegetables - Low-Carb for Your 6
ingredients: 4 chicken breasts | 2 bags frozen broccoli | 1 bag potato | 2 avocados
instructions: Put all of the ingredients in to the crock pot. Cook for 7 - 8 hours on low. The potatoes can be served with rice or enjoy it plain. The vegetables will be ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: almond flavoring,green chili pepper,bread crumb,ranch dressing,chili garlic sauce
title: Salsa Cruda
ingredients: 1 can green chili peppers, drained | 1/3 cup seasoned bread crumbs | 1/3 cup chili-garlic sauce | 1/2 cup ranch dressing | 1/8 teaspoon almond flavoring
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lay chilies in a food processor.

title: Couscous and Pork Tenderloins
ingredients: 1 box couscous | 2 pork tenderloins
instructions: Prepare noodles according to package directions. Meanwhile, season tenderloins with salt and pepper. Prepare sauce while noodles are still hot by placing in a large pot of boiling water. Cook until tenderloins are easy to handle, 5 to 8 minutes. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add couscous and cook for 8 to 10 minute or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: egg yolk,oatmeal,red potato,radish,garlic salt,cornstarch,flat leaf parsley
title: Garlic-Seasoned Cornstarch Potatoes
ingredients: 2 1/4 lbs red potatoes, scrubbed and halved if large | 1 1/2 cups stone-ground oatmeal | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 teaspoon coarse garlic salt | 1 bunch fresh flat-leaf parsley, stems trimmed | 2 large egg yolks | 1 cup cornstarch | 1 cup whole-milk egg yolk | 1 pinch salt | 1 pinch garlic salt | 1 pinch dried flat-leaf parsley
instructions: Cover potatoes with water by 1 inch, and bring to boil over high heat. Cover and simmer until tender, 16 to 20 minutes. Drain and cool completely, then spread a layer of oatmeal across a lightly greased baking sheet. Roast in a 400 degree f oven until lightly browned, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven, and set aside to cool to room temperature. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Whisk egg yolks and egg whites in a large bowl to blend. Season with garlic salt, salt, and parsley. Stir in about ½ cup of the oatmeal. Set aside until mixture cools. Remove potatoes from water and cut in half. Stir egg wash and remaining oatmeal into the potatoes, and season with salt and garlic salt mix. Drop potato mixture into remaining potatoes, gently flattening them. Spread potatoes out so that they cover the surface of the potatoes. Sprinkle top with remaining oatmeal. Bake uncovered in the 400 degree f oven until golden and crisp, about 25 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes. Place on a paper towel covered tray to soak up excess juices, and cut into wedges.

title: Dynamite
ingredients: 3 lbs ground sirloin or 3 lbs ground chicken | 1 can rotel tomatoes | 1 beef bouillon cube
instructions: Brown meat in saute pan, drain off fat. Add tomatoes and broth cube, if using. Cover and simmer at least 1 hour, stirring often to thicken. You can use frozen, instead of canned, just thaw when ready to use.

title: Frosting for Peruvian Meatballs
ingredients: 1 cup fresh white onion | 4 cloves | 4 ounces crumpled queso fresco | oil | 32 ounces fillings
instructions: Grind onions, cloves, queso fresco and garlic with a food processor. The mix should resemble course meal. Take the mix and form into finger size balls. Heat 1 to 2 table spoons oil in a deep frying pan. Drop one at a time. Fry the meatballs in the hot oil. When they turn a deep golden brown, turn out on paper towels and allow to drain. Serve with dipping sauce.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,baking potato,spaghetti sauce,baby bok choy,vegetable broth,bulgur,pine nut
title: Couscous Breakfast Burritos (Couscous)
ingredients: 4 ounces couscous ( cooked ) | 1 can spaghetti sauce | 4 large baking potatoes | 1/2 cup vegetable broth | 2 tablespoons pine nuts | 2 bunches baby bok choy | 4 flour tortillas
instructions: Cook the couscous according to the directions on the box. Cut up the potatoes and let it cool. Chop the bok choy. Scoop the spinach leaves from the stems. Slice up the stems into small pieces. Chop the nuts, and lightly toast the pine nuts. When the couscous is cooked, add the sauce, pine nuts, and bok choy. You shouldn't need to warm everything. Spoon into the cooked couscous, top with the sliced pine nuts. Fold and microwave on high for 2 minutes, then turn to let the burritos rest for 5 minutes. If you want to keep them longer, you can broil them for a minute or two before serving and watch the color change.

Random Ingredients: scallion,double cream,ice cream,cumin powder,red onion,sugar syrup,oregano leaf,tomato paste
title: Ganache
ingredients: 2 teaspoons cumin powder | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 6 scallions, chopped | 12 -14 scallions, thinly sliced on the diagonal | 1 red onion, finely chopped | 1/2 cup sugar syrup | 4 tablespoons tomato paste | 2 cups double cream ( heavy ) | 3 cups ice cream or 3 cups cream, for dipping
instructions: In a small skillet, heat the cumin. Cook gently, uncovered, for a minute or two, stirring, until fragrant. Set aside. In a medium sauté pan, gently combine the scallions, onions, scallions and red onion. Sweat for a few minutes, stirring, until the onions start turning light brown. Add the remaining ingredients. Add the spice mixture, mix well and cook until the sauce thickens, stirring occasionally. Remove from the heat. Scoop out 1/4 cup of the sauce, and add it to the cream. Add the extra cream to taste. Spoon over fresh fruit or serve with fresh bread cubes.

Random Ingredients: poppy seed,brown rice,salsa verde,apricot preserve,wheat bread,dark sesame oil,tequila,grain brown rice
title: Tequila Rice Salad
ingredients: 2 cups white whole wheat bread, cut into large chunks | 1/4 cup hoisin sauce from taco seasoning | 1/4 cup mild picante sauce or 1/4 cup salsa verde | 2 teaspoons dark sesame oil | 1 cup uncooked instant brown rice | 2 cups hot cooked brown rice | 2/3 cup apricot preserves | 2 tablespoons poppy seeds
instructions: Mix together half of the bread chunks, hoisin sauce, picante sauce, sesame oil, and rice. Place half the rice mixture on the top of the rice. Place 1/3 of the rice over rice, and sprinkle with 2/3 of the preserves. Repeat layers, ending with rice. Mix in the poppy seeds, and sprinkle the remaining 1/3 of rice over the top of the salad. Chill about 1 hour before serving. Note, i serve this salad with toothpicks, and a large spoonful of sour cream to scoop up the extra zest.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed oil,herb stuffing mix,yellow cheese,beef brisket
title: Crispy Sesame Brisket
ingredients: 4 lbs beef brisket, well trimmed ( not brisket meat, it is optional ) | herb stuffing mix : | 1/2 cup seasoned sesame seed oil | 1 package yellow cheese, cut into 8 wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Arrange brisket in foil lined roasting pan. Sprinkle rack of beef with herb stuffing mix. Heat oil in large skillet. Cook brisket on both sides, until lightly browned and cooked thoroughly. Transfer brisket to cutting board and tent with foil. Reserve 1/4 cup drippings in skillet. Bake in preheated 300 degree f oven for 5 hours, or until meat is tender and easily sliced.

title: Spanish Lentil and Turnips With Prosciutto
ingredients: 1 small turnip, peeled, and sliced into 1-inch chunks, rinsed, then halved if large | 1 garlic cloves, peeled and lightly smashed | 2 ounces prosciutto, chopped | 1/4 cup red lentil, rinsed
instructions: Arrange the turnip chunks around the inside of a large non stick frying pan or roasting tin. Sprinkle the garlic over them and, using a large, sharp knife, thinly slice the slices of garlic. Add to the frypan with the lentils and bring to a simmer, stirring occasionally. Reduce to a simmer and cook for about 5 minutes or until the turnip is tender but still has a little texture. Add salt and pepper to taste. Serve with spanish, crusty toast and lemon wedges to pass at the table.

Random Ingredients: red chile pepper,tea,worcestershire sauce,head cauliflower,red food coloring,shiitake mushroom,hard egg
title: Hot Deviled Eggs
ingredients: 4 hard-boiled eggs | 2 sprigs fresh seaweed ( optional ) | 2 dried shiitake mushrooms, soaked in warm water and coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1/4 teaspoon red chile pepper | 2 drops red food coloring | 3 drops teapsoon-hot red chile pepper | 1 cup coarsely chopped red food coloring
instructions: Remove the hard cooked eggs from their shells with a slotted spoon and rinse under cold water. Drain well and cut quarters lengthwise. Repeat with the remaining egg slices. Tear off 8 small pieces of the hard boiled egg and place in a mixing bowl with the seaweed pieces if desired. Gently fold in the chopped mushrooms with worcestershire sauce, chili powder, food coloring and red chile pepper. Set aside 15 minutes or longer. Break the remaining hard boiled eggs into bite sized pieces. Toss the pieces with the eggs and vegetables to coat. If desired, sprinkle with green food coloring. Serve at once.

title: Apple and Peach Sushi
ingredients: 225 g mung beans, soaked overnight | 1 small tart apple, sliced | 150 g mixed tart apples ( see note ) | 3 tablespoons chutney | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1 packet ladyfingers | chutney and chutney, to serve
instructions: Boil mung beans in lightly salted water until cooked. Drain. Press beans through a sieve. Arrange bean, apple and chutney on 4 serving plates. Spoon mung bean ontop and top with slice of tart apple. Serve with your choice of accompaniments, such as lettuce and chutney.

Random Ingredients: mustard seed,rosemary,cumin powder,feta cheese,wonton wrapper,baking powder,orange zest
title: Agnello
ingredients: 1/4 cup finely crumbled feta cheese ( about 1/3 cup ) | 1 teaspoon ground dry mustard seeds | 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin powder | 1/2 teaspoon finely grated orange zest, plus some orange zest for garnishing | 1/4 teaspoon finely chopped rosemary | 24 wonton wrappers | 1/4 teaspoon baking powder | 1 pinch cumin powder
instructions: Using a fork, stir together all the spices in a small bowl. Using a pastry brush, brush the top of each wonton wrapper with the spice mix. Lightly brush the outside of the wrapper with more spice mix. Place the wonton wrappers on a plate. Use a round bladed knife to cut about 1 inch deep, about 3/4 inch wide slits in each wrapper. Brush the top of each wrapper with the same amount of spice mix. Repeat with the remaining wrappers until you have 12 layers. Preheat an oven to 400 degrees. Bake the wontons until the top is lightly golden, about 12 minutes or so. Remove from the oven and spread some cheese along the edge of the wrapper. Replace the wontons on top of the cheese, about 5 minutes before the end of baking, sprinkle with the zest from 1 orange. Let stand 5 minutes. Slice each wonton in half and serve warm or at room temperature. Store in an air tight container.

Random Ingredients: red wine,active yeast,oyster sauce,chicken broth,onion salt,italian bread
title: Steamed Cheese-Stuffed French Bread
ingredients: 3 cups italian style bread, crusts removed | 1 cup chicken broth | 1 tablespoon minced onion | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 3 tablespoons dry red wine | 2 teaspoons active dry yeast
instructions: In a 3 qt saucepan combine the bread, broth, onion, oyster sauce, wine and yeast. Bring to the boil, then reduce to a simmer and cook until the bread is crusty, creamy and soft, about 45 minutes. Remove from the heat. Place the bread in a cold, dry oven and let stand at room temperature for 5 minutes. Remove the crusts and transfer to a 9 x 3 x 2½ loaf pan to cool. Cut a circle in the top of the loaf along the length of the pan, then cut a cross in the top from the cross to within an inch or two of the length of the pan. Sprinkle with salt. Pour the steamed french bread into the loaf pan and place into a steaming basket. Steam over simmering water until the bread is tender. Remove the pan from the steamer.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,pine nut,celery rib,orange peel,eggplant,baby spinach,shiitake mushroom
title: Eggplant Salad-Sauteed in Pine Nuts
ingredients: 1 large eggplant | 1 cup baby spinach | 4 shiitake mushrooms, washed and cut into thin slice | 1/2 cup roasted pine nuts | 1/2 cup packed fresh maraschino cherries | 2 tablespoons fresh minced orange peel | 1 large celery rib, sliced thin | 1 tablespoon minced candied orange peel
instructions: Place eggplant on a cookie sheet and broil for about 4 minutes or until charred. Turn frequently so they do not burn. Cool. Remove the skin from the eggplant and cut into 1/2 inch cubes. Toss with the spinach leaves and mushrooms. Toast the pine nuts in a small skillet over medium low heat. Set aside. In a small bowl, combine the cherries, pine nuts, peels, celery, and orange peel. Toss with the eggplant mixture. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella cheese,italian sausage,lavash bread,wheat flour,tabasco sauce,kalamata olive
title: Lavash Bread with Sausage and Olives
ingredients: 1 tablespoon whole wheat flour | 2 tablespoons mozzarella cheese, shredded | 2 tablespoons kalamata olives, pitted and chopped | 2 tablespoons fresh lavash bread, halved | 1 lb bulk hot italian sausage, sliced | tabasco sauce, to taste
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the flour, 1 tablespoon of the mozzarella cheese, olives, and lavash. Spread evenly over both halves of each bread. On the bottom half of each bread half, place a slice of hot italian sausage. Spread the remaining mozzarella cheese and the remaining italian sausage on top of the sausage. Sprinkle with remaining 1 tablespoon mozzarella cheese. Using 2 toothpicks from each toothpick, press each toothpick into the cheese to seal. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,vegetable broth,hot water,sun tomato oil,zucchini
title: Zucchini and Sun-Dried Tomato Soup
ingredients: 1 zucchini, medium sized, sliced into half moons | 2 cups vegetable broth | 8 sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained and sliced into strips ( not oil packed, or a lot of oil ) | 2 tablespoons plain flour | 2 2 cups hot water
instructions: Pour vegetable broth into a large saucepan. Scatter half the zucchini over the broth, then slice remaining half zucchini into half moons. Add the sun dried tomatoes, the flour and the hot water. Bring to the boil, then cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Stir occasionally towards the end of cooking to make sure the potatoes do not stick.

title: Leche's Prawn Cocktail - Shrimp Cocktail
ingredients: 6 -10 prawns | 150 ml chicken stock | 125 ml caramel ice cream topping | 1 cup crushed frozen caramel ice cream, to serve
instructions: Clean, devein and rinse prawns. Place in a bowl with the chicken stock. Cover, leave to set for about 20 minutes to allow the shrimp to be 'al dente'. Rinse prawns and combine with the caramel mixture. Serve on a warmed plate and sprinkle with half the crushed cream topping.

title: Grilled Bacon With Raisins and Thyme
ingredients: 8 ounces bacon | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 2 lbs raisins | 4 ounces bouquet garni | fresh thyme sprig | freshly ground red chilies ( to garnish ) or other red pepper, as desired ( to garnish )
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of the peanut oil in a large skillet. Cook the bacon strips over moderately high heat, turning frequently, until crisp and golden, 5 - 6 minutes. Remove from the pan and drain on paper towels and set aside. Reduce heat to moderately high and drizzle the remaining 1 tablespoon peanut oil into the pan and brown the raisins until golden, about 7 minutes. Remove the pan from the heat and set the raisins aside. Heat the remaining oil in a cast iron skillet over moderate heat. Add the bacon and sear it, turning occasionally, until brown and crisp, about 5 minutes. While the bacon is still hot, add the bouquet garni to the pan and add a few sprigs of thyme or chilie or other red pepper. Return the bacon to the skillet and cook, stirring frequently, until thickened, about 3 minutes. Serve warm and drizzling the raisins over the bacon.

title: Thai Sweet Pork
ingredients: 2 lbs pork shoulder, cut into 2-inch cubes | 3 tablespoons chives, chopped | 3 tablespoons sour cream | 1 tablespoon hot chili paste ( thai or you can substitute the chili pepper paste with chili flakes... but we love spicy ) or 1 tablespoon chili powder ( thai or you can substitute the chili pepper paste with chili flakes... but we love spicy ) | chives, finely chopped, to garnish ( optional )
instructions: In a mixing bowl, mix the chives, sour cream, chili paste and chives. Add the pork and marinate at least 20 minutes. In a large skillet, cook over high heat for 5 minutes, stirring often. Reduce heat to medium low and cook covered for 20 minutes. Uncover, turn and cook an additional 10 minutes. Serve garnished with chives.

title: Tahini Pork With Gruyere Cheese, Truffle, and Grie
ingredients: 1 teaspoon paprika or 1 teaspoon hot paprika
instructions: Grind the paprika in a mortar or spice mill with a blade of knife, or a grinding blade of your choice until finely ground. Add the ground smoked paprika to the tahini and mix together with a fork. Taste and add sugar or salt to taste. Let the pork meat dry completely in the refrigerator and marinate in the refrigerator for several hours or overnight. Preheat the oven to 200°f. Cut the pork roast in half lengthwise and remove all the fat and any trussing fat. Spread the pork evenly with the tahini and sprinkle the salt and paprika over the top. Place in the center of a roasting pan and transfer to the oven. Bake for 45 to 55 minutes or until the internal temperature reaches 155°f when measured with an instant reading thermometer. Insert a sharp knife into the thick part of the meat towards the center and remove from the oven. Let stand for 5 minutes before carving.

title: Roasted Corn on the Cob
ingredients: 4 ears fresh corn on the cob, cleaned and trimmed | 3 tablespoons red peppers cayenne
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place a rack in an ovenproof skillet. Fill the skillet with corn to within 1/2 inch of the top. Sprinkle with red pepper and salt. Bake in the preheated oven until the kernels pull from the cob, about 1 hour. Remove from the oven and cool on paper towels.

title: Chickhaya (Mung Bean and Pepper Salad)
ingredients: 1 package dried mung beans | 3 large yellow peppers | 2 teaspoons celery salt ( optional )
instructions: Place the beans in a saucepan and cover with just enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, and cook until tender, about 25 minutes. Drain and remove the stems. Cut the peppers in half lengthwise and remove the seeds and white parts with a teaspoon or two of celery salt. Place the peppers into a serving bowl, and mash with a fork. Add the mashed vegetables to the chick peas in the serving bowl and stir until thoroughly combined. Serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: ice,new potato,iceberg lettuce,liquid smoke flavoring,flat leaf italian parsley
title: Italian Baked Potato Rounds from the Cornerstone Hotel Hotel
ingredients: 2 lbs small new potatoes, scrubbed | 1 cup packed fresh flat-leaf italian parsley | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke flavoring | crushed ice | extra ice
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Using an icepick or sharp paring knife, poke holes about 1/4 inch deep into the bottoms and tops of potatoes. Rinse potatoes and place on a rimmed baking sheet with a lid or rimmed sheet of aluminum foil large enough to hold them in 1 layer. Cut remaining potato rounds into 1/4 inch thick slices and arrange on top of potatoes. Sprinkle with parsley and drizzle with liquid smoke. Bake potatoes until the edges are slightly browned, and potatoes show crisply shrunken, 12 - 15 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Ajiaco (Albanian Spicy Burgers)
ingredients: 250 g ground chuck | 250 g poblano peppers, seeds removed | 1/4 cup sherry wine vinegar | 250 g fresh lingonberries
instructions: Grill chuck or turkey over indirect heat. While beef is grilling, dice poblano peppers and set aside. Combine vinegar and sherry with ground chuck or turkey, adding more sherry at a time if necessary to obtain the right consistency. Add poblano slices and broil or grill over direct high heat for 15 to 20 minutes or until cooked through. The longer you let the meat cool in the vinegar, the milder it will become. Garnish with lingonberries and serve at once.

title: Minty Melon Rice
ingredients: 1 cup long grain white rice, rinsed and drained | 2 small daikon radishes, rinsed | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh mint leaves | 1 teaspoon fresh lime juice
instructions: Combine rice and daikon radishes in a medium bowl. Spoon lime juice over rice, and continue to stir. Cover, and chill 1 hour, or until all rice is absorbed.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,pesto sauce,cashew,cheddar cheese,wine,chicken bouillon cube,edible,bamboo shoot
title: Cocktail
ingredients: 8 ounces cheddar cheese, grated | 1 bottle pesto sauce | 1/2 cup cashews, roasted, salted, chopped or 1/2 cup peanuts | 0.5 bottle wine ( whatever type you prefer ) | 4 ounces bamboo shoots, chopped roasted ( drained ) | 2 chicken bouillon cubes | 1 teaspoon dark rum | 1 tablespoon sweetened lovage mixed with pesto sauce, to brush on top of finished cocktail
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together in a blender and blend thoroughly. Pour into a glass and top with some pesto.

title: Mexican Mocking Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup corn, frozen cut kernels cut from cob and thawed | 1/4 cup irish cream | 1 serrano pepper, minced | 1 teaspoon grated ground nutmeg
instructions: Mix all ingredients together.

title: Grape Salad
ingredients: 2 cups cooked yellow squash | 1 can frozen mango chutney | 1 can limeade concentrate | 1 cup grape, halved | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 teaspoon jam
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill until ready to serve.

title: Italian Grilled Shanks
ingredients: 4 beef shanks | 9 ounces fresh ricotta cheese | 15 fresh oregano leaves
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat and lightly oil grate. Grill the shanks until easily pierced with a fork, 2 to 5 minutes per side. Remove from the grill and cut the meat into 1 inch cubes. Place the meat and the ricotta cheese in a large bowl and stir to blend. Sprinkle the oregano leaves on top of the meat. Ladle the sauce over the meat and serve.

title: Grilled Indian Fish
ingredients: 16 long, hard-cooked fish fillets | 1 tablespoon shortening | 1 serrano pepper, minced
instructions: Make slits in the fleshy side of the fish to help keep it from curling up the flesh. Rub shortening on flesh side of fish and rub peppers into flesh. Place fish in a grill basket or other shallow baking dish. Pour in enough water to cover.

title: Scallops With Green Peas
ingredients: 12 large scallops | 2 tablespoons grapeseed oil or 2 tablespoons clarified butter | 1/2 cup chopped green peas | 1/3 cup cointreau liqueur | 2 leaves fresh basil, chopped
instructions: Combine the oil or butter or margarine and set it aside. Add the green peas, and saute until they are wilted. Add the pea mixture and cointreau.

title: Grilled Kaseri Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 cup kasseri cheese, grated | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh thyme | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh dill | 3 tablespoons olive oil
instructions: Combine 1/2 cup grated kasseri cheese, 3 tablespoons fresh thyme and 3 tablespoons chopped fresh dill in medium bowl. Stir in oil until well blended. Shape cheese mixture into 2 inch diameter rounds. Grill or broil slices over moderately high heat, turning once, until golden brown, about 3 minutes per side. Serve with kaseri and tomato gravy. Note, the recipe also suggests grating 1 tablespoon each cheese and oregano separately to make a total gratin. Just before grilling, brush gratin with oil and sprinkle with the remaining 2 tablespoons fresh ground pepper. Cut grilled cheese rounds in half lengthwise, then crosswise into 1/2 inch thick slices. Arrange cheese slices on a serving platter and drizzle each slice with 1 tablespoon tomato gravy.

Random Ingredients: cream tartar,cocoa,beef stew meat,green cabbage,sesame oil,port wine,chickpea,chicken bouillon
title: Chocolate Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat, cubed | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 2 tablespoons cocoa | 1 tablespoon cream of tartar | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon | 1/3 cup port wine | 1 can chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 3/4 - 1 cup green cabbage
instructions: Heat oil in skillet. Add beef. Brown beef, stirring until lightly browned. Stir in cocoa and cream of tartar. Stir fry 2 - 3 minutes, stir quickly. Return meat to skillet, add paprika, chicken bouillon, and chickpeas. Stir. Simmer, covered, about 45 minutes or until meat and vegetables are tender. Add cabbage and cook 3 - 5 minutes, stirring. Taste and adjust seasonings. Serve.

title: Pete's Swedish Meatballs
ingredients: 2 lbs ground venison | 2 tablespoons vanilla sugar | 2 -3 tablespoons jerk marinade
instructions: Mix all ingredients together, roll into balls about 2 1/2 inches in diameter. Brown in a non stick frypan or frying pan. Remove from pan and place on cloth covered plate, cover and place in fridge to chill for at least 2 hours.

title: Green Curry Paste
ingredients: 2 tablespoons green curry paste, or more to taste | 1 teaspoon rubbed sage
instructions: Mix curry paste with sage.

title: Chinese Onion Dip for Seafood
ingredients: 1 container sweet white onion, halved and sliced | 1/2 cup diced white onion, preferably a yellow onion | 3 tablespoons oyster sauce | 3/4 cup crushed graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Arrange half of onion slices in an 8 inch diameter glass pie plate. Top with remaining sliced onions and sprinkle with oyster sauce. Sprinkle top with crust crumbs. Chill and serve with other side dishes such as shrimp crackers.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,monterey jack cheese,chicken liver,loaf italian bread,clam juice,pita chip,blackberry
title: Llapingachio Nachos on Philly Clam Dip
ingredients: 1 package dried chicken livers ( lollies de marinade ) | 1/2 cup clam juice | 1 package chopped fresh clams in juice | 2 packages whipped cream cheese | 1 pound shredded monterey jack cheese | 1/2 cup crushed pita chips, divided
instructions: Stir chicken livers, clam juice, and clams in a saucepan over medium heat until heated through, about 5 minutes. Spread cream cheese evenly over the top of a glass baking dish. Top mixture with monterey jack cheese and 1/2 cup crushed pita chips. Return to refrigerator to cool before serving.

Random Ingredients: french bread,pea,bell pepper,pinto bean,strawberry jelly,celery seed,extra sharp cheddar cheese
title: Cheesy Pea and Pepper Salad
ingredients: 1 can rinsed and drained pinto beans | 1 can diced low-fat strawberry jelly | 1/2 cup dried split peas | 1/4 teaspoon celery seed | 1 1/2 cups shredded extra-sharp cheddar cheese | 1 loaf french bread, cut in half lengthwise and toasted | 1 large bell pepper, cut into 1/4-inch thick strips
instructions: In large bowl, combine first 3 ingredients. Stir in cheese, then toss until well combined. Place bread on baking sheet and bake for 5 - 7 minutes or until toasted. Break into pieces and top with pepper strips.

Random Ingredients: szechuan peppercorn,okra,jalapeno,mussel,orange juice concentrate,hoisin sauce,garlic steak chimichurri sauce,half cream
title: Chili-Oriental Mussels
ingredients: 1 lb fresh mussels, in the shell well scrubbed | 8 ounces frozen orange juice concentrate ( thawed overnight ) | 1/4 cup hoisin sauce | 3 tablespoons chopped garlic steamed okra | 2 tablespoons minced jalapenos | 1 tablespoon szechuan peppercorns | 1 tablespoon half-and-half cream | 1 cup fresh sweetened condensed milk or 1 cup sour cream
instructions: Combine peppercorns and cream in a shallow metal dish. Season shrimp or scallops with salt and pepper. Add to the bowl with peppercorns. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Remove shrimp from marinade and pat dry with paper towels. Return shrimp and any marinade to the shrimp or scallops in the dish. Cover and refrigerate until shrimp or scallops become opaque, about 20 minutes. Transfer shrimp and scallops to a bowl. Add okra and jalapeños.

title: Chinese Chicken Wings
ingredients: 10 lbs chicken wings, tips discarded | 1 cup golden raisin | 1 cup sweet bell pepper, chopped | 3 cups country style baguettes ( found at grocery stores )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Bake wings for one hour, then remove from baking sheet and place on a large cookie sheet. Let them cool down completely. Cut wings into wings. Sprinkle raisins on top. Place baguette on a large cookie sheet. Place in oven after 30 minues and broil for 1 - 2 minutes, turning once. Turn baguette back on under bread and broil until golden and crispy. Serve with butter, pickles, and lettuce.

title: Moroccan-Spiced Black Olives (Or Sea Shells-Lobster) Salad
ingredients: 1 cup black olive, sliced with rinsed edges removed | 1 tablespoon coriander leaves, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon sherry wine ( sweet cooking wine ) | 2 cups yogurt
instructions: Place sliced olives and coriander or mint leaves in serving dish or serving bowl. Spoon sherry or sweet cooking wine over. Mix well.

title: Authentic Poblano Soup
ingredients: 3 poblano chiles | 3 slices prosciutto | 1 can fish stock | 1/4 cup peanut butter | 3 -6 drops angostura bitters
instructions: Cut the ends off the poblano chilis and slice into 1/4 inch slices. In a skillet pan, heat the peanut oil over medium heat. Add poblano peppers and cook for about 2 minutes. Add fish stock and heat on medium heat to boiling. Turn off heat and add the proscuitto. Pour contents of skillet onto the poblano peppers and proscuitto. Add the angostur in slowly, as it will separate into chunky pieces when removed to drain on paper towels.

Random Ingredients: grain mustard,dill,palm sugar,italian herb,parmigiano reggiano cheese,tortilla,half,glutinous rice flour
title: Italian Rice Cake
ingredients: 2 tablespoons glutinous-rice flour | 2 tablespoons glutinous rice flour | 2 tablespoons palm sugar | 2 tablespoons half-and-half or 2 tablespoons whipping cream | 2 teaspoons coarse grain mustard ( or coarse dijon mustard powder ) | 1/3 cup fresh dill ( or chopped, fresh is always better ) | 2 cups half-and-half | 1 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/2 teaspoon mixed italian herbs
instructions: Spray a loaf pan or cake mold with vegetable oil and line bottom with parchment paper. Sift both flours in a bowl and set aside. Add palm sugar and half and half in a sauce pan. Heat while slowly stirring so it does not boil over. When the mixture reaches the boiling point, remove from heat. Add the mustard and dill to mixture and beat well to combine. Add half and half and blend in with the grated cheese. Add salt, pepper and herbs. Pour mixture into a bowl or bundt mold. Bake in a preheated oven for 30 to 40 minutes, or until cake has set. Cool on a rack and serve with cool slices of italian bread.

Random Ingredients: red cabbage,cardamom seed,rag pasta sauce chunky tomato
title: Ragù Di Rama (Cabbage Soup)
ingredients: 1 head red cabbage ( about 1 pound ) | 15 ounces rag� pasta sauce, or your favorite chunky tomato sauce | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seeds, crumbled
instructions: Clean cabbage head, removing large leaves from the outer core. Cut leaves into thick slices. In large pot, place cabbage, ragu and cardamom seeds in boiling water, remove and set aside until cabbage is cooked through, about 20 minutes. Serve topped with cheese.

title: Mushroom Chocolate Bark
ingredients: 1 package instant chocolate pudding mix | 1 package smoked hershey's pepper mushrooms | 1 package instant shiitake mushrooms | 1 tablespoon fresh parsley, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: Cook the pudding mix according to package directions. Add the peppermushroom, parsley and seasoning salt. Dump the chocolate mixture into a metal ring mold or jelly roll pan and bake in a preheated oven at 350 degrees farenheit for about 20 minutes or until just warm and starting to bubble all the way around.

Random Ingredients: onion,matzo meal,guinness stout,green enchilada sauce,corn flake,cherry,almond
title: Blackened Matzo Balls
ingredients: 2 cups grated matzo meal | 1/2 cup finely chopped onion | 1/2 cup whole almonds, toasted and chopped | 3/4 cup guinness stout | 1 1/2 cans green enchilada sauce | 1 cup sweet pickled cherries, chopped | 1/4 cup slivered blanched almond | 1 tablespoon corn flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with foil. In a large bowl, mix together matzo meal, onion, almonds, and guinness. Fold in enchilada sauce and sweet pickled cherries. Place 2 teaspoons of batter in each of the 4 baking sheets. Bake cake in the preheated oven 45 minutes. Top each with 1 teaspoon of sliced almonds.

Random Ingredients: parmesan cheese,whipping cream,blueberry,chipotle chile,brown sugar,apple juice
title: Smoky Blueberry and Apple Chipotle Cream(Cook's Country)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups packed light brown sugar | 1 cup firmly packed light sour cream ( to yield 1 1/3 cups ) or 1 cup yogurt, whisked until smooth | 1/2 cup unsweetened apple juice or 1/2 cup sparkling apple juice | 1/2 cup brown sugar, packed | 2 tablespoons dried chipotle chiles | 1 cup blueberries, large fresh blueberries ( or frozen ) | 2 teaspoons grated fresh parmesan cheese, fresh, plus more for garnish
instructions: Stir first 3 ingredients in a medium bowl. Stir in remaining ingredients except parmesan. Transfer to a small slow cooker, cover and heat on low setting for 8 to 9 hours or on high for 4 to 5 hours. Stir in parmesan. Garnish with more parmesan.

Random Ingredients: pearl barley,spice,lemon,black sesame seed,chicken bouillon granule
title: Sharon's Lebanese Barley Risotto
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups pearl barley | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon granules ( or more to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried mixed spices | 1/2 cup black sesame seed ( not ground ) | lemon slice in the center ( optional )
instructions: Rinse and drain the barley. Place into a large pot, add 8 cups cold water, plus a bit more if needed, on the bottom of the pot. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to a simmer and cook approximately 30 - 40 minutes until barley is tender. Add the rest of the seasonings and continue to cook about 15 - 20 minutes, until barley is tender and liquid absorbed. Garnish with lemon slices, lemon slice or lemon zest and a sprinkling of cracked black sesame seeds if desired. Serve, but not necessary.

title: Pumpkin Ramen Pie
ingredients: 3 packages refrigerated pie crust | 2 tablespoons instant pumpkin pie filling | 2 tablespoons distilled vinegar | 2 tablespoons ground garlic | 1 package refrigerated crispy roll doughnuts | 1 cup bread crumbs
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees f. Roll out one pie crust package per pie crust package. Open the one dough package from the package and unroll. Flatten both dough packages on a floured surface. Roll out the other one dough package into a circle. Using your finger tips, press any rough edges to seal. Cut the dough into four 4 or 5 inch wide cookies. Fill each round with about 2 teaspoons of canned pumpkin paste, then cover with the crispy roll doughnuts. Use toothpicks to secure the edges of the dough and make sure you don't cut through the filling. Bake in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, then remove toothpicks. Cool completely, about 1 hour, then cut into pieces. Make more dough for a more elegant meal, or for a more elegant dessert, top baked pie with bread crumbs before topping with bread crumbs.

Random Ingredients: green bean,shrimp,sake,almond extract,fennel seed,broccoli,prosciutto,butter lettuce leaf
title: Green Beans and Shrimp
ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter lettuce leaves | 1 cup fresh green beans | 1/2 pound frozen shrimp, thawed, peeled and deveined | 1/2 pound broccoli | 1/2 cup thinly sliced prosciutto | 2 sprigs fresh fennel seed | 1 tablespoon sake | 1/2 teaspoon ammonium extract
instructions: Bring a pot of water to a boil.

title: Butternut Squash Roasted Surprise
ingredients: 2 large butternut squash, peeled, roasted and cut into halves | 2 cans condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup mango juice | 1/2 cup wine | 1/2 cup vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon ground hazelnuts
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees f. Cut butternut squash halves in half and place in a 1 1/2 quart casserole dish. In a small bowl, mix together condensed cream of mushroom soup, mango juice, wine, vinegar and hazelnuts. Pour mixture over squash. Bake uncovered in preheated oven for 25 minutes.

title: Smooth Corn Guacamole
ingredients: 0.5 bag frozen whole kernel corn, cooked and cooled ( can use regular, but the corn will hold in a little moisture ) | 1 avocado, mashed | 2 -4 lime leaves, finely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Mix up well the avocado and lime leaves.

title: Tandoori Baked Potatoes
ingredients: 3 large baking potatoes, peeled | 1 cup italian cheese blend | 2 tablespoons tahini
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. Cut a piece of aluminum foil big enough to wrap the potatoes in, and place the potatoes cut side down on the foil. Wrap up the foil tightly to make a pouch for easy closing. Bake in the preheated oven for 1 hour. Remove the foil and potatoes. Bake until the potatoes are tender and browned, about 15 minutes more.

title: Sukiyar Bel Laban Wa Zeyto - Fresh Homemade Cucumber Yogurt
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups yogurt ( preferably fresh sour cream ) | 2 egg yolks | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 2 teaspoons caster sugar | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | fish sauce, to taste | 1/4 cup pomegranate, seeds or 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh chile ( optional )
instructions: Beat yogurt with a hand mixer until smooth. Beat egg yolks until pale and fluffy. Whisk in cumin, sugar and asafetida. Gradually beat warm yoghurt into egg mixture until well blended. Fold in pomegranate seeds if using to make a smooth consistency. Spoon into containers, cover and let dry at least 3 days. To serve, cut into wedges or rounds and serve at room temperature.

title: Halloumi and Vegetables with Hominy Soup
ingredients: 1 medium halloumi cheese, cut into 1/4-inch slices | 1 1/2 cups chopped assorted fresh asian mushrooms ( shiitake, bibb or button ) | 3 plum tomatoes, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 1 -2 cup drained hominy
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees farenheit. Arrange slices of halloumi on a lightly oiled baking sheet. Bake for 5 minutes, or until cheese is lightly browned. Remove cheese from oven. Arrange mushrooms, tomatoes and hominy on a separate baking sheet. Bake for a further 15 minutes, or until cheese bubbles. Note, you can omit the belloumi and vegetables, and the soup can be made ahead and served hot right away, or can be reheated later in a microwave or oven. You can substitute any other vegetable for the mushrooms, mushrooms and tomatoes.

Random Ingredients: creamy peanut butter,red currant jelly,cilantro leaf,kielbasa,green pepper
title: Spicy Peanut Butter and Kielbasa Salad
ingredients: 1 lb kielbasa or 1 lb other mild sausages | 3/4 cup creamy peanut butter | 1/2 cup red currant jelly ( or use a jelly or berry jelly can ) | 8 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 1 medium green peppers or 1 medium yellow pepper, thinly sliced, and cut into thin strips
instructions: In a small skillet cook kielbasa over medium heat until no longer pink, about 8 minutes. Meanwhile, in a bowl using clean hands, mix together peanut butter and jelly. Add half of chopped cilantro and peppers.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,red chile pepper,mint leaf,honey,puff pastry
title: Hot Chili and Sesame Powder
ingredients: 2 sheets frozen puff pastry | 1 teaspoon sesame seeds | 1 fresh red chile pepper, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon dried mint leaves | 1 tablespoon honey
instructions: Line baking sheets with parchment paper. Bake pastry sheets on the preheated baking sheets at 450 degrees f for 10 minutes, or until golden brown. Meanwhile, heat sesame seeds in a skillet over medium heat, stirring constantly. Stir in red chile pepper and dried mint.

title: Easy Cheese Flavoured Yogurt
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain fat-free yogurt | 1 -2 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients until mixed, but not smooth.

Random Ingredients: water chestnut,plain yogurt,szechuan bean sauce,black bean,greek yogurt,head cabbage
title: Vegetarian Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 3/4 cup plain low-fat yogurt | 1 1/2 cups water-packed plain fat-free yogurt | 1 tablespoon szechuan hot bean sauce | 2 teaspoons szechuan bean sauce | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh basil | 1 package shredded cabbage ( can also use packaged regular cabbage or mix ) | 2 cans black beans, rinsed and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Whisk together your favorite ingredients, then stir in your cabbage and black beans until thoroughly coated. Spread your cabbage mixture on a large baking sheet, top with the black bean topping, and bake for 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning,curly endive lettuce,dijon mustard,parsnip,cooking spray,self raising flour
title: Grilled Parsnips & Dijon Wedges Ww 5
ingredients: 2 tablespoons curly endive lettuce, chopped | 2 parsnips, peeled, thinly sliced | 2 teaspoons dijon mustard | 1/4 cup self-raising flour | 1/2 teaspoon taco seasoning | cooking spray
instructions: Place lettuce, parsnips, and mustard into a large, microwave safe bowl. Cook on high for 1 - 2 minutes or until tender. Stir in flour, then sprinkle with taco seasoning and stir to combine. Spoon mixture onto lightly greased barbecue plate, and cook for 3 - 5 minutes or until heated through.

Random Ingredients: season salt,oyster sauce,cumin,pea,applesauce,cardamom pod,pimiento,chili pepper flake
title: Applesauce Poached Peas and Rice
ingredients: 4 -6 cups fresh peas ( i prefer golden or green ) | 1 cup cooked apple, slices ( optional ) | 6 pimento-stuffed pimientos | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 teaspoon cumin | 1/4 - 1/2 - 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes ( depending on how hot you like it ) | 1 dash chili pepper flakes | 1 dash cardamom pod, powder ( optional ) | season salt
instructions: Add enough water to cover all veggies. Bring to boil and simmer until peas are tender about 30 min, stirring occasionally. While peas are boiling, steam your pimentos until they are just slightly softened & the green smell is gone. They must be very tender if they stick to the sides of the pan. When water has gone from the boil, drain the pan w/a slotted spoon and put peas on paper towels to drain moisture, then set aside. Strain off liquid. If you want to keep warm add a splash of oil in your wok or skillet. Add the peas, apple slices, pimentos, oyster sauce, spices & season salt to the pan. Bring to boil. Immediately reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes or until peas are heated thru. Adjust seasoning if needed. Serve hot over steamed rice.

Random Ingredients: hoagie,stew meat,vegetable broth,vinegar,coriander leaf,tea,cayenne pepper sauce,rom tomato
title: Slow-Cooked Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs stew meat, cut into thin bite size pieces | 1 can stewed tomatoes | 1 can vegetable broth | 1 teaspoon coriander leaves or 1 teaspoon basil leaves | 3 teaspoons mild tea | 4 hoagie rolls | cayenne pepper sauce | 2 tablespoons vinegar
instructions: Combine all ingredients except hoagie rolls in cooker. Set on high and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and pour over hoagie rolls.

title: Tenderloin With Beef
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs beef tenderloin | 1 package uncooked spaghetti | 1/4 cup canola oil | 2 tablespoons tapioca
instructions: Heat canola oil in a dutch oven over medium heat. Drain beef and set aside. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil, add spaghetti and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,ginger garlic paste,almond paste,romaine lettuce,iceberg lettuce,farfalle pasta,grain rice
title: Easiest Egg Rolls
ingredients: 8 ounces farfalle pasta | 2 cups cold cooked long-grain rice | 5 tablespoons almond paste | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 8 leaves iceberg lettuce | 1/2 cup frozen romaine lettuce | 1/8 cup sesame oil
instructions: Boil farfalle according to package directions. Drain. To make the rice, in a large bowl, combine the rice, almond paste, ginger garlic and 2 tblspn water. Stir to blend, then cover and let sit for 20 min, then fluff with a fork. Meanwhile, place the lettuce on a platter. Place some of the cooked farfalle along the center closest to you. Sprinkle the greens on top, then top with the long grain rice, then sesame oil. Roll up the farfalle in the lettuce leaves.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,white onion,pre mozzarella cheese,stewing beef,cornstarch,chili bean,pork loin chop
title: Mexican Pork Chops
ingredients: 8 boneless pork loin chops | 5 slices white onions | 1 can pork beans | 16 ounces cornstarch | 3/4 cup chili beans | pre-shredded mozzarella cheese | 2 vanilla beans
instructions: Place pork chops, onions, beans, and cornstarch into a large ziploc bag. Add the chili beans and the vanilla beans to the pork. Toss until it is well coated. Let marinate for at least 30 minutes. Drain and reserve pork juices. Heat pan to medium high. Cook chops for 1 minute per side. Top with cheese and serve.

title: Grilled Shrimp and Jalapenos
ingredients: 2 lbs large shrimp | 1 1 cup finely chopped jalapeno peppers | 1 1/2 cups very finely chopped pecans ( or more ) | 2 teaspoons saffron ( or to taste )
instructions: Heat charcoal grill for 10 minutes. Wash and dry shrimp with paper towels. Combine shrimp, peppers and pecans in large bowl. Add saffron and toss to coat. Grill shrimp until tender and shrimp looks dry. Serve with warm bread or crackers.

title: Marinated Antipasto Spiced BBQ Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup white wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons oil | 1/2 cup amaretto ( almond flavored liqueur ) | 1 tablespoon catsup | 1 1/4 teaspoons baking soda | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: Combine vinegar ingredients in a bowl, stirring until sugar has dissolved. Cover, and allow to sit at room temperature while preparing other ingredients. Preheat grill for high heat. Line a baking sheet with foil. Line a grill pan with aluminum foil. Drain liquid from vinegar mixture and discard about 2 tablespoons of the liquid used. Sift vinegar mixture all together and stir into honey. Brush grill rack with oil. Brush fish with oil. Place on grill, and cook until evenly browned, 5 to 7 minutes per side. Transfer fish to a large platter, and serve warm.

title: Homemade Sweetened Condensed Milk
ingredients: 2 cups skim milk | 1 cup mixed vegetables | 1 lemon, juice of | sugar
instructions: Heat milk in 2 qt container till boiling. Add vegetables. Stir constantly. When mixture boils, add lemon juice and sugar.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,plum tomato,heavy cream,red cabbage,cornstarch,sugar,lemon juice zest
title: Tomato-Lemon Dressing
ingredients: 2 large plum tomatoes, chopped | 1/4 cup cornstarch | 1 tablespoon sugar | 2 tablespoons lemon juice and zest | 1 cup heavy cream | 1/4 cup finely shredded red cabbage | 1/4 cup drained well-washed bean sprouts
instructions: In a bowl, toss diced tomatoes with cornstarch and sugar. Stir in the lemon zest. In a small saucepan, heat cream and lemon juice over medium heat until warm. Stir warm cream into tomato and cornstarch mixture, bring to a boil, whisking constantly until thickened, 1 - 2 minutes. Stir in cabbage and bean sprouts. Serve over greens.

Random Ingredients: milk chocolate,picante sauce,mushroom,vanilla essence,fajita seasoning mix,taco seasoning mix,green olive,herring
title: Herring-N Mushroom-Pate
ingredients: 400 g fresh sliced herrings | 100 g sliced green olives | 1/2 cup chopped mushroom | 1 tablespoon fajita seasoning mix | 1 -2 teaspoon herring | 1 envelope taco seasoning mix | 1/2 cup milk chocolate, grated | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1/4 cup salsa, your favourite
instructions: In a microwave safe bowl, microwave herring for 3 mins. Add olives last and cook on high for 1 minute. Stir in green olives and mushrooms, cover and microwave on high for 2 minutes add fajita seasoning and taco seasoning and cook on high for 1 minute add grated chocolate and vanilla. Microwave for 3 mins until melted. Stir and add salsa and serve over toast. Note, you can use canned herring for flavor if desired.

Random Ingredients: golden raisin,straw mushroom,wheat flour,tahini,chili paste,tamari,rice vinegar,white vinegar
title: Mushrooms & Garlic Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 8 ounces fresh whole wheat flour | 8 ounces fresh shiitake mushrooms ( about 2 medium ) | 1/4 cup golden raisin | 3 tablespoons light tahini | 1/2 tablespoon tamari | 1 tablespoon white vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili paste ( sambal oelek ) | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Coat a baking sheet with olive oil spray or use pam. Wash mushrooms and trim the ends. Set aside. Mince the shiitake and place in mixing bowl. Add raisins, tahini, tamari, white vinegar and chili paste and toss to mix. Add flour, stirring or lightly kneading to make a rough ball of dough. Flatten the ball of dough a little, place on baking sheet and flatten. Repeat with remaining dough, placing each on the baking sheet. Bake for 10 - 15 minutes. Remove from oven and immediately transfer to a wire rack to cool.

title: Quick and Easy Easy Charro Beans (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 14 ounces kidney beans ( i like rinsed and drained ) | 3 tablespoons water chestnuts ( minced ) | 2 tablespoons dry sherry
instructions: Stir fry the beans and water chestnuts in a little bit of sherry for 10 minutes, or until heated through. If you like your beans soupy you might want to add some additional sherry to keep them from sticking to each other. Pour beans and water into pot. Heat through and serve.

Random Ingredients: avocado,mustard powder,cannellini bean,hot chili sauce,dark beer,maraschino cherry,cornflour
title: Gourmet White Sangria
ingredients: 1 bottle pale dark beer | 1 teaspoon cornflour | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon hot chili sauce ( or to taste ) | 1 can cannellini beans ( drained ) | 1 avocado ( cut into chunks, pitted ) | maraschino cherry, to decorate
instructions: Place all ingredients in a highball glass or other large glass, stir and chill in the refrigerator to develop the flavors. Serve garnished with a few maraschino cherries and a drizzle of chili oil.

title: Italian Bread - Machine
ingredients: 2 cups peeled italian tomatoes, chopped | 1/2 cup chopped shallot | 1 teaspoon active dry yeast | 1 cup pitted black olives
instructions: Place all ingredients, including liquid, into the pan of your bread machine in the order recommended by the manufacturer. Select basic or white bread and basic/white bread settings. When the oven cycle is complete, remove bread from pan to wire rack to cool slightly and finish the loaf topping, and remove crusts.

title: Chocolate Milk Shake
ingredients: 1 quart milk | 2 green cardamom pods, crushed, or more to taste | 1 chocolate ice cream, split in half and to desired thickness
instructions: Fill a large, large pot with milk, and cook over medium heat until the mixture begins to warm to the touch. This should take 2 to 5 minutes. Stir cardamom pods into the milk just enough so the pods don't stick to the bottom of the jar. Pour the cardamom mixture into the milk, and swirl to coat the milk. Cover the pot and return to a simmer, and cook the milk milk over medium low heat for 20 minutes, or until slightly thickened and very thick around the edges. Do not boil as the cardamom pods may splatter. Remove from heat and let stand until softened, about 10 minutes. Serve chilled.

title: Parmesan Cheese Mashed Vegetables
ingredients: 1 -2 lb assorted raw vegetables, washed | 2 cups whole milk | 2 tablespoons fresh parmesan cheese, grated | 4 drops hot sauce ( optional ) | fresh parsley sprig ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: In sauce pan, heat milk over medium heat until it begins to thicken, stirring frequently to prevent burning. Add salt and pepper to taste. Stir in the parmesan cheese and hot sauce.

title: Tahini Corned Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 3 medium eggs | 8 ounces canned spaghetti sauce | 2 tablespoons vinegar or 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 2 beef bouillon cubes, dissolved in | 2 tablespoons tahini | 12 slices rye bread or 12 slices white sandwich bread, toasted | 3 lbs deli corned beef ( optional ) or 3 lbs cooked cod, shredded ( optional )
instructions: In bowl, beat together eggs and sauce. Measure 1 cup for dipping. Stir dissolved stock, dissolved bouillon and tahini into sauce until dissolved. Place drained corned beef slices on work surface. Pour egg/water mixture over corned beef. Top with bread slices and serve with sauce. This recipe can be done in a skillet on low heat and can be made in a crockpot or low oven.

Random Ingredients: russet potato,greek salad dressing,jalapeno pepper,american cheese,malt vinegar,sherry wine,baby pea,italian breadcrumb
title: Baby Peas & Cheese (Baby Peas) Stuffed With Potatoes
ingredients: 2 russet potatoes, scrubbed | 1/4 cup chopped fresh italian style style breadcrumb | 4 -6 tablespoons dry sherry wine | 3 tablespoons grated american cheese | 1 tablespoon malt vinegar | 1 tablespoon minced seeded jalapeno pepper | 3 ounces fresh baby peas, cooked | 1/4 cup greek salad dressing
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Place the potatoes, bread crumbs, cheese, vinegar, and jalapeno and minced pepper in a medium size bowl and mash together until well blended. Slice each potato lengthwise down the center so they will stand upright on a cutting board. Use a 1/4 cup glass measuring cup or spoon to fill the potato cavities with the stuffing. The stuffing makes a nice little pocket in the potatoes, allowing it to breath during final preparations. Remove the stuffing with a small spoon. Brush the stuffing slices with a little of the salad dressing and place them side by side in a baking dish. Drizzle with the remaining salad dressing. Bake until the potatoes are tender when pierced with a fork and the stuffing is golden, about 25 minutes.

title: Spinach and Dill in a Pack
ingredients: 10 heads baby spinach | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh dill
instructions: Place the spinach in a large, dry skillet over medium heat. Cook, stirring occasionally, until just wilted, about 10 minutes.

title: Poppy Seed Powder
ingredients: 1 cup poppy seeds | 1 tablespoon anise seed
instructions: Crush the poppy seeds with a mortar and pestle or with a coffee spoon. Add ground anise seeds. Blend well. If the mixture is too thick, add a tablespoon of water or a small amount of milk to form a paste. Note, anise powder is meant to be a small amount of powder which is slightly thicker than a whole blossom or other anise seed.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,beef broth,egg substitute,white wine,cilantro stem,tomato green chilies,watermelon,red potato
title: California Style Burritos
ingredients: 4 large eggs | 1 cup reduced-fat beef broth | 1/4 cup water | 1 can tomatoes and green chilies, drained | 3 medium red potatoes, cut into bite-size pieces | 1 flour tortilla, cut into 1/2-inch strips | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro stems | 1/2 cup white wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a small bowl, beat the eggs with beef broth and water.

Random Ingredients: parsnip,mustard seed,mandarin orange,kaffir lime leaf,black tea,basil leaf
title: Chai Concentrate (Chai Kaffir)
ingredients: 12 cups strongly brewed black tea | 6 tablespoons mustard seeds | 2 jars mandarin oranges, drained | 6 fresh kaffir lime leaves, crushed | 12 fresh basil leaves, torn | 10 cups chopped parsnips
instructions: Place the tea, mustard seeds, mandarin oranges, kaffir lime leaves, basil, and parsnips in the work bowl of a blender. Cover and blend until smooth.

Random Ingredients: margarine,garlic infused olive oil,semolina flour,garlic clove,almond flour,vinegar,cooking onion,salad green
title: Kosharyat Al-Holqum (Battered Salad Nuts)
ingredients: 500 g shelled almond flour or 500 g almond flour ( about 1/2 cup ) | 8 cups mixed salad greens | 3 tablespoons margarine ( can substitute vegetable oil ) | garlic-infused olive oil | 1/4 cup garlic-infused olive oil | 1 1/4 tablespoons vinegar | 3 tablespoons vodka | 2 tablespoons garlic flavored olive oil | 2 small cooking onions, chopped
instructions: The day before preparation, sift the almond flour into a large mixing bowl and add the salad greens mixing well. In a small saucepan melt all the remaining ingredients over a medium heat, stirring the entire time. If too thick to stir stir, add some of the vinegar. Place in the refrigerator to cool. When ready to serve, pour 3 or 4 tablespoons hot oil in a shallow baking dish and sprinkle the top with almond flour, shake to remove excess, then pour salad into a large serving dish. Let stand 10 minutes at room temperature before serving.

title: Smoked Mango Truffles
ingredients: 4 ounces smoked mangoes, chopped and drained | 6 ounces ricotta cheese | 2 scallions, chopped | 1 ounce unsweetened chocolate or 1 ounce semisweet chocolate, finely chopped | 1/4 cup basil, chopped | 2 teaspoons cumin seeds | 1/2 teaspoon tamari
instructions: Stir mango, ricotta, scallion, chocolate and basil together. Add tamari and mix well, until mixture becomes soft and creamy.

title: Beef Burgundy Steak and Onions
ingredients: 2 lbs beef, cut into thin slices | 3/4 cup burgundy wine | 3 tablespoons dried currants | 2 tablespoons dried shallots or 2 tablespoons green onions, coarsely chopped | 1 cup hot water | 4 -6 radishes, peeled and thinly sliced | 1/2 cup dry red wine
instructions: Combine beef slices with the flour, currants, shallots or green onions, and hot water. Marinate at least one hour. Broil or grill beef, until desired doneness, brushing with remaining marinade occasionally, until browned, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: madeira wine,cremini mushroom,pot roast,simple syrup,salt pork
title: Classic Pot Roast
ingredients: 1/2 lb salt pork, diced | 8 medium cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1 lb country-style madeira wine | 1 bottle simple syrup | 1 large pot roast
instructions: Simmer pork in water that clings to the sides for about 10 minutes. Drain. Poke holes in your madeira. Place mushrooms in a large pot with enough water to cover the bottom. Bring to a boil and boil for a few minutes until tender. Remove mushrooms from water and cut them into 2 inch pieces. Reserve water in the pot. Heat the pork fat in a heavy bottomed dutch oven until it darkens in color and becomes crispy on all sides. Drain pork and add to the pork. Add mushrooms to the pot and add the madeira. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for at least 1 1/2 hours, or until potatoes are cooked, but not soft. Add simple syrup and remove from heat. Let cool for about 30 minutes or until completely cool. Serve chilled.

title: Red Chili Lasagna (Lasagna W- Red Chile Paste)
ingredients: 1/2 lb lasagna noodle | 2 cans red chiles, mashed
instructions: Break the lasagna noodles into halves or thirds if it seems that way, and fry them in a frying pan in a bit of olive oil or butter. Cook the noodles with one can of red chilies over medium heat. When done, the noodles should be al dente. Drain the noodles. Put a pan over medium heat, and stir in the chiles. Serve with cheese, if desired.

Random Ingredients: tortilla,extra beef,graham cracker crumb,dill,beef consomme,italian seasoning,yellow cornmeal,buttermilk
title: Beef Tortilla Casserole #RSC
ingredients: 12 ounces extra lean ground beef | 12 ounces beef consomme | 1 cup buttermilk | 2 1/4 cups yellow cornmeal ( or yellow rice ) | 2 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 1 teaspoon dijon-style italian seasoning | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 2 tablespoons fresh dill, chopped ( to taste )
instructions: Brown and drain beef. Add consommé, buttermilk, cornmeal, cracker crumbs, italian seasoning, and dill. Heat oven to 350 degrees f. Pour meat mixture into a lightly greased casserole dish. Bake at 350 degrees f for approximately 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: bouillon cube,iceberg lettuce,chili oil,dark brown sugar
title: Tasty Crunchy Burrito Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 100 g iceberg lettuce ( lettuce leaves ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 2 teaspoons chili oil | 1 bouillon cube ( or equivalent )
instructions: Wash and dry lettuce leaves. Put in pan with 1 1/2 tbsp water, cover and cook for 2 mins or steam leaves for 3 mins, drain. Add sugar, 1/3 tsp of sugar, 1 tsp of chili oil, and 1 cube of cheese. Heat together for a minute, then drain. Heat another tablespoon of water in pan. When boiling, spread inside of wrap with lettuce leaves and roll up from the end. Serve with other accompaniment.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke,beef bouillon cube,stilton cheese,mushroom soup,sugar,baby arugula,lard
title: Stilton and Mushroom Gravy
ingredients: 2 kg stilton cheese, diced | 2 teaspoons beef bouillon cubes | 100 g baby arugula or 100 g baby spinach leaves, chopped | 50 g mushrooms, sliced | 1 can condensed mushroom soup | 1 drop liquid smoke | 1 pinch sugar
instructions: Add all the ingredients to a saucepan and boil for about 10 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Minted Tomato
ingredients: 3 ripe tomatoes, sliced | 2 tablespoons tomato juice | 2 tablespoons dry sherry
instructions: Place the tomatoes and tomato juice in a pan and bring to the boil. Simmer gently for 15 minutes then remove from heat. Pour into a sieve lined with a fine, clean tea towel. Sift the dry sherry over and leave to it to dry for at least 15 minutes. Pour this in to a sterilised jar or heat proof jug and seal with a tight lid. Let it set in a cool dry place in a preheated oven at 170 grades c/375 grades f for 1 hour or until it has become dark, crisp and almost black in colour and liquid. Pour into a sterilised jar and seal.

title: Korean Spiced Cucumbers
ingredients: 4 medium cucumbers, thinly sliced | 2 1/2 teaspoons garlic paste | 1 1/2 teaspoons pickling spices ( korean chili paste ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons espresso powder
instructions: Place sliced cucumbers in a bowl and mash them with a fork until they are somewhat evenly mashed. Mix in the garlic paste, pickling spices and espresso powder until well coated. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Baked Blueberry Pesto Dip
ingredients: 1/4 cup prepared pesto sauce | 1/2 cup crumbled goat cheese | 1 1/4 cups fresh shelled blueberries | 1/4 cup cold water | 1 tablespoon margarine, melted
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Spread pesto sauce on the inside of 2 ramekins. Sprinkle the cheese on top of the pesto. Bake in the preheated oven for 10 minutes, until bubbly.

Random Ingredients: bicarbonate soda,deli roast beef,creme fraiche,white onion,date,egg white,thyme,arugula
title: French Beef and Dates Bake (Low Fat)
ingredients: 500 g white onions, thin sliced | 1 tablespoon bicarbonate of soda | 500 g pitted dates, cut into quarters | 500 g low fat creme fraiche ( creme fraiche will make this salty substitute ) | 12 baby arugula | 2 tablespoons thyme, chopped | 125 g deli roast beef, sliced into chunks | 2 egg whites
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 c or 375f or. Heat oven to 200°c or 210c if fan forced. Grease or line a 20 x 15 cm loaf tin with baking paper. Place the onions and bicarb in a fry pan and cook over a medium heat for about 15 minutes or until golden brown. Spread onions and mixture over base of tin and bake in oven for about 30 minutes or until edges start to darken and beef golden. Meanwhile, to make the sauce combine all ingredients in a bowl and season with salt and pepper. Heat in saucepan for 5 minutes or until hot and reduced.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,green,green food coloring,banana,graham cracker crust,coconut milk
title: Banana Coconut Green Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 prepared graham cracker crust | 1 can coconut milk | 10 stalks green, cut into chunks | 6 -8 stalks green, finely chopped ( or to taste ) | 2 large firm bananas, mashed | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450°f. Place the graham cracker crust in a deep baking pan over a medium heat and cook until lightly browned. Drain on paper towels & set aside. Beat the coconut milk with 1 teaspoon of salt & the remaining green chilies. Add the mashed banana chunks & mix to combine. Pour over the graham cracker crust & bake at 450f for 30 minutes. Remove & allow to cool slightly. Garnish with additional green chunks and serve.

title: Gravlax- Meat Filling for Pasta Chips
ingredients: 1 lb ground meat | 1 - 1 1/2 cup grated lemon peel ( fresh will do )
instructions: In a food processor or blender add the meat. Process the mixture until all ingredients are moistened. Pour into a bowl and use your hands.

title: Chinese Meatball Sandwich Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 1/2 tablespoon shallot, finely minced | lettuce leaf
instructions: Put ground beef in bowl, add shallot and mix well. Wet hands and roll mixture into 1 inch balls about 1 1/2 inches in diameter. Let stand 15 to 30 minutes. Heat a small amount of oil in a nonstick skillet over high heat until almost smoking.

Random Ingredients: sunflower oil,yellow pepper,marjoram,coriander powder,arborio rice,chicken leg
title: Spanish Chicken & Bell Pepper Side
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 1 chicken leg | 1 medium yellow pepper | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/2 teaspoon marjoram ( or cilantro ) | 1 1/4 cups arborio rice
instructions: Heat the oil in a pan and fry the chicken legs skin side up for approx 5 mins before removing with a slotted spoon and placing on paper towels to drain any excess oil. Chop the pepper into roughly the same size dice as the chicken legs and place into the pan, add the coriander, pepper, and marjoram and cook for a further 10 min, stirring occasionally. Add in the rice in and stir to coat the rice with the grease in the pan, season well with salt and pepper, transfer to a warmed serving dish and serve immediately with salad.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,picante sauce,mustard seed,chicken,seasoning salt,kiwi,lamb,beef chuck roast
title: Grilled Jamaican Lamb Sandwiches With Kiwi
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 kg lamb ( for a very tenderloin, cut into 1/2-inch chunks ) or 1 -1 1/2 kg beef chuck roast ( for a very tenderloin, cut into 1/2-inch chunks ) | seasoning salt or salt | fresh ground mustard seed | 6 slices of ripe kiwi | 4 slices of fresh tomato- ripe kiwi | 12 slices thinly sliced smoked pork loin or 12 slices loin pate or 12 slices pate ( about 2 ounces ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup picante sauce, to taste ( to taste ) | dark soy sauce, to taste ( optional, optional )
instructions: Mix the onion with all of the seasoning salt. Put the chops in a glass bowl. Pour the onion mixture over and mix everything together. Let the chops marinate for at least 15 minutes at room temperature. Heat 3 burners on high in a heavy iron skillet/skillet. Make sure the chops are not sticking together, or they will burn if you leave them alone. Cook each side for about 7 minutes. Keep your eye on them.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper flake,saffron,ice water,potato flake,dill pickle,cayenne
title: Potato  N Cream Sauce
ingredients: 4 medium potatoes | 12 medium fresh dill pickles | 1 teaspoon red chili pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon powdered saffron | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne | 3 cups ice water
instructions: Peel potatoes and dice coarse. Place in a large pan, cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Cover, reduce heat, and simmer for 40 minutes. Drain, then cool potatoes and pickles. Add all ingredients and combine well. Serve in a bowl over fresh greens.

Random Ingredients: chickpea,spanish onion,wheat bread,broccoli floret,linguine,monterey jack pepper cheese
title: Linguine Pronto

instructions: Cook linguine according to package directions. Drain and set aside. In 1 1/2 quart saucepan, saute sliced onions until golden brown. Drain on paper towels. title: Taqueria Lime Sarnitas
ingredients: 1 box frozen mixed vegetables | 1 lime, zest of, about the 6 lime, zest from a zested lemons
instructions: Thaw the mixed vegetables on the counter for about 2 - 3 hours.

title: Sweet and Sour Sauce
ingredients: 1 bottle ketchup | 1 bottle sweet and sour sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: black eyed pea,anise,bay leaf,cheese,plain yogurt,rye bread
title: Black-Eyed Pea Cheese Sandwich
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dry black-eyed peas, washed | 4 -6 good quality plain yogurt, such as low-fat | 1 pinch anise | bay leaf | 1 slice rye bread | 1/4 cup grated aged tasty cheese
instructions: Place the black eyed peas and enough water to cover the peas by 2 inches in a medium sized saucepan and bring to the boil. Cover and cook over medium heat for 10 minutes or until just cooked. Drain the soaking liquid through a fine mesh strainer into a bowl, allowing excess liquid to drain. Place the cooked black eyed peas and enough water to cover the peas through a strainer into a second saucepan and add just enough water to cover the peas. Bring to the boil over high heat. Cover and reduce the heat to low. Cook until the water is very warm and the peas soften, about 15 to 20 min, stirring once, then breaking the peas up into smaller pieces about 1 - ½ inches in diameter. Meanwhile, combine your yogurt and anise in a small bowl. Place bread on an oven tray that is spread with oil. Slice or arrange the slices of cheese on it. Divide the split peas mixture among the 4 bread slices. Add the cheese on top of the peas. Re cover a baking tray. Heat in a 450 degree oven for 5 minutes or until the cheese has melted. Variation, try substituting plain fat free yoghurt for the yogurt for a standard yoghurt, reduced fat is ideal.

Random Ingredients: nonfat milk,orange extract,golden syrup,french bean,rye flour
