instructions: Combine all ingredients except the evaporated milk. Heat a lightly oiled frypan or griddle on medium low heat. When hot, spoon enough batter into pan to make 3 pancakes approximately 3/4 inch diameter. Use nonstick spatula to spread about 1 1/2 tablespoons of the mixture on each pancake and turn once so the top is browned and pancake is well cooked. To serve, stack pancakes and place hot pancake on plate and top with desired topping.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,oil,maple syrup,madeira wine,green onion,milk chocolate,scallion
title: Mexican Madeira Churros
ingredients: 6 1/2 ounces milky chocolate or 6 1/2 ounces semisweet chocolate, chopped | 3 tablespoons oil | 2 tablespoons scallions, sliced thin | 2 tablespoons green onions, chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons maple syrup | 1 tablespoon madeira wine | 1/2 cup picante sauce
instructions: Place chopped chocolate in a small bowl. Heat 1 t. Oil on medium low heat in a 2 quart sauce pan. Add scallions, green onions and maple syrup. Sauté to soften scallions and onion, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in sauce. In a large glass bowl, pour chocolate sauce over chocolate, stir until melted. Add madeira and picante. Toss to coat. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: prosciutto,seasoning salt,pomegranate seed,chinese white rice vinegar,sushi rice
title: Gourmet Chinese Rice Salad
ingredients: 2 cups cooked sushi-style rice ( short grain, sushi rice ) | 1/4 pomegranate seeds | 1/4 cup seasoned salt ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons chinese white rice vinegar | 2 tablespoons finely chopped prosciutto, plus more
instructions: Put the rice into a bowl and add the pomegranate seeds. Sprinkle with the seasoned salt. Pour over the vinegar and toss to combine. Divide the gourmet rice salad among 4 serving bowls, spreading it lightly with a spatula. Just before serving, sprinkle with prosciutto or your choice amount of green onion. Serve with additional pomegranate seeds in small pieces.

title: Island Prime Ribs
ingredients: 1 1/2 1 3/4 lbs rib roast or 1 1/4 lbs pork ribs, tied | 2 tablespoons wasabi, spice | 1 tablespoon dried mint leaves | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | cayenne ( optional ) | cooking oil | 1/4 cup ranch dressing | raisins ( optional )
instructions: Place the meat in a large pot or dutch oven with just enough water to cover the meat. Bring to a boil and cook until the meat easily pulls apart, about 1 - 2 minutes. Remove the meat from the pot place in a bowl and cover with cold water. Remove the cover, bring the water back to a boil. Turn off the boil then cover and let stand at room temperature 10 minutes. Drain the water and discard. Shake the meat and reserve the water. Mix the wasabi, mint, cumin and cayenne with 1 tbs of the oil. Rub the wasabi mixture over the meat and refrigerate it for at least 2 hours. Drain the meat and dry it on paper towels. Cut off the excess fat. Wrap the ribs in kitchen towels.

Random Ingredients: bay leaf,wild rice,golden syrup,chili powder,chili sauce,red wine,breadcrumb
title: Wild Rice Burgers
ingredients: 1 cup wild rice | 1/2 cup red wine | 3 tablespoons golden syrup | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 1 teaspoon chili sauce | 1 bay leaf | 2 teaspoons breadcrumbs
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Combine the remaining ingredients except the bread crumbs and mix together using your hands. Form into 6 patties, then dredge the patties in bread crumbs, coating well. Grill for 3 to 5 minutes on each side or until cooked through.

title: Bandolita
ingredients: 1 lb ground lamb or 1 lb ground turkey | 2 cans enchilada sauce | 1 teaspoon dried sage leaf | 8 ounces ham, sliced thin | 2 cans enchilada sauce, heated
instructions: Brown meat. Remove from pan. Add 1 can enchilada sauce to meat, and bring to a boil. Dice ham to 3/4 inches cubes and add to meat. Reduce heat. Return to slow cooker and stir in remaining 1 can sauce. Place all ingredients in slow cooker and stir to combine. Cover and cook on high for 5 hours.

title: Creole-Dairy Fudge
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups creole-style powdered dairy blend ( such as iphoenspice ( 1-3/4 tablespoon ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla | 2 tablespoons cilantro stems, finely chopped
instructions: Line a 15 x 10 inch jelly roll pan with plastic wrap extending over edges of pan. Dust with 1 1/2 teaspoons soft corn meal and wrap tightly around pan. Refrigerate for 1 1/2 hours. Make the dulce de leche, in a small bowl, mix creole style powdered dairy blend, vanilla, cilantro, and 1 tablespoon of the dulce de leche. Cover and refrigerate until set, at least 8 hours, or overnight. Position oven rack to middle of oven and preheat oven to 350°f spread the remaining dulce de leche mixture evenly in pan. Bake until topping is golden brown, about 40 minutes. Remove from oven immediately.

title: Lemongrass and Chilli Pepper Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup lemongrass, peeled | 2 red chilies | 2 sweet bell peppers, deseeded and chopped | 2 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, chopped finely
instructions: Place all ingredients in blender and process to a smooth dip. Cover and refrigerate up to 3 days. Serve with assorted fresh vegetables or fresh fish.

title: Smokin Hot Smoked Irish Stew
ingredients: 1/2 cup beer | 2 carrots, thinly sliced | 8 fresh shiitake mushrooms, sliced | 1 plum tomato, chopped | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh mint leaves | 3/4 teaspoon hot sauce | 1 pinch cayenne | 2 tablespoons brewed tea ( decaf )
instructions: Preheat a broiler. In a bowl, stir together the beer, carrots, mushrooms, tomato, mint, hot sauce, cayenne, and teabags. Place the stew in a broiler safe, 2 1/2 to 3 quart saucepan and broil for 10 minutes, or until the stew is hot and bubbling.

title: Dilly Bean Sprout Soup
ingredients: 3 cans baked beans with dill, drained and rinsed | 3 cups sliced carrot | 1 package frozen sliced havarti with dill, cut into bite size pieces
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Bring the baked beans and carrots to a boil in a kettle over medium low heat. Place the bag of havarti and dill in a separate kettle. Pour water into havarti, approximately one cup at a time, to just cover the havarti. The key to this soup is not to mix it thoroughly the soup is to let the dill melt a little bit and the flavor may mix more easily. Dump the havarti into the kettle, and mix in the carrot. Cook and stir until bubbling.

title: Mint Chili Verde
ingredients: 4 ounces red enchilada sauce | 1/2 ounce dried mint
instructions: Add 2 oz. Shredd lime meat into food processor with enough water to yield 2 oz. Juices. Process to a smooth sauce. Pour into a blender. Add remaining ingredients and pulse until combined. Serve with tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: pack pumpkin,cream tartar,oyster sauce,green chili salsa,flat leaf parsley
title: Green Pumpkin With Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 1 large green chili salsa, such as pasilla | 1 ounce cream of tartar | 1 2/3 lbs whole pack pumpkin ( peeled, seeded, and cut into 1 1/2 inch thick slices ) | 1/4 cup low-fat sour cream or 1/4 cup light sour cream | 1/4 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley or 1/4 cup finely chopped chives
instructions: Put pumpkin slices in a small nonreactive baking dish. Stir together sour cream and cream of tartar and pour over pumpkin. Sprinkle top with salt and pepper. Bake in a 425 degree f oven 12 - 16 minutes or until pumpkin is tender, stirring halfway through cooking time. Cool. Combine sour cream and fresh herbs. Serve pumpkin on a bed of the sweet sour cream topped with the creamy sour cream.

title: Rosemary Rub
ingredients: 2 lbs dried rosemary | 1/2 lb mild roasted, spicy italian herb such as basil, oregano, and/or herbes de provence or 1/2 lb cayenne pepper, soaked in water for 20 minutes ( optional ) | 3 ounces cocoa, preferably dutch-processed | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1 teaspoon lime zest | 2/3 cup good english mustard | 1/2 teaspoon dried coriander
instructions: Rinse the rosemary. Place dried rosemary in a small bowl and cover with boiling water for 2 minutes. Drain and place in a bowl of ice water. Cover and set aside. Remove the cocoa and spices from the heat and place into a small bowl. To use, mix and rub together with your favorite spiced rub. Rub a teaspoon of the spicy spice into the rosemary and allow to rest for 15 minutes before using. Store in the refrigerator for 3 days or up to 2 months.

title: Stuffed Swiss Roll Bar
ingredients: 1 cup old fashioned oats | 1/2 cup monterey jack cheese, shredded | 1/4 cup pine nuts | 1/4 cup radish, finely diced | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1/3 cup dry sherry ( or cooking sherry ) | salt

Random Ingredients: red chili powder,chili pepper,taco seasoning mix,white wine vinegar,sherry wine,vanilla pudding mix,cayenne pepper
title: Spanish Inspired Trimming Pasta (Pasta)

instructions: In a medium pot of boiling salted water, cook pasta until al dente. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, combine dry pudding mix, vinegar, chili powder, cayenne pepper, sherry, and hot pepper sauce until well blended. Drain the pasta, reserving 1/4 cup of the pasta cooking water. Stir the hot pasta into the pudding mix until combined, then toss to combine. Serve hot.

title: Gluten Free Taco Mix
ingredients: 3 tablespoons xanthan gum or 3 tablespoons treacle | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon | 14 cups onions, diced | 15 ounces chicken bouillon | 12 fluid ounces low-fat orange juice and zest ( from 1 pkg ) | 3 tablespoons aluminum foil
instructions: Cook onions and zest in 3 tbsp of hot water until onions are clear and soft, about ten minutes. Set onions aside to cool slightly. To serve, spread taco dough between pieces of aluminum foil, then bake for 15 - 20 minutes at 375°f, or place in crockpot for 4 - 5 hours or until hot. If desired, slice into pieces, freeze and serve with desired taco toppings.

Random Ingredients: shallot,chickpea,goat cheese,pork loin chop,plain flour,egg white,soda water
title: Pork Chops With Chickpeas

instructions: Prepare chickpeas and drain then rinse. Place into a large saucepan cover with 3 cups of water. Bring to the boil and immediately reduce to a simmer. Put under a hot grill/broiler for 1 minute until the cheese has melted and bubbled. Serve the sausages with a side of bread or with the pan juices. Serve with the remaining chickpeas.

instructions: Dough, in a large pot, combine 1 cup coconut milk, yeast, parsley or flat leaf parsley and chopped red apple. Mix well. title: Mexican Hot Chocolate

instructions: The easy way to make this hot chocolate is with pouring hot water in the bottom, making sure the water drips into the chocolate and making sure to cover it. Chill before serving, you may pour the hot chocolate on top of it.

title: Spinach Salad
ingredients: 1 lb fresh spinach | 0.5 can bamboo shoots | 1/2 cup marsala wine | 1/2 cup vinegar
instructions: Wash, remove and dry spinach, trim stems and cut into bite size pieces. Drain bamboo shoots and set aside. Cool salad while it cools to thaw completely and combine with dressing ingredients.

title: Pasta With Fresh Beef and Onions

instructions: Brush both sides of bread with oil. Place pieces of meat in a 12 nonstick skillet. Sprinkle with salt. Cook over medium high heat until well browned. Remove from heat.

ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs flank steaks ( i usually cut the meat up into individual medallions ) | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 1 package frozen french-fried onions | 1 tablespoon ginger paste | 3 tablespoons italian seasoning | 1 package italian quick-cooking cookies
instructions: Cut steak into 4 serving serving size pieces or smaller, depending on how hungry you are. Layer french fried onions on bottom of crock pot. Sprinkle with ginger paste. Cover with meat. Sprinkle with italian seasoning. Pour water over all. Cook on low for 5 to 7 hours.

ingredients: 1/2 cup barley | 7 1/2 cups spinach leaves | 3 tablespoons ground caraway seeds | 5 tablespoons anise seeds | 2 heads romaine lettuce
instructions: Boil the barley in water until tender. Drain and rinse the barley in a colander. Combine the cooked barley, spinach, ground caraway, and anise seeds. Chill well. Toss with lettuce. Refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: rigatoni pasta,chicken leg thigh,green bell pepper,active yeast
title: Chicken Parmesan
ingredients: 1 teaspoon active dry yeast | 1/2 pound dry rigatoni pasta | 1 1/4 pounds chicken legs and thighs, cut into pieces | 1 green bell pepper, chopped
instructions: Dissolve yeast in about 1/4 cup warm water, about 10 minutes. Heat a dutch oven or large pot over medium heat until hot. Combine the chicken legs and green bell pepper in the bottom of the dutch oven. Cover, and cook until onions start to brown, about 15 minutes. Drain excess fat. Stir chicken mixture into pan with onions. Cover, and continue cooking until most of the liquid has been absorbed. The mixture will still be soupy, and the chicken pieces no longer transparent. Cover tightly, and continue cooking until most of the liquid has evaporated. Allow to cool 10 minutes before serving.

title: Hawaiian Spiced Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup pineapple juice or 1/2 cup lemon juice | 1 teaspoon creole seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Combine all the ingredients and blend thoroughly. Heat in a small saucepan over low heat, stirring constantly, then whisk constantly. When sauce is thin, remove from heat and stir in 1 - 2 teaspoons of hot sauce from the can. For an added touch. Serve with poultry, shrimp or pork chops..

title: Easy Microwave Veggie Soup
ingredients: 1 liter vegetable broth ( low sodium if available ) | 1 tablespoon cornflour ( cornstarch )
instructions: Microwave on medium high for 3 - 4 minutes. Stir in cornflour stir. Add veggie broth and stir. Close lid and let sit for 5 minutes.

title: Spicy French Vanilla Pudding
ingredients: 100 g good quality vanilla instant pudding | 12 -16 slices prosciutto | 3 -4 small red chilies, thinly sliced lengthways | 1 -4 teaspoon vanilla sugar ( optional )
instructions: Firstly, make sure you make the vanilla pudding ahead so it doesn 'd' burn. I usually do this with a double layer of paper baking paper on the counter – no pudding, only one, and i usually use twice the amount of paper baking paper, as the jelly traps any spills too much onto your fingers. To make as a 'pudding', use the parchment paper to line two small buttered loaf tins and leave to one side for at least 20 minutes. When you are ready to cook, remove the parchment paper. You can use a slotted spoon or a sharp knife, if you prefer. Put the pudding in a large oven dish. Cut the slices of prosciutto on a slight diagonal onto them and add to one of the slices. Add a few thin slices of chiles to them to give them a bit of color. When the time is up, put a layer of pudding next to it, followed by a layer of prosciutto. Repeat until everything is used up. Sprinkle the top with a little vanilla sugar if desired. Cook in a preheated oven at 160°c for approximately 45 - 60 minutes, depending on the oven. Serve warm with icecream or whipped cream.

title: Coco - Banana Shrimp
ingredients: 1 lb medium shrimp, peeled | 1 banana | 6 carrots, diced ( optional )
instructions: Slice the carrot into long strips. Thouroughly chop the banana and combine all the remaining ingredients in a medium size bowl. Taste until it suits you. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve. Toss with some cooked noodles or hot rice if desired.

Random Ingredients: egg white,turkey breast chicken,creme fraiche,hot chili pepper,cilantro,tarragon,lemon pepper
title: Tarragon Turkey Breast With Lemon Pepper Cascadia
ingredients: 4 ounces low-fat creme fraiche | 3/4 cup egg white | 1 tablespoon fresh tarragon, minced or 1 tablespoon dried tarragon | 1 tablespoon fresh tarragon, minced or 1 tablespoon dried tarragon | 1 fresh hot chili pepper | 1 1/2 lbs turkey breast, boneless, skinless, and cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes ( or chicken breast ) | fresh cilantro ( to garnish ) or parsley leaves ( to garnish ) | lemon pepper ( optional to garnish )
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the creme fraiche, lemon pepper and minced herb. Stir until blended. Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add turkey and cook, stirring, until cooked through, 8 - 10 minutes. Transfer to a plate. Add the crème fraiche mixture, and fold well. Divide among 4 plates topped with a sprinkling of chopped cilantro. Serve with lemon pepper crème fraîche.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,dark red kidney bean,double cream,black bean,cremini mushroom,white chocolate
title: Wildfire and White Chocolate Riesling
ingredients: 400 g dark red kidney beans, drained and rinsed ( or 100g drained chard or spinach ) | 400 g broccoli florets ( or 200g baby ) | 400 g cremini mushrooms, sliced | 400 g dark red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 300 -400 g double cream | 100 g white chocolate, grated | 100 g white chocolate, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c/180c fan forced oven 20 mins/side. Line a 30cm/10trs baking dish with baking paper. Place beans, broccoli and mushrooms into a large saucepan with enough cold water to just cover. Bring to the boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium and simmer for 3 - 4 mins or until tender. Drain and set aside to cool for 5 minutes, then transfer to a large bowl. Place the cream, grated chocolate and 1tbsp chopped fresh chives into a bowl, then stir until all ingredients are well combined and melted. Season with pepper, to taste, and stir through the cooled beans and broccoli mixture. Spoon mixture into prepared pan. Dot with remaining grated white chocolate. Bake for 45 mins/175c fan forced ovens 180c/350f/gas mark 6 until top is golden. Remove from oven. Cut into 2 squares and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: nonfat milk,nonfat cream,serrano chili,vanilla,cayenne pepper,chocolate ice cream
title: Jalapenos & Chocolates
ingredients: 4 serrano chili ( small-medium-hot ) | 1 cup nonfat milk | 2 tablespoons vanilla | 1 cup nonfat sour cream | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 2 cans nonfat milk, heated | 1 package semisweet chocolate ice cream
instructions: Finely chop chilis. Combine chilis, 2 1/2 cups milk, vanilla, 1 cup sour cream, and cayenne. Pour into eight greased ramekins. Set ramekins in a large pan of simmering water. Place over medium high heat. Cook until warmed through about 8 - 10 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer chilis to a bowl, leaving hot liquid in the pot. Stir in 1 cup warm milk and stir.

title: Spiced Honey Walnut Rice Vinegar
ingredients: 2 quarts walnut pieces | 6 cups rice wine | 6 cups rice vinegar | 1/2 cup liquid honey | 1/2 cup crystallized ginger, finely chopped
instructions: Wash the walnuts well. Remove the stalks and nuts. Bring them to a boil in 2 quarts of water. Do not let them boil. Drain and allow to cool. Cut the walnuts in half lengthwise. Using kitchen shears, cut the walnuts into 1/4 inch pieces and set aside. Add the wine to the walnuts. Let them boil slowly and continue to boil, stirring constantly until the wine becomes a deep golden brown, about 1 hour. Remove the pan of walnuts from the stove, pour into an airtight container, and cover.

title: macaroni & Chicken
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained ( undrained ) | 1 lb macaroni, uncooked
instructions: Preheat oven to 375&deg.

Random Ingredients: tonic water,asparagus,irish cream,cilantro stem,adobo seasoning,kalamata olive
title: Irish Asparagus
ingredients: 2 lbs asparagus, bottoms trimmed | 1/4 cup asian tonic water | 1/2 cup chopped cilantro stem | 1/2 cup chopped kalamata olive | 1/2 teaspoon adobo seasoning, mccormick montreal brand steak seasoning | 1/3 cup bailey's irish cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Line a baking sheet with foil and spray with cooking spray. In a medium bowl, toss the asparagus with 1/4 cup of the asian tonic water. Spoon 1 1/2 tablespoons of the asparagus mixture onto the center of the foil. Spoon 1/4 cup of the asparagus mixture onto the asparagus and cover with the remaining asparagus mixture. Fold and seal the sides of the foil over the asparagus mixture. Bake asparagus uncovered for 10 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 325°f. Spoon remaining asparagus mixture evenly over remaining asparagus, sprinkle with cilantro sprigs, olives and adobo seasoning. Bake for 45 minutes or until cooked through and asparagus is tender.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,horseradish,flat leaf parsley,lard,taco seasoning mix,sirloin,meat
title: Easy Shredded Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin, cut in 1 inch chunks | 2 lbs sirloin, cut in 1 inch chunks | 4 tablespoons horseradish, grated | 3 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, chopped | 3 tablespoons lard, melted | 2 pounds minced beef stew meat | 1 package taco seasoning mix
instructions: Place sirloin chunks and beef in a large roasting pan, then grate into large pieces. Mix together horseradish, parsley, and melted lard. Sprinkle over beef. Stir in beef and horseradish mixture. Cover, and marinate at room temperature for 1 hour. Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Bake uncovered, stirring occasionally, for 1 1/2 hours. Remove cover, and bake 30 minutes more. Sprinkle with more grated horseradish if desired. Serve on italian rolls.

title: Grilled Chicken Legs with Raisins
ingredients: 1 pound chicken legs, separated at joints, wings tips discarded | 1 cup golden dark raisins | 1 cup dry roasted salted peanuts | 1/2 cup grand marnier
instructions: Place chicken legs in a large glass baking dish. Add raisins and peanuts. Pour olive sauce over all.

title: Black Beans and Anchovies
ingredients: 15 ounces small black beans, drained and rinsed | 1 teaspoon anchovy paste | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leave | 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander | 16 bamboo skewers, soaked in water
instructions: Rinse beans well and place in a food processor or blender along with anchovy paste, thyme and coriander. Start pulsing until well minced and the beans are all ground well. Pack into a plastic bag and marinate in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour as long as overnight. Preheat grill or a grill pan to medium heat. Grill the skewers until cooked. Serve hot.

title: Honeydew Melon & Asparagi Salad
ingredients: 3 cups honeydews melon, cut in 1-inch x 1/4-inch strips | 3/4 cup thinly sliced asparagus | 3/4 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Combine melon strips & asparagus in a large salad bowl. Sprinkle w/paprika. Serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: cake flour,herb,date,fenugreek seed,white bread,beef bouillon powder,broccoli,sirloin tip roast
title: Beef and Broccoli Patties
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin tip roast, cubed | 1 tablespoon dried fenugreek seeds | 14 ounces broccoli, florets only ( or equivalent ) | 6 ounces canned dates | 2 cups cake flour | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon powder | 14 ounces mixed dried herbs ( such as basil, parsley and cilantro ) | 2 1/4 cups cold white bread, thick slices, cut into 1-inch cubes
instructions: In a large bowl combine the beef cubes, fenugreek, and broccoli, then combine with dates and marinate for 30 minutes. Heat up two inches of oil in electric frypan, on stove top, until just barely smoking, add the beef mixture and stir fry for 4 - 5 minutes. Turn off the heat, and stir in the flour mixed with the beef and any accumulated juices that may have accumulated, and the water mix. Cover and set aside. Place two 12 x 2 inch bamboo skewers in water to soak for at least an hour. Place the beef and broccoli mixture on the skewer and place on oiled cookie sheets and broil for 10 minutes or until brown, turning to brown evenly.

title: Tex Mex Linguini
ingredients: 1 pound linguine | 1/2 cup dry port wine | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon hungarian paprika | 3 small red potatoes, cut in half
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the linguine, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 11 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Meanwhile, combine the port wine, taco seasoning, and paprika in a saucepan over medium heat, and boil until the liquid has reduced by half, about 5 minutes. Set aside for now. When the pasta is drained and cooled to room temperature, stir in the potatoes, and return to the pot. Do not toss the pasta will become tough. Toss until evenly coated with the hot potato mixture.

title: Crock Pot Kielbasa
ingredients: 1 lb ground lamb, browned and drained | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 1 tablespoon vodka
instructions: Place all ingredients in pot. Mix well. Simmer on low for 3 - 6 hours. Serve with meatballs, vegetables or rice.

title: Dawn's Newest Rice Noodle & Cheese Phyllo Wraps
ingredients: 1 package wide rice noodles | 2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese | 8 sheets frozen phyllo pastry, thawed and unfolded | 1/2 cup sliced almonds, toasted ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon dried oregano | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add rice noodles and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until tender.

title: Norman's Chili Sauce
ingredients: 7 cups chili ( bottled if possible ) | 10 cups tomato juice | 2 cups malt vinegar | 3 tablespoons fresh chives, snipped | pepper
instructions: Place tomatoes, chili, and vinegar in a large saucepan. Add 4 cups water along with chives. Bring to a boil, then simmer, uncovered, for 1 hour, stirring occasionally.

title: The Best Fish Ever
ingredients: 1/2 kg fresh yeast or 1/4 kg dry yeast | 3 - 3 1/2 cups warm water or 3 -3 1/2 cups body temperature water | 12 sheets shortcrust pastry, defrosted | 300 g shortcrust pastry, defrosted | 1 fillet tilapia, cut into 12 equal portions | 250 g spaghetti | salt and pepper, to taste
instructions: In an electric mixer or machine, combine the yeast with the warm water or body temperature and beat until foamy. Place the shortcrust pastry sheets in a large baking dish about 4 inches in size and place on top of the yeast mixture, pressing down to make sure the pieces are evenly spaced. Cover and leave to rise in a warm place until doubled in size, about 45 to 60 minutes. Place the fish fillets on top of the risen shortcrust pastry and brush well with egg wash. Dredge each piece in egg wash and then breadcrumbs. Place each piece on top of the fish fillets and spread out with the floured hands to cover and bring to the top of the pastry sheets. Cover and leave to rise in a warm place for 20 minutes. Preheat the oven to 230°c place a large baking tray in to the center of the oven and place 4 smaller ovenproof fish fillets in the oven dish. Turn the pieces of fish after 5 minutes and bake for 25 minutes, or until browned and cooked. Note, if the fish is large, it should be about 4” across by ½”. Also, it will be easier to cut after removing it from the oven. Place each piece on a warm serving plate and cover with the previously prepared spaghetti leaves and lemon peel. Serve with a little garden salad.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,picante sauce,mexican oregano,mint leaf,corn syrup,rice paper,button mushroom
title: Wild Mushroom and Chili Rolls!
ingredients: 6 -8 small button mushrooms, sliced into thirds | 2 tablespoons minced green chili peppers | 1/2 cup picante sauce | 1/4 cup rice vermicelli ( optional ) or 1/4 cup fried rice noodles ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons mexican oregano | 1/2 teaspoon pure maple syrup | 1/2 teaspoon corn syrup | 2 -3 sheets rice paper, rounds
instructions: First fry noodles or rice sticks in light olive oil for about 2 - 3 minutes or until golden. Add mushrooms and stir fry for another 3 minutes or until mushrooms soften. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Remove from heat and stir in picante & oregano. Spoon mushroom mixture onto rice paper rounds. Note, i use 1/4 cup of rice vermicelli per roll so it makes enough filling for 2 servings.

title: Artichoke Filling for Pyramids
ingredients: 2 artichoke hearts, sliced, with their liquid | 1/4 cup watercress, washed and chilled | 1 teaspoon green cardamom pods, lightly crushed | 4 tablespoons semi-sweet chocolate chips
instructions: Place the artichoke hearts and cold watercress in a medium saucepan. Add the cardamom pods and heat over high heat, stirring, until mixture boils. Lower the heat, cover and set aside for about 10 minutes or until the artichoke hearts are very soft and beginning to shrink from the artichokes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the artichokes to a separate bowl. Add watercress and set aside for 5 minutes or until water has been absorbed. Add the green cardamom and stir well. Pour mixture into a glass jar. Cover and store in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: red enchilada sauce,garlic,fish sauce,chicken thigh,baking potato,cranberry
title: Chicken Enchiladas Verde
ingredients: 4 whole boneless chicken thighs | 1 can red enchilada sauce | 1 package baking potatoes, peeled and chopped | 1/2 bunch fresh cranberries | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 1 teaspoon minced garlic
instructions: In a medium size pot, cook chopped chicken on med low heat till meat is done. Drain all fat. Add the tomato sauce, potatoes, cranberries, garlic until mixture is covered. Cook on high heat till mixture starts to bubble. Turn heat down to low. Cover and simmer for 10 min or till potatoes are soft. In a 13x9 pan, pour 1/3 of the mixture into the pan. Layer with 1/2 the chicken, and 1/2 the cranberries. Repeat with remaining ingredients. Cover and cook on low for an additional 25 minute. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: lebanese cucumber,salad green,apple cider,french onion soup mix,rice noodle,yukon gold potato
title: Potato and Cabbage Salad With Apples
ingredients: 4 small yukon gold potatoes, scrubbed | 250 g rice noodles | 2 lebanese cucumbers, halved lengthwise and thinly sliced | 1 packet french onion soup mix | 1/2 cup apple cider | 300 g salad greens
instructions: Boil water in a large saucepan, add potatoes, bring back to the boil and simmer for 6 - 8 minutes or until tender. Drain. Cook noodles according to directions on packet and drain. Heat 1/4 cup of oil in a frying pan, cook half the potatoes until crisp, turn and cook the other half. Divide the noodles between two plates, top with cucumber. Top with the onion soup mix, add the vinegar and stir. Divide the salad between 4 bowls and top with the potato salad.

title: Salad De Bleu
ingredients: 1/2 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 1/4 cup salad dressing ( i use kraft nutty salad dressing ) | 1/4 cup peanut butter | 1 vanilla bean | 1 cup powdered sugar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350f. In a small bowl, mix the bread crumbs with salad dressing. In another bowl, mash vanilla bean with the pestle and a fork. Mix in the peanut butter, stir until well blended. Fold in the crumb mixture. Drop onto a greased cookie sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake for 15 minutes until golden brown. Sprinkle with powdered sugar before serving.

Random Ingredients: rosemary,tarragon vinegar,red cooking wine,brown rice,horseradish,wheat english muffin,cream chicken soup,cherry tomato
title: Oven-Baked Hot Brown Rice
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked brown rice | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 red cooking wine | 1 tablespoon horseradish | 1 teaspoon tarragon vinegar | 2 teaspoons dried rosemary | 8 whole wheat english muffins, split in half | fresh cherries and a small amount of fresh mint, to garnish
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350º f. Bring a large pot of water to boil. Add the rice and cook for 15 minutes, stirring gently. Drain. Spread the rice in a 9x13 inch baking pan, then top with the cream of chicken soup, red wine, horseradish, tarragon vinegar, and rosemary. Cover and bake for 25 minutes. Spoon the rice mixture in the english muffin halves and top with fresh cherries and mint.

Random Ingredients: pecan,green olive,brown rice,dark sesame oil,mango chutney
title: Mango Nut Quick and Simple Brown Rice
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice ( i used brown basmati ) | 1/2 cup green olives, halved | 50 g pecan pieces ( i used walnut ) | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons mango chutney ( i used my own chutney from trader joe's )
instructions: Prepare brown rice according to directions on the packet. While the whole can of nuts is still raw, chop up the pecans and set aside. Drain olives and then chop up the walnuts into small pieces. Cut the sesame oil in to the green olives and then add to the rice. When the rice just starts to toast, add the chopped pecans and sesame oil. Stir through all your meal.

Random Ingredients: baking powder,lemonade,fish sauce,lemon lime beverage,tart apple,egg yolk,italian dressing
title: Lemonade-Apple Salad
ingredients: 1 tart apple ( about 9 ounces ) | 1/2 cup lemonade | 1/4 cup fish sauce | 3 egg yolks | 1 cup sweet italian dressing | 1 tablespoon baking powder | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 2 cups lemonade concentrate
instructions: Chop and core apple, if using apple, and cut into thick wedges. Add apple wedges to apple and toss gently. Stir remaining ingredients into apple mixture and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Italian Sausages
ingredients: 1/2 lb italian sausage, preferably sweet | 1 tablespoon raspberry jam | 2 tablespoons salad oil
instructions: Crumble italian sausage into 1/2 inch pieces and sear on both sides, until they're well browned and cooked through. Remove sausage and set aside in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: tuna vegetable oil,egg yolk,almond extract,chipotle pepper,butter,adobo seasoning
title: Chipotle Tuna Patties
ingredients: 2 1/2 cans tuna in vegetable oil | 2 egg yolks | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1/2 teaspoon adobo seasoning, or to taste | 1/4 teaspoon minced chipotle pepper | 1/2 teaspoon butter
instructions: Stir tuna, egg yolks, almond extract, adobo seasoning, chipotle pepper, and butter together in a bowl into the tuna mixture.

Random Ingredients: cracker,marsala wine,dark rum,creamy peanut butter,lemon juice
title: Rita's Steak
ingredients: 2 lbs of top sirloin steak | 1/2 teaspoon dark rum | 1/2 cup creamy peanut butter | 1/3 cup marsala wine | fresh lemon juice | crackers ( to garnish )
instructions: Prepare steaks as directed on package for your favorite recipe. Prepare a hot fire in your grill. While cooking the steaks, combine the dark rum and peanut butter. Grind the peanut butter with a mortar and pestle in a small bowl, mixing well until it forms a paste. Place the peanut butter mixture in a small bowl, and mix with the marsala wine. When the steak is done, place in a shallow dish. Pour the mushroom mixture directly over the steak, and allow to marinate for at least 1 hour. Preheat oven to grill your chosen side. Place the steaks on a foil lined baking sheet. Drizzle melted butter mixture over the steaks. Grill steaks for approximately 5 to 7 minutes per side, turning frequently.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,horseradish,hot water,ghee,sun tomato oil,pickapeppa sauce,grain white rice
title: Beef and Rice - Khara (Kheema)
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat, cut into 1/2 inch, cubes | 1/3 cup ghee or 1/3 cup clarified butter | 1/4 cup sweet pickapeppa sauce ( khatta ) | 1 tablespoon minced horseradish | 1 teaspoon hot water | 2 cups long grain white rice, uncooked, not instant ( kheer ) | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drain well before using ( kheer )
instructions: Brown meat in butter. Remove meat and set aside. Add khatta to the pot, add hot water, and stir to create a sauce. Return meat to pot and add cooked rice. If kheer are large, cut in half the size. Add sundried tomatoes, stirring to mix. Cover and simmer over low heat for 2 hours or until rice is tender.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,apple juice,saltine cracker,white onion,mascarpone cheese,white bread,seltzer water,littleneck clam
title: Clam-Crush Glams
ingredients: 2 packages saltine crackers, cut into quarters | 24 fresh littleneck clams, scrubbed and coarsely chopped ( use large wooden skewers for this ) | 1/2 large sweet white onion, chopped | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 cup white onion, chopped | 1 1/4 cups apple juice | 24 fluid ounces seltzer water | 1 lb mascarpone cheese | salt from littleneconton crackers ( optional )
instructions: Arrange the crackers on a large baking sheet. Sprinkle with salt. Place the clams on top and cover with plastic and heavy duty paper towel or aluminum foil. Place in the freezer for one hour or until the shells open. Remove the opened shells and refrigerate the clams. When cold, remove the plastic and discard. Remove the onion and place in a large bowl. Add the soups, onions, apple juice and drained shells. Mix well. Stir in the crème fraîche. Place one shell on each serving plate. Spoon some of the mixture over the shells and serve immediately. You may garnish each with a dab of seltzer cream.

Random Ingredients: kalamata olive,orange peel,confectioner sugar,soy sauce,chuck roast,pinto bean,whiskey
title: Portuguese Beef and Beans
ingredients: 4 lbs chuck roast | 1 can pinto beans, in water with | 1/4 - 1/3 cup whiskey | 1 1/2 tablespoons soy sauce | 1 orange peel | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar | 1/2 cup kalamata olives, pitted | confectioners'sugar for dusting
instructions: Place chuck roast in a large, heavy skillet. Brown on all sides until seared and beginning to crisp. Place the roast into a 9 x 13 inch pan. Add remaining ingredients except confectioners' sugar to pan and simmer about 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Remove from heat and stir in confectioners' sugar. Allow to cool slightly. Slice meat into 1/4 inch thick slices. Serve with sauce for dipping.

Random Ingredients: french sandwich,creole seasoning,coriander seed,chilies,italian bread,cumin powder
title: Chile & Cumin Bread
ingredients: 5 chilies | 1 french sandwich | 3 -4 tablespoons creole seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/4 teaspoon coriander seed | 2 slices italian bread
instructions: Start by mashing your chilies with a rolling pin and place them in a bowl. Combinate them well so they can be added to the bowl while you dry roast your french bread. This will help the mixture get properly moistened and will ensure your dry spices for the bread get well soaked up by the chilies. Grind the chilies with a mortar and pestle.. When done add your dry spice mixture to the chilies and mix well. Place the chilies in a plastic bag and freeze for 2 hours. Use some of the reserved seasoning to coat the bread slices and arrange them on a baking sheet sprayed with nonstick cooking spray. Spray all over with more cooking spray place in the oven for about 10 minutes, and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: tomato puree,white rice,tomato basil pasta sauce,coconut
title: Easy Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked white rice | 1 can tomato puree | 1 can tomato-basil pasta sauce | 1/4 cup shredded unsweetened coconut
instructions: Cook rice. Combine with sauce. Place in large casserole. Top with coconut. Bake at 375 degrees fahrenheit for 30 minutes.

title: Grilled Corn on the Cob
ingredients: 4 tablespoons grainy mustard | 2 tablespoons honey | 1/4 teaspoon dry crushed red pepper
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together mustard, honey and crushed red pepper until well mixed. Brush the inside of the grill grate with the mustard mixture. Lightly oil grate using direct. Grill corn on the preheated grill for 2 minutes on each side, or until charred. Serve hot.

title: Easy Garlic Dip (Yummy )
ingredients: 3 heads of garlic | 1 cup roasted peanuts ( i like barkers ) | 1/4 cup sunflower oil
instructions: Combine everything in a food processor or with a stick blender. Serve in a covered container.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,bicarbonate soda,sharp cheddar cheese,chunky peanut butter,rye bread,baking soda,iceberg lettuce
title: Peanut Butter Pork Braid (21 Day Wonder Diet : Day 2 )
ingredients: 3 1/2 ounces chunky peanut butter | 4 ounces sharp cheddar cheese or 4 ounces monterey jack cheese | 1 head iceberg lettuce, coarsely shredded | 1/4 cup chunky peanut butter | 1/4 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1 1/2 lbs pork shoulder, trimmed ( or lean ) | 4 slices rye bread ( thick slices or toasted bread ) or 4 slices wholemeal bread ( thick slices or toasted bread )
instructions: Heat oven to 200c. Line a 20cm x 15cm slice of baking parchment with baking paper. Process 2 ounces of the cheese and the peanut butter in a food processor until smooth. Spread some of the peanut butter on the base of a large ovenproof dish. Place a few lettuce on top of the peanut butter and top with a generous slice of cheese. Bake in the oven for approximately 20 minutes or until the lettuce is tender. Sprinkle over the remaining cheese and serve while warm.

title: Tomato Gravy for Pasta
ingredients: 500 g grape tomatoes or 500 g cherry tomatoes, halved | 3 celery ribs, chopped into large pieces | 1 tablespoon greshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshcheese leaves or 1/2 teaspoon greshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshreshly leaves | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard
instructions: Place all ingredients, except the grape tomatoes and the dijon mustard, into a saucepan and simmer over low heat for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Cool the chilli and then grind to a fine puree. Pour the chilli puree into a clean saucepan and bring to the boil. Reduce heat and simmer gently for 2 minutes. Remove from the heat, cool and chill, stirring occasionally. Stir through a fine sieve to get a smooth consistency. Serve with your favourite pasta and garnish with additional grated cheese if desired.

title: Slow-Cooker Swedish Noodle Dinner
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked noodles | 2 sirloin tip steaks, sliced | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1/2 cup fat-free cottage cheese | 2 eggs, lightly beaten | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1/4 cup chopped deli fresh cooked roast
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook the noodles in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 8 minutes. Drain and transfer to a 3 1/2 quart slow cooker. Place the sliced sirloin tip steaks into the slow cooker. Pour ketchup into the skillet, and add to the slow cooker. Set the cooker to low. In a small bowl, stir together the cottage cheese, eggs, turmeric, and roast until well blended. Pour the noodle mixture into the slow cooker. Cook on low for 3 hours.

title: Spiced Chipotle Ranch Sauce
ingredients: 1 can canned chipotle paste | 1/2 cup raw sugar-coated coconut ( about 1 cup ) | 2/3 cup gluten ( or gluten free flakes ) | 2 tablespoons gluten-free ranch dressing, such as < a href= '' https : //www.geniuskitchen.com/recipe/spicy-wish-sauce-492655 '' > spicy worish to taste (recipe # 492655 '' ) | 1 small red bell pepper, diced finely ( about 1/3 cup )
instructions: Combine the chipotle paste, coconut, and raw sugar flakes in small saucepan over medium low heat. Cook and stir until thoroughly heated and fragrant, 3 to 5 minutes. Off the heat, stir in the ranch dressing. Cover with plastic wrap and let sit at room temperature for about 1 hour or longer if you’re feeling fancy. Stirring occasionally, pour into a serving bowl. Garnish with diced bell pepper.

title: Quick Swiss Rollups
ingredients: 1/2 head cabbage, finely shredded | 1 cup swiss cheese, grated | 1/2 teaspoon chili flakes | 1 teaspoon confectioners'sugar
instructions: Combine all ingredients except confectioners' sugar, and roll each cabbage body into a snake shape. Roll in confectioners' sugar. Slice crosswise in 1/4 inch slices and serve.

title: Charishma's Chana Ki Raita
ingredients: 2 cups hot chicken broth | 50 g sunflower seed oil | sunflower seed oil, for deep frying
instructions: Heat the whole round iron skillet on medium high heat. Pour the 4 cup hot broth into a large bowl with about 1 cup of the fat. Using a whisk, whip the fat till it is light and well mixed. Add the blended oil to the broth to form a white foam haze. Immediately lower the flame and add this foam to the blender. Blend well, pour into the bowl of oil, and keep blending till the mixture starts leaving the sides of the bowl. Add the rest of the chicken broth. Keep blending till the mixture collects in small balls when whisked. This should take about 4 minutes. Pour into a bowl with some paper towels. Chill. When the fat has settled, dip the balls into the mixture, one by one. Leave for about 15 minutes to harden completely. If you need to make more balls, add a little of the saved broth. The raita should be dry inside. Dip into the reserved little broth for a refreshing snack.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,corn niblets,chicken thigh,apple juice,cherry tomato,graham wafer crumb,flat leaf parsley
title: Tortilla Chicken
ingredients: 1 teaspoon peanut oil | 1 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs | 4 tablespoons cherry tomatoes, halved | 2 tablespoons corn niblets, drained | 4 tablespoons apple juice | 1 tablespoon chopped flat leaf parsley | 1/3 cup graham wafer crumbs, finely crushed
instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add 1 tsp oil and chicken thighs to the pan and cook, turning once, about 4 minutes. Add cherry tomatoes, corn niblets, apple juice, parsley and 1/4 teaspoon salt.

title: Paneer Shrimps With Oyster Sauce (Geng Jeut Jee)
ingredients: 2 teaspoons cayenne powder | 4 halibut fillets ( firm ) | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | panir
instructions: In a skillet, add the panir. Spray over medium heat. Cook for about a minute on each side. This is better served hot.

title: Corned Beef on the Brisket
ingredients: 5 -8 lbs corned beef brisket | catsup, and sauce ( i used a-b-a-m. )
instructions: Place brisket in a pan. Cover with catsup and sauce. Cover and bake at 325 degrees for about 4 hours. Remove from oven and shred beef with 2 forks.

title: BBQ Studded Lamb Fondu
ingredients: 1 large sirloin steak | 3 lbs icing sugar | 3 teaspoons saffron | 2 1/2 cups candied green cardamom pods | 4 lbs spareribs
instructions: Remove excess fat from the meat. Cut into manageable sized cubes and then cut in 3 1/2 or smaller pieces. Put a piece of the meat on your skewer with your fingers. Place the meat in one layer on a bamboo skewer. Grill, turning until it becomes brown all over and no blood is left. Remove from skewers and keep warm. Place the icing sugar in a bowl. Grate one teaspoon or two of saffron into the icing sugar and mix well until it is a light yellowish white in color. Add half the sifted crushed cardamom pods and half the freshly ground green cardamom pods to the sifted icing sugar and mix well. Put the remaining sifted icing sugar, remaining saffron, and the rest of the cardamom pods into two large bowls. Make small balls with meat, dipping them in the icing sugar mixture to coat both sides. Repeat dipping them in the icing sugar mixture once more. Set the finished meat onto the skewer and place between the dipping blades or on the barbecue rack at moderate heat until the cheese has melted and then turn over and cook the other side. For your first batch you want to check to see if the meat is browning. If so, just turn off the bbq or grill element. You may take your first batch of meat and turn the rest over after about 20 - 30 minutes if necessary. Turn them over for about 5 - 10 minutes. If your meat starts to burn while cooking you may need to turn the exhaust fan on to avoid smoking the meat. When the cheese has melted, take it out of the oven on a cooling rack. Eat with ketchup or sweet and sour sauce.

title: Quick-Fix Chinese Chicken
ingredients: 5 lbs bone-in chicken thighs | 1 lb cube steaks, trimmed of excess fat
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. Place the chicken thighs in a 4 to 5 quart dutch oven. Cover with water to just below the level of the thighs. The water should not touch the bone bones or the meat will absorb it. Bring to a boil. Cover the dutch oven and place the whole contents of the dutch oven into the oven. Bake for 2 hours. The meat should be falling off the bone and the juices should have run clear. Stir once or twice or twice during the baking time. If necessary, use a large piece of aluminum foil to wrap around the dutch oven until the moisture is absorbed. Remove the foil and discard most of the water from the meat before slicing into 1/2 inch slices. Remove any bones or other unwanted pieces. Let the meat rest for a few minutes before serving. Serve with white rice.

title: Quick & Easy Veggies
ingredients: 1 can stewed tomatoes with juice | 1 large green pepper, roughly chopped
instructions: Empty entire can of stewed tomatoes and green pepper into a medium frying pan. Use all the canning liquid in the pan to make sauce. I usually make the sauce into my measuring cup, measuring 1/4 to 1/2 cup for each one of us. Once the tomatoes are all in the pan, cover with lid. Let cook on medium low heat until vegetables are tender and begin to brown for approximately 15 minutes. Do not stir or shake the pan if you attempt to avoid burning your vegetables. Remove from heat. Enjoy and keep on mind that this recipe can also be made by mixing together the vegetables and sauce. This will also give you a tasty green salad, which the dish is delicious and all the same flavour.

title: Italian Veal and Beans
ingredients: 1 package dried pinto beans | 1/8 lb veal, sliced thin | salt and pepper | 2 tablespoons fresh italian parsley, chopped
instructions: Soak the beans in water overnight, they cook fast. Drain soaked beans and place in a large pot. Add enough water to cover them. Add veal, salt and pepper. Bring to a boil, reduce to simmer until beans are tender about 1 1/2 hours or until a knife easily cuts through the beans. Add parsley when serving.

Random Ingredients: olive oil cooking spray,coriander seed,ketchup,farfalle pasta,white rum,pine nut,marsala wine
title: Farfalle With Marsala Syrup
ingredients: 1 lb farfalle pasta or 1 lb other short pasta | 3 tablespoons olive oil flavored cooking spray | 1 tablespoon coriander seed | 3 tablespoons pine nuts | 3 tablespoons ketchup | 1 tablespoon white rum | 3 tablespoons marsala wine or 3 tablespoons dry sherry
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place farfalle in a large pan of lightly salted boiling water. Cook until just tender, 2 - 3 minutes. Drain. Meanwhile, in a skillet, toast coriander seeds over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until fragrant, about 1 minute. Transfer coriander to a blender. Add pine nuts, ketchup, rum, and wine. Blend to a puree. Add farfalle pasta and stir to coat. Serve immediately.

title: Pasta With Mexican Ziti Sauce
ingredients: 12 ounces dry ziti pasta or 12 ounces rigatoni pasta | 5 tablespoons soymilk, divided | 1/4 - 1/2 cup salsa verde ( mild or hot, to taste ) | 1/4 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 small bunch fresh parsley, stems discarded ( optional )
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions, but don't overcook and drain before serving. Mix soymilk and salsa verde in a bowl.

title: English Crock
ingredients: 1 chuck roast | 6 lamb chops, 1 cm thick | 2 teaspoons allspice berries | 2 tablespoons fresh parsley, chopped
instructions: Sprinkle the roast with salt and pepper. Place meat on grill rack and grill 5 minutes on each side, or until internal temperature reaches 155°f and juices run clear. Remove from grill and allow to rest 10 minutes. Shred meat and mix with parsley. Serve.

title: Chili Crackers
ingredients: 1 tablespoon crisco | 1 tablespoon hot chili sauce | 1 teaspoon celtic hot chili flakes | 1 teaspoon fresh coarse ground black pepper | 1 teaspoon cheese, grated
instructions: In shallow dish sprinkle crisco over hot chili sauce and sprinkle over celtic hots and pepper. Sprinkle with cheese.

title: Simple Beef Burgundy
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin, thinly sliced | 2 large onions, sliced | 7 ounces chickpea flour | 1 tablespoon brown sugar | 1 cup marsala wine ( or other good wine, you can drink or re glaze your dish. ) ( optional )
instructions: Place sirloin and onions in crock Pot. Sprinkle with some of the brown sugar. Place the rest of the brown sugar over. Cook for 3 hours, stirring or spooning some of the liquid from the crock pot into a bowl. When meat is tender, remove beef and onions to a dish and dispose of remaining liquid until the liquid is gone. Mix the beef and the juice from the crock pot throughly and serve over rice, noodles, or mashed potatoes.

title: Matzo Crackers
ingredients: 2 cups matzo meal | 1 teaspoon celery leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Combine matzo meal and celery leaves in a bowl. Knead lightly for 5 to 10 minutes. Drap dough in pastry bag. Place on a tray and press to flatten. Cut into 16 squares. Bake 45 to 55 minutes, or until golden brown and fragrant. Remove to wire racks.

title: Taste for Beef
ingredients: 3 beef steaks | 2 teaspoons kosher salt ( if using table salt ) | 4 tablespoons thai basil | 1 tortilla ( i like to use a small, flat iron or soy roll ) | 1 -3 tablespoon white sauce
instructions: Preheat your grill to 300 degrees f. Wash your steaks and slice them into bite sized pieces as thinly as you can. Season each piece with 1 1/2 teaspoons of salt and lightly coat with a tablespoon or so of thai basil. Grill the beef for approximately 5 minutes on each side, or they will cook quite quickly. Top with some white sauce and serve on plate. Use your favorite white sauce to serve alongside. These will actually burn if left unattended for a couple of minutes until the coating is nicely browned.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower floret,chuck roast,double crust pie,anise seed,cooking spray,asafoetida powder,linguine,cod fish fillet
title: Cape Cod and Cauliflower Pot Pie
ingredients: 1 teaspoon ground anise seed | 1 1/4 - 1 1/2 lbs chuck roast, cut into 3-inch chunks | cooking spray | 1 medium cauliflower floret, cut into florets | 3 tablespoons anise seed | 1/2 lb linguine, cooked & drained | 1 lb boneless skinless cod fish fillet, cut into 3/4-inch chunks | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder
instructions: Lightly sprinkle the aniseed on the beef, wrap in plastic wrap & place in the refridgerator for at least 3 hours. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Spray a 9 inch nonstick baking pan w/cooking spray & place the sliced beef on top. Spray the cauliflower w/cooking spray. Place atop the beef. Toss in the aniseed & lightly sprinkle over the cauliflower. Toss the linguine in the hot cooking pan w/cooking spray over medium heat until just beginning to turn translucent, then toss in the cod. Sprinkle with anise seeds & lightly sprinkle over the asafetida. Toss lightly & sprinkle w/asafetida, pressing them in to adhere. Slice the beef into ¾ inch by ¼ inch strips and arrange over the cauliflower. Sprinkle cauliflower with 1 tablespoon of anise seeds. Top with the remaining 1 tablespoon of anise seeds. Cover with the remaining 1 tablespoon of anise seeds, then sprinkle w/asafetida. Bake 20 minutes or until the shrimp is curled & the cauliflower is browned. Serve with pasta & additional pan juices as desired.

title: Howler's Fondue
ingredients: 3 cups cream of tartar | 1 cup dry white wine
instructions: Mix cream of tartar in saucepan over medium heat until melted.

title: Sticky Garlic Steak
ingredients: 2 lbs flank steaks or 2 lbs round steaks | 1 1/2 - 2 tablespoons salt-free chicken bouillon cubes | 6 -8 ounces rice wine | 6 -8 mozzarella balls
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. Season the steak and coat with salt in a plastic bag with the bouillon. Put into a baking dish and pour the rice wine on top. Bake for about 45 minutes on a middle oven shelf. Remove the bag and continue baking uncovered for another 15 minutes.

title: Mixed Strawberry Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans red enchilada sauce | 2 tablespoons strawberry syrup
instructions: In blender, combine all ingredients and blend until smooth.

title: Smoky Maple Brandy Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups maple syrup | 1/2 cup unsulfured, dark aged barbecue sauce | 1/2 cup brandy ( optional )
instructions: Combine the maple syrup, barbecue sauce, and brandy in a small saucepan, and bring to a simmer over medium high heat.

title: Rhubarb Zucchini and Banana Bake
ingredients: 3 zucchini | 3 bananas ( peeled and sliced ) | 2 1/2 cups bean sprouts | 2 cups rhubarb ( sliced ) | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 2 teaspoons lemon pepper | 1/4 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/4 cup fat-free whipped topping
instructions: Slice zucchini, banana, and rhubarb. Dice rhubarb into 1/4 inch wide slices. Place zucchini, bananas, and rhubarb in a greased ovenproof dish. Combine remaining ingredients and season with pepper and mustard. Sprinkle over zucchini and bananas. Bake at 180c approximately 40 - 45 minutes.

title: Tacos II
ingredients: 1 pound pastry dough, thawed | 1 cup shredded yellow pepper | 1 cup chopped sweet yellow pepper | 1 cup confectioners'sugar | 1 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Mix shredded yellow and yellow peppers, shredded sweet yellow pepper, and confectioners' sugar together in a bowl. Brush pasty dough with a little olive oil and spread 1 tablespoon of the mixture in the center of each crust. Sprinkle with mace. Wrap with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Oats-Tomatoes, Plums & Tomato (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 1 )
ingredients: 2 cups rolled oats | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon granules | 300 g plum tomatoes, roughly chopped ( about 400g ) | 1/2 teaspoon saffron strand, crushed | 1/2 cup cherries, roughly chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 220c. Place rolled oats, chicken bouillon, tomatoes, saffron and cherries in a heatproof jug. Pour boiling water into measuring jug and stir with a fork to combine. Put into preheated oven and bake for 10 minutes or until tinged with brown and golden.

Random Ingredients: tapioca flour,macadamia nut,fenugreek seed,catsup,chickpea flour,cumin seed
title: Fenugreek Puffs (Tapioca Cookies)
ingredients: 1 cup chickpea flour | 1/2 cup tapioca flour | 1/4 cup fenugreek seeds ( ground ) | 1/4 cup chinese sweet noodles or 1/4 cup pear shaped macadamia nuts, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup catsup | 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin seed | 1 tablespoon tapioca flour | 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds ( ground )
instructions: Heat a large skillet over moderately high heat. While the pan is heating up, combine the chickpea and tapioca flour in a bowl and stir to blend. The flour mixture will appear bubbly. The fenugreek will expand and turn a beautiful golden color. Transfer the fenugreek to a large bowl and stir in the noodles. When the pan is hot, ladle 1/2 tablespoon of batter into each depression. The bubbles will form. When bubbles appear, flatten them with the back of the cup. Flip the puffs with a spoon and cook until the bottoms are light brown, about 7 minutes. Remove the puffs from the pan and keep. Continue cooking the batter until all the batter is used, about 10 more. Cool the puffs before making the glaze. To make the glaze, stir together the sugar and spices in a small bowl. Drizzle a little of the glaze over the top each puffs, allowing the glaze to run down the sides. Store covered in the refrigerator until serving time.

title: Rosemary and Quinoa (Quinoa) With Rosemary
ingredients: 1/2 cup quinoa | 1 sprig rosemary ( optional )
instructions: Rinse the quinoa well and place in a bowl. Add the rosemary sprigs or thyme. Cover with saran wrap and let sit a hour or two. Rinse well and serve. Store in refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon granule,greek feta cheese,egg,brown lentil,margarine,cherry tomato,potato
title: Greek Lentil Bake
ingredients: 1 cup brown lentils | 1 tablespoon margarine | 1/2 cup margarine | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon granules | 2 cups mashed potatoes | 1 package crumbled greek feta cheese | 2 eggs | 1 can chopped cherry tomatoes, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange the cooked lentils in a lightly greased 9x13 inch pan. In a medium saucepan over medium heat, melt 2 tablespoons of margarine.

title: Thai Green Curry Noodles
ingredients: 1 package dry rice noodles or ( 3 - 3 1/2 lb ) package egg noodles | 1/4 cup thai green curry paste ( thai kitchen brand is the real deal ) | 1 teaspoon savory, ground
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the rice noodles and boil, stirring occasionally until just firm to the bite, stirring occasionally, about 3 minutes. Transfer to drain. Drain noodles in a sieve set over a bowl. Heat the curry paste in a small skillet over medium low heat until fragrant. Stir in the noodles.

Random Ingredients: chocolate syrup,lebanese cucumber,chicken wing,green lentil,glace ginger,self rising flour
title: Easy New Zealand Chicken and Cucumber Scones
ingredients: 2 pints chicken wings | 375 g split green lentils | 200 g self rising flour | 2 tablespoons glace gingerroot and ginger shredded fresh ginger | 1 1/2 cups chocolate syrup | 2 lebanese cucumbers
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Spread half the chicken wings on an oven tray and bake for about 15 minutes, or until golden brown. Remove from the oven, cool. Place the lentils and pints of split beans in a saucepan and lightly cook over a medium heat. Simmer for about 10 minutes, or until just boiling. Place the flour in another bowl. Heat half the chicken, ginger, chocolate syrup and chillies in a small pan on a medium heat, stirring constantly for 2 - 3 minutes until warm. Stir in the lentil and beans and pour into the mixture. Stir to combine and set aside to cool to room temperature. Cut the cucumbers into 4 5cm cubes. Remove the scone joint from under the wings, and using 2 cm pieces, make little slits lengthways about 1 cm deep on the diagonal, place cucumber onto the scone. Roll up and place with all the scone on the tray, cut side down on the tray until the scone is complete. Brush each scone with some melted chocolate and bake for about 25 minutes, or until risen and brown. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast,icing sugar,white fish fillet,honey,chinese cabbage
title: Chinese Slice
ingredients: 12 slices skinless chicken breast | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 1/2 cup honey | 1 bunch chinese cabbage, in wedges and separated from the hard leaves | 4 white fish fillets ( cod ) ( optional )
instructions: Spread a little bit of icing sugar on each slice of chicken. Place the chicken on the bottom of a flat baking dish. Top with a slice of cabbage. Drizzle with honey and drizzle with more icing sugar. If desired, score the fish with a sharp knife before adding to the baking dish. Cover with aluminium foil and bake at 180c/350f/gas 4 for 35 - 40 minutes until the chicken is cooked. The cabbage may also be chopped into cubes or sliced, depending on your taste.

title: Chinese Ginger Rice
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ginger juice | 2 cups arborio rice or 2 cups medium grain rice
instructions: Cover and heat in a steaming pan on the stove or on top of your wok. When the rice starts steaming, stir fry in the ginger juice over high heat for 40 seconds. Remove rice from heat and stand for 5 minutes. Remove ginger and discard. Serve with soy sauce and fresh chives. Note, you can add more ginger juice or chinese mustard powder if necessary.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,grape jelly,graham cracker crumb,pistachio,chicken breast half,water chestnut
title: Pina Colada Chicken
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 1/2 cup cold water chestnuts | 1 jar grape jelly | 1 cup canned pineapple juice | 2 tablespoons chopped pistachios
instructions: Cut a lengthwise slit in each chicken breast half, and insert about 1/4 teaspoon of toothpick into the center of each breast to hold a slice of chicken on it. Place the graham cracker crumbs in a dish, and toss with the water chestnuts in a separate dish. Place the chicken pieces in the crumbs, and press into crumbs to coat. Arrange the chicken on a plate, and cover in plastic wrap.

Random Ingredients: white wine,heavy whipping cream,swiss chard,molasses,pecorino romano cheese,hungarian paprika,broth
title: Swiss Chard With Pecorino-Paprika Cream Sauce in a Cast Iron Broiler
ingredients: 1 lb swiss chard, trimmed and coarsely chopped | 1/3 cup heavy whipping cream | 2 1/4 teaspoons molasses | 1 teaspoon hungarian paprika | 1/2 cup dry white wine | 1/2 cup beef stock or 1/2 cup canned broth | 3/4 cup grated pecorino romano cheese, plus | 1/4 cup grated pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Spray an 8 to 10 inch nonstick skillet with nonstick spray and heat over moderate heat until hot but not smoking, about 5 minutes. Add chard and cook, stirring occasionally, until wilted and just beginning to wilt, 4 to 5 minutes. Transfer chard to a bowl. Heat cream in a small saucepan over moderate heat until almost simmering and let it cook, stirring occasionally, until reduced to 1 cup, 1 to 2 minutes. Remove from the heat and whisk in molasses, paprika, and wine. Season with salt and pepper. Return sauce to a simmer and whisk in cheese until melted and incorporated. Add chard and serve immediately or let cool.

Random Ingredients: couscous,cajun seasoning,celery rib,white mushroom,half cream,grand marnier,coconut milk
title: Couscous Dessert
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups half-and-half cream | 2 cups couscous, uncooked | 1 can coconut milk ( i prefer coco lopez ) | 1 tablespoon creamed coconut cream or 1 tablespoon coconut milk | 1/2 teaspoon cajun seasoning | 4 celery ribs, sliced thin | 2 tablespoons grand marnier or 2 tablespoons milk
instructions: Preheat the oven to put the soullapow cups in a 9x13 pan and pour some water into it. Put a lid on the pan and put in oven. I know this sounds confusing but it works the next day. When the oven reaches it's temp, put in couscous. Cook it for approximately 4 minutes. It should still be a little moist looking, but not wet like the way you would prepare porridge. Remove from oven, cover with a damp cloth, and set aside. When you are done, pour out the water and let it sit for a few minutes on the counter, just to warm the couscous and mix it. Pour the soullapot/cous back into the pan in the oven. Stir in coconut cream, creamed coconut and cajun seasoning. Stir to mix well or until coconut is incorporated and the couscous is smooth. Stir in celery and grand marnier. Spoon the mixture into the couscous bowls. Serve immediately.

title: Baked Southwest Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 2 cans pinto beans, undrained | 1 can chopped green chile peppers | 1 large papaya, diced | 1 container guacamole, or as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Pour the black beans into a 2 quart baking dish, and top with the green chile peppers. Cover with papaya, then spread guacamole over the entire dish. Bake in the preheated oven until bubbly, 2 to 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,pickapeppa sauce,noodle,cream chicken soup,active yeast,pinto bean
title: Noodle-Broccoli and Bean Dish
ingredients: 1 envelope active dry yeast | 2 cups uncooked noodles, any package | 3/4 cup fat free sour cream or 3/4 cup low fat sour cream | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 can pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can broccoli florets, drained
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup of warm water. Bring to boil and add in next 3 ingredients and 1/2 cup of broth. Return to boiling, cover and let stand in a warm place until yeast is bubbly. Remove and let stand until bubbly. Pour into a 2 quart lightly greased baking dish. Stir in broccoli and cover with remaining 1/2 cup broth. Cover, set aside in warm place, and place in a warm place until heated. This is where all the flavor comes from. Stir and refrigerate until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: green bean,creole seasoning,halibut fillet,beef brisket,lard,bok choy
title: Beef Brisket and Green Beans
ingredients: 2 beef brisket | 4 teaspoons lard | 1 package beef brisket | 12 stalks green beans, trimmed | 4 large bok choy, leaves, washed, chopped | 2 tablespoons creole-style seasoning
instructions: Sprinkle beef brisket with creole seasoning. Heat lard in a large skillet over high heat until smoking. Quickly brown brisket on all sides.

title: Mussels and Potato
ingredients: 12 large, deep mussels, scrubbed | 1 head red potatoes, scrubbed, scrubbed
instructions: Place potatoes in a large pot with enough water to cover.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,food coloring,oriental sesame oil,five spice powder
title: Jamaican Chili Powder for Bistro® Chicken Pieces
ingredients: 1 tablespoon five-spice powder | 2 cans petite diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | food coloring ( optional ) | old-fashioned oriental sesame oil ( optional )
instructions: In a small bowl, blend five spice powder, undrained tomatoes and food coloring until color is blended. Pour color into a resealable plastic bag. Add the bag to a large pot of boiling hot water. Boil 5 minute or until mixture thickens slightly. Using slotted spoon, transfer chili powder mixture to a bowl. Stir in sesame oil.

title: French Quarter Steaks With Shrimp
ingredients: 1 3/4 lbs stewing beef, cut into cubes | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1/2 small uncooked jumbo shrimp, peeled | 1/4 cup lard | 2 dozen medium mussels, scrubbed
instructions: Toss cubed stewing beef in worcestershire sauce. Heat lard in 10 inch skillet.

title: Bissara
ingredients: 650 g spinach leaves | 15 saffron strands | 600 g sugar-free yoghurt, made with 2 tbsp corn starch and 2 tbsp water | 1 kg of commercially prepared phyllo dough | 250 g bissara dough or 250 g kabocha dough
instructions: Preparation of phyllo dough. Heat oven to 180 degrees celsius. Dry the saffron with a tea towel. Pour 1/2 tsp of the saffron into a plastic bag with your hands and crush to release excess liquid. Add the saffron to yoghurt and mix well. Put the spinach and chilli into a large bowl and pour yoghurt mix over the top. Leave to rise till the edges begin to dry out. Preparation of bissara. Knead the bissara dough on a floured counter and divide it into thirds. On a lightly floured bench, press the dough out into two discs. Spread one disc with 1/4 cup of yoghurt mix and sprinkle with a few saffron leaves. Add 2 - 3 tbsp of yoghurt mix to each disc and continue to work it out until you have a square dough about 1/3 inch thick. Lay the three ends of the bissara dough on the bissara dough and wrap tightly. Put both the bissara in the oven for 15 minutes. Reduce the heat to 120 degrees c. After 15 minutes, take the bissara out of the oven and let it sit on a dry towel covered tray until it has dried out. Take the bissara out of the oven and spread the remaining yoghurt mix on top. When it has become dry, remove the bissara from its baking sheet. Keep covered with a napkin and put in the oven to dry the excess water. After 15 minutes, take the bissara out of its oven and take the bissara out and cut it into 4 squares. Keep aside and keep on a damp towel until serving time. Serves two.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,cottage cheese,mushroom,white onion,cayenne pepper,white cooking wine,oregano leaf,cashew
title: Mushroom Nests With Cashews-Cavatelli
ingredients: 20 ounces mushrooms, cleaned and stems removed | 12 ounces small cottage cheese | 1/2 small white onion, peeled and thinly sliced | 1/2 tablespoon dried oregano leaves | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper ( to taste ) | 1 tablespoon cashews, unsalted, chopped | 2 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, chopped | 1/2 tablespoon white cooking wine or 1/2 tablespoon wine vinegar
instructions: In a medium size bowl, combine mushrooms and cottage cheese. In a small bowl, combine onion, oregano and cayenne pepper. Spoon into cheese mixture and toss well. Transfer mixture to a plate. Place cashews and parsley in a small bowl, toss with cooking wine or vinegar.

title: Beef Linguine and Macaroon
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, cut in 1/2 strips | 1 1/2 cups chicken broth | 2 tablespoons oil | 8 macaroon | 8 ounces mozzarella cheese, shredded | 6 macaroons | 2 cups rice, cooked | applesauce
instructions: In a large skillet, combine beef, broth, and half the butter.

title: Coriander Spinach
ingredients: 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 1 1/2 lbs fresh spinach, washed, stems trimmed, and torn into small pieces | 1/2 cup dry cooking sherry | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh coriander seeds | cooked pancake or fried egg | 2 tablespoons marsala wine
instructions: In a very large pan, heat oil over moderate heat. Add the spinach to the pan and cook, stirring occasionally, for 2 to 4 minutes until barely wilted. Stir in the sherry and 1 tablespoons of the coriander and simmer, stirring, for 1 minute longer. Transfer the spinach to a large serving bowl. Stir in the remaining coriander and the remaining sherry and season. Serve.

title: Baby Carrots With Lemon Vinaigrette for Zesty Vegetarian
ingredients: 15 -20 baby carrots, peeled | 1 lemon, juice of
instructions: Cut each carrot in half diagonally. Bring a pot of salted water to boil. Add the carrots and return to the boil. Cook 6 - 8 minutes, until just tender but not mushy. Drain and place on a plate covered in paper towel. Let them cool a little bit. Drain off some of the accumulated water, then toss with the lemon juice..

title: Champagne Leaf and Root Soup
ingredients: 1 tablespoon coconut oil | 1/2 ounce leek, chopped with a little of the green outer leaves removed | 1/4 teaspoon champagne vinegar | 1 tablespoon red onion, diced
instructions: Heat the coconut oil and leek with the vinegar in a frying pan over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly. Add the vegetables then cover and simmer for 5 to 7 minutes until all the vegetables are tender. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,sherry wine,dark chocolate,worcestershire sauce,daikon radish,lamb
title: Lamb and Chocolate Skewers
ingredients: 600 g lamb, cut into thin strips | 60 g fresh daikon radishes, cut lengthways into 8 wedges ( about 2 cups ) | 60 g dark chocolate | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1/2 teaspoon sherry wine | 400 g kidney beans ( drained and rinsed )
instructions: Cut a cross in the base of the lamb and remove all excess fat. Place lamb, daikon and chocolate in a small bowl and set aside for 30 minutes to soften slightly. Combine worcestershire, sherry and beans in a small bowl and season with salt and pepper. Thread lamb and radish onto a chopping board, using 1/2 of the beef mixture per skewer. Place skewers on a wire rack set over a baking tray, cover and freeze.

title: Niku Jyaga (Fried Nuts)
ingredients: 4 tablespoons flour | 1 tablespoon mirin ( japanese sweet wine ) | 10 teaspoons tomato ketchup | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary leaves | 1 ounce walnut pieces or 1 ounce chopped roasted almonds
instructions: Make the sauce by combining the flour with the mirin, tomato ketchup and rosemary leaves. Pour over boiling water and simmer for 3 to 5 minutes, stirring frequently. Place the nuts in a serving dish and top with the sauce.

title: Dessert Party Dessert
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese, softened | 2 tablespoons sour cream | 2 teaspoons pineapple juice, reserved from the can
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, beat together the cream cheese, sour cream, and pineapple juice. Fold in the whipped cream cheese to coat. Pour mixture into prepared baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven 20 to 25 minutes, until the center appears set. Cool completely and slice into 1 inch squares. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: white sugar,cannellini bean,longhorn cheese,cream chicken soup,orange juice concentrate
title: Cheesy White Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 bag frozen orange-flavored concentrate, thawed | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 2 containers longhorn cheese | 1/4 cup white sugar | 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Whisk the orange orange juice concentrate, cream of chicken soup, 1/4 cup of sugar, and cannellini beans together in a large bowl until thoroughly combined. Transfer to a 9x13 inch baking dish and bake at 350 degrees f for 30 minutes.

title: Alfredo Dip (Copycat)
ingredients: 4 tablespoons alfredo sauce | 1 jar of ragu chunky salsa in sweet verde | 1 tablespoon pickle, minced ( i like a jar of ragu sweet verde dip )
instructions: Mix together in a serving bowl and chill in refrigerator for 30 minutes until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: black eyed pea,salt,chocolate,oregano leaf,garlic powder,taco seasoning
title: Oaxacan Black-Eyed Peas for Two
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground dark unsweetened chocolate | 2 tablespoons minced garlic powder | 1 tablespoon salt | 1 1/4 tablespoons taco seasoning | 1 1/2 cans chopped black-eyed peas, rinsed and drained | 1 1/2 tablespoons minced fresh oregano leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Lightly grease a 9x13 inch pan. In a mixing bowl, stir together the chocolate, garlic powder, salt, and taco seasoning. Stir in the black eyed peas, oregano and 1 1/4 tablespoons water. Mix well. Pack the mixture into prepared pan. Bake in preheated oven for 50 to 60 minutes until firm and lightly browned on top, and the edges a little crisped up. Let cool 10 minutes. Remove from oven, and slice into squares. Store airtight. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: cashew,baby spinach,red chili powder,french onion soup,green pepper,almond extract
title: Spinach With Cashews
ingredients: 1 cup french onion soup, canned ( or frozen ) | 250 g baby spinach | 1/2 cup slivered almonds, slivered | 1 tablespoon red chili powder | 1/2 cup cashews, roughly chopped | 1/4 tablespoon almond extract
instructions: In a food processor chop off the top of the soup and set aside. Heat up the almond extract on low heat. In a separate bowl, add the cashews, mix well so nuts don't burn. Take the soup from the stove and add it to the food processor. Pulse until well mixed. Add sugar and mix into the soup. Add red chili powder and mix well until well mixed. When you are done add the spinach mix well into the soup and serve cold.

Random Ingredients: spinach,stove stuffing mix,green chili pepper,ziti pasta
title: Mexican Ziti
ingredients: 1 package frozen spinach, thawed and squeezed, squeezed dry | 1 package ziti pasta, uncooked | 1 can mild green chili peppers, chopped, undrained | 1 package stove top stuffing mix
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Cook and drain ziti as directed on package. Mix together spinach, ziti, green chilies, stuffing mix, and 1/2 water in a large casserole dish. Mix well, and cover with aluminum foil. Bake 40 - 50 minutes.

title: Steamed Beef Patties
ingredients: 600 g stewing beef | 1 cup mushroom, sliced | 4 teaspoons poppy seeds | 6 eggs, beaten | 1 tablespoon fish sauce or 1 -2 teaspoon chili paste, to taste
instructions: Trim the beef of all excess fat. Cut into 2 equal portions. Lightly pound the poppy seeds with a rolling pin to get a paste. Add the remaining ingredients, and mix in the poppyseed paste. Cut into 3 or 4 equal sized patties. Steam for 10 minutes at 180 degrees celcius.

Random Ingredients: cannellini bean,feta cheese,rosemary sprig,head bok choy
title: Feta and Bok Choy
ingredients: 1 head bok choy, trimmed and cut into 2/3-inch sections | 1 1/4 cups cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1/4 cup crumbled feta cheese | 1 fresh rosemary sprigs
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil, or slightly dampened with cooking spray.
