Arrange the bok choy sections in an even layer onto the prepared baking sheet. Bake in preheated oven until tender and beginning to brown, about 5 minutes. Stir and cool 5 minutes. Transfer one quarter of bean slices to a small bowl and mash with a fork. Spoon beans into the center of each bok choy section. Top with crumbled feta cheese. Arrange the remaining bean slices around the cheese.

title: Easy Chicken
ingredients: 7 ounces frozen hearty crackers, thawed | 3 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1 cup buttermilk
instructions: Place thawed crackers in a medium sized mixing bowl. Put buttermilk in freezer for 15 minutes to thaw before using. Place chicken in a large freezer bag. Remove air bubbles.

title: Sambal Chili Paste
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chili oil | 24 large lettuce leaves
instructions: Heat the chili oil in a large frying pan. Add the lettuce leaves, lower the heat and cook for 2 - 3 minutes until the lettuce leaves are very soft. Serve with chili chips.

Random Ingredients: mustard,simple syrup,tabasco sauce,white flour,lard,chickpea,yellow bell pepper,icing sugar
title: Halloween Sweet Pepper Salad
ingredients: 1 yellow bell pepper or 1 red bell pepper | 1 can chickpeas | 2 -3 tablespoons mustard | 1 teaspoon icing sugar ( confectioner's sugar ) | 1/8 teaspoon tabasco sauce ( or to taste ) | 1 teaspoon white flour ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons simple syrup ( not necessary ) | 1 tablespoon lard, melted
instructions: Peel and slice the bell pepper. Place in bowl of a food processor with chickpeas, mustard, icing sugar, tabasco sauce, and flour. Process until combined. Add the remaining ingredients and process until it forms a smooth dressing. Serve on toasted fresh crackers or toasted bread. Makes about 2 cups. If making ahead of time, cover, cover and refrigerate for up to 2 weeks. Serve the salad in large lettuce leaves with crackers.

title: Simple, Cheater's Sweet and Sour Carrots from the Vegetarian Times
ingredients: 3/4 cup ketchup | 5 medium sized carrots, peeled and cut into 1/4 inch thick slices
instructions: Put all ingredients in a covered container and shake well until carrots are coated evenly. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for up to 2 days.

Random Ingredients: salsa,chinese five spice powder,purple onion,gingerroot,veal,white pepper,pumpkin pie spice
title: Pumpkin Chicken or Pork Empanadas
ingredients: 1 red onion ( diced ) | 1/2 cup of diced fresh gingerroot | 1 cup ground veal | 1 cup salsa ( i prefer kraft or prepared salsa ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons chinese five spice powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons pumpkin pie spice | 1 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Place onion, ginger, and pork into large cooking pot and sauté until pork is browned slightly. Drain grease and place all ingredients in blender and process to fine pieces.. Pour mixture to frying pan and add salsa and spice. Stir with spoon. Cook on very low until mixture starts to thicken. If too thick add water until desired consistency. You may add or take some of the mixture and add to sauce now if you desire. Remove from heat and set aside. Take a heaping tablespoons of mixture and roll into ball. Put in a pie pan with parchment paper to go around the edge of the pan or you can place the rolled empanada in a pan right on the paper covered plate. Repeat with the rest. Place in preheated 350 degree oven and bake for approximately 30 minutes until golden brown. Use a tooth pick to check the middle of the empanadas and turn them if they don't cook through. Serve with salsa to dip.

title: Pickled Turnips
ingredients: 8 turnips, peeled and halved | 2 tablespoons kosher salt | 2 stalks lemon grass, stalks trimmed, leaves finely chopped | 3 tablespoons chopped shallots | 1/2 cup packed golden raisins | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Line a rimmed baking sheet with aluminum foil large enough to fold over the top of the turnips. Place salt in a large glass bowl.

title: Creamed Edamame and Roasted Fried Chicken
ingredients: 1 package frozen shelled edamame | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 4 thin baked potatoes | 1 frying chickens | 4 teaspoons grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Place frozen shelled edamame in a large microwave safe bowl and cover with boiling water. Microwave on high for 3 minutes, stirring halfway through cooking. Drain and rinse under cold water until cool. Drain again. Place frozen edamame in a microwave safe bowl cover with water, cover and microwave on high for 5 minutes, stirring halfway through cooking. Dice potatoes. Uncover microwave safe bowl with edamame and microwave on high until hot, about 2 minutes. Stir potatoes and edamame into cooked edamame and pour into a 9x13 inch glass baking dish. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese. Bake for 5 minutes. Remove from oven and spread top with cream. Return to oven, uncovered, until hot, about 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pickle juice,granny smith apple,allspice,spanish paprika,picante sauce
title: Apple Dip
ingredients: 6 granny smith apples, peeled and diced | 3 tablespoons sweet spanish paprika | 3 tablespoons pickle juice | 1 tablespoon allspice | 1 cup picante sauce
instructions: Combine apples, paprika, pickle juice, and allspice.

title: Baby Bok Choy
ingredients: 2 lbs baby bok choy | 2/3 cup minced prosciutto | 2 teaspoons paprika
instructions: Preparation, wash bok choy for a couple of minutes in cold water. Slice and wash the prosciutto with cold water. Drain and set aside. Mix paprika with minced mushrooms. Set aside. Heat a skillet on high and add paprika mixture. When paprika begins to get a little dark, put entire piece of bok choy in and stir fry for about a minute or two, allowing excess moisture to escape. Remove bok choy from pan and place it in a 9x13 glass dish. Spread prosciutto over top. Cover with paprika/parmesan mixture. Bake in pre heated oven 45 minutes.

title: French Roast Chicken
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs whole chickens, thawed | 2 cups sherry wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 350'f/180'c/gas 4. Tie legs and wings together with kitchen string or tie securing closed with kitchen string. Tie wings tightly with kitchen string or tie with kitchen string. Place chicken, breast side down, in roasting bag. Pour 2/3s bottle sherry over. Cover and place in roasting pan. Cover and bake till tender about 1 hour. Remove chicken from pan. Reduce basting juices into pan juices. Pour mixture in pan juices. Baste chicken with sherry to glaze. Sprinkle with more sherry if desired.

title: Pasta With Shiitake Mushrooms & Herbs
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked elbow macaroni | 1 cup cremini mushrooms, finely chopped | 1 sprig fresh rosemary, leaves picked
instructions: Cook pasta in a large pot of boiling water until al dente.

title: Confusion Beans
ingredients: 3 cups pinto beans, drained | 1 1/2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar ( optional )
instructions: Stir together the confectioners' sugar and pinto beans in a saucepan. Cover, and cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the mixture is thick and smooth, about 15 minutes.

title: Pasta with Bean, Beans and Macaroni
ingredients: 1 bag macaroni | 1 pint chicken broth | 1 can cannellini beans
instructions: Fry macaroni in olive oil, add enough water to cover when pasta is done.

title: Salsa-Ranch-Simmered Mexican-Inspired Cucumber
ingredients: 2 cups water | 1 english cucumber, unpeeled | 3 cups whole kernel corn, drained | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained
instructions: Bring water and cucumber to simmer in a small saucepan over medium heat. Stir in corn and tomatoes with chilies. Heat through but do not boil. Ladle hot salsa into bowls.

title: Crispy Whole Wheat Salmon and Cilantro Lettuce Lasagna
ingredients: 12 fresh whole wheat lasagna noodles | 1 pound coarsely chopped fresh salmon | 1 pound skinless, boneless shrimp - peeled, deveined tails left on | 2 teaspoons dried italian seasoning | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro | 1/2 cup water | 1 large romaine lettuce, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Cook noodles in a large pot of water until al dente. Rinse with cold water and set aside. Place salmon, shrimp, italian seasoning and cilantro in a large skillet. Add water, bring to a boil and simmer over medium heat until shrimp turns pink. Remove from heat. Drain pasta and return to pot, toss to coat. Cover noodles with a layer of the salmon mixture, and repeat layers two more times. Cover tightly then transfer to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake, covered, in the preheated oven for 45 minutes. Uncover and bake for an additional 15 minutes, or until pasta is tender and seafood is opaque. Remove from the oven, remove paper and discard. Top each serving with a romaine lettuce leaf to serve.

title: Sugar Cookie Biscuits
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour | 1 cup cake flour | 1 cup powdered sugar
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the all purpose flour, cake flour, and powdered sugar until just mixed. Stir in flour just until dough gathers together. Pat dough into a ball, and cut into desired shapes. Bake on a greased cookie sheet for 10 minutes. Cool cookies on cookie sheets for 3 minutes before removing. Allow cookies to cool completely before removing.

Random Ingredients: barbecue sauce,self rising flour,bean,confectioner ' sugar,brown rice,seasoning,mandarin orange
title: Mandarin BBQ Beans
ingredients: 2 cans mandarin oranges, drained | 1 package frozen sweet beans, thawed | 1 cup barbecue sauce, divided | 4 cups self-rising flour, divided | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar | 1/4 cup seasoning
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. In a 9x13 inch baking dish, mix together the oranges, sweet beans, and 1/2 cup of the barbecue sauce until well combined. Mix the bread flour, confectioners' sugar, and seasoning into the remaining 1/2 cup of barbecue sauce in a separate bowl. Stir the seasoned flour into the remaining 1/2 cup of barbecue sauce. Spoon over the bean mixture in the prepared baking dish. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes in the preheated oven, until the top has browned.

title: Red Chile Buttermilk and Gruyere Salsas
ingredients: 1 large romaine lettuce hearts, washed | 4 small red chilies ( i prefer habanero ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup of pure grated gruyere cheese ( optional ) | 3/4 cup non-dairy buttermilk ( use 1/4 cup if they're dry ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried fenugreek | 1/2 teaspoon dried rubbed sage | 1 teaspoon cornflour, mixed with | 3 tablespoons water
instructions: Dressing, wash and coarsely chop the chilies. Mince the chilies, then stir in the cheese, buttermilk, fenugreek, sage and cornflour mixture. Let sit for a few minutes to develop the flavours. The buttermilk can be used immediately, but the flavours are better if allowed to stand for a few hours before using. If it is too thick, add a little more buttermilk. To serve, place some lettuce and a small pinch of cheese on each serving plate, then sprinkle with the chilies. Serve immediately.

title: Wild Turnip Salad
ingredients: 2 pounds baby greens | 1 package mixed salad greens | 8 ounces bittersweet chocolate squares, broken into pieces | 2 cups peeled, grated apples with liquid | 1 cup turnip, thinly sliced
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil. Cook the greens in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until evenly tender, about 1 minute. Drain and cool under cold water.

title: Kolache
ingredients: 1 teaspoon paprika | 1 teaspoon epazote leaves | 1/2 habanero pepper, halved | 1/4 cup semolina flour ( besan ) | 1/4 cup whole pitted kalamata olives
instructions: In a small bowl, mix paprika, epazote, and habanero. Place kalamata olives in a saucepan on low heat. Lightly oil grill. Lightly brush sauté pan with olive oil. Add paprika mixture. Continue to heat. Serve at once.

title: Cottage Cheese Roulades (Serve as your main course)
ingredients: 2 cups cooked chick-peas, drained well | 2 tablespoons minced fresh dill ( or 1/8 tsp. dried ) | 1/4 teaspoon savory | 1 tablespoon mascarpone | 12 hot soft flour tortillas, such as keebler club tortillas or 12 soft taco-size soft flour tortillas, such as keebler club tortillas | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs flank steaks
instructions: Combine chickpeas, dill, and savory in a small bowl. Spread each tortilla with just enough of the chick peas mixture to coat and wrap tightly. Microwave each tightly covered tortilla on high for 1 minute each, until heated through. Lay each roulade on a plate and cover tightly with plastic wrap. Microwave on high for 5 - 7 minutes.

Random Ingredients: scotch bonnet pepper,chinese five spice powder,beef stock,prosciutto,olive,chocolate chip,tortilla,scallion
title: Choc Ripple Wraps
ingredients: 1 can sliced ripe olives | 8 -10 inches tortillas, for wrap | 10 ounces thinly sliced prosciutto | 1/4 cup scotch bonnet peppers ( you may substitute habanero ) or 1/4 cup scotch bonnet pepper, finely chopped ( you may substitute habanero ) | 2 tablespoons scallions, finely chopped | 4 ounces chocolate chips | 1/2 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 3 1/4 cups beef stock
instructions: In a blender combine the olives, prosciutto, pepper, scallions, chinese five spice, and beef stock. Blend well. Spread mixture over tortillas and roll tightly. Secure with tooth picks. Refrigerate until serving.

title: Chilli Oil
ingredients: 4 tablespoons arrowroot | 4 tablespoons roughly chopped walnuts | chili flakes
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together arrowroot and walnuts until well combined and well coated. Pour into heated oil, or until oil reaches 250°f for small pancakes. Garnish with cayenne pepper, or hot chili flakes if you like.

Random Ingredients: anchovy fillet,taco sauce,brown rice,green pea,mint leaf
title: Lighter Fried Rice-Taco Meal
ingredients: 1/2 cup quick-cooking brown rice | 1/4 cup green peas | 1/2 teaspoon anchovy fillet, crumbled | 1/2 cup taco sauce | 1/2 teaspoon of fresh mint leaves, minced
instructions: Put all ingredients in a 2 quart casserole dish. Bake, covered, in a preheated 375 degree f oven for 20 minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,gingersnap,bonito flake,oyster sauce,cilantro leaf,vanilla extract,pre mozzarella cheese,parsnip
title: Chinese Parsnips and Apricots
ingredients: 1 medium parsnip | 1 tart apple | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro leaves | 1/4 teaspoon ground ginger | 1/2 cup pre-shredded mozzarella cheese, divided | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | 12 gingersnaps, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon oyster sauce
instructions: Halve parsnip.

title: Crazy Roasted Italian Sweet Potatoes
ingredients: 1 lb uncooked sweet potato starch | 2 1/2 cups cold mashed potatoes starch | coffee beans, warmed until warm | oregano, to taste
instructions: In a large bowl, combine sweet potato starch, sweet potato starch and 1/2 cup cold mashed potatoes starch until dough forms. Add enough of the warmed coffee beans to cover the surface a small amount. Stir until dough comes together. Dough will be quite sticky. Turn out dough onto a floured surface, knead until dough is evenly distributed. Cut dough in half. Wrap dough in plastic wrap, set aside in refrigerator for 1 - 2 hours, depending on your fridge. Preheat oven to 425°f roll half the dough out until almost as thin as you can. Cut into 8 pieces and then shape each piece into a round or oval shaped patty, placing pats side by side on a baking sheet. Make sure that they are spaced well apart. Sprinkle about 1 tbsp. Of oregano on each patty and then spread 1/2 tbsp of sweet potato starch mixture on each patty, evenly. Sprinkle a small mound of oregano on each patty. Bake until golden brown, about 12 - 15 minutes.

title: Guiness Guinness Pizza
ingredients: 1 pizza crust | 8 ounces guinness stout | 2 cans pizza sauce with vegetables
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Set the parchment paper in the oven, and spread the pizza crust evenly using the bottom and sides to within 1/2 inch of the edge of the pan. Pour guinness and pizza sauce into a shaker. Cover, and shake until the guiness has darkened into a dark, puffy surface, 10 to 15 minutes. Arrange the pizza on top of the parchment paper, and slide the parchment paper into the center. Bake the pizza in the preheated oven until the dough has risen and turned golden brown, 10 to 15 minutes. An instant reading thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 200 degrees f. Cool slightly, and cut into wedges to serve.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,picante sauce,belgian endive,chutney,horseradish,mango chutney,beef bouillon granule,green food coloring
title: Chutney Burger with Honey-And-Hot Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon honey-and-sour chutney | 1 tablespoon chutney | 1/4 teaspoon prepared horseradish ( or to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon beef bouillon granules | 1/4 teaspoon guar gumbo green food coloring | reduced sodium beef broth, as needed | 1 dash picante sauce | 1 dash mango chutney | 1/4 teaspoon prepared horseradish | 2 belgian endive ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon green food coloring
instructions: To prepare burger, combine first 8 ingredients in a small bowl. Cover and chill 30 minutes. To prepare sauce, blend 1 ounce mole sauce, 1 ounce melba toast, 1 ounce melba toast, 1 ounce mango chutney, and 1 ounce spicy pineapple sauce in blender until smooth. Makes 1 1/2 cups. Heat grill. Add endive to grill. Brush endive with 1 teaspoon of green food coloring, then grill.

title: Scallop Dogs (Vegan Friendly)
ingredients: 5 lbs fresh scallops, cleaned | 4 tablespoons vegan worcestershire sauce ( i recommend vegan brands ) | 1/2 jalapeno, finely chopped, seeded, and finely diced ( i recommend fresh roasted jalapenos for a spicy and spicy food )
instructions: In a large bowl, add the worcestershire sauce and chopped jalapeno. Stir to mix then add the scallops. Let sit at room temperature for 1 hour. You can freeze this for later use. To use it while your dog bakes, put the scallops in a pot and cover with water. I had to cover the pot for at least an hour to help them defrost and soften up. I left mine for about an hour or so, but you got to choose yours accordingly. I had to drain a couple times, then used kitchen shears to cut off the scallops, but you could try to get away with your eating by dropping them in a pot of water for 20 minutes or so. Cooking time is only about 20 minutes or so, depending on how thick your scallops are.

title: Reubens
ingredients: 8 slices rye bread | 8 tablespoons soft fresh goat cheese
instructions: Toast rye bread and spread each slice with soft goat cheese.

title: Fiddleheads with Almonds
ingredients: 1 cup slivered almonds | 2 cups frozen dream whip ( thawed ) | 1 1/4 teaspoons almond extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees f. Spray a 9x10 baking dish or a 9x9 glass baking dish with cooking spray. Place the almonds onto a cookie sheet or cutting board. Bake toasted almond in oven until lightly browned, stirring occasionally. Cool. In a medium bowl combine sugar, dream whip and almond extract. Place the cooled almonds onto waxed paper and cool completely. When cool, cut into strips about 1/2 inch wide and 2 inches long.

title: Sauerkraut and Red Capsicum Balls
ingredients: 2 cans sauerkraut | 1 red capsicum, deseeded and cut into thin strips | 4 tablespoons parsley flakes | 1/2 teaspoon xanthan gum | 1 liter campari
instructions: Put the drained sauerkraut and capsicum strips into a food processor and add remaining ingredients, process til well mixed. If mixture seems wet, add more kraut and capsicum. Roll dough into small balls, roll between your hands into balls about the size of a walnut, put on a tray and keep somewhere cold until serving.

Random Ingredients: wheat bread,head cauliflower,maraschino cherry,cream tartar,garam masala
title: Curried Cauliflower and Bread Spread
ingredients: 2 whole wheat bread, quartered lengthwise and cut 1/2 inch thick | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala | 1 large head cauliflower, separated into flowerets | 1/2 cup maraschino cherries, halved
instructions: Preheat the oven's broiler and set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place the bread quartered lengthwise into a food processor.

title: Lazy Man Dip
ingredients: 2 cups heavy whipping cream | 1 package dry onion soup mix
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, whip cream until stiff peaks form. In an 8x8 inch baking dish, layer the cream, soup mix, and onion soup mix into the baking dish. Bake for 5 to 10 minutes in the preheated oven, until cream is absorbed. Serve immediately, or refrigerate overnight to serve cold.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin,cream,watermelon,red potato,salmon,anchovy fillet,fontina cheese,pearl barley
title: Barley Potato-Salad With Salmon
ingredients: 3 cups watermelon, chunks, juice drained | 2 tablespoons fresh cream | 2 teaspoons anchovy fillets, rinsed | 1/2 cup fontina cheese, crumbled | 1 can beef tenderloin, sliced crosswise 2/3 | 2 -3 cups pearl barley, cooked according to label directions | 2 cups thinly sliced red potatoes | 1 medium-large tenderloin, sliced 6 to 8 med. thick slices apprx 1/4 inch thick
instructions: Heat oven to 325°f degrees. Mix watermelon juice, cream, anchovies & fontina cheese in medium bowl to blend. Place salmon in 2 quart casserole. Pour marinade over salmon, spreading to coat. Top salmon with barley & potatoes. Cover casserole. Bake, basting 3 times with marinade, 1 hour or until liquid is absorbed. Season salmon with salt.

title: Kir
ingredients: 300 g spinach | 1 lamb | 1 pint grape tomatoes | 1 bottle of dry vodka
instructions: Cook the spinach and lamb in a pot. Cook until tender. Add 1 bottle of vodka with 2 tbsp of vodka. Boil on low heat for 25 minutes. Chop the spinach fine and drop it, on top of the lamb in a pot. Drain off any excess liquid. Serve with boiled potatoes and rice.

Random Ingredients: olive,apricot,chipotle chile adobo,pork shoulder,almond butter,spinach leaf,limeade concentrate
title: Chile-Apricot Pork Saute
ingredients: 2 tablespoons almond butter, divided | 1 bag fresh spinach leaves, tightly packed | 1 can chopped apricots | 2 chipotle chiles in adobo, minced, divided | 4 tablespoons fresh limeade concentrate | 1 tablespoon dried chopped fresh lime leaves | 1 pound pork shoulder, trimmed and cut into thin strips
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon almond butter in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add the torn spinach leaves just as it wilts. Drain, and place in a large bowl. Melt 1 more tablespoon almond butter and add the drained spinach mixture. Stir in the apricots, chipotle peppers, 1 tablespoon limeade concentrate and the dried lime leaves. Cook over medium heat just until the sauce begins to bubble.

title: How Do I Sprout Salad Dressing and Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup distilled white vinegar | 2 tablespoons salt and pepper, or to taste
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the vinegar and salt and pepper. Stir in the vinegar mixture. Cover and refrigerate overnight to develop the flavors.

title: Crunchy Oat Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons instant yeast, plus | 3 tablespoons oat bran | 1 1/2 teaspoons corn syrup | 1 cup rolled oats ( preferably organic ) | 1/3 - 1/2 teaspoon dried apricot preserves, for garnish | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds
instructions: Dissolve yeast and corn syrup in 1 cup of the water in a large bowl. Add remaining water, and beat vigorously with a wooden spoon or electric mixer until blended. Add remaining dry ingredients in three increments alternately, and beat until creamy. Turn onto a floured surface, and knead until soft, elastic and no longer sticky, about 10 minutes, using additional flour to get a dough that is tacky enough to be distributed. If too sticky, add a small amount of more water. Place dough in a greased pan or a 2 1/2 quart greased loaf pan, and cover loosely with a tent of a towel. Let rise in a warm spot for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Preheat oven to 415 degrees f. Bake bread in preheated oven until browned and crust is bubbly, 35 to 40 minutes, on the lowest rack of your oven. If you feel the crust is becoming too dark, cover loosely with a kitchen towel. In a small jar with tight fitting lids, combine preserves and sesame seeds. Store bread in an airtight container.

title: Chinese Beet Soup
ingredients: 3 cups thinly sliced fresh beets | 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast meat - cut into 1-inch pieces | 4 cups soy milk | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 3/4 cup chopped canned cherries, drained ( optional )
instructions: Place beets in a large saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from heat, and allow to steam dry for another 3 to 5 minutes. Rinse with cold water, and drain. Place beets and chicken in a bowl.

title: French Canadian Hamburger
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | yellow onion, diced | maple syrup
instructions: Brown hamburger in skillet with chopped onion and syrup, until no longer pink. Serve hot with french fries.

title: Beets and Strawberries
ingredients: 15 -20 small beets ( we used ones which were cut out and peeled & roasted so they would have time to cool in the fridge ) | 2 -3 large strawberries | 3 tablespoons ground harissa or 3 tablespoons hot pepper sauce | harissa ( optional ) | 1 dash vanilla | 8 ounces chickpeas ( we used `` garbanzo'instead )
instructions: Cut the beets in half, then slice the beets crosswise into thin slices, and set aside. Peel the strawberries and remove the pith. Halve them if using small ones, if using larger ones. Cut the strawberries in half again, if using larger ones. Using a vegetable peeler, remove the hulls and seeds from the strawberries, if using larger ones. Rinse the beets well and pat dry with paper towels. Cut the hulls into 4 or 5 slices each, if using smaller ones. Spread a layer of ground harissa all over them, top with a layer of sliced beets and strawberries. Top with a layer of chopped chickpeas and a sprinkling of a couple tablespoons of vanilla, if using. Repeat this process until all ingredients are used up. Place two or three large baking sheets in the oven and preheat to 350°f. Cover loosely with a tea towel if using to keep them from drying out, and bake for 2 hours. After 2 hours turn off the oven/oven, and leave the beets in there for an additional 15 minutes or until they are soft. Uncover and leave them for 5 more minutes to crisp up. Serve immediately.

title: Feta and Tomato Skewers
ingredients: 100 g feta cheese, finely crumbled | 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 1 tablespoon fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped | 4 tablespoons fresh mint or 4 tablespoons fresh cilantro, chopped
instructions: Combine the feta, vanilla sugar, and parsley. Spoon into a food processor, and process until smooth. Season with salt and pepper. Thread onto skewers, place on a tray or serving dish. Cover, and chill for at least 30 minutes before serving cold over whole grain egg noodles, or as an accompaniment for roasted vegetables.

title: Noodle and Soba Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 box soba noodles | 1 jar jalapeno peppers, finely diced
instructions: Boil soba noodles according to package directions. Rinse soba with cold water.

Random Ingredients: provolone cheese,pastry double crust pie,french bread
title: Cheese and Bread Pies
ingredients: 1 pastry for double-crust pie | 1 crust french bread, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 4 ounces provolone cheese, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Fit pie crust into a 9 pie plate. Press bread cubes into the bottom of the crust. Spoon equal amounts of provolone cheese over the bread. Layer the remaining ingredients in the pie crust with alternate layers of cheese and bread.

title: Herbal Crusted Crumbs
ingredients: 1/2 cup corn flakes ( flakes ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried herbs ( thyme or coriander, fresh or dried herbs would be perfect if you can find them ) | 2 tablespoons orange juice, freshly squeezed
instructions: Place cornflakes in a mixing bowl. Add herbs and orange juice. Mix thoroughly. Pour onto a baking tray or a well greased paper lined tray. Roll into 1 inch balls.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,graham cracker crumb,squash,white rice,lemon juice,green chili pepper,radish
title: Spicy Squash With Brown rice(Cooking Light)
ingredients: 1 small squash, halved lengthwise, seeds removed, broiled | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 cup white rice, prepared ( long-grain brown rice will also work ) | 1 teaspoon grated lemon juice | 1/2 cup radish, thinly sliced ( optional ) | 1/2 cup minced green chili pepper | 1/4 teaspoon chopped fresh dill or 1/2 teaspoon dried dill weed
instructions: Preheat broiler. Place squash on a foil lined baking sheet, broil 3 to 4 inches from heat until just turning brown, about 5 minutes. Flip squash slices over, broil 2 to 3 minutes or until just beginning to turn pale golden. Place rice on large platter. Sprinkle squash with lemon juice. Combine all remaining ingredients in a small saucepan.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,baking potato,pesto sauce,pancetta bacon,creme fraiche,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Crispy Potato Poutine With Pancetta
ingredients: 2 large baking potatoes, scrubbed ( about 3 pounds in all ) | 8 slices pancetta bacon or 8 slices bacon fat | 1 -2 tablespoon crème fraiche ( to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon pesto sauce ( to taste ) | 4 -6 tablespoons freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 small fresh long red chili pepper, finely chopped
instructions: Cut a large enough lengthwise slit lengthwise across potato lengthwise to be able to remove most of the potato's membrane. Carefully pull slices of potato back to the cut side of potato to form a rectangle about 5x3 inches in size. Repeat with all slices and allow slices to be cut perpendicular to overlapping each other to help them stay together, making sure that they stay together without falling apart. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil over high heat. While waiting for the water to boil, fry the bacon slices until crisp and cooked but not crisp. You should have about 2 cups of bacon grease, but add more if necessary. Drain on paper towels then crumble bacon into small pieces. When the water is boiling, drop potatoes into the water. As soon as potatoes are softened, remove potatoes to a large bowl of ice water to halt cooking process. Drain, and then return potatoes to potato bowl. Add the crème fraîche, pesto and parmigiano reggiano. Stir to blend. Taste and add more pesto if you feel it has the texture of sour cream. Taste and adjust seasonings to taste. Spoon the potato mixture onto a serving platter. Sprinkle with chile and serve with warm cornstarch or cold beer. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cashew,sun tomato oil,italian seasoning,pepperoncini pepper,serrano chili pepper,sofrito sauce,sauce
title: Sarasota's Super Simple Authentic Cashew Nuts
ingredients: 1 jar roasted cashews ( packed in cashew syrup, drained, and finely chopped ) | 1 cup chopped fresh sun-dried tomato packed in oil, finely chopped | 1 -2 serrano chili pepper, finely minced | 3 -4 tablespoons sofrito sauce ( add more if preferred ) | 2 -3 tablespoons hot sauce ( optional, but highly recommend ) ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon minced hot pepperoncini pepper ( optional )
instructions: Place cashews in pan of boiling water and cook until just slightly tender. Drain and set aside. In a small bowl mix all the remaining sauce ingredients together. Pour in a little of the cashew oil from the jar and mix until you can no longer see the garlic or anything sticking. Pour into a small serving dish and set aside. Place remaining 1/2 cup warm cashew water in a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil and stir in remaining ingredients. Simmer on low heat for about 5 minutes, stirring constantly, to cook the flavors all the way through. Spoon over cooked cashews and serve.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,oyster sauce,dark rum,pork shoulder,black pepper,pinto bean
title: Big John's Pork and Beans
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dark rum | freshly ground black pepper to taste | 3 tablespoons oyster sauce | 2 pounds boneless pork shoulder, cut into 3/4-inch cubes | 2 cups frozen small button mushrooms | 1 can pinto beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Mix the rum, pepper, oyster sauce, and pork in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook until the pork is just about halfway cooked, 1 to 2 minutes per side. Stir together the mushrooms and pinto beans, and serve over the pork.

Random Ingredients: brandy,shaoxing wine,vegetable oil cooking spray,cherry,oregano leaf,tomato,onion,beef
title: Quick and Easy Kefta
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 1 large onion, chopped | 1 tablespoon canola oil or 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons shaoxing wine | 1 1/2 tablespoons dry oregano leaves | 1 large tomatoes, cut in wedges ( or 2-3 grape tomatoes ) | 1/3 cup cherries ( optional ) or 1/3 cup grape tomatoes ( optional ) | 1/4 cup brandy ( optional )
instructions: Mix together all ingredients and make into small meatballs or balls. Put on a tray, cover and chill overnight. Cook on a hot dry pan or griddle until done. If you like to serve kaftas, slice them and toss with your favourite sauce.

title: Tasty Couscous
ingredients: 1 cup couscous | 1 1/2 cups half-and-half cream
instructions: In a small saucepan, bring the half and half and sour cream to a boil. Pour the couscous into a colander and place it in the hot cream. When the rice begins to swell, remove it from the heat and allow to stand for 2 minutes. Fluff the rice again and top with sour cream.

title: Low Calorie Low Cal - Chicken and Potato
ingredients: 400 g chicken breasts | 500 g heirloom tomatoes ( washed and patted dry or similar product of your choice ) | 200 g parsnips ( washed carefully to remove all the starch ) | 250 g split white heirloom tomatoes ( washed and patted dry and patted dry or similar product of your choice ) | 3 spring onions ( thinly sliced and green part chopped ) | 400 g kidney beans ( tinned or cooked, drained and rinsed )
instructions: Slice the tomatoes in wedges then slice diagonally into halves. Peel and halve the parsnips then slice diagonally into slices about 1/4. Wash and pierce the chicken in several places with a fork. Place the chicken, tomatoes, parsnips, heirloom tomatoes onto a large platter or small individual serving bowls and set aside. Sprinkle spring onions or green onions on top. If using packaged heirloom tomatoes, preferably in a jar or resealable container. Wash the kidney beans in water to separate. If using canned tomatoes, place on the table. Bake chicken and tomato mixture in a medium oven on 180 degrees c for 30 - 45 minutes. Serve cooked chicken and tomato mixture on top of rice, topped with a few heirloom tomatoes and fresh parsley to taste.

Random Ingredients: white mushroom,bay leaf,pecan half,sumaq,bread,dijon mustard,ice cream,fennel seed
title: Mushrooms With Toasted Pecans
ingredients: 1/2 cup pecan halves ( unpeeled ) | 1 1/2 cups stale bread, chopped | 2 large white mushrooms | 6 teaspoons dijon mustard | 3/4 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 bay leaf | ice cream ( optional ) | sumaq ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f remove stems from mushrooms and cut each caps lengthwise into 1/4 inch slices. Place bread in a large bowl and cover with boiling water.

title: Lentil & Bean Sprouts
ingredients: 100 g brown lentils | 2 tablespoons brown beans sprouts | 1 teaspoon garam masala powder | 1 tablespoon light cream
instructions: Rinse lentils & soak for 2 hours. Drain, then cook gently in a pan with some of the water still covering the lentils. Meanwhile, cook the sprouts in a little water till tender. Drain of any water when cooked and keep aside. Heat butter in a skillet then add onions & fry till they change colour. Add garam masala powder & stir for a minute or two. Add sprouts, lentils, cream & cook, mixing well till the mixture dries up. Sprinkle with cashew nuts if using that's how you like it.

title: Honey Mango Salad
ingredients: 2 fresh ripe mangoes, peeled and chopped | 1/3 cup orange juice | 2 teaspoons honey | 1 dash dried marjoram ( optional )
instructions: Combine the mango, orange juice, honey, and marjoram in a bowl. Cover and chill until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,lime juice,white fish fillet
title: Cod & Coriander Flatbread
ingredients: 400 g white fish fillets | 2 tablespoons self-raising flour | 3 tablespoons lime juice ( juice of 1/2 limes ) | 3 tablespoons coriander ( leaves of 5 corns )
instructions: Place fish in a food processor and blend until fine, but not smooth. Add flour. Process until mixture forms a ball. Add 1 tbsp lime juice. Turn dough onto a lightly floured surface. Knead gently to form a smooth ball. Divide dough in half and shape into a round about 20cm by 5cm. Place on an oiled baking tray and flatten out. Brush with remaining lime juice. Bake in a medium oven until golden brown approx 25 minutes. Stand 5 minutes then cut into soldiers. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: orzo pasta,lime,couscous,polish sausage,red bell pepper,french bread,food coloring
title: Paella Salad
ingredients: 1/3 cup instant couscous | 1/3 cup country-style orzo pasta ( orzo ) | 1 tablespoon food coloring | 2 small red bell peppers | 1 small polskiy sausage ( or to taste ) | 2 small limes | 1 tablespoon french bread or 1 tablespoon other breadcrumbs
instructions: Cook couscous according to package directions and set aside. Cut peppers into strips about 1/4 inch width. Slice sausage and toss with couscous. Add 1 tablespoon water and food coloring into skillet and heat to boiling. Stir often until water is all absorbed and syrupy. Toss with cooked couscous and pepper strips. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon bread crumbs. Serve warm.

title: Smokin' Plastic
ingredients: 1 small pears or 2 pears, cored and chopped | 1 turkey breast, cooked and finely diced | 1 tablespoon adobo sauce | 1 cup instant polenta, crumbled
instructions: Set oven on broiler setting. In a 1 qt baking dish, mix together pears, turkey, 1 tablespoon of the adobo sauce, and crumbled polenta. Toss lightly in the pan to coat. Spoon into a bowl. Put the remaining 1 tablespoon of adobo sauce on top. Place baking dish and rack in oven. Broil for 12 minutes or until bottoms are golden brown.

title: Halloumi Queso Dip
ingredients: 1 halloumi cheese, cut into 8 slices | mayonnaise ( optional ) | queso fresco ( optional ) | 1 dried red chile ( optional ) | 1 dash curry powder ( optional )
instructions: Place the halloumi slices on plates, top with desired toppings. This is especially tasty with a green salad.

title: Miso Lamb Meat
ingredients: 4 ounces of dried australian lamb | 14 ounces sour cream or 14 ounces light sour cream | 3 ounces caster sugar | 3 ounces ling miso | 1 1/2 teaspoons cream of tartar
instructions: Soak lamb and blood for 2 hours drain then use to remove gizzards. Place meat in a greased shallow ovenproof dish with sour cream and sugar. Mix well and set in a warm place for 1 hour. Turn oven to 325°f and bake for 1 1/2 hours, basting once or twice whilst cooking. Serve with rice and beans.

Random Ingredients: pork tenderloin,black pepper,kosher salt pepper,fennel powder
title: Fennel Loin Sandwich
ingredients: 1 tablespoon fennel powder, or to taste | kosher salt and pepper to taste | 1 pound pork tenderloin, cut into narrow slices | 1 pinch freshly ground black pepper, or to taste
instructions: Mix fennel powder with 1 tablespoon kosher salt and pepper in a shallow bowl. Brush pork with fennel powder mixture. Sprinkle evenly with black pepper. Let sit 1 to 2 minutes before frying. Lightly oil a skillet for frying.

title: Chili Pepper Sauce
ingredients: 4 -6 ounces unsweetened applesauce | 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium sized bowl, stir well. Cover and refrigerate until needed for best results.

title: Lite-Baked Limerick Steak Sandwich
ingredients: 12 slices rye bread, toasted | 1/2 cup low-fat beef sirloin, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley | 2 tablespoons dark rum | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley, for garnish
instructions: Place the sliced beef on one slice of toasted rye bread, then top with the sauteed beef. Sprinkle with chopped parsley and rum. Garnish with fresh parsley.

title: Finnish Flat bread with Caramelized Carrots
ingredients: 1/4 cup light cream | 1/4 cup light sour cream | 1/4 teaspoon fenugreek seeds | 1 cup shredded carrot ( about 2 large ) | 8 thin slices rye bread
instructions: Preheat a grill or frying pan to high. In a small bowl, stir together the cream, sour cream and fenugreek seeks. Set aside. Divide the carrot among 4 slices of bread. Place another slice, brushed side down, on top of the cream mixture, and press lightly with your fingers to flatten slightly.

title: Pecan and Scallops
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1 1/2 tablespoons vinegar | 2 tablespoons grated pecans | 18 whole bay scallops, cleaned | 1 lb fresh button mushrooms
instructions: Mix all ingredients except mushrooms in shallow dish or bowl, making sure you don't mash the mushrooms. Beware, if you are using larger mushrooms, leave a little bit of the liquid. Add mushrooms and refrigerate several hours or overnight.. Before serving, remove scallops from the marinade and arrange on a serving plate. Spoon marinade over and serve.

title: Lite Veal or Tofu
ingredients: 1 pound veal, cut into serving size pieces | 4 shallots
instructions: Preheat the oven broiler to 500 degrees f. Arrange the veal pieces in a layer on a baking sheet. Broil the meat over medium heat until browned. Sprinkle with shallots, cover, and continue broiling until the shallots have softened, about 3 to 5 more minutes.

title: Fudgy Mexican Sandwich
ingredients: 2 -4 slices ham | 5 -6 lettuce | chocolate curl | green chili pepper | butter | shredded cheese
instructions: Take the ham slices and lightly coat them with melted butter. Cut the lettuce into 1/2 inch pieces. Remove the lettuce strings and cut them up into small pieces. Fill in to the center of the ham slices evenly. Top with a generous pinch of chocolate curl, followed by a small chile. Dip your finger in melted butter to wet the bread. Heat in a sandwich bun, or if it's not to your liking serve on a plate. Top it with shredded cheese, if you like.

title: Solo Veal Rolls
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs veal | 1/2 cup green bell pepper | 2 teaspoons adobo seasoning | 1/2 cup limoncello | 1/2 cup golden raisin
instructions: Thaw out freezer rolls in fridge. Use scissors to cut rolls in half lengthwise. Remove meat from freezer and roll each half over rolling pin to remove excess air. Put roll flat side down on cutting board. Cut a slit on top of each roll. Slice veal into 1 inch slices, lengthwise. Slice bell peppers in 1 inch strips. Heat up your saffron thread over medium heat. When warm, pour into saffron and let simmer for 20 minutes. Add the limoncello and pepper and let simmer for 10 more minutes. Add the raisins or currants. Remove from heat. Cover your cutting board and let cool down on counter. Remove meat and vegetables from the card and discard marinade. Stuff with a dozen or more veal rolls. Sauté the meat in a drippings over high heat, rolling the meat around to brown all sides. Add the rest of the vegetables and stir. Let the vegetables cook until just cooked through. Serve with white rice or potatoes and a nice hot green salad.

title: Quickie Casserole
ingredients: 2 cans cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 8 ounces egg noodles, uncooked | 2 stalks celery, cut into chunks ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Place the drained cannellini beans into a medium saucepan and pour in enough water to cover. Bring to a boil and simmer over medium heat until tender, about 10 minutes. Drain, saving about 2 cups broth. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Spray a large casserole dish with cooking spray. Cook the noodles in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until tender but firm to the bite, about 5 minutes. Drain, rinse under cold water and drain again. Scoop the noodles and bean mixture into the cooked casserole and top with celery chunks if desired. Cover and bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes. Remove and keep warm in the oven for 5 minutes so that the casserole will be hot and flavorful.

title: Nan's Grilled Cheese With Crushed Fruits
ingredients: 150 g fontina cheese ( grated ) | 300 g small pitted walnuts | 2 spring onions ( finely sliced ) | salt & pepper ( to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder ( optional ) or 1/2 teaspoon black mustard ( optional )
instructions: Sprinkle cheese with salt & pepper. Spread with mustard/nut mixture and then decorate with spring onion slices. Grill until golden brown.

title: Irish Tip
ingredients: 4 ounces fruit, cubes | 2 fluid ounces sweet juice | 2 tablespoons grenadine | 1/2 cup irish cream | 2 -3 dried red chili peppers | 1 teaspoon sweet basil or 1 teaspoon dried oregano
instructions: Pour all the ingredients into a small, nonstick sauce pan. Simmer, covered, on low heat for at least 2 hours. When ready to serve, stir well.

title: Nave's Linguine With Fresh Strawberries and Tomatoes
ingredients: 8 ounces linguine | 1 lb strawberries, hulled and halved | 1 package yeast | 2/3 cup plum tomato ketchup | 2 4 cups heavy cream ( or double if you can ) | 2 tablespoons potato starch or 2 tablespoons arrowroot | 7 ounces tuna in water, drained and flaked | 8 ounces linguine, cooked and drained to save the water
instructions: Dry fry your yeast in 1/4 cup of a warm water for a few minutes. Stir it in, and set aside. In a large bowl, combine the tomatoes, ketchup, cream, potato starch, and arrowroot. Stir in 1/3 cup water, and set aside. Cook your noodles in a large pot of boiling water with about 1/2 tsp salt, until you prefer a softer noodle with a little more chew. Drain in a colander, and run under warm water. Cook your pasta in the rest of the water according to the package directions. Serve the linguine in warm bowls. Top with sauce.

title: Tiger's Kebbles
ingredients: 5 walnuts, finely chopped | lemon wedge
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c. Line a baking tray with baking paper and place nuts in a bowl. Place 1 teaspoon of walnut mix in centre of nuts and roll in lemon wedge.

title: Aphrodisiac Appetizer
ingredients: 1 package farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 1 1/2 cups ricotta cheese | 1/4 cup grand marnier | 1/8 apple - peeled, cored, and cut into chunks | 1 bag fresh asparagus, trimmed | 1 1/2 cups rum
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook bow tie pasta at a boil, stirring occasionally, until cooked through yet firm to the bite, 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Curried White Beans
ingredients: 1 lb white onion | 1 1/2 cups mccormick's montreal brand steak seasoning | 1 1/2 teaspoons curry powder | 1 can cannellini beans, drained | 3/4 cup quick-cooking recaito
instructions: Cut off most of the onion except the stem. Set a deep pot of water over high heat and bring to a boil. Add onions and cook, stirring occasionally, until the onions are translucent, about 15 minutes. Remove from heat, cover, and set aside. In a small bowl, combine steak seasoning and curry powder. Using an iron skillet, cook steak over medium high heat in the seasoning mixture. The meat should be browned evenly. Turn off heat, cover and let sit for 5 minutes. Stir beans, recaito, half the cooked onions and the remaining steak in a large serving bowl.

Random Ingredients: spanish onion,yellow bell pepper,superfine sugar,active yeast,romano cheese,brown sugar
title: Roasted Bell Peppers With Caramelized Onions
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups yellow bell peppers, seeded, cut into 1/4 `` strips | 1 large spanish onion, halved, thinly sliced 1/4 inch thick | 1/3 cup superfine sugar | 2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 cup light brown sugar or 1 cup white sugar | 4 tablespoons superfine sugar | 1/2 cup freshly grated romano cheese
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the bell pepper strips, onion slices, superfine sugar, and yeast. Let sit for 45 minutes to ferment. In a large saucepan, combine the brown sugar, 4 tablespoons superfine sugar, and 2 tablespoons sugar. Stir until well blended and bubbly. Transfer hot caramelized onion mixture to a stainless steel bowl fitted with a dough hook and stir until dissolved. Remove bowl with dough, knead on the counter a few times for 3 - 4 minutes, until the mixture becomes smooth and elastic. Transfer dough to a floured surface and roll with a well floured rolling pin until very thin, using a 2 to 3 inch round cookie cutter. Transfer dough into an oiled bowl, cover with plastic wrap and let rise for 1 1/4 hours, until doubled in volume. Preheat oven to 425°f in the bowl of a food processor fitted with a medium blade or by hand, carefully add the caramelized onions and pulse until evenly coated and sticky. Transfer to a 9 by 13 inch glass baking dish or a large glass dish. Sprinkle with the cheese and bake in a 425°f oven for 20 minutes, until the topping is crisp and golden and bubbly. Let stand for 5 minutes before cutting into wedges.

title: Chinese Green Paste
ingredients: 8 fresh green chilies, seeded and chopped | 1/2 cup apple cider or 1/2 cup soy sauce | 1/2 cup chopped chives
instructions: Place all ingredients in small, heavy non reactive skillet. Heat to boiling.

title: Simple and Delicious British Columbian Margaritas
ingredients: 6 -12 ice, ice cubes, or as needed, to fill glasses ( optional ) | 2 1/2 tablespoons dark brown sugar
instructions: Fill a tall glass with ice, or as desired. Pour about 1/4 cup of brown sugar in the glass and top off the ice with a spoonful of ice. Pour the remaining brown sugar around the lip of the glass, and tap the rim of the glass. The ice should slide right onto the top into your mug, without actually swirling. The sugar will float to the top of the glass, and you will appreciate your drinking.

title: Kolayha Drink
ingredients: 1/4 cup orange juice ( including juice from oranges ) | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder or 1 pinch hing | 1/3 cup vanilla yogurt ( sour cream or other flavor ) | 1 pimento ( optional ) | 1 pimento sandwich bun
instructions: Put all of the ingredients into a blender. Blend until you have a smooth puree. Put mixture into containers, cover and let it chill in the refrigerator. To serve, put on individual servings and garnish with pimentos or coriander.

title: Broccoli, Raisin and Nuts
ingredients: 1 large broccoli | 1/4 cup kaffir lime leaf ( fresh lime leaves, 2 per potato ) | 2 tablespoons roasted blanched almonds, chopped | 1/2 cup chopped fresh cilantro | 1/4 cup desiccated coconut or 1/4 cup dried raisins | 1/4 cup diced dried fruit
instructions: Break off the thick stems from the broccoli, then cut it into 2 inch florets. In a large pan over medium heat, combine the kaffir lime leaves with the boiling, salted water. Place the broccoli in the hot water and cook until the blanched almond begins to soften, about 3 minutes. Remove from the pan and let stand for about 5 minutes. Drain. Wash the florets. Dice the remaining potato. In an oven proof skillet over medium heat, toast the almonds until golden, about 10 minutes. Remove from the heat. Spread the broccoli between two pieces of waxed paper or plastic wrap on a baking sheet and spread with the coconut/raisin mixture. Top with the raisins and candied almonds and bake in a 350 degree f oven for about 20 minutes or until heated through.

title: Lamb and Goat Cheese Stew
ingredients: 1 teaspoon chili flakes | 600 g lamb, cubed | 1 1/2 kg veal, cubed | 300 g chicken thighs | 150 g potatoes, cubed | 4 serrano chilies, chopped | 1 teaspoon pecorino cheese, grated | 2 cans rotel
instructions: Season with salt and pepper, and roast with a splash of olive oil for an hour at 180 degree celsius. Remove from oven, and turn into an oven proof dish. Put the lamb cubes, chillies, potatoes, chile flakes, veal cubes and pepper in an oven pot, and roast over a low heat for 2 hours adding the rotel. Serve with a crusty bread.

title: Mexican Broccoli Wrap
ingredients: 1/2 - 1 cup fresh broccoli | 1/2 - 1 cup frozen broccoli, thawed and slaw drained well | 2 tablespoons soya sauce | 1 deli sliced provolone cheese | 6 -8 slices of your favorite whole wheat roll ( see description, you may use your favorite roll-up ) | 3 -4 slices low fat fresh bread ( i use whole wheat )
instructions: Preheat oven. Line a cookie sheet with parchment paper or aluminum foil. Rinse and drain your broccoli. Chop it up in a food processor. Pour the soya sauce into a saucepan and stir over medium heat. Do not bring to a boil. Remove about 1/4 cup of the sauce mixture, and set aside. Stir broccoli into remaining 1/2 cup mixture. Toss it with the soya broccoli sauce and microwave for about 1 minute, or until it just starts to melt. Remove from microwave and pour into a shallow serving dish, or place in a baking dish. Cover loosely with the plastic wrap. Put in the oven and bake for about 15 to 20 minutes, or until heated through. Unwrap and put on a cutting board or platter and top with the provolone cheese slices. Wrap it up with your favorite roll, and serve hot.

title: Spiced Yogurt With Bulgur Wheat
ingredients: 1/4 cup bulgar wheat | 1/4 cup yoghurt | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 1 1/4 cups white flour
instructions: Soak bulgur overnight. Drain and squeeze out excess water using a fine sieve. Whip bulgur and yoghurt with red curry paste to blend and then add flour, mix well. Pour into lined, non stick tray bake in oven at 180c for 20 minutes, serve with indian pickle.

title: Quick Faux Couscous for One!
ingredients: 1 cup couscous | 1 lb ground veal
instructions: Combine couscous and ground veal together. Mix well and place in a bowl or covered container. This does not cook the meat. You may need to cook the meat at this point, because the couscous is very sticky. When you put this in the container, the couscous will be sticky, which takes the longest to prepare to your liking.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper,sherry,brown lentil,gruyere cheese,marinara sauce,white fish fillet
title: Lemon and Cheese Dippers With Dried Whitefish
ingredients: 200 g dried brown lentils | 200 g white fish fillets, skin on | 1 cup marinara sauce | 1/3 cup dry sherry | 50 g gruyere cheese, shredded | 1 small jalapeno pepper, seeded and finely sliced
instructions: Place the lentils in a large saucepan with cold water to cover. Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat and simmer until tender. Drain. Cool slightly and cut the fish fillets into 3mm pieces. Divide the lentils among 4 dinner plates. Place the fish in the centre of the lentils. Top with the marinara sauce, spreading evenly. Sprinkle with the sherry. Mix the cheese with the jalapeno pepper in a small bowl, then sprinkle over the cheese. Carefully remove the toothpicks from the fish. Spoon the cheese mixture on top of the fish. Serve with hot freshly cooked pasta.

Random Ingredients: caster sugar,vegetable oil cooking spray,tamari,black peppercorn,beef tenderloin,extra virgin olive oil
title: Tamari Beef Fillet (Beef Fillet With Tamari)
ingredients: 600 g beef tenderloin, sliced into 6 equal portions | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 cup tamari | 1 1/2 teaspoons caster sugar | 1 1/4 teaspoons whole black peppercorns | 1 1/3 cups extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c. Spray the beef fillets with oil on both sides and arrange in a single layer in a shallow roasting tin. Combine the tamari, sugar, peppercorns, 2/3 cup of the olive oil and 1/2 cup cold water in a screw top jar and shake until blended. Spoon over the beef and smooth the top with the back of a spoon. Make air holes across the top with a sharp knife. The beef should now have a well defined star shape with a criss cross pattern and all the air space should be left behind. Drizzle with the remaining 1/3 cup of olive oil and place the oven in the centre of the oven. Cook the beef for 15 - 20 minutes or until cooked to your liking. Serve with the tamari sauce, steamed vegetables, sliced red onion.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,tomato green chile pepper,mint,bouquet garni,flat leaf italian parsley
title: Spanish Style Salsa
ingredients: 2 cans diced tomatoes with green chile peppers | 2 cans diced tomatoes with chilies, drained | 1 bouquet garni | 1 bunch flat-leaf italian parsley, minced | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh mint
instructions: Stir diced tomatoes with chilies, diced tomatoes with green chilies, bouquet garni, and parsley together in a large, heavy skillet over medium heat.

title: Salt-Free Anise Chips
ingredients: 3 tablespoons old bay seasoning or 3 tablespoons old bay seasoning | 3 tablespoons anise seeds
instructions: Preheat the oven broiler with the rack 4 inches from the heat. When the oven door is almost completely open, spray two baking sheets with non stick cooking spray and scatter anise seeds on the bottoms. Arrange the chips on the baking sheets. Bake at 425 degrees f for 15 - 20 minutes, until the edges are very dark. The chip should be soft and lightly coloured. Allow the to cool and harden on the baking sheets before transferring to a wire rack.

title: Sour Raisins and Chipotle Puffs
ingredients: 12 ounces unbleached white flour | 3 ounces golden raisins | 3 1/2 teaspoons chipotle powder
instructions: Sift flour into a bowl. Add raisins and chipotle and mix together. Place on an ungreased cookie sheet and flatten slightly with a fork. Cook in a moderate oven 12 minutes. Place on rack and cool.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,cream cheese,italian parsley,wasabi paste,plum tomato,hot red chili pepper
title: Cold Sushi Rolls
ingredients: 1/4 lb cream cheese | 2 tablespoons finely chopped italian parsley | 1 dash chili powder | 1 dash hot red chili pepper | 1 teaspoon wasabi paste, mixed with | 1 small plum tomato
instructions: Soften the cream cheese in the microwave for approximately 30 seconds. Add remaining seasonings, mixing well. Cut the plum tomato in half, remove seeds and pulp. Fill with this blend and roll the chilled rolls. When serving, spread wasabi paste on the outside of roll. You may also serve with nori or other vegetables.

Random Ingredients: chili flake,potato starch,red chile pepper,filling,beef chuck roast,peach
title: Sweet Potato Beef Empanados
ingredients: filling : | 2 cans sliced potatoes with potato starch | 2 pounds ground beef chuck roast | 1/8 teaspoon chili flakes | 2 cans sliced ripe peaches, drained | 1/4 cup chili flakes, or to taste
instructions: Place the potatoes, beef, 1/8 teaspoon chili flakes, and peach pits in a pressure cooker. Pour the water into the cooker, and secure lid. Select the sweet potato/peach setting. Once the pressure indicator reaches 220 degrees f, steam will release naturally. Carefully open the lid, and press the sweet potato/peach filling into the top. Remove from the pressure cooker, and allow to cool to room temperature before removing the lid.

Random Ingredients: lime juice zest,double cream,ginger,spring onion,pecorino romano cheese
title: Lime Peppercorn  and Ginger Raita
ingredients: 350 ml double cream | 3 spring onions, chopped | fresh ginger, sliced | 1 lime, juice and zest of | 150 g of grated pecorino romano cheese
instructions: In the bowl of a food processor put the cream and the spring onions, ginger, lime zest and juice. Blend them on high speed until they become a smooth paste. Pour into a glass bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate overnight. Turn the bowl occasionally in your fridge to stop the sauce sliding off the bowl. When ready to serve, cut the rind of the lemons into strips. Stir the rinds into the cream. Serve with salad leaves or with sliced red chilli and basil or as suggested by some nice fresh basil leaves.

title: Mandarin Bacon Potato Salad
ingredients: 3 slices bacon, cooked until crisp | 2 medium sweet potatoes, peeled and diced | 1 can mandarin oranges, drained
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp. Drain bacon on paper towel, crumble and set aside. Place bacon in a large bowl. Place sweet potatoes in a large bowl. Drain oranges well, reserving juice. Add oranges to bowl. Toss together and add bacon, and mix until bacon is coated. Serve.

title: Blueberry Tuna Steaks
ingredients: 6 tuna steaks | 2 tablespoons chocolate chips | 1 cup blueberries ( fresh or frozen )
instructions: Melt chocolate in a microwave and spread on both sides the tuna steaks have to be covered. Sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cup blueberries. Place in refrigerator until serving time. Serve on a plate with your favourite side salad and lots of crackers.

title: Sweet Sticky Baking Macaroons
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast | 3/4 cup soymilk ( lukewarm ) | 1/2 cup dried pineapple, chopped ( not canned ) | 4 cups cake flour | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1/4 cup mushroom, chopped | 1/4 cup pineapple, chopped ( in jar ) | 1/4 cup sweetened soymilk ( lukewarm ) | sliced pancake or cooked macaroons
instructions: Combine yeast and 1/4 c. Of the milk in a large bowl. Add remaining milk, pineapple, and flour and beat in with a spoon so that the dough is well mixed. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead until smooth and elastic. Place in a well oiled bowl, cover with towel, and set aside in a warm place until doubled, about 45 - 60 minutes. Meanwhile, sift baking powder into a small bowl. Add remaining marinade ingredients and mix until thickened. Place dough on lightly floured surface and roll out until 3/4 inch thick. Using a cookie cutter, cut each macaroon into 8 rings. Arrange rings on a lightly greased baking sheet, cover, and allow to rest for 10 minutes. Preheat oven to brush top of macaroons with olive oil and sprinkle with paprika. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm with your favorite sauce.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,splenda sugar substitute,cottage cheese,phyllo pastry,beef roast
title: Moroccan Beef Strudels
ingredients: 1 bag phyllo pastry sheets ( i recommend the trader joe's brand ) | 1 lb boneless beef roast ( i buy the cut in strips at trader joe's ) | 1/4 cup low fat tiny cottage cheese | 1/2 cup splenda sugar substitute, mixed with | 3 teaspoons splenda sugar substitute | 2 cardamom pods ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Mix all ingredients except pastry in crockpot. Place beef and mix well, making sure the beef is coated. Place in oven for about 20 - 25 minutes or until beef is cooked and juices drain. Allow to cool slightly, then slice into thin strips if desired. To freeze, put on plastic wrap and place in freezer bags. To keep for later use, defrost and microwave on high for a few minutes or just reheat. Note, i usually microwave this in the skillet or oven on low, just to reheat and make it easier to handle. You can cook it right away as the broth is not as strong.

title: Greek Pasta Salad
ingredients: 10 ounces angel hair pasta | 3 ounces pasta ( your fav. angel hair ) | 1 english cucumber, cut in half, seeded and sliced | 1 lb chicken, cubed ( i use chicken breast and thigh pieces ) | 1 pint cherry tomatoes or 1 pint grape tomatoes
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. When pasta is done, rinse well and drain. Add cucumber and chicken to pasta. Chill for a couple hours to blend flavors. Add tomatoes at the last minute before serving.

title: The Greatest Bread Crumb Ever
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups dried fusilli ( about 1 pound uncooked pasta ) | 1 tablespoon xanthan gum | 2 slices loaf italian bread, cut diagonally into 1/4 inch slices
instructions: Cover and refrigerate pasta and bread.

title: French Canadian
ingredients: 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon dark rum
instructions: Combine all ingredients and pour over hot steaks.

title: My New Favorite Chicken & Pasta Dinner
ingredients: 12 ounces elbow macaroni | 3 lbs chicken tenders | 1 1/2 lbs butternut squash, cut into 1 inch cubes ( i like the zucchini best ) | 5 -8 ounces uncooked wagon wheel macaroni, i used whole wheat
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Cook elbow macaroni and snap into pieces, bring a large pot of water to a boil then add the pasta to the boiling water. When noodles are cooked, drain and rinse with cold water and set aside. Cook butternut squash in microwave for about 6 - 7 minutes, you can leave the skin on the squash. Add cubed squash and pasta to pasta, toss together. You may want to keep a little extra pasta cooking to add to your dish when you serve the dish. It will cook fast for those of you that like a little sweetness in your dish. Serve with a tossed salad and crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: chocolate syrup,red chilies,vegetable,tuna,green enchilada sauce,beef base,seasoning salt,cherry
title: Quick Beef & Mole Stir Fry With Coconut and Green Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 14 ounces tuna, drained | 1 can green enchilada sauce | 1/3 cup chocolate syrup | 3 -5 red chilies | 1 1/2 tablespoons beef base | 8 ounces mixed vegetables ( frozen, fresh, frozen chopped or canned ) | 2 cups cherries ( cut in half or quarters ) | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: Cut tuna in small pieces.

title: Steamed Thai Green Beans
ingredients: 3 bags fresh green beans | 8 fresh thai chiles
instructions: Fill a steamer with water about 2 inches deep and bring to a boil. Steam the green beans until they are bright green and slightly tender, 7 to 10 minutes. Rinse with cold water and transfer to a sieve lined with plastic wrap to drain. Place a steamer basket on the sink or bowl of a food processor. Bring 1 inch water to a boil in a pot. Add the green beans and chiles to the water. Cover, reduce the heat to medium low, and steam the beans in the steamer until tender and slightly crunchy, about 5 minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: provolone cheese,radish,monterey jack cheese,white breadcrumb,wooden skewer
title: Baked Radishes With Provolone
ingredients: 20 wooden skewers, soaked | 20 slices white breadcrumbs ( for dipping ) | 16 slices provolone cheese ( thin slices ) | 16 leaves radishes, small ( for garnish ) | 4 ounces monterey jack cheese ( shredded )
instructions: Soak the skewers in very cold water to cover for 20 - 30 minutes. Cut the bread slices into long strips lengthwise, so the strips are about 2 1/2 inches long, but not all of their width. Dip the bread sticks in a bowl of cold water, and then coat with the bread crumbs. On the skewer, lay a strip of provolone cheese inside each radish mound about a quarter inch thick and about 1/2 inch in width. Place the radishes in the bowl with salt, and sprinkle with the shredded cheese. Coat the radishes with the bread crumbs. Spray the exposed surfaces of the skewers with pam cooking spray. Place on a rack in a broiler pan, and broil for 2 minutes until cheese is bubbly and lightly browned. Watch closely to avoid burning. Remove from the hot broiler, and serve hot.

title: Red Wine Fennel Filling for Pasta
ingredients: 2 tablespoons fennel seeds | 1 1/4 cups red wine | 1 tablespoon potato starch | 1 dash ground nutmeg
instructions: Bring the sugar and wine to a boil over medium heat, then reduce heat to a simmer until reduced by about 2/3. Add the fennel seeds, potato flour, and nutmeg, stirring to combine. Remove from heat and cool to room temperature.

Random Ingredients: crumpet,veal,italian salad dressing mix,half,pork,hot italian sausage,italian parsley,tomato puree
title: Swiss Rolled Meatballs With Tomato Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground veal | 1/2 lb ground pork | 2 tablespoons canned tomato puree | 1 teaspoon dried italian salad dressing mix | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh italian parsley | hot italian sausage, casings removed, crumbled | 1/4 cup whole fat half-and-half | 1 tablespoon chopped italian parsley
instructions: Mix together veal ground pork, tomato puree, salad dressing mix, and italian parsley. Shape into 4 meatballs. Combine sausage and hot italian sausage and shape into a ball. Add half and half to the tomato cream sauce and simmer while meatballs are cooking 20 to 30 minutes, until meatballs are cooked through. Sprinkle tops of meatballs with italian parsley and serve with a fresh loaf of country bread.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,cornstarch,romaine lettuce,cayenne pepper,almond,chili pepper flake,hamburger
title: Almond Beef Wrap or Sandwich (Lite)
ingredients: 2 hamburger, slices thin, but lean | 1/2 cup vegetable stock | 4 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 tablespoon chili pepper flakes ( i use hot sauce ) | 1 tablespoon sambal oelek chili pepper flakes ( optional ) | 4 tablespoons slivered almonds ( for each wrap or sandwich ) | 3 romaine lettuce | 2 tablespoons slivered almonds, for each wrap ( to garnish ) | 1 tablespoon slivered almonds, for each wrap or sandwich ( to garnish )
instructions: Heat the oil in a nonstick skillet. Pound each hamburger slice in the pan until it are slightly flattened. Add the stock to the hamburger and heat until it boils. While the stock is heating up, prepare the wraps. Slightly warm the roll using a basting brush if necessary. Spread one side of each roll with the stock and chili flakes. Add the slivered almonds to each roll. Wrap each roll with the lettuce, dividing the lettuce equally, and scatter on the toasted slivered almonds.

Random Ingredients: snow pea,nut walnut,pepper,coconut,chicken,apple pie spice,puff pastry,allspice
title: Apple Coconut Chicken Tarts
ingredients: 1 package thawed puff pastry, cut into 24 slices | 1 can coconut pecan pieces | 1 apple, peeled and diced very fine | 1/2 cup snow peas, chopped in chunks | 1 teaspoon allspice | 1/2 teaspoon pepper | 1 teaspoon apple pie spice | 1 teaspoon nut walnut pieces ( toasted )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375f degrees. Combine the coconut, apple, peas, allspice, pepper, apple pie spice, and walnuts. Roll up the pastry slices and cut into 24 slices. Put 1 tsp of coconut mixture in the center of each pastry slice. Fold over the dough and seal the edges by pressing with your fingers. Spray your large oven proof skillet with non stick baking spray and put half of the tarts in the bottom. Cover each with the remaining pastry slices. Brush lightly with water to cover the tarts. Bake for 25 minutes. The pastry should be puffed up and golden brown. Remove from oven and pour any liquid that has collected on the bottom of the skillet over the tarts and serve.

title: Roasted Pine Nut Soup
ingredients: 1 small beef stock cube, dissolved in | 2 liters beef stock over 1/2 a cup warm homemade stock cube | 2 slices rye bread, soaked in hot water with ( you can also use bread soaked in boiling water and then drained ) | 1/2 cup pine nuts, toasted, optional garnish
instructions: Combine beef stock cube and warm beef stock over heat in a large saucepan, add soaked rye bread and gently stir until the soup comes to the boil. Then lower the heat and allow to simmer for 3 hours, or until frothy. Alternatively, break up the stale rye bread in a food processor, pulse in a few pieces of soaked rye bread, and add into the top of the soup. Serve sprinkled w/powdered sugar for added sweetness. Variation, toast pine nuts in a heated frying pan over a medium heat, then remove and serve hot toasted pine nuts.

title: Grill-On-Grill Sirloin
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 7 teaspoons adobo sauce
instructions: Prepare grill or broiler. Arrange beef on a rack in a shallow baking dish or pan. Spray beef with cooking spray and place in the preheated grill. Grill, turning once, until beef has started to seer and is reddish pink in the center, 6 to 8 minutes. Remove to cutting board and discard giblets and juices. Wipe out grill with paper towels. Transfer beef to a cutting board and slice across the grain. Pour a little of the pan drippings into the pan drippings, swirling pan and letting dripping run off. Drizzle hot drippings into sauce. Return meat to pan, pressing slightly with spatula for desired doneness.

title: Pizza Crackers- 2 1/2 Cups
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups bread flour, all-purpose, approximately | sun-dried tomato packed in oil, oil reserved
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f if you have a pizza stone, place it on a baking rack and set aside. If using a pizza stone, lightly oil the stone with sun dried tomatoes. If using a cookie sheet, lightly pat flour onto cookie sheet. If using a pizza roller, roll out the dough to a 1/4 inch thickness. If using cookie sheet, place on your work surface and stretch to an approximately 5 inch long by ¼ inch wide rectangle. It should be about ¾ to ½ inch wide. Using a sharp knife, cut the dough lengthwise into 3 inch lengths. Place the cookies on the hot stone, cut side up, and press the cookies in the cookie sheet with the flat of the hand to slightly flatten them. Bake for 5 to 8 minutes, or until the tops of the crackers are puffed up and golden. Remove and let cool on the pan. If you have a pizza stone, make the crackers out of the flour, pulling out flour one hand, the other hand, and the reserved sun dried tomato oil and water and drop the dough on the top of the stones. Using a spatula, scrape down the sides of the dough from the sides of the stones and onto the bread, smoothing and pulling down from time to time, like you are making pie crusts and flattening. Allow the cracker crackers to cool completely before slicing.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,white wine vinegar,cherry tomato,part mozzarella cheese,tarragon,vanilla bean
title: Part-skim mozzarella on the Half Shell
ingredients: 14 ounces part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded | 1 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded | 1 cup cherry tomatoes, halved ( about 8 tomato halves ) | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon fresh tarragon, chopped | salt & cracked pepper | 1/8 teaspoon vanilla bean, split in half
instructions: Combine the mozzarella and tomatoes. Blend with the vinegar, tarragon, salt and pepper to taste. Place the half shells on a baking sheet and bake in a 325 degree f oven until the cheese melts, about 8 minutes, stirring frequently. Stir in the vanilla bean and serve.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,cajun seasoning,iceberg lettuce,orange peel,large shrimp,beef bouillon cube,broccoli floret
title: Chinese Shrimp and Broccoli Salad (Gougeous)
ingredients: 2 lbs peeled large shrimp | 1 1/4 teaspoons cajun seasoning | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 2 cups shredded iceberg lettuce | 1 cup chopped broccoli floret | 1/4 cup coarsely grated orange peel
instructions: Place shrimp in a large skillet. Season with the cajun seasoning and place over high heat. In a small saucepan, bring water to boiling. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, dissolve the bouillon cube in sesame oil. Add bouillon liquid, a little at a time, to bouillon liquid and cook over high heat for 3 - 4 to 4 minutes, or until desired thickness is achieved. Remove from heat. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use. When ready to serve, top shrimp with lettuce, broccoli florets and orange peel and toss gently.

Random Ingredients: poblano pepper,chili garlic sauce,fast rising yeast,blueberry,basil leaf
title: Baked Fresh Cherry and Chile Pepper Peppers
ingredients: 6 medium poblano peppers ( roasted peeled, seeded, and quartered ) | 3 2 poblano peppers or 2 medium anaheim chilies | 7 -8 cups fresh strawberries ( washed, hulled and halved ) | 1 cup fresh blueberries | 3/4 cup good chili-garlic sauce
instructions: In a large bowl, gently toss the peppers then place in a greased 8x8 inch pan on top of the water. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Place the chilies on a cookie tray. Bake for about 25 minutes. Remove and turn them over. Roast for another 29 - 35 minutes or until just blacken. Place the pepper halves on a towel to remove most of the moisture about 5 minutes. Place the chilies in a blender and puree. Place the puree in a crock pot set on low for 10 minutes. To serve, line a serving platter with the fresh berries, then pour the pepper puree over them, and stir in the chile garlic sauce. Garnish with extra fresh basil leaves.

title: Fettuccine With Dates and Sage
ingredients: 2 cups yellow onions, finely chopped | 1 lb soft dates, pitted and finely chopped | 8 ounces dry fettuccine ( i prefer whole wheat but you can use your favourite pasta )
instructions: Cook the pasta until almost al dente. Drain well. Meanwhile, on high heat, cook the onion until it begins to soften, around 8 minutes. Stir in the dates. Remove the pan from the heat. Drain the pasta and return it to the pot. Toss with the onion sauce until evenly coated. I serve with parmesan cheese..

title: Italian Seasoned Salt
ingredients: 3 tablespoons red pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon oregano leaves
instructions: To prevent discoloration, lightly grind and measure. Combine all ingredients in small bowl.

title: Ancho and Sauerkraut Toasts With Cabbage
ingredients: 1/2 lb dried sauerkraut, rinsed | 10 slices stale bread | 3 cups cabbage ( chopped ) | 3 slices velveeta mexican cheese ( cut into small cubes ) | 2 teaspoons anchovy paste | 1 tablespoon kirsch ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons apple cider or 2 tablespoons water
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Mix saurkraut in bowl with 8 slices of bread. Spoon layer of bread on top of saurkraut, and top with remaining slices. Top with cheese cubes and anchovy paste. Brush tops with kirsch, if using. Put in oven and bake till cheese is melted and bread is crisp, and bread is lightly browned. Serve immediately, with ketchup, applesauce or water.

title: Quick and Easy Honey & Garlic Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 1 cup raw rice or 1 cup long grain rice | 1 - 2 1/2 teaspoon honey ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons garlic granules ( or to taste, i use the kind in jar )
instructions: Place raw or long grain rice in pot with enough water to cover. Bring to boil and then reduce to simmer or simmer until water is absorbed/al dente... Add garlic and honey, if desired. Cover and keep warm until ready to serve. If using honey, let it stand 5 - 10 minutes before serving so as not to deflate the heat. If using garlic, just squeeze the garlic into liquid 1/4 cup at a time to release the flavor.

Random Ingredients: jamaican jerk spice,cooking spray,tofu,rotisserie chicken,vanilla bean,red bean
title: Quick and Tasty Tandoori Chicken
ingredients: cooking spray | 1/2 lb firm tofu, cut into 8-10 pieces and cut into 8 pieces | 1 can red beans, rinsed and drained | 1/4 cup jamaican jerk spice | 1 medium jamaican jerk spice ( i use `` billy's brand '' ) | 1 large rotisserie chicken, cut in 8 pieces
instructions: Spray a 9x13 inch pan with cooking spray. Arrange tofu in a single layer in a 3 or 4 quart baking dish. Mix beans, jamaican jerk seasoning, and rotisserie chicken in a bowl until well blended. Spoon bean mixture over tofu.

Random Ingredients: half,currant,vanilla pudding mix,pork fillet,gingerroot,penne pasta,tamari,vanilla sugar
title: Pudding Pasta Primavera
ingredients: 125 g penne pasta ( or other large pasta ) | 1 lb pork fillet, cut into thin strips | 150 g currants | 2 teaspoons vanilla sugar | 1/2 teaspoon grated gingerroot | 2 cups half-and-half | 150 ml vanilla frozen pudding mix | 1 tablespoon tamari ( or soy sauce for gluten free version )
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions, adding pork during last five minutes of cooking time. While pork is cooking, stir together currants, sugar, and gingerroot in a small bowl.
