When pork is nearly cooked, add half and half, and stir in the vanilla sugar syrup until fully incorporated. Add the remaining half and half and mix until warmed through. Add pineapple to sauce for serving.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,broth,raspberry,liquid smoke,self rising flour,bay leaf,pearl barley,red chile pepper
title: Quick Barley Soup
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 cup chicken broth | 1/4 cup pearl barley | 1 bay leaf | crushed red chile pepper to taste | 1 1/4 cups frozen raspberries, thawed | 1 1/4 cups self-rising flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons liquid smoke, or as needed
instructions: Combine the cream of chicken soup, chicken broth, barley, bay leaf, red chile pepper, raspberries, dry red chile flakes, and flour in a pot. Simmer over low heat, stirring occasionally, until thickened and simmering, about 25 minutes.

title: Zippy Oil Oil
ingredients: 1 cup cooking oil | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon zest, grated ( optional )
instructions: In a small mixing bowl, combine oil and zest. Cover and store in a cool, dry place for up to 3 months. The zippy oil will keep in a tightly covered container at room temperature for up to 1 week.

title: Rice and Watermelon Salad
ingredients: 2 cups brown rice | 1 cup watermelon, cut into 1/8 inch-thick slices | 1 cup chopped seedless watermelon | 1/4 medium head escarole, outer leaves removed, leaves removed | 1/2 cup madeira wine
instructions: Cook rice in 2 cups water in large pot over high heat, stirring occasionally, until grains are tender and all the water has been absorbed. Immediately transfer rice to large bowl. Add 3/4 cup water, watermelon, escarole, and cook 2 minutes, stirring to heat well. Pour into bowl with rice. Season with salt and pepper. Chill 30 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: chicken broth,baking potato,cold water,watermelon,parmesan cheese,cream cheese spread
title: Parmesan Potato and Watermelon Scones
ingredients: 6 small baking potatoes, cubed | 1 can watermelon, drained | 1 loaf frozen chopped fresh watermelon, thawed | 1 package cream cheese spread | 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1 cup low-fat chicken broth
instructions: Heat oven to 425 degrees f. Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. In a large bowl, toss potatoes, watermelon, and frozen watermelon with cream cheese, parmesan cheese, and 1 cup broth to combine. Sprinkle mashed potato mixture evenly into prepared baking dish. Bake in preheated oven until the topping is bubbly and beginning to brown, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cream tartar,fontina cheese,green pepper,walnut oil,clove,parmigiano reggiano cheese,saffron strand,sauce
title: Foccacia Di Zucca
ingredients: 1 teaspoon saffron strand ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon hot sauce ( optional ) | 1 small green pepper, seeded cut into 1/4 inch slices | 12 -16 large walnut oil or 12 -16 walnut pieces, for frying | 1 lb fresh fontina cheese or 1 lb other low fat cheese, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 1/4 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | pamgrated clove ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons cream of tartar
instructions: Combine saffron and hot sauce in a small bowl. Cover tightly and set aside. Add green pepper slices to oil at least 30 seconds before dropping by spoonfuls. Turn down heat to low and cook until a light golden color, but not black. Set aside. Place cheese in bowl with saffron mixture and stir to combine. Add pepper slices in batches, sprinkling them with salt. If all pieces are coated with salt, add more. The cheese will hold its shape in the bowl. When cheese is melted and starts to turn golden around edges, transfer to bowl and mix. If desired, drizzle with cream of tartar, and sprinkle with additional cheese if desired. Serve immediately.

title: Oaxacan Polenta
ingredients: 3 cups cornmeal ( stone-ground, not self-rising ) | 1 teaspoon pimento stuffed olive, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Combine the ground cornmeal and the pimento stuffed olives and refrigerate overnight. On a greased baking sheet, toast the cornmeal and bake uncovered in a 400f degree oven for 25 - 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Seared Asian Tomatoes (Achiote Oil)
ingredients: 3 cups achiote ( achiote ) | 3 tablespoons mirin | 4 cans italian-style stewed tomatoes
instructions: Soak the achiote in water to cover for 10 minutes or until tender. Drain.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,puff pastry,table salt,corn,grapeseed oil,white kidney bean
title: Quick and Easy Calico  Indian Cheese Rolls
ingredients: 8 sheets ready rolled puff pastry | 1 can white kidney beans | 1 cup of chopped corn | 1 tablespoon cornflour ( corn starch ) | 1 teaspoon table salt | 2 teaspoons curry powder
instructions: Heat your oven to 180 degrees celsius. Drain the kidney beans then stir in the chopped beans and 1 cup of corn. Take 2 sheets of the pastry, cut them into 5 x 1/3 inch pieces. Use a cutter to cut out four 6 cm round circles. Using a tablespoon or 2 of the mixture, roll them towards the edges of your pastry, to make long, thin discs then flatten with your fingers. Repeat with remaining sheets, make sure you get all your rolls the same sizes. Place one dough disc on a greased tray and bake for 5 minutes, then remove from the oven and place on a cloth covered paper towel to drain off extra water. Place two teaspoons of oil on a flat frying pan at medium heat and spread the mustard and 1/2 tsp of curry powder into it. Once the mustard splutters, remove from the heat and place the mustard oil into a sauce pan containing the rest of the curry powder. When the oil is hot, add the mustard oil paste and allow to sizzle for a couple of minutes. Then add the shredded cheese and place the cheesy cheese on top of the mustard oil. Return to the heat and continue to cook until the cheese is golden all over. Remove from the heat, remove the paper towels and place on serving plates. Serve.

title: Easy Broccoli Bake (Japanese)
ingredients: 6 -8 cups fresh broccoli, cleaned | 1/4 cup tamari ( soy sauce ) | 1 cup sour cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Trim stem ends from broccoli and cut it in small florets. Wash broccoli and pat it dry. Spread it in a baking dish and top with remaining ingredients. Bake for 30 - 45 minutes till broccoli is cooked.

Random Ingredients: red wine,kraft italian dressing,plain nonfat yogurt,olive oil cooking spray
title: My Kicked up Zesty Italian Meatloaf
ingredients: 1 cup plain nonfat yogurt ( low and low fat works fine ) | 1/2 cup kraft italian dressing | 1/4 cup olive oil flavored cooking spray | 1/2 cup red wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 375f. Line loaf pan with kitchen towel or parchment paper. Stir yogurt, dressing, and oil in a medium bowl to mix. Add wine and mix well. Pour mix into loaf pan on towel/parchment paper and place on center rack of oven. Bake at 375 f for 80 minutes, uncovered. Cool for 20 minutes, then slice.

title: Easy Asian Dressing
ingredients: 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 1/4 cup chicken broth
instructions: Mix all the above in small bowl and refrigerate till flavors blend. Serve over chicken or fish.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,spring onion,black olive,sea salt black pepper,half,hard egg
title: Olive Bread Pudding
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups half-and-half | 1 1/2 cups self-raising flour | 1 large hard-boiled egg, chopped | 1 finely chopped spring onion | 1/4 cup chopped black olives | sea salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c or 190°c if your bread are at all large, cut into 2cm pieces. Place the half and half and flour in a large mixing bowl. Add 1 egg. Stir in your finely chopped egg, spring onion and chopped black olives. Add some salt and pepper to your taste. Add about 1 1/2 ladle full to the mixture and stir or work the mixture to ensure the mixture is well together. Add extra flour if the mixture is too dry. Grease 6 individual 4 1/2 cup oven proof bowls. Spoon the mixture into the prepared bread bowls, and place the filled bowls on a baking tray. Bake in the centre of the oven for 12 - 15 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through. Serve hot with cream, yoghurt, butter and salsa. If you can't get toasts/toasties, toast your bread before adding the filling as suggested. This recipe makes a large quantity so you can either use it for a topping or for other things.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,russet potato,bean,cold water,cayenne pepper
title: Potato, Potato & Refried Beans
ingredients: 2 medium russet potatoes, peeled, cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 2 cans refried beans ( i use spicy ) | 1/4 cup cold water | cayenne pepper, to taste | 1/2 large red bell pepper, seeded and chopped
instructions: Place potatoes and 2 1/2 cups water in a pot. Bring to boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium low and cook, covered, until potatoes are tender, about 25 minutes. Stir in beans and cook, covered 5 minutes more. Sprinkle with cayenne pepper and stir. Serve and enjoy.

title: Creamy Ricotta Cheese
ingredients: 4 ounces milk ricotta cheese ( i use whole-milk ) | 1 -2 teaspoon honey | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon creole seasoning | 1 -2 teaspoon chopped pistachio nuts
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender or food processor and puree until very smooth. This can be done either in batches or in a food processor for larger quantities. The texture of the ricotta cheese will be unevenly blended.

Random Ingredients: tabasco sauce,celery rib,gochujang,porcini mushroom,corn relish,hot salsa
title: Hot and Sour Mushroom Salad
ingredients: 14 ounces mushrooms, cleaned, trimmed of giblets and sliced thinly | 4 celery ribs, washed and sliced thinly | 1/2 cup gochujang, fresh | 2 tablespoons red japanese hot salsa ( or sriracha hot sauce ) | 2 tablespoons sweet corn relish | 1/2 cup very finely chopped fresh porcini mushrooms | 1/4 cup sweet hot salsa or 1/4 cup sweet and sour chinese hot sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients together in a large bowl. Chill for 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: coffee,chicken breast fillet,chicken stock vegetable,skirt steak,gingerroot,bread crumb,mexican cheese
title: Spiced Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken breast fillets | 1 teaspoon gingerroot, grated | 1 large bob evans original cheese, cubed | 500 g boneless skinless chicken breast fillets | 2 cups fresh bread crumbs | 1 1/2 cups chicken stock or 1 1/2 cups low-fat chicken stock | 1/3 cup strong coffee ( heaped ) | 1/4 cup fresh bread crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 190 degrees celsius. Line a heavy baking tray with baking paper. Using oiled fingers, spread one side of each chicken breast fillet with one teaspoon of ginger root. Place the chicken breast on baking trays. Drain bread crumbs from can and then dredge chicken in both. Set chicken aside and add chicken to tray, coat both sides and sides with 1 tablespoon of oil. Bake in oven for about 15 minutes, turn over and brown on other side. Remove from oven and set aside. In a separate pan, add 1 tablespoon of oil. Place chicken on tray and cover with 1 1/2 cups of bread crumbs, mix well and then cover. Bake in oven for a further 20 minutes. During that time, remove tray of chicken from oven and mix bread crumbs and 1/4 cup of strong coffee to make the breadcrumbs crunchy. Dip each chicken breast first into crumbs. Place on a baking tray and sprinkle bread crumb mixture over chicken breasts.

Random Ingredients: sausage,tabasco sauce,golden raisin,dark rum,deli roast beef,cooking oat,tamari
title: Oaty Roast Beef
ingredients: 3 tablespoons dark rum | 1/4 cup tamari ( or soy sauce ) | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce, more if desired | 1 1/2 lbs deli roast beef, cut diagonally into 1-inch slices | 3/4 cup quick-cooking oats | 1 package smoked sausages, cut into 1-inch slices | 3/4 cup golden raisin | 1/2 cup quick-cooking oats
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. In a small bowl, mix rum, tamari, and tabasco sauce until combined. Place beef slices in a large baking pan. Stir in 1/4 cup each oats, sausages, and raisins, making sure to evenly coat beef. Sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup oats. Cover and bake 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: apple,tabasco sauce,harissa,peanut oil,artichoke heart,cilantro stem,greek yogurt
title: Quick Yogurt Salad
ingredients: 4 tablespoons fat free greek yogurt | 1/8 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 2 tablespoons peanut oil or 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 2 ounces marinated artichoke hearts | 2 sprigs fresh cilantro stems | 2 teaspoons harissa ( or to taste ) | 2 -3 chopped cooked apples ( optional )
instructions: Whisk in a bowl the yogurt, tabasco, oil and marinated artichokes. Serve on lettuce leaves.

Random Ingredients: brown onion,white bread,ghee,red chilies,mexican cheese,feta cheese,pimiento,baking soda
title: Feta Baked Onions
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups finely chopped white bread | 1/2 lb feta cheese, crumbled | 1/4 cup chopped pimiento | 1/2 cup finely chopped brown onion | 1 finely chopped fresh red chilies, seeded | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 3 tablespoons ghee | 2 tablespoons mexican crema or 2 tablespoons sour cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f generously butter a 1 1/2 quart baking dish. Place the bread in a food processor fitted with the metal blade, process until crumbs are finely ground. Add to the crumbs and process until well mixed. Stir in next 8 ingredients. Transfer mixture to the baking dish. Bake until topping is bubbly, about 20 to 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: iceberg lettuce,garam masala,aromatic bitter,shiitake mushroom,corn oil
title: Seared Mushrooms With Garam Masala
ingredients: 8 -10 fresh shiitake mushrooms | 3 tablespoons light corn oil | 1/4 teaspoon aromatic bitters or 1/4 teaspoon your preferred curry powder | 1/2 small iceberg lettuce ( or other greens ) | 1 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Pour the oil into a fry pan with a lid. Slice off the ends of the mushrooms, and cut a slit in the stem end using the flat side of a knife. Place the mushrooms in the hot oil. Sprinkle the spice mix evenly and fry for 2 to 3 minutes or until fragrant. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: celery seed,french bean,jalapeno pepper,rye flour,red curry paste,vinegar
title: Spicy Curried French Beans
ingredients: 1 lb frozen french beans | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 1 teaspoon vinegar | 1 teaspoon vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons jalapeno peppers, minced | 2 teaspoons celery seeds | 1 dash ground flakey yellow curry paste
instructions: Cook beans according to directions on the package. Do not overcook. Drain beans well, remove and place in a saucepan. Combine remaining ingredients, adding curry paste. Cook and stir over medium heat until heated through.

title: Traditional Mexican Tamales
ingredients: 4 whole roma ( plum ) tomatoes | 4 fluid ounces tea | 3/4 pound ground pork | 2 teaspoons masa harina | 1 1/4 teaspoons mixed spice
instructions: Preheat oven to 475 degrees f. Place tomatoes on a baking sheet, and bake until blackened and collapsed. Remove from oven and set aside. Cut a small slit down the center of each tomato, and scoop out juice. Place roma tomatoes in a saucepan, and pour enough tea into the pan to cover. Bring to a boil, and drain if tomato skins form. Place tomatoes in a large bowl of cold water to soften. Mix in the soaked tomatoes, the ground pork, masa harina, 1/4 teaspoon mixed spice, and 1/4 teaspoon of black pepper. Gently mix in the drained tomatoes. Place about 1 tablespoon of mixture per tamale and roll in the masa harina to coat. Repeat with remaining tamales and filling.

title: Cheesecloth, Camembert Wrapped Chillies
ingredients: 4 medium chillies ( red and green ones ) | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs camembert cheese ( or other blue cheese ) | oil | 1 -2 cup dark molasses or 1 -2 cup maple syrup | cheesecloth
instructions: Remove the chillies by peeling them from the stalk ends and cutting them open at the base of the stalk with a sharp knife. Cut out the base of the chillies so they stay together better. Cut the cheese in 2 inch squares or rectangular pieces and roll each piece out to be a large square. Heat a griddle or heavy based frying pan over high heat. Brush the cheese evenly with molasses, keeping the heat low. When the cheese is bubbling, place in the chillies, taking care not to burn them. Place a piece of cheese just onto the top. Add a pinch of the chillies to each slice of the roll.

title: Mexican-Style Pickled Turnips
ingredients: 6 medium yellow turnips | 1 1/2 cups cider vinegar | 1/2 cup light molasses | 3 tablespoons olive oil | 1 jar chopped pimientos | 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Peel the turnips and cut into 1 1/2 1 inch cubes. Place in a large kettle with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium low, cover and simmer until the meat is cooked, 45 to 50 minutes. Drain the turnips and reserve the cooking liquid, then return turnips to the kettle and bring to a boil. Add salt and remaining liquid, mixing well. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium low. Stir in molasses. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, cover and simmer until the juices are slightly thickened, about 25 minutes. Stir in the olives and remove from heat. Stir in the pimientos and black beans.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,shallot,white bread,pork loin,swiss cheese,peanut butter,leek
title: Pork Panini
ingredients: 1 tablespoon pecorino romano cheese | 1 leek, thinly sliced and washed | 1 shallot, minced | 1 - 1 1/2 lb pork loin, sliced into thin strips | 1 - 1 1/2 loaf firm white bread, cut into 1/4-inch slices, toasted | 1 cup swiss cheese | 1/4 cup peanut butter
instructions: Sprinkle cheese over leek. Arrange slices of pork over cheese, turning to coat. Place slice of un Toast on top of steak and pork. Cover and let rest for 30 minutes. Remove meat and let rest another 10 minutes. Preheat broiler. Cut bread into 1/4 slices. Arrange in a 10 inch by 2 inch pan and broil, turning once, until lightly toasted, about 2 minutes. Slice pork and place on top of toasted slices. Sprinkle wisconsin cheese over top. Spread peanut butter over top of toasted slices and sprinkle wisconsin cheese over toasted slices. Broil until cheese is light brown, about 2 - 5 minutes. Watch carefully so it does not burn. Let stand 3 - 5 minutes before serving.

title: Tasty Vegetarian Baked Rice (India)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups brown rice ( washed and soaked in warm water ) | 2 tablespoons whole kernel corn | 400 g white wine ( r.l.l., i like to use cabernet sauvignon ) | 1 teaspoon coriander powder
instructions: Put all the ingredients together in a large oven proof dish. Cover with water and bake for 30 minutes and check water levels and stirring halfway through cooking. After 45 minutes, the rice is cooked, stir through, check and serve.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,hot pepper sauce,red potato,cream mushroom soup,herring fillet,beef broth,sirloin steak
title: Skirt Steak With Mushroom Gravy
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sirloin steaks | hot pepper sauce | 2 garlic cloves | 4 cans condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 2 packages dried herring fillets | 2 lbs red potatoes, scrubbed
instructions: Remove skin and bones from fish. Cut fish into 3 pieces. Put fish in a roasting pan. Insert garlic into slits on top of meat. Pour soup over fish. Cover with foil. Place in 350 f oven. Baste occasionally until fish flakes easily. When fish turns it on top, remove. Cover with foil. Let rest for 1 hr or refrigerate leftovers. Bake in 375f oven for 1 hr. Strain. Strain liquid. Put liquid, herring fillets, potatoes, salt and pepper sauce in a saucepan. Heat and simmer until potatoes are tender, drain. Serve stew in a separate dish.

Random Ingredients: fontina cheese,oregano,salt pork,basil leaf,brown ale,chicken stock,red wine,leek
title: Giant Beef Roulades
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg beef roulades ( or stewing beef ) | 1 pint chicken stock | 2 tablespoons red wine | 200 g fontina cheese ( or other hard melting cheese ; see below ) | 4 -6 leeks ( white and pale green parts only ; the green parts can be mixed in with the leeks and the white of the leek ) | 3 -4 tablespoons oregano | 2 tablespoons basil leaves ( chopped ) | salt ( to taste, probably not called salt, but you may use a lot )
instructions: Cut roulades up in small slices. Put stock, wine, cheese, leeks and spices in a saucepan and bring to boil over medium heat. Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 40 minutes. While the roulades are simmering, cook rice. Add a little butter to a frying pan and fry roulades in the butter until lightly golden. Remove roulades from the skillet with a slotted spoon to a dish. When the roulades have cooled a little, reheat the stock. Divide roulade among serving dishes. Pour on the stock, cover and heat through.

Random Ingredients: beef stock,orange juice zest,star anise,yellow squash,yellow onion,chili oil,avocado
title: Chili-Avocado Soup
ingredients: 1 small yellow onion ( i used white or yellow ) | 1/2 cup orange juice or 1/2 cup orange juice | 2 star anise | chili oil ( i used regular oil for this in a pinch ) | 8 cups beef stock | 1 medium avocado | 2 small yellow squash
instructions: Chop onion, zest of 1/2 cup orange juice, 3 star anise, and chili oil in a blender until very fine. Heat the stock in a soup pot over med/low heat until boiling, then add onion zest mix, orange juice, and 4 star anise. Simmer, uncovered, for 3 - 5 minute. Peel and thinly slice avocado and yellow squash. Add to soup. Serve with freshly ground black pepper and other spices, to taste. Note, if you wish to make a vegetarian/vegan dish, substitute 3 chicken breasts and/or 2 chicken thighs.

title: A.1. Hot Soup
ingredients: 900 ml vegetable stock | 10 g romaine lettuce, chopped ( or other leaf lettuce )
instructions: Heat the soup stock to boiling and simmer for 5 minutes or until reduced to about half. Stir in the lettuce. Serve hot garnished with chopped green onions, if desired.

Random Ingredients: poblano chile,triple sec,carrot,red wine,salmon fillet,plain yogurt
title: Salmon with Poblano Chile Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup shredded carrot | 2 poblano chiles, stemmed, seeded and chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried minced garlic | 1/2 cup red wine or 1/2 cup vermouth | 3 tablespoons triple sec | 2 tablespoons plain yogurt
instructions: Lightly oil grill. Place all vegetables on grill and sauté until crisp, about 5 minutes. Drain on paper towels. Combine garlic and red wine in small saucepan over medium high heat. Cover and cook until reduced by half, about 3 minutes. Stir in triple sec and yoghurt. Serve with salmon.

title: Mediterranean Stuffed Tomatoes
ingredients: 12 large ripe tomatoes | 1 cup low-fat yoghurt | 4 ounces canadian bacon, diced | 1/4 cup parmesan cheese, grated | 1/3 cup low-fat broth | 2 tablespoons mirin | 1/2 cup dates, finely chopped or 2 teaspoons dried dates
instructions: Cut a slice from each tomato in half, remove the pulp, scoop out the pulp, set aside for a serving dish. Place back halves in the tomatoes, pour boiling water over tomatoes, bring to the boil and boil for 5 minutes until skin is crisp and black. Dry off any burnt skin, then peel off the skin, cut into halves. Combine yoghurt, bacon, parmesan and chicken stock in a bowl. Dice tomatoes into cubes, set aside. Pour 2 tbsp mirin into the yoghurt mixture and stir until well blended. Mix in the tomatoes, dates and 1/4 cup reserved tomato pulp. Fill the tomatoes with the mixture and place into a dish covered with aluminium foil. Add some remaining chopped parsley, extra parmesan if desired and serve with white rice and bread.

Random Ingredients: shell pasta,ice water,bulk italian sausage,pesto sauce
title: Cold Sausage and Pesto Noodle Soup
ingredients: 18 ounces bulk italian sausage | 1 can refrigerated breaded pesto sauce | 3 1/4 cups ice water | 2 lbs shell pasta
instructions: In a large saucepan, cook sausage over medium heat for 10 minutes, or until crumbly and no longer pink. Drain sausage well and set aside. Remove crusts from breaded pesto.

title: Portuguese Spinach & Beans
ingredients: 4 large fresh spinach leaves | 14 1/2 ounces cans pinto beans, drained and rinsed ( cannellini beans ) | 2 tablespoons white rum | 1/2 teaspoon mace | 4 flat leaf lettuce leaves, washed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Spray an 11 x 7 x 2 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Cut the spinach with a very sharp knife into 3/4 inch pieces, cutting from stem to leaf if necessary. Rinse beans and transfer to a blender of food processor fitted with metal blade. Add the rum, mace and spinach. Cover and blend until smooth. Fill a medium saucepan with 2 inches of water and bring to a boil. Add the greens, cover and cook for 5 minutes, turning the greens over. Remove from heat and let cool briefly. Drain the greens and place them in a serving bowl. Pour bean mixture over greens. Serve warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: panko bread crumb,red lentil,italian seasoning,butterscotch chip,green onion,serrano pepper
title: Butter Cheddar Crouton
ingredients: 1 cup panko bread crumbs | 3 tablespoons butterscotch chips | 2 teaspoons dried italian seasoning | 2 teaspoons minced serrano peppers | 1 pound chopped green onions | 2 cups shredded sharp cheddar cheese ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. Mix panko cereal, italian seasoning, serrano pepper, and green onion in a bowl. Press panko crumbs into a 3x1 inch baking dish. Layer crumb mixture, chopped cheddar cheese, if using, toasted chipotle pepper mixture, and shredded green onion over cheese. Bake in the preheated oven until bubbly and lightly browned, 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Quick & Tasty Mexican Style Lentil Salad
ingredients: 4 cups green lentils | 1 can kidney beans | 1/4 cup soy sauce | 2/3 cup guacamole ( can also use your favorite dip )
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the first 3 ingredients and pour on top of the lentils and other ingredients. Chill till serving time.

Random Ingredients: coriander leaf,apricot jam,chicken bouillon granule,cilantro,onion ring,ginger,butter,mint
title: Persian Apricot and Cilantro Butter
ingredients: 5 tablespoons butter or 5 tablespoons olive oil | 3 tablespoons finely chopped fresh coriander leaves | 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger | 2 1/2 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon granules or 2 1/2 teaspoons chicken flavored instant granules | canned apricot jam | minced fresh mint | green onion rings | chopped of fresh mint
instructions: In a large skillet melt butter over medium high heat. When butter is foaming add the coriander, ginger and bouillon. Cook, stirring constantly for 3 to 4 minutes. Add jam and cook until boiling.

title: Quick and Easy Filipino Style Chicken
ingredients: 2 cans tomato paste | 1 cancatsup | 1 cup chopped fresh cilantro | 8 chicken thighs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with foil. Spread each piece of chicken with tomato paste. Bake in preheated oven until lightly browned and juices run clear, about 30 minutes. Stir catsup and cilantro into tomato sauce. Place chicken legs into the sauce. Cook, uncovered, until chicken legs are thoroughly browned, about 30 minutes.

title: Hungarian Eggplant Dip
ingredients: 6 medium yellow bell peppers | 6 medium eggplants | 1/2 cup caster sugar | 1 teaspoon hungarian paprika
instructions: Cut bell peppers in half length ways. Remove the stems, seeds and inner white part using a serrated knife. Place the eggplant in a steamer basket over boiling water, cover and steam for 2 - 3 minutes until tender. Skin may escape, remove and leave a tent of steam on top. When eggplant cools to room temperature, drain and peel, then slice in half lengthways. In a shallow bowl place the eggplant and 1 tbs of the sugar, then the paprika, and set aside for about an hour. Add more sugar to taste. Serve with french or italian bread.

Random Ingredients: irish cream,garbanzo bean,vegetable protein,red chili pepper,chuck,aluminum foil
title: Garlicky Beef Nests on the Planet's® Food for the Planet®
ingredients: 1 lb ground chuck | 1 can garbanzo beans | 1 red chili pepper, chopped | 1/4 cup vegetable protein | 1 tablespoon irish cream ( grey goose brand suggested ) | 24 sheets aluminum foil ( warmed in the oven prior to use )
instructions: Heat a heavy skillet over medium high heat. Cook and stir steak and red chile in the hot skillet until lightly browned, about 5 minutes. Stir burger and kidney bean mixture, vegetable protein, and whiskey into ground chuck. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer until mixture simmers, about 15 minutes. Stir occasionally. Arrange warm foil squares on a baking sheet. Spoon meat mixture into the center of each square, and brush edges of the foil with the heated juices from the pan. Cook nests in preheated oven until warm and pliable, 1 to 2 hours.

title: Homemade Choc-Chip Cocktail #2
ingredients: 4 ounces bittersweet chocolate, melted | 4 tablespoons fresh cranberry juice | chili powder | 2 green onions, thinly sliced | 1 pinch cayenne | 1 dash liquid smoke ( optional ) | pepper ( optional )
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the chocolate, cranberry juice, chili powder, chopped green onions and cayenne pepper. Slowly drizzle in the liquid smoke. Transfer to a serving bowl and chill at least 1 hour.

title: Irish Whiskey Soup
ingredients: 1 liter beef stock powder | 6 tablespoons irish whiskey or 6 tablespoons orange liqueur
instructions: Mix all ingredients well in a large saucepan that will hold 2 glasses. Bring to boil. Reduce heat. Simmer very gently for 2 hours, skimming occasionally. Do not boil. Serve hot.

title: Strawberry and Raisin Chutney (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 12)
ingredients: 1/4 kg fresh strawberries | 1/4 kg red onion ( sliced thin ) | 1 large red chilies ( diced ) | 8 raisins | 2 tablespoons radishes ( sliced thinly )
instructions: Wash and dry strawberries, place on baking tray and place under a grill, cut side down or under the grill grate until the skin blisters then peel away the skin and discard. Remove the skin and seeds if you wish. Finely chop the strawberries. Place all the ingredients in a blender jar or a screwtop container. Cover and blend until smooth. Cover with a fine cloth and allow to mature for at least 24 hours before using. Store refrigerated in a cool place. Variation, this recipe doubles with fresh banana and mint chutney, which is a good substitute for plain yogurt and has fewer calories.

title: Lentils With Shrimp, Onions and Dried Red Pepper
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups yellow sweet peppers, drained ( about 1 pound ) | 2 1/2 cups dry red lentils | 3 cans light-colored lager-style smoked anchovies packed in oil, drained | 1 cup sodium-reduced liquid smoke | 1 1/2 lbs large shrimp, peeled, deveined, extra large, shells peeled
instructions: To make broth, combine yellow and red peppers and rinsed lentils in a 6 - 6 qt heavy pot. Add sausage and anchovies. Bring to boil. Reduce heat. Cover. Simmer gently until tender, about 10 minutes. Stir in shrimp and simmer until shrimp turn pink, about 3 minutes longer. Season with salt. Serve on a bed of fresh cilantro if you like.

title: Irish Saffron Spice Cookies
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups ground celery | 2/3 cup sherry | 1/4 cup sifted confectioners'sugar | 1/4 teaspoon saffron threads | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Stir the celery, sherry, confectioners' sugar, saffron, thyme, and baking soda together in a bowl until the mixture is evenly combined. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate the mixture for at least 30 minutes. Preheat the oven to 275 degrees f. Line sheets with parchment paper. Drop rounded teaspoons of the mixture onto the parchment sheets in a thin layer. Bake the cookies in the preheated oven until the tops are light brown, about 15 minutes.

title: Steamed Broccoli for Jian Bing
ingredients: 6 cups small broccoli florets | 1 teaspoon szechuan peppercorns
instructions: Heat steamer rack in oven or heavy pot to boiling. Scatter peppercorns over steaming rack. Steam broccoli over open flame until crisp tender about 10 minutes, but still firm 3 to 5 minutes. Place broccoli on platter and pour steaming sauce over.

Random Ingredients: pecorino cheese,corn oil,tomato ketchup,cauliflower floret,jasmine rice,tart apple,olive,basmati rice
title: Spiced Cauliflower, Apple and Rice - Pilaf
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice | 1 cup jasmine rice | 1 large sweet tart apple | 1 medium cauliflower floret | 1/4 cup olive, halved ( kalamata is best ) | 2 -3 tablespoons corn oil | 1 tablespoon tomato ketchup | 1 tablespoon light olive, extra | 1 tablespoon pecorino cheese, grated
instructions: Place the rice and sweet potato in the fridge for 2 hours and drain. Preheat the oven to 150°c. Grease a shallow ovenproof dish with a little of the corn oil. Cut the sweet potato into 2cm cubes and set aside. Slice the cauliflower finely and place in a pan of boiling water. Boil for 3 - 5 mins until just tender and drain. Slice the apple and cut into wedges. Place in a roasting dish with the cauliflower and olive halves. Heat the remaining corn oil in the pan and brown the rice. Add the ketchup and stir well for 1 - 2 mins, or until it has the consistency of pouring cream. Serve with caramalised cream, drizzled with extra olive oil, chopped olives and grated cheese.

title: Tortilla Chip Potato Chips
ingredients: 5 medium russet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/8-inch thick chips | 1 can tomato juice | 1/4 teaspoon ground cayenne, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place potatoes in a baking dish, and bake in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until tender. Drain. Place tomatoes with juice into a saucepan over medium heat, and stir frequently. Bring to a boil, and stir in the cayenne. Simmer, stirring occasionally, until thickened.

Random Ingredients: dill sprig,lipton onion soup mix,raspberry,ranch dressing,clear honey
title: Easy Raspberry and Dill Sauces
ingredients: 4 raspberries | 4 tablespoons raspberry ranch dressing | 3 tablespoons litehouse ranch-style dry onion soup mix | 3 tablespoons clear honey | fresh dill sprig ( to garnish )
instructions: Cut raspberries in half and put in a glass jar with the ranch dressing, ranch style onion soup mix and honey in the freezer until mixture starts to freeze on the sides. Add more honey if needed at this point to make it to the consistency of small peas. Remove from freezer and stir contents of glass jar under ice water. If it doesn`t completely frozen, put lid back in refrigerator and let chill for at least 1 hour. Just remove from refrigerator and stir contents into raspberries on the top. Garnish with dill sprigs and serve.

title: Artichoke Chips
ingredients: 1 can marinated artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 1/4 cup butter | 1/4 cup minced fresh chile pepper | 1 cup crushed ice
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together artichoke hearts, butter, chile pepper and ice until well blended. Dip chips in the mixture to coat. Serve immediately, or store in refrigerator up to 2 months.

Random Ingredients: squash,dark sesame oil,yellow mustard,glutinous rice,beef sirloin steak,sugar,celery rib
title: Beef Kabobs (Komgogi)
ingredients: 2 lbs lean beef sirloin steaks, cut about 1 inch thick | 4 yellow mustard rolls, halved diagonally | 2 teaspoons dark sesame oil | 3 celery ribs, finely chopped | 1 head raw squash, cut into 1/4 inch-thick slices | 2 tablespoons sugar | 1/2 lb glutinous rice
instructions: Trim fat from beef steak and cut into 1/4 inch cubes. Slice rolls crosswise diagonally. Thread 12 to 18 meat parallel to each other on metal skewers. Brush rolls with sesame oil. Soak rolls in water for 30 minutes. Heat grill to high and line rimmed baking sheet with heavy duty aluminum foil. Brush the grilling surface with sesame oil. Grill beef, turning once and brushing again with sesame oil until meat is brown, about 10 minutes. Transfer beef to a cutting board. Pour off all but 2 tablespoons of the drippings and discard the remaining drippings. Place beef in a large nonreactive slow cooker. Add celery, squash, sugar, water and 1 teaspoon salt. Stir to blend. Cover cooker and cook on low setting until beef is very tender, about 8 hours. Transfer the beef to a platter and allow to rest for 10 minutes. Discard vegetables. Skim fat from cooking liquid. Slice beef thinly. Serve 1/2 cup hot broth and beef on each roll.

title: Gardash
ingredients: 2 egg whites | 2 tablespoons oil | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons currants ( dried )
instructions: Beat egg whites& vinegar until very stiff. Gradually fold dry ingredients into egg whites mix. Keep refrigerated for 1 or 2 days.

Random Ingredients: apricot,strawberry,chunky peanut butter,bean sprout,orange wedge,cream mushroom soup,tea
title: Peanut Butter Apricot Chowder
ingredients: 1 cup coarsely chopped dried apricot | 6 cups hot brewed tea | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 package chunky peanut butter | 7 ounces dried apricots, chopped | 1/2 - 3/4 cup coarsely chopped dried strawberries | 1 orange wedge
instructions: Place the apricots into a colander and sprinkle with salt. Let sit for 15 minutes, drain, then crumble into a bowl with hot tea. Chop the soup, peanut butter, apricots, strawberries, and orange wedges, if desired. Pour soup mixture and apricots into large pot. Bring to a boil, then simmer, stirring frequently for about 15 minutes. Serve, garnished with orange wedges.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,brandy,ginger,jalapeno chile,broccoli,tamarind soup mix,rotel tomato,ancho chile powder
title: Ginata Masala (Tomato & Brandy Stew)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable stock | 1 can tamarind soup mix ( or 1 packet of maggi ) | 1 1/4 cups hot chicken broth or 1 1/4 cups hot vegetable stock | 1 1/2 cups chopped broccoli, tips | 1/4 cup brandy | 1/2 jalapeno chile, chopped ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons fresh ginger ( or 1 tsp dry ginger powder. ) | 3 tablespoons toasted sesame seeds ( optional )
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a sauce pan. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes. Add yoghurt and simmer. To serve, put on a plate and drizzle over toasted sesame seeds. Variation, a can of rotel tomatoes works. Variation, alternatively, serve over fried rice with chunky salsa and guacamole.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella cheese,red wine vinegar,grain white rice,walnut half,self rising flour,head iceberg lettuce,milk chocolate,bacon
title: Gino's Baked Rice with Smoked Walnuts
ingredients: 1 loaf fresh mozzarella cheese ( about 2 and 1/2 pounds ) | 1 large head iceberg lettuce | 2 slices bacon, diced | 1 cup self-rising flour | 1 cup uncooked long grain white rice | 1 cup milk chocolate | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1/3 cup walnut halves
instructions: Cut cheese into 1/2 inch thick slices. Preheat oven to 300°f line a large baking sheet with aluminum foil.

title: Baja   orzo  Casserole
ingredients: 1 cup orzo pasta ( or other small pasta ) | 1 1/2 cups yellow onions, diced | 1/2 cup squash, diced | 3 cups bean, canned | 1 cup masala, masala powder ( i like mrs. t's ) | 2 bay leaves | 2 cups picante, jarred roasted enchilada sauce
instructions: Cook the orzo if you are using it for an extra pesentation. In the microwave, put the orzo in a pot with plenty of cold water to cover it about 1/2 inch above the orzo. Soak for about 5 minutes, or until the orzo begins to soften. Drain it, and put it back on the stove. Add the sliced onion and squash. Cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes. Set to the side. Add the beans and 3 cups of water and cook until everything is covered with the masala, about 15 to 20 minutes. The longer the water cooks out of the beans, the saltier the dish will be. While that cooks in the soup, put the 1/2 cup/1 1/2 cup jarred roasted enchilada sauce in a pot and bring to a boil. Turn down the heat right before the liquid boils, but do not cover. This allows the steam to escape. You want just an intermittent bubble start here, but the heat is just right in the pot. Add about 2 cups orzo and let it boil for 1 minute. This will give more flavor. You want it to be kind of firm, but not soupy. Turn off the heat. Take the bay leaves and bay leaves and discard them. If you can wait for 2 minutes to let the soup settle to the bottom of the pot, all the starch will have dissolved. Put the lid on and wait about 10 minutes, or until the soup is done. Turn off the heat. Add the roasted enchilada sauce and stir. You can prepare this the day before, and then wait until the soup is done before serving.

Random Ingredients: white wine,radish,onion soup mix,salt,jalapeno,sharp cheddar cheese,deli roast beef,kosher salt black pepper
title: Crock Pot Mac and Beef
ingredients: 5 -6 lbs deli roast beef, trimmed of fat if necessary | 1 package onion soup mix ( mccormicks montreal brand is recommended ) | 6 ounces white wine | 3 -6 radishes, finely chopped | 1 large onion, finely chopped | 1 -2 jalapeno, seeded and finely chopped ( optional, for milder flavour ) | 1/4 cup salt ( or to taste ) | 1/4 cup coarse salt ( or to taste ) | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 package sharp cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: In crock pot, combine beef, onion soup mix, wine and radishes. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cover and cook on high for 4 - 6 hours, or on low for 8 - 9 hours. Shred beef, serve hot with grated cheese.

title: Creamy Ricotta Cannoli
ingredients: 400 g ricotta shells | 2 shallots ( minced ) | 1/4 cup rice wine ( if using dry sherry, add more ) | 300 ml low-fat milk
instructions: Put some rice wine in a saucepan. Add shallots and boil over medium heat for 2 minutes. Add ricotta and turn into a colander set suspended over a bowl, let drain. Heat milk. Crush ricotta shells in a mortar. Put in a bowl, add a touch more, and stir to combine and set aside. Pour 2 tablespoons of milk into a pot, add shallots and cook over medium heat for 1 - 2 minutes. Add the drained ricotta and stir over medium heat for 2 - 3 minutes. Add enough of the liquid for the cream to just cover. Add the rum if using and gently fold through. Do not boil. The creamy ricotta will be light, creamy, sweet and sweet. Drain ricotta shells in a colander and add back into the pot. Stir over medium heat for 2 minutes or until just heated through.

title: Bluefish, Egg & Strawberry Pasta
ingredients: 600 g dried fusilli | 400 g red snapper or 400 g fresh bluefish, cut in chunks | 200 g egg substitute | 3/4 liter dashi | 100 g thinly sliced gingerroot or 1/2 inch grated gingerroot | 1/2 beef bouillon cube | 3 cups frozen strawberries | tortilla
instructions: Cut the salmon into bite sized chunks. Bring a large pot of water with the beef cubes to a boil with the ginger. Add the fusilli and cook for about 6 - 8 minutes. Meanwhile, make the egg substitute by beating the egg whites until they are thick but not dry, fold into the beaten egg and gently fold in the strawberries. Drain the pasta and put on a serving dish. Drain the snapper, cut into chunks, put on top of the pasta and pour over the egg mixture.

Random Ingredients: scotch bonnet pepper,raspberry,pecorino romano cheese,dill weed
title: Scotch Bonnet Pepper Ripe Bread
ingredients: 2 cans or bottles light beer ( schlenker's in the can ) | 10 scotch bonnet peppers, or 1 teaspoon ground scotch bonnet peppers | 4 tablespoons dried tarragon or 2 tablespoons dill weed | 4 -5 pinches powdered pecorino romano cheese, plus more for dusting
instructions: Pour the beer into a medium size bowl with the scotch bonnet peppers, tarragon, and about 1/2 tablespoon each of powdered pecorino and romano. Mix to blend. Place bread in a serving dish, and sprinkle with additional pecorino and romano. Serve.

title: Simple Italian Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans | 3 tablespoons tomato paste | 1 tablespoon dried oregano
instructions: In a medium bowl, mash cannellini beans with potato masher or a fork. Stir in tomato paste until well mixed. Sprinkle with oregano, and stir to combine. Chill in the refrigerator until serving. Garnish with grated parmesan cheese, if desired.

title: Italian Sausage Salad
ingredients: 1 lb hot italian sausage | 3 heads romaine lettuce | 1 cup hazelnuts, sliced, toasted, lightly ( or almonds ) | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar
instructions: Cut each sausage link in half and remove casings. Bake sausage links at 375°f. About 30 minutes before sausages are done, in large bowl, combine bread, hazelnuts, vinegar and vinegar. Tear off sausage skins and toss. Spread in individual serving bowl. Add sausage to bread mixture. Toss. Serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: pico de gallo,dijon mustard,prosciutto,oyster sauce,chicken broth
title: Pico De Gallo Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup chicken broth | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1/2 teaspoon prepared mustard | 1/4 cup pico de gallo ( pickled corn and black olives ) | 1/2 cup chopped prosciutto
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix chicken broth, dijon mustard, oyster sauce, and 1/2 teaspoon prepared mustard. Stir in pico de gallo. Transfer to serving bowl, and garnish with prosciutto.

title: Tex-Mex Dressing
ingredients: 1 package dry ranch-style dressing mix | 3/4 cup hot sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons guacamole
instructions: Stir ranch style salad dressing mix, hot sauce, and guacamole together in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: corkscrew macaroni,hi gluten flour,bell pepper,egg beater substitute,savory,water
title: Macaroni and Cheese With a Haggis (Savory) by Jennifer Iseraphan
ingredients: 1 package corkscrew macaroni ( or a small package equivalent ) | 2 1/2 cups water | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried sweet basil or 2 1/2 tablespoons basil leaves | 1/4 teaspoon ground savory | 1 large egg substitute ( eg egg beaters ) | 2 tablespoons hi-gluten flour | 1 small bell pepper, finely chopped ( green or red )
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions, drain. Meanwhile, in pot that the macaroni was cooked, combine water, basil, and savory. Heat to boiling. Add macaroni and cheese to boiling water. Stir well, then remove from heat. Meanwhile, heat a nonstick skillet until hot. Spray pan with a little bit of sesame oil. Add eggbeaters, increase heat to medium high, and sautee until mixture is frothy. Add flour, stir, and cook 1 minute, stirring slowly. Add bell pepper, increase heat to medium, and sautee about 2 minutes, until peppers turn color. Drain macaroni. Add to skillet and toss. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: thai red curry paste,sun tomato,italian turkey sausage,penne,clam,chicken bouillon granule,chili powder
title: Spicy Red Chili Glazed Sausages
ingredients: 2 ounces italian turkey sausage, casings removed | 1 tablespoon minced sun-dried tomato ( not packed in oil ) | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules | 1 teaspoon thai red curry paste | 1 lb penne ( spiral will work ) | fresh clams, in the shell
instructions: Cook the turkey and sun dried tomotoes in boiling water for 10 minutes or till sausage is no longer pink. Drain and set aside. Add next 5 ingredients except for pasta. Bring to a simmer, then lower to a simmer. Cook for 8 - 10 minutes. Stir in the cooked sausage. Stir in pasta and clam shells. Cook for 4 - 5 minutes or until pasta is tender.

title: The Spaniard’s Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup mexican-style oregano ( i use mexican oregano to make mine ) | 2 tablespoons chat masala | 2 tablespoons rice wine ( i prefer white, more authentic ) | 1 -2 slice prosciutto, chopped
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine the oregano, chat masala and rice wine. Over high heat bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium low and simmer uncovered until most of the liquid has been evaporated, about 9 minutes. Add a couple teaspoons of oil to a medium frying pan and warm a few seconds. Place the prosciutto around the rice and add to heat. Keep pan over direct heat just until the prosciutto is warm to the touch. Add a few tablespoons of warm broth to the pan and spoon a bit of the broth over the rice, then pour the rest into the pan. Stir and season with salt and pepper. Serve.

title: Kartoffelkloesse (Herbed Potatoes)
ingredients: 4 large baking potatoes, peeled and sliced 3/8 inch thick | 1 teaspoon dried herbs | 1 1 teaspoon dried dill
instructions: Cover potatoes with hot water. Set aside to soak for 30 minutes. Boil potatoes in the boiling water until tender, 20 to 30 minutes. Drain and serve while they are still hot.

title: Homemade Spicy Salt
ingredients: 1 cup coarse salt ( such as kosher salt ) | 1 cup coarse salt ( such as kosher salt ) | 1 1/2 cups coarse salt | 1 cup coarse salt | 1 cup dried oregano leaves | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried oregano leaves
instructions: Combine the coarse and coarse salt together in a large bowl or in your hand.

title: Crock Pot Clam Chowder
ingredients: 2 cans of canned clams with juice ( reserve juice ) | 2 cans of canned coffee beans | 1/2 cup cooking sherry | 1 tablespoon raspberry vinegar | chopped parsley ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Combine the canned clams with the reserved juice and the reserved clam juice and stir well. Pour into a crock pot and add the sherry and raspberry vinegar. Cook on low for 2 - 3 hours, or high for 3 - 4 hours stirring at least once in a while. Serve hot over noodles and garnish with parsley if desired.

title: Easy Blended Salsa
ingredients: 1 jar bottled chunky salsa | 1 teaspoon frank's red hot sauce
instructions: Put the salsa in a jar or bowl. Sprinkle the hot sauce over the salsa. Refrigerate until serving.

title: Guisado Con Maiz (White Hominy With Bread and Parsley)
ingredients: 2 cans white hominy, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup loosely packed fresh parsley leaves, chopped | 1/2 cup crumbled mexican queso frangelico ( or other anise-flavored caramel ) | 1 loaf crusty bread, cut into 1-inch cubes ( to yield 3 c total )
instructions: Place rinsed and drained hominy in a saucepan and add enough water to cover the ingredients. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low and simmer until the rinsed and seeded hominy is tender, about 30 minutes. Stir in parsley and set aside to cool until easy to handle. When cool, stir in crumbled frangelico. Serve warm. To serve, place a large serving platter on a portable board or portable burner, or in a glass bowl. Place one serving potato on the platter, and arrange the serving platter alongside. Spread crumbled frangelico over the entire surface of the potato.

title: Campfire Shrimp and Brown Rice
ingredients: 5 boneless, skinless chicken breast halves | 3 cups cooked brown rice | 1 cup peeled and deveined large shrimp | 1/2 cup sliced peppercorn, or to taste | 1/4 cup brown sauce, such as texas pete's
instructions: Preheat a grill for high heat, medium, or medium low. Cook the chicken breasts until no longer pink in the center, 5 to 7 minutes per side. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees f. Cut the chicken and shrimp lengthwise into strips about 1/2 inch wide and 1/3 inch thick.

Random Ingredients: soda cracker,spinach,plain yogurt,chuck,italian flat leaf parsley
title: Chilean Meatballs - No-Peel
ingredients: 1 lb chuck | 1 lb spinach, roughly chopped | 6 ounces italian style flat leaf parsley, chopped | 8 ounces plain yogurt | 7 ounces crushed soda crackers
instructions: Using a sharp cheese grater, grate 1 pound chuck into a large bowl.

title: Blueberry Guacamole
ingredients: 2 ripe avocados - peeled, pitted, and diced | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 cup fresh blueberries, picked over for storage
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the avocados, tomato sauce, and blueberries. Mix thoroughly. Transfer to a serving bowl, and serve while warm.

title: Gram's Yummy Yummies
ingredients: 3 large egg whites, room temp ( or equivalent amount egg white and 1 tb water ) | 4 cups powdered sugar | 4 limes, quartered ( or 1 tsp lime zest )
instructions: Beat egg whites until thick and soft peaks form. Slowly add cold sugar and continue beating until the sugar dissolves. Granish with a few mint leaves. Chill or freeze in a labeled freezer bag for up to 3 weeks.

title: Vegan French Toast - Tastes Like Olive Garden®
ingredients: 1 egg yolk | 1 tablespoon low-fat espresso or 1 tablespoon hot water | 1/8 teaspoon red curry paste | salt and pepper, to taste | 8 slices apricots
instructions: Pour the egg yolk into a mixing bowl. Add the espresso and curry paste, and gently mix. Pour into a bowl. Add salt and pepper to taste. Stir in the apricots to serve.

Random Ingredients: alfredo sauce,spicy pork sausage,rump roast,horseradish,turmeric powder,chicken leg,sambal oelek
title: Spicy Italian Crock Pot Chicken & Sausage
ingredients: 1 spanish spicy pork sausage ( i use hillshire farms sausage ) | 1 rump roast ( any cut will do ) | 1/2 cup spicy pork sausage fat ( can use more ) | 1/2 cup prepared horseradish | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 2 cans alfredo sauce | 1 tablespoon sambal oelek
instructions: Slice sausage into 2 rounds. Place slices in bottom of crock pot. Place the meat on top of the slices and sprinkle with salt and pepper to your liking. Mix the honey and horseradish until smooth, then add the turmeric. Add the chicken on the top of sausage and add the alfredo sauce. Cook on high for 3 to 4 hours, or low for 4 to 5 hours.

title: Lamb Cutlets With Fried Rice
ingredients: 4 lamb steaks | 1 cup bread crumbs | 2 tablespoons green cardamoms, crushed | 2 tablespoons dry bread crumbs | 1 tablespoon rice wine
instructions: Sprinkle lamb steaks with 1 cup of bread crumbs, then rub remaining 2 t. Of dry bread crumbs into meat. Press crushed cardamom into bread crumbs on both sides. Spray nonstick skillet on very high heat with cooking spray. Using a slotted spoon, cook meat on both sides until browned.

Random Ingredients: caraway seed,bean sprout,sherry wine,italian salad dressing,veal,cabbage
title: Veal-Stuffed Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 1 lb ground veal | 1/2 lb cabbage, large cored and finely shredded | 1/2 lb bean sprouts | 1/2 cup sherry wine | 1/2 cup bottled italian salad dressing | 1 1/2 teaspoons caraway seeds
instructions: Combine vegetable through caraway and mix well. With hands mix in sherry. Fill each cabbage leaf with mixture and place on heavy duty baking sheet. In small bowl, combine italian dressing. Pour dressing over cabbage rolls. Cover with foil. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour or until browned. Let cool 10 minutes.

title: Italian Pork Breakfast
ingredients: 1 lb pork roast | 1/2 lb eggplant | 2 scallions, chopped | 1 package dried rotini pasta
instructions: Cut the pork roast lengthwise, and make the cut into 2 inch pieces. Place all ingredients into a sauce pan. Bring to a boil, and then turn down to a simmer. Cook for 90 minutes. Add pasta and remove from heat.

title: Rosemary & Pear Cake
ingredients: 2 tablespoons flour | 100 g instant pear, finely chopped | 50 g mixed rosemary | 100 g sunflower seeds | 4 individual sponge cakes or 4 individual ramekin sponge cakes | 3 tablespoons coffee, cooking water
instructions: Place the flour, pear, rosemary & sunflower seeds in a bowl. Mix well. Tip about 1 tsp of the mixture into each sponge.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,chicken meat,tamari,potato traditional,sage
title: Papa Dave's Favorite Chicken Dinner #5FIX
ingredients: 1 bag simply potatoes traditional mashed potatoes | 12 pieces crispy crispy chicken meat ( for extra flavor ) | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 teaspoon dried sage | 1 teaspoon tamari or 1 teaspoon soy sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place diced potatoes on cookie sheet sprayed with non stick cooking spray and let stand for 6 - 8 hours. In large bowl, combine potato, chicken, oil and sage. Mix thoroughly. Pinch off pieces of potato mixture, and place on large sheet of parchment paper sprayed with non stick cooking spray and place in oven. Cook for 12 - 15 minutes or until crispy approximately, stirring with spatula. Remove from oven and let set on wax paper for up to 15 minutes. Enjoy.

title: Mexican White Bean Stew, 1-Pint
ingredients: 1 can refried beans | 4 tablespoons cornflour | 400 g vegetable stock or 400 g chicken stock | 3 tablespoons white wine vinegar | salsa ( to garnish )
instructions: Over high heat, stir fry beans until almost done. Lower heat, pour stock in and stir in cornflour until dissolved. Add vinegar until absorbed. When mixture is creamy, transfer to a jug and mix in a small amount of salsa. Serve over rice, with a green salad.

title: Easy Trout Biscuits
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds whole trout, cleaned and cut into pieces | 1/2 teaspoon dried garlic | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1/2 cup self-rising flour
instructions: Place the trout into a medium glass baking dish. Mix the dried garlic and garam masala into the trout, and sprinkle the fish with the masala mixture. Add the flour, and mix all together well. Turn the mixture into a baking dish, and refrigerate 30 minutes or overnight, turning once. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Bake the biscuits 8 - 10 minutes in the preheated oven, until they are golden on top.

title: Niter Kebab - Spicy Indian Spice Rub
ingredients: 1/4 cup fenugreek seeds, crushed ( kesar ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground turmeric powder
instructions: Combine fenugreek, turmeric, and ground fenugreek in an airtight glass jar and shake to combine. Allow seasoning to blend.

title: Lingtons With Lemons
ingredients: 500 g lard | 600 g caster sugar | 100 ml dark soy sauce | 2 meyer lemons
instructions: Heat the cast iron casserole over a very low heat so that the fat melts, this is done before your guests arrive. Cut the lard into small slices, this way the thinner and easier to cut. You need about 8 slices of lard. Put the sugar in a saucepan and add a couple of tablespoons of water. Crush the meyer lemons coarsely, this will give you a wonderful zest and a great zing. Add a tablespoon of dark soy, the brown sugar, the rest of the water and bring to the boil over a gentle heat. Add about half a tablespoon of sherry as the sugar syrup starts to thicken. Add half a tablespoon more if necessary. Take off the heat and leave for about 10 minutes. When the mixture is cool and a nice bonding together, remove the bitter rind, most of it. Add some of the zest back to the mixture, mix well then put back into the saucepan. Keep stirring and bring to the boil again, keep stirring until the mixture thickens and is easy to stir again. Take off the heat. Cut the lard into long, thin slices and then fry in hot oil until they are golden, turning them over so they are golden on all sides. They should take about 10 minutes to cook. Serve and keep in a cool, dry place.

title: Tees Spiced Vegemite
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups vegemite | 2 teaspoons ground coriander powder | 1/2 teaspoon cumin | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,almond,vegetable oil olive,soy sauce,cinnamon graham cracker,turnip,almond extract
title: Chinese Almond Veggies
ingredients: 1 lb turnip, peeled | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1 tablespoon almond extract | 1 cinnamon graham cracker, large | 1/4 cup sliced almonds, toasted
instructions: Place turnips vertically in a pot of boiling water.

title: Rice Noodle Kebabs
ingredients: 12 ounces rice noodles ( kari, or any noodle can also be used ) | 6 ounces fat-free yogurt | 1 teaspoon cinnamon
instructions: Soak rice noodles in lukewarm water for about 30 minutes. Drain and rinse well and set aside. Place noodles and half the yogurt in a food processor and process to roughly form a smooth paste. Pour paste into a bowl and stir in cinnamon. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve. Thread noodles onto the skewers, and grill for 1 to 2 minutes or until cooked through. Serve hot with remaining yogurt.

Random Ingredients: pepperoni,yellow onion,lemon juice zest,zucchini,worcestershire sauce,topping,penne,kidney bean
title: Totally Chewy Penne Salad
ingredients: 1 package penne, cooked | 8 ounces frozen whipped topping, thawed | 1/4 cup lemon juice ( or to taste ) | 1 yellow onion, diced | 1/4 cup lemon juice ( or to taste ) | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon pepperoni ( optional, i used pepperoni flakes ) | 1 package shredded kraft shredded cheddar cheese or ( 4 ounce ) package mozzarella cheese
instructions: Cook penne pasta according to package directions.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti,maple syrup,green bell pepper,red onion,pork roast,hard egg,vanilla sugar,chicken stock cube
title: Pork Spaghetti
ingredients: 200 g pork roast | 2 large hard-boiled eggs | 1 small red onion | 1 green bell pepper | 1/2 tablespoon maple syrup | 2 chicken stock cubes ( or 2 beef or 2 turkey bouillon cubes ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 200 g spaghetti
instructions: Boil spaghetti according to instructions on package. Slice pork up and onion into thin rings, then slice into strips. Slice bell pepper into 1/2 inch lengths, then cut into slices. Add all ingredients to the boiling spaghetti and simmer for 20 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Sweet and Savory Noodle Cheesecake With Ham and Jalapeno
ingredients: 1 box rice vermicelli ( thin sheets ) | 2 tablespoons coriander powder | 12 ounces ham ( cooked and crumbled ) or 12 ounces jalapeno sausage ( cooked and crumbled ) | 1 1/2 cups cream cheese, softened | 1/4 cup sugar | 4 tablespoons sour cream | 1 ounce kombu ( japanese horseshake ) | 2 tablespoons lemon peel ( julienned )
instructions: For best results, cook the rice and noodles first, then rinse them in cold water. In a small bowl combine the coriander and salt. Set aside 2 tb of the coriander, for garnish. Place this dry ingredient in a mortar with a pestle and pound with a rolling pin until fine in small crumbs. Remove and set aside. In a small bowl mix together the cream cheese and sugar until soft, then set aside until ready to use. Line the bottom of a 9 inch square glass dish with the rice noodles and then sprinkle half of the reserved coriander over the noodles. Place the ham on top of the rice noodles, then top with the cream cheese mixture. In a small dish combine the remaining coriander with the kombu and lemon peel, then set aside. Sprinkle the remaining coriander over the cream cheese and ham. Place the remaining ramen noodles on top and sprinkle with more kombu. Sprinkle with the remaining coriander and refrigerate. Refrigerate for up to 3 days or freeze up to 1 month. Before serving, slice into bite size pieces and serve cold.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,scotch bonnet pepper,green cabbage,strawberry,saffron strand,prime rib roast,grain white rice
title: Scottish Prime Rib Dinner, Southern Colcannon, Colcannon, and Fresh Strawberries
ingredients: prime rib roast, bones and silver skin removed | 250 g green cabbage, cored | 1 scotch bonnet pepper, seeded | 2 teaspoons coriander powder | 2 tablespoons rawsage leaves or 2 fresh sage leaves, roughly chopped | 250 g whole-grain white rice | 3 -4 saffron strands, depending on size
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180c, 400f, gas mark remove the meat from the bones to a roasting tin in a large bowl with the silver skin on. Cut off all the white and light green part from around the roast and discard. Cut the dark green, white part with the stem part into 1 cm cubes and scatter over the meat and scatter over the scotch bonnet pepper. Add all of the sage leaves or sage leaves and mix everything together. Place the roast in the oven and bake, basting occasionally, until the outside is brown and the meat is very tender, about 90 minutes. Let the roast rest, cover with foil and rest again for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, place the rice and saffron in a pan and pour over 100ml boiling water. Stir until half of the water is absorbed, cover, and set aside. Heat oven to 200c, gas mark remove the tin, slice the meat into thin slices to serve, sprinkle over the saffron and serve. To serve, arrange a layer of saffron rice around the plate and put the warm meat slices around the rice.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,chuck,kalamata olive,thai red curry paste,double cream,pork shoulder,arborio rice
title: Lobcrumbed Pork Vindaloo
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs chuck or 2 1/2 lbs blade steaks | 2 1/2 lbs pork shoulder | 4 1/2 tablespoons thai red curry paste | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom pod, lightly crushed | 2 cups arborio rice | 1/2 cup kalamata olive, pitted, coarsely chopped | 2 cups double cream
instructions: Slice meat, cutting across the grain into 1 1/2 inch cubes. Put meat in a bowl with the curry paste and cardamom. Marinate 1 hour or overnight. Cook rice, in a 10 inch skillet, heat oil over moderate heat until hot but not smoking. Remove from heat. Add rice, olives and cream and cook, stirring constantly just until creamy. Return to skillet and simmer, covered, stirring occasionally until liquid is absorbed, about 3 minutes. Serve with curry.

title: Chinese Style Black Pepper Seasoning (Mok Goo Cuon)
ingredients: 12 black peppercorns | 1 serrano pepper, seeded and minced
instructions: Grind peppercorns coarsely in a spice grinder or mortar and pestle. Blend or process remaining ingredients in a mortar and pestle. Store in an airtight glass jar.

Random Ingredients: neufchatel cheese,chicken stock cube,chinese barbecue pork,grain rice,water,cinnamon
title: Simple, Healthy and Delicious Chinese Baked Pork With Rice
ingredients: 500 g chinese barbecue pork, skinned and cut into cubes | 200 g neufchatel cheese, cut into cubes | 1/3 cup uncooked long grain rice | 375 ml chicken stock or 375 ml vegetable stock | 1/2 teaspoon instant cinnamon | 2 tablespoons water
instructions: Preheat oven to 150c. Place the beef, pork and cheese in a large ovenproof dish. Add the rice, stock, cinnamon and water. Cook in the oven for 20 minutes, or until the top of the beef and pork are cooked through and the rice feels tender.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,taco sauce,pineapple juice,salmon steak,coleslaw mix,wonton skin
title: Pineapple Glazed Salmon Wontons
ingredients: 1/2 cup pineapple juice | 3/4 cup coleslaw mix | 2 -3 tablespoons taco sauce | 1 lb salmon steak | cooking oil | 12 wonton skins
instructions: To make glaze, in small bowl combine pineapple juice and taco sauce. Add salmon, coat and refrigerate until ready to sauté in a sauté pan coated with cooking oil. Preheat oven to 350°f put wonton skins on baking tray. Brush tops of skins with reserved pineapple glaze. Bake at 350°f for 10 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Mama Corbasi's Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 2 cups finely shredded green cabbage | 1 can sliced black olives, drained | 1/4 cup chopped fresh oregano | 1/2 cup chopped raw nuts, optional garnish ( optional )
instructions: Arrange the cabbage in a bowl. Mix the olives, oregano and nuts. Pour over the cabbage and toss to blend.

title: Baked Dutch Peanut Beef Sandwich-Press
ingredients: 1 tablespoon brown onion, finely minced | 1 lb boneless beef chuck or 1 lb top round beef, very lean | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant yeast | 1 1/2 teaspoons pepper | 1 teaspoon peanut oil
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees. Dice onion. Slice beef into 1 inch chunks about 1 1/2 inch wide. Combine the first six ingredients in large, shallow baking pan. Cover pan with waxed paper and plastic wrap and place dish in oven. Bake about 3 hours or until the meat is tender, stirring once. Heat oil in non stick skillet over medium heat. Quickly add beef mixture and cook just until heated through. Spoon warm beef onto a cutting board and separate into small pieces. Place in single layer over a bowl and cover loosely with waxed paper.

title: White Spiced Herimos
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprig ( kamaguriko, available at asian grocery stores ) | 1 slice swiss cheese, 1/4 inch thick | 2 -4 tablespoons white miso paste | 1 sprig fresh mint ( may sub parsley for a spinkle of mint )
instructions: Heat 1 teaspoon of the spinkle dried thyme in a 1 inch nonstick skillet over high heat and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute. Turn off the heat and allow to cool for 1 minute. Cut cheese slices into 1/8 inch slices, and place 1 slice of cheese in the pan and sprinkle on the thyme. Return all of the cheese to the skillet, add the miso paste and cook over moderate heat until the cheese has just melted, about 1 minute. Transfer the hot spiced herimos to a serving dish, top with the remaining slice of cheese and sprinkle with mint.

title: Faux Bombay
ingredients: 400 g of greek bocconcini ( approximately 3 ounces each ) | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 teaspoon monosodium glutamate ( msg )
instructions: Mix it all together and store in an air tight container. The flavor gets better with age.

title: Simple Texas Caviar
ingredients: 2 cups chopped grape tomatoes | 16 ounces diced green peppers | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh cilantro
instructions: Combine the tomatoes, peppers, cilantro, and remaining ingredients in a large bowl. Cover and stir well. Cover and chill for 1 to 2 hours.

title: Sriracha Burritos
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated asafoetida powder | 12 tortillas
instructions: Heat a cast iron skillet or heavy skillet over medium heat. Add the asafoetida, and press it against the side of the skillet to form a caramelized mixture on the hot side. When it starts to release some of its liquid, flip it over and cook for an additional 2 minutes, or until it is slightly browned on the bottom. Turn it over again and spread it out on the hot cast iron skillet. When browned, add the tortillas and heat them for about 30 seconds on each side, until they are slightly charred on the bottom but still holding their shape, but still holding their shape. Place them in a bowl, sprinkle with the desired amount of salt, and serve.

Random Ingredients: lime,spanish onion,kaffir lime leaf,sea salt,orange zest,mint
title: Mint-Orange Ceviche
ingredients: 2 lbs spanish onions, finely chopped | 1 large kaffir lime leaf | 3/4 cup of fresh mint, coarsely chopped | 1 lb fresh orange zest | 1/4 cup fresh lime juice or 1/4 cup water | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Combine all ingredients, blend, pour into a well oiled container, cover and chill. Use immediately or refrigerate. Serve with spanish rice. It can be stored for up to several days in the refrigerator.

title: Cauliflower ( Indian Cauliflower) and Toast
ingredients: 1 large cauliflower floret, shredded ( i use small whole florets ) | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 slice white bread ( preferably indian bread, cut into small pieces )
instructions: If the cauliflower is big, cut it in half lengthwise. Steam it over low heat in a steamer basket. When the cauliflower is half cooked, transfer it to a serving dish. If the cauliflower has any leftover water in it, drain it and let it sit over low heat for a minute or two to allow it to cool. If you are using the bread, break it into small pieces and toast it. Keep an eye on it so that it does not burn. Transfer the cauliflower to the serving dish. Crack open the slice of red rice. The small slices should form a large criss cross pattern on each slice. Cover each fried cauliflower slice with the criss cross pattern on the bread. Garnish it with parsley, chutney or any other desired garnish and serve immediately with any curry or satay sauce you enjoy along with your meal.

Random Ingredients: ham,thai chili sauce,white pepper,granny smith apple,lasagna noodle,sunflower oil,salsa
title: Quick Apple or Potato Lasagnas
ingredients: 500 g lasagna noodles | 3 tablespoons sunflower oil | 400 g finely chopped ham | 1/2 cup salsa | 2 tablespoons thai sweet chili sauce | 1 small granny smith apple | salt and white pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 190c or 140c if you have a fan forced oven. Cook lasagna noodles in a large pan of boiling salted water, al dente. Drain and set aside. In a large saucepan, heat the oil over a low heat, then add the ham and cook for 6 - 8 minutes or until golden. Add the salsa, chili sauce, apple and noodles and toss to combine. Lay out one large sheet of greaseproof paper, lay it out on a work surface, then spread a layer of cooked lasagna base. Add about 1 - ¾ cups of filling and top with another half cup of filling. Roll up from the long side, pinch to seal and place seam side down on the greaseproof paper lined baking tray. Repeat until all the lasagna is used. Brush each roll with oil, season well and bake for 40 minutes or until golden and crisp.

Random Ingredients: cilantro,cardamom pod,stew vegetable,tomato basil pasta sauce,saffron,jalapeno pepper,peanut butter
title: Chef John's Veggies in Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 12 ounces stew vegetables, preferably baby bell peppers, cut in 1-inch pieces | 1 jar tomato and basil pasta sauce | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/2 cup peanut butter, smooth | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1 jalapeno pepper, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon fresh cilantro, chopped
instructions: Heat stew vegetables in a large pot over medium heat until all the pieces are slightly browned and tender, about 5 minutes. Stir in pasta sauce, salt, peanut butter, cardamom pod, and jalapeno. Cover, and simmer 15 minutes. Stir in cilantro just before serving.

Random Ingredients: beef mince,peanut butter,bouquet garni,wide egg noodle,mandarin orange
title: Easy Beef and Noodles (Canned)
ingredients: 500 g beef mince | 1 bouquet garni ( parsley, thyme, sage, caraway seeds, oregano and rosemary or anything else you like from your fridge ) | 1 can mandarin oranges | 100 ml crunchy peanut butter | 1 packet wide egg noodles
instructions: Brown the mince and the bouquet garni till cooked, drain off excess fat. Add the orange canning juices, peanut butter and noodles. Let sit in fridge for at least 1 hour, stirring occasionally, but longer is good. Serve with mashed potato.

Random Ingredients: mascarpone cheese,head cauliflower,almond extract,kernel corn,rosemary,parmigiano reggiano cheese,potato chip
title: Rosemary Mashed Potatoes (With Roasted Garlic) With Cauliflower
ingredients: 3 cups potatoes chips ( crushed ) | 1 small head cauliflower ( sliced into small florets ) | 4 1/2 ounces mascarpone cheese | 1 tablespoon rosemary | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1/2 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese ( grated ) | 2 tablespoons whole kernel corn
instructions: Preheat oven to 350'f place potatoes in a small bowl, drizzle with 1 teaspoon of the olive oil and toss to coat. Place on the bottom shelf of the oven and roast for 10 - 15 minutes, or until golden brown, turning halfway through the roasting time. Meanwhile, place cauliflower with remaining ingredients in a colander, sprinkle with salt and toss, coating veggies with the mixture. Serve immediately or refrigerate for later use.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,hamburger,pear,grain white rice,garlic salt,coffee,tomato ketchup,sausage
title: Beef Lovers' Rice
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups uncooked long grain white rice | 2 tablespoons instant coffee | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 pound lean ground sirloin steak | 1/2 pound smoked sausage, chopped | 2 cans stewed tomatoes with ketchup | 7 fluid ounces heinz irish beer | 1/2 cup maraschino cherries, finely chopped
instructions: In a pot, combine the rice and coffee. Season with garlic salt. Cook uncovered over low heat, stirring occasionally, for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, in a large skillet, cook the ground sirloin and sausage over medium heat until browned. Drain off any excess fat and stir in the tomatoes with ketchup, beer and choclate. Add the beef mixture and the rice. Mix until thoroughly combined. Cover the skillet and continue cooking over low heat for 30 minutes, or until most of the liquid is absorbed and the rice is tender.

title: Aussie Beef and Turnip Wedges
ingredients: 1 cup light cream cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons yeast | 1 teaspoon icing sugar | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs skirt steaks, cut into 2 inch dice | 1 turnip, cut into wedges | 3 stalks celery, cut into wedges | fresh ginger ( optional )
instructions: Mix together the cream cheese, yeast and icing sugar. Spray the steaks with oil and place in a ziploc bag. Drain the liquid from the bag into another bowl. Add the steaks, turning to coat. Marinate about 1 hour in the fridge or up to 1 hour. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Bake for 25 minutes or until cooked thru. Meanwhile, remove the meat from the marinade and place in a bowl. Add the turnips and celery and mix until coated. Stir in ginger slices and serve warm.

title: Melt in Your Mouth Mexican Chicken
ingredients: 1 broiler-fryer chicken, quartered or ( 4 ounce ) chicken breast | 2 tablespoons cheez whiz | 1 tablespoon tequila
instructions: Rub the outside of the chicken with tequila. Rub the inside with the tequila. Place the chicken on a rack in a shallow roasting pan or roasting pan that has been coated with cooking spray, brush with oil then rub with a mixture of the two. Bake in a 500 degree f oven for 30 to 40 minutes or until tender.. To serve, slice the chicken.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean,guinness stout,vanilla ice cream,red chilies,coffee liqueur,spice
title: Drunk Refrito
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans | 1/2 cup guinness stout | 1/2 cup coffee liqueur | 6 whole dried red chilies, stemmed and chopped | spices ( optional ) | vanilla ice cream ( optional )
instructions: Drain the pinto beans and transfer them to a mixing bowl. Stir in the remaining ingredients and chill. Serve in an ice cream cone or burrito depts.

title: Caramelized Hot Oil
ingredients: 1 1/2 pints hot oil | 15 fresh thyme sprigs, plus extra | thyme sprigs, for garnish | 2 tablespoons oil | 8 -10 cups water
instructions: Heat the whole thing gently and slowly in an oven that has a convection oven and a convection oven of 375 f to heat. Heat the oil in a big pan until almost smoking before adding the thyme. This will take a while to achieve a good aroma, but be patient and keep going, stirring. If at this stage it's not getting dark, add a tiny bit of water, to taste. Remove the thyme sprigs and thyme sprigs, and pour on hot oil. Let the oil cool down a bit then whisk in 2 tbsp of water. It will look a bit runny but keep stirring. Pour the mixture in a nice, sterilized jar and store in the fridge. You can also use it as a dipping sauce when you decorate the hot oil. Use in recipes calling for the thyme sprigs and thyme.

title: Easy Chile Sauce
ingredients: 3 cans whole peeled tomatoes with juice | 2 cans green chile peppers
instructions: Pour the tomato juice through a strainer set over a bowl. Chop the chile peppers in batches in a food processor. Transfer to a saucepan and pour the tomato juice into the mixture. Use immediately or refrigerate and use within 2 days.

title: Fur Goshti
ingredients: 1 package penne ( farfalle ) | 1 pinch saffron | 1 pinch asafoetida powder
instructions: Bring a pot of water to a boil. Add saffron. Boil for 1 minute. Drain water and set aside. Bring another pot of water to a boil. Add penne and boil for at least 15 - 20 minutes. Drain well. Return penne to pot and add all the ingredients. Cover and cook until the pasta is heated through.

Random Ingredients: gold tequila,chocolate,dark soy sauce,beef tenderloin,creole seasoning,meat
title: Gatsby's Grilled Beef Tataki
ingredients: 1 beef tenderloin, trimmed | 1/2 cup dark soy sauce | 1/2 cup soy sauce | 1/2 cup golden tequila | 3 tablespoons creole seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon chopped candied meat, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Place the beef tenderloin between 2 sheets of plastic wrap, and pound with a meat mallet to 1/4 inch thickness.
