Mix the dark and light soy sauces, tequila, creole seasoning, and candied meat together in a bowl until the sugar is dissolved. Spread one side of the beef slices with the soy sauce mixture.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,tamari,marshmallow,poblano chile,golden raisin,white sugar,lentil,nutritional yeast
title: Mexican-Lentil Spread
ingredients: 2 packages prewashed whole meal frozen lentils | 1 jar whole marshmallows | 1/2 cup nutritional yeast | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 1/2 cup dry white sugar | 3 poblano chiles, finely chopped | 1/2 cup golden raisin, chopped | 2 tablespoons tamari
instructions: Preheat oven according to package directions. Place lentils, marshmallows, nutritional yeast, chili powder, sugar, poblanos, raisins and tamari in a large bowl. Spray an 8x8 inch baking dish with non stick cooking spray. Spread the lentils evenly in the pan. Bake on middle rack of oven until lentils are tender and bubbly, approximately 35 to 40 minutes. Serve warm with grated cheese, sour cream, salsa, or guacamole.

Random Ingredients: wondra flour,penne pasta,coriander leaf,thai red curry paste,canola oil,walnut,green cardamom pod
title: Pasta With Indian Walnut Sauce
ingredients: 12 ounces penne pasta ( uncooked ) | 1 tablespoon canola oil or 1 tablespoon ghee | 1 -2 tablespoon thai red curry paste, to taste | 1/2 tablespoon thai green cardamom pods | 6 -8 ounces wondra flour | 1/2 cup chopped walnuts | fresh coriander leaves
instructions: Cook the pasta according to package directions. Heat the oil or ghee in a pan, add the curry paste and cook until the oil begins to leave the sides of the pan. Add the cardamom pods and cook for a few seconds. Add the pasta and coat with the curry paste. Simmer for 1 to 2 minutes. Serve immediately. Serve sprinkled with walnuts, coriander, & remaining curry paste. Cooks note, the walnuts impart a distinctive taste to the pasta. Also, if using uncooked pasta, cook at least 2 or 3 hours and check for readiness every 15 minutes. If cooking on a dry pan, cook at least 15 to 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,rosemary,celery seed,milk powder,fettuccine,wheat lasagna noodle,soya sauce,red onion
title: Easy Creamy Fettuccine Lasagna
ingredients: 8 ounces dry fettuccine | 5 ounces light soya sauce ( low sodium or low fat ) | 3/4 cup milk powder | 2 tablespoons finely chopped red onions | 3 ounces gruyere cheese, coarsely grated ( about 4 ounces ) | 1 package whole wheat lasagna noodles, cooked and drained ( i used the thin version ) | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh rosemary | 1/2 teaspoon celery seed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Cook pasta according to package directions, set aside. In a small bowl, blend soya sauce, milk, onions, cheese and rosemary or celery seed. Spread 1/3 cup sauce mixture into the bottom of a 9 x 13 baking dish.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,sirloin,yellow bell pepper,creamy peanut butter
title: Peanut Butter Beef Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sirloin, thinly sliced | 1 yellow bell pepper, chopped | 1 celery rib, chopped | 1/2 cup creamy peanut butter
instructions: Combine sliced sirloin and bell pepper. Whisk together peanut butter and celery. Stir into meat mixture. Cover and simmer slowly for 5 - 6 minutes or until meat is cooked through.

title: Sweet Onion Jam-Dip
ingredients: 4 large sweet vidalia onions, peeled | 2 1/2 cups caster sugar
instructions: Place onions and sugar in a pan and heat gently, stirring occasionally until sugar has dissolved & onions are soft. Stir in water or stock if mixture is quite dry. Cover and cook for about 1 hour. The temperature should reach 160c, and when cooked, test for firmness, but if it's still too hard, continue cooking for a few minutes longer. Leave to cool slightly then slice into thick wedges. Refrigerate jam at least 2 weeks before serving.

Random Ingredients: lime juice zest,kielbasa,gingerroot,salt pepper,xanthan gum,mussel,navy bean
title: Grilled Kielbasa and Mussels With Zinfandel
ingredients: 2 lbs kielbasa, cut into diagonal slices about 2 inches long and 1/3 inch thick, with tapered ends snipped off ( or 1 1/2 lbs smoked sausage ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons unrefined unbleached cane syrup or 1 1/2 tablespoons unsweetened light molasses | 1 lime, juice and zest of | salt and pepper | 1 teaspoon dried gingerroot, minced | 1 can small mussels, scrubbed and debearded ( about 20 ) | 1 cup light navy beans
instructions: Preheat grill. For the kielbasa, place sausage, syrup, lime zest, salt, pepper, and ginger in a large bowl and toss. For the mussels, drain any mussels that are open, then add them to the sausage mixture along with the navy beans. Toss to mix seasonings, add salt to taste. Brush the grill with oil and preheat to medium high. Spoon sausage mixture onto the grill, close grill lid and grill, stirring occasionally, about 6 - 7 minutes or until mussels are just opened. Turn kielbasa and grill, stirring frequently with a wooden spoon, until golden, about 8 - 9 minutes longer. Serve with salsa or lemon wedges to soak up the flavor. Variation, for a twist, sprinkle some dried cayenne peppers on top of kielbasa prior to grilling. Serve with rice and perhaps a salad on the side, or with lemon wedges to dip in.

title: Chinese Cognac Colcannon
ingredients: 1/2 cup sweet unsulphured aged french cognac | 1/4 cup port wine ( not sweet dessert wine. this would have had alcohol content. ) | 2 heads chinese cabbage, sliced ( each 1 inch long )
instructions: Place half the cabbage into a nonreactive container. Combine remaining cabbage with cognac and port over medium heat in a small bowl or saucepan. Bring to a simmer. Cover and reduce heat to low. Simmer 15 - 20 minutes or until all the liquid has been absorbed by the cabbage. Remove from heat and set aside. In a large bowl, add the wine mixture and the remaining cabbage. Toss until coated. Refrigerate, covered, at least 2 hours. Serve.

title: Kielbasa
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs pork | 1/4 - 1/2 lb pepperoni | flour | olive oil | 1/4 - 1/2 bottle vodka
instructions: Cut pork into 1 1/2 slices. Dredge slices in flour. Fry in hot olive oil. Grind pepperoni. Combine with pork pieces and vodka. Cover and cook on warm.

title: Couscous and Mushroom Salad
ingredients: 1 cup couscous | 1 cup button mushroom | 1 cup chopped walnuts | 1 can whole mixed chilies | 1/3 cup balsamic vinegar | 1 teaspoon arrowroot
instructions: Cook couscous according to directions on pack. Chop mushrooms and place on a plate. Sprinkle walnuts over salad. Drain chilies through a coffee filter if you like a stronger flavour. Pour vinegret on top of salad and toss. Add the other salad ingredients if desired. Enjoy.

title: Veal and Sausage Wrapped in Oatmeal
ingredients: 2 lbs ground veal | 2 lbs bulk hot italian sausages, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 lb ground pork shoulder | 2/3 cup catsup | 2/3 cup dry-roasted porridge oats | 2 tablespoons snipped fresh cilantro | 1 box frozen chopped spinach, thawed & squeezed dry | 2 tablespoons brandy or 2 tablespoons whiskey
instructions: Combine meats in medium bowl. Add worcestershire sauce and toss to coat. Cover with towel. In large stockpot of boiling, salted water, place rolls and cook 10 minutes or until tender. Cool roll mixture. With slotted spatula, remove rolls from colander. Remove centers from rolls.

Random Ingredients: mirin,catfish fillet,vegetable oil cooking spray,red chilies,raisin,brown rice,ginger,yeast
title: Sweet Chilli Catfish
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 1/2 cups cooked brown rice | 1 pinch dry yeast ( or other yeast ) | 1 tablespoon mirin | 1 1/2 teaspoons salt | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ginger, grated | 4 red chilies, seeded and finely sliced | 2 tablespoons raisins | 1 cup chopped cooked catfish fillet ( halibut, salmon or haddock work well )
instructions: Bring a saucepan of lightly salted water to the boil. Stir in the rice & yeast & cover the pan. Allow to stand for 10 mins, then stir in the mirin, salt, ginger & chillies. Stir the fish through the rice mixture, then spoon into an oiled 20 x 30cm swiss roll pan. Arrange the fish on top & brush the tops with the cooking spray. Cover with greaseproof paper, then tightly & let rise in a warm, draught free spot for 45 - 50 mins until the rice has doubled in size. Heat the oven to 180°c/fan 160°c/gas cut slits on top of the cake & prick the top of the cake a few times, then bake in the pre heated oven for 5 - 6 mins, until the top has turned a deep golden brown crust. Serve the catfish with the warm rice.

Random Ingredients: leek,red kidney bean,margarine,mexican cheese cotija,basmati rice
title: Mexican Rice & Bean Bake With Crisp Dill Sour Cream
ingredients: 2 tablespoons margarine, divided | 1 large leek, sliced | 2 cups basmati rice, cooked and cooled | 13 1/2 ounces red kidney beans, drained | 1/2 cup mexican blend cheese, grated ( or cotija cheese )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f oil a baking sheet. In a large fry pan, heat 3 tablespoons margarine, add the leeks over medium heat, saute for 5 minutes, till the soft and transparent. Add the rice, toss to coat. Transfer to the freezer to defrost for about 15 minutes. In a saucepan, heat remaining 1 tablespoon of margarine, add black beans and bring to a boil. Cover the pan and reduce heat to low. Cook for 5 minutes, till all of the liquid is absorbed and the beans are cooked. Remove from the heat and stir in 1/3 of the rice and 1/3 of the cheese. Spoon the bean mixture into the greased baking sheet. Top with the remaining 1/3 of the bean mixture. Bake for 25 minutes or until bubbly and golden brown.

title: Tortelli Di Rigati (Rigati with Parmesan Cheese)
ingredients: 1 lb romano cheese | 1 package grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In a small baking dish, combine grated romano cheese and grated parmesan cheese. Mix with a fork until well distributed. Press mixture into a greased 9x9 inch cake pan. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes. Let cool for 5 minutes before removing to a serving dish. Note, if romano cheese and parmesan cheese are not used in part of the cheese mixture, you can substitute romano cheese. Enjoy.

title: Cauliflower and Pepper Salad
ingredients: 1 medium cauliflower, halved crosswise, then cut into 3/4-inch florets | 1 small yellow bell pepper, cut into thin strips | 1 teaspoon lemon zest ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f.

title: Sauce Au Gratin
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups double cream | 2 hot sauce, such as tabasco or anjou | 1 can sliced black mushrooms, drained
instructions: Heat the cream to boiling and add the hot sauce. Cook until the sauce is thick and syrupy. Stir in the mushrooms and serve immediately.

title: Zeytoon
ingredients: 3 lbs yellow squash | 3 teaspoons poppy seeds, roasted | 1 pinch saffron strand | 1 tablespoon tahini | 1 tablespoon horseradish ( optional )
instructions: Cut the squash in 2 inch chunks. Place all the ingredients in a colander. Cover and let drain in the sink overnight. Place the squash and the marinade in a bowl. Cover and let the flavours meld. Serve right away.

Random Ingredients: tea,chicken part,tiger shrimp,garlic salt,vidalia onion,baking soda
title: Spicy Shrimp Loaf
ingredients: 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 1/2 lbs lean boneless chicken parts, trimmed of fat | 2 large vidalia onions, peeled and sliced | 2 cans or bottles dry tea, brewed | 12 frozen tiger shrimp, thawed and patted dry
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Mix together garlic salt and baking soda.

title: Fattoush
ingredients: 1/2 cup vinegar | 2 ounces dried sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 3 tablespoons pimentos, preferably smoked paprika or 3 tablespoons pickled jalapeno pepper | 1 tablespoon cumin seed | 2 tablespoons fresh chervil, chopped
instructions: In a bowl, mix vinegar, sun dried tomatoes, pimentos, cumin, and chervil. Stir well. Store in the refrigerator for up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: red lentil,chili garlic sauce,red potato,sea salt
title: Hot Chili Garlic Red Lentil Dish
ingredients: 1 medium red potato, halved | 2 cans red lentils | 1/4 cup red chili-garlic sauce ( thai ) | 5 teaspoons sea salt, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place sweet potato on a baking sheet and drizzle with 1 tablespoon chili garlic sauce. Bake sweet potato in the preheated oven until easily pierced with a skewer, about 45 minutes. Transfer to a food processor or blender and puree until almost smooth, about 1 minute. Return seasoned red lentils to pot and mix in chili garlic sauce. Season with sea salt, or more to taste.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,rom tomato,turkey,chicken stock,seasoning salt,oregano leaf,asparagus
title: Roasted Turkey and Asparagus
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 teaspoon oregano leaves | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 cup canned chicken stock | 1 tablespoon roganere tomatoes, finely diced | 2 lbs asparagus, tips trimmed | 1/2 lb whole turkey, sliced
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Combine seasoned salt, oregano, ginger garlic paste, stock, roganere, tomatoes in roasting pan. Cover. Bake about 1 1/2 hours or until Turkey is done.

Random Ingredients: lemon thyme,enchilada sauce,malt vinegar,romano cheese,pastry,taco seasoning mix,confectioner sugar
title: Chef John's Enchilada Pie
ingredients: 2 tablespoons lemon thyme | 3 1/4 pounds lean ground round | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning mix | 1 package dry taco seasoning mix | 9 inches pastry for a double crust pie | 6 cups enchilada sauce | 1/2 cup malt vinegar | 1 cup grated romano cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place the lemon thyme into a large, deep saucepan with 2 tablespoons water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium low. Stir in sugar, and simmer until syrup is very dark in color, about 15 minutes. Remove from heat, and stir in lemon thyme. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place ground round into a skillet over medium heat, and cook until evenly brown. Drain any excess grease, and stir in 2 tablespoons taco seasoning mix into the ground round. Spread the ground round into the bottom of the 9 inch pie plate. Spread about 1/3 cup enchilada sauce into the dish, and sprinkle 1/3 cup of grated romano cheese over the entire top. Spread another 1/3 cup of enchilada sauce over the cheese, and cover with pastry for a lid. Bake for 20 minutes in the preheated oven, until crust is golden brown and sauce has thickened slightly. Allow to cool 5 minutes before slicing.

Random Ingredients: hamburger,chicken bouillon powder,hot red chili pepper,cream tartar,clam,serrano pepper,brandy,salsa
title: Mexican Clam Chowder
ingredients: 6 cups bottled clam juice or 6 cups bottled clam juice | 8 ounces fresh cream of tartar | 6 teaspoons chicken bouillon powder | 1 lb hamburger | 1 hot red chili pepper, chopped | 1 teaspoon serrano pepper, chopped | 3 teaspoons salsa | 2 cups diced cheddar or 2 cups monterey jack cheese
instructions: Combine clam juice, cream of tartar, bouillon powder, and chopped green chili. Cook over medium heat until bubbles form around the edge of the pan. Crumble hamburger into pan. Cook to brown. Add pepper, salt, salsa, and cream of tartar. Stir for 2 minutes. Serve. Refrigerate unused portions.

title: Chocolate Chip Casserole
ingredients: 6 ounces milk chocolate, chopped | 12 ounces corn chips, crushed
instructions: Grease an 8 ounce baking dish or casserole dish. Melt the chocolate over hot water. Mix with the dry ingredients. Pour into greased dish or casserole dish. Bake in medium heat for 10 - 15 minutes, stirring every now and then. Serve with whipped cream or ice cream or chocolate shavings.

Random Ingredients: smart balance butter spread,carrot,cornflour,vegetable broth,white pepper,heavy cream,udon noodle,roast pork
title: Roast Pork and Noodles With Smoked Carrots & Smoked Carrots
ingredients: 4 cups mixed vegetables ( peeled, carrots, onions, celery, green onions, and onions ) | 1 lb sweet beef roast or 1 lb roast pork | 1 cup low sodium vegetable broth | 1/2 - 1 cup heavy cream | 2 tablespoons smart balance butter spread | 2 teaspoons cornflour | 1/4 cup sweet white pepper | 1 package udon noodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Prepare vegetables, cut roast into 1/2 to 1 inch cubes.

title: The Best Paleo Cranberry Coconut Sauce
ingredients: 400 g cranberries, rinsed and drained with 2 tbsp water | 400 g coconut milk
instructions: Place the coconut milk in a bowl and leave it for 20 minutes. Add the cranberries to the coconut milk and stir until they are completely warmed through. This should result in thick sauce that coats the back of a spoon.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,heirloom tomato,ra el hanout spice mix,savoy cabbage,sausage,tomato puree,beef steak,beef tenderloin steak
title: Picante Beef Stew
ingredients: 3 lbs beef round steak ( cut into 1/2 inch slices ) | 2 lbs fresh sausage ( cut into 1 inch cubes ) | 3 lbs beef tenderloin steaks ( trimmed ) | 1 cup fat-free picante sauce | 3 cans whole tomatoes ( undrained ) | 2 tablespoons tomato puree | 2 tablespoons arroz fasay spice mix | 2 1/2 - 3 lbs heirloom tomatoes ( peeled, seeded, chopped ) | 2 large savoy cabbage ( cored, cut into 1 inch squares )
instructions: Cook the meat in 2 cups water and salt to taste until tender. Transfer to crockpot. Drain and set aside. Slice sausages into 1/2 inch rounds, cut into 1 1/2 inch pieces. Place in crockpot. Slice beef into 1 inch cubes. Place in crockpot. Combine beer, picante sauce, tomatoes, spice mix and 1 cup water. Pour over beef and sausages and add meat. Cover and cook on low setting for 8 - 10 hours or on high setting for 4 - 5 hours. Add tomatoes and cook on high setting for 45 minutes. Turning tomatoes over and rearranging meat in crockpot for the last 30 minutes or so. Let stand for 10 minutes, taste and add salt if needed. Note, to keep meat refrigerated, place under foil and then under broiler for 15 to 20 minutes, or until meat is just warmed through. Stir tomato juice and juices from crockpot into juice. Add more picante sauce if desired.

Random Ingredients: asiago cheese,date,brown sugar,request cream mushroom soup,malt vinegar,cherry tomato
title: Chunky Creamy Tomato Mousse
ingredients: 1 can healthy request cream of mushroom soup ( or 10 1/2 ounces cream of mushroom soup ) | 8 ounces fresh dates, roughly chopped ( or more, depending on taste ) | 4 ounces fresh dates, cleaned and chopped ( or more, depending on taste ) | 2 tablespoons fresh cherries, in natural juice ( or a few of the pits ) | 1/4 cup brown sugar ( more or less, to taste ) | 4 tablespoons marsala malt vinegar
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl. Place bowl in the fridge to chill. When ready to serve, stir well. Serve with lots of cream, crackers or bread. Enjoy,.

Random Ingredients: parsley leaf,pine nut,rose wine,chinese five spice powder,ice,toffee,bread
title: Tobiko: Sweet and Spicy Toffee
ingredients: 1 cup toffee, coarsely chopped ( or use cashew or macadamia nuts ) | 2 tablespoons pine nuts, toasted | 1 pinch chinese five spice powder | 2 cups toffee, coarsely chopped ( or use cashew or macadamia nuts ) | 3 tablespoons fresh parsley leaves | crusty bread, to serve | crusty ice, to serve
instructions: Place the toffee, pine nuts, five spice and half of the parsley in a medium saucepan. Cook over low heat until toasted, stirring constantly. Add the remaining parsley and serve with toast, crème fraîche or plain ice.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,black eyed pea,white sugar,almond,tomato ketchup,phyllo pastry,green chilies,chipotle chile
title: Aji (Mexican Black Eyed Pea Pie)
ingredients: 15 ounces black-eyed peas, rinsed and drained | 2 tablespoons white sugar | 1/4 cup tomato ketchup | 2 tablespoons heavy cream | 1 teaspoon chipotle chile, or to taste | 1 1/2 teaspoons canned diced green chilies | 4 sheets phyllo pastry | 1/2 cup chopped almonds
instructions: Preheat your oven's broiler. Stir black eyed peas, sugar, tomato ketchup, cream, chipotle chile, and green chilies together in a large bowl. Unwrap phyllo pastry sheets. Brush both sides of sheets with oil and then put one sheet on a work surface. Fold in edges of top sheet, pressing edges to crimp. Place half of the peas mixture in the center of the pastry sheets, leaving about 2 inches of pastry on each side.

Random Ingredients: chicken wing,avocado,bulk italian sausage,grenadine,orange extract,veal,garlic clove
title: Italian Saucy Sausage Wings and Veggies
ingredients: 4 -6 lbs assorted chicken wings, tips removed, wings cut into 1 1/2-inch lengths | 8 -10 ounces bulk italian sausage | 4 garlic cloves, chopped | 2 teaspoons ground orange extract | 1 can diced ripe avocados | 1/4 cup grenadine | 1/4 cup grenadine
instructions: Place wings in large saucepan of cold water and bring slowly to boil. Meanwhile, place sausage in large, nonstick skillet and brown over medium hot heat. Add garlic and next 3 ingredients and cook 5 minutes. Drain sausage, crumble and set aside. Remove wings from water and drain. Arrange wings on a platter and add sausage mixture. Top with guacamole and sprinkle with grated parmesan cheese.

title: Homemade Flour Tortillas
ingredients: 2 cups heavy whipping cream or 2 cups half-and-half | 2 tablespoons olive
instructions: In a heavy bottomed frying pan, heat 1 tbsp olive oil and 1 tbsp flour over medium heat. As soon as bubbles form on the top, flip the tortillas over for 2 or 3 seconds. Turn over the tortillas, and cover until they are lightly browned. Add the cream to the heated frying pan. Place tortillas on a paper towel covered rack over a bowl, and allow to drain for 15 - 20 minutes. Heat a griddle or an electric griddle until medium high. Heat the tortillas to medium hot and flip over. Spread the bottom edge of each with some of the olive.

title: Orange, Chickpea and Rice Salad - Neilson's Recipe
ingredients: 1 package bacon-smoked turkey breast half - chopped | 1/2 cup fresh mushrooms, sliced | 1 cup raw small baking potatoes | 4 tablespoons grated orange rind | 1/4 cup canned chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 1 cup chicken stock or 1 cup vegetable stock, if needed
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions or until just tender and fluffy, but still firm to the bite. Drain and cut into bite size pieces. Fry bacon, mushrooms and orange in a frying pan, stirring occasionally, until cooked but not crisp. Add chickpeas, cooking until heated through. Mix in chicken or vegetable stock. Serve the salad over the cooled rice.

title: Canned Cannellini Beans & Red Potatoes
ingredients: 1 cup cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 1/4 lbs red potatoes or 1 1/4 lbs yukon gold potatoes, quartered | 1 sprig fresh thyme | 1 sprig fresh coriander, chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Place the rinsed beans, potatoes, thyme and coriander in a roasting pan and toss in the cannellini beans, if using, to coat well. Bake, uncovered, for 45 minutes. Remove from the oven, and serve.

title: Pesto Dipping Sauce for Dipping Seafood
ingredients: 2 cups dashi | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce | 1 g chicken bouillon granules | 125 g coarsely chopped dry roasted peanuts
instructions: Place dashi in a saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring to a boil over high heat and reduce heat to low. Meanwhile, combine pesto and bouillium in the bowl of a food processor. Process until mixture is smooth. Gradually stir in peanuts. In a small dish, heat chicken bouillon to a temperature of 100°f using a small spoon, pour over pesto mixture and stir until pesto dissolves. Drop mixture by heaping tablespoons in batches onto a plate. Roll each in nuts.

title: Japanese Dressing
ingredients: 1/3 cup rice wine vinegar
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a jar with a tight fitting lid. Shake to mix.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock,eagle brand milk,vanilla ice cream,vegetable broth,rice,peanut oil vegetable,red wine vinegar,garlic salt
title: African Peanut Soup
ingredients: 9 garlic saltines | 1/4 cup peanut oil or 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 1 quart chicken stock | 1 quart vegetable broth | 2 cups rice, uncooked | 1 - 1 1/2 cup peanut oil or 1 -1 1/2 cup vegetable oil, for frying | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar, for drizzling | 6 cups vanilla ice cream | 2 cups whole milk or 2 cups vegetarian milk
instructions: In large soup pot, heat peanut oil on medium high heat. Slice garlic saltines on a cutting bored. Toss with heated oil. Add to oil.

title: Papaya Fritters (Ceviche)
ingredients: 4 ripe papayas ( or 1/2 cup sweet potato ) | 8 pieces corn tortilla chips | 1/3 teaspoon ground cumin powder ( or to taste ) | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper ( or to taste )
instructions: Wash and pat papayas dry. Slice crosswise into half moon sized pieces. Rinse and pat dry with a paper towel. Place a scoop of chips in a bowl and mash well with a potato masher, the cumin and the white pepper. Spray a skillet with cooking spray. Dip each piece of papaya, one at a time, into the mixture and fry on both sides over medium heat until very lightly browned and cooked through. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper flake,muscovado sugar,cream chicken soup,palm oil,yellow pepper
title: Sweet Sour Peppers (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 4 -6 medium yellow sweet peppers, sliced | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 3 tablespoons dried red chili pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons palm oil | 3 tablespoons light muscovado sugar or 3 tablespoons brown sugar
instructions: Place all ingredients in a slow cooker or slow cooker. Cover and cook on low for 5 - 7 hours or high for 2 hours. Serve warm or cold on hot day rolls. Variation, place all frozen vegetables in a saucepan and cover with boiling water. Simmer on low for 20 - 30 minutes then remove from heat and mash until smooth. Drain liquid if necessary. Add sugar, if necessary, and mix thoroughly. Pour into glass baking dish, cover and freeze overnight or until hard, or hard when pressed. Remove when solid and serve. Serve warm on hot day rolls or crackers.

title: Roasted Roma Vegetable Pasta
ingredients: 8 ounces rigatoni pasta or 8 ounces penne pasta | 2 large leeks ( white and pale green part only ) | 1 cup fresh ricotta cheese | 1/3 cup fresh cilantro stem, chopped | 1 large red chilies, chopped or 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f in a large saucepan, bring 3 quarts of water to a boil. Meanwhile, cut off the ends from the leeks and trim away the dark green edges of the tops. Cut the leeks lengthwise into 2 inch pieces, put them in a large bowl and pour the boiling water over them. Let sit for about a minute, then drain and set aside. In a food processor or blender, combine the cooled leeks with the ricotta, cilantro, chiles, paprika and red pepper. Process, adding as much water as needed to keep the mixture smooth and creamy.. Place the pasta on a large baking sheet, then pour the tomato and veggie mixture evenly ontop. Scatter the leeks over the top. Bake the pasta for about 45 minutes, or until tender and the top is golden.

Random Ingredients: cognac,taco seasoning mix,strawberry,baking soda,bean,gouda cheese,red pepper flake,semolina
title: Sherry's  Baked Greek Layer Cake
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups semolina | 1 1/2 cups baking soda | 2 bags strawberries | 1 envelope taco seasoning mix | 3/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 2 cans baked beans ( plain or flavored ) | 8 ounces smoked gouda cheese, shredded ( about 1.25 cups ) | 1/4 cup cognac
instructions: For each layer, place 3 1/2 cups semolina, baking soda, strawberries, taco seasoning mix and red pepper flakes in food processor.

Random Ingredients: white fish fillet,pork fillet,french thyme,garlic salt,amaretto
title: Roasted Stuffed Pork Fillets
ingredients: 4 fresh white fish fillets | 1/2 lb pork fillet | 1/4 ounce amaretto | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 teaspoon french thyme
instructions: Roast the fish using all the marindo. Put it in the refrigerator to marinate for 30 minutes and bring to room temp. Heat oven to 350°f. Remove the fillets from the refrigerator and open them out flat, not too close to each other, and carefully remove any pin bones or extra fat. Sprinkle the fillets with the salt& french thyme and coat all over. Put the open fillets in a large, shallow roasting pan. Drizzle the remaining marinade over the top until all is covered. Bake for 20 min on the middle rack, or until the internal temp is 180 degrees celcius. Let rest for 10 min prior, slice thinly and serve as a side with the meal or as a main course.

title: Cottage Cheese
ingredients: 500 g cottage cheese | 1 cup unsweetened raspberry juice | 1 teaspoon shrimp paste | 2 -3 tablespoons ghee or 2 -3 tablespoons butter | 1 teaspoon dried mint | 1 1/4 kg chicken cutlets, pounded
instructions: Combine cottage cheese, 1 cup raspberry juice and shrimp paste in a blender and process to obtain a smooth paste. Keep aside. Heat ghee on medium heat. Dip chicken cutlets in batter, coating both sides. Cook in hot ghee for 2 minute on each side. Add mint, cottage cheese mixture and 2 3/4 cup raspberry juice to the pan and mix well. Serve immediately with rice.

title: Tropical Jice
ingredients: 8 jicama ( jiafan ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons vanilla sugar | 1 teaspoon red curry paste ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Blend all ingredients in a blender until well combined. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: milk chocolate,vegetable shortening,apple cider,peanut butter,mustard powder,kidney bean,cayenne
title: Chocolate Chip Kidney Bean Spread
ingredients: 1 package milk chocolate | 1/2 cup vegetable shortening | 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1/4 cup light creamy peanut butter | 1 teaspoon dry mustard powder | 1 pinch cayenne | 1 can apple cider, undiluted
instructions: Break the chocolate up into small pieces and let melt. In a large bowl, mash the shortening. Mix in the browned milk to make smooth paste. Press into the bottom of a deep 8 inch square cake pan. Spoon bean mixture over chocolate. Combine the peanut butter, mustard powder and cayenne and spread evenly over the bean bean surface. Pour the cider over cocoa. Let chill, at least one hour. Cut into squares.

title: Date Oat Crunch
ingredients: 3 cups quick cooking oats | 10 dates, stoned and stoned
instructions: Place the oats in a bowl, then roll each date and break them up into small lumps. Sprinkle over the oats and stir, until they have amalgamated into a smooth paste. Spray a large nonstick frying pan with cooking spray and set over a medium heat. Tip in the crumb mixture until it is evenly coated in crumbs and then cook for 2 minutes per side, stirring frequently. The dates should be soft inside, but not hard and crusty.

title: Cheese With Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb mexican cheese | 2 bay leaves ( or more to taste )
instructions: Take a casserole dish or other well buttered pan and place in oven at 400'. While the casserole is heating grate the mexican cheese with a potato masher. Drain your cheese and add to your oven and cover with saran wrap.. Let the cheese bake for about an hour. Take off the foil and let cool for about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: bicarbonate soda,tomato juice,green chilies,rice wine vinegar
title: Spicy Tomato Soup
ingredients: 1 tablespoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar | 2 cans chopped stewed tomatoes with juice | 5 small green chilies
instructions: Combine the soda and vinegar together, stir into the tomatoes, leave to set. Chop 4 chillies and divide amongst 6 soup spoons. Serve.

title: Simple Adobo Rice
ingredients: 3 tablespoons goya sazon goya | 1 1 teaspoon adobo seasoning | 1/2 cup diced carrot
instructions: Spray skillet with cooking spray. Heat over med and stir until hot. Add goya. Stir to coat. Add carrot. Add adobo. Cover. Let simmer, stirring occasionally for 20 - 25 minutes. Remove cover and let stand 5 minutes. Stir. You may serve either alone or with other rice.

title: Herbed Pizzas
ingredients: 3 thin slices white bread | 1 tablespoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Arrange bread on a baking sheet. Sprinkle with dried oregano. Bake in preheated oven until toasted, about 5 to 8 minutes.

title: Chicken Thighs (Sbd P1)
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon black pepper | cooking spray | 8 fluid ounces sliced jalapeno-stuffed fresh pimientos | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Spray a 9 x 13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Sprinkle the black pepper evenly over chicken.

title: Easy Cabbage Slaw
ingredients: 2 cups coleslaw mix | 1 can fat-free topping, such as miracle whip | 1 habanero pepper, halved, germ removed | 1 piece fresh ginger ale | 3/4 cup pecan pieces | 1 package top-of-bag frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: In a large bowl, mix coleslaw mix, sugar, habanero pepper, ginger ale and pecans. Mix well and stir in thawed whipped topping. Place 2 baguette slices on counter. Spoon cabbage slaw onto baguette slices, pressing lightly in center. Serve warm.

title: Chilli Spiced Slice
ingredients: 12 slices red chiles, cut into 1 cm pieces | 60 g fresh coconut milk | 50 g strong tea | 125 ml marinara sauce | 1/2 teaspoon crushed ground cloves | lettuce leaf, to serve
instructions: Place all 12 slices of red chiles in a heatproof bowl. Cover with boiling water and stand for 1 - 2 minutes. Drain and discard water. Rinse under cold water to cool. Transfer to a shallow roasting tin and add coconut milk, tea and spices. Mix well. Spread on top of chillies in overlapping slices. Place in oven and cook at 160c for 30 - 45 minutes, until golden and starting to crisp around edges. Serve in lettuce leaves.

Random Ingredients: sugar,goya extra virgin olive oil,wine vinegar,ice water
title: Fresh Sweet Vinegar
ingredients: 1 cup sweet wine vinegar | 3/4 cup sugar | 1/4 cup goya extra virgin olive oil ( sesker ) | 2 tablespoons ice water
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large glass or stainless steel bowl and stir until sugar dissolves. You can add a tsp of sea salt to the vinegar at this point if you like, though this never lasts long enough to make it the right color.

Random Ingredients: beef rib,nam pla,salad oil,liquid smoke,baby onion
title: Nam Thai Beef Ribs
ingredients: 3 lbs beef short ribs ( i use pork ribs, about 4-5 pounds ) | 1/2 cup nam pla ( sweet rice wine vinegar ) or 1/2 cup sherry wine vinegar ( sweet rice wine vinegar ) | 2 -4 tablespoons salad oil | 1 medium baby onion, sliced ( optional ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke
instructions: Place the ribs in a large zipper or sealable bag. Pour vinegar over the ribs.

title: Quick Mexican Bean Burritos
ingredients: 1 can great northern beans, undrained | 4 flour tortillas
instructions: Open the can of great northern beans with a spoon. Put the beans and water in a blender and puree it until fairly smooth. Place one tortilla on a plate. Spoon 3/4 cup of bean puree into the middle of tortilla and spread it evenly over the tortilla. Fold the two sides in toward the center, and roll up like a burrito. Repeat to make more burritos. To bake, preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Cut roll into wedges and serve.

title: Easy One Pot Macadamia Chips
ingredients: 4 baking potatoes ( about 7-8 large ) | 2 teaspoons chipotle powder ( plus more to taste ) | black pepper, to taste
instructions: Cut potatoes crosswise into 1/2 rounds the length of the potato, leaving about an inch between the rounds. Place potato rounds on wire rack to dry slightly, about 8 to 10 hours. Preheat oven to 450°f. Line a baking sheet with foil. Place potatoes on prepared baking sheet.. Bake about 2 hours or until slightly browned and firm. Place a paper towel between each chop and roll each chop in the towel. Remove nuts and sprinkle with chipotle powder. Serve immediately.

title: Perfect Espresso Beans
ingredients: 1 lb coffee beans, canned, picked over and rinsed and patted dry | sea salt
instructions: The french call the beans coffee salted beans and let sit for about 20 minutes to plump them up. Do not soak them by boiling on the stove. The beans will float to the surface when done. Do not worry if they rise to the surface. Remove the foam that forms. Add the salt. Pour into a glass jar. Store in the refrigerator. Use for coffee, espresso, espresso cake and other things. To soften a coffee bean, run a coffee knife around its back, releasing loose end, then twist the knife away from you. The bean will not be soft and gooey.

Random Ingredients: extra beef,cardamom pod,almond extract,cheddar cheese,cider vinegar,cumin powder,cream chicken soup
title: Crock Pot Mexican Cheesecake
ingredients: 2 lbs extra lean ground beef | 4 cups cheddar cheese, shredded | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 3 tablespoons cider vinegar | 2 teaspoons ground cumin powder | 1 teaspoon cardamom pod | 1 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Mix all ingredients together except cheese until well blended. Grate cheese and mix well. Pour into a greased crock pot and cover with a lid. Cook on low 15 - 20 minutes, then high 3 - 6 hours. Remove lid, and stir well. Allow to cool slightly before serving.

Random Ingredients: grain rice,mustard seed,tomato green chilies,tea,garlic powder,part mozzarella cheese,tomatillo
title: Spanish Rice (Rice Cooker)
ingredients: 2 cups long-grain rice | 4 cups packed reduced-sodium tomatoes and green chilies ( canned, undrained ) | 1 tablespoon dry mustard seeds | 8 ounces tomatillos, husked, rinsed | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant espresso or 1 1/2 teaspoons instant coffee | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder | 3/4 cup shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese
instructions: In a 3 - 3 1/2 to 4 quart slow cooker, stir together rice, tomatoes, mustard seeds, tomatillos, cocoa, instant coffee and garlic powder until well blended. Stir in cheese.

Random Ingredients: steak,lump crabmeat,meat,yellow cornmeal,rigatoni pasta,hard egg,peanut oil
title: Griddle Beef Stuffed Rigatoni
ingredients: 12 ounces rigatoni pasta | 1 lb lean top round steak | 1 can lump crabmeat ( about 12 ) or ( 16 ounce ) can crabmeat ( about 12 ) | 1/4 cup peanut oil | 2 hard-boiled eggs | 1/2 cup yellow cornmeal | 1/2 cup coarse salt or 1/2 cup coarse sea salt
instructions: Bring 6 quarts of salted water to a boil. Cook rigatoni in boiling water, uncovered, until tender but firm to the bite, stirring occasionally, about 12 minutes, drain. Transfer rigatoni to a bowl and cool slightly. Slice thin across the grain. Cut steak diagonally across the grain into 1/4 inch slices. Cut two eggs into 1/4 inch slices. Cut each egg slice into 8 thin wedges, making 4 slits. Coat both sides of each steak slice with cornmeal. Heat 2 tablespoons of peanut oil in a large, heavy skillet over high heat until hot but not smoking, and add sliced steak. Cook, stirring occasionally, until browned, about 1 1/2 minutes. Add crabmeat and remaining 6 tablespoons peanut oil and cook, stirring occasionally, until crabmeat is hot but not cooked through, 3 - 5 minutes. Drain rigatoni. When the steaks are cooked through, sprinkle with salt. Divide rigatoni among 4 warmed plates and spoon crab mixture on top. Break an egg into each plate and sprinkle over the crabmeat mixture. Garnish with the remaining 3 small wedges of peeled egg and the cornmeal.

title: Baked Apples With Kahlua & Smoked Gouda
ingredients: 12 apples | 3 ounces smoked gouda cheese, very finely chopped | 2 tablespoons rice wine, dark ( i used an aged dry mesclun ) | sweetened wahlua, to taste
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f/180°c. Remove the peel from the apples and set the pits on a medium baking tray lined with tin foil to help hold them under the skin. Place the apples on the tray with the pits in, and bake for 20 to 25 minutes. Set aside until cool enough to handle, remove the skins and cores from the apples. Mince the apples roughly and put the finely chopped cheese into a small bowl. Stir in the rice wine and set aside. Brush the apples with a little oil, and place on the baking tray lined with tin foil, then bake for about 15 minutes until lightly browned. Turn and bake for an additional 15 to 20 minutes, turning once or twice.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,potato,cottage cheese,lobster meat,salt,cannellini bean,chocolate chip
title: Chocolate and Lobster Nests
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 package potato pancakes, frozen, thawed | 14 ounces lobster meat | 1/2 cup unsweetened pineapple juice | 4 ounces bittersweet chocolate chips, melted | salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix 1 can cannellini beans and potato pancakes in a bowl with the lobster meat, pineapple juice and chocolate chips. Transfer mixture to a 2 quart casserole dish and bake 10 minutes, until golden and set. Sprinkle top with salt, if desired. These nests can be made earlier in the week and frozen, defrosted. To reheat, transfer to an ice cream maker and follow manufacturer's instructions. When hot, melt chocolate chips and serve on their own.

Random Ingredients: teriyaki sauce,quinoa,artichoke heart,green chili,dark brown sugar,salt black pepper
title: Tangy Artichoke Quinoa Salad With Sauteed Artichokes
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dry quinoa, rinsed and drained | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained quartered, liquid reserved | 1 green chili, seeded and chopped | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar, packed | 2 tablespoons teriyaki sauce ( or more, to taste ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: In a saucepan bring enough water to almost to a boil. Add the quinoa, artichokes, green chili and brown sugar. Cook over medium low heat for 10 minutes, until the liquid has been absorbed and the quinoa is beginning to become translucent. Remove from the heat and let cool. Stir in the teriyaki and salt and pepper to taste.

title: Spicy Nut Balls
ingredients: 1 cup walnut halves | 1/3 cup sambal oelek | 1/3 cup vanilla ice cream, softened
instructions: Finely grind the nuts in a food processor or blender.

Random Ingredients: lamb shank,black bean,chili paste,green onion,green chilies,seasoning
title: Lamb Shanks With Chilli Beans
ingredients: 3 tablespoons chili paste | 800 g lamb shanks | 2 tablespoons seasoning | 400 g canned black beans ( drained ) or 400 g can kidney beans ( drained ) | 2 tablespoons green onions or 2 tablespoons scallions, chopped | 2 green chilies, chopped
instructions: Sprinkle over the chilli paste and salt and pepper to your tastes. Place the lamb shanks in a roasting tin. Turning as necessary. Mix the remaining ingredients and pour over the shanks. Cover with foil and bake in the oven at 180c for 2 hours. Increase heat to 220c and bake for a further hour. Serve immediately with rice.

title: Chicken Breasts Strap From Heaven
ingredients: 3 tablespoons fresh sage leaves, coarsely chopped | 2 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts, trimmed and sliced 3/4 inch thick ( 1 1/2 to 1 3/4 pounds total weight ) | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon minced ginger ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice, see note
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. In small bowl, combine sage leaves, 1/2 teaspoon each ginger and mixed spice.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,pecan half,spanish onion,dark soy sauce,kalamata olive,tahini
title: Toasted Plough Pecan French Toast
ingredients: 2 slices dry rye bread ( very thin slices, i like rye bread ) | 1 tablespoon light dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon tahini ( i've used soy sauce, but i can get in almost any flavor ) | 1 -2 tablespoon spanish onions or 1 -2 tablespoon green onion, minced | 1 -2 tablespoon pecan halves, toasted ( optional ) | 12 kalamata olives, pitted ( optional )
instructions: Spread about 1 tablespoon of dark soy sauce on one side of each white bread slice, then top with the toasted slice of rye bread. Sprinkle with sesame seeds or other desired amount of dark soy sauce, then top with the minced onion. Sprinkle each slice of french toast with a few tablespoons of light dark soy sauce, or you can use 1/2 tablespoon dark soy sauce, 1 tablespoon tahini, and a sprinkling of onion or green onion. Heat a large, heavy skillet over medium heat. Place a spatula or other heavy skillet on top of the french toast, and turn with a spatula to coat the entire surface with dark soy sauce and oil. When the bottom of the pan is coated with olive oil, place 4 to 6 bread slices into the pan, and flip slices over over just so they get nice and brown on the bottom. Cook for 6 to 8 minutes, or more, or until golden brown, and the bottom of the pan is bubbling. As the bottom gets brown, remove the pan from the burner, and place the remaining slices of french toast on top. Remove the pan from the burner, drizzle with a bit more dark soy sauce, and top with the toasted pecan halves, and the olives, if desired.

Random Ingredients: pita bread,aluminum foil,vanilla bean,hoagie,chicken breast half,potato,rotini pasta
title: Mediterranean Chicken #5FIX
ingredients: 1 bag simply potatoes diced potatoes with onion | 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1 large vanilla bean | 6 hoagie rolls | aluminum foil ( enough to fold both ends in ) | 1 package rotini pasta
instructions: Place in 1 gallon freezer bag 1 package of simply potatoes diced potatoes with onion and 1 whole pod of vanilla bean. Put the plastic bag into a freezer for 45 minute to 2 hours. Remove the plastic bag and discard and discard the vanilla bean innards from the potato bag. Place the chicken breast halves open flat and place into pan of boiling water and remove from heat. Remove breast from pan and cover. Set aside to cool to room temperature. Once cool remove skin carefully discard and discard the skin from the breast and cut into 1/2 inch thick slices. Chop into 1/2 inch pieces. Remove vanilla bean ends from vanilla bean. Preheat olive oil grill to high then coat pan with spray oil. Place the chicken breast on grill and cook for around 2 minutes on each side or until cooked through and juices are clear. To assemble open bag and place 2 large spoonfuls of the simply potatoes diced potatoes with onions and 1 sliced chicken breast into each bowl. Serve with 1/4 of rotini pasta per portion if desired.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,mustard seed,mozzarella cheese
title: Cheesy English-French Fries
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/4 cup mustard seeds | 4 ounces shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat broiler. Spray a 9 inch square glass pie plate with cooking spray. Toast mustard seeds in preheated oven for 10 to 12 minutes or until fragrant. Spread mustard seeds over the prepared pan, cover with cheese, and broil until cheese browns, 5 to 7 minutes.

title: Simple Beef Tips
ingredients: 1 can cooked extra lean beef, with juice | 3 teaspoons oil ( a good spray will work also )
instructions: Open the can of beef and add to the skillet on the bottom of the pan. You may need to add more oil and beef, depending on amount of beef. Heat for 2 to 3 minutes until beef is well browned. Remove beef to plate and pour any juices in the pot over the beef. I serve this with a loaf of italian bread with extra virgin olive oil on top. You may also add your favourite veggies or vegetables. Note, this does taste great with some dried parsley.

title: Rutabagas in Red Gravy
ingredients: 2 medium rutabagas | kosher salt | cumin powder | 1/4 cup unsalted butter
instructions: In a medium bowl, thoroughly dry the rutabagas by soaking them in 1/4 cup of water for 15 minutes.

title: Vegan Mexican Hash Browns
ingredients: 200 g red potatoes, cubed | 1 spring onion, chopped | 150 g snow peas, sliced | 300 g hominy | 1/3 cup amaretto ( to taste ) | 1/3 cup buttermilk | 400 g tomatoes, skinned, deseeded and chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f. Bring a large saucepan of water to the boil then add potatoes. Cover and simmer for 12 minutes. Add spring onion and snow peas, remove from heat and mix until potato is well blended. Pour into a casserole. Add the hominy, amaretto and mix. Replace cover and cook in oven for 15 - 20 minutes, until soup is thickened. Add more amaretto if required and remove cover and cook for a few minutes longer. Stir in tomatoes. Serve warm.

title: Fruity French Bread and Cheese Squares
ingredients: 1 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 2 tablespoons self-raising flour | 1 cup shredded gruyere cheese | 1 cup coarsely shopped lettuce | 3 cups finely chopped fresh blueberries or 3 cups frozen blueberries | 2 buns, split
instructions: Mix together the flour and breadcrumbs until well combined and then add cheese. Stir until well combined. Place about 1 1/2 cups of the cheese mixture, in a greased and floured 16 x 8 inch pan, or two smaller, loaf pans. Sprinkle the berries over evenly. Dot with the remaining cheese mixture and top with the remaining cheese mixture. Bake in a preheated 350 degree f oven for 30 minutes, until set and browned. Cool on a wire rack. Cut into squares or triangles and serve with syrup or preserves.

title: Simple Cheese-Free Queso Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 package shredded mexican cheese blend
instructions: Pour the peanut oil into a skillet over medium heat. Add the garlic powder. Cook and stir until fragrant, about a minute. Remove the skillet from heat. Stir in the shredded cheese and place it, stirring and shaking the skillet, into the sauce. Cover immediately, and continue cooking over medium low heat for about 2 minutes to allow the cheese to melt and lightly brown.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,pork shoulder,sorrel,ramen noodle,chipotle chile adobo,puff pastry,red lentil,salt pork
title: Lentil and Pork Empanadas
ingredients: 1 package frozen puff pastry, thawed | 3 pounds boneless pork shoulder, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 pound salt pork, cut into 1 inch cubes | 3 tablespoons chipotle chiles in adobo, finely chopped | 1 can red lentils, rinsed and drained | 1 package frozen sorrel | 1 teaspoon salt | 2 teaspoons baking soda
instructions: Set oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source and preheat the oven's broiler. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place thawed pastry on a work surface, and roll out into a 12x15 inch rectangle. Cut dough in half from center to edges, and roll out each half as thinly as possible to make a 10x15 inch rectangle. Use each half to line a 1 1/2 quart baking dish. Arrange sausage, red onion, and salt in a layer on top of dough. Sprinkle baking soda on top of sausage. Spread lentils evenly over mixture. Top with sorrel, leaving a 1 inch border of dough around the outer edge of the dish. Cut reserved 1 1/2 inch border into strips, or cut through scored lines across each border. Carefully cut a slit in the top of each empanada so that the open end of the empanada remains intact. Roll empanadas over the sausage mixture, pressing them gently to seal. Arrange the empanadas on the prepared baking sheet. Broil in the preheated oven 2 to 3 minutes, basting occasionally with pan juices, until the edges of the empanadas are deep golden brown, and filling is hot and bubbling.

title: Gorgonzola Appetizer
ingredients: 8 ounces gorgonzola | 1 cup finely chopped pecans
instructions: Mix all ingredients together, using only the pecans, to coat the gorgonzola. Store in tightly covered tin.

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,walnut half,ditalini pasta,green pepper,almond extract,lemon juice,salad green,red food coloring
title: Pasta Salad With Almonds and Walnuts
ingredients: 6 ounces ditalini pasta or 6 ounces other large pasta | 2 medium green peppers ( or other green peppers ) | 2 cups mixed salad greens ( or other mixed greens ) | 4 tablespoons almond extract ( optional ) | 4 -5 drops red food coloring or 4 -5 drops green food coloring ( optional ) | 4 -6 large walnut halves | 4 -5 teaspoons fresh lemon juice | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Cook pasta according to directions on box. Drain and rinse the red food coloring, or green food coloring off if you prefer it smoother. Combine all salad ingredients in a large bowl. Combine lemon juice and almond extract. Slowly drizzle in the almond and lemon juice mixture. Stir in the vanilla and serve warm or cold. If the salad is too dry, add a little water to rinse the salad. Refrigerate salad for at least 2 hours prior to serving.

title: Pinto Bean Pancake
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups rice wine ( optional ) | 1 cup pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 1 large prosciutto, thinly sliced | 1 1/2 cups self-raising flour ( or all purpose flour mixed with 2/3 cup water to make a firmer pancake dough )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f place 3 tbsp warm oil in a nonstick pan. When the oil is hot, stir the pancake batter into the pan and quickly cook it on one side, then roll it up into a circle about 9 inches diameter. Transfer the pancake to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Repeat until all the batter has been used up, using a spatula to flatten it out into a circle. In a small bowl, stir together 1/2 cup water and the remaining 2/3 cup warm oil. Cut the pancake into 6 wedges. Arrange the wedges on the baking sheet in a circle with about 1/2 inch of water in the bottom and sides. Bake for 25 - 30 minutes, until crisp and risen and golden. Serve immediately.

title: Smoky Baked Mexican Bacon and Chiles
ingredients: 2 slices bacon, crumbled ( i prefer the lean kind ) | 4 ounces chile ( chipotle chiles ) | 3 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1 teaspoon chipotle chile, in adobo ( or other hot chile )
instructions: Place bacon in a non stick skillet and cook until browned remove from skillet leaving fat in the skillet. Sautee chile in skillet until soft, then add in the chipotle and cook until aromatic. In a 9x9 pan on parchment paper or the baking sheet add in the bacon and sprinkle with the chili powder or other chile powder. Scrape the chile with a spatula and add back into the pan. Cook over the top of the bacon until browned then remove and cover with foil for about 15 - 20 minutes. If you have to thick it up you can. Take out and cut into squares.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,swiss chard,black bean,pecorino romano cheese,vegetable
title: Quick Swiss Chard & Bean Casserole
ingredients: 1 bunch swiss chard, stemmed ( about 1.5 lbs ) | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup ( reduced-fat can use low fat and fat free ) | 1 lb small lima beans, cut in half ( optional ) or 1 can black beans, rinsed ( optional ) | 1/4 cup grated pecorino romano cheese | 6 tablespoons canned vegetable or 6 tablespoons cream of mushroom soup
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees. Spray a 3 qt casserole with nonstick cooking spray. Line the bottom of the casserole dish with a layer of blanched green leaves. Spread a layer of swiss chard in the dish and cover with a layer of beans and a second layer of leaves. Pour over a third layer of swiss chard and beans. Add a layer of soup and sprinkle with cheese. Top with a third layer of swiss chard and beans and then sprinkle with extra cheese. Repeat layers of swiss chard, beans and soup. Cover, and bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour, until hot and bubbly. Top with grated parmesan, if using. Allow to set 5 minutes before serving.

title: Hummus
ingredients: 1/3 cup tahini | 1 tablespoon ground black pepper | 1 small serrano pepper, seeded and finely chopped
instructions: Combine the tahini, ground black pepper and the serrano pepper in a bowl. Cover tightly and store in the refrigerator for up to 2 days.

Random Ingredients: white bread,artichoke heart,kefalograviera cheese,kernel corn,baby portabella mushroom,grand marnier
title: Artichoke Mushroom and Artichoke Dip
ingredients: 12 ounces artichoke hearts, rinsed and drained | 1 cup chopped baby portabella mushrooms | 15 1/2 ounces whole kernel corn | 6 slices white bread | 1 cup grated kefalograviera cheese | 1/4 cup grand marnier
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f slice bread into small pieces. Combine cheese and grand marnier in small nonstick pan. Heat on low until cheese melts.

title: Raspberry and Bacon Jam Jam Shooters
ingredients: 10 ounces frozen black frozen raspberries | 1 can canned bamboo shoots, drained | 2 tablespoons raspberry jam
instructions: In an airtight container, combine the frozen berries with the jam. Store in the refrigerator while you make the pop ups. To serve, place a popsicle stick between two scoops of raspberries and 1 to 2 teaspoons of jam onto each one, depending on size of raspberries. Put a popstick in the micro for 15 seconds, and the popstick toaster also for 15 seconds. To serve, place desired amount of cocktail on a ramekin, top with whipped cream or sweetened whipped topping.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,grain brown rice,sesame oil,turnip,ricotta cheese,tart apple
title: Yellow Rice Salad
ingredients: 3 cups cooked long grain brown rice, cooled slightly | 3 tart apples, diced | 1 turnip, peeled and diced very small | 1 package ricotta cheese, drained | 1/3 cup sesame oil | 1 kaffir lime leaf, shredded
instructions: Mix all ingredients except lime. Cover and chill for a minute or two before serving. Serve chilled.

title: Tropical and Delicious Japanese Style Sushi
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups sushi rice | 1 1/2 cups water | 1 orange, zest of, in | 1 orange, juice of | 3 cups fruit, prepared | 3 cups mustard seeds | 3 cups cherries tomatoes
instructions: Cook sushi rice per instructions on box, but be careful about overcooking and stirring rice. When done fluff with a fork, and set aside. Squeeze zest from oranges into rice, then add enough juice to make 3 cups plus 2 cups total. Bring water to a boil. Add mustard seeds and cook until they pop. Reduce heat to low and add 3 cups of prepared fruit, stirring all the time to prevent burning. Cook until almost all juice has evaporated and sauce has thickened, about 20 minutes more. Add 3 cups of prepared mustard, stirring all the time. Add 1 1/2 cups of rice, stirring constantly until done. Cut tomatoes into 1/2 pieces and add to the mixture. Spoon sushi on a platter and decorate with cherry tomatoes on top. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: spring wrapper,pork shoulder,parmigiano reggiano cheese,spice,beef sirloin steak,golden syrup
title: Polpette di Riso (Roasted Pork Roll-Ups)
ingredients: 1 kg beef sirloin steaks, roughly 2 3 inches long, trimmed of any visible fat ( or 3/4 lb lean shoulder ) | 250 g fine polpette or 250 g ricotta cheese | 125 g parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 2 tablespoonsspices | spring roll wrappers, to line the bases of your oven tray
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180 degrees f. Using the tip of a paring knife, poke the entire length of the sirloin steak in a few places. Arrange the meat on a baking tray and bake, turning occasionally, for around 30 minutes or until the meat is well browned and sticky. While the meat is roasting, use 2 forks to shred the beef. Stir together the ground meat, polpette cheese, golden syrup, s & plenty of freshly grated cheese. Spread some of the mixture on one end of the sirloin steak and roll up as you normally would. Transfer the roll to a tray and sprinkle some of the grated cheese on top of it. Bake in the oven for around 20 - 25 minutes or until the rolls are crispy and golden. Serve with a little extra golden syrup.

Random Ingredients: currant,double cream,pecorino cheese,tomato,dark raisin,poultry seasoning,vegetable stock
title: Raisin and Tomato Poultry
ingredients: 2 lbs ripe tomatoes | 2 large ripe pints vegetable stock | 1 ounce dark raisin, soaked in 1 tbsp water | 4 ounces currants | 7 ounces double cream | 1/2 teaspoon poultry seasoning
instructions: Heat oven to 350f/180°c/gas skin the tomatoes then cut on the diagonal into thick wedges. Put into a roasting tin or tin with the stock and raisins. Bring to the boil and put the tomatoes on top to cook for 1 hour, turn up the heat, then cook for an additional hour or until the tomatoes are very tender. When ready it should be very dark in color and very mushy. Stir through the currants and cream and season if necessary. Leave at least half an hour before serving to allow all the flavours to develop and the juices to blend.

Random Ingredients: walnut,sherry,tamari soy sauce,oil coconut,rice noodle,date,rye bread,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Vegan Noodle Sandwich With Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 4 ounces rice noodles, dried | 5 tablespoons oil, divided ( coconut or lard is fine ) | 1/2 cup walnuts, toasted, ground | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 2 tablespoons tamari soy sauce | 12 ounces round slices rye bread, sliced 1 or 2 inches thick | 1/2 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup seedless dates
instructions: Put noodles in a large bowl. In 2 tablespoons of oil, cook walnuts and soy sauce, stirring, just until heated. Set aside. Spread bread slices with 1 tbls of the oil. Top with remaining bread slices and spread with 1 teaspoon of remaining oil. Topping, spread walnuts, soy sauce and 3/4 cup cheese each of the 4 rolls. Top with date slices and nuts. Serve at once.

title: Pigs and Eggs
ingredients: 20 large eggs | 7 -8 pickled spring onions, depending on preference
instructions: Hard boil eggs if one type works best if the heat is too high for your pickled spring onions. You may need to hold the egg in the egg for a few minutes after the yolk has risen to the surface. The goal is for the egg to be hard boiled so that it falls in little pieces while you are cooking. Place the eggs in a mixing bowl and add the other fillings. Beat with a spoon to coat everything and let sit for about 10 minutes. This will absorb the egg yolk and mix together. After sitting for about ten minutes, dip each egg into the custard and fry in hot oil until completely golden. Enjoy.

title: Mashed Potato, Avocado, and Avocado
ingredients: 4 large ripe avocados, peeled and pitted | 5 potatoes, peeled and sliced | 1/2 cup dry white wine
instructions: Place potatoes into a large pot of boiling water, cover, and cook until tender, 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Basic Chili Powder Substitute
ingredients: 2 tablespoons coarsely ground dried chipotle chilies, or more to taste | 2 1/2 tablespoons maple syrup, or more to taste
instructions: Grind chipotle chiles with a mortar and pestle or spice grinder, or use a coffee grinder or a food processor. Add maple syrup and mix well. Use as a chili powder substitute for dried minced chicken, beef, tofu or tofu.

title: Curried Pepperoni
ingredients: 2 packages pepperoni | 1 tablespoon curry powder
instructions: Slice pepperoni into 1/4 inch pieces. Place in a skillet with curry powder and heat until hot. Stir and allow to cool completely before serving.

title: Japanese Beef Steak
ingredients: 2 - 2 1/2 lbs sirloin steaks ( or use top round, cut into bite sized pieces ) | 3 tablespoons soya sauce ( light japanese or red sweet ) | 1 tablespoon sherry wine or 1 tablespoon sake, for marinade
instructions: Mix together the soya sauce and rice wine till blended. Place the steak into a large zipper bag or baking dish and pour over the marinade. Nuke, covered, in a 400f oven for 15 minutes. Turn over the slices and bake 1 hour more, basting once with pan juices. The cooking time will vary for large cuts, thinner slices for small cuts. When done, transfer to a warm serving platter. Cover loosely with foil and keep warm.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,salt,coriander,large shrimp,mini chocolate chip,tomato paste
title: Mexican Hot Shrimp
ingredients: 1/2 lb uncooked large shrimp | 2 tablespoons minced fresh coriander ( or basil ) | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained ( hunts ) | 1/3 cup chopped peeled tomatoes with green chilies ( from a 28-ounce can ) or 1/3 cup chopped cilantro | 3 tablespoons tomato paste | 1 teaspoon salt ( to taste ) | 1/2 cup mini chocolate chip
instructions: Shell and devein shrimp, leaving tails intact. In 5 to 6 quart dutch oven or heavy pot, stir shrimp, coriander, tomatoes, chilies, tomato paste, salt and water to boiling over high heat. Cover.

Random Ingredients: bok choy,snow pea,black olive,cheese,red chile pepper,caper,red chili
title: Spicy Vegetables With Snow Peas
ingredients: 1 lb bok choy, shredded | 1 package fresh snow peas, strings removed | 1/2 lb roasted red chile peppers, chopped | 1/2 bunch fresh capers, rinsed | 1/4 cup sliced black olives | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh red chile peppers | 8 leaves fresh cheese, diced
instructions: Remove and discard the hard stems from the bok choy. Cut the ends off of the bok choy, and trim the remaining leaves until no more dirt remains. Chop the bok choy. In a mixing bowl, combine the bok choy, snow peas, roasted red chile peppers, capers, olives and red chile peppers. Season with salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: curry paste,oil,nutmeg,risotto mix,coriander powder,serrano chilies,red cabbage,pepper
title: Spiced Red Cabbage With Burrata
ingredients: 1 lb red cabbage | 2 tablespoons oil | 2 teaspoons hot curry paste | 1 1/2 tablespoons coriander powder | 1/2 cup risotto mix | pepper | nutmeg | 1 serrano chilies, thinly sliced
instructions: Wash cabbage and remove leaves. Shred cabbage into small 1 inch long thin shreds. Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large frying pan and stir fry cabbage until limp.

title: Spanish Steamed Fish
ingredients: 4 flounder, steamed until tender | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 can tomato juice
instructions: Slice fish into serving pieces. Place fish in a glass pot. Combine tomato sauce can and tomato juice. Pour over fish. Heat slowly. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,yukon gold potato,blueberry,oyster,salmon,yellow bell pepper,colby cheese
title: Black Forest Salmon & Blueberry Parfaits
ingredients: 1 salmon, skinned and boned | 1/4 cup cocoa powder | 6 yellow sweet potatoes, peeled, cut into halves, lengthwise | 1/2 lb ocean-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and chopped | 1/4 cup fresh blueberries | 1/2 cup frozen blueberries or 1/2 cup frozen pink berries | shredded colby cheese or monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. In a large bowl, combine salmon skin, and cocoa powder. Using a fork, prick the skin and bones in several places. Place in a small roasting pan. Add potatoes and cover with boiling water. Bake 2 minutes, or until just tender. Add tomatoes, blueberries, and remaining sauce ingredients. Cover and bake for 20 minutes. Uncover and bake for an additional 5 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese. Serve warm.

title: Cheater's Noodle Ciel
ingredients: 1/2 pound pork tenderloin, cut into strips | 2 envelopes egg noodles | 1 1/2 teaspoons fine sea salt
instructions: Place pork fat side up on a large piece of aluminum foil. Use kitchen scissors to make a slit 1/2 inch deep across the top of the pork. Sprinkle with fine sea salt. Spread 1 envelope of noodles across each slit of pork. Wrap tightly in foil, and refrigerate overnight. Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat and lightly oil the grate. Lightly oil the grate, and cook the pork for 12 to 15 minutes, turning and rearranging the meat over twice. Cook until crisp outside and pink in the center, 5 to 7 minutes total. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read 145 degrees f. Slice and eat.

Random Ingredients: malt vinegar,caramel,cannellini bean,lemon lime soda,cucumber,tomato green chilies,yeast,water chestnut
title: Chilli Bean Rolls With Chiles
ingredients: 1 cup malt vinegar | 1 tablespoon yeast | 1/4 cup warm water | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 1 lb caramels, chopped into small pieces | 1 cucumber, peeled and chopped | 2 cups cooked cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained
instructions: To make the dough, sift the vinegar into a large lidded plastic bowl and sprinkle the yeast over it. Let stand until frothy, about 5 minutes. Add the water and tomatoes. Cover well and set aside. To make the filling, stir the caramels and cucumber in a bowl with 1 cup of the beans. Let stand for 10 minutes. Stir in the rest of the beans, water chestnuts and 1/2 cup of the filling mixture. Pour into a greased 7 x 11 inch baking dish. Cover with a clean cloth and let rise in a warm, draft free place until doubled in bulk, about 1 hour, about 1 hour and 20 minutes. Bake in a preheated 400°f oven for about 30 minutes, stirring once or twice during the cooking time. Serve warm or room temperature.

title: Pounded Beef Brisket
ingredients: 5 lbs beef brisket | 6 lbs veal
instructions: Have the meat sawed, fat and tenderised, and tied very well with string. Put it into a kettle cover with cold water, bring to boil over medium high heat, and skim off any impurities that rise to the surface. When it comes to a boil, skim off the grayish foam that rises to the top and set the kettle on a rack to dry the meat a little. When ready, preheat the oven to 450 degrees f or until an instant reading thermometer reads 130 degrees f. Boil the brisket uncovered, in a kettle, until it has turned a rich golden brown color. The brown color will stain the meat a little, so watch it closely. Transfer the meat to a platter. Skim off any fat that rises to the top. Pour off 1/2 cup of the fat that rises to the top. Heat 1/2 cup oil in a large heavy kettle. Place the meat in the hot oil, fat side up. Brown on both sides, about 10 minutes. Place the brisket on a rack in a roasting pan which has been sprinkled with cornstarch. Place the kettle with the meat over very low heat, partially cover the kettle, and let it steam slowly over low heat for at least 3 hours. Remove the meat to a roasting pan, and pour off the fat fat. Use a paper towel to drain the fat. Serve the meat with potatoes, vegetables and gravy.

Random Ingredients: white flour,cardamom,white wine vinegar,gruyere cheese,celery,italian dressing,pepper sauce
title: Cheese Spread Appetizer
ingredients: 2 cups grated gruyere cheese | 1 cup white flour | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1/4 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons white wine vinegar | 3 tablespoons reduced-fat italian dressing
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the gruyere cheese, flour, cardamom, hot pepper sauce, vinegar and italian dressing. Cover with wax paper and let stand at room temperature 30 minutes. To serve, spread out the mixture on a serving platter. Spread with a little more gruyere cheese and decorate with fresh herbs and/or cheese shavings.

Random Ingredients: white onion,broth,cannellini bean,dark brown sugar,pesto sauce,sun tomato oil
title: Cannellini Beans Soup (Cannellini)
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans | 4 ounces sun dried tomatoes packed in oil, minced | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce | 4 tablespoons chopped white onions | 4 cups chicken stock or 4 cups broth | 1 1/4 tablespoons dark brown sugar
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small saucepan until the sugar is dissolved. Bring to a low boil and serve.

title: Cheater's Secret Ingredient Tiramisu - Easy!
ingredients: 1 tablespoon shortening | 1 package ladyfingers | 1 package corn tortilla chips
instructions: Place shortening into saucepan on stove on medium heat. Add ladyfinger and cook just till it melts. Tear chips in small bits while still warm. Dip half of the ladyfinger in the melted shortening. Coat with crushed marshmallow. Place half of the crushed marshmallow into waxed paper paper lined 9x9 baking pan. Continue doing this until all pieces are covered with marshmallow mixture. Spread remaining crushed marshmallow into another pan on medium high heat. Dip entire sheet of ladyfingers into marshmallow mixture until completely coated. Place in pan. Repeat steps 6 and 7 with remaining ingredients. Slice into serving sized pieces. Serve immediately. Optional, you can spread the last layer of prepared tiramisu onto a platter to serve as a topping.

title: Easy Microwave Ravioli
ingredients: 16 wonton wrappers | 1/4 cup cooking oil | 2 tablespoons ground almonds | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/2 teaspoon greek spices | 2 tablespoons dried coriander powder
instructions: Heat oil on the range/top burner. Place 1/2 tbsp of the ground almonds in the middle. Add the 1 tbsp dry coriander and 1 tsp of the greek spice. Place a wonton wrapper on top of the coriander and almonds. Dip the wonton in just enough water to moisten. Cook them on high for 15 minutes or until golden and tender. Serve hot.

title: Simple Fried Mushrooms With a Twist
ingredients: 4 thick slab bacon, cubed | 1 1/2 lbs trimmed mushrooms, such as chanterelles, such as shitake, crimini or shiitake, baby wood mushrooms, etc | 1 teaspoon smoked paprika ( or gory smoke, if you like a touch of smoke ) ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon madras curry powder ( optional ) or 1 teaspoon japanese curry powder, for sprinkling on mushroom
instructions: Preheat an ungreased frypan wok over low heat. Add the bacon, and swirl bacon around in the pan a few times to coat evenly. Raise the heat to medium, and set the bacon aside. Pour about 1 tablespoon water into the wok and swirl the pot wok to coat with some of the bacon grease. Add the mushrooms or shitake, and stir fry for 5 - 8 minutes. Sprinkle with smoked paprika and stir fry for 5 - 6 more minutes. Push the heat to low, add the curry powder, and stir fry for 1 minute. Remove from heat. Sprinkle with sugar if using, and serve, with brown basmati rice and/or steamed rice.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,yellow tomato,pepper sauce,chicken stock,vegetable stock,cinnamon,green bell pepper
title: Yellow Tomato Chutney
ingredients: 1 large yellow tomatoes, cored and diced | 1 small green bell pepper, cored and diced | 1/4 cup vegetable stock | 1/2 cup chicken stock | celery salt to taste | ground cinnamon to taste | 1 dash hot pepper sauce, or to taste
instructions: Place the tomato and green pepper into a pan over medium low heat, and fill with enough chicken or vegetable stock to cover. Simmer until tender, and remove from the heat. Stir in the celery salt, ground cinnamon, hot pepper sauce, and remaining 1/4 cup stock. Transfer the mixture to a blender, and puree until smooth. Strain to remove any lumps. Cover, and refrigerate in the refrigerator until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: lentil,linguine pasta,tomato,ginger garlic paste,cilantro,soy sauce,peanut,fast rising yeast
title: Lentil and Pasta Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces linguine pasta ( can use small to medium size pieces of your choice ) | 2 1/2 cups lentils ( yellow & green whole and green cut on the diagonal into 1-inch long strips ) | 1 ounce ginger-garlic paste | 14 1/2 ounces diced tomatoes | 1/2 cup fresh cilantro ( chopped ) | 1/3 cup soy sauce | 1/3 cup dark soya sauce | 1/3 cup chopped dry roasted peanuts ( optional )
instructions: Boil the pasta, drain. In a large bowl combine the drained pasta, lentils, ginger garlic paste, tomatoes, cilantro, soy sauce, dark soya sauce and peanuts, if using. When the pasta is done, toss it in a 9 x 13 inch baking dish. Cover and refrigerate till dinner time.

title: Ammagria - a Fresh, Simple, Traditional English Custard Dessert (Chessa)
ingredients: 1/2 lb puff pastry, thawed ( from an 18-oz. bag ) | 2 tablespoons milk | 3 saffron strands ( about 1 large saucer ) | 1 tablespoon currants ( or any dried fruit or dried glace )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Roll out the puff pastry into a rectangle about 10 x 6 inches on the parchment paper. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoons of milk and 1 tablespoon of the saffron strands. Make a well in the center. Invert the puff pastry onto the baking sheet. Brush the pastry with the remaining milk. Make another well in the center, and place it into the oven. Cook for 15 to 20 minutes, or until puffed and brown. Cut into squares and serve warm.

title: Curried Beet Soup
ingredients: 12 ounces diced cooked chicken breast strips | 1/2 cup sliced beets | 3 -4 tablespoons hot red curry paste | 1/2 cup fresh blueberries | fresh chives ( for garnish ), if desired ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in soup pot and bring to boil. Serve hot or cold.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,olive,shell pasta,egg white,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Cheesy Mango Macaroni With Shell Eggs (Quick)
ingredients: 1 bag uncooked shell-on pasta ( about 11 cups ) | 3 tablespoons olive oil | 1/3 cup mango chutney or 1/3 cup chipotle chile chutney, from a jar ( more or less to taste ) | 1 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1 scrambled egg white
instructions: Prepare pasta as directed on package and set aside. Meanwhile, heat oil in medium nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add chutney.

Random Ingredients: lamb stew meat,parsley leaf,red food coloring,cheddar bratwurst sausage,honey,molasses,baking potato
title: Dried Beef and Batsu
ingredients: 1 lb lamb stew meat, cut in 1/2 inch cubes | 1 lb ground batwurst sausage | 12 medium baking potatoes, peeled and cut in 1/4 inch cubes | 1/4 cup molasses or 1/4 cup maple syrup | 4 fluid ounces honey | 1 teaspoon red food coloring | 3/4 cup fresh parsley leaves, chopped, for garnishing
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Coat a large baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray and set aside. Mix lamb, sausage, and potato in a mixing bowl. In a saucepan, combine molasses or maple syrup, honey, food color, and parsley. Bring to a boil and immediately pour syrup mixture over meat and potatoes. Transfer pan into oven and bake for one hour, stirring meat and potatoes every 15 minutes. Remove from oven and let sit for 15 - 20 minutes. Slice and serve with garnish.

Random Ingredients: lettuce,fish stock,onion,lime wedge,beef,shiitake mushroom,dark sesame oil
title: Asian Beef Salad
ingredients: 5 ounces fresh shiitake mushrooms ( about 4-5 ounces ) | 1 lime wedge | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1 tablespoon fish stock | 1/2 lb lean ground beef | 1/4 cup thinly sliced onion ( about 3/4-1/4-inch ) | 1/2 head lettuce, torn into bite-size pieces
instructions: Remove the stems from the mushrooms and coarsely chop the caps. Place the mushrooms and caps in a small bowl. Set aside. Trim the shiitakes. Rinse the sesame oil and stir in fish sauce. Place the beef in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook, stirring, until lightly browned about 5 minutes. Remove from the heat. Drain the mushrooms and set aside. Cut the stems from the mushroom slices. Chop the caps and set aside. In a large bowl, combine the chopped mushroom, diced onion, beef, and sesame oil. Toss to combine. Put the chopped lettuce on top of the beef mixture. Top lettuce with the mushrooms and chopped onion mixture. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: rice,green pepper,beef stew meat,orange,spaghetti sauce,bamboo shoot,tomato soup
title: Orange Beef Skillet
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef stew meat, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 1/2 cup chopped green pepper | 1 medium orange, peeled & cut into wedges | 1 1/2 cups uncooked rice | 1 can tomato soup | 3/4 cup spaghetti sauce | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained
instructions: Set oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. Spray the bottom of the dish with cooking spray. Place beef in dish. Top beef with green pepper, orange slices, rice, tomato soup & spaghetti sauce. Cover dish tightly with foil. Bake in preheated oven for 45 minutes or until meat is tender and rice is tender. Shred meat with two forks. Serve family style in soup bowl with salad. Garnish with parsley and carrots.

title: Salsa Pimenton (Anguilla)
ingredients: 15 large pimento-stuffed, sweet corn, with a few holes ( about 1.5-3/4 pounds ) | 1/2 cup salsa, your choice ( mild or hot ) | 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1/4 teaspoon saffron | 1/4 teaspoon dark sesame oil
instructions: Cut the corn husks into three lengths and remove the seeds. Bring a pot of water to a boil.
