Place the corn and a handful of the jarred salsa in the water and cook over low heat until well heated, about 30 seconds. Drain well and spread all over a small baking sheet or tray covered with foil. Cover it with the remaining jarred salsa and a handful of the bag. In another frying pan, heat the sugar, then the cornstarch, and saffron over low heat until the sugar is golden brown and syrupy, about five minutes. Stir the corn mixture into the caramel. Bring to a boil, stirring from time to time, then lower the heat and simmer for five more minutes. Remove the pan from the heat and remove the husks from the corn. Lift the corn out and discard them. Cut into 4 equal portions. Pour the hot liquid over the corn pieces and serve at once, sprinkled with sesame oil.

title: British Beer and Raisin Mince Pops
ingredients: 1 liter good dark beer, such as guinness | 1 tablespoon golden syrup ( or light honey ) | 1/2 teaspoon allspice | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 2 1/4 cups raisins | 1/3 cup soy milk
instructions: Make sure to have yoghurt the freezer if you're at home. Mix everything together, except the milk into a thick paste. Put this mixture into a pan with a lid, so that the mixture doesn't stick to the rim. Heat on low/medium heat, but don't allow it to boil. Keep an eye catching spoon in the pan, until the mixture is bubbling and a thick, bubbling paste forms, about 10 minutes. Don't let it boil, because the lumps will only take the surface of the paste. When you can see bubbles escaping, remove from heat. Stir in milk. Leave to cool before cutting.

Random Ingredients: yellow pepper,yeast,buttermilk,pickling spice,parsley,italian salad dressing mix,cornbread stuffing mix
title: Italian Cornbread Wedges
ingredients: 4 1/2 cups cornbread stuffing mix | 4 1/2 cups italian salad dressing mix | 1/4 cup snipped fresh parsley | 2 teaspoons dry mustard or 1 1/2 teaspoon prepared dijon-style dry mustard | 1/2 teaspoon pickling spice | 2 yellow sweet peppers, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 1 1/2 cups buttermilk ( use very dry yeast water at the mix )
instructions: Heat oven to in bowl, stir dry italian mix, parsley, mustard, relish, hot pepper and 2 cups of the buttermilk. Let stand at room temperature for 30 minutes. Add remaining buttermilk, pepper pieces and breading yeast mixture, stir to blend. Turn onto oiled baking sheet and brush top of bread with remaining buttermilk mixture. Bake 50 - 60 minutes until tops appear golden. Cut into wedges and serve warm or cool completely.

title: Homemade Red Rice (Aarti Sequiera)
ingredients: 2 cups dry red rice | cloves, to taste
instructions: Soak the rice in a bowl of warm water before using to avoid contact with it. The clove will stain the rinsing off the rice. Place rice in a fine mesh strainer and squeeze the soaked rice to remove as fine liquid as possible. Drain the rice well. Place the rinsed rice in a bowl, pour hot water over rice, cover with plastic wrap, and let sit for one hour. Discard soaking liquid. Remove any hard threads or rind from the rice and stir into rice. If you like, you can also use ground spices to flavor the rice.

title: Mint Halva II
ingredients: 600 g semolina ( malai or gullavi ) | 50 g minced ginger-garlic paste | 2 leaves of fresh mint
instructions: Mix semolina, ginger garlic paste, and mint together in a bowl. Drain out excess liquid. Shape mixture into balls about 2 inches in diameter.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,tomato soup,lamb shoulder,duck leg,monterey jack cheese
title: Peking Duck
ingredients: 1 duck leg | 1 can tomato soup | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 1 pound cubed country-style lamb shoulder | 1 pound shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Rinse duck legs, and place them into a deep pan. Add beer and balsamic vinegar, and bring liquid to a boil. Baste duck legs occasionally during the hour. When duck legs are nearly done, preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Cover the pan, and place into the preheated oven. Bake duck legs in the preheated oven 45 minutes, or until tender. Remove foil from the baking dish, and arrange ham and cheese in the pan. Return to oven. Bake 15 minutes, or until cheese is melted.

Random Ingredients: butternut squash,red lentil,guinness stout,double cream,sourdough bread,chicken breast half
title: Lentil and Guinness Soup
ingredients: 400 g red lentils, rinsed | 400 g butternut squash, peeled and cut into pieces | 200 ml guinness stout | 150 double cream | 10 slices sourdough bread, toasted | 12 skinned boneless chicken breast halves, halved
instructions: Place the lentils in a pan. Cover with cold water and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat, maintaining a simmer, and cook for 25 minutes. Add the squash and cook for 5 minutes until tender. Drain well, then mash with the guinness until smooth. Place the cream, sourdough, chicken, and cooked lentils in the bottom of 4 soup bowls. Top with the soup. Serve with toasted bread.

Random Ingredients: clove,grenadine,walnut,phyllo dough,liquid smoke,bay leaf,tomato green chile pepper
title: Bamia Cigars
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups chopped walnuts | 2 cloves | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers | 1 jar roasted garlic flavored liquid smoke | 1 can chopped stewed tomatoes with liquid smoke | 11 sheets phyllo dough | 1 teaspoon grenadine
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Cook walnuts in a skillet over medium heat and stir until they are lightly toasted, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside to cool. Stir together the chopped walnuts and chopped cloves in a bowl with the 2 diced tomatoes. Stir together the roasted garlic sauce and stewed tomatoes in a pot and simmer over low heat until almost boiling. Place a sheet of phyllo dough into a glass pie plate and brush generously with some of the flavored garlic sauce. Place another sheet of phyllo dough on top. Place 1/3 of the walnut mixture on the phyllo, then cover with 1/2 the remaining dough.

title: Sausage & Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 12 hot italian sausages | 1 cup basmati rice ( soaked in 5 cups boiling water for 20 minutes ) | 4 teaspoons cornflour | 4 teaspoons baking powder | 2 cans filling | 1 head iceberg lettuce, roughly chopped | filling, and | pizza bread, triangles for dipping
instructions: Boil, water and rice for 20 minutes drain and rest. Cook and cool italian sausages. Dry them in a pan, and grill them until well cooked. While the sausages are in the pan, mix corn flour, baking powder, and fillings. Slice and serve on a lettuce leaf. Add more garlic, oregano, black bean, or any other topping you like to your taste.

title: Chinese Roasted Chicken
ingredients: 3 lbs chicken, whole, organic, skin on | 2 tablespoons sweet chili paste | 2 tablespoons sweet chili paste ( to taste )
instructions: In a large bowl, blend, sweet chili paste and sweet chile paste. Place chicken in large crock pot. Pour the sweet chili paste mixture over the chicken. Keep on low for at least six hours or up to 2 days before cooking. Discard remaining paste.

title: Quick and Easy Coconut Crackers
ingredients: 1 cup flaked coconut | 3 tablespoons hot sauce ( tabasco, peri-peri or cholula )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325°f. Use a cookie sheet or oven safe baking sheet with a lid or parchment paper or a baking dish with a close fitting lid. Combine the coconut and hot sauce and stir to combine. If using a cookie sheet, spray with pam or coat with a nonstick spray coating. Drop small bits at a time onto the cookie sheet. Bake on the center rack for 10 minutes or until the coconut has the desired colour and crispiness. Carefully remove the cookies from the oven. Allow for 10 minutes. Carefully remove the coconut and return to the oven. Bake for a further 8 minutes or until the coating begins to crisp and the coating on the coconut becomes more crisp and crisp. Remove from the oven and allow for 10 minutes more. Remove and store any leftover coating in an airtight container. This is an excellent snack to keep in the fridge, or even to serve with other tasty snacks.

title: Grilled Corn
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh corn, shucked | 3/4 cup whole dry-roasted unsalted corn | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom pod
instructions: Position rack in center of oven and preheat to 400°f place cayenne pepper in a shallow dish. Place corn on an ungreased nonmetallic metal or glass baking dish. Spread corn evenly in even layer. Roast until charred, about 15 minutes, stirring often and mashing with a wooden spoon.

title: Sticky Cuban Bread
ingredients: 4 pieces ciabatta, preferably long, fairly stale and toasted | cooking oil | fresh lime wedge ( optional ) | 1/4 cup sherry wine or 1/4 cup white wine vinegar
instructions: Heat 1/2 inch of cooking oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Lightly score top and bottom of bread, about 1/4 inch thick using a crisscross pattern across the cut surface. Add half of bread, overlapping slices slightly. Drizzle limeade over bread, then spoon sherry or white wine vinegar over bread. Using a wide spatula or wooden spatula, flip bread so that both sides of the bread are coated with juice. Cook about 3 minutes, or until bread is lightly toasted and golden and liquid is gone.

Random Ingredients: beef,rom tomato,orange blossom water,espresso,pink food coloring,poundcake
title: Sparkling Italian Meatballs
ingredients: 1 pound ground beef | 1 pinch pink food coloring | 2 frozen poundcake | 10 espresso beans, brewed and cooled | 1 roma ( plum ) tomato, diced | 2 teaspoons orange blossom water
instructions: Preheat an oven to 325 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Place the frozen pound cakes onto the prepared baking sheet. In a mixing bowl, mix beef, food color, and orange blossom water. Form the mixture into 2 meatballs, and place into the baking sheet. Bake for 30 minutes in the preheated oven, or until the internal temperature of the meatballs reaches 160 degrees f. Allow to cool for 10 to 15 minutes. Remove meatballs from the pan, and cut into 2 inch pieces. Place into a serving dish while still warm.

title: Southern Style Snack Mix
ingredients: 1/4 cup dry bread crumbs | 2 tablespoons catsup | 1/2 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg ( optional )
instructions: Stir bread crumbs, catsup, worcestershire sauce, and nutmeg together in a bowl until well combined.

Random Ingredients: yellow pepper,tomato paste,sesame oil,saffron,flour tortilla,amaretto,curry powder,beef
title: Somali Beef With Pepper & Saffron Filling
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef, cut into thin strips | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1 teaspoon sesame oil | 12 flour tortillas | 1 yellow peppers or 1 red pepper, sliced to 1/4-inch | 1/2 teaspoon saffron, dissolved in a little water | 1 tablespoon amaretto ( optional ) or 1 tablespoon rum ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients and marinate beef overnight. Preheat broiler. Lightly oil grill. Grill beef until done, about 4 minutes per side. Serve on flour tortillas. Top with pepper slices. Pour sauce over all and serve.

title: Fettuccine With Maple Syrup and Maple Garlic
ingredients: 1 lb fettuccine pasta, uncooked | 1/4 cup pure maple syrup | 1 garlic clove, crushed
instructions: Cook fettuccine according to package directions, omitting salt and fat. Toss with maple syrup and crushed garlic and serve.

Random Ingredients: cold water,rice wine,parmesan cheese,green onion,ketchup,linguine,purpose flour,jalapeno pepper
title: Noodles With Ketchup and Jalapeno
ingredients: 6 ounces linguine | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 1/4 cup cold water | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | 1 1/2 tablespoons rice wine | 2 tablespoons jalapeno peppers, seeded and thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon thinly sliced green onion | 1 tablespoon shaved parmesan cheese
instructions: Cook pasta in a large pot of boiling water until al dente. Drain. Meanwhile, whisk ketchup, water, flour and wine in small bowl. Stir in jalapeno, onions and cheese. Add hot pasta to sauce.

Random Ingredients: cornflour,icing sugar,canadian bacon,thyme leaf,lemon zest,cheese,chicken cutlet,jalapeno
title: Jalapeno Chicken Cutlets With Baked Sour Cream
ingredients: 1/2 lb cheese | 3 slices smoked canadian bacon, chopped fine | 1/4 teaspoon lemon zest, grated | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 2 tablespoons jalapenos, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons fresh thyme leaves, leaves, roughly torn | 14 -16 chicken cutlets, about 20 slices per person
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f & grease a baking dish with butter & oil. Process cheese until creamy & season to taste. Combine sour cream & cornflour, mix together. Stir in sugar. Add jalapenos, thyme & the cheese mixture. Spoon the mixture into the baking dish. Arrange the chicken in the mixture on top. Pour over the sourcream. Bake for 25 minutes, or until chicken is cooked & there is golden brown topping. Serve with your favourite accompaniments, such as, rice, pasta, noodles or a traditional vegetable dish. Note, i like to use my bbq to prepare the chicken & place the chicken on a baking tray, basting with the sour cream mix. Cook for 15 minutes, then lower the heat & cook for 25 - 30 minutes more. The chicken just needs to be crispy on the outside & just a little softer on the inside, but not overdone so watch carefully. The final product will be slightly thinner than the original version of the recipe ~ the result is a delicious marcy & a tasty tender chicken cutlet. Variation, when adding sour cream on top of the chicken, sprinkle on some chopped jalepeno, or add a little shredded cheddar before serving.

title: Faux-Cheese Fudge Bars
ingredients: 8 ounces peanut butter | 2 cups semisweet chocolate or 2 cups peanut butter | 1/2 cup finely grated chinese peppercorn chocolate ( if you can't find this use another brand with peanuts or use 1/2 cup bittersweet chocolate ) | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon chili powder ( as hot as you want! ) | 1/2 teaspoon lemon extract ( or vanilla ) | pepper | maraschino cherry ( just a note of garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Grease and line a 9 x 13 pan. With the waxed paper pat the chocolate into a 16 x 10 inch rectangle. Place the chocolate in a bowl over a small saucepan of boiling water, and set aside to let it melt. When the chocolate is melted, remove from the saucepan, and stir until thoroughly mixed. Add the peanut butter, and stir until well blended. Stir in the chocolate, cumin, chili powder and lemon extract. Spread the mixture evenly into the pan. Grate a bit of pepper ontop of the fudge, if desired, and spread evenly over the chocolate. Spread the remaining pepper on top of the fudge, if desired. Allow to set at room temperature about an hour or more. Sprinkle with additional pepper if desired.

title: Chinese Style Three Vegetable Beans
ingredients: 1 lb dry pinto bean, soaked overnight in cold salted water | 1 tablespoon arrowroot ( dissolved in about 2 tablespoons of cold water ) | 2 cups brown rice, soaked overnight in cold water | 1 teaspoon sesame oil | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon, dissolved in | 1 teaspoon arrowroot
instructions: Rinse and drain beans. Place in a 4 quart saucepan and add enough water to cover by several inches. Bring water to a boil and simmer over medium heat, uncovered, until beans are tender and a knife can be inserted in the thickest sections of the beans, about 45 minutes, skimming foam from top occasionally. While beans are simmering, place rice in a medium saucepan with 2 cups cold water. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low and simmer until rice is tender, about 20 minutes. Dissolve the bouillon in the same manner and add to the beans and rice. Continue cooking, covered, until the rice is tender but creamy and most of the liquid remains clear, about 10 minutes longer.

title: Lemon Thyme Green Pancetta Beans Sprouts
ingredients: 6 cups fresh bean sprouts | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 tablespoon lemon pepper | 9 ounces pancetta, diced | 1/2 cup fresh green, chopped
instructions: Bring 4 cups of water to a boil. Add the beans and thyme. Reduce the heat and simmer for 25 minutes or until tender. Meanwhile, place the pancetta, lemon pepper and green in a skillet. Saute over medium high heat until lightly browned. To serve, place 2 to 3 tablespoons of the sprouts on each plate.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,spanish onion,golden raisin,sugar syrup,tequila
title: Caramelized Spanish Onions
ingredients: 1 cup spanish onion | 3 tablespoons tequila | 1/3 cup golden raisin | 1 tablespoon sugar syrup | grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Cut 2 slits on each onion and set aside. Place onion slits in a food storage plastic bag. Combine remaining ingredients in a small saucepan or heavy bottomed pot and heat over medium high heat until it comes to a boil. Cook until onions are reduced to glaze and syrupy, about 12 minutes. Remove from heat and let steep at least 4 minutes. Makes about 2 cups.

title: Potatoes St. Pat's Coated with Crisco & Salt
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs small red potatoes | 3 tablespoons crisco | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Grate potatoes and place in a colander in sink. Toss potatoes with 2 tablespoons crisco and season with pepper to taste. Spread crisco evenly on baking sheet. Bake potatoes in 450f oven on center rack of oven until slightly browned and tender, stirring once halfway through cooking time, about 1 hour.

title: Calamonic - Calamonic Salad With Calamonic
ingredients: 50 ml lemon curd | 1/2 cabbage, shredded | 100 g frozen squid, thawed
instructions: Combine lemon curd and cabbage and refrigerate until cold.

title: Chinese Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 1 head chinese cabbage, cored and shredded ( about 1 pound ) | 12 dates, roughly chopped ( or more to taste ) | 1 sprig fresh thyme sprig ( optional )
instructions: Place all the shredded cabbage in a large bowl using a large slotted spoon, or a large serving spoon. Add the dates and thyme. Toss until well combined. Add more date or thyme if you prefer. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: black bean,cilantro stem,self raising flour,cornflour,cold water,heart palm,steak,cardamom seed
title: Cuban Black Bean and Hearts of palm recipe and accompaniment
ingredients: 1 cup self-raising flour | 2 cups cold water | 1/4 cup cornflour | 2 teaspoons cardamom seeds | 1 cup cilantro stem ( or parsley stems ) | 1 cup black beans ( drained, rinsed and cooked ) | 2 lbs steak ( sirloin or rib eye ) | 1 cup hearts of palm, cut into thin strips ( or green onion )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place flour and water in a medium bowl and mix well to form a smooth, malleable dough. Cover with plastic wrap and leave to stand for 20 minutes. Heat griddle or frying pan over high heat until hot but not smoking. Remove from heat and add cardamom seeds. Stir to bruise and then add cilantro and beans. Stir until beans are coated and starting to caramalise. Place the steak into a large mixing bowl. Add the flour and water to form a smooth paste. Season with salt and pepper. Form the dough by laying it out on a well floured surface, pulling together the same sized flour and water, into a ball. Shape into a log shape. Repeat with other balls and meat until there are three complete round, 5 inch diameter cookies of your choice. Place cookies onto greased grill or frying pan and cook for 8 - 10 minutes, then turn and cook the other side for 8 - 10 minutes until cooked. Remove from grill or frying pan and keep warm in oven. Arrange the hearts of palm, cut side down on serving platter. Cut meat across grain into slivers and drizzle over the palm. Serve with the beans and hearts of palm.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,lime peel,liquid smoke,clear honey,pineapple chunk,curd cottage cheese,cranberry,red potato
title: Broccoli Salad With Pineapple, Cranberries, and Corn Chips
ingredients: 1 head broccoli floret | 1 bag red potatoes | 1 jar pineapple chunks | 4 ounces curd cottage cheese | 1/4 cup orange marmalade liquid smoke | 4 tablespoons clear honey | 1 lime peel, grated | salt and freshly ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: In a large bowl, coarsely chop broccoli to expose florets. Add potatoes, breaking into 3/4 inch dice, and pineapple chunks to bowl. In small bowl of an electric blender, combine marmalade ingredients.

title: Paneer and Broccoli Sprout Fry
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | panir | 2 cups broccoli florets | 1 pinch saffron, crumbled
instructions: Coat pan with cooking spray, add broccoli and sauté for about 4 to 5 minutes, or until cooked, stirring often. Remove from heat, stir in paneer and crumbled saffron and serve immediately.

title: Easy Plain Enchiladas
ingredients: 2 cans enchilada sauce | 3 cups whole wheat germ
instructions: Combine enchilada sauce and 3 cups of whole wheat germ in a saucepan. Bring to boil. Pour enough enchilada sauce into a 13x9x2 dish to cover the bottom of the pan. Line up 8 - 8 of the tortillas in the bottom of the saucepan and pour 1 can of remaining enchilada sauce over the tortillas. Dip the enchiladas into the remaining sauce then cover the tortillas with the remaining can of sauce. Cook, covered, over low heat until warmed through.

title: Smoked Red Cabbage
ingredients: 3 cups shredded red cabbage | olive oil flavored cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Coat a 3 quart dish with cooking spray. Layer cabbage and enough water to coat bottom. Toss cabbage with cooking spray. Cover dish with foil. Bake in preheated oven for 1 hour. Serve and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: ham,garlic,wheat flour tortilla,clove,cream tartar,black eyed pea,chili oil
title: Bean and Crab Tortilla Stack
ingredients: 16 ounces uncooked black-eyed peas | 4 ounces diced cooked ham | 3/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon dried chipotle chili oil ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon garlic | 1/8 teaspoon ground cloves | 12 12 -14 whole wheat flour tortillas
instructions: To make sauce, stir fry garlic, chili oil, cream of tartar, and ground cloves in oil and set aside until cool. Grind beans using a mortar and pestle, or through meat grinder. Stir together beans with ham, tomatoes, and spices. Wrap tortilla in foil and warm in the preheated oven at 425f until warmed, about 5 - 10 minutes. Scoop bean mixture onto tortillas, roll up, and continue until all the tortillas are filled.

title: Gado De Huancaina (Fried Green Chile Scallions)
ingredients: 6 -8 large dried guajillo chilies, seeds and pith removed, soaked in hot water until soft, about 2 to 3 days | 1 lb sliced scallion ( green onions )
instructions: Slice the scallions into 1/2 inch slices.

title: Vodka Black Beans, Black Beans, Vinaigrette
ingredients: 16 ounces black beans, drained and rinsed | 3 tablespoons canola oil ( or other neutral flavoring ) | 3 tablespoons vodka | lemon juice and zest of | 1/4 cup vinegar
instructions: Heat oil in a medium saucepan. Add beans and vinegar. Cook over medium heat until just hot, not boiling. Stir in lemon juice and zest. Serve immediately.

title: Mexican-Russian Chili
ingredients: 1 can chick-peas ( drained ) | 1/3 cup white tequila
instructions: Empty the chickpeas and their liquid into a small pitcher. Pour in the white tequila. Stir to combine. Serve on your favorite mexican dish or jus with any mexi garnishes you like.

title: Easy Delicious Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans mexican-style tomatoes, undrained | 1/2 cup chopped italian parsley
instructions: Blend both cans of tomatoes and parsley in blender until smooth. Use to season pork and chicken.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,asafoetida powder,tomato soup,icing sugar,salsa,vanilla essence
title: Asafoetida Spiced Salsa for Veggies
ingredients: 400 g condensed tomato soup | 1 cup salsa ( i prefer medium or hot ) | 150 g icing sugar | 1 green cardamom pod | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 vanilla essence
instructions: Wash the veggies well, dry with absorbent paper and keep aside. Mix all ingredients in a saucepan, microwave for 10 minutes. Remove from heat and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: curd cottage cheese,vegetable seasoning,whipping cream,green pepper,yellow bell pepper,red bean,splenda sugar substitute,tomato juice
title: Pillsbury Refritos
ingredients: 1/2 cup vegetable seasoning | 1 1/2 cups dry curd cottage cheese, drained | 3/4 cup yellow bell pepper, diced | 1/2 cup green pepper, diced | 3/4 cup diced tomato with juice | 2 1/2 cups tomato juice | 1/2 cup splenda sugar substitute or 1/2 cup splenda sugar substitute | 1/2 cup whipping cream
instructions: In a small skillet, cook the cottage cheese until it is all lightly browned. While the cottage cheese is cooking, put chopped peppers, cubed tomatoes, splenda, and whipping cream in a food processor and process until smooth and creamy. If the mixture seems a little thick, add a little water. Stir the contents of the food processor with the cheese mixture in a large bowl. Drop spoonfuls of the cottage cheese mixture on a paper towel lined cookie sheet, spacing evenly, about 1 1/2 inches apart. They should be 3/4 covered by cheese. Bake at 350f for 15 - 20 minutes, until golden brown and well done. Serve with salsa and sour cream if desired.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower,pistachio,ginger,rice wine,carrot,hamburger bun,olive oil cooking spray
title: Chinese Cauliflower Burgers With Crisp Crisp Pistachio Rice Nests
ingredients: olive oil flavored cooking spray | 1 large cauliflower, cut into 2-inch florets | 1 medium carrot, cut into 1/4-inch dice | 1/4 cup sliced pickled ginger | 2 tablespoons pate or 2 tablespoons gingersnap cheese | 4 hamburger buns, halved | 1 -2 tablespoon whole-grain rice wine or 1 -2 tablespoon dry sherry | 1/3 cup salted pistachios, roughly chopped, for garnish
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Coat a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Add cauliflower and carrot.

title: Mexican Corn and Hazelnut Soup #2
ingredients: 2 cups sliced corned fruit ( such as strawberries, banana or apple ) | 2 tablespoons brown mustard seeds | 2/3 cup fresh mango or 2/3 cup can pineapple | 1/4 cup fresh salsa ( your choice ) | 3/4 cup buttermilk or 3/4 cup evaporated milk | 2 tablespoons sugar | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1 cup cooked and hulled corn
instructions: Prepare the corn and husk by placing the corn on the corn and steaming until tender. Wash corn well under cool water and drain. Slice off and discard the outer green tops of the ears of corn and discard, then use a vegetable peeler or sharp knife to trim kernels around the cob and transfer the corn to a mixing bowl. Dry the mustard seeds in a small skillet and set aside. Peel and chop the mango into about 2 to 3 cubes. Remove from the oven and cut the pineapple into chunks and add to the bowl with the corn. Mix well in with the other ingredients. Heat the buttermilk or milk over medium heat until it bubbles. Stir in the corn kernels, sugar and cream and cook until creamy and thickened, stirring often, about 8 minutes. Remove from the heat. Place 2 to 3 cups of the soup into a blender and fill 4 to 6 with the corn mixture. Blend to desired consistency and adjust the sweetness with a little sugar, adding more if desired. Pour into serving bowls and garnish with toasted hazelnuts.

title: Wild Rice With Veggies
ingredients: 3 cups seitan | 2 1/2 cups wild rice | 2 portabella mushrooms, sliced | 2 shallots, sliced | 3/4 cup ricotta cheese
instructions: Cook wild rice in boiling water according to package.. Meanwhile, boil seitan in 3/4 cup water. When rice is almost done, add seitan and mushrooms to seitan, simmer 3 minutes. Add 1/2 cup water, cook 5 minutes, add more water if needed. Add shallots and ricotta.

Random Ingredients: peanut butter,chili sauce,blackberry,carrot,anchovy,self raising flour,baby portabella mushroom,beer
title: Baby Portabella Mushrooms
ingredients: 3/4 cup self-raising flour | 1 teaspoon anchovy, chopped | 125 g baby portabella mushrooms, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup beer | 1/4 cup peanut butter, crunchy | 1/4 cup sweet chili sauce | 1/4 cup chili, fresh cooked or jarred sliced anchovies | 3 large mixed berry, halves
instructions: Mix flour, anchovy and mushroom in medium bowl. Combine remaining ingredients in a medium bowl and add to flour mixture, stir to combine. Divide into two equal quantities and place on lightly oiled tray. Space mushrooms evenly onto cakes. Bake in a moderate oven for 20 - 25 minutes or until golden brown and cooked. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: icing sugar,cayenne pepper,pork shoulder,peanut oil,poblano chile,mint sprig
title: Tortilla De Choclo
ingredients: 1 -2 lb pork shoulder, whole, boneless, lean | 1 -2 teaspoon icing sugar ( or confectioner's sugar ) | 10 tablespoons peanut oil | 10 tablespoons crushed dried poblano chiles | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | mint sprig
instructions: Cut meat into chunks using 2 forks. Place meat in a bowl with icing sugar. Using your fingers, drizzle 3 tbsp of peanut oil into a flat pan that is coated with the oil. Heat for 10 minutes on med high heat until the oil is bubbly. Turn heat to medium low and place the meat back into the pan. Sprinkle with crushed chilies, cayenne pepper, and salt to taste. Cover and simmer meat for 10 - 15 minute or until liquid evaporates. Sprinkle with mint before serving. Serve with fresh tortillas.

title: Summer Dumpados
ingredients: 2 avocados, halved and pitted | 1 cup yellow sweet pepper, cut into strips | 1 cup fresh pineapple juice | 1 tablespoon oil | 1 cup italian seasoned bread crumbs
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange the cut side of each avocado half in a baking dish. Drizzle with the sweet pepper and pineapple juice. In a small bowl, mash the avocados with 1 tablespoon of oil and the bread crumbs. Sprinkle over the avocado mixture. Bake for 20 minutes in the preheated oven, or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,plum tomato,five spice powder,meatball,olive oil,cranberry juice concentrate,cocoa,anchovy
title: Anchovy-Topped Fassouloni
ingredients: 1 package frozen meatballs | 6 plum tomatoes, seeded and diced | 1/3 cup canned cranberry juice concentrate, undiluted | 1/4 cup picante sauce | 1 tablespoon cocoa | 1/2 teaspoon five-spice powder | 1 tablespoon anchovy, minced | 3 tablespoons olive oil
instructions: Heat oven on broil. Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Place frozen meatballs in pan in a single layer. Set aside. To make tomato sauce, combine tomatoes, cranberry juice concentrate, picante sauce, cocoa, five spice powder, and anchovy.

title: Grilled Clam Salad
ingredients: 1 lb fresh clams, well scrubbed | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 1/3 cup light brown sugar | 1 tablespoon italian salad dressing ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons reduced-fat italian salad dressing | 1 tablespoon mirin ( optional ) | sliced radish ( optional )
instructions: Place clams in a bowl of cold water.

Random Ingredients: head iceberg lettuce,rosemary sprig,thai red chili pepper,rye cocktail bread
title: Thai Fried Steak Sandwiches
ingredients: 12 slices rye cocktail bread | 1/2 lb sirloin steak, cut into 6 thin pieces | 1/2 cup thai red chili pepper, finely chopped ( or to taste ) | fresh rosemary sprig ( to garnish ) | 1 bag round thai basil and lettuce rolls ( or other rolls )
instructions: Preheat broiler. Line baking sheet with foil and arrange bread slices on baking sheet. Drizzle each side of each slice with some of the red chile pepper's. Broil bread 3 inches from heat, 4 to 5 minutes or until lightly toasted, turning once, and turning once, until lightly toasted on both sides and just beginning to char, 10 to 15 minutes total. Remove bread slices from oven. Spread each slice with some of the steak and 1/8 cup green chili pepper mixture, sprinkling evenly with rosemary before slicing 1/4 inch thick. Top each steak with lettuce roll and remaining chile pepper mixture. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: vodka,yellow squash,flat bread,cottage cheese,dill pickle spear,chicken broth,yellow mustard
title: Squash and Mustard Soup
ingredients: 2 large yellow squash, halved and seeded | 2 tablespoons chopped dill pickles spears | 2 cups low sodium chicken broth | 1/4 cup coarse-grained yellow mustard | 1/4 cup vodka | 1/2 cup low fat cottage cheese | 4 tablespoons thinly sliced flat bread
instructions: Cut squash in half, then cut each half into 12 1/2 inch thick slices. Cut slices lengthwise into 8 wedges. Cut wedges crosswise in half, then cut wedge pieces crosswise into thin slices. Spray a large, wide frying pan with nonstick cooking spray. Add squash. Add pickles. Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until tender enough to pierce with a fork, about 3 minutes. Stir in broth. Add mustard, vodka, and 3 tablespoons of cottage cheese. Cook, stirring frequently, until smooth. Cover and cook over low heat until soup is hot and the cottage cheese is melted and creamy, about 5 minutes. Transfer mixture in bowls to individual serving bowls. Top with bread slices and remaining cottage cheese.

Random Ingredients: phyllo pastry,scallion,iceberg lettuce,anchovy,garam masala,curry paste,radicchio,ice water
title: Easy Phyllo Pizza
ingredients: 10 sheets phyllo pastry, thawed | ice water | 1/4 cup curry paste | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala | 1 can anchovies, drained | 1/4 cup scallion | 1 head iceberg lettuce, shredded | 1 radicchio, shredded
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Pierce the filo strip thick as possible. Place in an oven proof dish, and cover with plastic wrap. Microwave on high 1 minute, or until golden brown on the bottom. Place in microwave and micro on high 1 minute, or until golden brown on the bottom. Flip filo onto a sheet of wax paper. Spray with nonstick vegetable spray. Spread the curry paste over the filo, and sprinkle with garam masala. Spread the anchovies over the curry, and scatter over the scallions, iceberg lettuce, and radicchio. Place another layer of filo on top, and cover with a second layer of filo. Cover with waxed paper. Microwave on high 20 seconds. Flip off the microwave, and let rest 10 minutes. Cut and serve.

Random Ingredients: lime juice,white breadcrumb,anise seed,bow tie pasta,chicken thigh,grain rice,limeade concentrate,lime zest
title: Lime Chicken Cacciatore
ingredients: 1 cup lime juice | 1 1/2 cups limes, juice of | 1/2 cup white breadcrumbs | 1 lime, zest of | 1 lime, cut into wedges | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 2 -4 medium boneless chicken thighs | 3 1/2 cups hot cooked bow tie pasta, i use rotelle ( bowtie pasta )
instructions: Start rice according to package directions. Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Whisk together the lime dressing, lime zest, lime juice, bread crumbs, lime wedges, anise and half the orange juice in a large bowl. Add chicken and toss to coat. Arrange chicken slices in a single layer in a roasting pan coated with nonstick cooking spray. Pour the salad dressing mixture over chicken and toss to coat well. Arrange the chicken on top of the pasta in a single layer. Bake the chicken, covered, for 40 - 45 minutes, until chicken is cooked through. Pour the remaining orange juice into a medium bowl.

title: Easy French Cut
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless leg of lamb | 1/4 cup ketchup, any brand | 1 tablespoon instant chicken bouillon
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Place the cutlets side by side in a lightly greased baking pan. Mix together the ketchup and bouillon, pour on top of everything and turn to coat all sides. Cook in the oven 15 mins, basting once or twice while cooking. Turn down oven temperature to 350 degrees and bake for another 2 hours.

title: Italian Dressing & Salpicon Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain yogurt, balkan-style preferred | 1/3 cup watercress, packed ( stemmed and chopped fine ) | 1 container plain yogurt | 2 bunches of fresh parsley leaves, well snipped | 3 scallions, chopped very fine ( yellow shallots ) | 1/4 cup smooth peanut butter ( creamy type not natural ) | 1 -2 tablespoon bottled italian salad dressing, from the grocer, may need more | 2 medium radishes, peeled, and thinly sliced
instructions: Place yogurt in a bowl and stir in watercress and chopped parsley. Whisk in scallion whites and blend well. Add peanut butter and stir to combine. Add salad dressing. Stir in radishes. Serve immediately. This dip is good for a variety of things such as toasted pita bread, chips, etc.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,skirt steak,pork,ham steak,poblano chile,hot pepper,vanilla yogurt
title: Mexican-Style Skirt Steak
ingredients: 2 pork, cutlets about 1-inch long | 1 whole bunch poblano chile, seeded ( wear gloves ) | 1/8 teaspoon ground cayenne pepper | 1 cup fat-free vanilla yogurt or 1 cup plain yogurt | 8 slices cooked ham steaks ( about 3 ounces ) | 1 -2 lb skirt steak
instructions: Preheat your broiler. Line a broiler pan with aluminum foil, and spray with cooking spray. Cut the poblano and poblano peppers into thin chunky strips and set aside. Place the pork cutlets into a blender or food processor. Add the cayenne pepper, about 1/2 cup of the yogurt, and 1/2 teaspoon of the ground cayenne pepper. Blend the mixture until smooth and creamy, stopping to scrape down the sides. Put half of this marinade mixture in a zip top bag. Add the sliced ham and the remaining marinade mixture. Marinate the meat, turning once, in the refrigerate for at least 2 hours or up to 24 hours. Remove the meat from marinade and grill over indirect medium heat, turning and brushing with the remaining marinade mixture, until cooked through and lightly browned and slightly crisp, 6 - 8 minutes, brushing with reserved marinade mixture at least twice during the cooking. Remove grilled meat from broiler and serve garnished with the reserved chiles.

Random Ingredients: white wine,pecorino romano cheese,stewing beef,dripping,onion powder
title: Italian Beef for Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb stewing beef, cut into 1-1/2 inch cubes | 5 tablespoons drippings | 1/4 cup chopped onion | 3/4 cup dry white wine | 1/4 cup grated pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Brown beef in fat. Drain off any fat. Pour wine and onion over meat and stir. Cover and simmer for 1 1/2 hours or longer, until meat is tender. Stir in cheese just before serving, if desired.

title: Aam Burfi
ingredients: 1 can cream-style sweet corn | 1 can baked beans ( in water ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons green cardamom pods, crushed | 1 packet of good plain unsweetened chocolate
instructions: Take 2 - 3 tbsp of cream corn and put it in a microwavable bowl. Put the rest of the ingredients, apart from milk, and mix well. Cover the bowl with cling wrap. Microwave it on high, for 20 - 25 minutes, or until the beans have melted. Allow it to cool for 10 minutes. Then transfer the mixture in a container. Pour the mixture in a piping bag right in the container. You can pipe the mixture as you wish. Keep it covered in the container of the microwave and keep it in the microwave for an absolute minimum of 12 minutes. Allow it to cool for 10 minutes longer. You can also leave it in it for up to 2 days.

title: Almond and Cheese Grilled Beef (Sandwich) on the Cob Fritters
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground sirloin | 12 ounces mild white cheese, such as gruyere, grated | 1/4 cup sliced almonds | 1 tablespoon salad oil ( or as needed ) | 2 chilies | 2 teaspoons cornmeal | 1 cup toasted pecans ( optional )
instructions: In large bowl, combine cheese, almonds and salad oil. Spread 1 side with cheese mixture, sprinkle with ground red chilies and 1 teaspoon cornmeal. Starting with 1 side, roll up tightly like jelly roll. Repeat with remaining ingredients, placing seam side down on buttered grill grate over hot coals. Grill until browned and heated through, about 10 minutes. Serve immediately with warm toasted pecans, if desired.

Random Ingredients: green peppercorn,parsnip,parmigiano reggiano cheese,allspice berry,broth,italian tomato paste,basil leaf,westphalian ham
title: Spicey Baked Parsnips With Ham and Prosciutto
ingredients: 2 lbs parsnips | 4 slices of italian ham ( about 1/2 cup ) | 1 teaspoon whole allspice berry | 1/3 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, plus more for sprinkling ( about 3 tbsp ) | 1/2 cup broth or 1/2 cup chicken stock | 1/3 cup green peppercorn | 1/3 cup tomato paste | 1/2 cup chopped fresh basil leaf
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees. Scrub the parsnips and place in an ovenproof dish. Toss with the allspice to combine. Add the ham and the cheese and mix together. Sprinkle over the broth and the peppercorns. Cover with a lid and bake for 1 hour 30 minutes, until tender. Uncover and bake for 10 minutes more. Remove the lid and sprinkle over the basil. Bake until the topping is golden and bubbly, about 10 minutes longer. Remove from the oven and let sit at room temperature for 10 minutes. Serve with a nice bread or a fresh vegetable.

title: Portuguese Bean and Rice Mash
ingredients: 1 spanish onion, finely sliced | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 2 tablespoons rice wine | 2 tablespoons irish whiskey | 3/4 cup cannellini beans, drained and rinsed well | 1 tablespoon butter or 1 tablespoon margarine
instructions: Heat the oil or ghee in a wok, add the onions, and fry until golden. Add the cornflour to the pan and stir vigorously for 15 seconds. Then add the rice wine and stir briskly for about one minute until the wine has almost evaporated and the mixture is quite dry. Add half a cup of the beans and stir well together. Repeat this until all the rest of the beans and rice are mixed and thoroughly heated. Stir in the butter and serve.

title: Linguine with Cream Cheese
ingredients: 1 package linguine ( or penne ) | 1 package cream cheese | 1 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,mustard powder,fish sauce,creamy peanut butter,cider vinegar,garbanzo bean,guacamole
title: Peanut Beef With Tangy Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb beef chuck, sliced thinly | 1 can garbanzo beans, drained well | 2 tablespoons creamy peanut butter | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon mustard powder | 1/4 cup bottled mustard powder
instructions: In a bowl mix the remaining ingredients except the beef or beef stock. Slice beef across the grain into 1/2 inch slices and add to the bowl. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator at least 1 hour. Serve with lime wedges for squeezing over meat, if desired.

Random Ingredients: hot green chili pepper,lettuce leaf,cumin powder,cashew,turmeric
title: Cashew Nut Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup cashews, roasted ( about 1/4 cup ) | 2 -3 tablespoons fresh hot green chili peppers ( such as fresno chilies ) or 2 -3 tablespoons green jalapeno peppers, depending on your favorite chili | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric | 2 -3 large lettuce leaves, as accompaniment
instructions: Place cashews in large bowl, and set aside. Chop jalapeno peppers fine, and place in processor with cashews, hot chiles, cumin, and turmeric. Process until smooth. Add cashew mixture to salad. Serve and enjoy.

title: Homemade Italian Beef
ingredients: 1 lb extra lean ground beef | 1 teaspoon lemon pepper seasoning
instructions: Spray nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Heat skillet over medium high heat. Add beef and brown quickly until well cooked. Remove meat from skillet and set aside. Add lemon pepper seasoning and 1/2 cup of the liquid from the pan. Cook, stirring frequently, for approximately 5 minutes. Stir in the meat and serve.

title: Lemon Pasta Salad
ingredients: 9 ounces small fresh cheese ravioli | 2 baking potatoes | 3 tablespoons lemon juice | 2 tablespoons lychee juice
instructions: Boil, steam or microwave the ravioli until just done. Drain and cool. Peel the potatoes, cut into thin slices. Mix the lemon juice, zest and olive oil together and add to the potatoes. Keep warm while preparing the pasta. Dip the ravioli in the lemon mixture and deep fry in 350 degree f oil until golden brown. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: egg,water,rice wine vinegar,corn oil,vodka,yellow pepper,garlic chive
title: Vodka Fried Rice
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon corn oil, for frying | 3 large eggs | 1 dash rice wine vinegar | 1 dash water | 12 -15 garlic chives, minced ( including the green parts ) | 1 small yellow pepper, sliced | 1/2 - 3/4 cup vodka
instructions: In a large plate or bowl beat the eggs with the rice wine vinegar to form an omelet. Set aside. Heat the oil over high heat in a deep fryer to 375°f. Place 1/2 cup of the fried rice into the egg and carefully tilt it over. Pour 1/2 cup of vodka into the fryer and immediately lower it in with a heavy dinner plate or other suitable receptacle. The rice will puff up while shaking the pan.

Random Ingredients: chuck,red cabbage,purple cabbage,garlic powder,bean,german chocolate,vanilla essence,green chili pepper
title: Havana - German Antilles Style Cabbage Baked Beans
ingredients: 2 lbs ground chuck | 1 can refried beans | 1 jar sliced purple cabbage | 1/2 head red cabbage ( shredded ) | 1/2 head green chili pepper ( chopped ) | 14 ounces german sweet chocolate ( chopped ) | 2 teaspoons vanilla essence | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Brown the meat in the pan, drain, add the refried beans last. Cut up the purple and green peppers and add to the meat, cover with plastic wrap and then leave them somewhere peaceful to go. Mix the cheese, vanilla and garlic powder mix with the refried beans last. Line a 9x13 inch pan with foil or parchment paper add half the mixture, cover with remaining mixture and cover with foil or parchment paper bake for 45 minutes over low heat, uncover last 10 minutes to brown top, and garnish with a few sprigs of fresh thyme.

title: Pomodoro - Spicy Fruit Dip
ingredients: 8 medium grape ( preferably seedless ) | 1 1/4 lbs red bell peppers or 1 1/4 lbs yellow bell peppers ( about 24 ) | 1 tablespoon tamarind pulp, ground in a blender or coffee grinder | 1 teaspoon ground cumin, more to taste
instructions: Slice the grapes, peppers and tamarind pulp coarsely and place in a bowl. Add 2/3 of the cumin and add remaining cumin. Toss in the rest of the cumin. Cover and chill in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,wild rice,fusilli,broccoli,manicotti,graham cracker crumb,treacle,cream cheese
title: Frugal Gourmet's Cheesy Broccoli and Wild Rice Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 package dry fusilli ( rigati ) | 1 cup cooked wild rice | 1/4 cup treacle or 1/4 cup light molasses | 1 package cream cheese, cut into small pieces | 1/2 cup firmly packed dark brown sugar | 1 box frozen broccoli, thawed and drained | 4 ounces uncooked manicotti | 3 cups graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Cook and stir the fusilli and wild rice in a saucepan over medium heat until the rice looks dry and the saucepan is coated with grease, about 5 minutes. Pour into a 9x13 inch baking dish, set aside. In a skillet, combine the treacle or molasses, cream cheese and brown sugar over low heat and beat until smooth. Add the broccoli, cooking and stirring until the broccoli is just tender and the sauce has thickened, about 10 minutes. Stir in the cooked noodles and uncooked manicotti. Transfer the mixture to the prepared baking dish. Bake for 20 minutes in the preheated oven, or until the cheesecake is slightly browned and the filling is set. Remove the cheesecake from the oven and let it cool a few minutes. Place the cracker crumbs in a small bowl. Dip each cheeseecake slice into the cracker crumbs and press the crumbs into the sides of the cheesecake. Return the cheesecake to the oven for an extra 10 minutes, or until the cracker crumbs are puffed up and browned. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chow mein noodle,white flour,salt,hot chili pepper,sherry,beef broth,white wine vinegar,bulk italian sausage
title: Hot Chile Pepper Noodles
ingredients: 1 lb bulk hot italian sausage ( sweet or hot ) | 6 1/2 cups beef broth ( or water ) | 3/4 cup white wine vinegar | 1 cup white flour | 6 tablespoons dry sherry | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 3 cups mein noodles, dry or 3 cups japanese-type dried chow mein noodles | 1/3 cup chow mein noodles
instructions: Heat a large non stick skillet over medium high heat. Brown the sausage lightly breaking it up as it cooks. Drain the sausage mixture in a colander, as well as cooking spray and fat. Remove sausage from skillet, leaving fat in skillet. Combine beef broth with the vinegar and add to skillet with the hot sausage. Simmer over low heat for 20 minutes. Add sherry and salt and cook for 5 minutes more. Add noodles and simmer for about 10 minutes or until noodles are tender. Serve, passing chow mein at the table.

title: Baked Cinnamon Pork
ingredients: 4 pounds boneless pork loin roast, cut into cubes | 1 tablespoon ground cinnamon
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spray a 9x5 inch loaf pan with cooking spray. Place pork in prepared pan, brush with cooking spray, and sprinkle with cinnamon. Cook in preheated oven for approximately 25 hours.

Random Ingredients: butter margarine,cream chicken soup,bermuda onion,egg yolk,red cabbage
title: Creamy Borshchetta
ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter or margarine | 1 small bermuda onion, finely chopped | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 teaspoon egg yolk | 1 medium red cabbage, cut into wedges
instructions: Melt butter in a medium size skillet and add onion. Cook over low heat until tender. Stir often and add cream of chicken soup in a slow stream. Add the egg yolk and cook until the mixture thickens and is heated through, about 5 minutes. Add shredded cabbage and simmer over low heat for another 5 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Caramelized Grand Margarita
ingredients: 2 cups freshly made caramelized grand marnier | 1 bottle brandy or ( 1 liter ) bottle whiskey
instructions: Combine rum and grand marnier. Stir over ice for 1 - 2 hours. Pour into a clear and airtight container and store in the freezer. Before serving, add remaining ingredients and stir to combine.

Random Ingredients: tomato ketchup,green cardamom pod,yellow potato,pineapple,red capsicum,green cardamom,kale,chick pea
title: Indian Chickpea Stew
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 2 small yellow potatoes, cut into 3cm pieces | 120 g canned chopped pineapple | 1 can diced tomatoes with ketchup | 1 tablespoon green cardamoms | 4 green cardamom pods, split open | 1/2 red capsicum, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons tomato ketchup
instructions: Place the chickpeas in a saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring to the boil over high heat and then simmer until the beans are tender, around 20 minutes. Drain the beans and place in serving dishes. Sprinkle with the potatoes and pineapple. Mix together the tomatoes, ketchup and green cardamoms. Pour over the chickpea mixture and serve.

title: Chicken Quesadillas
ingredients: 1/2 pound skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 24 tortilla chips
instructions: Prepare a grill for medium heat. Spray the pan evenly with cooking spray. Place the chicken breasts on the grate, cook until no longer pink in the center and the juices run clear, 7 to 10 minutes per side. Allow the chicken to cool for a few minutes to help the chicken cool enough to handle. When the chicken is cool enough to handle, cut into thin slices with a knife or cleaver, or use a food processor, or whatever food processor you have on hand. Lay tortillas on a baking sheet, and spread about 1 teaspoon of chicken across each tortilla. Top each with about 2 or 3 tbls. Of chips per quesadillas, if desired. Cook the quesadillas in a preheated grilling pan until golden brown, 2 to 3 minutes per side.

title: Sesame-Olive Cream
ingredients: 3 cups heavy cream | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 2 tablespoons finely grated orange zest | 2 teaspoons finely ground anise seed
instructions: Blend until frothy cream. Let stand several hours covered in the refridgerator. In the meantime, toast until dark golden brown. In a bowl, mix seeds and cream. Bring cream to boil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Gradually beat in nut mixture. Cover skillet, reduce heat to low and simmer for about 7 minutes. Do not boil or cream will curdle. Remove from heat and keep on heat, covered for 2 minutes so you can stand it. Remove candy from refridgerator and stir, keeping the cream hot. Cover and refrigerate till ready to serve. The cream will keep in a covered container for up to 6 weeks. You may also put in a crockpot to serve it cold.

title: Mexican Fried Noodles
ingredients: 4 cups fettuccine | 1 lb spanish onion ( such as vidalias or a red onion, peeled and diced ) | 8 ounces low fat cottage cheese | 4 large garlic cloves, finely minced ( about 2 teaspoons if fresh ) | 1/4 cup lard ( a good, inexpensive, flavorful one that you can get near the fat in the jar ) | 2 -3 cups crushed tortilla chips, for dipping ( a mexican or flavored dish i like to use my baja nachos ) ( optional )
instructions: Cook the noodles as per instructions. You could serve them in a single layer and freeze them or transfer them to a freezer container. Defrost them in warm water for about 30 - 45 seconds until they are soft enough to slice. Combine the cottage cheese, onion, garlic and lard in a food processor or blender. Process until completely combined, adding the chips 2 - 3 minutes or until everything is a smooth mixture but not a paste. Heat a large, non stick skillet to medium low heat. Fry noodles until they are lightly toasted and crispy about 2 minutes. Turn once and add to your hot pan along with any of the cheese/lard sauce to keep them from sticking on the bottom and to give them the extra flavor. Serve hot with any mexi or sour cream, as you like.

Random Ingredients: lime powder,taco seasoning mix,stew vegetable,red lentil,hard egg,waffle,hungarian paprika
title: Hungarian Potato Lentil Tacos
ingredients: 2 lbs stew vegetables, diced fresh or 2 lbs frozen mixed vegetables, diced | 1 cup red lentil or 1 cup brown lentils, rinsed and drained | 1 1/2 tablespoons taco seasoning mix | 2 teaspoons sweet hungarian paprika | 4 medium hard-boiled eggs, peeled, quartered, lengthwise | 1 lime, juice of | 2/3 cup plain low-fat mashed waffles
instructions: Place the vegetables in an 8x8 x 2 inch baking dish. Pour over the water, cover and soak overnight. The next day, remove from refrigerator, drain, reserving 1 cup soaking liquid, and stir in lentils. In a small bowl, combine the taco seasoning and paprika. Toss with vegetable mixture. Divide the lentil mixture among the eight serving dishes. Spoon the egg quarters over the lentil mixture. Pour over any yogurt sauce or sour cream and garnish with sliced hard boiled egg.

title: Homemade Creamy Irish Cream
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 2 teaspoons irish cream | 1/4 cup bailey's irish cream ( bailey's, or other brandy )
instructions: Combine all ingredients and blend well. Store tightly covered in refrigerator. To serve, add to crackers during the last few minutes of grilling. Keep refrigerated.

title: Homemade Crumb Cookies
ingredients: 1 package graham cracker crumbs | 3 slices orange zest
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix graham cracker crumbs and orange zest. Remove peel from orange peel. Place the peel in front of you with the tip of a sharp knife. Take the peel, and cut into 1 inch slices, keeping slices separate from each other. Make sure you don't cut the membrane at any point, or peel and place in a resealable plastic bag. Shake the bag to remove any residual bits of rind. Place cookies on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes in the preheated oven, then remove the baking sheet from the oven. Remove the baking sheet from the oven, and spread cookies with a light coating of cream cheese. Return to oven, and bake an additional 20 to 30 minutes, or until the cream cheese has melted. The cream cheese will solidify onto the cracker crumbs. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: maple syrup,pea,puff pastry,chicken broth,pistachio nut,anchovy paste
title: French Pea Savory Phyllo Parcels
ingredients: 1 puff pastry sheet | 8 ounces frozen peas, thawed | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 1 tablespoon anchovy paste ( or more to taste ) | 1 1/2 cups light chicken broth | 1 tablespoon pistachio nut, finely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f or grill to high. Place pastry sheet on cookie sheet and using a pastry brush, lightly brush with some of the maple syrup. Sprinkle top with a little extra maple syrup and add some anchovy paste or more of your choice of spices. Bake 18 - 20 minutes or until pastry crisps up. While phyllo is baking, place frozen peas in saucepan and heat just until warmed through. Remove from heat and set aside. Remove phyllo from oven, using about 2 tablespoons of the broth in the bottom of the pan. Brush pastry with a little maple syrup. Place peas, peas, and anchovy paste or more of your choice on phyllo. Bake in oven for about 15 - 20 minutes or just until pastry is set. Place onto plates and drizzle with remaining maple syrup and chopped pistachios.

title: Chocolate Biscuits With Steak and Caramelized Vegetables
ingredients: 1/2 cup buttermilk | 3 tablespoons cocoa powder | 1 steak, trimmed | 5 tablespoons sweet tea | 2 teaspoons unsweetened cocoa powder ( see notes ) | 12 ounces sirloin, trimmed, sliced | 1 small courgette, sliced into thin spears | 8 ounces ladyfingers | 1 fresh lime wedge
instructions: Preheat oven to 400of. Combine the buttermilk and three tablespoons of cocoa in a medium bowl. Add the steak and turn to coat evenly. Spread the steak mixture in to a 12 inch square of parchment paper on a cookie sheet or a baking sheet. Bake the steak mixture in the oven for 12 minutes. Turn the oven down to 350of and continue baking for 10 to 15 minutes more until the meat is cooked. Meanwhile, combine the sweet tea and ¾ tablespoons cocoa in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil and boil for 3 minutes. Cool slightly. Cut the steak into 8 pieces. Combine the steak mixture, steak mixture, vegetable and remaining cocoa mix. Line the baking sheet with parchment paper. Remove the parchment and fill with the biscuit mixture. Return to the oven for 15 minutes and bake for 5 minutes, or until lightly browned. Serve biscuit and vegetable biscuit mixture sprinkled with cocoa.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,cardamom pod,brown sugar,cream corn,celery seed,artichoke,saffron
title: St. Patrick’s Day Cream Corn on the Cob
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 12 corn on the cob, husked | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon cardamom pod, crushed | 1/4 teaspoon celery seed | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom pod, crushed | 1/2 cup brown sugar | 1 cup sour cream ( low-fat is ok ) or 1 cup plain yogurt ( low fat is ok ) | 1 pinch saffron, ground
instructions: Soak the corn for at least 30 minutes to 1 hr in water.

title: Prawn Croquettes
ingredients: 600 g frozen prawns | 8 ciabatta | 2 slices gingerroot | 1 tablespoon finely chopped gingerroot | 1 small pineapple ring | 4 tablespoons chopped dried lentils
instructions: Defrost prawns, cut in half lengthwise, then remove tail, just enough meat to make 1 ciabatta. Place on a tray with 1 c water, lightly salted. Cook for 8 - 10 minutes until soft, then set aside. Remove meat and ginger from bones and slice into thin julienne strips. Place ginger and remaining spices in a large bowl. Cut a pocket into the side of the ciabatta and lay prawns on it. Drain lentils and add to bowl with prawn meat and ginger. Using fingers, rub prawn mixture into bread and serve with pineapple and mint dip. Cooking time is cinqatta.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,chicken breast half,plain nonfat yogurt,asparagus,green chili,garlic paste,bouillon cube
title: Chinese Green Asparagus Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1 -2 bunches asparagus, trimmed | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon cubes | 1 teaspoon garlic paste | 1/4 - 1/2 cup plain nonfat yogurt, stirred | 2 tablespoons green chilies, chopped
instructions: Place chicken pieces between sheets of plastic wrap and cut about 1” apart on the long side of each piece so they are about 1 inch wide. In a small bowl, combine remaining ingredients and mix well. Brush on the chicken generously with mixture, then wrap the chicken in cling wrap, pressing out excess air. Marinate at least 1 hour, or overnight. Bring water to a boil in a large pot.

title: Toasted Pasta Nests
ingredients: 1 cup broccoli floret | 1/4 cup toasted pine nuts | 2 cups cooked and drained pasta shapes ( fresh or dry ) | 2 teaspoons white flour ( or bread crumb )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Put half the broccoli in a pan and put water on to boil, add the rest and simmer for 5 minutes, then take off heat. In a small bowl mix the pine nuts and flour. Toss with the warm pasta and nuts, and serve immdiately or pass it separately.

title: Welsh  Spiced  Salad Dressing!!!!
ingredients: 175 ml miracle whip | 4 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | allspice | chopped coriander
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Pour into a glass bowl and enjoy that is also good with fresh fruit.

title: Corn and Jicama
ingredients: 2 cans corned corn, drained | 1 bunch jicama, chopped | 12 packets rice noodles | 1 teaspoon dried savory | 2 teaspoons chili paste, or as desired
instructions: In a large bowl, mix the corn, jicama, rice noodles, savory, and chili paste. Cover, and refrigerate for 20 minutes.

title: Creamy Mussels
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs fresh mussels | 10 ounces cream cheese | 1 teaspoon poultry seasoning | 1 teaspoon ground pork
instructions: Rinse the mussels and remove the white 'beard' from the shell. Fill a large pot with water and heat to low. Add the cream cheese and let it soften slightly. Add the poultry seasoning, ground pork and the mussels then place in the hot water. Cook until the mussels are open. Serve in soup plates with bread if desired.

title: Roasted Peanuts
ingredients: 1 jar roasted port peppers, drained and sliced | 2 ounces poppy seed dressing
instructions: Mix with a fork until well blended. Spread onto a cookie sheet and place in a preheated 375f oven. Roast for 20 minutes, then spread with a light coating of poppyseeds.

title: Lime Sausages
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups plain flour, for coating | 1 lime, rind of
instructions: Combine the flour and lime rind in a bowl, then rub through a sieve to extract the juice. Pour into a medium sized pot. Dip your hands in the liquid, then gather the dough around them. Gently roll the mixture out into an approximately 10 1/2 in diameter oval. Use a knife to make 2 diameter sausages. Heat a large non stick frying pan and cook the sausages for 2 mins on each side, or until just cooked through. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: turkey meat,breadcrumb,hot red chili pepper,courgette,pumpkin pie spice,red wine vinegar,cake flour
title: Pumpkin Turkey Burgers
ingredients: 1 kg turkish roasts or 1 kg australian meat or 1 kg australian turkey meat | 1 kg pumpkin pie spice | hot red chili pepper, deseeded and finely chopped | 2 teaspoons hot red chili pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons unseasoned breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon cake flour | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180c/170c fan forced. Trim the excess fat from the turkey. Mix the turkey and all the sauce ingredients in a large jug. Tip over the turkey mix and stir to coat. Cover the tray and place it in the oven for 2 hours, remove from the oven and stir turkey and sauce again. Remove the turkey mix and leave the mixture to rest and cool. Turn the oven up to 180c/fan 200c/gas mark 3, take the whole roasting tray with the turkey out and flatten it out a little. Sprinkle each cut surface with the pumpkin pie spice mixture, then place a little meat on each. Place on a baking tray and bake in the oven for 1 - 1½ hours, until no longer pink and cooked. Let stand for 20 minutes, then cut into fingers.

title: Irish Cowboy Chicken Sandwiches
ingredients: 3 ounces hoagie rolls | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 3 tablespoons hoagie rolls | 2 grilled chicken, pieces | 1 tablespoon irish whiskey | 2 tablespoons greek yogurt
instructions: Prepare sandwich rolls by covering each inside with a well drained plastic sandwich wrap. Set aside. Split bread lengthwise in two to make half sandwiches. Spread each half with vinegar. Top with chicken pieces and top with remaining half sandwiches. Combine whiskey and yogurt, brush over sandwiches. Wrap in parchment paper and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Dahl (Split Lentils)
ingredients: 1/2 1/2 cup brown lentils or 1/2 cup romano beans | 1/2 3/4 cup scallion, chopped | 1 tablespoon celery seed or 1 tablespoon ground dried celery | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1/4 teaspoon red food coloring
instructions: Place all ingredients in a medium saucepan and cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally. When the liquid boils, reduce heat & simmer gently, uncovered for about 15 to 20 minutes. Add water if necessary. Serve warm or cold. Enjoy.

title: Porcini Mushroom Gochujang for Nihm
ingredients: 600 g porcini mushrooms | 1 teaspoon gochujang
instructions: Place the mushrooms into a mortar and pestle and crush with a fork, crushing or grinding the mushroom until it looks like fine crumbs. Add 1 teaspoon of grated gochujang and pound into a paste. Place the resulting paste into a small pan and cook over gently just to warm through. Store any leftover paste in the fridge for use.

title: Pepperoni-Jalapeno Pepper Pepper Rollups
ingredients: 1 package pepperoni | 1/4 cup pickled jalapeno pepper juice, divided | 1 can diced jalapeno peppers in juice
instructions: Cut the pepperoni in half horizontally. Place the pepperoni halves cut side up on a cutting board, and cover with plastic wrap. When the pepperoni is completely coated with pepperoni, remove the wrap and wrap the pepperoni up around the pepperoni completely. Use two toothpicks to secure the pepper roll ups. Place the toothpicks in a steamer or large saucepan, cover to keep them warm over low heat. In a medium bowl, stir together 1/4 cup of the pickled jalapenos and juice. In a small bowl, stir together the diced jalapeno peppers and jalapeno peppers. Pour the jalapeno pepper juice mixture into the steamer, and bring to a boil over high heat, stirring to loosen the juice mixture from the pepperoni.

Random Ingredients: nutmeg,nonstick cooking spray,rice wine,chive,black bean,oregano leaf,blueberry
title: Black Bean and Blueberry Soup With Dolly Madison
ingredients: 1 can black beans or ( 16 ounce ) can navy beans | 1/2 cup rice wine ( not cooking wine ) | 1 cup chopped fresh chives, divided ( including tender green sections ) | 1/4 cup chopped fresh oregano leaves | 2 cans nonstick cooking spray | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/2 cup crumbled blueberries ( to garnish )
instructions: Drain beans thoroughly and discard the liquid. In a large bowl, combine black beans, rice wine, 1/3 cup chives, oregano, 1/4 cup chives, and 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg. Stir thoroughly to combine. Spray a 3 quart casserole dish with nonstick cooking spray.

title: Creamy Potato Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 shallots, peeled & halved | 2 cans crushed pineapple in juice, undrained, undrained | 4 cups sweet potato flakes | 2 -3 cups apricot preserves | 1/2 cup minced onion
instructions: Cut shallots lengthwise into 4 slices& set aside. Using 2 forks, or a food processor, or food processor, mash pineapple with shallots until mixture resembles fine crumbs. Stir in remaining ingredients& pour mixture into a baking dish. Cover& chill at least 4 hours. Bring to room temp. Cover & bake in a preheated 350f oven for 30 to 40 minutes, stirring several times.

Random Ingredients: chili without bean,amaretto,yukon gold potato,baking powder,caster sugar
title: Sweet Potato Chips (Chiles Con Piselli-Biscuits)
ingredients: 2 large yukon gold potatoes | 1 cup whole meal amaretto or 1 cup almond liqueur | 2 tablespoons caster sugar | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 3/4 cup chili without beans, drained just before baking
instructions: Slice the potatoes lengthwise. Drain well. Place the potato in the base of a well buttered 28cm x 23cm swiss roll tin and add the water. Place in a low oven and preheat to 150c. Place the amaretto in a small saucepan and heat until it starts to foam. Remove the pan from the heat and stir in the sugar. Stir in the baking powder until the sugar has dissolved. Pour the hot liquid over the potatoes and press down with your hands. Bake for 15 minutes, or until the potato is soft and the mixture has slightly softened. Turn the chips out on to a wire rack to cool. Melt the chili without beans in a small saucepan filled with warm water. Spread on toasted chips, or dip them in melted chocolate to coat and eat.

title: Pixie Rain
ingredients: 1 sheet rice paper | 4 red cayenne peppers, halved lengthways and seeded
instructions: Set up the rice paper according to package instructions to make an x on one side of the paper.

title: Raspberry Beef Casserole

instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Grease and line a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook egg noodles in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 5 minutes. Drain. Cook beef consommé in a skillet over medium heat until warm and dissolved, about 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: peanut butter,ricotta cheese,lamb,curry paste,asafoetida powder,dill pickle,panko breadcrumb

title: Sunflower Fritters (Qatar)

instructions: Grind fritters. Heat a little olive oil and add fritters. Cook over medium heat, turning as needed until golden brown and crisp looking. Serve immediately.

title: Cheat's Chorizo & Feta Burgers

instructions: Mix the beef, kirsch, 1/2oz of the cornflour and the chicken powder in a bowl. Stir in the chorizo, feta and the remaining cornflour. Shape into 4 burgers & cook on an oiled grill or barbeque.

title: Tropical Ratatouille (Italian Ratatouille)

instructions: Slice or cube vegetables. Combine with rum, if using. Chill for a minimum of 4 to 5 hours in fridge, tossing the Ratatouille before serving.

title: Caribbean Pork Chop
ingredients: 4 pork chops | 2 tablespoons flour | 1 can kidney beans, drained | 1/2 cup chopped broccoli | 1/3 cup thawed chopped green beans | 1 tablespoon mustard powder | 2 tablespoons coconut | 1/2 cup sweet chili sauce
instructions: In a shallow dish, mix the flour with the mustard powder and coat the pork chops before each chop. Coat the pork chops with the mustard mixture. Reserve the bread crumbs for another use. Place the breaded chops on top of the bean mixture and top with vegetables. Pour thick chili sauce over the chops and toss well. Cover, and marinate overnight. Remove chops from marinade, and cook 10 to 15 minutes on each side, or until browned and cooked through.

title: Loosies Bakalitos (Cashews and Nuts in Peanut Sauce)
ingredients: 2 cups raw cashews | 1 cup dry roasted peanuts | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 3 -6 drops hot chili sauce ( optional ) | 2 -3 teaspoons dried dill | 3 -4 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh dill, for garnish
instructions: Roast peanuts in a very hot oven until they are blanched and skin is charred, stirring often. This can take anywhere from 10 to 15 minutes. Place the peanuts in a dry pan over low heat, stirring often, until light brown and fragrant. This should only take 10 to 15 minutes. In a medium bowl, mix the cashews, raw peanuts, lime juice, hot pepper sauce, ground dill, and peanut oil until well combined. If the mixture seems too dry, add 1 teaspoon of water. Place nuts on a plate and sprinkle with salt. Pour any liquid from pan over nuts and shake to remove excess moisture. Sprinkle fresh dill on the nuts and serve.

title: Lemon and Cardamom Powder
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh lime zest, grated finely fresh | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 1/3 teaspoon cardamom
instructions: Place all ingredients in a shallow dish. Seal and shake. Let sit 15 minutes before using. Use.

title: Granny's Leek and Pimiento Omelet - Omelette
ingredients: 6 large leeks ( white and light green parts only ), washed, trimmed, sliced lengthwise into 1/4 inch disks, rinsed several times and drained completely before cooking | 3 ounces pimientos, thinly sliced | 1 -2 large egg white | 1 fluid ounce heavy cream | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom ( optional, to taste )
instructions: Sprinkle thinly sliced leeks with a thin layer of salt before washing. Place a heavy skillet directly on the burner top of the stovetop and heat the element very gently, without letting it touch the bottom of the pan. This will keep leeks from darkening too much but won't have a desirable browning of deep shade. When the element is very hot, add the sliced leeks. Cook, stirring, for 1 to 2 minutes, or until the color just begins to turn dark brown. Add pimientos, stir, and cook a few minutes longer. When most of the pimientos have been cooked through, set aside to cool somewhat. Preheat broiler. Whisk together the egg white and heavy cream in a small bowl and set aside. Spread about 1/3 cup of the leeks and pimiento mixture on the bottom of your 6 - 8 inch omelet pans. Place the rest of the leeks over. Use a spatula or knife to smooth the leeks down slightly but not too much. Using a rubber spatula, smooth the leeks to an even layer. Pour about 12 or 18 tablespoons of the cream mixture over the leeks. Sprinkle with the ground cardamom, if using. Place the pan under the preheated broiler for about 45 seconds, until the top of the omelet begins to brown lightly and the cream is bubbling away. Turn the pan and brush the leeks with any remaining cream mixture. Turn down the broiler to very low and broil the leeks until the cream is browned on top and bubbling inside the mounds slightly, about 10 to 15 minutes. Sprinkle with more cardamom if desired. Cut into 6 wedges and serve straight away.

title: Mock Russian Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa | 1/4 cup diced white onion | 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons instant coffee | 2 teaspoons light creole seasoning
instructions: Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat, and cook and stir the cocoa and onion until the onion is soft and the cocoa has melted, about 5 minutes, stirring constantly. Stir in the yogurt. Pour the coffee into the skillet with the onions and cocoa.

title: Tabbouleh
ingredients: 3 cups cracked bulgur | 3 tablespoons unsalted tahini | 1 1/2 - 2 teaspoons freshly grated nutmeg | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh italian parsley ( optional )
instructions: Place bulgur in fine, large bowl, cover with several inches of cold water by 2 inches. Using your fingers, squeeze the water out of the bulgur, then drain. Transfer to a medium bowl, and stir in the tahini, nutmeg and parsley. Taste and season with salt. Note, the tabbouleh can also be made in the bowl of a food processor. If you do not have an electric food processor, place the contents in a small bowl and blend until smooth.

Random Ingredients: chinese wine,corn,white bread,orange juice,celery salt,cornflour,coriander seed,midori melon liqueur
title: Chinese Fruit Stuffing for Pork or Beef

title: Pasta Florentine
