ingredients: 7 cups leftover vegetable, and crumbled or can chopped vegetables | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 cup cooked green beans or 1/2 cup frozen green beans | 8 -12 1 cup canned kidney beans, drained | 1/3 cup cornmeal | dipping pepper ( optional and to taste ) | 1/8 teaspoon basil ( optional and to taste )
instructions: Cook vegetables, mix all ingredients together in a large bowl or use immediately for a main dish or other dish.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,radish,gorgonzola,orange zest,red jalapeno chile,coriander powder
title: Spiced Gorgonzola in a Tomato Based Broth
ingredients: 3/4 cup gorgonzola, at room temperature | 3 -4 medium sized ripe tomatoes ( can use cherry tomatoes ) | 2 -3 dried hot green cardamom pods | 4 -5 finely minced fresh red jalapeno chiles, can substitute 1-2 teaspoons red chile powder | 1 teaspoon orange zest, freshly grated | 1 teaspoon coriander powder
instructions: Prepare the gorgonzola, cut about 1/3 cup of gorgonzola into 3 inch pieces by slicing it in half like a pizza piece. Place on a cutting board, and slice into 1/2 inch slices, about 1/4 inch thick and about 1/4 inch thick. Set aside. Prepare the tomato based broth, cut the small tomatoes in half vertically. Cut into 1/4 inch slices and set aside. Prepare the spices, cut the red chili into thin strips, or slices of 1 inch long. In a non reactive dish, mix 1 teaspoon of chili powder. Sprinkle on the orange zest and coriander powder. Set aside. Toast the bag of gorgonzola at room temperature until golden brown, about 15 to 20 minutes. Remove gorgonzola from the bag, place on a plate, and let cool. To serve, place the tomato slices on individual plates and place a piece of gorgonzola on top. Sprinkle with the chili slices and fresh coriander. You can add up to 2 tablespoons of fresh or frozen coriander to the broth as a garnish.

Random Ingredients: cooking oat,shell pasta,shiitake mushroom,lime zest,peanut oil,pizza dough,leek
title: Faux-Style Mushroom Loaf
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground round | 1 cup minced leeks or 1 cup dark green onion | 1 tablespoon minced lime zest | 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 14 1/2 ounces pizza dough, in a package or ( 16 ounce ) package refrigerated prepared pizza dough | 1 large leek, minced | 1 cup shiitake mushroom, sliced | 2 tablespoons quick-cooking oats
instructions: In a small bowl, combine ground round with leek, lime zest, and peanut oil. Form into a loaf. Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 1 hour, preferably overnight. Place a pizza stone on the lowest rack of the oven.  preheat the oven to 450 degrees. Unwrap the loaf from the refrigerator. Unwrap the loaf and place on a lightly oiled baking sheet. Prick the bottom of the loaf about 3 times with a fork. Bake 10 minutes. Let cool. Meanwhile, in the microwave or on the slow cooker, combine the pizza dough, lemon grass, and mushrooms. Cover and cook on high power 5 minutes, then reduce to low power. Add the oat and stir well until combined. Spread the crust mixture evenly over the hot loaf. Return the loaf to the oven until it is well browned and the crust is cooked, about 25 minutes. Let cool 10 minutes. Slice and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,arrowroot,lettuce,romano cheese,oregano leaf,oat,champagne white wine
title: Chicken Oranges In Wine
ingredients: 4 chicken or 4 chicken breasts ( 1lb ) | 1 teaspoon oregano leaves | 1/2 cup cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup dry champagne ( i prefer white cava ) | 1/4 cup arrowroot | 1 tablespoon cream of potato soup | 2 tablespoons dried breadcrumbs | grated romano cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Cut 4 chicken or 4 chicken breasts in thin strips, 1 1/4 wide. In medium size saucepan, melt soup with soup add oregano and wine. Bring to boiling. Add arrowroot, potato soup and breadcrumbs. Bake at 400°f for 25 - 30 minutes, brushing with soup. Place chicken in a serving platter, and sprinkle with cheese.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,cardamom pod,white cheese sauce
title: White Cheese Sauce With Sun-Dried Tomatoes and Spicy Chips
ingredients: 1/3 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil ( not oil packed ) | 2 tablespoons white cheese sauce | 2 cardamom pods
instructions: Heat oil to medium heat. In saucepan, warm white sauce until it turns dark brown, but not burned. Remove from heat, and stir in sun-dried tomatoes, and cardamom pods.

title: Chutney Crusted Swiss Steak
ingredients: 1/2 cup mango chutney | 1/4 cup shredded lemon peel | 1/4 cup quick-cooking spray | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 2 lbs boneless chuck, trimmed | 2 tablespoons quick-cooking spray
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in a shallow bowl. Add chuck and turn to coat.

title: Real Simple Sausage and Potato Beef Soup
ingredients: 1 bag rigatoni pasta | 1 1/4 lbs sausage | 2 large white potatoes | 2 beef stock cubes | 2 ounces ham
instructions: Cook rigatoni according to directions on the package. Brown sausage in a large pot and cut into 1/4 inch slices. Cut potato into 1/4 inch cubes. Brown sausage in pot. Add potatoes, stock and ham. Bring to a boil. When soup comes to a boil, add rigatoni. Reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes or until pasta is cooked. You do not want the pasta to be too soft or dry. Serve with butter and parmesan cheese.

Random Ingredients: potato starch,beef tenderloin,asparagus,gruyere,mozzarella cheese,monterey jack pepper cheese,steak
title: Beef Tenderloin With Asparagus # 5FIX
ingredients: 5 lbs lean sirloin | 4 cans asparagus | 1 package frozen french-style potatoes starch | 3 cups shredded monterey jack pepper cheese | 1 lb shredded mozzarella cheese | 3 packages of medium sliced pickled steak | 2 packages shredded gruyere or 2 cups emmenthaler cheese
instructions: Slice beef into strips about 1/4 inch wide and 1/4 inch thick depending on how thinly sliced you want the beef slices. Drain asparagus. Toss asparagus with the potato starch and set aside. Slice french style potatoes into wedges 1/4 inch thick and set aside. Tear frozen steak into bite size pieces and put aside. Tear shredded mozzarella cheese into small pieces and toss with the asparagus in a large bowl. Place beef slices in a 9x13 inch loaf pan and cover with cheese slices. Cover with shredded swiss or emmental cheese. Repeat layering until you get used up. Top with potato flour and shredded cheese mixture. Sprinkle with asparagus and a few shavings of shavings of shavings of gruyere cheese. Cover with foil and bake at 375 for 45 minutes or until heated through and bubbling. Let sit for 10 mintues before cutting and serving.

title: Garlicky Pork Roast for Tacos & Spices
ingredients: 4 -6 lbs pork roast ( or any fat ) | 1 jar pace picante sauce ( or mild mexican style sauce )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Put roasting pan with fat on top. Wrap in plastic wrap or aluminum foil. Pour picante sauce over the roast. Bake 1 to 3 hours or until internal temperature reaches 160 degrees f. Let stand 5 minutes before carving and eating. Serve with rice, beans, sour cream or guacomole.

title: Sweet Chilli Cheese (Pineapple) Dip With Herbs & Pecans
ingredients: 1/4 cup vegemite ( may sub light sweet potato or almond flavour ) | 1/4 cup pineapple chunk, drained ( soft but not mushy ) | 3 tablespoons pineapple juice or 3 tablespoons water | micro herbs, as required
instructions: Drain pineapple & reserve liquid. Combine remaining ingredients, except nuts & herbs, in processor. Heat until butter or margarine melts & thickens slightly. Remove from heat and stir through pineapple. Serve on a platter with crackers.

Random Ingredients: brown rice,gelatin,yeast,red chili pepper flake,almond,cumin powder,broccoli,carrot
title: Rice and Broccoli Filling With Yeast
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice | 1 package yeast, proofed | 4 tablespoons dry roasted cumin powder | 1 teaspoon crushed red chili pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons granulated yeast | 1 head broccoli | 1 carrot | 1 cup almonds | 2 tablespoons gelatin
instructions: Start with the brown rice, it will take a while, but it will rise up once it's cooked. Soak rice in cool water for 45 minutes. If you've got about 12 cups of liquid but not yet fully cooked, then go ahead and soak the rest. Rinse your yeast in a medium bowl, and whisk in 2 tbs of the cumin powder, the remaining crushed chile and the remaining 2 tbs of powdered cumin. Stir the yeast and 1/2 tsp of the crushed red chili peppers into the warm brown rice. Cover bowl and set in a warm spot for about 1 hour or until it starts to foam. In the meantime, cook up the carrots until they are very soft. Drain off the starch from the carrots, about 2 tbs at a time, and slice them into 1 inch lengths and set aside. Put the rest of the chile into a small bowl, add the other 1/2 tsp of sugar and put aside to sweeten. Take out the broccoli, cut off the stem, cut the stalk and then cut the remaining stalk into 1/2 inch lengths, and cut them into 1/2 inch pieces. Put the cooled green bean, carrot mixture in a bowl, and mix it all up with 1/2 cup of sugar. The yeast is good for this, so you can add a little water at a time. Leave it in a warm spot on a warm spot for an hour or two to set up. Take the yeast out of the fridge, and stir it in. Turn the bowl onto another warm spot until the yeast mixture is absorbed. Add the 3/4 cup of sugar and stir until you have a creamy glaze. Add 1 tbs roasted cumin, 1 tbs sugar and 2 tbs of roasted cumin. Stir with a spoon til it dissolves. Set in a warm place for another 15 min or more. It will rise up so you can take your time. You will need about 2 - 3 tbsp of broth if your rice cooker has room, or a little more if necessary. After 10 - 20 minutes, your rice should be ready. Drain excess liquid from the rice, stir and enjoy.

title: Easy Chilled Turnips and Chocolate Pie
ingredients: 2 medium turnips, peeled and cut into 1/4-inch chunks | 1/4 teaspoon peppercorn | 1/4 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 4 tablespoons oatmeal | 1 1/2 - 2 cups shredded mixed dark chocolate | 1 1/2 tablespoons peeled finely chopped crystallized ginger-garlic paste | 1 pie shell, cooked and cooled | 1/4 cup peeled finely chopped cucumber | 12 peppercorns | 1 unbaked pie shells
instructions: Heat oven to 425 degrees f. Mix first 5 ingredients in a large bowl and set aside. Beat together oatmeal, chocolate and crystallized ginger in a large bowl by hand. Add to mix. Add cooled chocolate mixture to bowl. Season with salt and pepper to your taste. In one pastry shell, layer turnip chunks and pour filling over. Repeat layers until all ingredients are used, ending with a top shell. Pour remaining filling into pie shell. Wrap pie in foil and bake for 45 minutes. Decrease heat to 350 degrees f and bake until topping is golden brown and crust is crisp and crust is puffed up a bit, about another 45 minutes. Remove from oven and let sit for 15 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,green cardamom pod,soy sauce,olive oil,thai green chili
title: Green Curry Sauce With Soy, Chillies and Oil
ingredients: 4 tablespoons olive oil | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 2 tablespoons chopped thai green chilies, finely chopped | 5 -6 green cardamom pods, crushed | 2 1/2 tablespoons soy sauce
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet over medium low heat, add curry paste and curry leaves, sauté for 2 minutes. Add chillies and cardamom and sauté for 2 minutes. Stir in soy sauce and stir well. Serve immediately.

title: Chicken Legs in a Wok
ingredients: 8 tablespoons peanut oil or 8 tablespoons canola oil | 2 lbs chicken legs ( approximately. )
instructions: Heat half the oil in a large wok or skillet over high heat. Add chicken and cook, stirring constantly, just until lightly browned. Turn chicken over and add the remaining oil. Cook, stirring, over medium heat for about 2 or 3 minutes. Turn chicken and cook 1 minute longer. Remove the chicken. Increase the heat to high and add the sauce to the pan. Decrease heat to medium high and boil, stirring often, until slightly reduced, about 5 minutes. Serve over noodles..

Random Ingredients: bok choy,rice noodle,breakfast sausage,flour tortilla,beef chuck,mango chutney,plain yogurt,chipotle chile powder
title: Smoky Beef and Sausage Quesadillas
ingredients: 1 beef chuck, trimmed and cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 2 tablespoons dried chipotle chile powder | 1 package breakfast sausage | 4 flour tortillas | 4 cups sliced bok choy | 2 cups fresh mango chutney | 1 package plain yogurt, drained | 6 large gluten free tortillas, warmed
instructions: Cook beef in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat until browned, about 5 minutes. Add chipotle powder.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,pistachio nut,pistachio,breadcrumb,apple cider vinegar,bamboo shoot,wasabi powder
title: Wasabi Fruit Loaf
ingredients: 4 1/2 ounces self-rising flour | 2 tablespoons ground dried breadcrumbs ( bread flakes ) | 2 ounces finely chopped pistachios | 2 ounces finely chopped bamboo shoots, finely chopped | 2 ounces shelled unsalted pistachios, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons wasabi powder | 2 tablespoons ground red hot pepper flakes or 2 tablespoons wasabi powder, for extra flavour | 2 tablespoons melted unsalted pistachio nuts
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. Sift the flour and breadcrumbs into a bowl and stir in the pistachios, bamboo shoots, pistachios, wasabi powder, chilli flakes and melted nuts. Pour the wet ingredients into a clean bowl and stir in the melted unsalted pistachios. Spoon the batter into a greased loaf tin and smooth the top. Bake the loaf until the loaf is well risen and a skewer inserted into the centre comes out clean, about 50 minutes. Let cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then transfer onto a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Nam Prik Num
ingredients: 3 -4 tablespoons wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon dried kaffir lime leaf or 1 teaspoon dried lime zest
instructions: Combine all the ingredients and shake well with a spoon or a handheld immersion blender until the mixture is completely smooth and thick. Refrigerate for 1 - 4 hours.

Random Ingredients: thyme sprig,chicken stock,flat leaf parsley,date,vanilla bean,corn oil,walnut
title: Date-Coddled Sticky Nut and Walnut Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs dates | 1 1/2 cups chicken stock | 4 tablespoons corn oil or 4 tablespoons grapeseed oil | 2 tablespoons walnuts | 1 tablespoon flat leaf parsley | 5 fresh thyme sprigs, crushed | 1 small vanilla bean, split and scraped
instructions: Toast the walnuts in a dry frying pan over medium heat, shaking, until golden all over, about 8 - 10 minutes in a 300 degrees f oven. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the walnuts to a clean tea towel to drain and dry. Put the stock, corn oil, walnuts, parsley and thyme in a heavy pan, bring to the boil, then reduce the heat and simmer partially covered for 15 minutes, until the nuts are tender and the sauce has reduced to a thick paste. Stir in the vanilla bean and remove from the heat. Let cool slightly. Season to taste with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Transfer the sauce to a food processor, adding the reserved walnuts and process until smooth. Store in a cool, dry, dark place in a jar for up to 3 days.

title: Crock Pot Hot Chicken
ingredients: 1 roasting chicken | 1/2 lb cream cheese, room temperature | 1/2 cup maraschino cherry, coarsely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon dried red chile
instructions: Place chicken in crock pot. Sprinkle with cheeses, cherries and chiles. Cover and cook on low 3 to 4 hours. Shred meat and serve on buns.

title: Beer and Sausage Noodle Stir-Fry (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 lb yellow onion | 1 serrano pepper | 1/2 cup light beer | 2 packages medium saltine noodles
instructions: Slice onion and peppers 1/4-inch thick. Heat 1 tblsp. Beer in a large nonstick skillet or wok over medium heat. Cut sausage into 1/8 pieces and place on top of onion and pepper in skillet. Raise heat to high and cook 3 - 5 minutes until sausage is done. Move to a cutting board and cut a slit into each noodle and remove vein using a spoon, leaving tails intact. Place into the slow cooker and stir in remaining tablespoon of beer. Cook on high heat 5 - 6 minutes, stirring occasionally, until sausage is warmed through. To serve, place noodles into a large bowl, pour sauce over, add cooked, crumbled sausage and stir.

Random Ingredients: turkey,italian breadcrumb,fish sauce,cherry tomato,pork,sunflower oil,oil,onion soup mix
title: Pork and Turkey Casserole in a Jar
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lean ground pork | 1 medium onion, roughly chopped | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 2 tablespoons oil | 1 can pork and turkey, undrained & rinsed | 1 package italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 jar cherry tomatoes, drained | 2 tablespoons fish sauce
instructions: Brown ground pork in hot olive oil over medium heat. Drain, remove any excess fat. Add onion.

Random Ingredients: white cabbage,red chilies,red wine vinegar,salt pepper,vegetable,tarragon,green chili pepper,potato
title: Hot Pot of Veggies With a Hint of Chilt.
ingredients: 1 red fresh white chile peppers or 1 green chili pepper | 1/2 red chilies | 2 small potatoes | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons fresh tarragon or 2 teaspoons dried tarragon, crushed | salt and pepper | canned mixed vegetables or mixed vegetables | green chili pepper ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Place the first 4 ingredients in a non stick, high sided frying pan and toast over a moderate heat, stirring constantly, until the chilies turn dark red in color to a rich red and have blackened spots, about 5 minutes. Add the potato and cook, stirring, until just tender. Drain and chill. Add the vinegar and tarragon and stir to blend. Cook for one minute. Season to taste with salt and pepper and garnish with chopped chilies. Serve immediately with fried veggies or garnish with fresh chilies.

title: Flaming Hot Pot
ingredients: 4 tablespoons golden syrup or 4 tablespoons maple syrup | 4 tablespoons hot water | salt and pepper, to taste
instructions: Warm the golden syrup or maple syrup, hot water and pepper thoroughly or shake it all together and serve immediately with your favourite hot dog or frankfurter.

title: Healthy Broiled Oatcakes
ingredients: 1/2 cup quick oats | 1 cup light corn kernel ( from the cob or frozen, thawed ) | 1/3 cup light-roasted corn syrup | 1/4 cup splenda granular ( or sugar substitute ) | 2 -3 teaspoons barbecue sauce ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon ground cloves | 1/2 cup grated fresh parmesan cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Spread oats onto a nonstick baking sheet. Bake 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until just slightly browned. Meanwhile, put corn, corn syrup, splenda, barbecue sauce, cloves and the 1/2 cup parmesan cheese into a small saucepan until boiling. Boil without stirring until the sugar is dissolved, about 5 minutes, then set aside to cool. When the oatcakes come out of the oven, spread a 2 1/2 to 3/4 cup measuring spoonful of corn syrup over one side of each, then cover with a second layer of oatcakes. Top with corn syrup. Broil the oatcakes 2 minutes, then immediately move the pan to broiler. Broil until topping is puffed and golden, about 2 minutes. Serve while still warm. Tip, sometimes supermarkets sprinkle the uncooked flakes with caraway seeds, sometimes or just buy a can of corn kernel from the market, and store it in airtight containers in the refrigerator.

title: Quick & Easy Tamarind-Cardamom Bread Dip
ingredients: 8 ounces fresh bread | 400 ml tomato puree | 2 -4 tablespoons tamarind pulp ( optional ) | 1/2 - 3 - 3/4 teaspoon chili pepper flakes ( optional ) | 1 pinch of freshly ground cardamom
instructions: Cut bread into pieces & soak in water or place in blender & process until smooth. You can use a food processor. Add tomato puree, tamarind juice, chili flakes & cardamom. Process to a smooth, creamy consistancy. If you like a smoother texture dip in a blender with a bit of water until desired consistency. This can be covered & chilled for up to 2 days.

title: Chipotle Crostini(Portuguese Cheese Bread)
ingredients: 10 slices portuguese style bread, cut 1-inch thick ( about 12 oz. ) | 3 large chipotle chiles, peeled, seeded, and coarsely chopped
instructions: Arrange bread slices on a baking sheet. Place chiles on top of the bread and sprinkle with chiles. Broil in a 400° oven until the bread is toasted, about 2 minutes.

title: Chicken Jumbo
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing chicken | 4 habanero peppers | 1 1/2 - 2 cups buttermilk or 1 1/2-2 cups cornstarch | heavy whipping cream
instructions: Cut the chicken into chunks with your hands, discarding any bone parts or trussy meat. Place the chicken, habanero peppers, buttermilk or cornstarch and whipping cream in a large pot over medium heat and bring to a boil. While the mixture is boiling, prepare the remaining chicken. When the chicken is almost cooked, add a little more buttermilk or cornstarch and simmer slowly until the chicken is completely cooked. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: green pea,beef stew meat,salmon,kaffir lime leaf,paprika,butter
title: Mulligatawny Soup
ingredients: 8 fluid ounces beef stew meat, chopped | 2/3 cup green peas | 1/3 cup butter | 30 -32 fluid ounces boiling salted salmon, skinned and chopped ( the flakey type ) | 6 -7 kaffir lime leaves or 6 -7 a few sprigs of fresh kaffir lime leaf | paprika
instructions: Mix the flour with the meat in one bowl and salt and pepper to taste. Add peas and cook gently until peas are soft and mushy. In the other bowl, fry the butter until it is foamy adding a little boiling water if necessary. Then add the vegetables and kaffir or lime leaves to the butter and fry until the vegetables are crisp tender. Ladle the soup into warm bowls and sprinkle with paprika.

title: Canadian Bacon Canapes
ingredients: 5 slices italian salami | 1/2 teaspoon fresh garlic powder | 2 slices canadian bacon | peppercorn
instructions: Using wet hands, tear the salami and place on a plate. Sprinkle generously with the garlic powder. Fold the bacon around each slice, and wrap each piece in peppercorns. Spray a non stick frying pan with non stick spray, and place pan over medium high heat.

title: Quick and Easy Salsa
ingredients: 1 jar pitted ripe olives | 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded and minced | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro | 1 pinch ground cloves, or as desired
instructions: Place olives, jalapeno pepper, cilantro, and cloves into the bowl of a blender or food processor. Blend until smooth, adding more water, if blender is too thick.

title: Maki's Buttermilk Pancakes
ingredients: 2 cakes | 1/2 cup buttermilk | 1 cup cakefat ( optional ) or 1 cup buttermilk ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon baking powder | toasted sesame seeds
instructions: Mix buttermilk with baking powder. Beat together the pancake mix and buttermilk. Turn the mix into a skillet or a flat griddle pan. Sprinkle on sesame seeds.

title: Sweet Pot Sticker Bread
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless pork loin | 2 tablespoons custard powder | 3 teaspoons white sugar
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the pork, custard powder, and sugar. Mix well, wrap in plastic wrap, and refrigerate overnight. Preheat the oven to 225º f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Remove the pork mixture from the refrigerator, and transfer to a loaf pan. Bake for 3 1/2 hours, or until the internal temperature reaches 165ºf. Cool completely on a rack. Remove the strings, slice, and serve.

Random Ingredients: bay leaf,dijon mustard,water chestnut,cumin powder,chickpea flour,chili pepper flake,teriyaki sauce
title: Bean Batter
ingredients: 2 cups chickpea flour | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin powder or 1/2 teaspoon cumin seed | 1/4 teaspoon dried hot chili pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon teriyaki sauce | 1/2 cup water chestnut | 1/8 - 1/4 cup water
instructions: Sift chickpea flour into a medium bowl. Place spices, mustard, teriyaki sauce, water chestnuts, and dry ingredients in a plastic zip bag. One at a time add the water and mix. Place the bag or two inches apart on a clean, dry, dry skillet. When the pan is hot, carefully remove the air bubbles and quickly move to cooking rack. Bake at 350 degrees for 15 - 20 minutes depending on the thickness of the bread.

Random Ingredients: black peppercorn,cotija cheese,pinto bean,mini chocolate chip,italian sausage,kosher salt,dark soya sauce,cake flour
title: Black Pepper Sausage and Bean Fritters
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans, drained | 1 lb mild italian sausage, casings removed | 2 tablespoons dark soya sauce | 1 box mini chocolate chip | 1/2 cup cake flour | 1 tablespoon kosher salt, plus more for greasing the pan | cracked black peppercorns, to taste | 1 ounce grated cotija cheese, plus more for serving
instructions: Drain the pinto beans and put in a bowl. Bring 3 quarts of water to a boil on high, then dump in the beans and their liquid and set aside. Remove the casings from the sausage and chop into 1/2 inch pieces and set aside. Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. In a medium bowl, stir together the soya sauce, chocolate chips, cake flour, salt, and black peppercorns. Mix this mixture into the beans, adding more if necessary. Shape the mixture into patties, about 15 patties, and set aside. Coat a baking sheet with nonstick spray and set aside. Bring the water back to a boil and transfer about 3/4 of the fritters into the water. Cook until the fritters float to the top, then remove with a slotted spoon and place in the baking sheet. Repeat these fritters 2 more times. Remove the baking sheet from the oven and transfer the fritters back into the oven. Heat the broiler if you wish, and lightly spray 1/2 cup of the crumpled ganache. After a few minutes, turn the fritters over and lightly spray again. Put the fritters back in the oven and broil on top shelf for 7 to 10 minutes until the fritters are golden brown and cooked through. Sprinkle with cotija cheese and serve hot. Note, i made extra patties for the party with this recipe, and it was amazing how good the recipe is.

title: Beets With Pork
ingredients: 4 medium red beets, scrubbed | 3 slices trimmed lean pork chops or 3 slices lean stew meat | 2 fennel bulbs, cored and cut in 1/2-inch slices
instructions: Trim the beet root ends, but not all the way to the root, and cut out and discard the root ends. Place the slices in the bottom of a lightly greased 13 by 9 inch pan and cover with 2/3 of the pork or beef. Sprinkle with the 2 fennel slices. Repeat with the remaining slices, trimming off any bits above. Pour enough water into the pan to leave 1 inch of headspace. Bake in the center of a preheated 350 degree f oven until tender, about 1 hour. With a slotted spoon, transfer the bacon to paper towels to drain.

title: Bitter Chocolate Parsnips
ingredients: 4 parsnips, peeled | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 4 teaspoons bittersweet bitter dry chocolate
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Cut the parsnips into 1/4 inch slices. Arrange the pieces about 1 inch apart on a baking sheet. Drizzle the vinegar over the strips of parsnips. Sprinkle with the bittersweet chocolate. Broil until the strips turn golden, 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Rosemary & Watermelon Terrine [parlotte]
ingredients: 5 1/4 cups watermelon, seeded and cut into chunks | 8 garlic cloves | 1/2 cup fresh rosemary leaf | 4 large egg yolks, lightly beaten
instructions: Place watermelon in a small saucepan and boil until soft, stirring occasionally. Mash roughly with a fork. Add the garlic and rosemary and heat through. Place the ramekins on a rimmed baking sheet and press into shape to cover the base, about 2. Heat oven to 375°f. Place the eggs and watermelon chunks in a food processor. Over medium heat, bring the watermelon mixture just to boiling. Remove from the heat and add the rosemary. Spoon the warm watermelon mixture into the terrine and place on a baking sheet or a jelly roll pan lined with parchment paper. Bake for about 30 minutes, or until set. Remove and cool slightly. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Remove from the refrigerator 1 hour before serving. Cut terrine into squares.

title: Beef Burgers for the Barbie
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef, fajita style | 8 ounces white beans, cooked, drained ( refried beans will do ) | 4 ounces ketchup | 4 ounces maple syrup | 8 ounces portabella mushrooms, sliced | 8 ounces fresh bean sprouts | 1 dash tequila
instructions: In a medium sized bowl, blend everything together with hands until thoroughly mixed. Chill for 1 - 2 hours to allow flavours to develop. Grill beef for 5 - 10 minutes on each side or to desired level of doneness. Serve on a bed of lettuce, topped with a small mound of bean sprouts and a dab of tequila.

title: Mulholland's Filling for Veggies
ingredients: 20 g oatmeal | 1 teaspoon dried fenugreek | 1 tablespoon jalapeno, sliced
instructions: Crush and dissolve fenugreek in hot water or milk. Add to the oatmeal, mix well and add more or less as required. Leave to cool for an hour or so before using.

title: Yummy Feta Spread
ingredients: 2 tablespoons good crumbled feta cheese | 1 pinch herbes de provence, the dried, crumbled herb, or 1 pinch of oregano | 1 pinch cayenne
instructions: Place the feta in a bowl and stir in the herbes, cheese, and cayenne to taste. Enjoy.

title: Cheese and Pistachio Spread
ingredients: 1/2 cup italian fat style cheese | 1/4 cup shelled crushed pistachio nut | 1/2 teaspoon crushed cardamom pod | 1 inch anchovy, finely chopped
instructions: Place all ingredients in a small bowl and blend until smooth. Keeps well into refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: arugula,mexican cheese,iceberg lettuce,egg yolk,green bell pepper,lime juice
title: Arugula Salad II
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce - rinsed, dried and torn into bite-size pieces | 1/4 green bell pepper, chopped | 2 packages shredded mexican-style processed cheese blend | 2 egg yolks | 3/4 cup fresh lime juice | 1/2 head arugula, rinsed and tough stems removed
instructions: Arrange iceberg lettuce leaves on large serving platter. Sprinkle bell pepper over top. In a medium bowl, stir together cheese, egg yolks, lime juice and arugula. Pour over cheese mixture and toss well. Chill at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Cherry Crisps
ingredients: 1 can sweetened condensed cherries | 1/2 cup corn oil
instructions: Drain cherries and reserve liquid. Mix in a bag or container with a tight fitting lid. Pour corn oil into a shallow pan. Spread about 1 tablespoon of cherry mixture in the center of each square.

Random Ingredients: fennel,red chili powder,red chilies,pumpkin seed,creme fraiche,pear
title: Pumpkin Seed and Pear Dip
ingredients: 1 cup creme fraiche | 1 red chili | 1 teaspoon fennel, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon roasted pumpkin seeds, chopped | 1 dried red chilies or 1 dried hot red chili powder | 3 teaspoons crushed dried red chilies | 3 tablespoons pepitas ( pumpkin seeds for garnishing )
instructions: Wash the skin off your pumpkin seeds and chop into quarters. Chop the chillies finely and roughly chop. Gently stir the crème fraîche into the creme fraiche mixture. Add the finely chopped chillies, pumpkin seeds and dried red chiles. Blend until well mixed. Serve with pappas. Chill before serving in a martini glass garnish with a twist of fennel leaf tucked under.

title: Green Chili Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 4 slices green chili paste or 4 slices chipotle chiles, very thin slices ( or less to taste ) | 4 large lettuce leaves | 2 cups grape tomatoes or 2 cups cherry tomatoes, very ripe | 1 bunch leek ( white part only ) or 1 bunch scallion, finely chopped ( white part only )
instructions: Heat up chili paste or chipotle chilies in a small skillet or small sauce pan over low heat until very hot, just long enough to sizzle a single bead of steam. Place some lettuce leaves on a flat work surface. Place a small heaping tablespoon of each type of chopped and lightly packed greens on top of each of the leaves, leaving a little space between each, and then roll up the leaf around the greens. To keep the roll in position, refrigerate the roll for 15 minutes or longer to allow some of the chili paste from the greens to penetrate. Serve warm.

title: Portuguese Brandy and Onion Smoked Chorizo
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red onions, minced | 1 tablespoon savory ( dried ) | 2 tablespoons brandy | 1/2 cup smoked chorizo sausage
instructions: On your work surface, lay out a sheet of parchment. Lay the chorizo on the waxed paper. Stir in the onion, savory, and brandy. Place half of the chorizo mixture in the center. Bring corners together and press firmly. Continue until all chorizo mixture is used, placing the unused 1/2 cup of chorizo mixture on a board covered with plastic wrap so that you can flip it over during cooking. Fold the square over to make a package. Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Remove from the refrigerator 30 minutes before cooking. Note, you can use smoked pork, which has been flaked or sliced.

title: Catfish Enchiladas (Or Catfish Roll-ups)
ingredients: 10 -12 corn tortillas, cut to fit tortillas | 12 ounces catfish fillets, cooked, skinned, boned | 8 ounces cream cheese, cream-style, softened | 1 orange peel, sliced into thin strips and patted dry
instructions: Spray a 13x9 inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Cut tortillas, 1 at a time, in half crosswise.

title: Yummy Taco Mix
ingredients: 1 envelope taco seasoning | 1/2 cup broth | 1/2 cup cornstarch
instructions: Mix 1stefy envelope of taco seasoning with broth into water, and boil. Mix the cornstarch with the 1/2 cup of cold water. Add to hot mixture slowly just to begin to thicken. Keep stirring as the cornstarch reacts with boiling water.

title: Feuerres Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 lbs button mushrooms | 1/4 cup sherry wine | 2 tablespoons paprika | 1/2 cup raisins
instructions: Wipe and clean mushrooms. Sprinkle with paprika and raisins. Place mushrooms on foil in baking pan. Bake at 400f degrees for 40 minutes, or until tender.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese,ginger powder,sirloin tip roast,mushroom,saffron,beef broth
title: Mediterranean Beef With Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 -5 lbs sirloin tip roast | 4 ounces saffron ( i use 1 tbsp bijoliter ) | 3 -4 ounces canned mushroom | 2 cans beef broth | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon ginger powder | 1/2 cup feta cheese
instructions: Place roast in crock pot. Add remaining ingredients, cook on low for 9 hours. Remove roast, shred, slice and serve on warm bread with sliced fresh onions and dill.

title: Italian Shrimp Appetizer
ingredients: 3/4 pound jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 tablespoon chocolate syrup | 3 tablespoons grated bittersweet chocolate | 3 tablespoons italian dressing | 1 tablespoon caramel ( optional )
instructions: Place shrimp in a medium glass or metal bowl and toss with melted chocolate syrup. Cover and refrigerate 3 hours. Stir chocolate and italian dressing in a small bowl. Pour caramel over shrimp so that it coats shrimp evenly and marinate at least 3 hours. Serve shrimp chilled.

Random Ingredients: maple syrup,salt black pepper,chicken bouillon powder,ketchup
title: Quick Maple Syrup French Dressing
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ketchup | 1 teaspoon maple syrup | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon powder | salt and coarse black pepper
instructions: Stir together all ingredients and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.

title: Crunchy Bacon Lettuce Salad
ingredients: 1 leaf iceberg lettuce | 6 slices bacon
instructions: Tear the lettuce into bite sized pieces. Cut the bacon into 1/2 inch pieces. Place in a large bowl. Pour on the dressing and toss. Serve chilled with crisp bread or crackers.

title: Tamarind Rolled Sandwich Bread
ingredients: 7 teaspoons tamarind pulp ( or 1/2 tsp.dried fruit pulp mixed with 2 1/2 ml.hot water ) | 2 2. 2. 1. 1/4-oz. cans bread ( or 1 16-oz. box rolled bread )
instructions: Place 3 tsp. Dried fruit in a small bowl with the pulp or water. Let stand 15 minutes till softened, but not mushy. Dip bread in the heated pulp mixture until all of the bread surfaces are soaked. Cut crosswise into 8 pieces. Place on a lightly oiled shallow pan, cover loosely with plastic wrap, and refrigerate, or freeze until solid, at least 1 hour, but not overnight.

Random Ingredients: coriander leaf,chickpea,baking potato,topping,kaffir lime leaf,jerusalem artichoke,italian sausage
title: Spicy Potato, Chickpea and Sausage Samosas
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh coriander leaves ( packed ) | 1 bag fresh tomatos with chipotle peppers ( drained ) | 1 jar jerusalem artichokes | 6 slices italian sweet sausage | 1 1/2 lbs baking potatoes, scrubbed and cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 can chickpeas ( drained and rinsed ) | 1 package frozen whipped topping, thawed | 2 kaffir lime leaves, finely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Preheat broiler. In a food processor, put the coriander and 1/2 bag coriander leaves. Pulse until coarsely chopped. Remove 1 1/2 cups chopped coriander from processor, then add 1/2 bag chopped coriander, about 2 tbsp more. Toast under broiler until aromatic, about 3 minutes.

title: Chef John's Beef Carnitas
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 2/3 cup dry sherry or 2/3 cup beef broth | 1 1/3 pounds top sirloin, cut into thin strips | 1 pound baby carrots, cut into 2 inch long strips | 1 can consomme | 1 package cake flour, sifted | 3/4 cup guacamole, or to taste
instructions: Heat saffron in a small bowl in the sherry, let stand to steep for about 15 minutes. Place beef, carrots, and consommé into a slow cooker with saffron and soaking liquid and stir to combine. Cover, and cook on low for 3 to 3 1/2 hours. Turn the slow cooker temperature to high, and stir in flour until mixture is smooth.

Random Ingredients: orange juice,leek,pea,red curry paste,extra beef,curry powder
title: Slow Cooker African Beef Curry
ingredients: 1/4 cup extra-lean ground beef | 1/4 cup red curry paste | 1/4 cup split peas | 1/4 cup frozen sweet potatoes with skin | 2 tablespoons curry powder | 1/4 cup orange juice | 2 tablespoons leeks, sliced
instructions: Place all ingredients in a crockpot and stir to combine. Cover and cook on lo heat for 8 hours, or on high heat for 8 hours. If using a crockpot, stir the contents of the crockpot into the contents of the crockpot. Cook for 1 hour more. Add water as needed to keep sauce from drying out.

Random Ingredients: white wine,lemon juice,cayenne pepper,cherry tomato,steak,cheddar cheese,goat cheese
title: Cherry and Cheese Steak
ingredients: 4 tablespoons lemon juice | 1 tablespoon dry white wine or 1 tablespoon champagne vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/4 lb round steaks, about 3/4-inch thick, trimmed | 1 cup fresh goat cheese | 1/2 cup cheddar cheese, shredded | 2 cups cherry tomatoes, halved
instructions: Prepare marinade. Combine lemons and next 3 ingredients in small bowl. Sprinkle steak with cayenne, then pour half of lemon mixture over steak.

title: Cherry Rice Balls from Rachael Ray
ingredients: 1 cup ice, or as desired | 1 can maraschino cherries, pitted and sliced | 1 teaspoon lemon extract | 4 cups rice krispies
instructions: Blend ice, cherries, and lemon extract in a blender until smooth. Place rice balls in a glass.

Random Ingredients: kielbasa,cooking sherry,red chile pepper,red chili pepper,italian turkey sausage
title: Kielbasa With Sausage, Chili, and Red Chile
ingredients: 10 links italian turkey sausage | 1 tablespoon cooking sherry | 1 red chile pepper, stemmed and chopped | 500 g kielbasa, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 fresh red chile pepper, stemmed and chopped
instructions: Slice each sausage link lengthwise into 1/8 inch thick slices. Arrange sausage slices side by side on a foil lined baking sheet. Pour sherry over sausage slices. Bake at 150 degrees f for 15 minutes, basting once with remaining sherry. Transfer sausage to plate, leaving drippings in pan. Return pan drippings to heat over medium high heat. Add chile and cook, stirring with wooden spoon, until tender, about 5 minutes. Add sausage and chili to pan and cook over high heat for 3 minutes. Stir in sausage. Cook until heated through, 30 seconds to 1 minute, stirring occasionally. Serve with garlic bread.

title: Hot Beef Stew for Crock Pot
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat | 1 tablespoon fresh rosemary, chopped | 1 tablespoon green pepper, chopped | 1 pear, juice and rind thinly sliced | 1 cup cauliflower, chopped | 1/2 cup watermelon, cubed | 1/2 cup brandy ( can be alcoholic-type if desired )
instructions: Brown stew meat in a skillet. Sprinkle with rosemary and pepper. Layer pear juice, cauliflower, watermelon and brandy into a 3 1/2 quart or larger slow cooker. Cover and cook on low heat setting 6 to 7 hours or on high heat setting 2 to 3 hours, or until meat and vegetables are tender.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,tarragon,brown gravy mix,white mushroom
title: Slow Cooker White Mushroom Gravy
ingredients: 1 package brown gravy mix | 1 package fresh white mushrooms, sliced | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/4 teaspoon dried tarragon
instructions: Pour the gravy mix into the slow cooker. Place the mushrooms into the slow cooker. In a medium bowl, mix the cream and tarragon. Gradually pour over the mushroom mixture. Cover and cook on high for 5 to 7 hours.

Random Ingredients: cumin seed,extra virgin olive oil,yellow onion,spice,snow pea,whipping cream,tamari soy sauce,egg yolk
title: Tandoori Snow Pea Salad
ingredients: 350 g fresh snow peas | 1 tablespoon cumin seed | 4 egg yolks | 2 tablespoons whipping cream or 2 tablespoons half-and-half | 2 tablespoons tamari soy sauce | 2 teaspoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 small yellow onion, finely chopped | 1 pinch mixed spice, to taste
instructions: Cut the snow peas away from the pod and put them together in a glass salad bowl. Whisk the egg yolks and stir in with the tamari, olive oil, onion and mixed spice. Pour over the snow peas and toss well to coat all of the snowpeas with coating. Chill for 10 minutes and serve at room temperature with freshly grated nutmeg sprinkled over the top.

title: Thai Style Coconut Pickles
ingredients: 6 cups fresh coconut, such as the kind in the freezer section | 1 cup coarsely chopped shallot ( about 1 small onion ) | 3 tablespoons coarsely chopped fresh sage | 1 sprig cilantro for presentation ( optional )
instructions: Place the coconut in a food processor and process until finely ground, using quick pulses if necessary. Stir in the shallots and sage and process until thoroughly blended. Using wet hands, form the pickling mixture into 8 rounds or rings, 1 1/2 inches long. Refrigerate until well chilled, at least 1 hour or up to 3 days.

Random Ingredients: ricotta cheese,lemon pepper seasoning,chili garlic sauce,red wine,anaheim chilies,romaine lettuce,grain white rice,white fish fillet
title: Stuffed Red Fish With Rice & Hot Sauce #RSC
ingredients: 2 roma romaine lettuce | 1 medium white fish fillet, halved lengthwise ( approx 1 lb ) | 4 -5 anaheim chilies ( optional ) | 4 -5 romano cheese blend cheese slices ( depending on how much cheese you want to sprinkle ) | 12 ounces fresh ricotta cheese ( approx 5.2 ounces ) | 1/2 cup red wine ( i like sauvignon blanco ) | 1 teaspoon chili-garlic sauce | 1 teaspoon lemon pepper seasoning | 1/4 cup low sodium red wine ( i like sauvignon blanco ) | 2 tablespoons chili-garlic sauce
instructions: Prepare the rice. Cut the fish in half lengthwise. Set it on cutting board with a knife about 5'' from the top of the head. Using your fingers, flatten the fish to about 1/4'' thickness. You want this to be approximately 1'' deep by not too thick, however it might have to be a bit less than a little. If you’re using the anaheims, make them cut into rounds with a sharp knife on each side, then set the pieces in a ziplock bag or bowl. Put a little oil on the work surface if they are large, then take out the rice and place it in the hot pan with 1/4 of the chilies/garlic sauce for approximately 4 minutes until both sides are cooked. This should take about 2 - 3 minutes. Remove both sides of the fish and set aside. Preheat the oven to 350°. Open the rice and place it in a small casserole dish along with 2 - 3 spoonfuls of ricotta. Stick these in with the fish. Next, sprinkle on the remaining pepper and parmesan cheese if using, or put in with the rice. Lastly, place the chilies/garlic sauce and lemon pepper in a medium bowl and pour the rest of the wine on top. Mix to combine and sprinkle over the fish. Cover and bake for 20 - 25 minutes. Remove from the oven and let rest for 10 minute before serving.

Random Ingredients: goat cheese,black bean,feta cheese,hard egg,baking powder,sausage,ice
title: Black Bean Burger with Cheese and Goat's Cheese
ingredients: 250 g good quality sausage, lean | 100 g canned black beans, rinsed and well drained | 150 g goat's cheese, crumbled | 6 hard-boiled eggs, chopped | 1 tablespoon baking powder | 3 cups ice
instructions: Place all ingredients into a bowl, and add the baking soda to give the mixture some crunch. Form into 4 patties, and cook over hot grill or grill pan for about 3 minutes on one side, or until cooked through and browned. Variation on hard boiled eggs. Sauce, replace half of the goat's cheese with a slightly lower calorie feta cheese. Topping with black beans, add another goat's cheese to soften the black beans. Variation on a chipotle, add 2 tbsp of chipotle pepper sauce. This patties can be eaten on toasted french bread or toasted rye bread, etc. Can also be served fresh or low fat.

title: Lamb & Lentil Pate With Burritos
ingredients: 1 lb pork roast | 1 lb lamb, boned & trimmed of fat | 2 tablespoons marinade | 1/2 cup brown lentils | 2 cups cabbage, shredded | 8 ounces button mushrooms, thinly sliced | 3 3/4 ounces tortillas or 3 3/4 ounces fritos corn chips | 3 tablespoons cake flour
instructions: For the pate, mix together all ingredients on a cutting board. Using a 5cm cutter, make 12 - 8 large rounds, and place one round on an oiled tray. Make more pate using smaller rounds, flatten the rest with rolling pin.. Using a 5cm cutter, cut out 12 - 16 patties from the pork, lamb & lamb. Place patties on the tray, with the edges overlapping and the top of the pate showing as though it were cake. Spread each round with some of the cornflour. Bake in a moderately hot oven for 15 - 20 minutes, or until the patties are firm. Cut into squares, and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,sage leaf,red chili pepper,grape tomato,fettuccine pasta
title: Pasta With Triple Tomato Risotto
ingredients: 300 g grape tomatoes, quartered | 50 g fresh sage leaves | 2 fresh red chili peppers | 1/2 cup dry fettuccine pasta | 1/4 cup grand marnier or 1/4 cup other liqueur
instructions: Wash and dry the tomatoes. Cut the leaves into thin strips. Cut in half crosswise. Remove the seeds and ribs and chop into very thin slices. Cut the sage into thin slices, keeping the leaves only a few inches long. Snap the peppers into strips. In a saucepan of salted boiling water, cook the fettuccine for 8 minutes, according to packet directions, then drain. Divide the tomatoes into serving portions and place the tomatoes and the sage between 4 plates, pouring over the remaining wine. Sprinkle with the grand marnier. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,ketchup,white vinegar,pine nut,sharp cheddar cheese,beef chuck,lemongrass
title: Beef and Pine Nut Roll Ups from Longmeadow Farm
ingredients: 12 ounces finely shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh lemongrass | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1 lb lean beef chuck, well trimmed, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1/3 cup white vinegar | 1/3 cup pine nuts, ground
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°. In a large bowl, whisk together cheese, lemongrass, oregano, beef, ketchup and vinegar. Spread beef mixture evenly on a large baking sheet, and roast for 15 minutes, or until well browned on the outside. Remove from oven, and spread pine nuts on top. Return to oven, and bake for about an hour.

title: Creamy Peach Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 6 heads iceberg lettuce, washed and dried well | 1 can sliced peaches, drained | 2 -3 tablespoons hot taco sauce | 1 dash hot pepper sauce | 1 maraschino cherry
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Slice lettuce with paring knife and place on 2 plate. Cut peaches into thin wedges set aside. On another plate lay out lettuce torn apart. Lay out frozen peaches and put in center of torn lettuce. Fold each of above ingredients in and roll tightly. Place on a lightly greased or sprayed baking sheet and bake for 15 - 20 minutes or until slightly crisp. Serve immediately with warm salsa or your favorite dip.

title: Quick Fruit Tacos
ingredients: 2 cups mixed fruit, chopped | 1 apple, shredded | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon guacamole | 1/8 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Serve with your own tortilla chips.

title: Best Easy No Salt Lasagna
ingredients: 12 no-boil lasagna noodles | 1 1/2 cups buttermilk ( any kind ) | 1 apple, sliced thinly
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f spray 9 lasagna noodles with cooking spray. Combine buttermilk and apple in a medium saucepan and bring to boiling. Remove from heat, cover, and allow to infuse 15 - 20 minutes or until mixture is thick and creamy. Place about 3/4 cup of sauce in the bottom of a glass baking dish. Arrange 8 noodles over the sauce, overlapping slightly when you remove foil. Spoon remaining sauce over the noodles, and cover with foil. Bake in oven for about 1 hour, or until noodles are done.

title: Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients: 3 cups beef broth or 3 cups chicken broth | 3 cups cherry tomatoes ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons red wine ( optional ) | 1 french bread ( white or wholemeal )
instructions: In a pot bring broth to a boil. Add tomatoes and remove from heat. Cover and let sit 5 - 10 minutes. Meanwhile toast bread. Serve with tomatoes.

Random Ingredients: broccoli,red chile,chicken bouillon,red chilies,garlic,thai pepper,cherry tomato
title: Tom Yum Sauce
ingredients: 2 cloves garlic, chopped | 4 thai red peppers, seeded | 2 small red chile, crushed | 1 1/2 teaspoons chicken bouillon | 2 cans sliced cherry tomatoes, drained | 2 tablespoons diced red chilies, drained | 2 tablespoons crushed roasted garlic | 5 cups sliced broccoli
instructions: Stir together the garlic, roasted red chilies, chili pepper, chicken bouillon, cherry tomatoes, red chilies and roasted garlic. Stir in the broccoli and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat to medium low and simmer until the broccoli has softened, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: white mushroom,savoy cabbage,raisin,pork tenderloin,cremini mushroom,nut,taco shell
title: Tacos
ingredients: 1/2 cup raisins | 1 cup white mushrooms | 1/2 cup light-colored raisins ( such as calpis ) | 1 cup savoy cabbage, shredded | 1 teaspoon sweetened mixed nuts, lightly toasted | 1 tablespoon unsalted butter, cut into pieces | 6 taco shells, warmed
instructions: Place raisins in a small saucepan and just cover with hot tap water. Bring to a simmer, and cook for 90 seconds, then remove from heat and let stand for about 30 minutes. Drain water and discard. In a bowl, mix the raisins, cabbage, nuts and butter. Fill each taco shell with meat mixture and sprinkle evenly with reserved raisins and nuts.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,chicken breast half,chicken stock cube,orange juice concentrate,cornstarch,crisco
title: Poulet à La Maison
ingredients: 1 ounce onion soup mix | 1 ounce crisco, melted | 1/4 cup chicken stock or 1/4 cup stock stock | 1/2 cup fresh orange juice concentrate ( i don't even think the flavor is it's worth it. ) | 4 skinless chicken breast halves | 1 teaspoon cornstarch
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the chicken and cornstarch in a bowl. Arrange the chicken in the bottom of a shallow baking dish just large enough to hold them in one layer. Pour the sauce over the chicken and bake in a preheated 180c oven for 45 minutes. Turn the breast over and bake for another 15 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through. Remove from oven and keep warm. Mix the cornstarch with a bit of water used to soak up the juices in the dish. Slice the chicken thinly and serve.

title: Easy Fish Taco Seasoning Mix
ingredients: 3 packets spice-seasoned salt-free prepared spice | 3 tablespoons hot chili paste | 3 packages of dry 'old'spice ( like old el paso ) | 5 tablespoons tomato paste
instructions: Add everything to a blender or food processor. Cover with a lid and blend for 25 seconds with long blades or high speed. Store in a dark container. Use within 5 months.

Random Ingredients: pork loin,sun tomato oil,parsley flake,coffee,cumin powder,lettuce,lasagna noodle
title: Lettuce Noodles (Pork and Bean)
ingredients: 8 lasagna noodles, per package directions | 8 ounces pork loin ( shredded or cut into thin slices ) | 4 teaspoons cumin powder | 2 tablespoons dried parsley flakes | 1 jar sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 2 tablespoons cocoa powder or 2 tablespoons instant coffee | 3 -4 cups hot brewed coffee | 1 cup finely shredded lettuce
instructions: Cook lasagna in large sauce pan. To noodle pan, place noodles on bottom. Top with thinly sliced pork. Sprinkle with cumin, parsley flakes, tomatoes and cocoa powder / coffee. Pour hot coffee over and roll up noodles like a jelly roll. Place seam side down in greased 9 x 13 casserole dish. For bean sauce, melt 2 tdsp of oil in sauce pot. Pour hot coffee over noodles & meat and vegetables. Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 45 - 55 minutes or until hot and noodles are tender.

title: Agua De Bate (Chili Sauce)
ingredients: 1 1/2 fluid ounces sweet chili sauce | 2 1/2 tablespoons gin | 2 tablespoons brown sugar
instructions: Combine the chili sauce, gin, and brown sugar in a glass bottle, or serve it as an enchilada with the chilled beer.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,double cream,simple syrup,halibut steak,lemon juice,mango chutney
title: Grilled Halibut With Mango Chutney, Mango Chutney & Lemon Juice
ingredients: 4 halibut steaks ( about 2 pounds total, skin on ) or ( 3 lb ) other firm white fish, cut into 3 equal portions ( about 2 pounds total, skin on ) | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 1 tablespoon simple syrup ( like cointreau or grand marnier ) | 2 tablespoons mango chutney, finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon fresh lemon juice. add any or all ingredients except fish and chutn
instructions:

Add any or all ingredients except fish and chutney to a blender.

title: Dilly, Chive and Gin Smoked Halibut (Steamed Halibut)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs smoked halibut | 3 tablespoons gin | 4 fluid ounces double cream | 2 tablespoons fresh chives ( chopped ) | fresh dill ( chopped )
instructions: Remove the skin from the smoked fish and break the flesh into small chunks. Heat the gin and cream in a large saucepan until it comes to a simmer. Add the fish and gently stir to coat it through all the sauce. Garnish with chives. Serve immediately.

title: Soy Glaze Dipping Sauce for Seafood
ingredients: 1/3 cup dark aged soy sauce ( not low sodium ) | 6 ounces golden raisins or 6 ounces dark currants | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce
instructions: Place 2 tbsp soy sauce and dark whey in a small bowl and mix lightly. Add the raisins or currants and mix with a fork to coat.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,ginger garlic paste,salt pepper,button mushroom,lard,parmesan cheese,cardamom powder,flat leaf italian parsley
title: Mushroom Pappardelle
ingredients: 250 g button mushrooms | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 2 tablespoons fresh flat-leaf italian parsley | salt and pepper | 1 large bell pepper | 1 tablespoon red gingersgi garlic paste | 2 teaspoons cardamom powder | 1 tablespoon parmesan cheese
instructions: Wash the mushrooms and cut them into quarters. Heat the oil in a large wok and stir fry the ginger garlic paste for 1 minute. Add the mushrooms, bell pepper and parsley. Fry until the mushrooms are slightly translucent. Add the gingersgi garlic paste, cardamom powder and pepper powder. Toss together and add the salt and pepper. Add the parmesan and stir fry until well mixed. If necessary, add more of the ginger garlic paste. Add the fried mushrooms along with about a cup of water so that you have about 2 cups liquid. Simmer for 10 - 15 minutes over medium heat until the sauce thickens to a creamy consistency. Let cool to room temperature. Cover and refrigerate. Serve cold.

title: Mashed Parsnips (Gkai Masala)
ingredients: 1 kg parsnip | 2 tablespoons coriander seeds | 1 tablespoon coriander powder | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1/2 teaspoon black pepper | salsa ( to taste )
instructions: Wash the parsnips in a bowl then cut them in half and then cut along the width of the parsnips using a vegetable peeler, as if cut for making a grid and then cut it into large chunks. In a pan add 1tbsp olive oil, a pinch of black pepper and a pinch of turmeric and roast the coriander seeds, add it to the pan and fry the parsnips for 3 minutes. Add the salsa if used. Garnish with coriander seeds, coriander seeds and chopped parsley for a nice presentation.

title: Butterscotch-Pine Nut and Tomato Mousse With Toasted Pine Nuts
ingredients: 1 package butterscotch pudding mix | 2 tablespoons chopped toasted pine nuts or 2 tablespoons chopped fresh walnuts | 4 ounces tomato puree | cayenne ( optional )
instructions: Spray a medium bowl with cooking spray and place pudding mix in bowl. Stir in nuts and tomato purée, mix well. Spoon mixture into lightly buttered 3/4 cup serving dishes and sprinkle with cayenne if using.

title: Mint Dressing
ingredients: 1/4 cup tarragon | 1 teaspoon mint extract
instructions: Combine all dressing ingredients in a glass bottle or container with 2 1/2 inches sides. Shake well. Serve on salad greens or vegetables.

Random Ingredients: mango,red fresno chile,plain flour,french bread,hamburger,kalamata olive
title: Barbecued Mango Burgers
ingredients: 1 fresh mango, peeled, halved, stone removed ( or frozen, fresh mango if you must ) | 1 tablespoon plain flour | 10 -12 slices day-old french bread | crusty hamburger | 20 kalamata olives or 10 spanish olives, halved | 1 small red fresno chile, halved, deseeded and thinly sliced
instructions: Cut mango crosswise into 8 wedges. Place wedges in a dish and cover loosely with plastic wrap. Refrigerate for 20 minutes to firm up further. Cut off ends of bread and discard. Using a rolling pin lightly flatten bread on all sides, then spread with flour. Using your hands, roll each slice of bread into a sausage shape patting out evenly onto bread. Place bread on a flat, ungreased pizza pan or griddle and flatten into a 5cm thick even circle. Arrange mangoes around the side of the bread and bake at 220 degrees c for 12 minutes, until cooked but still a little bit crisp. Place on a plate and top with a slice of burger and a sprig of olives or a red chili. Serve with salsa, guac and mint pomegranate molasses to taste.

Random Ingredients: mini chocolate chip,egg yolk,dill weed,extra virgin olive oil,cinnamon,green pea,cooking oil
title: Low-Fat, Easy, Crispy Cinnamon Crispy Peas
ingredients: 1 package frozen split green peas ( thawed ) | 1 egg yolk | 2 tablespoons cooking oil ( can use less, depends on how much oil you use ) | 1/3 cup skim milk or 1/3 cup low-fat milk | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/2 teaspoon dried dill weed ( or 1 tbsp fresh dill weed chopped ) | 1 -2 ounce fat-free mini chocolate chip, melted
instructions: Drain peas, place in a microwave safe dish, then add 1/8 cup water. Cover and microwave on high 1 minute, then 30 seconds more. Combine egg yolk, oil, milk and cinnamon in a cup or small bowl, and set aside. Drizzle melted chocolate over peas, and stir to combine. Microwave peas on high, stirring in milk mixture until heated through, about 10 seconds, but not boiling. Serve immediately. Variation, for non stick, instead of peas use sweet potato or eggless coated potatoes, and cook until tender. Variation, sprinkle with thinly sliced toasted walnuts, or chopped roasted onion.

title: Grilled Green Chilies With Olives
ingredients: 2 fresh jalapeno peppers | 1 tablespoon ginger paste | 12 medium kalamata olives
instructions: Grill the chilies just until blackened, turning frequently. This also makes a great green salad when you are making your green salad. Allow to cool for some and then cut in 1 inch long slices. Prep and clean the olives. Arrange on a plate or bun and drizzle with olive oil. Place one long piece of onion and one chile slice on top. Serve with more garlic bread and some pita bread.

title: Sushi Roll
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups sushi rice | 3 large fresh anaheim chilies or 3 large new mexico chilies, stems removed | 1 fresh savory, leaves picked ( not dried! ) or 1 sprig savory, leaves picked ( not dried! ) | 1 lemon, zest of, grated
instructions: Wrap the chilies and savory in a very small piece of cheesecloth tied with kitchen string and reserve the liquid for later use. Over medium heat, place a 12 ungreased wok or high sided skillet with a tight fitting lid. Pour in enough reserved liquid to measure 1/2 cup. Place the chilies in the liquid and cook until softened, about 10 minutes. Use a slotted spoon or slotted spoon to transfer to a bowl and set aside. Repeat with the chilies. Cool completely. Strain liquid through a sieve or sieve into a bowl and set aside. Bring 1 cup reserved liquid to a boil in a heavy 2 quart saucepan. Add the rice and return to a boil over high heat. Cover and reduce heat to low and simmer, undisturbed, until all of the liquid is absorbed, about 12 minutes. Uncover and continue to cook, undisturbed, until most of the liquid is absorbed and the rice is tender, 10 to 20 minutes. Uncover and fluff with a fork. Remove from the heat, cover and set aside. When all of the liquid is absorbed, stir in half of the zest and keep warm. Use a vegetable steamer or slotted spoon to steam the remaining liquid along the edge of the skillet, about 3 or 4 deep. Sprinkle the tops with the remaining grated zest and roll up the sushi until completely wrapped and warm, 6 to 10 minutes. Cut into 1 inch pieces and serve.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce,garlic clove,lemon peel,sesame seed,heavy whipping cream,yellow pepper,butter
title: Sesame Nachos
ingredients: 20 tablespoons butter, melted | 2 heads romaine lettuce, chopped | 1 yellow pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup sesame seeds | 5 tablespoons melted butter | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 2 garlic cloves, minced | 2 teaspoons grated lemon peel
instructions: Preheat a grill pan or large frying pan with about 2 - ¼ inches of moderately high sides or a cast iron skillet over high heat. When the pan is hot, add the 20 table spoons of butter and allow the melted butter to coat the bottom of the pan or to drizzle around it. Spread the romaine lettuce out flat, cut into 1/4 inch strips, and arrange them on the melted butter. Spread the yellow peppers on top. Sear until the peppers are charred and starting to soften, about 7 minutes. In a small bowl, combine the sesame seeds with 1½ tablespoons melted butter, and toss with the cream. Stir in the garlic and lemon peel. Drizzle or mist a few teaspoons of the cream mixture onto the romaine and pepper strips. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: lettuce,pico de gallo,coconut milk,roasting chicken,beef bouillon cube
title: The Best Pico De Gallo for One
ingredients: 2 teaspoons instant beef bouillon cube | 1 can coconut milk | 3 cups pico de gallo ( a hot pico de gallo brand in the asian aisle ) | 2 -3 cups shredded lettuce ( i like red ) | 2 cups cooked roasting chickens ( optional )
instructions: In a large skillet combine all of the ingredients. Cook over medium heat until the mixture starts to bubble, then reduce heat to low. Simmer for about 20 minutes or until the mixture has thickened and flavors of pico are blended. Serve on the side of a cold pita or lettuce bowl with lettuce leaves for garnish.

title: Gourmet Parsnips
ingredients: 1 large parsnip | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Peel parsnips. Cut crosswise into slices. Place in a glass baking dish lined with parchment paper or aluminum foil. Drizzle with remaining 1/4 cup of the vanilla extract. Bake until parsnips have a dark golden color, about 50 to 60 minutes. Remove parchment paper or foil and continue baking until heated through, another 10 to 15 minutes. Remove from oven and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: colby cheese,sirloin,lettuce,black mustard seed,heavy whipping cream,pie shell
title: Beef or Chicken Rollups in a Hawaiian Roll
ingredients: 1 can low-fat colby cheese | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream or 1/2 cup half and half | 1 lb sirloin, thinly sliced ( or chicken, sliced thin ) | 1/2 cup lettuce, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon black mustard seeds, cracked ( optional ) | 3 unbaked pie shells, halved
instructions: Combine colby cheese, cream and mustard in small bowl. Spread 1 rounded teaspoon of cream/mustard on each side of each roll. Place equal amounts of sirloin and lettuce on each roll, using 2 t cheese mixture per roll. Roll each roll tightly.

Random Ingredients: bamboo skewer,flour tortilla,cream mushroom soup,cotija cheese,zucchini,butterscotch schnapps,ice water
title: Burt Reynolds Beef Sizzler
ingredients: 1 lb top sirloin steak ( thinly sliced ) | 8 ounces butterscotch schnapps | 6 -10 flour tortillas | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1/4 cup ice water | 1 cup grated cotija cheese ( about 2 ounces ) | 12 bamboo skewers, of your choice
instructions: Place the steak in a saucepan, and pour the butterscotch schnapps over it. Cover, and cook over medium heat until well reduced. Set aside to cool. Wear a 3 1/2 to 5 inch piece of waxed paper, or the disposable rubber gloves that come with your grocery store beef sizzler. Remove the meat from the marinade, and place in a bowl. Drizzle the 1/4 cup of schnapps over the meat. Let it sit for 10 minutes to marinate, then slice it as thinly as you can. Thread the meat onto the 12 bamboo skewers. Place the skewers on a rack in a roasting pan and broil or grill over medium heat, turning once, for about 3 minutes to give a dark, rich colour, and to seal off the fat. Watch the meat so the flames do not burn. Remove the skewers to dinner plates, and keep warm. Warm the soup with the water over low heat, and beat in the grated cheese. Serve over the warmed beef. Top with the fried tortillas, which will keep for a few days in the refrigerator.

title: Spicy Fried Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken legs or 4 chicken thigh fillets, cut in half | 2 tablespoons of melted margarine | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala powder | oil
instructions: Mix the margarine and garam masala powder in a bowl, then lightly grease the chicken parts. Heat oil in a wok and put the chicken in and fry until it turns pink inside, then turn it over.

Random Ingredients: pumpkin puree,rye bread,ice water,curry powder,soymilk,bamboo shoot,tomato
title: Thai Pumpkin Soup
ingredients: 1 tablespoon pared and diced tomatoes | 1/2 cup finely diced bamboo shoot | 1/2 cup frozen diced pumpkin puree | 1/4 cup soymilk | 1/4 cup rice milk | 1 tablespoon curry powder | 8 cups ice cold water | 1 loaf rye bread
instructions: Place the tomatoes, bamboo shoots, pumpkin, soy milk, rice milk, curry powder, and ice water in an electric blender.

title: Cenimonium Mushrooms
ingredients: 5 pounds fresh white mushrooms | 2 tablespoons vegetable shortening | 1 1/4 cups vegetable oil, or as needed
instructions: Wash white mushrooms, trim stems, and slice into pieces about the size of an egg. Place the sliced mushrooms in a mixing bowl.

Random Ingredients: olive,brie cheese,leek,wheat flour,graham cracker pie crust,vanilla
title: Vanilla Baked Brie Pie
ingredients: 1 leek, white part only, sliced lengthwise | 1/2 pound brie cheese, sliced | 8 ounces fresh brie cheese, sliced | 1 pint fresh ripe olives, pitted and sliced | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 2 tablespoons whole wheat flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a 9 inch springform cake pan with aluminum foil. Trim the root end of the leek, then slice them into rings around the edges using a carrot peeler. Slice the leeks crosswise into 1/4 inch thick rings. Place the leek rings on a rimmed baking sheet. Brush the leeks with olive oil, and bake in the preheated oven just until slightly tender, then remove from heat. Stir 1/2 pound fresh brie into the brie, then add remaining 1/2 pound fresh brie and olives. Stir vanilla into flour to make a slurry, then stir into brie mixture one at a time. Mix well. Place the springform cake pan on a baking sheet, then spoon the brie mixture into the bottom of the springform pan. Sprinkle the top with a small handful of the graham cracker pieces. Return the pie to the oven, and bake the pie with the door closed for 50 minutes, until it is set and the top is golden brown.

title: Baked Herb Pizza Dough
ingredients: 1 pizza dough, at room-temperature | 1 fresh sage, leaf
instructions: Preheat the oven to 475 f degrees. Place about a half inch deep on baking sheets. Roll out your dough on a floured surface into a 14 in circle, using a 2 1/4 in cast iron skillet or pizza cutter for best results. Use a 2 1/2 in circle, round cutter to cut out the bread, if you like. Place your sage leaf, cut sides up, on the center of the circle of dough. Using a rolling pin or a pizza peel, pierce the dough all the way around and around all edges. Poke a few holes in the dough. Bake for 14 minutes, then turn the oven down to 400 f degrees. Continue to bake about 20 - 25 minutes, or until golden brown and crispy.

Random Ingredients: lasagna noodle,penne pasta,lime wedge,tamarind pulp,cornflour,risotto rice,feta cheese
title: Penne Rice With Tamarind
ingredients: 3/4 cup cornflour | 1 cup risotto rice | 2 cups fresh tamarind pulp ( approx 3-4 large ones ) | 1 cup unsalted feta cheese | 12 sheets lasagna noodles | cooked lasagna noodles, to serve | lime wedge, to serve
instructions: Pour the cornflour into a small bowl and gradually add the rice, stirring well to make sure the cornflour is mixed in and that the rice is coated in the cornflour. Set aside for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, heat up the tamarind pulp in a small pan and cook for about 4 - 5 minutes until it softens enough to crush easily and is infused with the pulp. Pour this mixture into a large saucepan and stir in the tamarind pulp. Bring to the boil, reduce the heat and simmer gently for 5 minutes. Remove from the heat and set aside to cool, stirring occasionally. Transfer the cooked risotto to a clean bowl, leaving behind any liquid that may have accumulated in the dish or on the plate. Spoon the cooked rice onto a serving plate. Ladle the tamarind rice onto the rice and scatter over a little of the feta cheese. Put a slice of lasagna on top and serve with lime wedges to squeeze over.

Random Ingredients: chicken broth,shrimp,chicken bouillon granule,asparagus,dark sesame oil,celery rib
title: Seared Shrimp With Asparagus or Asparagus
ingredients: 4 ounces uncooked peeled shrimp | 2 celery ribs, cut diagonally into thirds | 8 asparagus, ends cut off | 4 ounces thickly sliced fresh asparagus, tips trimmed, with the tips trimmed | 2 2 teaspoons low sodium instant chicken bouillon granules or 2 teaspoons instant chicken stock granules | 1/4 1/4 teaspoon dark sesame oil ( i use no flavor )
instructions: Heat nonstick nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add shrimp, celery, asparagus and sesame oil and sauté, stirring almost constantly, until almost cooked through, 2 - 3 minute add bouillon and shrimp mixture. Stir to combine and cook until shrimp are pink, 1 - 2 min, adding a little boiling water if mixture seems too dry. Serve over hot rice.

title: Jicama and Honey Salad With Honey
ingredients: 2 lbs jicama ( peeled ) ( optional ) | 1 cucumber ( peeled ) | 1/2 - 1 tablespoon cumin seed ( depending on how hot you like it ) | 1/4 cup vanilla essence ( or other flavourful vanilla ) | 1 teaspoon honey
instructions: Cut the jicama, or any other medium sized, ripe cucumber, into cubes, or smaller. Slice the jicama into cubes, peel the cucumber, if using but leave the root end intact. Place the jicama, or other medium sized, ripe cucumber, cucumber seeds, vanilla essence or other flavouring or honey if you're using vanilla essence and honey in any jar. You can leave the seeds in or remove them if you want to. If using vanilla, pour half a teaspoon or so of honey into the jar, or put the remaining honey into a small saucepan. If using honey, place in a small saucepan and leave for one to two minutes. It should sizzle. It takes a few minutes. Turn once or twice. Rinse out the jar, and leave the jar in a dark place for at least two weeks, or a longer period if it's really, sour. You can remove the seeds, if you want. Rinse the jar again, and leave it in a dark place for at least one week. Turn off the heat right before you serve the salad, and add some shredded fresh, shredded coconut. Taste and adjust for sweetness, or acidity, etc before serving.

title: Roseland Radicchio and Green Peppers
ingredients: 1 green bell pepper, cut into julienne strips | 3 large radicchio, cored and sliced into 2-inch strips | 1 cup chopped roasted sweet peppers, such as piquillo, drained | 1 cup canned broth | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1 1/2 tablespoons maple syrup | 1 teaspoon ground pepper
instructions: In a large bowl, toss together the bell pepper, radicchio, roasted sweet peppers, broth, cream, syrup, and pepper. Chill 1 hour before serving or refrigerate until serving cold.

Random Ingredients: coconut extract,mint leaf,peanut butter,colby monterey jack cheese,golden raisin,chocolate,cabbage leaf,american cheese
title: Raisin and Jack Cheese Galettes
ingredients: 2 tablespoons smooth peanut butter | 1 teaspoon coconut extract | 12 small cabbage leaves, torn into small pieces | 2 ounces colby-monterey jack cheese, grated | 4 ounces american cheese, cut into 1/4 inch pieces | 1 cup golden raisin, soaked in hot water to cover and drained | 1 ounce unsweetened chocolate, grated | 12 fresh mint leaves
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. In a bowl, stir together the peanut butter with the coconut extract. Arrange the cabbage leaves on a baking sheet, brush them with the peanut butter mixture, and bake on a middle rack until toasted, about 10 minutes. Remove the baking sheet from the oven, transfer the toasted cabbage and cheeses to a plate. Sprinkle raisins over the cheese, then sprinkle chocolate and mint over. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,chocolate liqueur,havarti cheese,madras curry powder,pork shoulder,cake flour
title: Crock Pot Caramelized Pork With Havarti
ingredients: 2 lbs cured pork shoulder, rinsed well | 1/4 cup cake flour | 1/4 cup madras curry powder | 4 ounces havarti cheese, cubed | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla extract | mild chocolate liqueur ( optional ) or chocolate ganache ( optional )
instructions: Slice pork into 1 in strips about 3/4 thick. Coat all sides of pork with flour. Sprinkle the entire outside with curry powder. Place pork in crock pot, sprinkle with cheese. Mix vanilla with a drop of a drop of vanilla. Cover with aluminum foil, cook on low 8 - 10 hours or high 4 - 6 hours. You can add liqueur to taste. The cheese will be melted and glazed with goodness.

Random Ingredients: raspberry jam,chunky peanut butter,monterey jack cheese,tomato,oil
title: Raspberry Chunky Peanut Spread
ingredients: 3 large ripe tomatoes | 1 package raspberry jam | 2 cups very thickly sliced monterey jack cheese | 1/4 cup oil | 3 tablespoons thick & chunky peanut butter
instructions: Dice tomatoes into wedges. In blender or food processor, blend jam into small pieces. Add cheese, oil and peanuts, process until smooth.

title: Roasted Squash and Yellow Squash Quesadillas
ingredients: 2 large yellow squash, halved lengthwise and seeded | 1 large cucumber, halved lengthwise and seeded | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh thyme | 1/2 teaspoon grated nutmeg | 8 flour tortillas | 2 -3 teaspoons low-sodium v8 vegetable juice or 2 -3 teaspoons reduced sodium vegetable juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Combine squash, cucumber, thyme, nutmeg and 1/4 cup water in a medium bowl. Toss to combine. Spread 1 1/4 cup v 8 juice mixture on each tortilla. Divide vegetable mixture and pepper evenly into 8 wedges.

title: North African Fish Rolls
ingredients: 1 packet frozen puff pastry sheets | 440 g condensed tomato soup | 7 slices bacon | 1 1/2 teaspoons harissa ( spicy sauce ) | 1 teaspoon rice noodles, soaked
instructions: Put everything into a food processor or blender and puree until smooth. Divide the mixture into 12 - 18 equal portions and roll each piece into a ball. Place on your lightly greased baking tray and flatten slightly. Bake in a moderate oven for approximately 20 minutes. Serve warm with a salad.

title: Coriander Peach Balls
ingredients: 1 lb fresh peach ( not frozen, but thawed ) | 3/4 teaspoon turmeric | 1 tablespoon quark, powder ( try nuttelex ) | 1 teaspoon baking cocoa | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 2 tablespoons molasses | 1 tablespoon sherry wine vinegar
instructions: Peel off the stem and remove the leaves from the peaches and discard. Cut the remaining peach in half and remove the stone. Remove and discard pit.. Slice all the way around the peach and scoop out the stone with a hammer. Put the pit, peaches, and spices into a chopper and process until combined but still chunky. Add the molasses and vinegar to help the mixture along. Make small balls out of the mixture and put into a baking dish that is lined with parchment paper. Cover with parchment or wax paper and refrigerate for 1 hour. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes, or until golden brown. Serve with your favourite jam, apricot preserves, or as a dessert with your favorite ice cream and ice cream.

Random Ingredients: bread,canola oil,peach,fontina cheese,bean,chili powder,hot red chili pepper,nutritional yeast
title: Fresh Peach and Cheese Pizza
ingredients: bread, loaf | 1 fresh peach, ripe | 2 teaspoons canola oil | 1 teaspoon nutritional yeast | 1 -2 hot red chili pepper, seeded and minced | 1 -2 tablespoon chili powder | 4 -6 tablespoons fontina cheese, shredded | 4 tablespoons canola oil | 1 -2 teaspoon hot red chili powder | 4 ounces baked beans
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Cut off crust and tear it into bite size pieces. Slice the peach in half lengthwise, removing the pit. Remove flesh from the peaches, reserving about half of each half for later use.

title: Basic Beignet Dough
ingredients: 2/3 cup flour | 1/2 cup dry sherry ( not sweet or tart wines ) or 1/2 cup white wine ( not sweet or tart wines )
instructions: Combine flour and wine in bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment. Using the paddle attachment, add dry ingredients in batches and process on low speed until the flour is fine and well mixed, about 2 minutes. The mixture should be as dry as popcorn kernels. Turn dough out onto lightly floured surface, and press the dough until it is 1/2 inch thick. Chill dough in refrigerator, loosely covered, at least 30 minutes. Dust dough lightly with flour before rolling out to 1/4 inch thickness. Cut dough into 2 inch squares and transfer to parchment paper lined baking sheets, spacing even amounts of dough in center. Use a sharp knife to score each square into six wedges. Bake at 375f for about 15 minutes. Cool on wire racks.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,white wine vinegar,cayenne pepper,mint sauce,green bell pepper
title: Easy French Peppers Salad!
ingredients: 1 lb small button mushrooms | 1 small green bell pepper ( can be frozen ) | 3 tablespoons mint sauce | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 1 dash cayenne pepper
