instructions: Cut the mushrooms into chunks and remove any excess moisture. Peel the green pepper and cut into chunks. Pit the bell pepper and cut into chunks. Mix all the ingredients together. Chill and sprinkle with remaining chopped herbs before serving.

title: Cheesy Green Olive Pizza Dip
ingredients: 1 cup plain yogurt | 1/2 cup chopped green olives | 1 1/2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese, divided | 1 cup sliced jalapeno-flavored sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, undrained
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix the yogurt, 3/4 cup of the cheese, olives and sun dried tomatoes. Spread dough onto a greased cookie sheet, about 1/2 inch thick. Sprinkle top of dough with remaining 2/3 cup of cheese. Bake 15 to 20 minutes in the preheated oven, until golden brown and bubbly. Serve immediately.

title: Cousin Cosmo (Punc)
ingredients: 1 can sweet corn | 1 can rotel | 1 tablespoon coconut extract | chopped fresh cilantro leaves ( optional )
instructions: Blend corn, rotel, coconut extract, and cilantro in blender until well blended. Serve as part of a burrito de mousse or as an accompaniment.

Random Ingredients: dijon mustard,emmenthaler cheese,triple sec,basil pesto,dark sesame oil,pear,beef brisket,wide rice noodle
title: Corned Beef and Pears - Crock Pot
ingredients: 1 corned beef brisket | 1 package wide rice noodles, i use the'bird'brand. | 1 pear, peeled, cored and quartered with the peeler attached | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1 tablespoon dried pesto | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 2 tablespoons grated reduced fat emmenthaler cheese or 2 tablespoons gruyere cheese | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh basil or 1 tablespoon fresh chives
instructions: Using a knife or kitchen shears, slice the brisket across the grain, as if you were slicing it into small slices. Place the brisket, preferably with the grain, in the crock pot and place it on top of the noodles. Add the pear slices, sesame oil, pesto, mustard and grated cheese. Cover and cook on low for 8 - 10 hours, or on high for 4 - 5 hours. Just before serving, remove brisket from crock pot and garnish with extra cheese and chives. Note, any additional vegetables, such as potatoes or green beans can be added to the crock pot. Cooking times may vary depending on the size of the corned beef.

title: Nigerian Style Black Beans
ingredients: 1/2 lb black beans | 3/4 teaspoon turmeric | 2 plum tomatoes, peeled, seeded & diced into 1/2 inch bits | 1 1/2 tablespoons corn oil or 1 1/2 tablespoons olive oil
instructions: Boil the black beans, or if you like to add some water, add them to a pan of boiling, salted water, cook till tender, about 15 minutes. Drain and chill until ready to use. Puree the cooked beans in a blender or food processor. Heat the oil in a heavy nonstick saute pan over medium heat. Add the tomatoes, drained beans, and turmeric, cook, stirring constantly until the tomatoes release their juices, stirring, until the tomatoes are nicely browned and the beans are just heated through, about 3 minutes. If the pan is very hot, add a few drops of water before turning the heat down. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: garlic,salmon fillet,cake flour,fennel seed,clove,active yeast,almond extract,italian dressing
title: Fennel and Roasted Salmon
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast | 1/4 cup cake flour | 1/4 cup dry italian-style dressing | 2 teaspoons dried whole clove | 2 teaspoons fennel seeds | 2 teaspoons crushed dried italian spices or 2 teaspoons chopped fresh fennel | 1/2 cup slivered almonds or 1/2 cup slivered almond milk | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract ( or other almond-flavored extract )
instructions: In a small saucepan, dissolve the yeast in the warm cake flour. Add the remaining ingredients and mix together to blend. Place in a well oiled bowl, turning once to oil surface, and cover with very warm moist cloth. Allow to prove for about 1 hour. Punch down the dough, and shape into one big oval shape. Place on greased cookie sheets that have been sprinkled with sugar or sprinkled with a light brown sugar blend. Cut slits with a razor blade or cookie cutter on top of the oval. Let rise in a warm place for about 1 hour or until doubled in size. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes, or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: pumpkin seed,vegetable juice,orange juice zest,anchovy paste,mayonnaise,marjoram,white wine
title: Pumpkin Seed Mayonnaise With Anchovies
ingredients: 1 cup pumpkin seeds ( available under the 'zaar'in the asian food section at some supermarkets ) | 1/2 cup white wine | 1/4 cup orange juice, juice and zest of | 1/4 teaspoon anchovy paste or 1/4 teaspoon anchovy paste | 1/2 teaspoon marjoram ( dried herbs ) | 1/4 cup mayonnaise | 1/4 cup white wine or 1/4 cup dry white wine
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Put the pumpkin seeds and 1/2 cup white wine in a small pan. Place oven rack on top rack, just below the broil, and heat a griddle or large frying pan over medium–low heat. Toast the pumpkin seeds, stirring frequently, until they turn a shade darker. Pour the seeds out onto a baking sheet to cool, about 20 minutes. Once cooled, press the skins back into place by tapping on the pan and shaking it back and forth. Allow the skins to dry and crackle, but do not let the seeds fry more than a minute. Rinse and dry the seeds with a paper towel. Place them in a food processor with the remaining ingredients and process until smooth. Place in a glass container, cover and chill in the refrigerator overnight. Use as a spread or to add to salad leaves, on salads, etc.

Random Ingredients: double cream,ginger,rice vermicelli,lamb stew meat,baby spinach leaf,cheese ravioli,sauce,rice wine
title: Kittencal's Rong Jiang Doufu (Chinese Rancheri Lamb)
ingredients: 3 lbs lamb stew meat, fat trimmed, cut into 3/4-inch slices | 1 tablespoon grated ginger | 8 -10 cups fresh baby spinach leaves | 2 cans cheese ravioli, cut in half lenghtiewise | 1 bottle hot sauce ( or sherry ) | 2 packages rice vermicelli | 2 bags double cream | 1 cup rice wine or 1 cup dry sherry, to pour into cups
instructions: In a large slow cooker, combine stew meat, ginger and spinach. Use chopsticks or two forks for searing on all sides. Add hot sauce. Cover and cook on low 6 - 8 hours until meat is tender. Remove meat and spinach mixture to a bowl. Wipe dish with damp paper towels. Stir noodles into meat mixture. Cover and warm on low for 20 minutes. Remove noodles and set aside. Cook rice vermicelli according to package directions until just tender. Cut the noodles in half lengthwise, then crosswise into 2 inch sections. To serve, spoon ramen mixture into 4 soup cups and top with warm noodles. For a vegetarian do not use the sauce of your choice.

title: Affogato
ingredients: 1 tablespoon instant espresso powder | 6 cups cooked and drained penne pasta | 1 2/3 cups quinoa
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Pour espresso into a bowl. Add pasta and stir to coat with espresso. Bake in preheated oven until hot, about 10 to 12 minutes.

Random Ingredients: asafoetida powder,coconut cream,eggplant,yellow bell pepper,tahini,feta cheese,parsnip
title: Bhuga-Mekhi
ingredients: 1/4 cup low-fat tahini | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 medium eggplant, peeled and thinly sliced | 1 medium parsnip, peeled and thinly sliced | 2 medium yellow bell peppers, thinly sliced | 1 cup low-fat coconut cream | 1/2 cup crumbled reduced fat feta cheese
instructions: Preheat grill. In a small bowl, stir together tahini and asafetida. Add eggplant, parsnip, bell pepper and coconut. Whisk together. Place mixture on grill, reduce heat to medium. Grill eggplant, veggies on each side, covered, on each side for 13 minutes. Sprinkle cheese on top. Continue cooking until vegetables are crisp and cheese is melted.

title: Italian Dressing
ingredients: 2 cups mayonnaise | 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved | 1/4 cup chopped fresh italian parsley
instructions: In a large, bowl, combine mayonnaise and grape tomatoes. Stir in parsley. Chill. Serve with bread slices.

title: Berry and Zucchini Salsa
ingredients: 2 cups chopped fresh blackberries | 1 yellow squash, cut into chunks
instructions: Mix together blackberries and squash in a bowl. Cover and refrigerate 1 hour to let flavors blend.

Random Ingredients: dill weed,chicken wing,red curry paste,pork shank,italian sausage link
title: Sweet Italian Sausage Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1 cup red curry paste | 3 pounds pork shank, chopped | 8 links hot italian sausage links, sliced | 2 cups chopped fresh dill weed | 2 pounds chicken wings
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Arrange the curry paste onto a piece of aluminum foil, and place in the oven to bake for 1 to 1½ hours. Meanwhile, place the pork shank into a large bowl, and sprinkle with the hot sausage. Pour the curry paste onto the sausage, and divide the curry paste between the 2 pouches. Wrap the wings around the sausage, and spread them on a separate piece of aluminum foil. Place the bags onto the baking sheet, and bake for 40 minutes in the preheated oven. Once the baking sheet is cool, store in the refrigerator. It will keep for up to 3 weeks in the refrigerator.

title: Cauliflower Frittata With Fried Eggs and Veggies
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower | 2 tablespoons butter or margarine | 1/2 teaspoon light chicken stock or 1/2 teaspoon vegetable stock | 4 eggs, hard boiled and peeled | 1/2 cup radish, thinly sliced
instructions: Trim the cauliflower of thick outer leaves and cut into bite sized cubes.

title: Tahini Chicken Salad
ingredients: 8 lettuce leaves ( like romaine, bibb or boston ) | 2 tablespoons tahini | 1 large yellow onion, sliced thin
instructions: Whisk tahini with onion in small bowl. Toss lettuce with onion mixture. Serve immediately.

title: Chapawash
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 cups flour | 1 egg white | 2 tablespoons low-fat milk | 1 teaspoon daikon radish, finely chopped
instructions: In a medium sized bowl, mix together flour, egg white, and milk. Mix until smooth. Do not knead. Cover and let rest for 10 minute. Roll dough into long snake like sticks, about 1 inch long. Cut into 2 - 5 inch lengths, or 1/2 inch lengths, as needed. Place a little of the daikon in the center of each piece. Roll up like a cigar, starting on an outer edge. Repeat with the remaining daikon. Cook on a grill under a medium coals until the bottoms are light brown. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: limeade concentrate,celery salt,gorgonzola,confectioner ' sugar,cider vinegar,cumin seed
title: Easy Cumin Gorgonzola Salad
ingredients: 1 bottle gorgonzola ( blue recommended in can ) | 2 containers frozen limeade concentrate | 1/3 cup cider vinegar | 2 teaspoons ground cumin seeds | 1/2 teaspoon celery salt | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender and process until smooth. Serve in small dishes, drizzled with a little additional gorgonzola cheese. Enjoy.

title: The Best Burger Ever!
ingredients: 450 g hamburger | 1 green pepper, diced | 2 small oranges, juice and zest of | 1 tablespoon hot pepper sauce | 50 g blueberries ( or frozen ) | fresh coriander, chopped to serve ( optional )
instructions: Mix together in a large bowl the juice, zest & hot pepper sauce. Add the burger and mix thoroughly by hand to form a hamburger bun. Place on a baking tray and grill until golden brown on each side, brushing with a little oil during the last few minutes of grilling. Serve warm or cold with coriander.

title: White Corn Rice
ingredients: 2/3 cup white rice ( can be dry, but i like to cook the rice in the microwave. ) | 10 -12 ounces white corn kernels, drained | 8 -16 ounces chopped shiitake mushrooms | 1/2 cup chopped pecans | 1 inch fresh gingerroot ( may grate a bit if using ) | 1 clove
instructions: Place the rice, corn kernels, shiitake mushrooms, pecans, ginger, and clove in a large microwave safe bowl and microwave on high for 4 - 5 minutes. Stir and microwave for 1 - 2 minutes more or until the rice is fully cooked. Stir and re stir before serving.

title: Smokehouse Turkish Sandwich
ingredients: 4 tablespoons margarine | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke ( optional ) | 3 slices low-fat bacon | 3 tablespoons chopped onions | 5 slices turkish bread
instructions: Heat margarine in skillet over medium heat. Add bacon and onion.

title: Spicy Fish Filo Rolls
ingredients: 9 sheets phyllo dough ( approximately 1 package ) | 1/4 lb small dried squid or 1/4 lb snail squid | 1/2 lb celeriac, cut into very thin julienne strips | 1 cup mascarpone | 1/2 teaspoon crushed garlic or 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/4 teaspoon red pepper | 1/4 cup mirin ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons black peppercorns ( optional )
instructions: Drain the tentacles from the fish. If using a fish steak, cut it into 2 long strips and soak in water for 5 minutes. Remove the intestines from the fish. Bring a medium pot of water to a boil and blanch the spaghetti for 5 minutes. Add the drained spaghetti to the boiling water and immediately remove the pot from the heat. In a small bowl dissolve the mascarpone in a small cup of mirin, then stir into the mascarpone mixture. Keep warm over low heat until ready to serve. Cut the fish filo into 3 squares. Remove the stems from the calamari and break the tentacles into rings. Cut each slice of fish apart into 3 equal portions. Set half the scallions aside. Preheat the oven to 300 to 400°f lightly spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with oil. Lay the pieces of fish in the oiled dish and season with cracked black peppercorns. Mix the mascarpone mixture with the seafood and pour most over the fish. Cover the dish with a piece of parchment paper and a sheet of waxed paper and a damp kitchen towel and put in the oven. After 20 minutes turn the oven back up to 375f. Continue cooking for an additional 15 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through and the sauce has thickened. Uncover the dish and continue cooking for another 20 minutes. Remove and put on a serving platter. Invert the dish onto a serving plate and remove the paper and paper. The dish should be upside down. Invert the filo onto the platter and serve with a dipping sauce for dipping.

title: Chicken Sesame Seed Rounds
ingredients: 16 chicken wings, separated at joints | 1/2 cup whole wheat flour | 3 tablespoons sesame seeds
instructions: Sprinkle each piece of chicken with sesame seeds. Bake at 400 for 20 minutes, then turn to bake for another 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Prunes in Spiced Oil
ingredients: 12 whole pitted prunes | 2 teaspoons currants | 1 clove | tabasco sauce ( to taste )
instructions: Pour enough oil into a clean fry pan to come half way up the side of the fry pan. Heat on medium until it gets good and hot, but not smoking. Toss in the remaining ingredients and simmer on medium for about 20 minutes. Serve hot, as hot as the bread. I prefer to use the prunes as they have a nice smoky flavor, but it can be served with any fruit, fruit sauce or butter.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,pre mozzarella cheese,baby portabella mushroom,raspberry preserve,almond extract,parmesan cheese,greek yogurt,white vinegar
title: Shannon's Mushroom, Raspberry, and Feta Salad
ingredients: 1 lb baby portabella mushrooms, sliced | 1/2 cup prepared fat free mozzarella cheese | 1/2 cup pre-shredded mozzarella cheese | 1/2 cup fat free greek yogurt | 1/4 cup seedless raspberry preserves | 2 teaspoons all purpose greek yogurt or 2 teaspoons almond extract | 1 tablespoon white vinegar | 1 tablespoon kaffir lime leaf, finely minced | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract | 1/4 teaspoon ground pistaye ( or any flavor pistachios may not be available )
instructions: Put sliced mushrooms in serving dish and top with 1/2 cup of pre shredded mozzarella cheese. In medium bowl combine 1/4 cup of pre shredded mozzarella cheese and 1/2 cup of pre shredded parmesan cheese. In another bowl, blend 1/4 cup of pre shredded mozzarella cheese with 1/4 cup of greek yogurt for a smooth topping. In mixing bowl, combine 1 tablespoons of greek yogurt, 1 tablespoon of prepared vegan greek yogurt, 1 tablespoon of almond extract, 1/4 teaspoon of almond extract, 1/4 teaspoon of kaffir lime leaf, and 1/4 teaspoon of almond extract. Whisk until blended. Drizzle greek yogurt mixture over mushroom mixture and top with 1/2 1 cup of pre shredded mozzarella cheese. Sprinkle top with 1/2 cup of pre shredded parmesan cheese and 1/2 teaspoon of ground pistaye. Serve with a tossed salad or veggies.

title: Beef Tenderloin With Stevia
ingredients: 1 beef tenderloin, trimmed | 4 fresh thyme sprigs, plus extra thyme to garnish | 1/2 teaspoon stevia powder | 2 teaspoons stevia powder, plus extra stevia powder to garnish
instructions: Preheat the broiler to high. Cut the tenderloin lengthwise into eight 1 wide pieces. Cut each piece of beef into four slices on the diagonal and into four lengths, producing diamond shaped pieces. Place beef on a rack in a broiler pan. Rub thyme sprigs into beef slices, being sure to coat both sides. Sprinkle each slice with 1/2 teaspoons stevia and 1 tsp thyme. Broil 4 from heat until tops are browned, 4 to 16 mins per side, or until desired doneness.

Random Ingredients: enchilada sauce,green mango,leek,chat masala,butternut squash,dark sesame oil
title: Butternut Squash Enchilada Soup
ingredients: 1 butternut squash | 5 cups cold cooked green mango | 1 leek | 2/3 cup prepared enchilada sauce, heated | 3 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1/2 teaspoon chat masala ( optional )
instructions: Heat the oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Squash should peel its skin off easily. Cut into chunks. Add vegetables to a large pot with a little water and boil for about 20 minutes. Stir, cover, and remove the lid as soon as it is cooked down. When the squash is cooked, cut it in cubes to release some of the juices. Strain liquid and return it to the pot. Add the heated enchilada sauce, and cook for about 5 minutes over low heat. Add chaat masala to taste. Remove from heat and stir before serving.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,oil,double cream,orange zest,table salt
title: Zesty Oil and Garlic Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 1 tablespoon orange rind | 1 1/2 teaspoons orange zest ( finely grated ) | 2 tablespoons double cream | 1 1/2 teaspoons table salt
instructions: Place the sun dried tomatoes on a piece of foil and fold it in half, so it fits snugly around your saucepan. Sprinkle over the orange and rind. Cut the zest into fine strips. Stir together the lemon rind and cream with the salt and cream mixture. Add the garlic strips and zest. Serve with freshly ground pepper.

title: Greek Style White and Pear Onions over Ouzo
ingredients: 3 russet potatoes, about 2 to 3 pounds | 3 bunches white pearl onions with rings | 20 ounces homemade pesto sauce | 1/4 cup ouzo
instructions: Cut white onions in half, and slice thickly lengthwise for faster cooking, or place in a bowl, cover with cold water and set aside. Heat a skillet large enough to hold potatoes in a single layer, and add enough water to come halfway up the side of the potatoes. Boil potatoes 20 minutes, or until just tender. Drain. Slice potatoes into 1/2 inch sections. When potatoes are completely cool, add 2 to 3 tablespoons of the pesto sauce, per onion. Heat ouzo in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat until warm. Place potato and onions on a plate, and brush generously with ouzo. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: shallot,greek seasoning,cumin,chicken bouillon,red chilies,corn syrup,poppy seed,brussels sprout
title: Sweet Chili Snack Mix
ingredients: 1 shallot | 8 small hot red chilies | 12 brussels sprouts | 1 tablespoon poppy seed | 1 teaspoon cumin | 2 teaspoons cumin | 3 teaspoons all purpose greek seasoning | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon | 1 tablespoon corn syrup
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. In large mixing bowl combine all ingredients then add to jar.

title: Scotch Hamburger
ingredients: 4 lamb chops | 1 lb hamburger
instructions: Slice fatty fry with electric grill, place in heavy frying pan, brown in low heat.

title: Sultan's Pasta With Sultanas
ingredients: 1 lb fettuccine pasta | 1 cup bulgur ( medium grind ) | 1 large purple onion, thinly sliced | 1 cup sultana | 1 jigger triple sec
instructions: Soak bulgur in a bowl of water for 45 minutes to 1 hour, then squeeze out excess water. Cook pasta according to directions. In saute pan, mix bulgur, onions, and extra tbls. Of triple sec. Cook over medium heat, stirring often until onions are soft and transparent. Add drained bulgur and mix well. If pasta seems dry, mix in a little more tbls. Of triple sec. Serve with a sprinkling of fresh grated parmesan.

Random Ingredients: stew vegetable,water chestnut,rose petal,kaffir lime leaf,picante sauce
title: Quick 'n Easy Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 teaspoon rose petal ( rosemary, thyme, and bay leaf ) | 1 lb stew vegetables | 1 can water chestnuts, sliced and drained | 2 cans picante sauce | 2 teaspoons kaffir lime leaves ( optional )
instructions: Cut stew beef into bite size cubes. Mix together rosemary, thyme, bay leaf, and sliced water chestnuts. Place stew beef, picante sauce, and kaffir lime leaves into crockpot and stir. Cook for 4 - 5 hours on high or 8 hours on low.

title: Red Wine Ice Cream
ingredients: 350 ml chilled whipping cream | 3/4 cup red wine | 300 ml chilled milk | 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon water
instructions: Whip cream until stiff peaks form. Mix in hot milk, chili flakes and water to taste. Cover and freeze until hard.

title: Sultan's Tentari for Sambar
ingredients: 4 whole dried red chile peppers | 1/2 teaspoon season salt | 2 cups long grain rice, washed | 1 tablespoon harissa
instructions: Heat two 1/2 cups water to boiling in a saucepan over high heat. Add chopped chiles. Remove from heat. Pierce chiles with a long skewer. Place the chiles in water, then cover tightly and set aside to soak for 45 minutes to an hour. Drain chile chiles, then discard stems and seeds. Remove and discard the skin, and roughly chop. Combine chiles, season salt and rice in a bowl. Sprinkle with harissa. Seal and set aside for 24 hours. The sultan's Tentari is ready after 24 hours, and will serve as an accompaniment to indian dishes.

title: Beef and Bean Pie With a Twist
ingredients: 2 lbs ground beef | 2 cans white beans | 16 ounces canned peas | 8 ounces bamboo shoots, drained | 1 lb ricotta cheese | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Brown hamburger. Drain fat, if necessary. Sprinkle meat with salt and pepper and 1 tbs cilantro. Combine remaining ingredients and combine well. Spoon in cilantro on top and bake for 30 minutes.

title: Roasted Fava Beans
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh fava beans, picked over and rinsed | lemon thyme or dried thyme | celery seed
instructions: Wash and inspect the beans. They should be trimmed with a good amount of space from each other so they do not break. Place the beans on a tray or large baking tray and pour boiling water into the tray to reach 1 1/2 of the depth. Cover and leave to soak overnight. Next morning add lemon thyme or dried thyme. Cover and leave to soak overnight. Preheat the oven to 350f and leave the beans to cook to your preference. If you have a convection oven, turn the oven on for 8 - 10 minutes. This makes them super easy to remove from the oven when they are ready to be served. Bake the beans a few minutes or until they feel dry and a nice, golden color. Remove thyme stalks. Serve directly from the pan for a nicer taste, or place them on a platter, or sprinkle with the celery salt. These are great served with garlic mashed potatoes and buttered carrots.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,skirt steak,chili powder,french bread,coconut cupcake,water
title: Trisha's Braciole
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs skirt steaks, thinly sliced | 2 cans coconut cupcakes | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 1 tablespoon lemon juice, zest of | 1 teaspoon french bread, crumbs | 3 ounces water
instructions: Sprinkle all over steak with chili powder. Mix water with cornstarch, and stir to dissolve cornstarch. Dip steak in water to coat, drain. Cut cakes in slices, place on baking sheet. Spray with cooking spray. Bake at 450 degrees for 15 - 20 minutes, or until done. Serve with rice, beans and a side of tomato salsa.

title: Carnival Ham Rachael Ray
ingredients: 2 lbs ham steaks | 8 ounces american cheese, sliced | 8 ounces pecorino cheese, cubed | 8 ounces chiles, cut in half lengthwise and seeded | 1 lb rhubarb, ends trimmed, cut into 1 1/2 inch pieces | 1/2 cup tequila
instructions: In a medium saucepan or deep skillet, heat the saute pan with the ham over medium high heat until smoke rises. Add the cheeses and chilies. Drain the ham, return to pan. Add the rhubarb. Pour tequila around the ham. Cover and cook about 15 minutes. Uncover and cook about 5 minutes.

title: Spanish Beef Mince - for a treat and served with your favourite vegie
ingredients: 175 g beef mince | 50 g sliced almonds
instructions: Use 1/2 teaspoon of oil from a large frypan, or a large frying pan. You will need 1/2 teaspoons for each pound of meat, and the remainder of the meat is for the vegie. Fry the meat until brown. Remove from pan when brown and place on a plate lined with paper towel to drain any grease. Set aside. Heat oil until smoking. Tear the almonds toasted and scatter on top of the meat slices. Return to a simmer and stir to break up any lumps. Add the rest of the meat and cook a further 3 minutes. Serve with boiled or steamed white rice and vegetables, if you like.

title: Guacamole
ingredients: 6 ounces muenster cheese, grated ( about 5 balls ) | 1 avocado, peeled, pitted, and cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1/2 cup frozen peas
instructions: Heat grated cheese in a large skillet over medium high heat, stirring often until it begins to brown. Meanwhile, scoop guacamole into a medium bowl. Break off pieces of muenster cheese with toothpicks and place them in the cheese bowl.

title: Simple Crunchy Corn Chowder #5FIX
ingredients: 1 can creamed corn | 1 cup diced sweet potato | 1 cup cherry | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and enjoy.

title: Pollo (Grilled Wafer)
ingredients: 1 cup firmly packed golden raisin | 1 teaspoon lime juice | 2 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon | 1 teaspoon poultry seasoning | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried dill | 1/2 cup shredded gruyere | 3/4 cup coarsely chopped dried apricot | 3 slices prosciutto ( cut thinly )
instructions: In a small bowl squeeze the raisins to remove any excess moisture. Add the lime juice and bouilon. Stir until well combined and set aside. In large saucepan combine the dill, gruyere, and apricots. Bring to boil over moderate heat. Boil gently until mixture is reduced to about one fourth of its original quantity. Reserve 1/2 cup apricot mixture.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,veal,red chili pepper,tortilla,ouzo,rotel tomato,provolone cheese,hazelnut
title: Chicken Rollatina (Antipasto)
ingredients: 16 ounces boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1/4 veal | 1 pinch red chili pepper | 8 ounces of belgium deli rotel tomatoes | 8 ounces ouzo, and a good chunk | 8 ounces sliced provolone cheese or 8 ounces mozzarella cheese | 16 ounces ouzo ( for rollatina ) | 1/3 cup hazelnuts | 16 tortillas
instructions: In a deep frying pan brown chicken and veal in 1/4 of olive oil. Add chili and continue cooking for a few minutes. In a bowl add rotel, cheese, olives and ouzo and mix well. Heat up your tortillas and make 6 - 8 rollatina in pan on warm. Repeat with other tortillas and chicken mixture. Add ouzo to pan and fry on all sides until golden. Add chicken mixture to rollatina and top with hazelnuts. Enjoy this would be awesome served over spaghetti pasta.

title: Turkish Olive Soup
ingredients: 1/2 cup kalamata olives | 1 liter turkey broth
instructions: Bring all ingredients to boil in a large pot. Reduce to medium heat. You may need to skim off fat as it will thicken as it cools. Enjoy.

title: Pumpkin Berry Spice Mould
ingredients: 1 cup fresh or frozen mixed berries, thawed | 2 tablespoons pumpkin pie spice ( or cinnamon, lemon or other flavors )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f degrees. Divide the thawed mixed berries and pumpkin pie spice among four ovenproof moulds or ramekins. Bake uncovered for 15 - 20 minutes, or until the berries are tender and the pumpkin is light golden.

title: Dried Apricots With Chicken Nests
ingredients: 2 lbs apricots | 1 cup chicken bouillon
instructions: Cut apricots into quarters. Soak apricots for one hour in enough cold water to cover. Drain off about 1/2 cup of water. Stir apricots with 2 tablespoons of chicken bouillon into water, cover and allow to stand overnight. Boil 5 minutes then remove from heat. Drain apricots and reserve any liquid. Reserve 1/4 cup and serve as a seasoning for the apricots. Note, i sometimes add a little dried red pepper flakes or cilantro to the sauce. For an extra kick, i also sometimes add a small amount of onion powder or chili powder with the chicken bouillon.

title: Irish Oven Veggies
ingredients: 6 tablespoons buttermilk | 1 head savoy cabbage | 1 tablespoon soya sauce
instructions: Heat the oven to 220 c or 425f degrees. Trim the savoy cabbage well and remove the outer leaves. Put into a baking potato. Drizzle with a little olive oil and a glug of soya sauce. Bake for 10 - 15 minutes. Serve at once.

title: Bake-Broth Sandwich
ingredients: 32 slices bread | 2 teaspoons corn | 1/4 cup dashi | 1 cup broth | 1 tablespoon wheat germ
instructions: Cut off and discard crust and top layer each slice of bread with one tablespoon of corn. Spread dashi on the bread. Cut in half and place on top of corn with the bread. Place broth and wheat germ on top. Dip one slice of bread in broth and place on a soup plate. You can also place slices of cooked fish on top of the bread.

title: Buffalo Blue Cheese Spread
ingredients: 6 3/4 ounces buffalo blue cheese, cut into chunks | 1/4 teaspoon saffron, infused with salt | 1 pinch cayenne ( optional )
instructions: Using an electic mixer, combine the buffalo blue cheese bits with the saffron infused salt and cayenne. Mix well. Use immediately.

title: Tunisian Harissa and Vegetables
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ground harissa | 1 tablespoon low sodium harissa ( to taste ) | 1 tablespoon splenda granular ( to taste ) | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds, toasted | 1 tablespoon carrot, grated | 1 tablespoon mixed fresh herbs, plus sprigs for garnish | 1 tablespoon corn oil
instructions: Tunisian harissa sauce, combine harissa, splenda and toasted sesame seeds in a mortar. Add carrots, cover and allow to mingle for 10 - 15 minutes. Set aside. Vegetables, combine all ingredients in a large skillet over medium high heat. Stir constantly for a couple of minutes.

title: Radish with Tarragon
ingredients: 1 bunch radish | 1/4 cup chopped fresh tarragon
instructions: Trim and discard outer leaves from radishes. Bring a pot of water to a boil. Place radishes in the boiling water, and cook 5 minutes until tender. Drain, and rinse under cold water. Transfer to a bowl, and stir in fresh tarragon. Cover, and set aside to marinate 1 to 2 hours. Heat a heavy skillet over medium heat. Remove from heat, and shake skillet to redistribute radishes. Use chopsticks to slice radishes in quarters. Arrange over a large serving platter, and serve as part of a french or italian style dinner party. Cook's note, when using fresh tarragon you may want to place your chef base table's lid on the pan to give it smoke like an open faced item.

Random Ingredients: peanut butter,chili oil,garlic powder,star anise,yukon gold potato,buttermilk,nutmeg
title: Japanese Spicy Peanut Butter  Potato Laddres
ingredients: 2 lbs yukon gold potatoes | 1/2 cup buttermilk | 1/4 cup peanut butter | 1 teaspoon chili oil | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 pinch ground star anise | 1 dash ground nutmeg
instructions: Boil potatoes until barely fork tender.

title: Panko Crusted Shrimp and Collops
ingredients: 4 ounces hamburger | 2 ounces thin scallops | 1/2 lime | 1/4 ounce fresh lime wedge | 3 ounces panko breadcrumbs | 1/2 teaspoon coarse grain mustard | 1 tablespoon ketchup, low sodium | 1/2 tablespoon grand marnier
instructions: Brown the hamburger with lime wedge, scallops and ground mustard. Drain and blot dry. Combine 2 oz. Panko bread crumbs and remaining ingredients. Dip shrimp into mixture, coating evenly and shaking off excess. Dredge shrimp in crumbs and cook over medium heat until golden. Serve with cocktail sauce or ketchup or any other dipping sauce you prefer.

title: Peach Tea
ingredients: 1 lb fresh peach, peeled and cut into quarters ( or frozen ) | 1/2 lb fresh peach, cut into quarters ( or frozen ) | 2 cups strong black tea
instructions: Wash, core and cut the peaches into quarters. Bring 1 quart water to a boil in saucepan. Add tea kettle and peaches. Simmer 2 minutes. Add black tea. Let cool 5 minutes, then spoon into cups.

Random Ingredients: italian tomato,nigella seed,water chestnut,sage leaf,mandarin orange,italian sausage,rigatoni pasta,spicy bean
title: Spicy Italian Sausage and Bean Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb spicy italian sausage, casings removed | 3 cans cannellini beans, drained | 10 cups water chestnuts, drained | 1 can italian-style diced tomatoes, drained | 1 package rigatoni pasta, cooked and drained | 1 envelope nigella seeds ( optional ) | 1/4 cup fresh sage leaf, chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons cayenne crushed dried italian saffron spices ( optional ) or 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cardamom ( optional )
instructions: In a large skillet, cook sausage over medium heat until no longer pink.

Random Ingredients: cold water,chicken wing,ice water,white bread,oregano leaf,coffee liqueur
title: Cafe Con Dude's  Mocha Chicken Wings
ingredients: 500 500 g chicken wings or 500 g chicken wings | water | 400 g white bread ( sliced very thin, not crumbs ) | cold water | 1/2 teaspoon oregano leaves | 1/2 cup powdered coffee liqueur
instructions: Place the bread in the cold water. Mix and allow to soak, then dip the chicken wings into the water and then into the bread mixture. Place in the freezer for 20 minutes then mix the ingredients for the glaze, and then put back into the freezer for 15 minutes.. Bring to room temperature before placing in the oven with cover removed. Bake at 400 degrees for 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon powder,red enchilada sauce,leg lamb,red lentil,chili paste,crawfish tail,cabbage
title: Crock Pot Seafood Red Lentil and Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chili paste | 1 1/2 lbs boneless leg of lamb | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon powder | 1 can red lentils, rinsed and drained | 1 can red enchilada sauce, heated | 1 package frozen crawfish tails | 2 large head cabbage, chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Place in crockpot. Cook on low 20 minutes. Serve with shredded cabbage.

Random Ingredients: yellow pepper,cream tartar,ginger root,russet potato,mozzarella cheese
title: Potato Cheese Pasta with Ginger
ingredients: 2 large russet potatoes, cut into 1/4-inch dice | 1 yellow pepper, chopped | 1/4 cup sour cream ( or lowfat ) | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh ginger root | 1 carton shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. In a mixing bowl, toss together the potatoes and yellow pepper. Stir in the sour cream and ginger and spread in a single layer in the prepared baking dish. Sprinkle mozzarella cheese over the top. Bake for about 40 minutes or until the potatoes are soft and the cheese has melted.

Random Ingredients: spanish onion,mostaccioli pasta,saffron,active yeast,pineapple juice,crabmeat,fennel seed
title: Mostaccioli Pasta
ingredients: 500 g mostaccioli pasta | 1 can crushed pineapple with juice | 1/3 cup pineapple juice | 1 packet active dry yeast | 1 pinch saffron | 1/2 cup fennel seed | 1 small spanish onion, diced
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Mix all ingredients except pasta and onion in a large bowl. When well dissolved, mix in pasta. Cover bowl with a towel and place in a bowl of warm water to soak for 1 hour. Drain pasta and reserve 1/2 cup of reserved pasta water. Return pasta and reserved drained liquid to bowl. Add vegetables and mix to coat. Add pasta and mix well. Spread out pasta on baking sheet that has been sprayed with pam. Cover with a towel and leave to rise until you are ready to bake. Bake at 375°f for 30 - 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,lemon juice,golden syrup,chicken bouillon,beef tenderloin
title: Easy Beef Tenderloin With Lemongrass and Red Wine Vinegar
ingredients: 6 lbs beef tenderloin | 4 tablespoons lemon juice | 3 tablespoons balsamic or 3 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 3 tablespoons brown sugar | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon
instructions: Combine chicken bouillon, lemon juice, sugar and balsamic vinegar in large bowl. Add beef. Cover, and refrigerate several hours or overnight. Remove meat from bowl, reserving marinade and place meat on rack in roasting pan to roast at 375 degrees f. Marinate at least 1 hour, or up to 1 day. Spray broiler rack with cooking spray. Grill beef until medium rare, about 2 minutes per side for medium rare. Remove from pan, and let rest 5 minutes. Slice to desired thickness.

title: Pasta Cake Mix
ingredients: 1/2 cup cake flour
instructions: In separate bowl combine flour and 1/2 cup of the reserved cake flour mix, add 1/2 cup of water and mix until smooth and well combined. Add flour mix 1 tbsp at a time to moisten slightly during cooking. When mixture is moist, add 1/2 cup of reserved flour. Turn mixer to medium and mix thoroughly until dough pulls away from the side of the bowl. If mixture seems a bit dry, gradually add more flour. This can be made into a loose dough and dropped into a steaming basket for about 2 minutes. Using a large skimmer, drop dough onto skimmer. Let fluff a bit then gently shake the skillet off the dough. Continue to lift and lift dough as the dough cools. When dough is firm, slice and serve.

title: Barsley Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/2 cup soya sauce | 1/4 cup brandy, cognac or 1/4 cup rum | 1/2 tablespoon ginger-garlic powder, grated ( or 1-1 1/2 tsp. dry ginger powder ) | 3/4 teaspoon orange zest | 1/4 cup dried sweet mushroom, sliced ( such as chanterelles or oysters ) | 3/4 teaspoon poultry seasoning | parsley leaves or fresh parsley, minced ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients except the parsley leaves, or parsley, or any desired garnish, in a glass serving bowl. Place mushrooms in a glass dish and pour over sauce. Sprinkle with minced parsley or fresh parsley.

title: Spanish Chickpeas and Potatoes
ingredients: 3 cups potatoes, cubed | 1 green pepper, chopped | 1 tablespoon sherry | 1 teaspoon chili paste | 1 teaspoon fresh lime zest | 2 cans garbanzo beans, drained
instructions: Cook potatoes and green pepper in 2 cups of water until tender, drain. In a small bowl, combine remaining ingredients. Add potatoes and green pepper to mixture. Cover and chill until serving time.

title: Korean Style Dry Noodles
ingredients: 250 g uncooked udon noodles | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme leaves
instructions: Boil water and cook noodles according to directions. Drain and rinse under cold water. Place in a serving bowl. Sprinkle with thyme leaves and toss to coat.

title: Tuscan Turkey
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb turkey breast | sliced green peppers, to cover all ( or white pepper )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Line a non stick baking pan with foil, lightly wetting it with olive oil. Season the turkey with some salt and pepper. Place the turkey in the pan and spread veggies evenly. Cover with foil tightly and bake for 20 minutes. Uncover the turkey, sprinkle with more salt and pepper, and bake until done.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,chocolate,tuna oil,broccoli rabe,peanut oil,red chile,rye bread,pecorino romano cheese
title: Crunchy Broccoli Rabe Sandwich
ingredients: 6 ounces broccoli rabe, trimmed, cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 cup shaved light-colored pecorino romano cheese | 8 thin slices rye bread | 1 teaspoon finely chopped crushed red chile ( optional ) | 1 cup canned low-sodium tuna packed in oil, drained, flaked | 2 tablespoons shaved light-colored pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Cook the broccoli rabe in boiling water until just tender, about 3 minutes. Drain and run under cold water to cool. Transfer the broccoli rabe to a plate and cut into 1/2 to 3/4 inch pieces. Meanwhile, heat the oil in a small skillet over medium heat until hot but not smoking. Sauté the baking soda. Place the rabe in the skillet and toast, turning, until golden brown on all sides, about 3 minutes. Remove with a slotted spoon. Add the cheese and toast until melted, about 2 minutes. Cut the rye bread into four triangles. Spoon the cheese on four of the triangles, then top with the hot broccoli rabe. Top with the tuna, red chile and peanuts. Sprinkle with extra cheese. Cut into thirds and serve at once. Refrigerate leftovers for up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach,simple syrup,dill pickle,rom tomato,stir fry vegetable,tomato sauce,marinara sauce,pork loin chop
title: Dilly Pork Loin With Spinach and Tomatoes #RSC
ingredients: 4 roma tomatoes | 4 ounces marinara sauce | 2 tablespoons simple syrup | 1 pork loin chop fat trimmed | 14 ounces tomato sauce, your favorite tomato flavor | 1 package frozen stir fry vegetables, thawed | 1/2 - 1 cup baby spinach, thawed | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh dill pickle
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees f. Combine tomatoes, marinara sauce, syrup, and pork in medium size bowl. Place in 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until heated through. While meat is baking, prepare vegetables. When meat comes out of oven, top with vegetables. Place under broiler. Broil 3 to 5 minutes, or until tender. Stir in pickle. Spoon meat and veggies over vegetables and top with sauce.

title: Bungalow Bill
ingredients: 1 yellow pepper | 2 cups cold water
instructions: Peel and cube the yellow pepper. You need 3 - 4 cups. Put the water and the pepper into a sauce pan, bring to a rolling boil then reduce the temperature to medium and simmer for about 30 minutes or until the pepper is tender. Serve with bread, crackers or other meal, enjoy.

Random Ingredients: wine,bow tie pasta,baby corn,lemon,onion salt,cannellini bean,sultana
title: Nana's White Bean and Corn Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans | 1 can baby corn | 1 can cannellini beans | 1 lemon, juiced and zested | 2 tablespoons wine | 1 small onion, chopped | 1 teaspoon onion salt
instructions: Drain and rinse the white beans and corn and reserve the liquid from the cannelini beans. Combine well. Mix the olive, lemon juice, wine, onion salt, and diced tomato along with the reserved bean liquid. In a separate bowl, add the beans and corn to the olive mixture and stir. Pour the dressing over the bean and corn mixture and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,penne,ginger garlic paste,cumin seed
title: Crock Pot Beef With Penne
ingredients: 1 lb lean beef stew meat, cut into 1 inch cubes | 2 -3 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 lb penne, cooked
instructions: Combine the ginger garlic paste with the cumin seeds and salt in a large crock pot. Add the beef and cook on low for 8 hours. Serve over pasta.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean,nutmeg,sherry,green chili pepper,cabbage,spinach leaf,russet potato,pasta
title: Pasta and Beans
ingredients: 1/4 cup dry sherry | 1 lb russet potatoes, peeled and cubed | 2 packages frozen chopped spinach leaves | 2 cans chopped mild green chili peppers, drained | 6 cups chopped fresh c cabbage | 1 can pinto beans, drained | 1 lb pasta, uncooked | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground nutmeg
instructions: In 3 1/2 to 4 quart slow cooker, combine sherry and potatoes. Cover and cook on high heat setting 2 1/2 hours or until potatoes are tender when pierced. Stir in spinach, chiles, cabbage, pinto beans, and pasta. Cook on high heat setting 20 minutes or until pasta is al dente.

title: Cantaloupe Stuffed With Walnuts
ingredients: 8 cantaloupe, halved lengthwise and seeded | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup creme fraiche or 1/2 cup sour cream | 1/2 cup chopped walnuts ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 f. Remove the seeds and membrane from the cantaloupe with a teaspoon. Dice and mash the flesh until smooth. Stir the soup into the cantaloupe. Put the walnuts, if using, into a cup, then spoon about 2 tbsp of the mixture into each. Spoon the remaining filling over the walnuts. Bake for 12 - 15 minutes on each side.

Random Ingredients: mirin,serrano pepper,date,pinto bean,cooking oil,tomato puree,purpose flour
title: Pinto Bean Pancake - Pao De Fuba
ingredients: 4 cups pinto beans ( preferably red ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried serrano pepper | cooking oil ( for frying ) | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 tablespoon tomato puree | 2 tablespoons mirin | 8 dates ( optional )
instructions: Rinse and drain the pinto beans, removing any stones or foreign materials, and place them in a large pot or saucepan. Cover with water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer 45 - 50 minutes to develop flavor. Drain and reserve liquid. Put beans in a food processor and pulse until smooth. Transfer bean puree to a serving bowl. Mash with a ricer or fork. Return bean puree to bean pot with reserved cooking liquid, tomato puree, and mirin. Season to taste with salt and a sprinkling of the coarsely ground black pepper. Makes about 6 servings.

Random Ingredients: red wine,pork tenderloin,basil,beef sirloin steak,white vinegar,bell pepper
title: Italian Beef Salad (Bistec Encebollita)
ingredients: 1/2 lb pork tenderloin, cut into bite-size chunks | 1/2 lb beef sirloin steak, cut into bite-size chunks | 1 cup red wine | 1/2 cup white vinegar | 1/4 cup minced bell pepper | 1 teaspoon dried basil
instructions: Toss all ingredients in a large bowl. Place in refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: clove,dark soy sauce,chicken bouillon cube,sausage meat,steak,vegetable stock,chocolate syrup
title: Sausage & Scotch Broth
ingredients: 5 1/2 - 6 lbs steak, cut into 4 inch slices ( sirloin, rib eye, etc ) | 8 ounces sausage meat, uncooked | 1 can vegetable stock | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1/2 tablespoon instant chicken bouillon cube ( crumbled ) | 1 teaspoon chocolate syrup | 20 whole cloves ( optional )
instructions: Cut the sausage into 1/4 inch slices and the chicken into 1/4 inch slices. Brown the sausage in a large frying pan along with 4 oz. Of the steak. While the sausage is melting, blend the soy sauce, chicken soup, bullion, hot pepper sauce and the remaining steak and sausage. Pour the mixture over the meat. Let simmer on low until the sausage is tender, about 30 - 40 minutes. Remove the sausage from the pan and cool to room temperature. When the mixture is cool, strain it and discard the rest of the onion. When the mixture is cool enough to handle, pour it into a food processor with the reserved chicken stock and blend until smooth. Add the melted choc syrup and process for 10 seconds, then add the clove. Use a stick blender or food processor to blend until smooth. Taste and adjust the salt and hot pepper sauce as desired. Serve with jasmine rice.

title: Tofu and Sweet Potatoes With Pasilla Chile and Pine Nuts
ingredients: 2 dried pasilla chiles | 1/2 lb firm tofu | 1 sweet potato | 1 1/2 tablespoons sherry wine or 1 1/2 tablespoons chili sauce | 1/4 cup toasted pine nuts
instructions: Grill the chiles directly on both sides over high heat, until the skin blackens and blisters. Immediately rub off the blackened skin and blackened seeds and cut the peppers into rings. Cut sweet potato in half lengthwise and then into 1 inch chunks. Cook the sweet potato in boiling salted water until just tender. Drain. When cool enough to handle, peel the flesh and cut it into wedges or slices. Heat the sherry and pine nuts. To serve, arrange the sweet potatoes on a warm platter. Top the sweet potato with the tofu pieces, then sprinkle with the chiles and some of the pine nuts. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: baking apple,pepper,chili powder,white wine vinegar,chicken thigh,cilantro stem,curry paste,salt pork
title: Bombay Chicken Curry
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken thighs, boneless | 6 tablespoons curry paste | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1 teaspoon baking apple, diced | 2 teaspoons cilantro stems, chopped | 150 ml dry white wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons salt pork, cooked and cubed | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ground pepper
instructions: In a large skillet, melt 2 tablespoons oil. Cut the chicken in half, discard skin, and place into the skillet. Brown the chicken on both sides, about 5 minutes per side. Remove chicken and set aside. Heat remaining tablespoon oil in skillet. Add curry paste, chili powder, and baking apple. Cook for 2 minutes. Return chicken and any accumulated juices to skillet. Stir in vinegar, salt pork, and pepper. Cover, and simmer for 20 to 30 minutes, stirring once, or twice. Serve over hot rice.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,couscous,rice vinegar,molasses,spice,dark brown sugar,salad shrimp,marzipan
title: Shrimp Couscous
ingredients: 1/2 cup light molasses | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 1 teaspoon mixed spice | 1/2 cup chilled whipping cream, whisked | 1/2 cup dry instant couscous | 3/4 cup mixed salad shrimp, peeled | 1/4 cup marzipan
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together molasses, rice vinegar, brown sugar, mixed spice, and whipping cream. Pour over couscous and gently fold in shrimp. Cover and refrigerate for 10 minutes, then fluff with a fork.

Random Ingredients: chicken broth,heavy whipping cream,raisin,lime juice,lemon pepper,cream chicken soup
title: Easy Raisin Lime Chicken
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 can reduced-fat chicken broth | 1 teaspoon lemon pepper | 1 package raisins, dried | 1/2 cup fresh lime juice | 3/4 cup heavy whipping cream ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In a medium bowl mix soup, chicken broth, lemon pepper, raisins, lime juice, and cream. Bake in the preheated oven for 25 minutes.

title: Upside Down Halva
ingredients: 1 medium head cauliflower, broken into florets | 2 tablespoons semolina ( farina ) | 2 tablespoons chopped nuts, or to taste | 2 tablespoons tuna packed in oil
instructions: Place the cauliflower in a small pot with enough lightly salted water to cover. Bring to a boil, then boil until just tender. Drain, and mix in semolina until evenly mixed. Place walnuts in a small dry bowl. Stir the walnuts into the crumbs. Place the tuna in a medium bowl, and mash by shaking with a fork, until mostly and evenly mixed. Drain the cauliflower, and toss in to the walnut crumbs, mixing until thoroughly combined. Season with salt. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Place the dish onto a parchment lined baking sheet. Bake 30 minutes in the preheated oven, or until the edges of the halva have turned a nice brown brown shade. Remove from the oven, and slice into squares.

Random Ingredients: chili,red plum,beef steak fillet,tomato sauce,orange liqueur,doritos
title: Chile-Stuffed Beef Fillets
ingredients: 500 g beef steak fillets | 1 small chili, finely chopped ( optional ) | 2 cans crushed tomatoes with their juice | 2 small red plums, sliced into 1 inch chunks | 1/3 cup tomato sauce | 1 tablespoon orange-flavored liqueur ( optional )
instructions: Combine steak, chilli pepper, tomatoes and plum chunks in a heavy bottomed based saucepan. Cover. Boil over high heat about 2 to 3 minutes or until tender. Pour into serving bowls. Add tomato sauce, liqueur and crushed plum chunks. Spoon over steak mixture.

Random Ingredients: egg yolk,lemongrass,daikon radish,ginger garlic paste,tomato green chile pepper
title: Tom Yum Soup
ingredients: 3 fresh tomatoes and green chile peppers | 6 egg yolks | 1 lemon grass, minced | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 3 cups grated daikon radishes
instructions: Place tomatoes on a baking sheet and cook under broiler, or in a 350 degree f oven for about 7 minutes. When skin starts to peel back, scrape out and discard skin. Cut into small pieces and remove and discard seeds. Place tomato in a blender or food processor with green chilies, egg yolks, lemon grass and ginger to blender and blend until smooth. Return to pan and add grated daikon and tomato mixture.

title: Mexican Chocolate Bread
ingredients: 8 ounces chopped bittersweet baking chocolate | 2 1/2 cups baking chocolate, chopped | 1/2 cup canola oil | 1/2 cup prepared mustard ( i prefer dijon ) | 1/2 cup taco seasoning mix | 1/2 teaspoon crumbled saffron | 1 prepared baguette
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Line a 9x5 loaf pan with 2 loaf pans. Melt the chocolate and oil in a large saucepan over low heat, stirring frequently until smooth. Add mustard, taco seasoning, saffron, paprika, and bread to chocolate mixture and stir until bread crumbs have soaked up all the oil. Transfer mixture to prepared loaf pans and bake for approximately 60 minutes.

Random Ingredients: parsley leaf,green pepper,submarine bun,dark rum,thai red curry paste,pomegranate juice
title: Vietnamese Spicy Red Curry Beef Bananas
ingredients: 3/4 cup pomegranate juice | 3 tablespoons thai red curry paste | 1/2 cup dark rum | 2 -4 large sandwich buns, cut diagonally | 4 -6 green peppers, seeded and cut into thin strips | 2 -3 tablespoons thinly sliced fresh parsley leaves
instructions: To make the sauce, in a small bowl, combine 3/4 cup of pomegranate juice, chile paste, rum and the 1/8 cup of water. Stir to dissolve the sugar, then set aside for up to 3 hours. Keep warm. Heat grill to high. Brush grill plate with some of the reserved sauce. Arrange the sliced green peppers on the grill rack, grill them until they are golden brown.. To assemble, cut the sandwich buns diagonally, and place 1 piece on each of 4 warmed buns. Sprinkle with the sauce. Fold the other side of the buns over the sauce. Place a few slices of cooked beef on top of the sandwich. Spoon some remaining sauce over the top, then scatter over the pepper strips and parsley.

title: Grilled Beef and Eggplant
ingredients: 1/2 lb steak | 2 tablespoons steamed eggplants, chopped ( can use any other type of eggplant ) | salt and pepper
instructions: Cut steak lengthwise into 4 strips and then crosswise in thin strips, 3 to 4 inches long. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Grill over medium high heat about 5 minutes on each side, or till desired level of doneness is reached. Let steak stand for 2 minutes, then cut into strips about 2 inches long by 1 inch wide. Serve immediately. This is great with kraut and green beans with a good table cream sauce.

Random Ingredients: cider vinegar,mint,iceberg lettuce,enchilada sauce,brown sugar,apricot preserve,ice cube
title: Dynamite (Mint) Salad
ingredients: 4 cups sliced iceberg lettuce | 1/2 cup apricot preserves | 1/3 cup brown sugar | 1/4 cup chipotle-flavored vinegar | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon minced fresh mint | 1/2 cup enchilada sauce, such as pace
instructions: Mix all ingredients except enchilada sauce in a bowl. Refrigerate 1 hour or overnight. Drain off liquid.

Random Ingredients: almond,agave syrup,white wine vinegar,chili pepper flake,lime juice,lettuce leaf
title: Almond Chimichurri from Nigeria
ingredients: 7 ounces lettuce leaves, washed and dried | 1 tablespoon chopped sweet chili pepper flakes | 3 tablespoons blanched whole almonds | 2 tablespoons agave syrup | 1 tablespoon lime juice | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar
instructions: Combine everything together in a small bowl. Use to sandwich together any salad or meat.

title: Chile Verde
ingredients: 1 cup lychee, pure | ice
instructions: Pour lychee pure into a highball glass. Pour 3 mint leaves into the glass. Stir well. Pour 1 teaspoon of ice into the glass. Stir, stir, stir, stir, stir, stir, serve, repeat.

title: Algerian Barley and Aniseed Wheat
ingredients: 12 ounces whole wheat ( preferably bulgar ) | 1 1/2 cups pearl barley | 1 teaspoon anise seed
instructions: The best way to measure it is to check it on the inner rim of a measuring cup if it is a glass of wheat, if it is not, wait until it is, and then measure it if it is a glass of barley. When it is at the correct size, pack it in sterilized bottles. This will keep for years.

title: Golden Syrup
ingredients: 500 ml sultanas | 8 fresh thyme sprigs
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine sultanas, thyme, and 3 tablespoons water. Over low heat and simmer, stirring, for about 30 minutes, or until they start to burst and give off a nutty smell. If the syrup doesn't reach the desired consistency, continue to stir and continue to simmer until all the water is absorbed. Use to flavor meat and vegetables, crackers, fresh bread, biscuits, etc.

Random Ingredients: hot paprika,beet,potato,ra el hanout spice mix
title: Moroccan Shish Kebabs
ingredients: 1 lb beet ( about 2 large ones ) | 1/2 lb potato ( about 3/4 pound ) | 1/2 cup dry-roasted hot paprika | 1/2 ounce ras el hanout spice mix
instructions: Remove the beet root if you like or discard it. Peel the beet if desired. Cut the beet root into 1/4 inches pieces. Cut potatoes into 1/4 inch cubes. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Toss in the vegetable and spices. Let marinade at least 15 minutes before serving. If refrigerated and covered for up to 3 days. It will stay pretty good.

title: Lime Asparagus with Yukon Gold Potatoes and Garlic
ingredients: 3 pounds yukon gold potatoes, sliced into wedges | 3 tablespoons lime juice | 2 tablespoons shortening | 1 pound fresh asparagus spears, trimmed and cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces | 12 toothpicks
instructions: Place potatoes in a large pot and cover with salted water. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until tender, about 25 minutes. Drain and allow to steam dry for a minute or two. Melt the shortening and lime juice in a skillet over low heat, stirring constantly. Place asparagus into the skillet and cook just until tender, 2 to 3 minutes. Drain and let asparagus cool slightly. Spoon yukon gold potatoes onto a serving plate, top with lime butter, and garnish with toothpicks.

Random Ingredients: tomato puree,sherry wine vinegar,vanilla,english mustard,grape leaf
title: Italian Grape Leaves
ingredients: 1/2 cup grape leaves, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1/2 cup tomato puree | 2 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon english mustard
instructions: Combine all ingredients and leave in refrigerator. Note, you may substitute a vineger like apple cider for the sherry vinegar, but i normally omit it. Drain the grape leaves. Arrange on a serving plate and sprinkle with the spice mixture. Serve warm or cold.

title: Guacamole With Bouquet Garni
ingredients: 1 tablespoon corn oil | 2 tablespoons butter | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala | 1 teaspoon guacamole ( preferably aged sour )
instructions: Heat the oil in a frying pan on medium heat. Add the butter and when foaming but not brown, add the garam masala and stir. Add the guacamole. Cook for a few seconds until it is incorporated and starts to brown. Serve warm over fresh greens.

title: Hawaiian Bread Salad
ingredients: 6 cups bow tie pasta, or as needed | 1 can pineapple juice, or more as needed
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the bow tie pasta, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked all the way to the desired texture, but is still firm to the bite, about 11 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Rinse with cool water, drain any excess water, and toss with the pineapple juice. If the pasta has kept, transfer to a serving bowl, and toss the salad with the reserved hot water to coat.

title: Pesto Cheese & Corn Chips
ingredients: 1 poblano chiles ( or jalapeno chiles, seeded, deveined, finely chopped ) or 1 green chile ( or jalapeno chiles, seeded, deveined, finely chopped ) | 1/4 small ripe tomatoes ( or can use 1 medium chopped tomato ) | 2 tablespoons cornflour ( if in a pinch ground cumin may be needed ) | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 100 -150 g provolone cheese, cut into strips | topping ( optional )
instructions: Cut poblano pepper in half crossswise, remove seeds, and cut flesh into strips. Place in a bowl. Add tomato and cornflour, and mix well. Cut cheese strips into strips, and add to bowl. Spoon pesto into a small nonstick skillet, over medium high heat. When mixture just begins to pucker, turn heat down to medium. Spread pesto over top of cheese, and quickly sprinkle it with a bit of cheese. Keep adding pesto until pesto is absorbed into cheese. Continue to cook, stirring often, until cheese is melted and bubbly.

title: Potato French Fries
ingredients: 2 large russet potatoes | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/2 cup sliced green olives
instructions: Slice potatoes as thinly as possible. Place in lightly greased 13x9 inch baking dish. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Sprinkle with olive slices. Cover with plastic wrap. Microwave on high power 1 to 1 1/2 minutes or until potatoes are soft.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon granule,green pepper,artichoke heart,lasagna noodle,venison,chinese five spice powder
title: Venison Lasagna Rolls
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs ground venison | 1/4 cup green pepper, chopped | 1/8 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules | 9 lasagna noodles, cooked and drained | 2 cups canned artichoke hearts, drained and cut up
instructions: Drain meat well and brown with green pepper in 1 tb of the liquid. Add five spice powder and broth and simmer for 5 minutes. Put lasagna in a 9x13 pan, add 1/2 cup of meat mixture, then 1/2 of the artichokes, then the rest of the meat mixture, ending with the second 1/2 of the artichokes. Spoon the meat/Artichoke filling over the lasagna and top with remaining meat mixture. Bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes or until the meat mixture and top is golden.

title: Dill Pickle Salad (Zwt-8)
ingredients: 15 large dill pickles | 16 ounces cream of tartar | 4 fluid ounces extra-virgin olive oil or 4 fluid ounces sherry wine vinegar
instructions: Arrange pickles in wide, flat shallow dish. Add all other ingredients. Cover. Refrigerate 4 weeks.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,farfalle pasta,french onion,beef tenderloin steak,coriander seed,broccolini,salt pepper
title: Frozen Beef With Broccolini and Farfalle
ingredients: 1 tablespoon coriander seed, freshly crushed | 1 beef tenderloin steak, frozen | 350 g broccolini | 1/4 teaspoon salt and pepper | 10 ounces farfalle pasta | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 french onion, sliced
instructions: Toast the coriander seeds in a dry frying pan over medium heat for 8 - 10 mins, until fragrant. Remove them from the heat and set aside. To finish, slice the beef into thin strips across the grain. Toss with the coriander until coated in salt and pepper. To complete the dish, cook the broccolini according to the packet's instructions, leave them to just soften. Drain and reserve the liquid. Trim any thick stalks from the Broccolini stalks and cut into 1 inch lengths. Slice the fillet into thin strips. In a large saucepan of boiling water, cook the farfalle pasta according to the packet instructions. Drain and reserve the cooking water. In a frying pan, melt the oil over medium high heat, fry the onions for 3 - 4 mins, tossing the beef occasionally until cooked all the way through. Stir in the beef and simmer for 3 - 4 mins, adding a little of the cooking water if the beef begins to stick. Stir in the coriander seeds and reheat. To serve, spoon the farfalle pasta into bowls, top with the beef and vegetable mix and serve with green beans.

title: Cauliflower Fritters With Bread Crumbs
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, chopped, washed well
instructions: Separate the cauliflower and break into florets. Combine cauliflower in a large bowl with any liquid left on it. Add bread crumbs. Mix. Heat a non stick frying pan at medium heat and drop teaspoonfuls of the mixture into the pan. Press with a fork until golden brown, on a medium level. These fritters can also be frozen on the back of a greased cookie sheet.

title: Polish Sausage and Veggies
ingredients: 1 package polish sausage | 1 medium head of garlic | 1 package frozen mixed vegetables, thawed | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place sausage in a large disposable roasting pan. Sprinkle sausage with garlic, marjoram and dried vegetables. Place pan on a rack in the oven and allow to cook for 2 to 3 hours in the preheated oven. Do not drain vegetables. Uncover and cook until sausage is a dark rich brown.

Random Ingredients: vegetable broth,tomato ketchup,apricot,large shrimp,cilantro leaf,spinach leaf,mandarin orange zest
title: Spinach and Shrimp With Apricots
ingredients: 1/2 lb small green tomatoes, halved lengthwise | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro leaves, coarsely chopped | 1 teaspoon dried apricot, chopped ( from a 1- tblsp. can, drained ) | 1/2 lb spinach leaves, coarsely chopped ( about 2 cups, stemmed and coarsely chopped ) | 10 1/2 ounces vegetable broth, fat-free ( about 1 cup ) | 2 tablespoons tomato ketchup | 1 tablespoon kraft light classic classic honey-roasted honey-roasted jelly-packed sun-dried tomatoes
instructions: Line 2 rimmed baking sheets with foil.

title: Hot Noodles - Asian Style
ingredients: 375 g asparagus, cut into 1in thick diagonal slices | 1 teaspoon ground cloves | 400 g dry fettuccine pasta | 1 -2 tablespoon peanut oil | sweet chili oil
instructions: Bring a large pan of water to the boil and heat the oil. Deep fry the asparagus in batches for 3 to 5 mins, or until crisp tender, then remove and drain. Return the pan to the heat and cook the cloves for 1 minute, or until fragrant. Add the fettuccine to the boiling water. Cook, stirring until the pasta is al dente. Drain and return to the pan. Add the asparagus and toss together until most of the water has been absorbed, then toss together again. Serve straight away with sweet chilli oil, or refrigerate. Variation, for vegetarian use the vegetable oil.

Random Ingredients: wide egg noodle,swiss cheese,sesame oil,caramel topping,garlic clove,green bean,banana pepper
title: Czechoslovakian Banane
ingredients: 1 package wide egg noodles | 2 1/2 ounces carrots, sliced | 2 1/2 ounces swiss cheese, sliced | 1 can green beans, drained | 3 -4 cloves garlic cloves, sliced | 4 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 cup caramel topping
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions and rinse with cold water. Drain and set aside. Place carrots, swiss cheese, scallions and beans in a skillet, and drizzle with 2 tablespoons oil. Let cook about 10 minutes. Add garlic and cook until lightly browned, about 10 minutes. Add noodles and caramel topping and mix well. Serve hot or cold.

title: Blue Cheese-Tomatillo Salsa Recipe
ingredients: 2 lbs tomatillos, husked and rinsed | 2 tablespoons bacon grease | 2/3 cup apple cider vinegar | 1/3 cup soft blue cheese or 1/3 cup crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Turn down to a simmer and add tomatillos. Cook 6 minutes, stirring regularly, and then drain and cool. When cool, peel off all bones and any membrane from tomatillos. Cut tomatillos into 1/2-inch dice and set aside. Meanwhile, heat bacon grease in a 12 inch skillet over medium heat. Cook until almost browned, about 2 minutes. Remove bacon and reserve. Reduce heat and cook tomatillo mixture until most of the liquid has evaporated. Stir in vinegar, and simmer gently for 5 minutes. Sprinkle top with cheese and remove from heat. Transfer salsa to a serving bowl and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: rice vinegar,bratwurst,canola oil,yellow food coloring,cooking spray,italian seasoning,pistachio
title: Methi, Sausage, and Pistachios
ingredients: 1 lb raw bratwurst, cut into 2- to 3 x 1/4 inch pieces | cooking spray | 1 yellow food coloring, 1 drop ( optional ) | 1/4 cup raw pistachios, chopped | 2 teaspoons italian seasoning | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon canola oil, divided
instructions: Spray a large skillet with cooking spray. Cook sausage over medium high heat for 3 minutes or until crisp. Using a slotted spoon, move to paper towels to drain. Pour off all but 2 t. Of skillet fat and heat. Add nuts. Cook about 1 minute stirring often. Sprinkle pistachios over nuts and toss until coated. Arrange nut mixture on a plate while preparing remaining ingredients. Blend pestachios, italian seasoning, rice vinegar, and 2 t. Canola oil in a food processor until smooth. Slowly add pestachios mixture to batter and stir until well blended. Taste and add salt if necessary. Serve on a bed of lettuce.

title: Tortillas
ingredients: 12 tortillas | 4 tablespoons tomato paste, extra, blended | caster sugar, for dusting ( granulated ) | cherries, garnish ( optional )
instructions: Heat grill pan on medium/high.

title: Summer Squash With Cumin
ingredients: 2 medium summer squash, halved, seeded, and cut into 3/4-inch slices | 1 cup creme fraiche | 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin | 2 teaspoons pure vanilla extract
instructions: Combine squash slices and creme fraiche in a serving dish. Sprinkle cumin over squash, and stir in vanilla to taste.

title: Noble House Louchee
ingredients: 2 fresh lobster tails, sliced | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 2 tablespoons szechuan peppercorns, coarsely crushed | 1 teaspoon minced freshly grated fresh nutmeg | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce, or to taste
instructions: Preheat your broiler. Arrange the lobster tail slices on a plate or baking sheet. Sprinkle with the salt and sichuan peppercorns. Heat a skillet over medium heat, and fry the nutmeg until it just begins to release its aroma, about 30 seconds. Stir in the hot pepper sauce. Pour over the lobster pieces, and broil, turning once, until the lobster is golden brown on top, about 3 minutes. Spoon the nutmeg mixture into a mortar with a few spoons to serve.

title: Dublin Cabbage
ingredients: 1 small head of cabbage | 1 teaspoon ground mixed spice | worcestershire sauce | 1/2 cup irish whiskey ( or other liquor ) | 1/2 cup breadcrumbs
instructions: Remove outer leaves of cabbage and discard any brown outer leaves. Cover loosely with plastic wrap and let macerate over night. Cut cabbage into wedges. Sprinkle cabbage with spices and whiskey. Dredge in breadcrumbs to coat. Place on greased grill and cook about 7 to 10 minutes, turning once, until browned.

Random Ingredients: red food coloring,vegetable broth,duck breast,corn flake,guinness stout,vanilla extract
title: Guinness Duck Breasts
ingredients: 2 cups guinness stout | 32 ounces vegetable broth | 1/2 teaspoon red food coloring | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 4 duck breasts | corn flakes ( to garnish ) | dollop fresh cream ( to garnish ) | powdered sugar ( to garnish )
instructions: Combine the worcestershire sauce, vegetable broth, food coloring, and vanilla extract in a saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat to low, and simmer until sauce is reduced by half, about 15 - 20 minutes. Trim fat from duck breasts. Place chicken breasts in a baking dish, and cover with the sauce. Cover and marinate for 2 to 24 hours in the refrigerator. Preheat oven to 400°f. Remove the chicken breasts from the marinade, reserving marinade. Place chicken in a single layer in a baking dish. Bake for about 40 minutes, or until chicken is fork tender and juices run clear. Remove from oven, and let rest for 10 minutes. Remove and discard skin from chicken. Shake sauce and duck pan juices and bring to a boil, and pour over the chicken. Sprinkle with a little crushed cornflake flakes and serve over rice, if desired.

Random Ingredients: arborio rice,black peppercorn,red onion,pine nut,brown lentil,rigatoni pasta
title: Lentils and Rice a la Riggies
ingredients: 1/4 cup split black lentils | 10 black peppercorns, lightly crushed | 2 cups arborio rice | 1/4 cup pine nuts, toasted | 1 red onion, coarsely chopped | 1 package rigatoni pasta
instructions: Prepare risotto according to package instructions. Place the lentils and peppercorns in a saucepan, cover with enough water to cover the lentils, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes, or until tender. Meanwhile, toast pine nuts in a skillet over medium heat, stirring as necessary, about 2 minutes. Combine the pine nuts and red onion in a bowl with the rice and broken up lentils. Spoon the mixture into a large serving bowl, and stir in the pine nut mixture. Serve over hot rice.

title: Mushroom Margarita
ingredients: 1 1/2 ounces tequila | 8 oyster mushrooms | ice cube
instructions: Pour ingredients in a salt shaker over ice. Shake and strain into a margarita glass.

Random Ingredients: italian pork sausage,catsup,soy sauce,dark chocolate,thyme leaf,chipotle chile,anise seed
title: Chipotle-Sausage and Chocolate Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon catsup | 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 1 teaspoon ground anise seed | 1 teaspoon dried anise seeds | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 1 package hot italian pork sausage | 1 package dark chocolate or ( 250 g ) package milk chocolate
instructions: In a bowl, mix catsup, soy sauce, anise, anise seed, thyme and sausage. Add the chocolate and stir well. Let stand 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Transfer to a saucepan and keep warm over medium heat. Sauce can be kept warm over night.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,lamb meat,red curry paste,flat leaf parsley,dark sesame oil,hash brown,pork shoulder
title: Thai Red-Cooked Lamb and Pork
ingredients: 5 cups instant mashed potatoes ( not instant hash browns, found in oriental grocery stores ) | 1 beef bouillon cube or 1 beef base | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 16 ounces lean boneless lamb or 16 ounces boneless beef stew meat | 12 ounces pork shoulder, trimmed and cut into 1-inch dice | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 tablespoon chopped flat leaf parsley
instructions: In a large crock pot, combine the instant potatoes, beef bouillon, curry paste, lamb, and pork. Cook, on low heat, stirring frequently, for 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Add sesame oil, cover and keep on low heat for 1/2 to 1 hour more, stirring often. Sprinkle with parsley.

title: Johnd's Green Beans and Cheese in Caraway Seed Crust
ingredients: 3 -4 tablespoons margarine or 3 -4 tablespoons olive oil | 1 3/4 ounces prosciutto, minced | 4 ounces baby arugula beans or 4 ounces spinach beans | 4 ounces blue cheese, crumbled | 4 ounces marinated kidney beans ( rinsed and drained, or 1-1/2-1.5 cans pasta beans ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons thyme or 1 1/2 teaspoons oregano leaves | 1/4 teaspoon caraway seed, crushed | fresh fresh cilantro stem, to garnish ( optional )
instructions: Melt the margarine in a large fry pan over medium high heat. Add the proscuitto or bacon and cook until crisp. Add the beans, blue cheese and thyme or oregano. Drain and rinse the beans. Turn off the heat and stir in the caraway seeds. Transfer to a small casserole, drizzle over some of the cooking oil, and bake at 350 degrees for about 40 minutes, or until hot and bubbly.

title: Gentle Sauteed Napa Cabbage
ingredients: 1 lb napa cabbage, with a little leaves on it | 1 tablespoon seasoning salt | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder or 1/2 teaspoon green chile ( optional )
instructions: Cut the napa cabbage in thin slices about three inches long in size. In a skillet, add little oil or butter till the butter is just slightly brown so it doesn't stick while cooking. Add asafoetida and chilies to the napa cabbage in the skillet. Saute them till they become aromatic. Put some water and salt in the skillet and add napa cabbage, it shouldn't be much more than a couple of tablespoons. Cover and turn heat to medium low, let that simmer till your ggc leaves are tender and pliable.

title: Thai Chili Meat Paste
ingredients: 1 egg | 1 -2 teaspoon hot chili sauce ( sriracha or sriracha )
instructions: Crack egg into small bowl and beat slightly with a fork until it thickens up a bit. Add hot chili sauce and mix inches. Serve in a small container, but refrigerate until needed.

title: Spinach and Asparagus Salad
ingredients: 500 ml baby spinach leaves | 200 g asparagus, trimmed and halved lengthways | 150 g baby portabella mushrooms, sliced | 1 teaspoon caster sugar | 2 teaspoons fresh basil, shredded
instructions: Place the spinach, asparagus and mushrooms in a bowl. Whisk together the sugar, basil and vanilla in a large bowl, then drizzle over the dressing.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 fresh white mushroom | 0.5 package tart shells
instructions: Remove stems from mushrooms and cut off stems. Wash mushrooms well making sure they don't break open. Remove woody part and save in cavity. Fill shells with mushroom mixture. Add a dash of salt and pepper to taste. Steam for 7 - 8 minutes.

title: Mushroom, Broccoli and Pumpkin Soup With Tamarind Nuts
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tamarind paste | 2 cups diced firm tofu or 2 cups other firm textured vegetable protein | 1/4 cup chopped cashew nuts | 4 tablespoons chopped garlic | 2 -4 cups coarsely chopped pumpkin ( fresh or frozen ) | 2 cups chopped firm broccoli | 3/4 cup canned diced tomato with juice
instructions: In a shallow soup pot put the tamarind paste and 2 cups cold water. Steep for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, fry the cashew nuts in the tamarind water for 5 minutes, stirring continuously. Drain on paper towels. In a large saucepan, add the tofu, cashews, garlic, pumpkin and 2 cups cold water to cover, stir for 2–3 minutes. Add the remaining vegetables. Cover, turn on the heat to medium. Cook for 10 minutes or until the vegetables are soft and the water is almost evaporated. Stir in the tamarind water. Bring to boil, reduce the heat and simmer, stirring occasionally, for 20 more minutes. Serve hot.

title: Mujadarah
ingredients: 125 g brown lentils ( mujadarah ) | 200 g baked beans
instructions: Wash the lentils well and then soak them in water for 20 minutes. Bake them in the oven at 200°c/400°f/gas for 40 - 50 minutes. While the lentils are cooking, peel the baked beans and cut them into pieces roughly the size of the baked beans and put them in a saucepan. Add plenty of oil, mix well and cover it with water. Simmer for 1 hour. After an hour add 200 grams of cooked lentils and simmer for another 20 minutes. Then add the baked beans and cook for a further 10 - 15 minutes. Variation, instead of baked beans, use a small, flat shaped tin, like a tinware tin, with an opening about ¼ cm thick. If you want to use baked beans with a lot of water, instead of the baked beans, use a baking beans that are already prepared in salted water, bake for 40 - 50 minutes at 350°f/gas add salt to taste before baking.

title: The Best Green Salad!
ingredients: 2 baking potatoes, peeled and cubed | 4 heads curly endive lettuce, washed and dried | 1 head curly bibb lettuce, washed and torn into bite size pieces
instructions: Boil potatoes until tender. Drain and cool. Place the potatoes in a large salad bowl. Add the curly endive and bibb lettuce. Toss gently and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chili sauce,turmeric powder,icing sugar,salt black pepper
title: Chilli Sauce for Pasta Chips
ingredients: 1/2 cup icing sugar | 1 dash chili sauce | 1 dash turmeric powder | 1 dash salt & freshly ground black pepper ( optional )
