instructions: Combine the icing sugar, chilli, and turmeric in a bowl. Add seasoning. To serve, place the chips in an oven safe dish or on a serving plate. Pour the chili sauce over. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: arborio rice,cooking oil,pineapple preserve,canadian bacon,marinara sauce,lemon,lemon peel
title: Lemon Risotto With Canadian Bacon
ingredients: 6 slices bacon, cut into 1/2 inch wide strips | 2 cups arborio rice or 2 cups small carnaroli rice | 3 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 can pineapple preserves | 1/2 lemon, juice of | 1 slice lemon peel | marinara sauce, for serving
instructions: Cook bacon in a 5 qt pot over medium heat until crispy, 5 - 10 minutes, remove bacon and slice into strips. Heat oil in the pot until just smoking add rice and stir to coat rice in fat, then pour in pineapple preserves while stirring. When preserves start bubbling add lemon peel and stir. Reduce heat to low and cover. Cook for 17 - 40 minutes.

title: Pepperoni Ramen (Oriental Version)
ingredients: 3 packages ramen noodles ( oriental version ) | 1 package pepperoni, sliced ( o'brien )
instructions: Soak ramen noodles in warm water for 3 - 5 minutes, to plump them up a bit. Remove and set aside. Break up the pepperoni into pieces. Bring water to boil and cook pepperoni until it looks like it is just about to soften, about 2 minutes. Drain pepperoni.

title: Ginger Bell Peppers
ingredients: 4 yellow bell peppers | 1 piece gingerroot, peeled | 1 -3 tablespoon powdered gingerroot
instructions: Slit a slit down one side of each bell pepper. Place the peppers in a roasting pan that's been sprinkled with ginger root. Sprinkle the ginger on top of the peppers. Cook in a 350ºf oven for 30 - 40 minutes. After 30 minutes, cut bell peppers into strips or wedges and serve.

Random Ingredients: coffee,rye bread,pea,red cherry,tabasco brand chipotle pepper sauce,hot water
title: Smokies (Quick Bread & Vegetable Soup)
ingredients: 1 cup sliced dried red cherries | 1/2 cup sliced hot water ( or 1/2 cup water ) | 2 cups rye bread, crust trimmed and cut into small cubes | 1/4 cup frozen peas ( or fresh peas ) | 1/2 cup low-fat coffee ( optional ) | red hot pepper sauce, to taste ( tabasco brand is preferred )
instructions: In a medium size bowl, stir together cherries and hot water. Let sit 15 minutes. Toast rye bread cubes until golden brown slightly. Stir bread cubes into soup. Add peas. Add sugar to taste.. Serve with red hot pepper sauce and hot sauce. Yummy.

title: Grilled Swiss Spread
ingredients: 1 lb swiss cheese, grated, divided | 1/4 teaspoon ground lemon rind | 1/8 cup coffee | 1 fresh green hot chili pepper, halved, seeded
instructions: Combine 1/2 cup cheese, lemon rind, coffee and green chile in large bowl. Mix well. Spread in lightly oiled shallow baking dish. Place other half cup cheese on top of cheese and spread with coffee mixture. Grill about 8 - 10 minutes on each side or until desired level of heat is achieved.

title: Subru Uncle's Delicious Kheer (Dumplings in Indian)
ingredients: 500 g urad dal, washed, soaked in water for 1 hour, and drained | 10 -12 cups whole milk
instructions: Make small dumplings out of each piece of lentils/dal. Boil the dal with 1 cup of water till the lentils are slightly browned and tender. Drain the water completely and transfer it to an electric pressure cooker, add 2 cups of cold water and pressure cook for 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: creamy peanut butter,pasta choice,equal sugar substitute,beet,chocolate chip,sun tomato oil,vegetable stock
title: Simple Peanut Butter, Beet & Chocolate  Pasta
ingredients: 300 g beets ( peeled and cut into quarters ) | 400 ml vegetable stock ( or water ) | 200 g chocolate chips | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil ( drained & chopped ) | 1 tablespoon creamy peanut butter | 1 1/4 tablespoons equal sugar substitute | 300 ml creamy peanut butter, thick | 300 g pasta of your choice ( see note )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large saucepan & cook over a low heat, stirring frequently, for 15 minutes. Taste & add more if necessary. Heat for a further 2 - 3 minutes & pour over your chosen pasta. Notes, if you can get your beets & chocolate not beets, cut them in half & cook with a little water until tender, remove from heat & cover. Leave to cool for 2 hours. Use a sharp knife. The flavour will develop. When cool, stir with a large spoon. Pour into a heat proof container, cover & refrigerate for at least 3 hours before serving, then serve. Note, if you can't find creamy peanut butter then you can use goat cheese, feta cheese or parmesan cheese in place of the peanut butter. Note, i have tried doing this with other nut combinations & i have liked the flavour of goats cheese. I have tried using other flavoured cheeses, such as parmesan, & cream cheese. The taste was good too.

title: Indian Muffins
ingredients: 4 cups flour or 4 cups bread flour | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Preheat oven to 400.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,buttermilk,red cabbage,flour tortilla,red chili pepper,celery rib,green salad,green chilies
title: Beef and Cabbage Tostadas
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat or 1 1/2 lbs boneless pork stew meat, cut into 1 - 1 1/2 cubes | 3/4 lb red cabbage, shredded | 1 medium green chilies, roasted and chopped or 1 medium green bell pepper, seeded and chopped | 1 can diced green chilies, drained | 3/4 teaspoon crushed red chili pepper | 1 tablespoon flour | 1 1/2 cups cold buttermilk | 6 -8 corn or 6 -8 whole wheat flour tortillas
instructions: Combine beef, cabbage, green chiles, peppers, flour and buttermilk in mixing bowl.

Random Ingredients: amaretto,pistachio,brown sugar,cream chicken soup,egg white,parmigiano reggiano cheese,ketjap manis,broccoli
title: Spicy Frittata
ingredients: 3 -4 large egg whites | 2 3/4 cups light cream of chicken soup | 1/4 cup ketchup or 1/4 cup other spicy hot sauce | 3 tablespoons amaretto ( almond or coconut flavored liqueur ) | 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 24 ounces frozen chopped broccoli, unpeeled ( optional ) | 1 cup shredded parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/4 cup finely chopped unsalted shelled pistachios
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Grease the 13x9 in casserole dish. Spray with oil. Using a hand mixer, beat the egg whites on high speed, scraping down the bowl as needed. As they become stiff, start slowly adding the cream of soup. Beat until egg is very thick and glossy, about 5 minutes. Turn and whip the egg whites into the soup mixture. Stir in the amaretto and cook another 2 minutes. Pour into prepared pan and coat top with parmigiano. Bake until golden brown and the top turns slightly crispy, about 25 minutes. Let cool for about 5 minutes, remove from pan and serve with pistachios and/or green onion if desired.

title: Spicy Baked Beans Sprout Filling for Pork
ingredients: 2 cans bean sprouts, drained but not very well-rinsed | 1 tablespoon chili oil
instructions: Melt the chili oil in a large skillet over medium heat.

title: Roasted Corn Niblets & Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried thyme | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 5 cups corn niblets, drained | 2 sweet cherry tomatoes, halved
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Combine thyme, rosemary, cayenne, corn niblets and tomatoes. Spread mixture evenly in the bottom of an oven proof pan. Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until heated through.

Random Ingredients: curry paste,irish whiskey,dark sesame oil,port wine
title: Spicy Bombay Sapphire
ingredients: 1/4 cup dark sesame oil | 4 vietnamese whiskey | 2 tablespoons curry paste | 2 tablespoons port wine
instructions: Shake contents of container with water. Stir in rest of the ingredients. Serve right away.

title: Grilled Chile-Chile Bread
ingredients: 8 vanilla wafers | 12 serrano chilies | 3 cups bread | 1/2 cup sugar
instructions: Wrap the serrano chiles in foil and cook them in a microwave for 45 seconds on high. Take them out and cut them in half. Wrap the foil in two pieces of aluminum foil. Put them in a bowl, pour the water and sugar mixture over them and let them sweat for 30 minutes. Toast the bread, cool and slice them about 1/4 thick. Spread out the sliced wafers in a large bowl, place 3 slices of bread on them and sprinkle with half the serrano chiles. Put a whole chile on top of the bread and wrap each piece of bread in a log. Refrigerate for about 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: natural peanut butter,cardamom pod,nutritional yeast,poultry seasoning,red pepper,nutmeg,sirloin tip roast,salmon
title: Beef Jerky in a Snap
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin tip roast | 1/2 cup natural-style peanut butter | 1/4 cup nutritional yeast | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 4 -5 teaspoons poultry seasoning | 2 teaspoons crushed red peppers | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Slice roast thickly across grain into thin strips. Combine peanut butter, nutritional yeast, cardamom, poultry seasoning, red pepper, nutmeg and mix well. Add meat and stir until well coated. Cover and refrigerate for 12 to 24 hours. Drain meat, reserving marinade for basting. Thread meat strips onto skewers. Pour reserved marinade into a small saucepan & bring to a low boil, stirring occasionally. Boil briskly for 5 minutes. Remove meat from marinade and reserve. Preheat grill. Baste meat with reserved marinade. Grill meat, brushing with reserved marinade, 6 to 8 minutes, brushing occasionally with reserved marinade.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,cranberry,sun tomato oil,butterscotch chip,cardamom powder
title: Butter & Nuts St. Patricks Day Nuts
ingredients: 1 package dry stir fry mixed nuts ( such as nutmeats, peperrots, dried cranberries, dried apricots, candy apples ) | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon dried cranberries | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom powder ( optional ) | 2 pinches salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste | 3 tablespoons melted butterscotch chips
instructions: In a large bowl, mix well.

Random Ingredients: green chili,amaretto,shrimp,corn oil vegetable,tea,tamari,brown lentil,dill pickle
title: Rajmama (Lentils With Spiced Shrimp)
ingredients: 3/4 cup yellow split peas or 3/4 cup brown lentils | 1/2 lb medium shrimp, peeled and deveined | 4 tablespoons corn oil or 4 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons tamari | 1 green chili, slit lengthwise | 2 tablespoons amaretto or 2 tablespoons dark beer | 1/2 tablespoon dried dill pickle, minced | 1 sprig fresh dill pickle, with leaves ( optional )
instructions: Cook split peas over medium heat, stirring often, until light brown, about 6 minutes. Stir in shrimp and cook until shrimp is pink and opaque throughout. Drain shrimp on a fine mesh sieve set over a bowl and set aside. Place tamari in a small, heavy based saucepan and bring to a boil. Boil for a minute or two, then stir in green chile.

title: Apple Asparagus & Egg (Pan Omelette)
ingredients: 2 teaspoons extra-large egg ( or substitute equivalent egg ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons apple juice ( not apple cider ) | 2 -3 tablespoons fresh asparagus, fresh
instructions: Put a small non stick frying pan on the hob and warm it up. Crack open egg into a bowl or plate. Heat up the pan over a high heat and quickly pour in egg. Using a fork or small spoon, poke holes all over the top of the egg to allow it to set. As soon as the egg is set, fold the asparagus through it so as to get an even distribution throughout the omelette. Cook both sides until lightly browned, about 30 seconds. Remove from pan onto a plate.

title: Peanut-Oat-Topped Spiral Sandwich
ingredients: 2 slices bread | 1/2 cup oatmeal ( not instant ) | 2 teaspoons peanut oil | 1 tablespoon all-purpose white flour | 100 g baby spinach | 100 g mixed crunchy snacks | 100 g coarsely ground bread
instructions: Pre heat the oven to 200c/400f/gas lightly grease a shallow 19cm x 29cm slab tin with peanut butter or olive oil. Place the toast on a board. Using the steel blade of a food processor, mix oatmeal, flour, spinach, and bread until the mixture resembles fine breadcrumbs. Spread mixture evenly on the bread and using the back of a spoon, lightly press into place. Cut into 16 - 20 slices. Turn the slices over when lightly pressed and leave to stand uncovered over a plate for 30 minutes before slicing. Serve warm.

title: Lamb Shank in Pimento
ingredients: 2 tablespoons garlic paste | 600 g lamb shanks | 8 pimentos, to taste
instructions: Place garlic paste and lamb shanks in a large ovenproof casserole dish. Spread the pimentos over the top. Mix together with enough water to just cover the shank. Cover and cook in the oven for 2 hours or until the lamb is tender. Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,garlic salt,mace,olive oil,beef bouillon,golden mushroom soup,feta cheese
title: Quick and Easy Stove-Top Dip
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground beef round | 4 fluid ounces beef bouillon, canned and undiluted | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 3 tablespoons finely chopped feta cheese | 1 tablespoon finely chopped sharp cheddar cheese | 1/2 teaspoon crushed garlic salt | 1/4 teaspoon dried mace
instructions: In a skillet over medium high heat, cook the beef until browned. Drain off fat. Stir in all remaining ingredients. Cook until warmed through. Transfer mixture to baking dish. Let cool before serving.

title: Cashew Nut Pudding
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1 large onion, chopped | 1/3 cup roasted cashew nuts | 1 liter vegetable stock
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c, 350°f or gas mark mix together cornflour and onion in a bowl,. Place cashew nuts in a blender, and process until they are finely ground. Add cornflour mixture to onion, cashew nuts and stock and mix thoroughly. Pour into ovenproof bowls and bake for 20 minutes. Serve warm or cold with ice cream and whipped cream.

title: Simple Black Beans
ingredients: 1 cup black beans | 1 teaspoon cajun seasoning
instructions: Soak beans for at least 5 hours in cool water, or overnight. Drain, and rinse beans under cool water until water runs clear. Heat a large skillet over medium low heat. Cook and stir black beans in the hot skillet until fragrant and lightly browned, about 20 minutes.

title: Indian Chutney
ingredients: 1 jar mango chutney | 1 stalk celery, chopped
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine chutney and celery. Cover and store in refrigerator until serving.

Random Ingredients: greek yogurt,rom tomato,apricot jam,currant,chuck,lamb,coconut cream,chicken breast fillet
title: Coconut-Sultana Burgers
ingredients: 400 g ground chuck | 1/4 cup plain greek yogurt | 1/2 cup low-fat sour cream | 1/4 teaspoon apricot jam | 2 ripe medium chicken breast fillets | 2 tablespoons dried currants ( or raisins ) | 1 teaspoon grated fresh roma tomato | 2 tablespoons desiccated coconut, toasted
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl. Season and mix well. Form mixture into 8 well coated burgers. Place in prepared grill pan. Grill over medium heat for 5 minutes or until cooked to your liking. Serve with sauce if so desired.

Random Ingredients: italian seasoning,mustard oil,cider vinegar,extra virgin olive oil,raisin
title: Soused Italian Charred Raisin Salad Dressing
ingredients: 2 lbs raisins ( about 17 ounces ) | 10 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 1/2 cup mustard oil | 1 teaspoon dried italian seasoning
instructions: Place all of the ingredients into a large, heavy duty screw top jar and shake vigorously. To keep the dressing airtight, store the jar in the refrigerator. In a large bowl, stir together the cooled raisins. Pour dressing over the raisins.

title: Saffron Pork
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pork tenderloin roast | 1/2 teaspoon saffron
instructions: Cut pork into 1 1/2 inch slices, sprinkle with saffron and tie with kitchen twine. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Heat an ovenproof skillet with a rack in the lower third of the oven until it is hot. Add the pork and brown well on all sides and discard the juices. Place the skillet in the lower third of the oven and bake 45 minutes, or until a meat thermometer registers 175 degrees. Let stand 10 minutes. Transfer the pork to a dish, discard the twine and serve.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,cauliflower,heavy cream,tart apple,olive oil cooking spray
title: Warm Cauliflower and Apple Salad
ingredients: 1 cauliflower, medium head ( fresh or frozen ) | 1 small tart apple | olive oil flavored cooking spray | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350º. Remove and discard stalk from cauliflower and cauliflower. Core and chop apple into 1 pieces. Place cauliflower and apple pieces in lightly oiled baking dish.

Random Ingredients: cod,white fish fillet,scotch,kiwi fruit,chicken wing,red cabbage,salmon fillet,red wine
title: Wonderful and Easy Fish and Kiwi Salad
ingredients: 2 scotch, thick and light green | 2 slices white fish fillets | 2 kiwi fruits, thick and light green | 1 teaspoon red wine ( i just add a splash of red wine to the mix ) | 1 red cabbage, cut into large wedges | 125 g smoked salmon fillet ( cut into strips ) | 125 g canned salmon in syrup ( i cut this into quarters as i took my first party mix ) | 300 g cooked cod, cubed ( can use salmon roe if you like, just not drained )
instructions: Mix the scotch, fish, kiwifruit and wine together in a bowl. Taste and add more wine if it's looking too sour. It should be enough to moisten the kiwifruit and fish, but not too mushy. Spoon over the fish and garnish with the cabbage and red roe. I served this as a main course with lots of crusty bread to dip in the warm atmosphere.

title: Fancy Mexican Grilled Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 lb medium shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1/2 lb turkey, whole turkey, cut into 3/4 inch chunks | 1 medium onion, sliced into 1/4 inch slices | 3/4 cup frozen green chilies, thawed, drained, and lightly mashed | 1/2 cup fresh liquid honey | 1/2 teaspoon liquid dry onion juice
instructions: In a shallow glass baking dish or dish, combine the shrimp, turkey, onion, green chiles, honey, liquid honey, and onion juice.

title: Spanish Picante Beef Ribs
ingredients: 5 lbs veal, rib | 1 cup picante sauce | 1 cup dry white wine | 4 lbs beef ribs | 1/4 cup white wine
instructions: Soak veal ribs in water for 3 days. After the third day, rinse and pat dry. In crock pot, combine picante sauce, white wine and beef ribs. Place on high and leave on low for 1 - 2 hours. Do not stir this is what the original recipe had but i do the final step. When ready, heat oven to 450 degrees. With a long handled fork, poke holes all over beef ribs, and poke in 1/2 to 1/2 cuts with knife as if sewing a kitchen string, being careful not to puncture membrane. Place ribs in oven and bake for about 2 hours. About 45 minutes before the ribs are done, in a separate pan, stir 1/4 cup white wine into dry remaining wine. Boil until reduced to 1 1/2 cups. About 1/2 hour before the ribs are done, add 1/4 cup of white wine to pan mixture, stir and cook for about 10 minutes or until mixture is thick. Put ribs in individual oven proof crocks. Pour sauce over and cook at 450 for 20 - 30 minutes or until ribs are cooked through.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,celery seed,lime wedge,graham cracker crumb,bailey irish cream,iceberg lettuce,tamarind pulp
title: Baileys Caramelized Caramelized Lettuce
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons sesame oil | 3 1/2 cups shredded iceberg lettuce | 1 large pinch celery seed | 2 tablespoons graham cracker crumbs | 1 tablespoon shredded lime wedge | 1 1/2 tablespoons baileys irish cream | 1 package frozen tamarind pulp, thawed
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a large wok or skillet over medium high heat. Toss in lettuce, celery seed, graham cracker crumbs, lime wedge, and baileys. Mix to coat. Immediately stir in tamarind pulp and continue cooking until heated through and mixture starts to caramelize, 2 to 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: apple,tomato,okra,vegetable,tart apple,milk,kosher salt black pepper,orange juice
title: Caribbean Okra Stew (Sweetened Vegetables)
ingredients: 1 lb sweet potato | 1 medium tart apple ( about 1/2-2 cups ) | 1 1/2 cups chopped domestic okra ( about 2 cups ) | 2 large carrots, diced ( about 1-1/3 cups ) | 1 can diced tomatoes | 1 can mixed vegetables | 1 1/2 cups orange juice | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Cut the sweet potato in half lengthwise then crosswise into 1/4 inch thick slices. Quarter and core the apple & cut into 1/4 inch thick slices. Trim and quarter the okra. Cut the carrots & tomatoes into 1/4 inch pieces or bite size cubes if using.

title: Meatballs in Creamy Vegan Sauce
ingredients: 500 g minced meat | 4 -5 vegetable stock cubes | 1 vanilla bean ( optional for me ) | 1 tablespoon cream of tartar
instructions: Start out by mashing your vanilla bean down the sides of the bean a little. Add this to the ground meat and stir. Add a touch more salt, pepper, or any other type of spice you like. Keep breaking up any clumps with the spoon as you go. Place this mixture into a bowl. Add the cream of tartar and stir. Add a few shakes of table salt. Enjoy as your starter.

title: El Leche
ingredients: 1 can condensed tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 1/2 cup dark rum
instructions: Poke holes all over the surface of the chilies, and place chilies on the griddle. Cook over medium heat with the lid slightly ajar, or slightly ajar until the skin is browned about 5 minutes. Be careful, as they can easily burn easily. Pour the dark rum over the chilies and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: iceberg lettuce,cardamom pod,italian herb seasoning,romaine lettuce,chili sauce
title: Spicy Broiled Romaine Lettuce on Spicy Dressing
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce | 1 bag italian herb seasoned seasoning ( or 2 tbsp dried italian herbs ) | 2 packets chili style hot sauce ( i had purchased ours at whole foods market's chili sauce mix ) | 2 cardamom pods | iceberg lettuce
instructions: Place romaine into ice water until water is icy. Remove and dry on paper towels. Reserve the rest of the dressing. Rinse romaine well, pulling away some of the white tough ribs and torn leaves so you can use the rest when you do. Trim any thin leaves or damaged lettuce to create a nice effect. Place romaine back into the ice water, drained of salt and rinse to stop grits. Drain again and dry on paper towels. Prepare the spicy hot sauce by mixing all of the listed ingredients in a small bowl. Refrigerate until dinner is ready to serve with salad, if making ahead. Dip lettuce into sauce to cover. Arrange on a serving platter.

title: Creole Pimiento
ingredients: 3/4 cup white sugar | 1 jar pimientos, drained | 2 tablespoons italian seasoning ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Spread pimento in an oven safe dish. Bake in the preheated oven until the pimientos become soft and golden brown, about 15 minutes. Sprinkle sugar over the pimientos, and return to the oven. Cook, uncovered, until browned, about 5 minutes, stirring frequently. Mix in the italian seasoning, if desired.

Random Ingredients: bamboo shoot,chicken breast meat,mung bean noodle
title: Chicken Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 package mung bean noodles | 2 cups cooked chicken breast meat, chopped | 3/4 can bamboo shoots, drained and sliced diagonally into thin rings
instructions: Place noodles in a large bowl with hot water.

title: Zucchini Au Gratin (Zucchini W-Cheese) With Bay Leaf
ingredients: 3 zucchini | 1/2 cup cold water | 1 1/2 cups gruyere cheese or 1 1/2 cups cheddar cheese, grated | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Slice zucchini into ¼” lengths lengthwise. Heat water in large pan over medium heat. Add zucchini and 2 tbsp cheese. Cook uncovered about 30 minutes or until zucchini is tender but firm.. Add bay leaf and remove bay leaf. To serve, put zucchini w/cheese on platter and pour sauce over w/a large dollop of cream.

title: Pico de Gallo with Water (Papaya)
ingredients: 1 cup water | 1 cup pico de gallo
instructions: Mix water, pico de gallo and salsa together in a glass serving dish. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 1 hour.

title: Artichoke Swiss Bread
ingredients: 1/2 lb swiss cheese, grated | 8 ounces canned artichoke hearts, drained and finely chopped | 2 -3 teaspoons milk | 2 -3 teaspoons anise seed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. In a medium bowl, mix cheese, artichokes, milk, and anise seeds. Shape the mixture into a loaf. Sprinkle each slice with slices of swiss cheese. Cook in the oven for 10 - 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: mint leaf,turkey sausage,maraschino cherry,beef bouillon cube,mango,cherry,liquid smoke flavoring
title: Mango Sausage and Cherry Meatball Soup
ingredients: 1/4 - 1/3 cup fresh mint leaves | 4 teaspoons liquid smoke flavoring | 1/2 teaspoon beef bouillon cube | 5 ripe mangoes, peeled and chopped | 6 mint leaves | 1 can sweetened cherries, with juice | 2 slices turkey sausage | 1 jar maraschino cherries, drained
instructions: Prepare meatballs and store in the freezer for later use. Place all ingredients, except the maraschino cherries, in a blender and puree until smooth. Add some of the reserved maraschino cherries to the mixture. Pour mixture into a large soup bowl. Sprinkle with remaining cherries.

title: Grilled Chicken Skewers With Choclo Chilli Cream Raita (Chocolate Based!)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ground mixed spice | 500 g firm ripe firm ripe chocolate | 4 cups chicken stock | 1 1/4 cups thick caramel topping | 1 jar salted anchovies packed in oil, drained if necessary, chopped | 6 -10 artichoke hearts, halved lengthways
instructions: Combine the ground mixed spice, chocolate, stock, caramel topping and anchovies in a large saucepan over low low heat and simmer, uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the chocolate is melted and the mixture just comes to a boil. Increase the heat to low, carefully pour the mixture into a large flat dish. Place a wooden skewer through the centre of each piece of chicken and push the chocolate mixture through with your hands to leave a circle of chocolate inside. Leave to cool completely. Refrigerate for up to 2 hours to let the chocolate set. Just before serving, remove the skewers from the mixture and cut each skewer into slices.

title: Quick 'n' Easy Tampico Soup
ingredients: 4 beef tamales, cut into thin slices | 1 can stewed tomatoes, drained and chopped | 1 can tomato paste | 3 cups vegetable stock | 1 large beet or 1 large kale leaf, washed and chopped into bite size pieces | 1 teaspoon nutmeg | 1 teaspoon chili powder
instructions: Combine the tomatoes, tomato paste, stock, beet or kale, nutmeg and chili powder in a saucepan and bring to boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat and simmer about 1 hour until the soup thickens and the beet is tender.

Random Ingredients: chili flake,hash brown,plain nonfat yogurt,russet potato,bean sprout,broth,green onion
title: Potato, Vegetable & Tvp Salad
ingredients: 1 russet potato, peeled and sliced | 1 tablespoon low-sodium instant chili flakes, crushed | 2 green onions, white part only, chopped | 2 cups broth, your choice of sodium reduced sodium and fat free | 4 cups hash browns, fresh or frozen | 1 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1/2 cup bean sprouts
instructions: Place potato in a saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to low.

title: Broccoli Vodka Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb chicken, cut into pieces | 1 cup frozen broccoli florets | 1/2 cup vodka | 1 pint double cream
instructions: Heat broiler. Put chicken pieces on broiler rack. Brush with vodka, set aflame, close and broil for 20 - 30 mins or until done. Top with cream and broil for a few mins. To make sauce melt butter.

title: Fantastic Seasoning for Lamb, Chicken and Beef Fajitas
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons groux | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 teaspoon dried sage
instructions: In a small bowl, sprinkle the groux with oregano, sage and black pepper and mix well. Rub the meat with the seasoning mixture. Let stand for 20 minutes before cooking. Grill as desired for even cooking.

instructions: Cook ziti according to pkg directions. Drain and run under cold water till cool enough to handle. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in skillet until hot. Transfer the beef to a large serving platter. Wipe the skillet clean with a paper towel. Heat the same oil in the skillet. Coat the tortillas with the sesame paste and fry till crisp and brown on both sides, about 3 or 4 minutes per side, transferring to a platter and garnish with mint.

title: Fiery Beef Stir-Fry over Brown Bag-Free

instructions: Heat a large nonstick nonstick skillet over medium high heat. When it is slightly hot, add the sesame oil. Add the steak, mushrooms, peppers, and 1/2 cup water.

Random Ingredients: bacon dripping,eggplant,gouda cheese,pecan half,red bell pepper,steak,chinese cabbage
title: Chinese Chicken Cabbage and Eggplant Rollups
ingredients: 4 slices bacon drippings | 2 large eggplants | 1 large red bell pepper | 1 package frozen chopped chinese cabbage, thawed | 1/2 cup shredded aged gouda cheese | 5 ounces thinly sliced crosshatch center-cut flank steak | 1/4 cup pecan halves, toasted
instructions: On a large skillet cook bacon until crisp. Remove bacon from skillet on paper towels. Slice crosswise into small pieces. Place eggplant slices in bowl of ice cold water.

title: Tomato Kebabs
ingredients: 1 kg cherry tomatoes | 1 beef bouillon cube | 3 tablespoons oil or 3 tablespoons ghee butter | 75 -80 kalamata olives
instructions: Place the cherry tomatoes in a glass bowl. Add the stock cube and rub them together. Leave in the fridge for at least 1 hour. Slice the olives in half and thread onto skewers. Preheat the grill and add 1/3 cup olive oil and 1/2 teaspoon of salt. Grill to taste. Serve with a sprinkling of parsley and some lemon wedges if desired.

Random Ingredients: vegetable broth,button mushroom,english cucumber,thai fish sauce,ranch dressing mix
title: Grilled Mushrooms & Cucumbers
ingredients: 1 english cucumber | 1 tablespoon thai fish sauce | 3 tablespoons vegetable broth or 3 tablespoons water | 1 teaspoon ranch dressing mix | 8 -10 button mushrooms ( depending on size )
instructions: Chop up all of the mushrooms or cut into quarters. Trim the stems off the cucumber. Cut in half lengthwise. Place on a foil lined grill. Top with the chopped up mushrooms. Add vinaigrette mix. Close the grill lid. Baste occasionally with vinaigrette mixture till done.. Cut into wedges.

title: Grilled Halibut with Mexican Salsa

instructions: Rinse halibut fillets.

title: Easy Bourbon Shrimp Soup
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef roast | 1 jar bourbon | 4 tablespoons chopped purple onion | 3 shallots, chopped | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro leaves | seasoning salt | 10 ounces shrimp paste | 6 ounces white flour
instructions: Slice roast into 1/4 inch pieces. Mix all ingredients, except flour, and pour into soup pot. Cover and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 2 hours or until meat is tender. Transfer shrimps to food processor, reserving juice and meat. Thicken broth with flour.

Random Ingredients: snow pea,chipotle chile adobo,napa cabbage,chili oil
title: Chipotle Noodles
ingredients: 1 large napa cabbage, about the equivalent weight of shredded cabbage, about 18 ounces total | 1 ounce dried chipotle chile in adobo, chopped, about 2 tablespoons | 1/2 cup snow peas, rinsed | 1 -2 teaspoon chili oil
instructions: In a mixing bowl, mix the snipped cabbage and the chiles and set aside. Cook the snow peas in 2 tablespoons water in a covered pan until tender crisp. Drain and set aside. Add the oil to the noodles and toss until noodles are coated with oil. Add the noodles to the cabbage and toss well. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: ice cube,flour tortilla,doritos,lemon wedge,parmesan cheese,pork shoulder,potato,sage leaf
title: Lemon and Pear Potato Burritos
ingredients: 2 pounds potatoes, peeled | 1 pound pork shoulder | 1 bunch fresh sage leaves | 1 quart ice cubes, divided | 1 1/2 cups shredded parmesan cheese, divided | 1 package frozen chopped frozen ranchero-style onions | 3 cans doritos, divided | lemon wedges ( optional )
instructions: Place the potatoes into a large pot and cover with salted water.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,stewing beef,butter,french bean,single cream,bulk sausage,chicken bouillon,hot chicken broth
title: Sausage Casserole
ingredients: 8 ounces bulk sausage | 1 1/2 lbs stewing beef, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1/4 cup instant chicken bouillon | 2 tablespoons french beans, chopped ( dried ) | 1/2 cup boiling hot fat free chicken broth | 16 fluid ounces single cream | 6 fluid ounces single cream | 3 tablespoons wheat flour | 2 tablespoons butter
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f degrees. Grease a 9x9 inch dish. In a large deep skillet, cook sausage on medium heat about 5 minutes, stirring to break up sausage. Add beef and cook, stirring often, about 5 minutes or until beef is browned. Dissolve bouillon in hot broth. Add to beef mixture and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer 2 hours. Remove from heat, and set aside. In bowl, cream cream together the cream and flour, and fold into meat mixture. Spoon mixture into casserole dish, cover with foil, and bake for 45 minutes, stirring about every 10 minutes. Remove foil, and bake for 15 minutes more. To serve, place pan and sausage stew in a baking dish, and bake 5 to 10 minutes more. Serve with potatoes and hot buttered noodles.

title: Spanish Orzo
ingredients: 10 ounces uncooked rice noodles, broken into 3 inch pieces | 1 spanish onion | spanish spanish spiced onion, for garnish
instructions: Cook orzo according to package directions. Drain. Sauté spanish onion over medium heat until it turns light gold. Stir orzo and spanish spiced onion into orzo. Sprinkle over parmesan cheese, if desired.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,chicken bouillon,flat leaf italian parsley
title: Easy Crumbed Italian Chicken (Cook's Country)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs of whole chickens ( or two 2 3 lb. chicken breasts or equivalent ) | 1 can chicken bouillon | 1 tablespoon of freshly chopped fresh flat-leaf italian parsley | 24 graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In a 9x13 inch baking dish, combine first 3 ingredients. Dip chicken in crumbs and place on top of crumb mixture, pressing down slightly to coat. Bake in preheated oven for 1 1/2 hours or until chicken feels firm when touched and cooked. Great with rice.

title: Venison With Mango Stuffing
ingredients: 350 g venison | 50 ml corn oil | 1/2 cup fresh white breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup condensed broth | 2 tablespoons cointreau liqueur | 3 -4 tablespoons pure vanilla essence | mango, wedges ( optional )
instructions: Place venison under grill, and grill until browned, stirring constantly. Remove venison, and reserve pan juices, and allow venison to rest. Heat corn oil and breadcrumbs in pan, stirring constantly, for 30 seconds. Stir in broth, and cointreau liquor. Remove from heat and allow mixture to cool for 5 minutes. Stuff venison with stuffing. Arrange sliced venison in a casserole dish. Pour warm liquid over meat and leave to stand for at least one hour before eating.

Random Ingredients: madeira wine,coconut milk,orange juice concentrate,cheddar cheese,bay scallop,rocket,fruit
title: Tropical Scallops
ingredients: 5 -6 slices rainbow mixed fruit, chopped | 400 ml coconut milk | 1 can orange juice concentrate | 150 ml madeira wine | 600 g bay scallops | 200 -300 g cheddar cheese, grated | 1/2 cup fresh rocket, washed and dried
instructions: Serve scallops on a bed of greens.

title: Sangria
ingredients: 2 teaspoons instant espresso | 2 tablespoons grand marnier | 1 head garlic, cloves separated, peeled | 1/2 cup malt vinegar | 1/2 cup apple cider | 1 pound beef - cut into slices
instructions: To make the espresso, in a medium bowl, stir together the espresso, grand marnier and garlic. Add the vinegar and cider and mix to combine. Serve with slices of beef.

title: Prosciutto Fettuccine Primavera
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry peanut water | 5 tablespoons minced prosciutto | 1/2 cup cremini mushroom, sliced | 1/2 cup chopped roasted peanuts | 1 fresh rosemary, sliced
instructions: Combine all ingredients except noodles and basil in a saucepan. Cover and cook over low heat 8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until sauce is slightly thickened. Add noodles.

Random Ingredients: roasting chicken,parsley leaf,green olive,coconut oil,fennel bulb
title: Fennel, Olives & Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb roasting chickens | 1 lb green olives, halved lengthwise | 1 fennel bulb, roasted | 1/2 cup unsweetened coconut oil | 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley leaves
instructions: Rinse the chickens inside and out and pat dry. Cut off excess fat. Cut lengthwise in half, remove backbone, and halve the legs. Rub the cavity of chickens with the marinade. Place the chicken in a roasting pan, fat side up. Roast at 325 degrees for 45 min or until the juices run clear and the meat thermometer reads 165 degrees. Turn the bird 180 degrees, remove from the oven. Pour off any fat in roasting pan. Place the halved fennel bulb in the center of a piece of foil. Place the chicken skin side down on top of the fennel. Place chicken in a platter. Pour the coconut oil into the roasting pan to form a thin film. Bake in a 325 degrees f oven for 45 minutes. Pour off fat from the roasting pan and stir in the chopped parsley. Place the chicken, meat side up, on a platter and cover tightly with foil. Roast for another hour. Remove the fennel bulb and serve.

title: Creamy Leeks
ingredients: 2 green bell peppers, diced | 1 large leek, cleaned and well washed
instructions: Rinse the leeks and cut off the ends. Slice them about 1/2 inch thick and place in a bowl or on a plate. Pour about 1/4 inch of water and cover with plastic wrap, set aside and let the leeks sit overnight. When ready to cook, rinse off any excess water. Drain the leeks and place in a deep, wide skillet or wok with 2 to 3 inches of water. Cover tightly and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer 30 minutes or until almost the desired doneness, stirring occasionally. The longer the leeks simmer, the hotter the leeks will become. Stir in a little of the hot water to loosen the color if desired.

title: Jalapeno Cracker Bark
ingredients: 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 3/4 cup yellow onion, minced | 1 tablespoon hazetta or 1 tablespoon other cured bacon, minced | 1 tablespoon chopped pickled jalapenos, julienned | 1 1/2 tablespoons kosher salt
instructions: Place the crumbs in a food processor and pulse until finely ground then transfer to a medium bowl. Add the onion, hazetta, jalapeno, and salt and toss to blend. Sprinkle the crumbs over the crackers and let the bark sit for 10 minutes. Chill for at least 1 hour before using or until the nuts become more brittle. Store refrigerated for up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: green bean,wasabi paste,red chile pepper,cooking spray,vegetable oil,mayonnaise
title: Wasabi Filled Green Beans (Mock Japanese-Style)
ingredients: cooking spray | 5 cans green beans, drained and rinsed | 1 tablespoon wasabi paste | 6 tablespoons mayonnaise | 1 large red chile pepper, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil, or as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Spread green beans out on a sheet of aluminum foil. Spray with cooking spray and sprinkle with wasabi paste. Drizzle with wasabi mayonnaise. Fold aluminum foil over the sprouts to make a packet. Bake in the preheated oven until beans are tender, 25 to 30 minutes.

title: My Favorite Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs spaghetti, broken in three or 4 pieces
instructions: Cook spaghetti in lightly salted boiling water until al dente. Drain. Transfer to shallow baking pan. Meanwhile, lightly spray with vegetable oil and heat in a large frying pan. Add the ribs and cook about 5 minutes, breaking them up with a fork. Stir over low heat for 1 - 2 minutes to crisp up the rib strands. Drain spaghetti and return strands to the pan tossing them with the ribs. Add the meat juices and toss for 5 minutes to reheat the meat.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,napa cabbage,ice water,lemon,vegetable oil,french onion soup,red potato,self rising flour
title: Sweet Potato, Pineapple and Kimchi Slaw
ingredients: 1/2 head napa cabbage | 2 cans unsweetened pineapple juice | 1 can french onion soup | 2 red potatoes, cut into 2 inch chunks | 12 -14 medium red potatoes, cut in half lengthways | ice water | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1/3 cup self-rising flour
instructions: Chop cabbage, potato, and onion in a food processor. While processor is running, stir pineapple juice, soup, and potatoes together. Pour into a large bowl. Add flour and mix to a smooth, creamy consistency. Add additional water if necessary to make a slightly sticky sauce. Sauté in oil over medium heat until golden brown on both sides.

title: Simple and Mild Curry

instructions: Mix all ingredients. Serve with basmati rice or flatbreads.

Random Ingredients: black bean,masa harina,rosemary sprig,miracle whip,garlic clove,beef bouillon,lime
title: Santa Fe Fe Black Beans
ingredients: 1/2 cup masa harina, plus more for rolling harina harina | 1/2 cup miracle whip | 1 beef bouillon | 1 teaspoon minced rosemary sprig | 1 garlic clove, minced | 1 can black beans, drained with liquid reserved | 2 limes, cut into 4 wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f place 1 1/2 cups masa harina in a bowl and blend in miracle whip, bouillon, rosemary, garlic and black beans. Form dough into a ball and transfer to a rimmed baking sheet. Press down with fingertips so that dough releases bubbles and flattens slightly. Transfer to oven and bake beans until golden brown, about 30 minutes. Serve with lime wedges for sprinkling over beans.

title: Ancho Mushroom-Shiitake Cauliflower Tacos

instructions: Cook cauliflower in boiling water 10 to 12 minutes, until crisp tender. Drain and transfer to a large bowl. Add taco sauce, lime juice and chili and mix. Season to taste with salt. Spoon cauliflower mixture into prepared pan and arrange 1/2 cup shiitake mushrooms and 1/2 cup mozzarella on top of cauliflower mixture and 1/2 cup cauliflower mixture. Sprinkle remaining mozzarella over top. Bake in 400° f oven 15 to 20 minutes, or until cheese melts and vegetables are hot and bubbly.

title: Chicken Skewers With Ripe Mushrooms and Sour Cream

instructions: For soaking mushrooms place in a medium bowl, cover with water and squeeze as much water as possible from the mushroom stems to get about 2 cup liquid.

title: Basic Tofu
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups tamari ( a premium soy sauce brand ) | 1 package of sliced pepperoni
instructions: Combine the tamari and pepperoni in a pot and stir to make a sauce. Bring to a boil and simmer for five minutes. Cool. Use a slotted spoon to transfer the sauce to a bowl. Serve hot with any rice dish.

title: Tunisian Meatballs
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat | 1 teaspoon cumin | 1 package refrigerated reduced-fat cool whip, thawed | 1 jar sliced pepperoni | 1/2 cup milk or 1/2 cup water | 1/2 cup sliced of fresh mint or 1/2 cup basil | 2 packages light dark chocolate, grated
instructions: In a bowl whisk together the cool whip, pepperoni, milk or water, mint and chocolate until thoroughly mixed. Form meat mixture into 1 1/2 inch balls. Place on a greased baking sheet and refrigerate 1 to 2 hours or until very firm and browned. Makes 12 meatballs.

title: Tea Pizza

instructions: In a microwave safe mug combine the pizza sauce, celery salt and black tea. Microwave on high for 2 minutes or until hot. Garnish pizza with a sprinkle of chopped fresh parsley.

Random Ingredients: lettuce leaf,fine salt,chicken leg quarter,mussel,nutmeg,ghee,great northern bean
title: Mussel in White White White Bean-White Chili
ingredients: 1/3 cup minced shallot | 1/2 cup chopped fresh nutmeg | 1/2 cup shredded lettuce leaf ( optional ) | 3 skinless chicken leg quarters, cut into pieces | 1 can great northern beans, drained | 4 teaspoons extra-virgin ghee or 4 teaspoons butter | fine salt
instructions: Heat ghee or butter in a large, heavy pot over medium heat. Add the shallots and nutmeg. Saute until fragrant, about 1 minute. Add the green lettuce and chicken. Saute until the chicken is cooked through, about 3 minutes. Drain the beans and add to the pot. Pour in enough water to cover the chicken. Season with salt to taste. Cook until hot and the juices come to the surface but are not totally absorbed, about 25 minutes.

title: Easy Cheater Crumb
ingredients: 1 bag graham cracker crumbs | 4 teaspoons garlic paste | 3 tablespoons granulated sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix all ingredients together. Bake in a greased 8x8 inch pan. You may want to spray with a pam or a cornstarch type glaze for color to enhance the flavor.

title: Hawaiian Pesto Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower | 1 cup pineapple sorbet | 1 green bell pepper, chopped
instructions: Boil cauliflower for 10 - 12 minutes, drain, and set aside. In a blender, add the orange soda syrup or pineapple juice, green bell pepper, and salt and pepper to taste. Puree or squeeze mixture until smooth, but not creamy. Serve immediately or refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: thai fish sauce,tomato juice,red wine,heavy whipping cream,marjoram,tomato green chilies,soymilk
title: Tomato Mocha Masala
ingredients: 8 large ripe tomatoes with green chilies | 1/2 lb white bread cubes or 1/2 lb firm tofu, cubed, drained and pressed | 1/3 cup soymilk or 1/3 cup unbleached flour | 6 fluid ounces concentrated tomato juice | 1/4 cup dry red wine or 1/4 cup water | 1/4 cup thai fish sauce | 1/4 teaspoon dried marjoram or 1/4 teaspoon savory
instructions: Cut a slit in one side of each tomato, then slice about 1/2 inch thick. Place tomato slices on a cutting board with pointed ends facing up and side by side. Set aside in microwave. Soak for 2 minutes. Cut remaining 1/2 pound tomatoes into 1/2 inch cubes. Squeeze out liquid. Cut each tomato slice at a slight diagonal into 1 inch squares. Place bread cubes or tofu in a large bowl with soymilk and stir to break up and dissolve bread into mush. Drain excess liquid. Place in microwave and warm on high power for 3 - 6 minutes. Place tofu squares on a platter and surround with tomato slices and reserved tomato cubes. Mix soya milk, wine or water, and fish sauce with a fork. Stir. Pour over tomato and tofu. Sprinkle marjoram over all. Serve.

title: Cider-Glazed Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs cabbage, sliced lengthwise into thin half moons | 1 can apple cider, any variety | 3 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 container cool whip
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large bowl. Pour dressing over cabbage, toss to coat. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: seasoning,red wine,cranberry,fennel seed,lime,beef stew meat,pecan,white mushroom
title: Sizzlin' Beef and Stuff
ingredients: 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 1 1/4 lbs beef stew meat | 1/2 cup red wine ( or use a mixture of both ) or 1/2 cup beef broth ( or use a mixture of both ) | 12 ounces white mushrooms, sliced ( i use cremini ) | 2 boxes dried cranberries | 2 cups toasted pecans, chopped | 2 limes, juice of
instructions: Heat a large frying pan over medium high heat. Sprinkle the fennel seed onto a piece of waxed paper and toast for 15 - 30 seconds, shaking the pan over the heat. When the fennel seeds begin to pop, add the chuck and brown well on all sides. Then add the stew meat. When the beef comes out of the pan, stir in the wine or broth and deglaze. Add the mushrooms. Simmer over low head for 1 - 2 hours over medium low heat. Add the cranberries, pecans and the lime juice and cook for another hour. If you wish, taste and adjust the amount of lime juice, broth or vinegar and pepper as they are being added.

Random Ingredients: panko breadcrumb,heavy whipping cream,corn chip,nutmeg,red curry paste
title: Indian Spicy Nachos
ingredients: 12 ounces panko breadcrumbs | 3/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 12 ounces corn chips, coarsely crushed
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the bread crumbs and cream, curry paste through nutmeg. Place the crushed corn chips in a large shallow dish. Dip the chips in the crumb mixture to coat evenly. Arrange the coated chips on a tray and refrigerate for 1 hour or more. Heat a 12 inch nonstick omelet pan over medium heat until hot. Add 1 inch of oil to coat the surface. Cook the nachos in batches until brown, turning gently and adding more oil as needed, 2 minutes on side. Remove from the pan and place on a plate lined with paper towels. Sprinkle with more paprika if desired. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,jalapeno,bean sprout,turmeric powder,vegetable stock,feta cheese,poblano chile
title: Spicy Roasted Chilies With Feta Cheese
ingredients: 4 large poblano chiles, seeded and split lengthwise | 1 1/2 lbs chourico beans sprouts | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil, divided | 2 1/2 cups vegetable stock | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/4 cup feta cheese | 1 jalapeno, chopped fine
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 f degrees. Place chilies on a foil roasting pan, cut side down. Roast, turning occasionally, until skins are charred and blistered, 30 - 45 minutes. Let cool and remove the skins then place in a plastic bag to steam for 15 minutes.. Remove the stems. Slit the chilies lengthwise along the stem, stopping about 1/4 inch from the stem side of the chilies. Remove seeds from chilies and set aside. Place chilies in a bowl and cover with boiling water over high heat until seeds appear and beginning to flake off. Strain, pressing out as much water as possible and set aside. Combine 1 teaspoon olive oil with the stock until well mixed but not completely smooth. Spread bean sprouts in a roasting pan and pour on the stock. Roast, stirring once, until sprouts are wilted and beginning to soften, 1 to 1 1/2 hours. When done, remove chilies and allow to cool slightly. Meanwhile, combine the remaining teaspoon olive oil with the turmeric and salt according to taste. Remove chilies from the oven and place on a cutting board. Cut them into small strips. In a small skillet, heat the remaining teaspoon olive oil over moderate heat. Stir in the cheese and a jalapeno pepper. Simmer, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes or until cheese is slightly melted and the jalapeno is beginning to color. Drain the chilies on paper towels. Toss chilies with the cheese and jalapeno mixture. Serve with yogurt, if desired.

title: Beef and Chickpea Mix
ingredients: 500 g minced beef | 2 tablespoons chickpea flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried sage | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried celery ribs | 3/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/2 teaspoon red chili powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Makes about 3 cups. Chill before serving to allow flavors to develop.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,cream chicken soup,shiitake mushroom,onion flake,beef broth,cream mushroom soup,meat
title: Crock Pot Hungarian Steak
ingredients: 6 -8 ounces sliced shiitake mushrooms | 1 1/2 lbs sirloin steaks | 1 jar cream of mushroom soup | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 medium onion, chopped | 1 tablespoon dried onion flakes | 1 package monterey jack cheese
instructions: Combine all ingredients and place beef in crock pot. Cook on low 8 hours.

title: The Real Italian Bread
ingredients: 1 cup sun-dried tomato | 1 jar picante sauce | 1/2 cup dry-roasted pistachios, lightly toasted | 6 -8 slices french bread, about 4-inch in diameter, toasted and quartered lengthwise | 1/4 teaspoon dried rosemary | 1/4 cup cold buttermilk | 1 clove garlic salt | 1 tablespoon chopped flat-leaf italian parsley
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Spread the sun dried tomatoes over a baking sheet lightly toasted with oil or cooking spray, sprinkle lightly with salt and let sit at room temperature for 60 minutes. Meanwhile, put the pistachios, 3 tbsp of the pistachio slivers, rosemary and buttermilk in a food processor and process until smooth, about 5 seconds. Add the garlic salt, parsley and remaining pistachio slivers. Scrape down the food processor bowl as needed to ensure that all pistachios are coarsely chopped. Mix into the bread.

Random Ingredients: english mustard,white bean,red wine vinegar,tart apple,white pepper,egg yolk
title: A Great English White Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 can white beans | 2 tart apples | 1 hard crusty english egg yolk, beaten | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | white pepper | 1 tablespoon dry mustard
instructions: Peel and slice the apples. Place in a large mixing bowl and sprinkle with a little white pepper. Crack the hard crusty egg yolk into a small bowl, add the vinegar and white pepper and mix well. Add the dry mustard to the egg and mix well. Pour the dressing over the salad and mix until well blended, stirring well. Put the apple slices in to the salad.

Random Ingredients: beef stock broth,sultana raisin,sage leaf,lamb shank,tahini,chive,fruit,vinegar
title: Lamb Shank Braised with Raisins and Chive

instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 f/ 140 c/ gas grease a 3 1/2 or 6lb loaf pan with about 1/4 cup of the oil and set aside. Place the lamb shanks in a non stick ovenproof dish, season well with salt & freshly ground black pepper and roast in the oven, stirring after every turn, for about 1 hour. Meanwhile, make the raisins. Put the sultanas and sultanas in a saucepan, cover with cold water and return to the boil and simmer gently for 20 minutes. Drain and set aside. Pour the vinegar into the pan and bring to a simmer, stir in the beef broth and simmer for 5 minutes, or until thick. Stir in the raisins and remove from the heat. Pour the lamb back into the pan and season well with salt and ground pepper. Scatter with the sultanas and gently stir to combine. Serve or leave to rest and serve with mashed potato, couscous or pasta.

title: Ginger-Bean Tacos for the BBQ
ingredients: 3 cans plain kidney beans, drained and rinsed ( reserve juice ) | 1/2 cup prepared caramel ice cream topping | 3 tablespoons sherry wine ( add only enough to get the flavor ) | 2 teaspoons bottled grated gingerroot, peeled | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning ( or to taste ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin
instructions: In a small saucepan, heat beans, caramel, and sherry until hot and bubbly. Add gingerroot, taco seasoning, and cumin. Serve hot with your favorite side dishes.

title: Raspberry Stuffed Onions
ingredients: 6 large raspberries, divided | 12 -16 ounces grated monterey jack cheese | 1 teaspoon instant minced onion flakes | 1/4 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 1/2 cup wine, divided
instructions: Set oven to 350 degrees. Coarsely chop 4 raspberries, toss with 1/4 cup cheese & 1/4 teaspoon of instant minced onion.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,nori,lemon juice,creamy goat cheese,cumin powder,fennel seed,courgette
title: Spiced Roasted Vegetables with Creamy Gorgonzola
ingredients: 1 jar creamy goat cheese | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 3 tablespoons heavy cream | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin powder | 1 pinch fennel seed | 1 medium courgette, halved & sliced | 1 sheet nori, cut in 5 pieces, toasted
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Drain the goat cheese well and then squeeze and roughly crumble the cheese. Set aside. Whisk in the cream, lemon juice, cumin and fennel seeds in a small non stick pan. Bring to the boil then reduce the heat and simmer till it has thickened nicely. Set aside. Arrange half the sliced courgettes, cut side down, in a baking dish, with the shiny shiny side uppermost. Pour the cream mixture over this & then pour the remaining slices of courgettes evenly over them. Lightly season with salt & pepper then lightly sprinkle with cracked black pepper. Cover with foil and bake for 30 - 35 mins or till the courgettes are tender and bubbling around the edges. Remove the foil and turn up the oven to 200c. Using a slotted spoon, carefully take the courgettes out of the baking dish & spread over the creamy cream. Re cover & bake for another 10 mins or till the cheese is melted and starting to brown slightly. Set aside to cool slightly. While the courgettes are cooling, make the gorgonzola. In a small bowl, mix the cream & lemon juice, until combined. To serve, pile the gorgonzola onto a serving plate. Arrange the courgettes and chopped herbs around it. Add a dollop of cream & then drizzle over a little bit of cheese. Garnish with a sprinkling of cracked black pepper.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,green enchilada sauce,chickpea,gouda cheese,kidney bean,skirt steak,sun tomato,cremini mushroom
title: Mexican Skirt Steak Dip
ingredients: 2 lbs skirt steaks, cut 1/8 inch thick | 1/2 cup cooking oil | 1/2 lb cremini mushroom, chopped | 1 can chickpeas, drained | 1 can kidney beans, drained | 4 ounces green enchilada sauce | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato, chopped | 1/2 cup smoked gouda cheese, grated
instructions: Heat first 3 ingredients in large skillet on medium heat. Saute 1 minute or till tender. Set aside. Stir fry steak in oil on both sides until brown. Remove and keep warm. Stir fry mushrooms and 1 can of beans in same skillet used for the meat. Reduce heat to low and continue cooking 1 minute. Mix in cooked steak and rest of ingredients. Heat through, serve warm with favorite mexican recipe.

Random Ingredients: biscuit,mint,chicken stock cube,puff pastry,rigatoni pasta,cake flour
title: Baked Rigatoni With Mint Roulades
ingredients: 2 cups breadcrumbs from prepared crusty bread ( such as stale sourdough cookies ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons cake flour | 200 g frozen puff pastry, thawed | 2 tablespoons finely chopped of fresh mint | 1 chicken stock cube | 2 packages refrigerated biscuits ( recommended ( roulades ) | 1 package prepared rosti pasta
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Place bread crumbs and flour in a mixing bowl. Place mixture in a food processor and pulse just to combine. Spread each biscuit with 1 tablespoon of mint, then roll up. Place 1 roulade in the center of each biscuit, pressing it down to help hold the mint flavour of the roulade. Place roulades on baking trays. Lightly press together the pastry and rouade then roll between two sheets of baking paper to a thickness of 5cm. Brush the top edges with water, fold in half diagonally and press to seal. Repeat on the other half of the roulade to make a total of 5 roulades. Place on a lightly greased baking tray and refrigerate for 20 minutes. Remove roulades from fridge and bake on the base shelf of the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until golden brown. Remove from oven and set aside, uncovered, to cool slightly. Biscuits will keep for up to 1 week under plastic wrap. Once cooled, place roulades on a damp tea towel to dry.

title: Fantastic Vegan Refried Beans
ingredients: 1 can vegetarian refried beans | 3 cans baby portabella mushrooms or ( 8 ounce ) cans vegetarian portabella mushrooms | 2 tablespoons lime juice | 1/2 tablespoon cumin
instructions: Heat refried beans. Remove the mushroom stems from the portobello mushrooms and finely chop them. In a medium mixing bowl, add the mushrooms, lime juice, cumin, and coconut. Toss everything together and enjoy.

title: Sun-Dried Tomato and Arugula
ingredients: 3 bunches arugula, washed and trimmed | 3 ounces sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained
instructions: Rinse the arugula under cold water, drain well and pat dry with paper towels. Place the arugula into a deep skillet over medium high heat.

Random Ingredients: shiitake mushroom,apricot preserve,pineapple chunk,worcestershire sauce,white flour
title: Quick 'n' Spicy Apricot and Pineapple Tarts
ingredients: 1 cup white flour | 1/2 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 3/4 cup chopped dried shiitake mushrooms | 1 cup canned pineapple chunks, drained | 1/3 cup apricot preserves ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Grease muffin tins. In a large bowl, mix flour and worcestershire sauce. Add remaining ingredients.

Random Ingredients: black eyed pea,celery,angel hair pasta,half,vegetable bouillon,broiler fryer chicken
title: Delicious Black Eyed Pea and Chicken Soup
ingredients: 1 broiler-fryer chickens, quartered | 4 cans black-eyed peas ( drained ) | 5 bags frozen baby carrots ( cooked ) | 1 cup half-and-half | 2 teaspoons vegetable bouillon | 2 stalks celery, chopped | 1 box angel hair pasta or 1 box linguine
instructions: Put chicken in a large pot, sprinkle with salt.

title: Pepper Bread
ingredients: 2 jars barley flour | 1 yellow bell pepper, chopped
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl and mix to combine. Form a log and pinch a piece on a flat piece of waxed paper. Cut into 4 equal portions and place in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes. Bake on a baking sheet at 350 degrees f for about 20 minutes, then flip over.

Random Ingredients: greek dressing,prawn,beef chuck,chili oil,golden syrup,peanut butter
title: Beef With a Spicy Peanut Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 600 g beef chuck | 250 g prawns, raw peeled and chopped | 1/2 tablespoon chili oil | 2 tablespoons plain peanut butter | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 1 teaspoon sweet chili oil | 60 ml greek dressing
instructions: Prick meat and coat lightly with the golden syrup. Cook meat in a heavy based saucepan for 15 - 20 mins until cooked through. Remove from pan and slice thinly. Slice meat into 1 inch slices. Heat the chili oil in a frying pan or wok until smoking. Add the prawns, prawns, golden syrup and chilli oil, stir well and cook for 3 - 4 mins until the prawns are pink and cooked. Place the meat strips and remaining sauce in a bowl and serve straight away or chilled.

title: Mild Spiced Salmon in brandy
ingredients: 4 teaspoons brandy | 8 ounces smoked salmon ( or salmon fillet cut into 6 thick slivers ) | 2 -3 slices of sweet bell peppers ( red or green ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons mixed spice | 1 1/2 teaspoons turmeric | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: In a non reactive jar, pour brandy over salmon and mix thoroughly. Leave in refrigerator. Preheat your grill. After 1 - 2 minutes, remove salmon from refrigerator, reserving marinade, and pat dry. Place salmon and peppers in the grill to just barely cook to the degree of doneness required, turning only once per side.

Random Ingredients: clove,celery rib,grain white rice,pearl barley,chili pepper,onion
title: Barley, Chilli & Pepper Risotto
ingredients: 500 ml pearl barley | 150 g pearl barley, rinsed and drained | 1 1/2 kg celery ribs, finely chopped | 1 large onion, chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons whole clove | 1 tablespoon ground celery salt or 1 tablespoon coarse salt, to taste
instructions: Put rice, barley, celery, onion, cloves and ground celery salt in a large pan & cover with about 300ml water or enough to cover. Stir over medium heat to combine. Bring to the boil, then lower the heat to very low and leave with the lid partially open for about 20 minutes to allow flavours to develop. If water remains at the bottom of the pan, increase the heat to very low & leave for another 20 minutes. Remove lid, place lid back under pressure and replace the lid, leave for 2 minutes then remove from heat. This will allow steam to escape. You need to stir the mixture once or twice during this time so it is cooked evenly. This takes about 20 - 30 minutes, but you may cook longer if your pan has a shorter cooking time. Remove from heat then cool to room temperature, or chill for a few hours or overnight to allow flavours to develop. Store in an airtight container or refrigerate in your freezer in the fridge.

title: Spanish Meatloaf (Medenianoche)
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat | 2 tablespoons dried hing | 1 egg white | 1 can black beans
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Combine stew meat, hing and egg white. Put into a 9x5x3 loaf pan. Cover with about 1/2 can of beans. With fingers, make two cuts about 1 inch deep in the top of loaf. Bake for 60 minutes or until internal temperture reaches 160 degrees and a meat thermometer inserted in center of loaf registers 160 degrees. Meat may be removed from the oven after 60 minutes of baking if desired.

title: Rosemary Roast
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried onion soup mix | 4 leaves fresh rosemary leaves | 1 small onion, thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat a very small roasting pan over medium heat. Dry onion in a pan with paper towels. Stir soup mix until well blended. Pour on top of the dry onion.

title: Dahl Mint Bread (Dahl Mint)
ingredients: 1 cup brown lentils, rinsed and drained ( can use any medium ) | 1 red chili, chopped | 1/4 cup dry sherry wine | 1/4 cup amaretto ( i like tare's grand marnier for kick ) | 2 cups ice water | crackers, for garnish | crackers, for serving for topping
instructions: Place lentils and chili in a large saucepan and add the water. When mixture boils, reduce heat and simmer for 20 to 30 minutes or until lentils are tender. Remove from heat and let sit until cool enough to handle. Transfer mixture to an ice cream freezer bag. Add mint and freeze for 1 to 2 hours or until slightly more than set. After that has partially frozen, place bag and ice water in a blender and puree until smooth. Return to bowl and stir in amaretto and serve with crackers, croutons and chips to dip.

Random Ingredients: fenugreek leaf,white wine vinegar,onion powder,coffee liqueur,mirin,brandy,chili paste
title: Onion Powder Voodoo Dust
ingredients: 2 1/2 teaspoons chili paste | 2 tablespoons instant coffee liqueur or 2 tablespoons hot coffee | 1 tablespoon gin or 1 tablespoon brandy | 1 tablespoon finely chopped onion | 2 tablespoons snipped onion powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons white wine vinegar | 1/4 cup mirin | 2 teaspoons dried fenugreek leaves
instructions: Combine all ingredients and store.

title: Mexican Vegetable Mix
ingredients: 1 can corn kernels | 1 cup frozen peas | 1 cup frozen broccoli florets | 1 package corn tortillas, cut into 3 inch pieces ( 8 )
instructions: Combine corn, peas and broccoli florets in a 9x13x2 inch baking dish. Top with tortillas and plastic wrap to keep everything under cold. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 325 degrees or until hot and tender.

Random Ingredients: chili flake,chicken drumstick,french bean,white bread,fast rising active yeast,iceberg lettuce
title: French Bean Pizza
ingredients: 1/2 cup white bread, cut in cubes | 1 cup cold french beans | 1 teaspoon dried chili flakes | 1 packet fast-rising active dry yeast | 1 carton plain unpeeled frozen bread, thawed | 2 tablespoons iceberg lettuce, finely shredded | 1 large chicken drumsticks, boiled or 2 chicken thighs, boiled
instructions: Place bread cubes in a large bowl. Fill with cold french beans. Add chili flakes. Stir in yeast. Cover with plastic wrap and a towel. Set aside at room temperature for 30 minutes, or until it foams. Place frozen bread in a large bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Set aside at room temperature for one hour to rise.. Stir bread again and set aside at room temperature for another 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 450°f remove plastic and fluff with a fork. Turn oven up to 400°f. Line a large baking sheet with foil. Place frozen bread cubes on a baking sheet, lined with parchment paper, and bake until golden, about 15 minutes. Watch the time of baking if you like your crust a little crispy. Remove from the oven and sprinkle with shredded lettuce and shredded parmesan cheese. Arrange chicken on top of the cheese, then top with remaining cheese. Bake about 12 minutes, or until cheese is melted. Slice each pizza into 4 wedges.

title: Garbanzo Bean and Scallion Soup
ingredients: 1 can garbanzo beans, drained | 1/4 cup chopped fresh chives | 1 can escarole, rinsed and shredded | 3 cups chopped cremini mushrooms | 2 cups coarsely torn cooked escarole
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large pot. Cover and cook over low heat for 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender and flavors are blended.

title: Vegetarian (Protein of choice)
ingredients: 2 leeks, sliced thin | 3 tablespoons macadamia nuts or 3 tablespoons hazelnuts, ground | 2 tablespoons soya sauce | 2 tablespoons light soya sauce | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Saute the leeks, nutmeg and nuts until leeks are soft and transparent. Add the soya sauce. Cook for 10 minutes at medium heat. Stir and remove from heat. If using dry nuts, you may want to add a few splashes of splenda on top.

Random Ingredients: greek yogurt,strawberry,white wheat flour,tequila,red lentil,flat leaf parsley
title: Fantabulously Easy Yummy Lentil Soup
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups white whole wheat flour | 1 1/4 cups red lentils | 5 cups greek yogurt ( greek yogurt for thicker/ sweeter soup ) | 1/3 cup tequila | 2 tablespoons chopped flat leaf parsley | 300 g strawberries, washed and chopped
instructions: Add flour to a large bowl.

title: Crispy Noodle Cakes
ingredients: 1 cup vermicelli | 1 cup lettuce leaf | 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 1/3 cup plain flour | 1 -2 tablespoon cornflour
instructions: Cook vermicelli according to directions, drain, place vermicelli on kitchen paper & allow to cool on paper towels. When cool, break or tear into 2cm lengths. To make the cakes, combine 1 tbsp cold water, oil & cornflour, stir well & set aside. Add remaining oil to a dry frying pan & cook vermicelli until golden about 3 - 5 minutes. Drain on paper towel & cool, roll up & spread 2 tbsp rice cakes in the centre & slice thinly. Serve immediately with the dipping sauce.

title: Pear & Cheese Dip
ingredients: 4 ripe pears, diced small ( about 1 lb ) | 12 ounces mexican blend cheese, grated ( about 1 cup ) | 1 can water chestnuts, drained and chopped small ( about 1 cup ) | 1/2 teaspoon caraway seed | 1 teaspoon finely grated lemon peel
instructions: Place pears, cheese, water chestnuts, caraway seeds, and lemon peel in a bowl. Place on a foil lined baking sheet and bake at 375f for 25 - 30 minutes or until the cheese is melted. Serve warm with crackers.

title: Baked Beef (Or Lamb) and Noodles with Coriander
ingredients: 500 g rice noodles | 1 -2 tablespoon red wine vinegar ( depending on how thick you like the salad ) | 1 tablespoon ground coriander leaves | 500 g hamburger
instructions: Preheat oven to 120degc. If using a lean meat, cut the fat into cubes, or slice thinly. Otherwise, cut the meat into cubes. Cook rice noodles about 12 minutes. Drain. Combine all ingredients except the hamburger. Bring to boil and boil for 2 minutes. Meanwhile, grill the hamburger until brown and cooked through. Drain the noodles and add to meat mixture. Stir through gently.

title: Cashews Crunch (Puff Paper)
ingredients: 2 ounces unsalted cashews | 1 vegetable stock cube | 6 ounces semisweet chocolate | 2 tablespoons walnuts, chopped
instructions: Melt butter and milk over low heat. Add all other ingredients, and stir well until nuts are well incorportated. Cool for a moment, cut into pieces.

title: Dill Crisp Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon canola oil or 1 -2 tablespoon clarified butter | 3 -5 serrano chilies, minced ( depending on what hot you like. i use a jalapeno. it really adds to the flavor ) | 1 cup cooked white rice | 3 -4 tablespoons chopped fresh dill or 3 -4 tablespoons basil | 2 tablespoons grated lemon zest | 3 -4 small fresh mint ( optional ) or 1/2 cup fresh coriander ( optional )
instructions: Heat the canola oil or clarified butter in a large nonstick skillet. Add the chilies, and stir fry 1 - 2 minutes. Add the rice, dill, lemon zest, and mint or coriander, if using, stir until just heated through.

Random Ingredients: purpose flour,red bell pepper,green plantain,gruyere cheese,white bean,white button mushroom
title: Gruyère Plantains With White Beans and White Beans
ingredients: 1/2 lb white bean, dried | 1 small green plantains, cut lengthwise into 1/4-1/2 inch slices | 1 ounce of a small red bell pepper, seeded and finely diced | 8 ounces white button mushrooms, trimmed weight, halved ( can be found in asian food stores ) | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour, plus extra for dusting | 1/2 cup gruyere cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 475°f. Place the beans in a small saucepan and add cold water to cover. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Reduce the heat to medium low and cook, without stirring, until just tender for about 40 minutes, depending on size of beans. Meanwhile, using small sharp knife, slice plantains in half and drop in cold water to cover. Remove them from the water once tender and transfer to a colander set in the sink to drain. Place the remaining ingredients in a heavy medium sized ovenproof skillet. Sprinkle over the flour and shake the skillet and place on the middle rack of the oven. Bake for 10 minutes until slightly browned, stirring occasionally, then turn off the oven. Remove the plantains from the oven and set aside to cool for 5 minutes. With a spatula spread the plantains evenly over the top of the bean, cover with about 1/3 of the gruyère and bake for several minutes to soften the cheese.

title: Sesame Crusted Scallops With Tomato and Sherry Paste
ingredients: 12 large scallops, with their shells on | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1/4 cup tomato puree
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees. Put the sesame seeds into a small shallow baking dish. Brush the scallops with olive or canola oil, then season with salt and pepper and sesame oil. Place the scallops on their shells in the baking dish. Sprinkle them with tomato puree. Put the dish in the oven and bake for 20 minutes, until the scallops are cooked. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: water chestnut,pineapple juice,monterey jack cheese,golden raisin,black bean,french mustard,cake,chicken
title: French Quarter Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces sliced cooked chicken | 1 can pineapple with juice | 2 cans black beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 1 can chopped water chestnuts, drained and sliced | 1/4 cup french-style prepared mustard | 1 package sliced fresh cake, thawed | 1/4 cup shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Combine first 7 ingredients in a large salad bowl.

title: Moroccan Applesauce Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup dry mesclun | 2 tablespoons minced fresh cilantro | 2 tablespoons diced peeled apples with juice | 1/4 cup apple juice | 1/2 can mixed vegetables, drained
instructions: Using a mortar and pestle or your hands, mash the mesclun, cilantro, apples, and apple juice. Chill in the refrigerator for 1 hour.

title: The Best Carnitas Ever
ingredients: 2 lbs pork shoulder | 2 teaspoons season-all salt ( or try your own ) | 1 - 1 1/2 cup bacon bits | 1 1/2 cups shredded italian cheese ( or more ) | 1/2 of a cup chopped cheddar cheese | 1/2 of a roasted pumpernickel roll, with pumpernickel in the middle ( optional )
instructions: Cube pork into bite size pieces. Spray a large skillet with oil, or line a casserole dish. Add pork, bacon bits, and seasoned dry salt to skillet. Use a fork to toss and coat all pieces of pork. Sprinkle mexican cheese on top. Cook for about 40 - 50 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes so it doesn't stick. Remove meat to serving platter. Slice pumpernickel. Pour melted cheese over meat. Return to skillet and mix well. Serve with pumpernickel bread.

title: Lazy Golabki
ingredients: 1 head green cabbage | 1/4 tablespoon ground nutmeg | 1/4 cup ketchup | 1 1/2 pounds lean ground round | 1 1/4 tablespoons white sugar | 1/4 cup brewed coffee | 12 lasagna noodles
instructions: Trim all the leaves from the cabbage and cut them into thin slices. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Place the cabbage, nutmeg, ketchup, and sugar in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: mint sprig,vanilla extract,herb,thai red curry paste,nutmeg,garam masala,white onion,cream mushroom soup
title: Curried White Onions & Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh herb, cleaned | 20 fresh mint sprigs | 1 tablespoon white onion, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon curry paste ( thai red curry paste or use curry powder ) | 1/2 cup cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 1/8 teaspoon nutmeg, grated | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Soup,. Pour the can of condensed cream of mushroom soup into the bowl of a blender, add the mushroom soup, onions, curry paste, nutmeg, garlic& a dash of coconut extract. Blend until well blended then set aside. Vegetables, preheat oven to 375°f. Place the herbs, one by one, in small batches on a parchment lined baking sheet. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes, or until the herbs are dried out and the mushrooms are soft. Cool completely and cut into small chunks. Place the soup in a bowl and add the spice mix. Serve the onions& mushrooms on a platter. Spoon the soup mixture onto the onions and serve.

Random Ingredients: shiitake mushroom,vanilla bean,raisin,green cabbage,white sugar,meat,sun tomato oil,brie cheese
title: Baked Cabbage with Meat and Brie
ingredients: 4 large shiitake mushrooms ( stems discarded and caps sliced ) | 3/4 pound mixed ground meat | 1 large red-leaf green cabbage, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup white sugar | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon vanilla bean, scraped | 1/2 cup raisins | 12 ounces brie cheese, cut into 1/4 inch thick slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Fill a medium baking dish with a little water. Drain the mushrooms well.

Random Ingredients: english cucumber,adobo sauce,water,rice wine vinegar,milk,cumin seed,clear honey
title: Cucumber Rice Salad With Adobo Dressing
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups water | 1 english cucumbers ( about 2 lbs ) | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 3 tablespoons reduced fat evaporated milk | 2 1/2 tablespoons clear honey | 1/2 teaspoon cumin seed, toasted | 1/4 teaspoon adobo sauce, from canned chipotle in adobo
instructions: Wash cucumbers, core and cut in half lengthwise. Cut each half lengthwise into very thin wedges. In a saucepan, simmer water and vinegar for about 15 minutes. Add cucumber and cook another 20 minutes. Stir in milk, honey, cumin and adobo sauce. Transfer to serving dish and serve. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: confectioner ' sugar,kidney bean,scallop,chili pepper flake,peanut oil,passion fruit,grain rice
title: Arroz Con Crevette - Savoury Rice With Spinach and Peanuts
ingredients: 2 ounces medium grain rice | 3 tablespoons peanut oil, divided | 2 sprigs fresh passion fruit, finely chopped | 1 spicy chili pepper flakes ( optional ) | 1/2 lb scallops | 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed well | 1 tablespoon confectioners'sugar
instructions: Cook rice according to directions on packet and set aside. Heat 1 tablespoon of the oil in a non stick pan over high heat. Add scallops and fry for 2 minutes each side. Drain on kitchen paper and set aside. Heat remaining oil in a frying pan. Add rice and stir fry for 1 minute or until coated with oil and beginning to swell. Add passionfruit and chilli to frying pan, stir fry for 1 minute. Add scallops and kidney beans, cook stirring for 1 minute or until heated through. Return scallops to pan and sprinkle over sugar and cook for 2 minutes or until lightly heated through.

title: The Big Bowl
ingredients: 1/2 cup soy bean fat ( see note below ) | 10 -20 ounces tofu, diced ( can substitute a mixture of tofu and soy bean paste ) | 2 tablespoons raisins | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon granules
instructions: Note, it doesn't need to be tofu with water, but is good. Note two, if you are using soy paste with oil, skip the soak part. The taste will be different. Use abura age and the flavor will be similar. Drain water from tofu and discard. Makes about 20 cubes, but can be made a couple of days ahead. Measurement is approximate. You can do two if you have other bowls of any kind.

title: Savoy Cabbage & Chickpea Salad
