ingredients: 400 g chicke ( cabbage ) | 1 large savoy cabbage or 3 large spinach, washed, trimmed, thinly sliced and cooked ( 3. 5oz cans ) | 1/4 cup white vinegar | 1/4 cup water | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon black pepper, freshly ground
instructions: Place chicke in a colander & rinse under running water. Leave to drain for 10 minutes. Rinse out the colander & dry thoroughly. Drain well again & leave on absorbant paper towels. Wash and tear up chicke into small, bite sized pieces. To finish, mix vinegar & water in a skillet, cook on medium heat until thickened, stirring regularly to avoid scorching. Add mustard and black pepper, then set aside to cool slightly. Stir salad & add salad before serving.

title: Jamaican Jerk Cheese Rounds
ingredients: 12 ounces processed cheese, softened with electric mixer | 1/2 cup jamaican jerk spice | 1/4 cup light gelatin | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary | 1 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Heat oven to 300 degrees. In a medium bowl, beat processed cheese and jerk spice at high speed until well blended. Stir in oregano, rosemary, paprika and 1 tablespoons water until blended. Divide mixture into 24 even pieces, each 1 1/2 inches long. On a greased baking sheet, arrange pieces in a single layer.

title: Zucchini (Kebab)
ingredients: 1 whole zucchini ( 1 to 1 1/3 pounds ) | 2 tablespoons sambhar powder | 1 tablespoon garlic, minced ( or as required )
instructions: Wash well and place in a pot with water to cover. Turn heat to medium and bring contents to a boil. Cover and cook until the zucchini is very tender, about 15 - 20 minutes. Drain zucchini thoroughly. Set aside. Cut into 2 slices, about 1/4, and set aside. In a small bowl, combine zucchini, sambar powder, garlic, and as much water as is needed to cover the zucchini. Bring mixture to a boil, cooking just long enough to heat zucchini.

Random Ingredients: margarine,green pea,garbanzo bean,palm sugar,breadcrumb,dijon mustard,rice wine
title: Vegetarian Rice Balls
ingredients: 1 bunch green peas | 1 can garbanzo beans | 2 tablespoons grated palm sugar | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon rice wine | 1 tablespoon margarine | 1/4 cup seasoned breadcrumbs
instructions: Shell and cut the green peas into large pieces, about a third to a quarter inch in size or smaller. Put all ingredients in a large bowl and mix thoroughly with hands. Cover and chill for at least 20 minutes or overnight. Using wet hands, roll the mixture into about 1 balls. Roll balls in bread crumbs, cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 1 hours.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,cucumber,pinto bean,garlic clove,hoagie,garlic salt
title: Beef & Cucumber Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs boneless lean beef stew meat | 2 1/4 teaspoons hoagie roll seasoning | 1 1/2 teaspoons finely crushed garlic cloves ( i like lots! ) | 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 medium cucumber, seeded & cut into thin wedges | 1 can pinto beans, drained & rinsed | 1 long hoagie roll, split
instructions: Cut beef into 1 1/4 inch cubes. In a 2 to 3 quart ziplock bag, mix beef, 6 tablespoons of the hoagie mix, 1/4 teaspoon of the garlic, and 1/4 teaspoon of the garlic salt. Place in refrigerator. Cut cucumber quarters lengthwise into thin wedges. Put 1/2 teaspoon salt in the bag, add beef, and shake to mix. Remove meat from bag. Toss in remaining 1 teaspoon of garlic, bean mix, and remaining 1 teaspoon of garlic salt. Place in plastic bag or covered container and shake. To serve, preheat grill to high. Grill meat and vegetables for 2 to 3 minutes on each side, or until meat juices run clear. Cut meat diagonally into 1/2 inch thick strips when done. Serve on hoagies.

Random Ingredients: new potato,brussels sprout,baking powder,caper,yellow pea,grape leaf,caster sugar,cardamom pod
title: Vegan Hot Pot
ingredients: 350 g fresh yellow split peas or 400 g frozen yellow split peas, defrosted | 6 large baking powder ( i use baking soda, but your brand will do... ) | 450 g young new potatoes ( peeled and halved if a whole potato isn't available ) | 200 g good quality brussels sprouts | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 2 -3 teaspoons capers, drained | fresh egg pickling salt and pepper
instructions: Place split peas, baking soda, potatoes, brussels sprouts, sugar, cardamom and capers in a large saucepan. Use the 1/2 cup water from the boiled potatoes to moisten the ingredients and mix thoroughly. Season with lots of freshly ground pepper and toss to combine, cover and place in the freezer for at least 2 hours or until they need somewhere firm. Remove half a cup of the potato water and reserve, discard shells if you did them in step step. Drain the rest of the potato water and place back into the saucepan. Place the potato water/potato mixture onto the potato/vegetable mixture and boil, covered, for about 2 hours at a very gentle simmer. Serve hot, with a few pickling salt strips and perhaps some chopped fresh mint or fresh dill, if desired.

title: Rice Milk and Caraway
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups fat free low-fat milk | 1/4 cup triple sec ( or more ) | 1/4 teaspoon caraway seed ( optional, see note )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a saucepan.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,portabella mushroom,bread crumb,red chilies,beet,hazelnut,green bell pepper
title: Grilled Beets With Mushrooms, Capsicum & Hazelnuts
ingredients: 8 medium beets | 2 medium red chilies ( or a good red capsicum ) | 1/3 cup hazelnuts, toasted and skins removed | 1/2 cup bread crumbs | 1/3 cup red chilies, red | 1/3 cup green bell peppers, chopped | 1/2 cup portabella mushroom, chopped
instructions: In a pan of boiling water steam the beets until very tender. Drain well and slice into 1/4 thick slices. Place the slices on a paper towel lined plate and allow to dry out. When cool, slip off the skins. Cut the chillies, nuts and peppers into thin strips. Place the bread crumbs, chilli, pepper strips, capsicums and mushrooms in a salad bowl. Dredge beets in crumbs, pressing them evenly onto the grates. In a hot pan or grill sauté the beets on each side, turning them frequently, for 3 to 4 minutes. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: saffron strand,sea salt,soda water,mint,heavy cream,pasta,saltine cracker,poblano chile
title: Saffron Saltimbocca and Pasta With Chiles
ingredients: 1 ounce saltine crackers, crushed | 2 tablespoons saffron strands, infused with 2 tbs. water, with 1 tbs. water ( or a combination of the two ) | 1 cup soda water | 1 pint heavy cream | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 3/4 lb medium tube pasta or 3/4 lb short pasta, of your choice | 2 poblano chiles, halved horizontally | 1/4 cup chopped of fresh mint or 4 teaspoons dried mint, for garnish
instructions: In a 12 inch nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray, combine the saltines and saffron. Mix well and allow to stand off the heat for 5 minutes. Mix in the soda water until the soda is completely absorbed, about 5 minutes. Add the cream and cream, whisking to blend. Turn the heat up until it bubbles softly, then reduce the heat and simmer for 2 minutes. Cook the pasta according to the directions on the package, drain, and place it in a sieve. Add the chiles and the mint into the sauce, toss, and pour the sauce over the pasta. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chervil,plain flour,shiitake mushroom,brown lentil,bread crumb,wheat flour,raisin,english mustard
title: Mushroom and Raisin Damsticks
ingredients: 12 large fresh shiitake mushrooms | 1 cup brown lentils | 1 cup gluten-free bread crumbs | 2 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 2 teaspoons english mustard | 1 tablespoon dried chervil | plain flour, to dust | 1/3 cup raisins
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c/400f/gas bash the dried mushrooms with your knuckle until the mushroom is crushed and the skin has begun to flake off. You know your shittake mushroom is cooking. Place the mushrooms in a clean cloth bag with a tight fitting lid. Pour boiling water into the bag, close the lid, and leave the bag to soak for 10 minutes, then remove the bag. Wash and tear into large pieces. Place on a lightly floured surface and knead well to ensure that all of the dry mushroom pieces are removed. Put the flour and mustard into a bowl with the chervil, the dried mushroom pieces, and raisins. Roll out the bread dough to rectangle about 5cm thick. Place a heaped tablespoon of the chopped mushrooms on the centre of the dough rectangle. Tightly roll the dough to the edge of the pan and pinch all around the edges, folding them underneath for a neat look. Pressing the pastry with your fingers, press the ends together. Using a sharp knife, roll out the damsticks until you have bread dough with the mushrooms, then gently push the slices into a steamer, cover, and cook for 30 minutes, turn once, and cook for a further 10 - 15 minutes. When tender, check the water level and if the damsticks are completely firm you can push in the lid and cook for a further 10 - 15 minutes to crisp them up.

title: Ginger Marinated Antipasto
ingredients: 1 jar orange marmalade | 1 cup water chestnut, sliced | 4 tablespoons ground gingerroot | 4 tablespoons greek seasoning | 1 cup lard | 4 pieces pepperoni ( optional ) or ( 3 ounce ) rolls ( optional )
instructions: Mix orange marmalade, water chestnuts, ginger, greek seasoning, and lard together. Store in refrigerator for 2 weeks.

title: Roasted Zucchini Lasagna
ingredients: 5 zucchini, sliced lengthwise | 3 tablespoons lemons, zest of | 4 tablespoons shredded monterey jack cheese | 4 lasagna noodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place zucchini in the baking pan. Drizzle 1 tablespoon lemon zest over zucchini. Top with 2 tablespoons cheese. Roast 30 minutes or till tender. Remove zucchini from oven, uncover, and top with remaining 2 tablespoons of cheese. Roast 15 minutes or till center is nicely browned. Sprinkle with remaining lemon zest. Serve with cooked pasta.

title: Chile Blueberry Cheese Dip
ingredients: 2 packages velveeta cheese | 1 can blueberries, drained | 1 can diced red chiles | 1 cup green olives, sliced | 1 cup celery, chopped
instructions: Brown velveeta in a saucepan, stirring to loosen. Stir in blueberries, red chilies, and olives.

title: Corn and Asparagus (Aubergine) on Toast
ingredients: 1 bunch asparagus, trimmed | mint sprig ( to garnish ) | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained
instructions: Trim and discard the tips of the asparagus and separate the ends from the tips by bending them under running a knife tip if you can. Trim the tips of the asparagus as you would cut your vegetables. Toast the asparagus in a large frying pan for a few minutes on each side until lightly browned and fragrant.

title: Shrimp and Avocado Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs medium shrimp, peeled, deveined | 1/2 green apple, peeled, cored and diced | 2 avocados, ripe, peeled and sliced | 1 tablespoon lemons, zest of, fresh, minced | 1 tablespoon minced chives
instructions: Drop shrimp into boiling water and blanch for about one minute. Immediately rinse and cool in cold water then drain and run under cold water until cool. Shrimp should be just cooked but still with tails. Slice and place on serving plate. Top with diced apple and chives. Serve cold.

title: Savoury Stuffed Veal Rolls
ingredients: 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 1/2 lb ground veal | 3 ounces cured goat cheese, crumbled | 2 tablespoons rum
instructions: Heat grill. Grill the veal meat until no longer pink. Spread a small portion of the goat cheese among the roll and roll up. Serve warm, or warm. Pour maple syrup over top of rolls, cover and refrigerate. Note, if freezing the rolls, cover with plastic wrap and place in freezer for several hours or overnight. When ready to grill, remove wrap from rolls and place in a container, resealable freezer bags. Defrost roll in refrigerator for about 30 minutes. When ready to serve, remove from freezer, remove cover, and place in freezer to defrost for about 20 minutes longer. Serve on your favorite meal. I prefer french rolls.

Random Ingredients: chicken thigh,onion soup mix,pine nut,cod,feta cheese,goat cheese
title: Cod Roulades
ingredients: 800 g cod, boned and skinned | 1 package onion soup mix | 4 tablespoons of grated natural goat cheese | 1 cup fresh pine nuts, toasted | 60 g crumbled feta cheese | 4 -6 skinned chicken thighs
instructions: Rinse the cod until the skin is clean. Cut into chunks and place in a large freezer bag. Mix the packet of onion soup mix with a little water and pour the mixture into the freezer bag. Add the goat cheese and pine nuts. Cut each piece of cod in half, lengthways. Place onto a large tray and place in the freezer bag. Place on your largest chopping board and cover with cling film. Allow it to rest in the fridge for 1/2 hour. Preheat the oven to 190c. Cut each piece of cod into 2cm thick strips. Place onto a tray, cover and refrigerate for another 15 minutes. Once your cod has chilled, place onto the tray with the fish and gently mix together. Bake for 3 - 5 minutes or until you are able to pierce a slit through the thickest part of the fish.

title: Mock Breadcrumbs Au Jus
ingredients: 1 cup plain whey | 1 cup panko breadcrumbs | 8 ounces cheddar cheese, cut into small dice | 4 teaspoons unsweetened cocoa | groundnuts or grated cheese, to sprinkle on top
instructions: Place the first measure of whey and panko into a medium saucepan then slowly add 1/2 cup of water and stir over high heat until it begins to bubble, then remove from the heat. Add the cheese and stir until melted and the cheese is smooth. Remove from the heat, then add the cocoa and stir until dissolved. Pour into a bowl, cool, then sprinkle with grated cheese.

Random Ingredients: vinegar,sun tomato,leg lamb,jasmine rice,fennel seed,garlic clove,apricot,pork shoulder
title: Lamb With Apricots and Fennel in Hot Tomato & Vinegar
ingredients: 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato, oil | 1/2 cup vinegar ( may use cider vinegar ) | 3 medium garlic cloves, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon fennel seed, crushed | 2 tablespoons dried apricots, chopped | 2 lbs leg of lamb, trimmed | 4 lbs boneless pork shoulder or 4 lbs pork chops, cut into 2-inch pieces | 8 cups jasmine rice ( may also use carnaroli rice, but they are sweeter )
instructions: Put sun dried tomatoes and vinegar into a saucepan, heat and bring to a boil. Add garlic and fennel.

title: Hot Chilli Powder - Salt Substitute
ingredients: 6 serrano chilies ( or 1 jalapenos or serrano chili ) | 2 tablespoons salt ( or to taste )
instructions: Grind chilli, jalapenos or chilies, or chillies with mortar and pestle. Keep in cool, dry place until needed.

Random Ingredients: angel hair pasta,baking soda,meatball,oregano leaf,beef stew meat,clove,coriander powder,cheese
title: Quick and Easy Greek Beef
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat, cubed | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 2 tablespoons oregano leaves | 2 tablespoons coriander powder | 2 whole cloves | 8 ounces cheese, cubed | 1 bag angel hair pasta
instructions: Cook pasta. Brown stew meat in olive oil over medium heat. Meanwhile in medium bowl mix all other dry ingredients together add meat and mix in the cheese. Bake in greased 9x13 pan until heated through, about 40 - 45 minutes. Serve over hot pasta.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast,red bell pepper,white vinegar,pesto sauce,lemon juice zest,red curry paste
title: Spicy Thai Chicken
ingredients: 2 boneless skinless chicken breasts | 1 jar prepared pesto sauce | 2 lemons, juice and zest of | 2 red bell peppers, halved deseeded | 2 packets red curry paste | 1/4 cup white vinegar
instructions: Slice the chicken breasts into thin strips. Preheat oven to 200 degc. Place the chicken in a large casserole dish with the pesto, lemon zest, peppers, curry paste and vinegar. Cover with foil and stir. Bake for 1 hour. Remove from oven and place under a bbq for an additional 10 - 15 minutes or until chicken is cooked through. Stir through the pesto.

title: Real Low Fat Fudge -- Easy!!!
ingredients: 1 lb nonfat milk | 3 tablespoons vanilla extract | 1 1//2 cups dry breadcrumbs
instructions: Heat milk until warm so it simmers down a bit for a while. Stir in vanilla. Then slowly add dry breadcrumbs. Place in a double boiler or in a cake pan. Cook just until breadcrumbs are dry. Remove from pot. Cut into squares and remove from pan. Store in an airtight container. These are wonderful for a week or two at room temperature. You can also freeze and reheat to create a solid, solid block of pudding for use.

title: Cape Malay
ingredients: 1 package knead fresh burdock root, cleaned | 1/4 cup grand marnier | 1 teaspoon freshly ground cayenne pepper | 1/2 cup chopped pistachio nuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Line a 9x9 inch baking dish with parchment paper. Peel the burdock root, and remove the tender part and very very tips, leaving the root intact. Slice off the tips and discard. Cut 1/4 inch from the top of the root with a sharp knife that is cut diagonally in 2 inch pieces. Place in the prepared dish, and stud the top with the grand marnier and cayenne pepper. Sprinkle with pistachios. Bake in the preheated oven until the roots have turned a shade of white, 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: chicken thigh,provolone cheese,german chocolate,italian bread,rotel tomato,bean sprout,marjoram,spinach
title: Italian Chicken Sandwich
ingredients: 1 loaf italian bread | 1 lb chicken thigh, boneless, skinless | 5 slices provolone cheese | 2 cans mixed beans sprouts, rinsed and drained | 2 -3 teaspoons fresh marjoram, chopped ( optional ) | 12 ounces rotel tomatoes, undrained | 1 package frozen chopped spinach, thawed | 4 ounces slicedgerman's sweet chocolate
instructions: Put bread onto cookie sheet. Arrange chicken thighs on the bread, cheese, mixed beans sprouts, and marjoram. Bake in 350°f oven until browned, about 15 minutes. Heat tomato sauce, stirring frequently, in a medium saucepan. Add spinach, cook for 1 minute. Spoon over chicken and sprinkle with chocolate. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: topping,curry powder,cornflour,flat leaf parsley,chinese five spice powder
title: Hot and Sour Cornflour Pies
ingredients: 500 ml warm cornflour ( cornstarch ) | 1 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons cornflour ( cornstarch ) | 1 tablespoon chopped flat leaf parsley | 1 tablespoon chopped flat leaf parsley
instructions: Combine cornflour with 5 spice, curry powder and cornflour. Knead to a soft dough. Cover with damp cloth and allow to rest at room temperature for 30 minutes. Divide dough into 4 equal portions. Roll each portion into a large thin circle around a stalk of finely chopped parsley. Place a piece of cornflour mixture down the center of each circle. Moisten the edge with cold water, fold over and twist the two opposite points to seal. If the biscuits have been baked ahead, preheat oven to 230c/450f and spray with oil. Bake on greased and floured tray for 15 - 20 minutes. Note, the mixture of cornflour and water will form a soft dough when the biscuits are baked.

Random Ingredients: snow pea,pomegranate seed,curry paste,bacon grease,jalapeno pepper
title: Easy Pomegranate Snow Pea Fingers
ingredients: 1 package frozen snow peas | 1 tablespoon bacon grease | 1 tablespoon pomegranate seeds | 1 tablespoon curry paste, or to taste | 1 jalapeno pepper, minced
instructions: Combine the snow peas, bacon grease, pomegranate seeds, curry paste, and jalapeno pepper in a food processor. Blend until smooth, stirring constantly. If desired, spread mixture onto a sheet of plastic wrap.

title: Easy Seasonable Bread Crumbs
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon italian seasoning ( optional, see note ) | 1 pre-baked pie crust, defrosted
instructions: Pre heat oven to 425°f degrees or 190°c. Place pie crust on cookie sheet. Sprinkle 1/2 tsp italian seasoning on top of crust. Pour 1/2 3/4 cups water into baking dish. Place baking dish in over. Bake approximately 20 minutes until crust is crusty.

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,rice flour,beet,iceberg lettuce,butter margarine,vegetable oil,beef stock,yellow zucchini
title: Swiss Pickled Beet & Zucchini
ingredients: 6 g butter margarine, melted | 1 liter beef stock | 2 tablespoons rice flour | 1 cup beet, peeled and thinly sliced | 5 g yellow zucchini, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup fresh oregano leaves | 1/4 cup iceberg lettuce
instructions: Pour melted butter into earthenware casserole dish. Cover with sliced beet & zucchini. Sprinkle over chopped oregano and a little of the warm meat stock. Cover and bake in a preheated oven for 30 - 40 mins or until heated through. Serve sliced beet topped with sliced zucchini, lettuce and remaining chopped oil & stock.

title: Quick Key Ramekin for One
ingredients: 6 hard-boiled eggs, diced | 6 tablespoons guacamole, divided | 1/2 chipotle chile in adobo, finely diced or 1/2 teaspoon pureed canned chipotle chile | 1 tablespoon raspberry jam or 1 tablespoon jam
instructions: Place egg in a small bowl, break yolk and mash with a fork and set aside. Mix together remaining ingredients and set aside. Sprinkle each ramekin with more cheese, if desired. Heat a nonstick skillet over medium high heat. When hot, add half of egg and swirl to coat. As soon as a second is inserted into the egg it will puff up like a souffle. Swirl skillet and continue to swirl. When bottom part of ramekin starts to crackle and crackle, remove from heat. Repeat with remaining egg, egg yolks and cheese. Slice egg into 5 slices. Serve with guacamole.

title: Homemade Quinoa
ingredients: 1/2 cup uncooked quinoa | 2 tablespoons braggs liquid aminos | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 tablespoon minced parsley leaves | 6 mint
instructions: Place quinoa in bowl of a food processor fitted with a finely chopping blade. Add braggs liquid aminos, mustard powder, parsley, and mint. Blend until mixture forms a thick paste. Turn the mixture into bowl with quinoa. Mix well and refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving. Serve cold.

Random Ingredients: clove,brown onion,red chile pepper,tomato sauce,chinese noodle,rice vermicelli
title: Chinese Glass Noodle and Tomato Soup
ingredients: 1 red chile pepper, seeded and finely chopped | 1/2 small brown onion, peeled and finely chopped | 2 cloves, crushed | 3 tablespoons tomato sauce | 1/2 pound dried rice vermicelli | 36 ounces tomato sauce
instructions: In a small saucepan over medium heat, place the red chile pepper, brown onion, cloves, and 1/2 cup tomato sauce and bring to a boil. Add the noodles and continue cooking over medium heat until tender, 5 to 10 minutes. Drain the noodles, reserving the liquid. Place the noodles in a large serving bowl, and add 1/2 cup of the reserved cooking liquid and stir until well combined. Pour the remaining 1/2 cup tomato sauce over the noodles and serve straight away.

title: Easy Microwave Tortilla Cakes
ingredients: 1 lb elbow macaroni | 1 jar frozen corn ( thawed ) | 1 packet limeade concentrate ( optional ) | 8 -10 hot tortilla chips
instructions: Place the first 4 ingredients in a 9 x 11 baking dish. Cover with the hot tortilla chips. Cook on high uncovered for 50 - 60 minutes.

title: Creamy Gorgonzola Onion Soup
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 yellow onion, sliced | 1 small onion, chopped ( for garnish ) | 1 pinch peppercorn | 8 cups beef stock ( or beef bouillon ) | 1/4 teaspoon palm sugar or 1/4 teaspoon brown sugar | 1/2 lb gorgonzola, sliced in 1/4 inch chunks
instructions: In a deep soup pot, heat oil and add sliced onions. Cook, stirring frequently, 20 - 30 minutes, or until onions are golden brown. Stir in onion and cook an additional 5 minutes, stirring constantly, adding chopped onion during the last 2 minutes of cooking. Add peppercorns to taste.

title: Chinese Turnip Chips
ingredients: 4 turnips, peeled and shredded | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons fish sauce
instructions: Place the shredded turnips in a bowl. Stir together the vinegar and fish sauce. Pour over the turnips to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Serve cold.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,corn tortilla chip,red chili,catsup,poblano pepper,wild rice,tomato paste
title: Mexican Restaurant Fondue
ingredients: 1 poblano pepper, cut into 4 pieces | 2 tablespoons catsup | 1/2 teaspoon red chili, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon tomato paste ( optional ) | 1/4 cup corn tortilla chips, coarsely crushed | 1 1/3 cups cooked wild rice | 1/2 cup fresh flat-leaf parsley, coarsely chopped, divided
instructions: Place poblano pepper, catsup, chili, tomato paste, tortilla chips, and 1/3 cup chopped parsley in a heavy skillet. Stir to blend. Over medium heat, cook until heated through. Stir until heated through. Pour into serving bowl, sprinkle with remaining parsley, and serve.

title: Penne With Peppers and Nuts
ingredients: 1/2 cup green cardamom | 16 ounces penne | 3 small red bell peppers, thinly sliced
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add the cardamom pods to the boiling water and let them cook 5 minutes. Drain. Toss the cardamom pods with the penne. Toss with the peppers and serve.

title: Easy and Fast Fajita Veggie and White Bean Filling
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1/4 cup diced onion | 2 cups frozen hash browns | 1 can white beans | 3 tablespoons lettuce | 1 tablespoon teaspoon onion powder
instructions: Heat the oil in a frypan over medium heat. Saute the onion for 2 minutes, or until tender crisp. Stir in the hash browns and white beans until lightly browned. Add the lettuce, onion powder and mix well. When the mixture is well heated, sprinkle with cheese and serve.

title: Pissaladiere (Meat Pies)
ingredients: 450 g lean meat, cut into small squares | 50 g basil leaves, washed
instructions: Place the meat in a colander and place it in the sink. Squeeze to express as much water as possible out of the meat. Leave to drain in the sink and dry lightly. Repeat this with the basil. Place the meat in a food processor and blend until it becomes a paste. Put the paste in serving dishes and sprinkle with a little more water. Serve with slices of your choice.

title: Kransekuchen (Red Wine Cake)
ingredients: 4 cups red wine | 4 cups cake flour
instructions: Mix wine flour and cake flour together. Knead until smooth. Roll to a thickness of 1/8 and cut into desired shapes. Bake on floured surface in a pre heated oven until lightly browned.

title: Kaffir Lime & Cinnamon Crumble
ingredients: 4 ounces shortcrust pastry | 12 -15 kaffir lime leaves | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1 tablespoon italian parsley, chopped
instructions: Roll out two thirds of pastry and line a 20 x 30 cm slice tin. Lightly prick base with a fork and bake at 180c for 15 - 25 minutes. Remove from oven and allow to cool. Squeeze limes over pastry & sprinkle with cinnamon & parsley.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,grain mustard,turmeric powder,phyllo dough,garlic powder,lemon peel,simple syrup,velveeta cheese
title: Davies II
ingredients: 2 packages store-bought phyllo dough | 1/2 cup vegetable stock | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 teaspoon lemon peel, grated | 12 ounces velveeta cheese, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 tablespoon simple syrup | 1 teaspoon grain mustard | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place phyllo sheets in a 1 1/2 quart baking dish and let dry at least 2 hours. Mix vegetable stock and turmeric powder in a small bowl. Lightly spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with nonstick spray and place half of phyllo sheets in dish. With a large spoon, cover phyllo with 2 layers of filo. Spread 1/2 of cheese cubes over phyllo sheets, covering them completely. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon of syrup and 1/2 teaspoon of mustard over cheese, then repeat layering, spraying with remaining 2 sheets of phyllo, ending with pastry. Bake 40 minutes or until top is golden.

Random Ingredients: green onion,corn oil,chicken thigh,caster sugar,strawberry,vanilla syrup,sugar,cornstarch
title: Mongolian Fried Chicken
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken thighs | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 1/4 cup cornstarch | 1 tablespoon vanilla-flavored syrup | 4 green onions, sliced ( including 1 tablespoon of the green part ) | 1 quart strawberry | 1/2 teaspoon sugar
instructions: Cut the chicken into thin shreds. Place in a bowl, add sugar, 1 1/2 tablespoons of cornstarch and a few tablespoons of corn oil and mix well. Toss with the remaining 2 tablespoons of cornstarch and chill until needed. Heat the second tablespoon of corn oil in a wok or frying pan and stir fry the chicken until just cooked through, about 4 minutes. Transfer to a plate. Make the sauce by combining the cornstarch and warm water in a cup with the sugar. Make sure the sugar is dissolved, otherwise it will make the sauce cloudy. Serve the sauce on the side, with the green onion slices. Garnish with strawberry slices and serve with sticky rice.

title: Cheater's Oaty Muffins
ingredients: 1 large egg white | sea salt | 1 cup porridge oats | 1 cup dried mixed fruit | 1 large dried mixed fruit | 1 cup sea salt or 1 cup sea salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place egg white in a medium sized mixing bowl, add salt of 1 cup of porridge oats, stir to combine. Add another cup of oats, stir for 2 - 3 minutes, remove from bowl then add mixed fruit and salt. Using a small ice cream scoop, scrape out 1/2 cup of mixed fruit. Mix into remaining oat porridge oats. Spoon 1/4 cup of mixed fruit mix into each 1/2 cup of lined muffin tin. Fill each tin 3/4 full. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes until firm.

title: Mushrooms for a Lonely Lady
ingredients: 2 tablespoons soft shortening | 1 whole hot chili pepper, or to taste, seeded and chopped | 10 button mushrooms, cleaned and trimmed
instructions: Place a skillet over medium high heat with a lid on the skillet. Mix in the shortening and hot chile. Pour in mushrooms, and cover skillet. Reduce heat to low, and simmer for 30 minutes.

title: Easy Fajita Seasoning Mix
ingredients: 1 packet taco seasoning ( spicy ) | 1/2 teaspoon salt and black pepper, or to taste
instructions: Spray large bowl with cooking spray. Stir in taco seasoning and salt and pepper. Let sit at room temperature 1 hour, then pour into a resealable plastic bag.

Random Ingredients: pork tenderloin,red chili pepper,roast beef,jicama,chipotle chile adobo,beef tenderloin
title: Hot Carnitas
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sweet beef, trimmed of fat | 1 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin, trimmed of fat | 1 1/2 lbs pork tenderloin | 1 - 1 1/2 cup jicama | 1 -3 canned chipotle chile in adobo | 1 -2 teaspoon dried red chili pepper | roasted jicama
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Cut the roast into eight medallions and slice the medallions into 12 medallions. Place the medallions on a roasting pan. Cut the beef into 12 medallions. Place the beef medallions on top of the medallions. Using the tip of a paring knife, gently pound each medallion to 1/8 1/4 inch thickness. Place the medallions on a sheet pan and put in the oven to bake for 20 - 30 minutes or until the meat juices run clear. While the roast is baking, combine the chipotle in adobo sauce with the chilies. Heat until the chilies are hot and the chilies are hot, stirring constantly. Brush the roast medallions with the sauce. Broil about 2 - 3 minutes or just until the meat is well browned. Place the roast on a platter and slice the medallions crosswise. Arrange the medallions on one platter and serve with the meat.

Random Ingredients: extra tofu,mustard,heavy whipping cream,castor sugar,leek,thyme,chunky peanut butter,oregano
title: Scrumptious Low Fat Tofu Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 box extra firm tofu, drained and pressed | 1 tablespoon dry minced leeks | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 tablespoon sweet grain mustard | 1 teaspoon castor sugar | 1 teaspoon finely chopped fresh thyme ( or 1 tsp dried ) | 1 teaspoon finely chopped fresh thyme ( or 1/2 tsp dried ) | 1 cup chunky peanut butter | 2 teaspoons oregano
instructions: Grease and flour 13 x 9 inch baking dish. Place the tofu in a mixing bowl, mash, and set aside. Add leek and beat until soft. Add remaining ingredients and mix until well blended. Pour into prepared pan. Bakes at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 30 - 40 minutes. Remove and let cool for 10 minutes. Remove sides and top and chill. Cut into cubes while still warm. If needed, remove and discard crusts. If desired ice cheesecake.

title: Crab Cakes With Vanilla
ingredients: 1 lb crabmeat, finely minced | 1/2 cup mango, finely chopped | 1/2 cup coriander powder | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla bean, finely chopped ( or other seeds in the juice ) | 2 tablespoons peanut oil
instructions: Mix all ingredients together, using hands. Make small patty shapes of the crab meat. Heat the oil in a skillet until very hot on stove top. Cook the crab cakes on each side until golden brown and just cooked through note i had to check for doneness.

Random Ingredients: blue cheese,sherry wine vinegar,baby portabella mushroom,white mushroom,pea,lemonade,matzo meal,farfalle pasta
title: Elegant Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 8 ounces farfalle pasta ( bow tie style ) | 1 package frozen mixed baby portabella mushrooms, thawed | 1 lb extra lean ground beef | 2 teaspoons sherry wine vinegar | 2 packages frozen peas, thawed | 13 1/2 ounces canned lemonade | 6 ounces baby portabella mushrooms, cleaned, trimmed | 1/4 cup matzo meal
instructions: In a large resealable plastic bag, combine the farfalle with the 2 pints water, making sure each package is coated with the marinade. Close close the bag, and refrigerate until the farfalle are cold, 24 hrs to overnight. Preheat the grill to high. Remove the farfalle from the bag, reserving the marinade, and drain the oil in a large pot over medium low heat. Add the beef and cook, breaking up any clumps of meat with the back of a wooden spoon, until browned, 20 - 25 minutes. Add the reserved marinade, vinegar, and peas and bring to a boil. Lower the heat, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes. Dice the remaining 2 pints of mushrooms, then stir into the sauce. Simmer for 2 minutes on low heat. Sprinkle with matzoh meal, and serve over pasta with a vegetable side.

title: Simmered Chicken
ingredients: 1 cup sliced bread, toasted | 1 cup frozen green pea, thawed | 3 -4 lbs chicken tenders | 3 tablespoons dry sherry | 2 tablespoons dry red wine | 1 -2 cup dashi
instructions: In a shallow nonmetal baking dish or serving platter, evenly spread the bread slices with frozen peas. Arrange chicken on the bread, sprinkle on the sherry, and top with the red wine. Add enough water to cover the chicken loosely. Preheat oven to 350 degrees/. Bring the dashi to a boil in a small, heavy saucepan. Add the chicken to the dashi, cover pan, and place in a preheated oven for about 45 minutes. Serve over steamed rice.

Random Ingredients: andouille sausage,kalamata olive,spinach leaf,chocolate,cajun seasoning,chicken stock
title: Jambalaya Soup
ingredients: 2 cups chicken stock | 1 pound andouille sausage, sliced | 1/2 cup kalamata olives, pitted | 1 tablespoon cajun seasoning | 1 package frozen chopped spinach leaves | 1/2 square semisweet chocolate square, chopped
instructions: Combine chicken stock and sausage in a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium low, and simmer about 10 minutes. Stir olives into the soup. Season with cajun seasoning. Mix spinach into the soup. Bring to a boil over low heat, and serve.

title: Salmon Tacos
ingredients: 1 cup thinly-sliced salmon fillet | 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice | 1 tortillas, warmed or 1 flour tortilla, warmed
instructions: Combine salmon and lime juice in small bowl. Heat a heavy skillet over low heat until just hot. Brush tortilla with a small amount of the salmon olive oil. Spread with a thin layer of the salmon mixture.

Random Ingredients: alfredo sauce,canadian bacon,dill,stock,vegetable oil,jasmine rice,italian tomato
title: Bacon, Tomato and Herb Spanish Rice
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 2 slices italian-style bacon, cut crosswise into 1-inch pieces | 2 cups jasmine rice | 1 cup alfredo sauce | 1 can italian-style stewed tomatoes ( undrained ) | 1 can diced tomatoes with jalapenos ( undrained ) | 1/4 cup dill, fresh, chopped
instructions: In a large, deep skillet, heat oil over medium heat until hot and sauté bacon until crisp. Using a slotted spoon, transfer bacon to a paper towel lined plate, leaving fat in skillet. Discard fat then sauté rice and alfredo sauce, stirring until hot. Add tomatoes with jalapeños and bring to a simmer. Cover and cook over medium low heat 5 minutes until alfredo sauce is hot. Add bacon and dill.

Random Ingredients: german chocolate,spanish paprika,superfine sugar,dark soy sauce,hard egg,lima bean,sirloin steak,tea
title: Steak Flambe
ingredients: 2 1/3 lbs sirloin steaks, cut to 1/4-inch slices | 1 teaspoon whole german sweet paprika | 12 fluid ounces light soy sauce | 4 ounces spanish paprika | 3/4 cup dark sweet soy sauce | 12 fluid ounces bottled tea | 9 fluid ounces roasted wood pea paste ( or use canned peas and chopped hard boiled eggs ) or 10 fluid ounces hot strong tea ( or use canned peas and chopped hard boiled eggs ) | 6 ounces finely grated superfine sugar | 1 -2 hard-boiled egg, cut into wedges
instructions: Brush steaks lightly with vegetable oil and sprinkle with 1/2 tsp whole german sweet paprika. Place in a shallow dish and marinate for at least one hour. Combine all the remaining ingredients in a saucepan and cook on low heat, stirring continuously, until steaks are tender and sauce has reduced somewhat in volume. Do not cook longer than desired temperature, or steaks will toughen. Lightly oil rack in a broiler pan. Cook steaks in hot oil, turning once, over high heat until cooked as desired, 3 to 5 minutes per side for medium rare, or 5 to 7 minutes per side for medium. Serve steaks warm on a bed of rice, with sweet red wine and garnish with egg wedges. Variation, for an extra flavor, stir chopped hard boiled eggs into sauce, if desired, and serve over steaks. Use leftover sauce and serve over boiled potatoes.

Random Ingredients: green onion,green chili pepper,water,jasmine rice,tarragon,shimeji mushroom
title: Easy Shoyu Rice  (Mushroom, Tarragon )
ingredients: 1 cup jasmine rice | 3 cups boiling water ( more or less depending on amount of water used, use as needed ) | 1 tablespoon tarragon | 1/2 teaspoon green chili pepper, sliced vertically and seeds removed ( optional, but better with it ) | 3 shimeji mushrooms, sliced ( optional ) | 3 green onions, chopped
instructions: Combine rinsed rice, hot water and tarragon in rice cooker. Press start and check if water is absorbed, adding more water as needed. When rice is almost ready, remove lid and add shimeji, mushrooms and green onions. Stir rice. Serve, i like to sprinkle more fresh, minced garlic. I also add an Asian herb or garlic salt called shoyu. This is a little bit more than the regular kind of rice, but not enough to bring the rice to a full boil.

Random Ingredients: caster sugar,salami,caraway seed,ice water,maraschino cherry,kalamata olive,baking potato
title: Potato Salami Sandwiches (Potatoes and Salami)
ingredients: 1/2 lb salami, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup maraschino cherry, halved | 1/3 cup kalamata olive, halved | 1 teaspoon caraway seed | 4 large baking potatoes, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1/2 cup caster sugar | 2 tablespoons ice water
instructions: Place the salami, cherry and kalamata olives in a small heatproof bowl. Sprinkle with the caraway seeds. Set aside. Boil the potato pieces in salted water, until almost tender, about 15 to 20 minutes. Drain, and cool slightly. Cut the potato slices in half lengthwise. Transfer to a clean dish, then set them out to dry and dry out for about 5 minutes. Dry the salami. Sprinkle on the sugar. Mix half of the ice water with the remaining ice water, and then stir in the potato pieces. Mash in the potato and salami mash with a wooden spoon to combine. Form into 4 patties about 3/4 inch thick. Place on baking sheets lined with parchment paper, and put into the freezer. Repeat with remaining potato. Makes 24 servings, 4 servings.

title: Scallops With Chili and Chili
ingredients: 4 egg whites | 1/4 cup kirsch | 1/2 teaspoon mexican chili powder | 1/2 lb scallops | 2 tablespoons fish sauce
instructions: Beat the egg whites with the kirsch until stiff peaks form. Pour 1/2 cup of the the beaten mixture into the egg whites and spread into a greased 8 x8 pyrex dish. Sprinkle the chili powder on top of this. Bake at 325f until puffed and the edges are brown, about 50 minutes. Remove from oven and carefully remove the scallops, set aside. Pour remaining chili onto the scallops. Serve with dipping sauce.

title: Havarti Soup
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable broth | 3/4 cup havarti cheese, finely shredded or 2 ounces other mild cheese | 6 cups chicken stock | 3/4 cup all-purpose flour
instructions: Cook in large pot, broth and chees all on low med heat for at least 10 minutes or until soup has thickest parts & cheese is melting. Stir in flour until smooth, then add more broth or water depending on your desired thickness.

Random Ingredients: maple syrup,pepperoni,hard egg,besan flour,artichoke heart,basmati rice,dark soy sauce,cumin powder
title: Artichoke-Kabobs
ingredients: 3 lbs fresh artichoke hearts | 5 fresh sweet peppers ( we like red or green ) | 2 hard-boiled eggs, cut in halves | 6 tablespoons besan flour | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 1/4 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/2 - 1 cup fresh basil or 1/2-1 cup fresh coriander, roughly chopped
instructions: Wash the artichokes well and cut off the tops and lower layers. Dip each artichoke one at a time in boiling water for 30 seconds. The water should run clear. Drain and set aside. Chop the artichokes and sweet peppers. Combine all the dry ingredients and knead well to combine. Divide among the artichokes, placing them in an oiled grilling pan. Heat 1 or 2 tablespoons oil over medium heat and cook artichokes and sweet peppers for 5 minutes. Place the eggs on top of artichokes and peppers. Cook until eggs are no longer translucent and peppers are tender. If using fresh peppers, place them on a cookie sheet in a oven preheated to 400 degrees. Cook for about 20 minutes or until cooked through. If using frozen artichokes and sweet peppers, place in individual bowls after taking it out of the oven to thaw a little. Pile up in the hot greens on a platter and serve.

title: Mexican Pork and Quinoa Casserole
ingredients: 2 1/2 tablespoons vegetable shortening | 2/3 cup hot cooked quinoa, rinsed and drained | 2/3 pound ground pork | 2 small heads cabbage, cored and coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Lightly grease a 2 quart baking dish. Line bottom of baking dish with reynolds wrap foil. Combine shortening and quinoa in a bowl and add pork, stirring to crumbs.

Random Ingredients: oil,irish whiskey,nicoise olive,green pepper,onion soup mix,icing sugar,black pepper,focaccia bread
title: Avocado Club Italian Breadsticks
ingredients: 1 loaf focaccia bread, cut of the loaf crust | 3 tablespoons oil | 1/8 teaspoon freshly grated black pepper | 1 package onion soup mix, powder | 1/4 cup irish whiskey | 3 green peppers, seeded and chopped | 1 cup chopped nicoise olives | 1 cup icing sugar, sifted
instructions: Remove and discard top crust from loaf of loaf and discard. Slice loaf into 1/4 inch slices and set aside. Place olive oil and freshly grated black pepper in small bowl. Dip slices of bread into mixture and then into icing sugar. Place under broiler until lightly browned and crisp.

title: Tortillas for One
ingredients: 1 pound pork sausage | 36 tortillas | 1 cup white vinegar | 1 cup golden syrup
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Place the casings on two large baking sheets. Slice the meat into 1 inch pieces. Dip the pieces into the vinegar, one at a time, until the meat is coated with vinegar, but not soaked. Arrange slices on the baking sheets, and bake in the preheated oven for 20 to 25 minutes, or until browned. When ready to serve, heat the dark golden syrup in a saucepan over medium heat. Remove from the heat, and pour into a serving bowl. Place tortillas on plates, and ladle the sauce over them.

title: Peanut Butter Shortbread
ingredients: 12 ounces flour | 1/2 cup flour | 1/2 cup butter, softened | 3 ounces peanut butter ( a creamy variety will do ) | 2 tablespoons dry red wine ( or 2 tbsp lemon juice ) | 1 teaspoon fresh thyme leave ( or 2 tsp. dried )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Roll into log on a piece of wax paper. Cut into 12 rounds or 1/4 thickness. Place on ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 250 degrees fahrenheit for 12 minutes. Cool.

title: Turnips and Barbeque
ingredients: 2 turnips - peeled, seeded and thinly sliced | 1/4 cup brown sugar | 1 tablespoon garlic powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place the turnips and brown sugar into a 9x13 inch baking dish and sprinkle with garlic powder. Bake in the preheated oven until tender and browned, about 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: grape leaf,sun tomato oil,mushroom stem,rotel tomato,chicken stock,greek yogurt,spiral pasta
title: Rustic Spiral Pasta
ingredients: 6 cups chicken stock | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, chopped | 3 mushrooms stems, chopped | 2 cans rotel tomatoes, drained and rinsed | 1 package spirals pasta ( spaghetti ) | 1 container greek yogurt | 1/4 cup grape leaves, drained ( optional )
instructions: In dutch oven, combine stock, sun dried tomatoes, mushrooms, and rotel tomatoes. Bring to low boil, cook over medium heat for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, bring 2 cups water to boil. Add spiral noodles, and cook until just tender, about 8 to 10 minutes. Drain, and stir in cheese, yoghurt, and grape leaves. Serve.

Random Ingredients: ketchup,lettuce,red bell pepper,quinoa,red chilies,apple,baker german chocolate,chocolate
title: German Quinoa Salad
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa ( japanese ) | 6 red red red chilies | 1 red bell pepper | 1/4 lb baker's german semi-sweet chocolate | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 1 tablespoon red bell pepper ( julienned ) | shredded lettuce | grated chocolate ( optional )
instructions: Rinse the quinoa. Place in a sieve, rinse and drain. Cut the chillies into half lengthwise and slice the halves into four wedges. Place the quinoa in a small saucepan, add enough water to cover and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat and cook, stirring occasionally, until done. Drain the quinoa. Set aside. Cut the red chilies and red bell pepper into four pieces. Remove the seeds from the chilies and slice into strips. Place in a bowl. In a separate bowl, stir the ketchup and red bell pepper into the quinoa. Pour the mixed ingredients over the quinoa and stir to coat evenly. Garnish with shredded chocolate if using and serve.

title: Chinese Pizza
ingredients: 1 ounce chocolate, baking powder or 3 tablespoons butter, melted | 1 tablespoon light soy sauce | 1 tablespoon tomato puree, to make pizza sauce
instructions: Heat oven 180°c. In small bowl stir together chocolate, soy sauce and tomato puree. Stir in the chocolate mixture and pour into oven proof pizza base. Bake on middle rack 15 - 20 minutes or until crust is crisp and golden.

Random Ingredients: green chili salsa,blue cheese,guacamole,beef bouillon cube,half cream,oil,gorgonzola,onion salt
title: Blue Cheese Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef ( or more, depending on how much meat you have ) | 2 tablespoons grated fresh gorgonzola | 2 tablespoons chopped green chili salsa | 2 tablespoons half-and-half cream | 1 medium onion salt | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1/4 cup oil | 1/4 cup fresh gorgonzola, chopped | 1/4 cup green chili salsa | guacamole
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Combine ground meat, 2 tbls. Crusty fresh cheese, 2 tbls. Salsa and 1/4 cup half and half. Mix well. Heat 1/2 t oil in a large skillet. Add onion salt. Cook until translucent. Pour meat mixture into a mixing bowl with the cheese mixture. In a small bowl, combine bouillon cube with hot water. Stir into the cheese mixture. Heat 1/4 cup oil in skillet. Place the meat/cheese mixture into the hot oil and pour in the half and half mixture. Cook until sauce thickens. Place 1/2 cup cheese mixture onto a plate. Using hands, roll half the sauce in the cheese. Place onto the sauce in the greased baking dish. Repeat with the rest of the cheese mixture. Pour remainder of sauce over tortillas on top. Top with the chopped black olives on top. Bake until cheese and sauce are heated through, about 30 minutes.

title: Italian Vegetable Barbecue
ingredients: 1 pound frozen italian-style vegetables, thawed and drained | 1 cup reduced-sodium bean liquid | 1/2 cup corn syrup | 1/4 cup light italian dressing
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place frozen vegetables in a slow cooker, and pour prepared Italian dressing over the vegetables. Cover, and cook on low 4 hours.

Random Ingredients: sugar,ciabatta,ocean spray cranberry juice,parmigiano reggiano cheese,non vanilla yogurt,key lime juice,mint,basil
title: Ocean Spray Cranberry-Yogurt-Herb Bread
ingredients: 1 ciabatta, loaf | non-fat vanilla yogurt | 8 mint, whole fresh mint | 1/2 cup ocean spray cranberry juice ( optional ) | 1/3 cup sugar ( or less to taste ) | 1/2 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated | fresh basil, whole | key lime juice
instructions: Preheat the broiler on high. Lightly toast the ciabatta in the oven until soft and slightly browned, 5 to 8 minutes, turning once. Set the bread aside. Place the mint, ocean spray, and sugar in the bowl of a blender or food processor. Mix until smooth. Spread the yogurt over the bread, then sprinkle with the shaved parmigiano reggiano, basil, and key lime juice. Place under the broiler until the toppings are bubbly, about 5 minutes.

title: Tex Mex Baked Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup medium grain rice ( i use trader joe's ready rice ) | 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 1/4 cup coriander leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Bring 2 cups of water to a boil. Add rice and taco seasoning mix. Bring to a boil again, then quickly place lid on and transfer back to the oven. Bake for 10 - 12 minutes, or until liquid is absorbed. Sprinkle with coriander leaves and serve.

title: Langosteen Rouladen
ingredients: 1 cup chicken wings ( cut into single pieces ) | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon dark rum | 1/2 cup dark rum | 1 cup chopped mixed fruit ( peeled or frozen ) | 6 egg yolks, beaten | 2 cups soup, diluted with | 1 tablespoon dark rum
instructions: Dry wings with damp cloth or paper towels and pat dry with paper towels. Place mustard seeds in small dry pan over medium heat and cook, stirring, until popping and blackened, about 2 minutes. Remove mustard seeds with slotted spoon and place in a sieve. Turn heat to lowest setting and let cool, stirring often, 20 minutes. Combine 1/2 cup rum with 1 tablespoon dark rum and set aside. Combine egg yolks, 1/2 cup water and remaining rum in a bowl. Gradually whisk 1/4 cup rum mixture into egg yolks and whisk until mixture thickens, 1 to 2 minutes. Stir about 1/4 cup rum mixture into egg mixture. Transfer to a 4 quart slow cooker. Stir in remaining 1/4 cup rum. Add chicken wings. Cover and cook on high until wings are tender and beginning to brown on top, about 3 hours. Turn off heat and let stand 5 minutes. Place a piece of kitchen twine on a plate and dip chicken wings several at a time. Lift wings out with forks and roll in reserved 1/2 cup rum mixture. Place on a platter, cover with plastic wrap and let stand at room temperature until cool, about 24 hours. Serve chicken wings warm.

title: Steak With Beer Marinade and Cherry Salsa
ingredients: 2 lbs chuck | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 tablespoon basil | 1 can good dark beer | 1 jar maraschino cherries
instructions: Heat oven to season chuck with garlic powder and basil. Rub half the marinated chuck roast with beer and put in roasting pan with lid. Roast in 350 degree f oven for 1 hour and reduce heat to 300 degrees and bake 1 hour more or until meat thermometer reaches 130 degree f for medium rare and 160 degrees f for medium well or you may need to insert meat thermometer into meat without touching or else your roast will be too watery. Let stand on a rack for 2 hours, and slice.

title: Anaheim Chocolate Oyster
ingredients: 4 medium oysters, shucked, with liquid reserved | 2 small tart apples, coarsely chopped ( preferably bramley's or mcintosh ) | 2 small anaheim chilies or 2 small small poblano chilies, seeded and cut into 1/8 inch slices | 1 1/2 tablespoons cocoa powder ( preferably dutch-process cocoa ) | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: In medium non aluminum metal bowl combine the oysters with the remaining ingredients and shake to combine. Arrange the oysters, apples, chilies and cocoa mixture over hot plates and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: parsley,orange extract,angel hair pasta,pinto bean,spanish onion
title: Angel Hair and Beans With Parsley
ingredients: 8 ounces angel hair pasta | 7 ounces pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 1/4 spanish onion, finely chopped | 1/4 cup fresh parsley, chopped
instructions: Cook or steam angel hair pasta as directed on package. While pasta is cooking, heat beans and onion in oil in large skillet over medium heat. Stir in parsley. Drain pasta and beans. Add onion mixture, breaking apart as necessary.

title: Green Lentils and Noodle Bake
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil ( or use olive oil ) | 12 ounces green lentils, rinsed, picked over | 3 -4 cups wide egg noodles
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the lentils to the pan and fry on all sides, until they are lightly browned. Add 3 cups water, cover and simmer until tender. While the lentils are cooking, cook the egg noodles according to the package directions. When the noodles are cooked, drain and return to the pot. Cover and warm until noodles are warm. Add more water if it becomes too dry. Serve warm.

title: Dijon Cantaloupe Salad
ingredients: 1 medium cantaloupe ( peeled, seeded, and sliced ) | 2 pints ricotta cheese | 1/4 lb bacon ( crispy & chopped ) | 2 teaspoons dijon mustard | 2 tablespoons apple juice | 1 teaspoon grated ginger ( fresh )
instructions: Slice cantaloupe in half and remove stones. Slice bacon into small pieces and fry in a frying pan till crispy & set aside. Add mustard & apple juice, ginger, and mix well. Add ricotta & mix. Chill for 1 hour to allow flavors to blend.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,mango chutney,sauce,spanish onion,honey,poblano chile,snow pea,chive
title: Mexican Onion and Peanut Dip
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sautéed spanish onions | 2 teaspoons honey | 3 tablespoons tomato and green chilies, chopped | 3 tablespoons mango chutney | 3 tablespoons mango chutney | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh chives | 1 tablespoon hot sauce | 1 large poblano chile, roasted, peeled, deveined and chopped | 1 package fresh snow peas, trimmed
instructions: Combine the sautéed sliced onions, 3 tablespoons honey, tomato and green chilies, 1 tablespoon mango chutney, 3 tablespoon mango chutney, hot sauce, poblano chile, and snow peas in a food processor. Cover and pulse once or twice to combine. Serve warm or chilled.

Random Ingredients: orange zest,chicken bouillon granule,mayonnaise,kidney bean,kaffir lime leaf
title: Red Lobster Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups mayonnaise | 2 tablespoons dried kaffir lime leaves | 1 tablespoon orange zest, minced | 1 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon granules | 2 cans kidney beans, drained, rinsed
instructions: In medium bowl, mix mayonnaise with lime leaves, orange zest, chicken bouillon, and kidney beans. Chill about 3 hours or overnight. Serve with pita chips or prawns for dipping.

title: Spicy Wedges
ingredients: 1 unbaked pastry for a 9 inch double crust pie | 1 red potato, cut into wedges | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 1/8 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 tablespoon sweetened condensed milk
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f in a large bowl, toss potato wedges with chili oil. Sprinkle evenly with nutmeg. Roll pieces of potato wedge crosswise to coat both sides. Bake potato wedges in the preheated oven 20 minutes, until beginning to firm. Turn wedges, and bake 10 minutes, or until golden brown. Serve wedges with sweetened condensed milk.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,beef stew meat,lime wedge
title: Mom's Beef N' Kowlies
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat, cubed | 3 cans cream of chicken soup | 5 lime wedges ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients, except the lime wedges, in a slow cooker. Cover and cook on low 6 - 8 hours. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: french baguette,beef stock,egg noodle,beef tenderloin steak,red wine,tomato paste,tea,anise seed
title: Quick Beef-Aduck Au Jus
ingredients: 12 ounces lean beef tenderloin steaks | 1 egg noodle | 16 fluid ounces beef stock | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1/4 teaspoon anise seed | 1/4 teaspoon french baguette | 1 fluid ounce dry red wine
instructions: Trim fat from steaks. Cut steak into 8 slices and then across into 1/2 inch strips. Rinse noodles under cold running water to clean. Soak, uncovered with more cold running water for 2 minutes. Drain thoroughly. Bring beef stock to a boil in a small saucepan. Remove from heat, add noodle and set aside. In medium sized heavy pot, heat oil over high heat. Add steak and fry until browned, about 2 minutes per side for med rare. Remove steak and set aside. Add tomato paste, anise, and a pinch of salt to the broth drippings. Turn down heat to medium low and simmer until sauce thickens about 3 - 4 minutes. Add steak and noodles. Add wine. Cover and simmer for 3 - 5 minutes to heat through. Serve with bread.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,celery,juice,romaine lettuce,gingerroot,asafoetida powder,ham,baking soda
title: Easy Crunchy and Crispy KO Points
ingredients: 1 teaspoon gingerroot, chopped fine | 2 tablespoons pecorino romano cheese, shredded | 1 teaspoon celery, shredded | 1 teaspoon rice-oaked rice-oaked rice-overs | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon baking soda | juice ( lots ) | 1 head romaine lettuce
instructions: In a bowl, stir together ginger, pecorino, cheese, celery, rice oats, asafetida and baking soda. Spoon onto lettuce leaves and roll up. Eat while still warm.

title: Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 1/2 cup sliced yellow pepper | 1/4 cup diced yellow pepper
instructions: Place chopped peppers and diced butter on a serving platter.

title: Corn Crusted Roasted Beef Filet Mignon
ingredients: 3 lbs filet mignon, trimmed ( sirloin steak cut into 6 equal portions ) | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 3/4 cup golden raisin | 3 tablespoons all purpose greek seasoning | freshly crushed greek seasoning
instructions: Prepare grill. Place meat on grill rack and sprinkle both sides with greek seasoning. Grill over medium heat for 8 minutes per side or until internal temperature reaches 140 degrees f, brushing frequently with oil. Brush with greek seasoning and rest on a platter. Cut crosswise into 1/4 inch thick slices.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,fontina cheese,maple syrup,orange peel,manchego cheese,bread,raisin
title: Capirotada
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs manchego cheese, in cubes | 1/4 lb fontina cheese, in cubes | 1/2 cup raisins ( fresh or dried, soaked in warm water until plump, drained ) | 1/4 cup dried orange peel | 1/4 - 1/2 cup maple syrup ( to taste ) ( optional ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 4 -8 slices of toasted bread
instructions: Cube the cheese and place in a large, deep skillet. Add raisins, orange peel, bread slices and the rest of the ingredients. Cover and simmer over medium low heat for 20 minutes until thick and cheese is bubbling. Serve warm, at room temperature.

title: White American Cheese Appetizer
ingredients: 1/2 lb american cheese, cubed | 1 small orange peel, sliced | 2 cups mixed candied fruit
instructions: Poke holes in cheese with a fork. Sprinkle a few strips of orange peel on top and distribute evenly over the cheese. Place the candied fruit over top and press the cheese down slightly. Wrap individually and freeze. You should be able to unwrap the cheese before using.

Random Ingredients: cottage cheese,worcestershire sauce,bacon,macaroni cheese,coriander powder,epazote,nonfat cream,green curry paste
title: Macaroni Cheese With Cheese, Bacon and Horsesh
ingredients: 500 -750 g macaroni cheese | 125 g cottage cheese | 4 slices bacon | 2 tablespoons green curry paste | 2 handfuls nonfat sour cream | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Cook macaroni until firm in salted water. Drain and add cottage cheese to water. Heat bacon in a pan. Remove pieces of fat from the bacon and fry in bacon fat until the bacon pieces are crispy and start separating from the fat. Turn off the heat. Add green curry paste to the bacon grease and stir until heated. Add sour cream and wesson while stirring. Add coriander powder and turmeric powder, mix well and add to the cheese mixture. Serve.

Random Ingredients: green pea,chinese mushroom,marjoram,heavy cream,thai red curry paste
title: Spicy Red Pea Soup
ingredients: 1 cup frozen green peas | 1/2 cup thinly sliced chinese mushrooms | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh marjoram or 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram | 10 1/2 ounces condensed thai red curry paste | 1 tablespoon heavy cream
instructions: Place peas in a medium saucepan. Add mushrooms and marjoram. Cover and microwave on high power for 12 minutes. Stir and microwave for another 5 minutes or until peas are tender. Stir in the cream and reheat. Stir and serve.

Random Ingredients: parmesan romano cheese mix,celery rib,lamb,clam,cinnamon,black peppercorn,chili pepper flake,thai fish sauce
title: Pine Clam Sauce With Lamb
ingredients: 6 tablespoons chili pepper flakes | 2 1/2 cans chopped clams | 1 medium celery rib | 2 tablespoons dried minced chili pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon ground cinnamon | 1/2 cup of coarsely grated parmesan-romano cheese mix | 1/2 cup of coarsely grated thai fish sauce | 1/2 cup finely grated parmesan romano cheese mix | 14 -16 dried hot red pepper flakes | 1/4 cup of coarsely ground black peppercorns
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients in a bowl add all ingredients and stir. Chill and add to your favorite fresh vegetable of choice.

title: Easy Beef Beetroot Braid
ingredients: 600 g buddig beef | 600 g beets
instructions: Slice meat into about 16 slices. Put a piece of tin foil on top of a baster at about 5 centimetre/9 in thickness. Take a beetroot and if any of the four squares come in slices that's roughly right. Use your hand to push the slices to the edges to seal up the foil. This will be challenge for a knife or beater. If you're using a knife, take the beef out of the foil and slice off the top of it if you don't like the bite, put it back into the foil and give it a slice. You'll need to cut every slice of beef so the pieces meet at the top of the foil so they don't stick. Don't worry if they do. You'll just need to end up with a mixture of beef and a beetroot shaped braid. If you're using a bread pan, put it in the bread pan so you can just take the pieces out of the foil and put them on the foil on. When all the braid is removed, put on the lid. Put in the oven and allow to bake until the braid is cooked. While this is happening, wash beats and get each pound out of the food making sure the tops are as dark as you like them. I take a piece of beetroot and poke holes in them. These don't even taste good when they're raw, but it's no problem. Cut the braid into 2 or 3 smaller squares while the braid is cooling. It doesn't matter if all the pieces get eaten. This braid doesn't actually make an army, if it does, the bottom will be a bit crunchy. Eat it when it's warm and has a bit of bite to it.

title: Broccoli Caesaral
ingredients: 1 head broccoli, trimmed and cut into florets | 1/4 cup white sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Place the broccoli in the baking sheet, and drizzle with a little olive oil. Sprinkle with a little sea salt. Bake broccoli for about 25 minutes in the preheated oven, until tender.

title: Tortilla Shells
ingredients: pastry for a 9 inch double crust pie | 1 can baked beans | 2 cans baby onions, drained | 1 1/2 cups thousand island dressing, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Open the bottom crust of a 9 inch pastry crust pie crust to level. Spread the baked beans into the crust, and top with the onion. Pour in the dressing, and spread evenly to fill the pastry. Bake in the preheated oven until the crust has risen, and the bean filling has begun to turn brown, 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Irish Fruit Punch - Jackie French
ingredients: 2 -6 large firm fresh fruit, such as strawberries, blueberries, raspberries with raspberries, pineapple, lemon peel, purple hulls, sliced peel, etc | ice water
instructions: In a large punch bowl, gently stir fruit so that it is coated with juice and begins to soften. Using a strainer set over a bowl, press pulp through several layers of sieve. Refrigerate until cool or place in your punch tins and freeze until solid. Turn out of freezer and put into a container that has been coated with juice and ice water to hold everything in one layer.. Serve cold and toss with soda. Note, use fresh fruit that has been sliced in rounds about 1/4 inch thick and that has been peeled or cut into cubes.

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,cornstarch,taco seasoning mix,tamarind paste,scallion,couscous,nori,pistachio nut
title: Nori Stuffed Onions
ingredients: 3 large sweet onions | 1/4 cup purchased tamarind paste | 1/4 cup commercial almond spread or 1/4 cup nori | 1/4 cup shelled crushed pistachio nuts | 1 1/2 tablespoons cornstarch | 3 tablespoons commercial taco seasoning mix | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/4 - 1/2 cup scallions, minced
instructions: Remove tops from onions, using a spoon to scrape away the browned outer layers. Using a vegetable peeler, peel off outer layers. Cut a 2 x 2 inch piece off the root end, and place 1 tablespoon of tamarind cut side up onto the root end of each onion, cutting in half from top to bottom. Repeat with remaining onions. Place in a bowl and cover.

title: Shrimp and Okra Cannelloni
ingredients: 1 package lasagna noodles | 1 pound frozen okra | 1 can sauerkraut, drained | 1/2 tablespoon palm sugar | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/3 cup chopped fresh parsley, for garnish
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: spice,basil,corn syrup,cream cheese,daikon radish,red bean,demerara sugar,mascarpone cheese
title: Red Bean Salad
ingredients: 10 ounces red beans, drained and washed | 2 ounces cream cheese | 1 cup mascarpone cheese or 1 cup gorgonzola, crumbs | 2 tablespoons demerara sugar or 2 tablespoons light golden caster sugar ( super -fine sugar ) | 1 tablespoon light corn syrup | 1/2 teaspoon spice | 1 tablespoon basil, shredded
instructions: Blend all ingredients together until well combined. Put in fridge to chill for 4 hours or in fridge overnight to allow flavours to work out if required. Serve chilled.

title: Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 lb velveeta cheese | 2 tablespoons lemon juice ( fresh, if available )
instructions: Melt 1 pound of the cheese and lemon juice together. Add the rest of the ingredients slowly and mix well. Note, this is a slightly thicker cheese than your Velveeta though the taste is identical. If you want, you can put the rest of the cheese in a ziplock bag with the lemon and cheese mixture. It will keep in the fridge for a few days or until you are ready to eat it.

title: Chipotle Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 lb mushroom | 3 chipotle hot sauce | 1 tablespoon adobo seasoning | 1 tablespoon confectioners'sugar
instructions: Wipe the mushrooms with a damp cloth and slice the stems to remove tough outer parts. Place in a large bowl and sprinkle the sliced mushrooms with the chipotle hot sauce. Mix together well. Chill for 20 to 30 minutes, then sprinkle with the sugar. Serve at room temperature.

title: Curried Farfalle
ingredients: 1 package farfalle pasta | 1 teaspoon curry
instructions: In a 10 inch skillet, bring 6 quarts water to a boil. Add farfalle pasta and curry. Reduce heat to low. Cover and cook 25 minutes, or until pasta is tender.

title: Guinness Onion Dip
ingredients: 2 -3 green onions, chopped | 1/2 cup guinness stout, room temperature | 2 tablespoons fresh minced shallots | 1/2 cup low sodium italian salad dressing
instructions: Finely chop onions and stir in 1/2 cup guinness until well blended. Add shallots and 1/2 cup salad dressing and stir to combine. Cover and chill for at least 1 hour. Serve with crackers, bagels or vegetables.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,fennel bulb,pumpkin,chicken bouillon powder,potato,egg
title: Spicy Sweet Potato, Pumpkin and Chile Filling
ingredients: 1 kg sweet potato, peeled and coarsely chopped | 500 g peeled pumpkin, peeled, chopped | 2 fennel bulbs, finely sliced | 4 tablespoons instant chicken bouillon powder | 1 green chili pepper, thinly sliced | 2 eggs
instructions: Boil the sweet potato in salted water until soft, approximately 10 - 15 minutes, drain and set aside. Place the pumpkin, fennel and chili in a saucepan, add the chicken or vegetable stock, bring to a boil and simmer until the fennel and chilpipis tender. Remove from heat. Pour the fennel mixture into a bowl and cool to room temperature. Add the cooled sweet potato and eggs and mix lightly with your hands. Grease a baking tray with the remaining beaten egg. Spread the fennel mixture equally over the tray and bake in a 200 degree centigrade oven for 25 - 30 minutes. Allow to cool for five minutes and cut into squares.

title: Peachy Pea Pappardelle
ingredients: 1 package pappardelle ( tiny ) pasta or ( 16 ounce ) package other small pasta | 1 cup frozen peas | 1 cup yellow pepper, cut in strips ( i like a mix of red and yellow pepper ) | 1 tablespoon honey
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast fillet,spaghetti,cherry tomato,tamari,taco flour tortilla
title: Mexican Chicken Wraps
ingredients: 8 soft taco-size flour tortillas | 500 g chicken breast fillets, sliced thinly | 3 cherry tomatoes | 2 teaspoons tamari | 200 -300 g spaghetti ( fettuccine style )
instructions: Cut tomatoes in half and scoop out seeds. Put a thin slice of chicken in the middle along one side of each tortilla and add a small quarter of cherry tomatoe to each piece. Brush each wrap with tamari. Wrap the wraps in foil and place on a plate. Cook the pasta in a large pan of boiling water. When it is cooked, drain it and serve.

Random Ingredients: dark molasses,vanilla sugar,meatball,tortilla chip,lime juice,roasting chicken,almond,blackberry
title: Chicken Filled With Blackberries
ingredients: 2 lbs ground meatballs | 20 blackberries | 1 roasting chickens | parchment paper | 1/2 cup ground almonds | 1/3 cup dark molasses | 1/3 cup lime juice | 1/3 cup vanilla sugar | tortilla chips
instructions: Prepare blackberry sauce by combining all ingredients in a blender. Cover in a plastic container and store until ready to use. Chicken breasts, rinse chicken well of all water and pat dry. Place in a large freezer bowl, add blackberries and 1/2 of the ground meatballs. Mix completely and roll the chicken up in the blackberries. Place chicken in a pan or tray and cover with aluminum foil. Bake at 425 degrees for about 1 hour or until the meatballs are browned. Remove from oven and let sit until chicken is cool enough to handle. Remove meatballs and put back on the stove.

title: Bubble & Squeak Pizza
ingredients: 4 -5 medium slices steak ( sandwich meat ) | 4 ounces broccolini or 4 ounces broccoli florets | 1 slice steak ( round steak ) | 4 slices mushrooms | 6 slices sandwich meat | 12 ounces cocoa powder
instructions: Put all the vegetables into a bowl and cover with cold water. Heat grill to high. Remove vegetables, place the steak and steak on the grill. Cook for 10 minutes until cooked, the steak is cooked and is just firm to the touch. Serve with dipping sauce and your favourite toppings.

title: Mini English Muffins
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon active dry yeast | 2 1/2 - 3 cups all-purpose flour | 3/4 teaspoon active dry yeast | 1/4 lb cooked ground turkey | 1 can sliced ripe peaches, drained ( or equivalent canned fruit ) | 1 cup packed mild cheddar cheese
instructions: In large mixing bowl, stir together 2 cups flour, yeast, and 1 1/2 cups warm water. Make a well. Stir in turkey, peaches, cheeses and remaining 2 cups flour and yeast mixture, blending into dough. Turn out on to lightly floured surface and knead for about 5 minutes. Cut out 24 pieces or circles and place on 2 cookie sheets lined with parchment paper. Cover with damp cloth and let rise 1 hour, until slightly bubbly. Preheat oven to 375°f. Bake 25 minutes, or until lightly golden.

title: Buttermilk Baked Sweet Corn
ingredients: 1 tablespoon butter | 3 cups fresh buttermilk | 1 tablespoon buttermilk | 6 cloves garlic salt | 3 tablespoons minced fresh ginger root | 3/4 cup cabbage-style buttermilk | 2 tablespoons butterscotch chips, or to taste | 1 pinch ground white pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Grease a 9x13 inch glass baking dish. Beat butter in a glass bowl with an electric mixer. Gradually beat in buttermilk to form a smooth sauce. Combine garlic salt and ginger. Pour half the buttermilk sauce into the buttermilk mixture and stir to blend. Whisk in the remaining buttermilk sauce. Stir in cabbage cheese and pepper. Pour into prepared dish and allow to set. Bake in the preheated oven until lightly browned, 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Spicy Salsa
ingredients: 1 tablespoon whole cumin seed | 2 cloves fresh jalapenos, coarsely chopped | 3 large roasted red bell peppers, chopped | 1 loaf, warm bread, cut into 8 strips
instructions: In a blender, combine the cumin seeds, jalapenos, red bell peppers and bread. Blend until smooth and transfer to a bowl.

Random Ingredients: thyme sprig,golden raisin,kalamata olive,cornichons,nutmeg,confectioner sugar,banana,tomato puree
title: Grilled Tossed Antipasto With Banana and Olive Aioli
ingredients: 12 kalamata olives, pitted and chopped | 3 tablespoons golden raisins | 1 tablespoon cornichon, ground | 2 tomatoes, seeded and chopped | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprigs | 6 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil and 1 tablespoon cornichons | 1 pinch nutmeg | 4 ripe plantains - toasted, peeled, and sliced into 1/2-inch thick rounds
instructions: Place all the ingredients into a bowl and stir to combine. Heat the grill to medium high. Thread 5 slices of tomato onto each banana round. Place the tomatoes onto the preheated grill slices. Grill tomato slices for 2 minutes on each side, or until heated through. Place bananas on a plate and serve with olive aioli.

title: Spiced Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 3/4 lbs cauliflower florets, broken into florets | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Cover the cauliflower in boiling water and bring to the boil over high heat. Cook until barely slightly tender. Drain and transfer it to a serving dish. Poke holes in the cauliflower and then sprinkle with allspice. Variation, replace 1/2 cup water with 1/2 cup water, add 2 tablespoons chopped red onion and 1/3 cup chopped fresh parsley.

title: Hot Truck Sauce
ingredients: 4 roma ( plum ) tomatoes, crushed | 2 tablespoons mild hot sauce
instructions: Place roma tomatoes into a skillet and mash the tomatoes with the back of a spoon. Add hot sauce, a few shakes at a time, and stir to mix well.

title: Kielbasa With Smoked Tomato Juice and Vanilla
ingredients: 2 kielbasa | 1 1/2 cups tomato juice or 1 1/2 cups v8 juice | 3 -5 dashes vanilla | 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke
instructions: Cut kielbasa diagonally, lengthwise and into 1/4 inch slices.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese,ginger garlic paste,tea,rice,pork loin,corn oil,date
title: Pork and Dates - Microwave
ingredients: 8 ounces pork loin, thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 cup cooked dates, finely chopped | 1/2 cup roasted oats, finely chopped | 1/2 cup instant rice | 1/2 cup sweetened condensed milk | 1 teaspoon corn oil
instructions: Mix together the spices and put in the container. Add the pork at step 1 3/4 tsp of the mix and store in the freezer for about 1 hour.. Mix the rice and condensed milk and mix. Then spread the rest on top and on the pork. Cover with aluminium foil and a lid. Microwave for 45 minutes on high power.

Random Ingredients: enchilada sauce,fontina cheese,bell pepper,vegetable oil cooking spray,pre mozzarella cheese,artificial sweetener,rice wine
title: Baked Empanadas
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 cups shredded fontina cheese | 1 1/2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese | 1 package pre-shredded fontina cheese, divided | 1 medium bell pepper, chopped | 1 jar prepared enchilada sauce | 1 pinch artificial sweetener | 2 tablespoons rice wine
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f spray two 8 x8 inch baking dishes or one 13 x9 inch baking dish with vegetable oil spray. Stir together both cheeses.

title: Copycat Bea's Mediterranean Yellow Salad
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce | 3 tablespoons butter and margarine, softened | 1/2 teaspoon oregano | 1/4 cup finely chopped yellow pepper ( green or red )
instructions: Shred lettuce. Place whole head in a bowl and drizzle with margarine, oregano and green or red peppers.

title: Wasabi Onions
ingredients: 4 tablespoons ghee | 200 g shallots, sliced into half-moons or 200 g red onions, very thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon dark soy sauce | 2 teaspoons rose water | 1 teaspoon wasabi, powder
instructions: Heat the ghee in a nonstick frying pan. Add the onion and fry over a low heat until golden in color. Stir the soy sauce and rose water into the onion mix and add to the fried onions. Stir until well combined and add wasabi powder to taste.

title: Zesty Italian Wedding
ingredients: 1/2 ounce fax-infused fusion liqueur ( zesty italian zesty ) | 1 tablespoon fresh gingerroot, grated | 12 tablespoons reduced-fat cream cheese | 3 tablespoons feta-free evaporated milk | 10 dates, cut in thirds | 1 tablespoon thinly sliced escarole ( italian ) | 4 tablespoons low-fat natural greek yogurt ( low fat, greek yogurt or regular greek yogurt )
instructions: In a heavy 10 - 15 inch skillet or a mini-skillet, combine faxinf and ginger. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, for 3 minutes or until heated through. Transfer ginger mixture to an 11 x 7 x 2 inch baking dish or dish with a lid. Spread cream cheese on top of the faxinf mixture.

Random Ingredients: madras curry powder,serrano chili pepper,bamboo shoot,mushroom,egg noodle
title: Quick Noodles With Madras
ingredients: 1 lb egg noodles, medium width | 1/2 lb mushroom | 1 small serrano chili pepper, small piece in the middle diced | 1/2 cup bamboo shoot | 1 teaspoon madras curry powder
instructions: Cook noodles in a large bowl of boiling water for 3 - 5 minutes. Rinse with cold water, and drain well. Set aside. Slice mushrooms. Cut serrano chili into thin slices and then into long thin slices. In a hot wok, add 1/2 lb. Mushrooms, sliced serrano pepper and 1/2 tsp. Curry powder. Stir fry mushrooms for 2 minutes. Remove and set aside. Mix and cook egg noodles at a slow steady simmer for 2 - 3 minutes.
