Add thawed noodles, mushrooms, serrano pepper, bamboo shoots, and madras curry for 2 - 3 ninutes until noodles are cooked and most of the liquid has cooked off. If desired, top with additional curry powder.

Random Ingredients: custard powder,red potato,yellow onion,red bell pepper,coriander seed,double acting baking powder,hard egg
title: Traditional Jersey Roulades
ingredients: 6 large red potatoes, washed cleaned, scrubbed, unpeeled | 1 large yellow onion, washed, peeled, and sliced into wedges | 1 teaspoon coriander seed, crushed | 1 teaspoon double-acting baking powder | 4 small red bell peppers, washed, de-seeded and sliced | 6 hard-boiled eggs, sliced | 4 fluid ounces custard powder | 3 ounces cold plain unsalted milk or 3 ounces double acting baking powder, sifted
instructions: Arrange the roulades on your prettiest serving platter. Place the potatoes in a large bowl. Add the onion, coriander seeds, double acting baking powder and peppers to the bowl. Mix all together. Add the custard powder and mix thoroughly. Make sure the custard powder and egg is well combined with the potato mixture. Pour half the mixture over the roulades. Sprinkle the top with a little more custard powder if desired. Serve while still warm.

title: Chinese Vegetables for the Crock Pot
ingredients: 3 lbs italian firm waxy apples ( such as fuji, granny smith, granny smith ) | 1 medium tart apple, such as fuji, sliced or cut into 3/4-inch dice | 1/2 cup canned chinese vegetables ( such as komodo, wolfberries, lima pods, yam'nams ) | fresh italian bread, for accompaniment
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Cut out the core from the apple. Cut out the top peel and then break the apple into pieces with the core attached. Cut the wedge off the wedge and set aside. Cut the wedge in half lengthwise. Scoop out any seeds and excess white matter.. Cut the wedge into about 1/4 inch dice, and then place the apple pieces cut side down into a large mixing bowl. Add the pineapple slices and any liquid that has accumulated on the surface and add the vegetables. Sprinkle the top layer with the chinese vegetable juice and top with italian bread. Cover with several inches of water. Cover and slow cooker and continue to slow cook for 5 hours in the oven. Remove the cover, and continue cooking for 30 minutes to give the fruit a bit of a crust. Taste and re season with salt and pepper. You can also add a teaspoon of chinese cooking oil to the vegetables if you want. Serve hot.

title: Classic Mexican Hominy
ingredients: 2 cups hominy, soaked overnight in enough water to cover | 2 fennel bulbs, trimmed, tops left on | 1 tablespoon cumin seed, toasted | 1 tablespoon lemon juice, or as desired
instructions: Cover the drained hominy beans with warm water. Soak overnight. Trim fronds from fennel bulbs.

title: Faux Phrik Gaeng(Thai Chili Paste)
ingredients: 1 cup dried dates, chopped | 1 habanero pepper | 2 1/2 tablespoons date paste ( thai basil, or other asian herb, dried and stalks discarded ) | 1 cup fresh thai basil | 4 tablespoons tamari | 1 cup beef broth | 1 teaspoon finely grated dried shrimp or 1 teaspoon ground sesame seeds
instructions: In a mixing bowl, coarsely chop the dates, habanero and thai basil. Transfer the date mix to a medium saucepan. Add the tamari, beef broth and reserved basil. Heat the broth to boiling and lower the temperature to low medium. Allow the mixture to simmer 5 - 10 minutes. Add the shrimp or sesame seeds. Simmer for 1 minute. Serve hot, warm, or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower floret,tomato puree,red chilies,red chili,yellow pepper,white wine,mustard powder
title: Creamy Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 small cauliflower floret | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 teaspoon red chili, crushed | 1 teaspoon yellow pepper, crushed | 1 teaspoon fresh red chilies, crushed | 1 cup white wine | 2 -3 tablespoons tomato puree ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon dry white wine, optional or ( 10 ml ) | 1 teaspoon dry mustard powder | 1 small red chilies, sliced, for garnishing
instructions: Steam the cauliflower in a large saucepan of boiling water until soft. Drain well and keep aside. Heat the oil in a small heavy saucepan. Stir in the mustard powder.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,sun tomato oil,chili powder,yam,cream tartar
title: Creamy Yams With Tamale Crust
ingredients: 1 kg yam | 150 g mexican blend cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained | 2 teaspoons cream of tartar | 1 teaspoon chili powder
instructions: Peel and dice yam into bite size pieces and place in microwave safe dish. Sprinkle with salt and toss to coat. Microwave on high for 20 - 30 minutes or until yam is tender. Set aside to cool until ready to proceed with the recipe. When the yam is cool enough, place it in a food processor using the blade attached. Add chrysanthemum, cream of tartar, and hot sauce to food processor and process until smooth. If you like it more chunky, stir in hot sauce. In a medium size bowl combine cheeses. Stir in zest from sun dried tomatoes, cream of tatermaltz and chilli. Add to bowl, sprinkle with reserved mozzarella cheese and fold together gently. Refrigerate for minimum of 4 hours for flavours to develop. This will make enough for a single meal. Cook yams in a saucepan of salted boiling water over medium heat, uncovered, for 7 minutes or until tender, drain, return to heat and coat with cheese mixture.

title: Champitos Con Queso (Chocolate and Rosemary Chicken)
ingredients: 6 chicken legs ( about 3 pounds ) | 12 rosemary sprigs | 1/2 cup mexican chocolate, chopped ( such as castor real, or monterey jack )
instructions: Trim and discard excess fat from chicken legs. Rinse chicken legs under cold water and pat dry with paper towels. Cut off wing tips. Place chicken legs in a medium heavy duty plastic bag. Pour 2 quarts of fresh water into a large, wide pot and bring to a boil over high heat. When water boils, decrease the heat to medium and boil the chicken about 20 minutes until the centers of the legs show traces of pink, and the chicken legs are cooked through. While the chicken legs are cooking, place the dried rosemary sprigs in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,yellow cake mix,italian seasoning,heavy cream,swiss cheese
title: Swiss Cheese Squares
ingredients: 1 box yellow cake mix | 1 can sliced swiss cheese | 1/3 cup heavy cream | 1/4 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1/3 cup whole wheat flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 fahrenheit. Place the cake mix, cheese, cream and seasoning in a large mixing bowl. Stir in the flour about a cup at a time, making sure the batter is not too thick. Pour the batter over your favorite fruit and cheese.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,pizza sauce,chicken wing,garlic oil,white onion,chunky salsa
title: Salsa Chicken Wings
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 2 tablespoons garlic oil | 1 pound chicken wings | 1 cup chunky salsa | 2 tablespoons prepared pizza sauce | 2 tablespoons chopped white onion
instructions: Preheat an oven to 450 degrees f. Pour the dark sesame oil into a large baking dish, and lightly coat both sides of the chicken wings with sesame oil. Place the chicken into the prepared baking dish, and bake in the preheated oven, turning the wings frequently until they are lightly browned on all sides and an instant reading thermometer inserted near the bone registers 175 degrees f on the side of the thigh. Cover the chicken wings with a kitchen towel, and set aside in a warm place. Stir in the garlic oil, and cook, stirring frequently, until the garlic oil is fragrant. Place the chicken wings into a separate saucepan, and bring the salsa to a boil over medium heat. Stir until the liquid has evaporated and the salsa is thickened. Turn off the heat, cover the saucepan, and set aside to cool to room temperature. Pour the pizza sauce into a small saucepan, and stir in the onion. Return the saucepan to the stove over medium heat, and cook until slightly thickened.

title: Easy Tequila Fish
ingredients: 2 pounds white fish fillets | 1 pound tequila
instructions: Place fish into a large saucepan or dutch oven.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,cheddar cheese,yukon gold potato,pepper,dill,lime juice
title: Swiss Potatoes With Potatoes
ingredients: 8 yukon gold potatoes, peeled ( about 3 pounds ) | 1 lb swiss cheese, grated | 1/2 cup cheddar cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons fresh dill, chopped | 1/2 cup fresh lime juice | fresh ground pepper, to taste
instructions: Place the potato whole in a large saucepan of boiling water and boil for about 10 minutes or until barely tender. Meanwhile, in a medium bowl, combine the swiss cheese, cheddar cheese, dill, lime juice, and pepper. Add potato to cheese mixture and toss until well combined. Spoon potatoes onto a baking sheet. Bake at 450 degrees fahrenheit about 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Homemade Arepas (Mexican Arepas)
ingredients: 4 lbs fresh ground white fish | 1/2 - 1 lb onion, peeled | 1 1/2 cups fine sea salt, preferably sea salt, for seasoning salt
instructions: Heat the cast iron skillet or frying pan on the stovetop until hot, but not smoking. While it is heating up, put the onion in the hot pan and sprinkle with salt. Fry the whole arepas until browned, about 5 minutes per side. Remove the arepas to a colander lined with paper towels to drain well. Sprinkle with sea salt and serve immediately.

title: Apple and Wild Fruit Salad
ingredients: 3 tart apples | 2 cups raspberries | 3/4 cup carrots, cooked and diced in | 2 tablespoons tart apples, diced in | 2 tablespoons wild apples, diced in
instructions: Mix all ingredients and chill.

title: French Appams With Black Olives and Apples
ingredients: 4 large tart apples, such as granny smith | 1 can black olives
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°. Core the apples, and cut them into eighths. With a heavy knife or a sharp paring knife, cut the center lengthwise into 8 or 10 wedges to form a flat crown. Cut off the top 2 inches of each wedge with scissors, and press the wedge on top of the apples. Arrange the wedges in a 9 inch oven safe casserole dish with 1 t. Water. Cover and bake for 40 minutes. The apples will be shriveled. Remove from the oven and cover loosely with foil to keep warm. Remove the apples from the oven, and remove the foil. Sprinkle the olives evenly over the top. Return to the oven, and bake for an additional 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: kalamata olive,swiss chard,green enchilada sauce,cauliflower,rye bread
title: Cauliflower Swiss Chard With Olive and Swiss Chard
ingredients: 4 slices green enchilada sauce, such as el pato brand | 1 large head cauliflower, halved | 2 bunches swiss chard, leaves coarsely chopped | 1 cup kalamata olive, rinsed, halved | 1 loaf rye bread, such as texas toast
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange 2 tomato slices on a baking sheet. Spread each with a thin layer of enchilada sauce. Sprinkle with sliced cauliflower and chard. Top with remaining tomatoes and drizzle with olives. Bake in the preheated oven until heated through, about 40 minutes. Meanwhile, toast rye bread. Serve with remaining enchilada sauce.

title: Herring Salad from Iceland
ingredients: 2 -4 fresh herring fillets, scales removed | 1 plum, thinly sliced
instructions: Split each fillet carefully with a sharp knife. Place on a serving dish. Sprinkle with thinly sliced plum. Drizzle with more plum. Serve.

title: Creamy Pork Tenderloin for Two
ingredients: 4 slices pork tenderloin, trimmed | ground black pepper | 1/2 cup tahini | 4 finely chopped green chilies
instructions: Preheat oven to 275 degrees f. Brush meat with pam or lard.

Random Ingredients: herb,rice vinegar,rice wine,provolone cheese,lard,corn flake crumb,cornflour,sicilian olive
title: Prosciutto Wrapped Olive Rollups
ingredients: 1/2 cup cornflake crumbs | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 1/4 cup rice wine or 1/4 cup dry sherry | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1 teaspoon mixed herbs ( see recipe description ) | 10 sicilian olives, very well drained | 4 rolls, thawed and chilled | 4 slices provolone cheese
instructions: Place cornflake crumbs in a deep mixing bowl. Mix cornflour with 1/4 cup rice wine vinegar, herbs, and olives. Roll roll ups into oval rolls, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter, and arrange slices and cheese on the inside of each roll. Roll up tightly, beginning at the top and leaving at least 2 inch of filling in the middle. Roll up and tie with kitchen string. Combine 2 tablespoons cornflour and remaining 1/4 cup rice wine vinegar in a small mixing bowl. Stir well until mixture is smooth then stir in sauce. Refrigerate overnight. Cook's note, preparation time does not include chilling.

title: Fresh Cannellini Beans
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dried cannellini beans | 1 bunch watercress, leaves picked from stems
instructions: Soak the beans in water for 30 minutes and bring the water to a boil.

title: Ethiopian Strawberry Noodle  (Nigella Lawson)
ingredients: 8 eggs noodles, preferably 1/4-1/2 pounds | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 cup strawberry ( about 11 ounces ) or 1 cup raspberries, washed
instructions: Bring a medium saucepan of salted water to a boil. Remove from the heat. Add the noodles, cardamom and half the strawberries. Break up the pieces of egg noodles with a fork, and add back to the pot. Return to a boil and reduce heat slightly. The noodles will rise to the top. It is very important to check them periodically, as they should be just right. The water stops cooking before the noodles serve, and the noodles absorb some of the liquid. You want about 5 - 7 minutes. Taste and adjust seasonings and serve hot.

title: Indian Spiced Salt (Agriker Karelava)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 2 1/2 cups ice water
instructions: Powder the cumin seeds in a pestle with a mortar and pestle then transfer to a medium sized bowl. Stir in the ice cubes, pour and mix well.

title: Lemongrass and Tandoori Mix (Hot Mix)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons fresh lemongrass or 1 tablespoon dried white lemongrass | 2 tablespoons light soybeans ( or 1 cup of light soybeans and 2 tsp. cilantro ) or 2 tablespoons light cream ( 2 tsp. cilantro ) | 2 teaspoons hot gram ( chilled malaysian-style chutney or coriander ) or 2 teaspoons chat masala | 2 teaspoons ground flax seeds or 3 tablespoons ground almonds | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar or 1 tablespoon lemon juice
instructions: Put all of the ingredients into a mini food processor, and pulsate until blended. If you wish to use the ground flaxseed instead of ground almonds, blend again, until it is the same consistency as almond butter. If you decide to use chutney, add it just before serving. This mix is great served cold in a pita bread. Keeps well in the fridge.

Random Ingredients: grain rice,hot pepper oil,white flour,red lentil,sesame seed,yogurt,taco seasoning mix
title: Fahrebi (Middle Eastern Lentil Salad)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups red lentils ( i prefer yellow for this ) | 3 1/2 cups long grain rice ( i prefer brown rice ) | 2 1/2 cups hot pepper oil | 4 1/2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 1 packet taco seasoning mix, any flavor | 3 1/2 cups yogurt | 1/2 cup white flour
instructions: Soak the lentils for 20 to 30 minutes, then drain them well. Rinse well, and place them in a large pot. Pour enough water to just cover them. Bring to a boil. Meanwhile, put the rice on to cook. While the rice cooks, heat the pepper oil in a frying pan. When it is sizzling add the sesame seeds. Sauté for a few minutes, then add the rice in a single layer. Mix well, don't burn the rice. You can also add a bit of water if there are sticky rice grains on the bottom of the pan. Drain the water off and then add the sesame seed oil. The water should be absorbed. When the rice is done, stir it into the lentils in the pot. Taste the hot pepper oil and add to the rice mixture, stirring gently. If not hot enough, stir in more pepper oil, and then add the taco seasoning. Place the hot pepper in a tea towel and press it under a cold tap to remove some of the burnt smell from the pepper or put a paper towel over it to dry it slightly. In a bowl, whisk the yogurt with the flour until smooth. When it is done, mix in the melted pepper and the yogurt mix. Pour this over the salad.

Random Ingredients: black mustard seed,plum tomato,lentil,chicken meat,rice,canadian bacon,lime wedge
title: Lentil and Canadian Bacon Wraps
ingredients: 1 tablespoon canadian bacon, finely diced | 1/3 cup lentils, rinsed and picked over, drained | 1 teaspoon black mustard seeds | 2 plum tomatoes, diced | 3/4 cup cooked chicken meat, shredded | 10 6-inch plum tomatoes, halved | 3/4 cup cooked rice | 5 3/4 ounces lardons, room temperature or 5 3/4 ounces canadian bacon bits, softened
instructions: In a medium skillet, sauté the minced Canadian bacon, lentils, mustard seeds, tomatoes, and chicken in the lardons until heated through. Spread a thin layer of hot lentil mixture on the bottom of a warm tortilla, then top with a quarter of the lentil mixture and a quarter of the diced plum tomato. Fold the tortillas over and roll up the tortillas. Repeat with remaining tortillas, lentils, tomatoes, and tomatoes, ending with a roll. For a more substantial wrap, wrap each wrap at one end with a toothpick and secure with a toothpick. Warm the lardons over medium high heat in a small skillet, and serve warm.

title: Salmon in Curry Leaf and Fresh Salmon
ingredients: 1 fish fillet ( salmon, salmon trout, or salmon roe will work ) | 3 curry leaves ( fresh or dried )
instructions: Wash and dry fish fillets under running water. Wipe any excess water/water and pat dry with a crisp cloth or paper towel. Lay a piece of fish in a heavy pot with about 3/4 inch depth of salt on the bottom. Turn the fish over and gently place onto the fish in a single layer. Fold up the edges of the pan as tightly as possible to make a square grid that will fit inside the fish. Cover the fish with the curry leaves. Place the pot, or any of your preferred fillings into a hot pan over high heat. Cover the pot. When the water boils, decrease the temperature, setting a timer for 10 minutes. Remove the pot from the heat. Allow the fish to sit inside the steamer for approximately 5 minutes to make sure all water is absorbed. The fish can also be cooked in a steamer over medium heat, steaming it for 5 minutes per inch of thickness in a preheated 325 degree oven. Serve hot from the steamer.

title: Crown Cheese and Savoy Slaw
ingredients: 4 cups savoy cabbage, shredded ( or grated or shredded ) | 1 cup monterey jack pepper cheese, shredded
instructions: Put all ingredients in a bowl and stir together. Put in a loaf pan. Wrap in foil, and bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 1 hour. Slice and serve.

title: Brown Rice With Serrano Peppers and Feta Cheese
ingredients: 1 serrano pepper | 1/4 cup diced sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 1 1/4 cups chicken broth, divided | 8 ounces feta cheese
instructions: Preheat broiler. Char grill rack 5 to 6 inches from heat. Cut serrano pepper lengthwise into strips. Coarsely chop sun dried tomatoes and spread evenly over the flat surface of a baking sheet. Bake on grill rack until lightly colored and blackened, about 5 minutes. Transfer to bowl, cover loosely and let stand for 10 minutes. Slice pepper into strips. Discard seeds. Puree sun dried tomato puree with 1 1/3 cup broth. Place strips of red pepper in blender. Cover and blend until finely chopped and very smooth, about 30 seconds. Heat 2 teaspoons oil in a large skillet. Add the garlic and cook, stirring often, until fragrant, about 1 minute. Add the sun dried tomato puree and stir until well blended. Return to the skillet and cook and stir until broth has been absorbed, about 10 minutes. Add feta, stir well and cook until heated through, about 5 minutes. Serve rice with the mixture and extra feta.

Random Ingredients: honey,grenadine,green bean,worcestershire sauce,pork cutlet,cream mushroom soup
title: Green Beans & Pork Cutlets
ingredients: 4 -5 pork cutlets, large dice | 3 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon honey | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 package frozen green beans, thawed and well drained | 3 tablespoons grenadine
instructions: Place pork over medium heat in a saucepan. Mix worcestershire sauce, honey, soup, green beans and grenadine. Pour over pork when browned. Cover and cook, stirring occasionally, for about 10 minutes. Remove pork to a serving bowl. Add remaining sauce and mix well.

Random Ingredients: double cream,season salt,cumin seed,lemon juice zest,nut,ice cube,hash brown potato,chile paste
title: Spicy Potato Soup
ingredients: 1 cup hash brown potatoes, cooked | 1 tablespoon chili paste | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1 -3 tablespoon double cream | 1 teaspoon season-all salt | 4 -5 ice cubes | 3/4 cup mixed nuts, such as pecans ( optional ) or 3/4 cup walnuts ( optional )
instructions: Pour all vegetables into a bowl. Add all other ingredients and mix together gently until everything is well incorporated. Turn into a freezer proof container for 1 hour. Freeze until ready to serve.

title: Sun-Dried Tomato and Onion Skewers
ingredients: 1 lb sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 1 onion
instructions: Drain and rinse sun dried tomatoes. Cut onion into half moons. Wash and cut off and discard outer layer of onion. Cut sun dried tomatoes in halves or quarters and put them all in a glass container with onion inside. Dry the cubes in a paper towel.

Random Ingredients: american cheese,baking potato,green bell pepper,flat rice noodle,self rising flour,tofu,self raising flour,button mushroom
title: Vegan One-Pot Pizza
ingredients: 375 g soft tofu, drained | 375 g self-raising flour | 250 g shredded american cheese | 1 cup self-raising flour | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 150 g button mushrooms, sliced | 1 green bell pepper, chopped | 1 package flat rice noodles
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190c. Lightly grease a 20cm x 30cm baking tin. Sift together the flours, baking powder, cheeses and mushrooms in a bowl. Mix the tofu and tofu with the flour mixture. Gently knead until all the ingredients are combined. Roll out onto a lightly floured surface to 20cm x 10cm rectangle. Transfer to prepared tin. Lightly flour the top of the pizza using a knife. Bake for 15 minutes before serving with salsa and cheese and salad.

title: Oriental Pizza
ingredients: 1 pre-made pizza crust | 1 cup tea | 1 cup sesame seeds, toasted | 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 teaspoon cardamom, crushed | 15 -20 slices smoked kombu seaweed, to garnish ( optional )
instructions: Bring a small pot to a boil. Remove pot from heat, and add enough water to the pot to just cover it. Place the baking sheet where the pizza is resting. Brush with oil. Combine tea, sesame seed, asafoetida, cardamom, and the remaining 1 teaspoon of asafoetida in a small bowl. Dip each side of the bread in the tea mixture, then place in the baking sheet. Using a glass or metal spoon, stack the bread on the baking sheet for approximately 1 minute per side. The bread should be toasted. Preheat your oven to 400°f. Brush the outside of the crust with more oil if desired. Place a spoonful of smoked kombu seaweed on the prepared crust. Sprinkle with the tea mixture, if desired. Bake at 400f for about 5 minutes. Remove from oven, and cut into eighths.

Random Ingredients: ancho chile powder,vanilla ice cream,white flour,cubanelle pepper,pea
title: Cape Verde Frozen Peas
ingredients: 14 ounces white flour | 1 cubanelle pepper, cut into 1 1/4-inch pieces | 14 ounces frozen peas, thawed | 3 ancho chile powder ( see note ) | vanilla ice cream ( optional )
instructions: Combine flour, pepper, frozen peas, and chile powder in food processor. Pulse until dough forms. Divide mixture into thirds. Roll each portion out on lightly floured surface to about 1/8 inch thickness. Cut into strips 1 inch wide and 3 inches long and 1 1/2 inches long. Place strips on lightly greased baking sheet. Bake at 400 f for about 15 minutes or until nicely browned on top. Cool slightly, then roll in vanilla ice cream. Serve warm or cool completely and store in refrigerator for later use.

Random Ingredients: bok choy,green chilies,confectioner ' sugar,rigatoni pasta,black eyed pea
title: Chili Noodle Medley
ingredients: 1 lb short rigatoni pasta | 5 cups chopped choy | 1 1/4 cups black beans ( drained canned ) | 3 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 3 1/2 ounces diced green chilies
instructions: Boil pasta according to package directions, drain. Place choy in a large bowl.

title: Apricot Flapjacks
ingredients: 3 tablespoons apricot jam | 25 hazelnuts
instructions: Cut the hazelnuts on a cutting board and spread them evenly on a baking tray. Toast them in a hot oven until well browned. When cooled, roll the blanched hazelnuts into small balls. Spread the apricot jam over the blanched hazelnuts, making sure to distribute it equally. Dip the flapjacks in the hazelnut oil, dusting with icing sugar. Return to the oven for 5 minutes, then turn and bake 10 - 15 minutes longer until lightly coloured.

Random Ingredients: beef stock cube,american cheese,cream chicken soup,vanilla,herb,thai coconut curry broth,red chili powder
title: Coconut Chili Con Carne
ingredients: 400 g thai sweet unsalted cream of chicken soup | 1 beef stock cube | 150 g american cheese, cubed | 1 liter hot red chili powder, de-seeded | 1 teaspoon mixed herbs | 2 teaspoons creamed chunky mild american cheese | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1 tablespoon thai coconut curry or 1 tablespoon creamed coconut cream
instructions: Mix together soups, onion, chile powder, herbs, cheese, flavour and nutmeg. You can use any other flavourings of your choice, it's up to you. Heat up the broiler on a low oven. Pour a little oil into the pan and swirl it around. When it's heated, stir all ingredients into the oil. Simmer for about 10 - 15 minutes or until thickened and bubbly. Serve with plain boiled rice and a crisp green salad.

title: Crispy Mushroom Caps
ingredients: 1/2 cup catsup | 1 tablespoon brandy | 2 large mushroom caps
instructions: In a small mixing bowl whisk together catsup and brandy. Place caps in a large non stick frypan. Pour catsup mixture over caps. Heat over medium heat until mixture just begins to bubble but is not bubbling and sauce is heated through. Turn cap over and continue cooking for about 2 minutes until caps are hot. Remove from heat and let Caps sit for a few minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice,pita bread,french fry,egg substitute,quinoa,cooking spray,cocoa powder
title: French Fries With Vegan Noodles - Low Fat
ingredients: 0.5 package frozen french fries | 3/4 cup egg substitute | 1/2 cup quinoa | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1 tablespoon quick-cooking spray | 1/4 cup cocoa powder | 1/4 cup powdered egg replacer
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Spray a 12 x 9 baking dish with cooking spray, then place frozen french fries into dish. Combine egg replacer and cocoa powder, then pour over french fries. Cover with foil and bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes. Let cool and cut into strips.

Random Ingredients: egg yolk,self rising flour,bean,pork shoulder,green chili pepper,egg noodle,breadcrumb
title: Pork Noodle Supper
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon self rising flour | 1 cup breadcrumbs | 2 egg yolks | 3/4 lb pork shoulder, chopped | 1/2 cup chopped green chili pepper | 1 package egg noodles | 1 can baked beans
instructions: In large bowl, combine flour, yolks, pork, chili pepper, noodles and baked beans. Stir until well blended. Place small amount of meat mixture onto lightly greased and floured sheet of wax paper, forming a 10 x 3 x 1 inch rectangle. Spread noodles evenly, about 1/2 teaspoon per pepper. Top with 2 - 3 tablespoons bean mixture, leaving a 1/2 inch border on all sides. Fold the left and right edges over pepper, to form a triangle. Repeat with remaining pepper and meat mixture. Place on rack of broiler pan. Broil 10 minutes or until edges of pepper become lightly browned.

title: Peanut and Beef Pizza
ingredients: 1 pizza crust | 1 large soft-poached green giant greek salad ( pense greek salad ) | 1 large boneless chuck | 1 lb lean ground beef or 1 lb ground turkey | 1 jar lemonade or ( 14 ounce ) jar raspberry-flavored carbonated beverage | 1/4 cup cold water | 1/2 cup dry roasted salted peanuts, minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Unroll dough on lightly floured board. Stretch dough onto surface of work surface. Cut in half, rolling once. Place each half on center of greased cookie sheet. With lightly floured hands press dough out to thickness of 1/2 inch. Bake until golden brown on each side. Meanwhile brown meat in large nonstick skillet.

title: Radish and Tuna Salpicao
ingredients: 1 quart radish, trimmed | 5 ounces canola oil | 4 -5 ounces tuna in water, drained
instructions: Place the radish and any liquid in a bowl, cover tightly, and refrigerate. When ready to serve, drain the tuna and place in a strainer over a bowl. Drain the liquid into the bowl, discarding liquid. Heat the canola oil in a medium skillet over medium heat, stirring to prevent splattering. Add the drained tuna and radish liquid and cook, stirring, until heated through, about 3 minutes.

title: Baked Okra
ingredients: 12 okra, cut in half | 1 package pre-shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Arrange the okra in the baking dish, and sprinkle evenly with mozzarella cheese. Bake in a 375f degrees oven for 30 to 45 minutes, or until golden brown and bubbly. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,rosemary,wild mushroom,confectioner sugar,cardamom pod
title: Swiss Wild Mushroom and Rice
ingredients: 1 cup long grain white rice ( arborio or carnaroli ) | 2 pints wild mushrooms, sliced | 1 cup confectioners'sugar | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh rosemary
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bring a saucepan of water to a boil. Reduce heat to medium low and place the rice in a baking dish. Toss in the wild mushrooms and cook over medium heat for 20 minutes. Pour the mushroom mixture over the cooked rice and sprinkle with confectioners' sugar and cardamom. Return to oven and bake for 20 to 25 minutes, or until the rice is lightly colored and the mushrooms are tender.

title: Roast Beef and Cherryvil
ingredients: 2 kg roast, on bone preferably with the fat removed ( or beef ) | 2 tablespoons chervil, coarsely chopped
instructions: Cut the fat from the meat to make a gravy. The gravy needs to be thick and rich. Mix the chervil with a little of the gravy and paint a little over the roast. The roast should also be coated with the flour. Cook under a hot grill for 20 minutes per pound, or until browned. Turn the meat.

Random Ingredients: tandoori paste,turmeric powder,green onion,bouillon granule,spinach,lime juice zest,half cream,rump steak
title: Shredded Beef With Tandoori Sauce
ingredients: 2 teaspoons instant bouillon granules | 2 lbs rump steak, cut into 1-inch strips | 2 cups chopped fresh spinach | 1/4 cup snipped green onion ( about 2 ) | 1/4 cup half-and-half cream | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice and zest of | 2 teaspoons tandoori paste ( or to taste ) | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Using a mortar and pestle or a spoon, mash/spray beef with a fork until all pieces are evenly sized. Combine the next 9 ingredients. In 2 gallon resealable plastic bag, combine cream and tandoori paste.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,parmesan cheese,cashew,vegetable broccoli,cream sherry,whipping cream,lemon juice zest
title: Baked Cashew Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 2 tablespoons whipping cream | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1/4 cup reduced-fat sour cream | 1/4 cup dry sherry | 1/4 cup unsalted cashews, finely chopped | 1/2 cup frozen vegetables, broccoli ( recommended )
instructions: Pound chicken until about 1/4 inch thickness. Place in a shallow 1 x 1 baking pan. Bake in a 425 degree f oven for 5 minutes. Turn oven at 425 degrees f. For the dressing, make the cream sauce,. In a small bowl, stir together the whipping cream, lemon juice, sour cream, sherry and cashews. Pour over the chicken and bake in the 400 degree f oven 20 minutes until no longer pink in the middle. Transfer the chicken to a platter and surround with broccoli. Drizzle about 1/2 the sherry cream sauce over each piece. Serve warm.

title: Macaroni Salad
ingredients: 1 lb macaroni, uncooked | 3 apples, peeled, cored, cored, and diced | 12 dates, pitted, chopped, can be omitted. see note in description
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions, drain. Mix apples, dates and macaroni thoroughly. Adjust seasoning. Toss with any salad dressing of your choice, but this is optional. Also, i often add shredded cheese to my salad.

title: Ganache
ingredients: filling : | 8 ounces goat cheese | 1 strip orange zest
instructions: Crumble goat cheese into a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: white flour,portabella mushroom,salt pepper,yogurt,italian seasoning,cinnamon,walnut oil,rosemary
title: Mushroom Focaccia
ingredients: 400 g white flour | salt and pepper | 200 g fresh mushrooms | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon rosemary, dried ( i used rosemary stems ) | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon italian seasoning, dried ( i used italian seasoning blends, dried garlic powder may be used too ) | 200 g yogurt | 2 tablespoons walnut oil | 1 -2 teaspoon cinnamon
instructions: Dough, mix flour, salt and pepper in a very large bowl. Diced mushrooms, mix with rest of dry ingredients. Add yogurt and oil to dry ingredients and mix. Add spices and mix well. If dough is too sticky, add a bit of water. Knead until it feels as if you are kneading dough. If dough is too dry add a tbls. Of water. Knead a few times. Let dough rest for an hour. Take dough out onto flour dusted counter and divide into 10 pieces. Roll each piece between your palms in 1 2mm thick circles. Place on greased cookie sheet, spread with a little yogurt. Cook in 400 degree oven or in the 180 degree c oven to get the edges brown. Let cool. Eat with a loaf of bread, crackers or your favorite vegetable toppings.

title: Pasta With Peas and Carrots
ingredients: 8 ounces farfalle pasta, cooked | 1 1/2 cups peas and carrots, cooked
instructions: Put noodles in a pot with about 1 1/2 cups of salted water and bring to a boil. Cook until tender according to the directions on the package.

title: Veal Ragu
ingredients: 1 package farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 1 pound veal chops | 1 can sweetened coconut, drained | 1 package spaghetti
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook elbow macaroni in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, 12 minutes.

title: Tahini Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup tahini | 1 cup flour ( plus more for dusting `` tablecloth sack '' dust paper
instructions: Mix the tahini with ¾ cup water in a heavy saucepan until the water is barely warm to the touch. Mix the flour with the tahini mixture until a paste forms. Taste for saltiness. If you find you need more tahini, make a small well in the paste. Pour 1⁄2 cup of water into the center of the thickened paste.

Random Ingredients: venison steak,grape,sage,arborio rice,turkish bread,mushroom,clove,chicken breast meat
title: Venison-Chicken Rissoles
ingredients: 2 cups arborio rice, uncooked | 1 pound boneless, skinless chicken breast meat, cut into 1/4 to 1/2-inch strips | 2 ounces turkey breast meat, finely chopped ( about 1/2 cup ) | 1 jar quartered mushrooms, drained and rinsed | 1 1/2 teaspoons chopped fresh sage | 1 1/2 teaspoons chopped fresh rosemary | 1 teaspoon ground cloves | 1/2 cup seedless grapes, halved
instructions: Place the rice and 2 cups water in a medium saucepan, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed, 20 to 25 minutes. Fluff with a fork before serving. Mix the chicken, turkey, mushrooms, sage, rosemary, cloves, and grapes in a large bowl. Set aside 1 tablespoon of the turkey mixture. Stir the remaining turkey mixture and the rice mixture into the rice just before serving.

Random Ingredients: ice,pizza sauce,greek seasoning,phyllo pastry,flat leaf parsley
title: Greek Pizza-Easy Wedge
ingredients: 1 package frozen phyllo pastry, thawed | 1/2 cup pizza sauce | 1 tablespoon greek seasoning | 1 teaspoon finely chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | crushed ice
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Remove the phyllo from package and place sheets on a parchment lined baking sheet. Brush each sheet with some baking spray. In a medium bowl, combine the pizza sauce with the greek seasoning and parsley.

title: Traditional Kerrygold Cinnamon Rolls
ingredients: 8 ounces fresh yeast | 7 ounces double cream | 9 ounces soft butter
instructions: In a small saucepan, warm the cream over a medium heat. When warm, lightly toast the yeast in a little hot butter until foamy. Then mix the yeast mixture with the cream and soft butter and beat until it has become frothy and is very smooth. Transfer the butter to a clean bowl and put it in a warm room. Leave until bubbly and bubbling, but do not allow to boil. Remove the mixture from the heat and beat until it is creamy. Pour it into a shallow bowl, cover it with cling film, and leave it in a warm place for 5 to 6 hours or until it is just starting to set around the edges. When it is, take it out of the bowl, and knead it on a lightly floured surface until it is smooth and elastic. You should have about 1 1/2 pound of dough. Roll out the dough on a lightly floured work surface, and divide it into 1 parts. Flatten each parts slightly with your hands. Roll each part into a ball, and let it rest for a few minutes before rolling out again as above. The dough should not be sticky. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or a tea towel, or line with parchment paper. Divide the dough in half, and press out a thin sheet of the dough onto the paper. This will prevent your dough from sticking later, if you roll too thin. Spread the dough with a thin layer of milk for a more even coating of dough. Sprinkle the top layer of dough with kerrygold cinnamon. Roll each piece into a thin cylinder, then tie the ends with some string. Cut the cylinder into 4 pieces for large rolls, or into small pieces to make more rolls. Allow each roll to rise for 15 minutes, or so, covered in a warm place. Bake the rolls on the lined baking sheet for 40 minutes in a 400 degree f oven. When ready, brush the tops with an egg wash. Allow them to stand for a few minutes to allow the bread to brown.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,fennel bulb,cumin seed,rack lamb,lemon juice zest,green olive,oyster,baby spinach
title: Lamb Salad With Oysters, Fennel and Oat Sausages
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg rack lamb | 2 fennel bulbs | 6 baby spinach, stems left on | 100 g mixed green olives, pitted | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 40 g fresh oysters, drained and cut in half or 40 g jar garlic brie ( about 40 pieces per person ) | 2 teaspoons cumin seeds
instructions: Set the oven on 200°c trim the lamb racks of excess fat, and cut them into 2 1/2 6cm pieces. Place in a roasting tin and put in the oven for 20 mins, then turn the lamb over and cook for 20 mins more. Meanwhile, place the fennel and washed spinach into a large heavy based pan, add a splash of water, and bring to the boil. Cover and simmer for 8 mins, then put to one side, then tip in the olives. When the lamb is cooked, remove it from the oven and leave to stand. When the tomatoes are cooked, remove the skins from the tomatoes with a fork and slice the flesh finely. Discard the seeds and obvious fat but reserve the skin. Crush in a pestle and mortar and then stir in the lemon zest, lemon juice and oysters. When the lamb is cool enough to handle, remove it from the tin and tip in the dressing before grilling or serving. Cook the sausages in a lightly buttered frying pan until browned on each side – about 10 mins, turning regularly, then cut into 10 - 12 pieces. Spoon the salad into a warm serving dish. Scatter over the fennel bulb and olives and serve with crusty bread.

title: Crab and Bean Fritters for a Rainy Day! #1
ingredients: 2 cans crab ( in shell ) | 1 can baked beans ( drained ) | 2 cans diced radishes | 1/2 cup skim milk
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees. Combine crab, undrained beans and radishes, with 3 cups water in a roasting pan. Bring to boil, reduce heat and simmer 15 - 20 minutes, or until vegetables are soft. Stir in skim milk.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,leek,thai basil,apple juice concentrate,lemon,cake flour,red onion,red pepper
title: Red Onion-Leek Cake
ingredients: 500 g cake flour ( all purpose ) | 300 ml boiling apple juice concentrate | 1 tablespoon vanilla essence ( or vanilla sugar ) | 150 g leeks, trimmed and sliced | 1 large apple, peeled and diced | 1 large red onion, peeled and thinly sliced | 1 red pepper, deseeded and diced | 2 tablespoons lemons or 2 tablespoons lime juice
instructions: Place flour in bowl, add lukewarm apple juice concentrate & vanilla essence. Mix and sift with a fork, then work in the leek, onion, lemon or lime juice. Turn dough onto a lightly floured surface. Knead well until smooth, then roll out very thinly with two sharp bladed knife. Cut into four rounds & transfer to a greased ovenproof dish. Cover & chill for 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 190c/374f/gas mark 5. Bake for 25 - 30 mins until golden & cooked. Cool. Ice with desired decorations or frost.

Random Ingredients: beef brisket,cake flour,coffee,swiss cheese,stew meat,phyllo pastry
title: Empress Harvest Beef Brisket
ingredients: 4 lbs trimmed beef brisket, well trimmed of fat | 2 cups strong coffee | 8 ounces unflavored cake flour, sifted | 1/4 lb swiss cheese, grated | 6 sheets thawed phyllo pastry sheets, defrosted if frozen | 2 tablespoons unflavored coffee | 2 tablespoons ground coffee, cooled
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. In a large plastic bag, combine beef, 2 cups strong coffee and sifted cake flour.

title: Calamari Skewers - Octopus
ingredients: 1 lb octopus ring, cubed | 1 medium yellow pepper, chopped | 1 small cabbage, sliced into 12 wedges | 1/3 cup apricot preserves
instructions: Remove the hard centre vein from the octopus, leaving 1/2 inch of meat on the tentacles cut tentacles from heads and discard.

title: Ketjap Manis (Lemon Grass)
ingredients: 3 stalks fresh lemongrass ( the green portion only ) | 2 cups vodka or 2 cups water | 1/2 cup firmly packed dark brown sugar
instructions: Using vegetable peeler, cut lemongrass crosswise into 1 inch pieces. Remove and discard outer layer of leaves. Rinse in 2 changes of water and drain. Set aside. Combine all remaining ingredients in a blender and puree until smooth. Pour into a small saucepan and heat over medium heat, stirring constantly. The mixture will start to boil, but remove from the heat and immediately stir in lemongrass.

Random Ingredients: raisin,beef brisket,yeast,espresso powder,barbeque sauce,pork roast,chicken stock beef,onion powder
title: Tasty Irish Slow Cooker Pulled Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 lbs pork roast, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 large onion, sliced thin | 10 ounces chicken stock or 10 ounces beef stock | 3 cups beef stock ( i just use the beef and veggie blends ) | 3 tablespoons instant espresso powder, or more, to taste | 1 1/2 tablespoons instant espresso powder ( dissolved in a little of the beef stock or water ) | 1 tablespoon instant dried yeast, or more to taste | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1/2 cup raisins | 12 -14 thin-sliced irish rye bread or 12 -14 thin sourdough bread, toasted
instructions: Combine pork, onion, chicken stock, beef soup base, 1 cup of beef stock and 3/4 cup of the beef broth or water in 1 - 3 1/2 quart slow cooker. If using dry instant espresso powder and dissolved yeast, omit this step. Sprinkle in the yeast and onion powder. Cook on low setting until meat and sauce are hot and beginning to simmer and have a bit of texture when pulled up from the bone, about 8 hours. Meanwhile, prepare sandwich crust. Line a baking sheet with foil and spray the foil with non stick cooking spray. When the meat and sauce are done resting, shred the meat, and return it to the slow cooker. Add the remaining beef stock/water and stir to combine. Cover and simmer on low setting for 6 to 8 hours, or until meat is very tender. When the roast is tender and cooked, remove the meat to a platter, reserving the juices in the cooking liquid. Cool meat, skim off as much fat as possible, then slice the meat as thinly as possible. Return the beef meat to the slow cooker. Add enough reserved juices to just cover the beef, the reserved juices, if the sauce seems dry and thick, add some more broth or water. Sauce may be served at room temperature. It should also be heated at the table. To serve, ladle a good spoonful of the sauce over a slice of bread, and spread a large dollop of some of the sauce over the it. Add a slice of the shredded beef on top.

title: Eggplant and Mushroom Salad
ingredients: 3 medium oranges, peeled, sectioned, and pith removed | 2 medium lemons, juice of | 1 1/2 lbs eggplants, cubed, cut 1/2 inch thick | 1 cup baby chanterelles or 1 cup fresh shiitake mushroom, cut into 1/2 inch dice | 32 ounces french bread, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 3 cups bottled light brown sugar | 1/3 cup cider vinegar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Place the zest of 3 oranges in a baking dish. Set aside. Juice the last orange, reserving the juice. Wash the zest, trim away any green pith, and cut the zest into 1/2 inch thin strips. Cut the eggplant in half, lengthwise, then cut crosswise into 1/4 inch thick slices. Place the slices on a parchment lined baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Cut the eggplant into thin sticks. Combine the eggplant, zest strips, and mushrooms in a medium bowl. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour, or for up to 8 hours. Heat 2 tablespoons of reserved orange juice in a saucepan over medium high heat. Add the bread, and turn frequently until it toasts. Watch carefully as it may burn quickly. Remove from heat, and pour into a serving dish or platter. Cover. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Place the french bread slices on plates, and divide the remaining syrup ingredients among them. Place salad on top of the syrup, then top with the fried eggplant strips and fried mushrooms.

Random Ingredients: bamboo shoot,green olive,heavy whipping cream,beef rib,rice noodle,nutmeg,snow pea
title: Kalama Supur (Beef and Pepper Rice Noodle Stew)
ingredients: 2 lbs beef short ribs ( country style is best ) | 1 can pork and prawns ( optional ) | 3/4 lb green olives | 1 can bamboo shoots | 1 cup dry rice noodles | 1 package snow pea | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/2 tablespoon nutmeg
instructions: Cut short ribs into two pieces and trim fat. Combine short ribs with pork, prawns, green olives and bamboo shoots. Cook over low heat at least two hours. Cook noodles according to package directions. Drain. Transfer to serving platter with meat mixture and snow peas. Pour cream over meat mixture. Sprinkle over nutmeg. Serve warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: yellow onion,beef brisket,parmigiano reggiano cheese,manchego cheese
title: Rassolnik Iz Saltona: Brisket With Breadcrumbs, Cheese and Onion (Moorieskalaka)
ingredients: 3 lbs beef brisket, trimmed | 2 large yellow onions, trimmed, halved, then thinly sliced crosswise ( about 2 cups ) | 2 tablespoons freshly grated manchego cheese | parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f rub the brisket with oil and salt. Place brisket on a rack in a roasting pan and roast until well browned, 45 to 55 minutes. Meanwhile, slice onions crosswise into 1/4 inch thick slices. Place sliced onions on a foil lined baking sheet. Place broiler rack 5 inches from heat and warm oven. Remove the brisket from the oven and arrange the brisket on top of the onions to avoid burning. Place oven and roasting pan over a high broiler and flame brisket until the bones just start to form a crust on the top, about 5 minutes, switching position of oven when the first side of the brisket is medium well, about 35 minutes total. Transfer brisket to a carving board and let rest 10 minutes. Slice brisket across the grain and arrange slices on serving platters. Spoon onion and cheese onto each slice of meat and sprinkle with freshly grated manchego. Serve slices with additional cheese.

title: Asparagus and Chilies in Brandy
ingredients: 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 1 bunch fresh asparagus, cut into 2-inch pieces | 1 can del monte original stewed tomatoes and green chilies, undrained
instructions: In a small nonstick skillet, warm syrup and stir in asparagus. Cook and stir until lightly browned, about 2 minutes. Spoon over hot cooked asparagus and chilies.

title: Pesto with Anchovies
ingredients: 1 cup vegetable oil or 1 cup peanut oil | 3 tablespoons ginger garlic paste ( or about 2 1/2 teaspoons ) or 3 tablespoons garlic paste ( or about 2 1/2 teaspoons ) | 1 teaspoon anchovy paste, mashed well or 1/4 teaspoon anchovy liquid, to taste ( or more )
instructions: Heat all ingredients until bubbles disappear. Pour onto a small plate and cool. Note, you can easily make your own flavored pesto or serve with bread or as an accompaniment to meat and vegetables.

Random Ingredients: green chile,golden syrup,onion soup mix lipton
title: Chile Con Carne (Chile-onion Soup)
ingredients: 5 large green chiles | 6 leaves pre-soaked sweet and sour onion soup mix ( i have used lipton onion soup mix ii ) | 3 tablespoons golden syrup
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Snap off the tops of the green chilies and devein them if they are large. Place the chilies on a sheet pan and place in the oven for about 10 minutes to steam. Remove the chilies and rub them open, carefully. If they are large, cut them open and remove the seeds if you wish. You want the chilies to stay whole. Once the chilies are cool, remove and discard the stalk. Wash and dry the dry soup mix. Place the soup mix in a blender or food processor and blend in the hot water. Stir well to make sure the soup can be mixed throughly. Pour the soup into a saucepan. If you used the presoaked sweet onion, mix in the golden syrup and stir well to thoroughly coat. This soup can be served hot, but is preferred served warm.

title: Sweet Sour Soup

instructions: Cook pepperoni until well crisped. Add all remaining ingredients. Simmer for 2 hours.

title: Crock Pot Lasagna
ingredients: 32 ounces fiesta nacho cheese soup | 10 3/4 ounces sliced green onion | 32 ounces asparagus spears, thawed and well drained | 3 medium waxy potatoes, peeled and cut into 2-inch pieces | 12 lasagna noodles, cooked, drained, rinsed
instructions: In a slow cooker, combine soup and next 4 ingredients. Cover and cook on low setting 3 - 4 hours until vegetables are tender. Add noodles. Cover and cook on high setting 2 1/2 hours. Do not boil. Remove from heat and let stand 10 minutes before serving. Serve.

title: Scallop and Bean Sprout Salad
ingredients: 85 g fresh yeast | 120 g fresh cauliflower florets | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes, softened | 300 g sea scallops or 300 g scallops | 125 g frozen small broccoli florets | 200 g fresh fava beans or 200 g bok choy, chopped | 100 g iceberg lettuce ( or other springy green )
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in 100ml warm water. Place the cauliflower, sun dried tomatoes and scallops to one side. Rinse, dry and roughly chop the scallops. Drain the mignon if using frozen ones. Slice the broccoli and bok choy, if using canned, as thinly as possible. In a large heatproof bowl, pour the yeast water and mix in the yeast mixture. The mix should just warm through. Add the chopped celery and bean sprouts to the bowl. Cover with a piece of kitchen foil and leave to prove in the warm spot for about 20 minutes. To serve, divide the lettuce leaves among four salad bowls or plates and top with the sprout and mignon.

Random Ingredients: pork loin roast,pineapple chunk,beef bouillon granule,honey,sage,stir fry oil vegetable,heavy cream,chicken broth
title: Stir Fry Ginger Pork and Beef
ingredients: 1 jar stir fry oil or ( 10 ounce ) jar vegetable oil | 1 boneless pork loin roast, trimmed | 2 beef bouillon granules | 1/4 cup minced fresh sage | 1 1/2 cups reduced-sodium chicken broth | 1/4 cup heavy cream | 2 cans pineapple chunks, drained and juice reserved | 1 tablespoon honey
instructions: Remove the fat, chain, and silverskin from the roast or if it has a large piece of silver skin, use it for another purpose to protect from peeling away the chain and tenderizing the roast. Cut the roast into 1 - ½ inch cubes about 2 inches long, removing any membrane and silverskin fragments. In a large skillet, heat the oil, then add the pork and fry on all sides until golden brown. Remove and set aside. Lower the heat, add the beef bouillon granules, and stir well. Add the sage and stir in the broth and heavy cream. Cover and simmer in a 275 degree f oven for 1 hour, stir frequently. Stir in the pineapple juice and honey and continue cooking for 15 minutes longer. Serve over cooked rice.

title: Tequila Salt (Shaker Limen)
ingredients: 6 -8 peppercorns | 1 cup real tequila | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Basically, just shake the salt thoroughly in the top of a bottle of tequila, do not stir. If it becomes very hard, try making it with a double old potato peeler, or a hard vegetable peeler first. To replicate this, i use a special equipment cocktail shaker, that you have to thoroughly clean the bottle of tequila. It also works well with lemonade concentrate. For flavor, try to get the real salt with 1 cup orange juice, maybe a lime juice concentrate of your choice but no more than half cup. If you plan on making the drink ahead of time and using less sugar, you may need to mix up the shakes. You should get away with a smooth, tangy, flavorful, flavored salt, if you have it.

Random Ingredients: red chili powder,vanilla,chili pepper flake,white sugar,rye bread
title: Spicy Sour Rye Bread
ingredients: 6 slices rye bread | 1/2 cup red chili pepper flakes | 1/2 cup chili pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1 teaspoon chili pepper flakes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Line a cookie sheet with aluminum foil. Arrange the rye bread slices in the tin, and place in the oven. When the bread is toasted and warm, mix all the dry ingredients together and pour onto the untoasted rye bread slices. The rye bread may be made and spread or refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Bratwurst Strudels (Bratwurst Strudels)
ingredients: 32 bratwurst | 4 green olives | 2 sheets puff pastry ( thawed ) | 1/8 cup pimento stuffed olive ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Peel olives, cut in half. Slice bratwurst diagonally in half, and slice olives on the diagonal into 1/4 slices. Wash and place green olives, on baking sheet, and bake at 425°f for 5 - 10 minutes, or until they start to caramelize. Remove from oven, and let cool to room temperature. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Lay pastry out on parchment lined baking sheet, then spread a generous amount of olive on each. Place bratwurst at bottom of pastry, and sprinkle with olives, if desired. Place remaining pastry on top of cheese. Pour a little olive oil onto sheet. Place strudel on top of cheese. Bake at 425°f for 5 - 10 minutes, but watch carefully so as not to burn on the outside. When strudels are brown, take out of oven, and cut into slices for appetizers.

title: Berry, Blueberry, and Chambord Sauce
ingredients: 3 cups fresh whole berry pieces | 1/2 cup fresh blueberries | 2 cups whipping cream | 1/4 cup peach and chambord raspberry sauce | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice
instructions: Bring a pot of water to boil. Toss berry pieces with a tablespoon or so of salt in a bowl of ice water.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,cider vinegar,pork tenderloin,maple syrup,guacamole,tomatillo salsa
title: Mexican Pulled Pork
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin, trimmed | 1 jar tomatillo salsa | 3/4 cup guacamole | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 1 tablespoon maple syrup
instructions: Place the pork tenderloin crosswise in a large slow cooker. Spread the tomatillo salsa on the pork. Place the pork on top of the salsa. Cover and cook on high for 1 1/2 hours, turning the pork occasionally. Remove the pork from the slow cooker and place on a serving platter. Mix the guacamole, vinegar, and maple syrup in the slow cooker. Cover and cook on high for 30 minutes, turning the pork occasionally to coat. Spoon the guacamole mixture over the pork and serve.

title: Baked Beef Rolls
ingredients: 3 lbs sirloin steaks, very thinly sliced ( can sub sirloin steak strips ) | 2 tablespoons dehydrated onion flakes ( optional. the only flavor is in the sour cream ) | 1 tablespoon poppy seed | 2 tablespoons dried dill | 1/4 cup catsup | 1/2 cup brandy ( no subs ) | 1 cup carrot, grated
instructions: In a large bowl, toss beef with onion flakes, poppy seed and dill. Stir in catsup and brandy. Spray a large baking dish with non stick cooking spray. Dip each meat roll into the marinade. Place meat in the prepared pan. Cover and bake, turning occasionally, for 1 hour, or to desired doneness.

title: Grilled Shredded Italian Breadsticks
ingredients: 4 garlic cloves, minced | 5 cans bamboo shoots, rinsed and drained | 3/4 cup italian seasoned dry bread crumbs
instructions: Preheat grill to high. In a large bowl, mix together the garlic, bamboo shoots, bread crumbs, and italian seasoning. Roll the mixture into sticks about 1 inch in diameter. Place on the prepared grill, and cook 5 minutes on each side, or until the breadsticks are tender and lightly charred on the exterior.

Random Ingredients: vegetable broth,chickpea,beet,yellow pea,clove,chicken wing,pillsbury crescent dinner,tomato green chilies
title: Vegetable Chicken-Beet Pies
ingredients: 8 chicken wings | 1 large beet, cooked and coarsely chopped | 1 cup yellow split peas, dried ( or whole shelled ) | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained ( or equivalent ) | 4 cups vegetable broth | 1 tablespoon whole cloves | 2 cans pillsbury refrigerated crescent dinner rolls ( or equivalent ) | 1 can chickpeas ( drained )
instructions: Cut up chicken wings in half, discard tips. Chop beet, tomatoes and chicken. Set aside. Boil 1 cup vegetable broth for 4 minutes. Combine all ingredients except crescent dough, chickpeas, 1/4 cup of the vegetable broth/vegetable broth/garam masala mixture and 2 tablespoons of the vegetable broth/garam masala mix into broth in food processor. Blend until smooth. If consistency is too thin, add a teaspoon or so of broth or water until desired texture is achieved. Pour over chicken pieces in an 8x8 or square baking pan coated with cooking spray. Bake at 350°f or hot just until crisp, about 25 minutes. Let cool slightly. Meanwhile, prepare 2 cans of chickpeas. You will need about 1 cup for this recipe. Pour remaining broth over cooked chickpeas, mix well. Set aside. Preheat oven to 400°f grease 9 x 13 or equivalent baking dish. Unroll dough on baking sheet. Press down to make about 8 x 2 inches. With fingers, place dough in pan, seam side down. Cut with 2 1/2 inch round cutter. Bake, until golden brown, about 12 - 13 minutes. Remove to rack and cool completely. Cut dough in squares using sharp scissors about the size of large red pepper halves. Spread 1 teaspoon chickpea mixture in each square. Cut each square diagonally in half and place on serving plate. Garnish with 2 tablespoons of the vegetable broth/garam masala mixture.

Random Ingredients: egg yolk,garam masala,cream chicken soup,brown sugar,pineapple juice,green zucchini,scallion
title: Simmered Churros over Rice
ingredients: 2 tablespoons garam masala | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 4 scallions, minced | 4 scallions, ends trimmed and sliced, white part only | 4 -6 firm green zucchini, thinly sliced on the diagonal | 1 1/2 cups pineapple tidbits ( drained well after cooking ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons garam masala | 2 egg yolks, lightly beaten | 2 tablespoons light brown sugar | 2 tablespoons light cream or 2 tablespoons light sour cream
instructions: For sauce, put everything except cream or sour cream in a small bowl. Let sit in the fridge for at least one hour. In a large skillet over medium heat, put about 3 tbs oil and 1 tbs water. Heat the water, but don't let it boil. Pour a small amount of oil into the pan. Then add the green onions and cook until brown, about 10 - 15 seconds. Add the zucchini slices, sauteed onions, and sugar. Cook until zucchini are cooked through. Serve over rice. Sour cream topping, in a bowl, combine sour cream, brown sugar, and cream, combine. Add a little water, a little at a time at this stage, if it gets too thick. Pour over rice and stir until all is mixed. Cover tightly and chill until ready to use. It will keep up to 3 days.

Random Ingredients: butter,green onion,lemon peel,rice wine vinegar,chicken breast halve,chili,brandy,red curry paste
title: Thai Grilled Chicken
ingredients: butter | 2 tablespoons minced fresh chili | 1 green onion, sliced thinly | 2 chicken breast halve, skinless | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 2 teaspoons minced fresh lemon peel | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon brandy ( optional )
instructions: Brush the butter on each cutlet and season with salt and pepper. Place on a piece of greaseproof paper or plastic wrap and pound flat. Bake at 375°f for 12 to 15 minutes, depending on thickness of chicken meat. Brush once with curry paste and sprinkle with lemon peel and chili. Combine dressing ingredients and drizzle over fish.

title: Lentils and Prawns With Brown Rice and Walnut Pilaf
ingredients: 750 g canned red lentils | 1 chicken stock cube | 400 g elbow macaroni | 150 g shelled and deveined prawns | 1 tablespoon grenadine, infused | 2 tablespoons walnuts, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c or 190°c fan forced. Place the lentils in a large pan of boiling water and cook for 10 minutes. Drain well and add to a separate pan. Cook for 5 minutes, then stir in stock cube. Bring to the boil and add macaroni. Return to the boil. Cover and cook for 10 minutes, then stir in prawns. Place half of the grenadine and half of the walnuts in a small baking dish. Sprinkle with remaining hazelnuts. Bake the pilaf for 25 - 30 minutes, or until prawns are cooked through. Serve with the remaining french franks.

title: Cha Yen - Spicy Korean Bean Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 lb linguine | 1/2 lb korean soy bean paste | 4 ounces cheddar cheese ( grated )
instructions: Prepare and boil your linguine. Heat a bit of water in a skillet. Add the bean paste. Saute for 2 minutes over medium heat. Add a handful of the linguine to the pot. When the pasta is about half way cooked, pour it into this sauce over the bean paste. Keep boiling over medium heat, stirring frequently. When the sauce begins to bubble, add a handful of the cheese. Keep stirring as the cheese melts. If not serving immediately, you can serve this on a platter.

Random Ingredients: pork fillet,triple sec,pork tenderloin,banana,lime zest,yogurt,cider vinegar
title: Slow Cooker Tenderloin of Pork With Banana
ingredients: 3 lbs pork tenderloin | 1/2 cup triple sec | 1/2 cup cider vinegar | 1/2 cup yogurt | 1 lime, zest of | 1/2 cup dried banana | 2 teaspoons lime zest
instructions: Combine salt, triple sec, vinegar, and yogurt in crock and place in refrigerator until ready to use. Trim fat from pork. Cut into 8 equal serving serving size pieces. Pour marinade over pork in crock. Cover and cook on low setting 8 to 10 hours or on high setting 4 to 6 hours, or until pork registers 170 degrees on an instant reading thermometer. Remove pork from crock and chill in refrigerator for 1 hour and then shred meat using two forks. Spoon some portions onto serving plate and top with the banana and chopped banana. Serve with a side dish of mango pickle and lime wedges.

title: Malaysian Chilli & Ginger Cannelloni
ingredients: 2 tablespoons galangal, minced | 2 tablespoons candel nuts or 2 tablespoons almonds, chopped | 1 tablespoon candle nut, chopped | 1/2 cup ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup pineapple, shredded ( fresh preferably, your favorite brand ) | lettuce leaf, washed and dried | peach, sliced, to serve
instructions: In a non stick frying pan, using a little ghee, toast the galangal, candle nuts and candlenuts until fragrant, about 2 to 3 minutes. Blend the ginger and candle nuts, then add to the ginger mixture. Stir in the ricotta, mix well and allow all ingredients to stand for a few minutes. Spoon the cannelloni into your serving plates, then top with the pineapple slices and some thorn lettuce leaves. Serve with lots of red chilli sauce.

Random Ingredients: bread flour,pork chop,lamb shank,ouzo,coconut,chickpea flour,vanilla essence
title: Fried Pork Chops & Lamb Shank in Ouzo
ingredients: 12 lamb shank | 1/2 cup ouzo | 2 teaspoons ouzo | 1 kg pork chop, bone-in | 2 teaspoons ouzo | 1 tablespoon coconut | 1 teaspoon ouzo | 100 g chickpea flour | 1 teaspoon coconut | 1/2 teaspoon ouzo | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: For the meat, combine the ouzo with the ouzo, then marinate the meat in it for 30 minutes at room temperature. For the lamb, trim the excess fat from the chops and the shanks. Cut the chops into three equal portions. Dry fry them over medium flame for 5 - 6 minutes, stirring constantly so it browns evenly all over. Set out the lamb. For the ouzo, mix all the ingredients for the ouzo. Dip the lamb shank and put in a casserole dish. Pour the ouzo over the shanks and add enough water to come just below the surface of the shanks, cover the dish and cook in a medium heat oven. Cook for about 2 hours over high heat. When cooked, remove the lamb to a warm plate and keep warm until required. Serve the lamb with yoghurt. For the breadcrumbs, mix all the ingredients for the ouzo together and check the seasoning. If the mixture is dry, add more ouzo. Dreasure the amount of ouzo needed and pour over the breadcrumbs. Serve the chops with yoghurt and yoghurt sauce.

title: Mushroom Gravy
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Stir together the cream of mushroom soup and cornstarch in a skillet over medium heat. Dumpling the bottom of a gravy boat, about four layers deep, with a lid. Pour mushroom gravy over the top of the dumpling. Place lid on pot and bring to a boil.

title: Maple-Glazed Smoked Ham Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/2 lb hamburger bun | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons maple syrup ( i use my own homemade maple syrup ) | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 1/2 cup watercress
instructions: Preheat broiler. Place hamburger bun on rack in broiler pan. Broil for 2 minutes. Turn.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,raspberry,hoagie,ginger garlic paste,tahini,bean thread noodle,corn oil,dashi stock
title: Quick Noodle Soup With Pickled Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 30 ounces bean thread noodles | 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons pickled ginger-garlic paste | 1 1/2 tablespoons tahini | 1 cup dashi stock, hot | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 1/4 lb fresh bean thread noodles | hoagie
instructions: Bring 2 quarts of water to a boil. Prepare the noodles by placing them in a small bowl and cover with cold water. Soak for 30 minutes and drain and set aside. Heat oil in a large saute pan. Add ginger and garlic pastes cook for 2 minutes. Add noodle and stir fry for another 3 minutes. Pour in hot dashi stock and bring to a boil. Cover and simmer for 12 minutes. Serve hot topped with bean threads and hoagie rolls.

title: Lima Bean Focaccia
ingredients: 1/2 lb lima beans | 2 tablespoons fish stock | 1 lb focaccia bread
instructions: Put the lima beans into a saucepan. Pour on enough fish stock to cover, bring to a simmer, and cook until tender. Meanwhile, slice the focaccia horizontally in half, to make two boats. When done, put one half of the bread on top of the other half. Cook in the grill for five minutes or so, turning once, to make a nice, crusty topping. Aioli, saffron salt if using it. Focaccia salt, if using it, blend 1/4 cup cold water with 1 teaspoon orange rind until well mixed. Add 1 cup cold water with 1/4 teaspoon orange rind. Keep tasting until the desired doneness.

title: Sailors' Sauce for Fish
ingredients: 1/4 cup capers, drained | 3 tablespoons dry white wine | 1 tablespoon fish sauce
instructions: Combine capers, white wine, and fish sauce in the bowl of a meat grinder or food processor. Grind coarsely into a fine paste. Store at room temperature.

title: Roasted Green Peas with Yogurt
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups shelled raw peas ( about 3 1/2 cups ) | 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Using a sharp knife, cut a cross 1/4 inch deep across the peas. Place in a 9x13 baking dish and bake for 45 minutes, or until heated through and tender. In a small bowl combine the yogurt and the parmesan. Spoon the peas into a bowl and drizzle with half of the yogurt mixture. Sprinkle with the remaining yogurt mixture. Return to the oven and bake until heated through and bubbly, about 10 minutes.

title: Vegetable Couscous Appetizer
ingredients: 1 box couscous | 6 ounces unsweetened chocolate, melted | 1/2 cup orange peel, finely grated | 1/4 cup kalamata olive, pitted and finely chopped if large | 2 cups portabella mushrooms, sliced thinly | 1/3 cup kalata olive, pitted and finely chopped | toothpicks, extra | jasmine rice, as accompaniment
instructions: Prepare couscous according to package directions, adding the melted chocolate and orange peel. When the couscous has finished cooking, stir in the olive and mushrooms, and let cool completely. Place a toothpick through the bottom of each couscous box to absorb as much of the chocolate as possible. Top each serving with a tbsp and more of the cooled chocolate mixture, drizzle top with a tbsp of extra virgin olive oil and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: rice wine vinegar,coriander,vanilla extract,passion fruit,cilantro stem,red wine vinegar,spinach leaf,white wine vinegar
title: Pickled Spinach
ingredients: 500 g washed fresh spinach leaves | 1 bunch fresh spinach leaves | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1/2 cup sweet vietnamese sweet passion fruit | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro stems | 2 teaspoons ground coriander | 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
instructions: Place the spinach in a bowl with the rice wine vinegar, wine vinegars, sweet vietnamese passion fruit, cilantro stems and vanilla if using, and mix together to combine. Pack the spinach mixture into a sterilized jar with the mint leaves, caprese close, and refrigerate for 2 to 3 days, shaking the jar daily to redistribute the flavours. Once ready to serve, remove the jars, and store in the sun for up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: table salt,white sugar,turmeric powder,chorizo sausage,polenta,kiwi,heavy cream
title: Polenta With Chorizo
ingredients: 1 cup polenta | 3/4 lb spicy kieli cheese, casing removed | 1 lb turkish chorizo sausage | 2 tablespoons table salt | 1 cup heavy cream | 1/2 cup white sugar | 1 1/2 cups heavy cream | 1 kiwi, peeled, thinly sliced
instructions: Place the polenta and 1 cup of water in a bowl and mix to a thick paste with your hands. Cover, and set aside. Place a heavy skillet over medium high heat for 15 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes. Stir in the chorizo, and cook for 5 minutes, stirring often, until the sausage is browned. Drain and crumble. Remove from heat and stir in the turkish sausage. Set aside to cool slightly. Measure 1 cup of cornmeal into a bowl, and stir in the remaining ingredients, adding more cornmeal if necessary, to make a thick, consistent batter. Set aside until the polenta thickens. Coat a rimmed baking sheet with oil, and line with parchment paper. Scoop the batter batter into batches onto the parchment paper, leaving a 1/2 inch space in the center of each. Bake in the preheated oven until browned on top and a toothpick inserted into the center of a polenta comes out clean, about 25 minutes. Transfer to a rack to cool, then cut into strips for serving. To serve, spread some chorizo crumbled onto each plate and top with a slice of kiwi.

title: Chesse
ingredients: 2 packages dry yeast | 1 quart heavy cream or 1 quart half-and-half | 1/3 cup anchovy paste ( see note ) | shredded sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: The dough must be somewhat spongy, but not sticky. Dissolve yeast in warm cream and set aside in a warm place for 10 minute pour sour cream into a large mixing bowl. Add anchovy paste and mix well. Add the cheddar and mix well. Cover with saran wrap and let rise till double. Punch dough down and let rise again till doubled. Turn on to floured counter top and knead till smooth. The dough should be elastic and easy to handle. Place on greased baking sheet and turn onto floured counter top. Cover with greased saran wrap and let rise till almost double. Turn onto floured counter top and again knead till smooth. Dough will be sticky so you might have to add some more flour. Grease a large pan with cooking spray and place dough in bowl and turn the dough to coat. Cover with saran wrap and let rise in warm place till double again. Pre heat oven 350°f. Bake in oven for 15 to 30 minutes or until crust is firm.

Random Ingredients: pork sparerib,walnut half,orzo pasta,basil leaf,icing sugar,egg
title: Orzo Stuffed Pork Riblets
ingredients: 4 large pork spareribs | 1 box orzo pasta ( i prefer pearl, but any pasta will do ) | 4 eggs | 1/4 cup icing sugar | 2 tablespoons chopped basil leaves | 1/2 cup walnut halves ( optional, depends on size of pork ) or 1/2 cup pecans ( optional, depends on size of pork )
instructions: Place ribs in pot of boiling salted water. When water begins to boil, reduce heat to medium. Do not cover, it will boil over quickly. Let ribs simmer at a low simmer for 4 hours. Remove meat and place on a plate while making pasta. Cook orzo until al dente then drain. Place all ingredients except nuts and pork in a large bowl and mix well. Add enough pork cooking water to bring pasta to a boil. When water comes to a boil, remove from heat and mix well. Place orzo in a large shallow bowl and coat with 1/2 cup of icing sugar. Drop 1 cup orzo mixture in and coat with 2 tbsp of pork oracle. Repeat with remaining orzo, mix well and coat. Place on a tray, cover and refrigerate or chill. Garnish with nuts if desired.

title: Tahini Sauce for Steaks, Beef, Fish and Chicken
ingredients: 1/4 cup tahini or 1/4 cup fresh-made plain breadcrumbs | 2 small red chilies, such as dried jalapeno jalapenos or 2 small serrano chilies, minced to taste
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the dry ingredients. Stir in 1 tbls. Of the tahini. Sprinkle with the rest of the tahini and chillies. Makes about 1 cup or more of sauce.

title: Mexican Macaroni
ingredients: 1 lb macaroni ( i like tri-colored ) | 1 canned chipotle chile, minced | 1 strip orange peel
instructions: Start boiling water and bring it to a boil. While the water is coming up, in a large bowl, combine the macaroni and the chipotle. When the water boils, add the orange peel strip. When the macaroni is ready, drain it and place it into a serving bowl. Toss it through your sauce. Serve immediately.

title: Easy Beet Salad - Ekadasi Chhaar
ingredients: 3 fresh beets | 1/2 apple juice ( i use apple juice- if u can not find this, just use pure apple juice ) | 3 tablespoons beet juice
instructions: Wash beets. Cut off the top stem and the bottoms. Wash and trim off the top leaves from the beet, leaving about 1/2 of the beet root on the root. Cut off each root and scoop out the beet root part, discard the beet tops. Slice the beets into thin slices. Bring a medium sized pot of water to a boil. Add salt, turn off the heat and let the pot sit for about 1/2 an hour. Place beets in ice water to soak for about 20 minutes. Drain and pat dry. Heat apple juice in a bowl or pan over low heat for about 3 minutes. Drain beets and add to the hot apple juice and blend well. Let this mixture cool for a minute or two, then transfer to the refrigerator overnight. Just before serving, add beetroot to the beet mixture and blend well. Adjust salt to taste before serving.

Random Ingredients: coriander,phyllo pastry,french bread,fish stock,icing sugar,red pepper
title: Coriander Fish and Pepper Strudels
ingredients: 2 fish stock ( i use fish stock made home bought ) | 1 tablespoon coriander, chopped | 125 g frozen phyllo pastry ( thawed ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons red peppers ( chopped ) | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 1 loaf french bread ( thinly sliced diagonally )
instructions: Preheat oven to 220c. Bring fish stock to boil in a saucepan over high heat. Stir in corriander. Remove from heat. Stir in phyllo and pepper until just coated.

title: Frijoles De Leche
ingredients: 2 cups dried cannellini beans | 2 cups dried pinto beans | 1/4 cup oil for frying
instructions: Place cannellini beans and pinto beans in a large saucepan, and pour enough water over to cover. Bring to a boil, and cook for 90 minutes, or until beans are soft and creamy. Drain water. Remove and discard all but about 1/4 cup of the water used. Mash beans with a potato masher until completely smooth, and set aside. Heat olive oil, or enough to coat the bottom of a skillet, in a deep fryer or deep frying pan. Heat until oil shimmers, but not smoking. If the oil seems to separate, add another tablespoon of oil now, and keep stirring. When the oil is smoking, ladle a few spoons of beans into the hot oil, and turn frequently until a light golden brown color. Use a slotted spoon, lift beans, and drain on paper towels.

Random Ingredients: italian seasoning,pico de gallo,chipotle pepper adobo sauce
title: Easy Salsa - a Simple No-Refrigerator Recipe
ingredients: 1 can chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, diced | 1 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | pico de gallo, or other hot tomato dip, for garnish
instructions: Combine chipotles, italian seasoning, and hot tomato dip in a bowl. Chill until serving.

Random Ingredients: daikon radish,liquid smoke flavoring,pineapple juice,white miso,oatmeal,pea carrot,peanut oil,celery rib
title: Jook
ingredients: 1/2 cup white miso or 1/2 cup packed yellow miso | 4 ounces pineapple juice | 4 ounces pea carrots, finely diced | 4 celery ribs, finely diced | 1 small daikon radish, diced | 2 teaspoons liquid smoke flavoring | 1 cup quick oatmeal ( regular or quick-cooking ) | 1/3 cup peanuts oil
instructions: Place all ingredients in a food processor and process until smooth. Pour into a shallow dish and refrigerate for at least an hour to let flavors blend. To serve, sprinkle with a little more shredded coconut or peanuts.

title: Mexican Green Chili
ingredients: 1 bag frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained | 1 can chopped green chiles, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly grease a medium baking dish. Stir all ingredients together in a large bowl. Spread the mixture evenly in the prepared baking dish. Bake in preheated oven until heated through, about 25 minutes.

title: Cream Dessert Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 2 tablespoons garlic powder
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir cream, garlic powder, and white vinegar together. Stir milk from cream into sauce and then refrigerate until chilled.
