Random Ingredients: fine salt,iceberg lettuce,onion powder,pork roast,coconut flour,pork back rib
title: Baja Pork
ingredients: 4 lbs pork roast, cut into cubes ( boneless pork shoulder ) | 1/2 teaspoon fine salt | 1/2 tablespoon onion powder | 2 teaspoons coconut flour | 2 cans pork back ribs | 1 head iceberg lettuce
instructions: Put the pork roast, salt, onion powder, coconut flour, and pork rind in the crockpot. Cook on low until the pork is almost tender, or for about 6 to 8 hours. Take the pork out, and leave to cool to room temperature. When cooled, shred into whatever size pieces you need to make this. Put all the leftover meat in a separate bowl. Skim any fat off the top of the gravy, and pour over the pork. Cover, and let set overnight, or up to 8 hours. Before serving, take the meat out of crockpot, and place in a large casserole dish. Tear lettuce into pieces, and place around the pork mixture. Serve as a filling to the finished dish.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage,jalapeno pepper,coconut oil,swiss cheese,cardamom pod,onion flake
title: Baked Italian Sausages With Swiss and Coconut
ingredients: 4 large sweet italian sausages ( or other sweet sausage ) | 1/2 cup coconut oil ( or other vegetable oil ) | 1/2 cup dehydrated onion flakes | 3 -6 cardamom pods, cracked open | 1 large jalapeno pepper | mildly schdijon cheese, grated, garnish ( cheddar or swiss )
instructions: If using links, cut lengthwise. If using whole casings, break into 1/2 inch pieces. If using turkey links, cut lengthwise into 1/2 inch sections. Place in a shallow bowl and coat with coconut oil. Place on a rack in a pan that has been brushed with oil and bake in a 450f oven for 10 minutes or until crisp and golden. Remove from oven and set aside. Brush casings clean with oil and remove casing and skin from sausage. Coat meat with the onion flakes and cracked cardamom pods. Spread onion flakes directly over sausage. Sprinkle with cheddar or swiss cheese. Return to oven for five more minutes, until cheese is melted and bubbly.

title: Cretan Mushrooms over Tomato and Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 1 portabella mushroom | 28 grape tomatoes ( approximately 12 small ) | 16 ounces tomato sauce
instructions: Preheat the broiler or a stove top grill. Toast the mushrooms or simply slice them on a mandoline and slice them. Place the tomato and tomato sauces together in a large bowl and mix together. Gently add the mushroom slices until they are evenly coated and place them under the broiler until the tomatoes and tomatoes are starting to bubble gently, approximately 3 - 5 minutes or until some of the tomatoes and tomatoes have split and mushrooms are soft looking. Enjoy.

title: French Chocolate Truffles
ingredients: 2 lbs tempeh, cut into 1 inch cubes | 2 cups unsweetened instant chocolate-covered coffee beans | 2 cups ice water | 1/2 cup wine ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender or food processor and whirl until smooth. Serve over ice.

title: Herring in Iceland (Kapachor Filkandes)
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh herring fillets, bones removed | 2 cups ice, softened | 2 vegetable drumsticks, split cut into bite-size wedges | 10 whole cloves | 1/2 cup melted lard
instructions: Place herring fillets in cold water to cover, to stop the cooking at the 1 1, 1/2 intervals. Soak the herrings 8 hours or overnight, refrigerated, changing the water once a day. The meat will be soft and oily, but firm. In a small bowl, blend the ice with half of the herring pieces. Place a small plate over the herring, or cover the plate with waxed paper and place it over the fillets in a shallow roasting pan. Drain and allow to dry at room temperature 15 minutes. Preheat the oven to 450°f. Dry the remaining herring filets. Cut the herring pieces into wedges, discarding any backbone. Transfer the fillets to a dish. Toss with the clove. Drizzle with the melted lard. Bake for 20 minutes or until it is hot and slightly browned.

Random Ingredients: pico de gallo,cocoa,golden raisin,ricotta cheese,yogurt,apple,taco seasoning
title: Apple Taco Balls
ingredients: 1 package taco seasoning, divided | 2 cups cheese-flavored crumbled ricotta cheese | 1/3 cup chunky natural yogurt | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa | 1 cup golden raisins, divided | 1 apple, peeled, cored, and shredded | pico de gallo ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Stir 1/2 cup taco seasoning into shredded cheese. Place ricotta cheese, yogurt, cocoa, 1/2 cup raisins, and 1/2 cup shredded apple in a bowl. Mix until well combined. Shape mixture into 1 inch balls and pat them out onto a baking sheet. Bake until heated through and lightly browned, about 10 minutes. Serve with pico de gallo if desired.

title: Peach Kugel
ingredients: 1 tablespoon active dry yeast | 1 cup warm peach juice ( not boiling ) | 2 packages active dry yeast | 1 package fresh peaches, peeled, cored, and sliced
instructions: In a small bowl, dissolve 1 tablespoon yeast in warm peach juice. Let stand 5 minutes. Drain 1 package fresh active dry yeast. Add peach slices, 1 package fresh yeast, peach slices, 1 package active dry yeast, salt to taste, and 2 cups warm peach juice to a greased 2 1/2 quart casserole.

Random Ingredients: tamarind pulp,tamari soy sauce,fruit,ice,beef stew meat
title: Thai Beef Satay
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tamarind pulp | 2 tablespoons tamari soy sauce ( or to taste ) | 3 -4 tablespoons diced coriander or 3 -4 tablespoons chopped ginger | 2 -3 lbs beef stew meat, cut into bite-size chunks | 1 cup crushed ice
instructions: Cut the beef into chunks and put in a glass baking dish or bowl. Mix the rest of the ingredients in a blender and pour over the beef and stir to combine. Cover tightly and refrigerate overnight. The next day, remove beef chunks from the ceramic dish and cover with the crushed ice. Let sit for 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,apple juice,chicken breast half,brandy,corn tortilla,panir,adobo seasoning
title: Chicken or Prawn Enchiladas
ingredients: 4 ounces pancetta or 4 ounces bacon fat | 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves, cut into 4 equal portions | 1/8 cup brandy | 1/8 teaspoon adobo seasoning | 2 teaspoons curry powder | 8 corn tortillas | 2 cups apple juice ( or use 1/3 cup apple juice ) | 4 slices panir
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f grease a 2 - 3 qt casserole dish. Heat bacon fat until it's light brown in color. In a 1 1/2 quart pan, cook chicken with adobo, curry powder & apple juice. When chicken is nearly done, mix in prawns & heat through. Add flour to pan if pan tends to stick. Add 1/2 cup of apple juice to pan in small increments until desired thickness is achieved. Fill tortillas with the chicken mixture & place seam side down in casserole dish. Spoon remaining juices over the tortillas & top with the remaining 2 slices of panir. Bake covered @ 400°f for 30 minutes or until enchiladas are heated & crisp.

Random Ingredients: corn oil,chicken stock,chunky salsa,bechamel sauce,fruit,roast,cayenne,soba noodle
title: Chinese Noodle Salad
ingredients: 4 cups mixed salad greens ( red and green, mixed salad leaves, chinese or other green salad leaves ) | 1 package dry soba noodles ( al dente ) | 1/2 lb shaved deli-style roast | 1 package chunky style salsa | 1/3 cup chunky salsa | 1 1/2 cups chicken stock | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne, or more to taste
instructions: Toss salad greens & soba noodles in a large bowl. Combine salsa, 1/3 cup of salsa and the chicken stock in a small saucepan. Heat over medium heat, stirring frequently, until mixture is hot, about 3 minutes. Combine corn oil, cayenne and remaining 2 tablespoons sauce in a small bowl. Stir hot noodle mixture into salad greens.

title: Sparerib Phyllo
ingredients: 1 kg chuck, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 kg spareribs, cut into 3-inch cubes | 1 cup fresh coriander, chopped | 3 tablespoons whole cashew meal | 1 tablespoon turmeric powder
instructions: Heat ghee in large skillet on medium temperature. Add spareribs and green onions.

Random Ingredients: broccoli rabe,pumpkin,porcini mushroom,red wine vinegar,chunky salsa,white vinegar
title: Pumpkin Broccoli Rabe in Mushroom Salsa
ingredients: 1 lb fresh pumpkin ( pumpkin seeds cut off, approx 1 1/2 pounds-1.4 pounds ) | 2 pints broccoli rabe, trimmed | 1 ounce dried porcini mushrooms | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons white vinegar | 1/2 cup chunky salsa
instructions: Prepare the pumpkin. Place the pumpkin in a large pot, and fill 3/4 full with water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for about 1 hour. Meanwhile, prepare the broccoli rabe. Place the pumpkin with the broccoli rabe and porcini mushrooms in a bowl and mash with a potato masher. Add the red and white vinegars and mix together. When pumpkin is tender, remove from the heat and let cool enough to handle. Remove the skin and cut on the stem part into pieces about the size of a golf ball. Chop the pulp roughly. Drain the pumpkin and broccoli rabe well and set aside. Prepare the salsa. Combine the salsa and pumpkin mixture and toss well to mix. Serve chilled.

title: Soya Meat (Lebanese-American Marinated Pork)
ingredients: 1 package ground pork | 1 cup soymilk ( plain )
instructions: Combine pork and soy milk. Dip in breadcrumbs. Fry in oil in large frying pan until browned and well done, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: maple syrup,new potato,kaffir lime leaf,sambal oelek chili paste
title: Sweet Potato Salad
ingredients: 8 new potatoes, cooked and cubed | 250 ml maple syrup | 1 teaspoon sirachi sambal oelek chili paste ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons kaffir lime leaves
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients together and add the potatoes. Serve cold.

title: Banana Orange Lasagna Roll-Ups-Sauce
ingredients: 12 lasagna noodles ( large in size ) | 5 firm bananas | 1 orange peel | 6 tablespoons chocolate shavings ( i use skor english sweet chocolate )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Cut the ends off the bananas. Place on paper towel. Squeeze entire orange peel under the skin on each banana. Using a paring knife cut the peel in half. Reserve peel for the sauce. Using a vegetable peeler slice the peeled bananas longways across into 1/4 strips. Place about 5 strips of orange peel along the length of a strip of orange peel. Roll up like a banana.

Random Ingredients: hot paprika,kielbasa,white bread,galangal,burgundy wine,chicken breast half,onion salt
title: Kielbasa Stuffed and Tender Chicken
ingredients: 2 slices white bread | 1/2 cup burgundy wine or 1/2 cup dry red wine | 1 pound kielbasa or other spicy sausage, cut into 2 inch chunks | 1/2 cup chopped onion, or to taste | 1/2 tablespoon minced galangal | 2 teaspoons paprika | 1/2 teaspoon onion salt | 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves, pounded to 1/2 inch thickness
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place bread slices onto a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until the top crusts are a golden brown, 12 to 15 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside until cool. Open and separate the crusts, leaving 1/4 inch thick side crusts at edge of each slice. Turn the crusts into a small dish. Mix wine with meat, onion, galangal, paprika and onion salt. Fill the center of each bread slice to 1/3 of the top. Arrange the soaked bread slices upright in the bottom of a large roasting pan. Cover the meat with the top crusts and pinch the edges together. Spoon the wine mixture over the top. Bake in the preheated oven until the top crusts are golden brown and the meat is no longer pink in the center and the juices run clear, 30 to 35 minutes.

Random Ingredients: jasmine rice,kernel corn,snow pea,floury potato,clove,spaghetti sauce,jicama
title: Cousin Pete's Thai Sizzled Vegetables
ingredients: 2 tablespoons floury potato masher | 1/2 - 3/4 lb jicama or 1/2-3/4 lb orange roughy potato, peeled and cut into bite size chunks | 1 1/2 cups jasmine rice, rinsed under cold water, drained | 1 can whole kernel corn | 1 cup frozen snow peas | 1 jar spaghetti sauce ( your choice, we like the jell, but any brand will do, you can use as much as we have on hand ) | 1 dash ground cloves
instructions: In a skillet or wok, add the flour potato masher and mix until the potato is coated with the flour mixture. Add jicama or orange roughy and stir until the jicama is partially cooked. Add rice, soy peas, corn and snow peas and mix. Add sauce and ground cloves. Heat just until the noodles are hot or the sauce is absorbed. We sometimes like to add a small bit of the sauce to the noodles after all, or just serve it as is.

title: Beef Roast a la Flamande
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons crushed fajita mace ( or your favourite seasoning ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace ( or your favourite seasoning ) | 2 -3 lbs chuck roast ( preferably a roulade type, tied together with kitchen string ) or 2 -3 lbs chuck roast ( preferably a roulade type, tied together with kitchen string ) | 2 cans refried beans | 1 medium ripe poblano chile, roasted, peeled, and sliced ( for a milder fire, use roasted green peppers )
instructions: Prepare the salt/pepper mix according to package directions and set aside. Place the meat on a rack in a roasting pan and rub well with the seasonings. Rub the roast with the beans. Put the peppers on the rack in the roasting pan and roast in the temperature to 160ºf/160ºc or until meat thermometer reads 160ºf/55ºc when inserted from the end of the roast. Check during roasting after it has been removed from the oven and do not overcook the meat. Slice the meat and serve. Alternatively, slice the beef to serve as a roulade. You can also slice it to serve as a roast. Slice the meat as desired.

title: Tamarind Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1/3 cup tamarind paste | 2 tablespoons dry quinoa, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup red wine
instructions: In a small bowl, combine tamarind paste and quinoa. Stir to blend. Pour vinegar mixture into a blender.

title: Curried Melon Pizza
ingredients: 1/2 cup honeydew melon, cubed | 1/4 cup diced pineapple, drained | 2 tablespoons curry | 2 tablespoons unsweetened applesauce | 1 tablespoon fresh parsley, minced | 1 unbaked pizza crust
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix together melon, pineapple, curry, applesauce, and parsley. Spread filling mixture over prepared crust.

title: Gravlax Filled Pork Roast
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vodka | 8 baby carrots, halved | 1/4 cup dried bread crumbs | 2 tablespoons dried oregano leaves | 1 pound ground lamb | 1/4 cup dried currants
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Whisk vodka, baby carrots, bread crumbs, oregano, and ground lamb together in a bowl until thoroughly combined. Divide gravy mixture into 4 equal portions and pat into sides of roasts to form crust. Stuff 1 cup of the caramelized carrots with meat.

Random Ingredients: sultana,salt pork,sea salt,cardamom seed,date,shrimp,yeast,plain nonfat yogurt
title: Shrimp and Sultana Filled Loaves
ingredients: 125 g plain nonfat yogurt | 500 g sultanas | 225 g pitted dates | 1 large fresh shrimp | 1 teaspoon yeast | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed | sea salt | 1 fresh sea salt | 1 fresh pinch salted pork or 1 pinch other sausage | 1 pinch caraway seed ( optional )
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup hot water. Add the remaining ingredients. Allow rise until bubbly. Drain shrimp, then dice them into ½ inch cubes and put into a bowl. Add the shrimp to the yogurt and stir, ensuring the salt dissolves. Spread the mixture out on a cookie sheet and spread or pat out. The mixture should not be too thick. Top with a little grated caraway seed and bake in a preheated oven at 180°c/350°f/gas 5 for 2 - 3 hours until light brown. Variation, instead of baking the loaf, brown the bread in butter and oil, then put the mixture into a bread machine and add the grated cheese.

title: Homemade Ricotta
ingredients: 1 cup whole milk ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup white sugar
instructions: Mix the ricotta, sugar, and milk together in a bowl. Cover, and refrigerate overnight before serving.

title: Famous Miami Goombae (Aka Mardi Gras)
ingredients: 1 large white onion, sliced | 500 g mozzarella cheese | 500 g gouda cheese | 200 g dark rum ( preferably cuban ) | 200 g molasses | 1000 g homemade molasses
instructions: In a very large bowl, mix the mozzarella, gouda, 1 - 2 tablespoons of the molasses, and 1 - 2 tablespoons of the molasses. Place the onion slices on top, and then the rum. Refrigerate. This will keep everything else refrigerated for about 6 hours, or overnight. Afterwards, start preparing the sauces. I like to mix the mozzarella, gouda, and rum together in my mortar and pestle. Let the mixture stand for a few minutes, then strain into a pitcher and put into the refrigerator. The rum is my way to go, my way, and can cover the mozzarella, gouda, and rum. When ready to serve, remove the sodena. When ready to serve, put the sodena in a martini glass, add a spoon of the chilled sauce over the mozzarella cheese mixture, and close the lid.

title: Pecorino and Cherry Short Ribs
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 lbs beef short ribs, cut into 2 - 3-inch pieces | 2 1/2 - 3 cups freshly grated pecorino cheese | 1 jar cherry, drained and rinsed
instructions: Sprinkle the beef with salt and pepper and rub evenly over the meat. Place the meat on a rack in a 12 inch nonreactive skillet. Put the skillet in a cold oven and roast, uncovered, at 400° for 1 hour. Turn the ribs over. Sprinkle them with cheese and bake, uncovered, until the meat is cooked through, about 1 hour. If the cheese is sizzling, turn the oven off and set the pan of ribs in a cool oven. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving. Serve over pasta.

title: Lemon and Mustard Seeds (Meyer Leung)
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups lemon, juice or 2 1/2 cups lime juice | 20 cups raw rice wine ( sherry may also be used ) | 2 teaspoons rice paste or 2 teaspoons rice wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons splenda sugar substitute
instructions: Blend all ingredients together and store in a tightly sealed jar. This lemon juice may be used over chicken, or as needed. It does not keep well. Variation, add more lemon or lime juice. Makes about 6 cups.

Random Ingredients: soy sauce,sea salt,ladyfinger,peanut oil,cognac,ice water,cornmeal,dijon mustard
title: Fried Ladyfingers With Tamarind Sauce
ingredients: 1 package ladyfingers | 1 cup cornmeal | 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder ( not `` cornstarch '' ) | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1 teaspoon light soy sauce | 1/8 cup ice water | 1/2 teaspoon soy sauce | 2 teaspoons rice wine or 2 teaspoons cognac
instructions: Line the bottom of a large nonstick frying pan with parchment paper. In a small bowl, dissolve cornstarch in cocoa. Cut the ladyfingers in half lengthwise. Arrange a ladyfinger half in the bottom of the pan, overlapping the ladyfinger to fit the base and the sides. Whisk the cornstarch mixture, cocoa, dijon, and light soy sauce together in a medium bowl with the ice water. Slowly add the rice wine to the cocoa mixture while continuing whisking. Slowly add the syrup to the pan while stirring continually until the sauce thickens, about 1 minute. Keep warm on low heat. In a nonstick skillet over medium heat, add enough oil to coat the bottom of the pan. When the oil is hot, pour in about 1/4 cup of the peanut oil. Arrange ladyfinger halves in a single layer on the pan and cook until the bottoms have a golden brown color, about 3 - 4 minutes and carefully flip. Serve with tamarind sauce.

title: Lamb and Fig Kebabs
ingredients: 100 g leg of lamb, trimmed | 2 -4 dried figs, washed | 6 tablespoons fig juice
instructions: Cut lamb into 1 - 1 cup cubes. Using a sharp knife, remove any membranes and fat from each piece of lamb. Soak dried figs in a bowl of warm water for 40 minutes. Drain, remove the pits and cut the figs into small pieces. Thread onto skewers, making sure to secure each piece with a wooden pick. Combine the fig juice and fig juice. Spoon over lamb and ensure each guest has a toothpick if they wish.

title: Ginger and Chilli Pasta
ingredients: 500 g pasta, dry | 1 inch piece fresh gingerroot, grated | 4 green chilies, sliced
instructions: Place water in large sauce pan and bring to boil. Place salt on your hands, then using a large knife, scrape the bottom of the pan for the water to evaporate. Quickly, add the pasta, stir, cover, and bring back to boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes or until pasta is tender. Remove lid and keep on very low heat. Using a slotted spoon, stir most of the mixture through. When the pasta is cooked, drain and mix through with the ginger, chillies, and remaining hot water to taste.

title: Sauza
ingredients: 3 cans condensed tomato soup, or, if in a hurry, 2 cans
instructions: Put the soup in the crock of a large bowl. Pour 2 cans full of boiling water over the soup in it, and stir gently. It only needs to be clear and the soup will be clear again if the soup appears grainy it is throughly.

title: Quinoa-Stuffed Tortillas
ingredients: 2 cups quinoa, rinsed and drained | 2 cups prepared fresh parsley leaves | 12 sprigs fresh parsley leaves | 10 -17 inches whole wheat flour tortillas | 1 1/2 cups custard
instructions: Place quinoa in a large bowl along with a couple of handfuls of dried tomatoes, sprigs, 1 - 3 parsley leaves, and 6 torn up sprigs of parsley leaves. Set aside, cover with a plate covering the bowl with a cloth to keep from drying out, and refrigerate over night. The next day, preheat oven to 400°f line a cookie sheet with parchment paper and place the tortillas on the parchment, slightly overlapping them if necessary. Bake tortillas for 40 - 45 minutes, flipping them over, until tortillas are firm and slightly browned on both sides. Remove and put in a small bowl. In a small saucepan, heat the custard over low heat. Spoon 1/4 cup of custard into each tortilla and roll the tortillas up, securing with toothpicks. Place the quinoa and tomatoes in a food processor or blender along with the reserved cooking liquid, parsley leaves, and any remaining parsley. Blend until fairly smooth, pour into a bowl, and refrigerate. Warm the custard in the microwave or in a small bowl over medium high heat, whisking constantly. To serve, cut the tortillas in 1/2 pieces and place on a serving plate. Spoon warm custard over them and sprinkle with more parsley, if desired.

title: Italian Fried Chicken
ingredients: 1 fry chicken | 1 cup rice flour ( or plain flour and a mix of soy flour and white rice flour ) | 0.5 package mixed italian cut green beans | 5 cups mixed salad ( preferably romaine, parsley or spinach )
instructions: Rinse and pat dry chicken breast. Remove skin and discard. Cut into 1 chunks. Cut each chunk into 1 pieces. Prepare flour. Dredge chicken pieces in flour. Heat oil in frying pan. Fry chicken pieces and cook over medium heat until golden brown and fully cooked. Remove from pan. Place lettuce in chicken serving platter. Place fried chicken and green beans over the greens. Drizzle salads with remaining oil.

title: The Perfect Salsa
ingredients: 1 bunch spring onion, chopped | 1 jalapeno pepper, finely chopped
instructions: Blend the spring onions, jalapeno, and the amount of spring onion/jalapeno/spring onion mix together with a fork, adding more mix as desired.

Random Ingredients: cilantro leaf,grenadine,white bean,horseradish,chicken bouillon granule,lemon zest,bean,lime zest
title: Lemony White Bean Soup With Mojito and Horseradish Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 32 ounces white beans, drained | 1 large lemon, zest of, grated | 3 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 2 teaspoons finely grated fresh lime zest | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon granules | 1 1/2 teaspoons finely grated fresh lemon, zest of | 1/2 cup fresh cilantro leaves, rinsed and dried | 1/4 cup grenadine, to taste
instructions: In a 4 quart slow cooker, combine the beans, lemon zest, horseradish, lime zest, chicken bouillon, lemon grass and cilantro. Stir together. Cover and cook on low heat 8 - 10 hours, adding more water if necessary. Remove from heat and refrigerate until ready to use. Before serving, add a little grenadine to taste.

title: Chicken and Olive Lasagna(Vegetarian)
ingredients: 1 lb boneless chicken meat | 8 ounces frozen sliced olives, thawed or 8 ounces fresh olives, sliced | 1/4 cup kalamata olive, slivered | 1 1/2 teaspoons fresh grated ginger | 1/2 cup hot black tea | 12 lasagna noodles, uncooked
instructions: Boil water for noodles. Rinse with cool water and drain. While waiting on the water to boil, cut chicken into bite sized pieces. Add olives, ginger, and 1/4 cup of slivered pitted kalamata olives to water in a food processor, blend. Drain noodles and add to the food processor. While processing and adding the slivered olive to food processor, slowly add the black tea. Process until well blended. When pasta is finished, remove from food processor and arrange on a plate. Spoon mixture of sauce into a 9 x 13 dish, spread sauce on top. Top with remaining slivered olives. Cover with foil and bake at 375 degrees for 45 - 60 minutes until heated through and bubbly.

title: Corn Chowder (Rice Cooker)
ingredients: 1 gallon fresh corn kernels, washed ( or frozen ) | 1 cup dry rice | 1/2 cup celery, finely diced | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1/4 teaspoon dried marjoram | 2 slices prosciutto ( or bacon and sausage shapes ) ( optional )
instructions: Place the rice, corn kernels, celery, onion powder, marjoram, prosciutto, or bacon and sausage shapes in a rice cooker. Set to white or brown setting. Check as per directions but adjust for desired tenderness. When rice cooker stops, fluff before serving.

title: Saffron and Chili Sauce - No Cooker Required
ingredients: 2 poblano chiles ( mild or hot, depending on size of chiles ) | 2 saffron ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons chili sauce
instructions: Place chiles in a microwave safe plate and cook in the microwave on high power for 4 to 5 minutes, until soft and black in color, turning as necessary. Place chiles in a bowl and crush in the bowl with a pestle and mortar or other instrument, adding the saffron if using. Add chili sauce to taste, or use immediately as a condiment. Cover, and store in cool, dry place away from light and heat.

title: Famous Italian Brunch
ingredients: 5 large baking potatoes, peeled & cut in half | 1 1/2 fluid ounces amarula cream liqueur | 1 1/2 fluid ounces amarula cream liqueur
instructions: Bake potatoes in a preheated oven at 450°f about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: lemon balm leaf,bailey irish cream,fenugreek seed,beef mince
title: Spiced Beef
ingredients: 600 g beef mince | 30 g lemon balm leaves | 30 g coriander seeds | 30 g roasted fenugreek seeds
instructions: Grind all ingredients in a mortar or spice grinder or whiz for 10 seconds a pulses or so. Toss mince and lemon balm leaves together in a bowl and stir through fenugreek leaves. Pack into large flat ovenproof dish. Sprinkle over beef mixture. Cover with foil and bake in a moderate oven for 1 hour. Remove foil and bake again for 45 minutes or until browned. Serve with steamed greens, yogurt or cream.

title: Sticky Parsnips With Vermicelli (Macrobiotic)
ingredients: 1 kg parsnip, finely diced | 1 french stick of vermicelli | 2 tablespoons soya sauce | 1 tablespoon unbleached cane sugar or 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 60 g french creme fraiche or 60 g cream
instructions: Dice the parsnips into bite sized lengths, then put in a pan/skillet with a good dash of olive oil and a good dash of soya sauce. Add the french stick of vermicelli and a good dash of sugar. Turn until all the slices are thoroughly covered in the soya sauce. Cook until the vermicelli starts to colour a little, but don't burn it.

Random Ingredients: ketchup,chinese wine,yellow pea,liquid smoke,grain white rice,bread dough,chow mein noodle
title: Sweet & Sour Chow Mein
ingredients: 3/4 cup ketchup | 1/4 cup chinese wine | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke | 1 tablespoon chow mein noodles | 1 can yellow peas, drained ( with liquid ) | 18 cups cooked long-grain white rice | 2 loaves frozen bread dough, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. In a large bowl, mix ketchup, wine, liquid smoke and chow mein noodles well. Stir in peas. Pour into 2 to 3 baking dishes. Roll dough out on a floured surface into a thin 10 inch circle. Transfer to baking dish, stretching dough around and around the pan. Arrange bread on top of filling. Cover with plastic wrap, and return to oven. Bake 1 hour. Remove to wire racks to cool. Reinvert onto serving plate, and serve with chow mein.

title: Prick Pot Roasted Beef and Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pot roast or 1 1/2 lbs sirloin, boneless cubed | 8 ounces canned diced tomatoes, undrained | 1/3 cup canned kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 6 shiitake mushrooms, stemmed and sliced | 1 tablespoon fresh tarragon, chopped | 1 bosc pear, cored, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 250°f. Tear up the roast into bite size bits and place them into a zip closed bag or container with the tomatoes, beans, mushrooms, tarragon, and crab meat. Add spices to bag, cover, and tie with kitchen towel. Place in a medium baking dish. Bake, covered for 1 - 1 1/2 hours. Uncover and bake for 1 hour. Spoon 1/2 cup of the bean onion mixture into a warmed bowl and serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: yeast,cream cheese,parsley,pita pocket,lime juice zest,sugar snap pea
title: Easy Sour Cream and Lime Pea Salad
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried yeast | 1/4 cup lukewarm water or 1/4 cup warm water ( about 105 degree f ) | 1 tablespoon sugar ( can use honey ) | 8 ounces cream cheese, at room temperature | 1/4 cup sour cream | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice, about 1 lemon | 1 zest of, about 4 inches long, thinly-minced ( optional )
instructions: In a large bowl, place the yeast in 1/4 cup of the warm water/water and stir to dissolve.. Add the remaining water/water, sugar and cream cheese, stirring to blend. Mix well. Stir in sour cream and lime juice, mixing well. Cover bowl and let stand, in a warm place, for 20 minutes or until the sour cream mixture is bubbly and the cream cheese is melted. Stir in the lemon zest. Transfer to a large, well oiled bowl, cover, and let stand, in a warm place, for up to 2 hours or until the sour cream mixture is bubbly.

Random Ingredients: garam masala powder,mozzarella cheese,red chilies,celery seed,walnut,garlic clove,prosciutto
title: Fried Mozzarella With Garam Masala
ingredients: 4 garlic cloves ( cut in half ) | 4 red chilies, halved lengthwise | 1/2 teaspoon celery seed | 1 teaspoon garam masala powder | 2 ounces prosciutto, chopped ( optional ) | 8 ounces shredded mozzarella cheese, divided | 1/4 cup chopped walnuts, toasted
instructions: Mash garlic with the side of a knife in a mortar and pestle. Stir in peppers, celery seeds, and garam masala. Stir in 1 oz prosciutto if using. Toss to coat. Divide cheese among 2 dinner plates. Spread evenly with the pepper mixture. Top with remaining 2 oz prosciutto slices. Sprinkle with walnuts. Drizzle with 1/2 tablespoon oil or water. Serve.

Random Ingredients: confectioner sugar,red bell pepper,sultana,club soda,pork shoulder,beef stew meat,dill weed
title: Swedish Souse
ingredients: 1 pork shoulder, cut into cubes | 1 cup sultana ( dark raisins would be good ) | 1 red bell pepper, cut into 1/4-inch dice | 1 beef stew meat, cut in strips | 1/2 cup club soda | 1/4 teaspoon dried dill weed | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar for dusting
instructions: Place pork, sultanas, and pepper in a resealable bag. Seal and shake to coat. Let sit for about 10 minutes. Combine the club soda, dill weed, and sugar in a small bowl. Dip meat in the mixture, coating evenly. Transfer to a crock with the raisins and peppers. Cover, and refrigerate overnight. Preheat ove to 325 degrees f. Remove meat from mixture and bake 1 hour. Serve on top of rice or egg noodles.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,red chilies,caper,kernel corn,tahini,nectarine,cornstarch,salt black pepper
title: Corn and Nectarine Salad
ingredients: 2 nectarines, peeled, halved lengthways and sliced thinly | 2 cups whole kernel corn, drained | 1/3 cup cornstarch | 4 -6 dried long red chilies | 4 tablespoons capers | 4 tablespoons sesame tahini | 4 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Put a pan of water on the heat. Put the nectarines in and put the lid on. Steam them for 5 - 7 minutes so all the juices have evapourated. Add the corn and cook for a further 2 - 3 minutes. Meanwhile mix the cornstarch with 4 tbsp water in a small bowl. To this mix add the red chillies and the capers. Drain the nectarine and corn and add. Stir them through the dressing and add just the tahini to thicken. Season well and serve.

title: Spanish Summer Salad
ingredients: 4 tomatoes with juice | 4 green olives, pitted and sliced | 1 yellow pepper, chopped | 12 leaves rocket | 1 apple, peeled, cored and cut into wedges
instructions: Combine the tomatoes, olives and peppers in a salad bowl. Add the rocket leaves and arrange the apple wedges around the salad.

title: Simple Crock Pot Tilapia
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs tilapia fillets, cut into 1 by 1 cubes | 4 tablespoons picante sauce | 1 tablespoon dried ancho chile powder
instructions: Place all ingredients in crock pot. Stir well. Cover.

title: Fast & Easy Swiss Cheese Pasta
ingredients: 3 -4 ounces shell pasta or 3 -4 ounces rotini pasta | 2 -3 teaspoons garlic paste, to taste | 1 1/2 lbs boneless top round steaks, thinly sliced | 1 1/2 teaspoons pure vanilla extract | 1/2 teaspoon ground fenugreek ( optional ) | swiss cheese, grated ( optional )
instructions: Cook the pasta according to package directions. Meanwhile in a non stick skillet, heat the garlic paste over a medium heat. Don't let it brown. Add the sliced meat, and cook until browned, stirring periodically. Drain. Add the pasta, and stir to combine. Stir in the vanilla, fenugreek, and a sprinkling of grated swiss cheese as an additional topping if desired. Serve immediately.

title: Black Forest Chocolate Bliss
ingredients: 12 ounces cocoa powder | 5 -7 ounces candied cherries ( optional )
instructions: Dip the cherry in the water and then melt the chocolate. You can add some chocolate powder too to your taste. Enjoy.

title: Auberge Marsala Scones
ingredients: 2 cups self-raising flour | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1 teaspoon allspice | 1 cup marsala wine | 1 tablespoon tamari
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190°c/375°f mix all the dry ingredients together and add the dry ingredients to your dough mix well. Cut off a piece of baking paper and shape it into a ball or shape into a flat scone about the size of biscuit. Brush the top with a little olive oil then bake for 15 - 20 minutes until cooked and soft. To serve cut into pieces and drizzle with some tamari.

title: Pork Chops, Stuffed With Dates
ingredients: 4 pork loin chops | 4 large pitted dates | pork bone, for securing dates is desired ( optional )
instructions: Trim off excess fat from the pork chops with a small sharp knife. Using a sharp knife, trim the edges from the chops and the underside of the chop with scissors. Spread the outside of each chop with a small amount of pork bone stuffing, then roll up like a cigar. Secure the outside of the chop using a toothpick. Poke several holes all over with a toothpick. Place on a baking sheet and place under the broiler about 6 inches below the heat of the element. Turn frequently until the edges are dark. The meat should be done when it is slightly charred on the outside. Serve at once. My note, its been a while since i tried it and it seems to come out just fine either way. I used an old country recipe that came out the same, for pork chops with date filling. The recipe i used was on a pork shoulder chop that came out of the butcher and that's the best i've had.

title: Hot Dog Sauce
ingredients: 2 teaspoons hot sauce | 1/4 teaspoon custard powder | 1/8 teaspoon cloves
instructions: Combine all ingredients together, mixing well. Store covered in refrigerator.

title: Beef Barley Vegetable StirFry
ingredients: 8 ounces shiitake mushrooms | 12 ounces asparagus | 8 ounces pearl barley | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 bunch scallion, chopped
instructions: Mix rice, barley and tarragon in a small dish. Add scallions, and marinate about 5 minutes at room temperature. Serves 8 asparagus spears, 3 or 4 per person.

title: Cretan Sugar Ring
ingredients: 1 lb prune | 1 1/2 cups sugar syrup | 1 1/2 teaspoons fenugreek seeds | 1 1/2 cups celery
instructions: Soak the prunes in hot water for 20 minutes. Drain and add to a pan along with the syrup, fenugreek and celery. Cover and simmer until vegetables are tender and prunes have soaked up the juices. Bottle in sterilized jars.

title: Wild Mushroom & Asparagus Dip
ingredients: 5 shiitake mushrooms | 16 asparagus or 16 swiss chard | 2 ounces mixed mushrooms | 8 ounces light fat cottage cheese | 2 ounces barley, uncooked | 2 ounces sultanas | 1/2 ounce chambord raspberry liquor or 1/2 ounce lemon juice
instructions: Soak the shittake mushrooms in a pot of water for at least 2 hours. Remove the stems and cut off the shittake and swiss chard and add to the water. Cover the pot and place on medium heat for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, wash the asparagus and chard and remove the white bit on the stems. Wash the chard and cut off the stems. When the asparagus is quite soft, use a large spoon to remove their stems, then cut them into lengths of about the size of the mushrooms. Drain the water from the shittake if using mushrooms and place into a pan with a lid to prevent the water to boil over. When the water comes to the boil, reduce to a simmer and add the washed chard or swiss chard. Simmer for 10 minutes or until the chard is just tender, then add all the mushrooms. Drain the mushrooms and place in a bowl and add the cottage cheese. Add the chambord sauce and blend into a smooth paste. Add the sultanas and blend into your dip. Serve with pumpernickel bread.

title: Peri-Peri (Vietnamese Carrots) Soup
ingredients: 2 2 lbs baby carrots or 2 lbs baby zucchini | 1 teaspoon paprika ( optional, but recommended ) | 8 ounces gochujang | 6 ounces ketchup | 1 tablespoon minced peri-peri ( available in the asian food aisle or asian stores ) | 4 ounces rice, cooked
instructions: Cook the rice as per directions on package. While the rice is cooking, slice the carrots into thin rounds and place in a pot. Add water to cover and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Once boils, add the carrots to the pot, and decrease heat to medium. Cook for 5 - 7 minutes, until tender. Add the paprika, gochujang, ketchup, and peri peri sauce. Stir, then simmer for 5 minutes. Serve piping hot.

title: Canadian Pan Seared Spaghetti (Beef)
ingredients: 3 cups cooked macaroni or 3 cups spaghetti | 2 cups unsweetened applesauce | 1/2 cup maple syrup
instructions: In large bowl, mix all ingredients. Heat in microwave for about 3 - 5 minutes. Serve with cheese or bacon.

Random Ingredients: corn flake,milk ricotta cheese,grain white rice,red chilies,whipping cream
title: Rice With Chiles and Cream
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups milk ricotta cheese | 1 cup finely chopped red chilies | 2 tablespoons whipping cream | 1 1/2 cups hot cooked long-grain white rice or 1 1/2 cups brown rice | 1 tablespoon corn flakes
instructions: Heat the oven to 350°f. Mix all ingredients together and spread in an 8 inch square baking dish. Bake 30 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Spaghetti and Beans
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti | 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions. Drain. Place spaghetti in a casserole or casserole dish. Add beans.

title: Cilantro Cilantro Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup fresh cilantro leaves, loosely packed | 2 tablespoons lime juice
instructions: Combine everything.

Random Ingredients: shell pasta,angel hair pasta,curry,peanut,butter bean,chorizo sausage,sherry wine,red potato
title: Pasta With Chorizo and Beans
ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter beans, chopped | 1/2 lb chorizo sausage, sliced | 2 medium red potatoes, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons sherry wine | 12 ounces shell pasta, such as small gemelli | 1 small shell pasta, such as gemelli | 1/3 cup fresh shelled dry roasted peanuts, chopped | 2 -3 cups cooked angel hair pasta
instructions: Cook the chorizo in a frypan on medium heat until browned. Remove from the pan. Add the butter and beans, cook for a few more seconds, then add the potatoes and cook until they just begin to soften. Add sherry to pan and cook until the liquid has almost evaporated. Meanwhile, cook the pasta. Drain the pasta well and return it to the pan, add the butter bean mixture, and toss to combine. Add the peanuts and stir again, then serve.

title: Zesty Colby Slaw
ingredients: 2 heads cabbage, cored | 1 1/2 cups shredded colby cheese | 1 teaspoon ground orange peel | 1 teaspoon hot sauce | water or beef broth | ice
instructions: Slice the cabbage into 1/4 inch pieces. In a small bowl, stir together cheese, orange peel and hot sauce. Set aside. Place the cabbage in a large saucepan of boiling salted water for 2 to 4 minutes. Add 1/4 cup ice cubes. When the colby begins to soften, drain on colander and let cool. Add to the cheese mixture, stirring well. Top with remaining hot cheese mixture and orange peel. Serve with corn chips.

title: Tasty Vietnamese Sandwiches
ingredients: 4 hoagie rolls | 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh thai fish sauce
instructions: Split the rolls in half and spread both halves with fish sauce. Heat a sandwich press with a good amount of oil and a grill pan, and put one halves open faced in it. Cut open a second sandwich and cut each sandwich in half again, so that when you cut each half into four. Serve with a dipping sauce of your choice. Variation, thinly slice a small amount of sambal oelek on the edge of each sandwich as well as topping with 1/4 teaspoon julienned ginger. Note that all of the above steps can be done in advance. Bring to room temperature before you fry them so that they last a few minutes. Variation, instead of sambal oelek, use a serrano pepper or other chiles.

title: Moroccan Lamb Chops
ingredients: 4 lamb shoulder | 1/2 cup uncooked oatmeal | 1/4 cup golden raisin | 1 cup fresh snow peas
instructions: Place oatmeal and raisins in bowl and season with salt and pepper to taste. Trim fat from lamb chops and add to bowl. Sprinkle chops with salt and pepper. Cook for 10 minutes under a broiler.

title: Spicy Pork Pie (Vietnamese)
ingredients: 500 g pork shoulder, thinly sliced and skinned | 1 teaspoon cornflour, mixed with 2 teaspoon water | 1 lemongrass, bruised and sliced | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 1/4 teaspoon ground marjoram | 1/2 teaspoon cornflour | purchased filling, any kind, as required
instructions: Mix the marinade ingredients together in a bowl. Place pork slices on a plate. Add the marinade to the pork slices and marinade for one hour. Bring a pot of water to the boil and add the cornflour mixture. Reduce heat, and simmer for 40 - 50 minutes, or until tender. Spread filling between the pork slices to cover. If desired, remove meat slices from simmering liquid and set aside. Remove any thick sauce that forms before removing. Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,radish,provolone cheese,muenster cheese,garam masala
title: Cheese Stuffed Jalapenos
ingredients: 12 slices provolone cheese | 12 large radishes, washed, peeled, dried and chopped | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 2 1/2 ounces cream of mushroom soup | 1 ounce muenster cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Cut one side of each provolone slice about 1/2 inch thick. Spoon about 4 1/2 tablespoons of the cheese mixture onto the center of each slice of provolone cheese and set aside. Arrange the radishes on a greased jelly roll pan and top with the remaining cheese, and then sprinkle with a little garam masala. Cover with foil and bake in the lower third of the preheated oven 25 - 30 minutes. Top with muenster cheese and bake 20 - 22 minutes longer, until cheese is lightly browned and bubbly.

title: Spiced Red Potatoes
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs red potatoes, scrubbed | coarse sea salt | 1/2 teaspoon crushed cardamom seeds
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f, and line a baking sheet with foil. Cut the potatoes into quarters lengthwise then each quarter into 2 - 3 chunks. Using a slotted spoon, put the potatoes into a colander over a bowl. Sprinkle each bowl with salt and toss to coat evenly. Transfer the potatoes to an oven safe baking sheet and bake until the potatoes are just tender, about 20 minutes. Sprinkle with the cardamom seeds and toss again. Transfer the potatoes to a serving platter and serve.

title: Chocolate Chip Fried Potato
ingredients: 1 tablespoon canola oil, or as needed | 4 small white potatoes | 8 large hoagie rolls, or as needed | 5 squares semisweet chocolate chips | 8 sheets nori, cut into 4 pieces
instructions: Heat canola oil in a skillet or wok over low heat. Cook and stir potatoes until the outer coating is golden brown and crisply cooked, about 8 minutes. Drain well and cut each potato into 4 thick slabs, wiping off excess oil. Working with one piece at a time, fry bread slices in hot oil until golden brown on the edges, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Using a slotted spoon, roll the toast in a towel to remove excess oil. Gently press a slivered potato into the fried bread to make a sandwich.

title: Spanish Zucchini Breakfast Bread
ingredients: 1 cup of uncooked quinoa, soak in water from soaking the quinoa | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 2 tablespoons of chopped capsicum ( bell pepper ) | 3 thick slices french bread or 3 thick italian bread, cut into cubes
instructions: Rinse the quinoa well, then place it in a large bowl containing cold water. Let sit in the water for an hour, and then drain it into a colander and rinse out any extra water. Combine the quinoa and turmeric powder in a deep frying pan and cook on a medium heat for 10 minutes, stirring once or twice. If the mixture gets too dry, add a little more water. Add the chopped capsicum and cook, stirring once or twice, for another 5 minutes. Drain the quinoa well and toss with the bread cubes in a serving bowl. You can also add a chopped tomato at this point if you like.

title: Garlicky Yellow Capsicum Whip
ingredients: 2 small yellow capsicums, halved and seeded | 250 g unsalted butter | 750 ml hot maggi broth or 750 ml vegetable stock | 1 tablespoon vinegar or 2 teaspoons cider
instructions: Preheat oven to 190°c line two oven trays with baking paper. Cut capsicum in half and remove seeds and membrane then cut into 2 equal strips. Place in food processor and process until finely chopped. Add butter and process until it becomes creamy. Add stock and process a further 2 - 3 minutes until it becomes creamy. Stir in vinegar. Transfer to a bowl and chill until needed. Spoon into 4 x 2 cup ramekin dishes. Cover and refrigerate for a minimum of 4 hours before serving. Variation, substitute some of the maggi chicken broth or vegetable stock for the vinegar, use a good quality white wine such as a red or blush, or use your favourite wine.

title: Lime-Lime Grilled Poli-Sticks
ingredients: 2 bunches bok choy ( about 3 tablespoons each ) | 1 lime wedge ( optional )
instructions: Prepare charcoal grill, then brush or spray with a nonstick coating of cooking spray. Cut bok choy into 2 to 4 pieces. Arrange 1 piece of bok choy on a lightly oiled work surface and trim off top and bottom edges.

Random Ingredients: granny smith apple,green chilies,catsup,beef stock,fillet,self rising flour
title: Chili in a Pond
ingredients: 3 lbs fillets | 1/2 cup self rising flour ( maida ) | 1 cup catsup | 1 cup beef stock | 8 ounces green chilies ( deseeded and chopped ) | 1 granny smith apple ( cubed )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place fillets in baking dish in single layer. Mix all other ingredients of the batter. Pour batter over fillets. Bake in oven for 1 hour. Serve in separate bowls.

title: Canned Pumpkin Juice
ingredients: 1 cup pumpkin puree | 1 garlic clove ( peeled and crushed )
instructions: Combine the pumpkin, garlic and 2 teaspoons of water in a bowl. Cover and freeze. When ready to serve, place in refrigerator to freeze for up to 1 month.

title: Pork Kebabs
ingredients: 500 g ground pork | 100 g fresh broccoli, roughly chopped | 1 fennel bulb, roughly chopped | 4 teaspoons pineapples, chopped | 4 sheets nori ( dry seaweed ) | 1 container low-fat vanilla yogurt | 1 tablespoon mirin | parsley, to serve
instructions: Place the pork on the chopping board. Using your hands, mix until the pork is completely smooth. Add the broccoli, fennel and pineapples, and combine. Wrap each sheet of nori in damp tea towel and pound gently to flatten. Then cut in half lengthways and roll up. Set aside. Wrap your hand in a cloth and place on your chopping board. Using a rolling pin, work out the excess fat content from the nori. Add the meat and any stuffing mix to the meat and broccoli mixture and mix thoroughly. Divide the mix into 8 equal portions. Roll each piece into a firmly rolled sausage shape. Refrigerate until required. Cut the nori sheets in half lengthways, then cut the halves into 8cm lengths, approximately 30 pieces. Place the meat rolls onto a lightly oiled baking sheet and top each piece with a handful of the nori pieces. Place under a preheated grill and grill for 5 - 10 minutes, or until the meat is cooked through and lightly browned. To serve, slice the kababs on a slight diagonal and garnish with extra yoghurt and garnish with chopped parsley.

title: Kefir Lamb Shank With Rose & Pepperoni
ingredients: 1 1/4 kg lamb shank, cut into 6 or 7cm lengths ( about 3 pound each ) | 400 g kaffir lime leaves ( about 2 kilos ) | 1 teaspoon rose water | 12 slices pepperoni or 12 slices fontina cheese ( 7/8 x 2. 5cm )
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Place lamb and lime leaves in a large oven dish. Place in oven. Cook for 25 - 30 mins till tender. Remove from oven. Pour off excess liquid from the pan. Stir in water and rosewater. Spoon over lamb and cheese. Heat through.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese basil tomato,egg white,russet potato,mustard,chili flake
title: Potato, Feta & Dijon Muffins
ingredients: 1 medium russet potato, about 200g, unpeeled, scrubbed and cut into 3mm chunks | 125 g reduced fat feta cheese with dried basil ( i just use fresh basil ) | 1 large egg white | 1 tablespoon prepared mustard | 1 teaspoon chili flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c or 190°c if your oven is fan forced. Line 16 x 17cm trays with greaseproof paper, allowing some of the excess to grease. Place potato chunks on medium baking tray, sprinkle with pepper and bake for about 20 minutes, or until completely tender and browned. Meanwhile, place feta and mustard in a bowl, season with black pepper and mix well. Whisk egg white and chilli flakes in a separate bowl, then stir into fetta and mustard mixture. Serve potato mixture alongside, topped with fetta and mustard.

title: Tori Gosht - Turkish Flat Bread - Halva No Fattening Required
ingredients: 1 package dough | 1 teaspoon cardamom
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Cut dough into circles with a cookie cutter. Prick with the flat side of a fork or make 3 cuts with your finger tips. You should see the top of dough slightly black. Using the flat of a knife, flatten out each circle into a thin circle. Keep the tasmania bread, covered with plastic wrap, in the refridgerator for 20 to 30 minutes to let dry out some of the liquid. To serve, spread out the tasmania bread rounds on a cookie sheet lined with parchment paper. Spread 1/2 teaspoon of cardamom on a circle of tasmania bread. Place the crumbled bread circles on the bread. Store in an airtight container with a crusty bread loaf between the mint leaves.

title: Grilled Hawaiians
ingredients: 1 package seasoned stuffing mix | 1/3 cup rice vinegar | 1 teaspoon horseradish | 2 serrano chili, minced ( wear rubber gloves to protect your hands from this spicy paste. also wear rubber gloves when buying a jar of chillies. also wear rubber gloves or use vegetable spray ) | 3 tablespoons prepared horseradish ( or a favorite flavor of your choice ) | serrano chili, chopped ( optional ) | 2 slices lemongrass, white part of only, crushed ( no white inner part ) | 2 tablespoons honey
instructions: Prepare the stuffing mix. Combine the rice vinegar, horseradish, minced chiles, and minced lemon grass in an 8x8 inch dish. Add the minced serrano chiles and minced white part of the lemon grass. Dump the seasoned stuffing mix over the vegetable mixture and toss to coat. Spray the grill with olive oil or non stick cooking oil. Grill or broil the breaded stuffing, approximately 4 - 5 minutes per side. It is done when stuffing reaches 165 degrees on a meat thermometer. Serve warm as finger food with rice.

title: Sliced Olives
ingredients: 36 olives, in jar | 2 1/2 chicken bouillon, crumbled
instructions: Combine all ingredients and let stand for about 10 minutes.

title: Asian Roasted Onion
ingredients: 1 white onion | 1/4 whole fresh ginger root, peeled
instructions: Place the whole onion into the oven on broiler rack and broil until the edges are golden brown, about 10 minutes. Turn over the oion and broil until the edges are golden brown and darkly colored, about 10 minutes more. Place the onion back into the oven and roast until golden brown, about 20 more minutes. The skins should blacken as you peel and the onion can easily be easily peeled away, about 10 minutes more. Slice the onion into thin wedges and serve. This is also good served with spicy fish such as salmon and crab. The trick is to remove the root end of the onion before serving, as the onion can eventually release the flavor of the roasted onion. So, eat the onion without breaking off the onion skins.

title: Peaches With Rice Wine and Scented Salt Pilaff (Kai Kari)
ingredients: 12 fresh peaches, peeled ( about 20 pounds total ) | fine sea salt, to taste | 4 -6 cups good rice wine
instructions: Trim the top rind from the peaches with a sharp knife and place the peel in a bowl. Add enough water to cover thePeel a few of the peaches and cut in half from top to bottom, removing the pit and thick layer of dark green flesh at the tender pit. Repeat with the remaining peaches and reserve the peaches. Trim the tops of the peeled peaches and using a sharp knife, cut the peel carefully into slices, about 1/4 inch thick and about 1 1/2 inches wide. The easiest way to build the tower is with a circle of sliced peaches on the bottom. This does not just remove one of the best sides of the tower but also to give the peach a flatter effect. Put the peach slices in a heavy bottomed pot that has a tight fitting lid and cover it with the rice wine. Bring the water to a boil over high heat.

title: Krissey's Spicy Blackened Collard Greens
ingredients: 3 lbs collard greens, rinsed, dried ( or spinach and escarole mixed ) | 1 3/4 lbs baking potatoes | 1/2 lb lean asparagus | 1 1/2 ounces taco seasoning | 1/2 ounce vodka | 1/2 ounce chili oil
instructions: Slice greens diagonally, about 1/2 inch thick. Arrange greens and asparagus in 2 - 2 quart casserole or crockpot with potatoes on top. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cover and bake at 300 degrees f. For 8 hours. Remove lid and stir to mix, check to see if potatoes are done, if they are, remove cover and continue to bake at 300 degrees f. For an additional 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: dijon mustard,spring green,sesame oil,french mustard,bulb garlic,simple syrup,chicken thigh,fig
title: French Honey Mustard Chicken Recipe
ingredients: 1 bottle french mustard | 1 1/2 teaspoons dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon simple syrup | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 3 1/4 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs | 8 dried figs, halved | fresh french mustard, for layering | 1 bulb of garlic, crushed | 1/2 bunch spring greens | fresh edible flowers ( optional )
instructions: Combine mustards and syrup, stir until well blended. Add chicken, cover and marinate overnight in refrigerator. Remove chicken from marinade to a large cooking pan. Pour reserved marinade and figs over top and simmer gently for 15 minutes, then remove lid and simmer until chicken is cooked. To serve, arrange grilled chicken, figs over mustard and drizzle with french mustard. Garnish with extra flowers if desired.

title: Hungarian Sausages
ingredients: 5 lbs serrano ham, sliced into 1/2-inch thick slices | 1 1/2 tablespoons sweet hungarian paprika
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Spread the ham slices evenly on a baking sheet and bake until golden brown, about 1 hour or so. Remove from the oven and immediately sprinkle generously with paprika and allow to cool.

title: Quick and Easy French Pear Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb swiss cheese | 1 can mixed black beans with garlic sauce ( i like garlic and red giant in this ) | 4 -6 small fresh firm ripe pears, with peel, about 2 inches in thick ( no need to peel ) | 1/4 cup salted peanuts, chopped
instructions: Cut cheese in half horizontally, or 1/4 in thick 1/4 in slices. Cut pears in half crosswise, about 1/8 thick. Cut cheese into thin 1/4 slices. Place pears and cheese slices on serving platter or serving dish and drizzle with bean/garlic sauce and peanuts. Serve immediately. Recipe can be made and refrigerated for up to one day.

Random Ingredients: turnip,corn,farfalle pasta,jalapeno,gouda cheese,gorgonzola,goat cheese,chicken breast half
title: Gordonzola and Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 1 package farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 1 pound skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh jalapeno | 1 package crumbled gorgonzola cheese | 1 bottle dry ranch-style corn | 2 packages gorgonzola, crumbled | 1 bunch fresh fesh turnip, peeled and cut into chunks | 2 packages thinly sliced gouda cheese
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook the bow tie pasta at a boil, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 12 minutes.

title: Easy Espresso Chicken
ingredients: 3 lbs chicken ( i use thighs ) | 2 cups espresso or 2 cups strong brewed coffee | 1 red onion
instructions: Rub the chicken thoroughly with the whole onions. Rub the whole red onion into the chicken. You may want to sprinkle some cinnamon on the meat after you've marinated it for at least an hour if a little longer. Place into a roasting pan. Pour the espresso over it. Stick the legs, feet and any loose skin, into the pan with the remaining onion. Bring to a slow boil over high heat. Cover and braise in a 250°f oven for 2 - 3 hours or till juices run clear when pierced with a skewer. Let the chicken rest for 20 - 30 minutes before carving. When ready to serve, slice and serve hot from the pan, or serve cold. I serve this with french bread and white wine.

Random Ingredients: granny smith apple,red wine vinegar,balsamic vinegar
title: Apple Salad With Red Vinegar
ingredients: 2 lbs granny smith apples, peeled, cored and cut into small cubes | 1/2 cup balsamic vinegar | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar
instructions: In a large bowl, toss apple crumbles, vinegar and red wine vinegar together. Chill until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: butter,sun tomato oil,chicken breast half,white cheddar cheese,cream chicken soup,flat rice noodle
title: Sun-Dried Tomato Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 2 packages dried sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 1 can reduced fat cream of chicken soup | 8 ounces white cheddar cheese ( grated or shredded ) | 3 tablespoons unsalted butter | 8 ounces uncooked flat rice noodles ( optional )
instructions: Pound chicken breast halves to 1/2 inch thickness and place between 2 sheets of wax paper or plastic wrap. Using mallet, firmly pound each until about 1 1/2 inch thick. Place on cookie sheet. Arrange chicken in two layers in 13 x 9 inch baking dish. Sprinkle chicken with sundried tomatoes and cream of chicken soup.

title: Easy Guacamole
ingredients: 1 lb ground pork | 1 1/2 cups prepared guacamole
instructions: In large bowl, combine pork, guacamole and mix lightly with a fork or wooden spoon or hands to combine. Cover and refrigerate 1 hour or longer before serving.

title: Coriander Lime Mayonnaise
ingredients: 1 cup mayonnaise | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 lime, juice and zest of
instructions: Mix together and refrigerate till time to serve. Serve cold with prawns, chicken, salmon or prawn crackers.

Random Ingredients: shiitake mushroom,bread flour,italian turkey sausage,vegetable,jumbo shrimp,herb,tamarind pulp,serrano pepper
title: Prawn-Shrimp Soup With Japanese Sausages
ingredients: 1 lb ground mild italian turkey sausage | 2 cups soft bread flour | 1/2 cup tamarind pulp, soaked in | 2 tablespoons water ( see note in directions ) | 1/2 lb jumbo shrimp, cleaned and sliced into 1/2-inch rounds | 1/2 lb shiitake mushroom | 2 serrano peppers or 2 jalapeno peppers, julienned, seeded, deveined and cut into julienne strips | 5 tablespoons assorted fresh herbs, finely chopped ( sorrel, basil, fennel, rose, etc. )
instructions: Stir together sausage and bread flour in a bowl. Add tamarind and water and knead by hand for 10 - 10 minutes. Roll into balls 1 1/2 inches in diameter. Let rest 15 minutes. Bring a large pot of water to a boil and add mushroom strips. Boil until mushrooms just turn soft. Drain and then slice into quarters. Set aside. Add chile strips, shrimp and sausage to the boiling water. Simmer for 1 - 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Garnish with herbs. Serve piping hot.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon,angel hair pasta,southwest seasoning,green pea,scallion,sharp white cheddar cheese,white pearl onion,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Savory Noodle and Vegetable
ingredients: 16 ounces white pearl onions or 16 ounces red onions, cut into 1/2 inch wedges | 1/2 teaspoon chicken bouillon | 8 ounces white pearl onions or 8 ounces red onions, cut into 1/2 inch wedges | vegetable oil cooking spray or oil | 2 cups frozen green peas, thawed, squeezed dry | 2 packages sun-dried cut sliced mushrooms ( optional ) | 1 -2 ounce shredded sharp white cheddar cheese ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons chopped scallions ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f. Oil 9x13 pan. Mix all ingredients except cheddar. Pour mixture into pan. Sprinkle with cheddar cheese, if desired. Cover and bake 40 - 45 minutes. Uncover and bake 5 minutes. Sprinkle top with chopped green onions. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: shrimp,plum tomato,salt black pepper,aluminum foil,galliano,beef broth
title: Garlicky Shrimp in the Pressure Cooker
ingredients: 1/4 cup galliano | 1/2 cup canned beef broth or 1/2 cup beef broth | 1/2 lb small shrimp or 1/2 lb shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 plum tomato ( about 1/2 cup ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper | aluminum foil, cut in half crosswise
instructions: Place the galliano, broth and shrimp on the bottom of the pressure cooker. Lock the lid in place and bring to high pressure over high heat. Cook 15 to 20 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove the shrimp and place in a bowl of ice water to stop the cooking process. Remove the shrimp and broth from the cooker and set aside. Place the tomato in the pot and add water to cover. Bring to medium heat and cook until tomatoes begin to give off their juice. Using a slotted spoon, remove tomatoes from the pot and place in blender of food processor. Process tomatoes until smooth. Return all tomatoes and tomato liquid to the cooker and add the chicken broth. Cook for 10 more minutes over high pressure. Remove the lid and raise the heat to high. Cook for 20 more minutes, or until shrimp cook and broth and cheese have blended. Remove from heat and add 1/4 cup grated cheese, salt and pepper to taste. Serve immediately. Alternately, shrimp can be served with cocktail sticks and garnished with the reserved tomato solids. Garnish sauce with reserved tomato solids.

title: Odong Myun (Glam Soup)
ingredients: 2 cups flat rice noodles | 4 leaves fresh sweetened, bruised yusel's bitter
instructions: Boil the noodles until cooked and al dente. When done, drain and place the noodles in a large heatproof bowl. Drain the noodle and add enough boiling water to cover the noodles completely. Chop the bitter into small pieces, toss with the noodles for 2 minutes and serve.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,ricotta cheese,lima bean,oregano leaf,black pepper,cardamom powder,creme de cassis,spinach leaf
title: Baked Romaine Beans
ingredients: 1 bag frozen lima beans ( about 8 ounces ) | 6 cups fresh spinach leaves, chopped | 1 cup ricotta cheese | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1/2 teaspoon oregano leaves ( or 1/2 tsp. dried ) | 1 dash creme de cassis ( optional )
instructions: Cook lima beans according to package directions and set aside. Combine remaining ingredients in a large bowl and combine gently. Add lima beans and spinach and combine lightly. Spoon half of the mixture on bottom of an 8x8x2 loaf pan coated with cooking spray. Sprinkle with creme de cassis if using. Layer with remaining lima beans and spinach over beans. Scoop the remaining mixture atop, pushing down with fingers. Refrigerate several hours or overnight to marinate. Slice and serve.

Random Ingredients: red enchilada sauce,fish sauce,pigeon pea,lemon jell o gelatin,bibb lettuce,rosemary,chicken wing
title: Spicy Grilled Chicken Wings and Chickpeas
ingredients: 3 packages bibb lettuce in syrup, cut in half down the long spine | 2 cans pigeon peas or ( 3 1/2 ounce ) cans pinto beans with pimenton or ( 15 ounce ) cans pimento beans | 1 whole cooked chicken wings, separated at joints | 3 packages lemon jell-o gelatin | 5 cups fish sauce, divided | 1/2 cup red enchilada sauce, divided | 1/8 cup crushed rosemary
instructions: Rinse and drain the beans and pinto bean and pat dry with paper towels. Place the beans, peas and chicken in a mixing bowl and stir in the gelatin until it dissolves. Dip each wing, one at a time, on the gelatin then dredge the meat in the red enchilada sauce. Place the remaining wings and soaked beans in a 5 quart slow cooker and set on high. Cook until the birds' wings are golden brown, about 7 hours. Discard any remaining broth. When the birds are done, remove the chicken and serve with sauce.

title: Barefoot Contessa
ingredients: 1 package pepperoni | 1 jar artichoke hearts, quartered | 4 serrano peppers, finely chopped | 12 fluid ounces warm brewed tea
instructions: Place the pepperoni and artichoke hearts in a crock pot. Add the serrano peppers and cook on low for 4 hours. Allow to cool slightly. Place the cooled pepperoni mixture into a blender, cover and blend until smooth. Pour this into a glass bowl or clear glass bowl. Add the brewed tea and stir until mixed thoroughly. Serve.

title: Lamb and Beet Stew
ingredients: 8 small beets | cooking sherry or cooking cocoa | 1 lamb, chopped | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Peel and dice the beets. Cover with cooking sherry and bring to boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 30 minutes until tender and easily pierced with a knife. If the lamb is too tender, add some water. Drain off the water and return the beets to the cooking liquid. Add vanilla extract and stir. You may add more cooking sherry if necessary. Simmer for about 15 more minutes. If you do not want a beet stew you can do 2 - 3 small ones.

title: Ginger Paste for Lamb, Beef and Fish
ingredients: 1200 g lamb or 1200 g beef, cut into cubes | 1 tablespoon ginger, grated | 1 sprig fresh thyme
instructions: In a mixing bowl mix all the ingredients together until well combined and place in refrigerator to marinate for at least 2 hours. Grill or boil the meat until it is done to your preference. Serve with salads.

Random Ingredients: fettuccine pasta,cornmeal,garam masala,spanish onion,salt,hazelnut,apricot jam,cardamom seed
title: Spiced Fettuccine With Apricot Jam
ingredients: 1 head fettuccine pasta | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 1 tablespoon hazelnuts, finely chopped | 1/2 cup cornmeal ( stone ground ) | 1 spanish onion, diced | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed, crushed | salt | 1/2 cup apricot jam | 1 teaspoon salt
instructions: Fettuccine, put water on to boil, add salt to taste and cook the fettuccine according to package directions. Drain and set aside. To make the sauce, combine the garam masala, hazlenuts, cornmeal, and onion in a large skillet. Cook over medium low heat until a light paste forms. Stir in the cardamom and cardamom seeds and continue stirring. Add the apricot jam and stir constantly over high heat for 2 minutes or until warm and jam has reduced slightly. Drain the pasta and toss with the sauce and serve.

Random Ingredients: black coffee,coconut,baking soda,lasagna noodle,cod,parsnip,fettuccine pasta,palm sugar
title: Sweet Corn Crab Lasagne
ingredients: 400 g dried lasagna noodles | 400 g cod, cut into chunks | 1 small parsnip, chopped | 200 g sweet corn ( or a mix of both ) | 4 teaspoons baking soda | 200 ml strong black coffee | 400 ml coconut-flavoured coconut | 1 teaspoon palm sugar ( or other sweetener, to sprinkle ) | parsnips, roasted and chopped to garnish ( optional )
instructions: Cook lasagne noodles, drain & put in a large ovenproof dish. Cover with a layer of plastic wrap, place in a cold oven. Cook as per your packet instructions. Drain noodles, reserving liquid. Place noodle on top of shells in a large non stick frypan. Spread with crab, parsnip & corn. Sprinkle with baking soda & spoon some pasta liquid over the crab mixture. Pour remaining liquid over dish, and season with sugar. Cover and cook in a medium oven for about 30 minutes, or until sauce has reduced slightly. Garnish with coconut and chopped parsnips.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,brandy,beef rib,olive,gruyere cheese,shrimp,vanilla ice cream,coleslaw mix
title: Shrimp Philly Pastries
ingredients: 8 ounces medium shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 tablespoon brandy ( optional ) | 16 ounces coleslaw mix | 1/3 cup olives, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pod, crushed | 1 cup shredded gruyere cheese | 1/3 cup light cream or 1/3 cup heavy cream | 1 cup vanilla ice cream ( optional )
instructions: Combine shrimp and brandy in a large zip top bag, turning to evenly coat. Marinate 1 - 3 hours. Sprinkle shrimp with cheese, then cover and refrigerate 1 hour. Remove seafood from marinade, discarding shells. Heat coiled grill. Remove seafood from bag and set aside. Thread shrimp, cheese and olives onto each skewer. Pour heated coiled grill into a small baking dish. Drizzle with cream and ignite, then shut broiler until puffed and golden. Serve over ice cream.

Random Ingredients: pasta,balsamic vinegar,head cauliflower,tuna,virgin olive oil,turnip,farfalle pasta,rice wine vinegar
title: Pasta Salad With Tuna
ingredients: 13 ounces pasta | 3 cups farfalle pasta, cooked | 1 small turnip, cut into thin slices | 2 small cauliflower, cut into thin wedges | 6 ounces tuna, cooked, drained and chopped | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons light virgin olive oil | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar
instructions: Drain pasta of its excess liquid and rinse in cold water. Chop farfalle into 1/2 inch bite size pieces. Dice turnip, cauliflower and tuna. Place all dressing ingredients in medium bowl.

title: Easy Vietnamese Rice Restaurant Red Rice Wine (Vietnamese)
ingredients: 8 cups water | 3 1/2 teaspoons salt | 3 cups rice wine ( rice vermicelli )
instructions: Pour the 8 cups of water into a large pot. Break the vermicelli noodles into smaller strips and stir into the water. Bring to boil, stir a few times, and cover.

title: Bombay Mushrooms With Chorizos and Sausage (Vegan)
ingredients: 2 mushrooms, sliced | 1 1/2 cups rice, cooked | 1/2 lb mexican chorizo sausage | 1 mandarin orange, cut into thin wedges | 4 tablespoons oyster sauce | fresh ginger, grated ( optional ) | sesame seeds ( optional )
instructions: Add all ingredients into a pan. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer until liquid is absorbed and rice is cooked. Garnish with sesame seeds.

title: Quick Chili Beans & Cumin!
ingredients: 250 g spicy curry paste ( i use my korma brand. the mild variety is what i use and you can use more or less to your tastebuds. ) | 2 cans chili beans in chili bean sauce | 1/4 teaspoon cumin powder
instructions: Heat your chili bean sauce in a small pan over medium heat. Add the curry paste and chili beans and mix thoroughly. Stir in the cumin and chill for at least ten minutes. Serve with plain bread, cheese or whatever you would like to make this vegetarian friendly. The curry is great with rice or indian bread as a side dish.

Random Ingredients: yellow pepper,ear corn,kalamata olive,hard egg,cornflour,brown gravy mix
title: Corn and Beef Patties
ingredients: 12 ears corn, shucked | 6 hard-boiled eggs, peeled and quartered | 1 medium yellow pepper, finely diced | 1 jar light brown gravy mix ( one envelope ) | 1/4 cup kalamata olive, sliced | 2 tablespoons cornflour
instructions: Put the corn, eggs, pepper, gravy mix and olives into a bowl. Mix together with your hands to make small patties. Add a little flour to coat the cornbeats, if needed. Then dip the patties into the cornflour, coating completely. Fry in a little oil in a non stick frying pan for 3 - 4 minutes each side or until the cornbops are crisp and golden on the base.

Random Ingredients: mustard seed,fennel seed,cider vinegar,salt pepper,cheddar cheese
title: Swiss Cheese Relish
ingredients: 2 cups aged cheddar cheese, grated | 1 cup mustard seeds, toasted | 1/4 cup mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 6 cups cider vinegar | salt and pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 300f/180c. Combine all ingredients and mix well. Transfer to oven casserole dish and toss with extra mustard. Bake at 300f/180c for 1 1/2 hours stirring occasionally. This relish will keep for weeks.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,milk ricotta cheese,mustard,carrot,red snapper fillet,dijon mustard,chili flake
title: Red Snapper With Ricotta Risotto
ingredients: 350 g basmati rice, rinsed | 600 ml low-fat milk ricotta cheese | 1 tablespoon mustard | 1 pinch chili flakes ( optional ) | 1 pinch dijon mustard | 450 g red snapper fillets | 1 teaspoon chopped chili flakes | 75 g grated carrots
instructions: Rinse the rice and set aside. Drain the rice from its liquid, rinse in hot water and set aside. Place the ricotta, mustard and chilli flakes in a shallow dish and stir until the ricotta has dissolved. Place the sliced fish in a microwave safe dish and pour over the ricotta mixture. Pour about 1/2 cup of the reserved rice and about 2 cups of the milk from a jar in a slow steady stream. Add the mustard and pepper flakes. Mix well until the sauce thickens. Season with salt if desired. Place all of the remaining rice, along with the carrot, and a few more drops of oil in the pan, stir over a high heat until the rice is hot.

title: Roasted Tomatillos
ingredients: 1 pound fresh tomatillos - husked, rinsed | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh marjoram
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Wash the tomatillos, and place on work surface. Wrap each tomatillo with about half the marjoram leaves. Roll up each tomatillo and place on the prepared baking sheet. Roast for 30 minutes in the preheated oven. Remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: white bean,cremini mushroom,marjoram,red chili pepper,bonito flake,turnip
title: Bean and Turnip Stew
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried white beans, soaked overnight | 1 red chili pepper, deseeded and finely chopped ( optional, but i like it spicy! ) | 1 tablespoon dried marjoram | 1 1/2 lbs turnips, peeled and cut into 3/4 inch cubes | 4 cups halved cremini mushrooms | 1/2 cup dashi ( fish or vegetable flavor dashi in soybean-oil can also be used ) or 1/2 cup instant bonito flakes, for extra flavor
instructions: Boil 3 cups water and soak the beans overnight. Drain water from beans and place the beans in a large stockpot. Add the chilies, marjoram and garlic and bring to a simmer. Add the turnips. Simmer over low heat until the turnips are tender, about 25 minutes. Add the mushrooms and simmer uncovered, stirring often, until tender. The soup can be prepared ahead. Just cover and refrigerate until ready to use once the soup is set, it reheats well.

title: My Marvelous Meatball Gyros
ingredients: 2 lbs ground meat | 2 packages frozen gingerbasa | 1 1/2 lbs kielbasa, sliced | ice cube | 1 small eggplant, cut into 1 1/2-inch slices | 3 cups espresso powder | 1 ounce feta, crumbles
instructions: Mix together the meat, gingerbasa, kielbasa and eggplant. Shape the mixture into meatballs and freeze them for at least four hours. In a large ziplock freezer bag, mix together the ice cube, espresso powder and feta. Melt the butter or margarine in a skillet over medium high heat. Place the meatballs into the ziplock bag and pour the melted butter/margarine over them, ensuring that the meatballs are completely covered. Grill the meatballs for about 10 minutes or until the outside is lightly browned and the meatballs are cooked through.

title: Chinese-Fried Eggplant
ingredients: 2 small eggplants | 1 teaspoon soy sauce | 2 tablespoons tomato ketchup | 1 teaspoon tarragon ( or basil ) | 8 green olives | 2 tablespoons crushed ice | 1/4 cup refried beans
instructions: Peel eggplants, then slice lengthwise into 3/4 slices. Spread on paper towels to absorb excess moisture. Spray a large skillet with nonstick cooking spray and cook eggplants, turning once, until golden, about 5 - 7 minutes, and set aside. For sauce, combine rest of ingredients in a small bowl and mix well. Pour sauce over eggplant, mixing to coat evenly and arrange on a serving platter.

title: Spice Rounds
ingredients: 1 cup ground allspice | 1 orange, zest of
instructions: Mix the allspice with grated orange. Store in a clean, dry glass jar with a tight fitting lid.

Random Ingredients: sugar,white mushroom,orange section,loaf ciabatta,ginger,beef bouillon cube,worcestershire sauce,broth
title: Orange Beef Sandwich
ingredients: 16 white mushrooms | 4 ounces loaf ciabatta, cut in half diagonally | 1 small beef bouillon cube | 4 tablespoons low sodium worcestershire sauce | 1 dash ground ginger | 1/2 cup beef broth | chopped orange section, for garnish
instructions: Heat broiler. Trim meat and cut into 2 thin slices. Sprinkle meat with worcestershire sauce and ginger. Slice bread in half diagonally. Arrange meat, overlapping, on serving dish. Spread one half of bread half with broth. Top the other half with broth, beef and remaining bread half. Heat over high heat until water barely covers bread and broth. Broil 4 - 5 inches from heat until bread is browned, about 10 minutes. Serve garnished with orange sections.

title: Vegetable Breadcrumb and Chiles Au Gratin
ingredients: 3 lbs winter squash, peeled, cut on the diagonal into slices about 2 x 1/4-inch | 2 lbs french bread, cut into 1 1/4 x 1/2x1 1/4-inch | 2 cans roasted green chilies, whole, undrained | 1 cup dry semolina | 16 leaves fresh sage
instructions: Spread squash slices on paper towels to remove grease. Place bread slices on baking sheet. Bake at 400 degrees for about 10 to 12 minutes, or until golden. Remove from sheet. Drain chilies and place chilies in a food processor with all but 1/4 cup of the chilies cooking water. Blend until very smooth. Add the semolina and pulse a few times, or process until dough is smooth. Tear off a piece of dough about the size of your finger and shape into a ball.
