Roll into a ball in the chilies, then transfer to a large shallow dish. Repeat. Chill until serving. Note, if the loaf is frozen, use two pieces of greaseproof paper each to line the bottom of a greased baking dish. Line the baking dish with dough. Spoon 1 cup of chilies and bread crumbs on dough. Top with remaining bread crumbs and chilies. Sprinkle with sage. Bake at 400 degrees for about 45 minutes or until heated through and topping is toasty. Let stand for 5 minutes before cutting.

title: Stir Fry Potatoes and Spinach
ingredients: 2 -3 small red potatoes | 1 bunch fresh chives, chopped ( may sub parsley ) | 8 ounces baby spinach
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Lightly oil a baking sheet. Cut one of the potatoes into quarters. Cut the other potato halfway into two equal quarters. Place the potato quarters on a cutting board and thinly slice diagonally. Remove the skin from each piece by pounding a piece between the fingers of a sharp knife. Using clean hands, flatten each slightly. Cut each piece into 3 - 4 evenly sized pieces. Place on prepared tray and sprinkle each with chives. Sprinkle the spinach lightly with salt, or to taste. Bake for about 25 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender but not mushy and the spinach has crisped up. If using fresh spinach, place on a plate and serve warm. Yield is estimated.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,tomato puree,baby spinach,cayenne pepper,pimiento,oyster sauce,pork tenderloin
title: Taste of the Islands
ingredients: 600 ml vegetable stock | 2 tablespoons tomato puree | 1 tablespoon tomato puree | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 4 tablespoons oyster sauce | 20 g baby spinach | 100 g pork tenderloin ( sliced thinly )
instructions: Bring stock to boil in large saucepan over high heat. Stir in tomato puree and tomato puree. Reduce heat to medium. Add cayenne, cayenne pepper, and oyster sauce. Simmer 1 minute. Stir in spinach. Simmer 3 - 5 minutes until just warm, stirring occasionally. Serve in shallow soup dishes. Accompany with crusty bread, salad and a light beer. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: sherry wine,thyme,green bell pepper,cherry,extra virgin olive oil,kosher salt
title: Spanish Olive Dip
ingredients: 5 ounces cherry peppers, cut in half | 3 ounces green bell peppers, cut in half | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1/4 teaspoon fresh thyme, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon sherry wine | 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Put olive oil, chiles, thyme, sherry, and salt in small sauce pot or skillet. Heat over medium high for 30 seconds. Remove from heat and add cherry peppers and green pepper.

Random Ingredients: orange lentil,nonfat milk powder,bicarbonate soda,soy sauce,red bell pepper,baby bok choy,okra
title: Vegetarian Goya
ingredients: 7 ounces red bell peppers, chopped | 1/4 cup frozen okra | 1/2 cup orange lentils, thawed | 1/4 cup nonfat dry milk powder | 1/4 cup low sodium soy sauce | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 2 cups baby bok choy, sliced
instructions: Place peppers, okra and lentils in medium microwave safe bowl and microwave on high, stirring every minute or so, for 4 minutes or so, until okra and vegetables are tender, but not falling apart. Stir in dry milk, soy sauce and bicarb of soda, stirring until well combined and set aside. Microwave for 12 minutes on high or until heated through. Stir vegetables gently.

Random Ingredients: hot dog bun,cauliflower,jalapeno pepper,hot italian sausage,tomato puree
title: Hot Breakfast Dogs
ingredients: 2 hot dog buns | 1/2 cup canned tomato puree | 1/4 lb hot italian sausage, thinly sliced | 1/4 lb pickled cauliflower, chopped | 1 jalapeno pepper, thinly sliced
instructions: Place the hot dog buns on a cookie sheet. Spread one third of the tomato puree over the hot dogs. Sprinkle lightly with salt and pepper. Arrange the sausage slices over the tomato puree and place under a preheated broiler of about 1 1/2 inches from heat. Cook the hot dogs about 1 minute or until just barely browned. Turn the hot dogs over and repeat for all the hot dogs. Divide the cauliflower between the two hot dogs.

title: Spicy Roast Jalapenos
ingredients: 2 lbs jalapeno chiles | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric powder | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 7 ounces cream cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 deg f. Rinse the chiles and remove stems and seeds. Rub the chilies with warm water to soften, then place each one skin side up on a baking sheet skin side up. Bake for 15 minutes. When the chilies have baked 25 minutes, remove chilies and place on a chopping board and roughly chop. Add the turmeric and salt and mix. Place the cream cheese in a plastic bag and pour in the turmeric mixture. Shake the bag to mix. Pour over the chilies. Wrap tightly in plastic wrap and allow to sit at room temperature for 1 hour. Serve with tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,gruyere cheese,coconut milk,beef stock,red curry paste,italian salad dressing,rice
title: Thai Red Curry Beef
ingredients: 1 ounce dark chocolate | 1/2 cup beef stock | 1/2 cup unsweetened coconut milk | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 12 ounces lean sirloin steaks, trimmed and cut into 2 inch cubes | 3 tablespoons mixed salad dressing | 2 tablespoons shredded gruyere cheese
instructions: Blend the chocolate by pulsing in food processor in increments until the chocolate is a smooth compound chocolate.

title: Aunt Jenny's Eggs
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups bacon drippings | 1 egg white | 1 egg white ( for egg wash )
instructions: You need 12 eggs. Bacon dripping is optional not needed. Pour bacon drippings into mixing bowl. Add egg whites and whisk until well mixed. Melt butter in frying pan or wok over medium heat. Dip eggs in egg white and place in pan. Fry until firm. Do not fry them completely serve hot or cold. Eggs will be hard.

title: Black Olive Popsicles
ingredients: 3 -4 black olives | 4 -6 tablespoons cointreau liqueur | 1/2 teaspoon cumin | 1/2 teaspoon ginger | 1 tablespoon minced cilantro
instructions: Blend all ingredients together in blender until smooth. Scrape into small popsicle tray. Sprinkle with cilantro and eat immediately or let chill for up to a day before serving. Serve on toothpicks, as an appetizer with meat or as a snack in a burger bun.

Random Ingredients: artichoke heart,gingerroot,spaghetti sauce,lemon juice zest,hungarian paprika,zucchini,chili powder
title: Quick & Easy Artichoke and Vegetable Stir-Fry
ingredients: 2 large zucchini, cut into bite size pieces ( about 4-5 ) | 1 jar spaghetti sauce ( i like homemade ) | 1/2 teaspoon sweet hungarian paprika | 8 artichoke hearts ( drained and chopped ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground gingerroot | pinch of fresh lemon juice and zest, grated | chili powder, to taste
instructions: Saute zucchini in sauce in a small skillet until lightly browned and tender crisp. Add remaining ingredients except korean chile powder & garnish. Serve over korean chile powder.

title: Red Pepper Polenta
ingredients: 1 cup yellow cornmeal | 1 package shell pasta | 1 tablespoon red pepper flakes
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook shell pasta in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until tender yet firm to the bite, about 8 minutes. Drain. Heat the cornmeal in a medium skillet over medium heat, stirring, and stir in red pepper flakes and dried cornmeal as the mixture heats. Cook and stir until the mixture becomes thick, about 5 minutes. Cut polenta into 6 wedges, and transfer to a baking dish. Cook in the preheated oven until the polenta is browned and crumbly, about 10 minutes.

title: Grilled Collard Greens With Prunes and Smoked Kielbasa
ingredients: 4 collard greens, washed, trimmed, and cut into wedges | 3 -4 slices smoked kielbasa | 12 pitted prunes | 2 -3 tablespoons light turkey tea | tabasco sauce, to taste
instructions: Preheat a gas grill to medium high heat. Wash and cut collards into 2 - 3 inch pieces. Lay them on a piece of buttered foil or other non stick surface that will fit snugly over the grill.

title: Homemade Buffalo Wing Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup unsweetened applesauce, or more to taste | 1 can or bottle light beer
instructions: Puree applesauce and beer in a blender until completely smooth.

title: Persian Sea  Sea  Bags  for Escargots  (Escargots a La Lena
ingredients: 4 lbs whole sea ike sea bream ( in the shell ) | 6 bunches watercress, very tightly packed ( about a handful ) | 5 -6 quarts water, room temperature | 1/4 cup white sesame seeds | 3 1/2-inch dried sage | 1 vegetable bouillon cube ( knorr )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. In a large roasting pan, put together the cleaned sea bream, watercress, sesame seeds, sage and bouillon cube. Cover and cook slowly for 4 hours. Carefully remove fish and place on paper towels to drain grease and dry off. Serve with your favorite salad, bread or toast.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,red potato,mushroom soup,soya sauce,cornflour,beef chuck,bay leaf
title: Garlic Beef and Potato Curry
ingredients: 500 g minced beef chuck | 2 tablespoons soya sauce | 2 red potatoes, chopped | 3 -4 fresh mushrooms ( if using canned, reconstitute if need be ) | 1 tablespoon cornflour ( cornstarch is too runny ) | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Sauté minced beef in soya sauce and keep going till it is browned and is almost cooked through and has a deep pink colour. Remove beef from pan and put aside. Add diced and roasted potato to pan in a single layer and sauté till potato is almost cooked. Add garam masala and a pinch of salt and sauté for few seconds before adding mushrooms and mushrooms in the same pan. Add mushroom soup in pan and stir well. Add bay leaf and bring to the boil. Add chopped beef back inches.

Random Ingredients: veal,greek yogurt,basil pesto,beef steak,corn,lime zest,corn oil
title: Beef With Lime and Corn in Yogurts
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef steaks or 1 1/2 lbs top round steaks, cut at least 3/4 of an inch thick | 2 teaspoons corn oil, for steaming, at room temperature | 1 -2 teaspoon basil pesto, for serving | 1 1/2 teaspoons lime zest, grated for serving | 1/2 cup greek yogurt, plain | 1/4 cup corn oil, for frying, at room temperature | 1 tablespoon corn oil, for frying | 1 cup frozen corn, thawed
instructions: Cut the steak into strips about 1 x 2 inches. Arrange on foil lined 2 serving plates. Spread one tablespoon of the pesto on the beef strips, then top with the remaining pesto. Serve with plain yogurt and corn oil.

Random Ingredients: white potato,celery salt,taco seasoning,marjoram,chicken stock cube,chocolate syrup,lard,cremini mushroom
title: Frozen White Potato and Mushroom Fondue
ingredients: 12 ounces cremini mushrooms, quartered ( or use crimini ) | 1 chicken stock cube | 2 ounces unsweetened chocolate syrup | 2 ounces lard, cut into small chunks | 3 large white potatoes, thinly sliced including some fat | 1 teaspoon marjoram | 1/2 teaspoon celery salt | 2 teaspoons taco seasoning
instructions: Place the mushrooms and 1 cube of the lard in a small saucepan over low heat. When the mushrooms are soft stir occasionally. Add the remaining lard and chocolate syrup to the saucepan and simmer for 10 minutes. Add the potatoes and marjoram, and stir. Add the seasoning and simmer for 5 minutes. Serve hot or cold with the cooked potatoes.

title: Penne Pasta
ingredients: 3/4 lb penne pasta | 3 tablespoons kirsch | 1/2 inch piece ginger, thinly sliced | 6 small black olives, sliced | 6 star anise | 2 tablespoons chili flakes | 1/2 ounce cherries, halved ( optional )
instructions: Cook the pasta in a large pan with a little oil or lemon juice until just tender. When pasta is ready, stir in the spices and cherries, reserving some for garnish.

title: Hamburger Pork Chops
ingredients: 4 pork loin chops | crushed cooked ham ( to make about 1/4-inch thick, or more )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 350 degrees. Brush pork chops with a little oil. Grill chops about 5 - 6 minutes on each side until no pink remains in the bone. They will brown quickly so remove chops from pan as soon as they are done.

Random Ingredients: iceberg lettuce,baking powder,flour tortilla,heavy cream,chicken bouillon granule
title: Chicken Wrap
ingredients: 2 lbs ground chicken | 4 teaspoons chicken bouillon granule | 5 teaspoons flour tortillas | 1 cup heavy cream | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Brown meat with bouillon and water. Cool. Drain meat and combine with sour cream and flour tortillas. Roll up and put seam side down onto a plate to be wrapped. Refrigerate overnight and then roll up and freeze for future use. When ready for storage, thaw in fridge or put in large bowl and use within 2 days.

title: Anchovy and Onion Soup
ingredients: 2 cans anchovies, drained and rinsed | 1 small brown onion | 1 quart beef stock
instructions: Drain the anchovies, reserving the liquid. Slice the onion into 1/4 rings. Bring the beef stock to a simmer, add the anchovy liquid and onion rings. Simmer for 10 minutes. The anchovies and onion will dissolve completely and the soup will be ready to serve.

title: Vietnamese Crunch
ingredients: 1 cup green pepper, cut in strips | 1/4 cup sweet red peppers or 1/4 cup sugar sweet green peppers | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 1 tablespoon grand marnier | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1 dash cayenne
instructions: Mix all ingredients together on a large baking pan. Bake in preheated 180 degree c oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until hot and crunchy.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower floret,fish sauce,cajun seasoning,grenadine,white wine vinegar,shiitake mushroom,cumin seed,pepperoni
title: Cauliflower Shish Kabobs
ingredients: 4 cups cauliflower florets, divided | 3/4 cup shiitake mushrooms | 6 slices pepperoni | 3 teaspoons cumin seeds | 2 cups white wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 1/4 cup cajun seasoning
instructions: Place 3/4 cup cauliflower, mushrooms, pepperoni and cumin seeds in blender or food processor and pulse until the cauliflower is chopped and the mushrooms are finely chopped into pieces. In a large glass or plastic bowl, whisk together vinegar, worcestershire sauce, fish sauce, cajun seasoning and remaining 1/4 cup cauliflower, stir in the cauliflower mixture and season with salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: baking potato,almond extract,vegetable juice,rigatoni pasta,green chili salsa,egg yolk
title: Mexican Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 small boiling baking potato | 1 cup frozen vegetables ( see note ) | 1 -2 chopped green chili salsa, as desired | 2 egg yolks | 1 tablespoon almond extract | 1 lb rigatoni pasta or 1 lb other tubular pasta, cooked | additional salsa, to taste ( optional )
instructions: Grate potato using large holes grater until the potatoes are roughly 3 or 4 inches in length. Heat griddle or large skillet to its max temperature. When hot, put potato through ricer. Add vegetables. Sprinkle with red chili salsa. Stir with wooden spoon. Turn vegetables over when mixture is bubbly and hot. You may have to turn down heat, depending on temperature of skillet. Remove from heat and sprinkle with yolks and almond extract. Mix well. While pasta or rigatoni are still hot, add to vegetable mixture. Stir with wooden spoon. Remove from heat and top with additional salsa if desired.

Random Ingredients: cooking sherry,lime juice,spinach leaf,tequila,yellow pepper,sesame oil
title: Spit Spinach
ingredients: 1 lime, juice of | 1 cup lime juice | 7 cups spinach leaves | 1 small yellow pepper, seeded and minced | 3 tablespoons cooking sherry | 2 teaspoons sesame oil ( optional )
instructions: Mix together lime juice and lime juice in large shallow salad bowl. In another bowl, toss together spinach, pepper, sherry, and sesame oil. Toss with lime juice mixture and serve.

title: Swiss Cheese Spiced Baked Onions
ingredients: 1/2 - 1 cup shredded swiss cheese | 3/4 cup buttermilk | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice, to taste | 1 fresh sage leaf, minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,rice flour,sun tomato oil,pineapple chunk
title: Sun-Dried Tomato Oil and Pineapple Rissoto
ingredients: 1 cup rice flour | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and chopped | 1/4 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 can pineapple chunks ( drained )
instructions: In a mixing bowl add rice flour, sun dried tomatoes and parmigiano reggiano cheese. Heat two tablespoons of the oil in a large skillet till very hot and then add the pineapple chunks and stir fry till just heated thru remove from heat and pour over mixture in bowl. Sprinkle pine nuts over mixture and serve.

title: Quinoa Fruit Salsa
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups quinoa | 1 can apricots, drained and chopped | 1/2 cup limeade concentrate, thawed ( or lime ) | 1/2 cup apple cider vinegar, unseasoned | 1/4 cup shortening ( i like crisco ) | 1 pint half-and-half cream, warmed ( i like fat free ) | 1 cup seedless grapes
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°. Put quinoa on plate and cover with foil. Let sit 30 minutes then drain, uncover and stir until the quinoa looks dry. In a large bowl add all remaining ingredients. Mix thoroughly. Put in a glass 9x13 pan.

title: Memphis-Style Pulled Pork with Sweet Corn
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pork shoulder, cut into about 1-1/2-inch pieces | 2 cans whole kernel corn, drained | 1/2 cup molasses | 2 tablespoons molasses, for brushing | 2 teaspoons pepper | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1 large head romaine lettuce, finely shredded | 1/2 lb sliced deli sliced cooked hamburger, about 2 cups
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f.

title: Simple Feta Cheese - Greek Style
ingredients: 1/4 lb feta | olive, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Cut feta into cubes and put them in the oven or microwave. Heat on high until it becomes golden brown on the edges. Remove from oven. Grate into a bowl. Drizzle with olive if desired.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,chipotle chile adobo,coconut rum,margarita mix,pasta shell,vanilla extract,monterey jack cheese,sirloin tip roast
title: Shrimp Cocktail
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin tip roast | 1/2 cup light coconut rum | 1/2 cup margarita mix | 1 cup frozen coconut shrimp in adobo | 1 1/2 - 2 cups monterey jack cheese ( or use cheddar ) | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning or 2 tablespoons chili pepper flakes | chili pepper flakes | 1 lb pasta shells
instructions: Rinse roast well with cool water. Slice 1/8 to 1/4 thick into 1/2 strips. In a 9x13 pan, pour 2 cups of rum and the mix. Add beef and marinade. Refrigerate for at least 2 hrs. While that marinates mix up the taco seasoning and chill for 30 minute. Start a large pot of water to boil. Add pasta. When it comes to a rolling boil, add the cornstarch. Once it starts to thicken, it is perfect timing on stove top. Drain the beef and reserve juice. Save the marinade, then pull meat from the marinade. Set aside. In a large skillet, heat remaining 1/2 cup rum and coconut shrimp on high until they turn pink. Add remaining taco seasoning. Drain beef and add to skillet, cooking until it starts to brown. Add the reserved marinade, and bring to a simmer. Cook until the sauce thickens enough to coat a spoon or two, about 1 - 2 minute. Serve over pasta and top with shredded cheese.

title: Shrimp Bites
ingredients: 2 spring roll wrappers | 250 g raw shrimp, peeled | 2 teaspoons green cardamoms, crushed | 8 pistaloones ( pignoli ) | 1 teaspoon salt, to taste
instructions: Place the shrimp, cardamom pods and salt in a mortar and pound or process into a fine paste. Wrap each piece of dough in plastic wrap and put in the fridge for at least 1 hour or for up to two days. Divide the shrimp mixture into 12 equal pieces and roll each piece into a log about 20 cm long and 2 inches wide. Slice each log of spring roll wrappers in half and using a serrated knife, cut diagonally into 3cm lengths and transfer to a tray. Cover with cling film and refrigerate for 30 minutes. To serve, arrange the spring roll wrappers on a tray and spoon half the shrimp mixture onto half the wrappers, leaving a 1/2 inch border of wrappers over for presentation. Sprinkle with pistelios and serve.

title: Hot and Sweet Tortellini Soup
ingredients: 6 cups hot water | 1 lb tortellini | 6 tablespoons red wine vinegar or 6 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 3 tablespoons walnuts | 1 cup plain flour
instructions: To make this recipe you need 4 - 6 qts boiling water dikeshos or 6 pint soup bowls if using soup bowls. Prepare the pasta according to the packet instructions while pasta is still hot. Drain pasta, and set aside. Bring the water to a boil. Meanwhile, rinse tortellini and cut them into cubes. Place them in boiling water in a small pan and return to the boil. Drain tortellini, then put into cold water and remove the water that has had settled onto the top of the tortellini. Drain the tortellini and add to soup bowl with the hot water. Add the vinegar. Toss the soup while continuously stirring, until well blended. Add the nuts and flour and mix well. Let soup sit for 5 minute. Divide between each soup bowl and serve. Garnish with parsley or paprika flakes if desired.

title: Roasted Capsicum
ingredients: 1 kg red capsicum | 250 g spinach | 150 ml vegetable juice | 1 garlic clove, crushed | 80 g cashews, shelled and roughly chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Place the capsicum on baking sheets, skin side down and, using a sharp knife, cut an x across the top. Bake for 20 mins, then remove from oven, peel, quarter and set aside. Remove capsicums and place in a large bowl, trimming off the ends if necessary. Drain capsicums on paper towel and cut into 2cm pieces. Place spinach and juice into a large saucepan and bring to the boil over high heat. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 3 min, stirring occasionally. Add the garlic and boil for 2 more. Pour the liquid mixture into the pan with the spinach and capicums, season and nestle the spinach and capicums evenly amongst the spinach. Cover with foil and bake in the oven for 30 mins until soft to the touch. Remove foil and sprinkle with cashews before serving.

Random Ingredients: apricot preserve,summer squash,kiwi fruit,alfredo sauce,garnish,oreo cooky,mustard powder,spring onion
title: Greek Salad
ingredients: 8 kiwi fruits, peeled and chopped | 10 apricot preserves, cut into pieces | 1 lb green summer squash, peeled, seeded and chopped | 1/2 cup prepared alfredo sauce, warmed | 1 tablespoon mustard powder | 1/2 cup chopped spring onion | 1/2 cup crumbled kraft signature asiago alfredo cheese, divided | alfredo sauce ( optional )
instructions: Mix kiwifruit, preserves, squash, marinade, mustard powder and green onions in a large bowl. Add alfredo cheese and mix well. Cover and refrigerate 6 hours to overnight. Serve atop a bed of alfredo sauce.

title: Currant Leeks
ingredients: 1 cup currants | 1/2 cup chopped leeks | 3 1/2 teaspoons pepperoni, chopped
instructions: Wash leeks well, cut off the tops and discard. In a small saucepan combine currants, leeks, and pepperoni. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to medium, and cover. Simmer for about 45 minutes, or until tender and leeks tender, stirring often.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile adobo,apricot preserve,dashi,dark chocolate,plum tomato,mango chutney,vanilla essence,onion
title: Chermoula - Glazed Dried Apricots
ingredients: 200 g dark chocolate or 200 g semisweet chocolate | 200 g dried apricot preserves | 1 large sweet onion | 2 large plum tomatoes | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla essence | 1 tablespoon adobo | 1 -2 chipotle chile in adobo, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons dashi | mango chutney or jam, to serve
instructions: Place the apricots in the microwave heat for exactly 10 minutes and then take off the heat and allow to cool. Using 2 tablespoons of the apricot sauce, brush onto each apricot, place in a paper bag to refrigerate until needed. Use the remaining sauce to make the glaze. Remove the seeds from the apricots and dice them roughly, then set aside in a colander. Chop the onion finely and place in a pan with the remaining apricot sauce, finely chopped onion, diced tomatoes, puree, chipotle pepper, adobo and puree. Heat, stirring, until the apricots become very soft, about 2 minutes. Add the chocolate and stir until melted, then add the dashi, bring to the boil and then turn the heat to low and leave for 5 minutes. When cool, break the chocolate and stir through. Pour into 4 individual glasses or small individual dishes and scatter with the chopped onion. Garnish with a dollop of mango chutney or jam and serve.

title: Easy Low Fat Banana & Cheese Dip and Rollups-A La Crock Pot
ingredients: 4 bananas, very ripe, peeled & very ripe | 2 1/2 ounces low fat cottage cheese ( or other dairy cheese ) | lemon, juice & zest of | 1 medium sugar cube
instructions: Put 2/3 cup of yoghurt, a small pinch of lemon rind, a pinch of zest & juice and a few pinches of sugar in the crock pot. Mix thoroughly. Peel & slice the bananas, if using a blender you 'll need around 2/3 of a cup. Pour the liquid over the top, sprinkle with a little lemon juice & lemon zest.. Put the other half of the cup of yoghurt in a bowl, pour over the top. Add lemon peel, lemon juice & zest. Cover & set to low. After 2 hours turn the top up a little & mix thoroughly. Cover & cook on high for another hour. Serve with crisp rolls, crackers or crusty bread. It keeps well for several days & the fat content can be reduced. If yoghurt is too thick, add a little hot water to thin it to the desired consistency. Also, i recommend a bit of flour mixed in a little water to stop the garlic & starch from forming.

title: Beef Phyllo Wraps
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ground spice | 1 beef tenderloin steak, steaks bone in | 4 sheets phyllo pastry sheets ( fresh or frozen ) | 1 cup cheddar cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup cheddar cheese, shredded | 1 1/2 tablespoons flour
instructions: In medium bowl mix ground spice with beef.

title: Crock Pot Sweet Corn
ingredients: 2 tablespoons bacon drippings | 28 ounces canned chickpeas ( drained and rinsed ) | 1 can cream-style corn | 12 ounces chicken-flavored catsup | 2 tablespoons orange juice | 1 1/2 2 1/2 teaspoons vegetable bouillon granules or 1 1/2 teaspoons arrowroot | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 1 celery rib, chopped
instructions: Melt half the bacon drippings in a skillet. Add the drained and rinsed chick peas and corn, and cook over low to medium heat. In a medium bowl, stir together the rest of the ingredients, mix well, and pour over the chick and corn mixture. Transfer to the crock pot, and cook 6 - 7 hours on low. If desired, stir in 1/2 cup of cream to the sauce, and cook for an additional 30 - 45 minutes. Remove the celery stalk before serving.

title: Spicy Apple Salad
ingredients: 8 tart apples, cut into thin wedges | 2 tablespoons lavender | 12 radishes, very thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh chili peppers
instructions: Combine the apples, lavender and chiles. Toss to mix.

title: Homemade yoghurt from Yemen
ingredients: 2 liters of hot yoghurt | 250 grams white wine, as a preservative
instructions: Place yoghurt into a large clear container. Add wine to yoghurt. Cover with a clean dishcloth. Let stand for at least a day before using. When you're ready to serve, transfer yoghurt to refridgerator for several hours. When ready to serve, transfer yoghurt into a large glass bowl, discarding wine. Dry fry until golden.

title: Jambalaya (Spicy Sausages and Banana Leaf Wraps)

instructions: Trim pork sausage of any excess fat and cut into 12 long sticks.

title: Spinach, Corn, and Cabbage Baked Mangoes

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place 1/2 the spinach in a salad bowl. Toss with the cilantro and let cool to room temperature. Coarsely chop the rest of the spinach and set aside. To prepare the bean bacon soup, stir the soup in a 1/2 cup measuring cup and heat until hot. Stir in the cheese, mushrooms and cabbage. Pour soup and cheese mixture into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Top with the bean bacon soup mixture. Place the remaining spinach over the bean bacon soup and cook for 5 minutes, until the spinach is browned. Remove from heat and stir in the orange. Pour the mixture into the casserole. Bake for 30 minutes, or until the cheese is slightly melted. Let cool for 15 minutes before slicing for serving.

title: Black Bean and Macaroni

instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Meanwhile, brown the garlic first in a generous amount of olive oil, then remove. Place the soup mix in a large skillet set over medium heat. Add the cloves to the oil and lightly toast. Add remaining ingredients except the pasta. Bring to gentle boil, remove from heat, and cover. Let stand 10 minutes, then serve over cooked drained pasta.

title: Simple Carrot Juice
ingredients: 1 cup carrot, peeled | 1 1/2 cups simple syrup ( recipe id # 20102 )
instructions: Poke holes with a sharp fork all over the carrot. The carrot should not be so deeply cut that it tears or burns. Leave the hole in the carrot for a few minutes, then drain and plunge into a small bowl of ice water. Drain excess water and pat carrot with paper towels to remove water. Put carrots into the juice and sweeten with simple syrup. Chill well before serving.

title: Sweet and Sour Marinaded Fish (Yogurt)
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs good quality seafood ( bonito, scrod, clams, squid, snail ) | 1 can water chestnuts | 1/2 cup mild buttermilk | 1/4 cup good quality soya sauce | 2 tablespoons drained capers | pomegranate molasses
instructions: Heat grill. Place the seafood on a large plate or dish. Arrange water chestnuts on top of fish and marinate several hours or overnight. If cooking in the refrigerator, allow time for the seafood to marinate up to two hours. The sauce can be thickened with a bit of cornstarch or water. To serve, mix all salad ingredients together in a small bowl. Taste sauce for your preferences and correct as desired. Serve accompanied by boiled rice and/or a nice green salad.

title: Cherry Apricot Lamb With Beef Oxtail

instructions: Pre heat oven to 350 degrees f. Sprinkle the oxtail with salt and pepper. In an oven proof pan, melt the butter a little over high heat. Sear the pieces of oxtail, 3/4 to 1/ depending on size of piece. Remove oxtail and place into roasting pan. Add the beef broth to the pan and stir to scrape up any browned bits on the bottom and sides of the pan. Add apricot preserves and stir in. Add the sweet cherry or vermouth and stir well. Add chili seasoning and capers and stir to mix well. Put in the oven and cook 30 - 40 minutes. Serve over cooked couscous and enjoy.

title: Beenniel
ingredients: 2 cups cooked penne pasta ( about 10 oz ) | 1 egg yolk | 1/3 cup white breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon celery salt | 2 cups granny smith apples, chopped ( about 2 packed cups ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons liquid smoke | 1/4 cup pine nuts, toasted | 2 tablespoons iceberg lettuce, chopped
instructions: Beat the egg yolk and set aside. In a skillet, cook the pasta until tender but not mushy. Drain and set aside. In a large bowl, stir together the bread crumbs and celery salt. Add the apple, liquid smoke, nuts and pasta, mix to combine. Line a shallow baking dish with foil and set the pasta mixture in a layer. Spoon the bread crumb mixture over the top. Arrange the romaine leaves in alternate circles on the breadcrumb mixture. Bake, uncovered, at 450°f for 10 minutes, or until bubbly.

title: Beef Tenderloin Teriyaki
ingredients: 1/4 cup ketchup | 2 teaspoons dried oregano leaves | 1 beef tenderloin
instructions: Pour ketchup with dried oregano into a shallow baking dish to marinate. Score fatty center of meat. Dredge meat in ketchup. Let stand 15 minutes. Preheat grill. Cook meat, on the preheated grill for 40 minutes, or to desired internal temperature. Allow to stand 5 minutes before slicing.

title: Sesame Seeds and Cardamoms
ingredients: 20 green cardamom pods ( not pods ) | 1 3/4 tablespoons sesame seeds ( or a mixture of both ) or 1 3/4 tablespoons sunflower oil ( or a mixture of both )
instructions: Place seeds in a bowl and cover with boiling water. This will loosen the oil. You can leave the seeds whole or use a knife, to make a small 'crisp' hole in the lid. After about 40 - 60 seconds, remove seed and remove the water immediately, or else, you will end up using a whole tablespoon of the oil. Allow to stand until the oil has drained. This will take quite a bit of oil and patience. The idea is to keep the seeds in, which will soften as the oil collects. Once the oil has dried, place in a air tight jar in which your nuts will last a few weeks.

title: Chocolate Chip Oatcakes
ingredients: 1 cup oatmeal | 400 g mixed beans, drained ( red kidney beans, cannellini beans ) | 250 g red potatoes ( russet ) | 2 stalks celery ( thinly sliced ) | 1/3 cup half-and-half | 200 g good quality choc chip | salt pork | coriander leaves
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees c, gas mark toast the oatmeal on a griddle, or in a heavy based frying pan. Combine the soaked beans, potato and celery in a large bowl with half and half. Combine chip and salt in a cup and stir well. Place a large spoonful of the oatcake batter into each ramekin and sprinkle generously with salt pork. Place stuffed ramekins into an oven proof dish and bake for 15 minutes, remove from the oven, and in the meantime toast the remaining oatcakes in a frying pan. Serve drizzled with melted chocolate and coriander.

title: Gingered Noodles (Vegetarian)

instructions: To prepare dressing, combine all ingredients.

title: Plum Sauce for Breakfast
ingredients: 2 plum tomatoes, seeded and chopped | 1 tart apple, peeled, cored and finely chopped ( use a little less if you like ) | 2 tablespoons gin ( optional ) | fresh lettuce leaf ( optional ) | peanut oil ( vegetable or olive spray or extra virgin olive oil is okay. vegetarian brands can be found in most major supermarkets and are very easily reduced to one fat clove )
instructions: Serve tomatoes, apple, chili and gin in a bowl with oil in it, adding lettuce leaves if desired. Serve with chips or toasted rye bread.

title: Mccormick's Wonton Quitos
ingredients: 8 chicken drumsticks | 1 can coke | 1 teaspoon sugar | 1/2 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 12 wonton wrappers | 1/2 cup sharp cheddar cheese, grated on large pieces | 1/2 cup provolone cheese, grated on large pieces | 1/2 cup taco-sized taco shells, cut in half
instructions: Mix Coke, sugar, and worcestershire sauce. Place chicken in a glass bowl or dish, and pour the Coke over. Cover, and refrigerate for 15 - 20 minutes. Preheat oven to 375°f. Place a wonton wrapper onto a clean, dry surface. Place a heaping teaspoon of chicken mixture onto the center of the wrapper, and gather up the edges of the wrapper, pinching the edges together so it doesn't get too soft until your finger hits the center of the wrapper. Place the wontons on a floured baking sheet, and bake them for 20 minutes, or until golden brown. Remove from the oven, and allow them to cool for a few minutes if the wrappers have cooled for long enough. When cool, slice each wonton into 6 slices. Place a slice of each provolone slice in the center of the wafer, then top with a few tablespoons of the grated cheese, and fold the edges over into a triangle. Serve with taco sauce or salsa. Tips,. These wontons can also be stuffed with left over meat, fish, or poultry. Wontons can also be eaten as a snack, or with a salad.

Random Ingredients: ancho chilies,ricotta cheese,extra virgin olive oil,red chili pepper,ketchup,rotel tomato,rosemary
title: Creamy Garlic-Raised Chicana Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 tablespoon chopped rosemary | 1 tablespoon chopped dried ancho chilies ( or 3 small red chilies ) | 1 can rotel tomatoes ( or your favorite mild italian tomatoes ) | 1 can patted dry tomatoes | 1 tablespoon ketchup ( optional ) | 1 -2 tablespoon crumbled canned red chili pepper
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Stir in the rosemary. Cook until the rosemary turns white, stirring often. Add the ancho chilies or chiles and stir. Cook for another 2 - 3 minutes. Stir in the rotel tomatoes, the patted dry tomatoes and the ketchup and bring to a simmer. Simmer, stirring constantly, for about 10 minutes or until it thickens. Remove from heat.

title: Quick and Easy Pizza With Rice and Bread Crumbs
ingredients: 1 prepared pizza crust ( pillsbury recommended ) | 1 can refrigerated biscuits | 1 1/2 cups short-grain rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Press biscuits into dough on lightly floured surface. Arrange on greased cookie sheet. Using floured hands, press rice into dough, coating evenly. Bake for 9 minutes. Remove and bake for another 5 minutes. Cool. Cut into 4 sections. Set aside to cool enough to touch. Use a spoon to scoop toppings onto crust. Bake 5 to 10 minutes more.

ingredients: 1 quart cooking wine | 1 1/4 pounds shredded monterey jack cheese | 8 wooden skewers or skewers, soaked in water | toppings : | 1/2 cup fresh lemon juice | 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 1 serrano pepper, or to taste, seeded and chopped | topping :
instructions: Place wine, monterey jack cheese, and soaked skewers or wood skewers in a large ceramic pot or baking dish, pour hot cooking wine over, and stir to blend. title: Chops of Beef
ingredients: 1 can crushed tomatoes with added tomato paste | 1/4 cup light corn oil | 4 ounces ginger, peeled | 3 serrano peppers, seeds and ribs removed, finely chopped | 1 lb top sirloin, cut lengthwise into four slices | 1 -2 tablespoon superfine sugar | toothpicks
instructions: Puree the tomatoes in a blender and set aside. Heat oil in a large skillet over high heat. Sear pork in hot oil for 2 - 3 minutes on one side until golden and golden on opposite side. Turn meat, raise heat to high, and sear both sides until golden and caramelized. Remove from skillet and set aside. Remove all but 1 tbsp of the oil from the skillet, leaving about 1 tbsp of oil in it. Add ginger and serrano peppers to the hot oil in the skillet and cook, stirring constantly until aromatic. Return pork to skillet. Transfer the meat and juices to a fondue pot. Add sugar and cook, stirring until sugar dissolves. Remove from stove. Dip top of beef slices into fondue and arrange on a platter.

title: Veal Orzo Pilaf With Oranges and Brown Sugar
ingredients: 2 tablespoons anise seeds, crushed or 2 tablespoons ground anise, crushed | 1 lb ground veal ( i use extra lean ) | 1 cup uncooked orzo pasta | 1 large orange, peeled and section cut into thin strips | 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 1 1/2 heads medium heads escarole, washed and chopped | 1 large bell pepper, seeded and chopped | 2 teaspoons fresh orange rind, coarsely grated
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Sprinkle the crushed or anise seeds evenly over a 9x13 pan. In a 4 quart dutch oven, cook the ground meat until browned and crumbly. Drain off any excess fat. Return meat mixture to pot and cook over medium heat until it begins to brown and smell fragrant and hot. Add orzo and 1 1/2 cups cold water or enough to cover. Bring to a boil, stir, and then return to a boil. Cover and transfer to the oven and bake until orzo is tender, stirring every 20 minutes, about 30 minutes, and adding more water if necessary. Meanwhile, in another saucepan or a dutch oven, bring 2 inches or more of water to a boil, add the remaining ingredients and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until vegetables are slightly crisp. Serve over the pilaf. Serve with some additional orange zest.

instructions: Place the oil in a bowl and warm it over medium high heat. Add the onions and stir until they have turned a deep golden color. instructions: Stir the marinara sauce. Serve as a marinara sauce with chicken or beef.

title: Pasta With Beef and Peppers
ingredients: 1/2 lb round steak, diagonally sliced across the grain | 1 green bell pepper, sliced into thin strips | 1 teaspoon whole cumin seed | 1 teaspoon coarsely chopped parsley leaves | 1 cube chicken bouillon | 2 ounces natural quick cooking sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 12 ounces angel hair pasta, cooked and drained
instructions: Combine the meat, green pepper strips, cumin seeds, parsley, and bouillon in a large bowl, and refrigerate 30 minutes. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add pasta and cook, uncovered, until al dente, about 8 to 10 minutes. Drain cooked pasta and serve with cooked steak mixture.

title: Stufato Di Riso Verde (Rice Balls)
ingredients: 2 cups long-grain white rice | 1 1/2 cups pine nuts | parsley flakes
instructions: Combine rice, pine nuts, and parsley flakes in a small bowl and mix all ingredients together until thoroughly blended. Roll into 1 inch balls and place on a baking sheet. Bake in a preheated 350 degree f oven until lightly browned, 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

Random Ingredients: muenster cheese,curry leaf,cherry tomato,irish cream,red pepper
title: Irish Country Fare
ingredients: 1 teaspoon red pepper, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon curry leaves, finely chopped | 6 ounces muenster cheese, sliced | 1 cup cherry tomatoes | 1 ounce irish cream or 1 ounce cream
instructions: Mix pepper, curry leaves, and cheese. Place 1/4 the cherry tomatoes on each plate of cheese mixture and serve as the table dish.

title: Meatball Shrimp Tacos
ingredients: 4 ounces meatballs, thawed | 2 -3 slices tail-on back bacon, diced | 1 teaspoon harissa or 1 teaspoon hot sauce | 1 -3 chipotle salsa | 1 1/2 teaspoons fish sauce | 1 teaspoon dry mustard | 1/2 - 3/4 lb precooked shrimp ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients except shrimp in 1 quart saucepan. Cook over medium heat 2 - 3 minutes or until meat is opaque. Stir mixture and cook 2 minutes longer. Serve with reserved pan sauce.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,red chili pepper flake,flat leaf parsley,five spice powder
title: Spicy Barm Brandy Cookies
ingredients: 1 cup self-rising flour | 1 teaspoon five-spice powder | 1/8 teaspoon red chili pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Grease 2 nonstick cake tins. In a small bowl, combine flour, five spice powder and red chilli flakes. Stir in pepper. Add herbs and combine. Place 1 teaspoon of the dough on a greased baking tray. Use a round bladed biscuit or other flat rounded cookie cutter to mark your diving lines. Bake for 12 minutes or until golden. Cool on wire racks.

Random Ingredients: sunflower oil,star anise,red chili pepper,head cauliflower,date
title: Hot and Spicy Cauliflower
ingredients: 350 g small head cauliflower, cut into small florets | 120 g sunflower oil | 2 dried red chili peppers | 1 star anise, pod | 1 tablespoon chopped dates, seeds removed
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°c or 240°c if your cauliflower is large, cut into pieces. Place half the cauliflower florets in a roasting tin with 100ml/7fl oz water and cover well with foil. Bake for 20 minutes. Remove the tin foil and roast for a further 7 minutes. Remove the baking vegetables from the oven and dry on kitchen paper. Heat half the oil in a frying pan and add the chilli. Cook over low heat for 1 minute. Slit the star anise pod into two and bash lightly with a pestle or the back of a spoon. Add the other half of the oil to the pan and heat. Remove from the heat and add the ginger. Drain the cauliflower and place in a food processor. Process until smooth. Season with salt and pepper. Place the oil into a clean frying pan and cook over medium heat. Fry for 2 minutes to crisp the base. Remove from the heat and add the chilli mixture and dates. Stir until the sauce has a deep golden colour. Serve.

Random Ingredients: papaya,yogurt,feta cheese,beef chuck,orange juice concentrate,marinara sauce
title: Beef,Yogurt and Papaya Kabobs (Slow Cooker)
ingredients: 1/2 cup yogurt | 1/4 cup marinara sauce | 1/2 tablespoon orange juice concentrate | 1 lb boneless beef chuck, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 2 papayas ( halved and seeds removed ) | 1/2 cup feta cheese
instructions: Stir all ingredients in a 4 - 5 quart slow cooker. Cover and cook on-low setting 6 - 7 hours or high for 4. Remove beef and papaya pieces with a slotted spoon, leaving juice in pan. Reserve cooking juices. Cut beef across the grain into 1/2 inch pieces. Return beef, papaya and feta to cooker and stir. Continue cooking on high for 15 minutes to thicken sauce. Serve meat, garnished with a dollop of sour cream.

title: Grilled Zucchini with Croutons
ingredients: 8 zucchini, sliced | 1 pound fresh asparagus spears, trimmed | 1/2 cup dry bread crumbs | 12 small toasted bread crumbs for topping
instructions: Prepare grill for high heat. Oil the grill grate. Cook asparagus in a large pot of boiling water until tender crisp, about 5 minutes. Drain and transfer to ice water. Drain, then cool in cold water. Drain well, then slice into 1/4 inch thick slices. Place 1 or 2 asparagus spears on each one.

title: Rosemary and Caraway Seed Powder
ingredients: 2 teaspoons caraway seeds, crushed | 1/4 teaspoon dried rosemary
instructions: To crush the caraway seeds in a mortar or spice grinder, process seeds in the mortar until course powder. Combine the crushed seeds with the dried rosemary in a dish. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: raspberry,cardamom,yogurt,red wine vinegar,crabmeat,german chocolate,hot noodle,raspberry gelatin powder
title: Nuts and Glo
ingredients: 1 package raspberry gelatin powder, with seeds | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 2 cups yogurt | 1 cup shredded german sweet chocolate | hot cooked noodles | 1 cup chopped fresh raspberry | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 lb frozen cooked crabmeat, thawed
instructions: Lightly oil a jelly roll pan. In a small bowl, combine the raspberry gelatin powder, vinegar, yogurt, and german chocolate. Stir until smooth, cover and refrigerate overnite until it is set. Meanwhile, pour hot noodle into a strainer, and run cold water over it to cool it down completely. Drain well. Transfer the hot noodles to the bottom of the prepared jelly roll pan, add the cooked drained crabmeat, and cover with the jelly. Press a layer of plastic wrap onto the surface of the jelly that will absorb all the water. Let it set a few hours before serving to help the flavors develop. Chill before serving.

title: Hot and Cold Ramen Soup
ingredients: 16 ounces prepared ramen noodles, seasoning packet reserved | 6 cups red sweet peppers, chopped | 6 cups white sugar | 1 bunch fresh cilantro, minced
instructions: Pour the ramen seasoning packet into a large pot. Add red and green peppers, and sugar. Bring to a boil over medium heat, and stir frequently, cooking until the sugar is dissolved. Serve hot, and add fresh cilantro for garnish.

Random Ingredients: thai basil,broccoli,onion seed,grape,salt pepper,chuck roast,wild rice,garlic powder
title: Rick's Beef and Wild Rice
ingredients: 2 cups wild rice | 1 teaspoon salt and half pepper | 1 teaspoon coarse salt, plus more as needed | 2 lbs chuck roast, trimmed | 1 teaspoon onion seeds, crushed | 2 teaspoons dried minced garlic powder | 1 cup chopped fresh broccoli or 1 cup cauliflower | 1 cup chopped fresh thai basil | 4 cups sliced grapes
instructions: In a medium saucepan, simmer rice and 3 cups water on medium heat, uncovered, stirring occasionally, until water is absorbed, about 20 minutes. Drain rice and stir into beef and seasonings.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,celery,lettuce,self rising flour,rye bread,kidney bean,oat,green tomato
title: Cheesy English Muffins
ingredients: 8 ounces self rising flour | 7 ounces self-rising flour | 7 ounces rye bread or 7 ounces plain wholemeal bread | 7 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 1 tablespoon celery, chopped | 3 ounces bacon or 3 ounces sausage, cooked and crumbled ( i used a mild, fat free sausage ) | 7 ounces tomatoes, chopped | 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 2 tablespoons lettuce ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220 degrees celsius. Grease a muffin tin. Stir the flour, rye bread, cheese, celery, bacon / sausage, tomatoes and beans together to make a soft dough. Spoon half of the mixture into the prepared muffin tin. Stir the beans and the rest of the flour into the filling. The batter should be just slightly moist. Sprinkle the top with chopped bread crumbs or a good grinding of salt, if desired. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes until golden. Serve warm, with the optional garnishes.

title: Easy Red Beans, Italian Style
ingredients: 3 cans red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 jar marinara sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients, stir or shake frequently, and put into large freezer covered freezer bag.

Random Ingredients: onion,fine sugar,parmigiano reggiano cheese,spring onion,mustard seed,ziti pasta
title: Ziti with Spring Onions and Parmigiano-Reggiano Cheese
ingredients: 1 pound ziti pasta | 1 can sliced spring onions, drained ( optional ) | 1/4 cup finely chopped onion | 1/4 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 teaspoon mustard seed | 2 tablespoons dry finely chopped spring onion ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon fine sugar
instructions: Cook ziti according to package directions. While ziti is cooking, combine spring onions, onion, cheese, mustard seeds, and black pepper in a large bowl. Drain pasta well and toss with sauce. Taste and adjust seasonings. Garnish with chopped onion and grated parmigiano reggiano.

Random Ingredients: cherry tomato,napa cabbage,corn,back bacon,hard egg,head cauliflower,italian parsley
title: Roasted Corn and Cauliflower Salad
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, separated into florets | 1 head napa cabbage ( swiss cabbage, trimmed, cored and roughly torn into bite sized pieces ) | 6 slices back bacon, lean, chopped | 1 bunch fresh italian parsley, trimmed, chopped | 1 can corn, drained | 3 hard-boiled eggs, quartered | 1/3 cup dried sour cherry tomatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f place cauliflower, cabbage, bacon and parsley in a shallow roasting pan. Drizzle with the corn.

Random Ingredients: coriander,orange zest,extra sharp cheddar cheese,sauce,romaine lettuce,bread
title: Orange Bolognaise
ingredients: 6 tablespoons a.1. original sauce | 2 -3 tablespoons grated orange zest | 3 tablespoons dried coriander | 12 leaves inner romaine lettuce | 1 rind-free loaf frozen bread, cut into 8 pieces | 1 cup extra-sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees degrees. In a small bowl, mix the a1, orange zest, coriander, and the extra virgin olive oil. Wash and dry the lettuce leaves. Boil 4 cups of water over medium heat. Stir in the lettuce until tender crisp, but still crunchy, and not mushy. Drain, and toss with the cheese. Spread the bolognaise over the bread and serve.

title: Zucchini With Zucchini
ingredients: 1 small zucchini, peeled | 1 tablespoon olive oil
instructions: Slice zucchini in half and rub zucchini with olive oil. Set aside in refrigerator at least 1 hour to marinate. Bake in oven, 400 degree oven until zucchini softens a little. Serve right away.

Random Ingredients: thyme leaf,orange blossom water,salad oil,gin,salami,irish cream,grain mustard,chili garlic sauce
title: Prawn Prawns
ingredients: 240 g pink prawns, prawns in the shell ready peeled | 1 tablespoon salad oil | 2 tablespoons chili-garlic sauce | 2 tablespoons orange blossom water | 1 tablespoon finely chopped thyme leaves | 1/2 cup gin | 1 tablespoon grain mustard ( gluten free if required ) | 1 tablespoon irish cream
instructions: In a small bowl whisk together sugar, the orange blossom water, chili garlic sauce, mustard and irish cream with a fork until sugar has dissolved. Add the prawns and toss to coat. Spread the prawns in a single layer on a plate or rimmed baking tray.

title: Kielbasa Filling for Fish
ingredients: 1 package frozen blueberries | 8 ounces kielbasa | bread crumbs | 1 red chili pepper, diced | 2 teaspoons corn oil, or as needed
instructions: Blanch the blueberries for 30 seconds, drain and set aside. Cut kielbasa into 1 inch pieces, or slices about 1/4 inch thick. If the blueberries are not quite thawed, microwave for about 2 minutes to soften. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Mix the bread crumbs, red chili pepper, and corn oil in a bowl. Coat the kielbasa with the bread crumb mixture. Line a baking sheet with foil. Bake the kielbasa for 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until golden brown and crispy.

title: Spinach and Pumpkin Patties
ingredients: 1 can pumpkin | 1 teaspoon vanilla bean | 2 pita bread | 1 tablespoon chopped peanuts | 1 cup chopped fresh spinach
instructions: Drain pumpkin and cut in 2 inch lengths. Heat up pita bread and spread out on the table. Toast patties either by spooning over the pita or you can broil them if you prefer. Spread with oil then place patties on it. Spread seeds in a design to simulate pineapples then add 1 tbsp nuts. Sprinkle chopped spinach on top.

title: Habanero Jelly
ingredients: 5 pounds habanero peppers | 8 cans lemon juice, or as needed
instructions: Blend habanero peppers with lemon juice in a blender until smooth. Pack habanero mixture into clean sterile cans. Fill a large pot with water, and stir the habanero juice mixture into the water to reach the top of the jar. Bring the water to a rolling boil, and boil the jars until sealed and beginning to extract liquid, 10 to 12 minutes. Ladle hot jellies out of the jars, and place on a cloth covered cookie sheet to cool.

title: Homemade Lemon Chips
ingredients: 2 tablespoons corn oil | 1 teaspoon lemon extract
instructions: Combine oil and lemon extract. Apply to chips and cover. Allow to sit for 30 minutes.

title: Nam Pla for Selines
ingredients: 6 slices white bread | 1/2 lb linguine, cooked & kept warm | 1/2 lb fresh sweet vermicelli or 1/2 lb spaghetti, cooked & kept warm | 1 1/2 cups nam pla or 1 1/2 cups sugar | 2 tablespoons nam pla | 3/4 teaspoon baking soda | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried citron peel
instructions: Preheat oven to 250°f. Place bread in a large bowl of cold water and soak until soft, about 2 - 3 minutes. Cut bread into small chunks and set aside. Cook pasta in large pot of boiling water for 3 - 4 minutes, until al dente. Drain. Immediately remove pasta from the pan and keep warm. Reserve 1/2 cup for later use. Bring 4 quarts of lightly salted water to a boil. Drop in linguine and cook for about 5 minutes or just until pasta is al dente. Drain all but a little of the pasta liquid. Transfer linguine to a colander and set aside. Add noodles into boiling water and cook until tender but still firm. Drain and place in large mixing bowl. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Chill for several hours, or overnight, until ready to serve. This is best served the next day at room temperature.

title: Shrimp & Chocolate Sundae
ingredients: 500 g raw shrimp, peeled, deveined and butterflied | 350 -500 g chocolate ice cream | 2 teaspoons fresh ginger, grated
instructions: Place the shrimp in the freezer, and process until they are smooth. Spoon into individual sundae glasses, cover with plastic wrap, then leave for 4 minutes. Pour the peanut butter and half of the grated ginger on top, pour the rest of the grated nutmeg over and serve.

title: Pantry Kidney Beans and Onions
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans | 12 -16 large white pearl onions | 12 -16 large green chilies
instructions: Pour cans of kidney beans into 4 quart dutch oven or 6 quart crock pot. Slice onions into thin strips then add to beans. Cover and cook on hi for 5 hours. Use cooking spoon to stir well. Use a slotted spoon to serve on spanish bread, toasted bagels or tostado chips. These can be frozen and reheated in preheated toaster oven if you want to make the party size party size servings.

title: Basic Falafel
ingredients: 1 tablespoon yellow whole wheat flour | 3 whole black mustard seeds | 3 1/2 cups canned chickpeas
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large bowl & mix well using hands to mix thoroughly. Cover & set aside in refrigerator for at least 15 minutes.. Place the mixture on a greased and floured cutting board & cut into smallish pieces using a pasta machine or in the food processor. Form your fingers into round, flat disks with the tips of your fingers, then shape them into flat disks about 3 in diameter. Cook on a heated griddle over a medium heat for about 5 minutes per side then move the disks around gently using the flat of your mitts. Keep a watchful eye while cooking so they don't burn.

Random Ingredients: red potato,lard,poppy seed,yellow cornmeal,deli roast beef
title: Slow Cooker Roast Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 tablespoon lard, divided | 1/2 pound thinly sliced deli roasted beef | 1 cup yellow cornmeal | 2 red potatoes, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 1 tablespoon poppy seeds
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of the lard in a skillet over medium low heat. Cook and stir beef until well browned. Remove beef and set aside. Combine cornmeal, potatoes, and remaining 2 tablespoons of lard in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: feta,tagliatelle pasta noodle,beef tenderloin steak,sunflower seed
title: Beef Tenderloin with Sunflower Nuts
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sunflower seeds | 1 teaspoon dried minced beef tenderloin steaks | 2 tablespoons sunflower seed oil, divided | 6 ounces tagliatelle pasta noodles
instructions: Place sunflower seeds in a food processor with 1 teaspoon of sunflower seed oil. Spread on a tray and toast in oven at 220 degrees celsius for 10 minutes, stirring once, until golden and fragrant. Rub sunflower oil onto steak. Place steak in a roasting tin, cover and refrigerate for an hour. Bring a pan of water to the boil and cook tagliatelle in the boiling water for 5 - 6 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,clam,chocolate,nut,lemon juice,white rice,cream cheese,plain flour
title: Lemon Chocolate Cheesecake
ingredients: 250 g white rice, cooked | 150 g sour cream, room temperature | 300 g soft cream cheese | 150 g grated chocolate | 1/2 teaspoon white vinegar | 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 250 g minced clams | nuts
instructions: Combine the cheese grated and chocolate in a bowl. Add the vinegar, lemon juice and cream cheese. Gently fold all ingredients together. Spread into your base lined with greased, lined tin. Add the minced clams. Garnish with dried/mint sprigs.

Random Ingredients: angostura bitter,lard,cranberry,extra virgin olive oil,crouton,red wine
title: Pain Perdu (French Potted Cranberry Wine)
ingredients: 1/2 cup crouton | 3 ounces lard | 11 ounces cranberries, soaked ( preferably frozen ) | 3 tablespoons red wine | extra virgin olive oil | angostura bitters ( or other brandy based sweetener of your choice )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Toast the breadcrumbs in oven until lightly colored. Drain and set aside on the rack to cool slightly. Combine the crumbs with the lard and cranberries. To serve, place in small ramekin dishes. Pour some of the pan juices over the top, then drizzle an extra virgin olive oil and bitters over all. Garnish with a drizzle of bitter.

Random Ingredients: pork bouillon cube,mustard,black bean,banana pepper,soymilk,anchovy,olive oil
title: Baked Cuban Banansas
ingredients: 1/4 cup olive oil ( the olive oil will make it more spicy, like extra virgin olive oil ) ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon mustard | 1 3/4 cups black beans ( frozen is fine ) | 1 beef bouillon cube ( or a vegetarian cube ) | 2 -3 anchovies ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups soymilk or 1 1/2 cups almond milk | 2 -6 ripe bananas ( for more color, try a combination of yellow ones and green bananas )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Place the olive oil, mustard, beans, bouillon cube and anchovies in a bowl and beat until well combined. Drain the beans and stir into the bowl, adding plenty of soymilk or almond milk. Dump into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Top with banana peppers. Bake at 350 degrees for 20 - 25 minutes, or until the banana peppers are tender in the middle. Serve warm or cool. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Beef Milkshake (21 Day Wonder Diet : Day 1 )
ingredients: 300 g lean rump steak | 85 g low-fat strawberry yogurt | 20 g low-fat sour mix | 2 teaspoons cornstarch | 2 teaspoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained and chopped
instructions: Trim any excess fat from the steak and cut into 3/4 diagonal strips. Put the steak and sour cream together in a medium bowl.

Random Ingredients: bean sauce,tuna,celery seed,shell pasta,taco seasoning mix,cornstarch
title: Tuna Pasta
ingredients: 12 ounces shell pasta | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 can refried beans | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1/2 teaspoon celery seed | 1 can tuna, drained
instructions: Cook the shell pasta in boiling water according to package directions on box. Drain and set aside. In a small bowl, mix cornstarch, hot bean sauce, taco seasoning, celery seed and tuna. Add to pasta, tossing to coat. Serve warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: spinach,sesame oil,tarragon,cauliflower,sun tomato,green bell pepper,lemon grass
title: North African Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, cut into florets | 1 bunch spinach, trimmed | 1 green bell pepper, cut into strips | 2 sun-dried tomatoes, torn into strips | 1 teaspoon lemon grass, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon
instructions: Place the cauliflower, spinach beans and sun dried tomatoes in a large bowl. In a small bowl, combine the lemon grass, sesame oil and tarragon. Drizzle over the vegetables and toss to coat. Serve immediately.

title: Seafood Tacos
ingredients: 1 can crabmeat, drained | 1 can diced green chile peppers | 1 medium red onion, chopped | 3 teaspoons diced veal
instructions: Prepare the crab meat by combining the crabmeat, green chile peppers, red onion, and veal in a bowl. Cover, and refrigerate overnight before serving.

title: Vanilla and Vanilla Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 1/2 3/4 cups cauliflower florets | 1 cup vital wheat gluten | 1 cup vanilla bean
instructions: Blanch the cauliflower in boiling water in a large pot. Set aside to cool until warm to the touch. In a small bowl mix the vanilla bean and wheat gluten together until well combined, use your imagination and mix the dough thoroughly. In batches, add 2 tblsp of flour to each batch and knead each batch on the lightly floured surface until the dough begins to hold together. Cut dough into 1 sections using a 3×4 inch cookie cutter or drinking glass, cover and let rest in a cool place for 30 minutes. Take the dough and flatten evenly on a work surface or lightly oil a nonstick griddle. Place 1/2 cup of the vanilla bean mixture in the center of the dough, add 1/2 cup of water and fold in the edges. Place in the griddle and cook until the crust is golden and the filling is slightly browned about 2 minutes. Remove and let rest for about 5 minutes. Serve with ice cream.

Random Ingredients: green curry paste,oyster mushroom,cooking oil,tahini,eggplant,clove,sourdough bread
title: Eggplant Curry With Mushrooms
ingredients: 20 slices sourdough bread | 1 eggplant | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 2 teaspoons green curry paste or 1 -2 teaspoon curry powder | 2 teaspoons roasted tahini | 6 tablespoons oyster mushrooms | 1/2 teaspoon whole cloves
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 c. Cut 2 slices of bread large enough to fit bread on the baking tray. Remove thick outer skin from bread using an egg, and discard butak. Cut remaining 2 slices on the diagonal. Put mustard on top, and leave well for 5 minutes. Coat slices with cooking oil. Bake on both sides in oven for 5 minutes, then turn and bake for another 3 minutes. Cool and cut diagonally into fingers. Slice eggplant into 1 slices on a diagonal, then fry until crispy. Set aside. In a microwave safe container add curry paste, tahini and oyster mushrooms. Microwave on high for approximately 1 minute, then remove from the microwave. Place slices of bread in a single layer on a serving plate, and add curry mixture. Place eggplant fingers on it, then serve with dipping sauces of your choice.

title: Camarones a La Ruben - Stuffed Fajitas
ingredients: 2 medium zucchini, halved lengthwise and hollowed out | 1/2 cup bottled tequila, or to taste | 1 canned chipotle pepper, seeded and chopped ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground cayenne pepper ( optional ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons minced lime zest | 1 pinch msg ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven's broiler and set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Line a rimmed baking sheet with reynolds wrap nonstick aluminum foil. Arrange the squash halves on the prepared baking sheet. Brush squash halves with the tequila and sprinkle with black pepper, cayenne, lime zest and optional msg. Broil in the preheated oven until the tops of the grilled squash are golden brown and tender, about 5 minutes. Allow to cool slightly. Serve warm.

title: My Kebab
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried tomato | fresh ground lamb or lamb fat | freshly chopped flat leaf parsley or parsley, to sprinkle
instructions: Soak the dried tomatoes in boiling hot water for 10 - 15 minutes, then squeeze out the excess water. Crush with a mortar and pestle or a large wooden spoon. Stir in most of the lamb fat, and the parsley or other optional ingredients for seasoning, and refrigerate for about an hour. Thread the meat onto skewers. Cook under a hot grill for about 20 seconds on each side, or until cooked as desired. Serve warm or room temperature.

title: Tart Shell Beer Can Filling for Tacos, Bread Fritters and Dipping
ingredients: 2 cans tart shells, drained ( i use king refill barrel sams ) | 3 tablespoons lime zest | 1 1/4 cups tbsps liquid smoke ( or other smoke product )
instructions: Pour the lime rinds into the canning canning jar with the liquid smoke and mix well. Put the canning funnel the canning funnel in canning funnel and fill jar with beer canning water until it reaches one half of the canning funnel. Place canning funnel in canning funnel into tins or pint jars. Bake at 225 degrees for 5 - 7 minutes, stirring halfway through.

title: Zucchini Whip
ingredients: 2 zucchini, sliced lengthwise | 3 yellow peppers, sliced | 3/4 cup light sour cream | 2 tablespoons dried fruit pectin crystals | paprika | lime wedge ( to garnish ) | cheese ( to garnish )
instructions: Scoop out seeds from zucchini. Heat 2 tblsp. Of water in a nonstick skillet. Add squash, cook until tender, about 5 minutes. Drain. Cool slightly. Process zucchini, peppers, sour cream, pectin, and paprika in a food processor until smooth, about 1 minute. Fold in reserved zucchini. Garnish with lime wedges and cheese.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,chinese noodle,basil,mango chutney,buttermilk,texas toast bread,sugar
title: Chinese Bread Salad
ingredients: 3 cups cooked white and wheat texas toast bread, 1/2-inch cubes | 2 cups chinese noodles, 1/2-inch cubes or | 1 cup mango chutney | 2 teaspoons sugar | 2 teaspoons white wine vinegar | 1 cup buttermilk | 1/4 cup chopped fresh basil ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients except basil in medium bowl.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,sugar ice cream cone,dark sesame oil,chipotle chile
title: Sesame-Chipotle Pulled Pork with Ice Cream cone & Sweet Chips
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1 chipotle chile, seeded, minced | 4 pork shoulder, trimmed, sliced diagonally into 1/4-inch-thick pieces | 3 tablespoons sugar-free ice cream cones, crushed
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of the oil in a large, heavy pot over medium high heat. Add the chipotle chile and pork.

title: Chile Tomato Jam
ingredients: 3 lbs plum tomatoes, chopped ( about 2 lbs ) | 1 teaspoon red chile, crushed
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a heavy saucepan.

title: Asparagus and Potatoes in a Potato Boat (Warm Potato and Asparagus)
ingredients: 5 potatoes | 2 lbs fresh asparagus, trimmed
instructions: Fill a large pot with water, add potatoes, bring to a boil, and cook over high heat until potatoes are tender, about 15 minutes. Drain, and transfer to a bowl, keeping hot. Peel and cut asparagus into 3 pieces. Cover asparagus with cold water, bring to a boil, and cook over medium heat until tender crisp, stirring frequently, about 10 minutes. Drain. Arrange asparagus in the top 1/3 of a large platter. Drizzle potatoes over asparagus.

title: Hoshi Soba (Japanese Ham Noodle Soup)
ingredients: 1/2 1/2 lb lamb or 1/2 lb pork roast, minced | 1/4 cup miso | 2 teaspoons miso | 6 -8 fresh thyme sprigs | 2 teaspoons pumpkin puree | 3/4 lb egg noodles or 3/4 lb fettuccine
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine the minced pork, miso paste and miso paste. Stir to combine. Add the thyme and pumpkin. Bring to a simmer, then cover, and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, or until pasta is tender. Add salt and pepper to taste, but do not overstir. Serve hot over hot cooked egg noodles or fettuccine.

Random Ingredients: single cream,beef gravy,poblano pepper,fennel,cream corn,wheat flour,strawberry
title: Corn Blanche
ingredients: 2 cups whole wheat flour, sifted | 1/2 lb cream corn | 1 cup single cream | 6 strawberries, hulled and sliced | 4 poblano peppers, seeded and chopped | 1 -3 ounce beef gravy | 1 small fennel, sliced into rings
instructions: Combine flour and 1 cup of water in a glass bowl and knead for a few minutes. Divide in half, shape half into balls, flatten balls into discs. Cover with a damp cloth and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Beat the cream corn with the cream and blend well. Heat oven to 400f degrees. Working on 1 pastry disc, place the blanched pastry disk on a lightly floured surface. Roll out the remaining pastry disc on the same flour. Roll out 2nd pastry disc on a lightly floured surface. Use a second pastry disc to continue rolling up the same way, using a third pastry disc. Repeat with the remaining pastry discs. Place the blanched pastry discs onto a well greased large baking sheet and bake on the center rack of the oven until the disks are beginning to brown and crisp, 7 to 10 minutes. Turn off the oven. Set the blanched pastry disks aside to cool for 10 minutes. Wash the blanched pastry disc well, and remove the outer layer of pastry dough. Remove the outer layer of pastry dough. Carefully peel back the white skin from the blanched pastry disks. Place the blanched pastry disks onto a baking sheet. Carefully spread the cream cream corn mixture on top, being careful not to leave any of the excess corn mixture on the surface. Add berries to the cream corn mixture, and sprinkle with the fennel rings. Using a sharp knife, cut the blanched pastry disks on the diagonal into thin slices. Arrange on a tray and refrigerate until the slices have chilled and are ready to serve.

title: Hot Dog Toasts
ingredients: 4 slices texas toast thick bread, 1/2 inch thick | cheddar cheese can also be dotted over the top
instructions: On a plate or cookie sheet, spread the 4 slices of texas toast with hot mustard like we just do for each american. Spread the 2 slices of bread with the hot mustard. Sprinkle with the cheddar cheese. Microwave on high 3 minutes, stirring every few seconds, until the cheese starts to melt somewhat. Serve immediately.

title: Fusilli D' Angelo III
ingredients: 2 cans halved and pitted green olives | 1 pint half-and-half cream | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano
instructions: Mix olives, half and half, and oregano together in a bowl.

title: Harmon's English Seven Hour Coffee Couscous
ingredients: 2 cups instant couscous | 1 cup black coffee | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon sesame seed
instructions: Combine the couscous and black coffee in a measuring cup. Sprinkle the mustard and sesame seeds on top, then pour water or coffee over.

Random Ingredients: superfine sugar,grapeseed oil,simple syrup,salami,flour,oyster sauce,chicken bouillon granule
title: Oriental Pizza-Style Salami
ingredients: 1 lb sliced salami | 1/2 cup light golden syrup | 1/2 cup superfine sugar | 1 tablespoon poppy seed oil | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon granules | 1/4 cup oyster sauce | 1/2 cup very light roux for dredging
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Mix all ingredients together and coat a baking sheet. Spread batter for a pizza using the thin layer of the prepared pizza dough. Bake for about 20 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is well heated through. Spread pizza toppings of your choice on the hot pizza to your liking and enjoy.

title: Slow Cooker Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 3 tablespoons reduced-fat margarine | 1 tablespoon honey | 1 teaspoon vodka | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/2 teaspoon sesame seeds | 4 lbs chuck roast | 1/2 package frozen small red cabbage, thawed
instructions: Melt margarine in skillet. In a small bowl combine honey, mustard, cinnamon and sesame seeds and spread on both sides of roast. Place roast in crockpot with cabbage and mustard mixture. Cook on high 3 - 4 hours, remove beef and cabbage and keep warm. Add liquid and remaining ingredients and cook on high for 15 minutes or on low for 5 hours, or until meat is tender. Remove meat and discard the cinnamon and sesame seeds mixture.

title: Crispy White Potatoes
ingredients: 2 pounds white potatoes, peeled, sliced and quartered | 1/2 cup tea, or as needed | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1/4 cup prepared ranch dressing
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place potatoes in a large pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil, then cook in the preheated oven until tender, about 25 minutes. Drain the potato, and transfer to a mixing bowl. Pour 1/2 cup of tea into the bowl, then beat in the almond extract. Stir in the potato cubes until coated. Spread potato mixture evenly in the pan, then sprinkle with the ranch dressing. Bake in the preheated oven until crispy and browned, 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Avocado Asparagus with Asparagus #5FIX
ingredients: 3 avocados, halved and pitted | 1 bunch fresh asparagus, trimmed | 2 tablespoons virgin olive oil
instructions: Mash avocados together into a smooth consistency using a garlic press or a potato masher. Stir in asparagus and continue to mash. Drizzle olive oil over avocado mixture. Transfer to serving dish and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,thyme,french green bean,spanish onion,sunflower oil,fava bean
title: Green Beans With French Green Beans
ingredients: 400 g french style green beans | 4 tablespoons sunflower oil | 8 sprigs thyme | 1 small spanish onion, sliced | 1 large fresh banana, sliced thinly | 1 can fava beans
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Line a baking tray with non stick baking paper. Cut the green beans in half lengthways but do not cut right through. Rinse the string from the ends of the beans, then put them together in a bowl with water to cover. Cover and leave them to soak in the water. Heat the oil in a large frying pan and fry the sprigs of thyme for 3 - 4 minutes, stirring often, until they are crispy and beginning to brown lightly. Add the onion and banana. Lower the heat and fry for 5 minutes, stirring regularly, until both are golden and just tender. Add the beans and water to cover. Cover the pan and put in the oven. Check after about 40 mins for tenderness and check when the liquid has reduced to a thick, thick sauce, adding water if necessary. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: rosemary,self raising flour,spanish onion,blackberry,pepper sauce,green chilies,splenda sugar substitute
title: Savory Blackberry Scones
ingredients: 2 cups self-raising flour | 4 tablespoons splenda sugar substitute or 4 tablespoons sugar | 1/4 teaspoon pepper sauce | 1/2 cup spanish onion, chopped | 1/2 cup green chilies, chopped | 1/2 cup blackberries, washed and chopped | 2 teaspoons rosemary, chopped
instructions: Pre heat oven to 425°f or 180°c mix the ingredients together. Roll out into a circle of approximately 12 diameter on a lightly floured surface. Cut into 12 wedges. Place on a lightly greased oven tray. Bake 25 minutes. Serve hot with melted butter and chopped onion and/or sprinkle with chopped chilies.

title: Triple Sec and Lime Soup
ingredients: 3 cups vegetable stock ( stock cubes are traditional ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons triple sec, plus more for seasoning
instructions: Pour the vegetable stock in a heavy bottomed frying pan. Bring it to a simmer over medium high heat then add the tri sec. Stir to blend, then increase the heat to high and boil for two minutes, stirring constantly. Remove from the heat and let the soup stand for five minutes. Strain through a sieve and check for seasoning..

title: My Easiest Egg Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 10 ounces egg noodles | 1 small red onion, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon rice ( i use converted, i use red )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. Cook the egg noodles according to the package directions. Drain and add the rice to the cooked noodles and onion. Mix well. Pour into a greased casserole dish and bake for 30 to 40 minutes until golden brown.

title: Mexican-Style Papaya Salad
ingredients: 4 papayas | 3 medium ripe mangoes | 3 ounces prosciutto, cut into thin strips | 1 passion fruit | 3 tablespoons mirin | 1 tablespoon sweet chili sauce | 1 teaspoon paprika | black pepper, freshly ground | chili powder, freshly ground
instructions: Peel the papayas, mangoes and prosciutto. Trim off any pith around the fruit and peel the fruit if desired. Cut the fruit into 2 inch pieces. Halve and pit the mangoes. Slice into 1 inch cubes. Mix all of the ingredients, except pomegranate seeds, in a large bowl. Cover and refrigerate until serving. To serve, divide the fruit among 4 small bowls, top with pomegranate seeds and chilli powder.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,vermouth,milk,tofu,baking potato,tuna olive oil,rosemary leaf
title: Tuna Potato Cake
ingredients: 4 medium baking potatoes ( about 2 pounds ) | 2 1/2 cups milk | 1/2 cup vermouth | 1/2 cup chopped fresh rosemary leaf | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1 can tuna in olive oil, drained | 1 package thin firm tofu, cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f grease a 12 cup bundt pan and set aside. Peel potatoes and cut each potato on the mandoline into 4 wedges. Place wedges in a colander, rinse with boiling water, drain and pat dry with paper towels. Dry with plastic wrap and set aside. To make potato cakes, toss the potatoes with the milk, vermouth and rosemary.

Random Ingredients: tea,white zinfandel wine,bay leaf,beef bouillon granule,lemon zest,caraway seed,chili paste
title: White Zinfandel
ingredients: 5 tablespoons teabags or 5 tablespoons white zinfandel wine | 2 teaspoons instant beef bouillon granules | 1 teaspoon grated lemon zest | 1/4 teaspoon caraway seed | 1/4 teaspoon dried chili paste ( such as chipotle or a chile in adobo ) | 1 bay leaf | 3/4 cup strong brewed white zinfandel or 3/4 cup other heavy red table wine
instructions: Pour the teabags into a 5 quart nonaluminum saucepan set over medium heat. When they start to sizzle, add the wine into the pan, stirring to dislodge any brown bits from the bottom of the pan. Stir in the bouillon, lemon rind, caraway, chile paste and bay leaf. Bring to a boil. Add the zinfandel, uncovered. Simmer partially covered until the zinfandel starts to thicken, about 30 minutes. Remove the pan from the heat. Ladle immediately into a serving bowl, reserving about 1/4 cup of the cooking liquid. Swish the wine into the wine. Allow to cool to room temperature. Transfer the zinfandel to a glass serving bowl, cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 2 - 3 days or until the brand is used. The zinfandel can be kept in the refrigerator for up to 1 month.

Random Ingredients: dark corn syrup,white chocolate,swiss cheese,radish,poblano chile
title: Chocolate Swiss Cheese Nachos
