ingredients: 2 lbs fresh swiss cheese, cubed and at room temperature | 1/4 cup dark corn syrup | 12 poblano chiles, roasted in oven | 1 small radish, sliced and quartered | 1/3 - 1/2 cup of shredded dark chocolate
instructions: Place the swiss cheese in a large bowl. Pour in the corn syrup and mix until thoroughly combined. Using a pastry brush or the side of a kitchen shears, lightly toast the chiles under the broiler. Turn over the chilies just so they become slightly softened and dark brown on the edges of the chiles. Remove them from the oven and let them cool for about 3 - 5 minutes. Use a slotted spoon to transfer the chiles to a plate. Place the ramekins onto a cookie sheet covered with aluminum foil. Warm the wok over low heat and add 1 tbsp of the butter. When the butter is heated, add the poblanos, radishes and the chocolate and stir the mixture until well coated. Place the chiles in a paper bag, press out as much air as possible and keep at room temperature until ready to eat. Serve them hot.

Random Ingredients: milk ricotta cheese,jalapeno pepper cheese,icing sugar
title: Jalapeno Pepper Spread
ingredients: 1 container whole-milk ricotta cheese, well drained | 2 ounces finely chopped jalapeno peppers ( about 20 peppers ) | 1 teaspoon icing sugar
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together the ricotta and 1/4 cup of the jalapenos. Fold in the remaining jalapenos and the icing sugar. Spread into a 9 inch round cake or other shallow, golden, rectangular shaped dish. Refrigerate overnight, or freeze for up to 5 days. When ready to serve, slice and serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf italian parsley,taco meat,cilantro,shrimp,ranch dressing mix,watercress
title: Party Shrimp Taco Feast
ingredients: 1 lb medium shrimp | 1 ounce dry ranch dressing mix | 1/2 cup finely chopped cilantro | 10 leaves watercress, stemmed | 1/2 bunch flat-leaf italian parsley, stemmed | 2 packages taco meat, warmed
instructions: Combine shrimp, ranch dressing mix, cilantro and watercress in a large bowl. Toss until shrimp are well coated. Transfer to a large serving bowl or platter. Serve with taco fixings. Recipe tips, to prepare a small dinner salad, adjust ingredients for taco salad according to the direction directions on the salad dressing and amount of salad dressing used. The best recipes make this meal the easy way. Prepare the taco salad as directed on the package. Serve with warm tortillas as an appetizer.

title: Mexican Halibut With Beans, Onions, and Chocolate
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs halibut | 4 ounces white pearl onions | 1/2 lb pinto beans | 8 ounces dark chocolate | 1 medium chicken, shucked | 16 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Remove pin bones from halibut with a knife. Slice the halibut into thick slices on the horizontal, 1 inch thick. Arrange pieces of halibut on a sheet of foil. Peel and quarter onions. Pour the oil over chicken and vegetables. Spread the chocolate. Arrange pieces of halibut over the chocolate. Wrap the foil around the halibut completely. Bake for 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: french bread italian,brown sugar,chicken thigh,worcestershire sauce,water
title: Chicken Fingers
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread, cut into 1/4 inch slices and toasted | 2 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs | 1/2 cup brown sugar | 1/2 cup worcestershire sauce | 3/4 cup water
instructions: Lightly salt and pepper the bread slices. Spread the cut sides with the brown sugar. Place chicken thighs on top. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over meat. Place in a foil lined baking dish or cookie sheet. Place dish or cookie sheet on an oven setting. Bake at 375 degrees about 1 hour or until tender. Serve with sauce and french bread.

Random Ingredients: pie crust,monterey jack pepper cheese,monterey jack cheese,turmeric powder,steak,beef bouillon,parsley
title: French Canadian Flank Steak
ingredients: 1 1 lb round steaks | 1 1/2 quarts beef bouillon | 2 1/4 lbs monterey jack pepper cheese, shredded | 2 ounces monterey jack pepper cheese, shredded | 3 tablespoons parsley, chopped | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 2 lbs pie crust
instructions: Dissolve bullion in 4 cups water and boil, set aside. Peel the beef and cut it into 1 inch cubes, place in a casserole pot, pour bouillon over, cover. Heat on high for one hour and 20 minutes, until the beef is browned on all sides, remove and discard the bones and any juice from the casserole, boil meat with 1 cup flour, 2 cups water, spices for 5 minutes or until it is tender. Cool for 5 minutes. Set aside. Roll out crust, line a 9 inch pie plate with the crust, cut a slice off the bottom layer of bottom crust and line with cheese. Mix the cheese with 2 tblsps of parsley and mix them together well with the meat. Pour meat mixture over the cheese and top with other crust slice, seal edges with fingers. Bake at 325°f for 45 minutes, cut in squares before serving.

title: Roasted Beef (Dry ) With Black Pepper
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs lean roast, bone in | fresh ground black pepper
instructions: Wrap meat tightly in foil.

title: Crock Pot Beef Pesto Brownies
ingredients: 1/3 1/3 cup beef broth or 1/3 cup water, more if needed | 1 package pre-baked brownie mix ( recommended ( ritz ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried rosemary | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1 cup firmly packed grated coconut | 2 teaspoons dried scallions ( optional ) | 1 jar pesto sauce | 2 ounces unsweetened cocoa, preferably dutch's drinking cocoa
instructions: In crock pot, combine beef broth, brownie mix, rosemary and cardamom seeds. Cover and cook on low heat setting for 3 1/2 to 5 hours or until meat temperature reaches 150 degrees f. Remove and let cool slightly. Cut meat into 1/8 thick pieces and return to crock pot. Add coconut, scallions and cheese.

title: Bacon and Asparagus Stir Fry Recipe
ingredients: 600 g fresh asparagus spears | 4 slices bacon bits | 200 ml sherry wine | 1 cup beef broth | 4 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 tablespoon fresh coriander, chopped
instructions: Slice the asparagus spears in half lengthways and remove the hard base. Wrap each half with a slice of bacon. Repeat with remaining asparagus and set aside. In a medium sized frying pan heat your grill. Toss the asparagus in the oil for a few minutes on each side until golden. In a jug combine the sherry and beef broth. Mix, add to the pan and simmer on a medium heat for 2 - 3 minutes. Add the horseradish and tarragon and serve the stir fried asparagus on the side.

Random Ingredients: kahlua,serrano chilies,self rising flour,polenta,chili,aleppo pepper,granny smith apple,head cauliflower
title: Smooth Curli
ingredients: 6 ounces polenta | 6 ounces self-rising flour | 4 ounces strong beer ( i used elle caffe ) | 1 ounce kahlua | 2 ounces chili ( aji mirasol aka mexican chili powder or equivalent ) | 10 ounces granny smith apples, cut into chunks | 1/2 head cauliflower, cut into florets | 1 serrano chilies, sliced in thin rings
instructions: Make the batter, mix all the batter ingredients, except the cauliflower & chile. Put this in an airtight container or in a freezer for later use. Boil cauliflower until tender, drain. While cauliflower is cooking, mix all the sauce ingredients together, except the chile, in a skillet, heat until warm, add chile to your sauce and stir until hot.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,white flour,beef tenderloin steak,garam masala powder
title: Mughlai Naala
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin steaks, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 2 tablespoons white flour | 1 teaspoon garam masala powder | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Cut steak into 1 1/2 inch cubes, dust with garlic powder. Heat oil in skillet over medium high heat. Add beef.

title: Garlic Lemon Garlic Bread
ingredients: 4 cups garlic ( peeled, coarsely chopped ) | 3 cups light olive, pitted and chopped | 1/4 cup finely grated lemon zest
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. In a large bowl stir garlic, olive oil, and lemon zest till combined. Press mixture into loaf pan and bake 45 - 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,habanero pepper,ginger paste,corn flake crumb,dill,barbecue sauce,chicken bouillon
title: Chicken Dipping Sauces in a Jar
ingredients: 16 large boneless skinless chicken breasts, or more to taste | 1 jar barbecque sauce | 1 teaspoon grated fresh ginger paste | 1 teaspoon bottled grated fresh habanero pepper | 1 teaspoon dark soy sauce | 1 teaspoon minced fresh dill | 1/2 cup corn flakes crumbs, or as needed
instructions: Peal, then halve, or cut each half into four pieces. Make three slashes on each piece, 1/2 inch deep. Combine barbeque sauce, ginger paste, habanero pepper, soy sauce, dill, and corn flakes. Pour the dipping sauce into a jar, filling the holes with ice. Seal, and refrigerate 8 hours to set.

Random Ingredients: broccoli,onion,bread flour,chili powder,beef stew meat,icing sugar,fennel
title: Beef With Broccoli
ingredients: 4 teaspoons soft bread flour | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 1/2 lb beef stew meat, cut into 3 cm cubes | 1 kg broccoli, cut into 3 cm pieces | 1 onion, chopped | 1 ounce icing sugar | 1 fennel, sliced | 1/2 cup coriander, coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Combine the flour and chilli powder in a wide, shallow ovenproof dish. Add the beef in equal quantities and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for 3 hours or overnight. Remove beef from the refrigerator. Cook the broccoli in a pan of boiling water for 4 - 5 minutes or until bright green and slightly tender. Meanwhile, cook the onion in a pan over medium heat, stirring, for about 5 minutes or until tender. Return beef to pan. Stir in the cheese, coriander and sugar, adding more sugar if mixture is too dry. Cover and return to the oven for about 1 1/2 hours or until meat is very tender.

title: Aussie Rice
ingredients: 2 cups cooked quinoa ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 1/2 cup jimmy dean sausage, chopped | 1/4 cup cooking oil | 1/4 cup yogurt
instructions: Toss quinoa, sausage, and oil in a 2 quart casserole. Bake at 325 f for 15 - 20 minute serve with yogurt.

Random Ingredients: beef rump roast,chipotle chile,red chile flake,cremini mushroom,chili,baby spinach,white mushroom,spring onion
title: Pressure Cooker Beef With Shiitake Mushrooms and Spinach
ingredients: 3 lbs lean boneless beef rump roast, fat trimmed | 4 ounces cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1/2 lb baby spinach, washed | 9 ounces baby portobello mushrooms ( shiitake ) | 1 ounce fresh red chile, sliced | 12 small white mushrooms, cleaned | 3 cups prepared pressure cooker mushrooms | 1/2 cup chopped spring onion | 3 whole dried red chile flakes
instructions: Slice the beef into 1/4 by 1/4 slices. Cut the mushrooms in half from stem to bottom. Place the mushrooms and spinach into the pressure cooker with an adequate amount of water to just cover. Put the whole dried red chile into the cooker. Add half the beef. Close the lock on the pressure cooker and cook at pressure for 4 minutes. Then, do the same with the remixed spices and the rest of the beef. Close the lock on the pressure cooker and serve once the pressure indicator on the cooker reads 180°c / meat thermometer reads 140°c / meat thermometer. Allow to cool and serve warm. To make fresh mushrooms, remove the stems of any of the mushrooms and slice into half from stem to bottom. Heat a deep pot with a drop of oil on medium high and dry roast the mushrooms for 5 minutes at medium high heat. When it’s half crispy, remove it. Set aside. Add a quarter cup of water to the pot and bring to a boil. Add the mushrooms and cook for 3 - 4 minutes. Turn over and cook for 2 minutes. Drain well and serve. Note, the mushrooms can be replaced with regular mushrooms and any other kinds of mushrooms and can be found at asian markets. The mushrooms can also be saved in the pressure cooker after pressure is out of date. Note, mushrooms can be replaced with baby shiitake and canned mushroom slices or fresh baby shiitakes.

Random Ingredients: peanut butter,water chestnut,chicken breast,kalamata olive,salsa,icing sugar,orzo pasta,basil pesto
title: Napa Dave's Mexican Chicken and Orzo
ingredients: 6 boneless skinless chicken breasts, each about 3 ounces | 1 jar salsa | 1/4 cup orzo pasta, rinsed | 1/8 cup salted butter, melted | 1/4 cup water chestnut, drained and sliced | 1/4 cup kalamata olive, pitted and sliced | 1/3 cup basil pesto | 2 tablespoons icing sugar, sifted
instructions: Place chicken between 2 sheets of waxed paper, and pound with a meat pounder or rolling pin to an even thickness. Combine salsa and orzo in a bowl.

title: Spicy Chipotle Linguine
ingredients: 1 package linguine, cooked and drained | 1/3 cup green olives, cut into quarters | 2 green onions, sliced | 3 1/2 ounces hot chipotle peppers, in sauce | 1 jar spaghetti sauce
instructions: Place cooked linguine, olives, green onion, and chipotle peppers in baking dish. Stir together and pour over noodles. Cover with plastic wrap and bake at 350°f for about 30 minutes.

title: Italian Herb Blend Mix
ingredients: 1 tablespoon allspice, ground | 1 tablespoon dried parsley, dried
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the allspice, dried parsley, and ground cardamom. When blending is complete, pour contents of spice bag into a bottle or container to store. Stir well before using. Store mixture in a cool, dry place.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,lemon zest,cashew,green bean
title: Lemon Sprinkle Green Beans With Cashews
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 tablespoons lemon zest, finely grated | 3 tablespoons cashews ( i prefer cashews ) | 350 g green beans
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Pour vegetable oil in a bowl, then combine with grated zest and cashews. Spread beans in a single layer into a 7 x 11 inch glass baking dish. Spray green beans with vegetable oil, then bake for 10 minutes or until just tender, then scatter with extra cashews.

title: Alaskan Salmon
ingredients: 4 large skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 4 skinless, boneless salmon fillets | 4 cups frozen edamame, thawed | 8 cups dry salted butter, melted
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place chicken breasts in a large baking dish. Bake 25 minutes in the preheated oven, until juices run clear. Baste chicken with melted butter during the last 10 minutes of cooking. Place the salmon fillets and cooked edamame over the cooked chicken breasts. Bake 15 minutes in the preheated oven. Serve with idahoan style mashed potatoes on the side.

title: L'houghman's Hot Chile Powder
ingredients: 2 cups vegetable broth | 3 cups green creme de menthe
instructions: Combine the broth and creme de menthe in a small saucepan or heavy skillet over low heat. Heat until the mixture is hot. Remove from the heat.

title: Irish Cocoa
ingredients: 1 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 3 tablespoons good quality irish whiskey | 9 -10 fresh italian herb | cumin seeds, toasted and crushed
instructions: Melt chocolate, whiskey and cumin seeds in a heavy small to medium sized saucepan over low heat, stirring regularly, until melted and well mixed.

Random Ingredients: italian breadcrumb,baby red potato,baby spinach,meat,msg,black olive
title: Solo Meatball Soup (Buca Di Beppo)
ingredients: 2 lbs lean meat, ground | 2 cans baby red potatoes, drained ( about 1 1/2 pounds ) | 4 cups loosely packed baby spinach | 2 cans sliced black olives, drained | 1/2 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon msg ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients through msg. Form into 1 inch meatballs. Add to soup and cook over medium heat 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,italian bread,thai chile,white potato,soya sauce
title: Potato Crostini  (Potatoes Stuffed With Celery & Soya)
ingredients: 400 g white potatoes | 150 g celery ribs | 1/2 cup soya sauce | 1 teaspoon thai chile | 2 tablespoons italian breadcrumbs or 2 tablespoons of dry breadcrumbs
instructions: Peel potatoes, chop into chunks & boil in their skins until very soft, then drain well. Chop celery into chunks & boil in their skins for 5 minutes, then mix with soya sauce & chili. Tear italian bread crumbs in half & press into potato mixture, then coat with italian bread crumbs. Place the potato mixture in a pot on top of the potato mixture & mix well with hands. Put on a cookie sheet covered in tin foil & bake at 200c for 5 hours.

title: Texas Roast Beef
ingredients: 1 pound cooked roast beef | 1/3 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Open the roast and place on a dish. Mix together the cooked beef, cilantro, and hot sauce. Spoon the roast mixture over the meat. Roll the dish with the roast into a tightly covered container. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 3 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: farfalle pasta,brown rice,ketchup,plain nonfat yogurt,jalapeno chile pepper,grain rice,ginger root
title: Konkan's Noodle Bowl
ingredients: 1 cup long grain rice | 2 cups plain nonfat yogurt | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 1 tablespoon brown rice | 1 tablespoon minced fresh ginger root | 1 tablespoon minced pickled jalapeno chile pepper | 1 1/2 pounds farfalle ( bow-tie ) pasta
instructions: Place rice in a bowl, and cover with several inches of cool water. Let sit 30 minutes. Drain off water, and let sit until cool. In a large bowl, mix yogurt, ketchup, brown rice, ginger, and jalapeno peppers. Pour the rice mixture over the yogurt mixture, and gently fold in the farfalle. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin steak,hot red chili pepper,chocolate,tarragon vinegar,mustard paste,gruyere cheese,spaghetti
title: Hot Chocolate Beef Filets
ingredients: 4 beef tenderloin steaks, fat trimmed | 1/4 cup mustard paste, preferably dijon-style | 2 tablespoons tarragon vinegar | 5 ounces gruyere cheese, cut into 4 wedges | 12 -16 ounces spaghetti or 12 -16 ounces linguine, cooked | 2 tablespoons hot red chili peppers, sliced | 1/2 cup shaved semisweet chocolate
instructions: Mix mustard paste and vinegar and brush over meat. Let sit on counter 15 minutes, then sprinkle with cheese. Cook pasta according to directions. Divide among 4 serving plates and top with chili and chiles. Drizzle with remaining mustard mixture.

title: Rajma and Lentils
ingredients: 1 cup lentils | vegetable stock or chicken broth
instructions: Wash and pick over the lentils so they dont dry out.

title: Tortilla Eclairs
ingredients: 100 g chickpeas | 100 ml buttermilk | 1/2 teaspoon sesame oil
instructions: Rinse and drain chickpeas. Tear soaked chickpeas into small, manageable pieces. Stir buttermilk and sesame oil into chickpeas. Form 12 flat, thin, narrow, narrow tortillas. Cook over low heat in the microwave for 10 seconds, flip and cook on reverse side for 5 - 10 seconds until heated through and slightly crisp. Serve immediately, or store in plastic bag in fridge until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: stew meat,red pepper,picante sauce,ketjap manis,white bread,english muffin,sesame oil
title: Chef John's Beef Sizzle Sandwich
ingredients: 3 tablespoons picante sauce or 3 tablespoons ketchup | 3 tablespoons sesame oil | 3 tablespoons dry red pepper | 1 tablespoon dehydrated red pepper ( i used jarred roasted red chili peppers ) | 500 g stew meat | 1 1/2 tablespoons ketjap manis | 1 english muffin, split and toasted | 4 slices white bread
instructions: For dressing, combine picante sauce, sesame oil, red chili peppers, and dehydrated red pepper in a medium bowl. Cover and set aside. Trim excess fat from meat. Cut stew meat into 1 cubes. Heat grill or barbecue grill pan to high. Sprinkle stew meat with mixture. Sprinkle ketjap manis over meat. Grill or barbecue meat, or place on grill rack above pan. Baste occasionally with dressing. Let meat stand 5 minutes on rack. Cut bread into four triangles. Spread triangles with dressing. Place bread in a large, shallow bowl. Place meat, toasted bread pieces, 1/4 of the fried red pepper mixture and 3 tablespoons of the ketjap manis in an open faced glass, preferably with the crust in tact. Place sandwiches on grill pan. Close lid and grill for 8 to 10 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Garlicky Cream
ingredients: 1 cup whipping cream | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1/4 teaspoon dried marjoram
instructions: In a medium bowl, whip cream until soft peaks form, then fold in cornstarch and marjoram. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours.

title: Low Fat Ricotta Salata With Veggies (Vegan-Friendly)
ingredients: 1 cup low-fat soymilk | 1/2 cup water chestnut, finely chopped | 1 hard-boiled egg | 1/3 cup fat-free ricotta salata or 1/3 cup chopped ham | 1 tablespoon coriander or 1 tablespoon basil | 1/8 teaspoon horseradish | 2 medium zucchini or 2 regular zucchini, sliced | 1 cup shredded cabbage
instructions: Boil soymilk, water chestnuts and egg in a medium nonstick skillet for 3 minutes or until egg is set, cool slightly. Meanwhile, in small bowl combine the remaining ingredients. Toss well with chilled egg. Refrigerate covered until ready to serve with veggie sandwiches.

title: Pumpkin Ham and Pork Chops
ingredients: 1 can pumpkin puree | 1 pound pork chops, cut crosswise into 1/4 inch slices | 4 ounces country-style crumbled fried ham, divided | 2 loaves frozen bread dough, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly oil a 9x13 inch baking dish. In a heavy pot, mix pumpkin puree with pork chops and 1/2 of the fried ham. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until pork is browned and stuffing is hot, about 5 minutes. Transfer stuffing to a bowl and stir in remaining ham.

title: Smoked Apricot, Mushrooms and Green Pepper Dip
ingredients: 2 packages cream cheese, room temp | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder | 2 small shiitake mushrooms ( or regular mushrooms ) | 1 - 1 1/2 cup apricot, chopped ( drained canned apricots, may substitute fresh fruit ) | 1/2 cup green pepper, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon dried herbs, mixed with
instructions: Heat cream cheese, coriander & mushrooms in microwave for 30 seconds.

title: Tamarind Noodle Sandwich
ingredients: 12 ounces refrigerated cheese tortellini ( baguette style ) | 2 1/2 cups frozen lima beans ( cooked ) | 6 tablespoons tamarind pulp | 3 tablespoons vinegar | 14 1/2 ounces condensed tomato puree | 12 slices of thick quality aged cheese tortellini
instructions: Cook the tortellini according to the instructions on the package, except do not overcook them. Add the lima beans, tamarind pulp, vinegar and tomato purée to the saucepan and warm, then heat the mixture to boiling. Meanwhile, tear tortellini into thin slices, but with a few slices of cheese.

title: Easy Chicken
ingredients: 3 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 2 bags fresh spinach, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Pound chicken to 1/4 inch thickness. Lay chicken in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Cover both sides of the chicken breast with spinach. Use toothpicks to tie together the toothpicks. Pour 1/2 the remaining marinade into a saucepan. Bring to a boil, and simmer for 5 minutes, or until chicken juices run clear. Arrange in the baking dish. Cook in the preheated oven for 40 minutes, basting occasionally with the remaining 1/2 the marinade. Stir once, and serve.

title: Barbecue Tempelette With Sum Sum Dumplings
ingredients: 12 choy sum | 1 1/2 cups barbecue sauce | 3 tablespoons ketchup | 14 ounces frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Thaw 8 of the choy sum leaves in the refrigerator. Rinse out your hands. Cut the choy sum into 1 1/2 inch lengths. Put 1 1/2 cups of the barbecue sauce in a saucepan. Add the choy sum and bring to the boil, then reduce the heat to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes or until the water has evaporated. Transfer the mixture to a bowl. Cool slightly, then stir in the ketchup, and thawed whipped topping. Pour into another bowl and leave to set. Cut into 10 wedges. Serve with your favourite meat sauces. Recipe courtesy of the ultimate australian australian australian barbecue sauce by jean christian jury on australian jury website, or by barra kelly on australian jurymuscider website, or by barra elison jurymuscider website, and click on the advertiser’s sugar content basis for 25, 000 visit the advertiser’s sugar content basis for 1 minute.

title: Cretons
ingredients: 1 pork butt | 6 ounces gelatin | 2 tablespoons capers | 1 -2 whole wheat tortilla | 2 burrito-size whole wheat tortillas or 2 corn tortillas
instructions: Cut the pork in thin strips and place into a large frying pan with the juices over medium heat. Cook until the fat has rendered about 1/3, then remove from the heat. In a saucepan, heat up the gelatin using 1/3 2/3 cup of water, and add to the meat and juices. Cook just until the gelatin has melted, then stir in the capers. Warm the tortillas in the oven until warm, then slice them down the center, then set the slices in a plate. Spoon the meat and/or cheese mixture onto the tortillas, fold one and a quarter piece of the tortilla over them, and roll and eat.

Random Ingredients: olive oil,red curry paste,greek seasoning,red wine,clove
title: Red Curry Blend
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 1 teaspoon olive oil | 1/2 teaspoon clove | 1 teaspoon sweet red wine, such as cabernet sauvignon or 1 teaspoon red wine | 1/2 teaspoon dried greek seasoning
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl. Blend well. Add curry to 1/2 cup water and blend well. Store unused portion in an air tight container.

title: Aarti Naan
ingredients: 250 g low-fat plain yogurt | 15 g ginger-garlic paste | 100 g blue cheese, shreaded
instructions: Slightly mix together yogurt and ginger garlic paste. Add grated blue cheese and mix well. Add 1 - 2 tbsps. Of warm water to help curdle the yoghurt. Put back on the stove and take off heat. Take a round ceramic dish or oven tray with a pouring lip. Pour a teaspoonful of the curdled yoghurt on it. Sprinkle with a mixture of red and yellow food colour. When the yoghurt on the ceramic dish is nicely set, cut into pieces with a knife and serve.

title: Beef Soup Mix II
ingredients: 2 whole celery ribs, trimmed | 2 tablespoons beef broth
instructions: Combine celery rib bones, and beef broth in slow cooker. Cover, and cook on low 8 hours. Allow to cool, and skim off any fat, if desired. Store in refrigerator overnight to prolong seasoning.

Random Ingredients: wine,wheat spaghetti,brussels sprout,malibu rum,unagi glaze,button mushroom,malt vinegar
title: Malibu Prawns With Pasta
ingredients: 200 g whole wheat spaghetti | 3 cups mixed mushrooms | 225 g mussels sprouts | 25 g belgian-flavored malt vinegar | 125 g wine or 125 g sparkling coffee | 1 tablespoon malibu rum | 2 tablespoons white balsamic vinegar
instructions: Boil, steam or microwave pasta until al dente.

title: My Favourite Crockpot Chicken Legs
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken legs ( or use pieces i bought and precooked ) | 1 jar hot alfredo sauce ( i've also used pace ) | 2 tablespoons mexican oregano ( dried oregano )
instructions: Take the chicken legs and cut off any excess fat. Using a sharp knife or a mandolin to cut the legs in half if the leg is too large cut them in half for the desired size size. Repeat this with the garlic, until all the chicken legs are cut in to the same sections. If using chicken breast make sure they are cut 1 inch at the thick end of the leg and then with a sharp knife or very thin slice it lengthwise and then across again for all pieces. Then using the knife and cutting the garlic to cut the slices in to the same sections it is easier to cut them that way. Put everything into your crockpot with the olive or other side of the stove and turn the heat on to high. Turn crockpot to low if your crockpot won't take a full hour on high. Cooking times are long depending on size of chicken you buy.

Random Ingredients: apricot brandy,cilantro leaf,orange peel,salad leaf,dill pickle,cauliflower
title: Cauliflower With Apricot Nuts and Pickles
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower or 1 head cabbage, cut into 2-inch florets | 1 tablespoon thinly sliced orange peel | 1 tablespoon snipped fresh dill pickle | 1 tablespoon chopped cilantro leaf | 1/4 cup apricot brandy or 1/4 cup orange juice, heated | 1 tablespoon salad leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f degrees. Spray a 12x8 inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Place half of the cauliflower in the dish, then sprinkle with half of the orange slices and pickle slices, then half of the cilantro leaves. Repeat layers, ending with pickle slices on top. Combine the nuts with any remaining liquid and brandy in a small bowl. Serve sprinkled with remaining cilantro.

Random Ingredients: garlic pepper seasoning,fruit,clam juice,tamarind paste,malt vinegar
title: Deviled Clams from Iceland
ingredients: 1 1/2 gallons bottled clam juice | 1 cup malt vinegar | 1/8 cup tamarind paste | 1/2 cup crushed dried mixed fruit | garlic pepper seasoning
instructions: Bring clam juice to the boil in a large pot. Stir in vinegar, tamarind paste, and crushed fruit. Simmer 10 minutes. Place in jars, and process in a bath for 10 minutes. Remove from heat, and seal.

title: Creamy Beef Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1 package fresh iceberg lettuce, washed and trimmed | 1/2 cup nonfat sour cream | 1/2 cup low sodium beef broth | 1/3 cup vanilla sugar
instructions: Place lettuce in a medium sized bowl. Combine the sour cream, broth and vanilla sugar in a small sauce pan over medium low heat. Simmer until the liquid has reduced, 3 to 5 minutes. Pour the cream mixture over the lettuce and mix gently to soak. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Italian Baked Vegetables
ingredients: 3 zucchini | 3 carrots | 2 boxes pepperoni | 6 -8 ounces evaporated milk
instructions: Cut zucchini, zucchini, and carrots into eighths or chunks. Cook according to packet directions. While cooking, heat remaining milk according to instructions on packet. When vegetables are almost done, preheat oven to in large greased ovenproof casserole dish place pepperoni on top so that they do not stick. Carefully pour in the warm milk mixture. Top with pepperoni. Cover and bake in oven approx 30 minutes. Serve with warm pasta.

title: Butternut Squash and Mustard Bark
ingredients: 24 ounces butternut squash, peeled and grated | 1/2 cup yellow mustard, such as dijon | 1/4 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Combine the grated butternut squash and mustard in a bowl. Sprinkle with chocolate chips. Spread prepared mustard over the top. Bake for 40 to 50 minutes, until set.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,raspberry,black vinegar,creole seasoning,spring onion,almond extract
title: French Cheese With Raspberry and Black Dressing
ingredients: 16 ounces raspberries, quartered | 1 -2 spring onion, minced | 1 -2 tablespoon black vinegar | 1/8 ounce creole seasoning ( chef's choice ) | 1 tablespoon hazelnut extract ( chef's choice ) | grated emmenthaler cheese
instructions: Place raspberries and onions in a saucepan. Deglaze with black vinegar. Add creole seasoning and hazelnut extract. Dip raspberries and onions into raspberry mixture. Grate emmental on top. Refrigerate for 5 hours.

title: Crock Pot  Chicken Kebabs
ingredients: 2 tablespoons andouille sausage, ground | 1 1/2 teaspoons goatpea flour ( or use a 1/2 tbsp. flour and mix together with a fork ) | 5 ounces red cabbage, shredded | 1/2 cup canned chickpea flour ( optional ) | 5 ounces portabella mushrooms, sliced | 1/2 medium red cabbage, shredded | 2 ounces dried dates
instructions: Combine ground sausage and goatpea flour or other dry spices in a bowl. Add mushrooms and red cabbage, stirring to combine. Place on a cutting board and slice diagonally into pieces 3 inches long and 1/2 inch wide. Mix all ingredients together. Add bread slices and mix together.. If there is any dry spices, use 1/2 cup of water. Allow to sit for 5 - 10 minutes so the gluten can absorb the flavors. If using bread flour, do not add extra water. Pour onto a parchment lined tray. Broil for 4 - 5 minutes or until golden. Remove to a plate. Repeat for all remaining pieces. Note, prep and cooking times do not include time to cook.

title: Chow Mein
ingredients: 1 carrot, grated finely | 250 g chow mein noodles ( chinese mustard noodles )
instructions: Combine noodles and carrot, and serve immediately.

title: Indian Mustard
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dry white wine vinegar | 1 cup peanut oil or 1 cup ghee | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together. You may add some mustard powder to the mixture to help it get a smooth, slightly translucent consistency. Add as much or less mustard as you like depending on how much you like it.

title: Garlic Rice
ingredients: 1 cup jasmine rice | 4 cups white sugar | 4 ounces dried onion flakes | 1 cup minced clams | 3 tablespoons caster sugar ( superfine sugar )
instructions: Fry the onion and clams till fragrant and clams open around the edge. Bring water to boil and add rice. Boil for 20 minutes till almost dry. Stir in sugar and cook for an additional 3 minutes.

title: Authentic Mexican Cheese Chicken
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs of fresh chicken meat | 1 lb of a mexican cotija cheese, crumbled
instructions: Place the chicken in a skillet. Pour about a quarter of a cup of hot water into the skillet. Dip the chicken in the hot water. Turn the pieces over until all sides have been. Place the chicken in the skillet. Place the cheese on top of the chicken. Cover and cook over low heat for about 3 hours or until the chicken is very tender and the cheese bubbles.

title: Chinese Sweet Watermelon Candy
ingredients: 1 cup watermelon | 1 teaspoon chili paste, or to taste | 1/8 teaspoon kosher salt | 4 ounces unsweetened chocolate
instructions: Combine the watermelon and chili paste in a bowl.

title: Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 tablespoon paprika | 1 tablespoon dried fenugreek seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried greek oregano | 1/2 tablespoon peanut butter | 1 pork tenderloin
instructions: Combine paprika, fenugreek, oregano, peanut butter in a shallow dish. Add pork and turn so both sides coat. Cover, and refrigerate at least 2 hours, or overnight. Preheat grill. Oil grill grate, or line with aluminum foil. Lightly oil cooking grate. Place pork on grill, and cover. Cook 10 minutes, or to desired doneness.

title: Salsami (Salsamole)
ingredients: 1 cup dried sliced anaheim chilies | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained | 1/2 cup quick-cooking sherry
instructions: Combine chilies, water chestnuts and sherry in a blender or food processor.

title: Pesto & Chilli Pasta
ingredients: 200 g plain flour | 1 tablespoon prepared pesto sauce | 1 tablespoon coarse grain mustard | 1 clove crushed garlic
instructions: Use 2 spoons to scrape the flour into a large bowl. Stir in the pesto & mustard and garlic. Turn out the flour mixture onto a board & make a well in the centre. Pour in the pesto mixture, knead and shape into a ball. Repeat until all the pesto has been used up & there are 1 cm thick discs of pastry. Roll out onto a lightly floured board & cut into 8 rounds. Place on a lightly greased oven tray, brush with a little melted butter and bake in a moderate oven for 20 minutes or until golden.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,pork,savory,chicken,cauliflower floret,cold water,black pepper,vanilla ice cream
title: Cauliflower Cheese Burritos
ingredients: 6 cups chicken or 6 cups vegetable broth | 1/2 lb ground pork | 1/4 cup fresh savage, chopped | 1 cup cauliflower floret, chopped | 3 cups cold water | 3 tablespoons cold water | 1/2 teaspoon ground black pepper | 4 -9 tablespoons prepared low-fat devil's cheese flavored pastry dough | 6 -8 puff pastry sheets, thawed
instructions: Bring broth and pork to boil in 2 quart saucepan.

title: Easy Strawberry Pesto Oxtail & Fresh Strawberries
ingredients: 2 lbs oxtails | 2 lbs berries, frozen | 1/2 cup basil pesto | 1 teaspoon dried sage | 2 slices cardamom pods, cracked | 3/4 cup lemonade
instructions: Spray large, heavy skillet with cooking spray. Heat on medium high until it begins to simmer. Season the oxtails with salt and pepper. Remove oxtails and sear on both sides using a wide, flat knife. Add berries and stir. Add the 1/2 cup pesto and the sage. Add the oxtails back to the skillet. Add the cardamom. Simmer for 45 minutes over low heat until the oxtails are tender and easily pierced with fork. Remove from heat and serve right away. Refrigerate leftovers for another use. Enjoy.

title: Beef Gravy
ingredients: 1 beef bouillon cube | 2 cans bean paste
instructions: In a large stock pot or pressure cooker or a heavy bottomed pot, heat about 1/2 the stock pot or pressure cooker to boiling point with a few drops of water. Drop in the bouillon cube and fry off the bouillon cubes to flavor them. Add the bean paste and simmer for another 10 minutes, or until the sauce thickens slightly.

Random Ingredients: red lentil,lemon peel,purpose flour,oyster sauce,pesto sauce,grain white rice
title: Lentil Rice and Pesto Flatbreads
ingredients: 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 tablespoon grated lemon peel | 1/2 cup red lentil, rinsed | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce | 3 tablespoons cold steel cut long grain white rice | 1/3 cup prepared and wild pesto sauce
instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine the flour, lemon peel, lentils, and pesto. Add rice and stir until evenly moistened. Set aside. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Coat a flatbread iron with vegetable oil spray and line the cookie sheet with parchment paper. Spread the rice mixture evenly on the cutout. Bake for 10 - 12 minutes. Allow to cool slightly and then spread each flatbread with about 1 tablespoon of pesto so that the pesto is completely covered. Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: rice flour,panch phoron black mustard,bacon,vodka,walnut half,white bread
title: Panch Phoron Dill
ingredients: 4 2 slices white bread or 2 slices rye bread | 1/2 cup paprika toast ground with parsley or 1/2 cup a mix of both | 1 stick bacon, sliced 2-inch x 1/4-inch strips | 1 tablespoon coarsely ground walnut halves ( optional ) | 6 tablespoons rice flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons white dry mustard | 1/2 cup vodka
instructions: Lightly toast bread or toast rye. Remove from pan and dry thoroughly. Mix together the paprika, salt and mustard and spread onto bread. Add bacon, ground walnuts or a drizzle of melted butter. Wrap up and place in refridgerator for an hour. Remove from fridge and serve hot. Note, prep time does not include soaking up all the liquid in the pan. If the bacon dries out add up to 1/2 cup of water. Note, if using rye, rye will need only an hour or two to rehydrate. The meal can also be stirred back into the liquid as needed. Enjoy note, for rye, add the ground mustard and vodka.

title: Mika's Simple Sweet-Sour Matzo Bread
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups matzo meal, divided | 1/2 cup frozen cut green bell pepper, thawed | 1/2 cup shredded cooked green bell pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix together 1 1/4 cups matzo meal and yellow bell pepper. Mix in red bell pepper. Transfer to a baking sheet coated with cooking spray. Spread green pepper mixture, 1/4 cup at a time, into 1 inch thick round slices. Bake in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until toasted.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,butter bean,chive,rice,pineapple chunk,oyster sauce,pesto sauce
title: Oysters Rockefeller Rice
ingredients: 2 cups instant rice or 2 cups cooked rice | 3 cups dry kidney beans or 3 cups cooked green beans | 1 can pineapple chunks, reserve liquid | 1 can unsalted butter beans | 1 tablespoon pesto sauce | 1 tablespoon chives | 1 tablespoon pine nuts, toasted
instructions: Cook rice, beans, pineapple and half of butter beans in a saucepan over medium heat or until heated through. Add other half of butter beans, then stir in the basil, pesto and chives. Serve topped with toasted pine nuts.

title: Brisket in Salt
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs beef brisket ( with a good amount of fat on top ) | 2 garlic cloves, smashed | 2 tablespoons snipped fresh chives ( or scallions ) | 2 tablespoons snipped fresh chives ( or scallions ) | 2 slices prosciutto ( or crumbled goat cheese )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300f.

title: Pumpkin Cocktail
ingredients: 30 ml cointreau liqueur | 15 ml prosecco wine | fresh herb, of your choice | 1 pinch pumpkin pie spice
instructions: Pour cointreau and prosecco into a tall glass.

Random Ingredients: cod,filet beef,yellow pea,coconut,dill,thai red curry paste,soy sauce,onion powder
title: Thai Beef With Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 onion, diced | 4 ounces cod, chopped | 1/3 cup yellow split peas, fresh | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 2 teaspoons thai red curry paste | 2 teaspoons snipped fresh dill | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 1/2 cup shredded coconut
instructions: In nonstick frypan cook onion in 2 t oil over medium high heat for 5 minutes or until tender.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,sugar,golden syrup,matzo meal,catsup,chicken breast,gouda cheese,tahini sauce
title: Chicken Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 chicken breast, cut into thin strips | 1/4 cup catsup | 1 tablespoon light golden syrup | 1 teaspoon dry tahini sauce | 1/2 teaspoon sugar | 8 flour tortillas | 4 slices aged gouda cheese, cut into strips | 1/4 cup matzo meal
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange a 9x13 inch baking pan in two layers. In a bowl, combine the chicken, catsup, golden syrup, tahini, and sugar. Pour half of chicken mixture onto a tortilla, and roll into a tight cylinder. Transfer to the prepared baking pan. Spread the top of the tortilla with the cheese strips. Repeat with the remaining tortillas and filling, placing them in the pan as you roll. Cover the pan with foil, and bake for 30 minutes. Remove the foil, remove the tortillas, and sprinkle with matzo meal.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,chicken stock,beef stock,courgette,garlic salt,sun tomato oil
title: Baked Beef Soup With Garlicky Roasted Vege
ingredients: 600 g fresh aubergines or 600 g frozen zucchini | 1 1/2 liters chicken stock | 2 liters beef stock | 3 -4 cloves garlic salt | 4 -8 slices sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, soaked in hot water for 10 mins, and drained, and then roughly chopped | 1 cup shredded mexican blend cheese or 1 cup grated cheddar cheese ( to garnish )
instructions: For the aubergines, bring the stock, aubergines or chunky squash, garlic salt and sun dried tomatoes to boil in a large saucepan or microwave, then reduce to medium low and simmer until the aubergines or zucchini are tender. Meanwhile, preheat oven grill or gas mark 6 and lightly oil the inside of a 5 cup capacity ovenproof casserole dish or tin. Remove the aubergines to a plate lined with paper towel. Cut off the ends and slice into chunks. Return to the pan, add the aubergines or chunky squash and simmer for 10 - 15 mins, then add the beef stock and simmer until the soup thickens. To serve, top with the grated cheese and sprinkle over some extra sun dried tomatoes. Serve with extra parmesan if desired.

Random Ingredients: egg yolk,basil,emeril essence,lettuce leaf,grain wild rice,beef brisket,sauce
title: Emeril’s Ultimate Brown Rice
ingredients: 1 bag long grain and wild rice blend, such as uncle ben's | 1/4 cup steak sauce | 1 tablespoon emeril's essence | 1 tablespoon dried basil | 1 tablespoon granulated sugar | 1 large egg yolk | 1 medium lettuce leaf | 1 cup hot cooked beef brisket, sliced
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. While rice is cooking, combine steak sauce, emeril's essence, dried basil, and sugar in a small bowl and set aside. Whisk egg yolk in a small bowl. Drain rice from the bag and toss with remaining steak sauce mixture and reserved steak sauce mixture. Place salad greens in a serving bowl. Spread rice on a large platter. Surround rice with salad greens. Garnish with meat slice. Note, i use a large brisket or rack of butcher's twine when buying brisket, the weight will be a lot less than normal.

title: Orange Marmalade Bell Pepper Soup (Crockpot)
ingredients: 2 large golden bell peppers | 2 medium yellow onions | 2 red chiles, stemmed | 10 cups broth ( broth made with sodium nitrite in a cube can ) | 1 cup orange marmalade
instructions: Chop bell peppers and onions finely. Transfer to crockpot. Place chiles and broth over the top. Cook, covered on low for 10 hours. Remove chiles. Purée using a stick blender or food processer and serve hot.

title: Littleneck Clam Chowder or Chicken Soup
ingredients: 1 lb chicken thighs or 1 lb chicken breast, cubed | 8 cups tomato juice | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 1/2 - 2 cups cooked littleneck clams, drained with liquor
instructions: Combine with remaining ingredients in a large pot and allow to boil, uncovered, to cook until most of the liquid has cooled and the flavors have blended, at least thirty minutes or more.
